tathā phena piṇḍa upamam rūpam vedanā budbuda upamā marīci sadṛśī saṃjñā saṃskārāḥ kadalī nibhāḥ māyā upamam ca vijñānam uktam āditya bandhunā evam dharmān vīkṣamāṇaḥ bhikṣuḥ ārabdha vīryavān divā vā yadi vā rātrau saṃprajānan pratismṛtaḥ pratividhyet padam śāntam saṃskāra upaśamam śivam iti

etāḥ ca gāthāḥ sarva nikāya śāstra sūtreṣu paṭhayante atas phena piṇḍa ādīnām hetu pratyaya sāmagrīm prāpya pratītya samutpannānām sāra vastu vigatānām kutas kṣaṇikā kṣaṇika cintā iti mahāyāna sūtreṣu ca su pinā upamā bhava gatī sakalā na hi kaści jāyati na caḥ mriyate na ca karma naśyati kadāci kṛtam phalu deti kṛṣṇa śubha saṃsarataḥ na ca śāśvatam na ca uccheda punaḥ na ca karma saṃcayu na ca api sthitiḥ na ca saḥ api kṛtva punar āspṛśatī na ca anyu kṛtva puna vedayate yathā kumārī supina antarasmim sva putra jātam ca mṛtaṃca paśyati jāte ati tuṣṭā mṛti daurmanasyitā tathā upamān jānatha sarva dharmān

yathā eva grāma antari lekha darśanāt kriyāḥ pravartanti pṛthak śubha aśubhāḥ na lekha saṃkrānti girāya vidyate tathā upamān jānatha sarva dharmān mudrāt pratimudra dṛśyate mudra saṃkrānti na ca upalabhyate na ca tatra na ca eva sā anyatas evam saṃskāra anuccheda śāśvatāḥ bījasya sataḥ yathā aṅkuraḥ na ca yaḥ bīju sa ca eva aṅkuraḥ na ca anyu tatas na ca eva tat evam anuccheda aśāśvata dharma tā yatha muñja pratītya balbajam rajju vyāyāma balena vartitā ghaṭiyantra sa cakra vartate teṣu ekaikasu na asti vartanā tatha sarva bhava aṅga vartinī anyam anya upacayena niśritā ekaikeṣu teṣu vartanī pūrvam aparāntatu na upalabhyate

atas eva uktam ācārya nāgārjuna pādaiḥ svādhyāya dīpa mudrā darpaṇa ghoṣa arka kānta bīja amlaiḥ skandha pratisaṃdhiḥ asaṃkramaḥ ca vidvadbhiḥ upadhāryau iti śatakaśāstre ca ārya deva pādaiḥ mahā bodhi caryā sthira prasthāna sthitaiḥ alāta cakra nirmāṇa svapna māyā ambu candrakaiḥ dhūmikā antar pratiśrutkā marī ci abhraiḥ samaḥ bhavaḥ iti

tat evam bimba pratibimba ādi nyāyena mātuḥ kukṣau vijñāne saṃmūrcchite vijñāna pratyayam nāma rūpam niṣicyate kṣarati prādurbhavati iti arthaḥ yadi iha gatau vijñānam na saṃmūrchitam syāt tadā nāma rūpa prādurbhāvaḥ na syāt saced ānanda vijñānam mātuḥ kukṣim na avakrāmeta na tat kalalam kalala tvāya saṃvarteta iti vacanāt

tat evam niṣikte nāma rūpe tu ṣaṣ āyatana saṃbhavaḥ duḥkha utpattyā āya dvāra bhāvena darśana śravaṇa ghrāṇa rasa sparśa manaa ākhyam ṣaṣ āyatanam nāma rūpa hetukam upajāyate sa cakṣuṣā rūpāṇi dṛṣṭvā saumanasya sthānīyāni abhiniviśate abhiniviṣṭaḥ san rāga jam dveva jam moha jam karma karoti ityādinā duḥkha utpatta āvāya dvāra tvam ṣaṇṇām āyatanānām tat evam saṃbhūte ṣaṣ āyatane uttara kālam ṣaṣ āyatanam āgamya saṃsparśaḥ saṃpravartate kaḥ punar ayam saṃsparśaḥ katham vā saṃpravartate iti pratipādayan āha cakṣuḥ pratītya rūpam ca samanvāhāram eva ca nāma rūpam pratītya evam vijñānam saṃpravartate saṃnipāta srayāṇām yaḥ rūpa vijñāna cakṣuṣām sparśaḥ saḥ

cakṣuḥ indriyam pratītya rūpāṇi ca samanvāhāram ca pratītya manaskāram viṣaya ādi vilakṣaṇam samanantara pratyayam vijñāna bīja bhūtam cakṣuḥ vijñānam utpadyate tatra cakṣuḥ ca rūpa āyatanam ca rūpam samanvāhāraḥ catuḥskandha lakṣaṇam nāma tat etat trayam pratītya utpadyamānam cakṣuḥ vijñānam nāma rūpam pratītya utpadyate tat evam eṣām indriya viṣaya vijñānānām trayāṇām yaḥ saṃnipātaḥ saha utpādaḥ anyonya upakāreṇa tulyam yā pravṛttiḥ sa spṛṣṭi lakṣaṇaḥ sparśaḥ tatas uttara kālam tasmāt sparśāt ca vedanā saṃpravartate iṣṭa aniṣṭa ubhaya viparīta viṣaya anubhūtiḥ viṣaya anubhavaḥ vedanam vittiḥ vedanā iti ucyate duḥkhā sukhā aduḥkha asukhā ca trividhā yathā ca eṣām rūpa vijñāna cakṣuṣām trayāṇām saṃnipāta lakṣaṇam sparśam āgamya vedanā uktā evam śeṣa indriya viṣaya vijñāna traya saṃnipāta lakṣaṇa sparśa hetukā vedanā vyākhyeyā

tatas uttara kālam vedanā pratyayā tṛṣṇā saṃpravartate iti vartate vedanā pratyayaḥ yasyāḥ tṛṣṇāyāḥ sā vedanā pratyayā kiṃviṣayā punar sā tṛṣṇā vedanā viṣayā eva kim kāraṇam yasmāt asau tṛṣṇāluḥ vedanā artham hi tṛṣyate vedanā nimittam eva abhilāṣam karoti iti arthaḥ katham kṛtvā yadi tāvat sukhā vedanā asya upajāyate sa tasyāḥ punar punar saṃyoga artham paritṛṣyate atha duḥkhā tadā tasyāḥ visaṃyoga artham paritṛṣyate atha aduḥkha asukhā tasyāḥ api nityam aparibhraṃśa artham paritṛṣyate saḥ evam tṛṣyamāṇaḥ upādānam upādatte caturvidham saḥ evam vedanāsu abhiniviṣṭaḥ saktaḥ tṛṣṇā pratyayam kāma dṛṣṭi śīla vrata ātma vāda upādāna ākhyam caturvidham karma ākṣepa kāraṇam parigṛhṇāti tat evam asya tṛṣṇā pratyayam upādānam bhavati

tatas uttara kālam upādāne sati bhavaḥ upādātuḥ pravartate syāt hi yadi anupādānaḥ mucyeta na bhavet bhavaḥ pañca skandhāḥ sa ca bhavaḥ caturvidhasya yathā uktasya upādānasya upādātā grahītā utpādayitā tasya upādātuḥ upādānapratyayaḥ bhavaḥ upajāyate kim kāraṇam yasmāt yaḥ hi anutpādita vedanā tṛṣṇaḥ pratisaṃkhyāna balena tṛṣṇām asvīkurvan caturvidham upādānam pravihāya upādātā amalā dvaya jñāna saṃmukhībhāvāt syāt hi yadi anupādānaḥ mucyeta saḥ tadānīm tasya na bhavet bhavaḥ

kaḥ punar ayam bhavaḥ pañca skandhāḥ sa ca bhavaḥ yaḥ upādānāt pravartate sa pañca skandha svabhāvaḥ veditavyaḥ trividham api kāyikam vācikam mānasikam ca karma bhavati asmāt anāgatam skandha pañcakam bhavaḥ iti vyapadiśyate tatra kāyikam vācikam karma rūpa skandha svabhāvam karma vijñapti tvāt mānasam tu catur skandha svabhāvam iti evam sa bhavaḥ pañca skandhāḥ iti vijñeyam tasmāt bhavāt jātiḥ pravartate anāgata skandha utpādaḥ jātiḥ sā ca bhavāt pravartate tatas uttara kālam jarā maraṇa duḥkha ādi śokāḥ sa paridevanāḥ daurmanasyam upāyāsāḥ jāteḥ etat pravartate

jāti hetukāḥ ete jarā maraṇa ādayaḥ pravartante eṣām ca yathāsūtram eva vyākhyānam veditavyam tatra skandha paripākaḥ jarā jīrṇasya skandha bhedaḥ maraṇam mriyamāṇasya vigacchataḥ saṃmūḍhasya sāmiṣaṅgaḥ hṛdaya saṃtāpaḥ śokaḥ śoka samutthitaḥ vāc pralāpaḥ paridevaḥ pañca indriya asāta nipātaḥ duḥkham manaḥ niṣṭa nipātaḥ daurmanasyam duḥkha daurmanasya bahu tva saṃbhūtāḥ upāyāsāḥ iti tat evam yathā upavarṇitena nyāyena kevalasya evam etasya duḥkha skandhasya saṃbhavaḥ kevalasya iti ātma ātmīya svabhāva vigatasya bāla pṛthagjana parikalpita mātrasya duḥkha ātmakasya sukha avyāmiśrasya eva iti arthaḥ evam iti hetu pratyaya mātra balena eva iti arthaḥ duḥkha skandhasya iti duḥkha samudāyasya duḥkha samūhasya duḥkha rāśeḥ iti arthaḥ

yatas ca evam yathā upavarṇitāt avidyā ādikāt eva bhava aṅgānām pravṛttiḥ atas saṃsāra mūlān saṃskārān avidvān saṃskaroti atas avidvān kārakaḥ tasmāt na vidvān tattva darśanāt tatra saṃsārasya vijñāna ādi pravṛtti lakṣaṇasya mūlam pradhānam kāraṇam saṃskārāḥ tatas ca saṃsāra mūlān saṃskārān avidvān saṃskaroti

avidyā anugataḥ yaḥ pudgalaḥ bhikṣavaḥ puṇyān api saṃskārān abhisaṃskaroti apuṇyān api saṃskārān abhisaṃskaroti āneñjyān api saṃskārān abhisaṃskaroti iti bhagavat vacanāt yatas ca evam avidvān kārakaḥ tasmāt avidvān eva pudgalaḥ kārakaḥ bhavati saṃskārāṇām na vidvān tattva darśī prahīṇa avidyaḥ kim kāraṇam tattva darśanāt tattva darśane hi sarva padārthanām eva anupalambhāt na asti kiṃcid yat ā ālambya karma kuryāt iti

yatas ca evam avidyāyām eva satyām saṃskārāḥ pravartante asatyām na pravartante atas avidyāyām niruddhāyām saṃskārāṇām asaṃbhavaḥ hetu vaiyarthyāt tasyāḥ punar avidyāyāḥ kutas nirodhaḥ iti āha avidyāyāḥ nirodhaḥ tu jñānena asya eva bhāvanāt asya eva pratītyasamutpādasya yathāvat aviparīta bhāvanātaḥ avidyā prahīyate yaḥ hi pratītyasamutpādam samyak paśyati sa sūkṣmasya api bhāvasya na svarūpam upalabhate pratibimba sva prālāta cakra mudga āt i vat tu svabhāva śūnyatām sarveṣām bhāvānām avatarati saḥ eva svabhāva śūnyatām sarveṣām bhāvānām avatīrṇaḥ na kiṃcid vastu upalabhate bāhyam ādhyātmikam vā saḥ anupalabhamānaḥ na kvacid dharme muhyati amūḍhaḥ ca karma na karoti iti evam pratītyasamutpāda bhāvanayā tattvam avatarati tattva darśinaḥ yoginaḥ niyatam eva avidyā prahīyate prahīṇa avidyasya saṃskārāḥ nirudhyante

yathā ca evam avidyā nirodhāt saṃskārāḥ nirudhyante evam tasya tasya nirodhena tat tat na abhipravartate duḥkha skandhaḥ kevalaḥ ayam evam samyak nirudhyate pūrvasya pūrvasya aṅgasya nirodhena utarasya uttarasya aṅgasya nirodhaḥ bhavati iti vijñeyam anayā ca ānupūrvyā ayam yogī ātma ātmīya ādya darśana āyāsa nirastaḥ kāraka vedaka vi rahitam bhāva svabhāva śūnyam duḥkha rāśim punar anutpattyā samyak nirodhayati yathā uktam ārya śāli stamba sūtre

evam ādhyātmikaḥ api pratītyasamutpādaḥ dvābhyām eva kāraṇābhyām utpadyate katamābhyām dvābhyām hetu upanibandhataḥ pratyaya upanibandhataḥ ca tatra ādhyātmikasya pratītyasamutpādasya hetu upanibandhaḥ katamaḥ yat idam avidyā pratyayāḥ saṃskārāḥ saṃskāra pratyayam vijñānam vijñāna pratyayam nāma rūpam nāma rūpa pratyayam ṣaṣ āyatanam ṣaṣ āyatana pratyayaḥ sparśaḥ sparśa pratyayā vedanā vedanā pratyayā tṛṣṇā tṛṣṇā pratyayam upādānam upādāna pratyayaḥ bhavaḥ bhava pratyayā jātiḥ jāti pratyayāḥ jarā maraṇa śoka parideva duḥkha daurmanasya upāyāsāḥ saṃbhavanti evam asya kevalasya mahataḥ duḥkha skandhasya samudayaḥ bhavati avidyā ced na abhaviṣyat na eva saṃskārāḥ prajñāsyante

evam yāvat jātiḥ ced na abhaviṣyat jarā maraṇam na prajñāsyate athavā satyām avidyāyām saṃskārāṇām abhinirvṛttiḥ bhavati evam yāvat jātyām satyām jarā maraṇasya abhinirvṛttiḥ bhavati atra avidyāyāḥ na evam bhavati aham saṃskārān abhinirvartayāmi iti saṃskārāṇām api na evam bhavati vayam avidyayā abhinirvartitāḥ iti evam yāvat jāteḥ api na evam bhavati aham jarā maraṇam abhinirvartayāmi iti jarā maraṇasya api na evam bhavati aham jātyā abhinirvartitam iti atha ca satyām avidyāyām saṃskārāṇa abhinirvṛtti rbhavati prādurbhāvaḥ evam yāvat jātyām satyām jarā maraṇasya abhinirvṛttiḥ bhavati prādurbhāvaḥ evam ādhyātmikasya pratītyasamutpādasya hetu upanibandhaḥ draṣṭavyaḥ

katham ādhyātmikasya pratītyasamutpādasya pratyaya upanibandhaḥ draṣṭavyaḥ iti ṣaṇṇām dhātūnām samavāyāt katameṣām ṣaṇṇām dhātūnām samavāyāt yat idam pṛthivī ap tejaḥ vāyu ākāśa vijñāna dhātūnām samavāyāt ādhyātmikasya pratītyasamutpādasya pratyaya upanibandhaḥ draṣṭavyaḥ tatra ādhyātmikasya pratītyasamutpādasya pṛthivī dhātuḥ katamaḥ yaḥ kāyasya saṃśleṣāt kaṭhina bhāvam abhinirvartayati ayam ucyate pṛthivī dhātuḥ yaḥ kāyasya anuparigraha kṛtyam karoti ayam ucyate abdhātuḥ yaḥ kāyasya aśita bhakṣitam paripācayati ayam ucyate tejaḥ dhātuḥ yaḥ kāyasya āśvāsa praśvāsa kṛtyam karoti ayam ucyate vāyudhātuḥ yaḥ kāyasya antar śauṣīryam abhinirvartayati ayam ucyate ākāśa dhātuḥ yaḥ nāma rūpam abhinirvartayati naḍa kalāpa yogena pañca vijñāna kāya saṃyuktam sa āsravam ca manaḥ vijñānam ayam ucyate bhikṣavaḥ vijñāna dhātuḥ tatra asatām eṣām pratyayānām kāyasya utpattiḥ na bhavati yadā tu ādhyātmikaḥ pṛthivī dhātuḥ avikalaḥ bhavati evam ap tejaḥ vāyu ākāśa vijñāna dhātavaḥ ca avikalāḥ bhavanti tatas sarveṣām samavāyāt kāyasya utpattiḥ bhavati

tatra pṛthivī dhātoḥ na evam bhavati aham kāyasya kaṭhina bhāvam abhinirvartayāmi iti ap dhātoḥ na evam bhavati aham kāyasya anuparigraha kṛtyam karomi iti tejaḥ dhātoḥ na evam bhavati aham kāyasya aśita pīta khāditam paripācayāmi iti vāyu dhātoḥ na evam bhavati aham kāyasya āśvāsa praśvāsa kṛtyam karomi iti ākāśa dhātoḥ na evam bhavati aham kāyasya antar śauṣīryam abhinirvartayāmi iti vijñāna dhātoḥ na evam bhavati aham kāyasya nāma rūpam abhinirvartayāmi iti kāyasya api na evam bhavati aham emiḥ pratyayaiḥ janitaḥ iti atha ca punar satām eṣām pratyayānām samavāyāt kāyasya utpatti rbhavati tatra pṛthivī dhātuḥ na ātmā na sattvaḥ na jīvaḥ na jantuḥ na manujaḥ na mānavaḥ na strī na pumān na napuṃsakam na ca aham na mama na ca anyasya kasyacid evam ap dhātuḥ tejaḥ dhātuḥ vāyudhātuḥ a ākāśa dhātuḥ vijñāna dhātuḥ na ātmā na sattvaḥ na jīvaḥ na jantuḥ na manujaḥ na mānavaḥ na strī na pumān na napuṃsakam na ca aham na mama na ca anyasya kasyacid

tatra avidyā katamā yāḥ eṣām evam ṣaṇṇām dhātūnāyamaiksaṃjñā piṇḍa saṃjñā nitya saṃjñā dhruva saṃjñā śāśvata saṃjñā sukha saṃjñā ātma saṃjñā sattva saṃjñā jīva pudgala m anuja mānava saṃjñā ahaṃkāra saṃjñā mamakāra saṃjñā evamādi vividham ajñānam iyam ucyate avidyā iti evam avidyāyām satyām viṣayeṣu rāga dveṣa mohāḥ pravartante tatra ye rāga dveṣa mohāḥ viṣayeṣu amī saṃskārāḥ iti ucyante vastu prativijñaptiḥ vijñānam vijñāna sahabhuvaḥ catvāraḥ skandhāḥ arūpiṇaḥ upādāna ākhyāḥ tad nāma rūpam catvāri mahābhūtāni tāni ca upādāya rūpam tat ca nāma rūpam aikadhyam abhisaṃkṣipya tad nāma rūpam

nāma rūpa saṃniśritāni indriyāṇi ṣaṣ āyatanam trayāṇām dharmāṇām saṃnipātaḥ sparśaḥ sparśa anubhavaḥ vedanā vedanā adhyavasānam tṛṣṇā tṛṣṇā vaipulyam upādānam upādāna nirjātam punarbhava janakam karma bhavaḥ bhava hetukaḥ skandha prādurbhāvaḥ jātiḥ jātasya skandhasya paripākaḥ jarā jīrṇasya skandhasya vināśaḥ maraṇam mriyamāṇasya saṃmūḍhasya sa abhiṣvaṅgasya antardāhaḥ śokaḥ śoka uttham ālapanam paridevaḥ pañca vijñāna kāya saṃyuktam asātam anubhavanam duḥkham manasā saṃyuktam mānasam duḥkham dārmanasyam ye ca api anye evamādayaḥ upakleśāḥ te upāyāsāḥ iti

tatra moha andhakāra arthena avidyā abhisaṃskāra arthena saṃskārāḥ vijñāpana arthena vijñānam anyonya upastambha na arthena nāma rūpam āya dvāra arthena ṣaṣ āyatanam sparśana arthena sparśaḥ anubhavana arthena vedanā paritarṣaṇa arthena tṛṣṇā upādāna arthena upādānam punarbhava arthena bhavaḥ janma arthena jātiḥ paripāka arthena jarā vināśa arthena maraṇam śocana arthena śokaḥ paridevana arthena paridevaḥ kāya paripīḍana arthena duḥkham citta saṃpīḍana arthena daurmanasyam upakleśa arthena upāyāsāḥ

athavā tattve apratipattiḥ mithyāpratipattiḥ ajñānam avidyā evam avidyāyām satyām trividhāḥ saṃskārāḥ abhinirvartante puṇya upagāḥ apuṇya upagāḥ ānen jya upagāḥ tatra puṇya upagānām saṃskārāṇām puṇya upagamā iva vijñānam bhavati apuṇya upagānām saṃskārāṇām apuṇya upagamā iva vijñānam bhavati āneñjya upagānām saṃskārāṇāmāneñjya upagam eva vijñānam bhavati idam ucyate vijñānam vijñāna pratyayam nāma rūpam iti vedanā ādayaḥ arūpiṇaḥ catvāraḥ skandhāḥ tatra tatra bhave nāmayanti iti nāma saha rūpa skandhena ca nāma rūpam ca iti nāma rūpam ucyate nāma rūpa vivṛddhayā ṣaḍbhiḥ āyatana dvāraiḥ kṛtya kriyāḥ pravartante prajñāyante tad nāma rūpa pratyayam ṣaṣ āyatanam iti ucyate ṣaḍbhyaḥ ca āyatanebhyaḥ ṣaṭ sparśakāyāḥ pravartante ayam ṣaṣ āyatana pratyayaḥ sparśaḥ iti ucyate

yat jātīyaḥ sparśaḥ bhavati tad jātīyā vedanā pravartate iyam ucyate bhikṣavaḥ sparśa pratyayāḥ vedanā iti yaḥ tām vedanām viśeṣeṇa āsvādayati abhinandati adhyavasyati adhyavasāya tiṣṭhati sā vedanā pratyayā tṛṣṇā iti ucyate āsvādana abhinandana adhyavasāna sthānāt ātma priya rūpa sāta rūpaiḥ viyogaḥ mā bhūt nityam aparityāgaḥ bhavet iti yā evam prārthanā idam ucyate bhikṣavaḥ tṛṣṇā pratyayam upādānam yatra vastuni sa tṛṣṇaḥ tasya vastunaḥ arjanāya viṭhapanāya upādānam upādatte tatra tatra prārthayate evam prārthayamānaḥ punarbhava janakam karma samutthāpayati kāyena vācā manasā ca saḥ upādānapratyayaḥ bhavaḥ iti ucyate tad karma nirjātānām skandhānām abhinirvṛtiḥ yā sā bhava pratyayā jātiḥ iti ucyate jātyā abhinirvṛttānām skandhānām upacayana paripākāt vināśaḥ bhavati tat idam jāti pratyayam jarā maraṇam iti ucyate

evam ayam dvādaśa aṅgaḥ pratītyasamutpādaḥ anyonya hetukaḥ anyonya pratyayaḥ na eva anityaḥ na eva nityaḥ na saṃskṛtaḥ na asaṃskṛtaḥ na ahetukaḥ na apratyayaḥ na vedayitā na avedayitā na pratītyasamutpannaḥ na apratītya samutpannaḥ na kṣaya dharmaḥ na akṣaya dharmaḥ na vināśa dharmaḥ na avināśa dharmaḥ na nirodha dharmaḥ na anirodha dharmaḥ anādi kāla pravṛttaḥ anucchinnaḥ anupravartate nadī srota vat

yadi api ayam dvādaśa aṅgaḥ pratītyasamutpādaḥ anucchinnaḥ anupravartate nadī srota vat atha ca imāni asya dvādaśa aṅgasya pratītyasamutpādasya catvāri aṅgāni saṃghāta kriyāyai hetu tvena pravartante katamāni catvāri yat uta avidyā tṛṣṇā karma vijñānam ca tatra vijñānam bīja svabhāva tvena hetuḥ karma kṣetra svabhāva tvena hetuḥ avidyā tṛṣṇā ca kleśa svabhāva tvena hetuḥ karma kleśāḥ vijñāna bījam janayanti tatra karma vijñāna bījasya kṣetra kāryam karoti tṛṣṇā vijñāna bījam snehayati avidyā vijñāna bījam avakirati asatām teṣām pratyayānām vijñāna bījasi abhinirvṛttiḥ na bhavati tatra karmaṇaḥ na evam bhavati aham vijñāna bījasya kṣetra kāryam karomi iti tṛṣṇāyāḥ api na evam bhavati aham vijñānasya sneha kāryam karom iti avidyāyāḥ api na evam bhavati aham vijñāna bījam avakirāmi iti vijñāna bījasya api na evam bhavati aham ebhiḥ pratyayaiḥ janitam iti

atha ca vijñāna bījam karma kṣetra pratiṣṭhitam tṛṣṇā sneha abhiṣyanditam avidyayā su avakīrṇam vibhajyamānam virohati tatra tatra upapattyāṃyatana pratisaṃdhau mātuḥ kukṣau nāma rūpa aṅkuram abhinirvartayati sa ca nāma rūpa aṅkuraḥ na svayaṃkṛtaḥ na para kṛtaḥ na ubhaya kṛtaḥ na īśvara kṛtaḥ na kāla pariṇāmitaḥ na prakṛti saṃbhūtaḥ na ca eka kāraṇa adhīnaḥ na api ahetu samutpannaḥ atha ca mātā pitṛ saṃyogāt ṛtu samavāyāt anyeṣām pratyayānām samavāyāt āsvāda anuviddham vijñāna bījam mātuḥ kukṣau nāma rūpa aṅkuram abhinirvartayati asvāmikeṣu dharmeṣu aparigraheṣu amameṣu ākāśa sameṣu māyā lakṣaṇa svabhāveṣu hetu pratyayānām avaikalyāt

tat yathā pañcabhiḥ kāraṇaiḥ cakṣuḥ vijñānam utpadyate katamaiḥ pañcabhiḥ yat uta cakṣuḥ pratītya rūpam ca ālokam ca ākāśam ca tad jamana sikāram ca pratītya utpadyate cakṣuḥ vijñānam tatra cakṣuḥ vijñānasya cakṣuḥ āśraya kṛtyam karoti rūpam ālambana kṛtyam karoti ālokaḥ avabhāsa kṛtyam karoti ākāśam anāvaraṇa kṛtyam karoti tad ja manasikāraḥ samanvāharaṇa kṛtyam karoti asatām eṣām pratyayānām cakṣuḥ vijñānam na utpadyate yadā tu cakṣuḥ ādhyātmikam āyatanam avikalam bhavati evam rūpa āloka ākāśa tajja manasikārāḥ ca avikalāḥ bhavanti tatas sarveṣām samavāyāt cakṣuḥ vijñānam utpadyate

tatra cakṣuṣaḥ na evam bhavati aham cakṣuḥ vijñānasya āśraya kṛtyam karomi iti ālokasya api na evam bhavati aham cakṣuḥ vijñānasya avabhāsa kṛtyam karomi iti ākāśasya api na evam bhavati aham cakṣuḥ vijñānasya anāvaraṇa kṛtyam karom iti tad ja mana sikārasya api na evam bhavati aham cakṣuḥ vijñānasya samanvāharaṇa kṛtyam karomi iti cakṣuḥ vijñānasya api na evam bhavati aham ebhiḥ pratyayaiḥ janitam iti atha ca satām eṣām pratyayānām samavāyāt cakṣuḥ vijñānasya utpattiḥ bhavati evam śeṣāṇām indriyāṇām yathāyogam karaṇīyam

tatra na kaścid dharmaḥ asmāt lokāt para lokam saṃkrāmati asti ca karma phala prativijñaptiḥ hetu pratyayānām avaikalyāt tat yathā bhikṣavaḥ su pariśuddhe ādarśa maṇḍale mukha pratibimbakam dṛśyate na ca tatra ādarśa maṇḍale mukham saṃkrāmati asti ca mukha prativijñaptiḥ hetu pratyayānām avaikalyāt evam asmāt lokāt na kaścid cyutaḥ na api anyatra upapannaḥ asti ca karma phala prativijñaptiḥ hetu pratyayānām avaikalyāt tat yathā bhikṣavaḥ candra maṇḍalam catvāriṃśat yojana śatam ūrdhvam vrajati atha ca punar parītte api udaka bhājane candrasya pratibimbam dṛśyate na ca tasmāt sthānāt ūrdhvam nabhasaḥ cyutam parītte udakasya bhājane saṃkrāntam bhavati asti ca candra maṇḍala prativijñaptiḥ hetu pratyayānām avaikalyāt evam asmāt lokāt na kaścid cyutaḥ na anyatra upapannaḥ asti ca karma phala prativijñaptiḥ hetu pratyayānām avaikalyāt

tat yathā agniḥ upādāna pratyaye sati jvalati upādāna vaikalyāt na jvalati evam eva bhikṣavaḥ karma kleśa janitam vijñāna bījam tatra tatra upapatti āyatana pratisaṃdhau mātuḥ kukṣau nāma rūpa aṅkuram abhinirvartayati asvāmikeṣu dharmeṣu aparigraheṣu māyā lakṣaṇa svabhāveṣu amameṣu kṛtrimeṣu hetu pratyayānām avaikalyāt

tatra ādhyātmikaḥ pratītyasamutpādaḥ pañcabhiḥ kāraṇaiḥ draṣṭavyaḥ katamaiḥ pañcabhiḥ na śāśvatataḥ na ucchedataḥ na saṃkrāntitaḥ parītta hetu vipula phala abhinirvṛttitaḥ tad sadṛśa anuprabandhataḥ ca iti katham na śāśvatataḥ yasmāt anye māraṇa antikāḥ skandhāḥ anye aupapatti aṃśikāḥ skandhāḥ na tu yaḥ eva māraṇa antikāḥ skandhāḥ te eva aupapatti aṃśikāḥ api tu māraṇa antikāḥ skandhāḥ nirudhyante tasmin eva ca samaye aupapatti aṃśikāḥ skandhāḥ prādurbhavanti atas na śāśvatataḥ katham na ucchedataḥ na ca pūrva niruddheṣu māraṇa antikeṣu skandheṣu aupapatti aṃśikāḥ skandhāḥ prādurbhavanti na api aniruddheṣu

api tu māraṇa antikāḥ skandhāḥ nirudhyante tasmin eva ca samaye aupapatti aṃśikāḥ skandhāḥ prādurbhavanti tulā daṇḍa unnābha avanāma vat candra bimba pratibimba vat atas na ucchedataḥ katham na saṃkrāntitaḥ visadṛśāḥ sattva nikāyāḥ sabhāgāyām jātyām jātim abhinirvartayanti atas na saṃkrāntitaḥ katham parītta hetutaḥ vipula phala abhinirvṛttitaḥ parīttam karma kriyate vipulaḥ phala vipākaḥ anubhūyate atas parītta hetutaḥ vipula phala abhinirvṛttitaḥ katham tad sadṛśa anuprabandhataḥ yathāvedanīyam karma kriyate tathā vedanīyaḥ vipākaḥ anubhūyate atas tad sadṛśa anuprabandhataḥ ca iti vistaraḥ

yaḥ ca evam pratītyasamutpādam yathābhūtam samyak paśyati sa na pūrva antam pratisarati na apara antam pratisarati ityādi sūtre paṭhayate tatra katamaḥ pūrva antaḥ katamaḥ apara antaḥ katham na pratisarati iti tat vayutpati artham idam ārabhyate tatra vartamānam ātma bhāvam apekṣya atītāḥ ātma bhāvāḥ pūrva antaḥ iti ucyate pūrvaḥ hi janma paraṃpara aṃśaḥ pūrva antaḥ tam na pratisarati dṛṣṭi prakāraiḥ na ālambate pratītyasamutpādasya yathāvat avasthita tattva darśanāt na anyathā avasthitam vastu anyathā abhiniviśate tatra aṣṭau dṛṣṭayaḥ pūrva antam ālambya anyathā pravṛttāḥ tat yathā abhūmatītam adhvānam nābhūm iti ca dṛṣṭayaḥ yāḥ tāḥ śāśvata loka ādyāḥ pūrva antam samupāśritāḥ

tatra iti śabdaḥ ādi arthaḥ athavā dṛṣṭi dvaya upādānam upalakṣaṇa artham catastraḥ tu etāḥ dṛṣṭayaḥ tat yathā kim nu aham abhūvam atītam adhvānam na abhūvam atītam adhvānam abhūvam ca na abhūvam ca na eva abhūvam na na abhūvam iti etāḥ catasraḥ dṛṣṭayaḥ pūrva antam samāśritāḥ aparāḥ api catasraḥ iti āha yāḥ tāḥ śāśvata loka ādyāḥ pūrvam prasaṅgena upavarṇitāḥ tāḥ api pūrva antam samupāśritāḥ

tatra yadi api pūrva antāt dṛṣṭi catuṣṭayāt uttaram dṛṣṭi catuṣṭayam na atibhidyate tathā api tāvat mātra viśeṣam āśritya pṛthak upādīyate tat ca uttaratra vyākhyāsyāmaḥ tatra śāśvataḥ lokaḥ iti etat abhūvam atītam adhvānam iti etasmāt na atibhidyate athavā ayam viśeṣaḥ yat śāśvataḥ lokaḥ iti eṣām dṛṣṭiḥ sāmānyena pūrva antam āśritā abhūvam atītam adhvānam iti eṣā tu ātmanaḥ eva pūrva anta parāmarśena pravṛttā na sāmānyena iti evam anyāsu api dṛṣṭiṣu viśeṣaḥ vaktavyaḥ iti evam tāvat aṣṭau etāḥ dṛṣṭayaḥ pūrva antam samupāśritāḥ

uktaḥ pūrva antar tad ālambikābhiḥ dṛṣṭibhiḥ sārdham idānīm aparāntaḥ ucyate tatra vartamānam ātma bhāvam apekṣya bhāvinaḥ ātma bhāvāḥ aparāntaḥ iti ucyate aparaḥ hi janma paraṃpara aṃśaḥ apara antaḥ tam na pratisarati dṛṣṭi prakāraiḥ na ālambate pratītyasamutpādasya yathāvat avasthita tattva darśanāt na anyathā avasthitam vastu anyathā abhiniviśate tatra aṣṭau dṛṣṭayaḥ apara antam ālambya anyathā pravṛttāḥ tat yathā dṛṣṭayaḥ na bhaviṣyāmi kim anyaḥ anāgate adhvani bhaviṣyāmi iti ca antādyāḥ apara antam samāśritāḥ

iha api dṛṣṭi dvaya upādānam upalakṣaṇa artham catastraḥ tu etāḥ dṛṣṭayaḥ tat yathā kim nu bhaviṣyāmi anāgatam adhvānam na bhaviṣyāmi bhaviṣyāmi ca na bhaviṣyāmi ca na eva bhaviṣyāmi na ca na bhaviṣyāmi anāgatam adhvānam iti etāḥ catasraḥ dṛṣṭayaḥ apara antam samāśritāḥ kim etāḥ eva catasraḥ dṛṣṭayaḥ apara antam samāśritāḥ na iti āha kim tarhi aparāḥ api catasraḥ vidyante anta ādyāḥ apara antam samāśritāḥ tatra anta ādyāḥ catasraḥ dṛṣṭayaḥ sāmānyena apara antam āśritya pravṛttāḥ kim tu bhaviṣyāmi anāgatam adhvānam iti etāḥ tu ātmanaḥ eva apara antam āśritya pravṛttāḥ iti evam dṛṣṭi catuṣṭayasya viśeṣaḥ iti boddhavyam

tatra ādyasya tāvat pūrva anta ālambikasya dṛṣṭi catuṣṭayasya yathā na saṃbhavaḥ tathā pratipādayan āha abhūmatītam adhvānam iti etat na upapadyate yaḥ hi janmasu pūrveṣu saḥ eva na bhavati ayam tatra yaḥ eva atīteṣu janmasu babhūva yadi saḥ eva ayam adhunā syāt tadā yuktam asya grahītum abhūvam aham atītam adhvānam iti na ca etat evam saṃbhavati nitya tva prasaṅgāt nityasya ca saṃsaraṇa anupapatteḥ eka gati sthasya api nānā gati saṃgṛhīta tva prasaṅgāt iha hi pūrvam yadi naraka ādi gatikaḥ bhūtvā idānīm karma vaicitryāt manuṣyeṣu upapannaḥ evaṃkalpayet aham eva asau nārakaḥ āsam iti tat asya na yuktam katham hi nāma manuṣyaḥ san nāraka ādikaḥ syāt

yat tarhi idam paṭhayate sūtre aham eva sa tena kālena tena samayena māndhātā nāma rājā cakravartī abhūvam iti tat katham veditavyam iti anyatva pratiṣedha param tat vacanam na ekatva pratipādakam iti vijñeyam atas eva hi na anyaḥ sa tena kālena tena samayena iti paṭhayate yadi punar saḥ eva ayam iti pūrvakasya ca adhunātanasya ca eka tvam syāt kaḥ doṣaḥ syāt uktaḥ tāvat atra doṣaḥ nitya tvam syāt iti

tathā api bhūyaḥ ucyate saḥ eva ātmā iti tu bhavet upādānam viśiṣyate yadi saḥ eva pūrvakaḥ ātmā ayam idānīm syāt tadā upādānasya pañca skandha lakṣaṇasya viśeṣaḥ na syāt upādātura viśeṣāt pūrva avasthāyām iva na ca evam upādāna aviśeṣaḥ asya ātmanaḥ kim tarhi viśiṣyate eva upādānam upādātuḥ karma bhedāt kāraka bhedāt ca tatas ca upādāna viśeṣāt saḥ eva ayam ātmā iti na yujyate atha manyase viśiṣyatām upādānam ātmā tu ekaḥ eva iti atas ātmanaḥ aviśiṣṭa tvāt abhūmatītam adhvānam iti etat bhaviṣyati eva ucyate upādāna vinirmuktaḥ ātmā te katamaḥ punar

yadi hi anyat upādānam anyaḥ ca ātmā syāt tadā upādāna viśeṣe api ātmanaḥ aviśeṣāt syāt etat evam na ca etat bhedena darśayitum śakyam ayam asau ātmā idam asya upādānam iti upādāna viśiṣṭa svabhāva tvāt ātmanaḥ ahetuka tva prasaṅgāt pṛthak grahaṇa prasaṅgāt ca yadā ca evam upādāna vinirmuktaḥ ātmā darśayitum na śakyate tadā upādāna viśeṣe api ātmā viśeṣaḥ iti na śakyate kalpayitum

atha api kaścid parikalpayet satyam upādāna vinirmuktaḥ iti evam na saṃbhavati kim upādānam eva ātma tvena parikalpyate iti etat api na yuktam iti pratipādayan āha upādāna vinirmuktaḥ na asti ātmā iti kṛte sati syāt upādānam eva ātmā na asti ca ātmā iti vaḥ punar yathā tāvat upādānam eva ātmā na saṃbhavati tathā pratipādayan āha na ca upādānam eva ātmā vyeti tat samudeti ca katham hi nāma upādānam upādātā bhaviṣyati

tatra yat etat pañca upādāna skandha ākhyam upādānam tat pratikṣaṇam utpadyate ca vinaśyati ca na ca evam ātmā pratikṣaṇam utpadyate ca vinaśyati ca ātmā skandhebhyaḥ tattva anyatva ādinā ca nitya anitya tvena api aśakyaḥ eva vaktum aneka doṣa prasaṅgāt nitya tve hi ātmanaḥ śāśvata vādaḥ syāt anitya tve ca uccheda vāda prasaṅgaḥ tatas ca tat ubhayam śāśvata uccheda ākhyam mahā nartha karam iti na upagantavyam atas upādānam eva ātmā iti tāvat na yujyate

api ca katham hi nāma upādānam upādātā bhaviṣyati iha upādīyate iti upādānam karma tasya ca avaśyam upādātrāḥ upārjakena bhavitavyam tasya ca upādānasya yadi ātma tvam iṣyate tatra upādānam eva upādātā iti api vidyate tatas ca kartṛ karmaṇoḥ aikye sati chetṛ chettavya ghaṭa kumbhakāra agni indhana ādīnām api aikyam syāt na ca etat dṛṣṭam yuktam vā iti pratipādayan āha katham hi nāma upādānam upādātā bhaviṣyati iti api tu atyanta asaṃbhavaḥ eva asya pakṣasya iti abhiprāyaḥ

atra āha satyam upādāna mātram ātmā na yujyate kim tarhi upādāna vyatiriktaḥ eva ātmā bhaviṣyati etat api na yuktam kim kāraṇam yasmāt anyaḥ punar upādānāt ātmā na eva upapadyate gṛhyate hi anupādānaḥ yadi anyaḥ na ca gṛhyate yadi upādānāt ātmā vyatiriktaḥ syāt gṛhyeta saḥ upādāna vyatiriktaḥ ghaṭāt iva paṭaḥ na ca evam gṛhyate tasmāt upādāna vyatiriktaḥ api na asti anupādānaḥ upādāna vyatirekeṇa agṛhyamāṇa tvāt kha puṣpa vat iti abhiprāyaḥ

idānīm yathā upapāditam artham nigamayan āha evam na anyaḥ upādānāt na ca upādānam eva saḥ ātmā na asti anupādānaḥ atha syāt yadi ātmā upādāna svarūpaḥ na bhavati upādāna upādātroḥ eka tva prasaṅgāt udaya vyaya prasaṅgāt ca sa hi anyaḥ api na bhavati upādānam anapekṣya bhedena grahaṇa prasaṅgāt na ca api anupādānaḥ upādāna nirapekṣasya grahaṇa prasaṅgāt evam tarhi na asti ātmā iti astu ucyate na api na asti eṣa niścayaḥ

yaḥ hi nāma skandhān upādāya prajñapyate sa katham na asti iti syāt na hi avidyamānaḥ vandhyā tanayaḥ skandhān upādāya prajñapyate katham sati upādāne upādātā na asti iti yujyate tasmāt na astitvam api asya na yujyate tasmāt na asti ātmā iti niścayaḥ api eṣa na upapadyate asya tu ātmanaḥ vyavasthānam vistareṇa madhyamaka avatārāt avaseyam iha api ca pūrvam eva sthāna sthāneṣu kṛtā vyavasthā iti na punar iha tadvayava sthāne yatnaḥ āsthīyate

evam tāvat abhūvam atītam adhvānam iti eṣā kalpanā na upapadyate idānīm na abhūvam atītam adhvānam ityet api yathā na upapadyate tathā pratipādayan āha na abhūm atītam adhvānam iti etat na upapadyate yaḥ hi janmasu pūrveṣu tatas anyaḥ na bhavati ayam yadi pūrvakāt ātmanaḥ asya adhunātanasya ātmanaḥ anya tvam syāt tadānīm na abhūm atītam adhvānam iti syāt na ca etat evam saṃbhavati tasmāt na abhūvam atītam adhvānam iti etat na upapadyate

yadi punar pūrvakāt ātmanaḥ asya anya tvam syāt kaḥ doṣaḥ iti ucyate yadi hi ayam bhavet anyaḥ pratyākhyāya api tam bhavet tathā eva ca sa saṃtiṣṭhet tatra jāyeta vā amṛtaḥ yadi hi ayam adhunātanaḥ ātmā pūrvakāt ātmanaḥ anyaḥ syāt tadā tam pūrvakam ātmānam pratyākhyāya parityajya tad nirapekṣaḥ atad dhetukaḥ eva syāt kim ca anyat tathā eva ca sa saṃtiṣṭhet tatra yadi pūrvakāt ātmanaḥ asya anya tvam syāt tadā anya tvāt ghaṭa utpāde paṭa avināśa vat pūrvasya ātmanā uttarasmin api ātmani samutpadyamāne api anirodhaḥ syāt aniruddha tvāt ca yatra pūrvam deva manuṣya ādi janmasu upapannaḥ yena varṇa saṃsthāna ādinā pūrvam upalabhyamānaḥ tena eva prakāreṇa tathā eva sa tatra avatiṣṭheta tathā eva avatiṣṭheta iti tasmāt na abhūvam atītam adhvānam iti etat na upapadyate

atra āha tatra yat uktam yadi hi ayam bhavet anyaḥ pratyākhyāya api tam bhavet iti yadi puna pūrvakam ātmānam pratyākhyāya ayam iha bhavet kaḥ doṣaḥ syāt tatra doṣāḥ bahavaḥ syuḥ katham iti ced yasmāt evam sati ucchedaḥ karmaṇām nāśaḥ tathā anya kṛta karmaṇām anyena paribhogaḥ syāt evamādi prasajyate

yadi pūrvakam ātmānam pratyākhyāya ayam ātmā bhavet tadā pūrvakasya ātmanaḥ tatra naṣṭa tvāt iha ca anyasya eva ca utpādanāt pūrvakasya ātmanaḥ ucchedaḥ syāt tasmin ca ātmani ucchinne karmaṇā ām adatta phalānām eva āśraya vicchedena vicchedāt bhoktaḥ ca abhāvāt nāśaḥ eva syāt atha pūrvakena ātmanā kṛtasya karmaṇaḥ uttareṇa ātmanā phala paribhogaḥ parikalpyate tathā api anyena kṛtasya karmaṇaḥ phalasya anyena upabhogaḥ syāt tatas ca akṛta abhyāgam abhayam syāt karma akṛtakam yadi iti evamādi aniṣṭam āpadyate

api ca yadi ayam ātmā pūrvakāt ātmanaḥ anyaḥ eva atra upapannaḥ syāt tadā pūrvam abhūtvā paścāt utpannaḥ iti syāt na ca etat yuktam iti pratipādayan āha na api abhūtvā samudbhūtaḥ doṣaḥ hi atra prasajyate kṛtakaḥ vā bhavet ātmā saṃbhūtaḥ vā api ahetukaḥ iti yadi hi ātmā pūrvam abhūtvā paścāt utpannaḥ syāt tadā kṛtakaḥ eva ātmā syāt na ca kṛtakaḥ ātmā iṣyate anitya tva prasaṅgāt vyatiriktasya ca tat niṣpādakasya kartuḥ abhāvāt kutas kṛtaka tvam ātmanaḥ yojyeta kṛtake ca ātmani parikalpyamāne ādimān saṃsāraḥ syāt eva apūrva sattvasya prādurbhāvaḥ ca na ca etat evam tasmāt na kṛtakaḥ ātmā api ca saṃbhūtaḥ vā api ahetukaḥ abhūtvā prāc ātmā samutpadyamānaḥ nirhetukaḥ eva upapadyate pūrvam hi ātmā na asti iti akṛtakaḥ nirhetukaḥ syāt vā śabdaḥ vikalpe kṛtakaḥ vā bhavet ātmā yadi vā na abhūvam atītam adhvānam iti etat na abhyupeyam saṃbhūtaḥ vā api ahetukaḥ yadi vā na abhūm atītam adhvānam iti etat na upapadyate iti abhyupagamyatām

idānīm yathā upavarṇitam eva artham nigamayan āha evam dṛṣṭiḥ atīte yā na abhūm aham abhūmaham ubhayam na ubhayam ca iti na eṣā samupapadyate evam yathā upavarṇitena nyāyena abhūmatītam adhvānam iti yā dṛṣṭiḥ eṣā api na eva upapadyate etat dvayasya abhāvāt ca ubhayam api na upapadyate kim kāraṇam yasmāt dvayam hi etat samāhatam ubhayam iti kalpyate ekaikasya ca pṛthak pṛthak abhāvāt kutas tad samāhāraḥ iti ubhayam api na saṃbhavati ubhayasya abhāvāt kutas tad pratiṣedhena na ubhayam bhaviṣyati iti tasmāt na eva abhūvam na na abhūvam iti etat api na upapadyate

tat evam pūrva antam samāśritasya dṛṣṭi catuṣṭayasya asaṃbhavam udbhāvyaḥ idānīm aparānta samāśritasya pratiṣedham āha adhvani anāgate kim nu bhaviṣyāmi iti darśanam na bhaviṣyāmi ca iti etat atītena adhvanā samam yathā eva hi atīte adhvani dṛṣṭi catuṣṭayam niṣiddham evam anāgate api adhvani dṛṣṭi catuṣṭayam niṣedhanīya m ukta pāṭha parivartanena tat yathā adhvani anāgate kim nu bhaviṣyāmi iti asaṃgatam aiṣya janmani yaḥ bhāvaḥ saḥ eva na bhavati ayam iti evamādinā sarvam samam yojyam eka tva pratiṣedhe evam anyatva pratiṣedhe api samam yojyam na syām anāgate kāle iti etat na upapadyate aiṣya janmani yaḥ bhāvaḥ tatas anyaḥ na bhavati ayam iti evamādinā pūrva śloka pāṭha parivartanena

idānīm pūrva antam samāśritasya śāśvata ādi dṛṣṭi catuṣṭayasya pratiṣedha artham āha sa devaḥ sa manuṣyaḥ ced evam bhavati śāśvatam anutpannaḥ ca devaḥ syāt jāyate na hi śāśvatam iha hi kaścid manuṣya gati sthaḥ kuśalam karma kṛtvā deva gatim gacchati tatra yadi saḥ eva devaḥ saḥ eva manuṣyaḥ iti evam ubhayoḥ aikyam syāt tadā śāśvatam syāt na ca etat evam yat eva eva manuṣyaḥ bhavet iti atas na asti kiṃcid śāśvatam api ca śāśvata vāde sati asamutpannaḥ ca devaḥ syāt kim kāraṇam yasmāt jāyate na hi śāśvatam yat hi vastu śāśvatam tat vidyamāna tvāt na eva jāyate tatas ca anutpannaḥ devaḥ syāt anutpannaḥ devaḥ na yujyate iti evam tāvat śāśvatam na yujyate

idānīm aśāśvatam api yathā na saṃbhavati tathā pratipādayan āha devāt anyaḥ manuṣyaḥ ced aśāśvatam ataḥ bhavet devāt anyaḥ manuṣyaḥ ced saṃtatiḥ na upapadyate yadi hi anyaḥ devaḥ anyaḥ ca manuṣyaḥ syāt tadā pūrvakasya manuṣya ātmanaḥ tatra naṣṭa tvāt iha ca anyasya eva utpādāt sa pūrvakaḥ manuṣya ātmā tatra vinaṣṭaḥ iti aśāśvatam syāt tad saṃtāna anuvṛttyā na aśāśvatam iti ced ucyate devāt anyaḥ manuṣyaḥ ced saṃtatiḥ na upapadyate

yadi devāt anyaḥ manuṣyaḥ bhavet tadā yathā nimbasya naḥ āmra taru saṃtānaḥ bhavati evam manuṣyasya devaḥ eka saṃtāna patitaḥ na syāt tatas ca pūrvakasya vināśāt aśāśvatam eva bhavet athavā yadi devāt anyaḥ manuṣyaḥ bhavet tadā saṃtāna anuvṛttiḥ na syāt asti ca iyam saṃtāna anuvṛttiḥ devasya manuṣyaḥ eka saṃtāna patitaḥ iti tasmāt saṃtāna abhāva prasaṅgāt devāt anyaḥ manuṣyaḥ na bhavati yatas ca evam atas aśāśvatam api na asti

idānīm śāśvata aśāśvata pratiṣedha artham āha divyaḥ yadi eka deśaḥ syāt eka deśaḥ ca mānuṣaḥ aśāśvatam śāśvatam ca bhavet tat ca na yujyate yadi ayam manuṣyaḥ aṃśena manuṣya tām vijahyāt aṃśena vihāya manuṣya tām deva ātma bhāvam upādadyāt tadā eka deśasya nāśādaśāśvatam syāt eka deśasya ca avasthānāt śāśvatam syāt etat ca ayuktam yat ekasya divya gati saṃgṛhītaḥ eka deśaḥ syāt eka deśaḥ ca manuṣyaḥ syāt tasmāt śāśvatam ca aśāśvatam ca etat ubhayam na upapadyate

idānīm naśāśvatana eva aśāśvata dṛṣṭi pratiṣedha artham āha aśāśvatam śāśvatam ca prasiddham ubhayam yadi siddhe na śāśvatam kāmam na eva aśāśvatam iti api yadi śāśvatam kiṃcid vastu syāt tadā paścāt aśāśvata darśanāt na eva śāśvatam iti syāt evam yadi kiṃcid aśāśvatam syāt tadā tasya paścāt śāśvata upapattitaḥ na aśāśvatam iti syāt yadā tu śāśvata aśāśvatam eva aprasiddham tadā kutas tad pratiṣedhena na eva śāśvatam na aśāśvatam syāt iti tasmāt etat api ayuktam

atha syāt anādi janma maraṇa paraṃpara apravṛttam avicchinna kamam saṃsāra prabandham upalabhya śāśvata mā ātmānam parikalpayāmaḥ asti asau śāśvataḥ kaścid padārthaḥ yaḥ hi nāma evam anādimati saṃsāre paribhraman adya api upalabhyate iti ucyate etat api na upapadyate kim kāraṇam yaḥ hi nāma kutaścid āgataḥ kaścid kiṃcid gacchet punar kvacid yadi tasmāt anādiḥ tu saṃsāraḥ syāt na ca asti saḥ

yadi hi saṃskārāṇām ātmanaḥ va kutaścid gati antarāt gamanam gati antaram āgamanam syāt tatas ca ganti antarāt punar kvacid gamanam syāt tadānīm ana ādiḥ saṃsāraḥ syāt na ca kutaścid kasyacid āgamanam saṃbhavati nityasya vā anityasya vā āgamana anupapatteḥ na ca api itas punar kasyacid kvacid gamanam saṃbhavati nityasya vā anityasya gamana anupapatteḥ yadā ca evam na saṃbhavati tadā kutas janma maraṇa paraṃparāyāḥ ati dīrgha tvena ādi anupalambhāt anādimān saṃsāraḥ syāt saṃsartuḥ abhāvāt kutas anādimat tvam ādima tvam vā saṃsārasya saṃbhavet yadā ca na saṃbhavati tadā yat uktam asti asau śāśvataḥ kaścid padārthaḥ yaḥ hi nāma evam anādimati saṃsāre paribhraman adya api upalabhyate iti tat na yuktam

atas ca evam yathā udita nyāyena na asti ced śāśvataḥ kaścid kaḥ bhaviṣyati aśāśvataḥ śāśvataḥ aśāśvataḥ ca api dvābhyāmābhyām tiraskṛtaḥ yadā ca evam śāśvataḥ eva padārthaḥ na saṃbhavati tadā kasya vigama nāt aśāśvataḥ syāt śāśvata aśāśvata anupalambhāt ca kutas ubhayam kutas na ubhayam iti tasmāt evam śāśvata ādi dṛṣṭi catuṣṭayam pūrva ante saṃsārasya na saṃbhavati

idānīm anta ananta ādi catuṣṭayam apara ante yathā na saṃbhavati tathā pratipādayan āha antavān yadi lokaḥ syāt para lokaḥ katham bhavet atha api anantavān lokaḥ para lokaḥ katham bhavet yadi hi antavān vināśāt ūrdhvam pūrva lokaḥ na syāt tadā para lokaḥ na syāt asti ca para lokaḥ iti antavān lokaḥ iti na upapadyate atha api anantavān lokaḥ syāt tadānīm api para lokaḥ katham bhavet na eva para lokaḥ syāt iti abhiprāyaḥ na ca para lokaḥ na asti atas para loka sadbhāvādantavān api lokaḥ na bhavati

idānīm antavat tvam anantava tvam ca ubhayam etat lokasya yathā na saṃbhavati tathā pratipādayan āha skandhānām eṣa saṃtānaḥ yasmāt dīpa arciṣām iva pravartate tasmāt na anta anantavat tvam ca yujyate pūrva uttara hetu phala bhāva saṃbandha nairantarya avicchinnakama vartī yasmāt ayam pradīpa vat pratikṣaṇa vināśī skandha saṃtānaḥ pravartate tasmāt hetu phala pravṛtti darśanāt na antavat tvam na anantavat tvam ca yujyate

katham kṛtvā pūrve yadi ca bhajyeran utpadyeran na ca api amī skandhāḥ skandhān pratītya imān atha lokaḥ antavān bhavet yadi pūrve manuṣya skandhāḥ naśyeyuḥ tān ca pratītya uttare deva gati upapatti saṃgṛhītāḥ na upapadyeran tadā antavān lokaḥ bhavet taila varti kṣaya niruddha pradīpa vat uttara ātma bhāva utpādāt na asti antavat tvam

pūrve yadi na bhajyeran utpadyeran na ca api amī skandhāḥ skandhān pratītya imān lokaḥ anantaḥ bhavet atha atha yadi pūrvakāḥ skandhāḥ na naśyeṣuḥ tān pratītya uttare phala bhūtāḥ skandhāḥ na utpadyeran tadā anantaḥ avināśī lokaḥ syāt sva rūpāt apracyuta tvāt yadā tu pūrvakāḥ skandhāḥ nirudhyante tad hetukāḥ ca apare skandhāḥ uttarakālam jāyante tadā pūrvakānām anavasthānāt kutas anantavat tvam saṃsārasya syāt

idānīm tṛtīyam ubhaya pakṣa bhāvam pratipādayan āha antavān eka deśaḥ ced eka deśaḥ tu anantavān syāt antavān anantaḥ ca lokaḥ tat ca na yujyate yadi hi kasyacid eka deśasya vināśaḥ syāt eka deśasya ca gati antara gamanam syāt yāt tadānīmantavān ca lokaḥ anantavān ca na ca etat evam saṃbhavati yat eka deśaḥ naśyati eka deśaḥ na naśyati iti atas antavān ca anantavān ca lokaḥ iti na yujyate

kasmāt punar eka deśasya vināśaḥ eka deśasya ca avasthānam na yujyate iti pratipādayan āha katham tāvat upādātuḥ eka deśaḥ vinaṅkṣyate na naṅkṣyate ca eka deśaḥ evam ca etat na yujyate iha eka deśasya vināśe eka deśasya ca avasthāne parikalpyamāne yadi vā upādātuḥ eka deśasya vināśaḥ avasthānam vā parikalpyeta yadi vā upādānasya tatra yadi tāvat upādātuḥ eka deśasya vināśaḥ eka deśasya ca avasthānam parikalpyate tat na yujyate kim kāraṇam yasmāt katham tāvat upādātuḥ eka deśaḥ vinaṅkṣyate na naṅkṣyate ca eka deśaḥ

na eva hi atra kācid upapattiḥ asti yayā eka deśasya vināśam eka deśasya ca avināśam parikalpayiṣyāmaḥ atas eva upapattim apaśyan ācāryaḥ āha evam ca etat na yujyate iti athavā upādātā hi nāma ātmā sa ca skandheṣu pañcadhā mṛgyamāṇaḥ na saṃbhavati yaḥ ca na saṃbhavati tasya katham eka deśaḥ vinaṅkṣyate eka deśaḥ ca na naṅkṣyate atas eva āha evam ca etat na yujyate iti athavā yadi upādātuḥ eka deśaḥ naśyet eka deśaḥ ca na naśyet tadā ekasya eva upādātuḥ deva tvam aṃśena anyena manuṣya tvam syāt na ca etat iṣyate iti āha evam ca etat na yujyate iti evam tāvat upādāturantavat tvam anantavat tvam ca na yuktam iti
idānīm upādānasya api yathā na saṃbhavati tathā pratipādayan āha upādāna eka deśaḥ ca katham nāma vinaṅkṣyate na naṅkṣyate ca eka deśaḥ na etat api upapadyate upādātṛ vat etat api vyākhyeyam

tat evam ubhaya darśana asaṃbhavam pratipādya idānīm yathā na ubhayam api na saṃbhavati tathā pratipādayan āha antavat ca api anantam ca prasiddham ubhayam yadi siddhe na eva anta vat kāmam na eva ananta vat iti api pratiṣedhyasya vastunaḥ asaṃbhavāt pratiṣedhasya api asaṃbhavaḥ iti atas antavat tve ca anantavat tve ca ubhayasmin apratīte kasya pratiṣedhena na eva antavān na anantavān lokaḥ iti dṛṣṭi saṃbhavaḥ syāt iti

evam tāvat sāṃvṛtam pratibimba ākāram upādātāram upādānam ca abhyupetya api śāśvata ādi dṛṣṭayasaṃbhavam pratipādya idānīm sarvathā bhāva svabhāva anupalambhena bandhyā putra śyāma gaura ta ādi vat śāśvata ādi dṛṣṭīnām a saṃbhavam pratipipādayiṣuḥ āha athavā sarva bhāvānām śūnya tvāt śāśvata ādayaḥ kva kasya katamāḥ kasmāt saṃbhaviṣyanti dṛṣṭayaḥ

iha sarva bhāvānām pratītyasamutpanna tvāt śūnya tvam sakalena śāstreṇa pratipāditam tatas ca sarva bhāvānām śūnya tvāt katamāḥ tāḥ sarva bhāva bāhyāḥ śāśvata ādyāḥ dṛṣṭayaḥ bhaviṣyanti yāḥ kaścid grahīṣyati yatas tad nirākaraṇam ārapsyāmahe tathā kim vā ālambanam yat sarva bhāva anantargatam yatra etāḥ dṛṣṭayaḥ utpatsyante yatra etāḥ dṛṣṭīḥ nivārayiṣyāmaḥ katamaḥ ca asau bhāvaḥ pudgalaḥ vā sarva bhāva bāhyāḥ yasya etāḥ dṛṣṭayaḥ utpatsyante yam dṛṣṭibhyaḥ nivārayiṣyāmaḥ kim vā dṛṣṭīnām utpatti kāraṇam ālambana nimittam sarva bhāva bāhyam yasmāt nimittāt utpadyamānāḥ śāśvata ādikāḥ dṛṣṭīḥ vārayiṣyāmaḥ sarveṣām eva hi padārthānām sarva bhāva antargata tvāt śūnya tvam śūnya tvāt ca sarve eva hi te padārthāḥ na upalabhyante iti kva kasya katamāḥ kasmāt saṃbhaviṣyanti dṛṣṭayaḥ na eva kāścid na eva kvacid na eva kasyacid na api kenacid ākāreṇa saṃbhaviṣyanti iti abhiprāyaḥ asaṃbhave ca sati āsām parikalpanā eva na utpadyate iti ayuktāḥ eva etāḥ dṛṣṭayaḥ

tat evam sarva dṛṣṭi prahāṇāya yaḥ saddharmam adeśayat anukampām upādāya tam namasyāmi gautamam tatra saṃsāra nirvāṇa prahāṇa adhigama upalambha prapāta patana saṃdhāraṇāt dharmaḥ satām āryāṇām kṛta kāryāṇām dharmaḥ saddharmaḥ yadi vā śobhanaḥ dharmaḥ saddharmaḥ sakala saṃsāra duḥkha kṣaya kara tvena praśaṃsanīya tvāt yaḥ saddharmam anirodham anutpādam anucchedam aśāśvatam aneka artha manāna artham anāgamam anirgamam prapañca upaśamam śivam pratītyasamutpāda saṃjñayā hi deśitavān sarva dṛṣṭi prahāṇa artham jagatām anukampām upādāya mahā karuṇām eva āśritya priya eka putra adhikatara prema pātra sakala tribhuvana janaḥ na lābha satkāra pratyupakāra ādi lipsayā tam namasyāmi niruttaram advitīyam śāstāram kiṃnāmadheyam gautamam parama ṛṣi gotra saṃbhūtam iti arthaḥ

yathā uktam ārya śāli stamba sūtre āryam aitreyeṇa mahā bodhisattvena yaḥ imam pratītyasamutpādam evam yathābhūtam samyak prajñayā satata samitam ajīvam nirjīvam yathāvat aviparītam ajātam abhūtam akṛtam asaṃskṛtam apratigham anāvaraṇam śivam abhayam anāhāryam avyayam avyupaśama svabhāvam paśyati asataḥ tucchataḥ riktataḥ asārataḥ rogataḥ gaṇḍataḥ śalyataḥ aghataḥ anityataḥ duḥkhataḥ śūnyataḥ anātmataḥ na sa pūrva antam pratisarati kim nu aham abhūvam atīte adhvani āhosvit na abhūvam atīte adhvani kaḥ nu aham abhūvam atīte adhvani katham nu aham abhūvam atīte adhvani

apara antam vā punar na pratisarati kim nu aham bhaviṣyāmi anāgate adhvani āhosvit na bhaviṣyāmi anāgate adhvani kaḥ nu bhaviṣyāmi anāgate adhvani katham nu bhaviṣyāmi anāgate adhvani pratyutpannam vā punar na pratisarati kim nu idam katham nu idam ke santaḥ ke bhaviṣyāmaḥ ayam sattvaḥ kutam āgataḥ saḥ itas cyutaḥ kutra gamiṣyati iti yāni ekeṣām śramaṇa brāhmaṇānām pṛthak loke dṛṣṭi gatāni bhaviṣyanti tat yathā ātma vāda pratisaṃyuktāni jīva vāda pratisaṃyuktāni kautuka maṅgala pratisaṃyuktāni tāni asya tasmin samaye prahīṇāni bhavanti parijñātāni samucchinna mūlāni tāla mastaka vadana ābhāsa gatāni āyatyām anutpāda ani rodha dharmāṇi atha khalu āyuṣmān śāriputraḥ maitreyasya bodhisattvasya mahāsattvasya bhāṣitam abhinandya anupramodya utthāya āsanāt prakrāntaḥ prakrāntāḥ te ca bhikṣavaḥ iti

atha atas dharmam vyākhyāsyāmaḥ kasyacid brāhmaṇasya veda abhyāsa vaśena vyapagata kalmaṣasya idam veda vākyam pratibabhau śarīram vāva santam priya apriye na spṛśataḥ iti tatas idam vākyam ālocya kaṇabhakṣam ājagāma tatas abhyuvāca bhagavan anena vākyena apahata śarīrasya kṣema sādhana tā kathyate tat ucyatām kaḥ upāyaḥ iti tatas muniḥ abhyuvāca dharmaḥ iti tatas jagāt brāhmaṇaḥ kaḥ dharmaḥ katham lakṣaṇaḥ kānyasya sādhanāni kimprayojanaḥ kān ca pratyupakaroti iti atas ebhyaḥ praśnebhyaḥ anantaram dharma vyākhyāna pratijñāyām atha śabdaḥ ānantaryam abhidhatte atas śabdaḥ api vairāgya prajñā kathā paripāka ādikām śiṣya guṇa sampadam hetu tvena apadiśati yasmāt ayam śiṣyaḥ guṇa sampadā yuktaḥ tatas asmai praśnebhyaḥ anantaram dharmam vyākhyāsyāmaḥ

kaḥ dharmaḥ iti āha yatas bhyudaya niḥśreyasa siddhiḥ sa dharmaḥ yāga devatā pūjā ādi kriyāṇām ājya puṣpa ādi nirvartyānām tadā eva vinaṣṭa tvāt uttara kālam phala dāna aśakteḥ yasmāt hetoḥ abhyudaya niḥśreyase bhavataḥ sa dharmaḥ iti boddhavyaḥ abhyudayaḥ brahma ādi lokeṣu iṣṭha śarīra prāptiḥ anartha uparamaḥ ca niḥśreyasam adhyātmanaḥ vaiśeṣika guṇa abhāva rūpaḥ mokṣaḥ

kṛtaḥ evaṃlakṣaṇaḥ dharmaḥ jñāyate iti ced āmnāyāt tasya prāmāṇyam katham iti āha tad vacanāt āmnāya prāmāṇyam tat iti hiraṇyagarbha parāmarśaḥ hiraṇyam retaḥ asya iti kṛtvā bhagavān maheśvaraḥ eva ucyate āptena ukta tvasya satya tā vyāpta tva ādi ha āptena hiraṇyagarbheṇa ukta tvāt āmnāyasya prāmāṇyam sādhyate īśvaraḥ ca sādhitaḥ tanu bhuvana ādīnām kārya tayā ghaṭa ādi vat buddhimat kartṛkatva anumānena

uktam dharma svarūpam tad lakṣaṇam ca sādhanāni asya idānīm dravya guṇa karmāṇi vakṣyāmaḥ tatra pṛthivī āpaḥ tejaḥ vāyuḥ ākāśam kālaḥ diś ātmā manaḥ iti dravyāṇi dravya tva abhisambandhāt dravyāṇi pṛthivī tva abhisambandhāt pṛthivī evam ap ādi saṃjñā nava eva dravyāṇi na adhikāni iti evam artham iti śabdaḥ

evam uddiṣṭāni dravyāṇi ke punar guṇāḥ iti āha rūpa rasa gandha sparśāḥ saṅkhyāḥ parimāṇāni pṛthaktvam saṃyoga vibhāgau paratva aparatve buddhyaḥ sukha duḥkhe icchā dveṣau prayatnaḥ ca guṇāḥ ete saptadaśa kaṇṭha uktāḥ rūpa ādayaḥ guṇāḥ caśabda samuccitāḥ ca gurutva dravya tva sna iha saṃskāra dharma adharma śabdāḥ gṛhyante ete yathāvasaram uttaratra vakṣyante

kāni punar karmāṇi iti āha utkṣepaṇam avakṣepaṇam ākuñcanam prasāraṇam gamanam iti karmāṇi etāni eva pañca karmāṇi draṣṭavyāni gamana grahaṇāt bhramaṇa recana ādīnām grahaṇam evam uddiṣṭāni dravya guṇa karmāṇi tad anuṣaṅgāt sāmānya viśeṣa samavāyāḥ api vakṣyante evam ṣṇṇām padārthānām sādharmya vaidharmya parijñānam viṣaya doṣa darśana dvāreṇa vairāgya utpattau satyām niḥśreyase sādhye dharma hetuḥ abhyudaye sādhye dharma hetu tvam punar amīṣām same yajeta iti pṛthivyāḥ adhas ambūni nayati ityādi yathāsvam anyeṣām dravyāṇām guṇānām tu kṛṣṇam ālabheta ityādi karmaṇām tu vrīhīn avahanti ityādi

vijñāta sādharmya vaidharmyāṇām ca dravya ādīnām abhyudaya niḥśreyasa hetu tvāt sādharmyam tāvat kathayati sat anityam dravya vat kāryam kāraṇam sāmānya viśeṣa vat iti dravya guṇa karmaṇā ām aviśeṣaḥ sat dravyam san suṇaḥ sat karma iti sattā trayāṇām aviśeṣaḥ tathā eva anitya tvam anyatra ākāśa ādibhyaḥ dravya vat iti samavāyikāraṇavat tvam aviśeṣaḥ paramāṇu ākāśa ādi varjam kāryatvam abhūtvā bhavanam tathā eva aviśeṣaḥ anyatra nitya dravyebhyaḥ kāraṇa tvam kārya janaka tvam trayāṇām aviśeṣaḥ kṣiti ādīni dravya guṇa karmaṇām samavāyi kāraṇam ākāśa ādīni guṇānām manaḥ antyāvayati dravye guṇa karmaṇām guṇāḥ tu rūpa rasa gandhān uṣṇa sparśa saṅkhyā parimāṇa eka pṛthak tva sneha śabdāḥ asamavāyi kāraṇam buddhi sakha duḥkha icchā dveṣa prayatna dharma adharma bhāvanā nimitta kāraṇam saṃyoga vibhāga auṣṇya guru tva drava tva vegāḥ ubhayathā kāraṇam para sva aparatva dvi tva dvi pṛthaktva pārimāṇḍalī ādayaḥ akāraṇam karmāṇi saṃyoga vibhāgeṣu asamavāyi kāraṇam sāmānyāni ca tāni dravya tva ādīnī viśeṣāḥ ca te iti sāmānya viśeṣāḥ tadvat tā trayāṇām aviśeṣaḥ

trayāṇām eka tve prāpte vaidharmyam ucyate tathā āha dravyāṇi dravya antaram ārabhante dravye ca dravyāṇi ca iti vigrahāt ekam anārambhakam samavāyi kāraṇāni dravyāṇi sva ātma vyatiriktam kārya dravyam ārabhante ākāśāt i anti ā avayavi dravyāṇi tu dravyam na ārambhante tulya jātīyānām mūrti kriyā rūpa ādimatām dvayoḥ bahūnām vā kāraṇānām kārya ārambhaka tvāt na ca evaṃvidhāni ākāśa ādīni manasaḥ asparśavat tvāt dravya akāraṇa tvam antya avaya vi dravyāṇām ca adṛṣṭa tvāt
guṇāḥ ca guṇa antaram guṇau ca guṇāḥ ca iti pūrvavat yathā tantu rūpa ādayaḥ sva āśraya samavete paṭa dravye rūpa ādi guṇān ātma vyatiriktān ārabhante

karma karma sādhyam na vidyate na karmaṇā karma janyate karmaṇām uparama darśanāt karma ārambhe hi karmaṇām niṣkarmaṇaḥ dravyasya anupalambhaḥ syāt evam ca kānicid dravyāṇi ārambhakāṇi kānicid na eva guṇāḥ kecid kāraṇa kecid na eva karmāṇi na eva karma kāraṇam iti etat vaidharmyam

vaidharmya antaram āha kārya avirodhi dravyam kāraṇa avirodhi ca vināśaḥ virodhaḥ pratibandhaḥ kkacid dravya ādinā kāryeṇa kāraṇa dravyam samavāyi asamavāyi kāraṇābhyām ca na virudhyate tathā hi aṅguli dravyam kāryam dvi aṅgulam janāyiṣyat tad arthena karmaṇā tad kṛtena saṃyogena tatas jātena dvi aṅgulena na virudhyate na api samavāyi asamavāyi kāraṇābhyām parva tad saṃyogābhyām vā manaḥ antya avaya vi dravyāṇi guṇa karmabhiḥ kāryaiḥ ākāśa ādīni guṇaiḥ nitya tvāt eṣām na kāraṇa virodhaḥ

ubhayathā guṇaḥ kārya kāraṇa ubhaya anubhayaiḥ avirodhī virodhī ca paramāṇu dvi aṇukā ādi antya avaya vi dravyeṣu rūpa ādayaḥ kārya ubhaya kāraṇaiḥ avirodhinaḥ yathāsambhavam rūpa rasa gandha sparśāḥ akārya kāraṇa bhūtāḥ avirodhinaḥ paraspareṇa virodhinaḥ ādyam adhyāntya śabdāḥ kārya ubhaya kāraṇaiḥ adṛṣṭaḥ kāryeṇa sparśavat dravya saṃyogena vega prayatnau saṃyoga vibhāgau sukha suḥkhe icchā dveṣau parasparataḥ akārya kāraṇa bhūtau virudhyete jñānam saṃskāra saṃtāna pratipakṣaiḥ saṃskāraḥ jñāna mada duḥkha ādibhiḥ iti yathāsambhavam etat draṣṭavyam
kārya virodhi karma saṃyoga vibhāga saṃskārāṇām kāryāṇām madhyāt saṃyogena eva karma virudhyate na vibhāga saṃskārābhyām saṃyoga anutpatti prasaṅgāt

vaidharmya antaram api kriyāvat guṇavat samavāyi kāraṇam iti dravya lakṣaṇam utkṣepaṇa ādikam karma kriyā yathāsambhavam yasmin yat samavāyena vartate tat kriyāvat anyatra ākāśa kāla diś ātmabhyaḥ guṇāḥ rūpa ādayaḥ yatra yathāsambhavam vartante tat guṇavat ayuta siddhānāmādhārya ādhāra bhūtānām iha iti yatas sa samavāyaḥ sa yasya asti tat samavāyi kāraṇam ca tat eva samavāyinaḥ vā kāryasya kāraṇam tatra kṣiti ādīni trayāṇām dravya guṇa karmaṇām samavāyi kāraṇam ākāśa ādīni guṇānām manaḥ antya avayavi dravye guṇa karmaṇām

dravya āśrayī aguṇavān saṃyoga vibhāgeṣu akāraṇam anapekṣaḥ iti guṇa lakṣaṇam dravyam āśrayati iti dravya āśrayī aguṇavān nirguṇaḥ saṃyoga vibhāgeṣu akāraṇam anapekṣaḥ iti sa apekṣaḥ kāraṇam tathā āha aṅgulyoḥ ākāśa saṃyogaḥ dvi aṅgula ākāśa saṃyoge karttavye dvi aṅgula utpattim apekṣate aṅgulyoḥ paraspara vibhāgaḥ dvi aṅgula ākāśa vibhāgam prati kārya vināśam apekṣate evam saṃyoga vibhāga lakṣaṇaḥ eva guṇaḥ saṃyoga vibhāgeṣu sa apekṣaḥ kāraṇam

eka dravyam aguṇam saṃyoga vibhāgeṣu anapekṣam kāraṇam iti karma lakṣaṇam ekam asya karmaṇaḥ dravyam āśrayaḥ na dve ekam eva vā dravye vartate iti eka dravyam na asya guṇāḥ santi iti aguṇam saṃyoga vibhāgeṣu kāryeṣu svasya āśrayasya anyatas vibhajya āśraya antareṇa saṃyojanāt utpādya vināśya anapekṣayā saṃyoga vibhāgeṣu anapekṣam kāraṇam iti

vaidharmya antaram api dravya guṇa karmaṇām dravyam kāraṇam sāmānyam sāmānya śabdaḥ samāna paryāyaḥ kṣiti ādīni trayāṇām kāraṇam samānam ākāśa ādīnām kevala guṇa kāraṇa tve api ekaikasya aneka guṇa tvāt ākāśa ādīni samānam guṇeṣu kāraṇam manaḥ antya avayavi dravye guṇa karmaṇām

tathā guṇaḥ saṃyogānām dravyam iti agni saṃyogāt guṇa antara prādurbhāvāt iti ātma saṃyoga prayatnābhyām haste karma iti vākyebhyaḥ saṃyogaḥ eva dravya guṇa karmaṇām samānam kāraṇam na anyaḥ guṇaḥ tathā hi tūla piṇḍasya vegavatā tūlena saṃyogāt karma dvi tūlaka dravyam tatra ca parimāṇam mahat utpadyate anye guṇāḥ yathāyogam
saṃyoga vibhāgānām karma sva āśrayam anyatas vibhajya āśraya antareṇa saṃyojayati atas saṃyoga vibhāgānām samānam kāraṇam karma
na dravyāṇām vyatirekāt yadi khalu dravyasya kāraṇam karma bhavet tathā sati kṛtvā api saṃyoge na nivarteta nivṛtte tu karmaṇi kevalasya saṃyogasya upalambhāt manyāmahe na dravya kāraṇam karma

guṇa vaidharmyāt na karmaṇām gurutva drava tvanodana abhidhāra saṃyukta saṃyogāḥ sva āśraye para āśraye ca karmāraṇam prayatna adṛṣṭau tu para āśrayaḥ eva tatra tāvat karma na sva āśraye karma kāraṇam niṣkriya dravyān upalabdhi prasaṅgāt na api para āśraye tad saṃyogena eva nivartita tvāt tasmāt etaiḥ karma kāraṇaiḥ guṇaiḥ vaidharmyāt na karma karma kāraṇam
aparam vaidharmyam dravyāṇām dravyam karmam sāmānyam sajātīyānām dvayoḥ bahūnām vā dravyāṇām dravyam tantūnām iva paṭaḥ samānam kāryam

dvi tva prabhṛtayaḥ ca saṅkhyāḥ pṛthaktvam saṃyoga vibhāgāḥ ca dvayoḥ dravyayoḥ dvi tvam sāmānyam kāryam trayāṇām tritvam ityādi tathā eva dvi pṛthaktva ādi dvayoḥ dravyayoḥ saṃyujyamānayoḥ saṃyogaḥ vibhajyamānayoḥ vibhāgaḥ eṣām aneka āśrita tvāt samān tvam
asamavāyāt sāmānyam karma kāryam na vidyate anekasmin dravye ekasya karmaṇaḥ samavāya niṣedhāt na dravyāṇām dvi bahūnām karma samānam kāryam asti
saṃyogānām dravyam dvayoḥ bahūnām vā asamavāyi kāraṇānām saṃyogānām dravyam samānam kāryam tantu saṃyogānām iva paṭaḥ
rūpāṇām rūpam dvayoḥ bahūnām vā kāraṇa rūpāṇām kārya dravya āśritam rūpam samānam kāryam yathā ghaṭa rūpam kapāla rūpāṇām evam rasa ādīnām
guru tva prayatna saṃyogānām utkṣepaṇam āditya raśmīnām aguru tvāt parvate tathābhūta prayatna abhāvāt loṣṭasya ca hastena asaṃyukta tvāt anutkṣepaṇam iti guru tva ādīnām utkṣepaṇam samānam kāryam
saṃyoga nibhāgāḥ karmaṇām ubhaya karma jāḥ ye saṃyogāḥ vibhāgāḥ ca te karmaṇām samānam kāryam

kāraṇa sāmānye dravya karmaṇām karma akāraṇam uktam iti yasmin prakarāne dravya ādīnām kāraṇam samānam varṇitam tasmin kāraṇa sāmānye dravya karmaṇām yatas karma akāraṇam uktam atas tāni api asya kāryam sāmānyam na bhavanti iti evam nānā dravya guṇa karmāṇi iti siddham

kāraṇa abhāvāt kārya abhāvaḥ kārya kāraṇa śabdau pūrvam uktau tad nirūpaṇa artham āha yasya abhāvāt tantu ādeḥ samavāyi kāraṇasya tad saṃyogānām vā asamavāyi kāraṇānām kārya dravyam na jāyate paṭa ādi vināśe vā vinaśyati tat kāraṇam anyat kāryam
na tu kārya abhāvāt kāraṇa abhāvaḥ na punar paṭa ādeḥ anutpattau dravyasya tantūnām tad saṃyogānām vā anutpattiḥ

uktāḥ ānuṣaṅgikāḥ sāmānya ādayaḥ trayaḥ padārthāḥ tatra sāmānyam kathayati sāmānyam viśeṣaḥ iti buddhi apekṣam bhinneṣu piṇḍeṣu anuvartamānām gauḥ gauḥ iti budbhim apekṣya ebhyaḥ eva ca parasparataḥ vyāvartamānām ayam asmāt anyaḥ iti tad anubṛtti buddhi apekṣam sāmānyam vyāvṛtti buddhi apekṣaḥ viśeṣaḥ iti
bhāvaḥ sāmānyam eva bhāvaḥ sattā sāmānyam eva triṣu api dravya ādiṣu anuvartamāna tvāt na viśeṣaḥ

dravya tvam guṇa tvam karma tvam ca sāmānyāni viśeṣāḥ ca kṣiti ādiṣu yatas dravyam dravyam iti anuvṛtti buddhiḥ rūpa ādiṣu ca guṇaḥ guṇaḥ iti utkṣepaṇa ādiṣu karma karma iti tāni dravya guṇa tva karma tvāni sāmānyāni parasparataḥ ca vyāvṛtteḥ viśeṣāḥ

anyatra antyebhyaḥ viśeṣebhyaḥ nityya dravyeṣu paramāṇu ākāśa ādiṣu samavāyena vartamānāḥ tulya ākṛti guṇeṣu ayam anyaḥ ayam anyaḥ iti atyanta vyāvṛtti buddhi hetavaḥ tad darśinām viśeṣaka tvāt viśeṣāḥ evam viśeṣāḥ vyākhyātāḥ
sattā tu sat iti yatas dravya guṇa karmasu bhinneṣu dravya ādiṣu triṣu yatas jāyate sat sat iti buddhiḥ sā sattā
āśraya vināśāt asyāḥ vināśaḥ iti ced na yatas dravya guṇa karmabhyaḥ artha antaram sattā yasmāt dravya ādibhyaḥ vyatiriktā sattā tasmāt na dravya ādi vināśe sattā vinaśyati iti

dravya ādi vyatireke yuktiḥ eka dravya vyavat tvāt na dravyam paramāṇu ākāśa ādi dravyam adravyam kāraṇa dravya abhāvāt aneka dravyam vā ghaṭa ādi samavāyi kāraṇa dravya yukta tvāt sattā punar pratyekam parisamāptyā vartamānāḥ eka dravyavat tvāt na dravyam
guṇa karmasu ca bhāvān na karma na guṇaḥ guṇānām guṇeṣu avṛtteḥ sarmasu ca karmaṇām guṇeṣu karmasu ca sattāyāḥ vartamāna tvāt na guṇa karmaṇī sattā
sāmānya viśeṣa abhāvāt ca yadi sattā dravya ādīnām anyatamā syāt evam dravya ādiṣu iva sattāyām api dravya tvāt ayaḥ sāmānya viśeṣāḥ vartteran na ca evam tasmāt na sattā dravya guṇa karmāṇi
eka dravyavat tvena dravya tvam uktam yathā pratidravyam sākalyena vartamāna tvāt na dravyam sattā tathā eka dravyavat tvāt na dravyam dravya tvam
sāmānya viśeṣa abhāvena ca dravya ādiṣu iva dravya tva ādīnām madhyāt kaścid sāmānya viśeṣaḥ dravya tve varteta yadi dravyam guṇaḥ karma vā syāt tasmāt na dravya ādīni dravya tvam
guṇe bhāvāt guṇa tvam uktam guṇeṣu guṇānām avṛtteḥ guṇa tvam ca guṇeṣu vartate tasmāt na guṇaḥ
sāmānya viśeṣa abhāvena ca yadi guṇa tvam dravyam karma vā syāt tasmin dravya tvam karma tvam vā sāmānya viśeṣau syātām na ca evam tasmāt na dravyam karma vā guṇa tvam
karmaṇi bhāvāt karma tvam uktam karmaṇi karma tvasya vṛtteḥ karmaṇaḥ karmaṇi ca āvṛtteḥ na karma karma tvam
sāmānya viśeṣa abhāvena ca dravya tvam guṇa tvam vā karma tve syātām yadi dravyam guṇaḥ vā syāt tasmāt na dravya guṇau karma tvam

sat liṅga aviśeṣāt viśeṣa liṅga abhāvāt cekaḥ bhāvaḥ iti eka śabdena abhedaḥ kathyate na tu saṅkhyā liṅgyate anena iti liṅgam pratyayaḥ yena liṅgena sat sat iti pratyayena pratīyate sattā tasya sarvatra aviśiṣṭa tvāt viśiṣṭasya ca pratyayasya abhāvāt abhinnā sattā

evam dravya ādīnām nānātve siddhe pṛthivī ādīnām dravya lakṣaṇa aviśeṣāt eka tve prāpte lakṣaṇa bhedena vaidharmyam āha rūpa rasa gandha sparśavatī pṛthivī ete asyāḥ rūpa rasa gandha sparśāḥ viśeṣa guṇāḥ anye tu saṅkhyā parimāṇa pṛthak tva saṃyoga vibhāga paratvāḥ aparatva gurutva naimittika drava tva saṃskārāḥ rūpam śekla ādi rasaḥ madhura ādiḥ gandhaḥ surabhiḥ asurabhiḥ ca sparśaḥ asyāḥ snuṣṇa aśīta tve sati pākajaḥ kāryam bāhyam ādhyātmikam ca

rūpa rasa sparśavatyaḥ āpaḥ dravāḥ snigdhāḥ ca śukla madhura śītāḥ eva rūpa rasa sparśāḥ dravāḥ iti sāṃsiddhikam drava tvam snigdhāḥ iti āsām eva snehaḥ saṅkhyā parimāṇa pṛthak tva saṃyoga vibhāga paratvāḥ aparatva gurutva saṃskārāḥ ca kāryam pūrvavat
tejaḥ rūpa sparśa vat rūpam bhāsvaram śuklam ca sparśaḥ uṣṇaḥ eva saṅkhyā parimaṇa pṛthak tva saṃyoga vibhāga paratvā aparatva naimittika drava tva saṃskārāḥ ca kāryam pūrvavat
vāyuḥ sparśavān anuṣṇa aśītaḥ apāka jaḥ sparśaḥ saṅkhyā parimāṇa pṛthak tva saṃyoga vibhāga paratvāḥ aparatva gurutva saṃskārāḥ ca kāryam pūrvavat bhauma ādi dehāḥ bhūmi ādi lokeṣu
te ākāśe na vidyante te rūpa rasa gandha sparśāḥ na santi ākāśe tasya guṇāḥ śabda saṅkhyā parimāṇa pṛthak tva saṃyoga vibhāgāḥ

sarpiḥ jatu madhūcchiṣṭānām pārthivānām agni saṃyogāt drava tā adbhiḥ sāmānyam madhūcchiṣṭam sikthakam sarpiṣaḥ jatunaḥ madhūcchiṣṭasya ca agni saṃyogāt drava tā yā san jāyate tat adbhiḥ samāna tvam pṛthivyāḥ
trapu sīsa loha rajata suvarṇānām taijasānām agni saṃyogāt drava tā adbhiḥ sāmānyam eṣām ca taijasānām yat agni saṃyogāt drava tvam upajāyate tat adbhiḥ sāmānyam tejasaḥ

viṣāṇī kakudmān prāntevāladhiḥ sāsnāvān iti go tve dṛṣṭam liṅgam dṛṣṭānta artham sūtram go tve iti go tva avacchinnā vyaktiḥ viṣāṇam kakudam sāsnā ca asya asti iti viṣāṇī kakudmān sāsnāvān prānta śabdena kaṭi bhāgaḥ vālā asmin dhīyante iti vāladhi śabdena puccham prānte vāladhiḥ asya iti prāntevāladhiḥ viṣāṇi ādibhiḥ śabdaiḥ tadvat pratipādakaiḥ api artha vyāpārāt dharmāḥ eva vyapadiśyante
yathā apratyakṣāyām go vyaktau kathañcid gṛhyamāṇāḥ viṣāṇa ādayaḥ liṅgam dṛṣṭam anumāpakāḥ tathā sparśaḥ ca sparśaḥ upalabhyamānaḥ nirāśrayasya anupapatteḥ vāyum anumāpayati
na ca dṛṣṭānām sparśaḥ iti adṛṣṭa liṅgaḥ vāyuḥ yadi khalu ayam kṣiti ādi sparśaḥ abhaviṣyat gandha rasa rūpaiḥ saha upalabhemahi na ca evam tasmāt pṛthivī ādi vyatiriktasya vāyoḥ liṅgam
adravyavat tvāt dravyam yaḥ paramāṇu svabhāvaḥ vāyuḥ sa khalu adravyavat tvāt samavāyi kāraṇa rahita tvāt dravyam dravyam hi adravyam neka dravyam ca
kriyāvat tvāt guṇavat tvāt ca kriyāvat guṇavat iti dravya lakṣaṇāt yatra kriyāḥ guṇāḥ ca samavetāḥ saḥ api mahān vāyuḥ dravyam
adravyavat tvena nitya tvam uktam paramāṇu lakṣaṇasya vāyoḥ adravyavat tvena samavāyi kāraṇa rahita tvena nitya tvam uktam
vāyoḥ vāyu saṃmūrcchanam nānātve liṅgam tiryak gāminaḥ vāyoḥ vāyu saṃmūrcchanena vāyu antara saṃśleṣeṇa ūrdhva gamanam pravartate tatas ūrdhva gamanāt saṃśleṣaḥ saṃśleṣāt vāyoḥ aneka tvam anumīyate

nanu ca vāyuḥ iti sati sannikarṣe pratyakṣa abhāvāt dṛṣṭam liṅgam na vidyate yathā ayam gauḥ iti goḥ cakṣuṣā sannikarṣe sati pratyakṣeṇa viṣāṇa ādīni tad yogi tayā dṛṣṭāni kadācid liṅgam na evam tvacā vāyoḥ sannikarṣe sati ayam vāyuḥ iti pratyakṣeṇa tad guṇa tayā sparśaḥ upalabdhaḥ yena anupalabhyamānam kadācid vāyum anumāpayet

kṣiti ādi sparśa vidharma tvāt asya sparśasya nirāśrayasya ca abhāvāt vāyuḥ āśrayaḥ iti ced sāmānyatas dṛṣṭāt ca aviśeṣaḥ ākāśa ādīnām api parokṣa tvāt tad pratiṣedhena vāyoḥ eva ayam sparśaḥ iti ayam viśeṣaḥ etasmāt sāmānyatas dṛṣṭān na avagamyate vibhūnām sparśavat tve bhāvānām pratighātaḥ iti ced evam tarhi vāyoḥ eva ayam bhavat prasiddhasya sparśaḥ na daśam asya dravyasya iti katham jñāyate
tasmāt āgamikam tasmāt vāyuḥ asti iti vākyam āgamikam pravāda mātram iti arthaḥ

na etat saṃjñā akarma tu asmad viśiṣṭānām liṅgam asmad ādīnām sakāśāt yaḥ bhagavān vijñāna ādibhiḥ viśiṣṭaḥ maheśvaraḥ tadīyam saṃjñā praṇayanam navānām eva dravyāṇām bhāve liṅgam daśam asya saṃjñā anabhidhānāt tasmāt nava eva dravyāṇi atas vāyoḥ eva sparśaḥ asmad viśiṣṭānām iti pūjāyām bahuvacanam

sa katham jñāyate iti ucyate pratyakṣa pūrvaka tvāt saṃjñā karmaṇaḥ pratyakṣeṇa hi padārtham ālocayantaḥ saṃjñāḥ praṇayanti dṛṣṭam ca dārakasya nāmakaraṇe praṇītāḥ ca imāḥ khalu saṃjñāḥ tasmāt manyāmahe asti bhagavān asmad viśiṣṭaḥ yaḥ asmad ādi parokṣāṇām api bhāvānām pratyakṣa darśī yena idam saṃjñā ādi praṇītam iti

niṣkramaṇam praveśanam iti ākāśasya liṅgam yat etat niṣkramaṇam praveśanam ca puruṣasya dvāra ādinā bhavati na bhitti ādau tad ākāśa kṛtam atas niṣkramaṇa praveśane ākāśasya liṅgam iti mūrta abhāvaḥ hi ākāśam
tat na tad aliṅgam eka dravyavat tvāt karmaṇaḥ niṣkramaṇa ādi karma puruṣe vartamānam eka dravyam karma iti ukta tvāt niṣkriya tvāt ca ākāśasya ākāśa āvṛtti katham tat gamayet asambandhāt

yathā loṣṭa vṛtti patanam guru tvasya liṅgam evam puruṣa vṛtti niṣkramaṇam ākāśasya liṅgam iti ced na kāraṇa antara anuklṛpti vaidharmyāt ca guru tvam karmaṇaḥ asamavāyi kāraṇam uktam tad anumīyatām na tu ākāśasya asamavāyi kāraṇa tvam yujyate nitya tva dravya tva anāśrita tvaiḥ ākāśasya gurutva ādinā asamavāyi kāraṇena vaidharmyāt

yat uktam niṣkramaṇam ca ākāśa kṛta tvāt dvāra ādinā iti etat na saṃyogāt abhāvaḥ karmaṇaḥ bhitti ādinā sparśavat dravyeṇa śarīra ādeḥ karma ādhārasya saṃyogāt niṣkramaṇam nivartate na tu ākāśa abhāvāt tasya sarva gata tvāt tatra api bhāvaḥ tasmāt śabda liṅgam eva ākāśam

bherī ādīnām eva nimittānām śabdaḥ guṇaḥ iti ced na kāraṇa guṇa pūrvaḥ kārye guṇaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ kārya antara aprādurbhāvāt ca śabdaḥ sparśavatām aguṇaḥ iha ye sparśavatām viśeṣa guṇāḥ ekaika indriya grāhyāḥ te kāraṇa guṇaiḥ kārye niṣpādyante na ca bherī avayaveṣu pūpa ādayaḥ iva laścit śabda bhāgaḥ samavetaḥ upalabhyate tasmāt akāraṇa guṇa pūrva tvāt na bherī ādeḥ sparśavataḥ viśeṣa guṇaḥ śabdaḥ yaḥ ca sparśavataḥ viśeṣa guṇaḥ sa kārye yāvat kāryam upalbhyamānaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ na ca evam śabdaḥ tatas na sparśavat viśeṣa guṇaḥ kiñca sparśavat viśeṣa guṇaḥ ārabdhe kārye kāraṇa guṇaiḥ ārabhyate na ca yadā śabdena śabdaḥ ārabhyate tadā kiñcid kāryam upannam paśyāmaḥ tasmāt kārya antarā prāduḥ bhāvāt ca na śabdaḥ sparśavataḥ viśeṣa guṇaḥ iti

paratra samavāyāt pratyakṣa tvāt ca na ātma guṇaḥ na manaḥ guṇaḥ paratra bahis iti arthaḥ ye khalu ātma guṇāḥ te sukha ādayaḥ iva antar śarīram upalabhyante na ca evam śabdaḥ bahis bahubhiḥ upalabhyamāna tvāt na ca ātma guṇaḥ bāhya indriya grāhyaḥ ayam tu śrotra pratyakṣaḥ tasmāt na ātma guṇaḥ atas eva bahis upalabhyamāna tvāt bāhya indriya pratyakṣa tvāt ca na manaḥ guṇaḥ śrotra pratyakṣa tvāt ca na diś kālayoḥ
tasmāt guṇaḥ san liṅgam ākāśasya tasmāt upalabhyamānaḥ śabdaḥ ākāśam gamayati
dravya tva nitya tve vāyunā vyākhyāte yathā adravyavat tvāt paramāṇu bhūtaḥ vāyuḥ dravyam nityaḥ ca evam ākāśam kāraṇa dravya abhāvāt dravyam nityam ca
tattvam bhāvena yathā sat liṅga aviśeṣāt viśeṣa liṅga abhāvāt ca ekaḥ bhāvaḥ evam śabda liṅga aviśeṣāt viśeṣa liṅga abhāvāt ca ekam ākāśam

yat uktam sparśavat viśeṣa guṇāḥ ārabdhe kārya dravye guṇān ārabhante śabdaḥ tu anārabdhe dravye śabdam ārabhate iti tat ayuktam anārabdhe api puṣpa vastrābhyām dravyātare puṣpa gandhasya vastre gandha ārambhāt tathā apsu uṣṇa tāyāḥ ucyate puṣpa vastrayoḥ sati sannikarṣe gandha antara aprādurbhāvaḥ vastre gandha abhāva liṅgam

puṣpeṇa khalu saṃyukte vastre na puṣpa gandhena gandhaḥ ārabhyate vastra gandhasya api sambhavāt paṣpavastra gandhābhyām dvābhyām vilakṣaṇam gandha antaram upajanitam upalabhemahi na ca evam api tu puṣpa gandham eva upalabhāmahe tasmāt anārabdhe kārye puṣpa gandhena gandhaḥ ārabhyate iti ayuktam gandha antara prasaṅgāt

etena apsu uṣṇa tā vyākhyātā apām tejasā saṃyoge sati vilakṣaṇa sparśa anutpattiḥ aiṣṇya abhāvasya liṅgam ayāvat dravya bhāvi tvam ca salile auṣṇyasya sūkṣmāṇām puṣpa avayavānām vastre tejaḥ vayavānām ca apsu saṅkrānteḥ saṃyukta samavāyāt gandha sparśa upalabdhiḥ

nanu ayāvat dravya bhāvinaḥ rūpa ādayaḥ vastra udakayoḥ puṣpa gandha uṣṇa sparśa upalambha kāle sva gandha śīta sparśa anupalabdheḥ na vyavasthitaḥ pṛthivyām gandhaḥ pārthive vāsasi vyavasthitaḥ api sva gandhaḥ puṣpa gandha abhibhavāt na upalabhyate
kiñca tejasi uṣṇa tā tejasi eva uṣṇa tā vyavasthitā na apsu saṃkrāmati
tathā auṣṇya upalabdhi kāle apsu śīta tā tejaḥ vayavānupraveśāt saṃyukta samavāyāt anuṣṇa upalabdhau api anupalabhyamānā api salile śīta tā vyavasthitā eva abhibhavāt na upalabhyate

kālaḥ idānīm kathyate aparasmin param yugapad a yugapad ciram kṣipram iti kāla liṅgāni etāni aparatva vyatikara ādīni kāla liṅgāni tatra pareṇa diś pradeśena saṃyukte yūni paratva jñāne jāte sthavire ca apareṇa diś pradeśena saṃyukte apara tva jñāna utpattau kṛṣṇa keśa ādi valī palita ādi paryālocanayā yena nimittena yūni aparatva jñānam sthavire ca paratva jñānam jāyate sa kālaḥ tathā tulya kāryeṣu kartṛṣu yugapad kurvanti ayugapad kutvanti iti yatas pratyayaḥ jāyate sa kālaḥ tathā ekam kriyā phalam uddiśya odana ākhyam bhūyasīnām adhiśrayaṇa ādi kriyāṇām prabandha pravṛttau tulye kartari ciram adya kṛtam kṣipram adya kṛtam iti yatas pratyayau bhavataḥ sa kālaḥ iti tasya guṇāḥ saṃkhyā parimāṇa pṛthak tva saṃyoga vibhāgāḥ
kiñca dravya tva nitya tve vāyunā vyākhyāte adravyavat tvāt paramāṇuvāyoḥ iva dravya tva nitya tve kālasya
tattvam bhāvena yathā sa liṅga aviśeṣāt viśeṣa liṅga abhāvāt ca ekaḥ bhāvaḥ tathā kāla liṅga aviśeṣāt viśeṣa liṅga abhāvāt ca ekaḥ kālaḥ

kālasya ekatve katham ārambha kāla ādi vyapadeśaḥ iti atra āha kārya viśeṣeṇa nānātvam kāryam kriyā kriyā viśeṣeṇa āviṣṭasya vastunaḥ ārambha sthiti vināśa kriyā dṛṣṭvā ekasya api kālasya nānā tva upacārāt ārambha kāla ādi vyapadeśaḥ

nanu kriyā mātram kālaḥ kutas kāla liṅgānām nityeṣu abhāvāt anityeṣu bhāvāt yadi kriyā vyatiriktaḥ syāt nityaḥ kālaḥ evam nityeṣu api ākāśa ādiṣu kāla liṅgāni pratibhāseran anityeṣu eva tu bhavanti tasmāt abhinirvartyamāneṣu eva avadhiḥ kālaḥ tasmāt kriyā eva kāt iti na etat vastu nirvṛtti uttara kāla bhāvi tvāt kāla liṅgāni anityeṣu bhavanti na tu kriyāyāḥ kāla tvāt
teṣām tu kāraṇe kāla ākhyā eṣām kāla liṅgānām nirnimittānām asambhavāt kriyā nimitta tve kṛtam iti syāt na yugapad tasmāt eṣām yat kāraṇam tasmin kāla ākhyā
itas idam iti yatas tat diśaḥ liṅgam mūrta dravyam avadhim kṛtvā yatas etat bhavati idam asmāt pūrveṇa ityādi pratyayaḥ tat diśaḥ liṅgam guṇāḥ saṃkhyā parimāṇa pṛthak tva saṃyoga vibhāgāḥ
kiñca dravya tva nitya tve vāyunā vyākhyāte adravyavat tvāt vāyu vat dravya tva nitya tve diśaḥ
tattvam bhāvena diś liṅga aviśeṣāt viśeṣa liṅga abhāvāt ca ekā diś iti arthaḥ
sati eka tve kārya viśeṣeṇa nānātvam pūrveṇa deva yajanam dakṣiṇena pitṛ yajanam ityādinā kriyā viśeṣeṇa nānā tvasya diśaḥ pūrva dakṣiṇa ādeḥ upacāraḥ

itaretara āśrayam iti ced evam tarhi āditya saṃyogāt bhūta pūrvāt bhaviṣyataḥ bhūtāt ca prācī savituḥ ahar ādau yena kalpata diś pradeśena saṃyogaḥ abhūt bhavati bhaviṣyati vā tasmāt iti asaṃyogāt prācī iti vyapadeśaḥ prāñcati atas ādityam iti
tathā dakṣiṇā pratīcī udīcī ca asmāt eva āditya samprayogāt dakṣiṇa ādi vyapadeśaḥ
etena digantarāṇi vyākhyātāni anena eva prakāreṇa pūrva dakṣiṇa ādīni digantarāṇi vyākhyātāni

tatra idānīm ātmā karaṇaiḥ adhigantavyaḥ karaṇāni śabda ādibhyaḥ guṇebhyaḥ nanu guṇa tvam asiddham śabda ādīnām siddham kṛtvā ucyate nanu guṇa tve kutas saṃśyaḥ āha kim saṃśayaḥ api hetumān evam etat kaḥ hetuḥ tat āha sāmānya pratyakṣāt viśeṣa apratyakṣāt viśeṣa smṛteḥ ca saṃśayaḥ sthāṇu puruṣayoḥ ūrdhva tām sāmānyam paśyan viśeṣa hetūn pāṇi ādi koṭara ādīn apaśyan smarati ca viśeṣān atas saṃśayaḥ kim ayam sthāṇuḥ syāt puruṣaḥ na vā iti

sa dvividhaḥ bāhyaḥ ābhyantaraḥ ca iti bāhyaḥ api dvividhaḥ pratyakṣaḥ apratyakṣaḥ ca apratyakṣe tāvat dṛṣṭam adṛṣṭam prāptaḥ manuṣyaḥ iti ukte kim imam dṛṣṭam paśyeyam adṛṣṭam iti śravaṇa mātrāt eva sa āśayaḥ
pratyakṣe tu dṛṣṭam ca dṛṣṭa vat samprati dṛṣṭvā puruṣam tam eva dṛṣṭam ālocayataḥ kim ayam mayā dṛṣṭa pūrvaḥ kadācid uta adṛṣṭaḥ iti saṃśayaḥ

dṛṣṭam yathādṛṣṭam ayathā dṛṣṭam ubhayathā dṛṣṭa tvāt ādau kuntalī devadattaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ madhye muṇḍaḥ tṛtīyasyām avasthāyām kuntalī caturthyām ālāpa ādibhiḥ avagate ārūpamatreṇa ca saṃdhyā ādau kim ayam kuntalī syāt uta muṇḍaḥ vā iti saṃśayaḥ pūrva sūtre aneka artha anusmṛteḥ saṃśayaḥ anena tu eka arthe viśeṣa anusmaraṇāt

ābhyantaraḥ tu vidyā avidyātaḥ ca saṃśayaḥ vidyā samyak jñānam avidyā mithyājñānam daivajñena śubham ādiṣṭam satyam abhūt dvitīyam asatyam tṛtīyasyām avasthāyām saṃśayaḥ kim ādya avasthāvat satyam uta dvitīya avasthā vat asatyam iti evam kathitaḥ saṃśayaḥ
tatra śabdaḥ eva tāvat kathyatām śrotra grahaṇaḥ yaḥ arthaḥ sa śabdaḥ śrotreṇa gṛhyate yaḥ arthaḥ sa śabdaḥ sāmānya ādīnām artha śabdasya asaṅketi tvāt śabda tvam śabdaḥ mā bhūt iti artha grahaṇam
tasmin dravyam karma guṇaḥ iti saṃśayaḥ sādhāraṇa rūpa tvāt dravya ādi tvena śabde saṃśayaḥ

tat āha tulya jātīyeṣu artha antara bhūteṣu ca viśeṣasya ubhayathā dṛṣṭa tvāt pṛthivī tvam sajātīyāt salila ādeḥ pṛthivyāḥ viśeṣaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ asajātīyābhyām ca guṇa karmabhyām tatas śabde api kim ayam śrotra grāhya tvam viśeṣaḥ guṇaiḥ tulyasya artha antara bhūtasya vā iti saṃśayaḥ
na etat eka dravyavat tvāt na dravyam ekasmin dravye ākāśe vartamāna tvāt na dravyam ayam śabdaḥ dravyam hi adravyam paramāṇu ādi aneka dravyam vā ghaṭa ādi
acākṣuṣattvāt na karma dravyam karma vā yat indriya antara pratyakṣam tat cākṣuṣam api dṛṣṭam ayam tu śabdaḥ śrotra pratyakṣaḥ api san na cākṣuṣaḥ evam sthitaḥ guṇaḥ
kintu guṇasya sataḥ apavargaḥ karmabhiḥ sādharnyam karmabhiḥ asya punar guṇa bhūtasya api sādharmi apavargaḥ vināśaḥ utpatti anantaram agrahaṇāt vināśaḥ anumīyate

sataḥ api nimittāt agrahaṇam iti ced na sataḥ liṅga abhāvāt yat sat api nimittān na gṛhyate tasya liṅgam sadbhāva grāhakam bhavati śabdasya tu uccāraṇāt ūrdhvaṃsaṃyogi a ādeḥ liṅgasya abhāvāt asat tā eva
kiñca nitya vaidharmyāt uccarīta pradhvaṃsaḥ nityaiḥ vaidharmyam tasmāt anityaḥ
kiñca kāryatvāt kāryaḥ ca śabdaḥ saṃyoga ādibhyaḥ utpatteḥ tasmāt anityaḥ
kiñca abhāvāt prāc abhāvāt iti arthaḥ prāgabhāvavataḥ vināśāt prāc abhāvaḥ ca asya kāraṇebhyaḥ utpatteḥ
na ca tāni vyañjakāni kutas kāraṇataḥ vikārāt yasmāt bherī ādi kāraṇebhyaḥ śabdasya vikāraḥ avagamyate mahati bherī ādau mahān alpe alpaḥ
abhivyaktau tu doṣāt nitya tvena abhivyaktau śabdaḥ anyena yajñe na anyena prayujyeta darbha ādi vat yātayāma tva ādi doṣāt tasmāt anityaḥ
kutas kāryatvam iti āha saṃyogāt vibhāgāt śabdāt ca śabda niṣpatteḥ bherī daṇḍa saṃyogāt vastra dala vibhāgāt śabdāt ca śabdasya vīci santāna vat niṣpatteḥ manyāmahe kāryaḥ śabdaḥ iti
liṅgāt ca anityaḥ tebhyaḥ trayaḥ vedāḥ ajāyante iti vacanāt vaidikāt liṅgāt anityaḥ

nanu nityaḥ śabdaḥ dvayoḥ tu pravṛttyoḥ abhāvāt kāryāṇām hi bhāvānām dve pravṛttī ekā nirvṛttiḥ anyā kārya viniyoga rūpā śabdasya punar arthapratipatti atha evam pravṛttiḥ uccāraṇa ākhyā na ātma arthā tasmāt nityaḥ
saṃkhyā bhāvāt uccarita pradhvaṃsi tve śabdasya dvis ayam āmnātaḥ iti vinaṣṭa tvāt saṃkhyā abhyāvṛttiḥ na bhavet asti ca tasmāt nityaḥ
prathamā śabdāt prathamā śabdāt iti tris prathamām anvāhaḥ iti vākyam uccarita vināśi tve śabdasya prathamāyāḥ ṛcaḥ abhyāvṛtti gaṇanam na syāt asti ca tasmāt nityaḥ
sampratipatti bhāt ca vināśi tve śabdasya saḥ eva ayam go śabdaḥ iti sampratipattiḥ pratyabhijñā na syāt tasmāt nityaḥ

na etat sāram sandigdhāḥ sati bahu tve pradīpā dāvat vipra vṛtta tvam dṛṣṭam dvis vidyut niḥsṛtā iti saṃkhyā bhāvaḥ sampratipattiḥ jvālā ādau tasmāt anityeṣu api bhāvāt bahavaḥ api amī hetavaḥ saṃśayitāḥ tasmāt anityaḥ
saṃkhyā bhāvaḥ sāmānyatas prathamā śabdaḥ sampratipatti bhāvaḥ ca iti sādṛśyāt ete draṣṭavyāḥ
evam diś antānām vaidharmyam uktvā ātmānam upakramate prasiddhāḥ indriya arthāḥ

śabda ādayaḥ yasmāt guṇa ādi svabhāvāḥ prasiddhāḥ tebhyaḥ ca indriyāṇi atas idānīm indriya artha prasiddhiḥ indriya arthebhyaḥ artha antara tve hetuḥ grāhyāṇām arthānām śabda ādīnām yā iyam prasiddhiḥ tayā śrotra ādīnām karaṇānām anayā indriya artha prasiddhyai ebhyaḥ grāhya grahaṇebhyaḥ indriya arthebhyaḥ paraḥ grahītā ātmā anumīyate
saḥ anapadeśaḥ grāhya grahaṇa prasiddhi ākhyaḥ gratī tṛ sadbhāve yaḥ hetuḥ uktaḥ hetuḥ uktaḥ saḥ anapadeṣaḥ akāraṇam iti arthaḥ
kim ātma kalpanayā katham indriyāṇi grahītṝṇi eva na bhavanti na etat kāraṇa ajñānāt bhūtānām indriya kāraṇānām a jña tvāt tad kāryāṇi indriyāṇi api ajñāni
bhūta ajñānam kārya ajñānāt anyasya bhūta kāryasya ghaṭa dera jña tvāt bhūtāni api ajñāni
ajñānāt ca bhūtānām ajñānāt indriyāṇi api ajñāni iti upasaṃhāra artham idam sūtram
anyaḥ eva hetuḥ iti anapadeśaḥ anyaḥ hetu lakṣaṇa bāhyaḥ iti arthaḥ tathā hi indriya artha prasiddhiḥ indriya artha dharma tvāt ātmanā asambandhāt na tam anumāpayet atas anapadeśaḥ

na etat saṃyogi samavāyi eka artha samavāyi virodhi ca kāryam kārya antarasya kāraṇam kāraṇa antarasya virodhi abhūtam bhūtasya bhūtam abhūtasya abhūtam abhūtasya bhūtam bhūtasya dhūmaḥ agneḥ saṃyogi viṣāṇam goḥ samavāyi eka artha samavāyi dvidhā kāryam kārya antarasya yathā rūpam sparśasya kāraṇam kāraṇa antarasya yathā pāṇiḥ pādasya caturdhā virodhi abhūtam varṣa karma vāyu abhra saṃyogasya bhūtasya liṅgam bhūtam varṣa karma vāyu abhra saṃyogasya abhūtasya liṅgam abhūtā śyāma tā abhūtasya agni saṃyogasya liṅgam bhūtam kāryam bhūtasya kāraṇa saṃyogasya liṅgam tasmāt iha prasiddhānām indriya arthānām karaṇa tā karma tā ca samavāyinī ātma liṅgam na te ātmani samavāyinī iti ced evam etat anyathā tu prayogaḥ indriyāṇi kartṛpta yojyāni karaṇa tvāt vā asya ādi vat iti
saṃyogi ādini eva katham liṅgam iti āha prasiddha pūrvaka tvāt apadeśasya prasiddhaḥ yaḥ saṃyogi ādiḥ na asambaddhaḥ yena saha jñātaḥ sa tasya artha antarasya api liṅgam sambaddha tvāt na asambaddham
tathā hi aprasiddhaḥ anapadeśaḥ aprasiddhaḥ viruddhaḥ sādhya dharmeṇa saha na eva asti sambandhaḥ api tu viparyayeṇa asau anapadeśaḥ ahetuḥ
asan sandigdhaḥ ca anapadeśaḥ asan yaḥ pakṣe na asti tena arthāt asan asiddhaḥ iti arthaḥ sandiddhaḥ ca anapadeśaḥ sandigdhaḥ anaikāntikaḥ iti arthaḥ

udāharaṇam āha viṣāṇī tasmāt aśvaḥ viṣāṇī tasmāt gauḥ iti ca ayam padārthaḥ aśvaḥ iti sādhye viṣāṇi tvam viruddham aśva viparyayeṇa viṣāṇi tvasya vyāpteḥ ayam padārthaḥ gauḥ iti sādhve viṣāṇi tvam anaikāntikam sādhya viparyābhyām vyāpta tvāt ca śabdaḥ anukta samuccaya arthaḥ śaśaḥ viṣāṇī iti sādhye asiddham viṣāṇi tvam pakṣe avartamāna tvāt prasaṅgāt etat ukram

kiñca ātma indriya manaḥ artha sannikarṣāt yat niṣpadyate tat anyat catuṣṭaya sannikarṣāt yat utpadyate jñāna ākhyam kāryam tat anyat hetu antaram ātma jñāpakam asti iti jñānasya samavāyi kāraṇa apekṣi tvam kāryatvāt ghaṭa vat

pravṛtti nivṛttī ca pratyagātmani dṛṣṭe paratra liṅgam iti pratyagātmā iti śarīram śarīre pravṛtti nivṛttī dṛṣṭe ātmānam anumāpayataḥ śarīram prayatnavatā adhiṣṭitam hita ahita pravṛtti nivṛttimat tvāt ghaṭa vat

uktaḥ ātma indriya manortha sannikarṣaḥ jñāna hetuḥ tad saddhi artham manaḥ kathayati ātma indriya artha sannikarṣe jñānasya abhāvaḥ bhāvaḥ ca manasaḥ liṅgam ātma indriya arthānām sannikarṣe yat abhāvāt jñānam na bhavati yad bhāve ca bhavati tat manaḥ evam jñāna utpatti anutpattī manasaḥ liṅgam guṇāḥ saṃkhyā parimāṇa pṛthaktva saṃyoga vibhāga paratva aparatva saṃskārāḥ
dravya tva nitya tve vāyunā vyākhyāte yathā adravyavat tvāt paramāṇu vāyoḥ dravya tvam nitya tvam ca evam manasaḥ

prayatna ayaugapadyāt jñāna ayaugapadyāt ca ekam manaḥ bahuṣu kāryeṣu ca yugapad prayatnāḥ jñānāni vā na prādurbhavanti iti atas prayatna jñāna ayaugapadyāt ekam manaḥ pratiśarīram mūrtam asparśam niravayavam nityam aṇu āśucārī iti

prāṇa apāna nimeṣa unmeṣa jīvana manaḥ gati indriya antara vikārāḥ sukha duḥkhe icchā dveṣau prayatnaḥ ca iti ātma liṅgāni praṇāpāna nimeṣa unmeṣā manogatiḥ ca prayatna kārya tvāt ātmanaḥ liṅgam jīvanam adṛṣṭa kāryatvāt indriya antara vikārāḥ smṛti prabhava tvāt sukha ādayaḥ yuga tvāt tiryak pavanasya vāyoḥ deha sthitasya yat prāṇa apāna karma tat prayatna kāryam śarīra parigṛhīta vāyu viṣaya tve sati vikṛta tvāt bhastrā parigṛhīta vāyu karma vat nimeṣa unmeṣa kriyā api prayatna kāryā nimeṣa unmeṣa kriyā śabda vācya tvāt dāru yantra nimeṣa unmeṣa kriyāvat manasā saṃyogaḥ ātmanaḥ adṛṣṭa apekṣaḥ jīvanam śarīra vṛddhi ādi tad kāryam api jīvanam śarīram prayatnavatā adhiṣṭhitam vṛddhi kṣara bhagna saṃrogaṇa nimitta tvāt jīrṇa gṛha vat

indriya antaram prati manasaḥ gamanam manogatiḥ prayatna kāryā abhimata pradeśa sambandha nimitta tvāt pelaka kriyāvat sā hi dāraka prayatna kṛtā rūpa ālocana saṃskāra vyakti rasasmaraṇa prayatna manaḥ kriyā rasana manaḥ sambandha rasana vikāraṇām pūrvasya pūrvasya kāraṇa tvāt utpattiḥ jñaptiḥ tu vaiparītyena uttarottarasmāt pūrvasya pūrvasya smaraṇena ātmā anumīyate na smṛtiḥ indriyāṇām anyena dṛṣṭe arthe anyasya na śarīra avayavasya avasthā bhedena bhidyamāna tvāt devadattasya rūpa rasa gandha sparśa pratyayāḥ eka aneka nimittāḥ mayā iti pratyayena pratisandhānāt kṛta saṅketānām bahūnām ekasmin nartakī bhrū kṣepe yugapad aneka pratyaya vat iti uddyota karaḥ sukha ādayaḥ ca guṇi sāpekṣāḥ guṇa tvāt rūpavat
dravya tva nitya tve vāyunā vyākhyāte adravyavat tvāt paramāṇuvāyoḥ iva dravya tva nitya tve

nanu ca yajñadattaḥ iti sati sannikarṣe pratyakṣa abhāvāt dṛṣṭam liṅgam na vidyate yathā cākṣuṣa artha sannikarṣe sati yajñadattaḥ ayam iti pratyakṣam bhavati na tathā prāṇa ādi sukha ādi sambaddhaḥ ayam ātmā iti jñānam jāyate atha katham adṛṣṭa sambandham prāṇa ādi ātmanaḥ liṅgam tat āha na praṇādi dṛṣṭam liṅgam

sāmānyatas dṛṣṭāt ca aviśeṣaḥ prāṇa ādīnām nirnimittānām sukha ādīnām ca anāśritānām anutpattiḥ atas eṣām kena api nimittena āśrayeṇa bhāvyam iti atas api sāmānyatas dṛṣṭāt ākāśa ādīnām anirāsāt aviśeṣaḥ teṣām api hetu tva sambhavāt
tasmāt āgamikam ātmā asti iti pravāda mātram iti arthaḥ
na etat aham iti śabda vyatirekāt na āgamikam aham iti śabdena kṣiti ādi bhinna ātma dravya viṣayeṇa aika adhikaraṇyāt aham prāṇa ādimān aham sukhavān iti tasmāt praṇādi liṅga tvāt na āgamikam

nanu ca yadi ca dṛṣṭa pratyakṣaḥ aham devadattaḥ aham yajñadattaḥ iti yadi khalu aham devadattaḥ aham yajñadattaḥ iti ātmani dṛṣṭa pratyakṣam idam bhavet evam yujyeta ahaṃśabdasya ātma vācaka tvam yāvatā śarīra abhidhāyaka devadatta śabda eka artha adhikaraṇa tvāt aham śabdaḥ api śarīra vācakaḥ tasmāt na prāṇa ādi sukha ādīni ātma nirṇaya hetuḥ

devadatta śabdaḥ katham śarīre iti āha devadattaḥ gacchati viṣṇu mitraḥ gacchati iti ca upacārāt śarīra pratyakṣaḥ gamana vācinā gacchati iti śabdena saha prayogāt devadatta śabdaḥ śarīra vacanaḥ avasīyate ātmanaḥ gati asambhavāt tasmāt ahaṃśabdaḥ api śarīre eva devadatta śabdena saha dṛṣṭa tvāt

na etat sandigdhaḥ tu upacāraḥ devadatta śabdena eka artha adhikaraṇa tvāt yaḥ ayam upacāraḥ ahaṃśabdasya śarīre sa sandigdhaḥ kim śarīrasya ātma upakāraka tvāt ahaṃśabdaḥ ātmā abhidhāyakaḥ upacaritaḥ uta mukhya tayā śarīrasya abhidhāyakaḥ iti na śarīra ātmanaḥ rahaṃśabdasya niścayaḥ

sva pakṣe niścayam āha aham iti pratyagātmani bhāvāt paratya abhāvāt artha antara pratyakṣaḥ pratyagātmani iti ātmani paratra iti śarīre yadi ahaṃśabdaḥ śarīra vacanaḥ syāt evam sati tasmin piṇḍe devadatta śabdaḥ iva sarvaiḥ prayujyeta na tu evam atas ātmani artha antare ahaṃśabdaḥ pratyakṣaḥ

śarīraḥ iva ātmani api paraiḥ apta yogāt na syāt iti ced atas āha na tu śarīra viśeṣāt yajñadatta viṣṇu mitrayoḥ jñāna viśeṣaḥ yajñadatta viṣṇu mitrayoḥ sambandhinaḥ śarīra viśeṣāt yathā dṛṣṭāt na tadīye sukha ādau asmad ādīnām jāyate jñānam tathā eva na tadīya ahaṅkāraḥ asmābhiḥ saṃvedyate yatas ahaṃśabdaḥ prayujyeta śārīra vācaka tve tu yathā śarīram dṛṣṭvā tatra devadatta śabdam prayuñjate tad vidimam api prayuñjīran na tu evam tasmāt na śarīre ātma vṛtti tve tu paraiḥ aprayogaḥ evam ahaṃśabdena eka adhikaraṇa tvāt sukha ādayaḥ ātma viṣayāḥ prāṇa ādayaḥ ca tad nimittāḥ
nanu sukha duḥkha jñāna niṣpatti aviśeṣāt aikātmyam yathā sat liṅga aviśeṣāt viśeṣa liṅga abhāvāt cailaḥ bhāvaḥ tathā eva sukha duḥkha jñānānām niṣpatti aviśeṣāt viśeṣa liṅga abhāvāt ca aikātmyam
