na etat nānā vyavasthātaḥ anyasya sukha ādi yoge anyasya tad abhāvāt anayā vyavasthayā nānā ātmānaḥ

śāstra sāmarthyāt ca iti grāma kāmaḥ yajeta svarga kāmaḥ yajeta iti atas api śāstra sāmarthyāt nānā ātmānaḥ tasya guṇāḥ buddhi sukha duḥkha icchā dveṣa prayatna adṛṣṭa saṃskārāḥ vaiśeṣikāḥ anye tu saṃkhyā parimāṇa pṛthaktva saṃyoga vibhāgāḥ
evam dravyāṇi uktvā nitya tvam upalabdhi anupalabdhī ca teṣu kathayati prasaṅgāt anyat sat akāraṇa vat tat nityam adravyavat tvāt iti anena yat sat kāraṇa rahitam tat nityam uktam paramāṇu ādi
upalabdhau tu tasya kāryam liṅgam tasya paramāṇu ādeḥ indriyaiḥ agṛhyamāṇasya api śarīra mahābhūta ādi kāryam liṅgam
yatas kāraṇa bhāvāt hi kārya bhāvaḥ yasmāt kāraṇebhyaḥ tantu ādibhyaḥ paṭāhi kāryam utpadyate atas kārya say kāraṇa pūrvaka tvāt kāraṇasya kāryam liṅgam
anityam iti ca viśeṣa pratiṣedha bhāvaḥ yadā khalu sarvam kāryam anityam iti ucyate tadā anena nitya tvasya viśeṣa pratiṣedhena kārya viṣayeṇa kiñcid kāraṇam nityam iti jñāyate
avidyā ca avidyā agrahaṇam atīndriya tvena paramāṇūnām tat api anitya tvam nivārayati adṛśyamāne hi arthe tad gatam anitya tvam kena gṛhyata tasmāt na anitya tā vaktumaḥ śakyā
upalabdhiḥ katham iti ced mahati aneka dravyavat tvāt rūpāt ca upalabdhiḥ mahat tva parimāṇa samavāyini dravye samavāyi kāraṇa dravya bahu tvāt rūpāt ca śukla ādeḥ jñānam bhavati
kutas etat yatas adravyavat tvāt paramāṇau anupalabdhiḥ sati api rūpe paramāṇoḥ samavāyi kāraṇa dravya abhāvāt na upalabdhiḥ

rūpa saṃskāra abhāvāt vāyau anupalabdhiḥ sati api aneka dravyavat tve mahat tve ca rūpa ākhyasya saṃskārasya abhāvāt vāyau anupalabdhiḥ aneka dravya tāyāḥ viśeṣṭāyāḥ grahaṇāt vyaṇuke api anupalabdhiḥ siddhā

rūpe katham aneka dravyeṇa dravyeṇa samavāyāt rūpa viśeṣāt ca upalabdhiḥ mahatā aneka dravyam avāyi dravyeṇa ghaṭa ādinā rūpa guṇasya samavāyāt rūpa viśeṣāt ca rūpa tva ākhyāt sāmānya viśeṣāt upalabdhiḥ
etena rasa gandha sparśeṣu jñānam vyākhyātam etena anantara uktena nyāyena aneka dravyeṇa dravyeṇa samavāyāt rasa tva ādi sāmānya viśeṣebhyaḥ ca rasa ādīnām upalabdhiḥ
tad abhāvāt avyabhicāraḥ paramāṇu rūpasya aneka dravyeṇa dravyeṇa samavāya abhāvāt na upalabdhiḥ tatas aneka dravyeṇa dravyeṇa samavāyasya rūpa upalabdheḥ ca avya abhicāraḥ

saṃkhyāḥ parimāṇāni pṛthaktvam saṃyoga vibhāgau paratva aparatve karma ca rūpi dravya samavāyāt cākṣuṣāṇi rūpiti viśiṣṭam rūpi tena upalabdhi yogyena rūpiṇā samavāyāt etāni cākṣuṣāṇi sva sāmānya viśeṣebhyaḥ ca
kutas arūpiṣu acākṣuṣa tvāt yasmāt rūpa hiteṣu mahatsu dravya antareṣu sthitāni na jñāmante

etena guṇa tve bhāve ca sarva indriya jñānam vyākhyātam yathā eva mahati aneka dravyeṇa samavāyāt rūpa ādīnām samavetānām upalabdhiḥ evam mahati samaveteṣu guṇeṣu samavetayoḥ guṇa tva bhāvayoḥ taiḥ taiḥ guṇaiḥ rūpa ādibhiḥ samavāyāt yathāsvam cakṣuḥ ādi indriyaiḥ upalabdhiḥ na tu sāmānya viśeṣāḥ teṣu upalambhakāḥ tad abhāvāt evam tattva ādīnām svaiḥ indriyaiḥ dravye tu bhāvasya samavāyāt karmaṇi samaveta samavāyāt guṇavat

idānīm ādhyātmikam eṣām kāryam ucyate tatra pratyakṣa apratyakṣāṇām apratyakṣa tvāt saṃyogasya pañca ātmakam na vidyate kṣiti ādi pañcakena śarīra ārambhe trayāṇām pratyakṣa tvāt vāyoḥ apratyakṣa tvāt yathā tadvatā saṃyogaḥ api apratyakṣaḥ evam śarīram apratyakṣam syāt pratyakṣa apratyakṣaiḥ ārabdha tvāt pratyakṣa tvāt tu manyāmahe na pañcabhiḥ ārabdham iti

nanu tribhiḥ pratyakṣaiḥ ārabhyeta guṇa antara aprādurbhāvāt ca tri ātmakam api na kṣiti salila analaiḥ ārambhe vilakṣaṇebhyaḥ rūpa ādibhyaḥ kārye vilakṣaṇāni rūpāṇi guṇa antarāṇi jāyeran na tu evam api tu pārthivān eva rūpa ādīn upalabhāmahe tasmāt na tri ātmakam

ātma saṃyogaḥ tu avipratiṣiddhaḥ mithas pañcānām ātma śabdena svarūpam svarūpeṇa pañcānām api bhūtānām paraspara saṃyogaḥ na pratiṣidhyate śarīre anārambhaka tvena pārthiva śarīre jala ādīni saṃyogīni na samavāyīni jala ādibhiḥ ayonijam eva śarīram ārabhyate varuṇa loka ādau
kutas aneka deśa pūrvaka tvāt aneka deśāḥ paramāṇavaḥ taiḥ eva atabhyate jala ādi śarīram na śukra śoṇitābhyām
tat ca dharma viśeṣāt dharma viśeṣa pekṣāḥ paramāṇavaḥ eva śarīram ārabhante na śukta ādi katham hi puṇyavatām śukra ādi mayam śarīram syāt
itas ca kārya viśeṣāt śalabha ādi śarīra ākhyāt kārya viśeṣāt manyāmahe santi ayonijāni
itas ca samākhyā bhāvāt aṅgārebhyaḥ jātaḥ aṅgitāḥ iti ovam ādi samākhya abhāvāt manyāmahe santi ayonijāni
kutas saṃjñā ādimattvāt yatas pratyakṣeṇa aṅgāra janma ādikam artham dṛṣṭaiḥ praṇīyante saṃjñāḥ aṅgirāḥ ityādayaḥ atas saṃjñānām ādimat tvāt samākhyā yathārthā
atas santi ayonijāḥ veda liṅgāt ca iti candramāḥ manasaḥ jātaḥ iti ādikāt ca veda liṅgāt santi ayonijāḥ śarīra viśeṣāḥ evam jala ādi śarīram ayonijam eva pārthivam tu yoni jam ayoni jam ca

evam ukteṣu guṇān ullaṅghya alpa vaktavya tvāt karmāṇi abhidhatte tatra ātma saṃyoga prayatnābhyām haste karma sva āśraya saṃyoga apekṣi tvāt prayatnasya kriyā ārambhe ātma hasta saṃyogaḥ karmaṇaḥ kāraṇam sa apekṣa kāraṇa tvāt saṃyogasya prayatnaḥ api kāraṇam atas dvābhyām haste karma

tathā musala karma hasta saṃyogāt ca tathā iti saṅkhyā mātra atideśaḥ tena hasta musala saṃyogaḥ musala karmaṇaḥ kāraṇam pūrva adhikṛtaḥ ca prayatnaḥ na tu ātma hasta saṃyogaḥ asamavāyi kāraṇam musala karmaṇi ātma saṃyukta hasta saṃyogāt eva tad siddheḥ

abhighāta je musala karmaṇi vyatirekāt akāraṇam hasta saṃyogaḥ vegavat dravya saṃyogaḥ abhighātaḥ ulūkhala abhighātāt utpanne musalasya utpatana karmaṇi akāraṇam hasta musala saṃyogaḥ pūrva prayatnasya abhighātāt vinaṣṭa tvāt utpatatu musala dravyam iti icchāyāḥ abhāvāt prayatna antarasya abhāvaḥ saṃyogasya ca guṇa karma ārambhe sa apekṣa kāraṇa tvāt prayatna rahitaḥ hasta musala saṃyogaḥ na kāraṇam utpatanasya

tathā ātma saṃyogaḥ hasta musala karmaṇi yathā eva hasta musala saṃyogaḥ musala utpatana karmaṇi na kāraṇam tathā ātma hasta saṃyogaḥ api gasta utpatana karmaṇi na kāraṇam saṃyogasya sa apekṣa kāraṇa tvāt musalena saha utpatatu hastaḥ iti abhisandheḥ abhāvena prayatnasya ca abhāvāt

kutas tayoḥ utpatanam iti ced musala abhighātāt tu musala saṃyogāt haste karma ulūkhala abhighātaḥ musalasya utpatana karmaṇaḥ karaṇam hasta nusala saṃyogaḥ tu musala gata vega apekṣaḥ hasta karmaṇam na abhighātaḥ asamaveta tvāt

tathā ātma karma hasta saṃyogāt ca ātmā iti śarīra eka deśaḥ yathā ca etat apratyayam haste musale ca karma tathā eva hasta avayava saṃyogāt hasta gata vega apekṣāt hasta utpatana kāle avayave tasmin apratyayam karma jāyate
saṃyoga abhāve guru tvāt patanam vibhāgāt nivṛtte hasta musala saṃyoge guru tvāt patanam bhavati

nodana viśeṣa abhāvāt na ūrdhvam na tiryak gamanam nudyate anena iti nodanam vega prayatna apekṣaḥ saṃyoga viśeṣaḥ preraka prayatna abhāve nodana abhāvāt na ūrdhvam tiryak vā kevalāt guru tvāt musala ādeḥ gamana karma bhavati
kutas nodana viśeṣaḥ prayatna viśeṣāt nodana viśeṣaḥ atra idam kṣipāmi iti icchā viśeṣa jaḥ prayatnaḥ utpannaḥ hasta ādeḥ dravyasya dravya antareṇa saṃyogam nodana ākhyam janayati
nodana viśeṣāt udasana viśeṣaḥ dūra deśa preraṇa icchā viśiṣṭāt prayatnāt jātaḥ nodana viśeṣaḥ dūgdeśa kṣepaṇam karoti

hasta karmaṇā dāraka karma vyākhyātam yat garbhasya spandana ādi karma tad ātma śarīra eka saṃyogāt jīvana pūrvaka prayatna apekṣāt bhavati iti sa pratyayam mātuḥ kārya avaskara upasarpaṇa karma garbhasya apratyayam ātma saṃyogāt adṛṣṭa apekṣāt bhavati iti
tathā dagdhasya visphoṭanam vyāsakte namasi yat dagdhasya hastāt arvikṣipaṇam tat api jīvana pūrvaka prayatna apekṣāt ātma hasta saṃyogāt bhavati iti na apratyayam
prayatna abhāve guru tvāt suptasya patanam śarīra vidhāraka prayatna abhāve suptasya aṅgānām patanam guru tvāt bhavati tadā abhisandheḥ abhāvāt
tṛṇa karma vāyu saṃyogāt vega apekṣāt vāyu tṛṇa saṃyogāt tṛṇa ādīnām karma teṣām prayatna abhāvāt
maṇi gamanam sūcī abhisarpaṇam iti adṛṣṭa kāritāni maṇīnām taskaram prati gamanam sūcīnām ca ayaskāntam prati dharma adharma kṛtam iti arthaḥ

iṣau ayugapad saṃyoga viśeṣāḥ karma anya tve hetuḥ nodanāt ādyam karma saṃskārāt bahūni karmāṇi iṣau utpadyante ekasmin tu karmaṇi prathameṇa eva ākāśa saṃyogena vinaṣṭa tvāt karmaṇaḥ uttara saṃyoga vibhāgāḥ na utpadyeran tasmāt iṣau anekam karma

nodanāt ādyam iṣoḥ karma karma kāritāt ca saṃskārāt uttaram tathā uttaram uttaram ca jyā śara saṃyogaḥ prayatna apekṣaḥ jyā gata vega apekṣaḥ vā nodanam tatas ādya m iṣoḥ karma nodana apekṣam saṃskāram karoti nirapekṣam tu saṃyoga vibhāgau tatas saṃyogāt vinaṣṭe karmaṇi nodane vibhāgāt vinivṛtte ādya karma ja saṃskāraḥ uttaram iṣau karma karoti tathā uttaram uttaram paunaḥpunya iti arthaḥ
saṃskāra abhāve guru tvāt patanam sparśavat dravya saṃyogena saṃskāra vināśāt guru tvam tad patana karma karoti

ādhyātmikeṣu tad sambaddheṣu ca karmāṇi uktvā mahābhūta karmāṇi vyācaṣṭe nodanāt abhighātāt saṃyukta saṃyogāt ca pṛthivyām karma samastān vyastān ca gurutva drava tva vega prayatna anapekṣamāṇaḥ yaḥ saṃyoga viśeṣaḥ nodanāt preraṇāt avibhāga hetoḥ karmaṇaḥ kāraṇam tat nodanam tathā hi pāda ādibhiḥ nudyamānāyām paṅka ākhyāyām pṛthivyām karma jāyate vega apekṣaḥ abhighātāt abhihanyamānasya vibhāga hetoḥ karmaṇaḥ kāraṇam saṃyogaḥ abhighātaḥ tathā hi ratha ādibhiḥ abhighātāt pṛthivī eka deśeṣu dṛśyate karma saṃyukta yogāt ca nudyamāna abhihanyamānābhyām ca saṃyukteṣu bhavanti karmāṇi

tat viśeṣeṇa adṛṣṭa kāritam yat khalu viruddha kriya vāyu saṃyogāt sarvasyām pṛthivyām kampa ādi karma prajānām śubha aśubha sūcanāya utpadyate tat sarveṣām eva śubha aśubha sūcanāt viśeṣeṇa adṛṣṭa kāritam
apām saṃyoga abhāve guru tvāt patanam vidhāraka vāyu abhra saṃyoga abhāve apām guru tvāt patana karma bhavati
tat viśeṣeṇa adṛṣṭa kāritam sasyānām samṛddhaye vināśāya vā sarva janānām adṛṣṭena janitam patana karma adṛṣṭa kāritam ucyate
drava tvāt syandanam vidhāraka abhāvā dapām syandana karma drava tvāt bhavati
nāḍyā vāyu saṃyogāt ārohaṇam nāḍī iti raśmiḥ savituḥ dvau raśmī śuciḥ ca śukraḥ ca śuciḥ apaḥ ādatte śukreṇa vṛddhim karoti śuci ākhyayā nāḍyāḥ vāyu saṃyuktayā āditya prayatna apekṣayā ārohaṇam
noganāt pīḍanāt saṃyukta saṃyogāt ca nodanāt citra daṇḍa ādibhiḥ ārohaṇam pīḍanāt vastra ādibhiḥ pīḍyamāna nudyamānābhyām ca saṃyukte
vṛkṣa abhisarpaṇam iti adṛṣṭa kāritam vṛkṣa mūle niṣiktānām apām vṛkṣa upari gamanam adṛṣṭena kriyate iti
apām saṅghātaḥ vilayanam ca tejasaḥ saṃyogāt apām saṅghātaḥ kāṭhinyam divyena tejasā saṃyogāt divya bhaumābhyām tu vilayanam
tatra avasphūrjathuḥ liṅgam asti divyāsu apsu tejaḥ iti atra tejasaḥ avasphūrjathuḥ abhrāt niḥsaraṇam liṅgam iti
vaidikam ca tām agnim garbham dadhire vabhūṣā iti ca vaidikam vākyam divyāsu apsu tejasaḥ liṅgam iti

apām saṃyogāt vibhāgāt ca stanayitnuḥ megha aśani śabdaḥ stanayitnuḥ viruddha dikkriyābhyām vāyubhyānapām preryamāṇānām taraṅga bhūtānām paraspara abhighāta ākhyāt saṃyogāt śabdaḥ ekena api prakupitena vāyunā vyavacchidyamānānām apām vibhāgāt śabdaḥ
pṛthivī karmaṇā tejaḥ karma vāyu karma ca vyākhyātam yathā nodana abhighāta saṃyukta saṃyoga adṛṣṭebhyaḥ pṛthivyām karma tathā tejasaḥ vāyoḥ ca etat aniyatam karma

niyatam tu agnetu ūrdhva jvalanam vāyoḥ ca tiryak pavanam aṇu manasoḥ ca ādyam karma iti adṛṣṭa kāritāni agneḥ avasthāne tiryak vā gamane pacyamānasya abhasmībhāvaḥ syāt apām vā tathā vāyoḥ atiryak gamane pūyamāna dravyāṇām pavana abhāvaḥ agneḥ ca aprabodhaḥ vinaṣṭa śarīrāṇām ātmanām sarga ādau pṛthivī ādi paramāṇuṣu ādyam paraspara upasarpaṇa karma na syāt tathā labdha bhūmīnām yoginām kalpa ante abhisandhāya prayatnena manaḥ śarīrāt vyātiricya avatiṣṭhamānānām sarga ādau nava śarīra sambandhāya manasaḥ ādyam karma na bhavet adṛṣṭāt ṛte tasmāt agneḥ ūrdhva jvalanam vāyoḥ ca tiryak pavana m aṇūnām ca upasarpaṇa karma manasaḥ ca ādyam karma etāni prāṇinām adṛṣṭena kṛtāni

hasta karmaṇā manasaḥ karma vyākhyātam yathā ātma saṃyoga prayatnābhyām haste karma tathā ātma manaḥ saṃyogāt prayatnāt ca manasaḥ karma etat sa dehasya karma tatra jāgrataḥ icchā dveṣa pūrvakāt prayatnāt prabodha kāle tu jīvana pūrvakāt

yatas saṃyogaḥ yogaḥ sa ca karma kāryaḥ atas yogāṅgam karma yoga mokṣau ca karma adhikare api ucyete ātma indriya manortha sannikarṣāt sukha duḥkhe tad anārambhaḥ yatas hetoḥ ātma indriya manortha sannikarṣaḥ jñāna kāraṇa tvena sukha duḥkhe janayati atas tad anārambhaḥ tasya sannikarṣasya anārambhaḥ anutpattiḥ ucyate iti

tathā hi ātma sthe manasi sa śarīrasya sukha duḥkha abhāvaḥ sa yogaḥ yadā hi ātmani manaḥ avasthitam na indriyeṣu tadā catuṣṭaya sannikarṣasya anārambhāt tad kāryayoḥ sukha duḥkhayoḥ abhāva rūpaḥ vidyamāna śarīrasya ātmanaḥ vāyu nigraha apekṣaḥ ātmanaḥ manasā saṃyoga yogaḥ
yogāṅgam prāṇāyāma karma kim na uktam kāya karmaṇā atma karma vyākhyātam iha ātma śabdena vāyuḥ yathā ātma saṃyoga prayatnābhyām haste karma tathā ātma vāyu saṃyogāt prayatnāt ca prāṇāyāma karma

apasarpaṇam upasarpaṇam aśita pīra saṃyogaḥ kārya antara saṃyogāḥ ca iti adṛṣṭa kāritāni maraṇa kāle pūrva śarīrāt manasaḥ niḥsaraṇam apasarpaṇam śarīra antareṇa abhisambandhaḥ manasaḥ upasarpaṇam śukra śoṇitāt prabhṛti garbha sthasya mātrā upayuktena anna pānena nāḍī anupraviṣṭena sambandhaḥ aśita pīta saṃyogaḥ kalala arbuda māṃsa peśī ghana śarīra ādibhiḥ ekasmin eva saṃsāre ye sambandhāḥ te kārya antara saṃyogāḥ tāni apasarpaṇa ādīni adṛṣṭena eva kriyante na prayatnena

tad abhāve saṃyoga abhāvaḥ aprādurbhāvaḥ sa mokṣaḥ evaṃrūpasya anādi apasarpaṇa ādi nimittasya adṛṣṭasya abhāve jīvana ākhyasya ātma manaḥ saṃyogasya abhāvaḥ anyasya ca śarīrasya aprādurbhāvaḥ yaḥ sa mokṣaḥ

tamaḥ vṛta tvāt sarvasya jñāna nutpattau tamaḥ hetuḥ tat punar dravya guṇa karma vaidharmyāt bhāva abhāva mātram tamaḥ vināśi tvena nityaiḥ dravyaiḥ vaidharmyāt amūrta tva asparśa tva prakāśa virodhaiḥ anitya dravyaiḥ vaidharmyāt na dravyam tamaḥ na ca guṇaḥ karma vā āśraya anupalabdheḥ tasmāt prakāśasya abhāva mātram tamaḥ

kutas etat tejasaḥ dravya antareṇa āvaraṇāt ca tejasaḥ savitṛ prakāśa ādeḥ bahis sadbhāvāt parvata guhā ādau ca dravya antareṇa āvṛte abhāvāt manyāmahe tejasaḥ abhāva mātram tamaḥ iti bāhyam pradīpa ādi nivartyam avidyā ātmakam tu jñāna jyotiṣā iti uktau yoga mokṣau
diś kālau ākāśam ca kriyāvat hyaḥ vaidharmyāt niṣkriyāṇi ākāśa kāla diśaḥ amūrtāḥ kriyāvataḥ pṛthivī ādeḥ amūrta tayā vaidharmyāt niṣkriyāḥ caśabdāt ātmā api niṣkriyaḥ
etena karmāṇi guṇāḥ ca vyākhyātāḥ etena amūrta tvena guṇāḥ karmāṇi ca niṣkriyāṇi dravyāni caśabdāt sāmānya ādayaḥ
niṣkriyāṇām samavāyaḥ karmabhyaḥ pratiṣiddhaḥ niṣkriyāṇām abhighāta ādīnām karma samavetam na bhavati sva āśraye karma jananāt
kāraṇam tu asamavāyinaḥ guṇāḥ yasya guṇāḥ kāraṇa muktāḥ tasya asamavāyinaḥ eva kāraṇam
guṇaiḥ diś vyākhyātā pūrveṇa niṣkramaṇam iti ādeḥ pratyaya bhedasya diś nimitta kāraṇam vyākhyātā kāraṇa tvena atideśaḥ na asasavāyi tvena
kāraṇena kālaḥ iti yena eva kāraṇena pratyaya bheda hetu tvena diś vyākhyātā tena eva yugapad kṛtam ityādi pratyaya bhedasya nimitta kāraṇam vyākhyātaḥ

karmāṇi vyākhyāya guṇāḥ vyākhyāyante tatra dharmaḥ ādau vyākhyāyate śāstra ādau tasya uddiṣṭa tvāt tasya vaidikaḥ vidhiḥ sādhanam vedasya satya tā kutas iti ced yatas buddhi pūrvā vākya kṛtiḥ vede agnihotram juhuyāt svarga kāmaḥ iti evaṃbhūtā racanā bhagavataḥ maheśvarasya buddhi pūrvā sā tatas pramaṇam āpta praṇīta tvasya satya tā vyāpteḥ

atīndriyam aśakyam jñātum iti ced na ca asmad buddhibhyaḥ liṅgam ṛṣeḥ liṅgyate anena arthaḥ iti liṅgam vijñānam na hi yādṛśam asmad vijñānam vartamāna avyavahita sambaddha artha viṣayam tādṛśam eva bhagavataḥ vijñānam atas sambhavati bhagavataḥ atīndriya artha viṣayam vijñānam

sa katham jñāyate tathā brāhmaṇe saṃjñā karma siddhiḥ liṅgam vinā upadeśena brāhmaṇa ādikam artham asmākam ālocayatām pratyakṣeṇa na brāhmaṇaḥ ayam iti jñānam utpadyate pratyakṣeṇa ca artham ālocya saṃjñā praṇayanam dṛṣṭam putra ādiṣu santi ca etāḥ brāhmaṇa ādi saṃjñāḥ tāḥ yena pratyakṣam artham ālocya praṇītāḥ iti sūtra artham varṇayanti

atas buddhi pūrvaḥ dadātiḥ yatas eva parameśvarasya kṛtiḥ veda ādau vakya pada racanā atas ayam smārtaḥ api dāna ādi vidhiḥ tadīyam āmnāyam ananta śākhā bhinnam ālocya saṃkṣepam anumanyamānānām bhṛgu prabhṛtīnām buddhi pūrvaḥ evam dāna ādi vidhayaḥ dharma hetavaḥ
tathā pratigrahaḥ tathā eva pratigrahaḥ api prakṣīṇa vṛtteḥ avadājanmanaḥ pratigrahān uparū guṇa yuktasya dharmāya eva bhavati

tayoḥ kramaḥ yathā anitara itara aṅga bhūtānām yathā bhūtāni anitara itara aṅgam na paraspareṇa kārya kāraṇa bhūtāni na hi araṇī agneḥ kāraṇam api tu sva avayavāḥ eva atha ca araṇyoḥ agneḥ ca kramaḥ evam etayoḥ pūrvam dāna dharmaḥ paścāt pratigraha dharmaḥ na tu kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ
kutas ātma guṇeṣu ātma antara guṇānām akāraṇa tvāt na hi anyadīyāḥ ātma guṇāḥ anyadīya ātma guṇānām kāraṇam bhavanti
tatra aduṣṭa bhojanāt samabhivyāhārataḥ abhyudayaḥ aduṣṭam brāhyaṇam bhojayitvā tadīyāt āśīrvāda ādi samabhivyāhārāt puruṣa abhyudayaḥ tad kāraṇam dharmaḥ bhavati iti arthaḥ
tat duṣṭa bhojane na vidyate sati api āśīrvāda ādi vacane duṣṭam brāhmaṇam bhojayitvā abhyudayaḥ na prāpyate
atha kaḥ duṣṭaḥ duṣṭam hiṃsāyām parasya hiṃsāyām śarīra mānasa duḥkha rūpāyām pravṛttam duṣṭam jānīṣva hiṃsā śabdaḥ upalakṣaṇam yatas
samabhivyāhārataḥ doṣaḥ kṛta mahāpātakasya saṃbhāṣaṇa mātrāt eva doṣeṇa yujyate kim uta bhojana ādinā iha samabhivyāhāraḥ sambhāṣaṇam pūrvātra āśīrvādaḥ
tat aduṣṭe na vidyate tat samabhivyāhāra dūṣaṇam hiṃsā ādi rahite brāhmaṇe na vidyate
aduṣṭe api viśiṣṭe pravṛttiḥ na hiṃsā ādi mātra rahite api tu deśa kāla vijñāna ācāraiḥ viśiṣṭe brāhmaṇe abhyudaya arthinaḥ pravṛttiḥ

tatas same hīne ca apravṛttiḥ aduṣṭaḥ brāhmaṇaḥ deśa ādi yuktaḥ viśiṣṭaḥ ucyate eṣām ekena guṇena yuktaḥ samaḥ savaiḥ yuktaḥ viśiṣṭaḥ tau tyaktvā anyaḥ duṣaḥ vā kṣatriya ādiḥ vā prāṇi mātram vā hīnaḥ ucyate tatra abhyudaya īpsoḥ mantra pūrvake suvarṇa ādi dāne vaiśākhya ādi nimitte sama hīnayoḥ apravṛttiḥ api tu viśiṣṭe

etena hīna sama viśiṣṭa dhārmikebhyaḥ parādānam vyākhyātam etena viparītena krameṇa āpadi para sva ādānam vyākhyātam uktam ca hīnāt ādeyam ādau tu tad abhāve samāt api asambhave tu ādadīta viśiṣṭāt api dharmikāt
tathā viruddhānām tyāgaḥ anena eva viparīta krameṇa brāhmaṇaḥ ātmanaḥ hīnaiḥ ripubhiḥ māraṇāya ākṣiptaḥ tān eva śatrūn abhiganyāt
same ātma tyāgaḥ para tyāgaḥ vā ātmanaḥ tulya guṇena śatruṇā prāptasya brāhmaṇasya vikalpaḥ ātmanaḥ vadhaḥ ātatāyinaḥ vā
viśiṣṭe ātma tyāgaḥ ātmanaḥ adhika guṇena śatruṇā prāptasya ātmanaḥ eva ripu prayuktaḥ vadhaḥ aṅgī kāryaḥ iha ātma apekṣayā hīna ādi vyavahāraḥ pratigrahe pratigrahītṝṇām anyonya apekṣayā

evam śruti smṛti vidhibhyaḥ dharmaḥ bhavati iti uktvā idānīm eṣām dharma siddhau prakāra viśeṣam āha tathā hi dṛṣṭānām dṛṣṭa prayojanānām dṛṣṭa abhāve prayogaḥ abhyudayāya śruti smṛti paridṛṣṭānām snāna ādīnām dṛṣṭasya mala apakarṣa ādeḥ anabhisandhāne prayogaḥ abhyudayāya bhavati

ke te abhiṣecana upavāsa brahmacarya guru kula vāsavān aprasthya yajña dāna prokṣaṇa diś nakṣatra mantra kāla nigamāḥ ca adṛṣṭāya viśiṣṭa deśa kāla apekṣeṇa ambhasā yaḥ śarīrasya saṃyogaḥ tad abhiṣecanam snānam naktaṃdinam vāsaḥ niyama pūrvaḥ anāhāra rūpaḥ upavāsaḥ brahma śabdena ātmā brahmaṇi caraṇam ātma manasorthaḥ saṃyogaḥ strī ādi parihāra rūpaḥ brahmacaryam vijñāna ādi arthinaḥ guru paricaryā parasya tad gṛheṣu vasanam guru kula vāsaḥ śāstra vidhinā gehāt niḥsṛtya araṇyam prasthitaḥ vānaprasthaḥ tasya karma vānaprasthyam yajñāḥ pākayajña ādayaḥ dānam suvarṇa ādi dānam abhaya dānam ca prokṣaṇam sandhyā upāsamādi diś niyama ādayaḥ anye viśeṣāḥ diś niyamaḥ prāṅmukhaḥ annāni bhuñjīta nakṣatra niyamaḥ kṛtikā su ādadhīta mantra niyamaḥ devasya tvā iti nirvapati kāla niyamaḥ vasante brāhmaṇaḥ agnīn ādadhīta evam etat sarvam dṛṣṭa prayojana tiraskāreṇa prayujyamānam dharmāya sampadyate iti
tatra cāturāśramyam upadhāt ca anupadhāt ca yat idam caturṇām āśramiṇām karma tad upadhayā prayujyamānam adharmāya anupadhayā tu dharmāya bhavati
kā upadhā bhāva doṣaḥ upadhā bhāvasya abhisandheḥ dambha ādi doṣaḥ upadhā iti arthaḥ
kā anupadhā adoṣaḥ anupadhā abhisandheḥ dambha ādi rahita tvam anupadhā iti arthaḥ
iṣṭa rūpa rasa gandha sparśam prokṣitam abhyukṣitam ca tat śuci smṛtau yasya rūpa ādayaḥ na niṣiddhāḥ tat śuci mantra pūrvakam prokṣitam kevalābhiḥ adbhiḥ abhyukṣitam ca etat viparītam aśuci
kiñca aśuci iti śuci pratiṣedhaḥ yasya ca atyanta śuci pratiṣedhaḥ tat api aśuci vāgduṣṭa ādikam
artha antaram madya ādi ca yat sākṣāt niṣidhyate tat api aśuci tatas śuci bhoktavyam
nanu ayatasya śuci bhojanāt abhyudayaḥ na vidyate yama abhāvāt ayatasya viśiṣṭa prayatna rahitasya śucim āhāram yadṛcchayaḥ payuñcānasya abhyudayaḥ na asti viśiṣṭasya abhisandheḥ abhāvāt
na etat vidyate ca anartha antara tvāt yam asya na prayatna vyatirekī yamaḥ prayatna abhāve sarvasyāḥ kriyāyāḥ abhāvāt vidyate śucim āhāram upayuñjānasya prayatnaḥ
yadi prayatnaḥ pradhānam vinā api yoga ādinā abhyudayaḥ syāt na etat asati ca abhāvāt asati yoga ādi anuṣṭhāne na prayatna mātrasya bhāvāt abhyudayaḥ kriyā upadeśa vaiyarthyāt
idānīm niḥśreyasa hetum dharmam āha sukhāt rāgaḥ strī ādi viṣaya janitāt sukhāt eva rāgaḥ vardhate
tad maya tvāt yaiḥ yaiḥ asya sukha hetubhiḥ śarīram bhāvitam tad mayaḥ iva āste tatas tad maya tvāt rāgaḥ
kiñca tṛpteḥ yadā tṛptaḥ bhavati tadā asya tṛpti nimittaḥ rāgaḥ bhavati śarīra puṣṭeḥ
kiñca adṛṣṭāt apūrva dṛṣṭeṣu anupakārakeṣu ca kasyacid rāgaḥ jāyate atra adṛṣṭaḥ eva kāraṇam
kiñca jāti viśeṣāt ca rāha viśeṣaḥ yathā tiraścām tṛṇa ādi bhojane evam jāti viśeṣāt api rāgaḥ

sukha ādibhyaḥ rāgaḥ duḥkha ādibhyaḥ dveṣaḥ tatas icchā dveṣa pūrvikā dharma adharmayoḥ pravṛttiḥ icchā pūrvikā dharme pravṛttiḥ anyena dhana madāt abhibhūtasya vā dveṣa pūrvikā api grāma kāma iṣṭi ādau adharme api icchā pūrvikā para dāra ādiṣu dveṣa pūrvikā evam dharma adharmayoḥ sañcayaḥ

yatas evam tatas saṃyogaḥ vibhāgaḥ ca sañcitau yadā dharma adharmau bhavataḥ tadā śarīra indriyaiḥ saṃyogaḥ janma ākhyaḥ bhavati kṣīṇayoḥ ca tayoḥ maraṇa kāle viyogaḥ punar api ābhyām dharma adharmābhyām śarīra ādi saṃyogaḥ vibhāgaḥ ca iti evam anādiḥ ayam ghaṭīyantra vat āvartate jantuḥ
etad viparīta krameṇa ucyate tathā hi ātma karmasu mokṣaḥ vyākhyāt ātmā iti manaḥ manaḥ karmasu tad abhāve saṃyoga abhāvaḥ aprādurbhāvaḥ ca sa mokṣaḥ iti mokṣaḥ vyākhyātaḥ
idānīm rūpa ādīn āha uktāḥ guṇāḥ rūpa ādi sūtreṇa udṛṣṭāḥ iti arthaḥ
guṇa lakṣaṇam ca uktam dravya āśrayī ityādinā dravya karmabhyām vaidharmyam kathitam iti arthaḥ
idam evaṃguṇam idam evaṃguṇam iti ca uktam tathā hi uktam rūpa rasa gandha sparśavatī pṛthivī ityādi
tatra pṛthivyām rūpa rasa gandha sparśāḥ dravya anitya tvāt anityāḥ ghaṭa ādeḥ pārthivasya dravyasya vināśāt tad gatānām api rūpa ādinām vināśaḥ āśraya vināśāt
agni saṃyogāt ca agni saṃyogāt ca pārthiveṣu paramāṇuṣu rūpa ādīnām vināśaḥ kārye samavetānām tu āśraya vināśāt eva
paramāṇuṣu agni saṃyogāt eva kutas guṇa antara prādurbhāvāt yasmāt śyāma ādi guṇebhyaḥ vyatiriktam guṇa antaram utpadyate tatas pūrve paramāṇu guṇāḥ vinaṣṭāḥ guṇavati guṇa an ārambhāt
etena nityeṣu anitya tvam uktam etena guṇa antara prādurbhāvena nityeṣu paramāṇuṣu rūpa ādīnām anitya tvam uktam pārthiveṣu eva
yatas apsu tejasi vāyau ca nityāḥ dravya nitya tvāt salila ānaka anila paramāṇu rūpa ādayaḥ nityāḥ āśraya nitya tvāt virodhi guṇa antara aprādurbhāvāt ca na agni saṃyogāt vināśaḥ
anityeṣu anityāḥ dravya anitya tvāt anityeṣu salila ādiṣu anityāḥ rūpa ādayaḥ āśraya vināśe teṣām api vināśāt
kāraṇa guṇa pūrvāḥ pṛthivyām pāka jāḥ ca anityāyām kārya rūpāyām pṛthivyām kāraṇa guṇa pūrvāḥ rūpa ādayaḥ jāyante nityāyām tu paramāṇu svabhāvāyām pāka jāḥ pākāt agni saṃyogāt jātāḥ
apsu tejasi vāyau ca kāraṇa guṇa pūrvāḥ pāka jāḥ na vidyante kārye udaka ādi avayavini samavāyi kāraṇa rūpe rūpa ādayaḥ ārabhyante pāka jāḥ tu jala ādi aṇuṣu na eva santi virodhi guṇa antara abhāvāt
aguṇavataḥ dravyasya guṇa ārambhāt karma guṇāḥ aguṇāḥ aguṇasya sravyasya eva utpannasya kāraṇa guṇaiḥ guṇāḥ janyante na guṇa karmaṇām aśeṣa avayava guṇa eka artha samavāya abhāvāt karma tva vat
etena pāka jāḥ vyākhyātāḥ agni saṃyogāt nivṛtteṣu śyāma ādiṣu pāka jāḥ jāyante iti te api guṇa rahite siddhāḥ

saṃyogaviti saṃyoga ārambha vat guṇavati pāka jāḥ iti ced na eka dravyavat tvāt eka dravyavantaḥ pāka jāḥ te katham tatra eva ārabhyeran viruddha tvāt saṃyogasya tu saṃyogavatī ārambhaḥ na duṣyati aneka dravya tvāt

parimāṇam idānīm vakṣyāmaḥ aṇoḥ mahataḥ ca upalabdhi anupalabdhī nitye vyākhyāte nitye iti adhyāyanām yat upalabhyate tatra avaśyam mahat tvam aṇu tve tu paramāṇu dvi aṇuka manasām anupalabdhiḥ evam nitya ākhye adhyāye upalabdhi anupalabdhyoḥ kāraṇe mahattva aṇu tve kathite bhavataḥ upalabdhau mahat tvasya niyamāt tri aṇukasya mahat tve api anupalabdhiḥ

kāraṇa bahu tvāt kāraṇa mahat tvāt pracaviśeṣāt ca mahat tri aṇuke tad kāraṇa dvi aṇuka gatā bahu tva saṃkhyā mahat tvam janayati kāraṇānām amahat tvāt dvi aṅgule kāraṇa aṅguli mahat tvam mahat tvam karoti praśithilaḥ saṃyogaḥ pracayaḥ dvi tūlake tūla piṇḍayoḥ vata mānaḥ pracayaḥ sva ādhāra avayava praśithila saṃyoga apekṣaḥ mahat tvam ārabhate
tad viparītam aṇu etasmāt tri kāraṇāt mahataḥ yat viparītam dvi aṇuka parimāṇam tat aṇu pratyetavyam

aṇu mahat iti tasmin viśeṣa bhāvāt viśeṣa abhāvāt ca tasmin mahati vastuni kuvala ādau āmalaka apekṣayā aṇu vyavahāraḥ āmalake tu bilva apekṣayā evam prakarṣasya bhāva abhāvābhyām ekasmin eva aṇu mahat vyavahāraḥ bhāktaḥ
kutas eka kāla tvāt yatas ekasmin eva kāle tasmin eva vastuni anya apekṣayā dvau puruṣau aṇu mahat vyavahāram viruddham kurvāte atas jānīmahe bhāktaḥ ayam iti
tatra apekṣikā aṇu vastuni dṛṣṭāntāt ca yathā śukla tantu janite kārye śuklimā eva na kṛṣṇa tā evam atas dṛṣṭāntāt mahadbhiḥ ārabdhe mahat tvam eva na aṇu tvam

aṇu tva mahat tvayoḥ aṇu tva mahat tva abhāvaḥ karma guṇaiḥ vyākhyātaḥ yathā guṇa karmāṇi nirguṇāni kāryasya rūpa ādeḥ avayava guṇaiḥ eka artha samavāya abhāvāt evam kāraṇa bahu tva ādibhiḥ eka artha samavāya abhāvāt aṇu tva mahat tvayoḥ tad abhāvaḥ
aṇu tva mahat tvābhyām karma guṇāḥ aguṇāḥ kāraṇa bahu tva ādibhiḥ eka artha samavāya abhāvāt aṇu tva mahat tve yathā aṇu tva mahat tva śūnye evam karmaṇā aṇu tva mahat tva śūnyāḥ

etena dīrgha tva hrasva tve vyākhyāte upalabdhi anupalabdhī mahat tva aṇu tva vat kāraṇa mahat tva ādibhyaḥ ca jāyate dīrgha tvam viparītam hrasva tvam tasmin viśeṣa bhāvāt iti aupacārika tvam tathā eva tayoḥ dīrgha tva hrasva tva abhāvaḥ iti atideśaḥ
karmabhiḥ karmāṇi guṇaiḥ guṇāḥ yathā kāraṇa bahu tva ādi ekārtha samavāya abhāvāt aṇu tva mahat tva śūnyāḥ evam dīrgha tva hrasva tva śūnyāḥ ete karma guṇāḥ
tat anitye anityam etat caturvidham parimāṇam anitye vartamāna tvāt anityam
kintu nityam parimaṇḍalam paramāṇu parimāṇam parimaṇḍalam tat nityam
tasya avidyā vidyā liṅgam parimāṇa rahitasya dravyasya asambhavaḥ paramāṇūnām paramāṇu parimāṇasya sambhave liṅgam avidyā asambhavaḥ sambhavaḥ avidyā a
vibhavāt mahān ākāśaḥ vibhavāt mūrtta dravyaiḥ samāgataiḥ agacchataḥ saṃyogāt parama mahat tvam ākāśasya asti iti gamyate
tathā ca ātmā ākāśam iva ātmā api parama mahān dṛṣṭavyaḥ asamāsāt diś kālau api mahāntau
tad abhāvāt aṇu manaḥ vibhavasya abhāvāt manasaḥ aṇu tvam jñāna ayaugapadyāt ca
guṇaiḥ diś vyākhyātā yatra yatra avadhim karoti tatra tatra idam asmāt pūrveṇa ityādi vyavahāraḥ mūrteṣu pravartate atas mūrta saṃyoga ākhyaiḥ guṇaiḥ diś vyākhyātā mahattvavatī
tathā kāraṇena kālaḥ iti yena kāraṇena parāpara vyatikara ādinā kālaḥ anumīyate tasya sarvatra bhāvāt tena eva kāraṇena kālaḥ vibhuḥ vyākhyātaḥ

idānīm saṅkhī ā ādīn upakramate bheda vyavahāra hetuḥ saṅkhyā sā adhunā rūpa ādi vyatiriktā iti etad artham āha rūpa rasa gandha sparśa vyatirekāt artha antaram eka tvam tathā pṛthaktvam ekaḥ ayam ityādi pratyayaḥ na rūpa ādi nimittaḥ tad pratyaya vilakṣaṇa tvāt rūpa ādi nimittaḥ hi rūpavān ityādi pratyayaḥ syāt tasmāt artha antara nimittaḥ ekatva eka pṛthaktve kāryeṣu kāraṇa guṇa pūrve dvi tva ādeḥ eka tvebhyaḥ aneka viṣaya buddhi sahitebhyaḥ niṣpattiḥ tathā eva dvi pṛthaktva ādeḥ pṛthaktvebhyaḥ kintu eka pṛthaktva ādya para sāmānya abhāvaḥ

tayoḥ nitya tva anityātve tejasaḥ pūra sparśābhyām vyākhyāte yathā dravya nitya tvāt tejaḥ paramāṇu rūpa sparśaiḥ nityaiḥ evam ekatva eka pṛthaktve nitya dravya vartinī nitye yathā ca anitye tejasi dravya nitya tvāt anityau rūpa sparśaiḥ tathā eva kārya vartinī anitye ekatva eka pṛthaktve
niṣpattiḥ ca yathā ca tejasi kārye kāraṇa guṇa pūrvā rūpa sparśayoḥ utpattiḥ utpattiḥ evam ekatva pṛthaktvayoḥ evam guru tva dravya tva snehānām
ekatva prthaktvayoḥ ekatva pṛthaktva abhāvaḥ aṇu tva mahat tvābhyām vyākhyātaḥ ekatva pṛthaktvayoḥ avayava guṇa eka artha samavāya abhāvāt na ekatva pṛthaktve staḥ iti arthaḥ
karmabhiḥ karmāṇi guṇaiḥ guṇāḥ tathā eva avayava guṇa eka artha samavāya abhāvāt karma guṇāḥ na ekatva pṛthaktvavantaḥ
nanu sarveṣām eva padārthānām eka tvam sat aviśeṣāt niḥsaṃkhya tvāt karma guṇānām sarva eka tvam na vidyate karmāṇām guṇānām ca saṃkhyā rahita tvāt sarva eka tvam na eva asti

bhāktam eka tvam guṇa ādiṣu iti ced eka tvasya abhāvāt bhāktam na vidyate mukhyasya ekatvasya abhāvāt guṇa ādiṣu bhāktam yat ekatvam kalpayate tat bhavataḥ eka tva siddhau na paryāpnoti dravyayeṣu mukhyam guṇeṣu bhāktam iti atas eva bheda prasaṅgāt

nanu kārya kāraṇayoḥ eka tvam prāptam dravye saṃkhyā nirviśeṣāt ekatva abhāvāt eva pṛthaktva bhāvaḥ syāt na etat kārya kāraṇa ekatva pṛthaktvā abhāvāt eka tva pṛthaktve na vidyete dvi tvāt kārya kāraṇayoḥ na eka tvam kāryasya kāraṇa vyatirikta āśraya abhāvāt na api pṛthaktvam
etat anitya nityayoḥ vyākhyātam etat pūrva sūtram anitya viṣayam api nityeṣu ākāśa ādiṣu yathāsaṃbhavam vyākhyātam boddhavyam tathā hi śabda ākāśayoḥ kārya kāraṇayoḥ na eka tvam na api pṛthaktvam

anityatara karma jaḥ ubhaya karma jaḥ saṃyoga jaḥ ca saṃyogaḥ anityatara karmañaḥ sma āyogaḥ śyenasya upasarpaṇa karmaṇā sthāṇunā mallayoḥ upasarpaṇāt ubhaya jaḥ saṃyoga jaḥ kāraṇa akāraṇayoḥ saṃyogāt kārya akārya gataḥ yathā aṅgulī ākāśa saṃyogābhyām dvi aṅgula ākāśa saṃyogaḥ

etena vibhāgaḥ vyākhyātaḥ anyatara karma jaḥ vibhāgaḥ śyenasya apasarpaṇāt ubhaya karma jaḥ meṣayoḥ apasarpaṇāt vibhāga jaḥ tu aṅgulyoḥ anyonya vibhāgāt vinaṣṭa mātre dvi aṅgule aṅgulī ākāśa vibhāgaḥ kāraṇa akāraṇayoḥ vā hasta ākāśayoḥ vibhāgāt śarīra ākāśa vibhāgaḥ
saṃyoga vibhāgayoḥ saṃyoga vibhāga abhāvaḥ aṇu tva mahat tvābhyām vyākhyātaḥ yuta siddhi abhāvāt na tau staḥ iti arthaḥ
karmabhiḥ karmāṇi guṇaiḥ guṇāḥ yuta siddhi abhāvāt na saṃyoga vibhāgavantaḥ iti arthaḥ

yuta siddhi abhāvāt kārya kāraṇayoḥ saṃyoga vibhāgau na vidyate kārya kāraṇayoḥ paraspareṇa saṃyoga vibhāgau na vidyete yathā ghaṭa kapālayoḥ yuta siddhi abhāvāt yuta siddhiḥ dviyoḥ anyatarasya vā pṛthak gatimat tvam sā ca nityayoḥ yuta āśraya samaveta tvam ca anityayoḥ yathā ghaṭa paṭayoḥ tvac indriya pārthiva śarīrayoḥ ca na ca ghaṭa kapālayoḥ yuta āśraya samavāyaḥ ghaṭasya teṣu eva samaveta tvāt
śabdasya arthena sambandhaḥ iti ced na guṇātvāt ākāśasya guṇa tvāt śabdaḥ na arthena sambadhyate
guṇe ca bhāṣyate guṇe ca pūrvam rasaḥ ityādiṣu prayujyate kriyāyām ca na ca guṇa karmaṇām guṇaiḥ sambandhaḥ
niṣkriya tvāt artha saṃyoge sati śabdaḥ artham prāpnuyāt niṣkriya tvāt ca guṇasya gamana abhāvaḥ
asati na asti iti ca prayogāt artha saṃyoge sati śabdaḥ asati abhāve na asti iti na prajyeta na hi asatā saṃyogaḥ
tasmāt saṃyoga āsya bhāvāt śabda arthau asambdhau
nanu ca saṃyoginaḥ daṇḍāt samavāyinaḥ viṣāṇāt ca saṃyogi samavāyibhyām daṇḍa viṣāṇābhyām daṇḍiṣāṇinoḥ pratyayaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ asti ca śabdāt artha pratyayaḥ tasmāt asya api sambandhaḥ asti iti
na etat dṛṣṭa tvāt ahetuḥ pratyayaḥ daṇḍi viṣāṇinoḥ dṛṣṭa tvāt adoṣaḥ iha tu śabda arthayoḥ sambandhasya ukta nyāyena adṛṣṭa tvāt ahetuḥ artha pratyayaḥ sambandhe
tathā pratyaya abhāvaḥ yadi śabdaḥ arthena sambaddhaḥ syāt agṛhīta saṅketaḥ api tatas artham pratipadyeta tasmāt asambaddhau

sambaddha sambandhāt iti ced sandehaḥ nanu śabdena ākāśam sambanddham ākāśena ca arthaḥ evam sambaddha sambandhāt arthena sambandhaḥ iti na etat sarva arthānām ākāśena sambandhāt kasmin arthe śabdaḥ prayuktaḥ iti sandehāt apratipattiḥ syāt atas na sambandhaḥ
tasmāt sāmayikaḥ śabdāt artha pratyayaḥ tasmāt saṅketa nimittaḥ śabdāt arthe pratyayaḥ na sambandhāt

eka diś kā ālābhyām sannikṛṣṭa viprakṛṣṭābhyām param a param eka dikkau piṇḍau dikkṛtayoḥ paratva aparatvayoḥ kāraṇam eka akālau vartamāna kāla sambaddhau kāla kṛtayoḥ paratva aparatvayoḥ kāraṇam tau ca sannikṛṣṭa viprakṛṣṭa buddhi apekṣayā piṇḍau kāraṇam

kāraṇa para tvāt kāraṇa apratvāt ca para apara diś pradeśa saṃyogāca samavāyi kāraṇam tathā eva parāpara kāla pradeśa saṃyogau diś kāla pradeśaiḥ saṃyogāt sannikṛṣṭa viprakṛṣṭayoḥ piṇḍayoḥ sannikṛṣṭa viprakṛṣṭa buddhyā apekṣayā sannikṛṣṭe apara tvam viprakṛṣṭe ca paratvam

paratva aparatvayoḥ paratva aparatva abhāvaḥ aṇu tva mahat tvābhyām vyākhyātaḥ parāpara diś kāla pradeśa saṃyogāḥ paratva aparatvayoḥ kāraṇam anayoḥ ca yuta siddhi abhāvena saṃyoga abhāvāt paratva aparatva abhāvaḥ
karmabhiḥ karmāṇi guṇaiḥ guṇāḥ yathā karma guṇāḥ aṇu tva mahat tva śūnyāḥ evam karmaṇā yuta siddhi abhāvena diś kāla pradeśa saṃyoga abhāvāt paratva aparatva śūnyāḥ

iha iti yatas kārya kāraṇayoḥ sa samavāyaḥ guṇa ādayaḥ samavāyinaḥ dravye atas samavāyam kathayati iha iti yatas kārya kāraṇayoḥ pratyayaḥ utpadyate iha tantuṣu paṭaḥ iha ghaṭe karma iti sa samavāyaḥ kārya kāraṇa grahaṇasya upalakṣaṇa tvāt jāteḥ vyaktau viśeṣāṇām ca nitya dravyeṣu samavāyaḥ iti uktam bhavati
dravya tva guṇa tva karma tva pratiṣedhaḥ bhāvena vyākhyātaḥ yathā eka dravyavat tvāt na dravyam bhāvaḥ guṇa karmasu ca bhāvāt na karma na guṇaḥ evam samavāyaḥ api
tattvam ca iti yathā sat liṅga aviśeṣāt ekaḥ bhāvaḥ tathā ihaliṅga aviśeṣāt ekaḥ samavāyaḥ vṛtti rahitaḥ nityaḥ niravayavaḥ ca
buddhiḥ idānīm nirūpyate dravyeṣu jñānam vyākhyātam ṣaṇṇām para arthānām madhyāt dravyeṣu eva jñānam vyākhyātam yathā utpadyate sannikarṣāt na tu guṇa ādiṣu
tasya manaḥ ātmā ca manaḥ ātmā ca jñānasya kāraṇam vyākhyātam
idānīm guṇa ādiṣu jñānam āha jñāna nirddeśe jñāna niṣpatiḥ uktā yatas indriya sannikarṣeṇa jñāna niṣpattiḥ uktā guṇa ādīnām ca indriyeṇa sannikarṣaḥ na asti iti aḥ tu idānīm jñānam ucyate

teṣām asannikarṣaḥ vijñānam yatas guṇa karmasu asannikṛṣṭeṣu jñāna niṣpatteḥ dravyam kāraṇam kāraṇa kāraṇam ca guṇa karmaṇām yatas dravyam samavāyi kāraṇam tat steṣu sākṣāt indriyeṇa āsat nikṛṣṭeṣu vijñāna niṣpatteḥ kāraṇasya tet eva dravyam kāraṇam na guṇa karmāṇi tasmāt guṇa karmasu saṃyukta samavāyāt jñānam caśabdaḥ hetau
sāmānya viśeṣeṣu sāmānya viśeṣa abhāvāt tat eva jñānam sāmānye sattā ādau viśeṣeṣu ca antyeṣu tad darśinām dravya sannikarṣāt eva jñānam utpadyate na sāmānya viśeṣebhyaḥ teṣu tad abhāvāt

anyatra tu sāmānya viśeṣa apekṣam dravya guṇa karmasu dravya guṇa karmasu dravya indriya sannikarṣāt sāmānyāt ca sattā ādeḥ sāmānya viśeṣāt ca dravya tva ādeḥ sat iti dravyam ityādi ca jñānam utpadyate iti iha sūtre sāmānyam sattā viśeṣāḥ dravya ātva ādayaḥ pūrva sūtre anyathā

tatra api dravye dravya guṇa karma apekṣam cakṣuḥ sannikarṣāt yat jñānam dravye sāmānya viśeṣa apekṣam viṣāṇī iti guṇa apekṣam śuklaḥ iti karma apekṣam gacchati iti utpadyate iti dravya ādīnām ca viśeṣaṇa tvāt pūrvam upalambhaḥ tena viśeṣaṇa buddheḥ kāraṇa tvam viśeṣya buddheḥ kāryatvam
guṇa karmasu guṇa karma abhāvāt guṇa karma apekṣam na vidyate guṇe guṇa karmaṇoḥ abhāvāt karmaṇi ca guṇa karma nimittam guṇa karmasu jñānam na bhavati iti

dravya ādau jñānasya pūrva utpattau aniyamaḥ yathā samavāyinaḥ śvaityāt śvaitya buddhaiḥ śvete buddhiḥ te kārya kāraṇa bhūte śveta guṇa samavāyinaḥ śvaitya sāmānyāt śvaitya sāmānya jñānāt ca śveta guṇa jñānam jāyate sāmānya guṇa sambandhaḥ api draṣṭavyaḥ atas viśeṣaṇa buddhiḥ kāraṇam viśeṣya buddhiḥ kāryam

viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya tva abhāve tu dravyeṣu anitara itara kāraṇāt kāraṇa ayaugapadyāt aṇu tvāt manasaḥ yaugapadya abhāvāt sati api krame ghaṭa paṭa jñānayoḥ na kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya tva ayogāt

tathā dravya guṇa karmasu kāraṇā viśeṣāt gauḥ śuklā gacchati iti ca dravya guṇa karmasu jñānānām krameṇa api jāyamānānām na kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya tā abhāvāt iti asya pūrva uktasya kāraṇasya aviśeṣāt atas dravya jñānam na guṇa karma buddhyoḥ kāraṇam guṇa karma buddhī api na parasya kāraṇam

viśeṣaṇa nyāya abhāve tu ayam eṣa kṛtam tvayā bhojaya enam iti buddhi apekṣam ayam iti sannikṛṣṭe eṣaḥ iti ca kiñcid viprakṛṣṭe pratyayaḥ kṛtam tvayā iti karma kartṛ pratyayau bhojaya enam iti kartṛ karma pratyayau sannikṛṣṭa apekṣaḥ viprakṛṣṭe pratyayaḥ kṛtam iti karma apekṣaḥ kartari bhojaya iti kartṛ apekṣaḥ karmaṇi

kutas sa apekṣāḥ iti ced dṛṣṭeṣu bhāvāt adṛṣṭeṣu abhāvāt dṛṣṭeṣu satsu yatas sannikṛṣṭa ādiṣu viprakṛṣṭa ādi pratyayāḥ bhavanti na adṛṣṭeṣu atas sa apekṣāḥ api santaḥ na kārya kāraṇa bhūtāḥ viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya tva ayogāt

buddhīnām artha indriya apekṣa tve api arthaḥ tāvat ucyate arthaḥ iti dravya guṇa karmasu vinā api artha tvena sāmānyena triṣu eva dravya ādiṣu tatra prasiddhyā artha śabdaḥ paribhāṣyate kkā iva yathā sāmānya viśeṣeṣu vinā sāmānya antareṇa yathā sattā ādiṣu sāmānyeṣu sāmānyam sāmānyam iti jñānam tathā viśeṣeṣu viśeṣa antara abhāve api viśeṣaḥ viśeṣaḥa iti tad darśinām vijñānam evam dravya ādiṣu vinā api artha tvena paribhāṣikaḥ artha śabdaḥ

indriyāṇi ucyate tāni ca na pañca ātmakāni yatas dravyeṣu pañca ātmakam pratyuktam yatas dravyeṣu ārabdhavyeṣu pañcabhūtāni ārambhakāṇi na vidyante api tu yāni ārabhante catvāri tāni svām svām jātim ārabhante

evam indriyāṇi api pratiniyata bhūta kāryāṇi tathā bhūyas tvāt gandhavat tvāt ca pṛthivī gandha jñāne gandha jñanam ghrāṇam tasmin ārabdhavye pṛthivī kāraṇam bhūyas tvāt śarīra apekṣayā tu bhūyas tvam bhūyas tvam ca ghrāṇe pṛthivyāḥ pāda ādinā gandha upalabdhi abhāvāt gandhavat tvāt ca yatas ca sva samavāyinā gandhena ghrāṇa indriyam gandham abhivyanakti atas tasya gandhavatī pṛthivī eva kāraṇam bhūta antarāṇi tu saṃyogīni su alpāni eva

tathā apaḥ tejaḥ vāyuḥ ca rasa rūpa sparśa jñāneṣu rasa rūpa sparśa viśeṣāt iti sva samavāyinā madhurā pāka jena rasena rūpeṇa śukla bhāsvareṇa sparśena apāka ja an uṣṇa aśītena yatas rasana nayana sparśanāni rasa rūpa sparśān abhivyañjanti atas rasavat tvāt rūpavat tvāt sparśavat tvāt ca bhūta antaraiḥ nimittaiḥ anabhibhūta tvena bhūyastvāt ca triṣu indriyeṣu yathāsaṅkhyam āpaḥ tejaḥ vāyuḥ ca samavāyi kāraṇāni draṣṭavyāni ākāśam tu svatas eva śrotram karṇa śaṣkulī avacchinnam na prakṛtiḥ anārambhaka tvāt evam pratyakṣam vyākhyātam

idānīm anumānam vyācikhyāsuḥ tasya viṣayam darśayati kriyā guṇa vyadeśa abhāvāt asat na tāvat pāryam prāk utpatteḥ pratyakṣeṇa gṛhyate na api anumānena sati liṅge tasya bhāvāt liṅga abhāvaḥ ca tadīyayoḥ kriyā guṇayoḥ anupalabdheḥ na ca anyat vyapadeśa śabda sūcitam liṅgam asti tasmāt prāk utpatteḥ asat
paścāt sat asat sadbhūtam ca kāryam pradhvastam uttara kālam asat eva na sataḥ tirodhānam kriyā guṇa vyapadeśa abhāvāt eva
madhye tu asataḥ sat kriyā guṇa vyapadeśa bhāvāt artha antaram pradhvasāt pūrvam utpatteḥ uttara kālam asataḥ artha antara bhūtam vastu sat iti ucyate kriyā guṇa vyapadeśānām bhāvāt
sat ca asat sat api vastu bhāva antara niṣedhena gauḥ aśvaḥ na bhavati iti kārya kāraṇena na ayam gauryaḥ na vahati asat iti upacaryate

yat ca anyat sataḥ tat api asat sataḥ ca vastunaḥ yat anyat atyanta abhāva rūpam prāk upādhi pradhvaṃsa abhāva aviṣayam śaśa viṣāṇa ādi tat api asat eva asatām aviśeṣāt prāk asati katham kāraka pravṛttiḥ mā anī atra iti ced na viśeṣa grahaṇāt

tatra asat iti bhūta pratyakṣa abhāvāt bhūta smṛteḥ virodhi pratyakṣa tvāt ca jñānam pradhvaṃsa asati asat iti jñānam bhūtasya vastunaḥ pūva vat idānīm darśana abhāvāt tasya ca bhūtasya vastunaḥ smaraṇāt virodhinaḥ ca kapāla ādeḥ grahaṇāt vināśam parikalpya utpadyate anyathā tat katham iva na dṛśyeta tathā aviśeṣāt

prāgabhāve tu tathā abhāve bhāva pratyakṣa tvāt ca mṛd piṇḍa avasthāyām prāgabhāve ghaṭa viṣayam pratyakṣa jñānam na abhūt idānīm tu ghaṭa viṣayam viruddham vijñānam udabhūt smaryate ca abhāva avasthā tasmāt idānīm ayam bhāvaḥ samabhūt pūrva masya abhāvaḥ eva ca āsīt iti prāgabhāve asat iti niścaya jñānam

etena aghaṭaḥ agauradharmaḥ ca vyākhyātaḥ yadā hi sthālyām ghaṭaḥ iti utpanna vijñānasya kāraṇa antarataḥ samyak pratyayaḥ utpadyate na ayam ghaṭaḥ sthālīyam iti tat api ghaṭa pratyayasya abhāvāt tasya ca smaraṇāt viruddhasya ca sthālī ādeḥ darśanāt boddhavyam evam aśve agauḥ iti tathā sāmānyatas darśanāt rātri snāna ādeḥ dharma tve sambhāvite adharmaḥ iti upadyate iti cetanā cetam āti indriya bhedena udāharaṇa trayam

abhūtam na asti iti anartha antaram prāc pradhvaṃsa upādhi abhāvebhyaḥ yat atyanta abhāva rūpam śaśa viṣāṇāt tat abhūtam na asti ti paryāya śabdābhyām avyatiriktam ucyate na asya paryāya śabdaiḥ artha antara tā kathyate atas asya paryāya śabdaiḥ eva upadarśaṇam lakṣaṇam na asya deśa kāla ādi niṣedhaḥ
anyatra tu na asti ghaṭaḥ gehaḥ iti sataḥ ghaṭasya geha saṃyoga pratiṣedhaḥ na asti ghaṭaḥ asmin deśe kāle vā iti deśa ādi niṣedhaḥ ghaṭa ādeḥ na svarūpataḥ niṣedhaḥ kriyate iti

na asti anya candramāḥ iti sāmānyāt candramasaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ na asti dvitīyaḥ candramāḥ iti saṅkhyā pratiṣedhena sāmānyāt candra tva ākhyāt candramāḥ nivartyate iti kṛtvā candra tvam sāmānyam na asti iti uktam bhavati deśa kāla bhāva samarthya upādhī nāma bhāve tat atyanta asataḥ eva prabhedaḥ candra tva sāmānya niṣedhaḥ iti varṇayanti sakatābhyaḥ anutpatteḥ dadhnaḥ kṣīrāt ca utpatteḥ pratyakṣeṇa ca agrahaṇāt sat asat kāryam kāraṇe
sat asatoḥ vaidharmyāt kārye sat asat tā na sattva asattvayoḥ yugapad viruddha tvāt na sat asat kāryam kāraṇe tasmāt asat eva

pratyakṣa parokṣa viṣaya tvāt yogi pratyakṣam pratyakṣa anumānayoḥ madhye vyākhyāyate ātmani ātma manasoḥ saṃyoga viśeṣāt ātma pratyakṣam āhṛtya viṣayebhyaḥ indriyāṇi tebhyaḥ ca manaḥ ātmani eva yadā samādhīyate tadā yoga ja dharma apkṣād ātma antaḥkaraṇa saṃyogāt viśiṣṭāt tatrabhavatām svasmin ātmani jñānam pratyakṣam utpadyate
tathā dravya antareṣu pratiṣiddha ātma saṃyogeṣu vyāpaka dravyeṣu ātmanā asaṃyukteṣu apratiṣiddha ātma saṃyogeṣu ca paramāṇu ādiṣu ubhābhyām saṃyukteṣu jñānam utpadyate
kiñca ātma indriya manortha sannikarṣāt ca sūkṣma vyavahita viprakṛṣṭeṣu artheṣu teṣām catuṣṭaya sannikarṣāt api pratyakṣam jāyate tathā asmad ādi pratyakṣeṣu

tad samavāyāt karma guṇeṣu yathā antaḥkaraṇa saṃyogāt dravya antareṣu jñānam utpadyate tathā eva tad dravya samaveteṣu karma guṇeṣu jñānam utpadyate yathā ca catuṣṭaya sannikarṣāt sūkṣma ādiṣu asmad pratyakṣeṣu ca jñānam tathā eva tad samaveteṣu guṇa karmasu jñānam utpadyate saṃyukta samavāyāt
ātma samavāyādatma guṇeṣu yathā ātma manaḥ saṃyogāt svasmin ātmani jñānam tathā eva sva ātma samaveteṣu sukha ādiṣu jñānam utpadyate

yogi pratyakṣam vyākhyāya anumānam vyācaṣṭe asya idam kāryam kāraṇam sambandhi eka artha samavāyi virodhi ca iti laiṅgikam asya idam iti sambandha mātram darśayitvā kāryam kāraṇam ityādinā viśinaṣṭi kārya kāraṇa grahaṇena samavāyi mātra upalakṣaṇāt jāti ādeḥ api grahaṇam sambandhi śabdena saṃyoginaḥ grahaṇam dhūma ādeḥ anyat vyākhyātam saṃyogi ādi sūtre tatra evaṃvidha prasiddha sambandhasya artha eka deśam asandigdham paśyataḥ śeṣa anuvyavasāyaḥ yaḥ sa liṅga darśanāt sañjāyamānaḥ laiṅgikam iti vṛtti kāraḥ

etena śabdam vyākhyātam yathā kārya ādi smṛti savyapekṣam anumānam tri kāla viṣayam atīndriya artham ca tathā eva śābdam saṅketa smṛti apekṣam tri kāla viṣayam atīndriya artham ca atas anumānena eka yogakṣema tvāt anumānam eva iti uktam bhavati
kaḥ śabdaḥ arthasya ced tat ucyate hetuḥ apadeśaḥ liṅgam nimittam pramāṇam kāraṇam iti anartha antaram hetu ādi śabdaiḥ tātparyeṇa kāraṇam kathayati hetuḥ apadeśaḥ kāraṇa priti arthaḥ

evam śabdaḥ kāraṇam sat arthasya pratipattau liṅgam kutas iti ced asya idam iti buddhi apekṣa tvāt yathā arthasya pratipattau iyam hasta ceṣṭā kāraṇam pratipattavyāḥ iti vṛtta saṅketaḥ tām hasta ceṣṭām dṛṣṭvā tatas śabdāt kāraṇāt artham pratipadyate evam asya arthasya pratipattau ayam śabdaḥ kāraṇam iti prasiddha saṅketaḥ tatas śabdāt kāraṇāt artham pratipadyat te yathā abhinaya ādeḥ api artham pratipadyante laukikāḥ evam śabdaḥ arthasya saṅketa vaśena vyañjaka tvāt kāraṇam iti vṛtti kāraḥ evam upamāna ādīnām antarbhāvaḥ evam dve eva pramāṇe pramāṇa tvam ca pramīyate anena iti pramāṇam pramā pramāṇam iti vā

anumāna aṅgam smṛtiḥ ucyate ātma manahoḥ saṃyoga viśeṣāt saṃskārāt ca smṛti agni arthinaḥ ghūma darśanam yat utpannam tad apekṣāt ātma antaḥkaraṇa saṃyogāt viśiṣṭāt ca bhāvanā ākhya saṃskārāt yatra dhūmaḥ tatra agniḥ iti smṛtiḥ upatpadyate

tathā svapnaḥ svapna antikam ca uparata indriyasya pralīna manaskasya antaḥkaraṇena eva jñānam svapnaḥ svapne pi svapna jñānam svapna antikam tat ubhayam pūrva pratyaya apekṣāt ātma manaḥ saṃyoga viśeṣāt bhāvanā sahāyāt utpadyate
dharmāt ca ananubhūta artha viṣayam api svapna jñānam śubha aśubha sūcakam dharmāt caśabdāt adharmāt ca iti

jāgrataḥ tu indriya doṣāt saṃskārāt ca avidyā vāta ādi doṣeṇa upahata indriyasya pūrva jatā anubhava janitāt saṃskārāt ātma manaḥ saṃyogāt ca viśiṣṭāt adharma apekṣādatasmin tadā eti jñānam yathā śuktikāyām rajatam iti anadhyavasāyaḥ yathā dākṣiṇāti asya uṣṭra darśane
tat duṣṭam jñānam yat etat saṃśaya viparyaya anadhyavasāya svapna lakṣaṇam tat duṣṭam apramāṇam iti
aduṣṭam vidyā yat aduṣṭam pratyakṣa anumāna ākhyaṃtat vidyā iti ucyate

ārṣam siddha darśanam ca dharmebhyaḥ tatra yat liṅga nirapekṣam atīta anāgata vartamāneṣu dharma ādiṣu atīndriyeṣu granthaiḥ anupātteṣu deva rṣīṇām yat prātibham utpadyate vijñānam laukikānām kadācid eva śvas me bhrātā āgantā hṛdatam me kathayati a iti anavadhāraṇa phalam kevalam tarkeṇa nīyate tadā ārṣam iti ucyate añjana rasāyana ādi siddhānām yu sūkṣma vyavahita viprakṛṣṭa artha viṣayam yat vā divya antarikṣa ādi nimittebhyaḥ prāṇinām dharma adharma vipāla parijñānam tat siddha darśanam tat ca pratyakṣa anumānābhyām na bhidyate ārṣam bhidyate iti varṇayanti tat etat ārṣām siddha darśanam ca viśiṣṭāt dharmāt ātma manaḥ saṃyogāt ca utpadyate

buddhi prasaṅgaḥ eva aparyavasite sukha duḥkhaddhyoḥ ālambane sukha duḥkhe ca kathayati tathā hi sukha duḥkha moham ayāni bhūtāni iti āhiḥ tat ayuktam ātma samavāyaḥ sukha duḥkhayoḥ pañcabhyaḥ artha antara tve hetuḥ tad āśrayibhyaḥ ca guṇebhyaḥ ātmani eva yaḥ samavāyaḥ sukha duḥkha dyoḥ asau pañcabhyaḥ kṣiti ādibhyaḥ tad āśrayibhyaḥ ca guṇebhyaḥ gandha rasa rūpa sparśebhyaḥ artha antara tve hetuḥ anya guṇānām anyatra asamavāyāt ātma samavāyaḥ ca etayoḥ ahaṅkāreṇa eka vākya bhāvāt

ātma samavāyi tve api iṣṭa aniṣṭa kāraṇa viśeṣāt virodhāt ca mithas sukha duḥkhayoḥ artha antara bhāvaḥ strī ādi kāraṇa janyam sukham viṣa ādi kāraṇa janyam duḥkham paraspara viruddhe ca sukha duḥkhe anyonya vināśena utpatteḥ atas anayoḥ bhedaḥ na ekatvam ekrātha samavāyāt

saṃśaya nirṇayau paraspara abhāva mātram na vastu santau iti ced na saṃśaya nirṇayayoḥ artha antara bhāvaḥ ca jñānantara tve hetuḥ artha antarāt paraspara vilakṣaṇāt kāraṇāt bhāvaḥ utpattiḥ saṃśaya nirṇayayoḥ tathā hi viśeṣam jijñāsoḥ agṛhīta viśeṣasya sāmānya locanāt saṃśayaḥ jāyate saṃśayāt paratas pramāṇa antareṇa viśeṣa grahaṇat sthāṇuḥ eva ayam iti niścayaḥ yadi ca etau na vastu santau bhavetām na etau vilakṣaṇa kāraṇābhyām utpadyeyātām atas jñāna antara bhūtau saṃśaya nirṇayau parasparataḥ nirṇayaḥ tu pratyakṣa anumānābhyām na bhidyate iti kecid

tayoḥ niṣpattiḥ pratyakṣa laiṅgikābhyām jñānābhyām vyākhyātā yathā smṛtim atas ātmanaḥ pratyakṣam liṅgam dṛṣṭvā apratyakṣe jñānam utpadyate tathā eva sāmānya mātra darśanāt smṛtimataḥ viśeṣam jijñāsoḥ agṛhīte viśeṣe sthāṇuḥ puruṣaḥ vā iti jāyate saṃśayaḥ yathā ca bhūta artha sambadha vaśena ayam evaṃbhūtaḥ arthaḥ iti pratyakṣam utpadyate tathā eva viśeṣa sambandha vaśena nivṛtte saṃśaye idam evaṃbhūtam iti nirṇayaḥ jāyate

idānīm kārya kāraṇa buddhī nirūpayati bhūtam iti pratyakṣam vyākhyātam sva kāraṇebhyaḥ utpanne kārye bhūtam niṣpannam idam kāryam iti kārya jñānam viśeṣaṇa jñānāt viśeṣya jñānam iti nyāyena tat vyākhyātam tat ca mukhyam

anyatra tu aipacārikam kārya abhāvāt tathā hi niṣpatsyamāne kārye bhaviṣyati iti kārya antare dṛṣṭa tvāt yathā bhūtāyāḥ sāmagryāḥ anantaram paṭa ādi kāryam utpannam dṛṣṭam tathābhūta sāmagrī darśam ād idānīm anutpanne api kārye kārya śabdam upacarya bhaviṣyati kāryam iti jāyate kārya buddhiḥ

niṣpadyamāne api tathā bhavati iti sa apekṣebhyaḥ anapekṣebhyaḥ ca yadā prastāritān tantūn pūrva pūrva saṃyoga apekṣā anupalabhamānaḥ paścāt paścāt uttarottara tantu saṃyoge sati anapekṣān upalabhate tadā asya paṭṭikā ādi ava antaram kāryam paśyataḥ upaṣadyamāne kārya dravye niṣpannā niṣpanna saṃyoga paryācanayā bhavati kāryam utpadyate kāryam iti jāyate buddhiḥ

yathā ca utpattau evam vināśe api prayatna anantara utpattīnām ghaṭa ādi dravyāṇām vināśe abhūt iti pratyayasya bhūta pratyakṣa abhāvāt ityādinā kathita tvāt idānīm pāriṇāmike śarīra ādau kathyate tatra vinaṣṭe abhūt iti abhūtāt abhūtāt vinaṣṭāt iti arthaḥ pāṇi pāda grīvā ādīn avayavān vibhaktān upalabhya vinaṣṭāt asamavāyi kāraṇāt saṃyogāt vinaṣṭe kārye abhūt kāryam śarīra ākhyam iti jāyate buddhiḥ

vinaśyati punar sati ca kārya asamavāyāt sati saṃyoge caśabdāt asati ghātaka ādi vināśa kāraṇabhyā pāre api keṣāñcid grīvadi avayavānām anivṛtte saṃyoge vibhāgāt ca pāṇi ādīnām vinivṛtte kāryasya śarīra ādeḥ asamavāyād vināśa kāraṇa ghrāta tvena pracalitvāt vinaṣṭa avinaṣṭa saṃyoga ālovanena kāryam naśyati iti jñānam utpadyate anye tu abhūt kāryam iti vyācakṣate tat ayuktam tad abhiprāyeṇa eva kāryasya vinaṣṭa tvāt

eṣā ca buddhiḥ eka artha samavāyiṣu kāraṇa antareṣu darśanāt eka deśaḥ iti ekasmin śarīra ādau kkacid ekasmin arye yadā pāṇi ādayaḥ avayavāḥ samavāyinaḥ upalabdhāḥ atha asya teṣu eka deśa buddhiḥ utpannā idānīm tān vibhajya vibhaktān upalabhya etasmin eka deśini abhūt kāryam iti jñāna utpattiḥ
ke te avayavāḥ iti āha śiraḥ pṛṣṭam udaram pāṇiḥ iti tad viśeṣebhyaḥ sva sāmānya viśeṣebhyaḥ śiraḥ tu ādibhyaḥ yeṣu jñānam jāyate te śiraḥ ādayaḥ avayavāḥ iti arthaḥ
kāraṇa buddhiḥ tu kāraṇam iti dravye kārya samavāyāt kāryam dravyam guṇān karma vā samavetam dravye paśyataḥ dravyam kāraṇam iti mukhyā buddhiḥ kāryasya jāta tvāt
ajāte tu saṃyoga dvā janiṣyamāṇe api kārye tantu ādīnām paraspareṇa saṃyogāt asya paṭam prati teṣu kāraṇa buddhiḥ utpadyate
kāraṇa samavāyāt karmaṇi saṃyoga vibhāgeṣu nirapekṣa kāraṇa tvāt tad kāraṇa dravye samaveta tvāt karma utpanna mātram eva kāraṇa buddhim janayati

idānīm guṇeṣu tathā rūpe kāraṇa kāraṇa samavāyāt ca kārya rūpasya samavāyi kāraṇe paṭa ādau yat samavāyi kāraṇam tantavaḥ teṣu kāraṇa kāraṇeṣu samaveta tvāt kāraṇam rūpa ādayaḥ iti ucyante caśabdāt anutpanne api kārya rūpe kāraṇa buddhiḥ
kāraṇa samavāyāt saṃyoge kāryasya paṭa ādeḥ samavāyi kāraṇeṣu tantu ādiṣu samaveta tvāt saṃyoge dravyam prati kāraṇa buddhiḥ

guṇa karma ārambhe tu tathā kāraṇa akāraṇa samavāyāt ca kāreṇe ghaṭe akāraṇe ca agnau agni saṃyogaḥ samaveta tvāt kāraṇam pāka jānām abhighātye karma kāraṇe abhihantari ca akāraṇe samaveta tvāt veda vat dravya saṃyogaḥ karmaṇaḥ kāraṇam

pākaja ārambhe tu saṃyukta samavāyāt agneḥ vaiśeṣikam aṇūnām pākaja rūpa ādi ārambhe aṇubhiḥ saṃyukte agnau samavetam uṣṇa sparśam vaiśeṣikam guṇam apekṣate saṃyogaḥ dravyam varjatitvā anyatra saṃyogaḥ sa apekṣaḥ kāraṇam
atīndriye bhūtādau arthe laiṅgikam pramāṇam vyākhyātam laiṅgikam parokṣam ucyate bhaviṣyati ityādi kāryāṇām yena avagamyate tad anumānam prāmāṇam vyākhyātam

śāstra ādau dharmaḥ vyākhyeya tayā pratijñātaḥ atas tasya pratyāmnāya anusaṃdhāna artham sūtra dvayam gatam api punar ucyate dṛṣṭānām dṛṣṭa prayojanānām dṛṣṭa abhāve prayogaḥ abhyudayāya śrutau smṛtau ca dṛṣṭānām dṛṣṭasya prayojanasya abhāve prayogaḥ abhyudayāya dharmāya iti arthaḥ

tasya ca āmnāyāt samadhigamaḥ uktaḥ āmnāyasya ca siddham prāmāṇyam tad vacanāt āmnāya prāmāṇyam iti tanu bhuvana ādi kārya tayā vijñātaḥ bhagavān īśvaraḥ tad praṇayanāt ca āmnāyasya siddham prāmāṇyam iti śabdaḥ samāpti arthaḥ evam dravya ādīnām sādharmya vaidharmya parijñānāt vairāgya dvāreṇa jñāna utpatteḥ ātmā jñātavyaḥ ityādi vākyebhyaḥ ca upāsā krameṇa vijñāna avāpteḥ niḥśreyasa adhigamaḥ jagataḥ asya ānanda karam vidyā śarvaryā sadā eva yaḥ candyam ānandayati sa vṛttim candrānandaḥ vyadhāt etām
namaḥ mañjunāthāya
parokṣa artha pratipatteḥ anumāna āśraya tvāt saṅkṣepataḥ tad vyutpādana artham idam ārabhyate

pakṣaḥ dharmī avayave samudāya upacarāt prayojana abhāvāt anupacāraḥ iti ced na sarva dharmi dharma pratiṣedha artha tvāt upacārasya evam hi cākṣuṣa tva ādi parihṛtam bhavati dharma vacanena api dharma āśraya siddhau para āśraya tvāt dharmasya dharma vacanāt pratyāsatteḥ sādhya dharmi siddhiḥ iti ced na dṛṣṭānta dharmiṇaḥ api pratyāsatteḥ tad aṃśa vyāptyā dṛṣṭānta dharmiṇi sattva siddheḥ dharmi dharma vacanāt sādhya dharmi parigrahaḥ siddhe punarvacanam niyama artham āśaṅkyeta sajātīyaḥ eva sattvam iti siddhe api tad abhāve vyatireke sādhya abhāve asattva vacana vat dharmi dharma vacanam siddhe api dṛṣṭānta dharmiṇi bhāve tad aṃśa vyāpti vacanāt tatra eva bhāva niyama artham āśaṅkyeta tat sāmarthyāt artha gatau upacāra mātrāt samāna nirdeśāt pratipatti gauravam ca parihṛtam bhavati pakṣasya dharma tve tad viśeṣaṇa apekṣasya anyatra ananuvṛtteḥ asādhāraṇa tā iti ced na ayoga vyavacchedena viśeṣaṇāt yathā caitraḥ dhanurdharaḥ iti na anya yoga vyavacchedena yathā pārthaḥ dhanurdhadaraḥ iti
tad aṃśaḥ tad dharmaḥ
vyāptiḥ vyāpakasya tatra bhāvaḥ eva vyāpyasya vā tatra eva bhāvaḥ

etena anvayaḥ vyatirekaḥ vā yathāsvam pramāṇena niścitaḥ uktaḥ veditavyaḥ pakṣa dharmaḥ ca sarvatra hetau asatā sādhya dharmeṇa hetoḥ vyāpti asiddheḥ vyāpakasya vā nivṛttau nivṛtti abhāvāt iti anvaya vyatirekābhyām niścitābhyām tad aṃśa vyāptiḥ niścitā bhavati

tatra pakṣa dharmasya sādhya dharmiṇi pratyakṣataḥ anumānataḥ vā prasiddhiḥ niścayaḥ yathā pradeśe dhūmasya śabde vā kṛtaka tvasya sa dhūmam hi pradeśam artha antara vivikta rūpam asādhāraṇa ātmanā dṛṣṭavataḥ pratyakṣeṇa yathā dṛṣṭa bheda parama artha viṣayam smārtam liṅga jñānam utpadyate
tatra tat ādyam asādhāraṇa viṣayam darśanam eva pramāṇam

tasmin tathābhūte dṛṣṭe sa yena yena asādhāraṇaḥ tat asādhāraṇa tām tatas bhedam abhilapantī smṛtiḥ utpannā pratyakṣa balena atad vyāvṛtti viṣayāḥ yathā dṛṣṭa ākāra grahaṇāt na pramāṇam prāk asādhāraṇam dṛṣṭvā asādhāraṇam iti abhilapataḥ apūrvā artha adhigama abhāvāt artha kriyā sādhanasya darśanāt adṛṣṭasya tad sādhanasya punar svabhāvasya vikalpena apratipatteḥ ca anumāna vat artha kriyā arthī hi sarvaḥ pramāṇam apramāṇam vā anveṣate prekṣāvān na ca sāmānyam kāñcid artha kriyām upakalpayati sva lakṣaṇa pratipatteḥ ūrdhvam tad sāmarthya utpanna vikalpa jñāna grāhyam

yathā nīlam dṛṣṭvā nīlam iti jñāne tat eva hi nīla sva lakṣaṇam tathāvidha sādhya artha kriyā kāri tat ca tena ātmanā pratyakṣeṇa dṛṣṭam eva na ca tad sva lakṣaṇa grahaṇa uttara kāla bhāvinaḥ nīla vikalpasya viṣayeṇa nīla sādhya artha kriyā sādhyate tasmāt anadhigata artha viṣayam pramāṇam iti api anadhigate sva lakṣaṇaḥ iti viśeṣaṇīyam adhigate sva lakṣaṇe tad sāmarthya janmā vikalpaḥ tad anukārī kāryataḥ tad viṣaya tvāt smṛtiḥ eva na pramāṇam anadhigata vastu rūpa an adhigateḥ vastu adhiṣṭhāna tvāt pramāṇa vyavasthāyāḥ artha kriyā yogya viṣaya tvāt tad arthi pravṛtteḥ artha kriyā yogya lakṣaṇa tvāt vastunaḥ tatas api vikalpāt tad adhyavasāyena vastuni eva pravṛtteḥ pravṛttau tu vikalpasya pratyakṣeṇa abhinna yogakṣema tvāt

pūrva pratyakṣa kṣaṇena kvacid abhinna upayoga tvāt uttareṣām aprāmāṇya prasaṅgaḥ iti ced na kṣaṇa viśeṣa sādhya arthavāñchāyām nānā yoga kṣema tvāt sādhāraṇe hi kārye na teṣām sāmarthya bhedaḥ apara apara dhūma pramita sannikṛṣṭa agni vat agni mātra sādhye arthe etena dharmi dharma liṅga ādi vikalpasya pramāṇa pṛṣṭha bhāvinaḥ prāmāṇyam pratyuktam

anvaya niścayaḥ api svabhāva hetau sādhya dharmasya vastutas tad bhāva tayā sādhana dharma bhāva mātra anubandha siddhiḥ sā sādhya viparyaye hetoḥ bādhaka pramāṇa vṛttiḥ yathā yat sat tat kṣaṇikam eva akṣaṇika tve artha kriyā virodhāt tad lakṣaṇam vastu tvam hīyate iti

kārya hetau kārya kāraṇa bhāva siddhiḥ yathā idam asya upalambhe upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptam anupalabdham upalabhyate satsu api anyeṣu hetuṣu asya abhāve na bhavati iti tad bhāve bhāvaḥ abhāve abhāvaḥ ca pratyakṣa anupalambha sādhanaḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ tasya siddhiḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ eva hi artha antarasya evam syāt yatra dhūmaḥ tatra avaśyam agniḥ iti agni bhāvaḥ eva hi bhāvaḥ dhūmasya tad kārya tvam iti
anupalabdhau api asat vyavahārasya upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāpta anupalabdhi mātra vṛtti sādhanam anvaya niścayaḥ nimitta antara abhāva upadarśanāt

vyatireka niścayaḥ api kārya svabhāva hetvoḥ kārya kāraṇa vyāpya vyāpaka bhāva siddhau kāraṇa vyāpaka anupalabdhibhyām dṛśya viṣayābhyām sādhya abhāve hetu abhāva siddhiḥ uddiṣṭa viṣayasya abhāvasya upadarśane anupalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptasya anyathā kvacid abhāva asiddheḥ anuddiṣṭa viṣayam punar sādhya abhāve abhāva khyāpanam pratibandha mātra siddhau sidhyati iti na tatra dṛśya viṣaya tā anupalabdheḥ vyatireka sādhane apekṣyate
vyatireka niścayaḥ anupalabdhau upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptāt sataḥ anupalambha abhāva darśanam

etad lakṣaṇaḥ tridhā eva sa hetuḥ tri prakāraḥ eva svabhāvaḥ kāryam anupalabdhiḥ ca iti yathā anitye kasmiṃścid gamye sattvam agnimati pradeśe dhūmaḥ abhāve ca upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptasya anupalabdhiḥ iti asmin eva tri prakāre avinābhāva niyamāt yathā uktā vyāptiḥ avinābhāvaḥ pakṣa dharmasya na sa trividhāt dhetoḥ anyatra asti iti atra eva niyataḥ ucyate

tatra sādhana dharma bhāva mātra anvayini sādhya dharme svabhāvaḥ hetuḥ vastutas liṅgi svabhāvaḥ eva apara apara vyāvṛttyā dharma bhede api hetuḥ hetu svabhāve anvaya vyabhicāra abhāvāt viśeṣaṇam lakṣaṇe tanmātra anvayena parama tāpekṣam pare hi artha antara nimittam atadbhāva mātra anvayinam api dharmam svabhāvam icchanti iti viśeṣaṇena tathāvidhasya atad svabhāva tām tasmin sādhye hetoḥ vyabhicāram ca āha yathā vināśe hetumati kṛtaka tvasya

tasya dvidhā prayogaḥ sādharmyeṇa vaidharmyeṇa ca yathā yat sat tat sarvam kṣaṇikam yathā ghaṭa ādayaḥ san ca śabdaḥ iti tathā kṣaṇika tva abhāve sattva abhāvaḥ yathā vandhyā sute san ca śabdaḥ iti sarva upasaṃhāreṇa anvayena vyatirekeṇa ca vyāpti pradarśana lakṣaṇau sādharmya vaidharmya prayogau

atra sāmarthyāt eva pratijñā artha pratīteḥ na pratijñā prayogaḥ apradarśite prameye katham tad pratītiḥ iti ced svayam pratipattau kaḥ prameyasya darśayitā pradeśa stham dhūmam upalabdhavataḥ tasya agninā vyāpti smaraṇe tad sāmarthyāt eva agniḥ atra iti bhavati na ca tatra kaścid agniḥ atra iti asmai nivedayati na api svayam prāk eva pratipadyate kiñcid pramāṇam antareṇa evam pratīteḥ nimitta abhāvāt pratītau vā liṅgasya vaiyarthyāt svayam eva akasmāt agniḥ atra iti prameyam vyavasthāpya punar tad pratipattaye liṅgam anusarati iti kaḥ ayam pratipatti kramaḥ pareṇa api tat ucyamānam plavate eva upayoga abhāvāt

viṣaya upadarśanam upayogaḥ ced tena eva tāvat darśitena kaḥ arthaḥ yadi pratipattiḥ anyathā na syāt sarvam śobheta tasmāt eṣa svayam pratītau viṣaya upasthāpanena kenacid vinā api pratiyan asmān kāryiṇaḥ dṛṣṭvā parva brāhmaṇaḥ iva vyaktam mūlyam mṛgayate asmat vacanāt api svayam siddham eva liṅgam anusṛtya pratyeti iti kaḥ anayoḥ avasthayoḥ viśeṣaḥ dṛṣṭā ca pakṣa dharma sambandha vacana mātrāt pratijñā vacanam antareṇa api pratītiḥ iti kaḥ tasya upayogaḥ sva niścaya vat anyeṣām niścaya utpādanāya ca sādhanam ucyate tatra ayam svayam prameya upadarśanam antareṇa api pratipadya param pratipādayan apūrvam artha kramam āśrayate iti kim atra kāraṇam tasmāt na prameya vacanena kiñcid anyathā api tad pratipatteḥ utpatteḥ iti

etena upanaya nigamana ādikam api pratyuktam etāvatā eva prayogeṇa pratīti bhāvāt iti ḍiṇḍika rāgam parityajya akṣiṇī nimīlya cintaya tāvat kim iyatā pratītiḥ syāt na vā iti bhāve vā kim prapañca mālayā itīyān eva sādhana vākya prayogaḥ jyāyān
atra api na kaścid pakṣa dharma sambandha vacana prayoga krama niyamaḥ sarvathā gamaka tvāt

sambandha vacane api prayogaḥ eva bhidyate na arthaḥ ubhayathā dharma bhede api tad bhāvasya eva khyāpanāt na hi ekāntena atad svabhāvasya bhāve anya bhāvaḥ kṛtaka tva bhāvaḥ iva prayatna utpatti dharma tāyāḥ na api atad svabhāvasya nivṛttau tad nivṛttiḥ akāryasya yathā anayoḥ eva dharmayoḥ viparyayeṇa tasmāt anvaya vyatirekayoḥ yathālakṣaṇam ekaḥ api prayuktaḥ dvitīyam ākṣipati iti na ekatra sādhana vākye dvayoḥ prayogaḥ iṣyate vaiyarthyāt tad svabhāvatayā tad anvaya siddhau tad abhāve abhāva siddheḥ tad abhāve abhāva siddhau ca tad anvaya siddheḥ
tad abhāvaḥ eva abhāva khyātiḥ yathā syāt na anyatra na viruddhaḥ iti niyama khyāpana arthaḥ api vyatireka prayogaḥ na yuktaḥ anya viruddhayoḥ api vipakṣa tvāt
katham idānīm gamyate sataḥ avaśyam naśvaraḥ svabhāvaḥ iti yena anvaya vyatirekau syātām vināśa hetu ayogāt svabhāvataḥ eva bhāvāḥ naśvarāḥ

na eṣām niṣpannānām anyatas nāśa utpattiḥ tasya asāmarthyāt na hi vināśa hetuḥ bhāva svabhāvam eva karoti tasya anyatas abhinirvṛtteḥ na api svabhāva antara karaṇe tad avasthasya bhāvasya kiñcid iti tathā upalabdhi ādi prasaṅgaḥ na api svabhāva antaram asya āvaraṇam tad avasthe tasmin āvaraṇasya api ayogāt na api vināśa hetunā bhāva abhāvaḥ kriyate abhāvasya vidhinā kāryatva upagame vyatireka avyatireka vikalpa anatikramāt bhāva pratiṣedha rūpa tve ca bhāvam na karoti iti syāt tathā ca akartuḥ ahetu tvam iti na vināśa hetuḥ kaścid

vaiyarthyāt ca yadi svabhāvataḥ naśvaraḥ bhāvaḥ tasya na kiñcid nāśa hetunā svayam tad svabhāva tayā eva nāśāt yaḥ hi yasya svabhāvaḥ sa sva hetoḥ eva utpadyamānaḥ tādṛśaḥ bhavati na punar tad bhāve hetu antaram apekṣate prakāśa drava uṣṇa kaṭhina ādi dravya vat na hi prakāśa ādayaḥ tad ātmānaḥ utpannāḥ punar prakāśa ādi bhāve hetu antaram apekṣante tad ātmanaḥ tādātmya abhāve nairātmya prasaṅgāt tadvat asthiti dharmā ced svabhāvataḥ bhāvaḥ niṣpannaḥ punar na tad ātmatāyām hetu antaram apekṣeta

bīja ādi vat anekāntaḥ iti ced syāt etat bīja ādayaḥ aṅkura ādeḥ janana svabhāvāḥ santaḥ api na kevalāḥ janayanti salila ādi kāraṇa antara apekṣa tvāt tadvat bhāvaḥ api vināśe syāt iti na tad svabhāvasya jananāt ajanakasya ca ātad svabhāva tvāt atas eva tayoḥ avasthayoḥ vastu bhedaḥ niśceyaḥ bhāvānām svabhāvānyathātva abhāvāt tad svabhāvasya paścāt iva prāk api janana prasaṅgāt tasmāt yaḥ antyaḥ avasthā bhedaḥ saḥ eva aṅkura ādi janana svabhāvaḥ pūrva bhāvinaḥ tu avasthā viśeṣāḥ kāraṇa kāraṇāni iti na anekāntaḥ kṣaṇikeṣu bhāveṣu apara apara utpatteḥ aikya abhāvāt
te antyāḥ samarthāḥ kim na janayanti iti ced janayanti eva na atrānyathā bhāvaḥ svabhāva avaiparītyāt

teṣu sarveṣu sahakāriṣu samartha svabhāveṣu kaḥ aparasya upayogaḥ iti ced na vai bhāvānām kācid prekṣā pūrva kāri tā yatas ayam ekaḥ api samarthaḥ kim atra asmābhiḥ iti apare nivarteran te hi nirabhiprāya vyāpārāḥ sva hetu pariṇāma upanidhi dharmāṇaḥ tad prakṛteḥ tathā abhavantaḥ na upālambham arhanti
samarthāḥ kim na aparāparam janayanti iti ced na tatra eva ekatra sāmarthyāt tasya eva ekasya janane samarthāḥ na anyasya iti na aparā para jananam

bhinna svabhāvebhyaḥ cakṣuḥ ādibhyaḥ sahakāribhyaḥ eka kārya utpattau na kāraṇa bhedāt kārya bhedaḥ syāt iti ced na yathāsvam svabhāva bhedena tad viśeṣa upayogataḥ tad upayoga kārya svabhāva viśeṣa āsaṅkurāt yathā mṛd piṇḍa kulāla sūtra ādibhyaḥ bhavataḥ ghaṭasya mṛd piṇḍāt amṛd svabhāvebhyaḥ vṛkṣa ādibhyaḥ bhinnaḥ svabhāvaḥ kulālāt tasya eva mṛdā ātmanaḥ sataḥ saṃsthāna viśeṣa ātma tayā tad anyebhyaḥ bhinnaḥ sūtrāt tasya eva mṛd saṃsthāna viśeṣa ātmanaḥ ca krādeḥ vibhaktaḥ svabhāvaḥ bhavati tat evam na kulālāt mṛd svabhāva tā na mṛdaḥ saṃsthāna viśeṣaḥ na ca tayoḥ śakti viśeṣa viṣaya bhede api tad janita viśeṣa bhedasya kāryasya svabhāva bhedaḥ mṛd saṃsthānayoḥ aparaspara ātma tayā saṃsthāna mṛd svabhāva viśeṣābhyām tayoḥ apratibhāsana prasaṅgāt

anyat eva saṃsthānam guṇaḥ mṛd dravyāt tena bhinnaḥ svabhāvaḥ kulāla mṛd piṇḍayoḥ upayoga viṣayaḥ iti ced uktam atra api ca yadi tad saṃsthānam bhinnam mṛdaḥ kulālaḥ kim na pṛthak karoti guṇasya dravya pāratantryāt na pṛthak siddhiḥ iti tad saṃsthāna ādhāra ātmakam tat dravyam saṃsthānam vā tad ādheya ātmakam prakṛtyā kim kulālam apekṣante iti ced na tatas paraspara sambandha yogya tā pratilambhāt anyathā prāk api mṛd piṇḍasya saṃsthāna viśeṣa sambandha yogya tve vastu dharma tayā eva saṃsthāna viśeṣa sambandha prasaṅgaḥ evam tarhi sā yogyatā mṛd dravyasya kulālāt na ca anayoḥ svabhāva bhedaḥ bhede vā pūrvavat prasaṅgāt iti asti tāvat kiñcid eka svabhāva tve api aneka pratyaya upahita svabhāva viśeṣam iti na nirbandhaḥ mṛd saṃsthānayoḥ eka svabhāva tva sādhane

tena sahakāriṇaḥ pratyayāḥ na eka upayoga viṣayāḥ kāryasya eka svabhāva tve api vastutas iti yathā iha kāraṇa bhedaḥ bhinna viśeṣa upayogāt na eka kāryaḥ tathā cakṣuḥ ādibhyaḥ vijñāna utpattau unneyaḥ tathā hi samanantara pratyayāt vijñānāt cakṣuḥ vijñānasya upalambha ātma tā tasya eva upalambha ātmanaḥ sataḥ cakṣuḥ indriyāt rūpa grahaṇa yogya tā pratiniyamaḥ viṣayāt tad tulya rūpa tā iti abhinna tve api vastutas kāryasya kāraṇānām bhinnebhyaḥ svabhāvebhyaḥ bhinnāḥ eva viśeṣāḥ bhavanti iti na kāraṇa bhede api abhedaḥ tad kārya viśeṣasya iti te eva ete kāraṇa śakti bhedāḥ yathāsvam prativiśiṣṭa kārya janane avyavadheya śakti tayā pratyupasthitāḥ kṣaṇika tvāt sāmagrī kāryasya svabhāva sthiti āśrayaḥ iti ucyante tathā hi tat tebhyaḥ samastebhyaḥ upalambha ātmakam rūpa grahaṇa pratiniyatam viṣaya rūpam ca iti prativiśiṣṭa svabhāvam ekam jātam iti

apratirodha śaktikeṣu anantara kāryeṣu kṣaṇikeṣu anādheya viśeṣeṣu pratyayeṣu parasparam kaḥ sahakāra arthaḥ iti ced na vai sarvatra atiśaya utpādanam sahakriyā kim tarhi eka artha karaṇam api yat bahūnām yathā antyasya kāraṇa kalāpasya tat eva mukhyam sahakāriṇām sahakāri tvam tasya eva antyasya kāraṇa tvāt tatra ca kṣaṇaḥ ekasya svabhāvasya avivekāt viśeṣasya kartum aśakya tvāt svabhāva antara utpatti lakṣaṇa tvāt viśeṣa utpatteḥ bhāva antara prasava sambhave ca na antyaḥ syāt tatas ca na sākṣāt kāraṇam syāt tasmāt na kāraṇasya saha kāribhyaḥ viśeṣa utpattiḥ te samarthāḥ eva svabhāvataḥ antyāḥ pratyayāḥ saha jāyante kṣaṇikāḥ yeṣām prāk paścāt pṛthak bhāvaḥ na asti yatas anantaram kārya utpattiḥ tatra ekārtha kriyā eva sahakāriṇām sahakāri tvam
samarthaḥ kutas utpannaḥ iti ced sva kāraṇebhyaḥ

tāni enam apara pratyaya sannidhānaḥ eva kim janayanti kadācid anyathā api syuḥ tatas ca ekaḥ api kvacid janayet iti ced apara apara pratyaya yogena pratikṣaṇam bhinna śaktayaḥ santanvantaḥ saṃskārāḥ yadi api kutaścid sāmyāt sarūpāḥ pratīyante tathā api bhinnaḥ eva eṣām svabhāvaḥ tena kiñcid eva kasyacid kāraṇam

tatra yaḥ avyavadhāna ādi deśa rūpa indriya ādi kalāpaḥ sa vijñāna janane samarthaḥ hetuḥ yaḥ teṣām paraspara upasarpaṇa ādi āśrayaḥ pratyaya viśeṣaḥ sa tad hetu janane samarthaḥ teṣām ca na pūrvam na paścāt na pṛthak bhāvaḥ iti samarthān api pūrva apara pṛthak bhāva bhāvinaḥ doṣāḥ na upalīyante tena eṣām paraspara upasarpaṇa ādi hetuḥ yaḥ sa samartha hetuḥ iti tasya na kadācid api anyathā bhāvaḥ anena nyāyena sarvatra hetu phala bhāva pratiniyamaḥ unneyaḥ pratikṣaṇam apara apara svabhāva bheda anvayinīṣu bhāva śaktiṣu na sthira eka svabhāveṣu bhāveṣu svabhāvānyathātva abhāvāt samartha asamartha svabhāvayoḥ kriyā kriyā yogāt

anya sahitaḥ karoti na kevalaḥ iti ced kim kevalasya kārya janane na samarthaḥ svabhāvaḥ samarthaḥ kim na karoti akurvan katham samarthaḥ kuvinda ādayaḥ paṭa ādi karaṇe samarthāḥ api na sarvadā kurvanti iti ced krīḍana śīlaḥ devānāmpriyaḥ sukha edhitaḥ kṛtam kṛtam punar kārayati tathā hi bīja ādi upanyāse nirloṭhitam etat tasmāt tad svabhāvasya anyathātva abhāvāt tad dharmaṇaḥ tathā abhāvaḥ antya avasthā vat anivāryaḥ
antya avasthāyām prāk asamarthasya sāmarthya utpattau tad sāmarthyasya tad svabhāva tve apūrva utpattiḥ eva sā atad svabhāva tve saḥ akārakaḥ eva sāmarthya ākhyāt padārtha antarāt kārya utpatteḥ

api ca sa tadā eva tāvat sannihita sakala sahakārī kāryam kim karoti kurvan dṛṣṭaḥ tena karoti iti brūmaḥ mahā sāmarthyam mahā prabhāvasya bhavataḥ darśanam yat idam bhāvān atatsvabhāvān api svabhāva mātreṇa citreṣu vyāpāreṣu niyuṅkte yadi nāma kadācid kiñcid kathaṃcid atra bhavataḥ darśana viṣayam atikrāmet hanta aprasava dharmakam apeta santānam syāt iti iyam naḥ cintā cittam dunoti na vai vayam atad svabhāvānām bhāvānām asmad darśanāt kārya kriyām brūmaḥ kim tarhi tad kriyā dharmāṇaḥ svabhāvataḥ eva te tān paśyantaḥ vidmaḥ te ete kārakāḥ iti satyam idam api asti svabhāvaḥ teṣām kārya kriyā dharmā tena na samasta pratyayānām kāryam akṛtvā upekṣā pattiḥ iti sa kim teṣām akṣepa kriyā dharmā svabhāvaḥ tadā eva antya avasthāyām utpannaḥ āhosvit prāk api āsīt āsīt apracyuta utpanna sthira eka svabhāvānām bhāvānām kadācid kasyacid svabhāvasya abhāva virodhāt tat kim idānīm mātā ca vandhyā ca kaḥ vā asya bhāṣitasya arthaḥ akṣepa kriyā svabhāvaḥ na karoti ca

sahitaḥ tad svabhāvaḥ na kevalaḥ iti ced anyaḥ tarhi kevalaḥ anyaḥ sahitaḥ svabhāva bheda lakṣaṇa tvāt bhāva bhedasya na hi sa sāhitye api para rūpeṇa kartā svarūpam ca asya prāk api tat eva iti katham kadācid kriyā virāmaḥ yasya api kṣaṇikaḥ bhāvaḥ tasya api kim na kevalaḥ karoti karoti eva yadi kevalaḥ syāt kim na bhavati kṣaṇika tvāt uktam atra yādṛśasya kriyā sa katham eka kṣaṇa bhāvi anyathā syāt yaḥ ca bhavati saḥ eva na bhavati iti na ayam prasaṅgaḥ kāraka ākārakayoḥ svabhāva tad hetvoḥ virodhāt

yaḥ api manyate akṣepa kriyā dharmā eva sa tasya svabhāvaḥ na sa sāhityam apekṣate kāryam tu pratyaya antara apekṣam iti sahitebhyaḥ eva jāyate na kevalebhyaḥ iti tasya api katham sa kevalaḥ api karoti eva kāryam ca tasmāt na utpadyate iti tad avasthaḥ virodhaḥ na kevalaḥ karoti eva iti ced katham idānīm akṣepa kriyā svabhāvaḥ nanu etat eva paridīpitam bhavati karoti eva iti kāryam ca ayam kevalaḥ api samarthaḥ san param apekṣamāṇam katham upekṣeta param anādṛtya etat prasahya kuryāt evam hi anena ātmanaḥ sāmarthyam api darśitam bhavati kāryam param apekṣate iti tatas kevalāt anutpattiḥ uktā bhavati sa kevalaḥ api samartha svabhāvaḥ iti tatas utpattiḥ iti ete ca ekatra katham syātām tat ayam īrṣyā śalya vitudyamāna marmā viklavam vikrośati iti upekṣām arhati
tasmāt idam eka artha kriyā lakṣaṇam sahakāri tvam kṣaṇikānām eva bhāvānām sambhavati na sambhavat pṛthagbhāvānām akṣaṇikānām pṛthakkaraṇa sambhavena sahakāri tva niyama ayogāt

yatra tu santāna upakāreṇa bhāvāḥ pratyaya tām pratipadyante yathā taṇḍula bīja ādibhyaḥ odana aṅkura ādi janmani dahana udaka pṛthivī ādayaḥ tatra viśeṣa utpādanam pratyayānām sahakriyā santāna āśrayeṇa ucyate na dravya āśrayeṇa kṣaṇike dravye viśeṣa anupapatteḥ na hi taṇḍula ādīnām dahana udaka ādibhyaḥ krameṇa svabhāva atiśaya anutpattau odana ādi abhinirvṛttiḥ asti indriyasya vā prabhāsvarād apavarakam praviṣṭasya sva upakāribhyaḥ sva santāna viśeṣa an utpattau artha pratipatti jananam

akṣepa kāriṣu punar indriya ādiṣu na parasparataḥ viśeṣa utpattiḥ tatra yathāsvam pratyayaiḥ paraspara upasarpaṇa ādi āśrayaiḥ ye yogya deśa ādi avasthāḥ jātāḥ te saha svabhāva niṣpattyā jñāna hetu tām pratipadyante iti eka artha kriyā eva sahakāri tvam yatra tu viśeṣa utpādanena sahakāriṇām pratyaya tvam tatra hetu santānasya pratyaya antara apekṣā iti tatas svabhāva antara pratilambhaḥ ucyate tatra svarasataḥ pūrvakṣaṇa nivṛttau hetu pratyayānām tebhyaḥ eva viśiṣṭa kṣaṇa viśeṣa utpattiḥ krameṇa atiśayavataḥ antyāt kāraṇa kalāpāt kārya utpattiḥ

sahakāriṇaḥ samutpanna viśeṣāt kāraṇāt kārya utpattau viśeṣasya eva utpattiḥ na syāt aviśiṣṭāt viśeṣa utpattau kāryasya api syāt tatas ca parasparataḥ viśeṣa utpāda anapekṣiṇaḥ sahakāriṇaḥ kāryam kuryuḥ tena akṣaṇikānām api sahakāri anapekṣiṇām kāraṇa tā syāt na ca apekṣyebhyaḥ svabhāva atiśaya utpattiḥ atha viśeṣa utpattau api sahakāriṇā kṛta viśeṣaḥ eva upatiṣṭheta anavasthā evam syāt na ca sahakāriṇaḥ nityam parasparasya kārya utpāda anuguṇa viśeṣa utpādana yogyā avasthāḥ yena nitya anuṣaktaḥ eva eṣām paraspara kṛtaḥ viśeṣaḥ syāt tad upāya apāyayoḥ kārya vyakti virāma darśanāt tena ādyaḥ viśeṣaḥ saha kāribhyaḥ nirupakārasya na utpadyeta iti

na asmākam punar punar vacane kaścid udvegaḥ yadi evam api lokasya nyāya pratipattiḥ syāt punar api brūmaḥ na viśeṣa utpādanāt eva sahakāriṇām sahakāri tvam yena tad abhāvāt viśeṣa utpattau asahakāriṇaḥ syuḥ kim tarhi eka artha kriyā api sā api na bhavet nirviśeṣāṇām parasparataḥ bhāve vā tad avasthāyām iva pṛthak api syāt tathā ca tad viśeṣa bhāvi kāryam api kevalāt syāt iti ced sarvam uktam pratikṣaṇam apara aparaiḥ pratyayaiḥ yathā bhāva santāne viśeṣa utpattiḥ yogya deśa tā ādi avasthā bhedāḥ kārya kāriṇaḥ teṣām ca yatas utpattiḥ pratyekam sāmarthye api yathā kevalānām akriyā kartṛ viśeṣa pṛthak bhāva abhāvāt

kārya dvaividhyam ca sahakāri janita viśeṣa parampara utpatti dharmakam anyat ca aṅkura ādi vat akṣepa kārī indriya vijñāna ādi vat ca kārya kāraṇa svabhāva bhedāt iti tatra sahakāribhyaḥ santāna upakāra apekṣa kāraṇa kārya janmani ādyaḥ sahakāri viśeṣaḥ na sahakāri kṛta viśeṣa janmā anantara kārya vat tatas prabhṛti ye viśeṣāḥ te tad janmānaḥ tad prakṛtika tvāt tasya teṣām ca iti na anavasthā tathā yadi akṣaṇikaḥ api bhāvaḥ anāhita atiśayaḥ sahakāriṇā ādi aviśeṣa hetu vat kāryam kurvīta karotu sa punar asya svabhāvaḥ akṣepa kartṛ dharmā ced pṛthak bhāva sambhavāt kevalaḥ api tathā syāt iti uktam atatsvabhāvaḥ tu tadā api akārakaḥ eva

tasmāt na akṣaṇikeṣu hetuṣu eka artha kriyayā kasyacid sahakāri tva niyamaḥ na api santāna upakāreṇa iti na tasya kaścid sahakārī tatas kevalaḥ api kuryāt iti prāyas tu saṅghāta sthāyī bhāva santānaḥ sahakāri pratyaya upajanita viśeṣaḥ sva kāryam kurvan dṛṣṭaḥ bīja ādi vat iti sthira hetu vādinaḥ pratyaya antara apekṣā vyaktam kāraka svabhāva antara utpattiḥ iti na akāryasya apekṣā iti ucyate kāraka svabhāvasya prāk api bhāve akriyā ayogāt

tasmāt yaḥ yadātmā sa sva sattā mātreṇa tādṛśaḥ bhavati na ca bhūtvā punar tad bhāve apara abhisaṃskāram apekṣate iti svabhāvataḥ asthiti dharmaṇaḥ bhāvasya na kiñcid nāśa kāraṇaiḥ sthiti dharmaṇaḥ api kenacid svabhāvānyathā bhāvasya kartum aśakya tvāt kim nāśa kāraṇaiḥ anyathātva pratipattau vā tad svabhāvaḥ eva na syāt iti pūrvaḥ vikalpaḥ tatra ca uktam yaḥ ca parasmāt anyathā bhāvaḥ saḥ aparaḥ svabhāvaḥ yaḥ ca aparaḥ sa katham tasya svabhāva bheda lakṣaṇa tvāt bhāva bhedasya tathā ca pūrvakaḥ bhāvaḥ apracyuti dharme sthitaḥ iti na tasya anyathā bhāvaḥ etena kaṭhina ādīnām tāmra ādīnām agni ādibhyaḥ drava tu a ādi svabhāva antara utpattiḥ pratyuktā tatra api pūrvakasya svarasa nirodhi tvāt vināśe sati anya ādeḥ upādānāt ca aparaḥ eva drava svabhāvaḥ utpannaḥ iti

sa svayam sthiti dharmā eva vināśa hetu asambhave avasthānāt tasya parasmāt vināśaḥ na ca vināśaḥ nāma aparaḥ svabhāvaḥ bhāva pracyutiḥ eva vināśaḥ iti na idam uttaram vikalpa dvayam atikrāmati kim nityaḥ bhāvaḥ svabhāvataḥ āhosvit anityaḥ iti vikalpe prāk nityaḥ bhūtvā paścāt anityaḥ bhavati iti bruvāṇaḥ bhāva dvayam nitya anitya svabhāva bhedam pūrvakasya nitya abhimatasya svayam nāśam anāśam ca sarvadā prāha iti asamarthaḥ pūrvasmin pakṣe vināśa hetuḥ na prāk nityaḥ bhūtvā paścāt anityaḥ bhavati kim tarhi paścāt api nityaḥ eva eka svabhāva tvāt sa tarhi bhāvaḥ svabhāvena vināśam anāviśan katham naṣṭaḥ nāma tad svabhāva vināśayoḥ paraspara parihāra rūpa tvāt
tasmāt sati asya vināśe vināśa svabhāvena eva anena bhavitavyam tathā api vyarthaḥ vināśa hetuḥ iti uktam tena svabhāvataḥ naśvare anaśvare vā bhāve na vināśa hetoḥ upayogaḥ
tasmāt vināśe anapekṣaḥ bhāvaḥ tad bhāva niyataḥ iti yaḥ san sa vināśī naśvara tā nivṛttau ca sattva nivṛttiḥ iti anvaya vyatireka siddhiḥ

svabhāvataḥ naśvara tve api kaścid atad svabhāvaḥ api syāt na hi sarvaḥ sarvasya svabhāvaḥ iti na anvaya vyatireka siddhiḥ iti ced na akṣaṇika tve avastu tva prasaṅgāt śaktiḥ hi bhāva lakṣaṇam sarva śakti virahaḥ abhāva lakṣaṇam na ca akṣaṇikasya kvacid śaktiḥ krama yaugapadyābhyām artha kriyā virodhāt tasmāt yat sat tat kṣaṇikam eva iti vyāpti siddhiḥ

artha antare gamye kārya hetuḥ avyabhicārāt kārya kāraṇa bhāvena gamaka tve liṅgasya sarvathā gamya gamaka bhāvaḥ sarvathā janya janaka bhāvāt iti ced na tad abhāve bhavataḥ tad utpatti niyama abhāvāt tasmāt kāryam svabhāvaiḥ yāvadbhiḥ avinābhāvi kāraṇe teṣām hetuḥ tad kāryatva niyamāt taiḥ eva ca dharmaiḥ ye taiḥ vinā na bhavanti aṃśena janya janaka tva prasaṅgaḥ iti ced na tad janya viśeṣa grahaṇe abhimata tvāt liṅga viśeṣa upādhīnām ca sāmānyānām aviśiṣṭa sāmānya vivakṣāyām vyabhicārāt na iṣyate

kasyacid kadācid kutaścid bhāve api sarvaḥ tādṛśaḥ tathāvidha janma iti kutas tathā ca na anvayavyatirekau iti ced na atadbhāvinaḥ sakṛt api tatas abhāvāt paraspara apekṣayā janya janaka svabhāva lakṣaṇe hi kārya kāraṇe tatra yadi dhūmaḥ agni ādi sāmagryāḥ anyatas api bhavet na tasya tat janyaḥ svabhāvaḥ iti sakṛt api tatas na bhavet artha antara vat na api sāmagrī tam janayet atajjanana svabhāva tvāt sāmagryantara vat na ca dhūmasya tat atat janyaḥ svabhāvaḥ yuktaḥ eka svabhāva tvāt dhūmādhūma janana svabhāvāt bhavataḥ dhūmādhūma svabhāvaḥ syāt kārya svabhāvānām kāraṇa svabhāva kṛta tvāt akāraṇa apekṣaṇe vā ahetuka tva prasaṅgāt tasmāt saḥ agni ādi sāmagrī viśeṣaḥ yaḥ dhūmajanakaḥ sa dhūmaḥ yaḥ agni ādi sāmagrī viśeṣa janitaḥ iti kārya kāraṇayoḥ evam svabhāva niyamāt na vijātīyāt utpattiḥ tat na dṛṣṭam kāryam kāraṇam vyabhicarati tena siddhe kārya kāraṇa bhāve kāryasya kāraṇena vyāptiḥ siddhā bhavati

nanu vijātīyāt api kiñcid bhavat dṛṣṭam tat yathā gomaya ādeḥ śālūka ādiḥ na vijātīyāt utpattiḥ tathāvidham eva hi kāraṇam tādṛśām ādi nimittam iti na kāraṇa bhedaḥ prabandha vṛttau tu śarāt bhāvaḥ asti ca gomayetarajat manoḥ svabhāva bhedaḥ rūpa abhede api na hi ākāra sāmyam eva bhāvānām tattve nibandhanam abhinna ākārāṇām api ke ṣāñcidanyatas viśeṣāt jāti bheda darśanāt anyathā hi vilakṣaṇāyāḥ api sāmagryāḥ avilakṣaṇasya utpattau na kāraṇa bheda abhedābhyām kārya bheda abhedau iti ahetukau viśvasya bheda abhedau syātām tathā hi na bhedāt bhedaḥ iti abhedāt api nābhedaḥ

tad vyatiriktaḥ ca na kaścid bhāva svabhāvaḥ iti ahetuka tvāt bhāvānām nityam sattvam asattvam vā syāt apekṣya abhāvāt apekṣayā hi bhāvāḥ kādācid kāḥ bhavanti vyavasthāvān ca sādhyeṣu sādhana niyogaḥ na syāt kāraṇa śakti pratiniyame hi kiñcid eva kasyacid sādhanāya upādīyeta na aparam tasya eva tatra śakteḥ anyasya ca aśakteḥ tayoḥ tad janana itara svabhāva tvena bhedāt tad janana svabhāva vilakṣaṇāt api tasya utpattau na tad janana śakti pratiniyamaḥ iti yat kiñcid yatas kutaścid syāt tad janana śakti sāmye tu tat eva iti na kāryam dṛṣṭam kāraṇam vyabhicarati
upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptasya anupalabdhiḥ abhāva hetuḥ abhāva vyavahāra hetuḥ vā

atra upalabdheḥ upalabhamāna dharma tve tat jñānam upalabdhiḥ tasmāt anya upalabdhiḥ anupalabdhiḥ vivakṣita upalabdheḥ anya tvāt abhakṣya asparśanīya vat paryudāsa vṛttyā upalabhyamāna dharma tve viṣaya svabhāvaḥ upalabdhiḥ sva viṣaya vijñāna janana yogya tā lakṣaṇaḥ yogyatāyāḥ bhāva rūpa tvāt tasmāt anyaḥ upalambha janana yogyaḥ eva svabhāvaḥ anupalabdhiḥ pūrvavat

yatra yasmin upalabhyamāne niyamena yat upalabdhiḥ bhavati yogyatāyāḥ aviśeṣāt sa tad saṃsṛṣṭaḥ eka jñāna saṃsargāt tayoḥ satoḥ na eka rūpa niyatā pratipattiḥ asambhavāt tasmāt aviśiṣṭa yogya tā rūpayoḥ eka jñāna saṃsargiṇoḥ paraspara apekṣam eva anya tvam iha iṣṭam sa kevalaḥ tad apekṣayā tasmāt anyaḥ tat jñānam tad svabhāvaḥ vā jñātṛ jñeya dharma lakṣaṇā anupalabdhiḥ sā abhāvam abhāva vyavahāram vā pratiyoginaḥ sādhayati

katham anya bhāvaḥ tad abhāvaḥ yena anya bhāva rūpa anupalabdhyā abhāva vyavahāraḥ sādhyate uktam atra yathā paryudāsa vṛttyā apekṣātaḥ abhāva anupalabdhī na pratiṣedha mātram iha anupalabdhiḥ tasya sādhana asiddheḥ abhāva vyavahāra asiddhi prasaṅgāt tasya asaṃsṛṣṭa rūpasya bhāva siddhiḥ eva aparasya abhāva siddhiḥ iti anya bhāvaḥ api tad abhāvaḥ iti vyapadiśyate

anya bhāva lakṣaṇaḥ abhāvaḥ svayam pramāṇena siddhaḥ tad abhāva vyavahāram sādhayet tad siddhi siddhaḥ vā tad abhāvaḥ iti na kaścid viśeṣaḥ yena anupalabdhyā abhāva vyavahāra siddhi virodhaḥ syāt saḥ eva anya bhāvaḥ tad viṣayā ca upalabdhiḥ tad abhāvasya kim na sādhanam kim punar anya bhāva siddhiḥ eva tad abhāva siddhiḥ iti apṛthak siddheḥ sambandha abhāvāt ca
anya bhāvaḥ tāvat na sādhanam

yad siddhau yasya na siddhiḥ tat tasya liṅgam bhavati dhūma agni vat anya bhāva siddhyā eva tad abhāvaḥ sidhyati tasya tad anyā saṃsṛṣṭa rūpasya kevalasya tattva vyavasthāpakāt eva pramāṇāt anya vyavaccheda siddheḥ

sambandha abhāvāt ca tat ca tasya liṅgam bhavati yena yasya kaścid sambandhaḥ yathā kṛtaka tva anitya tvayoḥ eka artha samavāyaḥ dhūmasya vā sva liṅginī eka artha samavāyaḥ ādhāra ādheya bhāvaḥ vā janya janaka bhāvaḥ vā na evam kaścid bhāva abhāvayoḥ sambandhaḥ yena asya sādhanam syāt

asti viṣaya viṣayi bhāvaḥ śabda arthavat sambandhaḥ iti ced na śabda arthayoḥ tad pratipādana abhiprāye sati prayogāt tena saha kārya kāraṇa lakṣaṇaḥ avinābhāva lakṣaṇaḥ vā sambandhaḥ syāt ayam ca prakāraḥ atra na sambhavati kutas viṣaya viṣayi bhāvaḥ siddhe hi tayoḥ sādhya sādhana bhāve tad mukhena viṣaya viṣayi bhāvaḥ syāt saḥ eva asati sambandhe na sidhyati tad asiddhau na viṣaya viṣayi bhāvaḥ anyathā itaretara āśrayam idam syāt
