anya bhāvāt ca abhāva siddhau asamudāyaḥ ca sādhyaḥ syāt tathā ca ghaṭa abhāvaḥ tad anya bhāvāt iti ghaṭasya sarvatra sarvadā abhāvaḥ syāt na pradeśa ādi dharmi viśeṣaṇasya abhāvasya sādhanāt iti ced syāt etat pradeśa ādeḥ dharmiṇaḥ viśeṣaṇa bhūtaḥ abhāvaḥ sādhyate na kevalaḥ tena na asamudāya sādhanam na ca liṅga liṅginoḥ asambandhaḥ anya bhāvasya pradeśa ādi dharmi sambandhāt iti na pradeśa ādeḥ eva tad anya bhāva tvāt yatra eva hi pradeśa ādau yat na asti iti ucyate saḥ eva tad asaṃsṛṣṭaḥ anya bhāvaḥ tad darśanāt eva asya ghaṭaḥ na asti iti bhavati katham tasya eva liṅga liṅgi bhāvaḥ

na ca atra sāmānya viśeṣa bhāva vikalpaḥ sambhavati yena sāmānyam hetuḥ syāt viśeṣaḥ dharmī tad viśeṣa pratipatteḥ eva tad abhāva pratīteḥ tasya ca anyatra ananvayāt pratijñā artha eka deśa tvāt ca āliṅga tvam na ca yatra pradeśa mātram tatra ghaṭa abhāvaḥ tādṛśe kevale pradeśe abhāvaḥ eva iti ced nanu tasya eva kaivalyam iti ghaṭa virahaḥ ucyate sa ca iha liṅga bhūta pradeśa pratipattau eva siddhaḥ kasya idānīm tat liṅgam anvaya anugamanam ca nirarthakam tasmāt anya bhāvaḥ na sādhanam abhāvasya

asti sambandhaḥ virodhaḥ tatas anya bhāvāt abhāva siddhiḥ iti ced kena kasya virodhaḥ anya bhāvena pratiyoginaḥ kim nu vai pratiyogī pramātum iṣṭaḥ yena virodhaḥ sambandhaḥ liṅga liṅginoḥ abhāvaḥ tu pratiyoginaḥ anya bhāvena na virudhyate saha avasthānāt tasmin prameye katham virodhaḥ liṅga liṅginoḥ iti asambandhaḥ eva atra api asamudāya sādhya tvam tad avastham

nanu asati sambandhe tad abhāvāni abhāvayoḥ anya bhāva gatyā api tad abhāva gatiḥ na syāt na vai kutaścid sambandhāt anya bhāvaḥ tad abhāvasya gamakaḥ iṣyate api tu anya bhāvaḥ eva tad abhāvaḥ yathā uktam prāk tasya ananya saṃsṛṣṭa rūpasya kevalasya eka ātmani vyavasthitasya tena ātmanā paricchedaḥ eva aparasya vyavaccheda iti tasya kaivalyam eva apara vaikalyam iti tad anya bhāvaḥ eva tad abhāvaḥ tad anya pratipattiḥ eva ca tad apratipattiḥ ucyate anyathā tad paricchedena tad anyā vyavacchede tad paricchedaḥ eva na syāt tad atad rūpayoḥ avivekāt iti yaḥ eṣa kasyacid darśanāt kvacid prāpti parihāra arthaḥ vyavahāraḥ saḥ eva na syāt na hi ayam analam paśyan api analam eva paśyati yena salila arthī tatra na pravarteta

anupalambhena salila abhāvam pratipadyate iti ced kaḥ ayam anupalambhaḥ nāma yadi salila upalambha abhāvaḥ sa katham abhāvaḥ kasyacid pratipattiḥ pratipatti hetuḥ vā tasya api katham pratipattiḥ kasyacid api tasya tad anyasya vā apratipattau api svāpa mada mūrchā vyavadhāna parāṅmukhya avasthā ādiṣu kim na abhāva pratipattiḥ iti vicāritam pramāṇa viniścaye tasmāt ayam analam paśyan api analaḥ ayam na salilam iti anadhyavasyan na tiṣṭhet na pratiṣṭheta iti dustaram vyasanam āpannaḥ

tatas eva eka darśanāt anya abhāva pratītiḥ iti ced katham ekam paśyan anyat na asti iti pratīyāt tasya eva kevalasya darśanāt iti ced idam eva asmābhiḥ ucyamānam kim atra bhavataḥ paruṣam iva ābhāti tasmāt tīrādarśinā iva śakuninā dūraṅgatvā api punar āgantavyam iti alam apratiṣṭhāna diś pratipattyā

yadi eka paricchedāt eva anyasya vyavaccheda siddhiḥ aviśeṣeṇa anyasya sarvasya tatra abhāva siddhiḥ syāt na tulya yogya avasthasya eva upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptasya anupalabdhiḥ abhāva vyavahāra sādhanī iti viśeṣaṇam ca avācyam anupalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptānām api tatra vyavacchedāt eka ātma paricchedāt tasya tad anya ātma vyavacchedaḥ bhavati tad ātma niyata pratibhāsa jñānāt na hi tad ātmā tad anya ātmā iti avyavacchede anya ātmanaḥ pravṛtti nivṛttyoḥ abhāvaḥ iti pūrvaḥ prasaṅgaḥ tam ca deśa kāla svabhāva avasthā niyatam tad ātmanā upalabha mānā buddhiḥ tathā tva pracyutim asya vyavacchinatti evam hi sa tayā paricchinnaḥ bhavati yadi anyathā bhāvaḥ vyavacchinnaḥ tathātvam ca tasya eva bhavati na anyasya iti anyathā bhūtāt tathābhūtam vyavacchindati eva tad paricchinatti iti eka pramāṇa vṛttiḥ sarva bhāvān dvairāśye vyavasthāpayati tasya anvaya vyatireka buddhi hetu tvena eva sāphalyāt

tad vyatirikta aśeṣa vyavaccheda vyāpti sādhanāt eva prakāra antara abhāva siddhiḥ tasya tad anyatayā avyāptau tena tad artha avyavacchedāt punarbhāva apariccheda prasaṅgāt tasmāt kvacid pramāṇam pravṛttam tat paricchinatti tatas anyat vyavacchinatti tṛtīya prakāra abhāvam ca sūcayati iti eka pramāṇa vyāpāraḥ eṣaḥ tathā hi kvacid pramāṇam pravṛttam tat eva tad anyasmāt vyavacchinatti tasya eva paricchedāt tat anyat eva ca tasmāt tad anyasya tatra aparicchedāt atas tat eva pramāṇam prakāra antara abhāvam sādhayati tasmin dṛśyamāne adṛṣṭa tad anya tvena sarvasya vyavasthāpanāt atad anyasya eva ca tattvena vyavasthāpanāt etena kramākrama ādayaḥ anyonya vyavaccheda rūpāḥ vyākhyātāḥ tat evam eka upalambhāt tasya tad anya ātmanaḥ vyavacchedaḥ bhavati na tad deśa kālayoḥ sarvānyabhāva vyavacchedaḥ tasmāt atada ātmā ca syāt tad deśa kālaḥ ca rasa rūpa ādi vat tasmāt kvacid kadācid kasyacid abhāva siddhiḥ yathā uktāt eva anupalambhāt syāt

anya bhāva viṣayā punar upalabdhiḥ tad abhāvasya sa adhikeṣṭā eva na punar liṅga tvena eva tatra api abhāvasya pṛthak sādhya tve sambandha abhāvasya tulya tvāt liṅga āvirbhāva kāle eva tad abhāva siddheḥ ca na hi anya bhāvam pratipadya punar tat pratipatteḥ anvaya vyatirekau prasādhya tad abhāvam pratipadyate kim tarhi tad anyam pratipadyamānaḥ eva tad abhāvam pratyeti tad darśana anantaram avyavadhānena idam asti idam na asti iti vyavasāyāt dṛṣṭānta asiddheḥ ca tat ca tasya liṅgam bhavati yasya yena anvayaḥ asti na hi evam śakyam darśayitum yatra anya bhāva upalabdhiḥ tatra tad abhāvaḥ iti tad eka upalabdheḥ kvacid api anyatra abhāvāt sāmānyena pradarśane dṛṣṭānte api pramāṇa antara abhāvāt sā eva tad anya bhāva upalabdhiḥ sādhya dharmasya sādhikā iti dṛṣṭāntān avasthāyām apratipattiḥ
tasmāt na kutaścid liṅgāt tad abhāva siddhiḥ saḥ anya bhāvaḥ pratyakṣa lakṣaṇena anupalambhena siddhaḥ abhāva vyavahāram sādhayet mūḍha pratipattau iti alam prasaṅgena

sā iyam trividha anupalabdhiḥ siddhe kārya kāraṇa bhāve siddhābhāvasya kāraṇasya anupalabdhiḥ vyāpya vyāpaka bhāva siddhau siddhābhāvasya eva vyāpakasya anupalabdhiḥ svabhāva anupalabdhiḥ ca iti tatra kāraṇa vyāpakayoḥ api svabhāva asat vyavahāra siddhiḥ anya bhāva siddhiḥ eva sa tathā asiddhaḥ kārya vyāpyayoḥ abhāvam abhāva vyavahāram vā sādhayati svabhāva anupalabdhau tu vyavahāraḥ eva anupalabdhyā liṅga bhūtayā sādhyate

yadi tarhi kāraṇa vyāpakau tad anya bhāva siddhi rūpayā anupalabdhyā siddha asat vyavahāra avabhāvam anyasya sādhayataḥ sā ca tayoḥ upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptau eva asat vyavahārasya sādhikā iti katham tayoḥ parokṣe arthe prayogaḥ na eva prayogaḥ pramāṇa tayā liṅga aniścayāt kevalam siddha sambandhayoḥ kāraṇa vyāpakayoḥ yadi abhāvaḥ parasya api avaśyam abhāva niścayaḥ iti darśana artham ete prayujyete
iti eṣaḥ eva pakṣa dharmaḥ anvaya vyatirekavān iti tad aṃśena vyāptaḥ tri lakṣaṇaḥ eva trividhaḥ eva hetuḥ gamakaḥ sva sādhya dharma avyabhicārāt

ṣaṣ lakṣaṇaḥ hetuḥ iti apare trīṇi ca etāni abādhita viṣaya tvam vivakṣita eka saṅkhya tvam jñāta tvam ca iti tatra ābādhita viṣaya tvam tāvat na pṛthak lakṣaṇam bādhāvinā bhāvayoḥ virodhāt avinā abhāvaḥ hi hetoḥ sādhya dharme sati eva bhāvaḥ katham ca sa tad lakṣaṇaḥ dharmiṇi hetuḥ syāt na ca atra sādhya dharmaḥ bhavet pratyakṣa anumāne hi sādhya dharmam bādhane pravṛtte tam tatas dharmiṇaḥ nivartayataḥ tasmin sati eva bhavan hetuḥ tam tatra dharmiṇi pravartayati iti param bata bhāvānām asvāsthyam vartate

anyatra sādhya dharmeṇa avinābhāvī hetuḥ na sādhya dharmiṇī eva iti ced tat kim ayam tapasvī ṣaṇḍham udvāhya putram mṛgyate yasya dharmiṇi sādhya dharme asati api bhāvaḥ tam upadarśya katham dharmī sādhya dharmavān iti ucyate atas eva ābādhām uktām iti ced syāt etat yatas eva hetuḥ anyathā api bhavet atas eva pramāṇābhyām abādhita tat dharmā dharmī iti ucyate iti tat kim idānīm hetoḥ sāmarthyam abādhayā eva sādhya siddheḥ sādhya abhāvaḥ hi bādhaka pramāṇa vṛtti niyate iti abādhāyām sādhya siddhiḥ iti vyarthaḥ hetuḥ bādhāyām api sādhana sāmarthya abhāvāt aniyame na ca bādhakam pramāṇam syāt sādhya abhāvasya ca sambhavaḥ iti na ābādhāyāḥ sāmarthyam

na ca bādhā abhāvaḥ abādhā kim tarhi bādhā anupalabdhiḥ sā puruṣasya kvacid bādhā sambhave api syāt iti sa hetu prayoga viṣayaḥ kim nu vai hetuḥ bādha upalabdheḥ bibheti na bādhāyāḥ yena bādhām anādṛtya anupalabdhau prayogaḥ iṣṭaḥ sa tarhi hetuḥ paramārthataḥ bādhāyāḥ bhāvam abhāvam vā anapekṣya bādhā anupalabdhau prayoktavyaḥ sa kim artham prayujyate sādhya siddhi artham sa kim kvacid bādhāyām api satyām sādhyam sādhayet yena asyāḥ na abhau anirṇayam prati yatnaḥ kriyate hetuḥ ca prayujyate tathā api na ābādhita viṣaya tvam hetu lakṣaṇam bādhāyām api asya sāmarthyāt tathā ca yathā anupalambhe bādhāyāḥ bhāva sambhave api abhyupagamya prayogaḥ saṃśayitasya anabhyupagame pravṛtti ayogāt tathā bādha upalabdhau api prayogaḥ abhyupagame sati viśeṣa abhāvāt
na bādhāyām samarthaḥ iti ced yadi evam na anirṇīta bādhā asambhavaḥ prayogam arhati mā bhūt prayuktasya api asāmarthyam iti

bādhā anupalambhe sāmarthyam iti ced kim upalambhaḥ bādhām vyāpnoti yena tad nivṛttau bādhā nivṛttiḥ yatas hetoḥ bādhā sambhava kṛtam asāmarthyam na syāt tathā api vyarthaḥ hetuḥ bādhā anupalambhāt eva sādhya siddheḥ anupalambhe bādhā asambhavāt upalambha nivṛttau api bādhā anivṛttau tad avastham hetoḥ asāmarthyam iti aprayogaḥ tasmāt sva sādhya bhāva abhāvābhyām anyathā api bhavan dharmiṇi hetuḥ na kiñcid bhāvayati na vibhāvayati iti na tad upakṣepaḥ samarthaḥ tat na bādhā avinā bhāvayoḥ sahabhāvaḥ tena na ābādhāḥ rūpa antaram

tat nāma tasmāt viśeṣaṇa antaram syāt lakṣaṇa antara tvena vā upādānam arhati yad bhāve api yasya anyathā bhāvaḥ tat yathā pakṣa dharma tvam sa pakṣe ca bhāvaḥ iti na ca etat abādhāyāḥ avinā abhāve sati sambhavati iti na hetu viruddhayoḥ sādhya viparyaya avinābhāvinoḥ viṣaye bādhā sambhavaḥ iti na tad abhāvaḥ pṛthak anayoḥ lakṣaṇa tvena vācyaḥ tasmāt na hetu prayoge sati pratijñā doṣāṇām sambhavaḥ na api kevalāyāḥ pratijñāyāḥ prayogaḥ asti iti na pratijñā doṣāḥ vācyāḥ
etena eka saṅkhyā vivakṣā api pratyuktā katham ekaḥ hi sva sādhya bhāvaḥ eva bhāvāt tena avyabhicārī tatra eva tad anyaḥ api tad bādhakasya bhāvaḥ eva bhāvāt viruddhaḥ tena iti bādhayā samānam
api ca yaḥ vastutas asambhavat pratihetuḥ sa kim samyak jñāna viparyaya hetuḥ iṣṭaḥ āhosvit apradarśita pratihetuḥ kim ca atas

yadi asambhavat pratihetuḥ alakṣaṇam etat aśakya niścaya tvāt hetu abhāvaḥ vā na hi aniścita ātmanaḥ pratipādaka dharmasya tad lakṣaṇa tvam saṃdigdha pakṣa dharma tva vat na api saṃdigdha lakṣaṇaḥ hetuḥ iti na kaścid dhetuḥ syāt tulya lakṣaṇe hi dṛṣṭaḥ pratiyogi sambhavaḥ adṛṣṭa pratiyogiṣu api śaṅkām utpādayati viśeṣa abhāvāt sati vā viśeṣe saḥ eva hetu lakṣaṇam tatas hi hetuḥ ekāntena nirasta pratipakṣaḥ sva sādhyam niścāyayati iti atad lakṣaṇaḥ na hetuḥ syāt tathā ca eka saṅkhyā vivakṣā vyarthā atas viruddha avi abhicāri lakṣaṇam hīyeta sva lakṣaṇa yuktayoḥ hetvoḥ ekatra virodhena upanipāte viruddha avyabhicāri iti na ca tasya viśeṣasya rūpam nirdiśyate yat pratītya pratiyogi sambhavā sambhavau utpaśyāmaḥ tasmāt na asti eva viśeṣaḥ iti sarvatra śaṅkayā bhavitavyam dṛṣṭa pratihetoḥ api hetoḥ prāk itareṇa na kaścid viśeṣaḥ lakṣyate na ca sambhavat pratihetūnām api sarvadā tad upalabdhiḥ atiśayavatī tu prajñā utprekṣaṇī dṛṣṭā tena aniścayaḥ sambhava asambhavayoḥ iti aniścita lakṣaṇa tvāt na kaścid dhetuḥ syāt

atha apradarśita pratihetuḥ hetuḥ yathā āha yadā tarhi śabda tvam nityam abhyupaiti tadā ayam hetuḥ eva syāt yadi atra anitya tva hetum kṛtaka tva ādikam api kaścid na nirdeśayet iti idam idānīm kaṣṭataram vyasanam āpatitam aprakāśyam asaṃvaraṇīyam ca katham nirvoḍhum śakyeta sa tāvat ayam hetuḥ vastūni sva sādhya tattva prakṛtīni kṛtvā tad pramāṇakān puruṣān abhyudaya niḥśreyasābhyām saṃyojya punar pratibhāvatā puruṣeṇa hetu antara nidarśana utkīlita sādhana sāmarthyaḥ tāni vastūni tān ca puruṣān tad bhāva sampadaḥ pracyāvya bhraṣṭa rājyaḥ iva rājā tapaḥ vanam gacchati iti kim atra brūmaḥ

puruṣa pratibhā kṛte ca sādhana tve kim idānīm vastutas sādhanam asādhanam vā sa ca hetuḥ svabhāvataḥ tad dharma bhāvī katham anyathā kriyate vastūnām svabhāvānyathā bhāvasya viruddha ubhaya svabhāvasya ca abhāvāt atad dharma bhāvī ca katham anyadā api sādhanam kasyacid
tasmāt svabhāvataḥ sva sādhya avinābhāvinoḥ vihita lakṣaṇayoḥ kārya svabhāvayoḥ tad lakṣaṇasya pratihetoḥ abhāvāt alakṣaṇam eka saṅkhyā vivakṣā vyavacchedya abhāvāt

jñānam punar aliṅga dharmaḥ katham liṅgasya lakṣaṇam syāt kiṃrūpāt liṅgāt arthaḥ pratipattavyaḥ iti cintāyām pratipattuḥ avisaṃvādakasya rūpam ucyate yad darśanāt ayam sādhana asādhane pravivecya tasya iṣṭa artha sannidhāna pratyayāt pravartate tatra yat asya ātma rūpam tat lakṣaṇam na para rūpam pratipatti janmani upayoga mātrāt tad lakṣaṇa tve ati prasaṅgāt evam hi prameya puruṣa ādīnām api tad lakṣaṇa tvam syāt na hi teṣu api asatsu liṅgini jñānam iti
niścita grahaṇam tarhi na kartavyam na na kartavyam tasya anya artha tvāt

sa pakṣa vipakṣayoḥ darśana adarśanābhyām gamakam hetum icchatām na evam samarthaḥ hetuḥ bhavati darśana adarśanayoḥ satoḥ api agamaka tvāt tena bhāva abhāvābhyām gamakaḥ iti jñāpana artham niścita grahaṇam tena na para rūpam lakṣaṇam liṅga rūpa viśeṣasya tena anabhidhānāt tau hi bhāva abhāvau tad bhāva sādhana pramāṇa vṛttyā boddhavyau upāya antarasya asambhavāt tena tayoḥ pradarśanāya niścita śabdaḥ prayuktaḥ lakṣaṇe yadi api bhāva abhāva vacana mātreṇa api tad sādhana pramāṇa vṛttiḥ ākṣipyate anyathā tayoḥ eva sattā aprasiddheḥ

jñāna sattā nibandhana tvāt jñeya sattā vyavasthāyāḥ sarvatra sattā vyavasthā eva pramāṇam tad sādhanam anvākarṣati iti para artha tvāt ca śāstra praṇayanasya trirūpam liṅgam vaḥ saṃvādakam arthasya iti tat rūpam ye na vidanti na teṣām tatas pravṛttiḥ iti para upalakṣaṇa tvāt eva jñānam siddham iti tathā api tau eva bhāva abhāvau kecid darśana adarśana mātreṇa vyavasthāpayanti iti tad niṣedha arthaḥ niścita śabdaḥ satoḥ api bhāva abhāvayoḥ anvaya vyatirekayoḥ sattā saṃśayāt yatas pramāṇāt anayoḥ niścayaḥ tad adhīna āsattā prasiddhiḥ iti jñāpanāya niścita vacanam kṛtam asmābhiḥ
yatas api bhāva abhāva vacana mātreṇa tad sādhana pramāṇa ākṣepa siddhiḥ pṛthak atas na jñānam lakṣaṇam tena eva gata tvāt upanaya artha vat pakṣa dharma tvāt

anvaya vyatirekayoḥ api tarhi na pṛthaktvam ekasya prayogāt ubhaya gateḥ iti ced na hetoḥ sa pakṣa vipakṣayoḥ bhāva abhāvayoḥ aparaspara apekṣa tvāt ekam vākyam ubhayam gamayati iti ucyate na ekaḥ arthaḥ dvitīyasya nanu tatra eva bhāvaḥ tad abhāve avaśyam abhāvaḥ ca parasparam ākṣipataḥ vacanam etat ubhayam sāmarthyāt ākṣipati ekasya api niyama khyāpakasya dvitīya ākṣepana antarīyaka tvāt na punar kevalau bhāva abhāvau parasparam ākṣipataḥ niyamavantau ca na kevalau niyamasya ubhaya rūpa tvāt tasmāt tatra eva bhāvaḥ iti na bhāvaḥ eva ucyate na itareṇa api abhāvaḥ eva yena bhāvaḥ abhāvaḥ vā dvitīyam ākṣipet na evam jñānam para upalakṣaṇāt trailakṣaṇyāt avyatirekāt iti na lakṣaṇa antaram
tasmāt na hetuḥ ṣaṣ lakṣaṇaḥ iti

samyak jñāna pūrvikā sarva puruṣa artha siddhiḥ iti tat vyutpādyate dvividham samyak jñānam pratyakṣam anumānam ca iti tatra pratyakṣam kalpanā apoḍham abhra antam abhilāpa saṃsarga yogya pratibhāsa pratītiḥ kalpanā tayā rahitam timira āśu bhramaṇa nauyāna sambhrama ādi anāhita vibhramam jñānam pratyakṣam

tat caturvidham indriya jñānam sva viṣaya anantara viṣaya sahakāriṇā indriya jñānena samanantara pratyayena janitam tat manaḥ vijñānam sarva citta caittānām ātma saṃvedanam bhūta artha bhāvanā prakarṣa paryanta jam yogi jñānam ca iti tasya viṣayaḥ sva lakṣaṇam yasya arthasya sannidhāna āsannidhānābhyām jñāna pratibhāsa bhedaḥ tad sva lakṣaṇam tat eva paramārtha sat artha kriyā sāmarthya lakṣaṇa tvāt vastunaḥ anyat sāmānya lakṣaṇam saḥ anumānasya viṣayaḥ tat eva ca pratyakṣam jñānam pramāṇa phalam artha pratīti rūpa tvāt artha sārūpyam asya pramāṇam tad vaśāt artha pratīti siddheḥ iti

anumānam dvidhā sva artham para artham ca tatra sva artham tri rūpāt liṅgāt yat anumeye jñānam tat anumānam pramāṇa lakṣaṇa vyavasthātrā api pūrvavat trairūpyam punar liṅgasya anumeye sattvam eva sa pakṣaḥ eva sattvam asapakṣe ca asattvam eva niścitam anumeyaḥ atra jijñāsita viśeṣaḥ dharmī sādhya dharma sāmānyena samānaḥ arthaḥ sa pakṣaḥ

na sa pakṣaḥ asapakṣaḥ tatas anyaḥ tad viruddhaḥ tad abhāvaḥ ca iti trirūpāṇi ca trīṇi eva liṅgāni anupalabdhiḥ svabhāvaḥ kāryam ca iti tatra anupalabdhiḥ yathā na pradeśa viśeṣe kvacid ghaṭaḥ upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptasya anupalabdheḥ iti upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptiḥ upalambha pratyaya antarasākalyam svabhāva viśeṣaḥ ca

yaḥ svabhāvaḥ satsu anyeṣu upalambha pratyayeṣu san pratyakṣaḥ eva bhavati sa svabhāva viśeṣaḥ svabhāvaḥ sva sattā mātra prabhāvini sādhya dharme hetuḥ yathā vṛkṣaḥ ayam śiṃśapā tvāt iti kāryam yathā vahniḥ atra dhūmāt iti atra dvau vastu sādhanau ekaḥ pratiṣedha hetuḥ svabhāva pratibandhe hi sati arthaḥ artham gamayet

tad apratibaddhasya tat avyabhicāra niyama abhāvāt sa ca pratibandhaḥ sādhye arthe liṅgasya vastutas tādātmyāt tad utpatteḥ ca atad svabhāvasya ātad utpatteḥ ca tatra apratibaddha svabhāva tvāt te ca tādātmya tad utpattī svabhāva kāryayoḥ eva iti tābhyām eva vastu siddhiḥ pratiṣedha siddhiḥ api yathā uktāyāḥ eva anupalabdheḥ

sati vastuni tasyāḥ asambhavāt anyathā ca anupalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāpteṣu deśa kāla svabhāva viprakṛṣṭeṣu artheṣu ātma pratyakṣa nivṛtteḥ abhāva niścaya abhāvāt amūḍha smṛti saṃskārasya atītasya vartamānasya ca pratipattṛ pratyakṣasya nivṛttiḥ abhāva vyavahāra prasādhanī tasyāḥ eva abhāva niścayāt sā ca prayoga bhedāt ekādaśa prakārā

svabhāva anupalabdhiḥ yathā na atra dhūmaḥ upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptasya anupalabdheḥ iti kārya anupalabdhiḥ yathā na atra apratibaddha sāmarthyāni dhūma kāraṇāni santi dhūma abhāvāt iti vyāpaka anupalabdhiḥ yathā na atra śiṃśapā vṛkṣa abhāvāt iti svabhāva viruddha upalabdhiḥ yathā na atra śīta sparśaḥ vahneḥ iti

viruddha kārya upalabdhiḥ yathā na atra śīta sparśaḥ dhūmāt iti viruddha vyāpta upalabdhiḥ yathā na dhruva bhāvī bhūtasya api bhāvasya vināśaḥ hetu antara apekṣaṇāt iti kārya viruddha upalabdhiḥ yathā na iha apratibaddha sāmarthyāni śīta kāraṇāni santi vahneḥ iti vyāpaka viruddha upalabdhiḥ yathā na atra tuṣāra sparśaḥ vahneḥ iti

kāraṇa anupalabdhiḥ yathā na atra dhūmaḥ vahni abhāvāt iti kāraṇa viruddha upalabdhiḥ yathā na asya romaharṣa ādi viśeṣāḥ sannihita dahana viśeṣa tvāt iti kāraṇa viruddha kārya upalabdhiḥ yathā na roma harṣa ādi viśeṣa yukta puruṣavān ayam pradeśaḥ dhūmāt iti ime sarve kārya anupalabdhi ādayaḥ daśa anupalabdhi prayogāḥ svabhāva anupalabdhau saṃgraham upayānti

pāramparyeṇa artha antara vidhi pratiṣedhābhyām prayoga bhede api prayoga darśana abhyāsāt svayam api evam vyavaccheda pratītiḥ bhavati sva arthe api anumāne asyāḥ prayoga nirdeśaḥ sarvatra ca asyām abhāva vyavahāra sādhanyām anupalabdhau yeṣām svabhāva viruddha ādīnām upalabdhyā kāraṇa ādīnām anupalabdhyā ca pratiṣedhaḥ uktaḥ teṣām upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptānām eva upalabdhiḥ ca veditavyā anyeṣām virodha kārya kāraṇa bhāva asiddheḥ viprakṛṣṭa viṣayā punar anupalabdhiḥ pratyakṣa anumāna nivṛtti lakṣaṇā saṃśaya hetuḥ pramāṇa nivṛttau api artha abhāva asiddheḥ iti

trirūpa liṅga ākhyānam para artham anumānam kāraṇe kārya upacārāt tat dvividham prayoga bhedāt sādharmya vat vaidharmya vat ca nānāyoḥ arthataḥ kaścid bhedaḥ anyatra prayoga bhedāt tatra sādharmya vat prayogaḥ yat upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptam san na upalabhyate saḥ asat vyavahāra viṣayaḥ siddhaḥ yathā anyaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ kaścid śaśaviṣāṇa ādiḥ na upalabhyate ca kvacid pradeśa viśeṣe upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptaḥ ghaṭaḥ iti anupalabdhi prayogaḥ

tathā svabhāva hetoḥ prayogaḥ yat sat tat sarvam anityam yathā ghaṭa ādiḥ iti śuddhasya svabhāva hetoḥ prayogaḥ yat utpattimat tat anityam iti svabhāva bhūta dharma bhedena svabhāvasya prayogaḥ yat kṛtakam tat anityam iti upādhi bhedena apekṣita para vyāpāraḥ hi bhāvaḥ svabhāva niṣpattau kṛtakaḥ iti

evam prayatna antarīyaka pratyaya bheda bhedi tva ādayaḥ api draṣṭavyāḥ san utpattimān kṛtakaḥ vā śabdaḥ iti pakṣa dharma upadarśanam sarve ete sādhana dharmāḥ yathāsvam pramāṇaiḥ siddha sādhana dharma mātra anubandhe eva sādhya dharme avagantavyāḥ tasya eva tad svabhāva tvāt svabhāvasya ca hetu tvāt vastutas tayoḥ tādātmyam

tad niṣpattau aniṣpannasya tad svabhāva tva abhāvāt vyabhicāra sambhavāt ca kārya hetoḥ prayogaḥ yatra dhūmaḥ tatra agniḥ yathā mahānasa ādau asti ca iha dhūmaḥ iti iha api siddhe eva kārya kāraṇa bhāve kāraṇe sādhye kārya hetuḥ vaktavyaḥ vaidharmyavataḥ prayogaḥ yat sat upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptam tat upalabhyate eva yathā nīla ādi viśeṣaḥ na ca evam iha upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptasya sataḥ upalabdhiḥ ghaṭasya iti anupalabdhi prayogaḥ

asati anitya tve na asti sattvam utpattimat tvam kṛtaka tvam vā san ca śabdaḥ utpattimān kṛtakaḥ vā iti svabhāva hetoḥ prayogaḥ asati agnau na bhavati eva dhūmaḥ atra ca asti dhūmaḥ iti kārya hetoḥ prayogaḥ sādharmyeṇa api hi prayoge arthāt vaidharmya gatiḥ iti asati tasmin sādhyena hetoḥ anvaya abhāvāt tathā vaidharmyeṇa api anvaya gatiḥ asati tasmin sādhya abhāve hetu abhāvasya asiddheḥ na hi svabhāva pratibandhe asati ekasya nivṛttau aparasya niyamena nivṛttiḥ sa ca dvi prakāraḥ sarvasya tādātmya lakṣaṇaḥ tad utpatti lakṣaṇaḥ ca iti uktam

tena hi nivṛttim kathayatā pratibandhaḥ darśanīyaḥ tasmāt nivṛtti vacanam ākṣipta pratibandha upadarśanam eva bhavati yat ca pratibandha upadarśanam tat eva anvaya vacanam iti ekena api vākyena anvaya mukhena vyatireka mukhena vā prayuktena sa pakṣāsa pakṣayoḥ liṅgasya sat asat tva khyāpanam kṛtam bhavati iti na avaśyam vākya dvaya prayogaḥ

anupalabdhau api yat sat upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptam tat upalabhyate eva iti ukte anupalabhyamānam tādṛśam asat iti pratīteḥ anvaya siddhiḥ dvayoḥ api anayoḥ prayogayoḥ na avaśyam pakṣa nirdeśaḥ yasmāt sādharmya vat prayoge api yat upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptam san na upalabhyate saḥ asat vyavahāra viṣayaḥ na upalabhyate ca atra upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptaḥ ghaṭaḥ iti ukte sāmarthyāt eva na iha ghaṭaḥ iti bhavati

tathā vaidharmya vat prayoge api yaḥ sat vyavahāra viṣayaḥ upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptaḥ saḥ upalabhyate eva na tathā atra tādṛśaḥ ghaṭaḥ upalabhyate iti ukte sāmarthyāt eva na iha sat vyavahāra viṣayaḥ iti bhavati kīdṛśaḥ punar pakṣaḥ iti nirdeśyaḥ sva rūpeṇa eva svayam iṣṭaḥ anirākṛtaḥ pakṣaḥ iti sva rūpeṇa iti sādhya tvena iṣṭaḥ

sva rūpeṇa eva iti sādhya tvena eva iṣṭaḥ na sādhana tvena api yathā śabdasya anitya tve sādhye cākṣuṣa tvam hetuḥ śabde asiddha tvāt sādhyam bhavati iti na punar tat iha sādhya tvena eva iṣṭam sādhana tvena api abhidhānāt svayam iti vādinā yaḥ tadā sādhanam āha etena yadi api kvacid śāstre sthitaḥ sādhanam āha tad śāstra kāreṇa tasmin dharmiṇi aneka dharma abhyupagame api yaḥ tadā tena vādinā dharmaḥ svayam sādhayitum iṣṭaḥ saḥ eva sādhyaḥ na itaraḥ iti uktam bhavati

iṣṭaḥ iti yatra arthe vivādena sādhanam upanyastam tasya siddhim icchatā saḥ anuktaḥ api vacanena sādhyaḥ bhavati tad adhikaraṇa tvāt vivādasya yathā para arthāḥ cakṣuḥ ādayaḥ saṅghāta tvāt śayana āsana ādi aṅga vat iti atra ātma arthāḥ iti anuktau api ātma artha tā eva sādhyā tena na ukta mātram eva sādhyam iti uktam bhavati

anirākṛtaḥ iti etad lakṣaṇa yoge api yaḥ sādhayitum iṣṭaḥ api arthaḥ pratyakṣa anumāna pratīti sva vacanaiḥ nirākriyate na sa pakṣaḥ iti pradarśana artham tatra pratyakṣa nirākṛtaḥ yathā aśrāvaṇaḥ śabdaḥ iti anumāna nirākṛtaḥ yathā nityaḥ śabdaḥ iti pratīti nirākṛtaḥ yathā acandraḥ śaśī iti sva vacana nirākṛtaḥ yathā na anumānam pramāṇam iti

iti catvāraḥ pakṣa ābhāsāḥ nirākṛtāḥ bhavanti evam siddhasya asiddhasya api sādhana tvena abhimatasya svayam vādinā tadā sādhayitum aniṣṭasya ukta mātrasya nirākṛtasya ca viparyayeṇa sādhyaḥ iti tena eva sva rūpeṇa abhimataḥ vādinaḥ iṣṭaḥ anirākṛtaḥ pakṣaḥ iti pakṣa lakṣaṇam anavadyam darśitam bhavati trirūpa liṅga ākhyānam para artha anumānam iti uktam tatra trayāṇām rūpāṇām ekasya api rūpasya anuktau sādhana ābhāsaḥ

uktau api asiddhau sandehe vā pratipādya pratipādakayoḥ ekasya rūpasya dharmi sambandhasya asiddhau sandehe vā asiddhaḥ hetvābhāsaḥ yathā anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti sādhye cākṣuṣa tvam ubhaya asiddham cetanāḥ taravaḥ iti sādhye sarva tvac apaharaṇe maraṇam prativādya siddham vijñāna indriya āyuḥ nirodha lakṣaṇasya maraṇa sya anena abhyupagamāt tasya ca taruṣu asambhavāt

acetanāḥ sukha ādayaḥ iti sādhye utpattimat tvam anitya tvam vā sāṃkhyasya svayam vādinaḥ asiddham tathā svayam tad āśrayaṇasya vā sandehe asiddhiḥ yathā bāṣpa ādi bhāvena sandihyamānaḥ bhūta saṅghātaḥ agni siddhau upadiśyamānaḥ sandigdha asiddhaḥ yathā iha nikuñje mayūraḥ kekāyitāt iti tad āpāta deśa bhrame

dharmya siddhau api asiddhaḥ yathā sarva gataḥ ātmā iti sādhye sarvatra upalabhyamāna guṇa tvam tathā ekasya rūpasya āsapakṣe asattvasya asiddhau anaikāntikaḥ hetvābhāsaḥ yathā śabdasya anitya tva ādike dharme sādhye prameya tva ādikaḥ dharmaḥ sa pakṣa vipakṣayoḥ sarvatra eka deśe vā vartamānaḥ tathā asya eva rūpasya sandehe api anaikāntikaḥ eva

yathā sarva jñaḥ kaścid vivakṣitaḥ puruṣaḥ rāga ādimān vā iti sādhye vaktṛ tva ādikaḥ dharmaḥ sandigdha vipakṣa vyāvṛttikaḥ sarvajñaḥ vaktā na upalabhyate iti evamprakārasya anupalambhasya adṛśya ātma viṣaya tvena sandeha hetu tvāt tatas asarvajña viparyayāt vaktṛ tva ādeḥ vyāvṛttiḥ sandigdhā vaktṛ tva sarvajña tvayoḥ virodha abhāvāt ca yaḥ sarvajñaḥ sa vaktā na bhavati iti adarśane api vyatirekaḥ na sidhyati sandehāt

dvividhaḥ hi padārthānām virodhaḥ avikala kāraṇasya bhavataḥ anya bhāve abhāvāt virodha gatiḥ śīta uṣṇa sparśa vat paraspara parihāra sthita lakṣaṇa tayā vā bhāva abhāva vat sa ca dvividhaḥ api virodhaḥ vaktṛ tva sarvajña tvayoḥ na sambhavati na ca aviruddha vidheḥ anupalabdhau api abhāva gatiḥ rāga ādīnām vacana ādeḥ ca kārya kāraṇa bhāva asiddheḥ

artha antarasya ca akāraṇasya nivṛttau na vacana ādeḥ nivṛttiḥ iti sandigdha vyatirekaḥ anaikāntikaḥ vacana ādiḥ dvayoḥ rūpayoḥ viparyaya siddhau viruddhaḥ kayoḥ dvayoḥ sa pakṣe sattvasya asapakṣe ca asattvasya yathā kṛtaka tvam prayatna ānantarīyaka tvam ca nitya tve sādhye viruddhaḥ hetvābhāsaḥ anayoḥ sa pakṣe asattvam asapakṣe ca sattvam iti viparyaya siddhiḥ

etau ca sādhya viparyaya sādhanāt viruddhau nanu ca tṛtīyaḥ api iṣṭa vighāta kṛt viruddhaḥ yathā para arthāḥ cakṣuḥ ādayaḥ saṅghāta tvāt śayana āsana ādi aṅga vat iti tad iṣṭa asaṃhata pārārthya viparyaya sādhanāt viruddhaḥ saḥ iha kasmāt na uktaḥ anayoḥ eva antar bhāvāt na hi ayam ābhyām sādhya viparyaya sādhana tvena bhidyate

na hi iṣṭa uktayoḥ sādhya tvena kaścid viśeṣaḥ iti dvayoḥ rūpayoḥ ekasya asiddhau aparasya ca sandehe anaikāntikaḥ yathā vīta rāgaḥ kaścid sarvajñaḥ vā vaktṛ tvāt iti vyatirekaḥ atra asiddhaḥ sandigdhaḥ anvayaḥ sarvajña vīta rāgayoḥ viprakarṣāt vacana ādeḥ tatra sattvam asattvam vā sandigdham anayoḥ eva dvayoḥ rūpayoḥ sandehe anaikāntikaḥ

yathā sa ātmakam jīvat śarīram prāṇa ādimattvāt iti na hi sa ātmaka nirātmakābhyām anyaḥ rāśiḥ asti yatra ayam prāṇa ādiḥ varteta ātmanaḥ vṛtti vyavacchedābhyām sarva saṃgrahāt na api anayoḥ ekatra vṛtti niścayaḥ sa ātmaka tvena anātmaka tvena vā prasiddhe prāṇa ādeḥ asiddheḥ tasmāt jīvat śarīra sambandhī prāṇa ādiḥ sa ātmakāt anātmakāt ca sarvasmāt vyāvṛtta tvena asiddheḥ tābhyām na vyatiricyate

na tatra anveti eka ātmani api asiddheḥ na api sa ātmakāt anātmakāt ca tasya anvaya vyatirekayoḥ abhāva niścayaḥ eka abhāva niścayasya apara bhāva niścayana āntarīyaka tvāt anvaya vyatirekayoḥ anyonya vyavaccheda rūpa tvāt tatas eva anvaya vyatirekayoḥ sandehāt anaikāntikaḥ sādhya itarayoḥ atas niścaya abhāvāt

evam eṣām trayāṇām rūpāṇām ekaikasya dvayoḥ dvayoḥ vā rūpayoḥ asiddhau sandehe vā yathāyogam asiddha viruddha an aikāntikāḥ trayaḥ hetvābhāsāḥ viruddha avyabhicārī api saṃśaya hetuḥ uktaḥ saḥ iha kasmāt na uktaḥ anumāna viṣaye asambhavāt na hi sambhavaḥ asti kārya svabhāvayoḥ ukta lakṣaṇayoḥ anupalambhasya ca viruddha tāyāḥ

na ca anyaḥ avyabhicārī tasmāt avastu darśana bala pravṛttam āgama āśrayam anumānam āśritya tad artha vicāreṣu viruddha avyabhicārī sādhana doṣaḥ uktaḥ śāstra kārāṇām artheṣu bhrāntyā viparīta svabhāva upasaṃhāra sambhavāt na hi asya sambhavaḥ yathā avasthita vastu sthitiṣu ātma kārya anupalambheṣu tatra udāharaṇam yat sarva deśa sthitaiḥ sva sambandhibhiḥ yugapad abhisambadhyate tat sarva gatam yathā ākāśam abhisambadhyate ca sarva deśa avasthitaiḥ sva sambandhibhiḥ yugapad sāmānyam iti

tad sambandhi svabhāva mātra anubandhinī tad deśa sannihita svabhāva tā na hi yaḥ yatra na asti sa tad deśam ātmanā vyāpnoti iti svabhāva hetu prayogaḥ dvitīyaḥ api prayogaḥ yat upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptam san na upalabhyate na tat tatra asti tat yathā kvacid avidyamānaḥ ghaṭaḥ na upalabhyate ca upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptam sāmānyam vyakti antarāleṣu iti ayam anupalambhaḥ svabhāvaḥ ca paraspara viruddha artha sādhanāt ekatra saṃśayam janayataḥ trirūpaḥ hetuḥ uktaḥ tāvatā na artha pratītiḥ iti na pṛthak dṛṣṭāntaḥ nāma sādhana avayavaḥ kaścid tena na asya lakṣaṇam pṛthak ucyate gata artha tvāt

hetoḥ sa pakṣaḥ eva sattvam asapakṣāt ca sarvatas vyāvṛttaḥ rūpam uktam abhedena punar viśeṣeṇa kārya svabhāvayoḥ ukta lakṣaṇayoḥ janma tanmātra anubandhau darśanīyau uktau tat ca darśayatā yatra dhūmaḥ tatra agniḥ asati agnau na kvacid dhūmaḥ yathā mahānasa itarayoḥ yatra kṛtaka tvam tatra anitya tvam anitya tva abhāve kṛtaka tva asambhavaḥ yathā ghaṭa ākāśayoḥ iti darśanīyam na hi anyathā sa pakṣa vipakṣayoḥ sat asat tve yathā ukta prakāre śakye darśayitum tad kāryatā niyamaḥ kārya liṅgasya svabhāva liṅgasya ca svabhāvena vyāptiḥ asmin ca arthe darśite darśitaḥ eva dṛṣṭāntaḥ bhavati etāvat mātra rūpa tvāt tasya iti

etena eva dṛṣṭānta doṣāḥ api nirastāḥ bhavanti yathā nityaḥ śabdaḥ amūrta tvāt karma vat paramāṇu vat ghaṭa vat iti ete dṛṣṭānta ābhāsāḥ sādhya sādhana dharma ubhaya vikalāḥ tathā sandigdha sādhya dharma ādayaḥ ca yathā rāga ādimān ayam vacanāt rathyā puruṣa vat maraṇa dharma ayam puruṣaḥ rāga ādimattvāt rathyā puruṣa vat asarvajñaḥ ayam rāga ādimattvāt rathyā puruṣa vat iti

tathā ananvayaḥ apradarśita anvayaḥ ca yathā yaḥ vaktā sa rāga ādimān iṣṭa puruṣa vat anityaḥ śabdaḥ kṛtaka tvāt ghaṭa vat iti tathā viparīta anvayaḥ yat anityam tat kṛtakam iti sādharmyeṇa dṛṣṭānta doṣāḥ vaidharmyeṇa api paramāṇu vat karma vat ākāśa vat iti sādhyādi a vyatirekiṇaḥ tathā sandigdha sādhya vyatireka ādayaḥ yathā asarva jñāḥ kapila ādayaḥ anāptāḥ vā avidyamāna sarvajña tā āpta tā liṅga bhūta pramāṇa atiśaya śāsana tvāt iti atra vaidharmya udāharaṇam yaḥ sarvajña āptaḥ vā sa jyotiḥ jñāna ādikam upadiṣṭavān yathā ṛṣabha vardhamāna ādiḥ iti tatra asarvajña tān āpta tayoḥ sādhya dharmayoḥ sandigdhaḥ vyatirekaḥ

sandigdha sādhana vyatirekaḥ yathā na trayī vidā brāhmaṇena grāhya vacanaḥ kaścid vivakṣitaḥ puruṣaḥ rāga ādimattvāt iti atra vaidharmya udāharaṇam ye grāhya vacanāḥ na te rāga ādimantaḥ tat yathā gautama ādayaḥ dharma śāstrāṇām praṇetāraḥ iti gautama ādibhyaḥ rāga ādimattvasya sādhana dharmasya vyāvṛttiḥ sandigdhā

sandigdha ubhaya vyatirekaḥ yathā avīta rāgāḥ kapila ādayaḥ parigraha agraha yogāt iti atra vaidharmyeṇa udāharaṇam yaḥ vīta rāgaḥ na tasya parigraha āgrahaḥ yathā ṛṣabha ādeḥ iti ṛṣabha ādeḥ avīta rāga tva parigraha āgraha yogayoḥ sādhya sādhana dharmayoḥ sandigdhaḥ vyatirekaḥ avyatirekaḥ yathā avīta rāgaḥ ayam vaktṛ tvāt vaidharmyeṇa udāharaṇam yatra avīta rāga tvam na asti na sa vaktā yathā upalakhaṇḍaḥ iti yadi api upala khaṇḍāt ubhayam vyāvṛttam tathā api sarvaḥ vīta rāgaḥ na vaktā iti vyāptyā vyatireka asiddheḥ avyatirekaḥ

apradarśita vyatirekaḥ yathā anityaḥ śabdaḥ kṛtaka tvāt ākāśa vat iti vaidharmyeṇa viparīta vyatirekaḥ yathā yat akṛtakam tat nityam bhavati iti na hi ebhiḥ dṛṣṭānta ābhāsaiḥ hetoḥ sāmānya lakṣaṇam sa pakṣaḥ eva sattvam vipakṣe ca sarvatra asat tvam eva niścayena śakyam darśayitum viśeṣa lakṣaṇam vā tad arthāpattyā eṣām nirāsaḥ draṣṭavyaḥ dūṣaṇā nyūna tādi uktiḥ ye pūrvam nyūna tā ādayaḥ sādhana doṣāḥ uktāḥ teṣām udbhāvanam dūṣaṇam tena para iṣṭa artha siddhi pratibandhāt dūṣaṇa ābhāsāḥ tu jātayaḥ abhūta doṣa udbhāvanāni jāti uttarāṇi iti

pramāṇam avisaṃvādi jñānam artha kriyā sthitiḥ avisaṃvādanam śabde api abhiprāya nivedanāt vaktṛ vyāpāra viṣayaḥ yaḥ arthaḥ buddhau prakāśate prāmāṇyam tatra śabdasya na artha tattva nibandhanam gṛhīta grahaṇāt na iṣṭam sāṃvṛtam dhī pramāṇa tā pravṛtteḥ tad pradhāna tvāt dheya upādeya vastuni viṣaya ākāra bhedāt ca dhiyaḥ adhigama bhedataḥ bhāvāt eva asya tad bhāve svarūpasya svatas gatiḥ prāmāṇyam vyavahāreṇa śāstram moha nivartanam ajñāta artha prakāśaḥ vā svarūpa adhigateḥ param
prāptam sāmānya vijñānam avijñāte sva lakṣaṇe yat jñānam iti abhiprāyāt sva lakṣaṇa vicārataḥ
tadvat pramāṇam bhagavān abhūta vinivṛttaye bhūta uktiḥ sādhana apekṣā tatas yuktā pramāṇa tā nityam pramāṇam na eva asti prāmāṇyāt vastu saṃgateḥ jñeya anityatayā tasyāḥ adhrauvyāt kramajanmanaḥ

nityāt utpatti viśleṣāt apekṣāyāḥ ayogataḥ kathaṃcid na upakārya tvāt anitye api apramāṇa tā sthitvā pravṛtti saṃsthāna viśeṣa artha kriyā ādiṣu iṣṭa siddhiḥ asiddhiḥ vā dṛṣṭānte saṃśayaḥ athavā siddham yādṛś adhiṣṭhātṛ bhāva abhāva anuvṛttimat saṃniveśa ādi tat yuktam tasmāt yat anumīyate vastu bhede prasiddhasya śabda sāmānyāt abhedinaḥ

na yukta anumitiḥ pāṇḍu dravya ādi vat dhuta aśane anyathā kumbhakāreṇa mṛd vikārasya kasyacid ghaṭa ādeḥ karaṇāt sidhyet valmīkasya api tad kṛtiḥ sādhyena anugamāt kārye sāmānyena api sādhane saṃbandhi bhedāt bheda ukti doṣaḥ kārya samaḥ mataḥ jāti antare prasiddhasya śabda sāmānya darśanāt na yuktam sādhanam go tvāt śaśa ādīnām viṣāṇi vat

vivakṣā paratantra tvāt na śabdāḥ santi kutra vā tad bhāvāt artha siddhau tu sarvam sarvasya sidhyati etena kāpila ādīnām acaitanya ādi cintitam anitya ādeḥ ca caitanyam maraṇāt tvac apohataḥ vastu svarūpe asiddhe ayam nyāyaḥ siddhe viśeṣaṇam abādhakam asiddhau api ākāśa āśraya vat dhvaneḥ

asiddhau api śabdasya siddhe vastuni sidhyati aulūkyasya yathā bauddhena uktam mūrti ādi sādhanam tasya eva vyabhicāra ādau śabde api avyabhicāriṇī doṣavat sādhanam jñeyam vastunaḥ vastu siddhitaḥ yathā tat kāraṇam vastu tathā eva tat akāraṇam yadā tat kāraṇam kena matam na iṣṭam akāraṇam

śāstra auṣadha abhisaṃbandhāt caitrasya vraṇa rohaṇe asaṃbaddhasya kim sthāṇoḥ kāraṇa tvam na kalpyate svabhāva bhedena vinā vyāpāraḥ api na yujyate nityasya avyatireki tvāt sāmarthyam ca duranvayam yeṣu satsu bhavati eva yat tebhyaḥ anyasya kalpane tad hetu tvena sarvatra hetūnām anavasthitiḥ

svabhāva pariṇāmena hetuḥ aṅkura janmani bhūmi ādiḥ tasya saṃskāre tad viśeṣasya darśanāt yathā viśeṣeṇa vinā viṣaya indriya saṃhatiḥ buddheḥ hetuḥ tathā idam ced na tatra api viśeṣataḥ pṛthak pṛthak aśaktānām svabhāva atiśaye asati saṃhatau api asāmarthyam syāt siddhaḥ atiśayaḥ tatas tasmāt pṛthak aśakteṣu yeṣu saṃbhāvyate guṇaḥ saṃhatau hetu tā teṣām na īśvara ādeḥ abhedataḥ

prāmāṇyam ca parokṣa artha jñānam tat sādhanasya ca abhāvāt na asti anuṣṭhānam iti kecid pracakṣate jñānavān mṛgyate kaścid tad ukta pratipattaye ajña upadeśa karaṇe vipralambhana śaṅkibhiḥ tasmāt anuṣṭheya gatam jñānam asya vicāryatām kīṭa saṃkhyā parijñānam tasya naḥ kva upayujyate
heya upādeya tattvasya hāni upāyasya vedakaḥ yaḥ pramāṇam asau iṣṭaḥ na tu sarvasya vedakaḥ dūram paśyatu vā mā vā tattvam iṣṭam tu paśyatu pramāṇam dūra darśī ced eta gṛdhrān upāsmahe

sādhanam karuṇā abhyāsāt sā buddheḥ deha saṃśrayāt asiddhaḥ abhyāsaḥ iti ced na āśraya pratiṣedhataḥ prāṇa apāna indriya dhiyām dehāt eva na kevalāt sva jāti nirapekṣāṇām janma janma parigrahe atiprasaṅgāt yat dṛṣṭam pratisaṃdhāna śaktimat kim āsīt tasya yat na asti paścān yena na saṃdhimat

na sa kaścid pṛthivī ādeḥ aṃśaḥ yatra na jantavaḥ saṃsveda ja ādyāḥ jāyante sarvam bīja ātmakam tatas tat sva jāti anapekṣāṇām akṣa ādīnām samudbhave pariṇāmaḥ yathā ekasya syāt sarvasya aviśeṣataḥ pratyekam upadhāte api na indriyāṇām manaḥ mateḥ upaghātaḥ asti bhaṅge asyāḥ teṣām bhaṅgaḥ ca dṛśyate

tasmāt sthiti āśrayaḥ buddheḥ buddhim eva samāśritaḥ kaścid nimittam akṣāṇām tasmāt akṣāṇi buddhitaḥ yādṛśyākṣepikā sā āsīt paścāt api astu tādṛśī tad jñānaiḥ upakārya tvāt uktam kāya āśritam manaḥ yadi api akṣaiḥ vinā buddhiḥ na tāni api tayā vinā tathā api anyonya hetu tvam tatas api anyonya hetuke

na akramāt kramiṇaḥ bhāvaḥ na api apekṣā viśeṣiṇaḥ kramāt bhavantī dhīḥ kāyāt kramam tasya api śaṃsati pratikṣaṇam apūrvasya pūrvaḥ pūrvaḥ kṣaṇaḥ bhavet tasya hetuḥ atas hetuḥ dṛṣṭaḥ eva astu sarvadā citta antarasya saṃdhāne kaḥ virodhaḥ antya cetasaḥ tadvat api arthataḥ cittam asaṃdhānam kutas matam

asiddhārthaḥ pramāṇena kim siddhāntaḥ anugamyate hetoḥ vaikalyataḥ tat ced kim tat eva atra na uditam tat dhīvat grahaṇa prāpteḥ manaḥ jñānam na sa indriyāt jñāna utpādana sāmarthya bhedāt na sakalāt api acetana tvāt na anyasmāt dhetu abhedāt saha sthitiḥ akṣa vat rūpa rasa vat artha dvāreṇa vikriyā

sattā upakāriṇī yasya nityam tad anubandhataḥ sa hetuḥ saptamī tasmāt utpādāt iti ca ucyate astu upakārakaḥ vā api kadācid citta saṃtateḥ vahni ādi vat ghaṭa ādīnām vinivṛttiḥ na tāvatā anivṛtti prasaṅgaḥ ca dehe tiṣṭhati cetasaḥ tad bhāva bhāvāt vaśya tvāt prāṇa apānau tatas na tat preraṇa ākarṣaṇe vāyoḥ prayatnena vinā kutas

nirhrāsa atiśaya āpattiḥ nirhrāsa atiśayāt tayoḥ tulyaḥ prasaṅgaḥ api tayoḥ na tulyam citta kāraṇe sthiti āvedhakam anyat ca yatas kāraṇam iṣyate na doṣaiḥ viguṇaḥ dehaḥ hetuḥ varti ādi vat yadi mṛte śamīkṛte doṣe punar ujjīvanam bhavet nivṛtte api anale kāṣṭha vikāra avinivṛtti vat tasya anivṛttiḥ iti ced na cikitsā prayogataḥ

apunarbhāvataḥ kiṃcid vikāra jananam kvacid kiṃcid viparyayāt agniḥ yathā kāṣṭha suvarṇayoḥ ādyasya anyaḥ api asaṃhāryaḥ pratyāneyaḥ tu yat kṛtaḥ vikāraḥ syāt punarbhāvaḥ tasya hemni khara tva vat durlabha tvāt samādhātuḥ asādhyam kiṃcid īritam āyuḥ kṣayāt vā doṣe tu kevale na asti asādhyatā

mṛte viṣa ādi saṃhārāt tat daṃśat chedataḥ api vā vikāra hetoḥ vigame sa na ucchvaḥ iti kim punar upādāna avikāreṇa na upādeyasya vikriyā kartum śakyā vikāreṇa mṛdaḥ kuṇḍādinaḥ yathā avikṛtya hi yat vastu yaḥ padārthaḥ vikāryate upādānam na tat tasya yuktam gogavaya ādi vat cetaḥ śarīrayoḥ evam tad hetoḥ kārya janmanaḥ

sahakārāt saha sthānam agni tāmra drava tva vat anāśrayāt sat asatoḥ na āśrayaḥ sthiti kāraṇam sataḥ ced āśrayaḥ na asyāḥ sthātuḥ avyatirekataḥ vyatireke api tad hetuḥ tena bhāvasya kim kṛtam avināśa prasaṅgaḥ sa nāśa hetoḥ mataḥ yadi tulyaḥ prasaṅgaḥ tatra api kim punar sthiti hetunā ānāśaka āgamāt sthānam tatas ced vastu dharma tā

nāśasya satyabādhaḥ asau iti kim sthiti hetunā yathā jala ādeḥ ādhāraḥ iti ced tulyam atra ca pratikṣaṇa vināśe hi bhāvānām bhāva saṃtateḥ tathā utpatteḥ sa hetu tvāt āśrayaḥ ayuktam anyathā syāt ādhāraḥ jala ādīnām gamana pratibandhataḥ agatīnām kim ādhāraiḥ guṇa sāmānya karmaṇām etena samavāyaḥ ca samavāyī ca kāraṇam

vyavasthita tvam jāti ādeḥ nirastam anapāśrayāt paratas bhāva nāśaḥ ced tasya kim sthiti hetunā sa vinaśyet vinā api anyaiḥ na śaktāḥ sthiti hetavaḥ sthitimān sa āśrayaḥ sarvaḥ sarva utpattau ca sa āśrayaḥ tasmāt sarvasya bhāvasya na vināśaḥ kadācana svayam vinaśvara ātmā ced tasya kaḥ sthāpakaḥ paraḥ

svayam na naśvara ātmā ced tasya kaḥ sthāpakaḥ paraḥ buddhi vyāpāra bhedena nirhrāsa atiśayau api prajñā ādeḥ bhavataḥ deha nirhrāsā atiśayau vinā idam dīpa prabhā ādīnām āśritānām na vidyate syāt tatas api viśeṣaḥ asya na citte anupakāriṇi rāga ādi vṛddhiḥ puṣṭi ādeḥ kadācid sukha duḥkha jā tayoḥ ca dhātu sāmya ādeḥ antararthasya saṃnidheḥ

etena saṃnipāta ādeḥ smṛti bhraṃśa ādayaḥ gatāḥ vikārayati dhīḥ eva abhyantarartha viśeṣa jā śārdūla śoṇita ādīnām saṃtāna atiśaye kvacid moha ādayaḥ saṃbhavanti śravaṇa īkṣaṇataḥ yathā tasmāt svasya eva saṃskāram niyamena anuvartate tat na antarīyakam cittam atas citta samāśritam yathā śruta ādi saṃskāraḥ kṛtaḥ cetasi cetasi

kālena vyajyate abhedāt syāt dehe api tatas guṇaḥ ananya sattvaneyasya hīna sthāna parigrahaḥ ātma snehavataḥ duḥkha sukha tyāga āpti vāñchayā duḥkhe viparyāsa matiḥ tṛṣṇā ca ābandha kāraṇam janminaḥ yasya te na staḥ na sa janma adhigacchati gati āgatī na dṛṣṭe ced indriyāṇām apāṭavāt adṛṣṭiḥ manda netrasya tanu dhūma āgatiḥ yathā

tanu tvāt mūrtam api tu kiṃcid kvacid aśaktimat jala vat sūta vat dhemni na adṛṣṭeḥ asat eva vā pāṇi ādi kampe sarvasya kampa prāpteḥ virodhinaḥ ekasmin karmaṇaḥ ayogāt syāt pṛthak siddhiḥ anyathā ekasya ca āvṛttau sarvasya āvṛttiḥ syāt anāvṛttau dṛśyeta rakte ca ekasmin rāgaḥ araktasya vā gatiḥ

na asti eka samudāyaḥ asmāt aneka tve api pūrvavat aviśeṣāt aṇu tvāt ca na gatiḥ ced na sidhyati aviśeṣaḥ viśiṣṭānām aindriya tvam atas anaṇuḥ etena āvaraṇa ādīnām abhāvaḥ ca nirākṛtaḥ katham vā sūta hema ādi miśram tapta upala ādi vā dṛśyam pṛthak aśaktānām akṣa ādīnām gatiḥ katham saṃyogāt ced samānaḥ atra prasaṅgaḥ hema sūtayoḥ

dṛśyaḥ saṃyogaḥ iti ced kutas adṛṣṭa āśraye gatiḥ rasa rūpa ādi yogaḥ ca viruddhaḥ upacārataḥ iṣṭaḥ ced buddhi bhedaḥ astu paṅktiḥ dīrgha iti vā katham saṃkhyā saṃyoga karma ādeḥ api tadvat svarūpataḥ abhilāpāt ca bhedena rūpam buddhau na bhāsate śabda jñāne vikalpena vastu bheda anusāriṇā guṇa ādiṣu iva kalpyā arthe naṣṭa ajāteṣu vā yathā

mataḥ yadi upacāraḥ atra saḥ iṣṭaḥ yat nibandhanaḥ saḥ eva sarva bhāveṣu hetuḥ kim na iṣyate tayoḥ upacāraḥ na sarvatra yadi bhinna viśeṣaṇam mukhyam iti eva ca kutas abhinne bhinna artha tā iti ced anartha antara hetu tve api aparyāyaḥ sita ādiṣu saṃkhyā ādi yoginaḥ śabdāḥ tatra api artha antaram yadi

guṇa dravya aviśeṣaḥ syāt bhinnaḥ vyāvṛtti bhedataḥ syāt anartha antara artha tve api akarmā dravya śabda vat vyatirekī iva yat ca api sūcyate bhāva vācibhiḥ saṃkhyā ādi tadvataḥ śabdaiḥ tad dharma antara bhedakam śrutiḥ tanmātra jijñāsoḥ na vā kṣiptā akhilā parā bhinnam dharmam iva ācaṣṭe yogaḥ aṅgulyā iti kvacid

yukta aṅgulī iti sarveṣām ākṣepāt dharmi vācinī khyāta eka artha abhidhāne api tathā vihita saṃsthitiḥ rūpa ādi śakti bhedānām anākṣepeṇa vartate tad samāna phalā hetu vyavacchede ghaṭa śrutiḥ atas na rūpam ghaṭaḥ iti eka adhikaraṇā śrutiḥ bhedaḥ ayam īdṛśaḥ jāti samudāya abhidāyinoḥ rūpa ādayaḥ ghaṭasya iti tad sāmānya upasarjanāḥ

tad śakti bhedāḥ khyāpyante vācyaḥ anyaḥ api anayā diśā hetu tve ca samastānām eka aṅga vikale api na pratyekam api sāmarthye yugapad bahu saṃbhavaḥ na aneka tvasya tulya tvāt prāṇa apānau niyāmakau eka tve api bahu vyaktiḥ tad hetoḥ nitya saṃnidheḥ na aneka hetuḥ iti ced na aviśeṣāt kramāt api

na eka prāṇe api aneka artha grahaṇāt niyamaḥ tatas ekayā aneka vijñāne buddhyāḥ tu sakṛt eva tat avirodhāt krameṇa api mā bhūt tad aviśeṣatas bahavaḥ kṣaṇikāḥ prāṇāḥ asvajātīyakāḥ kila tādṛśām eva cittānām kalpyante yadi kāraṇam kramavantaḥ katham te syuḥ krama vat dhetunā vinā pūrva sva jāti hetu tve na syāt ādyasya saṃbhavaḥ

tat dhetuḥ tādṛśaḥ na asti sati vā aneka tā dhruvam prāṇānām bhinna deśa tvāt sakṛt janma dhiyāmataḥ yadi ekakālikaḥ anekaḥ api eka caitanya kāraṇam ekasya api na vaikalye syāt manda śvasita ādiṣu atha hetuḥ yathābhāvam jñāne api syāt viśiṣṭa tā na hi tat tasya kāryam yadi asya bhedāt na bhidyate

vijñānam śakti niyamāt ekam ekasya kāraṇam anya artha āsakti viguṇe jñāne anartha antara grahāt śarīrāt sakṛt utpannā dhīḥ sva jātyā niyamyate paratas ced samarthasya dehasya viratiḥ kutas anāśrayāt nivṛtte syāt śarīre cetasaḥ sthitiḥ kevalasya iti ced citta saṃtānam sthiti kāraṇam tad hetu vṛtti lābhāya na aṅga tām yadi gacchati

hetuḥ deha antara utpattau pañcāyatanam aihikam tad aṅga bhāva hetutva niṣedhe anupalambhanam aniścaya karam proktam indriya ādi api śeṣavat dṛṣṭā ca śaktiḥ pūrveṣām indriyāṇām sva jātiṣu vikāra darśanāt siddham apara apara janma ca śarīrāt yadi tad janma prasaṅgaḥ pūrvavat bhavet cittāt ced tatas eva astu janma deha antarasya ca

tasmāt na hetu vaikalyāt sarveṣām antya cetasām asaṃdhiḥ īdṛśam tena śeṣavat sādhanam matam abhyāsena viśeṣe api laṅghana udaka tāpa vat svabhāva atikramaḥ mā bhūt iti ced āhitaḥ sa ced punar yatnam apekṣeta yadi syāt ca asthiḥ āśrayaḥ viśeṣaḥ na eva bardheta svabhāvaḥ ca na tādṛśaḥ tatra upayukta śaktīnām viśeṣa anuttarān prati

sādhanānām asāmarthyāt nityam ca anāśraya sthiteḥ viśeṣasya asvabhāva tvāt vṛddhau api āhitaḥ yadā na apekṣeta punar yatnam yatnaḥ anyaḥ syāt viśeṣa kṛt kāṣṭha pārada hema ādeḥ agni ādeḥ iva cetasi abhyāsa jāḥ pravartante svarasena kṛpā ādayaḥ tasmāt sa teṣām utpannaḥ svabhāvaḥ jāyate guṇaḥ

tat uttarottaraḥ yatnaḥ viśeṣasya vidhāyakaḥ yasmāt ca tulya jātīya pūrva bīja pravṛddhayaḥ kṛpā ādi buddhayaḥ tāsām sati abhyāse kutas sthitiḥ na ca evam laṅghanāt eva laṅghanam bala yatnayoḥ tad hetvoḥ sthita śakti tvāt laṅghanasya sthita ātma tā tasya ādau deha vaiguṇyāt paścāt vada vilaṅghanam

śanais yatnena vaiguṇye niraste sva bale sthitiḥ kṛpā sva bīja prabhavā sva bīja prabhavaiḥ na ced vipakṣaiḥ bādhyate ced te prayāti atyanta sātma tām tathā hi mūlam abhyāsaḥ pūrvaḥ pūrvaḥ parasya tu kṛpā vairāgya bodha ādeḥ citta dharmasya pāṭave kṛpā ātmaka tvam abhyāsāt ghṛṇauvairāgya rāga vat

dayāvān duḥkha hāna artham upāyeṣu abhiyujyate parokṣa upeya tad hetoḥ tad ākhyānam hi duṣkaram yukti āgamābhyām vimṛśan duḥkha hetum parīkṣate tasyānitya ādi rūpam ca duḥkhasya eva viśeṣaṇaiḥ yatas tathā sthite hetau nivṛttiḥ na iti paśyati phalasya hetoḥ hāna artham tat vipakṣam parīkṣate

sādhyate tad vipakṣaḥ api hetoḥ rūpa avabodhataḥ ātma ātmīya graha kṛtaḥ snehaḥ saṃskāra gocaraḥ hetuḥ virodhi nairātmya darśanam tasya bādhakam bahuśas bahudhā upāyam kālena bahunā asya ca gacchanti abhyasyataḥ tatra guṇa doṣāḥ prakāśatām buddheḥ ca pāṭavāt dhetoḥ vāsanātas prahīyate padārtha vṛtteḥ khaṅga ādeḥ viśeṣaḥ ayam mahā muneḥ upāya abhyāsaḥ eva ayam tādarthyāt śāsanam matam niṣpatteḥ prathamam bhāvāt dhetuḥ uktam idam dvayam hetoḥ prahāṇam triguṇam sugata tvam aniśrayāt

duḥkhasya śastam nairātmya dṛṣṭeḥ tat yuktitaḥ api vā punar āvṛttiḥ iti uktau janma doṣa samudbhavau ātma darśana bījasya hānāt apunar āgamaḥ tad bhūta bhinna ātma tayā aśeṣam akleśa nirjaram kāya vāc buddhi vaiguṇyam mārga ukti apaṭu tā api vā aśeṣa hānam abhyāsāt ukti ādeḥ doṣa saṃkṣayaḥ na iti eke vyatirekaḥ asya saṃdigdha avi abhicāryataḥ akṣayitvam ca doṣāṇām nitya tvāt anupāyataḥ upāyasya aparijñānāt iti vā parikalpayet hetumat tvāt viruddhasya hetoḥ abhyāsataḥ kṣayāt hetu svabhāva jñānena tad jñānam api sādhyate tāyaḥ sva dṛṣṭa mārga uktiḥ vaiphalyāt vakti na anṛtam

dayālu tvāt para artham ca sarva ārambha abhiyogataḥ tatas pramāṇam tāyaḥ vā catur satya prakāśanam duḥkham saṃsāriṇaḥ skandhāḥ rāga ādeḥ pāṭava īkṣaṇāt abhyāsāt na yadṛcchātaḥ ahetoḥ janma virodhataḥ vyabhicārāt na vāta ādi dharmaḥ prakṛti saṃkarāt adoṣaḥ ced tad anyaḥ api dharmaḥ kim tasya na īkṣyate

na sarva dharmaḥ sarveṣām sama rāga prasaṅgataḥ rūpa ādi vat adoṣaḥ ced tulyam tatra api codanam ādhipatyam viśiṣṭānām yadi tatra na karmaṇām viśeṣe api ca doṣānām aviśeṣāt asiddha tā na vikārāt vikāreṇa sarveṣām na ca sarvajāḥ kāraṇe vardhamāne ca kārya hāniḥ na yujyate tāpa ādiṣu iva rāga ādeḥ vikāraḥ api sukha ādi jaḥ

vaiṣamya jena duḥkhena rāgasya anudbhavaḥ yadi vācyam kena udbhavaḥ sāmyāt mada vṛddhiḥ smaraḥ tatas rāgī viṣam adoṣaḥ api dṛṣṭaḥ sāmye api na aparaḥ kṣayāt asṛk srutaḥ api anye na eka strī niyataḥ madaḥ te na ekasyām na tīvraḥ syāt aṅga rūpa ādi api iti ced na sarveṣām anekāntān na ca api aniyataḥ bhavet

aguṇa grāhiṇaḥ api syāt aṅgam saḥ api guṇa grahaḥ yadi sarvā guṇa grāhī syāt dhetoḥ aviśeṣatas yat avasthaḥ mataḥ rāgī na dveṣī syāt ca tādṛśaḥ tayoḥ asama rūpa tvāt niyamaḥ ca atra na īkṣyate sa jāti vāsanā bheda pratibaddha pravṛttayaḥ yasya rāga ādayaḥ tasya na ete doṣāḥ prasaṅginaḥ etena bhūta dharma tvam niṣiddham niśrayasya ca

niṣedhāt na pṛthivī ādi niśritāḥ dhavala ādayaḥ tad upādāya śabdaḥ ca hetu arthaḥ sva āśrayeṇa ca avinirbhāga varti tvāt āśraya ayuktam anyathā mad ādi śakteḥ iva ced vinirbhāgaḥ na vastunaḥ śaktiḥ artha antaram vastu naśyet na āśritam āśraye tiṣṭhati avikale yāti tad tulyam ced na bhedataḥ bhūta cetanayoḥ bhinna pratibhāsā avabodhataḥ

āvikāram ca kāyasya tulya rūpam bhavet manaḥ rūpa ādi vat vikalpasya kā eva artha paratantra tā anapekṣya yadā kāyam vāsanā bodha kāraṇam jñānam syāt kasyacid kiṃcid kadācid tena kiṃcana avijñānasya vijñāna anupādānāt ca sidhyati vijñāna śakti saṃbandhāt iṣṭaḥ ced sarva vastunaḥ etat sāṃkhya paśoḥ kaḥ anyaḥ sa lajjaḥ vaktum īhate

adṛṣṭa pūrvam asti iti tṛṇa agre kariṇām śatam yat rūpam dṛśyatām yātam tat rūpam prāk na dṛśyate śatadhā viprakīrṇe api hetau tat vidyate katham rāga ādi aniyamaḥ apūrva prāduḥ bhāve prasajyate bhūtātma tā anatikrānteḥ sarvaḥ rāga ādimān yadi sarvaḥ samāna rāgaḥ syāt bhūta atiśayataḥ na ced bhūtānām prāṇitā bhede api ayam bhedaḥ yat āśrayaḥ

tat nirhrāsa atiśaya vat tat bhāvāt tāni hāpayet na ced bhede api rāga ādi hetu tulya ātma tā kṣayaḥ sarvatra rāgaḥ sadṛśaḥ syāt dhetoḥ sadṛśa ātmanaḥ na hi go pratyayasya asti samāna artha bhuvaḥ kvacid tāratamyam pṛthivī ādau prāṇita ādeḥ iha api vā auṣṇyasya tāratamye api na anuṣṇaḥ agniḥ kadācana

tathā iha api iti ced na agneḥ auṣṇyāt bheda niṣedhataḥ tāratamya anubhavinaḥ yasya anyasya sataḥ guṇāḥ te kvacid pratihanyante tad bhede dhavala ādi vat rūpa ādi vat na niyamaḥ teṣām bhūta avibhāgataḥ tad tulyam ced na rāga ādeḥ saha utpatti prasaṅgataḥ vikalpya viṣaya tvāt ca viṣayāḥ na niyāmakāḥ sa bhāga hetu virahāt rāga ādeḥ niyamaḥ na vā

sarvadā sarva buddhīnām janma vā hetu saṃnidheḥ kadācid upalambhāt tat adhruvam doṣa niśrayāt duḥkham hetu vaśa tvāt ca na ca ātmā na api adhiṣṭhitam na akāraṇam adhiṣṭhātā nityam vā janakam katham tasmāt anekam ekasmāt bhinna kālam na jāyate kārya anutpādataḥ anyeṣu saṃgateṣu api hetuṣu

hetu antara anumānam syāt na etat nityeṣu vidyate kādācid ka tayā siddhā duḥkhasya asya sa hetu tā nityam sattvam asattvam vāhetoḥ anya anapekṣaṇāt taikṣṇya ādīnām yathā na asti kāraṇam kaṇḍaka ādiṣu tathā akāraṇam etat syāt iti kecid pracakṣate sati eva yasmin yat janma vikāre vā api vikriyā tat tasya kāraṇam prāhuḥ tat teṣām api vidyate

sparśasya rūpa hetu tvāt darśane asti nimitta tā nityānām pratiṣedhena na īśvara ādeḥ ca saṃbhavaḥ asāmarthyāt atas hetuḥ bhava vān śā parigrahaḥ yasmāt deśa viśeṣasya tat prāpti āśā kṛtaḥ nṛṇām sā bhavet śāpti anāpti icchoḥ pravṛttiḥ sukha duḥkhayoḥ yatas api prāṇinaḥ kāma vibhava icche ca te mate

sarvatra ca ātma snehasya hetu tvāt saṃpravartate asukhe sukha saṃjñasya tasmāt tṛṣṇā bhava āśrayaḥ virakta janma adṛṣṭeḥ iti ācāryāḥ saṃpracakṣate adeha rāga adṛṣṭeḥ ca dehāt rāga samudbhavaḥ nimitta upagamāt iṣṭam upādānam tu vāryate imān tu yuktiman vicchan bādhate sva matam svayam janmanā sahabhāvaḥ ced jātānām rāga darśanāt

sa bhāga jāteḥ prāk siddhiḥ kāraṇa tve api na uditam ajñānam uktā tṛṣṇā eva saṃtāna preraṇāt bhave ānantaryāt na karma api sati tasmin asaṃbhavāt tat anātyantikam hetoḥ pratibandha ādi saṃbhavāt saṃsāri tvāt anirmokṣaḥ na iṣṭa tvāt aprasiddhitaḥ yāvat ātmani na premṇaḥ hāniḥ sa paritasyati

tāvat duḥkhitam āropya na ca svasthaḥ avatiṣṭhate mithyā dhyāra upahāna artham yatnaḥ asati api moktari avasthā vīta rāgāṇām dayayā karmaṇā api vā ākṣipte avinivṛtti iṣṭeḥ sahakāri kṣayāt alam na ākṣeptum aparam karma bhava tṛṣṇā vilaṅghinām duḥkha jñāne aviruddhasya pūrva saṃskāra vāhinī vastu dharma udaya utpattiḥ na sā sattva anurodhinī

ātma antara samāropāt rāgaḥ dharme atad ātmake duḥkha saṃtāna saṃsparśa mātreṇa eva dayā udayaḥ mohaḥ ca mūlam doṣāṇām sa ca sattva grahaḥ vinā tena ādya hetau na dveṣaḥ na doṣaḥ atas kṛpā matā na amuktiḥ pūrva saṃskāra kṣaye anya apratisaṃdhitaḥ akṣīṇa śaktiḥ saṃskāraḥ yeṣām tiṣṭhanti te anaghāḥ manda tvāt karuṇāyāḥ ca na yatnaḥ sthāpane mahān

tiṣṭhanti eva para adhīnāḥ yeṣām tu mahatī kṛpā satkāya dṛṣṭeḥ vigamāt ādyaḥ eva abhavaḥ bhavet mārge ced sahajā hāneḥ na hānau vā bhavaḥ kutas sukhī bhave ayam duḥkhī vā mā bhūvam iti tṛṣyataḥ yā eva aham iti dhīḥ sā eva sahajam sattva darśanam na hi apaśyan aham iti snihyati ātmani kaścana

na ca ātmani vinā premṇā sukha kāmaḥ abhidhāvati duḥkha utpādasya hetu tvam bandhaḥ nityasya tat kutas aduḥkha utpāda hetu tvam mokṣaḥ nityasya tat kutas anitya tvena yaḥ avācyaḥ sa hetuḥ na hi kasyacid bandha mokṣau avācye api na vidyete katham ca na nityam tam āhuḥ vidvāṃsaḥ yaḥ svabhāvaḥ na naśyati

tyaktvā imām hrepaṇīm dṛṣṭim atas nityaḥ saḥ ucyatām uktaḥ mārgaḥ tat abhyāsāt āśrayaḥ parivartate sātmye api doṣa bhāvaḥ ced mārga vat na avibhu tvataḥ viṣaya grahaṇam dharmaḥ vijñānasya yathā asti saḥ gṛhyate saḥ asya janakaḥ vidyamāna ātmanā iti ca eṣā prakṛtiḥ asyāḥ tat nimitta antarataḥ skhalat

vyāvṛttau pratyaya apekṣam adṛḍham sarpa buddhi vat prabhāsvaram idam cittam prakṛti āgantavaḥ malāḥ tad prāc api asamarthānām paścāt śaktiḥ kva tad maye na alam praroḍhum atyantam syandinyām agni vat bhuvi bādhaka utpatti sāmarthya garbhe śaktaḥ api vastuni nirupadrava bhūta artha svabhāvasya viparyayaiḥ

na bādhā yatnavat tve api buddheḥ tat pakṣapātataḥ ātma graha eka yoni tvāt kārya kāraṇa bhāvataḥ rāga pratighayoḥ bādhā bhede api na parasparam moha avirodhāt maitrī ādeḥ na atyantam doṣa nigrahaḥ tad mūlāḥ ca malāḥ sarve sa ca sat kāya darśanam vidyāyāḥ pratipakṣa tvāt caittatvena upalabdhitaḥ

mithyā upalabdhiḥ ajñāna yukteḥ ca anyat ayuktimat vyākhyeyaḥ atra virodhaḥ yaḥ tad virodhāt ca tad mayaiḥ virodhaḥ śūnyatā dṛṣṭeḥ sarva doṣaiḥ prasidhyati na akṣayaḥ prāṇi dharma tvāt rūpa ādi vat asiddhitaḥ saṃbandhe pratipakṣasya tyāga saṃsarjanāt api na kāṭhinya vat utpattiḥ punar doṣa virodhinaḥ

sa ātma tvena anapāya tvāt anekāntāt ca bhasma vat yaḥ paśyati ātmānam tatra aham iti śāśvataḥ snehaḥ snehāt sukheṣu tṛṣyati tṛṣṇā doṣām sthirī kurute guṇa darśī paritṛṣyan mama iti tat sādhanāni upādatte tena ātma abhiniveśaḥ yāvat tāvat sa saṃsāre ātmani sati para saṃjñā sva para vibhāgāt parigraha dveṣau

anayoḥ saṃpratibaddhāḥ sarve doṣāḥ prajāyante niyamena ātmani snihyan tadīye na virajyate na ca asti ātmani nirdoṣe sneha apagama kāraṇam snehaḥ sa doṣaḥ iti ced tatas kim tasya varjanam adūṣite asya viṣaye na śakyam tasya varjanam prahāṇiḥ icchā dveṣa ādeḥ guṇa doṣa anubandhinaḥ tayoḥ adṛṣṭiḥ viṣaye na tu bāhyeṣu yaḥ kramaḥ

na hi sneha guṇāt snehaḥ kim tu artha guṇa darśanāt kāraṇe avikale tasmin kāryam kena nivāryate kā vā sa doṣa tā dṛṣṭā snehe duḥkha samāśrayaḥ tathā api na virāgaḥ atra sva tva dṛṣṭeḥ yathā ātmani na taiḥ vinā duḥkha hetuḥ ātmā ced te api tādṛśāḥ nirdoṣam dvayam api evam vairāgyam na dvayoḥ tatas

duḥkha bhāvanayā āsyāt ced ahi daṣṭa aṅga hāni vat ātmīya buddhi hānya atra tyāgaḥ na tu viparyaye upabhoga āśraya tvena gṛhīteṣu indriya ādiṣu sva tvadhīḥ kena vāryeta vairāgyam tatra tat kutas pratyakṣam eva sarvasya keśa ādiṣu kalevarāt cyuteṣu sā ghṛṇā buddhiḥ jāyate anyatra sa spṛhā samavāya ādi saṃbandha janitā tatra hi svadhīḥ

saṃbandhaḥ sa tathā eva iti dṛṣṭau api na hīyate samavāya ādi abhāve api sarvatra asti upakāritā duḥkha upakārāt na bhavet aṅgulyām iva ced svadhīḥ na hi ekāntena tat duḥkham bhūyasā sa viṣān na vat viśiṣṭa sukha saṃgāt syāt tad viruddhe virāgi tā kiṃcid parityajet saukhyam viśiṣṭa sukha tṛṣṇayā

nairātmye tu yathālābham ātma snehāt pravartate alābhe mattakāśinyā dṛṣṭā tiryakṣu kāmitā yasya ātmā vallabhaḥ tasya sa nāśam katham icchati nivṛtta sarva anubhava vyavahāra guṇa āśrayam icchet prema katham premṇaḥ prakṛtiḥ na hi tādṛśī sarvathā ātma grahaḥ sneham ātmani draḍhayati alam

ātmīya sneha bījam tat tad avastham vyavasthitam yatne api ātmīya vairāgyam guṇa leśa samāśrayāt vṛttimān pratibadhnāti tat doṣān saṃvṛṇoti ca ātmani api virāgaḥ ced na idānīm yaḥ virajyate tyajati asau yathā ātmānam vyarthātas duḥkha bhāvanā duḥkha bhāvanayā api eṣa duḥkham eva vibhāvayet

pratyakṣam pūrvam api tat tathā api na virāgavān yadi api ekatra doṣeṇa tat kṣaṇam calitā matiḥ viraktau na eva tatra api kāmī iva vanitā antare tyājya upādeya bhede hi saktiḥ yā eva eka bhāvinī sā bījam sarva saktīnām paryāyeṇa samudbhave nirdoṣa viṣayaḥ snehaḥ nirdoṣaḥ sādhanāni ca etāvat eva ca jagat kva idānīm sa virajyate

sa doṣa tā api ced tatra tasya tatra ātmani api sā samā tatra aviraktaḥ tad doṣe kva idānīm sa virajyate guṇa darśana saṃbhūtam sneham bādhita doṣa dṛś sa ca indriya ādau na tu evam bāla ādeḥ api darśanāt doṣavatī api sadbhāvāt svabhāvāt guṇavatī api anyatra ātmīyatāyām vā vyatīta ādau vihānitaḥ tatas eva ca na ātmīya buddheḥ api guṇa īkṣaṇam

kāraṇam hīyate sā api tasmāt na aguṇa darśanāt api ca asat guṇa āropaḥ snehāt tatra hi dṛśyate tasmāt tat kāraṇā bādhī vidhiḥ tam bādhate katham parāpara prārthanātaḥ vināśa utpatti buddhitaḥ indriya ādeḥ pṛthak bhūtam ātmānam vetti ayam janaḥ tasmāt na ekatva dṛṣṭyā api snehaḥ snihyan saḥ ātmani

upalambha antaraṅgeṣu prakṛtyā eva anurajyate pratyutpannā tu yaḥ duḥkhāt nirvedaḥ dveṣaḥ īdṛśaḥ na vairāgyam tadā api asya snehaḥ avasthā antar eṣaṇāt dveṣasya duḥkha yoni tvāt sa tāvat mātra saṃsthitiḥ tasmin nivṛtte prakṛtim svām eva bhajate punar audāsīnyam tu sarvatra hāna upādāna hānitaḥ

vāsī candana kalpānām vairāgyam nāma kathyate saṃskāra duḥkha tām matvā kathitā duḥkha bhāvanā sā ca naḥ pratyaya utpattiḥ sā nairātmya dṛś āśrayaḥ yuktiḥ tu śūnyatā dṛṣṭeḥ tad arthāḥ śeṣa bhāvanāḥ anityāt prāha tena eva duḥkham duḥkhāt nirātmatām aviraktaḥ ca tṛṣṇāvān sarva ārambha samāśritaḥ

saḥ amuktaḥ kleśa karmabhyām saṃsārī nāma tādṛśaḥ ātmīyam eva yaḥ na icchet bhoktā api asya na vidyate ātmā api na tadā tasya kriyā bhogau hi lakṣaṇam tasmāt anādi saṃtāna tulya jātīya bījikām utkhāta mūlām kuruta sattva dṛṣṭim mumukṣavaḥ āgamasya tathā bhāva nibandhanam apaśyatām muktim āgama mātreṇa vadan na paritoṣa kṛt

na alam bīja ādi saṃsiddhaḥ vidhiḥ puṃsām ajanmane taila abhyaṅga agni dāha ādeḥ api mukti prasaṅgataḥ prāk guroḥ lāghavāt paścāt na pāpa haraṇam kṛtam mā bhūt gauravam eva asya na pāpam guru amūrtitaḥ mithyājñāna tad udbhūta tarṣa saṃcetana avaśāt hīna sthāna gatiḥ janma tena tat chit na jāyate tayoḥ eva hi sāmarthyam jātau tanmātra bhavataḥ

te cetane svayam karma iti akhaṇḍam janma kāraṇam gati pratītyoḥ kāraṇāni āśrayaḥ tāni adṛṣṭataḥ adṛṣṭa nāśāt agatiḥ tat saṃskāraḥ na cetanā sāmarthyam karaṇa utpatteḥ bhāva abhāva anuvṛttitaḥ dṛṣṭam buddheḥ na ca anyasya tāni santi na santi kim dhāraṇa preraṇa kṣobha nirodhāḥ cetanā vaśāḥ na syuḥ teṣām asāmarthye tasya dīkṣā ādi anantaram

atha buddheḥ tadā abhāvāt na syuḥ saṃdhīyate malaiḥ buddheḥ teṣām asāmarthye jīvataḥ api syuḥ akṣamāḥ nirhrāsa atiśayāt puṣṭau pratipakṣa sva pakṣayoḥ doṣāḥ sva bīja saṃtānāḥ dīkṣite api anivāritāḥ nityasya nirapekṣa tvāt krama utpattiḥ virudhyate kriyāyām akriyāyām ca kriyā ca sadṛśa ātmanaḥ

aikyam ca hetu phalayoḥ vyatireke tatas tayoḥ kartṛ bhoktṛ tva hāniḥ syāt sāmarthyam ca na sidhyati anya smaraṇa bhoga ādi prasaṅgāḥ ca na bādhakāḥ asmṛteḥ kasyacid tena hi anubhūteḥ smṛta udbhavaḥ sthiram sukham mama aham ca iti ādi satya catuṣṭaye abhūtān ṣoḍaśa ākārān āropya paritṛṣyati tatra eva tad viruddha ātma tattva ākāra anurodhinī

hanti sa anucarām tṛṣṇām samyak dṛṣṭiḥ su bhāvitā tri hetoḥ na udbhavaḥ karma dehayoḥ sthitayoḥ api eka abhāvāt vinā bījam na aṅkurasya iva janmanaḥ asaṃbhavāt vipakṣasya na hāniḥ karma dehayoḥ aśakya tvāt ca tṛṣṇāyām sthitāyām punar udbhavāt dvaya kṣaya artham yatne ca vyarthaḥ karma kṣaye śramaḥ

phala vaicitrya dṛṣṭeḥ ca śakti bhedaḥ anumīyate karmaṇām tāpa saṃkleśāt na eka rūpāt tatas kṣayaḥ phalam kathaṃcid tat janyam alpam syāt na vijātimat atha api tapasaḥ śaktyā śakti saṃkara saṃkṣayaiḥ kleśāt kutaścid dhīyeta aśeṣam akleśa leśataḥ yadi iṣṭam aparam kleśāt tat tapaḥ kleśaḥ eva ced

tat karma phalam iti asmāt na śakteḥ saṃkara ādikam utpitsu doṣa nirghāta āt ye api doṣa virodhinaḥ tad je karmaṇi śaktāḥ syuḥ kṛta hāniḥ katham bhavet doṣāḥ na karmaṇaḥ duṣṭaḥ karoti na viparyayāt mithā vikalpena vinā nābhilāṣaḥ sukhāt api tāyāt tattva sthira aśeṣa viśeṣa jñāna sādhanam bodha artha tvāt gameḥ bāhya śaikṣā śaikṣa adhikaḥ tatas para artha jñāna ghaṭanam tasmāt tat śāsanam dayā tatas para artha tantra tvam siddhārthasya avirāmataḥ dayayā śreyaḥ ācaṣṭe jñānāt satyam sa sādhanam tat ca abhiyogavān vaktum yatas tasmāt pramāṇa tā upadeśa tathā abhāva stutiḥ tat upadeśataḥ

pramāṇa tattva siddhi artham anumāne api avāraṇāt prayoga darśanāt vā asya yat kiṃcid udaya ātmakam nirodha dharmakam sarvam tat iti ādau anekadhā anumāna āśrayaḥ liṅgam avinābhāva lakṣaṇam vyāpti pradarśanāt dhetoḥ sādhyena uktam ca tat sphuṭam

mānam dvividham viṣaya dvaividhyāt śakti aśaktitaḥ artha kriyāyām keśa ādiḥ na arthaḥ anartha adhimokṣataḥ sadṛśa asadṛśa tvāt ca viṣaya aviṣaya tvataḥ śabdasya anya nimittānām bhāve dhīsat asattvataḥ
artha kriyā samartham yat tat atra paramārtha sat anyat saṃvṛtisat proktam te sva sāmānya lakṣaṇe

aśaktam sarvam iti ced bīja ādeḥ aṅkura ādiṣu dṛṣṭā śaktiḥ matā sā ced saṃvṛtyāḥ tu yathā tathā sā asti sarvatra ced buddheḥ na anvaya vyatirekayoḥ sāmānya lakṣaṇe adṛṣṭeḥ cakṣu ūrūpādi buddhi vat etena samaya ābhoga ādi antaraṅga anurodhataḥ ghaṭa utkṣepaṇa sāmānya saṃkhyā ādiṣu dhiyaḥ gatāḥ keśa ādayaḥ na sāmānyam anartha abhiniveśataḥ

jñeya tvena grahāt doṣaḥ na abhāveṣu prasajyate teṣām api tathā abhāve apratiṣedhāt sphuṭa ābhatā jñāna rūpa tayā artha tvāt keśa ādi iti matiḥ punar sāmānya viṣayā keśa pratibhāsam anarthakam jñāna rūpa tayā artha tve sāmānye ced prasajyate tathā iṣṭa tvāt adoṣaḥ artha rūpa tvena samāna tā sarvatra sama rūpa tvāt tad vyāvṛtti samāśrayāt

tat avastu abhidheya tvāt sāphalyāt akṣa saṃhateḥ nāma ādi vacane vaktṛ śrotṛ vācya anubandhini asaṃbandhini nāma ādau arthe syāt apravartanam sārūpyāt bhrāntitaḥ vṛttiḥ arthe ced syāt na sarvadā deśa bhrāntiḥ ca na jñāne tulyam utpattitaḥ dhiyaḥ tathāvidhāyāḥ anyatra tat na anupagamāt dhiyaḥ

bāhya artha pratibhāsāyāḥ upāye vā apramāṇa tā vijñāna vyatiriktasya vyatireka aprasiddhitaḥ sarva jñāna arthavat tvāt ced svapna ādau anyathā īkṣaṇāt ayuktam na ca saṃskārān nīla ādi pratibhāsataḥ nīla ādi apratighātāt na jñānam tat yogya deśakaiḥ ajñātasya svayam jñānāt nāma ādi etena varṇitam sā eva iṣṭā arthavatī kena cakṣuḥ ādi matiḥ matā artha sāmarthya dṛṣṭeḥ ced anyat prāptam anarthakam apravṛttiḥ asaṃbandhe api artha saṃbandha vat yadi atīta anāgatam vācyam na syāt arthena tad kṣayāt

sāmānya grahaṇāt śabdāt aprasaṅgaḥ mataḥ yadi tat na kevala sāmānya agrahaṇāt grahaṇe api vā atad samāna tā vyaktī tena nitya upalambhanam nitya tvāt ca yadi vyaktiḥ vyakteḥ pratyakṣatām prati ātmani jñāna janane yat śaktam śaktam eva tat atha aśaktam kadācid ced aśaktam sarvadā eva tat

tasya śaktiḥ aśaktiḥ vā yā svabhāvena saṃsthitā nitya tvāt acikitsyasya kaḥ tām kṣapayitum kṣamaḥ tat ca sāmānya vijñānam anurundhan vibhāvyate nīla ādi ākāra leśaḥ yaḥ sa tasmin kena nirmitaḥ pratyakṣa pratyaya artha tvāt na akṣāṇām vyarthatā iti ced sā eva eka rūpāt śabda ādeḥ bhinna ābhāsā matiḥ kutas

na jātiḥ jātimat vyakti rūpam yena apara āśrayam siddham pṛthak ced kārya tvam hi apekṣā iti abhidhīyate niṣpatteḥ apara adhīnam api kāryam sva hetutaḥ saṃbadhyate kalpanayā kim akāryam kathaṃcana anya tve tat asaṃbaddham siddhātaḥ niḥsvabhāva tā jāti prasaṅgaḥ abhāvasya na apekṣā bhāvataḥ tayoḥ

tasmāt arūpā rūpāṇām āśrayeṇa upakalpitā tad viśeṣa avagāha arthaiḥ jātiḥ śabdaiḥ prakāśyate tasyām rūpa avabhāsaḥ yaḥ tattvena arthasya vā grahaḥ bhrāntiḥ sānādika ālīna darśana abhyāsa nirmitā arthānām yat ca sāmānyam anya vyāvṛtti lakṣaṇam yad niṣṭhāḥ te ime śabdāḥ na rūpam tasya kiṃcana sāmānya buddhau sāmānyena arūpāyām api īkṣaṇāt

artha bhrāntiḥ apīṣyeta sāmānyam sā api abhiplavāt artha rūpa tayā tattvena abhāvāt ca na rūpiṇī niḥsvabhāva tayā avācyam kutaścid vacanāt matam yadi vastu na vastūnām avācya tvam kathaṃcana na eva vācyam upādāna bhedāt bheda upacārataḥ atīta anāgate api arthe sāmānya vinibandhanāḥ śrutayaḥ niviśante sat asat dharmaḥ katham bhavet

upacārāt tat iṣṭam ced vartamāna ghaṭasya kā pratyāsattiḥ abhāvena yā paṭa ādau na vidyate buddheḥ askhalitā vṛttiḥ mukhya āropitayoḥ sadā siṃhe māṇavake ca iti ghoṣaṇā api asti laukikī yatra rūḍhyā sadarthaḥ api janaiḥ śabdaḥ niveśitaḥ sa mukhyaḥ tatra tad sāmyāt gauṇaḥ anyatra skhalat gatiḥ

yathā bhāve api abhāva ākhyām yathākalpanam eva vā kuryāt aśakte śakte vā pradhāna ādi śrutim janaḥ śabdebhyaḥ yādṛśī buddhiḥ naṣṭe anaṣṭe api dṛśyate tādṛśī eva sat arthānām na etat śrotra ādi cetasām sāmānya mātra grahaṇāt sāmānyam cetasoḥ dvayoḥ tasya api kevalasya prāk grahaṇam vinivāritam

paraspara viśiṣṭānām aviśiṣṭam katham bhavet rūpam dvi rūpa tāyām vā tat vastu ekam katham bhavet tābhyām tat anyat eva syāt yadi rūpam samam tayoḥ tayoḥ iti na saṃbandhaḥ vyāvṛttiḥ tu na duṣyate tasmāt samāna tā eva asmin sāmānye avastu lakṣaṇam kāryam ced tat anekam syāt naśvaram ca na tat matam

vastu mātra anubandhi tvāt vināśasya na nityatā asaṃbandhaḥ ca jātīnām akārya tvāt arūpatā yat ca vastu balāt jñānam jāyate tat apekṣate na saṃketam na sāmānya buddhiṣu etat vibhāvyate yā api abheda anugā buddhiḥ kācid vastu dvaya īkṣaṇe saṃketena vinā sārtha pratyāsatti nibandhanā pratyāsattiḥ vinā jātyā yatheṣṭā cakṣuḥ ādiṣu

jñāna kāryeṣu jātiḥ vā yayā anvā iti vibhāgataḥ kathaṃcid api vijñāne tad rūpa anava bhāsataḥ yadi nāma indriyāṇām syāt draṣṭā bhāseta tad vapuḥ rūpavat tvāt na jātīnām kevalānām adarśanāt vyakti grahe ca tad śabda rūpāt anyat na dṛśyate jñāna mātra artha karaṇe api ayogyam atas eva tat tat ayogya tayā rūpam tat dhi avastuṣu lakṣaṇam

yathā ukta viparītam yat tat sva lakṣaṇam iṣyate sāmānyam trividham tat ca bhāva abhāva ubhayāśrayāt yadi bhāva āśrayam jñānam bhāve bhāva anubandhataḥ na ukta uttara tvāt dṛṣṭa tvāt atīta ādiṣu ca anyathā bhāva dharma tva hāniḥ ced bhāva grahaṇa pūrvakam tat jñānam iti adoṣaḥ ayam meyam tu ekam sva lakṣaṇam

tasmāt artha kriyā siddheḥ sat asat tā vicāraṇāt tasya sva para rūpābhyām gateḥ meya dvayam matam ayathā abhiniveśena dvitīyā bhrāntiḥ iṣyate gatiḥ ced para rūpeṇa na ca bhrānteḥ pramāṇa tā abhiprāya avi saṃvādāt api bhrānteḥ pramāṇa tā gatiḥ api anyathā dṛṣṭā pakṣaḥ ca ayam kṛta uttaraḥ maṇi pradīpa prabhayoḥ maṇi buddhyā abhidhāvataḥ

mithyājñāna aviśeṣe api viśeṣaḥ artha kriyām prati yathā tathā yathārtha tve api anumāna tad ābhayoḥ artha kriyā anurodhena pramāṇa tvam vyavasthitam buddhiḥ yatra artha sāmarthyāt anvaya vyatirekiṇī tasya svatantram grahaṇam atas anyat vastu atīndriyam tasya adṛṣṭa ātma rūpasya gateḥ anyaḥ arthaḥ āśrayaḥ

tad āśrayeṇa saṃbandhī yadi syāt gamakaḥ tadā gamaka anuga sāmānya rūpeṇa eva tadā gatiḥ tasmāt sarvaḥ parokṣaḥ arthaḥ viśeṣeṇa na gamyate yā ca saṃbandhinaḥ dharmāt gatiḥ dharmiṇi jāyate sa anumānam parokṣāṇām ekāntena eva sādhanam na pratyakṣa parokṣābhyām meyasya anyasya saṃbhavaḥ tasmāt prameya dvi tvena pramāṇa dvi tvam iṣyate

tri eka saṃkhyā nirāsaḥ vā prameya dvaya darśanāt ekam eva aprameya tvāt asataḥ ced matam ca naḥ anekāntaḥ aprameya tve hi abhāvasya api niścayāt tad niścaya pramāṇam vā dvitīyam na akṣajā matiḥ abhāve artha balāt jāteḥ artha śakti anapekṣaṇe vyavadhāna ādi bhāve api jāyeta indriya jā matiḥ abhāve vinivṛtteḥ ced pratyakṣasya eva niścayaḥ

viruddham sā eva vā liṅgam anvaya vyatirekiṇī siddham ca para caitanya pratipatteḥ pramā dvayam vyāhāra ādau pravṛtteḥ ca siddhaḥ tad bhāva niścayaḥ pramāṇam avisaṃvādāt tat kvacid vyabhicārataḥ na āśvāsaḥ iti ced liṅgam durdṛṣṭeḥ etat īdṛśam yatas kadācid siddhā asya pratītiḥ vastunaḥ kvacid

tat avaśyam tatas jātam tad svabhāvaḥ api vā bhavet sva nimittāt svabhāvāt vā vinā na arthasya saṃbhavaḥ yat ca rūpam tayoḥ dṛṣṭam tat eva anyatra lakṣaṇam svabhāve sva nimitte vā dṛśye darśana hetuṣu anyeṣu satsu adṛśye ca sattā vā tadvataḥ katham aprāmāṇye ca sāmānya buddheḥ tad lopaḥ āgataḥ

pretyabhāva vat akṣaiḥ ced paryāyeṇa pratīyate tat ca na indriya śakti ādau akṣa buddheḥ asaṃbhavāt abhāva pratipattau syāt buddheḥ janma animittikam sva lakṣaṇe ca pratyakṣam avikalpa tayā vinā vikalpena na sāmānya grahaḥ tasmin tatas anumā prameya niyame varṇa anitya tā na pratīyate pramāṇam anyat tad buddhiḥ vinā liṅgena saṃbhavāt

viśeṣa dṛṣṭe liṅgasya saṃbandhasya aprasiddhitaḥ tat pramāṇa antaram meya bahu tvāt bahu tā api vā pramāṇānām anekasya vṛtteḥ ekatra vā yathā viśeṣa dṛṣṭeḥ eka tri saṃkhyā apohaḥ na vā bhavet viṣaya aniyamāt anya prameyasya ca saṃbhavāt yojanāt varṇa sāmānye na ayam doṣaḥ prasajyate na avastu rūpam tasya eva tathā asiddhe prasādhanāt

anyatra na anya siddhiḥ ced na tasya eva prasiddhitaḥ yaḥ hi bhāvaḥ yathābhūtaḥ sa tādṛś liṅga cetasaḥ hetuḥ tad jā tathābhūte tasmāt vastuni liṅgi dhīḥ liṅga liṅgi dhiyoḥ evam pāraṃparyeṇa vastuni pratibandhāt tad ābhāsa śūnyayoḥ api avañcanam tad rūpa adhyavasāyāt ca tayoḥ tad rūpa śūnyayoḥ tad rūpā vañcaka tve api kṛtā bhrānti vyavasthitiḥ tasmāt vastuni boddhavye vyāpakam vyāpya cetasaḥ nimittam tat svabhāvaḥ vā kāraṇam tat ca tat dhiyaḥ

pratiṣedhaḥ tu sarvatra sādhyate anupalambhataḥ siddhim pramāṇaiḥ vadatām arthāt eva viparyayāt dṛṣṭā viruddha dharma uktiḥ tasya tad kāraṇasya vā niṣedhe yā api tasya eva sa apramāṇa tva sūcanā anyathā ekasya dharmasya svabhāva uktyā parasya tat nāstitvam kena gamyeta virodhāt ced asau api

siddhaḥ kena asaha sthānāt iti ced tat kutas matam dṛśyasya darśana abhāvāt iti ced sāpramāṇa tā tasmāt sva śabdena uktā api sābhāvasya prasādhikā yasya apramāṇam sa avācyaḥ niṣedhaḥ tena sarvathā etena tad viruddha artha kārya uktiḥ upavarṇitā prayogaḥ kevalam bhinnaḥ sarvatra arthaḥ na bhidyate viruddham tat ca sa upāyam avidhāya apidhāya ca

pramāṇa uktiḥ niṣedhe yā na sā nyāya anusāriṇī ukti ādeḥ sarva vid pretya bhāva ādi pratiṣedha vat atīndriyāṇām arthānām virodhasya aprasiddhitaḥ bādhya bādhaka bhāvaḥ kaḥ syātām yadi ukti saṃvidau tādṛśaḥ anupalabdheḥ ced ucyatām sā eva sādhanam aniścaya karam proktam īdṛkṣā anupalambhanam tat na atyanta parokṣeṣu sat asat tā viniścayau

bhinnaḥ abhinnaḥ api vā dharmaḥ sa viruddhaḥ prayujyate yathā agniḥ ahime sādhye sattā vā janma bādhanī yathā vastu eva vastūnām sādhane sādhanam matam tathā vastu eva vastūnām sva nivṛttau nivartakam etena kalpanā nyastaḥ yatra kvacana saṃbhavāt dharmaḥ pakṣa sapakṣa anyatara tva ādiḥ apoditaḥ

tatra api vyāpakaḥ dharmaḥ nivṛtteḥ gamakaḥ mataḥ vyāpyasya sva nivṛttiḥ ced paricchinnā kathaṃcana yat apramāṇa tā bhāve liṅgam tasya eva kathyate tat atyanta vimūḍha artham āgopālam asaṃvṛteḥ etāvat niścaya phalam abhāve anupalambhanam tat ca hetau svabhāve vādṛśye dṛśya tayā mate anumānāt anitya ādeḥ grahaṇe ayam kramaḥ mataḥ

prāmāṇyam eva na anyatra gṛhīta grahaṇāt matam na anyāsya anitya tā bhāvāt pūrva siddhaḥ sa ca aindriyāt na aneka rūpaḥ vācyaḥ asau vācyaḥ dharmaḥ vikalpa jaḥ sāmānya āśraya saṃsiddhau sāmānyam siddham eva tat tad asiddhau tathā asya eva hi anumānam prasiddhaye kvacid tat aparijñānam sadṛśa apara saṃbhavāt

bhrānteḥ apaśyataḥ bhedam māyā golaka bheda vat tathā hi aliṅgam ābālam asaṃśliṣṭa uttara udayam paśyan paricchinatti eva dīpa ādi nāśinam janaḥ bhāva svabhāva bhūtāyām api śaktau phale adṛśaḥ anānantaryatas mohaḥ viniścetuḥ apāṭavāt tasya eva vinivṛtti artham anumāna upavarṇanam vyavasyanti īkṣaṇāt eva sarva ākārān mahā dhiyaḥ

vyāvṛtteḥ sarvatas tasmin vyāvṛtti vinibandhanāḥ buddhayaḥ arthe pravartante abhinne bhinna āśrayāḥ iva yathā codanam ākhyāḥ ca saḥ asati bhrānti kāraṇe pratibhāḥ pratisaṃdhatte sva anurūpāḥ svabhāvataḥ siddhaḥ atra api athavā dhvaṃsaḥ liṅgāt anupalambhanāt prāk bhūtvā hi abhavan bhāvaḥ anityaḥ iti abhidhīyate

yasya ubhayānta vyavadhi sattā saṃbandha vācinī anitya tā śrutiḥ tena tau antau iti kau smṛtau prāk paścāt api abhāvaḥ ced saḥ eva anitya tā na kim ṣaṣṭhī ādyayogāt iti ced antayoḥ sa katham bhavet sattā saṃbandhayoḥ dhrauvyāt antābhyām na viśeṣaṇam aviśeṣaṇam eva syāt antau ced kārya kāraṇe

asaṃbandhāt na bhāvasya prāgabhāvam sa vāñchati tad upādhi samākhyāne te api asya ca na sidhyataḥ sattāsu akāraṇa āśleṣa karaṇāt kāraṇam kila sā sattā sa ca saṃbandhaḥ nityau kāryam atha iha kim yasya abhāvaḥ kriyeta asau na bhāvaḥ prāgabhāvavān saṃbandha anabhyupagamāt nityam viśvam idam tatas

tasmāt anarthāskandinyaḥ abhinna artha abhimateṣu api śabdeṣu vācya bhedinyaḥ vyatireka āspadam dhiyaḥ viśeṣa pratyabhijñānam na pratikṣaṇa bhedataḥ na vā viśeṣa viṣayam dṛṣṭa sāmyena tad grahāt nidarśanam tat eva iti sāmānya agrahaṇam yadi nidarśana tvāt siddhasya pramāṇena asya kim punar vismṛta tvāt adoṣaḥ ced tatas eva anidarśanam dṛṣṭe tad bhāva siddhiḥ ced pramāṇāt anya vastuni tattva ārope viparyāsaḥ tad siddheḥ apramāṇa tā pratyakṣa itarayoḥ aikyāt eka siddhiḥ dvayoḥ api saṃdhīyamānam ca anyena vyavasāyam smṛtim viduḥ tad cihna apekṣaṇāt no ced smṛtiḥ na vyabhicārataḥ

pratyakṣam kalpanā apoḍham pratyakṣeṇa eva sidhyati pratyātma vedyaḥ sarveṣām vikalpaḥ nāma saṃśrayaḥ saṃhṛtya sarvatas cintām stimitena antarātmanā sthitaḥ api cakṣuṣā rūpam īkṣate sākṣa jā matiḥ punar vikalpayan kiṃcid āsīt me kalpanā īdṛśī iti vetti na pūrva ukta avasthāyām indriyāt gatau

ekatra dṛṣṭaḥ bhedaḥ hi kvacid na anyatra dṛśyate na tasmāt bhinnam asti anyat sāmānyam buddhi abhedataḥ tasmāt viśeṣa viṣayā sarvā eva indriya jā matiḥ na viśeṣeṣu śabdānām pravṛttau asti saṃbhavaḥ ananvayāt viśeṣāṇām saṃketasya apravṛttitaḥ viṣayaḥ yaḥ ca śabdānām saṃyojyeta saḥ eva taiḥ

asya idam iti saṃbandhe yau arthau pratibhāsinau tayoḥ eva hi saṃbandhaḥ na tadā indriya gocaraḥ viśada pratibhāsasya tadā arthasya avibhāvanāt vijñāna ābhāsa bhedaḥ hi padārthānām viśeṣakaḥ cakṣuṣaḥ artha avabhāse api yam paraḥ asya iti śaṃsati saḥ eva yojyate śabdaiḥ na khalu indriya gocaraḥ avyāpṛta indriyasya anya vāc mātreṇa avibhāvanāt

na ca anudita saṃbandhaḥ svayam jñāna prasaṅgataḥ manasoḥ yugapad vṛtteḥ sa vikalpa avikalpayoḥ vimūḍhaḥ laghu vṛtteḥ vā tayoḥ aikyam vyavasyati vikalpa vyavadhānena vicchinnam darśanam bhavet iti ced bhinna jātīya vikalpe anyasya vā katham alāta dṛṣṭi vat bhāva pakṣaḥ ced balavān mataḥ anyatra api samānam tat varṇayoḥ vā sakṛt śrutiḥ

sakṛt saṃgata sarva artheṣu indriyeṣu iha satsu api pañcabhiḥ vyavadhāne api bhāti avyavahitā iva yā sā matiḥ nāma paryanta kṣaṇika jñāna miśraṇāt vicchinnā abha iti tat citram tasmāt santu sakṛt dhiyaḥ pratibhāsā viśeṣaḥ ca sāntara anantare katham śuddhe manaḥ vikalpe ca na krama grahaṇam bhavet

yaḥ agrahaḥ saṃgate api arthe kvacid āsakta cetasaḥ saktyā anya utpatti vaiguṇyāt codyam ca etat dvayoḥ api śīghra vṛtteḥ alāta ādeḥ anvaya pratighātinī cakra bhrāntim dṛśā dhatte na dṛśām ghaṭanena sā kecid indriya ja tu ā ādeḥ bāladhī vat akalpanām āhuḥ bāla avikalpe ca hetum saṃketa manda tām teṣām pratyakṣam eva syāt bālānām avikalpanāt saṃketa upāya vigamāt paścāt api bhavet na saḥ manaḥ avyutpanna saṃketam asti tena sa ced mataḥ evam indriya je api syāt śeṣavat ca idam īdṛśam yat eva sādhanam bāle tat eva atra api kathyatām sāmyāt akṣa dhiyām uktam anena anubhava ādikam

viśeṣaṇam viśeṣyam ca saṃbandham laukikīm sthitim gṛhītvā saṃkalayya etat tathā pratyeti na anyathā yathā daṇḍini jāti ādeḥ vivekena anirūpaṇāt tadvatā yojanā na asti kalpanā api atra na asti atas yadi api anvayi vijñānam śabda vyakti avabhāsi tat varṇa ākṛti akṣara ākāra śūnyam go tvam hi varṇyate

samāna tve api tasya eva na īkṣaṇam netra gocaram pratibhāsa dvaya abhāvāt buddheḥ bhedaḥ ca durlabhaḥ samavāya agrahāt akṣaiḥ saṃbandha adarśanam sthitam paṭaḥ tantuṣu iha ityādi śabdāḥ ca ime svayam kṛtāḥ śṛṅgam gavīti loke syāt śṛṅge gauḥ iti alaukikam gavā ākhya pariśiṣṭa aṅga viccheda anupalambhanāt

taiḥ tantubhiḥ iyam śāṭī iti uttaram kāryam ucyate tantu saṃskāra saṃbhūtam na eka kālam kathaṃcana kāraṇa āropataḥ kaścid ekāpa uddhārataḥ api vā tantu ākhyām vartayet kārye darśayan āśrayam śruteḥ upakārya upakāri tvam viccheda at ṛṣṭiḥ eva vā mukhyam yat askhalat jñānam ādi saṃketa gocaraḥ

anumānam ca jāti ādau vastunaḥ na asti bhedini sarvatra vyapadeśaḥ hi daṇḍya ādeḥ api sāṃvṛtāt vastu prāsāda mālā ādi śabdāḥ ca anya anapekṣiṇaḥ gehaḥ yadi api saṃyogaḥ tad mālā kim nu tat bhavet jātiḥ ced gehaḥ ekaḥ api mālā iti ucyeta vṛkṣa vat mālā bahutve tad śabdaḥ katham jāteḥ ajātitaḥ mālā ādau ca mahat tva ādiḥ iṣṭaḥ yaḥ ca aupacārikaḥ

mukhyā viśiṣṭa vijñāna grāhya tvāt na aupacārikaḥ ananya hetu tā tulyā sā mukhya abhimateṣu api padārtha śabdaḥ kam hetum anyam ṣaṭsu samīkṣate yaḥ yathā rūḍhitaḥ siddhaḥ tad sāmyāt yaḥ tathā ucyate mukhyaḥ gauṇaḥ ca bhāveṣu api abhāvasya upacārataḥ saṃketa anvayinī rūḍhiḥ vaktuḥ icchā anvayī ca saḥ

kriyate vyavahāra artham chandaḥ śabda aṃśa nāma vat vastu dharma tayā eva arthāḥ tādṛś vijñāna kāraṇam bhede api yatra tat jñānam tān tathā pratipadyate jñānāni api tathā bhede abheda pratyavamarśane iti atad kārya viśleṣasya anvayaḥ na eka vastunaḥ vastūnām vidyate tasmāt tad niṣṭhā vastuni śrutiḥ bāhya śakti vyavaccheda niṣṭhā abhāve api tad śrutiḥ

vikalpa pratibimbeṣu tad niṣṭheṣu nibadhyate tatas anya apoha niṣṭha tvāt uktā anya apoha kṛt śrutiḥ vyatirekī iva yat jñāne bhāti artha pratibimbakam śabdāt tat api na artha ātmā bhrāntiḥ sā vāsanodbhavā tasya abhidhāne śrutibhiḥ arthe kaḥ aṃśaḥ avagamyate tasya āgatau ca saṃketa kriyā vyarthā tad arthikā

śabdaḥ artha aṃśam kam āha iti tatra anya apohaḥ ucyate ākāraḥ sa ca na arthe asti tam vadan artha bhāj katham śabdasya anvayinaḥ kāryam arthena anvayinā sa ca ananvayī dhiyaḥ abhedāt darśana abhyāsa nirmitaḥ tad rūpāra upagatyāni avyāvṛtta adhigateḥ punar śabda arthaḥ arthaḥ saḥ eva iti vacane na virudhyate

mithyā ava bhāsinaḥ vā ete pratyayāḥ śabda nirmitāḥ anuyānti imam artha aṃśam iti ca apoha kṛt śrutiḥ tasmāt saṃketa kāle api nirdiṣṭa arthena saṃyutaḥ sva pratīti phalena anya apohaḥ saṃbadhyate śrutau anyatra adṛṣṭi apekṣa tvāt kvacid tad dṛṣṭi apekṣaṇāt śrutau saṃbadhyate apohaḥ na etat vastuni yujyate tasmāt jāti ādi tad yogāḥ na arthe teṣu ca na śrutiḥ saṃyojyate anya vyāvṛttau śabdānām eva yojanāt

saṃketa smaraṇa upāyam dṛṣṭa saṃkalana ātmakam pūrva apara parāmarśa śūnye tat cākṣuṣe katham anyatra gata cittaḥ api cakṣuṣā rūpam īkṣate tad saṃketā grahaḥ tatra spaṣṭaḥ tad jā ca kalpanā jāyante kalpanāḥ tatra yatra śabdaḥ niveśitaḥ tena icchātaḥ pravarteran na īkṣeran bāhyam akṣa jāḥ rūpam rūpam iti īkṣeta tat hiyam kim iti īkṣate

asti ca anubhavaḥ tasyāḥ saḥ avikalpaḥ katham bhavet tasya eva anubhave dṛṣṭam na vikalpa dvayam sakṛt etena tulya kāla ani avijñāna anubhavaḥ gataḥ smṛtiḥ bhavet atīte ca sāgṛhīte katham bhavet syāt ca anya dhī pari cheda abhinna rūpā sva buddhi dhīḥ atītam apadṛṣṭāntam aliṅgam ca artha vedanam siddham tat kena tasmin hi na pratyakṣam na laiṅgikam

tad svarūpa avabhāsinyā buddhyā anantarayā yadi rūpa ādiḥ iva gṛhyeta na syāt tad pūrvadhī grahaḥ saḥ avikalpaḥ sva viṣayaḥ vijñāna anubhavaḥ yathā aśakya samayam tadvat anyat api avikalpakam sāmānya vācinaḥ śabdāḥ tad eka arthā ca kalpanā abhāve nirvikalpasya viśeṣa adhigamaḥ katham asti ced nirvikalpam ca kiṃcid tad tulya hetukam

sarvam tathā eva hetoḥ hi bhedāt bhedaḥ phala ātmanām anapekṣita bāhya arthāḥ yojanā samaya smṛteḥ tathā anapekṣya samayam vastu śaktyā eva netra dhīḥ saṃketa smaraṇa apekṣam rūpam yadi akṣa cetasi anapekṣya na ced śaktam syāt smṛtau eva liṅga vat tasyāḥ tad saṃgama utpatteḥ akṣadhīḥ syāt smṛteḥ na vā

tatas kāla antare api syāt kvacid vyākṣepa saṃbhavāt krameṇa ubhaya hetuḥ ced prāk eva syāt abhedataḥ anyaḥ akṣa buddhi hetuḥ ced smṛtiḥ tatra api anarthikā yathā samita siddhi artham iṣyate samaya smṛtiḥ bhedaḥ ca asamitaḥ grāhyaḥ smṛtiḥ tatra kim arthikā sāmānya mātra grahaṇe bheda apekṣā na yujyate tasmāt cakṣuḥ ca rūpam ca pratītya udeti netra dhīḥ sākṣāt ced jñāna janane samarthaḥ viṣayaḥ akṣavat atha kasmāt dvaya adhīna janma tat tena na ucyate

samīkṣya gamaka tvam hi vyapadeśaḥ niyujyate tat ca akṣa vyapadeśe asti tad dharmaḥ ca niyojyatām tatas liṅga svabhāvaḥ atra vyapadeśe niyojyatām nivartate vyāpakasya svabhāvasya nivṛttitaḥ saṃcitaḥ samudāyaḥ sa sāmānyam tatra ca akṣadhīḥ sāmānya buddhiḥ ca avaśyam vikalpena anubadhyate artha antara abhisaṃbandhāt jāyante ye aṇavaḥ apare

uktāḥ te saṃcitāḥ te hi nimittam jñāna janmanaḥ aṇūnām sa viśeṣaḥ ca na antareṇa aparān aṇūn tat eka aniyamāt jñānam uktam sāmānya gocaram atha eka āyatana tve api na anekam gṛhyate sakṛt sakṛt graha avabhāsaḥ kim viyukteṣu tila ādiṣu pratyuktam lāghavam ca atra teṣu eva krama pātiṣu kim na ākrama grahaḥ tulya kālāḥ sarvāḥ ca buddhayaḥ

kāścid tāsu akrama ābhāsāḥ kramavatyaḥ aparāḥ ca kim sarva artha grahaṇe tasmāt akramaḥ ayam prasajyate na ekam citra pataṃga ādi rūpam vā dṛśyate katham citram tat ekam iti ced idam citrataram tatas na ekam svabhāvam citram hi maṇi rūpam yathā eva tat nīla ādi pravibhāgaḥ ca tulyaḥ citra paṭa ādiṣu

tatra avayava rūpam ced kevalam dṛśyate tathā nīla ādīni nirasya anyat citram citram yat īkṣase tulya artha ākāra kāla tvena upalakṣitayoḥ dhiyoḥ nānā arthā kramavatī ekā kim eka artha akrama aparā vaiśvarūpyāt dhiyām eva bhāvānām viśva rūpa tā tat ced anaṅgam kena iyam siddhā bheda vyavasthitiḥ vijātīnām anārambhāt na alekhya ādau vicitra dhīḥ

arūpa tvāt na saṃyogaḥ citraḥ bhakteḥ ca na āśrayaḥ pratyekam avicitra tvāt gṛhīteṣu krameṇa ca na citra dhī saṃkalanam anekasya ekayā grahāt nānā artha ekā bhavet tasmāt siddhātaḥ api avikalpikā vikalpayan api eka artham yatas anyat api paśyati citra avabhāseṣu artheṣu yadi eka tvam na yujyate
