sā eva tāvat katham buddhiḥ ekā citra avabhāsinī idam vastu bala āyātam yat vadanti vipaścitaḥ yathā yathārthāḥ cintyante viśīryante tathā tathā kim syāt sā citra tā ekasyām na syāt tasyām matau api yadi idam svayam arthānām rocate tatra ke vayam tasmāt na artheṣu na jñāne sthūla ābhāsaḥ tad ātmanaḥ

ekatra pratiṣiddha tvāt bahuṣu api na saṃbhavaḥ paricchedaḥ antar anyaḥ ayam bhāgaḥ bahis iva sthitaḥ jñānasya abhedinaḥ bheda pratibhāsaḥ hi upaplavaḥ tatra ekasya api abhāvena dvayam api avahīyate tasmāt tat eva tasya api tattvam yā dvaya śūnyatā tat bheda āśrayiṇī ca iyam bhāvānām bheda saṃsthitiḥ

tad upaplava bhāve ca teṣām bhedaḥ api upaplavaḥ na grāhya grāhaka ākāra bāhyam asti ca lakṣaṇam atas lakṣaṇa śūnyatvāt niḥsvabhāvāḥ prakāśitāḥ vyāpāra upādhikam sarvam skandha ādīnām viśeṣataḥ lakṣaṇam sa ca tattvam na tena api ete vilakṣaṇāḥ yathā svaṃpratyaya apekṣāt avidyā upapluta ātmanām vijñaptiḥ vitatha ākārā jāyate timira ādi vat

asaṃvidita tattvā ca sā sarva apara darśanaiḥ asaṃbhavāt vinā teṣām grāhya grāhaka viplavaiḥ tad upekṣita tattva arthaiḥ kṛtvā gaja nimīlanam kevalam loka buddhyā eva bāhya cintā pratanyate nīla ādiḥ citra vijñāne jñāna upādhiḥ ananya bhāj aśakya darśanaḥ tam hi patati arthe vivecayan yat yathā bhāsate jñānam tat tathā eva anubhūyate

iti nāma eka bhāvaḥ syāt citra ākārasya cetasi paṭa ādi rūpasya ekatve tathā syāt aviveki tā vivekīni nirasya anyadā aviveki ca na īkṣyate kaḥ vā virodhaḥ bahavaḥ saṃjāta atiśayāḥ sakṛt bhaveyuḥ kāraṇam buddheḥ yadi nāma indriya ādi vat hetu bhāvāt ṛte na anyā grāhyatā nāma kācana tatra buddhiḥ yad ākārā tasyāḥ tat grāhyam ucyate

katham vā avayavī grāhyaḥ sakṛt sva avayavaiḥ saha na hi go pratyayaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ sāsna ādīnām adarśane guṇa pradhāna adhigamaḥ saha api abhimataḥ yadi saṃpūrṇa aṅgaḥ na gṛhyeta sakṛt na api guṇa ādimān vivakṣā paratantra tvāt viśeṣaṇa viśeṣyayoḥ yat aṅga bhāvena upāttam tat tena eva hi gṛhyate svatas vastu antarā bhedāt guṇa ādeḥ bhedakasya ca

agrahāt eka buddhiḥ syāt paśyataḥ api para aparam guṇa ādi bheda grahaṇāt nānā tva pratipad yadi astu nāma tathā api eṣām bhavet saṃbandhi saṃkaraḥ śabda ādīnām aneka tvāt siddhaḥ aneka grahaḥ sakṛt saṃniveśa graha ayogāt agrahe saṃniveśinām sarvatas vinivṛttasya vinivṛttiḥ yatas yatas tad bheda unnīta bhedā sā dharmiṇaḥ aneka rūpa tā

te kalpitāḥ rūpa bhedāḥ nirvikalpasya cetasaḥ na vicitrasya citra ābhāḥ kādācid kasya gocaraḥ yadi api asti sita tva ādi yādṛś indriya gocaraḥ na saḥ abhidhīyate śabdaiḥ jñānayoḥ rūpa bhedataḥ eka artha tve api buddhīnām nānā āśrayatayā sa ced śrotra ādi cittāni idānīm bhinna arthāni iti tat kutas jātaḥ nāma āśrayaḥ anyonyaḥ cetasām tasya vastunaḥ

ekasya eva kutas rūpam bhinna ākāra avabhāsi tat vṛtteḥ dṛśya aparāmarśena abhidhāna vikalpayoḥ darśanāt pratyabhijñānam gavā ādīnām nivāritam anvayāt ca anumānam yat abhidhāna vikalpayoḥ dṛśye gavā ādau jāti ādeḥ tat api etena dūṣitam darśanāni eva bhinnāni api ekām kurvanti kalpanām pratyabhijñāna saṃkhyātām svabhāvena iti varṇitam

pūrva anubhūta grahaṇe mānasasya apramāṇa tā adṛṣṭa grahaṇe andha ādeḥ api syāt artha darśanam kṣaṇika tvāt atītasya darśane ca na saṃbhavaḥ vācyam akṣaṇika tve syāt lakṣaṇam sa viśeṣaṇam niṣpādita kriye kaṃcid viśeṣam asamādadhat karmaṇi aindriyam anyat vā sādhanam kim iti iṣyate sakṛt bhāvaḥ ca sarvāsām dhiyām tad bhāva janmanām

anyaiḥ akārya bhedasya tad apekṣā virodhataḥ tasmāt indriya vijñāna anantara pratyaya udbhavam manaḥ anyam eva gṛhṇāti viṣayam na andhadṛś tatas sva artha anvaya artha apekṣā eva hetuḥ indriya jā matiḥ tatas anya grahaṇe api asya niyata grāhya tā matā tad atulya kriyā kālaḥ katham sva jñāna kālikaḥ sahakāri bhavet arthaḥ iti ced akṣa cetasaḥ

asataḥ prāk asāmarthyāt paścāt vā anupayogataḥ prāgbhāvaḥ sarva hetūnām na atas arthaḥ sva dhiyā saha bhinna kālam katham grāhyam iti ced grāhyatām viduḥ hetu tvam eva yukti jñāḥ jñāna ākāra arpaṇa kṣamam kāryam hi aneka hetu tve api anukurvat udeti yat tat tena arpita tad rūpam gṛhītam iti ca ucyate

aśakya samayaḥ hi ātmā sukha ādīnām ananya bhāj teṣām atas sva saṃvittiḥ nābhi jalpa anuṣaṅgiṇī avedakāḥ parasya api te svarūpam katham viduḥ eka artha āśrayiṇā vedyā vijñānena iti kecana tat atad rūpiṇaḥ bhāvāḥ tad atad rūpa hetu jāḥ tat sukha ādi kim ajñānam vijñāna abhinna hetu jam sārthe sati indriye yogye yathāsvam api cetasi

dṛṣṭam janma sukha ādīnām tad tulyam manasām api asatsu satsu ca eteṣu na janma ajanma vā kvacid dṛṣṭam sukha ādeḥ buddheḥ vā tat tatas na anyatas ca te sukha duḥkha ādi bhedaḥ ca teṣām eva viśeṣataḥ tasyāḥ eva yathā buddheḥ māndya pāṭava saṃśayāḥ yasya arthasya nipātena te jātāḥ dhī sukha ādayaḥ

muktvā tam pratipadyeta sukha ādīn eva sā katham avicchinnā na bhāseta tad saṃvittiḥ krama grahe tad lāghavāt ced tad tulyam iti asaṃvedanam na kim na ca ekayā dvaya jñānam niyamāt akṣa cetasaḥ sukha ādi abhāve api arthāt ca jāteḥ tad śakti asiddhitaḥ pṛthak pṛthak ca sāmarthye dvayoḥ nīla ādi vat sukham

gṛhyeta kevalam tasya tad hetu artham agṛhṇataḥ na hi saṃvedanam yuktam arthena eva saha grahe kim sāmarthyam sukha ādīnām na iṣṭā dhīḥ yat tad udbhavā vinā arthena sukha ādīnām vedane cakṣuḥ ādibhiḥ rūpa ādiḥ strī ādi bhedaḥ akṣṇā na gṛhyeta kadācana na hi sati antaraṅge arthe śakte dhīḥ bāhya darśanī

artha grahe sukha ādīnām tad jānām syāt avedanam dhiyoḥ yugapad utpattau tad tad viṣaya saṃbhavāt sukha duḥkha vidau syātām sakṛt arthasya saṃbhave sati āntare api upādāne jñāne duḥkha ādi saṃbhavaḥ na upādānam viruddhasya tat ca ekam iti ced matam tat ajñānasya vijñānam kena upādāna kāraṇam

ādhipatyam tu kurvīta tat viruddhe api dṛśyate akṣṇoḥ yathā ekaḥ ālokaḥ naktaṃcara tadanyayoḥ rūpa darśana vaiguṇya avaiguṇye kurute sakṛt tasmāt sukha ādayaḥ arthānām sva saṃkrānta avabhāsinām vedakāḥ sva ātmanaḥ ca eṣām arthebhyaḥ janma kevalam artha ātmā sva ātma bhūtaḥ hi teṣām taiḥ anubhūyate

tena artha anubhava khyātiḥ ālambaḥ tu tad ābhatā kaścid bahis sthitān eva sukha ādīn apracetanān grāhyān āha na tasya api sakṛt yuktaḥ dvaya grahaḥ sukha ādya bhinna rūpa tvāt nīla ādeḥ ced sakṛt grahaḥ bhinna avabhāsinoḥ grāhyam cetasoḥ tat abhedi kim tasya aviśeṣe bāhyasya bhāvanā tāratamyataḥ tāratamyam ca buddhau syāt na prīti paritāpayoḥ

sukha ādi ātma tayā buddheḥ api yadi avirodhitā saḥ idānīm katham bāhyaḥ sukha ādi ātmā iti gamyate agrāhya grāhaka tvāt ced bhinna jātīyayoḥ pumān agrāhakaḥ syāt sarvasya tatas hīyeta bhoktṛtā kārya kāraṇa tānena pratyukta akārya kāraṇe grāhya grāhaka tā bhāvāt bhāve anyatra api sā bhavet tasmāt te āntarā eva saṃvedya tvāt ca cetanāḥ

saṃvedanam na yat rūpam na hi tat tasya vedanam atad svabhāvaḥ anubhavaḥ bauddhān tān samavaiti ced muktvā adhyakṣa smṛta ākārām saṃvittim buddhiḥ atra kā tān tān arthān upādāya sukha duḥkha ādi vedanam ekam āvirbhavat dṛṣṭam na dṛṣṭam tu anyat antarā saṃsargāt avibhāgaḥ ced ayaḥ golaka vahni vat

bheda abheda vyavasthā evam ucchinnā sarva vastuṣu abhinna vedanasya aikye yat na evam tat vibheda vat sidhyet asādhana tve asya na siddham bheda sādhanam bhinna ābhaḥ sita duḥkha ādiḥ abhinnaḥ buddhi vedane abhinna ābhe vibhinne ced bheda abhedau kim āśrayau tiraskṛtānām paṭunā api ekadā bheda darśanāt pravāhe vitti bhedānām siddhā bheda vyavasthitiḥ

prāk uktam yoginām jñānam teṣām tat bhāvanā mayam vidhūta kalpanā jālam spaṣṭam eva avabhāsate kāma śoka bhaya unmāda caura svapna ādi upaplutāḥ abhūtān api paśyanti puratas avasthitān iva na vikalpa anubaddhasya spaṣṭa artha pratibhāsitā svapne api smaryate smārtam na ca tat tādṛś arthavat aśubha apṛthivīkṛtsnā ādi abhūtam api varṇyate

spaṣṭa ābham nirvikalpam ca bhāvanā bala nirmitam tasmāt bhūtam abhūtam vā yat yat eva abhibhāvyate bhāvanā pariniṣpattau tat sphuṭa akalpa dhī phalam tatra pramāṇam saṃvādi yat prāc nirṇīta vastu vat tat bhāvanā jam pratyakṣam iṣṭam śeṣāḥ upaplavāḥ śabda artha grāhi yat yatra tat jñānam tatra kalpanā sva rūpam ca na śabda arthaḥ tatra adhyakṣam atas akhilam

trividham kalpanā jñānam āśraya upaplava udbhavam avikalpakam ekam ca pratyakṣa ābham caturvidham anakṣaja tu asiddhi artham ukte dve bhrānti darśanāt siddha anumādi vacanam sādhanāya eva pūrvayoḥ saṃketa saṃśraya anyārtha samāropa vikalpane pratyakṣa āsanna vṛtti tvāt kadācid bhrānti kāraṇam yathā eva iyam parokṣa artha kalpanā smaraṇa ādikā

samayā apekṣiṇī na artham pratyakṣam adhyavasyati tathā anubhūta smaraṇam antareṇa ghaṭa ādiṣu na pratyayaḥ anuyan tat ca pratyakṣāt parihīyate apavādaḥ caturthaḥ atra tena uktam upaghāta jam kevalam tatra timiram upaghāta upalakṣaṇam mānasam tat api iti eke teṣām granthaḥ virudhyate nīla dvi candra ādi dhiyām hetuḥ akṣāṇi api iti ayam

pāraṃparyeṇa hetuḥ ced indriya jñāna gocare vicāryamāṇe prastāvaḥ mānasasya iha kīdṛśaḥ kim vā aindriyam yat akṣāṇām bhāva abhāva anurodhi ced tat tulyam vikriyā vat ced sā eva iyam kim niṣidhyate sarpa ādi bhrānti vat ca asyāḥ syāt akṣa vikṛtau api nivṛttiḥ na nivarteta nivṛtte api akṣa viplave

kadācid anya saṃtāne tathā eva arpyeta vācakaiḥ dṛṣṭa smṛtim apekṣeta na bhāseta parisphuṭam suptasya jāgrataḥ vā api yā eva dhīḥ sphuṭa bhāsinī sā nirvikalpa ubhayathā api anyathā eva vikalpikā tasmāt tasya avikalpe api prāmāṇyam pratiṣidhyate visaṃvādāt tad artham ca pratyakṣa ābham dvidhā uditam

kriyā sādhanam iti eva sarvam sarvasya karmaṇaḥ sādhanam na hi tat tasyāḥ sādhanam yā kriyā yatas tatra anubhava mātreṇa jñānasya sadṛśa ātmanaḥ bhāvyam tena ātmanā yena pratikarma vibhajyate anātma bhūtaḥ bhedaḥ asya vidyamānaḥ api hetuṣu bhinne karmaṇi abhinnasya na bhedena niyāmakaḥ

tasmāt yatas asya ātma bhedāt asya adhigatiḥ iti ayam kriyāyāḥ karma niyamaḥ siddhā sā tad prasādhanā arthena ghaṭayati enām na hi muktvā artha rūpa tām anyaḥ sva bhedāt jñānasya bhedakaḥ api kathaṃcana tasmāt prameya adhigateḥ sādhanam meya rūpa tā sādhane anyatra tad karma saṃbandhaḥ na prasidhyati

sā ca tasya ātma bhūtā eva tena na artha antaram phalam dadhānam tat ca tām ātmani artha adhigamana ātmanā savya apāram iva ābhāti vyāpāreṇa sva karmaṇi tad vaśāt tad vyavasthānāt akārakam api svayam yathā phalasya hetūnām sadṛśa ātmatayā udbhavāt hetu rūpa grahaḥ loke akriyāvat tve api kathyate ālocana akṣa saṃbandha viśeṣaṇa dhiyām atas

na iṣṭam prāmāṇyam eteṣām vyavadhānāt kriyām prati sarveṣām upayoge api kārakāṇām kriyām prati yat antyam bhedakam tasyāḥ tat sādhakatamam matam sarva sāmānya hetutvāt akṣāṇām asti na īdṛśam tad bhede api hi atad rūpasya asya idam iti tat kutas etena śeṣam vyākhyātam viśeṣaṇa dhiyām punar

atādrūpye na bhedaḥ api tadvat anyadhiyaḥ api vā na iṣṭaḥ viṣaya bhedaḥ api kriyā sādhanayoḥ dvayoḥ eka artha tve dvayam vyartham na ca syāt krama bhāvitā sādhya sādhana tā bhāvaḥ sakṛt bhāve dhiyaḥ aṃśayoḥ tad vyavasthā āśraya tvena sādhya sādhana saṃsthitiḥ sarva ātmanā api saṃbaddham kaiścid eva avagamyate

dharmaiḥ sa niyamaḥ na syāt saṃbandhasya aviśeṣatas tad abhede api bhedaḥ ayam yasmāt tasya pramāṇa tā saṃskārāt ced atādrūpye na tasya api avyavasthiteḥ kriyā karaṇayoḥ aikya virodhaḥ iti ced asat dharma bheda abhyupagamāt vastu abhinnam iti iṣyate evaṃprakārā sarvā eva kriyā kāraka saṃsthitiḥ bhāveṣu bhinna abhimateṣu api āropeṇa vṛttitaḥ

kārtha saṃvid yat eva idam pratyakṣam prativedanam tad artha vedanam kena tādrūpyāt vyabhicāri tat atha saḥ anubhavaḥ kva asya tat eva idam vicāryate sarūpayanti tat kena sthūla ābhāsam ca te aṇavaḥ tat na artha rūpa tā tasya satyām vā vyabhicāriṇī tad saṃvedana bhāvasya na samarthā prasādhane

tat sārūpya tad utpattī yadi saṃvedya lakṣaṇam saṃvedyam syāt samāna artham vijñānam samanantaram idam dṛṣṭam śrutam vedam iti yatra avasāya dhīḥ sa tasya anubhavaḥ sā eva pratyāsattiḥ vicāryate dṛśya darśanayoḥ yena tasya tat darśanam matam tayoḥ saṃbandham āśritya draṣṭuḥ eṣa viniścayaḥ

ātmā sa tasya anubhavaḥ sa ca na anyasya kasyacid pratyakṣa prativedya tvam api tasya tad ātma tā na anyaḥ anubhāvyaḥ tena asti tasya na anubhavaḥ paraḥ tasya api tulya codya tvāt svayam sā eva prakāśate nīla ādi rūpaḥ tasya asau svabhāvaḥ anubhavaḥ ca saḥ nīla ādi anubhavaḥ khyātaḥ svarūpa anubhavaḥ api san

prakāśamānaḥ tādātmyāt svarūpasya prakāśakaḥ yathā prakāśaḥ abhimataḥ tathā dhīḥ ātma vedinī tasyāḥ ca artha antare vedye durghaṭau vedya vedakau avedya vedaka ākārāḥ yathā bhrāntaiḥ nirīkṣyate vibhakta lakṣaṇa grāhya grāhaka ākāra viplavā tathā akṛta vyavastheyam keśa ādi jñāna bheda vat yadā tadā na saṃcodya grāhya grāhaka lakṣaṇā

tadā anya saṃvidaḥ abhāvāt sva saṃvid phalam iṣyate yadi bāhyaḥ anubhūyeta kaḥ doṣaḥ na eva kaścana idam eva kim uktam syāt sa bāhyaḥ arthaḥ anubhūyate yadi buddhiḥ tad ākārā sā asti ākāra viśeṣiṇī sā bāhyāt anyatas vā iti vicāram idam arhati darśana upādhi rahitasya agrahāt tad grahe grahāt darśanam nīla nirbhāsam na arthaḥ bāhyaḥ asti kevalam

kasyacid kiṃcid eva antar vāsanāyāḥ prabodhakam tatas dhiyām viniyamaḥ na bāhya artha vyapekṣayā tasmāt dvi rūpam asti ekam yat evam anubhūyate smaryate ca ubhaya ākārasya asya saṃvedanam phalam yadā niṣpanna tad bhāvaḥ iṣṭaḥ aniṣṭaḥ api vā paraḥ vijñapti hetuḥ viṣayaḥ tasyāḥ ca anubhavaḥ tathā yadā sa viṣayam jñānam jñāna aṃśe artha vyavasthiteḥ

tadā yaḥ ātma anubhavaḥ saḥ eva artha viniścayaḥ yadi iṣṭa ākāraḥ ātmā asyāḥ anyathā vā anubhūyate iṣṭaḥ aniṣṭaḥ api vā tena bhavati arthaḥ praveditaḥ vidyamāne api bāhye arthe yathā anubhavam eva saḥ niścita ātmā sva rūpeṇa na aneka ātma tva doṣataḥ abhyupāye api bhedena na syāt anubhavaḥ dvayoḥ adṛṣṭa āvaraṇān no ced na nāma artha vaśā gatiḥ

tam aneka ātmakam bhāvam eka ātma tvena darśayet tat adṛṣṭam katham nāma bhavet arthasya darśakam iṣṭa aniṣṭa avabhāsinyaḥ kalpanā na akṣadhīḥ yadi ariṣṭa ādau asaṃdhānam dṛṣṭam tatra api cetasām tasmāt prameye bāhye api yuktam sva anubhavaḥ phalam yatas svabhāvaḥ asya yathā tathā eva artha viniścayaḥ

tadā artha ābhāsa tā eva asya pramāṇam na tu san api grāhaka ātmā apara artha tvāt bāhyeṣu artheṣu apekṣyate yasmāt yathā niviṣṭaḥ asau artha ātmā pratyaye tathā niścīyate niviṣṭaḥ asau evam iti ātma saṃvidaḥ iti artha saṃvid sā eva iṣṭā yatas artha ātmā na dṛśyate tasyāḥ buddhi niveśya arthaḥ sādhanam tasya sā kriyā

yathā niviśate saḥ arthaḥ yatas sā prathate tathā artha sthiteḥ tad ātma tvāt sva vid api artha vid matā tasmāt viṣaya bhedaḥ api na sva saṃvedanam phalam uktam svabhāva cintāyām tādātmyāt artha saṃvidaḥ tathā avabhāsamānasya tādṛśaḥ anyādṛśaḥ api vā jñānasya hetuḥ arthaḥ api iti arthasya iṣṭā prameya tā

yathā kathaṃcid tasya artha rūpam muktvā avabhāsinaḥ artha grahaḥ katham satyam na jāne aham api īdṛśam avibhāgaḥ api buddhi ātmā viparyāsita darśanaiḥ grāhya grāhaka saṃvitti bhedavān iva lakṣyate mantra ādi upapluta akṣāṇām yathā mṛd śakala ādayaḥ anyathā eva avabhāsante tad rūpa rahitāḥ api tathā eva adarśanāt teṣām anupapluta cakṣuṣām

dūre yathā vā maruṣu mahān alpaḥ api dṛśyate yathā anudarśanam ca iyam meyamāna phala sthitiḥ kriyate avidyamānā api grāhya grāhaka saṃvidām anyathā ekasya bhāvasya nānā rūpa avabhāsinaḥ satyam katham syuḥ ākārāḥ tad eka tvasya hānitaḥ anyasya anyatva hāneḥ ca nābhedaḥ arūpadarśanāt rūpa abhedam hi paśyantī dhīḥ abhedam vyavasyati

bhāvāḥ yena nirūpyante tad rūpam na asti tattvataḥ yasmāt ekam anekam vā rūpam teṣām na vidyate sādharmya darśanāt loke bhrāntiḥ nāma upajāyate atadātmani tādātmya vyavasāyena na iha tat adarśanāt jagati asmin ekasya api tad ātmanaḥ asti iyam api yā tu antar upaplava samudbhavā doṣa udbhavā prakṛtyā sā vitatha pratibhāsinī

anapekṣita sādharmya dṛś ādiḥ taimira ādi vat tatra buddheḥ paricchedaḥ grāhaka ākāra sammataḥ tādātmyāt ātma vid tasya sa tasyāḥ sādhanam tatas tatra ātma viṣaye māne yathā rāga ādi vedanam iyam sarvatra saṃyojyā māna meya phala sthitiḥ tatra api anubhava ātma tvāt te yogyāḥ sva ātma saṃvidi iti sā yogyatā mānam ātmā meyaḥ phalam sva vid

grāhaka ākāra saṃkhyātā pariccheda ātma tā ātmani sā yogyatā iti ca proktam pramāṇam sva ātma vedanam sarvam eva hi vijñānam viṣayebhyaḥ samudbhavat tad anyasya api hetu tve kathaṃcid viṣaya ākṛti yathā eva āhāra kāla ādeḥ hetu tve apatya janmani pitroḥ tat ekasya ākāram dhatte na anyasya kasyacid tad hetu tvena tulye api tad anyaiḥ viṣaye matam

viṣaya tvam tad aṃśena tad abhāve na tat bhavet anartha ākāra śaṅkā syāt api arthavati cetasi atīta artha grahe siddhe dvi rūpa tva ātma vedane nīla ādi ābhāsa bhedi tvāt na arthaḥ jātiḥ atadvatī sā ca anityāḥ na jātiḥ syāt nityāḥ vā janikā katham nāma ādikam niṣiddham prāk na ayam arthavatām kramaḥ icchā mātra anubandhi tvāt arthaśaktiḥ na sidhyati

smṛtiḥ ca īdṛgvidham jñānam tasyāḥ ca anubhavāt bhavaḥ sa ca artha ākāra rahitaḥ sā idānīm tadvatī katham na arthāt bhāvaḥ tadā abhāvāt syāt tathā anubhave api saḥ ākāraḥ sa ca na arthasya spaṣṭa ākāra vivekataḥ vyatiriktam tat ākāram pratīyāt aparaḥ tathā nityam ātmani saṃbandhe pratīyāt kathitam ca na

ekaikena abhisaṃbandhe pratisaṃdhiḥ na yujyate eka artha abhiniveśa ātmā pravaktṛ śrotṛ cetasoḥ tat eka vyavahāraḥ ced sādṛśyāt atad ābhayoḥ bhinna ātmā arthaḥ katham grāhyaḥ tadā syāt dhīḥ anarthikā tat ca anubhava vijñānam ubhaya aṃśa avalambinā eka ākāra viśeṣeṇa tat jñānena anubadhyate anyathā hi atadākāram katham jñāne adhirohati

eka ākāra uttaram jñānam tathā hi uttaram uttaram tasya artha rūpeṇa ākārau ātma ākāraḥ ca kaścana dvitīyasya tṛtīyena jñānena hi vivicyate artha kārya tayā jñāna smṛtau artha smṛteḥ yadi bhrāntyā saṃkalanam jyotiḥ manaskāre api sā bhavet sarveṣām api kāryāṇām kāraṇaiḥ syāt tathā grahaḥ kulāla ādi vivekena na smaryeta ghaṭaḥ tatas

yasmāt atiśayāt jñānam artha saṃsarga bhājanam sārūpyāt tat kim anyat syāt dṛṣṭeḥ ca yamala ādiṣu ādya anubhaya rūpa tve hi eka rūpe vyavasthitam dvitīyam vyatiricyeta na parāmarśa cetasā artha saṃkalana āśleṣā dhīḥ dvitīya avalambate nīla ādi rūpeṇa dhiyam bhāsamānām puras tatas anyathā hi ādyam eva ekam saṃyojyeta artha saṃbhavāt

jñānam na adṛṣṭa saṃbandham pūrva arthena uttarottaram sakṛt saṃvedyamānasya niyamena dhiyā saha viṣayasya tatas anya tvam kena ākāreṇa sidhyati bhedaḥ ca bhrānti vijñānaiḥ dṛśyeta indau iva advaye saṃvitti niyamaḥ na asti bhinnayoḥ nīla pītayoḥ na arthaḥ asaṃvedanaḥ kaścid anartham vā api vedanam dṛṣṭam saṃvedyamānam tat tayoḥ na asti viveki tā

tasmāt arthasya durvāram jñāna kāla avabhāsinaḥ jñānāt avyatireki tvam hetu bheda anumā bhavet abhāvāt akṣa buddhīnām satsu api anyeṣu hetuṣu niyamam yadi na brūyāt pratyayāt samanantarāt bījāt aṅkura janma agneḥ dhūmāt siddhiḥ iti īdṛśī bāhya artha āśrayiṇī yā api kāraka jñāpaka sthitiḥ sā api tad rūpa nirbhāsāḥ tathā aniyata saṃgamāḥ

buddhiḥ āśritya kalpyeta yadi kim vā virudhyate anagni janyaḥ dhūmaḥ syāt tat kāryāt kāraṇe gatiḥ na syāt kāraṇa tāyām vā kutas ekāntataḥ gatiḥ tatra api dhūma ābhāsā dhīḥ prabodha paṭu vāsanām gamayet agni nirbhāsām dhiyam eva na pāvakam tad yogya vāsanā garbhaḥ eva dhūma avabhāsinīm vyanakti citta saṃtānaḥ dhiyam dhūmaḥ agnitaḥ tatas

asti eṣa viduṣām vādaḥ bāhyam tu āśritya varṇyate dvairūpyam saha saṃvitti niyamāt tat ca sidhyati jñānam indriya bhedena paṭu manda āvila ādikām pratibhāsa bhidām arthe bibhrat ekatra dṛśyate arthasya abhinna rūpa tvāt eka rūpam bhavet manaḥ sarvam tad artham arthāt ced tasya na asti tad ābhatā

artha āśrayeṇa udbhavataḥ tad rūpam anukurvataḥ tasya kenacid aṃśena paratas api bhidā bhavet tathā hi āśritya pitaram tad rūpaḥ api sutaḥ pituḥ bhedam kenacid aṃśena kutaścid avalambate mayūra candraka ākāram nīlalohita bhāsvaram saṃpaśyanti pradīpa ādeḥ maṇḍalam manda cakṣuṣaḥ tasya tad bāhya rūpa tve kā prasanna īkṣaṇe akṣamā

bhūtam paśyan ca tad darśī katham ca upahata indriyaḥ śodhitam timireṇa asya vyaktam cakṣuḥ atīndriyam paśyataḥ anya akṣa dṛśye arthe tat avyaktam katham punar āloka akṣamanaskārāt anyasya ekasya gamyate śaktiḥ hetuḥ tatas na anyaḥ ahetuḥ ca viṣayaḥ katham saḥ eva yadi dhī hetuḥ kim pradīpam apekṣate

dīpa mātreṇa dhībhāvāt ubhayam na api kāraṇam dūra āsanna ādi bhedena vyakta avyaktam na yujyate tat syāt āloka bhedāt ced tad pidhāna apidhānayoḥ tulyā dṛṣṭiḥ adṛṣṭiḥ vā sūkṣmaḥ aṃśaḥ tasya kaścana ālokena na mandena dṛśyate atas bhidā yadi eka tve arthasya bāhyasya dṛśya adṛśya bhidā kutas aneka tve aṇuśas bhinne dṛśya adṛśya bhidā kutas

māndya pāṭa a abhedena bhāsaḥ buddhi bhidā yadi bhinne anyasmin abhinnasya kutas bhedena bhāsanam mandam tat api tejaḥ kim āvṛtteḥ iha sā na kim tanu tvāt tejasaḥ api etat asti anyatra api atānavam ati āsanne ca su vyaktam tejaḥ tat syāt ati sphuṭam tatra api adṛṣṭam āśritya bhavet rūpa antaram yadi

anyonya āvaraṇam teṣām syāt tejaḥ vihatiḥ tatas tatra ekam eva dṛśyeta tasya anāvaraṇe sakṛt paśyet sphuṭa asphuṭam rūpam ekaḥ adṛṣṭena vāraṇe artha anarthau na yena staḥ tat adṛṣṭam karoti kim tasmāt saṃvid yathā hetu jāyamāna artha saṃśrayāt pratibhāsa bhidām dhatte śeṣāḥ kumati durnayāḥ jñāna śabda pradīpānām pratyakṣasya itarasya vā

janakatvena pūrveṣām kṣaṇikānām vināśataḥ vyaktiḥ kutas asatām jñānāt anyasya anupakāriṇaḥ vyaktau vyajyeta sarvaḥ arthaḥ tad hetoḥ niyamaḥ yadi na eṣā api kalpanā jñāne jñānam tu artha avabhāsataḥ tam vyanakti iti kathyeta tad abhāve api tad kṛtam na akārayati ca anyaḥ arthaḥ anupakārāt saha uditaḥ vyaktaḥ na ākārayan jñānam su a ākāreṇa katham bhavet vajra upalādiḥ api arthaḥ sthiraḥ saḥ anya anapekṣaṇāt sakṛt sarvasya janayet jñānāni jagataḥ svayam kramāt bhavanti tāni asya saha kāri upakārataḥ āhuḥ pratikṣaṇam bhedam sa doṣaḥ atra api pūrvavat

saṃvedanasya tādātmye na vivādaḥ asti kasyacid tasya artha rūpa tā siddhā sā api sidhyati saṃsmṛteḥ bhedena ananubhūte asmin avibhakte sva gocaraiḥ evam etat na khalu evam iti sā syāt na bhedinī na ca anubhava mātreṇa kaścid bhedaḥ vivecakaḥ vivekinī na ca aspaṣṭa bhede dhīḥ yamala ādi vat dvairūpya sādhanena api prāyas siddham sva vedanam

sva rūpa bhūta ābhāsasya tadā saṃvedana īkṣaṇāt dhiyā tad rūpayā jñāne niruddhe anubhavaḥ kutas svam ca rūpam na sā vetti iti utsannaḥ anubhavaḥ akhilaḥ bahis mukham ca tat jñānam bhāti artha pratibhāsa vat buddheḥ ca grāhikā buddhiḥ nityam antarmukha ātmani yaḥ yasya viṣaya ābhāsaḥ tam vetti na tat iti api

prāptam kā saṃvid anyā asti tādrūpyāt iti ced matam prāptam saṃvedanam sarva sadṛśānām parasparam buddhiḥ sarūpā tad vid ced na idānīm vid sa rūpikā svayam saḥ anubhavaḥ tasyāḥ na sa sārūpya kāraṇaḥ kriyā karma vyavasthāyāḥ tat loke syāt nibandhanam svabhāva bhūta tad rūpa saṃvid āropa viplavāt

nīla ādeḥ anubhūta ākhyā na anubhūteḥ para ātmanaḥ dhiyaḥ nīla ādi rūpa tve bāhyaḥ arthaḥ kiṃpramāṇakaḥ dhiyaḥ anīla ādi rūpa tve sa tasya anubhavaḥ katham yadā saṃvedana ātma tvam na sārūpya nibandhanam siddham tat svatas eva asya kim arthena upanīyate sarva ātmanā hi sārūpye jñānam ajñāna tām vrajet sāmye kenacid aṃśena syāt sarvam sarva vedanam

yathā nīla ādi rūpa tvāt nīla ādi anubhavaḥ mataḥ tathā anubhava rūpa tvāt tasya api anubhavaḥ bhavet na anubhūtaḥ anubhavaḥ iti arthavat tad viniścayaḥ tasmāt adoṣaḥ iti ced na arthe api asti eṣa sarvadā kasmāt vā anubhave na asti sati sattā nibandhane api ca idam yat ābhāti dṛśyamāne sitā ādike puṃsaḥ sita ādi abhivyakti rūpam saṃvedanam sphuṭam

tat kim sita ādi abhivyakteḥ para rūpam atha ātmanaḥ para rūpe aprakāśāyām vyaktau vyaktam katham sitam jñānam vyaktiḥ na sā vyakta iti avyaktam akhilam jagat vyakteḥ vyakti antara vyaktau api doṣa prasaṅgataḥ dṛṣṭyā vā ajñāta saṃbandham viśinaṣṭi tayā katham yasmāt dvayoḥ ekagatau na dvitīyasya darśanam

dvayoḥ saṃsṛṣṭayoḥ dṛṣṭau syāt dṛṣṭam iti niścayaḥ sarūpam darśanam yasya dṛśyate anyena cetasā dṛṣṭa ākhyā tatra ced siddham sa ārūpye asya sva vedanam atha ātma rūpam naḥ vetti para rūpasya vid katham sārūpyāt vedanā ākhyā ca prāk eva pratipāditā dṛṣṭayoḥ eva sārūpya grahaḥ artham ca na dṛṣṭavān

prāk katham darśanena asya sārūpyam saḥ adhyavasyati sārūpyam api na icchet yaḥ tasya na ubhaya darśanam tadā arthaḥ jñānam iti ca jñāte ca iti gatā kathā atha svarūpam sā tarhi svayam eva prakāśate yat tasyām aprakāśāyām arthaḥ syāt aprakāśitaḥ etena anātma vid pakṣe sarva artha adarśanena ye

apratyakṣām dhiyam prāhuḥ te api nirvarṇita uttarāḥ āśraya ālambana abhyāsa bhedāt bhinna pravṛttayaḥ sukha duḥkha abhilāṣa ādi bhedāḥ buddhayaḥ eva tāḥ pratyakṣāḥ tad viviktam ca na anyat kiṃcid vibhāvyate yat tat jñānam paraḥ api enām bhuñjīta anyena vid yadi tad jā tad pratibhāsā vā yadi dhīḥ vetti na aparā

ālambamānasya anyasya api asti avaśyam idam dvayam atha na utpadyate tasmāt na ca tad pratibhāsinī sā dhīḥ nirviṣayā prāptā sāmānyam ca tad agrahe na gṛhyate iti proktam na ca tat vastu kiṃcana tasmāt artha avabhāsaḥ asau na anyaḥ tasyāḥ dhiyaḥ tatas siddhe pratyakṣa bhāva ātma vidau gṛhṇāti tān punar

na adhyakṣam iti ced eṣa kutas bhedaḥ samarthayoḥ adṛṣṭa eka artha yoga ādeḥ saṃvidaḥ niyamaḥ yadi sarvathā anyaḥ na gṛhṇīyāt saṃvid bhedaḥ api apoditaḥ yeṣām ca yoginaḥ anyasya pratyakṣeṇa sukha ādikam vidanti tulya anubhavāḥ tadvat te api syuḥ āturāḥ viṣaya indriya saṃpāta abhāvāt teṣām tad udbhavam

na udeti duḥkham iti ced na vai duḥkha samudbhavaḥ duḥkhasya vedanam kim tu duḥkha jñāna samudbhavaḥ na hi duḥkha ādi asaṃvedyam pīḍā anugraha kāraṇam bhāsamānam svarūpeṇa pīḍā duḥkham svayam yadā na tad ālambanam jñānam na tadā evam prasajyate bhinne jñānasya sarvasya tena ālambana vedane

artha sārūpyam ālambaḥ ātmā vittiḥ svayam sphuṭaḥ api ca adhyakṣata abhāve dhiyaḥ syāt liṅgataḥ gatiḥ tat ca akṣam arthaḥ dhīḥ pūrvaḥ manaskāraḥ api vā bhavet kārya kāraṇa sāmagryām asyām saṃbandhi na aparam sāmarthya adarśanāt tatra na indriyam vyabhicārataḥ tathā arthaḥ dhīmanaskārau jñānam tau ca na sidhyataḥ

na aprasiddhasya liṅga tvam vyaktiḥ arthasya ced matā liṅgam sā eva nanu jñānam vyaktaḥ arthaḥ anena varṇitaḥ vyaktau ananubhūtāyām tad vyakta tva aviniścayāt atha arthasya eva kaścid sa viśeṣaḥ vyaktiḥ iṣyate na anutpāda vyayavataḥ viśeṣaḥ arthasya kaścana tat iṣṭau vā pratijñānam kṣaṇa bhaṅgaḥ prasajyate

sa ca jñātaḥ athavā ajñātaḥ bhavet jñātasya liṅgatā yadi jñāne aparicchinne jñātaḥ asau iti tat kutas jñāta tvena aparicchinnam api tat gamakam katham adṛṣṭa dṛṣṭayaḥ anyena dṛṣṭā dṛṣṭā na hi kvacid viśeṣaḥ saḥ anya dṛṣṭau api asti iti syāt svadhī gatiḥ tasmāt anumitiḥ buddheḥ svadharma nirapekṣiṇaḥ

kevalāt na artha dharmāt kaḥ svadharmaḥ svadhiyaḥ aparaḥ yaḥ pratyakṣaḥ dhiyaḥ hetuḥ tulya kāraṇa janmanaḥ tasya bhedaḥ kutas buddheḥ vyabhicārī anya jaḥ ca saḥ rūpa ādīn pañca viṣayān indriyāṇi upalambhanam muktvā na kāryam aparam tasyāḥ samupalabhyate tatra atyakṣam dvayam pañcasu artheṣu ekaḥ api na īkṣyate

rūpa darśanataḥ jātaḥ yaḥ anyathā vyasta saṃbhavaḥ yat evam apratītam tat liṅgam iti ati laukikam vidyamāne api liṅge tām tena sārdham apaśyataḥ katham pratītiḥ liṅgam hi na adṛṣṭasya prakāśakam tatas eva asya liṅgāt prāk prasiddheḥ upavarṇane dṛṣṭānta antara sādhya tvam tasya api iti anavasthitiḥ

iti arthasya dhiyaḥ siddhiḥ na arthāt tasyāḥ kathaṃcana tad aprasiddhau arthasya svayam eva aprasiddhitaḥ pratyakṣām ca dhiyam dṛṣṭvā tasyāḥ ceṣṭā abhidha ādikam para citta anumānam ca na syāt ātmani adarśanāt saṃbandhasya manaḥ buddhau artha liṅga aprasiddhitaḥ prakāśitā katham vā syāt buddhiḥ buddhi antareṇa vaḥ

aprakāśa ātmanoḥ sāmyāt vyaṅgya vyañjaka tā kutas viṣayasya katham vyaktiḥ prakāśe rūpa saṃkramāt sa ca prakāśaḥ tad rūpaḥ svayam eva prakāśate tathā abhyupagame buddheḥ buddhau buddhiḥ sva vedikā siddhānyathā tulya dharmāḥ viṣayaḥ api dhiyā saha iti prakāśa rūpāḥ naḥ svayam dhīḥ saṃprakāśate

anyaḥ asyām rūpa saṃkrāntyā prakāśaḥ san prakāśate sādṛśye api hi dhīḥ anyā prakāśyā na tayā matā svayam prakāśanāt arthaḥ tad rūpeṇa prakāśate yathā pradīpayoḥ dīpa ghaṭayoḥ ca tad āśrayaḥ vyaṅgya vyañjaka bhāvena vyavahāraḥ pratanyate viṣaya indriya mātreṇa na dṛṣṭam iti niścayaḥ tasmāt yatas ayam tasya api vācyam anyasya darśanam

smṛteḥ api ātma vid siddhāḥ jñānasya anyena vedane dīrgha ādi grahaṇam na syāt bahu mātra anavasthiteḥ avasthitau akramāyām sakṛt ābhāsanāt matau varṇaḥ syāt akramaḥ adīrghaḥ kramavān akramām katham upakuryāt asaṃśliṣyan varṇa bhāgaḥ parasparam āntyam pūrva sthitau ūrdhvam vardhamānaḥ dhvaniḥ bhavet

akrameṇa grahāt ante krama vat hīḥ ca naḥ bhavet dhiyaḥ svayam ca na sthānam tad ūrdhva viṣaya āsthiteḥ sthāne svayam na naśyet sā paścāt api aviśeṣatas doṣaḥ ayam sakṛt utpanna ākrama varṇa sthitau api sakṛt yatna udbhavāt vyarthaḥ syāt yatnaḥ ca uttarottaraḥ vyaktau api eṣa varṇānām doṣaḥ samanuṣajyate

anekayā tad grahaṇe yāntyā dhīḥ sā anubhūyate na dīrghagrāhikā sā ca tat na syāt dīrgha dhī smṛtiḥ pṛthak pṛthak ca buddhīnām saṃvittau tad dhvani śruteḥ avicchinna ābhatā na syāt ghaṭanam ca nirākṛtam vicchinnam śṛṇvataḥ api asya yadi avicchinna vibhramaḥ hrasva dvaya uccāraṇe api syāt avicchinna vibhramaḥ

vicchinne darśane ca akṣāt avicchinna adhiropaṇam na akṣāt sarva akṣa buddhīnām vitatha tva prasaṅgataḥ sarva antyaḥ api hi varṇa ātmā nimeṣa tulita sthitiḥ sa ca kramāt aneka aṇu saṃbandhena nitiṣṭhati ekāṇu atyaya kālaḥ ca kālaḥ alpīyān kṣaṇaḥ mataḥ buddhiḥ ca kṣaṇikā tasmāt kramāt varṇān prapadyate

iti varṇeṣu rūpa ādau avicchinna avabhāsinī vicchinnā api anyayā buddhiḥ sarvā syāt vitatha arthikā ghaṭanam yat ca bhāvānām anyatra indriya vibhramāt bheda alakṣaṇa vibhrāntam smaraṇam tat vikalpakam tasya spaṣṭa avabhāsi tvam jalpa saṃsargiṇaḥ kutas na akṣa grāhye asti śabdānām yojana iti vivecitam

vicchinnam paśyataḥ api akṣaiḥ ghaṭayet yadi kalpanā arthasya tad saṃvitteḥ ca satatam bhāsamānayoḥ bādhake asati sannyāye vicchinnaḥ iti tat kutas buddhīnām śakti niyamāt iti ced sa kutas mataḥ yugapad buddhi adṛṣṭeḥ ced tat eva idam vicāryate tāsām samāna jātīye sāmarthya niyamaḥ bhavet tathā hi samyak lakṣyante vikalpāḥ krama bhāvinaḥ etena yaḥ samakṣe arthe pratyabhijñāna kalpanām

spaṣṭa avabhāsām pratyakṣām kalpayet saḥ api vāritaḥ keśa gola ka dīpa ādau api spaṣṭa avabhāsanāt pratīta bhede api adhyakṣāḥ dhīḥ katham tādṛśī bhavet tasmāt na pratyabhijñānāt varṇa ādi ekatva niścayaḥ pūrva anubhūta smaraṇāt tad dharma āropaṇāt vinā saḥ eva ayam iti jñānam na asti tat ca akṣaje kutas

na ca artha jñāna saṃvittyoḥ yugapad saṃbhavaḥ yatas lakṣyate pratibhāsaḥ vā na artha artha jñānayoḥ pṛthak na hi artha ābhāsi ca jñānam arthaḥ bāhyaḥ ca kevalaḥ eka ākāram atigrāhye bheda abhāva prasaṅgataḥ su upa lakṣeṇa bhedena yau saṃvittau na lakṣitau artha artha pratyayau paścāt smaryete tau pṛthak katham

krameṇa anubhava utpāde api artha artha manasoḥ ayam pratibhāsasya nānā tva codya doṣaḥ duruddharaḥ tathā hi nīla ādi ākāraḥ ekaḥ ekam ca vedanam lakṣyate na tu nīla ābhe vedane vedanam param jñāna antareṇa anubhavaḥ bhavet tatra api ca smṛtiḥ dṛṣṭā tad vedanam kena tasya api anyena ced imām mālām jñāna vidām kaḥ ayam janayati anubandhinīm

pūrvā dhīḥ sā eva ced na syāt saṃcāraḥ viṣaya antare tām grāhya lakṣaṇa prāptām āsannām janikām dhiyam agṛhītvā uttaram jñānam gṛhṇīyāt aparam katham ātmani jñāna janane svabhāve niyatām ca tām kaḥ nāmānyaḥ vibadhnīyāt bahis aṅgaḥ antaraṅgikām bāhyaḥ saṃnihitaḥ api arthaḥ tām vibandhum hi na prabhuḥ

dhiyam na anubhavet kaścid anyathā arthasya saṃnidhau na ca asaṃnihita artha asti daśā kācid atas dhiyaḥ utsanna mūlā smṛtiḥ api utsanna iti ujjvalam matam atīta ādi vikalpānām yeṣām na arthasya saṃnidhiḥ saṃcāra kāraṇa abhāvāt utsīdet artha cintanam ātmani jñāna janane śakti saṃkṣayataḥ śanais viṣaya antara saṃcāraḥ yadi sā eva artha dhīḥ kutas

śakti kṣaye pūrva dhiyaḥ na hi dhīḥ prāk dhiyā vinā anya artha āsakti viguṇe jñāne jñāna udaya āgateḥ sakṛt vijātīya jātau api ekena paṭīyasā cittena ahita vaiguṇyāt ālayāt na anya saṃbhavaḥ na apekṣeta anyathā sāmyam manaḥ vṛtteḥ manaḥ antaram manaḥ jñāna krama utpattiḥ api apekṣā prasādhanī ekatvāt manasaḥ anyasmin saktasya anya āgateḥ yadi

jñāna antarasya anudayaḥ na kadācid sahodayāt sama vṛttau ca tulya tvāt sarva dānya āgatiḥ bhavet janma ca ātma manaḥ yoga mātra jānām sakṛt bhavet ekā eva ced kriyā ekasmāt kim dīpaḥ aneka darśanaḥ krameṇa api na śaktam syāt paścāt api aviśeṣatas anena deha puruṣau uktau saṃskārataḥ yadi niyamaḥ sa kutas paścāt buddheḥ ced astu sammatam

na grāhyatā anyā jananāt jananam grāhya lakṣaṇam agrāhyam na hi tejaḥ asti na ca saukṣmya ādi anaṃśake grāhyatā śakti hāniḥ syāt na anyasya janana ātmanaḥ grāhyatāyāḥ na khalu anyat jananam grāhya lakṣaṇe sākṣāt na hi anyathā buddhe rūpa ādiḥ upakārakaḥ grāhyatā lakṣaṇāt anyaḥ tad bhāva niyamaḥ asya kaḥ buddheḥ api tat asti iti sā api tattve vyavasthitā grāhī upādāna saṃvittī cetasaḥ grāhya lakṣaṇam

rūpa ādeḥ cetasaḥ ca evam aviśuddha dhiyam prati grāhya lakṣaṇa cintā iyam acintyā yoginām gatiḥ tatra sūkṣma ādi bhāvena grāhyam agrāhyatām vrajet rūpa ādi buddheḥ kim jātam paścāt yat prāk na vidyate sati svadhī grahe tasmāt yā eva anantara hetu tā cetasaḥ grāhyatā sā eva tatas na artha antare gatiḥ nānā eka śakti abhāve api bhāvaḥ nānā eka kārya kṛt prakṛtyā eva iti gaditam nānā ekasmāt na ced bhavet

na kiṃcid ekam ekasmāt sāmagryāḥ sarva saṃbhavaḥ ekam syāt api sāmagryoḥ iti uktam tat aneka kṛt artham pūrvam ca vijñānam gṛhṇīyāt yadi dhīḥ parā pūrva apara artha bhāsi tvāt cintā ādau eka cetasi abhilāpa dvayam nityam syāt dṛṣṭa kramam akramam dvis dvis ekam ca bhāseta bhāsanāt ātma tad vidoḥ

viṣaya antara saṃcāre yadi antyam na anubhūyate para anubhūta vat sarvān anubhūtiḥ prasajyate ātma anubhūtam pratyakṣam na anubhūtam paraiḥ yadi ātmā anubhūtiḥ sā siddhā kutas yena evam ucyate vyakti hetu aprasiddhiḥ syāt na vyakteḥ vyaktam icchataḥ vyakti asiddhau api vyaktam yadi vyaktam idam jagat

parasya pratipādya tvāt adṛṣṭaḥ api svayam paraiḥ dṛṣṭaḥ sādhanam iti eke tat kṣepāya ātma dṛś vacaḥ anumāviṣaye na iṣṭam parīkṣita parigrahāt vācaḥ prāmāṇyam asmin hi na anumānam pravartate bādhanāya āgamasya ukteḥ sādhanasya param prati saḥ apramāṇam tadā asiddham tat siddham akhilam tatas

tat āgamavataḥ siddham yadi kasya kaḥ āgamaḥ bādhyamānaḥ pramāṇena sa siddhaḥ katham āgamaḥ tad viruddha abhyupagamaḥ tena eva ca katham bhavet tad anya upagame tasya tyāga aṅgasya apramāṇa tā tat kasmāt sādhanam na uktam sva pratītiḥ yat udbhavā yuktyā yayā āgamaḥ grāhyaḥ grāhikā asya api sā na kim

prākṛtasya sataḥ prāk yaiḥ pratipatti akṣa saṃbhavau sādhanaiḥ sādhanāni artha śakti jñāne asya tāni alam vicchinna anugamāḥ ye ca sāmānyena api agocarāḥ sādhya sādhana cintā asti na teṣu artheṣu kācana puṃsām abhiprāya vaśāt tattva atattva vyavasthitau luptau hetu tad ābhāsau tasya vastu asamāśrayāt

san arthaḥ jñāna sāpekṣaḥ nāsan jñānena sādhakaḥ sataḥ api vastu asaṃśliṣṭa asaṃgatyā sadṛśī gatiḥ liṅgam svabhāvaḥ kāryam vā dṛśya adarśanam eva vā saṃbaddham vastutas siddham tat asiddham kim ātmanaḥ pareṇa api anyatas gantum ayuktam para kalpitaiḥ prasaṅgaḥ dvaya saṃbandhāt eka abhāve anya hānaye

tad artha grahaṇam śabda kalpanā āropita ātmanām aliṅga tva prasiddhi artham arthāt artha prasiddhitaḥ kalpanā āgamayoḥ kartuḥ icchā mātra anurodhataḥ vastunaḥ ca anyathā bhāvāt kalpitāḥ vyabhicāriṇaḥ

arthāt artha gateḥ śaktiḥ pakṣa hetu abhidhānayoḥ na arthe tena tayoḥ na asti svatas sādhana saṃsthitiḥ tat pakṣa vacanam vaktuḥ abhiprāya nivedane pramāṇam saṃśaya utpatteḥ tatas sākṣāt na sādhanam sādhyasya eva abhidhānena pāraṃparyeṇa na api alam śaktasya sūcakam hetu vacaḥ aśaktam api svayam

hetu artha viṣaya tvena tad aśakta uktiḥ īritā śaktiḥ tasya api ced dhetu vacanasya pravartanāt tad saṃśayena jijñāsoḥ bhavet prakaraṇa āśrayaḥ vipakṣa upagame api etat tulyam iti anavasthitiḥ antaraṅgam tu sāmarthyam triṣu rūpeṣu saṃsthitam tatra smṛti samādhānam tad vacasi ā iva saṃsthitam akhyāpite hi viṣaye hetu vṛtteḥ asaṃbhavāt viṣaya khyāpanāt eva siddhau ced tasya śakta tā vyāpti pūrve vinā api asmāt kṛtakaḥ śabdaḥ īdṛśaḥ sarve anityāḥ iti prokte api arthāt tat nāśadhīḥ bhavet

anuktau api pakṣasya siddheḥ apratibandhataḥ triṣu anyatam arūpasya eva anuktiḥ nyūna toditā sādhya uktim vā pratijñām sa vadan doṣaiḥ na yujyate sādhana adhikṛteḥ eva hetvābhāsā prasaṅgataḥ aviśeṣa uktiḥ api eka jātīye saṃśaya āvahā anyathā sarva sādhya ukteḥ pratijñātvam prasajyate siddha ukteḥ sādhana tvāt ced parasya api na duṣyate idānīm sādhya nirdeśaḥ sādhana avayavaḥ katham sa ābhāsa ukti ādi upakṣepa parihāra viḍambanā asaṃbaddhā tathā hi eṣa na nyāyaḥ iti sūcitam

gamya artha tve api sādhya ukteḥ asaṃmohāya lakṣaṇam tat catur lakṣaṇam rūpa nipāteṣu svayam padaiḥ asiddha asādhana artha ukta vādi abhyupagama grahaḥ anuktaḥ api icchayā vyāptaḥ sādhye ātma artha vat mataḥ sarva anyeṣṭa nivṛttau api āśaṅkā sthāna vāraṇam vṛttau svayam śruteḥ prāha kṛtā ca eṣā tad arthikā

viśeṣaḥ tad vyapekṣātaḥ kathitaḥ dharma dharmiṇoḥ anuktau api vāñchāyā bhavet prakaraṇāt gatiḥ ananvayaḥ api dṛṣṭānte doṣaḥ tasya yathā uditaḥ ātmā paraḥ ced saḥ asiddhaḥ iti tatra iṣṭa ghāta kṛt sādhanam yat vivāde na nyastam tat ced na sādhyate kim sādhyam anyathā aniṣṭam bhavet vaiphalyam eva vā

sa dvitīya prayogeṣu niranvaya viruddhate etena kathite sādhyam sāmānyena atha saṃmatam tat eva artha antara abhāvāt dehān āptau na sidhyate vācyam śūnyam pralapatām tat etat jāḍya cintitam tulyam nāśe api ced śabda ghaṭa bhedena kalpane na siddhena vināśena tadvatas sādhanāt dhvaneḥ tathā artha antara bhāve syāt tadvān kumbhaḥ api anitya tā

viśiṣṭāḥ dhvaninā anveti no ced na ayoga vāraṇāt dvividhaḥ hi vyavacchedaḥ viyoga apara yogayoḥ vyavacchedāt ayoge tu na anyena an anvaya āgamaḥ sāmānyam eva tat sādhyam na ca siddha prasādhanam viśiṣṭam dharmiṇā tat ca na niranvaya doṣavat etena dharmi dharmābhyām viśiṣṭau dharma dharmiṇau pratyākhyātau nirākurvan dharmiṇī evam asādhanāt samudāya apavādaḥ hi na dharmiṇi virudhyate sādhyam yatas tathā na iṣṭam sādhyaḥ dharmaḥ atra kevalaḥ

ekasya dharmiṇaḥ śāstre nānā dharma sthitau api sādhyaḥ syāt ātmanā eva iṣṭaḥ iti upāttā svayam śrutiḥ śāstra abhyupagamāt eva sarva ādānāt prabādhane tatra ekasya api doṣaḥ syāt yadi hetu pratijñayoḥ śabda nāśe prasādhye syāt gandhe bhū guṇa tā kṣateḥ hetuḥ viruddhaḥ aprakṛteḥ no ced anyatra sā samā

atha atra dharmī prakṛtaḥ tatra śāstra artha bādhanam atha vādīṣṭatām brūyāt dharmi dharma ādi sādhanaiḥ kaiścid prakaraṇaiḥ icchā bhavet sā gamyate ca taiḥ balāt tava iccheyam iti vyaktam īśvara ceṣṭitam vadan na kārya liṅgām tām vyabhicāreṇa bādhyate anāntarīyake ca arthe bādhite anyasya kā kṣatiḥ

uktam ca na āgama apekṣam anumānam sva gocare siddham tena su siddham tat na tadā śāstram īkṣyate vāda tyāgaḥ tadā syāt ced na tadā anabhyupāyataḥ upāyaḥ hi abhyupāye ayam anaṅgam sa tadā api san tathā viśuddhe viṣaya dvaye śāstra parigraham cikīrṣoḥ sa hi kālaḥ syāt tadā śāstreṇa bādhanam

tad virodhena cintāyāḥ tat siddhārtheṣu ayogataḥ tṛtīya sthāna saṃkrāntau nyāyaḥ śāstra parigrahaḥ tatra api sādhya dharmasya saṃbaddhasya eva bādhanam parihāryam na ca anyeṣām anavasthā prasaṅgataḥ kena iyam sarva cintāsu śāstram grāhyam iti sthitiḥ kṛtā idānīm asiddhāntaiḥ grāhyaḥ dhūmena na analaḥ

riktasya jantoḥ jātasya guṇa doṣam apaśyataḥ vilabdhāḥ bata kena amī siddhānta viṣam agrahāḥ yadi sādhanaḥ ekatra sarvam śāstram nidarśane darśayet sādhanam syāt iti eṣā lokottarā sthitiḥ asaṃbaddhasya dharmasya kim asiddhau na sidhyati hetuḥ tad sādhanāya uktaḥ kim duṣṭaḥ tatra sidhyati

dharmān anupanīya eva dṛṣṭānte dharmiṇaḥ akhilān vāc dhūma ādeḥ janaḥ anveti caitanya dahana ādikam svabhāvam kāraṇam vā arthaḥ avyabhicāreṇa sādhayan kasyacid vāda bādhāyām svabhāvāt na nivartate prapadyamānaḥ ca anyaḥ tam na antarīyakam īpsitaiḥ sādhya arthaiḥ hetunā tena katham apratipāditaḥ

uktaḥ anuktaḥ api ced dhetuḥ virodhaḥ vādinaḥ atra kim na hi tasya ukti doṣeṇa sa jātaḥ śāstra bādhanaḥ bādhakasya abhidhānāt ced doṣaḥ yadi vadet na saḥ kim na bādheta saḥ akurvan na yuktam kena duṣyati anyeṣu hetvābhāseṣu sveṣṭasya eva aprasādhanāt duṣyet vyartha abhidhānena na atra tasya prasādhanāt

yadi kiṃcid kvacid śāstre na yuktam pratiṣidhyate bruvāṇaḥ yuktam api anyat iti rāja kula sthitiḥ sarvān arthān samīkṛtya vaktum śakyam na sādhanam sarvatra tena utsanne ayam sādhya sādhana saṃsthitiḥ viruddhayoḥ eka dharmiṇī ayogāt astu bādhanam viruddha aikāntikena atra tadvat asti virodhitā

abādhya bādhaka tve api tayoḥ śāstra artha viplavāt asaṃbandhe api bādhā ced syāt sarvam sarva bādhakam saṃbandhaḥ tena tatra eva bādhanāt asti ced asat hetoḥ sarvasya cintya tvāt sva sādhye guṇa doṣayoḥ na antarīyaka tā sādhye saṃbandhaḥ sā iha na īkṣyate kevalam śāstra pīḍā iha doṣaḥ sa anya kṛte samā

śāstra abhyupagamāt sādhyaḥ śāstra dṛṣṭaḥ khilaḥ yadi pratijñā asiddha dṛṣṭānta hetuvādaḥ prasajyate uktayoḥ sādhana tvena no ced īpsita vādataḥ nyāya prāptam na sādhya tvam vacanāt vinivartate anīpsitam asādhyam ced vādinā anyaḥ api anīpsitaḥ dharmaḥ asādhyaḥ tadā asādhyam bādhamānam virodhi kim

pakṣa lakṣaṇa bāhya arthaḥ svayam śabdaḥ api anarthakaḥ śāstreṣu icchā pravṛtti arthaḥ yadi śaṅkā kutas anviyam saḥ aniṣiddhaḥ pramāṇena gṛhṇan kena nivāryate niṣiddhaḥ ced pramāṇena vācā kena pravartyate pūrvam api eṣa siddhāntam sva icchayā eva gṛhītavān kathaṃcid anyam sa punar grahītum labhate na kim

dṛṣṭeḥ vipratipattīnām atra akārṣīt svayam śrutim iṣṭa akṣatim asādhya tvam anavasthām ca darśayan samayā ahita bhedasya parihāreṇa dharmiṇaḥ prasiddhasya gṛhi iti artham jagāda anyaḥ svayam śrutim vicāra prastuteḥ eva prasiddhaḥ siddhaḥ āśrayaḥ sva icchā kalpita bhedeṣu padārtheṣu avivādataḥ

asādhyatām atha prāha siddhādeśena dharmiṇaḥ sva rūpeṇa eva nirdeśyaḥ iti anena eva tat gatam siddha sādhana rūpeṇa nirdeśasya hi saṃbhave sādhya tvena eva nirdeśyaḥ iti idam phalavat bhavet anumānasya sāmānya viṣaya tvam ca varṇitam iha evam na hi anukte api kiṃcid pakṣe virudhyate kuryāt ced dharmiṇam sādhyam tatas kim tat na śakyate

kasmāt dhetu anvaya abhāvāt na ca doṣaḥ tayoḥ ayam uttara avayava apekṣaḥ na doṣaḥ pakṣaḥ iṣyate tathā hetu ādi doṣaḥ api pakṣa doṣaḥ prasajyate sarvaiḥ pakṣasya bādhātaḥ tasmāt tanmātra liṅginaḥ pakṣa doṣāḥ matā na anye pratyakṣa ādi virodha vat hetu ādi lakṣaṇaiḥ bādhyam muktvā pakṣasya lakṣaṇam

ucyate parihāra artham avyāpti vyatirekayoḥ svayam nipāta rūpa ākhyāḥ vyatirekasya bādhikāḥ saha anirākṛtena iṣṭa śrutiḥ avyāpti bādhanī sādhya abhyupagamaḥ pakṣa lakṣaṇam teṣu apakṣatā nirākṛte bādhanataḥ śeṣe alakṣaṇa vṛttitaḥ svayam iṣṭa abhidhānena gata arthe api avadhāraṇe kṛtyā antena abhisaṃbandhāt uktam kāla antara chide iha anaṅga miṣeḥ niṣṭā tena īpsita pade punar aṅgam eva tathā asiddha hetu ādi pratiṣidhyate avācaka tvāt ca ayuktam tena iṣṭam svayam ātmanā anapekṣya akhilam śāstram tat abhīṣṭasya sādhya tā tena anabhīṣṭa saṃsṛṣṭasya iṣṭasya api hi bādhane yathā sādhyam abādhātaḥ pakṣa hetū na duṣyataḥ
aniṣiddhaḥ pramāṇābhyām sa ca upagamaḥ iṣyate saṃdigdhe hetu vacanāt vyastaḥ hetoḥ anāśrayaḥ
anumānasya bhedena sā bādhā uktā caturvidhā tatra abhyupāyaḥ kārya aṅgam svabhāva aṅgam jagat sthitiḥ

ātma aparodha abhimataḥ bhūta niścaya yukta vāc āptaḥ sva vacanam śāstram ca evam uktam samatvataḥ yathā ātmanaḥ apramāṇa tve vacanam na pravartate śāstra dṛṣṭe tathā na arthe vicāraḥ tat anāśraye tat prastāva āśraya tve hi śāstram bādhakam iti amum vaktum artham su avācā asya saha uktiḥ sāmya dṛṣṭaye

udāharaṇam api atra sadṛśam tena varṇitam pramāṇānām abhāve hi śāstra vācoḥ ayogataḥ sva vāc virodhe vispaṣṭam udāharaṇam āgame diś mātra darśanam tatra pretya dharmaḥ sukha pradaḥ śāstriṇaḥ api atadālambe viruddha uktau tu vastuni na bādhā pratibandhaḥ syāt tulya kakṣya tayā dvayoḥ yathā sva vāci tat ca asyāḥ tadā sva vacana ātmakam

tayoḥ pramāṇam yasya asti tat syāt anyasya bādhakam pratijñām anumānam vā pratijñāpeta yuktikā tulya kakṣyāḥ yathārtham vā bādheta katham anyathā prāmāṇyam āgamānām ca prāk eva vinivāritam abhyupāya vicāreṣu tasmāt doṣaḥ ayam iṣyate tasmāt viṣaya bhedasya darśanāya pṛthak kṛtaḥ anumāna abahis bhūtaḥ api abhyupāyaḥ prabādhanāt

anyathā atiprasaṅgaḥ syāt vyartha tā vā pṛthak kṛteḥ bhedaḥ vāc mātra vacane pratibandhaḥ sva vāci api tena abhyupagamāt śāstram pramāṇam sarva vastuṣu bādhakam yadi na icchet sa bādhakam kim punar bhavet sva vāc virodhaḥ abhedaḥ syāt sva vāc śāstra virodhayoḥ puruṣa icchā kṛtā ca asya paripūrṇā pramāṇa tā tasmāt prasiddheṣu artheṣu śāstra tyāge api na kṣatiḥ parokṣeṣu āgama aniṣṭau na cintā eva pravartate virodha udbhāvana prāyā parīkṣā api atra tat yathā adharma mūlam rāga ādi snānam ca adharma śodhanam

śāstram yat siddhayā yuktyā sva vācā ca na bādhyate dṛṣṭe adṛṣṭe api tat grāhyam iti cintā pravartate artheṣu apratiṣiddha tvāt puruṣa icchā anurodhinaḥ iṣṭa śabda abhidheya tvasya āptaḥ atra akṣata vāc janaḥ uktaḥ prasiddha śabdena dharmaḥ tat vyavahāra jaḥ pratyakṣa ādim iti māna śruti āropeṇa sūcitaḥ

tad āśraya bhuvām icchā varti tvāt aniṣedhinām kṛtānām akṛtānām vā yogyam viśvam svabhāvataḥ artha mātra anurodhinyā bhāvinyā bhūtayā api vā bādhyate pratirundhānaḥ śabda yogya tayā tayā tad yogya tā balāt eva vastutas ghaṭitaḥ dhvaniḥ sarvaḥ asyām apratīte api tasmin tad siddha tā tatas asādhāraṇa tā na syāt bādhā hetoḥ iha anyathā

tat niṣedhaḥ anumānāt syāt śabda arthe anakṣa vṛttitaḥ asādhāraṇa tā tatra hetūnām yatra na anvayi sattvam iti abhyudāhāraḥ hetoḥ evam phalaḥ mataḥ saṃketa saṃśrayāḥ śabdāḥ sa ca icchā mātra saṃśrayaḥ na asiddhiḥ śabda siddhānām iti śābda prasiddha vāc anumāna prasādhyeṣu viruddha avyabhicāriṇaḥ

abhāvam darśayati evam pratīteḥ anumā tu atas athavā bruvataḥ lokasya anumābhāvaḥ ucyate kim tena bhinna viṣayā pratītiḥ anumānataḥ tena anumānāt vastūnām sat asat ta anurodhinaḥ bhinnasya ātad vaśāt vṛttiḥ tat icchā jā iti sūcitam candra tām śaśinaḥ anicchan kām pratītim sa vāñchati iti tam pratyadṛṣṭāntam tat asādhāraṇam matam

na udāharaṇam eva idam adhikṛtya idam ucyate lakṣaṇa tvāt tathā avṛkṣaḥ dhātri iti uktau ca bādhanāt atra api loke dṛṣṭa tvāt karpūra rajata ādiṣu samayāt vartamānasya kāsa ādhāraṇatā abhidhā yadi tasya kvacid sidhyet siddham vastu balena tat pratīti siddha upagame aśaśinī api anivāraṇāt tasya vastuni siddhasya śaśini api anivāraṇam tad vastu abhāve śaśini vāraṇe api na duṣyati tasmāt avastu niyata saṃketa dhvani bhāvinām yogyāḥ padārthāḥ dharmāṇām icchāyāḥ anirodhanāt

tām yogyatām nirundhānam saṃketa apratiṣedha jā pratihanti pratīta ākhyā yogyatā viṣaya anumā śabdānām artha niyamaḥ saṃketa anuvidhāyinām na iti anena uktam atra eṣām pratiṣedhaḥ virudhyate naimittikyāḥ śruteḥ artham artham vā pāramārthikam śabdānām pratirundhānaḥ na bādhyaḥ tena varṇitaḥ

tasmāt viṣaya bhedasya darśanāya pṛthakkṛtā anumāna abahis bhūtā pratītiḥ api pūrvavat siddhayoḥ pṛthak ākhyāne darśayan ca prayojanam ete sa hetuke prāha na anumā adhyakṣa bādhane tatra api adhyakṣa bādhāyām nānā rūpa tayā dhvanau prasiddhasya śrutau rūpam yat eva pratibhāsate advayam śabala ābhāsasya adṛṣṭeḥ buddhi janmanaḥ tad artha artha uktiḥ asya eva kṣepe adhyakṣeṇa bādhanam

tat eva rūpam tatra arthaḥ śeṣam vyāvṛtti lakṣaṇam avastu rūpam sāmānyam atas tat na akṣa gocaraḥ tena sāmānya dharmāṇām apratyakṣa tva siddhitaḥ pratikṣepe api abādhā iti śrāvaṇa uktyā prakāśitam sarvathā avācya rūpa tvāt siddhyā tasya samāśrayāt bādhanāt tad balena uktaḥ śrāvaṇena akṣa gocaraḥ

sarvatra vādinaḥ dharmaḥ yaḥ sva sādhyatayā īpsitaḥ tat dharmavati vādhā syāt na anya dharmeṇa dharmiṇi anyathā asya uparodhaḥ kaḥ bādhite anyatra dharmiṇi gata arthe lakṣaṇe na asmin sva dharmi vacanam punar bādhāyām dharmiṇaḥ api syāt bādhā iti asya prasiddhaye āśrayasya virodhena tad āśrita virodhanāt

anyathā evaṃvidhaḥ dharmaḥ sādhyaḥ iti abhidhānataḥ tat bādhām eva manyeta sva dharmi vacanam tatas nanu etat api artha siddham satyam kecid tu dharmiṇaḥ kevalasya uparodhe api doṣavat tām upāgatāḥ yathā paraiḥ anutpādyā pūrvarūpan na kha ādikam sakṛt śabda ādi ahetu tvāt iti ukte prāha dūṣakaḥ

tadvat vastu svabhāvaḥ asan dharmī vyoma ādiḥ iti api na evam iṣṭasya sādhyasya bādhā kvacana vidyate dvayasya api hi sādhya tve sādhya dharma uparodhi yat bādhanam dharmiṇaḥ tatra bādhā iti etena varṇitam tathā eva dharmiṇaḥ api atra sādhya tvāt kevalasya na yadi evam atra bādhā syāt na anyā anutpādya śaktikaḥ sakṛt śabda ādi ahetu tvāt sukha ādiḥ iti pūrvavat virodhitā bhavet atra hetuḥ aikāntikaḥ yadi krama kriyā nitya tayoḥ avirodhāt vipakṣataḥ vyāvṛtteḥ saṃśayāt eṣa śeṣavat bhedaḥ iṣyate

svayam iṣṭaḥ yatas dharmaḥ sādhyaḥ tasmāt tad āśrayaḥ bādhyaḥ na kevalaḥ na anya saṃśrayaḥ vā iti sūcitam svayam śrutyā anya dharmāṇām bādhābādhā iti kathyate tathā svadharmiṇā anyasya dharmiṇaḥ api iti kathyate

sarva sādhana doṣeṇa pakṣaḥ eva uparudhyate tathā api pakṣa doṣa tvam pratijñā mātra saṃjñinaḥ uttara avayava apekṣaḥ yaḥ doṣaḥ saḥ anubadhyate tena iti uktam atas apakṣa doṣaḥ asiddha āśraya ādikaḥ dharmi dharma viśeṣāṇām svarūpasya ca dharmiṇaḥ bādhā sādhya aṅga bhūtānām anena eva upadarśitā

tatra udāhṛti diś mātram ucyate arthasya dṛṣṭaye dravya lakṣaṇa yuktaḥ anyaḥ saṃyoge arthaḥ asti dṛṣṭi bhāj adṛśyasya aviśiṣṭasya pratijñā niṣprayojanā iṣṭaḥ hi avayavī kāryam dṛṣṭyā dṛśyeṣu asaṃbhavī aviśiṣṭasya ca anyasya sādhane siddha sādhanam guru tva adhas gatī syātām yadi asau syāt tulā ānatiḥ

tat nirguṇa kriyaḥ tasmāt samavāyi na kāraṇam tatas eva na dṛśyaḥ asau adṛṣṭeḥ kārya rūpayoḥ tad bādhāni aviśeṣasya na antarīyaka bhāvinaḥ āsūkṣmāt dravyam ālāyāḥ tolya tvāt aṃśupāta vat dravya antara guru tvasya gatiḥ na iti aparaḥ abravīt tasya krameṇa saṃyukte pāṃśu rāśau sakṛt yute bhedaḥ syāt gaurave tasmāt pṛthak saha ca tolite

krameṇa māṣaka ādīnām saṃkhyā sāmyam na yujyate sarṣapāt āmahārāśeḥ uttarottara vṛddhimat guru tvam kāryam ālāyāḥ yadi na eva upalakṣyate āsarṣapāt guru tvam tat durlakṣitam analpakam taulyam tad kāraṇam kārya gaurava anupalakṣaṇāt nanu adṛṣṭaḥ aṃśu vat saḥ arthaḥ na ca tat kāryam īkṣyate gurutva āgati vat sarva tad guṇa anupalakṣaṇāt māṣaka ādeḥ anādhikyam anatiḥ sa upalakṣaṇam yathā svam akṣeṇa adṛṣṭe rūpa ādau adhika adhike abhyupāyaḥ sva vāc ādi bādhāyāḥ saṃbhavena tu udāharaṇam api anyat diśā gamyam yathā uktayā

tri kāla viṣaya tvāt tu kṛtyānām atatha ātmakam tathā param pratinyastam sādhyam na iṣṭam tadā api tat pratyāyana adhikāre tu sarva asiddha avarodhinī tasmāt sādhya śrutiḥ na iṣṭam viśeṣam avalambate tena aprasiddha dṛṣṭānta hetu udāharaṇam kṛtam anyathā śaśaśṛṅga ādau sarva asiddhe api sādhya tā sarvasya ca aprasiddha tvāt kathaṃcid tena na kṣamaḥ

karma ādi bheda upakṣepa parihārā vivecane prāc asiddha svabhāva tvāt sādhya avayavaḥ iti asat tulya siddhānta tā te hi yena upagama lakṣaṇāḥ samudāyasya sādhya tve api anyonyasya viśeṣaṇam sādhyam dvayam tadā asiddham hetu dṛṣṭānta lakṣaṇam asaṃbhavāt sādhya śabdaḥ dharmi vṛttiḥ yadi iṣyate śāstreṇa alam yathāyogam loke eva pravartatām sādhana ākhyāna sāmarthyāt tad arthe sādhya tā gatā hetu ādi lakṣaṇaiḥ vyāpteḥ anāśaṅkyam ca sādhanam

pūrva avadhāraṇe tena pratijñā lakṣaṇa abhidhā vyarthā vyāptiphalā soktiḥ sāmarthyāt gamyate tatas viruddha teṣṭa asaṃbandhaḥ anupakāra saha āsthitī evam sarva aṅga doṣāṇām pratijñādoṣa tā bhavet pakṣa doṣaḥ para apekṣaḥ na iti ca pratipāditam iṣṭa asaṃbhavya siddhaḥ ca saḥ eva syāt nirākṛtaḥ anitya tva sahetu tve śabdaḥ evam prakīrtayet dṛṣṭānta ākhyān atas anyat kim asti atra artha anudarśanam

viśeṣe bhinnam ākhyāya sāmānyasya anuvartane na tad vyāpteḥ phalam vā kim sāmānyena anuvartane syāt nirākaraṇam śabde sthitena eva iti atas abravīt viruddha viṣaye anyasmin vadan āha anya tām śruteḥ sā ca bheda apratikṣepāt sāmānyānām na vidyate vṛkṣaḥ na śiṃśapā eva iti yathā prakaraṇe kvacid

sarva śruteḥ eka vṛttiḥ niṣedhaḥ syāt na tāvatā saḥ asarvaḥ sarva bhedānām atattve tad asaṃbhavāt jñāpyajñāpakayoḥ bhedāt dharmiṇaḥ hetu bhāvinaḥ asiddheḥ jñāpaka tvasya dharmya siddhaḥ sva sādhane dharma dharmi vivekasya sarva bhāveṣu asiddhitaḥ sarvatra doṣaḥ tulyaḥ ced na saṃvṛtyā viśeṣataḥ

parama artha vicāreṣu tathābhūta aprasiddhitaḥ tattva anya tvam padārtheṣu sāṃvṛteṣu niṣidhyate anumāna anumeya artha vyavahāra sthitiḥ tu iyam bhedam pratyaya saṃsiddham avalambya ca kalpyate yathā svam bheda niṣṭheṣu pratyayeṣu vivekinaḥ dharmī dharmāḥ ca bhāsante vyavahāraḥ tad āśrayaḥ vyavahāra upanītaḥ atra saḥ eva āśliṣṭa bheda dhīḥ

sādhyaḥ sādhana tām nītaḥ tena asiddhaḥ prakāśitaḥ bheda sāmānyayoḥ dharma bhedāt aṅga aṅgitā tatas yathā anityaḥ prayatna utthaḥ prayatna uttha tayā dhvaniḥ pakṣa aṅga tve api abādha tvāt na asiddhiḥ bhinna dharmiṇi yathā aśvaḥ na viṣāṇi tvāt eṣa piṇḍaḥ viṣāṇavān sādhya kāla aṅga tā vā na nivṛtteḥ upalakṣya tat viśeṣaḥ api pratijñā arthaḥ dharma bhedāt na yujyate

pakṣa dharma prabhedena sukha grahaṇa siddhaye hetu prakaraṇa arthasya sūtra saṃkṣepaḥ ucyate ayogam yogam aparaiḥ atyanta ayogam eva ca vyavacchinatti dharmasya nipātaḥ vyatirecakaḥ viśeṣaṇa viśeṣyābhyām kriyayā ca saha uditaḥ vivakṣātaḥ prayoge api tasya arthaḥ ayam pratīyate vyavaccheda phalam vākyam yatas caitraḥ dhanurdharaḥ pārthaḥ dhanurdharaḥ nīlam sarojam iti vā yathā pratiyogi vyavacchedaḥ tatra api artheṣu gamyate tathā prasiddheḥ sāmarthyāt vivakṣā anugamāt dhvaneḥ tat ayoga vyavacchedāt dharmi dharma viśeṣaṇam tad viśiṣṭa tayā dharmaḥ na niranvaya doṣa bhāj

svabhāva kārya siddhi artham dvau dvau hetu viparyayau vivādāt bheda sāmānye śeṣaḥ vyāvṛtti sādhanaḥ na hi svabhāvāt anyena vyāptiḥ gamyasya kāraṇe saṃbhavāt vyabhicārasya dvidhā vṛtti phalam tatas prayatna anantaram jñānam prāk sataḥ niyamena na tasya āvṛtti akṣa śabdeṣu sarvathā anupayogataḥ kadācid nirapekṣasya kārya ākṛti virodhataḥ kādācid ka phalam siddham tat liṅgam jñānam īdṛśam

etena eva prasiddhaḥ api svabhāvasya pṛthak kṛtiḥ kāryeṇa saha nirdeśe mā jñāsīt sarvam īdṛśam vyutpatti arthī ca hetu uktiḥ ukta artha anumitau kṛtā prabheda mātram ākhyātam lakṣaṇam tu na bhidyate tena atra kārya liṅgena svabhāvaḥ api eka deśa bhāj sadṛśa udāhṛtiḥ ca atas prayatnāt vyakti janmanaḥ

yat na antarīyikā sattā yaḥ vā ātmā svaḥ avibhāgavān sa tena avyabhicārī syāt iti artham tat prabhedanam saṃyogi ādiṣu yeṣu asti pratibandhaḥ na tādṛśam na te hetavaḥ iti uktam vyabhicārasya saṃbhavāt sati vā pratibandheḥ tu saḥ eva gati sādhanaḥ niyamaḥ hi avinā abhāvaḥ anityaḥ ca na sādhanam

aikāntika tvam vyāvṛtteḥ avinā abhāvaḥ ucyate tat ca na apratibaddheṣu tatas eva anvaya sthitiḥ sva ātma tve hetu bhāve vā siddhe hi vyatirekitā sidhyati atas viśeṣe na vyatirekaḥ na ca anvayaḥ adṛṣṭi mātram ādāya kevalam vyatirekitā uktā anaikāntikaḥ tasmāt anyathā gamakaḥ bhavet

prāṇa ādi abhāvaḥ nairātmya vyāpti iti vinivartane ātmanaḥ vinivarteta prāṇa ādiḥ yadi tat ca na anyasya vinivṛttya anya vinivṛtteḥ ayogataḥ tad ātmā tad prasūtaḥ ced na etat ātma upalambhane tasya upalabdhau agatau agatau ca prasidhyati te ca atyanta parokṣasya dṛṣṭi adṛṣṭī na sidhyataḥ anyatra adṛṣṭa rūpasya ghaṭa ādau na iti vā kutas

ajñāta vyatirekasya vyāvṛtteḥ vyāpitā kutas prāṇa ādeḥ ca kvacid dṛṣṭyā sattva asattvam pratīyate tathā ātmā yadi dṛśyeta sattva asattvam pratīyate yasya hetoḥ abhāvena ghaṭe prāṇaḥ na dṛśyate dehe api yadi asau na syāt yuktaḥ dehena saṃbhavaḥ bhinne api kiṃcid sādharmyāt yadi tattvam pratīyate

prameya tvāt ghaṭa ādīnām sa ātma tvam kim na mīyate aniṣṭam ced pramāṇam hi sarva iṣṭīnām nibandhanam bhāva abhāva vyavasthām kaḥ kartum tena vinā prabhuḥ smṛti icchā āyatna jaḥ prāṇa nimeṣa ādiḥ tad udbhavaḥ viṣaya indriya cittibhyaḥ tāḥ sva jāti samudbhavāḥ anyonya pratyaya apekṣā anvaya vyatireka bhāj

etau atyātma bhāvaḥ ayam anavasthāni akalpane śrāvaṇa tvena tad tulyam prāṇa ādi vyabhicārataḥ na tasya vyabhicāri tvāt vyatireke api ced katham na asādhyāt eva viśleṣaḥ tasya nanu evam ucyate sādhye anuvṛtti abhāvaḥ arthāt tasya anyatra api asau samaḥ asādhyāt eva vicchedaḥ iti sādhye astitā ucyate

artha āpattyātas eva uktam ekena dvaya darśanam īdṛś avyabhicāraḥ atas ananvayeṣu na sidhyati pratiṣedha niṣedhaḥ ca vidhānāt kīdṛśaḥ aparaḥ nivṛttiḥ na asataḥ sādhyāt asādhyeṣu eva no tatas na iti sā eva nivṛttiḥ kim nivṛtteḥ asataḥ matā nivṛtti abhāvaḥ tu vidhiḥ vastu bhāvaḥ asataḥ api san vastu abhāvaḥ tu na asti iti paśya bāndhya vijṛmbhitam

nivṛttiḥ yadi tasmin na hetoḥ vṛttiḥ kim iṣyate sā api na pratiṣedhaḥ ayam nivṛttiḥ kim niṣidhyate vidhānam pratiṣedham ca muktvā śābdaḥ asti na aparaḥ vyavahāraḥ sa ca asatsu na iti prāptā atra mūka tā satām ca na niṣedhaḥ asti saḥ asatsu ca na vidyate jagati anena nyāyena nañarthaḥ pralayaṃgataḥ

deśa kāla niṣedhaḥ ced yathā asti sa niṣidhyate na tathā na yathā saḥ asti tathā api na niṣidhyate tasmāt āśritya śabda artham bhāva abhāva samāśrayam abāhya āśrayam atra iṣṭam sarvam vidhi niṣedhanam tābhyām sa dharmī saṃbaddhaḥ khyāti abhāve api tādṛśaḥ śabda pravṛtteḥ asti iti saḥ api iṣṭaḥ vyavahāra bhāj

anyathā syāt padārthānām vidhāna pratiṣedhane eka dharmasya sarva ātma vidhāna pratiṣedhanam anānātma ātma tayā bhede nānā vidhi niṣedha vat eka dharmiṇī asaṃhāraḥ vidhāna pratiṣedhayoḥ ekam dharmiṇam uddiśya nānā dharma samāśrayam vidhau ekasya tad bhājām iva anyeṣām upekṣakam niṣedhe tat viviktam ca tat anyeṣām apekṣakam

vyavahāram asatya artham prakalpayati dhīḥ yathā tam tathā eva avikalpya artha bheda āśrayam upāgatāḥ anādi vāsanā udbhūtam bādhante artham na laukikam tad phalaḥ atat phalaḥ ca arthaḥ bhinnaḥ ekaḥ tatas tatas taiḥ taiḥ upaplavaiḥ nīta saṃcaya apacayaiḥ iva atadvān api saṃbandhāt kutaścid upanīyate

dṛṣṭim bheda āśrayaiḥ te api tasmāt ajñāta viplavāḥ sattā sādhana vṛtteḥ ca saṃdigdhaḥ syāt asat na saḥ asattvam ca abhyupagamāt apramāṇān na yujyate asataḥ avyatireke api sa pakṣāt vinivartanam saṃdigdham tasya saṃdehāt vipakṣāt vinivartanam ekatra niyame siddhe sidhyati anya nivartanam

dvairāśye sati adṛṣṭe api syāt adṛṣṭeṣu saṃśayaḥ avyakti vyāpinaḥ api arthāḥ santi tad jāti bhāvinaḥ kvacid na niyamaḥ dṛṣṭyā pārthivāḥ loha lekhya vat bhāve virodhasya adṛṣṭau kaḥ saṃdeham nivartayet kvacid viniyamāt kaḥ anyaḥ tad kārya ātma tayā sa ca nairātmyāt api tena asya saṃdigdham vinivartanam

astu nāma tathā api ātmā na anairātmyāt prasidhyati yena asau vyatirekasya na abhāvam bhāvam icchati yathā na avyatireke api prāṇa ādiḥ na sa pakṣataḥ sa pakṣāvyatirekī ced dhetuḥ hetuḥ atas anvayī na anvaya vyatirekī ced anairātmyam na sa ātmakam yat na antarīyakaḥ sva ātmā yasya siddhaḥ pravṛttiṣu nivartakaḥ saḥ eva atas pravṛttau ca pravartakaḥ na antarīyaka tā sā ca sādhanam samapekṣate kārye dṛṣṭiḥ adṛṣṭiḥ ca kārya kāraṇa tā hi te artha antarasya tad bhāve abhāvaḥ niyamataḥ agatiḥ abhāva asaṃbhavāt teṣām abhāve nitya bhāvinaḥ

kārya svabhāva bhedānām kāraṇebhyaḥ samudbhavāt taiḥ vinā bhavataḥ anyasmāt tad jam rūpam katham bhavet sāmagrī śakti bhedāt dhi vastūnām viśva rūpa tā sā ced na bhedikā prāptam eka rūpam idam jagat bhedaka abhedaka tve syāt vyāhatā bhinna rūpa tā ekasya nānā rūpa tve dve rūpe pāvaka itarau

tat tasya ājananam rūpam anyasya yadi sā eva sā na tasya ājananam rūpam tat tasyāḥ saṃbhavet katham tatas svabhāvau niyatau anyonyam hetu kāryayoḥ tasmāt sva dṛṣṭau iva tat dṛṣṭe kārye api gamyate ekam katham anekasmāt kleda vat dugdha vāriṇaḥ drava śakteḥ yatas kledaḥ sā tu ekā eva dvayoḥ api

bhinna abhinnaḥ kim asya ātmā bhinnaḥ atha dravatā katham abhinna iti ucyate buddheḥ tad rūpāyāḥ abhedataḥ tadvat bhede api dahanaḥ dahana pratyaya āśrayaḥ yena aṃśena adadhat dhūmam tena aṃśena tathā gatiḥ dahana pratyaya aṅgāt eva anya apekṣāt samudbhavāt dhūmaḥ atat vyabhicārī iti siddham kāryam tathā param dhūma indhana vikāra aṅga tā pade dahana sthiteḥ anagniḥ ced adhūmaḥ asau sa dhūmaḥ ced sa pāvakaḥ na antarīyaka tā jñeyā yathā svam hetu apekṣayā svabhāvasya yathoktam prāk vināśa kṛtaka tvayoḥ ahetutva c ati nyāyaḥ sarvaḥ ayam vyatirekiṇaḥ abhyūhyaḥ śrāvaṇa tva ukteḥ kṛtāyāḥ sāmya dṛṣṭaye

hetu svabhāva vyāvṛttyā eva artha vyāvṛtti varṇanāt siddha udāharaṇa iti ukta anupalabdhiḥ pṛthak na tu tatra api adṛśyāt puruṣāt prāṇa ādeḥ anivartanāt saṃdeha hetu ta ākhyātyā dṛśya arthe sā iti sūcitam anaṅgīkṛtavastu aṃśaḥ niṣedhaḥ sādhyate nayā vastuni api tu pūrvābhyām paryudāsaḥ vidhānataḥ
tatra upalabhyeṣu astitvam upalabdheḥ na ca aparam iti ajña jñāpanāya eka anupākhyā udāhṛtiḥ matā

viṣaya asattvataḥ tatra viṣayi pratiṣidhyate jñāna abhidhāna saṃdeham yathā dāhāt apāvakaḥ tathā anyāḥ na upalabhyeṣu na astita anupalambhanāt tad jñāna śabdāḥ sādhyante tad bhāvāt tad nibandhanāḥ siddhaḥ hi vyavahāraḥ ayam dṛśya adṛṣṭau asan iti tasyāḥ siddhau asaṃdigdhau tad kārya tve api dhīdhvanī

vidyamāne hi viṣaye mohāt atra ananubruvan kevalam siddha sādharmyāt smāryate samayam paraḥ kārya kāraṇa tā yadvat sādhyate dṛṣṭi adṛṣṭitaḥ kārya ādi śabdāḥ hi tayoḥ vyavahārāya kalpitāḥ kāraṇāt kārya saṃsiddhiḥ svabhāva antargamāt iyam hetu prabheda ākhyānena darśita udāhṛtiḥ pṛthak eka upalambha anubhavāt idam na upalabhe iti buddheḥ upalabhe vā iti kalpikāyāḥ samudbhavaḥ

viśeṣaḥ gamyate arthānām viśiṣṭāt eva vedanāt tathābhūta ātma saṃvittiḥ bheda dhī hetuḥ asya ca tasmāt svatas dhiyoḥ bheda siddhiḥ tābhyām tad arthayoḥ anyathā hi anavasthānāt bhedaḥ sidhyet na kasyacid viśiṣṭa rūpa anubhavān na atas anyāni anirākriyā tad viśiṣṭa upalambhaḥ atas tasya api anupalambhanam tasmāt anupalambhaḥ ayam svayam pratyakṣataḥ gataḥ sva mātra vṛtteḥ gamakaḥ tad abhāva vyavasthiteḥ anyathā arthasya nāstitvam gamyate anupalambhataḥ upalambhasya nāstitvam anyena iti anavasthitiḥ

adṛśye niścaya ayogāt sthitiḥ anyatra vāryate yathāliṅgaḥ anya sattveṣu vikalpa ādiḥ na sidhyati aniścaya phalāḥ hi eṣā na alam vyāvṛtti sādhane ādya adhikriyate hetoḥ niścayena eva sādhane tasyāḥ svayam prayogeṣu svarūpam vā prayujyate artha bādhana rūpam vā bhāve bhāvāt abhāvataḥ anyonya bheda siddheḥ vā dhruva bhāva vināśa vat pramāṇa antara bādhāt vā sa apekṣa dhruva bhāva vat

hetu antara samūhasya saṃnidhau niyamaḥ kutas bhāva hetu bhava tve kim pāraṃparya pariśramaiḥ nāśanam janayitvā anyam sa hetuḥ tasya nāśanaḥ tam eva naśvaram bhāvam janayet yadi kim bhavet ātma upakārakaḥ kaḥ syāt tasya siddha ātmanaḥ sataḥ na ātma upakārakaḥ kaḥ syāt tena yaḥ samapekṣyate

anapekṣaḥ ca kiṃbhāvaḥ atathābhūtaḥ kadācana yathā na kṣepa bhāj iṣṭaḥ saḥ eva udbhūta nāśakaḥ kṣaṇam api anapekṣa tve bhāvaḥ bhāvasya na iti ced bhāvaḥ hi sa tathābhūtaḥ abhāve bhāvaḥ tathā katham ye apara apekṣa tadbhāvāḥ tad bhāva niyatāḥ hi te asaṃbhavāt vibandhe ca sāmagrī kārya karmaṇi
anadhyavasita avagāhanam analpadhī śaktinā api adṛṣṭa parama artha sāram adhika abhiyogaiḥ api matam mama jagati alabdha sadṛśa pratigrāhakam prayāsyati payonidheḥ payaḥ iva sva dehe jarām

om namaḥ buddhāya vidhūta kalpanā jāla gambhīra udāra mūrtaye namaḥ samantabhadrāya samanta spharaṇa tviṣe prāyas prākṛta saktiḥ apratibala prajñaḥ janaḥ kevalam na anarthī eva su bhāṣitaiḥ parigataḥ vidveṣṭi api īrṣyā amalaiḥ tena ayam na para upakāraḥ iti naḥ cintā api cetas ciram sūkta abhyāsa vivardhita vyasanam iti atra anubaddha spṛham

artha anartha vivecanasya anumāna āśraya tvāt tad vipratipatteḥ tad vyavasthāpanāya āha pakṣa dharmaḥ tad aṃśena vyāptaḥ hetuḥ tridhā eva saḥ avinā abhāva niyamāt hetvābhāsāḥ tatas apare pakṣaḥ dharmī avayave samudāya upacārāt prayojana abhāvāt anupacāraḥ iti ced na sarva dharmi dharma pratiṣedha artha tvāt tad eka deśa tvāt tad upacāra yogya dharmi dharma pratipatti artham tathā ca cākṣuṣa tva ādi parihāraḥ dharma vacanena api dharmya āśraya siddhau dharmi grahaṇa sāmarthyāt pratyāsattyā sādhya dharmi siddhiḥ iti ced na dṛṣṭānta dharmiṇaḥ api pratyāsatteḥ tad aṃśa vyāptyā dṛṣṭānta dharmiṇi sattva siddheḥ dharmi vacanāt sādhya dharmi parigrahaḥ siddhe punar vacanam niyama artham āśaṅkyeta sajātīyaḥ eva sattvam iti siddhe api vijātīya vyatireke sādhya abhāve asattva vacana vat

sāmarthyāt artha gatau pratipatti gaurava parihāra artham ca pakṣa vacanam pakṣasya dharma tve tad viśeṣaṇa apekṣasya anyatra ananuvṛtteḥ asādhāraṇa tā iti ced na ayoga vyavacchedena viśeṣaṇāt yathā caitraḥ dhanurdharaḥ na anya yoga vyavacchedena yathā pārthaḥ dhanurdharaḥ iti ākṣepsyāmaḥ tad aṃśaḥ tad dharmaḥ vaktuḥ abhiprāya vaśāt na tad eka deśaḥ pakṣa śabdena samudāyā vacanāt vyāptiḥ vyāpakasya tatra bhāvaḥ eva vyāpyasya vā tatra eva bhāvaḥ etena avayava vyatirekau yathāsvam pramāṇena niścitau uktau pakṣa dharmaḥ ca te ete kārya svabhāva anupalabdhi lakṣaṇāḥ trayaḥ hetavaḥ yathā agniḥ atra dhūmāt

vṛkṣaḥ ayam śiṃśapā tvāt pradeśa viśeṣe kvacid na ghaṭaḥ upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptasya anupalabdheḥ yadi syāt upalabdhi asattvaḥ eva syāt na anyathā tena upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāpta sattvasya iti uktam bhavati tatra dvau vastu sādhanau ekaḥ pratiṣedha hetuḥ svabhāva pratibandhe hi sati arthaḥ artham na vyabhicarati sa ca tad ātma tvāt tad ātma tve sādhya sādhana bheda abhāvaḥ iti ced na dharma bheda parikalpanāt iti vakṣyāmaḥ tathā ca āha sarve eva ayam anumāna anumeya vyavahāraḥ buddhi ārūḍhena dharma dharmi bhedena iti bhedaḥ dharma dharmitayā buddhi ākāra kṛtaḥ na arthaḥ api vikalpa bhedānām sva tantrāṇām anartha āśraya tvāt

tad kalpita viṣayāt artha pratītau anartha pratilambhaḥ eva syāt kāryasya api svabhāva pratibandhaḥ tad svabhāvasya tad utpatteḥ iti etau dvau anumeya pratyayau sākṣāt anutpatteḥ atad pratibhāsi tve api tad utpatteḥ tat vyabhicāriṇau iti pramāṇam pratyakṣa vat pratyakṣasya api hi artha avyabhicāraḥ eva prāmāṇyam tad abhāve bhāvinaḥ tad vipralambhāt avyabhicāraḥ ca anyasya kaḥ anyaḥ tad utpatteḥ anāyatta rūpāṇām sahabhāva niyama abhāvāt yadi tad utpatteḥ kāryam gamakam sarvathā gamya gamaka bhāvaḥ sarvathā janya janaka bhāvāt na tad abhāve bhavataḥ tad utpatti niyama abhāvāt tasmāt

kāryam svabhāvaiḥ yāvadbhiḥ avinābhāvi kāraṇe teṣām hetuḥ tad kāryatva niyamāt taiḥ eva dharmaiḥ ye taiḥ vinā na bhavati aṃśena janya janaka tva prasaṅgaḥ iti ced na tad janya viśeṣa grahaṇe abhimata tvāt liṅga viśeṣa upādhīnām ca sāmānyānām aviśiṣṭa sāmānya vivakṣāyām vyabhicārāt naḥ iṣyate svabhāve bhāvaḥ api bhāva mātra anurodhini hetuḥ iti vartate tādātmyam hi arthasya tanmātra anurodhini eva na anyāḥ āyatte tad bhāve abhūtasya paścāt bhāva niyama abhāvāt kāraṇānām kārya vyabhicārāt

apravṛttiḥ pramāṇānām anupalabdhiḥ apravṛtti phalā asati sat jñāna śabda vyavahāra pratiṣedha phalā upalabdhi pūrvaka tvāt teṣām iti idam sat asat pratiṣedha vidhi hetvoḥ tulyam rūpam tathā hi sattvam upalabdhiḥ eva vastu yogya tā lakṣaṇā tad āśrayā vā jñāna pravṛttiḥ tatas sat jñāna śabda vyavahāra vṛtteḥ asatām ca asattvam anupalabdhiḥ asajjñānaphalā kācid hetu bheda vyapekṣayā

hetuḥ anupalabdhiḥ bhedaḥ asyāḥ viśeṣaṇam upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāpta sattvam atra anupalabdheḥ liṅgāt asattāyām upalabdheḥ abhāvaḥ api anyayā anupalabdhyā sādhyaḥ iti anavasthānāt apratipattiḥ syāt atha upalabdhi abhāvaḥ vinā anupalabdhyā syāt tathā sattā abhāvaḥ api syāt apārthikā anupalabdhiḥ atha anya upalabdhyā anupalabdhi siddhiḥ iti pratyakṣa siddhāḥ anupalabdhiḥ tathā anya sattayā asattā kim na sidhyati iti yadā punar evaṃvidhāḥ anupalabdhiḥ eva asatām asattā tadā siddhe api viṣaye mohāt viṣayiṇaḥ asat jñāna śabda vyavahārān apratipadyamānaḥ viṣaya pradarśanena samaye pravartyate

yathā gauḥ ayam sāsnādi samudāya ātmaka tvāt iti tathā ca dṛṣṭānta asiddhi codanāḥ api prativyūḍhā viṣaya pratipattau api apratipanna viṣayīṇām darśanāt evam anayoḥ anupalabdhyoḥ sva viparyaya hetvabhāva bhāvābhyām sat vyavahāra pratiṣedha phala tvam tulyam ekatra saṃśayāt anyatra viparyayāt tatra ādyā sat vyavahāra niṣedha upayogāt pramāṇam uktā na tu vyatireka darśana ādau upayujyate saṃśayāt dvitīyā tu atra pramāṇam niścaya phala tvāt

viruddha kāryayoḥ siddhiḥ asiddhiḥ hetu bhāvayoḥ dṛśya ātmanoḥ abhāva artha anupalabdhiḥ caturvidhā yāvān kaścid pratiṣedhaḥ sa sarvaḥ anupalabdheḥ tathā hi sa dvidhā kriyeta kasyacid vidhinā niṣedhena vā vidhau viruddhaḥ vā vidhīyeta aviruddhaḥ vā aviruddhasya vidhau sahabhāva virodha abhāvāt apratiṣedhaḥ viruddhasya api anupalabdhi abhāvena virodha apratipattiḥ tathā hi aparyanta kāraṇasya bhavataḥ anya bhāve abhāvāt virodha gatiḥ sa ca anupalabdheḥ anyonya upalabdhi parihāra sthita lakṣaṇa tā vā virodhaḥ nitya anitya tva vat tatra api eka upalabdhyā anya anupalabdhiḥ eva ucyate anyathā aniṣiddha upalabdheḥ abhāva asiddheḥ ekasya niṣedhena anya abhāva sādhane siddhāḥ eva anupalabdhiḥ niṣedhasya anupalabdhi rūpa tvāt tatra api artha antara niṣedhe kārya kāraṇayoḥ anubhavasya vā tatra anubhavasya apratibandhāt tad abhāve anyena na bhavitavyam iti kutas etat kārya anupalabdhau api na avaśyam kāraṇāḥ api tadvanti bhavanti iti tad abhāvaḥ kutas

tasmāt kāraṇa anupalabdhiḥ eva abhāvam gamayati iti svabhāva anupalabdhiḥ tu svayam asattā eva tatra kevalam viṣayī sādhyate asyām api yadā vyāpaka dharma anupalabdhyā vyāpya abhāvam āha tadā abhāvaḥ api iti iyam pratiṣedha viṣaya anupalabdhiḥ prayoga bhedena caturdhā bhavati viruddha siddhyā yathā na śīta sparśaḥ atra agneḥ etena vyāpaka viruddha siddhiḥ uktāḥ veditavyā yathā na tuṣāra sparśaḥ atra agneḥ viruddha kārya siddhyā yathā na śīta sparśaḥ atra dhūmāt hetu asiddhyā yathā na atra dhūmaḥ anagneḥ svabhāva asiddhyāḥ yathā na atra dhūmaḥ anupalabdheḥ etena vyāpaka svabhāvā siddheḥ uktāḥ yathā na atra śiṃśapā vṛkṣa abhāvāt sarvatra ca asyām abhāva sādhanyām anupalabdhau dṛśya ātmanām eva teṣām tad viruddhānām ca siddhiḥ asiddhiḥ ca veditavyā anyeṣām abhāva virodha asiddheḥ yadi viruddha kārya upalabdhyā api abhāva siddhiḥ tad kāraṇa upalabdhyā kim na sidhyati

tad viruddha nimittasya yā upalabdhiḥ prayujyate nimittayoḥ viruddha tva abhāve sā vyabhicāriṇī yathā na śīta sparśaḥ atra kāṣṭhāt iti nimittayoḥ punar virodhe gamikāḥ eva yathā na asya romaharṣa ādi viśeṣāḥ santi saṃnihita dahana viśeṣa tvāt etena tat kāryāt api tad viruddha kārya abhāva gatiḥ uktāḥ veditavyā yathā na roma harṣa ādi viśeṣa yukta puruṣavān ayam pradeśaḥ dhūmāt iyam ca hetu asiddhyā eva tad viruddha siddhiḥ prāk eva nirdiṣṭāḥ iti iyam prayoga bhedāt aṣṭadhā anupalabdhiḥ tatra yā iyam viruddha kārya upalabdhiḥ uktā tatra

iṣṭam viruddha kārye api deśa kāla ādi apekṣaṇam anyathā vyabhicāri syāt bhasmāḥ iva aśīta sādhane yaḥ tarhi samagreṇa hetunā kārya utpādaḥ anumīyate sa katham trividhe hetau antarbhavati hetunā yaḥ samagreṇa kārya utpādaḥ anumīyate artha antara anapekṣa tvāt sa svabhāvaḥ anuvarṇitaḥ

asau api yathā asaṃnihitāt na anyam apekṣate iti tanmātra anubandhī svabhāvaḥ bhāvasya tatra hi kevalam samagrāt kāraṇāt kārya utpatti sambhavaḥ anumīyate samagrāṇām kārya utpādana yogya tā anumānāt yogyatā ca sāmagrī mātra anubandhinī iti svabhāva bhūtāḥ eva anumīyate kim punar kāraṇam sāmagryāḥ kāryam eva na anumīyate sāmagrī phala śaktīnām pariṇāma anubandhini anaikāntika tā kārye pratibandhasya sambhavāt

na hi samagrāṇi iti eva kāraṇa dravyāṇi sva kāryam janayanti sāmagrī janmanām śaktīnām pariṇāma apekṣa tvāt kārya utpādasya atra antare ca pratibandha sambhavān na kārya anumānam yogyatāyāḥ tu dravya antara anapekṣa tvāt na virudhyate anumānam uttarottara śakti pariṇāmena kārya utpādana samarthāḥ iyam kāraṇa sāmagrī śakti pariṇāma pratyayasya anyasya apekṣaṇīyasya abhāvāt iti pūrvasajāti mātra hetu tvāt śakti prasūteḥ sāmagryā yogyatā ananya apekṣiṇī iti ucyate yā tarhi akārya kāraṇa bhūtena anyena rasa ādinā rūpa ādi gatiḥ sā katham sā api

eka sāmagrī adhīnasya rūpa ādeḥ asataḥ gatiḥ hetu dharma anumānena dhūma indhana vikāra vat tatra hetuḥ eva tathābhūtaḥ anumīyate pravṛtta śakti rūpa upādāna kāraṇa sahakāri pratyayaḥ hi rasa hetuḥ rasam janayati indhana vikāra viśeṣa upādāna hetu sahakāri pratyaya agni dhūma janana vat tathā hi śakti pravṛttyā

sva kāraṇasya phala utpādanam prati ābhi mukhyena na vinā rasaḥ saḥ eva anya kāraṇam rūpa upādāna hetūnām pravṛtti kāraṇam sā api rasa upādāna kāraṇa pravṛttiḥ rūpa upādāna kāraṇa pravṛtti sahakāriṇī tasmāt yathābhūtāt hetoḥ rasaḥ utpannaḥ tathābhūtam anumāpayan rūpam anumāpayati iti tatra api

atīta ekaikālānām gati s na anāgatānām vyabhicārāt tat tasmāt iyam kārya liṅga jā tena na anyaḥ hetuḥ gamakaḥ asti apratibaddha svabhāvasya avinā abhāva niyama abhāvāt etena pipīlika utsaraṇa matsya vikāra ādeḥ varṣa ādi anumānam uktam tatra api bhūta pariṇāmaḥ eva varṣa hetuḥ pipīlikā ādi saṃkṣobha ādi hetuḥ iti

hetunā tu asamagreṇa yat kāryam anumīyate śeṣavat tat asāmarthyāt dehāt rāga anumāna vat samagrāṇi eva hi kāraṇāni yogyatām api anumāpayanti asamagrasya ekānta asāmarthyāt yathā deha indriya buddhibhyaḥ rāga ādi anumānam ātma ātmīya abhiniveśa pūrvakāḥ hi rāga ādayaḥ ayoni śoma naskāra pūrvaka tvāt sarva doṣa utpatteḥ deha ādīnām hetu tve api na kevalānām sāmarthyam asti iti vipakṣa vṛtteḥ adṛṣṭau api śeṣavat anumānāt saṃśayaḥ tathā vipakṣe adṛṣṭi mātreṇa kārya sāmānya darśanāt hetu jñānam pramāṇa ābham vacanāt rāgita ādi vat

na hi rāga ādīnām eva kāryam spandana vacana ādayaḥ vaktu kāma tā sāmānya hetutvāt saḥ eva rāgaḥ iti ced iṣṭa tvāt na kiṃcid bādhitam syāt nitya sukha ātma ātmīya darśana ākṣiptam sa āsrava dharma viṣayam cetasaḥ abhiṣvaṅgam rāgam āhuḥ na evam karuṇā ādayaḥ anyathā api sambhavāt iti nivedayiṣyāmaḥ atra yathā raktaḥ bravīti tathā viraktaḥ api iti vacana mātrāt apratipattiḥ na api viśeṣāt abhiprāyasya durbodha tvāt vyavahāra saṃkareṇa sarveṣām vyabhicārāt prayojana abhāvāt avyāhāraḥ iti ced na parārtha tvāt na yuktaḥ vīta rāga tvāt iti ced na karuṇāḥ api vṛtteḥ saḥ eva rāgaḥ iti ced iṣṭam aviparyāsa samudbhavān na doṣaḥ asatī api ātma grahe duḥkha viśeṣa darśana mātreṇa abhyāsa bala utpādinī bhavati eva karuṇā tathā hi sattva dharma ādi ālambanāḥ maitrī ādayaḥ iṣyante etāḥ ca sajātīya abhyāsa vṛttayaḥ na rāga apekṣiṇyaḥ na evam rāga ādayaḥ viparyāsa abhāve abhāvāt kāruṇikasya api niṣphalaḥ ārambhaḥ aviparyāsāt iti ced na para arthasya eva phala tvena iṣṭa tvāt

icchā lakṣaṇa tvāt phalasya sarvathā abhūta asamāropāt nirdoṣaḥ tad anyena doṣavat tva sādhane na kiṃcid aniṣṭam vaktari ātmani rāga ādi darśanena anyatra tad anumāne ati prasaṅgaḥ vyabhicārāt ananya anumāne iha avyabhicāraḥ iti kaḥ niścayaḥ karaṇa guṇa vaktu kāmate hi vacanam anumāpayet rāga utpādana yogya tā ra hite vacana adarśanāt tad anumāne atiprasaṅgaḥ uktaḥ rāgasya anupayoge katham tat śaktiḥ upayujyate śakti upayoge hi saḥ eva upayuktaḥ syāt tat ca na asti iti uktam tasmāt na antarīyakam eva kāryam kāraṇam anumāpayati tad pratibandhāt na anyat vipakṣe adarśane api sarva darśinaḥ hi darśana vyāvṛttiḥ sarvatra abhāvam gamayet kvacid tathā dṛṣṭānām api deśa kāla saṃskāra bhedena anyathā adarśanāt yathā āmalakyaḥ kṣīra avasekena madhura phalāḥ bhavanti na ca evam bahulam dṛśyante tena evam syāt yuktam vaktum mādṛśaḥ vaktā rāgī iti rāga utpatti pratyaya viśeṣeṇa ātma darśana ayoni śoma naskāreṇa yogāt tadā api apārthakaḥ vacana udāhāraḥ tasmāt vipakṣe adṛṣṭiḥ ahetuḥ

na ca adarśana mātreṇa vipakṣe avyabhicāritā sambhāvya vyabhicāra tvāt sthālī taṇḍula pāka vat na hi bahulam pakva darśane api sthālī antar gamana mātreṇa pākaḥ sidhyati vyabhicāra darśanāt evam tu syāt evam svabhāvāḥ etad samāna pāka hetavaḥ pakvāḥ iti anyathā tu śeṣavat etat anumānam vyabhicāri kim punar etat śeṣavat

yasya adarśana mātreṇa vyatirekaḥ pradarśyate tasya saṃśaya hetu tvāt śeṣavat tat udāhṛtam sa tasya vyatirekaḥ na niścitaḥ iti vipakṣe vṛttiḥ āśaṅkyeta vyatireka sādhanasya adarśana mātrasya saṃśaya hetutvāt na sarva an upalabdhiḥ gamikā tasmāt eka nivṛttyā anya nivṛttim icchatā tayoḥ kaścid svabhāva pratibandhaḥ api eṣṭavyaḥ anyathā agamakaḥ hetuḥ syāt

hetoḥ triṣu api rūpeṣu niścayaḥ tena varṇitaḥ asiddha viparīta artha vyabhicāri vipakṣataḥ na hi asati pratibandhe anvaya vyatireka niścayaḥ asti tena tam eva darśayan niścayam āha tatra anvayasya niścayena viruddha tat pakṣyāṇām nirāsaḥ vyatirekasya anaikāntikasya tad pakṣasya ca śeṣavat ādeḥ dvayoḥ iti eka siddha pratiṣedhaḥ prasiddha vacanena sandigdhayoḥ śeṣa vat asādhāraṇayoḥ sa pakṣa vipakṣayoḥ api

vyabhicāri vipakṣeṇa vaidharmya vacanam ca yat yat āha eṣa tāvat nyāyaḥ yat ubhayam vaktavyam viruddha anaikāntika pratipakṣeṇa iti vaidharmya vacanam anaikāntika pratipakṣeṇa yadi adṛṣṭi phalam tat ca yadi tena vipakṣe adarśanam khyāpyate tat anukte api gamyate

na hi tasya prāk darśana bhrāntiḥ yā vacanena nivartyeta smṛtiḥ vācā darśane kriyate iti ced darśanam khalu apratīyamānam anaṅgam iti yuktam tatra smaraṇa ādhānam adarśanam tu darśana abhāvaḥ sa darśanena bādhyate tad abhāve tu siddhaḥ eva iti apārthakam tad siddhaye vacanam na vai anupalambhamānasya tāvatā na asti iti bhavati tad artham vacanam iti ced na ca na asti iti vacanāt tat na asti eva yathā yadi na asti sa khyāpyate nyāyaḥ tadā na asti iti gamyate

yadi anupalabhamānaḥ na asti iti na pratyeti vacanāt api naḥ eva pratyeṣyati tat api hi anupalambham eva khyāpayati na ca eka anupalambhaḥ anya abhāvam sādhayati atiprasaṅgāt na ca tena na asti iti vacanāt tathā bhavati atiprasaṅgāt tat katham vaidharmya vacanena anaikāntika parihāraḥ tasmāt vyāvṛttim icchatā tatra nyāyaḥ vaktavyaḥ yatas asya vyāvṛttam iti bhavati nanu tad abhāve anupalambhāt siddhā vyāvṛttiḥ yadi adṛṣṭyā nivṛttiḥ syāt śeṣavat vyabhicāri kim

yathā pakvāni etāni phalāni evaṃrasāni vā rūpa aviśeṣāt eka śākhā prabhava tvāt vā upayukta vat iti atra api vivakṣita aśeṣa pakṣīkaraṇe hetoḥ sādhya abhāve anupalambhaḥ asti iti katham vyabhicāraḥ pratyakṣa bādha āśaṅkā vyabhicāraḥ iti eke na pakṣīkṛta viṣaye abhāvāt kadācid bhavet iti ced tathā śaṅkāyām atiprasaṅgaḥ anyatra api abhāva niyama abhāvāt vṛttam pramāṇam bādhakam avṛtta bādhane sarvatra anāśvāsaḥ vyatirekaḥ tu siddhaḥ eva sādhanam iti tathā abhāva niścayam apekṣate anupalambhāt tu kvacid abhāva siddhau api apratibaddhasya tad abhāve sarvatra abhāva asiddheḥ saṃśayāt avyatirekaḥ vyabhicāraḥ śeṣavataḥ kim ca vyatireki api hetuḥ syāt

na idam nirātmakam jīvat śarīram aprāṇa ādimattva prasaṅgāt iti nirātmakeṣu ghaṭa ādiṣu dṛṣṭeṣu prāṇa ādi adarśanāt tad nivṛtti ātma gatiḥ syāt adṛśya anupalambhāt abhāva asiddhau ghaṭa ādīnām nairātmya asiddheḥ prāṇa ādeḥ anivṛttiḥ abhyupagamāt siddham iti ced katham idānīm ātma siddhiḥ parasya api apramāṇikā katham nairātmya siddhiḥ abhyupagamena ca sa ātmakān ātmakau vibhajya tatra abhāvena gamaka tvam kathayatā āgamika tvam ātmani pratipannam syāt na anumeya tvam tasmāt adarśane api ātmanaḥ nivṛtti asiddheḥ tad nivṛttau kvacid nivṛttau api prāṇa ādīnām apratibandhāt sarvatra nivṛttya siddheḥ agamaka tvam yā api asiddhi yojanā tathā sa pakṣe san asan iti evamādiṣu api yathāyogam udāharyam iti evamādikā sā api

na vācyāḥ asiddhi yojanā anupalambhaḥ eva saṃśayāt upalambhe tad abhāvāt anupalambhāt ca vyatirekaḥ iti saṃśayitaḥ anivāryaḥ syāt yathāyoga vacanāt anivāritaḥ eva iti ced na yaḥ eva tu ubhaya niścita vācī iti ādi vacanāt tena anupalambhe api saṃśayāt anivṛttim manyamānaḥ tat pratiṣedham āha kim ca

viśeṣasya vyavaccheda hetu tā syāt adarśanāt śrāvaṇa tvasya api nitya anityayoḥ adarśanāt vyāvṛttiḥ iti tad vyavaccheda hetu tā syāt na hi tad vyāvṛtteḥ anyat vyavacchedanam avyavacchedaḥ tu kutaścid vyāvṛtteḥ eva aniścayāt yaḥ hi yatra na asti iti niścitaḥ sa bhavan tad abhāvam katham na gamayet

pramāṇa antara bādhā ced atha api syāt ubhaya vyavacchede pramāṇa antaram bādhakam asti anyonya vyavaccheda rūpāṇām eka vyavacchedena anya vidhānāt apratiṣedhaḥ vidhi pratiṣedhayoḥ virodhāt na idānīm na astitāḥ adṛśaḥ na evam adarśanam pramāṇam bādhā sambhavāt tathā anyatra api sambhāvyam pramāṇa antara bādhanam

lakṣaṇa yukte bādhā sambhave tad lakṣaṇam eva dūṣitam syāt iti sarvatra anāśvāsaḥ anumāna viṣaye api pratyakṣa anumāna virodha darśanāt anāśvāsa prasaṅgaḥ iti ced na yathā ukte asambhavāt sambhavinaḥ ca atad lakṣaṇa tvāt viruddha avi abhicārya vacanam iti ced anumāna viṣaye avacanāt iṣṭam viṣayam ca asya nivedayiṣyāmaḥ kim ca dṛṣṭā ayuktiḥ adṛṣṭeḥ ca syāt sparśasya avirodhinī

yadi hi anupalambhena abhāvaḥ sidhyet yat āha yadi adarśana mātreṇa dṛṣṭebhyaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ kriyate na ca saḥ api yuktaḥ iti katham ayuktaḥ anupalambhāt abhāva siddheḥ nanu upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāpteḥ sparśasya yuktaḥ eva pratiṣedhaḥ na yuktaḥ dṛśya tad svabhāva viṣaya mātrā pratiṣedhāt pṛthivī ādi sāmānyena gṛhītvā ayam pratiṣedham āha tatra ca tūla upala pallava ādiṣu tad bhāve api sparśa bheda darśanāt asya api kvacid viśeṣe sambhava āśaṅkayā bhavitavyam iti sarvatra adarśana mātreṇa ayuktaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ iti evam ācāryīyaḥ kaścid anupalambhāt abhāvam bruvāṇaḥ upālabdhaḥ api ca deśa ādi bhedāt dṛśyante bhinnāḥ dravyeṣu śaktayaḥ tatra eka dṛṣṭyā na anyatra yuktaḥ tad bhāva niścayaḥ

yadi kathaṃcid vipakṣe adarśana mātreṇa apratibaddhasya api tat avyabhicāraḥ kvacid deśe kānicid dravyāṇi kathaṃcid dṛṣṭāni punar anyathā anyatra dṛśyante yathā kāścid oṣadhayaḥ kṣetra viśeṣe viśiṣṭa rasa vīrya vipākāḥ bhavanti na anyatra tathā kāla saṃskāra bhedāt na ca tad deśaiḥ tathā dṛṣṭāḥ iti sarvāḥ tattvena tathābhūtāḥ sidhyanti guṇa antarāṇām kāraṇa antara apekṣa tvāt viśeṣa hetu abhāve tu syāt anumānam yathā adṛṣṭa kartṛkam api vākyam puruṣa saṃskāra pūrvakam iti vākyeṣu viśeṣa abhāvāt sarva prakārāṇām puruṣaiḥ karaṇasya darśanāt na evam asambhavat viśeṣa hetavaḥ puruṣāḥ yena vacana ādeḥ kiṃcid mātra sādharmyāt sarva ākāra sāmyam anumīyeta sarva guṇeṣu viśeṣa darśanāt
