saṃskāra bhedena viśeṣa pratipatteḥ tadvat anyasya api sambhavāt asambhava anumāne ca bādhaka hetu abhāvāt vairāgya adṛṣṭeḥ adṛṣṭena ca bādhya bādhaka bhāva asiddheḥ rāga ādi avyabhicāri kārya abhāvāt sambhave api viśeṣāṇām draṣṭum aśakya tvāt tādṛśām ca apratikṣepa artha tvāt na evam vākyāni dṛśya viśeṣa tvāt adṛśya tve api adṛṣṭa viśeṣāṇām vijātīyatva upagama virodhāt tad viśeṣāṇām anyatra api śakya kriya tvāt pratyakṣāṇām śabdānām apratyakṣa svabhāva abhāvāt bhrānti nimitta abhāvāt bādhaka abhāvāt bhrāntyasiddheḥ puruṣeṣu viśeṣa darśanasya bādhaka tvāt asamānam para bhāva bhūtasya ca vākya viśeṣasya atad viśeṣa tvāt tat abhinna svabhāvānām sarveṣām puruṣa kriyā na vā kasyacid kim ca

ātma mṛd cetana ādīnām yaḥ abhāvasya aprasādhakaḥ saḥ eva anupalambhaḥ kim hetvabhāvasya sādhakaḥ anupalambham ca asya pramāṇayataḥ ātma vādaḥ nirālambaḥ syāt apratyakṣa tvāt ātmanaḥ tad kārya asiddheḥ indriya ādīnām tu vijñāna kāryasya kādācid ka tvāt sa apekṣya siddhyā prasiddhiḥ ucyate kim api asya kāraṇam asti iti ca tu evaṃbhūtam iti na evam sukha ādi kāryam prasādhitam kaṃcid artham puṣṇāti yena kenacid kāraṇavat tva abhyupagamāt tathā ca anupalambhaḥ eva ātmanaḥ syāt tam tena pratyācakṣāṇaḥ kim iti prativyūḍhaḥ anupalambhasya asādhana tvāt iti katham asādhanam vyatirekam sādhayet

mṛdaḥ khalu api kaścid caitanyam anupalabhyamānam api icchan adarśanāt vacana ādeḥ vyāvṛttim āha dadhi ādikam ca aparaḥ kṣīra ādiṣu apara artheṣu saṃghāta tva adarśanāt vyatirekam kaḥ hi atra niyamaḥ saṃhataiḥ avaśyam para arthaiḥ bhavitavyam iti asti eva upalambhaḥ dadhi ādīnām kṣīra ādiṣu anumānam aśaktāt anutpatteḥ atha kā iyam śaktiḥ saḥ eva bhāvaḥ uta anyat eva kiṃcid saḥ eva ced tathā eva upalabhyeta viśeṣa abhāvāt anyat ced katham anya bhāve tat asti upacāra mātram tu syāt iti ayam eṣām paraspara vyāghātaḥ

tasmāt tanmātra sambandhaḥ svabhāvaḥ bhāvam eva vā nivartayet yathā vṛkṣaḥ śiṃśapām śākhā ādimat viśeṣasya eva kasyacid tathā aprasiddheḥ sa tasya svabhāvaḥ svam ca svabhāvam parityajya katham bhāvaḥ bhavet svabhāvasya eva bhāva tvāt iti tasya svabhāva pratibandhāt avyabhicāraḥ kāraṇam vā kāryam avyabhicārataḥ

kāraṇam nivartamānam kāryam nivartayati anyathā tat tasya kāryam eva na syāt siddhaḥ tu kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ svabhāvam niyamayati iti ubhayathā svabhāva pratibandhāt eva nivṛttiḥ anyathā eka nivṛttyā anya vinivṛttiḥ katham bhavet na aśvavān iti martyena na bhāvyam gamatā api kim saṃnidhānāt tathā ekasya katham anyasya saṃnidhiḥ gomān iti eva martyena bhāvyam aśvavatāḥ api kim

tasmāt svabhāva pratibandhāt eva hetuḥ sādhyam gamayati sa ca tad bhāva lakṣaṇaḥ tad utpatti lakṣaṇaḥ vā saḥ eva avinā abhāvaḥ dṛṣṭāntābhyām pradarśyate tasmāt vaidharmya dṛṣṭānte na iṣṭaḥ avaśyam iha āśrayaḥ tad abhāve ca tat naḥ iti vacanāt api tad gateḥ yatas tad bhāva hetu bhāvau hi dṛṣṭānte tad avedinaḥ khyāpyete

dṛṣṭānte hi sādhya dharmasya tad bhāvaḥ tanmātra anubandhena tad svabhāvatayā khyāpyate yaḥ kṛtakam svabhāvam janayati saḥ anitya svabhāvam santam janayati iti pramāṇam dṛṣṭāntena upadarśyate anyathā eka dharma sadbhāvāt tad anyena api bhavitavyam iti niyama abhāvāt sādhanasya sādhya vyabhicāra āśaṅkā syāt tena ca pramāṇena sādhya dharmasya tanmātra anubandhaḥ khyāpyate sva kāraṇāt eva kṛtakaḥ tathābhūtaḥ jātaḥ yaḥ naśvaraḥ kṣaṇa sthitaḥ dharmā anyatas tasya tad bhāva niṣedhāt hetu bhāvaḥ vā tasmin sati eva bhāvāt iti dṛṣṭāntena pradarśyate artha antarasya tathā prasiddhe tad bhāve hetu bhāve vā anitya tva abhāve kṛtaka tvam na bhavati dahana abhāve ca dhūmaḥ tathā hi sa tasya svabhāvaḥ hetuḥ vā katham svam svabhāvam hetum vā antareṇa bhavet iti āśrayam antareṇa api vaidharmya dṛṣṭānte prasidhyati vyatirekaḥ yeṣām punar prasiddhau eva tad bhāva hetu bhāvau teṣām

viduṣām vācyaḥ hetuḥ eva hi kevalaḥ yad arthe dṛṣṭāntaḥ ucyate saḥ arthaḥ siddhaḥ iti kim tad vacanena tadā tad pradarśane api kim vaidharmya dṛṣṭānta āśrayeṇa iti manyamānaḥ āśrayam pratikṣipti sma tena eva jñāta sambandhe dvayoḥ anyatarā uktitaḥ arthāpattyā dvitīye api smṛtiḥ samupajāyate

yat āha arthāpattyā vā anyatareṇa ubhaya pradarśanāt iti tatra api dṛṣṭāntena tad bhāva hetu bhāva pradarśanam manyamānaḥ artha āpattyai eka vacanena dvitīya siddhim āha tathā hi yat kṛtakam tat anityam iti ukte anartha antara bhāve vyaktam ayam asya svabhāvaḥ tanmātra anubandhī pramāṇa dṛṣṭaḥ tad bhāva niyamāt iti jñāta tad bhāvasya arthāpattyā anitya tva abhāve kṛtaka tvam na bhavati iti bhavati na hi svabhāvasya abhāve bhāvaḥ bhavati abhedāt anyathā tad bhāve bhavati iti eva na syāt tathā tad abhāve na bhavati iti ukte

tatas eva tad bhāvatā vedinaḥ tathā hi ayam asya svabhāvaḥ yena tad abhāve na bhavati anyathā ayogāt iti tad tad svabhāvatā pratipattyā anvaya smṛtiḥ bhavati tathā yatra dhūmaḥ tatra agniḥ iti ukte kāryam dhūmaḥ dahanasya yena dhūme avaśyam agniḥ bhavati anyathā artha antarasya tad anubandha niyama abhāvāt svātantryam bhāvasya syāt atas tad abhāve api svabhāva avaikalyāt na abhāvaḥ kārye tu avaśyam kāraṇam bhavati idam eva hi kāraṇasya kāraṇa tvam yat artha antara bhāve svabhāva upadhānam kāryasya api tad bhāvaḥ eva bhāvaḥ tat ca asti dhūme

tasmāt kāryam dhūmaḥ iti anvayena vidhita tat kārya tvasya dahana abhāve dhūmaḥ na bhavati iti arthāt vyatireka pratipattiḥ bhavati tathā asati agnau dhūmaḥ na asti iti ukte agniḥ dhūme bhavati avaśyam iti arthāt anvaya pratipattiḥ anyathā hi tad abhāve kim na bhavet iti nanu ca nitya anitya artha kārya tva abhāve api śravaṇa jñānam na bhavati tad abhāve na vai na bhavati tayoḥ eva tatas saṃśayāt anyathā abhāvena niścitāt katham tat bhāva parāmarśena saṃśayaḥ syāt kevalam tu bhāva niścaya abhāvāt na asti iti ucyate yadā punar dṛṣṭāntena na agni dhūmayoḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ pradarśyate

tadā yatra dhūmaḥ tatra agniḥ iti eva na syāt pratibandha abhāvāt kutas agni abhāve dhūmaḥ na asti iti arthāt vyatireka siddhiḥ tathā vaidharmyeṇa abhāva asiddheḥ anvaya smṛtiḥ tasmāt dṛṣṭāntena ayam eva yathā ukta svabhāva pratibandhaḥ pradarśyate eka sadbhāve anyasya prasiddhi artham tad abhāve asambhavāt hetu svabhāva abhāvaḥ atas pratiṣedhe ca kasyacid hetuḥ tau eva hi nivartamānau sva pratibaddham nivartayate iti kasyacid arthasya pratiṣedham api sādhayitu kāmena hetoḥ vyāpakasya vā svabhāvasya nivṛttiḥ hetu tvena ākhyeyā apratibandhe hi katham

ekasya nivṛttiḥ anyasya nivṛttim sādhayet yukta upalabhasya tasya ca anupalambhanam pratiṣedha hetuḥ pratiṣedha viṣaya vyavahāra hetuḥ tad hetuḥ iti uktaḥ svayam tathābhūta anupalambhasya pratiṣedha rūpa tvāt hetu vyāpaka anupalabdhiḥ ubhayasya api hetuḥ iti iyam trividhā api ukta anupalabdhiḥ anekadhā tat tad viruddha ādi agati gati bheda prayogataḥ

trividhaḥ eva hi pratiṣedha hetuḥ upalabhya sattvasya hetoḥ tathā abhāva niścaye vyāpakasya sva ātmanaḥ ca anupalabdhiḥ iti sa prayoga vaśena tad tad viruddha ādi agati gati bheda prayogataḥ aneka prakāraḥ uktaḥ tasya agatyā tad viruddha gatyā viruddha kārya gatyā iti ādi bheda prayogaiḥ yathoktam prāk kārya kāraṇa bhāvāt vā svabhāvāt vā niyāmakāt avinā abhau a niyamaḥ adarśanāt na na darśanāt avaśyaṃbhāva niyamaḥ kaḥ parasya anyathā paraiḥ artha antara nimitte vā dharme vāsasi rāga vat iti antaraślokau api ca artha antara nimittaḥ hi dharmaḥ syāt anyaḥ eva saḥ

na hi tasmin niṣpanne aniṣpannaḥ bhinna hetukaḥ vā tad svabhāvaḥ yuktaḥ ayam eva khalu bhedaḥ bheda hetuḥ vā bhāvānām viruddha dharma adhyāsaḥ kāraṇa bhedaḥ ca tau ced na bhedakau tadā na kasyacid kutaścid bhedaḥ iti ekam dravyam viśvam syāt tatas ca saha utpatti vināśau sarvasya ca sarvatra upayogaḥ syāt anyathā ekam iti eva na syāt nāma antaram vā artha bhedam abhyupagamya tathā abhidhānāt nanu anartha antara hetu tve api bhāva kāle anitya tā aniṣpatteḥ tulyā atatsvabhāva tā na vai kācid anyā anitya tā nāma yā paścāt niṣpadyeta saḥ eva hi bhāvaḥ kṣaṇa sthiti dharmā anitya tā vacana bhede api dharmi dharma tayā nimittam vakṣyāmaḥ tām punar asya kṣaṇa sthita udharma tām svabhāvam sva hetoḥ eva tathā utpatteḥ paśyan api manda buddhiḥ satta upalambhena sarvadā tad bhāva śaṅkā vipralabdhaḥ na vyavasyati sadṛśa apara utpatti vipralabdhaḥ vā

antyakṣaṇa darśinām niścayāt paścāt asya anupalabdhyā asthita upratipatteḥ niścaya kālaḥ iti tadā anitya tā vyavasthāpyate kārya utpādana śakteḥ kāraṇa svabhāva tve api adṛṣṭa tad kāryasya kāraṇa darśane api apratipanna tadbhāvasya kārya darśanāt tad pratipatti vat anyathā artha antaram eva anitya tā syāt anya nimitta tve animitta tve vā tathā ca bhāvaḥ tadvān na syāt tad anupayogāt upayoge vā saḥ eva asya sva ātma bhūtaḥ anitya tā iti kim anyayā svabhāvena vā acalasya artha antara yoge api tad bhāva anutpatteḥ sa ca artha antarāt bhavan anitya tā anyaḥ vā dharmaḥ hetuḥ phalam vā syāt ahetu phalasya asambandhāt tatra bhāva anumānasya asambhavāt tatra

paścāt bhāvān na hetu tvam phale api ekānta tā kutas sa hi niṣpanne bhāve artha antarataḥ paścāt bhavan katham tasya hetuḥ syāt phalasya api na avaśyam hetau bhāvaḥ iti tad bhāva hetoḥ anaikāntika tvam tat na artha antara nimittaḥ dharmaḥ bhāve avaśyam bhāvi iti ananumānam yadi tarhi darśana adarśane na anvaya vyatireka gateḥ āśrayaḥ katham dhūmaḥ agnim na vyabhicarati iti gamyate yasmāt kāryam dhūmaḥ hutabhujaḥ kārya dharma anuvṛttitaḥ yeṣām upalambhe tad lakṣaṇam anupalabdham yat upalabhyate tatra eka abhāve api naḥ upalabhyate tat tasya kāryam tat ca dhūme asti sa bhavan tad abhāve tu hetumat tām vilaṅghayet

sakṛt api tathā adarśanāt kāryam siddhaḥ akārya tve akāraṇāt sakṛt api abhāvāt kāryasya ca sva kāraṇam antareṇa bhāve ahetumat tā eva syāt na hi yasya yam antareṇa bhāvaḥ sa tasya hetuḥ bhavati bhavati ca dhūmaḥ agnim antareṇa tat na tad hetuḥ anya hetuka tvāt na ahetuka tvam iti ced na tatra api tulya tvāt tad abhāve api agnau bhavati iti katham vā tatas anyatas vā atajjanana svabhāvāt bhavet svayam atad svabhāvasya ajananāt tasya ahetutā syāt na vai saḥ eva bhavati tādṛśasya bhāvāt anyādṛśāt bhavan katham tādṛśaḥ syāt tādṛśāt hi bhavan tādṛśaḥ syāt anyādṛśāt api tādṛśaḥ bhāve tad śakti niyama abhāvāt na hetu bhedaḥ bhedakaḥ iti akāraṇam viśvasya vaiśvarūpyam syāt sarvam vā sarvasmāt jāyeta tasmāt kāraṇa bheda abhedābhyām kārya bheda abhedau tat na dhūmaḥ arthāt dṛṣṭa ākāra vijātīyāt bhavati ahetuka tva prasaṅgāt tathā ca nityam sattvam asattvam vā ahetoḥ anya anapekṣaṇāt apekṣātaḥ hi bhāvānām kādācid ka tva sambhavaḥ

sa hi dhūmaḥ ahetuḥ bhavat nirapekṣa tvāt na kadācid na bhavet tad bhāve vaikalya abhāvāt iṣṭa kāla vat tadā api vā na bhavet abhāva kāla aviśeṣāt apekṣayā hi bhāvāḥ kādācid kāḥ bhavanti bhāva abhāva kālayoḥ tad bhāva yogya tā ayogya tā yogāt tulya yogya tā yogyatayoḥ deśa kālayoḥ tadvat tā itarayoḥ niyama ayogāt sā ca yogyatā hetu bhāvāt kim anyat tasmāt eka deśa kāla parihāreṇa anya deśa kālayoḥ vartamānaḥ bhāvaḥ tad sāpekṣaḥ nāma bhavati tathā hi tathā vṛttiḥ eva apekṣā tad kṛta upakāra anapekṣasya tat niyama ayogāt tat niyata deśa kāla tvāt dhūmaḥ atra dṛṣṭaḥ sakṛt vaikalye ca punar na dṛṣṭaḥ tat janyaḥ asya svabhāvaḥ anyathā sakṛt api abhāvāt sa tad pratiniyataḥ anyatra katham bhavet bhavan vā na dhūmaḥ syāt tat janitaḥ hi svabhāva viśeṣaḥ dhūmaḥ iti tathā hetuḥ api tathābhūta kārya janana svabhāvaḥ tasya anyatas api bhāve na sa tasya svabhāvaḥ iti sakṛt api na janayet na vā sa dhūmaḥ adhūma janana svabhāvāt bhāvāt tad svabhāva tve ca saḥ eva agniḥ iti avyabhicāraḥ

agni svabhāvaḥ śakrasya mūrddhā yadi agniḥ eva saḥ atha anagni svabhāvaḥ asau dhūmaḥ tatra katham bhavet dhūma hetu svabhāvaḥ hi vahniḥ tad śakti bhedavān adhūma hetoḥ dhūmasya bhāve sa syāt ahetukaḥ iti saṃgraha ślokau katham tarhi idānīm bhinnāt sahakāriṇaḥ kārya utpatteḥ yathā cakṣu ūrūpādeḥ vijñānasya na vai kiṃcid ekam janakam tad svabhāvam kim tu sāmagrī janikā tad svabhāvā saḥ eva anumīyate saḥ eva ca sāmagrī svabhāva sthiti āśrayaḥ kāryasya atas eva sahakāriṇām api aparyāyeṇa jananam yat api kiṃcid vijātīyāt bhavat dṛṣṭam gomaya ādeḥ śāluka ādi tatra api tathā abhidhāne api asti eva sva bīja prabhavāt svabhāva bhedaḥ hetu svabhāva bhedāt yathā kadalī bījakandodbhavā sphuṭam eva tādṛśam lokaḥ vivecayati ākāra bhedāt tasmāt na su vivecita ākāram kāryam kāraṇam vyabhicarati

anvaya vyatirekāt yaḥ yasya dṛṣṭaḥ anuvartakaḥ svabhāvaḥ tasya tad hetuḥ atas bhinnāt na sambhavaḥ iti saṃgrahaślokaḥ tasmāt sakṛt api darśana adarśanābhyām kārya kāraṇa bhāva siddheḥ bhavati tatas tad pratipattiḥ na anyathā anvaya vyatirekayoḥ niḥśeṣa darśana adarśana āyattatvāt kvacid amūrta tve nitya tva darśane api anyatra anyathā adṛṣṭeḥ kvacid nitya tva abhāve api adṛṣṭasya punar dṛṣṭeḥ iti

svabhāve api avinābhāvaḥ bhāva mātra anurodhini yaḥ hi bhāva mātra anurodhī svabhāvaḥ tatra avinā abhāvaḥ bhāvasya iṣyate tad abhāve svayam bhāvasya abhāvaḥ syāt abhedataḥ yaḥ eva bhāvaḥ bhāva mātra anurodhī svabhāvaḥ iti ucyate saḥ eva svayam vastutas bhāvaḥ sa ca ātmānam parityajya katham bhavet yaḥ eva tarhi kṛtakaḥ saḥ eva anityaḥ bheda abhāvāt pratijñā artha eka deśaḥ hetuḥ syāt na eṣa doṣaḥ yasmāt

sarve bhāvāḥ svabhāvena sva svabhāva vyavasthiteḥ svabhāva para bhāvābhyām yasmāt vyāvṛtti bhāginaḥ tasmāt yatas yatas arthānām vyāvṛttiḥ tad nibandhanāḥ jāti bhedāḥ prakalpyante tad viśeṣa avagāhinaḥ tasmāt yaḥ yena dharmeṇa viśeṣaḥ sampratīyate na sa śakyaḥ tatas anyena tena bhinnā vyavasthitiḥ

sarve eva hi bhāvāḥ sva rūpa sthitayaḥ te naḥ ātmānam pareṇa miśrayanti tasya aparatva prasaṅgāt yat api eṣām abhinnam ātma bhūtam rūpam na tat teṣām tadānīm teṣām abhāvāt tat eva hi syāt abhinnasya bhāvāt tad vyatiriktasya bhinnasya ca abhāvāt tasya eva ca punar bheda virodhāt tat ca ātmani vyavasthitam amiśram eva artha antaram api aneka sambandhe api na tat teṣām sāmānyam atad rūpa tvāt dvi tva ādi saṃyoga kārya dravyeṣu api prasaṅgāt na hi sambandhinā api anyena anye samānā nāma tadvantaḥ nāma syuḥ bhūta vat kaṇṭheguṇena na abhinna pratyaya viṣayāḥ bhūta vat tadā ātmānam eva hi buddhiḥ saṃsṛjantī sāmānya viṣayā pratibhāsate na eka sambandhinau iti bhūta vat tad darśinyāḥ sā bhrāntiḥ iti ced tad darśinī iti kutas nirbīja bhrānti ayogāt iti ced te eva tad eka kāryā bījam saṃkhyā saṃyoga kārya dravya ādimatsu bhūtādiṣu abhāvāt ca tat na tathā sāmānya buddhau niveṣa abhāvāt sāmānyam anyat sati vā tasya api sva ātmani vyavasthānāt amiśraṇam anyena

tasmāt ime bhāvāḥ sajātīya abhimatāt anyasmāt ca vyatiriktāḥ svabhāvena eka rūpa tvāt yatas yatas bhinnāḥ tad bheda pratyāyanāya kṛta saṃniveśaiḥ śabdaiḥ tatas tatas bhedam upādāya svabhāva abhede api aneka dharmāṇaḥ pratīyante te api śabdāḥ sarva bhedān ākṣepe api eka bheda codanāt tad sva lakṣaṇa niṣṭhāḥ eva bhavanti tat ekasmāt api tasya bhedaḥ asti iti tasmāt ekasya bhāvasya yāvanti para rūpāṇi tāvat yaḥ tad apekṣayā vyāvṛttayaḥ tad asambhavi kārya kāraṇasya tad bhedāt yāvat yaḥ ca vyāvṛttayaḥ tāvat yaḥ śrutayaḥ atad kārya kāraṇa parihāreṇa vyavahāra arthāḥ yathā prayatna anantarīyakaḥ śabdaḥ śrāvaṇaḥ iti atad kārya kāraṇa parihāra arthaḥ tasmāt svabhāva abhede api yena yena dharmeṇa nāmnā yaḥ viśeṣaḥ bhedaḥ pratīyate na sa śakyaḥ anyena pratyāyayitum iti naḥ eka arthāḥ sarva śabdāḥ tat na pratijñā artha eka deśaḥ hetuḥ iti katham punar etat gamyate vyavacchedaḥ śabda liṅgābhyām pratipādyate vidhinā na vastu rūpam eva iti pramāṇa antarasya śabda antarasya ca pravṛtteḥ tathā hi

ekasya artha svabhāvasya pratyakṣasya sataḥ svayam kaḥ anyaḥ na dṛṣṭaḥ bhāgaḥ syāt yaḥ pramāṇaiḥ parīkṣyate ekaḥ hi artha ātmā sa pratyakṣaḥ asiddhe dharmiṇi sādhana asambhavāt yathā anitya tve sādhye śabdaḥ tasya pratyakṣeṇa eva siddheḥ sarva ākāra siddhiḥ tad anyasya asiddhasya abhāvāt bhāve vā atad svabhāva tvam na hi yaḥ yat eka yogakṣemaḥ na bhavati sa tad svabhāvaḥ yuktaḥ tanmātra nibandhana tvāt bheda vyavahārasya anyathā abhāva prasaṅgāt iti uktam tasmāt pratyakṣe dharmiṇi tad svabhāva sākalya paricchedāt tatra anavakāśā pramāṇa antara vṛttiḥ syāt no ced bhrānti nimittena saṃyojyeta guṇa antaram śuktau vā rajata ākāraḥ rūpa sādharmya darśanāt

yadi dṛṣṭa sarva tattvasya api bhāvasya tathā niścaya pratirodhinā bhrānti nimittena guṇa antaram na saṃyojyate yathā śuktau rajata ākāraḥ na hi śuktau dve rūpe samānam viśiṣṭam ca tathā pratipatti prasaṅgāt apratipattau vā vivekena dvi tva vikalpā yogāt atiprasaṅgāt ca tasmāt paśyan śukti rūpam viśiṣṭam eva paśyati niścaya pratyaya vaikalyāt tu aniścinvan tad sāmānyam paśyāmi iti manyate tatas asya rajata samāropaḥ tathā sadṛśa apara apara utpattyā alakṣita nānā tvasya tad bhāva samāropāt sthitaḥ bhrāntiḥ yāvantaḥ asya para bhāvāḥ tāvantaḥ eva yathāsvam nimitta bhāvinaḥ samāropāḥ iti tad vyavacchedakāni bhavanti pramāṇāni sa phalāni syuḥ teṣām tu vyavaccheda phalānām na apratīta vastu aṃśa pratyāyane pravṛttiḥ tasya dṛṣṭa tvāt anaṃśasya ca eka deśena darśana ayogāt

tasmāt dṛṣṭasya bhāvasya dṛṣṭaḥ eva akhilaḥ guṇaḥ bhrānteḥ niścīyate naḥ iti sādhanam sampravartate iti saṃgrahaślokaḥ tasmāt na adṛṣṭa grahaṇāya dṛṣṭe pramāṇa antara vṛttiḥ vastu grahe anumānāt ca dharmasya ekasya niścaye sarva dharma grahaḥ apohe na ayam doṣaḥ prasajyate

na kevalam pratyakṣa dṛṣṭe pramāṇa antarāvṛttiḥ kvacid yadā anumānam api vastu vidhinā pratyāyayati na vyavaccheda kṛt tadā eka dharma niścaye tat avyatirekāt sarva dharma niścayaḥ iti pramāṇa antarāvṛttiḥ na hi tasmin niścite tad ātmā aniścitaḥ yuktaḥ yadā punar anumānena samāropa vyavacchedaḥ kriyate tadā naḥ eka samāra upa vyavacchedāt anya vyavacchedaḥ kṛtaḥ bhavati iti tad artham anyat pravartate nanu na avaśyam viparyāsa pūrvakaḥ eva apratīta niścayaḥ bhavati yathā akasmāt dhūmāt agni pratipattiḥ na hi tatra anagni samāropaḥ sambhāvyate tat na sarvatra vyavacchedaḥ kriyate uktam atra dharmi pratipattau abhedāt sarva pratipattiḥ bhede vā asambaddhasya tatra apratipattiḥ iti tasmāt tatra api tad darśinaḥ tad svabhāva aniścayaḥ kutas viparyāsāt sa ca tam pradeśam tad viviktena rūpeṇa niścinvan agni sattā bhāvanā vimuktayā buddhyā katham aviparyastaḥ nāma tad ākāra samāropa saṃśaya rahitaḥ ca tad pratipattau na liṅgam anusaret na ca tasya anvaya vyatirekayoḥ ādriyeta

tasmāt apoha viṣayam iti liṅgam prakīrtitam anyathā dharmiṇaḥ siddhau asiddham kim atas param iti saṃgrahaślokaḥ kvacid dṛṣṭe api yat jñānam sāmānya artham vikalpakam asamāropitā anya aṃśe tad mātra apoha gocaram yat rūpa ādi darśana anantaram aliṅgam niścaya jñānam bhavati tat katham asati samārope bhavat vyavaccheda viṣayam bhavati samāropa viṣaye tasya abhāvāt yatra hi asya samāropaḥ yathā sthiraḥ sa ātmakaḥ iti vā na tatra bhede niścayaḥ bhavati

niścaya āra upamanasoḥ bādhya bādhaka bhāvataḥ na hi sarvatas bhinnaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ api bhāvaḥ tathā eva pratyabhijñāyate kvacid bhede vyavadhāna sambhavāt yathā śukteḥ śukti tve yatra tu pratipattuḥ bhrānti nimittam na asti tatra eva asya tad darśana aviśeṣe api smārtaḥ niścayaḥ bhavati samāropa niścayayoḥ bādhya bādhaka bhāvāt niścayasya

samāropa viveke asya pravṛttiḥ iti gamyate tad vivekaḥ eva ca anya apohaḥ tasmāt tat api tad mātra apoha gocaram na vastu svabhāva niścaya ātmakam tathā hi kasyacid niścaye api anyasya apratipatti darśanāt tad svabhāva niścaye ca tasya ayogāt yāvantaḥ aṃśa samāropāḥ tad nirāse viniścayāḥ tāvantāḥ eva śabdāḥ ca tena te bhinna gocarāḥ anyathā ekena śabdena vyāptaḥ ekatra vastuni buddhyā vā na anya viṣayaḥ iti paryāyatā bhavet

iti antaraślokaḥ yasya api nānā upādheḥ dhīḥ grāhikā arthasya bhedinaḥ yaḥ api manyate bhinnāḥ eva upādhayaḥ parasparam āśrayāt ca tad nibandhanāḥ śrutayaḥ tad ādhāreṣu vartante tatra eva vā tat ayam aprasaṅgaḥ iti tasya api nānā upādhi upakāra aṅga śakti abhinna ātmanaḥ grahe sarva ātmanā upakārasya kaḥ bhedakaḥ syāt aniścitaḥ

yadi api upādhayaḥ bhinnāḥ eva śabda jñāna antarāṇām nimittam arthe sa tu taiḥ tadvān ekaḥ eva upalīyate tasya nānā upādhīnām upakāra āśraya śakti svabhāvasya sva ātmani abhedāt sarva ātmanā grahaṇe kaḥ eva upādhi bhedaḥ aniścitaḥ syāt sarva upādhi upakāraka tvena grahaṇāt na hi upakāraka tvam anyat eva tasya sva rūpeṇa gṛhyamāṇasya agṛhītam nāma atas yat eva asya svabhāvena grahaṇam tat eva upakāra tvena api iti tayoḥ ātmani sambandhāt eka jñāne dvaya grahaḥ

ātma bhūtasya upādhi tadvatoḥ upakārya upakāraka bhāvasya grahaṇāt eka jñāne dvayoḥ api grahaṇam iti eka upādhi viśiṣṭe api tasmin gṛhyamāṇe sarva upādhīnām grahaṇam tad grahaṇana antarīyaka tvāt upādhimat grahaṇasya anyathā tathā api na gṛhyeta na hi anyaḥ eva anya upakārakaḥ yaḥ na gṛhītaḥ syāt na ca api upakārake tathā gṛhīte upakārya agrahaṇam tasya api agrahaṇa prasaṅgāt sva svāmi tva vat tasmāt artha antara upādhi vāde api samānaḥ prasaṅgaḥ atha api syāt bhinnāḥ eva śaktayaḥ śaktimataḥ yābhiḥ upādhīn upakaroti tatas na ayam prasaṅgaḥ iti dharma upakāra śaktīnām bhede tāḥ tasya kim yadi na upakāraḥ tatas tāsām tathā syāt anavasthitiḥ

yadi pratyupādhi upakāraka tvāni tasya na sva ātma bhūtāni eva na api tatas upakāram anubhavanti kim tasya iti tāḥ ucyante upakāre vā sva ātma bhūtābhiḥ ayam ekaḥ śaktibhiḥ śaktīḥ upakurvan ekaḥ upādhinā api gṛhyamāṇaḥ sarva ātmanā gṛhyate eva tathā hi eka upādhi grahaṇe tad upakāriṇyāḥ śakteḥ grahaṇam tad grahaṇe tad upakārī bhāvaḥ sva ātma bhūta sakala śakti upakāraḥ gṛhītaḥ sarvāḥ śaktīḥ grāhayati tāḥ ca sva upādhīn iti tad avasthaḥ prasaṅgaḥ atha tāḥ api śakti upakāriṇyaḥ śaktayaḥ bhinnāḥ eva bhāvāt evam upādhīnām tad śaktīnām ca aparā parāsu eva śaktiṣu aparyavasānena ghaṭanāt saḥ ekaḥ tābhiḥ kadācid api agṛhītaḥ tad upakāra ātmā tadvat tvena na gṛhyate yadi punar kevalān eva upādhīn śabda jñānāni upalīyeran tadā tasya asamāveṣāt na bhavati tad pratipatti mukhena sarva pratipattiḥ

tadā api tasya śabdaiḥ anākṣepāt na syāt tatra pravṛttiḥ iti vyarthaḥ śabda prayogaḥ syāt artha kriyā āśrayaḥ hi sarvaḥ vidhi pratiṣedhābhyām vyavahāraḥ upādhayaḥ ca tatra asamarthāḥ samarthaḥ ca naḥ eva ucyate iti kim śabda prayogaiḥ tatas ca upādhayaḥ naḥ upādhayaḥ syuḥ kvacid pravṛttau hi kasyacid pradhānasya aṅga bhāvāt tad apekṣayā tathā ucyate tasya śabdaiḥ anākṣepāt na te kasyacid aṅga bhūtāḥ iti kim upādhayaḥ lakṣita lakṣaṇāt adoṣaḥ iti ced samānaḥ prasaṅgaḥ sa tāvat taiḥ upādhibhiḥ na antarīyaka tayā upalakṣyamāṇaḥ ekena api upalakṣaṇe sarva ātmanā upalakṣitaḥ iti tad avasthaḥ prasaṅgaḥ kaḥ hi atra viśeṣaḥ śabdāḥ vai enam upalakṣayeyuḥ tad lakṣitāḥ vā upādhayaḥ sa tāvat tadānīm niścīyate sarva upakārakaḥ iti na kiṃcid etat tasmāt eka upakārake grāhye naḥ upakāraḥ tatas apare dṛṣṭe tasmin adṛṣṭāḥ ye tad grahe sakala grahaḥ iti saṃgrahaślokaḥ

yadi bhrānti nivṛtti artham gṛhīte api anyat iṣyate syāt etat nirbhāgasya vastunaḥ grahaṇe kaḥ anyaḥ tadā na gṛhītaḥ nāma sa tu bhrāntyā na avadhāryate iti pramāṇa antaram pravartate yadi evam tat vyavaccheda viṣayam siddham tadvat tatas aparam asamāropa viṣaye vṛtteḥ tat tarhi bhrānti nivṛtti artham pravṛttam pramāṇam anya samāra upa vyavaccheda phalam iti siddham anya apoha viṣayam tadvat anyat api asamāropa viṣaye vṛtteḥ yatra asya samāropaḥ na tatrā niścayaḥ iti samāropa abhāve vartamānaḥ anya apoha viṣayaḥ siddhaḥ api ca niścayaiḥ yat na niścīyate rūpam tat teṣām viṣayaḥ katham

iyam eva khalu niścayānām sva artha pratipattiḥ yat tat niścayanam tat ced ākāra antara vat aniścitam katham taiḥ gṛhītam katham idānīm aniścīyamānam pratyakṣeṇa api gṛhītam nāma na pratyakṣam kasyacid niścāyakam tat ayam api gṛhṇāti tat na niścayena kim tarhi tad pratibhāsena tat na niścaya aniścaya vaśāt pratyakṣasya grahaṇa agrahaṇe na evam niścayānām kiṃcid niścinvataḥ api anyatra aniścayena pravṛtti bhedāt grahaṇa agrahaṇam tasmāt tat eva asya grahaṇam yaḥ niścayaḥ anyathā eka ākāre api tat na syāt kim punar kāraṇam sarvatas bhinne vastu rūpe anubhava utpattau api tathā eva na smārtaḥ niścayaḥ bhavati saha kāri vaikalyāt tatas ca

pratyakṣeṇa gṛhīte api viśeṣe aṃśa vivarjite yat viśeṣa avasāye asti pratyakṣaḥ sa pratīyate yadi api aṃśa rahitaḥ sarvatas bhinna svabhāvaḥ bhāvaḥ anubhūtaḥ tathā api na sarva bhedeṣu tāvatā niścayaḥ bhavati kāraṇa antara apekṣya tvāt anubhavaḥ hi yathā avikalpa abhyāsam niścaya pratyayān janayati yathā rūpa darśana aviśeṣe api kuṇapa kāminī bhakṣya vikalpāḥ tatra buddhi pāṭavam tad vāsanā abhyāsaḥ prakaraṇam iti ādayaḥ anubhavāt bheda niścaya utpatti sahakāriṇaḥ teṣām eva ca pratyāsatti tāratamya ādi bhedāt paurvāparyam yathā janakatvā adhyāpakatva aviśeṣe api pitaram āyāntam dṛṣṭvā pitā me āgacchati naḥ upādhyāyaḥ iti saḥ api bhavat niścayaḥ asati bhrānti kāraṇe bhavati tasmāt na abhūtaḥ iti eva sarva ākāra niścayaḥ

tatra api ca anya vyāvṛttiḥ anya vyāvṛttaḥ iti api śabdāḥ ca niścayāḥ ca eva saṃketam anurundhate tatra api anya apohe na vyāvṛttiḥ anyā anyaḥ eva vyāvṛttaḥ tad vyāvṛtteḥ nivartamānasya tad bhāva prasaṅgāt tathā ca vyāvṛtteḥ abhāvaḥ tasmāt yā eva vyāvṛttiḥ saḥ eva vyāvṛttaḥ śabda pratipatti bhedaḥ tu saṃketa bhedāt na vācya bhedaḥ asti nanu ca vācya viśeṣa abhāvāt saṃketa bhedaḥ api ayuktaḥ dvayoḥ eka abhidhānāt tathā ca vyatirekiṇyā vibhakteḥ ayogaḥ tasyāḥ bheda āśraya tvāt dvayoḥ eka abhidhāne api vibhaktiḥ vyatirekiṇī bhinnam artham iva anveti vācye leśa viśeṣataḥ

na vai śabdānām kācid viṣaya svabhāva āyattā vṛttiḥ icchātaḥ vṛtti abhāva prasaṅgāt te yathā vyatirikte avyatirikte vā prayoktum iṣyante tathā niyuktāḥ tam artham pratibandhena prakāśayanti tena gauḥ go tvam iti eka artha abhidhāne api kasyacid viśeṣasya pratyāyana artham kṛte saṃketa bhede vyatirikta arthā vibhaktiḥ artha antaram iva adarśayantī pratibhāti anartha antare api tathā prayoga darśana abhyāsāt na tāvatā sarvatra bhedaḥ anyatra api puruṣa icchā vaśāt pravṛttasya pratibandha abhāvāt yathā ekam kvacid eka vacanena khyāpyate tad aviśeṣe api gaurava ādi khyāpana artham bahuvacanena prayojana abhāvāt tu saṃketa bhedaḥ na syāt tat api asti eva tathā hi bheda antara pratikṣepa apratikṣepau tayoḥ dvayoḥ saṃketa bhedasya padam jñātṛ vāñca anurodhinaḥ

yadā ayam pratipattā tad anya vyavaccheda bhāva anapekṣaḥ piṇḍa viśeṣe aśva vyavaccheda mātram jijñāsate tathā abhūta jñāpana artham tathā ākṛta saṃketena śabdena prabodhyata anaśva tvam asya asti iti yadā punar vyavaccheda antara anirākāṅkṣaḥ tam jñātum icchati tadā aparityakta vyavaccheda antare tatra eva aśva vyavacchede tathā aprakāśanāya prayuñjate anaśvaḥ ayam iti atas eva pūrvatra pratikṣipta bheda antara tvāt śabda vṛtteḥ na sāmānādhikaraṇyam viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāvaḥ vā go tvam asya śuklam iti tanmātra viśeṣeṇa buddheḥ tad āśraya bhūtāyāḥ ekatvena apratibhāsanāt nirākāṅkṣa tvāt ca dvitīye tu bhavati tathā saṃketa anusāreṇa saṃhṛta sakala vyavaccheda dharmaiḥ vibhāgavataḥ ekasya iva sandarśanena pratibhāsanāt vyavaccheda anta rasā kāṅkṣa tvāt ca

bhedaḥ ayam eva sarvatra dravya bhāva abhidhāyinoḥ śabdayoḥ na tayoḥ vācye viśeṣaḥ tena kaścana tasmāt na sarvatra dharma dharmi vācinoḥ śabdayoḥ vācye arthe niścaya pratyaya viṣaya tvena kaścid viśeṣaḥ ekaḥ tam eva pratyāyayan pratikṣipta bheda antaraḥ pratyāyayati anyaḥ pratikṣepeṇa iti ayam viśeṣaḥ jijñāpayiṣuḥ artham tam tat hitena kṛtā api vā anyena vā yadi brūyāt bhedaḥ na asti tatas aparaḥ

etāvantam eva ca bhedam darśayan tad hitena vā darśayet pācaka tvam iti kṛtā api vā pākaḥ iti anyena vā tathābhūta jñāpanāya svayam kṛtena samayena na punar tathā abhidhāna mātreṇa artha antaram eva tat bhavati tathābhūtasya eva jñāpanāya śabdasya kṛta saṃketa tvāt nanu ca pācaka tvam iti sambandhaḥ ucyate na pākaḥ eva na vai pākena anyaḥ eva kaścid pācakaḥ nāma abhidhīyate yādṛśaḥ varṇyate yat punar asya abhidheyam tat kathitam tat eva pācaka tvena api iti alam apratiṣṭhaiḥ mithyā vikalpaiḥ yathā ca na artha antara bhūtā kriyā asti tad samavāyaḥ vā tat pratyāyayiṣyāmaḥ tena anya apoha viṣaye tadvat pakṣa upavarṇanam pratyākhyātam pṛthaktve hi syāt doṣaḥ jāti tadvatoḥ

yat āhuḥ anya apohe api śabda arthe tad viśiṣṭasya abhidhānāt tadvat pakṣa uditaḥ sarvaḥ prasaṅgaḥ samānaḥ iti tat api anena prativyūḍham tatra hi artha antaram upādāya anyatra vartamānaḥ dhvaniḥ asvātantrya ādi doṣaiḥ upadrūyate na ca artha antaram anyasmāt vyāvṛttiḥ vyāvṛttāt dvayoḥ eka abhidhānāt iti uktam katham idānīm ekasya vyāvṛttasya anyān anugamāt anya vyāvṛttiḥ sāmānyam tad buddhau tathā pratibhāsanāt na vai kiṃcid sāmānyam nāma asti śabda āśrayā buddhiḥ anādi vāsanā sāmarthyāt asaṃsṛṣṭān api dharmān saṃsṛjantī jāyate tasyāḥ pratibhāsa vaśena sāmānyam sāmānādhikaraṇyam ca vyavasthāpyate asat arthaḥ api arthānām saṃsarga bheda abhāvāt tasya sarvasya tad kārya kāraṇa tayā anyebhyaḥ bhidyamānāḥ arthāḥ samāśrayaḥ dhvaniḥ ca aniṣṭa parihāreṇa pravartayati iti anya apoha viṣayaḥ uktaḥ

tatra anapekṣita bāhya tattvaḥ buddhi pratibhāsa vaśād ekaḥ aneka vyāvṛttaḥ śabdaiḥ viṣayīkriyate tad anubhava ahita vāsanā prabodha janmabhiḥ vikalpaiḥ adhyavasita tad bhāva arthaiḥ tatra eva ca ayam dharma dharmi vyavahāraḥ parasparam tattva anya tvābhyām avācyaḥ pratanyate na hi anyaḥ dharmaḥ dharmiṇaḥ anartha antara abhidhānāt na api saḥ eva tad vācinām iva dharma vācinām api vyavaccheda antarākṣepa prasaṅgāt tathā ca iṣṭa pratyāyanāt saṃketa bheda akaraṇam iti etat śabda arthe avācya tvam dharma dharmiṇoḥ vastuni tu sva lakṣaṇe sāmānya lakṣaṇam avācyam abhāvāt nanu ca dharma dharmiṇoḥ abhede bhede vā dṛṣṭāḥ ṣaṣṭhī ādi vibhaktayaḥ dharma bahu tvāt tatra dṛṣṭaḥ vacana bhedaḥ ca dharmiṇi na syāt uktam atra śabdānām svātantrya abhāvāt iti api ca

yeṣām vastu vaśāḥ vācaḥ na vivakṣā para āśrayāḥ ṣaṣṭhī vacana bheda ādi codyam tān prati yuktimat yadi nāma ete śabdāḥ puruṣaiḥ kvacid praṇinīṣitāḥ api na śakyante praṇetum vastu pratibandhāt dhūma ādi vat tadā ayam upālambhaḥ syāt katham ṣaṣṭhī ādayaḥ iti yadā punar yat yathā vācaka tvena vaktṛbhiḥ viniyamyate anapekṣita bāhya artham tat tathā vācakam vacaḥ

na hi vyatireke ṣaṣṭhī bāhulye jasā ādayaḥ iti etat api puruṣa abhiprāya nirapekṣam vastu saṃnidhi mātreṇa svayam pravṛttam te tu tatra tathā prayuñjate iti tatas tathā pratipattiḥ bhavati evam anyatra api kathaṃcid taiḥ prayuktāḥ tathā eva pratīti hetavaḥ bhavanti tatra vācyeṣu puruṣa āyatta vṛttīnām śabdānām avastu sandarśinām yathā abhyāsam vikalpa prabodha hetūnām pravṛtti cintā tad vaśāt vastu vyavasthāpanam ca kevalam jāḍya khyāpanam tathā akṛta vyavasthāḥ śabdāḥ dharma dharmyādiṣu na punar vyatireka vastu bhedāt iti kutas etat tathā vyavahāra ayogāt na hi dharma dharmiṇoḥ bhede tattva rūpa tve vā sāmānya tad sambandha sāmānā adhikaraṇya viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāvāḥ yujyante śabdānām vā yathāvastu vṛttau iti vakṣyāmaḥ yaḥ ca ayam sarvatra vastu kṛtam eva śabda pravṛtti bhedam icchati tasya

dārāḥ ṣaṇṇagarī iti ādau bheda abheda vyavasthiteḥ khasya svabhāvaḥ kha tvam ca iti atra vā kim nibandhanam yadā ekā api strī dārāḥ ekam api sikatā dravyam sikatā iti vyavahāraḥ tatra kim bāhulyam yena evam bhavati śakti bhedaḥ iti ced sarvatra utsannam idānīm eka vacanam eka śakteḥ abhāvāt yatnaḥ ca vyarthaḥ vastu abhedāt anyatra eka vacanam iti ced iha api astu tat ayam nirvastukaḥ niyamaḥ kriyamāṇaḥ svātantryam icchāyāḥ śabda prayoge khyāpayati ṣaṇṇagarī iti ca katham bahuṣu ekavacanam na hi nagarāṇi eva kiṃcid kutas teṣām samāhāraḥ prāsāda puruṣa ādīnām vijātīyānām anārambhāt kutas tad samudāyaḥ dravyam asaṃyogāḥ ca na saṃyogaḥ prāsādasya svayam saṃyoga ātmakasya pareṇa asaṃyogāt ca tatas eva saṃkhyā bhāvaḥ tad saṃyoga puruṣa viśiṣṭā sattā nagaram iti ced

kim asyāḥ niratiśayāyāḥ viśeṣaṇam sattāyāḥ ca eka tvāt nagara bahu tve api nagarāṇi iti bahuvacanam na syāt dvayasya paraspara sahita tā iti ced anupakārya upakārakaḥ kaḥ sahāyībhāvaḥ puruṣa saṃyoga sattānām ca bahu tvāt nagaram iti katham eka vacanam tathābhūtānām kvacid arthe abhinnā śaktiḥ asti sā nimittam iti ced na śakteḥ vastu rūpā vyatirekāt vyatireke vai anupakāryasya pāratantrya ayogāt upakāre vā śakti upakāriṇyāḥ api śakteḥ vyatirekaḥ iti anavasthiteḥ apratipattiḥ tat avyatireke vā ādyāyām api prasaṅgaḥ iti yat kiṃcid etat khasya svabhāvaḥ kha tvam iti vyatireka āśrayā ṣaṣṭhī na syāt na hi tatra sāmānyam asti na api vibhu tva ādayaḥ guṇāḥ tathā ucyante

artha antarasya tad svabhāva tva ayogāt teṣām ca niḥsvabhāva tva prasaṅgāt tasya api artha antara svabhāva tve ati prasaṅgaḥ tathā ca apratipattiḥ evam ṣaṭpadārtha varga ādayaḥ api vācyāḥ na hi tatra sāmānyam saṃkhyā saṃyogaḥ vā sambhavati katham idānīm asati atiśaye khasya svabhāvaḥ iti na tu kham iti eva khasya artha antara sādhāraṇa rūpa aparāmarśena kha śabda pravṛtti nibandhanam rūpam tathā jijñāsāyām evam ucyate nanu sarvatas vyāvṛttasya rūpasya abhidhānam na sambhavati na vai tat eva rūpam buddhau samarpyate anatīndriya tva prasaṅgāt kevalam ayam tathābhūtam pratyāyayiṣyāmi iti śabdena śrotari asaṃsṛṣṭa tad svabhāvam vikalpa pratibimbam arpayati

yat āha adṛṣṭa arthe artha vikalpa mātram iti na evam pratipādya pratipādakābhyām sva lakṣaṇam pratipannam pratipāditam vā bhavati svarga ādi śravaṇe api tad anubhāvinām iva pratibhāsā bheda prasaṅgāt tasmāt ayam apratipadyamānaḥ api bhāva svabhāvam tathābhūtaḥ eva vikalpa pratibimbe tat adhyavasāyī saṃtuṣyati tathābhūta tvāt eva śabda artha pratipatteḥ tena etat evam ucyate śabdaḥ sva rūpam āha iti na punar sva rūpa pratibhāsasyaḥ eva vijñānasya jananāt katham tarhi idānīm ekānta vyāvṛtta rūpeṣu bhāveṣu sāmānyam nāma teṣām asaṃsargāt anyasya ca abhāvāt uktam yādṛśam sāmānyam asaṃsṛṣṭānām eka asaṃsargaḥ tad vyatirekiṇām samāna tā iti api ca

para rūpam svarūpeṇa yayā saṃvriyate dhiyā eka artha pratibhāsinyāḥ bhāvān āśritya bhedinaḥ tayā saṃvṛta nānā arthāḥ saṃvṛtyā bhedinaḥ svayam abhedinaḥ iva ābhānti bhāvāḥ rūpeṇa kenacid tasyāḥ abhiprāya vaśāt sāmānyam sat prakīrtitam tat asat parama arthena yathā saṃkalpitam tayā

buddhiḥ khalu tad anya vyatirekiṇaḥ padārthān āśritya utpadyamānā vikalpikā sva vāsanā prakṛtim anuvidadhatī bhinnam eṣām rūpam tirodhāya pratibhāsam abhinnam ātmīyam adhyasya tān saṃsṛjantī sandarśayati sā ca eka sādhya sādhana tayā anya vivekinām bhāvānām tad vikalpa vāsanāyāḥ ca prakṛtiḥ yat evam eṣā pratibhāti tad udbhavā sā ca saṃvṛtiḥ saṃvriyate anayā svarūpeṇa para rūpam iti te ca tayā saṃvṛta bhedāḥ svayam bhedinaḥ api abhedinaḥ iva kenacid rūpeṇa pratibhānti tat eṣām buddhi pratibhāsam anurundhānaiḥ buddhi parivartinām eva bhāvānām ākāra viśeṣa parigrahāt bahis iva parisphuratām sāmānyam iti ucyate katham idānīm anya apohaḥ sāmānyam saḥ eva khalu anya apohas tam eva gṛhṇatī sā prakṛti vibhramāt vikalpānām vastu grāhiṇī iva pratibhāti sā hi tad anya vivekiṣu eva bhāveṣu bhavantī viveka viṣayāḥ iti gamyate

nanu bāhyāḥ vivekinaḥ na ca teṣu vikalpa pravṛttiḥ iti katham teṣu bhavati vyākhyātāraḥ khalu evam vivecayanti na vyavahartāraḥ te tu sva ālambanam eva artha kriyā yogyam manyamānāḥ dṛśya vikalpyau arthau ekīkṛtya pravartante tad abhiprāya vaśāt evam ucyate tad kāritayā atad kāribhyaḥ bhinnān tathā śabdena pratipādayanti iti pratibhāsa bheda ādibhyaḥ tu tattva cintakāḥ na abhedam anumanyante yadi pratipattṛ abhiprāyaḥ anuvidhīyate anya apohaḥ api sāmānyam mā bhūt na hi evam pratipattiḥ iti na vai kevalam evam apratipattiḥ vyakti vyatirikta avyatirikta eka nitya vyāpita ādi ākāraiḥ api naḥ eva pratipattiḥ kevalam abhinna ākārā buddhiḥ utpadyate tasyāḥ kaḥ āśrayaḥ iti anya apohaḥ ucyate tasya vastuṣu bhāvāt avirodhāt vyavahārasya ca śabda āśrayasya tathā adarśanāt na punar vastu bhūtam kiṃcid sāmānyam nāma asti yathā iyam buddhiḥ pratibhāti yasmāt vyaktayaḥ na anuyanti anyat anuyāyi na bhāsate

na hi imāḥ vyaktayaḥ parasparam anvāviśanti bheda abhāve na sāmānyasya eva abhāva prasaṅgāt anyat ca na tābhyaḥ vyatiriktam kiṃcid tathā buddhau pratibhāti apratibhāsamānam ca katham ātmanā anyam grāhayet vyapadeśayet vā na ca taiḥ sambaddham ekam iti eva sāmānyam bhavati atiprasaṅgāt iti uktam abhinna abhidhāna pratyaya nimittam ekam sāmānyam na sarvam iti ced katham anyatas anyatra pratyaya vṛttiḥ tad sambandhāt saṃkhyā kārya dravya ādiṣu api prasaṅgaḥ asāmānya ātmaka tvāt naḥ iti ced nanu saḥ eva ayam vicāryate kaḥ ayam sāmānya ātmā iti tatra sati sambandhe pratyaya vṛttiḥ tatas sāmānyam iti atra ucyate aneka sambandhebhyaḥ kārya dravya ādibhyaḥ nimitta sambhavāt pratyaya vṛttiḥ tatas ca sāmānya ātma tā anyathā anyatra api mā bhūt viśeṣa abhāvāt tathā ca dravya guṇa sāmānyānām rūpa saṃkaraḥ iti evam tarhi buddheḥ eva pratibhāsaḥ jñāna rūpa tvāt san eva sāmānyam tat na yasmāt

jñānāt avyatiriktam ca katham artha antaram vrajet jñānasya rūpam katham arthānām sāmānyam tasya teṣu abhāvāt tad bhāva adhyavasāyāt tathā abhrāntyā vyavahāraḥ iti ced tatra tathā ajñāna utpatteḥ kim nibandhanam anāśrayasya ca utpattau sarvatra syāt athavā jñānāt avyatiriktam ekasmāt katham anyasya punar jñānasya rūpam syāt vyakti antara bhāvinaḥ te tas ca jñāna antaram vyakti antaram vā avyāpnuvat katham sāmānyam syāt

tasmāt mithyā vikalpaḥ ayam artheṣu eka ātma tā grahaḥ na hi arthāḥ vyatiriktena avyatiriktena vā kenacid ātmanā samānāḥ tathā eṣām grahaṇam mithyā vikalpaḥ eva itaretara bhedaḥ asya bījam saṃjñā yad arthikā yasya pratyāyana artham saṃketaḥ kriyate abhinna sādhyān bhāvān atad sādhyebhyaḥ bhedena jñātvā tad parihāreṇa pravarteta iti saḥ ayam itaretara bhedaḥ tasya eka ātma tā pratibhāsinaḥ mithyā vikalpasya bījam tam eva gṛhṇan eṣa vikalpaḥ sva vāsanā prakṛteḥ evam pratibhāti katham punar bhinnānām abhinnam kāryam yena tad anyebhyaḥ bhedāt abhedaḥ iti ucyate prakṛtiḥ eṣā bhavānām yat

eka pratyavamarśa artha jñāna ādi eka artha sādhane bhede api niyatāḥ kecid svabhāvena indriya ādi vat yathā indriya viṣaya āloka m anaskārāḥ ātmā indriya manaḥ artha tad saṃnikarṣāḥ vā asati api tat bhāva niyate sāmānye rūpa vijñānam ekam janayanti evam śiṃśapa ādayaḥ api bhedāḥ parasparān anvaye api prakṛtyāḥ eva ekam eka ākāram pratyabhijñānam janayanti anyām vā yathāpratyayam dahana gṛha ādikām kāṣṭha sādhyām artha kriyām na tu bheda aviśeṣe api jala ādayaḥ śrotra ādi vat rūpa ādi jñāne

jvara ādi śamane kāścid saha pratyekam eva vā dṛṣṭāḥ yathā vai oṣadhayaḥ nānātve api na ca aparāḥ yathā vā guḍūcī vyakti ādayaḥ saha pratyekam vā jvara ādi śamana lakṣaṇam ekam kāryam kurvanti na ca tatra sāmānyam apekṣante bhede api tad prakṛti tvāt na tad aviśeṣe api dadhi trapusa ādayaḥ syāt etat sāmānyam eva kiṃcid tāsu tathābhūtāsu vidyate tatas eva tat ekam kāryam iti tat ayuktam

aviśeṣān sāmānyasya na sāmānyam tad kārya kṛt tasya api aviśeṣa prasaṅgataḥ tāsām kṣetra ādi bhede api yadi hi sāmānyāt jvara ādi śamanam kāryam syāt tasya aviśeṣāt vyaktīnām kṣetra ādi bhede api cira śīghra praśamana ādayaḥ viśeṣāḥ guṇa tāratamyam ca na syāt viśeṣe vā sāmānyasya svabhāva bhedāt svarūpa hānam dhrauvyāt ca sāmānyasya anupakārataḥ

yadi hi upakuryāt anādheya viśeṣasya ananya apekṣaṇāt sakṛt sarvam sva kāryam janayet na vā tad janana svabhāvam vyaktayaḥ tu kāla deśa saṃskāra vaśena viśiṣṭa utpattayaḥ viśeṣa vat kāryam kuryuḥ iti avirodhaḥ tadvat arthāḥ api kecid svabhāva bhede api eka pratyabhijñāna ādikām artha kriyām kurvantaḥ tad akāribhyaḥ bhedāt abhinnāḥ iti ucyante ekena vai anekaḥ janitaḥ atat janyebhyaḥ bhedāt kim punar anena bheda lakṣaṇena sāmānyena sva lakṣaṇam samānam iti pratyeyam atha anyat eva kim ca atas yadi sva lakṣaṇam katham vikalpasya viṣayaḥ anyatas vā katham artha kriyā sva lakṣaṇe ca anitya tva ādi pratīteḥ atādrūpyam teṣām ca avastu dharma tā

na eṣa doṣaḥ jñāna pratibhāsinī arthe sāmānya sāmāna adhikaraṇya dharma dharmi vyavahārāḥ yat etat jñānam vastu svabhāva grāhiṇa anubhavena āhitām vāsanām āśritya vikalpakam utpadyate atad viṣayam api tad viṣayam iva tad anubhava ahita vāsanā prabhava prakṛteḥ adhyavasita tad bhāva svarūpam abhinna kārya padārtha prasūteḥ abhinna artha grāhī iva tad anya bheda parama artha samāna ākāram tatra yaḥ artha ākāraḥ pratibhāti bāhyaḥ iva ekaḥ iva anartha kriyā kārī api tad kārī iva vyavahāriṇām tathā adhyavasāya pravṛtteḥ anyathā pravṛtti ayogāt tat artha kriyā kāritayā pratibhāsanāt tad akāribhyaḥ bhinnam iva na ca tat tattvam parīkṣā anaṅga tvāt iti pratipādayiṣyāmaḥ

te arthāḥ buddhi niveśinaḥ tena samānāḥ iti gṛhyante kutaścid vyāvṛttyā pratibhāsanāt na sva lakṣaṇam tatra apratibhāsanāt te eva ca kutaścid vyāvṛttāḥ punar anyatas api vyāvṛttimantaḥ abhinnāḥ ca pratibhānti iti svayam asatām api tathā buddhyā upadarśanāt mithyā arthaḥ eva sāmānya sāmāna adhikaraṇya vyavahāraḥ kriyate sarvaḥ ca ayam sva lakṣaṇānām eva darśana ahita vāsanā kṛtaḥ viplavaḥ iti tad pratibaddha janmanām vikalpānām atad pratibhāsi tve api vastuni avisaṃvādaḥ maṇiprabhāyām iva maṇi bhrānteḥ na anyeṣām tad bheda prabhave sati api yathā adṛṣṭa viśeṣa anusaraṇam parityajya kiṃcid sāmānya grahaṇena viśeṣa antara samāropāt dīpa prabhāyām iva maṇi buddheḥ tena na vikalpa viṣayeṣu artheṣu artha kriyā kāritvam na api sva lakṣaṇasya anitya tva ādi abhāvaḥ yasmāt na anitya tvam nāma kiṃcid anyat calāt vastunaḥ

kṣaṇa pratyupasthāna dharma tayā tasya tathābhūtasya grahaṇāt etat evam bhavati anityaḥ ayam anitya tvam asya iti vā tad dharmatām eva avatarantaḥ vikalpāḥ nānā eka dharma vyatirekān sandarśayanti na ca te nirāśrayāḥ tad bheda darśana āśraya tvāt na avastu dharma tā tad svabhāvasya eva tathā khyāteḥ vastunaḥ tu nānā eka vyatireka grahaḥ vibhramaḥ syāt tasya eka aneka kārya kāriṇaḥ tathā abhāva jijñāsāsu tathā abhāva khyāpanāya tathā akṛta sthiti tvāt na vastu bhedāt tasya ekasya aneka tva ayogāt anekasya ca eka tva ayogāt vyatiriktasya ca niṣedhāt

teṣām prakṛti bhedāt yathāvastu śabda artha abhyupagame sāmāna adhikaraṇya ayogāt tad upādheḥ ekasya dvābhyām abhidhānāt adoṣaḥ iti ced anupakāriṇi pāratantrya ayogāt anupādhiḥ pāratantrye ca janya janaka bhāvāt saha anavasthiteḥ dvayoḥ anabhidhānam ekasya buddhyā adhyāhāre na vastu viṣayaḥ śabdaḥ syāt buddhi pratibhāsa viṣaya tve ca sarvam tathā eva astu tathā bhinna upādhim atas ekasya grahaṇe apratibhāsanāt upakārya upakāriṇoḥ api upādhi tadvatoḥ saha avasthānāt adoṣaḥ iti ced na niṣpannasya pāratantrya abhāvāt anupādhi tvam

na aniṣpannasya svarūpa asiddheḥ sarvathā asat pāratantryam iti kalpanā āropitam kṛtvā vyavahāre sarvathā saḥ eva kim na buddhiḥ anuvidhīyate eka śabda pramāṇena viṣayīkaraṇe vastu balāt aśeṣa ākṣepāt tad anya vaiyarthyam ca na syāt buddhi pratibhāsasya nirvastuka tvāt vastu sāmarthya abhāvinām doṣāṇām aprasaṅgaḥ tat abhinnam eka ākāra viṣayīkaraṇe api aniścitāni ākāram ākāra anta rasā kāṅkṣa buddhi grāhyam bhinna śabda artha upasaṃhāre api abhinnam buddhau pratibhāti iti sāmānya viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāva sāmāna adhikaraṇyāni yathāprati iti na virudhyante dharma dharmi bhedaḥ api asya

aneka artha bheda sambhave tad eka artha bheda vidhi pratiṣedha jijñāsāyām tat eva vastu pratikṣipta bheda antareṇa dharma śabdena saṃcodya buddheḥ tathā pratibhāsanāt vyatiriktam dharmam iva aviśeṣeṇa aparam asya svabhāvam dharmi tayā vyavasthāpya pradarśyate tāvatā ca aṃśena dharma dharmiṇoḥ bhedāt bhedavatī iva buddhiḥ pratibhāti na vastu bhedāt yathā ukta doṣāt tathābhūta bheda bāhulya codanayā vacana bhedaḥ sādhya sādhana bhedaḥ ca tad svabhāva samāśrayaiḥ dharma pratibhāsa bhedaiḥ tad svabhāva pratipattaye kriyate iti

tad svabhāva grahaṇāt yā dhīḥ tad arthāḥ iva api anarthikā vikalpikā atad kārya artha bheda niṣṭhā prajāyate tasyām yat rūpam ābhāti bāhyam ekam iva anyatas vyāvṛttam iva nistattvam parīkṣā anaṅga bhāvataḥ arthāḥ jñāna niviṣṭāḥ te yatas vyāvṛtti rūpiṇaḥ tena abhinnāḥ iva ābhānti vyāvṛttāḥ punar anyatas te eva teṣām sāmānya samāna ādhāra gocaraiḥ jñāna abhidhānaiḥ mithyā arthaḥ vyavahāraḥ pratanyate sa ca sarvaḥ padārthānām anyonya abhāva saṃśrayaḥ tena anya apoha viṣayaḥ vastu lābhasya ca āśrayaḥ yatra asti vastu sambandhaḥ yathā ukta anumitau yathā na anyatra bhrānti sāmye api dīpa tejaḥ maṇau yathā tatra eka kāryaḥ anekaḥ api tad akārya anyata āśrayaiḥ eka tvena abhidhā jñānaiḥ vyavahāram pratāryate tathā aneka kṛt ekaḥ api tad bhāva paridīpane atad kārya artha bhedena nānā dharma pratīyate

yathā pratīti kathitaḥ śabda arthaḥ asau asan api sāmānādhikaraṇyam ca vastuni asya na sambhavaḥ dharma dharmi vyavasthānam bhedaḥ abhedaḥ ca yādṛśaḥ asamīkṣita tattva arthaḥ yathā loke pratīyate tam tathā eva samāśritya sādhya sādhana saṃsthitiḥ parama artha avatārāya vidvadbhiḥ avakalpyate saṃsṛjyante na bhidyate svatas arthāḥ pāramārthikāḥ rūpam ekam anekam ca teṣu buddheḥ upaplavaḥ bhedaḥ tatas ayam bauddhe arthe sāmānyam bhedaḥ iti api tasya eva ca anya vyāvṛttyā dharma bhedaḥ prakalpyate sādhya sādhana saṃkalpe vastu darśana hānitaḥ bhedaḥ sāmānya saṃsṛṣṭaḥ grāhyaḥ na atra sva lakṣaṇam samāna bhinna ādi ākāraiḥ na tat grāhyam kathaṃcana bhedānām bahu bhedānām tatra ekasmin ayogataḥ tad rūpam sarvatas bhinnam tathā tad pratipādikā na śrutiḥ kalpanā vā asti sāmānyena eva vṛttitaḥ

iti saṃgraha ślokāḥ kim punar kāraṇam sva lakṣaṇe śabdāḥ na prayujyante yasmāt śabdāḥ saṃketitam prāhuḥ vyavahārāya sa smṛtaḥ tadā sva lakṣaṇam na asti saṃketaḥ tena tatra na na hi śabdāḥ asaṃketitam artham prakāśayanti saṃketaḥ ca vyavahāra artham kriyate api nāma itas śabdāt kṛta saṃketāt uttarakālam imam artham pratipadyeta iti na ca prāk kṛta sambandhasya ekatra sva lakṣaṇe śabdasya paścāt prayogaḥ yuktaḥ tasya deśa kāla vyakti bhedān āskandhanāt tasmāt na sva lakṣaṇe samayaḥ sāmānyam tarhi vyatiriktam avyatiriktam vā vyāpi śabdaiḥ abhidhīyate tat na vyavahāra kāla abhāva doṣaḥ na etat asti yasmāt

api pravarteta pumān vijñāya artha kriyā kṣamān tat sādhanāya iti artheṣu saṃyojyante abhidhāyakāḥ na khalu vai vyasanam eva etat lokasya yat ayam asaṃketayan aprayuñjānaḥ vā śabdān duḥkham āsīta kim tarhi sarve eva asya avadheyaḥ ārambhaḥ phala arthaḥ niṣphala ārambhasya upekṣanīya tvāt tat ayam śabdān api kvacid niyuñjānaḥ phalam eva kiṃcid īhitum yuktaḥ tat ca sarvam tyāga āpti lakṣaṇam iṣṭa aniṣṭayoḥ tena ayam iṣṭa aniṣṭayoḥ sādhanam asādhanam ca jñātvā tatra pravṛtti nivṛttī kuryām kārayeyam vā iti śabdāt niyuñjīta niyoge vā ādriyeta anyathā apekṣaṇīya tvāt tatra anartha kriyā yogyā jātiḥ

na hi jātiḥ kvacid vāha doha upatiṣṭhate na ca tādṛśam prakaraṇam antareṇa loke śabda prayogaḥ vyavahāreṣu vyakteḥ aśakya codana tvāt lakṣita lakṣaṇa artham jāti codanāḥ iti ced aśabda codite sati api sambandhe katham pravarteta na hi kaścid daṇḍam chindhi iti ukte daṇḍinam chinatti na api asambhavāt vyaktau pravṛttiḥ evam hi asambaddha pralāpī syāt na tatas anyatra pravṛttiḥ balīvarda doha codanā vat na ca artha antara codanena artha antarasya lakṣaṇam na hi sambandhe sati api daṇḍa śabdāt daṇḍini pratipattiḥ aniyata sambandha tvāt tatra naḥ iti ced tat tulyam jātau api vyaktīnām apāye kevalāyāḥ jāteḥ avasthānāt

bhrātṛ ādi śabdāḥ tu sambandhi śabda tvāt ākṣipeyuḥ param na tathā go tva ādi śrutayaḥ sambandhi vācinyaḥ apeta vyaktīnām api jātīnām tat śrutibhyaḥ nityam anugamana prasaṅgāt sarvadā tad sambandha yogya tā pratīteḥ iṣṭam eva iti ced sarvadā tarhi go śabdāt apravṛttiḥ sahita asahita avasthayoḥ viśeṣeṇa anākṣepāt vyakti sambandhinyāḥ jāteḥ codanāt adoṣaḥ iti ced sarvadā tarhi tad viśeṣaṇa tvena avasthitā vyaktiḥ ākṣiptāḥ eva iti tadvān abhidheyaḥ syāt na ca jāti vyaktyoḥ kaścid sambandhaḥ anyonyam ajanya janaka tvena anupakārāt tatas lakṣaṇam api ayuktam tasmāt na jātau śabda niveśanam phala abhāvāt evam tarhi

tadvān alam artha kriyāsu iti tatra śabdaḥ niyojyate sa ca sākṣāt na yojyate kasmāt yadi vyaktau śabda niveśanam phalavat sa ca śabdaḥ kasmāt sākṣāt vyaktiṣu eva na niyujyate kim tatra anyena vyavadhinā ānantyāt ced idam samam

syāt etat ānantyāt vyaktīnām aśakyaḥ śabdena sambandhaḥ kartum evam sati idam ānantyam tadvatī api samānam jātyāḥ api hi vyaktasya eva vaktavyāḥ iti akṛta sambandhasya anabhidhānāt avaśyam tatra sambandhaḥ karaṇīyaḥ sa ca na śakyate tad sambandhini karaṇāt tatra api kṛtaḥ eva iti ced uktam atra sambandhe api ekatra kṛtāt anyatra apratītiḥ na ca sambandhaḥ asti iti api ca tad kāriṇām atatkāri bheda sāmye na kim kṛtaḥ yām artha kriyām adhikṛtya ayam artheṣu śabdāt niyuṅkte tad kāriṇām arthānām anyebhyaḥ bhedāt tatra eva ca eṣām abhede kim na śabdaḥ prayujyate tadvat doṣasya sāmyāt ced astu jātiḥ alam parā

syāt etat anya vyāvṛtte api śabda arthe vyāvṛtti viśiṣṭasya tadvataḥ abhidhānāt na tadvat pakṣāt viśeṣaḥ kaḥ hi atra viśeṣaḥ vyāvṛttiḥ jātiḥ vyāvṛttimān jātimān iti astu nāma tadvat doṣaḥ jātiḥ anyā mā bhūt jātim api hi abhyupagacchatā avaśyam bhāvānām bhedaḥ abhyupagantavyaḥ tad abhāve tasyāḥ api abhāva prasaṅgāt sa ca ekasmāt bhedaḥ tad anyeṣām abhedaḥ tad viśiṣṭeṣu artheṣu pratipattiḥ astu sarvathā doṣa parihārasya kartum aśakya tvāt artha antara abhyupagame prayojana abhāvāt tad arthasya anyena sādhanāt tad abhyupagamasya ca avaśyam bhāvi tvāt api ca

tad anya parihāreṇa pravarteta iti ca dhvaniḥ ucyate tena tebhyaḥ asya avyavacchede katham ca saḥ śabdam hi eṣa prayuñjānaḥ artheṣu aniṣṭa parihāreṇa pravarteta iti ca prayuṅkte tatra anyatra ca pravṛtti anujñāyām tad nāma grahaṇa vaiyarthyāt pravṛtti nivṛtti anujñāyām ca eka codanāḥ anādarāt avacanam eva syāt anya vyāvṛtti anabhidhāne tasmāt avaśyam śabdena vyavacchedaḥ codanīyaḥ sa ca abhinnaḥ tad anyeṣu iti jāti dharmaḥ api asti tat niyata abhyupagamam niyata codanam jāti artha prasādhanam ca parityajya artha antara kalpanam kevalam anartha nirbandhaḥ eva yathākalpanam asya ayogāt na vai vyavacchedaḥ na kriyate pravṛtti viṣayam tu kathayadbhiḥ jātiḥ uktā

vyavacchedaḥ asti ced asya nanu etāvat prayojanam śabdānām iti kim tatra sāmānyena apareṇa vaḥ nanu uktam pravṛtti viṣayaḥ pradarśyate iti uktam idam ayuktam tu uktam tathā hi na sā pravṛtti yogyāḥ iti niveditam etat tad dvāreṇa acodite pravṛttiḥ api pratyuktā tadvat codane ca vyavadhānam jāti tadvatoḥ pravṛtti viṣaya tve vyāvṛtti ta dvantau kim naḥ iṣyete vyāvṛtteḥ avastu tvena asādhana tvāt ced tat tulyam jāteḥ tadvataḥ sādhanāt adoṣaḥ iti ced tulyam tat vyāvṛttimataḥ avastu grāhī ca vyāvṛtti vādinām śābdaḥ pratyayaḥ sa vibhrama vaśāt akārake api kāraka adhyavasāyī pravartayati vastu saṃvādaḥ tu vastu utpattyā tad pratibandhe sati bhavati anyathā naḥ eva asti vastu utpatteḥ abhrāntiḥ iti ced na atad pratibhāsinaḥ tad adhyavasāyāt

maṇi prabhāyām maṇi bhrānti darśanena vyabhicārāt ca bhrānteḥ avastu saṃvādaḥ iti ced na yathā uktena eva vyabhicārāt vitatha pratibhāsaḥ hi bhrānti lakṣaṇam tat na antarīyaka tayā tu saṃvādaḥ na pratibhāsā apekṣī vastuni tu yathābhāvam arpita cetasaḥ pravṛttau grāhyasya sāmānyasya anartha kriyā yogya tvāt apravṛttiḥ anyatra ca pravṛttau atiprasaṅgaḥ tadvat grahaṇe ca sāmānya vaiyarthya ādayaḥ proktāḥ jāti grahaṇe api sambandhāt śliṣṭa ābhāsā buddhiḥ pravartayati iti ced tadā na jātiḥ na tadvān ekasya api svabhāva sthiteḥ agrahaṇāt iti para vādaḥ eva āśritaḥ syāt evam tarhi anvayinaḥ kasyacid arthasya abhāvāt prakṛti bhinneṣu artheṣu tat eva idam iti pratyabhijñānam na syāt na eṣa doṣaḥ yasmāt jñāna ādi artha kriyām tām tām dṛṣṭvā bhede api kurvataḥ arthān tad anya viśleṣa viṣayaiḥ dhvanibhiḥ saha saṃyojya pratyabhijñānam kuryāt api anya darśane

uktam etat bhede api bhāvāḥ tulya artha kriyā kāriṇaḥ cakṣuḥ ādi vat iti tām ekām jñāna ādikām artha kriyām teṣu paśyataḥ vastu dharma tayā eva anyebhyaḥ bhidyamānāḥ bhāvāḥ tad vyāvṛtti viṣaya dhvani saṃsṛṣṭam tat eva idam iti sva anubhava vāsanā prabodhena saṃsṛṣṭa bhedam mithyā pratyayam janayanti anyathā na bheda saṃsargavatī buddhiḥ syāt yathā daṇḍiṣu na hi tatra eka daṇḍa yoge api anyatra saḥ eva ayam iti bhavati kim tarhi tat iha iti na ca evam pratyabhijñānam kim tarhi tat eva idam iti tat na tat ekam anekatra paśyataḥ api bheda saṃsarga vat yuktam vibhrama balāt tu tathā jñāne na virodhaḥ nimitta abhāvāt vibhramaḥ ayuktaḥ iti ced te eva bhāvaḥ tad eka artha kāriṇaḥ anubhavadvāreṇa prakṛtyā vibhrama phalāyāḥ vikalpa vāsanāyāḥ hetu tvāt nimittam

marīcika ādiṣu api hi jala ādi bhrānteḥ tau eka abhinna ākāra parāmarśa pratyaya nimitta anubhava jananau bhāvau kāraṇam bhinnau api na hi tatra anyat eva kiṃcid sāmānyam asti yat tathā pratīyeta sattve vā sat artha grāhiṇī buddhiḥ bhrāntiḥ na syāt abhūta ākāra samāropāt bhrāntiḥ iti ced na tarhi sā tad sāmānya grāhiṇī yam eva khalu ākāram iyam āropayati saḥ eva asyāḥ viṣayaḥ iti aviṣayīkṛtasya aśakya samāropāt ākāra antara vat sa ca tatra na asti iti asāmānyam sati sāmānya grahaṇe tad āropaḥ na anyathā atiprasaṅgāt iti ced sati eka kārya kāri grahaṇaḥ iti kim naḥ iṣyate avaśyam ca icchatā api sāmānyam vyaktīnām eka kārya janana śaktiḥ eṣṭavyā

tatas te eva anyebhyaḥ bhidyamānāḥ tādṛśam pratyayam janayanti iti kim atra sāmānyena yathābhāvam eva asaṃsṛṣṭa bhedam kim na pratyeti iti ced aśaktiḥ eṣā vikalpānām avidyā prabhavāt na vai bāhya apekṣāḥ eva bhrāntayaḥ bhavanti kim tu viplavāt āntarāt api keśa ādi vibhrama vat avidyā udbhavāt viplava tve cakṣuḥ vijñāna ādiṣu api prasaṅgaḥ na tasyāḥ vikalpa lakṣaṇa tvāt vikalpaḥ eva hi avidyā sā svabhāvena eva viparyasyati na evam indriya jñānāni vikalpakāni na vā teṣu api eṣa doṣaḥ advayānām dvaya nirbhāsāt iti vakṣyāmaḥ sarveṣām viplave api pramāṇa tad ābhāsa vyavasthā ā āśraya parāvṛtteḥ artha kriyā yogya abhimata saṃvādanāt mithyātve api praśama anukūla tvāt mātṛ saṃjñā ādi vat

marīcikāyām jala jñānasya anyasya ca bhinna bhāva utpatteḥ vibhramasya ca aviśeṣe api abhimata artha kriyā yogya ayogya utpatteḥ artha saṃvādāḥ itarau ayogyāt katham utpattiḥ iti ced vikalpānām artha pratibandha niyama abhāvāt na hi vikalpāḥ yathārtham eva jāyante sati marīcikā darśane jala bhrāntiḥ iti tad udbhavāḥ iti ucyate na tu yathā svabhāvam ajala vivekinā arthena svabhāva anukāra pratyarpaṇena jananāt sā tu viśeṣa lakṣaṇa apāṭavāt pratyaya apekṣiṇā sva vāsanā prabodhena janyate tasmāt bhinna bhāva janmanaḥ vikalpa vibhramāt tat eva idam iti pratyabhijñānam na vyatiriktasya sāmānyasya darśanāt na avyatiriktasya vyakti vat ananvayāt api ca

parasya api na sā buddhiḥ sāmānyāt eva kevalāt na hi paraḥ api enām buddhim kevala sāmānya bhāvinīm vaktum arhati nityam tanmātra vijñāne vyakti ajñāna prasaṅgataḥ yadi hi nityam anayā buddhyā sāmānyam eva gṛhyeta apratītāḥ eva vyaktiḥ syāt anena jñānena tadā kadācid sambaddhasya agṛhītasya tadvataḥ

tadvat tā aniścayaḥ na syāt vyavahāraḥ tatas katham yadā sāmānya grāhiṇaḥ vijñānasya na bhedaḥ ālambana bhāvena upayujyate tadā na tau kadācid api śliṣṭau gṛhītau iti idam asya sāmānyam ayam vā tadvān iti na syāt tathā ca tad pratipattyā tadvati pratipattiḥ na syāt artha antara vat eka vastu sahāyāḥ ced vyaktayaḥ jñāna kāraṇam

syāt etat bhavanti vyaktayaḥ tasya ālambana bhāvena kāraṇam na tu kevalāḥ yadā punar āsām ekam sahakārī asti tadā tad sahitāḥ gṛhyante iti tat ekam vastu kim tāsām nānātvam samapohati nānā tvāt ca eka vijñāna hetu tā tāsu naḥ iṣyate kim vai teṣām bhedānām tena ekena nānātvam nirākriyate nānātvam hi teṣu eka vijñāna akāraṇa tve kāraṇam ucyate

anekam api yadi ekam apekṣya abhinna buddhi kṛt na brūmaḥ anekam ekam pratyayam na janayati bhedāt iti na bhedaḥ janana virodhī kim tarhi kaivalyam tena ekena sahitāḥ janayanti eva evam tarhi tābhiḥ vinā api pratyekam kriyamāṇām dhiyam prati tena ekena api sāmarthyam tāsām naḥ iti agrahaḥ dhiyā

katham idānīm vyaktīnām tatra jñāne sāmarthya gatiḥ pratyekam tāsām abhāve api tad bhāvāt asati sāmānye abhāvāt itarathā ca bhāvāt na eṣa doṣaḥ yathā nīla ādiṣu eka apāye api cakṣuḥ vijñānam bhavati iti na samūhe api teṣām asāmarthyam tathā iha api pratyekam eka apāye api bhavati iti na sarvadā sāmarthyam viṣamaḥ upanyāsaḥ tathā hi

nīla ādeḥ netra vijñāne pṛthak sāmarthya darśanāt śakti siddhiḥ samūhe api na evam vyakteḥ kathaṃcana nīla ādīnām hi cakṣuḥ vijñāne pratyekam api sāmarthyam dṛṣṭam iti samūhe api śaktiḥ aviruddhā tathā na kadācid vyaktayaḥ sāmānya nirapekṣāḥ anvayi vijñānam janayanti tasmāt asamarthāḥ eva vyaktayaḥ tatra iti na tena gṛhyeran

tāsām anyatama apekṣam tat ced śaktam na kevalam atha api syāt na vema rahitaḥ kuvindaḥ paṭam karoti prati ekam vema abhāve api kuvindaḥ karoti iti na tatas eva paṭa utpattiḥ tathā na kevalam ekaika vyakti apāye vijñāna utpattau api sāmānyam tad hetuḥ kim tarhi vyaktīnām ekām kāṃcid apekṣya vijñānam utpādayati evam sati

tat ekam upakuryuḥ tāḥ katham ekām dhiyam ca na bhinnānām hi arthānām eka artha upakriyā virodhinī iti sarvaḥ ayam ārambhaḥ tāḥ ced vyaktayaḥ bhinnāḥ api ekam sāmānyam upakurvanti kaḥ punar āsām vijñānena aparādhaḥ kṛtaḥ yat tat naḥ upakurvanti kim antar gaḍunā sāmānyena yathā asambhinnānām api eka sāmānya upakaraṇa śaktiḥ evam tat eva ekam vijñānam kurvantu kim ca kāryaḥ ca tāsām prāptaḥ asau jananam yat upakriyā

na hi anatiśayam ātmānam asya pūrvavat bibhrataḥ kaścid upakārakaḥ nāma atiprasaṅgāt artha antara janane api tasya kim tena tasya tad āśraya tve anupakāriṇaḥ kaḥ ayam āśraya āśrayi bhāvaḥ atiprasaṅgaḥ vā upakāre api tatra eva tad pratibandhaḥ iti kim anyaḥ tad karaṇāt tad upakārī tad apekṣasya āśrayasya tad upayoge anupakārya tve kā iyam apekṣā nāma tad utpatti dharmā dharmāḥ bhāvaḥ svabhāva pratibandhāt apekṣate nāma anādheya atiśaya ātmā paraiḥ apekṣate ca iti vyāhatam etat tasmāt yaḥ kaścid kasyacid kvacid pratibandhaḥ sa sarvaḥ janyatāyām eva antarbhavati para bhāva utpādane tad anupakārāt akiṃcitkarasya ca anupakārāt tasmāt vyakti upakṛtasya sāmānyasya vijñāna janane janane vyaktam asya tad kāryatā anuyujyate

kevalasya sāmarthye api vyaktīnām kvacid api atra sāmarthya asiddheḥ agrāhya tvam samarthāḥ vyaktayaḥ vijñāne pratibhāsanāt iti ced katham asiddha upakārāṇām pratibhāsaḥ iti saḥ eva sāmānya abhyupagame cintyate yasmāt na anupakārakaḥ viṣayaḥ ati prasaṅgāt na aviṣayasya vijñāne pratibhāsaḥ anupakārakasya aviṣaya tve atīta anāgata ādīnām aviṣaya tvam asatām upakāra asāmarthyāt iti ced bhavantu nāma tad viṣayāṇi nirviṣayāṇi nirviṣaya tve api tad anukārī pratibhāsaḥ tad rūpa anubhava ahita vāsanā utpatteḥ ātma bhūtaḥ eva vijñānasya bhāva abhāva anuvidhānāt ca sāmarthyam na pratibhāsanāt apratibhāsinaḥ api vyakti vyatirekeṇa sāmānyasya bhāvāt pratibhāsinām api keśa ādi viplavānām abhāvāt

abhinna pratibhāsā dhīḥ na bhinneṣu iti ced matam na brūmaḥ anekam eka kārya kṛt na bhavati iti kim tarhi na bhinneṣu artheṣu arpita tad ākārā buddhiḥ abhinna pratibhāsinī syāt na vai sāmānya grāhiṇīṣu sva lakṣaṇa pratibhāsaḥ tad abhāve api tāsām bhāvāt ākāra antareṇa ca sva jñāne pratibhāsanāt aneka ākāra ayogāt ekasya atiprasaṅgāt ca tasmāt naḥ iyam bhinna artha grāhiṇī abhinnā pratibhāti tad udbhavā atad pratibhāsinī api adhyavasāya vibhramāt vyavahārayati lokam sa tu tasyām pratibhāsamānaḥ ākāraḥ na artheṣu asti anyatra bhedāt abhedinaḥ sa ca arūpaḥ

tam eva eṣā gṛhṇatī tathā viplavataḥ iti uktam prāk api ca vastu sāmānya vādinaḥ api hi bhinnāḥ eva vyaktayaḥ katham tāsu abhinna ākārā buddhiḥ iti tulyam codyam na tulyam tatra abhinnasya sāmānyasya sadbhāvāt nanu tatra tasya ābhāsaḥ sataḥ api na lakṣyate sā hi varṇa saṃsthāna pratibhāsavatī vibhāvyate na ca īdṛśam sāmānyam na ca tatas vyatiriktaḥ kaścid abhinnaḥ ākāraḥ asti ākṛti sāmānya vādinaḥ api viśeṣa vat tasya avyatirekāt artha antare avṛttiḥ iti bhedāt na abhinna pratibhāsaḥ yujyate athavā astu

pratibhāsaḥ dhiyam bhinnaḥ samānāḥ iti tad grahāt na eva tāsu abhinnaḥ pratibhāsaḥ asti samānāḥ iti grahāt na hi ekasmin pratibhāse samānāḥ iti yuktam kim tarhi tat eva iti dvayasya grahaṇāt adoṣaḥ iti ced tathā api tat iha iti syāt na samānaḥ iti tat eva tāsām sāmyam iti ced katham anyonyasya sāmyam tad sambandhāt iti ced na pratibaddhasya sambandha ayogāt atiprasaṅgāt ca

katham tāḥ bhinna dhī grāhyāḥ samāḥ ced nanu samānāḥ iti grahaṇāt eva āsu abhinna pratibhāsaḥ na vai tad darśane bhinna abhinnayoḥ pratibhāsanāt samānāḥ iti pratītiḥ kim tarhi eka kārya tā sādṛśyam na hi vayam artha jñāne dvau ākārau paśyāmaḥ apaśyantaḥ ca katham artha dvaya kalpanena ātmānam eva vipralabhāmahe eka kāryāḥ tu vyaktayaḥ kalpanā viṣaya tām upayāntyaḥ tathā anayā vibhramāt miśrīkriyante iti anavadyam etat

nanu dhīḥ kāryam tāsām sā ca vibhidyate pratibhāvam tadvat tad pratibhāsinaḥ vijñānasya api bhedāt katham eka kāryāḥ tat hi tāsām kāryam tat ca bhidyate yat api udaka āharaṇa ādikam ekam ghaṭa ādi kāryam tat api pratidravyam bhedāt bhidyate eva iti naḥ ekam bhedānām kāryam asti na eṣa doṣaḥ yasmāt eka pratyavamarśasya hetu tvāt dhīḥ abhedinī ekadhī hetu bhāvena vyaktīnām api abhinnatā

niveditam etat yathā na bhāvānām svabhāva saṃsargaḥ asti iti tatra saṃsṛṣṭa ākārā buddhiḥ bhrāntiḥ eva tām tu bhedinaḥ padārthāḥ krameṇa vikalpa hetavaḥ bhavantaḥ janayanti svabhāvataḥ iti ca sa tu eṣām abhinnaḥ bhedaḥ iti ucyate jñāna ādeḥ kasyacid ekasya karaṇāt atatkāri svabhāva vivekaḥ tat api pratidravyam bhidyamānam api prakṛtyāḥ eka pratyavamarśasya abheda avaskandinaḥ hetuḥ bhavat abhinnam khyāti tathābhūta pratyavamarśa hetoḥ abheda avabhāsinaḥ jñāna ādeḥ arthasya hetu tvāt vyaktayaḥ api saṃsṛṣṭa ākāram svabhāva bheda parama artham svabhāvataḥ ekam pratyayam janayanti iti asakṛt uktam etat tasmāt eka kārya tā eva bhāvānām abhedaḥ

sā ca atad kārya viśleṣaḥ eva tad anyasya anuvartinaḥ vastunaḥ adṛṣṭeḥ pratiṣedhāt ca na hi dṛśyam vibhāgena apratibhāsamānam asti iti uktam etat sati vā kvacid anāśritam katham jñāna hetuḥ iti pratiṣedhasya ca vidhānāt tad kalpanāḥ ayuktāḥ iti tasmāt saṃketas

api tad vidarthikaḥ eva yuktaḥ yaḥ ayam anyonyam vivekaḥ bhāvānām tad pratītayaḥ eva saṃketaḥ api kriyamāṇaḥ śobheta atatkāri vivekena pravṛtti artha tayā yadi hi na tat prati iti arthaḥ saṃketaḥ tasya vyavahāra kāle api asaṃsparśāt na anya parihāreṇa pravarteta na hi sa teṣām tebhyaḥ vivekaḥ śabdena coditaḥ iti sā ca śrutiḥ akārya kṛti tad kāri tulya rūpa avabhāsinīm dhiyam vastu pṛthak bhāva mātra bījām anarthikām janayanti api atatkāri parihāra aṅga bhāvataḥ vastu bheda āśrayāt ca arthe na visaṃvādikā matā tatas anya apoha viṣayā tad kartṛ āśrita bhāvataḥ

eka svabhāva rahiteṣu artheṣu tam adhyāropya utpadyamānām mithyā pratibhāsi tvāt akārya kāriṇam api tad kārya kāriṇam iva adhyavasyantīm vastu pṛthak bhāva mātra bījām samāna adhyavasāyām mithyā buddhim śrutiḥ janayanti api tad anya parihāra aṅga abhāvāt paramārthataḥ tad vyatirekiṣu padārtheṣu na visaṃvādikāḥ iti ucyate tathā hi sa teṣu vyatirekaḥ bhūtaḥ sarvathā avyatikramaṇīya tvāt na ekaḥ vyatiriktaḥ avyatiriktaḥ vā sarvathā ayogāt tasya samāveśane vastuni dūra utsṛṣṭam eva vastu syāt śabda jñānābhyām tad viṣaya abhimatasya tasya abhāvāt anyasya ca vastu dharmasya kasyacid asaṃsparśāt tatas eva ca sā śrutiḥ anya apoha viṣayayā iti ucyate anya vyāvṛtteṣu artheṣu vyāvṛtti bhedam upādāya aviśeṣeṇa niveśanāt vyavahāre api anya parihāreṇa pravartanāt

avṛkṣa vyatirekeṇa vṛkṣa artha grahaṇe dvayam anyonya āśrayam iti eka graha abhāve dvayāgrahaḥ saṃketā sambhavaḥ tasmāt iti kecid pracakṣate yadi avṛkṣebhyaḥ bhedaḥ vṛkṣaḥ tasya avṛkṣa grahaṇam antareṇa tathā grahītum aśakya tvāt avijñāta vṛkṣeṇa avṛkṣasya api tad vyavaccheda rūpasya aparijñānāt buddhau anārūḍhe arthe na saṃketaḥ śakyate iti eke

teṣām avṛkṣāḥ saṃkete vyavacchinnā na vā yaḥ evam ekam vastu sāmānyam abhyupagamya itaretara āśrayam anya vyavacchedena saṃkete codayanti teṣām tatra api saṃketa karaṇe avṛkṣāḥ vyavacchinnāḥ na vā yadi vyavacchinnāḥ katham jñātāḥ prāk vṛkṣa grahaṇāt ṛte na hi tadā pratipattā vṛkṣam vetti na avṛkṣam tat jñānāya eva tad arthitayā upagamāt saḥ ajānānaḥ katham avṛkṣa vyavacchedam pratipadyeta saṃkete apratipattau ca aparihṛta tad anya niveśinaḥ śabdāt

anirākaraṇe teṣām saṃkete vyavahāriṇām na syāt tad parihāreṇa pravṛttiḥ vṛkṣa bheda vat na hi saṃkete para avyavacchedena niveśitāt śabdāt vyavahāre tad parihāreṇa pravṛttiḥ yuktā śiṃśapā ādi bheda vat atha api syāt avidhāya niṣidhya anyat pradarśya ekam puras sthitam vṛkṣaḥ ayam iti saṃketaḥ kriyate tat prapadyate vyavahāre api tena ayam adoṣaḥ iti ced

na vai vastu sat sāmānya vādinā kasyacid vyavacchedena kiṃcid vidhīyate kim tarhi ekam agratas vyavasthitam vastu sandarśya vṛkṣaḥ ayam iti saṃketaḥ kriyate saṃketa kāle tathā adṛṣṭam eva ayam artham tad sambandhinam vā vyavahāre api pratipadyate iti na samānaḥ prasaṅgaḥ na samānaḥ yasmāt tatra api taruḥ ayam api ayam eva iti prasaṅgaḥ na nivartate

ekam pradarśya ayam vṛkṣaḥ iti api bruvāṇaḥ ayam api ayam eva iti ubhayīm gatim na ativartate tayoḥ ca saḥ eva doṣaḥ na doṣaḥ dṛṣṭa viparītasya su jñāna tvāt ekam hi kiṃcid paśyataḥ anyatra tad ākāra vivekinīm buddhim anubhavataḥ tatas anyat iti yathā anubhavam tad vivecanaḥ vaidharmya niścayaḥ utpadyate sa hi ayam eva vṛkṣaḥ iti pradarśya vyutpāditaḥ yatra eva tam na paśyati tam eva avṛkṣam svayam eva pratipadyate na idam vyavaccheda vādinaḥ sambhavati ekatra dṛṣṭasya rūpasya kvacid ananvayāt darśanena pratipattau vyakti antare api na syāt tathā pratītiḥ evam tarhi tatra api tulyam etat yasmāt

eka pratyavamarśa ākhye jñānaḥ ekatra hi sthitaḥ prapattā tat atad hetūn arthān vibhajate svayam niveditam etat prāk yathā ete bhāvāḥ prakṛti bhedinaḥ api jñāna ādikam ekam kāryam kecid kurvanti na anyaḥ iti tān ayam tatra svayam eva tad hetūn atad hetūn ca vibhajya pratyeti tasya tad buddhi vartinaḥ bhāvān bhātaḥ hetu tayā dhiyaḥ ahetu rūpa vikalān eka rūpān iva svayam bhedena pratipadyeta iti uktiḥ bhede niyujyate tam tasyāḥ pratiyatī dhīḥ bhrāntyā ekam vastu iva īkṣyate

teṣām prakṛtyāḥ eva pratyaya vaśāt tathābhūta vikalpa kāraṇānām anvayāt tat draṣṭuḥ buddhau viparivartamānān tad jñāna hetu tayā tad anya vyāvṛttyā ca atathābhūtān api tathā adhyavasitān avibhakta bāhya ādhyātmika bhedān pratipattā pratipattim anusṛtya ete vṛkṣāḥ iti sva para vikalpeṣu eka pratibhāsān ādarśya vikalpa vijñāne vyavasthitaḥ tad vijñāna hetūn bhedena pratipadyeta iti uktim atad dhetubhyaḥ bhede niyuṅkte tam tasyāḥ pratipadyamānā buddhiḥ vikalpikā bhrānti vaśāt eva eka vastu grahiṇī iva pratibhāti

na punar ekam vastu tatra dṛśyam asti yasya darśana adarśanābhyām bhinna darśane api eṣa vṛkṣāvṛkṣa vibhāgam kurvīta tasya śākhā ādi pratibhāsa vibhāgena daṇḍa vat daṇḍinī agrahaṇāt agṛhītasya ca apara pravibhāgena anupalakṣaṇāt ākṛteḥ api ekatra dṛṣṭāyāḥ anyatra draṣṭum aśakya tvāt tat atadvatoḥ vṛkṣāvṛkṣa tve vyaktiḥ ekaḥ eva vṛkṣaḥ syāt bhavatu nāma ghaṭa ādi śabdeṣu artha antara vyavacchedaḥ atha jñeya ādi padeṣu katham na hi ajñeyam kiṃcid asti yatas bhedaḥ syāt tatas bhedena viṣayīkaraṇaḥ eva tasya jñeya tvāt na eṣa doṣaḥ yasmāt kvacid niveśanāya arthe vinivartya kutaścana buddheḥ prayujyate śabdaḥ tad arthasya avadhāraṇāt vyarthaḥ anyathā prayogaḥ syāt tat jñeya ādi padeṣu api vyavahāra upanīteṣu vyavacchedyaḥ asti kaścana

śabdam hi prayuñjānaḥ sarvaḥ anvaya vyatirekau na ativartate tasya pravṛtti nivṛtti artha tvāt yadi hi ayam na kasyacid kutaścid nivartayet pravartayet vā buddhim yathābhūta anujñānāt sarva vyavahāreṣu na kiṃcid vyāharet vyāhārasya avadhāraṇana āntarīyaka tvāt yathā ghaṭena udakam ānaya iti yadi ghaṭena añjalinā vā udaka ānayanam yathā kathaṃcid abhimatam syāt udakam ānaya iti eva vaktavyam syāt na ghaṭena iti tathā paṃśunā vā anena vā yena kenacid ānītena arthaḥ ānaya iti eva syāt anākṣipta karaṇa karmakam evam ānayanam anyat vā yat kiṃcid anuṣṭhānam vai abhimatam tadā ānaya iti api na brūyāt vyartha tvāt vacanasya tathā vyavahāra upanītānām jñeya ādi padānām api kenacid vyavacchedyena bhavitavyam ananyāśaṅkāyām prayoga ayogāt tatra hi yat eva mūḍha mateḥ āśaṅkā sthānam tat eva nivartyam

anāśaṅkamānaḥ vā kim parasmāt upadeśam apekṣate aśrotṛ saṃskāram ca bruvāṇaḥ katham naḥ unmattaḥ tad saṃskārāya eva śabdānām kṛta saṃketa tvāt avyavahāra upanītaḥ ca naḥ eva kaścid jñeya ādi śabdaḥ asti vākya gatasya padasya artha cintanāt kva punar ete śabdāḥ prayujyante iti prayoga viṣaya cintāyām anya apohaḥ ucyate anirdiṣṭa prayogam tu jñeya śabdasya kaḥ arthaḥ iti praśne na kaścid arthaḥ tatas kvacid apratipatteḥ tathā ghaṭa ādi śabdānām api yāḥ api kvacid prakaraṇe kevala śabda śravaṇāt pratipattiḥ dṛṣṭa prayoga anusāreṇa sa ākāṅkṣa tvāt sā aparisamāpta tad viplavaḥ eva ghaṭa ādi śabdeṣu tādṛśaḥ jñeya ādi śabdeṣu api yathādarśanam asti eva tasmāt sarve eva śabda prayogaḥ kutaścid buddhim nivartya kvacid niveśana arthaḥ tat sāphalyāt

niveśanam ca yaḥ yasmāt bhidyate vinivartya tam tad bhede bhidyamānānām samāna ākāra bhāsini sa ca ayam anya vyāvṛttyā gamyate tasya vastunaḥ kaścid bhāgaḥ iti proktaḥ rūpam na asya api kiṃcana tad gatau eva śabdebhyaḥ gamyate anya nivartanam na tatra gamyate kaścid viśiṣṭaḥ kenacid paraḥ na ca api śabdaḥ dvaya kṛt anyonya abhāvaḥ iti asan arūpaḥ rūpavat tvena darśanam buddhi viplavaḥ

niveśyamānaḥ api eṣa śabdaḥ yasmāt bhidyate tam vinivartya bhidyamānānām bhede samāna rūpa pratibhāsinī ākṣipta tad anya vyāvṛttiḥ niveśyate iti saḥ eva ayam artha antara vyāvṛttyā tasya vastunaḥ kaścid bhāgaḥ gamyate śabdaḥ artha antara nivṛtti viśiṣṭān eva bhāvān āha iti ādinā nirdiṣṭaḥ sa hi tam bhedam kathayan artha antara vyavacchedam ākṣipan eva vartate eka gata bheda codanāyāḥ tad anya vyāvṛtti ākṣepana āntarīyaka tvāt saḥ eva bhedaḥ tad vyāvṛttyā gataḥ bhāgaḥ tad gateḥ tad upādhi tvāt tad viśiṣṭaḥ gataḥ iti ucyate na punar artha antara nivṛttiḥ viśeṣaṇa bhūtā keṣāṃcid arthānām yayā viśiṣṭāḥ śabdaiḥ codyante daṇḍi vat

dvayoḥ hi bhidyamānayoḥ bhedasya ubhaya gata tvāt eka bheda abhidhāne api na antarīyakaḥ tad anyākṣepaḥ bhavati iti tayoḥ na viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāvaḥ eka bheda abhidhāne api anya vyāvṛtti gateḥ anvaya vyatireka codanayā vyavahāra aṅgatām śabdānām darśayan tad vyāvṛttyā gamyate tad viśiṣṭaḥ vā iti āha atas eva ca śabdasya na dvau vyāpārau tad anya vyāvartanam sva artha abhidhānam ca sva artha abhidhānāt eva tad anyavyāvṛtti gateḥ sva arthasya bheda rūpa tvāt na hi anvayaḥ avyatirekaḥ ananvayaḥ vā vyatirekaḥ eka anvayasya parihārya abhāve niṣphala codana tvāt tathā eka parihārasya kvacid sthiti abhāve sa ca ayam bhedaḥ arūpaḥ rūpavat tvena tu asya darśanam kevalam buddhi viplavaḥ eva tena eva aparama arthaḥ asau anyathā na hi vastunaḥ vyāvṛttiḥ vastu bhavati bhedaḥ asya asmāt iti īraṇāt

rūpam hi parama arthaḥ bhedaḥ ced rūpam syāt tad rūpam vā syāt atad rūpam vā tādrūpye tat eva iti na anyaḥ tatas bhidyeta na hi tasya rūpam anyasya syāt na tat eva bhedasya rūpam rūpam ca anyat eva syāt tatas ca bhāvaḥ tasmāt vyāvarteta tatas asmāt tasya bhedaḥ iti na syāt yat khalu yat bhedāt vyāvartate tat eva tat bhavati iti saḥ asya bhedaḥ iti ca na syāt na hi anyonyasya bhedaḥ bhavati sambandha abhāvāt sati vā sa kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ iti rūpam tat janitam bhedaḥ iti aviśeṣāt sarva kāryāṇi sva kāraṇānām vyāvṛttayaḥ syuḥ rūpa antara tve ca bhedasya tatas api asya bhedaḥ iti bheda upādhi tvāt dravya antara vat na bhedaḥ syāt na hi bheda upādhiḥ eva bhedaḥ ayam atas iti viśeṣa nirdeśāt tatas ca upādhi abhāve bhedasya eva abhāvaḥ syāt tasmāt na vyatiriktaḥ tad anyagati abhāvāt ca vastunaḥ na parama arthaḥ katham tarhi abhinnasya vastunaḥ śabdena codane tasya eva anyatas api bhedāt anaṃśaya eka bheda codane sarva bheda gateḥ tatra śabda pramāṇa antarāṇi vyarthāni na syuḥ yasmāt

eka artha śleṣa vicchedaḥ ekaḥ vyāpriyate dhvaniḥ liṅgam vā tatra vicchinnam vācyam vastu na kiṃcana yasya abhidhānataḥ vastu sāmarthyāt akhile gatiḥ bhavet nānā phalaḥ śabdaḥ eka ādhāraḥ bhavati atas uktam prāk yathā saṃsṛṣṭa bāhya ādhyātmika bhedā buddhiḥ svam eva ābhāsam vyavahāra viṣayam artha kriyā yogyam adhyavasāya śabda artham upanayati iti tatra eva ca te śabdāḥ taiḥ taiḥ bhrānti kāraṇaiḥ saṃsṛṣṭa rūpaḥ iva ābhāti yathā saṃketam vicchedāya vyāpriyante na ca eka sādhyam vyavacchedam anyaḥ karoti saṃketa pratiniyamāt na ca vicchinnam kiṃcid vastu ākṣipyate yasya abhidhānāt vastu balena akhile gatiḥ syāt śabdānām buddhi viplava viṣaya tvāt tatra ca avastuni vastu sāmarthya abhāvāt tathābhūta artha darśana dvāreṇa ayam nānā eka dharma bheda abheda pratibhāsa viplava anusārī vyavahāraḥ iti tasya tad pratibandhe sati tat avyabhicāraḥ tatas vitathāt api ante tathābhūtaḥ eva vastuni jñāna saṃvādāt na punar bhinna ākāra grāhiṇām jñāna śabdānām eka vastu viṣaya tvāt nānā phalaḥ śabdaḥ eka ādhāraḥ vyāghātāt yathā varṇite tu buddhi pratibhāsā āśraye na doṣaḥ iti

vicchedam sūcayan ekam apratikṣipya vartate yadā anyam tena sa vyāptaḥ eka tvena ca bhāsate sāmānādhikaraṇyam syāt tadā buddhi anurodhataḥ vastu dharmasya saṃsparśaḥ viccheda karaṇe dhvaneḥ syāt satyam sa hi tatra iti naḥ eka vastu abhidhāyini buddhau abhāsamānasya dṛśyasya abhāva niścayāt

iti antaraślokāḥ tena anya apoha viṣayāḥ proktāḥ sāmānya gocarāḥ śabdāḥ ca buddhayaḥ ca eva vastuni eṣām asambhavāt yadi hi vidhi rūpeṇa vastu eva śabdaiḥ vikalpaiḥ vā api viṣayīkriyeta saḥ ayam sarva artha sarva ākāra pratīti prasaṅgaḥ asāmānādhikaraṇya ādayaḥ ca iti manyamānaḥ praṇetāḥ nyāya śāstrasya anya apoha viṣayau etau prāha tathā hi eka tvāt vastu rūpasya bhinna rūpā matiḥ kutas anvaya vyatirekau vā na ekasya eka artha gocarau

tat ekam anaṃśam vastu katham bhinna ākārābhiḥ buddhibhiḥ viṣayīkriyate ākāra bheda āśraya tvāt bhedasya tasya ca abhedāt tad ā ātmanaḥ api sāmānyasya tad eka yogakṣema tvāt tat ayam anyonya artha parihāreṇa eka viṣayayoḥ vṛtti abhāvāt sāmānādhikaraṇya ādiḥ na ca vastu ātmanaḥ ekasya tatra eva vṛttiḥ avṛttiḥ ca yuktā vyāghātāt na ca anyatra avartamānam sāmānyam syāt sāmānyasya vṛttiḥ na viśeṣasya iti ced na bheda abhāvāt tat hi eka rūpam sāmānyam vā bhavet viśeṣaḥ vā na hi asati rūpa bhede ayam pravibhāgaḥ yuktaḥ sati vai avyatirekaḥ na syāt iti uktam tat ayam avibhāgaḥ anviyāt vā na vā na punar ananvayaḥ anvayī ca yaḥ api bhinnam eva sāmānyam āha tasya api abheda vyavahārāḥ ca bhede syuḥ anibandhanāḥ yathāsvam śabdāḥ bhinnam artham abhidadhānāḥ katham eka artha buddhi āśrayāḥ syuḥ artha antara abhidhāyinaḥ ca anākṣepakāḥ

nirākāṅkṣa tvāt katham viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāva āśrayāḥ sarvatra bhāvāt vyāvṛtteḥ na ete doṣāḥ prasaṅginaḥ yathā hi ekaḥ tasmāt bhinnaḥ tathā anyaḥ api iti bhedasya asāmānya doṣaḥ api na asti pariśiṣṭa abhāvaḥ tu prāk eva uktaḥ api ca eka kāryeṣu bhedeṣu tad kārya paricodane gaurava aśakti vaiphalyāt bheda ākhyāyāḥ samā śrutiḥ kṛtā vṛddhaiḥ atad kārya vyāvṛtti vinibandhanā na bhāve sarva bhāvānām svabhāvasya vyavasthiteḥ yat rūpam śābaleyasya bāhuleyasya na asti tat atad kārya parāvṛttiḥ dvayoḥ api ca vidyate artha abhedena ca vinā śabda abhedaḥ na yujyate tasmāt tad kāryatā api iṣṭā atad kāryāt eva bhinna tā cakṣuḥ ādau yathā rūpa vijñāna eka phale kvacid aviśeṣeṇa tad kārya codanā sambhave sati sakṛt sarva prati iti artham kaścid sāṃketikīm śrutim kuryāt ṛte api tad rūpa sāmānyāt vyatirekiṇaḥ

yaḥ api manyate katham abhinnam artham antareṇa bahuṣu ekā śrutiḥ teṣām asāmyāt eka vṛtteḥ anyatra pratyaya ajananāt apratyāsattike ca pratyaya utpāde ati prasaṅgāt teṣu ca eka śabda niveśana vaiphalyāt eka artha niyoga abhāvāt bhinna svabhāvānām pṛthak niyoge ca tathā coditānām vibhāga aparijñānāt iti tasya api ekam asti iti eva lokena śabdaḥ niveśanīyaḥ tat vai ekam enām śrutim vastu śaktyā eva dhvanayati iti na asti etat kim tarhi kenacid prayojanena kecid śabdāḥ kvacid niveśyante tatra yadi anekam ekatra upayujyeta tat avaśyam tatra codanīyam tasya pṛthak pṛthak codane ati gauravam syāt na ca asya ananya sādhāraṇam rūpam śakyam codayitum na api asya āyāsa asya kiṃcid sāphalyam kevalam anena tatra yogyāḥ te arthāḥ codanīyāḥ te ekena vā śabdena ca udyeran bahubhiḥ vā iti svātantryam atra vaktuḥ tat iyam ekā śrutiḥ bahuṣu vaktrabhiprāya vaśāt pravartamānā na upālambham arhati

na ca iyam aśakya pravartanā icchā adhīna tvāt yadi hi na prayoktuḥ icchā katham iyam ekatra api pravarteta icchāyām vā kaḥ enām bahuṣu api pratibandhum samarthaḥ prayojana abhāvāt eva apravartanam iti ced uktam prayojanam bhinneṣu ekasmāt pratītiḥ atad prayojana bhedena iti uktam na punar svabhāvasya eka tvāt yathāsvam vyavasthita svabhāvānām anyonya rūpa āśleṣāt katham eka svabhāva nimittaḥ śabdaḥ bhinneṣu bhavet iti uktam prāk atad prayojana vyāvṛttiḥ tu bhinnānām aviruddhāḥ iti saḥ eva artha abhedaḥ śabda abhedasya kāraṇam bhavatu tena ime tad prayojanāḥ iti atad prayojanebhyaḥ bhinnāḥ eva uktāḥ na punar eṣām anyā tad kāryatā anyatra anyatas bhedāt yathā cakṣu ūru upāloka manaskāresu ātma indriya manaḥ artha tad saṃnikarṣeṣu vā rūpa vijñāna eka kāryeṣu tad kārya sāmānya codanā sambhave kutas rūpa vijñānam iti vyavahāra lāghava artham kaścid sāṃketikīm śrutim niveśayet yaraḥ rūpa vijñāna hetuḥ śasaḥ vā iti

api nāma sarveṣām tad hetūnām sakṛt pratītiḥ yathā syāt iti na ca atra anugāmi kiṃcid rūpam asti kevalam tad artha tayā te bhāvāḥ atad arthebhyaḥ bhinnāḥ iti bhedaḥ eva eṣām abhedaḥ evaṃjātīyāḥ ca sarve samūha santāna avasthā viśeṣa śabdāḥ ye samastāḥ kiṃcid ekam kāryam kurvanti teṣām tatra viśeṣa abhāvāt apārthikāḥ viśeṣa codanāḥ iti sakṛt sarveṣām niyojana artham ekam ayam lokaḥ śabdam teṣu niyuṅkte ghaṭaḥ iti te api sajātīyāt anyatas ca bheda aviśeṣe api tad prayojana aṅga tayā tad anyebhyaḥ bhidyante iti abhedāt tatas aviśeṣeṇa pratīyante tatra ghaṭasya rūpa ādayaḥ iti api ghaṭa svabhāvāḥ rūpa ādayaḥ udaka dhāraṇa viśeṣa ādi kārya samarthāḥ iti yāvat sāmānya kārya sādhana prasiddhena ātmanā rūpa ādi śabdaiḥ prasiddhāḥ viśiṣṭa kārya sādhana ākhyena viśeṣeṇa viśiṣṭāḥ te evam ucyante na punar atra anyat kiṃcid yathāvarṇita lakṣaṇam dravyam asti tasya tādṛśasya anupalambhāt eka vacanam api tad eka śakti sūcana artham saṃketa paratantram vā

tathā ye hetu phala viśeṣa bhūtāḥ kiṃcid ekam sādhayanti sādhyante vā te api sakṛt pratyaya artham vrīhi ādi śabdaiḥ kṛta saṃketāḥ kathyante iti pūrvavat vācyam ye api pṛthak samastāḥ vā kvacid upayujyante te avasthā viśeṣa vācibhiḥ sakṛt eva śabdaiḥ pratyaya artham khyāpyante sa nidarśanāḥ sa pratighāḥ vā iti tad anyebhyaḥ bheda sāmānyena yathā eka kāryāḥ tad kārya codanāyām tad anya bhedena ghaṭa ādi śabdaiḥ kṛta samayāḥ tathā kāraṇa apekṣayā api anekaḥ ekena vyavahāra artham eva yathā śābaleyaḥ bāhuleyaḥ prayatna anantarīyakaḥ śabdaḥ kṛtakaḥ vā iti tathā tad kārya pratiṣedhena api acākṣuṣaḥ śabdaḥ anityaḥ anātmaḥ iti tad kāraṇa pratiṣedhena api asvāmikaḥ śūnyaḥ iti evam yathāyogam anyat api vācyam śūnyān ityādi śabdeṣu yathākalpanam samīhita ākāram buddhau āropya tad vyavacchedena vyapadeśaḥ kriyate buddhi samīhā sandarśita vibhāga tvāt sarvasya śabda arthasya apratipakṣa doṣa upakṣepa ādayaḥ durmati vispanditāni iti upekṣanīyāḥ atha

eka vṛtteḥ anekaḥ api yadi eka śrutimān bhavet na kevalam eka kāryāḥ tad anya bheda aviśeṣāt eka śabdena ucyante api tu eka vṛttyā api anekaḥ eka śabdena ucyeta kaḥ virodhaḥ syāt uktam atra tasya upalabhya abhimatasya anupalabdheḥ abhāvāt anupalabhyatāyām vā tad darśana āśrayāḥ vyapadeśa pratyabhijñāna ādayaḥ na bhaveyuḥ iti ādi api ca vṛttiḥ ādheya tā vyaktiḥ iti tasmin na yujyate yat etat ekam anekatra vartamānam ekām śrutim vartayati tasya kā iyam vṛttiḥ ādheya tā vā syāt yathā kuṇḍe badarāṇi vartante iti vyaktiḥ vā taiḥ abhivyakteḥ yadi ādheya tā nityasya anupakārya tvāt naḥ ādhāraḥ

nityam hi sāmānyam iṣyate anitya tve apara apara utpatteḥ anekatvāt bheda vat eka pratyaya ayogāt nityasya ca kim kurvāṇaḥ ādhāraḥ syāt tasya tatra samavāyāt ādhāraḥ iti ced kaḥ ayam samavāyaḥ nāma apṛthak siddhānām āśraya āśrayi bhāvaḥ tat eva idam anupakārakasya āśraya tvam na sambhāvayāmaḥ atiprasaṅga bhayāt tasmāt samavāya saṃyogau eka artha samavāya ādayaḥ api vastu sambandhāḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāvāt na vyatiricyante parasparam anyatas vā anupakāriṇām apratibandhāt apratibaddhasya ca asambandhāt yadi api eka artha samavāyinām parasparam anupakāraḥ tatas ekasmāt upakāreṇa bhāvyam abhāve yathā ukta doṣa prasaṅgāt atas sva upakāra dvāreṇa eva param api buddhyā saṃghaṭayya khyāpyate tasmāt tatra api kārya kāraṇa bhāva kṛtaḥ eva pratibandhaḥ tat ayam āśrayaḥ sāmānyasya sva ātmani anupakurvāṇaḥ anapekṣasya ādhāraḥ iti yācitaka maṇḍanam etat katham tarhi idānīm ajanakam kuṇḍam badarāṇām ādhāraḥ pravisarpataḥ śaktiḥ tad deśa jananam kuṇḍa ādeḥ badara ādiṣu

prakṛtyāḥ eva guruṇaḥ dravyasya asamāna deśa kārya utpādana dharmaṇaḥ samāna deśa kārya utpādana bhāvaḥ ādhāra kṛtaḥ tasmāt tad pūrvakṣaṇa sahakāri kuṇḍam tatra eva badara kāryam janayat ādhāraḥ iti ucyate anyathā iha kuṇḍe badarāṇi iti api na syāt na vai tad upakāra kṛtaḥ ayam vyapadeśaḥ kim tarhi saṃyoga kṛtaḥ kim punar sa tayoḥ eva saṃyogaḥ tābhyām jananāt samavāyāt vā sa kim ekatra eva na samavaiti janyate vā tasya asāmarthyāt tat asamartham pṛthak tat sahitam api tādṛśam eva iti anupakāraka tvāt na saṃyogena tadvat syāt sahitasya tad anya upakārāt viśeṣa utpatteḥ sāmarthyam kaḥ ayam ajanya janaka bhūtānām upakāraḥ svarūpasya siddheḥ akārya tvāt para rūpa kriyāyām api tatra anupakārāt ubhayathā kārakasya akiṃcitkara tvena anupakāraka tvāt iti ukta prāyam tasmāt sarve eva vastu sambandhāḥ janakasya eva upayoga viśeṣa vaśāt pravibhāgena kārya kāraṇa bhāvāt vyavasthāpyante tat ayam kuṇḍa ādīnām api ādhāra bhāvaḥ badara ādiṣu janana śaktiḥ eva

na sambhavati sā api atra na hi ayam janana viśeṣa lakṣaṇaḥ ādhāra bhāvaḥ sāmānye sāmānya āśrayasya sambhavati tasya ajanya tvāt tad abhāve api avasthiteḥ na sthitiḥ atha api syāt sthāpakaḥ āśrayaḥ sāmānyasya tatas sthiti hetu tvāt ādhāraḥ na jananāt iti tat ayuktam tasya tad abhāve api sthānāt patana dharmāṇām hi bhāvānām pāta pratibandhāt ajanakaḥ api sthāpakaḥ bhavet atra api yadi kaścid pratibandham na paryanuyuñjīta sa hi pāta pratibandhaḥ na artha antaram eva yaḥ sthāpayitrā kriyeta artha antara tve tatra eva asya upayogaḥ iti kaḥ patataḥ pratibandhaḥ pratibandhāt apāte api tulyaḥ paryanuyogaḥ anavasthā vā tasmāt pāta abhāvaḥ pāta pratibandhaḥ sa katham kenacid kriyate abhāvam karoti iti hi na abhāvaḥ nāma kaścid kāryaḥ
