tasya kathaṃcid kārya rūpa tve abhāva ayogāt tasmāt bhāva kriyā pratiṣedha nirdeśaḥ eṣa bhāvam na karoti iti yāvat tathā ca ayam na kiṃcid karoti iti akiṃcitkaraḥ ca kaḥ kasya sthāpakaḥ nāma tena ayam kenacid apratibaddhaḥ iti na kadācid tiṣṭhet tasmāt pāta pratibandhaḥ iti api kṣaṇikānām bhāvānām upādānasamāna deśa utpādanam ucyate astu nāma ajananam pātinām tad pratibaddhaḥ tad karaṇāt gatimatas dravyasya kaścid sthāpakaḥ api astu sāmānyasya akriyasya kiṃlakṣaṇām sthitim kurvāṇaḥ sthāpakaḥ syāt sthitiḥ hi tasya svarūpa apracyutiḥ eva sā ca naḥ āśraya āyattā nitya tvāt sā api ayuktāḥ eva bheda abheda vivecane

astu nāma āśraya hetukā sthitiḥ sāmānyasya sā sāmānyāt anyā vā syāt ananyā vā sā anyā ced tām eva saḥ āśrayaḥ karoti sā ca apratibaddhā sāmānyaḥ iti kim sāmānyasya āśrayeṇa pratibaddhe vā kaḥ pratibandhaḥ iti vācyam sthiti karaṇam ced tatra api tulyaḥ prasaṅgaḥ anavasthā ca tatas upakārān avadhāraṇāt asya iyam sthitiḥ iti apratītiḥ jananam ced kim āśrayeṇa apekṣitena anupakāriṇā apekṣāḥ iti hi tad pratibandhaḥ sa ca anādheya viśeṣasya sāmānyasya ayuktaḥ iti kevalam janayet iti na asti anyaḥ sthiti hetuḥ abhede vā sthiteḥ sāmānyāt svarūpam eva tat tasya tat ca nityam asti iti na sthitiḥ asya kenacid kriyate tasmāt na sāmānyasya ādhāraḥ asti tat naḥ ādheya tā asya vṛttiḥ atha punar sataḥ api sāmānyasya avyaktasya vyaktyā jñāna kāraṇa tvāt tad vyaktiḥ tatra vṛttiḥ syāt na yuktam evam bhavitum yasmāt vijñāna utpatti yogya tvāya ātmani anya anurodhi yat tat vyaṅgyam yogyatāyāḥ ca kāraṇam kārakam matam prāk eva asya ca yogya tve tad apekṣā na yujyate sāmānyasya avikāryasya tat sāmānyavataḥ kutas

na khalu vai kārakāt vyañjakasya kaścid bhedaḥ sva viṣaya vijñāna utpādana samartham aparam sajātīya upādāna apekṣam anapekṣam vā janayan bhāvam eva vyañjakaḥ ucyate paratra tu jñāna janana śaktiḥ anākṣiptāḥ janyasya iti janana mātreṇa kāraka tvam yaḥ hi yatas vijñāna utpādana yogya tām pratilabhate sa ced na tasya janyaḥ syāt sā asya svabhāva bhūtā yogyatā prāk eva asti iti na vijñāna janane tam apekṣeta para bhūtāyām ca asyām saḥ eva tatas bhavati iti sthiti vat prasaṅgaḥ tasmāt vyañjakaḥ na tam karoti na api anyam iti akiṃcitkaraḥ ca apekṣyate iti vyāhatam etat nanu ajanakāḥ api kāryatvāt dhūma ādayaḥ vyañjakāḥ satyam vyañjakāḥ na tu dhūmam apekṣya agniḥ ātmani jñānam janayati tathābhūtasya agneḥ sākṣāt ajanaka tvāt kevalam upādāna balena eva tatra jñānam utpadyate na viṣaya balena asati api tasmin bhāvāt paraṃparayā liṅga anusāreṇa

na api sāmānya lakṣaṇa avabhāsinām pratyayānām saṃnihita viṣaya tā viṣaya balena utpattiḥ vā iti niveditam etat nivedayiṣyate ca tasmāt ye viṣayāḥ sākṣāt upayogena vijñānam janayantaḥ tatra param apekṣante te avaśyam tatas ātmānam pratilabhante na ca ayam ātma pratilambhaḥ sāmānyasya nityasya kutaścid sambhavati tasmāt na tat kenacid vyaṅgyam na vai yogya tā pratilambham sāmānyasya vyaktim brūmaḥ kim tarhi sva āśraya samavāyam sva āśraya samavetam hi tat ātmani anyatra vā vijñāna hetuḥ iti uktam atra ajanya janakayoḥ kaḥ ayam āśraya āśrayi bhāva lakṣaṇaḥ samavāyaḥ iti sva āśraya samavāya apekṣaḥ vijñāna hetuḥ tena janyaḥ eva syāt tad hetoḥ svabhāvasya prāc abhāvāt paścāt ca tatas bhāvāt nityam tad svabhāva sadbhāve prāk api samavāyāt vijñāna udaya prasaṅgāt na vai vyaktiḥ sāmānyasya saṃskārāt vyañjikā kim tarhi tad grāhiṇaḥ indriyasya saḥ api

añjana ādeḥ iva vyakteḥ saṃskāraḥ naḥ indriyasya ca pratipatteḥ abhinna tvāt tad bhāva abhāva kālayoḥ saṃskṛtam añjana ādibhiḥ indriyam pratipattau kiṃcid atiśayam āsādayati spaṣṭa aspaṣṭa bhedāt atatkāriṇaḥ ca atad saṃskāraka tvāt na evam vyakteḥ indriyasya kaścid saṃskāraḥ tad bhāva abhāva kālayoḥ pratipattim prati aviśeṣāt viṣaya saṃskāraḥ tu indriya aviśeṣe api tad viśeṣa ādhānāt upakārī syāt na indriya saṃskāraḥ prāk adṛśye darśana śakti ādhānāt upakārakaḥ iti ced saḥ atīndriyam artham darśayan katham na pratipatteḥ bhedakaḥ eka pratiniyame ca sāmānya antarasya darśakaḥ na syāt vyaktyā ca indriya saṃskārāt tad darśane tad vyaṅgyeṣu sāmānyeṣu kadācid aniścayaḥ na syāt eka niścayaḥ vā tasyāḥ avibhāgāyāḥ teṣu viśeṣa abhāvāt

vyakteḥ yadi indriya saṃskāraḥ yadi naḥ indriya saṃskāraḥ sāmānyasya vijñāna janana svabhāvaḥ iti svabhāvāt apracyuteḥ anapekṣya eva indriya saṃskāram vijñānam janayet saṃskṛta indriya sahakāri tvāt kevalam asamartham iti ced kaḥ ayam anādheya atiśayasya sahakāra arthaḥ anityāḥ hi bhāvāḥ sahakāriṇaḥ viśiṣṭa ātma lābhāt tam apekṣeran yaḥ hi eṣām janakaḥ ātmā sa tadā eva tatas bhavati iti janyatā eva eṣām parasparataḥ apekṣā sāmānyam punar anāsādya param nityam tad svabhāvam kim iti indriyam apekṣate hi tasya kevalasya yaḥ na tad svabhāvaḥ sa punar kathaṃcid bhāvī vyakteḥ indriya saṃskāraḥ tad sahakāri sāmānyam vijñāna hetuḥ iti api pāraṃparyeṇa vyakteḥ kāryam eva sāmānyam uktam syāt api ca vyañjakasya ca jātīnām jāti mattā yadi iṣyate prāptaḥ go tva ādinā tadvān pradīpa ādiḥ prakāśakaḥ

yaḥ hi yat viṣaya vijñāna hetuḥ sa tasya vyañjakaḥ vijñāna hetu tvam go tva ādiṣu pradīpa ādeḥ api asti tejaḥ saṃskāra apekṣiṇaḥ cakṣuṣaḥ artha pratipatteḥ tatas pradīpa ādayaḥ go tva ādinā tadvantaḥ syuḥ na hi vyakteḥ api jñāna hetu tām muktvā anyā kācid asti abhivyaktiḥ sāmānyasya svabhāva atiśayasya ādhātum aśakya tvāt samavāyaḥ abhivyaktiḥ iti ced uktāḥ uttaram etat tasya samavāya ayogāt iti samavāya mātram hi vyaktyā saha asya jātam na anyaḥ kaścid viśeṣaḥ iti pūrvavat paścāt api na jñāna hetuḥ syāt samavāyāt eva jñāna hetu tve sva āśraya samavāyinām anyeṣām api dṛśyatā āpattiḥ tasmāt jñāna hetu tā eva vyañjaka tvam tat ca tulyam pradīpa ādau iti saḥ eva prasaṅgaḥ tat naḥ ādheya tā na vyaktiḥ vṛttiḥ sāmānyasya iti avṛtteḥ na anekatra jñāna hetuḥ atas eva

vyakteḥ anyā athavā ananyā yeṣām jātiḥ tu vidyate teṣām vyaktiṣu apūrvāsu katham sāmānya buddhayaḥ vidyate eva iti avadhāraṇa arthaḥ tuśabdaḥ vidyamānaḥ hi padārthaḥ sva sāmarthyena anyatra buddhim janayan sva rūpa anukāriṇīm tad sambandham apekṣate anyathā atiprasaṅgāt sa ca sāmānyasya sataḥ tattva anyat tva pakṣayoḥ na sambhavati ekatra dṛṣṭasya anyatra darśana asambhavāt sā hi buddhiḥ eka bhāvinī vyakti antaram evam āskandet bhūta grāhiṇī yadi tatra dṛṣṭam kiṃcid anyatra paśyet tat ca sataḥ ananya tve anvaya abhāvāt anya tve api anapāśrayāt

na sambhavati svabhāvaḥ hi svabhāvāt na tattvam anya tvam vā laṅghayati rūpasya atadbhūtasya anya tva avyatikramāt idam eva khalu rūpasya anya tvam yat na tat ākāra antara vat aviśeṣāt tat ced sāmānyasya rūpam ananyat tat eva tat bhavati atattve vastu antara vat anya tva prasaṅgāt na ca eka vyakti ātmanaḥ vyakti antara anvāveśaḥ avyakti antara tva prasaṅgāt tatas na avyatirekiṇaḥ sāmānyāt anvayinī buddhiḥ syāt na api vyatirekiṇaḥ tasya kvacid anāśrayāt anyasya api vyaṅgya vyañjaka bhāva ādeḥ sambandhasya kenacid anupakāryasya apratibandhena abhāvāt asambandhāt ca jñāna utpattau api prasaṅgāt

tat ayam eka vastu darśanena eka vṛtteḥ pratyayasya anyatra vṛttim icchan tattva anyat tve na atikrāmati iti ayuktam etat tasmāt iyam artheṣu eka rūpā pratītiḥ vikalpa vāsanā samutthitā bhrāntiḥ eva bhāva bhedaḥ vāsanā prakṛtiḥ ca tasya āśrayaḥ iti nirloṭhitam etat katham tarhi idānīm pradhāna īśvara ādi kārya śabdāḥ bhāveṣu atadbhūta bhedeṣu abhedena vartante te api yathā saṃketa ahita vāsanā upaskṛta tvāt vijñāna santateḥ sarva artha darśaneṣu anapekṣya api tad bhedam tathā adhyavasāyāt atathābhūta kalpita vyavacchedena vikalpa vijñāna pratibhāsini arthaḥ upādāna bala prabhava vikalpa samutthitāḥ pravartante

na hi teṣu atathābhūteṣu kiṃcid vyatiriktam avyatiriktam vā sāmānyam asti tathā abhāva kalpanayā tu tad anya bhedaḥ pratipattṛ abhiprāya vaśāt syāt tad abhiprāyāt eva sāmānyam kim naḥ iti ced tena avaśyam hi tatra bhedaḥ na antarīyaka tvāt eṣṭavyaḥ saḥ eva sāmānya kārye paryāptaḥ iti niḥ prayojanā sāmānya kalpanā yadi satsu asatsu vā bhāveṣu sāmānya buddhiḥ na iyam arthavatī kevalam viplavaḥ eva iti na asmākam asyāḥ viṣaya nirūpaṇam prati kaścid ādaraḥ kvacid avisaṃvādaḥ asyāḥ vastuni kārya kāraṇa bhāva pratibandhāt na tathābhūta grāhya samāveśāt pratyakṣa vat atatha abhāve api bhāvāt iti nivedayiṣyāmaḥ niveditam ca

bheda viṣaya tvam punar asyāḥ bahulam bhinna padārtha darśana balena teṣu bhāva adhyavasāyāt tathā bhāva kalpanāyām eva aparatra bhāvāt api ca ayam sāmānyam artha antaram kalpayan sva āśraya mātra gatam vā kalpayet sarva gatam vā ākāśa ādi vat tatra yadi sva āśraya mātra gatam ghaṭa tva ādi śūnyeṣu pradeśeṣu ghaṭa ādi utpattau katham teṣu bhinna deśa dravya vartinaḥ sāmānyasya sambhavaḥ yasmāt tat pūrva dravyāt utpitsu dravyam

na yāti niṣkriya tva upagamāt na hi anya dravya vṛtteḥ bhāvasya tatas avicalataḥ bhinna deśena bhāvena tad ubhaya antarālā vyāpinaḥ yogaḥ yuktaḥ prāk sa na ca tatra āsīt asti paścān na ca tatra utpannaḥ na kutaścid āyātaḥ iti kaḥ imam vyāghāta bhāram udvoḍhum samarthaḥ anyatra jāḍyāt api ca na ca aṃśa vat jahāti pūrvam naḥ ādhāram utpitsu deśāt bhinna deśam tayoḥ ca vartate iti aho vyasana santatiḥ

bhinna deśayoḥ hi bhāvayoḥ sambandhaḥ dvidhā bhavet nānā avayava ātma tayā anyonyābhyām avayavābhyām tad sambandhāt āloka rajju vaṃśa daṇḍa ādi vat na hi sa avayava tvam antareṇa bhinna deśābhyām yugapad kasyacid yogaḥ yuktaḥ tasya dvitīya ātma abhāvāt eka ātmanaḥ ca tad pradeśa varti sambandhi rūpa tvāt anyathā tad sambandha ayogāt ekasya ādheyasya tatra sthānam tadā eva tatra tena eva ātmanā asthānam iti tad sthita asthita ātmanoḥ ekasya virodhāt ayuktam etat sarvatra sarvadā sarva ākāra sthita ātmā iti ced tad svabhāva darśana āśrayaḥ pratyayaḥ sarvatra sarva ākāraḥ syāt tathā ca gām api aśvaḥ iti pratīyāt aśva sthita ātmanā dravya tvena sambandhāt tad svabhāva pratipattyā ca tathā niścayāt tasya ca ekasya adṛṣṭa ākāra antara abhāvāt tasmāt na anavayavam aneka deśe yugapad ādhīyate pūrva ādhāra tyāge tu bhinna deśe api varteta sa ca na abhimataḥ

anyatra vartamānasya tatas anya sthāna janmani svasmāt acalataḥ sthānāt vṛttiḥ iti ati yuktimat yatra asau vartate bhāvaḥ tena sambadhyate api na tad deśinam ca vyāpnoti kim api etat mahā adbhutam iti antaraślokau yasya tu sarva gatam sāmānyam tasya api vyaktāḥ eva ekatra sā vyaktyai abhedāt sarvatragāḥ yadi jātiḥ dṛśyeta sarvatra

na jāteḥ nityāyāḥ kācid vyaktiḥ iti niṣiddham etat tasmāt nityam anapekṣita para upaskārā dṛśyeta vā na vā kadācid tasmin svabhāve vyavasthānāt svabhāva antarasya kutaścid anutpatteḥ abhyupagamya api vyaktim vyāpini ekatra vyaktyai bheda abhāvāt vyaktāḥ eva sarvatra iti vyakti śūnyeṣu api pradeśeṣu dṛśyeta na ca sā vyakti apekṣiṇī yadi hi vyakti apekṣiṇī syāt vyañjaka apratipattau hi na vyaṅgyam sampratīyate viparyayaḥ punar kasmāt iṣṭaḥ sāmānya tadvatoḥ

yaḥ api hi sva āśraya indriya saṃyoga apekṣa pratipattikam sāmānyam āśraya śūnyeṣu pradeśeṣu na dṛśyate iti pratisamādadhīta tasya api asti eva āśraya indriya saṃyogaḥ upakārakaḥ iti tatas tad darśī yathā sthitām paśyet na hi tasyām dṛśyamānāyām adṛṣṭam tadīyam yuktam vyakti vyaṅgya tvāt sāmānyasya vyañjaka rahiteṣu pradeśeṣu adarśanam iti api mithyā tathābhūtasya vyaṅgya vyañjaka bhāvasya tatra abhāvāt sva pratipattyā apara pratipatti hetuḥ hi vyañjakaḥ pradīpa ādiḥ svarūpa śūnye deśe su a vyaṅgyam na darśayat na evam vyaktiḥ viparyayāt katham hi sā vyañjikā ca syāt sāmānyasya tad pratipatti dvāreṇa ca dṛśyā syāt vyaṅgyā ca sā eva prasajyate pradīpa ghaṭa vat kathaṃcid tad pratipattim antareṇa adṛśya rūpa tvāt api ca anena kim asambhavat abhisamīkṣya evam bahu āyāsaḥ sāmānya vādaḥ āśritaḥ para sparataḥ bhedāt vyatirekiṇīṣu vyaktiṣu anvayinaḥ pratyayasya ayogāt katham idānīm

pācaka ādiṣu abhinnena vinā api arthena vācakaḥ pācaka pāṭhaka ādiṣu anyonyam ananvayiṣu api śabda pratyaya anuvṛttiḥ asti pācakaḥ pāṭhakaḥ iti na hi teṣu anyat ekam abhinnam asti yena bhinnāḥ tathā pratīyeran karma asti ced vyaktibhyaḥ eva tarhi sa pratyayaḥ astu kim idānīm karmaṇā anyena vā bhinnam abhinna pratyaya hetuḥ na bhavati iti ekam sāmānyam iṣṭam tat yadi bhinnam api karma abhinnam pratyayam janayet vyaktibhiḥ kaḥ aparādhaḥ kṛtaḥ yena tāḥ tathā naḥ iṣyante tāsām eka rūpa tvāt asya idam iti vyatireka pratītiḥ atadākāra viśeṣavatī ca na syāt iti ced uktam atra yathā vyatirekaḥ viśeṣa pratyayāḥ ca yathāsvam artha antara vivekāt iti tasmāt vyakti vat

bhedāt na hetuḥ karma asya pācaka ādi abheda pratyayasya tat karma jātiḥ abhedāt hetuḥ iti ced na jātiḥ karma saṃśrayāt na hi artha antara sambandhinī jātiḥ artha antare pratyaya hetuḥ go tvam iva karka ādiṣu pācaka karmasu ca karma jātiḥ na ca tāni karmāṇi pācaka śabdena abhidhīyante kim tarhi tad karma āśrayaḥ dravyam tasya karma sāmānyasya

śruti antara nimitta tvāt ca pākaḥ pākaḥ iti hi tatas syāt na punar pācakaḥ iti tasya karma nimitta tve proktam kim ca sthiti abhāvāt ca karmaṇaḥ na hi anityam karma sarvadā asti tasya ca pratyayasya karma nimitta tve niruddhe karmaṇi na pācakaḥ iti ucyeta pacataḥ eva karma sadbhāvāt tatas eva

asambandhāt na sāmānyam na ayuktam śabda kāraṇam atiprasaṅgāt vinaṣṭe hi karmaṇi tat sāmānyam na karmaṇi na kartari iti sambaddha sambandhe api asya na asti iti asambandhāt na śabda jñāna hetuḥ anyathā hi atiprasaṅgaḥ syāt atītam anāgatam vā nimittīkṛtya tayoḥ pravṛttiḥ iti ced karma api na asat jñāna abhidhānayoḥ nimittam tayoḥ anaimittika tā āpatteḥ

asat hi nirupākhyam katham nimittam syāt kārya karaṇa lakṣaṇa tvāt vastu tvasya tat pracyutā samprāpta rūpam atīta anāgatam karma nimittam anyat ca vyakti ādikam naḥ iṣṭam iti animitte te syātām tathā ca na jāti siddhiḥ tasyāḥ jñāna abhidhānayoḥ nimitta tve naḥ iṣṭa tvāt śaktiḥ pācaka ādi śabda nimittam na karma na sāmānyam iti ced na ca śaktiḥ ananvayāt

na hi śaktiḥ nāma kiṃcid anyat eva pācaka ādīnām tasyāḥ eva pācaka ādi artha kriyā upayogena dravyasya anupayogi tva prasaṅgāt tasyām tasya upayogaḥ iti ced kim idānīm śaktyā śakti upayogāya śakti antarasya vyatirekiṇaḥ abhyupagame ati prasaṅgāt dravyam eva upayujyate iti vācyam tasya upayoge śaktau artha kriyāyām eva upayujyate iti kim naḥ iṣyate iti kim antarāle anarthikayā śaktyā tasmāt śaktiḥ iti dravyam eva tat kāryam tat ca na anveti iti tatas anvayī śabdaḥ na syāt

sāmānyam pācaka tva ādi yadi prāk eva tat bhavet vyaktam sattā ādi vat no ced na paścāt aviśeṣatas atha api pācaka tvam iti sāmānyam eva kiṃcid bhavet sati arthe tad samavāyasya akādācitka tvāt sattā ādi vat prāk eva vyaktam syāt yāvanti hi sāmānyāni arthe samavāya dharmāṇi tāni saha utpādena asya samavayanti iti samayaḥ tad vyatikrame tasya paścāt api aviśeṣāt na tad samavāyaḥ syāt tad sambandhi svabhāva vaiguṇyāt hi sa tasya prāk naḥ āsīt tatra eva ca asya svabhāve sthitasya paścāt bhavati iti duranvayam etat kriyā upakāra apekṣasya vyañjaka tve avikāriṇaḥ na apekṣā atiśaye api asya kṣaṇika tvāt kriyā kutas

karma upakāram apekṣya pācaka tvam dravyeṇa vyajyate iti ced sthira svabhāvasya anatiśayāt aviśeṣa ādhāyini kā apekṣā atiśaye vā kṣaṇika tvāt karmaṇaḥ pratikṣaṇam svabhāva bhūtasya anyāni asya atiśayasya utpatteḥ tat api kṣaṇikam syāt tatas sva utpatti sthāna vināśinaḥ kriyā kutas yat apekṣam vyañjakam syāt katham tarhi idānīm asti abhinne vastuni jñāna śabdayoḥ anvayinoḥ vṛttiḥ yathā pācaka ādiṣu nanu tat eva idam cintyate katham teṣu api iti cintitam etat yathā na teṣu sambhavati tat kim idānīm animitte te syātām na animitte kim tarhi na bāhya tattva nimitte yathāsvam vāsanā prabodhāt vikalpa utpattiḥ tatas śabdāḥ na punar vikalpa abhidhānayoḥ vastu sattā samāśrayaḥ iti ukta prāyam etat

yathāsvam samaya vāsanā vaśāt virodhi rūpa samāveśena apara apara darśane api anvayinoḥ tayoḥ darśanāt na ca tatra tad nibandhanaḥ kaścid svabhāvaḥ asti paraspara virodhinoḥ yugapad ekatra samāveśa ayogāt aniyamena tarhi syāt na hi animittam bhavat kvacid bhavati kvacid na bhavati iti niyamam arhati na khalu vai tat animittam vāsanā viśeṣa nimitta tvāt bāhyam tu tathābhūtam dṛśyam na asti iti brūmaḥ na ca asati tasmin na bhavitavyam supta taimirika upalabdheṣu artheṣu abhāveṣu samaya vāsana āropita rūpa viśeṣeṣu ca tathā vikalpa utpatteḥ na ca te asatsu utpadyante iti sarvatra sarva ākāraḥ vibhāge naḥ eva tathā upalabdhānām vikalpanāt uktam ca atra kiṃcid asmābhiḥ prakṛtyāḥ api kecid eka jñāna kāryāḥ svabhāva bhedāt iti api ca

tulye bhede yayā jātiḥ pratyāsattyā prasarpati kvacid na anyatra saḥ eva astu śabda jñāna nibandhanam iti antaraślokaḥ na nivṛttim vihāya asti yadi bhāva anvayaḥ aparaḥ ekasya kāryam anyasya na syāt atyanta bhedataḥ yadi ete bhāvāḥ vyāvṛttim muktvā svabhāvena kenacid anvayinā śūnyāḥ na eṣām bahūnām ekam kāryam syāt yaḥ hi tasya svabhāvaḥ janakaḥ na hi saḥ anyasya asti yaḥ asti sa na janakaḥ vyatirekaḥ yaḥ niḥsvabhāva tvāt yat janakam tat eva vastu tad janakam ca aparatra na asti iti na aparam janayet sa hi tasya svabhāvaḥ yaḥ janakaḥ saḥ anyasya api yadi syāt sa tena svabhāvena tatas abhinnaḥ syāt iti asti svabhāva anvayaḥ

yadi eka ātma tayā anekaḥ kāryasya ekasya kārakaḥ ātmā ekatra api saḥ asti iti vyarthāḥ syuḥ sahakāriṇaḥ yadi eka svabhāva tvāt anekaḥ ekasya kārakaḥ sa teṣām abhinnaḥ svabhāvaḥ eka saṃnidhāne api asti iti avaikalyāt kāraṇasya ekaḥ api janakaḥ syāt yasmāt na apaiti abhinnam tad rūpam viśeṣāḥ khalu apāyinaḥ

na hi tasya abhinna svabhāvasya artha antare viśeṣaḥ asti viśeṣaḥ abheda hāneḥ sa ca tatra api asti iti naḥ eka sthitau api tasya apāyaḥ asti ye viśeṣāḥ teṣām saha sthiti niyama abhāvāt syāt apāyaḥ na ca te janakāḥ iṣṭāḥ sahakāriṇām eka svabhāva tayā janakatvā abhyupagamāt tatas janakasya sthānāt asthāyinaḥ ca ajanaka tvāt eka sthitau api kārya utpattiḥ syāt na ca bhavati atas eka apāye phala abhāvāt viśeṣebhyaḥ tad udbhavaḥ

tad kāryam aneka sahakāri sādhāraṇam eka viśeṣa apāye api na bhavati punar api avikaleṣu sarveṣu viśeṣeṣu bhavati na tu avikale api abhinne rūpe kāryam hi kutaścid bhāva dharmi yat na bhavati tat tasya eva vaikalyāt na ca abhinnasya rūpasya eka sthitau api vaikalyam asti avikale api tasmin abhavat tasya ajanaka ātma tām sūcayati yat sākalya vaikalyābhyām ca kāryam bhāva abhāva vat tatas eva utpattiḥ tasmin sati niyamena bhavataḥ tad anyasmāt utpatti kalpanāyām atiprasaṅgāt tasmāt viśeṣāḥ eva janakāḥ na sāmānyam tatas te eva vastu yasmāt

sa pāramārthikaḥ bhāvaḥ yaḥ eva artha kriyā kṣamaḥ idam eva hi vastu avastunoḥ lakṣaṇam yat artha kriyā yogya tā ayogya tā ca iti vakṣyāmaḥ sa ca artha kriyā yogyaḥ arthaḥ na anveti yaḥ anveti na tasmāt kārya sambhavaḥ tasmāt sarvam sāmānyam anartha kriyā yogya tvāt avastu vastu tu viśeṣaḥ eva tatas eva tat niṣpatteḥ svabhāvān anvayāt tarhi ekasya janakam rūpam anyasya na asti iti ajanakaḥ syāt janaka tve vā bheda aviśeṣāt sarvaḥ janakaḥ syāt na etat asti yasmāt tena ātmanā hi bhede api hetuḥ kaścid na ca aparaḥ svabhāvaḥ ayam

ekasya janakāt ātmanaḥ bhidyamānāḥ sarve samam janakāḥ na vā aviśeṣe kaścid iti syāt etat yadi eṣām na viśeṣaḥ sambhavet tatas bheda api kutaścid ātmā atiśayāt kaścid janakaḥ na aparaḥ sa hi tasya svabhāvaḥ na aparasya na hi svabhāvāḥ bhāvānām paryanuyogam arhanti kim agniḥ dahati uṣṇaḥ vā naḥ udakam iti etāvat tu syāt kutas ayam svabhāvaḥ iti nirhetuka tve anapekṣiṇaḥ niyama abhāvena atiprasaṅgāt tasmāt svabhāvaḥ asya sva hetoḥ iti ucyate tasya api tad janana ātma tā tad anyasmāt iti anādiḥ hetu paraṃparāḥ bhinnānām hi kaścid hetuḥ na anyaḥ svabhāvāt iti atra na kiṃcid bādhakam

abhede tu syātām nāśa udbhavau sakṛt abhedāt svabhāvena eva viśvasya sva ātma vat vibhāga utpatti sthiti nirodha ādayaḥ na syuḥ tathā upalakṣaṇāt abhedasya idam eva hi bheda abheda lakṣaṇam eka ākārasya api vyatirekaḥ avyatirekaḥ ca virodhinoḥ eka ātmani asambhavāt bhedaḥ api tena naḥ evam ced

na vai sarva ākāra avyatirekam brūmaḥ yena evam syāt kaścid asya ātmā bhinnaḥ na anyaḥ iti bhedāt na saha utpatti ādayaḥ evam tarhi yaḥ ekasmin vinaśyati tiṣṭhati ātmā na tasya bhedaḥ sthāna āsthānayoḥ eka ātma āśraya tve kaḥ anyaḥ dharmaḥ bhedakaḥ iti nānātvam eva kvacid na syāt sarva ākāra viveka avivekinoḥ vā arthayoḥ abhyupagamāt nāma kevalam naḥ iṣṭam syāt na vastu iti uktam tat ime na eka yogakṣemāḥ bhāvāḥ bhinnāḥ eva

atas na syāt sāmānya bheda dhīḥ tat idam artha antaram anāyattam ajanya tvāt asya idam sāmānyam bhedaḥ vā iti vyapadeśam na arhati anya apohe api eṣa tulyaḥ prasaṅgaḥ iti ced na tulyaḥ yatas nivṛtteḥ niḥsvabhāva tvāt na sthāna āsthāna kalpanā na hi anyāpohaḥ nāma kiṃcid tasya ca svabhāva anuṣaṅgiṇyaḥ svabhāva sthiti pracyuti kalpanāḥ na kalpante

upaplavaḥ ca sāmānya dhiyaḥ tena api adūṣaṇā nirviṣayam eva khalu idam mithyājñānam yat anekatra eka ākāram iti na tad viṣayasya abhāvāt sthitiḥ asthitiḥ vā yat punar etat uktam tad janakaḥ hi sa tasya svabhāvaḥ yat tasya janakam rūpam tatas anyaḥ janakaḥ katham tatra na brūmaḥ anyasya tad janakam rūpam na asti iti kim tarhi yat ekasya tad janakam tat anyasya naḥ iti anyaḥ api sva rūpeṇa eva janakaḥ na para rūpeṇa atattvāt te yathāsvam bhinnāḥ ca tad janakāḥ ca svabhāvena iti kaḥ atra virodhaḥ eka rūpa vikalaḥ tad rūpaḥ na syāt na atad kāryaḥ tena eva ca tat kāryam kartavyam iti kaḥ atra nyāyaḥ api ca

bhinnā viśeṣā janakā iti uktam na ca te viśeṣāḥ tena ātmanā parasparam anuyanti yat ekasya janakam rūpam anyasya tat na asti na ca tāvatā ajanakāḥ api abhedaḥ api teṣu ced syāt etat satyam viśeṣāḥ janakāḥ na punar teṣām viśiṣṭam eva rūpam kim tu abhinnam api tad eka śakti yogāt janakāḥ tena te ajanakāḥ proktāḥ sati api sāmānye rūpe na tena te janakāḥ tasya anapāyāt eka sthitau api kārya utpatti prasaṅgāt iti uktam prāk kim ca pratibhāsaḥ api bhedakaḥ ananya bhāj

utpatti sthiti vināśa ādi bhedaḥ naḥ iti api śabdāt yaḥ ayam abhinnān sarva arthāt manyate tasya ayam artheṣu buddhi pratibhāsa bhedaḥ viruddha dharma adhyāsaḥ ca na syāt sati vā tasmin abhede api na kaścid bhedaḥ syāt tathā ca ayam pravibhāgaḥ na syāt eka ātma vat tasmāt ayam bhinna pratibhāsa ādiḥ viśeṣaḥ eva na ca atra aparam abhinnam pratibhāsam paśyāmaḥ yat balena abheda pratītiḥ syāt atas viśeṣaḥ eva

saḥ eva arthaḥ tasya vyāvṛttayaḥ apare tat kāryam kāraṇam ca uktam tat sva lakṣaṇam iṣyate tad tyāga āpti phalāḥ sarvāḥ puruṣāṇām pravṛttayaḥ yat artha kriyā kāri tat eva vastu iti uktam sa ca viśeṣaḥ eva yat punar etat sāmānyam nāma tat tasya eva aparasmāt bhedaḥ na hi tasya artha tve dṛśyasya rūpa anupalakṣaṇam yuktam tad upalakṣaṇa kṛta tvāt bhedeṣu abhinna pratyayasya api ca

yathā abheda aviśeṣe api na sarvam sarva sādhanam tathā bheda aviśeṣe api na sarvam sarva sādhanam yat uktam katham tad janaka svabhāvāt bhinnaḥ asya janakaḥ syāt janaka tve vā aviśeṣāt sarvaḥ janakaḥ syāt iti uktam atra yadi aviśeṣaḥ syāt syāt etat iti yathā ca asya svayam abheda vādinaḥ abheda aviśeṣe api na sarvaḥ sarvasya janakaḥ iti tathā bheda aviśeṣe api bhaviṣyati athavā

bhede hi kārakam kiṃcid vastu dharma tayā bhavet abhede tu virudhyete tasya ekasya kriyā kriye bheda mātrā viśeṣe api sva hetu pratyaya niyamita svabhāva tvāt kecid eva kārakāḥ syuḥ na anye atad svabhāva tvāt iti atra naḥ eva kiṃcid viruddham asti ekatve tu tasya tatra eva tathā kāraka tvam akāraka tvam ca iti vyāhatam etat

bhedaḥ api asti akriyātaḥ ced na kuryuḥ sahakāriṇaḥ na vai sarva ākāra avivekam brūmaḥ bhedasya api bhāvāt tasmāt kaścid akārakaḥ api iti tathā api kathaṃcid bhedāt sahakāriṇaḥ akārakāḥ syuḥ paryāyeṇa atha kartṛ tvam sa kim tasya eva vastunaḥ atha api syāt naḥ eva kaścid akārakaḥ asti sarveṣām sarvatra paryāyeṇa upayogāt śakteḥ vā vipariṇatāyāḥ tad niveśinyā rūpa antareṇa upayogāt saḥ eva khalu ayam paryāyaḥ bheda āśrayaḥ ekasya katham pariṇāmaḥ vai avyatirekiṇyāḥ viśeṣe vā kathaṃcid eka tva hāniḥ iti yat kiṃcid etat kim ca

atyanta bheda abhedau ca syātām tadvati vastuni anyonyam vā tayoḥ bhedaḥ sadṛśā sadṛśa ātmanoḥ bhāvāḥ ced abhinnena ātmanā sva ātma bhūtena bhedinaḥ tadvantaḥ syuḥ tad abhinna svabhāva ātma tvāt bhedasya api kutas parasparam bhedaḥ atha na sa tasya samānaḥ ātmā tathā sati tad ātmanā tena api na yuktam tathā bhavitum tathā abhāve hi ataddharmā syāt na hi ayam pravṛtti nivṛttimān svabhāvaḥ ekaḥ yuktaḥ na sarva ātmanā abhedaḥ eva

tayoḥ api bhavet bhedaḥ yadi na hi kvacid asya ekāntikaḥ bhedaḥ abhedaḥ vā vivekena vyavasthāpanāt sāmānyam viśeṣaḥ iti yena ātmanā tayoḥ bhedaḥ sāmānyam iti etat yadi bhedaḥ tad ātmanā bhedaḥ eva yadi sāmānya viśeṣayoḥ yam ātmānam āśritya sāmānyam viśeṣaḥ iti sthitiḥ tena ātmanā bhedaḥ tadā bhedaḥ eva yasmāt tau hi tayoḥ sva ātmānau tau ced vyatirekiṇau vyatirekaḥ eva sāmānya viśeṣayoḥ svabhāva bhedāt svabhāvaḥ hi bhāvaḥ iti

tathā ca syāt niḥsāmānya viśeṣa tā bheda sāmānyayoḥ yadvat ghaṭa ādīnām parasparam vyatireke ca bheda sāmānyayoḥ na bhedaḥ sāmānyāt na sāmānyam bheda vat sambandha abhāvāt parasparam ghaṭa ādi vat iti uktam api ca yam ātmānam puraskṛtya puruṣaḥ ayam pravartate tad sādhya phala vān chāvān bheda abhedau tad āśrayau cintyete sva ātmanā bhedaḥ vyāvṛttyā ca samāna tā asti eva vastu na anveti pravṛtti ādi prasaṅgataḥ

sarve eva gauḥ aśvāt bhinnaḥ abhinnaḥ vā iti bhedam abhedam vā pṛcchan viśeṣam eva bhāvasya svabhāva ākhyam adhikṛtya pravartate saḥ eva hi tathā ucyate dravya tva ādayaḥ tu na tatra śabda coditāḥ yathāsvam pṛthak abhidhānāt arthasya tat avyabhicārāt tatas gatiḥ syāt nirloṭhitam ca etat ācāryeṇa tat ayam gavā ādi śabda pratyupasthāpitam artham bhinnam abhinnam vā pṛcchan artha antara upakṣepeṇa tatra kim iti dvi mukha buddhiḥ kriyate tasmāt yaḥ asya ātmā ananya sādhāraṇaḥ yam puraskṛtya puruṣaḥ viśiṣṭa artha kriyā arthī pravartate yathā goḥ vāha doha ādau na anya sambhavinaḥ arthasya yathā yuddha praveśe saḥ eva svabhāvaḥ yathāsvam śabda coditaḥ na dravya tva ādi sāmānyam

tat codanayā tadā prāptum anabhipreta tvāt gavā ādi samāveśāt tat ātma bhūtānām ca ananvayena tatra anubhaya rūpa tvāt tam eva ca ayam bhāvam prakāraiḥ paryanuyuṅkte tasya bhede dravya tva ādi abhedaḥ asya abādhakaḥ eva sarvatra svabhāvena bhedasya abhyupagamāt sāmānyasya ca vyāvṛtti lakṣaṇasya svabhāva bhūtasya ca sāmānyasya abhede api uktam sva ātmanā eva abhede tu tad svabhāva nibandhana artha kriyā arthī samam dvayoḥ api pravarteta ekaḥ api tām artha kriyām tad svabhāva tvāt eva karoti tad anyasya api tat tulyam iti saḥ api kim na karoti

etena eva yat ahrīkāḥ kim api aślīlam ākulam pralapanti pratikṣiptam tat api ekānta sambhavāt yat ayam ahrīkaḥ syāt uṣṭraḥ dadhi syāt naḥ iti kim api aślīlam ayuktam aheya upādeyam apariniṣṭhānāt ākulam pralapanti tat api anena nirastam svabhāvena ekānta bhedāt tad anvaye vā sarvasya ubhaya rūpa tve tad viśeṣa nirākṛteḥ coditaḥ dadhi khāda iti kim uṣṭram na abhidhāvati

tathā hi uṣṭraḥ api syāt dadhi na api saḥ eva uṣṭraḥ ye na anyaḥ api syāt uṣṭraḥ tathā dadhi api syāt uṣṭraḥ na api tat eva dadhi yena anyat api syāt dadhi tat anayoḥ ekasya api kasyacid tad rūpa abhāvasya abhāvāt svarūpasya vā atadbhāvinaḥ sva niyatasya abhāvāt na kaścid viśeṣaḥ iti dadhi khāda iti coditaḥ uṣṭram api khādet atha asti atiśayaḥ kaścid yena bhedena vartate saḥ eva dadhi saḥ anyatra na asti iti anubhayam param

atha anayoḥ kaścid atiśayaḥ asti yena ayam tathā coditaḥ kṣīra vikāraḥ eva pravartate na anyatra saḥ eva atiśayaḥ artha kriyā arthi pravṛtti viṣayaḥ dadhi tad phala upādāna bhāva lakṣita svabhāvam hi vastu dadhi iti sa ca tādṛśaḥ svabhāvaḥ anyatra na asti iti pravṛtti abhāvāt arthinaḥ tasmāt tat naḥ ubhaya rūpam iti ekānta vādaḥ api ca sarva ātma tve ca sarveṣām bhinnau syātām na dhīdhvanī bheda saṃhāra vādasya tad abhāvāt asambhavaḥ

saḥ ayam ahrīkaḥ kvacid api ekam ākāram pratiniyatam apaśyan vibhāga abhāvāt bhāvānām katham asaṃsṛṣṭāni ākāravatyā buddhyā adhimucyeta arthān abhilapet vā tatas bheda agrahāt tad saṃhāra vādaḥ na syāt syāt uṣṭraḥ dadhi syāt naḥ iti atha punar asaṃsṛṣṭau ākārau pratipadya saṃharet eka rūpa saṃsargiṇyāḥ buddheḥ kvacid pratiniyamāt tad pratibhāsa bheda kṛtaḥ eva tayoḥ rūpayoḥ svabhāva bhedaḥ api syāt eka aneka vyavasthiteḥ pratibhāsa viṣaya tvāt tathā ca naḥ ekaḥ tad ubhaya rūpaḥ syāt iti mithyāvādaḥ eṣaḥ sthitam etat na bhāvānām kaścid svabhāva anvayaḥ asti bheda lakṣaṇam eva tu sāmānyam atha ca prakṛtyā kecid eka jñāna ādi phalāḥ kecid naḥ iti

bhavatu nāma bhāvānām svabhāva bhedaḥ sāmānyam yeṣām tu nirupākhyānām svabhāvaḥ eva na asti tatra katham svabhāva bheda viṣayāḥ śabdāḥ teṣu avaśyam śabda pravṛttyā bhāvyam kathaṃcid avyavasthāpiteṣu vidhi pratiṣedha ayogāt tathā ca sarvatra ayam anvaya vyatireka āśrayaḥ vyavahāraḥ na syāt uṣṇa svabhāvaḥ agniḥ na anuṣṇaḥ iti api svabhāva antarasya asataḥ kathaṃcid avyavasthāpanāt sarvathā apratipatteḥ agni svabhāvasya apratipattiḥ iti vyāmūḍham jagat syāt syāt etat na tatra kasyacid asataḥ niṣedhaḥ anuṣṇam sat eva artha antaram niṣidhyate iti katham idānīm sat asat nāma

na brūmaḥ sarvatra asat tatra na asti iti deśa kāla dharma niṣedhaḥ eva sarva bhāveṣu kriyate na dharmiṇaḥ tad niṣedhe tad viṣaya śabda pravṛtti abhāvāt anirdiṣṭa viṣayasya nañaḥ aprayogāt saḥ api tarhi deśa ādi pratiṣedhaḥ katham yasmāt na tatra api deśa ādīnām pratiṣedhaḥ na api arthasya sambandhaḥ niṣedhyate iti ced nanu tad niṣedhe api tulyaḥ doṣaḥ niṣedhāt asati śabda apravṛttiḥ iti ādi asataḥ vai asya niṣedhe tadvat dharmiṇaḥ api niṣedhaḥ na vai sambandhasya na asti iti niṣedhaḥ kim tarhi na iha ghaṭaḥ naḥ idānīm na evam iti uktau na anena sambandhaḥ asti naḥ etat dharmāḥ vā iti pratītiḥ tathā ca sambandhaḥ niṣiddhaḥ bhavati iti

tathā api katham niṣiddhaḥ yāvat asya sambandhaḥ dharmaḥ vā na asti iti matiḥ na bhavati na ca asyāḥ kathaṃcid bhāve sambhavaḥ abhāveṣu tathā abhāvāt tasmāt sambandha abhāva pratīteḥ na ayam iha iti ādyā pratītiḥ sa tad abhāve na syāt pratītau vā tad abhāvasya yathā pratītimataḥ tad prabhavāḥ śabdāḥ kena nivāryante saḥ eva hi śabdānām na viṣayaḥ yaḥ na vitarkāṇām te ced pravṛttāḥ kaḥ vacanasya niṣeddhā na hi avācyam artham buddhayaḥ samīhante sambandhasya tu svarūpeṇa anabhidhānam uktam abhidhāne sambandhi tvena buddhau upasthānāt yathā abhiprāyam apratītiḥ tat ayam pratīyamānaḥ api sambandhi rūpaḥ eva iti svarūpeṇa na abhidhīyate tasmāt na abhāva vat sambandhe api prasaṅgaḥ

rūpa abhāvāt abhāvasya śabdāḥ rūpa abhidhāyinaḥ na āśaṅkyāḥ eva siddhāḥ te vyavacchedasya vācakāḥ vastu vṛttīnām śabdānām kim rūpam abhidheyam āhosvit bhedaḥ iti śaṅkā syāt abhāvaḥ tu viveka lakṣaṇaḥ eva nimittīkartavyasya kasyacid rūpasya abhāvāt tad bhāve abhāva ayogāt tad bhāva lakṣaṇa tvāt bhāvasya tasmāt ayam eva sa mukhyaḥ vivekaḥ tasya tathā abhāva khyāpinaḥ śabdāḥ kim viveka viṣayāḥ iti asthānam eva etat āśaṅkāyāḥ tasmāt siddham etat sarve śabdāḥ viveka viṣayāḥ vikalpāḥ ca te ete eka vastu pratiśaraṇāḥ api yathāsvam avadhi bheda upakalpitaiḥ bhedaiḥ bhinneṣu iva pratibhātsu buddhau vivekeṣu upalayanāt bhinna viṣayāḥ eva tena svabhāvasya eva sādhya sādhana bhāve api na sādhya sādhana saṃsargaḥ tau na pratijñā artha eka deśaḥ hetuḥ iti sa ca ayam hetu tvena apadiśyamānaḥ

upādhi bheda apekṣaḥ vā svabhāvaḥ kevalaḥ athavā ucyate sādhya siddhi artham nāśe kāryatva sattva vat apekṣita para vyāpāraḥ hi svabhāva niṣpattau bhāvaḥ kṛtakaḥ tena iyam kṛtaka śrutiḥ svabhāva abhidhāyinī api para upādhim enam ākṣipati etena pratyaya bheda bhedi tva ādayaḥ vyākhyātāḥ evam upādhi bheda apekṣaḥ kvacid svabhāvaḥ hetuḥ ucyate kvacid anapekṣaḥ sāmānyena yathā anitya tvaḥ eva sattvam kvacid svabhāva bhūta dharma viśeṣa parigraheṇa yathā tatra eva utpattiḥ anayā diśāḥ anye api svabhāva hetu pravibhāgāḥ draṣṭavyāḥ

sattā svabhāvaḥ hetuḥ ced na sattā sādhyate katham ananvayaḥ hi bhedānām vyāhataḥ hetu sādhyayoḥ yadi sattvam anitya tve anyatra vā hetuḥ syāt sādhyam api kasmāt naḥ iṣyate tat kila evam prasādhyamānam viśeṣībhavati na ca viśeṣaḥ sādhāyitum śakyate ananvayāt yathā āha pramāṇa viśeṣayā ajñānāt iti saḥ ayam viśeṣaḥ na sādhyaḥ eva vyāhanyate kim tarhi hetau api tulya doṣa tvāt na hi hetuḥ ananvayaḥ siddheḥ aṅgam tatas saṃśayāt na eṣa doṣaḥ yasmāt

bhāva upādāna mātre tu sādhye sāmānya dharmiṇi na kaścid arthaḥ siddhaḥ syāt aniṣiddham ca tādṛśam na sarvathā sattā sādhane viśeṣaḥ sādhitaḥ bhavati bhāva mātra viśeṣaṇaḥ asti kaścid dharmī iti prasādhayataḥ anirdiṣṭa svabhāva viśeṣasya kasyacid sattā mātre virodha abhāvāt na iha sattā sādhana pratiṣedhaḥ kim tu sa tathā asti kaścid iti kaṃcana asya bhedam aparāmṛśan bruvāṇaḥ kam sva artham puṣṇāti tasmāt anena upātta bhedaḥ eva sādhyaḥ upātta bhede sādhye asmin bhavat hetuḥ ananvayaḥ sattāyām tena sādhyāyām viśeṣaḥ sādhitaḥ bhavet

sa hi dharmī pradhāna lakṣaṇaḥ ekaḥ nityaḥ sukha ādi ātmakaḥ anyaḥ vā iti yathā kathaṃcid api viśeṣitaḥ tad svabhāvaḥ prasādhitaḥ bhavati sa ca tathā na anveti yat api sattā mātram anveti na tena siddhena kiṃcid nanu evam agni ādiṣu api prasaṅgaḥ tatra api na agni sattā mātre kaścid vivādaḥ viśiṣṭa ādhāra viśeṣasya tu abhimatasya ananvayāt asiddhiḥ na vai saḥ ādhāraḥ tam viśeṣīkaroti tad ayoga vyavacchedena viśeṣaṇāt iti uktam vakṣyate ca tasmāt tatra sāmānyam eva sādhyate tad ayoga vyavacchedena na tathā iha api kvacid sattāyāḥ sādhanam pradhāna ādi śabda vācyasya eva arthasya kvacid abhāvāt nirviśeṣaṇā eva sā katham abhāvaḥ jñeya abhidheya prameya tvaiḥ saḥ api siddhaḥ eva tat kim idānīm jñeyam asti iti siddhiḥ astu tathā api kim siddham syāt anyatra tu tat eva agni sāmānyam tatra asiddham iti sādhyate

nanu tatra api tad ayoga virahiṇā sāmānyena anvayaḥ na siddhaḥ eva na vai kaścid tathā abhūtena anvayam karoti pratipādayatā hi param dhūmaḥ agninā antarīyakaḥ darśanīyaḥ yatra dhūmaḥ tatra agniḥ iti sa tathā agni mātreṇa vyāptaḥ siddhaḥ yatra eva svayam dṛśyate tatra eva agni buddhim janayati tatra ca sādhya nirdeśena na kiṃcid tatra darśana sambandha ākhyāna mātrāt iṣṭa siddheḥ tad anirdeśe ca katham tad viśiṣṭena anvayaḥ tat ayam agninā avinā bhāvī siddhaḥ arthāt eva agneḥ tad pradeśa ayogam vyavacchinatti iti sa tathā sādhyaḥ ucyate na punar tathā asya upanyāsa pūrvakaḥ anvayaḥ sa adhya ukteḥ iha anaṅga tvāt tad pūrvaka tve vā kaḥ pratijñām sādhanāt apākaroti tathā ca āha liṅgasya avyabhicāraḥ tu dharmeṇa anyatra darśyate tatra prasiddham tat yuktam dharmiṇam gamayiṣyati tasmāt na agni ādi sādhana vat sattā sādhanam api anavadyam iti

aparāmṛṣṭa tad bhede vastu mātre tu sādhane tanmātra vyāpinaḥ sādhyasya anvayaḥ na vihanyate sādhane punar sattve svabhāva viśeṣa aparigraheṇa vastu mātra vyāpini sādhya dharme na anvaya vyāghātaḥ na hi tatra avaśyam viśeṣa parigrahaḥ kāryaḥ sat mātra āśraye api sādhana sāmarthyāt na sādhya tve vaiphalyāt api ca na asiddhe bhāva dharmaḥ asti vyabhicāryu bhaya āśrayaḥ dharmaḥ viruddhaḥ abhāvasya sā sattā sādhyate katham

sattāyām hi sādhyāyām sarvaḥ tad hetuḥ na trayīm doṣa jātim atipatati asiddhim vyabhicāram virodham ca tatra yadi bhāva dharmaḥ hetuḥ ucyate sa katham asiddha sattāke syāt yaḥ hi bhāva dharmam tatra icchati sa katham bhāvam na icchet svabhāvaḥ eva hi kayācid apekṣayā dharmaḥ iti vyatirekī iva dharmiṇaḥ nirdiśyate na hi dharma dharmi vācinoḥ śabdayoḥ vācye kaścid viśeṣaḥ asti iti uktam etat atha punar ubhaya dharmam brūyāt anāśrita vastunaḥ aparyudāsena vyatireka mātrasya abhāve api avirodhāt yathā na bhavati mūrtaḥ iti amūrta tvam nirupākhye api syāt nirupākhyasya abhāvāt na pratiṣedha viṣaya tā iti ced tat kim idānīm vidhi viṣayaḥ astu tat api naḥ iti ced katham idānīm na pratiṣedha viṣayaḥ vidhi ni vṛtti rūpa tvāt pratiṣedhasya

tat etat vyavaccheda mātram dvayoḥ api sambhavat vipakṣa pracāra śaṅkā vyavacchedena labhyam gamaka tvam katham ātmasāt kuryāt sa ca svayam sva vāca ubhaya dharma tām bruvāṇaḥ sataḥ anyatra api asya vṛttim bhāṣate sattāyām ca avyabhicāram iti katham naḥ unmattaḥ abhāva dharmam tu bhāva mātra vyāpinaḥ arthasya vyavacchedam hetum sattāyām vadataḥ asya viruddhaḥ hetuḥ syāt tasya bhāve kvacid asambhavāt abhāve ca bhāva vyavacchedasya bhāvāt tat ayam tri prakāraḥ api dharmaḥ sattā sādhane na hetu lakṣaṇa bhāj na ca anyā gatiḥ asti tasmāt na sattā sādhyate sādhana tve punar asyāḥ sāmānyena tanmātra vyāpini vastu dharme siddha sattāke dharmiṇi na asiddhiḥ tena ca sādhya dharmeṇa vyāptiḥ yadi kathaṃcid niścīyate na virodhavyabhicārau iti na ayam prasaṅgaḥ aniścitāyām tu vyāptau dharmi samāśraye vā tad svabhāvatayā gamakaḥ na kaścid gamakaḥ atas eva svadharmeṇa vyāptaḥ

siddhaḥ svabhāvaḥ gamakaḥ vācyaḥ na hi prakāśa tayā prakāśayan pradīpaḥ tad rūpa apratipattau svām artha kriyām karoti vyāpakaḥ tasya niścitaḥ gamyaḥ svabhāvas tad dharma niścayāt eva niścitaḥ vyāpaka tvena tasya dharmiṇaḥ dharmaḥ gamyaḥ tasya ayam nivṛttau vā nivartakaḥ

tasya vyāpyasya dharmasya ayam nivartakaḥ vyāpakaḥ dharmaḥ svayam nirvartamānaḥ evam hi ayam asya vyāpakaḥ siddhaḥ bhavati yadi asya abhāve na bhavet tat anena dvividhasya api sādhana prayogasya gamaka tā lakṣaṇam uktam veditavyam dvividhaḥ hi prayogaḥ sādharmyeṇa vaidharmyeṇa ca yathā āhuḥ eke anvayī vyatirekī ca iti na anayoḥ vastutas kaścid bhedaḥ anyatra prayoga bhedāt sādharmyeṇa api hi prayoge arthāt vaidharmya gatiḥ asati tasmin sādhyena hetoḥ anvaya abhāvāt tathā vaidharmye api anvaya gatiḥ asati tasmin sādhya abhāve hetu abhāvasya sandehāt iti vistareṇa vakṣyāmaḥ

anitya tve yathā kāryam akāryam vā avināśini anena udāharaṇam anayoḥ darśayati tatra anvayī yat kiṃcid kṛtakam tat sarvam anityam yathā ghaṭa ādayaḥ śabdaḥ ca kṛtakaḥ iti kṛtaka tvasya api anitya tvena vyāptim pradarśya śabdaḥ yaḥ kṛtaka tve kathite sāmarthyāt eva anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti tasmāt na avaśyam iha pakṣa nirdeśaḥ iti ayam anvayinaḥ prayogaḥ vyatireke api na anitya tva abhāve kṛtaka tvam bhavati śabdaḥ ca kṛtakaḥ iti siddha tad svabhāva tayā tad abhāve na bhavataḥ kṛtaka tvasya śabde ca bhāva khyātau tad ātmanaḥ sataḥ bhāvaḥ iti sāmarthyāt siddheḥ pūrvavān na pratijñā vacanam anvayaḥ tu arthāpattyā siddhaḥ na hi atada ātma niyatasya tad nivṛttau nivṛttiḥ tasmāt tat niyamam prasādhya nivṛttiḥ vaktavyā sā ced sidhyati tad ātma niyamam arthāt sūcayati iti siddhaḥ anvayaḥ katham idānīm kṛtakaḥ avaśyam anityaḥ iti pratyetavyaḥ yena evam ucyate yasmāt

ahetu tvāt vināśasya svabhāvāt anubandhitā na hi bhāvāḥ vinaśyantaḥ tad bhāve hetum apekṣante sva hetoḥ eva vinaśvarāṇām bhāvāt tasmāt yaḥ kaścid kṛtakaḥ sa prakṛtyāḥ eva naśvaraḥ tathā hi sa apekṣāṇām hi bhāvānām na avaśyaṃbhāvitā īkṣyate nirapekṣaḥ bhāvaḥ vināśe sa apekṣa tve hi ghaṭa ādīnām keṣāṃcid nityatā api syāt yena

bāhulye api hi tad hetoḥ bhavet kvacid asambhavaḥ yadi api bahulam vināśa kāraṇāni santi teṣām api sva pratyaya adhīna saṃnidhi tvāt na avaśyam saṃnidhānam iti kaścid na vinaśyet api na hi avaśyam hetavaḥ phalavantaḥ vaikalya pratibandha sambhavāt etena vyabhicāri tvam uktam kārya avyavasthiteḥ sarveṣām nāśa hetūnām hetum at nāśa vādinām

iti antaraślokaḥ tat ayam bhāvaḥ anapekṣaḥ tad bhāvam prati tad bhāva niyataḥ asambhavat pratibandhāḥ iva kāraṇa sāmagrī sakalā kārya utpādane nanu anapekṣāṇām api keṣāṃcid kvacid na avaśyam tad bhāvaḥ bhūmi bīja udaka sāmagryām api kadācid aṅkurānutpatteḥ na tatra api santāna pariṇāma apekṣa tvāt na evam bhāvasya kācid apekṣā tatra api antyā kāraṇa sāmagrī yā avyavahitā kārya utpatteḥ sā phalavatī eva saḥ eva ca tatra aṅkura hetuḥ anyaḥ tu pūrvaḥ pariṇāmaḥ tad arthaḥ eva na ca tām tatra kaścid pratibandhum samarthaḥ ekatra bhāve vikārān utpatteḥ utpattau vai eka tva hāneḥ tad ātmanaḥ ca apracyutasya tad utpādanam prati vaiguṇyam kāraṇasya akurvāṇasya pratibandha hetoḥ apratibandhaka tvāt

nanu yava bīja ādayaḥ api śāli aṅkure janye na sa apekṣāḥ tad utpatti pratyayānām kadācid tatra api saṃnidhānāt katham na sa apekṣāḥ yāvatā saḥ eva eṣām svabhāvaḥ na asti yaḥ tad utpādanaḥ śālibījasya iti tad svabhāva apekṣāḥ evam tarhi kṛtakānām api keṣāṃcid satām vā saḥ eva svabhāvaḥ na asti yaḥ vinaśvaraḥ tasmāt tad svabhāva apekṣa tvāt na vinaśvarāḥ śāli bīja ādīnām api sa svabhāvaḥ sva hetoḥ iti yaḥ na tad hetuḥ saḥ atad svabhāvaḥ syāt niyata śaktiḥ ca sa hetuḥ sva rūpeṇa pratītaḥ eva na ca svabhāva niyamaḥ arthānām ākasmikaḥ yuktaḥ anapekṣasya deśa kāla dravya niyama ayogāt tathā atra api niyama hetuḥ vaktavyaḥ yatas ime kecid naśvara ātmanaḥ jātāḥ na ca atra kaścid niyāmakaḥ svabhāvasya asti sarva janminām vināśa siddheḥ

janmi svabhāvaḥ na āśī iti ced na vai janma nāśi svabhāvasya hetuḥ na ca ahetoḥ svabhāva niyamaḥ tasmāt na atra kaścid hetoḥ svabhāva pravibhāgaḥ tad abhāvāt phalasya api na asti iti asamānam sā iyam nirapekṣatā vināśasya kvacid kadācid ca bhāva virodhinī tad abhāvam svabhāvena sādhayati yaḥ hi svabhāvaḥ nirapekṣaḥ sa yadi kadācid bhavet kvacid vā tad kāla dravya apekṣaḥ iti nirapekṣaḥ eva na syāt iti uktam sa tarhi naśvaraḥ svabhāvaḥ nirapekṣaḥ iti ahetukaḥ syāt na ahetukaḥ sattā hetoḥ eva bhāvāt tathā utpatteḥ sataḥ hi bhavataḥ tādṛśasya eva bhāvāt na avaśyam sataḥ kutaścid bhāvaḥ iti ced ākasmikī tarhi sattā iti na iyam kasyacid kadācid kvacid viramet

tat hi kiṃcid upalīyeta na vā yasya yatra kiṃcid pratibaddham apratibaddham vā sā iyam sattā apratibandhinī ced niyamavatī na syāt tasmāt na iyam ākasmikī kvacid katham tarhi idānīm ahetukaḥ vināśaḥ uktaḥ jātasya tad bhāve anya anapekṣaṇāt uktam ca atra na vināśaḥ nāma anyaḥ eva kaścid bhāvāt svabhāvaḥ eva hi nāśaḥ saḥ eva hi eka kṣaṇa sthāyī jātaḥ iti tam asya mandāḥ svabhāvam ūrdhvam vyavasyanti na prāk darśane api pāṭava abhāvāt iti tad vaśena paścāt vyavasthāpyate vikāra darśanena iva viṣam ajñaiḥ tat ayam sattā vyatirekeṇa na anyat kiṃcid vināśaḥ apekṣate iti tad vyāpī katham punar etat gamyate nirapekṣaḥ vināśaḥ iti

asāmarthyāt ca tad hetoḥ abhāva kāriṇaḥ kriyā pratiṣedhāt ca iti caśabdāt katham asāmarthyam siddhe hi bhāve kārakaḥ na tam karoti na api anya kriyāyām tasya kiṃcid iti tad atad rūpā karaṇāt ca akiṃcitkaraḥ na apekṣyate iti katham kriyā pratiṣedhaḥ vināśaḥ iti hi te bhāva abhāvam manyante tat ayam vināśa hetuḥ abhāvam karoti iti prāptam tatra yadi abhāvaḥ nāma kaścid kāryaḥ syāt svabhāvaḥ saḥ eva bhāvaḥ iti na abhāvaḥ syāt tasmāt abhāvam karoti iti bhāvam na karoti iti kriyā pratiṣedhaḥ asya kṛtaḥ syāt tathā api ayam akiṃcitkaraḥ kim iti apekṣyate iti siddhā vināśam prati anapekṣayā bhāvasya tasmāt

bhavati eṣa svabhāvataḥ yatra nāma bhavati asmāt anyatra api svabhāvataḥ saḥ ayam kvacid bhavan dṛṣṭaḥ anapekṣa tvāt svabhāvataḥ eva bhavati tathā anyatra api svabhāva bhāvī viśeṣa abhāvāt iti yā kācid bhāva viṣayā dvidhā eva anumitiḥ tatas sva sādhye kārya bhāvābhyām sambandha niyamāt tayoḥ tasmāt dvi prakārāḥ eva vastu viṣaya anumitiḥ kārya liṅgā svabhāva liṅgā ca yathāsvam vyāpini sādhye tayoḥ eva pratibandhāt liṅgayoḥ liṅgini yathā uktam prāk

pravṛtteḥ buddhi pūrva tvāt tad bhāva anupalambhane pravartitavyam naḥ iti ukta anupalabdheḥ pramāṇa tā tṛtīyaḥ tu hetuḥ anupalabdhiḥ aviśeṣeṇa kvacid arthe gamakaḥ iti ucyate sanniścaya śabda vyavahāra pratiṣedhe hi sarvāḥ eva anupalabdhiḥ liṅgam sanniścayāt hi śabda vyavahārāḥ pravartante te pravṛttiḥ iti uktāḥ tathā hi anupalabdhiḥ eva asattvam iti uktam prāk tat ca pratipattṛ vaśāt na vastu vaśāt tāvat hi sa bhāvaḥ asya na asti yāvat atra apratipattiḥ satā api te na tad artha ākaraṇāt vastutas tu anupalabhyamānaḥ na san na asan satām api svabhāva ādi viprakarṣāt kadācid anupalambhāt tasya asatsu api tulya tvāt tat etat pratipattuḥ pramāṇa abhāvāt nivṛttam sattvam anupalabdhi lakṣaṇam sva nimittān śabda vyavahārān nivartayati tena yāḥ api iyam anupalabdhiḥ upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptānām vastutas api asattva rūpāḥ apravṛtti yogya tvāt tasyāḥ api etat tulyam prāmāṇyam atra viṣaye asat niścaya phalāḥ api sā asattāyām api iyam pramāṇam eva na hi asti sambhavaḥ yat upalabdhi yogyaḥ sakaleṣu anyeṣu kāraṇeṣu san naḥ upalabhyeta na punar pūrvā asattā sādhānī yasmāt

śāstra adhikāra asambaddhāḥ bahavaḥ arthāḥ atīndriyāḥ aliṅgāḥ ca katham teṣām abhāvaḥ anupalabdhitaḥ saḥ ayam asattām sādhayan anupalabdhi mātreṇa sarva arthānām pramāṇa traya nivṛttyā sādhayet tatra na śāstra nivṛttiḥ abhāva sādhanī tasya kvacid anadhikāre apravṛtteḥ śāstram hi pravartamānam kaṃcid puruṣa artha sādhanam upāyam āśritya pravartate anyathā abaddha pralāpasya aprāmāṇyāt tatra ca prakaraṇe bahavaḥ arthāḥ na avaśyam nirdeśyāḥ yathā pratyātma niyatāḥ kāścana puruṣāṇām cetaḥ vṛttayaḥ aniyata nimitta bhāvinyaḥ deśa kāla vyavahitāḥ vā prakaraṇa anupayoginaḥ dravya viśeṣāḥ na tān śāstram viṣayīkaroti na ca tathā viprakṛṣṭeṣu sva sāmarthya upadhānau jñāna utpādana śaktiḥ asti na ca avaśyam eṣām kārya upalambhaḥ yena anumīyeran na ca te pramāṇa traya nivṛttau api na santi iti śakyante vyavasātum tasmāt na sarva anupalabdhiḥ sādhanī nivṛtti niścayasya tat iyam

sat asat niścaya phalā naḥ iti syāt vā apramāṇa tā na eva vā iyam anupalabdhiḥ pramāṇam vyavasāya phala tvāt pramāṇānām na hi pravṛtti niṣedhe api iyam niḥśaṅka paricchedam cetaḥ karoti saṃśayāt api kvacid lokasya pravṛtteḥ tathā tve tat niravadyam yadi niścaya pūrvam vyavaharet iti sā iyam apravṛttiphalā proktā pramāṇam api kācid syāt liṅga atiśaya bhāvinī atra na sarva anupalabdhiḥ apramāṇam pramāṇam api kācid liṅga viśeṣa bhāvinī yathā udāhṛtā prāk yat punar uktam apramāṇam anupalabdhiḥ iti svabhāva jñāpaka ajñānasya ayam nyāya udāhṛtaḥ

yasya kasyacid svabhāvaḥ naḥ upalabhyate deśa ādi viprakarṣāt na sa tad anupalambha mātreṇa asat nāma yathoktam prāk yaḥ api jñāpakasya liṅgasya abhāvāt atīndriyaḥ pratikṣipyate arthaḥ svabhāva viśeṣaḥ vā yathā na asti viraktam cetaḥ devatā viśeṣaḥ vā na asti dāna hiṃsā virati cetanānām abhyudaya hetu tāḥ iti pratyakṣe api arthe phalasya ānantarya abhāvāt atad phala sādharmyāt viparyastaḥ apavadeta api na tāvatā tad abhāvaḥ eva vyavahitānām api hetoḥ phalānām utpatti darśanāt mūṣika alarka viṣa vikāra vat tad bhāve virodha abhāvāt atra anupalabdhi mātram apramāṇam bhāve kim pramāṇam iti ced atas eva saṃśayaḥ astu bhavet vā pramāṇam iti apratikṣepaḥ tat atra keṣāṃcid arthānām svabhāvānām vā darśana pāṭava abhāvāt kāraṇānām kārya utpādana niyama abhāvāt ca bhavet jñāpakā siddhiḥ neyatā tad abhāvaḥ punar paryāyeṇa keṣāṃcid abhivyakteḥ

kārye tu kāraka ajñānam abhāvasya eva sādhakam svabhāva abhāve sādhye tad anupalambhaḥ eva apramāṇam ucyate kāraka anupalambhaḥ tu pramāṇam eva na hi asti sambhavaḥ yat asati kāraṇe kāryam syāt nanu kadācid kāraṇa nāśe api kārya sthitiḥ dṛṣṭā na brūmaḥ kāraṇa sthiti kāla bhāvī kāryam iti hetu rahitā tu bhāva utpattiḥ na asti iti ucyate na ca tathā sthāyī bhāvaḥ tad upādānaḥ pāraṃparyeṇa tu santāna upakārāt tad kārya vyapadeśaḥ yadi asya kathaṃcid abhāvaḥ sidhyet tat phalam na asti iti niścīyate

svabhāva anupalambhaḥ ca svabhāve arthasya liṅgini svabhāva abhāvaḥ eva liṅgini svabhāva anupalambhaḥ api kaścid pramāṇam eva eva yadi anupalabhyamānaḥ vyāpakaḥ svabhāvaḥ asya siddhiḥ syāt yathā vṛkṣa tvam śiṃśapāyāḥ tad abhāvaḥ pratīyeta hetunā yadi kenacid yadi asya kāraṇasya svabhāvasya vyāpakasya vā abhāvaḥ kutaścid gamakāt hetoḥ sidhyet saḥ ayam asan eva sva kāryam vyāpyam vā nivartayati tad abhāva asiddhau nivartye api saṃśayāt katham idānīm bhāvasya svayam anupalabdheḥ abhāva siddhiḥ

dṛśyasya darśana abhāva kāraṇā sambhave sati bhāvasya anupalabdhasya bhāva abhāvaḥ pratīyate bhāvaḥ hi yadi bhavet yathāsvam grāhakeṇa karaṇena upalabhyaḥ eva bhavet sa darśana pratibandhiṣu vyavadhāna ādiṣu asatsu upalabhyaḥ eva anupalabdhaḥ tu asan iti niścīyate tādṛśaḥ sataḥ upalambha avi abhicārāt ayam eva hetuḥ hetu vyāpakayoḥ abhāve api veditavyaḥ viruddhasya ca bhāvasya bhāve tad bhāva bādhanāt tad viruddha upalabdhau syāt asattāyāḥ viniścayaḥ

yaḥ hi bhāvaḥ yena saha na avatiṣṭhate tad upādānayoḥ anyonya vaiguṇya āśraya tvena ārambha virodhāt tayoḥ viruddhayoḥ ekasya bhāve api anya abhāva gatiḥ bhavati yathoktam prāk idam anupalabdheḥ na pṛthak vyavasthāpyate tatas eva virodha gateḥ virodhāt ca abhāva sādhanāt bhavatu nāma evaṃvidhāyāḥ anupalabdheḥ abhāva gatiḥ sā punar katham anumānam katham ca na syāt dṛṣṭānta anapekṣaṇāt na hi asyām kaścid dṛṣṭāntaḥ asti kim na nirupākhyam vyoma kusuma ādi dṛṣṭāntaḥ tat asat katham avagantavyam yena evam syāt

anupalabdheḥ eva iti ced tatra katham adṛṣṭāntikāḥ asattā siddhiḥ sa dṛṣṭānta tve vā anavasthā prasaṅgaḥ tathā ca apratipattiḥ tasmāt nirupākhya abhāva siddhi vat anyatra api dṛṣṭānta anapekṣaṇāt ananumānam śṛṇvan api devānāṃpriyaḥ na avadhāraṇa paṭuḥ nimittam hi asat śabda vyavahārāṇām upalabhya anupalabdhiḥ sā sva saṃnidhānāt sva nimittān etān sādhayati iti sva nimitta sāmagrī yogya saṃnidhānaḥ sarvaḥ atra dṛṣṭāntaḥ asattā punar atra anupalabdhiḥ eva atas eva iyam kāraṇāt kārya anumāna lakṣaṇa tvāt

svabhāva hetau antar bhavati iti vakṣyāmaḥ sat śabda vyavahāra pratiṣedhe api pramāṇa nivṛttyā nimitta vaikalya abhāvinaḥ aṅkura ādayaḥ dṛṣṭāntaḥ na kevalam nirupākhyam nirupākhye api iyam eva pravṛttiḥ niṣidhyate anupalabdhi lakṣaṇāḥ asattā siddhāḥ eva saḥ ayam mūḍhaḥ nimittam tad abhāvam vā abhyupagamya pravṛtti nivṛttī vilomayan yathā abhyupagamam pratipādyate nirupākhya vat anya vat vā iti saḥ eva tāvat upalabdhi abhāvaḥ katham siddhaḥ iti ced etat uttaratra vakṣyāmaḥ

anyatra api anumāne sādhya dharmeṇa vyāptam sādhanam icchan kim iti dṛṣṭāntena pratyāyyaḥ vyāpya nirdeśāt eva vyāpnuvataḥ siddheḥ niścita arthasya api smṛti arthaḥ dṛṣṭāntaḥ iti ced tat itaratra api samānam saḥ ayam anyatra anupalambha mātrāt asat vyavahāram pratipadyamānaḥ api iha vyāmūḍhaḥ iti smāryate atha yat idam na santi pradhāna ādayaḥ anupalabdheḥ iti tatra katham asat vyavahāra vidhiḥ sat vyavahāra niṣedhaḥ vā katham ca na syāt tad artha pratiṣedhe dharmi vācinaḥ aprayogāt abhidhānasya nirviṣayasya ca pratiṣedhasya ayogāt na eṣa doṣaḥ yasmāt anādi vāsanā udbhūta vikalpa pariniṣṭhitaḥ śabda arthaḥ trividhaḥ dharmaḥ bhāva abhāva ubhayāśrayaḥ tasmin bhāvānupādāne sādhye asya anupalambhanam tathā hetuḥ na tasya eva abhāvaḥ śabda prayogataḥ

niveditam etat yathā naḥ ete śabdāḥ sva lakṣaṇa viṣayāḥ anādi vāsanā prabhava vikalpa pratibhāsinam artham viṣaya tvena ātmasāt kurvanti vaktuḥ śrotuḥ ca tad vikalpa bhājaḥ yathā pratibhāsi vastu pratipādana samīhā prayogāt tad ākāra vikalpa jananāt ca na ca upādāna kārya pratyaya apratibhā asi rūpam śakyam tad viṣaya tvena adhyavasātum sa tu vikalpaḥ sat asat ubhaya pratyaya ahita vāsanā prabhavaḥ iti tad pratibhā asi a ākāra adhyavasāya vaśena ca bhāva abhāva ubhaya dharmaḥ iti ucyate tat atra dharmiṇi vyavasthitāḥ sat asat tvam cintayanti kim ayam pradhāna śabda pratibhāsi arthaḥ bhāva upādānaḥ na vā iti tasya bhāvān upādāna tve sādhye saḥ eva pratyātma vedya tvāt apratikṣepa arhaḥ arthaḥ dharmī na ca saḥ eva arthaḥ sva lakṣaṇam iti śakyam vaktum asamprāpta niruddhayoḥ api arthayoḥ tasya anapāyāt vastu viparīta ākāra niveśiṣu api tīrtha ānantarīya pratyayeṣu bhāvāt

parama artha eka tāna tve śabdānām anibandhanā na syāt pravṛttiḥ artheṣu darśana antara bhediṣu atīta ajātayoḥ vā api na ca syāt anṛta artha tā vācaḥ kasyāścid iti eṣā bauddha artha viṣayā matā iti saṃgraha ślokau tasya ca yathā samīhita rūpa anupādāna tve sādhye tathā anupalambhaḥ asya dharmaḥ asti iti na sādhana dharma asiddhiḥ na punar atra ayam eva śabda vikalpa pratibhāsi arthaḥ apahnūyate tasya buddhau upasthāpanāya śabda prayogāt tad abhāve tad ayogāt api ca

śabda artha apahnave sādhye dharma ādhāra nirākṛteḥ na sādhyaḥ samudāyaḥ syāt siddhaḥ dharmaḥ ca kevalaḥ yadi hi śabda arthaḥ eva apohyeta pradhāna śabda vācyasya dharmiṇaḥ eva nirākaraṇāt nirādhāraḥ sādhya dharmaḥ syāt tat ayam ādhāravyavaccheda anapekṣaḥ na vivāda āśrayaḥ iti naḥ upanyasanīyaḥ eva syāt kim ca sat asat pakṣa bhedena śabda arthānapavādibhiḥ vastu eva cintyate hi atra pratibaddhaḥ phala udayaḥ artha kriyā samarthasya vicāraiḥ kim tad arthinām ṣaṇḍhasya rūpa vairūpye kāminyāḥ kim parīkṣayā

na hi śabda arthaḥ asan san vā kaṃcid puruṣa artham uparuṇaddhi samādadhāti vā yathā abhiniveśam atattvāt yathā atattvam ca asamīhita tvāt tat ayam pravartamānaḥ sarvadā sat asat cintāyām avadhīrita vikalpa pratibhāsaḥ vastu eva adhiṣṭhānīkaroti yatra ayam puruṣa arthaḥ pratibaddhaḥ yathā agnau śīta pratīkāra ādiḥ na hi atra śabda arthaḥ samarthaḥ tad anubhava āptau api tad abhāvāt tat ayam artha kriyā arthī tat asamartham prati datta anuyogaḥ bhavitum na yuktaḥ na hi vṛṣasyantī ṣaṇḍhasya rūpa vairūpya parīkṣāyām avadhat te yat punar etat uktam kalpitasya anupalabdhiḥ dharmaḥ iti tasya kaḥ arthaḥ

śabda arthaḥ kalpanā jñāna viṣaya tvena kalpitaḥ dharmaḥ vastu āśraya asiddhiḥ asya uktaḥ nyāya vādinā kalpanā viṣaya tvāt śabda arthaḥ eva kalpitaḥ tasya vastu āśraya anupalambhaḥ dharmaḥ iti abhiprāyaḥ yat uktam na pramāṇa traya nivṛttau api bhāva abhāva siddhiḥ iti tat mā bhūt anya pramāṇa anivṛttau nivṛttiḥ tayoḥ asakala viṣaya tvāt āgamaḥ punar na kiṃcid na vyāpnoti tad nivṛttiḥ katham na gamikāḥ iti uktam atra naḥ āgameṣu sarva arthāḥ upanibadhyante aprakaraṇa āpanna tvāt iti

na antarīyaka tā abhāvāt śabdānām vastubhiḥ saha na artha siddhiḥ tatas te hi vaktrabhiprāya sūcakāḥ na hi śabdāḥ yathābhāvam vartante yatas tebhyaḥ artha prakṛtiḥ niścīyeta te hi vaktuḥ vivakṣā vṛttayaḥ iti tat na antarīyakāḥ tām eva gamayeyuḥ na ca puruṣa icchāḥ sarvāḥ yathā artha bhāvinyaḥ na ca tad apratibaddha svabhāvaḥ bhāvaḥ anyam gamayati yat tarhi idam āpta vāda avisaṃvāda sāmānyāt anumāna tā iti āgamasya prāmāṇyam anumāna tvam uktam tat katham na ayam puruṣaḥ anāśritya āgama asitum samarthaḥ atyakṣa phalānām keṣāṃcid pravṛtti nivṛttyoḥ mahā anuśaṃsā pāpa śravaṇāt tad bhāve virodha adarśanāt ca tat sati pravartitavye varam evam pravṛttaḥ iti parīkṣayā prāmāṇyam āha tat ca

sambaddha anuguṇa upāyam puruṣa artha abhidhāyakam parīkṣā adhikṛtam vākyam atas anadhikṛtam param sambaddhaḥ vākyānām eka artha upasaṃhāra upakāraḥ na daśa dāḍima ādi vākyānām iva anupasaṃhāraḥ eva anyathā vaktuḥ vaiguṇyam udbhāvayet aśakya upāya phalāni ca śāstrāṇi phala arthī na ādriyeta vicārayitum apuruṣa artha phalāni ca viṣa śamanāya takṣaka phaṇa ratna alaṃkāra upadeśa vat kāka danta parīkṣā vat ca tat viparyayeṇa upasaṃhāra vat śakya upāyam puruṣa artha abhidhāyi ca śāstram parīkṣyeta anyatra avadhānasya eva ayukta tvāt tat yadi na parīkṣāyām visaṃvāda bhāj pravartamānaḥ śobheta kaḥ punar asya avisaṃvādaḥ

pratyakṣeṇa anumānena dvividhena api abādhakam dṛṣṭa adṛṣṭa arthayoḥ asya avisaṃvādaḥ tad arthayoḥ pratyakṣeṇa abādhanam pratyakṣa abhimatānām arthānām tathā abhāvaḥ yathā nīla ādi sukha duḥkha nimitta upalakṣaṇa rāga ādi buddhīnām atatha abhimatānām ca apratyakṣatā yathā śabda ādi rūpa saṃniveśinām sukha ādīnām dravya karma sāmānya saṃyoga ādīnām ca tathā anāgama apekṣa anumāna viṣaya abhimatānām tathā abhāvaḥ yathā catūrṇām ārya satyānām ananumeyānām tathā abhāvaḥ yathā ātma ādīnām āgama apekṣā anumāne api yathā rāga ādi rūpam tat prabhavam ca adharmam abhyupagamya tad prahāṇāya snāna agni hotra ādeḥ anupadeśaḥ saḥ iyam śakya pariccheda aśeṣa viṣaya viśuddhiḥ avisaṃvādaḥ

āpta vāda avisaṃvāda sāmānyāt anumāna tā buddheḥ agatyāḥ abhihitā parokṣe api asya gocare tasya ca asya evaṃbhūtasya āpta bhūtasya avisaṃvāda sāmānyāt adṛṣṭa vyabhicārasya pratyakṣa anumāna agamye api arthe pratipatteḥ tad āśraya tvāt tad anya pratipatti vat avisaṃvādaḥ anumīyate tatas śabda prabhavāḥ api satī na śābda vat abhiprāyam nivedayati eva iti artha avisaṃvādāt anumānam api athavā anyathā āpta vādasya avisaṃvādāt anumāna tvam ucyate heya upādeya tattvasya saḥ upāyasya prasiddhitaḥ pradhāna artha avisaṃvādāt anumānam paratra vā

heya upādeya tad upāyānām tad upadiṣṭānām avaiparītyam avisaṃvādaḥ yathā catūrṇām ārya satyānām vakṣyamāṇanītyā tasya asya puruṣa artha upayoginaḥ abhiyoga arthasya avisaṃvādāt viṣaya antare api tathā tva upagamaḥ na vipralambhāya anuparodhāt niṣprayojana vitatha abhidhāna vaiphalyāt ca vaktuḥ tat etat agatyāḥ ubhayathā api anumāna tvam āgamasya upavarṇitam varam āgamāt pravṛttau evam pravṛttiḥ iti na khalu evam anumānam anapāyam anāntarīyaka tvāt artheṣu śabdānām iti niveditam etat

puruṣa atiśaya apekṣam yathārtham apare viduḥ yathā artha darśana ādi guṇa yuktaḥ puruṣaḥ āptaḥ tad praṇayanam avisaṃvādaḥ iti anye iṣṭaḥ ayam arthaḥ śakyeta jñātum saḥ atiśayaḥ yadi sarve eva āgamam anāgamam vā pravṛtti kāmaḥ anveṣate prekṣā pūrva kārī na vyasanena api nāma anuṣṭheyam atas jñātvā pravṛttaḥ arthavān syām iti sa śakya darśana avisaṃvāda pratyayena anyatra api pravartate evaṃprāya tvāt loka vyavahārasya

ayam evam na vā iti anya doṣa anirdoṣa tā api vā durlabha tvāt pramāṇānām durbodhāḥ iti apare viduḥ ca etasyebhyaḥ hi guṇa doṣebhyaḥ puruṣāḥ samyak mithyā pravṛttaḥ te ca atīndriyāḥ sva prabhava kāya vāc vyavahāra anumeyāḥ syuḥ vyavahārāḥ ca prāyaśas buddhi pūrvam anyathā api kartum śakyante puruṣa icchā vṛtti tvāt teṣām ca citra abhisandhi tvāt tat ayam liṅga saṃkarāt katham aniścinvan pratipadyeta atha kim naḥ eva sa tādṛśaḥ puruṣaḥ asti yaḥ nirdoṣaḥ

sarveṣām sa vipakṣa tvāt nirhrāsa atiśaya śritām saḥ ātmībhāvāt tad abhyāsāt dhīyeran āśravāḥ kvacid sa tu prahīṇa āśravaḥ durjñānaḥ doṣāḥ hi nirhrāsa atiśaya dharmaṇaḥ vipakṣa abhibhava utkarṣa apakarṣam sādhayanti jvālā ādi vat te hi vikalpa prabhavāḥ sati api upādāne kasyacid manaḥ guṇasya abhyāsāt apakarṣiṇaḥ tad pāṭave niranvaya vināśa dharmāṇaḥ syuḥ jvālā ādi vat eva tena syāt api nirdoṣaḥ katham nirdoṣaḥ nāma yāvatā doṣa vipakṣa sātma tve api doṣa sātmanaḥ vipakṣa utpatti vat yathāpratyayam doṣa utpattiḥ api na ayam doṣaḥ yasmāt nirupadrava bhūta artha svabhāvasya viparyayaiḥ na bādhā yatnavat tve api buddheḥ tad pakṣa pātataḥ

na hi svabhāvaḥ ayatnena vinivartayitum śakyaḥ śrotriya kāpālika ghṛṇā vat yatnaḥ ca prāpya nivartyayoḥ svabhāvayoḥ guṇa doṣa darśanena kriyeta tat ca vipakṣa sa ātmanaḥ puruṣasya doṣeṣu na sambhavati tasya nirupadrava tvāt aśeṣa doṣa hāneḥ paryavasthāna janma pratibaddha duḥkha vivekāt praśama sukha rasasya anudvejanāt ca abhūta artham khalu api upādāna bala bhāvi santānasya viparyaya upādānāt na syāt na tu bhūta artham vastu bala utpatteḥ abhūta arthāḥ ca doṣāḥ na pratipakṣa sātmya bādhinaḥ tasmāt na punar doṣa utpattiḥ yatne api buddheḥ guṇa pakṣapātena pratipakṣaḥ eva yatna ādhānāt parīkṣāvataḥ viśeṣeṇa aduṣṭa ātmanaḥ kaḥ punar eṣām doṣāṇām prabhavaḥ yat pratipakṣa abhyāsāt prahīyante

sarvāsām doṣa jātīnām jātiḥ sat kāya darśanāt sā avidyā tatra tad snehaḥ tasmāt dveṣa ādi sambhavaḥ na hi na aham na mama iti paśyatam parigraham antareṇa kvacid snehaḥ na ca ananurāgiṇaḥ kvacid dveṣaḥ ātmā ātmīya anuparodhini uparodha pratighātini ca tad abhāvāt tasmāt samāna jātīya abhyāsa jam ātma darśanam ātmīya graham prasūte tau ca tat sneham sa ca dveṣa ādīni iti sat kāya darśana jāḥ sarva doṣāḥ tat eva ca ajñānam iti ucyate mohaḥ nidānam doṣāṇām atas eva abhidhīyate satkāya dṛṣṭiḥ anyatra tad prahāṇe prahāṇataḥ

moham doṣa nidānam āhuḥ amūḍhasya doṣān utpatteḥ punar anyatra sat kāya dṛṣṭim tat ca etat pradhāna nirdeśe sati syāt aneka janmanām doṣāṇām eka utpatti virodhāt na ca dvayoḥ prādhānye ekaika nirdeśaḥ para bhāga bhāj ubhayathā api ekasya nirdeśe na virodhaḥ prādhānyam punar tad upādāna tvena tad prahāṇe doṣāṇām prahāṇāt tasmāt sambhavati sat kāya darśana janmanām doṣāṇām tad pratipakṣa nairātmya darśana abhyāsāt prahāṇam sa tu kṣīṇa doṣaḥ duranvayaḥ yat upadeśāt ayam pratipadyeta

girām mithyātva hetūnām doṣāṇām puruṣa āśrayāt apauruṣeyam satya artham iti kecid pracakṣate na khalu sarve eva āgamaḥ sambhāvya vipralambhaḥ vipralambha hetūnām doṣāṇām puruṣa āśrayāt apauruṣeyam satya artham iti eke kāraṇa abhāvaḥ hi kārya abhāvam sādhayati iti yaḥ evaṃvādinaḥ tān eva prati girām satya artha hetūnām guṇānām puruṣa āśrayāt apauruṣeyam mithyā artham kim naḥ iti anye pracakṣate

yathā rāga ādi parītaḥ puruṣaḥ mṛṣāvādī dṛṣṭaḥ tathā dayā dharma tā ādi yuktaḥ satya vāc tat yathā vacanasya puruṣa āśrayāt mithyā artha tā tathā satya artha tāḥ api iti sa nivartamānaḥ tām api nivartayati iti ānarthakyam syāt viparyayaḥ vā na hi śabdāḥ prakṛtyāḥ arthavantaḥ samayāt tatas artha khyāteḥ kāya saṃjñā ādi vat aprātikūlyam tu yogya tā samaye tad icchā praṇayanāt nisarga siddheṣu icchā vaśāt pratipādana ayogāt te anarthakāḥ puruṣa saṃskārāt arthavantaḥ syuḥ tad saṃskāryatā eva ca eṣām pauruṣeya tā yuktā naḥ utpattiḥ tatas eva artha vipralambhāt utpannaḥ api anyathā samitaḥ naḥ uparodhī tad anya puruṣa dharma vat tat ayam nivartamānaḥ sva kṛta samaya sambhavām artha pratibhām nivartayati tat kutas tad nivṛttyā satya artha tā atha punar utpattiḥ eva pauruṣeya tā na samaya ākhyānam

artha jñāpana hetuḥ hi saṃketaḥ puruṣa āśrayaḥ girām apauruṣeya tve api atas mithyātva sambhavaḥ kim hi asya apauruṣeya tayā yatas hi samayāt artha pratipattiḥ sa pauruṣeyaḥ vitathaḥ api syāt śīla sādhana svarga vacanam tat anyathā samayena viparyāsayet tena ayathārtham api prakāśana sambhavāt saḥ eva doṣaḥ

sambandha apauruṣeya tve syāt pratītiḥ asaṃvidaḥ syāt etat akārya sambandhāḥ eva śabdāḥ na te artheṣu puruṣaiḥ anyathā viparyasyante tena adoṣaḥ iti kim idānīm saṃketena sa hi sambandhaḥ yatas artha pratītiḥ sa ced apauruṣeyaḥ na ayam samayam apekṣeta apratīti āśrayaḥ vā katham sambandhaḥ saṃketāt tad abhivyaktau asamartha ani akalpanā

na vai sambandhaḥ vidyamānaḥ api anabhivyaktaḥ pratīti hetuḥ saṃketaḥ tu enam abhivyanakti sa tarhi siddha upasthāyī kim akāraṇam poṣyate nanu iyān sambandhasya vyāpāraḥ yat artha pratīti jananam tat samayena eva kṛtam iti na ayogye samayaḥ samarthaḥ iti yogyatā tad sambandhaḥ ced tat kim vai śabdaḥ sambandhaḥ astu samartham hi rūpam śabdasya yogyatā kārya kāraṇa yogya tāvat sā ced artha antaram kim śabdasya iti sambandhaḥ vācyaḥ yogyatā upakāraḥ iti ced na nityāyāḥ niratiśaya tvāt tatra api atiprasaṅgāt upakāra asiddheḥ

yogyatāyām ca svatas yogya tve arthaḥ eva kim naḥ iṣyate samayaḥ tarhi katham śabda artha sambandhāḥ puruṣeṣu vṛtteḥ na amiśrāṇām siddhānām kaścid sambandhaḥ abheda prasaṅgāt anapekṣaṇāt ca artha viśeṣa samīhā preritā vāc atas idam iti viduṣaḥ sva nidāna ābhāsinam artham sūcayati iti buddhi rūpa vāc vijñaptyoḥ janya janaka bhāvaḥ sambandhaḥ tatas śabdāt pratipattiḥ avinā abhāvāt tad ākhyānam samayaḥ tatas pratyāyaka sambandha siddheḥ sambandha ākhyānāt na tu saḥ eva sambandhaḥ astu vai anyaḥ eva nityaḥ sambandhaḥ tena

girām eka artha niyame na syāt artha antare gatiḥ na hi tena sambandhena asambaddhe arthe pratītiḥ yuktā tasya vaiphalya prasaṅgāt dṛṣṭaḥ ca icchā vaśāt kṛta samayaḥ sarvaḥ sarvasya dīpakaḥ aneka artha abhisambandhe viruddha vyakti sambhavaḥ atha mā bhūt dṛṣṭa virodhaḥ iti sarve sarvasya vācakāḥ tathā na sarvaḥ sarva sādhanaḥ asaṃkarāt kārya kāraṇa tāyāḥ tatra pratiniyata sādhane abhimate arthe sarva sādhya sādhana sādhāraṇasya śabdasya iṣṭa vyaktim eva samaya kāraḥ karoti iti kutas etat saḥ aniyataḥ niyamam puruṣāt pratipadyate tadā

apauruṣeya tāyāḥ ca vyarthā syāt parikalpanā api nāma asaṃkīrṇam artham jānīyām iti saṃkara hetuḥ puruṣa upākīrṇaḥ tatra yādṛśāḥ puruṣaiḥ kvacid prayuktāḥ saṃkīryante tādṛśāḥ eva sarva sādhāraṇāḥ santaḥ kvacid taiḥ viniyamitāḥ tattva aparijñānāt prakṛtyāḥ eva vaidikāḥ niyatāḥ iti ced na upadeśam apekṣeran na anyathā saṃketena prakāśayeyuḥ vyākhyā vikalpaḥ ca na syāt upadeśasya ca iṣṭa saṃvādaḥ śakya vikalpe na asti iti vyarthāḥ eva apauruṣeya tā

vācyaḥ ca hetuḥ bhinnānām sambandhasya vyavasthiteḥ arthāḥ hi bāhyāḥ na rūpam śabdasya na śabdaḥ arthānām yena abhinna ātma tayā vyavasthā bhede api na antarīyaka tā syāt kṛtaka tva anitya tva vat na api ete vivakṣā janmānaḥ dhvanayaḥ ajanmānaḥ vā vivakṣā vyaṅgyāḥ na artha āyattāḥ tatas katham idānīm tad pratiniyama saṃsādhyam tat anvayam sādhayeyuḥ na hi apratibaddhaḥ tad sādhanaḥ iti asaṃskārya tayā pumbhiḥ sarvathā syāt nirarthatā saṃskāra upagame mukhyam gaja snānam idam bhavet

iti saṃgrahaślokaḥ api ca śabda arthayoḥ sambandhaḥ nityaḥ vā syāt anityaḥ vā yadi anityaḥ puruṣa icchā vṛttiḥ avṛttiḥ vā apuruṣa adhīna tve puruṣāṇām yathā abhiprāyam deśa ādi parāvṛttyā tena pratipādanam na syāt icchāyām api anāyattasya kadācid ayogāt parvata ādi vat ayam eva nitya tve api doṣaḥ tasya sthira rūpasya parāvṛttyayogāt iti samam sarva avasthāne api iṣṭa pratiniyama abhāvāt tatas viśeṣa pratipattiḥ na syāt iti pūrvavat prasaṅgaḥ icchā vṛttau ca pauruṣeya tvam iti vipralambha āśaṅkā api ca sambandhinām anitya tvāt na sambandhe asti nityatā

para āśrayaḥ hi sambandhaḥ apratibandhe tayoḥ sambandhitā ayogāt sa ca āśrayaḥ anityaḥ apāye asya sambandhasya api apāyaḥ anyathā anāśritaḥ syāt tatas na nityaḥ tad āśraya arthaḥ ca vaktavyaḥ nityasya anupakārya tvāt anupakurvāṇaḥ ca anāśrayaḥ jāteḥ vācya tvāt adoṣaḥ iti ced na tad vacane prayojana abhāvāt iti nirloṭhitam etat sarvatra ca jāti a sambhavāt ayogaḥ yādṛt chikeṣu vyakti vāciṣu sarvadā jāti codane viśeṣa antara vyudāsena pravṛtti ayogāt ca tasmāt anvaya vyatirekiṇaḥ bhāvasya bhāva abhāvau sambandhaḥ

arthaiḥ atas sa śabdānām saṃskāryaḥ puruṣaiḥ dhiyā tau eva bhāva abhāvau āśritya asaṃsṛṣṭau api saṃsṛṣṭau iva puruṣasya vyavahāra bhāvanātaḥ pratibhātaḥ iti pauruṣeyaḥ bhāvānām saṃśleṣaḥ kim ca āśraya vināśāt naṣṭe sambandhe sa śabdaḥ punar asambandha tvāt na apūrveṇa yojyeta utpanna utpannāḥ ca bhāvāḥ sthita sambandha abhāvāt asambandhinaḥ avācyāḥ syuḥ tatra api arthaiḥ eva saha utpāde kalpyamāne na svabhāva viparyayaḥ śabdeṣu yuktaḥ

atha mā bhūt naṣṭa sambandhasya śabdasya artha antare vaiguṇyam arthānām ca avācya tā iti utpannaḥ arthaḥ sambandhavān yadi utpadyeta sa sambandhaḥ utpannaḥ api na śabde syāt tasya tena asambandhi svabhāvasya svabhāva viparyayam antareṇa tad bhāva ayogāt arthena saha utpannasya anyatas siddhasya anupakāriṇi śabde asamāśrayāt ca tasya api tad utpatti sahakāri tve samarthasya nitya utpādana prasaṅgaḥ anapekṣa tvāt nityasya anupakārāt asāmarthye api paścāt api svabhāva atyāgāt aśaktiḥ

sambandhe na ayam doṣaḥ vikalpite na hi bhāva śleṣa apekṣī puruṣa bhāvanā pratibhāsī tad apekṣā lakṣaṇaḥ sambandhaḥ saḥ ayam nityānām api aparāvartayan svabhāvam kutaścid svayam utprekṣya ghaṭayet iti te api tathā syuḥ na ca cyavana dharmāṇaḥ yat uktam āśraya apāyena āśrita sambandha vināśāt anityaḥ saḥ iti tatra

nitya tvāt āśraya apāye api anāśaḥ yadi jāti vat nityeṣu āśraya sāmarthyam kim yena iṣṭaḥ saḥ āśrayaḥ śrūyate etat nityā jātiḥ āśrayitā ca na api āśrayeṇa saha naśyati iti kevalam nityeṣu āśraya sāmarthyam na paśyāmaḥ yena asau āśrayaḥ kṛtasya karaṇa abhāvāt akārakasya ca anapekṣa tvāt vyaktiḥ upakāraḥ jāteḥ sambandhasya ca āśrayāt tena āśrayaḥ iti ced jñāna utpādana hetūnām sambandhāt sahakāriṇām tad utpādana yogya tvena utpattiḥ vyaktiḥ iṣyate ghaṭa ādiṣu api yukti jñaiḥ aviśeṣe avikāriṇām vyañjakaiḥ svaiḥ kutas kaḥ arthaḥ vyaktāḥ taiḥ te yatas matāḥ

sahakāriṇaḥ sakāśāt upādāna apekṣāt jñāna janana yogya kṣaṇa antara utpattiḥ eva ghaṭa ādīnām abhivyaktiḥ anyathā anapekṣya tad upakāram jñāna utpādana prasaṅgāt sāmarthya kāriṇaḥ ca janakatvāt tasya ca tad ātmaka tvāt artha antara tve ca bhāvān upakāra prasaṅgāt sāmarthyāt ca jñāna utpatteḥ nityam ghaṭa ādīnām agrahaṇa āpatteḥ anāloka apekṣa grahaṇa prasaṅgāt anapekṣa ātmā anupakārāt tat ime sva viṣaya jñāna janane param apekṣamāṇāḥ tatas svabhāva atiśayam svīkurvanti tena asya te janyāḥ jñeya rūpā sādhanāt tu jñāna vaśena kārya atiśaya vācinā śabdena viśeṣa khyāti artham vyaṅgyāḥ khyāpyante na evam jāti sambandha ādayaḥ kathaṃcid api anupakārya tvāt anupakāriṇā vyaktā yujyate sambandhasya ca vastu tve syāt bhedāt buddhi citra tā

sa ca ayam sambandhaḥ vastu bhavat niyamena śabda arthābhyām bheda abhedau na ativartate rūpam hi vastu tasya atattvam eva anyat tvam iti uktam sa ca ayam aindriyaḥ san sva buddhau tad anya vivekinā pratibhāsamānaḥ rūpeṇa katham tathā syāt dṛśyau ivekā darśanayoḥ viveka sattā viparyaya āśraya tvāt anyathā tat sthiteḥ abhāva prasaṅgāt atīndriya tvāt apratibhāse api indriya ādiṣu iva adoṣaḥ iti ced na tatas apratipatti prasaṅgāt aprasiddhasya ajñāpaka tvāt saṃnidhi mātreṇa jñāpane avyutpannānām api syāt na anumānāt pratipattiḥ liṅga abhāvāt dṛṣṭānta asiddheḥ ca tatra api atīndriya tvena sādhana apekṣaṇāt tulyam indriya ādiṣu api iti ced na teṣām anyathā anumānāt jñānam hi keṣucid satsu vyatireka anvaya vat tanmātrā sambhavam tad vyatirikta apekṣām ca sādhayati tatas kārya dvāreṇa indriya siddhiḥ na evam sambandhasya tasya asiddhau tad kāryasya eva jñānasya abhāvāt

na hi tatra śabda rūpam arthaḥ vā liṅgam tayoḥ sarvatra yogya tvāt viśeṣa pratīti samāśrayasya apratyāyanāt apratītiḥ asya na hi asati sambandha viśeṣe sā yuktā tasyām vā animittāyām tad viśeṣa pratīti niyama vat artha pratipādanam api śabdānām animittam kim naḥ iṣyate tasmāt tat sadṛśam liṅgam sarva sambandhe tatas aviśeṣeṇa gamayet tatas aviśeṣeṇa eva pratītiḥ syāt sarvasya ca tasmāt sambandha siddhi artha pratīteḥ na kaścid sampradāyam apekṣeta sampradāya sahitasya liṅga tvam iti ced tat kim anayā paraṃparayā saḥ eva sampradāya apekṣaḥ artha jñāpanam kim na karoti sa ca śabdaḥ yat abhiprāyaiḥ prayujyamānaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ anyathā na dṛṣṭaḥ darśana adarśanābhyām dhūma ādi vat tad pratītim janayati iti saḥ eva sambandhaḥ avinābhāva ākhyaḥ na ca atra anyasya sāmarthyam paśyāmaḥ na api siddhi upāyam atha punar na śabda arthayoḥ anyaḥ eva sambandhaḥ

tābhyām abhede tau eva na atas anyā vastunaḥ gatiḥ rūpa bheda nibandhana tvāt vyavasthā antarasya tad rūpam tat eva syāt dharma bhedaḥ tu syāt pūrva ukta krameṇa sa ca aviruddhaḥ eva na vastu bhedaḥ na ca bheda abhedau muktvā vastunaḥ anyā gatiḥ tasya rūpa lakṣaṇa tvāt rūpasya ca etad vikalpa anati vṛtteḥ api ca bhinna tvāt vastu rūpasya sambandhaḥ kalpanā kṛtaḥ iti uktam prāk na hi śleṣa lakṣaṇaḥ sambandhaḥ aśliṣṭeṣu padārtheṣu sambhavati na ca artha antaram eṣām sambandhaḥ yasmāt sat dravyam syāt para adhīnam sambandhaḥ anyasya vā katham

na hi siddham sat param apekṣate na anapekṣaḥ svatantraḥ sambandhaḥ dravyam iti ca svabhāvaḥ ucyate sa katham para bhāvasya śleṣaḥ syāt na hi svabhāva antara sattayā anyaḥ śliṣṭaḥ nāma mā bhūt aśliṣṭena śliṣṭena tu syāt iti ced na tasya eva tābhyām śleṣa asiddheḥ saḥ eva asiddhaḥ yaḥ tau śleṣayet tat ayam atiprasaṅgaḥ yadi arthau artha antareṇa śliṣyataḥ viśeṣa abhāvāt kim ca varṇāḥ nirarthakāḥ santaḥ pada ādi parikalpitam avastuni katham vṛttiḥ sambandhasya asya vastunaḥ

vācakaḥ hi vacana aṅgena tadvān syāt santaḥ api avācakāḥ varṇāḥ tat na teṣu vācya vācaka sambandhaḥ tad vṛttau sva rūpa hāni prasaṅgāt krama viśeṣeṇa vācakāḥ varṇāḥ iti ced na kramasya anartha antara tvena abhedaka tvāt tad rūpasya krama antare api aviśeṣāt tulyā syāt pratipattiḥ artha antara tvam api kramasya niṣetsyāmaḥ tat asati varṇānām vācaka tve pada ādi vācakam syāt tat ca na kiṃcid vyatireka avyatireka virodhāt tasmāt indriya vijñāna viśeṣa anubandhī sa bhāga vāsana upādāna vikalpa pratibhāsa vibhramaḥ padam vākyam ca eka avabhāsi mithyā eva eka aneka tva ayogāt na hi ekam anekayā buddhyā krameṇa grahaṇa ayogāt na ca tat ekayā grāhyam varṇa anukrama grahaṇāt eka varṇa grahaṇa kāle ca aneka buddhi vyatikramāt kṣaṇika tvāt buddhīnām kṣaṇasya eka paramāṇu vyatikrama kāla tvāt

ādhikye vibhāgavataḥ paryavasāna ayogāt aneka aṇu vyatyaya nimeṣa tulya kāla tvāt antya varṇa parisamāpteḥ yathā anubhavam smaraṇāt smṛtiḥ api tad kāle eva anubhava smaraṇa anukramayoḥ viśeṣa anupalakṣaṇa tvāt ca na api anekam pada ādi abheda pratibhāsanāt buddheḥ tad aneka tvasya niṣetsyamāna tvāt ca tat na vastu tasya etad vikalpa anatikramāt vastu ca sambandhaḥ sa katham tad āśrayaḥ syāt āśrayanīyā yogāt anāśritaḥ hi evam syāt tathā ca asambandhaḥ tasmāt na svābhāvikaḥ śabda arthayoḥ sambandhaḥ tad abhiprāyasya prayogāt utpannaḥ abhivyaktaḥ vā śabdaḥ tat avyabhicārī iti tattvam asya sambandhaḥ sā ca utpattiḥ abhivyaktiḥ vai avyabhicāra āśrayaḥ pauruṣeyī iti pauruṣeya eva sambandhaḥ tad dvāreṇa ca artha pratyāyane aniyamaḥ śabdānām iti apauruṣeya tve api saḥ eva vipralambhaḥ

apauruṣeya tā api iṣṭā kartṝṇām asmṛteḥ kila yāḥ api iyam apauruṣeya tā veda vākyānām kartuḥ asmaraṇāt varṇyate santi asya api anuvaktāraḥ iti dhik vyāpakam tamaḥ tasya eva tāvat īdṛśam prajñā skhalitam katham vṛttam iti sa vismaya anukampam naḥ cetaḥ tat apare api anuvadanti iti nirdaya ākrānta bhuvanam dhik vyāpakam tamaḥ kaḥ prāṇinaḥ hita īpsā vipralabdhasya aparādhaḥ tathā hi smaranti saugatāḥ mantrāṇām kartṝn aṣṭaka ādīn hiraṇyagarbham ca kāṇādāḥ teṣām sa mithyāvādaḥ iti ced kaḥ idānīm evam pauruṣeyaḥ anyaḥ api kumāra sambhava ādiṣu ātmānam anyam vā praṇetāram upadiśantaḥ yat evam prativyūhyeran tatra prativahane abhyupeta bādhāḥ iti ced nanu idam eva abhyupagama aṅgam iti kasya bādhā tat parasya api tulyam eva tasya iṣṭa tvāt adoṣaḥ iti ced

kutas asya iyam iṣṭiḥ apramāṇikā prāk āsīt akasmāt grāhī ca ayam kim punar kvacid sādhanam apekṣate yat pauruṣeya apauruṣeya cintayā ātmānam āyāsayati tatas eva iṣṭeḥ anabhyupeta bādhāyām tad anyasya api tulyam iti anupālambhaḥ anatiśaya darśī ca ayam vākyeṣu evaṃprakārāṇām apauruṣeya tva sādhanānām kārya dharmāṇām vā kvacid atiśayam abhyupetaḥ iti apratyayaḥ eva asya vṛttiḥ dṛśyante ca vicchinna kriyā sampradāyāḥ kṛtakāḥ ca tān yatnavantaḥ upalabhante iti ced na niyama abhāvāt anyatra anupalambhasya upalambhasya vā para upadeśāt apratyayāt aniścaya artha tvāt svayaṃkṛtānām api apahnotṛ darśanāt niṣṭhā gamanasya aśakya tvāt

yathā ayam anyatas aśrutvā na imam varṇa pada kramam vaktum samarthaḥ puruṣaḥ tathā anyaḥ api iti kaścana tasya api tat eva uttaram evam apauruṣeya tve api kim idānīm pauruṣeyam iti ādi tathā hi anyaḥ vā racitaḥ granthaḥ sampradāyāt ṛte paraiḥ dṛṣṭaḥ kaḥ abhihitaḥ yena saḥ api evam na anumīyate

na khalu kiṃcid anyat apauruṣeya tva āśrayaḥ anyatra idānīntanānām anupadeśa pāṭhā śakteḥ sā ca anyatra api ekena racite granthe anyasya tulyā tad anusāriṇā sarvaḥ tathā unneyaḥ na vā kaścid tasya tathā aniṣṭa tvāt iti ādau api uktam iṣṭeḥ tad āśraya tvāt iti ādi api ca yat jātīyaḥ yatas siddhaḥ sa tasmāt agni kāṣṭha vat adṛṣṭa hetuḥ anyaḥ api aviśiṣṭaḥ sampratīyate

na adarśanāt hetuḥ ahetukaḥ nāma adṛṣṭa hetavaḥ api hi bhāvāḥ tad anyaiḥ svabhāva abhedam anubhavantaḥ tathāvidhāḥ samunnīyante hetu rūpa nivṛttau api tad rūpam anivṛttam kārya dharma vyatikramāt na tatas syāt iti na kaścid tathā vacanīyaḥ rūpa viśeṣaḥ vā tathā darśanīyaḥ yaḥ enam hetum anuvidadhyāt yena iṣṭa aniṣṭayoḥ iṣṭa viparyayaḥ na syāt svabhāva nivṛtteḥ ca hetoḥ abhedane bhāvānām bhedaḥ syāt ākasmikaḥ iti na kvacid vinivarteta tasmāt yaḥ svabhāvaḥ yat janmā dṛṣṭaḥ saḥ anyatra api avibhajyamānaḥ sva ātmanā tad kārya dharma tām na ativartate agni in dhana vat tatra apradarśya ye bhedam kārya sāmānya darśanāt hetavaḥ pravitanyante sarve te vyabhicāriṇaḥ

yathā ādyaḥ api pathika kṛtaḥ agniḥ jvālā antara pūrvakaḥ na araṇi nirmathana pūrvakaḥ pathika agni tvāt anantara agni vat iti katham punar pathika agneḥ vyabhicāraḥ jvālodbhava sāmarthyam hi āśritya dahanasya hetu antaram pratikṣipyate yadi hi vinā jvālayā syāt anyatra api syāt iti tatra jvālā itara janmanoḥ abādhya bādhaka tve jvālā prabhava tvam anyathā api syāt iti dharmayoḥ ekatra arthe sambhavāt sa pathika agniḥ anyaḥ vai arthaḥ eka pratiniyataḥ na syāt iti āśaṅkyate vyabhicāraḥ saḥ api anyonya vyatirekī dharma dvaya avatāraḥ vastu sāmānye aviruddhaḥ iti ucyate na avasthā bhedini viśeṣe niṣkalasya ātmanaḥ tad atattva virodhāt na ca jvālā itara janmanoḥ bādhya bādhaka tā pathika agnau tasya jvālā prabhava vyatirekeṇa asambhava abhāvāt evaṃbhūtaḥ pathika agniḥ jvālā prabhavaḥ iti syāt

na sarvaḥ tatra viśeṣa pratikṣepasya kartum aśakya tvāt sambhavat viśeṣasya ca tādavasthya aniyamāt yat api vinā jvālayā syāt anyatra api syāt iti bhavati eva yayā sāmagryā sambhavati sā yadi syāt asyāḥ sambhavam pradarśya tad abhāvam pradarśayet tatra vā jvālām syāt etat tasmāt naḥ ekasya parapūrvakam adhyayanam sarvasya tathā abhāvam sādhayati tasya anyathā asambhava abhāvāt tathāvidhasya tu tad kriyā pratibhā ra hitasya tathā syāt iti tathābhūtam evam vācyam syāt tat aviśeṣeṇa sambhavat viśeṣam ucyamānam chāyām na puṣṇāti katham viśeṣasya sambhavaḥ yāvatā teṣām api puruṣāṇām aśaktiḥ eva idānīntana puruṣa vat atra api śakti puruṣayoḥ na kiṃcid virodha darśanam iti na aviruddha vidhiḥ anupalabdhi prayogaḥ gamakaḥ

na hi atīndriyeṣu virodha gatiḥ asti iti uktam na ca ayam pūrva prayogāt bhidyate yadi puruṣāḥ śaktāḥ syuḥ idānīntanāḥ api iti viśeṣa asambhavaḥ etat syāt sa ca duḥsādhaḥ yatra ekasya aśaktiḥ tatra sarva puruṣāṇām iti api pūrvavat vyabhicāri bhārata ādiṣu idānīntanānām aśaktau api kasyacid śakti siddheḥ tasmāt kāraṇāni vivecayata artheṣu api tad atad pratibhaveṣu svabhāva bhedaḥ darśanīyaḥ tad abhāve sarvaḥ tad ātmā na vā kaścid na ca atra laukika vaidikayoḥ svabhāva bhedam paśyāmaḥ asati tasmin tayoḥ sāmānyasya eva dṛṣṭeḥ ekasya kaścid dharmam vivecayan tad svabhāva sambhavinā tena āśaṅkya vyabhicāra vādaḥ kriyate nanu veda avedayoḥ tattva lakṣaṇaḥ asti eva viśeṣaḥ satyam asti na kevalam tayoḥ eva

kim tarhi ḍiṇḍikapurāṇa itarayoḥ api na ca sva prakriyā bheda dīpanaḥ nāma bhedaḥ puruṣa kṛtim bādhate anyatra api prasaṅgāt yadi tādṛśīm racanām puruṣāḥ kartum na śaknuyuḥ kṛtām vā akṛta saṃketaḥ vivecayet vyaktam apauruṣeyaḥ vedaḥ nanu na śaknuvanti eva puruṣāḥ mantrān kartum etat uttaratra vicārayiṣyāmaḥ api ca na mantraḥ nāma anyat eva kiṃcid kim tarhi satya tapaḥ prabhāvavatām samīhita artha sādhanam vacanam tat adya tve api puruṣeṣu dṛśyate eva yathāsvam satya adhiṣṭhāna balāḥ viṣa dahana ādi stambhana darśanāt śabarāṇām ca keṣāṃcid adya api mantra karaṇāt avaidikānām ca bauddha ādīnām mantra kalpānām darśanāt teṣām ca puruṣa kṛteḥ tatra api apauruṣeya tve katham idānīm apauruṣeyam avitatham

tathā hi bauddha itarayoḥ mantra kalpayoḥ hiṃsā maithuna ātma darśana ādayaḥ anabhyudaya hetavaḥ anyathā ca varṇyate tat katham ekatra viruddha abhidhāyi dvayam satyam syāt tatra artha antara kalpane tat anyatra api tulyam iti artha anirṇayāt kvacid apratipattiḥ tathā ca sat api anupayogam apauruṣeyam bauddha ādīnām amantra tve tat anyatra api koṣa pānam syāt karaṇīyam viṣa karma adhikṛtaḥ bauddhāḥ api dṛśyante tatra amantra tvam api vipratiṣiddham mudrā maṇḍala dhyānaiḥ api anakṣaraiḥ karmāṇi kriyante na ca tāni apauruṣeyāṇi nityāni yujyate teṣām kriyā sambhave akṣara racanāyām kaḥ pratighātaḥ puruṣāṇām tasmāt na kiṃcid aśakya kriyam eṣām katham idānīm satya prabhavau mantra kalpau paraspara virodhinau na vai sarvatra tau satya prabhavau

prabhāva yukta puruṣa pratijñā lakṣaṇau api tau staḥ sa prabhāvaḥ gati siddhi viśeṣābhyām api syāt yadi pauruṣeyāḥ mantrāḥ kim na sarve puruṣāḥ mantra kāriṇaḥ tad kriyā sādhana vaikalyāt yadi tādṛśaiḥ satya tapaḥ prabhṛtibhiḥ yuktāḥ syuḥ kurvanti eva api ca kāvyāni puruṣaḥ karoti iti sarvaḥ puruṣaḥ kāvya kṛt syāt akaraṇe vā naḥ eva kaścid tadvat iti apūrvā eṣā vācoyuktiḥ satyam mantra kriyā sādhana vikalāḥ mantrān na kurvate tat tu kasyacid sākalyam na paśyāmaḥ puruṣāṇām samāna dharma tvāt uktam atra na mantraḥ nāma anyat eva kiṃcid satya ādimatām vacana samayāt iti tāni ca kvacid puruṣeṣu dṛśyante sarva puruṣāḥ tad rahitāḥ iti api tad sambhava virodha abhāvāt anirṇayaḥ na ca atyakṣa svabhāveṣu anupalabdhiḥ niścaya hetuḥ

na ca smṛti mati prativedha satya śaktayaḥ sarva bhāvinyaḥ tad sādhana sampradāya bheda vat guṇa antara sādhanāni api syuḥ na api san api sarvaḥ draṣṭum śakyaḥ atas eva adṛṣṭasya anapahnavaḥ na api puruṣeṣu utpitsoḥ kasyacid guṇasya pratiroddhā bādhya adṛṣṭeḥ bādhya bādhaka bhāva asiddheḥ etena sarva jñāna pratiṣedha ādayaḥ api nirvarṇita uttarāḥ tatra api evaṃbhūtaḥ yādṛśaḥ ayam asambhavat tad sādhana sampradāyaḥ naḥ iti nyāyaḥ na adṛṣṭa jñāpakaḥ atad svabhāvaḥ iti api satām api kārya anārambha sambhavāt svabhāva vipra karṣeṇa draṣṭum aśakya tvāt ca tasmāt adhyayanam adhyayana antara pūrvakam adhyayanāt iti bhārata adhyayane api bhāvāt vyabhicāri nanu vedane viśeṣaṇāt adoṣaḥ kaḥ punar atiśayaḥ veda adhyayanasya yat anyathā adhyetum na śakyate

na hi viśeṣaṇam aviruddham vipakṣeṇa asmāt hetum vyāvartayati aviruddhayoḥ ekatra sambhavāt idānīntanānām adhyayanāt iti ced ukta uttaram etat adarśanāt iti ced idam api prativyūḍham na api adarśana mātram abhāvam gamayati iti vyabhicāraḥ eva tasmāt na viśeṣaṇam atiśaya bhāj iti anupātta samam yat kiṃcid veda adhyayanam sarvam tad adhyayana antara pūrvakam iti api vyāptiḥ na sidhyati sarvasya tathā abhāva asiddheḥ yādṛśam tu tad nimittam dṛṣṭam tat tathā iti syāt dṛṣṭe viśeṣe tad nimitta tayā tad tyāgena sāmānya grahaṇam vyabhicāri eva hutāśana saṃsiddhau pāṇḍu dravya tva vat etena vacana āt ayaḥ rāga ādi sādhane pratyuktāḥ astu vedam adhyayanam adhyayana pūrva tā sādhanam

sarvathā anāditā sidhyet evam na apuruṣa āśrayaḥ tasmāt apauruṣeya tve syāt anyaḥ api anarāśrayaḥ puruṣaḥ eva hi svayam abhyūhya paratas vā ādhīyate na eṣām avyāpṛta karaṇānām svayam śabdāḥ dhvananti yena apauruṣeyāḥ syuḥ api syuḥ apauruṣeyāḥ yadi puruṣāṇām ādiḥ syāt tadā api anya pūrvakam na sidhyati adhyāpayituḥ abhāvāt tat prathamaḥ adhyetā kartā eva syāt tat ayam anādiḥ pūrva pūrva darśana pravṛttaḥ ḍimbhakapāṃsu krīḍā ādi vat puruṣa vyavahāraḥ iti syāt na apauruṣeyaḥ iti anādi tvāt apauruṣeya tve bahutaram idānīm apauruṣeyam tathā hi mleccha ādi vyavahārāṇām nāstikya vacasām api anādi tvāt tathā abhāvaḥ pūrva saṃskāra santateḥ
