pratiṣedhyasya svabhāvena viruddhasya upalabdhi rudrā āhriyate yathā iti atra iti dharmī na śīta sparśaḥ iti śīta sparśa pratiṣedhaḥ sādhyaḥ vahneḥ iti hetuḥ iyam ca anupalabdhiḥ tatra prayoktavyāḥ yatra śīta sparśaḥ adṛśyaḥ dṛśye dṛśya anupalabdhi prayogāt tasmāt yatra varṇa viśeṣāt vahniḥ dṛśyaḥ śīta sparśaḥ dūra stha tvāt san api adṛśyaḥ tatra asyāḥ prayogaḥ

pratiṣedhyena yat viruddham tad kāryasya upalabdhiḥ gamikā yathā iti atra iti dharmī na śīta sparśaḥ iti śīta sparśa abhāvaḥ sādhyaḥ dhūmāt iti hetuḥ yatra śīta sparśaḥ san dṛśyaḥ syāt tatra dṛśyā anupalabdhiḥ gamikā yatra viruddhaḥ vahniḥ pratyakṣaḥ tatra viruddha upalabdhiḥ gamikā dvayoḥ api tu parokṣa tve virudva kārya upalabdhiḥ prayujyate

tatra samasta apavaraka stham śītam nivarttayitum samarthasya agneḥ anumāpakam yadā viśiṣṭam dhūma kalāpam niryāntam apavarakāt paśyati tadā viśiṣṭāt vahneḥ anumitāt śīta sparśa nivṛttim anumimīte iha dṛśyamāna dvāra pradeśa sahitaḥ sarvaḥ apavaraka abhyantara deśaḥ dharmī sādhya pratipatti anusaraṇāt pūrvavat draṣṭavyaḥ iti

pratiṣedhyasya yat viruddham tena vyāptasya dharma antarasya upalabdhiḥ udāharttavyā yathā iti dhruvam avaśyam bhavati iti dhruva bhāvī na iti dhruva bhāvi tva niṣedhaḥ sādhyaḥ vināśaḥ dharmī bhūtasyīpi bhāvasya iti dharmi viśeṣaṇam bhūtasya jātasya api vinaśvaraḥ svabhāvaḥ na avaśyambhāvī kim uta ajātasya iti api śabda arthaḥ janakāt hetoḥ anyaḥ hetuḥ hetu antaram mudgara ādi tat apekṣate vinaśvaraḥ tasya apekṣuṇāt iti hetuḥ hetu antara apekṣaṇam nāma adhruva bhāvi tvena vyāptam yathā vāsasi rāgasya rañjam ādi hetu antara apekṣaṇam adhruva bhāvi tvena vyāptam dhruva bhāvi tva viruddham ca adhruva bhāvi tvam vināśaḥ ca vinaśvara svabhāva ātmā hetu antara apekṣaḥ iṣṭaḥ tatas viruddha vyāpta hetu antara apekṣaṇa darśanāt dhruva bhāvi tva niṣedhaḥ

iha dhruva bhāvi tvam nitya tvam adhruva bhāvi tvam ca anitya tvam nitya tva anitya tvayoḥ ca paraspara parihāreṇa avasthānāt ekatra virodhaḥ tathā ca sati paraspara parihāravatoḥ dvayoḥ yadā ekam dṛśyate tatra dvitīyasya tādātmya niṣedhaḥ kāryaḥ tādātmya niṣedhaḥ ca dṛśya tayā abhyupagatasya sambhavati yatas evam tādātmya niṣedhaḥ kriyate

yadi ayam dṛśyamānaḥ nityaḥ bhavet nitya rūpaḥ dṛśyeta na ca nitya rūpaḥ dṛśyate tasmāt na nityaḥ evam ca pratiṣedhyasya nitya tvasya dṛśyamāna ātmaka tvam abhyupagamya pratiṣedhaḥ kṛtaḥ bhavati vastunaḥ api adṛśyasya piśāca ādeḥ ya didṛśya ghaṭa ātmaka tva niṣedhaḥ kriyate dṛśya ātmaka tvam abhyupagamya karttavyaḥ yadi ayam ghaṭaḥ dṛśyamānaḥ piśāca ātmā bhavet piśācaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ bhavet na ca dṛṣṭaḥ tasmāt na piśācaḥ iti dṛśya ātma tva abhyupagama pūrvakaḥ dṛśyamāne ghaṭa ādau vastuni vastunaḥ avastunaḥ vā dṛśyasya adṛśyasya ca tādātmya pratiṣedhaḥ tathā ca sati yathā ghaṭasya dṛśya tvam abhyupagamya pratiṣedhaḥ dṛśya anupalambhāt eva tadvat sarvasya paraspara parihāravataḥ anyatra dṛśyamāne niṣedhaḥ dṛśya anupalambhāt eva tathā ca asya evaṃjātīyakasya prayogasya svabhāva anupalabdhau antarbhāvaḥ

pratiṣedhyasya yat kāryam tasya yat viruddham tasya upalabdheḥ udāharaṇam yathā iti iha iti dharmī apratibaddham sāmarthya yeṣām śīta kāraṇānām śīta jananam prati tāni na santi iti sādhyam vahneḥ iti hetuḥ yatra śīta kāraṇāni adṛśyāni śīta sparśaḥ api adṛśyaḥ tatra ayam hetuḥ prayoktavyaḥ dṛśya tve tu śīta sparśasya tad kāraṇānām vā kāryā anupalabdhiḥ dṛśyā anupalabdhiḥ vā gamikā tasmāt eṣa api abhāva sādhanī tatas yasmin uddeśe sat api śīta kāraṇam adṛśyam śīta sparśaḥ ca dūra stha tvāt pratipattuḥ vahniḥ bhāsvara varṇa tvāt dūrāt api dṛśyaḥ tatra ayam prayogaḥ iti

pratiṣedhyasya yat vyāpakam tena yat viruddham tasya upalabdhiḥ udāha rttavyāḥ yathā iti atra iti dharmī tuṣāra sparśaḥ na iti sādhyam vahneḥ iti hetuḥ yatra vyāpyaḥ tuṣāra sparśaḥ vyāpakaḥ ca śīta sparśaḥ na dṛśyaḥ tatra ayam hetuḥ tayoḥ dṛśya tve svabhāvasya vyāpakasya ca anupalabdhiḥ yatas prayoktavyā tathā ca satyabhāva sādhanīyam dūra varttinaḥ ca pratipattuḥ tuṣāra sparśaḥ śīta sparśa viśeṣaḥ śīta mātram ca parokṣam vahniḥ tu rūpa viśeṣāt dūra sthaḥ api pratyakṣaḥ tatas vahneḥ śīta mātra abhāvaḥ tatas śīta viśeṣetuṣāra sparśa abhāva niścayaḥ śīta viśeṣasya śīta sāmānyena vyāpta tvāt iti viśiṣṭa viṣaye asyāḥ prayogaḥ

pratiṣedhyasya yat kāraṇam tasya anupalabdheḥ udāharaṇam yathā iti atra iti dharmī na dhūmaḥ iti sādhyam vahni abhāvāt iti hetuḥ yatra kāryam sat api adṛśyam bhavati tatra ayam prayogaḥ dṛśye tu kārye dṛśyā anupalabdhiḥ gamikā tatas ayam api abhāva sādhanaḥ niṣkampa āyata salila pūrite hrade hemanta ucita bāṣpayā udgame virale sandhyātam asi sati san api tatra dhūmaḥ na dṛśyate iti kāraṇa anupalabdhyā pratiṣedhyate vahniḥ tu yadi tasya ambhasaḥ upari plavamānaḥ bhavet prajvalitaḥ rūpa viśeṣāt eva upalabdhaḥ bhavet ajvalitaḥ tu indhana madhya niviṣṭaḥ bhavet tatra api dahana adhikaraṇam indhanam pratyakṣam iti sva rūpeṇa ādhāra rūpeṇa vā dṛśyaḥ eva vahniḥ iti tatra asya prayogaḥ iti

pratiṣedhyasya yat kāraṇam tasya yat viruddham tasya upalabdheḥ udāharaṇam yathā iti asya iti dharmī romṇām harṣaḥ udbhedaḥ saḥ ādiḥ yeṣām danta vīṇā ādīnām śīta kṛtānām te viśi ṣyante tad anyebhyaḥ bhaya śraddha ādi kṛtebhyaḥ iti romaharṣa ādi viśeṣāḥ te na santi iti sādhyam dahanaḥ eva viśiṣyate tat anyasmāt dahanāt śīta nivarttana sāmarthyena iti dahana viśeṣaḥ kaścid dahanaḥ san api na śīta nivarttana kṣamaḥ yathā pradīpaḥ tādṛśa nivṛttaye viśeṣa grahaṇam sannihitaḥ dahana viśeṣaḥ yasya sa tathā uktaḥ tasya bhāvaḥ tasmāt iti hetuḥ yatra śīta sparśaḥ san api adṛśyaḥ roma harṣa ādi viśeṣāḥ ca adṛśyāḥ tatra ayam prayogaḥ romaharṣa ādi viśeṣasya dṛśya tve dṛśya anupalabdhiḥ prayoktavyā śīta sparśasya dṛśya tve kāraṇa anupalabdhiḥ tasmāt abhāva sādhanaḥ ayam rūpa viśeṣāt hi dūrāt vahanam paśyati śīta sparśaḥ tu adṛśyaḥ roma harṣa ādi viśeṣāḥ ca teṣām kāraṇa viruddha upalabdhyā abhāvam pratipadyate iti tatra asya prayogaḥ iti

pratiṣedhyasya yat kāraṇam tasya yat viruddham tasya yat kāryam tasya upalabdhiḥ udāharttavyā yathā iti ayam pradeśaḥ iti dharmī yogaḥ yuktam roma harṣa ādi viśeṣaiḥ yuvatam roma harṣa ādi viśeṣa yuktam tasya sambandhī puruṣaḥ roma harṣa ādi viśeṣa yukta puruṣaḥ tadvān na bhavati iti sādhyam dhūmāt iti hetuḥ

romaharṣa ādi viśeṣasya pratyakṣa tve dṛśya anupalabdhiḥ kāraṇasya śīta sparśasya pratyakṣa tve kāraṇa anupalabdhiḥ vahneḥ tu pratyakṣa tve kāraṇa viruddha upalabdhiḥ prayoktavyā trayāṇām api adṛśya tve ayam prayogaḥ tasmāt abhāva sādhanaḥ ayam tatra dūra sthasya pratipattuḥ dahana śīta sparśa roma harṣa ādi viśeṣāḥ apratyakṣāḥ santaḥ api dhūmaḥ tu pratyakṣaḥ yatra tatra etat pramāṇam dhūmaḥ tu yādṛśaḥ tad deśe sthitam śītam nivarttayitum samarthasya vahneḥ anumāpakaḥ saḥ iha grāhyaḥ dhūma mātreṇa tu vahni mātre anumite api na śīta sparśa nivṛttiḥ na api roma harṣa ādi viśeṣa nivṛttiḥ avasātum śakyā iti na dhūma mātram hetuḥ iti draṣṭavyam iti

yadi ekaḥ pratiṣedha hetuḥ uktaḥ katham ekādaśā abhāva hetavaḥ iti āha ime sarve ityādi ime anupalabdhi prayogāḥ idam ānantara prakrāntāḥ nirdiṣṭāḥ tatra kiyatām api grahaṇe prasaktaḥ āha kārya anupalabdhi ādayaḥ iti kārya anupalabdhi ādīnām api trayāṇām caturṇām vā grahaṇe prasaktaḥ āha daśa iti tatra daśānām api udāhṛta mātrāṇām grahaṇa prasaṅge sati āha sarve iti etat uktam bhavati aprayuktāḥ api prayukta udāharaṇa sadṛśāḥ ca sarve eva iti daśagrahaṇam antareṇa sarva grahaṇe kriyamāṇe prayukta udāharaṇa kārtsnyam gamyeta daśagrahaṇāt tu udāharaṇa kārtsnye avagate sarva grahaṇa matiricyamānam udāhṛta sadṛśa kārtsnya avagatayā ijāyate

te svabhāva anupalabdhau saṅgraham tādātmyena gacchanti svabhāva anupalabdhi svabhāvāḥ iti arthaḥ nanu ca svabhāva anupalabdhi prayogāt bhidyante kārya anupalabdhi ādayaḥ tat katham antarbhavanti iti āha prayoga bhede api prayogasya śabda vyāpārasya bhede api antarbhavanti katham prayoga bhedaḥ iti āha arthāntaravidhi iti pratiṣedhyāt arthāt artha antarasya vidhiḥ upalabdhiḥ svabhāva viruddha ādi upalabdhi prayogeṣu pratiṣedhaḥ kārya anupalabdhi ādiṣu prayogeṣu artha antara vidhinā artha antara pratiṣedhena ca prayogāḥ bhidyante yadi prayoga antareṣu artha antara vidhi pratiṣedhau katham tarhi antarbhavanti iti āha pāramparyeṇa iti praṇālikayā iti arthaḥ etat uktam bhavati na sākṣāt ete prayogāḥ dṛśya anupalabdhim abhidadhati dṛśya anupalabdhi avyabhicāriṇam tu artha antarasya vidhim niṣedham vā abhidadhati tatas praṇālikayā amīṣām svabhāva anupalabdhau saṅgrahaḥ na sākṣāt iti

yadi prayoga bhedāt eṣa bhedaḥ para artha anumāne vaktavyaḥ eṣaḥ śabda bhedaḥ hi prayoga bhedaḥ śabdaḥ ca para artha anumānam iti āśaṅkya āha prayoga darśana ityādi prayogāṇām śāstra paripaṭhitānām darśanam upalambhaḥ tasya abhyāsaḥ punar punar āvarttanam tasmāt nimittāt svayam api iti pratipattuḥ ātmanaḥ api evam iti anantara uktena krameṇa vyavacchedasya pratiṣedhasya pratītiḥ bhavati iti iti śabdaḥ tasmāt arthe tat ayam arthaḥ yasmāt svayam api evam anena upāyena pratipadyate prayoga abhyāsāt tasmāt sva pratipattau api upayujyamānasya asya prayoga bhedasya sva artha anumāne nirdeśaḥ yat punar para pratipattau eva upayujyate tat para artha anumānaḥ eva vaktavyam iti

nanu ca kārya anupalabdhi ādiṣu kāraṇa ādīnām adṛśyānām eva niṣedhaḥ dṛśya niṣedhe svabhāva anupalabdhi prayoga prasaṅgāt tathā ca sati na teṣām dṛśya anupalabdheḥ niṣedhaḥ tat katham eṣām prayogāṇām dṛśya anupalabdhau antarbhāvaḥ iti āha sarvatra ca ityādi abhāvaḥ ca tad vyavahāraḥ ca abhāva vyavahārau rava bhāva anupalabdha avabhāva vyavahāraḥ sādhya śiṣṭeṣu abhāvaḥ tayoḥ sādhanyām anupalabdhau sarvatra ca iti caśabdaḥ hi śabdasya arthe yasmāt sarvatra anupalabdhau yeṣām pratiṣedhaḥ uktaḥ teṣām upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptānām dṛśyānām evam pratiṣedhaḥ tasmāt dṛśya anupalabdhau antarbhāvaḥ

kutas etat dṛśyānām eva iti āha svabhāva ityādi atra api cakāraḥ hetu arthaḥ yasmāt svabhāva viruddhaḥ ādiḥ yeṣām teṣām upalabdhyā kāraṇam ādiḥ yeṣām teṣām anupalabdhyā pratiṣedhaḥ uktaḥ tasmāt dṛśyānām eva pratiṣedhaḥ iti arthaḥ yadi nāma svabhāva viruddha ādi upalabdhyā kāraṇa ādi anupalabdhyā ca pratiṣedhaḥ uktaḥ tathā api katham dṛśyānām eva pratiṣedhaḥ iti āha upalabdhiḥ ityādi atra api cakāraḥ hetu arthaḥ yasmāt ye virodhinaḥ vyāpya vyāpaka bhūtāḥ kārya kāraṇa bhūtāḥ ca jñātāḥ teṣām avaśyam eva upalabdhiḥ upalabdhi pūrvā ca anupalabdhiḥ veditavyā jñātavyā upalabdhi anupalabdhī ca dve yeṣām staḥ te dṛśyāḥ eva tasmāt svabhāva viruddha ādi upalabdhyā kāraṇa ādi anupalabdhyā ca upalabdhi anupalabdhimatām viruddha ādīnām pratiṣedhaḥ kriyamāṇaḥ dṛśyānām eva kṛtaḥ draṣṭavyaḥ

bahuṣu codyeṣu prakrānteṣu parihāra samuccaya arthaḥ cakāraḥ hetu arthaḥ bhavati yasmāt idam ca idam ca samādhānam asti tasmāt tat tat ca udyama yuktam iti cakāra arthaḥ kasmāt punar pratiṣedhyānām viruddha ādīnām upalabdhi anupalabdhī veditavye iti āha anyeṣām iti upalabdhi anupalabdhi madbhyaḥ anye anupalabdhāḥ eva ye teṣām virodhaḥ ca kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ ca kenacid sahābhāvaḥ ca vyāpyasya vyāpakasya abhāve na sidhyati yasmāt tatas virodha kārya kāraṇa bhāva abhāva asiddheḥ kāraṇāt upalabdhi anupalabdhimantaḥ evam viruddha ādayaḥ niṣedhyāḥ ubhayavantaḥ ca dṛśyāḥ eva tasmāt dṛśyānām eva pratiṣedhaḥ

tat ayam arthaḥ virodhaḥ ca kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ ca vyāpaka abhāve vyāpya abhāvaḥ ca dṛśya anupalabdheḥ eva iti eka saṃnidhau apara abhāva pratītau jñātaḥ virodhaḥ kāraṇa abhimata abhāve ca kārya abhimata abhāva pratyaye avasitaḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ vyāpaka abhimata abhāve ca vyāpya abhimata abhāve niścite niścitaḥ vyāpya vyāpaka bhāvaḥ tatra vyāpya vyāpaka bhāva pratīteḥ nimittam abhāvaḥ pratipattavyaḥ iha gṛhīte vṛkṣa abhāve hi śiṃśapātvā abhāva pratītau pratītaḥ vyāpya vyāpaka bhāvaḥ abhāva pratipattiḥ ca sarvatra dṛśya anupalabdheḥ eva tasmāt virodham kārya kāraṇa bhāvam vyāpya vyāpaka bhāvam ca smaratā virodha kārya kāraṇa bhāva vyāpya vyāpaka bhāvi viṣaya abhāva pratipatti nibandhanam dṛśya anupalabdhiḥ smartavyā dṛśya anupalabdhi asmaraṇe virodha ādīnām asmaraṇam tathā ca sati na viruddha ādi vidhi pratiṣedhābhyām itara abhāva pratītiḥ syāt virodha ādi grahaṇa kāla bhāvinyām ca dṛśya anupalabdhau avaśya smartavyāyām tatas eva abhāva pratītiḥ

tatra yadi api saṃpratitanī na asti dṛśya anupalabdhiḥ virodha ādi grahaṇa kāle tu āsīt yā dṛśya anupalabdhiḥ saṃprati smaryamāṇā sā eva abhāva pratipatti nibandhanam tatas saṃprati na asti dṛśya anupalabdhiḥ iti abhāva sādhana tvena dṛśya anupalabdhi prayogāt bhidyante kārya anupalabdhi ādi prayogāḥ viruddha vidhinā kāraṇa ādi niṣedhena ca yatas dṛśya anupalabdhiḥ ākṣiptā tatas dṛśya anupalabdheḥ eva kāla antara vṛttāyāḥ smṛti viṣaya bhūtāyāḥ abhāva pratipattiḥ amīṣām ca prayogāṇām dṛśya anupalabdhau antarbhāvaḥ tat anena sarveṇa dṛśya anupalabdhau antarbhāvaḥ daśānām anupalabdhi prayogāṇām pāramparyeṇa darśitaḥ iti veditavyam

uktāḥ dṛśya anupalabdhiḥ abhāve abhāva vyavahāre ca sādhye pramāṇam adṛśya anupalabdhiḥ tu kiṃsvabhāvā kiṃvyāpārā ca iti āha viprakṛṣṭa ityādi viprakṛṣṭaḥ tribhiḥ deśa kāla svabhāva viprakarṣaiḥ yasyāḥ viṣayaḥ sā viprakṛṣṭa viṣaya iti saṃśaya hetuḥ kiṃsvabhāvā sā iti āha pratyakṣa anumāna nivṛttiḥ lakṣaṇam svabhāvaḥ yasyāḥ sā pratyakṣa anumāna nivṛtti lakṣaṇā na jñāna jñeya svabhāva iti yāvat

nanu ca pramāṇāt prameya sattā vyavasthā tatas pramāṇa abhābāt prameya abhāva pratittiḥ yuktā iti āha pramāṇa nivṛttau api iti āha kāraṇam vyāpakam ca nivartamānam kāryam vyāpyam ca nivartayet na ca pramāṇam prameyasya kāraṇam na api vyāpakam atas pramāṇayoḥ nivṛttau api arthasya prameyasya nivṛttiḥ na sidhyati tatas asiddheḥ saṃśaya hetuḥ adṛśya anupalabdhiḥ na niścaya hetuḥ yat punar pramāṇa sattayā prameya sattā sidhyati tat yuktam prameya kārya hi pramāṇam na ca kāraṇam antareṇa kāryam asti na tu kāraṇāni avaśyam kāryavanti bhavanti tasmāt pramāṇāt prameya sattā vyavasthāpya a na pramāṇa amāvāt prameya abhāva vyavasthā iti

sva artha para artha anumānayoḥ sva artham vyākhyāya para artha vyākhyātu kāmaḥ āha trirūpa liṅga ākhyānam iti trīṇi rūpāṇi anvaya vyatireka pakṣa dharma tva saṃjñakāni yasya tat trirūpam trirūpam ca tat liṅgam ca tasya ākhyānam ākhyāyate prakāśyate anena iti trirūpam liṅgam iti ākhyānam kim punar tat vacanam vacanena hi trirūpam liṅgam ākhyāyate para smāyidam para artham

nanu ca samyak jñāna ātmakam anumānam uktam tat kim artham saṃprati vacana ātmakam anumānam ucyate iti āha kāraṇe kārya upacārāt iti trirūpa liṅga abhidhānāt trirūpa liṅga smṛtiḥ utpadyate smṛteḥ ca anumānam tasmāt anumānasya paramparayā trirūpa liṅga abhidhānam kāraṇam tasmin kāraṇe vacane kāryasya anumānasya upacāraḥ samāropaḥ kriyate tatas samāropāt kāraṇam vacanam anumāna śabdena ucyate aupacārikam vacanam anumānam na mukhyam iti arthaḥ na yāvat kiṃcid upacārāt anumāna śabdena vaktum śakyam tāvat sarvam vyākhyeyam kintu anumānam vyākhyātu kāmena anumāna svarūpasya vyākhyeya tvāt nimittam vyākhyeyam nimittam ca trirūpam liṅgam tat ca svayam vā pratītam anumānasya nimittam bhavati pareṇa vā pratipāditam bhavati tasmāt liṅgasya svarūpam ca vyākhyeyam tad pratipādakaḥ ca śabdaḥ tatra svarūpam sva artha anumāne vyākhyātam pratipādakaḥ ca śabdaḥ iha vyākhyeyaḥ tatas pratipādakam śabdam avaśyam vaktavyam darśayan anumāna śabdena uktavān ācāryaḥ iti parama arthaḥ
para artha anumānasya prakāra bhedam darśayitum āha tat dvividham iti tat iti para artha anumānam dvau vidhau prakārau yasya tat dvividham
kutas dvividham iti āha prayogasya śabda vyāpārasya bhedāt prayuktiḥ prayoga ūrtha abhidhānam śabdasya artha abhidhāna vyāpāra bhedāt dvividham anumānam

tat eva abhidhāna vyāpāra nibandhanam dvaividhyam darśayitum āha sādharmya vat vaidharmmavat ca iti samānaḥ dharmaḥ asya saḥ ayam sadharmā tasya bhāvaḥ sādharmyam visadṛśaḥ dharmaḥ asya vidharmā vidharmaṇaḥ bhāvaḥ vaidharmyam dṛṣṭānta dharmiṇā saha sādhya dharmiṇaḥ sādṛśyam hetu kṛtam sādharmyam ucyate asādṛśyam ca hetu kṛtam vaidharmyaṃmucyate tatra yasya sādhana vākyasya sādharmyam abhidheyam tat sādharmya vat yathā yata kṛtakam tat anityam yathā ghaṭaḥ tathā ca kṛtakaḥ śabdaḥ iti atra kṛtaka tva kṛtam dṛṣṭānta sādhya dharmiṇoḥ sādṛśyam abhidheyam yasya tu vaidharmyam abhigheyam tat vaidharmya vat yathā yat nityam tat akṛtakam dṛṣṭam yathā ākāśam śabdaḥ tu kṛtakaḥ iti kṛtaka tvā akṛtaka tva kṛtam śabda ākāśayoḥ sādhya dṛṣṭānta dharmiṇoḥ asādṛśyam iha abhidheyam

yadi anayoḥ prayogayoḥ abhidheyam bhinnam katham tarhi trirūpam liṅgam abhinnam prakāśyam iti āha nānayoḥ arthataḥ iti arthaḥ prayojanam yat prayojanam prakāśayitavyam vastu uddiśya anumāne prayujyete tatas prayojanāt anayoḥ na bhedaḥ kaścid trirūpam hi liṅgam prakāśayitavyam tat uddiśya dve api ete prayujyete dvābhyām api trirūpam liṅgam prakāśyate eva tatas prakāśayitavyam prayojana m anayoḥ abhinnam tathā ca na tatas bhedaḥ kaścid

abhidheya bhedaḥ api tarhi na syāt iti āha anyatra prayoga bhedāt iti prayogaḥ abhidhānam vācaka tvam vācaka tva bhedāt anyaḥ bhedaḥ prayojana kṛtaḥ na asti iti arthaḥ etat uktam bhavati anyat abhidheyam anyat prakāśyam prayojanam tatra abhigheya apekṣayā vācaka tvam bhidyate prakāśyam tu abhinnam anvaye hi kathite vakṣyamāṇena nyāyena vyatireka gatiḥ bhavati vyatireke ca anvaya gatiḥ tatas trirūpam liṅgam prakāśyam abhinnam na ca yatra abhidheya bhedaḥ tatra sāmarthya gamyaḥ api arthaḥ bhidyate yasmāt pīnaḥ devadattaḥ divā na bhuṅkte pīnaḥ devadattaḥ rātrau bhuṅkte iti anayoḥ vākyayoḥ abhidheya bhedepi gamyamānam ekam eva tadvat iha abhidheya bhedepi gamyasānam vastu ekam eva

tatra iti tayoḥ sādharmya vaidharmyavatoḥ anumānayoḥ sādharmya vat tāvat uhāran anupalabdhim āha yat ityādinā yat upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptam yat dṛśyam sanna upalabhyate iti anena dṛśya anupalambhaḥ anūdyate saḥ asat vyavahāra viṣayaḥ siddhaḥ tat asat iti vyavahartavyam iti arthaḥ anena asat vyavahāra yogya tvasya vidhiḥ kṛtaḥ tatas ca asat vyavahāra yogya tve dṛśya anupalambhaḥ niyataḥ kathitaḥ dṛśyam anupalabdham asat vyavahāra yogyam eva iti arthaḥ sādhanasya ca sādhye arthe niyata tva kathanam vyāpti kathanam yathā uktam vyāpti rvyāpakasya tatra bhāvaḥ eva

vyāpyasya vā tatra eva bhāvaḥ iti vyāpti sādhanasya pramāṇasya viṣayaḥ dṛṣṭāntaḥ tam eva darśayitum āha yathā anyaḥ iti sādhya dharmiṇaḥ anyaḥ dṛṣṭāntaḥ iti arthaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ iti pramāṇena niścitaḥ śaśa viṣāṇam hi na cakṣuṣā viṣayīkṛtam api tu pramāṇena dṛśya anupalambhena asat vyavahāra yogyam vijñātam śaśa viṣāṇam ādiḥ yasya asat vyavahāra viṣayasya sa tathā uktaḥ śaśa viṣāṇa ādau hi dṛśya anupalambha mātra nimittaḥ asa dvaya vahāraḥ pramāṇena siddhaḥ tatas eva pramāṇāt anena vākyena abhidhīyamānā vyāptiḥ jñātavyā

saṃprati vyāptim kathayitvā dṛśya anupalambhasya pakṣa dharma tvam darśayitum āha na upalabhyate ca iti pradeśaḥ eka deśaḥ pṛthivyāḥ saḥ eva viśiṣyate anyasmāt iti viśeṣaḥ ekaḥ pradeśa viśeṣaḥ iti ekasmin pradeśe kvacid iti pratipattuḥ pratyakṣaḥ ekaḥ api pradeśaḥ saḥ eva abhāva vyavahāra adhikaraṇam yaḥ pratipattuḥ pratyakṣaḥ na anyaḥ upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptaḥ iti dṛśyaḥ yathā ca asataḥ api ghaṭasya samāropitam upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāpta tvam tathā vyākhyātam

svabhāva hetoḥ sādharmyavantam prayogam darśayitum āha tathā iti yathā anupalabdheḥ tathā svabhāva hetoḥ sādharmyavān prayogaḥ iti arthaḥ yat sat iti sattvam anūdya tat sarvam anityam iti anitya tvam vidhīyate sarva grahaṇam ca niyama artham sarvam anityam na kiñcid na anityam yat sat tat anityam eva anitya tvāt anyatra nitya tve sattvam na asti iti evam sattvam anitya tve sādhye niyatam khyāpitam bhavati tathā ca sati vyāpti pradarśana vākyam idam yathā ghaṭa ādiḥ iti vyāpti sādhakasya pramāṇasya viṣaya kathanam etat śuddhasya iti nirviśeṣaṇasya svabhāvasya prayogaḥ

sa viśeṣaṇam darśayitum āha yat utpattimat iti utpatiḥ svarūpa lābhaḥ yasya asti tat utpattimat utpatti mittvam anūdya tad anityam iti anitya tva vidhiḥ tathā ca sati utpattimat tvam anitya tve niyatam ākhyātam svabhāvam bhūtaḥ tad ātmakaḥ dharmaḥ tasya bhedena bhedam hetūkṛtya prayogaḥ anutpannebhyaḥ hi vyāvṛttim āśritya utpannaḥ bhāvaḥ iti ucyate sā eva vyāvṛttiḥ yadā vyāvṛtti antara nirapekṣā vaktum iṣyate tadā vyatirekiṇī iva nirdiśyate bhāvasya utpattiḥ iti tayā ca vyatiriktayā iva utpattyā viśiṣṭam vastu utpattim at uktam tena svabhāva bhūtena dharmeṇa kalpita bhedena viśiṣṭaḥ svabhāvaḥ prayuktaḥ draṣṭavyaḥ

yat kṛtakam iti kṛtaka tvam anūdya anitya tvam vidhīyate iti anitya tve niyatam kṛtaka tvam uktam atas vyāptiḥ anitya tvena kṛtaka tvasya darśitā upādhi bhedena svabhāvasya prayogaḥ iti saṃbandhaḥ upādhiḥ viśeṣaṇam tasya bhedena bhinnena upādhinā viśiṣṭaḥ svabhāvaḥ prayuktaḥ iti arthaḥ iha kadācid śuddhaḥ eva arthaḥ ucyate kadācid avyatiriktena viśeṣaṇena viśiṣṭaḥ kadācid vyatiriktena devadattaḥ iti śuddhaḥ lambakarṇaḥ iti abhinna karṇa dvaya viśiṣṭaḥ citraguḥ iti vyatirikta citra gavīviśiṣṭaḥ tadvat sattvam śuddham utpatimat tvam avyatirikta viśeṣaṇam kṛtaka tvam vyatirikta viśeṣaṇam

nanu ca citra gu śabde vyatiriktasya viśeṣaṇasya vācakaḥ citra śabdaḥ go śabdaḥ ca asti kṛtaka śabde tu nirviśeṣaṇa vācinaḥ śabdasya prayoga uḥ ti iti āśaṅkya āha apekṣitā iti pareṣām kāraṇānām vyāpāraḥ svabhāvasya niṣpattau niṣpatti artham apekṣitaḥ para vyāpāraḥ yana sa tathā uktaḥ hi iti yasmāt arthe yasmāt apekṣita para vyāpāraḥ kṛtakaḥ ucyate tasmāt vyatiriktena viśeṣaṇena viśiṣṭaḥ svabhāvaḥ ucyate yadi api vyatiriktam viśeṣaṇa padam na prayuktam tathā api kṛtaka śabdena eva vyatiriktam viśeṣaṇa padam antar bhāvitam atas eva saṃjñā prakāraḥ ayam kṛtaka śabdaḥ yasmāt saṃjñāya āmayam kan pratyayaḥ vihitaḥ yatra ca viśeṣaṇam antar bhāvyate tatra viśeṣaṇa padam na prayujyate kvacid tu pratīyamānam viśeṣaṇam yathā kṛtaḥ iti ukte hatubhiḥ iti atat pratāyate tatra ca hetu śabdaḥ prayujyate kadācid na vā prayujyate

prayujyamānasva śabdaḥ ca yathā pratyaya bheda bhedi śabde pratyaya bheda śabdaḥ yathā ca kṛtaka śabdaḥ bhinna viśeṣaṇa svabhāva abhidhāyī evam pratyaya bheda bhedi tvam ādiḥ yeṣām prayatna antarīyaka tva ādīnām te api svabhāva hetoḥ prayogāḥ bhinna viśeṣaṇa svabhāva abhidhāyinaḥ draṣṭavyāḥ pratyayānām kāraṇānām bhedaḥ viśeṣaḥ tena pratyaya kāla ābhet enam bhettum śīlam yasyasa pratyaya bheda bhedī śabdaḥ tasya bhāvaḥ pratyaya bheda bhedi tvam tatas pratyaya bheda bhedi tvāt śabdasya kṛtaka tvam sādhyate prayatna anantarīyaka tvāt anitya tvam tatra pratyaya bheda śabdaḥ vyatirikta viśeṣaṇa abhidhāyī pratyaya bheda bhedi śabde prayuktaḥ prayatna anantarīyaka śabde ca prayatna śabdaḥ tat evam trividhaḥ svabhāva hetu prayogaḥ darśitaḥ śuddhaḥ avyatirikta viśeṣaṇaḥ vyatirikta viśeṣaṇaḥ ca evam artham ca etat ākhyātam vācaka bhedāt mā bhūt kasyacid svabhāva hetau api prayukte vyāmohaḥ iti

atha kim ete svabhāva hetavaḥ siddha sambandhe svabhāve sādhye prayoktavyā āhosvit asiddha sambandhaḥ iti āśaṅkya siddha sambandhe prayoktavyāḥ iti darśayitum āha sarve ete iti gamaka tvāt sādhanāni para āśrita tvāt ca dharmāḥ sādhana dharmāḥ eva sādhana dharma mātram mātra śabdena adhikasya apekṣaṇīyasya nirāsaḥ tasya anubandhaḥ anugamanam anvayaḥ siddhaḥ sādhana dharma mātra anubandhaḥ yasya sa tathā uktaḥ kena siddhaḥ iti āha yathāsvam pramāṇaiḥ iti yasya sādhya dharmasya yat ā ātmīyam pramāṇam tena eva pramāṇena siddhaḥ iti arthaḥ svabhāva hetūnām ca bahu bheda tvāt saṃbandha sādhanāni api pramāṇāni bahūni iti pramāṇaiḥ iti bahuvacana nirdeśaḥ gamayitavya tvāt sādhyaḥ para āśrita tvāt ca dharmaḥ sādhya dharmaḥ

tat ayam parama arthaḥ na hetuḥ pradīpa vat yogyatayā gamakaḥ api tu na antarīyaka tayā viniścitaḥ sādhya avinābhāvi tva niścayanam eva hi hetoḥ sādhya pratipādana vyāpāraḥ na anyaḥ kaścid prathamam bādhakena pramāṇena sādhya pratibandhaḥ niścetavyaḥ hetoḥ punar anumāna kāle sādhanam sādhya na antarīyakam sāmānyena smartavyam kṛtaka tvam nāma anitya svabhāvam iti sāmānyena smṛtam artha punar viśeṣe yojayati idam api kṛtaka tvam śabde vartamānam anitya svabhāvam eva iti tatra sāmānya smaraṇam liṅga jñānam viśiṣṭasya tu śabda gata kṛtaka tvasyāḥ anitya tva svabhāvasya smaraṇam anumāna jñānam tathā ca satya vinābhāvi tva jñānam eva parokṣa arthapratipādaka tvam nāma tena niścita tanmātra anubandhe sādhya dharme svabhāva hetavaḥ prayoktavyā na anyatra iti uktam

yadi evam sambandhaḥ niścetavyaḥ sādhyasya sādhanena saha sādhana dharma mātra anubandhaḥ tu sādhyasya kasmāt niścitaḥ mṛgyate iti āha tasya eva iti siddha sādhana dharma mātra anubandhasya tad svabhāva tvāt iti sādhana dharma rava bhāva tvāt yaḥ hi sādhya dharmaḥ sādhana dharma mātra anubandhavāt saḥ eva tasya sādhana dharmasya svabhāvaḥ na anyaḥ

bhavatu īdṛśaḥ eva svabhāvaḥ svabhāvaḥ eva tu sādhye kasmāt hetu prayogaḥ svabhāvasya ca hetu tvāt svabhāvaḥ eva iha hetuḥ prakrāntaḥ tasmāt saḥ eva sādhyaḥ kartavyaḥ yaḥ sādhanasya svabhāvaḥ syāt sādhana dharma mātra anubandhavān ca svabhāvaḥ na anyaḥ

yadi sādhya dharmaḥ sādhanasya svabhāvaḥ syāt pratijñā artha eka deśaḥ tarhi hetuḥ syāt iti āha vastutas iti vastutas paramārthataḥ sādhya sādhanayoḥ tādātmyam samāropitaḥ tu sādhya sādhana bhedaḥ sādhya sādhana bhāvaḥ hi niścaya ārūḍhe rūpe niścaya ārūḍham ca rūpam samāropitena bhedena itaretara vyāvṛtti kṛtena bhinnam iti anyat sādhanam anyat sādhyam dūrāt hi śākhā ādimānarthaḥ bṛkṣaḥ iti niścīyate na śiṃśapa iti atha ca saḥ eva vṛkṣaḥ sā eva śiṃśapā tasmāt abhinnam api vastu niścayaḥ bhinnam ādarśayati vyāvṛtti bhedena tasmāt niścaya ārūḍha rūpa apekṣayā anyat sādhanama anyat sādhyam atas na pratijñā artha eka deśaḥ hetuḥ vāstavam ca tādātmyam iti

kasmāt punar sādhana dharma mātra anubandhyā iva sādhyaḥ svabhāvaḥ na anyaḥ iti āha tad niṣpattau iti yaḥ hi yat na anubadhnāti sa tad niṣpatta a aniṣpannaḥ tasya tad niṣpatta a aniṣpannasya sādhana svabhāva tvam ayuktam yatas niṣpatti aniṣpattī bhāva abhāva rūpe bhāva abhāvau ca paraspara parihāreṇa sthitau yadi ca pūrva niṣpannasya aniṣpannasya ca aikyam bhavet ekasya eva arthasya bhāva abhāvau syātām yugapad na ca viruddhayoḥ bhāva abhāvayoḥ aikyam yujyate viruddha dharma saṃsarga ātmaka tvāt ekatva abhāvasya kiñca paścāt utpadyamānam pūrva niṣpannāt bhinna hetukam hetu bheda pūrvakaḥ ca kārya bhedaḥ tatas niṣpannā niṣpannayoḥ viruddha dharma saṃsarga ātmakaḥ bhedaḥ bheda hetuḥ ca kāraṇa bhedaḥ iti kutas eka tvam tasmāt sādhana dharma mātra anubandhyā iva sādhyaḥ svabhāvaḥ na anyaḥ

mā bhūt paścāt niṣpannaḥ pūrvajasya svabhāvaḥ sādhyaḥ tu kasmāt na bhavati iti āha vyabhicāra ityādi pūrvajena paścāt niṣpannasya vyabhicāraḥ parityāgaḥ yaḥ tasya saṃbhavāt ca na pūrva niṣpannasya paścāt niṣpannaḥ sādhyaḥ tasmāt sādhana dharma mātra anubandhyā iva svabhāvaḥ saḥ eva ca sādhyaḥ tathā ca siddha sādhana dharma mātra anubandhaḥ eva svabhāve svabhāva hetavaḥ prayoktavyāḥ iti sthitam

kārya hetoḥ prayogaḥ sādharmyavān iti prakaraṇāt apekṣaṇīyam yatra dhūmaḥ iti dhūmam anūdya tatra agniḥ iti agne rvidhiḥ tathā ca niyama arthaḥ pūrvavat avagantavyaḥ tat anena kārya kāraṇa bhāva nimittā vyāptiḥ darśitā vyāpti sādhana pramāṇa viṣayam darśayitum āha yathā mahānasa ādau iti mahānasa ādau hi pratyakṣa anupalambhābhyām kārya kāraṇa bhāva ātmā vinābhāvaḥ niścitaḥ asti ca iha iti sādhya dharmiṇi pakṣa dharma upasaṃhāraḥ

iha api iti na kevalam svabhāva hetau iha api kārya hetau siddhaḥ eva iti niścite kārya kāraṇa tve kārya kāraṇa bhāva niścayaḥ hi avaśyam kartavyaḥ yatas na yogyatayā hetuḥ gamakaḥ api tu na antarīyaka tvāt iti uktam

sādharmyavān svabhāva kārya anupalambhānām prayogaḥ darśitaḥ vaidharmyavantam darśayitum āha vaidharmyavataḥ iti yat sat upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptam iti yat sat dṛśyam iti astitva anuvādaḥ tat upalabhyate iti upalambha vidhiḥ tat anena dṛśyasya sattvam darśana viṣaya tvena vyāptam kathitam asattva nivṛttiḥ ca sattvam a anupalambha nivṛttiḥ ca upalambhaḥ tena sādhya nivṛtti anuvādena sādhana nivṛttiḥ vihitā tathā ca sādhya nivṛttiḥ sādhana nivṛttau niyata tvāt sādhana nivṛttyā vyāptā kathitā yadi ca dharmiṇi sādhya dharmaḥ na bhavet hetuḥ api na bhavet hetu abhāvena sādhya abhāvasya vyāpta tvāt asti ca hetuḥ atas vyāpakasya sādhana ābhāḥ vasya abhāvāt vyāpyasya sādhya abhāvasya abhāvaḥ iti sādhya gati rbhavati tatas vaidharmya prayoge sādhana abhāve sādhya abhāvaḥ niyataḥ darśanīyaḥ sarvatriti nyāyaḥ

svabhāva hetoḥ vaidharmya prayogam āha asatya nitya tvaḥ iti iha anitya tvasya sādhyasya abhāvaḥ hetoḥ abhāve niyataḥ ucyate tena hetu abhāvena sādhya abhāvaḥ vyāptaḥ uktaḥ triṣu api svabhāva hetuṣu san utpattimān kṛtakaḥ vā śabdaḥ iti trayāṇām api pakṣa dharma tva pradarśanam iha ca sādhana abhāvasya vyāpakasya abhāvaḥ uktaḥ tatas vyāpyaḥ api sādhya abhāvaḥ nivartate iti sādhya gatiḥ

kārya hetoḥ vā edha rmyavat prayogam āha asatyagnau iti iha api vahni abhāvaḥ dhūma abhāvena vyāptaḥ uktaḥ asti ca atra dhūmaḥ iti vyāpakasya dhūma abhāvasya abhāvaḥ uktaḥ tatas vyāpyasya vahni abhāvasya abhāve sādhya gatiḥ

nanu ca sādharmyavati vyatirekaḥ na uktaḥ vaidharmyavati ca anvayaḥ tat katham etat trirūpa liṅga ākhyānam iti āha sādharmyeṇa iti sādharmyeṇa api abhidheyena yukte prayoge kriyamāṇe arthāt sāmarthyāt vaidharmyasya vyatirekasya gatiḥ bhavati iti hi iti yasmāt tasmāt triru upa liṅga ākhyānam etat yadi nāma vyatirekaḥ anvayavatā na uktaḥ tathā api anvaya vacana sāmarthyāt eva avasīyate

katham asati tasmin vyatirekebuddhyā adhyavasite sādhyena hetoḥ anvayasya buddhyā adhya vasitasya abhāvāt sādhye niyatam sādhanam anvaya vākyāt avasya tā sādhya abhāve sādhanam na aśaṅkanīyam itarathā sādhya niyatam eva na pratītam syāt sādhya abhāve ca sādhana abhāva gatiḥ vyatireka gatiḥ atas sādhya niyatasya sādhanasya abhidhāna sāmarthyāt anvaya vākye avasitaḥ vyatirekaḥ
tathā iti yathā anvaya vākye tathā arthāt eva vaidharmyeṇa prayoge anvayasya anabhidhīyamānasya api gatiḥ

katham asati tasmin anvaye buddhi gṛhīte sādhya abhāve hetu abhāvasya asiddheḥ anavasāyāt hetu abhāve sādhya abhāvam niyatam vyatireka vākyāt avasyatā hetu saṃbhave sādhya abhāvaḥ na aśaṅkanīyaḥ itarathāḥ hetu abhāve niyataḥ na syāt pratītaḥ hetu sattve ca sādhya sattva gatiḥ anvaya gatiḥ atas sādhana abhāva niyatasya sādhya abhāvasya abhidhāna sāmarthyāt vyatireka vākye anvaya gatiḥ

yadi nāma ākāśa ādau sādhya abhāve sādhana abhāvaḥ tathā api kim iti hetu saṃbhave sādhya saṃbhavaḥ iti āha na hi iti svabhāvena pratibandhaḥ yaḥ tasmin asati ekasya sādhyasya nivṛttyā na aparasya sādhanasya niyamena yuktā niyamavatī nivṛttiḥ

sa ca svabhāva pratibandhaḥ dvi prakāraḥ sarvasya pratibaddhasya tādātmyam lakṣaṇam nimittam yasya sa tathā uktaḥ tad utpattiḥ lakṣaṇam nimittam yasya sa tathā uktaḥ yaḥ yatra pratibaddhaḥ tasya sa pratibandha viṣayaḥ arthaḥ svabhāvaḥ kāraṇam vā syāt anyasmin pratibaddha tva anupapatteḥ tasmāt dvi prakāraḥ saḥ iti uktam sa ca sārdhye arthe liṅgasya iti atra antare abhihitaḥ

hiḥ yasmāt arthe yasmāt svabhāva pratibandhe nivartya nivartaka bhāvaḥ tena sādhyasya nivṛttau sādhanasya nivṛttim kathayatā pratibandhaḥ nivartya nivartakayoḥ darśanīyaḥ yadi hi sādhanam sādhye pratibaddham bhavet evam sādhya nivṛttau tat niyamena nivarteta yatas ca tasya pratibandhaḥ darśanīyaḥ tasmāt sādhya nivṛttau yat sādhana nivṛtti vacanam tena ākṣiptam pratibandha upadarśanam yat ca tadākṣiptam pratibandha upadarśanam tat eva anvaya vacanam pratibandhaḥ ced avaśyam darśayitavyaḥ na vaktavyaḥ tarhi anvayaḥ yasmāt dṛṣṭānte pramāṇena pratibandhaḥ darśyamānaḥ eva anvayaḥ na aparaḥ kaścid tasmāt nivartya nivartakayoḥ pratibandhaḥ jñātavyaḥ tathā ca anvayaḥ eva jñātaḥ bhavati iti śabdaḥ hetau yasmāt anvaye api vyatireka gatiḥ vyatireke ca anvaya gatiḥ tasmāt ekena api sa pakṣe ca āsapakṣe ca sattva asattvayoḥ khyāpanam kṛtam

anvayaḥ mukham upāyaḥ abhidheya tvāt yasya tat anvaya mukham vākyam evam vyatirekaḥ mukham yasya iti iti hetau yasmāt ekena api vākyena dvaya gatiḥ tasmāt ekasmin sādhana vākye dvayoḥ anvayavyatireka vākyayoḥ avaśyam eva prayogaḥ na karttavyaḥ artha gati arthaḥ hi śabda prayogaḥ arthaḥ ced avagataḥ kim śabda prayogeṇa ekam eva anvaya vākyam vyatireka vākyam vā prayoktavyam

anupalabdhau api vyatirekeṇaḥ ktena anvaya gatiḥ yat sat upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptam iti sādhyasya asat vyavahāra yogya tvasya nivṛttim dṛśya sattva rūpām āha tat upalabhyate eva iti anupalambhasya nivṛttim upalambha rūpām āha tat anena sādhya nivṛttiḥ sādhana nivṛttyā vyāptā darśitā yadi ca sādhana saṃbhavepi sādhya nivṛttiḥ bhavet na sādhana abhāvena vyāptā bhavet atas vyāptim pratipadyamānena sādhana saṃbhavaḥ sādhya saṃbhavena vyāptaḥ pratipattavyaḥ atas eva āha anupalabhyamānam tādṛśam iti dṛśyam asat iti pratīteḥ saṃpratyayāt anvaya siddhiḥ iti

yatas ca sādhanam sādhya dharma pratibaddham tādātmya tad utpattibhyām pratipattavyam dvayoḥ api prayogayoḥ tasmāt pakṣaḥ avaśyam eva na nirdeśyaḥ yat sādhanam sādhya niyatam pratītam tatas eva sādhya dharmiṇi dṛṣṭāt sādhya pratītiḥ atas na kiṃcid sādhya nirdeśena iti

enam eva artham anupalabdhi prayoge darśayati sādharmyavati prayogepi sāmarthyāt eva na iha pradeśe ghaṭaḥ iti bhavati kim punar tat sāmarthyam iti āha yat upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptam sanna upalabhyate iti anupalambha anuvādaḥ saḥ asat vyavahāra viṣayaḥ iti asat vyavahāra yogyatva vidhiḥ tathā ca sati dṛśya anupalambhaḥ asat vyavahāra yogya tvena vyāptaḥ darśitaḥ na upalabhyate ca ityādinā sādhya dharmiṇi sattvam liṅgasya darśitam yadi ca sādhya dharmaḥ tatra sādhya dharmiṇi na bhavet sādhanarmaḥ api na bhavet sādhya niyata tvāt tasya sādhana dharmasya iti sāmarthyam a

yathā sādharmya vat prayoge tathā vaidharmya vat prayoge api sāmarthyāt eva na iha sat vyavahāra viṣayaḥ asti ghaṭaḥ iti bhavati sāmarthya darśayitum āha yaḥ sat vyavahāra viṣayaḥ iti vidyamānaḥ upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptaḥ iti dṛśyaḥ iti eṣā sādhya nivṛttiḥ saḥ upalabhyate eva iti sādhana nivṛttiḥ iti anena ca sādhya nivṛttiḥ sādhana nivṛttyā vyāptā darśitā na tathā iti yathā anyaḥ dṛśyaḥ upalabhyate na tathā atra pradeśe tādṛśaḥ iti dṛśyaḥ ghaṭaḥ upalabhyate iti anena sādhya nivṛtteḥ vyāpikā nivṛttiḥ asatī sādhya dharmiṇi darśitā yadi ca sādhya dharmaḥ sādhya dharmiṇi na syāt sādhana dharmaḥ api na bhavet asti ca sādhana dharmaḥ iti sāmarthyam atas sāmarthyāt na atsi atra ghaṭaḥ iti pratīteḥ na pakṣa nirdeśaḥ evam kārya svabhāva hetvoḥ api sāmarthyāt saṃpratyayaḥ iti na pakṣa nirdeśaḥ

kīdṛśaḥ purararthaḥ pakṣaḥ iti anena śabdena nirdeśyaḥ vaktavyaḥ iti āha sva rūpeṇa eva iti sādhya tvena eva svayam iti vādinā iṣṭaḥ iti na uktaḥ eva api tu iṣṭaḥ api iti arthaḥ evaṃbhūtaḥ san pratyakṣa ādibhiḥ anirākṛtaḥ yaḥ arthaḥ sa pakṣaḥ iti ucyate atha yadi pakṣaḥ na nirdeśyaḥ katham anirdeśyasya lakṣaṇam uktam na sādhana vākya avayava tvāt asya lakṣaṇam uktam api tu asādhyam kecid sādhyam sādhyam ca asādhyam kecid pratipannāḥ tat sādhya asādhya vipratipatti nikāraṇa artham pakṣa lakṣaṇam uktam
sva rūpeṇa iṣṭaḥ iti asya vivaraṇam a sādhya tvena iṣṭaḥ iti pakṣasya sādhya tvāt na aparam asti rūpam atas svarūpam sādhya tvam iti

eva śabdam vivaritum āha sva rūpeṇa eva iti nanu ca eva śabdaḥ kevalaḥ eva pratyavamarṣṭavyaḥ tat kim artham sva rūpa śabdena saha pratyavamṛṣṭaḥ ucyate eva śabdaḥ nipātaḥ dyotakaḥ pada antara abhihitasya arthasya viśeṣam dyotayati iti pada antareṇa viśeṣya vācinā saha nirdiṣṭaḥ na sādhana tvena api iti yat sādhana tvena nirdiṣṭam tat sādhana tvena iṣṭam asiddha tvāt ca sādhya tvena api iṣṭam tasya nivṛtti arthaḥ eva śabdaḥ

tat udāharati yathā iti śabdasya anitya tve sādhye cākṣuṣa tvam hetuḥ śabde asiddha tvāt sādhyam iti anena sādhya tvena iṣṭim āha tat iti cākṣuṣa tvam iha iti śabde sādhya tvena eva iṣṭam iti sādhya tvena iṣṭi niyama abhāvam āha sādhana tvena abhidhānāt iti yatas sādhana tvena abhihitam atas sādhana tvena api iṣṭam na sādhya tvena eva iti

svayam iti anena svayaṃśabdam vyākhyeyam upakṣipya tasya artham āha vādinā iti svayaṃśabdaḥ nipātaḥ ātmanaḥ iti ṣaṣṭhī antasya ātmanā iti ca tṛtīyā antasya atha varttate tat iha tṛtīya antasya ātma śabdasya arthe vṛttaḥ svayaṃśabdaḥ ātma śabdaḥ ca sambandhi śabdaḥ vādī ca pratyāsannaḥ tatas yasya vādinaḥ ātmā tṛtīya artha yuktaḥ saḥ eva tṛtīya artha yuktaḥ nirdiṣṭaḥ vādinā iti na tu svayaṃśabdasya vādinā iti eṣa paryāyaḥ

kaḥ punar asau vā ādī iti āha yaḥ tadā iti vāda kāle sādhanam āha aneka vādi sambhave api svayaṃśabda vācyasya vādinaḥ viśeṣaṇam etat yadi evam vādinaḥ iṣṭaḥ sādhyaḥ iti uktam etena ca kim uktena anena tadā vāda kāle tena vādinā svayam yaḥ dharmaḥ sādhayitum iṣṭaḥ saḥ eva sādhyaḥ na itaraḥ dharmaḥ iti uktam bhavati vādinaḥ aniṣṭa dharma sādhya tva nivarttanam asya vacanasya phalam iti yāvat

atha kasmin sati anya dharma sādhya tvasya sambhavaḥ yat nivṛtti artham tat vaktavyam iti āha tad śāstra kāreṇa iti yat śāstram tena vādinā abhyupagatam tad śāstra kāreṇa tasmin sādhya dharmiṇi anekasya dharmasya abhyupagame sati anya dharma sādhya tva sambhavaḥ tathā hi śāstram yena abhyupagatam tat siddhaḥ dharmaḥ sarve eva tena sādhyaḥ iti asti vipratipattiḥ anena apāsyate aneka dharma abhyupagame api sati saḥ eva sādhyaḥ yaḥ vādinaḥ iṣṭaḥ na anyaḥ iti nanu ca śāstra anapekṣam vastu bala pravṛttam liṅgam atas anapekṣaṇīya tvāt na śāstre sthitvā vādaḥ karttavyaḥ satyam āhopuruṣikayā tu yadi api kvacid śāstre sthitaḥ iti kiñcid śāstram abhyupagataḥ sādhanam āha tathā api yaḥ eva tasya iṣṭaḥ saḥ eva sādhyaḥ iti jñāpanāya it am uktam

iṣṭaḥ iti iṣṭa śabdam upakṣipya vyācaṣṭe yatra arthaḥ ātmani viruddhaḥ vādaḥ prakrāntaḥ na asti ātmā iti ātma pratiṣedha vādaḥ ātma sattāvādaviruddhaḥ vidhi pratiṣedhayoḥ virodhāt tena vivādena hetunā sādhanam upanyastam tasya ātma arthasya siddhim niścayam icchatā vādinā saḥ arthaḥ sādhyaḥ iti uktam bhavati iṣṭa śabdena yat tat iti uktam bhavati iti grahaṇam ante tat iha apekṣya vākyam samāpayitavyam yadi api para artha anumānaḥ uktaḥ eva sādhyaḥ yuktaḥ anuktā upi tu vacanena sādhyaḥ sāmarthya ukta tvāt tasya

kutas etat iti āha tat iti saḥ arthaḥ adhikaraṇam āśrayaḥ yasya sa tad adhikaraṇaḥ vivādaḥ tasya bhāvaḥ tattvam tasmāt iti etat uktam bhavati yasmāt vivādam nirākarttum icchatā vādinā sādhanam upanyastam tasmāt yat adhikaraṇam vivādasya tat eva sādhyam yatas viruddham vādam apanetum sādhanam upanyastam tat ced na sādhyam kim idānīm jāti niyatam kiṃcid sādhyam syāt iti

anuktam api para artha anumāne sādhyam iṣṭam tat udāharati para arthāḥ iti cakṣuḥ ādiḥ yeṣām śrotra ādīnām te cakṣuḥ ādayaḥ iti dharmī parasmāyime para arthāḥ iti sādhyam pārārthyam saṅghāta tvāt iti hetuḥ vyāpti viṣaya pradarśanam ca śayana āsana ādi aṅga vat iti śayanam āsanam ca te ādī yasya tat śayana āsana ādi puruṣa upabhoga aṅgam saṃghāta rūpam tadvat atra pramāṇe yat api ātma arthāḥ cakṣuḥ ādayaḥ iti ātma artha tā na uktā anuktau api ātma artha tā sādhyā

tathā hi sāṃkhyena uktam asti ātmā tad viruddham bauddhena uktam na asti ātmā iti tatas sāṃkhyena svavāda viruddham bauddhavāda hetūkṛtya viruddha vāda nirākaraṇāya sva vāda pratiṣṭhāpanāya ca sādhanam upanyastam atas anuktau api ātmā artha tā sādhyā tad adhikaraṇa tvāt vivādasya śayana āsana ādiṣu hi puruṣa upabhoga aṅgeṣu ātma artha tvena anvayaḥ na prasiddhaḥ saṅghāta tvasya pārārthya mātreṇa tu siddhaḥ tatas para arthāḥ iti uktam

cakṣuḥ ādayaḥ iti atra ādi grahaṇāt vijñānam api para artham sādhayitum iṣṭam vijñānāt ca paraḥ ātmā eva syāt parasya artha kāri vijñānam setsyati iti sāmarthyāt ātma artha tvam sidhyati cakṣuḥ ādīnām iti matvā para artha grahaṇam kṛtam tena iṣṭa sādhya tva vacanena na ukta mātram api tu prativādinaḥ vivāda āspada tvāt vādinaḥ sādhayitum iṣṭam uktam anuktam vā prakaraṇa gamyam sādhyam iti uktam bhavati

anirākṛtaḥ iti vyākhyeyam etat iti anantara prakrāntam yat pakṣa lakṣaṇam uktam sādhya tvena iṣṭa ityādi etad lakṣaṇena yoge api arthaḥ na pakṣaḥ iti pradarśana artham pratipādanāya anirākṛta grahṇam kṛtam kīdṛśaḥ arthaḥ na pakṣaḥ sādhayitum iṣṭaḥ api iti āha yaḥ sādhayitum iṣṭaḥ arthaḥ pratyakṣam ca anumānam ca pratītiḥ ca sva vacanam ca etaiḥ nirākriyate viparītaḥ sādhyate na sa pakṣaḥ iti

tatra iti teṣu caturṣu pratyakṣa ādi nirākṛteṣu pratyakṣa nirākṛtaḥ kīdṛśaḥ yathā iti yathā ayam pratyakṣa nirākṛtaḥ tathā anye api draṭavyāḥ iti yathā śabda arthaḥ śravaṇena grāhyaḥ śrāvaṇaḥ na śrāvaṇaḥ aśrāvaṇaḥ śrotreṇa na grāhyaḥ iti pratijñā arthaḥ śrotra agrāhya tvam śabdasya pratyakṣa siddhena śrotra grāhya tvena bādhyate
anumāna nirākṛtaḥ yathā nityaḥ śabdaḥ iti śabdasya pratijñātam nitya tvam anitya tvena anumāna siddhena nirākriyate

pratītyā nirākṛtaḥ acandraḥ iti candra śabda vācyaḥ na bhavati śaśī iti pratijñāta arthaḥ ayam ca pratītyā nirākṛtaḥ pratītaḥ arthaḥ ucyate vikalpa vijñāna viṣayaḥ pratītiḥ pratīta tvam vikalpa vijñāna viṣaya tvam ucyate tena vikalpa jñānena pratīti rūpeṇa śaśinaḥ candra śabda vācya tvam siddham eva tathā hi yat vikalpa vijñāna grāhyam tat śabda ākāra saṃsarga yogyam yat śabda ākāra saṃsarga yogyam tat sa aṅketikena śabdena vaktum śakyam atas pratīti rūpeṇa vikalpa vijñāna viṣaya tvena siddham candra śabda vācya tvam acandra tvasya bādhakam svabhāva hetuḥ ca pratītiḥ yasmāt vikalpa viṣaya tva mātra anubandhinī sa aṅketika śabda vācya tā tatas svabhāva hetu siddham candra śabda vācya tvam avācya tvasya bādhakam draṣṭavyam

sva vacanam pratijñā arthasya ātmīyaḥ vācakaḥ śabdaḥ tena nirākṛtaḥ pratijñā arthaḥ na sādhyaḥ yathā na anumānam pramāṇam iti atra anumānasya prāmāṇya niṣedhaḥ pratijñā arthaḥ sa na anumānam pramāṇam iti anena sva vācakena vākyena bādhyate vākyam hi etat prayujyamānam vaktuḥ śābda pratyayasya sat artha tvam iṣṭam sūcayati tathā hi mad vākyāt yaḥ artha sampratyayaḥ tava utpadyate saḥ asatya arthaḥ iti darśayan vākyam eva na uccārayet vaktā vacana arthaḥ ced asatyaḥ pareṇa jñātavyaḥ vacanam apārthakam yaḥ api hi sarvam mithyā bravīmi iti vakti saḥ api asya vākyasya satya artha tvam ādarśayan eva vākyam uccārayati yadi etat vākyam satya artham ādarśitam

evam vākya antarāṇi ātmīyāni asatya arthāni darśitāni bhavanti etat eva tu yadi asatya artham anyāni asatya arbhāni na darśitāni bhavanti tatas ca na kiñcid uccāraṇasya phalam iti na uccārayet tasmāt vākya prabhavam vākya artha ālambanam vijñānam satya artham darśayan eva vaktā vākyam uccārayati tathā ca sati bāhya vastunā antarīyakam śabdam darśayatā śabda jam vijñānam satya artham darśayitavyam tatas bāhya artha kāryāt śabdāt utpannam vijñānam satya artham ādarśayatā kārya liṅga jam anumānam pramāṇam śābdam darśitam bhavati

tasmāt na anumānam pramāṇam iti bruvatā śābdasya pratyayasya āsan arthaḥ grāhyaḥ uktaḥ asat artha tvam eva hi aprāmāṇyam ucyate na anyat śabda uccāraṇa sāmarthyāt ca artha avinā bhāvī sva śabdaḥ darśitaḥ tathā ca san arthaḥ darśitaḥ tatas kalpitāt artha kāryāt śabdācśābda pratyaya arthasya anumitam sattvam pratijñāyamānam asattvam pratibadhnāti

tat evam sva vacana anumitena sattvena asattvam bādhyamānam sva vacanena bādhitam uktam iti ayam atra arthaḥ anye tu āhuḥ abhiprāya kāryāt śabdāt jātam jñānam abhiprāya ālambanam sat artham icchataḥ śabda prayogaḥ tena aprāmāṇyam pratijñātam bādhyate iti tat ayuktam yatas iha pratīteḥ svabhāva hetu tvam sva vacanasya ca kārya hetu tvam kalpitam iṣṭam na vāstavam abhiprāya kārya tvam ca vāstavam eva śabdasya tatas tat iha na gṛhyate

kiñca yathā anumānam anicchan vahni avyabhicāri tvam dhūmasya na pratyeti tathā śabdasya api abhiprāya avi abhicāri tvam na pratyeṣyati bāhya vastu pratyāyanāya ca śabdaḥ prayujyate tat na śabdasya abhiprāya avinā bhāvi tva abhyupagama pūrvakaḥ śabda prayogaḥ api ca na sva abhiprāya nivedanāya śabdaḥ uccāryate api tu bāhya sattva pratipādanāya tasmāt bāhya vaḥ tu avinābhāvi tva abhyupagama pūrvakaḥ śabda prayogaḥ tatas pūrvakam eva vyākhyātam anavadyam
evaṃca sati anirākṛta grahaṇena anantara uktāḥ catvāraḥ pakṣa vat ābhāsantaḥ iti pakṣa ābhāsāḥ nirastāḥ bhavanti

samprati pakṣa lakṣaṇa padāni yeṣām vyavacchedakāni teṣām vyavachedena yādṛśaḥ pakṣa arthaḥ labhyate tam darśayitum vyavacchedyān saṃkṣipya darśayati evam iti anantara ukta krameṇa siddhasya viparyayeṇa viparīta tvena hetunā sādhyaḥ draṣṭavyaḥ yasmāt arthāt siddhaḥ arthaḥ viparītaḥ sa sādhyaḥ iti arthaḥ siddhaḥ ca viparītaḥ asiddhasya tasmāt asiddhaḥ sādhyaḥ asiddhaḥ api na sarvaḥ api tu sādhana tvena uktasya asiddhasya api viparyayeṇa svarya vādinā sādhayitum aniṣṭasya asiddhasya viparyayeṇa tathā ukta mātrasya asiddhasya api viparyayeṇa tathā nirākṛtasya asiddhasya api viparyayeṇa sādhyaḥ

yaḥ ca ayam pañcabhiḥ vyavacchedyaiḥ rahitaḥ arthaḥ asiddhaḥ asādhanam vādinaḥ svayam sādhayitum iṣṭaḥ uktaḥ anuktaḥ vā pramāṇaiḥ anirākṛtaḥ sādhyaḥ saḥ eva asau sva rūpeṇa eva svayam iṣṭaḥ anirākṛtaḥ etaiḥ padaiḥ uktaḥ iti arthaḥ yaḥ ca ayam sādhyaḥ sa pakṣaḥ iti ucyate iti śabdaḥ evam arthe evam pakṣa lakṣaṇam anavadyam iti avidyamānam avadyam doṣaḥ yasya tat anavadyam darśitam kathitam

trirūpa liṅga ākhyānam parisamāpayya prasaṅga āgatam ca pakṣa lakṣaṇam abhidhāya hetvābhāsān vaktu kāmaḥ teṣām prastāvam racayati trirūpa ityādinā etat uktam bhavati trirūpa liṅgam vaktu kāmena sphuṭam tat vaktavyam evam ca tat sphuṭa m uktam bhavati yadi tat ca tatpratirūpakam ca ucyate heya jñāne hi tat viviktam upādeyam su jñātam bhavati iti trirūpa liṅga ākhyānam para artham anumānam iti prāk uktam tatra iti tasmin sati trirūpa liṅga ākhyāne para artha anumāne sati iti arthaḥ trayāṇām rūpāṇām madhye ekasya api anuktau api śabdāt dvayoḥ api sādhanasya ābhāsaḥ sadṛśam sādhanasya na sādhanam iti arthaḥ trayāṇām rūpāṇām nyūna tā nāma sādhana doṣaḥ
na kevalam anuktau uktau api asiddhau sandehe vā kasya iti āha pratipādyasya prativādinaḥ pratipādakasya ca vādinaḥ hetvābhāsaḥ

atha kasya ekasya arūpasya asiddhau sandehe vā kiṃsaṃjñakaḥ hetvābhāse iti āha ekasya rūpasya iti dharmiṇā saha sambandhaḥ dharmi sambandhaḥ dharmiṇi sattvam hetoḥ tasya asiddhau sandehe vā asiddha saṃjñākaḥ hetvābhāsaḥ asiddha tvāt eva ca dharmiṇyapratipatti hetuḥ na sādhyasya na viruddhasya na saṃśayasya hetuḥ api tu apratipatti hetuḥ na kasyacid atas pratipattiḥ iti kṛtvā ayam ca arthaḥ asiddha saṃjñā karaṇāt eva pratipattavyaḥ
udāharaṇam āha yathā ityādi anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti anitya tva viśiṣṭe śabde sādhye cākṣuṣa tvam cakṣuḥ grāhya tvam śabde dvayoḥ api vādi prativādinoḥ asiddham

cetanāḥ taravaḥ iti tarūṇām caitanye sādhye sarvā tvac sarva tvac tasyāḥ apaharaṇe sati maraṇam digambaraiḥ upanyastam prativādinaḥ bauddhasya asiddham kasmāt asiddham iti āha vijñānam ca indriyam ca āyuḥ ca iti dvandvaḥ tatra vijñānam cakṣuḥ ādi janitam rūpa ādi vijñāna utpattyā yat anumitam kāya antarbhūtam cakṣuḥ golaka ādi sthitam rūpam tat indriyam āyuḥ iti loke prāṇāḥ ucyante na ca āgama siddham iha yujyate vaktum atas prāṇa svabhāvam āyuḥ iha teṣām nirodhaḥ nivṛttiḥ sa lakṣaṇam tattvam yasya tat tathā uktam tathābhūtasya maraṇasya anena bauddhena pratijñāta tvāt

yadi nāma evam tathā api katham asiddham iti āha tasya ca vijñāna ādi nirodha ātmakasya taruṣu asambhavāt sattā pūrvakaḥ nirodhaḥ tatas ca yaḥ vijñāna nirodham taruṣu icchet sa katham vijñānam na icchet tasmāt vijñāna aniṣṭeḥ nirodhaḥ api na iṣṭaḥ taruṣu nanu ca śoṣaḥ api maraṇam ucyate sa ca taruṣu siddhaḥ satyam kevalam vijñāna sattayā vyāptam yat maraṇam tat iha hetuḥ vijñāna nirodhaḥ ca tad sattayā vyāptaḥ na śoṣa mātram tatas yat maraṇam hetuḥ tat taruṣu asiddham yat tu siddham śoṣa ātmakam tat ahetuḥ digambaraḥ tu sādhyena vyāptam avyāptam vā maraṇam avivicya maraṇa mātram hetum āha tat asya vādinaḥ hetu bhūtam maraṇam na jñātam ajñānāt siddham śoṣa rūpam śoṣa rūpasya maraṇasya taruṣu darśanāt prativādinaḥ tu jñātam atas asiddham yadā tu vādinaḥ api jñātam tadā vādinā upya siddham syāt iti nyāyaḥ

acetanāḥ sukha ādayaḥ iti sukham ādiḥ yeṣām duḥkha ādīnām te sukha ādayaḥ teṣām acaitanye sādhye utpattimat tvam anitya tvam vā liṅgam upanyastam yaḥ utpattimantaḥ anityāḥ vā te na cetanāḥ yathā rūpa ādayaḥ tathā ca utpattimantaḥ anityāḥ vā sukha ādayaḥ tasmāt acetanāḥ caitanyam tu puruṣasya svarūpam atra ca utpattimat tvam anitya tvam vā paryāyeṇa hetuḥ na yugapad tat ca dvayam api sāṃkhyasya vādinaḥ na siddham para arthaḥ hi hetu upanyāsaḥ tena yaḥ parasya siddhaḥ sa hetuḥ vaktavyaḥ parasya ca asataḥ utpādaḥ utpattimat tvam sataḥ ca niranvayaḥ vināśaḥ anitya tvam siddham tādṛśam ca dvayam api sāṃkhyasya asiddham iha api anitya tva utpattimat tva sādhanāt vādinaḥ asiddham yadi tu anitya tva utpattimat tvayoḥ prāmāṇyam vādinaḥ jñātam syāt tadā vādinaḥ api siddham syāt tatas pramāṇa aparijñānāt idam vādinaḥ asiddham

saṃdigdha asiddham darśayitum āha svayam iti hetoḥ ātmanaḥ sandehe asiddhaḥ tad āśrayaṇasya vā iti tasya hetoḥ āśrayaṇam āśrīyate asmin hetuḥ iti āśrayaṇam hetoḥ vyatiriktaḥ āśraya bhūtaḥ sādhya dharmī kathyate tatra hi hetuḥ varttamānaḥ gamaka tvena āśrīyate tasya āśrayaṇasya sandehe sandigdhaḥ

ātmanā sandihyamānam udāharttum āha yathā iti bāṣpaḥ ādiḥ yasya sa bāṣpa ādiḥ tad bhāvena bāṣpa ādi tvena saṃdihyamānaḥ bhūta saṃghātaḥ iti bhūtānām pṛthivī ādīnām saṃghātaḥ samūhaḥ agni siddhau agni siddhi artham upādīyamānaḥ asiddhaḥ etat uktam bhavati yadā dhūmaḥ api bāṣpa ādi tvena saṃdigdhaḥ bhavati tadā asiddhaḥ gamaka rūpā niścayāt dhūmatayā niścitaḥ vahni janya tvāt gamakaḥ yadā tu saṃdigdhaḥ tadā na gamakaḥ iti asiddha tā ākhyaḥ doṣaḥ
āśrayaṇa asiddham udāharati yathā iti iha nikuñjaḥ iti dharmī parvata upari bhāgena tiryak nirgatena pracchāditaḥ bhūmāgaḥ nikuñjaḥ mayūraḥ iti sādhyam kekāyitāt iti hetuḥ kekāyitam mayūra dhvaniḥ

katham ayam āśrayaṇa asiddhaḥ iti āha tadāpātaḥ iti tasya kekāyitasya āpātaḥ āgamanam tasya deśaḥ saḥ ucyate yasmāda veśāt āgacchati kekāyitam tasya vibhrame vyāmohe satyayama āśrayaṇa asiddhaḥ nirantareṣu vahuṣu nikuñjeṣu satsu yadā kekāyitā pāta nikuñje vibhramaḥ kim asmāt nikuñjāt kekāyitam āgatam āhosvit anyasmāt iti tadā ayam āśrayaṇa asiddhaḥ iti

dharmiṇaḥ asiddhau api asiddha tvam udāharati yathā iti sarvasmin gataḥ sthitaḥ sarva gataḥ vyāpi iti yāvat vyāpitvaḥ ātmanaḥ sādhye sarvatra upalabhyamāna guṇa tvam liṅgam sarvatra deśaḥ upalabhyamānāḥ sukha duḥkha icchā dveṣa ādayaḥ guṇāḥ yasya ātmanaḥ tasya bhāvaḥ tattvam na guṇāḥ guṇinam antareṇa varttante guṇānām guṇini samavāyāt niṣkriyaḥ ca ātmā tatas ca yadi vyāpī na bhavet katham dākṣiṇāpathaḥ upalabdhāḥ sukha ādayaḥ madhyadeśaḥ upalabhyeran tasmāt sarva gataḥ ātmā tat iha bauddhasya ātmā eva na siddhaḥ kim uta sarvatra upalabhyamāna guṇa tvam sidhyet tasya iti asiddhau hetvābhāsaḥ pūrvam āśrayaṇa saṃdehena dharmiṇi saṃdehaḥ uktaḥ saṃprati tu asiddhaḥ dharmī uktaḥ iti ananayoḥ viśeṣaḥ tat evam ekasya rūpasya dharmi sambaddhasya asiddha a asiddhaḥ hetvābhāsaḥ

tathā aparasya ekasya rūpasya asapakṣe asattva ākhyasya asiddhau anaikāntikaḥ hetvābhāsaḥ ekaḥ antaḥ ekāntaḥ niścayaḥ sa prayojanam asya iti aikāntikaḥ na aikāntikaḥ anaikāntikaḥ yasmāt na sādhyasya na viparyayasya niścayaḥ api tu tad viparītaḥ saṃśayaḥ sādhya itarayoḥ saṃśaya hetuḥ anaikāntikaḥ uktaḥ

tam udāharati yathā ityādinā anitya tvam ādiḥ yasyā asau anitya tva ādikaḥ dharmaḥ ādi śabdāt aprayatna ānantarīyaka tvam prayatna ānantarīyaka tvam nitya tvam ca parigṛhyate prameya tvam ādiḥ yasya sa prameya tva ādikaḥ ādi śabdāt anitya tvam punar anitya tvam amūrtta tvam ca gṛhyate śabdasya dharmiṇaḥ anitya tva ādike dharme sādhye prameya tva ādikaḥ dharmaḥ anaikāntikaḥ caturṇām api hi vipakṣe asattvam asiddham

tathā hi anityaḥ śabdaḥ prameya tvāt ghaṭa vat ākāśa vat iti prameya tvam sa pakṣa vipakṣa vyāpi aprayatna ānantarīyakaḥ śabdaḥ anitya tvāt vidyut ākāśa vat ghaṭa vat ca iti anitya tvam sa pakṣa eka deśa vṛtti vidyut ādau asti na ākāśa ādau vipakṣavyāpi prayatna ānantarīyake sarvatra bhāvāt anitya tvāt prayatna ānantarīyakaḥ śabdaḥ ghaṭa vat vidyut ākāśa vat ca iti anitya tvam vipakṣa eka deśa vṛtti vidyut ādau asti na ākāśa ādau sa pakṣa vyāpi sarvatra prayatna ānantarīyake bhāvāt

nityaḥ śabdaḥ amūrtta tvāt ākāśa paramāṇu vat karma ghaṭa vat ca iti amūrta tvam ubhaya eka deśa vṛtti ubhayoḥ eka deśaḥ ākāśe karmaṇi ca vartate paramāṇau tu sa pakṣa eka deśe ghaṭa ādau ca vipakṣa eka deśe na varttate mūrtta tvāt ghaṭa paramāṇu prabhṛtīnām nityāḥ tu paramāṇavaḥ vaiśeṣikaiḥ abhyupagamyante tatas sa pakṣa antargatāḥ asya caturvidhasya pakṣa dharmasya asattvam asiddham vipakṣe tatas anaikāntika tā
yathā ca asya rūpasya asiddhau anaikāntikaḥ tathā asya eva vipakṣe asattva ākhyasya rūpasya saṃdehe anaikāntikaḥ

tam udāharati yathā iti asarvajñaḥ iti asarvajña tvam sādhyam kaścid vivakṣitaḥ iti vaktuḥ abhipretaḥ puruṣaḥ dharmīm rāgāḥ ādiḥ yasya dveṣa ādeḥ sa rāga ādiḥ sa yasya asti sa rāga ādimān iti dvitīyam sādhyam vāgrahaṇam rāga ādimattvasya pṛthak sādhya tva khyāpana artham tatas asarvajña tve rāga ādimattve vā sādhye prakṛte vaktṛ tvam vacana śaktiḥ tad ādiḥ yasya unmeṣa nimeṣa ādeḥ sa vaktṛ tva ādikaḥ dharmaḥ anaikāntikaḥ sandigdhā vipakṣāḥ vyāvṛttiḥ yasya sa tathā uktaḥ asarvajña tve sādhye sarvajña tvam vipakṣaḥ tatra vacana ādeḥ sattvam asat tvam vā sandigdham atas na jñāyate kim vaktā sarvajñaḥ uta asarvajñaḥ iti anaikāntikam vaktṛ tvam

nanu ca sarvajñaḥ vaktā na upalabhyate tat katham vacanam sarvajñe sandigdham atas eva sarvajñaḥ vaktā na upalabhyate iti evamprakārasya evaṃjātīyasya anupalambhasya saṃdeha hetu tvāt kutas iti āha adṛśyaḥ ātmā viṣayaḥ yasya tasya bhāvaḥ adṛśya ātma viṣaya tvam tena sandeha hetu tvam yatas adṛśya viṣayaḥ anupalambhaḥ sandeha hetuḥ na niścaya hetuḥ tatas asarvajña vipakṣāt sarvajñāt vaktṛ tva ādeḥ vyāvṛttiḥ sandigdhā

na anupalambhāt sarvajñe vaktṛ tvam asat brūmaḥ api tu sarvaṃjña tvena saha vaktṛ tvasya virodhāt etat na sarvajña tva vaktṛ tvayoḥ virodhaḥ na asti virodha abhāvāt ca kāraṇāt vyatirekaḥ na sidhyati iti saṃbandhaḥ vyāptimantam vyatirekam darśayati yaḥ sarvajñaḥ iti sādhya abhāva rūpam sarvajña tvam anūdya sa vaktā na bhavati iti sādhanasya vaktṛ tvasya abhāvaḥ vidhīyate tena sādhya abhāvaḥ sādhana abhāve niyata tvāt sādhana abhāvena vyāptaḥ uktaḥ iti vyāptimān īdṛśaḥ vyatirekaḥ virodhe sati vaktṛ tva sarvajña tvayoḥ sidhyet na ca asti virodhaḥ tasmāt na sidhyati iti kutas iti āha saṃdehāt yatas virodha abhāvaḥ tasmāt saṃdehaḥ sandehāt vyatireka asiddhiḥ
katham virodha abhāvaḥ hi iti yasmāt dvividhaḥ eva virodhaḥ na anyaḥ tasmāt na vaktṛ tva sarvaṃjña tvayoḥ viṃrodhaḥ

kaḥ punar asau dvividhaḥ virodhaḥ iti āha avikala kāraṇasya iti avikalāni samagrāṇi kāraṇāni yasya sa tathā uktaḥ yasya kāraṇa vaikalyāt abhāvaḥ na tasya kenacid api virodha gatiḥ tad artham avikala kāraṇa grahaṇam nanu ca yasya api kāraṇa sākalyam tasya api nivṛttiḥ aśakyā kenacid api karttum tat kutas virodha gatiḥ evam tarhi avikala kāraṇasya api yad kṛtāt kāraṇa vaikalyāt abhāvaḥ tena virodha gatiḥ

tathā ca sati yaḥ yasya viruddhaḥ sa tasya kiñcitkaraḥ eva tathā hi śīta sparśasya janakaḥ bhūtvā śīta sparśa antara janana śaktim pratibadhnan śīta sparśasya nivarttakaḥ viruddhaḥ tasmāt hetu vaikalya kārī viruddhaḥ janakaḥ eka nivartti asya saha anavasthāna virodhaḥ ca ayam tatas viruddhayoḥ ekasmin api kṣaṇe saha avasthānam pariharttavyam dūra sthayoḥ virodha abhāvāt ca nikaṭa sthayoḥ eva nivartti a nivarttaka bhāvaḥ

tasmāt yaḥ yasya nivarttakaḥ sa tam yadi param tṛtīye kṣaṇe nivarttayati prathame kṣaṇe sannipatan asamartha avasthā dhāna yogyaḥ bhavati dvitīye viruddham asamartham karoti tṛtīye tu asamarthe nivṛtte tad deśam ākrāmati tatra ālokaḥ gati dharmā krameṇa jala taraṅga nyāyena deśam ākrāman yadā andhakāra nirantaram ālokakṣaṇam janayati tadā aaloka samīpa varttinam andhakāram asamartham janayati tatas asāmarthyam taspa yasya samīpa vartti ālokaḥ asamarthe nivṛtte tad deśaḥ jāyate ālokaḥ iti evam krameṇā aalokena andhakāraḥ apaneyaḥ tathā uṣṇa sparśena śīta sparśaḥ nivarttanīyaḥ

yadā tu ālokaḥ tatra eva andhakāra deśe janyate tadā yatas kṣaṇāt andhakāra deśasya ālokasya janakaḥ kṣaṇaḥ utpadyate tatas eva andhakāraḥ andhakāra antara jananā samarthaḥ utpannaḥ tatas asamartha avasthā janaka tvam eva nivarttaka tvam atas ca yasmin kṣaṇe janakaḥ tatas tṛtīye kṣaṇe nivṛttaḥ viruddhaḥ yadi śīghram nivarttate

janya janaka bhāvat ca santānayoḥ virodhaḥ na kṣaṇayoḥ yadi api ca na santānaḥ nāma vastu tathā api santāninaḥ vastu bhūtāḥ tatas ayam parama arthaḥ na kṣaṇayoḥ virodhaḥ api tu bahūnām kṣaṇānām yatas satsu dahana kṣaṇeṣu pravṛttāḥ api śītakṣaṇāḥ nivṛtti dharmāṇaḥ bhavanti iti santānayoḥ nivartti anivarttaka tva nimitte ca virodhe sthite sarveṣām paramāṇūnām sati api eka deśa avasthāna abhāve na virodhaḥ itaretara santānā nivarttanāt teṣām gati dharmā ca ālokaḥ yām diśam ākrāmati tad digvarttinaḥ virodhi santānāt nivarttayati tatas apavaraka eka deśa sthā pradīpa prabhā andhakāra nikaṭa vartti vyapi na andhakāram nivarttayati andhakāra ākrāntāyām diśi āloka kṣaṇa antara janana asāmarthyāt kāraṇa asāmarthya hetu tva kṛtam santāna niṣṭham eva virodham darśayatā bhavataḥ iti kṛtam bhavataḥ prabandhena pravarttamānasya śīta sparśa santānasya abhāvaḥ anyasya uṣṇa santānasya bhāve sati iti

ye tu āhuḥ na virodhaḥ vāstavaḥ iti te idam vaktavyāḥ yathā na niṣpanne kārye kaścid janyajanaka bhāvaḥ nāma dviṣṭhaḥ asti kāraṇa pūrvikā tu kāryaṃvṛttiḥ atas vāstavaḥ eva tadvat na nivṛtte vastuni kaścid dviṣṭhaḥ nāma virodhaḥ asti dahana nimittam tu śīta sparśasya kṣaṇa antara janana asāmarthyam atas virodhaḥ api vāstavaḥ eva
udāharaṇam āha śītaḥ ca uṣṇaḥ ca tau eva sparśau tayoḥ iva śīta uṣṇa sparśayoḥ him pūrvavat virodhaḥ yojanīyaḥ

dvitīyam api virodham darśayitum āha parasparasya parihāraḥ parityāgaḥ tena sthitam lakṣaṇam rūpam yayoḥ tad bhāvaḥ paraspara parihāra sthita lakṣaṇa tā tayā iha yasmin paricchidyamāne yat vyavacchidyate tat paricchidyamānam avacchidyamāna parihāreṇa sthita rūpam draṣṭavyam nīle ca paricchidyamāne tādrūpya pracyutiḥ avacchidyate tat avyavacchede nīla apariccheda prasaṅgāt tasmāt vastunaḥ bhāva abhāvau paraspara parihāreṇa sthita rūpau nīlāt tu yat anyat rūpam tat nīla abhāva avyabhicāri nīlasya dṛśyasya pīta ādau upalabhyamāne anupalambhāt abhāva niścayāt yathā ca nīlam svābhāvam pariharati tadvat abhāva avi abhicāri pīta ādikam api iti tathā ca bhāva abhāvayoḥ sākṣāt virodhaḥ vastunoḥ tu anyonya abhāva avyabhicāri tvāt virodhaḥ

kasya ca anyatra abhāva avasāyaḥ yaḥ niyata ākāraḥ arthaḥ tasya na tu aniyata ākāraḥ kṣaṇika tva ādi vat kṣaṇika tvam hi sarveṣām nīla ādīnām sva rūpa ātmakam atas na niyata ākāram yatas kṣaṇika tva parihāreṇa na kiñcid dṛśyate yadi evam abhāvaḥ api na niyata ākāraḥ katham aniyata ākāraḥ nāma yāvatā vastu rūpa vivikta ākāraḥ kalpitaḥ abhāvaḥ tatas dṛṣṭam kalpitam vā niyatam rūpam anyatra asat iti avasīyate na aniyatam evam nitya tva piśāca ādiḥ api niyata ākāraḥ kalpitaḥ draṣṭavyaḥ eka ātma tva virodhaḥ ca ayam yayoḥ hi paraspara parihāreṇa avasthānam tayoḥ ekatva abhāvaḥ

atas eva lākṣaṇikaḥ ayam virodhaḥ ucyate lakṣaṇam rūpam vastūnām prayojanam asya iti kṛtvā virodhena hi anena vastu tattvam vibhaktam vyavasthāpyate atas eva dṛśyamāne rūpe yat niṣidhyate tat dṛśyam eva abhyupagamya niṣidhyate tathā hi abhāvaḥ api piśācaḥ api yadā pīte niṣeddhum iṣyate tadā dṛśya ātma tayā niṣedhya iti dṛśya tvam abhyupagamya dṛśya anupalabdheḥ eva niṣedhaḥ tathā ca sati rūpe paricchidyamānaḥ ekasmin tad abhāvaḥ dṛśyaḥ vyavacchidyate yat ca tad abhāva vat niyata ākāram rūpam tat api dṛśyam vyavacchidyate tatas sva pracyuti vat pracyutimantaḥ api vyavacchinnāḥ iti ye paraspara parihāra sthita rūpāḥ sarve te anena niṣiddha ekatvāḥ iti sati api ca asmin virodhe saha avasthānam syāt api

tatas bhinnavyāpārau virodhau ekena virodhena śīta uṣṇa sparśayoḥ ekatvam vāryate anyena saha avasthānam bhinna viṣayau ca sakale vastuni avastuni ca paraspara parihāra virodhaḥ vastuni eva katipaye saha anavasthāna virodhaḥ tasmāt bhinnavyā pārau bhinna viṣayau ca tatas na anayoḥ anyonya antarbhāvaḥ iti

sa ca ayam dvividhaḥ api virodhaḥ vaktṛ tvam ca sarvajña tvam ca tayoḥ na sambhavati na hi avikala kāraṇasya sarvajña tvasya vaktṛ tva bhāvāt abhāva gatiḥ sarvajña tvam hi adṛśyam adṛṣṭasya ca abhāvaḥ na avasīyate tatas na anena virodha gatiḥ bhavati na ca vaktṛ tva parihāreṇa sarvajña tvam avasthitam kāṣṭha ādayaḥ hi vaktṛ tva parihṛtāḥ teṣām api sarvajña tva prasaṅgāt na api sarvajña tva parihāreṇa vaktṛ tvam kāṣṭha ādīnām api vaktṛ tva prasaṅgāt tatas eva avirodhāt vaktṛ tva vidheḥ na sarvajña tva niṣedhaḥ

syāt etat yadi na asti eva virodhaḥ ghaṭa paṭayoḥ iva syāt api tayoḥ saha avasthiti darśanam sahau avasthiti adarśanāt tu virodha gatiḥ virodhāt ca abhāva gatiḥ iti āśaṅkya āha na ca aviruddha vidheḥ iti anupalabdhau api na ayam viruddha vidhiḥ yadi api saha avasthāna anupalambhaḥ tathā api na tayoḥ virodhaḥ yasmāt na saha anupalambha mātrāt virodhaḥ api tu dvayoḥ upalabhyamānayoḥ niva rti anivartaka bhāva avasāyāt tasmāt anupalabdhau api na vaktṛ tvavidhe rviruddha vidhiḥ atas asmāt na anyasya abhāva gatiḥ

tathā na vaktṛ tvāt rāga ādimattva gatiḥ yatas yadi vacana ādi rāga ādīnām kāryam syāt vacanāde rāga ādi gatiḥ syāt rāga ādi nivṛttau vacana ādi nivṛttiḥ syāt na ca kāryam kutas rāga ādīnām vacana ādeḥ ca kārya kāraṇa bhāvasyā asiddheḥ kāraṇāt na kāryam atas asmān na gatiḥ

mā bhūt rāga ādi kāryam vacanam sahacāri tu bhavati tatas rāga ādau sahacāriṇi nivṛtte nivarttaṃte vacanam iti āśaṅkya āha artha antarasya ca akāraṇasya nivṛttau sahacāri tva darśana mātreṇa na anyasya vacana ādeḥ nivṛttiḥ atas vaktṛ tvam bhavet rāga ādi virahaḥ ca
iti śabdaḥ tasmāt arthe tasmāt asarvajña tva viparyayāt vipakṣāt sarvajña tvāt rāga ādi mattva viparyaya āt arāga ādimattvāt sandigdhaḥ vyatirekaḥ vacana ādeḥ atas anaikāntikaḥ vacana ādiḥ
evam ekaika rūpa ādi siddhi sandehe hetu doṣān ākhyāya dvayoḥ dvayaḥ rūpayoḥ asiddhi sandehe hetu doṣān vaktu kāmaḥ āha dvayoḥ iti dvayoḥ rūpayoḥ viparyaya siddhau sattyām viruddhaḥ
trīṇi ca rūpāṇi santi tatas viśeṣa jñāpana artham āha kayoḥ dvayoḥ iti

viśiṣṭe rūpe darśayati sa pakṣe sattvasya asapakṣe ca asattvasya viparyaya siddhau iti sambandhaḥ kṛtaka tvam iti svabhāva hetuḥ prayatna ānantarīyaka tva miti kārya hetuḥ prayatna anantarīyaka śabdena hi prayatna anantaram janma jñānam ca prayatna ānantarīyakam ucyate janma jāyamānasya svabhāvaḥ jñānam jñeyasya kāryam tat iha prayatna anantaram jñānam gṛhyate tena kārya hetuḥ etau hetū nitya tve sādhye viruddhau hetvābhāsau
kasmāt punar etau viruddhau iti āha anayoḥ iti sa pakṣe hi nitye kataka tva prayatna ānantarīyaka tvayoḥ asattvam eva niścitam anitye vipakṣe eva sattvam niścitam iti viparyaya siddhiḥ
kasmāt punar viparyaya siddhau api etau viruddhau iti āha etau ca sādhyasya nitya tvasya viparyayam anitya tvam sādhayataḥ tatas sādhya viparyaya sādhanāt viruddhau

yadi sādhya viparyaya sādhanāt viruddhau etau uktam ca para artha anumāne sādhyam na tu anuktam iṣṭam ca anuktam atas anyaḥ iṣṭa vighāta kṛt ābhyām iti darśayan āha nanu ca tṛtīyaḥ api viruddhaḥ uktaḥ ukta viparyaya sādhanau dvau tṛtīyaḥ ayam iṣṭasya śabdena anupāttasya vighātam karoti viparyaya sādhanāt iti iṣṭa vighāta kṛt

tam udāharati yathā iti cakṣuḥ ādayaḥ iti dharmī paraḥ arthaḥ prayojanam para arthaḥ prayojakaḥ saṃskārya upakarttavyaḥ yeṣām te para arthāḥ iti sādhyam saṃghāta tvāt sañcita rūpa tvāt iti hetuḥ cakṣuḥ ādayaḥ hi paramāṇu sañciti rūpāḥ tatas saṃghāta rūpāḥ ucyante śayanam āsanam ca ādiryasya tat śayana āsana ādi tat eva aṅgam puruṣa upabhoga aṅga tvāt ayam vyāpti pradarśana viṣayaḥ dṛṣṭāntaḥ atra hi pārārthyena saṃhata tvam vyāptam yatas śayana āsana ādayaḥ saṃghāta rūpāḥ puruṣasya bhoginaḥ bhavanti upakārakāḥ iti para arthāḥ ucyante

katham ayam iṣṭa vighāta kṛt iti āha tad iṣṭa asaṃhata pārārthya viparyaya sādhanāt iti asaṃhate viṣaye pārārthyam asaṃhata pārārthyam tasya sāṃkhyasya vādinaḥ iṣṭam asaṃhata pārārthyam tat iṣṭa asaṃhata pārāthyaṃm tasya viparyayaḥ saṃhata pārārthyam nāma tasya sādhanāt viruddhaḥ ātmā asti iti bruvāṇaḥ sāṃkhyaḥ kutas etat iti paryanuyuktaḥ bauddhena idam ātmanaḥ siddhaye pramāṇam āha tasmāt asaṃhatasya ātmanaḥ upakāraka tvam sādhyam cakṣuḥ ādīnām ayam tu hetuḥ viparyaya vyāptaḥ yasmāt yaḥ yasya upakārakaḥ sa tasya janakaḥ janyamānaḥ ca yugapad krameṇa vā bhavati saṃhataḥ tasmāt para arthāḥ cakṣuḥ ādayaḥ saṃhata para arthāḥ iti siddham
ayam ca viruddhaḥ ācārya diś nāgena uktaḥ
sa kasmāt vārttikakāreṇa satā tvayā na uktaḥ itaraḥ āha anayoḥ eva sādhya viparyaya sādhanayoḥ antar bhāvāt

nanu ca ukta viparyapam na sādhayati tat katham ukta viparyaya sādhanayoḥ eva antarbhāvaḥ iti āha na hi ayam iti hi iti yasmāt arthe yasmāt ayam iṣṭa vidhāta kṛdābhyām hetubhyām sādhya viparyayasya sādhana tvena na bhidyate yathā tau sādhya viparyaya sādhanau tathā ayam api iti ukta viparyayam tu sādhayatu vā mā vā kim ukta viparyaya sādhanena tasmāt anayoḥ eva antarbhāvaḥ

nanu ca uktam eva sādhyam tat katham sādhya viparyaya sādhana tvena abhedaḥ iti āha na hi iti yasmāt iṣṭa uktayoḥ parasparasmāt sādhya tvena na kaścid viśeṣaḥ bhedaḥ iti tasmāt anayoḥ eva antarbhāvaḥ iti upasaṃhāraḥ prativādinaḥ hi yat jijñāsitam tat prakaraṇa āpannam yat ca prakaraṇa āpannam tat sādhana icchayā viṣayīkṛtam sādhyam iṣṭam uktam anuktam vā na tu ukta mātram eva sādhyam tena aviśeṣaḥ iti
dvayoḥ rūpayoḥ rviparyaya siddhau viruddhaḥ uktaḥ tayoḥ tu dvayoḥ madhye ekasya asiddhau aparasya ca sandehe anaikāntikaḥ

kīdṛśaḥ asau iti āha yathā iti vigataḥ rāgaḥ yasya sa vīta rāgaḥ iti ekam sādhyam sarvajñaḥ vā iti dvitīyam vaktṛ tvāt iti hetuḥ vyatirekaḥ atra asiddhaḥ iti sva ātmani eva sa rāge ca asarva jñe ca vipakṣe vaktṛ tvam dṛṣṭam atas asiddhaḥ vyatirekaḥ sandigdhaḥ anvayaḥ

kutas iti āha sa pakṣa bhūtayoḥ sarvajña vīta rāgayoḥ viprakarṣāt iti ati indriya tvāt vacana ādeḥ indriya gamyasya api tatra atīndriyayoḥ sarvajña tvavī tarāgayoḥ sattvam asat tvam vā sandigdham tatas ca na jñāyate kim baktṛ tvāt sarvaṃjñaḥ uta na iti anaikāntikam iti
samprati dvayoḥ eva sandehe anaikāntikam vaktum āha anayoḥ eva anvaya vyatireka rūpayoḥ sandehāt saṃśaya hetuḥ

udāharaṇam yathā iti saha ātmanā varttaṃte sa ātmakam iti sādhyam śarīram iti dharmī jīvat grahaṇam dharmi viśeṣaṇam mṛte hi ātmānam na icchati prāṇāḥ śvāsa ādayaḥ ādiḥ yasya unmeṣa nimeṣa ādeḥ prāṇi dharmasya sa prāṇa ādiḥ sa yasya asti tat prāṇa ādimat jīvat śarīram tasya bhāvaḥ tattvam tasmāt iti eṣa hetuḥ

ayam asādhāraṇaḥ saṃśaya hetuḥ upapādayitavyaḥ pakṣa dharmasya ca dvābhyām kāraṇābhyām saṃśaya hetutvam saṃśaya viṣayau yāvākārau tābhyām sarvasya vastunaḥ saṃgrahāt tayoḥ ca vyāpakayoḥ ākārayoḥ ekatra api vṛtti aniścayāt yābhyām hi ākārābhyām sarvam vastu na saṃgṛhyate tayoḥ ākārayoḥ na saṃśayaḥ prakāra antara sambhave hi pakṣa dharmaḥ dharmiṇam aviyuktam dvayoḥ ekena dharmeṇa darśayitum na śaknuyāt atas na saṃśaya hetuḥ syāt dvayoḥ dharmayoḥ aniyatam bhāvam darśayan saṃśaya hetuḥ dvayoḥ tu aniyatam api bhāvam darśayitum aśaktaḥ apratipatti hetuḥ niyatam tu bhāvam darśayan samyak hetuḥ viruddhaḥ vā syāt tasmāt yābhyām sarvam vastu saṃgṛhyate tayoḥ saṃśaya hetuḥ yadi tayoḥ ekatra api sadbhāva niścayaḥ na syāt sadbhāva niścaye tu yadi ekatra niyata sattā niścayaḥ hetuḥ viruddhaḥ vā syāt aniyata sattā niścaye tu sādhāraṇā anaikāntikaḥ

sandigdha vipakṣa vyāvṛttikaḥ sandigdha anvayaḥ asiddha vyatirekaḥ vā syāt ekatra api tu vṛtti aniścayāt asādhāraṇa anaikāntikaḥ bhavati tatas asādhāraṇa anaikāntikasya anaikāntika tve hetu dvayam darśayitum āha ) na hi iti saha ātmanā varttate sa ātmakaḥ niṣkrāntaḥ ātmā yasmāt sa nirātmakaḥ tābhyām yasmāt na anyaḥ rāśiḥ asti kiṃbhūtaḥ yatra ayam vastu dharmaḥ prāṇādiḥ vartteta tasmāt ayam tayoḥ bhavati saṃśaya hetuḥ

kasmāt anya rāśya bhāvaḥ iti āha ātmanaḥ vṛttiḥ sadbhāvaḥ vyavacchedaḥ abhāvaḥ tābhyām sarvasya vastunaḥ saṃgrahāt kroḍīkaraṇāt yatra hi ātmā asti tat sa ātmakam anyat nirātmakam tatas na anyaḥ rāśiḥ asti iti saṃśaya hetutva kāraṇam

prakārābhyām sarva vastu saṅgraham pratipādya dvitīyam āha na api anayoḥ sa ātmakān ātmakayoḥ madhye ekatra sa ātmake anātmake vā vṛtteḥ sadbhāvasya niścayaḥ asti dvau api rāśī tyaktvā na varttate prāṇa ādiḥ vastu dharma tvāt tatas ca anayoḥ eva varttate iti etāvat eva jñātam viśeṣe tu vṛtti niścayaḥ na asti iti ayam arthaḥ

tat āha sa ātmaka tvenā anātmaka tvena vā viśeṣeṇa yukte prasiddhe niścite vastuni prāṇa ādeḥ dharmasya sarva vastu vyāpinoḥ prakārayoḥ ekatra niyata sadbhāvasya asiddheḥ anaikāntikaḥ aniścita tvāt tat evam asādhāraṇasya dharmasya anaikāntika tve kāraṇa dvayam abhihitam

pakṣa dharmaḥ ca bhavan sarvaḥ sādhāraṇaḥ asādhāraṇaḥ vā bhavati anaikāntikaḥ tasmāt upasaṃhāra vyājena pakṣa dharma tvam darśayati tasmāt ityādinā jīvat śarīrasya sambandhī pakṣa dharmaḥ iti arthaḥ yasmāt tayoḥ ekatra api na nivṛtti niścayaḥ tasmāt tābhyām na vyatiricyate vastu dhame hi sarva vastu vyāpinoḥ prakārayoḥ ekatra niyata sadbhāvaḥ niścitaḥ prakāra antarāt nivartteta atas eva āha sa ātmakādana ātmakāt ca sarvasmāt vastunaḥ vyāvṛtta tvena asiddha īrita prāṇa ādiḥ tāvat kutaścid ghaṭa ādeḥ nivṛttaḥ eva tatas etāvat avasātum śakyam sa ātmakāt ana ātmakāt vā kiyataḥ nivṛttaḥ sarvasmāt tu nivṛttaḥ na avasīyate tatas na kutaścid vyatirekaḥ
yadi evam anvayaḥ astu tayoḥ niścitaḥ iti āha na tatra sa ātmake anātmake vā arthenveti anvayavān prāṇa ādiḥ

kutas iti āha eka ātmani api iti eka ātmani sa ātmake anātmake vā asiddheḥ kāraṇāt vastu dharma tayā tayoḥ dvayoḥ ekatra vā varttate iti avasitaḥ prāṇa ādiḥ na tu sa ātmakaḥ eva nirātmakaḥ eva vā varttate iti kutas anvaya niścayaḥ

nanu ca prativādinaḥ na kiñcat sa ātmakam asti tatas asya hetoḥ na sa ātmake anvayaḥ na vyatirekaḥ iti anvaya vyatirekayoḥ abhāva niścayaḥ sa ātmake na tu sadbhāva saṃśayaḥ iti āśaṅkya āha na api sa ātmakāt vastunaḥ tasya prāṇa ādeḥ anvaya vyatirekayoḥ abhāva niścayaḥ na api ca nirātmakāt sa ātmakādana ātmakāt iti ca pañcamī vyatireka śabda apekṣayā draṣṭavyā

katham anvaya vyatirekayoḥ na abhāva niścayaḥ iti āha ekasya anvayasya vyatirekasya vā yaḥ abhāva niścayaḥ saḥ aparasya dvitīyasya bhāva niścayana āntarīyakaḥ bhāva niścayasya avyabhicārī tasya bhāvaḥ tattvam tasmāt yatas eka abhāva niścayaḥ aparabhāva niścaya na antarīyakaḥ tasmāt na dvayoḥ ekatra abhāva niścayaḥ

kasmāt punar ekasya abhāva niścayaḥ apara sadbhāva niścayā avyabhicārī iti āha anvaya vyatirekayoḥ anyonya vyavacheda rūpa tvāt iti anyonyasya vyavacchedaḥ abhāvaḥ saḥ eva rūpam yayoḥ tayoḥ bhāvaḥ tattvam tasmāt kāraṇāt anvaya vyatirekau bhāva abhāvau bhāva abhāvau ca paraspara vyavaccheda rūpau yasya vyavacchedena yat paricchidyate tat tad parihāreṇa vyavasthitam svābhāva vyavacchedena ca bhāvaḥ paricchidyate

tasmāt svābhāva vyavacchedena bhāvaḥ vyavasthitaḥ abhāvaḥ hi nīrūpaḥ yādṛśaḥ vikalpena darśitaḥ nīrūpa tām ca vyavacchidya rūpam ākāra vat paricchidyate tathā ca sati anvaya abhāvaḥ vyatirekaḥ vyatireka abhāvaḥ ca anvayaḥ tatas anvaya abhāve niścite vyatirekaḥ niścitaḥ bhavati vyatireka abhāve ca niścite anvayaḥ niścitaḥ bhavati

tasmāt yadi nāma sā ātmakam avastu nirātmakam ca vastu tathā api tayoḥ na prāṇa ādeḥ anvaya vyatirekayoḥ abhāva niścayaḥ ekatra vastuni ekasya vastunaḥ yugapad bhāva abhāva virodhāt tayoḥ abhāva niścaya ayogāt na ca prativādi anurodhāt sa ātmakān ātmake vastunī sadasatī kintu pramāṇa anurodhāt iti ubhe sandigdhe tatas tayoḥ prāṇa ādimattvasya sat asattva saṃśayaḥ

yatas eva kvacid anvaya vi atirekayoḥ na bhāva niścayaḥ na api abhāva niścayaḥ tatas eva anvaya vyatirekayoḥ sandehaḥ yadi tu kvacid a pi anvaya vyatirekayoḥ ekasya api abhāva niścayaḥ syāt saḥ eva dvitīyasya bhāva niścayaḥ iti anvaya vyatireka sandehaḥ eva na syāt yatas ca na kvacid bhāva abhāva niścayaḥ tatas eva anvaya vyatirekayoḥ sandehaḥ sandehāt ca anaikāntikaḥ

kasmāt anaikāntikaḥ iti āha sādhyasya itarasya ca viruddhasya atas sandigdha anvaya yatirekāt niścaya abhāvāt sa pakṣa vipakṣayoḥ hi sat asattva sandehe na sādhyasya na viruddhasya siddhiḥ na ca sa ātmakān ātmakābhyām paraḥ prakāraḥ saṃbhavati tatas prāṇa ādimattvāt dharmiṇi jīvat śarīre saṃśayaḥ ātma bhāva abhāvayoḥ iti anaikāntikaḥ prāṇa ādiḥ iti

trayāṇām rūpāṇām asiddhau sandehe ca hetu doṣān upapādya upasaṃharan āha evam iti anantara uktena krameṇa eṣām madhye ekaikam rūpam yadā asiddham sandigdham vā bhavati dve dve vā asiddhe saṃdigdhe vā bhavataḥ tadā asiddhaḥ ca viruddhaḥ ca anaikāntikaḥ ca te hetvābhāsāḥ yathāyogam iti yasya asiddhau saṃdehe vā yaḥ hetvābhāsaḥ yujyate sa tasyāḥ asiddheḥ saṃdehāt ca vyavasthāpyate iti yasya yasya yena yena yogaḥ yathāyogam iti

nanu cā aacāryeṇa viruddha avyabhicārī api saṃśaya hetuḥ uktaḥ hetu antara sādhitasya viruddham yat tat na vyabhicarati iti viruddha avyabhicārī yadi vā viruddhaḥ ca asau sādhana antara siddhasya dharmasya viruddha sādhanāt avyabhicārī ca svasādhya avyabhicārāt viruddha avyabhicārī

satyam uktaḥ ācāryeṇa mayā tu iha na uktaḥ kasmāt iti āha anumānasya viṣayaḥ pramāṇa siddham trairūpyam yatas hi anumāna sambhavaḥ saḥ anumānasya viṣayaḥ pramāṇa siddhāt ca trairūpyāt anumāna sambhavaḥ tasmāt tat eva anumāna viṣayaḥ tasmin prakrānte na viruddha avyabhicāri sambhavaḥ prāmāṇa siddhe hi trairūpye prastute saḥ eva hetvābhāsaḥ sambhabati yasya pramāṇa siddham rūpam na ca viruddha avyabhicāriṇaḥ pramāṇa siddham asti rūpam atas na sambhavaḥ tatas asambhavāt na uktaḥ

kasmāt asaṃbhavaḥ iti āha na hi iti yasmāt na sambhavaḥ asti viruddha tāyāḥ kārya ca svabhāvaḥ ca tayoḥ ukta lakṣaṇayoḥ iti kāryasya kāraṇāt janma lakṣaṇam tattvam svamāvasya ca sādhya vyāpta tvam tattvam yat kāryam yaḥ ca svabhāvaḥ sa katham ātma vāraṇam vyāpakam ca svabhāvam parityajya bhavet yena viruddhaḥ syāt anupalambhasya ca ukta lakṣaṇasya iti dṛśya anupalambha tvam ca anupalambha lakṣaṇam tasya api vastu abhāva avyabhicāri tvāt na viruddha tva sambhavaḥ
syāt etat etebhyaḥ anyaḥ bhaviṣyati iti āha na ca anyaḥ etebhyaḥ avyabhicārī tribhyaḥ atas eva eṣu eva hetu tvam

kva tarhi ācārya dignāgena ayam hetu dopaḥ uktaḥ iti āha yasmāt vastu bala pravṛtte anumāne na sambhavati tasmāt āgama āśrayam anumānam āśritya vyabhicāri uktaḥ āgama siddham hi yasya anumānasya liṅga trairūpyam tasya āgamaḥ āśrayaḥ nanu ca āgama siddham api trairūpyam pramāṇa siddham iti āha avastu darśana bala pravṛttam iti avastunaḥ darśanam vikalpa mātram tasya balam sāmarthyam tatas pravṛttam apramāṇāt vikalpa mātrāt vyavasthitam trairūpyam āgama siddham anumānasya na tu pramāṇāt tat tarhi anumāna mā āgama siddha trairūpyam kva adhikṛtam iti āha tad artha iti tasya āgamasya yaḥ arthaḥ atīndriyaḥ pratyakṣa anumāna abhyām aviṣayīkṛtaḥ sāmānya ādiḥ tasya vicāreṣu prakrānteṣu āgama āśrayam anumānam sambhavati tad āśrayaḥ viruddha avyabhicāri uktaḥ ācāryeṇa iti

kasmāt punar āgama āśraye pyanumāne sambhavaḥ iti āha śāstra kṛtām viparītasya vastu viruddhasya svabhāvasya upasaṃhāraḥ ḍhaukanam artheṣu tasya saṃbhavāt viruddha avyabhicāri sambhavaḥ bhrāntyā iti viparyāsena viparyastāḥ hi śāstra kārāḥ santam asantam svabhāvam āropayanti iti

yadi śāstra kṛtaḥ api bhrāntāḥ anyeṣu api puruṣeṣu kaḥ āśvāsaḥ iti āha na hi iti na hetuṣu kalpanayā hetu tva vyavasthā api tu vastu sthityā tatas yathā avasthita vastu sthitiṣu ātma kāryānupalambheṣu asya sambhavaḥ na asti avasthitam parama artha sat vastu tad anatikrāntāḥ yathā avasthitāḥ vastu sthitiḥ vyavasthāḥ yeṣām te yathā avasthita vastu sthitayaḥ te hi yathā vastu sthitam tathā sthitāḥ na kalpanayā tatas teṣu na bhrānteḥ avakāśaḥ asti yena viruddha avyabhicāri sambhavaḥ syāt

tatra viruddha avyabhicāriṇī udāharaṇam yat sarvasmin deśe avasthitaiḥ sva sambandhibhiḥ yugapad abhisambadhyate iti sarva deśa avasthitarabhi sambadhyamāna tvam sāmānyasya anūdya sarva gata tvam vidhīyate tena yugapad abhisambadhyamāna tvam sarva gata tve niyatam tena vyāptam kathyate iha sāmānyam kaṇāda mahā ṛṣiṇā niṣkriyam dṛśyam ekam ca uktam yugapad ca sarvaiḥ svaiḥ sambandhibhiḥ samavāyena saṃbaddham tatra pailukena kaṇāda śiṣyeṇa vyaktiṣu vyakti rahiteṣu ca deśeṣu sāmānyam sthitam sādhayitum pramāṇam idam upanyastam yathā ākāśam iti vyāpti pradarśana viṣayaḥ dṛṣṭāntaḥ ākāśam api hi sarva deśa avasthitaiḥ vṛkṣa ādibhiḥ sva saṃyogibhiḥ yugapad abhisambadhyamānam sarva gatam ca abhisambadhyate ca sarva deśa avasthitaiḥ sva sambandhibhiḥ iti hetoḥ pakṣa dharma tva pradarśanam

asya svabhāva hetu tvam yojayitum āha tad sambandhī iti teṣām sarva deśa avasthitānām dravyāṇām sambandhī sāmānyasya svabhāvaḥ saḥ eva tad sambandhi svabhāva mātram tad anubadhnāti iti tad anubandhinī kā asau iti āha tad deśa saṃ nihita svabhāva tā teṣām sambandhinām deśaḥ tad deśaḥ tad deśe sannihitaḥ svabhāvaḥ yasya tat tad deśa saṃnihita svabhāvam tasya bhāvaḥ tat tā yasya hi yeṣām sambandhī svabhāvaḥ tat niyamena teṣām deśe sannihitam bhavati tatas tad sambandhitva anubandhinī tad deśa saṃnihita tā sāmānyasya

nanu ca gavām sambandhī svāmī na ca go deśe sannihita svabhāvaḥ tat kartham tad sambandhi tvāt tad deśa tvam iti āha na hi iti yaḥ yatra deśe na asti sa deśaḥ yasya sa tad deśaḥ tam na vyāpnoti ātmanā sva rūpeṇa iha sāmānyasya tadvatām ca samavāya lakṣaṇaḥ sambandhaḥ sa ca abhinna deśayoḥ eva tena yatra yat samavetam tat tad ātmī na rūpeṇa kroḍīkurvat samavāyi rūpa deśe sva ātmānam niveśayati

tad deśa rūpa niveśanam eva tad kroḍīkaraṇam tatas tad samavāyaḥ tasmāt yat yatra samavetam tat tat dravyam vyāpnu vat ātmanā tad deśe saṃ nihitam bhavati tat ayam arthaḥ tad deśa stha vastu vyāpanam tad deśa sattayā vyāptam tad deśa sattā abhāve tad vyāpana abhāvāt vyāpana lakṣaṇa samavāya saṃmbandhaḥ na syāt asti ca vyāpanam atas tad deśe sannihita tvam iti tat ayam svabhāva hetuḥ

paiṭhara prayogam darśayan āha dvitīyaḥ api iti yat upalabdheḥ lakṣaṇa tām viṣaya tām prāptam dṛśyam iti arthaḥ etena dṛśya anupalabdhim anūdya na tat tatra asti iti asat vyavahārya tvam vihitam tatas vyāpi adṛśya anupalabdheḥ vyāpakam asat vyavahārya tvam darśitam tat yathā iti kvacid asan ghaṭaḥ dṛṣṭāntaḥ pakṣa dharma tvam darśayitum āha na upalabhyate ca iti vyakti antarālam vyakti antaram ca vyakti śūnyam ca ākāśam dṛśyam api kasyāṃcid vyaktau go sāmānyam aśva ādiṣu vyakti antareṣu vyakti śūnye ca ākāśe na upalabhyate tasmāt na teṣu asti iti gamyate

ayam anupalambhaḥ pūrva uktaḥ ca svabhāvaḥ parasparasya viruddhau yau arthau tayoḥ sādhanāt tau ekasmin dharmiṇi saṃśayam janayataḥ na hi ekaḥ arthaḥ paraspara viruddha svabhāvaḥ bhavitum arhati ekena ca atra vyakti antareṣu vyakti śūnye ca ākāśe sattvam apareṇa ca anupalambhena asattvam sādhyate na ca ekasya ekadā ekatra sattvam asattvam ca yuktam tayoḥ virodhāt tad āgama siddhasya sāmānyasya sarva gata tva asarva gata tvayoḥ sādhyayoḥ etau viruddha avyabhicāriṇau jātau yatas sāmānyasya ekasya yugapad sarva deśa avasthitaiḥ abhisambandhi tvam ca abhyupagatam dṛśya tvam ca tatas sarva sambandhi tvāt sarva gata tvam dṛśya tvāt antarālāt anupalambhāt asarva gata tvam tatas śāstra kāreṇa eva viruddha vyāpta tvam apaśyatā viruddha vyāptau dharmau uktvā viruddha avyabhicārya vakāśaḥ dattaḥ iti na ca vastuni asya sambhavaḥ iti uktāḥ hetvābhāsāḥ

nanu ca sādhana avayava tvāt yathā hetavaḥ uktāḥ tad prasaṅgena ca hetvābhāsāḥ tathā sādhana avayava tvāt dṛṣṭāntāḥ vaktavyāḥ tad prasaṅgena ca dṛṣṭānta ābhāsāḥ tat katham na uktāḥ iti āha trirūpaḥ hetuḥ uktaḥ tat kim dṛṣṭāntaiḥ syāt etat tāvatā na artha pratītiḥ iti āha tāvatā ca iti ukta lakṣaṇena eva hetunā bhavati sādhya pratītiḥ atas saḥ eva gamakaḥ tatas tat vacanam eva sādhanam na dṛṣṭāntaḥ nāma na adhanasya avayavaḥ yatas ca ayam na avayavaḥ tena na asya dṛṣṭāntasya lakṣaṇam hetu lakṣaṇāt pṛthak ucyate

katham tarhi hetoḥ vyāpti niścayaḥ yadi adṛṣṭāntakaḥ hetuḥ iti ced na ucyate hetuḥ adṛṣaṭa antakaḥ eva api tu na hetoḥ pṛthak dṛṣṭāntaḥ nāma hetu antarbhūtaḥ eva dṛṣṭāntaḥ atas eva uktam na asya lakṣaṇam pṛthak ucyate iti na tu evam uktam na asya lakṣaṇam ucyate iti yadi evam hetu upayoginaḥ api lakṣaṇam vaktavyam eva iti āha gata artha tvāt gataḥ arthaḥ prayojanam abhidheyam vā yasya dṛṣṭānta lakṣaṇasya tat tathā tasya bhāvaḥ tattvam tasmāt dṛṣṭānta lakṣaṇam hi acyate dṛṣṭānta pratītiḥ yathā syāt dṛṣṭāntaḥ ca hetu lakṣaṇāt eva avasitaḥ tatas dṛṣṭānta lakṣaṇasya yat prayojanam dṛṣṭānta pratītiḥ tat gatam niṣpannam abhidheyam vā gatam jñātam dṛṣṭānta ākhyam

katham gata artha tvam iti āha hetoḥ rūpam uktam abhedena sāmānyena sādhāraṇam kārya svabhāva anupalambhānām etat lakṣaṇam iti arthaḥ kim punar tat sa pakṣaḥ eva yat sattvam vipakṣāt ca sarvasmāt vyāvṛttiḥ yā rūpa dvayam etat abhedena uktam na ca sāmānyam uktam api śakyam jñātum atas tat eva viśeṣa niṣṭham vaktavyam atas punar api viśeṣeṇa viśeṣavantau janma tanmātra anubandhau darśanīyau uktau kāryasya janma jñātavyam uktam janmani hi jñāte kāryasya sa pakṣaḥ eva sattvam vipakṣāt ca sarvasmāt vyāvṛttiḥ jñātā bhavati svabhāvasya tanmātra anubandhaḥ darśanīyaḥ uktaḥ tat iti sādhanam tat eva tanmātram sādhana mātram tasya anubandhaḥ anugamanam sādhana mātrasya bhāve bhāvaḥ sādhyasya tanmātra bhāvi tvam eva hi sādhyasya tādātmyam sādhanasya yadā svabhāvaḥ jñātaḥ bhavati tadā svabhāva hetoḥ sa pakṣaḥ eva sattvam vipakṣāt ca sarvasmāt vyāvṛttiḥ jñātā bhavati

tat evam sāmānya lakṣaṇam viśeṣa ātmakam jñātavyam na anyathā tatas viśeṣa lakṣaṇam uktam kim atas yadi nāma eva miti āha tat ca sāmānya lakṣaṇam darśayitu kāmena viśeṣa lakṣaṇam darśayata evam darśanīyam iti sambandhaḥ yatra dhūmaḥ tatra agniḥ iti kārya hetaḥ vyāptiḥ daśitā vyāptiḥ ca kārya kāraṇa bhāva sādhanāt pramāṇān niścīyate tatas yathā mahānasaḥ iti darśanīyam asati agnau na bhavati eva dhūmaḥ iti vyatirekaḥ darśitaḥ sa ca yathā itarasmin iti darśanīyaḥ vahni nivṛttiḥ hi dhūma nivṛttau niyatā darśanīyā sā ca mahān asāt itaratra iti darśanīyā
