yatra kṛtaka tvam tatra anitya tvam iti svabhāva hetoḥ vyāptiḥ darśitā anitya tva abhāve na bhavati eva kṛtaka tvam iti vyatirekaḥ darśitaḥ vyāpteḥ ca sādhakam pramāṇam sādharmya dṛṣṭānte darśanīyam prasiddha vyāptikasya ca hetoḥ sādhya nivṛttau nivṛttiḥ niyatā darśanīyā tat avaśyam yathā ghaṭe yathā ākāśe ca iti darśanīyam

kasmāt evam iti āha na hi iti yasmāt anyathā sāmānya lakṣaṇa rūpe sa pakṣa vipakṣayoḥ sat asat tve yathā ukta prakāre iti niyate sa pakṣaḥ eva sattvam vipakṣe asattvam eva iti niyamaḥ yathā ukta prakāraḥ te na śakye darśayitum viśeṣa lakṣaṇe hi darśite yathā ukta prakāre sat asat tve darśite bhavataḥ na ca viśeṣa lakṣaṇam anyathā śakyam darśayitum

tasya sādhyasya kāryam tat kāryam dhūmaḥ tasya bhāvaḥ tad kārya tā sā eva niyamaḥ yatas tad kārya tayā dhūmaḥ dahane niyataḥ saḥ ayam tad kāryatā niyamaḥ viśeṣa lakṣaṇa rūpaḥ anyatha darśayitum aśakyaḥ svabhāva liṅgasya ca svabhāvena sādhyena vyāptiḥ viśeṣa lakṣaṇa rūpā na śakyāḥ darśayitum yasmāt kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ tādātmyam ca mahānase ghaṭe ca jñātavyam tasmāt vyāpti sādhanam pramāṇam darśayatā sādharmya dṛṣṭāntaḥ darśanīyaḥ vaidharmya dṛṣṭāntaḥ tu prasiddhe tad kārya tve kāraṇa abhāve kārya abhāva pratipatti artham tatas eva na avaśyam vastu bhavati kāraṇa abhāve kārya abhāvaḥ vastuni avastuni vā bhavati tatas vastu avastu vā vaidharmya dṛṣṭāntaḥ iṣyate

tasmāt dṛṣṭāntam antareṇa na hetoḥ anvayaḥ vyatirekaḥ vā śakyaḥ darśayitum atas hetu rūpa ākhyānāt eva hetoḥ vyāpti sādhanasya pramāṇasya darśakaḥ sādharmya dṛṣṭāntaḥ prasiddha vyāptikasya sādhya abhāve hetu abhāva pradarśanāt vaidharmya dṛṣṭānte upādeyaḥ iti ca darśitam bhavati asmin ca arthe darśite darśitaḥ eva dṛṣṭāntaḥ bhavati yaḥ ayam arthaḥ vyāpti sādhana pramāṇa pradarśanaḥ kaścid upādeyaḥ nivṛtti pradarśana śca iti asmin arthe darśite darśitaḥ dṛṣṭāntaḥ iti āha etāvat mātram rūpam yasya tasya bhāvaḥ tattvam tasmāt iti etāvat eva hi rūpam dṛṣṭāntasya yat uta vyāpti sādhana pramāṇa pradarśaka tvam nāma sādharmya dṛṣṭāntasya prasiddha vyāptikasya ca sādhya nivṛttau sādhana nivṛtti pradarśaka tvam iti eta dvaidharmya dṛṣṭāntasya etat ca hetu rūpa ākhyānāt eva ākhyātam iti kim dṛṣṭānta lakṣaṇena

etena eva ca hetu rūpa ākhyānāt dṛṣṭānta tva pradarśanena dṛṣṭānta doṣāḥ dṛṣṭānta ābhāsāḥ kathitāḥ bhavanti tathā hi pūrva ukta siddhaye yaḥ upādīyamānaḥ api dṛṣṭāntaḥ na samarthaḥ sva kāryam sādhayitum sa dṛṣṭānta doṣaḥ iti sāmarthyāt uktam bhavati

dṛṣṭānta ābhāsām udāharati yathā nityaḥ śabdaḥ iti śabdasya nitya tve sādhye amūrta tvāt iti hetuḥ sādharmyeṇa karma vat paramāṇu vat ghaṭa vat iti ete dṛṣṭāntāḥ upanyastāḥ ete ca dṛṣṭānta doṣāḥ sādhyam ca sādhanam ca ubhayam ca iti taiḥ vikalāḥ sādhya vikalam karma tasyāḥ anitya tvāt sādhana vikalaḥ paramāṇuḥ mūrtta tvāt paramāṇūnām a asarva gata dravya parimāṇam mūrttiḥ asarva gatāḥ ca dravya rūpāḥ ca paramāṇavaḥ nityāḥ tu vaiśeṣikaiḥ iṣyante tatas na sādhya vikalaḥ ghaṭaḥ tu ubhaya vikalaḥ anitya tvāt mūrtta tvāt ca ghaṭasya iti

tathā saṃdigdhaḥ sādhya dharmaḥ yasmin sa saṃdigdha sādhya dharmaḥ saḥ ādiḥ yeṣām te tathā uktāḥ saṃdigdha sādhya dharmaḥ saṃdigdha sādhana dharmaḥ saṃdigdha ubhayaḥ udāharaṇam rāga ādimān iti rāga ādimat tvam sādhyam vacanāt iti hetuḥ rathyā puruṣa vat iti dṛṣṭānte rāga ādimattvam sandigdham maraṇam dharmaḥ asya iti maraṇa dharmā tasya bhāvaḥ maraṇa dharma tvam sādhyam ayam puruṣaḥ iti dharmī rāga ādimattvāt iti hetuḥ rathyā puruṣe dṛṣṭānte sandigdham sādhanam sādhyam tu niścitam maraṇa dharma tvam iti asarvajñaḥ iti asarvajña tvam sādhyam rāga ādimattvāt iti hetuḥ tat ubhayam api rathyā puruṣe dṛṣṭānte sandigdham asarvajña tvam rāga ādimattvam ca iti

tathā ananvayaḥ iti yasmin dṛṣṭānte sādhya sādhanayoḥ sambhava mātram dṛśyate na tu sādhyena vyāptaḥ hetuḥ saḥ ananvayaḥ apradarśita anvayaḥ ca yasmin dṛṣṭānte vidyamānaḥ api anvayaḥ na pradarśitaḥ vaktrā saḥ apradarśita anvayaḥ ananvayam udāharati yathā iti yaḥ vaktā iti vaktṛ tvam anūdya sa rāga ādimān iti rāga ādimat tvam vihitam tatas vaktṛ tvasya rāga ādimattvam pratiniyamaḥ tena vyāptiḥ uktā iṣṭa puruṣa vat iti iṣṭa grahaṇena prativādi api saṃgṛhyate vādī api tena vaktṛ tva rāga ādimattvayoḥ sattva mātram iṣṭe puruṣe siddham vyāptiḥ tu na siddhā tenā ananvayaḥ dṛṣṭāntaḥ iti anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti anitya tvam sādhyam kṛtaka tvāt iti hetuḥ ghaṭa vat iti dṛṣṭānte na pradarśitaḥ anvayaḥ

iha yadi api kṛtaka tvena ghaṭa sadṛśaḥ śabdaḥ tathā api na anitya tvena api sadṛśaḥ pratyetum śakyate ati prasaṅgāt yadi tu kṛtaka tvam anitya svabhāvam vijñātam bhavati evam kṛtaka tvāt anitya tva pratītiḥ syāt tasmāt yat kṛtakam tat anityam iti kṛtaka tvam anitya tve niyatam abhidhāya niyama sādhanāya anvaya vākya artha pratipatti viṣayaḥ dṛṣṭānte upādeyaḥ sa ca pradarśita anvayaḥ eva anena tu anvaya vākyam anuktvā eva dṛṣṭāntaḥ upāttar īdṛśaḥ ca sādharmya mātreṇa eva upayogī na ca sādharmyāt sādhya siddhiḥ atas anvaya arthaḥ dṛṣṭāntaḥ tad arthaḥ ca anena na upāttar sādharmya arthaḥ ca upāttaḥ nirupayogaḥ iti vaktṛ doṣāt ayam dṛṣṭānta doṣaḥ vaktrā hi atra paraḥ pratipādayitavyaḥ tatas yadi nāma na duṣṭam vastu tathā api vaktrā duṣṭam darśitam iti duṣṭam eva

tathā viparītaḥ anvayaḥ yasmin dṛṣṭānte sa tathā uktaḥ tam eva udāharati yat anityam tat kṛtakam iti kṛtaka tvam anitya tva niyatam dṛṣṭānte darśanīyam evam kṛtaka tvāt anitya tva gatiḥ syāt atra tu anitya tvam kṛtaka tve niyatam darśitam kṛtaka tvam tu aniyatam eva anitya tve tatas yādṛśam iha kṛtaka tvam aniyatam anitya tve darśitam tādṛśāt na asti anitya tva pratītiḥ tathā hi yat anityam iti anitya tvam anūdya tat kṛtakam iti kṛtaka tvam vihitam atas anitya tvam niyatam uktam kṛtaka tve na tu kṛtaka tvam anitya tve tatas yathā anitya tvāt aniyatāt prayatna anantarīyaka tve na prayatna anantarīyaka tva pratītiḥ tadvat kṛtaka tvāt anitya tva pratipattiḥ na syāt anitya tve aniyata tvāt kṛtaka tvasya yadi api ca kṛtaka tvam vastu sthityā anitya tve niyatam tathā api aniyatam vaktrā darśitam atas svayam aduṣṭam api vaktṛ doṣāt duṣṭam tasmāt viparīta anvayaḥ api vaktuḥ aparādhāt na vastutas para artha anumāne ca vaktuḥ api doṣaḥ cintyate iti
sādharmyeṇa nava dṛṣṭānta doṣāḥ uktāḥ

vaidharmyeṇa api dṛṣṭānta doṣān vaktum āha nitya tve śabdasya sādhye hetau amūrtta tve paramāṇuḥ vaidharmya dṛṣṭāntaḥ sādhyāvyatirekī nitya tvāt paramāṇūnām karma sādhana avyatireki amūrtta tvāt karmaṇaḥ ākāśam ubhaya avyatireki nitya tvāt amūrtta tvāt ca sādhyam ādiḥ yeṣām tāni sādhya ādīni sādhya sādhana ubhayāni teṣām avyatirekaḥ nivṛtti abhāvaḥ sa yeṣām asti te sādhyādi a vyatirekiṇaḥ te ca udāhṛtāḥ

aparān udāha rttum āha tathā iti sādhyasya vyatirekaḥ sādhya vyatirekaḥ saṃdigdhaḥ sādhya vyatirekaḥ yasmin sa saṃdigdha sādhya vyatirekaḥ saḥ ādiḥ yeṣām te tathā uktāḥ saṃdigdha sādhya vyatirekam udāha rttum āha yathā iti asarva jñāḥ iti ekam sādhyam anāptāḥ akṣīṇa doṣāḥ iti dvitīyam kapila ādayaḥ iti dharmīm avidyamāna sarvajña tā ityādi hetuḥ sarvajña tā ca āpta tā ca tayoḥ liṅga bhūtaḥ pramāṇa atiśayaḥ liṅga ātmakaḥ pramāṇa viśeṣaḥ avidyamānaḥ sarvajña tā āpta tā liṅga bhūtaḥ pramāṇa atiśayaḥ yasmin tat tathā uktam śāsanam tādṛśam śāsanam yeṣām te tathā uktāḥ teṣām bhāvaḥ tattvam tasmāt pramāṇa atiśayaḥ jyotiḥ jñāna upadeśaḥ iha abhipretaḥ yadi hi kapila ādayaḥ sarva jñāḥ āptāḥ vā syuḥ tadā jyotiḥ jñāna ādikam kasmāt na upadiṣṭavantaḥ na ca upadiṣṭavantaḥ tasmāt na sarva jñā āptā vā

atra pramāṇe vaidharmya udāharaṇam yaḥ sarvajña āptaḥ vā sa jyotiḥ jñāna ādikam sarvajña tā āpta tā āliṅga bhūtam upadiṣṭavān yathā ṛṣabhaḥ vardhamānaḥ ca tauvādī yasya saḥ ṛṣabha vardhamāna ādiḥ digambarāṇām śāstā sarvajñaḥ ca āptaḥ ca iti tat iha vaidharmya udāharaṇāt ṛṣabha ādeḥ a sarvajña tvasya anāpta tāyāḥ ca vyatirekaḥ vyāvṛttiḥ saṃdigdhā yatas jyotiḥ jñānam ca upadiśet asarva jñāḥ ca bhavet anāptā vā kaḥ atra virodhaḥ naimittikam etat jñānam vyabhicāri na sarvajña tvam anumāpayet

sandigdhaḥ sādhana vyatirekaḥ yasmin sa tathā uktaḥ tam udāharati yathā iti ṛc sāmayajaṃṣi trīṇi trayī tām vetti iti trayī vid tena na grāhyam vacanam yasya iti sādhyam vivakṣitaḥ iti kapilādiḥ dharmī rāga ādimattvāt iti hetuḥ atra pramāṇe vaidharmya udāharaṇam sādhya abhāvaḥ sādhana abhāvena yatra vyāptaḥ darśyate tat vaidharmya udāharaṇam grāhyam vacanam yeṣām te grāhya vacanāḥ iti sādhya nivṛttim anūdya na te rāga ādi mante iti sādhana abhāvaḥ vihitaḥ gautamaḥ ādiḥ yeṣām te tathā uktāḥ manu ādayaḥ dharma śāstrāṇi smṛtayaḥ teṣām karttāraḥ trayī vidā hi brāhmaṇena grāhya vacanāḥ dharma śāstra kṛtaḥ vīta rāgāḥ ca te iti iha dharmī vyatireka viṣayaḥ gautama ādayaḥ iti gautama ādibhyaḥ rāga ādimattvasya sādhanasya nivṛttiḥ sandigdhā yadi api te grāhya vacanāḥ tra yīvidaḥ tathā api kim sa rāgāḥ uta vīta rāgāḥ iti sandehaḥ

sandigdhaḥ ubhayoḥ vyatirekaḥ yasmin sa tathā uktaḥ tam udāharati yathā iti avīta rāgāḥ iti rāga ādimat tvam sādhyam kapila ādayaḥ iti dharmī parigrahaḥ labhyamānasya svīkāraḥ prathamaḥ svīkārāt ūrdhvam yat gārdhyam mātsaryam saḥ āgrahaḥ parigrahaḥ ca āgrahaḥ ca tābhyām yogāt kapila ādayaḥ labhyamānam svīkurvanti svīkṛtam na muñcanti iti te rāga ādi mantaḥ gamyante atra pramāṇe vaidharmya udāharaṇam yatra sādhya abhāve sādhana abhāvaḥ darśayitavyaḥ yaḥ vīta rāgaḥ iti sādhya abhāvam anūdya na tasya parigraha agrahau iti sādhana abhāvaḥ vihitaḥ yathā ṛṣabha ādeḥ iti dṛṣṭāntaḥ etasmādṛ ṣabha ādeḥ dṛṣṭāntāt avīta rāga tvasya sādhyasya parigraha agraha yogasya ca sādhanasya nivṛttiḥ sandigdhā ṛṣabha ādīnām hi parigraha agraha yogaḥ api sandigdhaḥ vīta rāga tvam ca yadi nāma tad siddhānte vīta rāgāḥ ca niṣparigrahāḥ ca paṭhyante tathā api sandehaḥ eva

aparān api trīn udāharttum āha avidyamānaḥ vyatirekaḥ yasmin saḥ avyatirekaḥ avīta rāgaḥ iti rāga ādimat tvam sādhyam vaktṛ tvāt iti hetuḥ iha vyatirekam āha yatra avīta rāga tvam na asti iti sādhya abhāva anuvādaḥ tatra vaktṛ tvam api na asti iti sādhana abhāva vidhiḥ tena sādhana abhāvena sādhya abhāvaḥ vyāptaḥ uktaḥ dṛṣṭāntaḥ yathā upalakhaṇḍaḥ iti

katham avyamavyatirekaḥ yāvatā upala khaṇḍāt ubhayam nivṛttam kim atas yadi api upala khaṇḍāt ubhayam vyāvṛttam sa rāga tvam ca vaktṛ tvam ca tathā api vyāptyā vyatirekaḥ yaḥ tasyā asiddheḥ kāraṇāt avyatirekaḥ ayam kīdṛśī punar vyāptiḥ iti āha sarvaḥ vīta rāgaḥ iti sādhya abhāva anuvādaḥ na vaktā iti sādhana abhāva vidhiḥ tena sādhya abhāvaḥ sādhana abhāva niyataḥ khyāpitaḥ bhavati iti idṛśī vyāptiḥ tayā vyatirekaḥ na siddhaḥ asya ca arthasya prasiddhaye dṛṣṭāntaḥ tat sva kāryā akaraṇāt duṣṭaḥ

apradarśitaḥ vyatirekaḥ yasmin sa tathā uktaḥ anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti anitya tvam sādhyam kṛtaka tvāt iti hetuḥ ākāśa vat iti vaidharmyeṇa dṛṣṭāntaḥ iha para artha anumāne parasmāt arthaḥ pratipattavyaḥ sa śuddhaḥ api svatas yadi pareṇa aśuddhaḥ khyāpyate sa tāvat yathā prakāśitaḥ tathā na yuktaḥ yathā yuktaḥ tathā na prakāśitaḥ prakāśitaḥ ca hetuḥ atas vaktuḥ aparādhāt api para artha anumāne hetuḥ dṛṣṭāntaḥ vā duṣṭaḥ syāt api na ca sādṛśya avasādṛśyāt vā sādhya pratipattiḥ api tu sādhya niyatāt hetoḥ atas sādhya niyataḥ hetuḥ anvaya vākyena vyatireka vākyena vā vaktavyaḥ anyathā gamakaḥ na uktaḥ syāt sa tathā uktaḥ dṛṣṭāntena siddhaḥ darśayitavyaḥ tasmāt dṛṣṭāntaḥ nāma anvaya vyatireka vākya artha pradarśanaḥ na ca iha vyatireka vākyam prayuktam atas vaidharmya dṛṣṭāntaḥ iha āsādṛśya mātreṇa sādhakaḥ upanyastaḥ na ca tathā sādhakaḥ vyatireka viṣaya tvena sa sādhakaḥ ca na tathā upanyastaḥ iti ayam apradarśita vyatirekaḥ vaktuḥ aparādhāt duṣṭaḥ

viparītaḥ vyatirekaḥ yasmin vaidharmya dṛṣṭānte sa tathā uktaḥ tam udāharati yathā yat akṛtakam ityādi iha anvaya vyatirekābhyām sādhya niyataḥ hetuḥ darśayitavyaḥ yadā ca sādhya niyataḥ hetuḥ darśayitavyaḥ tadā vyatireka vākye sādhya abhāvaḥ sādhana abhāve niyataḥ darśayitavyaḥ evam hi hetuḥ sādhya niyataḥ darśitaḥ syāt yadi tu sādhya abhāvaḥ sādhana abhāve niyataḥ na ākhyāyate sādhana sattāyām api sādhya abhāvaḥ sambhāvyeta tathā ca sādhanam sādhya niyatam na pratīyeta tasmāt sādhya abhāvaḥ sādhana abhāve niyataḥ vaktavyaḥ viparīta vyatireke ca sādhana abhāvaḥ sādhya abhāve niyataḥ ucyate na sādhya abhāvaḥ sādhana abhāve tathā hi yat akṛtakam iti sādhana abhāvam anūdya tat nityam iti sādhya abhāva vidhiḥ tatas ayam arthaḥ akṛtakaḥ nityaḥ eva tathā ca sati akṛtaka tvam nitya tve sādhya abhāve niyatam uktam na nitya tvam sādhana abhāve tatas na sādhya niyatam hetum vyatireka vākyam āha tathā ca viparīta vyatirekaḥ api vaktuḥ aparādhāt duṣṭaḥ

dṛṣṭānta doṣān udāhṛtya duṣṭa tva nibandhana tvam darśayitum āha na hi ebhiḥ iti sādhya niyata hetu pradarśanāya hi dṛṣṭāntāḥ vaktavyāḥ ebhiḥ ca hetoḥ sa pakṣaḥ eva sattvam vipakṣe ca sarvatra asattvam eva yat sāmānya lakṣaṇam tat niścayena na śakyam darśayitum nanu ca sāmānya lakṣaṇam viśeṣa niṣṭham eva pratipattavyam na svatas eva iti āha viśeṣa lakṣaṇam vā yadi viśeṣa lakṣaṇam pratipādayitum śakyeta syāt eva sāmānya lakṣaṇa pratipattiḥ viśeṣa lakṣaṇam eva tu na śakyam ebhiḥ pratipādayitum tasmāt artha āpattyā sāmarthyena eṣām nirākaraṇam draṣṭavyam sādhya niyata sādhana pratītaye upāttāḥ tat asamarthāḥ duṣṭāḥ sva kārya akaraṇāt iti asāmarthyam iyatā sādhanam uktam
dūṣaṇam vaktum āha dūṣaṇā kā draṣṭavyā nyūna tā ādīnām uvitaḥ ucyate anayā iti uvitarvacanam nyūna tā ādeḥ vacanam

dūṣaṇam vivarītum āha ye pūrvam nyūna tā ādayaḥ asiddha viruddha anaikāntikāḥ uktāḥ teṣām udbhāvakam yat vacanam tat dūṣaṇam nanu ca nyūna tā ādayaḥ na viparyaya sādhanāḥ tat katham dūṣaṇam iti āha tena nyūna tā ādi vacanena pareṣa ām iṣṭaḥ ca asau arthaḥ ca tasya siddhiḥ niścayaḥ tasyāḥ pratibandhāt na avaśyam viparyaya sādhanāt eva dūṣaṇam viruddha vat api tu parasya abhipreta niścaya vibandhāt niścaya abhāvaḥ bhavati niścaya viparyayaḥ iti asti eva viparyaya siddhiḥ iti uktā dūṣaṇā
dūṣaṇa ābhāsāḥ iti dūṣaṇa vat ābhāsantaḥ iti dūṣaṇa ābhāsāḥ ke te jātayaḥ iti jāti śabdaḥ sādṛśya vacanaḥ uttara sadṛśāni jāti uttarāṇi uttara sthāna prayukta tvāt uttara sadṛśāni jāti uttarāṇi

tat eva uttara sādṛśyam uttara sthāna prayuktvena darśayitum āha abhūtasya asatyasya doṣasya udbhāvanāni udbhāvyate etaiḥ iti uddhāvanāni vacanāni tāni jāti uttarāṇi jātyā sādṛśyena uttarāṇi jāti uttarāṇi iti katipaya pada vastu vyākhyayā yat mayā āptam kuśalam amalam indoḥ aṃśu vat nyāya bindoḥ padam ajaram avāpya jñāna dharma uttaram yat jagat upakṛti mātra vyāpṛtiḥ syām ataḥ aham

ye cakṣuḥ ādi jñānasya ālambanam bāhya arthaḥ asti iti icchanti nanu te kalpayanti paramāṇūn tad kāraṇa tvāt jñānasya saṃghātam vā tad ābhajñānasya jāyamāna tvāt tatra tāvat yadi api indriya vijñapteḥ grāhya aṃśaḥ kāraṇam bhavet atad ābhatayā tasyāḥ na akṣa vat viṣayaḥ sa tu viṣayaḥ iti jñānena svarūpam eva nirdhāryate tad ākāratayā jāyamāna tvāt yadi api aṇavaḥ tad kāraṇam tathā api na tādṛśāḥ akṣa vat evañca na aṇavaḥ tāvat ālambanam

saṃghātaḥ tu tad ābha tve api jñānasya na ālambanam yatas yad ābhāsā na tasmāt sā yaḥ arthaḥ sva avabhāsi vijñaptim utpādayati sa hi ālambanam yujyate yatas saḥ eva hi utpatti pratyayaḥ ucyate saṃghātaḥ tu na evam dravya abhāvāt dvi candra vat indriya vaikalyāt dvi candra darśanasya tad ābha tve api na tasya viṣayaḥ asti tadvat saṃghātaḥ dravyataḥ asattvena akāraṇa tvāt na ālambanam evam bāhya dvayañca eva na yuktam mati gocaraḥ aṇuḥ kalāpaḥ ca iti bāhyaḥ arthaḥ na ālambanam eka aṅga vaikalyāt

tatra sādhanam sañcita ākāram icchanti kila kecana sarvaḥ arthaḥ bahu ākāraḥ atas tatra kenacid ākāreṇa pratyakṣaḥ iṣyate paramāṇuṣu api asti sañcita ābha jñāna utpatti kāraṇa bhāvaḥ aṇu ākāraḥ na vijñapteḥ arthaḥ kaṭhina tā ādi vat yathā kaṭhina tā ādi vidyamānam api na cākṣuṣa buddhi viṣayaḥ evam anutvam api

bhavet ghaṭa śarāva ādeḥ tathā sati samā matiḥ ghaṭa śarāva ādi paramāṇuṣu bahuṣu api na kaḥ api viśeṣaḥ asti ākāra bhedāt bhedaḥ ced yadi manyase grīvā ādi ākāraḥ viśeṣa kriyā yena buddheḥ viśeṣaṇam upādhiḥ bhavet iti ayam upādhiḥ ghaṭa ādau asti na asti tu dravya satyaṇau pramāṇa bheda abhāvāt saḥ paramāṇuṣu dravya antareṣu api pārimāṇḍalye bhedaḥ na asti adravye asti tatas sa hi ākāra bhedaḥ saṃvṛti satsu eva asti na tu paramāṇuṣu ghaṭa ādayaḥ ca saṃvṛtisantaḥ eva

aṇūnām parihāre hi tad ābhajñāna viplavāt dravya satsu apanīta sambandhiṣu api nīla varṇa ādi vat sva buddhiḥ na tyajyate tathā sati indriya buddhīnām viṣayaḥ bahis na asti iti upapadyate yat antar heya rūpam tu bahis vat avabhāsate saḥ arthaḥ bāhya arthe avidyamāne antassat eva bahis vat avabhāsanam ālambana pratyayaḥ vijñāna rūpa tvāt tat pratyaya tayā api ca antar vijñānam artha tayā avabhāsate tatas utpadyate ca iti dharma tā dvaya viśiṣṭam iti atas antassa deva ālambana pratyayaḥ

yadi tāvat evam avabhāsaḥ eva vedyate katham tat eka deśaḥ sahajātaḥ pratyayaḥ eka aṃśaḥ pratyayaḥ avītāt saha bhūtaḥ api avyabhicārāt anya jātasya pratyayaḥ bhavati naiyāyikāḥ tu evam āhuḥ krameṇa jāyamānayoḥ hetu hetumatoḥ bhava abhāva tadvat tā lakṣaṇam iti athavā śakti arpaṇāt krameṇa vā krameṇa api saḥ artha avabhāsaḥ sva anurūpa kārya utpattaye śaktim vijñāna ādhārām karoti iti avirodhaḥ

yadi tarhi svarūpam eva ālambana pratyayaḥ katham tat rūpam cakṣuḥ ca upādāya cakṣuḥ vijñānam utpadyate iti sahakāri vaśāt yat hi śakti rūpam tat indriyam indriyam sva kāryāt śakti rūpam eva anumīyate na tu bhautikam sā ca aviruddhāḥ vijñapteḥ śaktiḥ tu vijñāne vā astu anirdeśye svasya rūpe vā astu kārya utpattau na viśeṣaḥ evam viṣaya rūpakam pravartete anādi kālam śaktiḥ ca anyonya hetuke cakṣuḥ ākhyām śaktimantaḥ rūpañca upādāya vijñānam artha avabhāsi ālambanāt avibhaktam utpadyate idam dvayam api anādi kālam anyonya hetukam kadācid vijñānasya śakti paripākāt viṣaya ākāra tā bhavati kadācid ca tad ākāra śaktiḥ vijñānam sā ca ubhayam anya tvena ananya tvena ca yatheṣṭam ucyatām evam antara ālambanam dharmatā dvaya viśiṣṭa tvāt viṣaya tayā upapadyate

pramāṇa bhūtāya jagat hita eṣiṇe praṇamya śāstre sugatāya tāyine pramāṇa siddhyai sva matāt samuccayaḥ kariṣyate viprasṛtāt iha ekatas atra bhagavataḥ hetu phala sampattyā pramāṇa bhūta tvena stotra abhidhānam prakaraṇa ādau gaurava utpādana artham tatra hetuḥ āśaya prayoga sampad āśayaḥ jagat hita eṣitā prayogaḥ jagat śāsanāt śāstṛ tvam phalam sva para artha sampad sva artha sampad sugata tvena trividham artham upādāya praśasta tva artham surūpa vat apunarāvṛtti artham su naṣṭa jvara vat niḥśeṣa artham su pūrṇa ghaṭa vat artha trayam ca etat bāhya vīta rāga śaikṣā śaikṣebhyaḥ sva artha sampad viśeṣaṇa artham para artha sampad tāraṇa arthena tāyi tvam evaṅguṇam śāstāram praṇamya pramāṇa siddhyai sva prakaraṇebhyaḥ nyāya mukha ādibhyaḥ iha samāhṛtya pramāṇa samuccayaḥ kariṣyate para pramāṇa pratiṣedhāya sva pramāṇa guṇa udbhāvanāya ca yasmāt pramāṇa adhīnaḥ prameya adhigamaḥ bahavaḥ ca atra vipratipannāḥ

tatra pratyakṣam anumānam ca pramāṇe te dve eva yasmāt lakṣaṇa dvayam prameyam na hi sva sāmānya lakṣaṇābhyām anyat prameyam asti sva lakṣaṇa viṣayam ca pratyakṣam sāmānya lakṣaṇa viṣayam anumānam iti pratipādayiṣyāmaḥ yat tarhi idam anitya ādibhiḥ ākāraiḥ varṇa ādi gṛhyate asakṛt vā tat katham asti etat grahaṇam kim tu tasya sandhāne na pramāṇa antaram sva sāmānya lakṣaṇābhyām hi avyapadeśya varṇa tvābhyām varṇa ādi gṛhītvā anitya tayā ca anityam varṇa ādi iti manasā sandhatte tasmāt na pramāṇa antaram na ca punar punar abhijñāne yat asakṛt tat eva artham prati abhijñānam tathā api na pramāṇa antaram kim kāraṇam aniṣṭha āsakteḥ yadi sarvam jñānam pramāṇa tvena iṣyate evam pramāṇam anavasthita tvena syāt smṛta ādi vat smṛtiḥ eva smṛtam tat yathā smṛti icchā dveṣa ādayaḥ pūrva adhigata arthe na pramāṇa antaram tadvat

tatra pratyakṣam kalpanā apoḍham yasya jñānasya kalpanā na asti tat pratyakṣam atha kā iyam kalpanā nāma nāma jāti ādi yojanā yadṛcchā śabdeṣu nāmnā viśiṣṭaḥ arthaḥ ucyate ḍitthaḥ iti jāti śabdeṣu jātyā gauḥ iti guṇa śabdeṣu guṇena śuklaḥ iti kriyā śabdeṣu kriyayā pācakaḥ iti dravya śabdeṣu dravyeṇa daṇḍī viṣāṇi iti

atra kecid āhuḥ sambandha viśiṣṭaḥ iti anye tu artha śūnyaiḥ śabdaiḥ eva viśiṣṭaḥ arthaḥ ucyate iti icchanti yatra eṣā kalpanā na asti tat pratyakṣam atha kasmāt dvaya adhīnāyām utpattau pratyakṣam ucyate na prativiṣayam asādhāraṇa hetu tvāt akṣaiḥ tat vyapadiśyate na tu viṣayaiḥ rūpa ādibhiḥ tathā hi viṣayāḥ manaḥ vijñānāni asantānika vijñāna sādhāraṇāḥ asādhāraṇena ca vyapadeśaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ yathā bherī śabdaḥ yava aṅkuraḥ iti tasmāt upapannam etat pratyakṣam kalpanā apoḍham

abhidharme api uktam cakṣuḥ vijñāna samaṅgī nīlam vijānāti no tu nīlam iti arthe artha sañjñī na tu dharma sañjñī iti katham tarhi sañcita ālambanāḥ pañca vijñāna kāyāḥ yadi tat ekatas na vikalpayanti yat ca āyatana sva lakṣaṇam prati ete sva lakṣaṇa viṣayā na dravya sva lakṣaṇam iti tatra aneka artha janya tvāt sva arthe sāmānya gocaram

aneka dravya utpādya tvāt tat su āyatane sāmānya viṣayam uktam na tu bhinneṣu abheda kalpanāt āhuḥ ca dharmiṇaḥ aneka rūpasya na indriyāt sarvathā gatiḥ sva saṃvedyam hi anirdeśyam rūpam indriya gocaraḥ evam tāvat pañca indriya jam pratyakṣa jñānam nirvikalpam parama tāpekṣam ca atra viśeṣaṇam sarve tu avikalpakāḥ eva mānasam ca artha rāga ādi sva saṃvittiḥ akalpikā mānasam api rūpa ādi viṣaya ālambanam avikalpakam anubhava ākāra pravṛttam rāga ādiṣu ca sva saṃvedanam indriya anapekṣa tvāt mānasam pratyakṣam

tathā yoginām guru nirdeśa avyavakīrṇa artha mātra dṛś yoginām api āgama vikalpa avyavakīrṇam artha mātra darśanam pratyakṣam yadi rāga ādi sva saṃvittiḥ pratyakṣam kalpanā jñānam api nāma satyam etat kalpanā api sva saṃvittau iṣṭāḥ na arthe vikalpanāt tatra viṣaye rāga ādi vat eva apratyakṣa tve api svam saṃvetti iti na doṣaḥ

evam tāvat pratyakṣam bhrānti saṃvṛti sat jñānam anumāna anumānikam smārta abhilāṣikam ca iti pratyakṣa ābham sa taimiram tatra bhrānti jñānam mṛgatṛṣṇā ādiṣu toya ādi kalpanā pravṛtta tvāt pratyakṣa ābhāsam saṃvṛti satsu artha antara adhyāropāt tad rūpa kalpanā pravṛtta tvāt anumāna tad phala ādi jñānam pūrva anubhūta kalpanayā iti na pratyakṣam

atra ca sa vyāpāra pratīta tvāt pramāṇam phalam eva sat na hi atra bāhyakānām iva pramāṇāt artha antaram phalam tasya eva tu phala bhūtasya jñānasya viṣaya ākāra tayā utpattyā sa vyāpāra pratītiḥ tām upādāya pramāṇa tvam upacaryate nirvyāpāram api sat tat yathā phalam hetu anurūpam utpadyamānam hetu rūpam gṛhṇāti iti kathyate nirvyāpāram api tadvat atra api sva saṃvittiḥ phalam vā atra dvi ābhāsam hi jñānam utpadyate su ābhāsam viṣaya ābhāsam ca tasya ubhaya ābhāsasya yat sva saṃvedanam tat phalam kim kāraṇam

tad rūpaḥ hi artha niścayaḥ yadā hi sa viṣayam jñānam arthaḥ tadā sva saṃvedana anurūpam artham pratipadyate iṣṭam aniṣṭam vā yadā tu bāhyaḥ eva arthaḥ prameyaḥ tadā viṣaya ābhāsa tā eva asya pramāṇam tadā hi jñāna sva saṃvedyam api svarūpam anapekṣya artha ābhāsa tā eva asya pramāṇam yasmāt saḥ arthaḥ tena mīyate yathā yathā hi artha ākāraḥ jñāne pratibhāti śubhra aśubhra ādi tvena tad tad rūpaḥ sa viṣayaḥ pramīyate evam jñāna saṃvedanam aneka ākāram upādāya tathā tathā pramāṇa prameya tvam upacaryate nirvyāpārāḥ tu sarva dharmāḥ

āha ca yadābhāsam prameyam tat pramāṇa phalate punar grāhaka ākāra saṃvittyoḥ trayam na atas pṛthak kṛtam atha dvi rūpam jñānam iti katham pratipādyam viṣaya jñāna tad jñāna viśeṣāt tu dvi rūpa tā viṣaye hi rūpa ādau yat jñānam tat artha sva ābhāsam eva viṣaya jñāne tu yat jñānam tat viṣaya anurūpa jñāna ābhāsam su ābhāsam ca anyathā yadi viṣaya anurūpam eva viṣaya jñānam syāt svarūpam vā jñāna jñānam api viṣaya jñānena aviśiṣṭam syāt

na ca uttarottarāṇi jñānāni pūrva viprakṛṣṭa viṣaya ābhāsāni syuḥ tasya aviṣaya tvāt atas ca siddham dvairūpyam jñānasya smṛteḥ uttara kālam ca dvairūpyam iti sambandhaḥ yasmāt ca anubhava uttara kālam viṣayaḥ iva jñāne api smṛtiḥ utpadyate tasmāt asti dvi rūpa tā jñānasya sva saṃvedya tā ca kim kāraṇam na hi asau avibhāvite na hi ananubhūta artha vedana smṛtiḥ rūpa ādi smṛti vat

syāt etat rūpa ādi vat jñānasya api jñāna antareṇa anubhavaḥ tat api ayuktam yasmāt jñāna antareṇa anubhave aniṣṭhā anavasthā iti tad jñāne jñāna antareṇa anubhūyamāne kasmāt tatra api hi smṛtiḥ yena hi jñānena tat jñānam anubhūyate tatra api uttara kālam smṛtiḥ dṛṣṭā tatas tatra api anyena jñānena anubhave anavasthā syāt viṣaya antara sañcāraḥ tathā na syāt sa ca iṣyate tasmāt avaśyam sva saṃvedya tā jñānasya abhyupeyā sā ca phalam eva tathā pratyakṣam kalpanā apoḍham iti sthitam tad anantaram para praṇītam pratyakṣam parīkṣyate

tatas arthāt vijñānam pratyakṣam iti atra tatas arthāt iti sarvaḥ ced yasya tat tatas eva na yadi tatas iti anena sarvaḥ pratyayaḥ ucyate yasya viṣayasya jñānam tat vyapadiśyate na tat tatas eva bhavati na ālambana pratyayāt eva utpadyate caturbhiḥ citta caittāḥ hi iti siddhānta sambhavāt ālambanam ced smārta ādi jñānam na anyat apekṣate yadi tatas arthāt iti anena viṣaya mātram smṛti anumāna abhilāṣa ādi jñānam api ālambana antara nirapekṣam na hi agni ādi jñānam dhūma ādau ālambya utpadyate

rūpa ādiṣu tu ālambana arthaḥ vaktavyaḥ kim yadābhāsam teṣu jñānam utpadyate tathā te ālambanam iti uktāḥ atha yathā vidyamānāḥ anya ābhāsasya api vijñānasya kāraṇam bhavanti tatas kim iti ced yadi yathā ābhāsam teṣu jñānam utpadyate tathā sañcita ālambana tvāt pañcānām vijñāna kāyānām saṃvṛti sat eva ālambanam iti kāmam nīla ādi ābhāseṣu vijñāneṣu tatas arthāt utpannam vijñānam pratyakṣam syāt tathā hi teṣu tad samudāye prajñaptisatī api dravya sadākāraḥ labhyate dravya saṅkhyā ādi ākāreṣu api tu prāpnoti te eva hi dravya ādi tvena ābhāsante

atha yathā vidyamānā kāraṇam bhavanti evam sati dravya ādiṣu prasaṅga doṣaḥ na syāt tathā teṣām asattvāt evam tu yasya tat vyapadiśyate iti etat na prāpnoti na hi pratyekam teṣu jñānam pratyekam ca te samuditāḥ kāraṇam na tad samudāyaḥ prajñapti sattvāt tat eva āha yat ābhāsam na tat tasmāt citā ālambam hi pañcakam yatas tat parama arthena na tasya vyapadiśyate iti antaraślokaḥ yāvat cakṣuḥ ādīnām api ālambana tva prasaṅgaḥ te api hi paramārthataḥ anyathā vidyamānāḥ nīla ādi ābhāsasya dvi candra ādi ābhasasya ca jñānasya kāraṇībhavanti

artha rūpa viviktam ca na vācyam sarvam jñānam artha rūpa vyatirekeṇa aśakyam vyapadeṣṭum viṣayaḥ asya ca sāmānya rūpa nirdeśyaḥ tasmāt na vyapadiśyate pañcānām vijñānānām viṣayaḥ tad sāmānya rūpeṇa vyapadiśyate na tu sva rūpeṇa vyapadiśyate sāmānya rūpeṇa rūpa ādi tvena vyapadiśyeta tasmāt pañcānām vijñānānām viṣayaḥ na śakyaḥ vyapadeṣṭum iti vāda vidheḥ

naiyāyikānām tu indriya artha sannikarṣa utpannam jñānam avyapadeśyam avyabhicāri vyavasāya ātmakam pratyakṣam iti atra api viśeṣaṇāni ayuktāni yasmāt indriya artha udbhave na asti vyapadeśya ādi sambhavaḥ viśeṣaṇam hi vyabhicāra sambhave kriyate na ca asti indriya buddheḥ vyapadeśya viṣaya tvam anumāna viṣaya tvāt vyapadeśyasya anirdeśya tve ca avyabhicāraḥ na hi indriya buddhiḥ sarvāḥ nirdeṣṭum śakyate tasmāt viśeṣaṇa vacanam na eva kartavyam na ca vyabhicāri viṣaya tve manaḥ bhrānti viṣaya tvāt vyabhicāriṇaḥ vyavasāyaḥ api hi niścayaḥ sa sāmānya ādi vat gavā ādi naḥ vikalpya adarśanāt na sambhavati atha ayathā artha ādi jñāna nivṛttayaḥ ucyate tathā api ayuktam viśeṣaṇam avyabhicārāt ca sarvā hi indriya buddhiḥ sva artha mātra grāhiṇī etena ukta vikalpaḥ api pratyuktaḥ yat uktam vyavasāya ātmakam iti vyavasāya kāryam iti na hi asti sākṣāt ayathārtha ādi jñāna kāryam indriya buddhau

atha api avyapadeśya ādi grahaṇam tasya jñānasya svabhāva pradarśanāya tat na pratyakṣa lakṣaṇa vācya tvāt tasya ca indriya artha sannikarṣeṇa eva siddha tvāt jñāna svabhāva nirdeśya tve ca guṇa tva dravya anārambhaka tva niṣkriya tva ākāśa ādi a viṣaya tvasya api nirdeśya tvāt atiprasaṅgaḥ sarvatra ca sannikarṣa utpannam pratyakṣam iṣṭau rūpa śabdayoḥ sa antara grahaṇam na syāt prāptau jñāne adhikasya ca na hi indriya nirantare gandha ādau sa antara grahaṇam dṛṣṭam na api adhika grahaṇam iti

bahis vṛtti tvāt upapannam eva bahis hi adhiṣṭhānāt vṛttiḥ indriya dvayasya atas upapannam tad viṣayasya sa antara adhika grahaṇam api iti ced tat api ayuktam yasmāt adhiṣṭhānāt bahis na akṣam siddham iti vākya śeṣaḥ adhiṣṭhāna deśaḥ eva indriyam tatra cikitsā ādi prayogāt atas indriyāt eva vicchinne arthe grahaṇam

sati api ca bahis nirgate na śaktiḥ viṣaya īkṣaṇe anyathā adhiṣṭhāna pidhāne api viṣaya grahaṇam syāt tatas cakṣuḥ śrotrayoḥ adhiṣṭhāna antar sthitayoḥ eva āsat nikṛṣya viṣaya īkṣaṇāt sa antara adhika grahaṇam yuktam pañcānām ca indriya tve na sukha ādi prameyam vā vā iti grahaṇam vā śabdāt pramāṇa antara upādānam yat dhi liṅga ādi abhāve sva sukha duḥkha icchā dveṣa prayatneṣu grahaṇam tat apramāṇam iti sukha ādīnām prameya tā na syāt tasya vā pramāṇasya pramāṇa antara tvam upasaṅkhyeyam manaḥ vā astu indriya antaram

athavā manasaḥ eva indriya tvam vācyam tat sannikarṣa utpannasya pratyakṣa tu a siddhi artham aniṣedhāt upāttam ced atha api paramatasya apratiṣiddhasya siddhau manasaḥ indriya tvam aniṣedhāt upāttam eva asti hi ekeṣām mate manasaḥ indriya bhāva āyattiḥ tathā anya indriya rutam vṛthā yadi pareṇa paṭhitasya manasaḥ apratiṣedhāt indriya tvam tatas ghrāṇa ādīni indriyāṇi ucyante iti nirdeśaḥ vṛthā syāt apratiṣedhāt eva siddha tvāt

jñānasya ca artha antara phala vādinaḥ pramāṇa tve niścite arthe phala abhāvaḥ niścaya ātmakam hi jñānam pramāṇam tad pramāṇa utpattau artha adhigamāt phala abhāvaḥ syāt viśeṣaṇa jñānam pramāṇam yat sāmānya ādi viśeṣaṇa jñānam tat pramāṇam yat ca dravya ādi viśeṣya jñānam tat phalam iti ced tat bhinna tvāt na viśeṣaṇe bhinnam viśeṣaṇam viśeṣyāt bhinnam na hi anya viṣayasya pramāṇasya anyatra phalam yuktam yathā khadira viṣayam chindatā cchedanena na palāśa chidā dṛṣṭā viśeṣya jñāna hetu tvāt tad viṣaya tvam api asti iti ced na atiprasaṅgāt evam hi sarva kāraka saṅkaraḥ syāt viśeṣya jñāna hetu tvena tad karaṇa tvāt tasmāt yasya karmaṇi vyāpāra khyātiḥ tasya eva tad phala tvam yuktam

api ca na tatra ca tatra viśeṣaṇe adhigantavye phala abhāvaḥ pramāṇa abhāvaḥ vā dvayam tat ced atha api tat eva viśeṣaṇa jñānam pramāṇam prameyam ca dvayam api bhavet tat yathā sva ātma adhigama mātre prameyam ca bhavati grahītā ca na viśeṣye api vartate evam hi viśeṣya jñāne api pramāṇam prameyam ca ubhayam prāpnoti yadi artha antare api jñāna jñeyayoḥ pramāṇam prameyam ca syāt sva adhigame tu jñānasya ātma vat tasya eva ubhaya bhāvaḥ viśeṣaṇa jñānam ātmanā samānam iti ubhayam na yujyate

evam tarhi prameya adhigame yā ajñāna saṃśaya viparyaya jñāna nivṛttiḥ sā phalam bhaviṣyati tat api ayuktam ajñāna ādi na sarvatra sarvatra tāvat ajñāna ādeḥ bhāva niyamaḥ na asti kvacid ābhoga mātreṇa jñāna utpatteḥ bhavatu nāma ajñāna ādiḥ tathā api nivṛttiḥ na asatī phalam nivṛttiḥ iti ajñāna ādi abhāve kriyate sāsatī na phalam tasyāḥ prameya bhāva ayukta tvāt evam tāvat naiyāyikānām pratyakṣam ayuktam

vaiśeṣikāṇām sautram tāvat kenacid sambandhena dravye niṣpannam pratyakṣa lakṣaṇam iti ātma indriya manortha sannikarṣāt yat niṣpadyate tat anyat iti kecid tu pramāṇāt phalam artha antaram icchanti asādhāraṇa kāraṇa tvāt indriya artha sannikarṣaḥ pramāṇam pratipattavyaḥ iti anye tu prādhānyāt ātma manaḥ sannikarṣaḥ pramāṇam iti

evam ca saṃśaya nirṇayayoḥ niṣpattiḥ pratyakṣa laiṅgikābhyām jñānābhyām vyākhyātāḥ iti yat uktam tat virudhyate na tulyam catuṣṭaya sannikarṣa ja jñānena nirṇaya ja jñānam vicāra pūrvaka tvāt nirṇayasya pratyakṣasya ca viṣaya ālocana artha tvāt viṣaya ālocana mātra artham hi catuṣṭaya sannikarṣa jam tatra kutas vicāraḥ indriya artha sannikarṣa pramāṇa vādinaḥ anatideśaḥ eva syāt indriya artha sannikarṣa pramāṇa vādinaḥ hi kim etat iti jighṛkṣāyām satyām sarvathā agrahaṇa prasaṅgaḥ sarva ātmanā sannikarṣāt ātma manaḥ sannikarṣa vādinaḥ ca viṣaya bhedaḥ api na hi anya viṣayasya pramāṇasya anyatra phalam iti pūrvam uktam

api ca sāmānya viśeṣa apekṣam dravya guṇa karma apekṣam ca pratyakṣam iti na yujyate yasmāt indriya artha sannikarṣa utpannasya viṣaya ālocana artha tvāt na sandhānam viśeṣaṇaiḥ indriya buddhau sva artha mātra grāhika tvāt viśeṣaṇaiḥ saha sandhānam na upapadyate idam asya sāmānyam dravya ādi vā iti avaśyam artha dvayam gṛhītvā tathā sambandhaḥ kalpyate tena matublopāt abheda upacārāt vā gṛhyate tat ca smārtena ākṛṣya viśeṣaṇam manaḥ buddhau upapadyate anyathā hi surabhi madhuram iti grahaṇam api pratyakṣam syāt na ca arhati evam viśeṣaṇa viśeṣyayoḥ bhinna indriya grāhya tvāt

yadi ca ekam dravyam aneka indriya grāhyam iti tathā na ekam rūpa ādi vat anekam syāt rūpa ādiṣu hi aneka indriya grāhyasya ekatvam na kvacid api dṛṣṭam rūpa ādi abhedaḥ vā yadi aneka indriya grāhyam api abhinnam iṣyate rūpa ādi api dravya vat ekam syāt dṛṣṭam ced ete yadi evam bhinna indriya viṣaye dravye abheda jñānam dṛṣṭam eva bhāva guṇa tvayoḥ iva na rūpa ādiṣu tasmāt eka aneka siddhiḥ iti abheda jñānam tathā dṛṣṭam kim tu na indriyeṇa tat na tat indriya dvāreṇa indriya antara viṣaye jñānam kutas akṣa an eka tva vaiyarthyāt yadi indriya antara viṣaye api indriya antarasya grahaṇa śaktiḥ iṣyate rūpa ādiṣu aneka indriya kalpanā pārthikā

atha api syāt rūpa ādīnām bheda sadbhāvāt ekam indriyam na grahaṇa śaktimat iti tat api ayuktam kasmāt indriyam hi sva arthe bhinne api śaktimat sva arthe nīla ādi bhedena saṅkhī ā ādi bhedena ca bhavat matena bhinne api indriyam śaktimat na tu indriya antara arthe indriya antara artha tvena eva rūpa bhinna sparśa vat yatas cakṣuṣā grahaṇam tasya tat yadi cakṣuḥ sparśana grāhyam api dravyam gṛhṇāti indriya antara arthaḥ api cakṣuṣaḥ sva arthaḥ iti abhyanujñāta tvāt bhinnasya api nīla ādeḥ iva sparśa ādeḥ api cakṣuṣā grahaṇa prasaṅgaḥ iti na bhinna tvam aneka indriya grāhya tve hetuḥ kim tarhi indriya antara artha agrahanam

yadi ca abhinnam api artham anekam indriyam gṛhṇīyāt rūpa ādīnām pratyekam api sārva indriya tvam āpnoti dravya vat evam hi rūpa ādayaḥ aneka indriya grāhyāḥ prāpnuvanti na santi ete doṣāḥ rūpa ādayaḥ teṣu sva viśeṣa niyāmakāḥ tad abhāvāt indriya buddhīnām nīle avyabhicāra iti ced katham teṣām niyāmaka tvam yasya rūpa tva abhāvaḥ na tasya cakṣuḥ grāhya tvam tadvat sparśa ādīnām api sva sva viṣaya niyāmaka tvam tathā sparśana cakṣuṣām vṛttiḥ na dravya ādau na hi dravya saṅkhyā ādi karmasu rūpa tva sparśa tve iṣyeta iti na syāt teṣām sparśanena cakṣuṣā ca grahaṇam

evam tarhi yasya rūpa tvam tat cakṣuṣā grāhyam tasmāt sparśa ādau api tadvat niyāmaka tvena viśeṣaḥ evam ca rūpa tva ādi abhāvāt dravya ādiṣu niyama abhāvaḥ syāt iti ced tathā sati tad abhāvāt avyabhicāraḥ iti sūtra virodhaḥ rūpa tva ādeḥ śabda ādau abhāvāt avyabhicāraḥ ucyate na rūpa tvāde rūpa ādau bhāva dvāreṇa yuktyā api ca iyam kalpanā na upapadyate yasmāt abhāva tvāt agrahasya indriya antareṇa agrahaṇam hi grahaṇa abhāvaḥ sa katham rūpa tva ādinā kriyate syāt tu hetu abhāvāt grahaṇa abhāvaḥ tasmāt rūpa tva ādīnām niyāmaka tvam na yujyate

yat tarhi dravya ādiṣu abheda jñānam dṛṣṭam tat katham iti ced anya gocaram cakṣuḥ sparśanābhyām bhinnam viṣayam upalabhya anyat eva tad sahacara samudāya viṣayam smārtam abheda jñānam utpadyate rūpa ādi agrahe tad buddhi abhāvāt tathā viśeṣyān svaiḥ indriyaiḥ bhinnān upalabhya artha antara vyavaccheda viṣayam abhedena sarvatra mānasam jñānam upajāyate na bhāva guṇa tvayoḥ pratyakṣam tasya anupalakṣaṇāt pratyakṣa abhimānaḥ eṣa kutarkikānām

tulya gocarateṣṭā ced syāt evam viśeṣaṇa viśeṣyayoḥ tu avaśyam tulya indriya viṣaya tvam abhyupagantavyam tad agrahe tad buddhi abhāvāt iti ced evam sati aniṣṭam anuṣajyate yadi ubhayasya tulya indriya grāhya tvam dravya guṇa karmāṇi api dravyavanti iti bhāva vat dravyam sārva indriyam syāt tathā eka dravya tvāt na dravyam bhāvaḥ bhāvasya sārva indriya tvāt

dravya vṛtteḥ bhāvaḥ eka dravyaḥ tadvān ucyate iti ced na abhinna tvāt abhinnaḥ bhāvaḥ sarvatra dravya ādi bhāve na pratiṣidhyate tathā hi uktam guṇa karmasu ca bhāvān na karma na guṇaḥ iti yadi ca dravye vartamānaḥ eva eka dravyaḥ na anyatra vartamānaḥ eka dravyaḥ iti bhinnaḥ syāt yadā ca cakṣuḥ pratyakṣeṇa agnim uṣṇaḥ ayam iti gṛhṇāti tadā sparśaḥ api cākṣuṣaḥ syāt na ca evam tasmāt bhāva guṇa tva vat bhinna indriya grāhya tve api abhinnam dravyam iti na yujyate

yadi evam bhinna indriya grāhya tvāt api aneka tva vāde anekāntaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ hi eka indriya grāhya tve api dravya guṇa karmaṇām bhedaḥ nīla ādi bhedaḥ ca anantareṇa api ca indriyeṇa grahaṇa bhedāt nīla ādiṣu bhedaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ yat yad abhāve api bhavati na tasya tat kāraṇam iti na indriya bhedaḥ aneka tve hetuḥ iti ced anyathā uktam tat bhinna indriya grāhya tvāt aneka tvam uktam na eka indriya grāhya tvāt eka tvam yatas anekāntaḥ syāt na ca atra anekāntaḥ na hi bhinnedriya grāhya tvāt eva aneka tvam ucyate kim tarhi aneka tvam eva

anantareṇa api ca indriyeṇa iti yat uktam atra na sarvam sādhyam ucyate na hi sarvam anekam indriya bhedāt iti uktam kim tarhi yatra indriya bhedaḥ tat anekam iti na buddhi bhedaḥ api anya tve kāraṇam niṣidhyate api ca akṣa abhede api dhī bhedāt bhede abhedaḥ kutas anyathā yatra ca anantareṇa api indriyeṇa dhī bhedāt nānātvam ucyate tatra indriya bhede grahaṇa bhede ca ekam iti na avakāśaḥ etena guṇa ādiṣu pratyakṣa jñānam api apoditam veditavyam tat api hi sva ādhāra sambandha dvāreṇa catuṣṭaya ādi sannikarṣāt eva utpadyate yathā ca na sarvatra sannikarṣāt jñāna utpattiḥ evam naiyāyika pratyakṣa parīkṣāyām uktam evam vaiśeṣikāṇām pratyakṣam api sa doṣam

kāpilānām tu śrotra ādi vṛttiḥ pratyakṣam iṣṭam śrotra tvac cakṣuḥ jihvā ghrāṇānām manasā adhiṣṭhitā vṛttiḥ śabda sparśa rūpa rasa gandheṣu yathākramam grahaṇe vartamānā pratyakṣam pramāṇam iti teṣām punar indriyāṇām anavasthā taiḥ hi anindriya antara grāhya viṣaya tvena indriyāṇi sva viṣaya viniveśāni abhimatāni traiguṇya utkarṣa apakarṣa mātra bhedāt śabda ādeḥ bhinna jātīya tvāt eka śabdasya api guṇa utkarṣa apakarṣa mātra bhedena ānantyāt grāhakam indriyam anantam abhyupeyam

atha vā indriya aikyam vā atha tatra traiguṇyā bhedāt abhinna jātīya tve śabda viśeṣa grāhaka vat sparśa ādīnām api grāhaka tvāt prāptam ekam eva indriyam sarvatra traiguṇyasya abhedāt na hi traiguṇya vyatirekeṇa śabda jātiḥ asti yā śabdaḥ eva bhavati na sparśa ādau katham na asti yadā sattva ādi saṃsthāna bhedāt śabda ādayaḥ bhidyante abhinna jāti śabdeṣu samānam saṃsthānam sparśa ādibhyaḥ asamānam ca sā jātiḥ śrotra vṛtteḥ grāhyam tathā sparśa ādiṣu api tatas na yathā ukta doṣa prasaṅgaḥ iti ced

tathā api cakṣuḥ sparśanayoḥ samāna viṣaya tvam prāptam yatas saṃsthānam dvi grāhyam dīrgha ādi saṃsthānasya cakṣuḥ sparśanayoḥ dṛṣṭa tvāt sva viṣaya viniveśa vyāghātaḥ śabda ādayaḥ ca na śrotra ādi grāhyāḥ syuḥ kutas saṃsthānam na tri gocaraḥ saṃsthānasya śrotra jihvā ghrāṇa agrāhya tva dṛṣṭa tvāt śabda rasa gandhāḥ na pratyakṣāḥ syuḥ

saṃsthāna kṛtam ca jāti bhedam icchataḥ saṃsthānāḥ bahavaḥ samāna deśāḥ āpannā eka indriya viṣaya jāti anatikrameṇa tad bheda jāti bahutvāt bahavaḥ saṃsthānāḥ samāna deśa tvam prāptāḥ tulya saṃsthāneṣu ca suvarṇa ādi darvi alaṅkāra ādiṣu abhedaḥ saṃsthāna tulya tvāt āpannam eka tvam suvarṇa ādi śabda ādi sattva ādi jātīnām tathā ca sva viṣaya vṛtti abhāvaḥ indriya vṛttiḥ jāti mātra grāhikā vā jāti viśiṣṭa sukha ādi grāhikā vā

yadi jāti mātra grāhikā arthasya na svabhāva gṛk saṃsthāna mātra grāhaka tve śabda ādīnām sukha ādi svabhāva agrahaṇam prasajyeta yasmāt dṛṣṭā manda prakāśaḥ upalabhyamānasya saṃsthāna mātrasya artha svabhāva anupalabdhiḥ saṃsthāna mātra grāhaka tve artha bheda āgraho śabda ādeḥ viśeṣa grahaṇam na syāt tathā hi vīṇā śabda bherī śabda ityādi bheda agrahaṇam syāt tatra saṃsthāna antara abhāvāt arthe vā yathā cetaḥ vikalpikā sva artha viśiṣṭasya tad viśeṣasya grahaṇāt manaḥ vṛtti vat sva viṣaye vikalpikā syāt atha saṃsthāna viśiṣṭa sukha ādi grāhikā tathā api tad avasthā manaḥ vṛtti vat vikalpikā eva iti arthaḥ sukha ādīn ca pratyekam samuditam vā grāhikā syāt

tatra na tāvat pratyekam indriya vṛttīnām sva viṣaye niveśāt śabda ādi grāhyam na sattva ādi na hi sattva ādi pratyekam śabda ādi svabhāvam tasmāt na te śrotra ādi vṛtti grāhyāḥ na ananya tvāt sukha arthayoḥ yasmāt śabda ādibhyaḥ ananyat sukha ādi tasmāt śabda ādi vat tat api grāhyam ananyat ced na vā kāryam yadi sattva ādi śabda ādeḥ ananyat abhinna śabda ādi na kāryam sattva ādi na śabda ādeḥ kāraṇam yat uktam sattvam śabda kāryam prati ākhyāya śabda ātmanā vyavatiṣṭhamānam ityādi tat api virudhyeta

sattva ādīnām vā paraspara abhedaḥ śabda ādi vā anekam eva syāt kārya kāraṇayoḥ abhinna svabhāva tvāt iti vikalpa arthaḥ vā śabdaḥ api ca ananya tve api na grāhyam yadi api sukha ādi śabda ādeḥ ananyat tathā api tad paramāṇuḥ api na grāhyaḥ iti pratyekam na grāhyam tanmātra ādi vā na ca yat indriya arthāt ananyat tat sarvam indriya arthaḥ bhavati kāryatva ādi grahaṇe sāmānya viṣaya tva prasaṅgāt

tathā tāvat na pratyekam grāhyam atha samuditam grahaṇe tathā api indriya vṛttiḥ sarvā syāt citra ākārā na bhinne grāhye abhinna ākāram grahaṇam yuktam tad vaśena grāhyā paricchedāt dṛṣṭam ca śabda ādiṣu abhinnam grahaṇam sukha ādi viṣaya tvaḥ indriyāṇām samārtha tvam indriyāṇām samāna viṣaya tvam syāt na sva viṣaye vṛtti tvam viṣaya antare sukha ādīnām abhinna jāti tvāt tena eka indriya tva prasaṅgaḥ

nanu ca saṃsthāna viśiṣṭān gṛhṇāti iti uktam iti tathā ukte na yuktam uktam yatas na eka anugama darśanam aneka saṃsthāna bhedena ekasyām rūpa jātau grahaṇāt na eka saṃsthāna anuvṛttiḥ dṛṣṭā tatra saṃsthāna bhedāt jāti bhedaḥ iṣṭe saḥ eva indriya ānantya prasaṅgaḥ atra ca ekeṣām sāṅkhyānām bhedaḥ iṣṭaḥ ced pūrveṣām kāpilānām abhimata atikramāt sāṅkhya nāśakaḥ mādhavaḥ tu āha na eva hi śabda ādi lakṣaṇebhyaḥ trikebhyaḥ sparśa ādi lakṣaṇāḥ trika jātayaḥ abhinnāḥ abhinnānām hi indriyā antareṇa grahaṇam ayuktam tasmāt sukha ādi indriya viṣayeṣu bhinna jātayaḥ yad vaśena sva viṣaya viniveśa tvam indriyāṇām iti sa ca abhinnaḥ sva viśeṣeṣu iti akṣa ānantyam prasajyate

yadi sukha ādi indriya jāti viṣaya jāti bheda siddhi artham pūrva siddhāntāt atikrāntaḥ tadā spaṣṭatareṇa nyāyena asmābhiḥ vyākhyeyaḥ ekaika rūpāḥ sarvatra pradhānam aṇavaḥ pṛthak sukha duḥkha moha śabda sparśa kriyā ādi bhedena bhinnānām jātitaḥ sarva gatānām paramāṇavaḥ pradhānam iti ucyante kārya rūpāḥ tu lakṣyante samprayoga viśeṣataḥ tathā samprayoga viśeṣāt sva jāti anatikrameṇa kārya rūpāḥ indriya viṣaya tvena pratipadyante aṇūnām tu tri rūpa tve kāryam ekam kutas gatam śabde śabdaḥ iti sukha ādi vyatirekena yā abhinnā buddhiḥ utpannā bhinne aneka svābhāvye na yujyate kim kāraṇam vijāti pariṇāmaḥ hi saṃprayoge api na iṣyate traya samprayogāt na ekībhāvaḥ sāṅkhyānām jāti bhedāt eka śabda vācyāḥ tu na eka svabhāvāḥ santi

atha yat utkaṭam trika svabhāve śabde sukha ādikam jighṛkṣitam vā tat indriyasya viṣayaḥ syāt anīpsite dvi rūpa tve syāt kāryasya eka rūpa tā yadi ghrāṇena śabda grahaṇa nirapekṣā buddhiḥ sukha ādīnām anyatame vartate tadā saḥ eva ātmā ekaḥ syāt kim kāraṇam indriya arthaḥ viśiṣṭaḥ hi aneka rūpe api vastunaḥ aneka rūpe hi śabda ādau yasmin buddhiḥ vartate saḥ eva indriyasya viṣayaḥ sa ca ekaḥ eva samānaḥ ca sparśa ādiṣu iti saḥ ayuktaḥ tasmāt varam prahāṇāt sāṅkhya iṣṭeḥ eka eka rūpa tā pūrva prasiddha sāṅkhya darśanāt viśiṣṭataram satyam eva kāryasya jāti bhedaḥ ekaika rūpāt kāraṇāt utpattiḥ kalpyate evam na vijātīya kāryam ārabhate na trikā nām eka rūpa tā yadi api śabda ādi grahaṇa mātraḥ indriya vṛttiḥ pratyakṣam tathā api na sarva prameya viṣayam pramāṇam kutas aśeṣa viṣaye vṛtti pramāṇasya avidhānataḥ indriya vṛtti saṃvedakasya manasaḥ liṅga ādim antareṇa pramāṇān abhidhānāt nyūna tā tad vṛtti saṃvedanam pramāṇa anyatame na antarbhavati

na eṣa doṣaḥ smārtam hi tat vṛtti saṃvedanam kāma ādi vat yathā uktam smṛti pratyakṣa vyavasāya viśeṣaḥ iti tasmāt indriya jñānam bāhye arthe pratyakṣam indriya vṛttau tu anantaram smārtam iti ced smārtaḥ na ananubhūta tvāt anantaram manasā aindriya vṛtti grāhakaḥ smārtaḥ na yuktaḥ pūrvam ananubhūta tvāt yugapad dve bhaviṣyataḥ indriya vyavasāya tat anubhūyamāna manasoḥ yugapad abhivyaktiḥ upagatāḥ iti ced evam ca aviṣaya nimittaḥ viṣayī syāt sa ca apramāṇam sa ca indriya anubhavaḥ pratyayaḥ pramāṇam na uktaḥ iti vṛttau api pramāṇa asiddheḥ sā eva nyūna tā sva saṃvedya tvāt kāma ādiṣu smārtaḥ iti na doṣaḥ smṛti pratyakṣa vyavasāya viśeṣaḥ iti andha padam eva etat

tathā hi indriya arthe api smārtaḥ na sambhavati anantaram manasā ananubhūta tvāt na hi manasā bāhya arthaḥ pūrvam anubhūtaḥ hāniḥ vā smṛtiḥ api anya darśane indriya vṛtti mātra anubhūta tvāt ananubhūte vā smārtaḥ hāniḥ vā iti vā śabdaḥ vikalpa arthaḥ katham hāniḥ yadi indriya vṛtti sahajaḥ bāhye arthe manasaḥ anubhavaḥ iṣyate yat uktam na eka artha kāriṇoḥ indriyayoḥ kalpane sāmarthyam asti iti tat vyāhanyate

na eṣa doṣaḥ smārta adhika vyavasāya pradarśana artham hi saha vyavasāya kriyā pratiṣidhyate saha tu siddhaḥ eva kim bāhyeṣu artheṣu indriyam anobhyām saha vyavasāyāḥ iti vyavasāye praśnaḥ sāmprate kāle kenacid indriyeṇa yuktam yadā manaḥ bhavati iti prāk ukta tvāt tathā api smṛteḥ adhikam uktau yadi smārtasya adhika ukti artham bāhya arthe manasā saha pratiṣidhyate tathā yathā ca indriya vyavasāye manaḥ anuvyavasāyam kurute evam mānasam vyavasāyam indriyam saṃvedayate ityādi tasya yāghātaḥ tena bāhya arthe smārtaḥ tat na asti yadi manaḥ bāhya arthe vastutas vartate tathā api anya akṣam apārthikam indriya antarāṇām bāhya arthe vṛttiḥ apārthikā prāpnoti manasā puṃsaḥ arthaḥ kṛtaḥ iti tathā viṣaya svabhāva grahaṇa asāmarthyāt na sāṅkhya pratyakṣam pramāṇam

mīmāṃsakānām tu sat samprayoge puruṣasya indriyāṇām buddhi janma tat pratyakṣam iti tatra sat iti asat vyudāsāya na niyogāt sa gaṃsyate samprayogaḥ hi niyamāt sataḥ eva upapadyate asat vyudāsa artham na sat prayogaḥ yuktaḥ pratiyogi atha nirdiṣṭaḥ atha indriyāṇām samprayogaḥ iti uktau kena samprayogaḥ iti cintāyām pratiyogi samprayogaḥ gamyate tad artham sat grahaṇam iti tathā api viśiṣṭaḥ akṣasya kathyatām indriyasya viśiṣṭaḥ eva arthaḥ pratiyogī vaktum yuktam

atha api syāt atra ātma ādi manaḥ sannikarṣaḥ vaktavyaḥ sa ca sāmānyena sat grahaṇāt uktaḥ iti tat api ayuktam sat mātram sannikarṣe na akalpyam yatas udāhṛtam sat mātrasya puruṣeṇa sannikṛṣṭa tvam sāmānyena siddham yasmāt asati tasya āvṛttiḥ ye api hi mṛgatṛṣṇā ādi pratyakṣa ābhāsāḥ asantaḥ na taiḥ saha kasyacid samprayogaḥ deśa viśeṣe tu sūrya upatāpāt utpannāḥ viśeṣāḥ avyapadeśyāḥ cakṣuḥ buddhi sanni karṣāt vinā api tad arthena sāma arthyāt krameṇa bhrāntasya manaḥ vijñānasya kāraṇam tatas na tad niṣedhāya sat grahaṇam yuktam atha indriye sīdati yaḥ yasya vā syāt praśasta tā yaḥ yasmin indriye sīdati anyatra āvṛtteḥ tena tad samprayogaḥ yaḥ vā yasya indriyasya praśastaḥ yogya tvena samyak uktaḥ tena tad samprayogaḥ iti uktam tat sīdati anyat api atra añjana ādeḥ ca praśasta tā tat iti vacanam upanyāsa artham antarāḥ api rajaḥ prabhṛtayaḥ indriye sīdanti na kevalam arthaḥ eva indriyasya praśastāḥ ca añjana pāda lepa ādayaḥ api atas tad samprayoge api pratyakṣatā syāt

na evam bhaviṣyati yathā gamanāt gauḥ iti vacane na anyat api gacchat gauḥ syāt tathā arthaḥ eva sadanāt san syāt na anyat tathā praśastasya api vaktavyam iti viṣamaḥ upanyāsaḥ yatas rūḍhau evaṃvikalpe api śabdaḥ akṣa viṣaye na saḥ go śabdaḥ gamanāt gavi rūḍhaḥ na ca evam sat śrutiḥ sadanāt praśasta tāyāḥ vā indriya arthe rūḍhā tasmāt evaṃvikalpe api na sat śabdaḥ yuktaḥ sarva artha samprayoge ca yat dṛṣṭam rūpa śabdayoḥ vicchinna pṛthu vijñānam tat nairantarya bādhakam yadi hi sarva artheṣu indriya prāptiḥ yat rūpa śabdayoḥ vicchinna grahaṇam indriya pariṇāma adhika grahaṇam ca tat na syāt indriya nirantara gandha ādiṣu tayoḥ adarśa na at

buddhi kāraṇa sāmagrīm uktām muktvā pramāṇataḥ yatas sā vṛtti kāraḥ hi artha antara phala vādī āha buddhi janmanaḥ anyat na dṛśyam kāryam iti yatas buddhi janma tat pratyakṣam iti uktam atra ca yathā ukta ātma ādi samprayaḥ gāt saṃskāra ādivataḥ buddhi kāraṇam anyat na asti yat pratyakṣam eva nirdeśyam atha iyam eva iti atha vā kāraṇa sāmagrī eva pratyakṣam uktā buddhi janma iti kim punar evam sat samprayogaḥ puruṣasya indriyāṇām pratyakṣam iti alam uktam syāt tat yatas utpannam iti vikalpya kim buddhi janmanā

kim ca artha indriya manaḥ puṃssaṃyogaḥ saṃskāravān yadā buddhi utpādaka sāmagrī uktā pratyakṣeṇa tat katham sarve hi tāni samuditāni na akṣam prati vartante yaḥ api hi kalpayet indriya artha sannikarṣaḥ pratyakṣam iti tasya api dviṣṭha tvāt na indriyaḥ eva vartanīyam iti akalpanā iyam gauḥ eva ayam aśvaḥ eva ayam iti yatas yat niścayaḥ jāyate tat pratyakṣam iti yat uktam tat api ayuktam go tva ādi yogāt ca arthaḥ go tva ādi tvena pramīyate na ca indriya dhiyaḥ sāmarthyam asti artheṣu yojane tvad matyā indriya dhiyaḥ go tva mātra darśanasya tad āśraya darśanasya ca śaktiḥ asti na tu tayoḥ anusandhāne na ca vinā api sambandhena gavā ādi niścayaḥ yujyate tasmāt mānasaḥ viśeṣaṇa viśeṣyayoḥ abhidhāna abhidheyayoḥ ca sarvaḥ abheda upacāra vikalpaḥ na indriya dhīḥ

kim kāraṇam sva saṃvedyam hi anirdeśyam rūpam indriya gocaraḥ aneka dharmaḥ api indriya arthaḥ yaḥ asādhāraṇena ātmanā indriye avabhāsamānaḥ su a ābhāsa jñāna utpatti hetuḥ sa pratyātma vedyaḥ eva jñāna sva aṃśa vat sa tad ātmanā aśakya nirdeśaḥ nirdeśyasya sāmānya viṣaya tvāt atha punar sāmānya ākāreṇa api saḥ arthaḥ indriya viṣaye sati sarvathā viṣayaḥ syāt sarvathā na artha vijñāne sthitā pratyakṣa dhīḥ bhavet pratyakṣa śabdaḥ hi triṣu vartate pramāṇa jñāna viṣayeṣu tatra pramāṇe mukhyaḥ anyayoḥ upacāritaḥ tatra viṣaye pratyakṣa meya tvāt pratyakṣa upacāraḥ jñāne akṣam prati vṛtteḥ pramāṇa tulya tvāt pratyakṣa upacāraḥ yadi ca dhī rūpa ādi sāmānya ākārā lambanā sa indriya nirapekṣā abheda upacāra pravṛttā na akṣa paratantrā syāt sarvathā ca artha vijñānam icchataḥ rūpa ādīnām guṇa tva sattā jñānāt indriya antara viṣaye sañcāraḥ iti akṣa aneka tva vaiyarthyam iti prāk uktam tasmāt asādhāraṇam eva viṣaya svarūpam indriya gocaraḥ tathā tāvat yatas buddhi janma tat pratyakṣam ayuktam

buddhi janma yadi iṣyeta yasya buddhi janmaḥ eva pratyakṣam śrūyate iti āśaṅkā tam pratyudgamya uttaram vaktavyam artha antara phala vādinā phalam anyat na labhyate katham kṛtvā iti ced buddhau eva hi jātāyām tatas anyat na phalam bhavet adhigamaḥ hi phalam avasitam sa ced pramāṇam buddheḥ ananya tvāt phala abhāvaḥ buddheḥ ca yadi janma anyat samavāyaḥ sva kāraṇe sa pramāṇam sa tu kuto janma vaiśeṣikānām phalasya sva kāraṇe samavāyaḥ sattā ādi samavāyaḥ vā tatra yadi tāvat samavāyaḥ buddhi janma iṣyate samavāyaḥ pratyakṣam prāpnoti tasya ca nitya tvāt na kutaścid utpadyate tasmāt ubhayathā api sa pramāṇam na yujyate atha ananya tvam apārthakam yadi buddheḥ janmān anyat evam buddhiḥ eva pratyakṣam iti janma grahaṇam apārthakam

buddhi janmani puṃsaḥ ca vikṛtiḥ yadi anitya tā yadi ca buddhi janmani pumān pūrva avasthām vikṛtya pramātṛ tvena iṣyate evam sati anityaḥ puṃsaḥ syāt tat ca aniṣṭam atha avikṛtiḥ ātmā ayam pramātā iti na yujyate avikṛtau buddhi janmani puṃsaḥ apramātṛ avasthāyāḥ aviśiṣṭaḥ pramātṛ tvena na yujyate evam para abhimatam pratyakṣam atra pramāṇam na upapadyate doṣavat ca vākyam

pramāṇa prameya saṃśaya prayojana dṛṣṭānta siddhānta avayava tarka nirṇaya vāda jalpa vitaṇḍā hetvābhāsa chala ja ati nigraha sthānānām tattva jñānāt niḥśreyasa adhigamaḥ duḥkha janma pravṛtti doṣa mithyā jñānām uttarottara apāye tad anantara apāyāt apavargaḥ pratyakṣa anumāna upamāna śabdāḥ pramāṇāni indriya artha sannikarṣa uttpannam jñānam avyapadeśyam avyabhicāri vyavasāya ātmakam pratyakṣam

atha tad pūrvakam trividham anumānam pūrvavat śeṣavat sāmānyatas dṛṣṭam ca prasiddha sādharmyāt sādhya sādhanam upamānam āpta upadeśaḥ śabdaḥ sa dvividhaḥ dṛṣṭa adṛṣṭa artha tvāt ātma śarīra indriya artha buddhi manaḥ pravṛtti doṣa pretya bhāva phala duḥkha apavargāḥ tu prameyam icchā dveṣa prayatna sukha duḥkha jñānāni ātmanaḥ liṅgam iti

ceṣṭa indriya artha āśrayaḥ śarīram ghrāṇa rasana cakṣuḥ tvac śrotrāṇi indriyāṇi bhūtebhyaḥ pṛthivī āpaḥ tejaḥ vāyuḥ ākāśam iti bhūtāni gandha rasa rūpa sparśa śabdāḥ pṛthivī ādi guṇāḥ tad arthāḥ buddhiḥ upalabdhiḥ jñānam iti anartha antaram yupagat jñāna anutpattiḥ manasaḥ liṅgam pravṛttiḥ vāc buddhi śarīra ārambhaḥ

pravartanā lakṣaṇāḥ doṣāḥ punar utpattiḥ pretyabhāvaḥ pravṛtti doṣa janitaḥ arthaḥ phalam bādhanā lakṣaṇam duḥkham tad atyanta vimokṣaḥ apavargaḥ samāna aneka dharma upapatteḥ vipratipatteḥ upalabdhi anupalabdhi avyavasthātaḥ ca viśeṣa apekṣaḥ vimarśaḥ saṃśayaḥ yam artham adhikṛtya pravartate tat prayojanam

laukika parīkṣakāṇām yasmin arthe buddhi sāmyam sa dṛṣṭa ānataḥ tantra adhikaraṇa abhyupagama saṃsthitiḥ siddhāntaḥ sa caturvidhaḥ sarva tantra pratitantra adhikaraṇa abhyupagama saṃsthiti artha antara bhāvāt sarva tantra aviruddhaḥ tantre adhikṛtaḥ arthaḥ sarva tantra siddhāntaḥ samāna tantra siddhaḥ pratantra asiddhaḥ prati tantra siddhāntaḥ

yat siddhau anya prakaraṇa siddhiḥ saḥ adhikaraṇa siddhāntaḥ aparīkṣita abhyupagamāt tad viśeṣa parīkṣaṇam abhyupagama siddhāntaḥ pratijñā hetu udāharaṇa upanaya nigamanāni avayavāḥ sādhya nirdeśaḥ pratijñā udāharaṇa sādharmyāt sādhya sādhanam hetuḥ tathā vaidharmyāt sādhya sādharmyāt tad dharma bhāvī dṛṣṭāntaḥ udāharaṇam tad viparyayāt vā viparītam udāharaṇa apekṣaḥ tathā iti upasaṃhāraḥ na tathā iti vā sādhyasya upanayaḥ hetu apadeśāt pratijñāyāḥ punarvacanam nigamanam avijñāta tattve arthe kāraṇa upapattitaḥ tattva jñāna artham ūhaḥ tarkaḥ vimṛśya pakṣa pratipakṣābhyām artha avadhāraṇam nirṇayaḥ

pramāṇa tarka sādhana upālambhaḥ siddhānta aviruddhaḥ pañca avayava upapannaḥ pakṣa pratipakṣa parigrahaḥ vādaḥ yathā ukta upapannaḥ chala ja ati nigraha sthāna sādhana upālambhaḥ jalpaḥ sa pratipakṣa sthāpanā hīnaḥ vitaṇḍā savyabhicāra viruddha prakaraṇa sama sādhya sama kāla atītāḥ hetvābhāsāḥ anaikāntikaḥ savyabhicāraḥ

siddhāntam abhyupetya tad virodhī viruddhaḥ yasmāt prakaraṇa cintā sa nirṇaya artham apadiṣṭaḥ prakaraṇa samaḥ sādhya aviśiṣṭaḥ sādhya tvāt sādhya samaḥ kāla atyaya apadiṣṭaḥ kāla atītaḥ vacana vighātaḥ artha vikalpa upapattyā chalam tat trividham vākchalam sāmānyacchalam upacāracchalam ca iti

aviśeṣa abhihite arthe vaktuḥ abhiprāyāt artha antara kalpanā vākchalam sambhavataḥ arthasya ati sāmānya yogāt asambhūta artha kalpanā sāmānyacchalam dharma vikalpa nirdeśe artha sadbhāva pratiṣedhaḥ upacāracchalam vākchalam eva upacāra chalam tat aviśeṣāt na tad artha antara bhāvāt aviṣeṣe vā kiñcid sādharmyāt eka chala prasaṅaḥ sādharmya vaidharmyābhyām pratyavasthānam jātiḥ vipratipattiḥ apratipattiḥ ca nigraha sthānam tad vikalpāt jāti nigraha sthāna bahu tvam

samāna aneka dharma adhyavasāyāt anyatara dharma adhyavasāyāt vā na saṃśayaḥ vipratipatti avyavasthā adhyavasāyāt ca vipratipattau ca sampratipatteḥ avyavasthā ātmani vyavasthita tvāt ca avyavasthāyāḥ tathā atyanta saṃśayaḥ tad dharma sātatya upapatteḥ yathā ukta adhyavasāyāt eva tad aviśeṣa apekṣāt saṃśaye na asaṃśayaḥ na atyanta saṃśayaḥ vā

yathra saṃśayaḥ tatra evam uttarottara prasaṅgaḥ pratyakṣa ādīnām aprāmāṇyam traikālya asiddheḥ pūrvam hi pramāṇa siddhau na indriya artha sannikarṣāt pratyakṣa utpattiḥ paścāt siddhau na pramāṇebhyaḥ prameya siddhiḥ yugapad siddhau pratyartha niyata tvāt krama vṛtti tva abhāvaḥ buddhīnām traikālya asiddheḥ pratiṣedha anupapattiḥ

sarva pramāṇa pratiṣedhāt ca pratiṣedha anupapattiḥ tad prāmāṇye vā na sarva pramāṇa vipratiṣedhaḥ traikālya apratiṣedhaḥ ca śabdāt ātodya siddhi vat tad siddheḥ prameyā ca tulā prāmāṇya vat pramāṇataḥ siddheḥ pramāṇānām pramāṇa antara siddhi prasaṅgaḥ tad vinivṛtteḥ vā pramāṇa siddhi vat prameya siddhiḥ

na pradīpa prakāśa siddhi vat tad siddheḥ kvacid nivṛtti darśanāt anivṛtti darśanāt ca kvacid anekāntaḥ pratyakṣa lakṣaṇa anupapattiḥ asamagra vacanāt na ātma manasoḥ sannikarṣa abhāve pratyakṣa utpattiḥ diś deśa kāla ākāśeṣu api evam prasaṅgaḥ jñāna liṅga tvāt ātmanaḥ na anavarodhaḥ tad ayaugapadya liṅga tvāt ca na manasaḥ

pratyakṣa nimitta tvāt ca indriya arthayoḥ sannikarṣasya sva śabdena vacanam supta vyāsakta manasām ca indriya arthayoḥ sannikarṣa nimitta tvāt taiḥ ca apadeśaḥ jñāna viśeṣāṇām vyāhata tvāt ahetuḥ na artha viśeṣa prābalyāt pratyakṣam anumānam eka deśa grahaṇāt upalabdheḥ na pratyakṣeṇa yāvat tāvat api upalambhāt

sādhya tvāt avayavini sandehaḥ sarva agrahaṇam avayavi asiddheḥ dhāraṇa ākarṣaṇa upapatteḥ ca senā vana vat grahaṇam iti ced na atīndriya tvāt aṇūnām rodha upaghāta sādṛśyebhyaḥ vyabhicārāt anumānam apramāṇam na eka deśa trāsa sādṛśyebhyaḥ artha antara bhāvāt vartamāna abhāvaḥ patataḥ patita patitavya kāla upapatteḥ

tayoḥ api abhāvaḥ vartamāna abhāve tad apekṣa tvāt na atīta anāgatayoḥ itaretara apekṣā siddhiḥ vartamāna abhāve sarva agrahaṇam pratyakṣa anupapatteḥ kṛta tā kartavya tā upapatteḥ tu ubhayathā grahaṇam atyanta prāya eka deśa sādharmyāt upamāna siddhiḥ prasiddha sādharmyāt upamāna siddheḥ yathā ukta doṣa anupapattiḥ

pratyakṣeṇa apratyakṣa siddheḥ na apratyakṣe gavaye pramāṇa artham upamānasya paśyāmaḥ tathā iti upasaṃhārāt upamāna siddheḥ na aviśeṣaḥ śabdaḥ anumānam arthasya anupalabdheḥ anumeya tvāt upalabdheḥ at vipravṛtti tvāt sambandhāt ca āpta upadeśa sāmarthyāt śabdāt artha sampratyayaḥ pūraṇa pradāha pāṭana anupalabdheḥ ca sambandha abhāvaḥ

śabda artha vyavasthānāt apratiṣedhaḥ na sāmāyika tvāt śabda artha sampratyayasya jāti viśeṣe ca aniyamāt tad aprāmāṇyam anṛta vyāghāta punarukta doṣebhyaḥ na karma kartṛ sādhana vaiguṇyāt abhyupetya kāla bhede doṣa vacanāt anuvāda upapatteḥ ca vākya vibhāgasya ca artha grahaṇāt vidhi artha vāda anuvāda vacana viniyogāt vidhiḥ vidhāyakaḥ stutiḥ nindā para kṛtiḥ purākalpaḥ iti artha vādaḥ vidhi vihitasya anuvacanam anuvādaḥ na anuvāda punaruktayoḥ viśeṣaḥ śabda abhyāsa upapatteḥ śīghratara gamana upadeśa vat abhyāsāt na aviśeṣaḥ mantra āyurveda prāmāṇya vat ca tad prāmāṇyam āpta prāmāṇyāt

na catuṣṭvam aitihya arthāpatti sambhava abhāva prāmāṇyāt śabdaḥ aitihya anartha antara bhāvāt anumāne arthāpatti sambhava abhāva anartha antara bhāvāt ca apratiṣedhaḥ arthāpattiḥ apramāṇam anaikāntika tvāt anartha āpattau arthāpatti abhimānāt pratiṣedha aprāmāṇyam ca anaikāntika tvāt tad prāmāṇye vā na arthāpatti aprāmāṇyam

na abhāva prāmāṇyam prameya asiddheḥ lakṣiteṣu alakṣaṇa lakṣita tvāt alakṣitānām tat prameya siddheḥ asati arthe na abhāvaḥ iti ced na anya lakṣaṇa upapatteḥ tad siddheḥ alakṣiteṣu ahetuḥ na lakṣaṇa avasthita apekṣa siddheḥ prāk utpatteḥ abhāva upapatteḥ ca ādhimat tvāt aindriyaka tvāt kṛtaka vat upacārāt ca

na ghaṭa abhāva sāmānya nitya tvāt nityeṣu api anitya vat upacārāt ca tattva bhāktayoḥ nānātvasya vibhāgāt avyabhicāraḥ santāna anumāna viśeṣaṇāt kāraṇa dravyasya pradeśa śabdena abhidhānāt prāk uccāraṇāt anupalabdheḥ āvaraṇa ādi anupalabdheḥ ca tad anupalabdheḥ anupalambhāt āvaraṇa upapattiḥ

anupalambhāt api anupalabdhi sadbhāvāt na āvaraṇa anupapattiḥ anupalambhāt anupalambha ātmaka tvāt anupalabdheḥ ahetuḥ asparśa tvāt na karma anitya tvāt na aṇu nitya tvāt sampradānāt tad antarāla anupalabdheḥ ahetuḥ adhyāpanāt apratiṣedhaḥ ubhayoḥ pakṣayoḥ anyatarasya adhyāpanāt apratiṣedhaḥ

abhyāsāt na anya tve api abhyāsasya upacārāt anyat anyasmāt ananya tvāt ananyat iti anya tā bhāvaḥ tad abhāve na asti ananya tā tayoḥ itaretara apekṣa siddheḥ vināśa kāraṇa anupalabdheḥ aśravaṇa kāraṇa anupalabdheḥ satata śravaṇa prasaṅgaḥ upalabhyamāne ca anupalabdheḥ asattvāt anapadeśaḥ pāṇi nimitta praśleṣāt śabda abhāve na anupalabdhiḥ

vināśa kāraṇa anupalabdheḥ ca avasthāne tad nitya tva prasaṅgaḥ asparśa tvāt apratiṣedhaḥ vibhakti antara upapatteḥ ca samāse vikāra ādeśa upadeśāt saṃśayaḥ prakṛti vivṛddhau vikāra vivṛddhiḥ nyūna sama adhika upalabdheḥ vikārāṇām ahetuḥ dvividhasya api hetoḥ abhāvāt asādhanam dṛṣṭāntaḥ na atulya prakṛtīnām vikāra vikalpāt

dravya vikāra vaiṣamya vat varṇa vikāra vikalpaḥ na vikāra dharma anupapatteḥ vikāra prāptānām apunar āpatteḥ suvarṇa ādīnām punar āpatteḥ ahetuḥ na tad vikārāṇām suvarṇa bhāva avyatirekāt nitya tve avikārāt anitya tve ca anavasthānāt nityānām atīndriya tvāt tad dharma vikalpāt ca varṇa vikārāṇām apratiṣedhaḥ

anavasthāyi tve ca varṇa upalabdhi vat tad vikāra utpattiḥ vikāra dharmi tve nitya tva abhāvāt kāla antare vikāra upapatteḥ ca apratiṣedhaḥ prakṛti aniyamāt aniyame niyamān na aniyamaḥ niyama aniyama virodhāt aniyame niyamāt ca apratiṣedhaḥ guṇa antara āpatti upamarda hrāsa vṛddhi leśa śleśebhyaḥ tu vikāra upapatteḥ varṇa vikārāḥ

te vibhakti antāḥ padam vyakti ākṛti jāti sannidhau upacārāt saṃśayaḥ yā śabda samūha tyāga parigraha saṅkhyā vṛddhi apacaya varṇa samāsa anubandhānām vyaktau upacārāt vyaktiḥ na tad anavasthānāt sahacaraṇa sthāna tādarthya vṛtta māna dhāraṇa sāmīpya yoga sādhana ādhipatyebhyaḥ brāhmaṇa mañca kaṭa rāja saktu candana gaṅgā śāṭaka anna puruṣeṣu atadbhāve api tad upacāraḥ ākṛtiḥ tad apekṣa tvāt sattva vyavasthāna siddheḥ vyakti ākṛti yukte api aprasaṅgāt prokṣa ādīnām mṛda gavake jātiḥ na ākṛti vyakti apekṣa tvāt jāti abhivyakteḥ vyakti ākṛti jātayaḥ tu padārthaḥ vyaktiḥ guṇa viśeṣa āśrayaḥ mūrtiḥ ākṛtiḥ jāti liṅga ākhyā samāna prasava ātmikā jātiḥ

darśana sparśanābhyām eka artha grahaṇāt na viṣaya vyavasthānāt tad vyavasthānāt eva ātma sadbhāvāt apratiṣedhaḥ śarīra dāhe pātaka abhāvāt tad abhāvaḥ sa ātmaka pradāhe api tad nitya tvāt na kārya āśraya kartṛ vadhāt savya dṛṣṭasya itareṇa pratyabhijñānāt na ekasmin nāsā asthi vyavahite dvi tva abhimānāt

eka vināśe dvitīya avināśāt na ekatvam avayava nāśe api avayavi upalabdheḥ ahetuḥ dṛṣṭānta virodhāt apratiṣedhaḥ indriya antara vikārāt na smṛteḥ smartavya viṣaya tvāt tad ātma guṇa sadbhāvāt apratiṣedhaḥ na ātma pratipatti hetūnām manasi sambhavāt jñātuḥ jñāna sādhana upapatteḥ saṃjñā bheda mātram

niyamaḥ ca niranumānaḥ pūrva abhyasta smṛti anubandhāt jātasya harṣa bhaya śoka sampratipatteḥ padma ādiṣu prabodha sammīlana vikāra vat tatvikāraḥ na uṣṇa śīta varṣā kāla nimitta tvāt pañca ātmaka vikārāṇām pretya āhāra abhyāsa kṛtāt stanya abhilāṣāt ayasaḥ ayaskānta abhigamana vat tad upasarpaṇam na anyatra pravṛtti abhāvāt

vīta rāga janma adarśanāt sa guṇa dravya utpatti vat tad utpattiḥ na saṅkalpa nimitta tvāt rāga ādīnām pārthivam guṇa antara upalabdheḥ pārthiva apya taijasam tad aguṇa upalabdheḥ niḥśvāsa ucchvāsa upalabdheḥ cāturbhautikam gandha kleda pāka vyūha avakāśa dānebhyaḥ pāñcabhautikam śruti prāmāṇyāt ca

kṛṣṇasāre sati upalambhāt vyatiricya ca upalambhāt saṃśayaḥ mahat aṇu grahaṇāt raśmi artha sannikarṣa viśeṣāt tad grahaṇam tad anupalabdheḥ ahetuḥ na anumīyamānasya pratyakṣataḥ anupalabdhiḥ abhāva hetuḥ dravya guṇa dharma bhedāt ca upalabdhi niyamaḥ aneka dravya samavāyāt rūpa viśeṣāt ca rūpa upalabdhiḥ

karma kāritaḥ ca indriyāṇām vyūhaḥ puruṣa artha tantraḥ madhyandina ulkā prakāśa anupalabdhi vat tad anupalabdhiḥ na rātrau api anupalabdheḥ bāhya prakāśa anugrahāt viṣaya upalabdheḥ anabhivyaktitaḥ anupalabdhiḥ abhivyaktau ca abhibhavāt naktañcara nayana raśmi darśanāt ca aprāpya grahaṇam kāca abhra paṭala sphaṭika antarita upalabdheḥ

kuḍya antarita anupalabdheḥ apratiṣedhaḥ apratīghātāt sannikarṣa upapattiḥ āditya raśmeḥ sphaṭika antarite api dāhye avighātāt na itara itara dharma prasaṅgāt ādarśa udakayoḥ prasāda svābhāvyāt rūpa upalabdhi vat tad upalabdhiḥ dṛṣṭa anumitānām hi niyoga pratiṣedha anupapattiḥ sthāna anya tve nānātvāt avayavi nānā sthāna tvāt ca saṃśayaḥ

tvac avyatirekāt na yugapad artha anupalabdheḥ vipratiṣedhāt ca na tvac ekā indriya artha pañcatvāt na tad artha bahu tvāt gandha tva ādi avyatirekāt gandha ādīnām apratiṣedhaḥ viṣaya tva avyatirekāt eka tvam na buddhi lakṣaṇa adhiṣṭhāna gati ākṛti jñāti pañcatvebhyaḥ bhūta guṇa viśeṣa upalabdheḥ tādātmyam

gandha rasa rūpa sparśa śabdānām sparśa paryantāḥ pṛthivyāḥ ap tejaḥ vāyūnām pūrvam pūrvam apohya ākāśasya uttaraḥ na sarva guṇa anupalabdheḥ ekaika śyena uttara uttara guṇa sadbhāvāt uttara uttarāṇām tad anupalabdhiḥ viṣṭam hi aparam pareṇa na pārthiva āpyayoḥ pratyakṣa tvāt pūrva pūrva guṇa utkarṣāt tat tat pradhānam tad vyavasthānam tu bhūyas tvāt sa guṇānām indriya bhāvāt tena eva tasya agrahaṇāt ca na śabda guṇa upalabdheḥ tad upalabdhiḥ itaretara dravya guṇa vaidharmyāt

karma ākāśa sādharmyāt saṃśayaḥ viṣaya pratyabhijñānāt sādhya sama tvāt ahetuḥ na yugapad agrahaṇāt apratyabhijñāne ca vināśa prasaṅgaḥ krama vṛtti tvāt ayugapad grahaṇam apratyabhijñānam ca viṣaya antara vyāsaṅgāt na gati abhāvāt sphaṭika anyatva abhimāna vat tad anyatva abhimānaḥ

sphaṭike api apara apara utpatteḥ kṣaṇika tvāt vyaktīnām ahetuḥ niyama hetu abhāvāt yathādarśanam abhyanujñā na utpatti vināśa kāraṇa upalabdheḥ kṣīra vināśe kāraṇa anupalabdhi vat dadhi utpatti vat ca tad upapattiḥ liṅgataḥ grahaṇāt na anupalabdhiḥ na payasaḥ pariṇāma guṇa antara prādurbhāvāt vyūha antarāt dravya antara utpatti darśanam pūrva dravya nivṛtteḥ anumānam

kvacid vināśa kāraṇa anupalabdheḥ kvacid ca upalabdheḥ anekāntaḥ na indriya arthayoḥ tad vināśe api jñāna avasthānāt yugapad jñeya anupalabdheḥ ca na manasaḥ tad ātma guṇa tve api tulyam indriyaiḥ manasaḥ sannikarṣa abhāvāt tad anutpattiḥ na utpatti kāraṇa anapadeśāt vināśa kāraṇa anupalabdheḥ ca avasthāne tad nitya tva prasaṅgaḥ

anitya tva grahāt buddheḥ buddhi antarāt vināśaḥ śabdavat jñāna samaveta ātma pradeśa sannikarṣāt manasaḥ smṛti utpatteḥ na yugapad utpattiḥ na antar śarīra vṛtti tvāt manasaḥ sādhya tvāt ahetuḥ smarataḥ śarīra dhāraṇa upapatteḥ apratiṣedhaḥ na tad ā āśu gati tvāt manasaḥ na smaraṇa kāla aniyamāt

ātma preraṇa yadṛcchā jña tābhiḥ ca na saṃyoga viśeṣaḥ vyāsakta manasaḥ pāda vyathanena saṃyoga viśeṣeṇa samānam praṇidhāna liṅga ādi jñānānām ayugapad bhāvāt yugapad asmaraṇam jñasya icchā dveṣa nimitta tvāt ārambha nivṛttyoḥ tad liṅga tvāt icchā dveṣayoḥ pārthiva ādyeṣu pratiṣedhaḥ paraśu ādiṣu ārambha nivṛtti darśanāt

niyama aniyamau tu tad viśeṣakau yathā ukta hetu tvāt pāratantryāt akṛta abhyāgamāt ca na manasaḥ pariśeṣāt yathā ukta hetu upapatteḥ ca smaraṇam tu ātmanaḥ jña svābhāvyāt p r a ṇ i d h ā n a n i b a n d h ā b h y ā s a l i ṅ g a l a k ṣ a ṇ a s ā d ṛ ś y a p a r i g r a h ā ś r a y ā ś r ita sambandha ānantarya viyoga eka kārya virodha atiśaya prāpti vyavadhāna sukha duḥkha icchā dveṣa bhaya arthi tva kriyā rāga dharma adharma nimittebhyaḥ

karma anavasthāyi grahaṇāt avyakta grahaṇam anavasthāyi tvāt vidyut sampāte rūpa avyakta grahaṇvat hetu upādanāt pratiṣeddhavyā abhyanujñā na pradīpa arciḥ santattsa bhivyakta grahaṇa vat tad grahaṇam dravye sva guṇa para guṇa upalabdheḥ saṃśayaḥ yāvat dravya bhāvi tvāt rūpa ādīnām na pāka ja guṇa antara utpatteḥ

pratidvandvi siddheḥ pāka jānām apratiṣedhaḥ śarīra vyāpi tvāt na keśa nakha ādiṣu anupalabdheḥ tvac paryanta tvāt śarīrasya keśa nakha ādiṣu aprasaṅgaḥ śarīra guna vaidharmyāt na rūpa ādīnām itaretara vaidharmyāt aindriyaka tvāt rūpa ādīnām apratiṣedhaḥ jñāna ayaugapadyāt ekam manaḥ

na yugapad aneka kriyā upalabdheḥ alāta cakra darśana vat tad upalabdhiḥ āśu sañcārāt yathā ukta hetu tvāt ca aṇu pūrva kṛta phala anubandhāt tad utpattiḥ bhūtebhyaḥ mūrti upādāna vat tad upādānam na sādhya sama tvāt na utpatti nimitta tvāt mātā pitroḥ tathā āhārasya prāptau ca aniyamāt śarīra utpatti nimitta vat saṃyoga utpatti nimittam karma etena aniyamaḥ pratyuktaḥ tat adṛṣṭa kāritam iti ced punar tad prasaṅgaḥ apavarge manaḥ karma nimitta tvāt ca saṃyoga avyucchedaḥ nitya tva prasaṅgaḥ ca prāyaṇa anupapatteḥ aṇu śyāma tā anitya tva vat etat syāt na akṛta abhyāgama prasaṅgāt

pravṛttiḥ yathā uktā tathā doṣāḥ tat trairāśyam rāga dveṣa moha artha antara bhāvāt na eka pratyanīka bhāvāt vyabhicārāt ahetuḥ teṣām mohaḥ pāpīyān na amūḍhasya itara utpatteḥ nimitta naimittika bhāvāt artha antara bhāvaḥ doṣebhyaḥ na doṣa lakṣaṇa avarodhāt mohasya nimitta naimittika upapatteḥ ca tulya jātīyānām apratiṣedhaḥ

ātma nitya tve pretyabhāva siddhiḥ vyaktāt vyaktānām pratyakṣa prāmāṇyāt na ghaṭāt ghaṭa aniṣpatteḥ vyaktāt ghaṭa niṣpatteḥ apratiṣedhaḥ abhāvāt bhāva utpattiḥ na anupamṛdya prādurbhāvāt vyāghātāt aprayogaḥ na atīta anāgatayoḥ kāraka śabda prayogāt na vinaṣṭebhyaḥ aniṣpatteḥ krama nirdeśāt apratiṣedhaḥ

īśvaraḥ kāraṇam puruṣa karma aphalya darśanāt na puruṣa karma abhāve phala aniṣpatteḥ tad kārita tvāt ahetuḥ animittataḥ bhāva utpattiḥ kaṇṭaka taikṣṇya ādi darśanāt animitta nimitta tvāt na animittataḥ nimitta animittayoḥ artha antara bhāvāt apratiṣedhaḥ sarvam anityam utpatti vināśa dharmaka tvāt

na anitya tā nitya tvāt tat anitya tvam agneḥ dāhyam vināśya anuvināśa vat nityasya apratyākhyānam yathā upalabdhi vyavasthānāt sarvam nityam pañcabhūta nitya tvāt na utpatti vināśa kāraṇa upalabdheḥ tad lakṣaṇa avarodhāt apratiṣedhaḥ na utpatti tad kāraṇa upalabdheḥ na vyavasthā anupapatteḥ sarvam pṛthak bhāva lakṣaṇa pṛthaktvāt

na aneka lakṣaṇaiḥ eka bhāva niṣpatteḥ lakṣaṇa vyavasthānāt eva apratiṣedhaḥ sarvam abhāvaḥ bhāveṣu itaretarābhāva siddheḥ na svabhāva siddheḥ bhāvānām na svabhāva siddhiḥ āpekṣika tvāt vyāhata tvāt ayuktam saṅkhyā ekānta asiddhiḥ kāraṇa anupapatti upapattibhyām na kāraṇa avayava bhāvāt

niravayava tvāt ahetuḥ sadyas kāla antare ca phala niṣpatteḥ saṃśayaḥ kāla antareṇa aniṣpattiḥ hetu vināśāt prāk niṣpatteḥ vṛkṣa phala vat tat syāt na āsat na san na sat asat sat asatoḥ vaidharmyāt utpāda vyaya darśanāt buddhi siddham tu tat asat āśraya vyatirekāt vṛkṣa phala utpatti vat iti ahetuḥ

prīteḥ ātma āśraya tvāt apratiṣedhaḥ na putra paśu strī paricchada hiraṇya anna ādi phala nirdeśāt tad sambandhāt phala niṣpatteḥ teṣu phalavat upacāraḥ vividha bādhana ayogāt duḥkham eva janma utpattiḥ na sukhasya antarāla niṣpatteḥ bādhanā nivṛtteḥ vedayataḥ paryeṣaṇa doṣāt apratiṣedhaḥ duḥkha vikalpe sukha abhimānāt ca

ṛṇa kleśa pravṛtti anubandhāt apavarga abhāvaḥ pradhāna śabda anupapatteḥ guṇa śabdena anuvādaḥ nindā praśaṃsā upapatteḥ samāropaṇāt ātmani apratiṣedhaḥ pātra caya anta anupapatteḥ ca phala abhāvaḥ suṣuptasya svapna adarśane kleśa abhāvāt apavargaḥ na pravṛttiḥ pratisandhānāya hīna kleśasya na kleśa santateḥ svābhāvika tvāt prāk utpatteḥ abhāva anitya tva vat svābhāvike api anitya tvam aṇu śyāma tā antya tva vat vā na saṅkalpa nimitta tvāt ca rāga ādīnām

doṣa nimittānām tattva jñānāt ahaṅkāra nivṛttiḥ doṣa nimittam rūpa ādayaḥ viṣayāḥ saṅkalpa kṛtāḥ tad nimittam tu avayavi abhimānaḥ vidyā avidyā dvaividhyāt saṃśayaḥ tad asaṃśayaḥ pūrva hetu prasiddha tvāt vṛtti anupapatteḥ api na saṃśayaḥ kṛtsna eka deśa avṛtti tvāt avayavānām avayavi abhāvaḥ

teṣu ca āvṛtteḥ avayavi abhāvaḥ pṛthak ca avayavebhyaḥ avṛtteḥ na ca avayavi avayavāḥ ekasmin bheda abhāvāt bheda śabda prayoga anupapatteḥ apraśnaḥ avayava antara bhāve api avṛtteḥ ahetuḥ keśa samūhe taimirika upalabdhi vat tad upalabdhiḥ sva viṣayān atikrameṇa indiḥ yasya paṭu manda bhāvāt viṣaya grahaṇasya tathā abhāvaḥ na aviṣaye pravṛttiḥ

avayava avayavi prasaṅgaḥ ca evam ā pralayāt na pralayaḥ anusadbhāvāt param vā truṭeḥ ākāśa vyatibhedāt tad anupapattiḥ ākāśa asarva gata tvam vā antar bahis ca kārya dravyasya kāraṇa antara vacanāt akārye tad abhāvaḥ śabda saṃyoga vibhavāt ca sarva gatam avyūha aviṣṭambha vibhu tvāni ca ākāśa dharmāḥ

mūrtimatām ca saṃsthāna upapatteḥ avayava sadbhāvaḥ saṃyoga upapatteḥ ca anavasthā kāri tvāt anavasthā anupapatteḥ ca apratiṣedhaḥ buddhyā vivecanāt tu bhāvānām yāthātmya anupalabdhiḥ tantu apakarṣaṇe paṭa sadbhāva anupalabdhi vat tad anupalabdhiḥ vyāhata tvāt ahetuḥ tad āśraya tvāt apṛthak grahaṇam

pramāṇataḥ ca artha pratipatteḥ pramāṇa anupapatti upapattibhyām svapna viṣaya abhimāna vat ayam pramāṇa prameya abhimānaḥ māyā gandharvanagara mṛgatṛṣṇikā vat vā hetu abhāvāt asiddhiḥ smṛti saṅkalpa vat ca svapna viṣaya abhimānaḥ mithyā upalabdhi vināśaḥ tattva jñānāt svapna viṣaya abhimāna praṇāśa vat pratibodhe

buddheḥ ca evam nimitta sadbhāva upalambhāt tattva pradhāna bhedāt ca mithyā buddheḥ dvaividhya upapattiḥ samādhi viśeṣa abhyāsāt na artha viśeṣa prābalyāt kṣudh ādibhiḥ pravartanāt ca pūrva kṛta phala anubandhāt tad utpattiḥ araṇya guhā pulina ādiṣu yoga abhyāsa upadeśaḥ apavarge api evam prasaṅgaḥ

na niṣpanna avaśyambhāvi tvāt tad abhāvaḥ ca apavarge tad artham yama niyamābhyām ātma saṃskāraḥ yogāt ca adhyātma vidhi upāyaiḥ jñāna grahaṇa abhyāsaḥ tad vidyaiḥ ca saha saṃvādaḥ tam śiṣya guru sabrahmacāri viśiṣṭa śreyaḥ arthibhiḥ anasūyibhiḥ abhyupeyāt pratipakṣa hīnam api vā prayojana artham arthi tve tattva adhyavasāya saṃrakṣaṇa artham jalpa vitaṇḍe bīja praroha saṃrakṣaṇa artham kaṇṭaka śākhā āvaraṇa vat tābhyām vigṛhya kathanam

s ā d h a r m y a v a i d h a r m y o t k a r ṣ ā p a k a r ṣ a v a r ṇ y ā v a r ṇ y a v i k a l p a s ā d h y aprāpti aprāpti prasaṅga pratidṛṣṭānta an utpatti saṃśaya prakaraṇā hetu artha apatti aviśeṣa upapatti upalabdhi anupalabdhi anitya nitya kārya samāḥ sādharmya vaidharmyābhyām upasaṃhāre tad dharma viparyaya upapatteḥ sādharmya vaidharmya samau go tvāt go siddhi vat tad siddhiḥ

sādhya dṛṣṭāntayoḥ dharma vikalpāt ubhaya sādhya tvāt ca utkarṣa apakarṣa varṇyāvarṇya vikalpa sādhya samāḥ kiñcid sādharmyāt upasaṃhāra siddheḥ vaidharmyāt apratiṣedhaḥ sādhya atideśāt ca dṛṣṭānta upapatteḥ prāpya sādhyam aprāpya vā hetoḥ prāptyā viśiṣṭa tvāt aprāpti ā asādhaka tvāt ca prāpti aprāpti samau

ghaṭa ādi niṣpatti darśanāt pīḍane ca abhicārāt apratiṣedhaḥ dṛṣṭāntasya kāraṇa anapadeśāt pratyavasthānāt ca pratidṛṣṭāntena prasaṅga pratidṛṣṭānta samau pradīpa upādāna prasaṅga vinivṛtti vat tad vinivṛttiḥ pratidṛṣṭānta hetu tve ca na ahetuḥ dṛṣṭāntaḥ prāk utpatteḥ kāraṇa abhāvāt anutpatti samaḥ

tathā abhāvāt utpannasya kāraṇa upapatteḥ na kāraṇa pratiṣedhaḥ sāmānya dṛṣṭāntayoḥ aindriyaka tve samāne nitya anitya sādharmyāt saṃśaya samaḥ sādharmyāt saṃśaye na saṃśayaḥ vaidharmyāt ubhayathā vā saṃśaye atyanta saṃśaya prasaṅgaḥ nitya tva anabhyupagamāt ca sāmānyasya apratiṣedhaḥ ubhaya sādharmyāt prakriyā siddheḥ prakaraṇa samaḥ

pratipakṣāt prakaraṇa siddheḥ pratiṣedha anupapattiḥ pratipakṣa upapatteḥ traikālya asiddheḥ hetoḥ ahetu samaḥ na hetutaḥ sādhya siddheḥ traikālya asiddhiḥ pratiṣeda anupapatteḥ ca pratiṣeddhavya apratiṣedhaḥ arthāpattitaḥ pratipakṣa siddheḥ arthāpatti samaḥ anuktasya arthāpatteḥ pakṣa hāneḥ upapattiḥ anukta tvāt anaika ānatika tvāt ca arthāpatteḥ

eka dharma upapatteḥ aviśeṣe sarva aviśeṣa prasaṅgāt sadbhāva aupapatteḥ aviśeṣa samaḥ kvacid tad dharma upapatteḥ kvacid ca anupapatteḥ pratiṣedha abhāvaḥ ubhaya kāraṇa upapatteḥ upapatti samaḥ upapatti kāraṇa abhyanujñānāt apratiṣedhaḥ nirdiṣṭa kāraṇa abhāve api upalambhāt upalabdhi samaḥ kāraṇa antarāt api tad dharma upapatteḥ apratiṣedhaḥ

tad anupalabdheḥ anupalambhāt abhāva siddhau tad viparīta upapatteḥ anupalabdhi samaḥ anupalambha ātmaka tvāt anupalabdheḥ ahetuḥ jñāna vikalpānām ca bhāva abhāva saṃvedanāt adhyātmam sādharmyāt tulya dharma upapatteḥ sarva anitya tva prasaṅgāt anitya samaḥ sādharmyāt asiddheḥ pratiṣedha asiddhiḥ pratiṣedhya sādharmyāt

dṛṣṭānte ca sādhya sādhana bhāvena prajñātasya dharmasya hetu tvāt tasya ca ubhayatha abhāvāt na aviśeṣaḥ nityam anitya bhāvāt anitye nitya tva upapatteḥ nitya samaḥ pratiṣedhye nityam anitya bhāvāt anitye anitya tva upapatteḥ pratiṣedha abhāvaḥ prayatna kārya aneka tvāt kārya samaḥ kārya anya tve prayatna ahetu tvam anupalabdhi kāraṇa upapatteḥ pratiṣedhe api samānaḥ doṣaḥ sarvatra evam pratiṣedha vipratiṣedhe pratiṣedha doṣa vat doṣaḥ pratiṣedham sa doṣam abhyupetya pratiṣedha vipratiṣedhe samānaḥ doṣa prasaṅgaḥ mata anujñā sva pakṣa lakṣaṇa apekṣā upapatti upasaṃhāre hetu nirdeśe para pakṣa doṣa abhyupagamāt samānaḥ doṣaḥ

pratijñāhāniḥ pratijñāntaram pratijñā virodhaḥ pratijñāsannyāsaḥ hetu antaram artha antaram nirarthakam avijñāta artham apārthakam aprāpta kālam nyūnam adhikam punaruktam ananubhāṣaṇam ajñānam apratibhā vikṣepaḥ mata anujñā paryanuyojya upekṣaṇam niranuyojya anuyogaḥ apasiddhāntaḥ hetvābhāsāḥ ca nigraha sthānāni

pratidṛṣṭānta dharma abhyanujñā sva dṛṣṭānte pratijñāhāniḥ pratijñāta artha pratiṣedhe dharma vikalpāt tad artha nirdeśaḥ pratijñāntaram pratijñā hetvoḥ virodhaḥ pratijñā virodhaḥ pakṣa pratiṣedhe pratijñāta artha apanayanam pratijñāsannyāsaḥ aviśeṣa ukte hetau pratiṣiddhe viśeṣam icchataḥ hetu antaram

prakṛtāt arthāt apratisambaddha artham artha antaram varṇa krama nirdeśa vat nirarthakam pariṣad prativādibhyām tris abhihitam api avijñātam avijñāta artham paurvāparya ayogāt apratisambaddha artham apārthakam avayava viparyāsa vacanam aprāpta kālam hīnam anyatamena api avayavena nyūnam hetu udāharaṇa adhikam adhikam

śabda arthayoḥ punar vacanam punar uktam anyatra anuvādāt arthāt āpannasya sva śabdena punarvacanam vijñātasya pariṣadā tris abhihitasya api apratyuccāraṇam ananubhāṣaṇam avijñātam ca ajñānam uttarasya apratipattiḥ apratibhā kārya vyāsaṅgāt kathā vicchedaḥ vikṣepaḥ sva pakṣe doṣa abhyupagamāt para pakṣe doṣa prasaṅgaḥ mata anujñā nigraha sthāna prāptasya anigrahaḥ paryanuyojya upekṣaṇam anigraha sthāne nigraha sthāna abhiyogaḥ niranuyojya anuyogaḥ siddhāntam abhyupetya aniyamāt kathā prasaṅgaḥ apasiddhāntaḥ hetvābhāsāḥ ca yathā uktāḥ

duḥkha trayā abhighātāt jijñāsā tad apaghātake hetau dṛṣṭe sāpā arthā ced na aikā antā atyantataḥ abhāvāt dṛṣṭa vat ānuśravikaḥ sa hi aviśuddhi kṣayā atiśaya yuktaḥ tad viparītaḥ śreyān vyaktā avyakta jña vijñānāt mūlaprakṛtiḥ avikṛtiḥ mahat ādyāḥ prakṛti vikṛtayaḥ sapta ṣoḍaśakaḥ tu vikāraḥ na prakṛtiḥ na vikṛtiḥ puruṣaḥ

dṛṣṭam anumānam āpta vacanam ca sarva pramāṇa siddha tvāt trividham pramāṇam iṣṭam prameya siddhiḥ pramāṇāt dhi prativiṣayā adhyavasāyaḥ dṛṣṭam trividham anumānam ākhyātam tat liṅga liṅgi pūrvakam āpta śrutiḥ āpta vacanam tu sāmānyatas tu dṛṣṭāt atī andriyāṇām pratītiḥ anumānāt tasmāt api cā asiddham paraḥ akṣam āpta āgamāt siddham

ati dūrāt sāmīpyāt indriya ghātāt manaḥ anavasthānāt saukṣmyāt vyavadhānāt abhibhavāt samānā abhihārāt ca saukṣmyāt tad anupalabdhiḥ nā abhāvāt kāryataḥ tad upalabdhiḥ mahat ādi tat ca kāryam prakṛti virūpam sarūpam ca asat akaraṇāt upādāna grahaṇāt sarva sambhavā abhāvāt śaktasya śakya karaṇāt kāraṇa bhāvāt ca satkāryam

hetumat anityam avyāpi sa kriyam anekam āśritam liṅgam sā avayavam paratantram vyaktam viparītam avyaktam triguṇam aviveki viṣayaḥ sāmānyam acetanam prasava dharmi vyaktam tathā pradhānam tad viparītaḥ tathā ca pumān prīti aprīti viṣāda ātmakāḥ prakāśa pravṛtti niyamā arthāḥ anyaḥ anyā abhibhava āśraya janana mithuna vṛttayaḥ ca guṇāḥ

sattvam laghu prakāśakam iṣṭam upaṣṭambhakam calam ca rajaḥ guru varaṇakam eva tamaḥ pradīpa vat cā arthataḥ vṛttiḥ aviveki ādi hi siddham traiguṇyāt tad viparyayā abhāvāt kāraṇa guṇa ātmaka tvāt kāryasyāḥ avyaktam api siddham bhedānām parimāṇāt samanvayāt śaktitaḥ pravṛtteḥ ca kāraṇa kārya vibhāgāt avibhāgāt vaiśvarūpasya

kāraṇam asti avyaktam pravartate triguṇataḥ samudayāt ca pariṇāmataḥ salila vat prati prati guṇa āśraya viśeṣāt saṃghāta parā artha tvāt triguṇa ādi viparyayāt adhiṣṭhānāt puruṣaḥ asti bhoktṛ bhāvāt kaivalyā artham pravṛtteḥ ca janana maraṇa karaṇānām pratiniyamāt ayugapad pravṛtteḥ ca puruṣa bahu tvam siddham traiguṇya viparyayāt ca aiva

tasmāt ca viparyāsāt siddham sākṣi tvam asya puruṣasya kaivalyam mādhyasthyam draṣṭṛ tvam akartṛ bhāvaḥ ca tasmāt tad saṃyogāt acetanam cetanāvat iva liṅgam guṇa kartṛ tve ca tathā kartā iva bhavati udāsīnaḥ puruṣasya darśanā artham kaivalyā artham tathā pradhānasya paṅgu andha vat ubhayoḥ api saṃyogaḥ tad kṛtaḥ sargaḥ

prakṛteḥ mahān tatas aham kāras tasmāt gaṇaḥ ca ṣoḍaśakaḥ tasmāt api ṣoḍaśakāt pañcabhyaḥ pañca bhūtāni adhyavasāyaḥ buddhiḥ dharmaḥ jñānam virāga aiśvaryam sāttvikam etat rūpam tāmasam asmāt viparyastam abhimānaḥ ahaṃkāraḥ tasmāt dvividhaḥ pravartate sargaḥ ekādaśakaḥ ca gaṇaḥ tanmātraḥ pañcakaḥ ca aiva

sāttvikaḥ ekādaśakaḥ pravartate vaikṛtāt ahaṃkārāt bhūtādeḥ tanmātraḥ sa tāmasaḥ taijasāt ubhayam buddhī andriyāṇi cakṣuḥ śrotra ghrāṇa rasana tvac ākhyāni vāc pāṇi pāda pāyū apasthān karm aā indriyāni āhuḥ ubhaya ātmakam atra manaḥ saṃkalpakam indriyam ca sādharmyāt guṇa pariṇāma viśeṣāt nānātvam bāhya bhedāt ca

śabda ādiṣu pañcānām ālocana mātram iṣyate vṛttiḥ vacana ādāna viharaṇa utsarga ānandāḥ ca pañcānām svālakṣaṇyam vṛttiḥ trayasya sā eṣā bhavati asāmānyā sāmānya karaṇa vṛttiḥ prāṇa ādyāḥ vāyavaḥ pañca yugapad catuṣṭayasya tu vṛttiḥ kramaśas ca tasya nirdiṣṭā dṛṣṭe tathā api adṛṣṭe trayasya tad pūrvikā vṛttiḥ

svām svām pratipadyante paraspara ākūta hetukām vṛttim puruṣā arthaḥ eva hetuḥ na kena cit kāryate karaṇam karaṇam trayodaśavidham tat āharaṇa dhāraṇa prakāśa karam kāryam ca tasya daśadhā āhāryam dhāryam prakāśyam ca antaḥkaraṇam trividham daśadhā bāhyam trayasya viṣaya ākhyam sāmprata kālam bāhyam tri kālam ābhyantaram karaṇam

buddhī andriyāṇi teṣām pañca viśeṣā aviśeṣa viṣayāṇi vāc bhavati śabda viṣayā śeṣāṇi tu pañca viṣayāṇi sā antaḥkaraṇā buddhiḥ sarvam viṣayam avagāhate yasmāt tasmāt trividham karaṇam dvāri dvārāṇi śeṣāṇi ete pradīpa kalpāḥ paraspara vilakṣaṇāḥ guṇa viśeṣāḥ kṛtsnam puruṣasyāḥ artham prakāśya buddhau prayacchanti

sarvam pratyupabhogam yasmāt puruṣasya sādhayati buddhiḥ sā eva ca viśinaṣṭi punar pradhāna puruṣā antaram sūkṣmam tanmātrāṇi aviśeṣāḥ tebhyaḥ bhūtāni pañca pañcabhyaḥ ete smṛtāḥ viśeṣāḥ śāntāḥ ghorāḥ ca mūḍhāḥ ca sūkṣmāḥ mātā pitṛ jāḥ saha prabhūtaiḥ tridhā viśeṣāḥ syuḥ sūkṣmāḥ teṣām niyatāḥ mātā pitṛ jāḥ nivartante
