yaḥ tu dīpa indriyāṇām tṛtīyā nirdeśaḥ sa phala upajananā vinābhāvi svabhāva tva ākhya sāmagrī sarūpa samāropaṇa nibandhanaḥ anyatra api ca tad rūpa samāropeṇa sthālyā pacati iti vyapadeśaḥ dṛśyate eva tasmāt antargata kāraka apekṣayā labdha karaṇa bhāvā sāmagrī pramāṇam

apare punar ācakṣate sāmagrī nāma samuditāni kārakāṇi teṣām dvairūpyam ahṛdayaṅgamam atha ca tāni eva pṛthak avasthitāni karma ādi bhāvam bhajante atha ca tāni eva samuditāni karaṇībhavanti iti kaḥ ayam nayaḥ tasmāt kartṛ karma vyatiriktam avyabhicāra ādi viśeṣaṇaka artha pramājanakam kārakam karaṇam ucyate tat eva tṛtīyayā vyapadiśanti dīpena paśyāmi cakṣuṣā nirīkṣe liṅgena buddhye śabdena jānāmi manasā niścinomi iti nanu trīṇi eva kārakāṇi asmin pakṣe bhaveyuḥ jñāna kriyāyām tāvat evam eva etat yathā bhavān āha pāka ādi kriyāsu kriyā āśraya dhāraṇa ādi upakāra bheda paryālocanayā bhavatu adhikaraṇa ādi kāraka antara vyavahāraḥ pramitau tu manaḥ dīpa cakṣuḥ ādeḥ na lakṣyate viśeṣaḥ iti tat sarvam karaṇa tvena sammatam

kaḥ teṣu tam avarthaḥ iti ced asti kaścid yat ayam lokaḥ aham mayā jānāmi ghaṭena ghaṭam jānāmi iti na kartṛ karmaṇī vismṛtya api karaṇa tvena vyapadiśati nayana manaḥ dīpa śabda liṅgāni tu tathā vyapadiśati saḥ ayam eṣām paśyati kartṛ karma vailakṣaṇyam cakṣuḥ ādīnām tad vailakṣaṇyam eva ca teṣām atiśayaḥ iti tat ayam iha pramāṇam pramātā prameyam pramitiḥ iti caturvargaḥ eva vyavahāraḥ parisamāpyate tasmāt kartṛ karma vilakṣaṇā saṃśaya viparyaya rahita artha bodha vidhāyinī bodhābodha svabhāvā sāmagrī pramāṇam iti yuktam

ye tu bodhasya eva pramāṇa tvam ācakṣate na sūkṣma darśinaḥ te bodhaḥ khalu pramāṇasya phalam na sākṣāt pramāṇam karaṇa artha abhidhānaḥ hi pramāṇa śabdaḥ pramīyate anena iti pramāṇam pramīyate iti kaḥ arthaḥ pramā janyate iti pramāṇāt avagacchāmaḥ iti vadantaḥ laukikāḥ karaṇasya eva prāmāṇyam anumanyante yaḥ tu pramā pramāṇam iti pramāṇa śabdaḥ sa pramāṇa phale draṣṭavyaḥ tathā ca saṃśaya viparyaya ātmakam apramāṇa phalam api jñānam ātma manaḥ anumāne tad viśeṣaṇa artha paricchede vā viśiṣṭa pramā jananāt pramāṇa tām pratipadyate avyabhicāra ādi viśeṣaṇa upapannam api jñānam aphala janakam apramāṇam eva kevala pramā svabhāvam pramāṇāt vibhinnam phalam iti pratyakṣa lakṣaṇe vakṣyāmaḥ

atha vyatirikta phala janakam api bodha rūpam eva pramāṇam ucyate tat ayuktam sakala jagat vidita bodha itara svabhāva śabda liṅga dīpa indriya ādi parihāra prasaṅgāt tasmāt sāmagrī anupraviṣṭaḥ bodhaḥ viśeṣaṇa jñānam iva kvacid pratyakṣe liṅga jñānam iva liṅgi pramitau sārūpya darśanam iva upamāne śabda śravaṇam iva tad artha jñāne pramāṇa tām pratipadyate atas eva bodhā bodha svabhāvā sāmagrī pramāṇam iti uktam

anye tu tulya sāmagrī adhīnayoḥ jñāna arthayoḥ grāhya gāhaka bhāvam vadantaḥ bodham pramāṇam abhyupāgaman kṣaṇa bhaṅgiṣu padārtheṣu saha kārī upādāna kāraṇa apekṣa kṣaṇa antara santati jananena ca lokayātrām udvahatsu jñāna janmani jñānam upādāna kāraṇam arthaḥ sahakāri kāraṇam artha janmani ca arthaḥ upādānakāraṇam jñānam ca sahakāri kāraṇam iti jñānam ca jñāna artha janyam arthaḥ ca artha jñāna janyaḥ bhavati iti evam ekasāmagrī adhīna tayā tam artham avyabhicarataḥ jñānasya tatra prāmāṇyam iti

tat idam anupapannam aphala janakasya pramāṇa tva anupapatteḥ iti ukta tvāt api ca karmaṇi jñānam pramāṇam iṣyate yathā uktam sa vyāpāram iva ābhāti vyāpāreṇa sva karmaṇi iti sa ca ayam artha kṣaṇaḥ jñāna sama kālaḥ tatas pūrvābhyām jñāna artha lakṣaṇābhyām upajanitaḥ iti tad karma tām pratipadyatām na punar sva samāna kāla prasūta jñāna kṣaṇa karma tām iti

nanu ca tulya sāmagrī adhīna tayā samāna kāla tayā ca tat avyabhicāra siddhau satyām kva karma tvam upayujyate hanta tarhi saha utpannayoḥ samāna sāmagrīkayoḥ grāhya grāhaka niyamaḥ kiṃkṛtaḥ iti vaktavyam jñānam sva prakāśa svabhāvam iti grāham arthaḥ jaḍa ātmā iti grāhyam iti ced ayam api viśeṣaḥ tulya kālayoḥ kutastyaḥ upādāna sahakāri kāraṇa bhedāt iti ced na tasya kṣaṇa bhaṅga bhaṅge nirākariṣyamāṇa tvāt

ye api nirākārasya bodha svarūpasya nīla pīta ādi aneka viṣaya sādhāraṇa tvāt janakatvasya ca cakṣuḥ ādau api bhāvena atiprasaṅgāt tad ākāra tva kṛtam eva jñāna karma niyamam avagacchantaḥ sa ākāram jñānam pramāṇam iti pratipedire te api vijñāna advaitasiṣā dhayiṣayā evam abhidadhānāḥ tad nirāsa prasaṅgaḥ eva nirasiṣyante na hi ekam eva sa ākāram jñānam grāhyam grāhakam ca bhavitum arhati iti vakṣyate

arthaḥ tu sa ākāra jñāna vādinaḥ na samasti eva sa hi anumeyaḥ vā syāt pratyakṣaḥ vā na anumeyaḥ sambandha grahaṇa abhāvāt arthe hi sati sa ākāram nirākāram tat atyaye nitya anumeya bāhya artha vādī jñānam kva dṛṣṭavān na api pratyakṣaḥ arthaḥ ākāra dvaya anupalambhāt abhyupagame ca anavasthā prasaṅgāt artha ākāraḥ hi nirākāra jñāna gamyaḥ na bhavati iti jñānena ākāravatā gṛhyate saḥ ayam idānīm jñāna ākāraḥ api grāhya tvāt anyena ākāravatā gṛhyate saḥ api anyena iti

atha vai arthaḥ nirākāra jñāna grāhya tām na upayāti iti sva grāhake jñāna ātmani samarpita ātmā bhavati iti sa ākāram jñānam eva idam saṃpannam iti punar arthaḥ anyaḥ kalpanīyaḥ saḥ api grāhya tvāt sva grāhakasya sa ākāra tva siddhaye tatra eva līyate iti sa ākāram jñānam eva avaśiṣyate iti punar anyaḥ arthaḥ iti ittham anavasthā pratikarma vyavasthā tu janakatva nibandhanā bhaviṣyati vastu svabhāvasya aparyanuyojya tvāt sa ākāra pakṣe api paryanuyoga sāmyam ityādi sarvam upariṣṭāt sa vistaram abhidhāsyate sa ākāra pakṣe api ca na pramāṇāt vyatiriktam phalam upadarśitam iti asat pakṣaḥ eva ayam

śāvarāḥ tu bruvate yaḥ ete bodha prāmāṇya vādinaḥ vijñānāt abhinnam eva phalam abhidadhati te bāḍham nirasanīyāḥ bhavanti eva vayam tu vijñānāt bhinnam eva phalam dṛṣṭatā ākhyam abhyupagacchāmaḥ tena eva tat anumīyate jñānam hi nāma kriyā ātmakam kriyā ca phala anumeyā jñātṛ vyāpāram antareṇa phala aniṣpatteḥ

saṃsargaḥ api kārakāṇām kriyā garbhaḥ eva bhavati tad anabhyupagame kim adhikṛtya kārakāṇi saṃsṛjyeran na ca asaṃsṛṣṭāni tāni phalavanti kriyā veśavaśāt ca kārakam kārakam bhavati aparathā hi tat vastu svarūpa mātram eva syāt na kārakam tatas ca na phala arthibhiḥ upādīyeta iti vyavahāra vilopaḥ tasmāt yathā hi kārakāṇi taṇḍula salila anala sthālya ādīni siddha svabhāvāni sādhyam dhātu artham ekam pāka lakṣaṇa m urarīkṛtya saṃsṛjyante saṃsṛṣṭāni ca kriyām utpādayanti tathā aatma indriya manaḥ artha sannikarṣe sati jñāna ākhyaḥ vyāpāraḥ upajāyate sa ca na pratyakṣaḥ

arthasya eva bahis deśa sambaddhasya grahaṇāt ākāra dvaya pratibhāsā bhāvāt agṛhītasya api tasya cakṣuḥ ādi vat upāya tvāt parokṣaḥ api ca asau viṣaya prakāśa tā lakṣaṇena phalena kalpyate tat āha bhāṣya kāraḥ na hi ajñāte arthe kaścid buddhim upalabhate jñāte tu anumānāt avagacchati iti vārtika kṛtā api uktam na anyathā hi artha sadbhāvaḥ dṛṣṭa ssannupapadyate jñānam ced na iti atas paścāta pramāṇam upakalpyate iti tat eṣa phala anumeyaḥ jñātṛ vyāpāraḥ jñāna ādi śabda vācyaḥ pramāṇam indriya ādīnām tu tad utpādaka tayā indriya vyāpāre jñānam upacarati na sākṣāt iti

atra pratividhīyate aho bata ime kebhyaḥ bibhyataḥ śrotriyāḥ param kim api vaiklavyam upāgatāḥ na khalu nityam parokṣam jñānam bhavitum arhati jñātaḥ arthaḥ iti kvacid tad dvi śiṣṭa artha pratyavamarśa darśanāt viśeṣaṇa agrahaṇe śuklaḥ paṭaḥ iti vat viśiṣṭa pratīteḥ anutpādāt kaḥ ca ayam iyān saṃtrāsaḥ viṣaya grahaṇa kāle vijñāna agrahaṇa mātrakeṇa bāhya artha nihnava vādinaḥ śākyāḥ śakyāḥ śamayitum
yat tu kriyā svabhāva tvāt tasya parokṣa tvam tat ayuktam na hi kriyā svabhāvam jñānam api tu phala svabhāvam eva

api ca kriyā api pratyakṣa dravya vartinī pratyakṣā eva bhāṭṭānām pratyakṣaḥ ca ātmā tat kim anena aparāddham yat etat īya kriyāyāḥ apratyakṣa tvam ucyate na ca utkṣepaṇa ādi bheda bhinna parispanda ātmaka vyāpāra vyatirekeṇa bāhya kārakeṣu api sūkṣmā nāma kācid asti kriyā sā hi yadi nityāḥ jāti vat atha anityāḥ rūpavat vastu dharmaḥ iṣyeta tatra yadi nityā tarhi sarvadā vastunaḥ kriyā yogāt sarvadā phala niṣpatti prasaṅgaḥ atha kāraka nirvartyā kriyā sā api idānīm kāryatvāt sa vyāpāra kāraka kāryā bhavet iti anavasthā niṣkriya kāraka kārya tve tu kriyām iva phalam api niṣkriyāṇi eva kārakāṇi kuryuḥ iti kim kriyayā

nanu karoti iti kārakam kriyā aaveśam antareṇa ca kāraka tva anupapattiḥ satyam karoti iti kārakam tat tu phalam eva karoti na kriyām nanu karoti iti yat brūṣe seya muktā eva kriyā bhavati caitraḥ kaṭam karoti iti caitrasya iva kaṭasya iva karoti arthasya apratyākhyeya tvāt tad kṛtam eva caitra ādīnām kāraka tvam ucyate na ati indriya kriyā yoga nibandhanaḥ kāraka bhāvaḥ kriyāyāḥ atīndriya tvena tad yoga kṛta kāraka tvān adhigame vyavahāra vipralopa prasaṅgāt kriyā aaveśa kṛtam hi tad kāraka tvam anavagacchantaḥ katham phala arthinaḥ tad upādadīran

mad pakṣe kāraka tvam hi na asti kiñcid ati indriyam kāraka tvam svarūpasya saha kārya ādi sannidhiḥ tāvat eva viniścitya tat upādīyate arthibhiḥ tat eva upādadānaiḥ ca phalam api adhigamyate nirvyāpārasya sattvasya kaḥ guṇaḥ saha kāribhiḥ sa vya apārasya sattvasya kaḥ guṇaḥ saha kāribhiḥ atha vyāpāraḥ eva eṣa sarvaissambhūya sādhyate kim phalena aparāddham vaḥ tat hi sambhūya sādhyatām

yat tu karoti arthasya apratyākhyeya tvāt iti uktam tatra ucyate pari spandaḥ eva bhautikaḥ vyāpāraḥ karoti arthaḥ na hi vayam parispanda ātmakam paridṛśyamānam vyāpāram apahnumahe pratikārakam vicitrasya jvalana ādeḥ vyāpārasya pratyakṣam upalambhāt atīndriyaḥ tu vyāpāraḥ na asti iti brūmahe

nanu pākaḥ nāma dhātu arthaḥ paridṛśyamāna jvalana ādi vyāpāra vyatiriktaḥ eṣitavyaḥ eva tam antareṇa phala niṣpatteḥ abhāvāt asati ca tasmin kim adhikṛtya kārakāṇi saṃsṛjyeran iti uktam tat ayuktam yam tam ekam dhātu artham sādhyam budhyase sa kim samudita sakala kāraka sampādyaḥ ekaika kāraka nirvartyaḥ vā tatra ādya pakṣaḥ ekaikam bhavet kārakam akriyam ekaika niṣkriya tve ca sākalye api kutas kriyā uttarasmin pakṣe pratyekam api pāka kriyā yogāt kāraka antara nirapekṣāt ekasmāt kārakāt phala niṣpatti prasaṅgaḥ na ca tathāvidha dhātu artha purassaraḥ kārakāṇām saṃsargaḥ

kriyā nimitta saṃsarga vādinaḥ hi dvayī gatiḥ satyām kriyāyām sambandhaḥ sambandhe sati vā kriyā melanāt pūrva siddhāyām kriyāyām melanena kim tathā ca janyeta phalam vibhaktaiḥ api kārakaiḥ melanāt tu kriyā siddhau punar ekaikam akriyam tathā sati na kāṣṭhāni jvaleyuḥ piṭharāt vinā nanu piṭharāt vinā kāṣṭhāni jvalanti na tu pacanti mā evam sati api piṭhare jvalanti eva kāṣṭhāni na anyat kurvanti dṛśyante tasmāt kriyā antara abhāvāt phalam eva urarīkṛtya kārakāṇi saṃsṛjyante

nanu phalam api siddham ced kaḥ sarveṣām siddha svabhāvānām sambandhaḥ phalam siddham kārakāṇi siddhāni iti sambandha abhāvaḥ sādhyam ced phalam sā eva kriyā parispanda vyatiriktā iti mā evam vocaḥ phalasya kriyā tva anupapatteḥ odanam hi phalam na kriyā kriyā nāmni tu kriyamāṇe na vivadāmahe

nanu pākaḥ idānīm kaḥ na ca paceḥ vāci aśūnyatā eva yuktā ucyate samudita devadatta ādi sakala kāraka nikara parispandaḥ eva viśiṣṭa phala avacchinnaḥ pākaḥ iti ucyate saḥ eva hi paceḥ arthaḥ tāḥ eva kāṣṭha piṭhara ādi kriyāḥ jvalana bharaṇa ādi svabhāvāḥ pṛthak tayā vyavasthitaḥ tathā tvena eva avabhāsante samuditāḥ tu satyaḥ phala antara avacchedāt rūpa antareṇa pāka ādinā parisphuranti vyapadiśyante ca tathā ca devadattaḥ pacati iti vat kāṣṭhāni pacanti sthālī pacati iti vyapadeśaḥ dṛśyate devadattasya api darvī vighaṭṭana ādiḥ eva paridṛśyamānaḥ tatra vyāpāraḥ na tatas anyaḥ sūkṣmaḥ

nanu devadatta ādeḥ bhautikaḥ vyāpāraḥ ātma vyāpāra pūrvakaḥ bhavitum arhati na etat evam na hi ātmanaḥ vyāpāraḥ kaścid asti icchā dveṣa pūrvaka prayatna vaśāt eva sa bhautika vyāpāra karaṇa tām pratipadyate tasmāt kāraka cakreṇa calatā janyate phalam na punar calanāt anyaḥ vyāpāraḥ upalabhyate calantaḥ devadatta ādyāḥ tad anantaramodanaḥ etāvart duśyate tu atra na tu anyā kācana kriyā

etena bhāvanā ākhyaḥ karoti arthaḥ puruṣa vyāpāraḥ vākya arthaḥ iti yaḥ abhyupagataḥ saḥ api pratyuktaḥ veditavyaḥ na hi puruṣa vyāpāraḥ kaścid upalabhyate viśiṣṭa guṇa samavāyaḥ eva asya kartṛ tvam na ca jñāna ādayaḥ guṇāḥ eva vyāpāra saṃjñā vācyāḥ siddha svabhāva tvāt

nanu kriyā vacanaḥ dhātuḥ iti jānāteḥ api kriyā eva vācyā syāt sā ca kriyā jñāna ātmā puruṣa vyāpāraḥ na ayam niyamaḥ kriyā vacanaḥ dhātuḥ iti gaḍi vadana eka deśe iti api darśanāt api ca ghaṭam aham jānāmi iti atra bhavataḥ kim pratibhāsate ghaṭam iti tāvat viṣayaḥ aham iti ātmā jānāmi iti tu cintyam krimatra prakāśate iti na vyāpāraḥ parokṣa tvāt phalam yat i atra prakāśate tat eva tarhi dhātu vācyam abhyupagatam bhavati tasmāt na kriyā ātmakam jñānam yadi ca kriyā ātmakam jñānam abhaviṣyat na bhāṣya kāraḥ kriyā ataḥ pṛthak enam niradekṣyata nirdiśati ca buddhi karmaṇī api hi pratyabhijñāyete te api nitye prāpnutaḥ iti tasmāt anyat jñānam anyā ca kriyā iti na kriyā svabhāva tvāt nityam parokṣam jñānam

yadi ca nitya parokṣaḥ jñātṛ vyāpāraḥ sa tarhi pratibandha agrahaṇāt anumātum api na śakyaḥ kriyā viśiṣṭa vāhya kāraka siddhāntasya nirasta tvāt ātma ādi anumāne kā vārtā iti ced na tatra sāmānyatas vyāpti grahaṇasya saṃbhavāt iti vakṣyāmaḥ iha tu bāhya kārakeṣu api na tad pūrvakam phalam dṛṣṭam iti uktam na ca arthāpattiḥ api jñātṛ vyāpāra kalpanāya eva prabhavati indriya artha sannikarṣa vaśāt eva artha dṛṣṭa tāyāḥ ghaṭamāna tvāt

kā ca iyam arthasya dṛṣṭa tā nāma kim darśana karma tā kim vā prakāśa svabhāva tā iti tatra darśanasya parokṣa tvāt katham tat karma tā arthasya dṛṣṭa tā gṛhyeta viśeṣaṇa agrahaṇe viśiṣṭa pratīteḥ anutpādāt artha prakāśa tāyāḥ tu sarvān pratyaviśeṣāt sarve sarvajñāḥ syuḥ na syuḥ sambandhitaya utpādāt iti ced akāraṇam etat arthasya eva hi prakāśa tvam atiśayaḥ dīpa ādeḥ iva na puruṣa niyamena vyavatiṣṭhate

na ca dvi tva ādinā sāmyam tasmin niyama darśanāt prakāśe tu na dīpa ādau sambandha niyamaḥ kvacid yad apekṣā dhiyā jātaṃdvi tvam tasya eva tad grahaḥ saṃvedanam api prājñaiḥ kasya atiśayaḥ ucyate jñātuḥ ced antarā anyena vyāpāreṇa asya kaḥ guṇaḥ nanu na eva kriyā śūnyam kārakam phala siddhaye uktam atra kriyā hi eṣā yathādarśanam iṣyatām jñānam saṃvedanam ca iti vidmaḥ paryāya śabda tām saṃvedanam tu jñānasya phala tvena na manmahe artha atiśaya pakṣe ca sarva sarvajña tā punar bhaṭṭapakṣāt viśeṣaḥ ca na kaścid kathitaḥ bhavet na ubhayā atiśayaḥ api eṣaḥ doṣa dvitaya sambhavāt saṃvedanam ca tat

kena grāhyam jñāna anumāpakam anavasthā bhavet asya jñāne saṃvedana antarāt sva saṃvedyā ca saṃvittiḥ upariṣṭāt niṣetsyate smṛti pramoṣa vāde ca rajata smaraṇa ātmikā katham te phala saṃvittiḥ sva prakāśā bhaviṣyati na ābhāti smṛti rūpeṇa na ca api anubhava ātmanā na tṛtīyaḥ prakāraḥ asti tat katham sā prakāśatām na ca kvacid anākārā saṃvittiḥ anubhūyate iyam saṃvid ayam ca arthaḥ iti na asti hi bheda dhīḥ artha ākāra anuraktā tu yadi saṃvid prakāśate vāhya artha nihnavaḥ tarhi tvayā saugata vat kṛtaḥ sva prakāśa mate yuktam na phalam saṃvid ātmakam tasmāt phala anumeyasya vyāpārasya na māna tā

yat api pramāṇa viśeṣaṇam anadhigata artha grāhi tvam abhidhīyate paraiḥ tat api na sāṃpratam pramāṇasya gṛhīta tad itara viṣaya pravṛttasya prāmāṇye viśeṣa abhāvāt nanu gṛhīta viṣaye pravṛttam pramāṇam kim kuryāt agṛhīte api kim kuryāt pramām iti ced gṛhīte api tām eva vidhattām kṛtāyām karaṇa ayogāt iti ced na pramā antara karaṇāt pramā antara karaṇe kim phalam iti ced pramā antara karaṇam eva phalam na ca phalasya phalam mṛgyam na ca prayojana anuvarti pramāṇam bhavati

kasya ca eṣa paryanuyogaḥ na pramāṇasya acetana tvāt puṃsaḥ tu sannihite viṣaye karaṇe ca saṃbhavanti jñānāni iti saḥ api kim anuyojya tām kim akṣiṇī nimīlya na asse kasmāt dṛṣṭam viṣayam paśyasi iti pramāṇasya tu na kiñcid bādham paśyāmaḥ yena tat apramāṇam iti vyavasthāpayāmaḥ na ca sarva ātmanā vaiphalyam heye ahi kaṇṭaka vṛka makara viṣa dhara ādau viṣaye punar punar upalabhyamāne manassantāpāt sa tvaram tad apahānāya pravṛttiḥ upādeye api candana ghana sāra hāra mahilā ādau paridṛśyamāne prīti atiśayaḥ sva saṃvedyaḥ eva bhavati

yat ca idam ucyate yatra api syāt paricchedaḥ pramāṇaiḥ uttaraiḥ punar nūnam tatra api pūrveṇa saḥ arthaḥ na avadhṛtaḥ tathā iti tat api na hṛdayaṅgamam yatas na eva adhika paricchedaḥ pramāṇaiḥ uttaraiḥ dhruvam dhārāvāhika bodheṣu kaḥ adhikaḥ arthaḥ prakāśate na hi sva haste śata kṛtvas api paridṛśyamāne kecana viśeṣāḥ parisphuranti

nanu gṛhīte api viṣaye pravartamānam pramāṇam kadā viramet na hitasya viratau kañcit avadhim adhigacchāmaḥ pramā utpādaḥ tu avadhiḥ anena laṅghitaḥ eva ucyate viṣaya antara samparkāt vā śramāt vā upāya saṅkṣayāt vā virāmaḥ bhaviṣyati anavasthā api ca iyam na mūla ghātinī na hi uttarottara vijñāna upajananam vinā prathama jñāna utpādaḥ vihanyate

mūla kṣati karīm āhuḥ anavasthām hi dūṣaṇam mūla siddhau tu arucyā api na anavasthā nivāryate yadi ca anupalabdha artha grāhi mānam upeyate tat ayam pratyabhijñāyāḥ spaṣṭaḥ eva jala añjaliḥ yaḥ ca id ānīnta na astitva prameya ādhikya lipsayā tasyāḥ pramāṇa tām āha saḥ api vañcayati iva naḥ āvināśaka sadbhāvāt astitvam pūrvayā dhiyā spaṣṭam eva tathā ca āha cira sthāyi iti gṛhyate tasmāt anupalabdha artha grāhi tve tyajyatām grahaḥ
nanu etasmin parityakte prāmāṇyam syāt smṛteḥ api na smṛteḥ apramāṇa tvam gṛhīta grāhita akṛtam api tu anartha janya tvam tad aprāmāṇya kāraṇam

nanu katham anartha jā smṛtiḥ tad ārūḍhasya vastunaḥ tadānīm asattvāt katham tarhi bhūta vṛṣṭi anumānam na anartha jam tatra dharmiṇaḥ anumeya tvāt tasya ca jñāna janakasya tatra bhāvāt nadī ākhyaḥ eva dharmī vṛṣṭi mat u paritana deśa saṃsarga lakṣaṇena dharmeṇa tat vā an anumīyate viśiṣṭa salila pūra yogi tvāt sa ca anumāna grāhyaḥ dharmī vidyate eva iti na anartha jam anu mānam

katham tarhi prātibham anāgata artha grāhi śvas me bhrātā aagantā iti pratyakṣam arthajam iṣyate bhavadbhiḥ tatra deśa antare vartamānasya bhrātuḥ śvas bhāvya āgamana viśeṣitasya eva tathā eva grahaṇam tena ca rūpeṇa gṛhyamāṇasya sataḥ tasya jñāna janaka tvam iti artha jam eva prātibham smaraṇam tu nirdagdha pitṛ ādi viṣayam anapekṣita artham eva jāyamānam dṛṣṭam iti anyatra deśa antara sthita artha smaraṇe tad artha sattvam akāraṇam eva tasmāt anartha ja tvena smṛti prāmāṇya vāraṇāt agṛhīta artha gantṛ tvam na pramāṇa viśeṣaṇam
śabdasya anupalabdhe arthe prāmāṇyam ca āha jaiminiḥ sarva pramāṇa viṣayam bhavadbhiḥ varṇyate katham

apare punar avisaṃvādaka tvam pramāṇa sāmānya lakṣaṇam ācakṣate tat uktam pramāṇam avisaṃvādi jñānam iti avisaṃvādaka tvam ca prāpaka tvam ucyate jñānasya prāpaka tvam sukha duḥkha sādhana samartha padārtha prāpti parihāra hetu bhūtāyāḥ pravṛtteḥ nimitta pradarśaka tvam eva jñāna pradarśite hi viṣaye pravṛttau satyām prāptiḥ bhavati iti prāptim prati pramāṇasya pradarśaka tvam eva vyāpāraḥ pradarśayatā hi tena saḥ arthaḥ prāpitaḥ bhavati yathā hantavyam prati rājñām ājñā dānam eva hantṛ tvam tat uktam prāpaṇa śaktiḥ prāmāṇyam iti loke api ca pradarśitam vastu prāpayataḥ pramāṇa tva vyavahāraḥ tat ca prāpaka tvam pratyakṣa anumānayoḥ ubhayoḥ api asti iti pramāṇa sāmānya lakṣaṇam

tatra pratyakṣasya vastu sva lakṣaṇa viṣaya tvāt tasya ca kṣaṇika tvena prāpti asambhave api tad santāna prāpteḥ santāna adhyavasāya jananam eva prāpaka tvam anumānasya tu āropita artha viṣaya tve api mūla bhūta vaḥ tu kṣaṇa pāramparya prabhava tvāt maṇi prabhā maṇi buddhi vat tad prāptyā prāpaka tvam tad ida madhya vasita prāpaka tvam prāmāṇyam adhyavasitasya avastu tve api tad mūla vastu prāptyā nirvahati yathā adhyavasita prāpakam ca pramāṇam iti matam atas ca pīta śaṅkha ādi grāhiṇām śaṅkha ādi mātra prāptau satyām api na prāmāṇyam yathā adhyavasitasya aprāpteḥ avagataḥ hi pītaḥ śaṅkhaḥ prāpyate ca śvetaḥ iti tasmāt yathā avagata artha prāpaka tvam avisaṃvādaka tvam prāmāṇyam iti

tat etat anupapannam idam eva tāvat bhavān vyācaṣṭām kim pradarśita prāpakam pramāṇam uta adhya vasita prāpakam tatra anumāne pradarśanam eva na asti kā kathā tad prāpaṇasya pratyakṣe tu bāḍham pradarśanam asti na tu pradarśitam prāpyate kṣaṇika tvena atikrānta tvāt adhyavasita prāpaka tvam api durghaṭam adhyavasāyasya bhavat mate vastu viṣaya tva abhāvāt avastunaḥ ca prāptum aśakyatvāt tat uktam bhavadbhiḥ yathā adhyavasāyam atattva tvāt yathātattvam ca anadhyavasāyāt iti mūla bhūta vastu prāptiḥ tu kākatālīyam na tu tad anyatareṇa api pramāṇena api spṛṣṭam yat gatvā prāpyate santāna prāptyā tad prāptiḥ iti api na yuktam santānasya bheda abheda vikalpābhyām anupapanna tvāt etat ca sa vistaram kṣaṇa bhaṅga bhaṅge nirūpayiṣyate

nanu kālpanike api santāne sati saṃvṛttyā pramāṇa lakṣaṇam idam nirvakṣyate yathā uktam sāṃvyavahārikasya etat pramāṇasya lakṣaṇam vastu tas tu anādya vidyā vāsanā aaropita grāhya grāhaka ādi bheda prapañcam jñāna mātram eva idam iti kim prāpyate kaḥ vā prāpayati iti saḥ ayam palāyana prakāraḥ iva prastūyate kā iyam saṃvṛtiḥ nāma sā api satī asatī vā iti vikalpyamānā na eva vyavahāra hetuḥ bhavati

avidyā vāsanā kṛtaḥ ca na bheda vyavahāraḥ kintu pāramārthikaḥ eva iti sādhayiṣyate sāṃvṛta santāna kalpa nāmām vā jātya vayavi prabhṛtayaḥ api sāṃvṛtāḥ kim iti na iṣyante vṛtti vikalpa ādi bādhaka upahata tvāt iti ced santāne api samānaḥ panthāḥ iti kadāśa ālambanam etat tasmāt asambhavi darśita prāpaka tvam iti alakṣaṇam etat

avyāpakam ca idam lakṣaṇam upekṣaṇīya viṣaya bodhasya avyabhicāra ādi viśeṣaṇa yogena labdha pramāṇa bhāvasya api anena asaṅgrahāt nanu kaḥ ayam upekṣaṇīyaḥ nāma viṣayaḥ sa hi upekṣaṇīya tvāt eva na upādīyate ced sa tarhi heyaḥ eva anupādeya tvāt iti na etat yuktam upekṣaṇīya viṣayasya sva saṃvedya tvena apratyākhyeya tvāt heya upādeyayoḥ asti duḥkha prīti nimitta tā yatnena hāna upādāne bhavataḥ tatra dehinām yatna sādhya dvaya abhāvāt ubhayasya api asādhanāt tābhyām visadṛśam vastu sva saṃviditam asti naḥ upādeye ca viṣaye dṛṣṭe rāgaḥ pravartate itaratra tu vidveṣaḥ tatra ubhau api durlabhau

yat tu anupādeya tvāt heyaḥ eva iti tad aprayojakam na hi evam bhavati yat etat napuṃsakam sa pumān astrī tvāt strī vā napuṃsakam apuṃstvāt iti strī puṃbhyām anyat eva napuṃsakam tathā upalambhāt evam upekṣaṇīyaḥ api viṣayaḥ heya upādeyābhyām artha antaram tathā upalambhāt iti yat etat tṛṇa parṇa ādi cakāsti pathi gacchataḥ na dhīḥ chatra ādi vat tatra na ca kākodara ādi vat tasmāt upekṣaṇīya jñānasya tam aprāpayataḥ api prāmāṇya darśanāt na prāpaka tvam tad lakṣaṇam

nanu yāvān pramāṇasya vyāpāraḥ prāpaṇam prati tāvān upekṣaṇīye api viṣaye tena sādhitaḥ uktam hi rājñām ādeṣṭṛ tvam eva hantṛ tvam pradarśaka tvam eva jñānasya prāpaka tvam iti mā evam evam pradarśaka tvam syāt kevalam tasya lakṣaṇam tat ca pracalat arka aṃśu jala jñāne api dṛśyate

nanu tatra viparīta adhyavasāya jana nāda prāmāṇyam darśanam hi marīci sva lakṣaṇa viṣayam eva salila adhyavasāyam tu janayat apramāṇībhavati tathā hi ekam eva darśanam anukūla itara vikalpa upajanana tad anutpāda bhedāt tridhā kathyate pramāṇam apramāṇam pramāṇam ca na bhavati iti nīla jñānam hi nīlam prati pramāṇam nīlam id abhiti anukūla vikalpa upajananāt nīla avyatireki kṣaṇika tvam api tena gṛhītam eva tatra tu pramāṇam na bhavati anukūla itara vikalpa an utpādāt sthairye tu tad apramāṇam viparīta adhyavasāya kaluṣita tvāt iti

yadi evam asmin prakrame sutarām idam pramāṇa lakṣaṇam dusstham santāna adhyavasāyaḥ prāpaṇam prati pramāṇasya vyāpāraḥ iti ca varṇitavān asi atas ca yathā marīci sva lakṣaṇa darśanam udaka adhyavasāya jana nāda pramāṇam evam sva lakṣaṇa darśanam api tad viparīta santāna adhyavasāya jana nāda pramāṇībhavet iti santāne ca kālpanike vyavasite dṛśya abhimukhaḥ kim iti pravartate dṛśya vikalpyau arthau ekīkṛtya pravartate yadi vā avivekāt prāptiḥ syāt pramāṇam api dūratas tasyāḥ tasmāt na prāpakam pramāṇam

api ca prāpti aprāptī puruṣa icchā mātra hetuke bhavataḥ artha pratītiḥ eva pramāṇa kāryā avadhāryate tasmāt mānasya lakṣaṇam atas kathayadbhiḥ tad viśeṣaṇam vācyam na punar prāpaṇa śaktiḥ prāmāṇyam kathayitum yuktam

sāṅkhyāḥ tu buddhi vṛttiḥ pramāṇam iti pratipannāḥ viṣaya ākāra pariṇata indriya ādi vṛtti anupātinī buddhi vṛttiḥ eva puruṣam uparañjayantī pramāṇam tad uparaktaḥ hi puruṣaḥ pratiniyata viṣaya draṣṭā saṃpadyate

tat etat ahṛdayaṅgamam yaḥ hi jānāti budhyate adhyavasyati na tasya tad phalam artha darśanam acetana tvāt mahataḥ yasya ca artha darśanam na sa jānāti na budhyate na adhyavasyati iti bhinna adhikaraṇa tvam pramāṇa phalayoḥ jñāna ādi dharma yogaḥ pramāṇam puṃsi na vidyate tad phalam artha darśanam buddhau na asti iti

atha svaccha tayā puṃsaḥ buddhi vṛtti anupātinaḥ buddheḥ vā cetana ākāra saṃsparśaḥ iva lakṣyate evam sati sva vācā eva mithyātvam kathitam bhavet cit dharmaḥ hi mṛṣā buddhau buddhi dharmaḥ citau mṛṣā sa ākāra jñāna vādāt ca na atīva eṣa viśiṣyate tvad pakṣaḥ iti atas amuṣya tad niṣedhāt niṣedhanam nirasiṣyate ca sakalaḥ kapila muni prakriyā prapañcaḥ ayam tasmāt na tad mate api pramāṇam avakalpate kiñcid
tīrtha antara abhihita rūpam atas pramāṇam na eva apavāda rahitam pratitarkayāmaḥ tena amala pramiti sādhanam indriya ādi sākalyam eva niravadyam uśanti mānam

tat caturvidham pramāṇam tat āha sūtrakāraḥ pratyakṣa anumāna upamāna śabdāḥ pramāṇāni iha hi bhedavataḥ prathama sūtra uddiṣṭasya trayam vaktavyam sāmānya lakṣaṇam vibhāgaḥ viśeṣa lakṣaṇam ca tatra viśeṣa lakṣaṇa pratipādakāni catvāri sūtrāṇi bhaviṣyanti indriya artha sannikarṣa utpannam ityādīni iha tu vibhāga sāmānya lakṣaṇe pratipādyete ekena anena sūtreṇa dvayam ca āha mahā muniḥ pramāṇeṣu catussaṅkhyam tathā sāmānya lakṣaṇam

pratyakṣa anumāna upamāna śabda sannidhāne pramāṇa śrutiḥ uccarantī catvāri eva pramāṇāni iti darśayati nanu na catvāri pramāṇāni iti saṅkhyā vacanaḥ śabdaḥ śrūyate na api pratyakṣa ādīni eva iti avadhāraṇa śrutiḥ asti tad kutas iyattā niyama avagamaḥ śabda śakti svabhāvāt iti brūmaḥ gargān bhojaya yajñadatta devadattau ānayaḥ iti vinā saṅkhyā śabdam eka vāram ca bhavati eva dvi tva ādi niyama avagamaḥ evam iha api pratyakṣa anumāna upamāna śabdāḥ pramāṇāni iti ukte sāmarthyāt nyūna adhika saṅkhyā vyavacchedaḥ avadhāryate iti evam tāvat vibhāga avagamaḥ

sāmānya lakṣaṇantu pramāṇa padāt eva samākhyā nirvacana sāmarthya sahitāt avagamyate pramīyate yena tat pramāṇam iti karaṇa artha abhidhāyinaḥ pramāṇa śabdāt pramākaraṇam pramāṇam iti avagamyate tat ca prāk eva darśitam prasiddha sādharmyāt sādhya sādhanam upamānam iti ca madhye sādhya sādhana grahaṇam upādadānaḥ sūtrakāraḥ sarva pramāṇa sādhāraṇam rūpam idam paribhāṣate yad sādhya sādhanasya pramākaraṇasya pramāṇa tvam iti

aśuddha pramiti vidhāyinaḥ tu prāmāṇyam prasajyate iti smṛti saṃśaya viparyaya janaka vyavacchedāya pratyakṣa sūtrāt artha utpannam iti avyabhicāri iti vyavasāya ātmakam iti ca pada trayam ākṛṣyate tat hi pramāṇa catuṣṭaya sādhāraṇam artha utpanna padena phala viśeṣaṇena smṛti janakam avyabhicāri padena viparyaya ādhāyi vyavasāya ātmaka padena saṃśaya janakam pramāṇam vyudasyate atas ca evam uktam bhavati artha viṣayam asandigdham avyabhicāri ca jñānam yena janyate tat pramāṇam iti evam ekasmāt eva sūtrāt sāmānya lakṣaṇam vibhāgaḥ ca avagamyate

nanu ekasya sūtrasya vibhāga sāmānya lakṣaṇa paratvena vākya medaḥ artha eka tvāt ca ekam vākyam yuktam ucyate śruti artha dvāraka aneka vastu sūcana śāliṣu sūtreṣu aneka artha vidheḥ vākya bhedaḥ na dūṣaṇam pramāṇa antara saṃsparśa śūnye śabda eka gocare prameye vākya bheda ādi dūṣaṇam kila dūṣaṇam artha dvaya vidhānam hi tatra ekasya na yujyate

rājā svārājya kāmaḥ vājapeyena yajeta iti guṇa vidhi pakṣe svārājyam prati yāgaḥ vidhātavyaḥ yāgam prati ca vājapeya guṇaḥ vidhātavyaḥ iti ekasya vākyasya paraspara viruddha vidhi anuvāda ādi rūpa āpatteḥ artha dvaya vidhānam ati durghaṭam iha punar pramāṇa antara pariniścita artha sūcana cāturya mahā argheṣu sūtreṣu nānā artha vidhānam bhūṣaṇam bhavati na dūṣaṇam aneka artha sūcanāt eva sūtram ucyate etat eva sūtra kārāṇām param kauśalam yat ekena eva vākyena su alpaiḥ eva akṣaraiḥ aneka vastu samarpaṇam adhyāhāreṇa vā tantreṇa vā āvṛttyā vā tam artham pratyāyayiṣyati sūtram idam iti na doṣaḥ

vibhāga sāmānya lakṣaṇayoḥ vidhāne paurvāparya niyamaḥ viśeṣa lakṣaṇa vat na asti iti tantreṇa yugapad ubhaya abhidhānam api na viruddhyate viśeṣa lakṣaṇam anukte sāmānya lakṣaṇe vaktum ayuktam iti tatra eṣa niyamaḥ sāmānya lakṣaṇa vibhāgayoḥ tu yathāruci pratipādanam ādau vibhāgaḥ tatas sāmānya lakṣaṇam ādau vā sāmānya lakṣaṇam tatas vibhāgaḥ siddhānta chala vat ubhayam vā yugapad eva pratipādyate iti tantreṇa āvṛttyā vā tad upapādane na kaścid doṣaḥ iti

āstām tāvat idam sūtre tantra āvṛtti ādi cintanam catussaṅkhyā pramāṇeṣu nanu na kṣamyate paraiḥ nyūna adhika saṅkhyā pratiṣedhena hi catvāri pramāṇāni pratiṣṭhāpi eran sa ca durupapādaḥ tathā hi pratyakṣam eva ekam pramāṇam iti cārvākāḥ pratyakṣa anumāne dve eva iti bauddhāḥ pratyakṣam anumānam āpta vacanam ca iti trīṇi pramāṇāni iti sāṅkhyāḥ ādhikyam api pramāṇānām mīmāṃsaka prabhṛtayaḥ pratipannavantaḥ tat katham catvāri eva pramāṇāni iti vibhāga niyamaḥ
ucyate anumāna prāmāṇyam varṇayantaḥ bārhaspatyam tāvat upariṣṭāt pratikṣepsyāmaḥ śabdasya ca anumāna vailakṣaṇyam tad lakṣaṇa avasaraḥ eva vakṣyate iti śākya pathaḥ api na yuktaḥ

nanu etat bhikṣavaḥ na kṣamante te hi prameya dvaividhyāt pramāṇam dvividham jaguḥ na anyaḥ pramāṇa bhedasya hetuḥ viṣaya bhedataḥ viṣayaḥ ca pratyakṣa parokṣa bhedena sva lakṣaṇa sāmānya bhedena vā dvividhaḥ eva paraspara parihāra vyavasthita ātmasu padārtheṣu tṛtīya rāśī anupraveśa abhāvāt tṛtīya viṣaya asattva paricchedaḥ eva kutasya iti ced pratyakṣa mahimnaḥ eva iti brūmaḥ nīle pravartamānam pratyakṣam nīlam nīlatayā paricchinatti iti tāvat avivādaḥ eva tat eva pratyakṣam anīlam api vyavacchinatti nīla saṃvidi tasya apratibhāsāt nīla jñāna pratibhā āsyam hi nīlam iti tad itarada nīlam eva bhavati

tṛtīyam api rāśim atas eva tat apākaroti saḥ api hi rāśiḥ nīla saṃvidi bhāti na vā bhāti ced nīlam eva syāt na prakāra antaram tu tat no ced tathā api anīlam syāt na prakāra antaram hi tat idam eva hi nīla ānīlayoḥ lakṣaṇam yat nīla jñāna avabhāsya tva anavabhāsya tve nāma evam ca pratyakṣam sva viṣaye pravṛttam tam pratyakṣa tayā vyavasthāpayati tatra apratibhāsamānam parokṣa tayā tṛtīyam api prakāram pūrvavat eva pratikṣipati iti

evam sva lakṣaṇa sāmānya vyatirikta viṣaya niṣedhe api eṣaḥ eva mārgaḥ anugantavyaḥ evam hi pratyakṣeṇa sva viṣayaḥ pariniścitaḥ bhavati tad uktam tat paricchinatti anyat vyavacchinatti tṛtīya prakāra abhāvam ca sūcayati iti eka pramāṇa vyāpāraḥ iti anyathā viṣayasya eva svarūpa apariniścayāt kva upādāna parityāgau kuryuḥ artha kriyā arthinaḥ tat uktam anala arthi analam paśyan api na tiṣṭhet na pratiṣṭheta iti

yadi api nirvikalpakam pratyakṣam puras avasthita vastu sva lakṣaṇa pradarśana mātra niṣṭhita vyāpāram avicārakam eva tathā api tad pṛṣṭha bhāvinām vikalpānām eva ca darśana viṣaye kṛta pariccheda tad itara viṣaya vyavaccheda tṛtīya prakāra abhāva vyavasthāpana paryanta vyāpāra pāṭavam avagantavyam itarathāḥ vyavahāra abhāvāt

evam ca paraspara parihāra vyavasthita svarūpa padārtha vyavacchedi pratyakṣa prabhāva avagata virodhi tvāt pratyakṣa itara viṣayayoḥ tṛtīya viṣaya asattva pariniścaye anumānam api pravartitum utsahate viruddhayoḥ ekatara pariccheda samaye dvitīya nirasanam avaśyam bhāti viruddha tvāt eva śīta uṣṇa vat tṛtīya viṣayaḥ api tad viruddhaḥ eva tad buddhau apratibhāsamāna tvāt

nanu na tvam dvitīyam iva tṛtīyam kadācid api viṣayam agrahīḥ grahaṇe hi viṣaya dvaya vat tasya api sattvam syāt agṛhītasya ca virodham avirodham vā katham niścetum arhasi iti bhoḥ sādho na atra pṛthak grahaṇam upayujyate tad buddhi anavabhāsa mātreṇa eva tad virodha siddheḥ viruddham hi tat ucyate yat tasmin gṛhyamāṇe na gṛhyate tat idam agrahaṇam eva virodhāvaham iti na pṛthak grahaṇam anveṣaṇīyam

evam itaretara parihāra vyavasthitānām arthānām na tṛtīyaḥ rāśiḥ asti iti sarvathā siddham viṣaya dvaividhyam evam eva sat asat nitya anitya krama yaugapadi a ādiṣu prakāra antara parākaraṇam avagantavyam tatra pratyakṣe sva lakṣaṇa ātmani viṣaye pratyakṣam pravartate parokṣe tu sāmānya ākāre anumānam iti pramāṇa dvaya siddhe ca viṣaya dvaya vedane vada kasya anurodhena tṛtīyam mānam iṣyatām

na ca asmin eva parokṣe sāmānya ātmani viṣaye anumānam iva śabda ādi api pramāṇa antaram pravartate iti vaktum yuktam ekasmin viṣaye virodha viphala tvābhyām aneka pramāṇa pravṛtti anupapatteḥ pūrva pramāṇa avagata rūpa yogi tayā tasmin vastuni punar paricchidyamāne pramāṇam uttaram aphalam eva syāt evam hi āhuḥ adhigatam artham adhigamayatā pramāṇena piṣṭam piṣṭam syāt iti anya rūpa tayā tu tad grahaṇam uttara pramāṇena duśśakam ādya pramāṇa viruddha tvāt iti atas eva na saṃplavam abhyupagacchanti nīti vidaḥ ekasmin viṣaye aneka pramāṇa pravṛttiḥ saṃplavaḥ sa ca tathāvidha viṣaya nirāsāt eva nirastaḥ na ca pratyakṣa anumāne parasparam api saṃplavete sva lakṣaṇe anumānasya sāmānye pratyakṣasya ca pravṛtti abhāvāt

sambandha grahaṇa apekṣam anumānam sva lakṣaṇe sajātīya vijātīya vyāvṛtte vartatām katham pratyakṣam api sat vastu saṃsparśa niyata vratam vikalpa āropita ākāra sāmānya grāhakam katham yat ca śabda upamāna ādi pramāṇa antaram iṣyate tat evam sati kutra aṃśe pratiṣṭhām adhigacchatu vastu sva lakṣaṇam tāvat pratyakṣeṇa eva mudritam tatas anyat anumānena sambandha apekṣa vṛttinā nānā pramāṇa gamyaḥ ca viṣayaḥ na asti vāstavaḥ tat vā anavayavī jātiḥ iti vārtā ekabhadrikā

yadi ca pratyakṣa viṣaye śabda anumānayoḥ api vṛttiḥ ipyate tarhi pratyakṣa saṃvid sadṛśīm eva te api buddhim vidadhātām na ca evam asti tat āhuḥ samāna viṣaya tve ca jāyate sadṛśī matiḥ na ca adhyakṣa viyā sāmyam eti śabda anumāna dhīḥ tejaḥ anyat eva nakṣatra śaśāṅka śakala ādiṣu uddhāṭita jagat kośam anyat eva raveḥ mahar

āha ca anya deva indriya grāhyam anyaḥ śabdasya gocaraḥ śabdāt pratyeti bhinna akṣaḥ na tu pratyakṣam īkṣate api ca anyathā eva agni sambandhāt dāham dagdhaḥ abhimanyate anyathā dāha śabdena dāha arthaḥ saṃpratīyate tasmāt uktena vartmanā viṣaya dvaividhya niścayāt na tṛtīyam pramāṇam asti na ca saṃplavaḥ iti

atra abhidhīyate yat tāvat idam ākhyāyi rāśi antara nirākṛtau pratyakṣasya eva sāmarthyam iti etat na upapadyate pūrva apara anusandhāna sāmarthya rahita ātmanā bhāraḥ katham ayam boḍhum avikalpena pāryate vikalpāḥ punar utprekṣā mātra niṣṭhita śaktayaḥ tebhyaḥ vastu vyavasthāyāḥ kā kathā bhavatām mate

athavā bhavatu nāma nīlāt ābuktena prakāreṇa rāśi antara nirākaraṇam pratyakṣa parokṣa bhāva nirṇaye tu na eṣa prakāra yojayitum śakyate viṣaye hi pravṛttam pratyakṣam viṣaya svarūpam eva paricchinatti na punar tasya pratyakṣatām api nīlam idam iti hi saṃvedyate na punar pratyakṣam idam iti tathā hi kim idam viṣayasya pratyakṣa tvam nāma kim akṣa viṣaya tvam uta akṣaja jñāna viṣaya tvam iti tatra akṣa viṣaya tvam tāvat anvaya vi atireka samadhigamyam eva na pratyakṣa gamyam tathā aaha bhaṭṭaḥ na hi śrāvaṇatā nāma pratyakṣeṇa avagamyate sā anvaya vyatirekābhyām jñāyate badhira ādiṣu iti akṣaja jñāna karma tvam api pratyakṣa tvam tadānīm paricchettam aśakyam eva viṣaya pratibhāsa kāle tad pratibhāsasya apratibhāsāt tad grahaṇam antareṇa ca tad karma tā grahaṇa asaṃbhavāt

katham punar viṣaya grahaṇa kāle tad pratibhāsasya apratibhāsaḥ na eva yugapad a ākāra dvitayam pratibhāsate idam jñānam ayam ca arthaḥ iti bheda anupagrahāt ekaḥ ca ayam ākāraḥ pratibhāsyamānaḥ grāhyasya eva bhavitum arhati na grāhakasya iti vakṣyate

nanu ca na agṛhītam jñānam artha prakāśana kuśalam bhavati āhuḥ apratyakṣa upalaṃbhasya na artha dṛṣṭiḥ prasiddhi ati iti tat ayuktam apratyakṣa upalaṃbhasya eva artha dṛṣṭiḥ prasiddhyati pratyakṣa upalambhasya tu na artha dṛṣṭiḥ upalambhe eva pratyakṣaḥ iti dvitīya ākāra anavabhāsāt kutas artha dṛṣṭiḥ yadi ca gṛhītam jñānam artham prakāśayet na dvayīm gatim ativarteta tat hi jñānam jñāna antara grāhyam vā bhavet sva prakāśam vā jñāna antara grāhya tve tu anavasthā mūla kṣati karī ca iyam iti andhamūkam jagṛt syāt upalambha pratyakṣatā pūrvaka artha pratyakṣa vādinaḥ na api sva prakāśam jñānam jñeya tvāt nīla pīta ādi vat vistarataḥ tu sva prakāśam vijñānam vijñāna vādi nirākaraṇe nirākariṣyāmaḥ

na ca jñānasya apratyakṣatāyām tad utpāda an utpādayoḥ aviśeṣāt ajña tvam sarvajña tvam vā pariśaṅkanīyam vijñāna utpāda mātreṇa jñātuḥ jñātṛ tva siddheḥ viṣaya prakāśana svabhāvam eva jñānam utpadyate iti katham utpannam anutpannāt na viśiṣyate yathā ca nīla ādi viṣaya jñāna utpattyā asya jñātṛ tvam tathā sukha ādi viṣaya jñāna utpattyā bhoktṛ tvam iti tatra api na ati prasaṅgaḥ tasmāt viṣaya vijñāna kāle tad vijñāna agrahaṇāt na tad karma tva kṛtam viṣaya pratyakṣa tvam avabhāsate tad apratibhāse ca na parokṣa vyavacchedaḥ na ca tṛtīya prakāra asattva sūcanam iti katham pratyakṣam viṣaya dvi tva siddhau pramāṇam

yat ca anumānam api uktam viṣaya dvaya siddhaye tat pratyakṣa paricchinna tad virodha nibandhanam virodha bodha sāmarthyam pratyakṣasya ca dūṣitam tad agrahe ca tad mūlam anumānam na siddhyati evañca viṣaya dvi tva sādhana anupapattitaḥ tad kṛtaḥ tyajyatām eṣa pramāṇa dvi tva doha daḥ

atha vā sati api viṣaya dvaividhye sāmagrī bhedāt phala bhedāt ca pramāṇa bhedaḥ bhavan katham apākriyate anye eva hi sāmagrī phale pratyakṣa liṅgayoḥ anye eva ca sāmagrī phale śabda upamānayoḥ iti vakṣyāmaḥ tena tad bhedāt api pramāṇa bheda siddheḥ na dve eva pramāṇe
etena trīṇi pramāṇāni iti sāṅkhya vyākhyātā api tad saṅkhyā pratyākhyātā sāmagrī phala bhedena upamānasya caturtha pramāṇasya pratipādayiṣyamāṇa tvāt

yat punar ekasmin viṣaye aneka pramāṇa prasaram nirasyatā saugatena saṃplava parākaraṇam akāri tat api mati moha vilasitam asati saṃplave anumāna prāmāṇya pratiṣṭhāpana anupapatteḥ na hi avijñāta sambandham liṅgam gamakam iṣyate sambandha dhīḥ ca sambandhi dvaya avagati pūrvikā sāmānya ātmaka sambandhi grahaṇam ca anumānataḥ tasmāt eva yadīṣyeta vyaktam anyonya saṃśrayam anumāna antara adhīnā sambandhi graha pūrvikā sambandha adhigatiḥ na syāt manvantara śataiḥ api tena dūre api sambandha grāhakam liṅga liṅginoḥ pratyakṣam upagantavyam tathā ca sati saṃplavaḥ

tatra etat syāt avidita saugata kṛta antānām etat ca udyam te hi vikalpa viṣaye vṛttim āhuḥ śabda anumānayoḥ tebhyaḥ saṃbandha siddhau ca na anavasthā na saṃplavaḥ tathā hi darśana samanantara utpatti avāpta darśana chāyā aturajyamāna vapuṣaḥ vikalpāḥ pratyakṣāyante tad ullikhita ka alpa nikata ditara parāvṛtta svabhāva sāmānya ākāra pratiṣṭaḥ ayam anumāna vyavahāraḥ pāramparyeṇa maṇi prabhā maṇi buddhi vat tad mūlaḥ iti tat prāptaya avakalpate na punar pratyakṣa eka samadhigamyam vastu spṛśati iti kutas saṃplava kutas vā anavasthā

tat etat vañcanā mātram yaḥ hi tādātmya tad utpatti svabhāva pratibandhaḥ iṣyate sa kim vastu dharmaḥ vikalpa āropita ākāra dharmaḥ vā tatra na ayam āropita dharmaḥ bhavitum arhati vastu vastunā janyate vastu ca vastu svabhāvam bhavet tasmāt vastu dharmaḥ pratibandhaḥ vikalpaiḥ ca vastu na spṛśyate tad pratibandhaḥ ca niścīyate iti citram

idam ca su bhāṣitam vastunoḥ pratibandhaḥ tādātmya ādiḥ gamya gamaka tvam ca vikalpa āra upitayoḥ apohayoḥ tat evam anyatra pratibandhaḥ anyatra tad grahaṇa upāyaḥ anyatra pratītiḥ anyatra pravṛtti prāptī iti sarvam kaitavam na ca dṛśya saṃsparśa śūnya ātmanām vikalpānām darśana chāyā kācana saṃbhavati idantā grāhi tva saṃspaṣṭa tva ādi api vastu saṃsparśa rahitam akiñcitkaram apramāṇa tva anapāyāt apramāṇa paricchinnaḥ pratibandhaḥ ca tattvataḥ na paricchinnaḥ eva iti tatas mithyā anumeya dhīḥ atha abhimatam eva idam buddhi ārūḍha tva varṇanāt hanta tāttvika saṃbandha sādhana vyasanena kim

yathā ca sāmānya viṣaye pratyakṣa abhyupagamam antareṇa sambandha grahaṇam aghaṭamānam iti visaṃṣṭhulam anumānam evam avagata saṃmbandhasya dvitīya liṅga darśanam api durupapādam iti tatas api saṃplavā palāpinām anumānam utsīdet na hi asādhāraṇa aṃśasya liṅga tvam upapadyate vinā na ca anumānena sāmānyam avagamyate sā eva anavasthā tatra api saḥ eva anyaḥ anya saṃśrayaḥ saḥ eva ca vikalpānām sāmarthya śamana kramaḥ atas sambandha vijñāna liṅga grahaṇa pūrvakam anumānam anihnutya katham saṃplava nihnavaḥ

api ca viṣaya dvaividhya siddhau api pratyakṣa anumāne eva parasparam api saṃplaveyātām yatas pratyakṣa tvam parokṣaḥ api pratyakṣaḥ api parokṣatām deśa kāla ādi bhedena viṣayaḥ pratipadyate kṣaṇa bhaṅgam niṣetsyāmaḥ santānaḥ yaḥ ca kalpitaḥ darśita prāpti siddhi ādau saṃplave api sa tādṛśaḥ

yat api jāti ādi viṣaya niṣedha manorathaiḥ saṃplava parākaraṇam adhyavasitam tatra jāti ādi samarthanam eva uttarīkariṣyati tāvakaiḥ dūṣaṇa gaṇaiḥ kāluṣyam apanīyate tat vā anavayavī jātiḥ iti vārtā eva bhadrikā

yat api virodha vaiphalyābhyām na saṃplavaḥ iti uktam tatra vaiphalyam anadhigata artha gantṛ tva viśeṣaṇa nivāraṇena eva pratisamāhitam virodhaḥ api na asti pūrva jñāna upamardenana idam rajatam iti vat uttara vijñāna anutpādāt aneka dharma visara viśeṣita vapuṣi dharmiṇi kadācid kenacid kaścid niścīyate dharma viśeṣaḥ iti kaḥ virodha arthaḥ

yat api pratyakṣasya śabda liṅgayoḥ ca samāna viṣaya tve sati sadṛśa pratīti janaka tvam āśaṅkitam tatra kecid ācakṣate viṣaya sāmye api upāya bhedāt pratīti bhedaḥ bhavati eva dūra avidūra deśa vyavasthita padārtha pratīti vat anye tu manyante na upāya bhedāt pratīti bhedaḥ bhavati api tu viṣaya bhedāt eva sannikṛṣṭa viprakṛṣṭa grahaṇe api viṣayau bhidyete dūrāt sāmānya dharma mātra viśiṣṭasya dharmiṇaḥ grahaṇam adūrāt tu sakala tad gata viśeṣa sākṣāt karaṇam tat imāḥ pratyakṣa anumāna śabda pramitayaḥ prameya bhedāt bhidyante viśeṣa dharma saṃbaddham vastu spṛśati netra dhīḥ vyāpti bodha anusāreṇa tadvat mātram tu laiṅgikī śabdāt tad tad avacchinnā vācye san jāyate matiḥ śabda anuvedha śūnyā hi na śabda arthe matiḥ bhavet

katham tarhi teṣām saṃplavaḥ sarvatra viṣaya bhedasya darśita tvāt satyam dharmī abhiprāyeṇa saṃplavaḥ kathyate imau tu pakṣau pratyakṣa lakṣaṇe vistaraśaḥ vicārayiṣyete sarvathā tāvat asti pramāṇānām saṃplavaḥ iti siddham
tad udāharaṇam tu bhāṣya kāraḥ pradarśitavān agniḥ āpta upadeśāt pratīyate amutra iti pratyāsīdatā dhūma darśanena anumīyate pratyāsannatareṇa upalabhyate ityādi

kvacid tu vyavasthā dṛśyate yathā agnihotram juhuyāt svarga kāmaḥ iti asmad ādeḥ āgamāt eva jñānam na pratyakṣa anumānābhyām stanayitnu śabda śravaṇāt tad hetu parijñānam anumānāt eva na pratyakṣa āgamābhyām sva hasta ādau pratyakṣāt eva pratītiḥ na śabda anumānābhyām iti tasmāt sthitam etat prāyeṇa pramāṇāni prameyam abhisaṃplavante kvacid tu prameye vyavatiṣṭhante api iti
iti uddhṛta akhila para udita doṣa jāta saṃpāta bhītiḥ iha saṃplavaḥ eṣa siddhaḥ sarvāḥ ca saugata manassu viraprarūḍhāḥ bhagnāḥ pramāṇa viṣaya dvaya siddhi vāñchāḥ

evam tāvat nyūna tvam saṅkhyāyāḥ parīkṣitam ādhikyam idānīm parīkṣyate tatra arthāpattyā saha pratyakṣa ādīni pañca pramāṇāni iti prābhākaraḥ abhāvena saha ṣaṣ iti bhāṭṭaḥ saṃbhava aitihyābhyām aṣṭau iti kecid aśakyaḥ eva pramāṇa saṅkhyā niyamaḥ iti su śikṣita cārvākāḥ

tatra bhāṭṭāḥ tāvat ittham arthāpattim ācakṣate dṛṣṭaḥ śrutaḥ vā arthaḥ anyathā na upapadyate iti artha antara kalpanā arthāpattiḥ dṛṣṭaḥ iti pratyakṣa ādibhiḥ pañcabhiḥ pramāṇaiḥ śrutaḥ iti kutaścana laukikāt vaidikāt vā śabdāt avagataḥ arthaḥ tatas anyathā anupapadyamāna artha antara kalpanā arthāpattiḥ iti evam ṣaṣ pramāṇa prabhava tvena ṣaḍvidhā asau bhavati iti
dṛṣṭa vacanena upalabdhi vācinā gata artha tve api śruta arthāpatteḥ pṛthak abhidhānam pramāṇa eka deśa viṣaya tvena prameya viṣaya artha āpatti pañcaka vilakṣaṇa tvāt

tatra pratyakṣa pūrvikā tāvat arthāpattiḥ pratyakṣa avagata dahana saṃsarga udgata dāha ākhya kāryānyathā anupapattyā vahneḥ dāha śakti kalpanā anumāna pūrvikā deśa antara prāpti liṅga anumitamarīci māli gati anyathā anupapattyā tasya gamana śakti kalpanā upamāna pūrvikā upamāna jñāna avagata gopiṇḍa ādi sārūpya viśiṣṭa gavaya ādi prameyā anyathā anupapattyā tasya tat jñāna grāhya tva śakti kalpanā iti

tat imāḥ tāvat atīndriya śakti viṣaya tvāt artha āpattayaḥ pramāṇa antaram śakteḥ pratyakṣa paricchedya tvā anupapatteḥ tad adhīna pratibandha adhigama vaidhuryeṇa anumāna viṣaya tva ayogāt anvaya vyatirekau hi dravya rūpa anuvartinau śaktiḥ tu tad gatā sūkṣmā na tābhyām avagamyate śabda upamānayoḥ tu atra saṃbhāvanā eva na asti iti artha āpatteḥ eva eṣa viṣayaḥ

arthāpatti pūrvikā yathā śabda karaṇikā artha prati iti anyathā anupapattyā śabdasya vāvaka śaktim avagatya tat anyathā anupapattyā tasya nitya tva kalpanā sā ca iyam śabda parīkṣāyām vakṣyate abhāva pūrvikā tu bhāṣya kāreṇa udāhṛtā jīvataḥ caitrasya gṛha abhāvam avasāya tat anyathā anupapattyā bahis bhāva kalpanā iti

nanu dṛṣṭena adṛṣṭa siddheḥ anumānam eva idam syāt na anumānam sāmagrya bhāvāt pakṣa dharma tā ādi sāmagryā yat jñānam utpadyate tad anumānam iti tārkika sthitiḥ sā ca iha na asti bahirbhāva viśiṣṭe caitre caitra viśiṣṭe bahis bhāve vā anumeye kasya liṅga tvam iti cintyam gṛha abhāva viśiṣṭasya vā caitrasya caitra abhāva viśiṣṭasya vā gṛhasya gṛhe caitrābhāvasya vā tatra caitra adarśanasya vā na ca eṣām anyatamasya api pakṣa dharma tvam asti na hi gṛham vā caitraḥ vā tad abhāvaḥ vā tad adarśanam vā caitrasya dharmaḥ tat vahiḥ bhāvasya veti apakṣa dharma tvāt anyatamasya api na liṅga tvam

api ca prameya anupraveśa prasaṅgāt api na idam anumānam tathā hi āgama avagata jīvanasya gṛha abhāvena caitrasya bahirbhāvaḥ parikalpyate itarathā mṛtena anaikāntikaḥ hetuḥ syāt abhāvaḥ ca gṛhītaḥ san bahis bhāvam avagamayati na agṛhītaḥ dhūma vat abhāva grahaṇam ca sakala sat upalambhaka pramāṇa pratyasta maya pūrvakam iha tu sat upalambhakam asti eva jīvana grāhi pramāṇam jīvanam hi kvacid astitvam ucyate apratyasta mite tu sat upalambhake pramāṇe katham abhāvaḥ pravarteta iti pravartamānaḥ eva asau sat upalambhakam pramāṇam pṛthak viṣayam upasthāpayati bahis asya bhāvaḥ gṛhe tu abhāvaḥ iti tena jīvataḥ bahis bhāva vyavasthāpana pūrvaka gṛha abhāva grahaṇa upapatteḥ prameya anupraveśaḥ

anumāne tu dhūma ādi liṅga grahaṇa samaye na manāk api tad anumeya dahana liṅgī anupraveśa sparśaḥ vidyate iti nanu artha āpattau api kim prameya anupraveśaḥ na doṣaḥ na doṣaḥ iti brūmaḥ pramāṇa dvaya samarpita eka vastu viṣaya abhāva bhāva samarthana artham arthāpattiḥ pravartamānā prameya dvayam parāmṛśati eva anyathā tad haṭanā yogāt atas ca yā iyam āgamāt aniyata deśa tayā kvacid asti iti saṃvittiḥ abhūt sā eva iyam gṛha abhāve gṛhīte bahis asti iti saṃvittiḥ adhunā saṃvṛttā tat atas vailakṣaṇyāt na anumānam arthāpattiḥ

atas ca evam sambandha grahaṇa abhāvāt bhāva abhāvau hi na ekena yugapad vahni dhūma vat pratibaddha tayā boddhum śakyau gṛha bahis sthitau anyathā anupapattyā ca prathamam pratibandha dhīḥ paścāt yadi anumāna tvam ucyate kāmam ucyatām nanu asti eva gṛha dvāre vartinaḥ saṅgatigrahaḥ bhāvena abhāva siddhau tu katham eṣa bhaviṣyati

yatra gṛhe caitrasya bhāvam avagamya tat anyathā anupapattyā tad anya deśeṣu na astitvam avagamyate tatra deśānām ānantyāt duradhigamaḥ pratibandhaḥ anagni vyatirekasya niścaye dhūmasya kā vārtā iti ced ucyate tatra dhūma jvalanayoḥ anvaya grahaṇa saṃbhavāt na vyatireka grahaṇam ādriyeran bhūyas darśana sulabha niyama jñāna saṃpādyamāna sādhya adhigama nirvṛtta manasām kim anagni vyatireka niścayena iha punar anvaya avasāya samayaḥ eva gamya dharmasya duravagam a tvam uktam ananta deśa vṛtti tvāt

anupalabdhyā tad niścayaḥ iti ced na mandira vyatirikta sakala bhuvana tala gata tad abhāva niścayasya niyata deśayā anupalabdhyā kartum aśakyatvāt teṣu teṣu deśa antareṣu paribhraman anupalabdhyā tad abhāvam niśceṣyāmi iti ced mā evam gatvā gatvā api tān deśāt na asya jānāmi na astitām kauśāmbyāḥ tvayi niṣkrānte tad praveśa ādi śaṅkayā tasmāt abhūmiḥ iyam asarva jñānām iti artha āpattyā eva tat niścayaḥ

nanu ittham amumartham anumānāt niśceṣyāmaḥ deśa antarāṇi caitra śūnyāni caitra adhiṣṭhita deśa vyatirikta tvāt tad samīpa deśa vat iti na pratyanumāna upahata tvāt deśa antarāṇi caitrāvyatiriktāni tad samīpa deśa vyatirikta tvāt caitra adhiṣṭhita deśa vat iti tasmāt niyata deśa upalabhyamāna paribhita parimāṇa puruṣa śarīrānyathā anupapattya eva tad itarasakala deśanā astitva ābadhāraṇam tasya iti siddham

pīnaḥ divā ca na atti iti sākāṅkṣa vacana śruteḥ tat eka deśa vijñānam śruta arthāpattiḥ ucyate iha evaṃvidha sākāṅkṣa vacana śravaṇe sati samupajāyamānam rajanī bhojana vijñānam pramāṇa antara karaṇakam bhavitum arhati pratyakṣa ādeḥ asannidhānāt na pratyakṣam kṣapā bhakṣaṇa pratīti kṣamam parokṣa tvāt na anumānam anavagata sambandhasya api tad pratīteḥ upamāna ādeḥ tu śaṅkā eva na udeti tasmāt śābdaḥ eva rātri bhojana pratyayaḥ

śabdaḥ ca na śrūyamāṇaḥ imam artham abhivaditum alam ekasya vākyasya vidhi niṣedha rūpa artha dvaya samarthana śūnyatvāt atra ca rātri ādi padānām aśravaṇāt apadārthasya vākya artha tva anupapatteḥ na ca vibhāvarī bhojana lakṣaṇaḥ arthaḥ divā vākya padārthānām bhedaḥ saṃsargaḥ vā yena ayam apadārthaḥ api pratīyet tasmāt kalpya āgama kṛtam naktamatti iti vedanam tad vākya kalpanāyām ca pramāṇam paricintyatām nā adhyakṣam anabhivyakta śabda grahaṇa śaktimat na liṅgam agṛhītvā api vyāptim tad avadhāraṇāt kvacid nitya parokṣa tvāt vyāpti bodhaḥ api durghaṭaḥ viniyoktrī śrutiḥ yatra kalpyā prakaraṇa ādibhiḥ

viniyoktrī hi śrutiḥ sarvatra prakaraṇa ādau vākya vidbhiḥ abhyupagamyate yathā uktam viniyoktrī śrutiḥ tāvat sarveṣu eteṣu sammatāḥ iti tasyāḥ ca nitya parokṣa tvāt duradhigamaḥ tatra liṅgasya pratibandhaḥ na ca niśā pada vacanasya sattā anumātum api śakyā tasyām sādhyāyām bhāva abhāva ubhaya dharmakasya hetoḥ asiddha viruddha anaikāntika tvena ahetu tvāt na ca atra dharmaḥ kaścid upalabhyate yaḥ tena tadvān parvataḥ iva agnimān anumīyate

na ca divā vākyam tad arthaḥ vā niśā vacana anumāne liṅgatām pratipattum arhati aśrute hi niśā vākye katham tad dharma tā grahaḥ śrute tu tasmin tad dharma grahaṇe kim prayojanam divā vākya padārthānām tiṣṭhatu liṅga tvam anupapadyamāna tayā api na niśā vākya pratyāyaka tvam avakalpate padārthānām hi sāmānya ātmaka tvāt viśeṣam antareṇa anupapattiḥ syāt na vākya antaram antareṇa tasmāt śrūyamāṇam vākyam eva tat eka deśam antareṇa nirākāṅkṣa pratyaya utpādaka sva vyāpāra nirvahaṇa sandhim anadhigacchat tat eka deśam ākṣipati iti sā iyam pramāṇa eka deśa viṣayā śruta arthāpattiḥ

nanu arthāt eva katham artha antaram na kalpyate pīvara tvam hi nāma bhojana kāryam upalabhyamānam sva kāraṇam bhojanam analam iva dhūmaḥ samupasthāpayatu tat ca vacasā kāla viśeṣe niṣiddham tad itara kāla viśeṣa viṣayam bhaviṣyati iti kim vacana anumānena vacanam api na adṛṣṭa artham api tu artha gati artham eva tat asya sākṣāt arthasya eva kalpyamānasya kaḥ doṣaḥ yat vyavadhānam āśrīyate ucyate śabda pramāṇa mārge asmin anabhijñaḥ asi vālaka pramāṇa tā eva na hi asya sa ākāṅkṣa jñāna kāriṇaḥ puras avasthita vastu aṃśa darśana prāpti nirvṛti pratyakṣa ādi yathā mānam na tathā śābdam iṣyate vākya arthe hi samagra aṅga paripūraṇa su sthite avidhāya dhiyam na asya vyāpāraḥ paryavasyati tāvantam bodham ādhāya prāmāṇyam labhate vacaḥ tad artha vācaka tvāt ca tat vākyam vākyam iṣyate śabda eka deśa śrutyā atas tad aṃśa paripūraṇam kalpyam prathamam arthasya kutas tena vinā gatiḥ

prāyas śruta artha āpattyā ca vedaḥ kāryeṣu pūryate tatra arthaḥ kalpyamānaḥ tu na bhavet eva vaidikaḥ yaḥ mantraiḥ aṣṭakā liṅgaiḥ tad vidhiḥ parikalpyate śrutiḥ liṅga ādibhiḥ yā ca kalpyate viniyojikā viśvajiti adhikāraḥ ca yāga kartavya tā śruteḥ utpatti vākyam saurya ādau adhikāra vidhi śruteḥ aindra agna ādi vikāreṣu kārya mātra upadeśataḥ yaḥ ca prakṛti vat bhāvaḥ vidhyantaḥ upapādyate tat evamādau sambandha grahaṇa anupapattitaḥ śruta artha āpattiḥ eva eṣā nissapatnam vijṛmbhate tayā śrutyā eka deśaḥ ca sarvatra parikalpyate artha kalpana pakṣe tu na syāt veda eka gamya tā iti artha āpattiḥ uktā eṣā ṣaṭpramāṇa samudbhavā

eṣā vicāryamāṇā tu bhidyate na anumānataḥ pratibandhāt vinā vastu na vastu antara bodhakam yam kañcid artham ālokya na yaḥ kaścid pratīyate pratibandhaḥ api na ajñātaḥ prayāti mati hetu tām na sadyojāta bāla ādeḥ udbhavanti tathā dhiyaḥ na viśeṣa ātmanā yatra saṃbandha jñāna saṃbhavaḥ tatra api asti eva sāmānya rūpeṇa tad upagrahaḥ

api ca tena vinā na upapadyate iti kalpanam arthāpattiḥ tena vinā na upapadyate iti ca vyatireka bhaṇitiḥ iyam vyatirekaḥ ca pratītaḥ tasmin sati upapadyate iti anvayam ākṣipati anvaya vyatirekau ca gamakasya liṅgasya dharmaḥ iti katham arthāpattiḥ na anumānam kevala vyatirekī hetuḥ anvaya mūlaḥ eva gamakaḥ iti vakṣyāmaḥ

yāḥ ca pratyakṣa ādi pūrvikāḥ śakti kalpanāyām artha āpattayaḥ udāhṛtāḥ tāḥ ca śakteḥ atīndriyāyāḥ abhāvāt nirviṣayā eva svarūpāt udbhavat kāryam saha kārī upavṛhmitāt na hi kalpayitum śaktam śaktim anyām atīndriyām

nanu śaktim antareṇa kārakam kārakam eva na bhavet yathā pādapam chettu manasā paraśuḥ udyamyate tathā pādukā ādi api udyamyeta śakteḥ anabhyupagame hi dravya svarūpā viśeṣāt sarvasmāt sarvadā sarva kārya udaya prasaṅgaḥ tathā hi viṣa dahanayoḥ māraṇe dāhe ca śakta a aniṣyamāṇāyām mantra pratibaddhāyām svarūpa pratyabhijñāyām satyām api sva kārya audāsīnyam yat dṛśyate tatra kā yuktiḥ na hi mantreṇa svarūpa sahakāri sānnidhyam pratibadhyate tasya pratyabhijñāyamāna tvāt śaktiḥ tu pratibadhyate iti sati api svarūpe satsu api sahakāriṣu kārya anutpādaḥ yuktaḥ kiñca sevā adhyayana ādi sāmye api phala vaicitrya darśanāt atīndriyam kim api kāraṇam kalpitam eva dharma ādi bhavadbhiḥ atas śaktiḥ atīndriyā tathā abhyupagamyatām iti

tat etat anupapannam yat tāvat upādāna niyamāt iti uktam tatra ucyate na hi vayam adya kiñcid abhinavam bhāvānām kārya kāraṇa bhāvam utthāpayitum śaknumaḥ kintu yathāpravṛttam anusarantaḥ vyavaharāmaḥ na hi asmad icchayā āpaḥ śītam śamayanti kṛśānuḥ vā pipāsām tatra chedana ādau anvaya vyatirekābhyām vā vṛddha vyavahārāt vā paraśvadha ādeḥ eva kāraṇa tvam adhyavagacchāmaḥ iti tat eva tad arthinaḥ upādadmahe na pādukā ādi iti

na ca paraśvadha ādeḥ svarūpa sannidhāne sati api sarvadā kārya udayaḥ svarūpa vat sahakāriṇām api apekṣaṇīya tvāt sahakāri sannidhānasya sarvadā anupapatteḥ sahakāri varge ca dharma ādikam api nipatati tad apekṣe kārya utpāde katham sarvadā tad saṃbhavaḥ dharma adharmayoḥ ca jagat vaicitrya kārya valena kalpanam aparihāryam tayoḥ ca na śakti tvāt atīndriya tvam api tu sva rūpamahimnā eva manaḥ paramāṇu ādi vat

yat api viṣa dahana sannidhāne sati api mantra prayogāt tad kārya adarśanam tat api na śakti pratibandhana nibandhanam api tu sāmagrī antara anupraveśa hetukam nanu mantreṇa praviśatā tatra kim kṛtam na kiñcid kṛtam sāmagryantaram tu saṃpāditam kācid hi sāmagrī kasyacid kāryasya hetuḥ svarūpam tad avastham eva iti ced yadi evam abhakṣitam api viṣam katham na hanyāt

tatrā aasi asaṃyoga ādi apekṣaṇīyam asti iti ced mantra abhāvaḥ api apekṣya tām divya karaṇa kāle dharmaḥ iva mantraḥ api anupraviṣṭaḥ kāryam pratihanti śakti pakṣe api vā mantrasya kaḥ vyāpāraḥ mantreṇa hi śakteḥ nāśaḥ vā kriyate pratibandhaḥ vā na tāvat nāśaḥ mantra apagame punar tad kārya darśanāt pratibandhaḥ tu svarūpasya eva śakteḥ iva astu svarūpasya kim jātam śakteḥ api kim jātam kārya audāsīnyam iti ced tat itaratra api samānam svarūpam asti eva dṛśyamāna tvāt iti ced śaktiḥ api asti eva punar kārya darśanena anumīyamāna tvāt iti

kiñca śaktiḥ abhyupagamyamānā padārtha svarūpa vat nityāḥ abhyupagamyeta kāryā vā nitya tve sarvadā kārya udaya prasaṅgaḥ sahakārī apekṣāyām tu svarūpasya eva tad apekṣā astu kim śaktyā kāryatve tu śakteḥ padārtha svarūpa mātra kārya tvam vā syāt sahakārya ādi sāmagrī kārya tvam vā sva rūpa mātra kārya tve punar api sarvadā kārya utpāda prasaṅgaḥ sarvadā śakteḥ utpādāt sāmagrī kārya tve tukāryam eva sāmagrī kāryam astu kim antarāla vartinyā śaktyā
aśaktāt kārakāt kāryam na niṣpadyate iti ced śaktiḥ api kāryam tad utpattau api evam śakti antara kalpanādanavasthā
āha dṛṣṭa siddhaye hi adṛṣṭam kalpyate na tu dṛṣṭa vighātāya śakti antara kalpanāyām śakti śreṇī nirmāṇaḥ eva kṣīṇa tvāt kārakāṇām kārya vighātaḥ syāt iti ekā eva śaktiḥ kalpyate tat kutas anavasthā

atra ucyate yadi adṛṣṭam antareṇa dṛṣṭam na siddhyati kāmam adṛṣṭam kalpyatām anyathā api tad upapattau kim tad upakalpanena darśitā ca anyathā api upapattiḥ kalpyamānam api ca adṛṣṭam tat kalpyatām yat anavasthām na avaheta dharma ādi vat api ca vyāpāraḥ api atīndriyaḥ śakti vat iṣyate bhavadbhiḥ anyatara kalpanayā eva kārya upapatteḥ kim ubhaya kalpanā gauraveṇa

śaktam avyāpriyamāṇam na kārakam kārakam iti ced tat śaktam iti tadā katham jānāmi kārya darśanāt jñāsyāmi iti ced vyāpārāt eva kāryam setsyati pādukā ādeḥ vyāpriyamāṇāt api na pādapa chedaḥ dṛśyate iti ced pratyakṣaḥ tarhi vyāpāraḥ na atīndriyaḥ yatas kārya darśanāt pūrvam api vyāpriyamāṇa tvam jñātam āyuṣma tā kārya anumeyaḥ hi vyāpāraḥ kāryam vinā na jñāyeta eva kāryam tu anyatarasmāt api ghaṭamānam na ubhayam kalpayitum prabhavati iti alam prasaṅgena prakṛtam anusarāmaḥ tasmāt atīndriyāyāḥ śakteḥ abhāvāt nirviṣayāḥ yathā udāhṛtāḥ tāḥ artha āpattayaḥ bhavanti

api vā śaktiḥ atīndriyāḥ anumānasya eva viṣayaḥ kāryasya kāraṇa pūrvaka tvena vyāpti grahaṇāt sva rūpa mātrasya ca kāraṇa tva anirvahaṇāt adhikam kim api anumāsyate sā śaktiḥ iti śabda nitya tva siddhau tu yā arthāpattiḥ udāhṛtā tasyāḥ śabda parīkṣāyām samādhiḥ abhidhāsyate

abhāva pūrvikā api arthāpattiḥ anumānam eva jīvataḥ gṛha abhāvena liṅga bhūtena bahirbhāva avagamāt caitrasya gṛha abhāvaḥ dharmī bahis bhāvena tadvān iti sādhyaḥ dharmaḥ jīvan manuṣya gṛha abhāva tvāt pūrva upalabdhā evaṃvidha gṛha abhāva vat yathā dhūmaḥ dharmī vahnimān iti sādhyaḥ dharmaḥ dhūma tvāt pūrva upalabdha dhūma vat iti atas ca gṛha ādīnām liṅga tva āśaṅkanam apākaraṇam ca āḍambara mātram

yat punar prameya anupraveśa dūṣaṇam abhyadhāyi tat api na sāṃpratam kim prameyam abhimatam atrabhavatām kim sattā mātram uta bahis deśa viśeṣitam sattvam sattā mātram tāvat āgamāt eva avagatam iti na pramāṇa antara prameya tām avalambate bahis deśa viśeṣitam tu sattvam bhavati prameyam tasya tu tadānīm anupraveśaḥ kutastyaḥ gṛha abhāva grāhakam hi pramāṇam gṛhe eva sat upalambhaka pramāṇa avakāśam apākaroti na bahissaṃdasattva cintām prastauti mṛtasya jīvataḥ dūre tiṣṭhataḥ prāṅgaṇe api vā gṛha abhāva paricchede na viśeṣaḥ asti kaścana jīvana viśiṣṭaḥ tu asau gṛhyamāṇaḥ liṅga tām aśnute vyabhicāra nirāsāt na ca viśeṣaṇa grahaṇam eva prameya grahaṇam jīvanam anyat anyat ca bahirbhāva ākhyam prameyam

nanu jīvana viśiṣṭa gṛha abhāva pratītiḥ eva bahirbhāva pratītiḥ na etat evam jīvana viśiṣṭa gṛha abhāva pratīteḥ bahirbhāvasya pratītiḥ na tad pratītiḥ eva bahirbhāva pratītiḥ na hi dahana adhikaraṇe dhūma pratītiḥ eva dahana pratītiḥ nanu dhūmāt anyaḥ eva dahanaḥ iha api gṛha abhāva jīvanābhyām anyaḥ eva bahirbhāvaḥ

parvata hutavahayoḥ siddha tvāt mattu artha mātram tatra apūrvam anumeyam evam iha api bahis deśa yoga mātram apūrvam anumeyam yadi tu tat adhikam prameyam iha na iṣyate tadā gṛha abhāva jīvanayoḥ sva pramāṇābhyām avadhāraṇāt ānarthakyam arthāpatteḥ tasmāt prameya antara sadbhāvāt tasya ca tadānīm ananupraveśāt na prameya anupraveśaḥ doṣaḥ

artha āpattau api ca tulyaḥ eva ayam doṣaḥ tatra api arthāt artha antara kalpanā abhyupagamāt dṛṣṭaḥ śrutaḥ vā arthaḥ anyathā na upapadyate iti artha kalpanā iti evam grantha upanibandhāt tasya tasmāt pratītiḥ iti yatra vyavahāraḥ tatra avaśyam tad pratītau tad anupraveśaḥ doṣaḥ eva svabhāva hetau iva tad buddhi siddhyā tad siddheḥ pramāṇa antara vaiphalyāt iti

prabhākarāḥ tu prakāra antareṇa anumānāt bhedam atra ācakṣate anumāne gamaka viśeṣaṇam anyathā anupapannam analam vinā dhūmaḥ hi na upapadyate iha tu viparyayaḥ gamyaḥ gamakena vinā na upapadyate gamyaḥ bahirbhāvaḥ sa jīvataḥ gṛha abhāvam vinā na upapadyate gṛhāt nirgataḥ jīvan bahis bhavati iti bhāṣya papi evam yojayanti dṛṣṭaḥ śrutaḥ vā arthaḥ artha kalpanā artha antaram kalpayati iti arthaḥ yatas sā kalpanā prameya dvārikā anyathā anupapadyate iti arthaḥ evam gamya gamakayoḥ anupapadyamāna tva viparyayāt anumānāt pramāṇa antaram iyam arthāpattiḥ iti bahirbhāvaḥ anyathānopapadyate sa ca gamyaḥ iti

etat api grantha vaiṣamya upapādana mātram na tu nūtana viśeṣa utprekṣaṇam gamye tāvat agṛhīte sati tad gatam anupapadyamāna tvam katham avadhāryeta gṛhīte tu gamye kim tad gata anupapadyamāna tva grahaṇena sādhyasya siddha tvāt purā tad gatam anyathā anupapadyamāna tvam gṛhītam āsīt iti ced aho mahān anu mānāt viśeṣaḥ idam hi pūrvam pratibandha grahaṇam uktam syāt

api ca bahirbhāvasya gṛha abhāvam vinā anupapattiḥ iti ukte tasmin sati tasya upapattiḥ vaktavyā sā ca kā kim utpattiḥ jñaptiḥ vā yadi jñaptiḥ sā ca anumāne api gamyam gamakam vinā na asti tasmin sati asti iti samānaḥ panthāḥ utpattiḥ tu gṛha abhāvāt bahirbhāvasya durbhaṇā prāc siddhe hi gṛha abhāve tad utpādaḥ kṣaṇa antare kāraṇam pūrva siddham hi kārya utpādāya kalpate tena ekatra kṣaṇe jīvan na gṛhe na bahis bhavet tasmāt yat kiñcid etat
evañca yat eke jñapti utpatti kṛtam iha vailakṣaṇyam utprekṣitavantaḥ dhūmena agniḥ gamyate eva gṛha abhāvena bahirbhāvaḥ janyate api iti tat api pratyuktam bhavati

yat tu sambandha grahaṇa abhāvāt iti uktam tat api na sundaram mandira dvāra vartinaḥ tad utpatteḥ etat ca svayam āśaṅkya na taiḥ pratisamāhitam udāharaṇam anyat tu vyatyayena pradarśitam gṛha bhāvena bahirabhāva kalpanam iti tatra etat eva vaktavyam iyam abhāva pūrvikā na bhavati eva arthāpattiḥ ṣaṣ arthāpattīḥ pratijñāya imām abhāva pūrvikām arthāpattim uktvā upanaiyyāyika kesari kaṭākṣa pāta bhītām iha gahane hariṇīm iva yat upekṣya gamyate tat atyantam atrabhava tām ana artha jana ucitam ceṣṭitam

tvad eka śaraṇām bālām imām utsṛjya gacchataḥ katham te tarkayiṣyanti mukham anyāḥ api striyaḥ bhāvena abhāva kalpanā tu pratyakṣa pūrvikā eva artha āpattiḥ tasyāḥ api ca na duravagamaḥ sambandhaḥ asarva gatasya dravyasya niyata deśa vṛtteḥ akleśena tad itara deśa nāstitva avadhāraṇāt anagni vyatireka niścaye ca dhūmasya bhavatām kā gatiḥ yā tatra vārtā sā eva iha api naḥ bhaviṣyati

na ca bhūyas darśanau agamyamāna anvaya mātra eka śaraṇa tayā yasya vastu antara abhāvaḥ gamyaḥ tasya eva duṣyati mama tu adṛṣṭi mātreṇa gamakāḥ sahacāriṇaḥ iti kathayitum ucitam aniścita vyatirekasya sādhya niścaya abhāvāt iti darśayiṣyāmaḥ pakṣa dharma anvaya vat vyatirekaḥ api na agṛhītaḥ anumāna aṅgam bahirbhāva siddhau ca anumāna prayogaḥ saḥ eva yaḥ tvayā darśitaḥ tasya tu pratiprayogaḥ pratyakṣa ādi viruddha tvāt hetvābhāse eva iti alam prasaṅgena

śruta arthāpattiḥ api varākī na anumānāt bhidyate vacana eka deśa kalpanāyāḥ anupapanna tvāt arthasya ca kārya liṅga gamyasya sattvāt yathā kṣitidhara kandhara adhikaraṇam dhūmam avalokya tad kāraṇam analam anuminoti bhavān evam āgamāt pīna tva ākhyam kāryam avadhārya tad kāraṇam api bhojanam anuminotu kaḥ atra viśeṣaḥ tad kārya tayā bhūyas darśanataḥ pratipanna tvāt liṅgasya tu kvacid pratyakṣeṇa grahaṇam kvacid vacanataḥ pratipattiḥ iti na eṣa mahān bhedaḥ

nanu vacanam aparipūrṇam iti pratītim eva yathocitām janayitum asamartham kim pīnaḥ devadattaḥ divā na bhuṅkte iti atas na bhavati tad pīnatā pratītiḥ na na bhavati sa ākāṅkṣā tu bhavati na ca sa ākāṅkṣa pratīti kāriṇaḥ tasya prāmāṇyam iti tat eva tāvat pūrayitum yuktam tat asat kasya atra sa ākāṅkṣa tvam kim śabdasya kim vā tad arthasya uta svid tadava gamasya iti

śabdasya tāvat artha nirapekṣasya na kācid ākāṅkṣā anabhivyakta śabda vat arthaḥ tu sā ākāṅkṣassan artha antaram upakalpayatu kaḥ avasaraḥ vacana kalpanāyāḥ avagamaḥ api artha viṣayaḥ eva sa ākāṅkṣaḥ bhavati na śabda viṣayaḥ śrotra karaṇakaḥ tasmāt avagamanaiḥ ākāṅkṣya siddhaye tad artha kalpanam eva yuktam vacana eka deśa kalpanam api artha avagati siddhi artham eva iti tad kalpanam eva astu kim sopāna antareṇa

yat tu kalpyamānasya arthasya avaidika tvam prāpnoti iti tatra vacana kalpanā pakṣe suta rāma vaidikaḥ saḥ arthaḥ syāt kalpyamānasya vacanasya vedāt anyatvāt śrutaḥ anumitaḥ ca dvividhaḥ sa vedaḥ eva iti ced śrauta arthaḥ śrauta artha anumitaḥ dvividhaḥ sa veda arthaḥ eva bhaviṣyati iti kim vacana sopāna antara kalpanayā tena śrūyamāṇa veda vacana pratipādya artha sāmarthya labhya tvāt eva tasya veda artha tā bhaviṣyati sarvathā na vacana eka deśa viṣayā śruta arthāpattiḥ śreyasī śruti eka deśa kalpanā pakṣa pratikṣepāt ca

tad atīndriya tayā sambandha grahaṇam aghaṭamānam iti yat uktam tat api pratyuktam arthe tu sāmānyena sambandha grahaṇam api sūpa pādam tatra tatra yaji ādeḥ arthasya adhikāra ādi artha antara sambaddhasya dṛṣṭa tvāt iti

prābhākarāḥ tu dṛṣṭaḥ śrutaḥ vā itibhāṣyam laukikam abhidhāna antaram eva idam upalabdhi vacanam iti varṇayantaḥ śruta arthāpattim pratyācakṣate śrūyamāṇasya eva śabdasya tāvatī arthe sāmarthyam upagacchantaḥ tam artham śābdam eva pratijānate vākyasya dūra avidūra vyavasthita guṇa aguṇa kriyā ādi aneka kāraka kalāpa uparakta kārya ātmaka vākya artha pratītau iṣoḥ iva dīrgha dīrghaḥ vyāpāraḥ avirata vyāpāre ca śabde sā pratītiḥ udeti tad vyāpāra viratau na udeti tad utpādaka kāraka abhāvāt vṛddha vyavahārataḥ ca śabdeṣu vyutpadyamānaḥ lokaḥ tathābhūta vākya vyavahāriṇaḥ vṛddhān paśyan vākyasya eva tādṛśa vākya arthe sāmarthyam avadhārayati tad anuvartīni tu padāni tasmin naimittike nimittāni bhavanti

naimittika ānukūlya paryālocanayā kvacid aśrūyamāṇāni api tāni nimitta tām bhajante viśva jit ādau svarga kāma ādi pada vat kvacid śrūyamāṇāni api tad ananukūla tvāt parityajyante yasya ubhayam haviḥ ārtim ārcchet iti vat kvacid anyathā sthitāni tat anurodhāt anyathā eva sthāpyante prayāja śeṣeṇa havīṃṣi abhighārayati itivat tasmāt prathama avagata eka ghana ākāra vākya artha anusāreṇa satām asatām vā padānām nimitta bhāva vyavasthāpanāt aśrūyamāṇa tathāvidha eka deśāt api vākyāt tad artha avagati saṃbhavāt kim śruta artha āpattyā atas eva na sa upāta vyavahitam tasya arthasya śābda tvam sākṣāt eva tad siddheḥ

nanu aśrūyamāṇeṣu nimitteṣu kutas tad artham avagacchāmaḥ anavagacchantaḥ ca kīdṛśam naimittikam avakalpayāmaḥ ucyate śruteṣu api padeṣu teṣām nimitta bhāvaḥ na sva mahimnā avaphalpate kintu naimittika anusāra dvārakaḥ iti uktam evam aśruteṣī api bhaviṣyati na yajau karaṇa vibhaktim śṛṇumaḥ na svarge karma vibhaktim na agnacit ādiṣu kvippratyayam na adhunā ādiṣu prakṛtim na samāsa tad hiteṣu yathocitām vibhaktim api ca pratīmaḥ eva tad artham evam viśva jit ādau api yajeta iti naimittika balāt eva svarga kāma ādi padārtham pratyeṣyāmaḥ niyoga garbha tvāt ca viniyogasya liṅga ādīni śruti kalpanām antareṇa api niyoga vyāpāram parigṛhya tena vastuni viniyojaka tām pratipatsyante

nanu evam sati sarvatra śabda vyāpāra saṃbhavāt mukhyasya api bhavet sāmyam gauṇala akṣaṇikā ādibhiḥ śruti liṅga ādi mānānām virodhe yat ca varṇyate pūrva pūrva balīyaḥ tvam tat katham vā bhaviṣyati ucyate sati api sarvatra śabda vyāpāre tad prakāra bheda upapatteḥ eṣa na doṣaḥ na hi padānām sarva ātmanā nimitta bhāvam apahāya eva naimittika pratītiḥ upaplavate tad aparityāgāt ca tad svarūpa vaicitryam anuvartate eva

anyathā siṃha śabdena matiḥ kesariṇī sute anyathā devadatta ādau pratītiḥ upajanyate gaṅgāyām majjati iti atra gaṅgā śabdaḥ nimitta tām upayāti yathā na evam ghoṣa ādi vasatau tathā śruti liṅga vākya prakaraṇa sthāna samākhyānām api artha sannikarṣa viprakarṣa kṛtaḥ asti eva viśeṣaḥ iti tatra api na viniyoga sāmyam

śruti liṅga ādibhiḥ yaḥ api kalpayet viniyojikām tasya api tasyāḥ tulya tvāt bādhya bādhaka tā katham atha tad kalpane teṣām vidūra antika vṛtti tā saḥ eva artha gataḥ nyāyaḥ iti tad kalpanena kim aindra agna ādiṣu vaikṛteṣu karmasu na prākṛta vidhi anta vacana anumānam api tu ca udaka vyāpāreṇa tasya eva prāptiḥ vaikṛtasya vidheḥ kācid ākāṅkṣā ca udakaḥ iti ucyate

nanu evam ubhayatra tad avagama aviśeṣāt upadeśa atideśayoḥ kaḥ viśeṣaḥ na niyoga avagame kaścid viśeṣaḥ kintu upadeśe yathopadeśam kāryam atideśe tu yathākāryam upadeśaḥ iti etayoḥ viśeṣaḥ nanu yathākāryam upadeśe anupayujyamāna kṛṣṇala carvavaghāta ādeḥ prāptiḥ eva na bhavet iti kaḥ bādha arthaḥ na akhaṇḍa maṇḍala vidhi anta kāṇḍa prāpteḥ na hi aṃśa aṃśikayā ca udakaḥ pravartate iti alam anayā prasakta anuprasakti āgata śāstra antara garbha kathā vistara prastāvanayā
iti prasaṅgāt vyākhyātam leśataḥ vākya vid matam etasya yuktā yukta tva paricchede tu ke vayam śruta arthāpattiḥ asmākam dūṣaṇīya tayā sthitā tad dūṣaṇam ca pūrva ukta vīthyā anena pathā astu vā

etena śabda sāmarthya mahimnā saḥ api vāritaḥ yam anyaḥ paṇḍitaṃmanyaḥ prapede kaṃcana dhvanim vidheḥ niṣedha avagatiḥ vidhi buddhiḥ niṣedhataḥ yathā bhava dhammiya vīsatthaḥ mā sma pāntha gṛham viśa māna antara paricchedya vastu rūpa upadeśinām śabdānām eva sāmarthyam tatra tatra tathā tathā athavā na īdṛśī carcā kavibhiḥ saha śobhate vidvāṃsaḥ api vimuhyanti vākya artha gahane adhvani tat alam anayā goṣṭhyā vidvat jana ucitayā ciram parama gahanaḥ tarka jñānām abhūmiḥ ayam nayaḥ prakṛtam adhunā tasmāt brūmaḥ na bhāti anumānataḥ tanuḥ api satām artha āpatteḥ viśeṣaḥ iti sthitam

āha abhāvaḥ tarhi pramāṇa antara mastuḥ sat paricchedakam yatra na pramāṇam pravartate tad abhāva mitau mānam pramāṇa abhāvaḥ ucyate iha ghaṭaḥ na asti iti ghaṭam prati sat upalambhaka pramāṇa pravṛttiḥ na asti iti asau pramāṇa abhāvaḥ ghaṭa abhāvam paricchinatti tatra ca ghaṭa viṣaya jñātṛvyāpārān utpādaḥ eva dṛśya adarśana vācyaḥ pramāṇam na asti iti buddhiḥ phalam atha vā ghaṭa abhāva grāhī grahītṛ vyāpāra sat upalambhaka pramāṇa abhāva janitaḥ na asti iti pratyaya svabhāvaḥ pramāṇam phalam tu hāna ādi jñānam bhaviṣyati tat uktam pratyakṣa ādeḥ anutpattiḥ pramāṇa abhāvaḥ ucyate sā aatmaṇaḥ apariṇāmaḥ vā vijñānam vā anya vastuni iti anya vastu śabdana ghaṭa abhāvaḥ eva uktaḥ

tatra tāvat idam na asti iti jñānam na pratyakṣa janitam indriya artha sannikarṣa abhāvāt sannikarṣaḥ hi saṃyoga samavāya svabhāvaḥ tad prabhava bhedaḥ vā saṃyukta samavāya ādiḥ iha na asti eva saṃyuktaṃviśeṣaṇa bhāvaḥ api na saṃbhavati kumbha abhāvasya bhū pradeśa viśeṣaṇa tva abhāvāt na hi asaṃyuktam asamavetam vā kiñcid viśeṣaṇam bhavati saṃyuktasya daṇḍa ādeḥ samavetasya śukla guṇa ādeḥ tathā abhāva darśanāt abhāvaḥ ca na kenacid saṃyujyate adravya bhāvāt na kvacid samavaiti guṇa ādi vailakṣaṇyāt iti

yadi ca saṃyukta viśeṣaṇa bhāva sannikarṣa upakṛtam cakṣuḥ abhāvam gṛhṇāti tarhi tad aviśeṣāt saṃyukta dravya vṛttīn rasa ādīn api gṛhṇīyāt ayogya tvāt na gṛhṇāti iti ced tad abhāvam api mā grahīt ayogya tva aviśeṣāt yogya ayogya tva kṛta grahaṇa agrahaṇa niyama vāde vā yogya tā eva sannikarṣaḥ bhavatu kim ṣaṭka ghoṣeṇa tasmāt na ghaṭa abhāva jñānam cākṣuṣam

nanu bhū pradeśam ca ghaṭa abhāvam ca viṣphārite cakṣuṣi nirīkṣāmahe nimīlite tu tasmin tayoḥ anyataram api na paśyāmaḥ tatra samāne ca tad bhāva bhāvi tve bhū pradeśa jñānam cākṣuṣam abhāva jñānam tu na cākṣuṣam iti kutas viśeṣam avagacchāmaḥ bāḍham avagacchāmaḥ sannikarṣa abhāvāt eva na hi asannikṛṣṭam cakṣuḥ avagati janmane prabhavati

tad bhāva bhāvi tvam tu idam anyathā siddham vidūra deśa vyavasthita sthūla jvālā āvalī jaṭila jvalana gata bhāsvara rūpa upalambha anuvarti tad gata uṣṇa sparśa jñāna vat tatra yathā rūpa anumīyamāna sparśa vedane nayana anvaya vyatireka anuvidhānam anyathā siddham evam iha api bhū predeśa upalambhāvinā bhāvini kumbha abhāva grahaṇe tad kṛtam indriya anvaya vyatireka anuvidhānam iti na cākṣuṣaḥ ghaṭa abhāva pratibhāsaḥ tat uktam gṛhītvā vastu sadbhāvam smṛtvā ca pratiyoginam mānasam na astita ajñānam jāyate akṣa anapekṣayā iti

atas ca eva asannihitasya api kvacid grahaṇam sva rūpa mātrakeṇa gauramūlakam upalabdhavataḥ tatas deśa antaram gatasya tatra kenacid gargaḥ asti vā na asti vā iti pṛṣṭasya sata sva rūpa mātram gṛhītam gauramūlakam anusmarataḥ tad ānīm asat nikṛṣṭaṃ api gargasya bhāve tadā eva tasya jñānam udeti tatra indriya kathā api na asti iti na tasya pratyakṣa tvam

na ca anumāna gamyaḥ ayam abhāvaḥ bhū pradeśasya tad gata ghaṭa adarśanasya vā liṅga tva anupapattaḥ na bhū pradeśaḥ liṅgam agṛhīta sambandhasya api tad pratīteḥ anaikāntika tvāt apakṣa dharma tvāt tad adhikaraṇa abhā a ānantyena sambandha grahaṇa asaṃbhavāt ca na api ghaṭādarśanam liṅgam apakṣa dharma tvāt ghaṭādarśanam ghaṭasya dharmaḥ na tad abhāvasya ghaṭa abhāva pratītim prati vyāpriyamāṇa tvāt tad dharma tvam asya iti ced na itaretara āśraya prasaṅgāt tad dharma tve sati liṅga pratīti janaka tvam pratīti janmani sati tad dharma tvam iti asiddhāyām ca ghaṭa abhāva pratītau tad dharmatā jñānam adarśanasya durghaṭam eva siddhāyām tu kim pakṣa dharma tā jñānena sādhya pratīteḥ siddha tvāt

api ca idam adarśana ākhyam liṅgam avidita vyāpti katham abhāvasya anumāpakam bhavet vyāpti grahaṇam ca dhūma agni vat ubhaya dharmi grahaṇa pūrvakam tatra vyāpti grahaṇa velāyām eva tāvat kutastyam abhāva ākhya dharmi grahaṇam iti cintyam tatas eva anumānāt iti yadi ucyate tad itaretara āśrayam anumāna antara nibandhane tu tad grahaṇe anavasthā

adarśana ākhyam liṅgam api darśana abhāva svabhāvam iti tad svarūpa pariccheda cintāyām api ayam eva panthāḥ atas dūram api gatvā tad avagama siddhaye pramāṇa antaram abhāva pariccheda nipuṇam avagantavyam iti tatas eva tad avagama siddheḥ na tasya anumeya tvam na ca idam iha ghaṭaḥ na asti iti jñānam śabda upamāna artha apatti anyatama nimittam āśaṅkitum api yuktam iti sat upalambhaka pramāṇa atīta tvāt abhāvasya eva bhūmiḥ abhāvaḥ iti yuktam api ca prameyam anurūpeṇa pramāṇena pramātum uvitam bhāva ātmake prameye hi na abhāvasya pramāṇa tā abhāve api prameye syāt na bhāvasya pramāṇa tā na prameyam abhāva ākhyam nihnutam bauddha vat tvayā pramāṇam api tena idam abhāva ātmakam iṣyatām

atra abhidhīyate satyam abhāvaḥ prameyam abhyupagamyate pratyakṣa ādi avasīyamāna svarūpa tvāt tu na pramāṇa antaram ātma paricchittaye mṛgayate adūra medinī deśa vartinaḥ tasya cakṣuṣā paricchedaḥ parokṣasya kvacid māna antaraiḥ api tathā ca iha ghaṭaḥ na asti iti jñānam ekam eva idam iha kuṇḍe dadhi iti jñāna vat ubhaya ālambanam anuparata nayana vyāpārasya bhavati tatra bhū pradeśa mātraḥ eva nayana jam jñānam itaratra pramāṇa antara janitam iti kutastyaḥ ayam vibhāgaḥ

atra agniḥ iti yuktaḥ ayam anakṣajaḥ pratibhāsaḥ dhūma grahaṇa anantaram avinā abhāva smaraṇa ādi buddhi antara vyavadhāna saṃbhavāt iha tu tathā na asti eva avyavahitā eva hi bhū pradeśa vat ghaṭana astitā avagatiḥ avicchedena anubhūyate na ca kṣitidhara adhikaraṇa parokṣa āśu śukṣaṇi vat anīkṣaṇa viṣaya tā bhavati abhāvasya tad vyāpāra anvaya vyatireka anuvidhāyi tvāt tad pratīteḥ tatra hi vyāpṛta akṣaḥ api na parvata vartinam analam avalokayitum utsahate iha tu ghaṭa abhāvam aparimlāna nayana vyāpāraḥ eva paśyati iti cākṣuṣam abhāva jñānam tad bhāva bhāvitva anuvidhānāt

na ca dūra sthita hutavaha rūpa darśana pūrvaka sparśa anumāna vat idam anyathā siddham tad bhāva bhāvi tvam tatra hi bahuśas sparśa darśana kauśala śūnya tvam avadhāritam cakṣuṣaḥ sparśa paricchedi ca kāraṇa antaram tvac indriyam avagatam avinā bhāvitā ca purā tathāvidhayaḥ rūpa sparśayoḥ upalabdhā iti anumeyaḥ eva asau sparśaḥ iti yuktam tatra anyathā siddha tvam cakṣuḥ vyāpārasya prakṛte tu na īdṛśaḥ prakāraḥ samasti na ca ekatra tad bhāva bhāvi tvam anyathā siddham iti sarvatra tathā kalpyate evam hi rūpam api cākṣupatām avajahyāt

nanu nīrūpasya asaṃbaddhasya ca cākṣuṣa tvam abhāvasya katham abhidhīyate cakṣuḥ janita jñāna vat tvāt hi cākṣuṣa tvam na rūpavat tvena rūpavatām api paramāṇūnām acākṣuṣa tvāt nīrūpasya api rūpasya cākṣuṣa tvāt ca saṃbaddham api na sarvam cākṣuṣam ākāśasya tathā ātve api tad abhāvāt nanu asambaddhasya cakṣuṣā grahaṇe dūra vyavahitasya vibhīṣaṇa ādeḥ api cākṣuṣa tva prasaṅgaḥ ucyate bhāve khalu ayam niyamaḥ yat asambaddhasya cakṣuṣā agrahaṇam abhāvaḥ tu asambaddhaḥ api cakṣuṣā gṛhīṣyate

ṣaṣ prakāra sannikarṣa varṇanam api bhāva abhiprāyam eva sambaddha hi yat gṛhyate tat ṣaṇṇām sannikarṣaṇām anyatamena sannikarṣeṇa iti prāpya kāri tvam api indriyāṇām vastu abhiprāyam eva ucyate tasmāt avastu tvāt abhāvasya tena sannikarṣam alabhamānam api nayanam upajanayati tad viṣayam avagamam iti na doṣaḥ na ca asambaddhatva aviśeṣāt deśa antara ādiṣu sarva abhāva grahaṇam āśaṅkanīyam āśraya grahaṇa sāpekṣa tvāt abhāva pratītaḥ āśrayasya ca sannihitasya eva pratyakṣa tvāt
athavā saṃyukta viśeṣaṇa bhāva ākhya sannikarṣa upakṛtam cakṣuḥ abhāvam grahīṣyati yathā samavāya pratyakṣa tva vādinām pakṣe samavāyāmati

nanu tat idam asiddham asiddhasya dṛṣṭāntīkriyate mā evam bhavatā api dravya guṇayoḥ vṛtteḥ aparihārya tvāt bheda buddhyā siddha bhedayoḥ asambaddhayoḥ ca dravya guṇayoḥ adarśanāt avaśyam kācid vṛttiḥ eṣitavyā iti alam artha antara cintanena

yat tu uktam saṃyoga samavāyayoḥ abhāvāt abhāvaḥ na bhū pradeśasya viśeṣaṇam iti tat api asādhu saṃyoga samavāyābhyām anyasya eva viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāva nāmnaḥ sambandhasya adūraḥ eva pratīti balena darśayiṣyamāṇa tvāt

yaḥ tu saṃyukta viśeṣaṇa bhāve sannikarṣe rasa ādibhiḥ ati prasaṅgaḥ udbhāvitaḥ saḥ ayam saṃyukta samavāya ākhye cakṣū rūpa sannikarṣe api samānaḥ doṣaḥ saṃyukta samavāyaḥ api tarhi mā bhūt sannikarṣaḥ kim naḥ chinnam tat kim asambaddham eva rūpam gṛhṇātu cakṣuḥ na hi saṃyukta samavāyāt anyaḥ cakṣū rūpayoḥ sambandhaḥ

nanu artha grahaṇa ātmakaḥ vyāpāraḥ eva cakṣuṣaḥ sannikarṣaḥ yogyatā vā tad vaśāt eva rūpasya tat grāhakam upeyate na ca saṃyukta samavāya ādinā iti sa tarhi vyāpāraḥ sā vā yogya tā katham abhāvam api prati tasya na syāt prāpya kārīṇi ca indriyāṇi kāraka tvāt iṣyante sannikarṣaḥ ca nihnūyate iti vipratiṣiddham

tasmāt ṣaṣ prakārā sannikarṣa anugāminī yogya tā vaktavyā na yogyatā mātraḥ eva viśramya sthātavyam yatra yogyatā tatra sannikarṣaḥ api asti na tu yatra sannikarṣaḥ tatra avaśyam yogyatā iti evam abhyupagacchatām na rasa ādi ati prasaṅga codanāḥ dhunoti manaḥ rasa ādeḥ sati api sannikarṣe yogya tva abhāvāt agrahaṇam yogya tā mātra vāde api na abhau asya astyayogya tā bhavadbhiḥ vastu dharmaḥ asya kaḥ vā na abhyupagamyate sarva upākhya viyukta tvāt na asti eva iti eṣa vā ucyatām abhāvaḥ cākṣuṣa jñāna viṣayaḥ vā abhyupeyatām

yat api sva rūpa mātram dṛṣṭvā api paścāt kiñcid smaran api tatra āmyanāstitām pṛṣṭaḥ tadā eva pratipadyate iti uktam tat api na yuktam vastu antara vivikta gaura mūlaka svarūpa grahaṇa samayaḥ eva tatra asat nihita sakala padārtha abhāva grahaṇasya mecaka buddhyā siddha tvāt idānīm tad gata gargā bhāva smaraṇam na tasya parokṣasya anubhavaḥ

tathā hi tadānīm gargaḥ tatra na āsīt iti evam asau smṛtvā satya vādī vadati idānīm astitvanāstitve prati saṃśetaḥ eva asau gargasya kutaścid āgatasya idānīm tatra astitva saṃbhavāt nanu na pūrvam sarva abhāva grahaṇam anubhūtavān asau gauramūlake iti ced ananubhūyamānam api tat asya balāt kalpyate abhyasta viṣaye avinā abhāva smaraṇa vat tathā hi tena tena anuyuktaḥ tasya tasya abhāvam smṛtvā uttaram asau sarvebhyaḥ ācaṣṭe

nanu mecaka buddhyā sakala abhāva grahaṇe sahasā eva sakala abhāva smṛtiḥ upajāyeta mā evam yatra eva praśna ādi smaraṇa kāraṇam asya bhavati tat eva smarati na sarvam avidyamāna smaraṇa nimittam krama upalabdheṣu api varṇeṣu yugapadanti avarṇa anubhava samanantaram smaraṇam anyatra tu yugapad upalabdhe api krameṇa smaraṇam bhaviṣyati iti na mecaka buddhau ayam doṣaḥ

kiñca svarūpa mātram dṛṣṭam iti vadatā bhavatā api mecaka jñānam abhyupagatam eva mātra grahaṇena tad anya abhāva grahaṇa siddheḥ evam hi bhavān eva abhyadhāt ayam eva iti yaḥ hi eṣa bhāve bhavati nirṇayaḥ na eṣa vastu antara abhāva saṃvitti anugamāt ṛte iti tasmāt gaura mūlaka avagama samayaḥ eva tatra asat nihitasya garga ādeḥ abhāva grahaṇāt na idānīm parokṣa abhāva grahaṇam abhāva kāraṇakam abhyupagantavyam iti pratyakṣa gamyaḥ eva ayam abhāvaḥ

yat punar ananumeya tvam iha ghaṭaḥ na asti iti prakṛta abhāva viṣayam abhyadhāyi tat asmākam abhimatam eva kaścid punar asannikṛṣṭa deśa vṛttiḥ anumeyaḥ api bhavati abhāvaḥ yathā santamase salila dhārā visara sikta sasya mūlam abhivarṣati deve ghana pavana saṃyoga abhāvaḥ anumīyate yathā vā arthāpattau udāhṛtam gṛha abhāvena caitrasya bāheḥ abhāva kalpanam iti āgamāt api abhāvasya kvacid bhavati niścayaḥ cora ādinā astita ajñānam adhvagānām iva āptataḥ

yat punar anurūpeṇa pramāṇena prameyam pramīyate prameya tvāt bhāva ātmaka prameya vat iti etat api aprayojakam sādhanam abhāvaḥ paṭala ādīnām pratyakṣasya prapadyate vipakṣa vṛtti abhāvaḥ ca liṅgasya sahakāritām puruṣoktiṣu doṣāṇām abhāvaḥ ca upayujyate sāmagrī antargatāt tasmāt abhāvāt api bhāva dhīḥ abhāvaḥ ca kvacid liṅgam iṣyate bhāva saṃvidaḥ vṛṣṭyabhāvaḥ api vāyu abhra saṃyogasya anumāpakaḥ tasmāt yuktam abhāvasya na abhāvena eva vedanam na nāma yādṛśaḥ yakṣaḥ valiḥ api asya tādṛśaḥ

atra rakta paṭāḥ prāhuḥ prameye sati cintanam yuktam nāma pramāṇasya tat eva tu ati durlabham abhāvaḥ nāma pratīyamānaḥ na tu atantra tayā ghaṭa ādi bhāva svarūpa vat anubhūyate api tu deśa kāla pratiyogi viśiṣṭa tvena tathā hi evam pratītiḥ idam idānīm iha na asti iti sa ca ittham avagamyamānaḥ api yadi taiḥ sambaddhaḥ eva bhavet abhāvaḥ kaḥ enam dviṣyāt na tu asau tad saṃbaddhaḥ na hi deśena kālena pratiyoginā saha asya kaścid sambandhaḥ saṃyoga samavāya ādeḥ anupapatteḥ na ca sambandha rahitam eva viśeṣaṇam bhavati

nanu viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāvaḥ eva sambandhaḥ kim sambandha antara apekṣayā mā evam sambandha antara mūlaka tvena tad avagamāt saṃyuktam samaveta vā viśaṣaṇa bhavati daṇḍī devadattaḥ nīlam utpalam iti atas ca na vāstavaḥ svatantraḥ eva viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāvaḥ sambandhaḥ puruṣa icchayā viparyasyantam api enam paśyāmaḥ viśeṣaṇam api viśeṣyībhavati viśeṣyam api viśeṣaṇībhavati iti kālpanikaḥ eva ayam sambandhaḥ na vastu dharmaḥ
