pratiyoginā saha nata rāma bhāvasya sambandhaḥ asamāna kāla tvāt yadā hi ghaṭaḥ na tadā tad abhāvaḥ yadā vā tad abhāvaḥ na tadā ghaṭaḥ iti virodha ākhyaḥ sambandhaḥ bhaviṣyati iti ced kaḥ virodha arthaḥ yadi hi prāk siddhaḥ ghaṭa abhāvaḥ āgatya ghaṭam virundhyāt bhavet api tad virodhī ghaṭa mudgarayoḥ iva na tu evam asti tayoḥ asamāna kāla tvāt abhyupagame vā ghaṭa tada bhāvayoḥ ghaṭa mudgarayoḥ iva vadhya ghātukayoḥ sāhacaryam anubhūyeta ghaṭa abhāvaḥ kim kurvan ghaṭam virundhyāt akiñcitkarasya virodhi tve ati prasaktiḥ abhāva antara karaṇe tu anavasthā mudgara ādayaḥ ghaṭa abhāvasya hetavaḥ na bhavitum arhanti bhāvasya svatas eva bhaṅgura tvena vināśa hetu anapekṣa tvāt

bhāvaḥ vinaśvara ātmā ced kṛtam pralaya hetubhiḥ atha api anaśvara ātmā ced kṛtam pralaya hetubhiḥ tasmāt vijātīya kapāla ādi santati jananaḥ eva mudgara ādi kāraka vyāpāraḥ sāmagryantara anupraveśe sati santati antara utpādaḥ na punar abhāvasya tatas niṣpattiḥ sa hi ghaṭāt vastu antaram ced kim āyātam yat asau na pūrvavat upalabhyate tad virodhi tvāt iti ced pratyuktam etat anartha antara tve tu ghaṭasya eva mudgara kārya tvam syāt

nanu yāni mudgareṇa kapālāni janyante saḥ eva ghaṭa abhāvaḥ hanta tarhi kapāla āsphoṭane sati ghaṭa abhāvasya vinaṣṭa tvāt ghaṭasya unmajjanam prāpnoti kiñca akiñcitkarāṇi kapālāni ghaṭasya abhāvaḥ iti yadi ucyate paṭasya api tathā ucyeran kiñcid kāraka tvam teṣām pūrvavat pratikṣeptavyam
api ca ayam abhāvaḥ bhavana dharmā vā syāt abhavana dharmā vā bhavana dharma tve bhāvaḥ asau bhavet ghaṭa ādi vat abhavana dharmā tu yadi abhāvaḥ asti sa nityaḥ eva asau tarhi bhavet

sa ca ayam eka padārtha sambandhī vā syāt sarva padārtha sambandhī vā tatra eka bhāva sambandhi tve na tasya niyama kāraṇam utpaśyāmaḥ sarva bhāva sambandhi tve tu sarva padārtha pratikṛlasya abhāvasya nitya tvāt nitya sannihita tvāt sakṛt eva trailokya lopa prasaṅgaḥ tasmāt na nityaḥ anityaḥ vā kaścid abhāvaḥ nāma asti

nanu abhāva anabhyupagame bhāvānām itaretara saṅkarāt akhila vyavahāra viplavaḥ prāpnoti yat āha kṣīre dadhi bhavet evam dadhni kṣīram ghaṭe paṭaḥ śaśe śṛṅgam pṛthivī ādau caitanyam mūrtiḥ ātmani iti abhāva abhyupagame tu bhāvānām iṃtaretara abhāvāt asaṅkīrṇa tā setsyati tat etat asādhu svatas eva bhāvānām asaṅkīrṇa svabhāva tvāt

abhāva kāraṇaka saṅkara parihāra kathane tu sutarām viplavaḥ bhāvaḥ bhāvāt iva anyasmāt abhāva aṃśāt api dhruvam asaṅkīrṇaḥ abhyupetavyaḥ sa katham vā bhaviṣyati anyonyam api abhāvānām yadi asaṅkīrṇa tā svatas bhāvaiḥ kim aparāddham vaḥ paratas ced kutas nu sā bhāvebhyaḥ yadi upeyeta bhavet anyonya saṃśrayam abhāva antara janyā ced anavasthā duruttarā

abhāva svabhāva tāyāḥ ca sarvān pratyaviśeṣāt pratiṣedhya nibandhanaḥ eva tad bhedaḥ pratiṣedhyāḥ ca bhāvāḥ paraspareṇa bhidyamānāḥ tam bhindanti iti pratyuta bhāva adhīnam abhāvānām asāṅkaryam vaktum ucitam na tu viparyayaḥ yuktaḥ tat akhila padārtha vyavasya avisaṃṣṭhulī bhāva bhayāt api na abhāva abhyupagamaḥ yuktaḥ

nanu abhāva pratikṣepe nañaḥ kim vācyam ucyatām na eva śabda anusāreṇa vācya sthitiḥ upeyate bauddhāḥ khalu vayam loke sarvatra khyāta kīrtayaḥ vikalpa mātra śabda artha parikalpana paṇḍitāḥ kvacid nāma pada prāpta vṛttinā janyate nañā niṣedha paryudasta ani aviṣaya ullekhinī matiḥ kvacid tva ākhyāta sambandham upetya vidadhāti asau tad upātta kriyā aaraṃbha nivṛtti ullekha mātrakam

nanu ca anena mārgeṇa yadi abhāvaḥ nirasyate ekādaśa prakāra eṣā anupalabdhiḥ kva gacchatu svabhāva anupalabdhiḥ yathā na iha ghaṭaḥ anupalabdheḥ iti kāraṇa anupalabdhiḥ yathā na atra dhūmaḥ dahana anupalabdheḥ iti vyāpaka an upalabdhiḥ yathā na atra śiṃśapā vṛkṣa anupalabdheḥ iti

kārya anupalabdhiḥ yathā na atra nirapavādāḥ dhūma hetavaḥ santi dhūma anupalabdheḥ iti svabhāva viruddha upalabdhiḥ yathā na atra śīta sparśaḥ pāvaka upalabdheḥ iti svabhāva viruddha kārya upalabdhiḥ yathā na atra śīta sparśaḥ dhūma upalabdheḥ iti viruddha vyāpta upalabdhiḥ yathā na dhruva bhāvī bhūtasya api bhāvasya vināśaḥ hetu antara apekṣaṇāt iti

kārya viruddha upalabdhiḥ yathā na atra śīta kāraṇam apratibaddha sāmarthyam asti jvalana upalabdheḥ iti vyāpaka viruddha upalabdhiḥ yathā na atra tuhina sparśaḥ kṛśa anu darśanāt iti kāraṇa viruddha upalabdhiḥ yathā naitasya roma harṣa danta vīṇā ādi viśeṣāḥ santi sannihita hutavaha viśeṣāt iti kāraṇa viruddha kārya upalabdhiḥ yathā pravṛtta danta vīṇā ādi viśeṣa puruṣa adhiṣṭhitaḥ eṣa deśaḥ na bhavati dhūmavat tvāt iti satyam ekādaśavidhā anupalabdhiḥ iha iṣyate sā tu asat vyavahārasya hetuḥ na abhāva saṃvidaḥ

nanu anupalabdheḥ svabhāva hetau antarbhāvaḥ uktaḥ svabhāva hetau ca sādhya sādhanayoḥ avyatirekaḥ iṣyate asat vyavahāraḥ ca jñāna abhidhāna ātmaka tvāt tatas eva pṛtham iti katham tat viṣaya tām yāyāt satyam evam kintu na asat vyavahāraḥ tayā sādhyate api tu tad yogya tā yogya tā ca na tatas artha antaram iti na svabhāva hetu tva hāniḥ

nanu yogyatā bhāva ātmikā anupalabdhiḥ tu abhāva svabhāva iti katham anartha antara tvam na etat evam na hi upalabdhi pratiṣedha ātmikām abhāva svabhāvām anupalabdhim anupalabdhi vidaḥ vadanti kintu pratiṣedha paryudaḥ ta vaḥ tu antara upalabdhim eva artha abhāva svabhāvām iti atas eva idam api na codyam anupalabdheḥ abhāva ātmaka tvāt anupalabdhi antara paricchedya tvāt anavasthā iti yasmāt vastu antara upalaṃbha ātmikā anupalabdhiḥ sva saṃvedyā eva iti

nanu anupalabdheḥ asat vyavahāra siddhau adṛśyasya api tathātvam siddhyet na dṛśya tva viśeṣaṇa upādānāt upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptasya anupalabdheḥ asat vyavahāraḥ na yasya kasya cit iti tatra ghaṭa ādeḥ pūrva dṛṣṭasya dṛśya tva pariniścayāt asattva vyavahāraḥ hi siddhi ati anupalabdhitaḥ ekānta anupalabdheṣu vihāyaḥ kusuma ādiṣu dṛśya tva yogya tā yogāt asattva pariniścayaḥ piśāca ādeḥ tu dṛśya tva niścayaḥ anavadhāraṇāt na śakyaḥ anupalambhena kartum na astitva niścayaḥ tatra api tu api śācaḥ ayam caitraḥ iti evamādiṣu tādātmya pratiṣedheṣu dṛśya tvam na upayujyate piśāca itara rūpaḥ hi caitraḥ pratyakṣa gācaraḥ tādrūpya niścaye tasya kim phalam tad viśeṣaṇam iti asat vyavahārasya siddheḥ anupalabdhitaḥ na bhāva vat abhāva ākhyam prameyam avakalpate

atra abhidhīyate idam tāvat sakala prāṇi sākṣikam saṃvedana dvayam upajāyamānam dṛṣṭam iha ghaṭaḥ asti iha na asti iti tatra vikalpa mātra saṃvedanam anālambanam ātma aṃśa ābalambanam vā ityādi yat abhilapyate tat na astita jñānaḥ iva astita ajñāne api samānam atas dvayoḥ api prāmāṇyam bhavatu dvayoḥ api vā mā bhūt yat tu asti iti jñānam pramāṇam itarattva pramāṇam iti kathyate tad icchā mātram asti iti jñāna samāna yogakṣema tve ca na asti iti jñānasya viṣayaḥ cintanīyaḥ

nanu ghaṭa vivikta bhū tala upalambha bhāve ghaṭa anupalambhaḥ iti uktam tat ayuktam kā iyam ghaṭa vivikta tā sā bhū pradeśāt abhinnā bhinnā vā abhede bhū pradeśa aviśeṣāt ghaṭa sannidhāne api ghaṭaḥ na asti iti pratipattiḥ jāyeta bhede api nāmni vivādaḥ syāt bheda abhedena cintyā ca ghaṭāt api viviktatā abhede ghaṭaḥ eva syāt bhede ca abhāvaḥ eva sā

tat iha ghaṭaḥ na asti iti ghaṭa vivikta bhū tala ālamba natāyām asyāḥ saṃvidaḥ iha iti tāvat asmin saṃvid aṃśe deśaḥ ālambanam iti avivādaḥ eva iha ghaṭaḥ asti iti bhāva pratīti samaye api tatra tad avabhāsa abhyupagamāt ghaṭaḥ na asti iti atra tu yat avabhāsate tat na bhū tala mātram eva bhāva pratīti samaya vat tad atirikta pratibhāsasya avaśya bhāvi tvāt tat atiriktam tu pratibhāsamānam ghaṭa vivikta tā iti vā kathyatām ghaṭa abhāvaḥ iti vā na atra vastuni viśeṣaḥ
nanu ghaṭaḥ na asti iti vikalpa mātram etat na darśana anantara pravṛtta tvena vidhi vikalpa tulya tvāt yathā anubhavam utpattum arhanti kila kalpanāḥ pratiṣedha vikalpaḥ tu na vidhi anubhava ucitaḥ

nanu na eva vikalpānām vayam prāmāṇya vādinaḥ kāmam vidhi vikalpānām api mā bhūt pramāṇa tā prāmāṇyam darśanānām ced tu adhi kalpa anusārataḥ iha api teṣām eva asti tu avikalpa anusārataḥ vastu prāptyā vidhi vikalpānām pramāṇa vyavahāraḥ iti ced iha api tad prāptyā eva niṣedha vikalpānām astu prāmāṇya vyavahāraḥ kim atra vastu prāpyata iti ced tatra api kim prāpyate nīlam iti ced sā iyam abhāvasya api prāptiḥ bhavati eva nīlam hi prāpyamāṇam tad abhāva avinābhūta pīta ādi vyavacchinna rūpam prāpyate sā ca iyam tathābhūta nīla prāptiḥ bhavantī itara abhāva prāptiḥ api bhavati anyathā hi nīlayāptiḥ eva na syāt iti etat ca lākṣaṇikam virodham ācakṣa arṇarbhavadbhiḥ eva upagatam

sukha duḥkha samutpattiḥ abhāve śatru mitrayoḥ kaṇṭaka abhāvam ālakṣya padam pathi nidhīyate prāk utpatteḥ ghaṭa abhāvam buddhvā tad kāraṇa ādaraḥ vyādhi abhāva paricchedāt bhaiṣajya vinivartanam iha abhāva pratiṣṭhāna vyavahāra paramparām paśyan abhāvam kaḥ nāma vihnuvīta sa cetanaḥ

nanu na ajanakam ālambanam bhavati jñānasya abhāvaḥ tu sakala upākhya vinirmukta svarūpaḥ iti na jñāna janana paṭuḥ atas katham tad ālambanam ucyate saugatānām tāvat na kiñcid janakam vastu pratibhāsate dvi tri kṣaṇa avasthiti prasaṅgena kṣaṇa bhaṅga vrata vilopa prasaṅgāt utpadyate ca artha jñānam ca janayati jātena tena gṛhyate ca iti āsām kriyāṇām eka kāla tva abhāvāt tasmāt akārakaḥ eva bhāvaḥ pratibhāsate

ākāra arpaṇa pakṣam ca pratikṣepsyāmaḥ evam bhāva vat abhāvaḥ api ajanakaḥ pratibhāsatām asmābhiḥ tu bhāva vat abhāvaḥ api jñāna janana samarthaḥ ipyate na hi niśśeṣa sāmarthya rahita tvam abhāva lakṣaṇam api tu na asti iti jñāna gamya tvam sat pratyaya gamyaḥ hi bhāvaḥ ipyate asat pratyaya gamyaḥ tu abhāvaḥ iti tat idam uktam sadasatī tattvam iti

nanu bhāva vat eṣa jñāna janakassan abhāvaḥ na bhāvāt viśiṣyate aho nipuṇa darśī devānāṃpriyaḥ pratīti bhedaḥ ca asti na ca pratīyamānau bhāva abhāvau bhidyete iti katham evam bhavet api re mūḍha jñāna janaka tva aviśeṣe api rūpa rasau katham bhidyete pratīti bhedāt iti ced bhāva abhāvau api janakatva dharma sāmānye api pratīti bhedāt eva bhidyeyātām na hi pratibhā āsi a bhedam antareṇa pratibhāsa bhedaḥ bhavati iti bhavatā api abhyupagatam yathā uktam prāmāṇyam vastu viṣayam dvayoḥ artha bhidām jagau pratibhāsasya citra tvāt ekasmin tad ayogataḥ iti

tasmāt asti iti pratīteḥ iva bhāvaḥ na asti iti pratīteḥ abhāvaḥ bhūmiḥ iti abhyupagamyatām athavā vijñāna vādaḥ eva sumpaṣṭam āsthīyatām antara avasthānam tu na sāṃpratam artha kriyā sāmarthyam api tasya darśitam eva sva jñāna ākhya kriyāśaktiḥ amuṣya durapahnavā artha kriyā anya janyā tu na bhāvena api janyate evam ca sati yaḥ pūrvam śaktivādaḥ atra varṇitaḥ sa pratyakṣa viruddha tvāt kaṇṭha śoṣāya kevalam

tathā sambandha abhāvāt iti yat uktam tatra deśena saha tāvat abhāvasya viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāvaḥ sambandhaḥ sa tu sambandha antara mūlaḥ iti bhāve ayam niyamaḥ na abhāve yat vā bhāve api eṣa na niyamaḥ na hi evam bhavati yat sambaddham tat viśeṣaṇam eva pāda pīḍite śirasi vā dhāryamāṇe daṇḍe daṇḍī iti pratyaya anutpādāt na api evam yat viśeṣaṇam tat sambanddham eva iti samavāyasya sati api viśeṣaṇa tve sambandha antara abhāvāt tasmāt sambandha antara rahitaḥ api pratibandhaḥ iva vācya vācaka bhāvaḥ iva viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāvaḥ svatantraḥ eva sambandhaḥ tathā apratīteḥ avadhāryate

ubhayoḥ ubhaya ātmaka tvāt kadācid kasyacid tathā pratibhāsāt puruṣa icchā anuvartanena vyatyaya pratyaya sattve api na doṣaḥ tasmāt viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāvaḥ eva sambandhaḥ deśena bhū tala ādinā saha abhāvasya evam kālena api saha saḥ eva veditavyaḥ kriyayā kartṛsthayā vā gamana ādikayā karma sthayā vā bhedana ādikayā saha saṃyoga ādi abhāve api viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāvaḥ eva sambandhaḥ tadvat abhāvasya api bhaviṣyati iti pratiyoginā tu saha virodhaḥ asya sambandhaḥ ayam eva ca virodha arthaḥ yat ekatra ubhayoḥ asamāveśaḥ atas ca eka vināśe na sarva vināśaḥ ghaṭa abhāvasya ghaṭa eka pratiyogika tvāt

yat tu bhavana dharmā abhavana dharmā vā iti vikalpitam tatra bhavana dharmā eva abhāvaḥ abhyupagamyate bhavana dharma tve api ca abhāvaḥ na bhāvāt na bhidyate pratibhāsa bhedasya rūpa rasa ādiṣu upadarśita tvāt bhavana dharma tvam ca asya hetu anvaya vyatireki tvāt bhavati ghaṭaḥ hi mṛd piṇḍa daṇḍa ādīn iva janmani vināśe api mudgara ādīn anuvartate hetūn

vijātīya santati janana pakṣe api sadṛśa santāna janikāyāḥ śakteḥ abhāvaḥ kriyate eva anyathā mudgara ādi upanipāte api vijātīya iva sajātīya santatiḥ api jāyeta sajātīya vijātīya ubhaya santati janana śakti yuktaḥ ghaṭaḥ iti ced mudgara ādi yogāt pūrvam api kapāla santati jananam tad yoge api vā sati ghaṭa santati jana nam aniyamena dṛśyeta iti vijātī ya kṣaṇa utpādana svabhāve ca ghaṭe mudgara ādi vaiyyarthyam eva syāt

tad utpāda svabhāve hi na kiñcid mudgara ādinā atad utpādaka tve api na kiñcid mudgara ādinā mudgara upanipātāt ca yadi utpannam kṣaṇa antaram ghaṭa kṣaṇasya kim vṛttam yena na ābhāti pūrvavat nanu asya abhavanam vṛttam saḥ eva arthaḥ ayam ucyate ghañā kim aparādhe vaḥ kim vā api upakṛtam lyuṭā

nanu uktam na tasya kiñcid bhavati na bhavati eva kevalam iti tat ayuktam yat asau na bhavati saḥ eva asya abhāvaḥ nanu sa na na tu tasya abhāvaḥ mā evam sa na iti śabdayoḥ jñānayoḥ ca viṣaya bhedāt saḥ iti jñānasya smaryamāṇaḥ ghaṭa ādiḥ viṣayaḥ na iti tu jñānasya abhāvaḥ bhūmiḥ iti alam alīka vidagdha viracita viphala vakra vacana vimardena

tasmāt ittham abhāvasya prameya tva upapādanāt na hi asat vyavahārāya kalpante anupalabdhayaḥ na svabhāva anumāne ca tad antarbhāva sambhavaḥ meyam pṛthak abhāva ākhyam amūṣām upapāditam kāraṇa anupalabdhi ādeḥ bāḍham astu anumāna tā svabhāva anupalabdhiḥ tu pratyakṣam iti sādhitam yā ca iyam ekādaśa anupalabdhi vadhū śuddhānta madhye viruddha vyāpta upalabdhiḥ udāhṛtā na dhruva bhāvī bhūtasya api bhāvasya vināśaḥ hetu antara apekṣaṇāt iti sā iyam idānīm eva sādhvī dūṣitā vistaraḥ tu kṣaṇa bhaṅga pakṣe dūṣayiṣyate

yaiḥ tu mīmāṃsakaiḥ sadbhiḥ abhāvaḥ na abhyupeyate pramādena amunā teṣām vayam api adya lajjitāḥ ghaṭaḥ hi na pratīyate na tu tad abhāvaḥ pratīyate iti evaṃvadadbhiḥ ebhiḥ darśana adarśane eva padārthānām sat asat tve iti kathitam syāt etat ca ayuktam darśana adarśanābhyām hi sat asat tve niścīyete na tu darśana adarśane eva sat asat tve

na ca apratīti mātreṇa tad abhāva nibandhanāḥ vyavahārāḥ prakalpante mṛd antarita toya vat khapuṣpasya piśācasya mṛd antarita vāriṇaḥ na khalu anupalabhya tve viśeṣaḥ pratibhāti naḥ sarvadā anupalambhaḥ hi kurvat nāstitva niścayam viśiṣyate mṛdanta sstha salila anupalabdhitaḥ āgamāt yuktitaḥ ca api sattva saṃbhāvanām gataḥ sarvadā anupalabdhaḥ api na piśācaḥ kha puṣpa vat
atas ca yat ucyate anupalabdheḥ punar anupalabdhiḥ eva anupalabdhiḥ iti tad bhaṇiti mātram kha puṣpa ādeḥ tu sa viśeṣaṇa tayā anupalabdhyā abhāvaḥ eva niścīyate na tasya anupalabdhi mātram

aniṣyamāṇe ca abhāve bhāvānām pratiyogini nitya tā eṣām prasajyeta na hi ete kṣaṇikāḥ tava mudgara ādeḥ ca kim kāryam kapālapaṭalī iti ced ghaṭaḥ tarhi avinaṣṭa tvāt sva kāryam na karoti kim adarśanāt iti ced tadānīm eva dṛṣṭasya sthirasya amuṣya kim kṛtam sarva indriya ādi sāmagrī sannidhāne api adarśanam tasmāt tad abhāva kṛtam eva tadānīm tasya adarśanam

sva prakāśā ca na asti iti saṃvittiḥ bhavatām mate na nirālambanā ca iyam asti iti pratipatti vat vikalpa viṣayāḥ śabdāḥ yathā śauddhodaneḥ gṛhe gīyante bhavatā na evam iti nañvācyam ucyatām prasiddhiḥ ca parityaktā na ca abhāvaḥ parākṛtaḥ upekṣitaḥ ca bhāṣya arthaḥ iti ahar naya naipuṇam alam ca bahunā uktena vimardaḥ atra na śobhate mahātmanām pramādaḥ api marṣaṇīyaḥ hi mādṛśaiḥ tasmāt na asti iti pratyaya gamyaḥ abhāvaḥ iti siddham
sa ca dvividhaḥ prāc abhāvaḥ pradhvaṃsa abhāvaḥ ca iti caturvidhaḥ iti anye itaretarābhāvaḥ atyanta abhāvaḥ tau ca dvau iti ṣaṣ prakāraḥ iti anye apekṣā bhāvaḥ sāmarthya abhāvaḥ te ca catvāraḥ iti

tatra ca prāc ātma lābhāt nāstitvam prāgabhāvaḥ abhidhīyate utpannasya ātma hānam tu pradhvaṃsaḥ iti kathyate na prāc abhāvāt anye tu bhidyante paramārthataḥ sa hi vastu antara upādhiḥ anyaḥ anya abhāvaḥ ucyate saḥ eva avadhi śūnya tvāt atyanta abhāva tām gataḥ apekṣā bhāva tā tasya deśa upādhi nibandhanā sāmarthyam pūrva siddham ced pradhvaṃse tad abhāva dhīḥ no ced tarhi viśeṣaḥ asya durlabhaḥ prāc abhāvataḥ utpannasya vināśaḥ vā tad anutpādaḥ eva vā abhāvaḥ tattvataḥ anye tu bhedāḥ tu aupādhikāḥ matāḥ tasmāt abhāva ākhyam idam prameyam tasya indriyeṇa grahaṇam ca siddham atas pramāṇeṣu jagāda yuktam catuṣṭam eṣām muniḥ akṣapādaḥ

nanu na adya api catuṣṭvam eṣām avatiṣṭhate saṃbhava aitihye iti dvayoḥ pramāṇa antara bhāvāt saṃbhavaḥ nāma samudāyena samudāyinaḥ avagamaḥ saṃbhavati khāryām droṇaḥ saṃbhavati śate sahasram iti anirdiṣṭa pravaktṛka pravāda paraṃparā ca aitihyam iha vaṭe yakṣaḥ prativasati iti na ca ayam āgamaḥ āptasya upadeṣṭuraniścayāt iti

tat idam anupapannam bhinnaḥ saṃbhavaḥ eṣa na hi anubhiteḥ ākhyāyi khāryām khalu droṇaḥ saṃbhavati iti sā iyam avinā abhāvāt matiḥ laiṅgikī aitihyam tu na satyam atra hi vaṭe yakṣaḥ asti vā na iti vā kaḥ jānāti kadā kva kena kalitam yakṣasya kīdṛś vapuḥ satyam api ca āgamāt pṛthak naitihyam upadeśa rūpa tvāt āpta grahaṇam sūtre na lakṣaṇāya iti vakṣyāmaḥ

cārvāka dhūrtaḥ tu atha atas tattvam vyākhyāsyāmaḥ iti pratijñāya pramāṇa prameya saṅkhyā lakṣaṇa niyama aśakya karaṇīya tvam eva tattvam vyākhyātavān pramāṇa saṅkhyā niyama aśakya karaṇīya tva siddhaye ca pramiti bhedān pratyakṣa ādi pramāṇa anupajanyānīdṛśān upādarśayat vakrāṅgaliḥ pravirala aṅguliḥ eṣa pāṇiḥ isi asti dhīḥ tamasi mīlita cakṣuṣaḥ vā na iyam tvac indriya kṛtā na hi tad kara stham tatra eva hi pramitim indriyam ādadhāti dūrāt karoti niśi dīpa śikhā ca dṛṣṭā paryanta deśa visṛtāsu matim prabhāsu dhatte dhiyam pavana kampita puṇḍarīka ṣaṇḍe anuvāta bhuvi dūra gate api gandhe saḥ evaṃprāya saṃvitti samutprekṣaṇa paṇḍitaḥ rūpam tapasvī jānāti na pratyakṣa anumānayoḥ

pratyakṣāt virala kara aṅgula pratītiḥ vyāpi tvāt akuśalam indriyam na tasyām ānābheḥ tuhina jalam janaiḥ pibadbhiḥ tad sparśaḥ śiśirataraḥ anubhūyate antar saṃyoga buddhiḥ ca yathā tad utthā tathā eva tad jā tad abhāva buddhiḥ kriyā viśeṣa grahaṇāt ca tasmāt ākuñcita tva avagamaḥ aṅgulīnām padma āmoda vidūra dīpaka vibhā buddhiḥ punar laiṅgikī vyāpti jñāna kṛtā iti kā khalu matiḥ māna antara apekṣiṇī saṅkhyāyāḥ niyamaḥ pramāṇa viṣaye na asti iti atas nāstikaiḥ tad sāmarthya viveka śūnya matibhiḥ mithyā eva visphūrjitam iyat tvam avilakṣaṇam niyatam asti māneṣu naḥ prameyam api lakṣaṇa ādi niyama anvitam vakṣyate aśakya karaṇīyatām kathayatā tu tattvam satām samakṣama munā aatmanaḥ jaḍam ati tvam uktam bhavet

evam pramāṇānām sāmānya lakṣaṇe vibhāge ca nirṇīte sati adhunā viśeṣa lakṣaṇa varṇa bhāva saraḥ iti sakala pramāṇa mūla bhūta tvena pūrva paṭhita tvena jyaiṣṭhyāt prathamam pratyakṣasya lakṣaṇam pratipādayitum āha indriya artha sannikarṣa utpannam jñānam avyapadeśyam avyabhicāri vyavasāya ātmakam pratyakṣam pratyakṣam iti lakṣya nirdeśaḥ itarat lakṣaṇam samāna asamāna jātīya vyavacchedaḥ lakṣaṇa arthaḥ samāna jātīyam pramāṇa tayā anumāna ādi vijātīyam prameya ādi tatas vyavacchinnam pratyakṣasya lakṣaṇam anena sūtreṇa upapādyate

atra codayanti indriya artha sannikarṣa utpanna tva ādi viśeṣaṇaiḥ svarūpam vā viśeṣyate sāmagrī vā phalam vā tatra sva rūpa viśeṣaṇa pakṣe yat evaṃsvarūpam jñānam tat pratyakṣam iti tad svarūpasya viśeṣita tvāt phala viśeṣaṇa anupādānāt ca lakṣaṇam avyāpti ati vyāptibhyām upahṛtam syāt avyāptiḥ tāvat atathāvidha svarūpasya bodhasya indriya ādeḥ ca nirmala phala janakatayā labdha pramāṇa bhāvasya api prāmāṇyam na uktam bhavet ativyāptiḥ ca tathāvidha svarūpasya api jñānasya ākārakasya vā saṃskāra kāriṇaḥ vā smṛtim janayataḥ vā saṃśayam ādadhānasya vā viparyayam utpādayataḥ vā pramāṇa tvam prāpnoti phalasya aviśeṣita tvāt

tad viśeṣaṇa abhidhāne punar aśruta sūtra antara adhyāhāra prasaktiḥ avyāptiḥ ca tad avasthā iti na sva rūpa viśeṣaṇa pakṣaḥ na api sāmagrī viśeṣaṇa pakṣaḥ tatra hi indriya artha sannikarṣa utpannam iti indriya artha sannikarṣa utpannam sāmagryam iti vyākhyātavyam jñānam avyapadeśyam avyabhicāri vyavasāya ātmakam iti ca tad janaka tvāt upacāreṇa tathā sākalyam varṇanīyam iti kliṣṭa kalpanā

phala viśeṣaṇa pakṣaḥ api na saṅgacchate jñāna pratyakṣa śabdayoḥ phala karaṇa vācinoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇya prasaṅgāt asamāna adhikaraṇa pramāṇa lakṣaṇa prastāvāt pratyakṣam pramāṇam ucyate tat ca karaṇam iti varṇitam jñānam tu tad upajanitam phalam iti katham aika ādhikaraṇyam tasmāt pakṣa trayasya api ayukta tvāt pakṣa antarasya api asaṃbhavāt ayuktam sūtram iti

atra ucyate sva rūpa sāmagrī viśeṣaṇa pakṣau tāvat yathā ukta doṣa upahata tvāt na abhyupagamyete phala viśeṣaṇa pakṣam eva saṃmanyāmahe tatra ca yat vaiyyadhikaraṇyam coditam tat yatas śabda adhyāhāreṇa parihariṣyāmaḥ yatas evaṃvidha viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭam jñāna ākhyam phalam bhavati tat pratyakṣam iti sūtra arthaḥ ittham ca na kvacid avyāptiḥ ati vyāptiḥ vā na kācid kliṣṭa kalpanā yatas śabda adhyāhāra mātreṇa niravadya lakṣaṇa upavarṇana samartha sūtra pada saṅgati saṃbhavāt

nanu samāna adhikaraṇe eva jñāna pratyakṣa pade katham na vyākhyāyete kim yatas śabda adhyāhāreṇa uktam atra karaṇasya pramāṇa tvāt jñānasya ca tad phala tvāt phala karaṇayoḥ ca svarūpa bhedasya siddha tvāt tat atra pramāṇa tāyām sāmagryāḥ tat jñānam phalam iṣyate tasya pramāṇa bhāve tu phalam hāna ādi buddhayaḥ

nanu smṛti ādi aneka buddhi vyavadhāna saṃbhavāt katham indriya artha sannikarṣa utpannam ālocanā jñānam hāna ādi phalam bhavet tathā hi kapittha ādi jātīyam artham indriya ādi sannikarṣa ādi sāmagrītaḥ upalabhya tad gatam sukha sādhana tvam anusmarati evaṃjātīyakena mama pūrvam sukham upajanitam abhūt iti tatas smṛti anantaram parāmarśa jñānam asya upajāyate ayam sa kapittha jātīyaḥ iti tatas upādeya tā jñānam utpadyate yatas eṣa sukha sādhanam kapittha ādi jātīyaḥ padārthaḥ tasmāt upādeyaḥ iti atra antare prathamasya indriya sannikarṣa janmanaḥ kapittha ālocanā jñānasya nāma api na avaśiṣyate iti katham asya tad phala tvam iti

atra ācāryāḥ tāvat ācakṣate sādhu coditam satyam īdṛśaḥ eva ayam jñānānām kramaḥ na vayam prathamam ālocana ajñānasya upādāna ādiṣu pramāṇa tām brūmaḥ tathā hi prathamam indriya artha sannikarṣa utpannam ālocanā jñānam indriya artha sannikarṣa ādi sāmagrī svabhāvasya pratyakṣasya pramāṇasya phalam eva na tu svayam pramāṇa tām pratilabhate smṛti janaka tvāt tad anantaram hi sukha sādhanatva anusmṛtiḥ bhavati iti sā iyam anusmṛtiḥ apramāṇa phalam api satī pratyakṣam pramāṇam saṃpadyate tathā ayam kapittha ādi jātīyaḥ iti indriya viṣaya parāmarśa utpattau indriya artha sannikarṣeṇa saha vyāpriyamāṇa tvāt

sa punar parāmarśa pratyayaḥ pratyakṣa janitaḥ dhūma jñāna vat anumānam pramāṇam ucyate parokṣasya agneḥ iva sukha sādhana sāmarthyasya tatas avagateḥ yadi api na kācid atīndriyā śaktiḥ asmat mate vidyate tathā api svarūpa saha kārya ādi dṛṣṭa adṛṣṭa kāraṇa samūha sannidhāna svabhāvam api sāmarthyam atīndriyam eva

tasmāt eṣa kapittha ādi jātīyaḥ arthaḥ sukha sādhanam iti vahnimat parvata pratīti vat tad jātīya liṅgakam ānumānikam idam jñānam tat idam anumāna phalam api sukha sādhana tva niścaya ātmakam jñānam indriya viṣaye kapittha ādau upādeya jñānam indriya artha sannikarṣeṇa saha janayat pratyakṣam pramāṇam bhavati tat eva ca hṛdi vyavasthāpya bhāṣya kṛt vabhāṣe yadā jñānam vṛttiḥ tadā hāna upādāna upekṣā buddhayaḥ pramitiḥ iti

vyākhyātāraḥ tu bruvate na ayam īdṛśaḥ jñānānām kramaḥ ādyam ālocanā jñānam sukha sādhanatva anusmṛtim upajanayati iti satyam smṛtyā ca tasya vinaśyattā vinaśyat avastham ca indriya viṣaye kapittha ādau sukha sādhana tva niścayam ādadhāti sukha sādhana tva jñānam eva ca upādeya tā jñānam ucyate na anyat parāmarśaḥ tu na kaścid antarāle saṃvedyate tat eva sādhyam darśitam indriya artha sannikarṣa janitam upādeya tā jñāna phalakam avakalpate iti kim asaṃvedyamāna jñāna kanthā kalpanena iti

nanu parāmarśaḥ anubhūyate eva na tu kalpyate dhūma jñāna anantaram avinā bhāvam yatra dhūmaḥ tatra agniḥ iti anusmṛtya parābhṛśati tathā ca ayam dhūmaḥ iti asati tu parāmarśe na liṅga jñānam liṅgini pramāṇa tām pratipadyeta smaraṇa janakam hi tat na ca smṛti janakam pramāṇam iṣyate smaraṇa anantaram ca liṅga pratītiḥ bhavantī na upalabhya anuvādena bhavet ayam agnimān iti api ca tathā ca kṛtakaḥ śabdaḥ iti yat upanaya vacanam avayaveṣu paṭhyate tasya kim vācyam bhaviṣyati parāmarśā palāpa vādinām sva pratipatti vat ca para pratipattiḥ avayavaiḥ janyate iti vakṣyāmaḥ tasmāt apratyākhyeyaḥ parāmarśaḥ iti

atra vadanti na tāvat antarā kaścid parāmarśaḥ anubhūyate anumeya miteḥ pūrvam ūrdhvam ca niyama smṛteḥ atas eva artham ālokya vinā eva hi davīyasā vilambena vyavasyanti grahaṇa ādiṣu laukikāḥ liṅga jñānam ca vinaśyat avastham anumeya pratītau vyāpriyamāṇam pramāṇa tām pratipatsyate tad kṛtā eva upalabhya anuvādena liṅga buddhiḥ bhaviṣyati tasmāt kapittha ādi padārtha darśanasya parāmarśa sopānam anārohataḥ eva upādeya jñāna phala tā vaktum yuktā iti

api ca anumeya viṣaye vahni ādau sukha sādhanatva anusmṛti kṛtam upādeya tā jñānam tava na samasti eva tatas ca tatra api tathā ca ayam jvalana jātīyaḥ iti parāmarśaḥ bhavatā abhyupeyaḥ eva sa ca kiṃkaraṇakaḥ iti nirūpaṇīyam na tāvat indriya dvārakaḥ pāvakasya parokṣa tvāt śabda upamāne tu āśaṅkitum api tatra na yukte dhūma ākhyāt liṅgāt eva saḥ utpadyate iti ced na liṅgasya parāmarśa aviṣayīkṛtasya anumeya miti janana naipuṇya anabhyupagamāt dhūma avamarśasya tadānīm atikrānta tvāt tathā hi prathamam liṅga jñānam tatas vyāpti smaraṇam tatas dhūma parāmarśaḥ tatas vahni jñānam tena dhūma parāmarśasya vinaśyattā tatas agnau sukha sādhanatva anusmaraṇam tadā ca dhūma parāmarśasya vināśaḥ eva iti tasmin vinaṣṭe na kevalaḥ dhūmaḥ tadānīm anala parāmarśam janayitum utsahate

agnau sukha sādhanatva anusmaraṇa anantaram punar dhūma jñānam indriyāt utpadyate iti ced mā evam ananubhavāt bhavatu vā dhūma jñānam tathā api dhūma jñāna anantaram punar vyāpti smṛtiḥ punar dhūma parāmarśaḥ ca avaśyam bhavet iti atra antare hutabhuji sukha sādhanatva anusmṛtiḥ atikrāntā iti tad sahāya parāmarśa janya sukha sādhana tva niścaya utpādaḥ na syāt sukha sādhanatva anusmaraṇena hi vinaśyat avasthena janyamānaḥ pratyakṣa viṣayaḥ asau dṛṣṭaḥ iti

atha manyase na tadānīm punar dhūma jñāna vyāpti smaraṇa tatparāmarśa utpāda ādi jñāna śṛṅkhalā abhyupeyate kintu prāktanaḥ eva dhūma parāmarśaḥ kṛśānau sukha sādhanatva anusmaraṇa anantaram smariṣyate tena smṛti viṣaya vartinā satā tathā ca ayam agni jātīyaḥ iti jvalana parāmarśaḥ janayiṣyate iti etat api ayuktam agni jñāna anantaram yugapad smaraṇa dvaya udaya prasaṅgāt tadā eva sukha sādhana tā anusmṛtiḥ tadā eva dhūma parāmarśa smṛtiḥ iti na hi krama utpāde kiñcid kāraṇam asti jñāna yaugapadyam ca śāstre pratiṣiddham

bhavatu vā krama utpādaḥ tathā api smaraṇa dvaya samanantaram upajāyamānaḥ pāvaka parāmarśaḥ na upalabhya anuvādena jāyate krama pakṣe api ca vahni jñāna anantaram tad gata sukha sādhanatva anusmaraṇam eva pūrvam bhavet tatas dhūma parāmarśa smaraṇam tena tasya vinaśyattā tatas agnau tad jātīya tva parāmarśaḥ tena sukha sādhana tva smṛteḥ vināśaḥ eva iti punar api sā vinaṣṭā satī sukha sādhana tva niścaya janmani na vyāpriyeta iti na ca dhūma liṅga anumita vahni jñāna anantaram dhūma smaraṇam ucitam analam upalabhya hi tad gata sukha sādhana tvam anusmarati lokaḥ na dhūmam iti tena anumāna viṣaye parāmarśaḥ ati durghaṭaḥ pratyakṣa viṣaye api evam kim anena śikhaṇḍinā

yat punar upanaya vacanam abhidheya rahitam aprayojyam prasajyate iti paricoditam tat avayavi prasaṅgaḥ eva nirūpayiṣyāmaḥ tasmāt antarāvartinaḥ parāmarśa jñānasya abhāvāt ādyam ālocanā jñānam eva heya ādi jñāna phalam yathā ukta rītyā bhaviṣyati iti

nanu ca pratyakṣa phalam iha mīmāṃsyam vartate sa ca ayam sukha sādhana tvāt liṅgāt udgamyamānaḥ ānumānikaḥ iti na pratyakṣa phala tām avalambate satyam etat kintu sambandha grahaṇa samaye sukha sādhana tva niścayaḥ pratyakṣa janitaḥ api samasti yatas anumānam pravartate mahānasa ādau dhūma agni darśana vat atas sambandha grahaṇa kāla bhāvinam sukha sādhana tva niścayam cetasi vidhāya bhāṣya kāraḥ tad phala tvaṃpratyakṣa jñānasya varṇitavān iti

nanu sambandha grahaṇa kāle api sukha sādhana tva śakteḥ atīndriya tvāt katham pratyakṣa gamyatā tad jātīya tvāt liṅgāt eva tadā api tad grahaṇe iṣyamāṇe tatas punar sambandha grahaṇāt anavasthā sukhāt eva kāryāt tadā tad avagamaḥ iti ced tadā api na ajñāta sambandham avagati janana samartham iti tad saṃbandha grahaṇa velāyām api śakti grahaṇe pratyakṣasya akṣama tvāt anumāna antara apekṣāyām anavasthā tad avasthā ucyate na khalu ati indriyā śaktiḥ asmābhiḥ upagamyate yayā saha na kāryasya sambandha jñāna saṃbhavaḥ svarūpa sahakāri sannidhānam eva śaktiḥ sā ca sugama eva

nanu sahakāriṇām madhye adṛṣṭam api anupraviṣṭam na ca tat pratyakṣa gamyam atīndriya tvāt dharmasya iti sā api na sugamā śaktiḥ na etat na dharma ādi śakti tvāt atīndriyam api tu tat naisargikam eva jagat vaicitryeṇa tad anumānam vakṣyāmaḥ tat evam tad itara sahakāri svarūpa sannidhāna ātmikāyāḥ śakteḥ pratyakṣa grāhya tva saṃbhavāt upapannam tad jātīya tva liṅgasya saṃbandha grahaṇam

nanu kapittha ādi kāryasya sukhasya idānīm na cakṣuḥ grāhya tvam iti tad sambandhi grahaṇa abhāvāt katham cākṣuṣa pratyaya gamyaḥ sambandhaḥ na cākṣuṣa gamyaḥ sambandhaḥ kintu mānasa pratyakṣa gamyaḥ sukha ādi manasā buddhvā kapittha ādi ca cakṣuṣā tasya kāraṇa tā tatra manasā eva avagamyate

nanu ca manasā kapittha ādeḥ sukha sādhana tva grahaṇa abhyupagame bāhya viṣaya pramitiṣu manaḥ eva niraṅkuśam karaṇam idānīm saṃvṛttam iti kṛtam cakṣuḥ ādibhiḥ atas ca na kaścid andhaḥ vā badhiraḥ vā syāt na eṣa doṣaḥ prathama pravṛtta samanaskavāhya indriya janita vijñāna viṣayīkṛta vapuṣaḥ vāhyasya vastunaḥ manaḥ grāhya tva abhyupagamāt tasya eva niyāmaka tvāt na ucchṛṅkhalam antaḥkaraṇam bāhya viṣaye pravartate

nanu ca sambandha grahaṇa kāle yadi mānasena pratyakṣeṇa sukha sādhanatva avadhāraṇam tarhi tad kāle iva vyavahāra kāle api mānasa pratyakṣaḥ eva sukha sādhana tva niścayaḥ astu kim tad jātīya tva liṅga apekṣaṇena iti mā evam śabda liṅga indriya ādi uparatau kevalam antaḥkaraṇam karaṇam kalpyate paridṛśyamānāyāḥ pratīteḥ apahnotum aśakya tvāt liṅga ādi upāya antara saṃbhave tu yadi manaḥ eva kevalam kāraṇam ucyate tat mānasam eva ekam pramāṇam syāt na catvāri pramāṇāni bhaveyuḥ iti alam prasaṅgena tasmāt sambandha grahaṇa kāle yat tat kapittha ādi viṣayam akṣa jam jñānam tat upādeya ādi jñāna phalam iti bhāṣya kṛtaḥ cetasi sthitam sukha sādhana tva jñānam eva upādeya ādi jñānam iti uktam

āha kimartham ayam īdṛśaḥ kleśaḥ āśrīyate pramāṇāt abhinnam eva phalam astu tat eva cakṣuḥ ādi janitam kapittha ādi padārtha darśanam viṣaya prakāśena vyāpriyamāṇam iva abhāti iti karaṇam ucyatām tat eva viṣaya anubhava svabhāva tvāt phalam iti kathyatām ittham ca pramāṇa phale na bhinna avikaraṇe bhaviṣyataḥ anyatra pramāṇam anyatra phalam iti tat uktam sa vyāpāra pratīti tvāt pramāṇam phalam eva sat iti

tat idam anupapannam pramāṇasya sva rūpa hāni prasaṅgāt karaṇam hi pramāṇam ucyate pramīyate ca anena iti na ca kriyā eva kvacid karaṇam bhavati kriyāyām sādhyāyām kārakam kim api karaṇam ucyate tatra yathā dātreṇa caitraḥ śāli stambam lunāti iti kartṛ karma karaṇāni kriyātas bhinnāni upalabhyante tathā iha api cakṣuṣā ghaṭam paśyati iti darśana kriyā ataḥ pṛthak bhāvaḥ eva teṣām yuktaḥ na darśanam karaṇam eva iti pramā pramāṇam iti tu phale pramāṇa śabdasya sādhu tva ākhyāna mātram kṛtiḥ karaṇam itivat

yat tu na bhinna adhikaraṇe pramāṇa phale ittham bhaviṣyataḥ iti sā iyam apūrva vācaḥ yuktiḥ kim atra adhikaraṇam vivakṣitam yadi tāvat viṣayaḥ tat asti eva eka viṣaya tvam yat viṣayam hi darśanam saḥ eva cakṣuḥ ādeḥ karaṇasya viṣayaḥ āśrayaḥ astu adhikaraṇam iti bauddha gṛhe tāvat avācakaḥ granthaḥ kṣaṇika tvena sarva kāryāṇām nirādhāra tvāt

asmat pakṣe tu bhinna āśrayayoḥ api phala karaṇa bhāvaḥ pāka kāṣṭhayoḥ dṛṣṭaḥ tathā cakṣuḥ jñānayoḥ api bhaviṣyati iti kvacid tu bhinnayoḥ api jñānayoḥ phala karaṇa tvena sthitayoḥ liṅga liṅgi jñānayoḥ iva viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya jñānayoḥ iva ca aikātmya āśrava tvam asti na ttu anena samāna āśraya tvena prayojanam cakṣuḥ ādau anirvahaṇāt

atha eka phala niṣpattau vyāpāra samāna āśraya tvam ucyate tat api bhavatu kāraka antarāṇām na tu phala svabhāvasya jñānasya phala niṣpattau vyāpāraḥ saṃbhavati yat api sa vyāpāra pratīti tvāt iti ucyate tat api pramāṇa phalayoḥ bhinnatām eva sūcayati na hi svarūpa niṣpattau savyāpāra tvam upapadyate api tu pṛthak bhūta phala nirvṛttau eva iti

nanu vastu sthityā phalam eva jñānam phalam api tu bhavat viṣaya anubhavam prati vyāpṛtam iti ayi mugdha buddhe viṣaya anubhavaḥ eva jñānam ucyate na tu viṣaya anubhavaḥ viṣaya anubhave sa vyāpāraḥ bhavati atha manuṣe viṣaya adhigama abhimānaḥ tasmin sati bhavati iti kaḥ ayam abhimānaḥ nāma viṣaya anubhavāt bhinnaḥ abhinnaḥ vā abhede sati tasmin sati bhavati iti asaṅga tā vācaḥ yuktiḥ bhede tu asmad mata anupraveśaḥ

api ca jñānam viṣaya adhigame vyāpṛtam iti kṛtvā viṣaya adhigama abhimānam upajanayati uta viṣaya adhigama svabhāva tvāt eva iti vicāre viṣaya adhigamāt pṛthak bhūtasya tatra vyāpriyamāṇasya anupalaṃbhāt viṣaya adhigama svabhāvam eva jñānam avadhāryate tad kṛtaḥ ca abhimānaḥ iti phalam eva jñānam avakalpate na karaṇam iti tathā ca loka phala tvam eva jñānasya anumanyate na karaṇa tvam tathā hi evam vadati cakṣuṣā paśyāmi liṅgena jānāmi iti na tu jñānena jānāmi iti vyapadiśan kaścid dṛśyate

nanu satsu api cakṣuḥ ādiṣu viṣaya jñānam anupajanayatsu na karaṇa tām vyapadiśati lokaḥ janayatsu ca vyapadiśati iti loke karaṇa utpādaka tvāt eva teṣām karaṇa tva vyapadeśaḥ na sākṣāt karaṇa tvāt iti tat ayuktam cakṣuḥ ādi eva karaṇam na tu tena anyat karaṇam upajanyate kim hi tat anyat karaṇam jñānam iti ced kasyām kriyāyām tat karaṇam iti parīkṣyatām etat na hi ātmani eva kiñcid karaṇam karaṇam bhavati iti

yat tu jñānam anupajanayati cakṣuḥ ādau na karaṇa tām ācaṣṭe lokaḥ tat yuktam eva na hi kriyā utpattau avyāpriyamāṇam karaṇam kārakam bhavati tena cakṣuḥ ādeḥ jñāna kriyām upajanayataḥ karaṇa tvam jñānasya tu phala tvam eva iti yuktaḥ tathā vyapadeśaḥ pramāṇasya pramāṇa tvam tasmāt abhyupagacchatām bhinnam phalam upetavyam eka tve tad asaṃbhavāt

yaḥ tu mūḍhataraḥ pramāṇa prameya phala vyavahāram ekatra eva jñāna ātmani nirvāhayitum udyacchati yadābhāsam prameyam tat pramāṇa phalate punar grāhaka ākāra saṃvittyoḥ trayam na atas pṛthak kṛtam iti tam apavarga āhnike jñānāt vaitat alana prasaṅgena durācāram nirbhartsayiṣyāmahe iti alam vistareṇa tasmāt suṣṭhu uktam yadā jñānam pramāṇam tadā hāna ādi buddhayaḥ phalam iti
tat evam phala viśeṣaṇa pakṣe yatas śabda adhyāhāreṇa vācakam sūtram yatas indriya artha sannikarṣa utpanna tva ādi viśeṣaṇa viśeṣitam jñāna ākhyam phalam bhavati tat pratyakṣam iti

tatra indriya artha sannikarṣa utpanna padam artha anapekṣa janmanaḥ smṛti ādi jñānasya artha janitasya api ca parokṣa viṣayasya anumānādi jñānattya vyavaccheda artham atas tad janakasya na pratyakṣatā prasajyate nanu indriya artha sannikarṣa utpannam indriya gati anumānam api asti tat hi indriya artha sannikarṣeṇa liṅga bhūtena janyate deśa antara prāpti eva tapana gamana anumānam iti katham anena padena anumānam apākriyate na etat evam indriyeṇa sva viṣaya sannikṛṣṭena satā tatra eva yat vijñānam utpadyate tat indriya artha sannikarṣa utpannam iha brūmahe na ca īdṛśam indriya gati anumānam

kutas viśeṣa pratilambhaḥ iti ced utpanna grahaṇāt iti brūmaḥ utpanna grahaṇena hi sannikarṣamya kāraka tvam khyāpyate tat ca api indriya viṣaye arthe jñānam utpādayataḥ nirvahati indriya gati anumāne tu na sannikarṣam kārakam āhuḥ api tu jñāpakam atas eva sva grahaṇa sāpekṣaḥ tad anumāne asau vyāpriyate na rūpa ādi pramitau iva tad nirapekṣaḥ iti

indriyāṇi ghrāṇa rasana nayana sparśana śrotrāṇi pṛthivī ādi bhūta pañcaka prakṛtīni vakṣyante arthāḥ tu gandha rūpa rasa sparśa śabdāḥ gandha tva ādi sva jāti avacchinnāḥ tad adhikaraṇāni pṛthivī ap tejāṃsi dravyāṇi tad adhiṣṭhānāḥ saṅkhī ā ādayaḥ guṇāḥ utkṣepaṇa ādīni karmāṇi tad vṛttīni sāmānyāni yeṣām sparśanena cakṣuṣā grahaṇam kaṇa vrata mate nirūpitam te arthāḥ prāk uktaḥ ca abhāvaḥ api arthaḥ eva vicārya gamyamāna tvāt

sannikarṣaḥ tu indriyāṇām arthaiḥ saha ṣaṣ prakāraḥ tatra dravyam cakṣuṣā tvac indriyeṇa vā saṃyogāt gṛhyate tad gataḥ rūpa ādiḥ guṇaḥ saṃyukta samavāyāt rūpa tva ādi sāmānyāni saṃyukta samaveta samavāyāt gṛhyante cakṣuṣā saṃyuktam dravyam tatra samavetam rūpam rūpe ca samavetam rūpa tvam iti samavāyāt śabdaḥ gṛhyate śrotram ākāśa dravyam tatra samavetaḥ śabdaḥ śabda tvam samaveta samavāyāt gṛhyate śrotra ākāśa samavete śabde tat hi samavetam iti saṃyukta viśeṣaṇa bhāvāt abhāva grahaṇam vyākhyātam iha ghaṭaḥ na asti iti cakṣuṣā saṃyuktaḥ bhū pradeśaḥ tad viśeṣaṇībhūtaḥ ca abhāvaḥ iti

nanu sannikarṣa avagame kim pramāṇam vyavahita anupalabdhiḥ iti brūmaḥ yadi hi asat nikṛṣṭam api cakṣuḥ ādi indriyam artham gṛhṇīyāt vyavahitaḥ api tatas arthaḥ upalabhyeta na ca upalabhyate tasmāt asti sannikarṣaḥ

nanu avyavadhānam eva astu kim sannikarṣeṇa mā evam indriyāṇām kāraka tvena prāpya kāri tvāt saṃsṛṣṭam ca kārakam phalāya kalpate iti kalpanīyaḥ saṃsargaḥ etat ca indriya parīkṣāyām nipuṇam nirṇeṣyate iti na iha vivicyate rasa sparśanayoḥ ca spaṣṭam prāpya kāri tvam upalabhyate iti tad sāmānyāt indriya antareṣu api kalpanīyam iti

nanu evam satyartha ākṣiptaḥ kāraka tvāt eva sannikarṣaḥ iti sva kaṇṭhena kasmāt ucyate ṣaḍvidha tva jñāpana artham iti uktam utpanna grahaṇena indriya arthayoḥ jñāna janaka tvam darśayati tatra indriyam karaṇa tvena janakam arthaḥ tu karma tvena nanu arthasya jñāna janaka tvam kutas avagamyate tad viṣaya jñāna utpādāt eva svatassa ākāra tvasya nirākṛta tvāt prakāra antareṇa pratikarma vyavasthāyāḥ asiddheḥ

nanu prayojanam etat pramāṇam pṛṣṭaḥ asi tat brūhi ucyate etat eva pramāṇam anyasya api vīraṇa ādeḥ karma kārakasya kaṭa ādi kārya utpattau pratyakṣa anupalaṃbha pratipannābhyām anvaya vyatirekābhyām yathā kāraṇa tvam avadhāryate tathā arthasya api jñāna utpattau yathā hi devadatta arthī kaścid gṛham gataḥ tatra asat nihitam na paśyati devadattam kṣaṇa antare ca enam āyāntam paśyati tatra anvaya vyatirekābhyām devadatta sada sattva anuvartinau jñāna utpāda an utpādau avadhārya mānasena pratyakṣeṇa candana sukha vat asya tad kāraṇa tām pratipadyate

nanu vīraṇa kaṭayoḥ pṛthak upalaṃbhāt yuktaḥ eṣa nyāyaḥ arthaḥ tu jñānāt pṛthak na kadācid upalabhyate iti duradhigamau tatra anvaya vyatirekau ucyate ayam eva pṛthak upalaṃbhaḥ yat asat nihite arthe na tad viṣayam abādhitam jñānam utpadyate iti tat alam asmin avasare jñāna vāda garbha codya udvibhāvayiṣayā bhaviṣyati etat avasare iti
yathā ca indriyāṇām karaṇānām anvaya vyatirekābhyām jñāna kāraṇa tvam evam arthasya karmaṇaḥ api iti utpanna grahaṇena darśitam

nanu indriya artha sannikarṣa utpanna padena sukha ādi viṣayam pratyakṣam na saṅgṛhītam na na saṅgṛhītam manasaḥ indriya tvāt sukha ādeḥ arthasya tad grāhya tvāt bhautika ghrāṇa ādi indriya dharma vailakṣaṇyāt tu manasaḥ tad varge parigaṇanam na kṛtam iti

tat ca idam pratyakṣam catuṣṭaya traya dvaya sat nikarṣāt pravartate tatra bāhye rūpa ādau viṣaye catuṣṭaya sannikarṣāt jñānam utpadyate ātmā manasā saṃyujyate manaḥ indriyeṇa indriyam arthena iti sukha ādau tu traya sannikarṣāt jñānam utpadyate tatra cakṣuḥ ādi vyāpāra abhāvāt ātmani tu yoginaḥ dvayoḥ ātma manasoḥ eva saṃyogāt jñānam upajāyate tṛtīyasya grāhyasya grāhakasya vā tatra abhāvāt tasmāt sukha ādi jñāna saṅgrahāt indriya artha sannikarṣa utpannam iti yuktam uktam ātma manasoḥ tu sat api jñāna janaka tvam iha na sūtritam sarva pramāṇa sādhāraṇa tvāt

jñāna grahaṇam viśeṣya nirdeśa artham tasya hi indriya artha sannikarṣa utpanna tva ādīni viśeṣaṇāni tāni asati viśeṣye kasya viśeṣaṇāni syuḥ iti athavā sukha ādi vyāvṛtti artham jñāna padam indriya artha sannikarṣa utpannam hi sukham api bhavati tatra tad janakam kāraka cakram pramāṇam mā bhūt jñāna janakam eva pramāṇam yathā syāt iti jñāna grahaṇam

atra śākyāḥ codayanti na jñāna padena sukha ādi vyavacchedaḥ kartum yuktaḥ śakyaḥ vā sukha ādīnām api jñāna svabhāva tvāt jñānasya eva amī bhedāḥ sukham duḥkham icchā dveṣaḥ prayatnaḥ iti kāraṇa adhīnaḥ hi bhāvānām bhedaḥ bhavitum arhati samāna kāraṇānām api tu bhede abhidhīyamāne na kāraṇa kṛtam padārthānām niyatam rūpam iti tad ākasmika tva prasaṅgaḥ tat uktam tat atad rūpiṇaḥ bhāvāḥ tad atad rūpa hetu jāḥ tad sukha ādi kim ajñānam vijñāna abhinna hetu jam iti tasmāt jñāna rūpāḥ sukha ādayaḥ tad abhinna hetu ja tvāt iti

tat idam anupapannam pratyakṣa viruddha tvāt hetoḥ sukha ādi saṃvedyamānam ānanda ādi rūpa tayā anubhūyate jñānam viṣaya anubhava svabhāva tayā iti pratyakṣa siddha bheda tvāt katham abhede anumānam kramate atas eva idam api na vacanīyam ekam eva idam saṃvid rūpam harṣa viṣāda ādi aneka ākāra vivartam paśyāmaḥ tatra yatheṣṭam saṃjñāḥ kriyantām iti saṃvidaḥ viṣaya anubhava svabhāva tayā eva pratibhāsāt sukha ādeḥ ca viṣaya anubhava svabhāvasya anusyūtasya apratibhāsāt jñānam eva viṣaya grahaṇa rūpam prakāśate na sukham duḥkham vā

yaḥ tu sukha jñānam duḥkha jñānam iti pratibhāsaḥ saḥ jñāna svabhāva meda kṛtaḥ eva saṃśaya jñānam viparyaya jñānam itivat uktam atra saṃśaya viparyaya ādau viṣaya anubhava svabhāva tvam anusyūtam avabhāti saṃśayaḥ hi viṣaya grahaṇa ātmakaḥ anubhūyate aniścitam tu viṣayam gṛhṇāti viparyayaḥ api viṣaya grahaṇa ātmakaḥ eva viparītam asantam vā viṣayam gṛhṇāti na tu viṣaya grahaṇa svabhāvam sukham duḥkham ca anubhūyate atas anyaḥ eva ayam grāhya eka svabhāvaḥ āntaraḥ dharmaḥ sukha duḥkha ādiḥ iti ghaṭa jñāna vat viṣaya tayā eva jñānam bhinatti na svabhāva bhedena saṃśaya jñāna vat iti

tatra etat syāt sva prakāśa tvāt sukha ādeḥ na grāhya eka svabhāva tvam atas ca grāhya grahaṇa ubhaya svabhāva tvāt jñānam eva tat iti mā evam vocaḥ sva prakāśa tvam jñāne api pratikṣiptam pratikṣepsyate ca tat kutas sukha ādau bhaviṣyati na hi grahaṇa svabhāvam kaścid sukham anubhavati jñāna vat iti

nanu asya prakāśa tva anabhyupagame sukha ādeḥ utpāda anutpādayoḥ aviśeṣāt sarvadā sukhi tvam na kadācid vā syāt iti na etat evam utpannam eva sapadi sukham gṛhyate jñānena iti katham anutpannāt na viśiṣyate pratyuta sva prakāśa sukha vādinām eṣa doṣaḥ sva prakāśa sukha utpādāt tena eva sva prakāśena sukhena anyaḥ api sukhī syāt sva prakāśasya dīpa ādeḥ sarvān pratyaviśiṣṭa tvāt kvacid santāne sva prakāśa sukha utpādāt tena eva sva prakāśena anyaḥ api sukhī syāt yasya api sukham na utpannam iti kiñca kim ekam eva jñānam sarva sukha duḥkha ādi aśeṣa ākāra bhūṣitam iṣyate uta kiñcid sukha ātmakam kiñcid duḥkha ātmakam iti ādye pakṣe sarva ākāra khacita jñāna upajananāt ekasmin eva kṣaṇe paraspara viruddha sukha duḥkha ādi dharma prabandha saṃvedana prasaṅgaḥ

uttarasmin tu kiñcid sukha jñānam kiñcid duḥkha jñānam iti yat kiñcit asukha duḥkha khacitam viṣaya anubhava svabhāvam api jñānam anubhūyamānam eṣitavyam eva tat ca na svaccham api tu kenacid haṭa ādinā viṣayeṇa uparaktam anvaya vyatirekābhyām ca ghaṭa ādi upajanana apāye api bodha svabhāvam anuvartamānam pratīyate tat idānīm sukha jñānam api anubhūyamānam sukhena viṣaya bhāva juṣā ghaṭa ādinā iva uparajyate iti gamyate na sva rūpeṇa eva sukha ātmakam tatas bhinna rūpasya bodha mātra svabhāvasya jñānasya anyadā dṛṣṭa tvāt iti tasmāt na bodha rūpāḥ sukha ādayaḥ

abhinna hetu ja tvāt iti ca ayam asiddhaḥ hetuḥ samavāyi kāraṇasya ātmanaḥ asamavāyi karaṇasya ca ātma mana ssaṃyogasya ca abhede api nimitta kāraṇasya sukha tva jñāna tva ādeḥ bhinna tvāt nanu sukha utpādāt pūrvam anāśrayam sukha tva sāmānyam katham tatra syāt kaḥ ca asya sukha hetubhiḥ kārakaiḥ saṃsargaḥ asaṃsṛṣṭam vā katham kārakam syāt ucyate sarva gatāni sāmānyāni sādhayiṣyante iti santi tatra api sukha tva ādīni yogya tā lakṣaṇaḥ eva ca eṣām sukha hetubhiḥ kārakaiḥ saṃsargaḥ dharma adharma vat dharma adharmau hi sarvasya prāṇinām sukha duḥkha hetoḥ jāyamānasya śāli ādeḥ kāryasya kāraṇam tayoḥ ca tad kāraṇaiḥ bīja kṣiti jala ādibhiḥ saha yogya tā eva saṃsargaḥ evam sukha tva ādīnām api syāt tasmāt nimitta kāraṇa bhedāt bhinnāni jñāna sukha ādīni kāryāṇi

nimitta kāraṇa anya tvam api kāryasya bhedakam vilakṣaṇāḥ hi dṛśyante ghaṭa ādau pāka jāḥ guṇāḥ api ca jñānam icchanti na sarve jñāna pūrvakam sukha duḥkha ādi sarvam tu viṣaya jñāna pūrvakam viṣaya anubhava utpādyāḥ yatra api na sukha ādayaḥ tatra api teṣām utpattau kāraṇam viṣaya smṛtiḥ kvacid tu saṅkalpaḥ api sukhasya kāraṇa tām pratipadyate tasmāt sarvam sukha ādi jñāna pūrvakam eva jñānam api jñāna pūrvakam eva iti ced na upariṣṭāt nirākariṣyamāṇa tvāt na hi garbha ādau mada mūrchā ādi anantaram vā jñānam upajāyamānam jñāna antara pūrvakam bhavati iti vakṣyāmaḥ tena jñāna sukha ādīnām vailakṣaṇya upapādanāt sukha ādi nivṛtti artham jñāna grahaṇam arthavat

nanu evam api na jñāna grahaṇena kṛtyam avyabhicāri padāt eva sukha ādi vyavacchedasya siddha tvāt vyabhicāra avi abhicārau hi jñānasya dharmau na sukha ādeḥ atas tad upādānāt tad dharma yogi jñānam labhyate eva kim jñāna grahaṇena na etat evam sukhasya api savyabhicārasya dṛṣṭa tvāt kim punassukham vyabhicāra vat dṛṣṭam yat etat para dāra abhimarśa ādi niṣiddha ācaraṇa saṃbhavam sukham tat vyabhicāri

nanu sukhasya kīdṛśaḥ vyabhicāraḥ jñānasya api kīdṛśaḥ vyabhicāraḥ atasmin tathā bhāvaḥ sukhasya api atasmin tathā abhāvaḥ eva kim para purandhrī pariraṃbha saṃbhavam sukham sukham na bhavati kim śuktikāyām rajata jñānam jñānam na bhavati jñānam bhavati kintu mithyā idam api sukham bhavati kintu mithyā

nanu na sukham mithyā tat api hi ānanda svabhāvam eva yadi evam śuktikāyām rajata jñānam api na mithyā tat api hi viṣaya anubhava svabhāvam eva nanu viṣaya anubhava svabhāvam api tat jñānam viṣayam vyabhicarati sukham api tarhi idam ānanda svabhāvam api sva hetum viṣayam vyabhicarati eva kim asukha sādhanena tat janitam jñānam api kim ajñāna sādhanena janitam

nanu jñānam jñāna sādhanena janitam asatyena pratyakṣa bādhitena rajata ādinā sukham api sukha sādhanena janitam asatyena tu śāstra bādhitena para vanitā ādinā kim para vanitā ādi na satyam tatra api jñāna janakam na satyam asatyam pratyakṣa bādhita tvāt para vanitā ādi api sukha sādhanam asatyam śāstra bādhita tvāt

nanu śāstreṇa kim atra bādhyate jñāne api pratyakṣeṇa kim bādhyate viṣayaḥ mithyā iti khyāpyate śāstreṇa api sukhasya hetuḥ bhithyā iti khyāpyate kim sa viṣaya ssukha hetuḥ na bhavati yathā tu eṣa viṣayaḥ kaluṣasya jñānasya hetuḥ tathā saḥ api kaluṣasya kaṭu vipākasya sukhasya hetuḥ iti tathāvidham sukham api vyabhicāri bhavati eva iti alam ati kelinā tasmāt samāna nyāya tvāt sukhe vyabhicāritā asti iti avyabhicāri padāt jñānam na labhyate

aparaḥ āha kim anena ḍimbha kalahena mā bhūt avi abhicāri padāt jñānasya lābhaḥ tathā api vyavasāya ātmaka padāt labhyate eva jñānam na hi sukha duḥkha ādayaḥ vyavasāya ātmakāḥ bhavanti kintu jñānam eva tathāvidham iti saṃśaya vyavaccheda artham tat padam iti ced satyam sukha ādi vyavacchedam api kartum alam eva bhavati vyavasāya ātmaka tvasya sukha ādiṣu asaṃbhavāt iti

tat evam siddhe api sukha ādi vyavacchede kartavyam eva jñāna grahaṇam viśeṣya nirdeśa artha tvāt tasya hi sarvāṇi amūni viśeṣaṇāni upāttāni tad anupādāne nirālambanāni bhaveyuḥ śrotuḥ ca buddhiḥ na samādhīyeta iti tena balāt gamyamānam eva kartavyam eva jñāna grahaṇam artha ākṣiptasya avacane pratyakṣam pratyakṣam iti etāvat mātram abhidheyam syāt anyat arthāt labhyate eva tasmāt dharmi nirdeśa artham yuktam jñāna padam
śabdānām artha saṃsparśi tvam śākya mata nirāsena sādhayiṣyate iti śabda anupraveśa vaśena vyapadeśyam nāma jñānam upapadyate iti tad vyavaccheda artham avyapadeśya padam

tatra vṛddha naiyāyikāḥ tāvat ācakṣate vyapadiśyate iti vyapadeśyam śabda karmatā āpannam jñānam ucyate yat indriya artha sannikarṣāt utpannam sat viṣaya nāmadheyena vyapadiśyate rūpa jñānam rasa jñānam iti tat vyapadeśyam jñānam pratyakṣa phalam pratyakṣam mā bhūt iti avyapadeśya grahaṇam tat idam anupapannam na hi nāmadheya vyapadeśya tvam aprāmāṇya kāraṇam bhavati yadi hi tat rūpa jñānam rasa jñānam ca viṣaya avyabhicāri nissaṃśayam ca tat katham apramāṇa phalam ucyate vyabhicāra ādi doṣa yoge vā pada antareṇa tad pratikṣepāt kim avyapadeśya padena pramāṇa phalam ca tat vijñānam idānīm kiṃpramāṇa prabhavam bhavatu na pratyakṣa phalam etat pada pratikṣipta tvāt na anumāna ādi janyam tad vailakṣaṇyāt na asti kiñcid pañcamam pramāṇam asaṅgrahaḥ asya lakṣyasya lakṣaṇena iti prajñā pramādaḥ tasmāt apavyākhyānam etat

vyavacchedya antaram avyapadeśya padasya varṇayāñcakruḥ ācāryāḥ śabda artheṣu sthaviravya bahāravaḥ vyutpadyamānaḥ janaḥ saṃśaya avagama samaye saṃjñā upadeśaka ādayam panasaḥ ucyate iti vṛddha udīritāt vākyāt purovasthita śākhā ādimantam artham panasa śabda vācya tayā jānāti tat asya jñānam indriya jam api na kevala indriya karaṇakam bhavitum ucitam asati saṃjñā upadeśini śabde tad anutpādāt tena śabda indriyābhyām saṃbhūya janita tvāt ubhaya jam idam jñānam vyapadeśāt jātam iti vyapadeśyam ucyate tat avyapadeśya padena vyudasyate

na ca idam pañcamam pramāṇam avatarati kintu śābdam iva etat anumanyate lokaḥ tathā ca katham punar jānīte bhavān panasaḥ ayam iti iti pṛṣṭaḥ prativakti mama devadattena ākhyātam panasaḥ ayam iti iti na punar evam vismṛtya api vravi iti cakṣuṣā mayā pratipannam panasaḥ ayam ucyate iti iti tat indriya anvaya vyatireka anuvidhāne sati api śabdaḥ eva atra karaṇam

atas eva sūtra kṛtā śabda lakṣaṇam varṇayatā na indriya anupraveśa pratiṣedhāya kim api viśeṣaṇam uparacitam upadeśaḥ śabdaḥ iti etāvat eva lakṣaṇam abhihitam atas ca indriya anupraveśe api śābda tām asya manyate sūtrakāraḥ iha punar avyapadeśya viśeṣaṇa padoṣa ādānena śabda anupraveśa pratiṣedhāt na pratyakṣam etat jñānam tasmāt evaṃvidha vyapadeśya vajñāna vyavaccheda artham avyapadeśya padam iti

tat etat vyākhyātāraḥ na anumanyante yadi ubhaya jam jñānam avyapadeśya padena vyudasyate tat api na apramāṇam apramāṇa lakṣaṇa atīta tvāt iti pramāṇam bhavat kasmin anuviśatām iti cintyam nanu śābdam idam jñānam tad bhāva anuvidhānataḥ bhavatu akṣajam api etat tad bhāva anuvidhānataḥ śābdam ca ubhaya jam ca iti viruddham abhidhīyate pramāṇa antaram eva syāt ittham tat api pūrvavat

nanu lokaḥ śābda tām asya vyapadiśati devadattena ākhyātam panasaḥ ayam iti iti vyavahārāt iti uktam aho loka vatsalaḥ śraddadhānaḥ mahā anubhāvaḥ na khalu lokasya vyapadeśa eka śaraṇāḥ vastu sthitayaḥ bhavanti lokaḥ hi yathāruci vyapadiśati nānā muni jana sādhāraṇam api tīrtham nandikuṇḍam iti kim na śrutavān bhavān

hanta tarhi sūtrakārāśayam anusarantaḥ śābdam idam jñānam pratipadyāmahe yat ayam sūtrakāraḥ pratyakṣe śabda anupraveśa vyavacchedāya viśeṣaṇam idam upadiśati śabde tu na indriya vyudāsāya kiñcid viśeṣaṇam upādatte sa paśyati kāraṇa antara anupraveśe api śābdam etat jñānam iti ucyate manu vat sūtra kāraḥ api na dharmasya upadeśakaḥ yena etat anurodhena tasya brūyāma śābda tām vastu sthityā tu nirūpyamāṇam indriya anvaya vyatireka anuvidhāyi tvāt idam vijñānam na pratyakṣa phala tām ativartate tatas ca vyudasyamānam pramāṇa antara tām eva spṛśet

tasmāt ubhaya jajñāna vyudāsā anupapattitaḥ vyākhyā bhaṅgi antareṇa asya padasya iyam vidhīyate asambhava doṣa vyavaccheda artham avyapadeśya pada upādānam evam hi paraḥ manyate sati lakṣye lakṣaṇa varṇanam ucitam iha tu lakṣyamāṇam pratyakṣam indriya artha sannikarṣa utpannam nāma na kiñcid asti gauḥ ityādi jñānānām śabda avacchinna vācya viṣaya tvena śābda tvāt iha hi viṣaya vyatirekeṇa jñānānām atiśayaḥ durupapādaḥ bodha svabhāvasya sarvān pratyaviśiṣṭa tvāt tatra yathā daṇḍī iti śuklaḥ iti vā pratyayaḥ viśeṣaṇa avacchinna viśeṣya viṣaya tayā sa atiśaya tvam aśnute tathā gauḥ iti ādi pratyayaḥ api vācaka avacchinna vācya viṣaya tvāt sa atiśaya tvam bhajate śabda avacchinna vācya viṣaya tvāt ca śābdaḥ eṣa pratyayaḥ tad vyatirikta karaṇa kāryatva anupapatteḥ

na hi indriya karaṇakam idam jñānam bhavitum arhati cakṣuṣaḥ viśeṣaṇā viṣaya tvāt viśeṣye ca śrotrasya asāmarthyāt na ca yugapad indriya dvaya dvārakam ekam utpadyamānam jñānam kvacid dṛṣṭam tatra etat syāt mānasam idam jñānam sugandhibandhūka bodha vat bhaviṣyati uktam atra śabda liṅga ādi karaṇa antara vyāpāra viratau kāryam upajāyamānam kevala manaḥ karaṇam iti kalpyate na tad saṃbhave api tathā hi sati mānasam eva ekam pramāṇam syāt iti asti ca atra śabdaḥ eva karaṇam sa hi sahasra kiraṇa vat ātmānam ca viṣayam ca prakāśayati iti tasmāt indriya viṣaye api gauḥ ityādi jñānam utpadyamānam śābdam eva iti avadhāryate

nanu saṅketa avagama samaye gauḥ iti ādi śabdaḥ śrutaḥ āsīt saḥ idānīm atikrāntaḥ iti katham tad kṛtaḥ eṣa pratyayaḥ syāt ucyate tadānīm aśrūyamāṇasya śabdasya smṛti ārūḍhasya tad pratyaya hetutvāt tad śrutau api kim sarve varṇāḥ pratyakṣa gocarāḥ viśeṣaḥ kaḥ antya varṇena gṛhītena smṛtena vā tat evam smṛti viṣayī kṛta śabda janitaḥ eṣa pratyayaḥ iti abhyupetavyaḥ yathā parokṣe api śabdaḥ uccaritaḥ ātmānam prakāśayati artham ca tathā pratyakṣe viṣaye saḥ eva smaryamāṇaḥ ātmānam artham ca prakāśayati iti vācaka avacchinna vācya pratibhāsaḥ ca evaṃvidhāsu buddhiṣu nūnam eṣitavyaḥ yathā aaha bhaṭṭaḥ saṃjñi tvam kevalam param iti

saṃjñi tvam iti mattu arthīya pratyaya antāt utpannaḥ bhāva pratyayaḥ saṃbandham ācaṣṭe saṃjñā saṃjñi saṃbandhaḥ saṃjñitvam iti kṛt taddhita samāseṣu sambandha abhidhānam bhāva pratyayena iti ābhiyukta smaraṇāt saṃjñā ca śabdaḥ saḥ ayam śabda viśiṣṭa artha pratibhāsaḥ uktaḥ bhavati na ca śabda anusandhāna rahitaḥ kaścid pratyayaḥ dṛśyate anullikhita śabdakeṣu api pratyayeṣu antatas sāmānya śabda samunmeṣa saṃbhavāt tad ullekha vyatirekeṇa prakāśa ātmikāyāḥ pratīteḥ anutpādāt tathā aaha bhartṛ hariḥ na saḥ asti pratyayaḥ loke yaḥ śabda anugamāt ṛte anuviddham iva jñānam sarvam śabdena gṛhyate iti tasmāt pratyakṣasya lakṣyasya abhāvāt kasya idam lakṣaṇam upakrāntam iti asaṃbhava doṣam āśaṅkya āha sūtra kāraḥ avyapadeśyam iti

yat idam avidita pada padārtha sambandhasya jñānam utpadyate vidita sambandhasya api vā yat prathama akṣa sannipāta samayaḥ eva jñānam anullikhita śabdakam śabda anusmaraṇe hetu bhūtam upajāyate tat aśabdam aśabda avacchinna viṣayam avyapadeśyam indriya artha sannikarṣa eka karaṇam avikalpam pratyakṣam na ca śabda kṛtā buddhīnām prakāśa svabhāva tā svatas eva tāsām evaṃrūpa tvāt na ca nirvikalpaka samaye yat kiñcid idam iti ādi sāmānya śabda ullekhaḥ kaḥ api kaiścid anubhūyate tasmāt gauḥ ityādi jñānānām śābda tve api tathāvidhasya jñānasya lakṣyasya sadbhāvāt na vyartham lakṣaṇam iti evam asaṃbhava doṣa nirākaraṇa artham avyapadeśya padam iti

tat etat ācāryāḥ na kṣamante na gauḥ iti ādi jñānam indriya artha sannikarṣa utpannam api idam śābdam iti vaktum yuktam na ca atra śabda avacchinna arthaḥ prakāśate tathāvidha artha grahaṇe kāraṇa abhāvāt viśeṣya artha pramitau tāvat śabdaḥ karaṇam viśeṣaṇībhūtasya tu śabdasya grahaṇe kim karaṇam iti nirūpyatām na śrotram viramya vyāpārā saṃvedanāt sambandha grahaṇāt ūrdhvam ca smaryamāṇa śabda yojanayā jāyamāne gauḥ iti ādi jñāne śrotram karaṇam āśaṅkitum api na yuktam na api manaḥ bāhya karaṇa nirapekṣam bāhye viṣaye dhiyam ādhātu m alam andhādya bhāva prasaṅgāt

nanu śabdaḥ eva karaṇam iti uktam tat kim apara karaṇa āśaṅkanena mā evam ekasya kārakasya ekasyām eva kriyāyām karma karaṇa bhāva anupapatteḥ savitṛ prakāśa vat iti ced na kriyā bhedāt yatra asau karaṇam na tatra karma yatra vā karma na tatra karaṇam iti ghaṭa ādi viṣaya pramiti janmani karaṇam eva taraṇi prakāśaḥ na karma tad grahaṇa kāle tu karma eva asau na karaṇam

kim tarhi tatra karaṇam iti ced kevalam eva cakṣuḥ iti brūmaḥ āloka grahaṇe cakṣuṣaḥ prakāśa antara nirapekṣa tvāt katham evam iti ced aparyanuyojyā hi vastu śaktiḥ ghaṭa ādi grahaṇe cakṣuḥ udyotam apekṣate na udyota grahaṇaḥ iti kam anuyuñjmahe saḥ ayam sūrya prakāśaḥ prakāśa antara nirapekṣa cakṣuḥ indriya prathama gṛhītaḥ ciram avatiṣṭhamānaḥ tad indriya grāhyaḥ eva viṣaye gṛhyamāṇe karaṇa tām upayāti iti yuktam

śabdaḥ tu kṣaṇikaḥ śrotra indriya grāhyaḥ tad itara paricchedye viṣaye tad avagama kriyāyām karaṇībhūya bhūyas tasyām eva kriyāyām katham iva karma bhāvam anubhavet śabdaḥ hi dhūma ādi vat upāyaḥ eva na upeyaḥ saḥ upāya tvāt prathamam gṛhyatām nāma na upeya grahaṇa kāle punar grahaṇam arhati dhūma vat eva iti evam smaryamāṇaḥ api śabdaḥ yatra artha pratīti kāraṇam tatra api prathamam śabda smaraṇam tatas śabda artha sampratyayaḥ bhavati na tarām tatra artha pratīti velāyām śabda grahaṇam saṃbhāvyate tasmāt na asti vācaka viśeṣita vācya pratibhāsaḥ api ca gauḥ ityādi jñānam indriya artha sannikarṣa anvaya vyatireka anuvidhāyi prasabham tat katham śābdam iti ucyate śabda smaraṇa sāpekṣam yasya utpādakam indriyam tat eva yadi te śābdam aho naiyāyikaḥ bhavān

nanu śabda avacchinnam artham na cakṣuḥ śrotrayoḥ anyatarat api karaṇam grahī tum alam iti uktam bhoḥ sādho cakṣuḥ eva enam grahīṣyati iti katham na brūṣe nanu na aviṣaye yuktam indriyasya pravartanam tena śabda viśiṣṭa artha jñānam na indriya jam bruve marīciṣu jala jñānam katham indriya jam tava tatra api hi na toyena sannikarṣaḥ asti cakṣuṣaḥ nanu ca smṛti upārūḍham udakam tatra gṛhyate iha api smṛti upārūḍhaḥ śabdaḥ kasmāt na gṛhyate nanu śabdaḥ na netrasya kadācid api gocaraḥ asannihitam api ambu kim vā bhavati gocaraḥ nanu eka indriya vādaḥ syāt cakṣuṣā śabda vedane atra api sarva bodhaḥ syāt asannihita vedane

nanu ca marīci jala jñānam bhrāntam iti katham iha dṛṣṭāntīkriyate katham asya bhrānta tvam kim anindriya ja tvāt uta vyabhicāri tvāt tatra anindriya ja tvena asya bhrānta tāyām indriya artha sannikarṣa utpanna padena eva nirāsāt avyabhicāri padam anupādeyam iti tad upādānāt vyabhicāri tvena asya bhrānta tvam iti nūnam idam indriya jam asat nihita salila jñānam abhyupagantavyam

yathā ca aviṣaye tasmin nīre nayana jā matiḥ tathā vācaka saṃspṛṣṭe vācye kim iti na iṣyate yathā ca tava kāla ādi nīrūpam api cākṣuṣam tathā śabda anuraktaḥ api kim iti arthaḥ na cākṣuṣaḥ evam hi indriya vyatireka anuvidhānam atra na bādhitam bhaviṣyati nanu cākṣuṣa tām śabde na jīvan vaktum utsahe tyaja enam vācaka upeta vācya avagama durgraham

api ca amuṣya śābda tve sambandha grahaṇam katham na ca agṛhīta sambandhaḥ śabdaḥ bhavati vācakaḥ nirvikalpaka vi jñāna viṣaye na ca tad grahaḥ śābda pakṣe tu nikṣiptam bhavatā sa vikalpakam sambandhaḥ śakyate boddhum na ca māna antarāt vinā śābda jñānena tad bodhe bhavet anyonya saṃśrayaḥ na ca śabda uparakte arthe sambandham buddhyate janaḥ go śabda vācyaḥ go śabdaḥ iti hi grahaṇam bhavet vācyasya hi gavā ādeḥ go śabda viśeṣitasya vācya tvāt vācyaḥ arthaḥ iva go śabdaḥ api vācya tām avalambate

yadi ca sva anurāgeṇa vācakāt vācya vedanam liṅgāt api bhavet buddhiḥ sva avacchedena liṅgini atha dhūma anvita tvena na vahniḥ avagamyate iha api śabda yogena gavādiḥ na eva gamyate na ca asti vastunaḥ dharmaḥ vā acya tā nāma kaścana yadi syāt nirvikalpe api pratibhāseta rūpavat artha asaṃsparśinaḥ śabdān kathayan duṣṭa saugataḥ pratyakṣa astreṇa bhettavyaḥ sa katham hanyate tvayā pratyakṣa viṣaye vṛttiḥ śabdānām bhavataḥ kutas teṣām yat viṣaye vṛttiḥ tat hi śābdīkṛtam tvayā

api ca viṣaya bhedena pratibhāsa bhedaḥ bhavati iti durāśayā śabda viśiṣṭam artham nirvikalpāt sa vikalpasya viṣayam adhikam paśyati bhavān anena eva ca vartmanā avataran param śabda adhyāsam na paśyati iti kaḥ ayam vyāmohaḥ sa tvam vacanīyaḥ asi saṃvṛttaḥ madhu paśyasi durbuddhe prapātam na eva paśyasi iti tasmāt gauḥ iti vijñānam pratyakṣam avadhāryatām śabda smaraṇa sāpekṣa cakṣuḥ indriya nirmitam mānasa tvam tu yadi asya na iṣyate yuktam eva tat tad bhāva anuvidhāyi tvāt bāhya indriya jam eva tat

atra punar pravarāḥ prāhuḥ nanu evam gauḥ iti ādi bodheṣu vācaka avacchinna vācya pratibhāse sarva prakāram apākriyamāṇe prathama akṣa sannipāta samaya samāsādita sadbhāva nirvikalpaka vedana vailakṣaṇyam katham eṣām bhavet na hi viṣaya atiśayam antareṇa pratibhāsā atiśayaḥ bhavitum arhati daṇḍī iti daṇḍa viśiṣṭaḥ puruṣaḥ pratibhāsate itarathā na kevala puruṣa pratīteḥ eṣā pratītiḥ viśiṣyata ubhaya pratibhāse api na daṇḍa puruṣau iti pratīteḥ viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāvasya niyāmaka tvāt pūrva apara cira kṣipra krama ādi avagameṣu api diś kāla ādi viśiṣṭaḥ arthaḥ sphurati atiśaya grahāt pratyakṣaḥ kim sa kāla ādiḥ pratītim pṛccha kim mayā gṛhyate tad viśiṣṭaḥ arthaḥ sa ca na iti etat adbhutam

etena samavāye api pratyakṣa tvam prakāsitam iha iti tantu sambanddha paṭa pratyaya darśanāt ayam paṭaḥ iti pratyayāt iha tantuṣu paṭaḥ iti vilakṣaṇaḥ eṣa pratyayaḥ tantu paṭa sambandhasya viśeṣaṇasya apratyakṣatāyām na kevala paṭa pratyayāt viśiṣyeta iti

atha matam upāya bhedāt pratīti bhedaḥ bhavati dūra avidūra deśa vyavasthita sthāṇu ādi padārtha pratīti vat saṃskṛta āsaṃskṛta akṣa karaṇa viṣaya bodha vat vā iti tat asāṃpratam upāya bhede api tad bheda asiddheḥ upāyaḥ buddhau atiśayam ādadhāti na viṣaye viṣaya avagati samaye ca na buddhiḥ avabhāti iti naiyāyikāḥ tat ayam atiśayaḥ yat adhikaraṇaḥ sā na pratibhāsate buddhiḥ yat ca tadānīm avabhāsate viṣayaḥ tatra atiśayaḥ na asti dṛśyate ca atiśaya saṃvedanam iti saṅkaṭaḥ panthāḥ na ca dūra avidūra deśa vartini padārthe pratītiḥ upāya bhedāt bhidyate sā api hi viṣaya bhedāt eva bhidyate

dūrāt hi vastu sāmānyam dharma mātra upalakṣitam adūrataḥ tu vispaṣṭa viśeṣam avasīyate yathā mādhena varṇitam cayaḥ tviṣām iti avadhāritam purā tatas śarīrī iti vibhāvita ākṛtim vibhuḥ vibhakta avayavam pumān iti kramāt amum nāradaḥ iti abodhi saḥ iti kriyā antarāṇām vaicitrye yat vā tat vā astu kāraṇam bhedaḥ jñāna kriyāyāḥ tu karma bheda nibandhanaḥ

tat etat ācāryāḥ pratisamādadhate na viṣaya bhedāt eva pratibhāsa bhedaḥ kintu upāya bhedāt bhavati eva yat ca coditam viṣaya pratibhāsa kāle tad pratibhāsā pratibhāsāt atiśaya vacane saṅkaṭaḥ panthāḥ iti tad avidita naiyāyika darśanasya eva codyam jñāna utpādaḥ eva viṣayasya pratyakṣata iti naḥ darśanam na jñāna grahaṇam iti tatra yathā puruṣaḥ iti niratiśaya jñāna mātra utpāde tāvat mātra viṣaya pratyakṣa tā bhavati na tatra jñānam prakāśate agṛhyamāṇe api jñāne viṣayaḥ eva pratibhāsate evam daṇḍī iti śukla vāsāḥ iti viśeṣaṇa jñāna abhyupāya vaśāt sa atiśaya pratyaya janane tad agrahaṇe saḥ eva viṣayaḥ avabhāsate iti kiyān eṣa saṅkaṭaḥ panthāḥ tathā ca daṇḍī iti puruṣa pravaṇā eva matiḥ kaḥ daṇḍī puruṣaḥ kaḥ puruṣaḥ daṇḍī iti sāmānādhikaraṇyena nissandigdhasya puṃsaḥ eva pratibhāsāt evam daṇḍinam bhojaya daṇḍine dehi iti bhojana ādi kārya yogi tvam na daṇḍe dṛśyate api tu puṃsi eva

nanu daṇḍī parvatam ārohati iti daṇḍe api kārya anvayaḥ dṛśyate loke vede api daṇḍī maitrāvaruṇaḥ praiṣān anvāhaḥ iti praiṣa anuvaṃcanasya vacana antarataḥ prāpteḥ daṇḍa vidhāna artham etat vākyam bhavati yathā lohita uṣṇīṣāḥ ṛtvijaḥ pracaranti iti śyena ādau ṛtvijām prakṛti vat bhāvena prāptānām lohita uṣṇīṣa vidhāna mātram etat bhavati ucyate bhavatu evam kintu daṇḍam abalambya puruṣaḥ parvatam ārohati na daṇḍaḥ niścetanaḥ vede api daṇḍa pāṇiḥ puruṣaḥ preṣān anubhāṣata na daṇḍaḥ na lohitāḥ uṣṇīṣāḥ caranti kintu anya padārthībhūtāḥ ṛtvijaḥ eva iti sarvatra viśeṣya pravaṇā eva matiḥ ubhaya pratipādane tu daṇḍa puruṣau iti syāt na daṇḍī iti

viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāvasya niyāmaka tvāt iti ced sā iyam viśeṣya pravaṇāḥ matiḥ uktā eva bhavati viśeṣaṇasya viśeṣaṇa tvena eva upasarjana tvāt daṇḍaḥ asya asti iti puruṣaḥ eva ucyate na daṇḍa puruṣau evam pūrva apara ādi pratyayāḥ cira kṣipra ādi pratyayāḥ iha tantuṣu paṭe ityādi pratyayāḥ ca diś kāla samavāya grāhiṇaḥ te ime diś kāla samavāyāḥ sāmagrī antargatāssantaḥ pratyaya atiśayam ādadhati na tad viṣayī bhavanti paṭa ādi dravya vat

evam patana ādi anumeya guru tva ādi kāraṇa bheda janitāḥ guruḥ pāṣāṇaḥ ityādi pratyayāḥ parokṣa viśeṣaṇam viśaṣyam avalambante iti alam vistareṇa tasmāt gauḥ ityādi jñānam na vācaka avacchinna vācya viṣayam atas ca na śābdam tat api tu su spaṣṭam pratyakṣam eva tasmin ca lakṣye sati lakṣaṇa vaiyarthya śaṅkā karaṇa abhāvāt na asaṃbhava doṣa nirākaraṇa artham avyapadeśya padam
kimartham tarhi idamaḥ tu uktam ācārvaiḥ ubhaya ja jñāna vyavaccheda artham iti

nanu tat api pratyakṣam eva iti anapohyam uktam purovasthita gava ādi padārtha svarūpa mātra grahaṇa niṣṭhita sāmarthyam atra pratyakṣam go śabda vācya tāyām tu saṃjñā karma upadeśī śabdaḥ eva pramāṇam yadi api śabda artha sambandha paricchede gati antaram api saṃbhavati tathā api yatra tāvat saṃjñinam nirdiśya saṃjñā vṛddhaiḥ upadiśyate go śabda vācyaḥ ayam panasa śabda vācyaḥ ayam iti tatra tat vācya tā paricchede saḥ eva karaṇam

atas eva ca lokaḥ api śābda tvam iha manyate śabda uparacitā pūrva jñāna atiśaya toṣitaḥ tat śabda vācya tā ājñaptiḥ vinā saṃjñā upadeśinaḥ śabdāt na iti saḥ eva atra sati api akṣe prakarṣa bhāj atas sūtra kṛtā api atra śabda atiśaya darśinā vyadhāyi tad vyavacchedaḥ na tu dharma upadeśinā tasmāt ubhayaja jñāna vyavaccheda artham eva idam padam iti

anye tu manyante yadi saṅketa grahaṇa kāle bhāvinaḥ saṃjñā upadeśaka vacana janitasya ubhaya ja jñānasya vyavacchedakam idam varṇyate padam tadā tad vyavahāra kāle api yat ayam gauḥ iti saṅketa grahaṇa kāla anubhūta devadatta ādi udīrita saṃjñā upadeśaka vacana smaraṇa pūrvakam vijñānam utpadyate tat api ubhaya jam eva iti katham anena na vyudasyate nanu tatra śabda smaraṇam kāraṇam na śabdaḥ saṅketa kāle api śabda smaraṇam eva kāraṇam na hi krama bhāvinaḥ varṇāḥ yugapad anubhavitum pāryante antya varṇe tu gṛhyamāṇe smaryamāṇe vā kim śabda vyāpāraḥ viśiṣyate

nanu vyavahāra kāle gavā ādi nāmadheya pada mātram eva smaryamāṇam indriyeṇa saha sa vikalpa pratyaya udaye vyāpriyate saṅketa kāle tu saṃjñā upadeśi vṛddha vākyam iti ced mā evam vyavahāra kāle api saṃjñā upadeśakam vṛddha vākyam eva smaryate tat asmaraṇe tad śabda vācya tā anavagamāt asya gauḥ iti nāma devadattena upadiṣṭam āsīt iti evam anusmṛtya go śabda vācya tayā evam vyavaharati iti vākya smaraṇa jam eva idam jñānam tasmāt asya api tat vākyam saṃjñā karma upadeśakam hetu tām upayāti iti śābdam etat apīpyatām evam astu iti ced śāntam evam sati tapasvinām naiyāyikānām utpannam pratyakṣam sa vikalpakam yatra mārga antareṇa api saṅketa jñāna saṃbhavaḥ tatra api anena nyāyena śābda tā na nivartate naiyāyikānām ca sa vikalpa pratyakṣa mayāḥ prāṇāḥ tasmāt na ubhaya jasya śābda tvam jñānasya vaktavyam

sambandha adhigamaḥ tu nānā pramāṇakaḥ tatra sve sve viṣaye tad tad pramāṇam pravartate yathā aaham bhaṭṭaḥ sambandhaḥ tri pramāṇakaḥ iti tasmāt na ekasya śabdasya bhāraḥ āropaṇīyaḥ pratyakṣam tu saṅketa grahaṇa kāle api sva viṣaya grāhakam iti na ubhaya ja jñāna vyavaccheda paṃkṣaḥ niravadyaḥ tasmāt varam jarat naiyāyika kathita śabda karmatā āpanna jñāna vyavaccheda pakṣaḥ iti saḥ eva aśrīyatām tatra tāvat karmaṇi kṛtye kṛte vyapadeśya śabdaḥ yathārthataraḥ bhavati

nanu tatra coditam na tādṛśam jñānam apramāṇam na pañcamam pramāṇam iti satyam ayantu teṣām āśayaḥ rūpa ādi viṣaya grahaṇa abhimukham hi tat akṣa jam jñānam pramāṇam phalam vā ucyate yadā tu tat eva śabdena ucyate rūpa jñānam rasa jñānam iti tadā rūpa ādi jñāna viṣaya grahaṇa vyāpāra labhyām pramāṇa tām apahāya śabda karmatā āpatti kṛtām prameya tām eva avalambataḥ iti na tasyām daśāyām tad pramāṇam iti kutas pañcama pramāṇa prasaṅgaḥ iti

aparaḥ āha sa vikalpakasya śabda saṅkalpakasya śabda saṃsarga sāpekṣa janmanaḥ pratyakṣa jñānasya śābda tām pūrvavat āśaṅkya tasya evaśābda tām darśayati avyapadeśya padena sūtrakāraḥ pratyakṣam eva tat jñānam indriya anvaya vyatireka anuvidhāyi tvāt avyapadeśyam aśābdam iti arthaḥ spaṣṭa tvāt vācaka abhāvāt indriya anuvidhānataḥ lokasya sammata tvāt ca pratyakṣam idam iṣyate śabda anusmṛti ja tve api na śābdam jñānam īdṛśam śabda smṛtiḥ sahāyaḥ syāt indriyasya pradīpa vat

nanu evam sa vikalpasya pratyakṣa tve prasādhite na idānīm saṅgṛhītam syāt pratyakṣam nirvikalpakam yaḥ tu śabda anuvedhena śābda tvam sa vikalpake kaścid āśaṅkate tasya pratiśabdaḥ ayam ucyate yatra śabda anuvedhe api pratyakṣam jñānam iṣyate tatra tad sparśa śūnyasya tathā tve kā vicāraṇā nirvikalpaka vat tasmāt pratyakṣam sa vikalpakam samagrahīt ca tat idaṃpadena anena sūtrakṛt iti ācārya matāni iha darśitāni yathā aagamam yadebhyaḥ satyam ābhāti sabhyāḥ tad avalambyatām

avyabhicāri grahaṇam vyabhicāri jñāna vyavaccheda artham yathā grīṣme tapati lalāṭantape tapane tad marīciṣu caturam ūṣara bhuvam abhihatya samutphaliteṣu taraṅga ākāra dhāriṣu yat vāri jñānam tat atasmin tad iti grahaṇāt vyabhicāri bhavati tat anena padena vyavacchidyate na tat pratyakṣam iti tatra nirvikalpakam api prathama nayana sannipāta jam jñānam udaka sa vikalpaka jñāna janakam udaka grāhyā iva na yathā tathā tathāgatāḥ kathayanti marīci viṣayam avikalpakam jñānam udaka vikalpaka jananāt apramāṇam iti nirvikalpa avasthāyām avicārayataḥ eva prathama unmīlita cakṣuṣaḥ jhaṭiti salila pratibhāsāt athavā vācaka ullekha pūrvikāḥ api saṃvidaḥ na eva indriya artha janya tvam jahati iti upapāditam tasmāt sa vikalpakam avikalpakam vā yat atasmin tat iti jñānam utpadyate tat vyabhicāri tat ca iha vyāvartyam iti

nanu marīciṣu jala jñānam avidyamāna salila avabhāsi tvāt atindriya artha sannikarṣa jam atas ca indriya artha sannikarṣa utpanna padena tad vyudāsa siddheḥ kim avyabhicāri padena na etat evam tasya indriya artha janya tvam siddham tat bhāva bhāvataḥ na hi anunmīlita akṣasya marau salila vedanam arthaḥ api janakaḥ tasya vidyate na asataḥ prathā

tad ālambana cintām tu tridhā aacāryāḥ pracakrire kaiścid ālambanam tasmin uktam sūrya marīcayaḥ nigūhita nija ākārāḥ salila ākāra dhāriṇaḥ tatra taraṅga ādi sāmānya dharma grahaṇe sati na sthāṇu puruṣa vat ubhaya viśeṣāḥ smaraṇa patham avataranti na ca sannihita marīci viśeṣāḥ smaraṇa patham avataranti kintu pūrva upalabdha viruddha salila vartinaḥ viśeṣāḥ tad smaraṇāt ca sthagiteṣu sva viśeṣeṣu marīcayaḥ svarūpam upadarśayitum aśaknuvantaḥ toya rūpeṇa avabhāsante

anye tu ālambanam prāhuḥ puras avasthita dharmiṇaḥ sādṛśya darśana udbhūta smṛti upasthāpitam payaḥ yatra kila jñāne yat rūpam upaplavate tat tasya ālambanam ucyate na sannihitam bhū pradeśasya tad āraṃbhakāṇām ca paramāṇūnām tad ālambana tva prasaṅgāt idam ca salila avabhāsi vijñānam atas tat eva asya ālambanam tat ca na iha sannihitam na ca ekānta asataḥ kha puṣpa ādeḥ khyātiḥ avakalpate iti deśa antara ādau vidyamānam eva salilam sadṛśa darśana prabuddha saṃskāra upajanita smaraṇa upārūḍham iha avalambanībhavati

anyat ālambanam ca anyat pratibhāti iti kecana ālambanam dīdhitayaḥ toyam ca pratibhāsate kartṛ karaṇa vyatiriktam jñāna janakam ālambanam ucyate iti na paramāṇu ādau prasaktiḥ iti tat idam pakṣa trayam api upariṣṭāt nipuṇataram nirūpayiṣyate tat evam bāhya indriya artha anvaya vyatireka anuvidhāyinām vibhramāṇām indriya artha sannikarṣa utpanna padena nirasitum aśakya tvāt yuktam avyabhicāri pada upādānam

ye tu mānasāḥ vibhramāḥ bāhya indriya anapekṣa janmānaḥ teṣām iṣyate eva indriya artha sannikarṣa padena paryudasanam iti na tad artham avyabhicāri pada upādānam tat yathā viraha uddīpita uddāma kāma ākulita dṛṣṭayaḥ dūra sthām api paśyanti kāntām antika vartinīm

nanu evaṃprāyeṣu nirālambaneṣu vibhrameṣu kutastyaḥ ākāraḥ pratibhāti ucyate ākāraḥ smṛti upārūḍhaḥ prāyeṇa sphurati bhrame smṛteḥ tu kāraṇam kiñcid kadācid bhavati kvacid kvacid sadṛśa vijñānam kāma śoka ādayaḥ kvacid kvacid tu darśana abhyāsaḥ timiram cakṣuṣaḥ kvacid kvacid nidrā kvacid cintā dhātūnām vikṛtiḥ kvacid alakṣyamāṇe tad hetau adṛṣṭam smṛti kāraṇam bālasya indu dvaya jñānam asti na asti iti vetti kaḥ astitve api smṛtau hetum adṛṣṭam tasya manvate nūnam niyama siddhi artham janakasya avabhāsanam na ca ekānta asataḥ dṛṣṭā jñāna utpādana yogya tā na ca sannihitam vastu tatra asti vanitā ādikam tena idam smṛti upārūḍham avabhāti iti manvate tatra ādyena padena etāḥ sva antaḥkaraṇa saṃbhavāḥ nirastāḥ bhrāntayaḥ akṣa ādi saṃsarga rahita udayāḥ yāḥ punar pīta śaṅkha ādi maru nīḥ a ādi buddhayaḥ akṣa jāḥ tat vyudāsāya sūtre padam idam kṛtam

dūrāt sthāṇu puruṣa sādhāraṇam dharmam āroha pariṇāha rūpam upalabhamānasya tayoḥ anyataratra vartamānān vakra koṭara ādīn kara caraṇa ādīn vā viśeṣān apaśyataḥ samāna dharma prabuddha saṃskāra tayā ca ubhaya vartinaḥ api viśeṣān anusmarataḥ puras avasthita artha viṣayam sthāṇuḥ vā puruṣaḥ vā iti saṃśaya jñānam upajāyate tat indriya artha sannikarṣa utpanna tva ādi viśeṣaṇa yuktam api na pratyakṣa phalam atas tat vyavacchedāya vyavasāya ātmaka grahaṇam

nanu mānasa tvāt saṃśaya jñānasya indriya artha sannikarṣa utpanna grahaṇena nirāsaḥ siddhi ati eva kim pada antareṇa tathā ca bhāṣya kāraḥ smṛti anumāna āgama saṃśaya pratibhāsvapna jñāna ūha sukha ādi pratyakṣam icchā ādayaḥ ca manasaḥ liṅgāni iti vakṣyati mā evam sthāṇu ādi saṃśayasya bāhya indriya anvaya vyatireka anuvidhāyi tvāt kaścid hi mānasaḥ saṃśayaḥ samasti eva yathā daiśikasya jyotiḥ gaṇaka ādeḥ ekadā anyadā ca asamyak ādiśya tṛtīye pade punar ādiśataḥ saṃśayaḥ bhavati kim ayam asmad ādeśaḥ saṃvadet uta visaṃvadet iti sa bhāṣya kṛtaḥ cetasi kevala manaḥ karaṇaḥ iti sthitaḥ yaḥ tu viṣphārita akṣasya sthāṇuḥ vā puruṣaḥ vā ityādiḥ saṃpadyate saṃśayaḥ tam anindriya artha sannikarṣa jam kaḥ nāma ācakṣīta

nanu atasmin tat iti jñānam vyabhicāri vyākhyātam eka rūpam ca puras avasthitam artham aneka rūpa tayā spṛśati saṃśayaḥ sthāṇuḥ vā puruṣaḥ vā iti saḥ ayam atasmin tathā abhāvāt viparyayaḥ eva iti pūrva pada vyudaḥ tatvāt na pada antara vyavacchedya tām arhati iti na etat evam svarūpa bhedāt kāraṇa bhedāt ca ekam eva viruddham ākāram ullikhan viparyayaḥ jāyate sthāṇau puruṣaḥ iti puṃsi vā sthāṇuḥ iti aniyata ākāra dvaya ullkhī tu saṃśayaḥ bhavati sthāṇuḥ vā syāt puruṣaḥ vā iti saḥ ayam svarūpa bhedaḥ pratyātma saṃvedyaḥ kāraṇa bhedaḥ ca viruddha viśeṣa smaraṇa prabhavaḥ viparyayaḥ śuktikāyām sannihitāyām rajata viśeṣān marīciṣu sannihiteṣu salila gata viśeṣān anusmarataḥ viparyayaḥ bhavati ubhaya viśeṣa smaraṇa janmā tu saṃśayaḥ iti pada antara nirasanīyaḥ eva ayam

nanu saṃśaya viparyayayoḥ api nirvikalpayoḥ asaṃbhavāt avyapadeśya padena eva pravara pakṣe pratikṣepaḥ siddhyet puras avasthita sthāṇu ādi dharmi darśana mātram eva nirvikalpakam indriya vyāpāra jam anantarantu ubhaya anyatara viśeṣaṇa smaraṇa janmanorullikhita śabdayoḥ eva saṃśaya viparyayayoḥ utpādaḥ tatra viśeṣasmṛtyā eva śabda anuvedhasya ākṣepāt atas pada dvayam api tat vyudāsāya na kartavyam atra etat eva tāvat vaktavyam pravara pakṣaḥ pratikṣiptaḥ eva yatas śabda anuvedha jātam api pratyakṣam upapāditam

nanu bhavatu pravara pakṣaḥ pratikṣiptaḥ sadṛśa darśana niṣṭhite tu nayana vyāpāre viśeṣa smṛteḥ ūrdhvam upajāyamānau saṃśaya viparyayau na indriya jau iti prathama padena eva nirastau bhavataḥ tat asat smṛteḥ ūrdhvam api indriya vyāpāra anuvṛtteḥ iti ukta tvāt etat ca anvaya vyatirekābhyām avagamyate nimīlita cakṣuṣaḥ tad anutpādāt na ca tadānīm antar saṅkalpa rūpeṇa api śabda ullekhaḥ utpanne tu saṃśaye viparyaye ca vācaka smaraṇam bhaviṣyati iti samyak jñāna vat saṃśaya viparyayau api śabda ullekha śūnyau saṃvedyete viśeṣa smṛtiḥ tu viśeṣa viṣaya tvāt tān eva ākṣipatu śabdasya kim vartate vācaka śabda smṛtiḥ tu śabdam upasthāpayati sā ca na tāvat utpannā iti samyak pratyaya vat tasmāt vācaka ullekha varjitau akṣa vyāpāra jau na staḥ na saṃśaya viparyayau īdṛśayoḥ katham anayoḥ ādya pada vyudasanīya tā tasmāt tad apākṛtaye yuktam pada dvayasya api upādānam

evam lakṣaṇa padāni lakṣya padam tu pratyakṣam iti jñāna viśeṣe rūḍhyā eva pravartate yogasya vyabhicārāt prati gatam akṣam pratyakṣam iti akṣara arthaḥ sa ca ayam sukha ādau api saṃbhavati iti rūḍhiḥ eva sādhīyasī

athavā jñāna padasya sūtre nirdeśāt yoga pakṣaḥ api astu na ca asau dṛśyamānaḥ nihnotum yuktaḥ yogarūḍhiḥ tu nāma na sammatā eva viduṣām yatra api hi dvayam dṛśyate tatra api śabda pravṛttau prayojakam eva bhavati katham punar akṣam prati gatam jñānam iṣyate na saṃyogi tvena añjana ādeḥ pratyakṣa prasaṅgāt na samavāyi tvena akṣa vartinām rūpa ādīnām tathā tva prasaṅgāt na janaka tvena akṣāraṃbhakāṇām paramāṇūnām api tathā abhāva prasakteḥ tasmāt janya tvena eva jñānam akṣam prati gatam iti vyākhyeyam

avyayībhāva vyākhyānam tu na yuktam pratyakṣaḥ puruṣaḥ pratyakṣā strī ityādi vyavahāra darśanāt iti alam ati prasaṅgena tena indriya artha ja tvādi viśeṣaṇa gaṇa anvitam yatas bhavati vijñānam tat pratyakṣam iti sthitam iti vigata kalaṅkam asya dhīmān akuruta lakṣaṇam etat akṣapādaḥ na tu para racitāni lakṣaṇāni kṣaṇam api sūkṣma dṛśām viśanti cetaḥ
yat tāvat kalpanā apoḍham abhra antam iti lakṣaṇam pratyakṣasya jagau bhikṣuḥ tat atyantam asāṃpratam śabda saṃsarga yogya artha pratītiḥ kila kalpanā asyāḥ ca kena doṣeṇa prāmāṇyam na viṣahyate

nanu abhilāpa saṃsarga yogya pratibhāsa tvāt api kam anyam doṣam mṛgayate bhavān asat artha viṣaya tvam eva idam uktam bhavati śabda arthasya vāstavasya abhāvāt sva lakṣaṇasya sajātīya itara vyāvṛtta ātmanaḥ sambandha adhigama savyapekṣa pravṛttinā śabdena viṣayīkartum aśakyatvāt tad vyatiriktasya vastunaḥ anupalambhāt

na ca indriya artha sannikarṣa anvaya vyatireka anuvidhāyinī kalpanā buddhiḥ tam antareṇa api bhāvāt tasmin sati api ca pūrva anubhūta vācaka śabda yojanam vinā anutpādāt yadi ca indriya artha sannikarṣaḥ tad janakaḥ bhavet prathamam eva tathāvidhām dhiyam janayet na ca janayati tat ayam śabda smṛteḥ ūrdhvam api na janakaḥ iti manyāmahe

tat uktam yaḥ prāc ajanakaḥ buddheḥ upayoga aviśeṣataḥ sa paścāt api tena syāt artha apāye api netra dhīḥ iti api ca sati api indriya artha saṃsarge smṛti apekṣāyām saḥ arthaḥ tayā eva vyavahitaḥ syāt āha ca artha upayoge api punar smārtam śabda anuyojanam akṣadhīrya di apekṣeta saḥ arthaḥ vyavahitaḥ bhavet iti

saṅketa smaraṇa sahakāri savyapekṣam akṣam īdṛśīm buddhim janayati iti ced na vyatirikta avyatirikta upakāra ādi vikalpaiḥ sahakāriṇaḥ nirasta tvāt kiñca daṇḍī ityādi vikalpa vijñānam na indriya āpāta velāyām eva jāyate kintu bahu prakriyā apekṣam yat āha viśeṣaṇam viśeṣyam ca saṃbandham laukikīm sthitim gṛhītvā sakalam ca etat tathā pratyeti na anyathā iti na ceyatīm prakriyām prathama nayana upanipāta jātam avikalpakam jñānam udvoḍhum kṣamam iti āha saṅketa smaraṇa upāyam dṛṣṭa saṅkalana ātmakam pūrva apara parāmarśa śūnye tat cākṣuṣe katham iti

tatra etat syāt dvividhāḥ vikalpāḥ chātra manoratha viracitāḥ idantā grāhiṇaḥ ca nīlam ityādayaḥ tatra pūrve mā bhūvan pramāṇam kaḥ teṣu artha nirapekṣa janmasu prāmāṇye abhiniviśeta idantā grāhiṇām tu artha avinābhūta tvāt katham na prāmāṇyam iti ucyate sarve eva amī vikalpāḥ paramārthataḥ artham na spṛśanti eva sa hi nirvikalpakena eva sarva ātmanā paricchinnaḥ tat uktam ekasya artha svabhāvasya pratyakṣasya sataḥ svayam kaḥ anyaḥ na dṛṣṭaḥ bhāgaḥ syāt yaḥ pramāṇaiḥ parīkṣyate iti

yat tu keṣāñcid vikalpānāmidantā grāhi tva spaṣṭa tva ādi rūpam tat arthāvinābhā vi nirvikalpaka darśana pṛṣṭha bhāvi tva avāpta tad chāyā saṃsarga ja nitam na tu teṣām artha sparśaḥ kaścid asti artha ātmanaḥ nirvikalpena eva mudrita tvāt tasmāt atāttvika ākāra samullekha purassarāḥ na yathāvastu jāyante kadācid api kalpanāḥ

pañca ca ete kalpanāḥ bhavanti jāti kalpanā guṇa kalpanā kriyā kalpanā nāma kalpanā dravya kalpanā ca iti tāḥ ca kvacid abhede api bheda kalpanāt kvacid ca bhede api abheda kalpanāt kalpanāḥ ucyante jāti jāti matoḥ bhedaḥ na kaścid paramārthataḥ bheda āropaṇa rūpā ca jāyate jāti kalpanā idam asya goḥ go tvam iti na hi kaścid bhedam paśyati tena abhede bheda kalpanā eva

etayā sadṛśa nyāyāt mantavyā guṇa kalpanā tatra api abhinnayoḥ bhedaḥ kalpyate guṇa tadvatoḥ tathā ca āhuḥ eṣa guṇī rūpa ādibhyaḥ artha antara tvena na ātmānam naḥ darśayati tebhyaḥ ca vyatirekam vāñchasi iti citram bheda āropaṇa rūpā eva guṇavat karma kalpanā tad svarūpa atiriktā hi na kriyā nāma kācana

gacchati devadattaḥ iti devadattasya eva anyūna an atiriktasya pratibhāsāt vibhinnayoḥ tu abhedena pravṛttā nāma kalpanā caitraḥ ayam iti abhedena niścayaḥ nāma nāminoḥ caitraḥ iti ayam śabdaḥ ayam iti arthaḥ kīdṛśam anayoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyam evam daṇḍī ayam iti ādiḥ mantavyā dravya kalpanā sāmānādhikaraṇyena bhedinoḥ grahaṇāt tayoḥ

nanu yadi abhede bhedam bhede ca abhedam āropayantyaḥ kalpanāḥ pravartante tat katham āsu bādhakaḥ pratyayaḥ na jāyate śuktikā ra jata buddhi vat ucyate yatra vastu vastu antarātmanā avabhāsate tatra bādhakaḥ bhavati marīciṣu iva jala buddhau iha tu na jāti ādi vastu antaram asti yatas vastu antarātmanā asya grahaḥ bhavet vyakti viṣayāḥ eva ete sāmānya ādi vikalpāḥ tasmāt vastu antara anava bhāsiṣu eṣu na bādhakaḥ pratyayaḥ jāyate tasmāt na viparyaya ātmānaḥ vikalpāḥ

na ca ete pramāṇam etat ullikhyamānasya jāti ādeḥ apāramārthika tvāt atas eva pramāṇa viparyaya abhyām ayam anyaḥ eva vikalpaḥ iti ācakṣate iti alam vistareṇa evam etāḥ pravartante vāsanā mātra nirmitāḥ kalpita alīka bheda ādi prapañcāḥ pañca kalpanāḥ evam ca paśyatā tāsām prāmāṇya āmoda manda tām bhikṣuṇā lakṣaṇa granthe tad apoḍha padam kṛtam

atra pratividhīyate tat idam saṃkīrṇa prāyam atibahu vilapatā bhavatā na niyatam kim api vikalpānām aprāmāṇya kāraṇam iti spaṣṭam āveditam tat ucyatām kim śabda artha avabhāsi tva garbhīkṛtam asat artha vāci tvam tad aprāmāṇya kāraṇam abhimatam uta saṃketa smṛti apekṣā upanatam anindriya artha sannikarṣa ja tvam
