uta viśeṣa grahaṇa ādi apekṣā avāptam bahu prayāsa sādhya tvam uta pūrva apara parāmarśa śūnya cākṣuṣa vailakṣaṇya vācaḥ yukti samarpitam vicāraka tvam uta nirvikalpaka paricchinna vastu grāhitā nibandhanam adhigata adhigantṛ tvam uta bheda abheda samāropa bhaṇitam atasmin tad iti grāhi tvam uta vṛtti vikalpa ādi vādhita sāmānya grahaṇa sūcitam bādhya tvam eva iti

tatra tāvat na śabda saṃsarga yogya artha grahaṇa dvāra kamasat artha grāhi tvam eṣām aprāmāṇya kāraṇam abhidhātum yuktam śabda arthasya vāstavasya samarthayiṣyamāṇa tvāt kaḥ punar asau iti ced yaḥ eva nirvikalpake pratibhāsate kim nirvikalpake sāmānya ādikam avabhāsate bāḍham avabhāsate iti vakṣyāmaḥ atas eva vā adhya tvam api na prāmāṇya apahāra kāraṇam eṣām vaktavyam vṛtti vikalpa ādeḥ bādhakasya parihariṣyamāṇa tvāt bādhaka antarasya ca na idam iti pratyayasya śuktikā ra jata jñāna ādi vat bhavatā eva anabhyupagamāt

na apya nindriya artha sannikarṣa janya tvam saṅketa grahaṇa kāla anubhūta śabda smaraṇa apekṣaṇāt asya vaktavyam sahakārī apekṣāyām api tad vyāpārā virateḥ yaḥ prāc ajanakaḥ buddheḥ sa labdhvā sahakāriṇam kāla antareṇa tām buddhim vidadhat kena vāryate vyatirikta avyatirikta upakāra karaṇa ādi vikalpāḥ tu kṣaṇa bhaṅga bhaṅge nirākariṣyante

rūpa grahaṇe ca cakṣuṣaḥ pradīpa ādi apekṣāyām duṣparihārāḥ te vikalpāḥ na vai kiñcid ekam janakam iti bhavantaḥ api paṭhanti iti bhavat pakṣe api tulyāḥ te yadi ubhayoḥ doṣaḥ na tena ekaḥ codyaḥ bhavati tasmāt upayoga aviśeṣataḥ iti asiddhaḥ hetuḥ ayam eva upayoga viśeṣaḥ yat indriya āloka manaskāra viṣaya vat vācaka smaraṇam api sāmagrī antaram etat pratyaya janmani vyāpriyate iti na vācaka smaraṇa janita tvena smārta tvāt apramāṇam vikalpaḥ rūpa smṛti ākhya samanantara pratyayatiḥ mitasya nirvikalpasya rūpa jñānasya api tathā tva prasaṅgāt

yat ca idam ucyate saḥ arthaḥ vyavahitaḥ bhavet iti tat na vidmaḥ kīdṛśam vyavadhānam arthasya iti na hi dīpena vā manasā vā vijñāna hetunā kadācid arthaḥ vyavadhīyate manaḥ vat ca vācaka smṛtiḥ api sāmagrī antargatā satī tad pratītau vyāpriyate iti katham artham vyavadadhīta smṛti viṣayīkṛtaḥ śabdaḥ tam artham vyavadhatte iti ced na śabdasya tad prakāśaka tvena jñāna vat dīpa vat vā vyavadhāyaka tva abhāvāt na ca indriya vyāpāra tirodhānam vyavadhānam tasya adhunā api anuvartamāna tvāt

yathā tad bhāva bhāvi tvāt ādyam vijñānam akṣa jam tathā tad bhāva bhāvi tvāt uttaram jñānam akṣa jam na hi vācaka smaraṇa antaram akṣiṇī nimīlya vikalpayati paṭaḥ ayam iti atha yāvat vācaka vijñānam hṛdaya patham avatarati tāvat saḥ arthaḥ kṣaṇika tvāt atikrāntaḥ iti vyavahitaḥ ucyate tat api durāśā mātram kṣaṇa bhaṅgasya upariṣṭāt nirākariṣyamāṇa tvāt api ca pradarśita prāpti ādi vyavahāra vat santāna dvārakam iha api tad grahaṇam bhaviṣyati iti sarvathā na vyavadhānam tat evam samaya smaraṇa sāpekṣa tve api na indriya artha sannikarṣa utpanna tām ativartate sa vikalpakam vijñānam iti katham apratyakṣam

yat punar viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya grahaṇa ādi sāmagrī apekṣa tvena bahu prayāsa sādhya tvam aprāmāṇyakāraṇam abhidhīyate tat atīva su bhāpitam na hi bahu kleśa sādhya tvam nāma prāmāṇyam upahanti uktam ca na hi giri śṛṅgam āruhya yat gṛhyate tat apratyakṣam iti rasa ādi jñāna apekṣayā ca rūpa ādi jñānasya dīpa ādi āloka āharaṇa prayāsa sādhya tvāt aprāmāṇyam syāt

yat api pūrva apara parāmarśa rahita cākṣuṣa vijñāna vaiparītyena vikalpa jñānānām vicāraka tvāt aprāmāṇyam ucyate tat api na samyak sarvatra jñānasya vicāraka tva anupapatteḥ vicārakaḥ hi pramātā sa hi paśyati smarati anusandhatte vicārayati icchati dveṣṭi yatate gṛhṇāti jahāti sukham anubhavati iti vakṣyāmaḥ artham ca spṛśataḥ vijñānasya vicārayataḥ api katham aprāmāṇyam syāt

atha asya nirvikalpena eva sarva ātmanā spṛṣṭa tvāt piṣṭa peṣaṇam ayuktam iti sa vikalpam adhigata artha grāhi tvāda pramāṇam iti manyase tat api na sādhu pūrvam eva parihṛta tvāt na hi anadhigata adhigantṛ tvam prāmāṇyam iti uktam gṛhīta grahaṇe api pramāṇasya pramāṇa tva anativṛtteḥ

yat tu abhyadhāyi bhinneṣu abhedam abhinneṣu ca bhedam kalpayantyaḥ kalpanāḥ atasmin tad grahaṇe prāmāṇyam avahajati iti tat yuktam atasmin tad grahaḥ bhavati apramāṇa tva kāraṇam tat tu iha na asti tasya hi bādhaka pratyaya upasannipātāt niścayaḥ na ca bhavat upavarṇitāsu pañcasu api jāti ādi kalpanāsu bādhakam kiñcid asti iti na atasmin tad grāhiṇyaḥ kalpanāḥ bhavanti

jātiḥ jātimataḥ bhinnā guṇī guṇa gaṇāt pṛthak tathā eva tad pratīteḥ ca kalpanā uktiḥ abādhikā etat ca upariṣṭāt nirṇeṣyate dravya nāmnaḥ atu bhinnayoḥ bhedena eva pratītiḥ nābheda kalpanā na hi devadatta śabdaḥ ayam iti evam tad vācyaḥ pratīyate nanu devadattaḥ ayam iti saṃjñā saṃjñya bheda vyavahāraḥ dṛśyate eva iti ced na śabda viśiṣṭa tad vācyā avagatiḥ eṣā na śabdaḥ asyām artha ārūḍhaḥ avabhāsate na śabda vivarta rūpeṇa arthaḥ parisphurati kim tarhi śabda smṛti ākhya sāmagrya sāmarthya atiśaya udbhavaḥ pratyaya atiśayaḥ saḥ ayam iti evam prāk prasādhitam

daṇḍī ayam iti dravya abheda kalpanā tu manda matibhiḥ eva udāhṛtā na hi daṇḍaḥ ayam iti devadatte pratītiḥ api tu daṇḍī iti tatra ca prakṛti pratyayau pṛthak eva upalabhyete daṇḍaḥ asya asti iti daṇḍī iti tat iha yathā eva vastu tathā eva tad avasāyaḥ iti nābhedāropaḥ karmaṇi tu dvayam api na asti na abhinne bheda kalpanā na ca bhinne api abheda kalpanā

kriyā hi tadvataḥ bhinnā bhedena eva ca gṛhyate calati ityādi bodheṣu tad svarūpa avabhāsanāt tena kriyā guṇa dravya nāma jāti uparañjitam viṣayam darśayan aiti vikalpaḥ na apramāṇa tām viparyayāt samuttīrṇaḥ iti sādhu sahāmahe pramāṇāt tu bahis bhūtam vikalpam na kṣamāmahe kvacid vādhaka yogena yadi tasya apramāṇa tā nirvikalpe api tulyā asau dvi candra ādi avabhāsini manorājya vikalpānām kāma mastu apramāṇa tā yathāvastu pravṛttānām na tu asau akṣa janmanām

na ca nirvikalpa pṛṣṭha bhāvi tva kṛtam eṣām etat rūpam viṣaya saṃsparśam antareṇa svatassvaccha rūpāṇām jñānānām evam ākāra tva anupapatteḥ kim nirvikalpa pṛṣṭha bhāvitā kariṣyati tad anantara bhāvinī hi smṛtiḥ api kvacid duśyate eva na ca sā tad śāyāvatī iti durāśā mātram etat nanu nirvikalpakena eva vastu sarva svam gṛhītam ekasya artha svabhāvasya iti varṇitam prativihitam etat gṛhīta grahaṇe api prāmāṇya anapāyāt

kiñca kim nirvikalpakena gṛhyate iti etat eva na jānīmaḥ bhavantaḥ nirvikalpasya viṣayam saṃpracakṣate sajātīya vijātīya parāvṛttam sva lakṣaṇam mahāsāmānyam anye tu sattām tad viṣayam viduḥ vāc rūpam apare tattvam prameyam tasya manvate kecid guṇa kriyā dravya jāti bheda ādi rūṣitam śabalam vastu manyante nirvikalpaka gocaram pratyakṣa viṣaye api etāḥ citram vipratipattayaḥ parokṣa arthe hi vimatiḥ pratyakṣeṇa upaśāmyati pratyakṣe hi samutpannā vimatiḥ kena śāmyati idam bhāti na bhāti iti saṃvid vipratipattiṣu para pratyāyane puṃsām śaraṇam śapatha uktayaḥ na tu śapatha śaraṇāḥ eva nirudyamam āsmahe mārga antareṇa api tat prameyam niścinumaḥ nirvikalpa anusāreṇa sa vikalpaka saṃbhavāt grāhyam tadā anuguṇyena nirvikalpasya manmahe

tatra na tāvat sakala sajātīya vyāvṛttam sva lakṣaṇam pratyakṣasya viṣayaḥ gṛhīte nirvikalpena vyāvṛtte hi sva lakṣaṇe akasmāt eva sāmānya vikalpa ullasanam katham nirvikalpa anusāreṇa hi vikalpāḥ prādurbhavitum arhanti api ca vijātīya parāvṛtta viṣayā yadi kalpanā vyāvṛtti rūpam sāmānyam gṛhītam hanta darśanaiḥ vyāvṛttān nanu na eva anyā vyāvṛttiḥ paramārthataḥ vyāvṛtta grahaṇena eva sutarām tad grahaḥ bhavet sāmānya grahaṇe api evam tad vyāpāra avakalpanāt sva lakṣaṇa pariccheda niṣṭham tat na avatiṣṭhate

na api sattā dvaita va ādi sammata satta ākhyaḥ nirvikalpasya viṣayaḥ yuktaḥ sattā grahaṇa pakṣe api viśeṣa avagatiḥ kutas sā bhāti bheda spṛṣṭā ced siddham advaita darśanam na ca bhedam vinā sattā gṛhītum api śakyate na avidyā mātram eva idam iti ca sthāpayiṣyate
vāc tattva pratibhāsaḥ api pratikṣiptaḥ anayā diśā katham ca cākṣuṣe jñāne vāc tattvam avabhāsate agṛhīte tu sambandhe gṛhīte vā api vismṛte aprabuddhe api saṃskāre vācaka avagatiḥ kutas

citra tā api pṛthak bhūtaiḥ dharmaiḥ tad samavāyibhiḥ jāti ādibhiḥ yadīṣyeta dharmiṇaḥ kāmam astu sā tad ātma tā tu na ekasya nityam tattva anupagrahāt aṃśa niṣkarṣa pakṣe tu dharma bhedaḥ balāt bhavet yatra yatra yadā udbhūtiḥ jighṛkṣā ca iti kathyate tad ātmaka tvam dharmāṇām ucyate ca iti asaṅgatam deśa bhedaḥ tu dharmāṇām asmābhiḥ api na iṣyate dharmī hi teṣām ādhāraḥ na punar sa tad ātmakaḥ

tasmāt yaḥ eva vastu ātmā sa vikalpasya gocaraḥ saḥ eva nirvikalpasya śabda ullekha vivarjitaḥ kimātmakaḥ asau iti ced yat yadā pratibhāsate vastu pramitayaḥ ca eva praṣṭavyāḥ na tu vādinaḥ kvacid jātiḥ kvacid dūvyam kvacid karma kvacid guṇaḥ yat eva sa vikalpena tat eva anena gṛhyate iha śabda anusandhāna mātram abhyadhikam param viṣaye na tu bhedaḥ asti sa vikalpa avikalpayoḥ atas śabda anusandhānavandhyam tad anubandhi vā jāti ādi viṣaya grāhi sarvam pratyakṣam iṣyate tasmāt yat kalpanā apoḍha padam pratyakṣa lakṣaṇe bhikṣuṇā paṭhitam tasya vyavacchedyam na vidyate

abhrānta padasya api vyāvartyam na kiṃcana tad mate paśyāmaḥ nanu timiraḥ āśu bhramaṇa nauyāna saṃkṣobha ādi āhita vibhramam dvi candra alāta cakra calat pādapa ādi darśanam apohyam asya paraiḥ uktam satyam uktam ayuktam tu kalpanā apoḍha padena eva tad vyudāsa siddheḥ tatra api nirvikalpakam jñānam eka candra ādi viṣayam eva vikalpāḥ tu viparīta ākāra grāhiṇaḥ bhavanti yathā marīci grāhiṇi nirvikalpake salila avasāyī vikalpaḥ iti

nanu timireṇa dvidhā akṛtam cakṣuḥ ekatayā na śaknoti śaśitam grahītum iti nirvikalpakam api dvi candra ādi jñānam yadi evam tarala taraṅga ādi sādṛśya rūṣitam ūṣare marīci cakram cakṣuṣā paricchettum aśakyam iti tatra api nirvikalpakam udaka grāhi vijñānam kim iti na iṣyate abhyupagame vā sat asat kalpana utpāta ādi kṛtaḥ pramāṇa itara vyavahāraḥ na syāt

api ca na bādhaka upanipātam antareṇa bhrānta tā avakalpate jñānānām na ca kṣaṇika vādi mate vādhya bādhaka bhāvaḥ buddhīnām upapadyate iti alam vimardena iti su nipuṇa buddhiḥ lakṣaṇam vaktu kāmaḥ pada yugalam api idam nirmame na anavadyam bhavatu mati mahimnaḥ ceṣṭitam dṛṣṭam etat jagat abhibhava dhīram dhīmataḥ dharma kīrteḥ
śrotra ādi vṛttiḥ aparaiḥ avikalpaka iti pratyakṣa lakṣaṇam avarṇi tat api apāstam sāmya at nayasya na ca siddhyati buddhi vṛttyā draṣṭṛ tvam ātmanaḥ iti pratipāditam prāk

sat saṃprayoge puruṣasya indriyāṇām buddhi janma tad pratyakṣam animittam vidyamāna upalaṃbhana tvāt iti etat sūtram jaiminīyaiḥ sākṣāt pratyakṣa lakṣaṇa paratvena na vyākhyātam codanā lakṣaṇaḥ arthaḥ dharmaḥ iti prakṛta pratijñā saṅgatyabhāvāt api tu dharmam prati pratyakṣam animittam evam lakṣaṇaka tvāt iti anuvāda bhaṅgyā lakṣaṇe yojitam yathā uktam evam sati anuvāda tvam lakṣaṇasya api saṃbhavet iti tad etad lakṣaṇa varṇane sūtra yojanam asamīcīnam ati vyāpti doṣān ativṛtteḥ tathā hi indriyāṇām sati saṃprayoge puruṣasya jāyamānā buddhiḥ pratyakṣam iti sūtra arthaḥ tathā ca ati vyāptiḥ saṃśaya viparyaya buddhyoḥ api indriya saṃyoga ja tvena pratyakṣa tva prasaṅgāt

atha sat saṃprayogaḥ iti satām saṃprayogaḥ iti vyākhyāsyate tathā api nirālambana vibhramāḥ eva artha nirapekṣa janmānaḥ nirastāḥ bhaveyuḥ na sa ālambanau saṃśaya viparyayau atha sati saṃprayogaḥ iti saptamī pakṣaḥ eva na tyajyate saṃśaya viparyaya chedī ca saṃprayogaḥ iti upasargaḥ varṇyate yathā uktam samyak arthe ca saṃśabdaḥ duṣprayoga nivāraṇaḥ duṣṭa tvāt śuktikā yogaḥ vāryatāmakṣaja īkṣaṇāt iti

tathā api prayoga samyaktvasya atīndriya tvena pratyakṣa anavagamya tvāt kāryataḥ avagatiḥ vaktavyā kāryam ca jñānam na ca tat aviśeṣitam eva prayogasya samyak tām avagamayati na ca tad viśeṣaṇa param iha padam api akṣaram api mātrām api vā sūtre paśyāmaḥ satām saṃprayogaḥ iti ca padam nirālambana jñāna nivṛttaye varṇitam sati iti tu sati saptamya eva gata artha tvāt anarthakam lokataḥ eva kārya viśeṣa avagamāt prayoga samyak tvam avagamiṣyāmaḥ iti ced lokataḥ eva pratyakṣasya siddha tvāt kim tad lakṣaṇe sūtra sāmarthya yojana ākleśena

yat api atra bhagavān vṛtti kāraḥ prāha yat pratyakṣam na tat vyabhicarati yat vyabhicāri na tat pratyakṣam kim tarhi pratyakṣam tad saṃprayoge puruṣasya indriyāṇām buddhi janma sat pratyakṣam yat viṣayam jñānam tena eva saṃprayoge indriyāṇām puruṣasya buddhi janma sat pratyakṣam yat anya viṣayakam jñānam anya saṃprayoge bhavati na tat pratyakṣam iti iti evam tad satoḥ vyatyayena lakṣaṇam anapavādam avakalpate iti tat api vṛthā aṭāṭyā mātram saṃśaya jñānena vyabhicāra anativṛtteḥ tatra hi yat viṣayam jñānam tena saṃprayogaḥ indriyāṇām asti eva

nanu ubhaya viṣayam jñānam na ca ubhābhyām saṃprayuktam indriyam mā evam na hi dhava khadira vat dvau api saṃśaya saṃvidi pratibhāsete kim tu sthāṇuḥ vā puruṣaḥ vā iti anirdhārita ekatara padārtha tattva avamarśī saṃśayaḥ jāyate nūnam ca tayoḥ anyatareṇa indriyam saṃprayuktam eva iti ubhaya avamarśi tvāt ca saṃśayasya yena saṃprayuktam cakṣuḥ tad viṣayam api tat jñānam bhavati eva iti na ati vyāptiḥ parihṛtā bhavati

atha brūyuḥ kim anena parikleśena na lakṣaṇa varṇanam asmākam abhimatam anuvāda pakṣa nikṣipta tvāt api tu loka prasiddha pratyakṣa anuvādena dharmam pratyanimitta tvam eva vidhīyate na dharmam prati pramāṇam pratyakṣam vidyamāna upalaṃbhana tvāt vidyamāna artha grāhi tvāt iti arthaḥ dharmaḥ ca na vartamānaḥ tri kālān avacchinnasya tasya yajeta dadyāt juhuyāt ityādi śabdebhyaḥ pratīteḥ

tarhi sat saṃprayoge puruṣasya indriyāṇām buddhi janma tat pratyakṣam iti kimarthaḥ granthaḥ iti ced na vidyamāna upalaṃbhana samarthana artha tvāt yadi vidyamāna upalaṃbhana tvam asiddham iti paraḥ brūyāt sa vaktavyaḥ vidyamāna upalaṃbhanam pratyakṣam sat saṃprayoga ja tvāt iti pratyakṣa grahaṇam api hetu nirdeśa artham eva sat saṃprayogasya asiddha tām bruvan anena pratyākhyāyate sat saṃprayoga jam pratyakṣam pratyakṣa tvāt iti tat uktam pratyakṣa tvam adohetuḥ śeṣam hetu prasiddhaye iti svātantryeṇa api pratyakṣa tvam dharma grāhaka tva niṣedhāya vaktavyam na dharma grāhi pratyakṣam pratyakṣa tvāt asmad ādi pratyakṣa vat iti evam anyatra eva sūtra tātparyāt na ati vyāpti ādi doṣa avasaraḥ iha iti

tat etat api na prāmāṇika manaḥ anukūlam katarasya pratyakṣasya dharmam pratyanimitta tvam pratipādyate kim asmad ādi pratyakṣasya yogi pratyakṣasya vā tatra asmad ādi pratyakṣasya tathātve sarveṣām avivādaḥ eva iti kim tatra iya tā śrameṇa yogi pratyakṣasya tu bhavatām asiddha tvāt kasya dharmam pratyanimitta tva pratipādanam

evam ca dharmiṇaḥ abhāvāt āśraya asiddha tām spṛśet vidyamāna upalaṃbha tva pratyakṣa tva ādi sādhanam para prasiddhyā tad siddhiḥ iti ced kā iyam prasiddhiḥ nāma pramāṇa mūlā tad viparītā vā ādye pakṣe pramāṇasya apakṣa pāti tvāt parasya iva tava api siddhiḥ bhavatu apramāṇa mūla tve tuna kasyacid aṣi asau prasiddhiḥ

yogi jñānam pareṣām yat siddham tad anubhāṣaṇe pratijñāpadayoḥ eva vyāghātaḥ te prasajyate paraiḥ hi dharma grāhi yogi jñānam abhyupagatam atas tad anubhāṣaṇe dharma grāhakam na dharma grāhakam iti uktam syāt para saṃsiddha mūlam ca na anumānam prakalpate uktam bhavadbhiḥ eva idam nirālambana dūṣaṇe sādhya siddhiḥ yathā na asti para siddhena hetunā tathā eva dharmi siddha tvam para siddhyā na yujyate

tatra etat syāt prasaṅga sādhanam idam prasaṅgaḥ ca nāma para siddhena parasya aniṣṭa āpādanam ucyate parasya ca vidyamāna upalaṃbhanam sat saṃprayoga janyam ca pratyakṣam siddham atas tena eva hetunā dharma animitta tvam tasya upapādyate iti kaḥ doṣaḥ na etat evam prasaṅga sādhanam nāma na asti eva paramārthataḥ tat hi kuḍyam vinā tatra citrakarmā iva lakṣyate

na hi nabhaḥ kusumasya saurabhā saurabha vicāraḥ yuktaḥ atha api kim na etena bhavatu evam prasaṅga sādhanam tat api tu vyāpti mūlam bhavati na ca saṃbhavati vyāpti pratītiḥ iha mādṛśām na dharma grāhi sarveṣām pratyakṣam iti vetti kaḥ mad pratyakṣam akṣamam dharma grahaṇaḥ iti bhavān na jānīte tvad pratyakṣam api na dharma grāhi iti na aham jāne anyasya pratyakṣam īdṛśam eva iti ubhau api āvām na jānīvahe

tvayā tu yadi sarveṣām pratyakṣam jñātam īdṛśam tarhi tvam eva yogī iti yoginaḥ dvekṣi kim vṛthā prāmāṇika sthitim tasmāt ittham śrotriya budhyase para ukte atīndriye hi arthe mā vādīḥ dūṣaṇam punar pramāṇa siddhe hata śakti dūṣaṇam pramāṇa śūnye api vṛthā tad uktayaḥ nirasya codya vyasanam tu mṛgyatām atīndriye vastuni sādhanam punar sa ced paryanuyuktaḥ san vaktum śaknoti sādhanam om iti pratipattavyam no ced na asti eva tasya tat

āha śikṣitāḥ smaḥ prāmāṇika vṛttam na dūṣaṇam brūmaḥ bhavantam eva anuyuñjmahe tat ā itarhi kathyatām dharma adhigama nipuṇa yogi pratyakṣa siddhau kim pramāṇam iti idam ucyate darśana atiśayaḥ eva pramāṇam tathā hi asmad ādiḥ apekṣitālokaḥ avalokayati nikaṭa sthitam artha bṛndam unduru vairiṇaḥ tu sāndratama tamaḥ paṅka paṭala vilipta deśa patitam api saṃpaśyanti saṃpāti nāmā ca gṛdhra rājaḥ yojana śata vyavahitām api daśaratha nandana sundarīm dadarśa iti śrūyate rāmāyaṇe saḥ ayam darśana atiśayaḥ śukla ādi guṇa atiśayaḥ iva tāratamya samanvitaḥ iti gamayati param api niratiśayam atiśayam atas ca yatra asya paraḥ prakarṣaḥ te yoginaḥ gīyante darśanasya ca paraḥ atiśayaḥ sūkṣma vyavahita viprakṛṣṭa bhūta bhaviṣyat ādi viṣaya tvam

nanu sva viṣaya anatikrameṇa bhavatu tad atiśaya kalpanā dharmaḥ tu cakṣuṣaḥ na viṣayaḥ eva tat uktam yatra api atiśayaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ sa sva artha an atilaṅghanāt dūra sūkṣma ādi dṛṣṭau syāt na rūpe śrotra vṛtti tā api ca ye api ca atiśayāḥ dṛṣṭāḥ prajñā medhā balaiḥ nṛṇām stoka stoka antara tvena na tu ati indriya darśanāt iti etat ayuktam yatas yadi api na asmad ādi nayana viṣayaḥ dharmaḥ tathā api yogi indriya gamyaḥ bhaviṣyati tathā hi yojana śata vyavahitam andhakāra antaritam vā na asmad ādi locana gocara tām upayāti saṃpāti pṛṣa d aṃśa dṛśoḥ tu viṣayaḥ bhavati eva

nanu evam aviṣaye pravṛttam yoginām cakṣuḥ gandha rasa ādīn api gṛhṇīyāt yathā uktam ekena tu pramāṇena sarvajñaḥ yena kalpyate nūnam sa cakṣuṣā sarvān rasa ādīn pratipadyate iti na etat evam rasa ādi grāhīṇi api yoginām indriyāṇi cakṣuḥ vat atiśayavanti eva iti na rasa ādiṣu cakṣuḥ vyāpāraḥ parikalpyate dharme api na tarhi kalpanīyaḥ iti ced na tasya rasa ādi vat tad aviṣaya tva abhāvāt

api ca yogi indriya aviṣaya tvam dharmasya katham avagatavān bhavān aviṣaya tvam tad bhāve api tad anavagamāt avagamyate yathā nayana sadbhāve api śabda aśravaṇāt tad aviṣaya tā śabdasya avasīyate na ca evam yogi cakṣuṣi sati api dharmasya agrahaṇam avagantum śaknoti bhavān ubhayasya api bhavataḥ parokṣa tvāt iti aviṣayassa tasya iti na te vaktum yuktam iti
nanu kartavyatā rūpaḥ tri kāla sparśa varjitaḥ cakṣuḥ viṣaya tām eti dharmaḥ iti ati sāhasam satyam sāhasam etat te mama vā carmacakṣuṣaḥ na tu eṣa durgamaḥ panthāḥ yoginām sarva darśinām

yat ca tri kālān avacchinnaḥ yajeta iti ādiliṅā ādi yukta śabda eka śaraṇa avagamaḥ dharmaḥ katham tatas anyena pramāṇena paricchidyatām iti ucyate tat api prakriyā mātram kim iva hi tri kāla sparśa asparśābhyām kṛtyam yathā vayam gamana ādi kriyāṇām deśa antara prāpti ādi prayojana tām jānīmaḥ tathā agnihotra ādi kriyāṇām svarga ādi phala tām jñāsyanti yoginaḥ iti kim atra sāhasam

yadi hi bāhya indriyeṣu amarṣaḥ na teṣu atiśayaḥ viṣahyate tat alam anubandhena manaḥ karaṇakam jñānam bhāvanā abhyāsa saṃbhavam bhavati dhyāyatām dharme kāntā ādau iva kāminām manaḥ hi sarva viṣayam na tasya aviṣayaḥ kaścid asti abhyāsa vaśāt ca atīndriyeṣu api artheṣu parisphuṭāḥ pratibhāsāḥ prādurbhavantaḥ dṛśyante yathā aahuḥ kāma śoka āmaya unmāda cora svaprādi upadrutāḥ abhūtān api paśyanti puratas avasthitān iva

nanu eteṣām mithyājñāna tvāt na yogi vijñāne dṛṣṭānta tvam yuktam na sphuṭa ābabhāsa mātra tayā dṛṣṭānta tva upapatteḥ na hi śabda ghaṭayoḥ api sarva ātmanā atulya tvam tatra kāma śoka ādi bhāvanā abhyāsa bhuvām pratibhāsānām bādhaka vaidhuryāt aprāmāṇyam bhaviṣyati na itareṣām tad abhāvāt sphuṭa ābhāsa tvam tu ubhayatra api tulyam

nanu abhyāsaḥ api kriyamāṇaḥ na atyantam apūrvam atiśayam āvahati laṅghana abhyāsa vat yaḥ api hi pratidinam ananya karmā laṅghanam abhyasyati saḥ api katipaya pada parimitam avani talam abhilaṅghayati na tu parvatam ambudhim vā iti ucyate laṅghanam deha dharma tvāt kapha jāḍya ādi saṃbhavāt mā gāt prakarṣam jñāne tu tasya kaḥ pratibandhakaḥ laṅghana ādau tu pūrvedyus prayatna samupārjitaḥ na dehe atiśayaḥ kaścid anyedyus avatiṣṭhate tatra kevalam abhyāsāt prakṣaye kapha medasoḥ śarīra lāghavam labdhvā laṅghayanti yathocitam iha vijñāna janyaḥ tu saṃskāraḥ vyavatiṣṭhate krama upacīyamānaḥ asau para atiśaya kāraṇam yathā anuvāka grahaṇe saṃsthā abhyasana kalpitaḥ sthiraḥ karoti saṃskāraḥ pāṭha smṛti ādi pāṭavam yathā vā puṭapākena śodhyamānam śanaiśśanais hema niṣpratikāśam tat yāti

kalyāṇa tām parām tathā eva bhāvanā abhyāsāt yoginām api mānasam jñānam sakala vijñeya sākṣātkāra kṣamam bhavet asmad ādeḥ ca rāga ādi mala āvaraṇa dhūsaram manaḥ na labhate jñāna prakarṣa padavīm parām pratyaham bhāvanā abhyāsa kṣapita aśeṣa kalmaṣam yoginām tu manaḥ śuddham kam iva artham na paśyati yathā ca teṣām rāga ādi prahāṇam avakalpate tathā apavarga cintāyām vistareṇa abhidhāsyate tat evam kṣīṇa doṣāṇām dhyāna avahita cetasām nirmalam sarva viṣayam jñānam bhavati yoginām

api ca anāgata jñānam asmad ādeḥ api kvacid pramāṇam prātibham śvas me bhrātā aagantā iti dṛśyate na anartha jam na sandigdham na bādha vidhurīkṛtam na duṣṭa kāraṇam ca iti pramāṇam idam iṣyatām kvacid vādhaka yogaḥ ced astu tasya apramāṇa tā yatra aparedyus abhyeti bhrātā tatra kim ucyatām kākatālīyam iti ced na pramāṇa pradarśitam vastu tad kākatālīyam iti śaṅkitum arhati

nanu anartha jam idam jñānam bhrātuḥ tad janakasya tadānīm asattvāt syāt etat evam yadi tadā astitvena bhrātaram gṛhṇīyāt kintu bhāvinam enam gṛhṇāti bhāvi tvam ca tadā asya asti eva iti katham anartha jam tat jñānam nanu bhāvitayā grahaṇam aghaṭamānam bhāvi tvam hi nāma sa avadhiḥ prāc abhāvaḥ abhāvasya ca bhāvena bhrātrā saha kaḥ sambandhaḥ vastu avastunoḥ virodhāt tat etat asamyak tad deśa sambandhasya tatra prāc abhāvaḥ na tu dharmiṇaḥ sa hi vidyate eva prāc avagataḥ sa ca kutaścid bhojana utkaṇṭha ādeḥ kāraṇāt smaraṇa padavīm upārūḍhaḥ śvastana āgamana viśiṣṭa tvena pratibhāti iti prātibhasya saḥ eva janakaḥ iti tasmāt anartha jatvā abhāvāt pramāṇam prātibham pramāṇam ca sat pratyakṣam eva na pramāṇa antaram śabda liṅga sārūpya nimitta anapekṣa tvāt

nanu pratyakṣam api mā bhūt indriya anapekṣa tvāt mā evam manasaḥ eva tatra indriya tvāt pūrva utpanna cākṣuṣa vijñāna viśeṣaṇasya bāhyasya vastunaḥ manaḥ grāhakam iti na andhādya bhāvaḥ iti uktam śabda ādi upāya antara viratau ca jāyamānam anavadyam jñānam mānasam pratyakṣam bhavati surabhi ketaka kusumam madhurā śarkarā iti jñāna vat iti api uktam atas eva na aniyata nimittakam jñānam pratibhā iti vaktavyam pratyakṣa nimitta tvāt

na ca ārṣam nāma jñānam pratibhā pratyakṣa atiriktasya ārṣa nāmnaḥ pratyayasya abhāvāt ṛṣīṇām api yat jñānam tat api āgama pūrvakam iti hi vadanti āgama grahaṇam ca nidarśana artham anupāyasya jñānasya teṣām asattvāt
na ca siddha darśanam pratibhā asmad ādeḥ api bhāvāt tasmāt na pramāṇa antaram prātibham api tu pratyakṣam eva

nanu pratyakṣam api na idam bhavati tat hi vartamāna eka viṣayam yathā uktam saṃbaddham vartamānam ca gṛhyate cakṣuḥ ādinā iti tathā eṣa pratyakṣa dharmaḥ ca vartamāna artha tā eva yat iti ca mā evam anāgata grāhiṇaḥ pratyakṣasya pradeśa antare svayam eva ukta tvāt rajatam gṛhyamāṇam hi cira sthāyi iti gṛhyata iiti ca bhavān eva avocat tasmāt pratyakṣam anāgata grāhi śvas me bhrātā aagantā iti siddham evañca asmad ādīnām iva anāgate bhrātari yoginām bhaviṣyati dharme pratyakṣam pravartsyati iti tasmāt yat sarvajña niṣadhāya kathyate yat jātīyaiḥ pramāṇaiḥ tu yat jātīya artha darśanam bhavet idānīm lokasya tathā kāla antare api abhūt iti tad apāstam bhavati

tatra etat syāt sarvajña tā yoginām kim ekena jñānena bahubhiḥ vā na tāvat ekena na hi ekasmin jñāne paraspara virodhinaḥ arthāḥ śīta uṣṇa vat avabhāsante na api bahubhi tāni hi krameṇa vā bhaveyuḥ yugapad vā na yugapad jñānāni saṃbhavanti sūkṣma antaḥkaraṇa sāpekṣa tvāt krama bhāvibhiḥ tu jñānaiḥ aśeṣa tribhuvana kuhara nihita nikhila padārtha sārtha sākṣāt karaṇam eṣām manvantara koṭibhiḥ api durghaṭam iti katham sarva jñāḥ yoginaḥ

ucyate yugapad ekayā eva buddhyā sarvatra sarvān arthān drakṣyanti yoginaḥ yat tu viruddha tvāt iti tad aprayojakam viruddhānām api nīla pīta ādīnām ekatra citra pratyaye avabhāsanāt ekatra ca mecaka pratyaye sannihita padārtha vyatirikta sakala vastu abhāva grahaṇasya pūrvam darśita tvāt śīta uṣṇayoḥ api kvacid avasare bhavati yugapad upalaṃbhaḥ tat yathā pratapati hutavaha visphuliṅga nikara anukāri kiraṇe taruṇa ūṣmaṇi grīṣme himaśakala śiśira payasi sarasi nimagna tā abhidaghna dehasya puṃsaḥ yugapad eva saras salila sūrya ātapa vartinau śīta uṣṇa sparśau anubhava patham avata rataḥ

nanu ekena jñānena sarvān arthān bhūta bhāvinaḥ parokṣān api paśyantaḥ yoginaḥ katham akhila trailokya vṛttānta darśinaḥ sakala jagadguroḥ īśvarāt viśiṣyeran asti viśeṣaḥ īśvarasya tathāvidham nityam eva jñānam yoginām tu yoga bhāvanā abhyāsa prabhavam iti

nanu na adṛṣṭa pūrve arthe kvacid bhavati bhāvanā āgamāt tu paricchinne dharme bhāvanayā api kim codanā eva dharme pramāṇam iti sa avadhāraṇa pratijñā arthaḥ prathamam āgamāt avagata dharma svarūpeṣu satsu api yogiṣu na viplavataḥ eva iti ucyate yogiṣu asti eva ayam prakāraḥ paścāt api pravartamāne dharma grāhiṇi pratyakṣe codanā eva iti avadhāraṇam śithilībhavati eva api ca īśvara jñānam sāṃsiddhikam eva dharma viṣayam vedasya kāraṇa bhūtam vakṣyāmaḥ tasmin api sati na codanā eva iti avadhāraṇa artha siddhiḥ

tasmāt na dharma grāhakam yogi pratyakṣam vidyamāna upalambhana tvāt sat saṃprayoga ja tvāt ityādi sādhanam aprayojakam pramāṇa antara vijñāta prameya pratipādakaḥ dharma upadeśakaḥ śabdaḥ śabda tvāt ghaṭa śabda vat pratyakṣaḥ kasyacid dharmaḥ prameya tvāt ghaṭa ādi vat ityādayaḥ ca sulabhāḥ santi eva pratihetavaḥ tena niṣpratigha yukti sādhitām yoga buddhim akhila artha darśinīm kim viḍambayitum ucyate mudhā duṣṭa hetu nikurumba śambaram tat ittham api jaiminīyam sūtram asaṅgatā artham lakṣaṇa paratvam tu asya nirastam eva

yat api kaiścid pratyakṣa lakṣaṇa m uktam ātma indriya manaḥ artha sannikarṣāt yat utpadyate jñānam tad anyat anumāna ādibhyaḥ pratyakṣam iti tat api traya dvaya sannikarṣa janmanām sukha ātma ādi jñānānām avyāpakam ati vyāpakam ca vyabhicārya ādi bodhānām iti upekṣaṇīyam
īśvara kṛṣṇaḥ tu prativiṣaya adhyavasāyaḥ dṛṣṭam iti pratyakṣa lakṣaṇam avocat tat api na manojñam anumāna ādi jñānānām api viṣaya adhyavasāya svabhāva tvena ati vyāpteḥ

yat tu rājā vyākhyātavān pratirābhi mukhye vartate tena ābhimukhyena viṣaya adhyavasāyaḥ pratyakṣam iti tat api anumāna ādau asti eva ghaṭaḥ ayam iti vat agnimān parvataḥ iti ābhimukhyena eva pratīteḥ spaṣṭa tā tu sarva saṃvidām sva viṣaye vidyate evam

atha manyase sāmānya vihitasya viśeṣeṇa bādhāt anumāna ādi vyāvṛttiḥ setsyati sāmānyena adhyavasāyaḥ utsṛṣṭaḥ sa liṅga śabdābhyām viśeṣitaḥ iti tad itaraḥ adhyavasāyaḥ pratyakṣam iti sthāsyati yadi evam pratyakṣa lakṣaṇam idānīm avyākaraṇīyam eva śabda liṅga grahaṇe varṇite sati tad vailakṣaṇyāt eva pratyakṣam jñāsyate iti tasmāt indriya artha sannikarṣa pada upādānam antareṇa na anumāna ādi vyavacchedaḥ upapadyate iti idam api na pratyakṣa lakṣaṇam anavadyam alam ati vistareṇa para darśana gītam atas vigata kalaṅkam asti na hi lakṣaṇam akṣa dhiyaḥ tad alam akṣa pāda muninā eva nibaddham idam harati manāṃsi lakṣaṇam udāra dhiyām

tad pūrvakam ca trividham anumānam pūrvavat śeṣavat sāmānyatas dṛṣṭam ca evam pramāṇa jyeṣṭhe asmin pratyakṣe lakṣite sati kathyate avasara prāptam anumānasya lakṣaṇam tatra anumāna svarūpam brūmahe tatas tatra sūtram yojayiṣyāmaḥ pañca lakṣaṇa kāt liṅgāt gṛhītān niyama smṛteḥ parokṣe liṅgini jñānam anumānam pracakṣate atra api liṅga viṣayam jñānam jñāna viṣayīkṛtam vā liṅgam pratibandha smaraṇa sahitam pramāṇam liṅgi jñānam phalam liṅgi jñānasya vā pramāṇa tāyām pūrvavat upādānādi jñānam phalam upavarṇanīyam karaṇasya hi pramāṇa tvam iti sthitam eva etat

tatra parokṣaḥ arthaḥ liṅgyate gamyate anena iti liṅgam tat ca pañca lakṣaṇam kāni punar pañca lakṣaṇāni pakṣa dharma tvam sa pakṣa dharma tvam vipakṣāt vyāvṛttiḥ avādhita viṣaya tvam asat pratipakṣa tvam ca iti siṣā dhayiṣita dharma viśiṣṭaḥ dharmī pakṣaḥ tad dharma tvam tad āśrita tvam iti arthaḥ sādhya dharma yogena nirjñātam dharmi antaram sa pakṣaḥ tatra astitvam sādhya saṃsparśa śūnyaḥ dharmī vipakṣaḥ tatas vyāvṛttiḥ anumeyasya arthasya pratyakṣeṇā aagamena vā anapaharaṇam avādhita viṣaya tvam saṃśaya bīja bhūtena arthena pratyanumāna tayā prayujyamānena anupahata tvam asat pratipakṣa tvam etaiḥ pañcabhiḥ lakṣaṇaiḥ upapannam liṅgam anumāpakam bhavati

eteṣām eva lakṣaṇānām ekaika apāyāt pañca hetvābhāsāḥ vakṣyante yasya pakṣa dharma tā na asti asau asiddhaḥ hetvābhāsaḥ yathā nityaḥ śabdaḥ cākṣuṣa tvāt sādhya viparyaya vyāptaḥ tu viruddhaḥ sa yathā nityaḥ śabdaḥ kṛtaka tvāt ākāśa vat vipakṣe asattvam yasya na asti saḥ anaikāntikaḥ yathā nityaḥ śabdaḥ prameya tvāt iti

yasya ābādhita viṣaya tvam na asti sa kāla atyaya apadiṣṭaḥ yathā anuṣṇaḥ tejaḥ avayavī kṛtaka tvāt ghaṭa vat iti yasya niṣpratipakṣatā na asti sa prakaraṇa samaḥ yathā anityaḥ śabdaḥ nitya dharma anupalabdheḥ ghaṭa vat nityaḥ śabdaḥ anitya dharma anupalabdheḥ ākāśa vat iti saḥ ayam eteṣu pañcasu lakṣaṇeṣu avinābhāvaḥ liṅgasya parisamāpyate
nanu tri lakṣaṇake hetau a vinābhāvaḥ parisamāpyate na ca tathāvidhe bādhā saṃbhavati bādhāvinā bhāvayoḥ virodhāt

yat ca idam agni anuṣṇa tva sādhane kṛtaka tvam tri lakṣaṇam api bādhaka vidhurita viṣayam iti udāhṛtam tat asamīkṣita abhidhānam atra trailakṣaṇya anupapatteḥ pakṣa dharmaḥ eva tāvat ayam na bhavati pratyakṣa ādi anirākṛtaḥ hi pakṣaḥ ucyate na ca ayam īdṛśaḥ iti apakṣaḥ eva tad dharmaḥ hetuḥ katham pakṣa dharmaḥ syāt

na api ayam anvayī hetuḥ anvaya grahaṇa samayaḥ eva tad viplava avadhāraṇāt anvayaḥ hi gṛhyamāṇaḥ sarva ākṣepeṇa yat yat kṛtakam tat tad anuṣṇam iti evam gṛhyate tatas ca tad grahaṇa samayaḥ eva ayam uṣṇaḥ api kṛtakaḥ iti hṛdaya patham avatarati tanūnapāt iti katham anvaya grahaṇam yadi tu analam utsṛjya ghaṭa ādau anvaya grahaḥ na antar vyāptiḥ gṛhītā syāt sādhya sādhana dharmayoḥ tatas ca īvaṃvidhāt hetoḥ sva sādhya niyama ujjhitāt sādhya abhilāṣaḥ iti evam ṣaṇḍa anunaya doha daḥ

anvaya pūrvaka tvāt ca vyatireka grahaṇasya tad nirākaraṇe tad apākaraṇam avagantavyam api ca siṣādhayita dharma vaiparītyena vahneḥ pratyakṣataḥ niścayāt vastu vṛtta na saḥ eva vipakṣaḥ iti na tatas vyatirekaḥ kṛtaka tvasya iti tasmāt trelakṣaṇya apāyāt eva hetvābhāsaḥ ayam iti na rūpa antaram abādhita viṣaya tvam apekṣate

katham ca idam abādhita tvam niścīyate na hi adarśana mātreṇa bādhā viraha niḥ cayaḥ sarva ātmanā hi nāstitvam vidyuḥ katham ayoginaḥ aniścite tad aṅge ca na hetoḥ hetu tā bhavet yathā eva pakṣa dharma ādi rūpāṇām anupagrahe tasmāt abādhita tvam rūpa antaram avacanīyam iti

atra abhidhīyate yat uktam anvaya grahaṇam sarva ākṣepeṇa iti tad grahaṇa velāyām eva siṣā dhayiṣita dharma viparyaya adhyāsita hutavaha svarūpa parisphuraṇāt anvaya śūnyaḥ ayam hetuḥ iti tad ahṛdayaṅgamam anvayaḥ satyam sarva ākṣepeṇa gṛhyate na punar eka eka dharmi samullekhena evam hi tad ānantyāt anvayaḥ gṛhītum eva na śakyeta anumānasya ca vaiphalyam ittham bhavet agnimatām dhūmavatām sarva dharmāṇām anvaya avagama kāle eva gṛhīta tvāt

dhūmaḥ hi yatra yatra iti sāmānyena eva gṛhyate na punar parvate araṇye gṛhe vā iti evam iṣyate evañca satya ākṣepa vācaḥ yuktiḥ upapannā bhaviṣyati na ca evam sati vaktavyam ṣaṇḍa anunaya mārgaṇam na hi tat varjam iti evam vyāpti grahaṇam iṣyate sāmānyena ca vyāptiḥ gṛhītā satī siṣā dhayiṣita dharmī apekṣayā sā eva antar vyāptiḥ ucyate yā eva ca naga lagna agni anumāna samaye tad vyatirikta kāntāra ādi pradeśa vartinī bahis vyāptiḥ abhūt sā eva kāla antare kāntāra vartini vahnau anumīyamāne antar vyāptiḥ avatiṣṭhate tat iha api yat kṛtakam tat anuṣṇam iti sāmānyatas paricchedāt na tadānīm anala unmeṣaḥ iti siddhaḥ anvayaḥ

vyatirekaḥ api kārye tejaḥ avayavini pakṣīkṛte kṛtaka tvasya tejaḥ paramāṇubhyaḥ vidhu tāraka paramāṇu anabhyupagame tu vipakṣaḥ eva na asti iti tad abhāvāt sutarām tatra āvṛttiḥ bhavati iti na hi sa pakṣaḥ iva vipakṣe vṛttiḥ iṣyate yena yatnatas tad siddhaye yateta agniḥ eva vipakṣaḥ iti ced mā evam na hi pakṣaḥ eva vipakṣaḥ bhavitum arhati

nanu vastūnāmat virūpa tvāt pakṣaḥ nāma paramārthataḥ na asti eva sādhya dharma adhikaraṇa bhūtaḥ ced saḥ arthaḥ tat sapakṣaḥ eva viparyaye tu na vipakṣatām ativartate na ca krama dvaya yogi tvam rūpa dvaya rahita tvam vā vastunaḥ samasti iti

tat ayuktam anumāna uccheda prasaṅgāt advirūpa tve api vastūnām nisarga viṣayīkṛtaḥ arthaḥ kaścid pakṣe eṣitavyaḥ tad abhāve tad apekṣa svarūpayoḥ sa pakṣa vipakṣayoḥ api abhāvaḥ syāt tat asya pakṣasya sataḥ vipakṣa tvam āropya yat tena vyabhicāra codanam tena agni anumānam api viplaveta

nanu parvata ādiḥ dharmī na jvalana ākhya sādhya dharma śūnya tayā tatra niścitaḥ tejaḥ avayavī tu anuṣṇa tva vaiparītyena pratyakṣataḥ niścitaḥ iti tat kim idānīm parvata ādiḥ agni mat tayā niścitaḥ tathā abhyupagame vā kim anumānena

nanu na parvataḥ agni mattayā niścitaḥ na api tat vaiparītyena kintu sandigdhaḥ eva āste yadi evam sandigdhe api vipakṣe vartamānaḥ dhūmādiḥ ahetuḥ eva syāt niścita vipakṣa vṛtti vat sandigdha vipakṣa vṛtteḥ api ahetu tvāt sarvam anumānam utsīdet tasmāt pakṣeṇa vyabhicāra codanam anucitam iti vyatirekavān eva ayam hetuḥ

yat punar abhihitam anirākṛta pakṣa vṛtti tvam asya na asti iti tat satyam vayam api amum pakṣam adhyakṣa vādhitam icchāmaḥ eva sa tu na pakṣa mātra paryavasitaḥ bādhaḥ kintu hetum api spṛśati na hetu nirapekṣa ātmā pakṣaḥ nāma asti kaścana prasādhayitum iṣṭaḥ hi hetunā pakṣaḥ ucyate sa na sādhayitum śakyaḥ pratyakṣe pratiyogini sādhya apahāra dvāreṇa hetuḥ bhavati bādhitaḥ abādhita anumeya tvam atas eva asya lakṣaṇam na tu hetuḥ asiddhaḥ ayam jvalane vṛtti saṃbhavāt

yat tva bādhita tā jñātum śakyā na iti vikalpitam pakṣasya api mahābhāga katham tām pratipatsyase prayatne kriyamāṇe api yadi bādhā na dṛśyate na asti eva iti avagantavyam vyavahāraḥ hi na anyathā atas tri lakṣaṇe api hetau bādha saṃbhavāt abādhita tvam rūpa antaram vaktavyam evañca yat ucyate bādhāvinā bhāvayoḥ virodhāt iti tad kathañcid yuktam kathañcid ayuktam pañca lakṣaṇake liṅge yaḥ parisamāptaḥ avinābhāvaḥ tatra na asti eva bādhaḥ iti evam yuktam etat tri lakṣaṇa kaliṅga abhiprāyeṇa tu ayuktam iti
evam āgama bādhitaḥ api hetuḥ draṣṭavyaḥ yathā brāhmaṇena surā peyā aduṣṭa tvāt kṣīra vat iti

nanu pratyakṣa āgama viruddha vat anu māna viruddham anumānam kasmāt na udāhriyate asambhavāt iti brūmaḥ na hi anumāna viruddham anumānam avakalpate anumānayoḥ hi tulya balayoḥ bādhya bādhaka bhāvaḥ atulya balayoḥ vā tatra tulya balayoḥ tulya bala tvāt eva na bādhya bādhaka bhāvaḥ samāne hi vīrye kim kasya bādhakam bādhyam vā atulya bala tva pakṣe api yat kṛtam alpa bala tvam anyatarasya tatas eva tad aprāmāṇya siddheḥ kim anumāna bādhayā tasmāt na anumāna viruddham anumānam buddhyāmahe atas eva anumāna viruddham anumānam apaśyatā bhāṣya kāreṇa uktam yat punar anumānam pratyakṣa āgama viruddham nyāya ābhāsassaḥ iti
yatra tu tulya bale dve anumāne nipatataḥ sa sat pratipakṣasya viṣayaḥ iti asat pratipakṣa tvam pañcamam liṅga lakṣaṇam upadiśyate

nanu vastūnām advi rūpa tvāt katham ekatra dharmiṇi paraspara viruddha dharma dvaya ākṣepi prayojaka hetu dvaya sannipātaḥ bhavet atas eva viruddhā avyabhicārī nāma na hetvābhāse iha iṣyate tad ati durlabhaḥ sat pratipakṣaḥ hetuḥ iti kam apahartum pañcamam idam hetu lakṣaṇam upadiśyate iti satyam evam kintu saṃśaya bījam yat viśeṣa agrahaṇam tad anyatara nirṇayāya bhrāntyā prayujyamānam sat pratipadyate sthāṇuḥ ayam puruṣa dharma anupalabdheḥ puruṣaḥ ayam sthāṇu dharma anupalabdheḥ iti anyatara viṣaya anupalaṃbhaḥ eva ayam saṃśaya ādhāyī pakṣa dharma anvaya vyatireka upapatti bhrameṇa hetuḥ iti prayujyamānaḥ sat pratipakṣaḥ bhavati iti prakaraṇa sama hetvābhāsa cintāyām vistareṇa nirūpayiṣyate puruṣa prajñā pramāda mūla tvāt ca vastunaḥ dvi ātmaka tvam iti tatra eva vakṣyate lakṣaṇa antaram atas kathanīyam pratyaneka vikala tvam avaśyam tena liṅgam anumāna patha jñāḥ pañca lakṣaṇakam abhyupajagmuḥ

pañca lakṣakāt liṅgāt iti vyākhyātam vyāpti grahaṇa samaya samadhigata svarūpasya api liṅgasya punar dharmiṇi kvacid anavadhṛta vapuṣaḥ na asya adhyavasāya sādhana tvam iti dvitīyam liṅga darśanam eva apekṣaṇīyam iti gṛhītāt iti uktam liṅgam hi jñāpakam na cakṣuḥ ādi vat kārakam jñāpakasya ca ayam svabhāvaḥ yat jñātam anu jñāpayati iti vyāpti grahaṇa kāla gṛhītam eva vyāpti vat smaryamāṇa tathā eva liṅgam liṅginam gamayiṣyati iti ced na grahaṇam antareṇa vyāpti smṛteḥ api abhāvāt iti alam prasaṅgena
niyamasmṛteḥ iti vivriyatām kaḥ ayam niyamaḥ nāma vyāptiḥ avinābhāvaḥ nitya sāhacaryam iti arthaḥ
āha na etāvatī eva virantum ucitam tasya tad avinābhāvi tvam iti atra hi nimittam anveṣaṇīyam tārkikaiḥ

tat ca tādātmya tad utpatti rūpam īkṣitavantaḥ bhikṣavaḥ yaḥ hi yadātmā bhāvaḥ sa katham tam utsṛjati vṛkṣa ātmikā eva hi śiṃśapā tena vṛkṣa tvam anumāpayati saḥ ayam svabhāva hetuḥ ucyate vṛkṣaḥ ayam śiṃśapā tvāt iti tatra tādātmyam pratibandhaḥ kāryam nāma kāraṇa adhīna ātma lābham eva bhavati na kāraṇa anapekṣam iti tat upalabhyamānam tat anumāpayati agniḥ atra dhūmāt iti kārya hetau tad utpattiḥ pratibandhaḥ evam hi dvividham pratibandham anumeya avyabhicāra nibandhanam anuktvā kevala sāhacarya niyama mātra varṇanam yat pāda prasārikā sā eva iti

ucyate pāda prasārikā eva sādhīyasī sthūla dṛṣṭibhiḥ avalambitāḥ varam na sūkṣma dṛṣṭibhiḥ utprekṣitāḥ tādātmya ādi pratibandhāḥ tādātmye tāvat gamaka aṅge hetu sādhyayoḥ avyatireke gamya gamaka bhāvaḥ eva durupapādaḥ na khalu a gṛhītam liṅgam liṅgi pratītim ādhātum arhati tatra liṅga buddhau liṅgī pratibhāsate na vā apratibhāse tad vuddhyā tad agrahaṇāt katham tasya tad ātmaka tvam pratibhāse tu liṅga vat pratyakṣaḥ eva saḥ arthaḥ iti kim anumānena

viparīta samāropa vyavaccheda artham anumānam iti ced tad svarūpa grahaṇe viparīta āropaṇa avasara abhāvāt na hi śiraḥ pāṇi ādi viśeṣa darśane sati sthāṇu samāropaḥ pravartate tatra tad bhedāt upapadyeta api na hi śiraḥ pāṇi ādayaḥ eva puruṣaḥ iti tad grahaṇe api apuruṣa āropaḥ kāmam bhavet iha vṛkṣa tva śiṃśapā tvayoḥ abhedāt śiṃśapātu agrahaṇe sati kā kathā vṛkṣa itara samāropasya

api ca vṛkṣa tva grahaṇe sati sāmānya dharma grahaṇāt viśeṣa an adhyavasāyāt kadācid aśiṃśapa āropaḥ syāt na tu śiṃśapātu agrahaṇe sati avṛkṣatva samāropaḥ yuktaḥ pramātuḥ śiṃśapā tvam hi yasya pratyakṣa gocaraḥ parokṣam tasya vṛkṣa tvam iti na atīva laukikam kiñca sādhya sādhanayoḥ avyatirekāt yathā śiṃśapā tve ca vṛkṣa tvam anumīyate tathā vṛkṣa tvena api śiṃśapā tu am anumīyeta tādātmya aviśeṣāt tathā ca prayatna anantarīyaka tvena anitya tvam sādhyate tadvat anitya tvena api tat sādhyeta tatas ca sa pakṣa vyāpti avyāptibhyām kṛtaka tva prayatna ānantarīyaka tvayoḥ yaḥ bhedaḥ uktaḥ sa hīyeta

nanu ca anyaḥ saṃbandhaḥ anyaḥ ca pratibandhaḥ dviṣṭhaḥ saṃbandhaḥ pratibandhaḥ tu parāyat tatva lakṣaṇaḥ tatra śiṃśapā tvam vṛkṣa tve pratibaddham na vṛkṣa tvam śiṃśapā tve prayatna ānantarīyaka tvam api anitya tve niyatam na tu anitya tvam tatra iti tathā dhūmasya agnau pratibandhaḥ na tu agneḥ dhūme satyam evam kintu ā ivam ucyamāne niyamaḥ eva aṅgīkṛtaḥ bhavet na tādātmyam tādātmye hi yathā śiṃśapā śiṃśapām vinā na dṛśyate tathā vṛkṣa tvam api śiṃśapā rahitam na dṛśyeta dṛśyate ca khadira ādau śiṃśapā rahitam vṛkṣa tvam vidyut ādau ca prayatna ānantarīyaka tva rahitam anitya tvam upalabhyate iti katham abhedaḥ

vinā sādhana dharmeṇa sādhya dharmaḥ ayam asti hi dṛṣṭaḥ tad vyatirekeṇa tad ātmā ca iti kaitavam atha vidyut ādya nitya tvāt anyat eva ghaṭa ādi anitya tvam yat prayatna ānantarīyaka tva abhinnam ucyate tarhi dharmi bhedena dharmāṇām bhede anvaya grahaṇa anupapatteḥ sarvam anumānam utsīdet dhūma agnyoḥ tu kārya kāraṇayoḥ bhedāt yuktam vaktum dhūmasya agnau pratibandhaḥ na tu agneḥ dhūme iha tu sādhya sādhanayoḥ avyatirekāt na tathā śakyate vaktum tathā abhidhāne vā na avyatirekaḥ sarvathā tādātmyam vā tyajyatām vṛkṣa tva anitya tvābhyām śiṃśapātu aprayatna anantarīyaka tve vai anumīyatām na antarā avasthātum śakyate

yaḥ ca ayam anityaḥ śabdaḥ kṛtaka tvāt iti svabhāva hetuḥ udāhṛtaḥ sa katham svabhāva hetuḥ idam hi cintyatām anitya tvam nāma kim ucyate kim ca kṛtaka tvam iti tatra anitya tvam vināśa yogaḥ utpatti yogaḥ ca kṛtaka tvam utpannasya ca bhāvasya vināśaḥ na tu utpādaḥ eva vināśaḥ iti katham sādhya sādhanayoḥ avyatirekaḥ

atra codayanti vināśa yoge hi anitya tve vināśī śabdaḥ iti buddhiḥ syāt na anityaḥ iti eṣyā ca sā mithyā buddhiḥ śikhariṇaḥ iva kṛśa anu viśeṣitasya vināśavataḥ śabdasya gṛhītum aśakyatvāt abhāvena hi dharmeṇa tadvat tā dharmiṇaḥ katham abhāva graha velāyām dharmiṇaḥ anupalambhanāt anitya tvam iti ca bhāva pratyayaḥ katham abhāve bhavet viruddha tvāt tasmāt ubhayānta paricchinnā vastu sattā anitya tvam ucyatām kṛtaka tvam api sattā eva kāraṇa utpāditā dhārā satī kathyate iti evañca sattā eva sādhyam sādhanam ca iti siddham svabhāva hetu tvam

tat idam anupapannam sādhya sādhanayoḥ tathā tvena anavabhāsanāt evam hi ucyamāne śabdaḥ sattāvān sattāvat tvāt iti pratītiḥ syāt na ca evam dṛśyate api tu anityaḥ śabdaḥ kṛtaka tvāt iti atha ubhaya anta paricchinnā sattā sādhyā kāraṇa nirvartyā aaśraya samavāyinī ca sādhanam ucyate tat etat aghaṭamānam vināśa rūpasya antasya tadānīmavidyamāna tvena sattā paricchedaka tva abhāvāt buddhi sthena atha tena asyāḥ paricchedaḥ abhyupeyate śabdasya eva paricchedaḥ vināśena astu tādṛśā dharmaḥ samāna kālaḥ api buddhyā eva viṣayīkṛtaḥ tad viśeṣaṇa tām yāti tathā bhāvi api yāsyati tat evam vināśī śabdaḥ iti viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāva siddheḥ kim sattā sādhya kalpanayā

yat punar abhihitam abhāve bhāva pratyayaḥ tu atalādiḥ na syāt iti tad atyanta anabhijñasya codyam śabda pravṛtti nimittasya tatra bhāva pratyayena abhidhānāt tasya guṇasya hi bhāvāt dravye tad śabda niveśaḥ iti abhāve api abhāva tvam iti darśanāt tasmāt buddhi stha vināśa yogaḥ eva anitya tvam kṛtaka tvam api utpatti yogaḥ eva na sattā kāraṇa utpādita āśraya avacchede tu tasyāḥ iṣyamāṇe dharmiṇaḥ eva tad avacchedaḥ bhavatu iti kim sopāna antareṇa

nanu utpāda vināśa ākhyam na dharma dvayam anvayi yat haṭe na asti tat śabde yat ca śabde na tad haṭe atha ekaḥ eva dharmaḥ sarva bhāva saṃbandhī iṣyeta tarhi eka bhāva samutpāde sarva utpādaḥ prasajyate eka pralaya kāle ca sakala pralayaḥ bhavet tasmāt sattā pakṣaḥ eva varam

na etat evam dharmi bhede api dharmāṇām tulya rūpāṇām avabhāsāt na ghaṭa ādi svarūpam hi nāśaḥ iti avakalpate yena ananvaya doṣaḥ syāt tad bheda upanibandhanaḥ eka tvam api dharmasya na asti sarveṣu dharmiṣu yena eka dhvaṃsa samaye sakala dhvaṃsa saṅkaraḥ bhinna tve api ca dharmāṇām samāna rūpa tvena avabhāsamāna tvāt anvaya grahaṇa ādi kārya avirodhaḥ atas eva sāmānyam antareṇa api samāna dharma mūla anvaya ādi vyavahāra upapatteḥ tatra na sūtrakāreṇa sāmānya grahaṇam kṛtam api tu sādharmya grahaṇam upāttam udāharaṇa sādharmyāt sādhya sādhanam hetuḥ sādhya sādharmyāt tad dharma bhāvī dṛṣṭāntaḥ udāharaṇam iti tena vināśa utpāda dharmayoḥ sādhya sādhana bhāvāt tayoḥ ca bhedāt anityaḥ śabdaḥ kṛtaka tvāt iti na svabhāva hetuḥ iti siddham

kārya hetuḥ api na saṃbhavati bhavatām hi pakṣe kṣaṇayoḥ vā kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ bhavet santānayoḥ vā kṣaṇayoḥ na iti vakṣyāmaḥ kṣaṇa bhaṅga nirākṛtau saṃbhavan api durlakṣaḥ sūkṣma tvāt ca tayoḥ asau dhūma agni santānayoḥ tu avāstava tvāt eva na asti kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ artha kriyā kāritvam eva vastu tvam yadi dhūmaḥ kārya tvāt analam anumāpayet kaṭu malina gagana gāmi tva ādi dharmaiḥ api tasya gamakaḥ bhavet na ca kathañcid tad kārya tvam kathañcid atad kārya tvam ca dhūmasya upapannam sarva ātmakasya tad anvaya vyatireka anuvidhāci prabhava tvāt atha sarva ātmanā api tad kārya tve dhūma tva mātram eva agni sahacārī iti manyase sahacāri tvam eva astu tad utpatti kathā vṛthā

nanu bhavadbhiḥ api kārya anumānam aṅgīkṛtam eva yathā śeṣavat iti vyākhyāsyate yathā aaha kaṇa vrataḥ kāryam kāraṇam saṃyogi samavāyi virodhi ca iti laiṅgikam iti na sāhacarya upalakṣaṇa artha tvāt dhūma agnyoḥ nadī pūrayoḥ vā na kārya kāraṇa bhāvāt gamaka tvam yathā ukta nyāyena api tu nitya sāhacaryāt niyamāt eva iti

virodhinoḥ katham sāhacaryam iti ced sat asatoḥ gamya gamaka bhāvāt virodhinoḥ ekatara darśanāt anyatarasya abhāvaḥ anumīyate bhāva abhāvayoḥ ca sāhacaryam tayoḥ asti eva kaṇāda sūtre kārya ādi grahaṇam ca upalakṣaṇam anyeṣām api hetūnām bhūmnām jagati darśanāt sūrya astamayam ālokya kalpyate tāraka udayaḥ pūrṇa candra udayāt vṛddhiḥ ambudheḥ avagamyate uditena anumīyante saritaḥ kumbhayoninā śuṣyat pulina paryanta viśrānta khaga paṅktayaḥ pipīlika aṇḍa sañcāra ceṣṭā anumita vṛṣṭayaḥ bhavanti pathikāḥ parṇa kuṭīra karaṇa udyatāḥ anye api saugata udgīta pratibandha dvaya ujjhitāḥ kiyantaḥ bata gaṇyante hetavaḥ sādhya bodhakāḥ loka prasiddhāḥ tādātmya tad utpatti avadhīraṇāt ḍimbha hevāka sadṛśam sva matyā tad samarthanam atas ca tad svabhāvaḥ tad kāryam ityādi vyasana mātrakam

api ca vyāvṛttyoḥ liṅga liṅgi tvam pratibandhaḥ ca vastunoḥ vikalpaiḥ grahaṇam tasya katham saṅgacchatām idam uktam ca etat prathamaḥ eva āhnike iti alam prasaṅgena tasmāt anumiti hetuḥ sambandhaḥ sāhacaryam iti siddham na tu śauddhodani śiṣya parikalpitam ubhayam api etat
yat tu abhyadhīyata paraiḥ kim adhīnam asya tad sāhacaryam iti tatra vidhiḥ pramāṇam tādātmya tad jananayoḥ api ca eṣa teṣām tulyaḥ anuyogaḥ iti kim viphalaiḥ pralāpaiḥ

niyamaḥ vyākhyātaḥ smṛteḥ iti kaḥ arthaḥ ucyate niyamaḥ hi gṛhītaḥ aṅgam anumeya pramām prati na nārikela dvīpa sthaḥ dhūmāt agnim prapadyate sādhya anumiti velāyām na ca asti niyama grahaḥ niyama graha kāle ca na sādhyam anumīyate tena pūrva gṛhītassan idānīm smṛti gocaraḥ niyamaḥ pratipatti aṅgam tathā avagati darśanāt dvitīya liṅga darśane sati api niyama smaraṇam antareṇa sādhya pramiteram utpādāt yatra api viṣaye abhyaste na eva sañcetyate smṛtiḥ tatra api anena nyāyena balāt sā parikalpyate
atas eva kecana pratyutpanna kāraṇa janyām smṛtim eva anumānam uktavantaḥ
pratyutpannam ca kāraṇam kutracid dharmiṇi dharma antara sahacarita liṅga darśanam iti parokṣe liṅginī iti uktam

tatra liṅgī tāvat ucyate dharma viśiṣṭaḥ dharmī sādhyaḥ saḥ eva liṅgī iti na dharmi mātram sādhyam parvata ādi dharmiṇaḥ siddha tvāt na dharma mātram agneḥ api yatra tatra siddha tvāt na ca dvayossādhya tvam svatantrayoḥ tayoḥ api siddha tvāt eva tasmāt ekasya dvayoḥ vā svātantryeṇa anumeya tā na avakalpate iti avaśyam anyatara viśiṣṭaḥ anyataraḥ sādhyaḥ vaktavyaḥ

tatra api tu dharma viśiṣṭaḥ dharmī sādhyaḥ yuktaḥ na dharmi viśiṣṭaḥ dharmaḥ tathā hi deśa viśiṣṭe vahnau sādhye ṣoḍaśa vikalpāḥ saṃbhaveyuḥ sarve eva agniḥ sarva deśa viśiṣṭaḥ anirdhārita deśa viśeṣa viśiṣṭaḥ pūrva anubhūta mahānasa ādi deśa viśiṣṭaḥ saṃprati upalabhyamāna parvata ādi deśa viśiṣṭaḥ vā anumeyaḥ syāt

anirdhārita viśeṣaḥ vā kaścid agniḥ sarva deśa viśiṣṭaḥ anirdhārita deśa viśiṣṭaḥ pūrva anubhūta deśa viśiṣṭaḥ paridṛśyamāna deśa viśiṣṭaḥ vā anumeyaḥ syāt pūrva anubhūtaḥ vā agniḥ sarva deśa viśiṣṭaḥ anirdhārita deśa viśiṣṭaḥ prāk dṛṣṭa deśa viśiṣṭaḥ upalabhyamāna deśa viśiṣṭaḥ anumeyaḥ syāt evam siṣā dhayiṣitaḥ vā agniḥ sarva deśa viśiṣṭaḥ prāk anubhūta deśa viśiṣṭaḥ idānī nubhūyamāna deśa viśiṣṭaḥ vā anumeyaḥ iti

tatra ete pañcadaśa pakṣāḥ pratyakṣa virodha siddha sādhana tva ādi doṣa upahatāḥ iti anādaraṇīyāḥ eva yaḥ ca ṣoḍaśaḥ pakṣaḥ etad deśa viśiṣṭaḥ eṣaḥ agniḥ iti tatra api deśa viśeṣa avacchedam antareṇa eva vahniḥ iti gṛhītum eva na śakyataḥ eva iti prathamam deśaḥ eva gamyate tasya ca pūrva pratipanna tvāt idānīm anavagata dahana viśiṣṭasya anumātum yogya tvāt saḥ eva sādhyaḥ yuktaḥ

api ca agneḥ sādhyatāyām anupalabdha tad dharmaḥ katham anumāpakaḥ syāt anupalabdhe tu jvalane na tad dharma tayā dhūmaḥ gṛhītum pāryate upalabdhe tu hutabhuji bhavat api niṣphalam eva dhūmasya tad dharmatā grahaṇam anumeyasya tadānīm abhāvāt tasmāt agni viśiṣṭaḥ paridṛśyamānaḥ deśaḥ eva sādhyaḥ sa ca svarūpataḥ pratyakṣaḥ api parokṣa dharma viśiṣṭa tayā anumeyaḥ iti dhūma dharma yogāt agni dharmavān saḥ eva anumīyate saḥ anumānasya viṣayaḥ liṅgī iti ucyate parokṣa grahaṇam ca etat abhiprāyam eva

kvacid tu vyāpti smaraṇa samanantaram eva pratyāsīdataḥ pramātuḥ jhaṭiti samunmiṣan akasmāt eva pratyakṣībhavati vibhāvasuḥ iti na tad viśiṣṭa tayā api dharmiṇaḥ parokṣa tvam avakalpate iti tad vyāvṛttaye parokṣa grahaṇam nitya parokṣasya api ca īśvara adṛṣṭa indriya ādeḥ anumeya tām vakṣyāmaḥ tasmāt yathocitāt liṅgāt yathā ukta niyama smṛteḥ yathā ukta liṅgi vijñānam anumānam iti sthitam

nanu sati anumānasya prāmāṇye lakṣaṇa āśrayaḥ kāryaḥ vicāraḥ na punar prāmāṇyam tasya yujyate tathā ca āhuḥ prāmāṇyasya agauṇa tvāt anumānāt artha niścayaḥ durlabhaḥ pakṣa dharma ādi rūpam hi liṅgasya balāt gauṇyāḥ vṛttyā darśayitavyam dharme hi sādhye na hetoḥ pakṣa dharma tvam agni dharma tvāt dhūmasya dharmiṇi sādhye hetoḥ ananvayi tvam na hi yatra dhūmaḥ tatra parvataḥ iti anvayaḥ dvaye tu sādhye dvayam api na asti na hi dahana mahīdhrayoḥ dhūmaḥ dharmaḥ

na api evam anvayaḥ yatra dhūmaḥ tatra parvata agnī iti dharma viśiṣṭe dharmiṇi sādhye tat ubhayam aghaṭa mānam eva na api agni viśiṣṭa dharādhara dharma tayā dhūmaḥ prathamam upalabdhum śakyate na ca api evam anvayaḥ yatra dhūmaḥ tatra agnimān parvataḥ iti tasmāt avaśyam pakṣa dharma tva anvaya vyavahāra siddhaye dharma viśiṣṭe dharmiṇi rūḍhaḥ pakṣa śabdaḥ tad eka deśe dharmiṇi gauṇyāḥ vṛttyā varṇanīyaḥ anvaya pradarśana samaye ca tad eka deśe tathā eva yojane ati gauṇa lakṣaṇa tvāt indriya artha sannikarṣa ja tvā ādi vat agauṇa lakṣaṇa tva abhāvāt anumānam apramāṇam
api ca viśeṣe anugama abhāvāt sāmānye siddha sādhanāt tadvataḥ anupapanna tvāt anumāna kathā kutas

sāhacarye ca sambandhe visrambhaḥ iti mugdha tā śata kṛtvas api tad dṛṣṭau vyabhicārasya saṃbhavāt deśa kāla daśā bheda vicitra ātmasu vastuṣu avinā abhau a niyamaḥ na śakyaḥ vaktum āha ca avasthā deśa kāla ādi bhedāt bhinnāsu śaktiṣu bhāvānām anumānena prasiddhiḥ ati durlabhā
bhavan api a vinābhāvaḥ paricchettum na śakyate jagattraya gata aśeṣa padārtha ālocanāt vinā na pratyakṣīkṛtāḥ yāvat dhūma agni vyaktayaḥ akhilāḥ tāvat syāt api dhūmaḥ asau yaḥ anagneḥ iti śaṅkyate
ye tu pratyakṣatas viśvam paśyanti hi bhavādṛśāḥ kim divya cakṣuṣām eṣām anumāna prayojanam
sāmānya dvārakaḥ api asti nāvinā abhāva niścayaḥ vāstavam hi na sāmānyam nāma kiñcana vidyate

bhūyas darśana gamyā api na vyāptiḥ avakalpate sahasraśas api tad dṛṣṭau vyabhicāra avadhāraṇāt bahu kṛtvas api vastu ātmā tathā iti pariniścitaḥ deśa kāla ādi bhedena dṛśyate punar anyathā bhūyas dṛṣṭyā ca dhūmaḥ agni sahacārī iti gamyatām anagnau tu sa na asti iti na bhūyas darśanāt gatiḥ

na ca api dṛṣṭi mātreṇa gamakāḥ sahacāriṇaḥ tatra eva niyata tvam hi tad anya abhāva pūrvakam niyamaḥ ca anumāna aṅgam gṛhītaḥ pratipadyate grahaṇam ca asya na anyatra na astitā niścayam vinā darśana adarśanābhyām hi niyama grahaṇam yadi tat api asat anagnau hi dhūmasya iṣṭam adarśanam anagniḥ ca kiyān sarvam jagat jvalana varjitam tatra dhūmasya nāstitvam na eva paśyanti ayoginaḥ tat evam niyama abhāvāt sati vā jñapti asaṃbhavāt anumāna pramāṇa tva durāśā parimucyatām

anumāna virodhaḥ api yadi ca iṣṭa vighāta kṛt viruddha avi abhicāraḥ vā sarvatra sulabha udayaḥ atas eva anumānānām apaśyantaḥ pramāṇa tām tad visraṃbha niṣedha artham idam āhuḥ manīṣiṇaḥ hasta sparśa ādinā andhena viṣame pathi dhāvatā anumāna pradhānena vinipātaḥ na durlabhaḥ api ca yatnena anumitaḥ api arthaḥ kuśalaiḥ anumātṛbhiḥ abhiyuktataraiḥ anyaiḥ anyathā eva upapādyate

atra abhidhīyate kim ayam anumāna svarūpākṣepaḥ eva kriyate uta tad tad tārkikā upalakṣita tad lakṣaṇa ākṣepaḥ iti tatra anumāna svarūpam ca aśakya nihnavam eva sarva loka prasiddha tvāt abalā bāla gopālahālika pramukhāḥ api buddhi ante niyatāt arthāt artha antaram asaṃśayam anumāna apalāpe tu pratyakṣāt api durlabhā lokayātrā iti lokāḥ syuḥ likhitāḥ iva niścalāḥ pratyakṣa dṛṣṭam api padārtha jātam tad jātīya tva liṅga vyāpāreṇa sukha sādhanam itara kāraṇam iti vā niścitya tat upādadate jahati vā laukikāḥ

atha avicārita ramaṇīya tā eva tattvam na tu lakṣaṇa niyamaḥ śakya kriyaḥ tasya iti lakṣaṇa ākṣepaḥ ayam ucyate saḥ api ayuktaḥ yatas yam kañcid artham ālokya yaḥ kaścid na avagamyate kañcid eva akṣipati artham arthaḥ kaścid iti sthitiḥ tatra vastu svabhāvaḥ ayam iti pāda prasārikā dṛśyate hi avinābhūtāt arthāt artha antare matiḥ atas yad darśanāt yatra pratītiḥ upajāyate tayoḥ asti arthayoḥ kaścid sambandhaḥ iti manmahe tad ātma tā tad utpattī na śraddadhati tad vidaḥ sāhacaryam tu sambandhaḥ iti naḥ hṛdayaṅgamam tasmin sati eva bhavanam na vinā bhavanam tatas ayam eva avinābhāvaḥ niyamaḥ sahacāritā kiṃkṛtaḥ niyamaḥ asya asmin iti ced evam uttaram tad ātma tā ādi pakṣe api na eṣa praśnaḥ nivartate jvalanāt jāyate dhūmaḥ na jalāt iti kā gatiḥ

evam eva etat iti ced sāhacarye api tad samam tarkasya yāvān viṣayaḥ sa tāvati nirūpyate vastu svabhāva bhede tu na tasya prabhaviṣṇu tā ayam ca viṣayaḥ yukteḥ yat uktam niyamāt vinā na arthāt artha antare jñānam atas tasya prakalpanam tatas param tu niyamaḥ api eṣa kiṃkṛtaḥ iti na yuktiḥ prabhavati tādātmya tad utpattyoḥ anupapanna tvāt atas niyamaḥ eva viramyate na ca pratibhā mātram ānumānikī pramitiḥ iti vaktum yuktam niyatāt kutaścid eva vastuni pratīti darśanāt iti ukta tvāt niyamaḥ ca yadi agṛhītaḥ eva prati iti aṅgam bhavet nārikela dvīpa vāsibhiḥ api dhūma darśanāt kṛśānuḥ anumīyeta na ca evam asti iti niyama grahaṇam apekṣaṇīyam

yat ca vikalpitam aśakyam tat grahaṇam iti tatra kecid ācakṣate mānasam pratyakṣam pratibandha grāhi iti pratyakṣa anupalaṃbhābhyām anala sahacaritam anagneḥ ca vyāvartamānam dhūmam upalabhya vibhāvasau niyataḥ dhūmaḥ iti manasā pratipadyate manaḥ ca sarva viṣayam kena vā na abhyupeyate asat nihitam api artham avadhārayitum kṣamam

na ca sakala tribhuvana vivara niruddha dhūma agni vyakti sārtha sākṣāt karaṇam upayujyate jvalana tva ādi sāmānya purassara tayā vyāpti grahaṇāt yat tu uktam sāmānyam vāstavam na asti iti tat śabda artha cintā prasaṅge pratisamādhāsyate

apare punar yogi pratyakṣa kalpam yauktikam sambandha grāhi pratyakṣam pratipedire kila dhūma tva agni tva sāmānya puraskāreṇa vyāpya vyāpakayoḥ anvayaḥ nāma gṛhyatām vyatirekaḥ tu anagnibhyaḥ dhūmasya grahītavyaḥ anagnayaḥ ca ativitatāḥ na ca teṣu anagni tvam nāma sāmānyam asti tena samasta trailokya antargata agni anagni gata anvaya vyatireka grāhi pratyakṣa vyatirekeṇa na pratibandhaḥ avadhṛtaḥ bhavet anavadhṛtaḥ ca na pramā aṅgam asti ca pramā iti yukti balāt pratibandha grāhakam ekasmin kṣaṇe pratyakṣam idam aśeṣa vyakti viṣayam asaṃvedyamānam api kalpitam iti yauktikam ucyate

anye punar atas eva tad kalpanā bhayāt bhūyas darśana paricchinna sāmānya purassara anvayam anapekṣita vyatireka niścayam eva liṅgam gamakam abhyupāgaman yathā uktam mama tu adṛṣṭi mātreṇa gamakāḥ sahacāriṇaḥ iti ayam āśayaḥ bhūyas darśanataḥ tāvat udeti matiḥ īdṛśī niyataḥ ayam anena iti sakala prāṇi sākṣikā tāvatā ca gamaka tvam autsargikam siddhyati mīmāṃsakānām tu vipakṣe darśanam bādhakaḥ pratyayaḥ na ca saḥ asti na adya yāvat anagnau dhūmaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ anutpanne api bādhake tad āśaṅkanam ayuktam iti uktam taiḥ doṣa jñāne tu anutpanne na śaṅkyāḥ niṣpramāṇa tā iti

etat tu na cāru vyatireka niścayam antareṇa pratibandha grahaṇa anupapatteḥ iti ukta tvāt jñāpaka tvāt hi niyamaḥ sva grahaṇam apekṣate niyamaḥ ca ayam ucyate yat tasmin sati bhavanam tatas vinā na bhavanam iti bhūyas darśanataḥ ca tasmin sati bhavanam iti anvaya mātra paricchedāt ardha gṛhītaḥ niyamaḥ syāt tatas vinā na bhavanam iti asya arthasya aparicchedāt iti

apare punar anagni tva sāmānyam antareṇa api yogi pratyakṣa kalpanām akurvante eva mānasa pratyakṣa gamyam anvaya vyatirekam āhuḥ dhūma agni sāmānye tāvat sahacarite upalabdhe tadvat tad abhāvau api sahacaritau upalabhyete eva dhūma tva sāmānyasya anagnau jalādau adarśanāt sarva gata tve api sāmānyānām vṛtti bhedaḥ niyāmakaḥ iti vakṣyate yadi api ca anagni tva ādi abhāva sāmānyam na asti tathā api pratiṣedhya agni tva sāmānya anugama siddhyā eva tad abhāva anugama grahaṇam siddhyati

sakala vyakti vijñānam anaṅgam vyāpti niścaye bhāva sāmānyayoḥ yadvat tathā eva tad abhāvayoḥ bhāvayoḥ sāhacaryam yat anvayam tat pracakṣate vyatirekam tu manyante sāhityam tad abhāvayoḥ sādhya sādhana bhāvaḥ tu bhavet yatra api abhāvayoḥ tayoḥ eva anvayaḥ tatra vyatirekaḥ tu bhāvayoḥ

tat evam abhāva anvaya vat bhāva vyatirekaḥ api pratyakṣa gamyaḥ bhavati eva iyāna iva viśeṣaḥ tu bhāvayoḥ yādṛśī yayoḥ vyāpya vyāpaka tā sā eva vyatyastā tad abhāvayoḥ abhāvayoḥ tu gamya gamaka bhāve bhāvayoḥ vyāpti vyatyayaḥ draṣṭavyaḥ evañca pratiṣedhya anugama pūrvaka sāmānya abhāva dvaya anugama pratyaya upapatteḥ anvaya vyatireka niścaye api na yogi pratyakṣam upayujyate bhāva abhāva sāhacaryam avadhārya manasā niyama jñāna siddheḥ iti alam nirvandhena tasmāt niyama vat tad grahaṇa upāyaḥ api asti iti siddham

gṛhīte niyame yāvat punar kvacid dharmiṇi dhūma ādeḥ liṅgasya grahaṇam na vṛttam tāvat na bhavati liṅginaḥ avagatiḥ iti sambandha grahaṇa kāla apekṣayā dvitīyam tad liṅga darśanam apekṣitavyam sā eva iyam pakṣa dharmatā ucyate pakṣa dharma anvaya vyatireka niścaye sati api pratyakṣa āgama virodhena pratipakṣa upanipātena vā na gamaka tvam iti tad aparam lakṣaṇa dvayam upadiṣṭam abādhita viṣaya tvam asat pratipakṣa tvam ca iti tat evam anubhava siddha tvāt anumāna svarūpam iva tasya lakṣaṇam api tāntrika kathitam apratyākhyeyam api ca yadi tāntrika viracitam avācakam lakṣaṇam tat svayam anavadyam āvedyatām na tu tad dveṣeṇa lakṣyam api anumānam nihnotum yuktam

yat punar abhāṇi pramāṇasya agauṇa tvāt anumānāt artha niścayaḥ durlabhaḥ iti tat na buddhyāmahe na hi pramāṇasya kiñcid gauṇa tvam iha paśyāmaḥ pakṣa dharma ādi padāni yadi nāma vyākhyātṛbhiḥ gauṇāni prayuktāni kim etāvatā pramāṇam gauṇībhavet śabda antareṇa hi tad lakṣaṇa abhidhāne na kaścid gauṇa tā ādi pramādaḥ

yat api avādi viśeṣe anugama abhāvāt sāmānye siddha sādhanāt iti tat api asādhu sādhyasya mattu arthasya darśita tvāt yat api avasthā deśa kāla ādi bhedāt iti abhyadhāyi tat api na bhaya āvaham samyak avadhṛtāyām vyāptau viplava abhāvāt pramātuḥ eva tatra tatra aparādhaḥ na anumānasya iti yat api vyāhāri viruddha anumāna virodhayoḥ sarvatra saṃbhavāt kutracid ca viruddha avyabhicāriṇaḥ iṣṭa vighāta kṛtaḥ ca sulabha tvāt iti tat api āla jālam prayojaka hetau prayukte sati evaṃprāyāṇām anavakāśa tvāt sa dvitīya prayogāḥ tu na bhavanti prayojakāḥ utprekṣā mātra mūla tvāt hetu ābhāsāḥ bhavanti te iti vakṣyāmaḥ

na viśeṣa viruddhaḥ ca na ca asti iṣṭa vighāta kṛt hetau su pratibaddhe hi na etāḥ santi viḍambanāḥ tādṛśā ca anumānena puṃsaḥ artham adhigacchataḥ na andhena tulya tā hasta sparśa anumita vartmanā yatnena anumitaḥ yaḥ arthaḥ kuśalaiḥ anumātṛbhiḥ abhiyoga śatena api saḥ anyathā na upapādyate

su śikṣitatarāḥ prāhuḥ dvividham anumānam kiñcid utpanna prati iti kiñcid utpādya prati iti īśvara ādi anumānam tu utpādya prati iti tatra dhūma anumāna ādeḥ prāmāṇyam kena na iṣyate atas hi sādhyam buddhi ante tārkikaiḥ akṣatāḥ api yat tva ātma īśvara sarvajña para loka ādi gocaram anumānam na tasya iṣṭam prāmāṇyam tattva darśibhiḥ ṛjūnām jāyate tasmāt na tāvat anumeya dhīḥ yāvat kuṭilitam cetaḥ na teṣām viṭa tārkikaiḥ

evam tu kathayadbhiḥ taiḥ param nāstikyam ātmanaḥ khyāpyate sma jaḍa tvam vā na anumāna apramāṇa tā na hi sambandha grahaṇa upāya vaicitryāt apramāṇa tā bhavitum arhati āgamena anumānena tarka vyutpādanena vā pratyakṣeṇa gṛhītaḥ vā sambandhaḥ na viśiṣyate īśvara ādi anumānānām tad prasaṅge sa vistaram draḍhimānam ca vakṣyāmaḥ iti alam bahu bhāṣitaiḥ pramāṇam upagamyatām tad anumānam evaṃvidhaiḥ avipluta parākramam bhavat udīritaiḥ dūṣaṇaiḥ anabhyupagame punar vigata ceṣṭitāḥ prāṇinaḥ bhaveyuḥ upala upamāḥ iti hi pūrvam āveditam

atha idānīm sūtram anusarāmaḥ tat pūrvakam ityādi anumānam iti lakṣya nirdeśaḥ tat pūrvakam iti lakṣaṇam tat iti sarva nāmnā prakrāntam pratyakṣam avamṛśyate tat pūrvam kāraṇam yasya tat tad pūrvakam etāvatī ucyamāne nirṇaya upamāna ādau tad pūrvake prasaṅgaḥ na vyāvartate iti tad vyāvṛttaye dvivacana antena vigrahaḥ pradarśayitavyaḥ te dve pratyakṣe pūrvam yasya iti yat ekam avinābhā vi pratyakṣam vyākhyātam yat ca dvitīyam liṅga darśanam te dve pratyakṣe anumānasya eva kāraṇam na upamāna ādeḥ tatra pratibandha grāhi pratyakṣam smaraṇa dvāreṇa tad kāraṇam liṅga darśanam tu svatas eva

nanu pratyakṣa mātrasya prakṛta tvāt prakṛta avamarśi tvāt ca sarva nāmnaḥ kutas ayam viśeṣa pratilābhaḥ ucyate udāharaṇa sādharmyāt sādhya sādhanam hetuḥ iti vakṣyate hetuḥ eva ca anumānam yat iha lakṣyam nirdiṣṭam na ca agṛhītam udāharaṇa sādharmyam tat vaidharmyam vā sādhya sādhanam bhavati iti tad grahaṇa upāyaḥ apekṣitavyaḥ pratyakṣa vyatirikta tad avagama upāya parikalpane ca anavasthā dūṣaṇam asakṛt abhihitam iti pratyakṣasya eva tad upāya tvam atas anumāna kāraṇa bhūta pratyakṣa apekṣayā pratyakṣa mātra prakrame api sarva nāmnā tad viśeṣa ākṣipyate yat pratibandha grāhi pratyakṣam yat ca dvitīyam liṅga darśanam iti

nanu pratyakṣa viśeṣa dvaya pūrvaka tvam anumāna ābhāseṣu api savyabhicāra viruddha ādiṣu saṃbhavati iti ativyāptiḥ mā evam hetu lakṣaṇe sādhya sādhana grahaṇena tad pratikṣepāt pratibandha svarūpam hi tatra eva nipuṇam abhidhāsyate iha tu tad grahaṇa upāya mātram ucyate samyak pravṛtte ca pratibandha grāhiṇi pratyakṣe vyāpti viplava abhāva at na anumāna ābhāsa prasaṅgaḥ sāmānya lakṣaṇa anuvādena ca viśeṣa lakṣaṇe varṇyamāne tatas eva pramāṇa ābhāsa vyudāsa siddheḥ kevalam idānīm samāna jātīya upamāna ādi vyavacchedaḥ vracanīyaḥ iti saḥ eva tad pūrvaka padena upāttaḥ artha utpannam avyabhicāri vyavasāya ātmakam iti phala viśeṣaṇānām sarva pramāṇeṣu anuvṛtteḥ yugapad ca kvacid na asti vyāpāraḥ śabda liṅgayoḥ atas na avyapadeśya tva viśeṣaṇam iha arthavat dvayoḥ api ca śabda liṅgayoḥ jñāpaka tvena svarūpa grahaṇa apekṣa tvāt jñāna ayaugapadyena ca yugapad grahaṇa asaṃbhavāt

nanu evam nirasyatām ativyāptiḥ avyāptiḥ tu katham nirasiṣyate āgama ādi pūrvakāṇām anumānānām asaṅgrahāt teṣu api mūla bhūtam pratyakṣam eva kāraṇam iti kecid āhuḥ yathā uktam yatra api anumitāt liṅgāt liṅgini grahaṇam bhavet tatra api maulikam liṅgam pratyakṣāt eva gamyate iti yat vā prādhānya abhiprāyeṇa pratyakṣa pūrvaka tvam ucyate na niyama artham iti na avyāptiḥ

tāni iti vā punar tāvat avabodhāya vigrahaḥ kartavyaḥ tāni pratyakṣa ādīni pūrvam yasya iti yadi api pratyakṣam eva lakṣya tvena prastutam tathā api vyavacchedya tayā anumāna ādīnām api prakṛta tvam na vāryate

atra codayanti tat iti karaṇa avamarśaḥ vā syāt phala avamarśaḥ vā karaṇa avamarśe indriya ādi karaṇa pūrvakam jñānam tat phalam tat pūrvakam ca anumānam iti pūrva śabdasya dvis pāṭhaḥ syāt sa ca aśrutaḥ kalpanīyaḥ phala avamarśe tu pratyakṣa phala pūrvakam anumāna phalam bhavet na anumānam iti tad pūrvaka śabdasya phala vacanasya anumāna śabdena karaṇa vācinā saha sāmānādhikaraṇyam na syāt tat pūrvakam anumānam iti pratyakṣa phalena hi liṅga darśanena parokṣa artha pratipattiḥ upajanyate sā ca anumāna phalam na anumānam iti ucyate ubhayathā api na doṣaḥ karaṇa avamarśe tāvat indriya ādi karaṇa pūrvakam tat phalam liṅga darśanam yat tat eva parokṣa artha pratipattau karaṇam anumānam iti na dvis pūrvaka śabdasya pāṭhe upayujyate phale api avamṛśyamāne pratyakṣa phala liṅga darśana pūrvakam yat avinā abhāva smaraṇam tad anumānam karaṇam eva tatas parokṣa artha pratipatteḥ yat uktam pratyutpanna kāraṇa janyā smṛtiḥ anumānam iti tatra spaṣṭam eva sāmānādhikaraṇyam
phale vā anumāna śabdam varṇayiṣyāmaḥ anumitiḥ anumānam iti yatas śabdam vā adhyāhariṣyāmaḥ pratyakṣa phala pūrvakam parokṣa artha pratipatti rūpam phalam yatas bhavati tad anumānam iti

atra hi prathamam liṅga darśanam tatas pratibandha smaraṇam tatas keṣāñcit mate parāmarśa jñānam tatas sādhya artha pratītiḥ tatas pratyakṣa lakṣaṇa avasara varṇitena krameṇa heya ādi jñānam itīyati pratīti kalāpe yathopapatti kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ vaktavyaḥ iti evam tad pūrvaka padam eva kevalam anumāna lakṣaṇa kṣamam iti guravaḥ varṇayāñcakruḥ

anye punar upamānāt yati vyāpti vyudāsāya trividha grahaṇam vyākhyāta bantaḥ tad pūrvakam anumānam iti ucyamāne sati upamāna ādau prasaṅgaḥ iti trividha grahaṇam liṅgam vakṣyamāṇa kārya ādi bhedāt vā trividham pakṣa dharma ādi rūpa traya yogāt vā trirūpam trividham ucyate liṅge ca trividhe sati tad ālambanam jñānam upacārāt trividham abhidhīyate tena pratyakṣa pūrvakam trividha liṅga ālambana jñānam anumānam iti ukte sati na ati vyāptiḥ

nanu pūrvavat ādibhiḥ śabdaiḥ kāryādi bheda varṇanam jñāsyāmaḥ pakṣa dharma ādi rūpa trayam tu katham ebhiḥ śabdaiḥ pratipādyate iti atra āhuḥ vāda ādi kathā traye api pūrvam upādīyamāna tvāt pakṣaḥ pūrva śabdena ucyate saḥ asya asti āśraya tvena iti pūrvavat liṅgam iti evam anena padena pakṣa dharma tvam uktam bhavati pakṣe upayukte sati śeṣaḥ sa pakṣaḥ bhavati saḥ asya asti āśraya tvena iti śeṣavat evam anena sa pakṣe vṛttiḥ uktā bhavati sāmānyatodṛṣṭam iti anena vipakṣāt vyāvṛttam liṅgam ucyate katham akāra praśleṣāt sāmānyatas adṛṣṭam iti tiṣṭhatu tāvat viśeṣaḥ sāmānyatas api na dṛṣṭam kva iti pakṣa sa pakṣayoḥ vṛtteḥ ukta tvāt pariśeṣāt vipakṣe sāmānyatas api na dṛṣṭam iti avatiṣṭhate ittham trirūpam liṅgam ebhiḥ śabdaiḥ uktam bhavati tad ālambanam jñānam anumānam

tat evam lakṣaṇe kaścid sarvam sūtram ayojayat evam tu khyāpitam na syāt sūtrakārasya kauśalam kiñca pañca lakṣaṇam iha śāstre abhyupagamyate iti trirūpe tasmin varṇyamāne kāla atyaya apadiṣṭa prakaraṇa samayoḥ prasaṅgaḥ na vyāvartate iti tasmāt tad pūrvaka padam eva lakṣaṇa pratipādana artham anavadyam

trividha grahaṇam tasya vibhāga pratipādakam bhedāḥ pūrvavat ityādi granthena kathitāḥ trayaḥ tad pūrvaka pada udgīta nirmala nyāya lakṣaṇaḥ parimlāna ādaraḥ anyatra sūtra kṛt vākya lāghave vibhāga vacanāt siddham traividhyam sva girā bhavet tathā ca śabda siddhānta chaleṣu evam adīdṛśat
pūrvavat iti yatra kāraṇena kāryam anumīyate yathā jaladhara unnatyā bhaviṣyati vṛṣṭiḥ iti
atra codayati pūrvam hi kāraṇam ucyate pūrvam asya asti iti pūrvavat kāryam vaktum yuktam tena kāryāt kāraṇa anumānam iha udāhartavyam na kāraṇāt kārya anumānam

na ca kāraṇena kāryam anumātum api pāryate kāryasya tāvat pakṣa tvam ayuktam siddhi asiddhi vikalpa anuvṛtteḥ siddhe hi kārye kim anyat anumeyam asiddhe kha puṣpa vat na pakṣa tvam api ca asti kāryam kāraṇasya astitvāt iti vyadhikaraṇaḥ hetuḥ anityaḥ śabdaḥ kākasya kārṣṇyāt iti vat sattāyām ca sādhyāyām bhāva dharmasya hetoḥ asiddha tvam abhāva dharmasya viruddha tvam ubhaya dharmasya anaikāntika tvam iti katham sādhayitum śakyate tat uktam na asiddhe bhāva dharmaḥ asti vyabhicāryu bhaya āśrayaḥ dharmaḥ viruddhaḥ abhāvasya sā sattā sādhyate katham iti na ca kāraṇa mātrasya hetu tvam yuktam vinā ca pratibandha ādinā vyabhicāra sambhavāt kāraṇa viśeṣaḥ ca na kaścid vipaścitā api niścetum śakyaḥ calat acala vipula vapuṣām utpala dala malīm asatviṣām api payomu cām a mukta payasām uparama darśanāt yadi tu antyadaśāvarti kāraṇam liṅgam iṣyate vyāpti smaraṇa velāyām kārya pratyakṣa tā bhavet

nanu saugataiḥ api kāraṇāt kārya anumānam aṅgīkṛtam eva hetunā yaḥ samagreṇa kārya utpādaḥ anumīyate artha antara anapekṣi tvāt sa svabhāvaḥ anuvarṇitaḥ iti agrantha jñaḥ devānām priyaḥ utpādyate asmāt iti utpādaḥ yogyatā kathyate sā ca atra anumeyā atas eva tasyāḥ vastunaḥ ananya tvāt svabhāva anumānam idam iṣyate sa svabhāvaḥ anuvarṇitaḥ iti

atra āhuḥ sarvam idam avidita anumāna prayoga kramasya durmateḥ codyam na kāryam atra pakṣīkriyate na sattā sādhyate na vyadhikaraṇaḥ hetuḥ prayujyate api tu payodharāḥ eva dharmiṇaḥ adūra kāla bhāvinyā vṛṣṭyā tadvantaḥ sādhyante viśiṣṭa unnati rūpa dharma ādi yogena iti na pūrva kathita doṣa avasaraḥ yathā agni mānayam dhūmaḥ bahula pāṇḍutā ādi dharma yogi tvāt mahān asa avadhṛta dhūma vat iti dhūmaḥ eva agnimattayā anumīyate evam samanantara utpādita vṛṣṭayaḥ amī jīmūtāḥ sa atiśaya unnati ādi dharma yogi tvāt pūrva upalabdha parjanya vat iti jaladharāḥ eva bhaviṣyat vṛṣṭimat tayā anumīyante yathā aaha bhaṭṭaḥ tasmāt dharma viśiṣṭasya dharmiṇaḥ syāt prameya tā sā deśasya agni yuktasya dhūmasya anyaiḥ ca kalpitā iti

yat tu pūrvam kāraṇam ucyate iti tat satyam pūrvam asya asti iti pūrvavat kāraṇa gatam unnata tva ādi dharma jātam ucyate tat eva liṅgam iti grantha doṣaḥ api na kaścid na ca kāraṇa mātrasya hetu tvam brūmaḥ yena asya vidhugpratyaya upanipāta ādi kṛtaḥ vyabhicāraḥ syāt api ca viśiṣṭam eva kāraṇam hetuḥ na ca kāraṇa viśeṣaḥ duravagamaḥ gambhīra garjita ārambha nirbhinna giri gahvarāḥ rolamba ga bala vyāla tamāla malina tviṣaḥ tuṅgat taṭit latā saṅga piśaṅga uttuṅga vigrahāḥ vṛṣṭim vyabhicaranti iha na evaṃprāyāḥ payomucaḥ anabhyupagame ca evam anumānasya jīvitam na syāt dhūma viśeṣāṇām api boddhum aśaktitaḥ

yat api kārya pratyakṣa tvam āśaṅkitam tat api ayuktam na hi vṛṣṭi anumāna samayaḥ eva śirasi salila kaṇāḥ patantaḥ payoda muktāḥ dṛśyante parokṣe liṅgini jñānam anumānam iti ca viśeṣaṇa upādānāt yatra tatra na tadānīm eva vṛṣṭiḥ pratyakṣībhavati tad udāharaṇam bhaviṣyati api ca anupajāta avayava kriyatayā anāśaṅkyamāna vināśe antyatantau jātayā kriyayā paṭa niṣpatti anumāne kriyamāṇe na paṭa pratyakṣa tā kāla vyavadhāna sambhavāt tathā hi ekatas tāvat antyatantau kriyā darśanam avinā abhāva smaraṇam parāmarśa jñānam anumeya pratītiḥ iti tricatvāraḥ kṣaṇāḥ anyatas tu kriyā kriyātaḥ vibhāgaḥ vibhāgāt pūrva saṃyoga nivṛttiḥ tatas uttara saṃyoga utpādaḥ tatas paṭa niṣpattiḥ niṣpanne paṭe kṣaṇa antare rūpa ādi guṇa āraṃbhaḥ rūpa ādi janmani paṭasya samavāyi kāraṇa tvāt kāraṇasya kāryāt avaśyam pūrva kāla bhāvi tvam atas niṣpannaḥ api nūnam ekasmin kṣaṇe nīrūpaḥ paṭaḥ bhavati iti na tadā eva pratyakṣaḥ tatas kṣaṇa antare rūpa utpādāt rūpavat dravyam indriya sannikarṣāt pratyakṣam bhaviṣyati iti ati vahavaḥ ete kṣaṇāḥ atas na kārya pratyakṣa tvam na api vidhura pratyaya ādinā kārya anutpattiḥ anutpanna avayava kriyatva viśeṣaṇa upādānena tad vināśa aśaṅkanāt kriyātaḥ ca uttarottara kāryāṇām avarśya bhāvi tvāt
yat api hetunā yaḥ samagreṇa ityādinā yogya tā anumānam vyākhyātam tat api asādhu svabhāva anumānasya nirasta tvāt lokaḥ ca kāraṇāt avikalāt kāryam eva kalpayati na yogyatām iti alam prasaṅgena

śeṣavat iti yatra kāryeṇa kāraṇam anumīyate yathā nadī pūreṇa uparitane deśe vṛṣṭiḥ iti atra api vṛṣṭi mat u paritana deśa saṃsarga lakṣaṇaḥ nadī dharmaḥ tad dharmeṇa eva viśiṣṭena pūrṇa tā ādinā anumīyate vṛṣṭimat pṛṣṭha deśa saṃsṛṣṭā iyam nadī phenila kaluṣa tva ādi viśiṣṭa ṣūra upeta tvāt pūrva upalabdhā evaṃvidhadhunī vat

ayam deśaḥ vā vṛṣṭi viśiṣṭa deśa antara saṃsṛṣṭaḥ viśiṣṭa nadī pūravat tvena anumīyata iti prāktana vaiyadhikaraṇyādi codya cakrasya iha api na asti prasaraḥ phala tattu iyam vācaḥ yuktiḥ kāryeṇa kāraṇam anumīyate kāraṇena kāryam anumīyate iti paramārthataḥ tu dharmīm dharmavat tvena dharmavān anumīyate iti sthitiḥ yat āha bhaṭṭaḥ saḥ eva ca ubhayā ātmā ayam gamyaḥ gamakaḥ eva ca asiddhena eka deśena gamyaḥ siddhena bodhakaḥ iti

yat tu setu bhaṅga hima vilaya nādinā api nadī pūra upapattiḥ dṛṣṭā iti tatra api ucyate āvarta vartanāśa ali viśāla kaluṣa udakaḥ kallola vikaṭa āsphāla sphurat pheṭa chaṭā añcitaḥ vahat bahala śaivāla vanaśāt bala saṅkulaḥ nadī pūra viśeṣaḥ api śakyeta na na veditum pramātuḥ aparādhaḥ ayam viśeṣam yaḥ na paśyati na anumānasya doṣaḥ asti prameya avyabhicāriṇaḥ rodha upaghāta sādṛśya vyabhicāra nibandhanam anumāna apramāṇa tvam atas vaktum asāṃpratam pāraṃparyeṇa vṛṣṭiḥ ca nadī pūrasya kāraṇam patat dhana payaḥ bindu sandoha syandana kramāt

sāmānyatodṛṣṭam tu yat akārya kāraṇa bhūtāt liṅgāt tādṛśasya eva liṅginaḥ anumānam yathā kapittha ādau rūpeṇa rasa anumānam rūpa rasayoḥ samavāyi kāraṇam ekam kapittha ādi dravyam na tu tayoḥ anyonyam kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ śākya dṛṣṭyā api vartamānayoḥ kṣaṇayoḥ itaretara kārya kāraṇa tā na sambhavati eva dharmiṇaḥ ca rūpavat tvena rasavat tā anumānāt asiddhi ādi codyānām pūrvavat anavakāśaḥ vaktavyaḥ

yat punar bhāṣya kāreṇa bhāskarasya deśa antara prāpti ā agati anumānam udāhṛtam tat ayuktam deśa antara prāpteḥ gati kārya tvāt kāryeṇa kāraṇa anumānam śeṣavat eva idam syāt api ca deśa antara prāptiḥ deśa antara saṃyogaḥ na ca daśa śata aṃśoḥ deśa antareṇa śailādinā saṃyogaḥ saṃbhavati nabhasā tu bhavan api diśā vā durlakṣyaḥ pratyakṣa itara vṛtti tvāt pavana vanaspati saṃyoga vat mātṛ garbha saṃyoga vat vā atha deśa antare taraṇi darśanam hetuḥ ucyate tasya api gati kārya tā pāramparyeṇa vidyate eva gatyā prāptiḥ prāptyā ca tatra darśanam iti

atha deśa antare tapana darśanam pakṣīkṛtya darśana tvena ca darśana śabda vācya tvena vā tasya gati pūrvaka tvam anumīyate deśa antare divākara darśanam gati pūrvakam deśa antara darśana tvāt tad śabda vācya tvāt vā devadatta deśa antara darśana vat iti tathā api pāramparyeṇa gati kārya tā na nivartate eva na hi darśana tvam go tva ādi vat sāmānyam asti kintu bhāva pratyayena atra darśana utpādikā śaktiḥ ucyate sā ca na atīndriyā nityā kācid api tu svarūpa sahakāri svabhāvā eva iti dṛśyamānam svarūpam api śakti varge patati dṛśyamānam ca deśa antara prāpti ātmakam iti gati kāryam

evam darśana śabda vācya tve api hetūkṛte vaktavyam gatyā deśa antara prāptiḥ janyate tayā tatra darśanam tena śabda prayogaḥ saḥ eva vācya tvam iti bhāva pratyayena uktaḥ tasmāt sarvathā gati kārya tvānapāyāt śeṣavat eva idam anumānam tat etat bhāṣya kārīyam udāharaṇam īdṛśam rūpāt rasa anumānam tu tasmāt yuktam udāhṛtam akārya kāraṇa prāya hetūnām ca pradarśitaḥ bhadanta kalahe asmābhiḥ udāharaṇa vistaraḥ

evam tāvat matu bvyākhyayā traividhyam anumānasya varṇitam etat tu phalgu prāyam iva manyante niyama ātmaka sambandha balāt eva liṅgasya gamaka tvam uktam na kārya ādi svarūpeṇa tat kim īdṛśa traividhyena darśitena iti vati pratyayam āśritya anyathā vyācakṣate pūrvavat iti atra sambandha grahaṇa kāle liṅga liṅginoḥ pratyakṣatas sva rūpam avadhārya punar tādṛśā eva liṅgena tādṛś eva liṅgī gamyate tat pūrveṇa tulyam vartate iti pūrvavat anumānam yathā mahānase dhūma agnī sahacaritau dṛṣṭvā punar parvate dhūma agni anumānam

nanu pratyakṣa pratītyā viṣaya gata sakala viśeṣa sākṣāt karaṇa kṣamayā tulyā na anumānikī matiḥ iti katham kriyā tulya tvam tad abhāvāt katham vatiḥ satyam evam tathā api vahneḥ eva tādṛśasya vailakṣaṇya āpādaka viśeṣa avacchinnasya liṅgena grahaṇāt adūra vipra karṣeṇa kriyā tulya tvam upapatsyate

śeṣa vat nām pariśeṣaḥ sa ca prasakta pratiṣedhe anyatra aprasaṅgāt śiṣyamāṇe saṃpratyayaḥ yathā kvacid pradeśe dhūmena agni mātre anumite kim indhanaḥ ayam agniḥ iti vimarśe prasaktānām tṛṇa parṇa kāṣṭha ādīnām aprasaṅgāt ca gomaya indhanaḥ agniḥ parikalpyate yathā vā śabde dravya karma tva pratiṣedhāt sāmānyādau aprasaṅgāt ca guṇa tva anumānam vakṣyate

sāmānyatodṛṣṭam tu yatra sambandha kāle api liṅgi svarūpam apratyakṣam nitya parokṣam eva sāmānyatas vyāpti grahaṇāt anumīyate yathā śabda ādi upalabdhyā śrotra ādi karaṇam indriyāṇām atīndriya tvāt na kadācid pratyakṣa gamya tvam atha ca chedana ādi kriyāṇām paraśvadha ādi karaṇa pūrvaka tvena vyāpti grahaṇāt śabda ādi upalabdhi kriyāṇām karaṇa pūrvaka tvam anumīyate

atra vati vyākhyāne codayanti pūrvavat evam ekam anumānam uktam syāt na trividham yatas na tāvat anavagata vyāptikam liṅgam gamakam bhavati viśeṣāṇām ananta tvena ca tad anvaya vyatirekayoḥ duravagama tvāt sarvatra sāmānyena eva vyāpti grahaṇam yat ca ittham vyāpti jñānam tad tulyam tritaye api atas sarvam pūrvavat eva syāt vateḥ sarvatra saṃbhavāt

tat etat ayuktam avāntara viśeṣasya su spaṣṭasya bhāvāt vyāpti pūrvakam anumānam iti etāvatā yadi ekavidham ucyate tat satyam evam prakāram eva idam tasmin sati api tu sāmye bheda antara saṃbhavāt traividhyam asya pratipādyate tathā hi dhūma jvalanayoḥ pūrvam pratyakṣeṇa grahaṇāt idānīm tena eva dhūmena saḥ eva agniḥ anumīyate iti pūrvavat idam anumānam ucyate yat pratyakṣa pūrvakam iti prasiddham

nanu dhūma antareṇa vahni antara anumānam kim na pratyakṣa pūrvakam kaḥ ekam āha na pūrvavat iti katham tarhi idam ucyate tena eva dhūmena iti jāti abhiprāyam etat ucyate na vyakti abhiprāyam nanu sāmānyatas tarhi tad paricchedāt sāmānyatodṛṣṭam eva idam syāt na sāmānyatodṛṣṭasya nitya parokṣa anumeya eka viṣaya tvāt prasakta pratiṣedha ādinā ca niyata sādhya pariccheda hetuḥ pariśeṣa anumānam ucyate yathā gomaya indhana dahana anumānam udāhṛtam śabde vā guṇa tva kalpanam sāmānyatodṛṣṭam tu nitya parokṣa viṣayam udāhṛtam eva śrotra ādi anumānam tat evam bheda saṃbhavāt trividham anumānam iti yuktam

āstām vai udāharaṇa bhedaḥ ekatra api udāharaṇe traividhyam abhidhātum śakyate yathā icchā ādi kāryam āśritam kāryatvāt ghaṭa vat iti āśraya mātre sādhye pūrvavat anumānam prasakta śarīra indriya ādi āśraya pratiṣedhena viśiṣṭa āśraya kalpane tat eva pariśeṣa anumānam anumeyasya nitya parokṣa tvāt tat eva sāmānyatodṛṣṭam ca

tarhi pariśeṣa anumānasya sāmānyatodṛṣṭasya ca kaḥ viśeṣaḥ ucyate pariśeṣa anumāna pravṛttau anyaḥ panthāḥ sāmānyatodṛṣṭasya anyaḥ icchā ādi kāryam deha ādi vilakṣaṇa āśrayam śarīra ādiṣu bādhaka pramāṇa upapattau satyām kāryatvāt iti sāmānyatodṛṣṭasya kramaḥ pariśeṣa anumānasya tu ittham pravṛttiḥ icchā ādeḥ āśraya tvena prasaktāni śarīra indriya manāṃsi niṣidhyante diś kāla ādau ca tad prasaṅgaḥ na asti tad pāriśeṣyāt ātmā eva tad āśrayaḥ iti pariśeṣa anumāne ca sarvatra na eṣa niyamaḥ sādhyasya ati parokṣa tvam iti gomaya agni kalpanā ādi darśanāt sāmānyatodṛṣṭam tu nitya parokṣa viṣayam eva iti sūktam traividhyam

apare punar adṛṣṭa sva lakṣaṇa viṣayam śakti kriyā anumānam sāmānyatodṛṣṭam udāharanti devadatta ādau api kriyāyāḥ parokṣa tvāt calati iti pratyaye hi na devadatta svarūpa atirikta kriyā tattva pratibhāsaḥ yaḥ eva devadatta ātmā tiṣṭhat pratyaya gocaraḥ calati iti api saṃvittau saḥ eva pratibhāsate avirala samullasat saṃyoga vibhāga prabandha viṣaya tvāt cala ti iti pratyayasya na sarvadā tad utpādaḥ

katham tarhi nitya parokṣe kriyāsu alakṣaṇe anumānam kramataḥ iti ced kāryasya kādācid ka tvena kāraṇa pūrvaka tvāt paridṛśyamānasya dravya svarūpasya kāraṇa tve sarvadā kārya utpādana prasaṅgāt sarvadā tad svarūpa sadbhāvāt na ca sarvadā kāryam utpadyate iti tad atirikta kriyā anumānam evam śaktau api draṣṭavyam kriyā śakti svarūpasya ca nitya parokṣa tvāt tad adṛṣṭa sva lakṣaṇa viṣayam anumānam ucyate na tu viśeṣa viṣayam viśeṣa vyāpti grahaṇasya asaṃbhavāt iti

tat idam anupapannam parispanda rūpasya utkṣepaṇa ādi bhedavataḥ karmaṇaḥ calati ādi pratītau prakāśamāna tvena pratyakṣa tvāt na tasya nitya anumeya tvam saṃyoga vibhāga ālambana tve tu saṃyujyate vibhajyate iti pratītiḥ syāt na calati iti yathā viṣayam pratyaya utpādāt saṃvedana anusāriṇī ca viṣaya vyavasthā anyathā ghaṭa pratyaye api paṭasya ālambanatā syāt saṃyoga vibhāga ālambana tve sati tiṣṭhati api calat pratyayaḥ prāpnoti tatra api saṃyoga vibhāga saṃbhavāt sthāṇau ca śyena saṃyoga vibhāgavati calati iti pratibhāsaḥ bhavet avirala tad upajanana prabandhe api bhūta bhāvinoḥ saṃyoga vibhāgayoḥ parokṣa tvāt vartamānayoḥ grahaṇam tau ca calitvā api sthite devadatte staḥ iti tatra api katham na calati iti pratyayaḥ nirantaram ca saṃyoga vibhāga śreṇi darśanāt bhūmau api bhavet buddhiḥ calati iti manuṣya vat

atha manuṣe yad kriyā janya tvam saṃyoga vibhāgayoḥ tatra eva calati ityādi buddhiḥ na anyatra devadatta kriyayā ca tau janyete na niṣkriyayā bhūmyā iti na tasyām tathā pratyayaḥ yadi evam kriyā anvaya vyatireka anuvidhānāt kriyā ālambanaḥ eva ayam pratyayaḥ na saṃyoga vibhāga ālambanaḥ tad ālambana tve hi tayoḥ dvaya vṛtti tva aviśeṣāt viśeṣe kāraṇam vācyam yena puruṣaḥ eva ayam pratyayaḥ na bhūmau iti devadatta kriyā janya tvena tu na viśeṣaḥ yatas kriyāyāḥ parokṣa tve sati tat eva na vidmaḥ kim asau devadatta āśrayā kriyā kim vā bhūmi āśritā iti saṃyoga vibhāga kārya anumānasya ubhayatra api tulya tvāt na ca devadatte gacchati bhūmau anavarata vahat vahala saṃyoga vibhāgavatī api vā taraṅgiṇī tīra pāṣāṇe calati iti pratyayaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ tasmāt kriyā viṣayaḥ eva calati iti pratyayaḥ na saṃyoga vibhāga ālambanaḥ

saṃyoga vibhāga agrahaṇe api ca nirālambe vihāyasi viharati vihaṅgame calati iti saṃvedanam dṛśyate na ca gagana saṃyogaḥ pratyakṣaḥ pratyakṣa itara vṛtti tvāt gandha vaha mahīruha saṃyoga vat vitata āloka avaya vi ākāśaḥ tad saṃyogaḥ ca patriṇaḥ pratyakṣaḥ iti ced na etat evam tamāla nīla jīmūta samūha pihita ambare niśīthe sa andhakāre api calat khadyota darśanāt
