svarga ādiḥ ca kāmya rūpaḥ arthaḥ kha tad puṣpābhyām vilakṣaṇaḥ iti bhāvyaḥ bhavati tad niṣṭhaḥ tad utpādakaḥ ca puruṣa vyāpāraḥ yaḥ sa bhāvanā sā ṇi antena bhavatinā ucyate prakṛti arthasya bhavateḥ kartā yaḥ svarga ādiḥ saḥ eva ṇī antasya tasya karma tām pratipadyate kartā tu asya prayojakaḥ puruṣaḥ ṇeḥ ca arthaḥ prayojaka vyāpāraḥ puruṣaḥ hi bhavantam svarga ādim artham sva vyāpāreṇa bhāvayati saṃpādayati sa tad saṃpādakaḥ vyāpāraḥ bhāvanā iti ucyate

nanu vyāpāraḥ kriyā eva tad atiriktasya vyāpārasya asaṃbhavāt kriyā vākya artha pakṣaḥ ca pratikṣiptaḥ ucyate na kriyā mātram bhāvanā api tu paridṛśyamāna pūrva aparībhūta yajya ādi bhāva svarūpa atiriktaḥ puruṣa vyāpāraḥ pratyayāt pratīyamānaḥ bhāvanā yathā aaha na sā kenacid utpādyā janikā sā na kasyacid kevalam jananī hi eṣā janyasya janakasya ca iti kriyā kāraka ādi vilakṣaṇā eva hi sā śabdāt pratīyate iti arthaḥ

nanu ca yajate iti atra prakṛti arthaḥ yāga ādiḥ kiyā pratyaya arthaḥ tu preraṇā rūpaḥ vidhiḥ kartṛ saṃkhyā ādiḥ ca na tu dhātu abhidhīyamāna vyāpāra vyatiriktaḥ bhāvanā ākhyaḥ puruṣa vyāpāraḥ pratyayāt pratīyate na hi bhāvanā vācinīm kāṃcid vibhaktim smarati pāṇiniḥ liṅā ādim iva vidhi ādau tasmāt na bhāvanā vākya arthaḥ ucyate bhāvanā api pratīyate eva ākhyātāt yadi naipuṇyena śābdī pramitiḥ avamṛśyate

āstām vidhi padam tāvat vartamāna apadeśinaḥ śabdāt yajate iti ādeḥ bhāvanā na na gamyate pacati gacchati iti atas yathā pākādiḥ dhātvarthaḥ pratīyate tathā sarva anugataḥ kartṛ vyāpāraḥ api pāka ādi upajanana apāye api vyāpāra pratīteḥ anapāyāt yathā hi aupagavaḥ kāpaṭavaḥ aupamanyavaḥ iti upagu prabhṛtīnām uddhāre ca nikṣepe ca pratyaya arthaḥ anuvartate tat dhita anteṣu tathā aakhyāteṣu api saḥ anuvartamānaḥ dṛśyate

api ca pacati iti ākhyāta padasya yadā arthaḥ vyāci khya asitaḥ bhavati tadā pākam karoti iti vākyam vyākhyātāraḥ prayuṃjate pacati iti kaḥ arthaḥ pākam karoti iti pāka śabdeta dvitīya antena sādhyam dhātu artham vyācakṣate kartṛ vyāpāra ātmakam pratyaya artham karoti iti padena kim ca kim karoti devadattaḥ iti pṛṣṭāssantaḥ dvaye vaktāraḥ bhavanti karoti pākam iti pacati iti vat tat idam ubhaya rūpam api uttaram ekārtham anyathā na tena praṣṭā pratyāyyeta tasmāt pākam karoti iti pada dvayasya yaḥ arthaḥ saḥ eva arthaḥ ekasya pacati iti padasya atra api pacati arthāt anyaḥ karoti arthaḥ pratīyate eva yaḥ asau anyaḥ karoti arthaḥ sā bhāvanā

āha na kartṛ saṃkhyā ādi vyatirekeṇa pratyayāt dhātu artha atiriktam vyāpāram pratipadyante pratipadyeran ced karoti iti atas api śabdāt pratipadyeran na ca karoti iti atra prakṛti pratyaya vācye kriye vibhajya darśayitum śakyete ucyate na idam sādhu budhyase yaḥ ca pākam karoti iti vyavahāraḥ vibhāgataḥ saḥ eva samudāyena proktaḥ pacatinā yathā tathā kāryam karoti iti pratītiḥ na asti laukikī pratyaya arthaḥ karoti arthe pacati ādau tu vartate kartṛ saṃkhyā pratītau ca na vivādaḥ asti kasyacid tāvatā nihnavaḥ kāryaḥ na tu vyāpāra saṃvidaḥ

karoti ityādi śabdebhyaḥ ca yathā na bhavitavya viśiṣṭebhyaḥ tat pratītiḥ iṣyate na tathā sarvebhyaḥ ke punar te viśiṣṭāḥ śabdāḥ ye bhāvanām abhidadhati ucyate bhāva arthāḥ karma śabdāḥ ye tebhyaḥ gamyeta bhāvanā yajeta iti evamādibhyaḥ saḥ eva arthaḥ vidhīyate bhavanti kecid bhāva arthāḥ na karma śabdāḥ yathā bhāvaḥ bhavanam bhūtiḥ iti bhavanti kecid karma śabdāḥ na bhāva arthāḥ yathā śyena eka trika ādayaḥ karma nāmadheya tayā prāk samarthitāḥ ye tu bhāva arthāḥ santaḥ karma śabdāḥ yajate dadāti juhoti iti evamādayaḥ tebhyaḥ bhāvanā ākhyā kriyā gamyate taiḥ eva liṅa ādi vibhakti antaiḥ saḥ arthaḥ abhidhīyate yajeta dadyāt juhuyāt iti tad uktam yajyādi arthaḥ ca atas avagamyate bhāvayet iti ca iti karoti śabdāt api kevalāt kartṛ vyāpāraḥ na na asau avagamyate yatra yāga ādi karmaṇā ananuraktena prayoga yogya tām pratipadyate iti viśiṣṭebhyaḥ eva yajati ādi śabdebhyaḥ bhāvanā ākhyaḥ anuṣṭheyaḥ puruṣa vyāpāraḥ pratīyate iti siddham

kriyā viśeṣaḥ eva ayam vyāpāraḥ jñāturāntaraḥ spanda ātmaka bahis bhūta kriyā akṣaṇa vicakṣaṇaḥ iti evam kecid puruṣasya prayatnaḥ vā bhāvanā iti abhidhīyate audāsīn yadaśa apāyam pumān yena prapadyate sa yatnaḥ yāga homa ādi kriyā nirvṛtti kāraṇam tasya tad vyatirikta tvam prāyas sarve anumanyate sa ca ayam ātma dharmaḥ api na vibhu tva ādi sannibhaḥ sādhya rūpa abhisambandhāt dhatte viṣaya tām vidheḥ iti apare

anye dhātu artha sāmānyam bhāvanām abhyupāgaman yāga dāna ādi anusyūtam rūpam go tva ādi jāti vat yathā hi śābaleya ādiṣu anugatam ca go rūpam avabhāsate vyāvṛttam ca śābaleya ādi rūpam evam iha api yāga ādi karmaṇām anugatam ca vyāpāra rūpam pratibhāsate paraspara vibhaktam ca yāga ādi rūpam yat tad anugatam vyāpāra rūpam sā bhāvanā yathā ca śābaleya ādi ananuraktam pṛthaktvena go tvam darśayitum aśakyam tad uparakta tvena tasya sarvadā avagamāt na ca etāvatā tasya nāstitvam sukha duḥkha ādi avastha anugatasya iva ātmanaḥ

tathā ca kim karoti iti anavagata viśeṣa vyāpāra sāmānya praśne sati pacati paṭhati iti tad viśeṣa uttara vacanam anuguṇam bhavati iti tat ca sāmānya rūpam api na go tva ādi vat kriyā tva vat vā siddha tayā avabhāsate yena vidhera viṣayaḥ syāt api ca yajate dadyāt juhuyāt iti sarvatra aparityakta pūrvāparī bhūta svabhāvam tat vyāpāra sāmānyam avagamyate tena vidheḥ ca viṣaya tām pratipadyate tat idam sakala dhātu artha sādhāraṇam sādhyamāna avastham vyāpāra sāmānyam bhāvanā iti ucyate tasmin ca pakṣe dhātu vācya tvam api bhāvanāyāḥ vaktum śakyate pāka ādi śabdebhyaḥ dhātau sati api tat apratīteḥ na dhātu vācya tvam bhāvanāyāḥ iti ced bhavati ādau tarhi satyati pratyaye tad apratīteḥ pratyaya vācya tvam api na syāt tat alam anena nirdhāraṇa prayatneta sarvathā dhātoḥ vā pratyayāt vā bhāvanā avagamyate iti siddham

sā dhātoḥ pratyayāt vā api bhāvanā avagatā satī apekṣa rte aśatritayam kim kena katham iti adaḥ bhāvayet iti avagate nūnam apekṣā trayam bhavati kim bhāvayet kena bhāvayet katham bhāvayet iti tatra kim iti apekṣā svarga kāma padena pūryate kim bhāvayet svargam iti nanu svarga kāmaḥ iti puruṣa nirdeśaḥ ayam na phala nirdeśaḥ satyam svarga paraḥ tu ayam nirdeśaḥ uktam hi niratiśaya prīti vacanaḥ svarga śabdaḥ prītiḥ ca yā an na artha iti api uktam sādhya tvena ca svargaḥ kāmyate iti saḥ eva hi kim iti aṃśe nipatati svargam bhāvayet iti svargam kāmayate iti ca vyatpattau vispaṣṭam eva tasya sādhya tvam bahu vrīhau api tasya eva sādhya tvam vidhi vṛtta paryālocanayā avadhāryate

evam svargam bhāvayet iti avagatekena bhāvayet iti apekṣāyām yāgena iti sambadhyate nanu yāgena iti na śrūyate kintu yajeta iti tat ca ākhyāta padam prakṛti pratyaya ātmaka samudāya rūpam tatra ṅipratyayasya bhāvanā vācya iti uktam yat iti dhātu mātram avaśiṣṭam tasya kṛdantasya tṛtīya antasya yāgena iti yaḥ arthaḥ sa katham ekākinā tena pratyāyyeta ucyate bhāvanā ced pratyaya arthaḥ iti soḍham āyuṣmatā yāgena iti abhisambandhaḥ soḍhavyaḥ eva yaḥ hi tasyām yathā sambaddhum yogyaḥ tamasau tathā pratyeṣyati na anyathā iti karaṇa ākāṅkṣā paripūraṇena sambandha yogyaḥ yajiḥ iti tathā eva eṣa bhāvanayā abhi sambadhyate

aprātipadika tvāt hi tṛtīyā tatra mā sma bhūt śabda sāmarthī a labhyā tu nūnam kāraṇa tā yajeḥ kasya punar śabdasya sāmarthyam etat bhāvanā vācinaḥ iti brūmaḥ tṛtīyayā eva kāraṇa tvam abhidhānīyam iti na iyam rājā ājñā tatas tad avagateḥ tu tathā abhyupagamyate evam iha api svarga kāmaḥ yajeta iti tathā avagatiḥ bhavantī kim iti na mṛṣyate ākhyātāt sādhya tā yā ca dhātu arthasya avagamyate dvitīyā śrūyate tatra kim vā tad abhidhāyinī

nanu evam tarhi dhātu arthasya sādhya tā avagateḥ kim iti aṃśe yajinā patitavyam kim bhāvayet yāgam kena iti apekṣite vākya antara samarpitaṃbrīhibhiḥ ityādi sambadhyatām na punar yajeḥ sādhya rūpa vyāpāra abhidhāyi pratyaya upasarjanī bhūta karmatām ati pratyāsannāman āruhya dūra vartinīm karaṇa tām adhiroḍhum arhati ucyate syāt etat evam yadi hi svarga kāmaḥ iti na śrūyeta tasmin tu śrute na evam bhavitum arhati kutas

svarga ādi sādhya saṃbandhāt alabdhvā sādhya tā anvayam yajiḥ tadā anuguṇyena karaṇa aṃśe avatiṣṭhate svargasya hi kāmyamāna tvena prīti ātmaka tvena ca ananya artha tvāt sādhya tāyām yogya tvāt kim iti aṃśa upanipāte siddhe tatra alabdha niveśaḥ yajiḥ tad apekṣitām karaṇa tām eva yogya tvāt abalambate sāmānādhikaraṇyam ca jyotiṣṭoma ādibhiḥ padaiḥ evam sati upapadyeta karaṇa tva anuvādibhiḥ karma nāmadheya tvam ca jyotiṣṭoma ādīnām śabdānām uktam

nanu sādhya tva pakṣa sākṣitām api karma nāmadheyāni bhajante agnihotram juhoti iti naiṣa doṣaḥ sādhyaḥ eva bhavan bhāva arthaḥ sādhana tām abalambate tatra api hi svarga bhāvanāyām agnihotra ākhyaḥ homaḥ karaṇam eva anyathā svarga kāma padān anvaya prasaṅgāt iti uktam nāmadheya padam tu karmatām anuvadati kiṃcid karaṇa tām agnihotram ityādi jyotiṣṭomena iti tasmāt yajeḥ karaṇa tvena eva anvayaḥ iti siddham yat tu pratyāsanna tvāt sādhya aṃśa upanipātitā iti ucyate tat ayuktam yogya tva virodhinī pratyāsattiḥ saṃbandha kāraṇam na tad viparitā yogya tvam ca svargasya eva sādhya tāyām yajeḥ ca karaṇa tāyām iti uktam

evam yāgena bhāvayet iti avagate katham iti apekṣāyām iti kartavyata tad vākya paṭhitā vākya antara niveditā vā saṃbadhyate tad vākya upāttā tāvat yathā etasya eva revatīṣu vāravantīyam agni ṣṭoma sāma kṛtvā paśu kāmaḥ hi etena yajeta iti vākya antara upāttā brīhīn abahanti taṇḍulān pinaṣṭi samidhaḥ yajati barhiḥ yajati tanūnapātam yajati iti

itikartavya tā hi iṣṭā dṛṣṭa adṛṣṭa prayojanā prāyas sarvatra bhāva arthe katham aṃśa upapādinī dṛṣṭa upakāra dvāreṇa sambaddhā peṣaṇa ādikā itikartavya tā jñeyā sannipatya upakāriṇī bhāva artham anugṛhṇāti yā tu adṛṣṭena vartmanā samidh ādya ātmikām āhuḥ tāmārāt upakāriṇīm evam aṃśa traya āśleṣa labdha anuṣṭhāna yogya tām bhāvanām īdṛśīm prāpya vṛtti vidhi niṣedhayoḥ darśa pūrṇamāsābhyām yajeta svarga kāmaḥ jyotiṣṭomena svarga kāmaḥ yajeta iti atra anantara ukta rītyai eṣa vākya arthaḥ jātaḥ darśa pūrṇamāsena yāgena svargam bhāvayet anayā agni ādhāna ādikayā itikartavyatayā iti

kimartham punar vidhiḥ āśrīyate vartamāna apadeśiṣu api ākhyāteṣu bhāvanā pratīyate iti darśitavān bhavān atas kim vidhinā tasya hi īḥ cayaṇam svarga yāgayoḥ sādhya sādhana bhāva bodhanāya pravṛtti nivṛtti liddhaye vā sādhya sādhana sambandhaḥ tāvat ākāṅkṣā sannidhi yogyatā paryālocanayā vartamāna apadeśinaḥ api ākhyātāt bhāvanā avagame sati bhavati eva antareṇa api vadhim

pravṛttiḥ api puruṣa icchā nibandhanā svargasya sādhya tve yāgasya sādhana tve avadhārite yaḥ svargam icchet sa tad siddhaye pravarteta eva yaḥ tu na icchet tasya vidhiḥ api kiṃkuryāt na hi apravartamānasya puṃsaḥ vidhiḥ gale pāśam nidadhātiḥ rajvā vā bāhū badhnāti niṣedha adhikāre api surā pāna brāhmaṇa hana na āde pratyavāya sādhanatva avadhāraṇāt tad parijihīrṣayā nivṛttiḥ bhavati na vidhitaḥ yaḥ tu pratyavāyāt na bibheti sa vidhau api śrute na nivartate eva iti tasmāt pravṛtti nivṛttyoḥ na kāraṇam vidhiḥ iti tad artham api tad āśrayaṇam asāṃpratam

kaḥ ca ayam vidhiḥ nāma iti etat api na vidmaḥ nanu ca āhuḥ vidheḥ lakṣaṇam etāvat apravṛtta pravartanam atiprasaṅga doṣeṇa na ajñāta jñāpanam vidhiḥ bāḍham śrutaḥ ayam ślokaḥ kintu kaḥ asau apravṛtta pravartakaḥ iti na jānīmaḥ pravartaka svarūpe hi saṃśerate pravādukāḥ iti

kim liṅādiḥ śabdaḥ eva pravartakaḥ tad vyapāraḥ vā tad arthaḥ niyogaḥ phalam vā svarga ādiḥ śreyassādhana tvam vā rāga ādiḥ vā pravartaka svarūpa anavadhāraṇāt vidheḥ api anadhāraṇam iti yat tāvat uktam kim vidhi āśrayaṇena iti tatra ucyate yat ayam sādhana tvena yajeḥ abhihitaḥ anvayaḥ svargasya ca phalatvena saḥ eva mahimā vidheḥ

vidhivacanam antareṇa hi svarga kāmaḥ yajeta iti puruṣa lakṣaṇa artha svarga kāma śabdaḥ śuklaḥ hotā iti vat syāt tadā ca eka pada upādāna lakṣaṇa pratyāsatti sambandha nisarga ghaṭita pūrva aparībhūta svabhāva dhātu artha sādhyatā atikrameṇa dūrāt svargasya sādhya tvam anyatra upasarjanībhūtasya katham kalpayitum śakyate tasmāt eṣa viśiṣṭaḥ sādhya sādhana sambandhaḥ vidhi prasāda labhyaḥ eva bhavati na anyathā iti vidhiḥ āśrayaṇīyaḥ

katham punar vidhiḥ api amum sādhya sādhana bhāvam bodhayati ittham bodhayati sa hi sa pratyaya pravartaka svabhāvaḥ na ca apuruṣa artha rūpe vyāpāre puruṣaḥ prayatna śata preryamāṇaḥ api sa pratyayaḥ pravartate pravartamāne api puṃsi pravartaka tva ākhya nija svarūpa saṃkocam āśaṅkamānaḥ vidhiḥ puruṣa artha svabhāvam svargam sādhya tayā vyavasthāpayati yāgam ca asya sādhanatayā iti evam hi avabodhayataḥ asya pravartaka tvam nirvahati

yat tu darśite api svarga ādau phale na pravartate ced puruṣaḥ kim vidhiḥ kuryāt iti tat api uktam na hi vāyu ādi vat puruṣasya pravartakaḥ vidhiḥ vāyu ādiḥ khalu sa pratyayam api tad itaram api pravartayati vidhiḥ tu sa pratyayasya eva pravartakaḥ sa pratyayasya ca etāvat pravartanam yat pravartitaḥ aham iti jñāna jananam na ca phalam adarśayatā vidhinā sa pratyayasya īdṛśam jñānam janayitum śakyam phale tu darśite sati tat asya jñānam janitam eva anena janitam ced jñānam pramāṇa vṛttena pravartitaḥ eva asau vidhinā puruṣaḥ ālasya ādinā anarthi tvena vā bahis pravṛtti paryanta tayā ced na pravarteta mā pravartiṣṭa vidhinā tu sva kartavyam kṛtam pravartitaḥ aham iti jñāna jananāt anyaḥ hi pravartana avagamaḥ anyaḥ ca bāhyaḥ vyāpāraḥ

evam vidhi vaśāt eva sādhya sādhana bhāva dhīḥ sā hi prathama nirvṛtta preraṇā jñāna pūrvikā yajeta iti preraṇā pratīyamānā sādhya sādhana sambandham anavabodhayati vidhau na nirvahati iti tad kṛtaḥ tad avabodhaḥ ucyate niṣedhe ca na hanyāt iti niṣedhyamānasya bhāva arthasya anartha tām anavabodhayan vidhiḥ na rāgataḥ pravartamānam pumāṃsam niroddhum utsahate iti vidheya vat niṣedhye api tasya eva vyāpāraḥ iti avaśya āśrayaṇīyaḥ vidhiḥ

yaḥ ca eṣa paryanuyogaḥ kimartham vidhiḥ āśritaḥ iti sa tu khalu saralam atikṛtaḥ iva lakṣyate na hi vaya madya kṛta vidhim āśrayema jahīmaḥ vā pratipattāraḥ hi vayam vedasya na kartāraḥ tatra ca sa vidhikāni yajeta svarga kāmaḥ iti prabhṛtīni śrūyante teṣām mīmāṃsyamānaḥ arthaḥ īdṛś avatiṣṭhate svargaḥ sādhyaḥ yāgaḥ sādhanam iti sa ca ayam vidhi sāmarthī alabhyaḥ iti yuktam vidheḥ āśrayaṇam

yat tu pravartaka svarūpā niścayāt vidhera niścayaḥ iti tatra api ucyate phalam tāvat na pravartakam siddhi asiddhi vikalpa anupapatteḥ siddhasya phalasya apravartaka tvam siddha tvāt eva na hi yat yasya asti sa tad artham yatate na api asiddhasya khara viṣāṇa prakhyasya phalasya pravartaka tvam yuktam adṛṣṭa tvāt atha kāmanā viṣayīkṛtam phalam pravartakam iṣyate sā iyam kāmanā eva pravartikā bhavati na phalam tasmāt rāga ādiḥ pravartakaḥ iti āhuḥ

etat api na peśalam upajāta pravṛddhatara rāgasyā pikāmi amanopāya paricchedam antareṇa pravṛtti anupapatteḥ na hi svarga kāmaḥ sāṃgrahiṇīm anutiṣṭhati tad varam śreyassādhana tvam pravartakam loke api ca evam eva vyavahāraḥ dṛśyate harītakī ādīnām ārogya sādhana tām vaidya ācārya codanā ataḥ avagatya tad upayogādāḥ vātu ra janaḥ pravartate tṛpti sādhana tām odanasya manyamānaḥ tad bhakṣaṇāya bubhukṣitaḥ pravartate iti śreyassādhana tvam eva pravartakam

etat api na catur asram śreyassādhana tvam hi anavagatam avagatam vā pravartakam bhavet na anavagatam avyutpannasya pravṛtteḥ adarśanāt yaḥ hi harītakīnām a ārogya hetu tām na kutaścid adhigatavān na asau tad arthī api tām upayuṅkte tasmāt tad bodha hetuḥ pravartakaḥ sa ca dṛṣṭe viṣaye anvaya vyatireka ādeḥ apisaṃbhavati kim tena adṛṣṭe tu viṣaye śreya ssādhana adhigamaḥ śabda eka nibandhanaḥ iti tad adhigama upāyaḥ śabdaḥ eva pravartakaḥ atas eva śabdaḥ api na sva rūpa mātreṇa pravartakaḥ vāyu ādi tulya tva prasaṅgāt yadi hi pavanaḥ iva piśācaḥ iva ku nṛpaḥ iva śabdaḥ pravartakaḥ bhavet anavagata śabda artha sambandhaḥ api śravaṇa paravaśaḥ pravarteta na ca evam asti tasmāt artha pratītim upajanayataḥ śabdasya pravartaka tvam

na ca nāma pada pratītau vartamāna apadeśaka ākhyātāt padārtha pratītau ca satyām sa pratyayaḥ apravartamānaḥ kaścid dṛśyate iti liṅādiḥ eva śabdaḥ pravartaka abhidhāna dvāreṇa pravartakaḥ bhavitum arhati śabdasya ca jñāpaka tvāt cakṣuḥ ādi kāraka vailakṣaṇye sati api pratīti janmani karaṇa tvam aparihāryam karaṇam ca kārakam ca na nirvyāpāram sva kārya nirvṛtti kṣamam iti vyāpāraḥ tasya avaśyaṃbhāvī liṅā ādeḥ ca śabdasya na pratīti janma mātre vyāpāraḥ kintu puruṣa pravṛttau api tathā avagamāt liṅā artha avagame sati pravṛttiḥ dṛśyate iti tatra api liṅavyā pāraḥ prabhavati sa ca ayam liṅā ādi vyāpāraḥ śabda bhāvanā nāmadheyaḥ vidhiḥ iti ucyate saḥ eva pravartakaḥ

iha hi liṅa ādi yukteṣu vākyeṣu dve bhāvane pratīyete śabda bhāvanā artha bhāvanā ca iti tatra artha bhāvanā tāvat dhātu artha atirikta prayojaka vyāpāra ātmikā darśitā eva yaḥ bhavana kriyā kartṛ viṣayaḥ prayojaka vyāpāraḥ puruṣa sthaḥ yatra bhavana kriyāyāḥ kartā svarga ādiḥ karma tām āpadyate saḥ artha bhāvanā śabdena ucyate vyākhyātaḥ ca asau

yaḥ tu śabda gataḥ prayojaka vyāpāraḥ yatra puruṣa pravṛttiḥ sādhyatām pratipadyate sā śabda bhāvanā tathā hi uktam abhidhām bhāvanām āhuḥ anyām eva liṅa ādayaḥ iti liṅanta śabda śravaṇe hi yathā yajya ādi avacchinnam sva vyāpāram puruṣaḥ adhigacchati tathā tad anuṣṭhāne preritaḥ aham iti api pratipadyate tena anuṣṭheya artha pratipādanaḥ iva preraṇāyām api śabdasya sāmarthyāt bhāvanā dvaya pratipādakam liṅa ādi yuktam vākyam iṣyate tatas puruṣa vyāpāraḥ ca artha bhāvanā śabda vyāpāraḥ ca śabda bhāvanā avagamyate śabda vyāpāra ātmaka tvāt ca śabda bhāvanā śabdena abhidhīyate anavagatā ca satī na kārya aṅgam iti śabdena sā abhi dhīyate api tat uktam abhidhatte karoti ca iti

nanu śabda bhāvanā api bhāvanā ātmaka tvāt artha bhāvanā avat aṃśa trayam epakṣataḥ eva iti tat asyāḥ darśayitavyam ucyate bhāvya aṃśe tāvat asyāḥ puruṣa pravṛttiḥ upanipati iti uktam eva puruṣa preraṇa ātmakaḥ hi vidhiḥ śabda bhāvanā iti tad sādhyā puruṣa pravṛttiḥ eva tatra bhāvyatām pratipadyate karaṇa aṃśe tu tasyāḥ niyojya viṣaya samarpaka pada vyāpāraḥ niviśate yathā hi yajya ādinā svarga ādiḥ bhāvyaḥ saṃpadyate iti artha bhāvanāyām asau tad karaṇa tām abalambate evam iha api niyojya puruṣa pravṛtti viṣaya ādi avagamāt saṃpadyate iti tad abhidhāyaka śabda vyāpāraḥ tatra karaṇa tām pratipadyate itikartavya aṃśe tu arthavāda pada vyāpāraḥ asyāḥ avatiṣṭhate kevalam vidhi pada śravaṇe hi sati na tathā pravartayitum utsahante śrotāraḥ yathā artha vāda janita bahu prakāra karma prāśastyajñāna paripoṣita hṛdayāḥ santaḥ iti artha vādāḥ pravṛtti atiśaya hetavaḥ tena tad vyāpāraḥ itikartavyatā aṃśam asyāḥ pūrayati iti evam niyojya vyāpāraḥ bhāvyaḥ viṣaya ādi samarpaka pada vyāpāraḥ karaṇam arthavāda pada vyāpāraḥ itikartavyatā iti sā iyam tri aṃśā śabda bhāvanā sā eva ca vidhiḥ

na ca vidheḥ vākya arthān anvaya lakṣaṇaḥ doṣaḥ āśaṅkanīyaḥ eka pratyayaḥ pādāna lakṣaṇayā pratyāsatyā tad anvita tva avagamāt āhuḥ ca vidhi bhāvanayoḥ tu eka pratyaya grāhyatā kṛtaḥ dhātu arthāt prathamam tāvat saṃbandhaḥ vyavasīyate iti vidhiḥ bhāvanāyām puruṣam niyuṅkte yathā aaha sva vyāpāre hi puruṣaḥ kartṛ tvena niyujyate iti tayoḥ katham anvayaḥ syāt

nanu ca tvayā eva uktam dhātu arthāt pūrvataram tad bhāvanāyāḥ vidheḥ ca saṃbadhaḥ ava gamyate eka pada upādāne api dhātu arthaḥ tāvat prakṛti aṃśa abhidheyaḥ vidhi bhāvane tu dve api pratyaya aṃśena abhidhīyete iti atas ca svacchā eva bhāvanā vidhinā spṛśyate na viṣaya ādi anuraktā svacchā ca na prayoga yogyā bhavati yathā ca phala karaṇa iti kartavyatā aṃśa paripūrti prasthitā prayoga yogyā na tām vidhiḥ spṛṣṭavān avidhi spṛṣṭeṣu ca dhātu artha kāraka ādiṣu kim iti sa cetāḥ puruṣaḥ pravarteta iti ucyate yadi api vidhiḥ anadhigata dhātu artha anurāga tayā svacchām eva bhāvanām eka abhidhāna tvāt prathamam ākrāmati

tathā api tādṛśi tasyām sa pratyaya pravartana ātmaka nija svarūpa nirvahaṇam alabhamānaḥ na tāvatī eva viramati kintu pariṇīta bāla kanyakaḥ varaḥ iva tāvat vilambamānaḥ prasārita hastaḥ āste yāvat sarva aṅgasundarī prayoga yogyā bhāvanā bhavati āha ca yadi api aṃśaiḥ asaṃspṛṣṭām vidhiḥ spṛśati bhāvanām tathā api aśaktitaḥ na asau tanmātre paryavasyati anuṣṭheye hi viṣaye vidhiḥ puṃsām pravartakaḥ aṃśa trayeṇa ca āpūrṇām na anutiṣṭhati bhāvanām tasmāt prakrānta rūpaḥ api vidhiḥ tāvat pratīkṣate yāvat yogya tvam āpannā bhāvanā anya anapekṣiṇī iti

sā hi vākya antara upāttam api apekṣate prakaraṇa antara adhītam api vā aṃchati prakṛti vat bhāvalabhyam api yācate artha sāmarthya gamyam pramāṇam api spṛhayati iti evaṃvidhaḥ eṣa śabda pramāṇa mahimā iti sa ca ayam vyutpādana kramaḥ īdṛśaḥ vyākhyātṛbhiḥ upadiśyate ittham asya anvayaḥ ittham asya iti vākya arthaḥ punarbhāvanā ātmā avagamyamānaḥ ekayā eva buddhyā aneka jāti guṇa dravya kriyā ādi aṅga kalāpa kalmāṣita tanuḥ avagamyate tādṛśi ekā eva iyam vākyāt vākya artha buddhiḥ yathā āha bhāvanā eva hi vākya arthaḥ sarvatra ākhyātavattayā aneka guṇa jāti ādi kāraka artha anuraṃjitā ekayā eva ca buddhyā asau gṛhyate citra rūpayā padārtha āhita saṃskāra citra piṇḍa prastayā iti

ekaḥ eva ayam ati dīrdhaḥ krama vikasvaraḥ sakala aṅga paripūrita bhāvanā tattva viṣayaḥ pratibhāsaḥ yathā hi sthālī adhiśrayaṇāt prabhṛti ānirākāṅkṣa odana niṣpatteḥ ekā eva iyam pāka kriyā salila avaseka taṇḍulā vapana darvī vighaṭṭana asrāvaṇa ādi aneka kṣaṇa samudāya svabhāvā tathā prathama pada jñānāt prabhṛti ānirākāṅkṣa vākya artha paricchedāt ekā eva iyam śābdī pramitiḥ āha ca padāt prabhṛti yā ca eṣā prajñā jñātuḥ vijṛmbhate puṣpitā sā padārtheṣu vākya artheṣu phaliṣyati iti kṛtam ati vistareṇa saḥ ayam vākya arthaḥ bhāvanānām adheya kartṛ vyāpāraḥ svarga yāga ādiḥ arthaḥ yaḥ tu vyāpāraḥ praiṣa rūpaḥ liṅā ādeḥ vācyaḥ kārye vā tam vidhim saṅgirante

tat etat ananumanyamānāḥ anye pracakṣate yaḥ asau śabda bhāvana ākhyaḥ śabda vyāpāraḥ śabdasya kāryaḥ abhidheyaḥ ca tam abhidadhataḥ kurvataḥ vā śabdasya vyāpāra antaram asti na vā yadi tāvat na asti tat eṣa vyāpāra antara nirapekṣasva vyāpāram iva artham api vadatu viśrāmyatu vyāpāra kalpanā asti ced asya tad abhidhāne vyāpāra antaram tadā anavasthā pratīkāraḥ kaścid anveṣaṇīyaḥ na jāsau dūrāt api labhyate bhūta parispanda vyatirikta vyāpāra nirāsaḥ ca pramāṇa sāmānya lakṣaṇe vistareṇa kṛtaḥ iti asau mārgaḥ iha api anusaraṇīyaḥ

yaḥ ca asau vyāpāraḥ kriyate ca abhidhīyate ca sa kim pūrvam abhidhīyate tatas kriyate pūrvam vā kriyate paścāt abhidhīyate yugapad eva vā karaṇa abhidhāne iti na tāvat pūrvam abhidhīyate tatas kriyate anutpannasya abhidhāna anupapatteḥ na hi ajāte putre nāmadheya karaṇam artha asaṃsparśī ca tathā sati śabdaḥ syāt atas eva na yugapad ubhayam anutpanna tvānapāyāt prayatna gaurava prasaṅgāt ca na api kṛtvā abhidhānam viramya vyāpārā saṃvedanāt

api ca ayam tapasvī liṅā ādiḥ pratyayaḥ sati api go bṛndāraka tve katham amumati bṛhantam bhāram vakṣyati kartāram ca tad saṃkhyām ca ākhyāsyati bhāvanām abhidhāsyate śabda bhāvanām ca kariṣyati tām ca vadiṣyati iti durvahaḥ ayam bhāraḥ

kaḥ ca ayam śabda bhāvanā nāmadheyasya vidheḥ vākya arthe bhāvanāyām anvayaḥ iti vaktavyam nanu uktaḥ eva eka pratyaya abhidheya tva lakṣaṇaḥ saṃbandhaḥ iti na brūmaḥ ābhidhānikaḥ saṃbandhaḥ na uktaḥ iti kintu puruṣa vyāpāra ātmikāyāḥ artha bhāvanāyāḥ pradhāna tvena vākya artha tvāt tad apekṣyamāṇa phala karaṇa itikartavyatā aṃśa pūraṇena svarga kāma ādi pada antara abhidheyaḥ arthaḥ samanveti guṇa tvena śabda vyāpāraḥ tu tat apekṣitam anyatamam api na aṃśam pūrayitum alam iti tatra na guṇa tām abalambate na ca dvayoḥ pradhānayoḥ ghaṭaḥ paṭaḥ itivat vā pacati paṭhati iti vat vā saṃbandhaḥ upalabhyate

atha artha bhāvanā śabda bhāvana ākhya vidheḥ viṣaya samarpaṇena guṇa tām abalambate vidhiḥ tarhi vākya arthaḥ na bhāvanā tasyāḥ aprādhānyāt atas bhāvanā dvayam pratyaya arthaḥ iti na hṛdayaṃgamam etat eka abhidhāna abhidheya tvam ca na bhāvanayoḥ anyonya samanvaye kāraṇam akṣāḥ pādāḥ māṣāḥ iti ādau adarśanāt

kiṃca kasya anurodhena dve bhāvane pratyaya vācye iṣyete ucyate liṅā ādi śabda śravaṇe sati kārye ca preraṇāyām ca buddhiḥ utpadyate iti yadi evam ekaḥ eva tādṛśaḥ asau liṅarthaḥ bhavatu tat eka tvāt ca na paraspara samanvayaḥ cintayiṣyate na ca pratyaye api atibhāraḥ āropayiṣyate

nanu ekasya api liṅarthasya yadi śabdaḥ kārya tvam preraṇām ca bravīti tatas tad avasthaḥ eva ati bhāraḥ kaḥ ca asau ekaḥ kārya ātmā preraṇa ātmā ca tasya arthaḥ ucyate yaḥ liṅā ādi pratyayāt avagamyate yam abhivadataḥ na tasya ati bhāraḥ yatra na tad vyatirekeṇa pramāṇa antaram kramate sa niyogaḥ nāma avākya arthaḥ tathā hi vṛddha vyavahārataḥ śabdānām arthe vyutpattiḥ iti atra tāvat avivādaḥ eva vyavahāre ca vākya arthe vākyasya vyutpattiḥ vākyena sarvatra vyavahārāt tatra yajeta iti āditiṅanta pada yukteṣu pada antarāṇām arthaḥ tāvat āstām ākhyāta arthe hi avagate tadā anuguṇyena asau sthāsyati ākhyātasya ca yajeta iti evamādeḥ arthaḥ parīkṣyamāṇaḥ preraṇa ātmakaḥ eva avatiṣṭhate yatas pada antara sannidhāne sati api na preraṇā buddhiḥ upajāyate ākhyāta pada śravaṇe ca sati sā jāyate tasmāt tasya eva preraṇa ātmakaḥ arthaḥ tatra api tu juhoti ādi dhātu antara upajanana apāya paryālocanayā dhātoḥ tad pratītau vyabhicārāt pratyayasya ca avyabhicārāt tasya eva saḥ arthaḥ iti gamyate

kaḥ punar asau arthaḥ yasmin sati niyuktaḥ aham atra iti pratipadyate puruṣaḥ saḥ asau arthaḥ saḥ eva vidhiḥ iti ucyate vidhau hi liṅā ādi pratyayam smarati pāṇiniḥ na dhātu arthe yāga ādau na kartṛ vyāpāre bhāvanāyām vidhiḥ ca nāma preraṇa ātmakaḥ eva atas eva vartamāna apadeśika ākhyāta janita pratīti vilakṣaṇā iyam pratītiḥ yajeta iti atra hi praiṣa praiṣyayoḥ saṃbandhaḥ avagamyate anyaḥ eva ayam kriyā kartṛ saṃbandhāt praiṣa praiṣya saṃbandhaḥ

nanu yajeta iti kriyā kartṛ saṃbandhaḥ avagamyate na brūmaḥ na avagamyate iti kintu praiṣa praiṣya lakṣaṇaḥ api saṃbandhaḥ prathamam avagamyate preṣitaḥ hi kriyām kartum udyacchati iti nanu kriyā saṃbandhi tayā eva asau preṣyate yajatām bhavān iti satyam kriyā saṃbandhi tayā eva preṣyate preṣyate tu saḥ preṣyate ced ayam anyam tarhi saṃbandhaḥ kriyā saṃbandhāt tu ubhaya saṃbandhi tāmasya rāja gavī kṣīra vat avagamiṣyāmaḥ yathā gauḥ rājñā ca saṃbadhyate kṣīreṇa ca yā rāja saṃbandhinī sā kṣīra saṃbandhinī yā kṣīra saṃbandhinī sā rāja saṃbandhini iti evam iha api puruṣaḥ preṣitena ca saṃbhantsyate kriyayā ca yaḥ preṣyate sa karoti atha yaḥ karoti preṣyate saḥ iti

nanu na idam ubhayam bhavati praiṣaḥ api kriyā eva pravartanam hi kurvan pravartayati iti ucyate saḥ ayam kriyā sambandhaḥ eva bhavati na tatas anyaḥ praiṣa praiṣya saṃbandhaḥ iti syāt etat evam yadi vāyu ādi vat pravartane kartā liṅādiḥ syāt preritaḥ aham atraḥ iti tu jñāna janaka tvam vidheḥ pravartaka tvam saḥ eṣa pravartanam jñāpayati na karoti iti anyaḥ eva ayam kriyā kartṛ saṃbandhāt praiṣa praiṣya saṃbandhaḥ

nanu jñānam api kriyā eva tad karaṇe ca punar ayi saḥ eva ayam kriyā kartṛ saṃbandhaḥ mā evam kāraka jñāpakayoḥ bhedasya su prasiddha tvāt iha ca yaḥ ayam yāga puruṣayoḥ kriyā kartṛ saṃbandhaḥ tatas anyam praiṣa praiṣya saṃbandham upadarśayitum pravṛttāḥ smaḥ sa tatas vilakṣaṇaḥ pradarśitaḥ eva vailakṣaṇye api tasya yathākathaṃcid nāma kriyamāṇam na vārayāmaḥ

bhavatu ayam anyaḥ praiṣa praiṣya saṃbandhaḥ sa tu prathamam avagamyate iti eṣa kutas niścayaḥ uktam atra preṣitaḥ aham iti hi viditvā kriyāyām pravartate ācārya coditaḥ karomi iti hi dṛśyate yajeta iti śrute niyuktaḥ aham iti prathamam avagacchati tatas yajate tena ayam ādyaḥ saṃbandhaḥ pāścātyaḥ tu kriyā kartṛ saṃbandhaḥ tat yaḥ ayam liṅarthaḥ prathamam avagamyate praiṣaḥ nāma sā preraṇā sa niyogaḥ sa vākya arthaḥ

nanu vidhau iva nimantraṇa ādiṣu liṅa loṭau api smaryete eva satyam te tu preraṇāyāḥ eva aupādhikāḥ avāntara bhedāḥ sama hīna jyāyaḥ viṣayaḥ eva prayoga upādhi nibandhanaḥ eṣa preṣaṇāḥ dhyeṣaṇa ādi bheda vyavahāraḥ preṣaṇā tu sarvatra anusyūtā avagamyate tat uktam pravartaka tvam tu śabda arthaḥ sarvatra aparityāgāt iti sa ca ayam liṅā ādīnām arthaḥ praiṣaḥ ṇijartha vilakṣaṇaḥ pratīyate

nanu prayojaka vyāpāre ṇit vidhīyate prayojaka vyāpāraḥ ca praiṣaḥ praiṣe ca loḍa ādayaḥ vidhīyante iti ṇijarthaḥ eva loḍarthaḥ tathā ca kuru kuru iti yaḥ brūte sa kārayati iti ucyate na pratīti bhedāt anyā hi karotu kuryāt iti pratītiḥ anyā ca karoti kārayati iti pratītiḥ prayojaka vyāpāraḥ hi ṇijarthaḥ jñāpaka vyāpāraḥ tu liṅarthaḥ pravṛtta kriyā viṣayaḥ ca prayojaka vyāpāraḥ ṇijarthaḥ ihatu tad viparītaḥ tatra hi kāryam paśyataḥ pravartanam iha tu pravatitasya kārya darśanam iti mahān bhedaḥ

tatra yathā kurvantam kārayati tathā eva iha api praiṣaḥ pravartamānam prerayati na apravartamānam sthāvaram iti na hi vanaspatiḥ ucyate yajasva iti na sthāvara ādeḥ ayogya tvāt brāhmaṇa ādiḥ tu yaḥ preryate asā vapra vṛtta kriyaḥ eva na hi yajamānaḥ eva yajeta iti codyate kintu apravṛtta kriyaḥ eva iti sarvathā ṇijarthāt vilakṣaṇaḥ liṅarthaḥ

āha bhavatu ayam vilakṣaṇaḥ arthaḥ sa tu pramāṇa antara avagamyaḥ ced tad upadarśya tām ayam asau evaṃrūpaḥ iti pramāṇa antara anavagamyaḥ ced katham śabda eka gocare tatra saṃbandha vyutpattiḥ ucyate śabda eka gocaraḥ tu niyogaḥ vyutpattiḥ ca tatra sūpa pādā eva yaḥ hi yajeta dadyāt juhuyāt iti liṅa ādibhyaḥ vidhiḥ pratīyate katham asau liṅā ādīnām agamyaḥ iṣyeta vyutpattiḥ ca asya vyavaharāt avakalpate gaccha adhīṣvaḥ iti śrṛṇvan vṛddhaḥ ceṣṭamānaḥ dṛśyate ceṣṭā ca sva ātmani pravartikā avagama pūrvikā dṛṣṭā pratyakṣa dṛṣṭe ca āmra ādau sukha sādhana tayā anvaya vyatirekābhyām avagate tad anusmaraṇāt pravartamānaḥ kasmiṃścid ātmā ākūte samupajāte sati bhautikam vyāpāra mārabhate sa ca ātma dharmaḥ ātmā iva sva saṃvedyaḥ

ahaṃpratyagamyaḥ hi ātmā na asau parasmai darśayitum śakyate na ca na carcayitum śakyate etāvatā na anubhūyate iti na śakyate vaktum paraḥ api hi enam ahaṃpratyayena anubhavati eva tathā ayam api bhautika vyāpāra hetuḥ ātma ākūta viśeṣaḥ na pramāṇa antara vedyaḥ bhavati na ca na vedyate tad saṃvedane sati ceṣṭāyāḥ dṛṣṭa tvāt tasmāt param api gaccha adhīṣvaḥ iti śabda śravaṇe sati ceṣṭā āpannam dṛṣṭvā tasya api tādṛś preraṇa avagamaḥ anumīyate sa ca śabda antara śravaṇe sati api adṛśyamānaḥ liṅā ādi śravaṇe ca sati dṛśya mānaḥ tad arthaḥ eva iti anvaya vyatirekābhyām avagamyate itīyati iyam vyutpattiḥ

tat etat ātma pratyakṣam liṅā ādi śravaṇe sati preraṇa avagatiḥ bhavati prathama śrutāt ca liṅā ādeḥ asau na bhavati na ca pramāṇa antareṇa saḥ arthaḥ darśayitum śakyate kuryāt iti asya arthaḥ kuryāt iti anena eva pratipādyate na prakāra antareṇa iti evam vyutpattau saṃbhavantyām api yaiḥ agṛhīta sambandhaḥ eva liṅādiḥ svarūpa sāmarthyena eva prerakaḥ iṣyate te atyanta bhīravaḥ iti upekṣaṇīyāḥ

nanu yadi liṅā ādi vyatirekeṇa na anyatas niyogaḥ avagamyate katham asau niyoga śabdāt pratīyate katham vā niyośabdasya nāmnaḥ api arthaḥ pramāṇa antara gocaraḥ syāt ayi sādho na niyogaḥ nipūrveṇa yujinā ghañatena bodhayitum śakyate vyavahāra mātram etat svarūpam ākhyātum āśrīyate yathā tu yajeta iti evamādibhyaḥ śabdebhyaḥ saḥ avagamyate tathā na anyatas iti atas eva na pramāṇa antara gocaraḥ dharmaḥ iti āhuḥ liṅarthaḥ hi niyogaḥ vākya arthaḥ saḥ eva dharmaḥ sa ca na pramāṇa antara gamyaḥ iti

nanu liṅarthaḥ preraṇa ātmakaḥ ayam vyākhyātaḥ kārya ātmā ca ayam anuṣṭheyaḥ dharmaḥ saḥ eva ca vākya arthaḥ yuktaḥ kārye arthe vedasya prāmāṇyam iti hi mīmāṃsakāḥ tasmāt punar api bhāṭṭa pakṣa vat dvayam āpatati prerakaḥ ca vidhiḥ kārya rūpaḥ ca anuṣṭheyaḥ arthaḥ iti sukha edhitaḥ niranusandhānaḥ iva āyuṣmān evam vyavaharati na hi anyaḥ prerakaḥ anyaḥ ca anuṣṭheyaḥ iti uktam niyogaḥ eva prerakaḥ niyogaḥ eva ca anuṣṭheyaḥ

katham dvairūpyam asya śabdaḥ vadati iti ced mā evam preraka tvam eva śabda arthaḥ ārtham tu kāryatvam yatas vidhiḥ eva anuṣṭheyatayā avagamyate ācārya ājñām karomi rāja ājñām karomi iti kimartham tarhi viṣaya anuṣṭhānam iti ced na hi ājñā ghaṭa ādi vat sva rūpeṇa kartum śakyā api tu viṣaya dvārakam tad saṃpādanam kamaṇḍulam bibhṛhi iti ācāryeṇa ājñaptaḥ kamaṇḍulam bhṛtvā aacārya ājñām kṛtām manyate kaṭakam gaccha iti rājñā aaptaḥ kaṭakam gatvā rāja ājñām kṛtām manyate saḥ ayam niyogaḥ eva anuṣṭheyaḥ nanu rāja ājñayā karomi iti api vyapadeśaḥ dṛśyate sa ca ananuṣṭheyām eva ājñām darśayati mā evam tatra api ājñā eva anuṣṭheyā preṣāṇa abhiprāyeṇa tṛtīyā nirdeśaḥ iti evam kecid

anye tu śābdam kāryatvam niyogasya preraka tvam tu arthāt iti ācakṣate anuṣṭheya tā hi tasya nijam rūpam sva siddhaye sa tu niyojyam niyuṃjānaḥ prerakaḥ iti ucyate tat idam kārya tvam aparityakta preraka bhāvam asya avagamyate preraka tvam ca aparityakta kārya bhāvam iti anyatarat atra śābdam rūpam anyatarat ca artham rūpam iti na bhāṭṭaiḥ iva asmābhiḥ pratyaye guruḥ bhāraḥ āropitaḥ

sa ca ayam niyogaḥ pratīyamānaḥ yajeta svarga kāmaḥ iti anubandha dvaya avacchinnaḥ pratīyate yajya ādina asya viṣaya anubandhaḥ dhātunā ucyate svarga kāmaḥ iti adhikāra anubandhaḥ pada antareṇa arpyate tatra ca svarga kāmasya eva adhikāraḥ nirvahati yadi bhāva arthasya svargam prati sādhana tvam avagamyate evam tarhi svarga kāmena eva asau kṛtaḥ bhavati iti svarga kāma pada anvaye prāktanaḥ eva mārgaḥ anumantavyaḥ na punar svarga ādi phala pradarśana pūrvakam vidheḥ pravartaka tvam asvātantrya prasaṅgāt na hi īdṛśam śāstrasya dainyam yat phalam vinā puṃsaḥ pravartayitum na śaknoti iti anyathā yāvajjīvam yajeta iti ādau apravartakam śāstram syāt

kim yāvajjīvam iti ādi codanāḥ phala śūnyāḥ eva om iti ucyate na hi vidhiḥ phalam ākāṅkṣati api tu niyojyam viṣayam ca kasya niyogaḥ kutra niyogaḥ iti te ete ubhe api ākāṅkṣe paripūrṇe tatra jīvataḥ niyogaḥ yāge ca niyogaḥ iti atas param phala kalpanam puruṣa buddhi prabhavam bhavati na śāstrī iyam kāma adhikāre tu niyojya tā eva anyathā svarga kāmasya na upapadyate iti svargasya sādhya tvam abhyupagatam na punar vidheḥ phala artha tvāt atas eva na tatra vaidhī pravṛttiḥ lipsayā eva pravṛtta tvāt āha ca tasya lipsā arthaṃlakṣaṇāḥ iti sādhya sādhana bhāva pratipādana paryavasitaḥ hi tatra vidhi vyāpāraḥ na prayoga paryavasitaḥ iti

atas eva śyena ādeḥ adharma tvam tatra hi abhicaran iti śatrā śatrum vaidikena upāyena jighāṃsuḥ adhikārī darśitaḥ tasya na tatra śāstram pravartakam jānāti eva asau mayā etat kartavyam upāyam tu na vedaḥ iti evam upāya mātram asya upadiśyate śyenaḥ śyanam kuru iti tu na vidhiḥ prabhavati jighāṃsāyāḥ eva tatra pravartaka tvāt atas śyena ādeḥ adharma tvāt tad vyudāsa artha pada upādānam codanā lakṣaṇaḥ arthaḥ dharmaḥ iti kāma adhikāreṣu hi iti kartavya tā aṃśe śāstrīyā pravṛttiḥ yathā uktam kratu arthaḥ hi śāstrāt avagamyate iti bhāva artha mātrasya hi karaṇa tvam avagatam itikartavya tā aṃśaḥ tu na karaṇa tva avagati belāyām upanipatitaḥ iti tatra lipsāyāḥ abhāvāt śāstram eva pravartakam

atas eva agnīṣomīyahiṃsāyāḥ na adharma tvam na hiṃsyāt sarvāḥ bhūtāni iti niṣedhaḥ sāmānya śāstram sāmānya śāstram ca viśeṣa śāstra kroḍīkṛta viṣaya parihāreṇa pravartate iti agnīṣomīyahiṃsāyāḥ śāstrīya tvāt na niṣedha vidhiḥ anartha tām bodhayet iti nanu śyene api śāstrīyā pravṛttiḥ pravartaka tvam hi vidheḥ svarūpam pramāṇa antara vilakṣaṇam na anvaya vyatireka vat sādhya sādhana pratīti mātra paryantaḥ hi vidhi vyāpāraḥ bhavitum arhati iti sarvatra vidheḥ prayoktṛ tva anapāyāt eva mevaceyam pravṛttiḥ śyenena yajeta iti

ucyate pravartitaḥ aham iti jñāna jananam vidheḥ preraka tvam tata satyam sarvatra tulyam karaṇe ca śyene itikartavya tāyām agnīṣomīye bāhye tu pravṛtti lakṣaṇe bhautike vyāpāre yatra lipsā ādi prakāra antaram asti tatra bhagavati api vidheḥ prayauktṛ śaktiḥ udāste paśu puroḍāśa prayāja vat tatra udāsīne vidhau niṣedha śāstram avataratina hiṃsyāt iti

yadi tu sarvatra eva prayoktṛ śaktiḥ udāsīnā bhavet tadā jyotiṣṭomān na viśiṣyeta śyenaḥ śāstrīyāyām pravṛttau agnīṣomīya iva niṣedha śāstrasya anavakāśāt jyotiṣṭome anullaṃghita niṣedhaḥ adhikārī svargasya aniṣiddha tvāt śyene tu hiṃsāyāḥ pratiṣiddha tvāt utkrānta niṣedhaḥ adhikārī iti ced mā evam adhikāri daśāyām api bhavat mate vidheḥ prayoktṛ tva anapāyāt na niṣedha śāstram avakāśam labhate iti śyene api na avadhīrita niṣedhaḥ adhikārī syāt

nanu na vidhiḥ phale prayojyam prerayati phalam kuru iti karmaṇi tu enam pravartayati yajasva iti tena adhikāri daśāyām apratihataḥ niṣedha śāstra avakāśaḥ āyuṣman asmat pakṣam eva āśritaḥ asi phale ced na pravartayati vidhiḥ puruṣam phala arthi tvāt eva enam upāye pravartamānam tatra api na prerayet upāya anabhijñasya tu upāyam eva darśayet yāvat aprāptam hi vidheḥ viṣayaḥ tad uktam jānāti eva asau mayā etat kartavyam upāyam tu na vedaḥ iti pratītiḥ api iyam īdṛśī abhicaran yajet iti yadi tvam śāstrīyena upāyena vairiṇam hantum udyataḥ śyenena jahi śyenaḥ tava upāyaḥ iti arthaḥ tad alam ati prasaṅgena kāma adhikāreṣu tāvat na phala ākāṅkṣī vidhiḥ phalam tu adhikāre hetuḥ iti sthitam

pratiṣedha adhikāre api pratyavāyaḥ na kalpate niṣedhyāt viṣayāt eva labdha tvāt adhikāriṇaḥ tatra asau kalpyamānaḥ api naraka ādi phala udayaḥ avaidha tvam prapadyeta na hi ākāṅkṣedṛśī vidheḥ vidheḥ apekṣe dve eva niyojya viṣayau prati tad pūraṇena tṛptaḥ tu na vā aṃchati tatas adhikam niyojyaḥ tāvat etāvān kruddhaḥ ari hanana udyataḥ viṣayaḥ tad nivṛttiḥ ca niyogaḥ yatra gamyate

nanu etāvat na vibudhyāmahe niṣedha vidheḥ kaḥ viṣayaḥ iti bhāva arthāḥ karma śabdāḥ tebhyaḥ kriyā pratīyeta iti sthite nañarthaḥ tāvat pūrva aparībhūta tva abhāvāt na vidheḥ viṣayaḥ ananvita abhidhānāt ca na hi nañaḥ anantaram liṅa vibhaktiḥ śrūyate api tu hanteḥ hananam api na vidheḥ viṣayaḥ tasya dharma tva prasaṅgāt nañprayogasya vaiyarthya prasakteḥ hanane ca puruṣasya svatas pravṛtteḥ ca nañviśiṣṭaḥ api na hanti arthaḥ asya viṣayaḥ tayoḥ viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāva abhāvāt yuktam dadhnā juhoti iti home dadhi anurakta tā hanteḥ svarūpa nāśāt tu na nañartha anurakta tā puruṣa prayatnaḥ api na kevalaḥ vidheḥ viṣayaḥ svatā ssiddha tvāt na api nañartha anuraktaḥ kutra api nañarthasya viśeṣaṇa tva anupapatteḥ

atha ayamabrāhmaṇa ādi nyāyena hantau paryudaste bhāva artha antare niyogaḥ kalpyate na hanyāt iti kaḥ arthaḥ anyat kim api kuryāt iti tarhi kim tad bhāva antaram iti na vicārayitum śakyam yat kiṃcid iti ced na tasya svatassiddha tvena vidhi anarha tvāt avaśyam jīvan pumān kiṃcid karoti paṭhati gacchati bhaṅkte ca

atha viṣaya aṃśam parihṛtya pramāṇa aṃśe nan niviśate sā hi pravartamāna pumāṃsam ruṇaddhi yat hanyāt tat na iti tat api anupapannam anvita abhidhānena vidhi vibhakteḥ hantinā avaruddha tvāt preraṇa śakti svabhāvaḥ vidhiḥ sthitaḥ yaḥ tu niṣedha ātmā nan pārśve sthitaḥ tatra na vidhiḥ saṃkrāmati saṃkrāntau api nañaḥ ca saṃbandhe sati vidheḥ svarūpa nāśaḥ avagamyate svabhānaḥ hi eṣa nañaḥ yat ayam yena yena saṃbadhyate tasya tasya abhāvam bodhayati iti atas vidhi saṃbandhe nañaḥ iṣyamāṇe etāvān vākya arthaḥ avatiṣṭhate hanana vidhiḥ na asti iti tatas ca hananasya vidhi tvam ca syāt

atra ucyate dadhnā juhoti iti homasya vacana antara codita tvāt vidhi vibhakti śaktiḥ upapadam saṃkāmati iti yathā varṇitam evam iha api hanane svatas pravṛtta tvena vidhi vaiphalyāt nañaḥ ca śrūyamāṇasya anarthakya prasaṅgāt vidhāyikā śaktiḥ nañartham eva spṛśati iti kim na iṣyate nanu ukta matpra bhāva arthāḥ karma śabdāḥ iti tatra dadhi anuraktaḥ homaḥ eva vidhīyate iti phalataḥ dadhi vihitam bhavati na pramāṇataḥ iha tu nañaḥ tad upamarda svabhāva tvāt saṃsargaḥ dadhi ādeḥ iva kalpate

mā evam nivṛttim eva kurvan viśeṣaṇībhavati sā iyam nañupahite hantau śrute hanana nivṛttiḥ gamyate yathā siddha rūpa dadhi anupraveśe api na homasya sādhyamānā avasthā nivartate tathā nañanuviddha hanti artha avagatau na pūrva aparībhāva buddhiḥ nivartate na hi abrāhmaṇa vat na hanyāt iti siddha rūpa buddhiḥ saḥ ayam hanana nivṛtti rūpaḥ pūrva aparībhūtaḥ arthaḥ vidhi viṣayaḥ bhavati

athavā vibhakti arthena nañ saṃbhantsyati śuddhasya liṅā ādeḥ arthaḥ pravartakaḥ nañupahitasya tasya arthaḥ nivartakaḥ iti śabda śaktiḥ eva eṣā vā aparyanuyojya iti yat tu sākṣāt nañaḥ anantaram vidhi vibhaktiḥ na utpadyate tat tasya ādhātu tvāt dhātoḥ pare tiṅādayaḥ pratyayāḥ bhavanti na anyasmāt iti yogya tayā tu nañarthena tasya saṃbandhaḥ na ca tatra ayam arthaḥ avatiṣṭhate hanana vidhiḥ na asti iti kintu nañupahitaḥ vidhiḥ audāsīnye puruṣam niyuṅkte tad avacchedakaḥ ca hantiḥ anyathā sarva kriyā audāsīnyam pratīyeta iti alam ati vimardena niṣedha vidheḥ api siddhaḥ anubandha dvaya yogaḥ

evam niyoga vyāpāre samāpte phala kalpanā nṛ buddhi prabhavā eva syāt atas sa apekṣatā bhavet katham naraḥ nivarteta pratyavāya bhayāt vinā mā nivartiṣṭa vidhinā tāvat uktam nivartanam pravṛddhatara rāga andhaḥ pratyavāye api kalpite na nivarteta iti evam kim vidhera pramāṇa tā phalam bhavatu mā vā bhūt puruṣaḥ api pravartatām mā pravartiṣṭa vā sve tu na asti arthe khaṇḍanā vidheḥ pravartana avagāma janane hi vidhi vyāpāraḥ iti asakṛt uktam tatra ca asya na kiṃcid vaikalyam

nanu vidheḥ phala apekṣā na asti ced kim tarhi aśrūyamāṇa phaleṣu viśva jit ādiṣu svarga ādi phalam kalpyate anabhijñaḥ devānāṃpriyaḥ na tatra vidheḥ phala apekṣā na ca phalam tatra kalpyate kintu aśrūyamāṇa tvā dadhikāra anubandhasya niradhikārasya ca vidheḥ vidhi tva anirvāhāt adhikāra anubandhaḥ kalpyate tatra sarvān pratyaviśiṣṭa tvāt svarga kāmaḥ codanā śeṣa bhāvena niyojyaḥ kalpyate na ca iyam pauruṣī kalpanā śruti eka deśaḥ saḥ iti hi tad vidaḥ tat iyam adhikāra anubandha kalpanā na phala kalpanā iti saḥ ayam anubandha dvaya avacchinnaḥ niyogaḥ vākya arthaḥ

vākya artha tvam ca asya pradhāna tvāt anyaḥ hi yajyādiḥ arthaḥ avagamyamānaḥ tad anupraveśena pratīyate iti guṇaḥ bhavati niyogaḥ tu sva mahima ākṣipta dṛṣṭa upakāra aneka kriyā kāraka kalāpa upabṛṃhita svarūpaḥ pratīyate iti prādhānyam abalambate kāryam ced pradhānam ucyate niyogaḥ eva kāryam phalam ced pradhānam uyate tat api na siddham api tu sādhyam sādhya tvam ca asya niyoga adhīnam iti niyogaḥ eva pradhānam puruṣaḥ tu niyojyamāna tvāt apradhānam iti

evam niyogaḥ eva pradhāna tvāt vākya arthaḥ sa ca pratīti bheda paryālocanayā catur avasthaḥ ucyate utpatti vidhiḥ viniyoga vidhiḥ prayoga vidhiḥ adhikāri vidhiḥ iti utpatti vidhiḥ agnihotram juhoti iti agnihotra ākhya karma svarūpa utpāda vyatirekeṇa artha antara anavagamāt viniyoga vidhiḥ dadhnā juhoti iti utpatti vidhitaḥ pratipanne bhāva arthe tatra dadhi ādi guṇa viniyoga avagamāt

adhikāri vidhiḥ agnihotram juhuyāt svarga kāmaḥ iti nirjñāte karmaṇi tatra adhikṛtasya puṃsaḥ tatas avagamāt prayoga vidhiḥ tu yaḥ krama paryantam prayoge padārthān avagamayati ayam ca adhikāra vidheḥ eva vyāpāra viśeṣaḥ iti tat eva asya udāharaṇam agni hotram juhuyāt svarga kāmaḥ iti kvacid ekasmin eva vākye rūpa catuṣṭayam vidheḥ avagamyate na tatra pṛthak udāharaṇam apekṣyate yathā etasya eva revatīṣu vāravantīyam agniṣṭoma sāma kṛtvā paśu kāmaḥ hi etena yajeta iti

anyāni api niyogasya rūpāṇi vyāpāra bhedāt avagamyante sa hi bhāva artha sidhi artham tat samartham artham ākṣipati iti tad prayojakaḥ ucyate yathā māṇavaka sthasya adhyayanasya ācārya karaṇa vidhiḥ kvacid anya ākṣipte vastuni labdhe sati tatra aprayojakaḥ vidhiḥ bhavati yathā kraya niyukta eka hāyinyā lābhe sati na pādapa aṃsu grahaṇa artham anyām eka hāyanīm ākṣipati vidhiḥ iti prakaraṇa paṭhita padārtha paṭala parigrahāt ca grāhakaḥ iti vidhiḥ ucyate

kvacid prakaraṇa paṭhitasya api tena agṛhītasya dvādaśa upasada ādeḥ prakaraṇāt utkarṣa darśanāt atas eva niyoga garbhaḥ viniyogaḥ iti ācakṣate kvacid viniyojaka śruti ādi pramāṇa virahe api paśu eka tva ādi upādānam śeṣīkurvan upādāyakaḥ iti ucyate paśunā yajeta iti vibhakyā hi prātipadikā arthaḥ viniyuktaḥ tad stham tu eka tvam uktam eva na viniyuktam ekena iti aśravaṇāt paśuḥ upādīyamānaḥ na saṃkhyā rahitaḥ upādātum śakyate śruta saṃkhyā parityāga kāraṇā bhāvāt ca ekatva viśiṣṭaḥ paśuḥ upādīyate iti upāda ānata śeṣīkṛtam eka tvam

vaikṛtaḥ tu saurya ādi vidhiḥ prākṛta miti karta vyātā jātam ākarṣaḥ caḥ dakaḥ iti ucyate tat idam ekasya eva bhagavataḥ liṅarthasya prayoktṛ śavita khacita ātmanaḥ pracura vyāpāra vaicitryam upadarśitam iti alam anayā mahām ati mānasavatyā mīmāṃsā artha kathayā saḥ ayam īdṛśaḥ niyogaḥ vākya arthaḥ tasya dvādaśa lakṣaṇyām tad tad rūpam prakāśitam tat na iha likhyate asmābhiḥ grantha gaurava bhīrubhiḥ diṅa mātram tu etat ākhyāyi niyogasya yathā aagamam amuṣman api vākya arthe vivadante manīṣiṇaḥ

liṅā ādeḥ avagamyamānaḥ kārya rūpaḥ preraṇa ātmā ca vākya arthaḥ niyogaḥ iti uktam na ca asau evaṃrūpaḥ api paridṛśyamāna bhāva artha ādi vyatiriktaḥ avagamyate kriyā eva tāvat kārya ātmā preraṇa ātmā phala arthitā pratīyate tatas anyaḥ tu niyogaḥ na ubhaya ātmakaḥ nanu anyaḥ eva kriyā kartṛ saṃbandhāt praiṣa praiṣya sambandhaḥ hi darśitaḥ na yuktaḥ asau kuryāt ityādi śabdebhyaḥ kriyā ādi vyatirekiṇaḥ na artha antarasya saṃvittiḥ kasya cit preraṇa ātmanaḥ

kim idānīm karoti kuryāt ityādi ca tulye ete pratipattī abhinavam idam śabda jña tvam āyuṣmataḥ na brūmaḥ na bhinne ete pratipattī iti karoti iti pravṛtta kriyaḥ ucyate vartamāna kāla avacchinnaḥ ca kim tu asau praiṣaḥ tatas avagamyamānaḥ api prerakaḥ na bhavati na ca kāryaḥ iti brūmaḥ nanu preraka tvena eva avagamyamānaḥ katham prerakaḥ na bhavet etat eva asya praiṣa tvam yat preraka tvam satyam preraka tvena eva asau gamyate na tu asau tathā bhavati vyavahāra mātram etat rāja ājñayā karomi iti kāryatvam api asya prakriyā mātram rāja ājñām karomi iti

ājñā hi nāma na eva anyā saṃpādya tvena gamyate na anuṣṭhātuḥ iyam buddhiḥ ājñā saṃpādyatām iti evam hi yasya kasya api pravarteta saḥ ājñayā na ca iha vāla unmatta ādi vacanāt phala varjitāt sati api preraṇa ajñāne pravartante sa cetasaḥ bhayam na āśaṅkyate yasmāt phalam vā api samīhitam tathāvidhasya rājñaḥ api na ajñā anuṣṭhīyate janaiḥ vartamāna apadeśe api phalam yatra avagamyate tatra pravartate lokaḥ liṅā ādiṣu aśruteṣu api bhavati ārogya saṃpattiḥ bhuṃjānasya harītakīm tad kāmaḥ bhakṣayet ca iti kaḥ viśeṣaḥ pravartane anvaya vyatirekābhyām tat evam anumanyate preraka tvam phalasya eva na niyoga ātmanaḥ punar

tatra etat smāt loke bhavatu phala arthi tvāt pravartanam āriḥ ādhayiṣate preraka atiśaya anuvartane vā tasya pāraṃparyeṇa phala hetu tvāt vede tu vaktuḥ abhāvāt preraṇa avagamāt eva pravṛttiḥ unmatta vākyāt api liṅā ādi yuktāt na preraṇa avagamaḥ na asti bhavan api doṣa darśanāt upekṣyate unmattaḥ evam pralapati iti vede punar yajeta iti atra preraṇa avagamāt parityāga kāraṇa abhāvāt tatas eva pravartanam pravarta na abhāve api na vedasya aprāmāṇyam pramāṇa vyāpārasya tena nirvartita tvāt iti uktam

ucyate vede api vaktā asti tad āśaya vaśena tatra api phala arthinām pravartanam iti saṃbhavat api idam uttaram na ācakṣmahe kathā antara prasaṅgāt kitvidaṃbrūmaḥ preṣaṇa avagamāt eva pravṛtti siddhau svarga kāma padam bādari vat anyathāvyākhyāyatām adhikāra anubandha abhidhāne puruṣa viśeṣaṇa mātram etat bhavatu kim svarga sādhyaka tva kalpanayā viśeṣaṇa tvam eva anyathā na nirvahati iti ced āyātam tarhi phalasya sādhya tvam tat ced sādhya tvena avagamyate tasya eva sāmarthya siddham loka anuguṇam avyabhicāri ca pravartaka tvam utsṛjya na preraṇa avagamasya tat vaktum arhasi iti niyogāt atha niṣpattiḥ phalasya iti abhidhīyate phalam pratyaṅga bhūta tvāt avākya artha tvam āpatet

nanu vidhi arthaḥ na bhāva artha vat phale karaṇam yena asya tad aṅga tvam syāt ākṣepaka tvāt tu tasya phala artha tvam ucyate prayoktṛ tvam hi tasya nijam rūpam yadi evam bhāva arthaḥ eva sādhyaḥ bhavatu vidhi arthasya tu kim anuṣṭhayetvamucyate saḥ api bhāva artha siddhyā saṃpadyate kṛtaḥ mayā svāmi niyogaḥ iti vyavahārāt iti ced bhāva arthāt tarhi niṣpattiḥ niyogasya phalasya ca iti ekatra pada grāme vākya artha dvayam āpatet

kiṃca anvitā abhidhānena viṣaya tva avadhāraṇāt niyogasya eva bhāva artha niṣpādya tvam pratīyate sa tu bhāva arthataḥ siddhaḥ phalāya yadi kalpyate para artha tvāt avākya arthaḥ bhavet iti upavarṇitam bhāva arthaḥ tu dvayam kuryāt yugapad vā krameṇa vā yugapad na asya sāmarthyam samatvam ca dvayoḥ bhavet

niyogaḥ ca śabda eka gocara tvāt mā darśi phalam tu svarga paśu ādi tena saha niṣpadyamānam kim iti na gṛhyate krama pakṣe pūrvam vā niyogaḥ paścāt phalam pūrvam vā phalam paścāt vā viniyogaḥ siddhyet iti yadi pūrvam niyogaḥ tadā niyogasya asaṃpādya tvāt tad viṣaya lipsāyāḥ anupapatteḥ karaṇa aṃśe api vaidhī pravṛtti ssyāt

yathā niyoga niṣpattiḥ prayāja ādi kṛtena tu tatas pravṛttiḥ śāstrīyāḥ bhāva arthe api tathā bhavet iṣyate eva iti ced nanu evam tasya lipsā artha lakṣaṇa iti abhyadhāyi yat śyena ādīnām adharma tvam varṇitam tat viruddhyate atha pūrvam phala siddhiḥ tatas niyoga siddhiḥ tarhi phalasya tadānīm darśanam bhavet siddha tvāt na ca bhāva artha velāyām putra paśu ādi dṛśyate adṛśyamānam api etat siddha vimiti vismayaḥ

atas ca yat kaiścid uccate svarga siddhim avāntara vyāpārīkṛtya niyaḥ gameva bhāva arthaḥ saṃpādayati iti tat api apāstam avāntara vyāpārasya jvalana ādeḥ iva pradhāna vyāpārāt pūrvam darśana prasaṅgāt iti atha ucyate svarga kāmasya svargam sādhayitum udyacchataḥ yāge niyogaḥ yaḥ saṃpādyaḥ śrūyate sa ced saṃpannaḥ śabda vṛttena phalam api saṃpannam eva ānubhāvikī tu svarga ādi siddhiḥ kāla antare bhaviṣyati iti etat ayaktam siddhi dvyānupalaṃbhāt na hi ekā śābdī siddhiḥ anyā ca ānabhāvikrī phala siddhiḥ kutastyeti cintyam

kāla antare ca bhāva arthaḥ kṣaṇika tvāt na vidyate śakti ādi rūpam ca apūrvam na bhavadbhiḥ upeyate bhavantaḥ hi apūrva śabdena dharma śabdena ca niyogam eva upacaranti na ca niyogaḥ śakti vat ātma saṃskāra vat vā kāla antara sthāyī bhavatī sa hi preraṇa ātmakaḥ kārya rūpaḥ vā na ubhayathā api sthairyam abalambate

tatra etat syāt niyoga siddhiḥ ākṣitta phala siddhiḥ bhavati viṣaya ādi anubandha avacchinnaḥ hi asau eva anuṣṭheyaḥ tatra yathā tena tena kāraka cakreṇa kriyā kalāpena vinā saṃpattim alabhamānaḥ tat tadākṣipati tathā adhikāra anubandha bandhyaḥ api na asau saṃpattim adhigacchati iti tam api ākṣipati yaḥ ca ayam adhikāra anubandha ākṣepaḥ saḥ eva ayam phala ākṣepeṇa tu vidheḥ phalākṣepi ta iti uktam etat ayuktam yaḥ hi yena dinā kāmam na siddhyet sa tam ākṣipet niyojya mātra ākṣepe tu niyogaḥ na phala ātmakaḥ

niyojyaḥ caṇḍāla sparśanena iva svarga kāmana utpāda mātreṇa niyojyatām pratipannaḥ iti katham niyojya ākṣepaḥ eva phalākṣepaḥ nanu ca svarga kāmaḥ atra niyojyaḥ na anyathā bhavet yadi svargasya saṃpattim na adhigacchet sva karmaṇaḥ na etat evam narecchā mātram eva idam na śabdaḥ tu iyati kṣamaḥ niyojyaḥ svarga kāmaḥ hi bhavet jīvanavān iva

nanu loke kāmyamānasya sādhya tvam dṛṣṭam harītakīm bhakṣayet ārogya kāmaḥ iti tena vede api yajeta svarga kāmaḥ iti svargasya sādhya tvam avabhotsyāmahe sādho loke api katham etat avagatam āyuṣmatā niyojya samarpaka pada vācya paryālocanena vidhi vṛtta parīkṣayā vā padārthaḥ tāvat etāvān evaṃcātaḥ hi asau iti idam tu siddhyati etasmāt iti tasya na gocaraḥ vidheḥ eṣa svabhāvaḥ ced āyuṣman sādhu buddhyase bhāṭṭaiḥ kim aparāddham te nitye api phala vādibhiḥ

adhikārī anupādeya viśeṣaṇa viśeṣitaḥ jīvan vā svarga kāmaḥ apitsamānaḥ kāmya nityayoḥ vidhi vīrya prabhāvaḥ tu dvayoḥ api tathāvidhaḥ sa pratyaya preraka tām vidhiḥ na upaiti niṣphalaḥ nanu kāmanā adhikāre svargaḥ śrūyate nitya adhikāre tu asau na śrūyate āśrūyamāṇaḥ kasya anurodhena kalpyate vidheḥ eva iti brūmaḥ svargeṇa śrutena api kim kariṣyati yadi asau vidhinā na apekṣyata ghṛta kulyāḥ asya bhavanti ityādi vat aśrutaḥ api ca asau vidhinā aakṛṣyate eva tasmāt vidhiḥ eva atra pramāṇam na śravaṇa aśravaṇe iti kāmya vat nitye api phalam abhyupagantavyam na vā kvacid api iti

pratiṣedha adhikāre api vidhi vṛtta parīkṣayā evam naraka pāta ādi phala yogaḥ na durbhaṇaḥ yena hi durviṣaha kleśa dveṣa kaluṣita manasā brāhmaṇa hananam sukha sādhanam iti kartavyam iti gṛhītam nirargala rāga rasikena surā pānam sukha sādhanam iti gṛhītam sa tatas vidhinā vāryeta yadi tad asukha sādhanam iti jñāpyate tasmāt nityeṣu pratyavāya parihāraḥ iva upātta durita kṣavaḥ iva vā pratiṣidhyamāneṣu karmasu naraka pātaḥ phalam iti abhyupagamanīyam itarathāḥ hi artha anartha vivekaḥ na siddhyati evam ca brahmahatyā ādeḥ api na eva asti adharma tā kim punar śyena vajra ādeḥ iti artha grahaṇam vṛthā

karaṇa aṃśe api lipsātaḥ pravṛttiḥ yadi upeyate itikatavya tā aṃśe tu śāstrāt yadi tat api asat na hi tad karaṇam śuddham sva phalāya upakalpate sa iti kartavya tākam hi karaṇam karaṇam viduḥ avāntara vibhāgaḥ eva eṣaḥ karaṇa iti kartavya tā lakṣaṇaḥ sakala aṅgaḥ bṛṃhita svarūpaḥ tu bhāva arthaḥ kāmyamāna upāya tām pratipadyate na ekena api aṃśena nyūnāḥ atas eva kāmyānām karmaṇām sarva aṅga upasaṃhāreṇa prayogam icchanti tasmāt karaṇa vat iti kartavya tāyām api lipsātaḥ eva pravṛttiḥ syāt ubhayatra api lipsātaḥ sati ca evam pravartane agnīṣomīyahiṃsā ādeḥ śyena ādi vat adharma tā

yat api uktam kāma adhikāreṣu kāmyamāna bhāva arthayoḥ upāya upeya bhāva mātra pratipādana paryavasitaḥ vidhi vyāpāraḥ iti tat api na samyak vidhi puruṣayoḥ him prerya preraka bhāva lakṣaṇaḥ saṃbandhaḥ tatra yāga ādayaḥ viṣaya tvena pratīyante neṣyamāṇa upāya tvena sādhya sādhana mātra pratipādana paryavasita vyāpāraḥ tu vidhiḥ viniyoga paraḥ eva syāt tatas ca apravṛtta pravartakam nāma nijam rūpam jahyāt vidheḥ catur avastha tvam phalataḥ kila kathyate preraka tvam ca tad rūpam sarva avasthā anugāmi yat kārya ātma tā api vidhi arthe preraṇā jñapti pūrvikā preryeṇa eva satā puṃsā tat kāryam avadhāryate liṅā ādi śrutitaḥ ca ādau preraṇā eva pratīyate sādhya sādhana saṃbandha buddhiḥ tat buddhi pūrvikā

nanu evam kāmyeṣu vidhitaḥ pravṛtta aviṣyamāṇāyām apravartamānaḥ pratyaveyāt vidhi atikramāt mā evam svargam siṣā dhayiṣoḥ tatra adhikārāt anyaḥ tu anadhikṛtaḥ eva kṣatriya ādiḥ iva vaiśya stome na asau akurvan pratyavāyam arhati svarga arthī tu vidhitaḥ pravartate eva lipsayā tu karaṇa aṃśe pravṛttiḥ iṣyamāṇā kratu artham itikartavyatā aṃśam api mā evam spṛśet kratu upakāra kāmaḥ hi tatra pravartate iti evam sarvatra vidhi ḥ utsīdet eva iti alam prasaṅgena

api ca pramāṇa antara saṃparka vikale bhavataḥ katham niyoga ātmani vākya arthe vyutpattiḥ vyavahārataḥ nanu uktam ākūta viśeṣa pūrvikām ceṣṭām ātma niṣṭhām dṛṣṭvā paratra api tathā anumānam iti ayuktam idam sva ātmani api preraṇa avagama nimitta abhāvāt na hi ātmā iva saṃvid iva preraṇa avagama nimitta abhāvāt preraṇā sva prakāśā preraṇā saṃvid sva prakāśa iti ced tad utpāde tarhi nimittam tāvat mṛgyam na tāvat śabdaḥ tadānīm vyutpatti abhāvāt sva ātmani preraṇa avagama pūrvikām hi ceṣṭām upalabdhavataḥ te paratra ceṣṭā darśanāt tad anumānam setsyati tad nimittam liṅādiḥ śabdaḥ iti bhotsyate sa punar vyutpatti kāle sva ātmani eva preraṇa avagamaḥ cintyaḥ vartate pramāṇa antarāt tu tad avagamaḥ iti ced uttiṣṭha asiddham śabda eka gocara tvam

yā ca iyam pūrva avadhārita sukha sādhana bhāve kapittha ādau sva ātmani pravṛtti rupalabdhā tatra preraka tvena phala arthitā nirjñātā na anyā kacid preraṇā tat uktam smaraṇāt abhilāṣeṇa vyavahāraḥ pravartate iti phala viṣayā hi icchā tatra sva saṃvedyā atas ca preraka jñānam śabdāt api parasya yat kalpyate kalpyatām tatra prerikā sā eva sundarī capeṭā parihārāya modaka prāptaye api vā pravartate vaṭuḥ na asau juhudhi iti niyogataḥ katham tarhi evam ācaṣṭe ācārya coditaḥ aham juhomi iti astu ayam vyapadeśaḥ ācārya codanā tu na tatra kāraṇam api tu hita ahita prāpti parihāra arthi tvam eva iti atas phalam pravartakam yuktam anubhava sākṣika tvāt

ye api āhuḥ prayoktra āśayasya pravartaka tvam yatas ananuvidheyasya vacanāt na pravartamānaḥ kaścid dṛśyate anuvidheyasya puṃsaḥ kiṃcid abruvataḥ api bhrū bhaṅga ādinā aaśayam avagamya pravartate iti etat api ayuktam yatas prayoktra āśaya anumānena sva artha saṃbhāvanayā lokaḥ pravartate na punar prayoktā eva prīyatām iti tad prītiḥ api sva prīti hetu tvena arthyate na tad prīti tvena buddhaḥ api hi nāma sakala sattva hitaṃpratipannaḥ para artham sva prayojana tayā eva saṃpādayati para artha saṃpādana dvārakam tu tat tasmāt sva prītiḥ eva pravartikā prayoktrā śayasya ca pravartaka tve veda artha prayoktra āśaya anavadhāraṇāt apravṛttiḥ eva prāpnoti tasmāt phalam eva pravartakam

yat punar phalasya preraka tve dūṣaṇam abhyadhāyi siddhi asiddha vikalpa anupapatteḥ iti tat api ayuktam icchā viṣayīkṛtasya pravartaka tva abhyupagamāt asiddhe katham kāmanā iti ced asiddha tvāt eva idānīm ca tat asiddham na ekānta asiddha svarūpam eva kha puṣpa vat sukhe duḥkha nivṛttau vā puṃsām bhavati kāmanā na punar vyoma puṣpa ādi kaścid kāmayate naraḥ

ye api rāga ādeḥ pravartaka tvam abhyupagatavantaḥ taiḥ api kāmanā viṣayīkṛtam phalam eva pravartakam abhyupagatam icchā viśeṣāḥ eva hi rāga ādayaḥ yat api śreya ssādhaka tvam pravartakam ucyate tat api na cāru satyām api śreya ssādhana tāyām anarthi tvena pravṛtti abhāvāt nanu arthinaḥ api na aniyata viṣayā pravṛttiḥ apitu nirjñāta śreyassā dhana bhāve bhāva arthe tasmāt tad sādhana tā avagamaḥ pravartakaḥ satyam dvaye sati api icchā eva pravartikā vaktum yuktā tasyām satyām eva pravṛtti darśanāt pravṛttiḥ hi nāma prayatnaḥ prayatnaḥ ca icchā kāryaḥ iti kāṇādāḥ viṣaya niyame tu śreyassādhana tvam kāraṇam na pravṛtti utpāde

kiṃca bhāvanā avagatam śreyassādhana tvam pratartakam iṣyate taiḥ tat ca na pṛthak abhidhātum yuktam bhavanāyāḥ tri aṃśa tvena tad svarūpānagama samaye etad aṃśayoḥ svarga yāgayoḥ sādhya sādhana bhāva a agati siddheḥ na ca aṃśa dvaya avacchinnasya vyāpārasya śreyassādhana tvam rūpam vaktum ucitam aniṣpannasya tasya tādrūpya abhāvāt na hi aniṣpanne gavi tad eka deśa sāsnā ādau go tva rūpam sāmānyam niviśate na ca aṃśa traya pūraṇam antareṇa bhāvanā ākhya vyāpāra niṣpattiḥ iti

yat tu liṅādeḥ śabdasya tad vyāpārasya vā preraka tvam ucyate tat prāk eva pratikṣiptam vidhiḥ api sva mahimnā vā prerakaḥ syāt sādhya sādhana bhāva saṃbandha avabodhanena vā sva mahimnā preraka tvam asya pūrvam eva nirastam sādhya sādhana bhāva saṃbandha avabodhana purassare tu tasya pravartaka tve phalasya eva pravartaka tvam idam anakṣaram abhihitam bhavati

yaḥ tu āha preraka tvam ced phalam darśayataḥ vidheḥ pratyakṣa ādi samāna tvāt svātantryam tasya hīyate sa vācyaḥ phala śūnya tve suta rām asvatantra tā yat riktam artham mūḍhaḥ api na kaścid anutiṣṭhati kaḥ hi nāma niṣphalam artham prekṣāvān anutiṣṭhet nanu phale api darśite kecid tatra na pravartante eva kiṃca atas kāma mā pravartiṣata na hi kārakaḥ vidhiḥ apitu jñāpakaḥ iti uktam nanu phalam apradarśayan api jñāpayet na jñāpayitum utsahate prekṣāvān hi jñāpyate na ca phalam vinā asau tathā jñāpitaḥ bhavati iti alam bahu bhāṣikayā

phalasya eva iṣyamāṇasya paśyan preraka tām atas yam artham adhikṛtya iti sūtram vyadhita sūtrakṛt tasmāt puṃsaḥ pravṛttau prabhavati na vidhiḥ na api śabdaḥ liṅādiḥ vyāpāraḥ api etadīyaḥ na hi paṭuḥ abhidhā bhāvanā nāmadheyā na śreyassādhana tvam vidhi viṣaya gatam na api rāga ādiḥ evam tena ākhyat kāmyamānam phalam amala matiḥ prerakam sūtrakāraḥ

āha para pakṣān pratikṣipya prerakam kathitam phalam evam parama tad viṣṭaiḥ vākya arthaḥ svayam ucyatām ucyate yam artham adhikṛtya puruṣaḥ pravartate tat prayojanam iti vadatā sūtra kṛtā phalam pravartakam iti pradarśitam pramāṇena khalu ayam jñātā artham upalabhya tam īpsati jihāsati vā tasya īpsā ajihāsā prayuktasya samīhā pravṛttiḥ ucyate sāmarthyam punar asyāḥ phalena abhisaṃbandhaḥ iti ca bruvāṇaḥ bhāṣya kāraḥ api phala īpsām pravartikām prādīdṛśat iti tadīyām saraṇim anusaradbhiḥ asmābhiḥ api tathā eva tat kathitam

vākya arthaḥ tu na kvacid api sūtrakāra bhāṣya kārābhyām sūcitaḥ iti kutas śikṣitvā vākya artha svarūpam vayam ācakṣmahe kim iti tābhyām asau na sūcitaḥ iti ced pṛthak prasthānāḥ hi imāḥ vidyāḥ pramāṇa vidyā ca iyam ānvīkṣakī na vākya artha vidyā iti yadi evam padārthaḥ api kasmāt iha darśitaḥ vyakti ākṛti jātayaḥ tu padārthaḥ iti sthāne praśnaḥ sa tu śabdānām artha asaṃsparśitām vadantam rudantam ca śamayitum śabda prāmāṇya siddhaye sūtra kṛtā yatnaḥ kṛtaḥ

yadi evam vākya artham api bāhyam vāstavam antareṇa śastrasya pramāṇatā na pratiṣṭhām labhate iti tatra api prayatnaḥ kartavyaḥ eva satyam padārtha pratipādana yatnena eva tu kṛtena tatra yatnam kṛtam manyate sūtrakāraḥ yat ayam pṛthak padārthebhyaḥ na vākya artham upadiśati sma tasmāt ayam asya āśayaḥ padārthaḥ eva vākya arthaḥ iti tat kim amum eva pakṣam anumodāmahe padārthaḥ eva vākya arthaḥ iti bāḍham brumaḥ kiṃtu na ekaḥ padārthaḥ vākya arthaḥ anekaḥ tu padārthaḥ vākya arthaḥ

nanu anekaḥ api bhavan padārthaḥ eva asau na ca padārthaḥ vākya arthaḥ bhavitum arhati sāmānye hi padam vartate viśeṣe vākyam anyat ca sāmānyam anyaḥ viśeṣaḥ anyatra api uktam yat atra ādhikyam sa vākya arthaḥ iti tasmāt anyaḥ padārthaḥ anyaḥ ca vākya arthaḥ ucyate yat etat uktam asmābhiḥ anekaḥ padārthaḥ vākya arthaḥ na punar ekaḥ iti tat na bṛhītam āyuṣma tā

etat uktam bhavati paraspara saṃspṛṣṭa padārtha samudāyaḥ vākya arthaḥ iti saṃsargaḥ eva adhikaḥ iti yat atra ādhikyam iti ucyate na ca anākṣipta viśeṣa tvena saṃsargaḥ upapadyate iti viśeṣaḥ vākya arthaḥ iti ucyate saṃsargaḥ tu svarūpataḥ na vākya arthaḥ apadārtha tvāt gauḥ śuklaḥ ānīyatām iti pada grāme saṃsarga vādinaḥ padasya aśravaṇāt śravaṇe api sutarām ananvayāt gauḥ śukla anīyatām saṃsargaḥ iti kaḥ asya arthaḥ tasmāt saṃsṛṣṭaḥ vākya arthaḥ na saṃsargaḥ tad uktam vyatiṣaktataḥ avagateḥ vyatiṣaṅgasya iti na ca tantubhiḥ iva paṭaḥ vīraṇaiḥ iva kaṭaḥ tad atiriktaḥ avayavi sthānīyaḥ padārthaḥ nirvartyamānaḥ vākya arthaḥ upalabhyate jāti guṇa kriyā avagame api avayavi buddheḥ abhāvāt na ca padārtha avayavī vākya arthaḥ tena pṛthak vākya artham na upadiṣṭavān ācāryaḥ

nanu guṇa pradhāna bhāvam antareṇa na saṃsargaḥ avakalpate na ca ekasmin vākye bahūni pradhānāni bhavanti prādhānyam eva hi tathā sati na syāt guṇāḥ tu bahavaḥ bhavanti yat idam aneka guṇa uparaktam ekam kiṃcid pradhānam sa vākya arthaḥ iti tat viṣayā iyam eka svabhāvā buddhiḥ satyam tathā api te eva saṃsṛṣṭāḥ padārthāḥ avabhāsante na tadā ārabdhaḥ kaścid ekaḥ saṃsarga siddhi kṛtaḥ tu guṇa pradhāna bhāvaḥ abhyupeyate sa ca guṇa pradhāna bhāvaḥ na niyataḥ yena ekam eva idam pradhānam iti vyavasthāpyeta kvacid kārakam pradhānam kriyā guṇa dravyasya cikīrṣita tvena avagamāt vrīhīn prokṣati iti siddha tantram kvacid sādhyam tat tantram itarat kvacid śabda prayoga tātparya paryālocanayā bhavet

tasmāt guṇa pradhāna bhāva aniyamāt anyonya saṃsṛṣṭaḥ padārtha samudāyaḥ vākya arthaḥ iti etāvat eva śreyaḥ saṃsarga avagame ca sarva vādi nāma vivādaḥ vākya artham manvate ye api niyogam bhāvanām kriyām taiḥ api anyonya saṃsṛṣṭaḥ padārtha grāmaḥ iṣyate

nanu saṃsarga vat anya vyavacchedaḥ api gamyate gauḥ śuklaḥ ānīyatām iti śrute kṛṣṇa aśva ādi vyavaccheda pratīti darśanāt satyam saṃsarga pūrvakaḥ tu vyavacchedaḥ śukla guṇa saṃsṛṣṭaḥ hi gauḥ kṛṣṇa ādibhyaḥ vyavacchidyate anya apohaḥ tu na padārthaḥ iti uktam tasmāt na bhedaḥ vākya arthaḥ

nanu saṃsargaḥ api na śabda arthaḥ satyam sa hi śabdasya abhidheyaḥ na bhavati na tu tatas na pratīyate anabhidheyaḥ katham pratīyate iti ced etat agre nirṇeṣyate vyavacchede tu na sā gatiḥ tasmāt saṃsṛṣṭāḥ padārthāḥ vākya arthaḥ iti sthitam

athavā guṇībhūta itara padārtha anugṛhitaḥ ekaḥ eva pradhāna bhūtaḥ padārthaḥ vākya arthaḥ iti eka ākāra pratīti balāt upeya tām ekaḥ tu ayam asau arthaḥ iti na nirṇetum śakyate yadi tu avaśyam ekasya kasyacid abhiṣeka kalaśaḥ dātavyaḥ tat phalasya eva dīyatām na hi niṣprayojanam kiṃcid vākyam uccaryate kvacid sākṣāt pada upāttam kvacid prakaraṇa āgatam kvacid ālocana ālabhyam phalam sarvatra gamyate sakalena ca kāraka kalāpena kriyā nirvartyate kriyayā ca phalam na tu phalena anyat kim api nirvartyate iti pradhāna tvāt phalam eva vākya arthaḥ

nanu phalam api puruṣa artham iti puruṣaḥ pradhānam syāt na etat evam phalam sukha ātmaka tvāt puruṣa āśritam bhavati sukha ādīnām ātma guṇa tvāt na ca etāvatā puruṣaḥ pradhānam saḥ api hi phala artham eva yatate bhāvanā tāvat phala niṣṭhaḥ eva vyāpāraḥ niyogasya api phalam vinā na pravartaka tvam iti uktam kriyāyāḥ api kevalāyāḥ vākya arthaṃtvam apāstam tasmāt phalasya sādhya tvāt sarvatra tad avarjanāt kriyā ādīnām ca tādarthyāt tasya vākya arthatā iṣyate

nanu phalasya svarga ādeḥ nisargataḥ siddha rūpa tvāt kārakaiḥ saha saṃbandhaḥ na prāpnoti siddhasya ca kaḥ saṃbandhaḥ kriyā garbhaḥ iti ced tarhi phalam api kārakāṇi api kriyayā saṃbadhyante kaḥ viśeṣaḥ satyam param tu kārakāṇi sādhana tvena phalam tu sādhya tvena kriyayā hi phalam sādhyate na phalena kriyā iti atas phalasya eva prādhānyam iti siddham anyonya saṃgati viśeṣitaḥ eva yasmāt vākya artha bhāvam upayāti padārtha puṃjaḥ etat ca cetasi nidhāya tatas na bhinnam vākya artham abhyakadhita ca kaścana sūtrakāraḥ prādhānya yogāt athavā phalasya vākya artha tā tatra satām hi yatnaḥ prayojanam sūtra kṛtā tat eva pravartaka tvena kila upadiṣṭam

apare punar liṅā ādi śabda śravaṇe sati samupajāyamānam ātma spanda viśeṣam udyogam nāma vākya artham ācakṣate tad svarūpam tu vayam na jānīmaḥ kaḥ ayam ātma spandaḥ nāma iti buddhi sukha duḥkha icchā dveṣa prayatna dharma adharma saṃskārāḥ hi navaḥ ātmanaḥ guṇāḥ viśeṣa guṇāḥ bhavanti na anye tatra ayam ātma spandaḥ buddhiḥ vā syāt prayatnaḥ vā icchā dveṣayoḥ anyataraḥ vā anye tu vikalpayitum api na yuktāḥ tatra yadi buddhiḥ ātma spandaḥ ucyate tarhi pratibhā vākya arthaḥ iti uktam bhavati na nūtanam kiṃcid utprekṣitam etat

atha prayatnaḥ ātma spandaḥ tarhi bhāvanāyāḥ nāma antara karaṇam udyoga eti atha icchā dveṣayoḥ anyataraḥ asau tarhi sukha icchā duḥkha jihāsā vā vākya arthaḥ iti akṣapāda pakṣaḥ eva ayam na apūrvam kicid atha api bhāṭṭa parikalpitaḥ vyāpāraḥ ātmā spandaḥ saḥ api bhāvanā eva na artha antaram atha anuṣṭheyaḥ prerakaḥ kaścid arthaḥ udyogaḥ sa tarhi niyogaḥ eva upasarga anyatvam idam na vastu anyat tasmāt aśruta pūrveṇa kṛtam udyoga parvaṇā sa bhārata manuṣyāṇām gocaraḥ na tu mādṛśām

anyaiḥ tu pratibhā vākya arthaḥ iṣyate tad pakṣaḥ tu saṃsarga nirbhāsa jñāna nirākaraṇena prāk eva pratikṣippaḥ pratibhā khalu vijñānam tat ca śabdena janyate na tu śabdasya viṣayaḥ rūpa dhīḥ iva cakṣuṣaḥ bāhyasya viṣayasya abhāvāt sā eva viṣayaḥ iti ced na tasya samarthita tvāt

yaḥ api vyāghraḥ āyātaḥ iti ukte śūrakātara nara adhikaraṇa nānā ākāra kārya utpādaḥ sa bāhye arthe vyāghra āgamānādau pratipanne vāsanā anusāreṇa bhavat na pratibhā mātra hetukaḥ bhavati tasya hi jñāyamānaḥ arthaḥ karaṇam na tat jñāna mātram arthaḥ tadānīm na asti iti ced vipralambha vākyam idam asatya artham bhaviṣyati na tu abāhya viṣayam tat yathā avasthite vanitā ātmani bāhye arthe vāsanā anusāreṇa kuṇapaḥ iti kāminī iti bhakṣyam iti pratibhāḥ bhavanti tathā śabda arthe api vyāghra āgamane avagate śūrāṇām utsāhaḥ kātarāṇa bhayam ityādi kāryam bhavati na tu etāvatā pratibhā śabda arthaḥ bhavitum arhati tasmāt vākya prayojana tvena vā yadi pratibhā vākya arthaḥ kayyate kathyatām nāma na tu asau śabdasya abhidheyā anabhidheyā api saṃsarga vat vākya arthaḥ iti ced tatra api uktam saṃsṛṣṭāḥ vākya arthaḥ na saṃsargaḥ evam iha api pratibhāvantaḥ arthāḥ vākya arthaḥ na pratibhā iti

śabdasya ca pratyakṣa vat vartamāna artha niṣṭhatva abhāvāt anāgata ādi artha abhidhāyinaḥ arthā sannidhānena pratibhā para tvam yat ucyate tat api ayuktam anāgata ādi viṣaya tve api tasya artha viṣaya tvam prasādhitam iti kṛtam vistareṇa vākya arthaḥ parama arthaḥ eva tat ayam no kalpanā nirmitaḥ tat vān api uditaḥ padasya viṣayaḥ tena artha saṃsparśinā aprāmāṇyam atas ca bāhya viṣaya abhāvena yat varṇyate tat śabdasya nirastam iti akaluṣam prāmāṇyam asya sthitam

nanu na adya api śabdasya niraṇāyi pramāṇa tā bījam padārtha vākya artha buddheḥ na hi nirūpitam ucyate kim atra nirūpaṇīyam yad anantaram hi yat bhavati tat tasya nimittam pada vākya śravaṇe sati padārtha vākya artha saṃpratyayaḥ bhavati iti te eva tatra nimittam kim punar idam padam nāma kiṃca vākyam iti uktam atra varṇa samūhaḥ padam pada samūhaḥ vākyam iti

nanu etat eva na kṣamante na hi varṇānām samūhaḥ kaścid asti vāstavaḥ tena kutas tad samūhaḥ padam bhaviṣyati tad abhāvāt ca na tarām pada samūhaḥ vākyam avakalpate na ca varṇānām vyasta samasta vikalpa upahata tvena vācaka tvam upapadyate tasmāt anyaḥ eva sphoṭa ātmā śabdaḥ artha pratipādakaḥ iti pratijānate

nanu evam astu sphoṭaḥ anyaḥ eva artha pratipādakaḥ bhavatu kā kṣatiḥ naiyāyikānām katham na kṣatiḥ āpta praṇīta tvena hi śabdasya pramāṇyam taiḥ uktam sphoṭasya ca nitya tvena na āpta praṇīta tvam atas ca yasya anitya tvam varṇa ātmanaḥ śabdasya sādhitam na asau artha pratīti hetuḥ atas na pramāṇam yaḥ ca artha pratīti hetuḥ sphoṭa ātmā śabdaḥ tasya na anitya tvam na ca āpta praṇīta tvam iti asthāne naiyāyikāḥ kliṣṭāḥ bhaveyuḥ tasmāt anityānām varṇānām eva vācaka tvam pratiṣṭhāpanīyam parākaraṇīyaḥ ca sphoṭaḥ iti

tat ucyate gakāra ādi varṇa avagame satyartha pratīteḥ bhāvāt tad abhāve ca abhāvāt teṣām eva artha pratyāyana sāmarthyam te eva ca śravaṇa karaṇaka avagama gocara tayā śabda vyapadeśa bhājaḥ iti na prati iti anupārūḍhaḥ sphoṭaḥ nāma śabdaḥ kaścid pratyakṣa anumāna atītaḥ parikalpanīyaḥ

āha katham evam bhaviṣyati dūra apetāḥ ime manorathāḥ kutas varṇānām artha pratyāyaka tvam te hi varṇāḥ gakāra ādayaḥ artham pratipādayantaḥ samastāḥ pratipādayeyuḥ vyastā vā na tāvat vyastāḥ ekaika varṇa ākarṇane sati api artha pratīteḥ anutpādāt sāmastyam varṇānām na asti eva tat hi sattā mātreṇa vā syāt pratīyamāna tvena vā naiyāyika pakṣe tāvat sat tayā yaugapadyam avidyamānam āśu vināśinaḥ śabdasya darśita tvāt

atha api mīmāṃsaka matena nityaḥ śabdaḥ iṣyate tatra api sat tayā yaugapadyasya sakala varṇa sādhāraṇa tvāt kena varṇa samudāyena kaḥ arthaḥ pratyāyyeta iti na avadhāryate artha ucyate na cakṣuḥ ādīnām iva varṇānām kāraka tvam yena agṛhī tānām eva satām yaugapadya mātram artha pratyāyana aṅgam syāt jñāpaka tvāt teṣām gṛhītānām satām dhūma ādi vat pratyāyaka tvam iti pratītau eva sāmastyam upayujyate iti

etat api aghaṭamānam pratīti sāmastyam hi kim eka vaktṛ prayuktānām varṇānām uta nānā puruṣa bhāṣitānām tatra ekadā aneka puruṣa bhāṣitānām kolāhala svabhāva tvena svarūpa bhedaḥ eva duravagamaḥ iti kasya sāmastyam asām astyam vā cintyeta sati api vā tathāvidhe sāmastye na asti eva artha pratītiḥ eka vaktṛ prayuktānām tu prayatna sthāna karaṇa krama aparityāgāt avaśyaṃbhāvī kramaḥ krame ca sati ekaika varṇa karaṇikā artha pratītiḥ prāpnoti na ca asau dṛśyate iti vyasta samasta vikalpa anupapatteḥ na varṇāḥ vācakāḥ varṇa viṣayāḥ api buddhayaḥ tathā eva vikalpanīyāḥ tāḥ api na yugapad saṃbhavanti krame ca sati ekaika varṇa buddheḥ artha saṃpratyayaḥ prasajyeta iti

yat api ucyate pūrva pūrva varṇa janita saṃskāra sahitaḥ antya varṇaḥ pratyāyakaḥ iti tat api ayuktam saṃskāraḥ hi nāma yat anubhava janitaḥ tad viṣayam eva smaraṇam upajanayati na punar artha antara viṣayam jñānam iti smṛti dvāreṇa asau tarhi artha pratyāyakaḥ asau bhaviṣyati iti ced etat api na asti jñāna yauga padya prasaṅgāt antya varṇa jñāna anantaram hi pūrva varṇa smaraṇam iva samaya smaraṇam api tadā eva āpatati tatas ca jñāna yaugapadyam

na ca krama utpāde kiṃcid kāraṇam utpaśyāmaḥ atha api tena krameṇa bhavetām tathā api tadānīmantya varṇa jñānam uparatam iti kasya sāhāyyakam pūrvam varṇa smṛtiḥ vidadhāti iti etat ca aneka pūrva varṇa viṣayām ekām smṛtimam abhyupagamya uktam na puna rekā sarva varṇa gocarā smṛtiḥ kutas bhinna upalaṃbha saṃbhūta vāsanā bheda nirmitāḥ bhaveyuḥ smṛtayaḥ bhinnāḥ na tu ekā aneka gocarāḥ

atha vadet saṃkalanā jñānam ekam sat asat varṇa gocaram bhaviṣyati tad rūpa ārūḍhāḥ ca varṇāḥ artham pratyāyayiṣyanti iti tat api durāśā mātram tathāvidha jñāna utpattau kāraṇa abhāvāt na ca indriyam atīta varṇa grahaṇa samartham na saṃskāraḥ vartamāna grāhī bhavati na ca yugapad indriyam saṃskāraḥ ca imām buddhim janayataḥ saṃskārasya sahacāra darśana ādyāhita prabodhasya sataḥ smaraṇa mātra janmani nirjñāta sāmarthyasya indriyeṇa saha vyāpāra abhāvāt tasmāt na varṇāḥ vācakāḥ atas ca evam yadi te vācakāḥ bhaveyuḥ viparīta krama prayuktāḥ api artham gamayeyuḥ kramaḥ ced apekṣyate sa vyatirikta avyatirikta tayā cintanīyaḥ avyatireke te eva te varṇaḥ iti katham na bodhakāḥ vyatireke tu kim api adhikam vācakam abhyupagatam bhavati iti mad pakṣam ājigamiṣati bhavān

nanu vyutpatti vaśena śabdaḥ artha pratyāyaka tām upayāti vyutpattau ca yāvantaḥ yat kramāvarṇāḥ yad artham abhivadantaḥ dṛṣṭāḥ te tāvantaḥ tad kramakāḥ tam artham abhivadiṣyanti iti kim vikalpa mālayā tat uktam yāvantaḥ yādṛśāḥ ye ca yad artha pratipādane varṇāḥ prajñāta sāmarthyaḥ te tathā eva avabodhakāḥ iti

tat ucyate vyutpattiḥ eva iyam vicāraṇīyā vartate para avagati pūrvikā hi śabdāt svayam avagatiḥ para avagatau ca ke kiyantaḥ katham kam artham pratipādayantaḥ anena dṛṣṭāḥ yebhyaḥ tathā eva tam artham pratīyāt iti duradhigamā hi varṇa vartanī yāvantaḥ yādṛśāḥ ye ca iti evam tāvat prabhāṣase kiyantaḥ kīdṛśāḥ keca iti evam yāvat na pṛcchayase tasmāt sarva prakāram avācakāḥ varṇāḥ

asti ca iyam śabdāt uccaritāt tad artha avagatiḥ na ca iyam akaraṇikā eva bhavitum arhati tat asyāḥ karaṇam sphoṭaḥ iti kārya anumānam idam astu pari śeṣa anumānam vā arthāpattiḥ vā sarvathā artha pratīti lakṣaṇa kārya vaśāt kalpya mānam tat karaṇam sphoṭaḥ iti ucyate sa ca niravayavaḥ nityaḥ ekaḥ niṣkāraṇakaḥ iti na varṇa pakṣa kṣepaṇa dakṣa dūṣaṇa pātra tām pratipadyate atas ca sphoṭaḥ artha pratipādakaḥ śabdāt artham pratipadyāmahe iti vyavahārāt bhavataḥ hi varṇa janita ssaṃskāraḥ artha pratipādakaḥ tatra śabdāt iti prātipadikā arthī anupapannaḥ

atha varṇāḥ śabda śabdena ucyante te ca artha pratipādakāḥ iti idam anyathā siddham tathā api śabdāt iti eka tvam vibhakti arthaḥ na saṃgacchate śabdebhyaḥ pratipadyāmahe iti vyavahāraḥ syāt sphoṭa ātmani tu śabde artha pratipādake iṣyamāṇe śabdāt iti prātipādikā arthaḥ vibhakti arthaḥ ca dvayam api upapannam

nanu na sphoṭaḥ śabda śabdena ucyate kintu varṇāḥ eva śrotra grahaṇe hi arthe śabdā śabdaḥ prasiddhaḥ te eva ca śrotra grahaṇāḥ iti na etat evam śabda tvasya api śrotra grahaṇa ātmanaḥ bhāvāt nirjhara jhāṅkāra rava prabhṛtīnām ca sati api śrotra grahaṇa tve śabda kārya nirvartaka tva anupapatteḥ tasmāt yatas artha pratipattiḥ sa śabdaḥ artha pratipattiḥ ca sphoṭāt eva na varṇebhyaḥ iti sphoṭaḥ eva śabdaḥ

nanu evam sati dhūma ādīnām api atha pratīti hetutvāt śabda tvam prāpnoti mā evam vādīḥ atha gauḥ iti atra śrotra ja pratibhāse bahavaḥ arthāḥ pratibhāsante tatra kaḥ teṣām śabdaḥ iti upakramya yatas artha pratipattiḥ sa śabdaḥ iyupasaṃhṛte kutas dhūma ādīnām śabda tva śaṅkā avakāśaḥ nanu ca iyam artha pratītiḥ varṇeṣu bhavatsu bhavantī teṣu abhavatsu ca abhavantī tān utsṛjya katham sphoṭa kārya tām upayāyāt ucyate ananyathā siddham tad bhāva bhāvi tvam tat kāryatām avagamayati na anyathā siddham idam tu anyathā siddham kā punar anyathā siddhiḥ sphoṭa vyaṃjaka tvāt varṇānām tat ā ānantaryam artha pratīteḥ upaplavate varṇa abhivyaktaḥ sphoṭaḥ artha pratītim ādadhāti bhrāmyati janaḥ varṇaiḥ iyam artha pratītiḥ utpāditā iti

nanu sphoṭa vyaktau aprīdānīm varṇānām kva gatāḥ te vyasta samasta vikalpāḥ āha ca bhaṭṭaḥ yasya anavayavaḥ sphoṭaḥ vyajyate varṇa buddhibhiḥ saḥ api paryanuyogena na eva anena vimucyate iti bhāṣya kṛtā api nanu saṃskāra kalpanāyām adṛṣṭa kalpanā iti āśaṃkya prativihitam śabda kalpanāyām sā ca śabda kalpanā ca iti naiṣa doṣaḥ na sphoṭa vyaktau vikalpāḥ prabhavanti kutas

eke tāvat ācakṣate prathama varṇa śravaṇa velāyām eva sphoṭaḥ abhivyaktaḥ bhavati na ca dvitīya ādi varṇa vaiphalyam tad avagateḥ eva atiśaya karaṇāt yathā ratna parīkṣakāṇām prathama darśane ratna rūpam amalam aprakāśa mānam api punar punar parīkṣamāṇānām carame cetasi cakāsti niravadyam ratna tattvam evam iha api prathama varṇa śrutyā vyakte api sphoṭe sphuṭatara pratītyai varṇa antarāṇi prayokṣyante iti

apare tu vadanti dhvanayaḥ eva sphoṭasya ca vyaṃjakāḥ taiḥ ca marudbhiḥ anavayavaḥ eva eṣa sphoṭaḥ abhivyajyamānaḥ tālu ādi sthāna karaṇa saṃyoga upādhi vaśa upaplavamāna nānā ākāra gakāra ādi bhāga yogī iva pratibhāsate marutām caṃcala tvāt uccārita pradhvaṃsinaḥ te tam kālpanikā ākāram avabhāsayante dṛṣṭam ca upādhi vaśāt asatyam api rūpam avabhāsamānam yathā kṛpāṇa maṇi darpaṇa ādi vyaṃjaka bhedena śyāma dīrgha ādi rūpam vadanasya nāda ātmakaḥ hi śabdaḥ vīṇā veṇu mṛdaṅga paṭaha ādi vyaṃja karbhadena nānātvam upagacchan dṛśyate tasmāt na pāramārthikāḥ eva te varṇāḥ na ca sphoṭasya vyaṃjakāḥ iti kva samasta vyasta vikalpāḥ prabhaveyuḥ

upādhi bhedena pratibhāsamānāḥ asati a ākārāḥ ca te artha pratyayānvayavyati reka anuvidhāyinaḥ dṛśyante tena yat ucyate śabda kalpanāyām kalpanāt vaigaṇyam iti tatra eka guṇā api kalpanā na asti kā kathā dvaiguṇyasya iti tasmāt sphoṭa ātmakāt eva śabdāt artha pratyayaḥ varṇa anuvidhāyi tvam tu tasya anyathā siddham iti siddham api ca tārkikāṇām anumāna priya tvāt tad paritoṣāya idam anumānam abhyadhāyi na paramārthataḥ paramārthataḥ tu śrautre pratyaye pratibhāsamānaḥ pratyakṣaḥ eva sphoṭaḥ

āha kim idam apūrvam taskara ācaritam vartate varṇāḥ pratyakṣam upalabhyamānāḥ api durbhagāḥ na pratyakṣāḥ sphoṭaḥ punar anavabhāsamānaḥ api subhagaḥ pratyakṣaḥ iti ucyate na brūmaḥ varṇāḥ na pratyakṣāḥ iti te punar asantaḥ api upādhi vaśāt vadana daiḥ dhya ādi vat avabhāsante śabdaḥ tu ekaḥ niravayavaḥ pratīyate tathā ca padam iti vākyam iti eka ākārā pratītiḥ asti na ca bhinnāḥ varṇāḥ tasyām ālambanībhavanti na hi sāmānya pratyayaḥ vyakti ālambanaḥ avayavi pratyayaḥ vā avaya bālambanaḥ na ca senā vana ādi buddhi vat ayathārthā pada vākya buddhiḥ bādhaka abhāvāt

eka artha pratyayavat tva upādhi kṛtā iyam eka ākārā buddhiḥ iti ced ekā rtha pratītiḥ idānīm kutastyā pada vākya pratīti pūrvikā hi padārtha vākya artha pratītiḥ padārtha vākya artha pratīti ākhya kārī aikyāt ca pada vākya buddhiḥ eka ākāra iti duruttaram itaretara āśraya tvam aupādhika tvam ca sāmānya avayavibuddheḥ api su vacam bādha saṃdeha rahita pratīti dārḍhyāt tatra parihāraḥ iti ced tat itaratra api samānam tasmāt pada buddheḥ padasphoṭaḥ vākya buddheḥ ca vākyasphoṭaḥ viṣayaḥ iti pratyakṣaḥ eva sphoṭaḥ tatra pada sphoṭāt padārtha pratipattiḥ vākyasphoṭāt ca vākya artha pratipattiḥ

āha yadi niravayavaḥ sphoṭa ātmā śabdaḥ bhavati vākyam api śabdaḥ eva tasya pada ātmakāḥ tvayavāḥ mā bhūvan tasya ced padātmānaḥ avayavāḥ bhavanti padasya api tarhi varṇa ātmānaḥ avayavāḥ bhavantu ucyate kiṃcid uccha vasitam iva me hṛdayam manye bhaviṣyati āyuṣmataḥ viveka ālokaḥ bodhyamānaḥ bhotsyase kiṃcid dhvani upādhi bheda pravṛtta varṇa bheda avabhāsa vipralabdha buddhim bhavadvidham bodhayitum padasphoṭaḥ eṣa niravayavaḥ asmābhiḥ darśitaḥ paramārthataḥ tu padasphoṭaḥ vākya avayava bhūtaḥ na asti eva niravayavam eva vākyam niravayavasya eva vākya arthasya bodhakam yathā padasya avayavāḥ na santi tathā vākyasya avayavāḥ padāni iti tathā ca āhuḥ vākye padānām asattvāt tad arthe padārthānām niravayavau vākya vākya arthau iti avayava kalpanāyām hi yathā vākyasya avayavāḥ padāni padānām avayavāḥ varṇāḥ evam varṇānau api avayavaiḥ bhavitavyam tad avayavānām api avayava antaraiḥ iti ānantyāt kā vyavasthā syāt varṇān prāpya tu yadi avayava kalpanātaḥ virantavyam tad vākyaḥ eva viramyatām

eka ghaṭana ākārā hi vākya artha buddhiḥ tathāvidhāt eva vākyāt utpattum arhati vṛddha vyavahārāt hi śabda arthe vyutpadyante vyavahartāraḥ tatra asya padasya prayogaḥ eva na kevalasya dṛśyate vyavahāra anaṅga tvāt vākyam tu prayoga arham iti tatra eva vyutpattiḥ tatas eva artha saṃpratyayaḥ avayava pratibhāsaḥ tu bhrama mātram arthaḥ api vākyasya ekaḥ eva narasiṃha ākāraḥ jāti antaram hi narasiṃhaḥ nāma tatra na nara arthaḥ na api siṃha arthaḥ

evam padārthebhyaḥ anyaḥ eva vākya arthaḥ pānaka ādi vat yathā pānakaḥ śarkarā nāgakesara marīci ādibhyaḥ artha antaram eva yathā ca sindūra harita āla lākṣā ādibhyaḥ artha antaram eva citram yathā vā ṣaḍja ṛṣabha gāndhāra dhaivatā ādibhyaḥ artha antaram eva grāma rāgaḥ tathā padebhyaḥ vākyam padārthebhyaḥ vākya arthaḥ katham tarhi tad aṃśa avagamaḥ iti ced kalpanā mātram tat na asau parama arthaḥ tad śabda anugame tad artha anugama darśanāt pāramārthika tvam bhāgānām iti ced na kūpa sūpa yūpānām eka akṣara anugame api artha anugama abhāvāt na ca kevala anugama mātreṇa tad kāraṇa bhāvaḥ vaktum śakyaḥ reṇu paṭala anugāmitayā kari turaga ādi vat pipīlikā paṅkteḥ api dṛśyamānāyāḥ tad kāraṇa tva prasaṅgāt tasmāt prakṛti pratyaya aṃśa vat asat padārtha parikalpanam vākya arthā vagama upāya tayā aaśrīyate na tu arthaḥ tadīyaḥ tatra aśvakarṇa ādi vat upalabhyate

asatyam api satya upāya tām pratipadyamānam dṛśyate alīka ahi daṃśa ādayaḥ satya maraṇa kāraṇam bhavanti lipi akṣarāṇi ca asatyāni eva satya artha pratipattim ādadhati sva rūpa satyāni tāni iti ced na rekhā rūpa tayā teṣām artha aprati pādaka tvāt gakāraḥ ayam iti evaṃgṛhyamāṇāḥ rekhā artha pratyaya hetavaḥ tāyena rūpeṇa satyāḥ tena na artha pradipādakāḥ yena ca artha pratipādakāḥ tena na satyāḥ iti

nanu prakṛti pratyaya ādi aṃśāḥ api parama artha santaḥ eva tathā pratibhāsāt artha pratyaya hetu tvāt ca na etat evam anvākhyāna bhedena teṣām svarūpeṇa iyattā niścaya anupapatteḥ bhavati iti atra bhū śabdaḥ prakṛtiḥ kvacid anvākhyāyate kvacid bhava śabdaḥ pratyaya ādeśa āgama guṇa vṛddhi varṇa lopa ādi anvākhyāna visaṃvādāt kaḥ pāramārthikaḥ prakṛti pratyaya vibhāgaḥ kalpanā mātram tu etat iyam prakṛtiḥ eṣa pratyayaḥ iti evam padārthānām api vākya artha parikalpanayā eva apoddhāraḥ tat uktam padam kaiścidvidhā bhinnam caturdhā paṃcadhā api vā apa uddhṛtya eva vākyebhyaḥ prakṛti pratyaya ādi vat iti
