tatra etat syāt gavādeḥ ga avyādeḥ ca vācakatva aviśeṣe api sādhu asādhu śabda uccāraṇa karaṇaka puṇya pāpa prāpti parihāra prayojana niyama vidhānāya śāstra sāphalyam bhaviṣyati tat uktam vācaka tva aviśeṣe api niyamaḥ puṇya pāpayoḥ iti etat api durghaṭam pratipadam aśakya tvāt vargīkaraṇa nimittasya ca asaṃbhavāt avaśyam hi vidhim vā niṣedham vā vidhitsatām praviṣedhyān ca niṣedhyān ca śabdānupadarśya niyamaḥ vidhātavyaḥ ebhiḥ bhāṣatavyam ebhiḥ naḥ iti tatra yadi ubhaye te śabdāḥ prativyakti nāma grahaṇa parigaṇana purassaram upadarśyeran tat ayam arthaḥ kalpa śata jīvinaḥ bhagavataḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ api na viṣayaḥ pravitata vadana sahasra saṃkula mūrteḥ anantasya api na gocaraḥ vācaspateḥ na bhūmiḥ sarasvatyāḥ ati bhāraḥ teṣām ānantyena darśayitum aśakyatvāt

atha kiṃcid upalakṣaṇam avalamya teṣām vargīkaraṇam upeyate hanta tarhi dṛśyatām na ca tad saṃbhavati avibhaktā hi śabda tva jātiḥ śabda apaśabdayoḥ na ca avāntara sāmānye kecid varga dvaye sthite na hi sādhu tva sāmānyam itareṣu vyavasthitam itareṣu api asādhu tva sāmānyam upalabhyate tad anupalambhāt asaṃbhavati vargīkaraṇa kāraṇe katham eṣa niyamaḥ vidhīyeta iti na avadhārayāmaḥ

kiṃca niyama arthe api śāstre vaktavyam kīdṛśaḥ niyama arthaḥ iti kim sādhubhiḥ eva bhāṣitavyam bhāṣitavyam eva na adhubhiḥ iti ubhayathā ca pramādaḥ āha hi yadi sādhubhiḥ eva iti nāsā adhora prasaṅgataḥ niyatam bhāṣitavyam ced maune doṣaḥ prasajyate iti na ca vācaka tvāt anyat sādhu tvam iti uktam avācakasya prayoga prasaṅgaḥ eva na asti iti

atha pramādā aśakti kṛta apa śabda prayoga pratiṣedhāya niyamaḥ āśrīyate tatra api pramādā aśakti jāḥ śabdāḥ yadi tāvat avācakāḥ teṣu prasaṅgaḥ na asti iti tad nivṛtti śrameṇa kim atha vācaka tā teṣām apramāda uttha śakti vat na tarhi pratiṣedhaḥ syāt apramāda uttha śakti vat nanu asti tāvat apaśabdānām aśakya nihnavaḥ paridṛśyamānaḥ loke prayogaḥ iti tad nivṛtti phalaḥ eṣa prayoga niyamaḥ katham na bhavet

yadi evam akṣi nikoca hasta saṃjñā ādeḥ api pracuraḥ prayogaḥ dṛśyate iti tat vyu dāsa phalaḥ api eṣa niyamaḥ syāt api ca vidhi phalaḥ sarvatra niyamaḥ bhavati ṛtau upeyāt ityādi niṣedha phalā tu parisaṃkhyā paṃca paṃcanakhāḥ bhakṣyāḥ iti tat ayam apaśabde prayoga pratiṣedha phalaḥ ca niyamaḥ ca iti vyāhatam abhidhīyate parisaṃkhyā tarhi bhaviṣyati iti ced na śabda apa śabdayoḥ yugapad prāpti abhāvāt tatra ca anyatra ca prāptau parisaṃkhyā abhidhīyate iti nyāyāt

yat api puṇya pāpa phala tvam su śabda apaśabdayoḥ iti gīyate tat api na peśalam paridṛśyamānam avivāda siddham artha pratyaya upajananam apahāya parokṣasya adṛṣṭasya puṇya pāpa ātmanaḥ kalpanā anupapatteḥ

yaḥ ca ayam svarge loke kāmadhugbhavati iti sādhu śabda stuti artha vādaḥ yaḥ ca sa vāc vajraḥ yajamānam hinasti iti apaśabde nindā artha vādaḥ tatra padārthasya vispaṣṭa dṛṣṭa tvāt arthavāda mātra paryavasitau ca dravya saṃskāra karmamu parārtha tvāt phala śrutiḥ artha vādaḥ syāt iti nyāyāt na phala artha tā iti tat evam sādhubhiḥ bhāṣitavyam asādhubhiḥ naḥ iti vidhi niṣedhayoḥ anārabhya adhītayoḥ śrūyamāṇayoḥ api dausthityāt tad mūla tayā labdha pramāṇa bhāvā vyākaraṇa smṛtiḥ aṃgatām eṣyati vedasya iti durāśā eva prakaraṇa viśeṣa pāṭhe tu tayoḥ tad upayogāt eva na sārvatrikaḥ niyama artha tā iti sarvathā na tad mūla tvam vyākaraṇasya

āha tarhi niṣkāraṇaḥ ṣaḍaṅgaḥ vedaḥ adhyeyaḥ jñeyaḥ ca iti vidheḥ śikṣā kalpa sūtra nirukta chandaḥ jyotiḥ śāstra vat vyākaraṇam api vedāṅga tvāt adhyeyam iti avagamyate na etat api asti śikṣā ādīnām itaretara sādhya saṃkīrṇa vividha vidhi apekṣita veda upakāra nirvartaka tvena tad aṅga tā su saṃgatā vyākaraṇasya tu su dūram api dhāvana plavane vidadhataḥ sādhu śabda prayoga niyama dvārakam eva tad aṅga tvam saṃbhāvyate na mārga antareṇa sa ca niyamaḥ durupapādaḥ iti darśitam atas na aṃga antarāṇi spardhitum arhati vyākaraṇam
niṣkāraṇa ṣaḍaṅga veda adhyayana vidhau ca niṣkāraṇa grahaṇam yathā prayojana śaithilyam sūcayati na tathā prayojanavat tām śruti liṅga ādi aṅga tva pramāṇa apekṣayā ṣaṣ aṅga tā varṇayiṣyate

etena tasmāt brāhmaṇena na mlecchita ve na apabhāṣita vai mlecchaḥ ha vai eṣa yat apaśabdaḥ iti ekaḥ śabdaḥ samyak jñātaḥ su prayuktaḥ svarge loke kāmadhuk bhavati iti āhitāgniḥ apa śabdam prayujya prāyaścittīyām sārasvatīm iṣṭim nirvapet iti tasmāt aśeṣāḥ vyākṛtā vāc ucyate ityādi vacana antara mūla tā api vyākaraṇa smṛteḥ pratyuktā

śiṣṭa prayoga mūlā tarhi vyākaraṇa smṛtiḥ astu vaidyaka smṛtiḥ iva anvaya vyatireka mūlā iti ced ke śiṣṭāḥ iti pṛṣṭaḥ vaktum arhasi kim tad abhimata gava ādi sādhu śabda vyavahāriṇaḥ gāvi ādi aśikṣita apa śabda vādināḥ dvaye vā ādye pakṣe duruttaram itaretara āśraya tvam śiṣṭa prayoga mūlam vyākaraṇam vyākaraṇa vidaḥ ca śiṣṭāḥ iti na hi aśikṣita vyākaraṇāḥ tad saṃskṛta gavā ādi śabda prayoga kuśalāḥ bhavanti

madhyama pakṣe gāvi ādi vyavahāriṇaḥ śākaṭikāḥ śiṣṭāḥ tad prayoga mūlam gavā ādi śabda saṃkāra kāri vyākaraṇam iti vyāhatam iva lakṣyate tṛtīye tu pakṣe go gāvī ādi śabda prayoga sāṃkāryāt kiṃphalam vyākaraṇam bhavet vaidya smṛteḥ tu yuktam anvaya vyatireka mūla tvam tathā darśanāt iti tad anayā api diśā na prayojana vat tām upayāti vyākaraṇam

atas ca niṣprayojanam vyākaraṇam tad sūtra kṛtā svayam prayojanasya anukta tvāt na hi atha atas dharma jijñāsā pramāṇa ādi jñānāt sādharmyādi jñāna dvā niḥśreyasa adhigamaḥ iti vat tatra sūtrakāraḥ prayojanam pratyapīpadat su jñāna tvāt na pratyapādayat iti ced kim ucyate su jñāna tvam yat adya api nipuṇam anveṣamāṇāḥ api na vidmaḥ yatra ca adya api sarve vivadante

kiṃca dharma artha kāma mokṣāḥ catvāraḥ puruṣa arthāḥ teṣām anyatamaḥ kila vyākaraṇasya prayojanam āśaṅkyeta tatra na tāvat dharmaḥ tasya prayojanam sa hi yāga dāna homa ādi svabhāvaḥ tad janita saṃskāra apūrvarūpaḥ vā vedāt eva avagamyate codanā eva dharme pramāṇam iti hi tad vidaḥ codanā mūlam anu ādi smṛti sat ācāra purāṇa itihāsa gamayaḥ vā sa kāmam bhavatu vyākaraṇasya tu svatas tad upadeśa sāmarthya asaṃbhavāt aṅga samākhyāta tvāt ca na tad prayojana tā yuktā

prayoga niyama dvārakaḥ tu dharmaḥ tasya aprayojana tayā nirastaḥ eva artha prayojana tā tu vārtā daṇḍanītyoḥ prasiddhā na vyākaraṇasya adhīta vyākaraṇāḥ api daridrāḥ prāyaśas dṛśyante iti na tasya arthaḥ prayojanam kāmaḥ tu vātsyāyana praṇīta kāma śāstra prayojana tām upagataḥ na vyākaraṇa sādhyatām spṛśati mokṣe tu dvāram ātma ādi parijñānam ācakṣate kleśa prahāṇam ca adhyātma vidaḥ ṣatvaṇa tva parijñānam punar apavarga sādhanam iti na sādhīyān vādaḥ tat evam dharma ādi caturvargāt ekaḥ api na vyākaraṇa sādhyaḥ iti sthitam

atha ucyate sakala puruṣa artha sārtha sādhana upadeśa vidheḥ vedasya vyākaraṇam avalagnakam aṅgam atas tad prayojanena eva prayojana vat idam iti na pṛthak prayojana antaram ākāṃkṣati iti tat api parihṛtam yayā hi sādhu śabda itara upadeśa diśā tasya tad aṅga tā sā vyudaḥ tā eva na ca aṅgasya api sataḥ tasya tad sevā dvāram aparam asti iti naṣprayojanyam eva na ca īdṛśam anupakārakam api aṅgam bhavitum arhati na hi tat pradhānena aṅgīkriyate niyoga garbhaḥ hi viniyogaḥ iti nyāya vidaḥ

yāni api rakṣā ādīni prayojanāni vyākaraṇasya vyākhyātṛbhiḥ abhihitāni teṣām anyatas api siddheḥ na vyākaraṇa śaraṇa tā muktā rakṣā tāvat adhyetṛ paramparātaḥ eva siddhā manāk api svarataḥ varṇataḥ vā pramādyantam kacid adhīyānam anye adhyetāraḥ mā vinīnaśas śrutim ittham uccārayaḥ iti ācakṣāṇāḥ śikṣayanti iti rakṣitaḥ bhavati vedaḥ

ūhaḥ tu trividhaḥ mantra sāma saṃskāra viṣayaḥ tatra sāma viṣayaḥ ūhaḥ kaśāstrāt avagamyate yājñika prayoga pravāhāt vā mantra viṣayaḥ api evam prokṣaṇa ādi saṃskāra viṣaye tu tasmin vyākaraṇam api kim kuryāt āgamaḥ tu anantaram eva parīkṣitaḥ āgama gamyam ca prayojanam bhavati na ca āgamaḥ eva prayojanam lāghavam tu kim ucyate vālyāt prabhṛti bahuṣu bahatsu api vatsareṣu yat na adhigantum śakyate vyākaraṇam sa ced ladhuḥ upāyaḥ kaḥ anyaḥ tatas guru bhaviṣyati

sandehaḥ api na kaścid veda arthe vyākaraṇena parāṇudyate prativākyam upaplavamāna nānā vidha sandeha sahasra visraṃsana phalā mīmāṃsā hi dṛśyate na vyākaraṇam tena rakṣaḥ hāgamala dhvasan dehāḥ prayojanam iti yat ucyate tat na sādhu vyāhṛtam yāni api prayojana antarāṇi bhūyāṃsi te asurāḥ helayaḥ helayaḥ iti udāharaṇa diśā darśitāni tāni api tuccha tvāt ānuṣaṅgika tvāt ca upekṣaṇīyāni tat uktam arthavat tvam na ced jātam mukhyaiḥ yasya prayojanaiḥ tasya anuṣaṅgikeṣu āśā kuśa kāśa ābalambinī iti

atha kathyate kim prayojana antara paryeṣaṇayā śabda saṃskāraḥ eva vyākaraṇasya prayojanam iti tat api vyākhyeyam kaḥ śabdasya saṃskāraḥ tena vā kaḥ arthaḥ iti na hi brīhīṇām iva prokṣaṇam ājyasya iva avekṣaṇam agnīnām iva ādhānam śabdasya kaścana vyākaraṇa kāritaḥ saṃskāraḥ saṃbhavati naiyāyika ādi pakṣe ca kṣaṇikāḥ varṇāḥ teṣām uccārita naṣṭānām kaḥ saṃskāraḥ śara ādeḥ iva na vegaḥ na ātmanaḥ iva bhāvanā na śākhā ādeḥ iva sthita sthāpakaḥ iti varṇānām nitya tva pakṣe api kṣaṇikā abhivyaktika tvam aparihāryam atas teṣu api kaḥ saṃskāraḥ

saṃskāraḥ ca varṇasya vā padasya vā vākyasya vā iti vikalpyamānaḥ na kasyacid vyavasthāpayitum śakyaḥ vaiyākaraṇānām tu niravayava vākya vādinām pada varṇayoḥ saṃskāraḥ sutarām anālambanaḥ apa uddhṛtya eva vākyebhyaḥ prakṛti pratyaya ādikam anyāni eva padāni saṃskariṣyante iti ced na asatām saṃskārya tva anupapatte āha ca vākyebhyaḥ eva parikalpanayā vibhajya saṃskartum icchati padāni mahāmatiḥ yaḥ uddhṛtya saurabha vibhūṣita dṛśi kasmāt ākāśa śākhi kusumāni na saṃskaroti iti

na ca śabda saṃskāra kartavyatā upadeśī kaścid anāramya adhītaḥ vā prakaraṇa paṭhitaḥ vā vidhiḥ upalabhyate yam anurudhyamānāḥ śabdasya upayukta raya cātvam lekṛṣṇa viṣāṇam prāsyati itivat upayokṣyamāṇasya vā brīhīn prokṣati iti vat kaṃcana saṃskāram anutiṣṭhema svādhyāyaḥ adhyetavyaḥ iti tu vidhiḥ abhimukhīkaraṇena māṇavakasya vā granthasya vā saṃskāram upadiśati iti mahatī caṛcā eṣā tiṣṭhatu sarvathā na ayam vyākaraṇa nivartya pratyaya āgama varṇa lopādeśa ādi dvāraka śabda saṃskāra upadeśa śaṅkām api janayati iti āḥ tām etat

na ca śabda prayoga upāyasya sthāna karaṇa ādeḥ koṣṭhasya mātariśvanaḥ vā śrotra indriyasya vā tad upalabdhi kāraṇasya prayoktuḥ ātmanaḥ vā buddheḥ vā kaścid vyākaraṇena saṃkāra leśaḥ śakya kriyaḥ iti tad vārake api saṃskāre anupāyaḥ eva vyākaraṇam na ca sthūla pṛṣati ityādi kati paya śabda vyutpādanam eva vyākaraṇa prayojana tayā vaktavyam tasya api kalpa sūtra ādi upāya antara labhya tvāt
yaḥ ca āha tattva avabodhaḥ śabdānām na asti vyākaraṇāt ṛte iti tasya sa upahāsam uttaram vārtikakāraḥ eva darśitavān tattva avabodhaḥ śabdānām na asti śrotra indriyāt ṛte iti

api ca vyākaraṇena kṛte api śabda saṃskāre tat upadiṣṭa saṃskāra bahiṣkṛta śabda prayogān vidadhataḥ tatra tatra pūrve api dṛśyante sūtrakāraḥ tāvat janikartuḥ prakṛtiḥ tad prayojakaḥ hetuḥ ca iti tṛjakābhyām kartari iti pratiṣiddham ṣaṣṭhī samāsam tathā janikartuḥ iti dhātu nirdeśa ekar viṣayam jani śabdam artha nirdeśe api prayuktavān

vārtikakāraḥ api dambheḥ halgṛhaṇasya jāti vācaka tvāt siddham iti tathā eva prayuktavān anya bhāvyam tu kāla śabda vyavāyāt iti ca kleśena samāsa saṃjñayā guṇa vacana saṃjñā bādhita tvāt aguṇa vacana tvāt brāhmaṇa ādi gaṇa paṭhita tvāt guṇa vacana brāhmaṇa ādibhyaḥ iti aprāptam eva ṣyañam kṛtavān

bhāṣya kāropi aviravika nyāyena iti dvandva garbhe tatpuruṣe prayuyukṣite supaḥ dhātu prātipadikayoḥ iti prāptam api lopam na kṛtavān anyathā kṛtvā codyam anyathā kṛtvā parihāraḥ iti ca atra cānyathā evam katham prāptam api ṇamulam upekṣya ttkāpratyayam prāyuṅkta tat idam tri muni vyākaraṇasya trayaḥ api ca munayaḥ skhalanti iti kam upāla bhemahi

manu ādi grantheṣi api kriyantaḥ apaśabdāḥ gaṇyante jñāta arassantime iti manunā akṣiṇī ājyaḥ iti āśvalāyanena mūrdhanyā abhijighraṇam iti gṛhyakāreṇa tad anantaram tubhyam ca rāghavasya iti vālmīkinā janme janme yat abhyastam iti dvaipāyanena prayuktam āha ca antaḥ na asti apaśabdānām itihāsa purāṇayoḥ iti athavā kim anena purāṇa puruṣa parivādena sarvathā ayam vastu saṃkṣepaḥ kṣāmaḥ api kaścid upayogaḥ na loke vede vā vyākaraṇasya vidyate iti

kiṃca anyat atha śabda anuśāsanam iti upakramya keṣām śabdanām iti pṛṣṭvā laukikānām vedikānām ca iti pratijñāya na laukikāḥ sarve vyākartum pāritāḥ śabdāḥ na api vaidikāḥ tathā hi teṣām vyākriyā pratipadam vā vidhīyate lakṣaṇataḥ vā pratipadam tāvat anuśāsanam aghaṭamānam ānantyāt śabdānām tathā ca āhuḥ bṛhaspatiri drāya divyam varṣa sahasram pratipadam vihitān śabdān provāca na ca antam jagām iti na api lakṣaṇataḥ tad asaṃbhavāt na hi sakala sādhu śabda varga anugatam apaśabdebhyaḥ ca vyāvṛttam go tva ādi vat iha kiṃcid lakṣaṇam asti iti uktam

tatra etat syāta na jāti ādi rūpam iha lakṣaṇam abhidhitsitam api tu katham anuśāsanam iti praśna pūrvakam uktam prakṛti ādi vibhāga kalpanayā sāmānya viśeṣa tatā lakṣeṇa ina iti ca tathā hi karmaṇi aṇ iti sāmānya lakṣaṇam karmaṇi upapade dhātu mātrā daṇ pratyayaḥ bhavati iti ātaḥ anupasarge kaḥ iti viśeṣa lakṣaṇam ākāra antāt dhātoḥ upasarga rahitāt karmaṇi upapade kapratyayaḥ bhavati iti tena anena sāmānya viśeṣavatā lakṣaṇena kumbhakāraḥ nagara kāraḥ ityādayaḥ go daḥ kambala daḥ ityādayaḥ bhūyāṃsaḥ śabdāḥ akleśena eva vyākariṣyante iti ucyate prakṛti ādi vibhāga kalpa nayā iti atra yat vaktavyam tad prāk eva sa vistaram abhihitam sāmānya viśeṣavatā lakṣaṇeta iti tu saṃpratinirūpyate tat api vyavasthitam lakṣaṇam na dṛśyate tathā hi dhātoḥ pare pratyayāḥ bhavanti iti lakṣaṇam kurvatā vaktavyam kaḥ punar ayam dhātuḥ nāma iti

nanu bhūva ādayaḥ dhātavaḥ iti uktam eva tad svarūpam kecana śabdāḥ kayācid paripāṭyā paṭhitāḥ te dhātu saṃjñayā lakṣyante tebhyaḥ pare tiṅaḥ kṛtaḥ ca pratyayāḥ bhavanti iti satyam uktam etat kintu evam pāṭhe kṛte api na dhātu svarupa nirṇayaḥ upavarṇitaḥ bhavatim tathā ca gaṇḍati iti api prāpnoti dhātoḥ tij pratyaya vidhānāt ghaṭa ceṣṭāyām iti dhātuḥ asti ca ghaṭaḥ iti prātipadikam amaḥ roge iti dhātuḥ anubandhati āgātam iti bhavati asti ca dvitīya avibhakteḥ eka vacanam iti bhū śabdaḥ dhātuḥ asti ca bhū prātipadikam yatī prayatne iti lupta anubandhaḥ yatas iti dhātuḥ asti ca yat iti sarvanāma tatra ca pāṭha prasiddha rūpa mātrā viśeṣāt adhātoḥ api ghaṭa bhū yat śabda rūpāt pare tiṅpratyayāḥ bhaveyuḥ

kriyā vacanaḥ dhātuḥ iti ced bhavati tiṣṭhati iti evamādīnām adhātu tvam prapnoti gaṇḍeḥ ca anarthakaḥ pāṭhaḥ ubhayam tarhi dhātu lakṣaṇam pāṭhaḥ kriyā vacana tā ca iti na bhavitum arhati tat api hi vyastam vā lakṣaṇam samastam vā vyavasta pakṣe pratyekam amihite doṣaḥ tad avasthaḥ eva samasta pakṣe api bhavati ādau kriyā vacana tvasya dvitīya lakṣaṇasya ca abhāvāt adhātu tvam eva syāt iti evam dhātoḥ prakṛteḥ anirṇīta tvāt kutas pare tiṅaḥ ca kṛtaḥ ca pratyayāḥ utpadyeran

kiṃca kecana tiṅpratyayāḥ kāla ādi upādhayaḥ na tad vacanāḥ anukteṣu ca kāla ādiṣu tad pūrvakam vartamāne laṭ bhaviṣyati ḷṛṣ bhūte luṅ iti niyama nirūpaṇam aśakyam ucyatām tarhi tiṅbhiḥ kāla ādayaḥ iti ced na bhāṣya virodhāt uktam hi bhagavatā bhāṣya kāreṇa bhūte dhātu arthaḥ iti na ca dhātu arthena eva dhātu arthaḥ vyavasthāpayitum śakyate liṅa ādayaḥ ca sutarām anadhigamyamāna viṣayāḥ te hi vidhi ādau arthe vidhīyante sa ca bidhi rūpaḥ arthaḥ svarūpa taḥ ca upādhitaḥ ca na śakyaḥ nirṇetum iti

tathā kāraka anuśāsanam api dusstham dhruvam apāye apādānam iti ucyate tatra dhruvasya vṛkṣa ādeḥ vṛkṣāt patitaḥ devadattaḥ iti patana kriyāyām acalataḥ kṛśam api na kāraka tvam utpaśyāmaḥ kriyāyogi hi kārakam sā ca vṛkṣe na upalabhyate iti sārthāt hīnaḥ rathāt patitaḥ iti sārtha rathayoḥ kriyā upalabhyate na vṛkṣa vat niścala tvam iti ced satyam sva rasa pravṛttā tayoḥ asti kriyā hāne yāne ca pādapa nirviśeṣau eva sārtha rathau na ca yat ekasyām kriyāyām kārakam tat sarvāsu kriyāsu kārakam bhavati atiprasaṅgāt

karmaṇā yam abhipraiti sa saṃpradānam iti atra karma śabdaḥ kriyā vacanaḥ vā syāt īpsitatama kāraka vācī vā ādye pakṣe kriyayā sarva kārakāṇi abhipreyante iti kriyāsu kārakāṇi saṃpradāna tām pratipadyeran na ca upādhyāyasya kicid abhiprīyamāṇasya vyāpāram utpaśyāmaḥ iti asau akārakam eva tatra syāt pratigrahaḥ tu kriyā antaram eva tatra ca uktam kriyayā ca abhipreyamāṇam phalam bhavati na kārakam iti vakṣyāmaḥ dvitīyaḥ tu pakṣaḥ karmaṇā kārakeṇa gavā ādinā yam abhipraiti iti sutarām saṃkaṭaḥ kriyā saṃbandhi tayā hi kārakam kārakam bhavati na kāraka saṃbandhi tayā karoti iti kārakam iti vyutpatteḥ

sādhakatamam karaṇam iti tam abartha anavadhāraṇāt anupapannam aneka kāraka saṃdarbha sannidhāne kāryam ātmānam labhate teṣām anyatama vyapagame api na labhyate iti tatas kim iva kārakam atiśaya khacita vapuḥ iti yam tam artham maṅgala kalaśena abhirṣicāmaḥ prācuryeṇa hi pradhāna saṃpatti paryanta vyāpāra yogi tva mityādi sarva sādhāraṇam na kāṣṭha eka niṣṭham iti kāṣṭhaiḥ pacati iti katham teṣām eva karaṇa tvam

ādhāraḥ adhikaraṇam iti yat ucyate tatra vaktavyam kasya ādhāraḥ iti kriyāyāḥ kārakasya vā yadi kriyādhāra tvam adhikaraṇa lakṣaṇam aśeṣa kārakāṇām adhikaraṇa saṃjñā prasajyeta kriyā yoga aviśeṣāt atha yatra sthālī ādau karma āśritam taṇḍula ādi tad adhikaraṇam same deśe pacati iti na syāt apsupacati iti syāt kaṭe sthitaḥ bhuṅkte iti ca apa bhraṃśaḥ bhavet kartuḥ hi tat adhikaraṇam na karmaṇaḥ kartṛ karmaṇoḥ kriyā āśrayayoḥ dhāraṇam adhikaraṇa tvena kārakam iti ced ubhaya dhāra tvam na kaṭasya na sthālyāḥ iti dvayoḥ api adhikaraṇa tā hīyeta ekaika ādhāra tve tu tad lakṣaṇe paraspara apekṣayā punar tad svarūpa sāṃkaryam bhavet yadi tu sakala kāraka ādhāra tvam adhikaraṇa lakṣṇam sthālyām odanam pacati iti na syāt sakala kārakān adhikaraṇa tvāt sthālyāḥ adhikaraṇasya ca ākāraka tva prasaktiḥ na hi adhikaraṇam adhikaraṇa āśritam bhavati madhyāhne snāti rātrau aśnāti pūrvasyām diśi viharati iti kāla ādīnām avyāpāra tvāt akāraka tvam eva bhavet tathā ca sati ete prayogāḥ asādhavaḥ syuḥ

kartuḥ īpsitatamam karma iti sādhakatama vat iha api na vācakaḥ ayam atiśāyanaḥ sarva kārakāṇām kriyā arthitayā kartuḥ īpsitatama tvāt atha yad arthā kriyā tad artham kartuḥ īpsitatamam tad artham tu anyat iti tatra tamappratyaḥ iti ucyate tarhi tasya kāraka tvam eva na yuktam kriyā saṃpādakam hi kārakam ucyate na kriyā saṃpādyam kriyā saṃpādyam tu phalam bhavati na kārakam kārakam ca kriyayā ca āptum iṣṭatamam iti ca vipratiṣiddham

atha abhidhīyate kriyā upayoga yogya tā nibandhanaḥ ayam kāraka vyapadeśaḥ sa ca vicitraḥ kriyā upayogaḥ anyathā karaṇasya anyathā adhikaraṇasya anyathā saṃpradāna ādeḥ iha ca kriyā asādhya tve api odanasya tad kriyā upayogi tvam anivāryam tam anuddiśya kriyāyāḥ pravṛtti abhāvāt iti ittham anena rūpeṇa tasya kriyā sādhana tvāt kāraka tvam iti na etat evam kāraka tva vyapadeśaḥ hi na pāribhāṣikaḥ kitu kriyā saṃbandha nibandhanaḥ kriyā saṃbandhaḥ ca īdṛśaḥ yat upeyā kriyā tad upāyaḥ kārakamisi viparyaye tu kīdṛśaḥ kāraka bhāvaḥ
astu tarhi taṇḍulān pacati iti mā ca bhūt odanam pacati iti odanasya phala daśa anupraveśāt iti uktam atra taṇḍuleṣu api tam abarthaḥ na vācakaḥ teṣām api phala sādhana upayoga aviśeṣāt iti
svatantraḥ kartā iti kim idam svātantryam kriyā saṃpādyam yat icchātaḥ pravartanam iti ced kūlam patati iti caitanya śūnya tayā kūlasya icchā anupalambhāt akartṛ tvam bhavet

atha yat vyāpāra adhīnaḥ kāraka antara vyāpāraḥ sa kartā iti ucyate sarva kāraka nirvartya tvāt kriyāyāḥ na vidmaḥ kiṃvyāpāra adhīnaḥ kasya vyāpāraḥ iti samagra kāraka grāmasya paraspara apekṣa tvāt atha yaḥ kāraka antarāṇi prayuṅkte taiḥ ca na prayujyate sa kartā iti tarhi punar acetanānām akartṛ tva prasaṅga doṣaḥ tad avasthaḥ eva atha dhātunā abhidhīyamāna vyāpāraḥ kartā iti tatra api na vidmaḥ kasya dhātunā abhihitaḥ vyāpāraḥ sakala kāraka vāci tvāt paceḥ anyathā hi sakala vyāpāra an abhidhāyini dhātau tad artha sādhane sarveṣām saṅgatiḥ eva na syāt tathā ca sati sarva kāra kaṇi kartṛ tvam eva spṛśeyuḥ

atha matam aguṇataḥ dhātunā abhidhīyamāna vyāpāraḥ kartā iti tat api asat sakṛt uccaritaḥ dhātuḥ anekasmit kāraka cakre kasyacid guṇa tvena kasya cit prādhānyena vyāpāram katham iva kathayitum śakṣyati iti tad prayojakaḥ hetuḥ ca iti prayojyena eva vyākhyātam evam kāraka anuśāsanasya avyavasthānāt tad adhīna prasakta vibhakti vidhānam api pratyuktam apādāne paṃcamī saptamī adhikaraṇe ca ityādi viṣaya nirūpaṇa pūrvaka tvāt tad vidhānasya iti

kiṃca yat api kṛt taddhita samāsa anuśāsanam tat sāmarthya niyama pūrvakam samarthānām prathamāt vā samarthaḥ pada vidhiḥ iti paribhāṣaṇāt tat atra api vaktavyam sāmarthyam nāma kim ucyate iti eka artha anvayitvam iti ced tat kutas avagamyate tad hita samāsa prayoga pratipattibhyām eva iti ced tarhi tābhyām sāmarthya avagamaḥ sāmarthye sati tayoḥ pravṛtiḥ iti itaretara āśrayam api ca sāmarthyam antareṇa api kvacid prayujate samāsam aśrāddha bhojī dadhi ghaṭaḥ go rathaḥ iti tathā sati api sāmarthye tad hita prayogam pariharanti aṅgulyā khanati vṛkṣa mūlāt āgataḥ iti āṅgulikaḥ vārkṣa mūlaḥ iti na vaktāraḥ bhavanti iti etat api asamaṃjasam anuśāsanam

tathā arthavat adha ātuḥ apratyayaḥ prātipadikam iti saṃjñā lakṣaṇam ati vyāpakam vākyasya api prātipadika saṃjñā prasaṃgāt atha kṛttat hita samāsāḥ ca iti sūtra antare samāsa grahaṇam vidhi śeṣa tvena varṇyamānam tad itara prataṣedha phalam bhavati iti tatas vākya nivṛttiḥ setsyati yadi evam adhātuḥ apratyayaḥ iti na vaktavyam dhātu pratyapayoḥ api tatas eva pratiṣedha siddheḥ

atha eka artha tayā samāna śīlasya vākyasya eva pratiṣedhe prabhavati samāsa grahaṇam na dhātu pratyayayoḥ iti tat api durāśā mātram vākya samāsayoḥ api vā vacana ānarthakya kathanena pārtha garthya vyavasthāpanāt iti tat evam prātipādika saṃjñā viṣayasya aniścayāt tad prakṛtikānām ṅyāpprātipadikāt iti adhikṛtya svādi pratyayānām vidhānam anupapannam iti alam prasaṅgena sarvathā durvyavasthitam śabda anuśāsanam

yaḥ ca vyākhyātṝṇām ukta anukta durukta nirīkṣaṇa prayatnaḥ yaḥ ca vācaka mātrā vā arṇā ādhikya miṣa purassara lakṣaṇa paricodana prakāraḥ yat ca idam vyākhyātṛ vacanam iha na bhavati anabhidhānāt iti yat ca pade pade bahula vacanam tat sarvam sutarām apariśuddhim anuśāsanasya darśayati iti

anye tu śobhā iti cīrṇam iti na yāti pratibhettum iti mātuḥ anuharati iti phalina barhiṇam balavānaḥ hi adyāsā iti kāṃdiśīkaḥ iti bhrājiṣṇuḥ iti gaṇeyaḥ iti vareṇyaḥ iti lakṣya saṃgraha bahiṣkṛta smṛti saṃdeha viparyaya pratipādaka tva lakṣaṇa skhalitam viplutam ca pāṇinitantram iti manyamānāḥ tatra mahāntam ākṣepa matāniṣuḥ sa tu sthūla udara prāyaḥ iti iha grantha gaurava bhayāt na likhyate

nanu yadi lakṣaṇasya praṇetā pāṇiniḥ asamyak darśī tatra vivaraṇa kārāḥ ca na ati puṇa dṛśaḥ kāmam anyaḥ sūtra kṛt kṛtabuddhitaraḥ bhaviṣyati vṛtti kārāḥ ca prauḍhatara dṛṣṭayaḥ bhaviṣyanti tebhyaḥ ca śabda lakṣaṇam aviplutam avabhotsyāmahe iti na etat asti teṣām api abhiyuktarāḥ kecid utprekṣante eva doṣam teṣām apare teṣām api apare tat evam anavastha prasaṅgāt na asti nirmalam anuśāsanam iti kleśāya eva vyākaraṇa adhyayana mahā vrata grahaṇam tathā ca āha bṛhaspatiḥ pratipadam aśakya tvāt lakṣaṇasya api avyavasthānāt tatra api skhalita darśanāt anavasthā prasaṅgāt ca maraṇa antaḥ vyādhiḥ vyākaraṇam iti auśanasā iti iha api uktam duṣṭa graha gṛhītaḥ vā bhītaḥ vā rāja daṇḍataḥ pitṛbhya abhiśaptaḥ vā kuryāt vyākaraṇe śramam

anyaiḥ api uktam vṛttiḥ sūtram tilāḥ māṣāḥ kaṭandī kodravodanaḥ ajaḍāya pradātavyam jaḍīkaraṇam uttamam iti evam vyākaraṇa avagāhana kṛta udyogaḥ api vidvat janaḥ vyutpattim labhate na vaidika pada grāme manuṣya ukti vat anyat kiṃcana tad pratīti śaraṇam na asti iti ca vyākṛtam tasmāt apratipatti manthara mukhe vedāḥ pramāṇam katham

atra abhidhiyate yat tāvat idama vādi gavā ādi śabda vat anādi prabandha siddham eva gāvi ādeḥ api vācaka tvam iti tatra amum pakṣam saṃśaya daśām eva tāvat āropayāpaḥ pūrva pākṣikā ukta yukti samutthāpita sthiratara viparyaya jñāna samanantaram sahasā eva samyak jñāna utpādana ati bhārāt bhāra eka deśa avataraṇa nyāyena saṃśayaḥ tāvat upapadyate tatas tarkāt pariśodhite adhvani sugame sukham vihariṣyati samyak nirṇaya upāyaḥ nyāyaḥ iti tat ucyate yadi gāvi ādīnām gavā ādīnām iva śabdānām prayoge gatiḥ anyā na kācid saṃbhāvanā bhūmi madhyeti tat satyam ādi sattāyāḥ kalpane kaḥ avasaraḥ

yathā hi svādhyāya adhyayana samaye yādṛśam eva śabdam yathā udita mātra anusvāra svara ādi svarūpa samuttham tam uccārayati ācāryaḥ tādṛśam eva tam śiṣyaḥ pratyuccārayati pramādyantam vā guruḥ eva enam anuśāsti ā tad uccāraṇa sāmarthya upajananam tāvat na muṃcati śikṣayati saḥ api śiṣṭaḥ yadā guruḥ bhavati tadā sva śiṣyam tathā eva śikṣayiṣyati ācāryaḥ api yadā śaiśave śiṣyaḥ āsīt tadā anyena guruṇā śikṣitaḥ abhūt saḥ api tad anyena saḥ api tad anyena iti evam anādi tvam jaiminīya pakṣe ā jagat sargāt prabhṛti pravṛtta tvam vā naiyāyika pakṣe vedasya vyavasthitam

ittham eva yadi gāvi ādīnām gavā ādi vat apramāda kṛtaḥ su parirakṣitaḥ prayogaḥ tathā eva ca etebhyaḥ artha pratipatti pūrvakaḥ vyavahāraḥ tadā anādi gava ādi śabda samāna viṣayāḥ eva gāvi ādayaḥ iti tadā kasya kim brūmaḥ asti tu atra aparaḥ prakāraḥ na hi ekāntena yādṛś eva vaktrā śabdaḥ prayujyate tādṛś eva śrotrā pratyuccāryate kintu pramāda ālasya ādi vividha aparādha vidhura karaṇa uccāryamāṇaḥ apabhraṃśatām spṛśan dṛśyate iti asti saṃśaya avasaraḥ

apabhraṃśatayā api ye sthitāḥ sthāsyanti vā śākaṭika bhāṣā śabdāḥ tān api gopāla bāla abala ādiṣu prayuṃjānāḥ jaraṭhapa amarāḥ prayatnena api na yathā uccāritān eva tān pāṭhayiktum śaknuvanti iti aśakti ja śabda prayoga bāhulya darśanāt saṃśayānā kuśa agra buddheḥ api buddhiḥ bhavitum arhati kim ete gavā ādi śabdāḥ eva anādi siddha vācaka śakti bhājaḥ tebhyaḥ anye viguṇa karaṇa prayojya apramāda prabhavāḥ apabhraṃśāḥ kim vā sarve eva tulya kakṣyāḥ iti rveṣāṃsa tulya kakṣya tve yaḥ ete adyatve api pramādataḥ pramadā dāsa dāraka ādi vadaneṣu apabhraṣṭā abhyadhikatarām apabhraṃśa daśām spṛśantaḥ te api tām eva gavā ādi śabda dhurā bhadhiroheyuḥ

na ca evam astu iti śakyam abhyanujñātum idanīm eva bhraśyatām teṣām pratyakṣataḥ upalabdheḥ iti tasmāt avaśyam tāvat adya tve paridṛśyamānā apabhraṃśa dṛśāḥ durbala bāla abala ādi śabdāḥ na gavā ādi śabdān spardhituḥ mahanti te ced na spardhante tad adhunā gāvya dayaḥ api prakāra antara upapatti saṃbhāvanā bhaṅgura prabhāvāḥ santaḥ na gavā ādi śabda samāna vidhi tvam adhyavasātum śaknuyuviti tarkayāmaḥ

tat uktam bhagavatā jaimininā śabde prayatna niṣpatteḥ aparādhasya bhāgi tvam iti bhāṣya kāreṇa api tat vyākhyātam mahatā prayatnena śabdaḥ uccāritaḥ vāyuḥ nābheḥ utthitaḥ urasi vistīrṇaḥ kaṇṭhe vivartitaḥ mūrdhānam āhatya parāvṛttaḥ vaktre caran vividhān śabdān abhivyanakti tatra aparādhyetā api uccārayitā yathā śuṣke patiṣyāmi iti kardame patati sakṛt upaspṛkṣyāmi iti dvis upaspṛśati ityādinā

āha viśeṣe tarhi pramāṇam vaktavyam yat ete gāvi ādayaḥ pramāda ādi aparādha nibandhanāḥ eva na gavā ādi śabda samāna vidhayaḥ iti ucyate bhavatu siddham nassamīhitam saṃśaya daśām tāvat ānītaḥ ayam anādi gāvi ādi śabda vācī mahāpuruṣaḥ saṃbodhyate bho mahātman ittham pūrva ukta nītyā saṃśaye sati cintyatām kim ete gāvi ādayaḥ gavā ādi samāna yogakṣemāḥ eva hastaḥ karaḥ pāṇiḥ iti vat bhavantu kiṃvā aparādha saṃbhāvanayā mārga antaram ālā ambantām iti

tatra ekasmin vācye bahavaḥ tulya kakṣyāḥ vācakāḥ iti na eṣa nyāyaḥ katham pratyartham śabda niveśāt tena eva sambandha karaṇa saukaryāt anyathā ca saṃbandhe yatna gaurava prasaṅgāt pratyartham śabda niveśe hi sati parasparam avyabhicāriṇau śabda arthaḥ bhavataḥ sa śabdaḥ tasya vācakaḥ saḥ arthaḥ tasya vācyaḥ iti aneka śabda vācyaḥ tu ekaḥ arthaḥ tam vācakam śabdam vijahyāt api tam antareṇa śabda abhidheyatām api pratipadyate itivya bhicāraḥ

aneka artha vācini ca ekasmin vācake iṣyamāṇe śabdaḥ artha vyabhicaret tasya iva artha antarasya api tatas pratipatteḥ iti ittham aniyamaḥ ayam upaplaveta hastaḥ karaḥ pāṇiḥ iti ādau akṣāḥ pādāḥ māṣāḥ ityādau tu kim kriyate gatiḥ anyā na upalabhyate tena aneka śabda tvam aneka artha tvam daiva balavat tayā aṅgīkṛtam prathamaḥ punar eṣaḥ ṛjuḥ panthāḥ yat ekasya vācakasya ekaḥ vācyaḥ arthaḥ iti iha ca gati antaram atispaṣṭam asti pramāda prabhava tvam nāma tasmin sati kim iti prathama prāptaḥ ayam prativācyam vācaka niyama kramaḥ laṅghyate tena pramāda aparādha nibandhanāḥ gāvi ādayaḥ na gavā ādi samāna mahimānaḥ iti yuktam

kiṃca vācakaśaktiḥ nāma sūkṣmā parama parokṣā arthāpatti mātra śaraṇa avagamā na tad manda tāyām anyatas kutaścid avagantum pāryate sā ca iyam anyathā api upapadyamānā gavā ādibhyaḥ artha pratyaya ādi vyavahāre mandībhavati teṣu śakti kalpanāyām arthāpattiḥ evam ca gavā ādayaḥ eva vācaka śakteḥ āśrayāḥ na gāvi ādayaḥ
katham tarhi bahūnām anadhigata vyākaraṇa tantrāṇām ebhiḥ avicchinnaḥ vyavahāraḥ yathā eva mleccha bhāṣābhiḥ akṣi nikoca hasta saṃjñā di vya vahāriṇām vā svaiḥ svaiḥ upāyaiḥ

kim akṣi nikoca ādīnām antya janapada vācām na asti śaktiḥ om iti ucyate katham tarhi tebhyaḥ artha pratipattiḥ naisargikī teṣām śaktiḥ na asti iti brūmaḥ tad svarūpasya avyavasthita tvena sāṃsiddhika śakti pātra tā anupapatteḥ pratipattiḥ tu sva kṛta samaya mātra nibandhanā tebhyaḥ

nanu naiyāyikānām vā na samayaḥ pratipatti upāyaḥ satyam sa tu īśvara praṇītaḥ prathama sargāt prabhṛti pravṛttaḥ mīmāṃsaka abhyupagata naisargika śakti sodaryaḥ eva na mādṛśa racita parimita viṣaya samaya samānaḥ sa ca gavā ādi śabdeṣu eva prāpta pratiṣṭhaḥ na gāvi ādiṣu te tu varṇa sārūpya chāyayā gavā ādi śabda smṛtim ādadhānāḥ tad artha pratipatti hetutām upagacchanti

nanu anavadhṛta svarūpāṇām katham gavā ādi śabdānām smaraṇam tad avadhāraṇe vā kaḥ abhyupāyaḥ abhiyoga viśeṣaḥ iti brūmaḥ kaḥ punar abhiyogaḥ kaḥ vā tasya viśeṣaḥ vyākaraṇa adhyayanam abhiyogaḥ tad abhyāsa anusāreṇa lakṣya nirīkṣaṇam tasya viśeṣaḥ vyākaraṇena ca pratipadam aparyavasitam ārya jana prayojya sādhu śabda sārtha saṅgra hataḥ tad visadṛśa barbara purandhri prāya prākṛta gocara apa śabda parihāra prakāra vyutpādanam upakramyate yadānantyāt kila kalpa śataiḥ api na avakalpate

kintu vyapanīta ati vyāpti ādi doṣa upanipāta trāsa tri muni parīkṣita lakṣaṇa dvārakaḥ tad upadeśaḥ śrūyate tena ca vedenava dharma adharmayoḥ brahma avatāreṇa iva satya anṛtayoḥ nīti śāstreṇa iva hita ahitayoḥ manu ādi vacanena iva bhakṣya abhakṣyayoḥ divyena iva śuddhi aśaddhayoḥ sidhyati eva sādhu asādhu śabdayoḥ adhigamaḥ iti sarva loka sākṣikam etat katham apanīyate

dṛśyate hi adyatve api vyākaraṇa kovidānām itareṣām ca kṛṣī bala ādīnām ati mahān vacasi viśeṣaḥ iti evam pramāda ādi mūla gāvyāt yapaśabda prayoga saṃbhavāt aneka śabda gata vācaka śakti kalpanā gaurava prasaṅgāt abhiyoga viśeṣa sādhyamāna sādhu asādhu śabda adhigama saukaryāt ca gavā ādīnām eva vācaka tvam na gāvi ādīnām iti sthite pūrva pakṣa upanyastaḥ samastaḥ eva parīvādaḥ parihṛtaḥ veditavyaḥ

tathā hi yat tāvat abhyadhāyi sādhu tva niścaye pramāṇam na asti iti sādhu tvam na indriya grāhyam liṅgam asya na vidyate śāstrasya viṣayaḥ na eṣa prayogaḥ na asti asaṃkaraḥ iti tatra ayam pratiślokaḥ sādhu tvam indriya grāhyam liṅgam api asya vidyate śāstrasya viṣayaḥ api evam prayogaḥ api asti asaṃkaraḥ

iti śrautre hi pratyaye grasta nirasta roma śāmbūkṛta ādi doṣa rahita udātta ādi dharma saṃbandha prasiddha anupūrvīka varṇa gaṇa ātmaka pada pratibhāsaḥ tāvat asti sa ca na saṃdigdhaḥ na bādhaka vidhūta dhairyaḥ na aśuddha karaṇa janmā na kalpanā mātra svarūpaḥ iti tatra parisphurat sphuṭa krama varṇa ātmaka pada grahaṇam eva sādhu tva grahaṇam tad viparīta yathā nirdiṣṭa doṣa kaluṣita śabda grahaṇam eva ca asādhu tva grahaṇam iti pratyakṣamye eva sādhu tva asādhu tve iti

nanu yadi śrotra karaṇakena eva pratyayena sādhu tva asādhu tve pratipattāraḥ pratipadyante vyākaraṇa adhyayana vandhya buddhayaḥ api pratipadyeran na ca pratipadyante tasmāt na te indriya viṣaye iti na eṣa doṣaḥ vaiyākaraṇa upadeśa sahāya kopa kṛta śrotra indriya gāhya tva abhyupagamāt yathā hi brāhmaṇa tva ādi jātiḥ upadeśa savyapekṣa cakṣuḥ indriya grāhyā api na pratyakṣa gamyatām apojjhati yathā aaha na hi yat giri śṛṅgam āruhya gṛhyate tat apratyakṣam iti yathā vā sa vikalpaka pratyakṣa prāmāṇya siddhau śabda anuviddha bodhe api prāmāṇyam upapāditam ādau

kila saṃjñā upadeśinā panasaḥ ayam iti vṛddha vacasā cakṣuḥ indriyeṇa panasa jñānam utpadyate saṅketa karaṇa kāle tad ubhaya jam iti avyapadeśya padena vyapanītam vyavahāra kāle tu punar panasa ādi jñānam upadeśa smaraṇa apekṣa cakṣuḥ janitam api cākṣuṣam eva iti varṇitam evam iha api vyākaraṇa kovida upadeśa saciva śravaṇa indriya grāhye api sādhu tva asādhu tve na pratyakṣatām ativartete

yathā ca brāhmaṇa tva ādi jāti pratītau kāraṇa antara m uktam kvacid ācārataḥ ca api samyak rāja anupālitāt iti manu ādi darśitān avadya vartma anusaraṇa nipuṇatara bhūpati paripālyamāna varṇa āśramāṇām śaṅkita kṛtakaka paṭa ārya veṣa duṣṭa śūdra tā vyabhicāre deśe viśiṣṭa ācāra gamyā api brāhmaṇa tva ādi jātiḥ bhavati evam i ha api viśiṣṭa śabda śravaṇa anantara kāla pravṛtta vyavahāra avagama artha pratipatti sahitam śabda anuśāsana śāstra upadiṣṭa prakṛti pratyaya vikaraṇa varṇa la upāgama ādeśa ādi liṅgam avyabhicāri tad svarūpa avadhāraṇe kāraṇam bhaviṣyati yat evaṃlakṣaṇakam artha pratyāyakam ca śabda svarūpam tata sādhu tayā avadhṛtam iti vyāpti grahaṇa upapatteḥ

śāstram api śruti smṛti rūpam aduṣṭa śabda prayoga upana ta kratu upakāra karaṇaka svarga ādi phala saṃyogam upadiśat apaśabda bhāṣaṇa prabhava pratyavāya pratipādakam ca vāc yoga vid duṣyati cāpa śabdaiḥ ityādi sādhu tva itara paricchede pramāṇa tām pratipadyate eva

nanu brīhi kalaṃja vat tad svarūpa siddhau satyām tad vidhi pratiṣedhayoḥ śāstram kramate na tu tad svarūpam eva vidhatte svarūpasya abhāva artha tvena vidhi viṣaya tva ayogāt iti uktam satyam kintu śruti smṛti śāstrayoḥ dharma upadeśinoḥ yathā upavarṇitena eva prakāreṇa sādhu asādhu viṣaya vidhi niṣedha paratvam tad svarūpa pratipatti kartavyatā param tu vidhi apekṣita vyākaraṇa smṛti rūpam eva śāstram veditavyam mūla vidhi apekṣita sādhu tvā anvākhyāna para tvāt ca vyākaraṇasya mūla śāstram api tatra sopāna vyavahitam pramāṇībhavati eva
yadi vā pāṇini ādiṣṭa smṛti draḍhimnā mūla bhūtam ācamana ādi vidhivat vaidikam api tathāvidham vidhi vākyam kalpayitum śakyam iti śāstrasya api na aviṣayaḥ sādhu tvam

śabda vid prayogaḥ ca saṅkara rahitaḥ eva tathā hi anyāḥ eva niravadya varṇa krama udīraṇa udāra gambhīra gatayaḥ sūktayaḥ sūri janasya anyāḥ eva duḥśravāḥ kussita saṅkīrṇa varṇa vibhāga vinihita hṛdaya udvevāḥ grāmyāḥ giraḥ iti pratyakṣam upalabhyate sa ca ayam asaṅkaraḥ prayogaḥ vyākaraṇa sahāyakam pratipadyamānaḥ sādhu tva avagama upāya tām bhajate eva iti sarvathā na aprāmāṇakaḥ sādhu asadhu śabda vibhāgaḥ iti evam ca brāhmaṇena na mlecchita vai na apabhāṣita vai mlecchaḥ havāḥ eṣa yat apaśabdaḥ iti ādi a āgama śabdāni api tad upayogīni vyākhyātāni iva bhavanti iti

yat punar niyama śāstre sādhubhiḥ bhāṣitavyam asādhubhiḥ naḥ iti asmin apabhāṣitam tat api na peśalam na hi nīra pāna upadeśa vat kṛśa anupāna niṣedha vat vā anavakāśam idam śāstram apaśabdānām anārya jana vadana pratiṣṭhānām yathā tathā artha prati iti upāya tva darśana pūrvaka prayoga prasaṅga an apāyena prāptau satyām pratiṣedhasya avakāśa saṃbhavāt sādhubhiḥ eva bhāṣaṇasya bhojana prāṅmukha tā ādi vat niyama adṛṣṭa sāphalyāt

yat api sādhu asādhu svarūpa anavadhāraṇāt pratipadā upadeśa ādi aśakya tvam āśaṅkitam tat api prativihitam yādṛś idam pratyakṣa anumāna gamyam sādhu asādhu śabda svarūpam vyākhyātam tad abalambana purassara niyama karaṇasya suśaka tvāt atas eva sādhu tvam nāma kim ucyate iti yat vikalpitam tat prativihita mā iva bhavati yatas vyākaraṇa lakṣaṇa anugama viśeṣitam vācaka tvam sādhu tvam iti uktam tat ca sarva anugāmi go tva ādi vat sāmānyam vā bhavatu pācaka tva ādi vat asatī api sāmānye avacchedakam bhavatu sarvathā tad kṛtaḥ nirvahati sarvaḥ vyavahāraḥ vargīkaraṇe hi tat eva kāraṇam iti athavā punar astu vācaka tvam eva sādhu tvam tathā api tatra niyama śāstram sādhubhiḥ eva bhāṣitavyam iti pravartitum arhati eva

yadi api asādhora vācaka tvāt prayoga prasaṅga ūnā asti tathā api sādhu smaraṇa saraṇi samupārūḍha vācaka tva śaṅkā upaplava māna prasaṅga nivṛttaye niyama sāphalyam bhaviṣyati vidhi phala tvena niyamasya phalatas parisaṃkhyā kāryam asādhu śabda nivṛttiḥ sthāsyati iti saḥ api na doṣaḥ

yat api para artha tvāt phala śrutim artha vādīkurvatā puṇya pāpa phala tvam dūṣitam tat api na sāṃpratam artha pratīti pārārthye sati api prayoga niyama apūrva dvāraka puṇya pāpa phala tva saṃbhavāt parṇa mayī ādiṣu api tathā prasaṃgaḥ iti ced bhavatu kaḥ doṣaḥ naiyāyikaiḥ eka ākāra nirabalambana artha vāda pada upadeśa anabhyupagamāt śabda śakti tātparya paryālocanam api taiḥ anyathā kriyate iti prāk vicārita miti tiṣṭhatu eṣā kathā tena kāmadhuk bhavati ityādi vacanāni api vyākaraṇa adhyayana phala prakaṭana paṭūni tathā eva netavyāni

yat api sūtra kṛtā svayam prayojanam kim iti na vyāhṛtam iti vyāhṛtam tat api adūṣaṇam eva vyākaraṇam hi vedāṃgam iti prasiddham etat ā himavataḥ ā ca kumārībhyaḥ vedaḥ ca yadi niṣprayojanaḥ svasti prajābhyaḥ samāptāni dṛṣṭa adṛṣṭa phalāni sarva karmāṇi jitam cāturvarṇya bāhyaiḥ antya janapada vāsibhiḥ mlecchaiḥ

atha sa prayojanaḥ vedaḥ soṃ agavat tvāt aṃgaiḥ saha eva sa prayojana tām bhajate iti kaḥ arthaḥ prayojana antara cintayā na hi darśa pūrṇamāsa prayojanāt anyat prayāja ādi prayojanam anviṣyate iti manvānaḥ svayam sūtra kṛt prayojanam na ākhyat vyākhyātāraḥ tu mukhya an uṣaṃgika bheda bhinna prayojana prapaṃca prarocana atiśaya vyutpādana dvāraka śrotṛ jana utsāha paripoṣa siddhaye darśitavantaḥ iti na kaścid upālabhyaḥ

katham punar aṃgatā vyākaraṇasya kam upakāram āvahate iti kasya eṣa paryanuyogaḥ veda vat aṃgānām anādi tvāt īśvara praṇīta tvāt vā paryanuyojana anupapatteḥ saṃkṣepa vistara vivakṣayā hi pāṇi nipiṃgala parāśara prabhṛtayaḥ tatra tatra kartāraḥ prasiddhim gatāḥ paramārthataḥ tu vedaḥ iva tad arthaḥ api tad artha avagama upāyaḥ api hi sarve eva anādayaḥ prajāpati nirmitā vā iti evam aparyanuyojyāḥ eva atas eva vedaiḥ tad aṅgaiḥ ca saha caturdaśa vidyā sthānāni gaṇyante aṅgāni vedāḥ catvāraḥ mīmāṃsā nyāya vistaraḥ purāṇam dharma śāstram ca vidyāḥ hi etāḥ caturdaśa iti

ye api śabda saṃskāra ādi vikalpāḥ kṛtāḥ te api bahu bhāṣitvā apasmāra nirmitāḥ eva na vastu spṛśaḥ śiṣṭāḥ eva atra praṣṭavyāḥ te eva ca jānanti ke saṃskṛtāḥ śabdāḥ ke vā tad viparītāḥ kaḥ ca teṣām saṃskāraḥ iti na ca tāvatā śiṣṭa prayoga mūlam eva vyākaraṇam brūmaḥ veda vadana ādi tvasya darśita tvāt andha paramparā prasaṅga doṣa parijihīrṣayā tu śiṣṭa prayoga mūla tvam abhidhīyate vaidyaka smṛteḥ iva anvaya vyatireka mūla tvāt ye hi vyākaraṇa smṛtau sādhavaḥ iti anuśāsyante śabdāḥ te śiṣṭaiḥ tathā eva prayujyamānāḥ dṛśyante harītakī bhakṣaṇāt iva ārogyam na tu śiṣṭebhyaḥ śabda samāmnāyam adhigamya pāṇiniḥ grantham praṇītavāt na ca anvaya vyatirekābhya dravya śaktīḥ avagamya carakam praṇītavān iti vidyānām anāditvā abhidhānāt etena itaretara āśrayam api pratyuktam na hi śiṣṭebhyaḥ vyākaraṇasya prabhavaḥ iti

yat tu śiṣṭānām api pramādi tvam upavarṇitam kila purāṇaiḥ munibhiḥ api bahubhiḥ apa śabdāḥ prayuktāḥ iti tatra abhiyuktaiḥ tad apanayana mārgaḥ pradarśitaḥ eva sa tu grantha vistaratrā sādiha na pratanyate

yat api pāṇinitantre dhātu prātipadika kāraka ādi anuśāsana visaṃṣṭhula tvam ane kaśākham ākhyāpitam tat api nipuṇa matibhiḥ pratisamāhitam eva na ca teṣām api doṣa utprekṣaṇa saṃbhavāt anavasthā nipuṇa darśita mārge vipla vakāra vaitaṇḍika paṇḍita taskara avakāśa anupapatteḥ
etena śobhā cīrṇa varṇa vareṇya gaṇeya bhrājiṣṇu kāndiśīka ādi śabda asaṃgraha smṛti saṃdeha viparyaya ādi dūṣaṇāni api kaiścid utprekṣitāni pratikṣiptāni mantavyāni tāni ca taiḥ eva samāhitāni iti

bārhaspatyam api sūtram asūtram eva iti alaṃsva manīṣikā kalpitānalpa durvikalpa ḍaṃbara uttarbhita alīka pāṇḍitya garva gala grahaṇa gadgada girām udvega kāriṇā anena vastu vicāreṇa sarvathā prakṛti nirmalam ati udāram vyākaraṇa ambaram evaṃprāyaiḥ parivāda pāṃsu pātaiḥ na manāk api dhūsarīkartum pāryate iti siddham tasmāt pavitrāt sarvasmāt pavitram ārya jana bahu matam adhigata catur varga agrāmyam ātmānam kartum adhyetavyam vyākaraṇam
āha ca āpaḥ pavitram prathamam pṛthivyām apām pavitram paramāḥ hi mantrāḥ teṣām ca sāmargya juṣām pavitram mahā ṛṣayaḥ vyākaraṇam nirāhuḥ

iha api uktam rūpa antareṇa devāḥ te viharanti mahī tale ye vyākaraṇa saṃskāra pavitrita mukhāḥ narāḥ kiṃca varam hi jātāḥ timayaḥ gabhīre jalāśaye paṅkini nitya mūkāḥ na mānavāḥ vyākaraṇa abhiyoga prabuddha saṃskāra vihīna vācaḥ manunā ca paṅkti pāvana tvena adhigata vyākaraṇaḥ mīmāṃsakaḥ ca sva smṛtau paṭhitau yaḥ ca vyākurute vācam yaḥ ca mīmāṃsate adhvaram iti puṣpadantaḥ api āha bhraṣṭaḥ śāpena devyāḥ śiva pura vasateḥ yadi aham mandabhāgyaḥ bhāvyam vā janmanā me yadi mala kalile martya loke sa śoke snigdhābhiḥ dugdha dhārā mala madhura sudhā bindu niṣyandinībhiḥ kāmam jāyeya vaiyākaraṇa bhaṇitibhiḥ tūrṇam āpūrṇa karṇaḥ

evam vyākaṇa abhiyoga sulabha prauḍhā uktibhiḥ paṇḍitaiḥ akleśena vicitra vaidika pada vyutpattiḥ āsādyate anyaiḥ api upabṛṃhite dṛḍhataraiḥ aṅgaiḥ nirukta ādibhiḥ vede sva arthadhiyam vitanvati kutas prāmāṇya bhaṅgaḥ bhavet aṅga bhāva nirapekṣayā eva naḥ pratyayaḥ yadi ha śabda vidyayā vaidika artha viṣayaḥ vidhīyate tat kutastyam itaretara āśrayam
ādṛtam askhalita vyavahāraiḥ bhogi matam śruta saṅgibhiḥ āryaiḥ vyākaraṇam katham etat anādi prākṛta lakṣaṇa sāmyam upeyāt
evam mṛṣā tvam udagīyata yena yena chidreṇa kalpita piśāca ravaiḥ anāryaiḥ tad tat samagram apasāritam iti atas ca prāmāṇyam apratihatam sthitam āgamānām
iti pramāṇāni yathopadeśam etāni catvāri parīkṣitāni pravanvatām saṃvyavahāram ebhiḥ sidhyanti sarve puruṣa artha sārthāḥ

evam pramāṇa padārthe parīkṣite sati yad artham tat parīkṣaṇam tat prameyam idānīm darśayitum āha ātma śarīra indriya artha buddhi manaḥ pravṛtti doṣa pretya bhāva phala duḥkha apavargāḥ tu prameyam pramāṇa vat iha api etat sūtram vyākhyāyi sūribhiḥ evam vibhāga sāmānya lakṣaṇa pratipādakam prameya śrutiḥ ātma ādi pada paryanta vartinī teṣām eva prameya tvam na anyasya iti niyacchati yathā deva datta yajñadatta viṣṇu mitrāḥ bhojyantām iti evakāra ādi śrutim antareṇa api śabda sāmarthyāt te eva bhojana kriyā yoginaḥ avagamyante na anye tathā iha api ātma ādayaḥ prameyam iti ukte tathā eva tat itara prameya niṣedhaḥ avadhāryate

nanu katham dvādaśavidham eva prameyam avadhāryate yāvatā samāna tantre pṛthivyānī ninava dravyāṇi rūpa ādayaḥ catur viśati guṇāḥ utkṣepaṇa ādi paṃcakarmāṇi parāpara bhedena dvividham sāmānyam nitya dravya vṛttayaḥ antyāḥ viśeṣāḥ ekaḥ samavāyaḥ iti ṣaṣ padārthān anukramya tat avāntara viśeṣaiḥ ānantyam prameyasya upavarṇitam asti ucyate kim punar iha prameyam vivakṣitam iti tad sāmānya lakṣaṇam tāva parīkṣyatām

āha sūktam idam kasya api karṇe pṛṣṭaḥ kaṭim cālayati iti dvādaśavidha tvam ākṣiptam na pratisamādhatte bhavān prayeyasya sāmānya lakṣaṇam tu parīkṣate iti ucyate alam kelinā etat eva atra pratisamādhānam bhavati na hi pramāṇa viṣaya mātram iha prameyam abhimatam evaṃvidhasya prasiddha tvena lakṣaṇān arha tvāt pramāṇaḥ evam jñāte sati tat viṣayaḥ arthaḥ prameyam iti prajñāyate eva kim tena lakṣitena tasmāt viśiṣṭam iha prameyam lakṣyate jñātam samyak atamyak vā yat mokṣāya bhavāya vā tat prameyam iha ābhoṣṭam na pramāṇa artha mātrakam tat ca dvādaśavidham eva bhavati na nyūnam adhikam vā iti samāhitam ittham bhavati vibhāga ākṣepaḥ

kutas punar eṣaḥ prameya viśeṣaḥ labhyate niḥśreyasa artha tvāt śāstrasya prameya jñānasya pramāṇa jñāna vat anya jñāna upayogi tām antareṇa svatas eva mithyājñāna nivṛtti ādi krameṇa apavarga ahetutva pratijñānāt tathāvidhasya ca apavarga upāya tvasya ātma ādiṣu eva bhāvāt

bhavatu evam sūtrasya tu katham īdṛśa prameya viśeṣa samarthane sāmarthyam viśeṣa nirdeśāt tu śabda prayoga sāmarthyāt ca satyam ākāśa kāla diś ādi pramāṇa viṣaya tvāt prameyam bhavati tat tu na sa prayojanam ātma śarīra indriya artha manaḥ pravṛtti doṣa pretya bhāva phala duḥkha apavargāḥ tu prameyam asya eva niḥśreyasa hetu tvāt iti a āśayaḥ

tat ittham eṣa tuśabdaḥ niḥśreyasa anaṅga bhūta prameya antara parihāra dvāreṇa viśiṣṭam ātma ādi prameyam iha sūcayati tad dvādaśavidha tve api heya upādeya bhedataḥ dvidhā ucyate mumukṣūṇām tathā eva dhyāna siddhaye tatra deha ādi duḥkhāntam heyam eva vyavasthitam upādeyaḥ apavargaḥ tu dvidhā avarithatiḥ ātmanaḥ sukha duḥkha ādi bhoktṛ tva svabhāvaḥ heyaḥ eva saḥ upādeyaḥ tu bhoga ādi vyavahāra parāṅmukhaḥ

ātmanaḥ hi bhoga adhiṣṭhānam śarīram bhoga sādhanāni indriyāṇi bhoktavyāḥ indriya arthāḥ bhoga kāraṇam manaḥ pravṛttiḥ puṇya pāpa ātmikā rāga ādayaḥ ca doṣāḥ śarīra ādi janma hetavaḥ etad kṛtaḥ ca śarīra ādi yoga viyoga abhyāsaḥ pretyabhāvaḥ etat kṛtam eva ca saṃsāre sukha duḥkha rūpam phalam tacya vividham eva vivekavataḥ sarvam duḥkham eva iti evam śarīra ādi duḥkhāntam heya tayā eva bhāvanīyam edat anupayuktaḥ ca ātmā api tathā eva etad viyuktaḥ tu ātmā eva apavargaḥ ucyate sa ca upādeya tayā bhāvanoyaityataḥ eva ātma pada saṃgṛhītasya api asya punar nirdeśaḥ sa rdi paramaḥ puruṣa arthaḥ iti

evam idam dvādaśavidham prameyam heya upādeya tayā tattva jñānena bhāvayana abhyāsāt tad viṣaya viparīta graha ātmakam mithyājñānam kṣiṇoti tattva jñāna udayena asya mithyājñāne apabādhite rāga dveṣa ādayaḥ doṣāḥ tad mūlāt kṣayam āpnuyuḥ kṣīṇa doṣasya na udeti pravṛttiḥ puṇyapāpikā tad abhāva anna tat kāryam śariḥ ādi upajāyate aśarīraḥ ca na eva ātmā spṛśyate duḥkha ḍambaraiḥ aśeṣa duḥkha uparamaḥ saḥ apavargaḥ abhidhīyate tat ittham eva dvādaśavidham prameyam ati gahana saṃsāra m ārava sthala prabhava bhīma santāpa nirvāpaṇa mahā hradatām upayāti iti tat eva upa deśa arham iti siddham
virakta saṃkathāḥ tāvat asatām tāpasa uditāḥ ātmā eva tu asti na asti iti katham na paricintyate

tathā ca lokāyatikāḥ para loka apavādinaḥ caitanya khacitāt kāyāt na ātmā anyaḥ asti iti manvate na ca tāvat ātmā pratyakṣataḥ gṛhyate ghaṭa ādi vat bāhya indriyeṇa sukhāt iyat manasā vā paricchettum aśakyatvāt anumānam tu na pramāṇam eva cārvākāṇām na ca ātma siddhau kiṃcana liṅgam asti jñāna ādi yogaḥ tu bhūtānām eva pariṇāma viśeṣa upapādita śakti atiśaya juṣām bhaviṣyati yathā guḍa piṣṭa ādayaḥ prāk asatīm api mada śaktim āsādita sura ākāra pariṇāmāḥ prapadyante tathā mṛd ādi avasthāyām acetanāni api bhūtāni śarīra ākāra pariṇatāni caitanyam sprakṣyanti kāla antare ca vyādhi ādinā pariṇāma viśeṣam avajahanti tāni eva caitanya śūnyatām upayāsyanti caitanyavat tvānapāyāt ca tāvantam kālam tāni eva smṛti anusandhāna ādi vyavahāra nirvahaṇa nipuṇa tām anubhaviṣyanti iti kim anumānakaḥ ātmā syāt āgamāḥ tu manoratha adhirūḍha prāmāṇyāḥ katham ātmānam avabodhayitum śakṣyanti ayam api ca āgamaḥ asti eva vijñāna ghanaḥ eva etebhyaḥ bhūtebhyaḥ samutthāya tāni eva anu vinaśyati na pretya saṃjñā asti iti tat ātmanaḥ nityasya para lokinaḥ abhāvāt kṛtam etābhiḥ apārthaka pariśrama kariṇībhiḥ para loka kathābhiḥ

tatra pratyakṣam ātmānam aupavarṣāḥ prapedire ahaṃpratyaya gamya tvāt sa yūthyāḥ api kecana asti ayam ahaṃpratyayaḥ kaścid śarīra samāna adhikaraṇaḥ sthūlaḥ aham kṣāmaḥ aham iti kaścid jñātṛ samāna adhikaraṇaḥ jānāmi aham smarāmi aham iti tatra sthūla ādi samāna adhikaraṇaḥ tāvat āstām aham pratyayaḥ

jñāna icchā sukha duḥkha ādi sāmāna adhikaraṇya bhāj yaḥ tu ahaṃpratyayaḥ tatra na ātmanaḥ anyaḥ prakāśate na hi jñāna sukha icchā ādi yogaḥ kāya indriya ādiṣu na ca jñāna ādi śūnye arthe jānāmi ityādi saṃvidaḥ jñāna mātra avabhāsaḥ api vāritaḥ pratyabhijñayā jñātavān aham eva ādau aham eva adya vedmi ca na uttarasya ca pūrvasya na jñāna kṣaṇayoḥ dvayoḥ na santānasya ca etasmin pratyaye asti avabhāsanam na uttarojñānavān pūrvam pūrvaḥ jānāti na adhunā na dvayoḥ dvayam api asti santānaḥ tu na vāstavaḥ avastu tvāt ca na asau pūrvam kiṃcid jñātavān na ca adya kiṃcid jānāti iti tasmāt aham eva hyas jñātavān aham eva adya jānāmi iti asmin pratyaye hyas ca adya ca anuvartamānaḥ jñātā pratibhāti iti gamyate

na ca asau kāyaḥ bāla ādi avasthā bhedena nānātvāt acetana tvāt ca evaṃca pratyabhijñā ahaṃpratyaya grāhye jñātari siddhe saḥ ayam sthūla ādi samāna adhikaraṇaḥ ahaṃpratyayaḥ tad abheda upacāreṇa śarīre vartamānaḥ mithyā iti kalpayiṣyate na punar etat anurodhena jñāna ādi samāna adhikaraṇa ahaṃpratyaya mithyā tva kalpanam yuktam abādhita tvāt na khalbaham jānāmi iti pratyayaḥ kena cit alpīyasā doṣa kāraṇena kaluṣīkartum pāryate tat asya ātmā eva mukhyaḥ viṣayaḥ tat atiriktam vastu bhāktaḥ iti tasmāt ahaṃpratyaya gamya tvāt ātmā pratyakṣaḥ iti

atra vadanti śabda mātra uccāraṇam etat aham jānāmi aham icchāmi ahaṃsukhī aham duḥkhī iti na tu jñāna ādi svarūpa atiriktaḥ tad āśrayaḥ kaścid etāsu buddhiṣu parisphurati iti katham ekasyām eva saṃvidi kartā ca karma ca ātmā bhavet grāhya grāha ka tā ekasya jñānasya apākariṣyate tvayā api na iṣyate ca iti tathā na asti ātmanaḥ api sā

yat ca avasthā akṛtam bhedam abalambya grāhma grāhaka bhāva samarthanam ekasya eva ātmanaḥ kṛtam kila dravya ādi rūpam ātmanaḥ grāhyam jñātṛ rūpam ca grāhakam iti tad anupapannam dravya ādi rūpe grāhye na jñātari grāhyatā sādhitā syāt ātma vartinaḥ api dravya ādi rūpasya ghaṭa ādi tulya tvāt

yat api nipuṇaṃmanyaiḥ ucyate bhavatu jñātṛ tā iva grāhikā tathā api viṣaya upādhikṛ taḥ asti eva bhedaḥ ghaṭa avacchinnā hi hi jñātṛ tā grāhmā śuddhā eva tu jñātṛ tā grāhikā iti ghaṭam aham jānāmi iti kaḥ arthaḥ katham jānantam ātmānam jānāmi iti asmad prayoga saṃbhedāt ca evam avakalpate anyatra tu śuddha viṣaya grahaṇam eva bhavati ghaṭaḥ ayam iti tat etat api saralam ati pratāraṇa mātram yathā hi ghaṭaḥ ayam ittra ghaṭa mātra pravaṇā eva saṃvid evam asmad prayoga saṃbhede api ghaṭam aham jānāmi iti atra ghaṭa pravaṇā eva buddhiḥ iyān tu viśeṣaḥ pūrvam kevalam ghaṭa grahaṇam adhunā tu jñāna viśiṣṭa ghaṭa avamarśaḥ iti

nanu vibhajyamānāyām pratītau ghaṭaḥ ayam iti tāvat viṣaya grahaṇam jānāmi iti tu jñāna grahaṇam api bhavatu nāma aham iti tu kasya grahaṇam na ca ekasyām eva pratītau aṃśa vibhāgā iva prāmāṇyam aprāmāṇyam ca vaktum yuktam ghaṭam iti jānāmi iti ca pramāṇam aham iti tu na pramāṇam iti tasmāt atra jñātuḥ ava bhāsaḥ abhyupeyaḥ uktam atra na ekasyām pratītau ātmanaḥ kartṛ tā karma tā ca syātām iti

yaḥ tu upādhiḥ tu ayā unnetum upakrāntaḥ saḥ ayam na ghaṭate ghaṭa pravaṇa tvāt ghaṭam aham jānāmi iti pratīteḥ vibhajyamāna tve api ghaṭam iti jānāmi iti ca aṃśa dvayam viṣaya niṣṭham eva jātam aham iti tu ayam aṃśaḥ yadi ātma viṣayaḥ iṣyate tarhi saḥ eva tu śuddhaḥ avaśiṣyate grāhyaḥ grāhakaḥ ca iti na avasthā kṛtaḥ tad bhedaḥ samarthitaḥ syāt bheda abhāvena ca ekasya eva grāhya grāhaka bhāvam anupādhikam abhidadhatā vijñāna vāda vartma saṃśritam syāt tasmāt ahaṃpratyayasya grāhakāt bhinnam grāhyam abhidhitsatā śarīram eva grāhyam abhyupagantavyam jñāna sāmānādhikaraṇyā anupapatteḥ ca varam asya mithyātvam astu nāma ātma avalambanatā atas eva kṛśa śyāma sāmāna adhikaraṇya dhīḥ śarīra ālambana tvasya sākṣiṇī na virotsyate

nanu mama idam śarīram iti bheda pratibhāsāt katham ahaṃpratyayaḥ śarīra ālambanaḥ syāt bhoḥ sādho na evaṃvidheṣu viśvasitum arhati mama ātmā iti api bheda pratyaya darśanāt atha avasthā bheda ādinā yathā tathā tad samarthanam āsthīyate tat iha śarīra ālambana tve api sā eva saraṇiḥ anusariṣyate tasmāt ahaṃpratyayaḥ śarīra ālambane eva iti sa ca jñāna ādi samāna adhikaraṇaḥ mithyā sthūla ādi samāna adhikaraṇaḥ tu samyak iti

ye tu mama śaroram mama ātmā iti buddhī te dve api mithyā mama pratyayasya ahaṃpratyaya vat ātma anālambana tvāt śarīre ca bheda anupapatteḥ mama pāṇiḥ bhujaḥ vā iti bhinna tvāt upapadyate śarīram tu mama iti eṣā kalpanā rāhu mūrdha vat tasmāt ahaṃkāra mamakārayoḥ dvayoḥ api aviṣaya tvāt ātmā parokṣaḥ iti siddham

apare punar āhuḥ na grāhya grāhaka rūpa ubhaya saṃpatteḥ ekasya karma tvam kartṛ tvam ca yugapad ātmanaḥ manyāmahe kintu citi śakti svabhāvam apara sādhanam aparokṣam ātma tattvam pracakṣmahe na hi ātmā anya janyena jñānena ghaṭa ādiḥ iva prakāśyate api tu svatas eva prakāśyate cetana tvam api tasya naisargikam eva na karaṇa upanīta citi yoga nibandhanam cit yogāt hi cetana tve ghaṭa ādau api tad prasaṅgaḥ na ca asti niyama hetuḥ aneka kāraka nikara parighaṭita tanuḥ api citiḥ ātmānam eva jñātāram karoti na kāraka antaram iti tasmāt svatas eva cit svabhāva tā tasya bhadrikā tat idam ātma prakāśanam saṃvid vat avagantavyam yat āhuḥ saṃvita saṃvid tayā eva saṃvedyate na saṃvedyatayā iti na asyāḥ karma bhāvaḥ vidyate iti arthaḥ evam ātmā grāhaka tayā eva prakāśyate na grāhyatayā iti tat vairupyasya codanam anupapannam iti

etat api na caturaśram apara sādhanam iti kaḥ arthaḥ upāya antara nirapekṣam eva prakāśamānam ātma tattvam āste iti tat ayuktam akaraṇikāyāḥ pratīteḥ adṛṣṭa tvāt apūrvam ca tat kim api yathā abhyupagata pramāṇa atiriktam eva pramāṇam syāt na ca niyama kāraṇam atra paśyāmaḥ tathā prakāśamānaḥ svaḥ eva ātmā prakāśate na parātmā iti prakāśamāna tvena ca ātmanaḥ nūnam anubhūyamāna tā vācyā anubhūyamāna tā ca anubhava karma tvam itarathā asyāḥ pratyakṣa tā eva na syāt

atha ucyate na pratyakṣaḥ ātmā kiṃntu aparokṣaḥ iti na idam artha antara vacanam śiśavaḥ evam pratāryante na prāmāṇikāḥ pratyakṣaḥ ca na bhavati aparokṣaḥ ca bhavati iti citram pratyakṣa jñāna karma tvam asya na asti iti ced tarhi aparokṣa tvam api mā bhūt prakāśa tvāt aparokṣa tvam iti ced na dīpa ādeḥ prakāśasya api andhādibhiḥ agṛhyamāṇasya prakāśamāna tva ayogāt tasmāt prakāśate ced ātmā nūnam anubhūyeta api iti balāt karma tvam aparihāryam atas ca tad avasthā eva dvairūpya codanā

prakāśa jñāna pakṣam ca pratikṣepsyāmaḥ sa ca ātmani api tulyaḥ nyāyaḥ kalpanāt vairūpyam ca bhavatām ātmā ca sva prakāśaḥ saṃvid ca sva prakāśa iti na ca nipuṇa matiḥ api vivekam īdṛśam upadarśayitum śaknoti bhavān iyam sva prakāśā phala rūpā saṃvid ayam sva prakāśaḥ jñātṛ rūpaḥ ātmā iti citram ca idam yat tayoḥ dvayoḥ prakāśayoḥ antarāle tad vyāpāraḥ parokṣaḥ jñāna ākhyaḥ saṃpannaḥ iti

nanu ghaṭam aham jānāmi iti atra traya pratibhāsaḥ ghaṭam iti viṣayaḥ prakāśate aham iti ātmā jānāmi iti saṃvid iti uktam atra ghaṭam jānāmi iti jñāna viśeṣaṇa viṣaya pratibhāsaḥ aham iti tu śarīre jñātṛ tva bhramaḥ ekasya ātmanaḥ grāhya grāhaka bhāva anupapatteḥ iti
yat api svatas cetana svabhāva tvam ātmanaḥ kalpyate tat api na sa upapattikam sa cetanaḥ citā yogāt tad yogena vinā jaḍaḥ na artha avabhāsāt anyat hi caitanyam nāma manmahe

yadi ca svatas eva artha avabhāsa sāmarthyam ātmanaḥ tat kim indriyaiḥ prayojanam manaṣṣaṣṭhaiḥ indriya nirapekṣa padārtha pariccheda sāmarthya pakṣe ca sarva sarvajña tā āpattiḥ atas avaśyam jñāna samavāyi nibandhanam eva ātmanaḥ cetayitṛ tvam na ca ghaṭa ādibhiḥ ati prasaṅgaḥ āśaṅkanīyaḥ padārtha svabhāva upanatasya eva kriyā vaicitryasya sarva loka prasiddha tvāt cetana ādi kriyāḥ karma samavāyinyaḥ na bhavanti gamana ādi kriyāḥ tu kartṛ samavāyinyaḥ tat iyam jñāna kriyā api kartṛ samavāyini eva na ca vastu śaktiḥ anuyojyā bhavati na jaḍa tva aviśeṣe api karma ādau samavaiti cit na dravya tva aviśeṣe api gandhaḥ spṛśati pāvakam tasmāt na pratyakṣaḥ ātmā na api svatas cetayitā iti sthitam

sva yūthyāḥ tu kecid ācakṣate yadi ekasya kartṛ tvam karma tvam ca anupapannam iti apratyatyakṣaḥ ātmā iṣyate tad ayam anumānena api katham grahīṣyate ātmānam ātmanā aatmā eva liṅgāt anuminoti hi tatra nūnam upetavyā kartṛ tā karma tā asya ca tatra anumāna jñānasya yathā aatmā yāti karmatām tathā ahaṃpratyayasya eṣaḥ pratyakṣasya api gacchatu deha ādi vyatiriktaḥ ca yathā liṅgena gamyate tathā ahaṃpratyayena api gamyatām tad vilakṣaṇaḥ

nanu ātmanaḥ kim rūpam yat pratyakṣeṇa sākṣātkriyate yadi evam sukha ādeḥ api kim rūpam yat mānasa pratyakṣa samadhigamyam iṣyate nanu ānanda ādi svabhāvam prasiddham eva sukha ādeḥ tarhi tad ādhāra tvam ātmanaḥ api rūpam avagacchatu bhavān sukha ādi ca ityamānam hi svatantram na anubhūyate matu bartha anuvedhāt tu siddham grahaṇam ātmanaḥ idam sukham iti jñānam dṛśyate na ghaṭa ādi vat aham sukhī iti tu jñaptiḥ ātmanaḥ api prakāśikā

api ca jñātṛ jñāna viśiṣṭa artha grahaṇam kila bhāṣya kṛt svayam prādīdṛśat tat ca kim vā yuktam upekṣitum viśeṣya buddhim icchanti na agṛhīta viśeṣaṇām pūrvam ca ananubhūtasya smaraṇam na avakalpate na ca anumānataḥ pūrvam jñātvā aatmānam viśeṣaṇam tad viśiṣṭa artha buddhiḥ syāt kramasya anavadhāraṇāt tasmāt pratyakṣaḥ ātmā

sāmānādhikaraṇyam ca smaraṇa anubhava ādiṣu anusandhīyamānam yat dṛśyate tat katham bhavet pūrvam aham amum artham anubhūtavān aham eva adya punar anubhavāmi iti tulya viṣayam tāvat tulya kartṛkatā api tatra prakāśate itarathā tu anumātum api ātmā na śakyeta jñāna icchā sukha duḥkha ādi kila idam liṅgam ātmanaḥ eka āśraya tayā jñātam anusandhātṛ bodhakam tathā tvena ca tat jñānam āśraya jñāna pūrvakam jñāte tatra aphalam liṅgam ajñāte tu na liṅgatā tasmāt pratyakṣaḥ eva ātmā varam abhyupagamyatām vṛddha āgama anusāreṇa saṃvid ālokanena ca

athavā abhiniveśena kim anena prayojanam anumeya tvam eva astu liṅgena icchā ādinā aatmanaḥ tat āha sūtrakāraḥ icchā dveṣa prayatna sukha duḥkha jñānāni ātmanaḥ liṅgam icchā nāma tāvat ittham upajāyate yat jātīyam arthamu payuṃjānaḥ puruṣaḥ purā sukham anubhūtavān punar kāla antare tat jātīyam artham upalabhya sukha sādhana tām anusmṛtya tadā adātum icchati sā iyam anena krameṇa samupajāyamāna icchā pūrva apara anusandhāna samartham āśrayam anumāpayati kāryasya nirādhārasya anupapatteḥ āśraya mātra pratītau ca ayam anvaya vyatirekavān eva hetuḥ bhavati icchā dharmiṇī āśritā iti sādhyaḥ dharmaḥ kāryatvāt ghaṭa ādi vat guṇa tvāt rūpa ādi vat iti vā hetuḥ vaktavyaḥ guṇa tvam ca icchā ādīnām acākṣuṣa pratyakṣa tva ādinā rasa ādi vat darśitam ācāryaiḥ

evam anvaya vyatirekavatā amunā hetunā adhiṣṭhāna mātre anumite tad adhiṣṭhāna tve ca deha indriya ādau prasakte pūrva anubhūta sukha sādhanatva anusandhānasa vyapekṣa tad utpādana paryālocanayā tad kārya samāna kartṛka tva avagamāt śarīra ādi pratiṣedhe sati saḥ eva kevala vyatireki bhavane tu viśiṣṭam āśrayam anumāpayati icchā śarīra ādi vilakṣaṇa āśrayā śarīra ādiṣu bādhaka upapattau satyām kāryatvāt atra ca sādharmya dṛṣṭāntaḥ na saṃbhavati iti vedharmya dṛṣṭāntaḥ pradarśyate sa ca ghaṭaḥ eva yaḥ abhūt sādharmya dṛṣṭāntaḥ kāryatve nirviśeṣaṇe api ghaṭaḥ saḥ eva vaidharmya dṛṣṭāntaḥ sa viśeṣaṇe yatra vilakṣaṇa āśrita tvam na asti tatra sa viśeṣaṇam kāryatvam api na asti yathā ghaṭa ādau iti na na śakyate vaktum tatra kāryatva mātra yoge api sa viśeṣaṇānām kāryatva abhāvāt vilakṣaṇa āśrita tvam api tatra na asti bhūta āśrita tvena pratyakṣam upalabhyamāna tvāt

nanu ca anvaya darśanam antareṇa kevalaḥ vyatirekaḥ pratīyamānaḥ saṃdigdhaḥ bhavati kim tad sādhya abhāva kṛtā eva tasya tasmāt vyāvṛttiḥ uta nimitta antara kṛtā iti sandigdha vyatirekasya hetoḥ agamaka tvam niścita vyabhicāra hetu vat iti tārkikāḥ ucyate syāt etat evam yadi prathamam anavagata anvayaḥ eva kevala vyatireka śaraṇaḥ hetuḥ prayujyeta yatra tu anvaya vyatirekavān eva hetuḥ kaṃcana viśeṣam āśritya kevala vyatireki tām abalambate tatra na sandigdha vyatireka tā avakāśam labhate ghaṭaḥ hi bhū tala āśrita tvena pratyakṣam upalabhyate tat asya vilakṣaṇa āśraya virahāt eva sa viśeṣaṇa hetu śūnyatā jātā nirviśeṣaṇa avasthāyām tad yoga darśanāt iti na sandigdhaḥ vyatirekaḥ athavā śarīra tvam sāmānyam iha vaidharmya dṛṣṭāntīkartavyam tatra hi sarva ātmanā kāryatvasya śaṅkā api na asti na ca tad vilakṣaṇa āśritam śarīra āśrita tvasya pratyakṣam upalambhāt iti

tat iyam icchā prathama padārtha darśana ādi kārya samāna kartṛkatayā avagamyamānā śarīra ādi vilakṣaṇam āśrayam avagamayati sa viśeṣaṇāt kārya tvāt iti sthitam yaḥ ca sa vilakṣaṇaḥ āśrayaḥ tatrā aatma saṃjñā agamikī

evam eva dveṣa ādeḥ ātma liṅga tā vaktavyā yat jātīyasya arthasya sannidhānāt duḥkham anubhūtavān puruṣaḥ tat jātīyam artham punar upalabhamānaḥ duḥkha sādhana tām anusandhāya tat dveṣṭi iti saḥ api pratisandhātāram ekam antareṇa na upapadyate ābhyām icchā dveṣābhyām anantaram prayatnaḥ samutpadyate saḥ api yathā uktena krameṇa anusandhāna pūrvakaḥ eva prayatamānasya sukha duḥkhe bhavataḥ te api tathā eva draṣṭavye

jñānam tu yadi api prathamam anu sandhāna nirapekṣam api bhavati tat api ca śakyataḥ eva ātma liṅgam abhidhātum tathā api anusandhāna pūrva icchā ādi kārya prakaraṇāt nirṇaya ātmakam eva jñānam udāhartavyam tatra hi bubhutsā vimarśa ādi pūrvaka tvam upalabdham iti tat eka kartṛka tvam upakalpyate tat evam icchā ādīni ātma liṅgāni iti sthitam
śāstre ca aneka hetu uktiḥ na doṣāya kathāsu iva śiṣyaḥ kaścid kvacid kiṃcid anusmṛtya abhidhāsyati iti kāruṇikaḥ hi muniḥ anekam iha hetu mārgam upadiṣṭavān

nanu atra coditam anusandhātāram antareṇa tat etat icchā ādi kāryam na avakalpate iti katham jñāyate ekatra pramātari tad darśanāt iti yat ucyate tat idam eka pramātṛ grahaṇāt ātma pratyakṣa tvam aṅgīkṛtam syāt iti vyartham anumānam agrahaṇe tu pramātuḥ ekasya tad pūrvaka tvena icchā ādeḥ pratibandha agrahaṇādaśakyam anu mānam iti parihṛtam etat kāryatvena eva liṅga tvam icchā ādeḥ upavarṇitam asmābhiḥ na smaraṇa ādi samāna ādhāratayā iti kimarthaḥ tarhi pratisandhāna upanyāsaḥ śarīra ādiṣu tad āśraya tva pratiṣedha arthaḥ na tu evam vyākhyātavantaḥ vayam ekasya pramātuḥ icchā ādi kāryāśraya tva darśanāt eka āśraya tva anumānam iti tasmāt na doṣaḥ

nanu katham na doṣaḥ śarīra ādyāśraya tva pratiṣedha sādhane api hetoḥ vyāpti grahaṇa asaṃbhavāt yāvat hi darśana smaraṇa icchā ādi kārya jātam eka pramātṛ niyata tayā anavadhāritam tāvat katham asmad avasthābhiḥ na śarīra ādyāśraya tva niṣedhasya tad pūrvakasya ca ekātma āśrita tvasya siddhiḥ kaḥ evam āha na gṛhītam eka kartṛka tayā kāryam icchā ādi iti yadi gṛhītam tarhi vaktavyam kva gṛhītam kena vā pramāṇena gṛhītam iti sva ātmani eva iti ced saḥ ayam pratyakṣaḥ ātmā bhavet evam anabhyupagame vā na vyāpti grahaṇam iti ucyate na ca pratyakṣaḥ ātmā na ca vyāpteḥ agrahaṇam na ca eva dharmi antare vyāptiḥ gṛhyate kintu sva santānaḥ eva tathā api na sidhyati pramātṛ niyata tā anumānam katham iva sidhyati santāna antareṣu eka pramātṛ pūrvaka tvena pratisandhānasya dṛṣṭa tvāt

nanu kaḥ atra vyāpti grahaṇa kālaḥ pramāṇa anumāna baddhi tad bhedena bhavitavyam tatas kim idam tatas bhavati katham sva santānaḥ eva vyāptiḥ gṛhyatām katham vā tatra eva pramātṛ niyamaḥ anumīyatām iti seyasu bhayataḥ pāśāḥ rajjuḥ ātmā vā pratyakṣaḥ vyāptiḥ vā duravagam eti

na etat evam yathā śākya pakṣe sattvāt kṣaṇikatva anumāne vyāpti grahaṇam tathā iha api bhaviṣyati tatra hi yā eva krama yaugapadya vyāvṛttyā sattvasya nityebhyaḥ vyāvṛttiḥ saḥ eva kṣaṇikaiḥ anvayaḥ iti dharmi antara nirapekṣa tayā eva sādhye api dharmiṇi pratibandha grahaṇam ca anumānam ca darśitam tadvat iha api eka pramātṛ pūrvaka tvena pratisandhānasya dharmi antare yadi api grahaṇam na asti tathā api santāna antara bhede yat asya adarśanam tat eva eka kartṛka tva darśanam iti kaḥ anayoḥ hetu tve viśeṣaḥ

nanu tatra nityebhyaḥ krama yaugapadya vyāvṛttyā vyāvṛtta tvam śakya grahaṇam iha tu pramātṛ bhedena pratisandhāna vyāvṛttiḥ duravagamā sva santāne api jñāna kṣaṇa abhinnāḥ eva pramātāraḥ na ca tebhyaḥ vyāvṛttam pratisandhānam iti tiṣṭhatu anvayaḥ vyatireka mukhena api kaṣṭam idam anumānam vartate sva santāne santāna antara vat pramātṛ bheda agrahaṇāt tad bheda grahe hi sva para santāna vivekaḥ na syāt yadi evam pramātṛ bheda grahaṇa abhāvāt punar api ātmā pratyakṣaḥ āyātaḥ

mā evam na ātmā pratyakṣaḥ pramātṛ bhedaḥ hi sva santāne na gṛhyate iti uktam na punar tat aikyam gṛhyate anyat ca bheda agrahaṇam anyat ca tad aikya grahaṇam bheda agrahaṇāt eva ca vyāpti siddheḥ na kaṣṭam anumānam nanu ca sva santāne api pramātṛ bheda agrahaṇam kim pramātuḥ eka tvāt uta jñānānām kārya kāraṇa bhāvāt iti na niścīyate tatas ca saṃdigdhaḥ vyatirekaḥ yathā jñānānām kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ na asti yathā ca na tad kṛtaḥ ayam vyavahāraḥ tathā anantaram eva sa vistaram vakṣyāmaḥ tasmāt icchā ādi kāryeṇa yuktam eka pramātṛ anumānam

nanu ca āśritam icchā ādi dehaḥ eva bhaviṣyati bhūtānām eva caitanyam iti prāha bṛhaspatiḥ uktam ca mada śakti vat vijñānam iti ucyate śarīram tau at na icchā āderā śrayaḥ śaiśava yauvana vārdhaka ādi daśa abhedena bhinna tvāt tathā hi na anya dṛṣṭaḥ arthaḥ smartum anyena śakyate na ca anyena smṛte tasmin anyasya icchā upajāyate tena adyāt artha vijñānāt prakṛtya icchā samudbhavāt ekasya kārya cakrasya vaktavyaḥ kaścid āśrayaḥ śarīram ca bālya ādi avasthā bhedena bhinnam atas tasya na āśrayaḥ bhavitum arhati santāna antara vat yathā hi devadatta dṛṣṭe arthe na yajñādattasya smaraṇam evam bāla śarīra anubhūte yuva śarīrasya tat na syāt

nanu avasthā mātram eva bhinnam avasthātṛ śarīra svarūpam abhinnam eva pratyabhijñā pratyaya prāmāṇyāt avagamyate na ca iyam pratyabhijñā lūna punar jāta keśa nakha ādi pratyabhijñāvat anyathā asiddhā vināśasya anupalambhāt stambha ādau hi kṣaṇa bhaṅgi tva pratiṣedhaḥ pratyabhijñayā eva kariṣyate sā ca iha api tādṛśi eva tat ayuktam stambha ādau nānātva kāraṇā grahaṇāt iha tu rūpa pariṇāma sanniveśa ādi anyatva darśanāt sādṛśya nibandhanā iyam bhrāntiḥ eva pratyabhijñā na khalu śiśu śarīre taruṇa śarīre jarat śarīre ca tulyam eva parimāṇa ādi upalabhyate

āhāra pariṇāmāt ca dehabhedaḥ avagamyate pākaja utpatti mārgeṇa na jīryeta annam anyathā na bhavet paripoṣaḥ hi dadhi kṣīra ādi bhakṣaṇe kāṃcika ādi upayoge ca na dṛśyeta asya rakta tā kṣīṇaiḥ avayavaḥ kaiścid kaiścid ca abhinava udgataiḥ abhinnaḥ eva avayavī katham bhavitum arhati tathā ca kecid pacyamānasya ghaṭa ādeḥ api prāk avasthā visadṛśa rūpa ādi yoginaḥ pāka kāraṇa bhūta vegavat agni dravya saṃyoga paryālocanayā eva pralaya udayau kalpitavantaḥ

yadi api kanduka nikṣiptāḥ ghaṭa ādayaḥ tṛṇa parṇa ādi pihita vapuṣaḥ api tad vivara prasṛtena nayana raśminā na vinaṣṭāḥ iti upalabhyante yadi api tad saṃkhyā tad parimāṇaḥ tad sanniveśaḥ tad deśāḥ ca pakvāḥ api dṛśyante yadi api patantaḥ na vibhāvyante yadi api ca tadā teṣām kartṛ ādi kāraka kalāpa asaṃbhavāt punar ghaṭanam aghaṭamānam iva lakṣyate tathā api teṣām anumānena vināśaḥ parikalpyate sarva avayaveṣu antar bahis ca pākāt pūrvarūpa ādi vilakṣaṇa guṇa upalabdheḥ antar praveśaḥ kṛśānoḥ anumīyate tena vegavatā vahni dravyeṇa nodanāt abhighātāt vā nūnam ghaṭa ādi ārambhakeṣu avayaveṣu kriyā jāyate kriyātaḥ vibhāgaḥ vibhāgāt dravya ārambhaka saṃyoga vināśaḥ tad vināśāt dravya vināśaḥ iti anupraveśa pakṣe api sūkṣma vivara parikalpanāt avaśyam avayava saṃyoga vighaṭanam ghaṭa ādeḥ iti vināśaḥ eva

api ca pāka anantaram kandukāt apakṛṣyamāṇāḥ piṭhāra ādayaḥ kecid sphuṭitāḥ kecid vakra tām gatāḥ kecid sanniveśa antaram eva pratipannāḥ dṛśyante tasmāt api paśyāmaḥ naśyanti iti tad saṃkhya tvāt iti sarvam anaikāntikam sūcī agra viddha kaṇṭha koṇaiḥ kumbha ādibhiḥ atas pūrva ukta nītyāḥ naṣṭeṣu ghaṭa ādi kārya dravyeṣu paramāṇavaḥ eva pacyante pakvāḥ ca śyāma ādi guṇān avaja hataḥ rakta ādi guṇa antara yogam anubhavantaḥ prāṇi gata sukha duḥkha upabhoga sādhana bhūta adṛṣṭa preryamāṇāḥ parasparam saṃyujya dyaṇukā ādi prakrameṇa tādṛśam eva ghaṭa ādi kāryam ārabhante tatra amuṣmin kṣaṇe amuṣya kāryasya prasavaḥ amuṣya pralayaḥ iti prakriyā na likhyate grantha vistara bhayāt aprayojana tvāt ca iti

evam tapana ātapa pacyamāneṣu āmra ādi phaleṣu eṣaḥ eva nyāyaḥ śarīre api audaryeṇa tejasā pacyamāneṣu anna pāna ādiṣu rasa mala dhātu bhāvena pariṇāmam upagacchatsu prāyeṇa pratikṣaṇam utpāda vināśau saṃbhavate iti sthairya abhāvāt katham anusandhāna ādi kārya yogaḥ tasya iti

apare punar pratyakṣa balavat tayā ghaṭa ādeḥ avināśam eva pacyamānasya manyante suṣira dravya ārambhāt ca antar bahis ca pākaḥ api upapatsyate dṛśyate ca pakve api kalaśe niṣiktānām apām bahis śīta sparśa grahaṇam atas ca pāka kāle jvalat anala śikhā kalāpa anupraveśa kṛta vināśa vat tadā api śiśiratara nīrakaṇa nikara anupraveśa kṛta vināśa prasaṅgaḥ na ca īdṛśī pramāṇa dṛṣṭiḥ atas prakṛti suṣira tayā eva kārya dravyasya ghaṭa ādeḥ ārambhāt antarā antarā tejaḥ kaṇā anupraveśa kṛta pāka upapatteḥ alam vināśa kalpanayā piṭhara pāka pakṣaḥ eva peśalaḥ

yādṛś eva hi nikṣiptaḥ ghaṭaḥ pākāya kanduke pāke api tādṛś eva asau uddhṛtaḥ dṛśyate tatas kvacid tu sanniveśa antara darśanam kāṣṭha ādi abhighāta kṛtam upapatsyate pāvaka saṃparka kāri tve tu sarvatra tathā abhāvaḥ syāt tasmāt avinaṣṭāḥ eva ghaṭa ādayaḥ pacyante saḥ ayam tu ghaṭa ādi nyāyaḥ śarīre na iṣyate na hi anna pākaḥ sthairye api tatra kumbha ādi pāka vat caya apacaya yuktam hi śarīram upalabhyate tasmāt parimāṇa ādi bheda darśanāt na ekam śarīram iti jvālā ādi pratyabhijñāvat tat pratyabhijñā iti sthitam

yat api ucyate avasthānām eva nānātvam avasthātā punar ekaḥ eva deha ākhyaḥ iti tat api ayuktam bheda abheda vikalpa anupapatteḥ yadi śarīrāt avyatiritāḥ eva tad avasthāḥ tarhi tad nānā tvāt śarīra nānā tva prasaṅgaḥ ekasmāt śarīrāt api ananya tvāt avasthānām api anyonyam bhedaḥ na syāt atha vyatiriktāḥ śarīrāt avasthāḥ tarhi bhedena tad upagrahaḥ darśayitavyaḥ na ca asau asti go tva ādau anuvṛttā buddhiḥ anyathā asiddhā satī jāti tad vatoḥ bhedam āpādayantī na kenacid pratihanyate iha punar avasthātuḥ eka tva grāhiṇī buddhiḥ pūrva nītyā pramāṇa bādhita tvāt bhrānta iti tasmāt śarīrasya bhinna tvāt santāna antara vat smṛti anusandhāna ādi kārya yogaḥ durghaṭaḥ iti na tasya icchā ādi kāri āśraya tvam

itas ca na śarīrasya jñāna ādi yogaḥ pariṇāmi tvāt kṣīra vat rūpa ādimat tvāt tadvat eva aneka samūha svabhāva tvāt tridaṇḍa ādi vat sānniveśa viśiṣṭāt ca bhūta tvāt vāhya bhūta vat caitanya śūnyam śarīram śarīra tvāt bhūta śarīra vat na śarīra dharmaḥ caitanyam ayāvat dravya bhāvi tvāt na ca saṃyoga ādibhiḥ vyabhicāraḥ tad upajanana apāyayoḥ nimitta antara janya tva darśanāt iha ca tad abhāvāt viśeṣa guṇa tve sati iti vā viśeṣaṇa upādānāt na vyabhicāraḥ tad viśeṣa guṇa tve hi caitanyasya rūpa ādi vat tad avasthānāt avināśa prasaṅgaḥ

yat tu mada śakti vat iti uktam tatra mada śakteḥ dṛṣṭa tvāt abhyupagamaḥ na tu jñānasya tatra darśanam nanu jñānam api tad anvaya vyatireka anuvidhāyi prāyeṇa dṛśyate bhūteṣu anna pāna ādi upayoga puṣṭeṣu paṭvī cetanā bhavati tad viparyaye viparyayaḥ brāhmī ghṛta ādi upayoga saṃskṛte ca kumāra śarīre paṭu prajña tā jāyate

varṣāsu ca sveda ādinā anati davīyasā eva kālena dadhi ādi avayavāḥ eva calantaḥ pūtanā ādi krimi rūpāḥ upalabhyante caitanye ca gurulāghava vyavahāraḥ api bhūta atiśaya sada sattva kṛtaḥ bhaviṣyati iti bhūta caitanya pakṣaḥ eva yukti yuktaḥ lakṣyate na etat cāru ceṣṭa indriya artha āśrayaḥ śarīram lakṣyate tatra tad anugrahāt indriya anugrahe sati paṭu karaṇa tvāt viṣaya grahaṇam api paṭutaram ivabhavati na ca viṣaya grahaṇāt anyat caitanyam nāma

etena brāhmī ghṛta upayogaḥ api vyākhyātaḥ vyāpaka tvāt ātmanaḥ sarvatra bhāve sati bhoga āyatana tvena kadācid bhūta avayavānām upādānam atas śukra śoṇita ādi vat dadhi avayavān vikṛta anupādāsyate tathā ca sveda ja ādi bhedena bahu bhedaḥ bhūta sargaḥ pravartate vicitra karma paripāka apekṣayā iti yat kiṃcid etat tasmāt na sarvathā bhūtānām caitanyam iti siddham

na api indriyāṇi yathā uktasya jñāna ādeḥ kāryasya āśraya tām pratipadyante darśana sparśanābhyām ekārtha grahaṇāt yam artham aham adrākṣam cakṣuṣā tam eva etarhi sparśanena spṛśāmi yamasprākṣa sparśanena tam adhunā cakṣuṣā paśyāmi iti katarat indriyam evam anusanda dhīta na cakṣuḥ sparśa aviṣaya tvāt na tvac indriyam rūpa aviṣaya tvāt tasmāt ubhaya viṣaya grahaṇa samarthaḥ kaścid anusandhātā asti iti saḥ indriya vyatiriktaḥ gamyate

amunā eva prasaṅgena rūpa ādi vyatirekiṇaḥ vaktavyā guṇinaḥ siddhiḥ etat buddhi nibandhanā rūpa ādiṣu svatantreṣu na hi eṣa pratyayaḥ bhavet na rūpam asya viṣayaḥ na sparśaḥ na ca tad dvayam atas ca na guṇa vyatiriktaḥ guṇī bhedena agrahaṇāt iti asiddhaḥ para uktaḥ hetuḥ bheda grahaṇasya darśita tvāt vṛtti vikalpa ādīnām tu pratisamādhānam sāmānya samarthana avasare kathitam avayavi siddhau vakṣyate ca iti alam avāntara cintayā

itas ca na indriyāṇām caitanyam karaṇa tvāt vā asya ādi vat bhautikāni ca indriyāṇi varṇayiṣyāmaḥ tena yaḥ eṣa bhūta caitanya nirākaraṇe nyāyaḥ varṇitaḥ sa teṣu api yojanīyaḥ atas ca evam indriya antara vikārāt āmre hi cakṣuṣā dṛṣṭe rasa niṣyanda sundare rasanasya vikāraḥ syāt na danta udaka saṃplavaḥ bahūnām indriyāṇām ca bhinna abhiprāya tā bhavet tena ekatra eva santāne nānā cetana tā bhavet ati tucchaḥ ca ayam indriya caitanya pakṣaḥ iti kim atra bahu likhyate

nanu manaḥ tarhi icchā ādeḥ adhiṣṭhānam bhaviṣyati tat hi nityam ekam sarva viṣayam abhautikam iti na prāktana dauṣaiḥ spṛśyate ucyate manasaḥ api tad āśraya tvam anupannam kutas jñātuḥ jñāna sādhana upapatteḥ saṃjñā bheda mātram manasaḥ hi icchā ādi āśraya tve jñāna ādau kartṛ tvāt tasya api bāhya gandha ādi viṣaya jñāna yauga padya anupapatteḥ tad grahaṇa karaṇa ghrāṇa ādi adhiṣṭhāna paṭunā kena cit āntara sukha duḥkha ādi viṣaya grāhiṇā smṛti ādi kriyā kāriṇā ca karaṇena bhavitavyam iti tatra ātma saṃjñā bhavet ātmani ca kartari manassaṃjñā iti

na ca asya bāhya karaṇaiḥ sidhyanti sakalāḥ kriyāḥ na ca smṛti sukha icchā ādau cakṣuḥ ādīni sādhanam tena icchā ākṛti sukha duḥkha vedanānām ādhāraḥ na khalu manaḥ na ca indriyāṇi dehaḥ api vrajati na tad samāśraya tvam tena anyam puruṣam atas prakalpayāmaḥ

diś pradarśanam idam kṛtam icchā dveṣa yatna sukha duḥkha matīnām liṅga tā kathanam ātmani tatra tu asti hetu nivahaḥ bahuḥ anyaḥ kartṛ prayojya tā khalu dṛṣṭā dātṛ ādi karaṇa jātasya tvac śrotra ādi api karaṇam tathā eva kartrā prayujyeta hita ahita prāpti visarga yogyā ceṣṭā ca dṛṣṭā niyatā śarīre tad cetanā adhiṣṭhita tām amuṣya gantrī ratha ādeḥ iva kalpayāmaḥ prāṇa ādi mārutānām antar cala tām cala acala gatīnām sahaja nija karma vikṛtau kāraṇam anumīyate kiṃcid idam ca dehāt itaratra durlabham nirīkṣya vṛddhi kṣata bhagna rohaṇam dhruvam grahasya iva gatiḥ prakalpate nija āśraya kṣema parāyaṇaḥ naraḥ

yuktam ca na eva manasā hi anadhiṣṭhitānām sva artha pramākaraṇa kauśalam indriyāṇām syāt kaścid iṣṭa viṣaya anuguṇaḥ prayatnaḥ yat preritam samadhitiṣṭhati tāni cetaḥ jñāna prayatna ādim ataḥ atha kasya dṛṣṭānta tā syāt karaṇa ādi liṅge kārye na naḥ paryanuyogaḥ eṣaḥ sāmānya mātrasya tava api siddheḥ

pratyakṣa ādi pramāṇaiḥ yaḥ vyavahāraḥ sa ca ātmanā vinā nityena na iti evam tatas api etasya kalpanā yat pratyakṣam pratyabhijñā svabhāvam jñātranya tve tasya na hi ātma lābhaḥ grāhyasya aikyam yadvat arthasya tasmāt sidhyati evam grāhakasya api puṃsaḥ avinābhauva grahaṇam liṅga jñānam tad anvaya smaraṇam liṅgipramitiḥ iti idam na boddhṛ bhede pramāṇam syāt jñāte vanecara mukhāt ati deśa vākye dṛṣṭe mṛge vipina vartini go sadṛkṣe tad saṃjñitām iti phalam labhate pramātṛ bhede na ca idam upamānam iti pratiṣṭham varṇānām śravaṇam krameṇa samaya smṛtyā padārtha grahaḥ tad saṃskāra jamantyavarṇa kalanā kāle tad ālocanam āka aṃkṣa ādi nibandhana anvaya kṛtam vākya artha saṃpiṇḍanam jñātrā ekena vinā ati durghaṭam atas nitya ātma siddhiḥ dhruvā mayā idam pūrvedyus vihitam idam anyedyus aparam vidhātavyam ca iti śruti kṛṣi vaṇijyā ādiṣu janāḥ yat evam ceṣṭante nipuṇam anusandhāya tat amī dhruvam sarva avasthā anugatam avagacchanti puruṣam
iti ātma lakṣaṇam avādi yat etat icchā dveṣa prayatna sukha duḥkha samāśraya tvam tad saṅginam tat iha heya tayā vyavasyet tad viprayuktam adhigamya tayā mumukṣuḥ

atho tathāgatāḥ prāhuḥ kim puṃsā kalpitena vaḥ jñāna mātreṇa pūrva uktaḥ vyavahāraḥ prasiddhyati jñānam kim ātma vat nityam saugataiḥ upagamyate prāk darśita anusandhāna kāmanā ādi kriyā kṣamam jñānam bauddha gṛhe tāvat kutas nityam bhaviṣyati anye api sarve saṃskārāḥ kṣaṇikāḥ iti gṛhyatām kṣaṇikam ca iṣyate kāryam na kvacid kiṃcid āśritam svatantram jñānam eva atas na anyaḥ tena anumīyate

jñānasya ca prabhedaḥ ayam icchā dveṣa sukha ādikaḥ na vastu antaram iti evam na tatas api anya kalpanam guṇa tvam api na asti asya yatas adhiṣṭhāna kalpanā na guṇa vyatiriktaḥ ca guṇī nāma asti kaścana

nirāśrayeṣu vijñāna skandheṣu kṣaṇa bhaṅgiṣu katham smṛti ādi kāryam vā para lokaḥ api vā katham sati api para loke katham akṛta abhyāgama kṛta vipraṇāśau parākriyete yena hi jñānena caitya vandana ādi karma kṛtam tasya vināśāt na tad phala upabhogaḥ yasya ca phala upabhogaḥ tena na tat karma kṛtam iti naiṣa doṣaḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāvasya niyāmaka tvāt anādi prabandha pravṛttaḥ hi jñānānām hetu phala bhāva pravāhaḥ eṣaḥ eva ca santānaḥ iti ucyate tad kṛtaḥ ca ayam anusandhānādi kārya niyamaḥ santāna anādi tvāt tad avicchedāt ca para lokaḥ api na kliṣṭa kalpanaḥ

yadi api santati antara patita jñāna janyam api santati antare jñānam dṛśyate tathā api na tādṛśa kārya kāraṇa bhāvena santāna vyavahāraḥ pratisandhāna ādi kārya nirvāhaḥ vā kintu upādāna rūpa tad viśeṣa nibandhanaḥ eva eṣa nirvahati niyamaḥ tasmin eva sati svarūpa santāna vibhāgaḥ avakalpate smṛti vat parihartavyau kṛta nāśa akṛta āgamau tad santāna upasaṃkrāntyā kusume bīja rāga vat

āha ca yasmin eva hi santāne āhitā karma vāsanā phalam tatra eva badhnāti kārpāse rakta tā yathā yathā yasmin eva hi kārpasabīje varṇaḥ rakta tā ākhyaḥ kṛtaḥ tasya eva kusumam api raktam na anyasya iti tathā yasmin eva jñāna santāne yādṛśī karma vāsanā tādṛśam phalam tasmin eva santāne bhavati na anyasmin jñānaḥ iti arthaḥ tathā ca kṛta hāna akṛta abhyāgama doṣa nirāsaḥ

nityaḥ tu ātmā abhyupagamyamānaḥ yadi sukha ādi janmanā vikṛtim anubhavati tat ayam anityaḥ eva carma ādi vat uktaḥ syāt nirvikāra tve tu satā asatā vā sukha duḥkha ādinā karma phalena kaḥ tasya viśeṣaḥ iti karma vaiphalyam eva tat uktam varṣa ātapābhyām kim vyomnaḥ carmaṇi asti tayoḥ phalam carma upamaḥ ced saḥ anityaḥ kha tulyaḥ ced asat phalaḥ iti tasmāt utsṛjyatāmeṣaḥ mūrdhābhiṣiktaḥ prathamaḥ mohaḥ ātma grahaḥ nāma tad nivṛttyā ca ātmīya grahaḥ api viraṃsyati aham eva na kim mama iti tat idam ahaṃkāra mamakāra granthi prahāṇena nairātmya darśanam eva nirvāṇa dvāra mabalambyatām

tasya ca mārgaḥ kṣaṇika padārtha niścayaḥ kṣaṇikeṣu hi sarva bhāveṣu nirāśrayeṣu jñānasya api āśraya virahāt kutastyam ātma kalpanam iti katham punar eṣaḥ sakala pramāṇa atītaḥ kṣaṇika padārtha vādaḥ śakyate śākyaiḥ abhyupagantum na khalu kṣaṇa bha aṅgi tve bhāvānām akṣajā matiḥ pramāṇam kṣaṇikā ākāra kalpanā utpatya sambhavāt athavā api avinābhūta hetu jñāna upapattitaḥ na bhūmiḥ anumānasya vikalpa niyata sthiteḥ smaraṇa pratyabhijñāne pratyuta sthairya sādhake evam ca vaṃcanā mātram āśu nāśi tva deśanāḥ

ucyate pratyakṣa gamyam kṣaṇika tvam bhavati na bhavati iti eṣam kariṣyate vicāraḥ anumānam tu saṃprati eva abhidhīyate sattvāt kṣaṇikāḥ padārthāḥ iti sattvam tāvat artha kriyā kāritvam ucyate yathā uktam artha kriyā samartham yat tat eva paramārtha sat iti

sat pratyaya gamya tve hi sattve keśoṇḍuka ādeḥ api sattva prasaṅgaḥ sattā sambandhi tve tu sattve sāmānya ādīnām tad asambandhāt asattvam syāt artha kriyā sāmarthya sattva anuvartī ca laukikaḥ vyavahāraḥ sati api putre tad kārya adarśanāt aputrāḥ vayam iti vyapadiśanti laukikā putrāt anyasmin api tad kārya kāriṇi sati sa putrāḥ vayam iti ca bruvate tasmāt artha kriyā kāri tvam eva sattvam

bhavatu evam tasya tu kutra katham vā kṣaṇika tvena vyāpti grahaṇam kutra iti yat pṛcchasi yatra rocate mahābhāgāya ghaṭe paṭe vā gṛhyatām vyāptiḥ kim sādhya dharmiṇī eva vyāpti grahaṇam upapadyate dhīman kaḥ atra pramādaḥ na hi daiva nirmitaḥ kaścid sādhya dharmī nāma grahītum śakyate ced vyāptiḥ yatra tatra sā gṛhyatām iti

yat tu katham asyāḥ grahaṇam iti tat ucyate bhāvānām hi sattvam krama yaugapadyābhyām vyāptam nityeṣu ca padārtheṣu vyāpaka anupalambhanāt tad vyāptam api sattvam hi balāt tebhyaḥ nivartate na ca rāśiḥ tṛtīyaḥ asti tena gati antara kṣayāt kṣaṇikān eva tān bhāvān sattvam sama balambate tat ca sva grāhakāt bodhāt asandigdham pratīyate jñāna utpattyā eva tad hetoḥ asāmarthye parākṛte asamarthāt samutpādaḥ dṛśyate na hi kasyacid śakta aśakta prasūta tvena tad bodhaḥ asti saṃśayaḥ atas eva ca tat jñānam pramāṇam jagaduḥ sadā svarūpe śakti ja tve tu saṃśaya ādeḥ asaṃbhavāt

kim idam rajatam uta śuktikā iti viśeṣa aṃśe saṃśeratām nāma pramātāraḥ na tu sāmarthyam prati dolā kācid saṃbhavati kim idam jñānam samarthena janitam uta tad itareṇa iti asamarthasya janakatvā anupapatteḥ vyāpakān upalambhasya api vyāpti grāhiṇaḥ svatas eva prāmāṇyam saṃśaya viparyayoḥ tatra api abhāvāt

katham punar nityeṣu padārtheṣu sattva vyāpakayoḥ krama yauga padyayoḥ anupalambhaḥ ucyate nityaḥ hi bhāvaḥ krameṇa vā kāryam kuryāt yaugapadyena vā paraspara parihāra vyavasthita ātmanām tṛtīya prakāra anupapatteḥ
na tāvat krameṇa sa hi samarthaḥ vā syāt asamarthaḥ vā syāt samarthaḥ ced kim krameṇa samarthasya kāla kṣepa ayogāt asamarthaḥ tu asamartha tvāt eva na karoti kiṃcid iti tasya api kim krameṇa

sahakārī apekṣayā karoti iti ced na asamarthasya sahakāriṇā api sāmarthya ādhāna anupapatteḥ samarthasya svatas eva sāmarthye sati sahakāri vaiyarthyāt sahakāri sannidhāne api ca asya svarūpeṇa vā kartṛ tvam syāt para rūpeṇa vā svarūpasya ca prāk api bhāvāt tasya ca kāraka tvāt kim sahakāriṇā para rūpeṇa kartṛ tve pūrvarūpa parityāgāt tad rūpa antara āpatteḥ ca kṣaṇika tvam āpadyate

evam sahakārī api samartha asamartha tayā vikalpanīyaḥ svataḥ asya sāmarthī ekim para upakāra anusaraṇa dainyena asamarthaḥ tu sacivaḥ kim āgatya api tapasvī kariṣyati kiṃca kiṃcitkaraḥ vā saha kārī syāt akiṃcitkaraḥ vā akiṃci tkara pakṣe sarvaḥ sarvasya sarvatra kārye sācivyam upagacchet kiṃcitkaraḥ ced vaktavyam kim karoti iti
