pṛthivī ādīnām guṇāḥ iti yat uktam didānīm vibhajya varṇyate kasya kati guṇāḥ iti tatra gandha ādayaḥ niyoktavyāḥ catvāraḥ pṛthivī guṇāḥ ap tejaḥ marutām ekam pūrva pūrvam apohya tu gandha varjam rasa rūpa sparśāḥ apām rasa varjam rūpa sparśau tejasaḥ rūpa varjam sparśaḥ eva vāyoḥ iti ākāśasya tu guṇaḥ śabdaḥ

nanu na ayam guṇa viniyogaḥ sādhīyān pṛthivyāḥ caturguṇa tve pārthivena ghrāṇa indriyeṇa caturṇām api tad guṇānām grahaṇam syāt evam uttareṣu api vaktavyam tasmāt ekaika guṇa tvam eva bhūtānām ucyatām na etat evam na hi guṇāḥ sva icchayā labhyante kintu yathā upalabhyante tathā vyavasthāpyante pratīti pramāṇakāḥ hi vayam tatra pārthive dravye caturṇām api guṇānām upalaṃbhāt katham ekaguṇām pṛthivīm brūmaḥ rūpa eka guṇe ca tejasi pṛthivī udakayoḥ vāyu vada rūpa tvāt apratyakṣa tvam syāt tasmāt trīṇi rūpavanti tavyāṇi

yadi evam sarveṣām sarvatra upalaṃbhāt sarvāṇi sarva guṇāni bhavantu bhūtāni paṭapaṭāyate pṛthivī calacalāyante āpaḥ dhagadhagāyate tejaḥ kathakathāyate vāyuḥ iti sarveṣām guṇaḥ śabdaḥ syāt ucyate na sarve guṇāḥ sarvatra upalabhyante nirgandhānām apām sarvatra darśanāt klinna rūpa ādau tu pārthi vā avayava saṃkrāntyā gandhaḥ payasi upalabhyate

evam suvarṇe taijase dravye saṃyukta samavāyāt rasa ādi upalabdhiḥ śabdaḥ tu sarva kālam ākāśa vṛttiḥ eva pratīyate pṛthivī ādi avayava saṃyoga vibhāga prabhavaḥ tu asau iti tad āśrita tva bhramam āvahati na tu akāśāt vinā tasya grahaṇam iti ākāśa guṇaḥ eva śabdaḥ iti etat ca prāk nirṇītam tasmāt na sarveṣām sarva guṇa tvam

yat ca pṛthivyāḥ catur guṇa tve tad guṇānām caturṇām api pārthiva ghrāṇa indriya grāhya tvam syāt iti tat na guṇa utkarṣasya niyāmaka tvāt sa atiśaya gandha guṇa adhikaraṇaiḥ vijātīya dravya avayava saṃsparśa leśa rahitaiḥ kevala pṛthivī avayavaiḥ adṛṣṭa saha kāribhiḥ ghaṭitam ghrāṇa indriyam iti gandhasya eva grāhakam

etat eva ca bhūyas tvam ācakṣate yathā aaha kaṇa vrataḥ bhūyastvāt gandhavat tvāt ca pṛthivī gandha jñāne prakṛtiḥ iha api uktam tad vyavasthānam tu bhūyaḥ tvāt iti dṛśyante ca kevala pṛthivī avayava upādāneṣu api padārtheṣu vyavasthita kārya niyamāḥ śaktayaḥ yathā pārthiva tva aviśeṣe api viṣam maraṇa kāraṇam agada dravyam anyat tu jīvitāya prakalpate tasmāt aparyanu yojyaḥ ayam pārthivena ghrāṇena gandha vat tad rasa ādayaḥ api katham na gṛhyante iti

sa atiśaya prakṛti guṇa yoge api na ca sva guṇa grahaṇa naipuṇyam indriyāṇām itī ndriya cintāyām nirṇītam śrotreṇa tu sva guṇasya śabdasya grahaṇam iti pariśeṣa anumāna pramāṇakaḥ ayam arthaḥ śabda parīkṣāyām eva parīkṣitaḥ iti alam ati prasaṅgena iti nipuṇa dhiyām asammatā eṣā sakala guṇa eka guṇa tva kalpanā tat ayam akaluṣaḥ abhyupeya tām guṇa viniyoga vidhiḥ yathā uditaḥ

te amī jñeyāḥ kṛtaka madhuram rūpam ādarśayantaḥ tikta udgārāḥ pariṇati vipad kāriṇaḥ hi indriyārthāḥ tyaktāḥ ca ete vyapagata mahā moha paṅkena puṃsā tīrṇaḥ ca ayam bhava jalanidhiḥ kleśa kallola raudraḥ

buddhiḥ upalabdhiḥ jñānam iti anarthāntaram nanu paryāya uccāraṇam etat na buddheḥ lakṣaṇa abhidhānam na paryāya prayoga sya eva lakṣaṇa kṣama tvāt lakṣaṇam hi tat ucyate yena samāna itara jātīyebhyaḥ lakṣyam vyavacchidyate vyavacchidyate ca buddhiḥ buddhi ādi paryāya vācya tayā eva tebhyaḥ iti na abhidhāna mālā mātram idam

nanu sāmayika tvāt śabda artha pratyayasya samayasya ca puruṣa icchā anuvarti tvāt katham idam vyavasthitam lakṣaṇam syāt mā evam sārvajanīnasya samayasya viplāvayitum aśakyatvāt tad viśiṣṭasya tad vācyasya lakṣaṇa tvāt prakāra antareṇa lakṣaṇam asyāḥ kim iti na uktam iti ced śiṃśapā ācodya midam tasmin api ukte anuyuṃjīta bhavāt ittham kim iti nīktam iti

asti ca prayojanam paryāya dvāraka lakṣaṇa upavarṇanasya yat sāṃkhyānām vyāmoha nirasanam evam hi sāṅkhyāḥ saṃgirante buddhiḥ anyā jñānam anyat upalabdhiḥ anyā iti tat bhraya apanayanāya idam ucyate buddhiḥ upalabdhiḥ jñānarmiti anartha antaram ekaḥ eva arthaḥ iti arthaḥ ittham ca svarūpataḥ nirjñātā buddhiḥ bhoga svabhāva tvāt tad sādhana tvāt ca saṃsāra hetuḥ iti heya tvena bhāvyate sukha ādi buddhiḥ bhogaḥ tad sādhana buddhiḥ tu bhoga sādhanam iti katham punar pāramarṣāḥ pravadanti buddhiḥ anyā jñānam anyat upalabdhiḥ anyā iti nityām hi buddhim te manyante

tat kim ātmā eva taiḥ buddhiḥ iti gṛhītaḥ na acetanāyāḥ bhogyāyāḥ prakṛteḥ thamā vikṛtiḥ mahat śabda vācyā buddhiḥ puruṣaḥ tu cetanaḥ bhoktā anyaḥ eva tau imau prakṛti puruṣau vivekena apaśyatām saṃsāraḥ prakṛti puruṣa viveka jñānāt mokṣaḥ iti

kā punar prakṛtiḥ nāma sattva rajaḥ tamasām trayāṇām guṇānām sāmya avasthā prakṛtiḥ pradhānam avyaktam ca tat ucyate yat sāmya avasthā gatam guṇatrayam iti nanu tad sattve kim pramāṇam anumānam iti āha tathā hi carācaram idam viśvam sukha duḥkha moha avinābhūtam upalabhyate na hi brahma ādau stamba paryante jagati tathābhūtam kim api bhūtam upalabhyate yat sukha duḥkha mohaiḥ vinākṛtam

tatra sukha svabhāvam sattvam duḥkha svabhāvam rajaḥ moha svabhāvam tamaḥ sarvatra ca prīti aprīti viṣāda darśanāt prakāśa pravṛtti niyama avagamāt ca sarvam triguṇa ātmakam jagat kāryam ca yat paraspara anvita rūpam tad eka rūpāt kāraṇāt utpadyamānam dṛśyate mṛd anvitāni hi ghaṭa śarāva udaṃcana prabhṛtīni kāryasya ekasmāt mṛdā ātmanaḥ kāraṇāt udbhavanti tat idam viśvam sukha duḥkha moha anvitam iti tad ātmaka kāraṇa kāryam bhavitum arhati yat sukha duḥkha moha ātmakam kāraṇam sā sattva rajaḥ tamaḥ rūpā prakṛtiḥ

evam anvaya purassarāḥ parimāṇa ādi hetavaḥ api vakyavyāḥ iyat tayā vā caturaśrata ādinā vā parimāṇena tadvatām kāryāṇām eka prakṛti tva darśanāt viṣama vṛttayaḥ ca ete guṇāḥ kāryeṣu dṛśyante kvacid sattvam ādhikam ūne rajaḥ tamasī kvacid rajaḥ prakṛṣṭam alpe sattva tamasī kvacid tamaḥ pravṛddham tucche sattva rajasī iti tat eṣām vaiṣamya bheda upadarśita viśva rūpa kāryāṇām kvacid sāmya avasthayā bhāvyam sā prakṛtiḥ ucyate sā iyam acetanā bhogyā prakṛtiḥ asyāḥ tu bhoktā cetanaḥ puruṣaḥ

puruṣaḥ idānīm kim anumānakaḥ uktam eva bhogyena bhoktuḥ anumānam na hi acetanasya bhogyasya bhoktāram antareṇa bhogya tā eva upapadyate dṛṣṭā ca sā iti bhoktā kalpyate sa ca citi śakti svabhāvakaḥ eva sarva prakāra kartṛ tva ādi vyahāra nirvaha bahiṣkṛta svarūpaḥ draṣṭṛ tvam eva puruṣasya svarūpam āhuḥ yathā bhavantaḥ enam ātmāna madhyavasāya ādi dharma yoginam manyante na tathā asau bhavitum arhati adhyavasāya ādeḥ buddhi dharma tvāt kartum śaknoti puruṣaḥ tṛṇasya api na kubjatām anya upanītam artham tu sa paśyati eva kevalam

prakṛtiḥ eva enam bhoga apavargābhyām saṃyunakti na ca nirvikārā satī bhoga saṃpādana samarthā asau bhavati iti mahat ādi vikṛtīḥ pratipadyate paṅga bandha nyāyena prakṛti puruṣau saṃyujyete prakṛtiḥ acetanā dṛśyā bhogyā draṣṭāram bhoktāram puruṣam apekṣate puruṣaḥ api draṣṭā bhoktā dṛśyam bhogyam apekṣate iti evam tayoḥ paṅgu andha vat saṃyogaḥ bhavati darśana śaktyā paṅgoḥ gamana śaktyā ca andhasya ekatra melanāt kārya siddhiḥ evam prakṛti puruṣa saṃyogāt sargaḥ pravartate tat uktam puruṣasya darśana arthaḥ kaivalya arthaḥ tathā pradhānasya paṅgu andhavat ubhayoḥ api saṃyogaḥ tad kṛtaḥ sargaḥ

yat ca ittham pradhānāt mahat tattvam utpadyate sā buddhiḥ adhyavasāya ātmikām dharma jñāna vairāgya aiśyarya tad viparyaya rūpa vṛtti yoginī mahat tattvam ucyate buddheḥ ahaṅkāraḥ udeti sa ca abhimāna svabhāvaḥ ahaṃkārāt tu ghrāṇa ādīni paṃca buddhīndriyāṇi vāc ādīni paṃca karmendriyāṇi saṅkalpakam ekādaśam manaḥ gandha ādi tanmātrāṇi ca paṃca iti ṣoḍaśakaḥ guṇaḥ prabhavati tatas gandha ādi tanmātra paṃcakāt paṃca pṛthivī ādīni mahābhūtāni jāyante iti āha ca prakṛteḥ mahāḥ tatas ahaṅkāraḥ tasmāt gaṇaḥ ca ṣoḍaśakaḥ tasmāt api ṣoḍaśakāt paṃcabhyaḥ paṃca bhūtāti

tāni imāni paṃcaviṃśati tattvāni saṃcakṣate pradhānam prakṛtiḥ eva na vikṛtiḥ mahat ahaṅkāra tanmātrāṇi sapta pūrva pūrva apekṣayā vikṛtayaḥ uttarova uttara kārya apekṣayā prakṛtayaḥ ekādaśa indriyāṇi paṃca bhūtāni vikṛtayaḥ eva aprakṛti vikṛti rūpaḥ tu śuddhaḥ puruṣaḥ iti tat āha mūlaprakṛtviravikṛtiḥ mahat ādyāḥ prakṛti vikṛtayaḥ sapta ṣoḍaśakaḥ tu vikāraḥ na prakṛtiḥ na vikṛtiḥ puruṣaḥ

evam mahā ādi vikāravatī prakṛtiḥ ātmanaḥ bhogam sādhayati kaḥ ca asya bhogaḥ buddhi vṛtti anupāti tvam viṣaya ākāra pariṇata indriya vṛtti anuraktām buddhi vṛtim jñāna ātmikām puruṣaḥ paśyati darśane api na tasya kiṃcid anya tvam tat eva darśanam yat tatra pratibimbanam iti ittham tayoḥ buddhi puṃsoḥ saṃyoge sati puruṣa dharmaḥ cetayitṛ tva lakṣaṇaḥ buddha avasan api san iva lakṣyate buddhi dharmaḥ ca kartṛ tva ādiḥ ātmani sākṣi sthānīye asan api san iva vibhāvyate tat āha tad smāt tad saṃyogāt acetanam cetanāvat iva liṅgam guṇa kartṛ tve api tathā kartā iva bhavati udāsīnaḥ

atha apavargāya katham ātmanaḥ prakṛtiḥ avakalpate svarūpam prakāśayatī tyācakṣate anavadhṛta prakṛti svarūpaḥ pumān svarūpa niṣṭhaḥ eva prakṛti kṛtam akhilam ātma kṛtam iti manyamānaḥ tad upārjitam bhuṅkte yadā tu pṛthak bhūtām enām manyate tadā bhavatu iyam āyāsa hetuḥ eva mama iti buddhyamānaḥ tad kṛtam anupabhuṃjānaḥ svarūpa niṣṭhaḥ eva avatiṣṭhate prakṛtiḥ api bhavatu dṛṣṭā aham anena pṛthak mām eṣa manyate iti na tad abhimukhībhavitum utsahate tat āha prakṛtessukumārataram na kiṃcid asti iti me matiḥ bhavati yā dṛṣṭā asmi iti punar na darśanam upaiti puruṣasya

parasparam ca bhagna rasayoḥ prakṛti puruṣayoḥ vyāpaka tvāt sati api saṃyoge sargaḥ na pravartate eva iti āha dṛṣṭā mayā iti upekṣakaḥ ekaḥ dṛṣṭā aham asmi iti uparamati anyā sati saṃyoge api tayoḥ prayojanam na asti sargasya aparimlāna kutūhalaḥ hi pumān vaṃcayitum śakyate na dṛṣṭa tattvaḥ iti matvā satyām api yogyatāyām nivartate prakṛtiḥ naṭī iva raṅga bhūmau pradarśita nikhila nija nṛtta vṛttānta naipuṇā tatas iti āha raṅgasya darśayitvā nivartate nartakī yathā nṛtyāt puruṣasya tathā aatmānam prakāśya vinivartate prakṛtiḥ

tat evam prakṛtiḥ eva saṃsāre pravartate prakṛtiḥ eva mokṣam anubhavati iti āha tasmāt na badhyate addhā na api mucyate na api saṃsarati kaścid saṃsarati badhyate mucyate ca nānā āśrayā prakṛtiḥ kimartham punar asau evam ceṣṭate prakṛtiḥ iti ced kim kriyate svabhāvaḥ eva eṣa daiva hati kāyāḥ tasyāḥ nānāvidhaiḥ upāyaiḥ upakāriṇī anupakāriṇaḥ puṃsaḥ guṇavati aguṇasya sataḥ tasya artham apārthakam carati

acetana tvāt asyāḥ katham evaṃkāri tvam iti ced uktam atra vatsa vivṛddhi nimittam kṣīrasya yathā pravṛttiḥ ajñasya puruṣa vimokṣa nimittam tathā pravṛttiḥ pradhānasya nanu utpanna tattva jñāne puṃsi prakṛteḥ bhoga anukūla mahat ādi kārya ārambha parāṅmukha tvāt ekasmin tattva vidi mukte sati sarve muktāḥ syuḥ na eṣam doṣaḥ tattva vidam eva pumāṃsam prati tasyāḥ audāsīnyāt anya sādhāraṇa tvena tad kāryānapāyāt tathā ca pātajaliḥ kṛtārtham prati naṣṭam api anaṣṭa tad atyasādhāraṇa tvāt

nanu evam yadā eva tattva jñānam utpannam tadā eva prakṛti upājita karma phala upabhoga parihāriṇaḥ puṃsaḥ śarīra pātaḥ syāt na iti āha tiṣṭhati saṃskāra vaśāt cakra bhrami vat dhṛta śarīraḥ tatas saṃskāra viratau satyām prāpte śarīra bhede caritārtha tvāt pradhāna vinivṛttau aikāntikam ātyantikam ubhayam kaivalyam āpnoti iti

aho nu khalu kāpilaka vikathā rasa ākṣipta hṛdayaiḥ atibahu prasakta anuprasaktyā likhitam asmābhiḥ tat iyam pradhāna vikṛtiḥ prathamā mahat śabda vācyā sā buddhiḥ tattva vidam prati naṣṭā api anya sādhāraṇa tvāt anaṣṭā eva iti nityā nitya tvāt ca pratyabhijñā sanu sandhānādi vyavahāra prabandha nirvahaṇa kṣamā buddhiḥ jñānam tu tasyāḥ vṛttiḥ upalabdhiḥ tu puṃsaḥ vṛttimat buddhi darśanam iti na eṣām paryāya śabda tvam iti

atra pratividhīyate ātmani eva nitye vyāpini boddhari jñātari adhyavasātari dharma adharma ādi yogini pratyabhijñāna ādi kāryāṇām kartari sā iyam buddhiḥ asaṃjñā sāṃkhyaiḥ kalpitā cetana tvam tu jñāna ādi yoginyāḥ api yat tu asyāḥ na abhyupagatam saḥ ayam atīva tamasvinām bhramaḥ yaḥ eva budhyate jānāti adhyavasyati saḥ eva paśyati cetayate ca na khalu atra vastu svarūpa bhedam paśyāmaḥ tatra buddhiḥ budhyate jānāti adhyavasyati puruṣaḥ tu paśyati cetayate ca iti vaṃcanāya evam ucyate mugdha tayā vā

yat ca idam ucyate budhya adhyavasitam artham puruṣaḥ paśyati iti tat vyākhyeyam kim idam tasya draṣṭṛ tvam iti pratibimbanam iti ced kim svacche puṃsi vṛttimatī buddhiḥ saṃkrāmati uta vṛttimatyām buddhau pumān iti tatra cati śaktiḥ apariṇāminī apratisaṃkrama iti na buddhau puruṣasya saṃkramaṇam buddhau tu puṃsi saṃkrāntāyām api puṃsaḥ kim vṛttam yena draṣṭā saṃpannaḥ draṣṭṛ tvam svabhāvaḥ eva asya iti ced kim buddhau pratibimbanena viśiṣṭa viṣaya avacchedaḥ iti ced tatas pūrvam anālambanam draṣṭṛ tvam aghaṭamānam iti na naisargikam draṣṭṭa rūpa tvam puṃsaḥ syāt

darśana śaktiḥ svābhāvikī iti ced na tasyāḥ bheda abhedābhyām nirūpayiḥ tum aśakyatvāt pratibimba pakṣe ca paraspara anurāgasya tulya tvāt aviyogāt ca katham idam nirdhāryatām amī buddhi dharmāḥ amī puṃdharmā iti na hi tayo pārtha garthyena kadācid svarūpa avadhāraṇam vṛttam

anavadhārita kārya bheda tvāt ca nānātvam api tayoḥ durvacam cetana acetana tvāt bhoktṛ bhogya tvāt ca vispaṣṭam tayoḥ nānātvam iti ced na jñāna ādi yogi tvam buddheḥ acetana tvam ca iti citram api ca kalpayitvā api buddhi puṃsoḥ nānātvam buddhi dharmāḥ puṃsi puṃdharmāḥ ca buddhau āropaṇīyāḥ iti kim bhedena bhede ca buddheḥ jñāna ādi yogi tvena cetana tu āpatteḥ ekatra kārya kāraṇa saṃghāte cetana dvayam aniṣṭam prasajyeta

nityam antaḥkaraṇam antareṇa puṃsaḥ upalabdhiḥ na bhavet iti buddheḥ kalpanā ced asti eva nityam antaḥkaraṇam manaḥ tena karaṇena kartuḥ ātmanaḥ viṣaya upalabdhi kriyā nirvartyate sā eva ca buddhiḥ iti ākhyāyate na tu anyā nityā buddhiḥ asti iti

kiṃca kasya kṛte paridṛśyamānam ātmanaḥ jñāna ādi kartṛ tvam utsṛjya buddheḥ adṛśyamānam tat upeyate kaḥ atra atiśayaḥ nanu puruṣasya svātantrya ātmaka kartṛ tve sati sva kṛta karma phala upabhoga ānantyāt anirmokṣaḥ syāt na hi karmaṇām parikṣayaḥ janma koṭi śataiḥ api śakya kriyaḥ yadā tu akartāram udāsīnam evam prakṛtiḥ badhnāti tadā sā eva jñātā satī mokṣyati iti na dūram mokṣa vartma bhaviṣyati iti

aho bata nikhilam eva maurkhyam sāṃkhya hṛdayeṣu eva pratiṣṭhitam iti katha manyo janaḥ idānīm mūrkhaḥ bhaviṣyati acetane hi niraṅkuśe pradhāne bandhayitari suta rām anirvokṣaḥ syāt tattva vidam api pumāṃsam na badhnāti prakṛti riti kaḥ asyāḥ niyantā paṅgu andha nyāyena saṃyogasya tadā api tulya tvāt nivṛtta kutūhalaḥ pumān iti ced prakṛtiḥ anirmukta kautukā abhinava vadhu ūḥ iva sthitā eva

api ca re mūḍha pūrvam api tapasvinā puṃsā kim kṛtam yadā asau baddhaḥ abhūt draṣṭṛ tvam tu tasya rūpam tad avinābhūtam iti kaivalya daśāyām api tat na naśyati eva iti tadā api tasya bandhanāya katham na pravarteta nirmaryādā prakṛtiḥ dṛṣṭā asmi iti viramati iti ced mā evam na hi asau eka patnī vrata durgraha gṛhitā nissaṅkhya puruṣa upabhoga saubhāgyā paṇya vanitā iva na vā asau niyamena vyavahartum arhati iti āḥ tām etat

yat ca sattva rajaḥ tamobhiḥ tribhiḥ guṇaiḥ sama avasthāyāḥ pradhāna śabda vyapadeśa bhājaḥ prakṛteḥ mahān nāma buddhiḥ utpadyate ityādi prakriyā jālam ālapitam tat sarvam mahā andha parampara anyāya pravṛtta guru pāṭha krama upanatam eva na pramāṇa mūlam kāryāt hi kāraṇam alpa parimāṇam upalabhyate na tu viparyayaḥ sva avayava āśritasya ghaṭa paṭa ādeḥ darśanāt tad avayavānām tad apekṣayā alpa tvāt anyasyāḥ mṛdaḥ mahā parimāṇa tvam aprayojakam

api ca buddhiḥ nāma viṣaya upalaṃbhaḥ ahaṅkāraḥ api ahaṃpratyaya rūpaḥ a bhimānaḥ buddhi viśeṣaḥ eva tena bāhyāni indriyāṇi janyante gandha ādayaḥ ca guṇāḥ guṇaiḥ ca pṛthivī ādīni bhūtāni iti mahāvyāmohaḥ idam ca citram viṣaya janyāḥ hi sukha ādayaḥ prasiddhāḥ te adya sukha ādi janyāḥ viṣayāḥ saṃvṛttāḥ iti naveyam viśvāmitrasya iva sāṃkhya muneḥ sṛṣṭiḥ

na ca pradhāna astitvam api pramāṇa vat anvaya ādi hetūnām asādhana tvāt cetanānām api hi kāmam bhavet api sukha duḥkha moha anvita tvam acetanāni bhūtāni sukha duḥkha mohavanti iti su bhāṣitam ghaṭe paṭe śakaṭe ca sukha duḥkha mohāḥ santi iti kaḥ pratipadyeta prakāśa pravṛtti niyamāḥ api cetaneṣu eva dṛśyante na acetaneṣu iti asiddha tvāt hetoḥ na pradhāna siddhiḥ

api ca satkārya vāda mūlaḥ eṣa tapasvinām vibhramaḥ sarvam sarvatra asti iti tatas anvaya siddham budhyamānāḥ te pradhāna siddha avadhyavasitāḥ satkārya vādaḥ ca vicāryamāṇaḥ na samasti eva iti kutastyāḥ hetu siddhiḥ

nanu satkārya vāde kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ bhavati bhāvānām na anyathā tathā hi catuṣṭayī gatiḥ iha syāt ghaṭa ādi kāryam mṛd piṇḍa ādinā kārayena kriyamāṇam asat vā kriyate sadvā sat asat vā anubhaya svabhāvam vā iti

tatra āsataḥ karaṇe khara viṣāṇāt epi karaṇam syāt asattve hi ghaṭasya khara viṣāṇasya kaḥ viśeṣaḥ ghaṭasya api prāc abhāva pradhvaṃsa abhāva daśayoḥ asattva aviśeṣāt prāgabhāva daśāyām iva pradhvaṃsa daśāyām api karaṇam bhavet asat karaṇe ca niyata upādāna grahaṇam na prāpnoti taila arthī tila sarṣapān upādatte na sikatāḥ asattve ca tailasya kaḥ viśeṣaḥ sarṣapāṇām sikatābhyaḥ asati ca kārye nirālambanaḥ kāraka vyāpāraḥ bhavet na hi asau mṛd piṇḍa ādi viṣayaḥ bhavitum arhati kāryam ca asat

api ca avidyamāne kāraṇa vyatirikte ca kārye janye tad kāraṇasya mṛd piṇḍa ādeḥ ghaṭa ādi kāryam janitavataḥ kim iti na svarūpam upalabhyate atha sva vināśena kāraṇam kāryasya janakam iṣyate tat iyam abhāvāt bhāva utpattiḥ bhavet tasyām ca kutas ayam niyamaḥ yad anantara vṛttaḥ eva mṛd piṇḍa abhāvaḥ kumbham abhinirvartayati na cira atikrāntaḥ iti atas ca parutmṛd piṇḍe naṣṭe eṣamaḥ kumbhotpādaḥ syāt atha sva avyatiriktam eva kāraṇena kāryam janyate tarhi kāraṇasya sattvāt tat avyatiriktam kāryam sat eva iti na asataḥ karaṇam

sat asat api na kārya vaktum yuktam sat asatoḥ vipratiṣedhena ekatra samāveśa ayogāt rūpa bhedāt avirodhaḥ iti ced na kāryasya vicāryamāṇasya eka tvāt tat ca tena eva svena kāryeṇa rūpeṇa sat ced na asat bhavet asat ced na sat iti para rūpeṇa tu asattvam sarva bhāvānām asti eva anubhaya ātmakam tu vastu na asti eva iti tat pāriśeṣyāt sat eva kāryam kim iti ca tadā na upalabhyate iti ced anumānena api yat upalabdham tat kim anupalabdham bhavati pratyakṣeṇa tu tadanīm anupalambhaḥ anabhivyakta tvāt abhivyati sampādanaḥ eva ca kāraka prayatna sāphalyam kāryam tu sat eva iti

atra abhidhīyate kena tu rūpeṇa tadānīm kāryam sat iti manyase yadi kāraka vyāpāra abhinirvartyena salila āharaṇa ādi artha kriyā samarthena pṛthu budhnā udara ākāravatā rūpeṇa cakra mūrdhani ghaṭaḥ asti iti tadā abhivyaktena api rūpeṇa sattvāt atyantāya kāraka vyāpāra vaiphalyam ityam api ca kāraka pravṛttau tad vyāpāra anuparama prasaṅgaḥ kim hi tadā upalabhya kārakāṇi nivarteran kāryasya prāk upalabdha tvāt

atha mṛd piṇḍa rūpeṇa tadānīm ghaṭaḥ asti iti kathyate na tarhi asau tadānīm ghaṭaḥ asti mṛd piṇḍaḥ eva asau asti na hi anya rūpeṇa anyaḥ asti iti śakyate vaktum uṣṭraḥ api asan mṛd piṇḍa rūpeṇa asti iti syāt atha uṣṭra rūpam uttara kālam api na nirvartyate ghaṭaḥ tu tatas nirvartyate yadi evam yadā eva asau nirvartyate tadā eva asti na tatas pūrvam iti atha pūrvam śaktayā ātmanā tasya astitvam idīnīm abhivyakti ātmanā kriyate iti tat api anupapannam abhivyaktiḥ api tad svarūpāt bhinnā abhinnā vā satī asatī vā iti vikalpyamānā na pūrva uktam doṣam ativartate

kā ca iyam abhivyaktiḥ kim kārya ātmanā avasthānam atha saṃsthāna viśeṣaḥ uta pratītiḥ iti yadi kārya ātmanā avasthānam tat pūrvam na abhūt tad adhunā bhūtam iti asat kāryam pūrvam api vā yadi tadā āsīt tadā punar kāraka vaiphalyam saṃsthānam api avayava sanniveśa viśeṣaḥ sa ca āsan eva kriyate avayavāḥ tu santi iti kasya atra vivādaḥ na hi paramāṇavaḥ asmābhiḥ na aṅgīkṛtāḥ

pratītiḥ tu ghaṭasya cakṣuḥ ādi kāraka sāmagrī adhīnā na mṛd piṇḍa daṇḍa cakra ādi kāraka cakra sādhya iti sā cakra mūrdhani ghaṭasya na asti eva iti asan ghaṭaḥ darśana adarśana adhīne sat asat tve hi vastunaḥ dṛśyamyādarśanāt tena cakre kumbhasya na astitā cakra mūrdha vat pradhvaṃsa daśāyām api anupalambhāt ghaṭasya na astitvam eva iti atas ca na asataḥ vidyate bhāvaḥ na abhāvaḥ vidyate sataḥ iti apramāṇakam pūrva apara antayoḥ bhāva svarūpa adarśanāt

śakti ātmanā api yat astitvam asya ucyate atra api cintyam kā iyam śaktiḥ nāma iti yadi ghaṭa svarūpāt bhinnā asau tarhi para rūpeṇa ghaṭaḥ asti sva rūpeṇa ca na asti iti asat kāryam uktam syāt ghaṭāt abhinna tve tu śakteḥ śakti rūpeṇa ghaṭaḥ asti iti sva rūpeṇa eva ghaṭa astitvam uktam bhavet tat ca pratyakṣa virodhāt nirastam
asat karaṇa pakṣe ca yat ca uditam śaśa viṣāṇa ādi api kriyeta iti tat tu vacana vyakti aparijñānāt yat asat tat kriyate iti na iyam vacana vyaktiḥ api tu yat kriyate tat asat iti

svarūpa sahakārya ādi hetavaḥ yat vidhāyinaḥ dṛśyante janyate tat hi na vyoma kusuma ādikam prāc abhāva daśāyām ca hetu vyāpāra darśanam na tu pradhvaṃsa velāyām atas kam anuyuṃjmahe upādānam tu sarvasya yat na sarvatra dṛśyate tat na kāryasya sadbhāvāt api tu evam nirīkṣaṇāt adya tve vyavahāraḥ api na eva apūrvaḥ pravartate yathā upalabdhaḥ vṛddhebhyaḥ sa tathā eva anugamyate taila arthī sikatāḥ kaścid ādadānaḥ na dṛśyate adṛṣṭavā ca adya na anyaḥ api tad arthī tāsu dhāvati anvaya vyatirekau ca gṛhyete vyavahārataḥ anādiḥ ca eṣa saṃsāraḥ iti kasya anuyojya tā

athavā śakti niyamāt eva upādāna niyamaḥ upapatsyate śaktiḥ tu nityā sūkṣmā ca na iha kācid upeyate tad abhyupagame nityam kārya utpatti prasaktitaḥ kintu yogya tā avacchinna svarūpa sahakāri sannidhānam eva śaktiḥ sā eva iyam dvividhā śaktiḥ ucyate avasthitā āgantukī ca mṛd tvā ādi avacchinnam svarūpam avasthitā śaktiḥ āgantukī ca daṇḍa cakra ādi saṃga rūpā śakti dvaya kṛtā ca kārya niṣpattiḥ asakṛt dṛṣṭā iti tad arthibhiḥ tu tad upādānam yogya tā api na artha antaram kiṃcid kintu vastu viśeṣaḥ eva iti evam vastu viśeṣa niyamāt upādāna niyama siddheḥ na sat kāryam

na ca śaktiḥ eva kāryam iti vaktavyam kārya svarūpasya tatas pṛtha gbhūtasya pratītyā vyavasthāpanāt śakteḥ ca kāryatve kāryāt eva kārya utpādaḥ aṅgīkṛtaḥ syāt na ca ghaṭāt ghaṭaḥ utpattum arhati śakteḥ ca kāryam utpadyate iti abhyupagatam atas anyat kāryam anyā ca śaktiḥ

nanu vācya vācakayoḥ śabda arthayoḥ vyaṅgya vyaṃjakayoḥ ca dīpa ghaṭayoḥ ubhaya āśritā śaktiḥ dṛṣṭā iti kārya kāraṇayoḥ api asau ubhaya adhiṣṭhānā bhavitum arhati asati dvitīye kārya ākhye tad āśraye katham iyam ubhaya āśritā syāt iti na etat evam yathādarśanam śakteḥ abhyupagamāta na ca ekatra dṛṣṭam rūpam anyatra api mṛgyate vācya vācakayoḥ vyaṅgya vyajakayoḥ ca dvayoḥ pṛthaktvena darśanāt ubhaya āśritā śaktiḥ aṅgīkṛtā iti hetu dvayasya anupalambhāt kevala kāraṇa vattiḥ eva śaktiḥ tad kṛtaḥ ca upādāna niyamaḥ iti siddham

asat kārya pakṣaḥ eva upādāna niyama vicāraḥ yuktaḥ utpattau khalu siddhāyām upādānam vicāryate sataḥ tu na eva na asti iti kim upādāna cintayā satkārya vāde ca sutarām upādāna niyamaḥ durghaṭaḥ sarvasya sarvatra bhāvāt sikatā tila sarit tīra kedāra vyapta bīja niyata aṅkura ādi krama utpadyamāna tila svarūpa paryālocanayā tileṣu iva sikatāsu api taila saṃbhavāt sarvasya sarvatra ca astitve niyata padārtha pratiṣṭhita hāna upādāna ādi vyavahāra sakalaḥ eva viplaveta

api ca prāyaścittam eṣa tapasvī taptakṛcchram atikaṣṭam katham cariṣyati iti mahat mama manasi kāruṇyam annam ca tāvat ayam aśnāti anne ca varcaḥ asti iti viṣ bhakṣaṇāt prāyaścittīyate eva ayam iti alam satkārya vāda pramādena

yat punar abhāṇi kāraṇa anupamardena kārya anutpādāt abhāvāt bhāva utpattiḥ bhavet tatra ca anantara vṛtti utpatti niyamaḥ na syāt iti tat api ayuktam mūrtānām samāna deśa ṛtva avarodhāt kārya kāraṇayoḥ eka deśa tvam na iṣyate na etāvatā bhāva utpattiḥ abhāvāt bhavitum arhati kāraṇa adhīna tad utpāda darśanāt atas eva ānantarya niyamaḥ api upapannaḥ na ca kārya kāraṇayoḥ abhedāt sat kāryam iti vaktavyam tayoḥ pratyakṣa siddha bhinna svarūpa tvāt

yat tu niralambanā kāraka pravṛttiḥ iti coditam parihṛtam tat bhāṣya kāreṇa buddhi siddham tu tat asat iti vṛddha vyavahārataḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāvām avagamya amuṣmāt kāraṇāt idam īdṛśam kāryam utpadyate iti buddhau nirdhārya kārakāṇi kartā niyuṅkte iti na nirviṣayaḥ kāraka vyāpāraḥ tat evam satkārya vādasya niṣpramāṇaka tvāt tad mūla anvaya ādi hetu sidhya bhāvāt na pradhāna astitva siddhiḥ tad abhāvāt ca na tad vikṛtiḥ nitya abuddhiḥ api tu jñāna upalabdhi rūpā eva iti samyak sūtritam buddhiḥ upalabdhi rjñānam iti anartha antaram iti

itas ca anityā buddhiḥ jānāmi jñāsyāmi ajñāsiṣam iti upajanana apāya dharma tayā pāka ādi vat kāla traye api prakāśamāna tvāt jñāna vyatiriktāyāḥ ca buddheḥ apratibhāsāt ayam tu viśeṣaḥ pāka ādi kriyāṇām odana ādi phala avaccheda dvārakam kāla vaitatyam api bhavati upalabdheḥ tu vastu svarūpa prakāśana mātra parisamāpta prayojanāyāḥ kāla vetatyam na asti eva atas eva anitya tve api utpanna apavargiṇīm eva buddhim ācakṣate śabda vat na ghaṭa ādi vat kāla antara sthā yinīm iti

sā ca iyam buddhiḥ ātma antaḥkaraṇa śabda dīpa indriya artha ādi aneka kāraka kalāpa kāryā api satī na bāhyena bāhya karmaṇi samavaiti na bāhya karaṇe cakṣuḥ ādau na antaḥkaraṇe manasi kintu kartari eva kartā api ca nityaḥ vibhuḥ ātmā na bhūta saṅghāta svabhāvaḥ kāryaḥ tasyāḥ āśrayaḥ iti ātma parīkṣāyām nirṇītam guṇa tvam api ca asyāḥ tatra eva darśitam

nanu evam tarhi na buddheḥ anitya tvam vināśa kāraṇa abhāvāt dvividhaḥ hi guṇānām vināśa hetuḥ āśraya vināśaḥ virodhi guṇa prādurbhāvaḥ vā na iha āśraya vināśa nitya tvāt ātmanaḥ na ca virodhinam asyāḥ kam cit ruṇam upalabhāmahe na śabda vat āśu vināśi tvāt nitya ākāśa guṇaḥ api śabdaḥ śabda antaram ārabhya yathā vinaśyati tathā buddhiḥ buddhi antaram ārabhya vinaśyati iti tathā darśanāt kalpyate yāvān ca kaścana vināśa darśana bheda upalambha ādiḥ śabdasya anitya tāyām nyāya uktaḥ sa sarvaḥ api buddhau api yojanīyaḥ

atas eva na buddhīnām eka pramātṛ vṛttīnām yaugapadya vidyate varṇānām iva eka vaktṛ prayuktānām vinaśyadavinaśyat daśayoḥ tu buddhyoḥ āśu vināśi tve api yaugapadyam anubhavāt abhyupeya taiti alam ati vistareṇa buddheḥ anitya tāyām ca prāyeṇa sarva vādinām avivādaḥ tathā ca āha jaiminiḥ sat saṃprayoge puruṣasya indriyāṇām buddhi janma tat pratyakṣam iti
acira ruci vat tasmāt buddhiḥ nisarga vinaśvarī bhavati janakaḥ sva ātmā tasyāḥ saḥ eva samāśrayaḥ bhava maru bhavaiḥ tāpaiḥ yā jātam eva yunakti sā vyasana jananīm jahyāt enām parama artha vid
yugapad jñāna anutpattiḥ manasaḥ liṅgam manasaḥ yat eva sattve pramāṇam tad gamya tvam eva asya lakṣaṇam samāna itara jātīya vyavaccheda kāritvāt

nanu manasaḥ indriya tvāt tad vargaḥ eva paṭhanam yuktam kimarthaḥ ayam pṛthak nirdeśaḥ na dharma bhedāt bhautikāni indriyāṇi niyata viṣayāṇi sa guṇānām ca eṣām indriya bhāvaḥ manaḥ tu na bhautikam na niyata viṣayam na ca asya sa guṇasya indriya bhāvaḥ iti

tat ca na bhautikam akārya tvāt atas eva na tad guṇa yogi na ca niyata viṣayam sarva viṣaya tvam tu asya sakala bāhya indriyāṇām adhiṣṭhātṛ tvat tad anadhigamya sukha ādi viṣaya grāhi tvāt ca bāhya indriyāṇi hi manaḥ a dhiṣṭhitāni sva viṣayeṣu pravartitum utsahante cakṣuḥ ādīni na anyathā kasmāt evam iti ced yugapad jñāna anutpatteḥ uttara kālam ca bāhya indriya vyāpāra virahe api tad artha avamarśāt asti eka indriya gamyeṣu kvacid jāti guṇa ādiṣu vijñāna ayaugapadyam yat manasaḥ tat na sādhanam tatra viṣaya ādi doṣeṇa dūra tva ādinā jāti ādeḥ yugapad gṛhītum aśakyatvāt

yat tu nānā indriya grāhyeṣu yugapad sannihiteṣu api gandha rasa rūpa ādiṣu viṣayeṣu tad grahaṇeṣu ca sva kārya anumita sannidhāneṣu satsu api avikaleṣu kāraṇeṣu yugapad upalabdhayaḥ na bhavanti tatas avasīyate nūnam kāraṇān daram ebhiḥ apekṣyate tat ca manaḥ iti ākhyāyate

nanu ca sugandhi śītalām dīrghām aśnantaḥ śuṣka śaṣkulīm kapila brāhmaṇāḥ santi yugapad paṃca buddhayaḥ api ca ayam khalu adhyāpakaḥ adhīte vrajati kamaṇḍalum dhārayati panthānam paśyati śṛṇoti araṇya jān śabdān bibhyat vyāla liṅgāni bubhutsate iti krama agrahaṇāt yugapad etāḥ buddhayaḥ asya bhavanti iti na āśu utpatteḥ sūcī agra bhidyamāna kokanada daḷa kadamba kāla vat ati sūkṣma tvāt kālasya kramaḥ tatra na vibhāvyate bhavitavyam tu tena iti

yadi kāraṇa antara nirapekṣa cakṣuḥ ādi karaṇa sādhyāḥ eva rūpa ādi viṣaya upalabdhayaḥ tad uttara kālam upahata karaṇānām api katham smaraṇa ādi rūpaḥ tad avamarśaḥ atas nūnam nayana ādi vat karaṇa antaram avikalam tat grāhi vidyate

avyāpakam ca tat vyāpi tve na hi buddhīnām yaugapadyam nivartate asti ca ayam vyavahāraḥ ukte api kyacit vacasi kaścid āha na aham etat aśrauṣama anyatra me manaḥ abhūt iti tasmāt na vyāpakam manaḥ pratiśarīram ekam ca tad aneka tve punar api jñāna yaugapadyān apāyāt kriyāvat ca tat niṣkriyeṇa indriyāṇām adhiṣṭhātum aśakyatvāt

mūrta ca tat amūrtasya kriyā anupapatteḥ mūrta tve sati nityam ca tat niravayavat tvāt anāśrita tvāt ca murta tvam tu anitya tā āyām aprayojakam iti vakṣyāmaḥ niravayavam ca tad avayava kalpanāyām pramāṇa abhāvāt vegavat ca tad āśu saṃcārāt āśu saṃcāram antareṇa upalabdhi śaighryasya dṛṣṭasya anupapatteḥ

indriya saṃyogi ca tat dravya tvāt dravyam ca tat vega ādi guṇa yogāt kriyāvat tvāt anāśrita tvāt ca acetanam ca tat kāraṇa tvāt itarathāḥ hi ekatra śarīre cetana dvaya samāveśāt avyavahāraḥ syāt iti tasmāt evaṃrūpam manaḥ sāṅkhya uktam su tasya rūpam ayuktam iti tad prakriyā niṣedhāt eva vyākhyātam

anyāni api smṛti anumāna āgama saṃśaya pratibhāsvapnoha jñānāni āntara sukha duḥkha icchā dveṣa ādi viṣaya grāhīṇi ca jñānāni manasaḥ liṅgāni santi eva teṣām bāhya indriya vyāpāra sādhya tva asaṃbhavāt karaṇa rahitāyāḥ ca kriyā abhinivṛtteḥ adarśanāt iti

smṛtiḥ tāvat manaḥ janyā eva anumāna āgama jñānam tu parokṣa artha viṣayat tvāt mānasam saṃśayaḥ tu mānasaḥ api kaścid vakṣyate pratibhā manāsī darśitā eva śvas me bhrātā aagantā iti svapna jñānam uparata indriya grāmasya bhavat katham nāma na mānasam tarkaḥ api saṃśaya vat kvacid viṣaye mānasaḥ bhavati eva sukha ādīnām tu jñapti vat utpattiḥ api manaḥ nibandhana eva kāryaṇām ātma guṇānām utpattau pratyāsanna kāraṇa antara saṃbhave api ātma mana ssaṃyogasya avadhṛta sāmarthyasya asamavāyi kāraṇa tvāt atas ca viṣaya anubhava janye api sukha ādau manassaṃyogaḥ kāraṇam sukha ādīnām ca bodha svarūpa tvam sva saṃvedya tvam ca nirastam atas tad upalabdhau manasaḥ eva kāraṇa tā

tat idam manaḥ pūrva kṛta śubha aśubha karma saṃkāravatā aatmanā tad vaśāt eva śarīra deśe saṃyogam pratipadyate tatra eva ca jīvana vyavahāraḥ vipacyamāna karma āśaya sahitaḥ ātma mana ssaṃyogaḥ jīvanam iti hi vadanti saṃyuktaṃca ātmanā manaḥ teṣu teṣu upapatti sthāneṣu nānāvidha bhoga sādhana tayā saṃsāra kāraṇam bhavati nitya tvāt ātma manasoḥ anādi tvāt ca saṃsārasya na idam codanīyam prathamam eva katham ātma manasossaṃyogaḥ iti na hi prathamaḥ nāma kaścid kālaḥ samasti ādisargasya api pūrva sarga sāpekṣa tvāt īśvaraḥ api hi karma apekṣaḥ eva vicitrasya jagataḥ sraṣṭā iti nirṇītam etat iti kṛtam vistareṇa vidadhat sukha ādi bhogam vahat ca tarala indriya aśvasārathitām bandha nimittam manaḥ iti manasvinā yatnataḥ heyam

pravṛttiḥ vāc buddhi śarīra ārambhaḥ vāc iti varṇa ātmaka śabda kāraṇa saṃyoga ādi ucyate na indriyam iti vyākhyātam buddhiḥ iti manaḥ iha ucyate na upalabdhiḥ śarīram prasiddham teṣām ārambhaḥ vyāpāraḥ taiḥ vā ārambhaḥ iti sarvathā tadīya kriyā pravṛttiḥ iti ucyate

sā ca dvividhā puṇyā pāpikā ca tatra pāpikā vācā caturvidhā manasā trividhā śarīreṇa trividhā eva iti daśavidhā vācā pravṛttiḥ tatra anṛta paruṣa sūcanā sambaddha vacana rūpā caturvidhā para droha para dravya abhilāṣa na āstikyā anuvyāna rūpā trividhā manasā pravṛttiḥ hiṃsā steya pratiṣiddha maithuna ācaraṇa rūpā trividhā śarīreṇa pravṛttiḥ maithuna grahaṇam evaṃprakāra surā pāna ādi upalakṣaṇa artham sā iyam daśavidhā pravṛttiḥ anavaratam abhijvalataḥ niratiśaya duḥkha vedanā dāyinaḥ naraka analasya indhanam

puṇyā api satya priya hita vacana svādhyāya adhyayana rūpā caturvidhā vācā pravṛttiḥ japa yajñe hi svādhyāya pāṭhaḥ eva upāṃśunā anta ssaṃjalpena vā aspṛhā anukampā para loka śraddhā ātmikā trividhā manasā pravṛttiḥ dāna paritrāṇa paricaraṇa rūpā trividhā śarīreṇa pravṛttiḥ iti iyam api darśavidhā eva eṣā ca svarga sadana dvāra sopāna kalpā

sā iyam ubhayatas viṃśati bhedā pravṛttiḥ saṃkṣepataḥ dvividhā eva vidhi niṣedha ātmaka tad avagama upāya bhedāt vidhi niṣedha avagama śaraṇaḥ eva hi sat asat karma avagamaḥ tatra vihita anuṣṭhānam svargāya niṣiddha ācaraṇam narakāya iti evam sukha duḥkha upabhoga sthāna śarīra indriya ādi abhisamba dhani bandhanam eṣā pravṛttiḥ bhavantī saṃsārasya paramam kāraṇam bhavati

yaḥ hi ayam deva manuṣya tiryagyoniṣu śarīra saṃsargaḥ yaḥ ca prativiṣayam buddhi saṃsargaḥ yaḥ ca ātmanā saha manasassaṃsargaḥ sa sarvaḥ pravṛtteḥ eva pariṇāma vibhavaḥ vṛtteḥ ca sarvasyāḥ kriyā tvāt kṣaṇika tve api tad upagataḥ dharma adharma śabda vācyaḥ ātma saṃskāraḥ karma phala upabhoga paryanta sthitiḥ asti eva na ca phalam adattvā dharma adharmau kṣīyete antya sukha duḥkha saṃvid virodhinau hi dharma adharmau udāharanti na ca jagati tathāvidham kim api kāryam asti vastu yat na dharma adharma abhyām anākṣipta saṃbhavam iti tad ucchede mumukṣuṇā yatnaḥ āstheyaḥ iti vitanutaḥ puṇya apuṇya pravṛtti samudbhavau nigala vat imau dharma adhamau rujam bhava bandhane yadi niravadheḥ duḥkhasya antam cikīrṣasi sarvathā parihara manaḥ vāc kāyānām pravṛttim anargalām
pravartanā lakṣaṇāḥ doṣāḥ pravartanā pravṛttim prati prayojaka tā sā lakṣaṇam yeṣām iti pravartanā lakṣaṇāḥ doṣāḥ doṣa prayuktaḥ hi puruṣaḥ puṇye karmaṇi pāpe vā pravartate

nanu pratyātma vedanīya tayā doṣāṇām sva rūpam aparokṣam eva tat kim artham eṣām lakṣaṇataḥ rūpam nirūpyate satyam pratyātma vehanīya tve api yat eṣām pravartanā lakṣaṇa tvam upadiśyate tat anena rūpeṇa saṃsāra kāraṇa tva jñāpana artham dharma adharma nirmitaḥ hi śarīra ādi duḥkha adhiṣṭhāna saṃbandhaḥ tad bījasya ca karmaṇaḥ kāraṇam doṣāḥ karmaṇi pumāṃsam pravartayantaḥ bhavanti iti pravartanā lakṣaṇāḥ iti uktāḥ para santāna vartinām doṣāṇām apratyakṣa tvāt tat pratītaye pravartana ālakṣaṇattva kathanam iti tu apavyākhyānam alpa prayojanaka tvāt iti

teṣām doṣāṇām trayaḥ rāśayaḥ bhavanti rāgaḥ dveṣaḥ mohaḥ iti tatra anukūleṣu artheṣu abhilāṣa lakṣaṇaḥ rāgaḥ pratikūleṣu asahana lakṣaṇaḥ dveṣaḥ vastu pāramārthya apariccheda lakṣaṇaḥ mithyā adhyavasāyaḥ mohaḥ
nanu ca īrṣyā asūyā lobha māna mada matsara ādi doṣa antara saṃbhavāt katham trayaḥ eva doṣāḥ na īrṣi ā ādīnām yathā nirdiṣṭeṣu eva antar bhāvāt

kāmaḥ matsaraḥ spṛhā tṛṣṇā lobhaḥ iti paṃca prakāraḥ rāga pakṣaḥ strī saṃyoga icchā kāmaḥ yat anyasmai nivedyamānam api vastu dhana vat na kṣīyate tad aparityāga icchā matsaraḥ anātmīyavaḥ tu āditsā spṛhā punarbhava prati sandhāna hetu bhūta icchā tṛṣṇā niṣiddha dravya grahaṇa icchā lobhaḥ iti abhilāṣa prakāra bhedāt rāga pakṣaḥ eva ayam

dveṣapakṣaḥ api paṃcavidhaḥ krodha īrṣyā asūyā drohaḥ amarṣaḥ iti akṣi bhvra ādi vikāra hetuḥ prajvalana ātmakaḥ krodhaḥ sādhāraṇe api vastuni parasya darśana ādya sahanam īrṣyā para guṇeṣu akṣamāḥ asūyā para apakāraḥ drohaḥ adarśita mukha ādi vikāraḥ param prati manyuḥ amarṣaḥ iti asahana prakāra bhedāt eṣa dveṣapakṣaḥ

mohapakṣaḥ tu caturvidhaḥ mithyājñānam vicikitsā mānaḥ pramādaḥ iti atasmin tat iti jñānam mithyājñānam kim svid iti vimarśaḥ vicikitsā asat guṇa adhyāropeṇa sva utkarṣa buddhiḥ mānaḥ kiyat etat iti avajñayā kartavyā karaṇam pramādaḥ saḥ eva madaḥ iti ākhyāyate saḥ ayam tattva aparijñāna prakāra bhedāt mohapakṣaḥ

evam trayaḥ eva ete doṣāḥ śoka haṣau tu sukha duḥkhe ucyete na doṣa antaram teṣām tu mohaḥ pāpatamaḥ itarayoḥ tu tad adhīna ātma lābha tvāt mūḍhasya hi rāga dveṣau bhavataḥ mithyā saṃkalpāt utpadyamānayoḥ anubhavāt ku saṃkalpaḥ ca mithyājñāna prakṛtiḥ evam mithyājñānasya eva bhagavataḥ sarvam idam vilasitam yaḥ ayam aneka prakāraḥ saṃsāra duḥkha bhāraḥ

yadi evam na tarhi mohasya doṣa tvam doṣa kāraṇa tvāt iti na tad lakṣaṇā napāyāt sati api doṣa antara hetu tve svayam api puruṣa pravṛtti prayojaka tva lakṣaṇa yogāt rāga vat doṣa tvam na mohaḥ api jahāti te ime doṣāḥ saṃsāra hetavaḥ iti yatnataḥ śamanīyāḥ

katham punar amī śamayitum śakyāḥ uktam atra na akasmikāḥ na nityāḥ na ajñāta śamana upāyāḥ na ca aśakya pratikriyā iti vistarataḥ ca etat apavarga āhnike parokṣyate mithyājñāna nimittāḥ khalu ete doṣāḥ tasmin samyak jñāna prabhāva nihate hetoḥ abhāvāt na bhavanti eva iti

nanu evam prasava vināśa kāraṇayoḥ eka tvāt ekaḥ eva doṣaḥ bhavet iti tritvam hīyeta na anubhava siddha bheda tvāt anubhūyate hi rāga dveṣa mohānām itaretara vibhaktam sva rūpam kāraṇa eka tvam tu na prayojakam ekasmāt eva jvalana saṃyogāt utpadyamānānām vinaśyatām ca pārthiva padārtha vṛttīnām gandharasa rūpa sparśānām nānātva darśanāt atas sūktam doṣaṇām trairāśyam iti saṃsāra kāra abhavana praveśa mārgāḥ te ete trayaḥ eva doṣāḥ eṣām prahāṇa udyamam ādadhānaḥ na janma mṛtyū punar abhyupaiti

punar utpattiḥ pretyabhāvaḥ kasya iyam punar utpattiḥ ucyate ātmanaḥ śarīrasya vā tatra ātmanaḥ nitya tvāt utpattiḥ eva na asti kā kathā punar śabda arthasya śarīrasya tu utpattiḥ asti na tu paunaḥpunyena na hi mṛtam śarīram tat eva punar utpadyate tasmāt punar utpattiḥ pretyabhāvaḥ iti avācakam sūtram ucyate punar śabda arthasya yatnatas upadiṣṭasya parihartum aśakyatvāt tasya eva nirveda utpāda dvāraka apavarga upayoga yogya upadeśa tvāt ātmanaḥ ca sthāyi tvena kriyā abhyāvṛtti saṃbhavāt tasya eva punar punar utpatti brūmaḥ utpatti vat maraṇam api saḥ ayam ātmanaḥ eva mṛtvā punarjanma pretyabhāvaḥ iti

nanu janma maraṇe ubhe api nitya tvāt ātmanaḥ na saṃstaḥ iti uktam satyam śarīra ādi saṃyoga viyogayoḥ tu tathā abhidhānāt na doṣaḥ maraṇam ātmanaḥ bhoga āyatana deha indriya ādi viyogaḥ ucyate janma tu tad saṃbandhaḥ te ete vipacyamāna karma āśaya anurūpeṇa deha indriya ādi tyāgopādāne eva maraṇa janmanī kriyā abhyāvṛttyā bhavantī pretyabhāvaḥ iti ucyate saḥ eva ca saṃsāraḥ tat ittham anudhyāyataḥ kasya sacetasaḥ nirvedaḥ na udiyāt tat uktam jarā viyoga maraṇa vyādhayaḥ tāvat āsatām janma eva kim na dhīrasya bhūyas bhūyastra pākaram

atha yaiḥ utpadyamānaiḥ deha indriya ādibhiḥ ātmanaḥ saṃbandhaḥ teṣām katham utpattiḥ iti uktam sūtra kṛtā vyaktāt vyaktānām utpattiḥ pratyakṣa prāmāṇyāt iti vyaktāt iti kāpila abhyupagata triguṇa ātmaka avyakta rūpa kāraṇa niṣedhena paramāṇūnām śarīra ādau kārye kāraṇa tvam āha tathā hi pārthivam āpyam taijasam vāyavīyam iti caturvidham idam kāryam sva avayava āśritam upalabhyate tatra yathā ghaṭaḥ sa avayavaḥ kapāleṣu āśritaḥ evam kapālāni api sāvayava tvāt tad avayaveṣu tad avayavāḥ api tad avayava antareṣu iti evam tāvat yāvat paramāṇavaḥ niravayavāḥ iti yatra yāvataḥ kārya jātasya sva avayava āśritasya pratyakṣeṇa grahaṇam tatra tat eva pramāṇam tatas ūrdhvam anumānam

tat api hi kāryam sva avayava āśritam sāvayava tvāt paridṛśyamāna kārya vat niravaya tve tu tasya parama aṇu tvam eva paramāṇuṣu ca sāvayava tvasya ca hetoḥ asiddha tvāt na avayava antara kalpanā teṣām hi sāvayava tve tad avayavāḥ paramāṇavaḥ bhaveyuḥ na te utpatti krama vat vināśa krameṇa api paramāṇavaḥ anumīyante loṣṭasya pravibhajyamānasya bhāgāḥ tad bhāgānām ca bhāga antarāṇi iti evam tāvat yāvat aśakya bhaṅga tvam adarśana viṣaya tvam ca bhavati tat yatas param a vayava vibhāgaḥ na saṃbhavati te paramāṇavaḥ ucyante teṣu api hi vibhajyamāneṣu tad avayavāḥ paramāṇavaḥ bhaveyuḥ na te tat etat evam utpatti krama vat vināśa kramasya īdṛśaḥ darśanāt santi paramāṇavaḥ

atra hi trayī gatiḥ asya ghaṭa ādeḥ kāryasya niravayava tvam eva vā avayava ānantyam vā paramāṇu anta tā vā tatra niravayava tvam anupapannam avayavānām paṭe tantūnām ghaṭe ca kapālānām pratyakṣam upalambhāt ananta avayava yogi tvam api na yuktam meru sarṣapayoḥ ananta avayava yogi tva aviśeṣeṇa tulya parimāṇa tva prasaṅgāt tasmāt paramāṇu anta tā eva yuktimatī

te ime paramāṇavaḥ cetanā icchā preraṇam antareṇa viśiṣṭa kramakam itarā itara saṅghaṭanam alabhamānāḥ kārya siddhaye na paryāpnuyuḥ acetana tvāt iti cetanaḥ eṣām adhiṣṭhānā sakala bhuvana nirmāṇa nipuṇa matiḥ īśvaraḥ abhyupagataḥ tat si ddhaye ca sakala kutarka timira tiraskāra pūrvakam pūrvam eva niravadyam anumānam upapāditam īśvaraḥ api na aneka ātma vṛtti vipāka unmukha dharma adharma saṃskāra vaicitryam ananurudhyamānaḥ vicitrasya jagataḥ janma nirmātum arhati iti etat api darśitam

na ca sakṛt eva sarve nirvartyamāna kārya parimāṇa anuguṇa saṅkhyāḥ paramāṇavaḥ ekatra saṃyojya kāryam ārabhante kintu dvi aṇuka ādi prakrameṇa sakṛt ārambhe hi kumbhe bhajyamāne kapāla śarkarā kaṇa cūrṇa ādi kramam apahāya prathamam eva paramāṇu anta tā bhavet sarva saṃyogasya sarva vibhāgena sahasā eva vināśāt atas ca karpara ādi krama darśanam virudhyeta avinaṣṭe api paṭa ādau tantu ādi avayava āśrita tvam upalabhyamānam katham vā samarthyeta paramāṇūnām apratyakṣa tvena tad āśrita tvasya grahītum aśakyatvāt paramāṇūnām ghaṭasya ca madhye kārya antara anārambhāt iti tasmāt dvi aṇuka ādi prakrameṇa paramāṇavaḥ kāryam ārabhante

nanu dvādveva paramāṇū prathamam saṃghaṭete iti atra kā yuktiḥ ucyate bahutva saṃkhyāyāḥ mahat parimāṇa kāraṇa tva darśanāt triṣu paramāṇuṣu prathamam milatsu tad kārye bahu tva saṃkhyāyāḥ mahat tva ārambhaka tvāt tad pratyakṣa tvam prasajyeta na ca tad pratyakṣa tvam ati sūkṣma tvāt atas dvābhyām paramāṇubhyām dvi aṇukam ādau utpadyate

tat ca paramāṇu vat a pratyakṣam eva mahattva anutpādāt dvi aṇuka dvayena tu kārya ārambhaḥ iṣyamāṇe tad aviśeṣa prasaṅgaḥ dvi aṇukaḥ iva tatra api mahat tva utpattau kāraṇa abhāvāt atas tribhiḥ dvi aṇukaiḥ tri aṇukam ārabhyate tatra ca bahu tva saṃkhyayā mahat tvam api ārapsyate pratyakṣa tvam ca bhaviṣyati tatas param tu krama sāmānye pramāṇam asti loṣṭa ādi bhaṅge sva avayava khaṇḍa avayava darśa nam krama viśeṣe tu pramāṇam na asti ittham ārambhaḥ iti yatra vā darśanam asti tatra tat astu krama viśeṣe pramāṇam iti

ārabhya ārambhaka tvam na iṣyate mūrtānām samāna deśa tva virodhāt na hi paramāṇavaḥ prathamam kāryam ārabhya tadanu te eva uttarottara kālam kāryāṇi āra bhante kintu yat paramāṇu nirvṛttam kārya dvi aṇukam tat kārya antarasya ārambhakam tat api anyasya kāryaṇya iti evam tāvat yāvat paripūrṇa avayavi niṣpattiḥ ittham ca tantubhiḥ paṭaḥ kriyate na tantu avayavaiḥ aṃśubhiḥ itarathā hi uttarottara kārya ārambhe api pūrva pūrva kāraṇān apāyāt mūrtānām eka deśa tvam syāt na ca tat dṛśyate iti yathā uktaḥ eva kramaḥ śreyān t a d e v a m a n e k ā t m a samaveta dharma adharma saṃskāra paripāka anurūpa prasarat īśvara icchā preryamāṇa paramāṇu kriyā ānupūrvī nirvartyamāna dvi aṇuka ādi kārya prakrameṇa śarīra ādi a vayavi nivṛttiḥ iti sthitam

etad viparītāni tu mata antarāṇi pramāṇa viruddhāni tathā hi nityam eva śarīra ādi anutpatti dharmakam iti pratyakṣa viruddham pṛthivī ādeḥ api avayava sanniveśa viśiṣṭa tvāt kāryatvam īśvara siddhau nirṇītam ākasmika tvam api śarīra ādeḥ kāryasya na yuktam kāraṇa niyama upalambhāt animittāyāḥ ca bhāva utpatteḥ anupapatteḥ

abhāvāt bhāva utpattiḥ api tādṛś eva triguṇa ātmaka pradhāna vikāra mahat ahaṅkāra ādi kāraṇaka tvam api kāryasya pṛthivī ādeḥ prāk eva pratiṣiddham anārabdha avayavi rūpa kāryāḥ paramāṇavaḥ eva ete saṃcaya viśiṣṭāssantaḥ lokayātrām vahanti iti etat api na samīcīnam saṃcayasya bheda abheda vikalpābhyām anupapadyamāna tvāt paramāṇūnām ca ati saukṣmyāt apratyakṣa tvāt

paudgalika kārya pakṣe api paryāya antareṇa paramāṇūnām kathanam apramāṇaka tvam vā śabda vivarta tvam tad anugama agrahaṇāt anupapannam paramātma upādāna tvam api na saṃbhavati tasya eva niṣpramāṇaka tvāt na ca na kadācid anīdṛśam jagat iti pāda prasārikā mātram kartum ucitam sarga pralaya prabandhasya samarthita tvāt iti

atas ca pakṣa antara durbala tvāt yathā uditaḥ siddhyati bhūta sargaḥ tam yaḥ tu paśyan api nihnuvīt tasmai namaḥ paṇḍita śekharāya anādau saṃsāre sthitam idam aho mūḍha manasām janitvā jantūnām maraṇam atha mṛtvā api jananam iyam sā duḥkhānām saraṇiḥ iti saṃcintya kṛtinā nidhātavyam cetaḥ janana maraṇa ucchedini pade

pravṛtti doṣa janitaḥ arthaḥ phalam pravṛtti doṣāḥ tu vyākhyātāḥ tat janitaḥ arthaḥ phalam iti ucyate artha pada grahaṇam gauṇa mukhya bheda pradarśana artham sukha duḥkhe mukhyam phalam tad sādhanam tu śarīra indriya viṣaya ādi gauṇam sarvam hi idam pravṛtti doṣa ākṣiptam phalam iti uktam tat idam anādinā prabandhena pravartamānam phalam punar punar upabhujyate iti mahataḥ khedasya hetuḥ iti bhāvyamānam nirveda vairāgya ādi mārgeṇa apavarga upayogi tām pratipadyate ātta māttam vijahataḥ tyaktam tyaktam ca gṛhṇataḥ puṃsaḥ phala ghaṭīyantram aho kaṣṭaḥ pariśramaḥ

tat punar phalam karmaṇā kim sadyas eva saṃpadyate kāla antareṇa vā ucyate dvividham karma vihitam niṣiddham ca tatra vidhi phalānām kāla niyamaḥ na asti kriyā phalam hi dogdhi pacati iti samanantaram utpadyamānam dṛśyate vidhi phalānām tu na eva niyamaḥ iti śabda parīkṣāyām citra ākṣepa parihāra avasare nirūpitam etat

vidhi phalam apiḥ ca kiṃcana codanā vacana paryālocanayā sadyas iti niścīyate vṛṣṭiḥ iva kārīryāḥ kiṃcid aihika phalam api karma vastu balāt kāla antara apekṣam bhavati putra iṣṭi ādi na hi sahasā eva nidhi lābha vat putra lābhaḥ saṃbhavati garbha saṃbhava hetu bhūta bhāryā parirambhaṇa ādi krama apekṣa tvāt jyotiṣṭoma ādi tu svarga phalam karma phala svarūpa mahimnā eva pāralaukika phalam avartiṣṭhate svargaḥ hi niratiśayā prītiḥ tad anyathā anupapatti parikalpitaḥ kanaka giri śikhara ādiḥ vā bhoga deśaḥ ubhayathā api na etat deha upabhoga yogya tām pratipadyate aniyata phalam tu citra ādi kaiścid uktam tat ca yuktam ayuktam iti vā tatra eva parīkṣitam

niṣiddhasya tu karmaṇaḥ sarvasya eva prāyeṇa para loke eva phalam para dāra abhimarṣaṇa ādau hi kriyā phalam surata sukha ādi sadyas phalam niṣedha vidhi phalam tu naraka patanam pāralaukikam svarga vat narakasya api niratiśaya duḥkha ātmanaḥ tad anyathā anupapati parikalpita deśa svabhāvasya vai etat śarīrān upa bhoga yogya tvāt tīvra saṃvega nirvṛttam tu karma vihitam itarat vā pratyāsanna vipākam iha eva bhavati nandīśvara nahuṣayoḥ iva iti āgama vidaḥ cora brahma ghna ādayaḥ ca kecid pratyāsanna pratyavāyāḥ prāyeṇa dṛśyante eva iti evam eṣām vicitraḥ karmaṇām vipākaḥ

yat api ca ucyate karma kāle phalam na asti phala kāle karma na asti kāla antare ca phalasya anyat pratyakṣam kāraṇam upalabhyate sevā ādikam iti tat api pūrvam parihṛtam karmaṇām vināśe api tat janitasya ātma saṃskārasya dharma adharma śabda vācyasya bhāvāt dṛṣṭasya ca sevā ādeḥ kāraṇasya vyabhicārāt adṛṣṭa kalpanāyāḥ avaśyaṃbhāvi tvāt

dharma ādeḥ ātma ni samavāyāt phalasya ca putra paśu ādeḥ anyatra samaveta tvāt bhinna adhikaraṇa tvam karma phalayoḥ iti api na codyam mukhyasya sukha duḥkha ātmanaḥ phalasya bhinna āśraya tva anupapatteḥ sukha duḥkhe hi ātmani vartete dharma adharmau ca tad sthau eva iti dṛṣṭam na eva sukhasya kāraṇam atas tad hetu rāgeṇa kim duḥkhasya api na tad nibandhanam iti dveṣaḥ tad artheṣu kaḥ tasmāt karma nimittakam phalam iti dhyāyan na kuryāt kṛtī saṅgam karmaṇi yena dustaram asau saṃsāram āpadyate

bādhanā lakṣaṇam duḥkham bādhanā pīḍanam santāpanam sā lakṣaṇam asya iti bādhanā lakṣaṇam duḥkham tatra mukhye duḥkhe lakṣye lakṣaṇa śabdaḥ yathāśrutaḥ eva bādhanayā eva hi duḥkha svarūpam lakṣyate bādhayati duḥkhayati iti gauṇe tu duḥkhe śarīra ādau lakṣye bādhanā lakṣaṇam bādhana anuṣaktam iti vyākhyeyam

nanu pūrva sūtra vyākhyātena phala grahaṇena eva duḥkhasya upadiṣṭa tvāt kim artha punar upadeśaḥ sukha pratyākhyana arthaḥ iti ced na pūrva apara virodhāt sakala prāṇabhṛt anubhava sākṣika tvena ca sukhasya pratyākhyātum aśakyatvāt tad pratyākhyāne ca vivakṣite kim artham prameya sūtre phala pada upādānam phale khalu sukha duḥkhe iti vyākhyātam tatas ca sukhe pratyākhyāte duḥkham eva avaśiṣyate tat ca anena duḥkha śabdena eva nirdiṣṭam iti kim phala grahaṇena

ucyate na sukha leśasya saṃsāre jantubhiḥ antarā antarā anubhūyamānasya pratyākhyānāya duḥkha grahaṇam kintu sarvatra tathātva bhāvanā upadeśa artham saḥ api hi sukha lavaḥ duḥkham eva iti bhāvayitavyaḥ tad sādhananam api sarvam duḥkham eva iti mantavyam na tad vyavasitam puṃsām na tat karma na tad vacaḥ na tad bhogyam samasti iha yat na duḥkhāya jāyate

tat ittham duḥkham utkṛṣṭam tiraścām madhyamam manuṣyāṇām hīnam devānām hīnataram vīta rāgāṇām iti āgama vidaḥ vīta rāgāṇām duḥkha tānavam yuktitaḥ api avagamyate duḥkhasya rāga nibandhana tvāt tattvataḥ cintyamānam hi sarvam duḥkham vivekinaḥ viṣa saṃpṛkta madhu vat sukham duḥkhībhavati adaḥ sukha adhigama lobhena yatamānaḥ hi puruṣaḥ sahasra śākham āpnoti duḥkham eva tad arjane evam sarvam idam duḥkham iti bhāvayataḥ aniśam sarva upapatti sthāneṣu nirvedaḥ asya pravartate nirviṇṇasya ca vairāgyam viraktasya ca dehinaḥ kleśa karma prahāṇa ādi dvāraḥ niḥśreyasa udayaḥ

nanu evam tarhi phala grahaṇam na kartavyam duḥkha padena eva gata artha tvāt iti uktam mā evam tasya anya prayojana tvāt pravṛtti doṣa janita tvena sukha duḥkhe bhāvayitavye abhyāsena ca vartamāne iti karma doṣa janita tvena hi phalam anucintayataḥ tad kāraṇayoḥ anukūla pratikūlayoḥ asya rāga dveṣau mā bhūtām abhyāvṛttyā ca sa sādhanasya phalasya hāna upādāna srotasohyamānaḥ tatra atyantāya nirvidya tām iti phala grahaṇam tat evam anyathā phalasya niḥśreyasa upayogi tvam anyathā tu phalatve sati api duḥkhasya iti

dīrghasya duḥkhasya nimitta bhūtam sukham ca duḥkha ātmakam eva sarvam mumukṣuṇā heya tayā vicintyam deha ādi duḥkhāntam idam prameyam iti nipuṇa matiḥ yaḥ dukham eva iti sarvam pariharati śarīre kleśa karma ādi jālam ajam ajaram anantam cintayan ātma tattvam gata bhayam apavargam śāśvatam saḥ abhyupaiti

evam śarīra ādau duḥkha paryante heye prameye nirṇīte yad arthaḥ etat upadeśaḥ yat param upādeyam prameyam yad arthaḥ śāstra ārambhaḥ tam apavargam lakṣayitum āha tad atyanta vimokṣaḥ apavargaḥ tat iti prakrāntasya duḥkhasya avamarśaḥ na ca mukhyam eva duḥkham bādhanā svabhāvam avamṛśyate kintu tad sādhanam tat anuṣaktam ca sarvam eva tena duḥkhena viyogaḥ apavargaḥ asti pralaya velāyām api ātmanaḥ duḥkha viyogaḥ sa tu apavargaḥ na bhavati sarga samaye punar akṣīṇa karma āśaya anurūpa śarīra ādi saṃbandhe sati dukha saṃbhavāt atas tad vyāvṛtti artham atyanta grahaṇam

ātyantikī duḥkha nivṛttiḥ apavargaḥ na sauvadhikā dvividha duḥkha avamarśinā sarva nāmnā sarveṣām ātma guṇānām duḥkha vat avamarśāt atyanta grahaṇena ca sarva ātmanā tad viyoga abhidhānāt navānām ātma guṇānām buddhi sukha duḥkha icchā dveṣa prayatna dharma adharma saṃskārāṇām nirmūla ucchedaḥ apavargaḥ iti uktam bhavati

yāvat ātma guṇāssarve na ucchinnāḥ vāsanā ādayaḥ tāvat ātyantikī duḥkha vyāvṛttiḥ na avakalpate dharma adharma nimittaḥ hi saṃbhavaḥ sukha duḥkhayoḥ mūla bhūtau ca tau eva stambhau saṃsāra sadmanaḥ tat ucchede tu tad kārya śarīra ādi anupaplavāt na ātmanaḥ sukha duḥkhe staḥ iti asau muktaḥ ucyate hacchādveṣa prayatna ādi bhoga āyatana bandhanam ucchinna bhoga āyatanaḥ na ātmā taiḥ api yujyate prāṇasya kṣuppipāse dve lobha mohau ca cetasaḥ śīta ātapau śarīrasya ṣaṣ ūmi rahitaḥ śivaḥ tat evam navānām ātma viśeṣa guṇānām nirmūla ucchedaḥ apavargaḥ iti yat ucyate tat eva idam uktam bhavati tad atyanta vimokṣaḥ apavargaḥ iti
nanu tasyām avasthāyām kīdṛś ātmā avaśiṣyate svarūpa eka pratiṣṭhānaḥ parityaktaḥ akhilaiḥ guṇaiḥ umiṣṭaka atigam rūpam tat asya āhuḥ manīṣiṇaḥ saṃsāra bandhana adhīna duḥkha kleśa ādya dūṣitam

atra tāvat vedāntinaḥ āhuḥ na ayam idṛśaḥ mokṣaḥ prekṣāvatām prayatna bhūmiḥ bhavitum arhati kaḥ hi nāma śilā śakala kalpam apagata sakala sukha saṃvedana saṃsparśam ātmānam upapādayitum yateta sa upādhi sau adhika parimita ānanda niṣyandāt svargāt api adhikam anavadhika niratiśaya naisargika ānanda sundaram aparimlāna tad saṃvedana sāmarthyam caturtham puruṣa artham ācakṣante vicakṣaṇāḥ

yadi tu jaḍaḥ pāṣāṇa nirviśeṣaḥ eva tasyām avasthāyām ātmā bhavet tat kṛtam apavargeṇa saṃsāraḥ eva varamastu yatra tāvat antarā antarā api duḥkha kaluṣitam api su alpam api sukham upabhujyate cintyatām tāvat idam kim alpa sukha anubhavaḥ bhadrakaḥ uta sarva sukha ucchedaḥ eva tasmāt nitya sukham ātmanaḥ mahattva vat asti iti āgama prāmāṇyāt abhyupagamyatām tat ca saṃsāra daśāyām avidyā āvaraṇa vaśena na anubhūyate tattva jñāna abhyāsa bhāvanā abhibhūta nirantara avidyā varaṇaḥ tu ātmā tasyām avasthāyām tat anubhavati iti

tat idam anupapannam ātmanaḥ nitya sukha sattāyām pramāṇa abhāvāt pratyakṣam tāvat na asmad ādīnām anyeṣām vā keṣāṃcid asmin arthe prabhaviṣyati iti kā iyam kathā anumānam api na saṃbhavati liṅga leśa anavalokanāt iti

nanu uktam eva anumānam apavargāya yatra prekṣāvatām prayatnaḥ sukha siddhaye hi buddhimantaḥ yatante na aśma kalpam ātmānam kartum iti tat ayam iṣṭa adhigama arthaḥ mumukṣoḥ prayatnaḥ prekṣā pūrva kāri prayatna tvāt kṛṣi ādi prayatna vat iti na aniṣṭa uparama artha tvāt aniṣṭasya api śāntaye santaḥ prayatamānāḥ hi dṛśyante vyādhi kheditāḥ ati durvahaḥ ca ayam saṃsāra duḥkha bhāraḥ iti tad upaśamāya vyavasyantaḥ santaḥ na niṣprayojana prayatnāḥ bhavanti iti anaikāntikaḥ hetuḥ

atha āgamāt avagamyate bibhutvena iva nityena sukhena avinākṛtaḥ sva ātmā iti tathā ca paṭhyate vijñānam ānandam brahma iti syāt etat evam yadi etat eva kevalam āgama vacanam aśroṣyata vacana antaram api tu śrūyate na ha vai sa śarīrasya sataḥ priya apriyayoḥ upahatiḥ asti aśarīram vā va santam na priya apriye spṛśataḥ iti

nanu bhavat paṭhitam āgama vacanam anyathā api vyākhyātum śakyate sa śarīrasya iti prakramāt sāṃsārike sukha duḥkhe anukūla itara viṣaya upalaṃbha saṃbhave tadānīm aśarīram ātmānam na spṛśate iti arthaḥ hanta tarhi tvad adhītam api veda vacanam ānandam brahma iti saṃsāra duḥkha parihāra prakaraṇāt eva tad duḥkha apāya viṣayam vyākhyāsyate na khalu vyākhyānasya bhagavataḥ kācid abhūmiḥ asti dṛṣṭāḥ ca duḥkha uparame sukha śabda prayogāḥ cira jvara śirorti ādi vyādhi duḥkhena kheditāḥ sukhinaḥ vayam adya iti tad apāye prayuṃjate

yadi ca ānandam iti vacanāt nityam sukham ātmanaḥ iṣyate tarhi brahma iti vacanāt vyāpaka tvam iva vijñānam iti vacanāt jñānam api nityam asya abhyupagantavyam atas ca sukha vat jñānasya api nitya tvāt saṃsāre api nitya sukha upalabdhiḥ syāt tatas ca dharma adharma phalābhyām sukha duḥkhābhyām asya nityasya sukhasya sāhacaryam anubhūyeta api ca sukha vat jñāna vat ca asya kāmam deha indriya ādi api nityam prakalpyatām ittham mokṣaḥ ramyataraḥ bhavet

atha kāryam sukha jñānam hetuḥ tasya vicintanīyaḥ yatas utpadyate iti dharmāt ced saḥ api kiṃprabhavaḥ iti vācyam yoga samādhi jaḥ iti ced tasya sva kārya tvāt sva kārya sukha saṃvedana avasāna tvāt na śāśvatika tvam syāt aprakṣayaḥ ca dharmasya niranumānakaḥ na hi yoga samādhi jaḥ dharmaḥ na kṣīyate iti atra ca kiṃcid anumānam asti viparyaye tu prasiddham anumānam sarvasya kṛtakasya anitya tva darśanāt iti kṣīṇe ca dharme tad kārya jñāna abhāvāt sat api sukham anupalabhyamānam asataḥ na viśiṣyate

sva prakāśam tat sukham iti ced na saṃsāre api tad upalabdhi prasaṅgāt śarīra ādi saṃbandhaḥ pratibandha hetuḥ iti ced na śarīra ādīnām upabhoga artha tvāt bhoga arthāḥ śarīra ādayaḥ te bhoga pratibandham vidadhati iti na sādhvī kalpanā

avidyā āvaraṇāt saṃsāre sva prakāśa sukha anupalambhaḥ iti ced na prakāśasya tucchena avaritum aśakyatvāt na ca prakāśa rūpam pāramārthikam ātmanaḥ sukham tad viparīta tuccha svabhāvā iyam avidyā na parītum arhati megha ādinā dinakara kiraṇāḥ varaṇa avadhāraṇāt avirala gavala m alīmasam balāhaka vyūha pihita ravi bimbam tat api na rajanī sadṛśam dinam iti sahasā moha mahimā meghāḥ api raveḥ anye svarūpeṇa ca vāstavāḥ tattva anya tvāt acintyā tu na avidyā avaraṇa kṣamā tasmāt na nitya ānanda tvam ātmanaḥ su vacam

api ca mokṣe nitya ānanda svabhāve tad rāgeṇa prayatamānaḥ mumukṣuḥ na mokṣam adhigacchet na hirāgiṇām mokṣaḥ asti iti mokṣa vidaḥ duḥkha nivṛtti ātmake api mokṣe duḥkha dveṣāt prayatamānasya samānaḥ doṣaḥ iti ced na mumukṣoḥ dveṣa abhāvāt rāga dveṣau hi saṃsāra kāraṇam iti ca jānāti mumukṣuḥ dveṣṭi ca duḥkham iti katham saṃgacchate sukhe api asya rāgaḥ na asti eva iti ced na svarga nirviśeṣe apavarge svargava drāgasya saṃbhāvyamāna tvāt duḥkhena tu nirviṇṇasya mumukṣoḥ vairāgyam jāyate na duḥkha viṣayaḥ dveṣaḥ viraktasya ca asya mokṣam prati yatnaḥ bhavati na duḥkham dviṣate iti na samānaḥ nyāyaḥ

yat uktam tādṛśaḥ mokṣaḥ prekṣāvatām prayatna viṣayaḥ na bhavati iti tat api na sāṃpratam prayojana anusāreṇa pramāṇa vyavasthā anupapatteḥ na hi prayojana anuvarti pramāṇam bhavitum arhati yadi nirānandaḥ mokṣaḥ prekṣāvatām na ruciraḥ kāmam mā bhūt na tu apramāṇakam ānandam tu atra kalpayitum śaknumaḥ

na ca sarva ātmanā sādhūnām anabhimataḥ eva tathāvidhaḥ mokṣaḥ na catad avāptaye na prayatante te hi evam vivecayanti duḥkha saṃsparśa śūnya śāśvatika sukha saṃbhoga asaṃbhavāt duḥkhasya ca avaśyam hātavya tvāt viveka hānasya ca aśakya tvāt viṣa madhunī iva eka pātre patite ubhe api sukha duḥkhe tyajyetām iti atas ca saṃsārāt mokṣaḥ śreyān yatra ayam iyān ati dussahaḥ duḥkha prabandhaḥ avalupyate varam iyatī kādācid kī sukha kaṇikā tyaktā na tasyāḥ kṛte duḥkha bhāraḥ iyānūḍhaḥ iti tasmāt na sukha upabhoga ātmakaḥ mokṣaḥ iti

anyaḥ tu āha tiṣṭhatu tāvat mokṣaḥ saṃsāre api na sukham nāma kiṃcid asti iti sarve eva ayam dukha abhāva mātre suḥkha vyavahāraḥ tathā hi tṛṣā śuṣyati āsye pibati salilam svādu surabhi kṣudhā ārtaḥ san śālīn kabalayati māṃ pāka valitān pradīpte rāga agnau ghana nibiḍam āśliṣyati vadhūm pratīkāre vyādheḥ sukham iti viparyasyati janaḥ

ucyate tad idam ati kṛta ka vairāgya prakaṭana kauru kucī kauśalam ānanda ātmanaḥ prati prāṇi saṃvedyasya sukhasya nihnotum aśakyatvāt anivṛtte api duḥkhe kvacid sukha saṃvedanāt na duḥkha abhāvaḥ sukham nirabhilāṣasya api atarkita upanata sukha sādhana viṣaya saṃparke sati sukha saṃveda darśanāt abhilāṣa ātmaka duḥkha abhāvaḥ sukham iti api na manojñam yaḥ tu duḥkha abhāve kvacid sukham iti api vyapadeśaḥ praśānta rogāṇām iva pūrvam darśitaḥ sa bhāktaḥ iti na tāvatā sva saṃvedana sākṣika sukha apahnavaḥ kartum ucitaḥ mokṣa tu nitya sukham asaṃbhavat pramāṇa tvāt na abhyupagamyate

api ca mokṣe sukham asti na vā iti vicāraḥ eṣa na prāmāṇika jana ucitaḥ sva rūpeṇa vyavasthānam ātmanaḥ mokṣaḥ iti mokṣa vidaḥ tatra ātma svarūpam eva kīdṛśam iti cintyam na pṛthak mokṣa svarūpam ātmanaḥ ca sukha duḥkha budhi ādayaḥ āgantukāḥ guṇāḥ na mahattva vat sāṃsiddhikāḥ iti nirṇītam etat ātma lakṣaṇe sukha ādi kāryeṇa ca ātmanaḥ anumānāt iti

atas eva kāpila kathita citi śakti svabhāva tvam api na yuktam ātmanaḥ sa cetanaḥ citā yogāt tad yogena vinā jaḍaḥ citiḥ nāma artha vijñānam kādācid kam tu tasya tat na artha saṃvenāt anyat caitanyam nāma vidyate tat ca sāmagrī adhīna tvāt katham mokṣe bhaviṣyati jāgrataḥ svapna vṛtteḥ vā suṣuptasya api vā aatmanaḥ jñānam utpadyate anyā tu caturthī na asti tādṛśī jāgrat daśāyām svapne ca buddheḥ pratyātma vedya tā sukham suptaḥ aham adya iti paścāt pratyavamarśanāt tadā tu avedyamānā api suṣupte dhīḥ prakalpyate turya avasthā tu saṃvitti śūnyasya sthitiḥ ātmanaḥ turya avasthā atigam rūpam yat āhuḥ kecid ātmanaḥ pramāṇa agocara tvena kalpanā mātram eva tat saṃvid prasava sāmarthyam sāmagrī sannidhānataḥ yadi nāma ātmanaḥ asti asya tāvatā na cit ātma tā

yadi tu darśana śakti yogyatā mātram eva puṃsaḥ caitanyam ucyate tarhi tathāvidhasya tasya kaivalyasya asmākīna mokṣa sadṛśa tvam eva sat saṃvid prasava yogya tāmātra saṃbhave api dṛśya indriya saṃprayoga ādi sāmagrī vaikalyāt kaivalya avasthāyām ātmanaḥ draṣṭṛ tva asaṃbhavāt darśana śūnyasya ca anyasya caitanyasya nirasta tvāt iti

nirvāṇa ādi pada ākhyeyam apavargam tu saugatāḥ santati ucchedam icchanti su acchām vā jñāna santatim mata dvitayam api etat pratyuktam pūrvam eva yat dhvastaḥ ca jñāna santānaḥ nityaḥ ca ātmā samarthitaḥ santati uccheda pakṣaḥ tu naiyāyika matāt api śocyaḥ yatra aśma kalpaḥ api na kaścid avaśiṣyate

arhat pakṣe api yat rūpam anya sa apekṣam ātmanaḥ na kevalasya tādrapyam iti asmad mata tulya tā vikāri tvam tu jīvānām atyantam asamaṃjasam śabda pudgala vat ca etat pratyākhyeyam asaṃbhavāt tasmāt na vedānta vidaḥ vadanti mokṣam na sāṅkhyāḥ na ca saugata ādyāḥ iti akṣa pāda abhihitaḥ apavargaḥ śroyān tad atyanta vimokṣaḥ eva

āha bhavatu ayamī dṛś apavargaḥ sa tu katham adhigamyate iti ucyatām uktam eva bhagavatā sūtrakāreṇa duḥkha janma pravṛtti doṣa mithyā jñānānām uttarottara apāye tad anantarā pāyāt apavargaḥ duḥkha ucchedaḥ tāvat apavargaḥ iti kathitam kārya tvāt ca duḥkhasya kāraṇa ucchedāt tad ucchedaḥ kāraṇam ca asya janma janmani sati hi duḥkham bhavati jāyate iti hi janma deha indriya ādi saṃbandhaḥ ātmanaḥ tat api janma kāraṇa ucchedāt eva ucchedyam atas tad kāraṇam pravṛttiḥ ucchedyā tasyāḥ api hetu ucchedāt ucchedaḥ iti tad hetayaḥ doṣāḥ ucchedyāḥ teṣām tu nimittam mithyājñānam tasmin ucchinne doṣāḥ ucchinnāḥ bhavanti iti mithyā jñānam ucchedyam tat ucchede ca tattva jñānam upāyaḥ prasiddhaḥ hi ayam arthaḥ samarthitaḥ ca pūrvam vistarataḥ tattva jñānam mithyājñānasya bādhakam iti tasmai tattva jñānāt mithyājñāna doṣa pravṛtti janma duḥkha nivṛtti krameṇa apavargaḥ iti

yadi api mithyājñānam api janma kāryam aśarīrasya ātmanaḥ mithyājñāna anupapatteḥ itaretara kārya kāraṇa bhāvena bīja aṅkura vadana ādi prabandha pravṛttena pravartamānāḥ mithyājñāna ādayaḥ bhāvāḥ saṃsāraḥ iti ākhyāyate tathā api tad kāraṇa uccheda cintāyām kutas prabhṛti ucchedaḥ upakramyatām iti vicāryamāṇe viśeṣa niyama abhāvāt yatas kutaścid iti prāpte mithyājñānasya pratikūlam uccheda kāraṇam tattva jñānam upalabdham iti viśeṣe pramāṇa abhavāt tad ucchadaḥ eva upakramyate

atas eva mithyājñāna mūlaḥ saṃsāraḥ ucyate tasmin ucchinne tad uccheda saṃbhavāt na tatas prabhṛti saṃsāraḥ pravartate iti nipuṇa matibhiḥ api nirdhārayitum śakyam anādi tvāt tasya iti tat evam tattva jñānāt mithyājñāna apāye tad kārya doṣa apāyaḥ doṣa apāye pravṛtti apāyaḥ pravṛtti apāye janma apāyaḥ janma apāye duḥkha apāyaḥ saḥ eva apavargaḥ iti tat idam uktam uttarottara apāye tad anantara apāyāt iti

āha viditaḥ ayam sūtra arthaḥ kintva ghaṭamāna manoratha viḍambanā mātram idam alīka śraddadhāna tā prakaṭanam vā duradhigamaḥ tu saṃkaṭaḥ mokṣa mārgaḥ sādhyaḥ trivargaḥ eva eṣaḥ dharma karma artha lakṣaṇaḥ caturthaḥ puruṣa arthaḥ tu kathāsu eva virājate yadā priya viyoga ādi bhavati udvega kāraṇam tadā mokṣa kathāḥ kāmam kriyantām śoka śāntaye na tu udyam asamaye tad adhigama samarthām upalabhāmahe saraṇim ṛṇa kleśa pravṛtti anubandhasya dustara tvāt

ṛṇa anubandhaḥ tāvat jāyamānaḥ ha vai brāhmaṇaḥ tribhiḥ ṛṇaiḥ ṛṇavā brahmacaryeṇa ṛṣibhyaḥ yajñena devebhyaḥ prajayā pitṛbhyaḥ iti idam hi vede paṭhyate tatra prathamam ṛṣīṇām anṛṇaḥ syām iti brahmacaryam ācarati tatas pitṛṇām anṛṇaḥ syām iti kṛta dāra saṅgrahaḥ prajā utpādanāya vyavaharati tadanu gṛhasthaḥ eva darśa pūrṇamāsa ādiṣu sahasra saṃvatsara paryanteṣu karmasu adhikṛtaḥ kratūn anutiṣṭhati iti devānām anṛṇaḥ syām iti kaḥ asya mokṣa vyavasāya avasaraḥ

nanu ca ṛṇāṇi trīṇi apākṛtya manaḥ mokṣe niveśayet iti manu ādi smaraṇāt asti eva tad avasaraḥ na śruti vākya virodhāt evam hi śrūyate jarā maryam vai etat satram yat agni hotram darśa pūrṇamāsau ca jarayā ha vai eṣaḥ etasmāt mucyate mṛtyunā vā iti na ca karma prayoga aśaktyā karmabhyaḥ virantum śakyate svayam aśaktasya bāhya śakti upadeśāt antevāsī vā juhuyāta brahmaṇā hi sa parikrītaḥ krītaḥ vā juhuyāt dhanena hi sa parikrītaḥ aśaktasya ca mokṣa upāya anuṣṭhāne api asya katham śaktiḥ

kleśa anubandhāt api apavarga abhāvaḥ ye hi rāga ādayaḥ doṣāḥ ātmanaḥ cira saṃbhṛtāḥ kaḥ tān śamayitum śaktaḥ punarāvṛtti dharmakān kāmam ciram vijitya api krodham vā lobham eva vā punar gacchan vaśe teṣām lokaḥ prāyeṇa dṛśyate tathā hi ciram api tapasi niyamita matiḥ api avijita viṣama śara vikṛtiḥ tanu pavana apanīta vasana kāminī stana jaghana darśanāt eva vaśam viśvāmitraḥ kusumadhanvanaḥ gataḥ iti śrūyate

alam ākhyāyikayā adyatve api evam śataśas dṛśyate iti durucchedāḥ doṣāḥ vīta rāga janma adarśanāt iti ca vicāritam ātma parīkṣāyām aviyuktaḥ eva doṣaiḥ jantuḥ jāyate iti doṣa vivṛddhi hetavaḥ ca rūpa ādayaḥ viṣayāḥ te katham iva sva karmaṇi udāsate tāmbūlam kusuma sugandha yassamīrāḥ saudheṣu pratiphalitāḥ śaśāṅka bhāsaḥ vācaḥ ca praṇaya nava amṛta drava ārdrāḥ dūtīnām dadhati na kasya rāga vṛddhim api ca mugdha smita sughādhauta madhura ālāpa śālinā mukhena pakṣmala akṣīnām kasya na ākṣipyate manaḥ iti evam nidāna anupaśamāt api sthitaḥ eva kleśa anubandhaḥ

pravṛtti anubandhaḥ khalu api rāga ādi preryamāṇaḥ hi karmāṇi ārabhate naraḥ dīrgha dīrghāḥ pratāyante yaiḥ dharma adharma vāsanāḥ yaḥ pravṛtti anubandhaḥ ca hetuḥ anyasya janmanaḥ tena janma antareṇa anyā janyate karma vāsanā ekam eva īdṛśam karma kartum āpatati kvacid janma ayuta śatena api yat phalam bhujyate na vā kleśa karma anubandha utthā janma duḥkha ādi śṛṅkhalā punar āvartamānā eṣā kena upāyena bhajyatām vinā phala upabhogena na vināśaḥ asti karmaṇām teṣām jñāna agninā dāhaḥ iti śraddhā vijṛmbhitam kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ hi śāstrāt eva avadhāritaḥ karmaṇām ca phalānām ca sa katham vā nivartatām na ca pyajñāna sāpekṣam karma iṣṭam bandha kāraṇam yena ātma jñāna yuktānām tat udāsīta tān prati ajñāna nairapekṣyeṇa karmaṇām svabhāvaḥ eva eṣaḥ yat phala avinābhāvi tvam iti tasmāt ittham ṛṇa kleśa pravṛtti ādi anubandhataḥ na mokṣa siddhiḥ asti iti tad arthaḥ viphalaḥ śramaḥ aśakye arthe vṛthā yatnaḥ iti matvā manīṣibhiḥ mokṣa carcāḥ parityajya sve gṛhe sukham āsyatām

atra abhidhīyate yat tāvat uktam ṛṇa anubandhāt iti tat ayuktam vidhi padā śravaṇāt aupacārikam ṛṇa śabdam jāyamāna śabdam ca prayujya karma stutiḥ iyam kriyate jāyamānaḥ ha vai brāhmaṇaḥ iti na tad vyatirikta puruṣa artha viṣaya prayatna pratiṣedhaḥ vidhīyate tathā hi ṛṇa śabdaḥ ayam viṣaya antare mukhya arthaḥ prasiddhaḥ yatra uttamarṇaḥ sa lābham amutaḥ pratigrahīṣyāmi iti dhanam adhamarṇāya prayacchati adhamarṇaḥ api sa lābham asmai pradāsyāmi iti mattvā gṛhṇāti saḥ ayam ṛṇa śabdasya mukhyaḥ viṣayaḥ iha na asti eva

jāyamānaḥ api mukhyaḥ utpadyamānaḥ hi mātuḥ kukṣi kuhārān nissaran abhi dhīyate na ca asau tapasvī bālaḥ karmabhiḥ abhisaṃbadhyate tasmāt brahmacaryam apatya utpādanam adhvara prayogaḥ iti tritayam idam ṛṇavat avaśya kartavyam iti karma stutiḥ iyam aupacārika pada prayogāt gamyate na ca etāvatā mokṣa vyavasāya avasara virahaḥ iti pariśaṅkanīyam āśrama antarasya tad aupayi kasya darśanāt

nanu maraṇa avadhi darśa pūrṇamāsa ādi dharma upadeśāt katham āśrama antara grahaṇam na jarā marya vāda sthāpya parityāga pratipādanāya karma praśaṃsā artha tvāt ye catvāraḥ pathayaḥ deva yānāḥ ityādayaḥ hi caturtha āśrama śaṃsinaḥ bhūyāṃsaḥ santi mantra artha vādāḥ manu ādi smṛti vacanāni caturtha āśrama upadeśīni caturtha āśrama ucita śauca ācāra ādi iti kartavya tā vitāna vidhāna parāṇi ca prabandhena eva dṛśyante evam gṛha āśrame sthitvā vidhivat snātakaḥ dvijaḥ vane vaset su niyataḥ bhaikṣa bhuj vijita indriyaḥ iti upakramya caturtha āśrama ucita mokṣa upāya anuṣṭhāna upadeśāya ṣaṣṭhaḥ adhyāyaḥ samastaḥ eva manunā anukrāntaḥ

jābāla śrutau ca vidhāyakena eva brāhmaṇa vākyena pratipadam āśrama catuṣṭaya mupadiṣṭam brahmacārī bhūtvā gṛhī bhavet gṛhī bhūtvā vanī bhavet vanī bhūtvā pravrajet iti agni samāropaṇa vidhāna upadeśaḥ ca pratyakṣa śrutaḥ katham apahnūyate ātmani agnīn samāropya brāhmaṇaḥ pravrajet gṛhāt iti api ca upaniṣadām adhyayanam asati mokṣa upāya prayoga samarthe caturtha āśrame nirarthakam eva prāpnoti kriyā kāṇḍa anuṣṭhāna niṣṭha tve hi vedasya jñāna kāṇḍa upadeśaḥ kiṃprayojanaḥ syāt

tat evam varṇa vat āśramāṇām api caturṇām pratyakṣa upadeśa siddha tvāt caturtha āśramiṇām ca mokṣa adhigama upāya tattva jñāna bhāvanā abhyāsa avasara saṃbhavāt saḥ ayam jarā maryavādaḥ praśaṃsā mātra paraḥ eva avatiṣṭhate jarayā ha vai eṣaḥ etasmāt mucyate mṛtyunā vā iti ca vacanāt jarasā karma tyāga anujñānāt saḥ eva caturtha āśrama avasaraḥ iti gamyate tat uktam gṛhasthaḥ tu yadā paśyet valī palitam ātmanaḥ apatyasya eva ca apatyam tadā araṇyam samāśrayet iti itarathāḥ hi mṛtyunā eva ca tasmāt mṛcyate iti avakṣyata ca tu evam abravīt tasmāt vārdhaka daśa ucitam caturtham āśramam anumanyante

tiṣṭhatu vā vārdhaka daśā yūnaḥ api paripakva kāṣa yasya āśrama catuṣṭaya kramam anapekṣya eva mokṣa adhikāraḥ ākhyātaḥ yathokyam brahmacaryāt eva pravrajet iti atas eva dvividhaḥ brahmacāri bhavati upakurvāṇaḥ naiṣṭhikaḥ ca tatra upakurvāṇakaḥ yaḥ brahmacaryam anubhūya gṛhastha āśramam anubhavati sa ca apari pakva kaṣāyaḥ anuṣa śānta rāgaḥ tam eva pratīdam ucyate anadhītya dvijaḥ vedān anutpādya ca santatim aniṣṭavā ca eva yajñaiḥ ca mokṣam icchan vrajati adhas iti yaḥ tu paripakva kaṣāyaḥ sa naiṣṭhikaḥ eva brahmacārī bhavati na gṛhastha āśramam pratipadyate gṛhasthaḥ api paripakva kaṣāyaḥ vānaprastha āśramam ullaṅghya yati tve adhikriyate yathā uktam gṛhāt vā vanāt vā pravrajet iti

kecid tu karma phala abhisandhirahitasya kartavyam iti karma kurvataḥ kṣīṇa rāgasya ātma vidaḥ gṛhasthasya api mokṣam ācakṣate yathā aaha yājñavalkyaḥ nyāya arjita dhanaḥ tattva jñāna niṣṭhaḥ atithi priyaḥ śrāddha kṛt veda vidyā vid gṛhasthaḥ api vimucyate iti tasmāt ṛṇa anubandhāt apavarga abhāvaḥ iti ayuktam

yat tu kleśa anubandhāt iti tat api anadhyavasāya mātram pratipakṣa bhāvanādinā kleśa upaśamasya suśaka tvāt yadi hi doṣāḥ nityāḥ bhaveyuḥ anitya tve api ākasmikā vā sa hetu tve api yadi eṣām nityaḥ hetuḥ bhavet kāryaḥ api vā yadi asau na jñāyeta jñātasya vā asya śamana upāyaḥ na jñāyeta jñātaḥ api vā anuṣṭhātum asau na śakyeta tadā kaḥ eva enam ucchindyāt kintu na akasmikāḥ na nityāḥ te na nitya ajñāta hetukāḥ na ajñāta śamana upāyāḥ na ca aśakya pratikriyāḥ na hi doṣāṇām ātma svarūpa vat nitya tvam upajanana apāya dharmaka tvena grahaṇāt mithyājñānam ca prasava kāraṇam eṣām avadhṛtam iti na akasmika tvam avināśi hetuka tvam ajñāta hetuka tvam vā

mithyājñānasya ca sanyak jñānam pratipakṣa bhāvanā abhyāsena ca sa mūlam unmīlayitum śakyante doṣāḥ iti na ajñāta pratīkāra tvam teṣām uktam ca kena cit sarveṣām sa vipakṣa tvāt nirhrāsa atiśaya āśritāt sā ātmībhāvāt tad abhyāsāt hīyeranna āsravāḥ kvacid iti viṣaya doṣa darśanena hi teṣu sakti lakṣaṇaḥ rāgaḥ śāmyati yadā hi eṣa cintayati vivekī asau tarala tārākṣī pīna unnata ghana stanī vilupyamānā kāntāre vihagaiḥ adya dṛśyate vibhāti bahis eva asyāḥ padma gandha nibham vapuḥ antar majja asthi viṣ mūtra bhedaḥ krimi kula ākulam asthīni pittam uccārāḥ klinnāni āntrāṇi śoṇitam iti carma pinaddham tat kāminī iti abhidhīyate medaḥ granthī stanau nāma tau svarṇa kalaśau katham viṣṭhā ādṛtau nitambe ca kaḥ ayam hema śilā bhramaḥ mūtra asṛj dvāram aśuci cchidram kledi jugupsitam

tat eva hi rati sthānam aho puṃsām viḍambanā prītiḥ yathā nija asya uttham lihataḥ śoṇitam śunaḥ śuṣke asthini tathā puṃsaḥ sva dhātu syandinaḥ striyām vyātta ānanā vivṛtta akṣī vivarṇā śvāsa ghurgharā katham adya na rāgāya mriyamāṇā tapasvinī aho bata varākaḥ ayam akāle tṛṣitaḥ phaṇī prasārita mukhaḥ asmākam śoṇitam pātum āgataḥ kim anena aparāddham naḥ svabhāvaḥ vastunaḥ svayam spṛśyamānaḥ dahati agniḥ iti kasmai prakupyati na anukūlaḥ priye hetuḥ pratikūlaḥ na vipriye sva karma phalam aśnāmi kaḥ suhṛtkaḥ ca me ripuḥ evam ahaniśam cintayataḥ nitāntam śāntasya manasaḥ sama citta tā sarvatra samudbhavati iti vilīyante doṣa granthayaḥ atas eva upadiśyante mokṣa śāstreṣu anekaśas tasya tasya upaghātāya tāḥ tāḥ pratyūha bhāvanāḥ

nanu ca pratipakṣa bhāvane api na sarva ātmanā doṣa pakṣaḥ kṣayam upayāti nimba abhyupayogaḥ iva kriyamāṇe kapha dhātuḥ iti na etat evam tatra nimba upayaḥ gavat tad anukūlasya anna pāna ādeḥ upayoga darśanāt api ca dharmi lopa bhayāt tatra na iṣṭaḥ sarva ātmanā kṣayaḥ kapha ādhikyam tu hantavyam dhātu sāmyasya siddhaye iha sarva ātmanā ucchedyāḥ kleśāḥ saṃsāra kāriṇaḥ chedaḥ ca ekāntataḥ teṣām pratipakṣa upasevayā na ca pratipakṣa bhāvanā abhyāsam ekam astram apāsya tad upaśame nimitta antaram kim api kramate

na hi viṣaya abhilāṣaḥ tad upabhogena viraṃsyati yathā aaha na jātu kāmaḥ kāmānām upabhogena śāmyati haviṣā kṛṣṇavartmā iva bhūyas eva abhivardhate anyatra api uktam bhoga abhyāsam anu vivardhante rāgāḥ kauśalāni ca indriyāṇām iti pārāśaryaḥ api āha tṛṣṇā khaniragādheyam duṣpūrā kena pūryate yā mahadbhiḥ api kṣiptaiḥ pūraṇena eva khanyate iti tasmāt pratipakṣa bhāvanā eva bhagavatī bhīma kāntiḥ antaḥkaraṇa kāntāre nirantaram abhijvalantī dāva dahana dīdhitiḥ iva dahati doṣa viṭapakān iti tat evam doṣa anubandha vidhvaṃsa upāya saṃbhavāt na tad kṛtaḥ mokṣa mārga nirodhaḥ abhidhātavyaḥ

atas eva kecana cetanasya prakṛtyā nirmala tvāt malānām āgantuka tvāt mala nibarhaṇa hetoḥ ca yathā uktasya saṃbhavāt tad ācaraṇāt tad apāye sati sva tassakala padārtha darśana sāmarthya svabhāva cid tattva avasthānāt sarvajña siddhim adūra vartinīm eva manyante

yat api uktam kleśa śūnya tvam ātmanaḥ na kadācid api dṛṣṭam anubandha vṛtti tvāt kva īśānām iti tat api asatyam suṣupta avasthāyām aspṛṣṭasya doṣaiḥ ātmanaḥ pratyaham upalambhāt jāgrataḥ api kā cana tādṛśī dṛśā dṛśyate eva yasyām asau ātma svarūpaḥ eva ātmā nirmalaḥ avatiṣṭhate yathā uktam aharahar brahma lokam yānti iti tad alam anena doṣa anubandha kathā anubandhena

yat api pravṛtti anubandhāt iti pratyapādi tat api sūtra kṛtā samāhitam na pravṛttiḥ pratisandhānāya hīna kleśasya iti doṣeṣu bandha hetuṣu vigaliteṣu pravṛttiḥ api na deha indriya ādi janmane prabhavati iti

nanu doṣa kṣayāt mā bhūt uttaraḥ karma saṅgrahaḥ katham phalam adattvā tu prāktanam karma śāmyati atra kecid āhuḥ dadati eva karmāṇi na adattvā śāmyanti tathā api bandha hetavaḥ na bhavanti yatas śama santoṣa ādi janitam yoginaḥ sukham utpādya dharmaḥ vinaṅkṣyati adharmaḥ ca śīta ātapa kleśa ādi dvārakam duḥkham dattvā iti

nanu amuṣmāt karmaṇaḥ idam phalam bhavati iti karma phalānām kārya kāraṇa bhāva niyamāt katham iyatā karma phala upabhogaḥ bhavet iti anyathā tad upabhogam apare varṇayanti yogī hi yogardhi siddhyā vihita nikhila nija dharma adharma karmā nirmāya tad upabhoga yogyāni teṣu teṣu upapatti sthāneṣu tāni tāni sa indriyāṇi śarīrāṇi raṇḍa antaḥkaraṇāni ca muktaiḥ ātmabhiḥ upekṣitāni gṛhītvā sakṛt eva sakala karma phalam anubhavati prāpta aiśvaryaḥ iti ittham upabhogena karmaṇām kṣayaḥ

anye tu ācakṣate kim anena bhoga āyāsena adatta phalāni eva karmāṇi yoginaḥ naṅkṣyanti tattva jñānasya eva bhagavataḥ iyān prabhāvaḥ yat asmin utpanne cira saṃcitāni api karmāṇi sahasā eva pralayam upayānti bhogāt api teṣām prakṣayaḥ śāstra prāmāṇyāt eva avagataḥ tathā tad prāmāṇyāt eva tattva jñānāḥ dapi tad prakṣayam pratipatsyāmahe tathā ca āha yathā edhāṃsi samiddhaḥ agniḥ bhasmasāt kurute arjuna jñāna agniḥ sarva karmāṇi bhasmasāt kurute tathā iti na ca idam śraddhā mātram veda vidāmagraṇyāḥ vyāsa muninā eva samabhidhānāt aveda artham hi na asau abhidadhīta iti

tam anye na manyante na sarva amanā karmaṇām dāhaḥ kintu svarūpeṇa satām api saha kāri vaikalyāt sva kārya karaṇa udāsīna tā teṣām bhavati bhraṣṭānām iva bījānām aṅkura karaṇa kauśala hāniḥ yatas sāmagrī kāryasya janikā na kevalam kārakam atas na karmāṇi eva kevalāni phala upabhoga yogya śarīra indriya ādi janma nimitta tām upayānti kintu mithyājñānena doṣaiḥ ca sahitāni tat uktam avidyā tṛṣṇe dharma adharmau ca janma kāraṇam iti

tattva vidaḥ ca tattva vid tvāt eva na avidyā mithyājñāna ātmikā bhavati doṣāṇām tu prathame darśitaḥ eva kramaḥ tad abhāve bhavantau api dharma adharmau na bandhāya kalpete na hi sva kāryam aṅkura ādi kusūla vartīni bījāni janayitum utsahante bhraṣṭa bījānām api svarūpa śaktiḥ api tānavam gatā tadvat karmaṇām sva rūpa śakti śaithilyam mā nāma bhūt tathā api kusūla varti bīja vat sahakāri vaidhuryāt kārya anārambhaḥ iti tat ida suktam na pravṛttiḥ pratisandhānāya hīna kleśasya iti

nanu svarūpa sattāyām dharma adharmayoḥ katham idam uktam navānām ātma guṇānām nirmūla ucchedaḥ apavargaḥ iti na eṣa doṣaḥ manassaṃyoga vat akiṃcitkarayoḥ avasthānam api ucchedāt na viśiṣyate muktasya ātmanaḥ vibhu tvāt aparihāryaḥ manassaṃyogaḥ na ca tadānīm asau san api sukha duḥkha jñāna ādi janmani vyāpriyate evam dharma adharmau santau api phala m anākṣipantau kim kariṣyate iti phalatas ucchinnau eva bhavataḥ tasmāt navānām ātma guṇānām ucchedaḥ apavargaḥ iti aviruddham evam pravṛtti anubandhasya api bandha hetoḥ abhāvāt na durgamaḥ apavargaḥ

apare punar āhuḥ karma phalānām śāstrataḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāva niyama avagateḥ śama santoṣa śīta ātapa ādi dvāraka sukha duḥkha mātra upapādanena karma parikṣayā anupapatteḥ yoga ṛddhyā ca dīrgha kāla avadhi sukha duḥkha upabhogasya sakṛt eva saṃpādayitum aśakya tvāt jñāna agninā ca dāhe tad karma upadeśi vaidika vacana sārtha ānarthakya prasaṅgāt adatta phalasya karmaṇaḥ anuparamāt avasthāna pakṣe ciram api uṣitvā kusūla avasthita bīja vat kāla antareṇa api tad phala ākṣepa prasaṅgāt avaśyam sva phala upabhoga dvārakaḥ eva karma kṣayaḥ vācyaḥ

na ca anirmokṣaḥ āśaṅkanīyaḥ tatas cirāt api tad siddhi saṃbhavāt tathā ca mumukṣuḥ nitya naimittikam karma avaśyam anutiṣṭhet ananutiṣṭhan pratyaveyāt iti tat kutas asya bandhaḥ syāt kāmyam niṣiddham ca karma svarga naraka kāri vispaṣṭam eva bandha sādhanam iti tad pariharet eva iti evam tāvat uttaraḥ ayam na karma saṃcayaḥ pravartate tat āha nitya naimittike kuryāt pratyavāya jihāsayā mokṣa arthī na pravarteta tatra kāmya niṣiddhayoḥ iti

prāktanasya tu karma saṃcayasya bhogāt eva kṣayaḥ ātma vidaḥ ca mumukṣoḥ ayam anuṣṭhāna kramaḥ bhavati na itarasya iti saḥ eva ittham apavṛjyate iti āha ca ātma jñe ca etat asti iti tat jñānam upayujyate tatra jñāta ātma tattvānām bhogāt pūrva kriyā kṣaye uttara pracaya asattvāt dehaḥ na utpadyate punar nanu nitya karma nuṣṭhāna pakṣe na asti eva mokṣaḥ yāni eva hi nityāni darśa paurṇamāsa ādi karmāṇi yāvajjīvam darśa pūrṇamāsābhyām yajeta iti ādi codana upadiṣṭāni tāni eva phalavanti śrūyante iti kāmyāni api bhavituma rhanti darśa paurṇamāsābhyām svarga kāmaḥ yajet agniṃhotram juhuyāt svarga kāmaḥ iti na phala abhisandhāna pūrvaka tvena aprayogāt tathā aaha prārthyamānam phalam jñātam na anicchoḥ tat bhaviṣyati

iti saḥ ayam pravṛttau viśeṣaḥ prayoge api viśeṣaḥ kāmyam karma sarva aṅga upasaṃhāreṇa prayujyamānam phala sādhanam iti na yathāśakti tathā tathā prayoktavyam iti nityakarmaṇaḥ akaraṇāt pratyavāyaḥ iti yathāśakti api tat prayoktavyam ananuṣṭhitāt yādṛś tādṛś anuṣṭhita śreyaḥ pratyavāya parihāra upapatteḥ kāmye tu sarvāṇi aṅgāni yadi asau upasaṃhartum na śaknuyāt mā pravartiṣṭa na hi apravartamānaḥ pratyaveyāt iti

evaṃca tat eva darśa paurṇamāsa ādi karma yāvajjīvam iti ca udanayā upadiṣṭam nityam sat tad phala anabhisandhānāt prayuktam na bandhāya kalpate kva sā svarga sādhana tva śaktiḥ asya gatā iti ced na na vayam karmaṇām śaktim aśakti vā pratyakṣatas prapaśyāmaḥ śāstra eka śaraṇāḥ tu śrotriyāḥ vayam codanā eva dharme pramāṇam iti naḥ kula vratam etat sā ca codanā ekatra kāminam adhikāriṇam āśritya pravṛttā tad adhikāraḥ ca phala nirvṛtteḥ vinā na syāt iti phala paryantatām pratipadyate

anyatra tu yāvat padoṣa baddha jīvana padārtha avacchinna adhikāri lābhena pravartamānā na phalāya prabhavati akriyamāṇe tu śāstra arthe pratyavāyāya bhavati adhikṛtena satā śāstra arthaḥ tyaktaḥ iti kāmye tu anutpanna kāmaḥ adhikṛtaḥ eva na bhavati iti na adhikṛtena satā vidhiḥ tyaktaḥ iti na pratyavaiti iti upakramya tu antarāle tyaktum na labhate eva vītāyām phala icchāyām āvāpte vā phale tad karma samāpana vat avaśya kartavyam eva tat iti alam śāstra antara garbheṇa bhūyasā kathā vistareṇa sarvathā suṣṭu uktam nitya naimittike kuryāt iti

nanu bhogāt prāktana karma kṣaya pakṣe dīrgha kāla apekṣaṇāt apratyāsannaḥ iva mokṣaḥ lakṣyate kim tvayā jñāta madhunā eva huṃ kṛtvā nirvilambam eva mokṣam āpnuyāt iti na khalu sulabhaḥ ayam puruṣa arthaḥ kim na śrutam idam āyuṣmatā kyāsa vacanam aneka janma saṃsiddhaḥ tatas yāti parām gatim iti jñāna agni dāha vacanam tu jñāna praśaṃsā artham eva saḥ ayam jñāna karma samuccayāt mokṣaḥ ucyate iti

atra abhidhīyate na khalu phala upabhoga dvārakaḥ karmaṇām parikṣayaḥ janma koṭi śataiḥ api śakya kriyaḥ uktam hi ekam eva īdṛśam karma kartum āpatati kvacid janma ayuta śatena api yat phalam bhujyate na vā dehaiḥ tad karma bhoga arthaiḥ karma anyat na kariṣyate deha bandhanam iti eṣā durāśā eva tapasvinām tat īdṛśam enam mokṣa patham upadiśadbhiḥ yājñikaiḥ mokṣa upekṣaṇam anakṣaram upadiṣṭam bhavati iti tasmāt pūrva ukta nītyā eva karmaṇām bandha hetu tvam apākaraṇīyam

nanu pakṣa catuṣṭaye api doṣaḥ uktaḥ na caturtha pakṣasya niravadya tvāt saha kāri vaikalyāt kusūla avasthita bīja vat karmaṇām anārambhaka tve sati na kaścid doṣaḥ eṣaḥ eva ca teṣām dāhaḥ yat kārya anārambhaka tvam

nanu avinaṣṭa svarūpāṇi kusūla bīja vat eva kadā cirāt ārapsyante kāryam tasmāt varam ucchidyantām eva kim idānīm nityam ātmānam api ucchettum yatāmahe sa hi purā bhoktā abhūt iti muktaḥ api punar bhoktṛtām pratipadyeta iti varam ucchidyantām eva sāmagrya bhāvāt katham asau punar bhoktṛtām gacchet iti ced karmāṇi api saha kārya bhāvāt katham kāryam ārabheran na ca karmaṇām bandha karaṇe rāga ādayaḥ na sahakāriṇaḥ iti vaktum śakyate vīta rāgasya jatma adarśanāt iti asakṛt ukta tvāt tasmāt ayam eva sūtrakāra upadiṣṭaḥ panthāḥ peśalaḥ na pravṛttiḥ pratisandhānāya hīna kleśasya iti

yat ca idam ucyate jñāna karma samuccayāt mokṣaḥ iti tatra idam vaktavyam karmaṇām kīdṛśaḥ mokṣam pratyaṅga bhāvaḥ na hi tad sādhyaḥ mokṣaḥ svargāḥ divada nitya tva prasaṅgāt api ca ātmā eva svarūpa avasthitaḥ mokṣaḥ iti ucyate na ca ātma svarūpam karma sādhyam anādi nidhana tvena siddha tvāt
