nanu nitya karma ananuṣṭhāne pratyaveyāt iti tad dvāraka bandha parihāra upāya tvāt karma api mokṣa aṅgam syāt na sa nyāsa vidhānasya pratyakṣa upadeśa ādi tyukta tvāt aparipakva kaṣāyāṇām śanaiśśanaiḥ tad paripāka aupayika tvena karma anuṣṭhānam pāramparyeṇa apavarga upāyaḥ iti tu bāḍham abhyupagamyate yathā aaha manuḥ mahāyajñaiḥ ca yajñaiḥ ca brāhmī iyam kriyate tanuḥ iti adhyātma vidaḥ ca jñāna kāṇḍa aupayikam eva kriyā kāṇḍam manyante sākṣāt tu karma sādhye apavarge svarga vat apāyi tva prasaṅgāt kṛtakasya sarvasya anitya tvāt tattva jñānam eva mokṣa upāyaḥ iti uktam

yat api yama niyama ādi sādhyam aṅga bhūtam karma jātam tat api tad aṅga tām gacchan na vāryate tad kāryatve api yāvat guṇa praghvaṃsa abhāva svabhāva tvāt mokṣasya na kṣayitvam svarga vat anyaḥ tu na mokṣaḥ iti uktam tad pūrva ukta prakrameṇa apavarga prāpteḥ tattva jñānam eva abhyupāyaḥ karma tu aṅgam tatra śauca ādi kiṃcid kiṃcid tad syāt ātma saṃskāra pūrvam

āha tattva jñānam idānīm vicintyatām kiṃviṣayam tad apavargāya kalpate kutas vā tasya niḥśreyasa sādhana tvam avagatam iti nanu ātma jñānam apavarga hetuḥ iti bahuśas kathitam eva etat iti kaḥ ayam praśnaḥ na vipratipatteḥ vipra vadante hi atra vādinaḥ

ekaḥ eva ayam avidyā parikalpitaḥ jīva ātma parama ātma vibhāgaḥ paramātma tattva jñānāt avidyā apāye mokṣaḥ iti brahma vādinaḥ śabda advaita niścayāt iti vaiyākaraṇāḥ vijñāna advaita darśanāt iti śākya bhikṣavaḥ prakṛti puruṣa viveka vijñānāt iti pāramarṣāḥ īśvara praṇidhānāt iti ca anye tat evam kasmai tattva jñānāya spṛhayantu mumukṣavaḥ iti vācyam

ucyate bhinnāḥ tāvat ātmānaḥ iti gṛhyatām ātma jñānam eva niḥśreyasa aṅgam iti yat tu kutas tasya niḥśreyasa sādhana tvam avagatam iti akṣa pāda vacanāt iti brūmaḥ akṣapādaḥ tāvat evam upadiṣṭavān ātma jñānāt niḥśreyasa adhigamaḥ iti na ca niṣpramāṇakam artham eṣaḥ ṛṣiḥ upādiśat iti bhavitavyam atra pramāṇena tat tu vaidikam vidhi vākyam ātmā jñātavyaḥ iti

saḥ eṣa tāvat na niradhikāraḥ vidhiḥ adhikāra rahitasya ca vidheḥ prayoga yogya tva abhāvāt adhikāra anveṣaṇam upakramaṇīyam para prakaraṇa paripaṭhana virahāt ca na asya samidh ādhi vidhi vat pradhāna adhikāra niveśi tvam atas viśva jit adhikaraṇa nyāyena svarga kāmam adhikāriṇam iha yāvat upādātu madhyavasyāmaḥ tadā eva na sa punar āvartate iti arthavāda samarpitā iyam apunarāvṛttiḥ eva hṛdaya patham avatarati rātri satraḥ iva pratiṣṭhā iti tām eva asya phala tvena pratipadyāmahe sā ca iyam sādhyamānā api rūpāt eva hi śāśvatī cakāsti apunarāvṛttiḥ na svarga vat apāyinī

nanu dṛṣṭa prayojana alābhe sati adṛṣṭa prayojana parikalpana avasaraḥ iha ca dṛṣṭam eva prayojanam ātma jñānasya karma pravṛtti hetu tvam upalabhyate nityena ātmanā vinā bhūteṣu eva acetaneṣu śmaśāna avadhiṣu bahu vitta vyaya āyāsa sādhyāni kaḥ nāma jyotiṣṭoma ādi karmāṇi anutiṣṭhet iti nityaḥ eva ātmā para lokī jñātavyaḥ evam hi nirviśaṅkaḥ karmasu pravarteta iti tat idam anupapannam anyatas eva siddha tvāt pratyabhijñā pratyakṣa pratyayena jaiminīyaiḥ anumāna mahimnā ca naiyāyika ādibhiḥ ātmā nityaḥ iti niścitaḥ eva kim atra vidhiḥ kariṣyati iti kartavya tā kalāpa upadeśaḥ ca tadānīm atyanta niṣprayojanaḥ syāt

amī ca tathā nāma ati mahā antaḥ veda granthāḥ iyati eva paryavasannāḥ iti tat idam upanatam sā iyam mahataḥ vaṃśastambāt laṭvā aakṛṣyate iti tasmāt arthavāda samarpita mapunarāvṛtti rūpam eva phalam ātma jñāna vidhiḥ abalambataḥ iti evam kecid

sūkṣma darśinaḥ tu āhuḥ iyam arpi mahatī durgatiḥ yat artha vāda mukha prekṣi tvam asya uktam adhikāra vidheḥ viśvajiti rātri satre vā kim anyat kriyatām na hi viśva jit rūpa paryālocanataḥ kaścid adhikārī labhyate iti balāt svarga kāma ādiḥ kalpyate vā arthavāda samarpitaḥ vā abalambyate yatra tu vidhi svarūpa mahimnā eva tad upalambhaḥ tatra kim kalpanayā kim artha vāda vadana avalokana dainyena vā

iha ca svādhyāyaḥ adhyetavyaḥ iti vat agnīnāt adhītaḥ itivat vā kṛtyena dvitīyayā vai īpsitatama tva nirdeśāt tad niṣṭha tvam eva avatiṣṭhate tatra yathā agni artha tayā aadhāna vidhiḥ avagamyamānaḥ agnīnām anekavidha puruṣa arthaupayika karma kalāpa upayogāt tadā arjanena eva kṛtārtha tvam upagataḥ iti na phala antaram apekṣate yathā vā svādhyāyaḥ adhyetavyaḥ iti akṣara grahaṇa artha tvāt asya vidheḥ akṣara grahaṇasya ca phalavat karma avabodha dvāreṇa parama puruṣa artha upāya tva avadhāraṇāt na tad atirikta ghṛta madhu kulyādi phala antara apekṣi tvam na ca adhyāpana vidhi aṅga tvam sva mahimnā eva īpsitatama saṃskāra dvāraka adhikāra lābhāt evam iha api apahata pāpma ādi ātma svarūpa parijñānam eva tasya parama puruṣa artha tām avabodhayan asya vidheḥ anya prayojana tām āpādayati

kaścid kila saṃskāra vidhiḥ saṃskriyamāṇa niṣṭhaḥ api saṃskriyamāṇa prayojana apekṣayā para mukha prekṣī bhavati brīhīn prokṣati itivat kaścid tu saṃskriyamāṇa prayojanam alabhamānaḥ tad īpsita tama tva anirvahaṇāt saṃskāra vidhi tvam eva jahāti saktūn juhoti iti vat yathā uktam bhūta bhāvi upayogam hi dravyam saṃskāryam iṣyate saktavaḥ na upayokṣyante na upayuktāḥ ca te kvacid iti

yasya tu saṃskāryam anardham iva ratnam aparyuṣitam iva amṛtam anastamita iva candra bimbam aparimlānam iva śatapatram asti kaḥ tarhi prakaraṇa pāṭhā apekṣāyām arthavāda mukha prekṣaṇena phala kalpanāyām vā abhilāṣaḥ atas eva na kāma śruti prayukta tvam ādhānasya na ca ācārya karaṇa vidhi prayukta tvam adhyayanasya iti

tasmāt svādhyāya adhyayana agni ādhāna vidhi samāna yogakṣema tvāt ātma jñāna vidheḥ tad kṛtam ātma jñānam apavarga artham avagamyate tathāvidha svarūpaḥ ātmā eva para upādhi janita dharma rahitaḥ apavargaḥ iti ucyate yatas tat idam ittham ātma jñāna mā iva niḥśreyasa sādhanam ananya labhyam iti tat eva upadiṣṭavān ācāryaḥ akṣa pādaḥ yat tu vijñāna satta ātma śabda āt i advaita darśanam tat mithyājñānam eva iti na niḥśreyasa sādhanam iti

nanu katham advaita darśanam mithyā kathyate tat pratyuta dvaita darśanam avidyā māyā api mithyājñānam iti yuktam tathā hi pratyakṣam eva tāvat nipuṇam nirūpayatu bhavān tatra hi yat anya anapekṣa tayā jhagiti padārtha svarūpam avabhāsate tat pāramāthikam itarat kālpanikam iti gamyate sat rūpam eva ca ca tatra abhinnam anya nirapekṣam avabhāti bhedaḥ tu anya apekṣaḥ iti na akṣaja vijñāna viṣaya tām upayāti

tatra yathā mṛd ru upatātaḥ prabhṛti yāvat kumbha avasthā iti asmin antarāḷe āvirbhavatām tirobhavatām ca ghaṭa kapāla śakala śarkarā kaṇā ādīnām kāryāṇām rūpam aparama artha sat eva vyavahāra padavīm avatarati paramārthataḥ tu mṛttikā eva yathā aahuḥ mṛttikā iti eva satyam iti evam tat api mṛttikā rūpam sattā apekṣayā na paramārtha sat iti sattā eva sarvatra parama arthā tat eva sat lakṣaṇam brahma iti āhuḥ āgamaḥ ca ekam eva advitīyam ityādiḥ abhedam eva darśayati na iha nānā asti kiṃcana mṛtyoḥ sa mṛtyum āpnoti yaḥ iha nānā iva paśyati iti ca

na ca pratyakṣa viruddha tvam abheda śaṃsinaḥ vaktum śakyam āgamasya na hi anya niṣedhe pratyakṣam prabhavati sva rūpa mātra grahaṇe parisamāpta vyāpāra tvāt para rūpa niṣedham antareṇa ca bhedasya durupapāda tvāt bhede kuṇṭham eva pratyakṣam iti katham abheda grāhiṇam āgamam virundhyāt tad uktam āhuḥ vidhātṛ pratyakṣam na niṣeddhṛ vipaścitaḥ na ekatve āgamaḥ tena pratyakṣeṇa virudhyate

nanu yadi ekam eva brahma na dvitīyam kiṃcid asti tarhi tat brahma nitya śuddha buddha svabhāva tvāt muktam eva āste kena tat baddham iti kimarthaḥ ayam mumukṣuṇām prayatnaḥ kutastyaḥ vā ayam vicitra jagat avabhāsaḥ avidyā uccheda arthaḥ mumukṣu prayatnaḥ iti brūmaḥ tatas tyaḥ eva ayam vicitra jāgada vabhāsaḥ

kā iyam avidyā brahmaṇaḥ vyatiriktā ced na advaitam avyatireke tu brahmā eva sā tatas na anyā asti eṣa iti katham ucchidyeta mā evam vastunī dṛṃśi kutārkika codyāni kramante avidyā tu iyama vastu rūpā māyā mithyā avabhāsa svabhāvā abhidhīyate tattva agrahaṇam avidyā agrahaṇam ca nāma katham vastu dharmaiḥ vikalpyate

nanu tattva agrahaṇa rūpā api kasya iyam avidyā na hi brahmaṇaḥ nitya buddha svabhāva tvāt avidyā bhavati anyaḥ tu na asti eva tad āśrayaḥ na ca niradhikaraṇam eva mithyājñānam bhavitum arhati ucyate jīvātmanām avidyā na brahmaṇaḥ nanu ke te jīva ātmānaḥ te api brahmaṇaḥ anya ananyatayā cintyāḥ evaāḥ kṣudratārkika sarvatra anabhijñaḥ asi brahma eva jīva ātmānaḥ na tatas anye na hi dahana piṇḍāt bhedena api bhāntaḥ sphuliṅgāḥ agni svarūpāḥ na bhavanti

tat kim brahmaṇaḥ eva avidyā na ca brahmaṇaḥ avidyā yathā hi ekam eva ghaṭa ādi āvaraṇa upahita bheda tayā bhinnam iva vibhāti nabhaḥ paṭa ākāśam ghaṭākāśa miti tad āvaraṇa vaśāt eva ca rajaḥ dhūma ādi kaluṣitam api bhavati tad āvaraṇa viratau tu gaḷita kāluṣya male tatra eva parame vyomni līyate tathā eva jīvāḥ tmānaḥ api avidyā kalpita bhedāḥ tad kṛtam aneka prakāra kāluṣyam anubhavanti tad uparame ca pare brahmaṇi līyante iti

nanu evam sati api avidyā parikalpitaḥ eṣa brahma jīva ātma vibhāgaḥ sā ca jīvātmanām avidyā iti ucyate tat etat itaretara āśrayam āpadyate avidyā kalpanāyām satyām jīva ātmānaḥ jīvātmasu ca satsu avidyā iti bhavatu itaretara āśrayam avidyā prapaṃcaḥ eva ayam aśeṣaḥ kasya eṣa doṣaḥ yadi vā anādi tvam asya parihāraḥ bīja aṅkura vat bhaviṣyati bhavadbhiḥ api ca ayam anādiḥ eva saṃsāraḥ abhyupagataḥ avidyayā eva ca saṃsāraḥ iti ucyate

nanu anādeḥ avidyāyāḥ katham ucchedaḥ kim anādeḥ ucchedaḥ na bhavati bhūme rūpasya bhavadbhiḥ vā katham anādi ssaṃsāraḥ ucchedyate nanu upāye satyanādiḥ api ucchidyate advaitinām kaḥ tad uccheda upāyaḥ avidyā eva iti brūmaḥ śravaṇa manana nidhyāna ādiḥ api avidyā eva sā tu abhyasyamānā satī avidyā antaram utsādayati svayam api utsīdati yathā payaḥ payaḥ jarayati svayam ca jīryati viṣam viṣa antaram śamayati svayam ca śāmyati yathā vā dravya antara rajaḥ kṣiptam rajaḥ kaluṣite ambhasi tat ca ātmānam saṃhṛtya svaccham ambu karoti evam iyam avidyā eva avidyā antaram ucchindantī vidyā upāya tām pratipadyate

nanu sva rūpeṇa asatyaiva iyam avidyā katham satya kāryam kuryāt ucyate asatyāt api satya artha sampattiḥ upapatsyate māyā sarpa ādayaḥ dṛṣṭāḥ satya pralaya hetavaḥ rekhā gakāra ādayaḥ ca asatyāḥ satya artha prati iti upāyāḥ dṛśyante sva rūpeṇa satyāḥ te iti ced kim tena kriyate gakāra ādi tvena hi te pratipādakāḥ tat ca eṣām asatyam iti

nanu brahmaṇaḥ nitya śuddha tvāt jīvānām ca tatas ananya tvāt katham teṣu avidyā avakāśam labhate parihṛtam etat ghaṭa ākāśa dṛṣṭānta upavarṇanena api ca yathā viśuddham api vadana bimbam ambu maṇi kṛpāṇa darpaṇa ādi upādhi vaśena śyāma dīrgha sthūla ādi rūpam apāramārthikam eva darśayati tathā brahmaṇaḥ tad abhāve api jīveṣu tad avakāśaḥ iti

nanu paramātmanaḥ nitya tvāt jīvānām api anyonyam ananya tvam iti eka smin baddhe mukte vā sarve baddhāḥ muktāḥ vā syuḥ ayi kutarka kaluṣita mate katham bodhyamānaḥ api na budhyase ghaṭa ākāśe hi ghaṭa bhaṅgāt parama ākāśa pratiṣṭhe jāte na paṭa ākāśaḥ api tathā bhavati ekasya api jīva ātmanaḥ upādhi bhedāt sukha duḥkha anubhava bhedaḥ dṛśyate pāde me vedanā śirasi me vedanā iti tīvratara taraṇi tāpa upanatā tanutara klamasya ca yatra eva ca śariḥ āvayave śiśira haricandana sthāsakam uparacayati parijanaḥ tatra eva tad duḥkha uparama anubhavaḥ na anyatra iti evam ekasmin api paramātmani kalpa nāmā atra pratiṣṭheṣu api jīva ātmasu baddha mukta vyavasthā siddhi ati eva iti eka ātma vādaḥ eva ayam āgama anuguṇaḥ upagantum yuktaḥ na ānantyam ātmanām brahma darśanam eva atas niḥśreyasa nibandhanam bheda darśana mūḍhānām saṃsāra viratiḥ kutas iti

atra abhidhīyate kapaṭa nāṭaka rahasya prakriyā kūrca uparacane tad anuguṇa dṛṣṭānta parampara upapādane ca kim ucyate param kauśalam bhavatām pramāṇa vṛtta nirūpaṇe tu tapasvinaḥ eva bhavantaḥ tathā hi bhedasya pramāṇa bādhita tvāt kim ayam abheda abhyupagamaḥ bhavatām uta svid abhedasya eva pramāṇa siddha tvāt iti dvayam api na asti pratyakṣa ādīni hi sarvāṇi eva bheda pratiṣṭhāni pramāṇāni

yat tāvat bhedasya para apekṣa tvāt akṣaja jñāna gamyatā na asti iti tat ayuktam abhedasya sutarām para apekṣa tvāt mṛd piṇḍāt prabhṛti ghaṭa karpara cūrṇa paryanta kārya paramparā paricchede tad anugata mṛd rūpa tā grahaṇe ca sati mṛdaḥ tat abhinna rūpa tvam avadhāryeta na anyathā bhikṣavaḥ tu ācakṣate cākṣuṣam vyāvṛtta sva lakṣaṇa grāhi nābheda viṣayam abhedasya para apekṣa tvāt iti

ayam asmāt anyaḥ iti iyam para apekṣā pratītiḥ iti ced ayam asmin anusyūtaḥ iti iyam api para apekṣā eva tat atra bhavān bhikṣavaḥ ca dvau api durgraha upahatau bheda abheda grahaṇa nipuṇam akṣa jam iti parikṣitam etat vistarataḥ sāmānya cintāyām aṅguli catuṣṭayam hi pratibhāsamānam itaretara vivikta rūpam api anugata rūpam api prakāśate iti uktam vyāvṛttiḥ anuvṛttiḥ vā para apekṣā astu vastuṣu asaṅkīrṇa svabhāvāḥ tu bhāvāḥ bhānti akṣa buddhiṣu

yat api uktam āhuḥ vidhātṛ pratyakṣam na niṣeddhṛ iti tat api asādhu vidhātṛ iti kaḥ arthaḥ idam api vastu svarūpam gṛhṇāti na anya rūpam niṣedhati pratyakṣam iti ced mā evam jñānam tarhi na tat bhavet anya rūpa niṣedham antareṇa tad svarūpa paricchedasya api asampatteḥ pītā divi a vat chinnam hi nīlam nīlam iti gṛhītam bhavati na itarathā tathā ca āha tat paricchinatti anyat vyavacchinatti iti bhāvavat abhāvam api gṛhītum prabhavati pratyakṣam iti ca sādhitam asmābhiḥ eva etat tasmāt itaretara vivikta padārtha svarūpa grāhi tvā anna abheda viṣayaṃpratyakṣam

śabda anumānayoḥ tu saṃbandha grahaṇa adhīna sva viṣaya vyāpārayoḥ bhedam antareṇa svarūpam eva na avakalpate iti tau ubhau api bheda viṣayau eva viśeṣa viṣaya tva abhāve api liṅga sāmānyasya tad itara vilakṣaṇasya paricchedāt bheda viṣayam anumānam śabdasya tu pada ātmanaḥ tadvat ādi vācya bheda rūpasya tu paraspara uparakta padārtha puṃja svabhāvaḥ itara padārtha viśeṣita anyatama padārtha rūpaḥ vā vākya arthaḥ viṣayaḥ iti pūrvam eva nirūpitam atas sarvathā na bhedasya pramāṇa bādhita tvam na api abheda grāhi kiṃcana pramāṇam asti yathā uktena eva nyāyena
yaḥ tu āgamaḥ paṭhitaḥ ekam eva advitīyam na iha nānā asti kiṃcana ityādiḥ tasya artha vāda tvāt na yathāśrutaḥ eva arthaḥ grahītavyaḥ

nanu siddhe api arthe vedasya prāmāṇyam abhyupagatam eva bhavadbhiḥ bāḍham abhyupagatam kintu dhūmaḥ eva agnedivā dadṛśe na arciḥ iti evamādīnām pratyakṣāḥ diviruddha artha abhidhāyinām artha vādānām mukhyām vṛttim apahāya gauṇyā api vṛttyā vyākhyānam āśritam evam idam api vacanam itara pramāṇa viruddham artham abhidadhat anyathā vyākhyāyate

ye tu pramāṇa antara viruddha artha anuvādinaḥ na bhavanti artha vādāḥ teṣām astu svarūpe prāmāṇyam vāyuḥ vai kṣepiṣṭhāḥ devatāḥ iti evamādīnām tasmāt sukha duḥkha avasthā bhede api na avasthātuḥ ātmanaḥ bhedaḥ deha indriya ādi nānātve api vā na tasya nānātvam iti evam yathākathaṃcid ayam artha vādaḥ yojanīyaḥ abheda upadeśī tu tad paraḥ śabdaḥ vidhi rūpaḥ iha na asti eva evam āgama balāt api na advaita siddhiḥ

yat punar avidyā ādi bheda codyam āśaṅkya āśaṅkya parihṛtam tatra āśaṅkā sādhīyasī samādhānam tu na peśalam tattva anya tvābhyām anirvacanīyeyam avidyā iti kaḥ arthaḥ anādinā prabandhena pravṛttā aavaraṇa kṣamā yatna ucchedya api avidyā iyam asatī kathyate katham astitve kaḥ enām ucchindyāt iti ced kātara santrāsaḥ ayam satā mā iva hi vṛkṣa ādīnām ucchedaḥ dṛśyate na asatām śaśa viṣāṇa ādīnām tat iyam ucchedya tvāt avidyā nityā mā bhūt satī tu bhavati eva nityam na śakyam ucchettum sat anityam tu śakyate asattvam anyat anyā ca padārthānām anitya tā

na ca tattva agrahaṇa mātram avidyā saṃśaya viparyayau api avidyā eva tau ca bhāva svabhāva tvāt katham asantau bhavetām grahaṇa prāgabhāvaḥ api nāsa nniti śakyate vaktum abhāvasya api astitva samarthanāt iti sarvathā na asatī avidyā asattve ca niṣiddhe asyāḥ sattvam eva balāt bhavet sat asat vyatiriktaḥ hi rāśiḥ atyanta durlabhaḥ sattve ca dvitīyāyāḥ avidyāyāḥ bhāvān na advaitam

yat tu brahmaṇaḥ satata prabuddha tvāt avidyā kṣevatā na iti jīvānām avidyā āspada tvam abhihitam avidyā uparame brahmaṇi parame te eva ghaṭa ākāśa vallīyante iti ca tat api na caturaśram ākāśa avaccheda hetoḥ ghaṭa ādeḥ ghaṭamāna tvāt avidyāyāḥ tu asattvāt tad kṛtaḥ paramātmanaḥ avacchedaḥ iti viṣamaḥ dṛṣṭāntaḥ avacchedaka abhāvāt ca jīva vibhāga kalpanā api niravakāśa eva

yat ca itaretara āśraya tvam parihartum anādi tvam āveditam avidyāyāḥ tatra bīja aṅkura vat vādi antara upagata saṃsāra vat ca tasyāḥ satya tvam eva syāt anādi prabandha pravṛtta tve sattve ca asyāḥ pratikūla hetu antara upanipāta kṛtam apākaraṇam ucitam eka ātma vādinām tu tad ati durghaṭam iti anirmokṣaḥ eva syāt yathā aaha bhaṭṭaḥ svābhāvikīm avidyām ca na ucchettum kaścid arhati vilakṣaṇa upapāte hi naśyet svābhābikam kvacid na tu eka ātmā abhyupāyānām hetuḥ asti vilakṣaṇaḥ iti

yat punar avidyā eva vidyā upāyaḥ iti atra dṛṣṭānta parampara udghāṭanam kṛtam tat api kleśāya na artha siddhaye sarvatra upāyasya sva rūpeṇa sattvāt asataḥ kha puṣpa ādeḥ upāya tva abhāvāt rekhā gakāra ādīnām tu varṇa rūpa tayā sattvam yadi api na asti tathā api svarūpataḥ sattvam vidyate eva

nanu gakāraḥ ayam iti gṛhyamāṇaḥ sa rekhā āsanniveśaḥ artha pratyāyakaḥ bhavati na ca asau tena rūpeṇa asti mā evam sva rūpeṇa sataḥ arthasya rūpa anta reṇā api gṛhyamāṇasya kūṭa kārṣa āpaṇa ādeḥ iva vyavahāra hetu tā dṛśyate ca yuktā ca yaḥ tu svarūpataḥ eva na asti na tasya sva ātmanā para ātmanā vā vyavahāra aṅga tā samasti rekhā āsanniveśaḥ ca svarūpeṇa san iti varṇa ātma tvena āsan api tad kāryāya paryāpnuyāt na tu ayam avidyāyām nyāyaḥ sva rūpa asattvāt tasyāḥ

sarpa ādau tu sarpa ādi svarūpa vat tat jñānasya api tat kāryatvam avagatam atas eva śaṅkā viṣasya api sva śāstreṣu cikitsām upadiśanti evam vana guhā kuhara deśāt eṣa nissṛtaḥ kesarī saroṣa mitas eva abhivarttate iti asatye api ukte yat bhīrūṇām palāyana ādi śūrāṇām ca sa utsāham āyudha udyamana ādi satyam kāryam upalabhyate tatra siṃha jñānasya tad kāryatvāt na asataḥ eva upāya tvam etena pratibimba dṛṣṭāntaḥ api pratyākhyātaḥ khaṅga ādeḥ mukha ādi kāluṣya kalpanā kāraṇasya tatra sadbhāvāt iha tu tad abhāvāt iti

yat api baddha mukta vyavasthā siddhaye pāda vedana ādi udāhṛtam tat api evam apākṛtam avacchedakasya pāda ādeḥ tatra tāttvika tvāt iha tu bheda kalpanā bījam advaita vādinām durghaṭam iti bahuśas pradarśitam tat atra ayam vastu saṅkṣepaḥ avidyāyām asatyām sarve eva ayam yathā udāhṛtaḥ vyavahāra prakāraḥ tad kṛtaḥ iti na avatiṣṭhate satyām tu tasyām na advaita miti atas eva āha sūtrakāraḥ saṅkhyā ekānta asiddhiḥ pramāṇa upapatti anupapattibhyām iti

yadi tāvat advaita siddhau pramāṇam astiḥ tarhi tat eva dvitīyam iti na advaitam atha na asti pramāṇam na tarāma dvaitam aprāmāṇikāyāḥ siddheḥ abhāvāt iti mantra artha vāda uttha vikalpa mūla mad vaitavāda parihṛtya tasmāt upeya tām eṣa padārtha bhedaḥ pratyakṣa liṅga āgama gamyamānaḥ

etena śabdāt vaitavadaḥ api pratyuktaḥ anādi nidhanam brahma śabda tattvam yat akṣaram vivartate artha bhāvena prakriyā jagataḥ yatas iti ucyate tatra anādi nidhana pada niveditā pūrvā para anta rahitā vastu sattā nitya tvam brahma pada pratipāditam ca vyāpi tvam iti ubhayam api śabdasya prāk eva nirastam niravayavaḥ ca sphoṭa ātmā śabdaḥ pratikṣiptaḥ eva

yat tu nityam vyāpi ca kiṃcid ucyate tat śabda tattvam iti atra kā yuktiḥ āha śabda upagrāhya tayā ca śabda tattvam tathā hi sarva pratyayaḥ upajāyamānaḥ na anullikhita śabdaḥ upajāyate tad ullekha virahiṇaḥ anāsādita prakāśa svabhāvasya pratyayasya anutpanna nirviśeṣa tvāt evam īdṛśam iti ādi parāmarśa pramuṣita vapuṣi vedane vedanā ātmaka tā eva na bhavet

ye api vṛddha vyavahāra upayoga vaidhuryāt anavāpta śabda artha saṃbandha viśeṣa vyutpattayaḥ bāla dāraka prāyāḥ pramātāraḥ te aapi nūnam yat sat tat kim ityādi śabda jātam anullikhantaḥ na pratiyanti kim api prameyam atas śabda unmeṣa prabhāva prāpta prakāśa svabhāva tvāt sarva pratyayānām śabda anuviddham bodhaka tvam iti sarvam śabda tattvam iti avadhāryatām tat āha na saḥ asti pratyayaḥ loke yaḥ śabda anugamāt ṛte anuviddham iva jñānam sarvam śabdena gamyate iti

evam anabhyupagame tu saṃvidaḥ prakāśa śūnya tayā anadhigata viṣayaḥ sarve eva andha mūka prāyaḥ lokaḥ syāt āha ca vāc rūpa tā ced utkrāmet avabodhasya śāśvatī na prakāśaḥ prakāśeta sā hi pratyavamarśinī iti atas krameṇa tāvat evam bodhyase śabda ākhya viśeṣaṇa anuvedha viśeṣāḥ bhavāt sarvam nirvikalpakam indriya jam sa vikalpakam vā jñānam śabda viśiṣṭam artham avadyotayati gauḥ śuklaḥ gacchati iti jāti guṇa kriyā avacchinna viṣaya ava bhāsini pratyaye śabda viśiṣṭaḥ eva arthaḥ sphurati iti budhyasva

evam ced boddhum avatīrṇaḥ asi śabda ākhya viśeṣaṇa anuraktasya tasya viśeṣyasya svarūpam pṛṣṭaḥ śabdena eva darśayasi śabda aparityāga labdha prakāśa svarūpayā eva vā anubhūtyā anubhavasi iti saḥ api viśeṣyaḥ śabda rūpaḥ eva iti jānīhi tat evam śabdaḥ eva artha upārūḍhaḥ pratibhāti iti vyavatiṣṭhate ittham iyantam adhvānam ced prāptaḥ api tad adhunā yat upārūḍhaḥ śabdaḥ prakāśate tasya pṛthak pradarśayitum anubhavitum ca aśakya tvāt śabdaḥ eva tathā tathā pratibhāti iti śabda vivarte eva ayam arthaḥ na anyaḥ kaścid iti pratipattum arhasi yathā ca ayam indriya jeṣu pratibhāseṣu prakramaḥ tathā śābdeṣu api pratyayeṣu śabda viśiṣṭaḥ vā arthaḥ pravibhāti śabdaḥ vā artha ārūḍhaḥ śabdaḥ eva artha rūpeṇa vivartate iti gṛhyatām atas ca śabdabrahma idam ekam avidyā upādhi darśita vicitra bhedam avidyā uparame yathā avasthita svarūpam prakāśate iti yuktam

atra abhidhīyate na khalu prakāra trayam api idam upapadyate pada padārtha saṃbandha vyutpatti virahiṇām anavāpta śabda yojana avairūpya svarūpa mātra pratiṣṭha viśuddha vastu grahaṇa pravaṇa indriya ja pratyaya darśanāt vṛddha vyavahāra paricaya adhigata śabda artha saṃbandha saṃskṛta dhiyām api śabda smaraṇa saṃskāra prabodha hetu bhūta prathama uda bhūta viśuddha vastu avabhāsasya aparihārya tvāt yatra hi vastuni niviśamānaḥ śabdaḥ śabda vid vyavahāreṣu yaḥ avadhṛtaḥ tad darśane tad saṃskāra prabodhāt sa hi smṛti patham eti na anyathā iti

sāmānya śabdeṣu api yat tat kim ityādiṣu viśeṣa śabdeṣu iva sā eva vārtā teṣām api vyutpatti upayoga virahe vividha vana vihāri vihaṅga kūjita ādi vat artha pratīti hetutva anupapatteḥ sa vikalpa kadaśāyām api na vācaka viśiṣṭam vācyam mecaka guṇa khacitam iva kuvalayam avalokayati lokaḥ iti vistaraśaḥ pratyakṣa lakṣaṇe parīkṣitam etat āha ca na śabda abheda rūpeṇa buddhiḥ artheṣu jāyate prāk śabda āt yādṛśī buddhiḥ śabdāt api hi tādṛśī iti

saṃjñi tva mātram adhikamadhunā dhvani sannidhāne buddhisadhirohati na tat vi śiṣṭaḥ arthaḥ tasya hi na netreṇa na śrotreṇa na ubhābhyām na kevalam manasā vā grahaṇam upapadyate atiprasaṅgāt śabdaḥ hi aneka dharmake dharmiṇi ekatara dharma avadhāraṇa abhyupāyaḥ bhavati na tatra ātmānam āropayati na hi dīpa indriya prabhṛtayaḥ prati iti upāyāḥ tad upeye rūpa ādau ātmānam āropayanti atas eva tad upāya tva bhrama kṛtaḥ tad abheda vādaḥ api na yuktaḥ na hi upāyāt abhinna tvam tad upeyasya yujyate rūpasya na hi abhinna tvam dīpāt vā cakṣuṣaḥ api vā

api ca yadi śabdāt abhinnaḥ arthaḥ pratibhāti eva kaḥ adhyāsa arthaḥ abhede api śabda mayam eva viśvam iti tatra api kaḥ adhyāsa arthaḥ adhyāsa bhramaḥ tu vaiyākaraṇānām eka ākāra nirdeśa doṣa nirmitaḥ yathā aaha gauḥ iti eva hi nirdeśaḥ vācyaḥ tad buddhi vācinām iti kaḥ tvayā dṛṣṭaḥ arthaḥ iti pṛṣṭaḥ vakti gauḥ iti kīdṛśam te jñānam utpannam gauḥ iti kīdṛśam śabdam prayuktavān asi gauḥ iti tatas eṣā bhrāntiḥ vastutas tu viviktāḥ eva ete śabda jñāna arthāḥ tat uktam gavi sāsna ādi sat rūpā gādi rūpa abhidhāyake nirākāra ubhaya jñāne saṃvittiḥ paramārthataḥ iti

evam indriya jeṣu iva śābdeṣu api pratyayeṣu na śabda svarūpa madhyasyati iti yuktam yadi ca śabdaḥ sva rūpeṇa artham pratipādayati tadā akṣa śabdasya aikyāt devana vibhītaka ratha akṣeṣu tulyā pratītiḥ syāt na ca akṣa śabdāḥ bhinnāḥ iti vaktavyam svarūpa pratyabhijñāna anapāyāt tad uccāraṇe ca artha travyām saṃśaya darśanāt bhavati śabdayoḥ ca suptiṅantayoḥ tulya rūpa tvāt adhyāsa pakṣe tulya artha pratīti hetu tvam prāpnoti tathā ca siddha sādhya buddhiḥ saṃvedyamānā api nihnūyeta evam agāt iti aśvaḥ iti aja avayaḥ iti ādau api draṣṭavyam

śabdasya siddha rūpa tvāt tad adhyāsena artha buddha aviṣyamāṇāyām yajeta dadyāt juhuyāt iti ādau na kvacid sādhya buddhiḥ bhavet siddha adhyāsena sādhya buddheḥ ananurūpa tvāt jāti guṇa kriyā śabdāḥ ca gauḥ śuklaḥ gacchati ityādayaḥ kena kāraṇena niyata madhyāsam anurundhataḥ iti na avagacchāmaḥ śabdasya artha an apekṣa nisarga siddha vaiśva rūpya kalpanā bīja abhāvāt pratiniyata śabda vṛtteḥ ca kasyacid lakṣaṇasya anupalakṣaṇāt vṛkṣa plakṣa śabdayoḥ ca ghaṭa paṭa śabdayoḥ iva svarūpa bhedāḥ viśeṣāt artha anapekṣi tvāt ca viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāva sāmānādhikaraṇye śabda adhyāsa vādinaḥ na bhavetām na hi ekatra vastuni vācye kvacid anayoḥ śabdayoḥ vṛttiḥ etena nīlotpalam api pratyākhyātam

tatra etat syāt na nīla guṇa viśeṣitam idam utpalam nāma kiṃcid asti viśeṣyam api tu tat nirasta avayava artham aśva karṇa ādi vat artha antaram eva idam vyutpatti prakāra mātram tu viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāva varṇanam iti tat etat asamī cīnam anubhūyamāna avayava artha pratīti nihna va nirmitta anupalambhāt aśva karṇa ādau hi yuktam artha antara tvam tatra hi na aśva arthaḥ na karṇa arthaḥ niravayava vākya artha vādaḥ ca prāk eva vistareṇa nirastaḥ iti alam punarukta ālāpena

atha śabda dvaya adhyāsa mātra nibandhanam eva sāmānādhikaraṇyam vṛkṣaḥ plakṣaḥ iti ucyate tat api na cāru vṛkṣaḥ taruḥ iti paryāyayoḥ api tad saṃbhave sati sāmānādhikaraṇya prasaṅgāt api ca paryāyeṣu hastaḥ karaḥ pāṇiḥ ityādiṣu śabda rūpa bheda adhyāsa pakṣe artha buddhi bhedaḥ prāpnoti na ca asau asti iti na adhyāsaḥ

kiṃca saṃbandha grahaṇa nirapekṣaḥ api śabdaḥ sva sāmarthyam anurudhyamānaḥ svādhyāsena buddhim vidadhyāt tad apekṣāyām vā kasya kena saṃbandhaḥ iti na budhyāmahe śabdāt arthasya pṛthak vyavasthita ātmanaḥ tvad mate durlabha tvāt śabda vyatirikta artha upagame vā kim anena śabda adhyāsa samartha nāḍambareṇa viramyatām atas mṛgatṛṣṇā anusaraṇa raṇikāt

api ca adhyāsaḥ kvacid sādṛśyāt bhavati śuktau iva rajatasya kvacid anurāgāt bhavati lākṣāyāḥ iva sphaṭike śabda arthayoḥ mūrtā mūrta tayā ati dūra bhinna svarūpayoḥ sādṛśyam tāvat anupapannam anurāgaḥ api tatas eva durghaṭaḥ pṛthak deśa tvāt bhinna indriya grāhya tvāt ca

pratibimba varṇanam api na sundaram dūra deśa tvena śabda arthayoḥ prāpti abhāvāt aprāptayoḥ ca pratibimbe dvāraka udyāna nivāsi vāsudeva sundarī vadana tāmarasāni sāgara taraṅga pavana paricaya cala dala kalati kālān chitāni su accheṣu jyotsnā avadāta dyutiṣu tuṣāra giri gahvara gata tuhina śilā karpūra darpaṇeṣu pratibimbitāni dṛśyeran atha sarva gata tvena śabdānām artha deśe prāptiḥ abhidhīyate tarhi sakala śabda sārtha sādhāraṇyāt atyantam adhyāsasā aṅkaryam anavadhāryamāṇa viśeṣa niyama kāraṇam āpadyate iti alam ati prasaṅgena sarvathā na saṃbaddhaḥ śabda adhyāsa vādaḥ

vivartavādaḥ api na samaṃjasaḥ tathā hi vivartate artha bhāvena iti kaḥ arthaḥ na tāvat artha ātmanā śabdaḥ pariṇāmam upayāti kṣīram iva dadhi rūpeṇa pariṇāmi tvena vikāritayā vā kṣīra ādeḥ iva anitya tva prasaṅgāt tathā abhāve api ca na advaita siddhiḥ dadhnaḥ iva kṣīra vikārasya śabda vikārasya arthasya tatas anya tvāt anya tvāt ca bādha kāraṇa kāluṣya ādi upaplava viraha pratīti samarpita bheda tvāt

atha artha pratibhāsam asatyam api indra jāla vat upadarśayati śabdaḥ iti ayam vivartaḥ arthaḥ saḥ api na yuktaḥ bāhyasya vastunaḥ pada abhidheyasya jāti vyakti ādeḥ vākya vācyasya api bhāvanā ādeḥ pūrva prasādhita tvāt avayava vyādeḥ ca adūraḥ eva agre samarthayiṣyamāṇa tvāt na ca indrajāla māyā ādi vat ayathārtha tāyām iha kim api kāraṇam utpaśyāmaḥ

atha artha rūpeṇa śabdaḥ śuktiḥ iva rajata ākāratayā avabhāsate iti iyam vivarta vācaḥ yuktiḥ iyam api na sādhīyasī śuktikā hi rajata vat prakāśataḥ iti śakyam vaktum śukteḥ ākāra sārūpyeṇa tathā avabhāsa sambhavāt iha tu śabda arthayoḥ atyanta visadṛśa vapuṣoḥ ākāra samāropakāraṇa anavadhāraṇāt katham itara rūpeṇa itarasya avabhāsaḥ śuktikā rajata ādiṣu ca bādhaka vaśāt tathātvam avagatam iha tu na bādhakam kiṃcid bhavati bhaviṣyati vā iti varṇitam

atha sva anuvedham ajahat satyām asatyām vā artha buddhim ādadhāti śabda tyayam vivarta arthaḥ eṣaḥ api saṃprati eva pratikṣiptaḥ śabda anuvedha virahiṇīnām prācuryeṇa pratipattīnām pradarśita tvāt na ca anyaḥ kaścid vipaścit cetasi vivartate vivarta prakāraḥ iti avācakam ucyate vivartate artha bhāvena iti

atha śabdabrahmā eva sṛjati jagat iti ayam vivarta prakāraḥ ucyate saḥ api na samyak acetana tvena śabdasya īśvarasya iva sraṣṭṛ tvā anupapatteḥ na ca paramāṇu vadasya kāraṇa tvam avayava samavāyi tvena pṛthivī ādeḥ kāryasya grahaṇāt atha vijñānam ānandam brahma iti āgama vacanam anusara tā vibhu tvam iva cetana tvam api śabdabrahmaṇaḥ varṇyate tarhi īśvarasya eva śabdabrahma iti nāma kṛtam syāt

yat api ucyate dve brahmaṇī veditavye śabdabrahma param ca yat śabdabrahmaṇi niṣṇātaḥ param brahma adhigacchati iti tadā api brahma subhikṣam atyantam alaukikam ekatarasya brahmaṇaḥ kālpa nika tvāt aka alpa nika tve vā katham advaita vādaḥ tasmāt kṛtam anena śabdabrahmaṇā svasti parasmai brahmaṇe bhūyāt avidyā māyā vinirmita vividha bheda prathana kalpaḥ ca sattā dvaita dūṣaṇa avasara eva nivāritaḥ iti śabda advaitam api tad bada samaṃjasam iti siddham

etena paramātma upādāna tvam api pratyuktam paramātmanaḥ nisarga nirmalasya evaṃprāya kaluṣa vikāra kāraṇa tva anupapatteḥ asatyam eva vikāra jātam avidyātaḥ paramātmani vibhāti iti etat api dūṣitam atas sarvathā na advaitapakṣaḥ kaścid anavadyaḥ

atha sarva prāṇinām ekaḥ eva ātmā na nānā ātmānaḥ iti īdṛśam ucyate tat api apramāṇakam ekasmin sukhini na sarve sukhinaḥ ekasmin duḥkhite na sarve duḥkhitāḥ iti vyavasthā darśanāt ātma para vyavahārasya ca sarva jana pratīti siddhasya durapahnava tvāt anya dṛṣṭe ca sukha duḥkha sādhane vastuni smaraṇa anusandhāna pūrvaka icchā dveṣa ādi kārya jātasya anyatra anupalambhāt ekasmin ca vīta rāge mokṣam āsāditavati saṃsāriṇām anyeṣām ānantya darśanāt ahaṃpratyayasya pratyagātma vṛtteḥ paratra asambhavāt jagat vaicitryasya ca puruṣa bheda niyata dharma nibandhanasya anyathā anupapatteḥ ātma bhedasya vispaṣṭa siddha tvāt tapta loha sphuliṅka ghaṭa ākāśa pāda vedanā ādi dṛṣṭānta kadambakasya ca niṣedhaḥ kṛtaḥ eva iti eka ātmavādaḥ api na yuktimān iti alam vistareṇa

śabdasya ayam vivartaḥ katham akhilam iti prasphurat tad vivikta su a ākāraḥ artha prapaṃcaḥ katham iva vikṛtiḥ brahmaṇaḥ vedṛśī syāt tasmāt na anātma tattvaḥ paricita sat asat karma pāka anusāra prādurbhūteśvara icchā vaśa vicala daṇu prodbhavaḥ bhūta sargaḥ

evam sthiteṣu sarveṣu tūṣṇīm advaita vādiṣu vidvān ādvaita vādī tu punar pratyavatiṣṭhate satyam anupajananam anapāyam aparimitam advayam brahma na yuktimat iti yuktaḥ eva tad anabhyupagamaḥ vijñānam eva tu kṣaṇikam upajanana apāya dharmakam anādi santāna prabandha pravṛtam idam tathā tathā avabhāti iti na tatas advitīyam artha rūpam nāma kiṃcid asti iti paśyāmaḥ

nanu pratyakṣa ādinā pramāṇena paraspara visadṛśa padārtha svarūpa saṃvedanasya darśita tvāt katham vijñānasya ayam avabhāsaḥ artha abhāve tad svarūpa anupapatteḥ grāhya grahaṇam hi nāma vijñānam bhavati na grahaṇa grahaṇam iti ucyate idam tāvat parīkṣyatām yat etat pratyakṣa vijñānam nīlam idam pītam idam iti utpadyate tatra kim ekaḥ ākāraḥ prakāśate uta dvitayam iti

yadi dvitayam avabhāti ayam arthaḥ nīlam idam tat jñānam iti tat kim atra vicāryate jitam bhavadbhiḥ jitasya yat ā āpadyate tat asmāsu vidhīyatām atha ekaḥ eva ayam ākāraḥ prathate tarhi asti vicāra avasaraḥ kasya ayam ākāraḥ kimarthasya kim jñānasya iti sa ca evam vicāryamāṇaḥ ākāraḥ yadi arthasya iti tat bhavantaḥ jeṣyanti jñāna ākāra pakṣe tu vayam jeṣyāmaḥ iti

kim tāvat atra yuktam jñānasya ayam ākāraḥ iti kutas kalpanā tāvat iha alpīyasi iti artha ākāra pakṣe hi arthasya jaḍa ātmanaḥ prakāśa ayogāt grāhya tvam anyathā na syāt iti grāhaka antara kalpanā avaśyaṃbhāvinī iti kalpanāt vaiguṇyam atha arthaḥ eva grāhya ātmā yaḥ saḥ eva grāhakaḥ iti kathyate sa tarhi prakāśaḥ eva iti saṃjñāyām eva vivādaḥ syāt bāhya abhyantara kṛtaḥ viśeṣam iti ced aho viśeṣa jñaḥ devānāṃpriyaḥ grāhakāt vicchinna tā hi grāhyasya bāhya tā na śarīra apekṣiṇaḥ bāhya tā bhavati yadā ca grāhyāt arthāt avyatiriktaḥ eva grāhakaḥ iṣyate tadā asya na tatas vicchinna tā iti abāhya tvāt jñānam eva tat iti katham na nāmni vivādaḥ ubhaya siddha tvāt jñānasya tasya ayam ākārī bhavitum arhati jñāne hi na kecana vivadante atas tasya eva ayam ākāraḥ iti yuktam aneka kalpanātaḥ hi eka artha kalpanā jyāyasi iti

atas ca jñānasya ayam ākāraḥ jñānam hi prakāśakam aprakāśasya arthasya bhavadbhiḥ abhyupagamyate tatas ca arthāt prathamataram asya grahaṇena bhavitavyam agṛhītasya dīpa ādeḥ prakāśasya prakāśaka tvā darśanāt utpanneṣu api ca ghaṭa ādiṣu artheṣu prakāśa vaikalyāt vā pratibandha vaidhuryāt vā bhavati agrahaṇam jñānasya tu utpannasya sataḥ na kiṃcid grahaṇe pratibandhakaḥ na ca prakāśaka antara apekṣaṇam svatas eva dīpa vat prakāśa svabhāva tvāt atas yadā eva tasya utpādaḥ tadā eva grahaṇam avaśyam bhavet na ced kāla antare api na syāt

kim hi tasya kāla antare bhaviṣyati kim vā tadā na abhūt yena tat kāla antare grahīṣyate tadā ca na gṛhyate iti jñāna antareṇa kāla antare tat grahīṣyate iti ced tat api kena grāhi iṣyate anyena iti ced tat api anyena iti kaḥ avadhiḥ śramaḥ iti ced kāmam śrāntaḥ viraṃsyati bhāvan artham tu na gṛhītavān eva prakāśa agrahaṇe tad prakāśya pariccheda ayogāt iti evam na kadācid artha grahaṇam syāt tasmāt artha grahaṇa vādinā api pūrvam jñāna grahaṇam avaśya āśrayaṇīyam yathā uktam apratyakṣa upalambhasya na artha dṛṣṭiḥ prasidhyati iti

atas ca etat evam jñāna pṛṣṭhena ca uttara kāla bhāvi pratyavamarśa darśanāt jñātaḥ mayā ayam arthaḥ iti hi pratyavamṛśantaḥ pramātāraḥ prathamam jñāna grahaṇam anumodante na hi agṛhīta viśeṣaṇā viśeṣya buddhiḥ bhavati tasmāt api pūrvam jñāna grahaṇam iti siddham jñānam ca gṛhyamāṇam ākāra rahitam grahītum aśakyam iti balāt sa ākāram eva tat grahītavyam sa ākāre ca jñāne gṛhīte sati dvitīya kāraṇa abhāvāt kutas jñāna atiriktaḥ bāhyaḥ arthaḥ

itas ca sa ākāram jñānam ākāravat tām antareṇa asya pratikarma vyavasthā anupapatteḥ kalpayitvā api bāhyam artham avaśyam ākāravat tā vijñānasya viṣaya niyama siddhaye vaktavyā nīla jñānam hi idam aneka sannidhāne samupajāyamānam katham akhila taditara padārtha parihāreṇa kevala nīla ālambanatām avalambeta bodha svabhāva tāyāḥ sarvān pratyaviśiṣṭa tvāt pravṛttiḥ api prekṣā pūrva kāriṇām katham tad eka viṣayā eva syāt na ca nīla janita tva kṛtaḥ eṣa tad adhigama niyamaḥ iti kathayitum ucitam āloka locana ādi kāraka antara janita tvasya api bhāvena tad viṣaya tva prasaṅgāt atas nīla ākāra tā eva nīla viṣaya tva vyavasthā hetuḥ na nimitta antaram āha ca tatra anubhava mātreṇa jñānasya sadṛśa ātmanaḥ bhāvyate anātmanā yena pratikarma vibhajyate iti

atas eva ākāra grahaṇam eva atiśayam āśritya tam abartha samarthane sati sādhakatamam jñānam eva pramāṇam bhaviṣyati aparathā kāraka atiśaya darśana abhāve tad tad sādhakatama tvasya durupapāda tvāt sa ākāra jñāna sākṣī ca laukikaḥ api dṛśyate vyavahāraḥ evam ca vaktāraḥ bhavanti laukikāḥ nīlaḥ arthaḥ ayam yatas atra tat ākāram jñānam utpannam iti tena pratikarma niyamāni atha anupapatteḥ avaśyam sa ākāram eva jñānam ittham sati api bāhye arthe jñānasya ākāra kalpanā bhavet eva iti tatra eva santuṣya sthīyatām varam

ye tu bruvante jñānasya svatas svaccha tva bhāva tvena nīla pīta ādi avabhāsaḥ para upādhiḥ eva bhavitum arhati sphaṭikasya iva lākṣā ādinā aruṇim a ādi anuvedhaḥ atas pṛthak ananubhūyamānaḥ api bāhyaḥ arthaḥ sa ākāra jñāna avabhāsā anyathā anupapattyā anumīyate yathokatam bāhya siddhiḥ syāt vyatirekataḥ iti tat idam anupapannam anvaya anupalabdheḥ arthe hi sati sa ākāram nirākāram tat atyaye nitya anumeya bāhya artha vādī jñānam kva dṛṣṭavān lākṣā sphaṭika ādau tu tathā yuktam tad anurakta sphaṭika śakala avalokanāt iha punar arthena rajyamānam hi nirākāram nisargataḥ jñānam na khalu paśyāmaḥ lākṣayā sphaṭikam yathā

ākāra dvaya pratibhāsaḥ hi na asti iti uktam abhyupagame vā su dusta ramanavasthā t ūṣaṇam artha ākāraḥ ca pratyakṣaḥ tad kṛtaḥ ca jñāna ākāraḥ pratyakṣaḥ iti ucyamāne artha ākāraḥ tāvat sa ākāreṇa jñānena gṛhītaḥ saḥ idānīm jñāna ākāraḥ api grāhya tvāt sa ākāra jñāna antaram bhavet tat api sa ākāram jñāna antaram tathābhūta jñāna antara grāhyam eva syāt iti aniṣṭam atha sva prakāśam tat sa ākāram jñānam iṣyate tena jñāna antara anapekṣaṇāt na anavasthā iti tarhi sva prakāśa sa ākāra jñāna vyatirikta artha ākāra anavabhāsāt tat eva astu kutas dvitīyaḥ idānīm artha ākāraḥ

na ca anyathā anupapattyā api tad kalpanā yuktimatī na hi rāja śāsanam idam arthena ākāravatā bhavitavyam iti jñānam eva nīla ādi ākāram yadi bhavet kaḥ doṣaḥ syāt iti nīla ādi ākāra yogāt arthassa bhavet iti ced saṃjñāyām vivādaḥ iti uktam dvitīyasya abhāvāt svaccha tvāt jñānasya kāluṣyam anya kṛtam yuktam iti ced avidyā vāsanā akṛtam tat bhaviṣyati svatas svaccham api jñānam anādya vidyā vāsanā vibhava upanatam aneka ākāra kāluṣya rūṣita vapuḥ iva prakāśate jñāna vāsanā bheda santānayoḥ ca bīja aṅkura vat anādi tvāt na atra paryanuyogasya avasaraḥ kutas vāsanā pravṛttāḥ iti tasmāt anādi vāsanā vaicitrya racita jñāna vaicitrya upapatteḥ kṛtam anumeyena api bāhyena arthena iti jñānasya eva ayam ākāraḥ iti siddham

atas ca jñānasya eva ayam ākāraḥ jñānena vinā hi na kvacid artha rūpam upalabhyate jñānam tu artha rahitam api gandharvanagara māyā ādiṣu vispaṣṭam upalabhyate iti anvaya vyatirekābhyām api jñāna ākāra tvam avagacchāmaḥ yadi ca jñānāt arthaḥ pṛthak avasthita ātmā bhavet jñānam antareṇa api asau upalabhyeta na ca evam asti tasmāt abhedaḥ eva jñāna arthayoḥ yat āha saha upalambha aniyamāt abhedaḥ nīla tad dhiyoḥ iti

na ca jñāna artha saṃsarga dharmaḥ ākāraḥ bhavitum arhati yadi hi pṛthak artham anākāram pṛthak ca jñāna mānākāraḥ upalabhya saṃsṛṣṭayoḥ jñānayoḥ ākāravat tā mupalabhemahi tatas imam ākāram saṃsarga dharmam pratipadyemahi na tu ayam asti kramaḥ artha rahita tve api ca smaraṇa svapna ādi jñānānām ākāravat tvam asti iti uktam atas katham saṃsarga dharmaḥ ākāraḥ

api ca nakṣatram tārakā tiṣyaḥ iti katham ekasmin arthe paraspara viruddha liṅga samāveśaḥ parivrājaka kāmuka kauleyakānām ca katham ekaḥ eva vanitā rūpaḥ arthaḥ kuṇapaḥ iti kāminī iti bhakṣyam iti ca pratibhāsa tritaya viṣaya tām anubhavet dārāḥ iti katham ekā eva strī vyaktiḥ puṃvacana bahu vacana viṣaya tām yāyāt ṣaṇṇagariti ca katham bahanām anya liṅgānām ekatā strī liṅga tā ca bhavet hrasva dīrghayoḥ ca katham paraspara apekṣa grahaṇayoḥ arthena ekataraḥ ākāraḥ pāramārthikaḥ syāt jñānānām tu bhinna tvāt vicitra vāsanābheda sahakāri rūpa anuvidhānena jāyamānānām na kiṃcid api virodhaḥ

tasmāt jñānam eva idam sarvatra tathā tathā pratibhāti na tad vyatiriktaḥ arthaḥ nāma kiṃcid iti jñānaḥ eva ca ekatra ayam pramāṇa prameya pramiti vyavahāraḥ parisamāpyate tasya hi viṣaya ākāra tā prameyam grāhaka ākāra tā prāmāṇam sva saṃvittiḥ ca phalam iti yathā uktam yadābhāsam prameyam tat pramāṇa phalate punar grāhaka ākāra saṃvittyoḥ trayam na atas pṛthakkṛtam iti

tat idam anādya vidyā vāsanā vilāsa viparyāsita tattva darśana tayā jñānam eva grāhya grāhaka saṃvitti bheda vat iva lakṣyate avidyā viratau tu svaccham eva tad saṃpadyate na kiṃcid vā iti tat uktam na anyaḥ anubhāvyaḥ buddhyā asti tasyāḥ na anubhavaḥ aparaḥ grāhya grāhaka vaidhuryāt svayam sā eva prakāśate tathā avibhāgaḥ api buddhi ātmā viparyāsita darśanaiḥ grāhya grāhaka saṃvitti bhedavān iva lakṣyate iti artha rūpa rahitam saṃvid mātram kila idam iti paśyan parihṛtya duḥkha santatim abhayam nirvāṇam āpnoti

atra abhidhīyate na khalu ekaḥ eva bodha ātmā grāhya grāha katayā ubhaya svabhāvaḥ bhavitum arhati grāhya grāhaka rūpayoḥ ita retara vi sadṛśa tvena ekatra samāveśa anupapatteḥ tathā hi nīla jñānam pīta jñānam śukla jñānam iti nīla pīta ādi upajanana apāye api anuvartamāna bodha rūpa tayā nīla ādi vilakṣaṇam anvaya vyatirekābhyām avadhāryate api ca jñānam ahaṃkāra āspadam ānanda ādi svabhāvam sva karmaṇi ca sa vyāpāram iva bhavadbhiḥ abhyupagatam arthaḥ tu na evam ātmakaḥ iti katham anayoḥ abhedaḥ

yadi api jñānam idam ayam arthaḥ iti evam ākāra dvaya pratibhāsaḥ na asti tathā api ayam ekaḥ api ākāraḥ pratibhāsamānaḥ prakāśya eva pratibhāti na prakāśakaḥ idam nīlam iti grāhakāt vicchinnaḥ eva grāhya ākāraḥ avabhāsate na tu aham nīlam iti tad aikyena avabhāsaḥ asti iti api ca prakāśyasya nīla ādeḥ prakāśaka bodha adhīnam yuktam nāma grahaṇam bodhasya tu tad grāhakasya tadā kiṃkṛtam grahaṇam iti cintyam na bodha antara nibandhanam anavasthā prasaṅgāt na api sva prakāśam jñānam aham nīlam iti apratibhāsāt

nanu na eva grāhya grāhakayoḥ anyatvam iti yaḥ ayam grāhya avabhāsaḥ iti bhavatā abhyupagataḥ saḥ eva grāhaka avabhāsaḥ grāhakāt anyaḥ ahi grāhyaḥ jaḍa ātmā bhavet grāhakaḥ tu prakāśa svabhāvaḥ grāhaka tvāt eva dvaya pratibhāsaḥ ca na asti iti uktam tatra anyatarasya pratibhāsane jaḍa prakāśayoḥ katarasya avabhāsitum yuktam iti cintāyām balāt prakāśaḥ eva prakāśate na jaḍaḥ nirākāraḥ ca na prakāśaḥ prakāśate iti tasmin sa ākāre prakāśyamāne kutas jaḍa ātmā tat atiriktaḥ arthaḥ syāt

tat idam apeśalam upāyena upeya nihnavasya aśakya karaṇīya tvāt rūpasya hi prakāśakam cakṣuḥ na cakṣuḥ eva prakāśa tām iti uktvā rūpam apahnotum śakyate tat idam arthasya mūrti drava tva kāṭhinī ādi dharma viśeṣita ātmanaḥ tad viparīta svaccha svabhāvam jñānam prakāśakam na tat eva cakṣuḥ vat tadā avabhāsitum arhati ca

nanu cakṣuḥ vat upāya tvam jñānasya prakāśa svabhāva tvāt cakṣuḥ janyaḥ hi prakāśaḥ nāma jñānam ucyate na ca agṛhītaḥ prakāśaḥ prakāśyam prakāśayati iti satyam vakṣuḥ janyaḥ prakāśaḥ jñānam iṣyate sa tu prakāśaḥ rūpa ādi viṣaya prakāśaḥ na prakāśa prakāśaḥ na hi cakṣuṣā prakāśaḥ prakāśyate api tu rūpam prakāśyate tatra yat rūpam ucyate sa viṣayaḥ grāhyaḥ yat tat prakāśate iti ucyate sa prakāśaḥ jñānam grāhakam tad utpatti mātreṇa ca rūpam prakāśitam bhavati iti na prakāśaḥ grahaṇam apekṣate

nanu uktam atra na anupalabdhāyām buddhau arthaḥ prakāśate apratyakṣa upalambhasya na artha dṛṣṭiḥ prasidhyati iti tat ayuktam apratyakṣa upalambhasya ca pratyuta artha dṛṣṭiḥ prasiddhyati upalambha utpādaḥ eva artha dṛṣṭiḥ na punar upalambha dṛṣṭiḥ nanu upalabdheḥ agrahaṇe tad utpāda nutpādayoḥ aviśeṣāt anutpanna upalambhasya api arthaḥ pratyakṣaḥ syāt iti sarva sarvajña tva prasaṅgaḥ tat idam ati subhāṣitam artha prakāśa ātmā eva khalu upalambhaḥ sa katham utpannāt anutpannaḥ na viśiṣyeta tasmāt artha pratyakṣīkaraṇa ātmaka tvāt jñānasya tad utpādaḥ eva artha pratyakṣa tā na tat grahaṇam iti agṛhītam eva jñānam artha prakāśakam iti yuktam am

yat tu upāya tvāt jñānasya pūrvam grahaṇam ucyate tat cakṣuḥ ādibhiḥ anaikāntikam iti uktam gṛhītam yadi ca jñānam bhavet artha prakāśakam dhūma vat dīpa vat vā iti vaktavyam yadi dhūma vat bhavet artha anumeya tvam tattvayā eva ca dūṣitam ākāra dvaya saṃvitti virahāt na ca dīpa vat ghaṭam dīpena paśyāmi iti asti dvitaya vedanam na tu jñānena vijñeyam jānāmi iti dvaya grahaḥ

yat api prakāśa tvāt jñānasya pradīpa vat pūrvam grahaṇam uktam tat api vyākhyeyam prakāśa tvāt iti kaḥ arthaḥ prakāśayati iti prakāśaḥ tasya bhāvaḥ prakāśa tvam iti tat cakṣuḥ ādibhiḥ anaikāntikam uktam eva atha prakāśanam prakāśaḥ tarhi prakāśa tvāt iti asiddhaḥ hetuḥ na hi artha grahaṇa kāle buddheḥ prakāśanam asti atha prakāśa śabdaḥ bodha paryāyaḥ eva prakāśa tvāt bodha rūpa tvāt iti arthaḥ tadā sādhana vikalaḥ dṛṣṭāntaḥ pradīpasya bodha rūpa tva abhāvāt atas ca sva saṃvedana pakṣaḥ na yukti yuktaḥ svatas prakāśasya kasya cit api adṛṣṭa tvāt

nanu jñāna śabda dīpāḥ trayaḥ sva para prakāśāḥ iti āhuḥ tat ayuktam śabda dīpayoḥ sva grahaṇe artha prakāśane ca sāmagryanta rasa vyapekṣa tvāt śabdaḥ artha prakāśane samaya grahaṇam apekṣate sva prakāśane tu śrotram dīpaḥ api cakṣuḥ ādi apekṣaḥ eva gṛhyate grāhayati ca artham iyān tu viśeṣaḥ ghaṭa ādi grahaṇe āloka sāpekṣam cakṣuḥ pravartate āloka grahaṇe tu nirapekṣam iti na etāvatā dīpasya sva prakāśa tā syāt ittham ca mārjāra ādi naktaṃcara cakṣuḥ apekṣayā sarve eva ghaṭa ādayaḥ sva prakāśāḥ syuḥ

jñānasya para prakāśaka tvam eva dṛśyate na sva prakāśaka tvam artha prakāśa kāle tad aprakāśasya darśita tvāt mudhā eva nasmāt bhaṇitaḥ te ete trayaḥ prakāśāḥ sva para prakāśāḥ pradīpa bodha dhvani nāmadheyāḥ vibhinna sāmagrī abhivedya vedakāḥ ātma pratyakṣa vādinām tu avasthā bhedena grāhya grāhaka aṃśayoḥ bhedaḥ vidyate eva iti sarvathā na sva prakāśam jñānam

yat api abhihitam utpadyamānam eva jñānam anapekṣa tvāt apratibandha tvāt ca tadā eva gṛhyate na vā kadācid iti tat api asāṃpratam tadānīm tad grahaṇa sāmagrya bhāvāt na ca avibandha mātreṇa pratītiḥ avakalpate upāya viraheṇa api tadā jñānasya na grahaḥ na ca jaiminīyāḥ iva vayam jñānam nitya parokṣam ācakṣmahe jñātaḥ mayā ayam arthaḥ iti kāla antare tad viśiṣṭa artha grahaṇa darśanāt

śuklaḥ paṭaḥ iti jñāne yathā asau bhāti tad guṇaḥ tathā jñātaḥ arthaḥ iti atra bhāti arthaḥ dhī viśeṣaṇaḥ na viśeṣye ca saṃvittiḥ agṛhīta viśeṣaṇā na anusāyadhiyam vā ittham pratīyeta krama agrahāt na ca nitya parokṣā buddhiḥ anumātum api na śakyate iti ca vicāritam eva tat alam anayā kathayā kim iti śākya sutsṛjya śrotriyam idānī manu yuṃjmahe

atas ca yat uktam jñāna pṛṣṭha avamarśa darśanāt jñāna grahaṇa pūrvakam artha grahaṇam iti tat na sārvatrikam api tu kvacid eva jñāna viśiṣṭa artha saṃvedanāt tathā abhyupagamyate tasmāt artha grahaṇāt pūrvam jñānasya anavabhāsāt nirākāra āvasāya virahāt ca jñānasya eva ayam ākāraḥ iti kadāśā pralapitam etat aruṇa ambarāṇām
yat punar abhyadhāyi jñāna ākāra pakṣe kalpanā alpīyasi iti tatra yathā ukta nītyā pratyakṣa gamye bāhye grāhye artha ākāre kalpanā uktiḥ kīdṛśī kīdṛśam vā tat alpa tvam mahat tvam vā iti

ubhaya siddha tvam api yat avādi jñānasya tatra yadi pramāṇa āyattā vastu sthitiḥ arthaḥ api ubhaya siddhaḥ eva icchā dveṣa nibandhanāyām tu vastu sthitau jñānam api katham ubhaya siddham syāt iti yat kiṃcid etat

yat punar idam abhihitam abhyupagamya api bāhyam artham apratyākhyeyaḥ pratikarma vyavasthā siddhaye jñānasya ākāra yogaḥ iti tat api na sāṃpratam pratikarma vyavasthāyāḥ prakāra antareṇa api upapatteḥ yadi api aneka sannidhāne nīla jñānam upajāyate yadi api ca bodha svarūpa tvam aśeṣa sādhāraṇam tathā api nīlena eva karma kārakeṇa tad upajanitam iti nīla niṣṭham eva avatiṣṭhate cakṣuḥ ādinā api tat janitam iti ced satyam janitam na tu karmaṇā satā nīlena tu karma bhūtena tat utpādyate iti tad eka viṣayam eva bhavati kutas eṣa niyamaḥ iti ced vastu svabhāva kṛtaḥ eva ākāra pakṣe api samānaḥ ayam paryanuyogaḥ yat ucyate kim iti nīlam eva karma kārakam kim iti vā karma viṣayam eva jñānam iti tatra vastu svabhāvaiḥ uttaram vācyam ākāram api ca jñānam upādadānam karmakārakasya eva katham upādadīta na kāraka antarasya iti atra api vastu svabhāvaḥ eva śaraṇam iti

arthasya ca jñāna janaka tvam anvaya vyatirekābhyām avagamyate yadā hi devadatta arthī kaścid vrajati tad gṛham tatra asat nihitam ca enam gatvā api na sa paśyati kṣaṇa antare saḥ āyāntam devadattam nirīkṣate tatra tad sat asattvena tathātvam vetti tat hiyaḥ anāgate devadatte na deva datta jñānam udapādi tasmin āgate ca tat utpannam iti tad bhāva bhāvi tvāt tat janyam tat avasīyate ittham ca tad janya tvena eva tatra niyama siddheḥ alam ākāra kalpanayā

etena puruṣa pravṛttiḥ api niyata viṣayā vyākhyātā sādhakatama tvam tu sāmagryāḥ pramāṇa sāmānya lakṣaṇe nirṇītam eva yaḥ tu lokikaḥ vyapadeśaḥ udāhṛtaḥ saḥ api vyabhicarati nīlaḥ arthaḥ ayam yatas tat viṣayam jñānam utpannam iti api na vyapadiśanti laukikāḥ tasmāt arthe sati api sa ākāram jñānam eṣitavyam iti yat uktam tad anupapannam

yat api avarṇi saha upalaṃbha niyamāt abhedaḥ nīla tad dhiyoḥ iti tat api bāla bhāṣitam iva naḥ pratibhāti abhede saha artha anupapatteḥ atha eka upalaṃbha niyamāt iti hetu arthaḥ vivakṣitaḥ tat ayam asiddhaḥ hetuḥ nīla ādi grāhya grahaṇa samaye tad grāhaka an upalambhāt grāhaka ākāra anu vedha rahita tad vicchinna bāhya grāhya mātra pratibhāsaḥ eva ayam nīlam idam ityādiḥ darśitaḥ

kvacid ca grāhya ākāra anuparśliṣṭa kevala grāhaka avamarśanam arpi dṛśyate na smarāmi mayā kaḥ api gṛhītaḥ arthaḥ tadā iti tat evam itaretara vibhakta jñāna artha ākāra saṃvedanāt katham eka upalambha niyamāt abhedaḥ nīla tad dhiyoḥ iti ucyate nīla tad dhiyoḥ iti vadatā bhavatā aṣi eṣa bhedaḥ eva nirdiśyate para ma tā anuvāda mātram etat iti ced na abhede pṛthak nirdeśasya api aghaṭamāna tvāt tasmāt api na jñānasya ayam ākāraḥ

yat api uktam asatī api bāhye arthe svapna gandharvanagara māyā ādiṣu jñānasya ākāravat tā dṛśyate iti tasya eva ayam ākāraḥ yuktaḥ iti tat api durāśā mātram sarvatra jñānāt vicchinnasva grāhya ākārasya pratibhāsanāt tathā hi bhrama jñāneṣu catuṣṭayī gatiḥ ātma khyātiḥ asat khyātiḥ akhyātiḥ viparīta khyātiḥ vā tatra rajatam idam iti sāmānādhikaraṇyena eka artha pratibhāsāt tad mate ca saṃvitteḥ aparokṣa tvāt rajata adhigama abhimānena tad arthinaḥ tatra pravṛtteḥ bādhaka pratyayasya tathāvidha bodha niṣedha paratvena prādurbhāvāt na tāvat akhyātiḥ iti prāk eva prāsādhitam etat

asat khyātiḥ api na asti ekānta asataḥ sva puṣpa ādeḥ pratibhāsā yogāt deśa kāla vyavahita anubhūta pūrva padārtha viṣayaḥ eva bhrāntaḥ api pratyayaḥ prāṇabhṛtām bhavati na tu atyanta asad artha viṣayaḥ

tathā hi dvividhā bhrāntiḥ bāhya indriya jā mānasī ca tatra bāhya indriya je bhrama jñāne viṣaya doṣāt indriya doṣāt vā samutpadyamāne na kvacid nirālambanatā dṛśyate bhāsvara rūpa sādṛśyena hi viṣaya doṣeṇa śuktikā rajatam iti parisphurati maru sthalī patita utphalitam ca sāvitram tejaḥ tarala taraṅga sārūpyeṇa payaḥ iti cakāsti indriya doṣāt api pitta upahata rasanasya tikta tayā śarkarā avabhāsate timira sīmantita nayana vṛtteḥ candra maṇḍalam ekam api dvidhā pratibhāti timira kaṇa nikara vivara viracita prasṛtāḥ ca nayana raśmayaḥ eva sūrya āśu saṃvalitāḥ santaḥ sūkṣma tayā keśa kūrcaka ākārāḥ pratibhānti iti

antaḥkaraṇa doṣeṇa vibhramaḥ yaḥ tu jāyate asati api mahelā ādau puṣpeṣu muṣita ātmanām saḥ api kaścid viṣaya doṣa sahāyaḥ bhavati sa ca ālambanaḥ eva tasyāḥ pāṇiḥ iti jñānam yathā bhavati kutracid komala anila kallola vellite bāla pallave anapekṣita tad tulya padārthasya eva yā punar mānasī manmatha unmāda mahimnā māninīmatiḥ

tasyām api rāga ādi vāsanā bala upaplavamāna smṛti upasthāpita deśa kāla vyavahita upalabdha purandhrī rūpa ādi samullekhaḥ na tu ekāntāsataḥ khara viṣāṇa ādeḥ iva pratibhā nidrā ādi manaḥ doṣa janmani svapne api dṛṣṭa pūrvasya eva tasya akārasya ullekhaḥ jālajvala agaḷat vahni drava dravya ādi darśane rūpam anya stham anyatra vetti na tu asat eva tat tat evam bhrānti bodheṣu na asti atyanta asatām prathā deśa kālānyathātvam tu kevalam bhāti vastunaḥ

nanu tatra asataḥ arthasya pratibhāse deśa antara ādiṣu sattvam kva upayujyate deśa antare hi san asan vā tatra tāvat na asti eva saḥ arthaḥ na ca dvayoḥ asattvayoḥ kiṃcid viśeṣaḥ deśa kālau api kim santā vasantau vā pratibhāsete iti vikalpanāyām tathā tayoḥ api tulyaḥ doṣaḥ mā evam bhavataḥ api asat khyāti vādinaḥ kim sarvatra eva tad artha asattvam saṃmatam uta tad deśaḥ eva tatra asannidhāna mātreṇa tāvat kaḥ iva tava sva arthaḥ sarva trāsataḥ tu pratibhāse kutastyaḥ eṣa niyamaḥ yat asattva aviśeṣe api rajata ādi eva asat pratibhāti na khara viṣāṇa ādi iti

ayam tu dvayoḥ asattvayoḥ viśeṣaḥ deśa antara ādiṣu sataḥ arthasya smaraṇa ādi upāroheṇa pratibhāsamāna tā yujyate na tu ekānta asate iti evam deśa kālayoḥ api sat asattva vikalpa codyam parihartavyam atas ca kiṃcid api na atyanta asad artha grāhi jñānam asti iti kim dṛṣṭānta balena sarvatra artha śūnyatā kalpyeta tasmāt na asat khyātiḥ

ātma khyāteḥ tu nirākaraṇāya saḥ ayam iyān kaliḥ vartate tatra ca bahuśas kathitam grāhakāt vicchinnam eva grāhyam avabhāsate nīlam idam iti na tu tat abhedena nīlam aham iti bhrānti jñāneṣu tad artha asannidhānāt bhānta tvam astu na ātma tattva grahaṇam iti yat ca ucyate yad antar jñeya rūpam tat bahis vadavabhāsate iti sā iyam viparīta khyātiḥ eva aṅgīkṛtā syāt tat varam sā eva tapasvinī sādhīyasī

atha kathyate grahakāt satyam vicchinnam grāhyam tat tu jñāna rūpam eva iti tatra vicchinnam iti priyam āveditam jñāna tve tu tasya kā yuktiḥ na ca jñānayoḥ yugapad utpannayoḥ krama bhāvinoḥ vā grāhya grāhaka bhāvaḥ upapadyate yaugapadye savya itara go viṣāṇa vat grāhya grāhaka niyama abhāvāt krama pakṣe api pūrvam uttarasya grāhakam ced tad utpatti tad grahaṇa kāla pratīkṣaṇāt kṣaṇika tām jahyāt uttaram api yadi pūrvasya grāhakam tadā api sā eva vārtā tāvat kālam avasthitim antareṇa tat grāhya tā anupapatteḥ na ca jñāna tvam nāma sāmānyam grāhya grāhakayoḥ anugatam go tvam iva śābaleya ādau vibhāti atas vicchinnaḥ ced grāhakāt grāhya aṃśaḥ saḥ arthaḥ eva bhavet iti na jñānasya ayam ākāraḥ

yat tu saṃsarga dharmaḥ ākāraḥ na bhavati iti bhāṣitam tat yuktam eva na kuṇḍa dadhi vat kaścid saṃsargaḥ asti artha bodhayoḥ tad kṛta ākāravattā vā prāganākārayoḥ tayoḥ tat evam śākya ukta yukti śakala daurbalyāt sarvatra viccheda pratibhāsāt jñānasya svatas vaivitrya anupapatteḥ arthasya eva ayam ākāraḥ iti siddham

yat tu artha ākāra pakṣe coditam ekatra arthe nakṣatram tārakā tiṣyaḥ iti paraspara virūddha ākāra samāveśaḥ na yuktaḥ iti tatra ucyate anupapannam iti naḥ kva saṃpratyayaḥ yat na pramāṇena avagatam viruddham api tat avabuddhyāmahe yat ekatra niviśamānam na paśyāmaḥ tat iha yadi abādhitena jñānena vispaṣṭam ākāra trayam ekatra gṛhyate tat katham anupapannam syāt katham vā viruddham iti

atha ekam samyak pramāṇa pariniścita rūpam itarat kālpanikam iti pratīyate tat evam astu kaḥ dīṣaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ ca citra ādau aneka varṇa samāveśaḥ na ca ekatra virodham avirodham vā dṛṣṭavā sarvatra tat kalpanam ucitam abādhita avagati nibandhanāḥ hi vastu sthitayaḥ bhavanti na kalpanā nirmitāḥ

api vā vastu tāt rūpya sada sattā anapekṣayā śabda prayoga sādhu tvam anvākhyāyeta kevalam dārāḥ iti na ekasyāḥ strī vyakteḥ puṃstvaṃhuvam tva vā vidyate śabdaḥ tu eṣa tatra prayujyamānaḥ sādhuḥ bhavati na artha asaṃsparśitā ca asya tāvatā vyavatiṣṭhate yathā etat ātmakam vastu tathā śaknoti bhāṣitum

parivrāj prabhṛtīnām ca kuṇapa ādi pratītayaḥ arthasya aneka śakti tvāt na avahanti artha śūnyatām kim na bhakṣayitum śakyā nārī kauleyakena sā kim vā na śamayati eṣā kāminaḥ madana jvaram śavāt vā kena rūpeṇa sā viśiṣyeta yoginaḥ dhī trayam tu na sarveṣām abhāvāt sahakāriṇaḥ prati prāṇi niyata anekavidha vāsanā bheda sahakāri sāpekṣaḥ hi tasya tasya jñānasya ātma lābhaḥ iti na sarveṣām sarva sārūpyeṇa jñānam

yadi evam vāsanā bhedaḥ eva vividha pratibhā udbhava hetuḥ bhavati kim artha kalpanayā ayi sādho kim adya api na pariharasau su ciram guṇitām kalpanā vācaḥ yuktim na hi arthaḥ kalpyate api tu pratibhāsate eva bahu rūpasya tu tasya ekatama rūpa pariccheda niyame kim arpi vāsanā ādi kāraṇam kvacid kalpyate kaḥ tāvatā artha nihnavasya avasaraḥ

yat ca uktam vāsanā bhedaḥ eva jñāna vaicitrya kāraṇam itaretara kārya kāraṇa bhāva prabandhaḥ ca bīja aṅkura vat anādiḥ jñānayāsanayoḥ iti tat api aghaṭamānam kā iyam vāsanā nāma jñānāt avyatiktā ced sā api svaccha rūpa tvāt na jñāna kāluṣya kāraṇam bhavet jñāna vyatiriktā ced vāsanā tad vaicitrya hetuḥ ca saḥ arthaḥ eva paryāya antareṇa uktaḥ syāt

api ca vāsanā nāma viṣaya anubhava samāhitaḥ saṃskāraḥ iti loke prasiddhiḥ saṃskāraḥ ca yat anubhava ghaṭitaḥ tatra eva kvacid avasare smaraṇam upajanayati na punar asadeva vaicitryam idam īdṛśam āvahati kiṃca bhikṣu pakṣe kṣaṇika tvena jñānānām grāhya grāhaka bhāvaḥ iva vāsya vāsaka bhāvaḥ api nirākartavyaḥ sthāyinaḥ hi bhāvāḥ tila ādayaḥ sthāyibhiḥ eva campaka ādibhiḥ vāsyante na tu utpadya sa padyeva vinaśyadbhiḥ jñānaiḥ tādṛṃśyā iva jñānāni iti niranvaya vināśāt ca na tad aṃśaḥ anuvartate yatas kathaścid vāsyeta pūrveṇa jñānam uttaram

api ca ekatra devadatta santāne vāsanātaḥ sahasrāṇi jñāna vaicitrya kārīṇi bhaveyuḥ na hi go vāsanātas hasti jñānam udeti ananta tve api khalu āsām ārambhe niyamaḥ kutas asamaṃjasa kāri tve vyavahārasya viplavaḥ dhūma jñāna samutpāde dhūma vāsanayā kṛte kim tadā na jala jñānam janayet jala vāsanā vāsanāḥ ca vāsanā santānārambha hetavaḥ eva bhaveyuḥ na punar anubhava jñānam ādhātum udyaccheyuḥ sadṛśāt sadṛśa utpattiḥ iti hi bhavatām darśanam

api ca na nirādhārāḥ vāsanāḥ āsate na ca bhavat pakṣe tad ādhāraḥ kaścana saṃbhavati bhaṅgura tvena jñānasya tad āśraya tva anupapatteḥ eka jñāna āśrita tve sarvāsām vāsanānām tad vināśe nāśaḥ syāt prativāsanam āśraya abhede tad ānantyena aniyamaḥ ca śataśākhaḥ

na ca ālayavijñānam nāma kiṃcid asti sati api tasmin aśeṣa vāsanā sahasra samāśraye tad kṣaṇika tvāt sakṛt eva tathāvidha vāsanā kusūla jñāna vināśaḥ syāt punar utpāde api katham tathāvidham jñānam eva samutpādyeta te tu gavāśvādi jñāna krama niyamaḥ bhavet iti sarvathā saṅkaṭaḥ ayam panthāḥ tasmāt mṛgatṛṣṇikā eṣā tapasvinām vāsanātaḥ eva lokayātrā liddheḥ kim bāhyena arthena iti kṛtam ati vācāla tayā ciram api nipuṇaiḥ nirūpyamāṇaḥ atas arthasya eva na buddheḥ sidhyati nīla ādiḥ ākāraḥ ekaḥ ca bodhaḥ pramiti pramāṇa prameya rūpāṇi katham bibharti bhinnam pramāṇāt phalam abhyadhāyi pranyakṣa cintā avasare purastāt

ye tu bruvate tiṣṭhatu tāvat pramāṇa mārgam iti prameyam eva vikalpayantaḥ na brāhmam artham kaṃcana nirapavādam pratipadyāmahe tathā hi na tāvat ayam avayavī ghaṭa ādiḥ avakalpate avayava vyatirekeṇa avayavinaḥ anupalambhāt yaḥ hi yasmāt vyatiriktaḥ saḥ tad adhiṣṭhita deśa vyatirikta deśa adhiṣṭhānaḥ upalabhyate ghaṭadiva paṭaḥ na ca evam avayavebhyaḥ pṛthak deśaḥ dṛśyate avayavī tad agrahaṇe ca tad budhya bhāvāt ghaṭāgrahaṇe api paṭaḥ gṛhyate na tu avayava anupalabdhau avayavī iti katham sa tebhyaḥ bhidyeta

avayava grahaṇa anupapatteḥ ca na hi sarve tad avayavāḥ śakyante grahītuṃmarvāc bhāga vartinaḥ eva gṛhyeran na madhya para bhāga gatāḥ iti budhyāḥ vibhajyamāne ca anupalambhāt yadā hi paṭam pāṇau nidhāya budhyā vivinākti eṣa tantuḥ eṣa tantuḥ iti tadā prācyādaṃcalāt prabhṛti praticīnam aṃcalam yāvat viviṃcayan asau tantu santatim eva kevalām upalabhate na tatas atiriktam paṭa a ayavinam

vṛtti anupapatteḥ ca na ekatra avayave kārtsnyena avayavī vartate tad anyeṣu avṛtti prasaṅgāt na eka deśenavartate su a ārambha avayava vyatirikta deśa abhāvāt abhyupagame vā anavasthā prasaṅgāt yaiḥ api eka deśaiḥ avayaveṣu asauvartate teṣu api katham vartate anyaiḥ eka deśaiḥ teṣu api anyaiḥ iti na asti antar asaṃbaddhaḥ tu eka deśaiḥ avayavī iti katham tad vāreṇa su a ārambhakaiḥ api saṃbadhyeta tasmāt abhayi api na asya vṛttiḥ avayaveṣu iti

dhāraṇa ākarṣaṇa ādi tu anārabdha kārye kāṣṭha mūlaka kārpāsa ādau api dṛśyate iti anaikāntikam eka ākārātu pratīti vikalpa mātram eka deśa avasthāna ādi nimittam āśritya kari turaga padāti prabhṛtiṣu iva senā iti dhava khadira palāśa ādiṣu iva vanam iti saṃciteṣu abhavayaveṣu eva ghaṭhaḥ ityādi buddhiḥ bhaviṣyatī ti eva avayava avayava paryālocanayā aṇu saṃcaya mātram eva avaśiṣyate na anyat

saṃcayaḥ api ca vyatirikta avyatirikta tayā cintyamānaḥ na asti eva iti aṇavaḥ eva avaśiṣyante paramāṇavaḥ api ṣaṭkena yugapad yogāt paramāṇā ūṣṣa ṣ aṃśatā iti evam vikalpyamānāḥ viplavantaḥ eva na ca taiḥ ati sūkṣmaiḥ eṣa vyavahāraḥ abhinirvartyate iti tasmāt vāhyasya prameyasya eva nirūpyamāṇasya anupapatteḥ vijñāna mātram eva idam iti abhyupagamanīyam

te api evam vadantaḥ prāktanebhyaḥ api bhikṣubhyaḥ kṛpaṇatarāḥ iva lakṣyante apūrvam eṣa tarka mārgaḥ yatra pratītim utsṛjya tarjanī visphoṭanena vastu vyavasthāḥ kriyante dṛḍhena ced pramāṇena bādha ādi rahita ātmanā gṛhītaḥ eva avayavī kim ebhiḥ bāla valgitaiḥ atha na asti pramāṇena kena cittadupagrahaḥ etat eva ucyatām vṛtti vikalpaiḥ kim prayojanam na ca śaknuyaḥ pade pade vayam ebhiḥ abhinavam alpam api kiṃcid apaśyadbhiḥ tat eva punar punar pṛcchadbhiḥ śākyahatakaiḥ saha kalaham atimātram kartum

sa vikalpakam pratyakṣam pramāṇam iti sādhitam nirvikalpakena api śabda ullekha mātra rahitam sa vikalpaka grāhyam eva vastu gṛhyate iti ca darśitam eka ākāra viṣaya vyatirekeṇa ca tad buddheḥ eka kāryatva eka deśa ādi anyathā siddhi nibandhana tvam api na kiṃcid vaktum śakyate iti api varṇitam kvacid vā pṛtanāvana ādau bādhakopanipātāt eka avagati mithyātvāt na sarvatra mithyā tva kalpanā yuktā iti api uktam kim vā tat asti yad sāmānya samarthana avamare na akathitam tasmāt tayā eva nītyā avayavi api siddhaḥ eva tad grāhiṇaḥ pratyakṣasya nirapavāda tvāt

yat tu deśa bhedena agrahaṇāt tad agrahe tad buddhi abhāvāt iti tatra avayava āśrita tvam eva nimittam na asattvam deśa bhedena hi jñānam tad deśasya katham bhavet na hi kaścid svatantraḥ asau api tu avayava āśritaḥ yāvatām grahaṇaḥ api asmin buddhiḥ bhavati tāvatām apekṣate asau grahaṇam na sarveṣām iti sthitiḥ vivicyamāneṣu aṃśeṣu yuktaḥ tad anupagrahaḥ tadā avaya vināśaḥ hi buddhau viparivartate avayava vavibhāgaḥ hi avayavinaḥ vināśa hetuḥ tasmin buddhyā samullikhyamāne avayavi vināśaḥ api na anullikhitaḥ bhavet iti katham avayavī tadānīm gamyeta

vṛttiḥ ca avayaveṣu asya vyāsa jyā eva iti gamyate na pratyavayavam tasya samāptiḥ vyakti jāti vat vyāsajya vartamānaḥ hi na khalu avayava antaraiḥ vartate tad asaṃvitteḥ kintu vartate eva saḥ tathā ca āhuḥ vartate iti brūmaḥ anāśritasya anupalaṃbhāt vṛttiḥ evaṃvidhā anyatra kva dṛṣṭā iti yat ucyate pratyakṣa dṛṣṭaḥ eva arthe dṛṣṭānta anveṣaṇena kim tasmāt pratyakṣatas eva avāyava vṛtteḥ avayavinaḥ upalabdheḥ na tadvat tau vikalpānām avasaraḥ

sraj sūtra ādi vṛttiḥ api tathā darśanāt abhyupagatā tat iyam avayavi vṛttiḥ api īdṛśī dṛśyamānā kim iti nihnūyate na ca avayavi grāhiṇaḥ pratyakṣasya kaścid apavādaḥ samasti aduṣṭa kāraṇa udbhūtam anāvirbhūta bādhakam asandigdham ca vijñānam katham mithyā iti kathyate na ca senā vanavadavaya vigrahaṇam abhidhātum ucitam abādhita tvāt senā ādau bādhaka sadbhāvāt

api ca gaja vāji padāti pīlu palāśa śiṃśapa ādi darśanasya tatra ghaṭamāna tvāt tad samavāye senā vanādi pratītiḥ upapadī eta api iha tu kiṃsamudāya viṣayaḥ paṭa pratyayaḥ iti cintyam tantu sasudāya ālambanaḥ iti ced tantu pratyayaḥ idānīm kim ālambanaḥ saḥ api su āvaya bālambanaḥ iti evam avayava avayava nirūpaṇe paramāṇavaḥ patti aśva śamī śiṃśapa ādi sthānīya vaktavyāḥ teṣām ca tadvat grahaṇam anupapannam atīndriya tvāt iti na tad ālambanaḥ avayavi pratyayaḥ tasmāt avayavī pratyakṣa grāhyaḥ asti iti siddham

paramāṇavaḥ api kārya anumāna pariniścita nitya niravayava svarūpāḥ santi iti pūrvam eva samarthitam atas na ṣaṭka yoga ādinā sāvayava tvam eṣā upapādayitum pāryate mūrta tvam api anitya tā āyām aprayojakam iti darśayiṣyate

atas prameya paryālīcana vartmanā api śūnya vāda samarthanam na suśakam prameya vicāre api hi pramāṇa vṛttam eva parīkṣyate atas ca pramāṇa carcā atas vibhyadbhiḥ prapalāyya yā prameya kathā vīthī tathāgata ebalambitā tasyām api sā eva bhīṣaṇa mukhī pramāṇa carcikā eva upanatā sarvatī vipadām mārgam ādeśayitum udyate vidhau vidhura tām yati prapalāpya kva gamyate tasmāt pramāṇataḥ aśakye śakye vā vastu nirṇaye evaṃprāyam ayuktam vaḥ kuśa kāśa abalambanam evam niṣphalam utsṛthya śūnya vāda baka vratam bāhyena eva artha jātena vyavahāraḥ vidhīyattam

atha asthā śaithilya jananāya sarvam śūnyam sarvam kṣaṇikam sarvam nirālambanam iti upadiśyate tarhi kim anena mṛṣodyena sati api ātmani satsu api sreṣu padārtheṣu viṣaya doṣa darśana dvāreṇa bhavati eva vivekavatām vairāgyam iti tad upajananāya śūnyavāda ādi varṇanam vakraḥ panthāḥ pratyuta prājñaḥ mumukṣuḥ kṣaṇika nairātmya śūnyatā ādi vacanam yukti bādhitam avabudhyamānaḥ vaṃcanā mayam iva tat upadeśam āśaṅkate saḥ eṣa buddhi śūnyānām śūnya vāda parigrahaḥ pratāraṇa parāṇām vā na tu tattva artha darśinām tasmāt parīkṣyamāṇaḥ ayam śabda ādi advaita pakṣa vat vijñānādvaitapakṣaḥ api gandharvanagara āyate
tat evam advaitadṛśāna dṛśyate janasya niḥśreyasa saṃpad āgamaḥ atas yathā ukta ātma su tattva cintayā kṛtī vyavasyet apavarga siddhaye

sāṅkhyaiḥ yaḥ tu apavarga sādhana vidhau uktaḥ prakṛti ātmanoḥ anyatva avagamaḥ abhyupāyaḥ iti sa prāk eva nirvāsitaḥ ajñā śaktimati vikāra bahulā badhnāti akiṃcitkaram bhūyas na prakṛtiḥ pumāṃsam iti vā kaḥ tām niyantum kṣamaḥ puṃsā na kiṃcid api bandha nidhāna bhūtam ati alpa mātram api karma kṛtam kadācid mathnāti tam prakṛtiḥ eva niraṅkuśā eṣā mattā kareṇuḥ iva padma vanāni bhūyas

kaca niluṃcana diś paṭa dhāraṇa kṣitidharā ākramaṇa krama pūrvakam kṣapaṇakāḥ tu apavargam uśanti amī hi atitarām parama artha vidaḥ tu te lomnām nitya saṃbhavāt khalatayaḥ mokṣam kṣaṇāt prāpnuyuḥ saṃsāra uparamaḥ digambara tayā sadyas tiraścām bhavet muktāḥ syuḥ giri śṛṅga vāsinaḥ ime śaśvat tad ārohaṇāt jantūnām apavarga vartma nikaṭam kena īdṛśam darśitam tasmāt ātma jñānam santaḥ mokṣa prāptau hetum prāhuḥ tīrthe tīrthe tat ca ācāryaiḥ taiḥ taiḥ uktam saṃjñā bhedaiḥ
yat api iha kecid a vikalpam īśvara praṇidhānam āhuḥ apavarga sādhanam idam ātma darśanam avādi taiḥ api prathitaḥ hi pūraṣa viśeṣaḥ īśvaraḥ

dṛṣṭā vādi antarāṇām gatiḥ iyam iyatī na apavargasya mārgam spraṣṭum draṣṭum samarthāḥ te iti ciram iha śvabhraḥ eva bhramanti nedī yāneṣu tasmāt bhava maru patitaiḥ akṣapāda upadiṣṭaḥ panthāḥ kṣemāyāḥ mokṣa adhigama samucitaḥ kṣipram ālambanīyaḥ

saṃśaya ādeḥ padārtha gaṇasya pramāṇa prameya pada saṃgṛhītasya apinyāya pravṛtti prayo jana tayā pṛthak vyutpādanīya tvasya prāk eva samarthita tvāt prathama sūtre ca prameyāḥ nantaram saṃśaya uddeśāt uddeśa anukrameṇa tasya lakṣaṇam pratipādayitum āha samāna aneka dharma upapatteḥ vipratipatteḥ upalabdhi anupalabdhi avyavasthātaḥ ca viśeṣa apekṣaḥ vimarśaḥ saṃśayaḥ nyā sū

nanu saṃśayasya samāna dharma upapatti ādi kāraṇa bhedena paṃcavidha tvāt sāmānya sakṣaṇam vibhāgaḥ viśeṣa lakṣaṇāni ca vaktavyāni tatra sāmānya lakṣaṇe vibhāge ca sūtra dvayam viśeṣa lakṣaṇa artham ca paṃcānām tad pramedānām sūtrapaṃcakam iti evam sapta sūtrāṇi praṇetum yuktāni ekam ca idam sūtram śrūyate tat katham etat bhaviṣyati ucyate satyam āha bhavān kim tu ekam eva idam sūtram āvṛtti nyāyam āśritya saptadhā kalpayiṣyate

tatra ācāryāḥ tāvat evam vyācakṣate samāna dharma upapatteḥ upalabdhi anupalabdhi avyavasthātaḥ viśeṣa apekṣaḥ vimarśaḥ saṃśayaḥ iti iyat sūtram sāmānya lakṣaṇā pratipādakam samāna aneka dharma upapatteḥ vipratipatteḥ upalabdhi anupalabdhi avyavasthātaḥ ca iti vibhāga sūtram punar ca samāna dharma upapatteḥ upalabdhi anupalabdhi avyavasthātaḥ viśeṣa apekṣaḥ vimarśaḥ saṃśayaḥ iti etat eva sūtram prathamasya saṃśayasya viśeṣa lakṣaṇa pratipādakam iti

nanu etat eva sūtram sāmānya lakṣaṇa artham iyat eva ced ayamanyūna an atiriktam viśeṣa lakṣaṇa artham iti katham etat ucyate viśeṣa smaraṇa kāraṇa bhūta sādhāraṇa dharma grahaṇāt viśeṣa agrahaṇāt viśeṣa āsmṛteḥ ca saṃśayaḥ bhavati iti pratyātma vedanīyam tāvat etat sūtre viśeṣa apekṣaḥ iti anena padena viśeṣa smaraṇam upadiṣṭam upalabdhi anupalabdhi avyavasthā padena ca viśeṣa agrahaṇam iti īyat tāvat dvayoḥ aṇi sāmānya viśeṣa lakṣaṇayoḥ tulyam samāna śabdaḥ tu ākṣipta sāmānya vacanaḥ san tad sāmānya lakṣaṇam āha anugata sāmānyatracanaḥ tu viśeṣa lakṣaṇam iti

katham punar ayam eva ākṣipta sāmānya vacanaḥ kathaṃca anugata sāmānya vacanaḥ iti ucyate saṃśaya utpattyā eva samāna dharya mātram ākṣipyate yat gṛhyamāṇam viśeṣa smaraṇa bīja saṃskāra udbodha nimitta tām pratipadyate tad vyatirekeṇa saṃśaya an utpādāt tathā hi viruddha viśeṣa avamarśa svabhāvaḥ tāvat saṃśayaḥ na ca viruddha viśeṣāṇām puras avasthite dharmiṇi sannihitānām avamarśanam viruddha tayā eva ekatra sannidhāna abhāvāt atas smṛti upārūḍhānām avamarśanam smṛtiḥ ca na akasmāt udbhavati iti yad sahacaritānām teṣām viśeṣāṇām pūrvam paryāyeṇa grahaṇam vṛttam tad darśana saṃskāra prabodha dvāreṇa smaraṇa kāraṇam avaśyam eva āśrayaṇīyam tat tu anugatam vā bhavatu vyāvṛttam vā vipratipatti ātmakam vā āntaram upalabdhi anupalabdhi avyavasthā rūpam vā iti evam ākṣipta sāmānya vācini samāna śabde paṃcasa ādhāraṇa rūpa avagamāt sāmānya lakṣaṇa artha tā yadā tu anugatam eva dharmam āroha pariṇāha ādi svabhāvam ācaṣṭe samāna śabdaḥ tadā aviśeṣa lakṣaṇa arthaḥ iti

tatra ca ittham sūtra yojanā samānaḥ dharmaḥ pariṇāha ādiḥ tasya guṇa tvena pratidravyam anya tve api tulya rūpa avagati viṣayīkṛta tvāt samāna tvam upapadyate tasya upapattiḥ upalabdhiḥ atha api sattā upapatti śabdena ucyate sā api upalabdhi adhīna sthitiḥ eva bhavati iti sarvathā samāna dharma upalabdheḥ saṃśayaḥ iti uktam bhavati

nanu samāna dharmaḥ artha antaram dharmiṇaḥ na ca artha antare dṛṣṭe anyatra saṃśayaḥ bhavitum arhati na artha antara viśeṣa tvāt artha antara viśeṣaḥ tu dharmyā iva ucyate artha antareṇa pariṇāha ādinā viśeṣyate iti tasmin eva sādhāraṇa dharma adhyāsita vapuṣi dharmiṇi nayana patha vartini tad gata viśeṣa avamarśa ātmā tatra eva saṃśayaḥ jāyate yaḥ ayam ūrdhva tva viśiṣṭaḥ dharmī dṛśyate saḥ sthāṇuḥ vāsyāt puruṣova iti na artha antara tvam dūṣaṇam

tathā api vakra koṭara tva kara caraṇa ādi viśeṣa darśinaḥ na dṛṣṭaḥ saṃśayaḥ iti kāraṇa antaram ucyate upalabdhi anupalabdhi avyavasthātaḥ iti viśeṣa agrahaṇāḥ diti arthaḥ katham punar upalabdhi anupalabdhi avyavasthātaḥ iti anena viśeṣa agrahaṇam ucyate ittham ucyate idantayā anidantayā vā tatra upalabdhiḥ na vyavatiṣṭhate anupalabdhiḥ vā iti viśeṣa grahaṇe hi sati tad vyavasthānam saṃbhavati sthāṇuḥ ayam na puruṣaḥ iti vakra koṭara ādi yiśeṣa grahaṇe śiraḥ pāṇi ādi paricchede tu puruṣaḥ ayam na sthāṇuḥ iti

evam anena padena viśeṣa agrahaṇam uktam tathā api preṅkhā ārūḍhasya sādhāraṇa dharma darśinaḥ viśeṣān upalabhamānasya api na dṛṣṭaḥ saṃśayaḥ iti kāraṇa antaram ucyate viśeṣa apekṣaḥ iti viśeṣa smṛti apekṣaḥ iti arthaḥ

nanu viśeṣa apekṣaḥ iti śrūyate na viśeṣa smṛti apekṣaḥ iti satyam aśrūyamāṇam api tad smaraṇam saṃśaya prastāvāt avagamyate smaryamāṇa tvena hi viśeṣāṇām saṃśaya utpattau apekṣā na anabhūyamāna tayā anubhūyamāneṣu hi teṣu saṃśaya chedaḥ bhavati na saṃśayaḥ apekṣā śabda artha nirūpaṇāt eva vā smṛtiḥ labhyate viśeṣāṇām apekṣā ākāṅkṣā te ca anupalabhyamānāḥ pūrva anubhūtāḥ ca ākāṅkṣyante iti iyam sā teṣām smṛtiḥ saṃprati upalabhyamāneṣu ekāntān anubhūteṣu vā teṣu ākāṅkṣā anupapatteḥ

nanu samāna dharma upapatteḥ viśeṣa smṛteḥ ca iti kāraṇa dvayam eva astu kim vaśeṣa agrahaṇena api ca viśeṣa smaraṇāt eva nanu ākṣiptaḥ tadā agrahaḥ grahaṇam smaraṇam ca eva bhavetām yugapad katham asti etat kintu na ati dūra gatāyām nija pramadāyām anurāgavataḥ kāminaḥ samāna dharma darśane tad gata viśeṣa adarśane tad anusmaraṇe ca sanī api na bhavati eva saṃśayaḥ atas saṃśaya utpatti avyabhicāre deśa kāla vyavahita viśeṣa agrahaṇa siddhaye pada antaram upādīyate deśa antare kāla antare vā cira dṛṣṭānām viśeṣāṇām idānīm agrahaṇam saṃśaya kāraṇam na viśeṣa agrahaṇa mātram evam amunā pada trayeṇa saṃśaya lakṣaṇam idam uktam

nanu ca saṃbhūya kārakaiḥ kāryam ārabhataḥ iti nyāyāt samāna dharma upalabdhi viśeṣa anupalabdhi tad smṛti lakṣaṇa kāraṇa traya janye saṃśaye jñāna yaugapadya mā āpadyate krama bhāvi tve hi buddhīnām na eka kārya utpattau yugapad vyāpāraḥ samasti viśeṣāḥ ca bahavaḥ api saṃbhavanti iti tad smaraṇāni api yugapad bhūyāṃsi bhaveyuḥ na etat evam samāna dharma grahaṇa anantaram pūrva upajāta vividha viśā eṣa anubhava paramparā upacita pīvara saṃskāra dvārakam ekam eva tat viṣayam smaraṇam bhaviṣyati yathā varṇānām artha pratītau varṇitam

upalabdhi anupalabdhi avyavasthā sūcitā ca viśeṣa anupalabdhiḥ anupalabdhiḥ eva na sā jñāna ātmikā kintu jñāna anutpādaḥ iti tat tṛtīyam kāraṇam api bhavat na jñāna ātmakam iti dve eva jñāna ātmake kāraṇe samāna dharma grahaṇam viśeṣa smaraṇam ca tayoḥ prathamam samāna dharma grahaṇam vinaśyat avastham viśesmaraṇam ca dvitīyam avinaśyat avastham saṃśayam upajanayataḥ īdṛśayoḥ ca jñānayoḥ yaugapadyam aviruddham iti śāstre sthitam evam samāna dharma grahaṇāt viśeṣa agrahaṇāt viśeṣa smṛteḥ ca saṃśayaḥ iti pada trayeṇa saṃśaya lakṣaṇam anavadyam ucyate iti

tat etat ācārya vyākhyānam arocayantaḥ pare aparathā vyācakṣate sāmānya lakṣaṇam tāvat vimarśa padena eva pratipādyate na hi paryāya uccāraṇa mātram idam vimarśaḥ saṃśayaḥ iti kintu saṃśayaḥ iti lakṣya padam vimarśaḥ iti lakṣaṇa padam pramāṇa pada vat ca nirvacana savyapekṣam etat padam lakṣaṇa pratipādana kṣamam bhavati viruddha artha avamarśaḥ vimarśaḥ sthāṇuḥ vā puruṣaḥ vā iti iyatā ca sajātīya saṃśaya paścaka anugatam vijātītebhyaḥ pramāṇa ādibhyaḥ vyavaccinnam sāmānya lakṣaṇam uktam bhavati saṃśayīt pādaka kāraṇa parigaṇanam punar indriya artha sannikarṣa utpanna grahaṇa vat iha api na upayujyate kāraṇa antarāṇām api ātmam anasyat nikarṣa ādīnām aparihārya tvāt atha anyāsādhāraṇa kāraṇa nirdeśaḥ cikīrṣitaḥ tena api kī arthaḥ sāmānya lakṣaṇasya pratipipādayiṣita tvāt tasya ca vimarśa padāt eva siddha tvāt

upalabdhi anupalabdhi avyavasthāpada pratipādyamāna viśeṣa agrahaṇa varṇanam ca atīva kliṣṭam iti punar ca viśeṣa lakṣaṇa prasaṅge yathāśrutam eva tat vyākhyeyam iti atibhāraḥ evam vimarśa padena vijātīya vyavaccheda kāriṇi sāmānya lakṣaṇe varṇite samāna dharma upapatteḥ iti ekam eva padam sajātīya saṃśaya antara vyavaccheda kāri viśeṣa lakṣaṇa kṣamam bhavati iti tatra api pada traya yojanam na upāyujyate iti atra vyākhyāna dvaye api katarat sādhu iti tad vidaḥ pramāṇam

aneka dharma upapatteḥ iti atra api tripada parigrahaṇena ena lakṣaṇam ācāryāḥ varṇayanti aneka dharma upapatteḥ upalabdhi anupalabdhi avyavasthātaḥ viṣeṣa apekṣaḥ iti asādhāraṇa dharma grahaṇāt viśeṣa grahaṇāt viśeṣa smṛteḥ ca saṃśayaḥ iti arthaḥ ekaika pada upādāna phalam ca pūrvavat atra api darśayitavyam na ca indriya mana ssaṃyoga ādi kāraṇa antara parigaṇana codanam yuktam teṣām sarva buddhi janma su tulya tvāt iha asādhāraṇa saṃśaya jñāna kāraṇa upadeśa prastāvāt iti

anye tu sāmānya lakṣaṇa sampādite vijātīya vyavacchede kevala sajātīya vyavacchinna lakṣaṇa pradhita pādana nipuṇam aneka dharma upapatti padam eva pūrvavat varṇayāṃcakruḥ nanu aneka dharma śabdena katham asādhāraṇaḥ dharmaḥ ucyate evam ucyate samāna jātīyam asamāna jātīyam ca anekam tasmāt parāvṛttaḥ dharmaḥ aneka dharmaḥ iti yat vā kim anayā kliṣṭa kalpanayā asti ayam eka śabdaḥ samāna paryāyaḥ tatra spaṣṭaḥ eva nañsamāsena asamāna dharmaḥ aneka dharmaḥ sādhāraṇa dharmaḥ ucyate eva iti

bhavatu evam asādhāraṇa dharmasya tu katham saṃśaya kāraṇa tvam iti cintyam viruddha viśeṣa anusmaraṇa kāraṇakam hi saṃśayam āhuḥ viśeṣāṇām ca smaraṇa hetoḥ saṃskārasya tat udbodhakam bhavati yena saha ete pūrvam paryāyeṇa upalabdhāḥ asādhāraṇa dharmasya tu asādhāraṇa dharma tvāt eva na kenacid saha pūrvam grahaṇam abhavat bhāve tu asādhāraṇa dharma tā eva hīyeta iti atas katham asau tad smṛti hetuḥ vyāvṛtta tayā eva tu smṛti hetu tve asya trailokya smaraṇa nimitta tā prasajyeta tatas api vyāvṛtta tvāt iti

na eṣa doṣaḥ prakāra antareṇa asya smṛti hetu tvāt iha hi keṣucid keṣucid asādhāraṇa dharmāḥ dharmiṣu bhavantaḥ tad gata sādhāraṇa dharma antara sahacaritāḥ bhavanti tat yathā pṛthivī tvac andha tva ādayaḥ dharmāḥ pṛthivyām asādhāraṇā ssantaḥ sneha vat tva ādi dharmāḥ ca tathā eva apsu dravya tva sahacāriṇaḥ dṛṣṭāḥ rūpa ādiṣu rūpa tva ādi dharmāḥ guṇa tva sahacāriṇaḥ utkṣepaṇa ādiṣu utkṣepaṇa tva ādi dharmāḥ karma tva sahacāriṇaḥ evam prakṛte api dharmiṇi kasmiṃścid asādhāraṇaḥ dharmaḥ upalabhyamānaḥ kena api sādhāraṇa dharma antareṇa sahacaritaḥ bhavati iti bhavati viśeṣa anusmṛti dvāreṇa saṃśaya sādhanam

nanu evam tarhi vyāvṛtta tvāt eva samāna dharmāt eṣa saṃśayaḥ na aneka dharmāt iti mā evam aneka dharmaḥ eva asau tena vartmanā viśeṣān smārayan saṃśaya janmane kalpate asati hi tasmin kim ālambanam vyāvṛtta tvam syāt iti ala m ati sūkṣma īkṣikayā tasya udāharaṇam bhāṣya kāreṇa darśitam śabde vibhāga ja tvam yathā hi pṛthivī ādau pṛthivī tva ādiḥ vyāvṛttaḥ dharmaḥ dravya tva ādi anugata dharma sahacārī dṛṣṭaḥ evam śabde vibhāga ja tvam dharmaḥ kenacid dravya tva ādīnām anyatamena dharmeṇa sahacaritaḥ syāt iti saṃśayaḥ

nanu vibhāga ja tvam asādhāraṇaḥ na bhavati eva śabda dharmaḥ vibhāga javi bhāge api bhāvāt tathā ca prayogaḥ guṇaḥ śabdaḥ vibhāga ja tvāt vibhāga ja vi bhāga vat iti tatra kecid āhuḥ satyam asti vibhāge api vibhāga ja tvam śabde tu viśeṣaḥ vivakṣitaḥ dvividhaḥ hi vibhāga jaḥ vibhāgaḥ kāraṇa vibhāga pūrvakaḥ kāraṇa akāraṇa vibhāga pūrvakaḥ ca kāraṇam samavāyi kāraṇam atra abhipretam kāraṇa vibhāga pūrvakaḥ tāvat tantu vibhāgāt tantu ākāśa vibhāgaḥ

kāraṇa akāraṇa vibhāga pūrvakaḥ tu aṅgulī ākāśa vibhāgāt hasta ākāśa vibhāgaḥ hasta ākāśa vibhāgāt api śarīra ākāśa vibhāgaḥ iti śabdaḥ tu niyamena eva kāraṇa vibhāga pūrvaka vi bhāga prabhavaḥ vaṃśa dala vibhāgāt dala ākāśa vibhāgaḥ dala ākāśa vibhāgāt ca asamavāyi kāraṇāt śabdaḥ niṣpadyate iti anena viśeṣeṇa āsya īdṛśa vibhāga ja tu asya asādhāraṇa tvam śabda dharmasya ucyate iti

anye tu vibhāga jam vibhāgam amṛṣyamāṇāḥ yathāśrutasya eva śabde vibhāga ja tu asya asādhāraṇa dharma tām ācakṣate nanu kim iti vibhāga jam vibhāgam te na mṛṣyante asti hi ayam tad siddhau nyāyaḥ yadā hi avayave karma utpannam avayava antarāt vibhāgam karoti na tad ākāśa ādi deśāt yadā tu ākāśa ādi deśāt na tadā aayava antarāt iti sthitiḥ

kim kṛtā punar iyam sthitiḥ iti ced ucyate yā hi avayava kriyā nabhaḥ bhāga vibhāga kāriṇī na asau dravya ārambhaka saṃyoga pratipakṣa bhūtam vibhāgam ārabhamāṇā dṛśyate dinakara kiraṇa parāmarśa upajanita kamala dala vikāsa kāri kriyāvat tat eva katham iti ced kamalasya mukula vikāsa daśayoḥ pratyabhijñāyamāna tvena avināśa niścayāt iyam tu pāṭyamāna vaṃśa dala kriyā dravya ārambhaka saṃyoga pratidvandvibhūta vibhāga ārambhikā dravyān āraṃbhaka saṃyoga pratidvaṃdvi vibhāga janikā upalabhyate iti na asau nabhasaḥ vibhāgam ārabheta iti atas eṣā sthitiḥ asti iti vibhāga ja vibhāga kalpanā kriyate

saṃyoga antam karma iti tāvat sthitam anyathā hi tasya kāla antara sthāyi tvam nitya dravya samavetasya ca nitya tvam syāt tasmāt karmaṇaḥ acira jīvi tvāt tad vināśakena saṃyogena bhavitavyam uttaraḥ tu saṃyogaḥ pūrva saṃyoga uparame sati jāyate na anyathā na ca vibhāga vyatiriktaḥ kaścana saṃyogasya hantā samasti

karma tu uttara saṃyoga janma nirjñāta kauśalam na hi prāktana saṃyoga vināśāya prakalpate tasmāt vibhāgena eva saṃyoga virodhinā bhavitavyam yat adhikaraṇaḥ vibhāgaḥ tad adhikaraṇam eva saṃyogam upaśamayati na tu aṅguli vibhāgaḥ kuṇḍa badara saṃyoga upamardāya prabhavati iti atas na vaṃśa dala vṛtti vibhāgaḥ dala ākāśa saṃyogam upahantum alam iti nūnam dala ākāśa saṃyoga vairiṇā dala ākāśa vibhāgena bhavitavyam

tat idānīm tasya utpatti kāraṇa cintāyām kriyāyām vaṃśa dala vibhāga mātraḥ pajanane caritārtha tvāt tam nirmāya vibhāga antara nirmāṇe viramya vyāpārā saṃvedanāt avaśyam vaṃśa dala vibhāgaḥ eva pratyāsanna tayā dala ākāśa vibhāga ārambhakaḥ abhyupagamanīyaḥ evam anabhyupagame karma nitya tva prasaṅgāt iti

atra vadanti na karma nitya tvam anabhyupagamyamāne api vibhāga je vibhāge bhaviṣyati uttara saṃyogasya karma vināśa hetoḥ astitvāt pūrva saṃyoga anuparame katham tad utpādaḥ iti ced bāḍham uparate eva pūrva saṃyogaḥ kaḥ tasya uparama hetuḥ iti ced karma hi uttara saṃyoga nimittam yat upeyate tat eva pūrva saṃyoga dhvaṃsa kāri bhaviṣyati na yat janane śaktam aśaktam tad vināśane hetuḥ dahana saṃyogaḥ pākaja utpāda nāśayoḥ

yathā ca vibhāge adhikaraṇa niyamaḥ yad ādhāraḥ vibhāgaḥ tad ādhāram eva saṃyogam niruṇaddhi tathā karmaṇi api niyamaḥ karma api sva āśrayasya yat anya diś saṃyoga nibandhanam tat tad viruddha diś vṛtteḥ saṃyogasya upamardakam iti na ati prasaṅgaḥ evam karma āviṣṭasya uttara saṃyoga darśa nam adūṣaṇam vigantara saṃyogasya tena upamardanāt

api ca yat eva karma vaṃśa dalana vibhāga kāri kathyate tat eva dala ākāśa vibhāga kāri bhaviṣyati kaḥ doṣaḥ nanu vyoma vibhāga kāri karma na dravya ārambhaka saṃyoga pratyanīka bhūta vibhā ārambhakam ambhoruha karma vat iti uktam satyam uktam ayuktam tu śatapatra patra karmaṇaḥ api dravya ārambhaka saṃyoga pratikūla vibhāga ārambhaka tvāt tat ca karma kuḍmala kamalāt vikaca kamalasya anya tva niścayāt niścitam

nanu tat eva idam aravindam iti saṃdeha viparyaya rahita tāmarasa pratyabhijñā darśanāt katham saṃkoca vikāsa daśā mātra bhedāt tad anyatvam iti kṛtam anayā durā śayā śarīre api su spaṣṭa upalabhyamāna śaiśava yauvana vārdhaka ādi daśā bheda bhinna svarūpe pratyabhijñāna darśanāt na ca śarīra kuśeśayayoḥ viśeṣa leśam ati kṛśam api paśyāmaḥ iti kutas tat eka tvam bhavatu vā puṇḍarīkasya avināśaḥ nidarśana mātram idam tu varṇitam na tu pratibaddhaḥ kaścana hetuḥ asti iti abhyadhāyi yena vaṃśa dala karmaṇaḥ kokanada pallava karma sāmyam kalpyeta kriyā tvam tu aprayojakam eva tad karmaṇām vicitra kārya hetu tvāt

yadi vā na anyaḥ vaṃśa dala vibhāgaḥ na anyaḥ ca tad kāryaḥ dala ākāśa vibhāgaḥ kintu ekaḥ eva vibhāgaḥ ayam bhedaḥ asi a āśraya bhedataḥ ekatra deśe avasthānāt vyomnaḥ vaṃśa dalasya ca samāna deśe vṛtti tvam mūrtānām hi viruddhyate vyomnassarva gata tvāt tu vidyate tatra sannidhiḥ eka deśa āśraya tve tu yat ekasmāt vibhāga kṛt tat eva anyatas iti asti na vibhāgaḥ vibhāga jaḥ

apare punar vibhāga ja vibhāga parākaraṇa upārūḍha rabhasāḥ saṃgirante tiṣṭhatu tāvat dūratas eva vimāga jaḥ vibhāgaḥ karma jaḥ api na vibhāgaḥ nāma kaścid asti saṃyoga virodhini tasmin abhyupagamyamāne mudgara ādi vat pūrva siddha tā avaśyaṃbhāvinī tatas ca pūrva siddhaḥ vibhāgaḥ saṃyogam unmūlayati iti ghaṭa mudgarayoḥ iva saṃyoga vibhāgayoḥ ekatra yugapad upalabdhiḥ bhaveta na ca evam asti tasmāt saṃyoga abhāva viṣayaḥ eva vibhakta pratyayaḥ iti na vibhāga ālambanatām pratipadyate
