sthūla svarūpa sūkṣma anvaya arthavattva saṃyamāt bhūta jayaḥ tatra pārthiva ādyāḥ śabda ādayaḥ viśeṣāḥ saha ākāra ādibhiḥ dharmaiḥ sthūla śabdena paribhāṣitāḥ etat bhūtānām prathamam rūpam dvitīyam rūpam sva sāmānyam mūrtiḥ bhūmiḥ snehaḥ jalam vahniḥ uṣṇa tā vāyuḥ praṇāmī sarvatas gatiḥ ākāśaḥ iti etat svarūpa śabdena ucyate

asya sāmānyasya śabda ādayaḥ viśeṣāḥ tathā ca uktam eka jāti samanvitānām eṣām dharma mātra vyāvṛttiḥ iti sāmānya viśeṣa samudāyaḥ atra dravyam dviṣṭhaḥ hi samūhaḥ pratyastamita bheda avayava anugataḥ śarīram vṛkṣaḥ yūtham vanam iti śabdena upātta bheda avayava anugataḥ samūhaḥ ubhaye deva manuṣyāḥ samūhasya devāḥ ekaḥ bhāgaḥ manuṣyāḥ dvitīyaḥ bhāgaḥ tābhyām eva abhidhīyate samūhaḥ

sa ca bheda abheda vivakṣitaḥ āmrāṇām vanam brāhmaṇānām saṃghaḥ āmravaṇam brāhmaṇa saṃghaḥ iti sa punar dvividhaḥ yutasiddha avayavaḥ ayutasiddha avayavaḥ ca yutasiddha avayavaḥ samūhaḥ vanam saṃghaḥ iti ayutasiddha avayavaḥ saṃghātaḥ śarīram vṛkṣaḥ paramāṇuḥ iti ayutasiddha avayava bheda anugataḥ samūhaḥ dravyam iti patañjaliḥ etat svarūpam iti uktam

atha kim eṣām sūkṣma rūpam tanmātram bhūta kāraṇam tasya ekaḥ avayavaḥ paramāṇuḥ sāmānya viśeṣa ātma ayuta siddha avayava bheda anugataḥ samudāyaḥ iti evam sarva tanmātrāṇi etat tṛtīyam atha bhūtānām caturtham rūpam khyāti kriyā sthiti śīlāḥ guṇāḥ kārya svabhāva anupātinaḥ anvaya śabdena uktāḥ atha eṣām pañcamam rūpam arthavat tvam bhoga apavarga artha tā guṇeṣu eva anvayinī guṇāḥ tanmātra bhūta bhautikeṣu iti sarvam arthavat teṣu idānīm bhūteṣu pañcasu pañca rūpeṣu saṃyamāt tasya tasya rūpasya svarūpa darśanam jayaḥ ca prādurbhavati tatra pañca bhūta svarūpāṇi jitvā bhūta jayī bhavati tad jayād vatsa anusāriṇyaḥ iva gāvaḥ asya saṃkalpa anuvidhāyinyaḥ bhūta prakṛtayaḥ bhavanti

tatas aṇima ādi prādurbhāvaḥ kāya saṃpad tad dharmānabhighātaḥ ca tatra aṇimā bhavati aṇuḥ laghimā laghuḥ bhavati mahimā mahān bhavati prāptiḥ aṅgulī agreṇa api spṛśati candramasam prākāmyam icchā anabhighātaḥ bhūmau unmajjati nimajjati yathā udake vaśitvam bhūta bhautikeṣu vaśī bhavati avaśyaḥ ca anyeṣām īśitṛ tvam teṣām prabhava apyaya vyūhānām īṣṭe yatra kāmāvasāyi tvam satya saṃkalpa tā yathā saṃkalpaḥ tathā bhūta prakṛtīnām avasthānam na ca śaktaḥ api padārtha viparyāsam karoti kasmāt anyasya yatra kāma avasāyinaḥ pūrva siddhasya tathā bhūteṣu saṃkalpāt iti etāni aṣṭau aiśvaryāṇi kāya saṃpad vakṣyamāṇā tad dharmānabhighātaḥ ca pṛthvī mūrtyā na niruṇaddhi yoginaḥ śarīra ādi kriyām śilām api anuviśati iti na apaḥ snigdhāḥ kledayanti na agniḥ uṣṇaḥ dahati na vāyuḥ praṇāmī vahati anāvaraṇa ātmake api ākāśe bhavati āvṛta kāyaḥ siddhānām api adṛśyaḥ bhavati
rūpa lāvaṇya bala vajra saṃhanana tvāni kāya saṃpad darśanīyaḥ kāntimān atiśaya balaḥ vajra saṃhananaḥ ca iti

grahaṇa svarūpa asmita anvaya arthavattva saṃyamāt indriya jayaḥ sāmānya viśeṣa ātmā śabda ādiḥ grāhyaḥ teṣu indriyāṇām vṛttiḥ grahaṇam na ca tad sāmānya mātra grahaṇa ākāram katham anālocitaḥ sa viṣaya viśeṣaḥ indriyeṇa manasā anuvyavasīyeta iti svarūpam punar prakāśa ātmanaḥ buddhi sattvasya sāmānya viśeṣayoḥ ayutasiddha avayava bheda anugataḥ samūhaḥ dravyam indriyam teṣām tṛtīyam rūpam asmitā lakṣaṇaḥ ahaṃkāraḥ tasya sāmānyasya indriyāṇi viśeṣāḥ caturtham rūpam vyavasāya ātmakāḥ prakāśa kriyā sthiti śīlāḥ guṇāḥ yeṣām indriyāṇi sa ahaṃkārāṇi pariṇāmaḥ pañcamam rūpam guṇeṣu yat anugatam puruṣa arthavat tvam iti pañcasu eteṣu indriya rūpeṣu yathākramam saṃyamaḥ tatra tatra jayam kṛtvā pañca rūpa jayāt indriya jayaḥ prādurbhavati yoginaḥ

tatas manojavi tvam vikaraṇa bhāvaḥ pradhāna jayaḥ ca kāyasya anuttamaḥ gati lābhaḥ manojavi tvam videhānām indriyāṇām abhipreta deśa kāla viṣaya apekṣaḥ vṛtti lābhaḥ vikaraṇa bhāvaḥ sarva prakṛti vikāra vaśi tvam pradhāna jayaḥ iti etāḥ tisraḥ siddhayaḥ madhupratīkāḥ ucyante etāḥ ca karaṇa pañca rūpa jayāt adhigamyante

sattva puruṣa anya tā khyāti mātrasya sarva bhāva adhiṣṭhātṛ tvam sarvajñātṛ tvam ca nirdhūta rajaḥ tamaḥ malasya buddhi sattvasya pare vaiśāradye parasyām vaśīkāra saṃjñāyām vartamānasya sattva puruṣa anya tā khyāti mātra rūpa pratiṣṭhasya sarva bhāva adhiṣṭhātṛ tvam sarva ātmānaḥ guṇāḥ vyavasāya vyavaseya ātmakāḥ svāminam kṣetrajñam pratyaśeṣa dṛśya ātma tvena upasthitāḥ iti arthaḥ sarvajñātṛ tvam sarva ātmanām guṇānām śānta udita avyapadeśya dharma tvena vyavasthitānām akrama upārūḍham viveka jam jñānam iti arthaḥ iti eṣā viśokā nāma siddhiḥ yām prāpya yogī sarvajñaḥ kṣīṇa kleśa bandhanaḥ vaśī viharati

tad vairāgyāt api doṣa bīja kṣaye kaivalyam yadā asya evam bhavati kleśa karma kṣaye sattvasya ayam viveka pratyayaḥ dharmaḥ sattvam ca heya pakṣe nyastam puruṣaḥ ca apariṇā amī śuddhaḥ anyaḥ sattvāt iti evam asya tatas virajyamānasya yāni kleśa bījāni dagdha śāli bīja kalpāni aprasava samarthāni tāni saha manasā pratyastam gacchanti teṣu pralīneṣu puruṣaḥ punar idam tāpa trayam na bhuṅkte tat eteṣām guṇānām manasi karma kleśa vipāka svarūpeṇa abhivyaktānām carita arthānām pratiprasave puruṣasya ātyantikaḥ guṇa viyogaḥ kaivalyam tadā svarūpa pratiṣṭhā citi śaktiḥ eva puruṣaḥ iti

sthāni upanimantraṇe saṅga smayā karaṇam punar aniṣṭa prasaṅgāt catvāraḥ khalu amī yoginaḥ prāthamakalpikaḥ madhu bhūmikaḥ prajñā jyotiḥ atikrānta bhāvanīyaḥ ca iti tatra abhyāsī pravṛtta mātra jyotiḥ prathamaḥ ṛtaṃbhara prajñaḥ dvitīyaḥ bhūta indriya jayī tṛtīyaḥ sarveṣu bhāviteṣu bhāvanīyeṣu kṛta rakṣā bandhaḥ kartavya sādhanāt imān caturthaḥ yaḥ tu atikrānta bhāvanīyaḥ tasya citta pratisargaḥ ekaḥ arthaḥ saptavidhā asya prānta bhūmi prajñā

tatra madhumatīm bhūmim sākṣāt kurvataḥ brāhmaṇasya sthāninaḥ devāḥ sattva viśuddhim anupaśyantaḥ sthānaiḥ upanimantrayante bho iha āsyatām iha ramyatām kamanīyaḥ ayam bhogaḥ kamanīyā iyam kanyā rasāyanam idam jarā mṛtyum bādhate vaihāyasam idam yānam amī kalpadrumāḥ puṇyā mandākinī siddhā mahā ṛṣayaḥ uttamā anukūlāḥ apsarasaḥ divye śrotra cakṣuṣī vajra upamaḥ kāyaḥ sva guṇaiḥ sarvam idam upārjitam āyuṣmatā pratipadyatām idam akṣayam ajaram amara sthānam devānām priyam iti evam abhidhīyamānaḥ saṅga doṣān bhāvayet ghoreṣu saṃsāra aṅgāreṣu pacyamānena mayā janana maraṇa andhakāre viparivartamānena kathaṃcid āsāditaḥ kleśa timira vināśī yoga pradīpaḥ tasya ca ete tṛṣṇā ya ūnayaḥ viṣaya vāyavaḥ pratipakṣāḥ sa khalu aham labdha ālokaḥ katham anayā viṣaya mṛga tṛṣṇayā vañcitaḥ tasya eva punar pradīptasya saṃsāra agneḥ ātmānam indhanīkuryām iti svasti vaḥ svapna upamebhyaḥ kṛpaṇa jana prārthanīyebhyaḥ viṣayebhyaḥ iti evam niścita matiḥ samādhim bhāvayet

saṅgam akṛtvā smayam api na kuryāt evam aham devānām api prārthanīyaḥ iti smayāt ayam susthitaṃmanyatayā mṛtyunā keśeṣu gṛhītam iva ātmānam na bhāvayiṣyati tathā ca asya cchidra antara prekṣī nityam yatna upacaryaḥ pramādaḥ labdha vivaraḥ kleśān uttambhayiṣyati tatas punar aniṣṭa prasaṅgaḥ evam asya saṅgasmayau akurvataḥ bhāvitaḥ arthaḥ dṛḍhībhaviṣyati bhāvanīyaḥ ca arthaḥ abhimukhībhaviṣyati iti

kṣaṇa tad kramayoḥ saṃyamāt viveka jam jñānam yathā apakarṣa paryantam dravyam paramāṇuḥ evam parama apakarṣa paryantaḥ kālaḥ kṣaṇaḥ yāvatā vā samayena calitaḥ paramāṇuḥ pūrva deśam jahyāt uttara deśam upasaṃpadyeta sa kālaḥ kṣaṇaḥ tad pravāha avicchedaḥ tu kramaḥ kṣaṇa tad kramayoḥ na asti vastu samāhāraḥ iti buddhi samāhāraḥ muhūrta ahorātra ādayaḥ sa khalu ayam kālaḥ vastu śūnyaḥ api buddhi nirmāṇaḥ śabda jñāna anupātī laukikānām vyutthita darśanānām vastu svarūpaḥ iva avabhāsate

kṣaṇaḥ tu vastu patitaḥ krama avalambī kramaḥ ca kṣaṇa anantari ātmā tam kāla vidaḥ kālaḥ iti ācakṣate yoginaḥ na ca dvau kṣaṇau saha bhavataḥ kramaḥ ca na dvayoḥ saha bhuvoḥ asaṃbhavāt pūrvasmāt uttara bhāvinaḥ yat ā ānantaryam kṣaṇasya sa kramaḥ tasmāt vartamānaḥ eva ekaḥ kṣaṇaḥ na pūrva uttara kṣaṇāḥ santi iti tasmāt na asti tad samāhāraḥ ye tu bhūta bhāvinaḥ kṣaṇāḥ te pariṇāma anvitā vyākhyeyāḥ tena ekena kṣaṇena kṛtsnaḥ lokaḥ pariṇāmam anubhavati tad kṣaṇa upārūḍhāḥ khalu amī sarve dharmāḥ tayoḥ kṣaṇa tad kramayoḥ saṃyamāt tayoḥ sākṣātkaraṇam tatas ca viveka jam jñānam prādurbhavati tasya viṣaya viśeṣaḥ upakṣipyate

jāti lakṣaṇa deśaiḥ anyatā anavacchedāt tulyayoḥ tatas pratipattiḥ tulyayoḥ deśa lakṣaṇa sārūpye jāti bhedaḥ anya tāyāḥ hetuḥ gauḥ iyam baḍaveyam iti tulya deśa jātīya tve lakṣaṇam anya tva karam kālākṣī gauḥ svastimatī gauḥ iti dvayoḥ āmalakayoḥ jāti lakṣaṇa sārūpyāt deśa bhedaḥ anya tva karaḥ idam pūrvam idam uttaram iti yadā tu pūrvam āmalakam anya vyagrasya jñātuḥ uttara deśaḥ upāvartyate tadā tulya deśa tve pūrvam etat uttaram etat iti pravibhāga anupapattiḥ asaṃdigdhena ca tattva jñānena bhavitavyam iti atas idam uktam tatas pratipattiḥ viveka ja jñānāt iti

katham pūrva āmalaka sahakṣaṇaḥ deśaḥ uttara āmalaka sahakṣaṇāt deśāt bhinnaḥ te ca āmalake sva deśa kṣaṇa anubhava bhinne anya deśa kṣaṇa anubhavaḥ tu tayoḥ anya tve hetuḥ iti etena dṛṣṭāntena paramāṇoḥ tulya jāti lakṣaṇa deśasya pūrva paramāṇu deśa sahakṣaṇa sākṣāt karaṇāt uttarasya paramāṇoḥ tad deśānupapattau uttarasya tad deśa anubhavaḥ bhinnaḥ sa hakṣaṇa bhedāt tayoḥ īśvarasya yoginaḥ anya tva pratyayaḥ bhavati iti apare tu varṇayanti ye antyāḥ viśeṣāḥ te anya tā pratyayam kurvanti iti tatra api deśa lakṣaṇa bhedaḥ mūrti vyavadhi jāti bhedaḥ ca anya tve hetuḥ kṣaṇa bhedaḥ tu yogi buddhi gamyaḥ eva iti atas uktam mūrti vyavadhi jāti bheda abhāvāt na asti mūlapṛthaktvam iti vārṣagaṇyaḥ

tārakam sarva viṣayam sarvathā viṣayam akramam ca iti viveka jam jñānam tārakam iti sva pratibhā uttham anaupadeśikam iti arthaḥ sarva viṣayam na asya kiṃcid aviṣayībhūtam iti arthaḥ sarvathā viṣayam atīta anāgata pratyutpannam sarvam paryāyaiḥ sarvathā jānāti iti arthaḥ akramam iti eka kṣaṇa upārūḍham sarvam sarvathā gṛhṇāti iti arthaḥ etat viveka jam jñānam paripūrṇam asya eva aṃśaḥ yoga pradīpaḥ madhumatīm bhūmim upādāya yāvat asya parisamāptiḥ iti prāpta viveka ja jñānasya aprāpta viveka ja jñānasya vā

sattva puruṣayoḥ śuddhi sāmye kaivalyam iti yadā nirdhūta rajaḥ tamaḥ malam buddhi sattvam puruṣasya anya tā pratīti mātra adhikāram dagdha kleśa bījam bhavati tadā puruṣasya śuddhi sārūpyam iva āpannam bhavati tadā puruṣasya upacarita bhoga abhāvaḥ śuddhiḥ etasyām avasthāyām kaivalyam bhavati īśvarasya anīśvarasya vā viveka ja jñāna bhāginaḥ itarasya vā na hi dagdha kleśa bījasya jñāne punar apekṣā kācid asti sattva śuddhi dvāreṇa etat samādhi jam aiśvaryam jñānam ca upakrāntam paramārthataḥ tu jñānāt adarśanam nivartate tasmin nivṛtte na santi uttare kleśāḥ kleśa abhāvāt karma vipāka abhāvaḥ carita adhikārāḥ ca etasyām avasthāyām guṇāḥ na puruṣasya punar dṛśya tvena upatiṣṭhante tatpuruṣasya kaivalyam tadā puruṣaḥ sva rūpa mātra jyotiḥ amalaḥ kevalī bhavati

janma auṣadhi mantra tapaḥ samādhi jāḥ siddhayaḥ deha antaritā janmanā siddhiḥ oṣadhibhiḥ asura bhavaneṣu rasāyanena iti evamādiḥ mantraiḥ ākāśa gamana aṇima ādi lābhaḥ tapasā saṃkalpa siddhiḥ kāmarūpī yatra tatra kāma gaḥ iti evamādi samādhi jāḥ siddhayaḥ vyākhyātāḥ tatra kāya indriyāṇām anya jātīya pariṇatānām

jāti antara pariṇāmaḥ prakṛti āpūrāt pūrva pariṇāma apāyaḥ uttara pariṇāma upajanaḥ teṣām apūrva avayava anupraveśāt bhavati kāya indriya prakṛtayaḥ ca svam svam vikāram anugṛhṇanti āpūreṇa dharma ādi nimittam apekṣamāṇāḥ iti

nimittam aprayojakam prakṛtīnām varaṇa bhedaḥ tu tatas kṣetrika vat na hi dharma ādi nimittam tad prayojakam prakṛtīnām bhavati na kāryeṇa kāraṇam pravartyate iti katham tarhi varaṇa bhedaḥ tu tatas kṣetrika vat yathā kṣetrikaḥ kedārāt apām pūrṇāt kedāra antaram piplāvayiṣuḥ samam nimnam nimnataram vā na apaḥ pāṇinā apakarṣati āvaraṇam tu āsām bhinatti tasmin bhinne svayam eva apaḥ kedāra antaram āplāvayanti tathā dharmaḥ prakṛtīnām āvaraṇa dharmam bhinatti tasmin bhinne svayam eva prakṛtayaḥ svam svam vikāram āplāvayanti yathā vā saḥ eva kṣetrikaḥ tasmin eva kedāre na prabhavati audakān bhaumān vā rasān dhānya mūlāni anupraveśayitum kim tarhi mudga gavedhu ka śyāmāka ādīn tatas apakarṣati apakṛṣṭeṣu teṣu svayam eva rasāḥ dhānya mūlāni anupraviśanti tathā dharmaḥ nivṛtti mātre kāraṇam adharmasya śuddhi aśuddhyoḥ atyanta virodhāt na tu prakṛti pravṛttau dharmaḥ hetuḥ bhavati iti atra nandīśvara ādayaḥ udāhāryāḥ viparyayeṇa api adharmaḥ dharmam bādhate tatas ca aśuddhi pariṇāmaḥ iti tatra api nahuṣa ajagara ādayaḥ udāhāryāḥ yadā tu yogī bahūn kāyāt nirmimīte tadā kim eka manaskāḥ te bhavanti atha aneka manaskāḥ iti
nirmāṇa cittāni asmitā mātrāt asmitā mātram citta kāraṇam upādāya nirmāṇa cittāni karoti tatas sa cittāni bhavanti iti
pravṛtti bhede prayojakam cittam ekam anekeṣām bahūnām cittānām katham ekacitta abhiprāya puraḥsarā pravṛttiḥ iti sarva cittānām prayojakam cittam ekaṭ nirmimīte tatas pravṛtti bhedaḥ

tatra dhyāna jam anāśayam pañcavidham nirmāṇa cittam janma auṣadhi mantra tapaḥ samādhi jāḥ siddhayaḥ iti tatra yat eva dhyāna jam cittam tat eva anāśayam tasya eva na asti āśayaḥ rāga ādi pravṛttiḥ na atas puṇya pāpa abhisaṃbandhaḥ kṣīṇa kleśa tvāt yoginaḥ iti itareṣām tu vidyate karma āśayaḥ yatas

karma aśukla akṛṣṇam yoginaḥ trividham itareṣām catuṣpadī khalu iyam karma jātiḥ kṛṣṇā śukla kṛṣṇā śukla aśukla akṛṣṇā ca iti tatra kṛṣṇā durātmanām śukla kṛṣṇā bahis sādhana sādhyā tatra para pīḍā anugraha dvāreṇa eva karma āśaya pracayaḥ śuklā tapaḥ svādhyāya dhyānavatām sā hi kevale manasi āyatta tvāt abahiḥ sādhana adhīnā na parān pīḍayitvā bhavati aśukla akṛṣṇā saṃnyāsinām kṣīṇa kleśānām carama dehānām iti tatra āśuklam yoginaḥ eva phala saṃnyāsāt akṛṣṇam ca anupādānāt itareṣām tu bhūtānām pūrvam eva trividham iti

tatas tad vipāka anuguṇānām eva abhivyaktiḥ vāsanānām tatas iti trividhāt karmaṇaḥ tad vipāka anuguṇānām eva iti yat jātīyasya karmaṇaḥ yaḥ vipākaḥ tasya anuguṇāḥ yāḥ vāsanāḥ karma vipākam anuśerate tāsām eva abhivyaktiḥ na hi daivam karma vipacyamānam nāraka tiryak manuṣya vāsanā abhivyakti nimittam saṃbhavati kiṃtu daiva anuguṇāḥ eva asya vāsanāḥ vyajyante nāraka tiryak manuṣyeṣu ca evam samānaḥ carcaḥ

jāti deśa kāla vyavahitānām api ānantaryam smṛti saṃskārayoḥ eka rūpa tvāt vṛṣadaṃśa vipāka udayaḥ sva vyañjaka añjana abhivyaktaḥ sa yadi jāti śatena vā dūra deśa tayā vā kalpa śatena vā vyavahitaḥ punar ca sva vyañjaka añjanaḥ eva udiyāt drāk iti evam pūrva anubhūta vṛṣa daṃśa vipāka abhisaṃskṛtāḥ vāsanā upādāya vyajyeta kasmāt yatas vyavahitānām api āsām sadṛśam karma abhivyajñakam nimittībhūtam iti ānantaryam eva kutas ca smṛti saṃskārayoḥ eka rūpa tvāt yathā anubhavāḥ tathā saṃskārāḥ te ca karma vāsanā anurūpāḥ yathā ca vāsanāḥ tathā smṛtiḥ iti jāti deśa kāla vyavahitebhyaḥ saṃskārebhyaḥ smṛtiḥ smṛteḥ ca punar saṃskārāḥ iti evam ete smṛti saṃskārāḥ karma āśaya vṛtti lābha vaśād vyajyante atas ca vyavahitānām api nimitta naimittika bhāva anucchedāt ānantaryam eva siddham iti

tāsām anādi tvam ca āśiṣaḥ nitya tvāt tāsām vāsanānām āśiṣaḥ nitya tvāt anādi tvam yā iyam ātma āśīḥ mā na bhūvam bhūyāsam iti sarvasya dṛśyate sā na svābhāvikī kasmāt jāta mātrasya jantoḥ ananubhūta maraṇa dharmakasya dveṣa duḥkha anusmṛti nimittaḥ maraṇa trāsaḥ katham bhavet na ca svābhāvikam vastu nimittam upādatte tasmāt anādi vāsanā anuviddham idam cittam nimitta vaśāt kāścid eva vāsanāḥ pratilabhya puruṣasya bhogāya upāvartate iti ghaṭa prāsāda pradīpa kalpam saṃkoca vikāsi cittam śarīra parimāṇa ākāra mātram iti apare pratipannāḥ tathā ca antara abhāvaḥ saṃsāraḥ ca yuktaḥ iti

vṛttiḥ eva asya vibhunaḥ cittasya saṃkoca vikāsinī iti ācāryaḥ tat ca dharma ādi nimitta apekṣam nimittam ca dvividham bāhyam ādhyātmikam ca śarīra ādi sādhana apekṣam bāhyam stuti dāna abhivādana ādi citta mātra adhīnam śraddhā ādi adhyātmikam tathā ca uktam ye ca ete maitrī ādayaḥ dhyāyinām vihārāḥ te bāhya sādhana niranugraha ātmānaḥ prakṛṣṭam dharmam abhinirvartayanti tayoḥ mānasam balīyaḥ katham jñāna vairāgye kena atiśayyete daṇḍaka araṇyam ca citta bala vyatirekeṇa śārīreṇa karmaṇā śūnyam kaḥ kartum utsaheta samudram agastya vat vā pibet

hetu phala āśraya ālambanaiḥ saṃgṛhīta tvāt eṣām abhāve tad abhāvaḥ hetuḥ dharmāt sukham adharmāt duḥkham sukhāt rāgaḥ duḥkhāt dveṣaḥ tatas ca prayatnaḥ tena manasā vācā kāyena vā parispandamānaḥ param anugṛhṇāti upahanti vā tatas punar dharma adharmau sukha duḥkhe rāga dveṣau iti pravṛttam idam ṣaṣ aram saṃsāra cakram asya ca pratikṣaṇam āvartamānasya avidyā netrī mūlam sarva kleśānām iti eṣa hetuḥ phalam tu yam āśritya yasya pratyutpanna tā dharma ādeḥ na hi apūrva upajanaḥ manaḥ tu sādhikāram āśrayaḥ vāsanānām na hi avasita adhikāre manasi nirāśrayāḥ vāsanāḥ sthātum utsahante yat abhimukhībhūtam vastu yām vāsanām vyanakti tasyāḥ tad ālambanam evam hetu phala āśraya ālambanaiḥ etaiḥ saṃgṛhītāḥ sarvāḥ vāsanāḥ eṣām abhāve tad saṃśrayāṇām api vāsanānām abhāvaḥ na asti asataḥ saṃbhavaḥ na ca asti sataḥ vināśaḥ iti dravya tvena saṃbhavantyaḥ katham nivartiṣyante vāsanāḥ iti

atīta anāgatam svarūpataḥ asti adhva bhedāt dharmāṇām bhaviṣyat vyaktikam anāgatam anubhūta vyaktikam atītam sva vyāpāra upārūḍham vartamānam trayam ca etat vastu jñānasya jñeyam yadi ca etat svarūpataḥ na abhaviṣyat na idam nirviṣayam jñānam udapatsyata tasmāt atīta anāgatam svarūpataḥ asti iti kiṃca bhoga bhāgīyasya vā apavarga bhāgīyasya vā karmaṇaḥ phalam utpitsu yadi nirupākhyam iti tad uddeśena tena nimittena kuśala anuṣṭhānam na yujyeta sataḥ ca phalasya nimittam vartamānīkaraṇe samartham na apūrva upajanane siddham nimittam naimittikasya viśeṣa anugrahaṇam kurute na apūrvam utpādayati iti

dharmī ca aneka dharma svabhāvaḥ tasya ca adhva bhedena dharmāḥ pratyavasthitāḥ na ca yathā vartamānam vyakti viśeṣa āpannam dravyataḥ asti evam atītam anāgatam ca katham tarhi svena eva vyaṅgyena svarūpeṇa anāgatam asti svena ca anubhūta vyaktikena sva rūpeṇa atītam iti vartamānasya eva adhvanaḥ sva rūpa vyaktiḥ iti na sā bhavati atīta anāgatayoḥ adhvanoḥ ekasya ca adhvanaḥ samaye dvau adhvanau dharmi samanvāgatau bhavataḥ eva iti na abhūtvā bhāvaḥ trayāṇām adhvanām iti

te vyakta sūkṣmā guṇa ātmānaḥ te khalu amī tri adhvanaḥ dharmāḥ vartamānāḥ vyakta ātmānaḥ atīta anāgatāḥ sūkṣma ātmānaḥ ṣaṣ aviśeṣa rūpāḥ sarvam idam guṇānām saṃniveśa viśeṣa mātram iti paramārthataḥ guṇa ātmānaḥ tathā ca śāstra anuśāsanam guṇānām paramam rūpam na dṛṣṭi patham ṛcchati yat tu dṛṣṭi patham prāptam tat māyā iva su tucchakam iti yadā tu sarve guṇāḥ katham ekaḥ śabdaḥ ekam indriyam iti

pariṇāma eka tvāt vastu tattvam prakhyā kriyā sthiti śīlānām guṇānām grahaṇa ātmakānām karaṇa bhāvena ekaḥ pariṇāmaḥ śrotram indriyam grāhya ātmakānām śabda tanmātra bhāvena ekaḥ pariṇāmaḥ śabdaḥ viṣayaḥ iti śabda ādīnām mūrti samāna jātīyānām ekaḥ pariṇāmaḥ pṛthivī paramāṇuḥ tanmātra avayavaḥ teṣām ca ekaḥ pariṇāmaḥ pṛthivī gauḥ vṛkṣaḥ parvataḥ iti evamādiḥ bhūta antareṣu api sneha auṣṇya praṇāmi tva avakāśa dānāni upādāya sāmānyam eka vikāra ārambhaḥ samādheyaḥ

na asti arthaḥ vijñāna visaha caraḥ asti tu jñānam artha visahacaram svapna ādau kalpitam iti anayā diśāḥ ye vastu svarūpam apahnuvate jñāna parikalpanā mātram vastu svapna viṣaya upamam na paramārthataḥ asti iti yaḥ āhuḥ te tathā iti pratyupasthitam idam sva māhātmyena vastu katham apramāṇa ātmakena vikalpa jñāna balena vastu svarūpam utsṛjya tat eva apalapantaḥ śraddheya vacanāḥ syuḥ kutas ca etat anyāyyam

vastu sāmye citta bhedāt tayoḥ vibhaktaḥ panthāḥ bahu citta ālambanībhūtam ekam vastu sādhāraṇam tat khalu na eka citta parikalpitam na api aneka citta parikalpitam kiṃtu sva pratiṣṭham katham vastu sāmye citta bhedāt dharma apekṣam cittasya vastu sāmye api sukha jñānam bhavati adharma apekṣam tatas eva duḥkha jñānam avidyā apekṣam tatas eva mūḍha jñānam samyak darśana apekṣam tatas eva mādhyasthya jñānam iti kasya tat cittena parikalpitam na ca anya citta parikalpitena arthena anyasya citta uparāgaḥ yuktaḥ tasmāt vastu jñānayoḥ grāhya grahaṇa bheda bhinnayoḥ vibhaktaḥ panthāḥ na anayoḥ saṃkara gandhaḥ api asti iti

sāṃkhya pakṣe punar vastu triguṇam calam ca guṇa vṛttam iti dharma ādi nimitta apekṣam cittaiḥ abhisaṃbadhyate nimitta anurūpasya ca pratyayasya utpadyamānasya tena tena ātmanā hetuḥ bhavati kecid āhuḥ jñāna saha bhūḥ eva arthaḥ bhogya tvāt sukha ādi vat iti te etayā dvārā sādhāraṇa tvam bādhamānāḥ pūrva uttara kṣaṇeṣu vastu rūpam eva apahnuvate

na ca ekacitta tantram vastu tat apramāṇakam tadā kim syāt ekacitta tantram ced vastu syāt tadā citte vyagre niruddhe vā asvarūpam eva tena aparāmṛṣṭam anyasya aviṣayībhūtam apramāṇakam agṛhīta svabhāvakam kenacid tadānīm kim tat syāt saṃbadhyamānam ca punar cittena kutas utpadyeta ye ca asya anupasthitāḥ bhāgāḥ te ca asya na syuḥ evam na asti pṛṣṭham iti udaram api na gṛhyeta tasmāt svatantraḥ arthaḥ sarva puruṣa sādhāraṇaḥ svatantrāṇi ca cittāni prati puruṣam pravartante tayoḥ saṃbandhāt upalabdhiḥ puruṣasya bhogaḥ iti

tad uparāga apekṣi tvāt cittasya vastu jñāta ajñātam ayaskānta maṇi kalpāḥ viṣayāḥ ayaḥ sadharmakam cittam abhisaṃbandhya uparañjayanti yena ca viṣayeṇa uparaktam cittam sa viṣayaḥ jñātaḥ tatas anyaḥ punar ajñātaḥ vastunaḥ jñāta ajñāta svarūpa tvāt pariṇāmi cittam yasya tu tat eva cittam viṣayaḥ tasya

sadā jñātāḥ citta vṛttayaḥ tad prabhoḥ puruṣasya apariṇāmi tvāt yadi citta vat prabhuḥ api puruṣaḥ pariṇamet tatas tad viṣayāḥ citta vṛttayaḥ śabda ādi viṣaya vat jñāta ajñātāḥ syuḥ sadā ajñāta tvam tu manasaḥ tad prabhoḥ puruṣasya apariṇāmi tvam anumāpayati syāt āśaṅkā cittam eva su ābhāsam viṣaya ābhāsam ca bhaviṣyati iti agni vat

na tat su ābhāsam dṛśya tvāt yathā itarāṇi indriyāṇi śabda ādayaḥ ca dṛśya tvāt na su ābhāsāni tathā manaḥ api pratyetavyam na ca agniḥ atra dṛṣṭāntaḥ na hi agniḥ ātma svarūpam aprakāśam prakāśayati prakāśaḥ ca ayam prakāśya prakāśaka saṃyoge dṛṣṭaḥ na ca sva rūpa mātre asti saṃyogaḥ kiṃca su ābhāsam cittam iti agrāhyam eva kasyacid iti śabda arthaḥ tat yathā sva ātma pratiṣṭham ākāśam na para pratiṣṭham iti arthaḥ sva buddhi pracāra pratisaṃvedanāt sattvānām pravṛttiḥ dṛśyate kruddhaḥ aham bhītaḥ aham amutra me rāgaḥ amutra me krodhaḥ iti etat sva buddheḥ agrahaṇe na yuktam iti

eka samaye ca ubhaya anavadhāraṇam na ca ekasmin kṣaṇe sva para rūpa avadhāraṇam yuktam kṣaṇika vādinaḥ yat bhavanam sā eva kriyā tat eva ca kārakam iti abhyupagamaḥ syāt matiḥ svarasa niruddham cittam citta antareṇa samanantareṇa gṛhyate iti

citta antara dṛśye buddhi buddheḥ atiprasaṅgaḥ smṛti saṃkaraḥ ca atha cittam ced citta antareṇa gṛhyeta buddhi buddhiḥ kena gṛhyate sā api anyayā sā api anyayā iti atiprasaṅgaḥ smṛti saṃkaraḥ ca yāvantaḥ buddhi buddhīnām anubhavāḥ tāvatyaḥ smṛtayaḥ prāpnuvanti tad saṃkarāt ca eka smṛti anavadhāraṇam ca syāt iti evam buddhi pratisaṃvedinam puruṣam apalapadbhiḥ vaināśikaiḥ sarvam eva ākulīkṛtam te tu bhoktṛ svarūpam yatra kvacana kalpayantaḥ na nyāyena saṃgacchante kecid tu sattva mātram api parikalpya asti sa sattvaḥ yaḥ etān pañca skandhān nikṣipya anyān ca pratisaṃdadhāti iti uktvā tatas eva punar trasyanti tathā skandhānām mahat nirvedāya virāgāya anutpādāya praśāntaye guroḥ antike brahmacaryam cariṣyāmi iti uktvā sattvasya punar sattvam eva apahnuvate sāṃkhya yoga ādayaḥ tu pravādāḥ sva śabdena puruṣam eva svāminam cittasya bhoktāram upayanti iti katham

citeḥ apratisaṃkramāyāḥ tad ākāra āpattau sva buddhi saṃvedanam apariṇāminī hi bhoktṛ śaktiḥ apratisaṃkramā ca pariṇāmini arthe pratisaṃkrāntā iva tad vṛttim anupatati tasyāḥ ca prāpta caitanya upagraha svarūpāyāḥ buddhi vṛtteḥ anukāri mātra tayā buddhi vṛtti aviśiṣṭā hi jñāna vṛttiḥ ākhyāyate tathā ca uktam na pātālam na ca vivaram girīṇām na eva andhakāram kukṣayaḥ na udadhīnām guhā yasyām nihitam brahma śāśvatam buddhi vṛttim aviśiṣṭām kavayaḥ vedayante iti atas ca etat abhyupagamyate

draṣṭṛ dṛśya uparaktam cittam sarva artham manaḥ hi mantavyena arthena uparaktam tat svayam ca viṣaya tvāt viṣayiṇā puruṣeṇa ātmīyayā vṛttyā abhisaṃbaddham tat etat cittam eva draṣṭṛ dṛśya uparaktam viṣaya viṣayi nirbhāsam cetana acetana svarūpa āpannam viṣaya ātmakam api aviṣaya ātmakam iva acetanam cetanam iva sphaṭika maṇi kalpam sarva artham iti ucyate

tat anena citta sārūpyeṇa bhrāntāḥ kecid tat eva cetanam iti āhuḥ apare cittamātram eva idam sarvam na asti khalu ayam gavādiḥ ghaṭa ādiḥ ca sa kāraṇaḥ lokaḥ iti anukampanīyāḥ te kasmāt asti hi teṣām bhrānti bījam sarva rūpa ākāra nirbhāsam cittam iti samādhi prajñāyām prajñeyaḥ arthaḥ pratibimbībhūtaḥ tasya ālambanībhūta tvāt anyaḥ sa ced arthaḥ cittamātram syāt katham prajñayā eva prajñā rūpam avadhāryeta tasmāt pratibimbībhūtaḥ arthaḥ prajñāyām yena avadhāryate sa puruṣaḥ iti evam grahītṛ grahaṇa grāhya svarūpa citta bhedāt trayam api etat jātitaḥ pravibhajante te samyak darśinaḥ taiḥ adhigataḥ puruṣaḥ kutas ca

tat asaṃkhyeya vāsanābhiḥ citram api para artham saṃhatyakāri tvāt tat etat cittam asaṃkhyeyābhiḥ vāsanābhiḥ eva citrīkṛtam api para artham parasya bhoga apavarga artham na sva artham saṃhatyakāri tvāt gṛha vat saṃhatya kāriṇā cittena na sva arthena bhavitavyam na sukha cittam sukha artham na jñānam jñāna artham ubhayam api etat para artham yaḥ ca bhogena apavargeṇa ca arthena arthavān puruṣaḥ saḥ eva paraḥ na paraḥ sāmānya mātram yat tu kiṃcid param sāmānya mātram svarūpeṇa udāharet vaināśikaḥ tat sarvam saṃhatyakāri tvāt para artham eva syāt yaḥ tu asau paraḥ viśeṣaḥ sa na saṃhatya kārī puruṣaḥ iti

viśeṣa darśinaḥ ātma bhāva bhāvanā nivṛttiḥ yathā prāvṛṣi tṛṇa aṅkurasya udbhedena tat bīja sattā anumīyate tathā mokṣa mārga śravaṇena yasya roma harṣa aśru pātau dṛśyete tatra api asti viśeṣa darśana bījam apavarga bhāgīyam karma abhinirvartitam iti anumīyate tasya ātma bhāva bhāvanā svābhāvikī pravartate yasya abhāvāt idam uktam svabhāvam muktvā doṣa āt i eṣām pūrva pakṣe ruciḥ bhavati aruciḥ ca nirṇaye bhavati tatra ātma bhāva bhāvanā kaḥ aham āsam katham aham āsam kiṃsvid idam kathaṃsvid idam ke bhaviṣyāmaḥ katham vā bhaviṣyāmaḥ iti sā tu viśeṣa darśinaḥ nivartate kutas cittasya eva eṣa vicitraḥ pariṇāmaḥ puruṣaḥ tu asatyām avidyāyām śuddhaḥ citta dharmaiḥ aparāmṛṣṭaḥ iti tatas asya ātma bhāva bhāvanā kuśalasya nivartate iti
tadā viveka nimnam kaivalya prāgbhāram cittam tadānīm yat asya cittam viṣaya prāgbhāram ajñāna nimnam āsīt tat asya anyathā bhavati kaivalya prāgbhāram viveka ja jñāna nimnam iti

tad chidreṣu pratyaya antarāṇi saṃskārebhyaḥ pratyaya viveka nimnasya sattva puruṣa anya tā khyāti mātra pravāhiṇaḥ cittasya tad chidreṣu pratyaya antarāṇi asmi iti vā mama iti vā jānāmi iti vā na jānāmi iti vā kutas kṣīyamāṇa bījebhyaḥ pūrva saṃskārebhyaḥ iti

hānam eṣām kleśa vat uktam yathā kleśāḥ dagdha bīja bhāvāḥ na praroha samarthāḥ bhavanti tathā jñāna agninā dagdha bīja bhāvaḥ pūrva saṃskāraḥ na pratyaya prasūḥ bhavati jñāna saṃskārāḥ tu citta adhikāra samāptim anuśerate iti na cintyante

prasaṃkhyāne api akusīdasya sarvathā viveka khyāteḥ dharma meghaḥ samādhiḥ yadā ayam brāhmaṇaḥ prasaṃkhyāne api akusīdaḥ tatas api na kiṃcid prārthayate tatra api viraktasya sarvathā viveka khyātiḥ eva bhavati iti saṃskāra bīja kṣayān na asya pratyaya antarāṇi utpadyante tadā asya dharma meghaḥ nāma samādhiḥ bhavati

tatas kleśa karma nivṛttiḥ tad lābhāt avidyā ādayaḥ kleśāḥ sa mūla kāṣam kaṣitāḥ bhavanti kuśala akuśalāḥ ca karma āśayāḥ sa mūla ghātam hatāḥ bhavanti kleśa karma nivṛttau jīvan eva vidvān vimuktaḥ bhavati kasmāt yasmāt viparyayaḥ bhavasya kāraṇam na hi kṣīṇa viparyayaḥ kaścid kenacid kvacid jātaḥ dṛśyate iti

tadā sarva āvaraṇa mala apetasya jñānasya ānantyāt jñeyam alpam sarvaiḥ kleśa karma āvaraṇaiḥ vimuktasya jñānasya ānantyam bhavati āvarakeṇa tamasā abhibhūtam āvṛtam anantam jñāna sattvam kvacid eva rajasā pravartitam udghāṭitam grahaṇa samartham bhavati tatra yadā sarvaiḥ āvaraṇa malaiḥ apagatam bhavati tadā bhavati asya ānantyam jñānasya ānantyāt jñeyam alpam saṃpadyate yathā ākāśe khadyotaḥ yatra idam uktam andhaḥ maṇim avidhyat tam anaṅguliḥ āvayat agrīvaḥ tam pratyamuñcat tam ajihvaḥ abhyapūjayat iti

tatas kṛtārthānām pariṇāma krama samāptiḥ guṇānām tasya dharma meghasya udayāt kṛtārthānām guṇānām pariṇāma kramaḥ parisamāpyate na hi kṛta bhoga apavargāḥ parisamāpta kramāḥ kṣaṇam api avasthātum utsahante atha kaḥ ayam kramaḥ nāma iti

kṣaṇa pratiyogī pariṇāma apara anta nirgrāhyaḥ kramaḥ kṣaṇa anantari ātmā pariṇāmasya aparāntena avasānena gṛhyate kramaḥ na hi ananubhūta krama kṣaṇā purāṇa tā vastrasya ante bhavati nityeṣu ca kramaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ dvayī ca iyam nityatā kūṭastha nityatā pariṇāmi nityatā ca tatra kūṭastha nityatā puruṣasya pariṇāmi nityatā guṇānām yasmin pariṇamyamāne tattvam na vihanyate tat nityam ubhayasya ca tattva anabhighātāt nitya tvam tatra guṇa dharmeṣu buddhi ādiṣu pariṇāma apara anta nirgrāhyaḥ kramaḥ labdha paryavasānaḥ nityeṣu dharmiṣu guṇeṣu alabdha paryavasānaḥ kūṭastha nityeṣu sva rūpa mātra pratiṣṭheṣu mukta puruṣeṣu svarūpa astitā krameṇa eva anubhūyate iti tatra api alabdha paryavasānaḥ śabda pṛṣṭhena āstikriyām upādāya kalpitaḥ iti

atha asya saṃsārasya sthityā gatyā ca guṇeṣu vartamānasya asti krama samāptiḥ na vā iti avacanīyam etat katham asti praśnaḥ ekānta vacanīyaḥ sarvaḥ jātaḥ mariṣyati iti om bhoḥ iti atha sarvaḥ mṛtvā janiṣyate iti vibhajya vacanīyam etat pratyudita khyātiḥ kṣīṇa tṛṣṇaḥ kuśalaḥ na janiṣyate itaraḥ tu janiṣyate tathā manuṣya jātiḥ śreyasī na vā śreyasi iti evam paripṛṣṭe vibhajya vacanīyaḥ praśnaḥ paśūn adhikṛtya śreyasī devān ṛṣīn ca adhikṛtya na iti ayam tu avacanīyaḥ praśnaḥ saṃsāraḥ ayam antavān atha anantaḥ iti kuśalasya asti saṃsāra krama samāptiḥ na itarasya iti anyatara avadhāraṇe doṣaḥ tasmāt vyākaraṇīyaḥ eva ayam praśnaḥ iti guṇa adhikāra krama samāptau kaivalyam uktam tad svarūpam avadhāryate

puruṣa artha śūnyānām guṇānām pratiprasavaḥ kaivalyam svarūpa pratiṣṭhā vā citi śaktiḥ iti kṛta bhoga apavargāṇām puruṣa artha śūnyānām yaḥ pratiprasavaḥ kārya kāraṇa ātmakānām guṇānām tat kaivalyam svarūpa pratiṣṭhā punar buddhi sattva anabhisaṃbandhāt puruṣasya citi śaktiḥ eva kevalā tasyāḥ sadā tathā eva avasthānam kaivalyam iti

namaḥ buddhāya pramāṇa bhūtāya jagat hita eṣiṇe praṇamya śāstre sugatāya tāyine kutarka sambhrānta jana anukampayā pramāṇa siddhiḥ vidhivat vidhīyate prāyas prastuta vastu vistara bhṛtaḥ na īkṣyante eva uccakais vaktāraḥ parama artha saṃgraha dhiyā vyādhūta phalgu kramāḥ tena asmin virala krama vyapagamāt atyanta śuddhān dhiyam dhanyānām vidadhātum uddhata dhiyām dhīḥ samvide dhīyate atra bhagavataḥ hetu phala sampattyā pramāṇa bhūta tvena stotra abhidhānam śāstra ādau śāstra artha tvāt bhagavān eva hi pramāṇa bhūtaḥ asmin prasādhyate

tatra hetuḥ āśaya prayoga sampad sāṃvyavahārika pramāṇa apekṣayā āśayaḥ jagat hita eṣitā prayogaḥ jagat śāsanāt śāstṛ tvam phalam sva para artha sampad sva artha sampad sugata tvena trividham artham upādāya praśasta tvam svarūpa vat apunarāvṛtti artham su naṣṭa jvara vat niḥśeṣa artham su pūrṇa ghaṭa vat para artha sampad jagat tāraṇāt tāyi tvam santāna arthañcā parinirvāṇa dharmma tvāt evambhūtam bhagavantam praṇamya pramāṇa siddhiḥ vidhīyate pramāṇa adhīnaḥ hi prameya adhigamaḥ bhagavān eva ca pramāṇam pramāṇa lakṣaṇa sadbhāvāt pramīyate anena iti pramāṇam

tatra sāmānyena pramāṇa lakṣaṇam nirdiśati pramāṇam avisaṃvādi jñānam jñānam pramāṇan tatra sati pramiti siddheḥ avisamvādi visamvāde sati viparyayāt indriya artha saṃyoga ādayaḥ hi visamvāda vivikta jñāna upalakṣitāḥ eva tattvam pratilabhante avisamvāda arthī hi sarvaḥ pramāṇa anveṣaṇa prayuktaḥ

nanu a visamvādi tvam tasya sādhana jñānasya svarūpam eva tasmin ca svarūpeṇa jñāyamāne jñātam eva tat iti kim parīkṣyate atha na svarūpa samvedanam tadā pramāṇam eva na asti iti āpatitam na ca ayam pakṣaḥ kṣamaḥ bhavatām iti tat asat na svarūpam eva jñānasya prāmāṇyam samvādi tvamvā api tu artha kriyā sthitiḥ avisamvādanam

na khalu jñāna svarūpa mātra avagatau idam pramāṇam iti bhavati kintarhi arthasya dāha pāka ādeḥ kriyā niṣpattiḥ tasyāḥ sthiti ravicalana visamvādanam vyavasthā vā sā ca artha kriyā bhāvinī na tad kāle tatas tad sambandhaḥ na svarūpa samvedana mātra avadhṛtaḥ nanu tad sambandhi tā svarūpam eva na asti tat katham na svarūpa samvedana mātra avadhāraṇam

na etat asti dviṣṭha sambandha samvittiḥ na eka rūpa pravedanāt dvaya svarūpa grahaṇe sati sambandha vedanam katham tarhi pravarttanā kāle tat jñānam etat uttaratra vakṣyāmaḥ yadi artha kriyā adhigame pūrvakam pramāṇam saḥ api artha kriyā adhigamaḥ pramāṇam apramāṇam vā apramāṇena artha kriyā adhigama abhāvāt pramāṇantat tatas tatas api artha kriyā adhigamaḥ para anveṣaṇīyaḥ iti anavasthā

na idam sādhīyaḥ uttara artha kriyā bhāvāt pūrvasya yadi mānatā tadā eva artha akriyā bhāvāt uttarasya kathat na sā yatra artha kriyā sthitiḥ apara upakalpitā tat yāvat pramāṇam yatra tu svatas tadā eva artha kriyā anubhavaḥ tat sutarām eva pramāṇam artha kriyā sthitiḥ avisamvādanam iti sāmānyena abhidhānāt

nanu dāha pāka ādi artha kriyā iyam svapna īppi sambhavati pītasa śaṅkha ādi jñāne ca śabda viṣaye tu jñāne na dāha pāka ādi artha kriyā svatas paratas ca artha kriyā bhāvāt tasmāt abādhitaḥ bodhaḥ pramāṇam iti yuktam tat api ayuktam yatas śābde api abhiprāya nivedanāt avisamvādanam śabda viṣayam jñānam śābdam api śabdāt anyatra api ayam arthaḥ

svarūpa bodha mātreṇa sarvam jñānam bhavet pramā atha avādhita bodha tvāt svapna ādau api kin na tat bodha mātra saṃgamaḥ hi svapna itara pratyaya sambhavī samānaḥ eva sarvatra sa hi na puruṣa arthasya sādhakaḥ atha ābādhita bodha tvam tat api samānam eva jāgrat pratyayena bādhamāna tā ced koyam bādhaḥ nāma

pareṇa viṣaya abhāva jñāpanam sa yadi hi iṣyate sva arthe pravṛttim ajñānam abhāvam jñāpayet katham na tāvat jñāna antareṇa abhāvaḥ svapna jñānasya anyasya vā kenacid kriyate tad kāle tasya svayam eva nāśāt na ca akṣi nimīlanāt naṣṭe jñāne bādhya tā pratīyate anyena na hi jñānena tasya viṣaya apahāraḥ asattā jñāpana lakṣaṇaḥ bādhaḥ na ca sva viṣaye pravṛttam anya viṣayapahāram racayitum alam svaviṣaya jñāna sva viṣayasya rūpa sādhanam hi jñānānām dharmmaḥ para viṣaya apaharaṇantu narādhipa dharmmaḥ

kathantarhi bādhya bādhaka bhāvaḥ na kathañcid atas eva ābādhita tvam pramāṇa tvam tasmāt yatra artha kriyā na asti tad apramāṇam svayam anyena vā yatra jñāyate na kriyā udayaḥ tad apramāṇam na svapna asvapna bheda usti tattvataḥ vyavahāra mātram eva idam svapnāsvapnabhedaḥ nāma tathā pramāṇa apramāṇa bhedaḥ iti hi vakṣyate na ca asau artha kriyā sthitiḥ avicalita tva abhāvāt bhāvanā mātrau asāyata artha kriyā svapne na tatra paritoṣaḥ abādhita tve tu anavasthā eva prathamam abādhanam sarvatra eva tad uttara kālam abādhane tatra api uttara kālam abādhanam iti kutas

bādhakasya purobhāvaḥ sarva vijñāna sambhavī parantu bādhaka abhāva statra api āśaṃkyatena kim pītasam śaṃkha ādi vijñānantu na pramāṇam eva tathā artha kriyā vāpteḥ abhāvāt saṃsthāna mātra artha kriyā prasiddhau anyat eva jñānam pramāṇam anumānam tathā hi pratibhāsaḥ evambhūtaḥ yaḥ sa na saṃsthāna varjitaḥ evam anyatra dṛṣṭa tvāt anumānam tathā ca tat

yena na kadācid vyabhicāraḥ upalabdhaḥ sa yathā abhiprete visamvādāt visamvādyate eva yaḥ tu vyabhicāra samvedī sa vicārya pravarttate saṃsthānam ātrantā vat prāpyate paratra sandehaḥ viparyayaḥ vā tatas anumānam saṃsthāne saṃśayaḥ paratra iti pratyaya dvayam etat pramāṇam apramāṇam ca anena maṇi prabhāyām maṇi jñānam vyākhyātam tathā ca vakṣyāmaḥ

atha kena dvayam etat iti pratīyate etat api vakṣyāmaḥ śabda viṣayantu jñānam abhiprāya nivedanāt pramāṇam abhipreta artha kriyā svarūpa nivedanam eva samvādanam jñeya sva rūpa saṃsiddhiḥ eva tatra kriyā matā citre api dṛṣṭi mātreṇa phalam parisamāptimat na khalu svarūpa samvedanāt aparam atra artha kriyā jñānam kvacid upalabhyate rūpa ādayaḥ hi sva svarūpa samvedana parāḥ eva na tad viṣayaḥ pratyayaḥ paratra pramāṇam tad svarūpaḥ samvedana mātra kañca sarvatra jñāne samānam iti na sāṃvyavahārika pramāṇa avatāraḥ tatas bhāvi artha viṣayam viṣaya antara gocaram pramāṇam adhyāropeṇa vyavahāra avabodha kṛt

bhāvi artha viṣaya antara prāpti arthāḥ hi pramāṇa apramāṇa anveṣaṇā aparaḥ yathā ca bhinnaḥ viṣaya sparśa ādikaḥ na rūpa ādi svarūpa grahaṇe antar yāti tathā bhāvi svarūpam api parama arthaṃtaḥ adhyāropeṇa tu tad ekatā viṣaya antarasya api tatas tad dvāreṇa samvādanam uktam jñāne yatra tu tat eva artha kriyā tatra avivādaḥ eva tatra bhāvi svarūpe tad kāraṇa tvena eka tāropaḥ paratra tu sparśa ādau tat ekasāma grī adhīna tvena iti na viśeṣaḥ yatra tu abhimata artha kriyā yathā jalagrāhi vijñānāt marīcikā artha kriyā avāptiḥ tad apramāṇam eva atas eva āha śābde api abhiprāya nivedanāt anyatra api citra ādau tathā ca ghaṭa jñāne paṭa prāptau śuktikāyāñca rajata jñāna paramparāyām api na pramāṇa tā a bhiprāyāvi samvāda abhāvāt

abhiprāya avi samvādāt pramāṇam sarvam ucyate na sajāti vijātīya vijñāna utpatti mātrataḥ bādhaka pratyasya api sthiteḥ evaṃprakāra tā tattvataḥ tu vijātīya vijñāna utpatti mātrakam vijātīya vid utpattiḥ yādi bādhakam ucyate ghaṭa jñāne paṭa jñānam bādhakam kin na yuktimat na iti pratyaya buddhyā ced bādhakam kiṃcid iṣyate saḥ eva pratyayonā iti pramāṇāda bhedaḥ āgataḥ abhāva lakṣaṇam mānam tatas ced tat nirūpyate kim anya rūpa samvittiḥ kim abhāvasya tasya vid anya rūpasya vittiḥ ced aviśeṣāt prasajyate tad abhāvasya vittau syāt tasya iti na samanvayaḥ

abhāvaḥ hi svarūpeṇa pratīyate svarūpañcā bhāvasya na ghaṭa ādi sambandhi tayā pratīyate pratīyamāne hi ghaṭe na tad sambandhitā a bhāvasya tadā abhāva abhāvāt na hi jīvate eva devadattasya maraṇam apratīyamāne na tu ghaṭena sambindhitā a bhāvasya na śakyā grahītum atha kārya kāraṇa bhāva vat pratītiḥ kāraṇe sati paścāt kāryam bhavati tad anantaram tasya upalabdhi krameṇa svarūpa pratipattau kārya kāraṇa sambandha parigrahaḥ evam bhāve satyabhāvaḥ abhāve ca sati bhāvaḥ iti bhavati sambandha pratipattiḥ tat api asat yatas atyanta abhāva sambandhaḥ kasyacid na prasidhyati na bhāve satyabhāvaḥ asau na ca tatra viparyayaḥ kiñca

kārya kāraṇayoḥ rūpam vinā tena pratīyate abhāvaḥ tu vinā bhāvam bhavataḥ na pratīyate deśasya śūnyatā yā tu tasyāḥ sarvatra tulya tā prāc abhāva ādi bhedasya tatra atyantam asambhavaḥ yathā ca vastunaḥ bhedaḥ pratyakṣeṇa pratīyate prāc abhāva ādi bhedaḥ api pratīyate tathā a kṣataḥ abhāveṇa pramāṇena pratītiḥ tasya ced matā kasya abhāvaḥ pramāṇasya pramāṇa abhāvādhivedane kinna bhāvasya sarvasya kin na suptasya sarvathā abhāva grāhikāḥ vittiḥ abhāvaḥ yadi sammataḥ bhāva vittim vinā evāsau kasyacid kinna lakṣyate eṣā eva tatra sāmagrī yadi na abhāva niścayaḥ vastutas vyatiriktasya na abhau asya asti vedanam idat na asti iti vijñānam vetti tad vyatirekitā kutas utpadyatām etat na indriyāt

smaraṇamvinā indriya smṛti saṃyogāt abhāva jñāna sambhave prāptam pratyakṣam eva idam akṣa bhāva anusārataḥ anyatra vṛttam akṣañcet na anya vijñāna kāraṇam mānasam na astita ajñānam katham asya pramāṇa tā pramāṇam avisamvādāt aparam mānam eva tat vyatirikte hi na abhāve visamvāda usti kasya cit kevala tve visamvādaḥ tad pratyakṣeṇa gṛhyate vinā bhāva matim tat ca kevala grahaṇam sadā parān anupraveśena pratītiḥ kevala grahaḥ kevala grahaṇa idhyakṣe visamvādasya sambhavaḥ tatas pratyakṣam eva idam anyathā anupalambhanam nanu kevala samvittiṃrabhāva avittitaḥ kutas sā api kevala samvittim vinā na iti samāna tā yathā vā kevalaḥ abhāvaḥ vinā bhāvena mīyate tathā bhāvaḥ api naivañced anavasthā pra sajyate

abhāva pratītim vinā na kevala pratītirita ced kevala pratītimvinā na abhāva pratītiḥ iti samānam abhāvaḥ vā kevalaḥ katham abhāva antaramvinā tatra api abhāva kalpane anavasthā saḥ eva smaryamāṇa padārtha apekṣaḥ anupalambhaḥ abhāva sādhanaḥ pratyakṣaḥ pratyayaḥ abhāva vyahāraḥ tu vāsanā anurodhāt kvacid eva bhavati na anyatra iti vibhāgaḥ

tasmāt yathā jāgrat pratyayaḥ svapna pratyasya bādhakaḥ tathā viparyayaḥ api kevala grahaṇāt iti nyāyaḥ eṣaḥ tasmāt śābde api abhiprāya nivedanāt prāmāṇyam iti nirākṛtam etat śrotra dhīḥ ca apramāṇam syāt itara an abhisaṅgateḥ nanu pramāṇa bhūtena bhagavatā kaḥ arthaḥ vyāvahārika pramāṇāt eva sarva puruṣa artha siddheḥ na etat asti svarūpa grahaṇe dhyakṣam anumāni atra pra varttate vakṣyatedaḥ punar pāścāt aparasya apramāṇa tā

na tāvat pratyakṣam para loka ādau pravarttate tasya sva rūpa mātra grahaṇāt iti pratipādayiṣyate anumānantu sambandha grahaṇam antareṇa na asti na ca sambandhaḥ vyāpya sarva vidā grahītum śakyaḥ sva rūpa samvedana niṣṭhena hi pratyakṣa ātmanā na sambandha grahaṇam anumānena eva sambandha grahaṇe itaretara āśrayaṇa doṣaḥ saṃvyavahāra mātreṇa tu pratyakṣa anumāne pramāṇam sarvajña sādhana anuguṇa tvena eva na anyathā iti paścāt etat pratipādayiṣyate

nanu yadi nāma pramāṇam para loka ādau pratyakṣa anumāna lakṣaṇam na pravarttate tasya svarūpa viṣaya tvāt anmānasya ca sambandha grahaṇa sāpekṣa tvāt śāstrantu na evam iti tatas eva samīhita saddhiḥ kimbhagavān pramāṇa bhūtaḥ prasādhyate atra ucyate vaktṛ vyāpāra viṣayaḥ yaḥ arthau buddhau prakāśate prāmāṇī antatra śabdasya na artha tattva nibandhanam

śabdasya hi na apauruṣeya tā iti paścāt pratipādayiṣyate pauruṣeya tā tu syāt tatra ca vaktuḥ vyāpāraḥ vivakṣā vaktā vivakṣitā vivakṣāyāḥ viṣayaḥ yorthaḥ śrotṛ buddhau prakaśate pramāṇi antatra eva śabdasya tatra eva ca vyāpāraḥ śabdasya anyathā anyathā vivakṣitam anyathā pratipādayati iti aprekṣā pūrva kārī syāt tathā ca sutarām eva aprāmāṇyam sa ca vivakṣitā na sarvaḥ sarva vedī anyathā paraspara viruddha tā śāstrāṇām na syāt na ca paraspara viruddha ūrthonuṣṭhātum śakyaḥ yathā anuṣṭhāna mātra artha siddhau vyartha tayā pramāṇa malam śāstrasya sva manīṣika anuṣṭhāne api phala siddhi prasaṅgāt tathā ca nirvivādam syāt yatheṣṭam saṃpravarttatām na hi kiciṃdanuṣṭhānam niṣphalam kasyacid kvacid

tasmāt vaktṛ vyāpāra viṣaye śabdasya prāmāṇyam na artha tattva nibandhanam yadi vaktā na sarvajñaḥ apauruṣeye api yorthaḥ buddhau prakāśate yadā svayam eva artham pratipadyate yadā tu vyākhyātuḥ tadā vaktṛ vyāpāra viṣayaḥ vyākhyātā eva vaktā yaḥ ca buddhau arthaḥ pratibhāti na saḥ eva arthaḥ anyathā sakala samīhita artha siddheḥ nna kaścid anuṣṭhāna arthī bhavet anuṣṭheya tayā eva tasya arthasya pratipādanāt na evam iti ced sa tarhi tadā svarūpeṇa na asti iti na tasya pratipattiḥ anya pratipattau sambandha abhāvāt sandehaḥ eva tatas ca yorthaḥ pratīyate sa siddhaḥ eva na tad arthī pravarttate yad arthī ca na sa pratipannaḥ iti na artha tattva nibandhanam prāmāṇyam

nanu niyogaḥ na vākya arthaḥ niyukta ūham iti pratīteḥ tatas niyogāt eva na asitum samarthaḥ koyat niyogaḥ nāma niśabdaḥ niḥśeṣa arthaḥ yoga arthaḥ yuktiḥ niravaśeṣaḥ yogaḥ niyogaḥ niravaśeṣa tvam ayogasya manāk api abhāvāt avaśya karttavya tā hi niyogaḥ niyoga prāmāṇikāḥ hi niyoga pratipatti mātrataḥ pravarttante

atra āha vaktṛ vyāpāraḥ ityādi ayam arthaḥ niyogaḥ bhāvanā dhātoḥ arthaḥ vidhiḥ iti īritāḥ yantra ārūḍha ādayaḥ na syuḥ svabhāvāt artha sādhanāḥ tasmāt yaḥ yasya pratibhāsate yathāpratibham sa vākyasya arthaḥ na ca idam artha tattvam yaḥ ca yathā vyācaṣṭe tathā sa śabdaḥ viguṇaḥ na bhavati na ca tathā artha tattva sthitiḥ

kiñca niyuktena nivṛttiḥ ced sarvasya atas prasajyate tad svabhāva tayā ākāśam anākāśam na kasyacid svabhāvaḥ api viparyāsāt anyathā yadi gamyate viparyyāsa aviparyāsa vyavasthā kaḥ kariṣyati yadi viparyāsāt niyoga parāt api vacanāt na pravarttate tathā sati viparyyāsa kalpanā pravarttamāne api na vyāhanyate yathā eva hi dveṣāt ayam na pravarttate viparyastaḥ tathā tad pakṣa pātāt aparaḥ api pravarttate iti samānam etat

na ca niyukta ūham iti etat pravarttate niṣphala niyoge pravṛtteḥ abhāvāt pracaṇḍa prabhu niyoge niṣphale api apāya bhayāt pravarttate pramāṇa antarāt ca pratipannaḥ apāyaḥ atra tu na pramāṇa antaram vyarthakaḥ niyogaḥ tathā ced bhavatu kaḥ doṣaḥ na hi dṛṣṭe anupapannam nāma prekṣā pūrva kārī niṣphala niyoge hi prekṣāvattā na syāt iti upālabhyate apauruṣeye tu

kasya upālambhaḥ apauruṣeye vyarthateya eva na yuktā iti ced na atra kiñcid pramāṇam anyatra apauruṣeye tathā adṛṣṭeḥ yadi ca niyoga mātrāt pravarttate apauruṣeyāt svarga kāmaḥ iti niṣphalam juhyāt iti niyoga mātrāt eva niyoga pratipatteḥ atha phala abhilāṣiṇaḥ phala upadarśanam phalam eva tarhi tasya upadarśanīyam kinniyogena svayam eva phala abhilāṣāt pravartiṣyate

apauruṣeya tvāt asambaddha tāyām api na ca udyam etat iti ced niṣphala codanāyām api na ca udyam iti vyarthakaḥ vedaḥ na ayuktaḥ : kiñca niyujyamāna viṣaya niyoktṛṇām yadi iṣyate dharmme niyogaḥ sarvatra na śabda arthaḥ avatiṣṭhate niyogaḥ nāma ayam hi kasya dharmaḥ iti cintyatām na khalu niyogaḥ paṭa ādi padārtha vat aparatantra tayā pratīyate tatra anena niyame niyojya ādīnām anyatamasya dharmmeṇa bhavitavyam apara prakāra asam vedanāt niyojya dharmi bhāvaḥ hi tasya anuṣṭheya tā kutas siddhaḥ api yadi anuṣṭheyaḥ na anuṣṭhā viratiḥ bhavet

na khalu pariniṣpannam anuṣṭhātum śakyam anuṣṭhānam hi tatra kriyā viśeṣaḥ sva rūpa jananamvā kriyā viśeṣaḥ tāvat anarthakaḥ eva pariniṣpannasya kriyā kimartha kāriṇī svarūpa niṣpādanantu pariniṣpannasya iti vyāhatam na ca pariniṣpannasya aparama pariniṣpannam āste apariniṣpannasya pariniṣpanna padārtha svabhāva tva ayogāt yaḥ hi yat rūpatayā upalabhyate sa tad svabhāvaḥ na ca aniṣpannam upalabdhum śakyam paścāt upalabhyate iti ced tat ayuktam yatas

tad svabhāvatayā paścāt upalabdhum na śakyate vartamāna svarūpasya grahaṇa idhī akṣa vṛttitaḥ na khalu varttamāna rūpa upagraha pravṛttam adhyakṣam pūrva apara rūpam īkṣitum kṣamate tasmāt na pūrvam eka tāvṛttiḥ na paścāt akṣa janmanaḥ jñānasya akṣa anusaraṇāt adhyakṣam iti mīyate tasmāt niyojya puruṣa dharme niyoge na śabda artha tā viṣaya dharma tāyām api viṣayasya apariniṣpatteḥ svarūpa abhāvāt katham śabdāt asau pratyetum śakyaḥ na hi avidyamānam śaśa viṣāṇa ādikam tathā dṛśyate anuṣṭhāna viṣaya tvena kenacid rūpeṇa vidyamānam kenacid rūpeṇa na iti ced tat asat

yena asau vidyate bhāvaḥ tena anuṣṭhīyate na saḥ vidyate yena na eva asau na tena api pratīyate pratīyamāna tā tasya siddha anuṣṭheya tā na ced tat eva tasya svam rūpam na niyogaḥ anyathā bhavet pratīyam āna tā mātram sāmānyam sarva vastunaḥ anuṣṭheya tayā eva asya niyoga tvam ananyathā yadi anuṣṭheya tā tatra pratibhāti na ca aparā anuṣṭhānam bhavet tatra na tu sāmānya vedane sāmānya vedane tatra na anuṣṭheya artha vedanam vākyasya na bhavet arthaḥ niyogaḥ tad pravādinām

nanu yāga ādi viṣaye niyukta ūham iti pratīyate iyam eva ca niyogasya pratītiḥ śābdāt yā niyukta ūham atra anena iti pratītiḥ tatra niyoktā śabde puruṣaḥ vede pramāṇa abhāvāt niyojyaḥ puruṣaḥ yāgaḥ viṣayaḥ sakalam idam pratīyate tatra pratītiḥ bhāvaḥ eva katham pratīyate iti koyam paryyanuyogaḥ tat asat

pratīyamānena vinā kasya tatra svarūpa vid vedyate yat svarūpeṇa tasya tad vedanam matam na ca svarūpasya abhāve svarūpasya asti vedanam upalambhaḥ yatas sattā sā asti na asti nu sā katham na ca pratīti mātreṇa vastu asti iti pratīyate paraspara viruddha arthāḥ na āgameṣu bhavet asau vedāt eva pratītiḥ ced hetu doṣa āmalīmasāt na lokān anusāreṇa vedāt buddheḥ asambhavāt yāga ādeḥ upalabdha tvāt loke śabda artha sambhavāt pṛrva dṛṣṭa anusāreṇa pratītiḥ na artha sādhikā kāma śoka bhaya unmāda doṣa upapluta cetasām buddhiḥ pūrva anusāreṇa na dṛṣṭā iṣṭasya sādhikā loke ca dṛśyate vākya padārtha upaplavaḥ kvacid vede tad anusāreṇa upaplavaḥ kim asambhavī na tatra āśaya doṣa usti kasyacid mūḍha tā ādikaḥ tatra api apratipattiḥ kinna doṣaḥ kasyacid mataḥ loka īkṣa āśaya doṣeṇa vastu sambandha hānitaḥ na pramāṇa tvam eṣā ca na na vede api kim pramā loke vākya padārthānām viplavasya upalabdhitaḥ vede te eva ced śabdāḥ kin na viplava sambhavaḥ

nanu yadi vedaḥ sattya arthaḥ na bhavati svatas tadā loke yāga ādi padārthasya svayam apravṛtteḥ katham yāga ādi kriyā vṛtti anupalambhaḥ na hi svayam vyutpādayitum idam śakyam tatas avisamvāda bhāgi artha pratipādanāt pramāṇam vedaḥ etat sarva āgameṣu samānam na hi pratiniyata āgama artha a āntara vibhāgāḥ sarva āgameṣu api samupalabdhāḥ svayam utprepekṣya vidhātum śakyāḥ puruṣa mātreṇa athavā sā kim aśabda liṅgam svayam kathañcid anusmarataḥ na bhavati buddhiḥ yathā tathā kriyā parikalpyate

sarva āgama samāna tvāt yāga ādi artha kriyā ātmanaḥ na sarvaiḥ karaṇantasya tulyam vede pi kinna tat na ced ādṛta tā śiṣṭaiḥ iṃti anyonya samāśrayaḥ veda artha ācaraṇāt śiṣṭāḥ tad ācārāt ca sa pramā kiñca dvijātayaḥ api jāyante āgama antara saṅgitaḥ na bhavati eva ced teṣām na pāpe ramate matiḥ pāpa itara vyavasthā iyam āyātāḥ mānataḥ kutas pāpa ātma tā a dvija tvena pāpa tvāt advija ātma tā kiṃca dvijātitāḥ nāma jāti gotra kriyā āditaḥ śakyā jñātum vivekāt na dvijānām śiṣṭa tā kutas

na khalu dvija ādi bhāvaḥ pramāṇa gocara cārī sa hi jāti yoga lakṣaṇaḥ gotra lakṣaṇaḥ kriyā sāmarthya atiśaya yogaḥ vā bhavet na tāvat go tva ādi jātim iva tad jātim ākāra viśeṣāt eva kecid avadhārayitum īśate ākṛti saṅkarasya darśanāt śūdra ādi abhimatānām api sā eva ākṛtiḥ upalabhyate na khalu vāhuleya ādi ākṛtayaḥ iva kauṇḍinī ādīnām api vijātīya abhimata vyakti vilakṣaṇāḥ vyaktaye upalabhyante atas eva vyakti saṅkareṇa sandeha viṣaya tvāt upadeśa sahitam pratyakṣam pramāṇam

para upadeśa prāmāṇyam pratyakṣa arthe na yuktimat upadeśaḥ hi lokānām anyathā api pravarttate yadi khalu bāhmaṇa tva ādi jātiḥ pratyakṣeṇa īkṣyate para upadeśasya vyartha tā na hi pratyakṣa arthe para upadeśaḥ garīyān tathā ced na para upadeśataḥ sandehaḥ syāt atas eva pratyakṣam sahāyam apekṣate upadeśam vinā adhyakṣam yadi arthasya prasādhakam tadā upadeśa sattya tvam vidhātum na anyathā kṣamam yadā tu punar pratyakṣam kevalam asamartham upadeśaḥ ca tadā dvayam asamartham puthak sahitam api tādṛśam eva iti na jāti grahaṇe sāmarthyaṃmāsādayet sāmagryāḥ sāmarthyam iti ced na asti etat kārya darśanataḥ sarvā sāmagrīyam pratīyate aṃkurādi vat atra api na kāryam kiñcid īkṣyate

na hi ghaṭa paṭa sāmagrī śāli aṅkare anyatra vā bhavati anvaya vyatirekābhyām hi jala ādīnām eva tattva upalabdheḥ na ca atra tathā kāryam jāti niścaya lakṣaṇam upalabhyate kāñcana ādi upadeśasya hi yadā sattyatā āśaṅkā tadā pratyakṣa darśanāt asau nivarttate na evam jāti upadeśasya asattya tā śaṅkā tadā pratyakṣa darśanāt asau nivartate na evam jāti upadeśasya asattya tā śaṅkāyām pratyakṣāt sattya tā jāti svarūpa grahaṇa ākārāt suvarṇṇa ādau hi rūpa viśeṣa sadbhāvāt evam bhūtam eva suvarṇṇa bhavati iti vyavahārasya parisamāpteḥ dṛṣṭasya na kācid kṣatiḥ atra tu punar evaṃvidham eva brāhmaṇyam iti na pāda prasāraṇa mātram trāṇam pāramārthika para loka vyavahārasya vāñchita tvāt eka vākya tayā hi suvarṇṇam sattyam bhavati na tu brāhmaṇyam kiñca tad śaṅkāyām gotra upadeśa antara ādinirūpaṇam eva kriyate na anyaḥ upāyaḥ

atha adhyayana ādinā kriyā viśeṣaṇam jñāyate na upadeśa mātrāt tat api asat dvijāti tve kriyā sādhyā na kriyātas dvijāti tā saṃskārāḥ api na eva syuḥ jāti niścaya varjitā jāti varjitasya hi na svādhyāya adhyayana saṃskāra ādayaḥ dvijāti tva ādikam ādadhati sarvasya tathā dvija tva prasaṅgāt api ca yadi pratyakṣataḥ jātiḥ na pratīyate kevalāt vacanāt api na eva asyāḥ pratītiḥ aviraudhinī

prathamam hi pravarttamānam adhyakṣam na tāvat dvija tva ādi vivekam upakalpayitum alam tatas param upadeśaḥ apekṣyate yadi pratyakṣataḥ na pratīyāt vacanāt api na eva pratyeṣyati tat api hi vacanam upalambham eva khyāpayati na khalu puruṣa vacana parijñāna pravarttitam niścayam upajanayati puruṣaḥ paryanuyuktaḥ kathambhavatā idam ajñāyi iti gotra saṃskāra ādikam eva parijñāna viṣaya tayā upadiśati na jāti upalambham kathayati sā eva jātiḥ iti ced uktam atra uttaram dvijāti tve kriyā na tu tat eva dvijāti tvam atha gotra lakṣaṇā jātiḥ tathā ca brahmaṇaḥ apattyam brāhmaṇaḥ iti hi vyapadiśanti

brahmaṇaḥ apattyatā mātrāt brāhmaṇyati prasajyate na kaścid abrāhma tanoḥ utpannaḥ kvacid iṣyate antarā jātibhadaḥ ced nirnimittaḥ katham bhavet antarāle kriyā bhedāt gotreṇa arthaḥ na kasyacid atha dvija ādi gotrāṇām anādiḥ bhedaḥ iṣyate jñāyatām sa kathat nāma pramāṇasya apravṛttitaḥ kriyā tad aparijñānāt akriyā eva prasajyate avicchedaḥ ca gotrasya pratyetum śakyate na ca avicchedaḥ na niyataḥ kasyacid gotra bhāvinaḥ sūta māgadha caṇḍālāḥ katham sambhavinonyathā jñāyante eva te tad jñaiḥ iti ced niyamaḥ na hi anādi gotra paddhatyām asyāt na skhalanam striyā iti jñātam katham nāma kāma ārttā hi sadā striyaḥ brāhmaṇa tve sthite pūrvam tad gotra tvasya sambhavaḥ tad āsthiteḥ kathaṅgotram sā iyam andha paramparā atha śakti viśeṣeṇa yoge brāhmaṇyam iṣyate idānīn dṛśyate na eva śakteḥ atiśayaḥ kvacid śrūyate pūrva kālaḥ ced sarvatra iti vṛthā vacaḥ sarva āgama prasiddhānām śakteḥ atiśayaḥ mahān yoginām gīyate pūrva siddhānām avigānataḥ

tasmāt na śakti viśeṣa yogaḥ dvijāti tvam yuktam na ca veda vacaḥ kiñcid dvijāti tva ādi pra sādhakam vyakteḥ sāmānya vacanam anukta samam eva tat na hi vedaḥ devadatta ādīnām brāhmaṇa tvam upadiśati sarvadā avidyamāna tvāt vedasya ca sarvadā bhāvāt arthasya abhāva kāle veda upadeśaḥ katham sārthakaḥ yadā bhaviṣyati tadā tathā eti ced anarthakaḥ katham vedaḥ paścāt arthena saṅgataḥ udāsīna svarūpasya tatra vyāpṛta tā katham na khalu svabhāva abhāvayaḥ rvedasya viśeṣaḥ upalabhyate tad svabhāva tve ca sarvadā katham ayam vibhāgam pratīyāt

tasmāt na idam brāhmaṇa tva ādikam pratyakṣāt upadeśāt ubhayāt vedāda vā pratīyate tat apratīyamānam katham upayogī iti kintena karttavyam tatas saṃvyavahāra mātra prasiddham brāhmaṇyam tatas brāhmaṇāḥ api bedān na artha kriyā krama kṛtaḥ iti katham vyavahāra saṃvādaḥ vedāt kasyacid tu vyavahāraḥ veda viparyyayāt api iti na veda āvedayoḥ viśeṣaḥ tasmāt na aparīkṣitāt vedat niyoga mātrāt eva pravarttanam yuktam tatas apravarttaka tvāt aprāmāṇyam

atha niyoktṛ dharma tā niyogasya tat ayuktam niyoktuḥ siddha rūpa tvāt niyogasya api siddha tā sampādyaḥ na niyogaḥ syāt siddham sampādyatām katham na khalu siddham apara nirapekṣam kathañcid sampādayitum śakyam tathā ced anuparatiḥ eva sampadanāyāḥ iti vyartha tā pramāṇasya atha niyojaka dharma tve api niyojya viṣaya apekṣayā niyogaḥ tathā tvam pratilabhate niyojya rahitaḥ kaśican na niyogaḥ pratīyate tathā niyoga viṣayam vinā na asti niyoga tā tathā hi niyuktaḥ ham anena atra viṣaya ye niyogaḥ iti pratītiḥ yatas niyogaḥ preraṇā rūpaḥ vinā na viṣayam kvacid niyojyaḥ api niyojya tvam ātmanaḥ saḥ avagacchati

sa ca tathābhūtaḥ niyogaḥ sādhyaḥ eva na khalu svāvyāpāra sādhanam vinā niyogaḥ sādhitaḥ iti bhavati evantarhi dhātu artha niyoga bhāvanānām paraspara sambandhaḥ niyogaḥ sa ca pratīti kāle na asti tat katham niyoge vākya arthe nirālambanatā na bhavet na ca niyogaḥ paraspara sa apekṣa dhātu artha ādi vyatirekeṇa aparaḥ upalabhyate sambandhaḥ ca hetu phala bhāvena vyavasthitānām krama bhāvinām na pratibhāsa gocaraḥ svarūpa pratibhāsasya vidyamāna viṣaya tvāt para rūpa pratibhāsasya ca atad pratibhāsa tvāt na khalu anyat anya rūpeṇa pratibhāsate tathā ca nirālambane kānyā apoha viṣayā śrutiḥ tathā hi kuru yāga ādikam iti yāga kartṛka tvam ātmanaḥ pratīti viṣaya prāptam manyamā ca pratīti kāle tat asti na ca

śabdāt prāc apratipannam pratyetum śakyam yena hi prāk yāga ādi kriyā āviṣṭaḥ paraḥ pratipannaḥ saḥ eva ātmanaḥ parasya vā tathā abhāvam avagacchati na anyaḥ pūrva anusāreṇa ca iyam pratītiḥ anya apoha viṣaya tām ātmanaḥ na atikrāmati na ca pratyakṣatas kartṛ tvam api pūrva pratipannam paurvāparyye pratyakṣasya āvṛtteḥ sāṃvyavahārika pratyakṣa apekṣayā tu pratītiḥ iti ucyate sarvathā pūrva pratīti anusaraṇāt ātmanaḥ karttṛ tva pratītiḥ

atha api na karttṛ tvena asau preryate kintu adhikāri tvena eva na hi akurvan karttā bhavati adhikāri tvantu yogyatayā tat api asat yogya tā viṣaye kvāpi vinā na viṣayeṇa sā viṣaya ati akṣatāyāñca pratītā yogyatā katham na khalu yogyatā viṣayam sva vyāpāram ajānānaḥ tad viṣaya viśiṣṭām yogyatām svarūpataḥ avagacchati tatas karttṛ tva vat atra api doṣaḥ eva vicāra gocara atītaḥ vacāra caritaiḥ katham niyogaḥ iṣyate vākyasya arthaḥ ācārya muṣṭitaḥ na khalu vicāryamāṇaḥ niyogaḥ kaścid asti yathā kalpanam ayogāt

śuddha kāryasya kim rūpa niyogaḥ kīrttitaḥ paraiḥ kevalā preraṇā kārya saṅga nātha viparyayaḥ prādhānyāt kārya rūpa tvam niyogasya kim iṣyate kim vā preraka tā tasya prādhānyāt ucyate paraiḥ kāryasya preraṇāyāḥ ca sambandhe kinniyoga tā niyogaḥ samudāya utha yat vā tad ubhayāt paraḥ yantra ārūḍhaḥ tathā abhīṣṭaḥ bhogya rūpaḥ thavā sa kim puruṣaḥ vā niyogaḥ syāt iti pakṣāḥ paraiḥ kṛtāḥ

śuddha kārya niyoga vādinām matam pratyaya arthom niyogaḥ ca yatas śuddhaḥ pratīyate kārya rūpaḥ ca tena atra śuddham kāryam asau mataḥ viśeṣaṇantu yat tasya kiṃcid anyat pratīyate pratyaya arthaḥ na tat yuktam dhātvarthaḥ svargga kāma vat prerakatvantu yat tasya viśeṣaṇam iha iṣyate tasya apratyaya vācya tvāt śabde kārya niyoga tā

śuddha preraṇā niyoga vādaḥ preraṇā eva niyogetra śuddhā sarvatra gamyate na apreritaḥ yatas kaścid niyuktam svam prabudhyate preraṇā saṅgata kārya niyoga pakṣaḥ mama idam kāryam iti evam jñātam pūrvam yadā bhavet sva siddhau prerakantat syāt anyathā tat na sidhyati kārya saṅgata preraṇā vādinaḥ prāhuḥ

preryate puruṣaḥ na eva kāryeṇa iha vinā kvacid tatas ca preraṇā proktā niyogaḥ kārya saṅga tā kāryasya eva upacārataḥ pravartaka tva vādinaḥ prāhuḥ preraṇā viṣayaḥ kāryam na tu tat prerakam svatas vyāpāraḥ tu pramāṇasya prameyaḥ upacaryate sambandhaḥ eva ubhayoḥ niyogaḥ iti apare

preraṇā hi vinā kārya prerikā na eva kasyacid kāryam vā preraṇāḥ yogaḥ niyogaḥ tena sammataḥ samudāya vāde api ayam abhiprāyaḥ paraspara avinābhūtam dvayam etat pratīyate niyogaḥ samudāyaḥ asmāt kārya preraṇayoḥ yatas apare punar āhuḥ ubhaya svabhāva nirmuktaḥ vākya arthaḥ siddham ekam yatas brahma gatam āmnāyataḥ sadā siddha tvena na tat kāryam prerakam kutas eva tat yantra ārūḍha niyoga vādinām matam kāmī yatra eva yaḥ kaścid niyoge sati tatra sa viṣaya ārūḍham ātmānam manyamānaḥ pravartate bhogya rūpa niyoga vādinām pravādaḥ

mama idam bhogyam iti evam bhogya rūpam pratīyate mamatvena ca vijñānam bhoktari eva vyavasthitam svāmi tvena abhimānaḥ hi bhoktari atra bhavet ayam bhogyantadeva vijñeyam tat eva svam nirūpyate sādhya rūpa tayā yena mama idam iti gamyate tad prasādhyena rūpeṇa bhogyam svam vyapadiśyate siddha rūpam hi yat bhogyam na niyogaḥ sa tāvatā sādhya tvena iha bhogyasya preraka tvāt niyoga tā

puruṣa niyoga vādiniḥ mama idam kāryam iti evam manyate puruṣaḥ sadā puṃsaḥ kārya viśiṣṭa tvam niyogosya ca vācya tā kāryaṃsya siddhau jātāyām tad yuktaḥpuruṣaḥ tadā bhavet sādhitaḥ iti evam pumān vākya arthaḥ ucyate sarvatra ca vākya arthe aṣṭa prakāraḥ bhedaḥ pramāṇam kinniyogaḥ syāt prameyam athavā punar ubhayena vihīnaḥ vā dvaya rūpothavā punar śabda vyāpāra rūpaḥ vā vyāpāraḥ puruṣasya vā dvaya vyāpāra rūpaḥ vā dvaya avyāpāraḥ eva vā atra ucyate sarvam etat asaṅgatam yatas

preraṇā rahitam kāryam niyojyena vivarjitam niyogaḥ na eva kasya api niyogaḥ iti kīrtyate vṛttiḥ niyoga śabdasya śuddhe kārye yadā matā saṃjñā mātrāt niyoga tvam bhavat kena nivāryate yaktaḥ tu puruṣaḥ kārye tatra na eva pratīyate niyogaḥ sa kathat nāma siddha atīta ādi bodha vat niyojakasya dharmmoyam niyogaḥ loka sammataḥ tat eva kāryam iti ced siddhatvāt na asya sādhya tā sādhya tvena niyogoyam iti ceda vyapadiśyate viṣaye tasya tattvena upacārāt prakīrttanam asiddhasya ca tasyāḥ tu katham preraka rūpa tā sādhya tvena avabodhosya preraka tvam yadi iṣyate aprasiddhasya sādhya tvam bodhaḥ siddha ātmakasya ca paraspara virūddha tvam ekasya katham iṣyate sādhya rūpatayā atasya pratītiḥ prerikā yadi niyoga tvam pratīteḥ syāt na niyogasya tattvataḥ

tathā niyogaḥ yadi vākya arthaḥ pramāṇam kim bhaviṣyati māna rūpaḥ niyogaḥ ced prameyam kim punar bhavete niyogaḥ puruṣasya iṣṭaḥ vyāpāraḥ tattvataḥ yadi vyāpāraḥ puruṣasya asau bhāvanā eva anyavā icakā vākya vyāpāra pakṣe tu bhavet sā śabda bhāvana śabda ātma bhāvanām āhuḥ anyām eva liṅa ādayaḥ śabdāt eva tu asau jātāḥ puruṣaḥ kim pravartate śabdena prerita ūnaḥ ced sva vyāpāre pravarttate śabdena ācodita tve asya katham astu pravarttanam śabdena codane tasya nirālamba natāḥ dhiyaḥ

evam yantra āruḍha ādayaḥ api vākya arthāḥ vācya doṣāḥ yatas yantra ārūḍha tayā bhogya bhoktroḥ sambandhaḥ ucyate na sambandhaḥ asti bhogyatma ārūḍhaḥ ca na naraḥ tadā pratīti kāle sarvasya sādhya tvena asvarūpa tā tat eva tasya rūpañced na sādhya tvasya hānitaḥ evam niyogaḥ pratyākhyātaḥ

bhāvanā idānīm vicāryate bhāvanā hi dvidhā śabda bhāvanā artha bhāvanā ca yat āha śabda ātma bhāvanā māhuḥ anyām eva liṅa ādayaḥ iti antu anyā eva sarva arthā sarva ākhyā teṣu vidyate śabda bhāvanā śabda vyāpāraḥ śabdena hi puruṣa vyāpāraḥ bhāvyate puruṣa vyāpāreṇa dhātu arthaḥ dhātu arthena ca phalam

idam ca ayuktam śabda vyāpāraḥ hi na śabda vācyaḥ tam prati kārakaḥ śabdaḥ na vācakaḥ apratipādakaḥ tathā hi śabdāt uccaritāt ātmā niyuktaḥ gamyate naraiḥ bhāvanātaḥ paraḥ kaḥ vā niyogaḥ parikalpyatām śabda bhāvanā eva khalu niyogaḥ iti śabda antareṇa ucyate tat asat yadi śabda vyāpāraḥ katham agṛhīta saṅketaḥ na avagacchati svabhāvataḥ hi niyojaka tve na śa sam ṅketa grahaṇam upayogi sā eva sāmagrī ced nanu sāmagrī yadi preraṇe bhāvanāyām vā vyāpriyate a yuktam etat yāvatā

śasam ṅketagraha sāmagrī vyāpṛtāḥ a rthasya vedane artha pratītau puruṣaḥ svayam eva pravarttate idam kuru iti preraṇa adhyeṣaṇayoḥ eva pratītiḥ tad apratipattau na niyukta tva pratipattiḥ niyukta tvañca nāma kārye vyāpārita tvam kārya vyāpṛtām avasthām pratipadya niyojakaḥ niryukte sā ca tasya bhāvinī avasthā na svarūpeṇa sākṣātkartum śakyā svarūpa sākṣāt karaṇe hi sarvam tadā eva siddham iti na niyogaḥ syāt saphalaḥ yathā prayojakaḥ tatra bādhyamāna pratītikaḥ prayaujyaḥ api tathā eva syāt śabdaḥ buddhi artha vācakaḥ

yathā eva hi prayojakasya prayojyena sva vyāpāra śūnyam ātmānam pratiyatā prayojaka pratītiḥ bādhyamānā nirālambanā tathā prayojya pratītiḥ api tena eva sva vyāpāra āviṣṭam ātmānapratiyatā bādhyate śabdāt tasya sā pratītiḥ iti ced na asti etat saḥ api śabdaḥ buddhi artham eva khyāpayati evam mayā pratipāditam evam mayā pratipannam iti dvayoḥ api adhyavasāyāt athavā evam tāvat pratipannam mayā asya tu abhiprāyaḥ bhavatu mā vā bhūt tathā bhavatu evam arthaḥ mā vā bhūt mayā tāvat evam pratipannam atas eva āha

vaktṛ vyāpāra viṣayaḥ yarthaḥ buddhau prakāśate prāmāṇī antatra śabdasya na artha tattva nibandhanam vaktṛ vyāpāra viṣayaḥ iti yatra vaktā asti buddhau prakāśate iti yatra sa na asti athavā tad ukteḥ eva tatra vaktā asti iti gamyatām yat jātīyaḥ yatas iti nyāyāt athavā tad aviśeṣāt sarvam eva apauruṣeyam puruṣa kṛteḥ vādhanāt na evam ced atra api atīndriya tvāt puruṣa kṛteḥ sā na bādhikā iti kutas etat

athavā apauruṣeyam eva tat vacanam puruṣasya tu mayā kṛtam etat iti bhrāntiḥ tathā hi atyanta naṣṭaḥ yaḥ granthaḥ pratibhāti eva kasyacid mayā kṛtaḥ iti prāpta abhimānasya kṣata smṛteḥ kavayaḥ api janma antara anubhūtam eva grantham kavi tvena utprekṣyante iti kutas etat tathā ca sarvam apauruṣeyam vyarthaka tvam api tathā bhavati iti vyartham apauruṣeya tvam tatra

samāna tatra vede api tatra api vyarthatā iṣyate anya artha kalpanāyān ca samānam ubhayam bhavet veda āvedayoḥ vyarthatā apauruṣeya tā kalpanā ca samānā eva anya artha kalpanāyām na vyarthatā iti ced sattya artha kalpanā tatra pauruṣeyī eva kalpyatām asatya artha avabhāsaḥ tu prathamaḥ yaḥ sa vedatas atas āha vaktṛ vyāpāra viṣayaḥ ityādi veda artham prāthamikam parityajya yorthaḥ buddhi vyāpāra viṣayaḥ tatra prāmāṇyam puruṣa buddheḥ eva na artha tattva nibandhanam na śabdasya iti vyasta pada sambandhaḥ

tathā hi tam parityajya veda artham prathamam naraḥ pramāṇa śuddham anya artham kalpayet tad matiḥ pramā saḥ api veda arthaḥ eva iti na pramāṇam iha asti vaḥ veda ādhipatyataḥ jāteḥ iti ced prathamaḥ na kim tasya api ca tad artha tve vyarthaḥ vedaḥ kathat na saḥ tathā ca sati sandehe apauruṣeye na mānatā

veda irtha tattvasya prāthamikasya abhāvāt citrayā yajeta paśu kāmaḥ iti vyarthaka tvāt karma vaiguṇya vat tatra iti ced na pramāṇa abhāvāt anya artha kalpanā tu puruṣa prayatnāt bhavantī puruṣa kṛtā eva tathā ca uktam sā kim aśabda liṅgā svayam kathañcid anusmarataḥ na bhavati sarve eva ca vedāt ātmānam niyuktam manyate pūrva anusāreṇa niyogaḥ ca śabda bhāvanā rūpaḥ yadi sa vākya arthaḥ tathā sati devadattaḥ pacet iti karttuḥ anabhidhānāt karttṛ karaṇayoḥ tṛtīye ti tṛtīyā prāpnoti kartṛ abhidhāne tu anabhihita adhikārāt tiṅgā eva ukta tvāt na bhavati kiṃca pacati iti karttā api pratīyate vyāpāra sāmarthyāt karttṛḥ ākṣepāt evam pratītiḥ iti ced na

krama pratītiḥ evam syāt prathamam bhāvanā gatiḥ tad sāmarthyāt punar tasmāt yatas karttā pratīyate na ca krama pratītiḥ upalabhyate dvi vacana bahuvacane ca na prāpnutaḥ eka tvāt vyāpārasya atha kāraka bhedāt vyāpara bhedaḥ bhaviṣyati iti ced kriyate kaṭaḥ devadatta yajñadattābhyām iti mahat asamaṃja satvam syāt tathā hi

eka tvāt karmmaṇaḥ prāptam kriyā eka tvam tathā bhidaḥ karttuḥ bhedaḥ iti itthañca kiṅkarttavyam vicakṣaṇaiḥ nanu dhātu arthasya abhedāt eka vacanam devadatta yajñadattābhyām āsyate sa ca dhātu arthaḥ na niyogaḥ niyogasya pratyaya artha tvāt sa ca dhātu artha atiriktaḥ karttṛ sādhyaḥ tasya karttṛ bhedāt bhedaḥ iti tatas kaṭam kurutaḥ iti bhavati dhātvarthaḥ tu śuddhaḥ na kāraka bhedāt bhedī tat asat

sambandhāt yadi tad bhedaḥ dhātu arthasya api asau bhavet saḥ api nirvarttya evatiḥ tad bhedena eva bhidyatām asmākantu vivakṣā paratantra tvāt bheda abheda vyavasthiteḥ lābhidhānāt kārakasya sarvam etat samañjasam kriyāḥ hi karttuḥ karmaṇaḥ ca bhedena vivakṣyate sā yadi lakāreṇa abhidhīyate na kartrā tadā karttari tṛtīyā bhavati yadā abhidhīyate tadā prathama artha tvāt prathamā bhavati kriyate mahātmanā karoti mahātme ti yadā bheda vivakṣā asya bhāvanā arthasya jñāyate lakāreṇa abhidhānañca tṛtīyā karttṛrīpsyatām yadā bheda vivakṣā asya karttā lena abhidhīyate tena eva ukteḥ tṛtīyā asti na kattuḥ iti gamyatām

yadā tu karttṛ vyā pāraḥ tipā pratipādyate tadā saḥ eva ca bhāvanā tathā ca āha bhāva arthā karmma śabdāḥ bhāvanam bhāvaḥ ṇī antasya pratyayaḥ tathā ca sati bhāvanā eva asau bhāvanā ca karttṛ vyāpāraḥ sa coditaḥ kartrā sva vyāpāre pravarttate niyogasya ca tad śeṣa tvāt apradhāna tvāt avākya artha tvam niyoga viśiṣṭa tvāt ca bhāvanāyāḥ tathā pratipādane niyamena pravarttate kathañca asau sva vyāpāram pratipanne nnotra na pravarttate anyathā sva vyāpāraḥ eva tasya na coditaḥ bhavet tat etada sat

vyāpāraḥ eṣa mama kim avaśyām iti manyate phalam vinā eva naidam ced sāphalye dhik amaḥ kutas yadi avaśyam eṣa mama vyāpāraḥ iti matiḥ tat ayuktam na hi phalam apaśyat mama idam karttavyam iti kaścid pratyeti saphala tve pravarttate saphala tvam na avagamyate iti pratipāditam kiṃca yajate pacati iti atra bhāvanā na pratīyate yaji arthāt atirekeṇa tasyāḥ vākya artha tā kutas pākam karoti yāgañca yadi bhedaḥ pratīyate evam sati anavasthā syāt asamañca satā karī

karoti yāgam sva vyāpāram niṣpādayati yāga niṣpattim nirvarttayati vyapadeśāḥ ete yathā kathaṃcid bheda purassarāḥ na etebhyosti padārtha tattva vyavasthā śilāputrakasya śarīram iti na bheda vyavahārāḥ bhedam antareṇa api dṛśyante yathā dvijasya vyāpāraḥ yāgaḥ iti api gīyate tatas parā punar dṛṣṭā karoti iti na hi kriyā yaji kriyā api dravyasya viśeṣāt aparāḥ na hi sāmānādhikaraṇyena devadatta tayā gatiḥ

nanu ca kim karoti devadattaḥ pacati yajati iti praśna uttara darśanāt karoti iti niścite sati yaji ādiṣu sandehāt anyat tvam prasiddham eva tathā ca āha na ca śarīram eva buddhiḥ tad siddhau api buddhi vikalpe saṃśayāt tat etat ayuktam karoti arthayajati arthau vibhinnau yadi tattvataḥ anyat saṃdigdham anyasya kathane durghaṭaḥ kramaḥ

yadi hi karoti kriyāḥ anyāḥ yajyādikāyāḥ tadā karoti iti niścite katham anyatra saṃdehe praśnaḥ aniścitaḥ eva praśnasya yukta tvāt sāmānya rūpotha karoti arthaḥ viśeṣa rūpaḥ yajyādiḥ iti ced sāmānyena viśeṣeṇa vinā kiṃcid pratīyate sāmānya ākṣipyamāṇasya nahi nāma apratīta tā kevala sāmānya pratītau hi viśeṣa aṃśe saṃdehaḥ iti uktam

atha sāmānyena viśeṣaḥ ākṣipyate tathā sati saḥ api pratītaḥ eva katham saṃśayaḥ na hi pratīta tvāt aparaḥ ākṣepaḥ atha pratītaḥ eva asau tathā api pratīta tā viśeṣa rūpeṇa na asti sāmānyena ākṣepāt nanu tat eva sāmānyam ākṣepakam tat eva akṣe apyam iti katham etat na ca sāmānyāt aparam sāmānyatā ākṣepyam tathā sati tatas api aparam tatas api aparam iti anavasthā nanu sāmānya pratyakṣāt viśeṣa apratyakṣāt viśeṣa smṛteḥ ca saṃśayaḥ yuktaḥ eva na anupalambhāt abhāvaḥ eva yuktaḥ sāmānyena anupalambha pramāṇa vādinaḥ anyathā upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāpta anupalambhāt abhāvaḥ na anupalabbhimātrāt tathā api anupalabdheḥ eva saṃśayaḥ vyartham etat sāmānya pratyakṣāt iti

yadi sāmānya pratyakṣa tāyām api upalabbhilakṣaṇa prāpta anupalabdhiḥ na sāmānya saṃśayaḥ ātma upalambha lakṣaṇa prāpta anupalabdhiḥ eva na sambhavati sāmānya pratyakṣa tāyām evantarhi sā eva anupalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptasya anupalabdhiḥ saṃśaya hetuḥ iti prāptam viśeṣasmṛtiḥ iti ca vyartham na hi viśeṣa smṛti vyatirekeṇa aparaḥ saṃśayaḥ ubhaya aṃśau alam vi smṛti rūpa tvāt asya dṛśyate kānya kubja ādiṣu sāmānya pratyakṣa tām antareṇa api prathamataram eva smaraṇāt saṃśayaḥ tat eva yajya ādikam aniyamena pratīyamānam sāmānyatas dṛṣṭāt anumānāt sāmānyam āha ca atra

atad rūpa parāvṛtta vastumā atra prasādhanāt sāmānya viṣaya proktam liṅgam bhedā pratiṣṭhiteḥ bheda an avadhāraṇa mātram eva sāmānya paricchedaḥ kvacid buddhiḥ eva tad ākāra viviktāḥ bhāva abhāva sādhāraṇa tvāt saṃśaya hetuḥ tathā tathābhūta anupalabdhiḥ eva saṃśaya hetuḥ buddhi rūpāḥ upalabhyamāna padārtha rūpā vā

nanu samāna ākāra anubhava abhāve dṛśyate saṃśayaḥ sthāṇuḥ vā puruṣaḥ vā iti ūrdhva tā sāmānyam upalabhyate yadi asti tadā dvaya ākārā buddhi rupalabhyate na bhedāt bhinnam asti atra sāmānyam buddhi bhedataḥ buddhayā ākārasya bhadena padārthasya vibhinna tā atha upalabhyate eva puruṣa sthāṇu svarūpa parihāreṇa dūra deśam ūrdhva tā mātram anyathā sthāṇu puruṣa ākāra antarggata anubhave na tatra sandehaḥ utpadyeta tasmāt tad parihāreṇa avabhāsanam eva tat vyatirekaḥ etāvat mātra lakṣaṇa tvāt vyatirekasya

tat na yuktam tanmātra vyatirekaḥ ced kinnādu ūreva bhāsanam dūrevabhāsamānasya sannidhāna iti bhāsanam yat khalu dūra deśa niveśi daśāyām avabhāsate tad sannidhāna vidhāna adhīnam sutarām avabhāsa vat padārtha antara tve ca sāmānyasya tat eva pratibhāsane katham anyatra trāspaṣṭa pratibhāsa vyavahāraḥ na khalu nīla padārtha pratibhāsane aspaṣṭa śukla pratibhāsa vyavahāraḥ

nanu bhavat pakṣe api kā iyam aspaṣṭa tā nāma aspaṣṭa pratibhāsatā nāma aspaṣṭa pratibhāsa tā hi kadācid apratibhāsa tā kadācid anya pratibhāsa tā kadācid tu tad pratibhāsata iti tasya eva pratibhāsaḥ ced aspaṣṭa pratibhāsa tā aspaṣṭa tā katham nāma svarūpeṇa avabhāsane anyasya pratibhāsaḥ api tasya eva aspaṣṭa tā kutas apratibhāsam vinā bhāvaḥ katham syāt pratibhāsane buddhiḥ eva tathā bhūtā yadi aspaṣṭa avabhāsitā buddhi svarūpa nirbhāsena arthasya aspaṣṭa bhāsitā

tat etat asat buddhiḥ eva atad ākārā tatas upadyate yadā tadā a spaṣṭa pratībhāsa vyavahāraḥ jagat mataḥ atha tat eva sāmānyan tathā sati varṇṇa saṃsthāna pratibhāsanam na syāt na khalu sāmānyam varṇṇa saṃsthāna vat dravya āśrita tvāt tayoḥ atha dravya gatam varṇṇa saṃsthānam tathā sati tata utpanna sāmānyam anavabhāsanāt varṇṇa saṃsthānayoḥ eva pratibhāsanam tayoḥ ca sādhāraṇa tvāt sthāṇu puruṣayoḥ sandehaḥ iti yuktam

tat api asat yatas sa varṇṇonyena rūpeṇa saṃsthānam katham anyathā tat pratīyate itthañca bhrāntā buddhiḥ pratīyate yadi varṇṇa saṃsthānam anyathā pratibhāti bhrāntiḥ eva sā katham sāmānya pratyakṣa tā atha avayavī tatra pratibhāti na sāmānyam na api varṇṇa saṃsthānam iti ced saṃsthāna varṇṇa rūpābhyām vyatireka avabhāsanam kutas dravyasya kintasmāt aparam pratibhāsate śyāma tā ādi rūpam hi varṇṇa ādikam avabhāsate na ca tatra anyat eva dravyam avabhāsate tad vyatirekeṇa aparasya dravyasya apratibhāsanāt tat eva dravyam iti ced na guṇa tvāt saṃsthāna varṇṇayoḥ

atha varṇṇa saṃsthāna vat dravyam na tad vyatirakeṇa anyathā pratibhāsana abhāvāt na khalu spaṣṭa aspaṣṭa vaṇṇa saṃsthāna vyatirekeṇa aparam dravyam upalabhyate aspaṣṭa varṇa saṃsthānasya ca tad apara sāmagrī prabhava jñānena bādhyamāna tvāt na idam evambhūtam iti spaṣṭa ākāra pratyaya udaye sati bhavati iti tad anupalabdhiḥ eva ca tad viparyaya upalabdhi rūpā bādhakam na idam iti kalpanā pratyayasya anutpatteḥ nna evam iti ced na utpadyate eva saḥ api na idam iti pratyayaḥ tathā hi tat varṇṇaṃmetat saṃsthānam na bhavati iti tad vyatirikta saṃsthāna bādhakam upajñāyate eva jñānam vyatiriktasya na bādhakam iti ced yatas eva avyatirikta saṃsthāna bādhakam atas eva vyatireki saṃsthānam bhaviṣyati

tat asat yādṛśasya pratītiḥ prāk bādhanam tādṛśasya ced anyathā na pratītiḥ ca kim anyat avaśiṣyate yādṛśam saṃsthānam dravyam vā varṇṇa avyatiriktam pratipannam yadi tādṛśasya bādhā kim aparam avaśiṣyate na khalu yoga vibhāgaḥ vidyate yena tatra ekasya bādhanam aparasya na iti vyavasthā vibhāgaḥ

atha api syāt tasya varṇṇasya na prāptiḥ saṃsthāna dravyayoḥ tadā tatas prāpteḥ param dravyantat ca prāk iti vittimat yat ca pūrva uttara bhāvena vedyate yat ca na tathā tayoḥ viruddha dharmma adhyāsa yogaḥ na yuktaḥ prabhedaḥ hi sakalaḥ evam eva sādhanīyaḥ parasya bheda sādhanasya abhāvāt tat asat tat anyat yadi tattvena pratyakṣe kinna bhāsate pūrve pare vā ubhayoḥ dṛśyate sambhavaḥ kadā

yadi tat paramārthataḥ bhinnam varṇṇa saṃsthānam dravyāt saṃsthānam vā varṇṇāt katham pūrvatra paratra vā pratyakṣe na pratibhāti pratyekam apratibhāsane samudāyasya tad vyatiriktasya abhāvāt tatra pratibhāsanam iti mahat moha sāmarthyam na ca dvayoḥ samavadhānam iti kutas samudāyaḥ anusandhānaḥ ca na pratyakṣāt iti tad abhāvāt anumānam api na asti iti kutas vyatireka pratītiḥ

tasmāt na sādhāraṇam nāma kiñcid sarvasya sva ātmani vyavasthita tvāt viśeṣa tā eva tasmāt na kriyā karoti iti sādhāraṇa rūpā yajana ādi kriyāḥ viśeṣāṇām sāmānyam tatas na bhāvanā katta vya apāra rūpā tad vyatirekeṇa avibhāvanāt na ca dhātu arthaḥ pi dravya vyatirekeṇa asti dravyam eva pūrva aparībhūtam anvaya vyatirekeṇa kalpita vyatireki svabhāvam abhede api bheda vat upacarya kriyātas bhinnam kriyā ca tatas bhinnā iti vyavahāra mātram etat na iyam vastu tattva vyavasthitiḥ sva vyāpāra dhātu arthau ca niyoga kāle bhāvinau pratīyete tatas kathantad ālambanā pratītiḥ pūrva vāsanā balāt upajāyamānā na nirālambanā iti uktam

atha api syāt pratyakṣasya hi varttamāna viṣaya tvāt bhāvi bhūta viṣaye na ālambana tvam śabdasya tu tad viṣaya tve api na tattvam tat āha codanā ityādi tat asat adṛśyamānaḥ saḥ api āsti iti etat vyavasitam katham anumāne tu sambandhaḥ iti tatra tathā sthitiḥ sarvā hi parokṣa viṣayā pratītiḥ artha sambandhāt eva avisamvādinī yathā anumāna pratītiḥ na hi yaḥ yena asambaddhaḥ tad bhāve tasya bhāva niyamaḥ nirālambanā tu tad svarūpa abhāvāt eva na hi avidyamānasya svarūpa grahaṇam iti uktam na ca bhāvinā saha sambandha niyamaḥ anumāne tu

kāraṇāt kāryam pratīyate tathā parama darśanāt na ca phala kāraṇa tā agnihotra ādeḥ upalabdhā na api tad akaraṇe pratyavāḥ yaniścayaḥ atha ātmanaḥ sāmarthyam avagacchan yāga karaṇa tām ātmanaḥ pratipadyamānaḥ yāge pravarttiṣyate kāraṇa tvam yadā svarge tasya na pratipadyate yāgasya deśitaḥ api eṣa kasmāt tatra pravarttate

atas eva bhāvanā niyoga dhātu arthānām paraspara sambandhaḥ phala abhisambandhaḥ vā vidhiḥ vākya arthaḥ iti na yuktam sarvasya bhāvi tvena jñānena agrahaṇāt nirālambanatā eva buddheḥ atas dṛśya vikalpya artha ekīkaraṇāt pravarttate saḥ eva ca anya apohaḥ iti na kaścid prekṣā pūrvaka rī vedāt pravarttate iti alam ati prasaṅgena tasmāt vaktṛ vyāpāra viṣayaḥ yaḥ arthaḥ buddhau prakāśate adhyāropitaḥ prāmāṇī antatra śabdasya na artha tattva nibandhanam na khalu adhyāropeṇa sattya artha viṣayeṇa bhavitavyam pratibandham antareṇa iti vyavasthitam etat prathama vārttika alaṅkāre vidhi bhāvanā ādi vārttikam prathamam

yadi tarhi artha kriyā sthitiḥ avi sambādanam atha pratyabhijñā ādi pratyayāt api saḥ eva ayam ityādi jñātvā pravarttamānaḥ avisamvāda bhāj iti pramāṇam syāt tatra apūrva artha vijñānam niścitam bādha varjitam aduṣṭa kāraṇa ārabdham pramāṇam loka sammatam avayavi ādi viṣaya tvam samvādaka tvāt pramāṇam iti atha ālocana ajñāna sāmarthyāt asau vikalpaḥ utpadyamānaḥ na pramāṇam avayavini ca avayava vijñāna sāmarthyāt tathā sati tat api ālocana ajñānam cakṣuḥ sannikarṣa ādi sāmarthyāt iti na syāt pramāṇam tatra yadi kāraṇa paramparā an viṣyate cakṣuḥ ādīnām prasaṅgaḥ atha anantaram vikalpasya eva prāmāṇya prasaṅgaḥ

atra ucyate gṛhīta grahaṇāt na iṣṭam sāṃvṛtam dhī pramāṇa tā pravṛtteḥ tad pradhāna tvāt heya upādeya vastuni saḥ eva ayam iti pratyayaḥ utpadyamānaḥ na ekatve pramāṇam apūrvasya eka tvasya agrahaṇāt dṛṣṭasya eva tasya pratipatteḥ eka tvam hi pūrveṇa saha gṛhyamāṇam eka tām vivāda viṣaya tām svīkaroti varttamāna tā mātrasya eka tve siddha sādhanam eva tat ca pūrvam pūrva pratyena gṛhīta tvāt na aparam pūrva pratyayena ca asau truṭyat avasthaḥ eva apūrva tayā ca gṛhyate tatas punar anusandhīyamānam yathābhūtam

gṛhītam tathā bhatam eva vā anusandhātavyam gṛhīta tvena ca grahaṇe smaraṇam etat iti gṛhīta grāhi tvāda pramāṇam apara smaraṇa vat saṃvādaḥ tu artha kriyā karaṇāt na ca eka tva sādhya artha kriyā vastu sāmarthya mātrāt utpatteḥ tasmāt saḥ eva ayam iti pratyadvayam eva etat atha ekatā pratīyate pūrveṇa saha aparasya tat ayuktam

pūrvam adhyakṣataḥ avittau tena ekatvā isti na pramā eka tvam apratītena pratītam iti sāhasam tena sāṃvṛtam eka tvam pūrva pūrva vikalpataḥ prāmāṇyam pratyayasya asya sāṃvṛtasya na vidyate ghaṭa ādi viṣayaḥ yaḥ api pratyayaḥ sarasa ādike tad pratyayaiḥ gṛhīterthe samudāya vikalpanāt samudāyāt paraḥ tu ekaḥ na eva kenacid īkṣyate anādi vāsanā dārḍhyāt parasya āgraha vaiśasam kathantarhi dhiyaḥ prāmāṇyam yadi pūrva apara ādikasya na ekā pratipattiḥ

atra ucyate heya upādeya viṣaye pravarttakam hi pramāṇam ucyate tatra ca pravarttane dhīḥ eva pradhānam yadi api nāma bhāvi arthaḥ na pratipannaḥ tathā api tatra pravarttanāt pramāṇam yathā anumānasya agrahaṇe api prāmāṇyam na hi anumānena vastu svarūpa svīkāraḥ iti pratipādayiṣyate na ca cakṣuḥ ādikāt pravarttate jñānam antareṇa vikalpam antareṇa api buddhyā abhyāsāt pravarttate tatas heya upādeya viṣaye dhīrā iva pūrvikā pravarttanāt pramāṇam na vikalpa ādayaḥ yatra tu na abhyāsaḥ tatra anumānam eva pratyabhijñāna ādayaḥ atas na ati prasaṅgaḥ eva antāvat phala arthitām vyavahārika tvena pramāṇa tvam pratipāditam

idānīm adhigama phala viṣaya vibhāga kāritayā pratipādyate viṣaya ākāra bhedāt ca dhiyodhi gama bhedataḥ api ca dhiyaḥ eva prāmāṇyam na anyasya yatas viṣaya ākāra bhedāt adhigamasya pramāṇa phalasya bhedaḥ na pravarttanāt pramāṇam api tu pratipatti karaṇāt pratipattau hi jñātāyām pravarttatām vā na vā tathā api artha tathā bhāvavya sthānāt pramāṇam vyavasthāpiterthe yadi na pravarttate na ayam pramāṇasya doṣaḥ prāpaka tvāt pramāṇam iti ced na prāpaṇa yogya tvāt pramāṇasya tat eva prāptau asatyām katham jñāyate rūpa viśeṣa darśanāt avyabhicāriṇaḥ rūpasya katham paricchittiḥ

samāptaḥ tarhi vāhya artha vyavahāraḥ avyabhicāri tvāt jñāne hi svarūpa samvedana mātram eva parisphuṭam tathā ca kutas vāhya artha para santāna ādi pratītiḥ etat ca uttaratra vakṣyamaḥ viṣaya ākāraḥ iva ākāraḥ asya viṣaya ākāram jñānam tasya bhedaḥ viṣaya ākāra bhedaḥ viṣaye vā ākāra bhedaḥ biṣaya ākāra bhedaḥ ākaraṇam ākāraḥ ullekhaḥ iti arthaḥ viṣaya sadṛśa tā viṣaya unmukha tā ca tad bhedāt dhiyaḥ adhigama bhedaḥ nīlasya saṃvittiḥ tad ākārasya ca iti artha adhigamaḥ ca

pramāṇa phalam sva rūpa adhigamaḥ vā tathā ca āha pramāṇa adhīnaḥ hi prameya adhigamaḥ sa ca viṣaya ākāraḥ ātma bhūtaḥ jñānasya tatas jñānam eva pramāṇam nanu yathākāraḥ jñāna ātma bhūtaḥ tathā adhigamaḥ api tatas jñānam eva phalam iti prāptam sattyam etat pramāṇataḥ phalat na anyat pramāṇam na phalāt param evam prakārā sarvā ca kriyā kārakayoḥ sthitiḥ

etat ca uttaratra pratipādayaṣyate yathā cakṣuḥ ādayaḥ na bhavanti pramāṇan tathā aakāraḥ api mā bhūt yathā kārakāḥ api saṃvedanasya cakṣuḥ ādayaḥ na pramāṇan tatha ākāraḥ api iti āha bhāvāt eva asya tad bhāve tad bhāve ākāra bhāve asya adhigamasya phalasya bhāvāt eva na khalu cakṣuḥ ādi bhāvesya phalasya bhāvaḥ eva ākārasya tu bhāve bhāvaḥ eva avyatirekāt iti sādhakatama tvam sādhakatamañca karaṇam avyavadhāne ca sādhakatama tvam iti pratipādayiṣyate

kathantarhi cakṣuṣā paśyati rūpam iti kāraṇe kāryya upacārāt evam ucyate cauraigrāmaḥ dagdhaḥ iti yathā tasmāt jñānam eva pramāṇam nanu prāpakam etat jñānam iti katham jñātavyam na tāvat pratyakṣataḥ na khalu sva saṃvedana pratyakṣam pramāṇa apramāṇa vibhāgam upadarśayati sarva jñāneṣu sva saṃvedanasya bhāvāt na ca tad utpatti kālaḥ eva saṃvādi itara jñāna vibhāga saṃvedane pravarttamānaḥ kaścid vipralabhyate na api sandehavān syāt

atha ābādhitatva lakṣaṇam prāmāṇyam svatas eva prasidhyati tad artha āpattyā prasādhyamānam parokṣa jñāna vādinām katham svatas siddhyati yathā artha āpattyā jñāna satttā siddhyati tasya arthāpattyā jñānasya na apareṇa prāmāṇyam jñāyate svatas eva tu pramāṇa tā aprāmāṇyantu bādhaka jñānāt bādhaka jñānasya ca svatas eva prāmāṇyam kiñca kāraṇāt utpadyate vi jñānam prāmāṇyantu tasya svatas eva tat api apavādena bādhaka jñānena ābādhitatva lakṣaṇam apodyate atra ucyate
