dharmaḥ puruṣa guṇaḥ kartuḥ priya hita mokṣa hetuḥ atīndiḥ yaḥ antya sukha saṃvijñāna virodhī puruṣa antaḥkaraṇa saṃyoga viśuddha abhisandhi jaḥ varṇa āśramiṇām pratiniyata sādhana nimittaḥ tasya tu sādhanāni śruti smṛti vihitāni varṇa āśramiṇām sāmānya viśeṣa bhāvena avasthitāni dravya guṇa karmāṇi tatra sāmānyāni dharme śraddhā ahiṃsā bhūta hita tvam satya vacanam asteyam brahamacaryam anupadhā krodha varjanam abhiṣecanam śici dravya sevanam viśiṣṭa devatā bhaktiḥ upavāsaḥ apramādaḥ ca brāhmaṇa kṣaciya vaiśyānām ijyā adhyayana dānāni brāhmaṇasya viśiṣṭāni pratigraha adhyāpana yājanāni sva varṇa vihitāḥ ca saṃskārāḥ kṣatriyasya samyak prajā pālanam asādhu nigrahaḥ yuddheṣu anivartanam svakīyāḥ ca saṃskārāḥ vaiśyasya kriya vikraya kṛṣi paśu pālanāni svakīyāḥ ca saṃskārāḥ śūdrasya pūrva varṇa pāratantryam amantrikāḥ ca kriyāḥ āśramiṇām tu brahmacāriṇaḥ guru kula nivāsinaḥ sva śāstra vihitāni guru śuśrūṣā agni indhana bhaikṣya ācaraṇāni madhu māṃsa divāsvapna aṃjana abhyañjana ādi varjanam ca

vidyā vrata snātakasya kṛta dārasya gṛhasthasya śālīnayāya avara vṛtti upārjitaiḥ arthaiḥ bhūta manuṣya deva pitṛ brahma ākhyānām pañcānām mahāyajñānam sāyam prātar anuṣṭhānam eka agni vidhānena pākayajña saṃsthānām ca nityānām śaktau vidyamānāyām agni ādheya ādīnām ca haviḥ yajña saṃsthānām agniṣṭoma ādīnām soma yajña saṃsthānām ca ṛtu antareṣu brahmacaryam apatya utpādanam ca brahmacāriṇaḥ gṛhasthasya vā grāmāt nirgatasya vana vāsaḥ valkaka ajina keśa śmaśru nakha roma dhāraṇam ca vanya huta atithi śeṣa bhojanāni vānaprasthasya trayāṇām anyatamasya śraddhāvataḥ sarva bhūtebhyaḥ nityam abhayam dattvā samnyasya svāni karmāṇi yama niyameṣu apramattasya ṣaṭpadārtha prasaṃkhyānāt yoga prasādhanam pravrajitasya iti dṛṣṭam prayojanam anuddiśya etāni sādhanāni bhāva prasādam ca apekṣyātma manasoḥ saṃyogāt dharma utpattiḥ iti

adharmaḥ api ātma guṇaḥ kartuḥ ahita pratyavāya hetuḥ atīndriyaḥ antya duḥkha saṃvijñāna virodhī tasya tu sādhanāni śāstre pratiṣiddhāni dharma sādhana viparītāni hiṃsā anṛta steya ādīni vihita akaraṇam pramādaḥ ca etāni duṣṭa abhisandhim ca apekṣyātma manasoḥ saṃyogāt adharmasya utpattiḥ

aviduṣaḥ rāga dveṣavataḥ pravartakāt dharmāt prakṛṣṭāt su alpa adharma sahitāt brahma indra prajāpati pitṛ manuṣya lokeṣu āśaya anurūpaiḥ iṣṭa śarīra indriya viṣaya sukha ādibhiḥ yogaḥ bhavati tathā prakṛṣṭāt adharmāt su alpa dharma sahitāt preta tiryagyoni sthāneṣu aniṣṭa śarīra indriya viṣaya duḥkhābhiḥ yogaḥ bhavati evam pravṛtti lakṣaṇāt dharmāt adharma sahitāt deva manuṣya tiryak nārakeṣu punar punar saṃsāra bandhaḥ bhavati

jñāna pūrvakāt tu kṛtāt asaṃkalpita phalāt viśuddhe kule jātasya duḥkha vigama upāya jijñāsoḥ ācāryam upasaṅgamya utpanna ṣaṭpadārtha tattva jñānasya ajñāna nivṛttau viraktasya rāga dveṣa ādi abhāvāt tad jayoḥ dharma adharmayoḥ anutpattau pūrva sañcitayoḥ ca upabhogān nirodhe santoṣa sukham śarīra paricchedam ca utpadya rāga ādi nivṛttau nivṛtti lakṣaṇaḥ kevalaḥ dharmaḥ parama artha darśana jam sukham kṛtvā nivartate tadā nirodhāt nirbījasyāt manaḥ śarīra ādi nivṛttiḥ punar śarīra ādi anutpattau dagdha indhana anala vat upaśamaḥ mokṣaḥ iti

śabdaḥ ambara guṇaḥ śrotra grāhyaḥ kṣaṇikaḥ kārya kāraṇa ubhaya virodhī saṃyoga vibhāga śabda jaḥ pradeśa vṛttiḥ samāna asamāna jātīya kāraṇaḥ sa dvividhaḥ varṇa lakṣaṇaḥ dhvani lakṣaṇaḥ ca tatra akāra ādiḥ varṇa lakṣaṇaḥ śaṅkha ādi nimittaḥ dhvani lakṣaṇaḥ ca tatra varṇa lakṣaṇasya utpattiḥ ātma manasoḥ saṃyogāt smṛti apekṣād varṇa uccāraṇa icchā tad anantaram prayatnaḥ tam apekṣamāṇāt ātma vāyu saṃyogāt vāyau karma jāyate sa ca ūrdhvam gacchan kaṇṭha ādīn abhihanti tatas sthāna vāyu saṃyoga apekṣamāṇāt sthāna ākāśa saṃyogāt varṇa utpattiḥ

avarṇa lakṣaṇaḥ api bherī daṇḍa saṃyoga apekṣāt bherī ākāśa saṃyogāt utpadyate veṇu parva vibhāgāt veṇu ākāśa vibhāgāt ca śabdāt ca saṃyoga vibhāga niṣpannāt vīcī santāna vat śabda santānaḥ iti evamṇ santānena śrotra pradeśam āgatasya grahaṇam śrotra śabdayoḥ gamana āgamana abhāvāt aprāptasya grahaṇam na asti prariśeṣāt santāna siddhiḥ iti
atha karma padārtha nirūpaṇam

utkṣepaṇa ādīnām pañcānām api karma tva sambandhaḥ eka dravyavat tvam kṣaṇika tvam mūrta dravya vṛtti tvam aguṇavat tvam guru tva drava tva prayatna saṃyoga ja tvam sva kārya saṃyoga virodhi tvam saṃyoga vibhāga nirapekṣa kāraṇa tvam asamavāyi kāraṇa tvam sva para āśraya samaveta kārya ārambhaka tvam samāna jātīya anārambhaka tvam dravya anārambhaka tvam ca pratiniyata jāti yogi tvam diś viśiṣṭa kārya ārambhaka tvam ca viśeṣaḥ

tatra utkṣepaṇam śarīra avayaveṣu tat sambaddheṣu ca yat ūrdhva bhāgibhiḥ pradeśaiḥ saṃyoga kāraṇam adhas bhāgbhiḥ ca pradeśaiḥ vibhāga kāraṇam karma utpadyate guru tva prayatna saṃyogebhyaḥ tat utkṣepaṇam tat viparīta saṃyoga vibhāga kāraṇam karma apakṣepaṇam

ṛjunaḥ dravyasya agrā ayvānām tat deśaiḥ vibhāgaḥ saṃyogaḥ ca mūla pradeśaiḥ yena karmaṇā avayavī kuṭilaḥ saṃjāyate tat ākuñcanam tad viprayayeṇa saṃyoga vibhāga utpattau yena karmaṇā avayavī ṛjuḥ sampadyate tat prasāraṇam
yat aniyata diś pradeśa saṃyoga vibhāga kāraṇam tat gamanam iti

etat pañcavidham api karma śarīra avayaveṣu tat sambaddheṣu ca sat pratyayam asat pratyayam ca yat anyat tat apratyayam eva teṣu anyeṣu ca tat gamanam iti karmaṇām jāti pañcaka tvam ayuktaṃgamanā viśeṣāt sarvam hi kṣaṇikam karma gamana mātram utpannam sva āśrayasya ūrdhvam adhiḥ tiryak vā api aṇu mātraiḥ pradeśaiḥ saṃyoga vibhāgātn karoti sarvatra gamana pratyayaḥ avusiṣṭaḥ tasmāt gamanam eva sarvam iti na vargaśas pratyaya anuvṛtti vyāvṛtti darśanāt iha utkṣepaṇam para tra apakṣepaṇam iti evam ādi sarvatra vargaśas pratyaya anuvṛtti vyāvṛttī dṛṣṭe tat dhetuḥ sāmānya viśeṣa bhedaḥ avagamyate

teṣām udādi upasarga viśeṣāt pratiniyata diś viśiṣṭa kārya ārambha tvāt upalakṣaṇa bhedaḥ api siddhaḥ evam api pañca eva iti avadhāraṇa anupapattiḥ niṣkrāmaṇa praveśana ādiṣu api vargaśas pratyaya anuvṛtti vyāvṛtti darśanāt yadi utkṣepaṇa ādiṣu sarvatra vargaśas pratyaya anuvṛtti vyāvṛtti darśanāt jāti bhedaḥ iṣyate evam ca niṣkramaṇa praveśana ādiṣu api kārya bhedāt teṣu pratyaya anuvṛtti vyāvṛttī iti ced naḥ utkṣepaṇa ādiṣu api kārya bhedāt eva pratyaya anuvṛtti vyāvṛtti prasaṅgaḥ

atha samāne vargaśas pratyaya anuvṛtti vyāvṛtti sadbhāve utkṣepaṇa ādīnām eva jāti bhedaḥ na niṣkramaṇa ādīnām iti atra viśeṣa hetuḥ asti iti na jāti saṅkara prasaṅgāt niṣkramaṇa ādīnām jāti bhedāt pratyaya anuvṛtti vyāvṛttau jāti saṅkaraḥ prasajyate katham dvayoḥ draṣṭroḥ ekasmāt apavarakāt apavaraka antaram gacchataḥ yugapad niṣkramaṇa praveśana pratyayau dṛṣṭau tathā dvāra pradeśe praviśati niṣkrāmati iti ca yadā tu pratisīra ādi apanītam bhavati tadā na praveśana pratyayaḥ na api niṣkramaṇa pratyayaḥ kin tu gamana pratyayaḥ eva bhavati

tathā nālikāyām vaṃśa pattra ādau patati bahūnām draṣṭṝṇām yugapad bhramaṇa patana praveśana pratyayāḥ dṛṣṭāḥ iti jāti saṅkara prasaṅgaḥ na ca evam utkṣepaṇa ādiṣu pratyaya saṅkaraḥ dṛṣṭaḥ tasmāt utkṣepaṇa ādīnām eva jāti bhedāt pratyaya anuvṛtti vyāvṛttī niṣkramaṇa ādīnām tu kārya bhedāt iti katham yugapad prayaya bhedaḥ iti ced atha matam yathā jāti saṅkaraḥ na asit evam aneka karma samāveśaḥ api na asti iti ekasmin karmaṇi yugapad draṣṭṝṇām bhramaṇa patana praveśana pratyayāḥ katham bhavanti iti atra brūmaḥ na avayava a ayavinoḥ diś viśiṣṭa saṃyoga vibhāgānām bhedāt

yaḥ hi draṣṭā avayavānām pārśvatas paryāyeṇa diś pradeśaiḥ saṃyoga vibhāgān paśyati tasya bhramaṇa pratyayaḥ bhavati yaḥ hi avayavini ūrdhva pradeśaiḥ vibhāgam adhas saṃyogam ca avekṣate tasya patana pratyayaḥ bhavati yaḥ punar nālikā antar deśe saṃyogam bahis deśe ca vibhāgam paśyati tasya praveśana pratyayaḥ bhavati iti siddhaḥ kārya bhedāt niṣkramaṇa ādīnām pratyaya bhedaḥ iti bhavatu utkṣepaṇa ādīnām jāti bhedāt pratyaya bhedaḥ niṣkramaṇa ādīnām tu kārya bhedāt iti

atha gamana tvam kim karma tva paryāyaḥ āhosvit aparam sāmānyam iti kutas te saṃśayaḥ samaḥ teṣu utkṣepaṇa ādiṣu karma pratyaya vat gamana pratyaya aviśeṣāt karma tva paryāyaḥ iti gamyate yatas tu utkṣepaṇa ādi vat viśeṣa saṃjñayā abhihitam tasmāt aparam sāmānyam syāt iti na karma tva paryāya tvāt ātma tva puruṣa tva vat karma tva paryāyaḥ eva gamana tvam iti atha viśeṣa saṃjñayā kim artham gamana grahaṇam kṛtam iti na bhramaṇa ādi avarodha artha tvāt utkṣepaṇa ādi śabdaiḥ anavaruddhānām bhramaṇa patana spandana ādīnām avarodha artham gamana grahaṇam kṛtam iti anyathā hi yāni eva catvāri viśeṣa saṃjñayā uktāni tāni eva sāmānya viśeṣa saṃjñā viṣayāṇi prasajyeran iti athavā astu aparam sāmānyam gamana tvam aniyata diś deśa saṃyoga vibhāga kāraṇeṣu bhramaṇa ādiṣu eva vartate gamana śabda ḥ ca utkṣepaṇa ādiṣu bhāktaḥ draṣṭavyaḥ sva āśraya saṃyoga vibhāga kartṛ tva sāmānyāt iti

sat pratyaya karma vidhiḥ katham cikīrṣiteṣu yajña adhyayana dāna kṛṣi ādiṣu yadā hastam utkṣeptum icchati apakṣeptum vā tadā hastavatī ātma pradeśe prayatnaḥ saṃjāyate tam prayatnam gurutvā ca upekṣamāṇāt ātma hasta saṃyogāt dhaste karma bhavati hasta vat sarva śarīra avayaveṣu pāda ādiṣu śarīre ca iti tat sambaddheṣu api katham yadā hastena musalam gṛhītvā icchām karoti utkṣipāmi hastena musalam iti tad anantaram prayatnaḥ tam apekṣa maṇād ātma hasta saṃyogāt yasmin eva kāle haste utkṣepaṇa karma utpadyate tasmin eva kāle tam eva prayatnam apekṣamāṇāt dhasta musala saṃyogāt musale api karma iti

tatas dūram utkṣipte musale tad artha icchā nivartate punar api apakṣepaṇa icchā utpadyate tad anataram prayatnaḥ tam apekṣamāṇāt yathā uktāt saṃyogāt dhasta musalayoḥ yugapad apakṣepaṇa karmaṇī bhavataḥ tatas antyena musala karmaṇā ulūkhala musalayoḥ abhighāta ākhyaḥ saṃyogaḥ kriyate sa saṃyogaḥ musala gata vegam apekṣamāṇaḥ apratyayam musale utpatana karma karoti tat karma abhighāta apekṣam musale saṃskāram ārabhate tam apekṣya musala hasta saṃyogaḥ aprayayam hate api utpatana karma karoti yadi api prāktanaḥ saṃskāraḥ vinaṣṭaḥ tathā api musala ulūkhalayoḥ saṃyogaḥ paṭu karma utpādakaḥ saṃyoga viśeṣa bhāvāt tasya saṃskāra ārambhe sācivya samarthaḥ bhavati athavā prāktanaḥ eva paṭuḥ saṃskāraḥ abhighātāt avinaśyan avasthitaḥ iti atas saṃskāravati punar saṃskāra ārambhaḥ na asti atas yasmin kāle saṃskāra apekṣāt abhighātāt aprayayam musale utpatana karma tasmin eva kāle tam eva saṃskāram apekṣamāṇāt musala hasta saṃyogāt apratyayam haste api utpatana karma iti

pāṇim ukteṣu gamana vidhiḥ katham yadā tomaram hastena gṛhītvā utkṣeptum icchā utpadyate tad anantaram prayatnaḥ tam apekṣamāṇāt yathā uktāt saṃyoga dvayāt tomara hastayoḥ yugapad ākarṣaṇa karmaṇī bhavataḥ prasārite ca haste tad ākarṣaṇa arthaḥ prayatnaḥ nivartate tad anantaram tiryak ūrdhva dūram āsannam vā kṣipāmi iti icchā saṃjāyate tad anantaram tat nurūpaḥ prayatnaḥ tam apekṣamāṇaḥ tomara hasta saṃyogaḥ nodana ākhyaḥ tasmāt tomare karma utpannam nodana apekṣam tasmin saṃskāram ārabhate tatas saṃskāra nodanābhyām tāvat karmāṇi bhavanti yāvat dhasta tomara vibhāgaḥ iti tatas vibhāgāt nodane nivṛtte saṃskārāt ūrdhvam tiryak dūram āsannam vā prayatna anurūpāṇi karmāṇi bhavanti āpatanāt iti

tathā yantram ukteṣu gaman vidhiḥ katham yaḥ balavān kṛta vyāyāmaḥ vāmena kareṇa dhanuḥ viṣṭabhya dakṣiṇena śaram sandhāya sa śarām jyām muṣṭinā gṛhītvā ākarṣaṇa icchām karoti sajyeṣu ākarṣayāmi etat dhanuḥ iti tad anantaram prayatnaḥ tam apekṣamāṇāt ātma hasta saṃyogāt ākarṣaṇa karma haste yadā eva utpadyate tadā eva tam eva prayatnam apekṣamāṇāt dhasta jyā śara saṃyogāt jyāyām śare ca karma prayatna viśiṣṭa hasta jyā śara saṃyogam apekṣamāṇābhyām jyā koṭi saṃyogābhyām karmaṇī bhavataḥ dhanuṣkoṭyoḥ iti etat sarvam yugapad

evam ākarṇāt ākṛṣṭe dhanuṣi na atas param anena gantavyam iti yat jñānam tatas tat ākarśaṇa arthasya prayatnasya vināśaḥ tatas punar mokṣaṇa icchā saṃjāyate tad anantaram prayatnaḥ tam apekṣamāṇāt ātma aṅguli saṃyogāt aṅguli karma tasmāt jyā aṅguli vibhāgaḥ tatas vibhāgāt saṃyoga vināśaḥ tasmin vinaṣṭe pratibandhaka abhāvāt yadā dhaṇuṣi vartamānaḥ sthiti sthāpakaḥ saṃskāraḥ maṇḍalībhūtam dhanuḥ yathā avasthitam sthāpayati tadā tam eva saṃskāram apekṣamāṇāt dhanuḥ jyā saṃyogāt jyāyām śare ca karma utpadyate tatsu akāraṇa apekṣam jyāyām saṃskāram karoti tam apekṣamāṇaḥ iṣu jyā saṃyogaḥ nodanam tasmāt iṣau ādyam karma nodana apekṣam iṣau saṃskāram ārabhate

tasmāt saṃskārān nodana sahāyāt tāvat karmāṇi bhavanti yāvat iṣujyā vibhāgaḥ vibhāgāt nivṛtte nodane karmāṇi uttara uttarāni iṣu saṃskārāt eva āpatanāt iti bahūni karmāṇi kramaśas kasmāt saṃyoga bahu tvāt ekaḥ tu saṃskāraḥ antarāle karmaṇaḥ apekṣā kāraṇa abhāvāt iti evam ātma adhiṣṭhiteṣu sat pratyayam asat prayayam ca karma uktam

anadhiṣṭhiteṣu bāhyeṣu caturṣu mahābhūteṣu apratyayam karma gamanam eva nodana ādibhyaḥ bhavati tatra nodanam guru tva drava tva vega prayatnān samastavyaḥ tān apekṣamāṇaḥ yaḥ saṃyoga viśeṣaḥ nodanam avibhāga hetoḥ ekasya karmaṇaḥ kāraṇam tasmāt caturṣu api mahābhūteṣu karma bhavati yathā paṅka ākhyāyām pṛthivyām vega apekṣaḥ yaḥ saṃyoga viśeṣāḥ vibhāga hetoḥ ekasya karmaṇaḥ kāraṇam saḥ abhighātaḥ tasmāt api caturṣu mahābhūteṣu karma bhavati yathā pāṣāṇa ādiṣu niṣṭhure vastuni abhipatiteṣu tathā pāda ādibhiḥ nudyamānāyām abhihanyamānāyām vā paṅka ākhyāyām pṛthivyām yaḥ saṃyogaḥ nodana abhighātayoḥ anyatara apekṣaḥ ubhaya apekṣaḥ vā sa saṃyukta saṃyogaḥ tasmāt api pṛthivī ādiṣu karma bhavati ye ca pradeśāḥ na nudyante na api abhihanyante teṣu api karma jāyate pṛthivī udakayoḥ guru tva vidhāraka saṃyoga prayatna vega abhāve sati guru tvāt yat adhas gamanam tat patanam yathā musala śarīra ādiṣu uktam tatra ādyam guru tvāt dvitīya ādīni tu guru tva saṃskārābhyām

srotaḥ bhūtānām apām sthalāt nimna abhisarpaṇam yat tat drava tvāt syandanam katham samantāt rodhaḥ saṃyogena avayavi drava tvam pratibaddham avayava drava tvam api eka artha samavetam tena eva pratibaddham uttara uttara avayava drava tvāni saṃyukta saṃyogaiḥ pratibaddhāni yadā tu mātrayā setu bhedaḥ kṛtaḥ bhavati tadā samantāt pratibaddha tvāt avayavi drava tu asya kārya ārambhaḥ na asti setu samīpa sthasya avayava drava tu asya uttarottareṣām avayava drava tvānām pratibandhaka abhāvāt vṛtti lābhaḥ tatas kramaśas saṃyuktānām eva abhisarpaṇam tatas pūrva dravya vināśe sati prabandhena avasthitaiḥ avayaviḥ dīrgham dravyam ārabhyate tatra ca kāraṇa guṇa pūrva krameṇa drava tvam utpadyate tatra ca kāraṇānām saṃyuktānām prabandhena gamane yat avayavini karma utpadyate tat syandana ākhyam iti

saṃskārāt karm aiṣu ādiṣu uktam tathā cakra ādiṣu avayavānām pārśvatas pratiniyata diś deśa saṃyoga vibhāga utpattau yat avayavinaḥ saṃskārāt aniyata diś deśa saṃyoga vibhāga nimittam karma tat bhramaṇam iti evam ādayaḥ gamana viśeṣāḥ prāṇa ākhye tu vāyau karma ātma vāyu saṃyogāt icchā dveṣa pūrvaka prayatna apekṣāt jāgrataḥ icchā anuvidhāna darśanāt suptasya tu jīvana pūrvaka prayatna apekṣāt ākāśa kāla diś ātmanām sati api dravya bhāve niṣkriya tvam sāmānya ādi vat amūrta tvāt mūrtiḥ asarva gata dravya parimāṇam tat anuvidhāyinī ca kriyā sā ca ākāśa ādiṣu na asti tasmāt na teṣām kriyā sambandhaḥ asti iti

sa vigrahe manasi indriya antara sambandha artham jāgrataḥ karma ātma manaḥ saṃyogāt icchā dveṣa pūrvaka prayatna apekṣāt anu abhiprāyam indriya antareṇa viṣaya antara upalabdhi darśanāt suptasya prabodha kāle jīvana pūrvaka prayatna apekṣāt apasarpaṇa karma utpasarpaṇa karma ca ātma manaḥ saṃyogāt adṛṣṭa apekṣāt katham yadā jīvana sahakārinoḥ dharma adharmayoḥ upabhogāt prakṣayaḥ anyonya abhibhavaḥ vā tadā jīvana sahāyayoḥ vaikalyāt tad pūrvaka prayatna vaikalyāt prāṇa nirodhe sati anyābhyām labdha vṛttibhyām dharma adharmābhyām ātma manaḥ saṃyoga sahāyābhyām mṛta śarīrāt vibhāga kāraṇam apasarpaṇa karma utpadyate

tatas śarīrāt vahiḥ apagatam tābhyām eva dharma adharmābhyām samutpanena ativāhika śarīreṇa sambandhyate tad saṅkra antam ca svargam narakam vā agatvā āśaya anurūpeṇa śarīreṇa sambadhyate tad saṃyoga artham karma upasarpaṇam iti yoginām ca bahis udrecitasya manasaḥ abhipreta deśa gamanam pratyāgamanam ca tathā sarga kāle pratyagreṇa śarīreṇa sambandha artham karma adṛṣṭa kāritam evam anyat api mahābhūteṣu yat pratyakṣa anumānābhyām anupalabhyamāna kāraṇam upakāra apakāra samartham ca bhavati tat api adṛṣṭa kāritam yathā sarga ādau aṇu karma agni vāyvoḥ ūrdhva tiryak gamane mahābhūtānām prakṣebhaṇam abhiṣiktānām maṇīnām taskaram prati gamanam ayasaḥ ayaskānta abhisarpaṇam ca iti

atha sāmānya padārtha nirūpaṇam sāmānyam dvividham param aparam ca sva viṣaya sarva gatam abhinna ātmakam aneka vṛtti eka dvi bahuṣu ātma svarūpa anugama pratyaya kāri svarūpa abhedena ādhāreṣu prabandhena vartamānam anuvṛtti pratyaya kāraṇam katham pratipiṇḍam sāmānya apekṣam prabandhena jñāna utpattau abhyāsa pratyaya janitāt ca saṃskārāt atīta jñāna prabandha pratyavekṣaṇāt yat anugatam asti tat sāmānyam iti tatra sat tāsā nyam param anuvṛtti pratyaya kāraṇam eva yathā paraspara viśiṣṭeṣu carma vastra kambala ādiṣu ekasma anila dravya abhisambandhāt nīlam nilam iti pratyaya anuvṛttiḥ tathā paraspara viśiṣṭeṣu dravya guṇa karmasu aviśiṣṭā sat sat iti pratyaya anuvṛttiḥ sā ca artha antarāt bhavitum arhati iti yat tat artha antaram sā sattā iti siddhā

sattā anusambandhāt sat sat iti pratyaya anuvṛttiḥ tasmāt sā sāmānyam eva aparam dravya tva guṇa tva karma tva ādi anuvṛtti vyāvṛtti hetu tvāt sāmānyam viśeṣaḥ ca bhavati tatra dravya tvam paraspara viśiṣṭeṣu pṛthivī ādiṣu anuvṛtti hetu tvāt sāmānyam guṇa karmabhyaḥ vyāvṛtti hetu tvāt viśeṣaḥ tathā guṇa tvam paraspara viśiṣṭeṣu rūpa ādiṣu anuvṛtti hetu tvāt sāmānyam dravya karmabhyaḥ vyāvṛtti hetu tvāt viśeṣaḥ tathā karma tvam paraspara viśiṣṭeṣu utkṣepaṇa ādiṣu anuvṛtti pratyaya hetu tvāt sāmānyam dravya guṇebhyaḥ vyāvṛtti hetu tvāt viśeṣaḥ evam pṛthivī tva rūpa tva utkṣepaṇa tva go tva ghaṭa tva paṭa tva ādīnām api prāṇi aprāṇi gatānām anuvṛtti vyāvṛtti hetu tvāt sāmānya viśeṣa bhāvaḥ siddhaḥ etāni tu dravya tva ādīni prabhūta viṣaya tvāt prādhānyena sāmānyāni sva āśraya viśeṣaka tvāt bhaktyā viśeṣa ākhyāni iti

lakṣaṇa bhedāt eṣām dravya guṇa karmabhyaḥ padārtha antara tvam siddham atas eva ca nitya tvam dravya ādiṣu vṛtti niyamāt pratyaya bhedāt ca parasparataḥ ca anya tvam pratyekam sva āśrayeṣu lakṣaṇa aviśeṣāt viśeṣa lakṣaṇa abhāvāt ca eka tvam yadi api aparicchinna deśāni sāmānyāni bhavanti tathā api upalakṣaṇa niyamāt kāraṇa sāmagrī niyamāt ca sva viṣaya sarva gatāni antarāle ca saṃyoga samavāya vṛtti abhāvāt avyapadeśyāni iti

atha viśeṣa padārtha nirūpaṇam anteṣu bhavāḥ antyāḥ sva āśraya viśeṣaka tvāt viśeṣāḥ vināśa ārambha rahiteṣu nitya dravyeṣu aṇu ākāśa kāla diś ātma manassu pratidravyam ekaikaśas vartamānāḥ atyanta vyāvṛtti buddhi hetavaḥ yathā asmadīnām gavā ādiṣu aśva ādibhyaḥ tulya ākṛti guṇa kriyā avayava saṃyoga nimittā pratyaya vyāvṛttiḥ dṛṣṭā gauḥ śuklaḥ śīghra gatiḥ pīnaka kudmāt mahā ghaṇṭaḥ iti tathā asmad viśiṣṭānām yoginām nityeṣu tulya ākṛti guṇa kriyeṣu paramāṇuṣu mukta ātma manassu ca anya nimitta asambhavāt yebhyaḥ nimittebhyaḥ pratyādhāram vilakṣaṇaḥ ayam vilakṣaṇaḥ ayam iti pratyaya vyāvṛttiḥ deśa kāla viprakarṣe ca paramāṇau saḥ eva ayam iti pratyabhijñānam ca bhavati te antyāḥ viśeṣāḥ

yadi punar antya viśeṣam antareṇa yoginām yoga jāt dharmāt pratyaya vyāvṛttiḥ pratyabhijñānam ca syāt tatas kim syāt na evam bhavati yathā na yoga jāt dharmāt aśukle śukla pratyayaḥ saṃjāyate atyanta adṛṣṭe ca pratyabhijñānam yadi syāt mithyā bhavet tathā iha api antya viśeṣam antareṇa yoginām na yoga jāt dharmāt pratyaya vyāvṛttiḥ pratyabhijñānam vā bhavitum arhati atha antya viśeṣeṣu iva paramāṇuṣu kasmāt na svatas pratyaya vyāvṛttiḥ kalpyate iti ced na tādātmyāt iha atad ātmakeṣu anya nimittaḥ pratyayaḥ bhavati yathā ghaṭa ādiṣu pradīpāt na tu pradīpe pradīpa antarāt yathā gavāśva māṃsa ādīnām svatas eva aśuci tvam tad yogāt anyeṣām tathā iha api tādātmyāt antya viśeṣeṣu svatas eva pratyaya vyāvṛttiḥ tad yogāt paramāṇu ādiṣu iti

atha samavāya padārtha nirūpaṇam ayutasiddhānām ādhārya ādhāra bhūtānām yaḥ sambandhaḥ ihapratyaya hetuḥ sa samavāyaḥ dravya guṇa karma sāmānya viśeṣāṇām kārya kāraṇa bhūtānām akārya kāraṇa bhūtānām vā ayuta siddhānām ādhārya ādhāra bhāvena avasthitānām iha idam iti buddhiḥ yatas bhavati yatas ca asarva gatānām adhigata anyatvānām aviṣvagbhāvaḥ sa samavāya ākhyaḥ sambandhaḥ katham yathā iha kuṇḍe dadhīti pratyayaḥ sambandhe sati dṛṣṭaḥ tathā iha tantuṣu paṭaḥ iha vīraṇeṣu kaṭaḥ iha dravye guṇakaṃraṇī iha dravya guṇa karmasu sattāḥ iha dravye dravya tvam iha guṇe guṇa tvam iha karmaṇi karma tvam iha nitya dravye antyāḥ viśeṣāḥ iti pratyaya darśanāt asti eṣām sambandhaḥ iti jñāyate

na ca asau saṃyogaḥ sam bandhinām ayutasiddha tvāt anyatara karma ādi nimitta asambhavāt vibhāga anta tva adarśanāt adhikaraṇa adhikartavyayoḥ eva bhāvāt iti sa ca dravya ādibhyaḥ padārtha antaram bhāva vat lakṣaṇa bhedāt yathā bhāvasya dravya tva ādīnām sva ādhāreṣu ātma anurūpa pratyaya kartṛ tvāt sva āśraya ādibhyaḥ parasparataḥ ca artha antara bhāvaḥ tathā samavāyasya api pañcasu padārtheṣu iha iti pratyaya darśanāt tebhyaḥ padārtha antara tvam iti na ca saṃyoga vat nānātvam bhāva vat liṅga aviśeṣāt viśeṣa liṅga abhāvāt ca tasmāt bhāva vat sarvatra ekaḥ samavāyaḥ iti

nanu yadi ekaḥ samavāyaḥ dravya guṇa karmaṇām dravya tva guṇa tva karma tva ādi viśeṣaṇaiḥ saha sambandha eka tvāt padārtha saṅkara prasaṅgaḥ iti naḥ ādhāra ādheya niyamāt yadi api ekaḥ samavāyaḥ sarvatra svatantraḥ tathā api ādhāra ādheya niyamaḥ asti katham dravyeṣu eva dravya tvam guṇeṣu eva guṇa tvam karmasu eva karma tvam iti evam ādi kasmāt anvaya vyatireka darśanāt iha iti samavāya nimittasya jñānasya anvaya darśanāt sarvatra ekaḥ samavāyaḥ iti gamyate dravya tva ādi nimittānām vyatireka darśanāt pratiniyamaḥ jñāyate yathā kuṇḍa dadhnoḥ saṃyoga eka tve bhavati āśraya āśrayi bhāva niyamaḥ tathā dravya tva ādīnām api samavāya eka tve api vyaṅgya vyaṃjaka śakti bhedāt ādhāra ādheya niyamaḥ iti

sambandha nitya tve api na saṃyoga vat anitya tvam bhāva vat akāraṇa tvāt yathā pramāṇataḥ kāraṇa anupalabdheḥ nityaḥ bhāvaḥ iti uktam tathā samavāyaḥ api iti na hi asya kiñcid kāraṇam pramāṇataḥ upalabhyate iti kayā punar vṛttyā dravya ādiṣu samavāyaḥ vartate na saṃyogaḥ sambhavati tasya guṇa tvena dravya āśrita tvāt na api samavāyaḥ tasya ekatvāt na ca anyā vṛttiḥ asti iti na tādātmyāt yathā dravya guṇa karmaṇām sat ātmakasya bhāvasya na anyaḥ sattā yogaḥ asti evam avibhāginaḥ vṛtti ātmakasya samavāyasya na anyā vṛttiḥ asti tasmāt sva ātma vṛttiḥ atas eva atīndriyaḥ sattā ādīnām iva pratyakṣeṣu vṛtti abhāvāt sva ātma gata saṃvedana abhāvāt ca tasmāt ihabuddhi anumeyaḥ samavāyaḥ iti
yoga ācāra vibhūtyā yaḥ toṣayitvā maheśvaram cakre vaiśeṣikam śāstram tasmai kaṇabhuje namaḥ

vīta āvīta viṣāṇasya pakṣa tāvana sevinaḥ pravādāḥ sāṃkhya kariṇaḥ sallakīṣaṃḍa bhaṅgurāḥ ṛṣaye paramāya arka marīci sama tejase saṃsāra gahanamadhva anta sūryāya gurave namaḥ tattvam jijñāsamānāya viprāya asuraye muniḥ tat uvāca mahat tantram duḥkha traya nivṛttaye na tasya adhigamaḥ śakyaḥ kartum varṣa śataiḥ api bhūyas tvāt iti saṃcintya munibhiḥ sūkṣma buddhibhiḥ granthena alpena saṃkṣipya tadā ārṣam anuśāsanam nibaddham amala prajñaiḥ śiṣyāṇām hita kāmyayā

pratipakṣāḥ punar tasya puruṣa īśa aṇu vādinaḥ vaināśikāḥ prākṛtikāḥ vikāra puruṣāḥ tathā teṣām icchā vighāta artham ācāryaiḥ sūkṣma buddhibhiḥ racitāḥ sveṣu tantreṣu viṣamāḥ tarka gahvarāḥ śiṣyaiḥ duravagāhāḥ te tattva artha bhrānta buddhibhiḥ tasmāt īśvara kṛṣṇena saṃkṣipta artham idam kṛtam saptati ākhyam prakaraṇam sakalam śāstram eva vā yasmāt sarva padārthānām iha vyākhyā kariṣyate

pradhāna astitvam eka tvam arthavat tvam atha anya tā pārārthyañca tathā anaikyam viyogaḥ yogaḥ eva ca śeṣa vṛttiḥ akartṛ tvam cūlikā arthāḥ smṛtāḥ daśa viparyayaḥ pañcavidhaḥ tathā uktāḥ nava tuṣṭayaḥ karaṇānām asāmarthyam aṣṭāviṃśatidhā matam iti ṣaṣṭiḥ padārthānām aṣṭābhiḥ saha siddhibhiḥ yathākramam lakṣaṇataḥ kārtsnyena iha abhidhāsyate tasmāt atas śāstram idam alam nānātva siddhaye

alpa grantham analpa artham sarvaiḥ tantra guṇaiḥ yutam pāramarṣasya tantrasya bimbam ādarśa gam yathā tasya vyākhyām kariṣyāmi yathānyāya upapattaye kāruṇyāt api ayuktām tām pratigṛhṇantu sūrayaḥ āha kariṣyati bhavān vyākhyām idam tu ādau upanyastam sarvaiḥ tantra guṇaiḥ yutam idam tantram iti ke tantra guṇāḥ kiyantaḥ vā iti

ucyate sūtra pramāṇa avayava upapattiḥ anyūna tā saṃśaya nirṇaya uktiḥ uddeśa nirdeśam anukramaḥ ca saṃjñā upadeśau iha tantra sampad sūtrāṇi ca pramāṇāni ca avayavāḥ ca sūtra pramāṇa avayavāḥ teṣām upapattiḥ sūtra pramāṇa avayava upapattiḥ upapattiḥ sambhavaḥ iti anarthāntaram ananyaḥ arthaḥ anartha antaram upapatti śabdaḥ pratyekam parisamāpyate sūtra upapattiḥ ityādi āha lakṣaṇa upeta sūtra upapattiḥ iti vaktavyam itarathāḥ hi alakṣaṇa upetasya api sūtrasya tantra aṅga bhāvaḥ syāt iti ucyate na na antarīyaka tvāt na hi antareṇa lakṣaṇa upeta tvam sūtra tvam atas na vaktavyam etat iti āha atha sūtram iti kasmāt

ucyate sūcanāt sūtram sūcayati tān tān artha viśeṣān iti sūtram tat yathā kāraṇam asti avyaktam bhedānām parimāṇāt iti atra pratijñā hetū kaṇṭha uktau tayoḥ upayogi dṛṣṭāntam sādhya siddhaye samartham iti kṛtvā mūla śakala ādayaḥ atra antaranabhihitāḥ api etasmāt avasīyante athavā bhikṣoḥ upasaṃhṛta bahiṣkaraṇa antaḥkaraṇasya teṣu teṣu atīndriyeṣu api pradhāna ādiṣu artheṣu buddhim sūcayati iti sūtram athavā saukṣmyāt tad anupalabdhiḥ iti sūtram tat yathā alpa akṣaram asandigdham sāravat viśvatomukham astobhamanavadyam ca sūtram sūtra vidaḥ viduḥ

astobhama punaruktam iti arthaḥ tathā laghūni sūcita arthāni su alpa akṣara padāni ca sarvatas sāra bhūtāni sūtrāṇi āhuḥ manīṣiṇaḥ pramāṇāni ca pratyakṣa ādīni tāni uttaratra vakṣyati dṛṣṭam anumānam āpta vacanam ca prativiṣaya adhyavasāyaḥ dṛṣṭam ityādi avayavāḥ punar jijñāsā ādayaḥ pratijña ādayaḥ ca tatra jijñāsā ādayaḥ vyākhyā aṅgam pratijña ādayaḥ para pratyāyana aṅgam tān uttaratra vakṣyāmaḥ

āha avayavān abhidhānam upadeśāt na hi tathā pratyakṣa ādīni pramāṇāni upadiṣṭāni tathā avayavāḥ upadiṣṭāḥ tasmāt avayava upapattiḥ iti etat asat bhāṣya kāra prāmāṇyāt adoṣaḥ iti ced syāt matam yadi api sūtra kāreṇa avayava upadeśaḥ na kṛtaḥ tathā api bhāṣya kārāḥ kecid eṣām saṃgraham cakruḥ te ca naḥ pramāṇam tasmāt yukatam avayava upapattiḥ iti etat ca ayuktam kasmāt utsūtra tvāt na hi utsūtram vyācakṣāṇāḥ bhāṣya kārāḥ pramāṇam bhavanti tathā ca etat utsūtritam iti

ucyate na liṅgāt na etat yuktam anupadeśāt na santi jijñāsā ādayaḥ kintarhi anupadiṣṭam api eṣām astitvam liṅgāt pratipadyāmahe yat ayam ācāryaḥ duḥkha traya abhighātāt jijñāsā tad apaghātake hetau iti jijñāsā prayojanam ācaṣṭe kāraṇam asti avyaktam iti pratijñām karoti bhedānām parimāṇāt iti hetum upadiśati naṭa vat vyavatiṣṭhate liṅgam iti dṛṣṭāntam dyotayati kṣīrasya yathā tathā pravṛttiḥ pradhānastyā iti upasaṃharati tasmāt trividham karaṇam dvārī iti nigamayati na ca anabhipretaiḥ ācāryāṇām śāstre vyavahāraḥ lakṣyate tena vayam liṅgāt pratipadyāmahe santi jijñāsā ādayaḥ avayavāḥ śāstre iti

āha satām anupadeśe prayojana vacanam evam ced manyase santi jijñāsā ādayaḥ avayavāḥ śāstre teṣām anupadeśe prayojanam vaktavyam amuṣmāt hetoḥ ācāryeṇa na upadiśyante santi ca te iti ucyate pramāṇa antarbhāvāt pramāṇeṣu antarbhāvaḥ eṣām iti ayam upadiṣṭaḥ hetuḥ asmābhiḥ anumāna aṅgam hi jijñāsā ādayaḥ tasmāt tad antarbhūtāḥ te iti na pṛthak upadiśyante kiñca tantra antara ukteḥ tantra antareṣu hi vindhya vāsi prabhṛtiḥ ācāryaiḥ upadiṣṭāḥ pramāṇam ca naḥ te ācāryāḥ iti atas ca anupadeśaḥ jijñāsā ādīnām iti

āha na pramāṇa anupadeśa prasaṃgāt yadi ca tantra antara upadeśāt eva avayavānām anupadeśaḥ pratyakṣa ādīni api ca tantra antareṣu upadiśyante śrotra ādi vṛttiḥ pratyakṣam sambandhāt ekasmāt śeṣa siddhiḥ anumānam yaḥ yatra abhiyuktaḥ karmaṇi ca āduṣṭassa tatra āptaḥ tasya upadeśaḥ āpta vacanam iti teṣām api anupadeśa prasaṅgaḥ atha sati tantra antara upadeśe pramāṇāni upadiśyante na avayavāḥ iti nanu etat icchā mātram iti

ucyate pūrvaḥ eva tarhi parihāraḥ astu athavā punar astu tantra antara ukteḥ iti ayam api parihāraḥ yat tu uktam pramāṇa anupadeśa prasaṅgaḥ iti atra brūmaḥ ayuktam etat kasmāt prayojanavatām upadeśasya adoṣa tvāt anupadeśaḥ hi prayojanavataḥ ca udyate iti yuktam etat upadeśam eva tu sa doṣaḥ iti kṛtvā kaḥ pratyācakṣīta tasmāt na kiñcid etat kiñca anyat pradhāna upadeśe guṇa bhūta antarbhāva siddheḥ tat yathā takṣṇu hi caitraḥ iti ukte yāvadbhiḥ sādhana viśeṣaiḥ vinā takṣaṇam na upapadyate sarvāḥ tān caitraḥ upādatte tathā pratyakṣa ādiṣu pramāṇeṣu upadiṣṭeṣu yaiḥ eṣām avinābhāvaḥ sarvāṇi tāni upādāsyāmahe kiñca anyāt anyatra api tad anuṣṭhānāt na kevalam iha anyatra api ayam ācāryaḥ pradhānām eva upadeśam karoti tad aṅga bhūtāḥ tu tad upadeśāt eva pratīyante tat yathā kāraṇam asti avyaktam bhedānām parimāṇāt iti

itarathāḥ hi dṛṣṭānta abhāvāt asādhanam etat syāt paśyati tu ācāryaḥ na adṛṣṭāntam sādhanam sādhyam āpnoti iti kṛtvā pratipādakāḥ pratipādana kāle tantra antara upadiṣṭān api mūla śakala ādīn ākṣepsyanti iti kiñca anyat anumāne bhūta vat upadeśāt atas ca etat evam yat ayam ācāryaḥ trividham anumānam ākhyātam iti bravīti katham kṛtvā jñāpakam ākhyātasya hi pratyāmnāye bhūta vācinā śabdena upadeśaḥ bhavati na ca anena pūrvam trividham anumānam ākhyātam ākhyātam iti ced na tat ākhyātam kvacid iti śakyam pratipādayitum saḥ ayam anākhyāya api yat bhūta vācinam śabdam upādatte tat jñāpayati ācāryaḥ tantra antara klṛptānām api iha sanniveśaḥ aṅgīkriyate kim etasya jñāpane prayojanam tantra antara upadiṣṭaḥ api karma yonīnām prāṇa bheda ādīnām ca lakṣaṇa upadeśa ssaṃgṛhītaḥ bhavati iti siddham tantra antara upadeśāt avayavān upadeśaḥ tasmāt sūktam eva avayava upapattiḥ iti

anyūna tā padārtha kārtsnyam aśeṣa tānyūnata iti abhidhīyate padārthāḥ ca daśa cūlikā arthāḥ paṃcāśat pratyayāḥ tatra astitvam eka tvam paṃcabhiḥ vītaiḥ siddham arthavat tvam kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ pārārthyam saṃhatya kāriṇām para artha tvāt atas eva anya tvam cetanā śakteḥ guṇa trayāt janma maraṇa karaṇānām iti evamādibhiḥ puruṣa bahu tvam puruṣasya darśana arthaḥ iti saṃyogaḥ prāpte śarīra bhede iti viyogaḥ samyak jñāna adhigamāt iti śeṣa vṛttiḥ tasmāt ca viparyāsāt iti puruṣasya akartṛ tvam iti ete daśa cūlikā arthāḥ pañca viparyaya bhedāḥ bhavanti aśaktiḥ ca karaṇa vaikalyāt aṣṭāviṃśati bhedā tuṣṭiḥ navadhā aṣṭadhā siddhiḥ iti pañcāśat pratyayāḥ sā eṣā ṣaṣṭiḥ padārthānām tad upapattiḥ anyūna tā

saṃśaya nirṇaya uktiḥ saṃśayaḥ ca nirṇayaḥ ca tau saṃśaya nirṇayau tayorukti ssaṃśaya nirṇaya uktiḥ sāmānya abhidhānam saṃśayaḥ tat yathā mahat ādi tat ca kāryam prakṛti virūpam sarūpam ca iti ukte saṃśayaḥ bhavati kena dharmeṇa kāryam prakṛti virūpam kena vā sarūpam iti viśeṣa abhidhānam nirṇayaḥ sa ca dvividhaḥ śabdataḥ arthataḥ ca śabdaḥ tāvat yathā hetumat ādibhiḥ kāryam prakṛti virūpam traiguṇya ādibhiḥ prakṛti sarūpam iti arthataḥ tat yathā tebhyaḥ bhūtāni pañca pañcabhyaḥ ete smṛtāḥ viśeṣāḥ kim kāraṇam yasmāt śāntāḥ ghorāḥ ca mūḍhāḥ ca aśānta ghora mūḍha tvāt tanmātrāṇi aviśeṣāḥ

uddeśa nirdeśam uddeśaḥ ca nirdeśaḥ ca uddeśa nirdeśam sarvaḥ dvandvaḥ vibhāṣaya eka vat bhavati iti dvandva eka vat bhāvaḥ saṅkṣepa vacanam uddeśaḥ tat yathā eṣa pratyaya sargaḥ viparyaya aśakti tuṣṭi siddhi ākhyaḥ vistara vacanam nirdeśaḥ tat yathā pañca viparyaya bhedāḥ bhavanti bhedaḥ tamasaḥ aṣṭavidhaḥ ityādiḥ anukramaḥ ca padārthānām ānupūrvyā sanniveśa upadeśaḥ anukramaḥ tat yathā prakṛteḥ mahān tatas ahaṃkāraḥ tasmāt gaṇaḥ ca ṣoḍaśakaḥ iti antena

saṃjñā upadeśau saṃjñi pratyāyana arthaḥ śabdaḥ saṃjñā sā ca dvividhā artha nibandhanā svarūpa nibandhanā ca tatra artha nibandhana artha vaśena artha kriyā apekṣā jāti ādi artha svarūpa antarbhāvī yathārthaḥ tathābhūtam eva saṃjñinam pratyāyati tat yathā pācakaḥ lāvakaḥ iti svarūpa nibandhanā punar saṃjñi pratyāyana upāya mātram sva rūpa mātra upakāriṇī vinā avayava artham samaya vaśāt atathābhūtam api saṃjñinam pratyāyati tat yathā gajakarṇaḥ aśvakarṇaḥ iti prayatnataḥ bhagavataḥ parama ṛṣeḥ ārṣeṇa jñānena sarva tattvānām svarūpam upalabhya saṃjñām vidadhataḥ na asti svarūpa nibandhanaḥ śabdaḥ tat yathā pradhīyante atra vikārāḥ iti pradhānam puri śetaḥ iti puruṣaḥ ityādi tad mata anusāriṇām api ācāryāṇām tābhiḥ eva saṃvyavahārāt na asti apūrva saṃjñā vidhānam pratyādaraḥ

upadeśaḥ itikartavya tā phala samākhyānam upadeśaḥ tat yathā evam tattva abhayasān nā asmi na me na aham iti apariśeṣam aviparyayāt viśuddham kevalam utpadyate jñānam ete sūtra upapatti ādayaḥ tantra guṇāḥ iti karaṇam prakāra artham evamprakārāḥ anye api draṣṭavyāḥ tat yathā utsargaḥ apavādaḥ atideśaḥ ityādiḥ tatra utsargaḥ prakṛti virūpam vyaktam sarūpam ca iti apavādaḥ tathā tad viparītaḥ iti utsargaḥ tathā ca pumān iti apavādaḥ sāmānyam acetanam prasava dharmi vyaktam tathā pradhānam iti atideśaḥ iti evam anyāḥ api tantra yuktayaḥ śakyāḥ iha pradarśayitum atiprasaṅgaḥ tu prakṛtam tirodadhāti iti nivartyate siddham tantra yuktīnām sambandha upapatteḥ tantram idam iti

kiñca tantra antara avirodhāt yadi khalvapi idam api prakaraṇam syāt tantra antare pātañjala pañca adhikaraṇa vārṣa gaṇa prabhṛtīnām anyatamasya śeṣa bhūtam syāt taiḥ ca api avirodhaḥ tatra tatra iti vakṣyāmaḥ pūrva tantra śeṣa bhāvāt iti ced tulyam etāni api pūrva tantra śeṣa bhūtāni teṣām api prakaraṇa tva prasaṅgaḥ atha matam sakala padārtha saṃgrahāt tantra antarāṇi etāni evam iha api sakala padārtha saṃgrahāt tantra antara tvam abhyupagantavyam tasmāt yuktam etat tantram idam iti upodghātaḥ

āha kiṃguṇa viśiṣṭāya śiṣyāya punar idam tantram vyākhyeyam iti ucyate jijñāsave matimate mīmāṃsa kāya arthine abhyupagatāya śiṣyāya vyākhyeyam śāstram kasmāt parama ṛṣi prāmāṇyāt yasmāt bhagavān viśva agrajaḥ parama ṛṣiḥ bhagavat āsureḥ jijñāsām upalabhya uttara guṇa viśeṣa sampadam ca vyākhyātavān rajaḥ eva duḥkham tad nirākariṣṇoḥ vivekaḥ ayam sattvāt sattvam ca asmān nānā iti evamādinā vacana pratipādyaḥ ayam arthaḥ mahadbhiḥ ca uktaḥ tasmāt rajaḥ duḥkha upaghāta upaghātaka jijñāsoḥ sattvāt dharma ādi kuśala mūla vipāka utpitsoḥ duḥkha traya nivṛttayaḥ idam śāstram pravṛttam tad arthāt pariṇamate śiṣyasya iti katham nāma śiṣyasya niḥśreyasena yogaḥ syāt iti evam artham idam vyākhyānam kriyate iti

āha yat uktam jijñāsave vyākhyānam kartavyam iti tatra kutas punar iyam jijñāsā kasmin vā arthe bhavati iti ucyate yat tāvat uktam kutas punar iyam jijñāsā bhavati iti atra brūmaḥ duḥkha traya abhighātāt jijñāsā duḥkham rajaḥ iti anarthāntaram duḥkhayati iti duḥkham bhavati iti trayam iti saṃkhyā padam sarva dravya viṣayam duḥkha śabdena viśiṣyate prādhānyāt ca vyatirikta buddhyā gṛhyamāṇam sambandhi tvāt ādhārasya bheda nibandhanāyāḥ ṣaṣṭhyā nimittattvam pratipadyate duḥkhānām trayam duḥkha trayam

abhihanyate anena iti abhighātaḥ kaḥ punar ayam abhighātaḥ nāma ucyate yaḥ asau upari ukta duḥkha trayeṇa antaḥkaraṇena cetanā śakteḥ abhisambandhaḥ tasmāt duḥkha traya abhighātāt jijñāsā yat uktam kasmin arthe bhavati iti tatra āha tad apaghātake hetau apahanti iti apaghātakaḥ tasya apaghātakaḥ tad apaghātakaḥ

āha tad apaghātake iti samāsa anupapattiḥ pratiṣedhāt kartari yau tṛjakau tābhyām saha ṣaṣṭhī na samasyate tasmāt tasya apaghātakaḥ iti vaktavyam ucyate na śāstre darśanāt tad prayojakaḥ hetuḥ ca iti śāstre dṛṣṭaḥ prayogaḥ pada kāraḥ ca āha jātivācaka tvāt tathā kadācid guṇaḥ guṇa viśeṣaḥ bhavati kadācid guṇinā guṇaḥ viśiṣyate iti cūrṇikārasya prayogaḥ tasmadanavadyam etat

ayam tu piṇḍa arthaḥ trividhena duḥkhena abhihataḥ brāhmaṇaḥ tad apaghātakam hetum jijñāsate kaḥ nāma asau hetuḥ syāt yaḥ duḥkha trayam abhihanyāt iti āha duḥkha śabdā vacanam ādau amaṅgala artha tvāt maṅgala ādīni hi śāstrāṇi prathante vīra puruṣāṇi ca bhavanti adhyetāraḥ ca maṃgalena abhihata saṃskārāḥ śāstra arthānāsu pratipadyante duḥkham iti ayam ca amaṅgala arthaḥ śabdaḥ tasmāt na ārabdhavyaḥ śāstra ādau iti

ucyate na vākyasya arthe prayogāt padasya anarthakyādamaṅgala artha tva anupapattiḥ vākyam artha pratyāyana artham prayujyate viśiṣṭa artha abhidhānāt na padam tathā hi padārtha vyatirekeṇa viśiṣṭaḥ eva vākya arthaḥ pratīyate kevalam tu padam sāmānya arthāt apracyutam viśiṣṭa artha abhidhānā samartham atas eva na vivakṣita artha pratyāyana yogyatayā upādīyate tat yathā devadattā iti ayam śabdaḥ kartṛ vācaka tvena upāttaḥ sarva kriyā viṣaya tvāt na antareṇa karma kriyā śabdau viśiṣṭa arthaḥ pratīyate tathā gām iti karma sarva kriyā kartṛ abhidhāna nimitta tvāt tathā abhyāja iti kriyā sarva karma kartṛ viṣaya tvāt yadā tu devadatta gām abhyāja śuklām iti ucyate tadā devadattena go śabdena karma antarebhyaḥ vicchidya sva ātmani avasthāpyate

kriyā ca go śabdaḥ ca sarva kartṛbhyaḥ devadatta karma tayā vyavasthāpyate kartṛ karmaṇī ca abhyāji kriyāyāḥ sādhana bhāvena eva niyamyete śukla śabdaḥ go śabdaḥ ca go śabdam sarva guṇa viṣayam ādheya antarebhyaḥ vyavacchedya sva ātmanaḥ ādhāra tve niyamya tat viṣaya tām pratipādayati iti anena krameṇa viśiṣṭaḥ vākya arthaḥ kevala anāntu padānām sāmānya arthāt pracyutānām viśeṣān abhidhānāt ānarthakyam āha ca pṛthak niviṣṭa tattvānām pṛthak artha abhipātinām indriyāṇām yathā kāryam ṛte dehāt na labhyate tathā eva sarva śabdānām pṛthak artha abhidhāyinām vākyebhyaḥ pravibhaktānām arthavat tā na labhyate iti

evam sati kutas ayam niścaya pratilambhaḥ yad duḥkha śabdaḥ ayam amaṅgala arthaḥ yāvatā sandihyate eva ayam kim sva artha pratipatti artham upāttaḥ atha heya tvāya iti vākyasya tu maṅgala artha tvam duḥkha prahāṇa artham upādānāt yat hi duḥkha prahāṇa artham vākyam upādīyate tad maṅgala artham dṛṣṭam tat yathā vyādhi apagamaḥ syāt alakṣmīḥ mā bhūt iti duḥkha prahāṇa artham ca idam vākyam upāttam tasmāt maṅgala artham idam tatra yat uktam duḥkha śabdā vacanam ādau amaṅgala artha tvāt iti etat ayuktam

āha traya grahaṇa ānarthakyam guṇa eka tvāt duḥkham rajaḥ iti pratipannaḥ bhavān tat ca ekam śāstre paṭhyate tasmāt traya grahaṇam anarthakam iti nimitta bhedāt bheda upacāraḥ iti ced syāt matam yadi api ekam duḥkham tathā api nimittānām adhyātma adhibhūta adhidaiva lakṣaṇānām bhedāt asya bheda upacāraḥ kariṣyate iti tat ca na evam kasmāt

nimitta ānantyena guṇa ānantya prasaṅgāt ādhyātmikam hi dvividham śārīram mānasam ca śārīram tāvat vāta pitta śleṣmaṇām vaiṣamya nimittam tathā mānasam kāma krodha lobha moha viṣāda bhaya īrṣyā asūyā rati aviśeṣa darśana nimittam ādhibhautikam ca manuṣya paśu mṛga pakṣi sarīsṛpa sthāvara nimittam ādhidaivikam śīta uṣṇa vāta varṣa aśanyavaśyāya āveśa nimittam tatra nimitta bhedāt tritva pragijñasya guṇa ānantya prasaṅgaḥ sa ca na iṣṭaḥ tasmāt na nimitta bhedāt tri tvam

ucyate yat uktam rajasaḥ eka tvāt tritva anupapattiḥ tasya nimitta bhedāt tritva upacāraḥ iti satyam etat yat tu uktam nimitta ān antyena guṇa ānantya prasaṅgaḥ iti tat ayuktam kasmāt bhede api sati varṇa saṃkhyā vat dvi avasthāna upapatteḥ tat yathā catvāraḥ varṇāḥ iti asyāḥ saṃkhyāyāḥ sati paippalādādi bhede teṣām brāhmaṇa tva ādi vyatireka abhāvāt na saṃkhyā antara hetu tvam no khalu api varṇa avyatirekāt eka tvam bhavati evam trīṇi duḥkhāni iti asyāḥ saṃkhyāyāḥ sati śarīra ādi bhede teṣām ādhyātmika ādi vyatireka asambhavāt na saṅkhyā antara hetu tvam no khalu api duḥkha avyatirekāt eka tvam bhavitum arhati kiñca anyat nimitta bhedāt bheda upacāraḥ iti bhavān eva pratipannaḥ na ca upacāraḥ parama arthaḥ iti alam asthāne yatnena

āha abhighātāt jijñāsāyām ati prasaṅgaḥ sarveṣām sambhavāt yathā sureḥ duḥkha traya abhighātāt jijñāsā bhavati iti etat iṣṭam tena sarveṣām abhighātaḥ asti iti sarveṣām jijñāsā prasaṅgaḥ atha matam duḥkha abhighāte kasyacid jijñāsā bhavati kasyacid na iti nanu evam icchā mātram prāc prasaṅgāt ca prāk api āsureḥ jijñāsāyāḥ duḥkha traya abhighātaḥ na ca asya ātyantike hetau jijñāsā babhūva tena kim prāptam paścāt asya yatas babhūva tat vaktavyam yathā anyatra brahmaṇaḥ abhyāsa nimittāt adharma kṣayāt pūrva dharma anugrahāt ca vividiṣā tathā anyeṣām kuśala mūla abhyāsa paripākāt na ca apadiṣṭam atas laghu uktam etat kiñca anyat tad apaghātāt ca anirmokṣaḥ akṛtsna tvāt mokṣaḥ hi kāmarūpārūpya dhātu traya āt iṣyate daiva mānuṣya tiryagyoni trayāt vā eka deśaḥ ca saṃsārasya duḥkha trayam tasmāt prayojanam api ayuktam

kiñca nimitta antara sadbhāvāt divya kāma dhyāna sukha anapekṣasya api vividiṣā sambhavati na kevalam tāpa udvignasya api tasmāt nimittam api ayuktam kiñca anyat ubhayathā ca asambhavāt parikalpyamānā khalu api iyam jijñāsā puruṣasya vā syāt guṇānām vā kiṃca atas tat na tāvat puruṣasya sambhavati kasmāt nairguṇya abhyupagamāt icchā dveṣa prayatna sukha duḥkha dharma adharma jñāna saṃskārāṇām ātma guṇa tvam na bhavadbhiḥ abhyupagamyate na guṇānām ācetanyāt na hi acetanā ghaṭa ādayaḥ hita ahita prāpti parihāram jijñāsamānā dṛśyate na ca cetanā bhavatām guṇāḥ sāmānyam acetanam prasava dharmi pradhānam iti vakṣyamāṇa vacanāt kiṃca anyat tattva antara anupapatteḥ na ca guṇa puruṣa vyatiriktam vastutas tattva antaram asti yasya jijñāsā parikalpyamānā parikalpyeta tasmāt anupapannā jijñāsā

ucyate yat uktam abhighātāt jijñāsāyām ati prasaṅgaḥ sarveṣām tad sambhavāt iti atra brūmaḥ na abhighāta tvena apratipatteḥ yadi api aviśiṣṭaḥ abhighātaḥ tathā api sarve na enam abhighāta tvena pratipadyante tathā hi satsu ādhyātmika ādi duḥkheṣu arjana rakṣaṇa kṣaya saṃga hiṃsāsu ca prīti abhiṣvaṅgāt eṣām na viṣayeṣu udvega apadveṣau na ca viṣaya parityāgaḥ bhavati tasmāt na aviśiṣṭaḥ abhighātaḥ viśeṣe abhighāta buddheḥ nimitta abhidhānam iti ced atha api syādya iyam asati viśeṣe sarva prāṇabhṛtām āsureḥ eva bhagavataḥ duḥkha traya abhighāta buddhiḥ bhavati na punar anyeṣām iti atra nimittam abhidhānīyam na hi antareṇa nimittam asau viśeṣaḥ avasthāpayitum śakyate iti etat ca ayuktam kasmāt praśnāsambandhāt

kutas jijñāsā bhavati iti evam ca udakena pūrvam akāri praśnaḥ tasyāḥ ca sākṣāt kāraṇam abhighātaḥ kāraṇa antarāṇām anabhidhāna ādityasya eva nirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ yat tu khalu idānīm kāraṇa kāraṇam api pṛcchyate tad anavasthā prasaṅga bhayāt na ucyate atha nirbandhaḥ kriyate tena pūrava dharma anugrahasya kuśala mūla abhyāsa paripākasya kāraṇa kāraṇa tvam asmābhiḥ na pratiṣidhyate iti tat eva kim na gṛhyate etena prāc prasaṅgaḥ pratyuktaḥ yat tu uktam tad abhighāte ca anirmokṣaḥ akṛtsna tvāt iti etat api ayuktam kasmāt śāstra artha an avabodhāt aṣṭa vikalpaḥ daivaḥ tairyagyoniḥ ca pañcadhā bhavati mānuṣyaḥ ca ekavidhaḥ iti etāvān asmākam saṃsāraḥ na tu tad vyatiriktāḥ kāmarūpa ārūpya dhātavaḥ kvacid api siddhāḥ caturdaśavidhe ca saṃsāre yā sukha mātrā sā duḥkha bhūyaḥ tvāt tad śabda vācyā bhavati iti tathā ca uktam

atra janma jarā maraṇa kṛtam duḥkham prāpnoti cetanaḥ puruṣaḥ liṅgasya avinivṛtteḥ tasmāt duḥkham samāsena dṛśyate ca loke bhūyasā grahaṇam tat yathā āmravanam iti tasmāt kṛtsna vikalpa pratiṣedhaḥ ayam yat punar etat uktam divya kāma dhyāna sukha anapekṣasya api vividiṣā sambhavāt nimittam ayuktam iti tat api anupapannam kasmāt uttaratra pratiṣedhāt iṣṭam eva etat saṅgṛhītam tathā ca uttara sūtreṇa pratiṣetsyati ācāryaḥ dṛṣṭa vat ānuśravikaḥ sa hi aviśuddhi kṣaya atiśaya yuktaḥ tasmāt divya sukha anapekṣasya api yuktā vividiṣā dhyāna sukham api kṣaya atiśayau na ativartate tat api atra eva saṅgṛhītam tasmāt pratiṣedhya eva ayam pakṣaḥ iti na kiñcid abhidhīyate yat api uktam ubhayathā sambhavāt jijñāsā anupapattiḥ iti astu guṇānām jijñāsā yat tu uktam ācetanyāt asambhavaḥ iti satya acetanye buddheḥ icchā ādi sadbhāvam uttaratra pratipādayiṣyāmaḥ tasmāt upapannā jijñāsā

āha tat śabda ānarthakyam pratipada sambandhāt yaḥ ayam ācāryeṇa tad śabdaḥ sūtre paṭhitaḥ asya khalu pratipadam asambandhāt su alpām api arthavat tām na upalabhāmahe tasmāt ainam apuṣkala artham adhyeṣyāmahe iti ucyate katham hi nāma prayoktṛ pāratantryāt śabdasya śabda antareṇa sambandhaḥ na syāt iti

āha na brūmaḥ avidyamāna sambandhaḥ asambandhaḥ kintarhi ayukta sambandhaḥ yaḥ sa khalu asambandhaḥ tat yathā anācāraḥ māṇavakaḥ iti dravyeṇa kriyā śakti tvāt na śakyam kiñcid anācāravatā kṣaṇam api avasthātum ayuktam tvācaran anācāraḥ iti ucyate tathā ca asya tad śabdasya pratipadam sambandhaḥ na yuktaḥ tasmāt anarthakaḥ tad śabdaḥ

ānantaryāt jijñāsā śabdasya iti ced syāt matam anantarasya vidhiḥ vā bhavati pratiṣedhaḥ vā iti anayā yuktyā jijñāsā śabdasya tad śabdena abhisambandhaḥ śakyaḥ iti tat ca na evam kasmāt tad apaghāte prayojana asadbhāvāt na hi jijñāsā apaghāte kiñcid prayojanam asti iti sati api sambandhe na tad śabdena arthaḥ

abhighātasya iti ced atha api syāt yadi jijñāsā apaghātena kiṃcid prayojanam asti iti atas tad sambandhaḥ na iṣyate tena tarhi abhighāta śabdena asya abhisambandhaḥ kariṣyate tathā ca api tat śabda urthavān bhaviṣyati iti etad anupapannam kasmāt nimitta avasthāne punar punar utpatteḥ naimittikaḥ ayam abhighātaḥ tasya nimittavat tvāt ātyantikaḥ apaghātaḥ na syāt itarathā jvara nimittakaḥ dāhaḥ iva śīta dravya saṃsparśāt praśāntaḥ api nimitta avasthānāt punar punar pravartate iti aphala tvam asya vyāyāmasya traya śabdasya iti ced na pāratantryāt āśraya paratantrā hi saṃkhyā tasyāḥ na antareṇa āśrayeṇa upaghātam apaghātaḥ śakyaḥ kartum ānarthakyañca samānam iti sutarām tad śabdena na arthaḥ

duḥkha śabdasya iti ced sāmānyam yadi eteṣām padānām abhisambandhe yathā ukta doṣa upapattiḥ duḥkha śabdam tarhi tad śabdena abhisaṃbhantsyāmaḥ tasmin eṣa niṣedhaḥ viśati iti tat ca na evam kasmāt aneka pada vyavadhānāt katham anantara vṛttinā sarva nāmnā aneka pada vyavahitasya duḥkha śabdasya abhisambandhaḥ śakyet pratipādayitum tasmāt na kiñcid etat kiñca anyat upasarjana tvāt ayam khalu api duḥkha śabdaḥ samāse upasarjanībhūtaḥ na ca ekasmin kāle śabdasya pradhāna tvam upasarjana tvam ca yuktitaḥ sambhavati pradhānasya ca pada antareṇa abhisambandhaḥ tasmāt vivāda āspadam eva etat sūtram kiñca anyat nityānām apaghāta anupapatteḥ iha nityānām apaghātaḥ kartum na śakyate

tat yathā puruṣāṇām anityānāñca apaghātaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ tat yathā jvara ādīnām nityañca duḥkham tasmāt tad apaghāte abhyutthānānarthakyam vṛtti apaghāte tad apaghātaḥ iti ced syāt punar eṣā buddhiḥ satyam nityānām apaghātaḥ na yuktitaḥ sambhavati na tu vayam guṇa lakṣaṇasya duḥkhasya apaghātam brūmaḥ kintarhi vṛttiḥ asya abhibhūyate iti tat ca na evam kasmāt ukta uttara tvāt uktam atra uttaram nimitta avasthāne punar punar utpatteḥ iti tasmāt ayam api amārgaḥ kiñca anyat aviśeṣāt kalpayitvā api vṛtti apaghātam vṛtti vṛttim atoḥ ananya tvāt vṛtti apaghāte vṛttimat apaghātaḥ prāptaḥ iti na asti kaścid viśeṣaḥ tasmāt kṛśaḥ ayam parihāraḥ iti na arthaḥ tad śabdena

ucyate yat uktam tat śabda ānarthakyam pratipadam asambandha ādityaḥ tu duḥkha śabdena abhisambandhaḥ tad sambandhe yathā ukta doṣa upapattiḥ iti ced syāt matam yadi tarhi tad śabdasya duḥkha śabdena eva abhisambandhaḥ abhyupagamyate tena ye asmābhiḥ pūrvam abhihitāḥ doṣāḥ te prasajyante tasmāt pratiṣiddhasya pakṣasya parigrahe sāhasa mātram iti etat ca na evam kasmāt pratividhānāt satyam asati pratividhāne sāhasa mātram syāt pratividhīyate tu tasmāt adoṣaḥ ayam iti kintat iti ced syāt matam ucyata antarhi kintat pratividhānam yasya avaṣṭambhena aneka doṣa vyāhataḥ api ayam pakṣaḥ āśrīyate na hi anuktam asmābhiḥ ākāra mātreṇa śakyam pratipattum iti

ucyate bāḍham yat tāvat uktam aneka pada vyavadhānāt na duḥkha śabdasya tad śabdena abhisambandhaḥ iti atra brūmaḥ na anabhyupagamāt yaḥ hi anantara kṛtam śabdasya śabda antareṇa saha sambandham ācaṣṭe tampratyayam upālambhaḥ syāt vayantu artha kṛtam sambandham ācakṣmahe tathā ca uktam yasya yena abhisambandhaḥ dūra sthasya api tasya saḥ arthataḥ tu asamānām ānantarye api asambhavaḥ kiñca anyat śāstre darśanāt śāstre ca vyavahitānām api sarva nāmnām abhisambandhaḥ dṛśyate yasya guṇasya hi bhāvāt dravye śabda niveśaḥ tad abhidhāne tu atalau iti atra artha kṛtaḥ ca sambandhaḥ śabdānām abhyupagataḥ ṅyāp prātipadikāt bahuṣu bahuvacanam supaḥ dhātu prātipadikayoḥ aluj uttara pade iti evamādīnām sambandha abhyupagamaḥ tathā anaḍvāham udahāriṇi bhagini vahasi yā tvam śirasi kumbham avācīnam abhidhāvantam adrākṣīḥ iti vārtike dṛṣṭāntaḥ na hi atra satya ānantarye śirasā anaḍuhaḥ vahanam kumbhasya vā saraṇam upapadyate yathā ca atra vyavahitānām abhisambandhaḥ tathā iha api draṣṭavyaḥ

yat punar etat uktam upasarjana tvāt pada antareṇa anabhisambandhaḥ iti etad anupapannam kasmāt samāsādapa uddhāre buddhayā vyavasthitasya svātantrya upapatteḥ satyam upasarjanasya pada antareṇa abhisambandhaḥ na upapadyate na tu vayam samāsa vṛtteḥ eva tad śabdena abhisambandhaḥ iti pratipadyāmahe kintarhi samāsādapa uddhṛtasya buddhi vyavasthitasya upajanita svātantryasya śabda antareṇa sambandham icchāmaḥ iti atha etat aniṣṭam yoga pramāṇe ca tad abhāve darśanam syāt atha śabda anuśāsanam keṣām śabdānām iti ca evamādīnām prayogāṇām virodhaḥ prāpnoti aniṣṭañca etat yat punar etat uktam nityānām apaghāta anupapatteḥ vṛtti apaghāte ca tad apaghāta prasaṅgāt iti etat api anupapannam kasmāt guṇa śakteḥ prayojana uparame satya ātma kalpena vyavasthāna abhyupagamāt na etat abhyupagamyate guṇasya ucchittiḥ bhavati vṛttiḥ vā asyā abhibhūyate kintarhi puruṣa artha nibandhanā caritārtha śaktiḥ asya puruṣa artha pravṛttau prayojana asadbhāvāt ātma kalpena vyavatiṣṭhate iti etat vivakṣitam tasmāt yuktam etat tad apaghātake hetau jijñāsā pravartate iti

dṛṣṭe sā apārthā ced syāt etat pratyakṣaḥ duḥka pratīkāra hetuḥ asti tasya samatikrame kim prayojanam tat yathā śārīrasya tāvat ayam apagama hetuḥ aneka dravya rasāyana upabhogaḥ mānasasya api manojña strī pāna vilepana bhojana vastra alaṅkāra ādi viṣaya samprāptiḥ ādhibhautikasya nīti śāstra abhyāsaḥ śastra astra kuśala tā viṣama sthāna an adhyāsanam ca ādhidaivikasya api yathākālam vividha nivasana āstaraṇa garbha gṛha prāsāda jāla antara candana vyajana maṇi hāra ādi sevā vividha auṣadha maṃgala stuti mantra prayoga anuṣṭhānam iti dṛṣṭe hetau sā jijñāsā apārtha iti ced na ekānta atyatataḥ abhāvāt

etat ca na evam kasmāt ekānta atyantataḥ abhāvāt ekāntaḥ nāma niyamena bhāvaḥ atyantam bhūtasya avināśaḥ ekāntaḥ ca atyantam ca te ekānta atyante tayoḥ abhāvaḥ ekānta atyantataḥ abhāvaḥ tasmāt ṣaṣṭhī sthāne pañcamī ṣaṣṭhyā eva vā tasiḥ ṣaṣṭhyā vyāśrayaḥ iti yoga vibhāgāt asamāsa karaṇam vṛtta pūraṇa artham mānasasya ca duḥkhasya pratīkāre doṣa antara upasaṃgraha artham tathā hi strī ādīnām sati etasmin doṣa dvaye aśakya marjjanam kartum asvābhāvika tvāt sati arjane rakṣaṇam aśakyam sādhāraṇa tvāt sati ca rakṣaṇe kṣayaḥ kṛtaka tvāt saṅgāt ca anupaśamaḥ bhūta upaghātam antareṇa ca asambhavaḥ iti ete doṣāḥ āha katham etat avagamyate yat dṛṣṭasya hetoḥ anaikāntika tvam anātyantika tvam ca iti

ucyate pratyakṣaḥ eva etat upalabhyate yat ā āyurveda vihitasya kriyā kramasya abhiyuktam ātmavantam bheṣaja bhiṣaj paricāraka sampannam pratyānarthakyam āha ca sarveṣām vyādhi rūpāṇām nidānam trividham smṛtam āhāraḥ ca vihāraḥ ca karma pūrva kṛtam tathā tatra āhāra vihāra utthān rogān dravyam apohati yaḥ tu karma kṛtaḥ vyādhiḥ maraṇāt sa nivartate punar api āha sa upadravaḥ sarva rūpaḥ bala māṃsa indriya apahaḥ sāriṣṭhaḥ ca eva yaḥ vyādhiḥ tam bhiṣaj parivarjayet iti evam anaikāntika tvam anātyantika tvam tu nivṛttānām api vyādhīnāmpunar utpatti darśanāt mahatā khalu api prayatnena nivartitāḥ vyādhayaḥ punar utpadyante tathā ca uktam punar jvare samutpanne kriyā pūrva jvara anugā iti

tasmāt yathā eva asya āyurveda ādeḥ pratīkāra hetu tvam pratyakṣa siddham evam ekānta atyantataḥ abhāvaḥ api tathā mānasasya ca yathā ca śārīra duḥkha pratīkāra hetavaḥ anaikāntikāḥ tathā strī ādayaḥ api kasmāt tad sannidhāne viṣaya antara abhilāṣa darśanāt yadi hi strī ādayaḥ viṣayāḥ sarvadā duḥkha pratīkāra samarthāḥ bhaveyuḥ kim ati teṣu sannihiteṣu viṣayiṇaḥ viṣaya antara jighṛkṣā syāt evam anaikāntika tvam anātyantika tvam api nivṛtta icchānām api bhūyas prārthanā sambhavāt yadi hi viṣaya upabhogaḥ atyantam eva mānasam duḥkham apahanyāt kim prāptam yena bhūyas tam prati viṣayiṇaḥ abhilāṣaḥ syāt kim kāraṇam yasmāt na hi avidyamāne tamasi devadattasya pradīpam pratyapekṣā bhavati dṛśyate ca nivṛtta icchānām api viṣaya upabhogāt viṣayiṇām bhūyas viṣaya abhilāṣaḥ tena manyāmahe na ayam dṛṣṭaḥ hetuḥ duḥkham ahapanti kintarhi sutarām vṛddhim karoti āha ca na jātu kāmaḥ kāmānām upabhogena śāmyati haviṣā kṛṣṇavartmā iva bhūyas eva abhivardhate

aparaḥ āha saṃvedya tvāt guru tvāt ca nindita tvāt ca sādhubhiḥ sarvatra āsat nidhānāt ca na dṛṣṭaḥ hetuḥ iṣyate saṃvedya tvāt bhoga sādhana vikalānām arthinām madhye viṣayiṇā upayujyamānāḥ taiḥ saṃvedyante teṣām apradāya upayujyamānam nairghṛṇyam āviṣkuryāt viṣayiṇā pradīyamānaḥ vā arthibhyaḥ parimita tvāt avacchidyeta iti anupāyaḥ ayam duḥkha apaghāte buddhimatām kim ca guru tvāt bhogānām vividha nivasana strī pāna bhojana vilepana alaṃkāra ādīnām samagrye sukham utpadyate na anyatara vaikalye sāmagryam ca eṣām svābhāvika tvāt anupapannam āha ca nābhi jātim na vijñānam na ca śauryam apekṣate lakṣmī saṃskāra yogāt ca kvacid eva avatiṣṭhate

iti evam aneka artha āśraya tvāt guruḥ viṣaya upabhogaḥ kim ca nindita tvāt ca sādhubhiḥ ninditaḥ khalu api sādhubhiḥ viṣaya upabhogaḥ yasmāt āha āyāsāḥ ca vighātaḥ ca vipralambha bhayāni ca yat ca anyat aśivam loke tad kāmebhyaḥ pravartate punar api āha ayam sa kṣetriyaḥ vyādhiḥ ayam ātyantikaḥ jvaraḥ idam āspadamītīnām eṣa yoniḥ sa pāpmanām agādham etat pātālam eṣa paṅkaḥ duruttaraḥ kleśa vyādhi bhaya ākīrṇam etat śvabhram bhaya āvaham vividha āyāsa śokānām etat āyatanam mahat dainya śrama viṣādānām etat kṣetram apāvṛtam yasmāt viṣaya sambhogāt vihagaḥ pañjarau iva gataḥ vaneṣu ramate sa sukhāni samaśnute

tasmāt sādhubhiḥ apākṛta tvāt asādhuḥ viṣaya upabhogaḥ kim ca sarvatra asat nidhānāt na hi su pratiniviṣṭasya api kāminaḥ sarvatra viṣaya sannidhānena bhavitavyam no khalu api ekasmin deśe avasthānam sambhavati viṣaya abhāva prasaṅgāt tasmāt avaśyam viyogena bhavitavyam viyoge ca sati dhruvaḥ aniṣṭa anubandhaḥ iti kaḥ arthaḥ viṣaya parigraheṇa tatra yat uktam dṛṣṭasya hetoḥ sadbhāvāt apārthakāḥ jijñāsā iti etat ayuktam

āha yadi ekānta atyantataḥ abhāvāt dṛṣṭe hetau aparitoṣaḥ tena tarhi astyayam anyaḥ hetuḥ ubhaya doṣa varjitaḥ sa kasmāt na parigṛhyate kaḥ asau iti ced ucyate śāstra uktaḥ karma vidhiḥ sa hi aikāntikaḥ katham evam hi āha paśu bandhena sarvān lokān jayati na tu uktam kadācid jayati kadācid na iti phalasya pratyakṣa anupalabdheḥ anaikāntika tvam iti ced syāt matam pratyakṣatas eva idam vihitasya karmaṇaḥ phalam na upalabhyate tathā hi putra kāmaḥ iṣṭim nirūpya duhitaram api na prāpnoti artha kāmaḥ ca karma kṛtvā māṣakam api na labhate tasmāt na ayam anaikāntikaḥ iti etat ca na evam kasmāt sādhana vaikalyāt tad anupapatteḥ aneka sādhana sādhyaḥ hi karma vidhiḥ yatra phalam na upalabhyate tatra sādhana vaikalyam anumātavyam kasmāt na hi etat iṣṭam sati kāraṇe kāryam na bhavati kim ca anyat saṃsāra abhāva prasaṅgāt yadi khalu api karmaṇaḥ phalavat tvam na iṣyate tena tad nimittasya saṃsāsarasya abhāva prasaṅgaḥ aniṣṭam ca etat tasmāt siddham asya aikāntika tvam

ātyantika tvam api siddham eva yasmāt āha apāma somam amṛtā abhūma iti atra soma pānāt amṛta tva avāptiḥ śrūyate tasmāt tat eva anuṣṭhātavyam kim anyena hetunā parikalpitena iti jijñāsā apārtha eva iti ucyate dṛṣṭa vat ānuśravikaḥ anuśrūyate iti anuśravaḥ anuśrave bhavaḥ ānuśravikaḥ dṛṣṭena tulyam vartate dṛṣṭa vat kim asau anabhipretaḥ iti vākya śeṣaḥ

āha kaḥ punar ayam anuśravaḥ ucyate mantra brāhmaṇam yāvat vā purātanam anuśrūyamāṇam prāmāṇyena abhyupagamyate tatrabhavadbhiḥ yathā śruti nibandhanāḥ smṛtayaḥ aṅgāni vedāḥ tarkā vā yathā āha veda vedāṅga tarkeṣu veda saṃjñā nirucyate iti āha kim pūrvasmāt eva hetoḥ ayam ānuśravikaḥ hetuḥ anabhipretaḥ iti

na iti ucyate kintarhi sa hi aviśuddhi kṣaya atiśaya yuktaḥ iti saḥ iti ānuśravikasya hetoḥ pratinirdeśaḥ hi śabdaḥ yasmāt arthe aviśuddhiḥ ca kṣayaḥ ca atiśayaḥ ca taiḥ yuktaḥ etat uktam bhavati yasmāt ayam ānuśravikaḥ hetuḥ aviśuddhaḥ anityaḥ tāratamyavān ca atas dṛṣṭaḥ iva anabhipretaḥ tatra aviśuddhi yuktaḥ tāvat hiṃsā vidhānāt yat āha brāhmaṇe brāhmaṇam ālabheta ityādi tathā ṣaṣ śatāni niyujyante paśūnām madhyame ahani aśvamedhasya vacanāt ūnāni paśubhiḥ tribhiḥ

iti hiṃsā ca aviśuddhiḥ prāṇinām iṣṭa śarīra vyāpādanāt āha tad anupapattiḥ śāstra codita tvāt yadi śāstreṇa coditā iyam hiṃsā na syāt mukta saṃśayam aviśuddhi tvam asyāḥ pratipadyāmahe śāsra coditā tu tasmāt na iyam aviśuddhiḥ tad prāmāṇya anabhyupagamāt aviśuddhiḥ iti ced syāt matam veda prāmāṇyam abhyupagacchatām asaṃśayam etat evam syāt hetu vāda kuśalāḥ tu vayam tasmāt adhīyatām yadi kaścid asti ubhaya pakṣa prasiddhaḥ hetuḥ yatas nissaṃśayaḥ pratyayaḥ syāt iti etat ca ayuktam kasmāt abhyupagama virodhāt dṛṣṭam anumānam āpta vacanam ca iti prāmāṇya trayam abhyupagatam bhavadbhiḥ idānīm vedasya āpta vacana tve satya prāmāṇyam bruvataḥ sva mata vyāghātaḥ tasmāt ayuktam etat

vedasya āpta vacana tva anupapatteḥ adoṣaḥ iti ced syāt matam āpta vacana tvam prāc prasādhya asya vedasya paścāt ayam upālambhaḥ yuktam abhidhātum syāt tattva siddham tasmāt anupālambhaḥ ayam iti etat api uktam kasmāt puruṣa buddhi pūrvaka tve sati rāga ādi yogāt śabdaḥ vicāra arhaḥ syāt kim āpta vacanam na vā iti apuruṣa buddhi pūrvakaḥ tu āmnāyaḥ svatantraḥ puruṣa niśśreyasa artham pravartate tasmāt na evaṃvidham aniṣṭam vicāram arhati kim ca anyat aviśuddhi tva anupapatti prasaṅgāt yadi ca etasmin arthe bhavān api paryanupayujyeta katham idam niścīyate yat uta prāṇinām iṣṭa śarīra vyāpāda nāda viśuddhi hiṃsā iti avaśyam abhidhānīyam śāstrate iti tat eva ca śāstram kratau hiṃsām āha tasmāt kaḥ atra hetuḥ anyatra pramāṇam iha eva etat apramāṇam bhavitum arhati hiṃsātaḥ dharmaḥ iti

anugraha upaghāta lakṣaṇa tvāt ahiṃsā hiṃsayoḥ pratyakṣa siddhiḥ iti ced atha api syāt ahiṃsātaḥ ca anugrahaḥ bhavati iṣṭa śarīra vyāpādana lakṣaṇaḥ hiṃsātaḥ ca upaghātaḥ bhavati abhipreta śarīra vyāpādana lakṣaṇaḥ kriyā anurūpam ca phalam anumātum yuktam iti pratyakṣa siddham anayoḥ iṣṭa aniṣṭa phala hetu tvam tasmāt kaḥ atra śāstra vyāpāraḥ iti etat ca anupapannam kasmāt aniṣṭa prasaṃgāt evam hi parikalpyamāne guru bhāryā gamane api sattva antara anugraha sāmartha ādiṣṭa phala sambandhaḥ syāt māṇavakam ca upanīya vrata ādeśa śauca brahmacaryya svādhyāya abhyāsa bhaikṣa agni paricaraṇa guru śuśrūṣā ādiṣu pravartayataḥ aniṣṭa phala sambandhaḥ syāt tasmāt loka śāstra viruddhaḥ asat tarkaḥ na iṣṭaḥ iti

ubhaya abhidhānāt śāstra virodha prasaṅgaḥ iti ced syāt matam tat eva śāstram ahiṃsām āha tat eva hiṃsām evam sati paraspara viruddhayoḥ arthayoḥ ca udita tvāt ubhaya anugrahā sambhave śāstra virodha prasaṅgaḥ iti tat ca na evam kasmāt utsarga apavādayoḥ viṣaya bhedāt sāmānye hi śāstram ahiṃsām utsṛjya viśeṣe kratu lakṣaṇe apavādam śāsti sāmānya vihitam ca viśeṣa vihitena bādhyate tat yathā dadhi brāhmaṇa ibhaḥ dīyatām takram kauṇḍinyāya iti tasmāt utsarga apavādayoḥ viṣaya bhedāt na asti śāstra virodhaḥ iti kim ca anyat kanyā gamana vat punar vidhāne doṣa abhāvāt yathā khalu api śāsre pratiṣiddham kanyā gamanam iti na idānīm abhirūpaḥ pratigṛhya tām abhigamya adharma bhāj bhavati

gṛhasthaḥ sadṛśīm bhāryām vindeta ananya pūrvikām iti śāstra antara sadbhāvāt evam śāstre pratiṣiddhā hiṃsā na idānīm kratau hiṃsāyām pravartamānaḥ aniṣṭa phala bhāj syāt pūrva uktāt eva śāstra antara sadbhāvāt tara yat uktam prāṇinām iṣṭa śarīra vyāpāda nāda viśuddhiḥ hiṃsā iti etat ayuktam ucyate na abhiprāyānavabodhāt citram api bahu etat abhidhīyamānaḥ na abhi prāyam veda bhavān kim kāraṇam yasmāt na vayam vedasya prāmāṇyam pratyācakṣmahe no khalu api brūmaḥ śāstra coditāyām hiṃsāyām pravartamānasya aniṣṭa phala sambandhaḥ bhavati kintarhi sati svarga prāpti nimitta tve veda vihitasya karmaṇaḥ samanuṣṭhānam prāṇi jam upaghātam antareṇa na sambhavati iti hita kāmaiḥ abhyupekṣyate yasmāt na hi etat uktam yat anyeṣām upaghātena ātma anugrahaḥ kāryaḥ iti āha na tad parasya sandadhyāt pratikūlam yadātmanaḥ eṣa saṅkṣepataḥ dharmaḥ kāmāt anyaḥ pravartate

āha yadi etat na abhyupagamyate katham pūrvam uktam prāṇinām iṣṭa śarīra vyāpāda nāda viśuddhiḥ hiṃsā iti ucyate kārye kāraṇa upacārāt yaḥ asau hiṃsā nimittakaḥ kāruṇyāt manasi naḥ paritāpaḥ utpadyate sā khalu aviśuddhiḥ abhipretā tasyām kāraṇam upacarya uktam aviśuddhiḥ hiṃsā iti yathā mudgaiḥ tṛptāḥ gobhiḥ sukhinaḥ iti

āha katham etat avagamyate hiṃsā kāryam paritāpa mātram aviśuddhiḥ ācāryasya abhipretā na punar hiṃsā eva iti ucyate prakarṣa pratyaya upalabdheḥ vakṣyati upadiṣṭāt tad viparītaḥ śreyān iti samāna jātīyam ca pratiyoginam apekṣya prakarṣa pratyayaḥ utpadyate yadi ca ānuśravikasya praśasyatā na abhi pretā syāt prakarṣa pratyaya anupapatti prasaṅgaḥ tasmāt na utsūtram etat

āha sannyāsa anupapattiḥ aviyoga śravaṇāt na hi karmaṇaḥ atyāga sannyāsayoḥ tvam īśiṣe kintarhi śāstram yat āha tat avaśyam kartavyam tat ca amaraṇāt karmabhiḥ aviyogam śāsti kasmāt evam hi āha jarā maryam etat satram yat agnihotra dārśa paurṇamāsau jarayā ha etasmāt satrāt vimucyate mṛtyunā ca punar api āha kurvan eva iha karmāṇi jijīviṣet śatam samāḥ tasmāt āmaraṇāt karmaṇā ām atyāgaḥ tasmin sati hetu antara karmaṇām ānarthakyam ucyate na sādhanānām asvabhāvika tvāt patnī saṃyoga ādibhiḥ anekaiḥ sādhanaiḥ ayam karma vidhiḥ prasādhyate teṣām ca asvābhāvika tvāt aśakyam arjanam prayogataḥ pūrvam kartum iti pratipāditam tasmāt anityāni karmāṇi

hetu śāstra vipratipattau śāstra balīyaḥ tvam iti ced syāt matam yatra hetu śāstrayoḥ vipratipattiḥ bhavati tatra vipralambha bhūyiṣṭha tvāt anumānasya balīyaḥ śāstram iti avaśayam abhyupagantavyam iti tat ca anupapannam kasmāt śaktitas viniyogāt śaktim apekṣya śāstram agnihotra ādīni karmāṇi vidadhat teṣām anitya tām jñāpayati katham evam hi āha yaḥ alam san agni hotrāya agnihotram na juhoti tam eṣā devatā paruṇaddhi asmāt lokāt amuṣmāt ca ubhābhyām tasmāt anityāni karmāṇi kim ca anyat jarā grahaṇa sāmarthyāt tvadīyaḥ eva jñāpake jarā grahaṇam asti atas anumīyate śakti apekṣam anityam ca karma kim ca anyat śāstra hāneḥ ubhayam hi śāstre nirdiṣṭam karmāṇi sannyāsaḥ ca yadi punar karmāṇi nityakartavyatayā īṣi ante tena sannyāsa śāstram hīyate tasmāt viṣaya rāga āviṣkaraṇam etat vaḥ

āha na śruti balīyaḥ tvāt tulya balayoḥ hi śāstrayoḥ eka viṣaya sannipāte dvayoḥ yugapad anugrahā sambhave vikalpa paryāyau bhavataḥ śruti smṛti sannipāte ca śrutiḥ balīyasī smṛti vihitaḥ ca sannyāsaḥ tasmāt na anayoḥ vikalpaḥ na khalu api paryāyaḥ nyāyyaḥ ucyate tat itaratra tulyam yathā eva karmaṇām samanuṣṭhānam śāsti śāstram tathā sannyāsam api katham evam hi āha na karmaṇā na prajayā dhanena tyāgena ekena amṛta tva mānaśuḥ pareṇa nākam nihitam guhāyām vibhrājate yat yatayaḥ viśanti na karmaṇā mṛtyum ṛṣayaḥ niṣeddhuḥ prajāvantaḥ draviṇam icchamāṇāḥ atha apare ṛṣayaḥ manīṣiṇaḥ param karmabhyaḥ amṛta tva mānaśuḥ

brāhmaṇam ca atra bhavati tat yaḥ idam viduḥ ye ca ime araṇyāḥ śraddhā ātapaḥ iti upāsate te arciṣam abhisambhavanti arciṣaḥ harahnaḥ āpūryamāṇa pakṣam āpūryamāṇa pakṣāt yan ṣaṣ udaḍḍa iti māsān tān māsebhyaḥ saṃvatsaram saṃvatsarāt ādityam ādityāt candramasam candramasaḥ vidyutam tatpuruṣaḥ amāṇavaḥ saḥ etān brahma gamayati punar api āha etam eva viditvā muniḥ bhavati etam eva pravrājinaḥ lokam icchantaḥ pravrajanti etat ha sma vai pūrve vidvāṃsaḥ prajām na akāmayanta prajayā kim kariṣyāmaḥ yeṣām na ayam ātmā na ayam lokaḥ iti te ha sma putra eṣaṇāyāḥ ca vitta eṣaṇāyāḥ ca loka eṣaṇāyāḥ ca vyutthāya atha bhikṣā caryam caranti iti tasmāt ete tyāga sannyāsayoḥ ubhayoḥ liṅgam

āha yadi api evam śāstram tathā api samanuṣṭhāne vidhiḥ asti vihitam ca avaśyam kartavyam sannyāse tu artha vāda mātram iti anayoḥ ayam viśeṣaḥ tasmin sati samanuṣṭhānam jyāyaḥ na tyāgaḥ ucyate kaḥ ayam vidhiḥ kaḥ ayam artha vādaḥ āha vidhiḥ tad artha tvena apūrva upadeśaḥ yaḥ hi vidhi arthena liṅā loṭā kṛtyaiḥ vā apūrva upadeśaḥ kriyate sa vidhiḥ yathā agnihotram juhuyāt svarga kāmaḥ vāyavyam śvetam ajam ālabheta bhūti kāmaḥ iti stutiḥ artha vādaḥ tasya tu vihitasya prarocana artham yā stutiḥ saḥ artha vādaḥ tat yathā vāyuḥ vai kṣepiṣṭhā devatāḥ vāyum eva tena bhāgadheyena upadhāvati saḥ eva enam bhūtim gamayati iti evaṃvidhām hi stutim upaśrutya phala arthine hi yajamānāya vidhiḥ prarocate etasmin hita kāmaḥ pravartate iti

ucyate na atas eva sannyāsa siddhiḥ evam ced manyase yama āmnāyaḥ śreyāṃsam artham manyate tam prarocanāya stauti tathā sannyāsa siddhiḥ kasmāt stuta tvāt bahula arthinām sannyāsam āmnāyaḥ stauti sa kasmāt na prarocate itarathāḥ hi ānarthakyam yadi khalu api artha vādaḥ stuvan api na prarocayet yat uktam prarocana arthaḥ artha vādaḥ iti tat bhavadbhiḥ hāpitavyam syāt anarthakaḥ hi evam satyartha vādaḥ na prarocana arthaḥ artha antara vacanam vā yadi prarocana artha tvam asya na iṣyate tena tarhi artha antaram vaktavyam mā bhūt anarthaka tvam veda eka deśasya iti tasmāt na anayā vibhīṣikayā vayam śakyāḥ sat mārgāt apanetum kiṃca anyat ubhayathā vikalpe aniṣṭa prasaṅgāt iha ayam āmnāyaḥ vidheya tvena vā sannyāsam stūyāt avidheya tvena vā kiṃca atas tat yadi tāvat vidheya tvena stauti kim anyat vicāryate siddhaḥ sannyāsaḥ atha vidheya tvena stutau asya prayojanam kartavyam yat hi kartavya tayā na iṣṭam tad apuruṣa buddhi pūrvakaḥ svatantraḥ puruṣa niśśreyasa artham pravartamānaḥ āmnāyaḥ kim iti prarocayeta

tasmāt etām api kalpanām kṛtvā kṛśam eva etat athavā ubhathāḥ vikalpaḥ iti asya ayam anyaḥ arthaḥ iha ayam āmnāyaḥ bhūta arthena vā sannyāsam prarocayet abhūta arthena vā kim ca atas tat yadi tāvat bhūtārthena prarocayati tathā sati amṛta tva prāpakasya sannyāsasya aparigrahe viṣaya ārāgāt anyaḥ hetuḥ vaktavyaḥ atha abhūta arthena puruṣaḥ niḥśreyasāt hīyate kasmāt na hi etat yuktam yat aśreyasi mārge pramāṇa bhūtaḥ āmnāyaḥ mātṛmodaka nyāyena īhita arthinaḥ prāṇinaḥ pratārayet tasmāt ayuktam etat kiñca anyat anekāntāt naca ayam ekāntaḥ yat vihitam eva kartavyam tathā ca śābarāḥ paṭhanti grāma gamanam bhavataḥ śobhanam iti atra antareṇa vidhim stutiḥ eva devadattam grāma gamanāya prarocayati iti kiñca anyat āśaṅkā prasaṅgāt yadi khalu api kiñcid satyam kiñcid anṛtam brūyāt vedaḥ tathā sati pauruṣeya vākyavat veda vākye api āśaṃkā prasajyeta tathā ca sati yat uktam eva prasaṃgaḥ aniṣṭam ca etat

kim ca vidhi anumānam vā tat evam eka deśa bhūta tvāt athavā vidhi eka deśaḥ artha vādaḥ iti atisṛṣṭam bhavatā tatra sannyāse artha vādam upalabhya vidhiḥ api asti iti anumātavyam anupalambhāt adoṣaḥ iti ced syāt ca evam yadi asau vidhiḥ upalabhyate tasmāt anupalambha āt ayam doṣān nivartiṣyate iti etat ca anupapannam kasmāt aneka bheda tvāt upalabdhau yatnaḥ kriyatām aneka bhedaḥ hi prativedam āmnāyaḥ tatra yat uktam vidhi sadbhāvāt kriyā prādhānyam iti etat api ayuktam itikarta vya tā anupadeśāt sannyāsa anupapattiḥ iti ced atha api syāt yadi sannyāsam api āmnāyaḥ vidheyam manyeta tena yathā gārhasthyasya itikartavyatām bhāryā udvahana ādikām mantravat upadiśati tathā sannyāsam api upadiśet na tu upadiṣṭavān tasmāt na asti sannyāsaḥ iti etat api ayuktam kasmāt abhāvāt itikartavya tānām hi sarvāsām abhāvaḥ sannyāsaḥ tatra kim śāstram upadekṣyati yāvatī khalu iti kartavya tā sannyāsa aṅgam tām upadiśati śāstram katham

evam hi āha tapaḥ śraddhe ye hi upavasanti araṇye śāntāḥ vidvāṃsaḥ bhaikṣa caryā carantaḥ sūrya dvāreṇa te virajasaḥ prayānti yatra amṛtaḥ sa puruṣaḥ avyaya ātmā tatra tapaḥ śraddhe ye hi apavasanti iti enam śraddhayā upetam yama niyama lakṣaṇam dharmam āha araṇyaḥ iti gṛhebhyaḥ vinissṛtim śāntāḥ iti indriyāṇām antaḥkaraṇasya ca viṣaya abhilāṣāt vi nivartanam vidvāṃsaḥ iti pūrva rātra apararātra ādiṣu kāleṣu anirviṇṇasya yoginaḥ jñāna abhyāsam bhaikṣa caryām carantaḥ iti śarīra sthiti nimittam parimitam abhyavahāra niyogam uttara ardhena ca phalam ācaṣṭe tat nibandhanaḥ ca vistaraḥ sanyāsa itikartavyatāyām manu ādibhiḥ abhihitaḥ śruti nirvacanāḥ ca smṛtayaḥ bhavatām pramāṇam iti pakṣaḥ tatra yat ukta miti kartavya tā anupadeśāt na asti sannyāsaḥ iti eda yuktam evam ca nityāni karmāṇi yat tu anena etat uktam ānuśravikaḥ hetuḥ anaikāntikaḥ iti satyam etat avaśyam hi karmaṇaḥ phalam abhyupagantavyam itarathāḥ hi tad nimittasya saṃsārasya abhāvāt aniṣṭa prasaṅgaḥ tasmāt aniṣṭām eva etat ācāryasya

āha katham etat anumātavyam iti ucyate kṣaya grahaṇa sāmarthyāt yadi pūrva sūtra uktam iha anuvartate kṣaya grahaṇam anarthakam syāt kasmāt atyanta abhāva paryāyaḥ hi kṣayaḥ iti kṛtvā evam siddhaḥ aviśuddhi yogaḥ āha kṣaya yogaḥ idānīm katham anumātavyaḥ iti ucyate kṣaya yogaḥ aṅga parimāṇāt kṣaya yogaḥ punar asya hetoḥ aṅga parimāṇāt veditavyaḥ yāni hi yajeḥ aṅgāni paśu puroḍāśa ādīni tāni parimitāni parimitānām sādhanānām tantu ādīnām parimitam kāryam paṭa ādi dṛṣṭam parimitam kṣaya dharmi dṛṣṭam tadvat eva kiñca anyat saṃsāra upalambhāt dṛśyate ca ayam vāc buddhi svabhāva āhāra vihāra bheda bhinna karma vihāra vaicitrya nimittaḥ saṃsāraḥ yadi punar sākṣāt kṛtam karma akṣaya phalam syāt sa punarāvṛtti abhāvāt prāṇinām na upalabhyeta

śabda sāmarthyāt nitya tvam iti ced syāt etat śabda pramāṇakāḥ vayam yat śabdaḥ āha tat asmākam pramāṇam sa ca asya hetoḥ amṛta tvam āha tarati mṛtyum tarati pāpmānam ityādi tasmāt anicchatā api etat avaśyam abhyupagantavyam anabhyupagame vā pratijñā ahāniḥ vedaḥ pramāṇam iti etat ca na evam kasmāt śabda antareṇa virodhāt anitya tvam asya hetoḥ śabdaḥ anumanyate tasya evam sati virodhaḥ prāpnoti katham evam hi āha atha ye ime grāme iṣṭāpūrte dattam iti upāsate atha etam eva adhvānam punar nivartante yathā etam ākāśam ākāśāt vāyum te dhūmam abhisambhavanti dhūmaḥ bhūtvā abhram bhavati meghaḥ bhūtvā pravarṣati te iha vrīhi yavāḥ oṣadhi vanaspatayaḥ tilāḥ māṣāḥ iti jāyante tatas vai yaḥ annamati yaḥ retaḥ siñcati sa bhūyas eva bhavati iti tatra yat uktam śabda sāmarthyāt nitya tvam iti et ayuktam

ubhayathā abhidhānāt śāstra virodha prasaṅgaḥ iti ced syāt matam tat eva śāstram nitya tvam āha tat eva anitya tvam evam sati paraspara virodhinoḥ arthayoḥ ca udita tvāt ubhaya anugrahā sambhave sati śāstra virodha prasaṅgaḥ iti tat ca na evam kasmāt asambhave satyartha antara klṛpteḥ yatra hi pramāṇa bhūtā śrutiḥ asambhavinam artham codayati tatra artha antaram kalpayati tat yathā saḥ ātmanaḥ vapām udakhidat stenam manaḥ anṛta vādinaḥ vāc iti evamādiṣu evam iha api na asti sambhavaḥ yat ekaḥ arthaḥ nityaḥ ca syāt anityaḥ ca iti tasmāt nitya tva vācakasya śāstra antarasya bhaktyā artha antaram parikalpayiṣyāmaḥ

tat vat itaratrāpi iti ced syāt matam yathā eva bhavatā nitya anityayoḥ ekatra asambhavān nitya tvasya bhaktyā kalpanā kṛtā tathā eva anitya tvasya api kariṣyate iti etat ca ayuktam kasmāt sarva pramāṇa virodha prasaṅgāt vināśe hi bhaktyā kalpyamāne sarva pramāṇa virodhaḥ prasajyeta katham pratyakṣa virodhaḥ tāvat saṃsāra upalambhāt anumāna virodhaḥ aṅga parimāṇe sati aṅginaḥ nitya tva anupapatteḥ śabda virodhaḥ te dhūmam abhisambhavanti iti vacanāt na tu nitya tve bhaktyā kalpyamāne doṣaḥ ayam upadyate tasmāt viṣam etat

āha katham idānīm bhaktyā kalpayitavyam śāstram iti ucyate prakṛṣṭa artha tayā yathā khalu api amṛtam vā mṛtam atijīvaḥ mā te hāsiṣuḥ asavaḥ śarīram iti abhidhīyate na ca prāṇinām atyantāya āsavaḥ jahati kintarhi prakṛṣṭam kālam evam iha api ucyate tarati mṛtyum iti na atyantāya mṛtyum tarati kintarhi prakṛṣṭam kālam upacaryate hi loke prakṛṣṭe nitya śabdaḥ tat yathā nitya prahasitaḥ nitya prajalpitaḥ iti evam siddhaḥ kṣaya yogaḥ

āha atiśaya yogaḥ idānīm asya hetoḥ katham anumātavyaḥ iti ucyate atiśaya yogaḥ kriyā abhyāsāt yatra hi kriyā sakṛt pravartate yatra ca asakṛt āvartate tatra atiśayaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ tat yathā kṛṣi ādiṣu yajñe ca dravya upādāna śakti apekṣā kvacid sakṛt eva pravṛttiḥ kvacid punar punarāvṛttiḥ tasmāt atiśayena bhavitavyam kim ca anyat aṅga atiśayāt iha aṅgānām atiśayāt aṅginaḥ api ghaṭa ādeḥ atiśayaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ asti ca ayam pratiyajñam aṅgānām dakṣiṇa ādīnām atiśayaḥ tasmāt atra api atiśayena bhavitavyam

devatā aṅga bhāva gamanāt kṣaya atiśaya anupapattiḥ iti ced atha api syāt yaḥ hi yajñe dravya mātrasya sādhana bhāvam anumanyate tam prati kṣaya atiśaya doṣa a aparihāryau syātām vayantu dravya samavāyinīm devatām kratau aṅga bhāvam upagacchantīm vidmaḥ tasmāt adoṣaḥ ayam iti tat ca anupapannam kasmāt sādhya tvāt devatānām a parimita tvam sādhyam tad aṅga bhāva gamanāt ca doṣa abhāvaḥ na ca ātma kriyā aṅga tvam udāsīna tvāt iti naḥ siddhāntaḥ tasmāt ayuktam etat upetya vā kratu samanuṣṭhānānarthakya prasaṅgāt

yadi dravya samavāyinīm devatām upalabhya tad aṅga bhāva gamanāt akṣayaḥ niratiśayaḥ ca hetuḥ avāpyate iti iṣṭam vaḥ tena tarhi yat vā tat vā veda uktam karma kṛtvā śakyaḥ avāptum arthaḥ kim prāṇi vināśa hetubhiḥ kratubhiḥ katham na hi kiṃcid karma vidyate yatra śarīrasya aṅga bhāvaḥ na syāt sarva devatā mayam ca śarīram yasmāt āha tasmāt vai vidvān puruṣam idam brahma iti manyate sarvāḥ hi asmin devatāḥ śarīre adhi samāhitāḥ tatra yat uktam devatā aṅga bhāva gamanāt kṣaya atiśaya anupapattiḥ iti etat ayuktam evam ayam hetuḥ tridoṣaḥ tena yaḥ phala viśeṣaḥ abhinirvartyate saḥ api tathājātīyakaḥ iti śakyam anumātum tasmāt na asya jijñāsoḥ atra samādhiḥ

āha yadi na ayam śreyān iti kṛtvā asya jijñāsoḥ na atra samādhiḥ tena tarhi yaḥ śreyān phala viśeṣaḥ saḥ upadeṣṭa vayaḥ iti ucyate tad viparītaḥ śreyān tat iti anena karma vidhi niṣpāditasya svarga prāpti lakṣaṇasya phalasya abhisambandhaḥ tasmāt viparītaḥ śuddhaḥ akṣayaḥ niratiśayaḥ iti arthaḥ kaḥ asau iti ucyate mokṣaḥ śreyān etat uktam bhavati ubhau api etau praśasyau svarga apavargau āmnāya vihita tvāt mokṣaḥ tu praśasyataraḥ kasmāt yathā ukta doṣa anupapatteḥ sa hi avaśyaṃbhāvi tvāt aikāntikaḥ atīndriya tvāt asaṃvedyaḥ sva ātmani avasthi tvāt laghuḥ sarvatra sannihitaḥ ca āmnāya stuta tvāt praśastaḥ sadbhiḥ āsevita tvāt aninditaḥ yama niyama vairāgya jñāna abhyupāya śuddheḥ viśuddhaḥ adravya tvāt akṣayaḥ niratiśayaḥ ca

āha katham punar ayam apavargaḥ prāpyate iti ucyate saṃyoga abhāvāt duḥkham ca pradhānam tathā ca tantra antareṣu api uktam duḥkha hetuḥ kārya karaṇa śaktiḥ iti tena yadā puruṣasya saṃyogaḥ tadā aviśuddhi tvam asya sva śakti viśeṣa yogāt teṣu teṣu jāti antara parivarteṣu dharma ādi nimitta sāmarthyāt āyāsam anubhavati yadā tu pradhāna saṃyogaḥ vinivartate tadā nimitta abhāve naimittikasya api abhāvaḥ iti kṛtvā na punar dvandvāni anubhavati

āha kimarthaḥ punar ayam pradhānasya puruṣeṇa saha saṃyogaḥ ucyate na etat iha abhidhānīyam vakṣyati ayam upariṣṭāt ācāryaḥ puruṣasya darśana arthaḥ kaivalya arthaḥ tathā pradhānasya paṅgu andhavat ubhayoḥ api saṃyogaḥ iti āha viyogaḥ tarhi kasmāt nimittāt bhavati iti ucyate vyakta avyakta jña vijñānāt

vyaktam ca avyaktam ca jñaḥ ca vyakta avyakta jñāḥ teṣām vijñānam vyakta avyakta jña vijñānam tasmāt bahuṣu aniyamāt alpācaḥ api jña śabdasya na pūrva nipātaḥ athavā jñānasya sādhakatamam vyaktam tad pūrvaka tvāt avyakta samadhigamasya iti abhihitam yat vā vyaktam ca avyaktam ca te vyakta avyakte te vijānāti iti vyakta avyakta jñaḥ tad vijñānāt saṃyogaḥ nivartate vakṣyati ca etat dṛṣṭā mayā iti upekṣate ekaḥ dṛṣṭā aham iti uparamati anyāḥ iti

tatra rūpa pravṛtti phala lakṣaṇam vyaktam rūpam punar mahān ahaṃkāraḥ pañca tanmātrāṇi ekādaśa indriyāṇi pañca mahābhūtāni sāmānyatas pravṛttiḥ dvividhā hita kāma prayojanā ca ahita pratiṣedha prayojanā ca viśeṣataḥ paṃca karma yonayaḥ vṛtti ādyāḥ prāṇa ādyāḥ ca pañca vāyavaḥ phalam dvividham dṛṣṭam adṛṣṭam ca tatra dṛṣṭam siddhi tuṣṭi aśakti viparyaya lakṣaṇam adṛṣṭam brahma ādau stamba paryante saṃsāre śarīra pratilambhaḥ iti etat vyaktam eṣām guṇānām sattva rajaḥ tamasāmaṅga aṅgibhāva gamanāt viśeṣa gṛhītiḥ yadā tu aṅga bhāvam agacchantaḥ nirlikhita viśeṣāḥ vyavatiṣṭhante tadā avyaktam iti ucyante cetanā śakti rūpa tvāt citram guṇa vṛttam jānāti iti jñaḥ

eṣām trayāṇām bhedam abhedam ca vijñāya saṃyoga nivṛttim labhate kasmāt saṃyoga nimitta pratidvandvi bhūta tvāt yoga nimittasya iha yadā adarśana nimittaḥ pradhāna puruṣayoḥ saṃyogaḥ tasmāt asya pratidvandvi bhūtena jñānena viyoga hetunā bhavitavyam kaḥ dṛṣṭāntaḥ tamaḥ prakāśa vat yathā tamasā tirohitāni dravyāṇi ghaṭa ādīni na upalabhyante tad pratidvandvi bhūtena tu pradīpena prakaśitānām eṣām upalabdhiḥ bhavati tadvat iha api draṣṭavyam iti siddham jñānāt mokṣaḥ uktam ca vṛkṣa agrāt cyuta pādaḥ yadvat anicchat naraḥ patati eva tadvat guṇa puruṣa jñaḥ anicchan api kevalī bhavati

kim ca anyat āmnāya abhihita tvāt āmnāya nibandhanaḥ hi ayam arthaḥ jñānāt mokṣaḥ iti na yādṛcchikaḥ katham evam hi āha satyam jñānam anantam brahma yaḥ veda nihitam guhāyām parame vyoman saḥ aśnute sarvān kāmān saha brahmaṇā vipaścitā yatas vācaḥ nivartante aprāpya manasā saha ānandam brahmaṇaḥ vidvān na bibheti kutaścana tam eva viditvā amṛta tvam eti na anyaḥ panthāḥ ayanāya vidyate tathā brāhmaṇe api uktam tarati śokam ātma vid brahma vid brahmā eva bhavati iti tasmāt āmnāya prāmāṇyāt api manyāmahe jñānāt mokṣaḥ iti

āha jñāna vācinaḥ amṛta tva nimitta abhyupagamāt mahataḥ āmnāya antarasya ānarthakyam yadi jñāna vācinaḥ āmnāya khaṇḍakāt amṛta tvam avāpyate iti etat abhyupagamyate tena kriyā vācinaḥ mahataḥ āmnāya antarasya ānarthakyam prāptam kim kāraṇam na hi anāyāsena iṣṭa avāptau satyām āyāsa bhūyiṣṭhe karmaṇi pravartamānaḥ kṛtī bhavati iti āha ca akke ced madhu vindeta kim artham parvatam vrajet iṣṭasya arthasya saṃprāptau kaḥ vidvān yatnam ācaret

ucyate yadi punar karmāṇi atyanta kartavyatayā īṣyante jñāna vācinaḥ āmnāyasya katham arthavat tā siddhā bhavati āha samuccaye tu ubhaya arthavat tvam jñāna karmaṇoḥ tu samuccaye abhyupagamyamāne dvayoḥ api āmnāya arthavattā siddhā bhavati vidvān yajeta vidvān yājayet iti vacanāt tathā sarva puruṣāṇām kratau adhikāraḥ aśrotriya ṣaṇḍha śūdra varjam iti nyāyāt tasmāt jñāna karmaṇoḥ samuccayāt iṣṭa prasiddhiḥ

ucyate na pūrva doṣa aparihārāt yadi niyamataḥ viduṣā eva karmāṇi kartavyāni iti abhyupagamyate tena yaḥ pūrva uktaḥ doṣaḥ saṃsāra abhāva prasaṅgaḥ tasya aparihāraḥ kim ca śāstra hāneḥ ca yaḥ ca śāstram iṣṭāpūrte samupāsyate te dhūmam abhisaṃbhavanti iti tat etasyām kalpanāyām hīyate kim ca anyat bhinna phala tvāt iha abhinna phalāni dravyāṇi samuccīyante tat yathā bhujyaṅgāni sūpa ādīni abhinnam teṣām tṛpti lakṣaṇam phalam iti na ca etat jñāna karmaṇoḥ abhinnam phalam svarga apavarga hetu tvāt jñāna sāmarthāt kaivalyam abhinnam phalam iti ced pūrveṇa aviśeṣaḥ yat uktam saṃsāra abhāva prasaṃgaḥ iti tat anapahṛtam eva bhavati kiṃca anyat śrūyamāṇa phala virodhaḥ ca yat ca kriyāyāḥ phalam śrūyate agnihotram juhuyāt svarga kāmaḥ rāṣṭram agniṣṭomena jayati iti tat virudhyate karmaṇaḥ ca śeṣa bhāvaḥ sva artha upasarjana tve satyartha antara niṣpādaka tvāt yathā avahanti iti evamādyāḥ kriyāḥ svam phalam upasarjanīkṛtya tad dvāreṇa yajeḥ upakurvantyaḥ tad śeṣa bhūtāḥ bhavanti evam kriyā api jñāna phala bhūta tvāt tad śeṣa bhūtā syāt

vidhi sadbhāvāt kriyā prādhānyam iti ced na ukta tvāt katham etat na asti vidhi kṛtaḥ viśeṣaḥ upetya vā tatra api tad utpatteḥ asti hi jñānasya api vidhāyakam śāstram katham evam hi āha yaḥ ātma apahata pāpmā vijighatsaḥ vipipāsaḥ vijaraḥ vimṛtyuḥ viśokaḥ sannyasta saṃkalpaḥ saḥ anveṣṭavyaḥ sa jijñāsitavyaḥ sarvān ca kāmān avāpnoti yaḥ ātmānam anuvidya vijānāti iti prajāpateḥ vacanam śrūyate punar api āha dve vidye veditavye parā ca eva aparā ca yā tasmāt vidhi sadbhāvāt kriyā prādhānyam iti sva pakṣa anurāga mātram etat

dṛṣṭa artha tvāt iti eke eke punar ācāryāḥ manyante dṛṣṭam eva jñānasya ajñāna nivṛtti lakṣaṇam phalam tasmāt na śāstreṇa vidhīyate kim kāraṇam dṛṣṭa arthasya hi karmaṇaḥ na śāstram prayojakam svayam eva arthita tvāt tatra pravṛtteḥ bhujya ādi vat teṣām jñāna vidhāyakāni vākyāni tāni upāya guṇa vidhāna artham anuvāda bhūtāni āśrīyante tat yathā dadhnā juhoti payasā juhoti iti

yat tu khalu idam ucyate vidvān yajeta vidvān yājayet śrotriyasya ca karmaṇi adhikāraḥ iti tasya ām ayam arthaḥ adhītya vedam kriyā anupūrvaḥ ca jñātvā karmaṇi pravartitavyam evam ca sati na kaścid doṣaḥ yadi punar niyamataḥ eva ātmavidhām karmaṇi adhikāraḥ tena saṃsāra abhāva prasaṃgaḥ svābhāvika tvāt vijñānasya śāsrasya sarva adhikāra virodhaḥ tasmāt na asti samuccayaḥ jñāna karmaṇoḥ aparaḥ āha satyam na asti anayoḥ samuccayaḥ kintarhi sarva arthā kriyā jñānam pratiṣiddha artham ye hi ṣaṇḍhān dhava badhira ādayaḥ karmaṇaḥ atyantam nirākṛtāḥ teṣām jñānāt āśrama antare amṛta tva avāptiḥ itareṣām tū mūla āśrame karmaṇaḥ eva iti tasya na ayam vādinaḥ parihāraḥ iti

ucyate na sva samaya virodhāt evam bruvāṇasya asya vādinaḥ sva samayaḥ eva virudhyate yat uktam vidvāṃsaḥ prajām na akāmayanta kim prajayā kariṣyāmaḥ atha yat uktam putra eṣaṇāyāḥ ca vitta eṣaṇāyāḥ ca vyutthāya bhaikṣa caryām caranti iti na ca ṣaṇḍānām putra eṣaṇā vyutthānam athavat bhavati deva kṛta tvāt kim ca anyat rahasya bhūta tvāt rahasya bhūtam hi vedānām jñānam yasmāt āha tat ha sma etat āruṇiḥ auddālakiḥ jyeṣṭhāya putrāya provāca idam jyeṣṭha putrāya pitā brahma prabrūyāt praṇāyya antevāsine na anyasmai yasmai kasmaicana yaḥ imāmadbhiḥ parigṛhītām vasunā vasumatīm pūrṇām dadyāt etat eva tatas bhūyaḥ iti
