āha yat uktam prati puruṣa vimokṣa artham ayam ārambhaḥ iti tat ayuktam ācārya vipratipatteḥ prati puruṣam anyat pradhānam śarīra ādi artham karoti teṣām ca māhātmya śarīra pradhānam yadā pravartate tadā itarāṇi api tad nivṛttau ca teṣām api nivṛttiḥ iti paurikaḥ sāṃkhya ācāryaḥ manyate tad katham apratiṣidhya ekā prakṛtiḥ abhyupagamyate iti

ucyate na pramāṇa abhāvāt na tāvat pratyakṣataḥ eva tat śakyam niścetum pradhānānām atīndriya tvāt liṅgam ca asandigdham na asti āptāḥ ca naḥ na abhidadhurataḥ manyāmahe na etat evam iti kiṃca ekena artha parisamāpteḥ aparimita tvāt etat ekam pradhāna malam sarva puruṣa śarīra utpādanāya tasmāt anya parikalpanā narthakyam parimitam iti ced atha matam parimitam pradhānam iti na uccheda prasaṃgāt evam api tasya ucchedaḥ prāptaḥ kṣīra vat tathā ca saṃsāra uccheda prasaṃgaḥ kim ca anavasthā prasaṃgāt ekasya īśvarasya yoginaḥ vā icchā yogāt aneka śarīra tvam

tad parimitāt ayuktam pratiśarīram vā pradhāna parikalpane pradhāna anavasthā bhavati parimita śarīra kāraṇa tva abhyupagamāt anya parikalpanā narthakyam tatas ca pradhāna eka tvam eva tasmāt ayuktam prati puruṣam pradhānāni iti yat tu uktam māhātmya śarīra pradhāna pravṛttau itareṣām pravṛtiḥ tad nivṛttau nivṛttiḥ iti atra brūmaḥ na atiśaya abhāvāt yathā kṣetrajñānām niratiśaya tvāt itaretarā pravartaka tvam evam eṣām api sa atiśaya tve vā pradhāna anupapatti prasaṃgaḥ vaiṣamyāt tasmāt yuktam prati puruṣa vimokṣa artham ekā prakṛtiḥ pravartate iti

āha tad anupapattiḥ ācetanyāt iha acetanānām ghaṭa ādīnām uddiśya pravṛttiḥ adṛṣṭā sā ced iyam acetanā prakṛtiḥ asyāḥ api uddiśya puruṣa artham pravṛttiḥ na upapadyate bhavati ced caitanyam tarhi prāptam asya a tatra yat uktam prati puruṣa vimokṣa artha prakṛteḥ pravṛttiḥ iti etat ayuktam iti ucyate na dṛṣṭānta upapatteḥ vatsa vivṛddhi nimittam kṣīrasya yathā pravṛttiḥ ajñasya puruṣa vimokṣa nimittam tathā pravṛttiḥ pradhānasya

yathā kṣīram acetanam vatsa vivṛddhim uddiśya pravartate evam pradhānam api puruṣa vimokṣam uddiśya pravartate na ca asya caitanyam syāt sādhya tvāt ayuktam iti ced syāt matam sādhyam etat kim kṣīrasya uddiśya vatsa vivṛddhim pravṛttiḥ atha na iti tasmāt udāharaṇam sādhya tvāt ayuktam iti etat ca ayuktam kasmāt tad abhāve abhāvāt tad bhāve ca bhāvāt yatra na asti vatsa vivṛddhiḥ tatra na kṣīrasya pravṛttiḥ upalabdhā yatra asti tatra upalabdhā yadi asmin sati bhavati tasya tad arthā pravṛttiḥ dṛṣṭā tat yathā ghaṭe kumbhakārasya sa ca ayam īdṛśaḥ asmākam uddeśaḥ abhipretaḥ yat uta tādarthyam tasmāt na asti udāharaṇa sādhya tvam iti

asadbhāva abhidhānāt sat kārya virodhaḥ iti ced na vyakti paryāya tvāt vyakti paryāyaḥ hi tat iti śāstra loka prāmāṇyāt śāstram tāvat sattā mātraḥ mahān vyakti mātraḥ iti arthaḥ loke api na asti asmin kūpe salilam iti ucyate na kvacid api kūpe salilam na asti abhivyaktam na tat bhavati tasmāt na satkārya virodhaḥ

adṛṣṭa preraṇa tvāt asiddhiḥ iti ced atha matam dharma adharma preritam kṣīram pravartate na vatsa vivṛddhi artham iti tat api ayuktam kasmāt doṣa sāmyāt dharma adharmau acetanau vivṛddhi kāle kṣīram pravartayataḥ tad avasāne ca nivartayataḥ tasamāt ittham api parikalpyamāne samānaḥ doṣaḥ īśvara preraṇāt iti ced syāt matam īśvaraḥ tatra kṣīram pravartayate vatsa artham na svayam iti tat ayuktam kasmāt pratiṣedhāt prāk pratiṣiddham īśvara karma tasmāt idam api ayuktam evam ced avasthitaḥ dṛṣṭāntaḥ vārṣa gaṇānām tu yathā strī puṃśarīrāṇām acetanānām uddiśya itaretaram pravṛttiḥ tathā pradhānasya iti ayam dṛṣṭāntaḥ

āha katham avagamyate tādarthyāt utpannena vyaktena puruṣasya sambandhaḥ na punar sānnidhya mātrāt bhikṣu vat iti ucyate na anapavarga prasaṃgāt sānnidhya mātrāt puruṣa upabhogam abhyupagacchataḥ na apavarga prasaṃgaḥ syāt nityasānnidhyāt tasmāt ayuktam etat apravartayitāram prati kārya kāraṇānām pravṛttiḥ ayuktā iti ced syāt matam apravartayitā kṛṣṇa ādīnām bhikṣu ḥ atas na teṣām api tam prati pravṛttiḥ evam apravartayitā kārya karaṇānām puruṣaḥ tasmāt teṣām api tam prati pravṛttiḥ ayuktā iti etat api atas eva anaikāntikam vatsaḥ hi kṣīrasya apravartayitā atha ca tam prati tasya pravṛttiḥ tasmāt yuktam eta puruṣa vimokṣa arthā prakṛtteḥ pravṛttiḥ na caitanya prasaṃgaḥ iti

āha na apravṛtti prasaṃgāt yadi pradhānasya puruṣa kaivalya arthā pravṛttiḥ tena tad abhāve kaivalyam siddham eva iti apravṛtti prasaṃgaḥ atha kevale puruṣe pradhānam pravartate na tarhi asya tad arthā pravṛttiḥ iti autsukya nivṛtti artham yathā kriyāsu pravartate lokaḥ puruṣasya vimokṣa artham pravartate tadvat avyaktam

prāk eva etat apadiṣṭam yathā dṛśya darśana śakti yukta tvāt anyatara abhāve ca tayoḥ ānarthakyāt pradhāna puruṣayoḥ itaretara sambandham pratyautsukyam dṛṣṭā ca uparama arthā api lokasya autsukya nivṛtti arthā pravṛttiḥ tathā pradhānasya api uparama arthā pravṛttiḥ atha dṛśya darśana śaktyā urautsukya nivṛtti artham pravartate iti ekatra kṛtārtha tvāt itareṣu apravṛtti prasaṃgaḥ iti ced syāt etat pradhānam ekasya puruṣasya ātmānam prakāśya uparamede dṛśya darśana śaktayā uḥ autsukya nivṛttiḥ bhaviṣyati

apravṛttiḥ ca iti etat api na upapannam kasmāt dṛṣṭānta antara sāmarthyāt tat yathā kim ucyate raṅgasya darśayitvā nivartate nartakī yathā nṛtyāt puruṣasya tathā ātmānam prakāśya vinivartate prakṛtiḥ tatra nānā varṇa svabhāva vijñānānām prekṣā arthinām puruṣāṇām saṃghātaḥ raṅgaḥ iti ucyate nartakyāḥ ca tad ārādhanā nṛtti kriyā aneka puruṣa arthā yadi vā atra kaścid brūyāt nṛtta ācāryeṇa kuśīlavaiḥ vā dṛṣṭā eva iyam kasmāt na nivartate katham akṛtārtha tvāt evam sarva puruṣāṇām kārya kāraṇa sambandhena autsukyavatām nirāka aṃkṣīkaraṇa artham pravṛttā prakṛtiḥ katham ekasya puruṣasya autsukya nivṛttau kṛtārthā syāt tasmāt na ekasya puruṣasya ātmānam prakāśya prakṛteḥ nivṛttiḥ yuktā iti atra ca

kārya kāraṇa kriyā sākṣī puruṣaḥ tasmāt ye bhautikāḥ śiraḥ pāṇi ādayaḥ ye ca ahaṃkārikāḥ śravaṇa ādayaḥ vacana ādayaḥ saṃkalpa abhimāna adhyavasāyāḥ ca te lakṣaṇa viparyayāt na aham na aṣṭau prakṛtayaḥ tat etat evam tattvānām abhyāsa ekāgra manasaḥ yateḥ punar punar abhyāsāt ekasya api asmitā rūpasya parikalpita viṣaya bheda pratiṣedha mukhena na asmi na me na aham iti apariśeṣam

āprakṛteḥ pratipakṣa grahaṇāt aviparyayāt pañca srotasaḥ asya avidyā parvaṇaḥ nivṛtteḥ śāntam dhruvam sakala bhāva anubandha pratipakṣa bhūtam dharma ādi āpyāyitasya buddhi tattvasya asan digdham aviparītam viśuddham kevalam utpadyate jñānam āha viśuddham kevalam anyatara anabhidhānam artha abhedāt yat eva viśuddham tat eva kevalam iti artha abhedāt anyatarat śakyam avaktum iti ucyate guṇa antara rūpa nivṛtti hetu tvāt rajaḥ tamaḥ dharmāṇām tāvat grahaṇāt śuddham saṃśaya viparyaya vyatiriktam ca kevalam kṣetrajña parijñāne apūrvam eva iti āha tad sama kālam eva śarīrasya pātaḥ prāpnoti sati dha vasthānena ajñāna hetukam śarīram iti

ucyate ajñāna hetukam śarīram atha ca ayam nānā tva darśī dharma ādīnām akāraṇa prāptau tiṣṭhati saṃskāra vaśāt cakra bhrama vat dhṛta śarīraḥ ya śarīra antara upārjitāḥ dharma ādayaḥ na tāvat kāraṇam buddhi mupasaṃprāptā akṛtārtha tvāt buddhiḥ ca pradhānam tadā tiṣṭhati ayam nānā tva darśī tasya saṃskārasya sāmarthyāt kaḥ dṛṣṭāntaḥ cakra bhrama vat dhṛta śarīraḥ tat yathā kumbhakāra prayatna viśiṣṭena daṇḍena ghaṭa ādi niṣpatti yogya kriyā cakrasya bhramaḥ tena tulyam cakra bhrama vat yathā cakra bhramaṇam ghaṭa artham niṣpanne ghaṭa ādi niṣpatti yogya kriyā cakrasya bhramaḥ tena tulyam cakra bhrama vat yathā cakra bhramaṇam ghaṭa artham niṣpanne ghaṭe pūrva saṃskāra anurodhāt na nivartate na ca tadā nivṛttam iti kṛtvā saṃskāra kṣaye api avatiṣṭhate evam samyak darśana artham śarīram samyak jñāna adhigame api na nivartate pūrva saṃskāra vaśāt na ca tadā nivṛttam iti kṛtvā saṃskāra kṣaye api avasthāpyate iti

yadā tu saṃskāra kṣaye tad nimittasya śarīrasya bhedaḥ atas prāpte śarīra bhede dharma adharmau kṛtārthau kāraṇe buddhi lakṣaṇe layam gacchataḥ yaḥ ca asya bhūta avayavaḥ śarīra ārambhakaḥ sa sarva bhūteṣu bhūtāni tanmātreṣu indriyāṇi tanmātrāṇi ca ahaṃkāre ahaṃkāraḥ buddhau buddhiḥ avyakte sā iyam tattva ānupūrvī tad artha pradhānāt utpannā parisamāpte punar pradhāne pralayam gacchati iti pradhānam api artha vaśāt eva asya śarīrāṇi teṣu teṣu jāti antara parivarteṣu karoti sa cāryaḥ caritārthaḥ

atas caritārtha tvāt pradhāna vinivṛttau atīndriyam asaṃvedya laghu sarvatra sannihitam praśastam anirmitam viśuddham akṣayam niratiśayam ekāntam ātyantikam abhayam kaivalyam āpnoti etat ca avasthānam bauddhaiḥ nirupadhi śeṣa nirvāṇa lakṣaṇam apavargaḥ vyākhyātaḥ etat param brahmam dhruvam amalam abhayam atra sarveṣām guṇa dharmāṇām pratipralayaḥ etat prāpya sarva āyāsaiḥ sarva bandhanaiḥ anādi kāla pravṛtta rāga dveṣa viyuktaḥ muktaḥ bhavati etad artham brāhmaṇāḥ dayitaputra dāra dhana sambandham apahāya guru śuśrūṣā parāḥ śarīram araṇyeṣu yātayanti katham nāma ekāntikam ātyantikam ca kaivalyam syāt iti yatra eva utthānam śāstrasya tatra eva upasaṃhāraḥ ācāryeṇa kṛtaḥ

āha kimartham punar idam śāstram kena vā pūrvam prakāśitam iti ucyate yat uktam kimartham iti puruṣa artha artham idam katham nāma ajñāna vaśāt tad saṃskāra upanipatitānām prāṇinām apavargaḥ syāt iti evam artham idam śāstram vyākhyātam yat tu uktam kena iti ucyate guhyam parama ṛṣiṇā samākhyātam

guhyam iti gūhanīyam rahasyam akṛtātmanām yama niyameṣu anavasthitānām ādarāt api anadhyeyam parama ṛṣiḥ bhagavān sāṃsiddhikaiḥ dharma jñāna vairāgya aiśvaryaiḥ āviṣṭa piṇḍaḥ viśva agrajaḥ kapila muniḥ tena kapila muninā samākhyātam samyak ākhyātam cira abhyastasya vidyā srotasaḥ nirvacana sāmarthyāt syāt etat katham idam guhyam iti ucyate katham vedam guhyam na syāt

bhava agra utpannaiḥ api sanaka sanātana sanandana sanatkumāra prabhṛtibhiḥ anityānām sthiti utpatti pralayāḥ cintyante ca yatra bhūtānām tatra sthitiḥ tāvat rūpa pravṛtti phala nirdeśena utpattiḥ api prakṛteḥ mahān iti ādiḥ pralayaḥ api avibhāgāt vaiśvarūpyasya iti vacanāt autsukya anuparamāt prakṛti puruṣayoḥ sthitiḥ utpattiḥ dṛśya darśana śaktayoḥ sa apekṣa tvāt tathā ca uktam puruṣasya darśana arthaḥ kaivalya arthaḥ tathā pradhānasya paṅgu andhavat ubhayoḥ api saṃyogaḥ tad kṛtaḥ sargaḥ iti

pralayaḥ prāpte śarīra bhede caritārtha tvāt pradhāna vinivṛttau iti athavā sthiti kṣaṇa bhaṅga pratiṣedhāt kāla antareṣu asya anāśāt utpattiḥ vipariṇāma anna abhūta prādurbhāvāt akasmāt asambhavāt pralayaḥ api nimitta antarāt svābhāvyāt eva bhūtānām api vyaktānām niṣpattimatām iti yāvat evam ca mahat ādayaḥ api parigṛhītāḥ iti āha puruṣa ādayaḥ tarhi parityaktāḥ katham vā bhūta śabdaḥ iti

ucyate vitatha pratiṣedha artha tvāt yāvat kiṃcid avitatham bhūtam tasya sarvasya iha sthiti ādayaḥ ucyante iti utpatti vināśa pratiṣedha aviśeṣāt evam api puruṣa ādīnām utpatti pralayau api prāpnutaḥ kim kāraṇam aviśeṣāt iti ucyate sambhavataḥ viśeṣaṇam bhavati tatra sthitiḥ eva puruṣa ādīnām itareṣām tu sthiti utpatti pralayāḥ iti vijñāsyāmaḥ

āha kasmai punar idam śāstram parama ṛṣiṇā prakāśitam iti ucyate etat pravitram agryam muniḥ āsuraye anukampayā pradadau tatra pavitram pāvanāt agryam sarva duḥkha kṣapaṇa samartha tvāt pavitra antarāṇi punar eka deśam kṣālayanti adhamarṣaṇa gaṅgā ādīni tasmāt idam eva agryam muniḥ āsuraye anukampayā pradadau

āha sampradānasya akasmika tvam dharma ādi nimitta anupapatteḥ na tāvat parama ṛṣeḥ dharma artham śāstra pradānam upapadyate phalena anabhiṣvaṅgāt na artha kāma artham śiṣyāṇām anāyāsa prasaṃgāt na mokṣa artham sāṃsiddhikena eva jñānena tad prāpteḥ tasmāt viparīta artha asambhavāt pariśeṣāt akasmāt ācāryaḥ śāstra nidhānam pradadau iti

ucyate na akasmāt kim tarhi anukampayā pradadau ādhyātmika ādhidaivika ādhibhautikaiḥ duḥkhaiḥ pīḍyamānam āsurim upalabhya sva ātmani ca jñāna sāmarthyāt sati kārya kāraṇa samprayoge duḥkhānām apravṛttim parijñāya śiṣya guṇān ca katham nāma yathā mama sukha duḥkheṣu jñāna upanipātāt sāmyam evam āsureḥ api syāt tad dvāreṇa ani eṣām api puruṣāṇām evam anukampayā bhagavān parama ṛṣiḥ śāstram ākhyātavān

yathā ca parama ṛṣiḥ āsuraye tathā āsuriḥ api daśamāya kumārāya bhagavat pañcaśikhāya tena ca bahudhā kṛtam tantram bahubhyaḥ janaka vaśiṣṭha ādibhyaḥ samākhyātam asya tu śāstrasya bhagavataḥ agre pravṛtta tvāt na śāstra antara vat vaṃśaḥ śakyaḥ varṣa śata sahasraiḥ api ākhyātum

saṃkṣepeṇa tu dvau a hārīta vādhalikaiḥ āta paurika āṛṣabha īśvara pañca adhikaraṇa patañjali vārṣa gaṇya kauṇḍinya mūka ādika śiṣya paramparayā āgatam bhagavān īśvara kṛṣṇaḥ ca sāhāyakam śāstram pūrva ācārya sūtra prabandhe gurulāghava manādriyamāṇaḥ paurastyāni ākhyānavyā na garbham atipramādam dadāti iti grantha bhūyastvam upajāyate tad ced ānīntanaiḥ prāṇibhiḥ alpa tvāt āyuṣaḥ granthataḥ eva na sūpa pādam kim punar śravaṇa prayogābhyām āha ca caturbhiḥ prakāraiḥ vidyā su upa yuktā bhavati āgama kālena svādhyāya kālena prayoga kālena ca tatra ca asya āgamana kālena eva āyuḥ paryupayuktam syāt tatas ca śāstra ānarthakyam iti asya manda dhiyām api āśu grahaṇa dhāraṇa prayoga sampatsyāt iti ṣaṣṭi tantrāt upākhyāna gāthā vyavahitāni vākyāni ekatas upamṛdya śiṣya anukampā artham yāvat īśvara kṛṣṇena ca etat āryābhiḥ saptatyā saṃkṣiptam ārya matinā sarva sattva hita pravṛttena samyak vijñāya siddhāntam katham ca asya samyak siddhānta vijñānasya api aneka grantha śata sahasra ākhyeyam sāṃkhya padārtham sa tattvam akhaṇḍam ācāryāṇām saptatyā saṃkṣiptavān

āha ca saptatyām kila ye arthāḥ te arthāḥ kṛtsnasya ṣaṣṭitantrasya ākhyāyikā virahitāḥ para vāda vivarjitāḥ ca api yatas ca nārāyaṇam anujanaka vaśiṣṭhadvaipāyana pravṛttibhiḥ ācāryaiḥ pradhāna puruṣa ādayaḥ padārthāḥ parigṛhītāḥ ca upadiṣṭāḥ ca praśastāḥ ca atas svabhāvataḥ prasiddham aiśvaryasya phalatas ṛddhyā ārya mārgam alaṃkartum iti bhagavat īśvara kṛṣṇena padārtha svarūpa nirūpaṇa nipuṇa sāra matinā parama ṛṣya ādi yathā ukta āgamena pramāṇa trayam puraskṛtya tarka dṛśā vicāraḥ kṛtaḥ na ca asya mūla kanaka piṇḍasya iva su alpam api doṣa jātam asti iti

āha ca ajñāna dhvānta śānti artham ṛṣi candramasaḥ cyutā malinaiḥ tīrtha jaladaiḥ chādyate jñānacandrikā iti sadbhiḥ asambhrāntaiḥ kudṛṣṭi timira apahā prakāśikā iyam sargasya dhāryatām yuktidīpikā sphuṭa abhidheyā madhurā api bhāratī manīṣiṇaḥ na upakhalam virājate kṛśa anugarbha api abhitas hima āgame kaduṣṇa tām yāti divākara dyutiḥ nayanti santaḥ ca yatas sva śaktitaḥ guṇam pareṣām tanum api udāra tām iti prayātu eṣa mama śramaḥ satām vicāraṇa anugraha mātra pātra tām >

namaḥ buddhāya pudgala dharma nairātmyayoḥ apratipanna vipratipannānām aviparīta pudgala dharma nairātmya pratipādana artham triṃśikā vijñapti prakaraṇa ārambhaḥ pudgala dharma nairātmya pratipādanam punar kleśa jñeya āvaraṇa prahāṇa artham tathā hi ātma dṛṣṭi prabhavāḥ rāga ādayaḥ kleśāḥ pudgala nairātmya avabodhaḥ ca sat kāya dṛṣṭeḥ pratipakṣa tvāt tad prahāṇāya pravartamānaḥ sarva kleśān prajahāti dharma nairātmya jñānāt api jñeya āvaraṇa pratipakṣa tvāt jñeya āvaraṇam prahīyate kleśa jñeya āvaraṇa prahāṇam api mokṣa sarvajña tva adhigama artham kleśāḥ hi mokṣa prāpteḥ āvaraṇam iti atas teṣu prahīṇeṣu mokṣaḥ adhigamyate jñeya āvaraṇam api sarvasmin jñeye jñāna pravṛtti pratibandha bhūtam akliṣṭam ajñānam tasmin prahīṇe sarva ākāre jñeye asaktam apratihatan ca jñānam pravartate iti atas sarvajña tvam adhigamyate

atha vā dharma pudgala abhiniviṣṭāḥ cittamātram yathābhūtam na jānanti iti atas dharma pudgala nairātmya pradarśanena saphale vijñaptimātre anupūrveṇa praveśa artham prakaraṇa ārambhaḥ atha vā vijñāna vat vijñeyam api dravyataḥ eva iti kecid manyante vijñeya vat vijñānam api saṃvṛtitaḥ eva na paramārthataḥ iti asya dvi prakārasya api ekānta vādasya pratiṣedha arthaḥ prakaraṇa ārambhaḥ

ātma dharma upacāraḥ hi vividhaḥ yaḥ pravartate loka śāstrayoḥ iti vākya śeṣaḥ vijñāna pariṇāme asau ātma dharma upacāraḥ iti saṃbadhyate ātmā dharmāḥ ca upacaryante iti ātma dharma upacāraḥ sa punar ātma prajñaptiḥ dharma prajñaptiḥ ca vividhaḥ iti aneka prakāraḥ ātmā jīvaḥ jantuḥ manujaḥ māṇavaḥ iti evam ādikaḥ ātma upacāraḥ skandhāḥ dhātavaḥ āyatanāni rūpam vedanā saṃjñā saṃskārāḥ vijñānam iti evamādikaḥ dharma upacāraḥ

ayam dvi prakāraḥ api upacāraḥ vijñāna pariṇāmaḥ eva na mukhye ātmani dharmeṣu ca iti kutas etat dharmāṇām ātmanaḥ ca vijñāna pariṇāmāt bahis abhāvāt kaḥ ayam pariṇāmaḥ nāma anyathātvam kāraṇa kṣaṇa nirodha sama kālaḥ kāraṇa kṣaṇa vilakṣaṇaḥ kāryasya ātma lābhaḥ pariṇāmaḥ tatra ātma ādi vikalpa vāsanā paripoṣāt rūpa ādi vikalpa vāsanā paripoṣāt ca ālaya vijñānāt ātma ādi nirbhāsaḥ vikalpaḥ rūpa ādi nirbhāsaḥ ca utpadyate tam ātma ādi nirbhāsam rūpa ādi nirbhāsan ca tasmāt vikalpāt bahis bhūtam iva upādāya ātmā ādi upacāraḥ rūpa ādi dharma upacāraḥ ca anādikālikaḥ pravartate vinā api bāhyena ātmanā dharmaiḥ ca tat yathā taimirikasya keśoṇḍukā ādi upacāraḥ iti yat ca yatra na asti tat tatra upacaryate tat yathā bāhīke gauḥ

evam vijñāna svarūpe bahis ca ātma dharma abhāvāt parikalpitaḥ eva ātmā dharmāḥ ca na tu paramārthataḥ santi iti vijñāna vat vijñeyam api dravyataḥ eva iti ayam ekānta vādaḥ na abhyupeyaḥ upacārasya ca nirādhārasya asaṃbhavāt avaśyam vijñāna pariṇāmaḥ vastutas asti iti upagantavyaḥ yatra ātma dharma upacāraḥ pravartate atas ca ayam abhyupagamaḥ na yukti kṣamaḥ vijñānam api vijñeya vat saṃvṛtitaḥ eva na paramārthataḥ iti saṃvṛtitaḥ api abhāva prasaṅgāt na hi saṃvṛtiḥ nirupādānā yujyate

tasmāt ayam ekānta vādaḥ dvi prakāraḥ api niryuktika tvāt tyājyaḥ iti ācārya vacanam evan ca sarvam vijñeyam parikalpita svabhāva tvāt vastutas na vidyate vijñānam punar pratītyasamutpanna tvāt dravyataḥ asti iti abhyupeyam pratītyasamutpanna tvam punar vijñānasya pariṇāma śabdena jñāpitam katham etat gamyate vinā bāhyena arthena vijñānam eva artha ākāram utpadyate iti bāhyaḥ hi arthaḥ sva ābhāsa vijñāna janaka tvena vijñānasya ālambana pratyayaḥ iṣyate na kāraṇa tva mātreṇa samanantara ādi pratyayāt viśeṣa aprasaṅgāt

sañcita ālambanāḥ ca pañca vijñāna kāyāḥ tad ākāra tvāt na ca sañcitam avayava saṃhati mātrāt anyat vidyate tad avayavān apohya sañcita ākāra vijñāna abhāvāt tasmāt vinā eva bāhyena arthena vijñānam sañcita ākāram utpadyate na ca paramāṇavaḥ eva saṃcitāḥ tasya ālambanam paramāṇūnām atadākāra tvāt na hi asañcita avasthātaḥ sañcita avasthāyām paramāṇūnām kaścid ātma atiśayaḥ tasmāt asañcita vat sañcitāḥ api paramāṇavaḥ na eva ālambanam

anyaḥ tu manyate ekaika paramāṇuḥ anya nirapekṣyaḥ atīndriyaḥ bahavaḥ tu paraspara apekṣāḥ indriya grāhyāḥ teṣām api sa apekṣa nirapekṣa avasthayoḥ ātma atiśaya abhāvāt ekāntena indriya grāhya tvam atīndriya tvam vā yadi ca paramāṇavaḥ eva paraspara apekṣāḥ vijñānasya viṣayībhavanti evam sati yaḥ ayam ghaṭa kuḍya ādi ākāra bhedaḥ vijñāne sa na syāt praramāṇūnām atadākāra tvāt na ca anya nirbhāsasya vijñānasya anya ākāraḥ viṣayaḥ yujyate ati prasaṅgāt na ca paramāṇavaḥ stambha ādi vat paramārthataḥ santi arvāk madhya para bhāga sadbhāvāt

tad anabhyupagame vā pūrva dakṣiṇā para uttara ādi diś bhedaḥ yaḥ sa paramāṇoḥ na syāt tatas ca vijñāna vat paramāṇoḥ api amūrta tvam adeśa stha tvan ca prasajyate evam bāhya artha abhāvāt vijñānam eva artha ākāram utpadyate svapna vijñāna vat iti abhyupeyam vedanā ādayaḥ api na atīta anāgatāḥ tad ākāra vijñāna janakāḥ niruddha ajāta tvāt na ca vartamānā vartamāna janakāḥ utpadyamāna avasthāyām asattvāt utpanna avasthāyām vijñānasya api tad ākāreṇa utpanna tvāt na kiñcid kartavyam asti iti manaḥ vijñānam api anālambanam eva utpadyate

anyaḥ tu āha asati ātmani mukhye dharmeṣu ca upacāraḥ na yujyate upacāraḥ hi triṣu satsu bhavati na anyatama abhāve mukhya padārthe tad sadṛśe anyasmin viṣaye tayoḥ ca sādṛśye tat yathā mukhye agnau tad sadṛśe ca māṇavake tayoḥ ca sādhāraṇe dharme kapila tve tīkṣṇa tve vā sati agniḥ māṇavakaḥ iti upacāraḥ kriyate atra hi agniḥ māṇavakaḥ iti jātiḥ dravyam vā upacaryate ubhayathā api upacāra abhāvaḥ

tatra tāvat na jāteḥ sādhāraṇam kapila tvam tīkṣṇa tvam vā na ca sādhāraṇa dharma abhāve māṇavake jāteḥ upacāraḥ yujyate ati prasaṅgāt atad dharma tve api jāteḥ tīkṣṇa tva kapila tvayoḥ jāti avinābhauvi tvāt māṇavake jāti upacāraḥ bhaviṣyati jāti abhāve api tīkṣṇa tva kapila tvayoḥ māṇavake darśanāt avinā abhāvi tvam ayuktam avinā abhāvi tve ca upacāra abhāvaḥ agnau iva māṇavake api jāti sadbhāvāt tasmāt na māṇavake jāti upacāraḥ saṃbhavati

na api dravya upacāraḥ sāmānya dharma abhāvāt na hi yaḥ agneḥ tīkṣṇaḥ guṇaḥ kapilaḥ vā saḥ eva māṇavake kim tarhi tatas anyaḥ viśeṣasya sva āśraya pratibaddha tvāt na vinā agni guṇena agneḥ māṇavake upacāraḥ yuktaḥ agni guṇa sādṛśyāt yuktaḥ iti ced evam api agni guṇasya eva tīkṣṇasya kapilasya vā māṇavaka guṇe tīkṣṇe kapile vā sādṛśyāt upacāraḥ yuktaḥ na tu māṇavake agneḥ guṇa sādṛśyena asaṃbandhāt tasmāt dravya upacāraḥ api na eva yujyate

mukhyaḥ api padārthaḥ na eva asti tad svarūpasya sarva jñāna abhidhāna viṣaya atikrānta tvāt pradhāne hi guṇa rūpeṇa eva jñāna abhidhāne pravartete tad svarūpa asaṃsparśāt anyathā ca guṇa vaiyarthya prasaṅgaḥ na hi jñāna abhidhāna vyatiriktaḥ anyaḥ padārtha svarūpa paricchitti upāyaḥ asti iti atas pradhāna svarūpa viṣaya jñāna abhidhāna abhāvāt na eva mukhyaḥ padārthaḥ asti iti avagantavyam evam yāvat śabde saṃbandha abhāvāt jñāna abhidhāna abhāvaḥ evan ca abhidhāna abhidheya abhāvāt na eva mukhyaḥ padārthaḥ asti api ca sarve eva ayam gauṇaḥ eva na mukhyaḥ asti gauṇaḥ hi nāma yaḥ yatra avidyamānena rūpeṇa pravartate sarvaḥ ca śabdaḥ pradhāne avidyamānena eva guṇa rūpeṇa pravartate atas mukhyaḥ na asti eva tatra yat uktam asati ātmani mukhye dharmeṣu ca upacāraḥ na yuktaḥ iti tat ayuktam

vijñāna pariṇāmaḥ kati prabhedaḥ iti na jñāyate atas tad prabheda upadarśana artham āha pariṇāmaḥ sa ca tridhā yatra ātma ādi upacāraḥ dharma upacāraḥ ca sa punar hetu bhāvena phala bhāvena ca bhidyate tatra hetu pariṇāmaḥ yālaya vijñāne vipāka niṣyanda vāsanā paripuṣṭiḥ phala pariṇāmaḥ punar vipāka vāsanā vṛtti lābhāt ālaya vijñānasya pūrva karma ākṣepa parisamāptau yā nikāya sa bhāga antareṣu abhinirvṛttiḥ niṣyanda vāsanā vṛtti lābhāt ca yā pravṛtti vijñānānām kliṣṭasya ca manasaḥ ālaya vijñānāt abhinirvṛttiḥ tatra pravṛtti vijñānam kuśala akuśalam ālaya vijñāne vipāka vāsanām niṣyanda vāsanān ca ādhatte avyākṛtam kliṣṭan ca manaḥ niṣyanda vāsanām eva

yaḥ asau trividhaḥ pariṇāmaḥ uktaḥ asau api na jñāyate atas tad bheda pradarśana artham āha vipākaḥ mananā ākhyaḥ ca vijñaptiḥ viṣayasya ca iti saḥ eṣa trividhaḥ pariṇāmaḥ vipāka ākhyaḥ manana ākhyaḥ viṣaya vijñapti ākhyaḥ ca tatra kuśala akuśala karma vāsanā paripāka vaśāt yathākṣepam phala abhinirvṛttiḥ vipākaḥ kliṣṭam manaḥ nityam mananā ātmaka tvāt manana ākhyam rūpa ādi viṣaya pratyavabhāsa tvāt cakṣuḥ ādi vijñānam ṣaṣ prakāram api viṣaya vijñaptiḥ tad svarūpa nirdeśam antareṇa na tat pratīyate iti atas yasya yat sva rūpam tat yathākramam pradarśayan āha tatra ālaya ākhyam vijñānam vipākaḥ sarva bījakam

iti tatra iti yaḥ ayam anantara uktaḥ trividhaḥ pariṇāmaḥ ālaya ākhyam iti ālayavijñāna saṃjñakam yat vijñānam sa vipāka pariṇāmaḥ tat ca sarva sāṃkleśika dharma bīja sthāna tvāt ālayaḥ ālayaḥ sthānam iti paryāyau atha vālīyante upanibadhyante asmin sarva dharmāḥ kārya bhāvena tat vālīyate upanibadhyate kāraṇa bhāvena sarva dharmeṣu iti ālayaḥ vijānāti iti vijñānam sarva dhātu gati yoni jātiṣu kuśala akuśala karma vipāka tvāt vipākaḥ sarva dharma bīja āśraya tvāt sarva bījakam yadi pravṛtti vijñāna vyatiriktam ālaya vijñānam asti tatas asya ālambanam ākāraḥ vā vaktavyaḥ na hi nirālambanam nirākāram vā vijñānam yujyate na eva tat nirālambanam nirākāram veṣyate kim tarhi aparicchinna ālambana ākāram kim kāraṇam yasmāt ālayavijñānam dvidhā pravartate adhyātmam upādāna vijñaptitaḥ bahirdhā paricchinna ākāra bhājana vijñaptitaḥ ca

tatra adhyātmam upādānam parikalpita svabhāva abhiniveśa vāsanā sādhiṣṭhānam indriya rūpam nāma ca asya ālambanasya ati sūkṣma tvāt asaṃvidita kopa ādi sthāna vijñaptikan ca tat asaṃviditakaḥ upādiḥ yasmin asaṃviditakā ca sthāna vijñaptiḥ yasmin tat ālaya vijñānam asaṃvidita kopa ādi sthāna vijñaptikam upādānam upādiḥ sa punar ātma ādi vikalpa vāsanā rūpa ādi dharma vikalpa vāsanā ca tad sadbhāvāt ālaya vijñānena ātma ādi vikalpaḥ rūpa ādi vikalpaḥ ca kāryatvena upāttaḥ iti tat vāsanā ātma ādi vikalpānām rūpa ādi vikalpānān ca upādiḥ iti ucyate saḥ asmin idam tat iti pratisaṃvedana ākāreṇa asaṃviditaḥ iti atas tat asaṃvidita kopa ādiḥ iti ucyate

āśraya upādānan ca upādiḥ āśraya ātma bhāvaḥ sādhiṣṭhānam indriya rūpam nāma ca tasya punar yat upādānam upagamanam eka yogakṣema tvena tat upādiḥ tatra kāmarūpa dhātvoḥ dvayoḥ nāma rūpayoḥ upādānam ārūpya dhātau tu rūpa vīta rāga tvāt rūpa vipāka an abhinirvṛtteḥ nāma upādānam eva kin tu vāsanā avastham eva tatra rūpam na vipāka avastham tat punar upādānam idantayā pratisaṃvedayitum aśakyam iti atas asaṃviditaḥ iti ucyate

sthāna vijñaptiḥ bhājana loka saṃniveśa vijñaptiḥ sā api aparicchinna ālambana ākāra pravṛtta tvāt asaṃviditā iti ucyate katham vijñānam aparicchinna ālambana ākāram bhaviṣyati iti anya vijñāna vādinām api nirodha samāpatti ādi avasthāsu tulyam etat na ca nirodha samāpatti ādi avasthāsu vijñānam na eva asti iti śakyate pratipattum yukti virodhāt sūtra virodhāt ca iti

tatra ālaya ākhyam vijñānam iti uktam vijñānan ca avaśyam caittaiḥ saṃprayuktam iti atas vaktavyam katamaiḥ katibhiḥ ca tebhyaḥ saṃprayujyate tathā kim taiḥ sarvadā saṃprayujyate uta na iti atas āha sadā sparśa manaskāra vid saṃjñā cetana anvitam iti sadā iti yāvat ālayavijñānam tāvat ebhiḥ sparśa manaskāra vedanā saṃjñā cetanā ākhyaiḥ pañcabhiḥ sarvatragaiḥ dharmaiḥ anvitam vedanā vid

tatra sparśaḥ trika saṃnipāte indriya vikāra paricchedaḥ vedanā saṃniśraya dāna karmakaḥ indriya viṣaya vijñānāni trīṇi eva trikam tasya kārya kāraṇa bhāvena samavasthānam trika saṃnipātaḥ tasmin sati tad sama kālam eva indriyasya sukha ādi vedana anukūlaḥ yaḥ vikāraḥ tena sadṛśaḥ viṣayasya sukha ādi vedanīya ākāra paricchedaḥ yaḥ sa sparśaḥ indriyam punar yena viśeṣeṇa sukha duḥkha ādi hetu tvam pratipadyate sa tasya vikāraḥ sparśaḥ punar indriya vikāra sādṛśyena indriyam spṛśati indriyeṇa vā spṛśyate iti sparśaḥ ucyate atas eva viṣaya vikāra pariccheda ātmakaḥ api indriya vikāra paricchedaḥ uktaḥ vedanā saṃniśraya tvam asya karma evam hi uktam sūtre sukha vedanīyam sparśam pratītya utpadyate sukham veditam iti vistaraḥ

manaskāraḥ cetasaḥ ābhogaḥ ābhujanam ābhogaḥ ālambane yena cittam abhimukhīkriyate sa punar ālambane citta dhāraṇa karmakaḥ citta dhāraṇam punar tatra eva ālambane punar punar cittasya āvarjanam etat ca karma citta santateḥ ālambana niyamena viśiṣṭam manaskāram adhikṛtya uktam na tu yaḥ praticitta kṣaṇam tasya hi pratikṣaṇam eva vyāpāraḥ na kṣaṇa antare

vedanā anubhava svabhāvā sā punar viṣayasya āhlādaka paritāpaka tad ubhaya ākāra vivikta svarūpa sākṣāt karaṇa bhedāt tridhā bhavati sukhā duḥkhā aduḥkha asukhā ca evam tu anye manyante śubha aśubhānām karmaṇām phala vipākam pratyanubhavanti anena iti anubhavaḥ tatra śubhānām karmaṇām sukhaḥ anubhavaḥ phala vipākaḥ aśubhānām duḥkhaḥ ubhayeṣām aduḥkha asukhaḥ

atra ca ālaya vijñānam eva śubha aśubha karma vipākaḥ tad saṃprayuktā eva upekṣā paramārthataḥ śubha aśubhānām karmaṇām phala vipākaḥ sukha duḥkhayoḥ tu kuśala akuśala karma vipāka ja tvāt vipāka upacāraḥ tatra sukhaḥ anubhavaḥ yasmin utpanne viyoga icchā niruddhe ca punar saṃyoga icchā jāyate duḥkhaḥ anubhavaḥ yasmin utpanne viyoga icchā niruddhe ca punar asaṃyoga icchā aduḥkha asukhaḥ yasmin utpanne niruddhe cobhyam na jāyate saṃjñā viṣaya nimitta udgrahaṇam viṣayaḥ ālambanam nimittam tad viśeṣaḥ nīla pīta ādi ālambana vyavasthā kāraṇam tasya udgrahaṇam nirūpaṇam nīlam etat na pītam iti cetanā citta abhisaṃskāraḥ manasaḥ ceṣṭā yasyām satyām ālambanam prati cetasaḥ praspandaḥ iva bhavati ayaskānta vaśāt ayaḥ praspanda vat

vedanā trividhā sukhā duḥkhāḥ aduḥkha asukhā ca dharmāḥ catuḥ prakārāḥ kuśalāḥ akuśalāḥ anivṛta avyākṛtāḥ nivṛta avyākṛtāḥ ca tatra ālaya vijñāne vid iti sāmānya upadeśena na vijñāyate tisṝṇām vedanānām katamā vedanā tathā tat api kim kuśalam akuśalam anivṛta avyākṛtam nivṛta avyākṛtam iti na vijñāyate iti atas āha

upekṣā vedanā tatra anivṛta avyākṛtan ca tat tatra iti ālaya vijñānam eva prakṛta tvāt saṃbadhyate upekṣā eva ālaya vijñāne vedanā na sukhā na duḥkhā tayoḥ paricchinna ālambana ākāra tvāt rāga dveṣa anuśayita tvāt ca anivṛta avyākṛtan ca tat ālayavijñānam iti prakṛtam tatra anivṛta grahaṇam nivṛta vyavaccheda artham avyākṛta grahaṇam kuśala akuśala vyavaccheda artham manaḥ bhūmikaiḥ āgantukaiḥ upakleśaiḥ anāvṛta tvāt anivṛtam vipāka tvāt vipākam prati kuśala akuśala tvena avyākaraṇāt avyākṛtam tathā sparśa ādayaḥ

yathā ālaya vijñānam ekāntena vipākaḥ aparicchinna ālambana ākāram sadā sparśa ādibhiḥ anvitam tatra ca upekṣā eva vedanā nivṛta avyākṛtan ca tathā sparśa ādayaḥ api ekāntena vipākāḥ eva aparicchinna ālambana ākārāḥ ca ātmānam hitvā itaraiḥ caturbhiḥ ālaya vijñānena ca nityam anugatāḥ teṣu ca upekṣā eva vedanā nivṛta avyākṛtāḥ ca ālaya vijñāna vat na hi vipākena saṃprayuktānām avipāka tvam aparicchinna ālambana ākāreṇa ca paricchinna ālambana ākāra tvam saṃbhavati evam anyatra api vācyam

kim punar tat ālayavijñānam ekam abhinnam āsaṃsāram anuvartate uta saṃtānena na hi tat ekam abhinnam anuvartate kṣaṇika tvāt kim tarhi tat ca vartate srotasā ogha vat tat ca iti ālaya vijñānam eva saṃbadhyate tatra srotaḥ hetu phalayoḥ nairantarya prabandhena pravṛttiḥ udaka samūhasya pūrva apara bhāga avicchedena pravāhaḥ oghaḥ iti ucyate yathā hi oghaḥ tṛṇa kāṣṭha gomaya ādīn ākarṣayaṅ gacchati evam ālaya vijñānam api puṇya apuṇyāneñjya karma vāsanā anugatam sparśa manaskāra ādīn ākarṣan srotasā saṃsāram avyuparatam pravartate iti

tasya evam śrotasā pravṛttasya kasyām avasthāyām vyāvṛttiḥ iti āha tasya vyāvṛttiḥ arhat tve kim punar arhat tvam yat yogāt arhan iti ucyate kasya punar yogāt arhan iti ucyate kṣaya jñāna anutpāda jñāna lābhāt tasyām hi avasthāyām ālaya vijñāna āśrita dauṣṭhulya niravaśeṣa prahāṇāt ālaya vijñānam vyāvṛttam bhavati sā eva ca arhat avasthā uktaḥ sa vibhaṅgaḥ vipāka pariṇāmaḥ

idānīm mananā ākhyām dvitīyam pariṇāmam āha tat āśritya pravartate iti vistaraḥ tatra yathā cakṣuḥ ādi vijñānānām cakṣuḥ ādaya āśraya tvena rūpa ādayaḥ ca ālambana tvena prasiddhā na eva kliṣṭasya manasaḥ āśraya ālambanam vā prasiddham na ca vijñānam āśraya ālambana nirapekṣam yujyate iti atas kliṣṭasya manasaḥ āśraya ālambana pratipādana artham nirukti pratipādana arthan ca āha

tat āśritya pravartate tad ālambam manaḥ nāma vijñānam mananā ātmakam tat āśritya pravartate iti tad śabdena ālaya vijñānam abhisaṃbadhyate tad vāsanā āśrayaḥ hi ālaya vijñānam atas tat āśritya pravartate santānena utpadyate iti arthaḥ atha vā yasmin dhātau bhūmau vālaya vijñānam vipākaḥ tat api kliṣṭam manaḥ tad hātukam tat bhūmikam ca iti tad pratibaddha vṛtti tvāt tat āśritya pravartate

tad ālambam iti ālaya vijñāna ālambanam eva sat kāya dṛṣṭi ādibhiḥ saṃprayogāt aham mama iti ālaya vijñāna ālambana tvāt katham punar yatas eva cittāt utpadyate tat eva tad ālambanam bhavati yathā tat anicchatām keṣāṃcid kasyāñcid avasthāyām yatas eva cittān manaḥ vijñānam utpadyate tad ālambanam eva tat utpadyate manaḥ nāma vijñānam iti manaḥ iti nāma ākhyā yasya vijñānasya tat ālayavijñānam āśritya pravarte tad ālambanam ca manaḥ nāma iti anena ālaya vijñānāt pravṛtti vijñānāt ca vyavacchinatti tat punar kim svabhāvam iti āha mananā ātmakam iti evam mananā ātmaka tvāt manaḥ iti ucyate nairūktena vidhinā

vijñāna svarūpa tvāt avaśyam tat caittaiḥ saṃprayujyate idam tu na jñāyate katamaiḥ tat caittaiḥ kiyadbhiḥ kiyantam kālam vā saṃprayujyate iti atas āha kleśaiḥ caturbhiḥ sahitam nivṛta avyākṛtaiḥ sadā caittāḥ hi dvi prakārāḥ kleśāḥ tat anye ca tad anyebhyaḥ vyavaccheda artham āha kleśaiḥ iti kleśāḥ api ṣaḍ na ca taiḥ saṃprayujyate atas caturbhiḥ iti āha sahitam iti saṃprayuktam

kleśāḥ api dvividhāḥ akuśalāḥ nivṛta avyākṛtāḥ ca akuśalebhyaḥ viśeṣa artham āha nivṛta avyākṛtaiḥ iti na hi nivṛtena vijñānena akuśalānām saṃprayogaḥ saṃbhavati nivṛtāḥ kliṣṭa tvāt avyākṛtāḥ kuśala akuśala tvena avyākaraṇāt sadā iti sarvakālam yāvat tat asti tāvat taiḥ saṃprayuktam sāmānya nirdeśāt viśeṣataḥ na jñāyante iti viśeṣataḥ nirdiśati ātma dṛṣṭi ātma moha ātma māna ātma sneha saṃjñitaiḥ

upādāna skandheṣu ātmā iti darśanam ātma dṛṣṭiḥ sat kāya dṛṣṭiḥ iti arthaḥ mohaḥ ajñānam ātmani ajñānam ātma mohaḥ ātma viṣaye mānaḥ ātma mānaḥ asmimānaḥ iti arthaḥ ātmani snehaḥ ātma snehaḥ ātma prema iti arthaḥ tatra ālaya vijñāna svarūpe saṃmūḍhaḥ san ālayavijñāne ātma dṛṣṭim utpādayati ātma darśanāt yā cittasya unnatiḥ saḥ asmimānaḥ etasmin traye sati ātma abhimate vastuni yaḥ abhiṣvaṅgaḥ saḥ ātma snehaḥ

āha ca avidyayā ca ātma dṛṣṭyā ca asmi mānena tṛṣṇayā ebhiḥ caturbhiḥ saṃkliṣṭam mananā lakṣaṇam manaḥ viparyāsa nimittam tu manaḥ kliṣṭam sadā eva tat kuśala avya ākṛte citte sadā ahaṅkāra kāraṇam ete hi ātma moha ādayaḥ kleśāḥ manaḥ vat nava bhūmikāḥ iha ca sāmānyena abhidhānāt na jñāyate kim sva bhūmikaiḥ eva saṃprayujyate uta anya bhūmikaiḥ api iti atas āha

yatrajaḥ tad mayaiḥ iti yatra jātaḥ yatrajaḥ tad mayaiḥ iti yatra dhātau bhūmau vā jātaḥ tad dhātukaiḥ tad bhūmikaiḥ eva ca saṃprayujyate na anya dhātukaiḥ anya bhūmikaiḥ vā kim punar caturbhiḥ eva kleśaiḥ saṃprayujyate na iti āha anyaiḥ sparśa ādyaiḥ ca saṃprayujyate iti saṃbadhyate caśabdaḥ samuccaya arthaḥ sparśa ādyaiḥ iti sparśa manaskāra vedanā saṃjñā cetanābhiḥ ete hi pañca dharmāḥ sarvatraga tvāt sarva vijñānaiḥ saṃprayujyante etaiḥ api yatra jātaḥ tad mayaiḥ eva saṃprayujyate na anya dhātu bhūmikaiḥ

atha vā anyaiḥ iti mūla vijñāna saṃprayuktebhyaḥ vyavaccheda artham mūla vijñāne hi anivṛta avyākṛtāḥ sparśa ādayaḥ kliṣṭe tu manasi manaḥ vat nivṛta avyākṛtāḥ yadi tat kliṣṭam manaḥ kuśala kliṣṭa avyākṛta avasthāsu aviśeṣeṇa pravartate na tasya tarhi nivṛttiḥ asti anivṛtte ca tasmin kutas mokṣaḥ iti katham na mokṣa abhāvaḥ prasajyate na prasajyate yasmāt arhataḥ na tat na nirodha samāpattau mārge lokottare na ca

arhataḥ tāvat aśeṣa kleśa prahāṇāt kliṣṭam manaḥ na eva asti tat dhi bhāva agrika bhāvanā prahāta vya kleśa vat arhat tva prāpti ānantarya mārgeṇa eva prahīyate tat anya kleśa vat arhat tva avasthāyāt na eva vidyate ākiñcani āyatana vīta rāgasya api anāgāminaḥ nirodha samāpatti lābhinaḥ mārga balena nirodha samāpatteḥ labhya tvām mārga vat nirodha samāpatti avasthāyām api nirudhyate nirodhāt ca vyutthitasya punar ālaya vijñānāt eva pravartate

mārge lokottare na ca iti loka uttara grahaṇam laukika vyavaccheda artham laukike tu mārge kliṣṭam manaḥ pravartate eva nairātmya darśanasya ātma darśana pratipakṣa tvāt na loka uttara mārge pravartitum utsaheta vipakṣa pratipakṣayoḥ ayaugapadyāt loka uttara mārge tat nirudhyate tasmāt api vyutthitasya punar ālaya vijñānāt eva utpadyate

dvitīyaḥ pariṇāmaḥ ayam uddiṣṭaḥ nidiṣṭaḥ ca iti nigamayati dvitīya pariṇāma antaram tṛtīyaḥ pariṇāmaḥ vaktavyaḥ iti atas āha tṛtīyaḥ ṣaḍvidhasya yā viṣayasya upalabdhiḥ sā tṛtīyaḥ vijñāna pariṇāmaḥ iti vākya śeṣaḥ ṣaḍvidhasya iti ṣaṣ prakārasya rūpa śabda gandha rasa spraṣṭavya dharma ātmakasya viṣayasya yā upalabdhiḥ grahaṇam pratipattiḥ iti arthaḥ sā punar kim kuśala akuśala avyākṛtā iti atas āha kuśala akuśalā dvayā kuśala akuśalā dvaya iti avyākṛtā api alobhāt veṣā mohaiḥ saṃprayuktā kuśalā lobha dveṣa mohaiḥ saṃprayuktā kuśalā kuśala akuśalaiḥ asaṃprayuktā dvayā na kuśalā na akuśala iti arthaḥ

sā punar kīdṛśaiḥ caitasikaiḥ saṃprayujyate kiyantaḥ vā tad saṃprayogiṇaḥ caitasikā iti atas āha sarvatragaiḥ viniyataiḥ kuśalaiḥ ca etasaiḥ asau saṃprayuktā tathā kleśaiḥ upakleśaiḥ tri vedanā ye ete sarvatraga ādayaḥ uddiṣṭāḥ te na vijñāyante iti atas tad pradarśana artham āha adyāḥ sparśa ādayaḥ

ādau nirdiṣṭa tvāt ādyāḥ sarvatragāḥ iti arthaḥ tathā hi sadā sparśa manaskāra vid saṃjñā cetana anvitam iti prathamatas nirdiṣṭāḥ sparśaḥ eṣām ādiḥ iti sparśa ādayaḥ te punar sparśa manaskāra ādayaḥ pañca dharmāḥ sarva cittam anugacchanti iti sarvatragāḥ tathā hi ete ālayavijñāne kliṣṭe manasi pravṛtti vijñāneṣu ca aviśeṣeṇa pravartante

viniyatān adhikṛtya āha chanda adhimokṣa smṛtayaḥ saha samādhi dhībhyām niyatāḥ viśeṣe niyata tvāt viniyatāḥ eṣām hi viśeṣaḥ eva viṣayaḥ na sarvaḥ tatra chandaḥ abhiprete vastuni abhilāṣaḥ abhiprete vastuni abhilāṣaḥ iti pratiniyata viṣaya tvam jñāpitam bhavati anabhiprete chanda abhāvāt darśana śravaṇa ādi kriyā viṣaya tvena yat abhimatam vastu tat abhipretam tatra darśana śravaṇa ādi prārthanā chandaḥ sa ca vīrya ārambha saṃniśraya dāna karmakaḥ

adhimokṣaḥ niścite vastuni tathā eva avadhāraṇam niścita grahaṇam aniścita pratiṣedha artham yuktitaḥ āpta upadeśataḥ vā yat vastu asaṃdigdham tat niścitam yena eva ākāreṇa tat niścitam anitya duḥkha ādi ākāreṇa tena eva ākāreṇa tasya vastunaḥ cetasi abhiniveśanam evam etat na anyathā iti avadhāraṇam adhimokṣaḥ sa ca asaṃhāryatā karmakaḥ adhimukti pradhānaḥ hi sva siddhāntāt para pravādibhiḥ apahartum na śakyate

smṛtiḥ saṃstute vastuni asaṃpramoṣaḥ cetasaḥ abhilapana tā saṃstutam vastu pūrva anubhūtam ālambana grahaṇa avipraṇāśa kāraṇa tvāt asaṃpramoṣaḥ pūrva gṛhītasya vastunaḥ punar punar ālambana ākāra smaraṇam abhilapana tā abhilapanam eva abhilapana tā sā punar avikṣepa karmikā ālambana abhilapane sati cittasya ālambana antaraḥ ākāra antare vā vikṣepa abhāvāt avikṣepa karmikā

samādhiḥ upaparīkṣye vastuni cittasya ekāgra tā upaparīkṣyam vastu guṇataḥ doṣataḥ vā ekāgra tā eka ālambanatā jñāna saṃniśraya dāna karmakaḥ samāhite citte yathābhūta parijñānāt dhīḥ prajñā sā api upaparīkṣya eva vastuni pravicayaḥ yoga ayoga vihitaḥ anyathā vā iti pravicinoti iti pravicayaḥ yaḥ samyak mithyā vā saṃkīrṇa sva sāmānya lakṣaṇeṣu iva dharmeṣu viveka avabodhaḥ yuktiḥ yogaḥ sa punar āpta upadeśaḥ anumānam pratyakṣan ca tena tri prakāreṇa yogena yaḥ janitaḥ sa yoga vihitaḥ sa punar śruta mayaḥ cintāmayaḥ bhāvanā mayaḥ ca

tatra āpta vacana prāmāṇyāt yaḥ avabodhaḥ sa śruta mayaḥ yukti nidhyāna jaḥ cintā mayaḥ samādhi jaḥ bhāvanā mayaḥ ayogaḥ anāpta upadeśaḥ anumāna ābhāsaḥ mithyā praṇihitaḥ ca samādhiḥ tena ayogena janitaḥ ayoga vihitaḥ upapatti pratilambhikaḥ laukika vyavahāra avabodhaḥ ca na yoga vihitaḥ na ayoga vihitaḥ eṣā ca saṃśaya vyāvartana karmikā saṃśaya vyāvartanam prajñayā dharmān pravicinvataḥ niścaya lābhāt iti ete hi pañca dharmāḥ parasparam vyatiricya api pravartante evan ca yatra adhimokṣaḥ tatra na avaśyam itaraiḥ api bhavitavyam evam sarvatra vācyam uktāḥ viniyatāḥ

tad anantara uddiṣṭāḥ tu idānīm kuśalāḥ vaktavyāḥ iti atas āha śraddhā atha hrīḥ apatrapā alobha ādi trayam vīryam praśrabdhiḥ sāpramādikā āhiṃsā kuśalāḥ ete ekādaśa dharmāḥ iti vākya śeṣaḥ tatra śraddhā astitva guṇavat tva śakya tveṣu karma phala satya ratneṣu abhisaṃpratyayaḥ prasādaḥ cetasaḥ abhilāṣaḥ śraddhā hi tridhā pravartate sati vastuni guṇavatī aguṇavati vā saṃpratyaya ākārā sati guṇavati ca prasāda ākārā sati guṇavati ca prāptum utpādayitum vā śakye abhilāṣa ākārā cetasaḥ prasādaḥ iti śraddhā hi citta kāluṣya vairodhikī iti atas tad saṃprayoge kleśa upakleśa mala kāluṣya vigamāt cittam śraddhām āgamya prasīdati iti cetasaḥ prasādaḥ ucyate sā punar chanda saṃniśraya dāna karmikā

hrīḥ ātmānam dharmam vā adhipatim kṛtvā avadyena lajjā sadbhiḥ garhita tvāt aniṣṭa vipāka tvāt ca pāpam eva avadyam tena avadyena kṛtena akṛtena vā yā cittasya āvalīna tā lajjā sā hrīḥ iyam ca duścarita saṃyama saṃniśraya dāna karmikā apatrāpyam lokam adhipatim kṛtvā avadyena lajjā loke hi etat garhitam mām ca evam karmāṇam viditvā garhiṣyati iti aśloka ādi bhayāt avadyena lajjate idam api duścarita saṃyama saṃniśriya dāna karmakam

alobhaḥ lobha pratipakṣaḥ lobhaḥ nāma bhave bhava upakaraṇeṣu ca yāsaktiḥ prārthanā ca tad pratipakṣaḥ alobhaḥ bhave bhava upakaraṇeṣu vānāsaktiḥ vaimukhyan ca ayan ca duścarita apravṛtti saṃniśraya dāna karmakaḥ adveṣaḥ dveṣa pratipakṣaḥ maitrī dveṣaḥ hi sattveṣu duḥkhe duḥkha sthānīyeṣu ca dharmeṣu āghātaḥ adveṣaḥ dveṣa pratipakṣa tvāt sattveṣu duḥkhe duḥkha sthānīyeṣu ca dharmeṣu anāghātaḥ ayam api duścarita apravṛtti saṃniśraya dāna karmakaḥ

amohaḥ moha pratipakṣaḥ yathābhūta saṃpratipattiḥ mohaḥ karma phala satya ratneṣu ajñānam moha pratipakṣa tvāt amohaḥ teṣu eva karma phala satya ratneṣu saṃpratipattiḥ ayam api duścarita apravṛtti saṃniśraya dāna karmakaḥ vīryam kausīdya pratipakṣaḥ kuśale cetasaḥ abhyutsāhaḥ na tu kliṣṭe kliṣṭe tu utsāhaḥ kutsita tvāt kausīdyam eva etat ca kuśala pakṣa paripūraṇa pariniṣpādana karmakam

praśrabdhiḥ dauṣṭhulya pratipakṣaḥ kāya citta karmaṇya tā dauṣṭhulyam kāya cittayoḥ akarmaṇya tā sāṃkleśika dharma bījāni ca tad apagame praśrabdhi sadbhāvāt tatra kāya karmaṇyatā kāyasya sva kāryeṣu laghu samutthāna tā yatas bhavati citta karmaṇya tā samyak manasikāra saṃprayuktasya cittasya āhlāda lāghava nimittam yat caitasikam dharma antaram yat yogāt cittam avyāhatam ālambane pravartate atas tat citta karmaṇyatā iti ucyate kāyasya punar spraṣṭavya viśeṣaḥ eva prīti āhṛtaḥ kāya praśrabdhiḥ veditavyā prīta manasaḥ kāyaḥ praśrabhyate iti sūtre vacanāt iyam tad vaśena āśraya parāvṛttitaḥ aśeṣa kleśa āvaraṇa niṣkarṣaṇa karmikā

sāpramādikā saha apramādena pravartate iti sāpramādikā kā punar asau upekṣā kutas etat ekānta kuśala tvāt sarva kuśalānām ca iha nirdeśa adhikārāt śraddhā ādi vat sākṣāt anirdeśāt tad vyatiriktāni akuśala abhāvāt ca upekṣā eva vijñāyate tatra apramādaḥ pramāda pratipakṣaḥ alobhāt yāvat vīryam apramādaḥ yān alobha ādīn niśritya akuśalān dharmān prajahāti tad pratipakṣān ca kuśalān dharmān bhāvayati te alobha ādayaḥ apramādaḥ atas eva pramāda pratipakṣaḥ pramādasya atas viparīta tvāt sa punar laukika lokottara saṃpatti paripūraṇa karmakaḥ

upekṣā citta samatā citta praśaṭha tā citta anābhoga tā ebhiḥ tribhiḥ padaiḥ upekṣāyai ādi madhya avasāna avasthā dyotitā tatra laya auddhatyam vā cetasaḥ vaiṣamyam tasya abhāvāt ādau citta sama tā tatas anabhisaṃskāreṇa aprayatvena samāhitasya cetasaḥ yathāyogam samasya eva yā pravṛttiḥ sā citta praśaṭha tā sā punar avasthā laya auddhatya śaṅkā anugata acira bhāvita tvāt tatas bhāvanā prakarṣa gamanāt tad vipakṣa dūrī bhāvāt tad śaṅkā abhāve laya auddhatya pratipakṣa nimitteṣu ābhogam akurvataḥ anābhoga avasthā cittasya anābhogatā iyan ca sarva kleśa upakleśa anavakāśa saṃniśraya dāna karmikā

avihiṃsā vihiṃsā pratipakṣaḥ vadha bandhana ādibhiḥ sattvānām aviheṭhanam avihiṃsā sattveṣu karuṇā kam ruṇaddhi iti karuṇā kam iti sukhasya ākhyā sukham ruṇaddhi iti arthaḥ kāruṇikaḥ hi para duḥkha duḥkhī bhavati iti iyam ca aviheṭhana karmikā uktāḥ ekādaśa kuśalāḥ tad anantara uddiṣṭāḥ tu kleśāḥ iti atas tān adhikṛtya āha

kleśāḥ rāga pratigha mūḍhayaḥ māna dṛś vicikitsāḥ ca iti rāgaḥ ca pratighaḥ ca mūḍhiḥ ca rāga pratigha mūḍhayaḥ tatra rāgaḥ bhava bhogayoḥ adhyavasānam prārthanā ca sa punar duḥkha saṃjanana karmakaḥ duḥkham atra upādāna skandhāḥ teṣām kāmarūpa ārūpya tṛṣṇā vaśāt abhinirvṛtteḥ atas rāgasya duḥkha saṃjananam karma nirdiśyate

pratighaḥ sattveṣu āghātaḥ sattveṣu rūkṣa citta tā yena āviṣṭaḥ sattvānām vadha bandhana ādikam anarthan cintayati sa punar asparśa vihāra duścarita saṃniśriya dāna karmakaḥ sparśaḥ sukham tena sahitaḥ vihāraḥ sparśa vihāraḥ na sparśa vihāraḥ asparśa vihāraḥ duḥkha sahitaḥ iti arthaḥ āghāta cittasya avaśyam daurmanasya samudācārāt cittam tapyate citta anuvidhānāt ca kāyaḥ api tapyate eva iti sarveḥ yāpatheṣu sa duḥkha sa vighātaḥ asparśa vihāraḥ bhavati pratihata cittasya ca na kiñcid duścaritam vidūraḥ iti pratighaḥ asparśa vihāra duścarita saṃniśraya dāna karmakaḥ uktaḥ

mohaḥ apāyeṣu sugatau nirvāṇe tad pratiṣṭhā pākeṣu hetuṣu teṣām ca aviparīte hetu phala saṃbandhe yat ajñānam ayan ca saṃkleśa utpatti saṃniśriya dāna karmakaḥ tatra kleśa karma janma ātmakaḥ trividhaḥ saṃkleśaḥ tasya utpattiḥ pūrva pūrva saṃkleśa nimittāt uttarottarasya saṃkleśasya ātma lābhaḥ tasya utpatteḥ saṃniśraya dāna karma mūḍhasya eva hi mithyājñāna saṃśaya rāga ādi kleśa paunarbhavika karma janmanām pravṛtteḥ na amūḍhasya iti

mānaḥ mānaḥ hi nāma sarve eva sat kāya dṛṣṭi samāśrayeṇa pravartate sa punar cittasya unnati lakṣaṇaḥ tathā hi ātma ātmīya bhāvam skandheṣu adhyāropyāyam aham idam mama iti ātmānam tena tena viśeṣeṇa unnamayati anyebhyaḥ adhikam manyate sa ca agaurava duḥkha utpatti saṃniśraya dāna karmakaḥ agauravam guruṣu guṇavatsu ca pudgaleṣu stabdha tā kāya vācoḥ apraśrititā duḥkha utpattiḥ punar atra punarbhava utpattiḥ sa ca punar citta unnati svarūpa abhede api citta unnati nimitta bhedāt saptadhā bhidyate mānaḥ atimānaḥ iti evamādi

hīnāt kula vijñāna vitta ādibhiḥ śreyān asmi kula vijñāna vitta ādibhiḥ iti yā cittasya unnatiḥ sadṛśena vā kula ādibhiḥ eva sadṛśaḥ asmi iti yā cittasya unnatiḥ sa mānaḥ atimānaḥ kula vijñāna vitta ādibhiḥ sadṛśāt tyāga śīla pauruṣa ādibhiḥ śreyān asmi śreyasā vā kula vidyā ādibhiḥ sadṛśaḥ asmi vijñāna vitta ādibhiḥ iti ayam atimānaḥ

śreyasaḥ kula vijñāna vittaiḥ aham eva śreyān asmi kula vijñāna vittaiḥ iti yā cittasya unnatiḥ ayam māna atimānaḥ asmimānaḥ pañca su upādāna skandheṣu ātma ātmīya rahiteṣu ātma ātmīya abhiniveśāt yā cittasya unnatiḥ saḥ asmimānaḥ abhimānaḥ aprāptaḥ uttare viśeṣa adhigame prāptaḥ mayā iti yā cittasya unnatiḥ saḥ abhimānaḥ

ūna mānaḥ bahu antara viśiṣṭāt kula vidyā ādibhiḥ alpa antara hīnaḥ asmi kula vidyā ādibhiḥ iti yā cittasya unnatiḥ ayam ūna mānaḥ mithyāmānaḥ aguṇavataḥ guṇavān asmi iti yā cittasya unnatiḥ sa mithyāmānaḥ aguṇāḥ hi dauḥśīlya ādayaḥ te yasya vidyante saḥ aguṇavān tasmāt guṇavān asmi iti anena hi dāna śīla ādi abhāve api guṇavat tvam abhyupagatam bhavati iti atas nirvastuka tvāt mithyāmānaḥ iti ucyate

dṛś iti sāmānya nirdeśe api kleśa adhikārāt pañca eva kleśa ātmikāḥ sat kāya dṛṣṭi ādikāḥ dṛṣṭayaḥ saṃbadhyante na laukikī samyak dṛṣṭiḥ anāsravā vā āsām tu kliṣṭa nitīraṇa ākāra tvāt aviśeṣe api ālambana ākāra bhedāt parasparataḥ bhedaḥ tatra sat kāya dṛṣṭiḥ yat pañca su upādāna skandheṣu ātma ātmīya darśanam anta grāha dṛṣṭiḥ teṣu eva pañca su upādāna skandheṣu ātma ātmīya tvena gṛhīteṣu yat ucchedataḥ śāśvatataḥ vā darśanam

mithyādṛṣṭiḥ yayā mithyā dṛṣṭyā hetum vā apavadati phalam kriyām vā sat vā vastu nāśayati sā sarva darśana pāpa tvāt mithyādṛṣṭiḥ iti ucyate dṛṣṭa parāmarśaḥ pañca su upādāna skandheṣu agratas viśiṣṭataḥ śreṣṭhataḥ paramatas ca yat darśanam śila vrata parāmarśaḥ pañca su upādāna skandheṣu śuddhitaḥ muktitaḥ nairyāṇikataḥ ca yat darśanam vicikitsā karma phala satya ratneṣu vimatiḥ vividhā matiḥ vimatiḥ syāt na syāt iti prajñātaḥ ca iyam jāti antaram eva uktā

uktāḥ ṣaṣ kleśāḥ tad anantara uddiṣṭāḥ tu idānīm upakleśāḥ vaktavyāḥ iti atas āha krodha upanāhane punar mrakṣaḥ pradāśaḥ īrṣyā atha mātsaryam saha māyayā śāṭhyam madaḥ avihiṃsā hrīḥ atrapā styānam uddhataḥ āśraddhyam atha kausīdyam pramādaḥ muṣitā smṛtiḥ vikṣepaḥ asaṃprajanyan ca kaukṛtyam middham eva ca vitarkaḥ ca vicāraḥ ca iti upakleśāḥ dvaye dvidhā

tatra krodhaḥ vartamānam apakāram āgamya yaḥ cetasaḥ āghātaḥ ayam ca āghāta svarūpa tvāt pratighān na bhidyate kim tu asya pratighasya avasthā viśeṣe prajñapta tvāt pratighāṃśikaḥ vartamānam apakāram āgamya yaḥ cetasaḥ āghātaḥ sattva asattva viṣayaḥ daṇḍa dāna ādi saṃniśraya dāna karmakaḥ ca sa krodhaḥ iti prajñapyate

upanāhaḥ vaira anubandhaḥ krodhāt ūrdhvam mama anena idam apakṛtam iti asya vaira ātmakasya anuśayasya anutsargaḥ prabandhena pravartanam upanāhaḥ ayan ca akṣānti saṃniśraya dāna karmakaḥ akṣāntiḥ apakāra āmarṣaṇam pratyapakāra cikīrṣā ca ayam api krodha vat pradveṣa avasthā viśeṣe prajñapyate atas prajñaptisan eva veditavyaḥ

mrakṣaḥ ātmanaḥ avadya pracchādanā chanda dveṣa bhaya ādīn nirākṛtya kāle tad hita eṣiṇā ca udakena tat tvam evaṃkārī iti anuyuktasya moha aṃśikī avadya pracchādanāḥ mrakṣaḥ moha aṃśika tvam tu mrakṣasya pracchādana ākāra tvāt ayan ca kaukṛtya asparśa saṃniśraya dāna karmakaḥ dharmatā eṣā yat avadyam pracchādayataḥ kaukṛtyam utpadyate kaukṛtyāt ca avaśyam daurmanasyena saṃprayogāt asparśa vihāraḥ iti

pradāśaḥ caṇḍava cā udāśitā caṇḍam vacaḥ pragāḍham pāruṣyam marma ghaṭṭana yogena daśana śīlaḥ dāśī tad bhāvaḥ dāśitā ayan ca bhāva pratyayaḥ svārthikaḥ caṇḍena vacasā pradaśati iti caṇḍava cā udāśitā ayan ca krodha upanāha pūrvakaḥ cetasaḥ āghāta svabhāvaḥ iti pratighā aṃśikaḥ eva na dravyataḥ vidyate ayan ca vāc duścarita prasava karmakaḥ asparśa vihāra karmakaḥ ca tadvataḥ pudgalasya duḥkha saṃvāsa tvāt īrṣyā para saṃpattau cetasaḥ vyāroṣaḥ lābha satkāra adhyavasitasya lābha satkāra kula śīla śruta ādīn guṇa viśeṣān parasya upalabhya dveṣa aṃśikaḥ amarṣa kṛtaḥ cetasaḥ vyāroṣaḥ īrṣyā svam āśrayam vyāpya roṣaḥ vyāroṣaḥ daurmanasya saṃprayogāt tad pūrvakaḥ ca asparśa vihāraḥ iti daurmanasya asparśa vihāra karmikā ucyate

mātsaryam dāna virodhī cetasaḥ āgrahaḥ upāttam vastu dharma āmiṣa kauśala ātmakam yena pūjā anugraha kāmyayā arthine anarthine vā dīyate tat dānam tasmin sati dāna abhāvāt tat virodhi iti ucyate lābha satkāra adhyavasitasya jīvita upakaraṇeṣu rāga aṃśikaḥ cetasaḥ āgrahaḥ aparityāga icchā mātsaryam idam ca asaṃlekha saṃniśraya dāna karmakam asaṃlekhaḥ punar mātsaryeṇa anupayujyamānānām api upakaraṇānām saṃnicayāt veditavyaḥ

māyā para vañcanāya abhūta artha saṃdarśana tā lābha satkāra dhyavasitasya para vañcana abhiprāyeṇa anyathā avasthitasya śīla ādeḥ arthasya anyathā prakāśanā iyan ca sahitābhyām rāga mohābhyām abhūtān guṇān prakāśayataḥ tayoḥ samuditayoḥ prajñapyate iti krodha ādi vat prajñaptitaḥ eva na dravyate iti mithyā jīva saṃniśraya dāna karmikā

śāṭhyam sva doṣa pracchādana upāya saṃgṛhītan cetasaḥ kauṭilyam sva doṣa pracchādana upāyaḥ para vyāmohanam tat punar anyena anyat pratisaran vikṣipati aparisphuṭam vā pratipadyate atas eva śāṭhyam mrakṣāt bhidyate sa hi sphuṭam eva pracchādayati na kākvā idam api lābha satkāra adhyavasita upāyābhyām rāga mohābhyām sva doṣa pracchādana artham para vyāmohanāya pravartate tayoḥ eva sahitayoḥ prajñapyate idan ca samyak avavāda lābha paripantha karmakam samyak avavādasya yaḥ lābhaḥ yoniśas manasikāraḥ tasya antarāyam karoti

madaḥ sva saṃpattau raktasya uddharṣaḥ cetasaḥ paryādānam kula ārogya yauvana bala rūpa aiśvarya buddhi medhā prakarṣaḥ sva saṃpattiḥ uddharṣaḥ harṣa viśeṣaḥ yena harṣa viśeṣeṇa cittam asvatantrīkriyate tena tad ātma tantrīkaraṇāt paryāttam bhavati iti etat uktan cetasaḥ paryādānam iti ayan ca sarva kleśa upakleśa saṃniśraya dāna karmakaḥ

vihiṃsā sattva viheṭhanā vividhaiḥ vadha bandhana tāḍana tarjana ādibhiḥ sattvānām hiṃsā vihiṃsā viheṭhyante anayā sattvāḥ vadha bandhana ādibhiḥ duḥkha daurmanasya utpādanāt iti sattva viheṭhanā sā punar pratighāṃśikī nirghṛṇa tā sattveṣu citta rūkṣa tā sattva viheṭhana karmikā vihiṃsā iti ucyate āhrīkyam svayam avadyena ālajjā tasmin karmaṇi ātmānam ayogyam manyamānasya api yāvadyena ālajjā sāhrīkyam hrī vipakṣa bhūtam

anapatrāpyam paratas avadyena ālajjā lokaśāstra viruddham etat mayā kriyate iti evam avagacchataḥ api yā tayā pāpa kriyayā alajjā sāpatrāpya vipakṣa bhūtam anapatrāpyam etat ca dvayam api sarva kleśa upakleśa sāhāyya karmakam rāga dveṣa moha prakāreṣu sarva asat kārya prabhava hetuṣu rāga dveṣayoḥ ayaugapadyāt yathāsaṃbhavam prajñapyate na tu svatantram asti

styānan cittasya akarmaṇya tā staimityam stimitasya bhāvaḥ staimityam yat yogāt cittam jaḍībhavati stimitam bhavati na ālambanam pratipattum samutsahate etat ca sarva kleśa upakleśa sahāyya dāna karmakam moha aṃśe prajñapta tvāt ca moha aṃśikam eva na pṛthak vidyate auddhatyam cittasya avyupaśamaḥ vyupaśamaḥ hi śamathaḥ tad viruddhaḥ avyupaśamaḥ sa punar eṣa rāga anukūlam pūrva hasita rasita krīḍita ādi anusmarataḥ cetasaḥ avyupaśama hetuḥ śamatha paripantha karmakaḥ

āśraddhyām karma phala satya ratneṣu anabhisaṃpratyayaḥ śraddhā vipakṣaḥ śraddhā hi astitva guṇavat tva śakya tveṣu abhisaṃpratyayaḥ prasādaḥ abhilāṣaḥ ca yathākramam aśraddhā tad viparyeṇa astitva guṇavat tva śakya tveṣu anabhisaṃpratyayaḥ aprasādaḥ anabhilāṣaḥ ca kausīdya saṃniśraya dāna karmakam aśraddadhānasya prayoga chanda abhāvāt kausīdya saṃniśraya dāna karmaka tvam

kausīdyam kuśale cetasaḥ anabhyutsāhaḥ vīrya vipakṣaḥ kuśale kāya vāc manaḥ karmaṇi nidrā pārśva śayana sukham āgamya yaḥ moha aṃśikaḥ cetasaḥ anabhyutsāhaḥ etat ca kuśala pakṣa prayoga paripantha karmakam pramādaḥ yaiḥ lobha dveṣa moha kausīdyaiḥ kleśāt rāga dveṣa moha ādikāt cittam na rakṣati kaśalam ca tad pratipakṣa bhūtam na bhāvayati teṣu lobha dveṣa moha kausīdyeṣu pramādaḥ prajñapyate ayan ca akuśala vṛddhi kuśala parihāṇi saṃniśraya dāna karmakaḥ

muṣitā smṛtiḥ kliṣṭā smṛtiḥ kliṣṭā iti kleśa saṃprayuktā iyan ca vikṣepa saṃniśraya dāna karmikā vikṣepaḥ rāga dveṣa moha aṃśikaḥ cetasaḥ visāraḥ vividham kṣipyate anena cittam iti vikṣepaḥ yaiḥ rāga dveṣa mohaiḥ cittam samādhi ālambanāt bahis kṣipyate teṣu yathāsaṃbhavam vikṣepaḥ prajñapyate eṣa ca vairāgya paripantha karmaḥ

asaṃprajanyam kleśa saṃprayuktā prajñā yayā saṃviditā kāya vāc citta caryā abhikrama pratikrama ādiṣu vartate karaṇīyā karaṇīyā jñānāt etat ca āpatti saṃniśraya dāna karmakam kaukṛtyam cetasaḥ vipratisāraḥ kutsitam kṛtam iti kukṛtam tad bhāvaḥ kaukṛtyam iha tu kukṛta viṣayaḥ cetasaḥ vilekhaḥ kaukṛtyam caitasikā adhikārāt etat ca citta sthiti paripantha karmakam

middham asvatantra vṛtti cetasaḥ abhisaṃkṣepaḥ vṛttiḥ ālambane pravṛttiḥ sā asvatantrā cetasaḥ yatas bhavati tat middham kāya sandhāraṇā samarthā vā vṛttiḥ cetasaḥ asvatantrā sā yatas bhavati tat middham abhisaṃkṣepaḥ cetasaḥ cakṣuḥ ādi indriya dvāreṇa apravṛttiḥ etat ca moha aṃśe prajñapanāt moha aṃśikam kṛtyā atipatti saṃniśraya dāna karmakan ca

vitarkaḥ paryeṣakaḥ manaḥ jalpaḥ prajñā cetanā viśeṣaḥ paryeṣakaḥ kim etat iti nirūpaṇa ākāra pravṛttaḥ manasaḥ jalpaḥ manaḥ jalpaḥ jalpaḥ iva jalpaḥ jalpaḥ artha kathanam cetanā prajñā viśeṣaḥ iti cetanāyāḥ citta parispanda ātmaka tvāt prajñāyāḥ ca guṇa doṣa viveka ākāra tvāt tad vaśena citta pravṛtteḥ kadācid citta cetanayoḥ vitarkaḥ prajñaptiḥ kadācid prajñā cetasoḥ yathākramam anabhyūha abhyuha avasthayoḥ atha vā cetanā prajñayoḥ eva vitarkaḥ prajñaptiḥ tad vaśena cittasya tathā apravṛtta tvāt saḥ eva cittasya audārika tā audārika tā iti sthūla tā vastu mātra paryeṣaṇa ākāra tvāt eṣa ca nayaḥ vicāre api draṣṭavyaḥ vicāraḥ api hi cetanā prajñā viśeṣa ātmakaḥ pratyavekṣakaḥ manaḥ jalpaḥ eva idam tat iti pūrva adhigata nirūpaṇāt atas eva ca citta sūkṣma tā iti ucyate

etau ca sparśa asparśa vihāra saṃniśraya dāna karmakau anayoḥ ca audārika sūkṣma tayā vyavasthāpanāt pṛthakkaraṇam dvaye dvidhā iti dvayan ca dvayan ca dvaye te punar kaukṛtyam iddhe vitarka vicārau ca ete ca catvāraḥ dharmāḥ dvidhā kliṣṭāḥ akliṣṭāḥ ca tatra akuśalam akṛtvā kuśalan ca kṛtvā yaḥ cetasaḥ vilekhaḥ tat saṃkliṣṭam kaukṛtyam yat kuśalam akṛtvā akuśalan ca kṛtvā tat kaukṛtyam akliṣṭam

middham api kliṣṭa citta āviddham kliṣṭa citta saṃprayuktam ca kliṣṭam akliṣṭa citta āviddham akliṣṭa citta saṃprayuktan ca akliṣṭam kāma vyāpāt avihiṃsā ādi vitarkāḥ kliṣṭāḥ naiṣkramya ādi vitarkāḥ akliṣṭāḥ evam para upaghāta upāya vicāraḥ kliṣṭaḥ para anugraha upāya vicāraḥ akliṣṭaḥ tatra ye kaukṛtyam iddha vitarka vicārāḥ kliṣṭāḥ te eva upakleśāḥ na itare

tatra yathā rūpa śabda ādi upalabdhiḥ ṣaṣ prakārāḥ yathāsaṃbhavam sarvaiḥ caitasikaiḥ saṃprayujyate sarvatragaiḥ viniyataiḥ kuśalaiḥ kleśaiḥ upakleśaiḥ ca evam tri vedanā tisṛbhiḥ ca vedanābhiḥ saṃprayujyate sukhayā duḥkhayā aduḥkha asukhayā ca saumanasya daurmanasya upekṣā sthānīyeṣu rūpa ādiṣu tad utpatteḥ kuśalāḥ akuśalāḥ avyākṛtā ca ālayavijñānan tu sarvatragaiḥ pañcabhiḥ eva saṃprayujyate na anyaiḥ tatra ca upekṣā eva vedanā anivṛta avyakṛtan ca kliṣṭam manaḥ sarvatragaiḥ pañcabhiḥ caturbhiḥ ca kleśaiḥ ātma moha ādibhiḥ sadā saṃprayujyate tatra upekṣā eva vedanā nivṛta avyākṛtan ca iti

idam idānīn cintyate kim pañcānān cakṣuḥ vijñāna ādīnām yugapad ālambana pratyaya sānnidhye api ālaya vijñānāt ekasya eva utpattiḥ bhavati na dvayoḥ na bahūnām vā yathā eke manyante na dvayoḥ na bahūnām vā yugapad samanantara pratyaya abhāvāt ekasya eva vijñānasya utpattiḥ bhavati na ca ekam vijñānam bahūnām samantara pratyaya tvam pratipattum utsahate uta aniyamena yadi ekasya eva pratyaya sāṃnidhyam ekam eva utpadyate evam dvayoḥ bahūnān ca pratyaya sāṃnidhye utpattiḥ bhavati iti atas āha pañcānām mūla vijñāne yathāpratyayam udbhavaḥ vijñānānām saha na vā taraṅgāṇām yathā jale

pañcānām iti cakṣuḥ ādi vijñānānām tad anucara manaḥ vijñāna sahitānām pañcānām cakṣuḥ ādi vijñānānām bīja āśraya tvāt tad utpatteḥ gatiṣu janma upādānāt cālaya vijñānam mūla vijñānam iti ucyate yathāpratyayam udbhavaḥ iti yasya yasya yaḥ pratyayaḥ saṃnihitaḥ tasya tasya niyamena udbhavaḥ ātma lābhaḥ saha na vā iti yugapad krameṇa vā taraṅgāṇām yathā jalaḥ iti ālayavijñānāt pravṛtti vijñānānām yugapad ayugapad ca utpattau dṛṣṭāntaḥ yathā uktam

tat yathā viśāla mate mahataḥ udaka oghasya vahataḥ saced ekasya taraṅgasya utpatti pratyayaḥ pratyupasthitaḥ bhavati ekam eva taraṅgam pravartate saced dvayoḥ trayāṇām saṃbahulānām taraṅgāṇām utpatti pratyayaḥ pratyupasthitaḥ bhavati yāvat saṃbahulāni taraṅgāṇi pravartante na ca tasya udaka oghasya srotasā vahataḥ samucchittiḥ bhavati na paryupayogaḥ prajñāyate evam eva viśāla mate tat ogha sthānīyam ālayavijñānam saṃniśritya pratiṣṭhāya saced ekasya cakṣuḥ vijñānasya utpatti pratyayaḥ pratyupasthitaḥ bhavati ekam eva cakṣuḥ vijñānam pravartate saced dvayoḥ trayāṇām saced pañcānām vijñānānām utpatti pratyayaḥ pratyupasthitaḥ bhavati sakṛt yāvat pañcānām pravṛttiḥ bhavati

atra gāthā ādāna vijñāna gabhīra sūkṣmaḥ oghaḥ yathā vartati sarva bījaḥ bālānaḥ eṣaḥ mayi na prakāśi mā ha eva ātmā parikalpayeyuḥ iti na hi vijñāna pratiniyamena ālambana pratyaya vat samanantara pratyayaḥ iṣyate sarva vijñāna utpattau sarvasya vijñānasya tad samanantara pratyaya tva abhyupagamāt atas ekasmāt api samanantara pratyayāt ālambana pratyaya sānnidhye dvayoḥ bahūnām vā vijñānānām utpattiḥ na virūdhyate kiñ ca atra kāraṇam yat samanantara pratyaya pratiniyama abhāve pañcānān ca yugapad ālambana pratyaya sānnidhyaḥ ekena eva utpattavyam na pañcabhiḥ api iti tasmāt alambana sadbhāve pañcānām api ca utpattiḥ iti abhyupeyam

idam īdānīm vaktavyam kim manaḥ vijñānam cakṣuḥ ādi vijñānaiḥ saha pravartate vinā ca uta na eva iti atas āha manaḥ vijñāna saṃbhūtiḥ sarvadā saṃjñikāt ṛte samāpatti dvayāt middhāt mūrcchanāt api acittakāt iti sarvadā iti sarvakālam cakṣuḥ ādi vijñānaiḥ saha vinā ca iti arthaḥ asya utsargasya imam apavādam ārabhate āsaṃjñikāt ṛte samāpatti dvayāt middhāt mūrcchanāt api acittakāt iti tatra asaṃjñikam asaṃjñi sattveṣu deveṣu upapannasya yaḥ citta caitasikānām dharmāṇām nirodhaḥ samāpatti dvayam asaṃjñi samāpattiḥ nirodha samāpattiḥ ca

tatra asaṃjñi samāpattiḥ tṛtīyāt dhyānāt vīta rāgasya ūrdhvam avīta rāgasya niḥsaraṇa saṃjñā pūrvakeṇa manasikāreṇa manaḥ vijñānasya tad saṃprayuktānān ca caittānām yaḥ nirodhaḥ saḥ atra asaṃjñi samāpattiḥ iti ucyate nirudhyate anena iti nirodhaḥ sa punar sa saṃprayogasya manaḥ vijñānasya samudācāra nirodhaḥ āśrayasya avasthā viśeṣaḥ sa ca samāpatti cittāt anantaran citta antara utpatti viruddhaḥ āśrayaḥ prāpyate iti samāpattiḥ iti ucyate nirodha samāpattiḥ ākiñcani āyatana vīta rāgasya śānta vihāra saṃjñā pūrvakeṇa manasikāreṇa sa saṃprayogasya manaḥ vijñānasya kliṣṭasya ca manasaḥ yaḥ nirodhaḥ iyam api asaṃjñi samāpatti vat āśrayasya avasthā viśeṣe prajñapyate

acittakam middham gāḍham iddha upahata tvāt āśrayasya tāvatkālam manaḥ vijñāna apravṛtteḥ acittakam iti ucyate acittikā mūrcchā āgantukena abhighātena vāta pitta śleṣma vaiṣamyeṇa vā yat āśraya vaiṣamyam manaḥ vijñāna pravṛtti viruddham tatra acittikā mūrcchā upacaryate etāḥ pañca avasthā varjayitvā tad anyāsu sarvāsu avasthāsu manaḥ vijñāna pravṛttiḥ veditavyā evam āsaṃjñika ādiṣu manaḥ vijñāne niruddhe tad apagame punar kutas utpadyate yatas tasya kāla kriyā na bhavati tat punar ālaya vijñānāt eva utpadyate tat dhi sarva vijñāna bījakam iti yatra vijñāna pariṇāme ātma dharma upacāraḥ sa punar tridhā iti uddiśya vistareṇa trividhaḥ api nirdiṣṭaḥ

idānīm ātma dharma upacāraḥ yaḥ pravartate sa vijñāna pariṇāmaḥ eva na vijñāna pariṇāmāt ca pṛthak asti ātmā dharmā ca iti yat pratijñātam tad prasādhana artham āha vijñāna pariṇāmaḥ ayam vikalpaḥ yat vikalpyate tena tat na asti tena idam sarvam vijñāpti mātrakam iti yaḥ ayam vijñāna pariṇāmaḥ trividhaḥ anantaram abhihitaḥ saḥ ayam vikalpaḥ adhyāropita artha ākārāḥ traidhātukāḥ citta caittāḥ vikalpaḥ ucyate yathā uktam

abhūta parikalpaḥ tu citta caittāḥ tri dhātukāḥ iti tena trividhena vikalpena ālaya vijñāna kliṣṭa manaḥ pravṛtti vijñāna svabhāvena sa saṃprayogeṇa yat vikalpyate bhājanam ātmā skandha dhātu āyatana rūpa śabda ādikam vastu tat na asti iti atas sa vijñāna pariṇāmaḥ vikalpaḥ ucyate asat ālambana tvāt katham punar etat vijñāyate tad ālambanam asat iti yat dhi yasya kāraṇam tasmin samagre ca aviruddhe ca tat utpadyate na anyathā vijñānan ca māyā gandharvanagara svapna timira ādau asati api ālambane jāyate yadi ca vijñānasya ālambana pratibaddhaḥ utpādaḥ syāt evam sati māyā ādiṣu artha abhāvāt na vijñānam utpadyate

tasmāt pūrvakāt niruddhāt tad jātīya vijñānāt vijñānam utpadyate na bāhyāt arthāt tasmin asati api bhāvāt dṛṣṭā ca abhinne api arthe pratipattṝṇām paraspara viruddhā pratipattiḥ na ca ekasya paraspara viruddha an eka ātmaka tvam yujyate tasmāt adhyāropita rūpa tvāt vikalpasya ālambanam asat iti pratipattavyam

anena tāvat samāropa antam parihṛtya apavāda anta pariji hīrṣayā āha tena idam sarvam vijñāpti mātrakam iti tena iti tasmāt yasmāt pariṇāma ātmakena vikalpena yat vikalpyate tena tat na asti tasmāt viṣaya abhāvāt sarvam vijñaptimātrakam sarvam iti traidhātukam asaṃskṛtan ca mātra śabdaḥ tad adhika viṣaya vyavaccheda arthaḥ kakāraḥ pāda pūraṇa arthaḥ

yadi sarvam vijñaptimātrakam eva na tatas anyaḥ kartā karaṇam vā asti katham mūla vijñānāt anadhiṣṭhitāt asati karaṇe vikalpāḥ pravartante iti āha sarva bījam hi vijñānam pariṇāmaḥ tathā tathā yāti anyonya vaśāt yena vikalpaḥ sa sa jāyate tatra sarva dharma utpādana śakti anugamāt sarva bījam vijñānam iti ālaya vijñānam vijñānam hi asarva bījam api asti iti atas sarva bījam iti āha vijñānāt anyat api kaiścid pradhāna ādi sarva bījam kalpyate iti vijñānam iti āha atha vā eka pada vyabhicāre api viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya tva darśanāt na ayam doṣaḥ

pariṇāmaḥ tathā tathā yāti anyonya vaśāt iti pūrva avasthātaḥ anyathā bhāvaḥ pariṇāmaḥ tathā tathā iti tasya tasya vikalpasya anantara utpādana samartha avasthām prāpnoti iti arthaḥ anyonya vaśāt iti tathā hi cakṣuḥ ādi vijñānam sva śakti paripoṣe vartamāne śakti viśiṣṭasya ālaya vijñāna pariṇāmasya nimittam saḥ api ālaya vijñāna pariṇāmaḥ cakṣuḥ ādi vijñānasya nimittam bhavati evam anyonya vaśāt yasmāt ubhayam pravartate tasmāt ālaya vijñānāt anyena anadhiṣṭhitāt aneka prakāraḥ vikalpaḥ sa sa jāyate tatra ca vartamāne janmani yathā ālaya vijñānāt pravṛtti vijñānasya utpattiḥ bhavati tathā ākhyātam

idānīm vijñaptimātre anāgatam janma vartamāna janma nirodhe sati yathā pratisaṃdhīyate tat pradarśayan āha karmaṇaḥ vāsanā grāha dvaya vāsanayā saha kṣīṇe pūrva vipāke anyam vipākam janayanti tat iti puṇya apuṇyāneñjya cetanā karma tena karmaṇā yat anāgata ātma bhāva abhinirvṛttaye ālayavijñāne sāmarthyam āhitam sā karma vāsanā grāha dvayam grāhya grahaḥ grāhaka grāhaḥ ca tatra vijñānāt pṛthak eva sva santāna adhyāsitam grāhyam asti iti adhyavasāyaḥ grāhya grāhaḥ tat ca vijñānena pratīyate vijñāyate gṛhyate iti yaḥ ayam niścayaḥ sa grahaka grāhaḥ pūrva utpanna grāhya grāhaka grāha ākṣiptam anāgata tajjātīya grāhya grāhaka grāha utpatti bījam grāha dvaya vāsanā tatra karma vāsanā bhedāt gati bhedena ātma bhāva bhedaḥ bīja bhedāt aṅkura bheda vat

grāha dvaya vāsanā tu sarva karma vāsanānām yathāsvam ākṣipta ātma bhāva utpādane pravṛttānām sahakāri tvam pratipadyate tat yathā ap ādayaḥ bījasya aṅkura utpattau iti evan ca na kevalāḥ karma vāsanā grāha dvaya vāsanā ananugṛhītāḥ vipākan janayanti iti uktam bhavati atas eva āha graha advaya vāsanayā saha iti kṣīṇe pūrva vipāke anyam vipākam janayanti tat iti

pūrva janma upacitena karmaṇā yaḥ iti vipākaḥ abhinirvṛttaḥ tasmin kṣīṇaḥ iti ākṣepa kāle paryanta avasthite yathābalam karma vāsanā grāha dvaya vāsanā sahitāḥ upabhūktāt vipākāt anyam vipākam tat eva ālaya vijñānam janayanti ālayavijñāna vyatirekeṇa anyasya vipākasya abhāvāt kṣīṇe pūrva vipākaḥ iti anena śāśvata antam pariharati anyam vipākam janayanti iti uccheda antam

cakṣuḥ ādi vijñāna vyatiriktam ālaya vijñānam asti tat eva ca sarva bījakam na cakṣuḥ ādi vijñānam iti kutas etat āgamāt yuktitaḥ ca uktam hi bhagavatā abhidharmasūtre anādikālikaḥ dhātuḥ sarva dharma samāśrayaḥ tasmin sati gatiḥ sarvāḥ nirvāṇa adhigamaḥ api ca na ca ālaya vijñānam antareṇa saṃsāra pravṛttiḥ nivṛttiḥ vā yujyate tatra saṃsāra pravṛttiḥ nikāya sa bhāga antareṣu pratisandhi bandhaḥ nivṛttiḥ sa upadhi śeṣaḥ nirupadhi śeṣaḥ ca nirvāṇa dhātuḥ tatra ālaya vijñānāt anyat saṃskāra pratyayam vijñānam na yujyate saṃskāra pratyaya vijñāna abhāve pravṛtteḥ api abhāvaḥ

saṃsārasya ālaya vijñāna anabhyupagame pratisandhi vijñānam vā saṃskāra pratyayam parikalpyeta saṃskāra paribhāvitāḥ vā ṣaṭ vijñāna kāyāḥ tatra ye saṃskārāḥ prātisaṃdhika vijñāna pratyaya tvena iṣyante teṣān cira niruddha tvāt niruddhasya ca asatvāt asataḥ ca pratyaya tva abhāvāt na saṃskāra pratyayam pratisandhi vijñānam yujyate pratisandhau ca nāma rūpam api asti na kevalam vijñānam tatra vijñānam eva saṃskāra pratyayam na nāma rūpam iti kā tatra yuktiḥ tasmāt saṃskāra pratyayam nāma rūpam iti vāktavyam na tu vijñānam iti katamat anyat vijñāna pratyayam nāma rūpam yat uttarakālam iti ced tasya prātisandhika nāma rūpāt kaḥ ātmā atiśayaḥ yatas tat eva vijñāna pratyayam na pūrvam pūrvan ca saṃskāra pratyayam na uttaram iti atas ca saṃskāra pratyayam nāma rūpam eva astu kim pratisandhi vijñānena aṅga antareṇa parikalpitena tasmāt na pratisandhi vijñānam saṃskāra pratyatyayam yujyate

saṃskāra paribhāvitāḥ vā ṣaṣ vijñāna kāyāḥ api na saṃskāra pratyayam vijñānam yujyate kim kāraṇam na hi vijñānam vipāka vāsanām niṣyanda vāsanām vā sva ātmani ādhātum samartham sva ātmani kāritra virodhāt na api anāgate tasya tadā anutpanna tvāt anutpannasya ca asattvāt na api utpanne pūrvasya tadā niruddha tvāt acittikāsu ca nirodha samāpatti ādi avasthāsu punar saṃskāra paribhāvita citta utpatti asaṃbhavāt vijñāna pratyayam nāma rūpam na syāt tad abhāvāṭ ṣaṣ āyatanam na syāt evam yāvat jāti pratyayam jarā maraṇam na syāt tatas ca saṃsāra pravṛttiḥ eva na syāt

tasmāt avidyā pratyayāḥ saṃskārāḥ tad adhivāsitan cālaya vijñānam saṃskāra pratyayam vijñānam tad pratyayam pratisandhau nāma rūpam iti eṣā eva nītiḥ anavadyā saṃsāra nivṛttiḥ api ālayavijñāne asati na yujyate saṃsārasya hi karma kleśāḥ ca kāraṇam tayoḥ ca kleśāḥ pradhānam tathā hi kleśa ādhipatyāt karma punarbhava ākṣepa samartham bhavati na anyathā tathā ākṣipta punarbhavaḥ api karma kleśa ādhipatyāt eva punarbhavaḥ bhavati na anyathā evan ca kleśāḥ eva saṃsāra pravṛtteḥ pradhāna tvāt mūlam atas teṣu prahīṇeṣu saṃsāraḥ vinivartate na anyathā na ca ālaya vijñānam antareṇa tad prahāṇam yujyate

katham punar na yujyate saṃmukhībhūtaḥ vā kleśaḥ prahīyate bīja avasthaḥ vā tatra saṃmukhībhūtaḥ prahīyate iti aniṣṭiḥ eva iyam tad prahāṇa mārga sthānāt bīja avasthaḥ api na eva prahīyate na hi pratipakṣāt tadānīm kiñcid anyat abhyupagamyate yatra kleśa bījam vyavasthitam tad pratipakṣeṇa prahīyeta atha pratipakṣa cittam eva kleśa bīja anuṣaktam iṣyate na hi tat kleśa bīja anuṣaktam eva tad pratipakṣaḥ bhavitum arhati na ca aprahīṇa kleśa bījānām saṃsāra nivṛttiḥ saṃbhavati tasmāt avaśyam ālayavijñānam tad anya vijñāna sahabhūbhiḥ kleśa upakleśaiḥ

bhāvyate sva bīja puṣṭi ādhānataḥ iti abhyupeyam ye punar cittataḥ eva saṃtati pariṇāma viśeṣāt yathābalam vāsanā vṛtti lābhe sati kleśa upakleśāḥ pravartante teṣān cālaya vijñāna vyavasthitam bījam tad sahabhuvā kleśa pratipakṣa mārgeṇa apanīyate tasmin ca apanīte na punar tena āśrayeṇa kleśānām utpattiḥ iti sa upadhi śeṣaḥ nirvāṇa dhātuḥ prāpyate pūrva karma ākṣipta janma nirodhe ca tatas anya janma apratisaṃdhānāt nirupadhi śeṣaḥ nirvāṇa dhātuḥ na hi karma vidyamānam api kleśeṣu prahīṇeṣu sahakāri kāraṇa bhāvāt punarbhavam abhinirvartayitum samartham evam ālaya vijñāne sati saṃsāra pravṛttiḥ nivṛttiḥ ca na anyathā iti avaśyam cakṣuḥ ādi vijñāna vyatiriktam ālayavijñānam tat eva ca sarva dharma bīja anugatam na cakṣuḥ ādi vijñānam iti abhyupagantavyam vistara vicāraḥ tu pañca skandha kopa nibandhāt veditavyaḥ

yadi vijñaptimātram eva idam katham na sūtra virodhaḥ sūtreṣu hi trayaḥ svabhāvāḥ uktāḥ parikalpitaḥ paratantraḥ pariniṣpannaḥ ca na asti virodhaḥ vijñaptimātre eva sati svabhāva traya vyavasthānāt katham iti atas āha yena yena vikalpena yat yat vastu vikalpyate parikalpitaḥ eva asau svabhāvaḥ na sa vidyate ādhyātmika bāhya vikalpya vastu bhedena vikalpānām ānantyam pradarśayan āha yena yena vikalpena iti yat yat vastu prakalpyate ādhyātmikam bāhyam vāntaśas yāvat buddha dharmāḥ api parikalpitaḥ eva asau svabhāvaḥ iti atra kāraṇam āha na sa vidyate iti

yat vastu vikalpya viṣayaḥ tat yasmāt sattā bhāvāt na vidyate tasmāt tat vastu parikalpita svabhāvam eva na hetu pratyaya pratibaddha svabhāvam tathā hi ekasmin vastuni tad abhāve ca paraspara viruddha aneka vikalpa pravṛttiḥ dṛṣṭā na ca tat ekam vastu tad abhāvaḥ vā paraspara viruddha aneka svabhāvaḥ yujyate tasmāt sarvam idam vikalpa mātram eva tad arthasya parikalpita rūpa tvāt uktam ca sūtre na khalu punar subhūte dharmāḥ tathā vidyante yathā bāla pṛthagjanāḥ abhiniviṣṭāḥ iti

yathā uktam abhūta parikalpaḥ tu citta caittāḥ tri dhātukāḥ iti paraiḥ hetu pratyayaiḥ tantryate iti paratantraḥ utpādyate iti arthaḥ svatas anya hetu pratyaya pratibaddha ātma lābhaḥ iti yāvat uktam bhavati uktaḥ paratantraḥ

pariniṣpannaḥ katham iti atas āha niṣpannaḥ tasya pūrveṇa sadā rahita tā tu yā avikāra pariniṣpattyā sa pariniṣpannaḥ tasya iti paratantrasya pūrveṇa iti parikalpitena tasmin vikalpe grāhya grāhaka bhāvaḥ parikalpitaḥ tathā hi tasmin vikalpe grāhya grāhaka tvam avidyamānam eva parikalpyate iti parikalpitam ucyate tena grāhya grāhakeṇa paratantrasya sadā sarvakālam atyantarahita tā yā sa pariniṣpanna svabhāvaḥ atas eva sa na eva anyaḥ na ananyaḥ paratantrataḥ

atas eva sa na eva iti parikalpitena svabhāvena paratantrasya sadā rahita tā pariniṣpannaḥ rahita tā ca dharma tā sā ca dharmatā dharmāt na anyā na ananyā yujyate pariniṣpannaḥ ca paratantra dharmatā iti atas paratantrāt pariniṣpannaḥ na anyaḥ na ananyaḥ iti boddhavyaḥ yadi hi pariniṣpannaḥ paratantrāt anyaḥ syāt evam na parikalpitena paratantraḥ śūnyaḥ syāt atha ananyaḥ evam api pariniṣpannaḥ na viśuddha ālambanaḥ syāt paratantra vat saṃkleśa ātmaka tvāt evam paratantraḥ ca na kleśa ātmakaḥ syāt pariniṣpannāt ananya tvāt pariniṣpanna vat

anitya tā ādi vat vācyaḥ na anyaḥ na ananyaḥ iti vākya śeṣaḥ yathā hi anitya tā duḥkha tā ana ātma tā ca saṃskāra ādibhyaḥ na anyā na ananyā yadi saṃskārebhyaḥ anitya tā anyā evam tarhi saṃskārāḥ nityāḥ syuḥ atha ananyāḥ evam api saṃskārāḥ pradhvaṃsa abhāva rūpāḥ syuḥ anitya tāvat evam duḥkha tā ādiṣu api vācyam yadi grāhya grāhaka bhāva rahitaḥ paratantraḥ katham asau gṛhyate agṛhyamāṇaḥ vā katham asti iti vijñāyate atas āha

na adṛṣṭe asmin sa dṛśyate na adṛṣṭe asmin iti pariniṣpanna svabhāve sa dṛśyate iti paratantraḥ svabhāvaḥ nirvikalpa loka uttara jñāna dṛśye pariniṣpanne svabhāve adṛṣṭe apratividdhe asākṣātkṛte tad pṛṣṭha labdha śuddha laukika jñāna gamya tvāt paratantraḥ anyena jñānena na gṛhyate atas pariniṣpanne adṛṣṭe paratantraḥ na dṛśyate na punar loka uttara jñāna pṛṣṭha labdhena api jñānena na dṛśyate

tathā nirvikalpa praveśāyām dhāraṇyām uktam tat pṛṣṭha labdhena jñānena māyā marīci svapna pratiśrutka udaka candra nirmita samān sarva dharmān pratyeti iti atra ca dharmāḥ paratantra saṃgṛhītāḥ abhipretāḥ pariniṣpannaḥ ca ākāśa vat ekarasaḥ jñānan ca yathā uktam nirvikalpena jñānena ākāśa sama tayā tān sarva dharmān paśyati iti paratantra dharmāṇām tathatā mātra darśanāt

yadi dravyam eva paratantraḥ katham sūtre sarva dharmāḥ niḥsvabhāvāḥ anutpannāḥ aniruddhāḥ iti nirdiśyante na asti virodhaḥ yasmāt trividhasya svabhāvasya trividhām niḥsvabhāva tām sandhāya sarva dharmāṇām deśitā niḥsvabhāva tā trayaḥ eva svabhāvāḥ na caturthaḥ asti iti jñāpana artham saṃkhyā nirdeśaḥ svena svena lakṣaṇena vidyamāna vat bhavati iti svabhāvaḥ trividhā niḥsvabhāva tā lakṣaṇa niḥsvabhāva tā utpatti niḥsvabhāva tā parama artha niḥsvabhāva tā ca sarva dharmāḥ parikalpita paratantra pariniṣpanna ātmakāḥ

idānīm trividhasya svabhāvasya yā yasya niḥsvabhāva tā tām tasya pradarśayan āha prathamaḥ lakṣaṇena eva niḥsvabhāvaḥ aparaḥ punar na svayaṃbhāvaḥ etasya iti aparā niḥsvabhāva tā dharmāṇām parama arthaḥ ca sa yatas tathatā api saḥ prathamaḥ parikalpitaḥ svabhāvaḥ ayam ca lakṣaṇena eva niḥsvabhāvaḥ tad lakṣaṇasya utprekṣita tvāt rūpa lakṣaṇam rūpam anubhava lakṣaṇāḥ vedanā ityādi atas ca svarūpa abhāvāt kha puṣpa vat sva rūpeṇa eva niḥsvabhāvaḥ

aparaḥ punar iti paratantra svabhāvaḥ na svayaṃbhāvaḥ etasya māyā vat para pratyayena utpatteḥ atas ca yathā prakhyāti tathā asya utpattiḥ na asti iti atas asya utpatti niḥsvabhāvatā iti ucyate dharmāṇām parama arthaḥ ca sa yatas tathatā api saḥ iti paramam hi loka uttara jñānam niruttara tvāt tasya arthaḥ parama arthaḥ atha vā ākāśa vat sarvatra ekarasa arthena vaimalya avikāra arthena ca pariniṣpannaḥ svabhāvaḥ parama arthaḥ ucyate sa yasmāt pariniṣpannaḥ svabhāvaḥ sarva dharmāṇām paratantra ātmakānām parama arthaḥ tat dharma tā iti kṛtvā tasmāt pariniṣpannaḥ eva svabhāvaḥ parama artha niḥsvabhā vātā pariniṣpannasya abhāva svabhāva tvāt

kim punar parama artha abhidhānena eva pariniṣpannaḥ abhidhātavyaḥ na iti āha kim tarhi tathatā api saḥ api śabdāt na kevalam tathatā śabdena eva abhidhātavyaḥ kim tarhi yāvantaḥ dharmadhātu paryāyāḥ sarvaiḥ taiḥ api abhidhātavyaḥ iti sarvakālam tathā abhāvāt tathatā tathā hi pṛthagjana śaikṣā śaikṣa avasthāsu sarvakālam tathā eva bhavati na anyathā iti tathatā iti ucyate

kim punar tathatāvat pariniṣpannaḥ eva vijñaptimātra tā uta anyā vijñaptimātra tā atas āha sā eva vijñaptimātra tā su viśuddha lakṣaṇa avabodhāt yathā uktam nāmni tiṣṭhati tat cittam tadā tanmātra darśanāt nāmni sthānāt ca vijñaptau upalambhaḥ prahīyate na upalambham tadā dhātum spṛśate bhāvanā anvayāt sarva āvaraṇa vimokṣam vibhu tvam labhate tadā iti sā eva vijñaptimātra tā iti anena vacanena abhisamayaḥ uktaḥ

yadi vijñaptimātram eva idam kasmāt cakṣuḥ śrotra ghrāṇa rasana sparśanaiḥ rūpa śabda gandha rasa sparśān gṛhṇāti iti asya bhavati iti atas āha yāvat vijñaptimātra tve vijñānam na avatiṣṭhate grāha dvayasya anuśayaḥ tāvat na vinivartate atha vā yāḥ tāḥ karma vāsanāḥ grāha dvaya vāsanā sahitāḥ kṣīṇe pūrva vipāke anyam vipākam janayanti iti uktam tasmāt katham prahāṇam aprahāṇam ca iti atas āha yāvat vijñaptimātra tve vijñānam na avatiṣṭhata

iti vistaraḥ yāvat citta dharma tāyām vijñaptimātra saṃśabditāyām vijñānam na avatiṣṭhate kim tarhi grāhya grāhaka upalambhe carati grāha dvayam grāhya grāhaḥ grāhaka grāhaḥ ca tasya anuśayaḥ tat ā ahitam anāgata grāha dvaya utpattaye bījam ālaya vijñāne yāvat advaya lakṣaṇe vijñaptimātra tve yoginaḥ cittam na pratiṣṭhitam bhavati tāvat grāhya grāhaka anuśayaḥ na vinivartate na prahīyate iti arthaḥ atra ca bahis upalambha aprahāṇena ādhyātmika upalambhā prahāṇam darśitam iti atas asya evam bhavati aham cakṣuḥ ādibhiḥ rūpa ādīn gṛhṇāmi iti

idam idānīm vaktavyam kim artha rahita citta mātra upalambhāt citta dharmatā avasthānam na iti āha kim tarhi vijñapti mātram eva idam iti api hi upalambhataḥ sthāpayan agratas kiñcid tanmātre na avatiṣṭhate iti atha vā yaḥ punar ābhimānikaḥ śruta mātrakeṇa jānīyat aham vijñaptimātra tāyām śuddhāyām sthitaḥ iti tad graha vyudāsa artham āha vijñapti mātram eva idam iti api hi upalambhata

ityādi vijñapti mātram eva idam artha rahitam na bāhyaḥ arthaḥ asti iti evam upalambhataḥ grahaṇataḥ citrīkaraṇataḥ iti arthaḥ agratas iti abhimukham sthāpayan iti yathāśrutam manasā bahu prakāra tvāt yoga ācāra ālambanānām kiṃcid iti āha asthi saṃkalikam vā vinīlakam vā vipūyakam vā vipaḍumakam vā vyādhmātaka ādikam vā tanmātre na avatiṣṭhate vijñāna upalambha aprahāṇāt

kadā punar vijñāna grāhasya prahāṇam citta dharma ātāyān ca pratiṣṭhitaḥ bhavati iti atas āha yadā tu ālambanam jñānam na eva upalabhate tadā sthitam vijñaptimātra tve grāhya abhāve tad agrahāt yasmin kāle deśanā ālambanam avavāda ālambanam prākṛtam vā rūpa śabda ādi ālambanam jñānam bahis cittān na upalabhate na paśyati na gṛhṇāti na abhiniviśate yathābhūta artha darśanāt na tu jāti andha vat tasmin kāle vijñāna grāhasya prahāṇam sva citta dharmatāyām ca pratiṣṭhitaḥ bhavati atra eva kāraṇam āha

grāhya abhāve tad agrahāt iti grāhye sati grāhakaḥ bhavati na tu grāhya abhāvaḥ iti grāhya abhāve grāhaka abhāvam api pratipadyate na kevalam grāhya abhāvam evam hi sama samālambya ālambakam nirvikalpam loka uttaram jñānam utpadyate grāhya grāhaka abhiniveśa anuśayāḥ prahīyante sva citta dharmatāyām ca cittam avasthitam bhavati

yadā evam vijñaptimātra tāyām cittam avasthitam bhavati tadā katham vyapadiśyate iti āha acittaḥ anupalambaḥ asau jñānam lokottaran ca tat āśrayasya parāvṛttiḥ dvidhā dauṣṭhulya hānitaḥ saḥ eva anāsravaḥ dhātuḥ acintyaḥ kuśalaḥ dhruvaḥ sukhaḥ vimukti kāyaḥ asau dharma ākhyaḥ ayam mahā muneḥ

iti tat anena śloka dvayena darśana mārgam ārabhya uttara viśeṣa gatyā phala saṃpattiḥ udbhāvitāḥ vijñapti mātra tā praviṣṭa yoginaḥ tatra grāhaka citta abhāvāt grāhya artha anupalambhāt ca acittaḥ anupalambhaḥ asau anucita tvāt loke samudācāra abhāvāt nirvikalpa tvāt ca lokāt uttīrṇam iti jñānam lokottaran ca tat iti

tasya jñānasya anantaram āśrayasya parāvṛttiḥ bhavati iti jñāpana artham āha āśrayasya parāvṛttiḥ iti āśrayaḥ atra sarva bījakam ālaya vijñānam tasya parāvṛttiḥ yā dauṣṭhulya vipāka dvaya vāsanā bhāvena nivṛttau satyām karmaṇyata adharma kāya advaya jñāna bhāvena parāvṛttiḥ sā punar āśraya parāvṛttiḥ kasya prahāṇāt prāpyate atas āha

dvidhā dauṣṭhulya hānitaḥ dvidhā iti kleśa āvaraṇa dauṣṭhulyam jñeya āvaraṇa dauṣṭhulyan ca dauṣṭhulyam āśrayasya akarmaṇya tā tat punar kleśa jñeya āvaraṇayoḥ bījam sā punar āśraya parāvṛttiḥ śrāvaka ādi gata dauṣṭhulya hānitaḥ ca prāpyate yat āha vimukti kāya iti bodhisattva gata dauṣṭhulya hānitaḥ ca prāpyate yat āha

dharma ākhyaḥ ayam mahā muneḥ iti dvidhā āvaraṇa bhedena sa uttarā niruttarā ca āśraya parāvṛttiḥ uktā atra gāthā jñeyam ādāna vijñānam dvaya āvaraṇa lakṣaṇam sarva bījam kleśa bījam bandhaḥ tatra dvayoḥ dvayoḥ iti dvayoḥ iti śrāvaka bodhisattvayoḥ ādyasya kleśa bījam itarasya dvaya āvaraṇa bījam tat udghātāt sarvajña tā avāptiḥ bhavati iti

saḥ eva anāsravaḥ dhātuḥ iti saḥ eva āśraya parāvṛtti rūpaḥ anāsravaḥ dhātuḥ iti ucyate nirdauṣṭhulya tvāt sarva āsrava vigataḥ iti anāsravaḥ ārya dharma hetu tvāt dhātuḥ hetu arthaḥ hi atra dhātu śabdaḥ acintyaḥ tarka agocara tvāt pratyātma vedya tvāt dṛṣṭānta abhāvāt ca kuśalaḥ viśuddha ālambana tvāt kṣema tvāt anāsrava dharma maya tvāt ca dhruvaḥ nitya tvāt akṣaya tayā sukhaḥ nitya tvāt eva yat anityam tat duḥkham ayam ca nityaḥ iti tasmāt sukhaḥ

kleśa āvaraṇa prahāṇāt śrāvakāṇām vimukti kāyaḥ saḥ eva āśraya parāvṛtti lakṣaṇaḥ dharma ākhyaḥ api ucyate mahā muneḥ bhūmi pāramitā bhāvanayā kleśa jñeya āvaraṇa prahāṇāt āśraya parāvṛtti samudāgamāt mahā muneḥ dharma kāyaḥ iti ucyate saṃsāra aparityāgāt tad anupasaṃkleśa tvāt bodhisattvānām sarva dharma vibhu tva lābhataḥ ca dharma kāyaḥ iti ucyate mahā muneḥ iti paramauneya yogāt buddhaḥ bhagavān mahā muniḥ iti

vārttika ārambhe śiṣṭa ācāram anuvidadhānaḥ maṅgalam tāvat karoti viśuddha iti dṛṣṭā hi śiṣṭānām pravṛttiḥ sarva kāryeṣu maṅgala ācaraṇa pūrvikā maṅgalam ca devatā stuti namaskāra ādi asya ca niyogataḥ phalavat kārya antara ārambha saṃyogāt sākṣāt aphala tvāt ca phalavat sannidhau aphalam tad aṅgam iti nyāyena kārya antara śeṣa tve avadhṛte satya ārambhasya samāpti paryanta tvāt apekṣita avighna parisamāptiḥ phalam apekṣita vidheḥ anapekṣita vidhānam durbalam iti nyāyena phala antara kalpanāyāḥ durbala tvāt atas yathā sāmpradāyikam adhyāyānadhyāya ādi svādhyāya avighna artham evam idam api tat ayam arthaḥ viśuddhau jñāna dehau yasya sa tathā uktaḥ

viśuddham ca bhagavataḥ jñānam rāga ādibhiḥ jñāna kāraṇānām adūṣita tvāt dehaḥ ca ayonija tvāt vividha garbha vedanā virahāt ca tri vedī ca tasya cakṣuḥ iti gauṇaḥ vādaḥ asandigdha aviparīta spaṣṭa veda artha prakāśaka tvāt divyam ca atīndriya artha gocara tvāt bhautikam hi cakṣuḥ pratyutpanna artha viṣayam idam tu anāgata ādi viṣayam divyam iti śreyasaḥ ca hita ahita prāpti parihāra ātmanaḥ bhagavān nimittam soma ardha dhāriṇe soma kalā dhāriṇe namaḥ iti yadi api vigraha ādi pañcakam devatā adhikaraṇe nirākariṣyate tathā api ājya ādi stotra vat pradhāna karmaṇaḥ eva devatā stuteḥ evaṅkṛtāyāḥ phalam iti adoṣaḥ iti
