nanu ukti visaṃvādāt aprāmāṇyam uktam na ca kiñcid iha visaṃvādaḥ na hi kṛte karmaṇi tāvatī eva phalena bhavitavyam iti śabdaḥ brūte kin tu asya idam phalam iti etāvati ca paryavasānāt atas kāla antare phalam dāsyati tat etat uktam kāla antare phalam dāsyati iti ced iti tat etat āha ānantaryam iti pariharati na sāmarthya iti sākṣāt anuktasya anantaryasya api atra sāmarthyena avabodhanam kṛtam yadā eva hi asya idam phalam iti uktam tadā evam arthāt eva avagamyate anantaram anena bhavitavyam iti katham nāma anyathā asat kāla antare phalam dāsyati iti nanu evam api sāmarthya labhyam ānantaryam anantara phala anupalambhanena bādhyatām aviśeṣa pravṛttā tu codanā katham bādhyate atas āha śabda iti na hi sāmarthyam nāma pṛthak pramāṇam api tarhi sarva ākhyātānām artham bruvatām śaktiḥ sahakāriṇī iti śabda eka deśaḥ eva atas sruva avadānam iva api adravyeṣu arthāt anantaram eva phalam niścīyate iti tad bodhe api śābda bodhaḥ bhavati eva iti

itas ca ānantaryam avagamyate iti āha kāla antara iti yadi hi atra phalam dāsyati iti lṛṅśroṣyat tadā tad sāmarthyena kalpanā kācid api abhaviṣyat adya punar asya idam karmaṇaḥ phalam iti paryavasite vacasi sarva karmaṇām anantara phala upalambhāt vaidikasya api citra ādeḥ codyamānasya api karmaṇaḥ tad svābhāvyāt ānantaryam viśeṣaṇa tayā avatiṣṭhate iti

atra anantaram aparam bhāṣyam dṛṣṭa viruddham api kiñcid vaidikam vacanam saḥ eṣa yajñāyudhī yajamānaḥ añjasā svargam lokam yāti iti tat yena viśeṣeṇa uktam tam āha atra iti atra hi citra ādi vākyeṣu ukti visaṃvādāt aprāmāṇyam uktam uttaratra tu yajña āyudhi vākye pratyakṣa ādi virodhaḥ iti virodham abhidyotayati svargayānaḥ iti yajamānasya niratiśaya ānanda ātmanaḥ svargāt ati dūram apabhraṣṭaḥ bhasmībhāvaḥ pratyakṣam upalabhyate citra ādi codanāsu tu anantara phala anupalambha mātram na tu viruddha upalambhaḥ kaścid asti iti syāt api kāla antare phala kalpanā bhasmībhūtam tu śarīram kāla antare api svargam lokam yāsyati iti na sambhavati iti pūrvasmāt viśeṣaḥ

aparam api ca evaṃjātīyakam pramāṇa viruddham vacanam apramāṇam ambuni majjanti alābūni grāvāṇaḥ plavante iti yathā iti bhāṣyam tat vyācaṣṭe yajña iti vākyam antena yajñāyudha vacaḥ dharmī mṛṣā iti sādhyaḥ dharmaḥ pratyakṣa virodhāt yad pratyakṣa viruddham tat mithyā yathā grāvāṇaḥ plavante iti śilā vākyam sādharmyeṇa yathā iti darśayitavyam iti vaidharmya dṛṣṭāntam āha vaidharmyeṇa iti yat amithyā na tad pratyakṣa viruddham yathā āpta bhāṣitam iti pūrvam tu mardana sukhayoḥ vaidharmye dṛṣṭānta tayā upanyāsāt śilā vākyam api vaidharmyeṇa bhāṣya kṛta uktam iti bhrāntim apanetum sādharmya vaidharmya vivekaḥ vārtika kṛtāḥ darśitaḥ

nanu pratyakṣa virodhāt iti hetuḥ asiddhaḥ eva asti hi para loka phala bhoktā cetanaḥ karmaṇām kartā sa svargam lokam yāsyati iti tam eva abhipretya svargam lokam yāsyati iti uktam atas kaḥ virodhaḥ atas āha śarīrāt iti yadi hi śarīrāt anyaḥ cetanaḥ bhavet bhavet api na tasya yajña āyudhaiḥ asti kaścid sambandha prakāraḥ śarīrasya eva tu sruk kapāla ādi yajña āyudhaiḥ sambandhaḥ yadyajña āyudhī yajamānaḥ iti tad abhiprāyeṇa matu artha saṃyogaḥ ghaṭate api ca saḥ eṣaḥ iti aparokṣa pratinirdeśaḥ saḥ api śarīrasya eva pratyakṣa tvāt upapannaḥ na ātmanaḥ

tat etat api bhāṣya kāreṇa uktam hi śarīrakam vyapadiśati iti kiñ ca yajamāna śabdaḥ hi ātmani asamañjasaḥ yāgasya hi kartā yajamānaḥ iti ucyate na ca yathā codita vitata pūrvā parībhūta aneka karma kṣaṇa ātmaka kratu kriyā kartṛ tvam ātmanaḥ sambhavati vibhoḥ pūrva apara deśa vibhāgasam yoga phala karmaṇām asamavāyāt tat etat āha na ca iti abhyupagamya ca ātmanaḥ sadbhāvam idam asmābhiḥ uktam parama arthena tu deha indriya vyatirikta ātma sadbhāvaḥ api pramāṇa abhāvāt durlabhaḥ iti āha sadbhāvaḥ iti prapañcayiṣyate ca etat ātma vādaḥ iti iha na pratanyate iti

aparam ca na ca eṣa yāti iti vidhi śabdaḥ iti bhāṣyam tasya abhiprāyam āha yadi iti asya arthaḥ yadi hi atra yajña āyudhi vākye vidhi śabdaḥ bhavet tadā citra ādīnām anantara phala adarśanāt bhedena virodha upanyāsa artham yajña āyudhi vākya upādānam na upapadyate atas sva kṛta bheda upādāna samarthana artham vidhi śabda nirākaraṇam iti vidhi śabde kaḥ viśeṣaḥ atas āha vidhīti vidhi śabde hi kāla viśeṣa anupādānāt vidhi sāmarthyāt eva kāla antara bhāvitām phalasya parikalpya syāt api citra ādi codanāsu iva abhāva virodha parihāraḥ iha tu yāti iti vartamāna apadeśāt na pratyakṣa virodhaḥ śakyate parihartum iti adarśanāt viśeṣaḥ iti

citra ādi vākya abhiprāyeṇa ca idam asmābhiḥ uktam vidhi śabde bhaviṣyat tvam phalasya parikalpya virodhaḥ śakyate parihartum iti iha tu pratyakṣeṇa bhasmībhāva upalambhāt na kāla antara phala bhāvitayā svarga gamanam phalam iti śakyate kalpayitum na hi vidhi sahasreṇa api āśaṅkanīyaḥ arthaḥ śakyaḥ pratyāyayitum tat etat āha phalam ca iti kim tarhi vidhi śabda tā nirākaraṇasya phalam atas āha tad sāmarthyena iti cetana pravartana ātmakaḥ hi vidhiḥ antareṇa para loka phala upabhoktāram anupapadyamānaḥ kalpayet api kāya karaṇa saṅghāta atiriktam ātmānam tasya ca svarga loka gamanam upacaryeta api śarīre tasya vā pratyakṣa tvam ātmani bhāktam iti evamādi kalpanā niṣedha artham vidhi śabda nirākaraṇam iti

bhūyān ca ayam pramāṇa antara viruddhaḥ mantra arthavāt ātmakaḥ veda bhāgaḥ yathā aditiḥ dyauḥ aditiḥ antarīkṣam yajamānaḥ eka kapālaḥ iti evamādiḥ sa ca sarve eva atra prayatnataḥ mukhya tayā mithyātvena aihika ākṣepe pakṣī kāryaḥ tat mithyā tvena ca ānuṣaṅgikam pareṣām mithyātvam bhaviṣyati iti abhiprāyeṇa āha prāyas iti

tad sāmānyāt agnihotra ādi codanāsu api anāśvāsaḥ iti bhāṣyam tasya abhiprāyam āha evam sati iti yadā hi citra ādi vākya ādiṣu aprāmāṇyam samarthitam bhavati tadā veda vākya eka deśa tayā agnihotra ādi vākyeṣu api mṛṣā artha tā śakyate anumātum atas kṛtsnasya eva vedasya aprāmāṇyāt na codanā lakṣaṇa arthaḥ dharmaḥ iti ākṣepaḥ

atra anantaram autpattikaḥ tu śabdasya arthena sambandhaḥ tasya jñānam iti bhāṣya kāreṇa sambandha nitya tā dvāreṇa ākṣepa parihāraḥ avatāritaḥ saḥ ayuktaḥ paroktā kṣepa hetu anantaram hi tasya eva viruddha asidhya ādi doṣa udbhāvanam ucitam yat tu tam adūṣayitvā eva anyat ucyate tad asaṅgatam eva atas āha sva pakṣaḥ iti ayam abhiprāyaḥ yāvat dhi sambandha autpattika tvena anapekṣā lakṣaṇam codanāyāḥ svatas prāmāṇyam na pratipādyate tāvat dūṣite api sādhane na codanā lakṣaṇaḥ dharmaḥ iti pratijñā sidhyati bhūyān ca anena krameṇa arthaḥ vaktum abhipretaḥ śabda artha sambandha nirūpaṇa ādiḥ anyathā kriyamāṇam tad ākāśa patitam iva āpadyeta tat ca etat śabda svarūpa nirūpaṇa avasare vakṣyate na ca idam ākṣepeṇa na saṅgacchate dvedhā api pratyavasthāna darśanāt yathā uktam

dvedhā api pratyavasthānam para hetu avabādhanāt ātmīya sādhana uktyā vā tatra ātmīyam iha ucyate iti na ca atra para sādhana dūṣaṇah na kariṣyate tatra hetoḥ asiddhatvam iti citrā parihāre vakṣyate anena tu krameṇa tat kartavyam iti tāvat iti uktam iti tat ca sva pakṣa sādhanam tārkikāṇām cittam anurañjayitum prayoga dvāreṇa āha amṛṣā iti vaidika vacaḥ dharmī sva arthe satyam iti sādhyaḥ dharmaḥ sva arthe vaktra napekṣa tvāt yat sva arthe vaktāram na apekṣate tat satyam yathā padāt padārtha gatā buddhiḥ padam hi svabhāvāt eva sva arthena sambaddham tad pratipādanāya vaktāram na apekṣate iti sambandha parihāre vakṣyate sva arthaḥ iti tantreṇa ubhaya viśeṣaṇa tayā yojanīyam

yadi hi amṛṣā vaidikam vacanam iti etāvat ucyate pūrva pakṣa artha samyaktva āpātāt aniṣṭa artha tā prasādhana prasaṅgaḥ na hi svarga kāmaḥ yāgam kuryāt iti ādi arthe svarga kāmaḥ yajeta iti vākyam samyak iṣyate ṣaṣṭha ādi a siddhānta virodhāt yāgena svargam kuryāt iti hi tatra sthāsyati vaktra napekṣa tvāt iti ca aviśiṣṭaḥ hetuḥ upāttaḥ asiddhaḥ eva syāt asti hi vaidika vākyānām api svarūpa abhivyaktaye vaktrapekṣā sva arthe tu pratyāyayitavye na vaktāram apekṣante apauruṣeya tvāt śabda artha sambandha nitya tvāt ca pauruṣeyam pramāṇa antara pramita gocaram āpta vacanam api vaktuḥ pramāṇam apekṣate yathā uktam āpta uktiṣu nara apekṣā iti

prayoga antaram āha tad kṛtaḥ iti eva antena vaidika vākya kṛtaḥ pratyayaḥ samyak iti sādhyam nitya vākya udbhava tvāt yathā tad vākya svarūpa viṣayā buddhiḥ sā api hi vākyāt udbhavati nirviṣaya budhi anutpatteḥ veda vākya nitya tā ca veda adhikaraṇe sthāpayiṣyate iti atra eva sādhye pūrva uktāḥ na anya tvāt iti bhāṣya vyākhyāna avasaraḥ uktāḥ doṣa varjitaiḥ kāraṇaiḥ janyamāna tvāt anāpta apraṇīta ukti janya tvāt deśa ādi bhede api bādha varjanāt iti hetavaḥ darśayitavyāḥ iti āha atra iti

atra bhāṣyam syāt etat na eva śabdasya arthena sambandhaḥ kutas asya pauruṣeya tāḥ apauruṣeya tā vā iti tasya abhiprāyam āha nityān iti abravīt antena asya arthaḥ śabda artha sambandhānām nitya tvam āśritya anapekṣa tvāt iti sūtrakāreṇa yaḥ hetuḥ svatas prāmāṇya sidhi artham uktaḥ tena codanānām aprāmāṇye nirākṛte adhunā sambandha udbhava tva abhāvena paraḥ bauddha ādiḥ mithyātvam uktavān evam ca tadā vārtikakāreṇa vṛtti kāra matena atra eva svatas prāmāṇyam vyutpādyam iti darśitam tathā ca sūtrakāreṇa ca ucyate iti punarukti parihāre paratas prāmāṇya uktaiḥ eva ākṣepa hetubhiḥ pūrva pakṣaḥ abhihitaḥ iha api ca bhāṣya kāreṇa brūtaḥ iti ucyate avabodhayati budhyamānasya nimittam bhavati ityādi codanā sūtra uktam eva svatas prāmāṇya kāraṇam uktam iti

etat eva vivṛṇoti sambandhaḥ iti vakṣyate antena codanām idhyā artha nirāsa artham hi sambandha sadbhāvaḥ nitya tā ca hetuḥ uktaḥ tat ca dvayam api paraiḥ na iṣyate tatra sambandha abhāvaḥ tāvat anena eva bhāṣyeṇa uktaḥ kṛtaka tvam tu yadi prathamam aśrutaḥ na pratyāyayati kṛtakaḥ tarhi iti anena vakṣyate tat atra sambandha abhāvena anapekṣa tvāt iti hetoḥ asiddhiḥ uktā na ca asati sambandhe para uktā artha pratītiḥ utpadyate iti darśitam pratibandha bale hi artha antara darśinaḥ api artha antare jñānam utpadyate anādṛta pratibandhaḥ tu yat kiñcid vidvān sa sarvam jānīyāt iti ati prasajyate iti

atra bhāṣya kāreṇa kārya kāraṇa bhāva ādayaḥ sambandhāḥ śabdasya anupapannāḥ iti uktvā saṃśleṣa sambandha bhāvaḥ eva darśitaḥ tat etat vārtikakāraḥ darśayati asambhavena iti nimitta naimittika āśraya āśrayi bhāva ādayaḥ sambandhāḥ śabda arthayoḥ atyanta asambhāvitāḥ eva kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ tu bauddha gandhi vaiyākaraṇaiḥ abhyupagataḥ eva te api āhuḥ arthāḥ śabdāḥ ca dṛśyante pratyakṣāḥ yadi api sphuṭam abhidhāna abhidheyau tu jñāna ākārau tathā api naḥ

iti evam hi manyante na tāvat varṇāḥ śabdaḥ pratyekam avācaka tvāt ayugapad vartinām ca avayavi samudāya ārambha anupapatteḥ atas eva go śabda tva ādi jātya sambhavāt bhūta ādi viśeṣāṇām ca pratiprayogam anya tvena avācaka tvāt varṇa buddhi smṛti saṃskārāṇām ca akṣara vat pratyākhyānāt pūrva varṇa janita saṃskāra sahita antya varṇasya api varṇa tvena apūrva varṇa vat avācaka tvāt pūrva pūrva nikhila varṇa pada upasahāra krameṇa caramasya kasyacid sphoṭa ātmanaḥ anavagrahāt yugapad ava sthita aneka varṇa ākāra jñāna ātmā eva śabdaḥ arthaḥ api jāti vyakti avayava avayavi guṇa guṇi vyatireka avyatireka ādi vikalpa dūrīkṛta nirūpaṇaḥ na bāhya s sambhavati iti jñāna ātmaka śabda vedanā anantara utpadyamāna bāhya jāti ādi nirbhāsa pratyaya mātra ātmā eva sa ca ayam evambhūtaḥ arthaḥ śabdena janyataḥ eva iti kārya kāraṇa bhāvam eva śabda arthayoḥ sambandham ātiṣṭhante tat ca idam ati dūram apabhraṣṭam evam ca sati avidita svarūpa śaktīnām api artha saṃvid upajāyeta

dṛṣṭā hi khalu mṛd salila pracchannāḥ api vrīhayaḥ aṅkura ādi kāryam ārabhamāṇāḥ avidita svarūpa śaktayaḥ api iti sūktam asambhavena śeṣāṇām iti katham tu saṃśleṣaḥ pariśiṣyate iti pratīteḥ abhyupagamāt ca gauḥ ayam iti hi sāmānādhikaraṇyena śabda upaśliṣṭam artham avayantaḥ laukikāḥ dṛśyante abhyupagataḥ ca kaiścid śabda arthayoḥ saṃśleṣaḥ eva sambandhaḥ prapañcitaḥ ca asau adhyāsa vādaḥ iti laukikāḥ ca prāyeṇa saṃśleṣam eva saṃbandham manyante iti saḥ eva sambandhaḥ prasaktaḥ nirākārya iti āha tasmin iti prāha antena niṣedham eva prayogeṇa darśayati na śabdaḥ iti saṃśleṣaḥ hi yasya yena bhavati sa tad deśaḥ eva dṛśyate rañjuḥ iva ghaṭe tad anantara deśe vā pradeśinī iva madhyamāyāḥ na ca śabda arthayoḥ anyatara deśe vā anyataraḥ dṛśyate atas himavat vindhyayoḥ iva nānayoḥ sambandhaḥ iti

arthaḥ vā pakṣīkāryaḥ iti āha evam iti dvayam vā parasparam asambaddham itaretara deśe tad anantara deśe vā adṛṣṭeḥ sādhyam iti āha dvayam iti atra bhāṣya kāreṇa syāt ced arthena sambandhaḥ kṣurama udaka śabda uccāraṇe mukhasya pāṭana pūraṇe syātām iti uktam tasya abhiprāyam āha kṣura iti uktam antena asya arthaḥ atra bhāṣya kāreṇa śabda arthayoḥ sambandha siddhi artham tad deśa anantara adṛṣṭeḥ iti hetuḥ antarṇītaḥ tam ca gauḥ ayam iti sāmānādhikaraṇya pratīti bhramāt yaḥ nāma asiddham manyate saḥ evam pratibodhyate yadi śabda arthayoḥ upaśleṣa lakṣaṇaḥ sambandhaḥ bhavet arthaḥ api śabda deśaḥ eva syāt mukham ca tasya deśaḥ iti kṣurama udaka śabda uccāraṇe mukhasya pāṭana pūraṇe syātām na ca te staḥ tasmāt modaka ādi artha kriyā anupalambhāt śabda deśe tad deśa anantara adṛṣṭeḥ iti siddhaḥ hetuḥ

sāmānādhikaraṇya buddhiḥ tu śabda arthayoḥ na asti eva na hi nīlimnā iva anuraktam utpalam śabda anuraktam artham upalabhāmahe gādi sāsnā ādimat rūpā hi tayoḥ buddhiḥ udeti atra siddhānta bhāṣyam yaḥ atra vyapadeśyaḥ sambandhaḥ tam ekam na vyapadiśati bhavān ityādi tasya abhiprāyam āha atha iti hīna tā antena atra ayam abhiprāyaḥ pratyāyya pratyāyaka śakti rūpaḥ hi naḥ śabda arthayoḥ sambandhaḥ abhipretaḥ tat yadi saṃśleṣa lakṣaṇa sambandha abhāvaḥ sādhyate tadā siddha sādhya tā doṣaḥ sambandha abhāva mātre tu yauna ādi sambandhaiḥ anaikāntika tvam himavat vindhyayoḥ api ca eka bhūmi ādi sambandhāt sādhya hīnaḥ dṛṣṭāntaḥ iti

yadi tu vācya vācaka sambandham eva abhipretya na śabdaḥ arthena saṅgataḥ iti sādhyate tatas laukika virodhaḥ iti āha vācya iti dūṣaṇa antaram āha virodhaḥ iti atra kāraṇam āha na hi iti parāntena ayam abhiprāyaḥ caturvidhaḥ hi puruṣaḥ pratipannaḥ apratipannaḥ sandigdhaḥ viparyastaḥ ca iti tatra pratipannaḥ pratipādayitā itare sa apekṣāḥ pratipādyāḥ tad pratipādana arthā ca pratijñā tat yaḥ eva teṣām anyatamaḥ paraḥ pratipādayitum abhipretaḥ bhavati saḥ eva vācya vācaka sambandha varjitaiḥ pratijñā artha gocaraiḥ padaiḥ pratipādayitum aśakyaḥ atas pratijñām prayuñjānaiḥ āśritaḥ śabda arthayoḥ vācya vācaka lakṣaṇa sambandhaḥ iti tad nirākaraṇe sva vāc virodhaḥ iti sa ca ayam abhidhayā sva vāc virodhaḥ pañcadhā hi tad virodhaḥ uccāraṇa abhidhā dharma dharmī ubhaya uktibhiḥ iti

vācya vācaka sambandha svarūpam idānīm abhidyotayati abhidhāna iti asya arthaḥ ekasyām abhidhāna kriyāyām śabdaḥ karaṇam kartā vā vivakṣātaḥ kāraka pravṛtteḥ arthaḥ tu karma eva atas anayoḥ karma karaṇa tvam karma kartṛ tvam vā nirūpitaḥ sambandhaḥ iti vakṣyamāṇena sambandhaḥ iti yat vā ekasyām gavā ādi artha pratipattau sādhyamānāyām ekena vaktra upādīyamānā varuṇa eka hāyanīvat vivakṣita sāhityau śabda arthau yat niyamyete saḥ anayoḥ sambandhaḥ iti āha pratipattau iti upādānāt iti upādīyamāna tayā viśeṣaṇa vivakṣām darśayati upādeyasya hi viśeṣaṇam vivakṣitam bhavati paśoḥ iva ekatvam paśunā yajeta iti uddeśya viśeṣaṇam tu avivakṣitam bhavati yathā graha viśeṣaṇam eka tvam uddeśyāḥ hi grahāḥ teṣu sammārjana vidhānāt iha ca artha pratipattau ekasyām upādeyau śabda arthau paśuḥ iva yāge atas vivakṣitam anayoḥ sāhityam viśeṣaṇam iti aruṇa eka hāyanyoḥ iva anayoḥ niyamaḥ sambandhaḥ iti

nanu evam aruṇa eka hāyanyoḥ śrūyamāṇayoḥ sāhitya vivakṣā yuktā samudāye hi tatra vākyam samāpyate śabda arthau tu na eva pratīti kriyāyām viśeṣaṇa tayā śrutau katham anayoḥ sāhitya vivakṣā na śrūyamāṇa tā viśeṣaṇa vivakṣā hetuḥ api tu artha saṃvyavahāraḥ api hi pāka ādau yadā odana ādi sthālya ādi kriyā vyavahāra darśanāt anabhihitam api artham jānāti tadā sthālī ādīnām vivakṣitam sāhityam manyate tathā manvānaḥ svayam api paktu kāmaḥ tat sarvam āharati evam iha api bālaḥ prayojya vṛddhasya viśiṣṭa artha vyavahāra darśanena tad viṣayām buddhim anumāya śabda anantara bhāvitayā śabda kāraṇa tām tāvat avadhārayati vaktuḥ ca asyām prayojya vṛddha pratipattau darśana pārārthyāt pradhāna bhūtāyām upādīyamānayoḥ śabda arthayoḥ sāhityam vivakṣitam iti evam ca viditvā svayam api para artha prayoge sahitau śabda arthau hṛdayam āveśitau upādāya śabdam ca uccārya para pratipattim bhāvayati iti sūktam sāhitya vivakṣā varṇa sāhitya vivakṣā vat iti

nanu evam vadatā śabda arthayoḥ kriyā sambandhaḥ eva darśitaḥ na paraspara sambandhaḥ tathā hi yat tāvat uktam abhidhāna kriyāyām hi iti anena abhidhāna kriyā sambandhaḥ eva karma karaṇa ādi rūpeṇa ubhayoḥ upavarṇitaḥ na paraspara sambandhaḥ pratipattau upādānāt iti api pratipādya pratipādaka tayā pratipatti kriyā sambandha mātraḥ eva darśitaḥ na parasparam guṇa pradhāna bhāvam antareṇa sambandha ayogāt vakṣyati hi guṇānām ca parārtha tvāt asambandhaḥ sama tvāt iti syāt etat kriyā kāraka sambandha pūrvaka tvāt sarva sambandhānām kriyā kāraka sambandhaḥ eva darśitaḥ iti astu tāvat tad uttara kāla bhāvī tu kaḥ anayoḥ sambandhaḥ iti vācyam eva tat etat sarvam anubhāṣya pariharati tatra iti tayoḥ antena asya arthaḥ yadi api kārakāṇām pradhāna artha tvāt na paraspara sambandhaḥ tathā api pratipatti abhidhānayoḥ yā kācid kriyā gṛhyate tasyām ca kriyā kāraka sambandha uttara kāla bhāvī paraspara upakārya upakāraka lakṣaṇaḥ śabda arthayoḥ asti sambandhaḥ

tat punar idam pūrva apara viruddham pradeśa antara viruddham ca tathā hi atra tāvat ekasyām kriyāyām upakārya upakāraka tvam śabda arthayoḥ sambandhaḥ iti uktam pratipattau upādānāt iti kriyā anumāna aṅga tvam eva paraspara niyama ātmakaḥ darśitaḥ sambandhaḥ abhidhāna kriyāyām hi iti ca karma tva karaṇa tve sambandhaḥ iti uktam pradeśa antare śaktiḥ eva sambandhaḥ iti vakṣyati kvacid ca śabda śakti niyamam eva sambandham āha

vācya vācaka śaktyoḥ ca niyamaḥ phala lakṣaṇaḥ iti bruvānaḥ anyatra api uktam eka abhidhā nim itta tvam karma kartṛ tvayoḥ ca yat yaḥ vā karaṇa karma tva niyamaḥ abhidhaya ekayā sa naḥ artha śabda sambandhaḥ iti atas vivecanīyam idam kaḥ atra sambandhaḥ śabda arthayoḥ vārttikakārasya abhimataḥ iti

atra ucyate yathā ekena kraya karmaṇā parigṛhītayoḥ dravya guṇayoḥ itaretarāka aṃkṣā paripūraṇena paraspara upakārya upakāraka lakṣaṇaḥ sambandhaḥ na hi anāśritaḥ kraya kriyām abhinirvartayati na dravyam guṇa viśeṣān avacchinnam utsahate kraya kriyām nirvartayitum na ca guṇena sva mahimnā āśraya bhūta dravya mātram upādīyamānam api kraye gṛhyate svakīya gaḥ dravya avarodhāt dravye guṇa mātrā avacchedāt tat guṇa mātram upādīyamānam api kraya kriyā na pratīcchati svakīya aruṇim aguṇa avarodhāt saḥ ayam arthaḥ niyamaḥ sampadyate tat evam iha api eka artha pratipatti abhidhāna kriyā siddhi artham upādīyamānayoḥ vivakṣita sāhityayoḥ śabda arthayoḥ kriyā kāraka sambandha uttara kāla bhāvī yaḥ yam upakārya upakāraka bhāvaḥ saḥ eva sambandhaḥ

kaḥ punar anayoḥ paraspara upakāraḥ śrūyatām arthaḥ hi na pratipādakam antareṇa pratipādyaḥ bhavati śabdaḥ na pratipādyam antareṇa pratipādakaḥ atas pratipādya pratipādaka tayā avatiṣṭhamānau anyonyasya upakārya upakārakau bhavataḥ tat ca idam rūpam anayoḥ niyatam iti atyanta sannikarṣa mātreṇa niyame sambandha abhidhānam na tu niyamaḥ eva sambandhaḥ śakti sambandha vādaḥ api ca atas eva vācya vācaka śaktyoḥ eva hi satyoḥ upakārya upakāraka bhāvaḥ bhavati na tu śaktiḥ eva sambandhaḥ tat atra pratyāsatteḥ abheda upacāreṇa śaktiḥ sambandhaḥ niyamaḥ sambandhaḥ kartṛ tvam karaṇa tvam vā sambandhaḥ iti evamādayaḥ samullāpāḥ vastutas tu upakārya upakāraka tvam eva sambandhaḥ

katham punar tad rūpam anayoḥ niyatam iti ucyate na hi anuccarite śabde paraspara upakārya upakāraka bhāvaḥ śabda arthayoḥ asti na ca tadānīm tau na staḥ nitya tvāt tasmāt asat etat tat na śakti ātmanā vidyamāna tvāt anuccarite api hi śabde asti pratipādaka śaktiḥ arthe ca pratipādya śaktiḥ atas eva sambandhaḥ nityaḥ iti ucyate

nanu evam api kara hasta ādibhiḥ anekaiḥ śabdaiḥ ekatra arthe pratipādye aneka artha vacane ca ekasmin gavā ādi śabde katham avyabhicāraḥ śakyate avagantum atas prakaraṇa ādīnām api padārtha avadhāraṇa apoya tvāt vṛddha vyavahāre hi bālena kevala padā prayoga āt au āpa uddhāra bhedena etat avadhāritam yadā yad artha vivakṣayā śabdaḥ prayujyate sa tasya arthaḥ iti vivakṣā ca artha prakaraṇa ādi vaśa unneyā gām ānaya dogdhum iti ukte arthāt etat avagamyate sāsna ādimatyasya vivakṣā iti yotsyāmi iti ukte artha ādi muṣau pratītiḥ udeti tat evam artha prakaraṇa ādi bheda bhinnam anyayā anyayā ca śaktyā upahitam anyat anyat ca padam anyasya anyasya vācakam iti na padavyabhicāraḥ arthaḥ api ca udbhūta tad pada abhidhāna yogya avasthā bheda bhinnaḥ hasta ādiḥ anyonyaḥ ca kara ādi padānām vācyaḥ iti na padam vyabhicarati api ca ekasyām kriyāyām ayam niyamaḥ iti uktaḥ na ca ekasyām pratipattau abhidhāne vā upādīyamānayoḥ śabda arthayoḥ anyonya vyabhicāraḥ asti tat idam uktam hi niyamyete yat ekasyām iti

nanu evam eka kriyā nimittakaḥ niyamaḥ śabda arthayoḥ sambandhaḥ iti ucyamāne anumāna aṅgam avinā abhāvaḥ eva āśritaḥ bhavet atas tat balena dhūmāt iva agni jñānam śabdāt artha jñānam upajāyamānam anumānam syāt atas āha na ca api iti idam ca śābde prasādhitam iti āha sādhitam iti nanu yadi avinā abhāvaḥ na upayujyate kaḥ tarhi upayujyate uktam bhāṣya kāreṇa saṃjñā saṃjñi sambandhaḥ iti nanu ca ayam api sambandhaḥ anupayogi eva tat etat āśaṅkate saṃjñā iti tad aṅgam gamakatva aṅgam iti arthaḥ

katham anaṅgam atas āha gamayanti iti vyavahāra darśanena gamayantī eṣā saṃjñā kalpyate iti kim atas yadi evam atas āha na ca eṣā iti etat uktam bhavati gamaka tvam eva saṃjñā tvam na tad sambandha antaram antareṇa iti yatas ca evam atas dhūma ādeḥ iva gamaka tvam sambandha antara pūrvakam eva paścāt āpatitam iti āha tasmāt iti tad tulya tve doṣam āha sā anaṅgam iti yathā eva avinābhāvaḥ eva dhūma ādau prati iti aṅgam na tad uttara kāla bhāvi gamaka tvam evam tatra api syāt iti dhūma ādi vaiṣamyeṇa idānīm parihāram āha na iyam iti vaiṣamyam eva darśayati nirūpitaḥ iti tatra hi dhūma ādau mahānasa ādi deśe agni avinābhāva nirūpaṇa uttara kālam tad kṛtā eva asau gamakatā iti api ca dhūme prathamam gamaka tvam na avagamyate iti āha gamaka tvena iti śabde tu viparītam iti āha iha iti sārdhena

gamaka tvena eva śabde prathamam vyutpattiḥ iti uktam tat vivṛṇoti kathayanti iti trayeṇa ayam arthaḥ tredhā hi śabde vyutpattiḥ vṛdda upadeśāt tad vyavahārāt pada antara samabhivyāhārāt vā sarvatra ca atra gamakatā eva ādau avagamyate tathā hi vṛddha upadeśe tāvat ayam asya vācyaḥ ayam asya vācakaḥ iti gamya gamaka bhāvaḥ eva avagamyate yatra api kvacid uccaritāt vākyāt prayojya vṛddhasya artha viṣayām kriyām dṛṣṭvā ca iṣṭā anumānena gavā ādi artha boddhṛ tvam upakalpyate tatra api yasmāt atas śabdāt anena ayam arthaḥ vagataḥ tasmāt ayam asya arthaḥ iti gamakatā eva śabdasya ādau avagamyate prasiddha pada antara samabhivyāhāre api iha sahakāratarau madhuram pikaḥ rauti iti evamādau vidita sahakāra ādi arthaḥ avidita pikā ādi arthaḥ ca yaḥ ayam sahakāratarau rauti tasya pika śabdaḥ gamakaḥ iti gamaka tvam eva avagacchati iti siddham sarvatra gamaka tvam na vyutpattiḥ iti

nanu ākṛtiḥ śabda arthaḥ iti vaḥ siddhāntaḥ na ca tat vācya tvam anvaya vyatirekau antareṇa śakyate avagantum atas tad pradhānā eva śabda pratītiḥ āpadyeta atas āha ittham iti ayam arthaḥ anvaya vyatirekayoḥ atra niṣkṛṣṭa artha niyama mātre vyāpāraḥ vācaka tā tu nānā jāti a ādi saṅkīrṇa artha viṣayā siddhā eva iti

nanu āgopālam śabda artha vyavahāraḥ dṛśyate na ca te anvaya vyatirekābhyām artha niṣkarṣam kurvanti na ca tān pratyavācakāḥ śabdāḥ iti yuktam vaktum tulya vat pratīteḥ pikā ādi artha nirṇayasya ca mleccha ādi nibandhanasya vakṣyamāṇa tvāt atas āha bahu jāti iti sārdhena ayam abhiprāyaḥ laukikāḥ hi hāna upādāna ādi vyavahāra mātra arthinaḥ na ca teṣām vyavahāraḥ śabda uccāraṇa kṣaṇa upajāta saṅkīrṇa artha bodha sādhyaḥ eva iti śrauta lākṣaṇika ādi vivekam pratyanādṛtāḥ iti tena tarhi kim artham viviñcate atas āha balābala ādi iti śāstra sthā hi anirūpita śaktayaḥ na śāstra artham anuṣṭhātum śaknuvanti iti teṣām hāna upādāna upayogī śabda śakti vivekaḥ iti te viviñcate iti

etat eva prapañcayati kakṣyā antaritā iti dvayena asya arthaḥ dvividham sāmānyam param aparam ca param sattā ākhyam aparāṇi dravya tva ādīni tāni sāmānyāni api santi vyāvṛtti buddheḥ api hetu tvāt viśeṣa sajñām api labhante iti tāni sāmānya viśeṣa śabdena apadiśanti tatra ca sāmānya viśeṣāḥ sāmānya śabdasya sva arthena kakṣyayā antaritāḥ bhavanti yathā sat śabdasya sattām ācakṣāṇasya tad antaritā dravya tva ādayaḥ sāmānya viśeṣāḥ teṣu ca asau lakṣaṇa abalena pravartamānaḥ durbalaḥ jāyate sva arthe tu śrutyā vartate iti sa tatra balavān kā punar iyam lakṣaṇā nāma abhidheyauvina abhāvena pratītiḥ yathā uktam

abhidheya avinā abhāva pratītiḥ lakṣaṇa iṣyate iti kriyā kiyat vā abhidheyau ina abhāvena lakṣyate kiyat sva mahimnā śabdena ucyate iti śāstra sthānām anuṣṭhāna viśeṣa artham vivekaḥ yuktaḥ sā ca iyam lakṣaṇā prāyeṇa nitya sambandhāt bhavati iti nitya sambandhāt iti uktam sambandha mātram eva tu lakṣaṇāyāḥ bījam āha kaḥ punar anuṣṭhāne śrautalākṣaṇika vivekasya upayogaḥ śrūyatām loke tāvat brāhmaṇebhyaḥ dadhi dīyatām takram kauṇḍinyāya iti brāhmaṇa sāmānya sthā brāhmaṇa śrutiḥ lakṣaṇayā tad viśeṣam kauṇḍinyam avatarantī durbalā bhavati iti avyavahita viśeṣa sthayā kauṇḍinya śrutyā bādhyate

vede api evam eva yajuḥ sāmānya sthāḥ upāṃśu yajuṣā iti śrutiḥ tad viśeṣa sthayā uccais nigadena iti śrutyā bādhyate iti evamādi darśayitavyam iti sāmānya śabdena atra viśeṣān viśiṃṣan na sāmānya atiriktāḥ kecana viśeṣāḥ vidyante iti darśayati asti hi keṣāñcid darśanam nityāḥ dravya vṛttayaḥ antyāḥ viśeṣāḥ te ca vyāvṛtti buddheḥ eva hetu tvāt viśeṣāḥ eva iti paramāṇu kāraṇakam hi kāṇādāḥ dvi aṇuka ādi krameṇa jagataḥ nirmāṇam ātiṣṭhante na ca aṇu tvena parasparam anatiśayānaiḥ aṇubhiḥ asaṅkīrṇa ākāra jagat utpādayitum śakyate

atas santi kecana aṇu samavāyinaḥ veśeṣāḥ nāma ye tān itaretaratas vyāvartayanti iti saṅgirante te ca nirdhūta nikhila kāluṣyaiḥ aparokṣam īkṣante eva iti tān pratyucyate na tāvat akṣa adhīneṣu bhāveṣu avāntara sāmānya atiriktān viśeṣān īkṣāmahe dravya tvena hi pṛthivī ādayaḥ guṇa karmabhyaḥ viśiṣyante pṛthivī tvena pṛthivī ap ādibhyaḥ dravya antarebhyaḥ vṛkṣa tvena vṛkṣāḥ pārthiva antarebhyaḥ śiṃśapā tvena śiṃśapā vṛkṣa antarebhyaḥ iti evam aṇūn yāvat iyam viśeṣa kathā vartayitavyā kim atra viśeṣa antareṇa aṇuṣu tu eka jātīyeṣu api kārya vibhāgāt rūpam eva vibhaktam anumāsyāmahe no khalu avibhakta ākāram pūrvavastu vibhakta ākāra kārya ghaṭanāya utsahate iti pṛthaktva ākhyaḥ vā guṇaḥ teṣām anyonyasya viśeṣaka tvāt viśeṣaḥ bhaviṣyati saḥ eva anapekṣita viśeṣa antaraḥ na sidhyati iti ca iti viśeṣāḥ vā katham anapekṣita viśeṣa antarāḥ setsyanti apekṣaṇe vā tadānantyam atas mandaḥ eva ayam viśeṣa antara abhyupagamaḥ yoginaḥ tu tān paśyanti iti śraddhadhānāḥ budhyante vayam aśraddhadhānāḥ smaḥ ye yuktim prārthayāmahe iti sūktam sāmānya viśeṣeṣu iti

anvaya vyatirekābhyām vākya jñāḥ tu viviñcate iti uktam tau anvaya vyatirekau darśayati tatra iti dvayena tatra sāmānye gavā ādau go śabdasya bahulam prayogāt tad viśeṣeṣu ca śābaleya ādiṣu asatsu api bāhuleya ādiṣu prayoga darśanāt para sāmānye ca sattā ādau sati api bhāva antare aprayogāt sāsnādibhiḥ saha eka avayavi rūpa artha sambandhi go tva mātrasya go śabdaḥ vācakam iti anvaya vyatirekābhyām jñānam janyate sā asnādi ekārthasambandhī iti ca avinābhāvinā cihnena go tvam upalakṣayati iti atas siddham gamya gamaka bhāvaḥ eva śabda arthayoḥ sambandhaḥ prathamam avagamyate na punar avinā abhāvaḥ iti

upasaṃharati tasmāt iti nanu saṃjñā saṃjñi sambandhaḥ bhāṣya kāreṇa uktaḥ na ca gamakam saṃjñā iti laukikāḥ manyante na hi agneḥ dhūmaḥ saṃjñā iti ucyate atas āha abhidhāyaka tā iti ayam abhiprāyaḥ asya arthasya ayam gamakaḥ iti jñāte na avya apriyamāṇasya avagatau kāraṇa tvam upapadyate iti tad vyāpāraḥ avasīyate śabda vyāpāraḥ ca abhidhā iti ucyate atas atra abhidhāna kriyā sambandhāt gamaka tvasya eva viśeṣaḥ abhidhāyaka tā śabde jñāyate abhidhāyaka tā eva saṃjñātvam iti upapannaḥ saṃjñā saṃjñi sambandhaḥ iti avinā bhāvitā tu sambandha niyamaḥ na sambandhaḥ iti āha sambandha iti idam ca niṣkṛṣṭe arthe niyamyate iti atra uktam asmābhiḥ tasmāt iti pada anuṣaṅgeṇa upasaṃhṛtam iti veditavyam anvaya vyatireka avinābhāva śabdau paryāyau iti na artha bhedaḥ śaṅkitavyaḥ iti

yadi pratyāyakaḥ iti bhāṣya kāreṇa prayogaḥ antarṇītaḥ tam āha sambandha iti devadatta ādayaḥ hi yadṛcchā śabdāḥ yatra eva saṅka iti ante tam eva pratipādayanti na ca eṣām kvacid api svābhāvikī śaktiḥ tat ayam prayoga arthaḥ gavā ādi śabdaḥ dharmī na abhidhā śaktaḥ iti sādhyam upāya antara apekṣa tvāt iti hetuḥ yat upāya antara apekṣam tat na svarūpataḥ śaktam devadatta ādi padam iva saṅketa grahaṇa apekṣam iti

atra bhāṣya kāreṇa yadi pratyāyakaḥ śabdaḥ prathama śrutaḥ kim na pratyāyati iti paricodya sarvatra naḥ darśanam pramāṇam ityādinā darśana balena gṛhīta śaktikaḥ pratyāyayati iti parihāraḥ uktaḥ tat darśayati yathā eva iti asya arthaḥ gamaka tvam eva tāvat śabdasya kim abhyupagamyate vyavahāra darśana balena iti ced samānam idam śakti saṃvedane api na hi avidita śaktayaḥ śabdāt artham avayantaḥ dṛśyante iti

syāt etat prakāśakāḥ pradīpa ādayaḥ avidita sambandhāḥ api sva artham prakāśayantaḥ dṛśyante tat vidharmā ca śadbaḥ atas na prakāśakaḥ iti tat ca na evam śakti vailakṣaṇyāt vicitra śaktayaḥ api hi bhāvāḥ tad pradīpaḥ pratyakṣa parikara tayā gṛhīta sambandhaḥ api prakāśayatu nāma na etāvatā śabdena api tad dharmeṇa bhavitavyam atas ayam aparyanuyogaḥ api ca vrīhi ādayaḥ agṛhīta svarūpāḥ api kāryam ārabhante eva iti śabde tad dharmaḥ kim na āropyate kāraka hetavaḥ hi vrīhi ādayaḥ śabdaḥ tu jñāpaka hetuḥ atas apekṣate svarūpa grahaṇam iti ced kena vedam ājñāpitam jñāpakena svarūpa grahaṇam apekṣitavyam na sambandha grahaṇam iti darśana balena iti ca iti samānam idam sambandha grahaṇa apekṣāyām api darśana balāt eva hi liṅga śabda ādayaḥ jñāpaka viśeṣāḥ sambandha grahaṇam apekṣante na cakṣuḥ ādayaḥ sarvatra hi naḥ darśanam pramāṇam kārakāḥ cakṣuḥ ādayaḥ iti na anumanyāmahe jñāna kāraṇasya eva jñāpaka tvāt tat etat āha svarūpa iti

nanu ca sambandha grahaṇāt prāk api abhidhāne śabdaḥ śaktaḥ na vā yadi śaktaḥ kim sambandha grahaṇa apekṣayā na ced sambandha grahaṇam eta hi tad āgama nyāyena kāraṇam āpadyeta atas āha yat sādhakatamā iti na tāvat sambandha grahaṇāt pūrvam aśaktam eva śabdam avagacchāmaḥ na ca śaktasya anugrāhaka apekṣā sva śaktim vihanti iti kim punar na vihanti atas āha na hi iti yadi hi anugrāhaka apekṣā sva śāktim vihanyāt sarvam eva laukikam vaidikam karaṇam karaṇa tām jahyāta apekṣate hi sarvam eva karaṇam itikartavya tā janitam anugraham iti

kiñ ca astu tāvat itikartavya tāpekṣā karaṇa bhāvam na vihanti iti pratyuta tayā api na eva karaṇa tvam na asti pratikaraṇa svarūpam tad apekṣā niyamāt iti āha pratyātmā iti nanu evam ubhaya samavadhānam eva antareṇa kārya aniṣpatteḥ katham karaṇa iti kartavyatā vibhāgaḥ darśayitavyaḥ atas āha bāhya antarā iti na antena yad kārya siddhau sannihitam tad karaṇam itarat bāhyam itikartavyatā iti bāhyam api kvacid vivakṣātaḥ kāraka pravṛtteḥ karaṇa tayā vivakṣyate iti āha kvacid syāt vā iti

etat eva darśayati udvignaḥ iti jñāna utpattau antaraṅgam api cakṣuḥ na karaṇa tayā manyate kin tu kutaścid tāratamya viśeṣāt bāhyam eva pradīpam karaṇa tayā vivakṣati iti sa ca ayam vivakṣā nibandhaḥ karaṇa bhāvaḥ kādācid kaḥ nitya vṛttau nityam tu kārya siddhau āntarasya cakṣuṣaḥ karaṇa tvam avagamyate iti āha nitya vṛttau iti andhānām dṛṣṭiḥ darśanam na asti iti arthaḥ

nanu astu vijñāna kārya asatti viśeṣaṇāt pradīpa ādi apekṣayā cakṣuṣaḥ karaṇa bhāvaḥ ātma manassaṃyogaḥ tu jñāna utpattau atyantam āsannaḥ atas katham tad apekṣayā cakṣuṣaḥ karaṇa tvam bhaviṣyati iti atas āha śarīra iti ayam abhiprāyaḥ na asatti viśeṣaḥ eva karaṇa tve kāraṇam api tarhi bāhya pradīpa ādi apekṣayā āsattiḥ ābhyantara ātma manassaṃyoga apekṣayā tu asādhāraṇyam ātma mana ssaṃyogaḥ hi rasa ādi jñāna sādhāraṇaḥ na avi abhicāritayā rūpa darśana kāraṇam iti śakyate avagantum cakṣuṣaḥ punar asādharaṇa tayā eva rūpa jñāne kāraṇa tvam iti cakṣu ūrūpādi bhedaḥ tu iti atra uktam iti

tat evam dṛṣṭānte vivakṣā sannikarṣa viśeṣa kṛta karaṇa iti kartavya tā vibhāgam darśayitvā prakṛte yojayati tathā eva iti anena yat tat āgama nyāyena sambandha grahaṇam eva kāraṇam āpadyeta iti uktam tat api vivakṣā viśeṣa vaśena astu iti darśitam iti aparam api yathā cakṣuḥ draṣṭṛ na bāhyena prakāśena vinā ityādi parihāra bhāṣyam tasya abhiprāyam āha yathā iti cakṣuḥ hi pradīpa ādi upāya antara apekṣam api rūpa prakāśane svabhāvataḥ śaktam iti anaikāntikaḥ hetuḥ dṛṣṭāntaḥ api sādhya vikalaḥ iti āha devadattā iti

yadṛcchā śabdānām api jñāna sāmarthyam vidyamānam eva niyogena abhivyajyate iti adhyāsa vāde varṇitam atra ca yathā cakṣuḥ iti bhāṣye cakṣuṣaḥ karaṇa bhāvaḥ darśitaḥ katham punar tulye api cakṣuḥ pradīpayoḥ jñāna kāraṇa tve cakṣuṣaḥ karaṇa tvam iti atra upapattim āha prakāśaḥ iti idam ca nitya vṛttau iti atra uktam api adhunā bhāṣya samarthana artham uktam iti apaunaruktyam iti tat evam upapāditaḥ saṃjñā saṃjñi sambandhaḥ kṛtaka tvena bhāṣya kṛta ākṣiptaḥ yadi prathama śrutaḥ na pratyāyayati kṛtakaḥ tarhi iti tat etat vārtikakāraḥ darśayati puruṣa iti evam ca atra prayogaḥ yaḥ saṃjñā saṃjñi sambandhaḥ sa kṛtakaḥ puruṣa apekṣa tvāt rajju ghaṭa saṃyoga vat iti

aparam api svābhāvataḥ hi asambandhau etau śabda arthau ityādi bhāṣyam tasya abhiprāyam āha bhinna iti ayam arthaḥ yathā rajju sarpa ādiṣu bhinna deśa kāla adhiṣṭhāneṣu kiñcid deśa ādi samam na asti evam tayoḥ śabda arthayoḥ atas tadvat eva tau api svabhāvataḥ asambandhau iti īdṛśī ca atra prayoga racanā śabda arthau svabhāvataḥ asaṅgatau asama deśa kāla tvāt rajju ādi vat tau eva na sama deśa kālau bhinna deśa ādi adhiṣṭhāna upalambhāt tadvat eva iti
sādhanam dūṣaṇam ca eva sa ābhāsam para saṃvide pratyakṣam anumānam ca sa ābhāsam tu ātma saṃvide iti śāstra artha saṃgrahaḥ

tatra pakṣa ādi vacanāni sādhanam pakṣa hetu dṛṣṭānta vacanaiḥ hi prāśnikānām apratītaḥ arthaḥ pratipādyate iti tatra pakṣaḥ prasiddhaḥ dharmī prasiddha viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭa tayā svayam sādhya tvena īpsitaḥ pratyakṣa ādi aviruddhaḥ iti vākya śeṣaḥ tat yathā nityaḥ śabdaḥ anityaḥ vā iti hetuḥ trirūpaḥ kim punar trairūpyam pakṣa dharma tvam sa pakṣe sattvam vipakṣe ca asattvam iti kaḥ punar sa pakṣaḥ kaḥ vā vipakṣaḥ iti sādhya dharma sāmānyena samānaḥ arthaḥ sa pakṣaḥ tat yathā anitye śabde sādhye ghaṭa ādiḥ anityaḥ sa pakṣaḥ vipakṣaḥ yatra sādhyam na asti yat nityaḥ tat akṛtakam dṛṣṭam yathā ākāśam iti tatra kṛtaka tvam prayatna anantarīyaka tvam vā sa pakṣaḥ eva asti vipakṣe na asti eva iti anitya ādau hetuḥ

dṛṣṭāntaḥ dvividhaḥ sādharmyeṇa vaidharmyeṇa ca tatra sādharmyeṇa tāvat yatra hetoḥ sa pakṣaḥ eva astitvam khyāpyate tat yathā yat kṛtakam tat anityam dṛṣṭam yathā ghaṭa ādiḥ iti vaidharmyeṇa api yatra sādhya abhāve hetoḥ abhāvaḥ eva kathyate tat yathā yat nityam tat akṛtakam dṛṣṭam yathā ākāśām iti nitya śabdena atra anitya tvasya abhāvaḥ ucyate akṛtaka śabdena api kṛtaka tvasya abhāvaḥ yathā bhāva abhāvaḥ abhāvaḥ iti uktāḥ pakṣa ādayaḥ

eṣām vacanāni para pratyāyana kāle sādhanam tat yathā anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti pakṣa vacanam kṛtaka tvāt iti pakṣa dharma vacanam yat kṛtakam tat anityam dṛṣṭam yathā ghaṭa ādiḥ iti sa pakṣa anugama vacanam yat nityam tat akṛtakam dṛṣṭam yathā ākāśam iti vyatireka vacanam etāni eva trayaḥ avayavāḥ iti ucyante

sādhayitum iṣṭaḥ api pratyakṣa ādi viruddhaḥ pakṣa ābhāsaḥ tat yathā pratyakṣa viruddhaḥ anumāna viruddhaḥ āgama viruddhaḥ loka viruddhaḥ sva vacana viruddhaḥ aprasiddha viśeṣaṇaḥ aprasiddha viśeṣyaḥ aprasiddha ubhayaḥ prasiddha saṃbandhaḥ ca iti tatra pratyakṣa viruddhaḥ yathā aśrāvaṇaḥ śabdaḥ iti anumāna viruddhaḥ yathā nityaḥ ghaṭaḥ iti āgama viruddhaḥ yathā vaiśeṣikasya nityaḥ śabdaḥ iti sādhayataḥ loka viruddhaḥ yathā śuci nara śiraḥ kapālam prāṇi aṅga tvāt śaṅkha śukti vat iti sva vacana viruddhaḥ yathā mātā me vandhyā iti aprasiddha viśeṣaṇaḥ yathā bauddhasya sāṃkhyam prati vināśī śabdaḥ iti aprasiddha viśeṣyaḥ yathā sāṃkhyasya bauddham prati cetanaḥ ātmā iti aprasiddha ubhayaḥ yathā vaiśeṣikasya bauddham prati sukha ādi samavāyi kāraṇam ātmā iti prasiddha saṃbandhaḥ yathā śrāvaṇaḥ śabdaḥ iti eṣām vacanāni dharma svarūpa nirākaraṇa mukhena pratipādana asaṃbhavataḥ sādhana vaiphalyataḥ ca iti pratijñā doṣāḥ uktāḥ pakṣa ābhāsāḥ

asiddha anaikāntika viruddhāḥ hetvābhāsāḥ tatra asiddhaḥ catur prakāraḥ tat yathā ubhaya asiddhaḥ anyatara asiddhaḥ saṃdigdha asiddhaḥ āśraya asiddhaḥ ca iti tatra śabda anitya tve sādhye cākṣuṣa tvāt iti ubhaya asiddhaḥ kṛtaka tvāt iti śabda abhivyakti vādinam prati anyatara asiddhaḥ bāṣpa ādi bhāvena saṃdihyamānaḥ bhūta saṃghātaḥ agni siddhau upadiśyamānaḥ saṃdigdha asiddhaḥ dravyam ākāśam guṇa āśraya tvāt iti ākāśa asattva vādinam prati āśraya asiddhaḥ

anaikāntikaḥ ṣaṣ prakāraḥ sādhāraṇaḥ asādhāraṇaḥ sa pakṣa eka deśa vṛttiḥ vipakṣa vyāpī vipakṣa eka deśa vṛttiḥ sa pakṣa vyāpī ubhaya pakṣa eka deśa vṛttiḥ viruddha avyabhicārī ca iti tatra sādhāraṇaḥ śabdaḥ prameya tvāt nityaḥ iti tat dhi nitya anitya pakṣayoḥ sādhāraṇa tvāt anaikāntikam kim ghaṭa vat prameya tvāt anityaḥ śabdaḥ āhosvit ākāśa vat prameya tvāt nityaḥ iti asādhāraṇaḥ śrāvaṇa tvāt nityaḥ iti tat dhi nitya anitya pakṣābhyām vyāvṛtta tvāt nitya anitya vinirmuktasya ca anyasya asaṃbhavāt saṃśaya hetuḥ kiṃbhūtasya asya śrāvaṇa tvam iti

sa pakṣa eka deśa vṛttiḥ vipakṣa vyāpī yathā aprayatna anantarīyakaḥ śabdaḥ anitya tvāt aprayatna ānantarīyakaḥ pakṣaḥ asya vidyut ākāśa ādiḥ sa pakṣaḥ tatra eka deśe vidyut ādau vidyate anitya tvam na ākāśa ādau aprayatna ānantarīyakaḥ pakṣaḥ asya ghaṭa ādiḥ vipakṣaḥ tatra sarvatra ghaṭa ādau vidyate anitya tvam tasmāt etat api vidyut ghaṭa sādharmyeṇa anaikāntikam kim ghaṭa vat anitya tvāt prayatna anantarīyakaḥ śabdaḥ āhosvit vidyut ādi vat anitya tvāt aprayatna anantarīyakaḥ iti

vipakṣa eka deśa vṛttiḥ sa pakṣa vyāpī yathā prayatna ānantarīyakaḥ śabdaḥ anitya tvāt prayatna ānantarīyakaḥ pakṣaḥ asya ghaṭa ādiḥ sapakṣaḥ tatra sarvatra ghaṭa ādau vidyate anitya tvam prayatna ānantarīyakaḥ pakṣaḥ asya vidyut ākāśa ādiḥ vipakṣaḥ tatra eka deśe vidyut ādau vidyate anitya tvam na ākāśa ādau tasmāt etat api vidyut ghaṭa sādharmyeṇa pūrvavat anaikāntikam

ubhaya pakṣa eka deśa vṛttiḥ yathā nityaḥ śabdaḥ amūrta tvāt iti nityaḥ pakṣaḥ asya ākāśa paramāṇu ādiḥ sa pakṣaḥ tatra eka deśaḥ ākāśa ādau vidyate amūrta tvam na paramāṇau nityaḥ pakṣaḥ asya ghaṭa sukha ādiḥ vipakṣaḥ tatrika deśe sukha ādau vidyate amūrta tvam na ghaṭa ādau tasmāt etat api sukha ākāśa sādharmyeṇa anaikāntikam

viruddha avyabhicārī yathā anityaḥ śabdaḥ kṛtaka tvāt ghaṭa vat nityaḥ śabdaḥ śrāvaṇa tvāt śabda tva vat iti ubhayoḥ saṃśaya hetu tvāt dvau api etau ekaḥ anaikāntikaḥ samuditau eva viruddhaḥ catur prakāraḥ tat yathā dharma svarūpa viparīta sādhanaḥ dharma viśeṣa viparīta sādhanaḥ dharmi svarūpa viparīta sādhanaḥ dharmi viśeṣa viparīta sādhanaḥ ca iti tatra

dharma svarūpa viparīta sādhanaḥ yathā nityaḥ śabdaḥ kṛtaka tvāt prayatna anantarīyaka tvāt vā iti ayam hetuḥ vipakṣaḥ eva bhāvāt viruddhaḥ dharma viśeṣa viparīta sādhanaḥ yathā para arthāḥ cakṣuḥ ādayaḥ saṃghāta tvāt śayana āsana ādi aṅga viśeṣa vat iti ayam hetuḥ yathā pārārthyam cakṣuḥ ādīnām sādhayati tathā saṃhata tvam api parasya ātmanaḥ sādhayati ubhayatra avyabhicārāt

dharmi svarūpa viparīta sādhanaḥ yathā na dravyam na karma na guṇaḥ bhāvaḥ eka dravyavat tvāt guṇa karmasu ca bhāvāt sāmānya viśeṣa vat iti ayam hi hetuḥ yathā dravya ādi pratiṣedham bhāvasya sādhayati tathā bhāvasya abhāva tvam api sādhayati ubhayatra avyabhicārāt dharmi viśeṣa viparīta sādhanaḥ yathā ayam eva hetuḥ asmin eva pūrva pakṣe asya eva dharmiṇaḥ yaḥ viśeṣaḥ sat pratyaya kartṛ tvam nāma tad viparītam asat pratyaya kartṛ tvam api sādhayati ubhayatra avyabhicārāt

dṛṣṭānta ābhāsaḥ dvividhaḥ sādharmyeṇa vaidharmyeṇa ca tatra sādharmyeṇa tāvat dṛṣṭānta ābhāsaḥ pañca prakāraḥ tat yathā sādhana dharma asiddhaḥ sādhya dharma asiddhaḥ ubhaya dharma asiddhaḥ ananvayaḥ viparīta anvayaḥ ca iti tatra sādhana dharma asiddhaḥ yathā nityaḥ śabdaḥ amūrta tvāt paramāṇu vat yat amūrtam tat nityam dṛṣṭam yathā paramāṇuḥ paramāṇau hi sādhyam nitya tvam asti sa dhana dharmaḥ amūrta tvam na asti mūrta tvāt paramāṇūnām iti

sādhya dharma asiddhaḥ yathā nityaḥ śabdaḥ amūrta tvāt buddhi vat yat amūrtam tat nityam dṛṣṭam yathā buddhiḥ buddhau hi sādhana dharmaḥ amūrta tvam asti sādhya dharmaḥ nitya tvam na asti anitya tvāt buddheḥ iti ubhaya asiddhaḥ dvividhaḥ san asan ca iti tatra ghaṭa vat iti vidyamāna ubhaya asiddhaḥ anitya tvāt mūrta tvāt ca ghaṭasya ākāśa vat iti avidyamāna ubhaya asiddhaḥ tat asattva vādinam prati

ananvayaḥ yatra vinā anvayena sādhya sādhanayoḥ sahabhāvaḥ pradarśyate yathā ghaṭe kṛtaka tvam anitya tvam ca dṛṣṭam iti viparīta anvayaḥ yathā yat kṛtakam tat anityam dṛṣṭam iti vaktavye yat anityam tat kṛtakam dṛṣṭam iti bravīti vaidharmyeṇa api dṛṣṭānta ābhāsaḥ pañca prakāraḥ tat yathā sādhya avyāvṛttaḥ sādhana avyāvṛttaḥ ubhaya avi āvṛttaḥ avyatirekaḥ viparīta vyatirekaḥ ca iti tatra

sādhya avyāvṛttaḥ yathā nityaḥ śabdaḥ amūrta tvāt paramāṇu vat yat anityaḥ tat mūrtam dṛṣṭam yathā paramāṇuḥ paramāṇoḥ hi sādhana dharmaḥ amūrta tvam vyāvṛttam mūrta tvāt paramāṇūnām iti sādhya dharmaḥ nitya tvam na vyāvṛttam nitya tvāt paramāṇūnām iti sādhana avyāvṛttaḥ yathā karma vat iti karmaṇaḥ sādhyam nitya tvam vyāvṛttam anitya tvāt karmaṇaḥ sādhana dharmaḥ amūrta tvam na vyāvṛttam amūrta tvāt karmaṇaḥ

ubhaya avi āvṛttaḥ ākāśa vat iti tad sattva vādinam prati tatas nitya tvam amūrta tvam ca na vyāvṛttam nitya tvāt amūrta tvāt ca ākāśasya iti avyatirekaḥ yatra vinā sādhya sādhana nivṛttyā tad vipakṣa bhāvaḥ nidarśyate yathā ghaṭe mūrta tvam anitya tvam ca dṛṣṭam iti viparīta vyatirekaḥ yathā yat anityam tat mūrtam dṛṣṭam iti vaktavye yat mūrtam tat anityam dṛṣṭam iti bravīti eṣām pakṣa hetu dṛṣṭānta ābhāsānām vacanāni sādhana ābhāsam

ātma pratyāyana artham tu pratyakṣam anumānam ca dve eva pramāṇe tatra pratyakṣam kalpanā apoḍham yat jñānam arthe rūpa ādau nāma jāti ādi kalpanā rahitam tat akṣam akṣam prati vartate iti pratyakṣam anumānam liṅgāt artha darśanam liṅgam punar trirūpam uktam tasmāt yat anumeye arthe jñānam utpadyate agniḥ atra anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti vā tat anumānam ubhayatra tat eva jñānam phalam adhigama rūpa tvāt savya apāravat khyāteḥ pramāṇa tvam iti

kalpanā jñānam artha antare pratyakṣa ābhāsam yat jñānam ghaṭaḥ paṭaḥ iti vā vikalpayataḥ samutpadyate tat artha sva lakṣaṇa aviṣaya tvāt pratyakṣa ābhāsam hetvābhāsa pūrvakam jñānam anumāna ābhāsam hetvābhāsaḥ hi bahu prakāraḥ uktaḥ tasmāt yat anumeye arthe jñānam avyutpannasya bhavati tat anumāna ābhāsam

sādhana doṣa udbhāvanāni dūṣaṇāni sādhana doṣaḥ nyūna tvam pakṣa doṣaḥ pratyakṣa ādi viruddha tvam hetu doṣaḥ asiddhānaikāntika viruddha tvam dṛṣṭānta doṣaḥ sādhana dharma ādi asiddha tvam tasya udbhāvanam prāśnika pratyāyanam dūṣaṇam

abhūta sādhana doṣa udbhāvanāni dūṣaṇa ābhāsāni saṃpūrṇe sādhane nyūna tva vacanam aduṣṭa pakṣe pakṣa doṣa vacanam siddha hetuke asiddha hetukam vacanam ekānta hetuke anekānta hetukam vacanam aviruddha hetuke viruddha hetukam vacanam aduṣṭa dṛṣṭānte duṣṭa dṛṣṭānta doṣa vacanam etāni dūṣaṇa ābhāsāni na hi ebhiḥ para pakṣaḥ dūṣyate niravadya tvāt tasya
iti uparamyate padārtha mātram ākhyātam ādau diś mātra siddhaye yā atra yuktiḥ ayuktiḥ vā sā anyatra su vicāritā iti nyāya praveśaka sūtram samāptam
yat akṣapādaḥ pravaraḥ munīnām śamāya śāstram jagataḥ jagāda ku tārkikā jñāna nivṛtti hetuḥ kariṣyate tasya mayā nibandhaḥ

pramāṇa ādi padārtha tattva jñānāt niḥśreyasa adhigamaḥ iti etat śāstrasya ādi sūtram tasya abhisambandha vākyam pramāṇataḥ artha pratipattau iti evam ādi tasya anusandhāna vākyam śāstrasya puruṣa śreyaḥ abhidhāyaka tvāt śāstram punar pramāṇa ādi vācaka pada samūhaḥ vyūha viśiṣṭaḥ padam punar varṇa samūhaḥ pada samūhaḥ śūtram sūtra samūhaḥ prakaraṇam prakaraṇa samūhaḥ āhnikam āhnika samūhaḥ adhyāyaḥ pañca adhyāyī śāstram tad padārthāḥ pramāṇa ādayaḥ tasya śāstrasya padānām arthāḥ pramāṇa ādayaḥ ṣoḍaśa ātmānaḥ tat śāstram puruṣa śreyaḥ abhidhatte pratyakṣa anumāna adhigata vastu tattva anvā ākhyānam śāstra dharmaḥ tasya viṣayaḥ pratyakṣa anumānān adhigata vastu tattva

ādhyātmika śakti sampad i uktaḥ antevāsī puruṣaḥ punar caturdhā bhidyate pratipannaḥ apratipannaḥ sandigdhaḥ viparyastaḥ ca iti tatra pratipannaḥ pratipādayitā itare sa apekṣāḥ santaḥ pratipādyāḥ te yadā indriya artha sannikarśam apekṣante tadā pratyakṣena yadā liṅga darśana smṛti ādi apekṣante tadā anumānena yadā punar upadeśam apekṣante tadā śāstram pravartate śreyaḥ punar sukham ahita nivṛttiḥ ca tat śreyaḥ bhidyamānam dvedhā vyavatiṣṭate dṛṣṭa adṛṣṭa bhedena dṛṣṭam sukham adṛṣṭam ahita nivṛttiḥ ahita nivṛttiḥ api ātyantikī ca anātyantikī ca anātyantikī kaṇṭaka ādeḥ duḥkha sādhanasya parihāreṇa ātyantikī punar ekaviṃśati prabheda bhinna duḥkha hānyā

ekaviṃśati prabheda bhinnam punar duḥkham śarīram ṣaṣ indriyāṇi ṣaṣ viṣayāḥ ṣaṣ buddhayaḥ sukham duḥkham ca iti śarīram duḥkha āyatana tvāt duḥkham indriyāṇi viṣayāḥ buddhayaḥ ca tad sādhana bhāvāt sukham duḥkha anuṣaṅgāt duḥkham svarūpataḥ iti tasya hāniḥ dharma adharma sādhana parityāgena anutpannayoḥ dharma adharmayoḥ anutpādena utpannayoḥ ca upabhogāt prakṣayena iti puruṣāḥ rāga ādi mantaḥ vīta rāgāḥ ca tatra rāgaḥ viṣaya abhiṣvaṅga lakṣaṇaḥ sa yeṣām asti te rāga ādimantaḥ vairāgyam punar bhoga anabhiṣvaṅga lakṣaṇam tat yeṣām asti te vīta rāgāḥ pravṛtteḥ dvaividhyam puruṣa bheda anuvidhānena teṣām puruṣāṇām yāḥ pravṛttayaḥ tāḥ puruṣa bhedam anuvidhīyamānāḥ ubhaya rūpāḥ bhavanti

vīta rāga pravṛttiḥ ekadhā tatra yā vīta rāgāṇām pravṛttiḥ sā khalu eka rūpāḥ aniṣṭa pratiṣedha arthāḥ aniṣṭam hāsyāmaḥ iti evam eva pravartante na punar eṣām kvacid abhiṣvaṅgaḥ asti iti rāga ādimad pravṛttiḥ tu dvi rūpā ye tu rāga ādimantar teṣām yāḥ pravṛttayaḥ tāḥ dvividhāḥ bhavanti iṣṭāniṣṭa viṣaya adhigama pratiṣedha arthāḥ iṣṭam āpsyāmi iti rāgāt pravartate aniṣṭam hāsyāmi iti dveṣāt nivartate pravṛtteḥ api dvaividhyam bhavati samartha asamartha bhedāt yā khalu rāga ādimad pravṛttiḥ sā samarthā ca asamarthā ca bhavati iṣṭam āpsyāmi iti pravartamānaḥ yadā prāpnoti tadā samartha aniṣṭam hāsyāmi iti pravartamānaḥ yadā jahāti tadā api samarthā yadā viparyayaḥ tadā asamartha iti

tat punar pravṛtteḥ dvaividhyam pramāṇasya arthavat anarthaka tvāt pramāṇam tāvat artha paricchedakam pramāṇa sāmānyāt pramāṇa pratirūpakam api pramāṇam iti upacaryate kim punar pramāṇa sāmānyam pramāṇa ābhāsasya sāmānya paricchedaka tvam pramāṇena api sāmānyam paricchidyate pramāṇa ābhāsena api saḥ ayam pramātā yadā pramāṇena artham avadhārya pravartate tadā asya pravṛttiḥ samarthā bhavati yadā punar pramāṇa ābhāsena avadhārya pravartate tadāsamarthā tasyāḥ punar arthavat tvam pramāṇataḥ artha pratipattau iti ādi bhāṣyam paraspara apekṣi tvāt ubhaya asiddhiḥ iti ced nānā ādi tvāt yadi pramāṇataḥ artha pratipattau pravṛtti sāmarthyam yadi vā pravṛtti sāmarthyāt pramāṇataḥ artha pratipattiḥ kim pūrvam kim vā paścāt iti vācyam yadi tāvat pramāṇataḥ pūrvam artha pratipattiḥ pravṛtti sāmarthyam antareṇa kim iti pratipadyate atha pūrvam

pravṛtti sāmarthyam anavadhārya arthe kim iti pravartate tasmāt pravṛtteḥ pramāṇataḥ artha pratipatteḥ vā pūrva apara bhāvaḥ na kalpate iti tat ca na evam kasmāt anādi tvāt anādiḥ ayam saṃsāraḥ iti pūrva abhyasta sūtre pratipādayiṣyāmaḥ ādimati ca saṃsāraḥ eṣa doṣaḥ kim pūrvam pramāṇataḥ artha pratipattiḥ uta aho pūrvam pravṛtti sāmarthyam iti pramāṇa pravṛttyoḥ vā bala abala jijñāsāyām ubhaya sāmarthya pradarśana artham vākyam lokaḥ khalu pravartamānaḥ pramāṇena artham avadhārya pravartate sa ca tathā pravartamānaḥ phalam upalabhate tatra idam cintyate kim pramāṇataḥ artha pratipattiḥ samarthota aho pravṛttiḥ iti ubhayam samartham tat na antarīyaka tvāt phalasya asya ca arthasya upadarśana artham vākyam iti loka vṛtta anuvādaḥ vā sarvaḥ pramātā pramāṇena artham avadhārya pravartamānaḥ phalam upalabhate iti loka vṛttam tad vākyena anūdyate iti

heya hāna upāya adhigantavya bhedāt catvāri artha padāni heyam duḥkham tat hetuḥ ca duḥkham uktam duḥkha hetuḥ avidyā tṛṣṇe dharma adharmau iti hānam tattva jñānam tat punar yathā avasthita padārtha adhigatiḥ tat ca pramāṇam upāyaḥ śāstram tat api uktam adhigantavyaḥ apavargaḥ sa punar ātyantikaḥ duḥkha abhāvaḥ etasmin ca caturvarge pramāṇasya prādhānya pradarśana artham ca iti katham punar anena vākyena pramāṇa ādi caturvargaḥ pradarśyate iti pramāṇa prameya adhigatayaḥ śruti gamyāḥ pramātā tat na antarīyaka tvāt na hi pramātāram antareṇa pramāṇam sambhavati tat idam vākyam avayavaśas upanyasya varṇyate tatra pramāṇataḥ iti

tasiḥ vacanam vacana vibhakti vyāpti jñāpana artham pramāṇataḥ iti iyam nimitta pañcamī asya abhidhānam vacana vyāpti artham vibhakti vyāpti artham ca katham punar pañcamī vyatirekeṇa tasiḥ labhyate labhyate iti āha ādi a ādau upasaṃkhyānāt iti tat kim siddham bhavati vacana vyāptyā saṃplavaḥ vyavasthā ca pramāṇena pramāṇābhyām pramāṇaiḥ pratipattiḥ iti saṃplavaḥ gamyate pramāṇena eva iti vyavasthā vibhakti vyāptyā hetu karaṇa bhāvaḥ pramāṇāt artha adhigatiḥ bhavati iti hetu tvam pramāṇena artham sādhayati iti sādhakatama tvāt karaṇa arthaḥ saṃplava anupapattiḥ viśiṣṭa viṣaya tvāt iti ced na anabhyupagamāt syāt matiḥ eṣā viśiṣṭa viṣayāṇi

pramāṇāni viśeṣa viṣayam pratyakṣam sāmānya viṣayam anumānam iti etāvat ca adhigantavyam yat uta sāmānyam viśeṣaḥ ca na ca sāmānya viṣayam pratyakṣam na jātu anumānam viśeṣa viṣayam iti etat ca na anabhyupagamāt na tāvat pramāṇa dvayam pratipadyāmahe na viṣaya dvayam na api asaṃkaram kim kāraṇam pramāṇāni tāvat catvāri viṣayaḥ ca sāmānya viśeṣa tadvat bhedāt tredhā saṃkaraḥ api ekasya sarvaiḥ pramāṇaiḥ adhigateḥ indriya vat iti indriyam khalu artha prakāśaka tvāt pramāṇam tasya vyavasthā saṃkaraḥ ca vyavasthā gandha ādiṣu saṃkaraḥ pṛthivī ādiṣu dvi indriya grāhya tvāt sattāyām guṇa tve ca sārva indriyam jñānam iti

adhigata tvāt vaiyarthyam iti ced na anyathā tad adhigateḥ syāt matam yadi saṃkīryeran pramāṇāni nanu ekena pramāṇena adhigate arthe dvitīyam pramāṇam vyartham āpadyeta adhigatam ca artham adhigamayatā pramāṇena piṣṭapeṣaṇam syāt na anyathā tad adhigateḥ na brūmaḥ yathā pratyakṣena arthaḥ adhigamyate tathā anumāna ādibhiḥ api iti anyathā pratyakṣena indriya sambaddhaḥ indriya asambaddaḥ anumānena saṃjñā saṃjñi saṃbandha pratipattiḥ upamānena śabda ullekhena āgamena iti viṣaya antare vyavasthā darśanāt ca na ca sarvasmin arthe saṃplavaḥ asti iti atas na vaiyarthyam iti tasmāt vyavasthitam etat tasiḥ vacanam vacana vibhakti vyāpti jñāpana artham iti

pramāṇa svarūpa avadhāraṇam kartavyam kim punar pramāṇasya pramāṇa tvam kim ca uktam bhavati pramāṇam iti upalabdhi hetuḥ pramāṇam upalabdhi hetu tvam pramāṇa tvam yat upalabdhi nimittam tat pramāṇam iti samāna tvāt alakṣaṇam iti ced yadi upalabdhi hetuḥ pramāṇam nanu pramātṛ prameyayoḥ api upalabdhi hetu tvāt pramāṇa tvam prasajyeta viśeṣaḥ vā vaktavyaḥ iti ayam viśeṣaḥ pramāṇe pramātṛ prameyayoḥ caritārtha tvāt pramāṇe pramātā prameyam ca caritārtham acarita artham tu pramāṇam atas tat eva upalabdhi sādhanam iti akaraṇā pramāṇa utpattiḥ iti ced na indriya artha sannikarṣasya karaṇa bhāvāt yadi pramātṛ prameyābhyām pramāṇam janyate akaraṇā tarhi pramāṇa utpattiḥ prāpnoti na indriya artha sannikarṣasya karaṇa bhāvāt na akaraṇā pramāṇa utpattiḥ pramāṇa utpattau indriya artha sannikarṣam apekṣamāṇābhyām pramātṛ prameyābhyām pramāṇam janyate iti

na akaraṇa pramāṇa utpatti prasaṅgaḥ yadi tarhi pramāṇa utpattau indriya artha sannikarṣam apekṣete pramātṛ prameye atha tarhi indriya artha sannikarṣa utpattau kim apekṣeta iti tasmin api indriyam iti anādiḥ kartṛ karaṇa bhāvaḥ yat yat paścāt bhavati tat tat pūrva bhāvinam apekṣate iti anādiḥ kartṛ karaṇa bhāvaḥ draṣṭavyaḥ iti yadi pramātṛ prameyābhyām sadbhyām pramāṇam janyate tatas pramāṇam antareṇa pramātṛ prameya bhāvasya asiddha tvāt pramātṛ tvam prameya tvam ca anupapannam iti katham pramāṇam iti yathā kāraka śabdaḥ ayam tathā prameyam pramātā iti ca na ca kāraka śabdāḥ kriyā sambandham antareṇa ātmānam labhante iti na ca dravya mātram kārakam na ca kriyā mātram iti kāraka śabdaḥ hi pravartamānaḥ kriyā sādhane kriyā viśeṣa yukte pravartate pramātṛ prameya śabdau ca kāraka śabdau tau antareṇa kriyām na pravarteyātām iti na pācaka ādi śabda vat

tri kāla viṣaya tvāt na brūmaḥ kriyā sambandhena eva kāraka śabdāḥ pravartante iti api tu tri kāla viṣayāḥ ete yadi kriyā sambandha nimittāḥ eva syuḥ na kriyām antareṇa pravarteran kriyā sambandham antareṇa tu pravartante kim punar nimittam sāmarthyam tat ca triṣu api kāleṣu asti iti tasmāt upapannam pramātṛ prameyābhyām pramāṇam janyate tad upalabdhi sādhanam iti sādhakatama tvāt vā na prasaṅgaḥ na ca ayam prasaṅgaḥ asti pramātā ca prameyam ca upalabdhi nimitta tvāt pramāṇam prasajyate iti kasmāt sādhakatama tvāt sādhakatamam pramāṇam na tu pramātṛ prameye kaḥ khalu sādhakatama arthaḥ sādhakatamam pramāṇam iti kevalam vākyam abhidhīyate na arthaḥ iti bhāva abhāvayoḥ tadvat tā na pramātari prameye vā asati pramā bhavati sati tu bhavati na punar sati bhavati eva pramāṇe tu sati bhavantī bhavati eva sa ca ayam atiśayaḥ sādhakatama tvam

ucyate yadvān vā pramimīte saḥ atiśayaḥ kiṃvān pramimīte pramāṇavān ayam pramāṇe sati pramimīte na asati iti satoḥ vā akartṛ tvam yat abhāvāt yasya ca abhāvāt pramātṛ prameye na pramām kurutaḥ saḥ atiśayaḥ saṃyoga vat carama bhāvitā vā yathā vā saṃyogaḥ paścāt bhāvī dravya śaktiḥ bhavati tathā pramāṇam caram a bhāvi pramātṛ prameyayoḥ pramā śaktiḥ bhavati paścāt bhāvaḥ atiśayaḥ pratipatteḥ ānantaryam vā yat vā pramāṇa anantaram pratipatteḥ janma sa ca ayam atiśayaḥ iti asādhāraṇa karaṇa tā vā pramātā tāvat sādhāraṇam kāraṇam pratyakṣa ādi jñānānām sarva pratipattīnām prameyam api aśeṣa puruṣa sādhāraṇa tvāt tathābhūtam pramāṇam tu asādhāraṇa kāraṇa tvāt pradhānam prādhānyāt ca sādhakatama tvena abhidhīyate iti pramā kāraṇa saṃyoga viśeṣaka tvam vā yaḥ vā pramā kāraṇam saṃyogaḥ tasya pramāṇam anugrahe vartamānam atiśaya śabda vācyam

artha grahaṇam pramāṇa viṣaya pratipatti pratiṣedha artham yatas na pramāṇa viṣayā pratipattiḥ puruṣam itikartavya tāyām prayojayati kim tu arthasya tathā abhāva viṣayā yadā ayam arthasya tathā abhāvam pratipadyate atha pravartate iti upekṣaṇīya vastu pratiṣedha artham vā na hi upekṣaṇīya vastu viṣayā pratipattiḥ puruṣam itikartavya tāyām prayojayati kim tu arthasya sukha duḥkha hetu bhāva viṣayā yadā ayam arthasya sukha duḥkha hetu bhāvam pratipadyate atha pravartate iti pramāṇa grahaṇam gamyamāna tvāt iti ced na pramāṇa viśeṣa jñāpana artha tvāt artha pratipattau pravṛtti sāmarthyāt iti abhidhīyamāne gamyate eva etat pramāṇataḥ iti na hi kācid artha pratipattiḥ pramāṇam antareṇa sambhavati iti tat ca na evam pramāṇa viśeṣa jñāpana artha tvāt asti ayam pramāṇa śabdaḥ pramāṇe vartamānaḥ asti ca pramāṇa sāmānyāt pramāṇa ābhāse api iti tat yā iha

pramāṇena pratipattiḥ sā pravṛtti sāmarthyam pratipādayati pramāṇam na itarat iti na ca pramāṇa grahaṇam antareṇa nimitta pañcamī abhidhānam labhyate tena ca prayojanam atas ca pramāṇa grahaṇam kṛtam iti artha grahaṇam sukha duḥkha tad hetu tvena sarva saṃgrahaḥ arthyamāṇa tvāt ca sarvaḥ pramāṇa ādiḥ arthaḥ sukha duḥkha hetuḥ sarvaḥ ca arthyate arthyamāṇa tvāt arthaḥ iti na vyāghātāt avivakṣita tvāt ca sarvaḥ pramāṇa ādiḥ arthaḥ sukha duḥkha hetuḥ iti bruvataḥ heya ādi bhedāt catvāri artha padāni iti vyāhanyeta na ca pramāṇa ādi hānam śakyam kartum na ca pramāṇa ādi hanam vivakṣitam tasmāt apavyākhyānam etat kim tu sukha duḥkha tvena tad hetu tvena ca yāvatām saṃgrahaḥ te abhidhīyante adhikārāt na saṃvidaḥ grahaṇam anadhikārāt akarma tvāt ca na saṃvid dheya asukha duḥkha tvāt atad hetu tvāt ca na api arthyate aphala tvāt

saḥ ayam pramāṇa arthaḥ aparisaṃkhyeyaḥ iyān ayam pramāṇa viṣayaḥ iti na parisaṃkhyātum śakyam ānantyāt na ubhayasya api parisaṃkhyāta tvāt etāvān ayam pramāṇa arthaḥ yat uta sukha duḥkhe tad hetuḥ ca iti tat ca ubhayam parisaṃkhyātam atas na yuktam ānantyāt na parisaṃkhyātate iti prāṇabhṛt bhedasya ca aparisaṃkhyeya tvāt aparisaṃkhyeyaḥ pramāṇa arthaḥ iti asambaddham uktam iti na artha śabdasya prayojana vāci tvāt pramāṇa arthaḥ aparisaṃkhyeyaḥ iti pramāṇa prayojanam aparisaṃkhyeyam iti ayam vākya arthaḥ katham saḥ eva arthaḥ keṣāñcid sukha hetuḥ bhavati keṣāñcid duḥkha hetuḥ iti arthavati ca samarthe pramāṇe arthavanti bhavanti samarthāni iti anyatamatva arthaḥ sādhakatama tva arthaḥ draṣṭavyaḥ prakaraṇāt prakaraṇam hi caturvarge pramāṇam pradhānam iti vartate yadi punar yathāśruti vākyam arthavat syāt kim pramāṇa sāmarthyam varṇitam syāt tasmāt yathoktam nyāyyam iti

pramātā svatantraḥ kim punar svātantryam kāraka phala upabhoktṛ tvam yasmāt kārakāṇām phalena ayam abhisambadhyate tad samavāyaḥ vā yat vā aśeṣa kāraka niṣpādyāyāḥ kriyāyāḥ puruṣaḥ āśrayaḥ bhavati tat prayoktṛ tvam itara aprayojya tā vā yat vā paridṛṣṭa sāmarthyāni kāraka cakrāṇi prayuṅkte taiḥ ca na prayujyate iti tattva parisamāptiḥ viniyoga yogyatā upekṣyatā vā yāsau avisaṃvāditā sa avadhāritasya arthasya viniyoga yogya tā sukha sādhanam vā duḥkha sādhanam vā ayam arthaḥ iti jñātvā viniyogaḥ sā samāptiḥ tad prāptiḥ tad pratiṣedhaḥ ca yat vā na sukha sādhanam na duḥkha sādhanam vā iti upekṣā iti

kim punar tat sat asatī tat tasya bhāvaḥ tattvam iti atra tat vācyam yasya bhāvaḥ iti sadasatī tat pramāṇa viṣaya tvena adhikārāt sat asatī pramāṇasya viṣayau iti adhikṛtam tasmāt sat asatī tat iti tad bhāvaḥ sat asat tvam sat asatoḥ pramāṇa viṣaya tā tad pratiṣedhaḥ ca tayoḥ khalu sat asatoḥ bhāvaḥ dvi rūpaḥ vidhīyamānaḥ pratiṣidhyamānaḥ ca yat ekatra vidhīyate tat anyatra pratiṣidhyate tat yathā gandhavatī pṛthivī agandhā āpaḥ iti pramāṇa viṣaya tvāt sat asatayoḥ viśeṣa prasaṅgaḥ iti ced nānā ekāntāt tatra bhavet eṣā buddhiḥ yadi pramāṇena sat asatī gamyete tatas pramāṇa viṣaya tvāt ubhayoḥ aviśeṣaḥ prāptaḥ iti tat ca nānā ekāntāt sarvam idam go ghaṭa ādi dravya jātam pramāṇa gamyam bheda vat ca tasmāt anekāntaḥ ayam iti svatantra paratantra upalabdhi anupalabdhi kāraṇa bhāvāt ca viśeṣaḥ sat khalu pramāṇasya ālambanam

svatantram bhavati asat tu paratantram pratiṣedha mukhena pratipadyate pradīpa vat iti tat yathā pradīpaḥ khalu apavaraka ādi sthitam ghaṭa ādikam artham pratipādayati tadvat asat api pratipādayati na hi asat pratipattau upāya antaram āsthīyate dṛśyamāne hi ghaṭa ādike arthe na anena samāna jātīyam dṛśya antaram asti yadi abhaviṣyat idam iva adrakṣyata na ca dṛśyate tasmāt darśana abhāvāt na asti iti gamyate evam pramāṇena api sati pramīyamāṇe na anena samāna jātīyam prameya antaram asti yadi abhaviṣyat idam iva amāsyata na tu mīyate tasmāt māna abhāvāt na asti iti tat evam sataḥ prakāśakam pramāṇam asat api prakāśayati iti tatra asat bhedāḥ svātantryeṇa na prakāśante iti na ucyante caturvarga anantarbhāvāt vā bhāva prapañca vat abhāva prapañcaḥ api uddiṣṭaḥ veditavyaḥ iti bhāva upadeśāt eva abhāvaḥ upadiṣṭaḥ bhavati iti atas ca na ucyantaḥ iti

tatra sat ca khalu ṣoḍaśadhā vyūḍham upadekṣyate iti vyūhaḥ saṃkṣepaḥ te ete sat bhedāḥ iti sūtram pramāṇa prameya saṃśaya prayojana dṛṣṭānta siddhānta avayava tarka nirṇaya vāda jalpa vitaṇḍā hetvābhāsa chala ja ati nigraha sthānānām tattva jñānāt niḥśreyasa adhigamaḥ sarva padārtha pradhānaḥ samāsaḥ dvandvaḥ kim uktam bhavati sarve ete pramāṇa ādayaḥ vijñeyāḥ iti anyathā hi samāsa antara parigrahāt viśeṣaṇa tvena upayuktānām pramāṇa ādīnām avijñeya tā syāt yathāvacanam vigrahaḥ iti yat eva nirdeśe vacana bheda upādāne prayojanam tat iha api draṣṭavyam iti pramāṇa ādīnām tattvam iti śaiṣikī ṣaṣṭhī kaḥ punar śeṣaḥ kārakāṇām avivakṣā śeṣaḥ iti yatra na kārakam kāraka arthaḥ

vā vivakṣyate sa śeṣaḥ tat yathā brāhmaṇasya kamaṇḍaluḥ iti tattvasya pramāṇa ādibhyaḥ anyān anya tve doṣaḥ yadi tāvat pramāṇa ādi vyatiriktam tattvam na pramāṇa ādi jñānāt niḥśreyasa adhigamaḥ iti prāptam kim kāraṇam tattva viśeṣaṇa tvena upādānāt rāja puruṣa ānayana kriyā vat iti atha abhedaḥ tattva grahaṇa ānarthakyam yadi pramāṇa ādi vyatiriktam tattvam na pratipadyasaḥ evam tarhi tattva grahaṇam anarthakam sampadyate iti na ubhayathā api adoṣāt iti eke yadi tāvat pramāṇa ādi vyatiriktam tattvam syāt tasya asvatantra tvāt pramāṇa ādayaḥ api gamyante id kuṇḍe badara vṛtti vat iti yathā ukte kuṇḍe badarāṇām vṛttiḥ iti bhāve deśite bhāvasya asvatantra tvāt kuṇḍe badarāṇi vartante iti

uktam bhavati tathā iha api tattva jñānāt niḥśreyasa adhigamaḥ iti pramāṇa ādīnām grahaṇam bhāvasya asvatantra tvāt iti abhede api iṣu sthiti vat tad bhāva pratiṣedhaḥ na artha antaram iti na pramāṇa ādi mātram ucyate api tu artha antaram pratiṣidhyate yathā iṣoḥ sthitiḥ iti na iṣu mātram sthitiḥ api tu gatimat artha antaram na bhavati iti tat na anartha antara tva asiddheḥ tattva jñānāt niḥśreyasa adhigamaḥ iti tattvam jñāyamānam karma sampadyate niḥśreyasam ca adhigamyamānam karma bhavati iti kim punar tattvam kim vā niḥśreyasam iti tattvam padārthānām yathā vyavasthita ātma pratyaya utpatti nimitta tvam yaḥ yathā vyavasthitaḥ padārthaḥ sa tathābhūtasya pratyayasya utpatti nimittam bhavati iti etat tattvam

niḥśreyasam punar dṛṣṭa adṛṣṭa bhedāt dvedhā bhavati tatra pramāṇa ādi padārtha tattva jñānāt dṛṣṭam niḥśreyasam na hi kaścid padārthaḥ jñāyamānaḥ hāna upādāna upekṣā buddhi nimittam na bhavati iti evam ca kṛtvā sarve api padārthāḥ jñeyatayā upakṣipyante iti param tu niḥśreyasam ātma ādeḥ tattva jñānāt bhavati iti dṛṣṭam pramāṇa ādi parijñānāt adṛṣṭam punar ātma ādeḥ prameyasya tattva parijñānāt iti na pramāṇam asti na na asti arthasya tathā abhāvāt arthaḥ eva ayam tathābhūtaḥ yat ātma ādeḥ prameyasya tattva jñānāt niḥśreyasam adhigamyate yadā hi ayam ātma ādi prameyam viparyayeṇa adhyavasitaḥ bhavati atha saṃsāram na ativartate iti enam ca artham dvitīya sūtre pratipādayiṣyāmaḥ

yadi punar pramāṇa ādi padārtha tattva jñānāt niḥśreyasam syāt na mokṣamāṇāḥ mokṣāya ghaṭeran na hi kasyacid kvacid ca tattva jñānam na asti iti tasmāt ātma ādi eva prameyam mumukṣuṇā jñeyam iti pṛthak upadeśāt ca yadi ca pramāṇa ādi eva prameyam syāt tasya ca parijñānāt niḥśreyasam bhavet na ātma ādi prameyam pṛthak upadṛṣṭam syāt prameya avadhāraṇa arthāyām ca uttara sūtra prakriyāyām prameyasya vihita tvāt ādyena sūtreṇa akuśalaḥ sūtrakāraḥ syāt tat ca etat uttara sūtreṇa anūdyate iti bhāṣyam heya hāna upāya adhigantavya bhedāt catvāri artha padāni samyak buddhvā niḥśreyasam adhigacchati iti heyam iti heyam duḥkham tasya nirvartakam avidyā tṛṣṇe dharma adharmau iti hānam tattva jñānam upāyaḥ śāstram adhigantavyaḥ mokṣaḥ etāni catvāri artha padāni sarvāsu adhyātma vidyāsu sarva ācāryaiḥ varṇyante iti

saṃśaya ādi agrahaṇam pṛthak prameya antarbhāvāt iti ced na vidyā prasthāna prabheda jñāpana artha tvāt iti saṃśaya ādayaḥ prameye antarbhavanti iti pṛthak te na vācyāḥ na vidyā prasthāna prabheda jñāpana artha tvāt catasraḥ imāḥ vidyāḥ bhavanti iti tāḥ ca pṛthak prasthānāḥ agni hotra havana ādi prasthānā trayī hala śakaṭa ādi prasthānā vārtā svāmi amātya bheda anuvidhāyinī daṇḍanītiḥ saṃśaya ādi bheda anuvidhāyinī ānvīkṣikī tasyāḥ saṃśaya ādi prasthānam antareṇa adhyātma vidyā mātram iyam syāt tatas kim syāt adhyātma vidyā mātra tvāt upaniṣad vidyāvat trayyām eva antarbhāvaḥ iti catuṣṭvam nivartate tasmāt pṛthak ucyante iti

tatra saṃśayaḥ tāvat vastu svarūpa anavadhāraṇa ātmakaḥ pratyayaḥ anavadhāraṇa ātmakaḥ ca pratyayaḥ ca iti vyāhanyate na vyāghātaḥ svarūpa avadhāraṇāt sva rūpam asya avadhāryate asti me saṃśaya jñānam iti vastu svarūpam tu na anena paricchidyate tat ubhayam anavadhāraṇa ātmakaḥ ca pratyayaḥ ca iti sa katham nyāyasya aṅgam bhavati iti yasmāt na anupalabdhe na nirṇīte arthe nyāyaḥ pravartate upalabdhaḥ anirṇītaḥ ca iti vyāghātaḥ yadi upalabdhaḥ na anirṇītaḥ atha anirṇītaḥ na upalabdhaḥ upalabdhaḥ anirṇītaḥ ca iti vyāhatam na asti vyāghātaḥ sāmānyena upalabdhaḥ viśeṣataḥ anirṇītaḥ iti evam api yathā upalabdhaḥ tathā anirṇītaḥ iti vyāghāta anivṛttiḥ na anivṛttiḥ yathā tathā iti vyapadeśāt sarvathā nirṇīte yathā nirṇītaḥ tathā upalabdhaḥ iti anarthakam syāt tasmāt sāmānyatas upalabdhaḥ viśeṣataḥ anirṇītaḥ iti sa ca ayam saṃśayaḥ evambhūtaḥ prameye antarbhavan evam artham pṛthak ucyate

atha prayojanam kim punar prayojanam iti yena prayuktaḥ pravartate tat prayojanam iti laukikaḥ ayam arthaḥ kena punar prayujyate dharma artha kāma mokṣaiḥ iti kecid vayam tu paśyāmaḥ sukha duḥkha āpti hānibhyām prayujyate iti sukha duḥkha sādhana bhāvāt tu sarve arthāḥ cetanam prayojayanti tat idam prayojanam nyāyasya āśrayaḥ kaḥ āśraya arthaḥ ādhāra arthaḥ tāvat na bhavati upakāraka tvam āśraya arthaḥ tad mūla tvāt parīkṣā vidheḥ prayojane sati parīkṣyate iti prayojanam parīkṣām pravartayati iti kā punar iyam parīkṣā nyāyaḥ kaḥ punar ayam nyāyaḥ pramāṇaiḥ artha parīkṣaṇam

nyāyaḥ kim uktam bhavati samasta pramāṇa vyāpārāt artha adhigatiḥ nyāyaḥ iti na ekaikam pramāṇam artha pariccheda hetu bhāvena vyavatiṣṭhamānam nyāyaḥ iti ucyate kiṃtu samastāni saḥ ayam vipratipanna puruṣa pratipādaka tvāt paramaḥ nyāyaḥ iti vakṣyāmaḥ pratyakṣa āgama āśritam ca anumānam iti pratyakṣa āgama āśritam iti pratyakṣa āgama avirodhi yadi hi anumāna adhigataḥ arthaḥ pratyakṣa āgamābhyām anusandhīyeta atha sphuṭataraḥ pratyayaḥ bhavati yatra punar etāni pramāṇāni itara itara apratisaṃhitāni vyāvṛttāni prayujyante nyāya viplavaḥ asau lābha pūjā khyāti kāmaiḥ tīrtha pratirūpakaḥ pravādaḥ varṇyate

yat punar anumānam pratyakṣa āgama viruddham nyāya ābhāsaḥ saḥ iti pratyakṣa viruddham tāvat anuṣṇaḥ agniḥ kṛtaka tvāt ghaṭa ādi vat iti kaḥ punar asya anumānasya virodhaḥ anumāna aviṣaye prayogaḥ na ayam anumānasya viṣaye prayogaḥ na ayam anumānasya viṣayaḥ yasmin viṣaye etat prayujyate sa pratyakṣena apahṛtaḥ iti apare punar aśrāvaṇaḥ śabdaḥ iti pratyakṣa virodham varṇayanti taiḥ tu na pratyakṣasya viṣayaḥ jñātaḥ na anumānasya viṣayaḥ iti kim kāraṇam indriya vṛttīnām atīndriya tvāt śrāvaṇa tvam ca indriya vṛttiḥ sā katham pratyakṣā bhavati āgama viruddham śuci nara śiraḥ kapālam prāṇi aṅga tvāt śaṅkha śukti vat iti katham idam āgama viruddham śuci nara śiraḥ kapālam iti bruvatā śuci arthaḥ vācyaḥ kim uktam bhavati śuci iti yadi spraṣṭuḥ pratyavāya abhāvaḥ sa kasya iti vācyam yadi ātmanaḥ iti brūyāt tad āgama anuṣṭhāna tātparyena avasthānāt evam etat

atha trayī vidām iti brūyāt trayī abhyupagamāt virodhaḥ iti vācyam śuci nara śiraḥ kapālam iti kaḥ arthaḥ viśeṣa vidhānam etat viśeṣa vidhānam ca śeṣam pratiṣedhati yadi śuci nara śiraḥ kapālam iti kim aśuci iti vācyam atha sarvam eva śuci dṛṣṭāntaḥ na asti sarvasya pakṣīkṛta tvāt atha anumāna viruddham kasmāt anumānam na bhavati ekasmin anumāna dvaya samāveśa asambhavān na virodhaḥ na hi anvaya vyatireka sampanne anumāne ekasmin vastuni samāviśataḥ tasmāt na anumāna viruddham pratyakṣa virodhi api tarhi na prāpnoti na na prāpnoti anvaya vyatireka sampannasya pratyakṣena bādhita tvāt atha upamāna viruddham kasmāt na bhavati na upamāna viruddham pūrva pramāṇa virodha anuvidhānāt upamāna virodhaḥ pūrva pramāṇa virodha anuvidhāyini āgama ahita saṃskāra smṛti apekṣam ca sārūpya jñānam upamānam iti vakṣyāmaḥ pratyakṣa āgamayoḥ virodhāt uktam tat iti

tatra vāda jalpau sa prayojanau iti bhāṣyam tasya kutas utthānam tena anena prayojanena sarve prāṇinaḥ sarvāṇi karmāṇi sarvāḥ ca vidyā vyāptāḥ iti tatra vāda jalpau kiṃprayojanau iti yuktaḥ vicāraḥ iti atas āha tatra vāda jalpau sa prayojanau iti tasmin nyāya ābhāsaḥ iti vitaṇḍā tu parīkṣyate sa prayojanā niṣprayojanā vā iti eke tāvat bruvate niṣprayojanā dūṣaṇa mātra tvāt iti tat ca na evam na dūṣaṇa mātram vitaṇḍā kim tarhi abhyupetya pakṣam yaḥ na sthāpayati sa vaitaṇḍikaḥ iti ucyate atha pakṣam api na pratipadyate unmatta vat upekṣaṇīyaḥ bhavati atha para pakṣa pratiṣedha jñāpanam prayojanam iti tādṛś eva etat etasmin api caturvargam ced pratipadyate saḥ asya pakṣaḥ caturvargaḥ bhāṣyaḥ uktaḥ atha na pratipadyate pūrvavat upekṣyaḥ pratipakṣa sthāpanā hīnam ca vākyam vitaṇḍa iti ucyate tasya abhidheyam yadi artham pratipadyate saḥ asya pakṣaḥ atha na pratipadyate pūrvavat doṣaḥ iti uktam prayojanam

pratyakṣa viṣayaḥ arthaḥ dṛṣṭāntaḥ kim uktam bhavati laukika parīkṣakāṇām darśana avighāta hetuḥ iti evam ca ātma ādi vyāptiḥ iti darśana avighāta hetutvena dṛṣṭānte varṇyamānaḥ ātma ādi vyāptam bhavati pratyakṣa ādi viṣaya tāyām ca ātmā ādi tyaktam bhavati tatas ca udāharaṇa sūtram vyāhanyeta saḥ ayam dṛṣṭāntaḥ prameyam upalabdhi viṣaya tvāt tasya pṛthak upadeśaḥ nyāyasya tad mūla tvāt sati tasmin anumāna āgamau syātām asati ca na syātām iti pūrva pratyakṣam artham anumimīte pūrva jñātam ca artham parasmāy ācaṣṭe iti nāstikasya ca vyāghātaḥ abhyupagame anabhyupagame vā tat uktam bhāṣyaḥ iti

abhyupagama vyavasthā siddhāntaḥ abhyupagamaḥ idam ittham bhūtam ca iti idam iti sāmānyatas ittham bhūtam iti viśeṣataḥ tasya vyavasthā idam sāṃkhyeṣu eva idam yogeṣu eva iti sarva tantra siddhāntaḥ tarhi na siddhāntaḥ avyavasthānāt na hi ayam kva cit vyavatiṣṭhate iti tat ca na yaḥ ayam sarvaiḥ abhyupagamaḥ iyam eva vyavasthā tasya prameye antar bhrūtasya pṛthak vacanam vāda ādi viṣaya tvāt siddhānta bhede sati vāda jalpa vitaṇḍāḥ pravartante iti

atha avayavāḥ avayavāḥ vākya eka deśāḥ kim punar vākyam pūrva pada smṛti apekṣaḥ antya pada pratyayaḥ smṛti anugrahena pratisandhīyamānaḥ viśeṣa pratipatti hetuḥ vākyam tasya bhāgāḥ eka deśāḥ iti te kiyantaḥ yāvadbhiḥ siddhiḥ parisamāpyate iti kā punar iyam siddhiḥ padārthasya tathā tā kā parisamāptiḥ viśeṣa pratyayaḥ te samākhyā śabdaiḥ abhidhīyante pratijña ādayaḥ iti tatra āgamaḥ pratijñā iti na yuktam āgamasya tattva vyavacchedaka tvāt pratijñā arthasya ca pratipādya tvāt āgama adhigatasya pratipādya tvāt āgamaḥ pratijñā iti na doṣaḥ yaḥ eva arthaḥ āgamena adhigataḥ tam

eva parasmāy ācaṣṭe iti āgamaḥ pratijñā iti ucyate evam liṅga darśana mātre hetu upacārāt dhetuḥ anumānam iti yat tu dvitīyam liṅga darśanam tad sambandha smṛti vyakti hetu bhāvāt dhetuḥ iti ucyate smṛti viṣayasya pratyakṣatas punar upadarśanāt udāharaṇam pratyakṣam yasmāt pūrva anubhūtam artham smarati tam ca smṛti viṣayam udāharaṇa tvena upādatte iti tena pūrva anubhava prasiddham anuvidhīyamānam pratyakṣam iva pratyakṣam iti kaḥ punar upamāna arthaḥ avipratipattiḥ yathā pratyakṣe na vipratipadyate evam udāharaṇe api iti yathā tathā iti upamāna eka deśaḥ upamāna upacārāt

upamānam upanayaḥ iti upamānam khalu yathā tathā iti upadeśa upayoge sati pratyakṣa āgama smṛti pūrvakam sārūpya jñānam upamānam iti tatra upamāna eka deśe upamānam iti upacaranti sarveṣām eka artha samavāye sāmarthya pradarśanam nigamanam iti kaḥ punar eka artha samavāyaḥ eka vākya adhyāropaḥ kim punar sāmarthyam itaretara sampratyāyita artha apekṣi tvam etat ca vakṣyāmaḥ iti nigamyante anena pratijña ādayaḥ eka arthe sambadhyante iti saḥ ayam paramaḥ nyāyaḥ iti kaḥ punar parama arthaḥ vipratipanna puruṣa pratipādaka tvam ekaikaśas pramāṇāni varttamānāni apratipannam puruṣam

pratipādayanti vākya bhāva āpannāni punar vipratipannam atas ayam paramaḥ iti kim punar avayavāḥ pramāṇa antaram uta teṣu eva antarbhavanti kim ca atas yadi pramāṇa antaram parisaṃkhyānam ayuktam atha teṣu eva antarbhavanti pṛthak abhidhāna ānarthakyam avayavānām iti na pramāṇa antaram iti brūmaḥ saṃhatānām eteṣām vākya paratantrāṇām vipratipanna puruṣa pratipādaka tvena pṛthak upādānam iti te ete avayavāḥ pramāṇebhyaḥ pṛthak bhavantaḥ vāda jalpa vitaṇḍānām pravṛtti hetavaḥ bhavanti tattva vyavasthāyāḥ ca āśrayāḥ bhavanti iti kaḥ āśraya arthaḥ viśeṣa pratipādaka tvam iti

tarkaḥ na pramāṇa saṃgṛhītaḥ na pramāṇa antaram aparicchedaka tvāt pramāṇam paricchedakam na tarkaḥ tasmāt na pramāṇam na pramāṇa antaram api atas eva pramāṇa viṣaya vibhāgāt tu pramāṇānām anugrāhakaḥ yaḥ pramāṇānām viṣayaḥ tam vibhajate kaḥ punar vibhāgaḥ yukta ayukta vicāraḥ idam yuktam idam ayuktam iti yat tatra yuktam bhavati tat anujānāti na tu avadhārayati anavadhāraṇāt na pramāṇam bhavati tasya udāharaṇam bhāṣye karma nimittam janma iti katham punar karma nimitta tā janmanaḥ bhedavat tvāt kaḥ punar bhedaḥ sugatiḥ durgatiḥ ca iti sugatau devaḥ manuṣyaḥ iti manuṣya tve pumān itaraḥ iti puṃstve brāhmaṇaḥ anyaḥ iti brāhmaṇa tve paṭu indriyaḥ

mṛdu indriyaḥ iti paṭu indriya tāyām ucca abhijanaḥ nīca abhijanaḥ iti ucca abhijana tāyām sakalaḥ niṣkalaḥ iti sākalye vidvān mūrkhaḥ iti vidvattāyām samāśvāsinī paritrastaḥ iti samāśvāse vaśī parāyatte iti durgatau api tiryak nārakaḥ iti nāraka tve api kuṭaśālmalyām ayaḥ kumbhyām iti tiryaktāyām gauḥ itaraḥ iti saḥ ayam bhedaḥ anekam avasthitam anityam eka dravyam pratyātma niyatam nimittam antareṇa na yuktaḥ kim kāraṇam pṛthivī ādīnām sarva puruṣa sādhāraṇa tvāt pṛthivī ādi gatasya ca niyama hetoḥ abhāvāt sarvam sarva ātmakam prasajyeta dṛṣṭaḥ ca niyama bhedaḥ tasmāt karma niyāmakam iti saḥ ayam itthaṃbhūtaḥ tarkaḥ upalabdhi viṣaya tvāt prameyam

nirṇayaḥ tattva jñānam pramāṇānām phalam kadā punar nirṇayaḥ pramāṇānām phalam bhavati yadā vastu antara pariccheda hetu bhāvena na upādīyate tadā phalam yadā tena paricchinatti tadā pramāṇam iti na vyavatiṣṭhate pramāṇa phala bhāvaḥ etat ca vakṣyāmaḥ prameyā ca tulā prāmāṇya vat iti etasmin sūtre nimitta dvaya samāveśāt ekam vastu dvi śabda vācyam iti tau etau tarka nirṇayau lokayātrām vahate iti buddhvā buddhvā lokaḥ pravartamānaḥ tarka nirṇayābhyām heyam jahāti upādeyam ca upādatte asya antarbhāvaḥ pramāṇeṣu prameyeṣu vā yadā phalam tadā prameyam yadā anena paricchidyate tadā pramāṇam

vādaḥ nānā pravaktṛkaḥ iti siddhānta bheda anuvidhānāt nānā pravaktṛkaḥ iti pratyadhikaraṇa sādhanaḥ anyatara adhikaraṇa nirṇaya avasānaḥ iti adhikaraṇam adhikaraṇam prati pratyadhikaraṇam asya sādhanam kim uktam bhavati ubhābhyām sādhanam vaktavyam iti anyatarasmin adhikaraṇe nirṇayaḥ etat ca vakṣyāmaḥ saḥ ayam kiṃrūpaḥ vādaḥ vākya samūhaḥ iti āha nanu ca pramāṇa tarka sādhana upālambhaḥ iti śrūyate pramāṇāni ca jñāna ātmakāni indriya artha sannikarṣa utpannam jñānam iti evam ādinā prakrameṇa pramāṇāni jñāna ātmakāni iti uktam tarkaḥ ca ūhaḥ sa ca uhaḥ jñāna ātmakaḥ eva tasmāt vākya samūhaḥ vādaḥ iti na yuktam na pramāṇa tarka sādhana upālambha śabdasya anyathā vyākhyānāt tat ca sūtram varṇayiṣyantaḥ vakṣyāmaḥ

tad viśeṣau jalpa vitaṇḍe iti kaḥ punar viśeṣaḥ aṅga ādhikyam aṅga hāniḥ ca iti chala ja ati nigraha sthāna prayogāt adhikaḥ jalpaḥ sa pratipakṣa sthāpanā hīnaḥ tu vitaṇḍā etāvatā ca viśeṣeṇa kathā mārga bhedaḥ iti viṣaya bhedāt ca bhedaḥ śiṣya ādi viṣayaḥ vādaḥ śiṣyamāṇa viṣaye jalpa vitaṇḍe iti anyatama liṅga dharma anuvidhānena pravartamānāḥ ahetavaḥ santaḥ hetu vat ābhāsantaḥ iti hetvābhāsāḥ te ca nigraha sthānam nigraha sthāna prāptānām punar eṣām pṛthak upadeśaḥ vāde codanīya tvāt iti bhāṣyam yasmāt kila ete vāde codyanta atas pṛthak upadiśyante iti na ubhayathā api asambandhān na vāde codanīya tvam pṛthak upadeśa avinābhāvi pṛthak upadeśaḥ vā vāde codanīya tva āvinā abhāvi iti yadi tāvat yaḥ pṛthak upadiśyate sa vāde ca udyate iti sarve padārthāḥ vāde codanīyāḥ prasajyante iti kim kāraṇam sarve pṛthak ukadiṣṭāḥ iti atha vāde codyante ye te pṛthak upadiśyante iti tat api na anekāntāt na tāvat nigraha sthānebhyaḥ

nyūna adhikayoḥ pṛthak upadeśaḥ atha ca codyete vādaḥ iti tasmāt vāde codanīya tvāt pṛthak upadeśaḥ iti yat kiṃcid etat etat eva tu nyāyyam pṛthak upadeśa prayojanam vidyā prasthāna bheda jñāpana artha tvāt iti atha kasmāt nigraha sthāna bhāva āpannānām hetvābhāsānām pṛthak upadeśaḥ iti pramāṇa sāmānyāt pṛthak upadeśaḥ iti atha kasmāt vāde deśyante pramāṇa sāmānyāt pramāṇāni vāde abhidhīyante pramāṇa sāmānyam ca hetvābhāseṣu asti atas pramāṇa sāmānyāt vāde abhidhīyante iti atha vāde nigraha sthānāni kānicid santi kānicid na iti kim ayam padārthānām niyogaḥ atha tathābhūtānām anvākhyānam iti kim ca atas yadi tāvat niyoga

evam bhavatā evam mā bhūta iti padārthān niyuñjānaḥ bhavān upekṣaṇīyaḥ atha svarūpataḥ eva avasthitāḥ padārthāḥ tān anujānāti bhavān iti kasmāt nigraha sthānāni kānicid vāde bhavanti kānicid na iti vaktavyam na lakṣaṇa paratantra tvāt artha tathā bhāvasya iti brūmaḥ na padārthāḥ vaktuḥ niyogam anuvidhīyante yathā tu bhavanti tathābhūtāḥ eva arthāḥ anvākhyāyante saḥ ayam lakṣaṇa paratantram tattvam anvācakṣāṇaḥ nābhi ākhyeyaḥ padārthāḥ bhavatā niyujyante iti vādasya śiṣya ādi viṣaya tvāt na ca śiṣya ādibhiḥ saha vādam kurvāṇena api apratibhā ādi codanā kāryā tāvat asya abhidheyam yāvat asau bodhitaḥ bhavati iti pramāṇa pratirūpaka tvāt tu

hetvābhāsānām avarodhaḥ iti kim kāraṇam bhrānteḥ puruṣa dharma tvāt puruṣa dhramaḥ eva ayam bhrāntiḥ iti saḥ ayam bhrāntyā pramāṇam bruvan pramāṇa ābhāsam api brūte atas asya nigrahaḥ iti kaḥ punar śiṣya ācāryayoḥ nigrahaḥ iti vivakṣita artha apratipādaka tvam nyūna adhika apasiddhāntānām vāde katham avatāraḥ pramāṇa sāmānyāt eva nyūnasya api pramāṇa sāmānyam adhikasya api pramāṇa sāmānyam asti avayava hīna tā ca avayava adhika tā ca vākyasya bhrāntyā bhavataḥ iti asti avatāraḥ jalpa vitaṇḍayoḥ tu nigraha sthānāni iti vijigīṣuḥ jalpa vitaṇḍābhyām pratyavastheyaḥ tasya yathāsambhavam nigraha sthānāni vaktavyāni iti na upekṣaṇīyaḥ

chala ja ati nigraha sthānānām sva vākye parivarjanam para vākye paryanuyogaḥ parijñāna artham eva kevalam chala ja ati nigraha sthānāni svayam na prayojyāni iti jāteḥ tu svayam ca sukaraḥ prayogaḥ iti na vyāghātāt sva vākye parivarjanam sukaraḥ ca prayogaḥ iti vyāhatam yadi sukaraḥ prayogaḥ na sva vākye parivarjanam atha sva vākye parivarjanam na sukaraḥ prayogaḥ iti vyāghātaḥ na vyāghātaḥ praśna apākaraṇa artha tvāt svayam ca sukaraḥ prayogaḥ iti kim uktam bhavati pareṇa jātau prayuktāyām praśnikān bravīti jātiḥ anena prayuktā iti te enam pratyanuyuñjīran katham jātiḥ katamā jātiḥ iti atas jāti abhijñaḥ sukham śaknoti vaktum evam jātiḥ iyam ca jātiḥ iti evam ca sukaraḥ prayogaḥ iti tasmāt ete saṃśaya ādayaḥ padārthāḥ pramāṇe prameye ca antarbhavantaḥ vidyā prasthāna bheda jñāpana artham pṛthak upadiṣṭāḥ iti

sā iyam ānvīkṣikī nyāya vidyā pramāṇa ādibhiḥ padārthaiḥ vibhajyamānā pradīpaḥ sarva vidyānām bhavati prakāśaka tvāt pradīpaḥ pramāṇa ādi pratipāditam artham itarāḥ vidyāḥ pratipadyante iti kim itarāsu vidyāsu pramāṇa ādīni na santi na santi iti āha katham na santi anadhikārāt na tāḥ vidyāḥ pramāṇa ādi parijñānena adhikriyante iti pramāṇa ādi prakāśite tu arthe tāḥ pravartante iti upāyaḥ sarva karmaṇām iti pramāṇa prakāśitānām karaṇāt upāyaḥ yasmāt pramāṇa prakāśitam artham itarāḥ vidyāḥ kurvanti āśrayaḥ sarva dharmāṇām iti sarva vidyā upakāraka tvāt āśrayaḥ sarvāsām vidyānām iyam upakaroti upakāri tvāt āśrayaḥ rāja bhṛtya vat iti

tat idam tattva jñānam niḥśreyasa adhigamaḥ ca yathāvidyam veditavyam sarvāsu vidyāsu tattva jñānam asti niḥśreyasa adhigamaḥ ca iti trayyām tāvat kim tattva jñānam kaḥ ca niḥśreyasa adhigamaḥ iti tattva jñānam tāvat agnihotra ādi sādhanānām svāgata ādi parijñānam anupahata ādi parijñānam ca niḥśreyasa adhigamaḥ api svarga prāptiḥ tathā hi atra svargaḥ phalam śrūyate iti atha vārtāyām kim tattva jñānam kaḥ vā niḥśreyasa adhigamaḥ iti bhūmi ādi parijñānam tattva jñānam bhūmiḥ kaṇṭaka ādi anupahata iti etat tattva jñānam niḥśreyasam sasya adhigamaḥ tad phalam daṇḍanītyām kim tattva jñānam kaḥ vā niḥśreyasa adhigamaḥ iti sāma dāna daṇḍānām yathākālam yathādeśam yathāśakti viniyogaḥ tattva jñānam niḥśreyasam api pṛthivī jayaḥ iti iha tu adhyātma vidyāyām ātma ādi jñānam tattva jñānam niḥśreyasa adhigamaḥ apavarga prāptiḥ iti

yat punar pramāṇa ādi tattva jñānāt niḥśreyasam na tat vivakṣitam mada māna ādi nimitta tvāt vāda ādi parijñānasya nābhi sambandhaḥ niḥśreyasena iti kecid na ca anabhisambaddham pratipādayati iti ayuktam uktam pramāṇa ādi tattva jñānāt niḥśreyasam iti na sūtra artha aparijñānāt sūtra artham naḥ na vyajñāsīḥ yatas evam pratyapatthāḥ kaḥ evam sūtra artham varṇayanti pramāṇa ādi padārtha tattva jñānāt niḥśreyasam iti api tu yat parijñānāt niḥśreyasam tat anantara sūtre vakṣyāmaḥ uktam ca ātma ādeḥ khalu prameyasya tattva jñānāt niḥśreyasa adhigamaḥ iti yat ca idam ucyate mada māna ādi nimitta bhūtāḥ vāda ādayaḥ iti etat ca na asati bhāvāt sati ca abhāvāt asati vāda ādi jñāne rāga ādayaḥ sanaka ādīnām bhavanti sati ca tattva vidām na bhavanti tasmāt na nimittam vāda ādi parijñānam rāga ādīnām iti
