iti yadi upalabdhiḥ sattva sādhanam tatas anupalabdhiḥ asattvam sādhayati viparyaye hi hetoḥ sāmarthyam dṛṣṭam iti na citta vyatirekiṇaḥ viṣayāḥ grāhya tvāt vedanā vat iti yathā vedanā ādi grāhyam na ca citta vyatiriktam tathā viṣayāḥ api vedanā sukha duḥkhe cittam vijñānam iti sukha duḥkhābhyām ca anyat jñānam iti asiddhaḥ dṛṣṭāntaḥ sukha duḥkhe grāhye grahaṇam vijñānam iti grāhya grahaṇa bhāvāt anya tvam atha abhinnam vijñānam vedanātas tathā api grāhyam ca gṛhītiḥ ca ekam iti na dṛṣṭāntaḥ asti na hi karma ca kriyā ca ekam bhavati iti atha eka tvam pramāṇa vṛttam anapekṣya pratipadyethāḥ tathā api catvāraḥ skandhāḥ iti śāstra vyāghātaḥ atha catuṣṭvam na pratipadyate dṛṣṭam vijñāna mātram eva abhyupeyāt saḥ api dṛṣṭam vijñāna bhedam anuyoktavyaḥ bāhyasya ādhyātmikasya ca vijñāna bheda hetoḥ abhāvāt katham vijñāna bhedaḥ

iti svapna vat vijñāna bhedam yadi pratipadyase saḥ api dṛṣṭa anumitānām arthānām bhāvanā vaśena vijñāna bhedam pratipādayitavyaḥ atha svapna pakṣe api bhāvanā bhedāt vijñāna bhedam pratipadyeta saḥ api bhāvanā bhāvaka vargayoḥ bhedena pratyavastheyaḥ na abhinnam bhāvyam bhāvakam ca iti ye ca ete svapna ādi pratyayāḥ pura vimāna udyāna yāna ādi bheda anuvidhāyinaḥ te mithyā pratyayāḥ iti mithyā pratyayānām ca jāgrat avasthā pratyaya sāmānyāt bhāvaḥ mama api sarve eva mithyā pratyayāḥ bhavanti iti bruvāṇaḥ pradhānam anuyoktavyaḥ na niṣpradhānam viparyaya pratyayam paśyāmaḥ iti citta vyatirekiṇam ca viṣayam apratipadyamānaḥ sādhana dūṣaṇayoḥ svabhāvaḥ paryanuyoktavyaḥ yadi bāhya svabhāvakam vyāghātaḥ atha citta svabhāvakam na cittena paraḥ pratipadyate iti na artha pratipattiḥ na hi itareṇa svapnam anākhyātam itaraḥ vijānāti iti atha

śabda ākāram cittam pratipadyate tena api śabda ākāram cittam iti ākāra arthaḥ vaktavyaḥ ākāraḥ hi nāma pradhāna vastu sāmānyāt atasmin tat iti pratyayaḥ na ca bhavat pakṣe śabdaḥ vidyate iti śabda ākāram cittam iti nirabhidheyam vākyam citta vyatiriktam ca viṣayam apratipadyamānaḥ jāgrat svapna avasthayoḥ bhedam paryanuyojyaḥ jāgratavasthāyām viṣayāḥ na santi svapna avasthāyām ca iti iyam svapna avasthāḥ iyam jāgrat avasthāḥ iti kutas etat dharma adharma vyavasthānam ca na prāpnoti yathā svapna avasthāyām agamyā gamanāt adharma utpattiḥ na bhavati evam jāgrat avasthāyām na syāt atha siddha upaghāta anupaghātau bhedakau pratipadyeta tat api tādṛś eva middha upaghātaḥ cetasaḥ vaikṛtya hetuḥ iti etat katham avagamyate atha vijñānasya spaṣṭām ca aspaṣṭām ca bhedam pratipadyeta viṣayam antareṇa jñānasya spaṣṭa tā ca aspaṣṭa tā ca vaktavyā

asati arthe vijñāna bhedaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ iti ced atha manyase yathā tulya karma vipāka utpannāḥ pretāḥ pūya pūrṇām nadīm paśyanti na tatra nadī asti na pūyam na hi ekam vastu aneka ākāram bhavitum arhati iti dṛṣṭaḥ ca vijñāna bhedaḥ ke cit tām eva jala pūrṇām nadīm paśyanti ke cit rudhira pūrṇām iti atas avasīyate ādhyātmaka nimitta apekṣam asati bāhye nimitte vijñānam eva tathā utpadyate iti na vyāghātāt asati bāhye vijñānam eva tathā utpadyate iti bruvāṇaḥ praṣṭavyaḥ jāyate katham tathā iti yadi rudhira ākāram vijñānam rudhiram tarhi vaktavyam kim rudhiram iti evam jala ākāram nadī ākāram ca vaktavyam pūya pūrṇām paśyanti iti ca vākyasya padāni pratyekam vicāryamāṇāni rūpa ādi skandha apavāde nirviṣayāṇi bhavanti deśa ādi niyamaḥ ca na prāpnoti ekasmin deśe nadīm pūya pūrṇām paśyanti na deśa antareṣu

asati arthe niyama hetuḥ vaktavyaḥ yasya punar vidyamānam kena cit ākāreṇa vyavasthitam tasya śeṣaḥ mithyā pratyayaḥ iti yuktam mithyā pratyayāḥ ca bhavantaḥ na pradhānam bādhante iti pūya ādi pratyayānām pradhānam vaktavyam iti yathā ca pūya ādi pratyayānām evam māyā gandharvanagara mṛga tṛṣṇikā ādi salilānām iti karmaṇaḥ vāsanāḥ anyatra phalam anyatra kalpate iti asya arthaḥ yatra eva kila karma tatra eva kila phalena bhavitavyam yasya ca citta vyatirekiṇaḥ viṣayāḥ tasya anyatra karma anyatra phalam iti vyadhikaraṇe karma phale bhavataḥ iti tat na anabhyupagamāt na mayā karma phale vyadhikaraṇe abhyupagamyete ātmani karma tatra eva phalam iti adoṣaḥ madīyāt cittāt artha antaram viṣayāḥ sāmānya viśeṣavat tvāt santāna antara citta vat pramāṇa gamya tvāt kāryatva anitya tvāt dharma pūrvaka tvāt ca iti

evam ca sati mithyā upalabdheḥ vināśaḥ tattva jñānāt svapna viṣaya abhimāna praṇāśa vat pratibodhe sthāṇau puruṣa adhyavasāyaḥ mithyā upalabdhiḥ tattva jñānena ca yaḥ mithyā adhyavasāyaḥ sa nivartate na arthaḥ sthāṇu puruṣala sāmānya kṣaṇaḥ na hi asau sthāṇuḥ na bhavati iti yathā svapna upalabdhānām ye adhyavasāyāḥ te jāgrat avasthā upalabdhyā nivartyante na arthaḥ viṣaya sāmānya lakṣaṇaḥ iti śeṣam bhāṣye

arthavat apratiṣedhaḥ mithyā buddheḥ nimittam asti kim punar tat sāmānya darśanam viśeṣa adarśanam avidyamāna viśeṣa adhyāropaḥ iti mithyā buddhim ca pratipadyamānena tasyāḥ nimittam vaktavyam nimittam ca pratipadyamānena arthaḥ abhyupeyaḥ iti
tattvam sthāṇuḥ iti pradhāna puruṣaḥ iti tattva pradhānayoḥ alope mithyā buddhiḥ bhavati iti śeṣam bhāṣye

doṣa nimittānām tattva jñānāt ahaṅkāra nivṛttiḥ iti uktam atha tattva jñānam katham utpadyate iti samādhi viśeṣa abhyāsāt śeṣam bhāṣye vyāpaka tvāt antaḥkaraṇasya pratyāhāraḥ na yuktaḥ iti ced atha manyase vyāpakam antaḥkaraṇam tat katham pratyāhriyate iti na ukta uttara tvāt yathā na vyāpakam antaḥkaraṇam tathā uktam adhastāt aṇu tvāt sva aṅga gati īkṣaṇa anutpattiḥ iti ced atha manyase yasya api antaḥkaraṇam aṇu tasya api sva aṅga gati īkṣaṇe na prāpnutaḥ yugapad haste cakṣuṣi ca asannidhānāt na śarīra ātma manaḥ saṃyoga yaugapadyāt

prayatna darśanayoḥ yugapad utpatteḥ ātma śarīra sambandhaḥ ca ātmanaḥ sambandhaḥ ca yugapad bhavati iti tatra ātma manaḥ śarīra sambandhāt sva aṅga gatiḥ ātma manaḥ sambandhāt cakṣuṣaḥ preraṇam tathā sva aṅga gatiḥ prayatnāt bhavati iti darśanam cakṣūḥ aśmeḥ arthasya ca sannidhānāt iti na ca ātmanaḥ pradeśāḥ santi iti acodyam pradeśavati ca ātmani anyena ātma pradeśena manaḥ sambadhyate anyena śarīram iti sva aṅga gati īkṣaṇa ādi doṣaḥ yasya punar niṣpradeśaḥ eva ātmā tasya eṣaḥ doṣaḥ na bhavati iti tatra śarīram sambandhinā ātma manaḥ sambaddham iti
na upapadyate samādhi viśeṣa abhyāsaḥ abubhutsamānasya api buddhi utpatteḥ yathā stanayitnoḥ śabda prabhṛtiṣu iti
kṣudh pipāsābhyām ca anivṛttaḥ api buddhayaḥ eva utpadyante iti na yuktaḥ samādhi viśeṣaḥ

pūrva kṛtaḥ pūrva śarīra abhyastaḥ samādhi viśeṣaḥ tasya phalam dharmaḥ tad kṛtaḥ punar samādhi viśeṣaḥ iti samādhi viśeṣāt ca bāhya viṣaya abhibhavaḥ laukikasya api tāvat samādhi viśeṣa avasthitasya bāhya viṣaya upanipātena buddhayaḥ naḥ utpadyante kim aṅga punar yoginaḥ iti
araṇya guhā pulina ādiṣu yoga abhyāsa upadeśaḥ
yadi bāhya viṣaya upanipātāt vijñānāni prādurbhavanti apavarge api evam prasaṅgaḥ muktasya api apavarge bāhya viṣaya viśeṣa upanipātaḥ vidyate iti buddhi utpāda prasaṅgaḥ
sati śarīre bāhya viṣayaḥ jñāna utpatti kāraṇam na anyathā iti sūtra arthaḥ

tasya śarīra ādeḥ upalabdhi kāraṇasya abhāvaḥ apavarge iti tasmāt sarva duḥkha mokṣaḥ apavargaḥ iti yasmāt sarvam duḥkha bījam duḥkham ca apavarge vicchidyate tasmāt sarveṇa duḥkhena vimuktiḥ apavargaḥ
tasya apavargasya adhigamāya yama niyamābhyām ātma saṃskāraḥ
jñāna grahaṇam śāstra grahaṇam iti yaḥ evam upāyam buddhi ante iti tad vidyāḥ tad vidyaiḥ ati avibhakta artham vacanam
tam śiṣya guru sabrahmacārī iti evam ādi sūtram etat tu nigadena eva nīta artham
tam abhyupeyāt iti vartate
tattva adhyavasāya saṃrakṣaṇa artham jalpa vitaṇḍe bīja praroha saṃrakṣaṇa artham kaṇṭaka śākhā āvaraṇa vat iti anutpanna tattva jñānena etat kartavyam iti sūtra arthaḥ

vidyā nirveda ādibhiḥ ca pareṇa avajñāyamānasya tābhyām vigṛhya kathanam tābhyām jalpa vitaṇḍābhyām iti vigṛhya iti vijigīṣayā na tattva bubhutsayā iti vidyā paripālana artham ca etat na lābha pūjā khyātyartham iti pravṛtti doṣa saṃsiddhiḥ pretyabhāvaḥ prapañcataḥ phalam duḥkham vimuktiḥ ca tad upāyāḥ ca kīrtitāḥ

jāteḥ saṃkṣepeṇa uktāyāḥ vistaraḥ vaktavyaḥ iti idam ārabhate sādharmyādi sūtram tatra jātiḥ nāma sthāpana ahetau prayukte yaḥ pratirodha asamarthaḥ hetuḥ jāteḥ prayoga pratiṣedhāt asat uttara tvāt ca ārambhaḥ na yuktaḥ chala ja ati nigraha sthānānām sva vākye parivarjanam iti pratiṣiddhā jātiḥ na ca jātiḥ sat uttaram atas ca jāteḥ prayogaḥ na yuktaḥ na ārambha prayojanasya ukta uttara tvāt uktam jāteḥ ārambha prayojanam svayam ca sukaraḥ prayogaḥ iti sādhu sādhana nirākaraṇa artham ca prayogaḥ yadā ca vādī parasya sādhanam sādhu iti manyate lābha pūjā khyāti kāmaḥ ca bhavati tadā jātīḥ prayuṅkte kadā cit ayam jāti uttareṇa ākulīkṛtaḥ naḥ uttaram pratipadyeta uttara apratipattyā ca nigṛhyate anabhidhāne tu jāteḥ ekānta parājayaḥ parasya iti aikāntikāt parājayāt varam astu sandehaḥ iti yuktaḥ jāteḥ prayogaḥ

asādhu sādhana nirākaraṇa artham iti anye eke tu jāteḥ prayogam manyante asādhu sādhana nirākaraṇa artham evam ca āhuḥ asādhau tu sādhane prayukte yaḥ āsām prayogaḥ saḥ anabhijña tayā sādhana doṣasya tad doṣa pradarśana artham vā prasaṅga vyājena iti etat tu na yuktam prayojana abhāvāt yadi tāvat asādhu etat sādhanam iti pratipadyate yaḥ eva asya doṣaḥ buddhaḥ saḥ eva vaktavyaḥ na jāti abhidhānena prayojanam asti atha na budhyate kim iti jātim prayuṅkte na hi anavabudhyamānaḥ śaktaḥ prayoktum atha anavabuddhyamānaḥ api prayuṅkte yat kim cit brūyāt niyamaḥ na syāt iti

etena anaikāntike pañcānām prayogaḥ pratyuktaḥ yaḥ āhuḥ anaikāntike sādhane pareṇa prayukte pañca jātayaḥ prayoktavyāḥ iti tat api anena eva pratyuktam katham iti buddhvā tat eva vaktavyam abuddhvā ajñānam iti etena yukta āyukta pakṣayoḥ pūrva apara bhāvaḥ pratyuktaḥ ayukte sādhane ayuktam uttaram vaktum yukte yuktam iti yuktam ca nāma uttaram yat pratijña ādi doṣa udbhāvanam yat ca pratijña ādi doṣa udbhāvanam na asau jātiḥ uttaram eva tat iti jāti lakṣaṇa aparijñānāt ayuktam etat api iti

samīkaraṇa artham prayogaḥ samaḥ sādharmyam eva samam vaidharmyam eva samam iti sama arthaḥ samīkaraṇa arthaḥ prayogaḥ draṣṭavyaḥ samīkriyatām vā para pakṣaḥ mā vā kāri ayam tu samīkaraṇa artham pravartate iti yathā loke kuṭumba artham ghaṭate iti viśeṣa hetu abhāvaḥ vā sama arthaḥ na bhavatā viśeṣa hetuḥ kaḥ cit apadiśyate iti enam artham urarīkṛtya jāti vādī pravartate yathābhūtam bhavataḥ sādhanam tathābhūtam mama api iti na ca sarva apadeśa vyāptiḥ avyāpaka tvāt na hi sarva apadeśeṣu sarvāḥ jātayaḥ pravartante na hi vaidharmyeṇa sthāpanāyām utkarṣa apakarṣa varṇya avarṇya vikalpa samāḥ prayoktum śakyante iti na ca vādi prativādinoḥ tulya tā sama arthaḥ jāteḥ asat uttaratvāt niyamena jāti vādya sat vādī bhavati vādinām tu sat asat vādi tve aniyamaḥ iti

pratiṣedhau iti sādharmyeṇa upasaṃhāre tad viparīta sādharmyeṇa pratyavasthānam vaidharmyeṇa upasaṃhāre tad viparītena sādharmyeṇa pratyavasthānam sādharmya samaḥ yathā anityaḥ śabdaḥ utpatti dharmaka tvāt utpatti dharmakam kumbha ādi anityam dṛṣṭam yadi anitya ghaṭa sādharmyāt anityaḥ nityena api ākāśena sādharmyam amūrta tvam asti iti nityaḥ prāptaḥ iti etasmin eva hetau ākāśa vaidharmyāt iti ukte yadi nitya ākāśa vaidharmyāt anityaḥ nitya sādharmyam api ākāśena amūrta tvam asti atas nityaḥ prāptaḥ atha manyase sati asmin sādharmye na nityaḥ na tarhi vaktavyam anitya ghaṭa sādharmyāt nitya ākāśa vaidharmyāt ca anitya iti sā iyam jātiḥ viśeṣa hetu abhāvam darśayati

viśeṣa hetu abhāvāt ca anaikāntika deśana ābhāsāḥ iti evam vaidharmyeṇa ukte hetau tad viparīta vaidharmyeṇa pratyavasthānam sādharmyeṇa ca ukte hetau tad viparīta vaidharmyeṇa pratyavasthānam vaidharmya samaḥ yathā tasmin eva hetau ākāśa vaidharmyāt anityaḥ iti ukte yadi nitya ākāśa vaidharmyāt anityaḥ anityena api ghaṭena asya vaidharmyam amūrta tvam atas nityaḥ prāptaḥ tasmin eva hetau ghaṭa sādharmyāt iti kṛte yadi anitya ghaṭa sādharmyāt anityaḥ vaidharmyam api asya anena asti amūrta tvam atas nityaḥ prāptaḥ atha manyase sati etasmin vaidharmye na nityaḥ na tarhi ayam ekāntaḥ anitya ghaṭa sādharmyāt nitya ākāśa vaidharmyāt ca anityaḥ iti sā iyam viśeṣa hetu abhāvaḥ iti

anayoḥ uttaram go tvāt go siddhi vat tad siddhiḥ gavā aśvasā dharmye sattva ādau samāne vaidharmye ca ekaśapha tva ādau sādharmyāt sattvāt gauḥ aśvaḥ na bhavati na ca vaidharmyāt ekaśapha tva ādeḥ agauḥ gauḥ bhavati kiṃkāraṇam ekasya ananvayāt ekasya ca avyāvṛtteḥ yat anvayavyatireki sādharmyam tasmāt dharma vyavasthā go tvam ca tathā tasmāt go tvāt eva gauḥ sidhyati tathā iha api amūrta tvam ubhaya vyatireki ubhaya anvayi ca tasmāt nitya tvam anitya tvam ca na śakyam pratipattum api tu anvaya vyatireka sampannāt utpatti dharmaka tvāt anityaḥ iti atas yat bravīṣi viśeṣa hetu abhāvāt iti ayam viśeṣa hetuḥ iti

avidhyamāna dharma adhyāropaḥ utkarṣaḥ vidyamāna dharma apacayaḥ apakarṣaḥ varṇyaḥ sādhyaḥ avarṇyaḥ asādhyaḥ vikalpaḥ viśeṣaḥ eteṣām dharmāṇām udbhāvanā arthāḥ prayogāḥ utkarṣa sama ādyāḥ jātayaḥ iti sādhya sādhana dharmayoḥ tulya tayā pratyavasthānam sādhya samāḥ iti ucyate yathā tasmin eva hetau ghaṭa sādharmyāt iti kṛte yadi yathā ghaṭaḥ tathā śabdaḥ tadā ghaṭaḥ rūpa ādimān śabdaḥ api evam prasaktaḥ iti utkarṣa samaḥ śabdaḥ vā arūpaḥ iti ghaṭaḥ api evam prasaktaḥ iti apakarṣa samaḥ ghaṭaḥ anityaḥ iti avarṇyaḥ śabdaḥ api evam śabdaḥ vā varṇyaḥ iti ghaṭaḥ api evam iti varṇyāvarṇya samau sati etasmin utpatti dharmaka tve vibhāga jaḥ śabdaḥ na vibhāga jaḥ ghaṭaḥ vibhāga jā vibhāga ja vikalpa vat ca nityān iti vikalpaḥ iti vikalpa samaḥ ghaṭaḥ vā anityaḥ iti atra kaḥ hetuḥ ayam api sādhya vat prajñāpayitavyaḥ iti sādhya vat pratyavasthānāt sādhya samaḥ

na hetu artha aparijñānāt iti sūtra arthaḥ na brūmaḥ yāvantaḥ ghaṭa dharmāḥ te sarve eva śabde sambhavanti iti api tu yaḥ yasya sādhakaḥ dharmaḥ upapadyate sa tad sādhanam tatra upasaṃhriyate tathā ca śabdena utpatti dharmaka tvam śabde dharmaḥ upasaṃhriyate evam ca yathā uktam asambaddham yathā gauḥ tathā gavayaḥ iti ukte na go dharmāḥ sarve eva gavaye na gavaya dharmāḥ eva sarve eva gavi prāpnuvanti api tu yat itarasya itareṇa sambadhyate tāvat mātram eva upasaṃhriyate aśeṣa dharma upasaṃhāre tu yathā tathā iti evam na syāt saḥ eva asau iti syāt tathā iha api iti ayam adoṣaḥ yat punar etat vibhāga jā vibhāga ja vikalpa vat nitya anitya vikalpaḥ iti yathā utpatti dharmaka tvam anvayavyatireki naḥ evam vibhāga ja tvam na hi kim cit vibhāgāt jāyamānam yathā ukta viśeṣaṇam nityam anityam vā drṣṭam iti etat api anuttaram

dṛṣṭāntaḥ sādhyaḥ iti bruvatā bhavatā na dṛṣṭānta lakṣaṇam vyajñāyi dṛṣṭāntaḥ hi nāma avihatayoḥ darśanayoḥ viṣayaḥ tathā ca sādhya tvam anupapannam atha darśanam vihanyate na asau dṛṣṭāntaḥ lakṣaṇa abhāvāt iti yat tu atra uktam jātīnām paunaruktyam prasajyate iti na paunaruktyam artha bhedāt yathā ca utkarṣa sama ādīnām bhinnaḥ arthaḥ tathā uktam prayoga bheda darśanāt ca prayogaḥ ca bhinnaḥ utkarṣa sama ādīnām iti ānantyam iti ced atha manyase yadi prayoga bhedāt bhedaḥ na caturviṃśatiḥ jātayaḥ iti prāptam na anavadhāraṇāt na eva idam avadhāryate caturviṃśatiḥ jātayaḥ iti api tu udāharaṇānām bhedaḥ katham avagamyate tathā hi prakaraṇa samāḥ ekā caturdhā bhinnāḥ iti atha sāmānyatas abhinnāḥ jātayaḥ iti abhedam brūyāt tasya api abhyupagatam caturdaśa tvam nivartate atha kutas cit bhedāt bhedaḥ adeśyam tarhi utkarṣa sama ādyāḥ na vikalpa samāḥ atas bhidyante iti yathā kena cit bhedena caturdaśa tvam tathā kena cit bhedena caturviṃśati tvam aviśeṣa samā ca iyam jātiḥ utkarṣa sama ādīnām eka tvam kim cit sādharmyāt iti asyāḥ ca jāteḥ uktam uttaram

tasmin eva hetau ghaṭa ādi sādharmyāt iti kṛte yadi tāvat ayam hetuḥ sādhyam samprāpnoti prāptyā aviśiṣṭaḥ kaḥ aviśeṣa arthaḥ ubhayoḥ vidyamāna tā na avidyamānaḥ samprāpyate iti hetoḥ sādhana arthaḥ hīyate atha na prāpyate aprāpteḥ ahetubhiḥ aviśiṣṭa tvāt ahetuḥ bhavati na hi agniḥ aprāptaḥ dahati prāptyā pratyavasthānam prāpti samaḥ aprāptyā pratyavasthānam aprāpti samaḥ anayoḥ bhedena upadeśaḥ vivakṣātaḥ bheda vivakṣāyām prāpti aprāpti samau iti abheda vivakṣāyām tu ekam eva uttaram yathā vṛkṣāḥ vanam iti

jāti lakṣaṇa abhāvāt naḥ eva iyam jātiḥ iti ced atha manyase yat jāteḥ lakṣaṇam tat asyāḥ na asti sādharmya vaidharmyābhyām pratyavasthānam iti hi tat na ca lakṣaṇena asambaddhā jātiḥ iti śaktyam vaktum na hi go lakṣaṇa hīnaḥ aśvaḥ gauḥ iti na sūtra artha aparijñānāt sādharmya vaidharmyābhyām pratyavasthānam jātiḥ iti asya sūtrasya arthaḥ bhavatā na vyajñāyi iti anuttaram etat etena traikālya samādyāḥ pratyuktāḥ sūtra artha aparijñānāt

mṛd piṇḍa prāptānām daṇḍa ādīnām na aviśeṣaḥ na ca sādhya sādhana bhāva nivṛttiḥ na hi mṛd piṇḍa prāptaḥ daṇḍaḥ sādhanam na bhavati na api itarat sādhya tvam jahāti atha manyase ghaṭaḥ tatra sādhyaḥ tasya ca avidyamānasya kim sādhanena iti na avidyamānasya sādhanam api tu mṛd piṇḍaḥ ghaṭīkriyate iti kim idam ghaṭīkriyate iti mṛd avayavāḥ pūrva vyūha parityāgena vyūha antaram āpadyante vyūha antarāt ca ghaṭa utpattiḥ iti pīḍane ca abhicārāt aprāpya api ca sādhaka tvam dṛṣṭam kaḥ aprāpti arthaḥ paraspara upaśleṣaṇam antareṇa sādhaka tvam anyathā tu uddeśena asau prāptaḥ eva niyamāt iyam ca jātiḥ sarva hetu apavāda dvārikā yadi jñāpakaḥ hetuḥ apadiśyate tathā api atha api kārakaḥ tathā api iti sā ca iyam kārya kāraṇa tva apavāda dvāreṇa pravartamānā vyāhatā bhavati kaḥ vyāghātaḥ uttarasya anutthānam katham iti yadi idam uttaram prāpya artham kāraṇa tva apavāda dvāreṇa sādhayet aprāpya vā iti tasya api pratiṣedhyam prāpya vai aprāpya vā iti samānaḥ doṣaḥ

yathā asmin eva hetau ghaṭa ādi sādharmyeṇa kṛte ittham ghaṭaḥ eva tāvat anityaḥ iti atra kaḥ hetuḥ iti prasaṅga samaḥ pratidṛṣṭānta samasya yat eva bhāṣye udāharaṇam tat eva draṣṭavyam iti vāyu ākāśa saṃyogasya akāraṇa tvāt ayuktam iti ced atha manyase na vāyu ākāśa saṃyogaḥ kriyā kāraṇam triṣu api kāleṣu asambhavāt na vāyu ākāśa saṃyogena ākāśe kriyā kṛtā na karoti na kariṣyati iti yat ca triṣu api kāleṣu akāraṇam tat akāraṇam yathā ghaṭaḥ ghaṭa antarasya na tad samāna dharma upapatteḥ na brūmaḥ vāyu ākāśa saṃyogaḥ eva ekaḥ kriyā kāraṇam api tu tathābhūtaḥ dharmaḥ anyatra dṛṣṭaḥ yathā vāyu vanaspati saṃyogaḥ iti yaḥ tu asau tathābhūtaḥ kriyām na karoti tatra akāraṇa tvāt api tu pratibandhāt kena asya pratibandhaḥ mahat parimāṇena yathā manda vāta vegena nunnānām loṣṭa ādīnām iti

yadi ca kriyām dṛṣṭvā kriyā karaṇam iti manyase sarvam kāraṇam kriyā anumeyam bhavataḥ prāptam tatas ca upādānam kāraṇasya na prāpnoti kim idam kariṣyati iti āhaḥ na kariṣyati yasya punar sādharmyāt upādānam tasya yuktam yadi ca tad sadṛśam na kāraṇam iti manyase anaikāntikaḥ hetuḥ na prāpnoti na hi yat śabde amūrta tvam tat ākāśa ādau iti anumānam ca anyatra dṛṣṭasya anyatra sādṛśyāt eva pravartate na hi ye dhūma dharmāḥ ekasmin dhūme te eva dhūma antareṣu api iti

idam tāvat ayam praṣṭavyaḥ ke pradīpam upādadate kim artham ca iti didṛkṣamāṇāḥ dṛśya darśana artham iti atha pradīpa upalabdhi artham kasmāt na pradīpa upādānam kurvate antareṇa pradīpaḥ dṛśyate pradīpa antaram iti atha dṛṣṭāntaḥ kim artham upādīyate ajñātasya prajñāpana artham atha dṛṣṭānte api dṛṣṭāntaḥ kim artham deśyate yadi prajñāpana artham na aprajñātaḥ dṛṣṭāntaḥ iti yat punar ākāśa dṛṣṭānta vat iti

abhyupagamāt pratidṛṣṭāntasya ca hetu bhāvam pratipadyamānena dṛṣṭāntasya api hetu bhāvaḥ abhyupagantavyaḥ hetu bhavaḥ ca sādhaka tvam sa ca katham ahetuḥ na syāt yadi apratiṣiddhaḥ sādhakaḥ syāt apratiṣiddhaḥ ca ayam sādhaka prayoga anupapatteḥ ca yadi tāvat evam prayuṅkte yathā ayam tvadīyaḥ dṛṣṭāntaḥ tathā madīyaḥ iti abhyupagamāt na pratidṛṣṭāntaḥ atha evam prayuṅkte yathā madīyaḥ na dṛṣṭāntaḥ tathā tvadīyaḥ iti tathā api vyāghātāt na pratidṛṣṭāntaḥ iti

yathā anityaḥ śabdaḥ utpatti dharmaka tvāt ghaṭa vat iti kṛte yadi brūyāt prāk utpatteḥ utpatti dharmaka tvam na asti tad abhāvāt anutpatti dharmakaḥ anutpatti dharmaka tvāt ca nityaḥ iti anutpattyā pratyavasthānam anutpatti samaḥ

yathā eva prāk utpatteḥ utpatti dharmaka tvam na asti tathā śabdaḥ api iti utpannaḥ san śabdaḥ iti bhavati utpannaḥ san utpatti dharmakaḥ iti bhavati tathā anityaḥ iti utpannasya ca upatti dharmaka tvam asti iti na kāraṇa pratiṣedhaḥ anutpannasya ca atathā bhāvāt na ca ayam anutpannaḥ śabdaḥ iti vai utpatti dharmakaḥ iti vā nityaḥ iti vā anityaḥ iti vā vyapadeṣṭum śakyate iti jñāpakaḥ ca ayam hetuḥ na kārakaḥ jñāpake ca kāraka vat pratyavasthānam asambaddham na kāraka jñāpakayoḥ bhedaḥ asti kāraka tvāt iti ced na kāraka jñāpakayoḥ kriyā ājñapti hetutvāt yaḥ ayam jñāpakaḥ saḥ api kim cit kurvan jñāpakaḥ iti ucyate kārakaḥ api iti na eṣaḥ doṣaḥ kārakasya kriyā hetu tvāt jñapti hetu tvāt ca jñāpakasya iti tatra ekaḥ vastu niṣpādayati ekaḥ tu vidyamāne vastuni jñaptim karoti prāk ca utpatteḥ utpatti dharmaka tvasya abhāvāt anutpatti dharmakaḥ śabdaḥ iti bruvāṇaḥ śabdam abhyupaiti na asataḥ anutupatti dharmaka tvam dharmaḥ iti tatas ca viśeṣaṇam anarthakam prāk utpatteḥ iti

apare tu prāk utpatteḥ kāraṇa abhāvāt iti ukte arthāpatti samāḥ eva iyam iti prāk utpatteḥ prayatna anantarīyaka tvasya abhāvāt arthāt aprayatna ānantarīyakaḥ aprayatna anantarīyaka tvāt ca nityaḥ iti kṛte uttaram bruvate na ayam niyamaḥ prayatna anantarīyakam nityam iti trayī hi tasya gatiḥ kim cit nityam ākāśa ādi kim cit anityam vidyut ādi kim cit asat eva ākāśa kusuma ādi

etat tu na yuktam utpaśyāmaḥ katham iti yat tat asat aprayatnānāntarīyakam iti na yuktam prayatna anantarīyaka tvasya janma viśeṣaṇa tvāt yasya na prayatna anantaram janma tat aprayatna ānantarīyakam na ca abhāvaḥ vidyate atas na tasya janma yat ca asat kim tasya viśeṣyam asti etena nityam pratyuktam na hi nityam aprayatna anantarīyakam iti śakyam vaktum jāti lakṣaṇa abhāvāt na iyam jātiḥ iti ced na anutpannaiḥ ahetubhiḥ sāmānyāt yaḥ anutpannaḥ sa na hetuḥ tat yathā anutpannāḥ tantavaḥ na paṭasya kāraṇam

udāharaṇam bhāṣye saṃśaya samā sādharmya samātaḥ na bhidyate iti ced atha manyase yathā sādharmya samāḥ udāharaṇam sādharmyāt pravartate tathā saṃśaya samāḥ api iti atas abhedāt na jāti antaram iti na ubhaya eka sādharmya bhedāt ubhaya sādharmyāt saṃśaya samāḥ eka sādharmyāt sādharmya samāḥ iti viśeṣaḥ

sādharmyāt sāmānya darśanāt saṃśayaḥ vaidharmyāt viśeṣa darśanāt na saṃśayaḥ ubhayathā tu saṃśaye sāmānya viśeṣa darśane sati saṃśaye atyanta saṃśaya prasaṅgaḥ nityam sāmānyam saṃśayam karoti etat na pratipadyāmahe sati sāmānye viśeṣa darśanāt vyāvṛtteḥ iti

udāharaṇam bhāṣye saṃśaya samāsādharmya samābhyām prakaraṇa samā na bhidyate katham iti tatra api sādharmyam iha api sādharmyam iti na ubhaya pakṣa sādharmyāt tad bheda upapatteḥ ubhau atra vādi prativādinau pakṣa parigraheṇa nitya anitya tve sādhayataḥ na tu evam sādharmya saṃśaya samayoḥ iti
viruddha avyabhicārī eṣaḥ uttarottare iti prakaraṇa utthānam ca na pratipakṣāt iti brūmaḥ kim tu tattvasya adarśanāt tat uktam prakaraṇa same hetvābhāse iti
ahetu sāmānyāt pratyavasthānam ahetu samaḥ iti
virodhaḥ sūtra arthaḥ na utpadyamānam ahetutaḥ utpadyate na api jñāpyamānam ahetunā jñāpyate iti
virodhaḥ uttara doṣaḥ iti triṣu api kāleṣu yaḥ na sādhayati sa na hetuḥ iti pratiṣedhe api samānaḥ doṣaḥ ukta uttara tvāt ca pratyakṣa ādīnām aprāmāṇyam traikālya asiddheḥ iti atra ukta uttaram etat
udāharaṇam bhāṣye

anupapādya sāmarthyam arthāt āpadyate iti bruvāṇaḥ pakṣam hāpayati kim kāraṇam sāmarthyasya anukta tvāt evam ca pakṣa hāneḥ upapattiḥ anaikāntika tvāt ca arthāpatteḥ pūrva sūtra vyāghātaḥ yat uktam na anaikāntika tvam anartha āpattau arthāpatti abhimānāt iti tat vyāhanyate na asti vyāghātaḥ sannidhi viśiṣṭāyāḥ anaikāntika tvena abhyupagamāt yā iyam sūtreṇa upāttā sā anaikāntikī na arthāpatti mātram yathā anumānam vyabhicāri yat tat apramāṇam na itarat iti tathā iha api

udāharaṇam bhāṣye sādharmya samātaḥ na bhidyate aviśeṣa samaḥ kasmāt sādharmya mātrāt pravṛtteḥ aviśeṣāt iti ced na eka samasta bhedāt bhedaḥ eka sādharmyāt sādharmya samā samasta sādharmyāt viśeṣa samāḥ iti

kva cit sādharmyam upalabhyate kva cit naḥ iti sūtra arthaḥ abhyupagamāt ca virodhaḥ sarva bhāvānām anitya tvam prasañjayatā abhyanujñātam śabdasya anitya tvam vyartham vā sarva bhāva grahaṇam iti uktaḥ ca viśeṣaḥ anvaya vyatireka sampannaḥ hetuḥ naḥ uttaraḥ iti

udāharaṇam bhāṣye upapatti samaḥ prakaraṇa samāt na bhidyate iti tatra api nitya anitya kāraṇa upapattiḥ iha api iti na nitya anitya kāraṇasya ekatra upapatteḥ nitya kāraṇam ca anitya kāraṇam ca ekatra upapadyate iti upapatti sama arthaḥ nitya anitya pakṣābhyām tu pratyavasthānam prakaraṇa samaḥ iti bhedaḥ

upapatti kāraṇa abhyanujñānāt apratiṣedhaḥ iti virodhaḥ sūtra arthaḥ nitya tva kāraṇam api asya upapadyate iti bruvatā abhyanujñātam anitya tva kāraṇam iti tathā ca virodhāt uttara pakṣa utthānam na yuktam

udāharaṇam bhāṣye sarva sādhya āropeṇa avyāpaka tvam sādhanasya iti upalabdhi sama arthaḥ sarvam anityam sāmānya viśeṣavataḥ asmad ādi bāhya karaṇa pratyakṣa tvena adhyāropya avyāpaka tvam hetoḥ na hi ayam hetuḥ sarvasmin anitye dvi aṇuka ādau vidyate iti śrūyamāṇa pratijñā artha avyāpaka tvam vā hetoḥ yathā anityaḥ śabdaḥ śabda antara utpādaka tvāt iti na śabda antara utpādaka tvena sarvaḥ śabdaḥ vyāpyate na hi antar śabdaḥ śabda antaram karoti

anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti bruvatā na sādhya antarāṇām kāraṇa antaram pratiṣidhyate na sādhyasya kāraṇa antaram iti apare tu parihāram bruvate yat eva prayatna āntarīyakam tat eva tasmāt anityam iti etat tu na avivādāt yaḥ prayatna ānantarīyaka tvam pratipadyate na tam prati kim cit sādhyate yadā tu prayatna ānantarīyaka tvam vastu viśeṣaṇam tadā anyaḥ hetuḥ vaktavyaḥ jāti lakṣaṇa abhāvāt na iyam jātiḥ na ahetu sāmyāt jātiḥ
udāharaṇam bhāṣye na ukta uttara tvāt dvitīya adhyāye ukta uttaram etat
anupalambha ātmaka tvāt anupalabdheḥ ahetuḥ

āvaraṇa ādi a sambhave sattva abhyupagame ca sati anupalabdheḥ iti prayogaḥ evam ca sati na hetu antaram na anaikāntikam vipakṣa āvṛtti tvāt āvaraṇa ādi a sambhave sattva abhyupagame viparyayasya avyabhicārāt na artha āpatti samaḥ
sarvam anityam prāpnoti iti udāharaṇam bhāṣye aviśeṣa samātaḥ anitya samā na bhidyate tatra api sarva aviśeṣaḥ iha api iti bhidyate tatra sarva aviśeṣaḥ iha sarva anitya tvam iti
sādharmyāt asiddheḥ pratiṣedha asiddhiḥ pratiṣedhya sāmarthyāt

pratiṣedhyena pakṣeṇa pratiṣedhasya pratijña ādi yogaḥ sāmānyam tat yadi pratiṣedhyasya anityasyasya asiddhiḥ ghaṭa ādi sādharmyāt nanu pratiṣedhasya api asiddhiḥ pratiṣedhyena pratijña ādi yoga sāmānyāt iti na ca iyam sādharmya mātrāt sthāpanā api tu dṛṣṭānte viśiṣṭam anvayavyatirekiṇam dharmam upalabhya tad sāmarthāt na ca pratipakṣasya evaṃbhūtaḥ dharmaḥ upapadyate tasmāt pratiṣedhaḥ naḥ upapadyate iti uktam ca atra kva cit tad dharma anupapatteḥ kva cit ca upapatteḥ pratiṣedha abhāvaḥ iti yat ca aviśeṣa same uttaram tat iha api draṣṭavyam nāsādhanāt iti ced atha manyase na mayā sarvasya anitya tva prasaṅgena sarvasya anitya tvam sādhyate api tu evam bruvāṇasya sarvasya anitya tvam prāpnoti iti prasaṅgaḥ kriyate na viśeṣa hetu upapatteḥ na mayā sādhya sādharmya mātreṇa sthāpana ucyate iti atas na sarva anitya tva prasaṅgaḥ sarva anitya tva sādhaka pramāṇa asaṃbhavāt ca na sarva anitya tva prasādhakam pramāṇam saṃbhavati iti atha sarvam anityam sattvāt iti sadhayet tasya api na anvayaḥ na vyatirekaḥ

anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti etasyām pratijñāyām pratijña ādi doṣa udbhāvanat vārikā jātiḥ anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti abhidadhānaḥ eva bhavān śabdasya nitya tvam pratijānīte katham iti yat tat anitya tvam tat kim śabde nityam asti uta kadā cit bhavati iti yadi nityam dharmasya nitya tvāt dharmiṇaḥ api nitya tvam atha anityam anitya tvasya abhāvāt nityaḥ śabdaḥ iti

pratiṣedhye nityam anitya tvam iti bruvatā abhyanujñātam anitya tvam bhavati abhyanujñānāt ca asamarthaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ iti atha na abhyanujñāyate nityam anitya bhāvāt nityaḥ śabdaḥ iti hetuḥ naḥ upapadyate hetu anupapatteḥ anarthakaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ iti paripraśna anupapattiḥ ca pṛthak dharma tvena anitya tvasya anabhyupagamāt api ca anātyantika sattā yogaḥ anitya tvam iti ukte na yuktaḥ praśnaḥ kim ayam atyantam bhavati uta na atyantam iti ātyantikānātyantikā abhāva yogaḥ ca ekasya na yuktaḥ anitya tā nityāḥ iti bruvatā ekasya ātyantika sattā yogaḥ anātyantika sattā yogaḥ ca abhyanujñāyate sa ca ayam virodhāt na yuktaḥ iti pratiṣedhya doṣa udbhāvanāt yuktaḥ iti ced atha manyase na mayā ekasya nitya tvam anitya tvam vā abhyupagamyate api tu anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti bruvāṇasya bhavataḥ saḥ eva doṣaḥ iti na vikalpa anupapatteḥ na ayam pakṣa doṣaḥ na sādhana doṣaḥ pakṣa doṣaḥ tāvat ayam na bhavati pakṣasya tādavasthyāt na sādhanasya pratijña ādi doṣāṇām ca anuddhāvanāt virodhasya ca ukta uttara tvāt iti

anityaḥ śabdaḥ prayatna anantarīyaka tvāt iti ukte jātiḥ kārya samā prayujyate prayatna kāryam anekadhā dṛṣṭam iti kim cit prayatna anantaram vyajyate kim cit prayatna anantaram utpadyate prayatna anantaram upalabdheḥ hetu tva adhyāropeṇa anaikāntika tva deśanāt kārya samaḥ kāryaḥ śabdaḥ prayatna anantaram upalabdheḥ iti hetu artham anaikāntikam codayati prayatna anantaram upalabhamānam kāryam akāryam ca dṛṣṭam iti atha prayatna anantaram janma hetu arthaḥ tathā api asiddha deśanā iti

yat khalu prayatnena vyajyate tatra anupalabdhi kāraṇam upapadyate na tu śabdasya anupalabdhi kāraṇam kim cit asti tasmāt na vyajyate iti saṃśaya samāḥ atas na bhidyate iti ced ubhaya sādharmyāt saṃśaya samaḥ ayam tu na tathā tasmāt bhidyate iti sādharmya samātaḥ na bhidyate iti ced na hetu adhyāropaṇāt sādharmya samā na hetu adhyāropeṇa pravartate iyam tu anyathā abhihite hetau anyathā ākāram pravartate

evam tāvat jātayaḥ vyavasthitāḥ atha idānīm ṣaṣ pakṣīm upanyasiṣyan idam āha pratiṣedhe api samānaḥ doṣaḥ prathama pakṣa vādī jāti vādinam prati uttaram bravīti iti yadi anaikāntika tvāt ahetuḥ pratiṣedhaḥ api anaikāntikaḥ syāt kasya cit apratiṣedhāt kasya cit pratiṣedhāt iti viśeṣa hetu abhāvaḥ vā aviśeṣaḥ śeṣam bhāṣye
sarvāsu jātiṣu eṣā pratyuktiḥ iti sūtra arthaḥ
tṛtīyaḥ pakṣaḥ vipratiṣedhaḥ etasmin vipratiṣedhe samānam anaikāntika tvam doṣaḥ iti caturthaḥ pakṣaḥ

pratiṣedham dvitīya pakṣam sa doṣam abhyupetya tṛtīya pakṣe api pratiṣedhe tulya doṣa tām āsañjayan vipratiṣedhe api samānaḥ doṣaḥ iti bruvan matam anujānāti sā iyam mata anujñā bhavati iti pañcamaḥ pakṣaḥ

sva pakṣa samutthānam doṣam abhyupetya para pakṣe api prayuñjan sva pakṣa doṣam anujānāti iti tulyā mata anujñā śeṣam bhāṣye atra khalu sthāpanā hetu vādinaḥ prathama tṛtīya pañcama pakṣāḥ pratiṣedha hetu vādinaḥ dvitīya caturtha ṣaṣṭha pakṣāḥ teṣām sādhu asādhutāyām mīmāṃsyamānāyām caturtha ṣaṣṭhayoḥ aviśeṣāt na punar ukta doṣa prasaṅgaḥ samānaḥ tṛtīya pañcamayoḥ punarukta doṣaḥ tatra pañcama ṣaṣṭhayoḥ punarukta doṣaḥ tṛtīya caturthayoḥ mata anujñā doṣaḥ prathama dvitīyayoḥ viśeṣa hetu abhāvaḥ iti ṣaṣ pakṣyām ubhayoḥ asiddhiḥ ayukta tva vādi tvāt yadā tu anupalabdhi kāraṇa abhāve sati prayatna anantaram upalabdheḥ iti viśeṣa hetuḥ ucyate tadā na ṣaṣ pakṣī pravartate etāḥ tu jātayaḥ na tattva vivekam upakurvanti iti bheda mātram āsām uktam

vipratipatti apratipattyoḥ vikalpāt nigraha sthāna bahu tvam iti saṅkṣepeṇa uktam tat idānīm vibhajanīyam nigraha sthānāni ca parājaya vastūni aparādha adhikaraṇāni sāmānyatas dve nigraha sthāne kartṛ karma karaṇānām kasya nigrahaḥ tatra eke varṇayanti pakṣasya iti evam ca āhuḥ dūṣaṇāni nyūna tā avayava uttara doṣa ākṣepa bhāva udbhāvanāni ebhiḥ hi asau para pakṣaḥ dūṣyate iti etat tu na samyak karmaṇaḥ tādavasthyāt na hi dūṣaṇa abhidhānena karmaṇaḥ anyathātvam bhavati yathābhūtaḥ eva arthaḥ dūṣyamāṇaḥ tathābhūtaḥ eva adūṣyamāṇaḥ api na karaṇasya viṣaya antare asāmarthyāt sādhanam api pratijña ādikam na dūṣyate viṣaya antare asāmarthyāt na hikim cit sādhanam yat viṣaya antare samartham syāt sarvam sādhanam sva viṣaye samartham iti tasmāt asamarthayoḥ

karma karaṇayoḥ upādānāt kartuḥ nigrahaḥ iti yat karma kriyā artham upādīyamānam abhīṣṭa kriyām na nirvartayati tat idam asamartham yathā sikatā ghaṭa ādi karaṇe iti yat ca karaṇam kriyā artham upādīyamānam kriyām na nirvartayati tat asamartham yathā turya ādi ghaṭe sva viṣaye tu ubhayam samartham tat anya viṣayasya ca karmaṇaḥ anya viṣayasya ca karaṇasya anyathā upādānāt kartuḥ ajñānam ajñānam punar apratipatti vipratipattiḥ vā iti kartā nigṛhyate na karma karaṇe pāratantryāt tasmāt svatantryasya kartuḥ nigrahaḥ iti vipratipatti apratipattyoḥ ca puruṣa dharma tvāt puruṣasya iti vipratipatti apratipattī ca puruṣasya vacana dvāreṇa gamyete tasmāt pratijña ādi doṣāḥ iti bhaktiḥ kāni cit nigraha sthānāni ajñāna ādīni puruṣa dharmāḥ eva

dvaividhya anupapattiḥ aneka abhidhānāt iti ced anekam nigraha sthānam pratijñāhānyādi sūtre paṭhyate tasmāt dve nigraha sthāne iti ayuktam na sāmānya bheda vistarasya vivakṣātaḥ pravṛtteḥ sāmānyam adhikṛtya dve nigraha sthāne bheda vistara vivakṣāyām tu dvāviṃśatidhā bhedaḥ udāharaṇa mātra tvāt ca bhedasya ānantyam iti

prāyeṇa pratijña ādi avayava āśrayāṇi iti bhāṣyam vaktṛ viṣayaka tvāt pratijña ādi ava yava āśrita tvam anupapannam iti ced atha manyasevi pratipattiḥ apratipattiḥ ca nigraha sthānam iti abhidhāne pratijña ādi avayava āśri tve kaḥ prasaṅgaḥ iti na kriyā vacana doṣa dvāreṇa kartṛ vaktṝṇām ajña tva upapatteḥ kriyā dvāreṇa kartā dūṣyate vacana dvāreṇa vaktā iti na pratijña ādi āśraya tvam anupapannam na ca ādhāra ādheya bhāvaḥ āśraya āśrayi bhāvaḥ vivakṣitaḥ kim tu pratijña ādi mukhena udbhāvanam iti

tattva vādinam atattva vādinam ca abhisaṃplavante iti bhāṣyam tattva vādinaḥ nigraha sthāna anupapattiḥ pratipādaka tvāt tattvam bravīti iti pratipādayati iti pratipādayan ca nigṛhyate iti na yuktam na para apad iṣṭa dūṣaṇa doṣān avabodha dvāreṇa tad upapatteḥ tattva vādī prathama pakṣe dvitīya pakṣa vādinā ca yaḥ dūṣaṇa ābhāsaḥ uktaḥ tasya tattva anavabodhāt nigṛhyate tattvam abhidadhānaḥ api iti tatra vastu nirṇītam nirṇīte api ca vastuni dūṣaṇa ābhāsasya apratipattyā nigṛhyate iti tatra udāharaṇa bheda pradarśana artham pratijñāhānyādi sūtram

lakṣaṇam ca pratidṛṣṭānta dharma abhyanujñā sva dṛṣṭānte pratijñāhāniḥ pratidṛṣṭāntasya yaḥ dharmaḥ tam yadā sva pakṣe dṛṣṭānte abhyanujānāti tadā nigṛhītaḥ veditavyaḥ yathā anityaḥ śabdaḥ aindriyaka tvāt ghaṭa vat iti kṛte sāmānyam aindriyakam dṛṣṭam nityam kasmāt na tathā śabdaḥ iti dvitīyaḥ yadi sāmānyam aindriyakam nityam iti ghaṭaḥ api evam astu iti tritīyaḥ anena kila hetu doṣeṇa pratidṛṣṭānta dharma sva dṛṣṭānte abhyanujāntaḥ bhavati abhyanujñānāt ca dṛṣṭāntam jahati dṛṣṭāntam ca jahat nigamana antam eva pakṣam jahāti iti pratijñāhāniḥ iti ucyate

etat tu na buddhyāmahe katham atra pratijñā hīyate iti hetoḥ anaikāntika tvam sāmānya dṛṣṭāntena pareṇa codyate etasya anaikāntika doṣa uddhāram anuktvā sva dṛṣṭānte nityatām pratipadyate nitya tā pratipatteḥ ca asiddha tā dṛṣṭānta doṣaḥ bhavati saḥ ayam dṛṣṭānta doṣeṇa hetu doṣeṇa vā nigrahaḥ na pratijñāhāniḥ dṛṣṭāntam ca jahat pratijñām api jahāti iti upacāreṇa nigraha sthānam na ca pradhāna asambhave upacāraḥ labhyate iti pratijñā hāneḥ mukhyaḥ viṣayaḥ vaktavyaḥ

katham tarhi idam sūtram pratidṛṣṭānta dharma abhyanujñā sva dṛṣṭānte pratijñāhāniḥ iti dṛṣṭaḥ ca asau ante vyavasthitaḥ iti dṛṣṭāntaḥ svar ca asau dṛṣṭāntaḥ ca iti sva dṛṣṭāntaḥ sva dṛṣṭānta śabdena pakṣaḥ eva abhidhīyate pratidṛṣṭānta śabdena ca pratipakṣaḥ pratipakṣaḥ ca asau dṛṣṭāntaḥ ca iti etat uktam bhavati pratipakṣasya yaḥ dharmaḥ tam sva pakṣaḥ abhyanujānāti iti yathā anityaḥ śabdaḥ aindriyaka tvāt iti dvitīya pakṣa vādini sāmānyena pratyavasthite idam āha yadi sāmānyam aindriyakam nityam dṛṣṭam iti śabdaḥ api evam

bhavatu iti eṣā pratijñāhāniḥ prāk anena pratijñātam anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti sāmānyena anaikāntika tvena pratyavasthitaḥ idam āha nityaḥ iti prāk pramāṇa avadhārita artha parityāgāt vipratipattitaḥ nigraha sthānam iti prasaṅga vidhānāt iti ced atha manyase na asau paścāt api śabdasya nityatām pratipadyate kim tu prasaṅgam karoti yadi sāmānyam aindriyakam nityam dṛṣṭam śabdaḥ api evam bhavatu iti prasaṅgam vidhatte tat ca na atas eva tad prāpteḥ yatas eva asau hetu doṣa uddhāre kartavye prasañjayati atas eva nigṛhyate iti

hetu doṣeṇa caritārtha tvāt na pratijñāhāniḥ nigraha sthānam iti anye anye tu varṇayanti naḥ eva idam nigraha sthānam yuktam hetu doṣeṇa caritārtha tvāt yasmāt aindriyaka tvāt iti asya hetoḥ anaikāntika tvam doṣaḥ tena ayam nigṛhītaḥ iti na anā ekāntika doṣa parīhāra dvāreṇa vipratipattitaḥ tad upapatteḥ tasya eva anaikāntikasya parihāram kurvāṇaḥ ayam nigṛhyate iti atas anaikāntika tvam na nigraha sthānam

udāharaṇam pūrvavat sarva gatā sarva gata vikalpena pratijñāntaram karoti asarva gataḥ anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti tatra anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti pūrvā pratijñā sāmānyena aindriyakeṇa pratihatā asarva gataḥ anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti pratijñāntaram tat katham nigraha sthānam sādhana sāmarthya aparijñānāt aparijñāya sādhana sāmarthyam anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti pratijñā na ca pratijñā pratijñāntaram sādhayati sādhana sāmarthya aparijñānāt tat etat pratijñāntaram tat idam apratipattitaḥ vipratipattitaḥ vā nigraha sthānam iti

yatra pratijñā hetunā virudhyate hetuḥ ca pratijñayā sa pratijñāvirodhaḥ nāma nigraha sthānam yathā guṇa vyatiriktam dravyam bhedena agrahaṇāt iti etena eva pratijñā virodhaḥ api uktaḥ yatra pratijñā sva vacanena virudhyate yathā śramaṇā garbhiṇī hetu virodhaḥ api yatra pratijñā hetunā virudhyate yathā sarvam pṛthak samūhe bhāva śabda prayogāt iti etena pratijñayā dṛṣṭānta virodhaḥ api vaktavyaḥ hetoḥ ca dṛṣṭānta ādibhiḥ virodhaḥ pramāṇa avirodhaḥ ca pratijñā hetvoḥ vaktavyaḥ para pakṣa siddhena go tva ādinā

anaikāntika deśanāt viruddhaḥ yaḥ para pakṣa siddhena go tva ādinā vyabhicārayati tat viruddham uttaram veditavyam sva pakṣa anapekṣam ca yathā yam sva pakṣa anapekṣam hetum prayuṅkte anityaḥ śabdaḥ aindriyaka tvāt iti sa sva siddhasya go tva ādeḥ nitya tva virodhāt viruddhaḥ ubhaya pakṣa sampratipannaḥ tu anaikāntikaḥ yat ubhaya pakṣa sampratipannam vastu tathātvena tena anaikāntika deśenā iti dṛṣṭānta ābhāsāḥ tu kasmāt nigraha sthāneṣu naḥ uktāḥ hetvābhāsa pūrvaka tvāt dṛṣṭānta ābhāsānām tat abhidhānena eva uktāḥ veditavyāḥ iti

yaḥ pratijñātam artham pratiṣedhe kṛte parityajati sa pratijñāsaṃnyāsaḥ veditavyaḥ udāharaṇam pūrvavat sāmānyena anaikāntika tve hetau kṛte brūyāt kaḥ ca evam āha anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti etat sādhanasya sāmarthya aparijñānāt vipratipattitaḥ nigraha sthānam iti
udāharaṇam bhāṣye sādhana antara upādāne pūrvasya asāmarthya khyāpanāt nigraha sthānam sāmarthye vā pūrvasya hetu antaram vyartham iti
udāharaṇam bhāṣye abhyupagata artha asaṅgata tvāt nigraha sthānam yat abhyupagatam tad sambaddham anyat asambaddham ucyate iti
udāharaṇam bhāṣye sādhana anupādānāt ajñānam evam bruvan na sādhanam sādhyam jānīte iti na sādhyam na sādhanam ca upādatte iti nigṛhyate
udāharaṇam bhāṣye asāmarthya khyāpanāt nigraha sthānam asāmarthyam ca ajñānam iti

yathā daśa dāḍima ādi vākyam nirarthaka apārthakayoḥ abhedaḥ iti ced atha manyase nirarthakāt apārthakam na bhidyate tatra api arthaḥ na gamyate iha api iti bhidyate iti brūmaḥ katham tatra hi varṇa mātram iha tu padāni asambaddhāni tat katham nigraha sthānam vākyāt ṛte na viśeṣa avagatiḥ iti sādhana sāmarthya aparijñānāt nigraha sthānam

avayavānām viparyayeṇa abhidhānam nigraha sthānam na evam api siddheḥ iti eke eke tu bruvate naḥ etat nigraha sthānam evam api siddheḥ iti samaya anabhyupagamāt ca na ca vayam evam samayam pratīcchāmaḥ iti prayogāt ca prayuktaḥ ca avayava vyatyayaḥ sarva śāstreṣu iti kasya ayam samayaḥ iti yat tāvat na evam api siddheḥ iti prayoga apeta śabda vat etat syāt yathā gauḥ iti asya padasya arthe gāvi iti prayujyamānam padam kakudādimantam artham pratipādayati iti na ca śabdānvākhyānam vyartham anena śabdena go śabdam eva asau pratipadyate go śabdāt kakudādimantam

artham tathā pratijña ādi ava yava viparyāsena ānupūrvī pratipadyate ānupūrvyā ca artham iti etat katham iti pūrvam tāvat karma upādīyate tatas karaṇam mṛd piṇḍa ādi udāharaṇam anekadhā loke iti yat punar etat samaya anabhyupagamāt iti na ayam samayaḥ api tu arthasya ānupūrvī saḥ ayam arthasya ānupūrvīm anvācakṣāṇaḥ anābhyākhyeyaḥ iti yat punar etat prayogāt iti na nigraha sthāna viṣaya aparijñānāt śāstre vākyāni artha saṃgraha artham upādīyante saṃgṛhītam tu artham vākyena pratipādayitā prayoga kāle pratijña ādikayā ānupūrvyā pratipādayati iti

yasmin vākye pratijña ādīnām anyatamaḥ avayavaḥ na bhavati tat vākyam nyūnam veditavyam tat katham nigraha sthānam na sādhana abhāve sādhya siddhiḥ iti eke tu pratijñānyūnam vākyam na asti iti ācakṣate etat tu na yuktam pratijñām antareṇa prayogaḥ vikalpataḥ paryanuyojyaḥ yaḥ pratijñānyūnam vākyam brūte kim ayam nigṛhyate atha naḥ iti yadi nigṛhyate katamat nigraha sthānam iti na hi hetvābhāsa ādayaḥ atra santi iti na ca hetu ādi doṣāḥ santi iti nigraham ca abhyupaiti tasmāt pratijñānyūnam eva iti atha na nigrahaḥ nyūnam vākyam artham sādhayati iti sādhana abhāve siddhiḥ abhyupagatā bhavati yat tu bravīṣi siddhānta parigrahaḥ eva pratijñā etat api na budhyāmahe karmaṇaḥ upādānam pratijñā sāmānya viśeṣavataḥ avadhāritasya vastunaḥ parigrahaḥ siddhāntaḥ iti

yasmin vākye hetū dvau dṛṣṭāntau dvau tat vākyam adhikam nigraha sthānam ādhikyāt tat ca na dārḍhyāt iti eke eke tu bruvate naḥ idam nigraha sthānam dārḍhyāt dārḍhyam hi jñāpyasya bhūyobhiḥ jñāpakaiḥ dṛṣṭam yathā dhūma ālokābhyām agneḥ iti na dārḍhya artha an abhidhānāt bhūyobhiḥ jñāpakaiḥ dārḍhyam bhavati iti na dārḍhya arthaḥ abhidhīyate kim bravīṣi dārḍhyāt iti sutarām pratipattiḥ dārḍhyam iti tat api tādṛś eva kim uktam bhavati sutarām iti atha bravīṣi dve api jñāpake satyam dve api jñāpake ekena eva abhidhānāt vyartham abhidhānam dvitīyasya prakāśite pradīpa antara upādāna vat iti anavasthā vā prakāśite api sādhana antara upādānāt iti

śabda punaruktam anityaḥ śabdaḥ anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti artha punaruktam anityaḥ śabdaḥ nirodha dharmakaḥ dhvānaḥ iti anuvāde tu apunaruktam artha viśeṣa upapatteḥ na ābādhanāt iti eke eke tu bruvate naḥ idam nigraha sthānam abādhanāt na hi parīkṣā vidheḥ punar bruvatā kim cit bādhyate para pratipādana artham ca vākya prayogaḥ punar abhidhānena sutarām artham pratipadyate iti na nigraha sthānam pratipādaka tvāt satyam pratipādayati pratipādita artha pratipādaka tvāt vaiyarthyam syāt vaiyarthyāt nigraha sthānam sādhana viṣaya aparijñānāt na ca ayam śiṣyaḥ na guruḥ tasmāt na ayam punar pratipādyate iti
arthāt āpannasya sva śabdena punarvacanam punar uktam pūrvavat nigraha sthānam

śeṣam bhāṣye na uttarena avasthānāt na idam nigraha sthānam iti ke cit uttareṇa avasthānāt uttareṇa guṇa doṣavatā mūḍha tva āmūḍha tvam gamyate iti kim punar uccaritena asti asti hi uttare kaḥ cit samarthaḥ dṛśyate na pratyuccāraṇe na asau tāvatā nigraha sthānam arhati yaḥ ca ārabhya sva pakṣam na nirvāhayet tasya syāt khalīkāra mātram iti na uttara viṣaya aparijñānāt yadi ayam na pratyuccārayati nirviṣayam uttaram prasajyate atha uttaram bravīti katham naḥ uccārayati tat idam vyāhatam ucyate naḥ uccārayati uttaram ca bravīti iti apratijñānāt ca na idam pratijñāyate pūrvam uccārayitavyam paścāt uttaram abhidheyam api tu yathā katham cit uttaram vaktavyam uttaram ca āśraya abhāve na yuktam iti yuktam apratyuccāraṇam nigraha sthānam iti
sphuṭam bhāṣye apratipattitaḥ nigraha sthānam
śloka pāṭhā ādibhiḥ avajñām darśayan naḥ uttaram pratipadyate iti tat apratibhā nāma nigraha sthānam mūḍha tvāt iti

yatra kartavyam kāryam vyāsajya kathām vicchinatti sa vikṣepaḥ vijñeyaḥ yathā rasālayā mayā bhuktam pratiśyāya kaṇaḥ me kaṇṭham kṣiṇoti iti evam ādi tat katham nigraha sthānam ajñāna nigūhana artham tu prayukta jñānam eva parihāreṇa āviṣkaroti

yaḥ pareṇa coditam doṣam anuddhṛtya bhavataḥ api ayam samānaḥ doṣaḥ iti bravīti sā mata anujñā para matam sva mate anujānāti udāharaṇam bhavān cauraḥ puruṣa tvāt iti sa tam prati brūyāt bhavān api iti saḥ abhyupagamya doṣam para pakṣe abhyanujānāti iti nigṛhītaḥ veditavyaḥ anabhyupagacchatā na puruṣa tvam caurya hetuḥ iti vaktavyam kim tu para svena anati sṛṣṭena sambandhaḥ etat uttarā parijñānāt nigṛhyate iti

prasaṅga vidhānāt na nigraha sthānam iti anye apare tu bruvate naḥ etat nigraha sthānam prasaṅga vidhānāt na eva asau paścāt api tam doṣam pratipadyate api tu prasaṅgam karoti yadi puruṣa tvāt cauraḥ bhavati bhavān api puruṣaḥ tasmāt cauraḥ iti etat tu na atas eva yatas eva ayam uttare vaktavye prasaṅgam karoti atas eva uttara aparijñānāt nigṛhyate iti

yaḥ nigraha sthāna prāptam na nigṛhṇāti sa nigṛhītaḥ veditavyaḥ nigraha sthāna prāptasya aparijñānāt na anya vacanāt iti anye anye bruvate naḥ idam nigraha sthānam anya uttarasya abhidhānāt yasmāt asau nigraha sthāna prāptam na nigṛhṇāti bruvan anyat uttaram abhidhatte iti tat ca na atas eva yatas eva asau nigraha sthāne vaktvaye anyat abhidhatte atas eva nigṛhyate jānānaḥ hi asau kim artham anyat bravīti
anigraha sthāne eva abhidhatte nigṛhītaḥ asti iti etat nigraha sthāna aparijñānāt nigraha sthānam iti
asya udāharaṇam sphuṭam bhāṣye pratijñāta artha vyatirekeṇa abhyupagata artha parityāgāt nigṛhyate iti

yathā eva vibhaktāḥ lakṣaṇena tathā eva teṣām nigraha sthāna bhāvaḥ iti te ime pramāṇa ādayaḥ uddiṣṭāḥ prathama sūtre lakṣitāḥ prathame adhyāye parīkṣitāḥ śeṣeṣu iti trividhā tantrasya parisamāptiḥ uktāḥ veditavyāḥ iti
jātīnām sa prapañcānām nigraha sthāna lakṣaṇam śāstrasya ca upasaṃhāraḥ pañcame parikīrtitaḥ yat akṣapāda pratimaḥ bhāṣyam vātsyāyanaḥ jagau akāri mahataḥ tasya bhāradvājena vārttikam

māhāyāne traidhātukam vijñaptimātram vyavasthāpyate cittamātram bho jinaputrāḥ yat uta traidhātukam iti sūtrāt cittam manaḥ vijñānam vijñaptiḥ ca iti paryāyāḥ cittam atra sa saṃprayogam abhipretam mātram iti artha pratiṣedha artham vijñapti mātram eva idam asat artha avabhāsanāt yadvat taimirikasya asat keśa uṇḍūka ādi darśanam na arthaḥ kaścid asti

atra codyate : na deśa kāla niyamaḥ saṃtāna aniyamaḥ na ca na ca kṛtya kriyā yuktā vijñaptiḥ yadi na arthataḥ kim uktam bhavati yadi vinā rūpa ādi arthena rūpa ādi vijñaptiḥ utpadyate na rūpa ādi arthāt kasmāt kvacid deśaḥ utpadyate na sarvatra tatra eva ca deśe kadācid utpadyate na sarvadā tad deśa kāla pratiṣṭhitānām sarveṣām saṃtāna aniyamaḥ utpadyate na kevalam ekasya yathā taimirikāṇām saṃtāne keśa ādi ābhāsaḥ na anyeṣām

kasmāt yat taimirikaiḥ keśa bhramara ādi dṛśyate tena keśa ādi kriyā na kriyate na ca tad anyaiḥ na kriyate yat anna pāna vastra viṣa āyudha ādi svapne dṛśyate tena anna ādi kriyā na kriyate na ca tad anyaiḥ na kriyate gandharvanagareṇa asattvāt nagara kriyā na kriyate na ca tad anyaiḥ na kriyate vinā arthena eṣu asat samāneṣu deśa kāla niyamaḥ saṃtāna aniyamaḥ kṛtya kriyā ca na yujyate

na khalu na yujyate yasmāt : deśa ādi niyamaḥ siddhaḥ svapna vat svapnaḥ iva svapna vat katham tāvat svapne vinā api arthena kvacid eva deśe kiṃcid grāma ārāma strī purūṣa ādikam dṛśyate na sarvatra tatra eva ca deśe kadācid dṛśyate na sarvakālam iti siddhaḥ vinā api arthena deśa kāla niyamaḥ

preta vat punar saṃtāna aniyamaḥ siddhaḥ iti vartate pretānām iva preta vat katham siddhaḥ samam sarvaiḥ pūyanadī ādi darśane pūya pūrṇā nadī pūyanadī ghṛta ghaṭa vat tulya karma vipāka avasthāḥ hi pretāḥ sarve api pūya pūrṇām nadīm paśyanti na ekaḥ eva yathā pūya pūrṇām evam mūtra purīṣa ādi pūrṇām daṇḍa asi dharaiḥ ca puruṣaiḥ adhiṣṭhitām iti ādi grahaṇena evam saṃtāna aniyamaḥ vijñaptīnām asati api arthe siddhaḥ

svapna upaghāta vat kṛtya kriyā siddhā iti veditavyam yathā svapne dvaya samāpattim antareṇa śukra visarga lakṣaṇaḥ svapna upaghātaḥ evam tāvat anya anyaiḥ dṛṣṭāntaiḥ deśa kāla niyama ādi catuṣṭayam siddham naraka vat punar sarvam siddham iti veditavyam narakeṣu iva naraka vat katham siddham naraka pāla ādi darśane taiḥ ca bādhane

yathā hi narakeṣu nārakāṇām naraka pāla ādi darśanam deśa kāla niyamena siddham śva vāya sa āyasa parvata ādi āgamana gamana darśanam ca iti ādi grahaṇena sarveṣām ca na ekasya eva taiḥ ca tad bādhanam siddham asatsu api naraka pāla ādiṣu samāna sva karma vipāka ādhipatyāt tathā anyatra api sarvam etat deśa kāla niyama ādi catuṣṭayam siddham iti veditavyam kim punar kāraṇam naraka pālāḥ te ca śvānaḥ vāyasāḥ ca sattvāḥ na iṣyante

ayogāt na hi te nārakāḥ yujyante tathā eva tad duḥkha apratisaṃvedanāt parasparam yātayatām ime nārakāḥ ime naraka pālāḥ iti vyavasthā na syāt tulya ākṛti pramāṇa balānām ca parasparam yātayatām na tathā bhayam syāt dāha duḥkham ca pradīptāyām ayaḥ mayyām bhūmau asahamānāḥ katham tatra parān yātayeyuḥ anārakāṇām vā narake kutas saṃbhavaḥ

katham tāvat tiraścām svarge saṃbhavaḥ evam narakeṣu tiryak preta viśeṣāṇām naraka pāla ādīnām saṃbhavaḥ syāt tiraścām saṃbhavaḥ svarge yathā na narake tathā na pretānām yatas tad jam duḥkham na anubhavanti te ye hi tiryañcaḥ svarge saṃbhavanti te tad bhājana loka sukha saṃvartanīyena karmaṇā tatra saṃbhūtāḥ tad jam sukham pratyanubhavanti na ca evam naraka pāla ādayaḥ nārakam duḥkham pratyanubhavanti tasmāt na tiraścām saṃbhavaḥ yuktaḥ na api pretānām

teṣām tarhi nārakāṇām karmabhiḥ tatra bhūta viśeṣāḥ saṃbhavanti varṇa ākṛti pramāṇa bala viśiṣṭāḥ ye naraka pāla ādi saṃjñām pratilabhante tathā ca pariṇamanti yat vividhām hasta vikṣepa ādi kriyām kurvantaḥ dṛśyante bhaya utpādana artham yathā meṣa ākṛtayaḥ parvatāḥ āgacchantaḥ gacchantaḥ ayaḥ śālmalī vane ca kaṇṭakāḥ adhomukhībhavantaḥ ūrdhva mukhībhavantaḥ ca iti na te na saṃbhavanti eva yadi tad karmabhiḥ tatra bhūtānām saṃbhavaḥ tathā iṣyate pariṇāmaḥ ca kim vijñānasya na iṣyate vijñānasya eva tad karmabhiḥ tathā pariṇāmaḥ kasmāt na iṣyate kim punar bhūtāni kalpyante api ca :

karmaṇaḥ vāsanā anyatra phalam anyatra kalpyate tatra eva na iṣyate yatra vāsanā kim nu kāraṇam yena hi karmaṇā nārakāṇām tatra tādṛśaḥ bhūtānām saṃbhavaḥ kalpyate pariṇāmaḥ ca tasya karmaṇaḥ vāsanā teṣām vijñāna saṃtāna saṃniviṣṭā na anyatra yatra eva ca vāsanā tatra eva tasyāḥ phalam tādṛśaḥ vijñāna pariṇāmaḥ kim na iṣyate yatra vāsanā na asti tatra tasyāḥ phalam kalpyate iti kim atra kāraṇam āgamaḥ kāraṇam yadi vijñānam eva rūpa ādi pratibhāsam syāt na rūpa ādikaḥ arthaḥ tadā rūpa ādi āyatana astitvam bhagavatā na uktam syāt

akāraṇam etat yasmāt : rūpa ādi āyatana astitvam tat vineya janam prati abhiprāya vaśāt uktam upapāduka sattva vat yathā asti sattvaḥ upapādukaḥ iti uktam bhagavatā abhiprāya vaśāt citta saṃtati anucchedam āyatyām abhipretya na asti iha sattvaḥ ātmā vā dharmāḥ tu ete sa hetukāḥ iti vacanāt evam rūpa ādi āyatana astitvam api uktam bhagavatā tad deśanā vineya janam adhikṛtya iti ābhiprāyikam tat vacanam

kaḥ atra abhiprāyaḥ yatas sva bījāt vijñaptiḥ yadābhāsā pravartate dvividha āyatana tvena te tasyāḥ muniḥ abravīt kim uktam bhavati rūpa pratibhāsā vijñaptiḥ yatas sva bījāt pariṇāma viśeṣa prāptāt utpadyate tat ca bījam yad pratibhāsā ca sā te tasyāḥ vijñapteḥ cakṣu ūru upāyatana tvena yathākramam bhagavān abravīt evam yāvat spraṣṭavya pratibhāsā vijñaptiḥ yatas sva bījāt pariṇāma viśeṣa prāptāt utpadyate tat ca bījam yad pratibhāsā ca sā te tasyāḥ kāya spraṣṭa vya āyatana tvena yathākramam bhagavān abravīt iti ayam abhiprāyaḥ

evam punar abhiprāya vaśena deśayitvā kaḥ guṇāḥ tathā pudgala nairātmya praveśaḥ hi tathā hi deśyamāne pudgala nairātmyam praviśanti dvaya ṣaṭkābhyām vijñāna ṣaṭkam pravartate na tu kaścid ekaḥ draṣṭā asti na yāvat mantā iti evam viditvā ye pudgala nairātmya deśanāvineyāḥ te pudgala nairātmyam praviśanti

anyathā punar deśanā dharma nairātmya praveśaḥ anyathā iti vijñaptimātra deśanā katham dharma nairātmya praveśaḥ vijñapti mātram idam rūpa ādi dharma pratibhāsam utpadyate na tu rūpa ādi lakṣaṇaḥ dharmaḥ kaścid asti iti viditvā yadi tarhi sarvathā dharmaḥ na asti tat api vijñaptimātram na asti iti katham tarhi vyavasthāpyate na khalu sarvathā dharmaḥ na asti iti evam dharma nairātmya praveśaḥ bhavati api tu : kalpita ātmanā

yaḥ bālaiḥ dharmāṇām svabhāvaḥ grāhya grāhaka ādiḥ parikalpitaḥ tena kalpitena ātmanā teṣām nairātmyam na tu anabhilāpyena ātmanā yaḥ buddhānām viṣayaḥ iti evam vijñaptimātrasya api vijñapti antara parikalpitena ātmanā nairātmya praveśāt vijñaptimātra vyavasthāpanayā sarva dharmāṇām nairātmya praveśaḥ bhavati na tu sarvathā tad astitva apavādāt itarathāḥ hi vijñapteḥ api vijñapti antaram arthaḥ syāt iti vijñaptimātra tvam na sidhyeta arthavatī tvāt vijñaptīnām

katham punar idam pratyetavyam : anena abhiprāyeṇa bhagavatā rūpa ādi āyatana astitvam uktam na punar santi eva tāni yāni rūpa ādi vijñaptīnām pratyekam viṣayībhavanti iti yasmāt : na tat ekam na ca anekam viṣayaḥ paramāṇuśaḥ na ca te saṃhatāḥ yasmāt paramāṇuḥ na sidhyati iti kim uktam bhavati yat tad rūpa ādikam āyatanam rūpa ādi vijñaptīnām pratyekam viṣayaḥ syāt tat ekam vā syāt yathā avayavi rūpam kalpyate vaiśeṣikaiḥ anekam vā paramāṇuśaḥ saṃhatāḥ vā te eva paramāṇavaḥ na tāvat ekam viṣayaḥ bhavati avayavebhyaḥ anyasya avayavi rūpasya kvacid api agrahaṇāt na api anekam paramāṇūnām pratyekam agrahaṇāt na api te saṃhatāḥ viṣayībhavanti yasmāt paramāṇuḥ ekam dravyam na sidhyati

katham na sidhyati yasmāt : ṣaṭkena yugapad yogāt paramāṇoḥ ṣaṣ aṃśa tā ṣaḍbhyaḥ digbhyaḥ ṣaḍbhiḥ paramāṇubhiḥ yugapad yoge sati paramāṇoḥ ṣaṣ aṃśa tā prāpnoti ekasya yaḥ deśaḥ tatra anyasya asaṃbhavāt ṣaṇṇām samāna deśa tvāt piṇḍaḥ syāt aṇu mātrakaḥ atha yaḥ eva ekasya paramāṇoḥ deśaḥ saḥ eva ṣaṇṇām tena sarveṣām samāna deśa tvāt sarvaḥ piṇḍaḥ paramāṇu mātraḥ syāt paraspara avyatirekāt iti na kaścid piṇḍaḥ dṛśyaḥ syāt na eva hi paramāṇavaḥ saṃyujyante niravayava tvāt mā bhūt eṣa doṣa prasaṅgaḥ saṃghātāḥ tu parasparam saṃyujyante iti kāśmīra vaibhāṣikāḥ te idam praṣṭavyāḥ : yaḥ paramāṇūnām saṃghātaḥ na sa tebhyaḥ artha antaram iti

paramāṇoḥ asaṃyogāt tad saṃghāte asti kasya saḥ saṃyogaḥ iti vartate na ca anavayava tvena tad saṃyogaḥ na sidhyati atha saṃghātāḥ api anyonyam na saṃyujyante na tarhi paramāṇūnām niravayava tvāt saṃyogaḥ na sidhyati iti vaktavyam sāvayavasya api saṃghātasya saṃyoga anabhyupagamāt atas paramāṇuḥ ekam dravyam na sidhyati yadi ca paramāṇoḥ saṃyogaḥ iṣyate yadi vā na iṣyate :

diś bhāga bhedaḥ yasya asti tasya ekatvam na yujyate anyaḥ hi paramāṇoḥ pūrva diś bhāgaḥ yāvat adhas diś bhāgaḥ iti diś bhāga bhede sati katham tad ātmakasya paramāṇoḥ eka tvam yokṣyate chāyā āvṛtī katham vā yadi ekaikasya paramāṇoḥ diś bhāga bhedaḥ na syāt āditya udaye katham anyatra pārśve chāyā bhavati anyatra ātapaḥ na hi tasya anyaḥ pradeśaḥ asti yatra ātapaḥ na syāt āvaraṇam ca katham bhavati paramāṇoḥ paramāṇu antareṇa yadi diś bhāga bhedaḥ na iṣyate na hi kaścid anyaḥ para bhāgaḥ asti yatra āgamanāt anyena anyasya pratighātaḥ syāt asati ca pratighāte sarveṣām samāna deśa tvāt sarvaḥ saṃghātaḥ paramāṇu mātraḥ syāt iti uktam

kim evam na iṣyate : piṇḍasya te chāyā vṛtī na paramāṇoḥ iti kim khalu paramāṇubhyaḥ anyaḥ piṇḍe iṣyate yasya te syātām na iti āha : anyaḥ na piṇḍaḥ ced na tasya te yadi na anyaḥ paramāṇubhyaḥ piṇḍaḥ iṣyate na te tasya iti siddham bhavati saṃniveśa parikalpaḥ eṣaḥ paramāṇuḥ saṃghātaḥ iti vā kim anayā cintayā lakṣaṇam tu rūpa ādīnām na pratiṣidhyate kim punar teṣām lakṣaṇam cakṣuḥ ādi viṣaya tvam nīla ādi tvam ca tat eva idam saṃpradhāryate : yat tat cakṣuḥ ādīnām viṣayaḥ nīla pīta ādikam iṣyate kim tat ekam dravyam atha vā tat anekam iti

kim ca atas aneka tve doṣaḥ uktaḥ eka tve na krameṇa itiḥ yugapad na graha āgrahau vicchinna aneka vṛttiḥ ca sūkṣma anīkṣā ca naḥ bhavet yadi yāvat vicchinnam nīla ādikam cakṣuṣaḥ viṣayaḥ tat ekam dravyam kalpyate pṛthivyām krameṇa itiḥ na syāt gamanam iti arthaḥ sakṛt pāda kṣepeṇa sarvasya gata tvāt arvāc bhāgasya ca grahaṇam para bhāgasya ca agrahaṇam yugapad na syāt na hi tasya eva tadānīm grahaṇam ca agrahaṇam ca yuktam

vicchinnasya ca anekasya hasti aśva ādikasya ekatra vṛttiḥ na syāt yatra eva hi ekam tatra eva aparam iti katham tayoḥ vicchedaḥ iṣyate katham vā tat ekam yat prāptam ca tābhyām na ca prāptam antarāle tat śūnya grahaṇāt sūkṣmāṇām ca udaka jantūnām sthūlaiḥ samāna rūpāṇām anīkṣaṇam na syāt yadi lakṣaṇa bhedāt eva dravya antara tvam kalpyate na anyathā tasmāt avaśyam paramāṇuśaḥ bhedaḥ kalpayitavyaḥ sa ca ekaḥ na sidhyati tasya asiddhau rūpa ādīnām cakṣuḥ ādi viṣaya tvam asiddham iti siddham vijñaptimātram bhavati iti

pramāṇa vaśāt astitvam nāstitvam vā nirdhāryate sarveṣām ca pramāṇānām pratyakṣam pramāṇam gariṣṭham iti asati arthe katham iyam buddhiḥ bhavati pratyakṣam iti pratyakṣa buddhiḥ svapna ādau yathā vinā api arthena iti pūrvam eva jñāpitam sā ca yadā tadā na saḥ arthaḥ dṛśyate tasya pratyakṣa tvam katham matam yadā ca sā pratyakṣa buddhiḥ bhavati idam me pratyakṣam iti tadā na saḥ arthaḥ dṛśyate manaḥ vijñānena eva pariccheda āt cakṣuḥ vijñānasya ca tadā niruddha tvāt iti katham tasya pratyakṣa tvam iṣṭam viśeṣeṇa tu kṣaṇika vādinaḥ yasya tadānīm niruddham eva tat rūpam rasa ādikam vā

na ananubhūtam manaḥ vijñānena smaryate iti avaśyam artha anubhavena bhavitavyam tat ca darśanam iti evam tad viṣayasya rūpa ādeḥ pratyakṣa tvam matam asiddham idam anubhūtasya arthasya smaraṇam bhavati iti yasmāt : uktam yathā tad ābhāsā vijñaptiḥ vinā api arthena yathā artha ābhāsā cakṣuḥ vijñāna ādikā vijñaptiḥ utpadyate tathā uktam

smaraṇam tatas tatas hi vijñapteḥ smṛti saṃprayuktā tad pratibhāsā eva rūpa ādi vikalpikā manaḥ vijñaptiḥ utpadyate iti na smṛti utpādāt artha anubhavaḥ sidhyati yadi yathā svapne vijñaptiḥ abhūta artha viṣayā tathā jāgrataḥ api syāt tathā eva tad abhāvam lokaḥ svayam avagacchet na ca evam bhavati tasmāt na svapnaḥ iva artha upalabdhiḥ sarvā nirarthikā

idam ajñāpakam yasmāt svapna dṛś viṣaya abhāvam na aprabuddhaḥ avagacchati evam vitatha vikalpa abhyāsa vāsanā nidrayā prasuptaḥ lokaḥ svapne iva abhūtam artham paśyan aprabuddhaḥ tad abhāvam yathāvat na avagacchati yadā tu tad pratipakṣa loka uttara nirvikalpa jñāna lābhāt prabuddhaḥ bhavati tadā tad pṛṣṭha labdha śuddha laukika jñāna saṃmukhībhāvāt viṣaya abhāvam yathāvat avagacchati iti samānam etat

yadi sva saṃtāna pariṇāma viśeṣāt eva sattvānām artha pratibhāsāḥ vijñaptayaḥ utpadyante na artha viśeṣāt tadā yaḥ eṣa pāpa kalyāṇa mitra saṃparkāt sat asat dharma śravaṇāt ca vijñapti niyamaḥ sattvānām sa katham sidhyati asati sat asat saṃparke tad deśanāyām ca anyonya adhipati tvena vijñapti niyamaḥ mithas

sarveṣām hi sattvānām anyonya vijñapti ādhipatyena mithas vijñapteḥ niyamaḥ bhavati yathāyogam mithas iti parasparataḥ atas saṃtāna antara vijñapti viśeṣāt saṃtāna antare vijñapti viśeṣaḥ utpadyate na artha viśeṣāt yadi yathā svapne nirarthikāḥ vijñaptiḥ evam jāgrataḥ api syāt kasmāt kuśala akuśala samudācāre suptā suptayoḥ tulyam phalam iṣṭa aniṣṭam āyatyām na bhavati yasmāt : middhena upahatam cittam svapne tena asamam phalam idam atra kāraṇam na tu artha sadbhāvaḥ

yadi vijñāpti mātram eva idam na kasyacid kāyaḥ asti na vāc katham upakramyamāṇānām aurabhrika ādibhiḥ urabhra ādīnām maraṇam bhavati atatkṛte vā tad maraṇe katham aurabhrika ādīnām prāṇa atipāta avadyena yogaḥ bhavati maraṇam para vijñapti viśeṣāt vikriyā yathā smṛti lopa ādikāni eṣām piśāca ādi manaḥ vaśāt

yathā hi piśāca ādi manaḥ vaśāt anyeṣām smṛti la upa svapna darśana bhūta graha āveśa vikārāḥ bhavanti ṛddhi vat manaḥ vaśāt ca yathā sāraṇasya ārya mahākātyāyana adhiṣṭhānāt svapna darśanam āraṇyaka ṛṣi manaḥ pradoṣāt ca vema citriṇaḥ parājayaḥ tathā para vijñapti viśeṣa ādhipatyāt pareṣām jīvita indriya virodhinī kācid vikriyā utpadyate yayā sa bhāga saṃtati viccheda ākhyam maraṇam bhavati iti veditavyam

katham vā daṇḍaka araṇya śūnya tvam ṛṣi kopataḥ yadi para vijñapti viśeṣa ādhipatyāt sattvānām maraṇam na iṣyate manodaṇḍasya hi mahāsāvadya tvam sādhayatā bhagavatā upāliḥ gṛhapatiḥ pṛṣṭaḥ : kaccit te gṛhapate śrutam kena tāni daṇḍaka araṇyāni mātaṅga araṇyāni kaliṅga araṇyāni śūnyāni medhyībhūtāni tena uktam : śrutam me bho gautama ṛṣīṇām manaḥ pradoṣeṇa iti

manodaṇḍaḥ mahāvadyaḥ katham vā tena sidhyati yadi evam kalpyate tad abhiprasannaiḥ amānuṣaiḥ tad vāsinaḥ sattvāḥ utsāditāḥ na tu ṛṣīṇām manaḥ pradoṣān mṛtāḥ iti evam sati katham tena karmaṇā manodaṇḍaḥ kāya vāc daṇḍābhyām mahāvat yatamaḥ siddhaḥ bhavati tad manaḥ pradoṣa mātreṇa tāvatām sattvānām maraṇāt sidhyati

yadi vijñaptimātram eva idam para citta vidaḥ kim para cittam jānanti atha na kim ca atas yadi na jānanti katham para citta vidaḥ bhavanti atha jānanti : para citta vidām jñānam ayathārtham katham yathā sva citta jñānam tat api katham ayathārtham ajñānāt yathā buddhasya gocaraḥ yathā tat nirabhilāpyena ātmanā buddhānām gocaraḥ tathā tad ajñānāt tat ubhayam na yathārtham vitatha pratibhāsa tayā grāhya grāhaka vikalpasya aprahīṇa tvāt

ananta viniścaya prabheda agādha gāmbhīryāyām vijñaptimātra tāyām vijñapti mātra tā siddhiḥ sva śakti sadṛśī mayā kṛtā iyam sarvathā sā tu na cintyā sarva prakārā tu sā mādṛśaiḥ cintayitum na śakyā tarka aviṣaya tvāt kasya punar sā sarvathā gocaraḥ iti āha : buddha gocaraḥ buddhānām hi sā bhagavatām sarva prakāram gocaraḥ sarva ākāra sarva jñeya jñāna avighātāt iti
viṃśikā vijñapti mātra tā siddhiḥ kṛtiḥ iyam ācārya vasubandhoḥ

pramaṇataḥ artha pratipattau pravṛtti sāmarthyāt arthavat pramāṇam pramāṇam antareṇa na artha pratipattiḥ na artha pratipattim antareṇa pravṛtti sāmarthyam pramāṇena khalu ayam jñāta artham abhīpsati jihāsati vā tasya īpsā ajihāsā prayuktasya samīhā pravṛttiḥ iti ucyate sāmrthyam punar asyāḥ phalena abhisambandhaḥ samīhamānaḥ tam artham abhīpsan jihāsan vā tam artham āpnoti jahāti vā arthaḥ tu sukham sukha hetuḥ ca duḥkham duḥkha hetuḥ ca

saḥ ayam pramāṇa arthaḥ aparisaṅkhyeyaḥ prāṇabhṛt bhedasya aparisaṅkhyeya tvāt arthavati ca pramāṇe pramātā prameyam pramitiḥ iti arthavanti bhavanti kasmāt anyatama apāye arthasya anupapatteḥ tatra yasya īpsā ajihāsā prayuktasya pravṛttiḥ sa pramātā sa yena artham pramiṇoti tat pramāṇam yaḥ arthaḥ pramīyate tat prameyam yat artha vijñānam sā pramitiḥ catasṛṣu ca evaṃvidhāsu artha tattvam parisamāpyate kim punar tattvam sataḥ ca sadbhāvaḥ asataḥ ca asadbhāvaḥ sat sat iti gṛhyamāṇam yathābhūtam aviparītam tattvam bhavati asat ca asat iti gṛhyamāṇam yathābhūtam aviparītam tattvam bhavati

katham uttarasya pramāṇena upalabdhiḥ iti sati upalabhyamāne tad anupalabdheḥ pradīpa vat yathā darśakena dīpena dṛśye gṛhyamāṇe tat iva yat na gṛhyate tat na asti yadi abhaviṣyat idam iva vyajñāsyata vijñāna abhāvāt na asti iti evam pramāṇena sati gṛhyamāṇe tat iva yat na gṛhyate tat na asti yadi abhaviṣyat idam iva vyajñāsyata vijñāna abhāvāt na asti iti tat evam sataḥ prakāśakam pramāṇam asat api prakāśayati iti

sat ca khalu ṣoḍaśadhā vyūḍham upadekṣyate tāsām khalu āsām sadvidhānām pramāṇa prameya saṃśaya prayojana dṛṣṭānta siddhānta avayava tarka nirṇaya vāda jalpa vitaṇḍā hetvābhāsa chala ja ati nigraha sthānānām tattva jñānāt niḥśreyasa adhigamaḥ nirdeśe yathāvacanam vigrahaḥ ca arthe dvandva samāsaḥ pramāṇa ādīnām tattvam iti śaiṣikī ṣaṣṭhī

tattvasya jñānam niḥśreyasasya adhigamaḥ iti karmaṇi ṣaṣṭhau te etāvantaḥ vidyamāna arthāḥ yeṣām aviparīta jñāna artham iha upadeśaḥ saḥ ayam anavayavena tantra arthaḥ uddiṣṭaḥ veditavyaḥ ātma ādeḥ khalu prameyasya tattva jñānāt niḥśreyasa adhigamaḥ tat ca etat uttara sūtreṇa anūdyate iti heyam tasya nirvartakam hānam ātyantikam tasya upāyaḥ adhigantavyaḥ iti etāni catvāri artha padāni samyak buddhvā niḥśreyasam adhigacchati tatra saṃśaya ādīnām pṛthak vacanam anarthakam saṃśaya ādayaḥ yathāsambhavam pramāṇeṣu prameyeṣu ca antarbhavantaḥ na vyatiricyante iti satyam etat imāḥ tu catasraḥ vidyāḥ pṛthak prasthānāḥ prāṇabhṛtām anugrahāya upadiśyante yāsām caturthī iyam ānvīkṣikī nyāya vidyā

tasyāḥ pṛthak prasthānāḥ saṃśaya ādayaḥ padārthāḥ teṣām pṛthak vacanam antareṇa adhyātma vidyā mātram iyam syāt yathā upaniṣadaḥ tasmāt saṃśaya ādibhiḥ padārthaiḥ pṛthak prasthāpyate tatra na anupalabdhe na nirṇīte arthe nyāyaḥ pravartate kim tarhi saṃśayite arthe yathā uktam vimṛśya pakṣa pratipakṣābhyām artha avadhāraṇam nirṇayaḥ iti vimarśaḥ saṃśayaḥ pakṣa pratipakṣau nyāya pravṛttiḥ artha avadhāraṇam nirṇayaḥ tattva jñānam iti sa ca ayam kiṃsvid iti vastu vimarśa mātram anavadhāraṇam jñānam saṃśayaḥ prameye antarbhavan evam artham pṛthak ucyate

atha prayojanam yena prayuktaḥ pravartate tat prayojanam yam artham abhīpsan jihāsan vā karma ārabhate tena anena sarve prāṇinaḥ sarvāṇi karmāṇi sarvāḥ ca vidyāḥ vyāptāḥ tad āśrayaḥ ca nyāyaḥ pravartate kaḥ punar ayam nyāyaḥ pramāṇaiḥ artha parīkṣaṇam nyāyaḥ pratyakṣa āgama āśritam anumānam sa anvīkṣā pratyakṣa āgamābhyām īkṣitasya anvīkṣaṇam anvīkṣā tayā pravarttate iti ānvīkṣikī nyāya vidyā nyāya śāstram yat punar anumānam pratyakṣa āgama viruddham nyāya ābhāsaḥ saḥ iti

tatra vāda jalpau sa prayojanau vitaṇḍā tu parīkṣyate vitaṇḍayā pravartamānaḥ vaitaṇḍikaḥ sa prayojanam anuyuktaḥ yadi pratipadyate saḥ asya pakṣaḥ saḥ asya siddhānte iti vaitaṇḍika tvam jahāti atha na pratipadyate na ayam laukikaḥ na parīkṣakaḥ iti āpadyate atha api para pakṣa pratiṣedha jñāpanam prayojanam bravīti etat api tādṛś eva yaḥ jñāpayati yaḥ jānāti yena jñāpyate yat ca jñāpyate etat ca pratipadyate yadi tadā vaitaṇḍika tvam jahāti atha na pratipadyate para pakṣa pratiṣedha jñāpanam prayojanam iti etat asya vākyam anarthakam bhavati vākya samūhaḥ ca sthāpanā hīnaḥ vitaṇḍā tasya yadi abhidheyam pratipadyate saḥ asya pakṣaḥ sthāpanīyaḥ bhavati atha na pratipadyate pralāpa mātram anarthakam bhavati vitaṇḍā tvam nivartate iti

atha dṛṣṭāntaḥ pratyakṣa viṣayaḥ arthaḥ yatra laukika parīkṣakāṇām darśanam na vyāhanyate sa ca prameyam tasya pṛthak vacanam ca tad āśrayau anumāna āgamau tasmin sati syātām anumāna āgamau asati ca na syātām tad āśrayā ca nyāya pravṛttiḥ dṛṣṭānta virodhena ca para pakṣa pratiṣedhaḥ vacanīyaḥ bhavati dṛṣṭānta samādhinā ca sva pakṣaḥ sādhanīyaḥ bhavati nāstikaḥ ca dṛṣṭāntam abhyupagacchan āstika tvam jahāti anabhyupagacchan kiṃsādhanaḥ param upālabheta iti niruktena ca dṛṣṭāntena śakyam abhidhātum sādhya sādharmyāt tad dharma bhāvī dṛṣṭāntaḥ udāharaṇam tad viparyayāt viparītam iti

asti ayam iti anujñāyamānaḥ arthaḥ siddhāntaḥ sa ca prameyam tasya pṛthak vacanam satsu siddhānta bhedeṣu vāda jalpa vitaṇḍāḥ pravartante na atas anyathā iti sādhanīya arthasya yāvati śabda samūhe siddhiḥ parisamāpyate tasya pañca avayavāḥ pratijña ādayaḥ samūham apekṣya avayavāḥ ucyante teṣu pramāṇa samavāyaḥ āgamaḥ pratijñā hetuḥ anumānam

udāharaṇam pratyakṣam upanayanam upamānam sarveṣām eka artha samavāye sāmarthya pradarśanam nigamanam iti saḥ ayam paramaḥ nyāyaḥ iti etena vāda jalpa vitaṇḍāḥ pravartante na atas anyathā iti tad āśrayā ca tattva vyavasthā te ca ete avayavāḥ śabda viśeṣāḥ santaḥ prameye antarbhūtāḥ evam artham pṛthak ucyante iti tarkaḥ na pramāṇa saṃgṛhītaḥ na pramāṇa antaram pramāṇānām anugrāhakaḥ tattva jñānāya kalpate tasya udāharaṇam kim idam janma kṛtakena hetunā nirvartyate āhosvit akṛtakena atha ākasmikam iti

evam avijñāte arthe kāraṇa upapattyā ūhaḥ pravarttate yadi kṛtakena hetunā nirvartyate hetu ucchedāt upapannaḥ ayam janma ucchedaḥ atha ākṛtakena hetunā tatas hetu ucchedasya aśakya tvāt anupapannaḥ janma ucchedaḥ atha ākasmikam atas akasmāt nirvartyamānam na punar nivartsyati iti nivṛtti kāraṇam na upapadyate tena janma anucchedaḥ iti etasmin tarka viṣaye karma nimittam janma iti pramāṇāni pravarttamānāni tarkeṇa anugṛhante tattva jñāna viṣayasya vibhāgāt tattva jñānāya kalpate tarkaḥ iti saḥ ayam itthambhūtaḥ tarkaḥ pramāṇa sahitaḥ vāde sādhanāya upālambhāya ca arthasya bhavati iti evam artham pṛghak ucyate prameya antarbhūtaḥ api iti

nirṇayaḥ tattva jñānam pramāṇānām phalam tad avasānaḥ vādaḥ tasya pālana artham jalpa viṭaṇḍe tau etau tarka nirṇayau lokayātrām vahate iti saḥ ayam nirṇayaḥ prameya antarbhūtaḥ evam artham pṛthak uddīṣṭaḥ iti vādaḥ khalu nānā pravaktṛkaḥ pratyadhikaraṇa sādhanaḥ anyatara adhikaraṇa nirṇaya avasānaḥ vākya samūhaḥ

pṛthak uddiṣṭaḥ upalakṣaṇa artham upalakṣitena vyavahāraḥ tattva jñānāya bhavati iti tad viśeṣau jalpa vitaṇḍe tattva adhyavasāya saṃrakṣaṇa artham iti uktam nigraha sthānebhyaḥ pṛthak uddhiṣṭāḥ hetvābhāsāḥ vāde codanīyāḥ bhaviṣyanti iti jalpa vitaṇḍayoḥ tu nigraha sthānāni iti chala ja ati nigraha sthānānām pṛthak upadeśaḥ upalakṣaṇa artham iti upalakṣitānām sva vākye parivarjanam chala ja ati nigraha sthānānām para vākye paryanuyogaḥ jāteḥ ca pareṇa prayujyamānāyāḥ sulabhaḥ samādhiḥ svayam ca sukaraḥ prayogaḥ iti

sā iyam ānvīkṣikī pramāṇa ādibhiḥ padārthaiḥ vibhajyamānā pradīpaḥ sarva vidyānām upāyaḥ sarva karmaṇām āśrayaḥ sarva dharmāṇām vidyā uddeśe prakīrtitā tat idam tattva jñānam niḥśreyasa adhigama artham yathāvidyam veditavyam iha tu adhyātma vidyāyām ātma ādi jñānam tattva jñānam niḥśreyasa adhigamaḥ apavarga prāptiḥ

tat khalu niḥśreyasam kim tattva jñāna antaram eva bhavati na iti ucyate kim tarhi tattva jñānāt duḥkha janma pravṛtti doṣa mithyā jñānām uttarottara apāye tad anantara apāyāt apavargaḥ tatra ātma ādi apavarga paryanta prameye mithyājñānam aneka prakārakam varttate ātmani tāvat na asti iti anātmani ātmā iti duḥkhe sukham iti anitye nityam iti atrāṇe trāṇam iti sa bhaye nirbhayam iti jugupsite abhimatam iti hātavye apratihātavyam iti pravṛttau na asti karma na asti karma phalam iti doṣeṣu na ayam doṣa nimittaḥ saṃsāraḥ iti pretyabhāve na asti jantuḥ jīvaḥ vā sattvaḥ ātmā vā yaḥ preyāt pretya ca bhavet iti animittam janma animittaḥ janma uparamaḥ iti ādimān pretyabhāvaḥ anantaḥ ca iti naimittikaḥ san akarma nimittaḥ pretyabhāvaḥ iti deha indriya buddhi vedanā santāna uccheda pratisandhānābhyām nirātmakaḥ pretyabhāvaḥ iti apavarge bhīṣmaḥ khalu ayam sarva kāya uparamaḥ sarva viprayoge apavarge bahu ca bhadrakam lupyate iti katham buddhimān sarva sukha ucchedam acaitanyam amum apavargam rocayet iti

etasmāt mithyājñānāt anukūleṣu rāgaḥ pratikūleṣu dveṣaḥ rāga dveṣa adhikārāt ca asatya īrṣya māyā lobha ādayaḥ doṣāḥ bhavanti doṣaiḥ prayuktaḥ śarīreṇa pravarttamānaḥ hiṃsā steya pratiṣiddha maithunāni ācarati vācā anṛta paruṣa sūcanā sambaddhāni manasā para droham para dravya abhīpsām nāstikyam ca iti sā iyam pāpa ātmikā pravṛttiḥ adharmāya

atha śubhā śarīreṇa dānam paritrāṇam paricaraṇam ca vācā satyam hitam priyam svādhyāyam ca iti manasā dayām aspṛhām śraddhām ca iti sā iyam dharmāya atra pravṛtti sādhanau dharma adharmau pravṛtti śabdena uktau yathā anna sādhanāḥ prāṇāḥ annam vai prāṇinaḥ prāṇāḥ iti sā iyam pravṛttiḥ kutsitasya abhipūjitasya ca janmanaḥ kāraṇam janma punar śarīra indriya buddhīnām nikāya viśiṣṭaḥ prādurbhāvaḥ tasmin sati duḥkham tat punar pratikūla vedanīyam bādhanā pīḍā tāpaḥ iti te ime mithyājñāna ādayaḥ duḥkhāntāḥ dharmāḥ avicchedena eva pravartamānāḥ saṃsāraḥ iti yadā tu tattva jñānāt mithyājñānam apaiti tadā mithyā jñāna apāye doṣāḥ apayanti doṣa apāye pravṛttiḥ apaiti pravṛtti apāye janma apaiti janma apāye duḥkham apaiti duḥkha apāye ca ātyantikaḥ apavargaḥ niḥśreyasam iti

tattva jñānam tu khalu mithyājñāna viparyayeṇa vyākhyātam ātmani tāvat asti iti anātmani anātmā iti evam duḥkhe anitye atrāṇe sa bhaye jugupsite hātavye ca yathā viṣayam veditavyam pravṛttau asti karma asti karma phalam iti doṣeṣu doṣa nimittaḥ ayam saṃsāraḥ iti pretyabhāve khalu asti jantuḥ jīvaḥ sattvaḥ ātmā vā yaḥ pretya bhavet iti nimitta vat janma nimittavān janma uparamaḥ iti anādiḥ pretyabhāvaḥ apavarga ante iti naimittikaḥ san pretyabhāvaḥ pravṛtti nimittaḥ iti sa ātmakaḥ san deha indriya buddhi vedanā santāna uccheda pratisandhānābhyām pravarttate iti apavarge śāntaḥ khalu ayam sarva viprayogaḥ sarva uparamaḥ apavargaḥ bahu ca kṛccham ghoram pāpakam lupyate iti katham buddhimān sarva duḥkha ucchedam sarva duḥkhā saṃvidam apavargam na rocayet iti tat yathā madhu viṣa sampṛkta annam anādeyam iti evam sukham duḥkha anuṣaktam anādeyam iti

trividhā ca asya śāstrasya pravṛttiḥ uddeśaḥ lakṣaṇam parīkṣā ca iti tatra nāmadheyena padārtha mātrasya abhidhānam uddeśaḥ tatra uddiṣṭasya tattva vyavacchedakaḥ dharmaḥ lakṣaṇam lakṣitasya yathālakṣaṇam upapadyate na vā iti pramāṇaiḥ avadhāraṇam parīkṣā tatra uddiṣṭasya pravibhaktasya lakṣaṇam ucyate yathā pramāṇānām prameyasya ca uddhiṣṭasya lakṣitasya ca vibhāga vacanam yathā chalasya vacana vighātaḥ artha vikalpa upapattyā cchalam tat trividham iti atha uddiṣṭasya vibhāga vacanam pratyakṣa anumāna upamāna śabdāḥ pramāṇāni

akṣasya akṣasya prativiṣayam vṛttiḥ pratyakṣam vṛttiḥ tu sannikarṣaḥ jñānam vā yadā sannikarṣaḥ tadā jñānam pramitiḥ yadā jñānam tadā hāna upādāna upekṣā buddhayaḥ phalam anumānam mitena liṅgena liṅginaḥ arthasya paścāt mānam anumānam upamānam sāmīpya jñānam yathā gauḥ evam gavayaḥ iti sāmīpyam tu sāmānya yogaḥ śabdaḥ śabdyate anena arthaḥ iti abhidhīyate jñāpyate upalabdhi sādhanāni pramāṇāni samākhyā nirvacana sāmarthyāt boddhavyam pramīyate anena iti karaṇa artha abhidhānaḥ hi pramāṇa śabdaḥ tad viśeṣa samākhyāyāḥ api tathā eva vyākhyānam kim punar pramāṇāni prameyam abhisaṃplavante atha pratiprameyam vyavatiṣṭhante iti

ubhayathā darśanam asti ātmā iti āpta upadeśāt pratīyate tatra anumānam icchā dveṣa prayatna sukha duḥkha jñānāni ātmanaḥ liṅgam iti pratyakṣam yuñjānasya yoga samādhi jam ātma manasoḥ saṃyoga viśeṣāt ātmā pratyakṣaḥ iti agniḥ āpta upadeśāt pratīyate atra agniḥ iti pratyāsīdatā dhūma darśanena anumīyate pratyāsannena ca pratyakṣataḥ upalabhyate vyavasthā punar agnihotra juhuyāt svarga kāmaḥ iti laukikasya svarge na liṅga darśanam na pratyakṣam stanayitnu śabde śrūyamāṇe śabda hetoḥ anumānam tatra na pratyakṣam na āgamaḥ pāṇau pratyakṣataḥ upalabhyamāne na anumānam na āgamaḥ iti

sā ca iyam pramitiḥ pratyakṣa parā jijñāsitam artham āpta upadeśāt pratipadyamānaḥ liṅga darśanena api bubhutsate liṅga darśana anumitam ca pratyakṣataḥ didṛkṣate upalabdhe arthe jijñāsā nivarttate pūrva uktam udāharaṇam agniḥ iti pramātuḥ pramāṇānām sambhavaḥ abhisaṃplavaḥ asambhavaḥ vyavasthā iti iti tri sūtrī bhāṣyam

atha vibhaktānām lakṣaṇa vacanam iti indriya artha sannikarṣa uttpannam jñānam avyapadeśyam avyabhicāri vyavasāya ātmakam pratyakṣam indriyasya arthena sannikarṣāt utpadyate yat jñānam tat pratyakṣam na tarhi idānīm idam bhavati ātmā manasā saṃyujyate manaḥ indriyeṇa indriyam arthena iti

na idam kāraṇa avadhāraṇam etāvat pratyakṣe kāraṇam iti kim tu viśiṣṭa kāraṇa vacanam iti yat pratyakṣa jñānasya viśiṣṭa kāraṇam tat ucyate yat tu samānam anumāna ādi jñānasya na tat nivarttate iti manasaḥ tarhi indriyeṇa saṃyogaḥ vaktavyaḥ bhidyamānasya pratyakṣa jñānasya na ayam bhidyate iti samāna tvāt na uktaḥ iti

yāvat artham vai nāmadheya śabdāḥ taiḥ artha sampratyayaḥ artha sampratyayāt ca vyavahāraḥ tatra idam indriya artha sannikarṣāt utpannam artha jñānam rūpam iti vā rasaḥ iti evam vā bhavati rūpa rasa śabdāḥ ca viṣaya nāmadheyam tena vyapadiśyate jñānam rūpam iti jānīte rasaḥ iti jānīte nāmadheya śabdena vyapadiśyamānam sat śābdam prasajyate atas āha avyapadeśyam iti

yat idam anupayukte śabda artha sambandhe artha jñānam na tat nāmadheya śabdena vyapadiśyate gṛhīte api ca śabda artha sambandhe asya arthasya ayam śabdaḥ nāmadheyam iti yadā tu saḥ arthaḥ gṛhyate tadā tat pūrvasmāt artha jñānāt na viśiṣyate tat artha vijñānam tādṛś eva bhavati tasya tu artha jñānasya anyaḥ samākhyā śabdaḥ na asti iti yena pratīyamānam vyavahārāya lakpeta na ca apratīyamānena vyavahāraḥ tasmāt jñeyasya arthasya saṃjñā śabdena iti karaṇa yuktena nirdiśyate rūpam iti jñānam rasaḥ iti jñānam iti tat evam artha jñāna kāle sa na samākhyā śabdaḥ vyāpriyate vyavahāra kāle tu vyāpriyate tasmāt aśa abdam artha jñānam indriya artha sannikarṣa utpannam iti

grīṣme marīcayaḥ bhaumena ūṣmaṇā saṃsṛṣṭāḥ spandamānāḥ dūra sthasya cakṣuṣā sannikṛṣyante tatra indriya artha sannikarṣāt udakam iti jñānam utpadyate tat ca pratyakṣam prasajyate iti atas āha avyabhicāri iti yat atasmin tat iti tat vyabhicāri pratyakṣam iti dūrāt cakṣuṣā hi ayam artham paśyan na avadhārayati dhūmaḥ iti vā reṇuḥ iti vā tat etat indriya artha sannikarṣa utpannam anavadhāraṇa jñānam pratyakṣam prasajyate iti atas āha vyavasāya ātmakam iti na ca etat mantavyam ātma manaḥ sannikarṣa jam eva anavadhāraṇa jñānam iti cakṣuṣā hi ayam artham paśyan na avadhārayati yathā ca indriyeṇa upalabdham artham manasā upalabhate evam indriyeṇa anavadhārayat manasā na avadhārayati yat ca tad indriya anavadhāraṇa pūrvakam manasā anavadhāraṇam tat viśeṣa apekṣam vimarśa mātram saṃśayaḥ na pūrvam iti sarvatra pratyakṣa viṣaye jñātuḥ indriyeṇa vyavasāyaḥ paścāt manasā anuvyavasāyaḥ upahata indriyāṇām anuvyavasāya abhāvāt iti

ātma ādiṣu sukha ādiṣu ca pratyakṣa lakṣaṇam vaktavyam anindriya artha sannikarṣa jam hi tat iti indriyasya vai sataḥ manasaḥ indriyebhyaḥ pṛthak upadeśaḥ dharma bhedāt bhautikāni indriyāṇi niyata viṣayāṇi sa guṇānām ca eṣām indriya bhāvaḥ iti manaḥ tu abhautikam sarva viṣayam ca na asya sa guṇasya indriya bhāvaḥ iti sati ca indriya artha sannikarṣe sannidhim asannidhim ca asya yugapad jñāna anutpatti kāraṇam vakṣyāmaḥ iti manasaḥ ca indriya bhāvāt na vācyam lakṣaṇa antaram iti tantra antara samācārāt ca etat pratyetavyam iti para matam apratiṣiddham anumatam iti hi tantra yuktiḥ vyākhyātam pratyakṣam

atha tad pūrvakam trividham anumānam pūrvavat śeṣavat sāmānyatas dṛṣṭam ca tad pūrvakam iti anena liṅga liṅginoḥ sambandha darśanam liṅga darśanam ca abhisambadhyate liṅga liṅginoḥ sambaddhayoḥ darśanena liṅga smṛtiḥ abhisambadhyate smṛtyā liṅga darśanena ca apratyakṣaḥ arthaḥ anumīyate

pūrvavat iti yatra kāraṇena kāryam anumīyate yathā megha unnatyā bhaviṣyati vṛṣṭiḥ iti śeṣavat tat yatra kāryeṇa kāraṇam anumīyate pūrva udaka viparītam udakam nadyāḥ pūrṇa tvam śīghra tvan ca dṛṣṭvā srotasaḥ anumīyate bhūtāḥ vṛṣṭiḥ iti sāmānyatodṛṣṭam vrajyā pūrvakam anyatra dṛṣṭasya ṇi atra darśanam iti tathā ca ādityasya tasmāt asti apratyakṣā api ādityasya vrajyā iti

atha vā pūrvavat iti yatra yathāpūrvam pratyakṣa bhūtayoḥ anyatara darśanena anyatarasya anumānam apratyakṣasya anumānam yathā dhūmena agniḥ iti śeṣa vat nāma pariśeṣaḥ sa ca prasakta pratiṣedhe ṇi atra aprasaṅgāt śiṣyamāṇe sampratyayaḥ yathā sat anityam evamādinā dravya guṇa karmaṇām aviśeṣeṇa sāmānya viśeṣa samavāyebhyaḥ vibhaktasya śabdasya tasmin dravya karma guṇa saṃśaye na dravyam eka dravya tvāt na karma śabda antara hetutvāt yaḥ tu śiṣyate saḥ ayam iti śabdasya guṇa tva pratipattiḥ

sāmānyatodṛṣṭam nāma yatra apratyakṣe liṅga liṅginoḥ sambandhe kenacid arthena liṅgasya sāmānyāt apratyakṣaḥ liṅgī gamyate yathā icchā ādibhiḥ ātmā icchā ādayaḥ guṇāḥ guṇāḥ ca dravya saṃsthānāḥ tat tat eṣām sthānam saḥ ātmā iti vibhāga vacanāt eva trividham iti siddhe trividha vacanam mahataḥ mahā viṣayasya nyāyasya laghīyasā sūtreṇa upadeśāt param vākya lāghavam manyamānasya anyasmin vākya lāghave anādaraḥ tathā ca ayam itthaṃbhūtena vākya vikalpena pravṛttaḥ siddhānte chale śabda ādiṣu ca bahulam samācāraḥ śāstre iti sat viṣayam ca pratyakṣam sat asat viṣayam ca anumānam kasmāt traikālya grahaṇāt tri kāla yuktāḥ arthāḥ anumānena gṛhyante bhaviṣyati iti anumīyate bhavati iti ca abhūt iti ca asat ca khalu attam anāgatam ca iti

atha upamānam prasiddha sādharmyāt sādhya sādhanam upamānam prajñātena sāmānyāt prajñāpanīyasya prajñāpanam upamānam iti yathā gauḥ evam gavayaḥ iti kim punar atra upamānena kriyate yadā khalu ayam gavā samāna dharmam pratipadyate tadā pratyakṣataḥ tam artham pratipadyate iti samākhyā sambandha pratipattiḥ upamāna arthaḥ iti āha yathā gauḥ evam gavayaḥ iti upamāne prayukte gavā samāna dharmam artham indriya artha sannikarṣāt upalabhamānaḥ asya gavaya śabdaḥ saṃjñā iti saṃjñā saṃjñi sambandham pratipadyate iti yathā mudgaḥ tathā mudgaparṇī yathā māṣaḥ tathā māṣaparṇī iti upamāne prayukte upamānāt saṃjñā saṃjñi sanandham pratipadyamānaḥ tām oṣadhīm bhaiṣajyāya āharati evam anyaḥ api upamānasya loke viṣayaḥ bubhutsitavyaḥ iti

atha śabdaḥ āpta upadeśaḥ śabdaḥ āptaḥ khalu sākṣātkṛta dharmā yathādṛṣṭasya arthasya cikhyā apayiṣayā prayuktaḥ upadeṣṭā sākṣātkaraṇam arthasya āptiḥ tayā pravartate iti āptaḥ ṛṣi āri amlecchānām samānam lakṣaṇam tathā ca sarveṣām vyavahārāḥ pravarttante iti evam ebhiḥ pramāṇaiḥ deva manuṣya tiraścām vyavahārāḥ prakalpante na atas anyathā iti

sa dvividhaḥ dṛṣṭa adṛṣṭa artha tvāt yasya iha dṛśyate arthaḥ sa dṛṣṭa arthaḥ yasya amutra pratīyate saḥ adṛṣṭa arthaḥ evam ṛṣi laukika vākyānām vibhāgaḥ iti kimartham punar idam ucyate sa na manyeta dṛṣṭa arthaḥ eva āpta upadeśaḥ pramāṇam arthasya avadhāraṇāt iti adṛṣṭa arthaḥ api pramāṇam arthasya anumānāt iti

kim punar anena pramāṇena artha jātam pramātavyam iti ātma śarīra indriya artha buddhi manaḥ pravṛtti doṣa pretya bhāva phala duḥkha apavargāḥ tu prameyam tatra ātmā sarvasya draṣṭā sarvasya bhoktā sarvajñaḥ sarva anubhāvī tasya bhoga āyatanam śarīram bhoga sādhanāni indriyāṇi bhoktavyāḥ indriya arthāḥ bhogaḥ buddhiḥ sarva artha upalabdhau na indriyāṇi prabhavanti iti sarva viṣayam antaḥkaraṇam manaḥ śarīra indriya artha buddhi sukha vedanānām nivṛtti kāraṇam pravṛttiḥ doṣāḥ ca na asya idam śarīram apūrvam anuttaram ca pūrva śarīrāṇām ādiḥ na asti uttareṣām apavargaḥ antaḥ iti pretyabhāvaḥ sa sādhana sukha duḥkha upabhogaḥ phalam duḥkham iti na idam anukūla vedanīyasya sukhasya pratīteḥ pratyākhyānam kim tarhi janmanaḥ eva idam sa sukha sādhanasya duḥkha anuṣaṅgāt duḥkhena aviprayogāt vividha bādhana ayogāt duḥkham iti samādhi bhāvanam upadiśyate
