samāhitaḥ bhāvayati bhāvayan nirvidyate nirviṇṇasya vairāgyam viraktasya apavargaḥ iti janma maraṇa prabandha ucchedaḥ sarva duḥkha prahāṇam apavargaḥ iti asti anyat api dravya guṇa karma sāmānya viśeṣa samavāyāḥ prameyam tad bhedena ca aparisaṅkhyā iyam asya tu tattva jñānāt apavargaḥ mithyājñānāt saṃsāraḥ iti atas etat upadiṣṭam viśeṣeṇa iti

tatra ātmā tāvat pratyakṣataḥ na gṛhyate sa kim āpta upadeśa mātrāt eva pratipadyate iti na iti ucyate anumānāt ca pratipattavyaḥ iti katham icchā dveṣa prayatna sukha duḥkha jñānāni ātmanaḥ liṅgam iti yat jātīyasya arthasya sannikarṣāt sukham ātma upalabdhavān tad jātīyam eva artham paśyan upādātum icchati sā iyam ādātum icchā ekasya aneka artha darśinaḥ darśana pratisandhānāt bhavati liṅgam ātmanaḥ niyata viṣaye hi buddhi bheda mātre na sambhavati deha antara vat iti evam ekasya aneka artha darśinaḥ darśana pratisandhānāt duḥkha hetau dveṣaḥ yat jātīyaḥ asya arthaḥ sukha hetuḥ prasiddhaḥ tad jātīyam artham paśyan ādātum prayatate ekam aneka artha darśinam darśana pratisandhātāram antareṇa na syāt niyata viṣaye buddhi mātre na sambhavati deha antara vat iti

etena duḥkha hetau prayatnaḥ vyākhyātaḥ sukha duḥkha smṛtyā ca ayam tad sādhanam ādadānaḥ sukham upalabhate duḥkham upalabhate sukha duḥkhe vedayate pūrva uktaḥ eva hetuḥ bubhutsamānaḥ khalu ayam vimṛśati kiṃsvid iti vimṛśan ca jānīte idam iti tat idam jñānam bubhutsā vimarśābhyām abhinna kartṛkam gṛhyamāṇam ātma liṅgam pūrva uktaḥ eva hetuḥ iti tatra deha antara vat iti vibhajyate yathā anātma vādinaḥ deha antareṣu niyata viṣayā buddhi bhedā na pratisandhīyante tathā eka deha viṣayāḥ api na pratisandhīyeran aviśeṣāt saḥ ayam eka sattvasya samācāraḥ svayaṃdṛṣṭasya smaraṇam na anyat dṛṣṭasya na adṛṣṭasya iti evam khalu nānā sattvānām samācāraḥ anya dṛṣṭam anyaḥ na smarati iti tat etat ubyayam aśakyam anātma vādinā vyavasthāpayitum iti evam upapannam asti ātmā iti

tasya bhoga adhiṣṭhānam ceṣṭa indriya artha āśrayaḥ śarīram katham ceṣṭā āśrayaḥ īpsitam jihāsitam vā artham adhikṛtya īpsā ājihāsa aprayuktasya tad upāya anuṣṭhāna lakṣaṇā samīhā ceṣṭā sā yatra varttate tat śarīram katham indriya āśrayaḥ yasya anugraheṇa anugṛhītāni upaghāte ca upahatāni sva viṣayeṣu sādhu asādhuṣu vartante saḥ eṣām āśrayaḥ tat śarīram katham artha āśrayaḥ yasmin āyatane indriya artha sannikarṣāt utpannayoḥ sukha duḥkhayoḥ pratisaṃvedanam pravartate saḥ eṣām āśrayaḥ tat śarīram iti

bhoga sādhanāni punar ghrāṇa rasana cakṣuḥ tvac śrotrāṇi indriyāṇi bhūtebhyaḥ jighrati anena iti ghrāṇam gandham gṛhṇāti iti rasayati anena iti rasanam rasam gṛhṇāti iti caṣṭe anena iti cakṣuḥ rūpam paśyati iti tvac sthānam indriyam tvac tad upacāraḥ sthānāt iti śṛṇoti anena iti śrotram śabdam gṛhṇāti iti evam samākhyā nirvacana sāmarthyāt bodhyam sva viṣaya grahaṇa lakṣaṇāni indriyāṇi iti bhūtebhyaḥ iti nānā prakṛtīnām eṣām satām viṣaya niyamaḥ na eka prakṛtīnām sati ca viṣaya niyame sva viṣaya grahaṇa lakṣaṇa tvam bhavati iti
kāni punar indriya kāraṇāni pṛthivī āpaḥ tejaḥ vāyuḥ ākāśam iti bhūtāni saṃjñā śabdaiḥ pṛthak upadeśaḥ bhūtānām vibhaktānām su vacam kāryam bhaviṣyati iti
ime tu khalu gandha rasa rūpa sparśa śabdāḥ pṛthivī ādi guṇāḥ tad arthāḥ pṛthivī ādīnām yathā viniyogam guṇāḥ indriyāṇām yathākramam arthāḥ viṣayāḥ iti

acetanasya karaṇasya buddheḥ jñānam vṛttiḥ cetanasyākartuḥ upalabdhiḥ iti yukti viruddham artham pratyācakṣāṇakaḥ iva idam āha buddhiḥ upalabdhiḥ jñānam iti anartha antaram na acetanasya karaṇasya buddheḥ jñānam bhavitum arhati tat dhi cetanam syāt ekaḥ ca ayam cetanaḥ deha indriya saṃghāta vyatiriktaḥ iti prameya lakṣaṇa arthasya vākyasya anya artha prakāśanam upapatti sāmarthyāt iti

smṛti anumāna āgama saṃśaya pratibhāsvapna jñāna ūhāḥ sukha ādi pratyakṣam icchā ādayaḥ ca manasaḥ liṅgāni teṣu satsu ayam api yupagat jñāna anutpattiḥ manasaḥ liṅgam anindriya nimittāḥ smṛti ādayaḥ karaṇa antara nimittāḥ bhavitum arhanti iti yugapad ca khalu ghrāṇa ādīnām gandha ādīnām ca sannikarṣeṣu satsu yugapad jñānāni na utpadyante tena anumīyate asti tat tat indriya saṃyogi sahakāri nimitta antaram avyāpi yasya asannidheḥ na utpadyate jñānam sannidheḥ ca utpadyate iti manaḥ saṃyoga anapekṣasya hi indriyārtha sannikarṣasya jñāna hetu tve yugapad uptadyeran jñānāni iti

krama prāptā tu pravṛttiḥ vāc buddhi śarīra ārambhaḥ manaḥ atra buddhiḥ iti abhipretam budhyate anena iti buddhiḥ saḥ ayam ārambhaḥ śarīreṇa vācā manasā ca puṇyaḥ pāpaḥ ca daśavidhaḥ tat etat kṛta bhāṣyam dvitīya sūtraḥ iti

pravartanā lakṣaṇāḥ doṣāḥ pravartanā pravṛtti hetu tvam jñātāram hi rāga ādayaḥ pravartayanti puṇye pāpe vā yatra mithyājñānam tatra rāga dveṣau iti pratyātma vedanīyāḥ hi ime doṣāḥ kasmāt lakṣaṇataḥ nirdiśyante iti karma lakṣaṇāḥ khalu rakta dviṣṭa mūḍhāḥ raktaḥ hi tat karma kurute yena karmaṇā sukham duḥkham vā labhate tathā dviṣṭaḥ tathā mūḍhaḥ iti rāga dveṣa mohāḥ iti ucyamāne bahu na uktam bhavati iti

punar utpattiḥ pretyabhāvaḥ utpannasya kvacid sattva nikāye mṛtvā yā punar utpattiḥ sa pretyabhāvaḥ utpannasya sambaddhasya sambandhaḥ tu deha indriya manaḥ buddhi vedanābhiḥ punar utpattiḥ punar deha ādibhiḥ sambandhaḥ punar iti abhyāsa abhidhānam yatra kvacid prāṇa bhṛt nikāye vartamānaḥ pūrva upāttān deha ādīn jahāti tat praiti yat tatra anyatra vā deha ādīn anyān upādatte tat bhavati pretyabhāvaḥ mṛtvā punarjanma saḥ ayam janma maraṇa prabandha abhyāsaḥ anādiḥ apavarga antaḥ pretyabhāvaḥ veditavyaḥ iti

pravṛtti doṣa janitaḥ arthaḥ phalam sukha duḥkha saṃvedanam phalam sukha vipākam karma duḥkha vipākam ca tat punar deha indriya viṣaya buddhiṣu satīṣu bhavati iti saha deha ādibhiḥ phalam abhipretam tathā hi pravṛtti doṣa janitaḥ arthaḥ phalam etat sarvam bhavati tat etat phalam upātam upātam heyam tyaktam tyaktam upādeyam iti na asya hāna upādānayoḥ niṣṭhā paryavasānam vā asti sa khalu ayam phalasya hāna upādāna srota sohyate lokaḥ iti

atha etat eva bādhanā lakṣaṇam duḥkham bādhanā pīḍā tāpaḥ iti tayā anuviddham anuṣaktam avinirbhāgena vartamānam duḥkha yogāt duḥkham iti saḥ ayam sarvam duḥkhena anuviddham iti paśyan duḥkham jihāsuḥ janmani duḥkha darśī nirvidyate nirviṇṇaḥ virajyate viraktaḥ vimucyate

yatra tu niṣṭhā yatra tu paryavasānam saḥ ayam tad atyanta vimokṣaḥ apavargaḥ tena duḥkhena janmanā atyantam vimuktiḥ apavargaḥ katham upāttasya janmanaḥ hānam anyasya ca anupādānam etām avasthām aparyantam apavargam vedayante apavarga vidaḥ tat abhayam ajaram amṛtyu padam brahma kṣema prāptiḥ iti

nityam sukham ātmanaḥ mahat tva vat mokṣe vyajyate yena abhivyaktena atyantam vimuktaḥ sukhī bhāti iti kecid manyante teṣām pramāṇa abhāvāt anupapattiḥ na pratyakṣam na anumānam na āgamaḥ vā vidyate nityam sukham ātmanaḥ mahat tva vat mokṣe abhivyajyate iti nityasya abhivyaktiḥ saṃvedanam tasya hetu vacanam nityasya abhivyaktiḥ saṃvedanam jñānam iti tasya hetuḥ vācyaḥ yatas tat utpadyate iti

sukha vat nityam iti ced saṃsāra sthasya muktena aviśeṣaḥ yathā muktaḥ sukhena tad saṃvedanena ca sannityena upapannaḥ tathā saṃsāra sthaḥ api prasajyate iti ubhayasya nitya tvāt abhyanujñāne ca dharma adharma phalena sāhacaryam yaugapadyam gṛhyeta yat idam utpatti sthāneṣu dharma adharma phalam sukham duḥkham vā saṃvedyate paryāyeṇa tasya ca nitya saṃvedanasya ca sahabhāvaḥ yaugapadyam gṛhyeta na sukha abhāvaḥ na anabhivyaktiḥ asti ubhayasya nitya tvāt

anitya tve hetu vacanam atha mokṣe nityasya sukhasya saṃvedanam anityam yatas utpadyate sa hetuḥ vācyaḥ ātma manaḥ saṃyogasya nimitta antara sahitasya hetu tvam ātma manaḥ saṃyogaḥ hetuḥ iti ced evam api tasya sahakāri nimitta antaram vacanīyam iti dharmasya kāraṇa vacanam yadi dharmaḥ nimitta antaram tasya hetuḥ vācyaḥ yatas utpadyate iti yoga samādhi jasya kārya avasāya virodhāt prakṣaye saṃvedana nivṛttiḥ yadi yoga samādhi jaḥ dharmaḥ hetuḥ

tasya kārya avasāya virodhāt prakṣaye saṃvedanam atyantam nivartate asaṃvedane ca avidyamānena aviśeṣaḥ yadi dharma kṣayāt saṃvedana uparamaḥ nityam sukham na saṃvedyate iti kim vidyamānam na saṃvedyate atha avidyamānam iti na anumānam viśiṣṭe asti iti aprakṣayaḥ ca dharmasya niranumānam utpatti dharmaka tvāt yoga samādhi jaḥ dharmaḥ na kṣīyate iti na asti anumānam utpatti dharmakam anityam iti viparyayasya tu anumānam yasya tu saṃvedana uparamaḥ na asti tena saṃvedana hetuḥ nityaḥ iti anumeyam

nitye ca mukta saṃsāra sthayoḥ aviśeṣaḥ iti uktam yathā muktasya nityam sukham tad saṃvedana hetuḥ ca saṃvedanasya tu uparamaḥ na asti kāraṇasya nitya tvāt tathā saṃsāra sthasya api iti evam ca sati dharma adharma phalena sukha duḥkha saṃvedanena sāhacaryam gṛhyeta iti śarīra ādi sambandhaḥ pratibandha hetuḥ iti ced na śarīra ādīnām upabhoga artha tvāt viparyayasya ca ananumānāt syāt matam saṃsāra avasthasya śarīra ādi sambandhaḥ nitya sukha saṃvedana hetoḥ pratibandhakaḥ tena aviśeṣaḥ na asti iti etat ca ayuktam śarīra ādayaḥ upabhoga arthāḥ te bhoga pratibandham kariṣyanti iti anupapannam na ca asti anumānam aśarīrasya ātmanaḥ bhogaḥ kaścid asti iti

iṣṭa adhigama arthā pravṛttiḥ iti ced na aniṣṭa uparama artha tvāt idam anumānam iṣṭa adhigama arthaḥ mokṣa upadeśaḥ pravṛttiḥ ca mumukṣūṇām na ubhayam anarthakam iti etat ca ayuktam aniṣṭa uparama arthaḥ mokṣa upadeśaḥ pravṛttiḥ ca mumukṣūṇām iti na iṣṭam aniṣṭena ananuviddham sambhavati iti iṣṭam api aniṣṭam sampadyate aniṣṭa hānāya ghaṭamānaḥ iṣṭam api jahāti viveka hānasya aśakya tvāt iti

dṛṣṭa atikramaḥ ca deha ādiṣu tulyaḥ yathā dṛṣṭam anityam sukham parityajya nityam sukham kāmayate evam deha indriya buddhīḥ anityāḥ dṛṣṭāḥ atikramya muktasya nityāḥ deha indriya buddhayaḥ kalpayitavyāḥ sādhīyaḥ ca evam muktasya ca aikātmyam kalpitam bhavati iti upapatti viruddham iti ced samānam deha ādīnām nitya tvam pramāṇa viruddham kalpayitum aśakyam iti samānam sukhasya api nitya tvam pramāṇa viruddham kalpayitum aśakyam iti

ātyantike ca saṃsāra duḥkha abhāve sukha vacanāt āgame api sati avirodhaḥ yadi api kaścid āgamaḥ syāt muktasya ātyantikam sukham iti sukha śabdaḥ ātyantike duḥkha abhāve prayuktaḥ iti evam upapadyate dṛṣṭaḥ hi duḥkha abhāve sukha śabda prayogaḥ bahulam lokaḥ iti nitya sukha rāgasya aprahāṇe mokṣa adhigama abhāvaḥ rāgasya bandhana samājñānāt yadi ayam mokṣaḥ nityam sukham abhivyajyate iti nitya sukha rāgeṇa mokṣāya ghaṭamānaḥ na mokṣam adhigacchet na adhigantum arhati iti bandhana samājñātaḥ hi rāgaḥ na ca bandhane sati api kaścid muktaḥ iti upapadyate iti prahīṇa nitya sukha rāgasya apratikūla tvam atha asya nitya sukha rāgaḥ prahīyate tasmin prahīṇe na asya nitya sukha rāgaḥ pratikūlaḥ bhavati yadi evam muktasya nityam sukham bhavati atha api na bhavati na asya ubhayoḥ pakṣayoḥ mokṣa adhigamaḥ vikalpyate iti

sthānavataḥ eva tarhi saṃśayasya lakṣaṇam vācyam iti tat ucyate samāna aneka dharma upapatteḥ vipratipatteḥ upalabdhi anupalabdhi avyavasthātaḥ ca viśeṣa apekṣaḥ vimarśaḥ saṃśayaḥ samāna dharma upapatteḥ viśeṣa apekṣaḥ vimarśaḥ saṃśayaḥ iti sthāṇu puruṣayoḥ samānam dharmam āroha pariṇāhau paśyan pūrva dṛṣṭam ca tayoḥ viśeṣam bubhutsamānaḥ kiṃsvid iti anyataram na avadhārayati tad anavadhāraṇam jñānam saṃśayaḥ samānam anayoḥ dharmam upalabhe viśeṣam anyatarasya na upalabhaḥ iti eṣā buddhiḥ apekṣā saṃśayasya pravṛttikā vartate tena viśeṣa apekṣaḥ vimarśaḥ saṃśayaḥ

aneka dharma upapatteḥ iti samāna jātīyam asamāna jātīyam ca anekam tasya anekasya dharma upapatteḥ viśeṣasya ubayathāḥ dṛṣṭa tvāt samāna jātīyebhyaḥ asamāna jātīyebyaḥ ca arthāḥ viśiṣyante gandhavat tvāt pṛthivī ap ādhibyaḥ viśiṣyate guṇa karmabhyaḥ ca asti ca śabde vibhāga janya tvam viśeṣaḥ tasmin dravyam guṇaḥ karma vā iti sandehaḥ viśeṣasya ubayathāḥ dṛṣṭa tvāt

kim dravyasya sataḥ guṇa karmabhyaḥ viśeṣaḥ āhosvit guṇasya sataḥ iti atha karmaṇaḥ sataḥ iti viśeṣa apekṣā anyatamasya vyavasthāpakam dharma na upalabaḥ iti buddhiḥ iti vipratipatteḥ iti vyāhatam eka artha darśanam vipratipattiḥ vyāghātaḥ virodhaḥ asahabhāvaḥ iti asti ātmā iti ekam darśanam na asti ātmā iti aparam na ca sadbhāva asadbhāvau saha ekatra sambhavataḥ na ca anyatara sādhakaḥ hetuḥ upalabhyate tatra tattva anavadhāraṇam saṃśayaḥ iti

upalabdhi avayava sthātaḥ khalu api sat ca udakam upalabhyate taḍāga ādiṣu marīciṣu ca avidyamānam udakam iti atas kvacid upalabhyamāne tattva vyavasthāpakasya pramāṇasya anupalabdheḥ kim sat upalabhyate atha asat iti saṃśayaḥ bhavati anupalabdhi avyavasthātaḥ sat ca na upalabyate mūlakīlaka udaka ādi asat ca anutpannam niruddham vā tatas kvacid anupalabhyamāne saṃśayaḥ kim san na upalabyate uta asat iti saṃśayaḥ bhavati viśeṣa apekṣā pūrvavat pūrvaḥ samānaḥ anekaḥ ca dharmaḥ jñeya sthaḥ upalabdhi anupalabdhī punar jñātṛ sthe etāvatā viśeṣeṇa punarvacanam samāna dharma adhigamāt samāna dharma upapatteḥ viśeṣa smṛti apekṣaḥ vimarśaḥ iti

sthānavatām lakṣaṇam iti samānam yam artham adhikṛtya pravartate tat prayojanam yam artham āptavyam hātavyam vā vyavasāya tad āpti hāna upāyam anutiṣṭhati prayojanam tat veditavyam pravṛtti hetu tvāt imam artham āpsyāmi hāsyāmi vā iti vyavasāyaḥ arthasya adhikāraḥ evam vyavasīyamānaḥ arthaḥ adhikriyate iti

laukika parīkṣakāṇām yasmin arthe buddhi sāmyam sa dṛṣṭa ānataḥ loka sāmānyam anatītāḥ laukikāḥ naisargikam vainayikam buddhi atiśayam aprāptāḥ tad viparītāḥ parīkṣakāḥ tarkeṇa pramāṇaiḥ artham parīkṣitum arhanti iti yathā yam artham laukikāḥ budhyante tathā parīkṣakāḥ api saḥ arthaḥ dṛṣṭāntaḥ dṛṣṭānta virodhena hi pratipakṣāḥ pratiṣeddhavyāḥ bhavanti iti dṛṣṭānta samādhinā ca sva pakṣāḥ sthāpanīyāḥ bhavanti iti avayaveṣu ca udāharaṇāya kalpate iti

atha siddhāntaḥ idam itthambhūtan ca iti abhyanujñāyamānam artha jātam siddham siddhasya saṃsthitiḥ siddhāntaḥ saṃsthitiḥ ittham bhāva vyavasthā dharma niyamaḥ sa khalu ayam tantra adhikaraṇa abhyupagama saṃsthitiḥ siddhāntaḥ tantra artha saṃsthitiḥ tantra saṃsthitiḥ tantram itaretara abhisambaddhasya artha samūhasya upadeśaḥ śāstram adhikaraṇa anuṣakta artha saṃsthitiḥ adhikaraṇa saṃsthitiḥ abhyupagama saṃsthitiḥ anavadhārita artha parigrahaḥ tad viśeṣa parīkṣaṇāya abhyupagama siddhāntaḥ
tantra bhedāt tu khalu sa caturvidhaḥ sarva tantra pratitantra adhikaraṇa abhyupagama saṃsthiti artha antara bhāvāt tatra etāḥ catasraḥ saṃsthitayaḥ artha antara bhūtāḥ
tāsām sarva tantra aviruddhaḥ tantre adhikṛtaḥ arthaḥ sarva tantra siddhāntaḥ yathā ghrāṇa ādīnīnindriyāṇi gandha ādayaḥ indriya arhāḥ pṛthivī ādīni bhūtāni pramāṇaiḥ arthasya grahaṇam iti

samāna tantra siddhaḥ pratantra asiddhaḥ prati tantra siddhāntaḥ yathā na asataḥ ātma lābhaḥ na sataḥ ātma hānam niratiśayāḥ cetanāḥ deha indriya manaḥsu viṣayeṣu tad tad kāraṇeṣu ca viśeṣaḥ iti sāṅkhyānām puruṣa karma ādi nimittaḥ bhūta sargaḥ karma hetavaḥ doṣāḥ pravṛttiḥ ca sva guṇa viśiṣṭāḥ cetanāḥ asat utpadyate utpannam nirudhyate iti yogānām

yat siddhau anya prakaraṇa siddhiḥ saḥ adhikaraṇa siddhāntaḥ yasya arthasya siddhau anye arthāḥ anuṣajyante na taiḥ vinā saḥ arthaḥ sidhyati te arthāḥ yat adhiṣṭhānāḥ saḥ adhikaraṇa siddhāntaḥ yathā deha indriya vyatiriktaḥ jñātā darśana sparśanābhyām eka artha grahaṇāt iti atra anuṣaṅgiṇaḥ arthāḥ indriya nānā tvam niyata viṣayāṇi indriyāṇi sva viṣaya grahaṇa liṅgāni jñātuḥ jñāna sādhanāni gandha ādi guṇa vyatiriktam dravyam guṇa adhikaraṇam aniyata viṣayāḥ cetanāḥ iti pūrva artha siddhau ete arhāḥ sidhyanti na taiḥ vinā saḥ arthaḥ sambhavati iti

aparīkṣita abhyupagamāt tad viśeṣa parīkṣaṇam abhyupagama siddhāntaḥ yatra kiñcid artha jātam aparīkṣitam abhyupagamyate astu dravyam śabdaḥ sa tu nityaḥ atha anityaḥ iti dravyasya sataḥ nitya tā anitya tā vā tad viśeṣaḥ parīkṣyate saḥ abhyupagama siddhāntaḥ sva buddhi atiśaya cikhyā apayiṣayā para buddhi avajñānāt ca pravartate iti

atha avayavāḥ pratijñā hetu udāharaṇa upanaya nigamanāni avayavāḥ daśa avayavān eke naiyāyikāḥ vākye sañcakṣate jijñāsā saṃśayaḥ śakya prāptiḥ prayojanam saṃśaya vyudāsaḥ iti te kasmāt na ucyantaḥ iti tatra apratīyamāne arthe pratyaya arthasya pravartikā jijñāsā apratīyamānam artham kasmāt jijñāsate tam tattvataḥ jñātam hāsyāmi vā upāda āsyaḥ upekṣiṣye vā iti tāḥ etāḥ hāna upādāna upekṣā buddhayaḥ tattva jñānasya arthaḥ tad arthaḥ ayam jijñāsate sā khalu ayam asādhanam arthasya iti jijñāsā adhiṣṭhānam saṃśayaḥ ca vyāhata dharma upasaṅghātāt tattva jñāne pratyāsannaḥ vyāhatayoḥ hi dharmayoḥ anyatara tattvam bhavitum arhati iti sa pṛthak upadiṣṭaḥ api asādhanam arthasya iti pramātuḥ pramāṇāni prameya adhigama arthāni sā śakya prāptiḥ na sādhakasya vākyasya bhāgena yujyate pratijña ādi vat iti prayojanam tattva avadhāraṇam artha sādhakasya vākyasya phalam na eka deśaḥ iti saṃśaya vyudāsaḥ pratipakṣa upavarṇanam tat pratiṣedhena tattva jñāna abhyanujñāna artham na tu ayam sādhaka vākya eka deśaḥ iti prakaraṇe tu jijñāsā ādayaḥ samarthāḥ avadhāraṇīya artha upakārāt tattva artha sādhaka bhāvāt tu pratijña ādayaḥ sādhaka vākyasya bhāgāḥ eka deśāḥ avayavāḥ iti
teṣām tu yathā vibhaktānām sādhya nirdeśaḥ pratijñā prajñāpanīyena dharmeṇa dharmiṇaḥ viśiṣṭasya parigraha vacanam pratijñā sādhya nirdeśaḥ anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti

udāharaṇa sādharmyāt sādhya sādhanam hetuḥ udāharaṇena sāmānyāt sādhyasya dharmasya sādhanam prajñāpanam hetuḥ sādhye pratisandhāya dharmam udāharaṇe ca pratisandhāya tasya sādhana tā vacanam hetuḥ utpatti dharmaka tvāt iti utpatti dharmakam anityam dṛṣṭam iti

kim etāvat dhetu lakṣaṇam iti na iti ucyate kim tarhi tathā vaidharmyāt udāharaṇa vaidharmyāt ca sādhya sādhanam hetuḥ katham anityaḥ śabdaḥ utpatti dharmaka tvāt anutpatti dharmakam nityam yathā ātmā ādi dravyam iti

sādhya sādharmyāt tad dharma bhāvī dṛṣṭāntaḥ udāharaṇam sādhyena sādharmyam samāna dharma tā sādhya sādharmyāt kāraṇāt tad dharma bhāvī dṛṣṭāntaḥ iti tasya dharmaḥ tad dharmaḥ tasya sādhyasya sādhyam ca dvividham dharmi viśiṣṭaḥ vā dharmaḥ śabdasya anitya tvam dharma viśiṣṭaḥ vā dharmī anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti iha uttaram tad grahaṇena gṛhyate iti kasmāt pṛthak dharma vacanāt tasya dharmaḥ tad dharmaḥ tasya bhāvaḥ tad dharma bhāvaḥ sa yasmin dṛṣṭānte vartate sa dṛṣṭāntaḥ sādhya sādharmyāt utpatti dharmaka tvat tad dharma bhāvī bhavati sa ca udāharaṇam iṣyate tatra yat utpadyate tat utpatti dharmakam tat ca bhūtvā na bhavati ātmānam jahāti nirudhyate iti anityam evam utpatti dharmaka tvam sādhanam anitya tvam sādhyam saḥ ayam ekasmin dvayoḥ dharmayoḥ sādhya sādhana bhāvaḥ sādharmyāt vyavasthitaḥ upalabhyate tam dṛṣṭāntaḥ upalabhamānaḥ śabde api anuminoti śabdaḥ api utpatti dharmaka tvāt anityaḥ sthālī ādi vat iti udāhriyate anena dharmayoḥ sādhya sādhana bhāvaḥ iti udāharaṇam

tad viparyayāt vā viparītam dṛṣṭāntaḥ udāharaṇam iti prakṛtam sādhya vaidharmyāt atad dharma bhāvī dṛṣṭāntaḥ udāharaṇam iti anityaḥ śabdaḥ utpatti dharmaka tvāt anutpatti dharmakam nityam ātma ādi saḥ ayam ātma ādiḥ dṛṣṭāntaḥ sādhya vaidharmyāt anutpatti dharmaka tvāt atad dharma bhāvī yaḥ asau sādhyasya dharmaḥ anitya tvam sa tasmin na bhavati iti

atra ātma ādau dṛṣṭāntaḥ utpatti dharmaka tvasya abhāvāt anitya tvam na bhavati iti upalabhamānaḥ śabde viparyayam anuminoti utpatti dharmaka tvasya bhāvāt anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti sādharmya uktasya hetoḥ sādhya sādharmyāt tad dharma bhāvī dṛṣṭāntaḥ udāharaṇam vaidharmya uktasya hetoḥ sādhya vaidharmyāt atad dharma bhāvī dṛṣṭāntaḥ udāharaṇam

pūrvasmin dṛṣṭānte yau tau dharmau sādhya sādhana bhūtau paśyati sādhye api tayoḥ sādhya sādhana bhāvam anuminoti uttarasmin dṛṣṭānte tayoḥ dharmayoḥ ekasya abhāvāt itarasya abhāvam paśyati tayoḥ ekasya bhāvāt itarasya bhāvam sādhye anuminoti iti tat etat dhetuvā ābhāseṣu na sambhavati iti ahetavaḥ hetvābhāsāḥ tat idam hetu udāharaṇayoḥ sāmarthyam parama sūkṣmam duḥkha bodham paṇḍita rūpa vedanīyam iti

udāharaṇa apekṣaḥ tathā iti upasaṃhāraḥ na tathā iti vā sādhyasya upanayaḥ udāharaṇa apekṣaḥ udāharaṇa tantraḥ udāharaṇa vaśaḥ vaśaḥ sāmarthyam sādhya sādharmya yukte udāharaṇe sthālī ādi dravyam utpatti dharmakam anityam dṛṣṭam tathā śabdaḥ utpatti dharmakaḥ iti sādhyasya śabdasya utpatti dharmaka tvam upasaṃhriyate

sādhya vaidharmya yukte punar udāharaṇaḥ ātma ādi dravyam anutpatti dharmakam nityam dṛṣṭam na ca tathā śabdaḥ iti anutpatti dharmaka tvasya upasaṃhāra ra pratiṣedhena utpatti dharmaka tvam upasaṃhriyate tat idam upasaṃhāra dvaitam udāharaṇa dvaitāt bhavati upasaṃhriyate anena iti ca upasaṃhāraḥ veditavyaḥ iti

dvividhasya punar hetoḥ dvividhasya ca udāharaṇasya upasaṃhāra dvaite ca samānam hetu apadeśāt pratijñāyāḥ punarvacanam nigamanam sādharmya ukte vā vaidharmya ukte vā yathā udāharaṇam upasaṃhriyate tasmāt utpatti dharmaka tvāt anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti nigamanam nigamyante anena iti pratijñā hetu udāharaṇa upanayā ekatra iti nigamanam nigamyante samarthyante sambadhyante tatra sādharma ukte tāvat dhetau vākyam anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti pratijñā utpatti dharmaka tvāt iti hetuḥ utpatti dharmakam sthālī ādi dravyam anityam iti udāharaṇam tathā ca utpatti dharmakaḥ śabdaḥ iti upanayaḥ tasmāt utpatti dharmaka tvāt anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti nigamanam vaidharmya ukte api anityaḥ śabdaḥ utpatti dharmaka tvāt anutpatti dharmakam ātma ādi dravyam nityam dṛṣṭam na ca tathā anutpatti dharmakaḥ śabdaḥ tasmāt utpatti dharmaka tvāt anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti

avayava samudāye ca vākye sambhūya itara itara abhisambandhāt pramāṇāni arthān sādhayanti iti sambhavaḥ tāvat śabda viṣayā pratijñā āpta upadeśasya pratyakṣa anumānābhyām pratisandhānāt anṛṣeḥ ca svātantrya anupapatteḥ anumānam hetuḥ udāharaṇe sādṛśya pratipatteḥ tat ca udāharaṇa bhāṣye vyākhyātam pratyakṣa viṣayam udāharaṇam dṛṣṭena adṛṣṭa siddheḥ upamānam upanayaḥ tathā iti upasaṃhārāt na ca tathā iti vā upamāna dharma pratiṣedehe viparīta dharma upasaṃhāra siddheḥ sarveṣām eka artha pratipattau sāmarthya pradarśanam nigamanam iti

itaretara abhisambandhaḥ api asatyām pratijñāyām anāśrayāḥ hetu ādayaḥ na pravarteran asati hetau kasya sādhana bhāvaḥ pradarśyeta udāharaṇe sādhye ca kasya upasaṃhāraḥ syāt kasya ca apadeśāt pratijñāyāḥ punarvacanam nigamanam syāt iti asati udāharaṇe kena sādharmyam vaidharmyam vā sādhya sādhanam upādīyeta kasya vā sādharmya vaśāt upasaṃhāraḥ pravarteta upanayam ca antareṇa sādhye anupasaṃhṛtaḥ sādhakaḥ dharmaḥ na artham sādhayet nigamana abhāve ca anabhiyukta sambandhānām pratijña ādīnām eka arthena pravartanam tathā iti pratipādanam kasya iti

atha avayava arthaḥ sādhyasya dharmasya dharmiṇā sambandha upādānam pratijñā arthaḥ udāharaṇena samānasya viparītasya vā sādhyasya dharmasya sādhaka bhāva vacanam hetu arthaḥ dharmayoḥ sādhya sādhana bhāva pradarśanam ekatra udāharaṇa arthaḥ sādhana bhūtasya dharmasya sādhyena dharmeṇa sāmānādhikaraṇya upapādanam upanaya arthaḥ udāharaṇa sthayoḥ dharmayoḥ sādhya sādhana bhāva upapattau sādhye viparīta prasaṅga pratiṣedha artham nigamanam na ca etasyām hetu udāharaṇa pariśuddhau satyām sādharmya vaidharmyābhyām pratyavasthānasya vikalyāt jāti nigraha sthāna bahu tvam prakramate avyavasthāpya khalu dharmayoḥ sādhya sādhana bhāvam udāharaṇe jāti vādī pratyavatiṣṭhate vyavasthite tu khalu dharmayoḥ sādhya sādhana bhāve dṛṣṭānta sthe gṛhyamāṇe sādhana bhūtasya dharmasya hetu tvena upādānam na sādharmya mātrasya na vaidharmya mātrasya vā iti

atas ūrdhvam tarkaḥ lakṣaṇīyaḥ iti atha idam ucyate avijñāta tattve arthe kāraṇa upapattitaḥ tattva jñāna artham ūhaḥ tarkaḥ avijñāyamāna tattve arthe jijñāsā tāvat jāyate jānīya imam artham iti atha jijñāsitasya vastunaḥ vyāhatau dharmau vibhāgena vimṛśati kiṃsvid ittham āhosvit na ittham iti vimṛśyamānayoḥ dharmayoḥ ekam kāraṇa upapattyā anujānāti sambhavati asmin kāraṇam pramāṇam hetuḥ iti kāraṇa upapattyā syāt evam etat na itarat iti

tatra nidarśanam yaḥ ayam jñātā jñātavyam artham jānīte tam tattvataḥ jānīya iti jijñāsā sa kim utpatti dharmakaḥ atha anutpatti dharmakaḥ iti vimarśaḥ vimṛśyamāne avijñāta tat te arthe yasya dharmasya abhyanujñā kāraṇam upapadyate tam anujānāti yadi ayam anutpatti dharmakaḥ tatas sva kṛtasya karmaṇaḥ phalam anubhavati jñātā duḥkha janma pravṛtti doṣa mithyā jñānānām uttaram uttaram pūrvasya pūrvasya kāraṇam uttarottara apāye tad anantara apāyāt apavargaḥ iti syātām saṃsāra apavargau

utpatti dharmake jñātari punar na syātām utpannaḥ khalu jñātā deha indriya buddhi vedanābhiḥ sambadhyate iti na asya idam sva kṛtasya karmaṇaḥ phalam utpannaḥ ca bhūtvā na bhavati iti tasya avidyamānasya niruddhasya vā sva kṛta karmaṇaḥ phala upabhogaḥ na asti tat evam ekasya aneka śarīra yogaḥ śarīra viyogaḥ ca atyantam na syāt iti yatra kāraṇam anupapadyamānam paśyati tat na anujānāti saḥ ayam evaṃlakṣaṇaḥ ūhaḥ tarkaḥ iti ucyate

katham punar ayam tattva jñāna arthaḥ na tattva jñānam eva iti anavadhāraṇāt anujānāti ayam ekataram dharmam kāraṇa upapattyā na tu avadhārayati na vyavasyati na niścinoti evam eva idam iti katham tattva jñāna arthaḥ iti tattva jñāna viṣaya abhyanujñā lakṣaṇa anugraha bhāvitāt prasannāt anatara pramāṇa sāmarthyāt tattva jñānam utpadyate iti evam tattva jñāna arthaḥ iti saḥ ayam tarkaḥ pramāṇāni pratisanda dhānaḥ pramāṇa abhyanujñānāt pramāṇa sahitaḥ vāde apadiṣṭaḥ iti avijñāta tattvam anujānāti yathā saḥ arhaḥ bhavati tasya tathā abhāvaḥ tattvam aviparyayaḥ yāthātathyam

etasmin ca tarka viṣaye vimṛśya pakṣa pratipakṣābhyām artha avadhāraṇam nirṇayaḥ sthāpanā sādhanam pratiṣedhaḥ upālambhaḥ tau sādhana upālambhau pakṣa pratipakṣa āśrayau vyatiṣaktau anubandhena pravartamānau pakṣa pratipakṣau iti ucyete tayoḥ anyatarasya nivṛttiḥ ekatarasya avasthānam avaśyambhāvi yasya avasthānam tasya artha avadhāraṇam nirṇayaḥ na idam pakṣa pratipakṣābhyām artha avadhāraṇam sambhavati iti ekaḥ hi pratijñātam artham hetutaḥ sthāpayati pratiṣiddham ca uddharati dvitīyasya dvitīyena sthāpanā hetuḥ pratiṣidhyate tasya eva pratiṣedha hetuḥ ca uddhriyate sa nivartate tasya nivṛttau yaḥ avatiṣṭhate tena artha avadhāraṇam nirṇayaḥ

ubhābhyām eva artha avadhāraṇam iti āha kayā yuktyā ekasya sambhavaḥ dvitīyasya asambhavaḥ tau etau sambhava asambhavau vimarśam saha nivarttayataḥ ubhaya sambhave ubhayā sambhave vā anivṛttaḥ vimarśaḥ iti vimṛśya iti vimarśam kṛtvā saḥ ayam vimarśaḥ pakṣa pratipakṣau avadyotya nyāyam pravartayati iti upādīyate iti etat ca viruddhayoḥ eka dharmi sthayoḥ boddhavyam yatra tu dharmi sāmānya gatau viruddhau dharmau hetutaḥ sambhavataḥ tatra samuccayaḥ hetutaḥ arthasya tathā abhāva upapatteḥ yathā kriyāvat dravyam iti lakṣaṇa vacane yasya dravyasya kriyā yogaḥ hetutaḥ sambhavati tat kriyāvat yasya na sambhavati tat akriyam iti eka dharmi sthayoḥ ca viruddhayoḥ dharmayoḥ ayugapad bhāvinoḥ kāla vikalpaḥ yathā tat eva dravyam kriyā yuktam kriyāvat anutpanna uparata kriyam punar akriyam iti na ca ayam nirṇaye niyamaḥ vimṛśya eva pakṣa pratipakṣābhyām artha avadhāraṇam nirṇayaḥ iti kim tu indriya artha sannikarṣa utpanna pratyakṣe artha avadhāraṇam nirṇayaḥ iti parīkṣā viṣaye tu vimṛśya pakṣa pratipakṣābhyām artha avadhāraṇam nirṇayaḥ vāde śāstre ca vimarśa varjam

tisraḥ kathāḥ bhavanti vādaḥ jalpaḥ vitaṇḍā ca iti tāsām pramāṇa tarka sādhana upālambhaḥ siddhānta aviruddhaḥ pañca avayava upapannaḥ pakṣa pratipakṣa parigrahaḥ vādaḥ eka adhikaraṇa sthau viruddhau dharmau pakṣa pratipakṣau pratyanīka bhāvāt asti ātmā na asti ātmā iti nānā adhikaraṇa sthau viruddhau na pakṣa pratipakṣau yathā nityaḥ ātmā anityā buddhiḥ iti parigrahaḥ abhyupagama vyavasthā saḥ ayam pakṣa pratipakṣa parigrahaḥ vādaḥ tasya viśeṣanam pramāṇa tarka sādhana upālambhaḥ pramāṇaiḥ tarkeṇa ca sādhanam upālambhaḥ ca asmin kriyate iti sādhanam sthāpanā upālambhaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ tau sādhana upālambhau ubhayoḥ api pakṣayoḥ vyatiṣaktau anubaddhau ca yāvat ekaḥ nivṛttaḥ ekataraḥ vyavasthitaḥ iti nivṛttasya upālambhaḥ vyavasthitasya sādhanam iti

jalpe nigraha sthāna viniyogāt vāde tad pratiṣedhaḥ pratiṣedhe kasyacid abhyanujñāna artham siddhānta aviruddhaḥ iti vacanam siddhāntam abhyupetya tad virodhī viruddhaḥ iti hetvābhāsasya nigraha sthānasya abhyanujñā vāde pañca avayava upapanne iti hīnam anyatamena api avayavena nyūnam hetu udāharaṇa adhikam adhikam iti ca etayoḥ abhyanujñāna artham iti avayaveṣu pramāna tarka antarbhāve pṛthak pramāṇa tarka grahaṇam sādhana upālambha vyatiṣaṅga jñāpana artham anyathā ubhau api pakṣau sthāpanā pravṛttau vādaḥ iti syāt

antareṇa api ca avayava sambandham pramāṇāni artham sādhayanti iti dṛṣṭam tena api kalpena sādhana upālambhau vāde bhavataḥ iti jñāpayati chala ja ati nigraha sthāna sādhana upālambhaḥ jalpaḥ iti vacanāt vinigrahaḥ jalpaḥ iti mā vijñāyi chala ja ati nigraha sthāna sādhana upālambhaḥ eva jalpaḥ pramāṇa tarka sādhana upālambhaḥ vād eva iti mā vijñāyi iti evam artham pṛthak pramāna tarka grahaṇam iti

yathā ukta upapannaḥ chala ja ati nigraha sthāna sādhana upālambhaḥ jalpaḥ yathā ukta upapannaḥ iti pramāṇa tarka sādhana upālambhaḥ siddhānta aviruddhaḥ pañca avayava upapannaḥ pakṣa pratipakṣa parigrahaḥ chala ja ati nigraha sthāna sādhana upālambhaḥ iti chala ja ati nigraha sthānaiḥ sādhanam upālambhaḥ ca asmin kriyate iti evaṃviśeṣaṇaḥ jalpaḥ

na khalu vai chala ja ati nigraha sthānaiḥ sādhanam kasyacid arthasya sambhavati pratiṣedha artha tā eva eṣām sāmānya lakṣaṇe viśeṣa lakṣaṇe ca śrūyate vacana vighātaḥ artha vikalpa upapattyā chalam iti sādharmya vaidharmyābhyām pratyavasthānam jātiḥ vipratipattiḥ apratipattiḥ ca nigraha sthānam iti viśeṣa lakṣaṇeṣu api yathāsvam iti na ca etat vijānīyāt pratiṣedha artha tayā eva artham sādhayanti iti chala ja ati nigraha sthāna upālambhaḥ jalpaḥ iti evam api ucyamāne vijñāyate etat iti

pramāṇaiḥ sādhana upālambhayoḥ chala jāti nigraha sthānānām aṅga bhāvaḥ sva pakṣa rakṣaṇa artha tvāt na svatantrāṇām sādhana bhāvaḥ yat tat pramāṇaiḥ arthasya sādhanam tatra chala jāti nigraha sthānānām aṅga bhāvaḥ rakṣaṇa artha tvāt tāni hi prayujyamānāni para pakṣa vighātena sva pakṣam rakṣanti tathā ca uktam tattva adhyavasāya saṃrakṣaṇātham jalpa vitaṇḍe bīja praroha saṃrakṣaṇa artham kaṇṭaka śākhā āvaraṇa vat iti yaḥ ca asau pramāṇaiḥ pratipakṣasya upālambhaḥ tasya ca etāni prayujyamānāni pratiṣedha vighātāt saha kārīṇi bhavanti tat evam aṅgī bhūtanām chala ādīnām upādānam jalpe na svatantrāṇām sādhana bhāvaḥ upālambhe tu svātantryam api asti iti

sa pratipakṣa sthāpanā hīnaḥ vitaṇḍā sa jalpaḥ vitaṇḍā bhavati kiṃviśeṣaṇaḥ pratipakṣa sthāpanayā hīnaḥ yau tau samāna adhikaraṇau viruddhau dharmau pakṣau iti uktam tayoḥ ekataram vaitaṇḍikaḥ na sthāpayati iti prapakṣa pratiṣedhena eva pravartate iti astu tarhi sa pratipakṣa hīnaḥ vitaṇḍā yat vai khalu tat para pratiṣedha lakṣaṇam vākyam sa vaitaṇḍikasya pakṣaḥ na tu asau sādhyam kañcid artham pratijñāya sthāpayati iti tasmāt yathānyāsam eva astu iti
hetu lakṣaṇa abhāvāt ahetavaḥ hetu sāmānyāt dhetu vat ābhāsamānāḥ te ime savyabhicāra viruddha prakaraṇa sama sādhya sama kāla atītāḥ hetvābhāsāḥ teṣām

anaikāntikaḥ savyabhicāraḥ vyabhicāraḥ ekatra avyavasthitiḥ saha vyabhicāreṇa vartate iti svayabhicāraḥ nidarśanam nityaḥ śabdaḥ asparśa tvāt sparśavān kumbhaḥ anityaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ na ca tathā sparśavān śabdaḥ tasmāt asparśa tvāt nityaḥ śabdaḥ iti dṛṣṭānte sparśavat tvam anitya tvam ca dharmau na sādhya sādhana bhūtau gṛhyete sparśavān ca aṇuḥ nityaḥ ca iti ātma ādau ca dṛṣṭānte udāharaṇa sādharmyāt sādhya sādhanam hetuḥ iti asparśa tvāt iti hetuḥ nitya tvam vyabhicarati asparśā buddhiḥ anityā ca iti evam dvividhe api dṛṣṭānte vyabhicārāt sādhya sādhana bhāvaḥ na asti iti lakṣaṇa abhāvāt ahetuḥ iti nitya tvam api ekaḥ antaḥ anitya tvam api ekaḥ ntaḥ ekasmin ante vidyate iti aikāntikaḥ viparyayāt anaikāntikaḥ ubhaya anta vyāpaka tvāt iti

siddhāntam abhyupetya tad virodhī viruddhaḥ tam viruṇaddhi iti tad virodhi abhyupetam siddhāntam vyāhanti iti yathā saḥ ayam vikāraḥ vyakteḥ apaiti nitya tva pratiṣedhāt na nityaḥ vikāraḥ upapadyata apetaḥ api vikāraḥ asti vināśa pratiṣedhāt saḥ ayam nitya tva pratiṣedhāt iti hetuḥ vyakteḥ apetaḥ api vikāraḥ asti iti anena sva siddhāntena virudhyate katham vyaktiḥ ātma lābhaḥ apāyaḥ pracyutiḥ yadi ātma lābhāt pracyutaḥ vikāraḥ asti nitya tva pratiṣedhaḥ na upapadyate yat vyakteḥ apetasya api vikārasya astitvam tat khalu nitya tvam iti nityatvapratiṣedhaḥ nāma vikārasya ātma lābhāt pracyuteḥ upapattiḥ yat ātma lābhāt pracyavate tat anityam dṛṣṭam yat asti na tat ātma lābhāt pracyavate astitvam ca ātma lābhāt pracyutiḥ iti ca viruddhau etau dharmau na saha sambhavataḥ iti saḥ ayam hetuḥ yam siddhāntam āśritya pravartate tam eva vyāhanti iti

yasmāt prakaraṇa cintā sa nirṇaya artham apadiṣṭaḥ prakaraṇa samaḥ vimarśa adhiṣṭhānau pakṣa pratipakṣau ubhau anavasitau prakaraṇam tasya cintā vimarśāt prabhṛti prāk nirṇayāt yat samīkṣaṇam sā jijñāsā yad kṛtā sa nirṇaya artham prayuktaḥ ubhaya pakṣa sāmyāt prakaraṇam anativartamānaḥ prakaraṇa samaḥ nirṇayāya na prakalpate

prajñāpanam tu anityaḥ śabdaḥ nitya dharma anupalabdheḥ iti anupalabhyamānan iti adharmakam nityam dṛṣṭam sthālī ādi nityaḥ śabdaḥ vā anitya dharma anupalabdheḥ anupalabhyamāna anitya dharmakam nityam dṛṣṭam ākāśa ādi yatra samānaḥ dharmaḥ saṃśaya kāraṇam hetu tvena upādīyate sa saṃśaya samaḥ savyabhicāraḥ eva

yā tu vimarśasya viśeṣa apekṣitāḥ ubhaya pakṣa viśeṣa anupalabdhiḥ ca sā prakaraṇam pravartayati yathā śabde nitya dharmaḥ na upalabhyate evam anitya dharmaḥ api sā iyam ubhaya pakṣa viśeṣa anupalabdhiḥ prakaraṇa cintām pravartayati katham viparyaye hi prakaraṇa nivṛtteḥ yadi nitya dharmaḥ śabde gṛhyeta na syāt prakaraṇam yadi na syāt prakaraṇam yadi vā anitya dharmaḥ gṛhyeta evam api nivarteta prakaraṇam saḥ ayam hetuḥ ubhau pakṣau pravartayan anyatarasya nirṇayāya na prakalpate

sādhya aviśiṣṭaḥ sādhya tvāt sādhya samaḥ dravyam chāyā iti sādhyam gatimat tvāt iti hetuḥ sādhyena aviśiṣṭaḥ sādhanīya tvāt sādhya samaḥ ayam api asiddha tvāt sādhya vat prajñāpayitavyaḥ sādhyam tāvat etat kim puruṣa vat śāyā api gacchati āhosvit āvaraka dravye saṃsarpati āvaraṇa santānāt asannidhi santānaḥ ayam tejasaḥ gṛhyate iti sarpatā khalu dravyeṇa yaḥ yaḥ tejaḥ bhāgaḥ āvriyate tasya tasya asannidhiḥ eva avicchinnaḥ gṛhyate iti āvaraṇam tu prāpti pratiṣedhaḥ

kāla atyaya apadiṣṭaḥ kāla atītaḥ kāla atyayena yuktaḥ yasya artha eka deśaḥ apadiśyamānasya sa kāla atyaya apadiṣṭaḥ kāla atītaḥ iti ucyate nidarśanam nityaḥ śabdaḥ saṃyoga vyaṅgya tvāt rūpavat prāk ūrdhvam ca vyakteḥ avasthitam rūpam pradīpa ghaṭa saṃyogena vyajyate tathā ca śabdaḥ api avasthitaḥ bherī daṇḍa saṃyogena vyajyate dāruparaśu saṃyogena vā tasmāt samyoga vyaṅgya tvāt nityaḥ śabdaḥ iti ayam ahetuḥ kāla atyaya apadeśāt vyañjakasya saṃyogasya kālam na vyaṅgyasya rūpasya vyaktiḥ atyeti sati pradīpa saṃyoge rūpasya grahaṇam bhavati na nivṛtte saṃyoge rūpam gṛhyate nivṛtte dāruparaśu saṃyoge dūra sthena śabdaḥ śrūyate vibhāga kāle sā iyam śabdasya vyaktiḥ saṃyoga kālam atyeti iti na saṃyoga nirmitā bhavati kasmāt kāraṇa abhāvāt dhi kārya abhāvaḥ iti evam udāharaṇa sādharmi asya abhāvāt asādhanam ayam hetuḥ hetvābhāse iti

avayava viparyāsa vacanam tu na sūtra arthaḥ kasmāt yasya yena artha sambandhaḥ dūra sthasya api tasya saḥ arthataḥ hi asamarthānām ānantaryam akāraṇam iti etad vacanāt viparyāsena uktaḥ hetuḥ udāharaṇa sādharmyāt tathā vaidharmyāt sādhya sādhanam hetu lakṣaṇam na jahāti ajahat hetu lakṣaṇam na hetvābhāsaḥ bhavati iti avayava viparyāsa vacanam aprāpta kālam iti nigraha sthānam uktam tat eva idam punar ucyate iti atas tat na sūtra arthaḥ
atha chalam vacana vighātaḥ artha vikalpa upapattyā chalam na sāmānya lakṣaṇe chalam śakyam udāhartum vibhāge tu udāharaṇāni

vibhāgaḥ ca tat trividham vākchalam sāmānyacchalam upacāracchalam ca iti teṣām aviśeṣa abhihite arthe vaktuḥ abhiprāyāt artha antara kalpanā vākchalam nava kambalaḥ ayam māṇavakaḥ iti prayogaḥ atra navaḥ kambalaḥ asya iti vaktuḥ abhiprāyaḥ vigrahe tu viśeṣaḥ na samāse tatra ayam chala vādī vaktuḥ abhiprāyāt avivakṣitam anyam artham nava kambalā asya iti tāvat abhihitam bhavatā iti kalpayati kalpayitvā ca asambhavena pratiṣedhati ekaḥ asya kambalaḥ kutas nava kambalāḥ iti

tat idam sāmānya śabde vāci chalam vākchalam iti asya pratyavasthānam sāmānya śabdasya aneka artha tve anyatara abhidhāna kalpanāyām viśeṣa vacanam nava kambalaḥ iti aneka artha abhidhānam navaḥ kambalaḥ asya iti nava kambalā asya iti etasmin prayukte yā iyam kalpanā nava kambalā asya iti etat bhavatā abhihitam tat ca na sambhavati iti etasyām anyatara abhidhāna kalpanāyām viśeṣaḥ vaktavyaḥ yasmāt viśeṣaḥ artha viśeṣeṣu vijñāyate ayam arthaḥ anena abhihitaḥ iti sa ca viśeṣaḥ na asti tasmāt mithyā abhiyoga mātram etat iti prasiddhaḥ ca loke śabda artha sambandhaḥ abhidhāna abhidheya niyama niyogaḥ asya abhidhānasya ayam arthaḥ abhidheyaḥ iti samānaḥ sāmānya śabdasya viśeṣaḥ viśiṣṭa śabdasya prayukta pūrvāḥ ca ime śabdāḥ arthe prayujyante na aprayukta pūrvāḥ prayogaḥ ca artha sampratyaya arthaḥ artha pratyayāt ca vyavahāraḥ iti

tatra evam artha gati arthe śabda prayoge sāmarthyāt sāmānya śabdasya prayoga niyamaḥ ajām grāmam naya sarpiḥ āhāra brāhmaṇam bhojaya iti sāmānya śabdāḥ santaḥ artha avayaveṣu prayujyante sāma arthyat yatra artha kriyā codanā sambhavati tatra pravartante na artha sāmānye kriyā deśanā sambhavāt evam ayam sāmānya śabdaḥ nava kambalaḥ iti yaḥ arthaḥ sambhavati navaḥ kambalaḥ asya iti tatra pravartate yaḥ tu na sambhavait nava kambalāḥ asya iti tatra na pravartate saḥ ayam anupapadyamāna artha kalpanayā para vākya upālambhaḥ na kalpate iti

sambhavataḥ arthasya ati sāmānya yogāt asambhūta artha kalpanā sāmānyacchalam aho khalu asau brāhmaṇaḥ vidyā caraṇa sampannaḥ iti ukte kaścid āha sambhavati brāhmaṇe vidyā caraṇa sampad iti asya vacanasya vighātaḥ artha vikalpa upapattyā sambhūta artha kalpanayā kriyate yadi brāhmaṇe vidyā caraṇa sampad sambhavati vrātye api sambhavet vrātyaḥ api brāhmaṇaḥ saḥ api astu vidyā caraṇa sampannaḥ iti yat vivakṣitam artham āpnoti ca atyeti ca tat atisāmānyam yathā brāhmaṇa tvam vidyā caraṇa sampadam kvacid āpnoti kvacid atyeti sāmānya nimittam chalam sāmānyacchalam iti

asya ca pratyavasthānam avivakṣita hetukasya viṣaya anuvādaḥ praśaṃsā artha tvāt vākyasya tat atra asambhūta artha kalpanā anupapattiḥ yathā sambhavanti asmin kṣetre śālayaḥ iti anirākṛtam avivakṣitam ca bīja janma pravṛtti viṣayaḥ tu kṣetram praśasyate saḥ ayam kṣetra anuvādaḥ na asmin śālayaḥ vidhīyante iti bījāt tu śāli nirvṛttiḥ satī na vivakṣitā evam sambhavati brāhmaṇe vidyā caraṇa sampad iti sampad viṣayaḥ brāhmaṇa tvam na sampad hetuḥ na ca atra hetuḥ vivakṣitaḥ viṣaya anuvādaḥ tu ayam praśaṃsā artha tvāt vākyasya sati brāhmaṇa tve sampad hetuḥ samarthaḥ iti viśayam ca praśaṃsatā vākyena yathā hetutaḥ phala nirvṛttiḥ na pratyākhyāyate tat evam sati vacana vighātaḥ asambhūta artha kalpanayā na upapadyate iti

dharma vikalpa nirdeśe artha sadbhāva pratiṣedhaḥ upacāracchalam abhidhānasya dharmaḥ yathā artha prayogaḥ dharma vikalpaḥ anyatra dṛṣṭasya anyatra prayogaḥ tasya nirdeśe dharma vikalpa nirdeśe yathā mañcāḥ krośanti iti artha sadbhāvena pratiṣedhaḥ mañca sthāḥ puruṣāḥ krośanti na tu mañcāḥ krośanti kā punar atra artha vikalpa upapattiḥ anyathā prayuktasya anyathā artha kalpanam bhaktyā prayoge prādhānyena kalpanam upacāra viṣayam chalam upacāracchalam upacāraḥ nīta arthaḥ sahacaraṇa ādi nimittena atadbhāve tadvat abhidhānam upacāraḥ iti

atra samādhiḥ prasiddhe prayoge vaktuḥ yathā abhiprāyam śabda arthayoḥ abhyanujñā pratiṣedhāḥ vā na cchandataḥ pradhāna bhūtasya śabdasya bhāktasya ca guṇa bhūtasya prayogaḥ ubhayoḥ loka siddhaḥ siddhe prayoge yathā vaktuḥ abhiprāyaḥ tathā śabda arthau anujñeyau pratiṣedhyau vā na cchandataḥ yadi vaktā pradhāna śabdam prayuṅkte yathābhūtasya abhyanujñā pratiṣedhaḥ vā na cchandataḥ atha guṇa bhūtam tadā guṇa bhūtasya yatra tu vaktā guṇa bhūtam śabdam prayuṅkte pradhāna bhūtam abhipretya paraḥ pratiṣedhati sva manīṣayā pratiṣedhaḥ asau bhavati na para upālambhaḥ iti

vākchalam eva upacāra chalam tat aviśeṣāt na vākchalāt upacāracchalam bhidyate tasya api artha antara kalpanāyāḥ aviśeṣāt iha api sthāni arthaḥ guṇa śabdaḥ pradhāna śabdaḥ sthāna arthaḥ iti kalpayitvā pratiṣidhyate iti

na tad artha antara bhāvāt na vākchalam eva upacāra chalam tasya artha sadbhāva pratiṣedhasya artha antara bhāvāt kutas artha antara kalpanātaḥ anyā hi artha antara kalpanā anyaḥ artha sadbhāva pratiṣedhaḥ iti

aviṣeṣe vā kiñcid sādharmyāt eka chala prasaṅaḥ chalasya dvi tvam abhyanujñāya tritvam pratiṣidhyate kiñcid sādharmyāt yathā ca ayam hetuḥ tritvam pratiṣedhati tathā dvi tvam api abhyanujñātam pratiṣedhati vidyate hi kiñcid sādharmyam dvayoḥ api iti atha dvi tvam kiñcid sādharmyāt na nivartate tritvam api na nivartsyati

chala lakṣaṇāt ūrdhvam sādharmya vaidharmyābhyām pratyavasthānam jātiḥ prayukte hi hetau yaḥ prasaṅgaḥ jāyate sa jātiḥ sa ca prasaṅgaḥ sādharmya vaidharmyābhyām pratyavasthānam upālambhaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ iti udāharaṇa sādharmyāt sādhya sādhanam hetuḥ iti asya udāharaṇa vaidharmyeṇa pratyavasthānam udāharaṇa vaidharmyāt sādhya sādhanam hetuḥ iti asya udāharaṇa sādharmyeṇa pratyavasthānam pratyanīka bhāvāt jāyamānaḥ arthaḥ jātiḥ iti

vipratipattiḥ apratipattiḥ ca nigraha sthānam viparītā vā kutsitā vā pratipattiḥ vipratipattiḥ vipratipadyamānaḥ parājayam prāpnoti nigraha sthānam khalu parājaya prāptiḥ apratipattiḥ tu ārambha viṣaye anārambhaḥ pareṇa sthāpitam vā na pratiṣedhati pratiṣedham vā na uddharati asamāsāt ca na ete eva nigraha sthāne iti

kim punar dṛṣṭānta vat jāti nigraha sthānayoḥ abhedaḥ atha siddhānta vat bhedaḥ iti atas āha tad vikalpāt jāti nigraha sthāna bahu tvam tasya sādharmya vaidharmyābhyām pratyavasthānasya vikalpāt jāti bahu tvam tayoḥ ca vipratipatti apratipattyoḥ vikalpāt nigraha sthāna bahu tvam nānā kalpaḥ vikalpaḥ vividhaḥ vā kalpaḥ vikalpaḥ tatra ananubhāṣaṇam ajñānam apratibhā vikṣepaḥ mata anujñā paryanuyojya upekṣaṇam iti apratipattiḥ nigrasthānam śeṣaḥ tu vipratipattiḥ iti ime pramāṇa ādayaḥ padārthāḥ uddiṣṭāḥ yathoddeśam lakṣitāḥ yathālakṣaṇam parīkṣiṣyante iti trividhā ca asya śāstrasya pravṛttiḥ veditavyā iti

atas ūrdhvam pramāṇa ādi parīkṣā sā ca vimṛśya pakṣa pratipakṣābhyām artha avadhāraṇam nirṇayaḥ iti agre vimarṣaḥ eva parīkṣyate samāna aneka dharma adhyavasāyāt anyatara dharma adhyavasāyāt vā na saṃśayaḥ samānasya dharmasya adhyavasāyāt saṃśayaḥ na dharma mātrāt atha vā samānam anayoḥ dharmam upalabhaḥ iti dharma dharmi grahaṇe saṃśaya abhāvaḥ iti

atha vā samāna dharma adhyavasāyāt artha antara bhūte dharmiṇi saṃśayaḥ anupapannaḥ na jātu rūpasya artha antara bhūtasya adhyavasāyāt artha antara bhūte sparśe saṃśayaḥ iti atha vā na adhyavasāyāt artha avadhāraṇāt anavadhāraṇa jñānam saṃśayaḥ upapadyate kārya kāraṇayoḥ sārūpya abhāvāt iti etena aneka dharma adhyavasāyāt iti vyākhyātam anyatara dharma adhyvasāyāt ca saṃśayaḥ na bhavati tatas hi anyatara avadhāraṇam eva iti

vipratipatti avyavasthā adhyavasāyāt ca na vipratipatti mātrāt avyavasthā mātrāt vā saṃśayaḥ kim tarhi vipratipattim upalabhamānasya saṃśayaḥ evam avyavasthāyām api iti atha vā asti ātmā iti eke na asti ātmā iti apare manyante iti upalabdheḥ katham saṃśayaḥ syāt iti tathā upalabdhiḥ avyavasthitāḥ anupalabdhiḥ ca avyavasthitā iti vibhāgena adhyavasite saṃśayaḥ na upapadyate iti

vipratipattau ca sampratipatteḥ yām ca vipratipattim bhavān saṃśaya hetuḥ manyate sā sampratipattiḥ sā hi dvayoḥ pratyanīka dharma viṣayā tatra yadi vipratipatteḥ saṃśayaḥ sampratipatteḥ eva saṃśayaḥ iti

avyavasthā ātmani vyavasthita tvāt ca avyavasthāyāḥ na saṃśayaḥ yadi tāvat iyam avyavasthā ātmani eva vyavasthitā vyavasthānāt avyavasthā na bhavati iti anupapannaḥ saṃśayaḥ atha avyavastha ātmani na vyavasthitā evam atādātmyāt avyavasthā na bhavati iti saṃśaya abhāvaḥ iti

tathā atyanta saṃśayaḥ tad dharma sātatya upapatteḥ yena kalpena bhavān samāna dharma upapatteḥ saṃśayaḥ iti manyate tena khalu atyanta saṃśayaḥ prasajyate samāna dharma upapatteḥ anucchedāt saṃśaya anucchedaḥ na hi ayam ataddharmā dharmī vimṛśyamāṇaḥ gṛhyate satatam tu tat dharmā bhavati iti

asya pratiṣedha prapañcasya saṅkṣepeṇa uddhāraḥ yathā ukta adhyavasāyāt eva tad aviśeṣa apekṣāt saṃśaye na asaṃśayaḥ na atyanta saṃśayaḥ vā na saṃśaya anutpattiḥ saṃśayānucchedaḥ ca prasajyate katham yat tāvat samāna dharma adhyavasāyaḥ saṃśaya hetuḥ na samāna dharma mātram iti evam etat kasmāt evam na ucyate iti viśeṣa apekṣaḥ iti vacanāt tad siddheḥ viśeṣasya apekṣā ākaṅkṣā sā ca anupalabhyamāne viśeṣe samarthā na ca uktam samāna dharma apekṣaḥ iti samāne ca dharme katham ākaṅkṣāḥ na bhavet yadi ayam pratyakṣaḥ syāt etena sāmarthyena vijñāyate samāna dharma adhyavasāyāt iti

upapatti vacanāt vā samāna dharma upapatteḥ iti ucyate na ca anyā sadbhāva saṃvedanāt ṛte samāna dharma upapattiḥ asti anupalabhyamāna sadbhāvaḥ hi samānaḥ dharmaḥ avidyamāna vat bhavati iti viṣaya śabdena vā viṣayiṇaḥ pratyayasya abhidhānam yathā loke dhūmena agniḥ anumīyate iti ukte dhūma darśanena agniḥ anumīyate iti jñāyate katham dṛṣṭvā hi dhūmam atha agnim anuminoti na adṛṣṭvā iti na ca vākye darśana śabdaḥ śrūyate anujānāti ca vākyasya artha pratyāyaka tvam tena manyāmahe viṣaya śabdena viṣayiṇaḥ pratyayasya abhidhānam boddha anujānāti evam iha api samāna dharma śabdena samāna dharma adhyvasāyam āha iti

yathohitvā samānam anayoḥ dharmam upalabhaḥ iti dharma dharmi grahaṇe saṃśaya abhāvaḥ iti pūrva dṛṣṭa viṣayam etat yau aham arthau pūrvam adrākṣam tayoḥ samānam dharmam upalabhe viśeṣam na upalabhaḥ iti katham nu viśeṣam paśyeyam yena anyataram avadhārayeyam iti na ca etat samāna dharma upalabdhau dharma dharmi grahaṇa mātreṇa nivartate iti

yat ca uktam na artha antara adhyavasāyāt anyatra saṃśayaḥ iti yaḥ hi artha antara adhyavasāya mātram saṃśaya hetum upādadīta saḥ evam vācyaḥ iti yat punar etat kārya kāraṇayoḥ sārūpya abhāvāt iti kāraṇasya bhāva abhāvayoḥ kāryasya bhāva abhāvau kārya kāraṇayoḥ sārūpyam yasya utpādāt yat utpadyate yasya ca anutpādāt yat na utpadyate tat kāraṇam kāryam itarat iti etat sārūpyam asti ca saṃśaya kāraṇe saṃśaye ca etat iti etena aneka dharma adhyavasāyāt iti pratiṣedhaḥ parihṛtaḥ iti

yat punar etat uktam vipratipatti avyavasthā adhyavasāyāt ca na saṃśayaḥ iti pṛthak pravādayoḥ vyāhatam artham upalabhe viśeṣam ca na jānāmi na upalabhe yena anyataram avadhārayeyam tat kaḥ atra viśeṣaḥ syāt yena ekataram avadhārayeyam iti saṃśayaḥ vipratipatti janitaḥ ayam na śakyaḥ vipratipatti sampratipatti mātreṇa nivartayitum iti evam upalabdhi anupalabdhi avyavasthā kṛte saṃśaye veditavyam iti

yat punar etat vipratipattau ca sampratipatteḥ iti vipratipatti śabdasya yaḥ arthaḥ tad adhyavasāyaḥ viśeṣa apekṣaḥ saṃśaya hetuḥ tasya ca samākhyā antareṇa na nivṛttiḥ samāne adhikaraṇe vyāhata arthau pravādau vipratipatti śabdasya arthaḥ tad adhyavasāyaḥ ca viśeṣa apekṣaḥ saṃśaya hetuḥ na ca asya sampratipatti śabde samākhyā antare yojyamāne saṃśaya hetutuvam nivartate tat idam akṛtabuddhi sammohanam iti

yat punar avyavasthā ātmani vyavasthita tvāt ca avyavasthāyāḥ iti saṃśaya hetoḥ arthasya apratiṣedhāt avyavasthā abhyanujñānāt ca nimitta antareṇa śabda antara kalpanā vyarthā śabda antara kalpanā vyavasthā khalu avyavasthā na bhavati avyavasthā ātmani vyavasthita tvāt iti na anayoḥ upalabdhi anupalabdhyoḥ sat asat viṣaya tvam viśeṣa apekṣam saṃśaya hetuḥ na bhvati iti pratiṣidhyate yāvatā ca avyavasthā ātmani vyavasthitā na tāvatā ātmānam jahāti tāvatā hi anujñāta avyavasthā evam iyam kriyamāṇā api śabda antara kalpanā na artha antaram sādhayati iti

yat punar etat tathā atyanta saṃśayaḥ tad dharma sātatya upapatteḥ iti na ayam samāna dharma ādibhyaḥ eva saṃśayaḥ kim tarhi tad viṣaya adhyavasāyāt viśeṣa smṛti sahitāt iti atas na atyanta saṃśayaḥ iti anyatara dharma adhyavasāyāt vā na saṃśayaḥ iti tat na yuktam viśeṣa apekṣaḥ vimarṣaḥ saṃśayaḥ iti vacanāt viśeṣaḥ ca anyatara dharmaḥ na tasmin adhyvasīyamāne viśeṣa apekṣā sambhavati iti

yathra saṃśayaḥ tatra evam uttarottara prasaṅgaḥ yatra yatra saṃśaya pūrvikā parīkṣā śāstre kathāyām vā tatra tatra evam saṃśaye pareṇa pratiṣiddhe samādhiḥ vācyaḥ iti atas sarva parīkṣā vyāpi tvāt prathamam saṃśayaḥ parīkṣitaḥ iti
atha pramāṇa parīkṣā pratyakṣa ādīnām aprāmāṇyam traikālya asiddheḥ pratyakṣa ādīnām pramāṇa tvam na asti traikālya asiddheḥ pūrva apara sahabhāva anupapatteḥ iti arthaḥ

asya sāmānya vacanasya artha vibhāgaḥ pūrvam hi pramāṇa siddhau na indriya artha sannikarṣāt pratyakṣa utpattiḥ gandha ādi viṣayam jñānam pratyakṣam tat yadi pūrvam paścāt gandha ādīnām siddhiḥ na idam gandha ādi sannikarṣāt utpadyate iti
paścāt siddhau na pramāṇebhyaḥ prameya siddhiḥ asati pramāṇe kena pramīyamāṇaḥ arthaḥ prameyaḥ syāt pramāṇena khalu pramīyamāṇaḥ arthaḥ prameyam iti etat sidhyati

yugapad siddhau pratyartha niyata tvāt krama vṛtti tva abhāvaḥ buddhīnām yadi pramāṇam prameyam ca yugapad bhavataḥ evam api gandha ādiṣu indriya artheṣu jñānāni pratyartha niyatāni yugapad sambhavanti iti jñānānām pratyakṣa niyata tvāt krama vṛtti tva abhāvaḥ yāḥ imāḥ buddhayaḥ krameṇa artheṣu varttante tāsām krama vṛtti tvam na sambhavati iti vyāghātaḥ ca yugapad jñāna anutpattiḥ manasaḥ liṅgam iti etāvān ca pramāṇa prameyayoḥ sadbhāva viṣayaḥ sa ca anupapannaḥ iti tasmāt pratyakṣa ādīnām pramāṇa tvam na sambhavati iti

asya samādhiḥ upalabdhi hetoḥ upalabdhi viṣayasya ca arthasya pūrva apara sahabhāva aniyamāt yathādarśanam vibhāga vacanam kavacid upalabdhi hetuḥ paścāt upalabdhi viṣayaḥ yathā ādityasya prakāśaḥ utpadyamānānām kvacid pūrvam upalabdhi viṣayaḥ paścāt upalabdhi hetuḥ yathā avasthitānām pradīpaḥ kvacid upalabdhi hetuḥ upalabdhi viṣayaḥ ca saha bhvataḥ yathā dhūmena agneḥ grahaṇam iti upalabdhi hetuḥ ca pramāṇam prameyam tu upalabdhi viṣayaḥ evam pramāṇa prameyayoḥ pūrva apara sahabhāve aniyate yathārthaḥ dṛśyate tathā vibhajya vacanīyaḥ iti tatra ekāntena pratiṣedha anupapattiḥ sāmānyena khalu vibhajya pratiṣedhaḥ uktaḥ iti

samākhyā hetoḥ traikālya yogāt tathābhūtā samākhyā yat punar idam paścāt siddhau asati pramāṇe prameyam na sidhyati pramāṇena pramīyamāṇaḥ arthaḥ prameyam iti vijñāyate iti pramāṇam iti etasyāḥ samākhyāyāḥ upalabdhi hetu tvam nimittam tasya traikālya yogaḥ upalabdhim akārṣīt upalabdhim karoti upalabdhim kariṣyati iti samākhyā hetoḥ traikālya yogāt samākhyā tathābhūtā pramitaḥ anena arthaḥ pramīyate pramāsyate iti pramāṇam pramitam pramīyate pramāsyate iti ca prameyam evam sati bhaviṣyati asmin hetutaḥ upalabdhiḥ pramāsyate ayam arthaḥ prameyam idam iti etat sarvam bhvati iti traikālyān abhyanujñāne ca vyavahāra anupapattiḥ yaḥ ca evam na abhyanujānīyāt tasya pācakam ānaya pakṣyati lāvakam ānaya laviṣyati iti vyavahāraḥ na upapadyate iti

pratyakṣa ādīnām aprāmāṇyam traikālya asiddheḥ iti evamādi vākyam pramāṇa pratiṣedhaḥ tatra ayam praṣṭavyaḥ atha anena pratiṣedhena bhavatā kim kriyate iti kim sambhavaḥ nivartyate atha asambhavaḥ jñāpyate iti tat yadi sambhavaḥ nivartyate sati sambhave pratyakṣa ādīnām pratiṣedha anupapattiḥ atha asambhavaḥ jñāpyate pramāṇa lakṣaṇam prāptaḥ tarhi pratiṣedhaḥ pramāṇa asambhavasya upalabdhi hetu tvāt iti

kim ca atas traikālya asiddheḥ pratiṣedha anupapattiḥ asya tu vibhāgaḥ pūrvam hi pratiṣedha siddhau asati pratiṣedhye kim anena pratiṣidhyate paścāt siddhau pratiṣedhya asiddhiḥ pratiṣedha abhāvāt iti yugapad siddhau pratiṣedhya siddhi abhyanujñānāt anarthakaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ iti pratiṣedha lakṣaṇe ca vākye anupapadyamāne siddham pratyakṣa ādīnām pramāṇa tvam iti

katham sarva pramāṇa pratiṣedhāt ca pratiṣedha anupapattiḥ traikālya asiddheḥ iti asya hetoḥ yadi udāharaṇam upādīyate hetu arthasya sādhaka tvam dṛṣṭānte darśayitavyam iti na ca tarhi pratyakṣa ādīnām aprāmāṇyam atha pratyakṣa ādīnām aprāmāṇyam upādīyamānam api udāharaṇam na artham sādhayiṣyati iti saḥ ayam sarva pramāṇa vyāhataḥ hetuḥ ahetuḥ siddhāntam abhyupetya tad virodhī viruddhaḥ iti vākya arthaḥ hi asya siddhāntaḥ sa ca vākya arthaḥ pratyakṣa ādīni na artham sādhayanti iti idam ca avayavānām upādānam arthasya sādhanāya iti atha na upādīyate apradarśitam hetu arthasya dṛṣṭāntena sādhaka tvam iti niṣedhaḥ na upapadyate hetu tva asiddheḥ iti

tad prāmāṇye vā na sarva pramāṇa vipratiṣedhaḥ pratiṣedha lakṣaṇe sva vākye teṣām avayava āśritānām pratyakṣa ādīnām prāmāṇye abhyanujñāyamāne para vākye api avayava āśritānām prāmāṇyam prasajyate aviśeṣāt iti evam ca na sarvāṇi pramāṇāni pratiṣidhyante iti vipratiṣedhaḥ iti vi iti ayam upasargaḥ sampratipatti arthe na vyāghāte artha abhāvāt iti

traikālya apratiṣedhaḥ ca śabdāt ātodya siddhi vat tad siddheḥ kim artham punar idam ucyate pūrva ukta nibandhana artham yat tāvat pūrva uktam upalabdhi hetoḥ upalabdhi viṣayasya ca arthasya pūrva apara sahabhāva aniyamāt yathādarśanam vibhāga vacanam iti tat itas samutthānam yathā vijñāyeta anityam adarśī khalu ayam ṛṣiḥ niyamena pratiṣedham pratyācaṣṭe traikālyasya ca ayuktaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ iti tatra ekām vidhām udāharati śabdāt ātodya siddhi vat iti

yathā paścāt siddhena śabdena pūrva siddham ātodyam anumīyate sādhyam ca ātodyam sādhanam ca śabdaḥ antarhite hi ātodye svanataḥ anumānam bhavati iti vīṇā vādyate veṇuḥ pūryate iti svana viśeṣeṇa ātodya viśeṣam pratipadyate tathā pūrva siddham upalabdhi viṣayam paścāt siddhena upalabdhi hetunā pratipadyate iti nidarśana artha tvāt ca asya śeṣayoḥ vidhayoḥ yathoktam udāharaṇam veditavyam iti kasmāt punar iha tat na ucyate pūrva uktam upapādyate iti sarvathā tāvat ayam arthaḥ prakāśayitavyaḥ saḥ iha vā prakāśyeta tatra vā na kaścid viśeṣaḥ iti

pramāṇam prameyam iti ca samākhyā samāveśena varttate samākhyā nimitta vaśāt samākhyā nimittam tu upalabdhi sādhanam pramāṇam upalabdhi viṣayaḥ ca prameyam iti yadā ca upalabdhi viṣayaḥ kvacid upalabdhi sādhanam bhavati tadā pramāṇam prameyam iti ca ekaḥ arthaḥ abhidhīyate asya arthasya avadyotana artham idam ucyate prameyā ca tulā prāmāṇya vat

guru tva parimāṇa jñāna sādhanam tulā pramāṇam jñāna viṣayaḥ guru dravyam suvarṇa ādi prameyam yathā suvarṇa ādinā tulā antaram vyavasthāpyate tadā tulā antara pratipattau suvarṇa ādi pramāṇam tulā antaram prameyam iti evam anavayavena tantra arthaḥ uddiṣṭaḥ veditavyaḥ ātmā tāvat upalabdhi viṣaya tvāt prameye paripaṭhitaḥ upalabdhau svātantryāt pramātā buddhiḥ upalabdhi sādhana tvāt pramāṇam upalabdhi viṣaya tvāt prameyam ubhaya abhāvāt tu pramitiḥ evam artha viśeṣe samākhyā samāveśaḥ yojyaḥ tathā ca kāraka śabdāḥ nimitta vaśāt samāveśena varttante iti vṛkṣaḥ tiṣṭhati iti sva sthitau svātantryāt kartā vṛkṣam paśyati iti darśanena āptum iṣyamāṇatama tvāt karma vṛkṣeṇa candramasam jñāpayati iti jñāpakasya sādhakatama tvāt karaṇam

vṛkṣāya udakam āsiñcati iti āsicyamānena udakena vṛkṣam abhipraiti iti sampradānam vṛkṣāt parṇam patati iti dhruvam apāye apādānam iti apādānam vṛkṣe vayāṃsi santi iti ādhāraḥ adhikaraṇam iti adhikaraṇam evam ca sati na dravya mātram kārakam na kriyā mātram kim tarhi kriyā sādhanam kriyā viśeṣa yuktam kārakam yat kriyā sādhanam svatantram sa kartā na dravya mātram na kriyā mātram kriyayā vyāptum iṣyamāṇatamam karma na dravya mātram na kryā mātram evam sādhakatama ādiṣu api evam ca kāraka an vā ākhyānam yathā eva upapattitaḥ evam lakṣaṇataḥ kāraka an vā ākhyānam api na dravya mātre na kriyāyām vā kim tarhi kriyā sādhane kriyā viśeṣa yuktaḥ iti kāraka śabdaḥ ca ayam pramāṇam prameyam iti sa ca kāraka dharmam na hātum arhati

asti bhoḥ kāraka śabdānām nimitta vaśāt samāveṣaḥ pratyakṣa ādīni ca pramāṇāni upalabdhi hetu tvāt prameyam ca upalabdhi viṣaya tvāt saṃvedyāni ca pratyakṣa ādīni pramāṇāni pratyakṣeṇa upalabhe anumānena upalabhe upamānena upalabhe āgamena upalabhe pratyakṣam me jñānam ānumānikam me jñānam aupamānikam me jñānam āgamikam me jñānam iti viśeṣāḥ gṛhyante lakṣaṇataḥ ca jñāpyamānāni jñāyante viśeṣeṇa indriya artha sannikarṣa utpannam jñānam iti evamādinā

sā iyam upalabdhiḥ pratyakṣa ādi viṣayā kim pramāṇa antarataḥ atha antareṇa pramāṇa antaram asādhana iti kaḥ ca atra viśeṣaḥ pramāṇataḥ siddheḥ pramāṇānām pramāṇa antara siddhi prasaṅgaḥ yadi pratyakṣa ādīni pramāṇena upalabhyante yena pramāṇena upalabhyante tat pramāṇa antaram asti iti pramāṇa antara sadbhāvaḥ prasajyate iti anavasthām āha tasya api anyena tasya api anyena iti na ca anavasthā śakya anujñātum anupapatteḥ iti

astu tarhi pramāṇa antaram antareṇa niḥsādhana iti tad vinivṛtteḥ vā pramāṇa siddhi vat prameya siddhiḥ yadi pratyakṣa ādi upalabdhau pramāṇa antaram nivarttane ātma ādi upalabdhau api pramāṇa antaram nivartsyati aviśeṣāt

evam ca sarva pramāṇa vilopaḥ iti atas āha na pradīpa prakāśa siddhi vat tad siddheḥ yathā pradīpa prakāśaḥ pratyakṣa aṅga tvāt dṛśya darśane pramāṇam sa ca pratyakṣa antareṇa cakṣuṣaḥ sannikarṣeṇa gṛhyate pradīpa bhāva abhāvayoḥ darśanasya tathā abhāvāt darśana hetuḥ anumīyate tamasi pradīpam upādadīthāḥ iti āpta upadeśena api pratipadyate evam pratyakṣa ādīnām yathādarśanam pratyakṣa ādibhiḥ eva upalabdhiḥ indriyāṇi tāvat sva viṣaya grahaṇena eva anumīyante arthāḥ pratyakṣataḥ gṛhyante indriya artha sannikarṣāḥ tu āvaraṇena liṅgena anumīyante

indriya artha sannikarṣa utpannam jñānam ātma manasoḥ saṃyoga viśeṣāt ātma samavayāt ca sukha ādi vat gṛhyate evam pramāṇa viśeṣaḥ vibhajya vacanīyaḥ yathā ca dṛśyaḥ san pradīpa prakāśaḥ dṛśya antarāṇām darśana hetuḥ iti dṛśya darśana vyavasthām labhate evam prameyam sat kiñcid artha jātam upalabdhi hetu tvāt pramāṇa prameya vyvasthām labhate sā iyam pratyakṣa ādibhiḥ eva pratyakṣa ādīnām yathādarśanam upalabdhiḥ na pramāṇa antarataḥ na ca pramāṇam antareṇa niḥsādhana iti

tena eva tasya agrahaṇam iti ced na artha bhedasya lakṣaṇa sāmānyāt pratyakṣa ādīnām pratyakṣa ādibhiḥ eva grahaṇam iti ayuktam anyena hi anyasya grahaṇam dṛṣṭam iti na artha bhedasya lakṣaṇa sāmānyāt pratyakṣa lakṣaṇena anekaḥ arthaḥ saṃgṛhītaḥ tatra kenacid kasyacid grahaṇam iti adoṣaḥ evam anumāna ādiṣu api iti yata uddhṛtena udakena āśaya sthasya grahaṇam iti

jñātṛ manasoḥ ca darśanāt aham sukhī aham duḥkhī ca iti tena eva jñātrā tasya eva grahaṇam dṛśyate yugapad jñāna anutpattiḥ manasaḥ liṅgam iti ca tena eva manasā tasya eva anumānam dṛśyate jñātuḥ jñeyasya ca abhedaḥ grahaṇasya grāhyasya ca abhedaḥ iti nimitta bhedaḥ atra iti ced samānam na nimitta antareṇa vinā jñātā ātmānam jānīte na ca nimitta antareṇa vinā manasā manaḥ gṛhyate iti samānam etat pratyakṣa adbhiḥ pratyakṣa ādīnām grahaṇam iti atra api artha bhedaḥ na gṛhyate iti pratyakṣa ādīnām ca aviṣayasya anupapatteḥ yadi syāt kiṃcid artha jātam pratyakṣa ādīnām aviṣayaḥ yat pratyakṣa ādibhiḥ na śakyam grahītum tasya grahaṇāya pramāṇa antaram upādīyeta tat tu na śakyam kenacid upapādayitum iti pratyakṣa ādīnām yathādarśanam eva idam sat ca asat ca sarvam viṣayaḥ iti

kvacid nivṛtti darśanāt anivṛtti darśanāt ca kvacid anekāntaḥ kecid tu dṛṣṭāntam aparigṛhītam hetunā viśeṣa hetum antareṇa sādhya sādhanāya upādadate yathā pradīpa prakāśaḥ pradīpa antara prakāśam antareṇa gṛhyate tathā pramāṇāni pramāṇa antaram antareṇa gṛhyate iti sa ca ayam yathā ca ayam prasaṅgaḥ nivṛtti darśanāt pramāṇa sādhāya upādīyate evam prameya sādhanāya api upādeyaḥ aviśeṣa hetu tvāt yathā ca sthālī ādi rūpa grahaṇe pradīpa prakāśaḥ prameya sādhanāya upādīyate evam pramāṇa sādhāya api upādeyaḥ viśeṣa hetu abhāvāt saḥ ayam viśeṣa hetu parigraham antareṇa dṛṣṭānte ekasmin pakṣe upādeyaḥ na pratipakṣaḥ iti anekāntaḥ ekasmin ca pakṣe dṛṣṭāntaḥ iti anekāntaḥ viśeṣa hetu abhāvāt iti

viśeṣa hetu parigrahe sati upasaṃhāra abhyanujñānāt apratiṣedhaḥ viśeṣa hetu parigṛhītaḥ tu dṛṣṭānte ekasmin pakṣe upasaṃhriyamāṇaḥ na śakyaḥ anujñātum evam ca sati anekāntaḥ iti ayam pratiṣedhaḥ na bhavati pratyakṣa ādīnām pratyakṣa ādibhiḥ upalabdhau anavasthā iti ced na saṃvid viṣaya nimittānām upalabdhyā vyavahāra upapatteḥ pratyakṣeṇa artham upalabhe anumānena artham upalabhe upamānena artham upalabhe āgamena artham upalabhe iti pratyakṣam me jñānam ānumānikam me jñānam aupamānikam me jñānam āgamikam me jñānam iti saṃvid viṣayam saṃvid nimittam ca upalabhamānasya dharma artha sukha apavarga prayojanaḥ tad pratyanīka parivarjana prayojanaḥ ca vyavahāraḥ upapadyate saḥ ayam tāvatī eva nivartate na ca asti vyavahāra antaram anavasthā sādhanīyam yena pratyukta anavasthām upādadīta iti
sāmānyena pramāṇāni parīkṣya viśeṣeṇa parīkṣyante tatra pratyakṣa lakṣaṇa anupapattiḥ asamagra vacanāt ātma manaḥ sannikarṣaḥ hi kāraṇa antaram na uktam iti

na ca asaṃyukte dravye saṃyoga janyasya guṇasya utpattiḥ iti jñāna utpatti darśanāt ātma manaḥ sannikarṣaḥ kāraṇam manaḥ sannikarṣa anapekṣasya ca indriya artha sannikarṣasya jñāna kāraṇa tve yugapad utpadyeran buddhayaḥ iti manaḥ sannikarṣaḥ api kāraṇam tat idam sūtram purastāt kṛta bhāṣyam na ātma manasoḥ sannikarṣa abhāve pratyakṣa utpattiḥ ātma manasoḥ sannikarṣa abhāve na utpadyate pratyakṣam indriya artha sannikarṣa abhāva vat iti

sati ca indriya artha sannikarṣe jñāna utpatti darśanāt kāraṇa bhāvam bruvataḥ diś deśa kāla ākāśeṣu api evam prasaṅgaḥ diś ādiṣu satsu jñāna bhāvāt tāni api kāraṇāni iti akāraṇa bhāve api jñāna utpattiḥ diś ādi sannidheḥ avarjanīya tvāt yadā api akāraṇam diś ādīni jñāna utpattau tadā api satsu diś ādiṣu jñānena bhavitavyam na hi diś ādīnām sannidhiḥ śakyaḥ parivarjayitum iti tatra kāraṇa bhāve hetu vacanam etasmāt dhetoḥ diś ādīni jñāna kāraṇāni iti

ātma manaḥ sannikarṣaḥ tarhi upasaṅkhyeyaḥ iti tatra idam ucyate jñāna liṅga tvāt ātmanaḥ na anavarodhaḥ jñānam ātma liṅgam tad guṇa tvāt na ca asaṃyukte dravye saṃyoga jasya guṇasya utpattiḥ asti iti

tad ayaugapadya liṅga tvāt ca na manasaḥ anavarodhaḥ iti varttate yugapad jñāna anutpattiḥ manasaḥ liṅgam iti ucyamāne sidhyati eva manaḥ sannikarṣa apekṣaḥ indriya artha sannikarṣaḥ jñāna kāraṇam iti

pratyakṣa nimitta tvāt ca indriya arthayoḥ sannikarṣasya sva śabdena vacanam pratyakṣa anumāna upamāna śabdānām nimittam ātma manaḥ sannikarṣaḥ pratyakṣasya eva indriya artha sannikarṣaḥ iti asamānaḥ asamāna tvāt tasya grahaṇam

supta vyāsakta manasām ca indriya arthayoḥ sannikarṣa nimitta tvāt indriya artha sannikarṣasya grahaṇam na ātma manasoḥ sannikarṣasya iti ekadā khalu ayam prabodha kālam praṇidhāya suptaḥ praṇidhāna vaśāt prabudhyate yadā tu tīvrau dhvani sparśau prabodha kāraṇam bhavataḥ tadā prasuptasya indriya sannikarṣa nimittam prabodha jñānam utpadyate tatra na jñātuḥ manasaḥ ca sannikarṣasya prādhānyam bhavati kim tarhi indriya arthayoḥ sannikarṣasya na hi ātmā jijñāsamānaḥ prayatnena manaḥ tadā prerayati iti

ekadā khalu ayam viṣaya antara āsakta manāḥ saṅkalpa vaśāt viṣaya antaram jijñāsamānaḥ prayatna preritena manasā indriyam saṃyojya tat viṣaya antaram jānīte yadā tu khalu asya niḥsaṅkalpasya nirjijñāsasya ca vyāsakta manasaḥ bāhya viṣaya upanipātanāt jñānam utpadyate tadā indriya artha sannikarṣasya prādhānyam na hi atra asau jijñāsamānaḥ prayatnena manaḥ prerayati iti prādhānyāt ca indriya artha sannikarṣasya grahaṇam kāryam guṇa tvāt na ātma manasoḥ sannikarṣasya iti

prādhānye ca hetu antaram taiḥ ca apadeśaḥ jñāna viśeṣāṇām taiḥ indriyaiḥ arthaiḥ ca vyapadiśyante jñāna viśeṣāḥ katham ghrāṇena jighrati cakṣuṣā paśyati rasanayā rasayati iti ghrāṇa vijñānam cakṣuḥ vijñānam rasanā vijñānam gandha vijñānam rūpa vijñānam rasa vijñānam iti ca indriya viṣaya viśeṣāt ca pañcadhā buddhiḥ bhavati atas prādhānyam indriya artha sannikarṣasya iti

yat uktam indriya artha sannikarṣa grahaṇam kāryam na ātma manasoḥ sannikarṣasya iti kasmāt supta vyāsakta manasām indriya arthayoḥ sannikarṣasya jñāna nimitta tvāt iti saḥ ayam vyāhata tvāt ahetuḥ yadi tāvat kvacid ātma manasoḥ sannikarṣasya jñāna kāraṇa tvam na iṣyate tadā yugapad jñāna anutpattiḥ manasaḥ liṅgam iti vyāhanyeta na idānīm manasaḥ sannikarṣam indriya artha sannikarṣaḥ apekṣate manaḥ saṃyoga anapekṣāyām ca yugapad jñāna utpatti prasaṅgaḥ atha mā bhūt vyāghātaḥ iti sarva vijñānānām ātma manasoḥ sannikarṣaḥ kāraṇam iṣyate tad avastham eva idam bhavati jñāna kāraṇa tvāt ātma manasoḥ sannikarṣasya grahaṇam kāryam iti

na artha viśeṣa prābalyāt na asti vyāghātaḥ na hi ātma manaḥ sannikarṣasya jñāna kāraṇa tvam vyabhicarati indriya artha sannikarṣasya prādhānyam upādīyate artha viśeṣa prābalyāt dhi supta vyāsakta manasām jñāna utpattiḥ ekadā bhavati artha viśeṣaḥ kaścid eva indriya arthaḥ tasya prābalyam tīvra tā paṭute tat ca artha viśeṣa prābalyam indriya artha sannikarṣa viṣayam na ātma manasoḥ sannikarṣa viṣayam tasmāt indriya artha sannikarṣaḥ pradhānam iti asati praṇidhāne saṅkalpe ca asati supta vyāsakta manasām yat indriya artha sannikarṣāt utpadyate jñānam tatra manaḥ saṃyogaḥ api kāraṇam iti manasi kriyā kāraṇam vācyam iti

yathā eva jñātuḥ khalu ayam icchā janitaḥ prayatnaḥ manasaḥ prerakaḥ ātma guṇaḥ evam ātmani guṇa antaram sarvasya sādhakam pravṛtti doṣa janitam asti yena preritam manaḥ indriyeṇa sambadhyate tena hi apreryamāṇe manasi saṃyoga abhāvāt jñāna anutpattau sarva artha tā asya nivarttate eṣitavyam ca asya guṇa antarasya dravya guṇa karma kāraṇa tvam anyathā hi caturvidhānām aṇūnām bhūta sūkṣmāṇām manasām ca tatas anyasya kriyā hetoḥ asambhavāt śarīra indriya viṣayāṇām anutpatti prasaṅgaḥ

pratyakṣam anumānam eka deśa grahaṇāt upalabdheḥ yat idam indriya artha sannikarṣāt utpadyate jñānam vṛkṣaḥ iti etat kila pratyakṣam tat khalu anumānam eva kasmāt eka deśa grahaṇāt vṛkṣasya upalabdheḥ arvāc bhāgam ayam gṛhītvā vṛkṣam upalabhate na ca eka deśaḥ vṛkṣaḥ tatra yathā dhūmam gṛhītvā vahnim anuminoti tādṛś eva tat bhavati

kim punar gṛhyamāṇāt eka deśāt artha antaram anumeyam manyase avayava samūha pakṣe avayava antarāṇi dravya antara utpatti pakṣe tāni ca avavavī ca iti avayava samūha pakṣe tāvat eka deśa grahaṇāt vṛkṣa buddheḥ abhāvaḥ na agṛhyamāṇam eka deśa antaram vṛkṣaḥ gṛhyamāṇa eka deśa vat iti atha eka deśa grahaṇāt eka deśa antara anumāne samudāya pratisandhānāt tatra vṛkṣa buddhiḥ na tarhi vṛkṣa buddhiḥ anumānam evam sati bhavitum arhati iti dravya antara utpatti pakṣe na avaya vi anumeyaḥ asya eka deśa sambaddhasya agrahaṇāt grahaṇe ca aviśeṣāt anumeya tva abhāvaḥ tasmāt vṛkṣa buddhiḥ anumānam na bhavati

eka deśa grahaṇam āśritya pratyakṣasya anumāna tvam upapādyate tat ca na pratyakṣeṇa yāvat tāvat api upalambhāt na pratyakṣam anumānam kasmāt pratyakṣeṇa eva upalambhāt yat tad eka deśa grahaṇam āśrīyate pratyakṣeṇa asau upalambhaḥ na ca upalambhaḥ nirviṣayaḥ asti yāvat ca artha jātam tasya viṣayaḥ tāvat abhyupajñāyamānam pratyakṣa vyavasthāpakam bhavati kim punar tatas anyat artha jātam avayavī samudāyaḥ vā na ca eka deśa grahaṇam anumānam bhāvayitum śakyam hetu abhāvāt iti

anyathā api ca pratyakṣasya na anumāna tva prasaṅgaḥ tad pūrvaka tvāt pratyakṣa pūrvakam anumānam sambaddhau agni dhūmau pratyakṣataḥ dṛṣṭavataḥ dhūma pratyakṣa darśanāt agnau anumānam bhavati yat ca sambaddhayoḥ liṅga liṅginoḥ pratyakṣam yat ca liṅga mātra pratyakṣa grahaṇam na etat antareṇa anumānasya pravṛttiḥ asti na tu etat anumānam indriya artha sannikarṣa ja tvāt na ca anumeyasya indriyeṇa sannikarṣāt anumānam bhavati saḥ ayam pratyakṣa anumānayoḥ lakṣaṇa bhedaḥ mahān āśrayitavyaḥ iti

na ca eka deśa upalabdhiḥ avayavi sadbhāvāt na ca eka deśa upalabdhi mātram kim tarhi eka deśa upalabdhiḥ tad sahacarita avayavī upalabdhiḥ ca kasmāt avayavi sadbhāvāt asti hi ayam eka deśa vyatiriktaḥ avayavī tasya avayava sthānasya upalabdhi kāraṇa prāptasya eka deśa upalabdhau anupalabdhiḥ anupapanna iti akṛtsna grahaṇāt iti ced na kāraṇataḥ anyasya eka deśasya abhāvāt na ca avayavāḥ kṛtsnāḥ gṛhyante avayavaiḥ eva avayava antara vyavadhānāt na avayavī kṛtsnaḥ gṛhyate iti na ayam gṛhyamnāṇeṣu avayaveṣu parisamāptaḥ iti sā iyam ekaddeśa upalabdhiḥ anivṛttā eva iti

kṛtsnam iti vai khalu aśeṣa tāyām satyām bhavati akṛtsnam iti śeṣe sati tat ca etat avayaveṣu bahuṣu asti avyavadhāne grahaṇāt vyavadhāne ca agrahaṇāt iti aṅga tu bhavān pṛṣṭaḥ vyācaṣṭām gṛhyamāṇasya avayavinaḥ kim agṛhītam manyate yena eka deśa upalabdhiḥ syāt iti na hi asya kāraṇebhyaḥ anye eka deśāḥ bhavanti iti tatra avayava vṛttam na upapadyate iti idam tasya vṛttam yeṣām indriya sannikarṣāt grahaṇam avayavānām taiḥ saha gṛhyate yeṣām avayavānām vyavadhānāt agrahaṇam taiḥ saha na gṛhyate na ca etad kṛtaḥ asti bhedaḥ iti

samudāya śeṣa tā vā samudāyaḥ vṛkṣaḥ syāt tad prāptiḥ vā ubhayathā grahaṇa abhāvaḥ mūla skandha śākhā palāśa ādīnām aśeṣa tā vā samudāyaḥ vṛkṣaḥ iti syāt prāptiḥ vā samudāyinām iti ubhayathā samudāya bhūtasya vṛkṣasya grahaṇam na upapadyate iti avayavaiḥ tāvat avayava antarasya vyavadhānāt aśeṣa grahaṇam na upapadyate prāpti grahaṇam api na upapadyate prāptimatām agrahaṇāt sā iyam eka deśa grahaṇa sahacaritā vṛkṣa vuddhiḥ dravya antara utpattau kalpate na samudaya mātre iti

sādhya tvāt avayavini sandehaḥ yat uktam avayavi sadbhāvāt iti ayam ahetuḥ sādhya tvāt sādhyam tāvat etat kāraṇebhyaḥ dravya antaram utpadyate iti anupapāditam etat evam ca sati vipratipatti mātram bhavati vipratipatteḥ ca avayavini saṃśayaḥ iti

sarva agrahaṇam avayavi asiddheḥ yadi avayavī na asti sarvasya grahaṇam na upapadyate kim tat sarvam dravya guṇa karma sāmānya viśeṣa samavāyāḥ katham kṛtvā paramāṇu samavasthānam tāvat darśana viṣayaḥ na bhavati atīndriya tvāt aṇūnām dravya antaran ca avaya vi bhūtam darśana viṣayaḥ na asti darśana viṣaya sthāḥ ca ime dravya ādayaḥ gṛhante te niradhiṣṭhānāḥ na gṛhyeran gṛhyante tu kumbhaḥ ayam śyāmaḥ ekaḥ mahān saṃyuktaḥ spandate asti mṛd mayaḥ ca iti santi ca ime guṇa ādayaḥ dharmāḥ iti tena sarvasya grahaṇāt paśyāmaḥ asti dravya antara bhūtaḥ avayavi iti

dhāraṇa ākarṣaṇa upapatteḥ ca avayavi artha antara bhūtaḥ iti saṅgraha kārite vai dhāraṇa ākarṣaṇe saṃgrahaḥ nāma saṃyoga sahacaritam guṇa antaram sneha drava tva kāritam apām saṃyogāt āme kumbhe agni saṃyogāt pakve yadi tu avayavi kārite abhaviṣyatām pāṃśu rāśi prabhṛti śu api ajñāsyetām dravya antara anutpattau ca tṛṇa upala kāṣṭha ādiṣu jatu saṃgṛhīteṣu api na abhāviṣyatām iti

atha avayavinam pratyācakṣāṇakaḥ mā bhūt pratyakṣa lopaḥ iti aṇu sañcayam darśana viṣayam pratijānānaḥ kim anuyoktavyaḥ iti ekam idam dravyam iti eka vuddheḥ viṣayam paryanuyojyaḥ kim eka buddhiḥ abhinna artha viṣaya iti āhosvit bhinna artha viṣaya iti abhinna artha viṣaya iti ced artha antara anujñānāt avayava visiddhiḥ nānā artha viṣaya iti ced bhinneṣu eka darśana anupapattiḥ anekasmin ekaḥ iti vyāhatā buddhiḥ na dṛśyate iti

senā vana vat grahaṇam iti ced na atīndriya tvāt aṇūnām yathā senā aṅgeṣu vana aṅgeṣu ca dūrāt agṛhyamāṇa pṛthaktveṣu ekam idam iti upapadyate buddhiḥ evam aṇuṣu sañciteṣu agṛhyamāṇa pṛthaktveṣu ekam idam iti upapadyate buddhiḥ iti yathā gṛhyamāṇa pṛthaktvānām senā vana aṅgānām ārāt kāraṇa antarataḥ pṛthaktu asya agrahaṇam yathā gṛhyamāṇa jātīnām palāśaḥ iti vā khadiraḥ iti vā nārāt jāti grahaṇam bhavati yathā gṛhyamāṇa praspandānām nārāt spanda grahaṇam gṛhyamāṇe ca artha jāte pṛthaktvasya agrahaṇāt ekam iti bhāktaḥ pratyayaḥ bhavati na tu aṇūnām gṛhyamāṇa pṛthaktvānām kāraṇataḥ pṛthaktu asya agrahaṇāt bhāktaḥ eka pratyayaḥ atīndriya tvāt aṇūnām iti

idam eva ca parīkṣyate kim eka pratyayaḥ ṇu sañcaya viṣayaḥ āhosvit na iti aṇu sañcaye eva senā avanāṅāni na ca parīkṣyamāṇam udāharaṇam iti yuktam sādhya tvāt iti dṛṣṭam iti ced na tad viṣayasya parīkṣā upapatteḥ yat api manyeta dṛṣṭam idam senā vana aṅgānām pṛthaktvasya agrahaṇāt abhedena ekam iti grahaṇam na ca dṛṣṭam śakyam pratyākhyātum iti tat ca na evam tad viṣayasya parīkṣā upapatteḥ darśana viṣayaḥ eva ayam parīkṣyate yaḥ ayam ekam iti pratyayaḥ dṛśyate sa parīkṣyate kim dravya antara viṣayaḥ vai atha aṇu sañcaya viṣayaḥ iti atra darśanam anyatarasya sādhakam na bhavati nānā bhāve ca aṇūnām pṛthaktvasya agrahaṇāt abhedena ekam iti grahaṇam atasmin tat iti pratyayaḥ yathā sthāṇau puruṣaḥ iti tatas kim

atasmin tat iti pratyayasya pradhāna apekṣi tvāt pradhāna siddhiḥ sthāṇau puruṣaḥ iti pratyayasya kim pradhānam saḥ asau puruṣe puruṣa pratyayaḥ tasmin sati puruṣa sāmānya grahaṇāt sthāṇau puruṣaḥ ayam iti evam nānā bhūteṣu ekam iti sāmānya grahaṇāt pradhāne sati bhavitum arhati pradhānam ca sarvasya agrahaṇāt iti na upapadyate tasmāt abhinnaḥ eva ayam abheda pratyayaḥ ekam iti

indriya antara viṣayeṣu abheda pratyayaḥ pradhānam iti ced na viśeṣa hetu abhāvāt dṛṣṭānta avyavasthā śrotra ādi viṣayeṣu śabda ādiṣu abhinneṣu eka pratyayaḥ pradhānam anekasmin eka pratyayasya iti evam ca sati dṛṣṭānta upādānam na vyavatiṣṭhate viśeṣa hetu abhāvāt aṇuṣu saṃśiteṣu eka pratyayaḥ kim atasmin tat iti pratyayaḥ sthāṇau puruṣa pratyaya vat atha arthasya tathā abhāvāt tasmin tat iti pratyayaḥ yathā śabdasya eka tvāt ekaḥ śabdaḥ iti viśeṣa hetu parigrahaṇam antareṇa dṛṣṭāntau saṃśayam āpādayate iti kumbha vat sañcaya mātram gandha ādayaḥ api iti anudāharaṇam gandha ādayaḥ iti

evam parimāṇa saṃyoga spanda jāti viśeṣa pratyayān api anuyoktavyaḥ teṣu ca evam prasaṅgaḥ iti ekatva buddhiḥ tasmin tat iti pratyayaḥ iti viśeṣa hetuḥ mahat iti pratyayena sāmānādhikaraṇyāt ekam idam mahat ca iti eka viṣayau pratyayau samāna adhikaraṇau bhavataḥ tena vijñāyate yat mahat tat ekam iti aṇu samūha atiśaya grahaṇam mahat pratyayaḥ iti ced saḥ ayam amahatsu aṇuṣu mahat pratyayaḥ atasmin tat iti pratyayaḥ bhavati iti kim ca atas atasmin tat iti pratyayasya pradhāna apekṣi tvāt pradhāna siddhiḥ iti bhavitavyam mahati eva mahat pratyayena iti

aṇuḥ śabdaḥ mahān iti ca vyavasāyāt pradhāna siddhiḥ iti ced na mandatīvra tā grahaṇam iyattā an avadhāraṇāt yathā dravye aṇuḥ śabdaḥ alpaḥ mandaḥ iti etasya grahaṇam mahan śabdaḥ paṭuḥ tīvraḥ iti etasya grahaṇam kasmāt iyattā an avadhāraṇāt na hi ayam mahān śabdaḥ iti vyavasyan iyān ayam iti avadhārayati yathā badara āmalaka bilva ādīni

saṃyukte ime iti ca dvi tva samāna āśraya prāpti grahaṇam dvau samudāyau āśrayaḥ saṃyogasya iti ced kaḥ ayam samudāyaḥ prāptiḥ anekasya anekā vā prāptiḥ ekasya samudāyaḥ iti ced prāpteḥ agrahaṇam prāpti āśritāyāḥ saṃyukte ime vastunī iti na atra dve prāptī saṃyukte gṛhyete aneka samūhaḥ samudāyaḥ iti ced na dvi tvena samāna adhikaraṇasya grahaṇāt dvau imau saṃyuktau arthau iti grahaṇe sati na aneka samūha āśrayaḥ saṃyogaḥ gṛhyate na ca dvayoḥ aṇvoḥ grahaṇam asti tasmāt mahatī dvi tva āśraya bhūte dravye saṃyogasya sthānam iti

pratyāsattiḥ pratīghāta avasānā saṃyogaḥ na artha antaram iti ced na artha antara hetu tvāt saṃyogasya śabda rūpa ādi spandānām hetuḥ saṃyogaḥ na ca dravyayoḥ guṇa antara upajananam antareṇa śabde rūpa ādiṣu spande ca kāraṇa tvam gṛhyate tasmāt guṇa antaram pratyaya viṣayaḥ ca artha antaram tat pratiṣedhaḥ vā kuṇḍalī guruḥ akuṇḍalaḥ chātre iti saṃyoga buddheḥ ca yadi artha antaram na viṣayaḥ artha antara pratiṣedhaḥ tarhi viṣayaḥ tatra pratiṣidhyamāna vacanam saṃyukte dravye iti yat artha antaram anyatra dṛṣṭam iha pratiṣidhyate tat vaktavyam iti dvayoḥ mahatoḥ āśritasya grahaṇāt na aṇvāśrayaḥ iti

jāti viśeṣasya pratyaya anuvṛtti liṅgasya apratyākhyānam pratyākhyāne vā pratyaya vyavasthā anupapattiḥ vyadhikaraṇasya anabhivyakteḥ adhikaraṇa vacanam aṇu samavasthānam viṣayaḥ iti ced prāpta aprāpta sāmarthya vacanam kim aprāpte aṇu samavasthāne tad āśrayaḥ jāti viśeṣaḥ gṛhyate atha prāpte iti aprāpte grahaṇam iti ced vyavahitasya aṇu samavasthānasya api upalabdhi prasaṅgaḥ vyavahite aṇu samavasthāne tad āśrayaḥ jāti viśeṣaḥ gṛhyeta prāpte grahaṇam iti ced madhya para bhāgayoḥ aprāptau anabhivyaktiḥ yāvat prāptam bhavati tāvatī abhivyaktiḥ iti ced tāvataḥ adhikaraṇa tvam aṇu samavasthānasya yāvati prāpte jāti viśeṣe gṛhyate tāvat asya adhikaraṇam iti prāptam bhavati tatra eka samudāye pratīyamāne artha bhedaḥ evam ca sati yaḥ ayam aṇu samudāyaḥ vṛkṣaḥ iti pratīyate tatra vṛkṣa bahu tvam pratīyeta yatra yatra hi aṇu samudāyasya bhāge vṛkṣa tvam gṛhyate sa sa vṛkṣaḥ iti tasmāt samudita aṇu samavasthānasya artha antarasya jāti viśeṣa abhivyakti viṣaya tvāt avayavi artha antara bhūtaḥ iti

parīkṣitam pratyakṣam anumānam idānīm parīkṣyate rodha upaghāta sādṛśyebhyaḥ vyabhicārāt anumānam apramāṇam apramāṇam iti ekadā api arthasya na pratipādakam iti rodhāt api nadī pūrṇā gṛhyate tadā ca upariṣṭāt vṛṣṭaḥ devaḥ iti mithyā anumānam nīḍa upaghātāt api pipīlikā aṇḍa sañcāraḥ bhavati tadā ca bhaviṣyati vṛṣṭiḥ iti mithyā anumānam iti puruṣaḥ api mayūra vāśitam anukaroti tadā api śabda sādṛśyāt mithyā anumānam bhavati

na eka deśa trāsa sādṛśyebhyaḥ artha antara bhāvāt na ayam anumāna vyabhicāraḥ ananumāne tu khalu ayam anumāna abhimānaḥ katham na aviśiṣṭaḥ liṅgam bhavitum arhati pūrva udaka viśiṣṭam khalu varṣa udakam śīgratara tvam srātasaḥ bahutara phena phala parṇa kāṣṭha ādi vahanam ca upalabhamānaḥ pūrṇa tvena nadyā upari vṛṣṭaḥ devaḥ iti anuminoti na udaka vṛddhi mātreṇa pipīlikā prāyasya aṇḍa sañcāre bhaviṣyati vṛṣṭiḥ iti anumīyate na kāsāñcid iti na idam mayūra vāśitam tad sadṛśaḥ ayam śabdaḥ iti viśeṣa aparijñānāt mithyā anumānam iti yaḥ tu sadṛśāt viśiṣṭāt śabdāt viśiṣṭa mayūra vāśitam gṛhṇāti tasya viśiṣṭaḥ arthaḥ gṛhyamāṇaḥ liṅgam yathā sarpa ādīnām iti saḥ ayam anumātuḥ aparādhaḥ na anumānasya yaḥ artha viśeṣeṇa anumeyam artham aviśiṣṭa artha darśanena bubhutsate iti

tri kāla viṣayam anumānam traikālya grahaṇāt iti uktam atas ca vartamāna abhāvaḥ patataḥ patita patitavya kāla upapatteḥ vṛntāt pracyutasya phalasya bhūmau pratyāsīdataḥ yat ūrdhvam sa patitaḥ adhvā tad saṃyuktaḥ kālaḥ patita kālaḥ yaḥ adhastāt sa patitavyaḥ adhvā tad saṃyuktaḥ kālaḥ patitavya kālaḥ na idānīm tṛtīyaḥ adhvā vidyate yatra patati iti vartamānaḥ kālaḥ gṛhyeta tasmāt vartamānaḥ kālaḥ na vidyate iti

tayoḥ api abhāvaḥ vartamāna abhāve tad apekṣa tvāt na adhva vyaṅgyaḥ kālaḥ kim tarhi kriyā vyaṅgyaḥ patati iti yadā patana kriyā vyuparatā bhavati sa kālaḥ patita kālaḥ yadā utpatsyate sa patitavya kālaḥ yadā dravye vartamānā kriyā gṛhyate sa vartamānaḥ kālaḥ yadi ca ayam dravye vartamānam patanam na gṛhṇāti kasya uparamam utpatsyamāna tām vā pratipadyate patitaḥ kālaḥ iti bhūtā kriyā patitavyaḥ kālaḥ iti ca utpatsyamānā kriyā ubhayoḥ kālayoḥ kriyā hīnam dravyam adhas patati iti kriyā sambaddham saḥ ayam kriyā dravyayoḥ sambandham gṛhṇāti iti vartamānaḥ kālaḥ tad āśrayau ca itarau kālau tat ahāve na syātām iti

atha api na atīta anāgatayoḥ itaretara apekṣā siddhiḥ yadi atīta anāgatau itaretara apekṣau sidhyetām pratipadyemahi vartamāna vilopam na atīta apekṣā anāgata siddhiḥ na api anāgata apekṣā atīta siddhiḥ kayā yuktyā kena kalpena atītaḥ katham atīta apekṣā anāgata siddhiḥ kena ca kalpena anāgataḥ iti na etat śakyam nirvaktum avyākaraṇīyam etat vartamāna lopaḥ iti yat ca manyeta hrasva dīrghayoḥ sthala nimnayoḥ chāyā ātapayoḥ ca yathā itara itara apekṣayā siddhiḥ evam atīta anāgatayoḥ iti tat na upapadyate viśeṣa hetu abhāvāt dṛṣṭānta vat pratidṛṣṭāntaḥ api prasajyate yathā rūpa sparśau gandharasau na itaretara apekṣau siddhi atas evam atīta anāgatau iti na itara itara apekṣā kasyacid siddhiḥ iti yasmāt eka abhāve ṇyatara abhāvāt ubhaya abhāvaḥ yadi ekasya anyatara apekṣā siddhiḥ anyatarasya idānīm kim apekṣā yadi anyatarasya eka apekṣā siddhiḥ ekasya idānīm kim apekṣā evam ekasya abhāve anyatarat na sidhyati iti ubhaya abhāvaḥ prasajyate

artha sadbhāva vyaṅgyaḥ ca ayam vartamānaḥ kālaḥ vidyate dravyam vidyate guṇaḥ vidyate karma iti yasya ca ayam na asti tasya vartamāna abhāve sarva agrahaṇam pratyakṣa anupapatteḥ pratyakṣam indriya artha sannikarṣa jam na ca avidyamānam asat indriyeṇa sat nikṛṣyate naca ayam vidyamānam sat kiñcid anujānāti pratyakṣa nimittam pratyakṣa viṣayaḥ pratyakṣa jñānam sarvam na upapadyate pratyakṣa anupapattau tad pūrvaka tvāt anumāna āgamayoḥ anupapattiḥ sarva pramāṇa vilope sarva grahaṇam na bhavati iti

ubhayathā ca vartamānaḥ kālaḥ gṛhyate kvacid artha sadbhāva vyaṅgyaḥ yathā asti dravyam iti kvacid kriyā santāna vyaṅgyaḥ yathā pacati chinatti iti nānāvidhā ca eka arthā kriyā kriyā santānaḥ kriyā abhyāsaḥ ca nānāvidhā ca eka arthā kriyā pacati iti sthālī adhiśrayaṇam udaka āsecanam taṇḍulā vapanam edhaḥ apasarpaṇam agni abhijvālanam darvī ghaṭṭanam maṇḍa srāvaṇam adhas avatāraṇam iti

chinatti iti kriyā abhyāsaḥ udyamya udyamya paraśum dāruṇi nipātayan chinatti iti ucyate yat ca idam pacyamānam chidyamānam ca tat kriyamāṇam tasmin kriyamāṇe kṛta tā kartavya tā upapatteḥ tu ubhayathā grahaṇam kriyā santānaḥ anārabdhaḥ cikīrṣitaḥ anāgataḥ kālaḥ pakṣyati iti prayojana avasānaḥ kriyā santāna uparamaḥ atītaḥ kālaḥ apākṣīt iti

ārabdha kriyā santānaḥ vartamānaḥ kālaḥ pacati iti tatra yā uparatā sā kṛta tā yā cikīrṣitā sā kartavyatā yā vidyamānā sā kriyamāṇa tā tat evam kriyā santāna sthaḥ traikālya samāhāraḥ pacati pacyate iti vartamāna grahaṇena gṛhyate kriyā santānasya hi atra avicchedaḥ abhidhīyate na ārambhaḥ na uparamaḥ iti saḥ ayam ubhayathā vartamānaḥ gṛhyate apavṛktaḥ vyapavṛktaḥ ca atīta anāgatābhyām sthiti vyaṅgyaḥ vidyate dravyam iti kriyā santānā viccheda abhidhāyī ca traikālya anvitaḥ pacati chinatti iti anyaḥ ca pratyāsatti prabhṛteḥ arthasya vivakṣāyām tad abhidhāyī bahu prakāraḥ lokeṣu utprekṣitavyaḥ tasmāt asti vartamānaḥ kālaḥ iti

atyanta prāya eka deśa sādharmyāt upamāna siddhiḥ atyanta sādharmyāt upamānam na sidhyati na ca evam bhavati yathā gauḥ evam gauḥ iti prāyas sādharmyāt upamānam na sidhyati na hi bhavati yathā anaḍvān evam mahiṣaḥ iti eka deśa sādharmyāt upamānam na sidhyati na hi sarveṇa sarvam upamīyate iti

prasiddha sādharmyāt upamāna siddheḥ yathā ukta doṣa anupapattiḥ na sādharmyasya kṛtsna prāya alpa bhāvam āśritya upamānam pravartate kim tarhi prasiddha sādharmyāt sādhya sādhana bhāvam āśritya pravartate yatra ca etat asti na tatra upamānam pratiṣeddhum śakyam tasmāt yathā ukta doṣaḥ na upapadyate iti
