astu tarhi upamānam anumānam pratyakṣeṇa apratyakṣa siddheḥ yathā dhūmena pratyakṣeṇa apratyakṣasya vahneḥ grahaṇam anumānam evam gavā pratyakṣeṇa apratyakṣasya gavayasya grahaṇam iti na idam anumānāt viśiṣyate

viśiṣyate iti āha kayā yuktyā na apratyakṣe gavaye pramāṇa artham upamānasya paśyāmaḥ yadā hi ayam upayukta upamānaḥ godarśī gavaya samānam artham paśyati tadā ayam gavayaḥ iti asya saṃjñā śabdasya vyavasthām pratipadyate na ca evam anumānam iti para artham ca upamānam yasya hi upamānam aprasiddham tad artham prasiddha ubhayena kriyate iti para artham upamānam iti ced na svayam adhyavasāyāt bhavati ca bhoḥ svayam adhyavasāyaḥ yathā gauḥ evam gavayaḥ iti na adhyavasāyaḥ pratiṣidhyate upamānam tu tat na bhavati prasiddha sādharmyāt sādhya sādhanam upamānam na ca yasya ubhayam prasiddham tam prati sādhya sādhana bhāvaḥ vidyate iti
atha api tathā iti upasaṃhārāt upamāna siddheḥ na aviśeṣaḥ tathā iti samāna dharma upasaṃhārāt upamānam sidhyati na anumānam ayam ca anayoḥ viśeṣaḥ iti

śabdaḥ anumānam arthasya anupalabdheḥ anumeya tvāt śabdaḥ anumānam na pramāṇa antaram kasmāt śabda arthasya anumeya tvāt katham anumeya tvam pratyakṣataḥ anupalabdheḥ yathā anupalabhyamānaḥ liṅgī mitena liṅgena paścāt mīyate iti anumānam evam mitena śabdena paścāt mīyate arthaḥ anupalabhyamānaḥ iti anumānam śabdaḥ

itas ca anumānam śabdaḥ upalabdheḥ at vipravṛtti tvāt pramāṇa antara bhāve dvi pravṛttiḥ upalabdhiḥ anyathā hi upalabdhiḥ anumāne anyathā upamāne tat vyākhyātam śabda anumānayoḥ tu upalabdhiḥ at vipravṛttiḥ yathā anumāne tathā śabde api viśeṣa abhāvāt anumānam śabdaḥ iti

sambandhāt ca śabdaḥ anumānam iti vartate sambaddhayoḥ ca śabda arthayoḥ sambandha prasiddhau śabda upalabdheḥ artha grahaṇam yathā sambaddhayoḥ liṅga liṅinoḥ sambandha pratītau liṅga upalabdhau liṅgi grahaṇam iti

yat tāvat arthasya anumeya tvāt iti tat na āpta upadeśa sāmarthyāt śabdāt artha sampratyayaḥ svargaḥ apsarasaḥ uttarāḥ kuravaḥ sapta dvīpāḥ samudraḥ loka sanniveśaḥ iti evamādeḥ apratyakṣasya arthasya ca śabda mātrāt pratyayaḥ kim tarhi āptaiḥ ayam uktāḥ śabdaḥ iti atas sampratyayaḥ viparyayeṇa sampratyaya abhāvāt na tu evam anumānam iti yat punar upalabdheḥ at vipravṛtti tvāt iti ayam eva śabda anumānayoḥ upalabdheḥ pravṛtti bhedaḥ tatra viśeṣe sati ahetuḥ viśeṣa abhāvāt iti

yat punar idam sambandhāt ca iti asti ca śabda arthayoḥ sambandhaḥ anujñātaḥ asti ca pratiṣiddhaḥ asya idam iti ṣaṣṭhī viśiṣṭasya vākyasya artha viśeṣaḥ anujñātaḥ prāpti lakṣaṇaḥ tu śabda arthayoḥ sambandhaḥ pratiṣiddhaḥ kasmāt pramāṇataḥ anupalabdheḥ pratyakṣataḥ tāvat śabda artha prāpteḥ na upalabdhiḥ atīndriya tvāt yena indriyeṇa gṛhyate śabdaḥ tasya viṣaya bhāvam ativṛttaḥ arthaḥ na gṛhyate asti ca ati indriya viṣaya bhūtaḥ api arthaḥ samānena ca indriyeṇa gṛhyamāṇayoḥ prāptiḥ gṛhyate iti

pūraṇa pradāha pāṭana anupalabdheḥ ca sambandha abhāvaḥ prāpti lakṣaṇe ca gṛhyamāṇe sambandhe śabda arthayoḥ śabda antike vā arthaḥ syāt artha antike vā śabdaḥ syāt ubhayam vā ubhayatra atha khalu ubhayam sthāna karaṇa abhāvāt iti ca arthaḥ na ca ayam anumānataḥ api upalabhyate śabda antike arthaḥ iti etasmin pakṣe api āsya sthāna karaṇa uccāraṇīyaḥ śabdaḥ tad antike arthaḥ iti anna agni asi śabda uccāraṇe pūraṇa pāha pāṭanāni gṛhyeran na ca gṛhyante agrahaṇāt na anumeyaḥ prāpti lakṣaṇaḥ sambandhaḥ artha antike śabdaḥ iti sthāna karaṇa asambhavāt anuccāraṇam sthānam kaṇṭha ādayaḥ karaṇam prayatna viśeṣaḥ tasya artha antike anupapattiḥ iti ubhaya pratiṣedhāt ca na ubhayam tasmāt na śabdena arthaḥ prāptaḥ iti

śabda artha vyavasthānāt apratiṣedhaḥ śabdāt artha pratyayasya vyavasthā darśanāt anumīyata asti śabda artha sambandhaḥ vyavasthā kāraṇam asambandhe hi śabda mātrāt artha mātre pratyaya prasaṅgaḥ tasmāt apratiṣedhaḥ sambandhasya iti

atra samādhiḥ na sāmāyika tvāt śabda artha sampratyayasya na sambandha kāritam śabda artha vyavasthānam kim tarhi samaya kāritam yat tat avocāma asya idam iti ṣaṣṭhī viśiṣṭasya vākyasya artha viśeṣaḥ anujñātaḥ śabda arthayoḥ sambandhaḥ iti samayam tam avocāmaḥ iti kaḥ punar ayam samayaḥ asya śabdasya idam artha jātam abhidheyam iti abhidhāna abhidheya niyama niyogaḥ tasmin upayukte śabdāt artha sampratyayaḥ bhavati viparyaye hi śabda śravaṇa api pratyaya abhāvaḥ sambandha vādinaḥ api ca ayam avarjanīya iti prayujyamāna grahaṇāt ca samaya upayogaḥ laukikānām samaya paripālana artham ca idam pada lakṣaṇāyāḥ vācā anvākhyānam vyākaraṇam vākya lakṣaṇāyāḥ vācaḥ artha lakṣaṇam pada samūhaḥ vākyam artha parisamā prau iti tat evam prāpti lakṣaṇasya śabda artha sambandhasya artha tuṣaḥ api anumāna hetuḥ na bhavati iti

jāti viśeṣe ca aniyamāt sāmāyikaḥ śabdāt artha sampratyayaḥ na svābhāvikaḥ ṛṣi āri amlecchānām yathākāmam śabda viniyogaḥ artha pratyāyanāya pravartate svābhāvike hi śabdasya artha pratyāyaka tve yathākāmam na syāt yathā taijasasya prakāśasya rūpa pratyaya hetu tvam na jāti viśeṣe vyabhicarati iti

putra kāma iṣṭi havana abhyāseṣu tad aprāmāṇyam anṛta vyāghāta punarukta doṣebhyaḥ tasya iti śabda viśeṣam eva adhikurute bhagavān ṛṣiḥ śabdasya pramāṇa tvam na sambhavati kasmāt anṛta doṣāt putra kameṣṭau putra kāmaḥ putra iṣṭyā yajeta iti na iṣṭau saṃsthitāyām putra janma dṛśyate dṛṣṭa arthasya vākyasya anṛta tvāt adṛṣṭa artham api vākyam agnihotram juhuyāt svarga kāmaḥ ityādi anṛtam iti jñāyate

vihita vyāghāta doṣāt ca havane udite hotavyam anudite hotavyam samaya adhyuṣite hotavyam iti vidhāya vihitam vyāhanti śyāvaḥ asya āhutim abhyavaharati yaḥ udite juhoti śabalaḥ asya āhutim abhyavaharati yaḥ anudite juhoti śyāva śabalau vā asya āhutim abhyavaharataḥ yaḥ samaya adhyuṣite juhoti vyāghātāt ca anyatarat mithyā iti punarukta doṣāt ca abhyāse deśyamāne tris prathamām anvāha tris uttamām iti punarukta doṣaḥ bhavati punaruktam ca pramatta vākyam iti tasmāt apramāṇam śabdaḥ anṛta vyāghāta punarukta doṣebhyaḥ iti

na karma kartṛ sādhana vaiguṇyāt na anṛta doṣaḥ putra kāma iṣṭau kasmāt karma kartṛ sādhana vaiguṇyāt iṣṭyā pitarau saṃyujyamānau putram janayate iti iṣṭeḥ karaṇam sādhanam pitarau kartārau saṃyogaḥ karma trayāṇām guṇa yogāt putra janma vaiguṇyāt viparyayaḥ iṣṭi āśrayam tāvat karma vaiguṇyam samīha abhreṣaḥ kartṛ vaiguṇyam avidvān prayoktā kapūya ācaraṇaḥ ca

sādhana vaiguṇyam haviḥ asaṃkṛtam upahatam iti mantrāḥ nyūna adhikāḥ svara varṇa hīnāḥ iti dakṣiṇā durāgatā hīnā ninditā ca iti atha upajana āśrayam karma vaiguṇyam mithyā samprayogaḥ kartṛ vaiguṇyam yoni vyāpadaḥ bīja upaghātaḥ ca iti sādhana vaiguṇyam iṣṭau abhihitam loke ca agni kāmaḥ dāruṇī mathnīyāt iti vidhi vākyam tatra karma vaiguṇyam mithyā abhimanthanam kartṛ vaiguṇyam prajñā prayatnataḥ pramādaḥ sādhana vaiguṇyam ārdram suṣiram dā iti tatra phalam na niṣpadyate iti na anṛta doṣaḥ guṇa yogena phala niṣpatti darśanāt na ca idam laukikāt bhidyate putra kāmaḥ putra iṣṭyā yajeta iti

abhyupetya kāla bhede doṣa vacanāt na vyāghātaḥ havanaḥ iti anuvartate yaḥ abhyupagatam havana kālam bhinatti tatas anyatra juhoti tatra ayam abhyupagata kāla bhede doṣaḥ ucyate śyāvaḥ asya āhutim abhyavaharati yaḥ udite juhoti tat idam vidhi bhreṣe nindā vacanam iti

anuvāda upapatteḥ ca punarukta doṣaḥ abhyāse na iti prakṛtam anarthakaḥ abhyāsaḥ punar uktam arthavān abhyāsaḥ anuvādaḥ yaḥ ayam abhyāsaḥ tris prathamām anvāha tris uttamām iti anuvādaḥ upapadyate arthavat tvāt tris vacanena hi prathama uttamayoḥ pañcadaśa tvam sāmidhenīnām bhavati tathā ca mantra abhivādaḥ idam aham bhrātṛvyam pañcadaśa avareṇa vāc vajreṇa avabodhe yaḥ asmān dveṣṭi yam ca vayam dviṣmaḥ iti pañcadaśa sāmidhenīḥ vajramantraḥ abhivadati tat abhyāsam antareṇa na syāt iti
vākya vibhāgasya ca artha grahaṇāt pramāṇam śabdaḥ yathā loke
vibhāgaḥ ca brāhmaṇa vākyānām trividhaḥ vidhi artha vāda anuvāda vacana viniyogāt tridhā khalu brāhmaṇa vākyāni viniyuktāni vidhivacanāni arthavāda vacanāni anuvāda vacanāni iti
tatra vidhiḥ vidhāyakaḥ yat vākyam vidhāyakam ca udakam sa vidhiḥ vidhiḥ tu niyogaḥ anujñā vā yathā agnihotram juhuyāt svarga kāmaḥ ityādi

stutiḥ nindā para kṛtiḥ purākalpaḥ iti artha vādaḥ vidheḥ phala vāda lakṣaṇā yā praśaṃsā sā stutiḥ sampratyaya arthā stūyamānam śraddadhīta iti pravartikā ca phala śravaṇāt pravartate sarva jitāḥ vai devāḥ sarvam ajayan sarvasya āptyai sarvasya jityai sarvam eva etena āptena āpnoti sarvam jayati iti evamādi aniṣṭa phala vādaḥ nindā varjana arthāḥ ninditam na samācaret iti

saḥ eṣa vāva prathamaḥ yajñaḥ yajñānām yat jotiṣṭomaḥ yaḥ etena ādiṣṭvā anyana yajate garttapatyam eva tat jīyate vā pramīyate vā iti evamādiḥ anya kartṛkasya vyāhatasya vidheḥ vādaḥ para kṛtiḥ hutvā vapām eva agre abhighārayanti atha pṛṣat ājyam tat uha caraka adhvaryavaḥ pṛṣadājyam eva agre abhidhārayanti agneḥ prāṇāḥ pṛṣadājya stomam iti evam abhidadhati iti evamādi aitihya samācaritaḥ vidhiḥ purākalpaḥ iti tasmāt vai etena brāhmaṇāḥ bahis pavamānam sāmastomama stoṣan yone yajñam pratanavāmahe iti evamādi katham purā ākṛti purā kalpau artha vādau iti stuti nindā vākyena abhisambandhāt vidhi āśrayasya kasyacid arthasya dyotanāt artha vādaḥ iti

vidhi vihitasya anuvacanam anuvādaḥ vidhi anuvacanam ca anuvādaḥ vihita anuvacanam ca pūrvaḥ śabda anuvādaḥ aparaḥ artha anuvādaḥ yathā punar uktam dvividham evam anuvādaḥ api kimartham punar vihitam anūdyate adhikāra artham vihitam adhikṛtya stutiḥ bodhyate nindā vā vidhi śeṣaḥ vā abhidhīyate vihita anantara arthaḥ api ca anuvādā bhavati evam anyat api utprekṣaṇīyam

loke api ca vidhiḥ artha vādaḥ anuvādaḥ iti ca trividham vākyam odanam pacet iti vidhi vākyam arthavāda vākyam āyuḥ varcaḥ balam sukham pratibhānam ca anne pratiṣṭhitam anuvādaḥ pacatu pacatu bhavān iti abhyāsaḥ kṣipram pacyatām iti vā aṅga pacyatām iti adhyeṣaṇa artham pacyatām eva iti ca avadhāraṇa artham yathā laukike vākye vibhāgena artha grahaṇāt pramāṇa tvam evam veda vākyānām api vibhāgena artha grahaṇāt pramāṇa tvam bhavitum arhati iti

na anuvāda punaruktayoḥ viśeṣaḥ śabda abhyāsa upapatteḥ punaruktam asādhu sādhuḥ anuvādaḥ iti ayam viśeṣaḥ na upapadyate kasmāt ubhayatra hi pratīta arthaḥ śabdaḥ abhyasyate caritārthasya śabdasya abhyāsāt ubhayam asādhu iti

śīghratara gamana upadeśa vat abhyāsāt na aviśeṣaḥ na anuvāda punaruktayoḥ aviśeṣaḥ kasmāt arthavataḥ abhyāsasya anuvāda bhāvāt arthavān abhyāsaḥ anuvādaḥ śīghratara gamana upadeśa vat śīghram śīghram gamyatām iti kriyā atiśayaḥ abhyāsena eva ucyate udāharaṇa artham ca idam evam anyaḥ api abhyāsaḥ pacati pacati iti kriyā anuparamaḥ grāmaḥ grāmaḥ ramanīyaḥ iti vyāptiḥ pari pari trigartebhyaḥ vṛṣṭaḥ devaḥ iti parivarjanam adhi adhi kuḍyam niṣaṇṇam iti sāmīpyam tiktam tiktam iti prakāraḥ evam anuvādasya stuti nindā śeṣa vidhiṣu adhikāra artha tā vihita anantara artha tā ca iti

kim punar pratiṣedha hetu uddhārāt eva śabdasya pramāṇa tvam sidhyati na atas ca mantra āyurveda prāmāṇya vat ca tad prāmāṇyam āpta prāmāṇyāt kim punar āyurvedasya prāmāṇyam yat tat āyurvedena upadiśyate idam kṛtvā iṣṭam adhigacchati idam varjayitvā aniṣṭam jahāti tasya anuṣṭhīyamānasya tathā abhāvaḥ satya artha tā viparyayaḥ mantra padānām ca viṣaya bhūta aśani pratiṣedha arthānām prayoge arthasya tathā abhāvaḥ etat prāmāṇyam kiṃkṛtam etat āpta prāmāṇya kṛtam kim punar āptānām prāmāṇyam sākṣātkṛta dharmatā bhūta dayā yathābhūta artha cikhyā payiṣā iti

āptāḥ khalu sākṣātkṛta dharmāṇaḥ idam hātavyam idam asya hāni hetuḥ idam asya adhigantavyam idam asya adhigama hetuḥ iti bhūtāni anukampante teṣām khalu vai prāṇabhṛtām svayam anavabudhyamānānām na anyat upadeśāt avabodha kāraṇam asti na ca anavabodhe samīhā varjanam vā na vā akṛtvā svastibhāvaḥ na api asya anyaḥ upakārakaḥ api asti hanta vayam ebhyaḥ yathādarśanam yathābhūtam upadiśyāmaḥ te ime śrutvā pratipadyamānāḥ heyam hāsyanti adhigantavyam eva adhigamiṣyanti iti evam āpta upadeśaḥ etena trividhena āpta prāmāṇyena parigṛhītaḥ anuṣṭhīyamānaḥ arthasya sādhakaḥ bhavati evam āpta upadeśaḥ pramāṇam evam āptāḥ pramāṇam

dṛṣṭa arthena āpta upadeśena āyurvedena adṛṣṭa arthaḥ veda bhāgaḥ anumātavyaḥ pramāṇam iti āpta prāmāṇyasya hetoḥ samāna tvāt iti asya api ca eka deśaḥ grāma kāmaḥ yajeta iti evamādiḥ dṛṣṭa arthaḥ tena anumātavyam iti loke ca bhūyān upadeśa āśrayaḥ vyavahāraḥ laukikasya api upadeṣṭuḥ upadeṣṭavya artha jñānena para anujighṛkṣayā yathābhūta artha cikhyā apayiṣayā ca prāmāṇyam tad parigrahāt āpta upadeśaḥ pramāṇam iti

draṣṭṛ pravaktṛ sāmānyāt ca anumānam yaḥ eva āptāḥ veda arthānām draṣṭāraḥ pravaktāraḥ ca te eva āyurveda prabhṛtīnām iti āyurveda prāmāṇya vat veda prāmāṇyam anumātavyam iti nitya tvāt veda vākyānām pramāṇa tve tad prāmāṇyam āpta prāmāṇyāt iti ayuktam śabdasya vācaka tvāt artha pratipattau pramāṇa tvam na nitya tvāt nitya tve hi sarvasya sarveṇa vacanāt śabda artha vyavasthā anupapattiḥ na anitya tve vācaka tvam iti ced na laukikeṣu adarśanāt te api nityāḥ iti ced na anāpta upadeśāt artha visaṃvādaḥ anupapannaḥ nitya tvāt dhi śabdaḥ pramāṇam iti

anityaḥ saḥ iti ced aviśeṣa vacanam anāpta upadeśaḥ laukikaḥ na nityaḥ iti kāraṇam vācyam iti yathāyogam ca arthasya pratyāyanāt nāmadheya śabdānām loke prāmāṇyam nitya tvāt prāmāṇya anupapattiḥ yatra arthe nāmadheya śabdaḥ niyujyate loke tasya niyoga sāmarthyāt pratyāyakaḥ bhavati na nitya tvāt manvantara yugāntantareṣu ca atīta anāgateṣu sampradāya abhyāsa prayoga avicchedaḥ vedānām nitya tvam āpta prāmāṇyāt ca prāmāṇyam laukikeṣu śabdeṣu ca etat samānam iti

ayathārthaḥ pramāṇa uddeśaḥ iti matvā āha na catuṣṭvam aitihya arthāpatti sambhava abhāva prāmāṇyāt na catvāri eva pramāṇāni kim tarhi aitihyam arthāpattiḥ sambhavaḥ abhāvaḥ iti etāni api pramāṇāni tāni kasmāt na uktāni itiha ūcuḥ iti anirdiṣṭa pravaktṛkam pravāda pāramparyam aitihyam arthāt āpattiḥ arthāpattiḥ āpattiḥ prāptiḥ prasaṅgaḥ yatra abhidhīyamāne arthe yaḥ anyaḥ arthaḥ prasajyate saḥ arthāpattiḥ yathā megheṣu asatsu vṛṣṭiḥ na bhavati iti

kim atra prasajyate satsu bhavati iti sambhavaḥ nāma avinābhāvinaḥ arthasya sattā grahaṇāt anyasya sattā grahaṇam yathā droṇasya sattā grahaṇāt āḍhakasya sattā grahaṇam āḍakasya sattā grahaṇāt prasthasya iti abhāvaḥ virodhi abhūtam bhūtasya avidyamānam varṣa karma vidyamānasya vāyu abhra saṃyogasya pratipādakam vidhārake hi vāyu abhra saṃyoge guru tvāt apām patana karma na bhavati iti

satyam etāni pramāṇāni na tu pramāṇa antarāṇi pramāṇa antaram ca manyamānena pratiṣedhaḥ ucyate saḥ ayam śabdaḥ aitihya anartha antara bhāvāt anumāne arthāpatti sambhava abhāva anartha antara bhāvāt ca apratiṣedhaḥ anupapannaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ katham āpta upadeśaḥ śabdaḥ iti na ca śabda lakṣaṇam aitihyāt vyāvartate saḥ ayam bhedaḥ sāmānyāt saṃgṛhyate iti pratyakṣeṇa apratyakṣasya sambaddhasya pratipattiḥ anumānam

tathā ca arthāpatti sambhava abhāvaḥ vākya artha sampratyayena anabhihitasya arthasya pratyanīka bhāvāt grahaṇam arthāpattiḥ anumānam eva avinā abhāva vṛttyā ca sambaddhayoḥ samudāya samudāyinoḥ samudāyena itarasya grahaṇam sambhavaḥ tat api anumānam eva asmin sati idam na upapadyate iti virodhi tve prasiddhe kārya anupapattyā kāraṇasya pratibandhakam anumīyate saḥ ayam yathārthaḥ eva pramāṇa uddeśaḥ iti

satyam etāni pramāṇāni na tu pramāṇa antarāṇi iti uktam atra arthāpatteḥ pramāṇa bhāva abhyanujñā na upapadyate tathā hi iyam arthāpattiḥ apramāṇam anaikāntika tvāt asatsu megheṣu vṛṣṭiḥ na bhavati iti satsu bhavati iti etat arthāt āpadyate satsu api ca ekadā na bhavati sā iyam arthāpattiḥ apramāṇam iti

na anaikāntika tvam arthāpatteḥ anartha āpattau arthāpatti abhimānāt asati kāraṇe kāryam na utpadyate iti vākyāt pratyanīka bhūtaḥ arthaḥ sati kāraṇe kāryam utpadyate iti arthāt āpadyate abhāvasya hi bhāvaḥ pratyanīkaḥ iti saḥ ayam kārya utpādaḥ sati kāraṇe arthāt āpadyamānaḥ na kāraṇasya sattām vyabhicarati na khalu asati kāraṇe kāryam utpadyate tasmāt na anā ekāntikī

yat tu sati kāraṇe nimitta pratibandāt kāryam na utpadyate iti kāraṇa dharmaḥ asau na tu arthāpatteḥ prameyam kim tarhi asyāḥ prameyam sati kāraṇe kāryam utpadyate iti yaḥ asau kārya utpādaḥ kāraṇasya sattām na vyabhicatati tat asyāḥ prameyam evam tu sati anartha āpattau arthāpatti abhimānam kṛtvā pratiṣedhaḥ ucyate iti

pratiṣedha aprāmāṇyam ca anaikāntika tvāt arthāpattiḥ na pramāṇam anaikāntika tvāt iti vākyam pratiṣedhaḥ tena anena arthāpatteḥ pramāṇa tvam pratiṣidhyate na sadbhāvaḥ evam anaikāntikaḥ bhavati anaikāntika tvāt apramāṇena anena na kaścid arthaḥ pratiṣidhyate iti

atha manyase niyata viṣayeṣu artheṣu sva viṣaye vyabhicāraḥ bhavati na ca pratiṣedhasya sadbhāvaḥ viṣayaḥ evam tarhi tad prāmāṇye vā na arthāpatti aprāmāṇyam arthāpatteḥ api kārya utpādena kāraṇa sattāyāḥ avyabhicāraḥ viṣayaḥ na ca kāraṇa dharmaḥ nimitta pratibandhāt kārya anutpādaka tvam iti
abhāvasya tarhi pramāṇa bhāva abhyanujñā na upapadyate katham iti na abhāva prāmāṇyam prameya asiddheḥ abhāvasya bhūyasi prameye loka siddhe vaiyātyāt ucyate na abhāva prāmāṇyam prameya asiddheḥ iti

atha ayam artha bahu tvāt artha eka deśaḥ udāhriyate lakṣiteṣu alakṣaṇa lakṣita tvāt alakṣitānām tat prameya siddheḥ tasya abhāvasya sidhyati prameyam katham lakṣiteṣu vāsaḥsu anupādeyeṣu upādeyānām alakṣitānām alakṣaṇa lakṣita tvāt lakṣaṇa abhāvena lakṣita tvāt iti ubhaya sannidhau alakṣitāni vāsāṃsi ānaya iti prayuktaḥ yeṣu vāsaḥsu lakṣaṇāni na bhavanti tāni lakṣaṇa abhāvena pratipadyate pratipadya ca ānayati pratipatti hetuḥ ca pramāṇam iti

asati arthe na abhāvaḥ iti ced na anya lakṣaṇa upapatteḥ yatra bhūtvā kiñcid na bhavati tatra tasya abhāvaḥ upapadyate na ca ālakṣiteṣu vāsaḥsu lakṣitāni bhūtvā na bhavanti tasmāt teṣu lakṣaṇa abhāvaḥ anupapannaḥ iti na anya lakṣaṇa upapatteḥ yathā ayam anyeṣu vāsaḥsu lakṣaṇānām upapattim paśyati na evam alakṣiteṣu saḥ ayam lakṣaṇa abhāvam paśyan abhāvena artham pratipadyate iti

tad siddheḥ alakṣiteṣu ahetuḥ teṣu vāsaḥsu lakṣiteṣu siddhiḥ vidhyamāna tā yeṣām bhavati na teṣām abhāvaḥ lakṣaṇānām yāni ca lakṣiteṣu vidyante lakṣaṇāni teṣām alakṣiteṣu abhāvaḥ iti ahetuḥ yāni khalu bhavanti teṣām abhāvaḥ vyāhate iti

na lakṣaṇa avasthita apekṣa siddheḥ na brūmaḥ yāni lakṣaṇāni bhavanti teṣām abhāvaḥ iti kin tu keṣucid lakṣaṇāni avasthitāni anavasthitāni keṣucid apekṣamāṇaḥ yeṣu lakṣaṇānām bhāvam na paśyati tāni lakṣaṇa abhāvena pratipadyate iti

prāk utpatteḥ abhāva upapatteḥ ca abhāva dvaitam khalu bhavati prāk ca utpatteḥ avidyamāna tā utpannasya ca ātmanaḥ hānāt avidyamāna tā tatra ālakṣiteṣu vāsaḥsu prāk utpatteḥ avidyamāna tā lakṣaṇaḥ lakṣaṇānām abhāvaḥ na itaraḥ iti

āpta upadeśaḥ śabdaḥ iti pramāṇa bhāve viśeṣaṇam bruvatā nānā prakāraḥ śabdaḥ iti jñāpyate tasmin sāmanyena vicāraḥ kim nityaḥ atha anityaḥ iti vimarśa hetu anuyoge ca vipratipatteḥ saṃśayaḥ ākāśa guṇaḥ śabdaḥ vibhuḥ nityaḥ abhivyakti dharmakaḥ iti eke gandha ādi saha vṛttiḥ dravyeṣu sanniviṣṭaḥ gandha ādi vat avasthitaḥ abhivyakti dharmakaḥ iti apare

ākāśa guṇaḥ śabdaḥ utpatti nirodha dharmakaḥ buddhi vat iti apare mahābhūta saṃkṣobha jaḥ śabdaḥ anāśritaḥ utpatti dharmakaḥ nirodha dharmakaḥ iti anye atas saṃśayaḥ kim atra tattvam iti anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti uttaram katham ādhimat tvāt aindriyaka tvāt kṛtaka vat upacārāt ca ādiḥ yoniḥ kāraṇam ādīyate asmāt iti kāraṇa vat anityam dṛṣṭam saṃyoga vibhāga jaḥ ca śabdaḥ kāraṇavat tvāt anityaḥ iti kā punar iyam artha deśanā kāraṇavat tvāt iti utpatti dharmaka tvāt anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti bhūtvā na bhavati vināśa dharmakaḥ iti

sāṃśayikam etat kim utpatti kāraṇam saṃyoga vibhāgau śabdasya āhosvit abhivyakti kāraṇam iti atas āha aindriyaka tvāt indriya pratyāsattigrāhya aindriyakaḥ kim ayam vyañjakena samāna deśaḥ abhivyajyate rūpa ādi vat atha saṃyoga jāt śabdāt śabda santāne sati śrotra pratyāsannaḥ gṛhyate iti saṃyoga nivṛttau śabda grahaṇāt na vyañjakena samāna deśasya grahaṇam dāru vraścane dāruparaśu saṃyoga nivṛttau dūra sthena śabdaḥ gṛhyate na ca vyañjaka abhāve vyaṅgya grahaṇam bhavati tasmāt na vyañjakaḥ saṃyogaḥ utpādake tu saṃyoge saṃyoga jāt śabdāt śabda santāne sati śrotra pratyāsannasya grahaṇam iti yuktam saṃyoga nivṛttau śabdasya grahaṇam iti

itas ca śabdaḥ utpadyate na abhivyajyate kṛtaka vat upacārāt tīvram mandam iti kṛtakam upacaryate tīvram sukham mandam sukham tīvram duḥkham mandam duḥkham iti upacaryate ca tīvraḥ śabdaḥ mandaḥ śabdaḥ iti vyañjakasya tathā abhāvāt grahaṇasya tīvra manda tā rūpavat iti ced na abhibhava upapatteḥ saṃyogasya vyañjakasya tīvra manda tayā śabda grahaṇasya tīvra manda tā bhavati na tu śabdaḥ bhidyate yathā prakāśasya tīvra manda tayā rūpa grahaṇasya iti tat ca na evam abhibhava upapatteḥ tīvraḥ bherī śabdaḥ mandam tantrī śabdam abhibhavati na mandaḥ na ca śabda grahaṇam abhibhāvakam śabdaḥ ca na bhidyate śabde tu bhidyamāne yuktaḥ abhibhavaḥ tasmāt utpadyate śabdaḥ na abhivyajyate iti

abhibhava anupapattiḥ ca vyañjaka samāna deśasya abhivyaktau prāpti abhāvāt vyañjakena samāna deśe abhivyajyate śabdaḥ iti etasmin pakṣe na upapadyate abhibhavaḥ na hi bherī śabdena tantrī svanaḥ prāptaḥ iti aprāpte abhibhavaḥ iti ced śabda mātra abhibhava prasaṅgaḥ atha manyeta asatyām prāptau abhibhavaḥ bhavati iti evam sati yathā bherī śabdaḥ kañcid tantrī svanam abhibhavati evam antika stha upādānam iva davīyaḥ sthaḥ pādānān api tantrī svanān abhibhavet aprāpteḥ aviśeṣāt tatra kvacid eva bheryām praṇāditāyām sarva lokeṣu samāna kālāḥ tantrī svanāḥ na śrūyeran iti nānā bhūteṣu śabda santāneṣu satsu śrotra pratyāsatti bhāvena kasyacid śabdasya tīvreṇa mandasya abhibhavaḥ yuktaḥ iti kaḥ punar ayam abhibhavaḥ nāma grāhya samāna jātīya grahaṇa kṛtam agrahaṇam abhibhavaḥ yathā ulkā prakāśasya grahaṇa arhasya āditya prakāśena iti

na ghaṭa abhāva sāmānya nitya tvāt nityeṣu api anitya vat upacārāt ca na khalu ādimattvāt anityaḥ śabdaḥ kasmāt vyabhicārāt ādimataḥ khalu ghaṭa abhāvasya dṛṣṭam nitya tvam katham ādimān kāraṇa vibhāgebhyaḥ hi ghaṭaḥ na bhavati katham asya nitya tvam yaḥ asau kāraṇa vibhāgebhyaḥ na bhavati na tasya abhāvaḥ bhāvena kadācid nivartyate iti yat api aindriyaka tvāt tat api vyabhicarati aindriyakam ca sāmānyam nityam ca iti yat api kṛtaka vat upacārāt iti etat api vyabhicarati nityeṣu anitya vat upacāraḥ dṛṣṭaḥ tathā hi bhavati vṛkṣasya pradeśaḥ kambalasya pradeśaḥ evam ākāśasya pradeśaḥ ātmanaḥ pradeśaḥ iti bhavati iti

tattva bhāktayoḥ nānātvasya vibhāgāt avyabhicāraḥ nityam iti atra kim tāvat tattvam artha antarasya anutpatti dharmakasya ātma hāna anupapattiḥ nitya tvam tat ca abhāve na upapadyate bhāktam tu bhavati yat tatra ātmānam ahāsīt yat bhūtvā na bhavati na jātu tat punar bhavati tatra nityaḥ iva nityaḥ ghaṭa abhāvaḥ iti ayam padārthaḥ iti tatra yathājātīyakaḥ śabdaḥ na tathājātīyakam kāryam kiṃcid nityam dṛśyate iti avyabhicāraḥ

yat api sāmānya nitya tvāt iti indriya pratyāsatti grāhyam aindriyakam iti santāna anumāna viśeṣaṇāt nityeṣu avyabhicāraḥ iti prakṛtam na indriya grahaṇa sāmarthyāt śabdasya anitya tvam kim tarhi indriya pratyāsatti grāhya tvāt santāna anumānam tena anitya tvam iti

yat api nityeṣu api anitya vat upacārāt iti na kāraṇa dravyasya pradeśa śabdena abhidhānāt nityeṣu api avyabhicāraḥ iti evam ākāśa pradeśaḥ ātma pradeśaḥ iti na atra ākāśa ātmanoḥ kāraṇa dravyam abhidhīyate yathā kṛtakasya katham hi avidyamānam abhidhīyate avidyamāna tā ca pramāṇataḥ anupalabdheḥ kim tarhi tatra abhidhīyate saṃyogasya avyāpya vṛtti tvam paricchinnena dravyena ākāśasya saṃyogaḥ na ākāśam vyāpnoti avyāpya vartate iti tat asi kṛtakena dravyeṇa sāmānyam na hi āmalakayoḥ saṃyogaḥ āśrayam vyāpnoti sāmānya kṛtā ca bhaktiḥ ākāśasya pradeśaḥ iti anena ātma pradeśaḥ vyākhyātaḥ saṃyoga vat ca śabda buddhi ādīnām avyāpya vṛtti tvam iti parīkṣitā ca tīvra manda tā śabda tattvam na bhakti kṛta iti kasmāt punar sūtrakārasya asmin arthe sūtram na śrūyate iti śīlam idam bhagavataḥ sūtrakārasya bahuṣu adhikaraṇeṣu dvau pakṣau na vyavasthāpayati tatra śāstra siddhāntāt tattva avadhāraṇam pratipattum arhati iti manyate śāstra siddhāntaḥ tu nyāya samākhyātam anumatam bahu śākham anumānam iti

atha api khalu idam asti idam na asti iti kutas etat pratipattavyam iti pramāṇataḥ upalabdheḥ anupalabdheḥ ca iti avidyamānaḥ tarhi śabdaḥ prāk uccāraṇāt anupalabdheḥ āvaraṇa ādi anupalabdheḥ ca prāk uccāraṇāt na asti śabdaḥ kasmāt anupalabdheḥ sataḥ nupalabdhiḥ āvaraṇa ādibhyaḥ etat na upapadyate kasmāt āvaraṇa ādīnām anupalabdhi kāraṇānām agrahaṇāt anena āvṛtaḥ śabdaḥ na upalabhyata asannikṛṣṭaḥ ca indriya vyavadhānāt iti evamādi anupalabdhi kāraṇam na gṛhyate iti saḥ ayam anuccāritaḥ na asti iti uccāraṇam asya vyañjakam tad abhāvāt prāk uccāraṇāt anupalabdhiḥ iti kim idam uccāraṇam nāma iti vivakṣā janitena prayatnena koṣṭhyasya vāyoḥ preritasya kaṇṭha tālu ādi pratighātaḥ yathāsthānam pratighātāt varṇa abhivyaktiḥ iti saṃyoga viśeṣaḥ vai pratighātaḥ pratiṣiddham ca saṃyogasya vyañjaka tvam tasmāt na vyañjaka abhāvāt agrahaṇam api tu abhāvāt eva iti saḥ ayam uccāryamāṇaḥ śrūyate śrūyamāṇaḥ ca abhūtvā bhavati iti anumīyate ūrdhvam ca uccāraṇāt na śrūyate sa bhūtvā na bhavati abhāvāt na śrūyate iti katham āvaraṇa ādi anupalabdheḥ iti uktam tasmāt utpatti tiraḥ bhāva dharmakaḥ śabdaḥ iti

evam ca sati tattvam pāṃśubhiḥ iva avakiran idam āha tad anupalabdheḥ anupalambhāt āvaraṇa upapattiḥ yadi anupalambhāt āvaraṇam na asti āvaraṇa anupalabdhiḥ api tarhi anupalambhāt na asti iti tasyāḥ abhāvāt apratiṣiddham āvaraṇam iti katham punar jānīte bhavān na āvaraṇa anupalabdhiḥ upalabhyate iti

kim atra jñeyam pratyātma vedanīya tvāt samānam ayam khalu āvaraṇam anupalambhamānaḥ pratyātmam eva saṃvedayate na āvaraṇam upalabhaḥ iti yathā kuḍyena āvṛtasya āvaraṇam upalabhamānaḥ pratyātmam eva saṃvedayate sā iyam āvaraṇa upalabdhi vat āvaraṇa anupalabdhiḥ api saṃvedya eva iti evam ca sati apahṛta viṣayam uttara vākyam asti iti

abhyanujñā vādena tu ucyate jāti vādinā anupalambhāt api anupalabdhi sadbhāvāt na āvaraṇa anupapattiḥ anupalambhāt yathā anupalambhamānā api āvaraṇa anupalabdhiḥ asti evam anupalabhyamānam api āvaraṇam asti iti yadi abhyanujānāti bhavān anupalabhyamāna āvaraṇa anupalabdhiḥ asti iti abhyanujñāya ca vadati na asti āvaraṇam anupalambhāt iti etasmin api abhyanujñā vāde pratipatti niyamaḥ na upapadyate iti

anupalambha ātmaka tvāt anupalabdheḥ ahetuḥ yat upalabhyate tat asti yat na upalabhyate tat na asti iti anupalambha ātmakam asat iti vyavasthitam upalabdhi abhāvaḥ ca anupalabdhiḥ iti sā iyam abhāva tvāt na upalabhyate sat ca khalu āvaraṇam tasya upalabdhyā bhavitavyam na ca upalabhyate tasmāt na asti iti tatra yat uktam na āvaraṇa anupapattiḥ anupalambhāt iti ayuktam iti
atha śabdasya nitya tvam pratijānānaḥ kasmāt dhetoḥ pratijānīte asparśa tvāt asparśam ākāśam nityam dṛṣṭam iti tathā ca śabdaḥ iti
saḥ ayam ubhayatas savyabhicāraḥ sparśavān ca aṇuḥ nityaḥ asparśam ca karma anityam dṛṣṭam asparśa tvāt iti etasya sādhya sādharmyeṇa udāharaṇam na karma anitya tvāt sādhya vaidharmyeṇa udāharaṇam
na aṇu nitya tvāt ubhayasmin udāharaṇe vyabhicārāj na hetuḥ
ayam tarhi hetuḥ sampradānāt sampradīyamānam avasthitam dṛṣṭam sampradīyate ca śabdaḥ ācaryeṇa antevāsane tasmāt avasthitaḥ iti

tad antarāla anupalabdheḥ ahetuḥ yena sampradīyate yasmai ca tayoḥ antarāle avasthānam asya kena liṅgena upalabhyate sampradīyamānaḥ ahi avasthitaḥ sampradātuḥ apaiti sampradānam ca prāpnoti iti avarjanīyam etat
adhyāpanāt apratiṣedhaḥ adhyayanam liṅgam asati sampradāne adhyāpanam na syāt iti

ubhayoḥ pakṣayoḥ anyatarasya adhyāpanāt apratiṣedhaḥ samānam adhyāpanam ubhayoḥ pakṣayoḥ saṃśaya anivṛtteḥ kim ācārya sthaḥ śabdaḥ antevāsinam āpadyate tat adhyāpanam āhosvit nṛtya upadeśa vat gṛhītasya anukaraṇam adhyāpanam iti evam adhyāpanam aliṅgam sampradānasya iti

ayam tarhi hetuḥ abhyāsāt abhyasyamānam avasthitam dṛṣṭam pañca kṛtvas paśyati iti rūpam avasthitam punar punar dṛśyate bhavati ca śabde abhyāsaḥ daśa kṛtvas adhītaḥ anuvākaḥ viṃśati kṛtvas adhītaḥ iti tasmāt avasthitasya punar punar uccāraṇam abhyāse iti
na anya tve api abhyāsasya upacārāt anavasthāne api abhyāsasya abhidhānam bhavati dvis nṛtyatu bhavān tris nṛtyatu bhavān iti dvis anṛtyat tris anṛtyat dvis agnihotram juhoti dvis bhuṅkte

evam vyabhicārāt pratiṣiddha hetau anya śabdasya prayogaḥ pratiṣidhyate anyat anyasmāt ananya tvāt ananyat iti anya tā bhāvaḥ yat idam anyat iti manyase tat sva arthena ananya tvāt anyat na bhavati evam anyatāyāḥ abhāvaḥ tatra yat uktam anya tve api abhyāsa upacārāt iti etat ayuktam iti

śabda prayogam pratiṣedhataḥ śabda antara prayogaḥ pratiṣidhyate tad abhāve na asti ananya tā tayoḥ itaretara apekṣa siddheḥ anyasmāt ananyatām upapādayati bhavān upapādya ca anyat pratyācaṣṭe ananyat iti ca śabdam anujānāti prayuṅkte ca ananyat iti etat samāsapadam anya śat baḥ ayam pratiṣedhena saha samasyate yadi ca atra uttaram padam na asti kasya ayam pratiṣedhena saha samāsaḥ tasmāt tayoḥ anya ananya śabdayoḥ itaraḥ ananya śabdaḥ itaram anya śabdam apekṣamāṇaḥ sidhyati iti tatra yat uktam anyatāyāḥ abhāvaḥ iti etat ayuktam iti

astu tarhi idānīm śabdasya nitya tvam vināśa kāraṇa anupalabdheḥ yat anityam tasya vināśaḥ kāraṇāt bhavati yathā loṣṭasya kāraṇa dravya vibhāgāt śabdaḥ ced anityaḥ tasya vināśaḥ yasmāt kāraṇāt bhavati tat upalabhyeta na ca upalabhyate tasmāt nityaḥ iti

aśravaṇa kāraṇa anupalabdheḥ satata śravaṇa prasaṅgaḥ yathā vināśa kāraṇa anupalabdheḥ avināśa prasaṅgaḥ evam aśravaṇa kāraṇa anupalabdheḥ satatam śravaṇa prasaṅgaḥ vyañjaka abhāvāt aśravaṇam iti ced pratiṣiddham vyañjakam atha vidyamānasya nirnimittam aśra vanam iti vidyamānasya nirnimittaḥ vināśaḥ iti samānaḥ ca dṛṣṭa virodhaḥ nimittam antareṇa vināśe ca aśravaṇe ca iti

upalabhyamāne ca anupalabdheḥ asattvāt anapadeśaḥ anumānāt ca upalabhyamāne śabdasya vināśa kāraṇe vināśa kāraṇa anupalabdheḥ asattvāt iti anapadeśaḥ yathā yasmāt viṣāṇī tasmāt aśvaḥ iti kim anumānam iti ced santāna upapattiḥ upapāditaḥ śabda santānaḥ saṃyoga vibhāga jāt śabdāt śabda antaram tatas antat tatas api anyat iti tatra kāryaḥ śabdaḥ kāraṇa śabdam niruṇaddhi pratighāti dravya saṃyogaḥ tu antyasya śabdasya nirodhakaḥ dṛṣṭam hi tiras pratikuḍyam antika sthena api aśravaṇam śabdasya śravaṇam dūra sthena api asati vyavadhāne iti

ghaṇṭāyām abhihanyamānāyām tāraḥ tārataraḥ mandaḥ mandataraḥ iti śruti bhedāt nānā śabda santānaḥ avicchedena śrūyate tatra nitye śabde ghaṇṭā stham anya gatam vā avasthitam santāna vṛtti vā abhivyakti kāraṇam vācyam yena śruti santānaḥ bhavati iti śabda bhede vā asati śruti bhedaḥ upapādayitavyaḥ iti anitye tu śabde ghaṇṭā stham santāna vṛtti saṃyoga sahakāri nimitta antaram saṃskāra bhūtam paṭu mandam anuvartate tasta anuvṛttyā śabda santāna anuvṛttiḥ paṭu manda bhāvāt ca tīvra manda tā śabdasya tad kṛtaḥ ca śruti bhedaḥ iti

na vai nimitta antaram saṃskāraḥ upalabhyate anupalabdheḥ na asti iti pāṇi nimitta praśleṣāt śabda abhāve na anupalabdhiḥ pāṇi karmaṇā pāṇi ghaṇṭā praśleṣaḥ bhavati tasmin ca sati śabda santānaḥ na utpadyate atas śravaṇa anupapattiḥ tatra pratighāti dravya saṃyogaḥ śabdasya nimitta antaram saṃskāra bhūtam niruṇaddhi iti anumīyate tasya ca nirodhāt śabda santānaḥ na utpadyate anutpattau śruti vicchedaḥ yathā pratighāti dravya saṃyogāt iṣoḥ kriyā hetau saṃskāre niruddhe gamana abhāvaḥ iti kampa santānasya sparśana indriya grāhyasya ca uparamaḥ kāṃsya pātra ādiṣu pāṇi saṃśleṣaḥ liṅgam saṃskāra santānasya iti tasmāt nimitta antarasya saṃskāra bhūtasya na anupalabdhiḥ iti

vināśa kāraṇa anupalabdheḥ ca avasthāne tad nitya tva prasaṅgaḥ yadi yasya vināśa kāraṇam na upalabhyate tat avatiṣṭhate avasthānāt ca tasya nitya tvam prasajyate evam yāni khalu imāni śabda śravaṇāni śabda abhivyaktayaḥ iti matam na teṣām vināśa kāraṇam bhavatā upapādyate anupapādanāt avasthānam avasthānāt teṣām nitya tvam prasajyate iti atha na evam na tarhi vināśa kāraṇa anupalabdheḥ śabdasya avasthānāt nitya tvam iti

kampa samāna āśrayasya anunādasya pāṇi praśleṣāt kampa vat kāraṇa uparamāt abhāvaḥ vaiyadhikaraṇye hi pratighāti dravya praśleṣāt samāna adhikaraṇasya eva uparamaḥ syāt iti asparśa tvāt apratiṣedhaḥ yat idam na ākāśa guṇaḥ śabdaḥ iti pratiṣidhyate ayam anupapannaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ asparśa tvāt śabda āśrayasya rūpa ādi samāna deśasya agrahaṇe śabda santāna upapatteḥ asparśa vyāpi dravya āśrayaḥ śabdaḥ iti jñāyate na kampa samāna āśrayaḥ iti

pratidravyam rūpa ādibhiḥ saha sanniviṣṭaḥ śabdaḥ samāna deśaḥ vyajyate iti na upapadyate katham vibhakti antara upapatteḥ ca samāse santāna upapatteḥ ca iti ca arthaḥ tat vyākhyātam yadi rūpa ādayaḥ śabdāḥ ca pratidravyam samastāḥ samuditāḥ samuditāḥ tasmin samāse samudāye yaḥ yathājātīyakaḥ sanniviṣṭaḥ tasya tathā jātīyasya eva grahaṇena bhavitavyam śabde rūpa ādi vat tatra yaḥ ayam vibhāgaḥ eka dravye nānā rūpāḥ bhinna śrutayaḥ vidharmāṇaḥ śabdāḥ abhivyajyamānāḥ śrūyante yat ca vibhāga antaram sarūpāḥ samāna śrutayaḥ sa dharmāṇaḥ śabdāḥ tīvra manda dharma tayā bhinnāḥ śrūyante tat ubhayam na upapadyate nānā bhūtānām utpadyamānānām ayam dharmaḥ na ekasya vyajyamānasya iti asti ca ayam vibhāgaḥ vibhāga antaram ca tena vibhāga upapatteḥ manyāmahe na pratidravyam rūpa ādibhiḥ saha śabdaḥ sanniviṣṭaḥ vyajyate iti

dvividhaḥ ca ayam śabdaḥ varṇa ātmakaḥ dhvani mātraḥ ca tatra varṇa ātmani tāvat vikāra ādeśa upadeśāt saṃśayaḥ dadhi atra iti kecid ikāraḥ itvam hitvā yatvam āpadyate iti vikāram manyante kecid ikārasya prayoge viṣaya kṛte yat ikāraḥ sthānam jahāti tatra yakārasya prayogam bruvate saṃhitāyām viṣaye ikāraḥ na prayujyate tasya sthāne yakāraḥ prayujyate saḥ ādeśaḥ iti ubhayam idam upadiśyate tatra na jñāyate kim tattvam iti

ādeśa upadeśaḥ tattvam vikāra upadeśe hi anvayasya agrahaṇāt vikārān anumānam sati anvaye kiñcid nivartate kiñcid upajāyate iti śakyeta vikāraḥ anumātum na ca anvayaḥ gṛhyate tasmāt vikāraḥ na asti iti bhinna karaṇayoḥ ca varṇayoḥ aprayoge prayoga upapattiḥ vivṛta karaṇaḥ ikāraḥ īṣat spṛṣṭa karaṇaḥ yakāraḥ tau imau pṛthakkaraṇa ākhyena prayatnena uccāraṇīyau tayoḥ ekasya aprayoge anyasya prayogaḥ upapannaḥ iti

avikāre ca aviśeṣaḥ yatra imau ikārayakārau na vikāra bhūtau yatate yacchati prāyaṃsta iti ikāraḥ idam iti ca yatra ca vikāra bhūtau iṣṭyā dadhi āhara iti ubhayatra prayoktuḥ aviśeṣaḥ yatnaḥ śrotuḥ ca śrutiḥ iti ādeśa upapattiḥ prayujyamāna agrahaṇāt ca na khalu ikāraḥ prayujyamānaḥ yakāra tām āpadyamānaḥ gṛhyate kim tarhi ikārasya prayoge yakāraḥ prayujyate tasmāt avikāraḥ iti

avikāre ca na śabdānvākhyāna lopaḥ na vikriyante varṇāḥ iti na ca etasmin pakṣe śabda anvākhyānasya asambhave yena varṇa vikāram pratipadyemahi iti na khalu varṇasya varṇa antaram kāryam na hi ikārāt yakāraḥ utpadyate yakārāt vā ikāraḥ pṛthak sthāna prayatna utpādyāḥ hi ime varṇāḥ teṣām anyonyasya sthāne prayujyate iti yuktam etāvat ca etat pariṇāmaḥ vā vikāraḥ syāt kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ vā ubhayam ca na asti tasmāt na santi varṇa vikārāḥ varṇa samudāya vikāra anupapatti vat ca varṇa vikāra anupapattiḥ asteḥ bhūḥ bruvaḥ vaciḥ iti yathā varṇa samudāyasya dhātu lakṣaṇasya kvacid viṣaye varṇa antara samudāyaḥ na pariṇāmaḥ na kāryam śabda antarasya sthāne śabda antaram prayujyate tathā varṇasya varṇa ānataram iti
itas ca na santi varṇa vikārāḥ prakṛti vivṛddhau vikāra vivṛddhiḥ prakṛti anuvidhānam vikāreṣu dṛṣṭam yakāre hrasva dīrgha anuvidhānam na asti yena vikāra tvam anumīyate iti
nyūna sama adhika upalabdheḥ vikārāṇām ahetuḥ dravya vikārāḥ nyūnāḥ samāḥ adhikāḥ ca gṛhyante tadvat ayam vikāraḥ nyūnaḥ syāt iti

dvividhasya api hetoḥ abhāvāt asādhanam dṛṣṭāntaḥ atra na udāharaṇa sādharmyāt dhetuḥ asti na vaidharmyāt anupasaṃhṛtaḥ ca hetunā dṛṣṭāntaḥ na sādhakaḥ iti pratidṛṣṭānte ca aniyamaḥ prasajyeta yathā nuḍuhaḥ sthāne aśvaḥ voḍhum niyuktaḥ na tad vikāraḥ bhavati evam iva ṛṇasya sthāne yakāraḥ prayuktaḥ na vikāraḥ iti na ca atra niyama hetuḥ asti dṛṣṭāntaḥ sādhakaḥ na pratidṛṣṭāntaḥ iti

dravya vikāra udāharaṇam ca na atulya prakṛtīnām vikāra vikalpāt atulyānām dravyāṇām prakṛti bhāvaḥ vikalpate vikārāḥ ca prakṛtīḥ anuvidhīyante na tu iva ṛṇam anuvidhīyate yakāraḥ tasmāt anudāharaṇam dravya vikāraḥ iti
dravya vikāra vaiṣamya vat varṇa vikāra vikalpaḥ yathā dravya bhāvena tulyāyāḥ prakṛteḥ vikāra vaiṣamyam evam varṇa abhāvena tulyāyāḥ prakṛteḥ vikāra vikalpaḥ iti

na vikāra dharma anupapatteḥ ayam vikāra dharmāḥ dravya sāmānye yad ātmakam dravyam mṛd vā suvarṇam vā tasya ātmanaḥ anvaye pūrvaḥ vyūhaḥ nivartate vyūha antaram ca upajāyate tam vikāram ācaṣṭe na varṇa sāmānye kaścid śabda ātmā anvayī yaḥ ittham jahāti yatvam ca āpadyate tatra yathā sati dravya bhāve vikāra vaiṣamye na anaḍuhaḥ aśvaḥ vikāraḥ vikāra dharma anupapatteḥ evam iva ṛṇasya na yakāraḥ vikāraḥ vikāra dharma anupapatteḥ iti

itas ca na santi varṇa vikārāḥ vikāra prāptānām apunar āpatteḥ anupapannā punar āpattiḥ katham punar āpatteḥ ananumānāt iti ikāraḥ yakāra tvam āpannaḥ punar ikāraḥ bhavati na punar ikārasya sthāne yakārasya prayogaḥ aprayogaḥ ca iti atra anumānam na asti

ananumānāt iti na idam hi anumānam suvarṇa ādīnām punar āpatteḥ ahetuḥ suvarṇam kuṇḍala tvam hitvā rucaka tvam āpadyate rucaka tvam hitvā punar kuṇḍala tvam āpadyate evam ikāraḥ api yakāra tvam āpannaḥ punar ikāraḥ bhavati iti

vyabhicārāt ananumānam yathā payaḥ dadhi bhāvam āpannam punar na payaḥ bhavati kim evam varṇānām na punar āpattiḥ atha suvarṇa vat punar āpattiḥ iti suvarṇa udāharaṇa upapattiḥ ca na tad vikārāṇām suvarṇa bhāva avyatirekāt avasthitam suvarṇam hīyamānena dharmeṇa upajāyamānena ca dharmi bhavati na evam kaścid śabda ātmā hīyamānena itvena upajāyamānena yatvena dharmī gṛhyate tasmāt suvarṇa udāharaṇam na upapadyate iti

varṇa tva avyatirekāt varṇa vikārāṇām apratiṣedhaḥ varṇa vikārāḥ api varṇa tvam na vyabhicaranti yathā suvarṇa vikāraḥ suvarṇa tvam iti sāmānyavataḥ dharma yogaḥ na sāmānyasya kuṇḍala rucakau suvarṇasya dharmau na suvarṇa tvasya evam ikārayakārau kasya varṇa ātmanaḥ dharmau varṇa tvam sāmānyam na tasya imau dharmau bhavitum arhati na ca nivartamānaḥ dharmaḥ upajāyamānasya prakṛtiḥ tatra nivartamānaḥ ikāraḥ na yakārasya upajāyamānasya prakṛtiḥ iti

itas ca varṇa vikāra anupapattiḥ nitya tve avikārāt anitya tve ca anavasthānāt nityāḥ varṇāḥ iti etasmin pakṣe ikārayakārau varṇau iti ubhayoḥ nitya tvāt vikāra anupapattiḥ nitya tve avināśi tvāt kaḥ kasya vikāraḥ iti atha anityāḥ varṇāḥ iti pakṣaḥ evam api anavasthānam varṇānām kim idam anavasthānam varṇānām utpadya nirodhaḥ utpadya niruddhe ikāre yakāraḥ utpadyate yakāre ca utpadya niruddhe ikāraḥ utpadyate iti kaḥ kasya vikāraḥ tat etat avagṛhya sandhāne sandhāya ca avagrahe veditavyam iti

nitya pakṣe tu tāvat samādhiḥ nityānām atīndriya tvāt tad dharma vikalpāt ca varṇa vikārāṇām apratiṣedhaḥ nityāḥ varṇāḥ na vikalpante iti vipratiṣedhaḥ yathā nitya tve sati kiñcid atīndriyam kiñcid indriya grāhyam indriya grāhyāḥ ca varṇāḥ evam nitya tve sati kiñcid na vikriyate varṇāḥ tu vikriyante iti

virodhāt ahetuḥ tad dharma vikalpaḥ nityam na upajāyate na apaiti anupajana apāya dharmakam nityam anityam punar upajana apāya yuktam na ca antareṇa upajana apāyau vikāraḥ sambhavati tat yadi varṇāḥ vikriyante nitya tvam eṣām nivartate atha nityāḥ vikāra dharma tvam eṣām nivartate saḥ ayam viruddhaḥ hetvābhāsaḥ dharma vikalpaḥ iti

anitya pakṣe samādhiḥ anavasthāyi tve ca varṇa upalabdhi vat tad vikāra utpattiḥ yathā anavasthāyinām varṇānām śravaṇam bhavati evam eṣām vikāraḥ bhavati asambandhāt asamarthāḥ artha pratipādikā varṇa upalabdhiḥ na vikāreṇa sambandhāt asamarthāḥ yā gṛhyamāṇā varṇa vikāram anumāpayet iti tatra yādṛś idam yathā gandha guṇā pṛthivī evam śabda sukha ādi guṇā api iti tādṛś etat bhavati iti na ca varṇa upalabdhiḥ varṇa nivṛttau varṇa antara prayogasya nivartikā yaḥ ayam iva ṛṇa nivṛttau yakārasya prayogaḥ yadi ayam varṇa upalabdhyā nivartate tadā tatra upalabhyamānāḥ ivaṛṇaḥ yatvam āpadyate iti gṛhyeta tasmāt varṇa upalabdhiḥ ahetuḥ varṇa vikārasya iti

vikāra dharmi tve nitya tva abhāvāt kāla antare vikāra upapatteḥ ca apratiṣedhaḥ tad dharma vikalpāt iti na yuktaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ na khalu vikāra dharmakam kiñcid nityam upalabhyate iti varṇa upalabdhi vat iti na yuktaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ avagrahe hi dadhi atra iti prayujya ciram sthitvā tatas saṃhitāyām prayuṅkte dadhi atra iti cira nivṛtte ca ayam iva ṛṇe yakāraḥ prayujyamānaḥ kasya vikāraḥ iti pratīyate kāraṇa abhāvāt kārya abhāvaḥ iti anuyogaḥ prasajyate iti

itas ca varṇa vikāra anupapattiḥ prakṛti aniyamāt ikāra sthāne yakāraḥ śrūyate yakāra sthāne khalu ikāraḥ vidhīyate vidhyati iti tat yadi syāt prakṛti vikāra bhāvāḥ varṇānām tasya prakṛti niyamaḥ syāt dṛṣṭaḥ vikāra dharmi tve prakṛti niyamaḥ iti

aniyame niyamān na aniyamaḥ yaḥ ayam prakṛteḥ aniyamaḥ uktaḥ sa niyataḥ yathā viṣayam vyavasthitaḥ niyata tvāt niyamaḥ iti bhavati evam sati aniyamaḥ na asti tatra yat uktam prakṛti aniyamāt iti etat ayuktam iti

niyama aniyama virodhāt aniyame niyamāt ca apratiṣedhaḥ niyamaḥ iti atra artha abhyanujñā aniyamaḥ iti tasya pratiṣedhaḥ anujñāta niṣiddhayoḥ ca vyāghātāt anartha antara tvam na bhavati aniyamaḥ ca niyata tvāt niyamaḥ na bhavati iti na atra arthasya tathā abhāvaḥ pratiṣidhyate kim tarhi tathābhūtasya arthasya niyama śabdena abhidhīyamānasya niyata tvāt niyama śabdaḥ eva upapadyate saḥ ayam niyamāt aniyame pratiṣedhaḥ na bhavati iti

na ca iyam varṇa vikāra upapattiḥ pariṇāmāt kārya kāraṇa bhāvāt vā kim tarhi guṇa antara āpatti upamarda hrāsa vṛddhi leśa śleśebhyaḥ tu vikāra upapatteḥ varṇa vikārāḥ sthānyādeśa bhāvāt aprayogaḥ vikāra śabda arthaḥ sa bhidyate guṇa antara āpattiḥ udāttasya anudātte iti evamādiḥ upamardaḥ nāma eka rūpa nivṛttau rūpa antara upajanaḥ hrāsaḥ dīrghasya hrasvaḥ vṛddhiḥ hrasvasya dīrghaḥ tayoḥ vā plutaḥ leśaḥ lāghavam staḥ iti asteḥ vikāraḥ śleṣaḥ āgamaḥ prakṛteḥ pratyayasya vā ete eva viśeṣāḥ vikārāḥ iti ete eva ādeśāḥ ete ced vikārāḥ upapadyante tarhi varṇa vikārāḥ iti

te vibhakti antāḥ padam yathādarśanam vikṛtāḥ varṇāḥ vibhakti antāḥ pada saṃjñāḥ bhavanti vibhaktiḥ dvayī nāmikī ākhyātikī ca brāhmaṇaḥ pacati iti udāharaṇam upasarga nipātāḥ tarhi na pada saṃjñāḥ lakṣaṇa antaram vācyam iti śiṣyate ca khalu nāmikyāḥ vibhakteḥ avyayāt lopaḥ tayoḥ pada saṃjñā artham iti

padena artha sampratyayaḥ iti prayojanam nāma padam ca adhikṛtya parīkṣā gauḥ iti padam khalu idam udāharaṇam tad arthe vyakti ākṛti jāti sannidhau upacārāt saṃśayaḥ avinā abhāva vṛttiḥ sannidhiḥ avinā abhāvena vartamānāsu vyakti ākṛti jātiṣu gauḥ iti prayujyate tatra na jñāyate kim anyatamaḥ padārthaḥ uta etat sarvam iti

śabdasya prayoga sāmarthyāt padārtha avadhāraṇam tasmāt yā śabda samūha tyāga parigraha saṅkhyā vṛddhi apacaya varṇa samāsa anubandhānām vyaktau upacārāt vyaktiḥ vyaktiḥ padārthaḥ kasmāt yā śabda prabhṛtīnām vyaktau upacārāt upacāraḥ prayogaḥ yā gauḥ tiṣṭhati yā gauḥ niṣaṇṇa iti na idam vākyam jāteḥ abhidhāyakam abhedāt bhedāt tu dravya abhidhāyakam

gavām samūhaḥ iti bhedāt dravya abhidhānam na jāteḥ abhedāt vaidyāya gām dadati iti dravyasya tyāgaḥ na jāteḥ amūrta tvāt pratikrama anukrama anupapatteḥ ca parigrahaḥ sva tvena abhisambandhaḥ kauṇḍinyasya gauḥ brāhmaṇasya gauḥ iti dravya abhidhāne dravya bhedāt sambandha bhedaḥ iti upapannam abhinnā tu jātiḥ iti saṅkhyā daśa gāvaḥ viṃśatiḥ gāvaḥ iti bhinnam dravyam saṅkhyāyate na jātiḥ abhedāt iti vṛddhiḥ kāraṇavataḥ dravyasya avayava upacayaḥ avardhata gauḥ iti niravayavā tu jātiḥ iti etena apacayaḥ vyākhyātaḥ varṇaḥ śuklā gauḥ kapilā gauḥ iti dravyasya guṇa yogaḥ na sāmānyasya samāsaḥ go hitam go sukham iti dravyasya sukha ādi yogaḥ na jāteḥ iti anubandhaḥ sarūpa prajanana santānaḥ gauḥ gām janayati iti tad utpatti dharma tvāt dravye yuktam na jātau viparyayāt iti dravyam vyaktiḥ iti hi na artha antaram

asya pratiṣedhaḥ na tad anavasthānāt na vyaktiḥ padārthaḥ kasmāt anavasthānāt yā śabda prabhṛtibhiḥ yaḥ viśeṣyate sa go śabda arthaḥ yā gauḥ tiṣṭhati yā gauḥ niṣaṇṇa iti na dravya mātram aviśiṣṭam jātyā vinā abhidhīyate kim tarhi jāti viśiṣṭam tasmāt na vyaktiḥ padārthaḥ evam samūha ādiṣu draṣṭavyam

yadi na vyaktiḥ padārthaḥ katham tarhi vyaktau upacāraḥ iti nimittāt atadbhāve api tad upacāraḥ dṛśyate khalu sahacaraṇa sthāna tādarthya vṛtta māna dhāraṇa sāmīpya yoga sādhana ādhipatyebhyaḥ brāhmaṇa mañca kaṭa rāja saktu candana gaṅgā śāṭaka anna puruṣeṣu atadbhāve api tad upacāraḥ atadbhāve api tad upacāraḥ iti atad śabdasya tena śabdena abhidhānam iti sahacaraṇāt yaṣṭikām bhojaya iti yaṣṭikā sahacaritaḥ brāhmaṇaḥ abhidhīyate iti

sthānāt mañcāḥ krośanti iti mañca sthāḥ puruṣāḥ abhidhīyante tādarthyāt kaṭārtheṣu vīraṇeṣu vyuhyamāneṣu kaṭam karoti iti bhavati vṛtāt yamaḥ rājā kuberaḥ rājā iti tadvat vartate iti mānāt āḍhakena mitāḥ saktavaḥ āḍhaka saktavaḥ iti dhāraṇāt tulāyām dhṛtam candanam tulā candanam iti sāmīpyāt gaṅgāyām gāvaḥ caranti iti deśaḥ abhidhīyate sannikṛṣṭaḥ yogāt kṛṣṇena rāgeṇa yuktaḥ śāṭakaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ iti abhidhīyate sādhanāt annam prāṇāḥ iti ādhipatyāt ayam puruṣaḥ kulam ayam gotram iti tatra ayam sahacaraṇāt yogāt vā jāti śabdaḥ vyaktau prayujyate iti

yadi gauḥ iti asya padasya na vyaktiḥ arthaḥ astu tarhi ākṛtiḥ tad apekṣa tvāt sattva vyavasthāna siddheḥ ākṛtiḥ padārthaḥ kasmāt tad apekṣa tvāt sattva vyavasthāni siddheḥ sattva avayavānām tad avayavānām ca niyataḥ vyūhaḥ ākṛtiḥ tasyām gṛhyamāṇāyām sattva vyavasthānam sidhyati ayam gauḥ ayam aśvaḥ iti na agṛhyamāṇāyām yasya grahaṇāt sattva vyavasthānam sidhyati tam śabdaḥ abhidhātum arhati saḥ asya arthaḥ iti

tat upapadyate yasya jātyā yogaḥ tat atra jāti viśiṣṭam abhidhīyate gauḥ iti na ca avayava vyūhasya jātyā yogaḥ kasya tarhi niyata avayava vyūhasya dravyasya tasmāt na ākṛtiḥ padārthaḥ astu tarhi jātiḥ padārthaḥ vyakti ākṛti yukte api aprasaṅgāt prokṣa ādīnām mṛda gavake jātiḥ jātiḥ padārthaḥ kasmāt vyakti ākṛti yukte api mṛd gavake prokṣaṇa ādīnām aprasaṅgāt iti gām prokṣaya gām ānaya gām dehi iti na etāni mṛdgavake prayujyante kasmāt jāteḥ abhāvāt asti hi tatra vyaktiḥ asti ākṛtiḥ yat abhāvāt tatra asampratyayaḥ sa padārthaḥ iti
na ākṛti vyakti apekṣa tvāt jāti abhivyakteḥ jāteḥ abhivyaktiḥ ākṛti vyaktī apekṣate na agṛhyamāṇāyām ākṛtau vyaktau ca jāti mātram śuddham gṛhyate tasmāt na jātiḥ padārthaḥ iti

na vai padārthena na bhavitum śakyam kaḥ khalu idānīm padārthaḥ iti vyakti ākṛti jātayaḥ tu padārthaḥ tuśabdaḥ viśeṣaṇa arthaḥ kim viśiṣyate pradhāna aṅga bhāvasya aniyamena padārtha tvam iti yadā hi bheda vivakṣā viśeṣa gatiḥ ca tadā vyaktiḥ pradhānam aṅgam tu jāti ākṛtī yadā tu bhedaḥ avivakṣitaḥ sāmānya gatiḥ ca tadā jātiḥ pradhānam aṅgam tu vyakti ākṛtī tat etat bahulam prayogeṣu ākṛteḥ tu pradhāna bhāvaḥ utprekṣitavyaḥ

katham punar jñāyate nānā vyakti ākṛti jātayaḥ iti lakṣaṇa bhedāt tatra tāvat vyaktiḥ guṇa viśeṣa āśrayaḥ mūrtiḥ vyajyate iti vyaktiḥ indriya grāhyā iti na sarvam dravyam vyaktiḥ yaḥ guṇa viśeṣāṇām sparśa antānām guru tva ghana tva drava tva saṃskārāṇām avyāpinaḥ parimāṇasya āśrayaḥ yathāsambhavam tat dravyam mūrtiḥ mūrcchita avayava tvāt iti

ākṛtiḥ jāti liṅga ākhyā yayā jātiḥ jāti liṅgāni ca prakhyāyante tām ākṛtim vidyāt sā ca na anyā sattva avayavānām tad avayavānām ca niyatāt vyūhāt iti niyata avayava vyūhāḥ khalu sattva avayavāḥ jāti liṅgam śirasā pādena gām anuminvanti niyate ca sattva avayavānām vyūhe sati go tvam prakhyāyate iti anākṛti vyaṅgyāyām jātau mṛd suvarṇam rajatam iti evamādiṣu ākṛtiḥ nivartate jahāti padārtha tvam iti

samāna prasava ātmikā jātiḥ yā samānam buddhim prasūte bhinneṣu adhikaraṇeṣu yayā bahūni iteḥ a itarataḥ na vyāvartante yaḥ arthaḥ anekatra pratyaya anuvṛtti nimittam tat sāmānyam yat ca keṣāñcid abhedam kutaścid bhedam karoti tat sāmānya viśeṣaḥ jātiḥ iti

parīkṣitāni pramāṇāni prameyam idānīm parīkṣyate tat ca ātmā ādi iti ātmā vivicyate kim deha indriya manaḥ buddhi vedanā saṅghāta mātram ātmā āhosvit tat vayatiriktaḥ iti kutas saṃśayaḥ vyapadeśya ubhayathā siddheḥ kriyā karaṇayoḥ kartrā sambandhasya abhidhānam vyapadeśaḥ sa dvividhaḥ avayavena samudāyasya mūlaiḥ vṛkṣaḥ tiṣṭhati stambhaiḥ prāsādaḥ dhriyate iti anyena anyasya vyapadeśaḥ paraśunā vṛścati pradīpena paśyati asti ca ayam vyapadeśaḥ cakṣuṣā paśyati manasā vijānāti buddhyā vicārayati śarīreṇa sukha duḥkham anubhavati iti tatra na avadhāryate kim avayavena samudāyasya deha ādi saṅghātasya atha anyena anyasya tad vyatiriktasya vā iti

anyena ayam anayasya vyapadeśaḥ kasmāt darśana sparśanābhyām eka artha grahaṇāt darśanena kaścid arthaḥ gṛhītaḥ sparśanena api saḥ arthaḥ gṛhyate yam aham adrākṣam cakṣuṣā tam sparśanena api spṛśāmi iti yam ca āspārkṣam sparśanena tam cakṣuṣā paśyāmi iti eka viṣayau ca imau pratyayau eka kartṛkau pratisandhīyete na ca saṅghāta kartṛkau na indriyeṇa eka kartṛkau tat yaḥ asau cakṣuṣā tvac indriyeṇa ca eka arthasya grahītā bhinna nimittau anya kartṛkau pratyayau samāna viṣayau pratisandadhāti saḥ artha antara bhūtaḥ ātmā

katham punar na indriyeṇa eka kartṛkau indriyam khalu sva sva viṣaya grahaṇam ananya kartṛkam pratisandhātum arhati na indriya antarasya viṣaya antara grahaṇam iti katham na saṅghāta kartṛkau ekaḥ khalu ayam bhinna nimittau sva ātma kartṛkau paryayau pratisaṃhitau vedayate na saṅghātaḥ kasmāt anivṛttam hi saṅghāte pratyekam viṣaya antara grahaṇasya apratisandhānam indriya antareṇa iva iti

na viṣaya vyavasthānāt na deha ādi saṅghātāt anyaḥ cetanaḥ kasmāt viṣaya vyavasthānāt vyavasthita viṣayāṇi indriyāṇi cakṣuṣi asati rūpam na gṛhyate sati ca gṛhyate yat ca yasmin asati na bhavati sati bhavati tasya tat iti vijñāyate tasmāt rūpa grahaṇam cakṣuṣaḥ cakṣuḥ rūpam paśyati evam ghrāṇa ādiṣu api iti tāni indriyāṇi imāni sva sva viṣaya grahaṇāt cetanāni indriyāṇām bhāva abhāvayoḥ viṣaya grahaṇasya tathā abhāvāt evam sati kim anyena cetanena sandhigdha tvāt ahetuḥ yaḥ ayam indriyāṇām bhāva abhāvayoḥ viṣaya grahaṇasya tathā abhāvaḥ sa kim cetana tvāt āhosvit cetanā upakaraṇānām grahaṇa nimitta tvāt iti sandihyate cetanā upakaraṇa tve api indriyāṇām grahaṇa nimitta tvāt bhavitum arhati

yat ca uktam viṣaya vyavasthānat iti tad vyavasthānāt eva ātma sadbhāvāt apratiṣedhaḥ yadi khalu ekam indriyam avyavasthita viṣayam sarvajñam sarva viṣaya grāhi cetanam syāt kaḥ tatas anyam cetanam anumātum śaknuyāt yasmāt tu vyavasthita viṣayāṇi indriyāṇi tasmāt tebhyaḥ anyaḥ cetanaḥ sarvajñaḥ sarva viṣaya grāhī viṣaya vyavasthitam atītaḥ anumīyate tatra idam abhijñānam apratyākhyeyam cetana vṛttam udāhriyate rūpa darśī khalu ayam rasam gandham vā pūrva gṛhītam anuminoti gandha pratisaṃvedī ca rūpa rasau anuminoti evam viṣaya śeṣe api vācyam rūpam dṛṣṭvā gandham jighrati ghrātvā ca gandham rūpam paśyati

tat evam aniyata paryāyam sarva viṣaya grahaṇam eka cetanā adhikaraṇam ananya kartṛkam pratisandhatte pratyakṣa anumāna āgama saṃśayān pratyayān ca nānā viṣayān sva ātma kartṛkān pratisandhāya vedayate sarva viṣayam ca śāstram pratipadyate artham aviṣaya bhūtam śrotrasya krama bhāvinaḥ varṇān śrutvā pada vākya bhāvena pratisandhāya śabda artha vyavasthām ca budhyamānaḥ aneka viṣayam artha jātam agrahaṇīyam ekaikena indriyeṇa gṛhṇāti sā iyam sarvajñasya jñeya avyavasthā anupadam na śakyā parikramitum ākṛti mātram tu udāhṛtam tatra yat uktam indriya caitanye sati kim aneya cetanena tat ayuktam bhavati

itas ca deha ādi vyatiriktaḥ ātmā na deha ādi saṅghāta mātram śarīra dāhe pātaka abhāvāt śarīra grahaṇena śarīra indriya buddhi vedanā saṅghātaḥ prāṇi bhūtaḥ gṛhyate prāṇi bhūtam śarīram dahataḥ prāṇi hiṃsā kṛta pāpam pātakam iti ucyate tasya abhāvaḥ tad phalena kartuḥ asambandhāt akartuḥ ca sambandhāt śarīra indriya buddhi vedanā prabandhe khalu anyaḥ saṅghātaḥ utpadyate anyaḥ nirudhyate utpāda nirodha santati bhūtaḥ prabandhaḥ na anya tvam bādhate deha ādi saṅghātasya anyatva adhiṣṭhāna tvāt anya tva adhiṣṭhānaḥ hi asau prakhyāyate iti evam ca sati yaḥ deha ādi saṅghātaḥ prāṇi bhūtaḥ hiṃsām karoti na asau hiṃsā phalena sambadhyate yaḥ ca sambadhyate na tena hiṃsā kṛtā tat evam sattva bhede kṛta hānam akṛta abhyāgamaḥ prasajyate sati ca sattva utpāde sattva nirodhe ca akarma nimittaḥ sattva saṃsargaḥ prāpnoti tatra mukti arthaḥ brahmacarya vāsaḥ na syāt tat yadi deha ādi saṅghāta mātram sattvam syāt śarīra dāhe pātakam na bhavet aniṣṭam ca etat tasmāt deha ādi saṅghāta vyatiriktaḥ ātmā nityaḥ iti

tad abhāvaḥ sa ātmaka pradāhe api tad nitya tvāt yasya api nityena ātmanā sa ātmakam śarīram dahyate tasya api śarīra dāhe pātakam na bhavet dagdhuḥ kasmāt nitya tvāt ātmanaḥ na jātu kaścid nityam hiṃsitum arhati atha hiṃsyate nitya tvam asya na bhavati sā iyam ekasmin pakṣe hiṃsā niṣphalāḥ anyasmin tu anupapanna iti

na kārya āśraya kartṛ vadhāt na brūmaḥ nityasya sattvasya badhaḥ hiṃsā api tu anucchitti dharmakasya sattvasya kārya āśrayasya śarīrasya sva viṣaya upalabdheḥ ca kartṛṇām indriyāṇām upaghātaḥ pīḍā vaikalya lakṣaṇaḥ prabandha ucchedaḥ vā pramāpaṇa lakṣaṇaḥ vā vadhaḥ hiṃsā iti kāryam tu sukha duḥkha saṃvedanam tasya āyatanam adhiṣṭhānam āśrayaḥ śarīram kārya āśrayasya śarīrasya sva viṣaya upalabdheḥ ca kartṛṇām indriyāṇām badhaḥ hiṃsā na nityasya ātmanaḥ tatra yat uktam tad abhāvaḥ sa ātmaka pradāhe api tad nitya tvāt iti etat ayuktam yasya sattva ucchedaḥ hiṃsā tasya kṛta hānam akṛta abhyāgamaḥ ca iti doṣaḥ etāvat ca etat syāt sattva ucchedaḥ vā hiṃsā anucchitti dharmakasya sattvasya kārya āśraya kartṛ vadhaḥ vā na kalpa antaram asti sattva ucchedaḥ ca pratiṣiddhaḥ tatra kim anyat śeṣam yathābhūtam iti

atha vā kārya āśraya kartṛ vadhāt iti kārya āśrayaḥ deha indriya buddhi saṅghātaḥ nityasya ātmanaḥ tatra sukha duḥkha pratisaṃvedanam tasya adhiṣṭhānam āśrayaḥ tad āyatanam tat bhavati na tatas anyat iti saḥ eva kartā tad nimittā hi sukha duḥkha saṃvedanasya nivṛttiḥ na tam antareṇa iti tasya vadhaḥ upaghātaḥ pīḍā pramāpaṇam vā hiṃsā na nitya tvena ātma ucchedaḥ tatra yat uktam tad abhāvaḥ sa ātmaka pradāhe api tat nitya tvāt etat na iti

itas ca deha ādi vyatiriktaḥ ātmā savya dṛṣṭasya itareṇa pratyabhijñānāt pūrva parayoḥ vijñānayoḥ eka viṣaye pratisandhi jñānam pratyabhijñānam tam eva etarhi paśyāmi yam ajñāsiṣam saḥ eva ayam arthaḥ iti savyena cakṣuṣā dṛṣṭasya itareṇa api cakṣuṣā pratyabhijñānāt yam adrākṣam tam eva etarhi paśyāmi iti indriya caitanye tu na anya dṛṣṭam anyaḥ pratyabhijānāti iti pratyabhijñā anupapattiḥ asti tu idam pratyabhijñanam tasmāt indriya vyatiriktaḥ cetanaḥ
na ekasmin nāsā asthi vyavahite dvi tva abhimānāt ekam idam cakṣuḥ madhye nāsā asthi vyavahitam tasya antau gṛhyamāṇau dvi tva abhimānam prayojayataḥ madhya vyavahitasya dīrghasya iva
eka vināśe dvitīya avināśāt na ekatvam ekasmin upahate ca uddhṛte vā cakṣuṣi dvitīyam avatiṣṭhate cakṣuḥ viṣaya grahaṇa liṅgam tasmāt ekasya vyavadhāna anupapattiḥ
avayava nāśe api avayavi upalabdheḥ ahetuḥ eka vināśe dvitīya avināśāt iti ahetuḥ kasmāt vṛkṣasya hi kāsucid śākhāsu chinnā asu upalabhyate eva vṛkṣaḥ

dṛṣṭānta virodhāt apratiṣedhaḥ na kāraṇa dravyasya vibhāge kārya dravyam avatiṣṭate nitya tva prasaṅgāt bahuṣu avayaviṣu yasya kāraṇāni vibhaktāni tasya vināśaḥ yeṣām kāraṇāni avibhaktāni tāni avatiṣṭhante atha vā dṛśyamāna artha virodhaḥ dṛṣṭānta virodhaḥ mṛtasya hi śiraḥ kapāle dvau avaṭau nāsā asthi vyavahitau cakṣuṣaḥ sthāne bhedena gṛhyete na ca etat ekasmin nāsā asthi vyavahite sambhavati

atha vai eka vināśasya aniyamāt dvau imau arthau tau ca pṛthak āvaraṇa upaghātau anumīyete vibhinnau iti avapīḍanāt ca ekasya cakṣuṣaḥ raśmi viṣaya sannikarṣasya bhedāt dṛśya bhedaḥ iva gṛhyate tat ca eka tve virudhyate avapīḍana nivṛttau ca abhinna pratisandhānam iti tasmāt ekasya vyavadhāna anupapattiḥ

anumīyate ca ayam deha ādi saṅghāta vyatiriktaḥ cetanaḥ iti indriya antara vikārāt kasyacid amla phalasya gṛhīta tad rasa sāhacarye rūpe gandhe vā kenacid indriyeṇa gṛhyamāṇe rasanasya indriya antarasya vikāraḥ rasa anusmṛtau rasa gardhi vartitaḥ danta udaka saṃplava bhūtaḥ gṛhyate tasya indriya caitanye anupapattiḥ na anya dṛṣṭam anyaḥ smarati
na smṛteḥ smartavya viṣaya tvāt smṛtiḥ nāma dharmaḥ nimittāt utpadyate tasyāḥ smartavyaḥ viṣayaḥ tad kṛtaḥ indriya antara vikāraḥ na ātma kṛtaḥ iti

tad ātma guṇa sadbhāvāt apratiṣedhaḥ tasyāḥ ātma guṇa tve sati sadbhāvāt apratiṣedhaḥ ātmanaḥ yadi smṛtiḥ ātma guṇaḥ evam sati smṛtiḥ upapadyate na anyat dṛṣṭam anyaḥ samarati iti indriya caitanye tu nānā kartṛkāṇām viṣaya grahaṇānām apratisandhānam pratisandhāne vā viṣaya vyavasthā anupapattiḥ ekaḥ tu cetanaḥ aneka artha darśī bhinna nimittaḥ pūrva dṛṣṭam artham smarati iti ekasya aneka artha darśinaḥ darśana pratisandhānāt smṛteḥ ātma guṇa tve sati sadbhāvaḥ viparyaye ca anupapattiḥ smṛti āśrayāḥ prāṇabhṛtām sarve vyavahārāḥ ātma liṅgam udāharaṇa mātram indriya antara vikāraḥ iti

aparisaṅkhyānāḥ ca smṛti viṣayasya aparisaṅghyāya ca smṛti viṣayam idam ucyate na smṛteḥ smartavya viṣaya tvāt iti yā iyam smṛtiḥ agṛhyamāṇe arthe ajñāsiṣam aham amum artham iti etasyāḥ jñātṛ jñāna viśiṣṭaḥ pūrva jñātaḥ arthaḥ viṣayaḥ na artha mātram jñātavān aham amum artham asa arthaḥ mayā jñataḥ asmin arthe mama jñānam abhūt iti caturvidham etat vākyam smṛti viṣa ya jñāpakam samāna artham sarvatra khalu jñātā jñānam jñeyam ca gṛhyate atha pratyakṣe arthe yā smṛtiḥ tayā trīṇi jñānāni ekasmin arthe pratisandhīyante samāna kartṛkāṇi na nānā kartṛkāṇi na akartṛkāṇi kim tarhi eka kartṛkāṇi adrākṣam amum artham yam eva etarhi paśyāmi adrākṣam iti darśanam darśana saṃvid ca na khalu asaṃvidite sve darśane syāt etat adrakṣam iti te khalu ete dve jñāne yam eva etarhi paśyāmi iti tṛtīyam jñānam evam ekaḥ arthaḥ tribhiḥ jñānaiḥ yujyamānaḥ na akartṛkaḥ na nānā kartṛkaḥ kim tarhi

eka kartṛkaḥ iti saḥ ayam smṛti viṣayaḥ aparisaṅkhyāyamānaḥ vidyamānaḥ prajñātaḥ arthaḥ pratiṣidhyate na asti ātmā smṛteḥ smartavya viṣaya tvāt iti na ca idam smṛti mātram smartavya mātra viṣayam vai idam khalu jñāna pratisandhāna vat smṛti pratisandhānam ekasya sarva viṣaya tvāt ekaḥ ayam jñātā sarva viṣayaḥ svāni jñānāni pratisandhatte amum artham jñāsyāmi amum artham vijānāmi amum artham ajñāsiṣam amum artham jijñāsamānaḥ ciram ajñātvā adhyavasyati ajñāsiṣam iti evam smṛtim api tri kāla viśiṣṭām suṣmūrṣā viśiṣṭām ca pratisandhatte saṃskāra santati mātre tu sattve utpadya utpadya saṃskārāḥ tirobhavanti sa na asti ekaḥ api saṃskāraḥ yaḥ tri kāla viśiṣṭam jñānam smṛtim ca anubhavet na ca anubhavam antareṇa jñānasya smṛteḥ ca pratisandhānam aham mama iti ca utpadyate deha antara vat atas anumīyate asti ekaḥ sarva viṣayaḥ pratideham sva jñāna prabandham smṛti prabandham ca pratisandhattaḥ iti yasya deha antareṣu vṛtteḥ abhāvāt na pratisandhānam bhavati iti

na ātma pratipatti hetūnām manasi sambhavāt na deha ādi saṅghāta vyatiriktaḥ ātmā kasmāt ātma pratipatti hetūnām manasi sambhavāt darśana sparśanābhyām eka artha grahaṇāt iti evamādīnām ātma pratipādakānām hetūnām manasi sambhavaḥ yatas manaḥ hi sarva viṣayam iti tasmāt na śarīra indriya manaḥ buddhi saṅghāta vyatiriktaḥ ātmā iti

jñātuḥ jñāna sādhana upapatteḥ saṃjñā bheda mātram jñātuḥ khalu jñāna sādhanāni upapadyante cakṣuṣā paśyati ghrāṇena jighrati sparśanena spṛśati evam mantuḥ sarva viṣayasya mati sādhanam antaḥkaraṇa bhūtam sarva viṣayam vidyate yena ayam manyate iti evam sati jñātari ātma saṃjñā na mṛṣyate manaḥ saṃjñā abhyanujñāyate manasi ca manaḥ saṃjñā na mṛṣyate mati sādhanam tu abhyanujñāyate tat idam saṃjñā bheda mātram na arthe vivādaḥ iti pratyākhyāne vā sarva indriya vilopa prasaṅaḥ atha mantuḥ sarva viṣayasya mati sādhanam sarva viṣayam pratyākhyāyate na asti iti evam rūpa ādi viṣaya grahaṇa sādhanāni api na santi iti sarva indriya vilopaḥ prasajyate iti

niyamaḥ ca niranumānaḥ yaḥ ayam niyamaḥ iṣyate rūpa ādi grahaṇa sādhanāni asya santi mati sādhanam sarva viṣayam na asti iti ayam niyamaḥ niranumānaḥ na atra anumānam asti yena niyamam pratipadyāmahe iti rūpa ādibhyaḥ ca viṣaya antaram sukha ādayaḥ tad upalabdhau karaṇa antara sadbhāvaḥ yathā cakṣuṣā gandhaḥ na gṛhyate iti karaṇa antaram ghrāṇam evam cakṣuḥ ghrāṇābhyām rasaḥ na gṛhyate iti karaṇa antaram rasanam evam śeṣeṣu api tathā cakṣuḥ ādibhiḥ sukha ādayaḥ na gṛhyante iti karaṇa antareṇa bhavitavyam tat ca jñāna ayaugapadya liṅgam yat ca sukha ādi upalabdhau karaṇam tat ca jñāna ayaugapadya liṅgam tasya indriyam indriyam prati sannidheḥ asannidheḥ ca na yugapad jñānāni utpadyante iti tatra yat uktam ātma pratipatti hetūnām manasi sambhavāt iti tat ayuktam

kim punar ayam deha ādi saṅghātāt anyaḥ nityaḥ uta anityaḥ iti kutas saṃśayaḥ ubhayathā dṛṣṭa tvāt saṃśayaḥ vidyamānam ubhayathā bhavati nityam anityam ca pratipādite ca ātma sadbhāve saṃśaya anivṛttiḥ iti ātma sadbhāva hetubhiḥ eva asya prāk deha bhedāt avasthānam siddham ūrddhvam api deha bhedāt avatiṣṭhate kutas pūrva abhyasta smṛti anubandhāt jātasya harṣa bhaya śoka sampratipatteḥ

jātaḥ khalu ayam kumārakaḥ asmin janmani agṛhīteṣu harṣa bhaya śoka hetuṣu harṣa bhaya śokān pratipadyate liṅga anumeyān te ca smṛti anubandhāt utpadyante na anyathā smṛti anubandhaḥ ca pūrva abhyāsam antareṇa na bhavati pūrva abhyāsaḥ ca pūrva janmani sati na anyathā iti sidhyati etat avatiṣṭhate ayam ūrdhvam śarīra bhedāt iti

padma ādiṣu prabodha sammīlana vikāra vat tatvikāraḥ yathā padma ādiṣu anityeṣu prabodhaḥ sammīlanam vikāraḥ bhavati evam anityasya ātmanaḥ harṣa bhaya śoka sampratipattiḥ vikāraḥ syāt hetu abhāvāt ayuktam anena hetunā padma ādiṣu prabodha sammīlana vikāra vat anityasya ātmanaḥ harṣa ādi sampratipattiḥ iti na atra udāharaṇa sādharmyāt sādhya sādhanam hetuḥ na vaidharmyāt asti hetu abhāvāt asambaddha arthakam apārthakam ucyate iti

dṛṣṭāntāt ca harṣa ādi nimittasya anivṛttiḥ yā ca iyam āseviteṣu viṣayeṣu harṣa ādi sampratipattiḥ smṛti anubandha kṛtā pratyātmanam gṛhyate sā iyam padma ādi sammīlana dṛṣṭāntena na nivartate yathā ca iyam na nivarttate tathā jātasya api iti kriyā jātau ca parṇa vibhāga saṃyogau prabodha sammīlane kriyā hetuḥ ca kriyā anumeyaḥ evam ca sati kim dṛṣṭāntena pratiṣidhyate

atha nirnimittaḥ padma ādiṣu prabodha sammīlana vikāraḥ iti matam evam ātmanaḥ api harṣa ādi sampratipattiḥ iti tat ca na uṣṇa śīta varṣā kāla nimitta tvāt pañca ātmaka vikārāṇām uṣṇa ādiṣu satsu bhāvāt asatsu abhāvāt tad nimittāḥ pañcabhūta anugraheṇa nivṛttānām padma ādīnām prabodha sammīlana vikārāḥ iti na nirnimittāḥ evam harṣa ādayaḥ api vikārāḥ nimittat bhavitum arhanti na nimittam antareṇa na ca anyat pūrva abhyasta smṛti anubandhāt nimittam asti iti na ca utpattitirodha kāraṇa anumānam ātmanaḥ dṛṣṭāntāt na harṣa ādīnām nimittam antareṇa utpattiḥ na uṣṇa ādi vat nimitta antara upādānam harṣa ādīnām tasmāt ayuktam etat

itas ca nityaḥ ātmā pretya āhāra abhyāsa kṛtāt stanya abhilāṣāt jāta mātrasya vatsasya pravṛtti liṅgaḥ stanya abhilāṣaḥ gṛhyate sa ca na antareṇa āhāra abhyāsam kayā yuktyā dṛśyate hi śarīriṇām kṣudhā pīḍyamānānām āhāra abhyāsa kṛtāt smaraṇa anubandhāt āhāra abhilāṣaḥ na ca pūrva śarīra abhyāsam antareṇa asau jāta mātrasya upapadyate tena anumīyate bhūta pūrvam śarīram yatra anena āhāraḥ abhyastaḥ iti sa khalu ayam ātmā pūrva śarīrāt pretya śarīra antaram āpannaḥ kṣudh pīḍitaḥ pūrva abhyastam āhāram anusmaran stanyam abhilaṣati tasmāt na deha bhedāt ātmā bhidyate bhavati eva ūrddhvam deha bhedāt iti
ayasaḥ ayaskānta abhigamana vat tad upasarpaṇam yathā khalu ayaḥ abhyāsam antareṇa ayaska antam upasarpati evam āhāra abhyāsam antareṇa bālaḥ stanyam abhilaṣati

kim idam ayasaḥ ayaskānta abhisarpaṇam nirnimittam atha nimittāt iti nirnimittam tāvat na anyatra pravṛtti abhāvāt yadi nirnimittam loṣṭa ādayaḥ api ayaskāntam upasarpeyuḥ na jātu niyame kāraṇam asti iti atha nimittāt tat kena upalabhyate iti kriyā liṅgaḥ kriyā hetuḥ kriyā niyama liṅgaḥ ca kriyā hetu niyamaḥ tena anyatra pravṛtti abhāvaḥ bālasya api niyatam upasarpaṇa kriyā upalabhyate na ca stanya abhilāṣa liṅgam anyat āhāra abhyāsa kṛtāt smaraṇa anubandhāt nimittam dṛṣṭāntena upapādyate na ca asati nimitte kasyacid utpattiḥ na ca dṛṣṭāntaḥ dṛṣṭam abhilāṣa hetum bādhate tasmāt ayasaḥ ayaskānta abhigamanam adṛṣṭāntaḥ iti

ayasaḥ khalu api na anyatra pravṛttiḥ bhavati na jātu ayaḥ loṣṭam upasarpati kiṃkṛtaḥ asya niyamaḥ iti yadi kāraṇa niyamāt sa ca kriyā niyama liṅgaḥ evam bālasya api niyata viṣayaḥ abhilāṣaḥ kāraṇa niyamāt bhavitum arhati tat ca kāraṇam abhyasta smaraṇam anyat vā iti dṛṣṭena viśiṣyate dṛṣṭaḥ hi śarīriṇām abhasta smaraṇāt āhāra abhilāṣaḥ iti

itas ca nityaḥ ātmā kasmāt vīta rāga janma adarśanāt sa rāgaḥ jāyate iti arthāt āpadyate ayam jāyamānaḥ rāga anubhaddhaḥ jāyate rāgasya pūrva anubhūta viṣaya anucintanam yoniḥ pūrva anubhavaḥ ca viṣayāṇām anyasmin janmani śarīram antareṇa na upapadyate saḥ ayam ātmā pūrva śarīra anubhūtān viṣayān anusmaran teṣu teṣu rajyate tathā ca ayam dvayoḥ janmanoḥ pratisandhiḥ evam pūrva śarīrasya pūrvatareṇa pūrvatarasya pūrvatamena ityādinānādiḥ cetanasya śarīra yogaḥ anādiḥ ca rāga anubandhaḥ iti siddham nitya tvam iti

katham punar jñāyate pūrva anubhūta viṣaya anucintana janitaḥ jātasya rāgaḥ na punar sa guṇa dravya utpatti vat tad utpattiḥ atha utpatti dharmakasya dravyasya guṇāḥ kāraṇataḥ utpadyante tathā utpatti dharmakasya ātmanaḥ rāgaḥ kutaścid utpadyate atra ayam udita anuvādaḥ nidarśana arthaḥ

na saṅkalpa nimitta tvāt rāga ādīnām na khalu sa guṇa dravya utpatti vat utpattiḥ ātmanaḥ rāgasya ca kasmāt saṅkalpa nimitta tvāt rāga ādīnām ayam khalu prāṇinām viṣayān āsevamānānām saṅkalpa janitaḥ rāgaḥ gṛhyate saṅkalpaḥ ca pūrva anubhūta viṣaya anucintana yoniḥ tena anumīyate jātasya api pūrva anubhūta artha cintana kṛtaḥ rāgaḥ iti ātma utpāda adhikaraṇāt tu rāga utpattiḥ bhavantī saṅkalpāt anyasmin rāga kāraṇe sati vācyā kārya dravya guṇavat na ca ātma utpādaḥ siddhaḥ na api saṅkalpāt anyat rāga kāraṇam asti

tasmāt ayuktam sa guṇa dravya utpatti vat tayoḥ utpattiḥ iti atha api saṅkalpāt anyat rāga kāraṇam dharma adharma lakṣaṇam adṛṣṭam upādīyate tathā api pūrva śarīra yogaḥ apratyākhyeyaḥ tatra hi tasya nirvṛttiḥ na asmin janmani tad maya tvāt rāgaḥ iti viṣaya abhyāsaḥ khalu ayam bhāvanā hetuḥ tad maya tvam ucyate iti jāti viśeṣāt ca rāga viśeṣaḥ iti karma khalu idam jāti viśeṣa nirvartakam tādarthyāt tāt śabdyam vijñāyate tasmāt anupapannam saṅkalpāt anyat rāga kāraṇam iti

anādiḥ cetanasya śarīra yogaḥ iti uktam sva kṛta karma nimittam ca asya śarīram sukha duḥkha adhiṣṭhānam tat parīkṣyate kim ghrāṇa ādi vat eka prakṛtikam uta nānā prakṛti iti kutas saṃśayaḥ vipratipatteḥ saṃśayaḥ pṛthivī ādīni bhūtāni saṅkhyā vikalpena śarīra prakṛtiḥ iti pratijānataḥ iti kim tatra tattvam pārthivam guṇa antara upalabdheḥ

tatra mānuṣam pārthivam kasmāt guṇa antara upalabdheḥ gandhavatī pṛthivī gandha vat ca śarīram ap ādīnām agandha tvāt tad prakṛti agandham syāt na tu idam abādibhiḥ asampṛktayā pṛthivī ārabdham ceṣṭa indriya artha āśraya bhāvena kalpate iti atas pañcānām bhūtānām saṃyoge sati śarīram bhavati bhūta saṃyogaḥ hi mithas pañcānām na niṣiddhaḥ iti āpya taijasa vāyavyāni loka antare śarīrāṇi teṣu api bhūta saṃyogaḥ puruṣa artha tantraḥ iti sthālī ādi dravya niṣpattau api niḥsaṃśayaḥ nāba ādi saṃyogam antarena niṣpattiḥ iti

pārthiva apya taijasam tad aguṇa upalabdheḥ niḥśvāsa ucchvāsa upalabdheḥ cāturbhautikam gandha kleda pāka vyūha avakāśa dānebhyaḥ pāñcabhautikam te ime sandigdhāḥ hetavaḥ iti upekṣitavān sūtrakāraḥ katham sandigdhāḥ sati ca prakṛti bhāve bhūtānām dharma upalabdhiḥ asati ca saṃyoga apratiṣedhāt sannihitānām iti yathā sthālyām udaka tejaḥ vāyu ākāśānām iti tat idam aneka bhūta prakṛti śarīram agandham arasam arūpam asparśam ca prakṛti anuvidhānāt syāt na tu idam ittham bhūtam tasmāt pārthivam guṇa antara upalabdheḥ

śruti prāmāṇyāt ca sūryam te cakṣuḥ gacchatāt iti atra mantre pṛthivīm te śarīram iti śrūyate tat idam prakrtau vikārasya pralaya abhidhānam iti sūryam te cakṣuḥ spṛṇomi iti atra mantra antare pṛthivīm te śarīram spṛṇomi iti śrūyate sā iyam kāraṇāt vikārasya spṛtiḥ abhidhīyate iti sthālī ādiṣu ca tulya jātīyānām eka kārya ārambha darśanāt bhinna jātīyānām eka kārya ārambha anupapattiḥ

atha idānīm indriyāṇi prameya krameṇa vicāryante kim āvyaktikāni āhosvit bhautikāni iti kutas saṃśayaḥ kṛṣṇasāre sati upalambhāt vyatiricya ca upalambhāt saṃśayaḥ kṛṣṇasāram bhautikam tasmin anupahate rūpa upalabdhiḥ upahate ca anupalabdhiḥ iti vyatiricya kṛṣṇasāram avasthitasya viṣayasya upalambhaḥ na kṛṣṇasāra prāptasya na ca aprāpya kāri tvam indriyāṇām tat idam abhautika tve vibhu tvāt sambhavati evam ubhaya dharma upalabdheḥ saṃśayaḥ

abhautikāni iti āha kasmāt mahat aṇu grahaṇāt mahat iti mahattaram mahattamam ca upalabhyate yathā nyagrodha parvata ādi aṇu iti aṇutaram aṇutamam ca gṛhyate yathā nyagrodha dhāna ādi tat ubhayam upalabhyamānam cakṣuṣaḥ bhautika tvam bādhate bhautikam hi yāvat tāvat eva vyāpnoti abhautikam tu vibhu tvāt sarva vyāpakam iti

na mahat aṇu grahaṇa mātrāt abhautika tvam vibhu tvam ca indriyāṇām śakyam pratipattum idam khalu raśmi artha sannikarṣa viśeṣāt tad grahaṇam tayoḥ mahat aṇvoḥ grahaṇam cakṣūraśmeḥ arthasya ca sannikarṣa viśeṣāt bhavati yathā pradīpa raśmeḥ arthasya ca iti raśmi artha sannikarṣaḥ ca āvaraṇa liṅgaḥ cākṣuṣaḥ hi raśmiḥ kuḍya ādibhiḥ āvṛtam artham na prakāśayati yathā pradīpa raśmiḥ iti

āvaraṇa anumeya tve sati idam āha tad anupalabdheḥ ahetuḥ rūpa sparśa vat dhi tejaḥ mahat tvāt aneka dravyavat tvāt rūpavat tvāt ca upalabdhiḥ iti pradīpa vat pratyakṣataḥ upalabhyeta cākṣuṣaḥ raśmiḥ yadi syāt iti

na anumīyamānasya pratyakṣataḥ anupalabdhiḥ abhāva hetuḥ sannikarṣa pratiṣedha arthena āvaraṇena liṅgena anumīyamānasya raśmeḥ yā pratyakṣataḥ anupalabdhiḥ na asau abhāvam pratipādayati yathā candramasaḥ para bhāgasya prthivyāḥ ca adhobhāgasya

dravya guṇa dharma bhedāt ca upalabdhi niyamaḥ bhinnaḥ khalu ayam dravya dharmaḥ guṇa dharmaḥ ca mahat aneka dravya vat ca viṣakta avayavam āpyam dravyam pratyakṣataḥ na upalabhyate sparśaḥ tu śītaḥ gṛhyate tasya dravyasya anubandhāt hemanta śiśirau kalpyete tathāvidham eva ca taijasam dravyam anudbhūta rūpam saha rūpeṇa na upalabhyate sparśaḥ tu asya uṣṇaḥ upalabhyate tasya dravyasya anubandhāt grīṣma vasantau kalpyete

yatra tu eṣā bhavati aneka dravya samavāyāt rūpa viśeṣāt ca rūpa upalabdhiḥ tatra rūpam ca dravyam ca tad āśrayaḥ pratyakṣataḥ upalabhyate rūpa viśeṣaḥ tu yat bhāvāt kvacid rūpa upalabdhiḥ yad abhāvāt ca dravyasya kvacid anupalabdhiḥ sa rūpa dharmaḥ ayam udbhava samākhyātaḥ iti anudbhūta rūpaḥ ca ayam nāyanaḥ raśmiḥ tasmāt pratyakṣatas na upalabhyate iti dṛṣṭaḥ ca tejasaḥ dharma bhedaḥ udbhūta rūpa sparśam pratyakṣam tejaḥ yathā āditya raśmayaḥ udbhūta rūpam anudbhūta sparśam ca pratyakṣam yathā pradīpa raśmayaḥ udbhūta sparśam anudbhūta rūpam apratyakṣam yathā bādi saṃyuktam tejaḥ anudbhūta rūpa sparśaḥ apratyakṣaḥ cākṣuṣaḥ raśmiḥ iti

karma kāritaḥ ca indriyāṇām vyūhaḥ puruṣa artha tantraḥ yathā cetanasya arthaḥ viṣaya upalabdhi bhūtaḥ sukha duḥkha upalabdhi bhūtaḥ ca kalpyate tathā indriyāṇi vyūḍhāni viṣaya prāpti arthaḥ ca raśmeḥ cākṣuṣasya vyūhaḥ rūpa sparśānabhivyaktiḥ ca vyavahāra prakḷpti arthā dravya viśeṣe ca pratīghātāt āvaraṇa upapattiḥ vyavahāra arthā sarva dravyāṇām viśvarūpaḥ vyūhaḥ indriya vat karma kāritaḥ puruṣa artha tantraḥ karma tu dharma adharma bhūtam cetanasya upabhoga artham iti

avyabhicārāt ca pratīghātaḥ bhautika dharmaḥ yaḥ ca ātvaraṇa upalambhāt indriyasya dravya viśeṣe pratighātaḥ sa bhautika dharmaḥ na bhūtāni vyabhicarati na abautikam pratighāta dharmakam dṛṣṭam iti apratighātaḥ tu vyabhicārī bhautikā bhautikayoḥ samāna tvāt iti yat api manyeta pratighātāt bhautikāni indriyāṇi apratighātāt abhautikāni iti prāptam dṛṣṭaḥ ca apratighātaḥ kāca abhra paṭala sphaṭika antarita upalabdheḥ tat na yuktam kasmāt yasmāt bhautikam api na pratihanyate kāca abhra paṭala sphaṭika antarita prakāśāt pradīpa raśmīnām sthālī ādiṣu pācakasya tejasaḥ apratighātaḥ

upapadyate ca anupalabdhiḥ kāraṇa bhedāt madhyandina ulkā prakāśa anupalabdhi vat tad anupalabdhiḥ yathā aneka dravyeṇa samavāyāt rūpa viśeṣāt ca upalabdhiḥ iti sati upalabdhi kāraṇe madhyandina ulkā prakāśaḥ na upakabhyate āditya prakāśena abhibhūtaḥ evam mahat aneka dravyavat tvāt rūpa viśeṣāt ca upalabhiḥ iti sati upalabdhi kāraṇe cākṣuṣaḥ raśmiḥ na upalabhyate nimitta antarataḥ tat ca vyākhyātam anudbhūta rūpa sparśasya dravyasya pratyakṣataḥ anupalabdhiḥ iti

atyanta anupalabdhiḥ ca abhāva kāraṇam yaḥ hi bravīti loṣṭa prakāśaḥ madhyandine āditya prakāśa abhibhavāt na upalabhyate iti tasya etat syāt na rātrau api anupalabdheḥ api anumānataḥ anupalabdheḥ iti evam atyanta anupalabdheḥ loṣṭa prakāśaḥ na asti na tu evam cakṣuṣaḥ raśmiḥ iti

upapanna rūpā ca iyam bāhya prakāśa anugrahāt viṣaya upalabdheḥ anabhivyaktitaḥ anupalabdhiḥ bāhyena prakāśena anugṛhītam cakṣuḥ viṣaya grāhakam tad abhāve anupalabdhiḥ sati ca prakāśa anugrahe śīta sparśa upalabdhau ca satyām tad āśrayasya dravyasya cakṣuṣā agrahaṇam rūpasya anudbhūta tvāt sā iyam rūpa anabhivyaktitaḥ rūpa āśrayasya dravyasya anupalabdhiḥ dṛṣṭā tatra yat uktam tad anupalabdheḥ ahetuḥ iti etat ayuktam

kasmāt punar abhibhavaḥ anupalabdhi kāraṇam cākṣuṣasya raśmeḥ na ucyate iti abhivyaktau ca abhibhavāt bāhya prakāśa anugraha nirapekṣatāyām ca iti ca arthaḥ yat rūpam abhivyaktam udbhūtam bāhya prakāśa anugraham ca na apekṣate tat viṣayaḥ abhibhavaḥ viparyaye abhibhava abhāvāt anudbhūta rūpa tvāt ca anupalabhyamānam bāhya prakāśa anugrahāt ca upalabhyamānam na abhibhūyate iti evam upapannam asti cākṣuṣaḥ raśmiḥ iti

naktañcara nayana raśmi darśanāt ca dṛśyante hi naktam nayana raśmayaḥ naktañcarāṇām vṛṣadaṃśa prabhṛtīnām tena śeṣasya anumānam iti jāti bheda vat indriya bhedaḥ iti ced dharma bheda mātram ca anupapannam āvaraṇasya prātipratiṣedha arthasya darśanāt iti

indriya artha sannikarṣasya jñāna kāraṇa tva anupapattiḥ kasmāt aprāpya grahaṇam kāca abhra paṭala sphaṭika antarita upalabdheḥ tṛṇa ādi sarpat dravyam kāce abhra paṭale vā pratihatam dṛṣṭam avyavahitena sat nikṛṣyate vyāhanyate vai prāptiḥ vyavadhānena iti yadi ca raśmi artha sannikarṣaḥ grahaṇa hetuḥ syāt na vyavahitasya sannikarṣaḥ iti agrahaṇam syāt asti ca iyam kāca abhra paṭala sphaṭika antarita upalabdhiḥ sā jñāpayati aprāpya kārīṇi indriyāṇi atas eva abhautikāni prāpya kāri tvam hi bhautika dharmaḥ iti
kuḍya antarita anupalabdheḥ apratiṣedhaḥ aprāpyakaritve sati indriyāṇām kuḍya antaritasya anupalabdhiḥ na syāt

prāpya kāri tve api tu kāca abhra paṭala sphaṭika antarita upalabdhiḥ na syāt apratīghātāt sannikarṣa upapattiḥ na ca kācaḥ abhra paṭalam vā nayana raśmim viṣṭabhnāti saḥ apratihanyamānaḥ sat nikṛṣyate iti

yaḥ ca manyate na bhautikasya apratighātaḥ iti tat na āditya raśmeḥ sphaṭika antarite api dāhye avighātāt ādityaraśmeḥ avighātāt sphaṭika antarite api avighātāt dāhye avighātāt avighātāt iti ca pada abhisambandhāt vākya bhedaḥ iti prativākyam ca artha bhedaḥ iti āditya raśmiḥ kumbha ādiṣu na pratihanyate avighātāt kumbha stham udakam tapati prāptau hi dravya antara guṇasya uṣṇasya sparśasya grahaṇam tena ca śīta sparśa abhibhavaḥ iti sphaṭika antarite api prakāśanīye pradīpa raśmīnām apratighātaḥ apratighātāt prāptasya grahaṇam iti bharjana kapāla ādi stham ca dravyam āgneyena tejasā dahyate tatra avighātāt prāptiḥ prāptau tu dāhaḥ na aprāpya kāri tejaḥ iti

avighātāt iti ca kevalam padam upādīyate kaḥ ayam avighātaḥ nāma avyuhyamāna avayavena vyavadhāyena dravyeṇa sarvatas dravyasya aviṣṭhmbhaḥ kriyā hetoḥ apratibandhaḥ prāpteḥ apratiṣedhaḥ iti dṛṣṭam hi kalaśa niṣaktānām apām bahis śīta sparśasya grahaṇam na ca indriyeṇa āsat nikṛṣṭasya dravyasya sparśa upalabdhiḥ dṛṣṭau ca praspanda parisravau tatra kāca abhra paṭala ādibhiḥ nayana raśmeḥ apratighātāt vibhidya arthena saha sannikarṣāt upapannam grahaṇam iti
na itara itara dharma prasaṅgāt kāca abhra paṭala ādi vat vā kuḍya ādibhiḥ apratighātaḥ kuḍya ādi vat vā kāca abhra paṭala ādibhiḥ pratighātaḥ iti prasajyate niyame kāraṇam vācyam iti

ādarśa udakayoḥ prasāda svābhāvyāt rūpa upalabdhi vat tad upalabdhiḥ ādarśa udakayoḥ prasādaḥ rūpa viśeṣaḥ svaḥ dharmaḥ niyama darśanāt prasādasya vā svaḥ dharmaḥ rūpa upalambhanam yathā ādarśa pratihatasya parāvṛttasya nayana raśmeḥ svena mukhena sannikarṣe sati sva mukha upalambhanam pratibimba grahaṇa ākhyam ādarśa rūpa anugrahāt tad nimittam bhavati ādarśa rūpa upaghāte tad abhāvāt kuḍya ādiṣu ca pratibimba grahaṇam na bhavati evam kāca abhra paṭala ādibhiḥ avighātaḥ cakṣūraśmeḥ kuḍya ādibhiḥ ca pratighātaḥ dravya svabhāva niyamāt iti

dṛṣṭa anumitānām hi niyoga pratiṣedha anupapattiḥ pramāṇasya tattva viṣaya tvāt na khalu bhoḥ parīkṣamāṇena dṛṣṭa anumitāḥ arthāḥ śakyā niyoktum evam bhavatā iti na api pratiṣeddhum evam na bhavatā iti na hi idam upapadyate rūpavat gandhaḥ api cākṣuṣaḥ bhavatu iti gandha vat vā rūpam cākṣuṣam mā bhūt iti agni pratipatti vat dhūmena udaka pratipattiḥ api bhavatu iti udaka apratipatti vat vā dhūmena agni pratipattiḥ api mā bhūt iti kim kāraṇam yathā khalu arthāḥ bhavanti yaḥ eṣām svaḥ bhāvaḥ svaḥ dharmaḥ iti tathābhūtāḥ pramāṇena pratipadyante iti tathābhūta viṣayakam hi pramāṇam iti imau khalu niyoga pratiṣedhau bhavatā deśitau kāca abhra paṭala ādi vat vā kuḍya ādibhiḥ apratighātaḥ bhavatu kuḍya ādi vat vā kāca abhra paṭala ādibhiḥ apratighātaḥ mā bhūt iti na dṛṣṭa anumitāḥ khalu ime dravya dharmāḥ pratighāta apratighātayoḥ hi upalabdhī vyavasthāpike vyavahita anupalabdhyā anumīyate kuḍya ādibhiḥ pratighātaḥ vyavahita upalabdhyā anumīyate kāca abhra paṭala ādibhiḥ apratighātaḥ iti

atha api khalu ekam idam indriyam bahūni indriyāṇi vā kutas saṃśayaḥ sthāna anya tve nānātvāt avayavi nānā sthāna tvāt ca saṃśayaḥ bahūni dravyāṇi nānā sthānāni dṛśyante nānā sthānaḥ ca san ekaḥ avayavī ca iti tena indriyeṣu bhinna sthāneṣu saṃśayaḥ iti

ekam indriyam tvac avyatirekāt tvac ekam indriyam iti āha kasmāt avyatirekāt na tvacā kiñcid indriya adhiṣṭhānam na prāptam na ca asatyām tvaci kiñcid viṣaya grahaṇam bhavati yayā satva indriya sthānāni vyāptāni yasyām ca satyām viṣaya grahaṇam bhavati sā tvac ekam indriyam iti na indriya antara artha anupalabdheḥ sparśa upalabdhi lakṣaṇāyām satyām tvaci gṛhyamāṇe tvac indriyeṇa sparśe indriya antara arthāḥ rūpa ādayaḥ na gṛhyante andhādibhiḥ na sparśa grāhakāt indriyāt indriya antaram asti iti sparśa vat andhādibhiḥ gṛhyeran rūpa ādayaḥ na ca gṛhyante tasmāt na ekam indriyam tvac iti

tvac avayava viśeṣeṇa dhūma upalabdhi vat tad upalabdhiḥ yathā tvacaḥ avayava viśeṣaḥ kaścid cakṣuṣi sannikṛṣṭaḥ dhūma sparśam gṛhṇāti na anyaḥ evam tvacaḥ avayava viśeṣāḥ rūpa ādi grāhakāḥ teṣām upaghātāt andhādibhiḥ na gṛhyante rūpa ādayaḥ iti vyāhata tvāt ahetuḥ tvac avyatirekāt ekam indriyam iti uktvā tvac avayava viśeṣeṇa dhūma upalabdhi vat rūpa ādi upalabdhiḥ iti ucyate evam ca sati nānā bhūtāni viṣaya grāhakāṇi viṣaya vyavasthānāt tad bhāve viṣaya grahaṇasya bhāvāt tad upaghāte ca abhāvāt tathā ca pūrvaḥ vādaḥ uttareṇa vādeṇa vyāhanyate iti sandigdhaḥ ca avyatirekaḥ pṛthivī ādibhiḥ api bhūtaiḥ indriya adhiṣṭhānāni vyāptāni na ca teṣu asatsu viṣaya grahaṇam bhavati iti tasmāt na tvac anyat vā sarva viṣayam ekam indriyam iti

na yugapad artha anupalabdheḥ ātmā manasā sambadhyate manaḥ indriyeṇa indriyam sarva arthaiḥ sannikṛṣṭam iti ātma indriya manortha sannikarṣebhyaḥ yugapad grahaṇāni syuḥ na ca yugapad rūpa ādayaḥ gṛhyante tasmāt na ekam indriyam sarva viṣayam asti iti asāha caryāt ca viṣaya grahaṇānām na ekam indriyam sarva viṣayakam sāhacarye hi viṣaya grahaṇānām andha ādi anupapattiḥ iti

vipratiṣedhāt ca na tvac ekā na khalu tvac ekam indriyam vyāghātāt tvacā rūpāṇi aprāptāni gṛhyante iti aprāpya kāri tve sparśa ādiṣu api evam prasaṅgaḥ sparśa ādīnām ca prāptānām grahaṇāt rūpa ādīnām prāptānām grahaṇam iti prāptam prāpya aprāpya kāritvam iti ced āvaraṇa anupapatteḥ viṣaya mātrasya grahaṇam atha api manyeta prāptāḥ sparśa ādayaḥ tvacā gṛhyante rūpāṇi tu aprāptāni iti evam sati na asti āvaraṇam āvaraṇa anupapatteḥ ca rūpa mātrasya grahaṇam vyavahitasya ca avyavahitasya ca iti dūra antika anuvidhānam ca rūpa upalabdhi anupalabdhyoḥ na syāt aprāptam tvacā gṛhyate rūpam iti dūre rūpasya agrahaṇam antike ca grahaṇam iti etat na syāt iti

pratiṣedhāt ca nānātva siddhau sthāpanā hetuḥ api upādīyate indriya artha pañcatvāt arthaḥ prayojanam tat pañcavidham indriyāṇām sparśanena indriyeṇa sparśa grahaṇe sati na tena eva rūpam gṛhyate iti rūpa grahaṇa prayojanam cakṣuḥ anumīyate sparśa rūpa grahaṇe ca tābhyām eva na gandhaḥ gṛhyate iti gandha grahaṇa prayojanam ghrāṇam anumīyate trayāṇām grahaṇe na taiḥ eva rasaḥ gṛhyate iti rasa grahaṇa prayojanam rasanam anumīyate na ca caturṇām grahaṇe taiḥ eva śabdaḥ śrūyate iti śabda grahaṇa prayojanam śrotram anumīyate evam indriya prayojanasya anitaretara sādhana sādhya tvāt pañca eva indriyāṇi

na tad artha bahu tvāt na khalu indriya artha pañcatvāt pañca indriyāṇi iti sidhyati kasmāt teṣām arthānām bahu tvāt bahavaḥ khalu ime indriya arthāḥ sparśāḥ tāvat śīta uṣṇa an uṣṇa aśītāḥ iti rūpāṇi śukla harita ādīni gandhāḥ iṣṭa aniṣṭa upekṣaṇīyāḥ rasāḥ kaṭuka ādayaḥ śabdāḥ varṇa ātmānaḥ dhvani mātrāḥ ca bhinnāḥ tat yasya indriya artha pañcatvāt pañca indriyāṇi tasya indriya artha bahu tvāt bahūni indriyāṇi prasajyante iti

gandha tva ādi avyatirekāt gandha ādīnām apratiṣedhaḥ gandha tva ādibhiḥ sva sāmānyaiḥ kṛta vyavasthānām gandha ādīnām yāni gandha ādi grahaṇāni tāni asamāna sādhana sādhya tvāt grāhaka antarāṇi na prayojayanti artha samūhaḥ anumāna muktaḥ na artha eka deśaḥ artha eka deśam ca āśritya viṣaya pañcatva mātram bhavān pratiṣedhati tasmāt ayuktaḥ ayam pratiṣedhaḥ iti
