artha api bādhanā nivṛtteḥ vedayataḥ paryeṣaṇa doṣāt apratiṣedhaḥ sukhasya duḥkha uddeśena iti prakaraṇāt paryeṣaṇam prārthanā viṣaya arjana tṛṣṇā paryeṣaṇasya doṣaḥ yat ayam vedayamānaḥ prārthayate tat ca asya prārthitam na sampadyate sampadya vā vipadyate nyūnam vā sampadyate bahu pratyanīkam vā sampadyate iti etasmāt paryeṣaṇa doṣāt nānāvidhaḥ mānasaḥ santāpaḥ bhavati evam vedayataḥ paryeṣaṇa doṣāt bādhanāyāḥ anivṛttiḥ bādhanā nivṛtteḥ duḥkha saṃjñā bhāvanam upadiśyate anena kāraṇena duḥkham janma na tu sukhasya abhāvāt iti atha api etat anūktam kāmam kāmayamānasya yadā kāmaḥ samṛdhyati atha enam aparaḥ kāmaḥ kṣipram eva prabādhate api ced udanemi samantāt bhūmim imām labhate sa gavāśvām na sa tena dhanena dhanaiṣī tṛpyati kid nu sukham dhana kāme iti

duḥkha vikalpe sukha abhimānāt ca duḥkha saṃjñā bhāvanā upadeśaḥ kriyate ayam khalu sukha saṃvedane vyavasthitaḥ sukham parama puruṣa artham manyate na sukhāt anyat niḥśreyasam asti sukhe prāpte caritārthaḥ kṛta karaṇīyaḥ bhavati mithyā saṅkalpāt sukhe tad sādhaneṣu ca viṣayeṣu saṃrajyate saṃraktaḥ sukhāya ghaṭate ghaṭamānasya asya janma jarā vyādhi prāyaṇa aniṣṭa saṃyoga iṣṭa viyoga prārthita anupapatti nimittam anekavidham yāvat duḥkham utpadyate tam duḥkha vikalpam sukham iti abhimanyate sukha aṅga bhūtam dukham na duḥkham anāsādya śakyam sukham avāptum tādarthyāt sukham eva idam iti sukha saṃjñā upahata prajñaḥ jāyasva ca iti saṃdhāvatī iti saṃsāram na ativarttate tat asyāḥ sukha saṃjñāyāḥ pratipakṣaḥ duḥkha saṃjñā bhāvanam upadiśyate duḥkha anuṣaṅgāt duḥkham janma iti na sukhasya abhāvāt

yadi evam kasmāt duḥkham janma iti na ucyate saḥ ayam evam vācye yat evam āha duḥkham eva janma iti tena sukha abhāvam jñāpayati iti janma vinigraha arthīyaḥ vai khalu ayam eva śabdaḥ katham na duḥkham janma svarūpataḥ kim tu duḥkha upacārāt evam sukham api iti etat anena eva nirvarttyate na tu duḥkham eva janma iti

duḥkha uddeśa anantaram apavargaḥ sa pratyākhyāyate ṛṇa kleśa pravṛtti anubandhāt apavarga abhāvaḥ ṛṇa anubandhāt na asti apavargaḥ jāyamānaḥ ha vai brāhmaṇaḥ tribhiḥ ṛṇaiḥ ṛṇavān jāyate brahmacaryeṇa ṛṣibhyaḥ yajñena devebhyaḥ prajayā pitṛbhyaḥ iti ṛṇāni teṣām anubandhaḥ sva karmabhiḥ sambandhaḥ karma sambandha vacanāt jarā maryam vai etat satram yat agnihotram darśa pūrṇam āsau ca iti jarayā ha vai eṣa tasmāt satrāt vimucyate mṛtyunā ha vā iti ṛṇa anubandhāt apavarga anuṣṭhāna kālaḥ na asti iti apavarga abhāvaḥ

kleśa anubandhāt na asti apavargaḥ kleśa anubaddhaḥ eva ayam mriyate kleśa anubaddhaḥ ca jāyate na asya kleśa anubandha vicchedaḥ gṛhyate pravṛtti anubandhāt na asti apavargaḥ janma prabhṛti ayam yāvat prāyaṇam vāc buddhi śarīra ārambheṇa avimuktaḥ gṛhyate tatra yat uktam duḥkha janma pravṛtti doṣa mithyā jñānānām uttarottara apāye tad anantara abhāvāt apavargaḥ iti tat anupapannam iti

atra abhidhīyate yat tāvat ṛṇa anubandhāt iti ṛṇaiḥ iva ṛṇaiḥ iti pradhāna śabda anupapatteḥ guṇa śabdena anuvādaḥ nindā praśaṃsā upapatteḥ ṛṇaiḥ iti na ayam pradhāna śabdaḥ yatra khalu ekaḥ pratyādeyam dadāti dvitīyaḥ ca pratideyam gṛhṇāti tatra asya dṛṣṭa tvāt pradhānam ṛṇa śabdaḥ na ca etat iha upapadyate pradhāna śabda anupapatteḥ guṇa śabdena ayam anuvādaḥ ṛṇaiḥ iva ṛṇaiḥ iti prayukta upamam ca etat yathā agniḥ māṇavakaḥ iti anyatra dṛṣṭaḥ ca ayam ṛṇa śabdaḥ iha prayujyate yathā agni śabdaḥ māṇavake katham guṇa śabdena anuvādaḥ nindā praśaṃsā upapatteḥ karma lope ṛṇī iva ṛṇa ādānāt nindyate karma anuṣṭhāne ca ṛṇī iva ṛṇa dānāt praśasyate saḥ eva upama arthaḥ iti

jāyamānaḥ iti guṇa śabdaḥ viparyaye anadhikārāt jāyamānaḥ ha vai brāhmaṇaḥ iti ca guṇa śabdaḥ gṛhasthaḥ sampadyamānaḥ jāyamānaḥ iti yadā ayam gṛhasthaḥ jāyate tadā karmabhiḥ adhikriyate mātṛtaḥ jāyamānasya anadhikārāt yadā tu mātṛtaḥ jāyate kumāraḥ na tadā karmabhiḥ adhikriyate arthinaḥ śaktasya ca adhikārāt arthinaḥ karmabhiḥ adhikāraḥ karma vidhau kāma saṃyogaḥ mṛteḥ agnihotram juhuyāt svarga kāmaḥ iti evamādi śaktasya ca pravṛtti sambhavāt śaktasya karmabhiḥ adhikāraḥ pravṛtti sambhavāt śaktaḥ khalu vihite karmaṇi pravarttate na itaraḥ iti ubhaya abhāvaḥ tu pradhāna śabda arthe mātṛtaḥ jāyamāne kumāre ubhayam arthitā śaktiḥ ca na bhavati iti

na bhidyate ca laukikāt vākyāt vaidikam vākyam prekṣā pūrva kāri puruṣa praṇīta tvena tatra laukikaḥ tāvat aparīkṣakaḥ api na jāta mātram kumārakam evam brūyāt adhīṣva yajasva brahmacaryam cara iti kutas evam ṛṣiḥ upapannāna vadya vādī upadeśa arthena prayuktaḥ upadiśati na khalu vai narttakaḥ andheṣu pravarttate na gāyakaḥ badhireṣu iti

upadiṣṭa artha vijñānam ca upadeśa viṣayaḥ yaḥ ca upadiṣṭam artham vijānāti tam prati upadeśaḥ kriyate na ca etat asti jāyamāna kumārakaḥ iti gārhasthya liṅgam ca mantra brāhmaṇam karma abhivadati yat ca mantra brāhmaṇam karma abhivadati tat patnī sambandha ādinā gārhasthya liṅgena upapannam tasmāt gṛhasthaḥ ayam jāyamānaḥ abhidhīyate iti arthi tvasya ca avipariṇāme jarā maryavāda upapattiḥ

yāvat ca asya phalena arthi tvam na vipariṇamate na nivartate tāvat anena karma anuṣṭheyam iti upapadyate jarā maryavādaḥ tam prati iti jarayā ha vā iti āyuṣaḥ turīyasya caturthasya pravrajyā yuktasya vacanam jarayā ha vai eṣaḥ etasmāt vimucyate iti āyuṣaḥ turīyam caturtham pravrajyā yuktam jarā iti ucyate tatra hi pravrajyā vidhīyate atyanta jarā saṃyoge jarayā ha vā iti anarthakam aśaktaḥ vimucyate iti etat api na upapadyate svayam aśaktasya bāhyām śaktim āha antevāsī vā juhuyāt brahmaṇā sa parikrītaḥ kṣīra hotā vā jahuyāt dhanena sa parikrītaḥ iti

atha api vihitam vānūdyeta kāmāt vā arthaḥ parikalpyeta vihita anuvacanam nyāyyam iti ṛṇavān iva asvatantraḥ gṛhasthaḥ karmasu pravarttate iti upapannam vākyasya sāmarthyam phalasya hi sādhanāni prayatna viṣayaḥ na phalam tāni sampannāni phalāya kalpante vihitam ca jāyamānam vidhīyate ca jāyamānam tena yaḥ sambaddhyate saḥ ayam jāyamānaḥ iti

pratyakṣa vidhāna abhāvāt iti ced na pratiṣedhasya api pratyakṣa vidhāna abhāvāt iti pratyakṣataḥ vidhīyate gārhasthyam brāhmaṇena yadi ca āśrama antaram abhaviṣyat tat api vyadhāsyata pratyakṣataḥ pratyakṣa vidhāna abhāvāt na asti āśrama antaram iti na pratiṣedhasya api pratyakṣataḥ vidhāna abhāvāt na pratiṣedhaḥ api vai brāhmaṇena pratyakṣataḥ vidhīyate na santi āśrama antarāṇi ekaḥ eva gṛhastha āśramaḥ iti pratiṣedhasya pratyakṣataḥ aśravaṇāt ayuktam etat iti adhikārāt ca vidhānam vidyā antara vat yathā śāstra antarāṇi sve sve adhikāre pratyakṣataḥ vidhāyakāni na artha antara abhāvāt evam idam brāhmaṇam gṛhastha śāstram sve adhikāre pratyakṣataḥ vidhāyakam na āśrama antarāṇām abhāvāt iti

ṛc brāhmaṇam ca apavarga abhidhāyi abhidhīyate ṛcaḥ ca brāhmaṇāni ca apavarga abhivādīni bhavanti ṛcaḥ ca tāvat karmabhiḥ mṛtyum ṛṣayaḥ niṣeduḥ prajāvantaḥ draviṇam icchamānāḥ atha apare ṛṣayaḥ manīṣiṇaḥ param karmabhyaḥ amṛta tvam ānaśuḥ na karmaṇā na prajayā dhanena tyāgena eke amṛta tvam ānaśuḥ pareṇa nākam nihitam guhāyām vibhrājate yat yatayaḥ viśanti veda aham etam puruṣam mahāntam āditya varṇam tamasaḥ parastāt tam eva viditvā atimṛtyum eti na anyaḥ panthāḥ vidyate ayanāya

atha brāhmaṇāni trayaḥ dharma skandhāḥ yajñaḥ adhyayanam dānam iti prathamaḥ tapaḥ eva dvitīyaḥ brahmacārī ācārya kula vāsī iti tṛtīyaḥ atyantam ātmānam ācārya kule avasādayan sarve eva ete puṇya lokāḥ bhavanti brahma saṃsthaḥ amṛta tvam eti etam eva pravrājinaḥ lokam icchantaḥ pravrajanti iti atho khalu āhuḥ kāma mayaḥ eva ayam puruṣaḥ iti sa yathākāmaḥ bhavati tad kratuḥ bhavati yat kratuḥ bhavati tat karma kurute yat karma kurute tat abhisaṃpadyate

iti karmabhiḥ saṃsaraṇam uktvā prakṛtam anyat upadiśanti iti nu kāmayamānaḥ atha akāmayamānaḥ yaḥ akāmaḥ niṣkāmaḥ ātma kāmaḥ āpta kāmaḥ bhavati na tasya prāṇāḥ utkrāmanti iha eva samavalīyante brahmā eva san brahmā api eti iti tatra yat uktam ṛṇa anubandhāt apavarga abhāvaḥ iti etat ayuktam iti ye catvāraḥ pathayaḥ deva yānāḥ iti ca cāturāśramya śruteḥ aikāśramyān upapattiḥ

phala arthinaḥ ca idam brāhmaṇam jarā maryam vai etat satram yat agnihotram darśa pūrṇam āsau ca iti katham samāropaṇāt ātmani apratiṣedhaḥ prājāpatyām iṣṭam nirūpya tasyām sarva vedasam hutvā ātmani agnīn samāropya brāhmaṇaḥ pravrajet iti śrūyate tena vijānīmaḥ prajā vitta loka eṣaṇābhyaḥ vyutthitasya nivṛtte phala arthi tve samāropaṇam vidhīyate iti evam ca brāhmaṇāni saḥ anyat vratam upākariṣyamāṇaḥ yājñavalkyaḥ maitreyīm iti ha uvāca pravrajiṣyan vai are aham asmāt sthānāt asmi hanta te anayā kātyāyanyā sahāntam karavāṇi iti atha api ukta anuśāsanā asi maitreyi etāvat are khalu amṛta tvam iti ha uktvā yājñavalkyaḥ pravavrāja iti

pātra caya anta anupapatteḥ ca phala abhāvaḥ jarā āmarye ca karmaṇi aviśeṣeṇa kalpyamāne sarvasya pātra caya antāni karmāṇi iti prasajyate tatra eṣaṇā vyutthānam na śrūyeta etat dha sma vai tat pūrve brāhmaṇāḥ anūcānāḥ vidvāṃsaḥ prajām na kāmayante kim prajayā kariṣyāmaḥ yeṣām naḥ ayam ātmā ayam lokaḥ iti te ha sma putra eṣaṇāyāḥ ca vitta eṣaṇāyāḥ ca loka eṣaṇāyāḥ ca vyutthāya atha bhikṣā caryam caranti iti eṣaṇābhyaḥ ca vyutthitasya pātra caya antāni karmāṇi na upapadyante iti na aviśeṣeṇa karttuḥ prayojakam phalam bhavati iti

cāturāśramya vidhānāt ca itihāsa purāṇa dharma śāstreṣu aikāśramya anupapattiḥ tat apramāṇam iti ced na pramāṇena prāmāṇya abhyanujñānāt pramāṇena khalu brāhmaṇena itihāsa purāṇasya prāmāṇyam abhyanujñāyate te vā khalu ete atharva aṅgirasaḥ etat itihāsa purāṇam abhyavadan itihāsa purāṇam pañcamam vedānām vedaḥ iti tasmāt ayuktam etat aprāmāṇyam iti aprāmāṇye ca dharma śāstrasya prāṇabhṛtām vyavahāra lopāt loka uccheda prasaṅgaḥ

draṣṭṛ pravaktṛ sāmāṇyāt ca aprāmānya anupapattiḥ ye eva mantra brāhmaṇasya draṣṭāraḥ pravaktāraḥ ca te khalu itihāsa purāṇasya dharma śāstrasya ca iti viṣaya vyavasthānāt ca yathā viṣayam prāmāṇyam anyaḥ mantra brāhmaṇasya viṣayaḥ anyat ca itihāsa purāṇa dharma śāstrāṇām iti yajñaḥ mantra brāhmaṇasya loka vṛttam itihāsa purāṇasya loka vyavahāra vyavasthānam dharma śāstrasya viṣayaḥ tatra ekena na sarvam vyavasthāpyate iti yathā viṣayam etāni pramāṇāni indriya ādi vat iti

yat punar etat kleśa anubandhasya avicchedāt iti suṣuptasya svapna adarśane kleśa abhāvāt apavargaḥ yathā suṣuptasya khalu svapna adarśane rāga anubandhaḥ sukha duḥkha anubandhaḥ ca vicchidyate tathā apavarge api iti etat ca brahma vidaḥ muktasya ātmanaḥ rūpam udāharanti iti

yat api pravṛtti anubandhāt iti na pravṛttiḥ pratisandhānāya hīna kleśasya prakṣīṇeṣu rāga dveṣa moheṣu pravṛttiḥ na pratisandhānāya pratisandhiḥ tu pūrva janma nivṛttau punarjanma tat ca adṛṣṭa kāritam tasyām prahīṇāyām pūrva janma abhāve janma antara abhāvaḥ apratisandhānam apavargaḥ karma vaiphalya prasaṅgaḥ iti ced na karma vipāka pratisaṃvedanasya apratyākhyānāt pūrva janma nivṛttau punarjanma na bhavati iti ucyate na tu karma vipāka pratisaṃvedanam pratyākhyāyate sarvāṇi pūrva karmāṇi hi ante janmani pipacyante iti
na kleśa santateḥ svābhāvika tvāt na upapadyate kleśa anubandha vicchedaḥ kasmāt kleśa santateḥ svābhāvika tvāt anādiḥ iyam kleśa santatiḥ na ca anādiḥ śakyaḥ ucchetum iti
atra kaścid parīhāram āha prāk utpatteḥ abhāva anitya tva vat svābhāvike api anitya tvam yathā anādiḥ prāk utpatteḥ abhāvaḥ utpannena bhāvena nivartyate evam svābhāvikī kleśa santatiḥ anityā iti

aparaḥ āha aṇu śyāma tā antya tva vat vā yathā anādiḥ aṇu śyāma tā atha ca agni saṃyogāt anityā tathā kleśa santatiḥ api iti sataḥ khalu dharmaḥ nitya tvam anitya tvam ca tattvam bhāve abhāve bhāktam iti anādiḥ aṇuśyāma tā iti hetu abhāvāt ayuktam anutpatti dharmakam anityam iti na atra hetuḥ asti iti

ayam tu samādhiḥ na saṅkalpa nimitta tvāt ca rāga ādīnām karma nimitta tvāt itaretara nimitta tvāt ca iti samuccayaḥ mithyā saṅkalpebhyaḥ rañjanīya kopanīya mohanīyebhyaḥ rāga dveṣa mohāḥ utpadyante karma ca sattva nikāya nirvartakam naiyamikān rāga dveṣa mohān nirvarttayati niyama darśanāt dṛśyate hi kaścid sattva nikāyaḥ rāga bahulaḥ kaścid dveṣa bahulaḥ kaścid moha bahulaḥ iti itaretara nimittā ca rāga ādīnām utpattiḥ mūḍhaḥ rajyati mūḍhaḥ kupyati raktaḥ muhyati kupitaḥ muhyati

sarva mithyā saṅkalpānām tattva jñānāt anutpattiḥ kāraṇa anutpātau ca kārya anutpatteḥ iti rāga ādīnām atyantam anutpattiḥ iti anādiḥ ca kleśa santatiḥ iti ayuktam sarve ime khalu ādhyātmikāḥ bhāvāḥ anādinā prabandhena pravarttante śarīra ādayaḥ na jātu atra kaścid anutpanna pūrvaḥ prathamatas utpadyate anyatra tattva jñānāt na ca evam sati anutpatti dharmakam kiñcid avyaya dharmakam pratijñāyate iti karma ca sattva nikāya nirvartakam tattva jñāna kṛtāt mithyā saṅkalpa vighātāt na rāga ādi utpatti nimittam bhavati sukha duḥkha saṃvittiḥ phalam tu bhavati iti

kim nu khalu bhoḥ yāvantaḥ viṣayāḥ tāvatsu pratyekam tattva jñānam utpadyate atha kvacid utpadyate iti kaḥ ca atra viśeṣaḥ na tāvat eka ekatra yāvat viṣayam utpadyate jñeyānām ānantyāt na api kvacid utpadyate yatra na utpadyate tatra anivṛttaḥ mohaḥ iti moha śeṣa prasaṅgaḥ na ca anya viṣayeṇa tattva jñānena anya viṣayaḥ mohaḥ śakyaḥ pratiṣeddhum iti

mithyājñānam vai khalu mohaḥ na tattva jñānasya anutpatti mātram tat ca mithyājñānam yatra viṣaye pravartamānam saṃsāra bījam bhavati sa viṣayaḥ tattvataḥ jñeyaḥ iti kim punar tat mithyājñānam anātmani ātma grahaḥ aham asmi iti mohaḥ ahaṅkāraḥ iti anātmānam khalu aham asmi iti paśyataḥ dṛṣṭiḥ ahaṅkāraḥ iti kim punar tad artha jātam yat viṣayaḥ ahaṅkāraḥ śarīra indriya manaḥ vedanā buddhayaḥ katham tat viṣayaḥ ahaṅkāraḥ saṃsāra bījam bhavati

ayam khalu śarīra ādi artha jātam aham asmi iti vyavasitaḥ tad ucchedena ātma ucchedam manyamānaḥ anuccheda tṛṣṇā pariplutaḥ punar punar tat upādatte tat upādadānaḥ janma maraṇāya yatate tena aviyogāt na atyantam duḥkhāt vimucyate iti yaḥ tu duḥkham duḥkha āyatanam duḥkha anuṣaktam sukham ca sarvam idam duḥkham iti paśyati sa duḥkham parijānati parijñātam ca duḥkham prahīṇam bhavati anupādānāt sa viṣān na vat evam doṣān karma ca duḥkha hetuḥ iti paśyati na ca aprahīṇeṣu doṣeṣu duḥkha prabandha ucchedena śakyam bhavitum iti doṣān jahāti prahīṇeṣu ca doṣeṣu na pravṛttiḥ pratisandhānāya iti uktam

pretyabhāva phala duḥkhāni ca jñeyāni vyavasthāpayati karma ca doṣān ca praheyān apavargaḥ adhigantavyaḥ tasya adhigama upāyaḥ tattva jñānam evam catasṛbhiḥ vidhābhiḥ prameyam vibhaktam āsevamānasya abhyasyataḥ bhāvayataḥ samyak darśanam yathābhūta avabodhaḥ tattva jñānam utpadyate evam ca doṣa nimittānām tattva jñānāt ahaṅkāra nivṛttiḥ

śarīra ādi duḥkha antam prameyam doṣa nimittam tad viṣaya tvāt mithyājñānasya tat idam tattva jñānam tat viṣayam utpannam ahaṅkāram nivartayati samāna viṣaye tayoḥ virodhāt evam tattva jñānāt duḥkha janma pravṛtti doṣa mithyā jñānānām uttarottara apāye tad anantara abhāvāt apavargaḥ iti sa ca ayam śāstra artha saṃgrahaḥ anūdyate na apūrvaḥ vidhīyate iti

prasaṅkhyān ānupūrvī tu khalu doṣa nimittam rūpa ādayaḥ viṣayāḥ saṅkalpa kṛtāḥ kāma viṣayāḥ indriya arthāḥ iti rūpa ādayaḥ ucyante te mithyā saṅkalpyamānāḥ rāga dveṣa mohān pravartayanti tān pūrvam prasañcakṣīta tān ca prasañca kṣāṇasya rūpa ādi viṣayaḥ mithyā saṅkalpaḥ nivartate tad nivṛttau adhyātmam śarīra ādi prasañcakṣīta tad prasaṅkhyānāt adhyātma viṣayaḥ ahaṅkāraḥ nivartate saḥ ayam adhyātmam bahis ca vivikta cittaḥ viharan muktaḥ iti ucyate

atas param kācid saṃjñā heyā kācid bhāvayitavyā iti upadiśyate nātha nirākaraṇam artha upādānam vā katham iti tad nimittam tu avayavi abhimānaḥ teṣām doṣāṇām nimittam tu avayavi abhimānaḥ sā ca khalu strī saṃjñā sa pariṣkārā puruṣasya puruṣa saṃjñā ca striyāḥ sa pariṣkārā nimitta saṃjñā anuvyañjana saṃjñā ca

nimitta saṃjñā rasanā śrotram danta uṣṭham cakṣuḥ nāsikam anuvyañjana saṃjñā ittham daṇḍāḥ ittham oṣṭhau iti sā iyam saṃjñā kāmam vardhayati tad anuṣaktān ca doṣān vivarjanīyān varjanam tu asyāḥ bhedena avayava saṃjñā keśa loma māṃsa śoṇita asthi snāyu śirā kapha pitta uccāra ādi saṃjñā tām aśubha saṃjñā iti ācakṣate tām asya bhāvayataḥ kāma rāgaḥ prahīyate sati eva ca dvividhe viṣaye kācid saṃjñā bhāvanīyā kācid parivarjanīya iti upadiśyate yathā viṣa sampṛkte anne anna saṃjñā upādānāya viṣa saṃjñā prahāṇāya iti

atha idānīm artham nirākariṣyata avayavi nirākaraṇam upapādyate vidyā avidyā dvaividhyāt saṃśayaḥ sat asatoḥ upalambhāt vidyā dvividhā sat asatoḥ anupalambhāt avidyā api dvividhā upalambhyamāne avayavini vidyāt vaividhyāt saṃśayaḥ anupalabhyamāne ca avidyāt vaividhyāt saṃśayaḥ saḥ ayam avayavī yat upalabhyate atha api na upalabhyate na kathañcana saṃśayāt mucyate iti
tad asaṃśayaḥ pūrva hetu prasiddha tvāt tasmin anupapannaḥ saṃśayaḥ kasmāt pūrva ukta hetūnām apratiṣedhāt asti dravya antara ārambhaḥ iti
vṛtti anupapatteḥ api na saṃśayaḥ vṛtti anupapatteḥ api tarhi saṃśaya anupapattiḥ na asti avayavi iti

tat vibhajate kṛtsna eka deśa avṛtti tvāt avayavānām avayavi abhāvaḥ ekaikaḥ avayavaḥ na tāvat kṛtsne avayavini vartate tayoḥ parimāṇa bhedāt avayava antara sambandha abhāva prasaṅgāt ca na api avayavi eka deśena na hi asya anye avayavāḥ eka deśa bhūtāḥ santi iti

atha avayaveṣu eva avayavī vartate teṣu ca āvṛtteḥ avayavi abhāvaḥ na tāvat pratyavayavam vartate tayoḥ parimāṇa bhedāt dravyasya ca eka dravya tva prasaṅgāt na api eka deśaiḥ sarveṣu anya avayava abhāvāt tat evam na yuktaḥ saṃśayaḥ na asti avayavi iti
pṛthak ca avayavebhyaḥ avṛtteḥ avayavi abhāvaḥ iti vartate na ca ayam pṛthak avayavebhyaḥ vartate agrahaṇāt nitya tva prasaṅgāt ca tasmāt na asti avayavi iti
na ca avayavi avayavāḥ na ca avayavānām dharmaḥ avayavī kasmāt dharma mātrasya dharmibhiḥ avayavaiḥ pūrvavat sambandha anupapatteḥ pṛthak ca avayavebhyaḥ dharmibhyaḥ dharmasya agrahaṇāt iti samānam

ekasmin bheda abhāvāt bheda śabda prayoga anupapatteḥ apraśnaḥ kim pratyavayavam kṛtsnaḥ avayavī vartate atha eka deśena iti na upapadyate praśnaḥ kasmāt ekasmin bheda abhāvāt bheda śabda prayoga anupapatteḥ kṛtsnam iti anekasya aśeṣa abhidhānam eka deśaḥ iti nānātve kasyacid abhidhānam tau imau kṛtsna eka deśa śabdau bheda viṣayau na ekasmin avayavini upapadyete bheda abhāvāt iti

anya avayava abhāvāt na eka deśena vartate iti ahetuḥ avayava antara bhāve api avṛtteḥ ahetuḥ avayava antara abhāvāt iti yadi api eka deśaḥ avayava antara bhūtaḥ syāt tathā api avayave avayava antaram vartate na avayavī iti anyaḥ avayavi iti anya avayava bhāve api avṛtteḥ avayavinaḥ na eka deśena vṛttiḥ anya avayava abhāvāt iti ahetuḥ

vṛttiḥ katham iti ced ekasya anekatra āśraya āśrita sambandha lakṣaṇā prāptiḥ āśraya āśrita bhāvaḥ katham iti ced yasya yatas anyatra ātma lābha anupapattiḥ saḥ āśrayaḥ na kāraṇa dravyebhyaḥ anyatra kārya dravyam ātmānam labhate viparyayaḥ tu kāraṇa dravyeṣu iti nityeṣu katham iti ced anityeṣu darśanāt siddham nityeṣu dravyeṣu katham āśraya āśrayi bhāvaḥ iti ced anityeṣu dravya guṇeṣu darśanāt āśraya āśrita bhāvasya nityeṣu siddhiḥ iti tasmāt avayavi abhimānaḥ pratiṣidhyate niḥśreyasa kāmasya na avayavī yathā rūpa ādiṣu mithyā saṅkalpaḥ na rūpa ādayaḥ iti

sarva agrahaṇam avayavi asiddheḥ iti pratyavasthitaḥ api etat āha keśa samūhe taimirika upalabdhi vat tad upalabdhiḥ yathā ekaikaḥ keśaḥ taimirikeṇa na upalabhyate keśa samūhaḥ tu upalabhyate tathā ekaikaḥ aṇuḥ na upalabhyate aṇu sañcayaḥ tu upalabhyate tat idam aṇu samūha viṣayam grahaṇam iti

sva viṣayān atikrameṇa indiḥ yasya paṭu manda bhāvāt viṣaya grahaṇasya tathā abhāvaḥ na aviṣaye pravṛttiḥ yathā viṣayam indriyāṇām paṭu manda bhāvāt viṣaya grahaṇānām paṭu manda bhāvaḥ bhavati cakṣuḥ khalu prakṛṣyamāṇam na aviṣayam gandham gṛhṇāti nikṛṣyamāṇam ca na sva viṣayāt pracyavate saḥ ayam taimirikaḥ kaścid cakṣuḥ viṣayaṃkeśam na gṛhṇāti kaścid gṛhṇāti keśa samūham

ubhayam hi ataimimirikeṇa cakṣuṣā gṛhyate paramāṇavaḥ tu atīndriyāḥ indriya aviṣaya bhūtāḥ na kenacid indriyeṇa gṛhyante samuditāḥ tu gṛhyante iti aviṣaye pravṛttiḥ indriyasya prasajyeta na jātu artha antaram aṇubhyaḥ gṛhyate iti te khalu ime paramāṇavaḥ sannihitā gṛhyamāṇā atīndriya tvam jahati viyuktāḥ ca āgṛhyamāṇāḥ indriya viṣaya tvam na labhantaḥ iti saḥ ayam dravya antara anutpattau ati mahān vyāghātaḥ iti upapadyate dravya antaram yat grahaṇasya viṣayaḥ iti

sañcaya mātram viṣayaḥ iti ced na sañcayasya saṃyoga bhāvāt tasya ca atīndriyasya agrahaṇāt ayuktam sañcayaḥ khalu anekasya saṃyogaḥ sa ca gṛhyamāṇa āśrayaḥ gṛhyate na ati indriya āśrayaḥ bhavati hi idam anena saṃyuktam iti tasmāt yuktam etat iti gṛhyamāṇasya ca indriyeṇa viṣayasya āvaraṇa ādi anupalabdhi kāraṇam upalabhyate tasmāt na indriya daurbalyāt anupalabdhiḥ aṇūnām yathā na indriya daurbalyāt cakṣuṣā anupalabdhiḥ gandha ādīnām iti

avayava avayavi prasaṅgaḥ ca evam ā pralayāt yaḥ khalu avayavinaḥ avayaveṣu vṛtti pratiṣedhāt abhāvaḥ saḥ ayam avayavasya avayaveṣu prasajyamānaḥ sarva pralayāya vā kalpeta niravayavāt vā paramāṇutaḥ nivarteta ubhayathā ca upalabdhi viṣayasya abhāvaḥ tad abhāvāt upalabhya bhāvaḥ upalabhya āśrayaḥ ca ayam vṛtti pratiṣedhaḥ saḥ āśrayam vyāghnan ātma ghātāya kalpate iti

atha api na pralayaḥ anusadbhāvāt avayava vibhāgam āśritya vṛtti pratiṣedhāt abhāvaḥ prasajyamānaḥ niravayavāt paramāṇoḥ nivartate na sarva pralayāya kalpate niravayava tvam tu paramāṇoḥ vibhāgaiḥ alpatara prasaṅgasya yatas na alpīyaḥ tatra avasthānāt loṣṭasya khalu pravibhajyamāna avayavasya alpataram alpatamam uttaram uttaram bhavati sa ca ayam alpatara prasaṅgaḥ yasmāt na alpataram asti yaḥ paramaḥ alpaḥ tatra nivartate yatas ca na alpīyaḥ asti tam parama anum pracakṣmahe iti
param vā truṭeḥ avayava vibhāgasya anavasthānāt dravyāṇām asaṅkhyeya tvāt truṭi tva nivṛttiḥ iti

atha idānīm ānupalambhikaḥ sarvam na asti iti manyamānaḥ āha ākāśa vyatibhedāt tad anupapattiḥ tasya aṇoḥ niravayavasya nityasya anupapattiḥ kasmāt ākāśa vyatibhedāt antar bahis ca aṇuḥ ākāśena samāviṣṭaḥ vyatibhinnaḥ vyatibhedāt sāvayavaḥ sāvayava tvāt anityaḥ iti
ākāśa asarva gata tvam vā atha etat na iṣyate paramāṇoḥ antar na asti ākāśam iti asarva gata tvam prasajyate iti

antar bahis ca kārya dravyasya kāraṇa antara vacanāt akārye tad abhāvaḥ antar iti pihitam kāraṇa antaraiḥ kāraṇam ucyate bahis iti ca vyavadhāyakam avyavahitam kāraṇam eva ucyate tat etat kārya dravyasya sambhavati na aṇoḥ akārya tvāt akārye hi paramāṇau antar bahis iti asya abhāvaḥ yatra ca asya bhāvaḥ anukāryam tat na paramāṇuḥ yatas hi na alpataram asti sa paramāṇuḥ iti

śabda saṃyoga vibhavāt ca sarva gatam yatra kvacid utpannāḥ śabdāḥ vibhavanti ākāśe tad āśrayāḥ bhavanti manobhiḥ paramāṇubhiḥ tad kāryaiḥ ca saṃyogāḥ vibhavanti ākāśe na asaṃyuktam ākāśena kiñcid mūrta dravyam upalabhyate tasmāt na asarva gatam iti

avyūha aviṣṭambha vibhu tvāni ca ākāśa dharmāḥ saṃsarpatā pratighātinā dravyeṇa na vyuhyate yathā kāṣṭhena udakam kasmāt niravayava tvāt sarpat ca pratighāti na viṣṭambhāti na asya kriyā hetum guṇam pratibadhnāti kasmāt asparśa tvāt viparyaye hi viṣṭambhaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ iti sa bhavān sa avayave sparśavati dravye dṛṣṭam dharmam viparīte nāśa aṅkitum arhati

aṇu avayavasya aṇutara tva prasaṅgāt anukārya pratiṣedhaḥ sāvayava tve ca aṇoḥ aṇu avayavaḥ anutaraḥ iti prasajyate kasmāt kārya kāraṇa dravyayoḥ parimāṇa bheda darśanāt tasmāt aṇu avayavasya aṇutara tvam yaḥ tu sāvayavaḥ anukāryam tat iti tasmāt anukāryam idam pratiṣidhyate iti kāraṇa vibhāgāt ca kāryasya anitya tvam na ākāśa vyatibhedāt loṣṭasya avayava vibhāgāt anitya tvam na ākāśa samāveṣāt iti

mūrtimatām ca saṃsthāna upapatteḥ avayava sadbhāvaḥ paricchinnānām hi sparśavatām saṃsthānam tri koṇam catur asram samam parimaṇḍalam iti upapadyate yat tat saṃsthānam saḥ avayava sanniveṣaḥ parimaṇḍalāḥ ca aṇavaḥ tasmāt sa avayavāḥ iti

saṃyoga upapatteḥ ca madhye san aṇuḥ pūrva aparābhyām aṇubhyām saṃyuktaḥ tayoḥ vyavadhānam kurute vyavadhānena anumīyate pūrva bhāgena pūrveṇa aṇunā saṃyujyate para bhāgena pareṇa aṇunā saṃyujyate yau tau pūrva aparau bhāgau tau asya avayavau evam sarvatas saṃyujyamānasya sarvatas bhāgāḥ avayavāḥ iti yat tāvat mūrtimatām saṃsthāna upapatteḥ avayava sadbhāvaḥ iti atra uktam kim uktam vibhāge alpatara prasaṅgasya yatas na alpīyaḥ tatra nivṛtteḥ aṇava yavasya ca aṇutara tva prasaṅgāt aṇu kārya pratiṣedhaḥ iti

yat punar etat saṃyoga upapatteḥ ca iti sparśavat tvāt vyavadhānam āśrayasya ca avyāptyā bhāga bhaktiḥ uktam ca atra sparśavān aṇuḥ sparśavatoḥ aṇvoḥ pratighātāt vyavadhāyakaḥ na sāvayava tvāt sparśavat tvāt ca vyavadhāne sati aṇu saṃyogaḥ na āśrayam vyāpnoti iti bhāga bhaktiḥ bhavati bhāgavān iva ayam iti uktam ca atra vibhāge alpatara prasaṅgasya yatas na alpīyaḥ tatra avasthānāt tad avayavasya ca aṇutara tva prasaṅgāt aṇu kārya pratiṣedhaḥ iti

mūrtimatām ca saṃsthāna upapatteḥ saṃyoga upapatteḥ ca paramāṇūnām sāvayava tvam iti hetvoḥ anavasthā kāri tvāt anavasthā anupapatteḥ ca apratiṣedhaḥ yāvat mūrtimat yāvat ca saṃyujyate tat sarvam sa avayavam iti anavasthā kāriṇau imau hetū sā ca anavasthā na upapadyate satyām anavasthāyām satyau hetū syātām tasmāt apratiṣedhaḥ ayam niravayavatvasya iti vibhāgasya ca vibhajyamāna hāniḥ na upapadyate tasmāt pralaya anta tā na upapadyate iti anavasthāyām ca pratyadhikaraṇam dravya avayavānām ānantyāt parimāṇa bhedānām guru tvasya ca agrahaṇam samāna parimāṇa tvam ca avayava avayavinoḥ paramaṇva vayavi bhāgāt ūrdhvam iti

yat idam bhavān buddhīḥ āśritya buddhi viṣayāḥ santi iti manyate mithyā buddhayaḥ etāḥ yadi hi tattva buddhayaḥ syuḥ buddhyā vivecane yāthātmyam buddhi viṣayāṇām upalabhyeta buddhyā vivecanāt tu bhāvānām yāthātmya anupalabdhiḥ tantu apakarṣaṇe paṭa sadbhāva anupalabdhi vat tad anupalabdhiḥ yathā ayam tantuḥ ayam tantuḥ iti pratyekam tantuṣu vivicyamāneṣu na artha antaram kiñcid upalabhyate yat paṭa buddheḥ viṣayaḥ syāt yāthātmya anupalabdheḥ asati viṣaye paṭa buddhiḥ bhavantī mithyā buddhiḥ bhavati evam sarvatra iti

vyāhata tvāt ahetuḥ yadi buddhyā vivecanam bhāvānām na sarva bhāvānām yāthātmya anupalabdhiḥ atha sarva bhāvānām yāthātmya anupalabdhiḥ na buddhyā vivecanam bhāvānām buddhyā vivecanam yāthātmya anupalabdhiḥ ca iti vyāhanyate tat uktam avayava avayavi prasaṅgaḥ ca evam ā pralayāt iti

tad āśraya tvāt apṛthak grahaṇam kārya dravyam kāraṇa dravya āśritam tat kāraṇebhyaḥ pṛthak na upalabhyate viparyaye pṛthak grahaṇāt yatra āśraya āśrita bhāvaḥ na asti tatra pṛthak grahaṇam iti buddhyā vivecanāt tu bhāvānām pṛthak grahaṇam atīndriyeṣu aṇuṣu yat indriyeṇa gṛhyate tat etayā buddhyā vivicyamānam anyat iti

pramāṇataḥ ca artha pratipatteḥ buddhyā vivecanāt bhāvānām yāthātmya upalabdhiḥ yat asti yathā ca yat na asti yathā ca tat sarvam pramāṇataḥ upalabdhyā sidhyati yā ca pramāṇataḥ upalabdhiḥ tat buddhyā vivecanam bhāvānām tena sarva śāstrāṇi sarva karmāṇi sarve ca śarīriṇām vyavahārāḥ vyāptāḥ parīkṣamāṇaḥ hi buddhyā adhyavasyati idam asti idam na asti iti tatra na sarva bhāva anupapattiḥ

pramāṇa anupapatti upapattibhyām evam ca sati sarvam na asti iti na upapadyate kasmāt pramāṇa anupapatti upapattibhyām yadi sarvam na asti iti pramāṇam upapadyate sarvam na asti iti etat vyāhanyate atha pramāṇam na upapadyate sarvam na asti iti asya katham siddhiḥ atha pramāṇam antareṇa siddhiḥ sarvam asti iti asya katham na siddhiḥ
svapna viṣaya abhimāna vat ayam pramāṇa prameya abhimānaḥ yathā svapne na viṣayāḥ santi atha ca abhimānaḥ bhavati evam na pramāṇāni prameyāṇi ca santi atha ca pramāṇa prameya abhimānaḥ bhavati
māyā gandharvanagara mṛgatṛṣṇikā vat vā

hetu abhāvāt asiddhiḥ svapna ante viṣaya abhimāna vat pramāṇa prameya abhimānaḥ na punar jāgarita ante viṣaya upalabdhi vat iti atra hetuḥ na asti hetu abhāvāt asiddhiḥ svapna ante ca asantaḥ viṣayāḥ upalabhyante iti atra api hetu abhāvaḥ pratibodhe anupalambhāt iti ced pratibodha viṣaya upalambhāt apratiṣedhaḥ yadi pratibodhe ṇu palambhāt svapne viṣayāḥ na santi iti tarhi ye ime pratibuddhena viṣayāḥ upalabhyante upalambhāt santi iti viparyaye hi hetu sāmarthyam upalambhāt sadbhāve sati anupalambhāt abhāvaḥ siddhyati ubhayathā tu abhāve na anupalambhasya sāmarthyam asti yathā pradīpasya abhāvāt rūpasya adarśanam iti tatra bhāvena abhāvaḥ samarthyate iti svapna anta vikalpe ca hetu vacanam svapna viṣaya abhimāna vat iti bruvatā svapna anta vikalpe hetuḥ vācyaḥ kaścid svapnaḥ bhaya upasaṃhitaḥ kaścid pramoda upasaṃhitaḥ kaścid ubhaya viparītaḥ kadācid svapnam eva na paśyati iti nimittavataḥ tu svapna viṣaya abhimānasya nimitta vikalpāt vikalpa upapattiḥ

smṛti saṅkalpa vat ca svapna viṣaya abhimānaḥ pūrva upalabdha viṣayaḥ yathā smṛtiḥ ca saṅkalpaḥ ca pūrva upalabdha viṣayau na tasya pratyākhyānāya kalpete tathā svapne viṣaya grahaṇam pūrva upalabdha viṣayam na tasya pratyākhyānāya kalpate iti evam dṛṣṭa viṣayaḥ ca svapna antaḥ jāgarita antena yaḥ suptaḥ svapnam paśyati saḥ eva jāgrat svapna darśanāni pratisandhattaḥ idam adrākṣam iti tatra jāgrat buddhi vṛtti vaśāt svapna viṣaya abhimānaḥ mithyā iti vyavasāyaḥ sati ca pratisandhāne yā jāgrataḥ buddhi vṛttiḥ tad vaśāt ayam vyavasāyaḥ svapna viṣaya abhimānaḥ mithyā iti

ubhaya aviśeṣe tu sādhana ānarthakyam yasya svapna anta jāgarita antayoḥ aviśeṣaḥ tasya svapna viṣaya abhimāna vat iti sādhanam anarthakam tad āśraya pratyākhyānāt atasmin tat iti ca vyavasāyaḥ pradhāna āśrayaḥ apuruṣe sthāṇau puruṣaḥ iti vyavasāyaḥ sa pradhāna āśrayaḥ na khalu puruṣe anupalabdhe puruṣaḥ iti apuruṣe vyavasāyaḥ bhavati evam svapna viṣayasya vyavasāyaḥ hastinam adrākṣam parvatam adrākṣam iti pradhāna āśrayaḥ bhavitum arhati

evam ca sati mithyā upalabdhi vināśaḥ tattva jñānāt svapna viṣaya abhimāna praṇāśa vat pratibodhe sthāṇau pruṣaḥ ayam iti vyavasāyaḥ mithyā upalabdhiḥ atasmin tat iti jñānam sthāṇau sthāṇuḥ iti vyavasāyaḥ tattva jñānam tad tvad jānena ca mithyā upalabdhiḥ nivartyate na arthaḥ sthāṇu puruṣa sāmānya lakṣaṇaḥ yathā pratibodhe yā jñāna vṛttiḥ tayā svapna viṣaya abhimānaḥ nivartyate na arthaḥ viṣaya sāmānya lakṣaṇaḥ tathā māyā gandharvanagara mṛga tṛṣṇikāṇām api yā buddhayaḥ atasmin tat iti vyavasāyāḥ tatra api anena eva kalpena mithyā upalabdhi vināśaḥ tattva jñānāt na artha pratiṣedhaḥ iti

upādāna vat ca māyā ādiṣu mithyājñānam prajñāpanīya sarūpam ca dravyam upādāya sādhanavān aparasya mithyā adhyavasāyam karoti sā māyā nīhāra prabhṛtīnām naga rasa rūpa sanniveśe dūrāt nagara buddhiḥ utpadyate viparyaye tad abhāvāt sūrya marīciṣu bhaumena ūṣmaṇā saṃsṛṣṭeṣu spandamāneṣu udaka buddhiḥ bhavati sāmānya grahaṇāt antika sthasya viparyaye tad abhāvāt kvacid kadācid kasyacid ca bhāvān na animittam mithyājñānam dṛṣṭam ca buddhi dvaitam māyā prayoktuḥ parasya ca dūrānika sthayoḥ gandharvanagara mṛgatṛṣṇikāsu su puta pratibuddhayoḥ ca svapna viṣaye tat etat sarvasya abhāve nirupākhya tāyām nirātmaka tve na upapadyate iti

buddheḥ ca evam nimitta sadbhāva upalambhāt mithyā buddheḥ ca arthavat apratiṣedhaḥ kasmāt nimitta upalambhāt sadbhāva upalambhāt ca upalabhyate hi mithyā buddhi nimittam mithyā buddhiḥ ca pratyātmam utpannā gṛhyate saṃvedya tvāt tasmāt mithyā buddhiḥ api asti iti

tattva pradhāna bhedāt ca mithyā buddheḥ dvaividhya upapattiḥ tattvam sthāṇuḥ iti pradhānam puruṣaḥ iti tattva pradhānayoḥ alopāt bhedāt sthāṇau puruṣaḥ iti mithyā buddhiḥ utpadyate sāmānya grahaṇāt evam patākāyām balākā iti loṣṭe kapotaḥ iti na tu samāne viṣaye mithyā buddhīnām samāveśaḥ sāmānya grahaṇa vyavasthānāt yasya tu nirātmakam nirupākhyam sarvam tasya samāveśaḥ prasajyate gandha ādau ca prameye gandha ādi buddayaḥ mithyā abhimatāḥ tattva pradhānayoḥ sāmānya grahaṇasya ca abhāvāt tattva buddhayaḥ eva bhavanti tasmāt ayuktam etat pramāṇa prameya buddhayaḥ mithyā iti

doṣa nimittānām tattva jñānāt ahaṅkāra nivṛttiḥ iti uktam atha katham tattva jñānam utpadyate iti samādhi viśeṣa abhyāsāt sa tu pratyāhṛtasya indriyebhyaḥ manasaḥ dhārakeṇa prayatnena dhāryamāṇasya ātmanā saṃyogaḥ tattva bubhutsā viśiṣṭaḥ sati hi tasmin indriya artheṣu buddhayaḥ na utpadyante tad abhyāsa vaśāt tattva buddhiḥ utpadyate

yat uktam sati hi tasmin indriya artheṣu buddhayaḥ na utpadyante iti etat na artha viśeṣa prābalyāt anicchataḥ api buddhi utpatteḥ na etat yuktam kasmāt artha viśeṣa prābalyāt abubhutsamānasya api buddhi utpattiḥ dṛṣṭā yathā stanayitnu śabda prabhṛtiṣu tatra samādhi viśeṣaḥ na upapadyate
kṣudh ādibhiḥ pravartanāt ca kṣudh pipāsābhyām śīta uṣṇābhyām vyādhibhiḥ ca anicchataḥ api buddhayaḥ pravartante tasmāt aikāgrya anupapattiḥ iti

astu etat samādhim vihāya vyutthānam vyutthāna nimittam samādhi pratyanīkam ca sati tu etasmin pūrva kṛta phala anubandhāt tad utpattiḥ pūrva kṛtaḥ janma antara upacitaḥ tattva jñāna hetuḥ dharma pravivekaḥ phala anubandhaḥ yoga abhyāsa sāmarthyam niṣphale hi abhyāse na abhyāsam ādriyeran dṛṣṭam hi laukikeṣu karmasu abhyāsa sāmarthyam

pratyanīka parihāra artham ca araṇya guhā pulina ādiṣu yoga abhyāsa upadeśaḥ yoga abhyāsa janitaḥ dharmaḥ janma antare api anuvartate pracaya kāṣṭha āgate tattva jñāna hetau dharme prakṛṣṭāyām samādhi bhāvanāyām tattva jñānam utpadyate iti dṛṣṭaḥ ca samādhinā artha viśeṣa prābalya abhibhavaḥ na aham etat aśrauṣam na aham etat ajñāsiṣam anyatra me manaḥ abhūt iti āha laukikaḥ iti
yadi artha viśeṣa prābalyāt anicchataḥ api buddhi utpattiḥ anujñāyate apavarge api evam prasaṅgaḥ muktasya api bāhya artha sāmarthyāt buddhayaḥ utpadyeran iti

na niṣpanna avaśyambhāvi tvāt karma vaśāt niṣpanne śarīre ceṣṭa indriya artha āśraye nimitta bhāvāt avaśyambhāvī buddhīnām utpādaḥ na ca prabalaḥ api san bāhyaḥ ṛthe ātmanaḥ buddhi utpāde samarthaḥ bhavati tasya indriyeṇa saṃyogāt buddhi utpāde sāmarthyam dṛṣṭam iti

tad abhāvaḥ ca apavarge tasya buddhi nimitta āśrayasya śarīra indriyasya dharma adharma abhāvāt abhāvaḥ apavarge tatra yat uktam apavarge api evam prasaṅgaḥ iti tat ayuktam tasmāt sarva duḥkha vimokṣaḥ apavargaḥ yasmāt sarva duḥkha bījam sarva duḥkha āyatanam ca apavarge vicchidyate tasmāt sarveṇa duḥkhena vimuktiḥ apavargaḥ na nirbījam nirāyatanam ca duḥkham utpadyate iti

tad artham yama niyamābhyām ātma saṃskāraḥ yogāt ca adhyātma vidhi upāyaiḥ tasya apavargasya adhigamāya yama niyamābhyām ātma saṃskāraḥ yamaḥ samānam āśramiṇām dharma sādhanam niyamaḥ tu viśiṣṭam ātma saṃskāraḥ punar adharma hānam dharma upacayaḥ ca yoga śāstrāt ca adhyātma vidhiḥ pratipattavyaḥ sa punar tapaḥ prāṇāyāmaḥ pratyāhāraḥ dhyānam dhāraṇa iti indriya viṣayeṣu prasaṃkhyāna abhyāsaḥ rāga dveṣa prahāṇa arthaḥ upāyaḥ tu yoga ācāra vidhānam iti

jñāna grahaṇa abhyāsaḥ tad vidyaiḥ ca saha saṃvādaḥ tad artham iti prakṛtam jñāyate anena iti jñānam ātma vidyā śāstram tasya grahaṇam adhyayana dhāraṇe abhyāsaḥ satata kriyā adhyayana śravaṇa cintanāni tad vidyaiḥ ca saha saṃvādaḥ iti prajñā paripāka artham paripākaḥ tu saṃśaya chedanam avijñāta artha bodhaḥ adhyavasita abhyanujñānam iti samayāvādaḥ saṃvādaḥ
tad vidyaiḥ ca saha saṃvādaḥ iti avibhakta artham vacanam vibhajyate tam śiṣya guru sabrahmacāri viśiṣṭa śreyaḥ arthibhiḥ anasūyibhiḥ abhyupeyāt etat nigadena eva nīta artham iti

yadi ca manyeta pakṣa pratipakṣa parigrahaḥ pratikūlaḥ parasya iti pratipakṣa hīnam api vā prayojana artham arthi tve tam abhyupeyāt iti vartate paratas prajñām upāditsamānaḥ tattva bubhutsā prakāśanena sva pakṣam anavasthāpayan sva darśanam pariśodhayet iti anyonya pratyanīkāni ca prāvādukānām darśanāni

sva pakṣa rāgeṇa ca eke nyāyam ativartante tatra tattva adhyavasāya saṃrakṣaṇa artham jalpa vitaṇḍe bīja praroha saṃrakṣaṇa artham kaṇṭaka śākhā āvaraṇa vat anutpanna tattva jñānānām aprahīṇa doṣāṇām tad artham ghaṭamānānām etat iti
vidyā nirveda ādibhiḥ ca pareṇa avajñāyamānasya tābhyām vigṛhya kathanam vigṛhya iti vijigīṣayā na tattva bubhutsayā iti tat etat vidyā pāla artham na lābha pūjā khyātyartham iti

sādharmya vaidharmyābhyām pratyavasthānasya vikalpāt jāti bahutvam iti saṅkṣepeṇa uktam tat vistareṇa vibhajyate tāḥ khalu imāḥ jātayaḥ sthāpana ahetau prayukte caturviṃśatiḥ pratiṣedha hetavaḥ s ā d h a r m y a v a i d h a r m y o t k a r ṣ ā p a k a r ṣ a v a r ṇ y ā v a r ṇ y a v i k a l p a s ā d h y aprāpti aprāpti prasaṅga pratidṛṣṭānta an utpatti saṃśaya prakaraṇā hetu artha apatti aviśeṣa upapatti upalabdhi anupalabdhi anitya nitya kārya samāḥ sādharmyeṇa pratyavasthānam aviśiṣyamāṇam sthāpanā hetutaḥ sādharmya samaḥ aviśeṣam tatra tatra udāhariṣyāmaḥ evam vaidharmya sama prabhṛtayaḥ api nirvaktavyāḥ

lakṣaṇam tu sādharmya vaidharmyābhyām upasaṃhāre tad dharma viparyaya upapatteḥ sādharmya vaidharmya samau sādharmyeṇa upasaṃhāre sādhya dharma viparyaya upapatteḥ sādharmyeṇa eva pratyavasthānam aviśiṣyamāṇam sthāpanā hetutaḥ sādharmya samaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ nidarśanam kriyāvān ātmā dravyasya kriyā hetu guṇa yogāt dravyam loṣṭaḥ kriyā hetu guṇa yuktaḥ kriyāvān tathā ca ātmā tasmāt kriyāvān iti evam upasaṃhṛte paraḥ sādharmyeṇa eva pratyavatiṣṭhate niṣkriyaḥ ātmā vibhunaḥ dravyasya niṣkriya tvāt vibhu ca ākāśam niṣkriyam ca tathā ca ātmā tasmāt niṣkriyaḥ iti

na ca asti viśeṣa hetuḥ kriyāvat sādharmyāt kriyāvatā bhavitavyam na punar akriya sādharmyāt niṣkriyeṇa iti viśeṣa hetu abhāvāt sādharmya samaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ bhavati atha vaidharmya samaḥ kriyā hetu guṇa yuktaḥ loṣṭaḥ paricchinnaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ na ca tathā ātmā tasmāt na loṣṭa vat kriyāvān iti na ca asti viśeṣa hetuḥ kriyāvat sādharmyāt kriyāvatā bhavitavyam na punar kriyāvat vaidharmyāt akriyeṇa iti viśeṣa hetu abhāvāt vaidharmya samaḥ

vaidharmyeṇa ca upasaṃhāraḥ niṣkriyaḥ ātmā vibhu tvāt kriyāvat dravyam avibhu dṛṣṭam yathā loṣṭaḥ na ca tathā ātmā tasmāt niṣkriyaḥ iti vaidharmyeṇa pratyavasthānam niṣkriyam dravyam ākāśam kriyā hetu guṇa rahitam dṛṣṭam na ca tathā ātmā tasmāt na niṣkriyaḥ iti na ca asti viśeṣa hetuḥ kriyāvat vaidharmyāt niṣkriyeṇa bhavitavyam na punar akriya vaidharmyāt kriyāvatā iti viśeṣa hetu abhāvāt vaidharmya samaḥ atha sādharmya samaḥ kriyāvān loṣṭaḥ kriyā hetu guṇa yuktaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ tathā ca ātmā tasmāt kriyāvān iti na ca asti viśeṣa hetuḥ kriyāvat vaidharmyāt niṣkriyaḥ na punar kriyāvat sādharmyāt kriyāvān iti viśeṣa hetu abhāvāt sādharmya samaḥ

anayoḥ uttaram go tvāt go siddhi vat tad siddhiḥ sādharmya mātreṇa vaidharmya mātreṇa ca sādhya sādhane pratijñāyamāne syāt avyavasthā sā tu dharma viśeṣe na upapadyate go sādharmyāt go tvāt jāti viśeṣāt gauḥ sidhyati na tu sāsnādi sambandhāt aśva ādi vaidharmyāt go tvāt eva gauḥ sidhyati na guṇa ādi bhedāt tat ca etat kṛta vyākhyānam avayava prakaraṇe pramāṇānām abhisambandhāt ca eka artha kāri tvam samānam vākyaḥ iti hetvābhāsa āśrayā khalu iyam avyavasthā iti

sādhya dṛṣṭāntayoḥ dharma vikalpāt ubhaya sādhya tvāt ca utkarṣa apakarṣa varṇyāvarṇya vikalpa sādhya samāḥ dṛṣṭānta dharmam sādhye samāsañjayate utkarṣa samaḥ yadi kriyā hetu guṇa yogāt loṣṭa vat kriyāvān ātmā loṣṭa vat eva sparśavān api prāpnoti atha na sparśavān loṣṭa vat kriyāvān api na prāpnoti viparyaye vā viśeṣaḥ vaktavyaḥ iti

sādhye dharma abhāvam dṛṣṭāntāt prasañjayataḥ apakarṣa samaḥ loṣṭaḥ khalu kriyāvān avibhuḥ dṛṣṭaḥ kāmam ātmā api kriyāvān avibhuḥ astu viparyaye vā viśeṣaḥ vaktavyaḥ iti khyāpanīyaḥ varṇyaḥ viparyayāt avarṇyaḥ tau etau sādhya dṛṣṭānta dharmau viparyasyataḥ varṇyāvarṇya samau bhavataḥ sādhana dharma yukte dṛṣṭānte dharma antara vikalpāt sādhya dharma vikalpam prasañjayataḥ vikalpa samaḥ kriyā hetu guṇa yuktam kiñcid guru yathā loṣṭaḥ kiṃcid laghu yathā vāyuḥ evam kriyā hetu guṇa yuktam kiñcid kriyāvat syāt yathā loṣṭaḥ kiñcid akriyam yathā ātmā viśeṣaḥ vā vācyaḥ iti hetu ādi avayava sāmarthya yogī dharmaḥ sādhyaḥ tam dṛṣṭānte prasañjayataḥ sādhya samaḥ yadi yathā loṣṭaḥ tathā ātmā prāptaḥ tarhi yathā ātmā tathā loṣṭaḥ iti sādhyaḥ ca ayam ātmā kriyāvān iti kāmam loṣṭaḥ api sādhyaḥ atha na evam na tarhi yathā loṣṭaḥ tathā ātmā

eteṣām uttaram kiñcid sādharmyāt upasaṃhāra siddheḥ vaidharmyāt apratiṣedhaḥ alabhyaḥ siddhasya nihnavaḥ siddham ca kiñcid sādharmyāt upamānam yathā gauḥ tathā gavayaḥ iti tatra na labhyaḥ go gavayayoḥ dharma vikalpaḥ codayitum evam sādhake dharme dṛṣṭānta ādi sāmarthya yukte na labhyaḥ sādhya dṛṣṭāntayoḥ dharma vikalpāt vaidharmyāt pratiṣedhaḥ vaktum iti

sādhya atideśāt ca dṛṣṭānta upapatteḥ yatra laukika parīkṣakāṇām buddhi sāmyam tena aviparītaḥ arthaḥ atidiśyate prajñāpana artham evam sādhya atideśāt dṛṣṭānte upapadyamāne sādhya tvam anupapannam iti

prāpya sādhyam aprāpya vā hetoḥ prāptyā viśiṣṭa tvāt aprāpti ā asādhaka tvāt ca prāpti aprāpti samau hetuḥ prāpya vā sādhyam sādhayet aprāpya vā na tāvat prāpya prāptyām aviśiṣṭa tvāt asādhakaḥ dvayoḥ vidyamānayoḥ prāptau satyām kim kasya sādhakam sādhyam vā aprāpya sādhakam na bhavati na aprāptaḥ pradīpaḥ prakāśayati iti prāptyā pratyavasthānam prāpti samaḥ aprāptyā pratyavasthānam aprāpti samaḥ

anayoḥ uttaram ghaṭa ādi niṣpatti darśanāt pīḍane ca abhicārāt apratiṣedhaḥ ubhayathā khalu ayuktaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ kartṛ karaṇa adhikaraṇāni prāpya mṛdam ghaṭa ādi kāryam niṣpādayanti abhicārāt ca pīḍane sati dṛṣṭam aprāpya sādhaka tvam iti

dṛṣṭāntasya kāraṇa anapadeśāt pratyavasthānāt ca pratidṛṣṭāntena prasaṅga pratidṛṣṭānta samau sādhanasya api sādhanam vaktavyam iti prasaṅgena pratyavasthānam prasaṅga samaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ kriyā hetu guṇa yogī kriyāvān loṣṭaḥ iti hetuḥ na apadiśyate na ca hetum antereṇa siddhiḥ asti iti pratidṛṣṭāntena pratyavasthānam pratidṛṣṭānta samaḥ kriyāvān ātmā kriyā hetu guṇa yogāt loṣṭa vat iti ukte pratidṛṣṭāntaḥ upādīyate kriyā hetu guṇa yuktam ākāśam niṣkriyam dṛṣṭam iti kaḥ punar ākāśasya kriyā hetu guṇaḥ vāyunā saṃyogaḥ saṃskāra apekṣaḥ vāyu vanaspati saṃyoga vat iti

anayoḥ uttaram pradīpa upādāna prasaṅga vinivṛtti vat tad vinivṛttiḥ idam tāvat ayam pṛṣṭaḥ vaktum arhati atha ke pradīpam upādadate kimartham vā iti didṛkṣamāṇā dṛśya darśana artham iti atha pradīpam didṛkṣamāṇāḥ pradīpa antaram kasmāt na upādadate antareṇa api pradīpa antaram dṛśyate pradīpaḥ tatra pradīpa darśana artham pradīpa upādānam nirarthakam atha dṛṣṭāntaḥ kimartham ucyate iti aprajñātasya jñāpana artham iti atha dṛṣṭānte kāraṇa apadeśaḥ kim artham deśyate yadi prajñāpana artham prajñātaḥ dṛṣṭāntaḥ sa khalu laukika parīkṣakāṇām yasmin arthe buddhi sāmyam sa dṛṣṭāntaḥ iti tad prajñāpana arthaḥ kāraṇa apadeśaḥ nirarthakaḥ iti prasaṅga samasya uttaram

atha pratidṛṣṭānta samasya uttaram pratidṛṣṭānta hetu tve ca na ahetuḥ dṛṣṭāntaḥ pratidṛṣṭāntam bruvatā na viśeṣa hetuḥ apadiśyate anena prakāreṇa pratidṛṣṭa ānataḥ sādhakaḥ na dṛṣṭāntaḥ iti evam pratidṛṣṭānta hetu tve na ahetuḥ dṛṣṭāntaḥ iti upapadyate sa ca katham ahetuḥ na syāt yadi apratiṣiddhaḥ sādhakaḥ syāt iti

prāk utpatteḥ kāraṇa abhāvāt anutpatti samaḥ anityaḥ śabdaḥ prayatna anantarīyaka tvāt ghaṭa vat iti ukte aparaḥ āha prāk utpatteḥ anutpanne śabde prayatna ānantarīyaka tvam anitya tva kāraṇam na asti tad abhāvāt nitya tvam prāptam nityasya ca utpattiḥ na asti anutpattyā pratyavasthānam anutpatti samaḥ

asya uttaram tathā abhāvāt utpannasya kāraṇa upapatteḥ na kāraṇa pratiṣedhaḥ tathā abhāvāt utpannasya iti utpannaḥ khalu ayam śabdaḥ iti bhavati prāguta patteḥ śabdaḥ eva na asti utpannasya śabda bhāvāt śabdasya sataḥ prayatna anantarīyaka tvam anitya tva kāraṇam upapadyate kāraṇa upapatteḥ ayuktaḥ ayam doṣaḥ prāk utpatteḥ kāraṇa abhāvāt iti

sāmānya dṛṣṭāntayoḥ aindriyaka tve samāne nitya anitya sādharmyāt saṃśaya samaḥ anityaḥ śabdaḥ prayatna anantarīyaka tvāt ghaṭa vat iti ukte hetau saṃśayena pratyavatiṣṭate sati prayatna anantarīyaka tve asti eva asya nityena sāmānyena sādharmyam aindriyaka tvam asti ca ghaṭena anityena atas nitya anitya sādharmyāt anivṛttiḥ saṃśayaḥ iti

asya uttaram sādharmyāt saṃśaye na saṃśayaḥ vaidharmyāt ubhayathā vā saṃśaye atyanta saṃśaya prasaṅgaḥ nitya tva anabhyupagamāt ca sāmānyasya apratiṣedhaḥ viśeṣāt vaidharmyāt avadhāryamāṇe arthe puruṣaḥ iti na sthāṇu puruṣa sādharmyāt saṃśayaḥ avakāśam labhate evam vaidharmyāt viśeṣāt prayatna anantarīyaka tvāt avadhāryamāṇe śabdasya anitya tve nitya anitya sādharmyāt saṃśayaḥ avakāśam na labhate yadi vai labhate tatas sthāṇu puruṣa sādharmya anucchedāt atyantam saṃśayaḥ syāt gṛhyamāṇe ca viśeṣe nityam sādharmyam saṃśaya hetuḥ iti na abhyupagamyate na hi gṛhyamāṇe puruṣasya viśeṣe sthāṇu puruṣa sādharmyam saṃśaya hetuḥ bhavati

ubhaya sādharmyāt prakriyā siddheḥ prakaraṇa samaḥ ubhayena nityena ca anityena ca sādharmyāt pakṣa pratipakṣayoḥ pravṛttiḥ prakriyā anityaḥ śabdaḥ prayatna anantarīyaka tvāt ghaṭa vat iti ekaḥ pakṣam pravarttayati dvitīyaḥ ca nitya sādharmyāt pratipakṣam pravarttayati nityaḥ śabdaḥ śrāvaṇa tvāt śabda tva vat iti evam ca sati prayatna anantarīyaka tvāt iti hetuḥ anitya sādharmyeṇa ucyamānaḥ na prakaraṇam ativarttate prakaraṇa anativṛtteḥ nirṇaya anativartanam samānam ca etat nitya sādharmyeṇa ucyamāṇe hetau tat idam prakaraṇa anativṛttyā pratyavasthānam prakaraṇa samaḥ samānam ca etat vaidharmye api ubhaya vaidharmyāt prakriyā siddheḥ prakaraṇa samaḥ iti

asya uttaram pratipakṣāt prakaraṇa siddheḥ pratiṣedha anupapattiḥ pratipakṣa upapatteḥ ubhaya sādharmyāt prakriyā siddhim bruvatā pratipakṣāt prakriyā siddhiḥ uktā bhavati yadi ubhaya sādharmyam tatra ekataraḥ pratipakṣaḥ iti evam sati upapannaḥ pratipakṣaḥ bhavati pratipakṣa upapatteḥ anupapannaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ yadi pratipakṣa upapattiḥ pratiṣedhaḥ na upapadyate atha pratiṣedha upapattiḥ pratipakṣaḥ na upapadyate pratipakṣa upapattiḥ pratiṣedha upapattiḥ ca iti vipratiṣiddham iti tattva anavadhāraṇāt ca prakriyā siddhiḥ viparyaye prakaraṇa avasānāt tattva avadhāraṇe hi avasitam prakaraṇam bhavati iti

traikālya asiddheḥ hetoḥ ahetu samaḥ hetuḥ sādhanam tat sādhyāt pūrvam paścāt saha vā bhavet yadi pūrvam sādhanam asati sādhye kasya sādhanam atha paścāt asati sādhane kasya idam sādhyam atha yugapad sādhya sādane dvayoḥ vidyamānayoḥ kim kasya sādhanam kim kasya sādhyam iti hetuḥ ahetunā na viśiṣyate ahetunā sādharmyāt pratyavasthānam ahetu samaḥ

asya uttaram na hetutaḥ sādhya siddheḥ traikālya asiddhiḥ na traikālya asiddhiḥ kasmāt hetutaḥ sādhya siddheḥ nirvartanīyasya nirvṛttiḥ vijñeyasya vijñānam ubhayam kāraṇataḥ dṛśyate saḥ ayam mahān pratyakṣa viṣayaḥ udāharaṇam iti yat tu khalu uktam asati sādhye kasya sādhanam iti yat tu nirvatyate yat ca vijñāpyate tasya iti
pratiṣeda anupapatteḥ ca pratiṣeddhavya apratiṣedhaḥ pūrvam paścāt yugapad vā pratiṣedhaḥ iti na upapadyate pratiṣedha anupapatteḥ sthāpanā hetuḥ siddhaḥ iti

arthāpattitaḥ pratipakṣa siddheḥ arthāpatti samaḥ anityaḥ śabdaḥ prayatna anantarīyaka tvāt ghaṭa vat iti sthāpite pakṣe arthāpattyā pratipakṣam sādhayataḥ arthāpatti samaḥ yadi prayatna anantarīyaka tvāt anitya sādharmyāt anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti arthāt āpadyate nitya sādharmyāt nityaḥ iti asti ca asya nityena sādharmyam asparśa tvam iti

asya uttaram anuktasya arthāpatteḥ pakṣa hāneḥ upapattiḥ anukta tvāt anaika ānatika tvāt ca arthāpatteḥ anupapādya sāmarthyam anuktam arthāt āpadyate iti bruvataḥ pakṣa hāneḥ upapattiḥ anukta tvāt anitya pakṣa siddhau arthāt āpannam nitya pakṣasya hāniḥ iti anaika ānatika tvāt ca arthāpatteḥ ubhaya pakṣa samā ca iyam arthāpattiḥ yadi nitya sādharmyāt asparśa tvāt ākāśa vat ca nityaḥ śabdaḥ arthāt āpannam anitya sādharmyāt prayatna anantarīyaka tvāt anityaḥ iti na ca iyam viparyaya mātrāt ekāntena arthāpattiḥ na khalu vai ghaṇasya grāvṇaḥ patanam iti arthāt āpadyate dravāṇām apām patana abhāvaḥ iti

eka dharma upapatteḥ aviśeṣe sarva aviśeṣa prasaṅgāt sadbhāva aupapatteḥ aviśeṣa samaḥ ekaḥ dharmaḥ prayatna ānantarīyaka tvam śabda ghaṭayoḥ upapadyate iti aviśeṣe ubhayoḥ anitya tve sarvasya aviśeṣaḥ prasajyate katham sadbhāva upapatteḥ ekaḥ dharmaḥ sadbhāvaḥ sarvasya upapadyate sadbhāva upapatteḥ sarva aviśeṣa prasaṅgāt pratyavasthānam aviśeṣa samaḥ

asya uttaram kvacid tad dharma upapatteḥ kvacid ca anupapatteḥ pratiṣedha abhāvaḥ yathā sādhya dṛṣṭāntayoḥ eka dharmasya prayatna anantarīyaka tvasya upapatteḥ anitya tvam dharma antaram aviśeṣaḥ na evam sarva bhāvānām sadbhāva upapatti nimittam dharma antaram asti yena aviśeṣaḥ syāt atha matam anitya tvam eva dharma ānataram sadbhāva upapatti nimittam bhāvānām sarvatra syāt iti evam khalu vai kalpyamāne anityāḥ sarve bhāvāḥ sadbhāva upapatteḥ iti pakṣaḥ prāpnoti tatra pratijñā artha vyatiriktam anyat udāharaṇam na asti anudāharaṇaḥ ca hetuḥ na asti iti pratijña eka deśasya ca udāharaṇa tvam anupapannam na hi sādhyam udāharaṇam bhavati sataḥ ca nitya anityabhāvāt anitya tva anupapattiḥ tasmāt sadbhāva upapatteḥ sarva aviśeṣa prasaṅgaḥ iti nirabhidheyam etat vākyam iti sarva bhāvānām sadbhāva upapatteḥ anitya tvam iti bruvatā anujñātam śabdasya anitya tvam tatra anupapannaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ iti

ubhaya kāraṇa upapatteḥ upapatti samaḥ yadi anitya tva kāraṇam upapadyate śabdasya iti anityaḥ śabdaḥ nitya tva kāraṇam api upapadyate asya asparśa tvam iti nitya tvam api upapadyate ubhayasya anitya tvasya nitya tvasya ca kāraṇa upapattyā pratyavasthānam upapatti samaḥ

asya uttaram upapatti kāraṇa abhyanujñānāt apratiṣedhaḥ ubhaya kāraṇa upapatteḥ iti bruvatā na anitya tva kāraṇa upapatteḥ anitya tvam pratiṣidhyate yadi pratiṣidhyate na ubhaya kāraṇa upapattiḥ syāt ubhaya kāraṇa upapatti vacanāt anitya tva kāraṇa upapattiḥ abhyanujñāyate abhyanujñānāt anupapannaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ vyāghātāt pratiṣedhaḥ iti ced samānaḥ vyāghātaḥ ekasya nitya tva anitya tva prasaṅgam vyāhatam bruvata uktam pratiṣedhaḥ iti ced sva pakṣa para pakṣayoḥ samānaḥ vyāghātaḥ sa ca na ekatarasya sādhakaḥ iti

nirdiṣṭa kāraṇa abhāve api upalambhāt upalabdhi samaḥ nirdiṣṭasya prayatna ānantarīyaka tvasya anitya tva kāraṇasya abhāve api vāyunodanāt vṛkṣa śākhā bhaṅga jasya śabdasya anitya tvam upalabhyate nirdiṣṭasya sādhanasya abhāve api sādhya dharma upalabdhyā pratyavasthānam upalabdhi samaḥ

asya uttaram kāraṇa antarāt api tad dharma upapatteḥ apratiṣedhaḥ prayatna anantarīyaka tvāt iti bruvatā kāraṇatas utpattiḥ abhidhīyate na kāryasya kāraṇa niyamaḥ yadi ca kāraṇa antarāt api utpadyamānasya śabdasya tat anitya tvam upapadyate kim atra pratiṣidhyate iti

na prāk uccāraṇāt vidyamānasya śabdasya anupalabdhiḥ kasmāt āvaraṇa ādi anupalabdheḥ yathā vidyamānasya udaka ādeḥ arthasya āvaraṇa ādeḥ anupalabdhiḥ na evam śabdasya agrahaṇa kāraṇena āvaraṇa ādinā anupalabdhiḥ gṛhyeta ca etat asya agrahaṇa kāraṇam udaka ādi vat na gṛhyate tasmāt udaka ādi viparītaḥ śabdaḥ anupalabhyamānaḥ iti tad anupalabdheḥ anupalambhāt abhāva siddhau tad viparīta upapatteḥ anupalabdhi samaḥ

teṣām āvaraṇa ādīnām anupalabdhiḥ na upalabhyate anupalambhāt na asti iti abhāvaḥ asyāḥ sidhyati abhāva siddhau hetu abhāvāt tad viparītam astitvam āvaraṇa ādīnām avadhāryate tad viparīta upapatteḥ yat pratijñātam na prāk uccāraṇāt vidyamānasya śabdasya anupalabdhiḥ iti etat na sidhyati saḥ ayam hetuḥ āvaraṇa ādi anupalabdheḥ iti āvaraṇa ādiṣu ca āvaraṇa ādi anupalabdhau ca samaya anupalabdhyā pratyavasthitaḥ anupalabdhi samaḥ bhavati

asya uttaram anupalambha ātmaka tvāt anupalabdheḥ ahetuḥ āvaraṇa ādi anupalabdhiḥ na asti anupalambhāt iti ahetuḥ kasmāt anupalambha ātmaka tvāt anupalabdheḥ upalambha abhāva mātra tvāt anupalabdheḥ yat asti tat upalabdheḥ viṣayaḥ upalabdhyā tat asti iti pratijñāyate yat na asti tat anupalabdheḥ viṣayaḥ anupalabhyamānam na asti iti pratijñāyate saḥ ayam āvaraṇa ādi anupalabheḥ anupalambhaḥ upalabdhi abhāve anupalabdhau sva viṣaye pravarttamānaḥ na sva viṣayam pratiṣedhati

apratiṣiddhā ca āvaraṇa ādi anupalabdhiḥ hetu tvāya kalpate āvaraṇa ādīni tu vidyamāna tvāt upalabdheḥ viṣayāḥ teṣām upalabdhyā bhavitavyam yat tāni na upalabhyante tat upalabdheḥ sva viṣaya pratipādikāyāḥ abhāvāt anupalambhāt anupalabdheḥ viṣayaḥ gamyate na santi āvaraṇa ādīni śabdasya agrahaṇa kāraṇāni iti anupalambhāt tu anupalabhiḥ sidhyati viṣayaḥ sa tasya iti

jñāna vikalpānām ca bhāva abhāva saṃvedanāt adhyātmam ahetuḥ iti varttate śarīre śarīre jñāna vikalpānām bhāva abhāvau saṃvedanīyau asti me saṃśaya jñānam na asti me saṃśaya jñānam iti evam pratyakṣa anumāna āgama smṛti jñāneṣu sā iyam āvaraṇa ādi anupalabdhiḥ upalabdhi abhāvaḥ sva saṃvedyaḥ na asti me śabdasya āvaraṇa ādi upalabdhiḥ iti na upalabhyante śabdasya agrahaṇa kāraṇāni āvaraṇa ādīni iti tatra yat uktam tat anupalabdheḥ anupalambhāt abhāva siddhiḥ iti etat na upapadyate

sādharmyāt tulya dharma upapatteḥ sarva anitya tva prasaṅgāt anitya samaḥ anityena ghaṭena sādharmyāt anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti bruvataḥ asti ghaṭena anityena sarva bhāvānām sādharmyam iti sarvasya anitya tvam aniṣṭam sampadyate saḥ ayam anitya tvena pratyavasthānāt anitya samaḥ iti

asya uttaram sādharmyāt asiddheḥ pratiṣedha asiddhiḥ pratiṣedhya sādharmyāt pratijña ādi avayava yuktam vākyam pakṣa nivartakam pratipakṣa lakṣaṇam pratiṣedhaḥ tasya pakṣeṇa pratiṣedhyena sādharmyam pratijña ādi yogaḥ tat yadi anitya sādharmyāt anitya tvasya asiddhiḥ sādharmyāt asiddheḥ pratiṣedhasya api asiddhiḥ pratiṣedhyena sādharmyāt iti

dṛṣṭānte ca sādhya sādhana bhāvena prajñātasya dharmasya hetu tvāt tasya ca ubhayatha abhāvāt na aviśeṣaḥ dṛṣṭānte yaḥ khalu dharmaḥ sādhya sādhana bhāvena prajñāyate sa hetu tvena abhidhīyate sa ca ubhayathā bhavati kenacid samānaḥ kutaścid viśiṣṭaḥ sāmānyāt sādharmyam viśeṣāt ca vaidharmyam evam sādharmya viśeṣaḥ hetuḥ na aviśeṣeṇa sādharmya mātram vaidharmya mātram vā sādharmya mātram vaidharmya mātram ca āśritya bhavān āha sādharmyāt tulya dharma upapatteḥ sarva anitya tva prasaṅgāt anityasam iti etat ayuktam iti aviśeṣa sama pratiṣedhe ca yat uktam tat api veditavyam

nityam anitya bhāvāt anitye nitya tva upapatteḥ nitya samaḥ anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti pratijñāyate tat anitya tvam kim śabde nityam atha anityam yadi tāvat sarvadā bhavati dharmasya sadā bhāvāt dharmiṇaḥ api sadā bhāvaḥ iti nityaḥ śabdaḥ iti atha na sarvadā bhavati anitya tvasya abhāvāt nityaḥ śabdaḥ evam nitya tvena pratyavasthānāt nitya samaḥ

asya uttaram pratiṣedhye nityam anitya bhāvāt anitye anitya tva upapatteḥ pratiṣedha abhāvaḥ pratiṣedhye śabde nityam anitya tvasya bhāvāt iti ucyamāne anujñātam śabdasya anitya tvam anitya tva upapatteḥ ca na anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti pratiṣedhaḥ na upapadyate atha na abhyupagamyate nityam anitya tvasya bhāvāt iti hetuḥ na bhavati iti hetu abhāvāt pratiṣedha anupapattiḥ iti

utapannasya nirodhāt abhāvaḥ śabdasya anitya tvam tatra paripraśna anupapattiḥ yaḥ ayam paripraśnaḥ tat anitya tvam kim śabde sarvadā bhavati atha na iti ayam anupapannaḥ kasmāt utpannasya yaḥ nirodhāt abhāvaḥ śabdasya tat anitya tvam evam ca sati adhikaraṇa ādheya vibhāgaḥ vyāghātāt na asti iti nitya anitya tva virodhāt ca nitya tvam anitya tvam ca ekasya dharmiṇaḥ dharmau iti virudhyete na sambhavataḥ tatra yat uktam nityam anitya tvasya bhāvān nityaḥ eva tat avartamāna artham uktam iti

prayatna kārya aneka tvāt kārya samaḥ prayatna anantarīyaka tvāt anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti yasya prayatna anantaram ātma lābhaḥ tat khalu abhūtvā bhavati yathā ghaṭa ādi kāryam anityam iti ca bhūtvā na bhavati iti etat vijñāyate evam avasthite prayatna kārya anekatvāt iti pratiṣedhaḥ ucyate prayatna anantaram ātma lābhaḥ ca dṛṣṭaḥ ghaṭa ādīnām vyavadhāna apohāt ca abhivyaktiḥ vyavahitānām tat kim prayatna anantaram ātma lābhaḥ śabdasya aho abhivyaktiḥ iti viśeṣaḥ na asti kāryā viśeṣeṇa pratyavasthānam kārya samaḥ

asya uttaram kārya anya tve prayatna ahetu tvam anupalabdhi kāraṇa upapatteḥ sati kārya anya tve anupalabdhi kāraṇa upapatteḥ prayatnasya ahetu tvam śabdasya abhivyaktau yatra prayatna anantaram abhivyaktiḥ tatra anupalabdhi kāraṇam vyavadhānam upapadyate vyavadhāna apohāt ca prayatna anantara bhāvinaḥ arthasya upalabdhi lakṣaṇā abhivyaktiḥ bhavati iti na tu śabdasya anupalabdhi kāraṇam kiñcid upapadyate yasya prayatna anantaram apohāt śabdasya upalabhilakṣaṇā abhivyaktiḥ bhavati iti tasmāt utpadyate śabdaḥ na abhivyajyate iti

hetoḥ ced anaikāntika tvam upapadyate anaikātika tvāt asādhakaḥ syāt iti yadi ca anaikāntika tvāt asādhaka tvam pratiṣedhe api samānaḥ doṣaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ api anaikāntikaḥ kiñcid pratiṣedhati kiñcid na iti anaikāntika tvāt asādhakaḥ iti atha vā śabdasya anitya tva pakṣe prayatna anantaram utpādaḥ na abhi vyaktiḥ iti viśeṣa hetu abhāvaḥ nitya tva pakṣe api prayatna anantaram abhivyaktiḥ na utpādaḥ iti viśeṣa hetu abhāvaḥ saḥ ayam ubhaya pakṣa samaḥ viśeṣa hetu abhāvaḥ iti ubhayam api anaikātikam iti
sarvatra evam sarveṣu sādharmya prabhṛtiṣu pratiṣedha hetuṣu yatra yatra aviśeṣaḥ dṛśyate tatra ubhayoḥ pakṣayoḥ samaḥ prasajyate iti

pratiṣedha vipratiṣedhe pratiṣedha doṣa vat doṣaḥ yaḥ ayam pratiṣedhe api samānaḥ doṣaḥ anaikāntika tvam āpadyate saḥ ayam pratiṣedhasya vipratiṣedhe api samānaḥ tatra anityaḥ śabdaḥ prayatna anantarīyaka tvāt iti sādhana vādinaḥ sthāpanā prathamaḥ pakṣaḥ prayatna kārya aneka tvāt kārya samaḥ iti dūṣaṇa vādinaḥ pratiṣedha hetunā dvitīyaḥ pakṣaḥ sa ca pratiṣedhaḥ iti ucyate tasya asya pratiṣedhe api samānaḥ doṣaḥ iti tṛtīyaḥ pakṣaḥ vipratiṣedhaḥ ucyate tasmin pratiṣedha vipratiṣedhe api samānaḥ doṣaḥ anaikāntika tvam caturthaḥ pakṣaḥ

pratiṣedham sa doṣam abhyupetya pratiṣedha vipratiṣedhe samānaḥ doṣa prasaṅgaḥ mata anujñā pratiṣedham dvitīyam pakṣam sa doṣam abhyupetya tad uddhāram akṛtvā anujñāya pratiṣedha vipratiṣedhe tṛtīya pakṣe samānam anaikāntika tvam iti samānam dūṣaṇam prasañjayataḥ dūṣaṇa vādinaḥ mata anujñā prasajyate iti pañcamaḥ pakṣaḥ

sva pakṣa lakṣaṇa apekṣā upapatti upasaṃhāre hetu nirdeśe para pakṣa doṣa abhyupagamāt samānaḥ doṣaḥ sthāpanā pakṣe prayatna kārya anekatvāt iti doṣaḥ sthāpanā hetu vādinaḥ sva pakṣa lakṣaṇaḥ bhavati kasmāt sva pakṣa samuttha tvāt saḥ ayam sva pakṣa lakṣaṇam doṣam apekṣamāṇaḥ anuddhṛtya anujñāya pratiṣedhe api samānaḥ doṣaḥ iti upapadyamānam doṣam para pakṣe upasaṃharati ittham ca anaikāntikaḥ pratiṣedhaḥ iti hetum nirdiśati tatra sva pakṣa lakṣaṇa apekṣayā upapadyamāna doṣa upasaṃhāre hetu nirdeśe ca sati anena para pakṣa doṣaḥ abhyupagataḥ bhavati katham kṛtvā yaḥ pareṇa prayatna kārya anekatvāt ityādinā anaikāntika doṣaḥ uktaḥ tam anuddhṛtya pratiṣedhe api samānaḥ doṣaḥ iti āha evam sthāpanām sa doṣām abhyupetya pratiṣedhe api samānam doṣam prasañjayataḥ para pakṣa abhyupagamāt samānaḥ doṣaḥ bhavati yathā parasya pratiṣedham sa doṣam abhyupetya pratiṣedha vipratiṣedhe api samānaḥ doṣa prasaṅgaḥ mata anujñā prasajyate iti tathā asya api sthāpanām sa doṣām abhyupetya pratiṣedhe api samānam doṣam prasañjayataḥ mata anujñā prasajyate iti sa khalu ayam ṣaṣṭhaḥ pakṣaḥ

tatra khalu sthāpanā hetu vādinaḥ prathama tṛtīya pañcama pakṣāḥ pratiṣedha hetu vādinaḥ dvitīya caturtha ṣaṣṭha pakṣāḥ teṣām sādhu asādhu tāyām mīmāṃsyamānāyām caturtha ṣaṣṭhayoḥ artha aviśeṣāt punar ukta doṣa prasaṅgaḥ caturtha pakṣe samāna doṣa tvam parasya ucyate pratiṣedha vipratiṣedhe pratiṣedha doṣa vat doṣaḥ iti ṣaṣṭhe api para pakṣa doṣa abhyupagamāt samānaḥ doṣaḥ iti samāna doṣa tvam eva ucyate na artha viśeṣaḥ kaścid asti samānaḥ tṛtīya pañcamayoḥ punar ukta doṣa prasaṅgaḥ tṛtīya pakṣe api pratiṣedhe api samānaḥ doṣaḥ iti samāna tvam abhyupagamyate pañcama pakṣe api pratiṣedha vipratiṣedhe samānaḥ doṣa prasaṅgaḥ abhyupagamyate na artha viśeṣaḥ kaścid ucyate iti tatra pañcama ṣaṣṭha pakṣayoḥ artha aviśeṣāt punar ukta doṣa prasaṅgaḥ tṛtīya caturthayoḥ mata anujñā prathama dvitīyayoḥ viśeṣa hetu abhāvaḥ iti ṣaṣ pakṣyām ubhayoḥ asiddhiḥ

kadā ṣaṣ pakṣī yadā pratiṣedhe api samānaḥ doṣaḥ iti evam pravarttate tad ā ubhayoḥ pakṣayoḥ asiddhiḥ yadā tu kārya anya tve prayatna ahetu tvam anupalabdhi kāraṇa upapatteḥ iti anena tṛtīya pakṣaḥ yujyate tadā viśeṣa hetu vacanāt prayatna anantaram ātma lābhaḥ śabdasya na abhi vyaktiḥ iti siddhaḥ prathama pakṣaḥ na ṣaṭpakṣī pravartate iti

vipratipatti apratipattyoḥ vikalpāt nigraha sthāna bahu tvam iti saṅkṣepeṇa uktam tat idānīm vibhajanīyam nigraha sthānāni khalu parājaya vastūni aparādha adhikaraṇāni prāyeṇa pratijña ādi avayava āśrayāṇi tattva vādinam atattva vādinam ca abhisaṃplavante teṣām vibhāgaḥ pratijñāhāniḥ pratijñāntaram pratijñā virodhaḥ pratijñāsannyāsaḥ hetu antaram artha antaram nirarthakam avijñāta artham apārthakam aprāpta kālam nyūnam adhikam punaruktam ananubhāṣaṇam ajñānam apratibhā vikṣepaḥ mata anujñā paryanuyojya upekṣaṇam niranuyojya anuyogaḥ apasiddhāntaḥ hetvābhāsāḥ ca nigraha sthānāni tāni imāni dvāviṃśatidhā vibhajya lakṣyante

pratidṛṣṭānta dharma abhyanujñā sva dṛṣṭānte pratijñāhāniḥ sādhya dharma pratyanīkena dharmeṇa pratyavasthite pratidraṣṭānta dharmam sva dṛṣṭānte abhyanujānan pratijñām jahāti iti pratijñā hāniḥ nidarśanam aindriyaka tvāt anityaḥ śabdaḥ ghaṭa vat iti kṛte aparaḥ āha dṛṣṭam aindriyaka tvam sāmānye nitye kasmāt na tathā śabdaḥ iti pratyavasthite idam āha yadi aindriyakam sāmānyam nityam kāmam ghaṭaḥ nityaḥ astu iti sa khalu ayam sādhakasya dṛṣṭāntasya nitya tvam prasañjayan nigamana antam eva pakṣam jahāti pakṣam jahat pratijñām jahāti iti ucyate pratijña āśraya tvāt pakṣasya iti

pratijñāta artha pratiṣedhe dharma vikalpāt tad artha nirdeśaḥ pratijñāntaram pratijñāta arthaḥ anityaḥ śabdaḥ aindriyaka tvāt ghaṭa vat iti ukte yaḥ asya pratiṣedhaḥ pratidṛṣṭāntena hetu vyabhicāraḥ sāmānyam aindriyakam nityam iti tasmin ca pratijñāta artha pratiṣedhe dharma vikalpāt iti dṛṣṭānta pratidṛṣṭa antayoḥ sādharmya yoge dharma bhedāt sāmānyam aindriyakam sarva gatam aindriyakaḥ tu asarva gataḥ ghaṭaḥ iti dharma vikalpāt tad artha nirdeśaḥ iti sādhya siddhi artham katham yathā ghaṭaḥ asarva gataḥ evam śabdaḥ api asarva gataḥ ghaṭa vat eva anityaḥ iti tatra anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti pūrvā pratijñā asarva gataḥ iti dvitīyā pratijñā pratijñāntaram tat katham nigraha sthām iti na pratijñāyāḥ sādhanam pratijñāntaram kim tu hetu dṛṣṭāntau sādhanam pratijñāyāḥ tat etat asādhana upādānam anarthakam iti ānarthakyāt nigraha sthānam iti

pratijñā hetvoḥ virodhaḥ pratijñā virodhaḥ guṇa vyatiriktam dravyam iti pratijñā rūpa āditaḥ artha antarasya anupalabdheḥ iti hetuḥ saḥ ayam pratijñā hetvoḥ virodhaḥ katham yadi guṇa vyatiriktam dravyam rūpa ādibhyaḥ artha antarasya anupalabdhiḥ na upapadyate atha rūpa ādibhyaḥ artha antarasya anupalabdhiḥ guṇa vyatiriktam dravyam iti na upapadyate guṇa vyatiriktam ca dravyam rūpa ādibhyaḥ ca artha antarasya anupalabdhiḥ iti virudhyate vyāhanyate na sambhavati iti

pakṣa pratiṣedhe pratijñāta artha apanayanam pratijñāsannyāsaḥ anityaḥ śabdaḥ aindriyaka tvāt iti ukte paraḥ brūyāt sāmānyam aindriyakam na ca anityam evam śabdaḥ api aindriyakaḥ na ca anitya iti evam pratiṣiddhe pakṣe yadi brūyāt kaḥ punar āha anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti saḥ ayam pratijñāta artha nihnavaḥ pratijñāsannyāsaḥ iti

aviśeṣa ukte hetau pratiṣiddhe viśeṣam icchataḥ hetu antaram nidarśanam eka prakṛti idam vyaktam iti pratijñā kasmāt dhetoḥ eka prakṛtīnām vikārāṇām parimāṇāt mṛd pūrvakāṇām śarāva ādīnām dṛṣṭam parimāṇam yāvān prakṛteḥ vyūhaḥ bhavati tāvān vikāraḥ iti dṛṣṭam ca prativikāram parimāṇam asti ca idam parimāṇam prativyaktam tad eka prakṛtīnām vikārāṇām parimāṇāt paśyāmaḥ vyaktam idam eka prakṛti iti

asya vyabhicāreṇa pratyavasthānam nānā prakṛtīnām eka prakṛtīnām ca vikārāṇām dṛṣṭam parimāṇam iti evam pratyavasthite āha eka prakṛti samanvaye sati śarāva ādi vikārāṇām parimāṇa darśanāt sukha duḥkha moha samanvitam hi idam vyaktam parimitam gṛhyate tatra prakṛti antara rūpa samanvaya abhāve sati eka prakṛti tvam iti tat idam aviśeṣa ukte hetau pratiṣiddhe viśeṣam bruvataḥ hetu antaram bhavati sati ca hetu antara bhāve pūrvasya hetoḥ asādhaka tvāt nigraha sthānam hetu antara vacane sati yadi hetu artha nidarśanaḥ dṛṣṭāntaḥ upādīyate na idam vyaktam eka prakṛti bhavati prakṛti antara upādānāt atha na upādīyate dṛṣṭānte hetu arthasya anidarśitasya sādhaka bhāva anupapatteḥ ānarthakyāt dhetoḥ anivṛttam nigraha sthānam iti

prakṛtāt arthāt apratisambaddha artham artha antaram yathā ukta lakṣaṇe pakṣa pratipakṣa parigrahe hetutaḥ sādhya siddhau prakṛtāyām brūyāt nityaḥ śabdaḥ asparśa tvāt iti hetuḥ hetuḥ nāma hinoteḥ dhātoḥ tuni pratyaye kṛdantam padam padam ca nāma ākhyāta upasarga nipātāḥ abhidheyasya kriyā antara yogāt viśiṣyamāṇa rūpaḥ śabdaḥ nāma kriyā kāraka samudāyaḥ kāraka saṅkhyā viśiṣṭa kriyā kāla yoga abhidhāya ākhyātam dhātu artha mātram ca kāla abhidhāna viśiṣṭam prayogeṣu arthāt abhidyamānā rūpāḥ nipātāḥ upasṛjyamānāḥ kriyā avat yotakāḥ upasargāḥ iti evamādi tad artha antaram veditavyam iti

varṇa krama nirdeśa vat nirarthakam yathā anityaḥ śabdaḥ kacaṭa tapāḥ java gaḍa daśa tvāt jhabhan ghaḍha dhaṣa vat iti evamprakāram nirarthakam abhidhāna abhidheya bhāva anupapattau artha gateḥ abhāvāt varṇāḥ eva krameṇa nirdiśyante iti

pariṣad prativādibhyām tris abhihitam api avijñātam avijñāta artham yat vākyam pariṣadā prativādinā ca tris abhihitam api na vijñāyate śliṣṭa śabdam apratīta prayogam atidruta uccaritam iti evamādinā kāraṇena tat avijñātam avijñāta artham asāmarthya saṃvaraṇāya prayuktam iti nigraha sthānam iti

paurvāparya ayogāt apratisambaddha artham apārthakam yatra anekasya padasya vākyasya vā paurvāparyeṇa anvaya yogaḥ na asti iti asambaddha artha tva gṛhyate tat samudāya arthasya apāyāt apārthakam yathā daśa dāḍimāni ṣaṭ apūpāḥ kuṇḍam aja ajinam palala piṇḍaḥ atha raurukam etat kumāryāḥ pāyam tasyāḥ pitā apratiśīnaḥ iti
avayava viparyāsa vacanam aprāpta kālam pratijña ādīnām avayavānām yathālakṣaṇam artha vaśāt kramaḥ tatra avayava viparyāsena vacanam aprāpta kālam asambaddha artham nigraha sthānam iti
hīnam anyatamena api avayavena nyūnam pratijña ādīnām avayavānām anyatamena api avayavena hīnam nyūnam nigraha sthānam sādhana abhāve sādhya asiddhiḥ iti
hetu udāharaṇa adhikam adhikam ekena kṛta tvāt anyatarasya ānarthakyam iti tat etat niyama abhupagame veditavyam iti

śabda arthayoḥ punar vacanam punar uktam anyatra anuvādāt anyatra anuvādāt śabda punaruktam artha punaruktam vā nityaḥ śabdaḥ nityaḥ śabdaḥ iti śabda punaruktam artha punaruktam anityaḥ śabdaḥ nirodha dharmakaḥ dhvaniḥ iti anuvāde tu apunaruktam śabda abhyāsāt artha viśeṣa upapatteḥ yathā hetu apadeśāt pratijñāyāḥ punar vacanam nigamanam iti

arthāt āpannasya sva śabdena punarvacanam punaruktam iti prakṛtam nidarśanam utpatti dharmaka tvāt anityam iti uktvā arthād āpannasya yaḥ abhidhāyakaḥ śabdaḥ tena sva śabdena brūyāt anutpatti dharmakam nityam iti tat ca punarukatam veditavyam artha sampratyaya arthe śabda prayoge pratītaḥ saḥ arthaḥ artha āpttyeti

vijñātasya pariṣadā tris abhihitasya api apratyuccāraṇam ananubhāṣaṇam vijñātasya vākya arthasya pariṣadā prativādinā tris abhihitasya yat apratyauccāraṇam tat ananubhāṣaṇam nāma nigraha sthānam iti apratyuccārayan kim āśrayam para pakṣa pratiṣedham brūyāt
avijñātam ca ajñānam vijñāta arthasya pariṣadā prativādinā tris abhihitasya yat avijñātam tat ajñānam nāma nigraha sthānam iti ayam khalu avijñāya kasya pratiṣedham brūyāt iti
uttarasya apratipattiḥ apratibhā para pakṣa pratiṣedhaḥ uttaram tat yadā na pratipadyate tadā nigṛhītaḥ bhavati

kārya vyāsaṅgāt kathā vicchedaḥ vikṣepaḥ yatra kartavyam vyāsajya kathām vyavacchinatti idam me karaṇīyam vidyate tasmin avasite paścāt kathayāmi iti vikṣepaḥ nāma nigraha sthānam eka nigraha avasānāyām kathāyām svayam eva kathā antaram pratipadyate iti

sva pakṣe doṣa abhyupagamāt para pakṣe doṣa prasaṅgaḥ mata anujñā yaḥ pareṇa coditam doṣam sva pakṣe abhyupagamyān uddhṛtya vadati bhavat pakṣe api samānaḥ doṣaḥ iti sa sva pakṣe doṣa abhyupagamāt para pakṣe doṣam prasañjayan para matam anujānāti iti matānujñām nāma nigraha sthānam āpadyate iti

nigraha sthāna prāptasya anigrahaḥ paryanuyojya upekṣaṇam paryanuyojyaḥ nāma nigraha upapattyā codanīyaḥ tasya upekṣaṇam nigraha sthānam prāptaḥ asi iti ananuyogaḥ etat ca kasya parājaya iti anuyuktayā pariṣadā vacanīyam na khalu nigraham prāptaḥ sva kaupīnam vivṛṇuyāt iti
anigraha sthāne nigraha sthāna abhiyogaḥ niranuyojya anuyogaḥ nigraha sthā lakṣaṇasya mithyā adhyavasāyāt anigraha sthāne nigṛhītaḥ asi iti param bruvan niranuyojya anuyogāt nigṛhītaḥ veditavyaḥ iti

siddhāntam abhyupetya aniyamāt kathā prasaṅgaḥ apasiddhāntaḥ kasyacid arthasya tathā abhāvam pratijñāya pratijñāta artha viparyayāt aniyamāt kathām prasañjayataḥ apasiddhāntaḥ veditavyaḥ yathā na sat ātmānam jahāti na sataḥ vināśaḥ na asat ātmānam labhate na asat utpadyate iti siddhāntam abhyupetya sva pakṣam vyavasthāpayati eka prakṛti idam vyaktam vikārāṇām anvaya darśanāt mṛd anvitānām śarāva ādīnām dṛṣṭam eka prakṛti tvam tathā ca ayam vyakta bhedaḥ sukha duḥkha moha anvitaḥ dṛśyate tasmāt samanvaya darśanāt sukha ādibhiḥ eka prakṛti idam viśvam iti evam uktavān anuyujyate atha pratṛtiḥ vikāraḥ iti katham lakṣitavyam iti yasya avasthitasya dharma antara nivṛttau dharma antaram pravartate sā prakṛtiḥ

yat dharma antaram pravartate nivartate vā sa vikāraḥ iti saḥ ayam pratijñāta artha viparyāsāt aniyamāt kathām prasañjayati pratijñātam khalu anena na asat āvirbhavati na sat tirobhavati iti sat asatoḥ ca tirobhāva āvirbhāvam antareṇa na kasyacid pravṛttiḥ pravṛtti uparamaḥ ca bhavati mṛdi khalu avasthitāyām bhaviṣyati śarāva ādi lakṣaṇam dharma antaram iti pravṛttiḥ bhavati abhūt iti ca pravṛtti uparamaḥ tat etat mṛd dharmāṇām api na syāt evam pratyavasthitaḥ yadi sataḥ ca ātmahānam asataḥ ca ātma lābham abhyupaiti tat asya apasiddhānataḥ nigraha sthānam bhavati atha na abhyupaiti pakṣaḥ asya na sidhyati

hetvābhāsāḥ ca yathā uktāḥ hetvābhāsāḥ ca nigraha sthānāni kim punar lakṣaṇa antara yogāt hetvābhāsāḥ nigraha sthāna tvam āpannāḥ yathā pramāṇāni prameya tvam iti atas āha yathā uktāḥ iti hetvābhāsa lakṣaṇena eva nigraha sthāna bhāvaḥ iti te ime pramāṇa ādayaḥ padārthāḥ uddiṣṭāḥ lakṣitāḥ parīkṣitāḥ ca iti yaḥ akṣapādam ṛṣim nyāyaḥ pratyabhāt vadatām varam tasya vātsyāyanaḥ idam bhāṣya jātam avartayat

pramiti viśiṣṭa anantarya pratipādanāt ca tad abhāva nirāsaḥ atas śabdaḥ api hetau vartamānaḥ viśiṣṭa deśa kula prasūtam aviplutena brāhmaṇena aviplutāyām brāhmaṇyām vighnu deśa avasitāyām upajātam śuśrūṣā śravaṇa grahaṇa dhāraṇa ūha apoha tattva abhiniveśa vat antevāsinam āha iti tathā ca sa aṅgāḥ catur vedān va sumatiḥ brāhmaṇaḥ bhagavantam ulūkam ājagāma na ha vai sa śarīrasya priya apriyayoḥ upahatiḥ asti aśarīram vāva santam na priya apriye spṛśataḥ iti vākyāt aśarīra avasthāyām sukha duḥkham aniśam pratipadyate pakāṇāt adarśanam āpta vat tat ca yathā upapannam bhagavān adhikāriṇam dṛṣṭvā samādhi balāt ekasmin aṇau utpanna ṣaṭpadārtha tattva jñānaḥ maheśvareṇa upadiṣṭa sūtra karaṇe pravṛttaḥ

tad artha siddhaye sūtra sandarbhasya ca ati saṃkṣipta tvāt avedyatayā vā asmad ādeḥ tattva jñānam na syāt iti praśasta pāda saṃkṣepaḥ tvādivat apratibhāsanāt adhikārya bhāvaḥ tat asat upadeśa vyaṅgya tvāt tathā hi dravya ādiṣu iva kṛta samayasya anugatam jñānam i brāhmaṇaḥ ayam iti jñāne paścāt bhā vi bādhaka anupapatteḥ pramāṇa tayā śiṣṭa padārtha adhikāri siddheḥ nirviṣaya tvāt na doṣaḥ nirabhidheya tvam avisiddham dravya ādi bhāvaḥ ca nirastaḥ eva tad abhidhānāt tathā prayojana upanyāsāt tad abhāvaḥ ca iti atha kim punar ca vijñānam kim vā niḥśreyasam iti vācyam avasthita padārtha vi na vānām ātma viśeṣa guṇānām atyanta ucchittiḥ na dharma artha kāmāḥ teṣām alpa sādhana sādhya tvāt

atha niḥśreyasa astitve kim pramāṇam vibhu cetanam anumāna bhāga va tathā hi navānām ātma viśeṣa guṇānām santānaḥ atyantam ucchidyate santāna tvāt yaḥ yaḥ santānaḥ sa saḥ atyantam ucchidyamānaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ yathā pradīpa santānaḥ tathā ca ayam santānaḥ tasmāt tam ucchidyate iti santāna tvasya ca vyāptyā buddhayā ādiṣu sambhavāt pakṣa dharma tayā asiddha tva abhāvaḥ tad samānarmiṇi ca pradīpa ādau upalambhāt aviruddha tvam na ca pakṣe paramāṇu ādau asti saṃ iti anaikāntika tva abhāvaḥ viparīta artha upasthāpakayoḥ pratyakṣa āgamayoḥ anupalambhāt na kāla atyaya apadiṣṭaḥ na ca ayam sat pratipakṣaḥ iti pañca rūpa tvāt pramāṇam

atha nirhetukāvinā prati vaśya anta ādeḥ eva hetuḥ vācyaḥ yatas samucchidyate iti sa tu uktaḥ eva tattva jñānam niḥśreyasa hetuḥ iti nirdeśāt ca tattva jñānam aviśiṣṭa tvāt na prativyakti apekṣam kintu ityādi lakṣaṇāt tathā hi dravya ādi lakṣaṇa lakṣiteṣu utpadyate tattva jñānam iti

atha tattva jñānasya niśreyasa kāraṇa tve samutpanna tattva jñānaḥ tu anantaram eva apamṛdyam manasi asambhave asmad ādīnām tattva jñāna anupapattiḥ atha yoga ja dharmāt upajāta tattva jñānaḥ asmad ādeḥ tattva jñāna sampādanāya kaṇādaḥ sūtrāṇi karoti iti avasthām iṣyate gata arha tattva jñānasya niḥśreyasa kāraṇe sati api abhāvāt na eṣa doṣaḥ viśiṣṭa tattva jñānasya niḥśreyasa kāraṇa tva abhyupagamāt tathā hi upajāte api śraute tattva jñāne asmad ādīnām niḥśreyasam yoga abhyāsa janita tattva jñānasya asambhavāt śraute hi tattva jñāne samutpanne yoga abhyāse pravartamānasya abhyāsa vaśāt ātmani aśeṣa viśeṣa āliṅgite antyam tattva jñānam upajātam niśśreyasa kāraṇam iti

tathā hi upalabdham samyak jñānasya mithyājñāna nivṛttau sāmarthyam śuktikā ādau iti samyak jñānasya jñāna antara virodhi tvāt uttara kāla bhāvinā mithyājñānena api samyak jñānasya virodhaḥ sambhavati eva yadi sā manaḥ santāna ucchittiḥ vivakṣitā iti yathā hi samyak jñānāt mithyājñānasya santāna ucchedaḥ na evam mithyājñānāt samyak jñānasya iti nivṛtte ca mithyājñāne tad mūla tvāt rāga ādayaḥ naśyanti kāraṇa abhāvena kāryasya anutpādāt iti rāga ādi abhāve ca tad kārya apravṛttiḥ vyāvartate tad abhāve ca dharma adharmayoḥ anutpattiḥ ārabdha kāryayoḥ ca upabhogāt prakṣayaḥ iti

katham tattva jñānāt eva iti yathā uktam yathā edhāṃsi samiddhaḥ agniḥ bhasmasāt kurute kṣaṇāt jñāna agniḥ sarva karmāṇi bhasmasāt kurute tathā iti nanu upabhogāt eva prakṣayaḥ iti api āgama uktam yathā uktam na abhuktam kṣīyate karma kalpa koṭi śataiḥ api avaśyam anubhoktavyam kṛtam karma śubha aśubham

tathā ca viruddha artha tvāt ubhayoḥ katham prāmāṇyam iti bhogāt ca prakṣaye api anumānam api asti pūrva karmāṇi upabhogāt eva kṣīyante karma tvāt yat yat karma tat tat upabhogāt eva kṣīyate yathā ārabdha śarīram karma tathā ca amūni karmāṇi tasmāt upabhogāt eva kṣīyante iti upabhogena ca prakṣaye karma antarasya avaśyambhāvāt saṃsāra anucchedaḥ tat asat samādhi balāt utpanna tattva jñānaḥ hi karmaṇā añca sādhyam artham viditvā yugapad śarīrāṇi nirmāya upabhoga ktaḥ iti na ca karma antara utpattiḥ mithyājñāna janita anusandhāna ākhyasya sahakāriṇaḥ abhāvāt

atha mithyājñāna abhāve abhilāṣasya abhāvāt bhoga anupapattiḥ tat na upabhogam vinā hi karma yāḥ anupapatteḥ jānan api tad arthi tayā pravartate eva vaidya upadeśāt ātura vat auṣadha āvaraṇe jñānam api evam aśeṣa śarīra utpatti dvāreṇa upabhogāt karmaṇām vināśe vyāpārāt agni iti vyākhyeyam na tu sākṣāt na ca etat vācyam tattva jñāninām karma vināśaḥ tattva jñānāt itareṣa antu upabhogāt iti jñānena karma vināśe prasiddha udāharaṇa abhāvāt

anye tu mithyājñāna janita saṃskārasya sahakāriṇaḥ abhāvāt vidyamānāni api karmāṇi na janma antare śarīra ārambha kāṇi iti manyante atra ca kārya vastunaḥ nitya tvam syāt iti dūṣaṇam atha anāgatayoḥ dharma adharmayoḥ utpatti pratiṣedhe tattva jñāninaḥ nitya naimittika anuṣṭhānam tarhi katham pratyavāya parihāra artham tathā hi nitya naimittikaiḥ eva kurvāṇaḥ durita kṣayam jñānañca vimalīkurvan abhyāsena tu pācayet abhyāsāt pakva vijñānaḥ kaivalyam labhate naraḥ iti

kevalantu kāmye niṣiddhe ca pravṛtti pratiṣedhaḥ iti yat vā tattva jñāninaḥ nitya naimittika anuṣṭhāne na nivartate dharma utpattiḥ tathā eva abhisandhānāt tad phala sannyāsaḥ vā tathā hi sarva karmaṇām parama gurau arpaṇam iti śrūyate na vā pravṛttiḥ pratisandhānāya hīna kleśasya iti alam atha astu tattva jñānam niḥśreyasa kāraṇam avadhāraṇantu niṣidhyate sannyāsa ādi kriyāyāḥ ca mokṣa hetu tvena śravaṇāt tathā hi sannyasyantam dvijam dṛṣṭvā sthānāt calati bhāskaraḥ mama eṣa maṇḍalam bhitvā prayātā lokam akṣayam dvau etau puruṣau loke sūrya maṇḍala bhedinau parivrāj yoga yuktaḥ ca raṇe ca abhimukhe hataḥ iti ādi uktam

satyam sannyāsa ādi kriyāyāḥ sūrya maṇḍala bhedi tvena ūrdhva gamana hetu tvam iṣyate eva yadi nāma lokam iti abhidhānāt akṣaya tvam adhastana loka apekṣayā kriyā antara phala apekṣayā vā draṣṭavyam tathā hi sannyāsa ādi lakṣaṇa kriyā bhautikāni akriyā apekṣayā pradhāna bhūtā iti na ca navānām ātma viśeṣa guṇānām atyanta ucchittiḥ niḥśreyasam sūrya maṇḍala bhedi tvena bhavati iti tasya viśeṣa guṇa viyukta ātma rūpa tayā sarvatra bhāvāt atas eva na tattva jñāna kārya tvāt anitya tvam iti vācyam viśeṣa guṇa ucchedasya pradhvaṃsa rūpa tvāt tad upalakṣita ātmanaḥ eva nitya tvāt iti kārya vastunaḥ ca anitya tvam iti na ca buddhi ādi nāśe guṇinaḥ tathā bhāvaḥ tādātmya pratiṣedhasya vakṣyamāṇa tvāt

atha mokṣa avasthāyām caitanyasya api ucchedāt na kṛtabuddhayaḥ pravartante iti ānanda rūpaḥ mokṣaḥ iṣyatām iti manuṣe yathā uktam ānandam brahmaṇaḥ rūpam tat ca mokṣe abhipadyate iti tathā sukhena aham asva apsam iti suṣupti avasthā uttara kālam smaraṇāni atha anupapattyā anubhavaḥ jñāyate tatra ca abhidhāna anumānayoḥ vyāpāraḥ anupalabdhaḥ bāhya indriyāṇāñcaḥ iti antaḥkaraṇasya vyāpāraḥ jñāyate iti mānasam pratyakṣam anumānañca ātmā sukha svabhāvaḥ atyantam priya buddhi viṣaya tvāt ananya paratayā upādīyamāna tvāt ca yat yat evaṃvidham tad tad sukha svabhāvam yathā vaiṣayikam sukham tathā ca ātmā evaṃvidhaḥ tasmāt sukha svabhāvaḥ iti

tat etat asat bādhaka upapatteḥ tathā hi tasya anitya tāyām utpatti kāraṇam vācyam na ca mokṣa avasthāyām ātma antaḥkaraṇa sambandhaḥ śarīra sambandha apekṣaḥ sambhavati śarīra ādeḥ abhāvāt na ca asamavāyi kāraṇam vinā vastu utpattiḥ dṛṣṭā atha nityam tat sukham iti ced ajñāta saṃvedanantu yadi nityam muktā avasthāyām iva saṃsāra avasthāyām api bhāvāt aviśeṣa prasaṅgaḥ smaraṇa anupapattiḥ ca anubhavasya eva avasthānāt saṃskāra anupapattiḥ ca anubhavasya niratiśaya tvāt atha saṃsāra avasthāyām vā anya viṣaya vyāsaṅgāt vidyamānasya api anubhavasyā saṃvedanam tad abhāvāt ca mokṣa avasthāyām vedanam iti asti viśeṣaḥ

tat asat nitya sukhe hi anubhavasya api nitya tvāt vyāsaṅga anupapattiḥ tathā hi ātmanaḥ rūpa ādi viṣayaka jñāna utpattau viṣaya antare jñāna anutpattiḥ vyāsaṅgaḥ evam indriyasya api ekasmin viṣaye jñāna janaka tvena pravṛttasya viṣaya antare jñāna ajanaka tvam vyāsaṅgaḥ na ca evam ātmanaḥ rūpa ādi viṣayaka jñāna utpattau nitya sukhe jñāna anupapattiḥ tat jñānasya api nitya tvāt na ca śarīra ādinā pratibadhya tvāt asaṃvedanam iti vācyam nitya tvāt eva tathā hi pratibandhakam kārya vyāghāta kṛt ucyate na ca nitya sukha jñānasya anutpattiḥ sambhavati tathā upabhoga artha tvāt ca śarīra ādeḥ bhoga pratibandhaka tva anupapattiḥ yat yad artham tat tasya eva pratibandhakam iti na upalabdham pratibandhaka tvena tad apahantuḥ hiṃsā phalam na syāt tathā hi pratibandha vighātakaḥ upakārakaḥ eva iti dṛṣṭam tena hi nitya sukha saṃvedana pratibandhakasya śarīra ādeḥ apahantuḥ hiṃsā phalasya abhāvaḥ iti alam

atha anityam tad saṃvedanam iti ced na utpatti kāraṇa abhāvāt atha yoga ja dharma apekṣaḥ puruṣa antaḥkaraṇa saṃyogaḥ asamavāyi kāraṇam iti ced na yoga ja dharmasya api anitya tayā vināśe apekṣā kāraṇa abhāvāt atha ādya saṃyoga ja dharmāt upajātam vijñānam apekṣya uttaram vijñānam tasmāt ca uttaram iti santānaḥ tat na pramāṇa abhāvāt tathā ca śarīra sambandha anapekṣam vijñānam eva ātma antaḥkaraṇa saṃyogasya apekṣā kāraṇam iti na dṛṣṭam na ca dṛṣṭyā viparītam śakyate hi anujñātum ākasmikantu kāryam na bhavati eva atas eva nitya sukha jñānasya abhāvāt sukhena aham asva apsam iti jñānam na idam smaraṇam kim tarhi duḥkha kāraṇa anusmaraṇa abhāvena tad abhāva anumiti jñānam etat sukhena aham asva apsam iti viparyaye vā nitya sukha vat duḥkhena aham asva apsam iti smaraṇāt nitya duḥkham api syāt atha suṣupti avasthā antarāle duḥkha kāraṇa saṃvedanāt duḥkhena aham asva apsam iti jñānam etat evam tarhi tad abhāvāt sukhena aham iti bhaviṣyati iti

atha āgamaḥ tarhi katham ānandam brahmaṇaḥ rūpam ityādi mukhye hi bādhaka upapatteḥ gauṇaḥ iti tathā hi duḥkha abhāve ayam ānanda śabdaḥ prayuktaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ sukha śabdaḥ duḥkha abhāve yathā bhāra ākrāntasya vāhakasya tad apāyaḥ iti yat ca anumānam ātmā sukha svabhāvaḥ iti tatra yadi sukha svabhāva tvam sukha tva jāti sambandhi tvam tat na ātmani sambhāvyate guṇaḥ eva upalambhāt na hi ekāḥ ahaṅkāra ādi vat aparā jātiḥ dravya guṇayoḥ sādhāraṇi upalabdha iti atha sukha adhikaraṇa tvam tat na asti nitya anitya tva vikalpa anupapatteḥ tathā sukha tva adhikaraṇa tve sukha adhikaraṇa tāyām vā tat jñānasya nitya anitya tva vikalpaḥ sādhanam vā atyanta priya buddhi viṣayam ananya paratayā upādīyamāna tvañca anaikānta āt asādhanam duḥkha abhāve api bhāvāt ananya para tayā upādīyamāna tvañcā siddham sukha artham upādānāt tathā atyanta priya buddhi viṣaya tvam api asiddham duḥkhitāyām apriya buddheḥ api bhāva āt iti anumāna dvayam apramāṇam

yadi ca mokṣa avasthāyām nityam sukham asti iti abhilāṣeṇa pravarteta na muktaḥ syāt rāgasya bandhana rūpa tvāt atha buddhi ādikam upacchedayāmi iti dveṣāt api pravartamānasya tat eva dūṣaṇam na anukūla tvāt tathā ca pratikūlasya adoṣasya pratiṣedhasya tad rāge api samānam iti adūṣaṇam etat iti anya dūhyam atha sarva guṇa ucchedāt varam vaiṣayikam sukham duḥkha sādhana parihāreṇa bhoktavyam iti manyase tat na tasya duḥkha anuṣaṅgeṇa duḥkha rūpa tayā heya tvāt yeṣāñca etat upādeyam na tān prati idam arthavat śāstram santi ca vaiṣayika sukha dveṣiṇaḥ puruṣāḥ tān pratīdam śāstram te ca yadi upadeśam apekṣante na upāya antarāt eva artham pratipadya anuṣṭhāne pravartante iti mokṣa astitve ca pramāṇa upapatteḥ śeṣam vacana mātram iti upekṣyate
