na ca kārya avirodhi tvena aviśeṣaḥ tatra hi kāryeṇa avināśa tvam kāraṇa dharmaḥ kāraṇa avirodhi tvam kāraṇa avināśaka tvam kārya dharmaḥ iti apunaruktam tat evam ubhayathā api vipakṣa eka deśa avyāvṛttaḥ sādharmyam eva na tat lakṣaṇam iti siddham evam antyāḥ viśeṣāḥ vidyante yeṣām te tadvantaḥ teṣām bhāvaḥ antya viśeṣavat tvam antya viśeṣa upalakṣitaḥ samavāyaḥ samavetāḥ vai antya viśeṣāḥ tathā anāśrita tvañca nitya tvañca iti anāśrita tva nitya tve anāśrita tvam āśrita tva abhāvaḥ nitya tvam avināśi tvam ubhaya anta anupalakṣitāḥ vastu sattā vā kim etat dharma trayam sarveṣu pṛthivī ādiṣu asti vyāpakañca iti āha anyatra avaya vi dravyebhyaḥ iti avayavi dravyāṇi varjayitvā nitya dravyeṣu eva iti

nanu dharma trayasya sa apavāda tva aviśeṣe api antya viśeṣavat tvena asamāsa karaṇe kim prayojanam iti antya viśeṣāṇām avyāpaka tve asādhāraṇa tā jñānena eva anāśrita tva niya tvayoḥ ca anyatra api sadbhāvāt sādhāraṇa tvena asamāsa karaṇam tathā hi nitya tvam guṇa ādiṣu api asti iti sādhāraṇam anāśrita tvam samavāyasya api mukhya vṛttau bādhaka upapatteḥ gauṇa vṛtti āśrayaṇena sambhāvyate na paramārthataḥ iti sādhāraṇam

evam pṛthivī ādīnām navānām padārtha antarāt vyāvṛtam sādharmyam abhidhāya punar teṣām sva bhedāt vyāvṛttam sādharmyam darśayati pṛthivī udaka jvalana pavana ātma manasām iti ca arthe dvandvaḥ samāsaḥ aneka tvañca apara jātimat tvañcā iti aneka tva apara jātimat tve aneka tvañca kṣiti ādeḥ viśeṣa lakṣaṇa yoginaḥ vyakti bhedaḥ aneka tva saṃkhyā vā na ākāśa ādeḥ vyakti bhedaḥ na aneka tva saṃkhyā vā sambhavati iti tasmāt vyāvṛttiḥ iti aneka tvāt eva apara jātimat tvam apara jātiḥ dravya tva apekṣayā pṛthivī tva ādi rūpā sā vidyate yeṣām tāni tadvanti teṣām bhāvaḥ apara jātimat tvam apara jāti upalakṣitaḥ samavāyaḥ samavetā vā apara jātiḥ iti

evam kṣiti jala jyotiḥ anila manasām sādharmyam kriyāvat tvan ca mūrta tvañca paratvañca aparatvañca vegavat tvañca iti tathā uktāni tathā ca kriyā calana rūpā sā vidyate yeṣām tāni tadvanti teṣām bhāvaḥ kriyāvat tvam samavetā kriyā tad samavāyaḥ vā tathā mūrtiḥ avyāpi dravya parimāṇam sā vidyate yeṣām tāni mūrtāni teṣām bhāvaḥ mūrta tvam samavetā mūrtiḥ tad samavāyaḥ vā mūrta tvāt eva ca paratva aparatva ādi sadbhāvaḥ kriyāvat tvañca iti parāparāṇām bhāvaḥ paratva aparatve yat sadbhāve kṣiti ādiṣu parāpara vyavahāraḥ iti samavetau paratva aparatva guṇau tad samavāyaḥ vā vegaḥ vidyate yeṣām tāni vegavanti teṣām bhāvaḥ vegavat tvam samavetaḥ vega guṇaḥ tad samavāyaḥ vā etāni ca kṣiti ādiṣu eva iti niyamyante na tu sarvadā teṣu bhavanti iti

evam ākāśa kāla diś ātmanām sarva gata tva ādi sādharmyam sarva śabdaḥ ca anantara ukta mūrteṣu eva vartate sarveṣu gatāḥ sarva gatāḥ sarva prāptāḥ teṣām bhāvaḥ sarva gata tvam sarva mūrtaiḥ saṃyogaḥ sa ca anyatara karma jaḥ saṃyoga jaḥ vā sa tu ubhaya niṣṭhatva aviśeṣe api ākāśa ādeḥ eva sādharmyam tasya hi sarva mūrtaiḥ saha saṃyogaḥ na mūrtānām anyatamasya iti

tathā parama mahatām bhāvaḥ parama mahat tvam niratiśaya parimāṇam tad samavāyaḥ vā tathā sarva saṃyogi samāna deśa tvam sarvāṇi ca tāni saṃyogīni ca mūrta dravyāṇi taiḥ samānāḥ saṃyogāḥ teṣām ākāśa ādayaḥ deśāḥ ādhārāḥ teṣām bhāvaḥ sarva saṃyogi samāna deśa tvam sarva saṃyogi saṃyoga ādhāra tvam na ca saṃyogasya ubhaya niṣṭhatvāt mūrtānām api eṣa dharmaḥ iti vācyam yathā hi ekam ākāśam sarva mūrta saṃyoga ādhāraḥ na evam ekam mūrtam iti arthāt viśeṣaḥ labhyate na ca sarva gata tvena aviśeṣaḥ sarva gata tvam hi sarva saṃyogaḥ tad upalakṣitaḥ vā samavāyaḥ sarva saṃyogi saṃyoga ādhāra tvam iti

yat vā sarve ca te saṃyogaḥ vidyate yeṣām te saṃyoginaḥ te ca sarva saṃyoginaḥ ghaṭa ādayaḥ śarāva ādayaḥ ca teṣām samānāḥ saṃyogāḥ iti śeṣam pūrvavat anye tu upacāreṇa eva vyutpattyā vā saṃyogi śabdena saṃyogaḥ eva ucyate iti manyante saṃyujyante iti saṃyogāḥ te vidyante yeṣām te saṃyoginaḥ saṃyogāḥ eva sthānāt upacāraḥ vā iti sarva saṃyoginā antu samānāḥ ca te deśāḥ ca iti ekatve satya ādhāraḥ iti atra ca eka tve satī iti viśeṣaṇam śabda vṛttyā labhyate iti sāmarthya aśravaṇam apāstam bhavati tat ca asat indriya sāmānya lakṣaṇe viśeṣa guṇa lakṣaṇa ādau ca tasya eva samāśrayaṇāt iha prayāsa mātram eva iti

tathā pṛthivī ādīnām sādharmyam āha pṛthivī ādīnām pṛthivī ādiḥ yeṣām tāni pṛthivī ādīni teṣām na jñāyate kiyatām atas pañcānām api sādharmyam bhūta tvañcaḥ indriya prakṛti tvañca bāhya ekaika indriya grāhya viśeṣa guṇavat tvañca iti tathā uktāni bhūtānām bhāvaḥ bhūta tvam tat ca sāmānyam eva tathā hi dravya guṇa karmaṇi nimitte ca abādhyamānam anugata jñānam sāmānyāt bhavat dṛṣṭam yathā gauḥ ityādi jñānam asti ca bhūtam tam ityādi kṣiti ādiṣu jñānam atas samā anyāt bhavati iti na ca asya sāmānya ādau anumata jñānasya iva kiñcid bādhakam asti tathā ca sāmānye sāmānya kalpanāyām anavasthā syāt iti sāmānyam dravya tvam sāmānyam guṇa tvam iti jñānam sāmānyam vinā bhavati iti uktam na ca tat bhūtam bhūtam iti jñāne bādhakam asti

atha nārikela dvīpa vāsinām kasmāt eka ākāra tā pratibhāsaḥ na bhavati iti vyañjaka anupalabdheḥ yathā hi guṇa tva ādi sāmānyam nārikela dvīpa vāsinām vyañjaka anupalambhāt vidyamānam api na upalabhyate tathā bhūta tvam api iti kim asya tarhi vyañjakam iti brāhmaṇa tvasya iva upadeśaḥ yathā hi brāhmaṇa tvam upadeśāt vijñāyate tadvat bhūta tvam api iti

atha upadeśaḥ eva astu alam sāmānya kalpanayā yathā anyaiḥ uktam bhūta tvam bhūta śabdasya vācya tvam iti abhidhāna abhidheya niyama niyoga pratipattiḥ sā ca śabdāt vṛddha vyavahārāt vā anvaya vyatirekābhyām bhavati iti etat ca asat abādhyamāna anugata jñānasya nimitta antara kalpanāyām dravya tva ādeḥ api asattvam syāt asti ca kṛta samayasya bhūtam bhūtam iti jñānam brāhmaṇaḥ brāhmaṇaḥ iti vat dravyam dravyam iti jñāna vat ca tatas asti bhūta tvam sāmānyam iti

atha yathā dravyeṣu asādhāraṇaḥ samavāyi kāraṇa tva ādiḥ vyāpakaḥ dharmaḥ kṛta samayasya dravya tva abhivyañjakaḥ asti na evam bhūteṣu iti ced na indriya prakṛti tva ādeḥ asādhāraṇa tvāt atha tad upalambhe api akṛta samayasya na anugatam jñānam iti ced dravya tva ādiṣu api samānam tatra api samavāyi kāraṇa tva ādeḥ upalambhe api akṛta samayasya dravyam dravyam iti jñānam na dṛṣṭam iti

atha kṛta samayasya utpatteḥ asti dravyat tva ādi sāmānyam tat ca bhūta tve api samānam iti alam tathā indriya prakṛtīnām bhāvaḥ indriya prakṛti tvam ghrāṇa rasana cakṣuḥ tvac śrotra kāraṇa tvam yathāsaṃkhyam tat ca vakṣyāmaḥ pṛthivī adhikāre bhūyas tvāt gandhavat tvāt ityādi sūtraiḥ iti śrotre tu karṇa śaṣkulī ākāśa saṃyoga upalakṣitasya ākāśasya kārya tvāt tad apekṣayā ākāśasya kāraṇa tvāt svabhāva arthaḥ vā prakṛti śabdaḥ iti

nanu āhaṅkārika tvāt indriyāṇām ayuktam etat tathā ca prakāśaka tvam sattva dharmaḥ iti sāttvikāt ahaṅkārāt indriyāṇām udayaḥ kim atra pramāṇam iti ced aprāpya kāri tvam tat ca śākhā candramasoḥ yugapad grahaṇāt vijñātam anyathā hi śākhā sambandha uttara kālam cireṇa candramasā ca sambandhāt yugapad grahaṇam na syāt asti ca atas aprāpya kāri tvam tat ca bhautikeṣu na sambhavati pradīpa ādiṣu adarśana āditya bhautika tvam anyeṣām api pratipattavyam cakṣuḥ dṛṣṭānta balāt eva

tathā mahat aṇu prakāśaka tvāt ca yat hi yāvat parimāṇam tāvat eva kriyām kurvat dṛṣṭam iti tathā hi alpa parimāṇam vā asya ādi mahāntam vaṭa vṛkṣam vyāpya cchidām na karoti iti dṛṣṭam kim tarhi sva vyāpta pradeśaḥ eva iti cakṣuḥ api alpa parimāṇa tvāt na parvata ādi paricchedakam syāt tat tu dṛṣṭam atas na bhautikam iti

tathā niyata viṣaya tvāt ca yadi hi cakṣuḥ taijasam syāt rūpasya eva tad guṇa tvāt grāhakam na dravya sāmānya ādeḥ iti evam śeṣeṣu api niyamena sva guṇa grāhaka tva prasaṅgaḥ na ca etat dṛṣṭam atas na bhautikam iti itas ca na bhautikāni indriyāṇi indriya tvāt yat yat indriyam tat tat abhautikam dṛṣṭam yathā manaḥ tathā ca indriyāṇi tasmāt na bhautikāni iti

yat tāvat aprāpya kāri tvāt iti sādhanam tat asiddham vyavahita artha anupalabdhyā prāpteḥ upalambhāt anyathā hi vyavahitasya agrahaṇam antike ca grahaṇam na syāt aprāpteḥ ubhayatra aviśeṣāt āvaraṇa anupapattiḥ ca prāpti pratiṣedhaka tvāt tathā ca prāpti pratiṣedham kurvat āvaraṇam agrahaṇāya kalpyate dṛṣṭañca āvaraṇa sāmarthyam dūre vā prakāśaka tvam atas pradīpasya iva prāpta artha paricchedaka tvam tathā ca cakṣuḥ prāpta artha paricchedakam vyavahita aprakāśaka tvāt yat yat vyavahita aprakāśakam tat tat prāptau artha paricchedakam yathā pradīpaḥ tathā vyavahita aprakāśakam cakṣuḥ tasmāt prāpta artha paricchedakam iti

prāpti sadbhāve pramāṇa upapatteḥ śākhā candramasoḥ kāla bhedena grahaṇa sadbhāve api āśu bhāvāt utpala patra śata vyatibheda abhimāna vat yugapad grahaṇa abhimānaḥ yat ca mahat anuprakāśaka tvam tat api anyathā siddha tvāt asādhanam tathā hi cakṣuḥ bahis gatam bāhya āloka sambandhāt viṣaya parimāṇam utpadyate iti mahat ādi artha prakāśakam nābhautika tvāt iti

yat ca uktam taijasa tvāt rūpasya eva prakāśakam syāt iti etat asat pradīpe darśanāt na hi pradīpaḥ taijasa tvāt rūpasya eva prakāśakaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ kim tarhi rūpa dravya sāmānya ādeḥ iti etāvān eva viśeṣaḥ cakṣuṣaḥ atas taijasa tvam na virudhyate iti rūpa ādiṣu madhye niyamena rūpasya eva prakāśaka tvam taijasa tve anumānam iti vakṣyāmaḥ niyamena gandha ādi prakāśaka tvañca pārthiva tva ādiṣu ghrāṇa ādeḥ iti na ca eka prakṛtika tve viṣaya vyavasthā upalabdha iti nānā prakṛtika tvam tathā hi ekasmāt kāraṇāt upajātāḥ pradīpa bhedāḥ samāna viṣayāḥ iti upalabdham tadvat indriyeṣu api samāna viṣaya tvam syāt dṛṣṭā tu ghrāṇa ādeḥ gandha ādiṣu vyavasthā iti nānā prakṛtika tvam

tathā nānā jāti upādānāni indriyāṇi dravya tve sati pratiniyata viṣaya tvāt yat yat dravya tve sati pratiniyata viṣayam tat tat nānā jāti upādānam dṛṣṭam yathā vyaṃjana anila pradīpa kastūrikā ādīni iti tathā ca etāni dravya tve sati pratiniyata viṣayāṇi tasmāt nānā jāti upādānāni iti tathā hi jñāna śabdeṣu eka jāti upādāna tvam pratiniyata viṣaya tvañca iti vyabhicāraḥ tad artham dravya tve sati iti viśeṣaṇam na ca asya pakṣa dharma tva ādimataḥ aprāmāṇyam ati prasaṅgāt

yat ca abhautika tve anumānam indriya tvāt iti tatra bhūtāt anivṛttam abhautikam tat pratiṣedhe ca kāraṇa antara prabhava tvam viśeṣa pratiṣedhasya śeṣa abhyanujñā viṣaya tvāt iti sādhya vikalaḥ dṛṣṭāntaḥ tathā ca manasi na bhautika tvam na api abhautika tvam iti atha bhūtāt utpatti pratiṣedhena nitya tvam atra api abhyupagama vyāghātaḥ manasi api nitya tva abhyupagamāt indriya tvañca ukta viśeṣaṇasya aparokṣa jñāna janaka tvena bhūtāt utpatti pratiṣedhena iti anyathā siddham

nirmūlañcaḥ indriyāṇām ahaṅkāra prabhava tvam tad sadbhāve pramāṇa asambhavāt tathā hi pradhāna sadbhāve sati eṣā prakriyā tasya ca asattvam vakṣyamāṇam iti yeṣāñca āsaṃsāra maṇḍala vyāpīni indriyāṇi teṣām aśeṣa viṣaya grahaṇa prasaṅgaḥ atha adṛṣṭa vaśāt niyata deśe vṛtti vyajyate iti ced atra pravṛttīnām tādātmye na kiñcid uktam syāt vyatireke tu tat eva indriyam iti saṃjñā bheda mātram eva atha niyata viṣaya avabodhāni atha anupapattyā tad ākāra tayā eva indriyasya pariṇāmaḥ niścīyate tat na anyathā api upalambhāt tathā hi niyata artha sannikarṣe api upalambhaḥ ghaṭataḥ eva na ca vyāpi tvam parasya abhīpsitataram iti na iha pratanyate pariṇāma pakṣaḥ ca na sambhavati iti vakṣyāmaḥ iti alam

tathā bāhyena ekaika indriyeṇa gṛhyante iti bāhya ekaika indriya grāhyāḥ te ca te viśeṣa guṇāḥ ca iti te vidyante yeṣām tāni tadvanti teṣām bhāvaḥ bāhya ekaika indriya grāhya viśeṣa guṇavat tvam samavetāḥ hi yathā uktāḥ guṇāḥ tad upalakṣitaḥ vā samavāyaḥ guṇavat tvam sarveṣu asti iti viśeṣa grahaṇam viśeṣa guṇavat tvam sva ātmani asti iti bāhya indriya grāhya grahaṇam indriya grāhyāḥ ca saṃkhyā ādayaḥ api bhavanti na ca viśeṣa guṇāḥ tathā hi ekaika grahaṇam anarthakam bāhya indriya grāhya viśeṣa guṇavat tvasya anyatra abhāvāt satyam tathā api dvitīyam sādharmyam iti adoṣaḥ tathā hi saṃkhyā ādeḥ dvi indriya grāhya tvāt eka indriya grāhya grahaṇam eka indriya grāhya tvañca rūpa ādiṣu asambhavi syāt na hi ekam indriyam sarveṣām prakāśakam iti ekaika grahaṇam tathā api antaḥkaraṇasya bāhya indriya ādi adhiṣṭhāna dvāreṇa vyāpārā sambhavi tvam eva iti bāhya grahaṇam evañca bāhya ekaika indriya grāhya guṇavat tvam viśeṣa pada tyāgena dvitīyam sādharmyam iti

tathā caturṇām dravya ārambhaka tvam sparśavat tvañca iti dravya ārambhaka tva sparśavat tve tat na jñāyate keṣām iti viśeṣa anabhidhānāt pṛthivī ādīnām iti anuvartanīyam anantara tvāt iti kim punar dravya ārambhakāṇām bhāvaḥ dravya ārambhaka tvam dravya utpattau samavāyi kāraṇa tvam kārya dravyasya samavāyaḥ tena hi satā dravyam dravya utpattau samavāyi kāraṇam iti vyavahārāt tathā hi dravya ārambhakāṇām bhāvaḥ dravya ārambhaka tvam yena satā dravyam utpādayanti iti na vivakṣitam kim tarhi yena satā dravyam ārabhante iti dravya utpattau samavāyi kāraṇāni iti vyavahāraḥ sa ca dravya samavāyena satā bhavati iti dravya ārambhaka tvam dravya samavāyaḥ eva

atha yena satā sva samaveta dravya ārabhante iti vivakṣā tat yadi sparśavatām eva dravya ārambhaka tva darśanāt sparśaḥ eva tathā api sparśavat tvena gata artha tvāt vyartham syāt dravya ārambhaka tvam atra eke sahakāri viśeṣa upacita sparśe dravya ārambhaka tvam sparśavatām bhāvaḥ sparśavat tvam sparśa upalakṣitaḥ samavāyaḥ iti parihāram bruvate

tathā pṛthivī ādīnām trayāṇām sādharmyam āha pratyakṣatvañca rūpavat tvañca drava tva vat tvañca iti tathā uktānām pratyakṣāṇām bhāvaḥ pratyakṣa tvam aparokṣa jñāna viṣaya tvam tena satā pratyakṣāṇi iti vyavahārāt mahat tva ādi kāraṇa yogaḥ vā ātma ādeḥ tu pratyakṣatāyām sādharmya mātram apratyakṣa tve ca vyāvṛttam iti

anye tu artha tayā bhāvāt dvi indriya vivakṣayā pratyakṣa tvam atra vivakṣitam tat ca ātma ādiṣu na asti iti vyāvṛttam sādharmyam iti manyante nirvikalpaka sa vikalpaka jñāna viṣaya tvañca na vyāvṛttam ātmani api bhāvāt tathā ca aham iti śabdaḥ pṛthivī ādi śabda vyatirekāt ātmani vartate iti upalabdha samayasya tad smaraṇād bhavati eva sa vikalpaka jñānam iti

tathā rūpam vidyate yeṣām tāni rūpavanti teṣām bhāvaḥ rūpavat tvam rūpa samavāyaḥ samavetam vā rūpam iti tat ca avivakṣita viśeṣam anyathā hi kṣiti ādi vyāvṛtta rūpa adhikaraṇam eva iti tathā dravāṇām bhāvaḥ drava tvam samavetaḥ drava tva guṇaḥ tad samavāyaḥ vā atra api na viśeṣa vivakṣā anyathā kṣiti tejasoḥ naimittikam apāñca sāṃsiddhikam iti viśeṣaḥ eva syāt

evam dvayoḥ pṛthivī udakayoḥ guru tvam rasavat tvañca sādharmyam tathā hi guroḥ bhāvaḥ guru tvam samavetaḥ guru tva guṇaḥ tad samavāyaḥ vā tathā rasaḥ vidyate yayoḥ te rasavatī tayoḥ bhāvaḥ rasavat tvam rasa upalakṣitaḥ samavāyaḥ samavetaḥ vā rasaḥ

evam bhūtāni ca ātmānaḥ ca iti tathā uktāḥ teṣām vaiśeṣika guṇavat tvam sādharmyam viśeṣāḥ eva vaiśeṣikāḥ te vidyante yeṣām guṇānām te vaiśeṣika guṇavantaḥ teṣām bhāvaḥ tattvam tad upalakṣitaḥ samavāyaḥ te vā samavetāḥ

evam kṣitiḥ ca uda kañca ātmānaḥ ca iti tathā uktāḥ teṣām sādharmyam caturdaśa guṇavat tvam tathā hi caturdaśa guṇāḥ vidyante yeṣām te tadvantaḥ teṣām bhāvaḥ tattvam samavetāḥ te tad samavāyaḥ vā atra ca anya guṇānām anyatra āvṛtteḥ saṃkhyā mātram sādharmyam vivakṣitam iti jñeyam

ākāśaḥ ca ātmānaḥ ca iti tathā uktāḥ teṣām sādharmyam kṣaṇika eka deśa vṛtti viśeṣa guṇavat tvam kṣaṇikāḥ ca te eka deśa vṛttayaḥ ca iti tathā uktāḥ te ca te viśeṣa guṇāḥ ca iti te vidyante yeṣām te tat vantaḥ teṣām bhāvaḥ tattvam tad samavāyaḥ te vā samavetāḥ guṇavat tvam sarveṣu asti iti viśeṣa grahaṇam tat kṣiti ādiṣu api samānam iti eka deśa vṛtti padam

tathā api kṣaṇika grahaṇam anarthakam eka deśa vṛtti viśeṣa guṇavat tvasya anyatra abhāvāt tat na dvitīya sādharmyasya vivakṣita tvāt tathā hi viśeṣa guṇavat tvam anyatra api asti iti kṣaṇika grahaṇam kṣaṇika tvañca āśraye vidyamāne sati āśutara vināśi tvam kṣaṇika guṇavat tvan ca vibhāga apekṣayā anyatra api asti iti viśeṣa grahaṇam kṣaṇika viśeṣa guṇavat tvañca anyatra abhāvāt vyāvṛttam sādharmyam iti

tathā diś kālayoḥ pañca guṇavat tvam viśeṣāt sādharmyam pañcaguṇāḥ vidyante yayoḥ tau pañca guṇavantau tayoḥ bhāvaḥ pañca guṇavat tvam pañca guṇa upalakṣitaḥ samavāyaḥ te vā samavetāḥ etat ca saṃkhyā mātra sāmyena sādharmyam tathā ca sarve ca te utpattiḥ vidyate yeṣām te utpattimantaḥ ca iti tathā uktāḥ teṣām utpattau nimitta kāraṇa tvam iti nimitta padasya kāraṇa paryāyasya api abhidhānam samavāyi asamavāyi vyavaccheda artham anyathā hi samavāyi asamavāyi sādhāraṇa tvāt tad apekṣayā asambhavi tvam eva syāt

tathā hi nimitta kāraṇasya bhāvaḥ nimitta kāraṇa tvam yena satā nimitta kāraṇam iti vyavahāraḥ sa ca kāraṇayoḥ satoḥ samavāyi asamavāyi lakṣaṇa abhāvaḥ tena satā tathā vyavahārāt yadi api sva gata saṃkhyā ādi utpattau asti samavāyikāraṇa tvam tathā api sarveṣām eva iti viśeṣaṇāt adoṣaḥ evam kṣitiḥ ca tejaḥ ca iti kṣiti tejasī tayoḥ naimittika drava tva yogaḥ sādharmyam nimittāt upajātam naimittikam iti nimitta śabdaḥ sāmānya śabdaḥ api arthāt agni saṃyoge vartate naimitti kañca tat drava t vañca iti etena yogaḥ samavāyaḥ sādharmyam iti idānīm upasaṃhāra vyājena śiṣyam śikṣayati yat etat vyākhyātam mayā sādharmyam tat eva sarvatra viparyayāt vyāvṛttam bheda antarāt vaidharmyam vācyam iti yat vā sādharmyam vyākhyātam iti upasaṃhāraḥ viparyayāt vaidharmyam vakṣyamāṇam iti anāgata artha sūcanam iti

pṛthivī ādīnām navānām punar pañcānām ityādi rūpeṇa sādharmyam abhidhāya pratyekam teṣām vaidharmyam āha iha ityādinā iha iti kṣiti ādi manaḥ paryanteṣu prakaraṇeṣu idānīm sāmpratam ekaikaśas vaidharmyam ucyate iti nanu eka ekaśas iti vīpsāyām śaspratyayasya vidhānāt vyartham vīpsā abhidhānam

ekaikaśas vinighnanti viṣayāḥ viṣa sannibhāḥ iti vyāsa prayogāt adoṣaḥ iti eke pratyekam kṣiti ādeḥ vīpsāyām vaidharmya lābhe punar vīpsā karaṇam avāntara bhedena śarīra ādīnām vaidharmya jñāpana artham iti guravaḥ vadanti vaidharmyantu viśiṣṭaḥ itarasmāt vyāvṛttaḥ dharmaḥ yasya asau vidharmā tasya bhāvaḥ vaidharmyam asādhāraṇaḥ tattva vyavasthāpakaḥ dharmaḥ kevala vyatireki anumānam iti yāvat

tatra ādau uddiṣṭa tvāt pṛthivyāḥ tat ucyate pṛthivī tva abhisambandhāt iti pṛthivī iti lakṣya nirdeśaḥ pṛthivī tva abhisambandhāt iti lakṣaṇam asādhāraṇaḥ dharmaḥ pṛthivī tvena abhisambandhaḥ pṛthivī tvena upalakṣitaḥ samavāyaḥ iti pṛthivī dharmiṇī itarebhyaḥ bhidyate iti sādhyaḥ dharmaḥ pṛthivī tva abhisambandhāt yaḥ tu itarasmāt na bhidyate na ca asau pṛthivī tvena sambaddhaḥ yathā udaka ādi na ca tathā pṛthivī tvena nābhisambaddhā pṛthivī tasmāt itarebhyaḥ bhidyate iti samavāyaḥ hi ati vyāpaka tvāt alakṣaṇaḥ syāt iti pṛthivī tvam viśeṣaṇam

nanu evam pṛthivī tvam eva asādhāraṇa tvāt vyavaccheda samartham iti asamartha viśeṣaṇatā hetoḥ doṣaḥ na pakṣe asambhavi tvā śaṅkā parihāra artha tvāt tathā hi pṛthivī tvāt pṛthivī iti ukte pakṣe asti na asti iti āśaṅkā na nivarteta atas samartham abhisambandha padam nanu bhāva pratyayāt eva sambandha adhigateḥ ṣaṣṭhyā vā pṛthivyāḥ bhāvaḥ pṛthivī tvam iti sva śabdena tasya abhidhānam vyartham tat na bhāva pratyayaḥ śabda vṛttyā bhāvam abhidhatte nābhi sambandham na ca gamyām vṛttim āśritya sambandha padasya vaiyarthyam śāstre tathā abhāve ati prasaṅgāt ṣaṣṭhī ca aniyata sambandha abhidhāyikā iti viśiṣṭa sambandha lābhāya abhisambandha padam

nanu ca evam upādhi bhedāt avāstavaḥ bhedaḥ samavāyasya iti avārakam lakṣaṇam katham itarebhyaḥ bheda jñāpakam iti syāt na kalpita bhedasya api artha kriyā karaṇāt yathā śrotrasya tathā hi śrotram karṇa śaṣkulī ākāśa saṃyoga upalakṣitaḥ nabhaḥ deśaḥ sa ca āvāstava bhedaḥ api śabda upalabdhi lakṣaṇām artha kriyām vidadhāti tadvat samavāye api adoṣaḥ samavetam vā pṛthivī tvam lakṣaṇam pṛthivī tvañca tat abhisambadhyate iti abhisambandhaḥ ca iti karma dhāraya parigrahāt

nanu ubhaya pada vyabhicāra abhāvāt viśeṣaṇa samāsaḥ katham tathā sati abhisambadhyate iti abhisambandhaḥ samavetam rūpa ādi dṛṣṭam iti arthavat pṛthivī tvam pṛthivī tvañca iti ukte na asamavetam pṛthivī tvam sambhavati iti vyabhicāra abhāvaḥ atha apṛthivī vyāvṛtti rūpam pṛthivī tvam asamavetam tad nirāsāya arthavat abhisambandha padam na tasya asiddha tvāt pramāṇena hi prasiddhasya viśeṣaṇena vyudāsaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ yathā nīlena ānīla ādeḥ na vai apohaḥ siddhaḥ vṛtti vikalpa anupapatteḥ bādhakasya apramāṇa tayā vāstava sāmānya sadbhāvāt eka pada avyabhicāre api karma dhāraya samāsa abhyupagamāda doṣaḥ iti

kecid abhigrahaṇam abhi samantāt sambandhaḥ iti pakṣe vyāpti artham ābhimukhyena ca sambandhaḥ iti kevala vyatireka avyabhicāreṇa gamaka tva pradarśana artham nanu kim itarasmāt vyāvṛttā pramāṇa siddhā pṛthivī pakṣīkriyate atha aprasiddhā iti yadi aprasiddhā pakṣīkaraṇam ayuktam atha pramāṇa prasiddhā vyāvṛtta tayā tarhi lakṣaṇa vaiyarthyam atha avyāvṛtta tayā upalabdhā tat asat vyāvṛttam hi padārthānām svarūpam tena ca vapuṣā gṛhyamāṇāḥ dharmiṇaḥ na rūpa antareṇa iti dṛṣṭam na etat evam loka prasiddhi vaśena pṛthivyāḥ pakṣīkaraṇāt tathā hi yatra janānām pṛthivī iti vyavahāraḥ sā pakṣīkṛta iti abādhaḥ

nanu itaretara āśraya tvam pṛthivī itarebhyaḥ bhidyate iti atra itarebhyaḥ bhedaḥ sādhyaḥ teṣān tu pṛthivī itas bhedena pratipattau avadhibhāvaḥ ghaṭataḥ iti eka apratipattau itara apratipatteḥ ubhaya abhāva prasaṅgaḥ tat na asādhāraṇa dharma upalambha sahakāriṇa indriyeṇa vyāvṛtta rūpa tayā nirvikalpaka jñāne pṛthivī pratibhāsate tathā ap ādayaḥ api asādhāraṇa dharma upalambha vyāvṛttyā naḥ parasparam cakṣuḥ vyāpārāt eva prathante svayam pratipanne api bhede para pratipādanāya anumāna upanyāsaḥ tathā hi vipratipadyamānaḥ paraḥ para artha anumānena eva pratipādyate iti

atha itarebhyaḥ bhede sādhye abādayaḥ api itarebhyaḥ bhidyante iti vidyamāne sa pakṣe katham kevala vyatireka avyabhicāraḥ na sādhya aparijñānāt tathā hi pṛthivī itarebhyaḥ bhidyate iti pṛthivī itarebhyaḥ niravaśeṣebhyaḥ bhidyate iti sādhya arthaḥ tathā ca sa pakṣa abhāvaḥ na hi udaka ādayaḥ sva ātmabhyaḥ bhedinaḥ iti atha pṛthivī tvam yadi asā dhāraṇa dharmāt bhidyate tatas api anyasmāt bhidyate iti anavasthā abhede tu sādhya sādhana bhāva anupapattiḥ atas svatas bhidyate kṣiteḥ api tathā abhāvena bādhāt

atha pṛthivī tvam pṛthivyāḥ viśeṣyate pṛthivī ca pṛthivī tvena iti itaretara āśraya tvam na etat evam pṛthivyām anuvartamāna vapuṣaḥ bheda antarāt vyāvṛttasya indriya vyāpārāt nirvikalpaka jñāne pratibhāsanāt tathā hi anugata svabhāvasya apīta rasmāt vyāvṛttam svarūpam sāmānyasya tat ca pratyakṣeṇa svayam pratītam api para pratipādanāya hetu tvena abhidhīyate iti anavasthā ādi a bhāvaḥ na ca sarvathā vipratipadyamānaḥ pratipādyaḥ syāt iti dharmi jñānam sāmānyena sādhana jñānañca abhyupeyam kevalam itarebhyaḥ bhinnā pṛthivī na pratipadyate iti sādhana upanyāsaḥ

tathā ekam vākyam āvartyamānam bhūyāṃsam artham āha iti śabda artha nirūpaṇa paratvena abhisambadhyate pṛthivī tva abhisambandhāt iti vākyam tathā ca sāmānyam śabda arthaḥ tasya ekatayā saṅketa kāraṇāt iti jaiminīyāḥ viśeṣāḥ tu aniyata diś deśa sambandhi tayā na kārtsnyena upalabdhi bhājaḥ bhavanti iti katham saṅketa viṣayāḥ

atha yāvatām upalambhaḥ tāvatsu eva saṅketakaraṇāt vyavahāraḥ tarhi viśeṣa antare saṃketā sambhavāt vyavahāra anupapattiḥ na ca ayoginaḥ pratyekam aśeṣa viśeṣa upalambhaḥ na ca anupalabdheṣu idam asya vācyam idam asya vācakam iti abhidhāna abhidheya niyama niyoga pratipattiḥ samaya pratipattiñca vinā śabda śravaṇāt artha pratibhāsā bhāvaḥ atha abhinna nimittam upādāya viśeṣeṣu saṅketaḥ tat api asat abhinna nimitta sadbhāve api viśeṣāṇām ānantvam na ativartate iti sāmānye saṅketāt sāmānyam śabda arthaḥ

na ca sāmānyavati saṅketa upalambhena sāmānyam abhidhāya anantaram viśeṣeṣu vartiṣyate iti vācyam viramya vyāpāra abhyupagamena śabda karma buddhi ādīnām viramya vyāpāra asambhavāt iti sūtra virodhāt tathā ca viśeṣaṇa pratipattau eva kṣīṇa tvāt viśeṣya apratipādakam tat uktam viśeṣyam na abhidhā gacchet kṣīṇa śaktiḥ viśeṣaṇe atha sāmānya pratipatteḥ apuruṣa artha tvāt viśeṣa artha tayā pratipattuḥ pravṛtti nivṛttī na syātām iti tat na sāmānya pratipatti anyathā anupapattyā viśeṣa avabodhe sati pravṛtti nivṛttyoḥ bhāvāt tathā hi nirādhāram hi sāmānyam bhavet śaśa viṣāṇa vat iti ādhāra pratipattiḥ iti alam ati kalpitena

sarvam etat ayuktam abhinna nimitta upādāne sati sāmānyavati saṅketa kāraṇāt sāmānyavān śabda arthaḥ tat yathā ānantyena avasthitāḥ viśeṣāḥ tathā hi ekam teṣu abhinnam sāmānyam ekatra upalabdham tad upalambhāt anupalabhyamānāḥ api viśeṣāḥ sāmānyavantaḥ saṅketa viṣayāḥ śabdāḥ ca anitya tve api viśiṣṭa ānupūrvī sacivāḥ iti tathā hi yatra yatra īdṛśam sāmānyam paśyasi tatra tatra ayam śabdaḥ prayoktavyaḥ ittham bhūtāt ca śabdāt ayam arthaḥ pratipattavyaḥ iti saṅketa grahaḥ viśeṣāṇām ānantye api ghaṭataḥ iti tathā ca śabda śravaṇāt sāmānyavati arthe pratipattiḥ dṛṣṭā sā ca saṅketa pratipattim ākṣipati saṅketaḥ ca anena eva · prakāreṇa ghaṭate na anyathā iti

atha go śabda śravaṇāt śāvaleya ādi viśeṣa apratipatteḥ na viśeṣaḥ śabda arthaḥ satyam kim tarhi sāmānya yuktaḥ arthaḥ pratīyate na śāvaleya ādi viśeṣaḥ sa ca śāvaleya ādi śabdebhyaḥ eva pratīyate iti na ca etāvatā sāmānyam eva śabda arthaḥ pradhāna upasarjana bhāvena ubhayoḥ pratibhāsanāt tathā gāmānaya ityādi prayogeṣu sāmānyavataḥ arthasya ānayana ādi kṛtyā sambandhāt

atha sāmānyam abhidhāya katham viśeṣe vartate sūtra virodhāt na sūtra artha aparijñānāt tathā ca sūtrasya arthaḥ śabdaḥ hi ekadā viśeṣaṇam pratipādya punar viśeṣaṇam na pratipādayati iti viramya vyāpāraḥ niṣiddhaḥ na punar viśeṣaṇam pratipādya viśeṣyam na abhidhattaḥ iti tathā karma vibhāgam kṛtvā uttara saṃyogam karoti akṛta saṃyogasya vināśa abhāvāt na ca vibhāgam kṛtvā saṃyogam karoti iti viramya vyāpāra pratiṣedhaḥ tathā viśeṣaṇa buddhiḥ viśeṣya buddhim kṛtvā na kārya antaram ārabhate iti evam sukha ādiṣu api pratiṣedhaḥ

nanu uktam kṣīṇa śaktiḥ viśeṣaṇe iti viśeṣyam na abhidadhyāt iti tāvat śakteḥ kārya viṣaya tvāt kāryañca viśeṣaṇa pratipatti vat viśeṣya pratipatti lakṣaṇam upalabhyamānam śakteḥ vyavasthāpakam atha kāryasya eva abhāvam brūyāt sa ca evam bruvāṇaḥ sva saṃvedanam api bādhate viśeṣya pratipatteḥ saṃvedanāt bhinna jñāna ālambanayoḥ ca viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāva pakṣe codyam na eka jñāna ālambane iti samānañca etat upalabhyamānasya śabdasya artha pratipādaka tva abhyupagamāt sva ātma pratipattau ca kṣīṇa tvāt sāmānya pratipādaka tvam na syāt atha sāmānya pratipatteḥ dṛṣṭa tvāt na tatra śabda śakteḥ prakṣayaḥ tarhi viśeṣa pratipatteḥ api dṛṣṭa tvāt na śakti prakṣayaḥ artha pratipādana arthaḥ ca śabda prayogaḥ iti

yat ca uktam śabda sāmānya pratipatti anyathā anupapattyā viśeṣa adhyavasāye pravṛtti nivṛttī syātām iti tatra kim sāmānya mātra pratipatti anyathā anupapattyā viśeṣa avabodhaḥ tad viśeṣa pratipatti anyathā anupapattyā vā yadi sāmānya mātra pratipatti anyathā anupapattyā tathā sati sāmānya mātra pratipattau viśeṣa mātra pratipattiḥ iti pravṛtti abhāvaḥ atha viśiṣṭa sāmānya pratipatti anyathā anupapattyā sa tarhi viśeṣa pratipannaḥ viśeṣaṇam iti śabdāt eva pratīyate

atha pramāṇa antarāt iti yadi śabdāt katham sāmānyam eva śabda arthaḥ viśeṣasya api abhidhāyaka tvāt atha pramāṇa antaram na vā pramāṇa antara vyāpārān anubhavāt na ca sāmānyam para pakṣe viśeṣāt bhinnam sambhavati iti abhede sāmānya pratipatti vat viśeṣa pratipatti prasaṅgaḥ anyathā hi etad pratipattau itara pratipatteḥ bhedaḥ atha iṣyate eva kenacid rūpeṇa abhinnam bhinnañca iti na bheda abhedayoḥ vidhi pratiṣedha rūpa tvāt abhinne dharmiṇī asambhavaḥ tathā hi kim yena rūpeṇa bhinnam tena eva rūpeṇa abhinnam uta rūpa antareṇa iti vācyam yadi deśa bheda apekṣayā bhinnam rūpa bhedena tu abhinnam iti avipratipattiḥ paraḥ vibhinna deśa bheda apekṣayā bhedam pratipadyate iti

atha anugata vyāvṛtta ātma tayā pratibhāsāt vastu bodha ātmaka tvam tat asat anugata sāmānya sambandhāt anugatam svarūpeṇa tu vyāvṛttam iti iṣyate eva dvi rūpa tā na ca eka tve tādātmye sati dvi rūpa tā upapadyate iti samavāya lakṣaṇaḥ sambandhaḥ abhyupagantavyaḥ svarūpa bhedena tu bhede samavāyam vinā niyata viśeṣeṇa vyapadeśa anupapattiḥ pṛthivyāḥ pṛthivī tvam iti ādi sambandham vinā yāvat pṛthivyāḥ vyapadiśyate tad avasthā antareṇa kasmāt na iti niyama abhāvaḥ

yadi ca pṛthivī śabdaḥ pṛthivī tvam abhidadhyāt pṛthivī tva śabdasya arthaḥ vaktavyaḥ na ca abhede tad hita sāphalyam paśyāmaḥ iti sāmānyavān arthaḥ pṛthivī śabdasya iti yuktam atha ekatra saṅketitaḥ pṛthivī śabdaḥ katham artha antare pravartiṣyate iti āha pṛthivī tva abhisambandhāt nimittāt pṛthivī śabdaḥ ekatra saṅketitaḥ sa ca artha antare api tad vaśāt pravartate iti saṅketa anupapatteḥ viśeṣaḥ eva śabda arthaḥ na sambhavati iti sāṃkhya śākta pakṣaḥ api niṣiddhaḥ eva

tathā śaktayaḥ sarva bhāvānām kārya arthāpatti gocarāḥ iti tad nirāsaḥ yat pṛthivī tva abhisambandhāt pṛthivī kāryam karoti iti pṛthivī tvam eva nijā śaktiḥ anyā tu caramasahakāri rūpā tad sadbhāve kārya karaṇāt tad abhāve ca akaraṇāt iti tathā hi vidyamānāḥ api tantavaḥ kāryam na ārabhante antya tantu saṃyogam vinā iti sā eva śaktiḥ atha artha antaram artha antarasya katham śaktiḥ anartha antara tve api samānam etat sā eva tasya eva śaktiḥ iti atha yadi pūrveṣām caramasahakāryā iva śaktiḥ tasya api aśaktasya akāraṇa tvāt anyā śaktiḥ vācyā iti anavasthā na etat evam caramasya hi sahakāriṇaḥ pūrva sahakāriṇaḥ eva śaktiḥ itaretara abhisambandhena kārya karaṇāt saḥ eva ca samagrāṇām bhāvaḥ sāmagri iti bhāva pratyayena ucyate tena hi satā samagra vyapadeśa darśanāt

nanu yadi atīndriyā śaktiḥ na iṣyate maṇi mantra ādinā tarhi pratibaddhaḥ agniḥ na sphoṭa ādi kāryam ārabhataḥ iti kasya pratibandhaḥ na ca agneḥ na ca agni saṃyogasya upalabhyamāna tvāt iti śakteḥ pratibandhaḥ tat asat maṇi mantra ādi pratibandhaka abhāvasya api kārya utpattau sahakāri tvāt tad abhāve tu na kāryasya udayaḥ iti tad viśiṣṭa saṃyogaḥ eva śaktiḥ na punar śakteḥ pratibandhaḥ na anutpattiḥ vināśaḥ vā sambhavati iti cira utpanna tvāt vinaṣṭāyāḥ ca punar utpatti kāraṇa abhāvāt anutpatti prasaṅgaḥ aśaktasya kārya anutpādaka tvāt iti anvaya vyatirekābhyām pratibandhaka abhāva viśiṣṭaḥ agni saṃyogaḥ eva agni śaktiḥ iti jñātam evam atra api pṛthivī tvam nijā śaktiḥ aparā tu sahakāri bhūta iti

pṛthivī ādīnām navānām guṇavat tvam samavāyi kāraṇa tvam kṣiti udaka ātmanām caturdaśa guṇavat tvañca uktam tatra kaiḥ guṇaiḥ guṇavatī keṣām utpattau samavāyi kāraṇa tvam ke vā caturdaśa guṇāḥ kiñca guṇa ātmakam lakṣaṇam iti āha rūpa ādi vākyam rūpa ādayaḥ saṃskāra paryantam vidyante yasyāḥ sā rūpa ādi saṃskāravatī kim ete svatantra tayā vṛtti kṛtā pratipādyante uta sūtrakārasya abhipretāḥ iti āśaṅkya āha ete ca guṇa viniveśa adhikāre ityādi ete ca sūtra kāreṇa abhihitāḥ kasmin adhikāre guṇāḥ vividham aneka prakāreṇa viniveśyante yasmin adhikāre sa tathā uktaḥ dvitīyaḥ adhyāyaḥ tatra sūtrakāreṇa pratipāditāḥ

tathā ca rūpa rasa gandha sparśavatī pṛthivī iti anena viśeṣa guṇāḥ catvāraḥ abhihitāḥ tathā cākṣuṣa vacanāt iti saṃkhyāḥ parimāṇāni pṛthaktvam saṃyoga vibhāgau paratva aparatve karma ca rūpi dravya samavāyāt cākṣuṣāṇi iti sūtram darśayati sūtrasya arthaḥ rūpi dravyam upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāptam mahat tva ādi upetam tatra samavāyāt saṃkhyā ādayaḥ ca pratyakṣa grāhyāḥ iti anya pareṇa api sūtreṇa rūpavati dravye saṃkhyā ādīnām sadbhāvaḥ abhihitaḥ anyathā hi avidyamāna tva ādev tatra teṣām upalambhaḥ na syāt iti

padārthaḥ ca saṃkhyā iti bahuvacanam saṃkhyā tu a vyatirekeṇa eka tva tva ādi apara sāmānya pradarśana artham parimāṇāni iti tathā parimāṇa tva apekṣayā aṇu tva ādi apara sāmānya jñāpana artham pṛthaktvam iti eka vacanam pṛthaktva tva sāmānya apekṣayā eka pṛthaktva tva ādi apara sāmānya śūnyatā pradarśana artham saṃyoga vibhāgau iti dvivacanena saṃyoga tva vibhāga tva vyatirekeṇa apara sāmānya abhāve api vibhāgasya saṃyoga apekṣita ājñāpana artham samāsa karaṇam tathā paratva aparatve iti api dvivacanam paratva aparatvam sāmānya apekṣayā apara sāmānya abhāve api sāhacarya jñāpana artham samāsa karaṇam iti

tathā patana upadeśāt iti guru tvāt patamam iti sūtram darśayati yathā ca patane guru tvam kāraṇam tathā vakṣyāmaḥ guru tva parīkṣāyām adbhiḥ sāmānya vacanāt iti sarpiḥ jatu madhūcchiṣṭhānām pārthivānām agni saṃyogāt drava tvam adbhiḥ sāmānyam iti sūtram darśayati sarpiḥ ādīnām agni saṃyogāt drava tvam sampadyate adbhiḥ tathā sāmānyam yathā bhavati iti sūtra arthaḥ uttara karma vacanāt iti nodanāt ādyam iṣoḥ karma tad karma kāritāt ca saṃskārāt tathā uttaram uttarañcaḥ iti sūtram darśayati iṣoḥ śarasya ādyam karma nodanāt bhavati iti karma ca nodana apekṣam saṃskāram ārabhate karma kāritāt ca saṃskārāt tathā uttarañca ekaḥ saṃskāraḥ anekam karma ārabhate patanam yāvat iti iṣoḥ samavāyi kāraṇasya avagatāyām sambhavini āmiṣoḥ iti ṣaṣṭhī abhidhānam tad avayaveṣu api karma jñāpana artham yat vā ṣaṣṭhī arthasya vidyamāna tvāt tad abhidhāne api adoṣaḥ

rūpa ādayaḥ hi asādhāraṇa tvāt bhedakāḥ iti pratijñāta artha samarthana artham asādhāraṇa tvam āha kṣitau eva gandhaḥ ityādi atha udake tejasi vā upalambhāt gandhasya avadhāraṇam anupapannam na saṃyukta samavāyena upalambhāt tathā hi udake vāsaka dravya samparkāt gandha abhivyaktiḥ dṛṣṭā tejasi vai indhana viśeṣa anuvidhānāt iti yadi punar svabhāvataḥ eva syāt gandhaḥ tejasi indhana viśeṣam vinā vāsaka dravya samparkañca vinā vāriṇi upalabhyeta na ca evam atas yuktam etat kṣitau eka gandhaḥ iti

rūpam śukla ādi aneka prakāram kṣitau eva na udake na tejasi niyamena śuklam eva udake bhāsvarañca tejasi upalabhyate pṛthivī āntu aneka prakāram tathā hi paṭa ādi bheda bhinna tvāt pṛthivyāḥ kācid śuklā kācid harita iti upalambhaḥ nanu yuktam vyakti bheda apekṣayā aneka rūpa sambandhi tvam pṛthivyāḥ yā tu golaka rūpāḥ na tasyām aneka prakāram atha tatra api kecid bhāgāḥ śuklāḥ kecid kṛṣṇā ityādi upalambhāt aneka rūpa sambandhi tvam na avayava avayavinoḥ anya tvāt avayavānām aneka rūpa sambandhi tve katham avayavinaḥ tathā bhāvaḥ abhyupagame vā sūtra vyāghātaḥ avibhuni dravye samāna indriya grāhyāṇām viśeṣa guṇānām asambhavāt iti vyāhanyeta iti

vyāpake hi dravye samāna indriya grāhyāṇām bahūnām api sambhavaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ yathā śabdānām ākāśaḥ iti tad nirāsāya avibhu grahaṇam tathā avibhuni dravye vibhinna indriya grāhyāṇām rūpa rasa ādīnām sambhavāt iti samāna indriya grāhya padam samāna indriya grāhyāṇām api saṃkhyā ādīnām bahūnāma vibhuni dravye sambhavaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ tad vyavacchedāya viśeṣa grahaṇam

atas bahūnām rūpāṇām ekasyām pṛthivyām abhyupagame vyāghātaḥ abhyupagamya api brūmaḥ śukla ādīnām bahūnām ekatra sadbhāve kim āśraya vyāpi tvam pradeśa varti tvam vā āśraya vyāpi tve sati eka avayava sahite api avayavinī upalabdhe para avayava āvaraṇe api aneka rūpam gṛhyeta āśraya vyāpi tvāt eva atha pradeśa vṛtti tvam tathā api viśeṣaṇam āśraya vyāpi tvam iti nirudhyate

atha ekam citram tat rūpam iti yathā śuklam pītam ityādi viśeṣaḥ tathā citram rūpa viśeṣaḥ eva atra uktam citram tat ekam iti ced idam citrataram tatas yadi ekam tat katham citram citrañcet ekatā katham ekam citrañcā iti atiśayena āścaryam iti na paraspara viruddhānām rūpāṇām eka rūpa ārambhaka tvam nyāyyam samāna rūpa ārambhaka tvena upalambhāt śuklāt śuklam iti

atha pṛthivyām apsu ca śukla ādi viśeṣa rūpa mātram upalambhāni atha anupapattyā niścīyate anyathā hi nīrūpa tvāt cakṣuḥ grāhya tvam na syāt rūpavataḥ dravyasya cakṣuḥ grāhya tvāt iti na ca avayava rūpāt eva cakṣuḥ viṣaya tvam anya rūpeṇa anyasya cakṣuḥ viṣaya tve vāyoḥ api tathā abhāva prasaṅgāt atas cakṣuḥ viṣaya tvāt rūpa mātram kṣitau iti nanu evam aneka prakāram kṣiteḥ rūpam iti virudhyate rūpa mātrasya śukla ādi antar bhāva abhāvāt tathā hi aneka prakāram śukla ādi bheda bhinnam iti ucyate rūpa mātrañca viśeṣa rahitam iti virodhaḥ

tat etat sarvam avidita artham śukla ādi aneka prakārasya rūpasya kṣitau abhyupagamāt nanu uktam sūtra virodhaḥ iti na sūtra artha aparijñānāt tathā ca sūtrasya arthaḥ avibhuni avyāpake dravye samāna indriya grāhyāṇām viśeṣa guṇānām eka ākārāṇām asambhavaḥ iti pratiṣedhaḥ na tu aneka prakārāṇām katham etat aneka ākāra svarūpasya kṣitau upalambhāt tathā rasasya ṣaṣ bhedasya iti

artha eka ākārāṇām bahūnām rūpāṇām rasa anāñca ekatra sadbhāvaḥ tasmāt na iṣyate vaiyarthyāt tathā hi ekena eva śukla rūpeṇa rūpa pratyayasya janita tvāt dvitīyasya vaiyarthyam eva tathā madhura rasena madhura pratyayasya iti atha śukla ādīnām ekasya sadbhāve kim vyāpya vṛtti tvam uta avyāpya vṛtti tvam iti uktam tatra avyāpya vṛtti tve na virodhaḥ śeṣāṇām āśraya vyāpi tvam eva iti avadhāraṇa anabhyupagamāt atas eva eka avayava sahitasya paṭasya upalambhāt tad eka rūpa upalambhaḥ api āśraya vyāpitayā aneka rūpāṇām anupalambhāt citra pratibhāsā bhāvaḥ

atha kim citrāt utpadyate citram atha acitrāt iti citrāt utpatti abhyupagame paṭa kāraṇa kāraṇeṣu api citra pratibhāsa prasaṅgaḥ atha acitrāt utpadyate tadā hi eka rūpaḥ sarvatra citra rūpa utpatti prasaṅgaḥ na etat yuktam nānā rūpāṇi hi kāraṇāni nānā rūpam kāryam ārabhantaḥ iti upalabdham na ca evam tad kāraṇa kāraṇeṣu nānā rūpāṇi santi iti citra anutpādaḥ na ca tantūnām nīla ādi aneka rūpa sambandhi tvāt paṭe api aneka rūpa ārambhaka tve kiñcid bādhakam asti kāraṇa guṇa pūrva prakrameṇa tathāvidhasya rūpasya upādānāt tathā hi pratyekam kāraṇeṣu avicitrāt api rūpāt nīlāt nīlam pītāt pītam iti yuktam bhavatu ca eva ekam citram rūpam nīla ādi rūpaiḥ eka rūpa ārambhāt yathā hi śukla ādiḥ viśeṣaḥ rūpasya tathā citram rūpa ādi viśeṣaḥ eva yadi api śukla ādi śabdaiḥ na vyapadiśyate tathā api sva śabdena vyapadeśāt astitvam

atha viruddhānām nīla ādīnām katham eka rūpa ārambhaka tvam yathā śuklānām iti yathā hi bahūni śukla rūpāṇi ekam śukla rūpam ārabhante iti upalabdham tathā nīla ādīnām api citra rūpa ārambhaka tvam dṛṣṭa tvāt abhyupagantavyam atha citra śabdasya nānā paryāya tvāt ekam citrañcaḥ iti idam eva citram āścaryam iti tat asat yathā nānā rūpeṣu citra vyapadeśaḥ citrāḥ tantavaḥ nīla ādi rūpa sambandhinaḥ iti tathā tad ārabdhe api paṭe citra vyapadeśaḥ citraḥ paṭaḥ iti citram rūpam asya iti na ca avaśyam nānā rūpa sambandhiṣu api paṭa ādiṣu citra vyapadeśaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ nānā rūpaiḥ tu kāraṇaiḥ ārabdhe avaśyam bhavati iti

atha eka tvāt citra rūpasya eka avayava sahite api avayavinī upalabdhe śeṣa avayava āvaraṇe vicitra pratibhāsaḥ syāt na saha kārya bhāvāt tathā hi avayaveṣu nānā rūpa upalambha saha kāri indriyam avayavini citra pratibhāsam janayati iti anvaya vyatirekābhyām upalabdham tena śeṣa avayava āvaraṇe tad rūpāṇām agrahaṇāt avayavini citra pratibhāsā bhāvaḥ na ca apratibhāsāt ekāntena asattvam saha kārya bhāvena api anupalambhāt

yat ca rūpa mātram upalambhāni atha anupapattyā jñāyate iti kaiścid uktam tatra api na doṣaḥ vipratipadyamānasya anumāna upanyāsāt tathā hi śukla ādi viśeṣa vyatiriktam citram rūpam kṣitau vidyamānam api vaijātyāt yaḥ na manyate tam pratyanumānam kṣiteḥ upalambhāt rūpavat tvam vijñāyate iti cakṣuṣā upalambhāt ca siddhe rūpavat tve śukla ādi śabdaiḥ vyapadeśa asambhavāt citra śabdena abhidhīyate iti siddham

etena rasaḥ vyākhyātaḥ rasaḥ ṣaḍvidhaḥ madhura ādiḥ kṣitau eva vyakti bhedena ekasya añca vyaktau iti tathā ca ekasyām api harītakyām upalabhyate ṣaḍvidhaḥ rasaḥ iti atas eva ṣaṭ bhedasya anyatra anupalambhāt itarebhyaḥ bhedaka tvam tathā gandhaḥ dvividhaḥ surabhiḥ asurabhiḥ ca ekasyām pṛthivyām vyakti bhedena ekasyām ca iti pūrvavat atha surabhi gandhā bhāvaḥ eva asurabhiḥ iti vyavahāra sambhavāt gandhasya dvaividhyam anupapannam na ubhayoḥ tīvratara ādi bheda bhinna tvāt yathā hi surabhi gandhe tīvratara ādi vyavahāraḥ tathā asurabhi gandhe api iti surabhi gandha abhāve ca etat na upapannam abhāvasya niratiśaya tvāt iti

sparśaḥ asyāḥ pṛthivyāḥ anuṣṇa aśīta tve sati pākajaḥ anuṣṇaḥ iti uṣṇa sparśa vyavaccheda artham aśītaḥ iti śītāt pākajaḥ iti vāyavīyāt atha pāka jaḥ agni saṃyoga jaḥ iti ukte na vyabhicāraḥ asti iti kimartham anuṣṇa aśīta grahaṇam iti ced svarūpa kathana artham anye tu pākāt agneḥ uṣṇa sparśaḥ bhavati iti anuṣṇa grahaṇam aśīta grahaṇam eva tu svarūpa artham iti atha rūpa ādīnām iva vailakṣaṇya apratibhāsanāt na pākaja tvam sparśasya tat na pratyakṣeṇa vailakṣaṇya apratītau api anumānena pākaja tvaprasiddheḥ tathā ca pārthiva sparśaḥ pākajaḥ pārthiva viśeṣa guṇa tvāt tad gata rūpa ādi vat iti

nanu evam sāmānya guṇānām api pāka ja tvaprasaṅgaḥ pārthiva guṇa tvāt rūpavat iti na etat yuktam sāmānya guṇānām pakṣīkaraṇe agni saṃyogena eva anekāntaḥ tathā hi pārthiva paramāṇau agni saṃyogaḥ agni saṃyoga jaḥ na bhavati pārthiva guṇaḥ ca iti na ca evam pārthiva viśeṣa guṇa tvam vyabhicarati iti sa pakṣa eka deśe vartamānasya atyantam vipakṣāt vyāvṛtteḥ gamaka tvam eva na ca pakṣe pratyakṣa āgamābhyām virudhyate iti na kāla atyaya apadiṣṭaḥ na ca prakaraṇa samaḥ tattva anupalabdheḥ aprayojaka tvāt atas pākaja sparśa ādi kāraṇa tvāt itarebhyaḥ bhidyate pṛthivī iti

samānānām bhāvaḥ sāmānyam bheda adhiṣṭhānam atas bhedam āha sā tu dvividhāḥ iti sā tu pṛthivī dvividhā kena rūpeṇa iti āha nityā ca anityā ca nityā paramāṇu lakṣaṇā paramāṇu svabhāvā kārya lakṣaṇā kārya svabhāvā tu anityā iti bhedaḥ bhede ca sati sāmānya lakṣaṇam upapadyate iti asambha vitva āśaṅkā vyudāsaḥ sarvasya kāryasya vināśe samavāyikāraṇa abhāvāt punar utpattiḥ na syāt iti āśaṅkā nirāsa arthañca vākyam sā tu dvividhā nityā ca anityā ca anityāyāḥ ca nāśe nityā punar dvi aṇuka ādi prakrameṇa svarga ādau kāryam ārabhate iti siddham

katham punar paramāṇu svabhāvā pṛthivī jñāyate iti āśaṅkya āha kārya lakṣaṇā kāryeṇa lakṣyate jñāyate iti tathā hi kāryam samavāyi kāraṇa pūrvakam tad kāraṇam api anya samavāyi kāraṇa janyam iti yāvat ādyam kāryam tat api samavāyi kāraṇa janyam iti tad janakāḥ paramāṇavaḥ tathā kāryāt alpa parimāṇam samavāyi kāraṇam tasya api anyat alpa parimāṇam iti ādyam kāryam niratiśaya aṇu parimāṇaiḥ ārabdham iti jñāyate

atha tad avayavānām api paryavasānam na iṣyate nitya kāraṇa anabhyupagamāt tarhi kāryasya ākasmikasya asambhavāt tad kāraṇe api anyam samavāyi kāraṇam iti anavasthāyām kārya dravyasya alpatara ādi bhedaḥ na syāt tathā hi alpa kāraṇa ārabdham alpam bhūyas kāraṇa ārabdham mahat iti dṛṣṭam na ca kārya dravyasya nitya kāraṇa anabhyupagamena anavasthāyām etat upapadyate sarvasya api ananta kāraṇa janya tva aviśeṣāt iti yathā ananta kāraṇaiḥ ārabdhā golaka rūpā pṛthivī tathā ghaṭa ādi kāryam api iti eka ākāra tā prasaṅgaḥ na ca saṃkhyā pala parimāṇaiḥ eka ākāra tā upalabdhā ghaṭa ādeḥ bhinna parimāṇa tvāt bhinna pala tvāt ca iti tathā hi kiñcid hīnam pañca palam adhika tarañca daśa palam samāna kāraṇaiḥ ārabdham bahubhiḥ ca iti vaicitryam tat ca anavasthāyām na syāt

na ca nitya anabhyupagame pralaya avasthāyām sarvasya kārya dravyasya vināśe punar utpattiḥ bhavet abhāvasya samavāyi kāraṇa tva abhāvāt iti yathā ca pralaya avasthāyām sambhavati tathā ca vakṣyāmaḥ bhūta parīkṣāyām iti atas na anavasthā vyāvartanīyā paṭa ādi kāraṇa kāraṇānām alpatara ādi bhāvena avasthitānām ādi kāryam abhyupagantavyam

tad ādyam kāryam samavāyi kāraṇa janyam kāryatvāt yat yat kāryam tat tat samavāyi kāraṇa janyam yathā paṭa ādi tathā ca etat kāryam tasmāt samavāyi kāraṇa janyam iti na ca kārya tvam abhāvena vyabhicarati iti vācyam sva kāraṇa sattā sambandha rūpa tvāt kāryatvasya tathā ghaṭa ādi kāraṇa kāraṇeṣu alpatara ādi bhāvaḥ kvacid viśrāntaḥ taratama śabda vācya tvāt mahā parimāṇa vat yatra viśrāntāḥ te paramāṇavaḥ iti atha sa avayavāḥ paramāṇavaḥ mūrta tvāt ghaṭa vat ṣaṭkena yugapad sambadhyamāna tvāt tathā pūrva bhāgaḥ apara bhāgaḥ iti diś upalakṣitaiḥ deśaiḥ vyapadiśyamāna tvāt sa avayava kārya ārambhaka tvāt ca tantu ādi vat iti

sarvam etat āśraya asiddham paramāṇu sadbhāva asiddheḥ atha iṣyate eva paramāṇoḥ sadbhāvaḥ tarhi paramāṇu sadbhāva āvedaka pramāṇasya abhyupagamāt tad viparīta anumānam nirviṣaya tvāt apramāṇam iti abhedyāḥ paramāṇavaḥ pareṇa abhyupagamāt tasya aniṣṭa āpattiḥ kriyate iti prasaṅga sādhanam tatra yadi pramāṇena abhyupagatāḥ pareṇa paramāṇavaḥ tasya prāmāṇya abhyupagame anutthānam viparīta anumānasya atha apramāṇāt evam tarhi tasya apramāṇa tayā paramāṇu sadbhāvaḥ na sidhyati iti kim anumāna upanyāsena āśraya asiddha tā prasaṅgāt

tathā paramāṇavaḥ sa avayavāḥ ca iti pratijñā vākye padayoḥ virodhaḥ tathā hi paramāṇu śabdasya niratiśaya aṇu vāci tvam sāvayava tve vā avayava apekṣayā adhika parimāṇa tvam iti virodhaḥ na ca samāna adhika parimāṇa tve samavāyikāraṇa tvam iti tad avayavāḥ paramāṇavaḥ teṣām api sāvayava tve tad avayavāḥ teṣām api sāvayava tve tad avayavāḥ iti anavasthāyām uktam dūṣaṇam alpatara ādi bheda anupapattiḥ iti

atha mā bhūt anavasthā iti niravayavāḥ paramāṇavaḥ abhyupagamyante pramāṇataḥ tarhi tena bādhyamāna tvāt sāvayavatva anumānam apramāṇam iti atha niravayava tvāt aṇūnām ṣaṭkena yogaḥ diś deśa vyapadeśaḥ ca na syāt na anyathā api bhāvāt tathā hi saṃyogasya avyāpya vṛtti tayā pūrva uttara ādi diś vyavasthite yugapad sambandhe api na sāvayava tvam evam pūrva bhāgaḥ apara bhāgaḥ iti yadi asti vyapadeśaḥ saḥ api mukhye bādhaka upapatteḥ bhāktaḥ draṣṭavyaḥ avyāpya vṛtti saṃyoga ādhāra tva sāmānyāt iti

yat ca sāvayava ārambhaka tvam tat ca yadi saha avayavaiḥ ārambhaka tvam tat asiddham niravayava tvāt atha sāvayavasya sadā avayavaiḥ vartiṣyamāṇasya kāryasya janaka tvam tat asiddham paramāṇubhyām dvi aṇuka ārambhāt tathā hi paramāṇavaḥ dvi aṇukāni ārabhante na sva ātmānam nitya tvāt sva ātmani kriyā virodhāt ca iti tantu dṛṣṭāntaḥ api sādhana vikalaḥ te hi na avayava sahitāḥ kāryam ārabhante na api avayavā sahitāḥ iti sthitam kāryeṇa

lakṣyate nityā pṛthivī iti abheda vādi nirāsa arthañca sā dvividhā iti vākyam tathā hi pṛthivī pṛthivī antarāt bhidyamānā kim pṛthivī rūpa tayā bhidyate uta apṛthivī rūpatayā iti pṛthivī rūpa tayā pṛthivī antarāt bhede tasyāḥ pṛthivī tva prasaṅgaḥ atha apṛthivī rūpa tayā bhidyate yā tarhi bhidyate sā pṛthivī na syāt atha avāntara viśeṣa sambandhāt bhedaḥ te api yadi viśeṣa antarāt anavasthā atha antareṇa viśeṣam viśeṣāḥ bhidyante pṛthivyāḥ tathā abhāva prasaṅgaḥ iti uktam dvaita vādinā

bhedam āha sā ca dvividhā nityā anityā ca nityā pṛthivī nīrūpa tayā anityātas bhidyate anityā tu nityātas ca iti avāntara bhedāt eva bhedaḥ atha teṣām api viśeṣa antarāt bheda abhyupagame anavasthā iti uktam tat asat tatra api asādhāraṇa dharmasya asādhāraṇa dharmāt bheda abhyupagame api jāti guṇa kriyā ādi rūpa tayā ṣaṭsu eva antarbhāvāt anavasthāyām api adoṣaḥ vyāvṛtta svarūpam padārthānām nirvikalpaka jñāne pratibhāsate iti ukta uttaram etat

yat vā lakṣaṇena lakṣyamāṇasya eka aneka tva upalabdheḥ saṃśaye sati tad nirāsa artham vākyam sā tu dvividhāḥ iti na eka tvam ākāśasya iva iti vipratipatti nirāsa artham kārya lakṣaṇāyāḥ dharma antaram nirūpayati sā ca sthairya ādi ava yava sanniveśa viśiṣṭāḥ iti sthirāyāḥ bhāvaḥ sthairyam tad ādiḥ yeṣām mṛdu tva kaṭhina tva ādīnām te sthairya ādayaḥ te ca avayavānām sanniveśaḥ ca racanā viśeṣaḥ taiḥ viśiṣṭa iti

guru tva vidhārakasya asambhavāt sarvadā patanam kṣitau vidyamānam api pūrva para bhāgāt avadhāraṇāt na upalabhyate iti digvāsasām matam tat nirasyate sthairya padena sthairyam sthira tvam apātaḥ iti yāvat yadi punar pātaḥ syāt guru tva atiśayena pāta atiśaya upalabdheḥ kṣiteḥ atiśayena pātāt upari kṣiptasya loṣṭa ādeḥ bhūmi sambandhaḥ na syāt tathā hi loṣṭasya yāvat upari gamanam punar mandam āgamanam tāvat kṣiteḥ śīghra pātitayā yojana śata ādivya vadhānam syāt iti sambandha abhāvaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ tu sambandhaḥ iti jñāyate na patanam kṣiteḥ iti atas eva apatanāni atha anupapattyā jñāyate guru tva vidhārakam kiñcid asti iti anyathā hi guru tva vidhāraka abhāve pātaḥ avaśyam syāt iti sa tu na bhavati iti pratibandhaḥ anumīyate atra hi guruṇaḥ dravyasya pratibandhaka tve tasya api guru tva yogi tayā pātaḥ syāt iti vāyoḥ mahataḥ pratibandhaka tvam dṛṣṭam hi alpīyasaḥ api vāyoḥ upari parṇa ādi vyavasthāpane guru tva vidhāraka tvam pṛthivī pratibandhakaḥ tu ādi sṛṣṭau utpannaḥ atiśayena mahān vāyuḥ pṛthivīmudaka ādi sahitām tṛṇam iva dhārayate

tathā sthairyam pṛthivyāḥ akṣaṇika tvam iti kṣaṇika tva apākaraṇa arthañca sthairya grahaṇam yathā ca kṣaṇika tvam na sambhavati tathā vakṣyāmaḥ iti yetu niravaya vāma kāryāñca pṛthivīm manyante tad nirāsa artham avayava sanniveśa viśiṣṭa iti avayavāḥ hi bhāgāḥ te kṣitau upalabhyante tad sanniveśaḥ racanā viśeṣaḥ pratyakṣaḥ iti tathā avayava sanniveśa viśiṣṭa tvāt ca kāryatvam tathā hi pṛthivī kāryā avayava sanniveśa viśiṣṭa tvāt yat yat avayava sanniveśa viśiṣṭam tat tat kāryam dṛṣṭam yathā ghaṭa ādi tathā ca avayava sanniveśa viśiṣṭā pṛthivī tasmāt kāryā iti

nanu kāryatve api avayava sanniveśa viśiṣṭa tva anupalabdheḥ buddhi ādau itya prayojaka tvāt apramāṇam iti jaiminīyāḥ tat asat sa pakṣa eka deśa vṛtteḥ gamaka tva abhyupagamāt tathā hi yat yat avayava sanniveśa vat tat tat kāryam dṛṣṭam na punar yat yat kāryam tad tad avayava sanniveśa vat iti brūmaḥ na ca sa pakṣa eka deśe vartamānasya āgamaka tvam dhūma anumānasya āgamaka tva prasaṅgāt tathā hi yadi dhūmavat tva prayuktam syāt agnimat tvam antareṇa dhūmavat tvam agnimat tvam na bhavet iti atha viṣama vyāptika tvāt yaḥ yaḥ dhūmavān sa saḥ agnimānitya iva vyāptiḥ na punar yaḥ yaḥ agnimān sa sa dhūmavān iti evam tarhi avayava sanniveśavat tvasya api sa pakṣa eka deśe vartamānasya na aprayojaka tvam

atha abhūtvā bhāvi tvasya anupalabdheḥ na kṣiteḥ kāryatvam kim atra pratyakṣeṇa anupalabdhiḥ atha abhūtvā bhāvi tvasya anumānena vā pratyakṣeṇa anupalabdhau kasyacid ghaṭa ādau na upalabhyate iti akāryatā prasaṅgaḥ atha tatra api abhūtvā bhāvi tvam avayava sanniveśa tvena jñāyate iti kṣitau api avayava sanniveśavat tvena eva abhūtvā bhāvi tvam gamyate iti samānam kāryatvena ca kartṛ pūrvaka tvam gamyate iti vakṣyāmaḥ bhūta parīkṣāyām

tathā kārya lakṣaṇāyāḥ dharma antaram āha apara jāti bahutva upetāḥ iti aparā tu jātiḥ pṛthivī tva apekṣayā ghaṭa tva paṭa tva ādi rūpā tasyāḥ bahu tvam aparisaṃkhyāta tvam tad upetā tad yuktā iti na ca evam paramāṇu lakṣaṇe ati vailakṣaṇyam tathā kārya lakṣaṇāyāḥ kāryam nirūpayati śayana āsana ādi bhedena anekam upakāram karoti iti aneka upakāra karī ca yat eva artha kriyā kāri tat eva paramārtha sat artha kriyā virahaḥ hi abhāva lakṣaṇam iti darśanasya sattā sambandhena sattā abhyupagame api abhyupagama vādena nirāsa artham ca etat bhavati iti

pṛthivī kāryasya ananta tvāt aśakyam tad parijñānam mā bhūt iti avāntara bhedena vaidharmyam vīpsāyām pratijñātam āha trividhañcā asyāḥ kāryam iti yathā hi evaṃbhūtaḥ dharmaḥ kārya paramāṇu rūpa tayā nitya anitya bhedaḥ kārya rūpāyāñca sthairya ādi dharma yogaḥ apara jāti bahutvañca asyāḥ pṛthivyāḥ tathā trividhañca kāryam iti kṣiteḥ kāryasya ānantye api śarīra ādi rūpeṇa parasparam vyāvṛtta ātma tayā trividha avasthitasya tattva jñāna viṣaya tvam tathā hi śarīram indriyam viṣayaḥ iti saṃjñā yasya tat śarīra indriya viṣaya saṃjñakam sarvam kṣiteḥ kāryam iti jñeyam

anye tu asyāḥ paramāṇu lakṣaṇāyāḥ trividham kāryam śarīra ādi rūpam iti manyante vyavahitasya api idaṃśabdena kvacid parāmarśāt iti tatra śarīrasya itarasmāt vaidharmyam āha śarīram dvividham iti viśeṣasya sāmānya apekṣi tvāt viśeṣa abhidhāne avaśyam sāmānya lakṣaṇam vidyamānam antevāsinohyatām iti ūhana śakteḥ saṃvardhanāya na sāmānya lakṣaṇam avocat tathā hi śarīra abhidhāne śarīra tvam śarīra vyavahāra kāraṇam jñāyate eva lakṣaṇam iti tathā icchā anuvidhāyi kriyā āśraya tvam na ṛte śarīrāt sambhavati iti śarīra vacanāt arthāt labhyate iti sva śabdena avacanam grantha ādau tu śarīra ādi dvāreṇa iti ati vyāpti abhāvaḥ

atha śarīra tvam sakala śarīra vyāpaka tvāt bheda antarāt vyāvṛtteḥ ca yuktam lakṣaṇam na ca evam icchā anuvidhāyi kriyā āśraya tvam tasya hi vipakṣāt vyāvṛttasya api sataḥ pakṣe sarvatra asambhavāt tathā hi mṛta ādi avasthāyām etat na sambhavati iti avyāpakam atha jīvat śarīrasya etat lakṣaṇam iti ced tat na supta mūrchita ādi avasthāyām api anupalabdheḥ katham tarhi idam lakṣaṇam yogyatā āśrayaṇāt tathā hi śarīram itarasmāt bhidyate sākṣāt icchā anuvidhāyi kriyā āśraya yogya tvāt śarīra tva sambandhāt ca yaḥ tu evam na bhavati na ca asau sākṣāt icchā anuvidhāyi kriyā āśraya yogyaḥ śarīra tva yuktaḥ ca yathā indriya ādiḥ iti

āmaraṇāt yasya paṭutva āpaṭu tvābhyām indriyāṇām paṭu tva apaṭu tve tat śarīram iti kecid tathā hi auṣadha upayogāt api indriyeṣu paṭu tvam sambhavati iti āmaraṇāt iti padam tathā ca avyādhitasya śarīra paṭu tvena amaraṇam indriya paṭu tvam dṛṣṭam vyādhitasya tu auṣadha upayogena vyādhi upaśame śarīra paṭu tvāt eva indriya paṭu tvam iti paśyāmaḥ śarīrasya apaṭu tvāt eva indriyeṣu ca kāca kāmalā ādi doṣāḥ sambhavanti iti tad paṭu tvena vyāvṛttaḥ iti pārthivantu śarīram māṃsa ādi avayava janya tve satyanti āvayavi tvāt iti draṣṭavyam māṃsa ādi avayava janyasya api aṅgyulyādeḥ śarīra vyavahāra aviṣaya tvāt iti anti a avayavi padam antya avayavi tvañca aśarīrasya api sambhāvyate iti māṃsa ādi avayava janya padam

sāmānya lakṣaṇa lakṣitasya pārthiva śarīrasya viśeṣa lakṣaṇa artham vibhāgaḥ śarīram dvividham kena rūpeṇa yoni jam ayonijañca pūrvam uddiṣṭe api yoni je artha prakāśasya vivakṣita tvāt ayonijam āha tatra ayonijam iti yoni śabdasya kāraṇa paryāya tvāt tad niṣedhe mā bhūt ākasmikam iti āha anapekṣa śukra śoṇitam iti yoni śabdaḥ sāmānya śabdaḥ api kāraṇa viśeṣe śukra śoṇita lakṣaṇe vivakṣitaḥ iti tad niṣedhena kāraṇa antaram labhyate śukra śoṇitam anapekṣya kāraṇa antarāt utpannam ayoni jam keṣām deva ṛṣīṇām śarīram iti ayonijantu śarīram deva rṣīṇām na tu ayoni jam eva yoni ja tvasya api śravaṇāt

anye tu vyabhicāra niṣedha artham ekasya deva padasya lopena samāsam kurvate devāḥ ca devarṣayaḥ ca devarṣayaḥ teṣām iti atra devāḥ tu aṣṭadhā piśāca ādayaḥ tatra api kasyacid yoni ja tu a śravaṇe anyat viśeṣaṇam na cintyam atha kebhyaḥ tat śarīram bhavati iti āha dharma viśeṣa sahitebhyaḥ aṇubhyaḥ jāyate iti tathā hi tad śarīra utpattau aṇavaḥ samavāyi kāraṇam tad saṃyogaḥ ca asamavāyi kāraṇam dharma viśeṣaḥ nimitta kāraṇam iti kāryā eka artha samavāyaḥ ca dravya utpattau saṃyogasya iti atha deva rṣīṇām ayonijam śarīram asti iti atra kim pramāṇam āgamaḥ tathā ca ayonija śarīrāṇi bhavanti adbhuta karmaṇām yoni jāni eva maudgalya na mātā pitṛ jāni tu

tathā hi adbhutam utkṛṣṭam karma yeṣām te tathā uktāḥ teṣām utkṛṣṭa karma vaśāt yoni jāni śarīrāṇi bhavanti kāraṇa mātra niṣedhaḥ mā bhūt iti āha yoni jāni kāraṇa jāni eva katham tarhi teṣām ayonija tvam iti āha na mātā pitṛ jāni iti pitṛ mātṛ śabdena śoṇita śukrayoḥ abhidhānam upacāreṇa iti tathā utkṛṣṭam karma dvedhā dharma rūpam adharma rūpañca iti tatra dharma rūpāt deva rṣīṇām adharma rūpāt ca kṣudra jantu yātanā śarīrāṇi kṣudra jantavaḥ yūka ādayaḥ yātanā śarīrāṇi nārakīya śarīrāṇi iti tāni adharma viśeṣa sahitebhyaḥ aṇubhyaḥ jāyante atha deva ṛṣīṇām śarīrāṇi dharma viśeṣāt upajātāni api anumānena yoni jāni iti pratīyante tathā hi deva ṛṣi śarīrāṇi yoni jāni śarīra tvāt asmad ādi śarīra vat iti tat ca āgamena bādhyamāna tvāt apramāṇam iti tathā anumānena ca āgamasya bādhāt deva ṛṣi śarīrāṇām sadbhāva asiddheḥ nija anumānasya āśraya asiddha tvāt apramāṇa tva prasaṅgaḥ

na ca anumānasya āgama viṣaye tad upaghātena pramāṇa tā sambhavati yuktañca āgama anugrāhaka tvam tathā hi deva ṛṣi śarīrāṇi ayonijāni utkṛṣṭa karma ārabdha tvāt śarabha ādi śarīra vat utkṛṣṭam karma adharma rūpam śarabha ādi śarīre deva ṛṣi śarīre tu dharma rūpam iti viśeṣe api utkṛṣṭa karma ārabdha tvam ubhayatra aviśiṣṭam iti na sādhana hīnam udāharaṇam

yonijam āha śukra śoṇita sampāta jam iti śukra śoṇitayoḥ sannipātāt sambandhāt jāyate iti śukram pituḥ mātuḥ śoṇitam iti tayoḥ sannipāta sama kālam bhoktaḥ karma vaśāt antaḥkaraṇa sambandhaḥ śukra śoṇitayoḥ saṃyogāt majjita ākāram dravyam utpannam tad anantaram āntareṇa tejasā sambandhāt vega apekṣā t avayave kriyā tad anantaram vibhāgāt dravya ārambhaka saṃyoga vināśaḥ

tad vināśāt tad ārabdhasya dravyasya vināśaḥ punar anyasmāt agni saṃyogāt pūrvarūpa ādayaḥ vyāvartante anyasmāt ca apūrvarūpa ādi utpattiḥ evam utpanna pāka jeṣu aṇuṣvātma aṇu saṃyogāt adṛṣṭa apekṣāt utpannā kriyā vibhāgam ārabhate tasmāt pūrva saṃyoga vyāvṛttāt uttara saṃyogāt dvi aṇuka utpattiḥ evam dvi aṇukaiḥ tri aṇuka utpattiḥ ityādi krameṇa śarīra utpattiḥ iti punar mātrā bhuktam pītam tanmātrayā avatāryate tatas punar āntarālena ca sambandhāt avayave kriyā punar vibhāgāt saṃyoga vināśaḥ tatas dravya vināśaḥ anyasmāt agni saṃyogāt pūrvarūpa ādi vināśaḥ anyasmāt ca rakta ādi utpattiḥ tatas dvi aṇuka ādi prakrameṇa śarīra utpattiḥ iti nyāyaḥ śarīre api etat lakṣaṇam draṣṭavyam yāvat bhasmībhāvaḥ iti anyathā hi āhāra upayogasya āśraya upacaya akāraṇa tvāt vaiyarthyam syāt

na ca ārabdha śarīrāḥ ye vā avayavāḥ sahakāri prāptau śarīra antaram ārabhante punar saha kāri antara prāptau anyat śarīram iti vācyam ārabhya ārambhaka vāda prasaṅgāt atha iṣyate vā ekam dravyam ārabhya tasmin avinaṣṭe punar dravya antara ārambhaka tvam na yuktam etat sarvasya api kārya dravyasya paramāṇu vṛtti tva prasaṅgāt tathā hi paramāṇubhyām dvi aṇukam ārabdham tasmin avinaṣṭe tābhyām eva anya paramāṇu sahitābhyām anyat ārabdham punar anya paramāṇu sahitaiḥ anyadārabhyate iti mūrtānām samāna deśatā prasaṅgaḥ tathā hi paramāṇubhyām ārabdham paramāṇvoḥ vartate punar anya sahitābhyām ārabdham tayoḥ tasmin ca iti mūrtānām eka deśa tvam syāt teṣāntu paraspara vyatirikta ādhāra samavāyi tvam dṛṣṭam yatra hi ekam mūrtam samavetam na tatra anyat samavaiti

artha eka deśatā parihāra artham paramāṇubhyām anya sahakāribhyām ārabdham ekasmin eva paramāṇau vartate punar anya sahitaiḥ taiḥ ārabdham ekasmin eva iti ucyate evam api ekasmin dravye vartamānam kārya dravyam kāraṇa vibhāga abhāvāt avināśi syāt tathā adravyam dravyam aneka dravyañca dravyam iti vacana vyāghātaḥ tathā hi na vidyate janyam jana kañca dravyam iti adravyam paramāṇūnām janakam na asti ākāśa ādīnām janyam na api janakam iti adravyam nitya dravyam iti yāvat aneka dravyantu aneka dravyam janakam asya iti anena sva rūpeṇa dvividham eva dravyam adravyam nityam aneka dravyam janyam kāryam iti eka dravyasya ca kārya dravyasya abhyupagame vyāhatam etat bhavati iti

na ca ekasya krama yaugapadyābhyām ārambhaka tvam nyāyyam eka svarūpa tayā yāvat kartavyam tāvat ekasmin kāle kuryāt aśeṣa kārya utpattau samarthasya anya anapekṣita tvāt iti yugapad aśeṣa kāryam kṛtvā punar akaraṇe hetuḥ na asti iti atha pūrvam ārabdham kārya dravyam avekṣya ārabhante tarhi pūrvasya ārabdha kāryasya api samavāyi tve katham ekasmin eva dravye vartate pūrvasmin sva vṛttau anekam dūṣaṇam abhyūhyam samāna asamāna jātīyayoḥ ārambhaka tva āsambhavāt ityādi tathā sarvasya api kārya dravyasya paramāṇu vṛtti tāyām iha tantuṣu paṭaḥ iha vīraṇeṣu kaṭaḥ ityādi prayogaḥ na syāt tantu ādeḥ samavāyi tvā abhāvāt iti kārya dravyasya vināśe ca antara kāryasya anutpanna tvāt upalambha abhāvaḥ

atha paramāṇubhiḥ pūrva pūrvasya kāryasya avināśe sati uttarottara kārya ārambhāt anekam kārya dravyam iti antyasya vināśe pūrva pūrvasya avasthānāt aneka kārya upalambhaḥ iti ced nanu evam tarhi kapāla saṃyoga vināśe api ghaṭasya avināśa prasaṅgaḥ tad avayava tad avayava saṃyoga vināśe ca tad avayava tad avayavānām teṣām samavāyi tvā abhāvena tad saṃyogasya asamavāyi tva abhāvāt iti samavāyi kāraṇa vināśena asamavāyi kāraṇa vināśena vā dravyasya vināśa darśanāt

atha paramāṇau utpannā kriyā saṃyoga vināśa dvāreṇa dravya vināśika iṣyate tatra yadi ādya dravya ārambhake paramāṇau utpannā kriyā vibhāgāt saṃyoga vināśe sati dravyam vināśayet tarhi pūrva pūrva saṃyogasya uttarottara saṃyoga sahakāri tayā śeṣa kārya utpattau asamavāyi kāraṇa tva abhyupagamāt tad vināśe avaśyam sakala kārya vināśaḥ iti na kiñcid kāryam upalabhyeta

atha antya paramāṇu saṃyogasya pūrva pūrva paramāṇu saṃyoga upacitasya eka kārya utpattau asamavāyikāraṇa tvam iti tad vināśe tad ā ārabdhasya eva vināśāt avāntara kāryasya upalambhaḥ eva iti ced nanu evam api paramāṇu saṃyogasya vināśāt upajātaḥ ghaṭa ādi nāśaḥ asmad ādeḥ ati indriyaḥ syāt yathā hi āpāka nikṣipteṣu ghaṭeṣu agni saṃyogāt vināśaḥ para māṇu kriyā dvāreṇa iti pratyakṣaḥ ca kapāla saṃyoga vināśāt ghaṭasya vināśaḥ tena jñāyate kapālānām samavāyi tvam iti alam ati vistareṇa atas śarīre pratikṣaṇam āhāra upayoga anupayoge sati upacaya apacaya prapañca darśanāt pūrva dravya nimittāt utpanna pāka jaiḥ dvi aṇuka ādi prakrameṇa ca utpattiḥ vācyā iti yathā ca paramāṇuṣu pākaḥ dvi aṇuka ādi prakrameṇa ca utpattiḥ tathā vakṣyāmaḥ pākaja utpattau iti

idānīm śukra śoṇita sannipāta jasya api avāntara vaidharmyam āha tat dvividham jarāyu maṇḍa jañcaḥ iti tathā hi śarīram garbhe pratikṣaṇam pākaja utpatti nyāyena utpadyamānam niṣkramaṇa kāle jarāyuṇā veṣṭita tvāt jarāyu jam aṇḍa jam mātṛ śarīrāt niḥsṛtam api kiñcid kāla maṇḍa udare pākaja utpatti nyāyena āveṣṭitam utpadyate iti aṇḍa jam keṣām jarāyu jam iti āha mānuṣa paśu mṛgāṇām iti mānuṣāḥ ca paśavaḥ ca mṛgāḥ ca iti paśu śabdena saṃgṛhītānām api mṛga śabdena abhidhānam araṇyaja tvāt iti

anye tu ekasya mānuṣa śabdasya lopena samāsam kurvate mānuṣāḥ ca mānuṣa paśavaḥ ca mṛgāḥ ca iti atra mānuṣa śabdena abhihitānām paśu śabdena abhidhānena tat eva dūṣaṇam iti prayojanañca cintyam tathā mṛga śabdena sarva paśūnām abhidhāna asambhavāt avyāptiḥ iti aṇḍa jam keṣām iti āha pakṣi sarīsṛpāṇām iti pakṣiṇaḥ ca sarīsṛpāḥ ca iti pakṣi sarīsṛpāḥ teṣām iti sarīsṛpāḥ kuṭilam sarpanti iti sarpa ādayaḥ rūḍhi vaśāt ca iti

śarīrasya śarīrāt samāna jātīyāt ca vaidharmyam abhidhāya indriyasya vaidharmya nirūpaṇa artham āha indriyam gandha vyañjakam iti tathā indriyāṇām nānātvāt tat vyāpi sāmānya lakṣaṇam arthāt labhyate eva karaṇa tva ati indriya tva dravya tva niyata adhiṣṭhāna vṛtti tve satya parokṣa jñāna janaka tvāt iti aparokṣa jñāna janaka tvam kartuḥ ātmanaḥ saṃbhavati iti tad nirāsāya karaṇa tva grahaṇam anindriyasya pradīpa ādeḥ karaṇa tve satya parokṣa jñāna janaka tvam dṛṣṭam iti tad nirākaraṇa artham atīndriya padam tathā indriya artha sannikarṣaḥ karaṇa tva ati indriya tve satya parokṣa jñāna janaka

iti dravya tva padam tathā diś kālayoḥ sarva utpattimatām nimitta tvāt karaṇa tva ati indriya tva dravya tve satya parokṣa jñāna janaka tvam asti iti niyata adhiṣṭhāna vṛtti tva padam diś kālayoḥ tu vyāpaka tvena sakala kārya janaka tvena niyata adhiṣṭhāna asambhavāt atha ātmā api vyāpaka tvāt anena viśeṣaṇena vyavacchinnaḥ iti vyartham karaṇa tva padam na vyāpakasya api bhoktṛ tvena śarīra adhiṣṭhāna tvāt atas indriya m itarasmāt bhidyate karaṇa tva ati indriya tva dravya tva niyata adhiṣṭhāna vṛtti tve satya parokṣa jñāna janaka tvāt yaḥ tu na bhidyate na ca asau ukta sādhanaḥ yathā śarīra ādiḥ iti

sāmānya lakṣaṇa lakṣitasya samāna jātīyāt bhedam āha indriyam ghrāṇam indriya sāmānya lakṣaṇa lakṣita tve sati gandha vyañjaka tvāt itarebhyaḥ bhidyate tathā indriyam gandha vyañjakam iti kāryeṇa sadbhāvam darśayati tathā hi gandha upalabdhiḥ karaṇa kāryā kriyā tvāt yā yā kriyā sā sā karaṇa kāryā dṛṣṭā yathā cchidi kriyā tathā ca iyam kriyā tasmāt karaṇa kāryā iti

yat ca gandha upalabdhi sampādakam karaṇam tat ghrāṇam tat ca pārthivam rūpa rasa gandha sparśeṣu madhye niyamena gandha vyañjaka tvāt yat yat rūpa ādiṣu madhye niyamena gandha vyañjakam tat tat pārthivam dṛṣṭam yathā kastūrikā ādi dravyam tathā ca ghrāṇam rūpa ādiṣu madhye niyamena gandha prakāśakam tasmāt pārthivam iti nanu niyamena gandha vyañjaka tvam asiddham gandha tva guṇa tva sat tā ādeḥ api vyañjaka tvāt iti atas rūpa rasa gandha sparśeṣu madhye iti viśeṣaṇam

atha pārthiva tva aviśeṣāt ghrāṇam gandhasya iva rūpa ādi prakāśakam api syāt rūpa ādeḥ api pārthiva guṇa tvāt saṃyukta samavāyasya ca sambandhasya aviśeṣāt anyasya ca viśeṣa hetoḥ abhāvāt iti atas āha jala ādi anabhibhūtaiḥ pārthiva avayavaiḥ ārabdham ghrāṇam atas gandhasya eva prakāśakam iti katham etat jñāyate kiñcid jala ādinā sampṛktaiḥ anabhibhūtaiḥ pārthiva avayavaiḥ ārambhaḥ ghrāṇasya iti kārya niyamāt tathā ghrāṇasya vyāpārāt gandhasya eva upalambhaḥ na rūpa ādeḥ iti dṛṣṭam na ca kāraṇa niyamam vinā kārya niyamaḥ sambhavati iti kiñcid jala ādi asampṛktaiḥ utpādaḥ jñāyate ca adṛṣṭa viśeṣāt gandha upalabdheḥ sampādakāt anyathā hi ghrāṇa vyāpārāt gandhasya eva upalabdhiḥ na bhavet sā ca dṛṣṭā atas jñāyate anyasya kāraṇatva asambhavāt viśiṣṭa utpādaḥ nimittam sa ca adṛṣṭa vaśāt adṛṣṭasya ca vyavasthā kāraṇa tvāt iti abhipretañca etat sūtrakartuḥ iti

bhūyas tvāt gandhavat tvāt ca gandha jñāne prakṛtiḥ pṛthivī iti vacanāt gandhaḥ jñāyate anena iti gandha jñānam ghrāṇam tasmin utpādye prakṛtiḥ kāraṇam pṛthivī bhūyastvāt nimittāt iti yathā bhūyasām pārthiva avayavānām gandha upalabdhi sampādaka adṛṣṭa viśeṣa upagṛhītānām jala ādinā ca atiraskṛta vapuṣām ghrāṇa janaka tvam niyamena gandha upalabdheḥ jñāyate bhūyasā añca pārthiva avayavānām kāraṇa tva abhidhānāt alpīyasām api jala ādi avayavānām akāraṇa tvam labdham atas eva teṣām pārthiva avayavānām abhibhāvaka tvam tathā na param viśiṣṭa adṛṣṭa upagrahe satīṣat jala avayava ādi sampṛktaiḥ ārambhāt gandhasya eva prakāśaka tvam gandhavat tvāt ca iti pārthiva tvāt ghrāṇasya rūpa ādimattvam api sambhavati iti gandhavat tvam utkarṣaḥ vivakṣitaḥ sva gata gandha utkarṣāt ca rūpa ādiṣu ca madhye saṃyukta samavāya aviśeṣe api gandhasya eva prakāśakam iti

yadi vā kācid eva pṛthivī gandha upalabdheḥ kāraṇam na sarva iti viśeṣa hetuḥ na asti iti ukte vākyam saṃbadhyate bhūyas tvāt gandhavat tvāt ca gandha jñāne prakṛtiḥ iti gandhe jñaptiḥ jñānam gandha viṣaya ka jñānam tasmin prakṛtiḥ kāraṇam pṛthivī bhūyas tvāt vyākṛtāt gandhavat tvāt ca iti anyaḥ vā arthaḥ gandhavat tvāt niyamena gandha upalabdheḥ kāraṇam viśeṣa hetuḥ na asti iti ukte vākyam saṃbadhyam ghrāṇam tat ca gandha vat pārthiva tva aviśeṣāt ghrāṇam kutas iti āha bhūyas tvāt ukta rūpāt iti

anye tu jala ādya sampṛktaiḥ śuddhaiḥ pārthiva avayavaiḥ ārambhaḥ viśiṣṭa adṛṣṭa apekṣaiḥ bhūyastvam iti manyante tathā ca bhāṣyam jala ādi anabhibhūtaiḥ asampṛktaiḥ kevalaiḥ pārthiva avayavaiḥ ārabdham ghrāṇam iti atra ca īṣat jala ādi samparke api anabhibhavasya sambhavāt asaṃpṛktaiḥ iti viśeṣaṇam na budhyāmahe na ca bhūyasām bhāvaḥ bhūyas tvam iti ukte anyeṣām atyanta asambhavaḥ upalabhyate iti alam

indriyam sarva prāṇinām gandha vyañjakam iti sāmānya viśeṣa ātmatayā abhidhāya viṣaya svarūpa nirūpaṇa artham āha viṣayaḥ tu dvi aṇuka ādi prakrameṇa ārabdhaḥ iti nanu dvi aṇuka ādi prakrameṇa ārambhaḥ śarīrasya indriyasya ca asti iti ati vyāpi idam viṣaya lakṣaṇam iti na etat evam śarīra indriyayoḥ lakṣaṇa abhidhānena viṣayāt bheda siddhau tad anya tve satī iti viśeṣaṇa lābhāt tathā hi śarīra indriya anya tve sati dvi aṇuka ādi prakrameṇa ārabdha tvāt viṣayaḥ tasya hi viṣaya bhāva upakāraka tvāt viṣayaḥ tu upabhogyaḥ indriya grāhyaḥ vā asmad ādeḥ

atha tri aṇukam dvi aṇuka ādi prakrameṇa utpannam śarīra indriya anya tve satyasmad ādi indriyam grāhyañca na bhavati avyāpi idam viṣaya lakṣaṇam iti dvi aṇuka ādi prakrameṇa ārabdhaḥ iti viśeṣaṇena vyavacchedāt tathā hi dvi aṇukam ādiḥ yasya prakramasya ityādi grahaṇam tri aṇukasya api avarodhakam iti asau dvi aṇuka ādiḥ sa ca asau prakramaḥ ca iti tena ārabdhaḥ viṣayaḥ dvi aṇuka tri aṇuka ādi prakrameṇa ārabdhaḥ iti yāvat tri aṇu kantu dvi aṇukaiḥ ārabdham dvi aṇuka ādi prakrameṇa iti tri aṇukāna an tva niyamena ārambhaka tvam dvayoḥ bahūnāñca iti tad ārabdhasya indriya viṣaya tā sambhāvyate iti viṣayasya ca sāmānya lakṣaṇa lakṣitasya api avāntara bhedena ānantyāt saṃgraham āha trividhaḥ kena rūpeṇa mṛd pāṣāṇa sthāvara lakṣaṇaḥ iti mṛd ca pāṣāṇaḥ ca sthāvarāḥ ca iti lakṣaṇam svabhāvaḥ yasya asau tathā uktaḥ svabhāvaḥ tu mṛdi mṛd tvam pāṣāṇeṣu pāṣāṇa tvam iti

nanu mṛd ādi bhedena traividhyam anupapannam iṣṭakā ādeḥ viṣayasya asaṃgrahāt ityāśaṅkya āha tatra prākārāḥ ca iṣṭakāḥ ca tad ādayaḥ ghaṭa ādayaḥ te ca mṛd vikārāḥ iti mṛd śabdena saṃgṛhītāḥ vikāraḥ tu viśiṣṭa racanā āpannāyāḥ mṛdaḥ agni sambandhāt paramāṇu kriyā dvāreṇa pūrva dravya vināśe śyāma ādi nivṛttau utpanna pāka jaiḥ ārambhāt iti ucyante taiḥ utpanna pāka jaiḥ ārabdhe api mṛd tvam sāmānyam na nivartate iti mṛd śabdena abhidhīyante iti pāṣāṇa tva sāmānya yoginaḥ darśayati pāṣāṇāḥ upala maṇi vajra ādayaḥ iti teṣāñca svarūpam tat śāstra prasiddha loka vyavahārataḥ avagantavyam sthāvara tva jāti sambandhinaḥ darśayati sthāvarāḥ tṛṇa oṣadhi vṛkṣa gulma latā vitāna vanaspatayaḥ iti tṛṇam ubhayavādi prasiddham oṣadhayaḥ phala pāka antāḥ dhānya ādayaḥ vṛkṣāḥ ca vṛkṣa tva jāti sambandhinaḥ aśoka ādayaḥ evam gulma latā vitāna ādi viśeṣaḥ avagantavyaḥ tat uktam oṣadhyaḥ phala pāka antāḥ latā gulmāḥ ca vīrudhaḥ phalī vanaspatiḥ jñeyaḥ vṛkṣāḥ puṣpa phala upagāḥ iti

idānīm uddeśavataḥ udakasya lakṣaṇa parīkṣā artham āha aptvā abhisambandhāt iti ādi prakaraṇam ap tvena abhisambandhaḥ aptvena abhilakṣitaḥ sambandhaḥ samavāyaḥ lakṣaṇam iti tathā hi āpaḥ itarasmāt bhidyante aptvā abhisambandhāt ye tu na bhidyante na te aptvā abhisambaddhāḥ yathā kṣiti ādayaḥ na ca tathā apaḥ tasmāt bhidyante iti vyavahāraḥ vā sādhyate vivāda āspadībhūta dravyam āpaḥ iti evam vyavahartavyam aptvā abhisambandhāt ye tvāpaḥ iti evam na vyavahriyante na te aptvā abhisambaddhāḥ yathā kṣiti ādayaḥ na tathā idam tasmāt āpaḥ iti evam vyavahartavyam iti śeṣañca lakṣaṇasya ākṣepa pratisamādhānam pṛthivī adhikāre jñeyam evam śabda artha nirūpaṇāya śakteḥ atīndriya tva pratiṣedha arthañca āptvā abhisambandhāt iti vākyam pūrvavat yojanīyam

pūrvam hi pṛthivī ādīnām navānām api samavāyi kāraṇa tvam guṇa tvam kṣiti udaka ātmanām caturdaśa guṇavat tvañca iti uktam tatra keṣām utpattau samavāyi kāraṇa tvam kaiḥ guṇaiḥ guṇavat tvam ke vā caturdaśa guṇāḥ kim vā guṇa ātmakam lakṣaṇam iti āha rūpa rasa sparśa sneha sāṃsiddhika drava tva ādi saṃskāra paryantāḥ vidyante yāsām tāḥ tadvatyaḥ iti

ete ca pūrvavat iti guṇa viniveśa adhikāre siddhāḥ tathā hi rūpa rasa sparśavatyaḥ āpaḥ dravāḥ snigdhāḥ ca iti pañca viśeṣaṇāḥ siddhāḥ te ca asādhāraṇa tvādi tarasmāt bhedakāḥ iti asādhāraṇa tā pratipādana artham āha śukla madhura śītāḥ eva rūpa rasa sparśāḥ sūtreṇa sāmānya śabdena api arthāt abhihitāḥ iti tathā hi śuklam eva hi rūpam abhāsvaram apsu madhuraḥ eva rasaḥ śītaḥ eva sparśaḥ iti tathā snehaḥ ambhasya iva sāṃsiddhi kañca drava tvam ambhasya iva iti asa ādhāraṇa tvam eṣām sāṃsiddhikam iti agni saṃyoga anapekṣam na tu ākasmikam kārye kāraṇa guṇa pūrvakam paramāṇuṣu ca nityam iti saṃkhyā ādayaḥ tu pūrvavat vyākhyeyāḥ

evam lakṣaṇena lakṣyamāṇasya eka aneka tva upalabdhau saṃśaye sati tad nirākaraṇa artham ap tva sāmānyasya ca bheda adhiṣṭhāna tvāt iti tad samarthana artham advaita vādī ca udakasya udaka antarāt bhedam na pratyeti tad nirākaraṇa artham sarvasya kārya dravyasya vināśe pralaya avasthāyāñca sarga ādau punar utpattiḥ na syāt abhāvāt bhāva utpatteḥ ayogāt iti bīja pratipādana arthañca tāḥ tu pūrvavat dvividhāḥ iti vākyam vyākhyeyam yathā hi pṛthivī paramāṇu svabhāvā nityā kārya lakṣaṇā tu anityā tadvat āpaḥ api iti āha nitya anityabhāvāt iti nitya tvāt anitya tvāt ca iti anena rūpeṇa dvaividhyam iti avāntara bhedena vaidharmyam darśayati kāryantu sati api ānantye trividham iti jñeyam kena rūpeṇa iti āha śarīram indriyam viṣayaḥ iti saṃjñā yasya tat tathā uktam

śarīrasya ca sāmānya lakṣaṇam pūrva uktam iti utpattiḥ eva ucyate śarīram ayonijam eva iti na śukra śoṇita sannipāta jam iti tat ca dharma viśeṣa sahitebhyaḥ āpyebhyaḥ paramāṇubhyaḥ jāyate varuṇa loke prasiddham āgamāt iti atha āpyam śarīram drava tva adhikaraṇa tayā na viśiṣṭa upabhogāya kalpyate iti āha pārthiva avayava upaṣṭambhāt ca upabhoga samartham iti tathā hi āpya avayavāḥ samavāyi kāraṇam tad saṃyogāḥ ca asamavāyi kāraṇam pārthiva avayavāḥ ca nimitta kāraṇam iti evam taijasāḥ vāyavīyāḥ ca iti nanu ca ayuktam etat śarīrasya pāñcabhautika tva śravaṇāt tathā hi gandha kleda pāka vyūha avakāśa dānebhyaḥ pāñcabhautikam iti

gandha upalabdheḥ kṣiteḥ kāraṇa tvam kledāt ca apām pākāt tejasaḥ vyūhāt ca racanā viśeṣāt vāyoḥ avakāśa dātṛ tvena ca ākāśasya iti pāñcabhautika tvam iti tat ca asat vibhinna jātīyānām eka dravya utpattau samavāyi tvasya adarśanāt na ca vibhinna jātīya avayaveṣu samavetam śarīram upalabhyate yadi ca pañcānām samavāyi tvam syāt evañca satyebhyaḥ kaḥ pārthivaḥ anyaḥ tu āpyaḥ taijasa vāyavīyāḥ teṣu samavetam śarīram upalabhyeta na ca evam tathā vicitra guṇa adhikaraṇa tvāt samavāyi kāraṇānām kārye api tad vaicitryam syāt evañca sati pārthiva avayave śukla ādīnām anyatamam rūpam pākaja sparśaḥ syāt āpya avayave ca śuklam eva rūpam śītaḥ eva sparśaḥ syāt taijase bhāsvaram rūpam uṣṇaḥ eva sparśaḥ vāyavīye ca anuṣṇa aśīta tve satya pākaja sparśaḥ syāt iti vicitra avayavaiḥ ārabdha tvāt śarīram vaicitryam upalabhyeta na tu upalabhyate tasmāt ayuktam etat

atha avayavasya api aneka bhūtaiḥ ārambhaḥ tathā hi pārthiva apyābhyām paramāṇubhyām dvi aṇukam punar āpi ataijasābhyām tathā taijasa vāyavīyābhyām ārabdham iti evam vāyu śabda tanmātrābhyām etāni dvi aṇukāni utpannāni tri aṇuka ādi prakrameṇa śarīram ārabhantaḥ iti abhyupagame ca rūpa ādīnām utpattiḥ na bhavet tathā hi guṇāḥ ca guṇa antaram ārabhante iti sūtreṇa anekasya guṇasya guṇa ārambhaka tvam uktam evañca sati pārthiva apyābhyām aṇubhyām ārabdhe dvi aṇuke gandha utpattiḥ na syāt tasya hi eka tvena ajanaka tvāt evam āpya taijasābhyām ārabdhe dvi aṇuke rasaḥ na syāt tathā taijasa vāyavīyābhyām ārabdhe dvi aṇuke rūpa abhāvaḥ tathā vāyu śabda tanmātrābhyām ārabdhe sparśa abhāvaḥ iti tat evam gandha rasa rūpa sparśānām dvi aṇukeṣu abhāve tad kārya kāryeṣu api abhāvāt iti śarīre api abhāva prasaṅgaḥ

etat ca dvi ātmaka ādiṣu api samānam tathā hi pārthiva āpyābhyām ārabdhe śarīre gandha anutpattiḥ pārthiva taijasābhyām ārabdhe gandha rasa anutpattiḥ pārthiva vāyavīyābhyām ārabdhe śarīre gandha rasa rūpa anutpattiḥ evam pārthiva ākāśābhyām ārabdhe caturṇām anutpattiḥ iti na ca dravya ārambhaka tvam ākāśasya amūrta tvāt iti mūrtasya hi sparśavataḥ dravyasya dravya ārambhaka tva darśanāt evam aṇu ādeḥ api itara sa hakāri tvena ārambhe dūṣaṇa m ūhyam

tathā trayāṇām pṛthivī ādīnām caturṇāñca ārambhaḥ iti pañca anāñca kāraṇa tvam iṣyate iti pāñcabhautika tvam iṣṭam samavāyi tvañca ekasya eva iti pārthive hi śarīre pārthivasya anyasmin anyasya iti pārthive ca kleda upalambhaḥ saṃyukta samavāyena pākaḥ tvā antara anala saṃyogāt sa ca na upalabhyate eva indriyeṇa śarīre sarvadā kevalantu guṇa antara prādurbhāvāt pūrva śarīra nivṛttau utpanna pāka jaiḥ ārambhaḥ kalpyate vyūhaḥ tu avayava racanā viśeṣaḥ sa tu vāyu kāryaḥ na bhavati eva avakāśa dātṛ tvañca mūrta dravya abhāvasya eva iti ākāśasya na liṅgam iti alam

indriya svarūpa nirūpaṇa artham āha indriyañca rasa vyañjakam iti rasa upalabdhiḥ karaṇa kāryā kriyā tvāt yā yā kriyā sā sā karaṇa kāryā yathā chidi kriyā tathā ca iyam kriyā tasmāt karaṇa kāryā iti yat ca rasa upalabdhi sampādakam karaṇam tat āpyam tad rasanam rūpa rasa ādiṣu madhye niyamena rasa vyañjaka tvāt yat yat rūpa ādiṣu madhye niyamena rasa vyañjakam tat tat āpyam dṛṣṭam yathā danta antargata udakam tathā ca etat tasmāt āpyam iti rasana vyāpārāt rasa tva ādīnām api grahaṇasya sambhavāt asambhavi tvam syāt iti rūpa ādiṣu madhye iti padam tathā hi śuṣka kaṇṭhasya modaka ādiṣu rasa upalabdhiḥ na upalabdhā udaka sadbhāve tu rūpa ādiṣu madhye rasasya ekasya upalabdhiḥ iti sa pakṣe sattvam anāpye ca etat na sambhavati iti vipakṣāt vyāvṛttiḥ iti tad etat asādhāraṇa tvāt i tarasmāt bhedakam api iti jñeyam

atha kasmāt kiñcid evāpyam dravyam rūpa ādiṣu madhye niyamena rasa vyañjakam indriyañca iti āha anya avayavān abhibhūtaiḥ īṣat sampṛktaiḥ api jala avayavaiḥ ārabdham rasanam iti rasasya eva vyañjakam iti anye tu anya avayava an abhibhūtaiḥ asaṃpṛktaiḥ śuddhaiḥ jala avayavaiḥ ārabdham iti bruvate bhūyas tvāt rasavat tvāt ca udakam rasa jñāne prakṛtiḥ iti asya ca sūtrasya idam bhāṣyam

bhūyastvāt iti bhūyasām āpya avayavānām rasa upalabdhi prāpaka adṛṣṭa apekṣāṇām saṃyoge satīṣa t itara avayava samparke ca viśeṣa utpādaḥ upadiśyate atas eva anya avayava abhibhava anupapattiḥ jala avayavānām bhūyas tvāt itareṣāñca alpa tvāt iti rasavat tvan ca rasanā indriyasya rasa utkarṣaḥ sāmānya śabdena api arthaḥ anuktaḥ iti rasaḥ jñāyate anena iti rasa jñānam indriyam tasmin utpādye prakṛtiḥ kāraṇam udakam bhūyas tvāt vyākṛtān nimittāt tasmāt etat eva indriyam rūpa ādiṣu madhye niyamena rasa prakāśa kañca iti

yat vā kārya niyamaḥ kāraṇa niyamam vinā na ghaṭataḥ iti niyamena rasanā indriyāt rasa upalabdheḥ eva utpattiḥ kutas iti āha bhūyas tvāt rasavat tvāt ca nimittāt rase jñaptiḥ jñānam tatra prakṛtiḥ kāraṇam rasanā indriyam iti tathā hi saṃyukta samavāya aviśeṣe api niyamena rasa upalambhāni atha anupapattyā jñāyate niyama hetuḥ sa ca anyasya asambhavāt rasa utkarṣaḥ bhūyas tvañca iti kalpyate

yat vā rasa upalambhāni atha anupapattyā anyasya asambhavāt jñāyate rasa utkarṣe kim nimittam iti āha bhūyastvam iti tathā hi āpya tva aviśeṣe api rasasya eva utkarṣaḥ na rūpa ādeḥ iti bhūyas tvam viśiṣṭa utpāde nimittam sa ca adṛṣṭa vaśāt adṛṣṭasya ca vyavasthā hetu tvāt iti viṣayam nirūpayati śarīra indriya vyatiriktaḥ dvi aṇuka ādi prakrameṇa ārabdhaḥ viṣayaḥ tasya hi viṣaya bhāvena eva upakāri tvāt iti sa tu sarit samudra hima karaka ādiḥ iti

idānīm uddeśavataḥ tejaḥ lakṣaṇa parīkṣā artham āha tejaḥ tvā abhisambandhāt ityādi prakaraṇam tejaḥ tu ena abhisambandhaḥ tejaḥ tvā upalakṣita samavāyaḥ lakṣaṇam iti tathā hi tejaḥ itarasmāt bhidyate tejaḥ tvā abhisambandhāt ye tu na bhidyante na te tejaḥ tvā abhisambandhāḥ yathā kṣiti ādayaḥ na ca tathā tejaḥ tasmāt itarasmāt bhidyate iti vyavahāraḥ vā sādhyate tathā tejaḥ śabdasya sāmānyavān arthaḥ iti jñāpana artham atīndriya śakti pratiṣedha arthañca pūrvavat vyākhyeyam

evam samavāyi tva guṇavat tva pratipādana arthañca rūpa ādi vākyam tathā hi rūpa sparśa ādayaḥ saṃskāra paryantāḥ vidyante yasya tat tadvat iti pūrvavat eṣām siddhiḥ iti yathā pṛthivī adhikāre rūpa ādayaḥ viśeṣa guṇāḥ guṇa viniveśa adhikāre siddhāḥ tadvat iha api iti tathā tejaḥ rūpa sparśa vat iti sūtreṇa viśeṣa guṇau uktau tau ca asādhāraṇa tvāt itarasmāt bhedakauvitya sādhāraṇa tām āha śuklam bhāsvarañca rūpam prakāśana śīlam iti uṣṇaḥ eva sparśaḥ na sparśa antaram iti naimitti kañca drava tvam iti saṃkhyā ādayaḥ ca pūrvavat iti trapu sīsa loha rajata suvarṇānām taijasānām agni saṃyogāt drava tvam adbhiḥ sāmānyam iti sūtreṇa drava tvam uktam

lakṣaṇena lakṣyamāṇasya eka aneka tva upalabdhau saṃśaye sati tad nirāsāya advaita vādinaḥ ca pratiṣedhāya sāmānya samarthanāya bīja sadbhāva pratipādanāya ca tat api dvividham iti pūrvavat vākyam vyākhyeyam tathā hi na kevalam pṛthivī udakañca dvividham kim tarhi etat api iti tejaḥ api hi dvividham iti kena rūpeṇa iti āha aṇu kārya bhāvāt iti paramāṇu svabhāvam nityam kārya svabhāvañcā nityam kāryasya ca ānantyāt aparijñānam mā bhūt iti āha kāryam śarīra ādi trayam iti śarīram indriyam viṣayam iti anena rūpeṇa jñeyam iti avāntara vaidharmyam

śarīrasya sāmānya lakṣaṇa muktam iti utpattiḥ eva ucyate śarīram ayonijam eva iti ayonijam hi śukra śoṇita sannipāta anapekṣam dharma viśeṣa sahitebhyaḥ aṇubhyaḥ iti taijasāḥ paramāṇavaḥ samavāyi kāraṇam tad saṃyogāḥ ca asamavāyi kāraṇam pārthiva ādi avayavāḥ ca nimitta kāraṇam iti tat ca āditya loke siddham āgamāt atha tejaḥ avayavinaḥ kṣaṇikatāyām tadā ārabdham viśiṣṭa upabhoga ajanakam iti āha pārthiva avayava upaṣṭambhāt ca upabhoga samartham iti tat ca śarīram sāmānya lakṣaṇa lakṣita tve sati tejaḥ avayavaiḥ ārabdha tvāditarasmāt bhidyate iti viśeṣa lakṣaṇam jñeyam

atha indriya svarūpa nirūpaṇa artham āha indriyam sarva prāṇinām rūpa vyañjakam iti rūpa upalabdhiḥ karaṇa kāryā kriyā tvāt yā yā kriyā sā sā karaṇa kāryā yathā chidi kriyā tathā ca iyam kriyā tasmāt karaṇa kāryā iti yad rūpa upalabdheḥ sampādakam karaṇam tat cakṣuḥ iti tat ca taijasam rūpa ādiṣu madhye niyamena rūpa vyañjaka tvāt yat yat rūpa ādiṣu madhye niyamena rūpa vyañjakam tad taijasam yathā pradīpaḥ tathā ca rūpa ādiṣu madhye niyamena rūpa vyañjakam cakṣuḥ tasmāt taijasam iti cakṣuṣaḥ hi rūpa vat dravya ādi prakāśaka tva upalabdheḥ niyamena rūpa prakāśaka tvam asiddham syāt iti rūpa ādiṣu madhye iti padam rūpa rasa gandha sparśeṣu madhye niyamena rūpa vyañjaka tvam vivakṣitam iti

atha taijasa tvāt cakṣuṣaḥ rūpasya iva ūṣma prakāśaka tvam api syāt tasya hi taijasa tvāt saṃyukta samavāyasya aviśeṣāt anyasya ca viśeṣa hetoḥ abhāvāt iti āha anya avayavān abhibhūtaiḥ tejaḥ avayavaiḥ ārabdham cakṣuḥ atas rūpasya eva vyañjakam iti tathā hi īṣat pārthiva avayava saṃyuktaiḥ anabhibhūtaiḥ tejaḥ avayavaiḥ ārabdham cakṣuḥ iti rūpasya eva vyañjakam atha ittham bhūta ārambhe kim pramāṇam kārya niyamaḥ tathā hi cakṣuḥ vyāpārāt rūpa ādiṣu madhye rūpasya eva upalabdhiḥ dṛṣṭā sā ca kāraṇa niyamam vinā na syāt iti anyasya asambhavāt viśiṣṭa utpādaḥ atra nimittam sa ca adṛṣṭāt rūpa upalabdhi sampādakāt tasya hi vastu vyavasthā hetu tvāt iti

bhūyas tvāt rūpavat tvāt ca rūpa jñāne prakṛtiḥ kāraṇam tejaḥ iti asya ca sūtrasya idam bhāṣyam rūpam jñāyate anena iti rūpa jñānam cakṣuḥ tasmin utpādye prakṛtiḥ kāraṇam tejaḥ bhūyastvāt nimittāt atas rūpasya eva prakāśakam indriyañca iti bhūyas tvam hi bhūyasām tejaḥ avayavānām viśiṣṭa adṛṣṭa upagṛhītānām īṣat itara avayava samparke ca ārambhaka tvam iti yat vā rūpe jñaptiḥ jñānam tasmin eva rūpa ādiṣu madhye kāraṇam cakṣuḥ kutas iti āha bhūyas tvāt vyākṛtāt rūpavat tvāt ca iti rūpavat tvam hi rūpa utkarṣaḥ vivakṣitaḥ anyathā hi taijasa tvāt uṣṇa sparśavat tvam api sambhāvyate iti viśeṣa abhidhānam anarthakam syāt yat vā rūpa ādiṣu madhye rūpasya eva upalambhāni atha anupapattyā jñāyate rūpa utkarṣaḥ kutas bhavati iti āha bhūyas tvāt ukta rūpāt iti
