asat etat śabdasya viramya vyāpāra pratiṣedhāt ekadā padam sva viṣaya jñānam kṛtvā punar na karoti iti anye tu pratijña ādi padasya pada antara uccāraṇa kāle api ākāśe padānta rambhaka tvena avasthānam tāvat yāvat antyapadam tatas pañcabhiḥ padaiḥ śrāpadeśe vākyam avayavi bhūtam ārabhyate tatas vākya artha pratipattiḥ iti niraḥ tañca etat anubhavana na hi pūrva pūrva padasya uttarottara pada kāle sarveṣāñca vākya kāle anubhavaḥ asti iti

anye tu ekasmin pade jñānam tena kriyate saṃskāraḥ pudvitīya pada jñānam tena prāktanena saṃskāreṇa anyaḥ saṃskāraḥ iti tāvat yāvat antyapade śānam iti tatas prāktana saṃskāra abhivyaktī pada catuṣṭaya viṣaya smaraṇam utmayate tad viśiṣṭañcā antya padam vākyam iti na ca atra anubhavena virādhaḥ karaṇa aṃśasya ev kīrtanāt

anye smaraṇena anubhavasya avirodham manyamānāḥ kalpanām āśrayante pada jñānāt sa kata smaraṇasya utpādaḥ padārtha pratipatteḥ utpadyamāna tā tatas padārtha jñānasya utpādaḥ pūrva pada jñānasya vinaśyattā dvitīya pada jñānasya utpadyamāna tā tatas dvitīya pada jñānasya utpādaḥ padārtha jñānasya vinaśyattā pada jñānasya vināśaḥ saṅketa smaraṇasya utpadyam āna tā iti anena krameṇa antya pada jñāne sati vākya artha pratipattiḥ na ca atra pūrva pada padārthān asmaraṇena prayojanam asti tad kāyasya vinaśya daśa ānanaṃva kṛta tvāt pūrva pada anurakte hi dvitīya pade jñānam utpannam tat anuraktam tṛtīya padam iti aśeṣa pada anuraktam antyapada vākyam iti

etat ca asat pūrva pada anurāgasya antya pade apratibhāsanāt yathā hi daṇḍī iti jñānam daṇḍa anuraktam eva na evam dvitīya ādi pada jñānam pūrva pada anuraktam iti na ca ayam niyamaḥ sambhavati pūrva pada anantaram eva dvitīya ādi pada uccāraṇam katipaya kālavyavadhān api uccāraṇe artha pratipatti darśanāt iti pūrvā eva kalpanā nyāyyā

atha astu evam vākya parikalpanā vācakatvantu niṣidhyata anya vyatireka abhāvāt padārthabhyaḥ tu vākya artha pratipattiḥ yatra hi pramāṇa antareṇa api padārtha prasiddhiḥ tatra antareṇa api vākyam vākya artha prattipatiḥ dṛṣṭā yathā paśyataḥ cakṣuṣā rūpam heṣa aśabdaḥ ca śṛṇvataḥ khura nikṣepa śabdañca śvetaḥ aśvaḥ dhāvati iti dhīḥ

tathā ca dūrāt cakṣuṣā śvetam rūpam upalabhya heṣā śabdena vā aśva tva jāti manum inoti khura nikṣepa śabdena ca dhāvana kriyām avagatya vākyam vinā api vākya artha pratipadyate sati api ca vākye padārthānām apratipatteḥ na vākya artha prati pattiḥ yathā prasiddha padārthaiḥ kavi iivara cite vākyaḥ iti tasmāt abhihita padārthānām ākāṅkṣa ayogya tā sannidhi dvāreṇa vākya artha gamaka tvam iti na yuktam etat śabdasya aprāmāṇya prasaṅgāt tathā ca pada rūpasya tāvat aprāmāṇyam anuvādaka tvāt tat uktam padam abhyadhika abhāvāt smārakāt na viśiṣyate yat ca ādhikyam bhavet etat sa padasya na gocaraḥ

vākyantu pāramparyeṇa api avācakam iti katham śabdaḥ pramāṇam syāt atha padaiḥ abhihitānāñca padārthānām gamaka tvāt iti pāramparyeṇa śabdaḥ pramāṇam tāha śrotra paricchinnasya śabdasya artha paricchede vyāpārāt iti pāramparyeṇa pratyakṣasya api codanā viṣaye sannidhi prāmāṇya upapatteḥ katham codanā eva dharma pramāṇam pramāṇam ava codanā iti na asya avadhāraṇasya vyāghātaḥ vākyasya artha paricchedaka tva anabhyupagame ca pramāṇa antara asambhavāt padārthānām pratyakṣa ādiṣu antarbhāvaḥ cintanīyaḥ

tatra indriya artha sannikarṣeṇa saha vyāpāra anupalabdheḥ na pratyakṣe antarbhāvaḥ avi na abhau asya anupapatteḥ na anumāne anupapadyamāna artha asambhavān na artha āpattau upamānā bhāvayoḥ ca niyata viṣaya tvam eva pramāṇa antarasya ca anabhyupagamāt ayuktam etat na ca padānām sva artha pratipattau eva caritārtha tvam a ukta nyāyena vākya atha pratipattau api vyāpārāt viramya vyāpāraḥ tu ekam artham pratipādya punar tama pratipādayanti iti pratiṣiddhaḥ

yat ca idam vinā api vākyam vākya artha pratipattiḥ iti uktam tad aparijñānāt vākyena hi janitā vākya artha pratipattiḥ pratyakṣa anumāna sampāditāḥ śvetā dhāvati iti buddhayaḥ yat api idam padārdha apratipattau sati api vākyena vākyā pratipattiḥ iti tat asat pūrva padārtha smaraṇa anugṛhītasya antya padasya vākyatvā avaśyam artha pratipādaka tvam iti vyabhicāra abhāvaḥ anvitā abhidhānantu na sarva padānām ekena eva kriyā kāraka saṃsarga anvitasya padārthasya abhidhāne śeṣa pada uccāraṇa vaiyarthya prasaṅgāt atha antyam padam anvita abhidhāyakam tasya api pūrva pada an apekṣi tve tad uccāraṇa vaiyarthyam sa apekṣi tve tu na asmad siddhāntāt bhedaḥ

ke punar avayavāḥ tat āha pratijñā apadeśa nidarśana anusandhāna pratyāmnāyāḥ vākya deśa tvāt na punar para upagatāḥ jijñāsā ādayaḥ teṣām aśabda rūpa tvāt tatas upadeśa krameṇa avasara prāptāyāḥ pratijñāyāḥ tāvat lakṣaṇam acyate anumeya uddeśaḥ avirodhī pratijñā iti anumeyaḥ pratipipādāya vāra aṣṭatā hi astitva ādi apekṣayā sarva padārtheṣu astoti pratipipādayiṣita yaḥ hi dharmaḥ pratipādayitum iṣṭaḥ tad viśiṣṭaḥ dharmī pakṣaḥ tasya uddeśa mātram sādhāvaruddham pareṣāma aniścita artha abhidhāyakam vacanam pratijñā iti apadeśasya vaṣayā āpādanam arthaḥ prayojanam asya iti prayojana upanyāsaḥ prayogaḥ tu pratijñā tarasmāt bhidyate pratyakṣa ādi aviruddha anumeya uddeśa tvāt yaḥ tu na bhidyate na pāsau evam yathā udāharaṇa ādiḥ iti anumeya uddeśaḥ vā pratijñā iti vyavahartavyaḥ kā anumeya uddeśa tvāt yaḥ ca evam na vyavahriyate na ca asau evam yathā apadeśaḥ iti udāharaṇantu yathā dravyam vāyuḥ iti

nanu ca asādhana aṅgam pratijñā vacanam tad antareṇa api sambandha vacana mātrāt artha pratīteḥ tathā hi yat yat kṛtakam tat tat anityam dṛṣṭam yathā ghaṭaḥ tathā ca kṛtakaḥ śabdaḥ iti atra sāmarthyāt eva pratijñā artha siddhayartham tat abhidhānam atra ca prameyasya pramāṇena eva siddheḥ sāmarthya kiṃrūpam iti cintyam na pratyakṣa svarūpam indriya artha sannikarṣaṇa vipratipatti viṣayasya aparicchedāt evam āga menā api iti atha anumānam eva sāmarthya tat avaśyam artha pratipattau pakṣa dharma tva ādi kama pekṣate iti pratijñā vacanam antareṇa sa pakṣa āsa pakṣa apravibhāge sati tad artha apratītana gamakam iti atha abhidhīyamāna anumāna vyatirekeṇa anyat anumānam prastuta anumāna sāmarthyam na tasya api avinā abhāva anapekṣi tve na gamaka tvam pratijñā avacanat ca vinā tad artha apratīteḥ iti pūrva doṣa anuṣaṅgāt na ca abhipreta artha pratipādanāya anumāna upanyāsa kāle tad artha siddhaye anumāna antaram paśyāmaḥ

na ca kṛtaka tva anitya tvayoḥ sāmānyena vyāpti abhidhāne samartha sādhanasya śabdaḥ eva upasaṃhārāt vijñāyate atra eva anitya tvam asya abhipretam iti sambandha abhi dhānasya viruddha aviruddha abhiprāyeṇa api samāna tayā viveka pratipatteḥ abhāva prasaṅgāt atha yat yat kṛtakam tat tat nityam dṛṣṭam iti vyāpti vacane viruddha vādī anitya tvena ca kṛtaka tvasya vyāpti vacane tattva vādī iti viniścayaḥ tat na kṛtaka tva nitya tvayā uppteḥ pratipādayitum aśakyatvāt tathā ca na kṛtakaṣu ghaṭa ādiṣu nitya tvam nityeṣu ca ākāśa ādiṣu kṛtaka tvam iti dṛṣṭānta doṣaṇa gata artha tvāt katham viruddha tvam yadā ca nityaḥ śabdaḥ iti pratijñāya kṛtaka tvā nitya tvayoḥ vyāpti brūte tadā abhipreta artha viparītena vyāpti kathanāt viruddha vā adyayam iti viśeṣa adhyavasāyaḥ bhavati eva

nanu nityāḥ nitya abhiprāyeṇa eva api nityaḥ śabdaḥ iti vacana sambhavāt pratijñā vacane sati api tattva atattva vādinoḥ aniścayaḥ eva na vacanena eva abhiprāya viśeṣa prasiddhaḥ na hi vaktṛṇām vacanāt ṛte abhiprāya avabodhe pramāṇa antaram asti iti nitya vacanāt nitya abhiprāyaḥ eva niścīyate abhiprāya antara kalpanāyām pramāṇa abhāvāt a atas eva vādi prativādinā ūrjaya parājaya vyavasthā prāśnikaiḥ kriyate yatra api ayana pratipadyamānā vicitra abhiprāya tayā prakaraṇa artham anyathā bravate tatra api vā viśeṣeṇa eva abhiprāya viśeṣaḥ anumeyaḥ vivakṣā antarāt vacana antara anutpattaḥ abhyupagame vā sambandha vacanāt api aniścayaḥ eva syāt kim nitya tva palakṣātaḥ kṛta ka tva anitya tvayoḥ sambandha vacanam uta anitya tva vivakṣātaḥ iti

atha hetu tad abhāva vyavasthāyāḥ vāstava sambandha apekṣi tvāt viparīta vivakṣayā api pakatva anitya tvayoḥ asti eva sambandhaḥ iti gamaka tvam tarhi nitya tva abhiprāyeṇa api eva sambandham upadarśayataḥ tattva vādi tvam syāt prakāra antareṇa sambandhaḥ sanasyavā abhāvāt tathā pratijñā vacanam vinā sandigdha viparyasta avyutpanna puruṣa pāṇā prameya viśeṣeṣu ākāṅkṣā pratipattau vādinaḥ viśeṣeṇa puruṣa mātrasya mātra pratipādanāya pravartamānasya unmatta vādi tvam syāta

atha vivādāt puruṣa viśeṣasya prameya viśeṣa apekṣi tva pratipattiḥ tarhi abhyupagatā eva vivādasya tat rapa tvāt pratijñā hi pratiyogi pratijñā antarama yā vivādaḥ sādhana sahitā tu pratijñā iti na ca śāstrāt eva yathā ukta pratipattiḥ anamāna upanyāsa kāle tasya apramāṇa tvāta prāmāṇye vā mānanati tasmāta parārthāna mānam icchatā avaśyam kārya pratijñā vacanam iti yat ca idam arthāt artha gatau śaktiḥ pakṣa hetu abhidhānayoḥ na artha tena tayoḥ na asti svatas sādhana saṃsthitiḥ iti utkam tatra arthasya artha gatau sāmarthya na niṣidhyate kevalayoḥ ca pakṣa hetva pacā nātha paricchede sāmarthyam a avayava antara sat abhāve ca sva artha upasthāpana dvāreṇa sāmarthyam iṣyate eva anyathā hetu abhidhānasya api asāmarthya para artha anumānasya apravṛttiḥ eva

atha hetu vacanam svayam asamartham api samartha hetu saṃsūcaka tvāt para pratipattau apahīyate ādīyate na ca evam pratijñā iti āha sādhya abhidhānāta pakṣoktiḥ pāramparyeṇa na api alama śaktasya sūcakam hetu vacaḥ aśaktam api svayam tatra pakṣoktiḥ pratijñā vacanam pāramparyeṇa api alam samartham na bhavati iti dhina aṅgam iti sādhye sādhya abhidhānam asādhāraṇam eva sa pakṣa āsa pakṣayoḥ aprasiddhaḥ tathā sādhya abhidhānasya pakṣa ukteḥ paryāya tvāt sādhya aviśiṣṭa tā ca iti atha sādhya anupayogi tvāt sādhyān abhidhānam tat api avayava antara sahitasya sādhya pratipādaka tvāt asiddham viparyaye tu anaikāntikam kevalasya hetu vacanasya api asādhaka tvāt tathā pratijñā vacanam api asādhana aṅgam iti vadatā abhyupagatava pratijñā iti vyāghātaḥ

atha sva pratipattau pratijñā vacanasya anupalambhāt para pratipattau anupādānam evam tarhi hetu vacanasya api adarśanāt anupādānam syāt atha hetu arthasya upalambhāt yuktam hetu vacanam tarhi pratijñā arthasya upalabdheḥ kārya pratijñā vacanam yathā hetu arthaḥ kāraṇam sādhya pratipattau evam pratijñā arthaḥ karma iti ubhayoḥ kāraṇatvā viśeṣāt pakṣasya avacane pramāṇam na asti iti upasthāpite ca karmaṇi karaṇānā pravṛtteḥ upalambhāt tad upasthāpana artham avaśyam kārya pratijñā vacanam iti alam vistareṇa avirodhi grahaṇāt pratyakṣa anumāna abhyupagata sva śāstra sva vacana virodhinaḥ anumeya uddeśāḥ nirastāḥ bhavanti iti vyavacchedyam darśayati yaḥ ha anumeya uddeśaḥ na pratyakṣa ādinā virudhyate sā pratikṣā iti

anye tu pratyakṣa ādi aviruddhaḥ anumeyaḥ tasya uddeśaḥ pratijñā iti vyākhyām kurvate yadi api anumeyasya sādhyasya sādhana āha tayā pratyakṣa ādi virodha abhāvāt na vyavacchedya tva masti tathā api kimbhūtam sādhyam iti apekṣāyām svarūpa upavarṇa nātha pratyakṣa ādi aviruddha padam pratyakṣa śabdena eva viśiṣṭa artha pratītau indriya artha sannikaḥ dipada vat iti tat ca asat avirodhi padasya uddeśa padena sāmānādhikaraṇyāt karmaṇaḥ karaṇena virodha abhāvāt ca iti yathābhūtam upalabhyamānam karma tathābhūta manu palabhyamānam api iti uddyota kara pādaiḥ uktam pratijñā tu kara amāta yuktaḥ tatra virodhaḥ

tatra pratyakṣa virodhī yathā anuṣṇaḥ agniḥ iti anu uṣṇa tāyāḥ stvac indriyeṇa pratibhāsanāt dhanam ambaram iti anumāna virodhī ākāśasya anumānāt eva amūrta tva vibhu tva prasiddheḥ ghanam niviḍa avayavam iti uddeśaḥ tena virudhyate eva ghana tve sati asmad ādīnām asañcāra prasaṅgāt ca iti abhyupagata śāstra virodhī yathā vaiśeṣikasya sarva kārya matpatteḥ pūrvam sa dutpadyatat iti bruvataḥ vaiśeṣika śāstre hi asat utpadyate iti prasiddham na śabdaḥ artha atyāyakaḥ iti sva vacana virodhī yadi hi śabdaḥ artha pratyāyakaḥ na bhavati katham asya arthasya jñāpana artham śabda uccāraṇam na virudhyeta iti

atha pramāṇa tri tve sati katham virodha bahu tvam loka prasiddha yapekṣayā paraḥ āgama viruddhasya pratyakṣa viruddhasya ca amī bhedāḥ tathā api sva vacana viruddhaḥ śāstra avaruddhaḥ ca ityādi vyapadeśaḥ janāḥ nāma atas tathā eva abhidhānam anamānasya tu anumāna antareṇa virodha asambhave api svakīyāna mānasya balavatu āt ayam vyapadeśaḥ anumānena pratijñā bādhyate iti

pratijñā anantaram hetu lakṣaṇam āha liṅga vacanam avadeśaḥ iti artha lakṣaṇa tvāt vacasām iti liṅga lakṣaṇa anuvāde apadeśasya mānyana prasiddham manyatra āvṛtteḥ sarvatra ca iti ca vipakṣe sarvatra na asta sama kāla atyaya apadiṣṭayoḥ ca vyudāsaḥ da vacasām iti liṅga lakṣaṇa anuvādena apadeśasya lakṣaṇa abhidhānam iti vana sahacaritam tad samāna jātīye sarvatra ca sāmānyena prasiddham khāḥ dhamaḥ pakṣe tad samānaḥ sa pakṣe prasiddhaḥ na pūna viśeṣaḥ anya dharmāṇā taḥ sarvatra ca iti vyāpaka avyāpaka bhedam darśayati tad aviparīte pakṣa sarvatra na asti eva iti vipakṣāt atyanta vyāvṛtti darśayati prakaraṇa tyayā apadiṣṭayoḥ ca vyudāsaḥ pūrvavat iti etat liṅgam uktam iti diḥ tasya vācakam vacanam tatīya antam paścamī antam vai apadeśaḥ ayam itarasmāt bhidyate yathā ukta liṅga vacana tvāt yaḥ tu na bhidyate tathā ca ayam itarasmāt ca asau evam yathā pratijñādiḥ iti

tasya vyāpaka avyāpaka svarūpa upadarśana arthama udāharaṇa dvayam yathā kriyāvat tvāt guṇavat tvāt ca iti ca śabdena prakāra antaram kriyāva tvena guṇava tvena ca iti darśayati anayoḥ lakṣaṇena abhisambandha upadarśana artham anuvādaḥ tathā ca tat kriyāvat tvam guṇavat tvañca anumeye pakṣe asti tad samāna jātīye ca sa pakṣe sarvasmin guṇavat tvam asarvasmin kriyāvat tvam asti iti ubhayam api etat adravye sattādā na asti eva iti tasya guṇavat tvasya kriyāvat tvasya ca yathā uktam vacanam apadeśaḥ iti siddham

etena sāmarthyāt apadeśa ābhāsāḥ nirastāḥ bhavanti iti svavākya parivarjana artham para vākye ca udbhāvanā artham saṃlakṣyate tatra idam sāmānya lakṣaṇam apadeśa vat ābhāsamānāḥ samyak matau apadeśa ābhāsāḥ aāhetra virapi va paryasta buddheḥ hetu dā d bhāsate iti samyak matau iti padam etasmir aṇa pakṣe anyatara asiddhasya samyak amatau hetu vat ābhāsamāna tvam cintyam a tasya hi para dharma tva ādima tvam iti atas hetu vat ābhāsamāna tvāt hetvābhāsāḥ iti siddham lakṣaṇam yasya tu hetuḥ api tasya pakṣa dharma tva ādi apadarśanena hetṛ tva pratipattau yatnaḥ kāya tpratipattertha pratipattau kāraṇa tvāt iti atas eva anyatara asiddhaḥ yadi api vṛttyā hetuḥ tathā api pakṣa dharma tayā pareṇa apratipanna tvāt asiddha buddhi janayatā pratipanne ca pramāṇataḥ pakṣa dharma tvena sādhya siddharbhāvāt hetuḥ eva iti

anye tu ahetavaḥ pakṣa dharma tva ādi anyatama rūpāna vidhānāt samāna hetvābhāsāḥ iti atha kiyatām punar evam anapadeśa tvam iti āha asiddha viruddha sandigdhān adhyava sita vacanānām anapadeśa tvam uktam bhavati iti tatra asiddhaḥ caturvidhaḥ iti vibhāgaḥ sāmānya lakṣaṇañca āśaṅkya māna pakṣa vṛtti tvam arthāt labhyate bhāśakyamāne hi pakṣe vattiḥ sarvasya viśeṣaṇa asiddha ādi prapañcasya asti iti pakṣa pāpāda sāmānya lakṣaṇam na ca evam pakṣa āvṛtti tvam tasya asamartha viśeṣaṇa ādi bhedeṣu asambhavāt

kena rūpeṇa caturvidhaḥ iti āha ubhaya asiddhaḥ anyatara asiddhaḥ tad bhāva asiddhaḥ anumeya asiddhaḥ ca iti tatra ubhayoḥ vādi prativādinā uḥ asiddhaḥ yathā anityaḥ sa avayava tvāt iti śabde hi sāvayava tvam nitya anitya vādinoḥ na prasiddha ta anyatara asiddhaḥ yathā anityaḥ śabdaḥ kāryatvāt iti mīmāṃsakasya atyabhijñāna ādikam apalabhamānasya śabde kāryatvam tāvat asiddham yāvat anyatara sadāsa dvāreṇa pramāṇataḥ vyavasthāpyate iti niścīyate niścite dhama tve tatas sādhyam pratipadyate eva tad abhāva asiddhaḥ yathā dhama bhāvenāgi adhigataḥ iti dhama tvena aniścitam vāṣpa ādikam upalabhamānasya agni adhi kartavyāyām tad bhāva asiddhaḥ dhūma bhāvasya aniścita tvāt iti anumeyāḥ ddhā yathā pārthivam dravyam tamaḥ kṛṣṇa rūpatva avat tvā diti sa ākhya abhyupagatasya tamasaḥ aprasiddha tvāt ayam āśraya asiddhaḥ na tu abhāva rūpatamaḥ apekṣayā tasya tu pramāṇena prasiddheḥ pakṣīkaraṇe kṛṣṇa rūpa tvam vat tvam sva rūpa asiddham natu āśraya asiddham iti

nanu evam viśeṣaṇa asiddha ādi prapañcasya asaṅa grahaṇāt ayuktaḥ ayam vibhāgaḥ na siddha anyatara asiddhe vā antarbhāvāt tathā ca ubhayaḥ viśeṣaṇā siddhaḥ yathā śabdaḥ anabhidheya tve sati bāhya indriya pratyakṣa tvāt bāhya indriya pratyakṣa tve ca anabhidheya tvāt iti ubhayaḥ viśeṣya asiddhaḥ yathā nityaḥ śabdaḥ kṛtaka tve sati amūrta tvāt evam anyeṣu api puruṣa viśeṣa abhiprāyeṇa atyādhuhyam iti asamartha viśeṣaṇā siddhaḥ yathā nityaḥ śabdaḥ prameya tve kṛtaka tvāta viparyayeṇa asamartha viśeṣya siddhaḥ iti vyadhikaraṇa viśeṣaṇā siddhaḥ yathā nityaḥ śabdaḥ cākṣuṣa tve sati kṛtaka tvāt viparyayeṇa ubhaya asiddhe anyatara asiddha vā natyaḥ śabdaḥ anabhidheya tve vyadhikaraṇa viśeṣya asiddhaḥ iti viruddha viśeṣaṇā siddhaḥ yathā nityaḥ śabdaḥ kāryatve sati amūrta tvāt iti anyathā siddha viśeṣaṇa asiddhaḥ yathā nityaḥ śabdaḥ abhyasyamāna tve sati amūrta tvāt iti

nanu evam api eṣām ubhayā siddhe anyatara asiddhe antarbhāva vat tad bhāvā siddhāḥ nu meyā siddhayoḥ api antarbhāvaḥ syāt iti katham cāturvidhyam tayoḥ avāntara bheda apekṣayā tad bhāva asiddhaḥ para artha anumānasya prastuta tvāt ubhaya asiddhaḥ anyatara asiddhaḥ ca iti bhidyate evam anumeya asiddhaḥ api iti cāturvidhyam anye tu ubhaya asiddham yatra viśeṣaṇam viśeṣyañca asiddham iti anyatarā siddhantu viśeṣaṇā siddham viśeṣya asiddham vā iti manyante na ca etat bhāṣyakatubhi pretam vādī abhiprāyeṇa udāharaṇa upanyāsāt anye tu sva artha anumānasya tad bhāva asiddhaḥ anumeya asiddhaḥ ca iti bhada sakala bheda saṅgrāhakaḥ para artha anumānasya tu ubhaya asiddhaḥ anyatara asiddhaḥ ca iti atra tu sva artha anumānena para arthasya bheda nirūpaṇam iṣṭam eva svātantryantu niṣidhyate

viruddha lakṣaṇam āha yaḥ hi anumeye pakṣe vyāptyai avidyamānaḥ api tad samā najātīye ca sa pakṣe sarvasmin na asti tad viparīte ca vipakṣe asti sa viparīta sādhanāt viruddhaḥ yathā yasmāt viṣāṇī tasmāt aśvaḥ iti viṣāṇinām piṇḍam pakṣīkṛtya aśvaḥ ayam iti sādhayataḥ viṣāṇi tvāt hāta hetu viruddhaḥ asya hi anaśvena eva vyāpta tvāt ayantu vipakṣa eka deśa vṛttiḥ vidyamānasapakṣaḥ tathā vipakṣa vyāpakaḥ nitya śabdaḥ kāryatvāt iti avidyamāna sa pakṣaḥ vipakṣa vyāpakaḥ sarvam kārya sarvajña kartakam prameya tvāt iti vidya mānasapakṣā vipakṣa eka deśa vṛttiḥ jīvat śarīram sa ātmakam kārya tvāt iti atas catuvidhaḥ

ekasmiḥ ca dvayoḥ hetvoḥ i atha ukta lakṣaṇa yoviruddhayoḥ sannipāte sati sa śaya darśanāt ayam anyaḥ sandigdhaḥ iti kacita yathā mūrta tva amūrta tvam prati manasaḥ kriyāvat tva asparśava tvayoḥ iti nanu ayam asādhāraṇaḥ eva acākṣaṣatva pratyakṣa tvavata saṃhatayoḥ anyatara pakṣā sambhavāt tatas ca anadhyavasitaḥ iti vakṣyāmaḥ

nanu śāstre tatra tatra ubhayathā darśanam saṃśaya kāraṇam apadiśyate iti na saṃśayaḥ viṣaya dvaita darśanāta saṃśaya utpattau viṣaya dvaita darśanam eva kāraṇam tulya bala tve ca tayoḥ paraspara virodhāt nirṇaya anutpādaka tvam syāt na tu saṃśaya hetu tvam na ca tayoḥ tulya bala tvam asti anyatarasya anumeyaḥ haśasya āgama bādhita tvāt ayantu viruddha bhedaḥ eva

yaḥ tu san anumeye vyāptyā tad samāna asamāna jātīyayoḥ sa pakṣa pāḥ san ā iva sa sandigdhaḥ anaikāntikaḥ sandeha janaka tvāt iti kārya upanyāsaḥ na tū lakṣaṇam a indriya ādiṣu api sat abhāvena ati vyāpaka tvāta jantu yathā yasmāda viṣāṇī tasmāda gauḥ iti viṣāṇinam piṇḍa bhārati sādhayataḥ viṣāṇi tvāt iti hetuḥ anaikāntikaḥ pakṣa traya vṛtti a ayantu sa pakṣa vyāpaka tve sati vipakṣaka deśa vṛttiḥ agauḥ ayam viṣāṇi śata sa pakṣaka deśa vatti tve sati vipakṣa vyāpakaḥ sa pakṣa vipakṣaka deśa nityaḥ śabdaḥ asparśavat tvātaḥ iti catavidhaḥ anekāntikaḥ

jaya cāturvidhyam anapapannam a anekāntikasya lakṣaṇañcā vyāpakam viruddhāḥ bhicārya sādhāraṇayoḥ akhyāpanādaḥ iti āśaṅkā pratiṣedha artham ekasmiḥ ca ityādi prakaraṇam dvayoḥ hetvaḥ vibhinna dharmi sthayoḥ sannipāte saṃśayāḥ yathā nityaḥ śabdaḥ kārya tvāta nityam ākāśam akārya tvāt iti vipakṣayoḥ san ā iva sa sa kārya upanyāsaḥ na tu lakṣaṇa pakṣīkṛtya gauḥ iti sādhayataḥ vi tvāt iti sa pakṣaka deśa vṛtti dvayoḥ ityādi prakaraṇam hara darśanāt yathā nityaḥ śabdaḥ kāyaḥ ekasmin dharmiṇī iti padam tathā athāḥ na saṃśayaḥ yathā anityaḥ śabdaḥ yathā ukta lakṣaṇayoḥ maṇi iti padam tathā atha api ekasmin dharmiṇi dvayoḥ sannipāte api yathā anityaḥ śabdaḥ kāryatvāt nityaḥ tu amūrta kārya tvāt iti tad artham

tathā api aviruddha artha sādhakayoḥ evaṃvidhayoḥ api na saṃśaya hetu tvam yathā nityaḥ śabdaḥ kāryatvāt āśritaḥ guṇa tvāt atas viruddhayoḥ viruddha artha sādhakayoḥ sannipāte saṃśayasya darśanāt ayam anyaḥ sandigdhaḥ anekāntikaḥ iti kecid udāharaṇantu yathā mūrta tva amūrta tvam prati manasaḥ kriyāvat tva asparśavat tvayoḥ iti mūrta manaḥ kriyāvat tvāt chatra vat iti ekaḥ amūrta manaḥ asparśavat tvāt ākāśa vat iti aparaḥ ubhayoḥ ca pakṣa dharma anvaya vyatirekavat tva upalabdheḥ kim mūrtam manaḥ syāḥ duta amūrtam iti saṃśayaḥ

tat asat abhayoḥ prayoga asambhavāt tathā hi ekasmin sādhane prayukta tasya nirduṣṭa tāyām sādhya siddha ranyasyaḥ upanyāsa anupapattiḥ duṣṭa tāyām vā sā eva asya abhidheya iti na ca paraspara viruddha artha sādhaka tvam eva anumānayoḥ doṣaḥ pramā genaḥ ubhayoḥ ekatra sadbhāva siddhau virodhasya abhāva prasaṅgāt avyabhicārya anumā nayoḥ ca avaśyam artha vyavasthāpaka tvam avyabhicārasya tad lakṣaṇa tvāt viparyaye tu vyabhicāri tvam eva yathā mūrtam manaḥ asparśavat tve sati kriyāvat tvāt amūrtañca kriyāvat tve satya sparśavat tvāt iti samastayoḥ prayogaḥ

tatra api asādhāraṇam iti āha nanu ayam asādhāraṇaḥ eva acākṣuṣa tva pratyakṣa tvavat saṃhatayoḥ anyatara pakṣa asambhavāt iti yathā hi rūpa ati indriya guṇavyati rekeṇa anya guṇānām guṇa vyavahāre sādhya sāmānyavat tvāt dravya tve sati niyamena ācā kṣuṣa tvam hetuḥ na sa pakṣe rūpa ādau asti na api vipakṣe ghaṭa ādau iti a sādhāraṇaḥ tadvat sahacarayoḥ kriyāvat tva asparśavat tvayoḥ anyatara pakṣā sambhavāt iti anyatarasmin sa pakṣe vipakṣe vā asambhavāt asādhāraṇa tvam na ca asya asaṅgrahaḥ iti āha tatas ca anadhyavasitaḥ iti vakṣyāmaḥ

yat vā cākṣuṣa tva pratyakṣa tva vat iti vā edha udāharaṇam yathā hi guṇaḥ śabdaḥ sāmānyavat tvāt dravya tve sati niyamena acākṣuṣa pratyakṣa tvāt andhāt iva diti asya sa pakṣaka deśe vartamānasya vipakṣāt atyantam vyāvṛttiḥ na ca evam kriyāva ttvā asparśavat tvayoḥ iti āha saṃhatayoḥ anyatara pakṣa asambhavāt iti

evam viruddha avyabhicāriṇaḥ asādhāraṇasyaca saṃśaya hetu tve nirākṛte sūtra virodha mudbhāvayan āha nanuśāstretatra tatra ubhayathā darśanam saṃśaya kāraṇam apadiśyate iti tatra tatra śāstre tasmiḥ tasmin sūtre dṛṣṭañca dṛṣṭa vat dṛṣṭa ca manasi māna abhisambaddhaḥ ubhayacā parāyā bhavati dṛṣṭañca manasi kriyāva tvam punar daṣṭena tulyam vartate iti sat asparśavat tvam atas viruddha sādhana abhisambaddham manaḥ dṛṣṭvā saṃśete ki mūtam uta amūrta manaḥ iti ayathā dṛṣṭam ayathā dṛṣṭañca a saṃśayaḥ iti asādhāraṇasya ca saṃśaya hetu tvam uktam yathā dṛṣṭam pakṣe dṛṣṭa sa pakṣe vipakṣe ca na dṛṣṭam atas ubhayathā dṛṣṭa tvāt

yat vā yathādṛṣṭam kriyāvat tvena punar ayathā dṛṣṭam aspara a ubhābhyām saha dṛṣṭa tvāt saṃśayaḥ iti uktam paraṇāha viṣaya dvaita darśanāt utpatteḥ asya eva vivaraṇam saṃśaya utpattau viṣa nam eva kāraṇam iti viṣaya dvaite dṛśyate iti viṣaya dvaita darśanam sāmā yasya vā dvaitam vaividhyam yasya tat tathā uktam sāmānyam tad arśanam eva paśaṣa anuvṛtti hetu tvāta saṃśaya kāraṇam na viruddha hetu sannipātaḥ

asādhāraṇa a viruddha viśeṣaiḥ saha anapalambhena tasya tad smāraka tva anupapatteḥ manu smṛti hetuḥ ca dharmaḥ saṃśaya kāraṇam na paraspara virodhī samāna bala māna bala tve ca tayoḥ paraspara virodhātaḥ itarasya itareṇa pratibandhātaḥ utpādaka tvam syāt na saṃśaya hetutvam taila ādinā abhyaktasya śāli svāṅakurānat pādaka tva vat iti abhyupagamya etat aktam paramārthataḥ jyāḥ tulya bala tvam asti anyatarasya amūrta manaḥ iti anumeya udde parādhi tvāt iti tathā ca āgamaḥ tad abhāvāt aṇu manaḥa saṃśayasya viṣaya dvaita darśanāt ura yat vā eta darśanam eva kāraṇam nyam eva viṣayasya vā dvara viruddha viśeṣa anuvṛtti hata dharmaḥ vā viruddhāva viruddha viśeṣa anusmṛti haru iti samāna bala tva nirṇaya anutpādaka tvam syāt na bījasya svāṅakura na ca tayoḥ tulya bala śasya āgama virodhi tvāt iti mūrta tvañca avyāpita vacanam apramāṇam tarhi manaḥ sadbhāva asiddhara āśrayā siddham anumāna māṇam tarhi me bhūta tva anabhyupagame mā avana yugapaj

atha idam vacanam apramāṇam tarhi manaḥ miti yathā ukta lakṣaṇa anupapattiḥ na ca tyāpi manaḥ sadbhāva siddhiḥ jñāna utpatti prasaṅgāta atas pratijñā na yathā ukta lakṣaṇam iti viruddhāt bhidyate iti vi panyāsāt sadbhāva siddhiḥ amartasya sakala indriya adhiṣṭhāyaka tvena yagapaja māt atas pratijñā vacanasya āgamena virodhāt amūrta anumānam kṣaṇāmati ayantu viruddha bhedaḥ pratijñā avasare abhihitaḥ eva bhidyate iti viruddha bhedaḥ kāla atyaya apadiṣṭaḥ duṣṭa pakṣa upanyāsa anantaram u

sūtra dvitayañcaḥ eka dharmi viṣaya tvena saṃśaya pratipādana artham iti vyākhyeyam tathā ca niyata sāmānya vastu pratiniyata viśeṣaiḥ sahacaritam ekadā dṛṣṭam punar te ttulyam anya viśeṣa a inābhūtam atas kāla antare deśa vyavadhāna vaśāt tat dṛṣṭvā saṃśete kim idam evam āhosvit evam na bhavati iti tathā eka dharmi viṣaya tve api yathādṛṣṭam iti kiñcid sāmānya vat vastu kenacid viśeṣeṇa saha dṛṣṭam ayathādṛṣṭam tat eva upalabdhi viśeṣa śūnyam viśeṣa antara sahitam dṛṣṭam atas ubhayathā dṛṣṭa tvāt ubhābhyām saha dṛṣṭa tvāt ubhaya śūnyasya upalabdhau tat smaraṇa tu asati saṃśayaḥ bhavati iti yathā devadattam sa keśam upalabhya punar niṣkeśam atas kāla antare tam eva veṣṭita śirasam upalabhamānasya kim ayam sa keśaḥ niṣkeśaḥ vā iti saṃśayaḥ bhavati iti

samasta sapakṣe tu asādhāraṇasya anadhyavasi tvam āha yaḥ ca san anumaya tad samāna asamāna jātīyayoḥ sa pakṣa vipakṣayoḥ asan eva saḥ anyatarā siddhaḥ anadhyavasāya hetutvāt niścaya anupādaka tvāt atas tad hetu tvāt anaḥ dhyavasitaḥ yathā sat kāryam utpatteḥ iti udāharaṇam sakala kāya mutpatteḥ prāk sadanu dutpadyamāna tvāt iti hetar na pratyā ākāśa ādāḥ na api khara viṣāṇa ādau iti anadhyavasitaḥ

na ca asya sūtreṇa asaṅgrahaḥ iti āha ayam aprasiddhaḥ anapadeśaḥ iti vacanāt avaruddhaḥ sa pakṣa vipakṣayoḥ aprasiddha tvāt iti evam asādhāraṇasya sa śaya hetu tve niraste satra virodha mada bhāvayan āha nanu ca ayam viśeṣaḥ saṃśaya mā āhataḥ śāstre talya jātīyeṣu sa pakṣeṣu artha antara bhūteṣu vipakṣaṣu ca viśeṣasya asādhāraṇa dharmasya ubhayathā sa pakṣe vipakṣe ca daṣṭa tvātaḥ iti anena asādhāraṇasya saśaya samiti āṅakya āha na sūtrasya anya artha tvāta sattā sambandhi atha śabda vācya tvāt ca kim dravyam gaṇaḥ karma vā śabdaḥ iti saṃśayaḥ na sambandhāt śrāvaṇa tvāt ca iti akte sūtrakāreṇa paraḥ brūte viśeṣasya upalabdhaḥ katham śabde saṃśayaḥ iti āśaṅakī āha masya iti na dravyasya gaṇasya karmaṇaḥ vā viśeṣaḥ śrāvaṇa tvam sāmānyam eva sampadyate kasmāta

yasmāta guṇa tve śabdasya sādhye sāyaṣu rūpa ādiṣa śakla tva ādi viśeṣaḥ guṇa tvena sahacaritaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ param sattā sambandhāt na amanyatamasya iti tulya jātīyeṣu rūpa ādiṣu artha antara bhūteṣaḥ utkṣepaṇa ādiṣu viśeṣaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ tathā pṛtha bhedānām draya dṛṣṭa tvāt dravya tvaguṇa śrāvaṇa tvam viśeṣaḥ tat dravya tva ādi vi sataḥ ayam viśeṣaḥ śrāvaṇa tvam guṇasya kāraṇam śrāvaṇa tvam na tu asa dhāraṇa dharma upalabdhau sa saṃśaya kāraṇa tvam anvayavyā na ca sarvasmāt vyāvṛtta bhāvāt saṃśayaḥ yuktaḥ

sadbhāva bhāvāt tasmāt sāmāna bhūtaṣu utkṣepaṇa ādiṣu karma tvena sahacaritaḥ utkṣepaṇa tva ādi dṛṣṭaḥ tathā pṛthivī ādiṣu pṛthivī tva adivya tvena iti dravya ādi dravya gaṇa karmaṇām a ekaikaśas pratyekam kaikaśaḥ pratyekam a viśeṣasya ubhayathā vara dravya tva guṇa tva ādi sahacaritasya dṛṣṭa tvāt upalabhyate ca śabde viśaṣaḥ tat dravya tva ādi viṣayam smaraṇam bhavati eva atas kim dravyasya paḥ śrāvaṇa tvam guṇasya karmaṇaḥ vā iti uktena nyāyena saṃśaya ṇa tvam na tu asādhāraṇa tvena ṣaṭsu api padārtheṣu asā palabdhau saṃśaya prasaṃṅgāt utkṣepaṇa tva ādi viśeṣa anupalabdheḥ ca svam anvaya vyatirekābhyām upalabdham na tad upalabdheḥ

na ca sarvasmāt vyāvattam viśeṣam upalabhamānasya viruddha viśeṣān asmatera sayā yuktaḥ sat abhāve api anucchedaḥ syāta nirṇaya utpatti kāraṇā tasmāt sāmānya pratyakṣāt eva saṃśayaḥ na viśeṣa darśanāt iti upasaṃhāraḥ yat vā viśeṣavat tvasya ubhayathā sa pakṣa vipakṣā viśeṣitasya upalabdheḥ tadu upalambhā saṃśayaḥ na saṃśaya kāraṇam asādhāraṇaḥ dharmaḥ ṣaṭsu api padārtheṣu saṃśaya prasaṅgāt iti śeṣam pūrvavat

atha apadeśa anantaram nidarśana svarūpa nirūpaṇa artham dvividham nidarśanam ityādi prakaraṇam dvividham iti vibhāgaḥ nidarśanam iti nirukti lakṣaṇam nidarśyate sādhya sādhanayoḥ bahi vyāptiḥ asmin iti nidarśanam dṛṣṭāntaḥ tathā nidarśāte sādhya sādhanayoḥ vyāptiḥ anena iti nidarśanam vyāpti pratipādakam dṛṣṭānta vacanam tathā hi nidarśanam itarasmāt bhidyate yathā ukta dṛṣṭānta vacana tvāt yaḥ tu na bhidyate na ca asau evam yathā pratijñādiḥ iti

tat kena rūpeṇa dvividham sādharmyaṇa vaidhayeṇa ca iti tatrā numeya sāmānyena sādhya sāmānyena liṅga sāmānyasya sādhana sāmānyasya anuvidhāna darśana sādharmya nidarśanam sādhana sāmānyam vyāpyam vyāpaka ca sādhya sāmānyam iti yat yat kriyāvat tat tat dravyam dṛṣṭam yathā śaraḥ iti udāharaṇam atra hi dravya tva vyāptau kriyāvat tvam sādhanam asti iti anumeya viparyaye sādhya viparyaye liṅgasya sādhanasya abhāva t aśana vaidharmya nidarśanam tat yathā yat yat adravyam tat tat kriyāvat na bhavati yathā sattā iti sattāyām hi dravya tva vyāvṛtyā kriyāvat tva vyāvṛttiḥ aḥ tāva vaidharya udāharaṇam

anena nidarśana ābhāsāḥ nidarśana vat ābhāsantaḥ iti nidarśana ābhā sat samāna dharmāṇaḥ nirastāḥ bhavanti iti sva vākye parivarjana artham para ca adbhāvanā artham nirūpyante tat yathā nityaḥ śabdaḥ amṛta tvāta yat amūrta dṛṣṭam tat nityam dṛṣṭam yathā paramāṇuḥ iti sādhanasyā tya paramāṇauvabhāvāta sādhana vikalam udāharaṇam asmin eva sādhye kamāta a sādhya vikalam nitya tvasya karmaṇi abhāvāt yathā sthālaḥ sāpakalam nitya tvasya amūrta tvasya ca sthālyām abhāvāt yathā tamaḥ māsiddham sāṃkhya abhyupagatasya tamasā uprasiddha tvāt ambara vat iti sāvya sādhana adhikaraṇa tve api ani nagataḥ vacana doṣaḥ yat yat amūrta dṛṣṭam natya dṛṣṭam yathā ambaram iti vacanam vinā anugatasya apratīteḥ

yat vā samyak dṛṣṭāntaḥ api ākāśā sattva vādinaḥ na sādhya siddhi karāti yāvat na pramāṇataḥ vyavasthāpyate iti ābhāsaḥ ucyā tājñāpana artham ittham bhūtaḥ iti anye tu ābhāsā avasare samyak adṛṣṭa anta upadarśanam ābhāsānām ābhāsa m ittham bhūtam hi nidarśanam etad pratirūpakāṇi ca tad ābhāsā tathā vyāpya vyāpaka bhāva pratipatti dravya tva upalabdheḥ samavyāptike api pattiḥ na syāt iti dūṣaṇa

yat yat dravyam tat tat kriyāvat dṛṣṭam iti ca vipa atā dravya tvam vyāpyam kiyāvat tvañca vyāpakam syāt āta mauvapratipattiḥ na ca etat asti ākāśa ādau kriyāvat tvam vinā api yaḥ samavyāpti ke api sādhanasya vyāpaka tva abhidhāne sādhyasya prati dāta dūṣaṇam viṣama vyāptike viparīta anugamaḥ doṣaḥ na samavyāptike atra upasaṃhāra vākyam liñca anameyaḥ ca ubhayañca āśrayaḥ ca iti pāśrayāḥ te asiddhāḥ yeṣu ābhāseṣu te tathā uktāḥ te ca ananu rāta anugatāḥ ca iti liṅga anumeya ubhaya āśraya asiddhān anugata viparītānaḥ iti ca anye atra upasaṃhāravāḥ jānu meya ubhaya āśrayāḥ te asiddhāḥ yeṣu ābhāsa tāḥ sādharmya nidarśana ābhāsāḥ

vaidharmya nidarśana ābhāsān darśayati yat anityam tat mūrtam dṛṣṭam yathā karma iti sādhana avyāvṛttam tasya hi amūrta tvāt iti tasmin eva sādhye yathā paramāṇuḥ iti sādhya avyāvṛttam vyatireka udāharaṇam paramāṇaḥ nitya tvāt iti yathā ākāśam iti ubhaya avyāvṛttam amūrta tvasya nitya tvasya ca tatra avyāvṛtti riti yathā tamaḥ iti dharma asiddham sāṃkhya abhyupagatasya tamasaḥ aprasiddha tvā diti ghaṭa vat iti ubhaya avyāvṛttau api avyatirekaḥ yat yat nityam na bhavati tat tat amṛtam na bhavati iti vacanam vinā vyatirekasya apratipatteḥ ghaṭā sattva vādinaḥ vā pramāṇena apratipāditaḥ na sādhya siddhi karoti iti ābhāsaḥ ucyate

yat niṣkriyam tat adravyam dṛṣṭam iti vyatirekaḥ sādhya vyāvṛttyā hi sādhana vyāvṛttiḥ vācyā na tu sādhana vyāvṛttyā sādhya vyāvṛttiḥ kriyāvat tva abhāve api ākāśa ādau dravya tvasya sādhyasya avyāvṛtteḥ sādhana abhāvaḥ hi vyāpakaḥ sādhyāḥ bhāvaḥ vyāpyaḥ iti eteṣām upasaṃhāraḥ liṅgat ca anumeyaḥ ca ubhayañca iti liṅga anumeya ubhayāni tāni avyāvṛttāni yeṣu ābhāseṣu te liṅga anumeyaḥ bhaya avyāvṛttāḥ te ca āśraya asiddhañca avyāvṛt tañca viparīta vyāvṛttañca iti liṅga anumeya ubhaya avi āvṛtta āśraya asiddha avi āvṛtta viparīta vyāvṛttāḥ vaidharmyani darśana ābhāsāḥ iti

evam saha ābhā sainidarśanam upadarthya anusandhāna nirūpaṇa artham āha nidarśane anumeya sāmānyena saha ityādi nidarśane dṛṣṭānte anumeya sāmānyena sādhya sāmānyena saha dṛṣṭasya liṅga sāmānyasya anumeye pakṣe anvānayana manu sandhānam ānayanam pratipādanam anyasya api sambhavati iti liṅgasya iti padam tathā api liṅgasya nidarśane pratipādanam asti iti tat vyudāsāya anumeya padam anumeye ca gṛhīta avinābhāvasya liṅgasya pratipādakam hetu vacanam api iti nidarśane anumeya sāmānyena saha dṛṣṭasya liṅga sāmānyasya iti padam atas anusandhāna mitarasmāt bhidyate nidarśane gṛhīta vyāptikasya liṅgasya anumeye anvānayana rūpa tvāt yaḥ tu na bhidyate na ca asau evam yathā pratijñādiḥ iti

saṅgraha ukte vivaraṇam āha anumeya dharma mātra tvena abhihitam liṅga sāmānyam na tu samartham iti mātrā abhidhānena darśayati anupalabdha śaktikam iti anupalabdhā śaktiḥ avinā abhāvaḥ yasya tat tathā uktam punar nidarśane anumeya dharma sāmānyena saha dṛṣṭam anumeye pakṣe yena vacanena anu paścāt sandhīyate pakṣa dharma tayā khyāpyate tat anusandhānam

tat api dvividham sādharmyaṇa vaidharyeṇa ca tatra anumeya sāmānyena saha liṅga sāmānyasya nidarśane sattvam upalabhya abhisandhatte tathā ca ayam kriyāvān vāyu riti vaidharmya nidarśane tu anumeyasya dravya tvasya abhāve ca tasya kriyāvat tvasyā sattvam upalabhya na ca tathā vāyu niṣkriyaḥ iti upasaṃhāraḥ niṣkriya tva pratiṣedhena kriyāvat tvam upasaṃharati iti pṛthak vacanantu pratiṣedha abhiprāyeṇa eva

nanu vyartham anusandhāna vacanam tad antareṇa api hetu vacanāt gṛhīta vyāptikāt sādhya siddheḥ na anena vinā abādhita viṣaya tvasya apratipatteḥ hetu vacanantu kāraṇa mātra upasthāpakam na tu gṛhīta vyāptikasya antar vyāpti pratipādaka miti yathābhūtena dravya tva avinā bhāvinā pramāṇa antara aviruddhena kriyāvat tvena kriyāvān karaḥ tathā ca vāyuḥ iti anta āpti pratipattiḥ tad abhāve tu bahis vyāpti sadbhāve api na gamaka tvam yathā śabdasya anitya tve sādhye sāmānyavat tve sati cākṣuṣa pratyakṣaḥ tasya kāla atyaya apadiṣṭa sya tvam ca iti atas eva atra upanaya vacanam na nirviṣaya tvāt apramāṇam

na ca upasaṃhāra vinā dharmi viśeṣeṇa sambandha aprasiddhau tatra eva sādhya viśeṣa pratipattiḥ syāt sva artha anumāna kāle ca upanaya arthasya upalabdheḥ kārya tat vacanam sva pratipatti anusāreṇa para artha anumāna pravṛtteḥ na ca sva pratipattau etasyā satvam avinā abhau a sambandha smaraṇa anantaram parāma śaṃjñānasya anubhavāt anabhyu pagame ca sambandha smaraṇasya aniyata tvāt niyata pradeśe pratipattiḥ na syāt iti uktam

tasmāt ayam iti aparokṣatā nirdeśasya avinā abhāva sambandha smaraṇa anantara mupalabdharasti parāmarśa jñānam atas tad upanyāsa artha kāryam anusandhāna vacanam iti atha pratyāmnāya svarūpa upadarśana artham anumeya tvena uddiṣṭe ityādi prakaraṇam anumeya tvena anumāna yogya tvena uddiṣṭe ca aniścite ca pareṣām saṃśayita viparyasta avyutpannānām punar niścaya āpādana artham pratijñāyāḥ punar vacanam pratyāmnāyaḥ

saṅgraha ukte vivaraṇam āha anumeye dharma mātre pratipādya tvena sādhya tvena uddiṣṭe ca aniścite ca pareṣām kim viśiṣṭānām hetu ādibhiḥ a vaya vairāḥ hita śaktīnām iti āhitā śaktiḥ avinā abhāvaḥ yasya liṅgasya yaḥ taiḥ tathā uktaiḥ teṣām etasmāt sādhanāt bhaviṣyati sādhya siddhiḥ iti ava kṛta āsthānām iti bhāvaḥ niścaya āpādana artham pratijñāyāḥ punar vacana pratyāmnāyaḥ iti punarukta mātra vyavaccheda artha pratijñāyāḥ punarvacanam iti padam tathā api anityaḥ śabdaḥ anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti punarukta vyu dāsa artham niścayā pādanā artham iti padam avipratipannasya etasmāt api niścayaḥ bhavati iti tat aya pareṣām iti tathā api teṣām madhye kasyacid eka avayava upadarśanena anvaya vyātara kānusmaraṇa dvāreṇa artha pratipattiḥ bhavati iti parisamāptena vākyena iti grahaṇam yasmin avayave sati vākyam parisamāpyate iti tat evam pratyāmnāya itarasmāt bhidyate yathā ukta lakṣaṇa tvāt iti

nanu pratijñā vacanasya tu vināśi tvena avasthāna asambhavāt katham punarvacana miti tad samāna śabda uccāraṇāt yathā kṣaṇika tve api karmaṇaḥ pūrvam samānāmi naya karaṇāt punar nṛtyati iti vyapadeśaḥ tadvat pratijñā asamāna śabda prayoga karaṇāra punar vacana bhiti vyapadeśaḥ bhavati eva atiśaye pūnaḥ śabdaḥ vivakṣita pratijñā pakṣaḥ tasya punarvacanam ghaṭataḥ eva

liṅga vākya artha vādinaḥ tu pratijñāyate anena iti pratijñā liṅgam tasya punarvacanam pratyāmnāya iti udāharaṇantu tasmāt dravyam eva iti etena adravya tva pratipādaka pramāṇa abhāvaḥ api upadarśitaḥ eva atha vyartham pratyāmnāya vacanam sambandha abhidhānāt eva vivakṣita artha prasiddhaḥ tat uktam

aḍiṇḍika rāgam parityajya akṣiṇī nimīlya cintaya tāvat ki iyata artha māttabhavati nava iti yadi iha bhavati kim anayā śabda mālayā na bhavati iti vācyam dṛṣṭa tvāt a natadevam pratijñā vacanam vinā anvayanī atireka aprasidvau sambandha abhidhāna sya āgamaka tvena pūrvam eva vyavasthāpita tvāt

atha pratijñādeḥ eva artha pratipādaka tvam astu ki pratyāmnāyena tathā hi pratijñā vacanaiviṣaya vyavasthāpanāt hetu udāharaṇābhyām vahiḥ vyāpti prasiddhau upanaya na antaryāpti upadarśane sati avaśyam abhipreta artha siddhiḥ iti satyam etata tathā api avaśyambhāvinaḥ arthasya pratijñādinā pratipāditasya pratipādana artham avaśyam kāya nigamanam iti āha na hi etasmin iti na pūrveṣām avayavānām samastānā tad artha vācaka tvam asti vyastānām itaretara vyāvṛtta sva artha vyavasthāpane caritāya tvam iti anyat atas vācyam yasya sahakāriṇām pūrva padānām samastānām api smṛti upa sthāpitānām vākya artha pratipādaka tvam iti

atha sādhanasya antar vyāpti bahis vyāpti abhidhāne sati sādhya viśeṣaḥ gamyaḥ eva iti āha gamyamāna artha tvāt iti ced na atiprasaṅgāta tathā hi pratijñāna hetu mātra abhidhānam kartavyam svatas eva viduṣām hetu upalambhe sati anvayamā reka anusmaraṇam tasmāt ca adhigatiḥ bhaviṣyati iti viśeṣa abhidhāna vaiyayam syāt

atha param pratipādayatā vacanena eva pratipādana kāryam iti śeṣāṇā prayā hi vākya artha pratipādana artham nigamanam api kāryam a na ca pratipādya amitrā prayogaḥ yuktaḥ tasya manuṣya dharmaṇā sākṣāt apratīteḥ avyavasthāpanāt ca tathā hi kāścad ekasmāt eva avayavāt artham pratipadyate kaścid dvābhyām anyaḥ tribhiḥ itya nava sthita tvāt pratipādyānām tad abhiprāyā niścaye prayoga anupapattiḥ eva syāt atas param pratipādayatā sva pratipatti upāya upadarśanam kāryam iti pañcānām prayogaḥ puratas tathā hi pradeśa stham dhamam upalabhya avinā abhau a sambandham smṛtvā tathā pāya dhūmavān iti parāmṛśati tatas sādhyam pratipadyate tasmāt agnimān iti jagamana arthasya api upalabdheḥ para pratipādanāya tad upanyāsaḥ yuktaḥ eva iti pañcānām bhāgaḥ kāryaḥ iti āha bhāṣya kāraḥ tasmāt atra eva artha parisamāptiḥ iti

anye tu antar vyāpti pratipādana artham nigamanam iti manyante anusandhānāt vyāpaka tva prasiddhau viparīta prasaṅga pratiṣedha artham nigamanam iti viparīta artha vyavasthāpaka pramāṇasya aprāmāṇya upadarśane sati pakṣe vyāptiḥ ca āyate eva yatra ca para pakṣa apratiṣedhaḥ tatra hetonam gamaka tvam yathā mūryaḥ atad putra tvāt upalabhyamāna tat putra vat iti atra hi tad putrasya amūrkha tve na cat bādhakam asti iti tad sādhaka pramāṇa abhāvaḥ ca niścitaḥ eva iti anyathā siddham sādhanam etat

atha avinābhūtasya pramāṇa virodha abhāvāna yuktam viparīta pramāṇasya aprāmā padaśanam iti ced na tad antareṇa avinābhā asya eva aprasiddheḥ tathā hi nitya tva pādaka pramāṇasya prāmāṇye sati na śabde kṛtaka tvasya anitya tvena vyāptiḥ yādāta na ca para pakṣa pratiṣedhakāt eva sva pakṣa siddhiḥ vyadhikaraṇa tvāt vārāpa vaiyarthya prasaṅgāt ca iti para pakṣa pratiṣedhe tu upadarśita bahis vyāptikam pakṣe palabhyamānam bhavati eva sādhanam iti nigamana prayogaḥ kāryaḥ

atha pratijñā vacanam eva para pakṣa pratiṣedha sahāyam sādhanam iti ced na tasya mātrā abhidhāyaka tvāta sādhyamaḥ iti arhati arthe śakya arthe vā kṛtya tābhi katha tad vacanāt tasya siddhiḥ tasmāt bahis vyāpti vat antāpti samarthayatā taviṣayatva asat pratipakṣa tva pratipādana artham eva avayava antaram abhidheyam

atha prakaraṇa sama kāla atyāpadiṣṭayoḥ api bahis vyāpti sabhāvāt gamaka tvam bhasti ca tayoḥ pakṣa vyāpaka tve satya nvaya vyatireka sadbhāvaḥ iti ayuktam etat tādātmya tad utpatti lakṣaṇa pratibandha āyattaḥ tu avyabhicāraḥ na bhavatī tyuktam vyāpti samarthana avasare tasmāt ukta nyāyena atra eva artha parisamāptiḥ iti

evam vibhinna prakaraṇeṣu avayavānām svarūpa upadarśane api ekatra tad svarūpa parijñāna apekṣayā praśnaḥ katham iti anityaḥ śabdaḥ iti anana aniścita anitya tva mātra viśiṣṭaḥ śabdaḥ kathyate iti pratijñā eṣā prayatnā nantarīyaka tvāt iti anena anitya tva sādhana dharma mātram abhidhīyate na tu samartham iti hetu vacanam iha yat prayatna ānantarīyakam tat anityam dṛṣṭam yathā ghaṭaḥ iti anena sādhya sāmānyena sādhana sāmānyasya anugama mātram ucyate hāta sādharya udāharaṇam nityam aprayatna ānantarīyakam dṛṣṭam yathā ākāśam iti anena sādhya abhāvena saha sādhanasya asattvam vyākhyāyate

pradaśyate śata vaidharya udāharaṇam tathā ca prayatna anantarīyakaḥ śabdaḥ na ca tathā prayatnā nantarīyakaḥ na bhavati iti anvaya vyatirekābhyām dṛṣṭa sāmarthyasya sādhana sāmānya sya śabde anusandhāna gamyate tasmāt anityaḥ eva śabdaḥ iti anana anityaḥ eva śabdaḥ iti pratipipādayiṣita artha parisamāptiḥ gamyate iti abhipreta atha siddhiḥ bhavati iti atas pañca avayavena eva vākyena pareṣām sva niścita artha prati pādanam kriyate iti siddham atra ca śabda viśeṣasya pakṣīkaraṇe prayatna ānantarīyaka tvam sādhanam vivakṣita miti jñeyam anyathā hi śabda mātra parigrahe prayatna ānantarīyaka tvam bhāga asincha syāt na hi prayatna anantaram sarva śabdānām janma asti iti

atha nirṇayaḥ vidyā antaram iti kecid taniṣedha artham viśeṣa darśana jam ityādi prakaraṇam para artha anumāna anantaram asya antar bhāva nirūpaṇam atra api antarbhāva śāpana artham nirṇayaḥ iti lakṣya nirdeśaḥ avaśiṣṭam lakṣaṇam avadhāraṇa jñānam hi viṣaya yajñānam api bhavati na tu viśeṣa darśanāt jāyate viśeṣa darśana jam ca ubha ca saṃśa yajñānam api iti avadhāraṇa grahaṇam

tathā api viśeṣa darśana jam avadhāraṇa jñānam nirṇayaḥ iti ukte vyabhicāra abhāvāt saṃśaya virodhi iti padam na viśiṣṭa nirṇaya lakṣaṇa artha tvāt yadi api padarśana jam avadhāraṇa jñānam iti sakala nirṇaya vyāpi idam sāmānya lakṣaṇam tathā api virodhi iti padam saṃśaya pūrvakasya nirṇayasya lakṣaṇa artham tathā ca naiyāyikaiḥ vimṛśya pakṣa pratipakṣābhyām artha avadhāraṇam nirṇayaḥ a taśaya pūrvakasya lakṣaṇam vimṛśya iti vimarśa kṛtvā pakṣa pratipakṣābhyām iti nābhyām sa punar sādhana dūṣaṇābhyām nirṇayaḥ iti

atha viśeṣa darśanāt saṃśayaḥ vyāvartate na nirṇayāt iti katham tat virodhi tvam upacāreṇa nirṇaya kāraṇasya saṃśaya virodhi tvāt nirṇayaḥ tavi rodhī iti uktam asya antarbhāvam āha etat eva pratyakṣam anumānam vā na jñāna antaram sāmagnī janyam hi pratyakṣam anumāna sāmagrījanyantu anumānam iti yat daśanāt saṃśaya virodhi utpadyate sa nirṇayaḥ iti prāktanasya vivaraṇam viśeṣa darśanāt saṃśayā

atra sthāṇu puruṣa yorūla tā mātra sādṛśya ālocanāt viśeṣaṣu apratyakṣeṣu ubhaya pānu smaraṇāt kim ayam sthāṇuḥ puruṣaḥ vā iti saṃśaya utpattau satyām śiraḥ pāṇi ādi viśeṣa darśanāt puruṣaḥ eva ayam iti avadhāraṇa jñānam indriya artha sannikarṣā ta pratyakṣa nirṇayaḥ viṣāṇa mātra darśanāt iti piṇḍa vyavadhāne api sya avaśiṣṭa viṣāṇa darśanāt gauḥ gavayaḥ vā iti saṃśaya utpattau satyām sāsnā mātra darśanāt avinā abhau a sambandha smaraṇe sati parāmarśa jñāna anantaram ravāyam iti avadhāraṇa jñānam anumāna nirṇayaḥ

atha smṛteḥ kārya kāraṇa viṣaya svarūpa nirūpaṇa artham liṅga darśana icchā anu smaraṇa ādi apekṣāt ityādi prakaraṇam liṅga darśana icchā anusmaraṇa ādi apekṣāt liṅgadarśanañca icchā ca anusmaraṇañcā iti tathā uktāni tāni ādiḥ yeṣām ityādi padena praṇidhāna ādeḥ grahaṇam tāni apekṣate iti tad apekṣaḥ tasmāta ātma manasā saṃyoga viśeṣāt iti asamavāyi kāraṇa nirdeśaḥ liṅga darśana icchā anusmaraṇa adha pekṣāt paṭavabhyāsa ādara pratyaya janitāt ca saṃskārāt iti nimitta kāraṇa nirdeśaḥ dṛṣṭa śruta anubhūteṣu artheṣu iti dṛṣṭaḥ pratyakṣeṇa śrutaḥ śabdena anubhūtāḥ anumānena

anye tu dṛṣṭaḥ cakṣuṣā anubhūtaḥ tvac indriyeṇa iti tatra liṅgam darśayati śeṣa anuvyavasāya anusmaraṇa icchā dveṣa hetuḥ iti upayuktāt liṅgāt anumeyaḥ śeṣaḥ saḥ anuvyavasīyate anena iti śeṣa anuvyavasāya parāmarśa jñānam tasya hetuḥ avinā abhāva sambandha smaraṇam tathā pada smaraṇā vākya smaraṇam sukha smaraṇāt icchaḥ duḥkha smaraṇāda dveṣaḥ iti atīta viṣayāḥ iti sva rūpa kathanam atītaḥ viṣayaḥ yasyāḥ sā tathā ukta iti nanu ayuktam etat vidyamāne api vastuni smaraṇasya darśana āt itya vyāta ativyāptiḥ ca anumāna ādeḥ atīta viṣaya tvāt iti

atha codanā eva bhūtam bhaviṣyantam viprakṛṣṭa ādikam artham prakāśayati nātha kiñcanaḥ indriya ādikam iti ced na anamānasya api atīta ādi artha prakāśana palambhāt tathā ca megha unnatyā bhaviṣyati vṛṣṭiḥ iti anumīyate nada āpūra viśiṣṭāt upariṣṭāt vṛṣṭiḥ iti uktam pratyakṣañca atra avinābhāva grāhaka yam anyathā vyāpti grahaṇa abhāve anumānam eva na pravarteta na ca anumānanāḥ bhāva grahaṇam anavasthā prasaṅgāt vartamānena ca avinā abhāva grahaṇe katham atīta ādi artha anumānam syāt anyena avinābhāva grahaṇe anyasya anumitau atiprasaṅgāt tasmāt atīta viṣaya tvam vyākhyeyampacāreṇa yatra hi viṣaye anubhavaḥ atītaḥ tatra smṛtiḥ utpadyate iti

anye tu atītaḥ vyavahitaḥ viṣayaḥ yasya anubhavasya asau atīta viṣayaḥ sa viṣayaḥ yasyāḥ sā atīta viṣaya iti prāpte sati ekasya viṣayasya lopaḥ draṣṭavyaḥ iti atīta anubhava viṣaya tvam labhyate iti manyante atha artha ja tvam eva smateḥ kasmāt na iṣyate artha vināśe api utpādāt yad daśa kāla āliṅgite anabhava jñānamatpannam tad ālambanam eva nyāyyam smṛti kāle tasya avidyamāna tayā viṣaya tva abhāvāt bāhya indriyāṇāñca smṛti janmani vyābhacārāt antaḥkaraṇasya vyāpāraḥ niścīyate na ca tasya svātantryeṇa bāha viṣaye vyāpāraḥ sambhavati iti anartha ja tvam eva nyāyyam avaśyañca yatva sati avyabhicāri tvā ādi dharma upeta tvāt pramā rūpa tāyām smṛteḥ pramāṇāḥ uttavācyā anamāna ādeḥ ca vyāpāra anupalabdheḥ antaḥkaraṇasya svātantryeṇa uttiā prāmāṇye sati smateḥ aparokṣa tvam syāta na ca etat asti tasmāniviṣaya tvam eva

atha ārṣa jñānasya kāraṇa viṣaya pramāṇa nirūpaṇa artham āmnāya vidhāta m ityādi prakaraṇam āmnāyaḥ vedaḥ śruti smṛti lakṣaṇaḥ tasya vidhātāraḥ katāraḥ teṣām ṛṣīṇām utpadyate yat prātibham jñānam iti pratibhayā kāra avaśeṣeṇa nirvatitam a yathā ātma nivedanam yathā tasya padārtha mā svarūpam tanivedanama tad ālambanam utpadyate tat ārṣam iti ācakṣate keṣu artheṣu utpadyate atīta anāgata vartamāneṣu kiviśiṣṭeṣu atīndriyeṣu dharma ādiṣu ādipadena paramāṇu ādeḥ grahaṇam iti grantha upanibadveṣu anupanibaddheṣu ca grantha upanibaddheṣu ātma ādiṣu anupanivaddheṣu ca paramāṇu ādiṣaḥ iyān dharmaḥ iti kutas kāraṇa ādeṣu yathārtha vijñānam ātma manasoḥ saṃyogāt asamavāyinaḥ dharma viśeṣāt ca nimittāt iti tat ta prastāreṇa ṛṣīṇāma taḥ tad ārṣam tat tu kadācid eva laukikānām api arṣīṇām evaṃvidham vijñānam asti iti kima smad ādīnām tra pramāṇam iti āha kadācid eva lokikānām tat prātibha jñānam iti yathā kanyakā bravīti śvas me bhrātā āganta iti na ca indriya ja tat tat vyāpāram vinā api utpatteḥ

atha bāhya indriyāṇām vyāpāra asambhave api antaḥkaraṇasya vyāpārāt pratyakṣa phala tvam sambandhaḥ api indriyeṇa saha bhrātuḥ saṃyukta viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāvaḥ tathā hi tad viśiṣṭam ātmānam deśam kālam vā ālambya utpadyate jñāna metat iti uktam paraiḥ tat ca asat asya aparokṣa tvān upa patteḥ yatra hi aparokṣa jñānam tatra eva indriya vyāpāra kalpanā kriyate na ca atra tat asti iti na ca bahis viṣaye viśeṣaṇe api manasaḥ svātantryeṇa vyāpāraḥ sambhavati iti uktam liṅga liṅgi sambandha anusmaraṇān anubhavāt ca na anumāna jam śabda vinā api utpattana śābdam atas pramāṇa antara phalam etat tathā praśne kṛte sati na pratyakṣa ādika nirdiśati api tu hṛdayam me kathayati iti brūte atha kasmāt pratyakṣa anumāna anantaram ārṣa jñānasya na nirūpaṇam asmad ādīnām tena vyavahāra abhāvāt yatas tat tu prastāreṇa ṛṣīṇām eva kadācid eva laukikānām iti

siddha darśanam vidyā antaram iṣṭam paraiḥ ta niṣedha artham āha siddha darśanam na śāna antaram iti ārṣa jñāna anantaram asya antarbhāva nirūpaṇam ārṣe api anta na avātham yat siddhānām darśanam utpadyate tat pratyakṣam eva keṣu artheṣu sūkṣma pāhatau aprakṛṣṭeṣu iti sūkṣmāḥ paramāṇavaḥ vyavahitā nāga bhavana ādayaḥ dādāndriya apekṣayā na tu siddha indriyāṇām vyavadhāyakam asti viprakṛṣṭā pādayaḥ teṣu siddhānām kim viśiṣṭānām mukta ātma vyavaccheda artham dṛśya ṇām iti kiñca teṣām sadbhāve pramāṇam iti āha dṛśyānām cit añjana ādi viyuktāḥ pratyakṣeṇa api upalabhyante kā punar teṣām siddhiḥ iti āha janapādalepakhaḍagagalikā ādisiddhānāmaḥ iti ādipadena cintāmaṇi vānā grahaṇam añjana ādi vaśāt ca siddha indriyāṇām sūkṣma ādi artha prakāśanam atas tat pratyakṣam eva na jñāna antaram iti

atha jyotiṣām ayanam dṛṣṭvā prāṇinām śubham aśubham vā bhaviṣyati iti jñānam śāntaram iṣṭam taniṣedha artham divya antarikṣa bhaumānām ityādi bhavam divyam ulkā pāta ādi antarikṣe bhavañca antarikṣam digdāha ādi bhūmau bhāvam bhaumam bhū sañcala na ādi teṣām graha nakṣatra sañcāra ādi nimittam upalabhya prāṇinām dharma adharma yovipākaḥ phala dāna sāmarthyam tad darśanam na jñāna antaram iṣṭam tat api anumānam eva liṅga darśana anubandha smaraṇa ādi janya tvāt

yat vā divya antarikṣa bhaumānām sura siddha manuṣyāṇām prāṇinām graha nakṣatra dinim ittam upalabhya dharma adharma yovipāka darśana miṣṭam tat api anumānam eva iti atha liṅaga anapekṣam dharma adharma ādiṣu darśanam iṣṭam tat api yadi indriya artha pāda parokṣam utpadyate pratyakṣam eva atha indriya artha sannikarṣam vinā eva dharma dutpadyate tathā api ārṣam iti āha pratyakṣa ārṣaya ranyatarasmin antarbhūtam iti buddhiā arati upasaṃhāraḥ para upagatāyāḥ baddhe vināśa paraḥ iti

atha buddheḥ anantaram sukhasya kārya kāraṇa svarūpa upadarśana artham anugraha lakṣaṇa sukham ityādi anugraha lakṣaṇam anugraha svarūpam yasmin utpanne sati ātmā anugṛhītam ātmānam manyate iti sraj ādi abhipreta viṣaya sānnidhye sati iti sraj ādayaḥ ca te abhipreta viṣayāḥ ca iti teṣām sānnidhyam anabhipratā rāga ādayaḥ sukha hetavaḥ na bhavanti iti abhipreta grahaṇam iṣṭa upalabdhiḥ ca indriyāḥ rtha sannikarṣaḥ ca iti tathā uktam tasmāt dharma ādi apekṣāt ityādi padena dikkā lādena haṇam tāni apekṣate iti tad apekṣaḥ tasmāt iṣṭa upalabdhi indriya artha sannikaṣāt dharma ādi apekṣāt ātma manasoḥ saṃyogāt asamavāyi kāraṇāt ātmani sukha mutpadyate anugraha abhiṣvaṅga nayana ādi prasāda janakam iti kārya nirūpaṇam anugṛhītiḥ anugrahaḥ sukha viṣayam jñānam

āsattiḥ abhiṣvaṅa gaḥ nayana ādi prasāda prasanna tā ādipadena mukha ādi prasanna tā gṛhyate iti tat etat asādhāraṇa tvā ditarasmāt bhedakam iti jñeyam na ca sarvam vivekinaḥ svarūpataḥ duḥkham anugraha ātmakasya sukhasya api anubhavāt ataeva na duḥkha abhāve sukha vyavahāraḥ iti vācyam vibhinna kāraṇa janyasya tīvratara ādi bheda bhinnasya pratibhāsanāt evam duḥkhasya api na sukha abhāva rūpa tā iti yat etat uktam sukham tat sannihite vastuni indriya artha sannikarṣāt utpadyata atīta anāgateṣu smaraṇa saṅkalpābhyām iti āha atīteṣu sukha sādhana smṛti jam anāgateṣu saṅkalpa jam iti etat heyam upadarśitam

yat tu viduṣām asatsu viṣaya anusmaraṇa icchā saṅkalpeṣa viṣayānuḥ raṇañca icchā ca saṅkalpaḥ ca iti tathā uktāḥ teṣu avidyamāneṣu āvirbhavati tad upādaka meva vidyā śama santoṣa dharma viśeṣa nimittam iti kāraṇa upanyāsaḥ vidyā tattva jñānam tasmāt tattva jñāninām sukham tathā śamaḥ rāga ādiāvināśaḥ tasmāt ca śānta manasām sukham santoṣaḥ viṣayeṣu alam pratyayaḥ tasmāt ca sukham keṣāścid dharma viśeṣāt ca iti anye tu vidyayā janitaḥ saḥ śamaḥ tasmāt sukham iti śeṣam pūrvavat

duḥkha nirūpaṇa artham āha upaghāta lakṣaṇam upaghāta svarūpam duḥkham iti tyata anena iti upahatam ātmānam manyate iti kāraṇam āha viṣa ādi anabhi viṣaya sānnidhye sati viṣa ādayaḥ ca te anabhipreta viṣayāḥ ca iti teṣām navya sati iti abhipretāḥ ca viṣaya ādayaḥ sūkha hetavaḥ eva iti anabhipreta grahaṇam a jānnaṣṭa upalabdhi indriya artha sannikarṣāt adharma ādi apekṣāta aniṣṭa upalabdhiḥ ca apāya sannikarṣaḥ ca iti tathā uktaḥ tasmāt adharma apekṣāditya ādi padena dikkālāde m tasmāt aniṣṭa upalabdhi indriya artha sannikarṣāda adharma ādi apekṣāt ātma manasoḥ saṃyogāt asamavāyi kāraṇa ādaḥ ātmani samavetam yat utpadyate tat daḥkham pagha ātadanyānām nimittam kāraṇam tat itarasmāt bhedakam iti jñeyam laghu sādiṣu iti kārya nirūpaṇam amarṣaḥ asahiṣṇu tā upahatiḥ upaghātaḥ lālambanam jñānam iti dainyam dīna rūpa tā daḥkhāt padyate iti tat etada māraṇa tvāt itarasmāda bhedakam iti jñeyam atīteṣu sarpa vyāghra caurāḥ duḥkha sādhaneṣu smṛti jam anāgateṣu saṅkalpajam iti

icchāyāḥ kārya kāraṇa svarūpa nirūpaṇa artham sva artham para artha vā ityādi aprāpte vastuni prārthanā rūpa tvāt iccha iti sva artham para artham vā iti vipratipatti nirāsa artham vibhāga kathanam na kevalam sva artham eva para artham api utpatti kāraṇam āha sā ca ātma manasoḥ saṃyogāt asamavāyi kāraṇāt utpadyate kim apekṣāt sukha ādi apekṣāt smṛti apekṣāt vā iti prayatna smṛti dharma adharma hetuḥ iti kārya nirūpaṇam śuddha abhisandhiḥ dhama hetuḥ duṣṭa abhisandhi śca adharma hetuḥ iti

anye api guṇāḥ kāma ādayaḥ santi ca śabde te ca kim na sucitāḥ iti ca udyasya parihāra artham antarbhāvam nirūpayati kāmaḥ abhilāṣaḥ rāgaḥ saṅkalpaḥ kāruṇyam vairāgyam upadhā bhāvaḥ iti evamādayaḥ icchā bhedāḥ tad viśeṣāḥ iti maithuna icchā kāmaḥ tad sadbhāve kāmī iti vyapadeśāt na icchā mātram iti abhyava haraṇa icchāḥ abhilāṣaḥ abhilāṣa lakṣaṇa icchā sāmānyena sarvasmin vastuni abhyavaharaṇam ādānam vivakṣitam tad icchā abhilāṣaḥ iti ca anye punar punar viṣaya anurañjana icchā rāgaḥ tena hi satā rāgī iti vyapadeśāt anāsan na kriyāyām anāgata kriyāyām icchā saṅkalpaḥ sva artham anapekṣya para duḥkha prahā ṇa icchā tad vināśa icchā kāruṇyam doṣa darśanāt viṣayeṣu parityāga icchā vairāgyam tat sadbhāve virakta vyavahārāt para vañcana icchā upadhā antar nigūḍha icchā bhāvaḥ iti yadi api icchā sarvāḥ antar na bāhya iti tathā api iyam anya apekṣayā kathañcid vijñāyate iti anta nigūḍhā iti ucyate cikīrṣā jihīra ityādi kriyā bhedāt icchā bhedāḥ bhavanti kartum icchā cikīrṣā hartum icchā jihīrṣa iti

dveṣa nirūpaṇa artham āha prajvalana ātmakaḥ prajvalana svarūpaḥ dveṣaḥ yasmin sati prajvalitam iva ātmānam manyate sa dveṣaḥ iti pūrvasya vivaraṇam sa ca ātmanasoḥ saṃyogāt asamavāyi kāraṇāt duḥkha apekṣāt smṛti apekṣāt vā ātmani utpadyate iti prayatna smṛti dharma adharma hetuḥ iti kārya nirūpaṇam yathā hi dveṣāt vadha ādau pravarttamānasya adharmaḥ bhavati evam yajana ādau pravarttamānasya dharmaḥ api iti bheda nirūpaṇa artham āha drohaḥ krodhaḥ manyuḥ akṣamāḥ amarṣaḥ iti dveṣa bhedāḥ tad viśeṣāḥ iti svāminaḥ apakāraḥ drohaḥ krodhaḥ tu yasmin utpanne śarīra indriya avayavānām vikāraḥ sampadyate manyuḥ apakṛtasya apa kartum asamarthasya kaṇṭha akṣa vikāra janakaḥ akṣamā asahiṣṇu tā amarṣaḥ apa kartuḥ varṣa ādi vyavadhānena api apa karaṇam

nanu ete sukha duḥkha icchā dveṣāḥ katham vijñānāt vyatiricyante samāna kāraṇa janya tvāt antar mukha ākāra tayā pratīyamāna tvāt ca iti kāraṇa bhedena hi padārthāḥ bhidyante iti uktam tat uktam tad atad rūpiṇaḥ bhāvāḥ tad atad rūpa hetu jāḥ tad sukha ādi kim ajñānam vijñāna abhinna hetu jam iti tathā hi kecid bhāvaḥ tad rūpiṇaḥ dhānya ādi rūpiṇaḥ anye atad rūpiṇaḥ tat vidharmāṇaḥ iti kasmāt tad atad rūpa hetu ja tvāt dhānya rūpāt kāraṇāt utpannā stad rūpiṇaḥ anye tu vilakṣaṇāḥ atad rūpiṇaḥ iti ukte satyāha yadi evam tad sukha ādi vijñānena abhinna hetu jam kim ajñānam iṣṭam

na etat evam abhede sādhye samavāyya samavāyi nimitta apekṣayā api samāna kāraṇa janya tvasya vyabhicārāt tathā hi ekasmāt samavāyi kāraṇāt utpadyante pāka jāḥ parasparam vibhinnāḥ ca iti asamavāyikāraṇantu pārthiva paramāṇu agni saṃyogaḥ teṣām ekaḥ eva tathā ekaḥ api uṣṇa sparśaḥ teṣām nimitta kāraṇam iti tad apekṣayā api vyabhicāraḥ sāmagra capa īkṣayā tu asiddham samāna kāraṇa janya tvam tasyāḥ pratikārya niyata tvāt uktañca ekatra sraj ādi apalakṣitā sāmagrī kāraṇam anyatra anyathā ābhata iti tathā pratiniyata jātaḥ prāgabhāvasya ca anupraveśe sarvatra sāmagrī bhedaḥ bhavati eva iti antar mukha ākāra tayā pratīyamāna tvañca jñāna dharmar vī abhicārī iti asti ca dharma dharmiṇoḥ bhedaḥ iti uktam tathā jñānasya anutpatti vināśābhyām vyabhicāraḥ tayoḥ antar mukha ākāra tayā pratāya māna tvam na ca bodha rūpa tā iti alam ati prasaṅgena

atha prayatnasya kāraṇa svarūpa vibhāga nirūpaṇa artham āha prayatnaḥ sarammaḥ utsāhaḥ iti paryāyāḥ lakṣaṇam asādhāraṇa tvāt tathā hi prayatnaḥ itara smāt bhidyate anādi kāla pravāha āyāta ittham bhūta paryāya abhidheya tvāt yaḥ tu bhidyate na ca asau evam yathā rūpa ādiḥ iti sa dvividhaḥ kāraṇa bhedāt iti āha jīvana pūrvakaḥ icchā dveṣa pūrvakaḥ ca jīvanam pūrva kāraṇam asya iti jīvana pūrvakaḥ sa katham vijñāyate iti āha suptasya prāṇa apāna santāna prerakaḥ iti suptasya prāṇa apāna santāna kriyā sā prayatna kāryā śarīra kriyā tvāt jāpa vasthāyām prāṇa kriyā ādi vat iti na param prāṇa ādi santāna prerakaḥ prabāyakā ca antaḥkaraṇasya indriya antareṇa prāpti hetuḥ iti yathā hi prabāyata yena eva indriyeṇa upalambhaḥ tena eva sambandha artham antaḥkaraṇasya nirindriya ātmā vartamānasya avaśyam karma abhyupeyam tat ca prayatna kārya parigṛhīta antara karma tvāt jāgrat avasthāyām tat karma vat atas eva na adṛṣṭasya eva atra kāraṇa anamānena prayatna kārya tva upalabdheḥ kāraṇa antarā sambhave ca adṛṣṭasyavānā kāraṇa tvam iṣyate iti

sthite hi sadbhāve jīvana pūrvakasya utpatti kāraṇam āha ātma manasoḥ pāgāt asamavāyi kāraṇāda viśiṣṭa dharma adharma apekṣā datpattiḥ iti itaraḥ tu raṇa dvaṣa pūrvakaḥ hita ahita prāpti parihāra samarthasya vyāpārasya kāyika vyāpārasya hetuḥ tathā śarīra vidhārakaḥ ca tena hi pratibaddham śarīre guru tvam na patanam ārabhate tasya utpatti kāraṇam āha ātma manasoḥ saṃyogāta asamavāyi kāraṇāt icchā apekṣāda dveṣa apekṣāt vā utpadyate iti

guru tvasya lakṣaṇa parīkṣā artham garu tvam jala bhūmyoḥ a ityādi prakaraṇam a pratyakṣa tve sati patana karma kāraṇa tvāt guru tvam itarasmāt miyata pada apekṣam vā lakṣaṇam jāḥ guru tvam rasaḥ api jala bhūna vā ca kāraṇa atiśayana bhāvena pāta atiśaya ābhā na asti iti na rasaḥ kāraṇa patana karma kāraṇam iti apratyakṣa grahaṇam jalabhūmyoti āśrayān arū vā lakṣaṇam jala bhūmyoḥ eva vartamāna tve sati patana karma kāraṇa tvāt a rasaḥ api jala bhūmyoḥ eva vartate na tu patana kāraṇam abhyupagame akāraṇa atiśayena kārya atiśayasya anyatra upalabdhaḥ pāṣāṇa āde rasa atiśayā tātiśaya abhāvaḥ pippalyādau ca tad sadbhāvena sat abhāvaḥ syāta sa śati na rasaḥ kāraṇam patana utpattau rūpa ādeḥ ca kāraṇa tve anala ādau api pad pātaḥ syāt na ca asti iti atas rūpa ādi vyatiriktam kāraṇam anumīyata maha patana karma ānameyamaḥ iti ādyasya hi patana karmaṇaḥ asamavāyi guru tvam dvitīya ādeḥ tu saṃskāraḥ api iti sa ca asau jala bhūmyoḥ eva kāraṇam guru tvam dvitīyāt ava vartate pratyakṣatā prasaṅgāt atha ca tat pṛthivī ādi guru tvaḥ

nanu tvac indriyasya vyāpārāta pañca palam daśa palam iti pratibhāsanāt satyakṣam na tvac indriyeṇa sambandha upapatteḥ pṛthivī ādi garu tvasya api pratyakṣatā prasaṅgāt atha ādheya gatam eva guru tvam paricchinatti tvac indriyam na cavya ādi guru tve asti iti nanu evam api makṣikā ādi guru tvam paricchindyāt tasya api ādheya gata tvāt iti na ca tasya aviśiṣṭa tvāt aparicchedaḥ pratyakṣa dravya sa mavāyasya aviśeṣāt atha adhas gati hetu tvam vaiśiṣṭayam tarhi tvac indriya samba ndhena adhas gati viśeṣam upalabhamānasya pañca palam daśa palam iti ānumānikaḥ eva pratyayaḥ

atha daśa palaiḥ tantubhiḥ ārabdhe paṭe guru tva atiśayasya anupalabdheḥ kāraṇaḥ eva guru tvam na tu kārye tat asat ubhayatra api pāta upalabdheḥ na ca sva gata gurutvā bhāve api āśraya antara guru tvāt eva patanam vāyu ādeḥ api pāta prasaṅgāt tasmāt uḥ bhayatrāpi kāryeṇa sadbhāva siddheḥ guru tvam asti iti avanati viśeṣa anupalambhaḥ ca kārye makṣikā ādi guru tva samparkeṇa api samānaḥ iti tathā hi tantuṣu mīyamāna makṣikā ādi samparke api avanati viśeṣāḥ na upalabhyante na ca tad guru tvasya asattva miti alam

atha guru tvasya pāta hetu tve kim iti sarvadā pātaḥ na bhavati pratibandhāḥ dityāha saṃyoga prayatna saṃskāra virodhi iti vṛnta phala saṃyogena pratibaddha na phale patanam ārabhate prayatna pratibandhāt ākāśa avasthiteṣu śakuniṣu guru tvam na patanam karoti dhanu nikṣipteṣu śareṣu guru tvam na patanam karoti vega ākhya saṃskā pratibandhāt eṣām apāye phala ādiṣu pāta darśanāt

tasya ca ābādi paramāṇu rūpa ādi vat nitya anitya tva niṣpattayaḥ iti ap ādayaḥ ca te paramāṇavaḥ ca iti tathā uktāḥ tad paramāṇu rūpa ādīnām iva iti yathā āpya paramāṇu rūpa ādīnām aniṣpadyamāna tvāt nitya tvam evam eva guru tvam nityeṣu āna ṣpatta ainityam anitye tu kāraṇa guṇa pūrva prakrameṇa niṣpadyamāna tvāt tad rūpava t evāni tyam iti atideśa arthaḥ

drava tvasya lakṣaṇa parīkṣā arthamāha drava tvam syandana karma kāraṇam iti syandana vakṣyamāṇam tad kāraṇam drava tvam iti ukte vegena vyabhicāraḥ tad artham tri dravya ta tathā api nidravyavatti tvam vegasya api sambhavati iti niyamena iti pada m ūhyam rūpantu niyamena tri dravya vṛtti na tu syandanakam akāraṇam sarasmā dbhidyate niyamena tri dravya vṛtti tve sati syandana karma kāraṇa tvāt iti

tat tu dvividham iti vibhāgaḥ kena rūpeṇa sāṃsiddhikam naimittika pati tayoḥ parasparam vailakṣaṇya nirūpaṇa artham āha sāṃsiddhikam apām viśeṣa guṇaḥ naimittika pṛthivī tejasoḥ sāmānya guṇaḥ iti paraspara bhedaḥ sāṃsiddhi tya guru tva vat nitya anitya tva niṣpattayaḥ iti yathā guru tvam nityeṣu aniṣpadya māna tvāt nityama anityeṣa niṣpatteḥ anityam kāraṇa guṇa pūrvakam āśraya vināśāt ca vinaśyati evam sāṃsiddhika drava tvam api iti atideśa arthaḥ

nanu ca ayuktam etat apām sāṃsiddhika dravya tvam iti himakaraka ādau anupa bhāt tat āha saṅghāta darśanāt sāṃsiddhika tvam ayuktam iti ced na etat evam patra salile sāṃsiddhika drava tvasya upalabdheḥ āpya paramāṇuṣu tad sadbhāva siddhau himakarakādaḥ tasya ānat pādāta pratibandhakam asti iti niścīyate tat ca anyasyāna palambhāt divya tejaḥ saṃyogaḥ eva iti āha divya tejaḥ saṃyuktānām āpyānām paramāṇūnām raspara saṃyogaḥ dravya ārambhakaḥ sa ca saṅghāta ākhyaḥ tena paramāṇu drava tvasya tibandhāt kārye himakaraka ādau drava tva anutpattiḥ iti tejaḥ sadbhāvaḥ tu sphoṭa ādi kārya anumeyaḥ tathā ca himakaraka asambandhāt upalabhyate sphoṭa ādi lakṣaṇam kārya śarīre vṛkṣa ādau ca dāhaḥ iti vilayanañcā asya divya tejaḥ sambandhāt avayave kriyā tatas vibhāgaḥ tasmāt saṃyoga nivṛttau dravya vināśe sati paramāṇavaḥ kāryam ārabhante tatra ca divya tejaḥ saṃyogasya pratibandhakasya nivṛtteḥ paramāṇu drava tvam kārye drava tvam ārabhate

na ca idam naimittikam sarpiḥ ādau iva punar saṃgraha anupalabdheḥ yathā hi naimittika drava tvam sarpiḥ ādau iti drutasya saṃgrahaḥ tathā ihā api syāt na ca etat asti iti naimitti kañca pṛthivī tejasoḥ agni saṃyoga jam katham iti avyutpanna praśnaḥ tatra āha sarpiḥ ādīnām kāraṇeṣu ityādi padena sūtra uktānām saṃgrahaḥ tathā hi sa pirjatu madhūcchiṣṭānām pārthivānām agni saṃyogāt drava tvam adbhiḥ sāmānyam trapu sosa loha rajata suvarṇānām taijasānām agni saṃyoga adrava tvam adbhiḥ sāmānyam iti atas sa pira ādi kāraṇeṣu ca paramāṇuṣu agni saṃyogā pekṣāḥ vega apekṣāt karma utpattau satyantataḥ vibhāgāḥ jāyante tebhyaḥ vibhāgebhyom dravya ārambhaka saṃyoga vināśaḥ tatas kārya dravya nivṛttiḥ tasya añca satyām agni saṃyogāt auṣṇya apekṣāt svatantreṣu paramāṇuṣu drava tvam utpadyate paramāṇavaḥ sa bhavāyi kāraṇam

agni saṃyogaḥ asamavāyi kāraṇam uṣṇa sparśī nimitta kāraṇa miti tatas anantaram utpanna drava tveṣu bhoginām adṛṣṭa apekṣāt ātma aṇu saṃyogāt karma utpadyate iti paramāṇuḥ samavāyi kāraṇam ātma aṇu saṃyogaḥ asamavāya kāraṇam bhoginām adṛṣṭaḥ nimitta kāraṇam iti tatas vibhāgebhyaḥ prāktana saṃyoga vināśe sati tebhyaḥ karmabhyaḥ paramāṇu antareṇa saṃyogāḥ jāyante tebhyaḥ saṃyogebhyaḥ dvacaṇukāṇi utpadyante tad ādi krameṇa dvi aṇuka ādi kāryam utpadyata tasmin ca dvi aṇuka ādau rūpa ādi utpatti sama kālam kāraṇa guṇa pūrva krameṇa drava tvam utpadyaraḥ iti pākaja utpatti nyāyaḥ atra draṣṭavyaḥ etāvān tu viśeṣaḥ tatra avaśyam rūpāvi nivṛttiḥ na ca evam drava tvasya iti

snehasya lakṣaṇa parīkṣā artham snehaḥ apām viśeṣa guṇaḥ saṅgraham aja ādi hetuḥ śata apām viśeṣa guṇaḥ rūpa ādiḥ api iti saṅgrahamṛja ādi hetuḥ iti padam saṅgrahaḥ piṇḍīkaraṇam mṛjā tu viśada tvam tat hatu tvāditarasmāt bhidyate nanu snehasya abhinava pallava ādau upalambhāt udaka viśeṣa guṇa tvam asiddham sa yukta samavāyena upalambhāt saṃyukta hi pallava ādinā udakam tat samaveta na hā gṛhyate tad apāye tasya anupalabdheḥ tathā snāna uttara kālam keśa ādau anagdha pratyaya darśanāt yathā ca saṃyogi āśraya vaiguṇya abhāve sarvasmin udake snigdha sāna nave sarvasyām pṛthivyām iti asya api guru tva vat nitya anitya tva niṣpattaya sasa nityeṣu nityaḥ anityeṣu kāraṇa guṇa pūrvaḥ āśraya vināśāt vinaśyati iti

saskāra nirūpaṇa artham āha saṃskāraḥ trividhaḥ kena rūpeṇa vegaḥ bhāvanā tasthāpaka tvena iti vibhāgaḥ eva asādhāraṇa tvāt lakṣaṇam iti tat lakṣaṇa citrya jñāpana artham etat tatra vegasya samāna jātīyāt bhedam āśrayañca nirūpa na āha mūrti matsū ityādi mūrtimatsu dravyeṣu na jñāyate kiyatsu tad artham pañcasu tathā api na jñāyate keṣu tad artham mūrtimatsu iti āśraya nirūpaṇam vā saṃskāra tve sati pañcasu mūrtimatsu eva vartamāna tvāt vegaḥ iti lakṣaṇam

kāraṇam āha nimitta viśeṣa apekṣāt karmaṇaḥ jāyate iti saṃyoga vibhāgayoḥ tvam iti nimitta viśeṣa apekṣāt iti viśeṣaṇam nimitta viśeṣaḥ nodanāḥ ati saṃyukta saṃyogāḥ tad apekṣāt iti karma asamavāyi kāraṇam sva kāraṇa sapāḥ nodana ādi nimitta kāraṇam vega ādhāraḥ tū samavāyikāraṇam itya raṇa tvāt lakṣaṇam ca idama kāryasā āha niyatāyām diśi kriyā prabandhasya kriyā santānasya hetuḥ iti

nanu ca ayuktam etat aniyata diga deśasya bhramaṇa ākhyasya api karmaṇaḥ kāraṇa tvāt satyam etat tathā api adoṣaḥ niyata dikriyā prabandhasya eva hetuḥ iti avadhāra ṇa anabhyupagamāt saḥ api niyatāyām eva diśi kriyā prabandhaḥ iti ca anye ani yatadikriyā prabandha hetuḥ iti avadhāraṇasya atra pūrva rūpa tām manyamānā vyākhyā antara kurvate tasya vināśa kāraṇam āha sparśava dravya saṃyoga viśeṣa virodhī iti sparśava dravya saṃyoga mātra virodhi tve vāyu saṃyogena virodha ādiṣoḥ gamanam na syāt tad hetoāgasya vināśāt iti viśeṣa grahaṇam kaṭhina avayava saṃyogena ādau āpa tad vināśa upalabdheḥ

nanu evam api ākāśe prakṣiptasya iṣaḥ nibiḍa avayava saṃyogasya vega vināśakasyāḥ bhāvāt apātaḥ syāt na aneka kārya karaṇe sparśava dravya saṃyoga mātreṇa api vinā śasya anvaya vyatirekābhyām upalambhāt tathā ca kṣiptasya iṣoḥ vega vināśa upalabdha ravaśyam kāraṇam abhidheyam nirhetuka vināśa pratiṣedhāt atas vāyu saṃyogena api aneka kārya karaṇe sati virudhyate adṛṣṭa prakṣayāt vā iti kvacid kāraṇa guṇa pūva prakrameṇa utpadyate yathā parvata srotasām adhas patatām saṃyoge sati ekasmin udaka samutpanne rūpa ādi vat kāraṇa vegāt begaḥ api iti

bhāvanā saṃjñakaḥ tu ātma guṇa tvāt itarasmāt bhidyate na ca buddhayā ādiā a bhicāraḥ saṃskārasya sataḥ avāntara viśeṣa nirūpaṇāt smṛti pratyabhijñāna haraḥ iti kārya nirūpaṇam sadbhāve pramāṇañca iti smṛtiḥ vāsanā ākhyāt bhavati tathā aktam ātma adhikāre keṣu smṛti pratyabhijñāna hetuḥ iti āha dṛṣṭa śruta anubhūteṣu iti nirṇīta artheṣu iti bhāvaḥ

nāśa kāraṇam āha jñāna mada daḥkha ādi virodhī iti jñānam pratipakṣa jñānam vivakṣitam tena virudhyate yathā ātma ādi jñāna janitaḥ saṃskāraḥ nairātmyā camyāsena iti tasmin sati tatra asmaraṇāt sva madena virodhaḥ bāla avasthā anubhava janita saṃskārasya punar yava avasthāyām viṣaya abhibhūtasya tatra asmaraṇāt utkhana yathā śāstra anubhava janita saṃskārasya tīvraṇa dāra ādi duḥkhena iti tena satā tatra asmaraṇāt ādi padena tu krodha ādeḥ api saṃskāra nivartaka tvam uktam

tasya utpatti kāraṇam āha paṭavabhyāsa ādara pratyayebhyaḥ jātaḥ tat pratyayaja ta paṭu pratyaya apekṣāt ātma manasoḥ saṃyogāt asamavāyi kāraṇāt ātmani āścarye arthe saṃskāraḥ jāyate yathā dākṣiṇāti asya uṣṭra darśanāt sa ca atiśayena smṛti hetuḥ bhavati iti vidyā śilpa vyāyām a ādiṣu abhyaḥ mānaṣu tasmin eva arthe pūrva pūrva saṃskāram apekṣamāṇā dattara uttarasmāt pratyayāḥ manasoḥ saṃyogāt saṃskāra atiśayaḥ jāyate pūrva pūrva saṃskāra apekṣaḥ hi sarāttara pratyayaḥ abhyāsaḥ tam apekṣamāṇāt ātma manasoḥ saṃyogāt asamavāyi kāraṇāḥ māna saskāra atiśayaḥ jāyate tatra vidyā āyāmaḥ upādhyāya uccarita pada śravaṇe kaḥ saṃskāraḥ pūnar vivakṣa ādi krameṇa svayam uccāraṇe sati tu jñānam pūrva skāra apekṣam saṃskāra antaram ārabhate punar tad uccāraṇe sati tat jñānam pūrva saṃskā pakṣa saṃskāra antaram ārabhate iti evam tri catur ādi parivarttane satyanti apada anubhavāt saskāra apekṣāta saṃskāra atiśayaḥ jāyate etat ca avaśyam abhyupeyam

anyathā savayathya syāt na ca atiprasaṅgaḥ adṛṣṭasya vyavasthā hetu tvāt na ca bhāsta sarvatra sat abhāvaḥ kāryasya smaraṇasya sarvatra anupalabdheḥ yatra hi ṇamāḥ ta tatra eva pūrva saṃskāra apekṣam jñānam saṃskāram ārabhate iti āntare pāsa pūrva pūrva saṃskāra apekṣam niyata artha smaraṇam eva saṃskāram ārabhate iti yam evam śilpe api apādhyāya likhita citra darśanāta saṃskāraḥ punar svayam pādha upalabhate tad anubhavaḥ pūrva saṃskāra apekṣaḥ saṃskāra antaram ārabhate punar svayam khatvā upalabhate tad ana bhavaḥ pūrva saṃskāra apekṣaḥ saṃskāra antaram ārabhate iti evam dvinyādi parivarttanena saṃskāra atiśayaḥ vyāyāme api upādhyāyena dhanurveda pari paṭhita nyāyena prayukteṣu upalambhāt upajāte saṃskāre punar tad anusāritayā svayam prayukta tad anubhavena pūrva saṃskāra apekṣeṇa saṃskāra antaram ārabhyate punar tathā eva prayoge sati tad anubhavena pūrva saṃskāra apekṣeṇa anyaḥ saṃskāraḥ iti evam antya anubhavāt saṃskāra atiśayaḥ iti

ādara pratyaya ja saṃskāram āha prayatlena manaḥ cakṣuṣi sthāpayitvā apūrvam artha didṛkṣamāṇasya iti draṣṭum icchataḥ vidyut sampāta darśanena tulyam vartate iti tad arśana vat ādara pratyayaḥ tam apekṣamāṇāt ātma manasoḥ saṃyogāt asamavāyi kāraṇā dātmani saṃskāra atiśayaḥ jāyate yathā devahrade sauvarṇa rājata padma darśanā diti tatra hi sauvarṇa rāja tapatrayoḥ utthānam āgamāt loka pravādataḥ vā samupalabhya puna viśiṣṭayā trā samaye prayatnena saṃskāra atiśayaḥ bhavati iti

sthiti sthāpakaḥ tu saṃskāra tve sati sparśavatsu eva dravyeṣu vartamānatvā ditarasmāda bhidyate kim bhūteṣu dhana avayava sanniveśa viśiṣṭaṣu iti ghanāḥ ca te avayavāḥ ca teṣām sanniveśaḥ racanā viśeṣaḥ ghanaḥ iti sanniveśasya vā viśeṣaṇam tad viśiṣṭeṣu kāla antara avasthāyiṣu sva āśrayam anyathā akṛtam yathāvat sthāpayati iti atas sthiti sthāpakaḥ

sadbhāve pramāṇam āha sthāvarāḥ ca jaṅgamāḥ ca iti tathā uktāḥ teṣām vikāreṣu dhanuḥ śākhā danta śṛṅga asthiṣu sūtra vastra ādiṣu ca bhagneṣu saṃvartiteṣu piṇḍī kṛteṣu tasya kārya saṃlakṣyate tathā hi dhanuṣi śākhā ādī ca ākarṣaṇa karmaṇi upa jāte nodana ādibhyaḥ tad nivṛttau api karma upalambhāt avaśyam asamavāyi kāraṇam vācyam vastunaḥ tad antareṇa anutpatteḥ na ca nodana ādeḥ anyatamaḥ sambhāvyate iti anyena asama vāyi kāraṇena bhavitavyam kriyā vibhāgayoḥ ca kriyā utpattau akāraṇa tva upalambhāt tathā tad nivṛttau api pratibandhaka abhāve sati śākhā ādau pūrva avasthā avasthāpaka karma upa lambhā nimitta antaram eva nyāyyam adṛṣṭa viśeṣasya tu sādhāraṇa tvāt kāraṇa tvam na pratiṣiddhayate iti nitya anitya tva niṣpattayaḥ api asya guru tva vat draṣṭavyāḥ iti yathā hi garu tvam nityeṣu nityam utpatti vināśa kāraṇa abhāvāt anityeṣu kāraṇa pūrvakam āśraya vināśāt vinaśyati evam sthiti sthāpaka saṃskāraḥ api iti kārye tu sthiti sthāpaka saṃskāra prasiddheḥ tad ārambhaka paramāṇuṣu api tad kalpanā kriyate

dharmasya lakṣaṇa parokṣa artham āha dharmaḥ puruṣa guṇaḥ ityādi puruṣa guṇa tvam buddhayā ādau api iti atas priya hita mokṣa hetuḥ iti priyam sukham hitam tad sādhanam navānām ātma viśeṣa guṇānām atyanta ucchittiḥ mokṣaḥ iti atha īśvara jñānam api eṣām hetuḥ atas kartuḥ iti yena hi kṛtaḥ dharmaḥ tatra eva priya hita mokṣa hetuḥ na ca evam īśvara jñānasya akārya tayā kartuḥ abhāvāt iti atha tattva jñānam kartuḥ yathā ukta phala hetuḥ tad artham atīndriyaḥ iti saṃskāraḥ api smṛti dvāreṇa eva bhavati iti atas antya sukha saṃvijñāna virodhi iti antyamāvasānikam sukham tad saṃvedanena virudhyate

nanu evam api atīndriya tve satyanti asukha saṃvijñāna virodhi tvāt dharmaḥ itarasmāt bhidyate iti ukte vyabhicāra abhāvāt vyartham śeṣa abhidhānam na anye svāt kartuḥ priya hita mokṣa hetuḥ iti viśiṣṭa artha kriyā nirūpaṇam puruṣa guṇaḥ iti anyathā bhāva pratiṣedha artham atha puruṣa guṇa tve kim pramāṇam anumānam āgamaḥ ca tathā hi tanu bhuvana ādi kāryam puruṣa guṇa pūrvakam vicitra kārya tvāt ratha ādi vat iti yathā hi ratha ādi kartā bhoktuḥ abhiprāyam vicitram apekṣamāṇaḥ tathā eva tat racanām karoti evam śarīra ādikā api iti na ca śarīra utpatteḥ pūrvam asmat ādi ātmani buddhayā ādayaḥ santi saṃskāraḥ tu smaraṇa utpattau eva avagata sāmarthyaḥ iti guṇa antaram tad gatama pakṣamāṇaḥ tad upabhoga niṣpattaye vicitram śarīra ādikam ārabhate iti āgamaḥ tu ayāvat ātmani dharma adharmom tāvat āyuḥ śarīram indriyāṇi viṣayāḥ ca iti tathā akṣīyante ca asya karmāṇī ati

yeṣāntu buddhi guṇaḥ dharmaḥ teṣām katham na akarma nimittaḥ svargaḥ tathā hi pralaya avasthāyām buddheḥ pradhāne pralīna tayā dharma adharmayoḥ anabhivyaktī pradhānasya buddhadhā ādi bhāvena pariṇāmaḥ na syāt abhivyaktasya karmaṇaḥ kāraṇatva abhyupa gamāt na ca ādau anabhivyaktam eva kāraṇam buddhi sthañcā abhivyaktam iti vācyam viśeṣa hetu abhāvāt buddhayā ādi sampāditam karma kartuḥ bhoga sampādakam iti abhyupagame ca aviśeṣeṇa sakala puruṣa upabhoga sampādakam syāt niyama hetu abhāvāt tathā mukta ātmanaḥ api śarīra ādi sampādanāya pravarteta aviśeṣāt iti saṃsāri tva prasaṅgaḥ guṇa puruṣa antara viveka ādarśanañca pradhāna pravṛtteḥ na kāraṇam pūrvam eva pratiṣedhāt

ye api paramāṇu rūpaḥ dharmaḥ iti manyante teṣām api tasya nityatāyām sakala kriyā vilopa prasaṅgaḥ maraṇa ādi abhāvaḥ ca anitya tā tu paramāṇu rūpa tāyām na sambhavati eva tasya parama aṇu tvena utpatti vināśa kāraṇa abhāvāt tathā paramāṇūnām dharma śabdena abhidhāne saṃjñā bheda mātram eva syāt atha paramāṇu guṇau dharma ādhau evam api sarva puruṣāṇām eka ākāraḥ bhogaḥ syāt puṇya apuṇyā dhikaraṇaiḥ paramāṇubhiḥ ārambha aviśeṣāt atha kecid puṇya adhikaraṇāḥ paramāṇavaḥ anye ca apuṇya adhikaraṇāḥ tatra adhikaiḥ puṇya adhikaraṇaiḥ ārabdhe sukha atiśayaḥ adhikaiḥ ca apuṇya adhikaraṇaiḥ duḥkham iti ced atra api tayā unitya tve maraṇa ādi abhāva prasaṅgaḥ anitya tvantu na yuktam paramāṇu viśeṣa guṇānām asmad ādi vyāpāreṇa upapatteḥ adarśanāt

anye tu anāśritaḥ dharmaḥ iti manyante tatra api anitya pakṣe na kiñcid anāśritam bastu bhūtam kārya sambhavati iti dūṣaṇam nitya pakṣe tu yāga ādi kriyā vilopa prasaṅgaḥ atha kriyā abhivyaktaḥ kārya kāraṇaḥ tarhi kṣaṇika tvena kriyā vināśe svarga ādi phalam na syāt na ca pradīpasya iva abhivyañjaka tvam tat prakāśa katvam kriyāyāḥ tad bhāve api tasya anupalambhāt atha yāga ādi kriyā dharmasya sāmarthyam upajanayati iti ced tarhi yat tat sāmarthyam saḥ eva dharmaḥ yatra āśritaḥ sa ca ātmā iti saṃjñā bheda mātram syāt tathā amūrtasya ātmanā sambandha abhāvāt tad sambandhi tvena phala abhāvaḥ iti alam prasaṅgena na ca bodha ātmakam eva karma vyati reka anabhyupagame bodha rūpa tayā sarvatra aviśeṣeṇa jagat vaicitrya aprasaṅgāt

tasya utpatti kāraṇam āha puruṣa antaḥkaraṇa saṃyogāt asamavāyi kāraṇāt upajāyate śuddha abhisandhi jaḥ iti abhisandhenimitta kāraṇa tvam darśayati varṇa āśramiṇām pratiniyatāni sādhanāni nimittam yasya asau tad nimittaḥ tat eva āha tasya tu sādhanāni śruti smṛti vihitāni varṇāḥ ca brāhmaṇa ādayaḥ āśramāḥ ca brahmacarya ādayaḥ teṣām sāmānya viśeṣa bhāvena avasthitāni dravya guṇa karmāṇi iti

tatra sāmānyāni sādhanāni dharme śraddhā bhakti viśeṣaḥ kāraṇam ahiṃsā tu yati ādeḥ sarvadā anyasya deśa viśeṣa īṣe kāla viśeṣe ca iti yathā tīrthe na haniṣyāmi amāvāsyā ādau bhūtarhi tvam api kasyacid sarvadā kasyacid deśa viśeṣa ādau iti satya vacanam dharma sādhanam yat na pareṣām aniṣṭam uktañca ana brūyāt satyam apriyam i ati asteyam acauryam kasyāñcit avasthāyām caurye api na dūṣaṇam iti uktam yathā mumūrṣaḥ dvijasya aśana mātra āharaṇam iti anupadhā parādrohaḥ brahmacaryam apatya sṛjaḥ karaṇasya upasthasya saṃyamaḥ tat ca kasyacid sarvadā kasyacid deśa kāla viśeṣaḥ iti krodha varjanam api evam abhiṣecanam snānam śuci dravyāṇām sevanam āsana paridhāna aśanaiḥ viśiṣṭa devatā bhaktiḥ iti trayī prasiddha anumāna avagata devatā viśeṣa bhaktiḥ upavāsaḥ ahorātram nairaśana tā kāla viśeṣa ādau dharma sādhanam apramādaḥ vihita anuṣṭhāne nirālasyam

brāhmaṇa kṣatriya viśām sāmānyāni dharma sādhanāni ijyā yajanam adhyayana veda pāṭhaḥ dānam sat pātrasya dravya nivedanam iti brāhmaṇasya asādhāraṇāni dharma sādhanāni pratigraha adhyāpana yājanāni pratigrahaḥ śāstreṇa anindita dravya ādānam veda pāṭhaḥ yājanam yāge paurohityam sva varṇa niyatāḥ ca saṃskārāḥ kṣatriyasyā sādhāraṇāni dharma sādhanāni samyak prajā pālanam asādhu nigrahaḥ yuddhaṣva nivartanam svakīyāḥ ca saṃskārāḥ vaiśyasya kraya vikraya kṛṣi paśu pālanāni svakīyāḥ ca saṃskārāḥ śūdrasya sarvadā brāhmaṇa ādi ājñayā vartanam amantrakāḥ ca uṅkāra ādi vijitāḥ kriyāḥ iti

āśramiṇā antu dharma sādhanāni acyante tatra brahmacāriṇaḥ ki viśiṣṭa tva guru kūle vasataḥ tad śīlam vā iti tad vāsinaḥ guru śuśraṣa agni indhana bhaikṣya ācaraṇāni guru śuśrūṣā tad upāsanam agni indhanam agni artham indhana āharaṇam bhikṣāṇām samūhā bhakṣa mādhukarī bhikṣā tad ācaraṇam madhu māṃsa divāsvapna añjana abhyañja na ādi varjanam etat ta prativedam dvādaśa varṣāṇi iti aṣṭacatvāriṃśat varṣāṇi vidyāvatam yāvat grahaṇam bhavet

tatas vidyā vrata snātakasya cīrṇa vidyā vratasya kṛta dārasya udvahita patnīkasya tyasya dharma sādhanāni ucyante te caturvidhāḥ vārtā vṛttayaḥ śālīna vṛttayaḥ pāvarāḥ ghora saṃnyāsikāḥ ca iti tatra vārtā vṛttayaḥ kṛṣi vāṇijyā ādi kama pata śāstraṇava yañjantaḥ śata saṃvatsarābhiḥ kriyābhiḥ yajantaḥ yājayanta māna prārthayante śālīnavattayaḥ tu yajantaḥ yājayantaḥ dadataḥ pratigṛhṇantaḥ śata saṃvatsarābhiḥ kriyābhiḥ ātmānam prārthayante yāyāvarāḥ tu adhīyantaḥ adhyāpayantaḥ yajantaḥ na yājayantaḥ dadattaḥ na pratigṛhṇantaḥ iti ātmāna prārthayante tatra ghora saṃnyāsikāḥ nāma uddhṛta para pūtābhiḥ abhiḥ pya kurvāṇāḥ pratidinam āhata uñcha vṛttim upajīvantaḥ śata saṃvatsarābhiḥ kriyāḥ jantaḥ ātmānam prārthayante udāharaṇa arthañca gṛhastha dvayam uktaḥ lāna śālīna

yāyāvara vṛtti upājita dravyaiḥ bhūta manuṣya deva pitṛ brahma ākhyānām yā mahā yajñānām sāyam prātaranaṣṭhānam sāyam a parā bāhya balinā bhata yajñaḥ hantakāreṇa atithi deya taṇḍulena manaṣya a puṣpa patra ādi utsargeṇa agni santarpaṇena deva yajñaḥ atidānena pitṛ yajñaḥ pacanana brahma yajñaḥ iti eṣām sāyam prātaranaṣṭhānam eka agni vidhānena ekaḥ agni kāle parigṛhītaḥ iti naimittikānāntu parasparam vyāvṛttam anuṣṭhāna bhedam darśayati pākayajña saṃsthā nāmaḥ ityādinā pākayajña saṃsthāḥ tu aṣṭakāḥ pārvaṇam śrāddham śrāvaṇī āgrahāyaṇī tathā catrī ca āśvayujī ca eva pāka saṃsthāḥ imāḥ smṛtāḥ yajñaḥ puṣpa patra ādi utsagaṇa veda adhyayanena brahma yajña na doṣaḥ iti tat eva āha

eṣāḥ ca nityānām śaktau vidyamānāyām anuṣṭhānam asamarthasya tu akaraṇe api na dośaḥ iti tat eva āha jarayā ha vai eṣaḥ etasmāt satrāt vipramucyate mṛtyunā vā iti agni ādheya anāñca havi yajña sasyātām agni ādheya anāñca haviḥ yajña saṃsthānām agni ādheyaḥ agnihotram sā ca cāturmāsya agrahāyaṇa iṣṭi nirūḍha paśu bandha sautrāmaṇī ca iti sapta haviryajña saṃsthāḥ agniṣṭomaḥ atyagniṣṭomaḥ ukthyaḥ ṣoḍaśī vājapeyaḥ atirā trāptoḥ yāmaḥ iti sapta homa yajña saṃsthāḥ tat āha soma yajña saṃsthānām agniṣṭomā dīnām iti evam anye api yajña viśeṣāḥ tad śāstra prasiddhāḥ eva grāhyāḥ iti ṛtu antareṣu brahmacaryam apatya utpādanañca vana sthasya dharma sādhanam āha brahmacāriṇaḥ gṛhasthasya vā vana vāsaḥ iti uktañca yadi vā brahmacaryāt eva pravrajet iti atas brahmacāriṇaḥ gṛhasthasya vai adhikāraḥ te api caturvidhāḥ vaikhānasāḥ audumbarāḥ bālakhilyāḥ

phenapāḥ ca iti tatra vaikhānasāḥ nāma akṛṣṭa pacyābhirauṣadhī bhima bahiṣkṛtābhiḥ agni paricaraṇam kṛtvā pañca mahāyajña kriyām nivartayantaḥ ātmānam prārthayante tatra audumbarāḥ nāma prātar utthāya yām diśam prekṣante tadāhṛtaiḥ badara nīvāra śyāmākaiḥ agni paricaraṇam kṛtvā pañca mahāyajña kriyām nivartayantaḥ ātmānam prārthayante tatra bālakhilyāḥ nāma jaṭā dharā cīra valkala saṃvṛta aṅgāḥ paurṇamāsyām vā kāttikyām puṣya ādi bhakṣa mutsṛjanta aṣṭau māsān vṛtti upārjanam kṛtvā pañca mahāyajña kriyām nivartayantaḥ ātmānam prārthayante tatra phenapāḥ nāma uddaṇḍa kānat mattāḥ śīrṇa patra abhibhojinaḥ yatra tatra vā vasantaḥ ātmānam prārthayante tat eva āha valkala ajina keśa śmaśru nakha romadhāraṇam vanya amba hutā atithi śeṣa bhojanāni vana sthasya iti yati āśramam upadarśa yat āha trayāṇām anyatamasya iti trayāṇām brahmacāri gṛhastha vānaprasthānām anya tamasya kim viśiṣṭasya
