śraddhāvataḥ sarva bhatebhyaḥ nityam sarvadā abhayam datvā uktañca na hisyāt sarva bhūtāni iti saṃnyasya svāni karmāṇi agni hotra ādīni yama niyameṣu apramattasya iti ahiṃsā ādayaḥ yamāḥ śuśrūṣā dayāḥ niyamāḥ teṣu apramattasya ṣaṣ padārtha prasaṃkhyānāt parijñānāt yoga sādhana pravajitasya iti yogaḥ eva tasya dharma sādhanam

ukta nyāyena te api caturvidhāḥ kuṭīcakāḥ bahadakāḥ haṃsāḥ paramahaṃsā śca iti kuṭīcakāḥ tridaṇḍa kamaṇḍalu kantha ādi dhāriṇaḥ jñāti gaheṣu bhojinaḥ bahudakāḥ nāma brāhmaṇa gṛheṣu bhikṣā āśinaḥ śūnya āgāra deva gṛha vāsinaḥ haṃsā nā śikhākamaṇḍalu daṇḍa hastā grāma ekarātra vāsinaḥ tīrtha ādiṣa tri pañca rātram eka pakṣa upavāsa ādibhiḥ ātmānam prārthayante paramahaṃsāḥ tu eka daṇḍa dharāḥ muṇḍāḥ kaupīna vāsasaḥ śikhā yajña upavītaka maṇḍala bhikṣā kapāla ādīn āñca tyāginaḥ sapāḥ dhas na adharmaḥ na satyam na ca ānatam sarva sahāḥ sarva samāḥ lāṣṭa aśma kāñcanāḥ eṣām caturṇām api dṛṣṭam prayojanam anuddiśya etāni vanāni bhāva prasādam śaddhā abhisandhiñcā apekṣya ātma manaḥ saṃyogāt asamavāyi kāraṇāt dharma utpattiḥ iti

na param dharmaḥ adharma upya ātma gaṇaḥ kartara hita pratyavāya hetuḥ atīndriyaḥ antya duḥkha sānāvarādhī iti atondriya tve satyanti adūḥkha saṃvijñāna virodhi tvāt adharṃaḥ itarasmāda bhidyate śeṣa parvavata tasya sādhanāni śāstre viprati māna dharma sādhana viparītāni hiṃsā nata steya ādīni hiṃsā prāṇi vadhaḥ anatama stayam cauryam a ādipadena anyeṣām api dharma sādhana viparītānām avarodhaḥ cakattavyasya saṃdhyā vandana ādeḥ akaraṇam vihita kāla atikrameṇa api ananuṣṭhānam ca ālasyam etāni nimittāni duṣṭa abhisandhi duṣṭa abhiprāyam ca apekṣyā manāsa yogāt asamavāyi kāraṇāt ātmani adharmaḥ tpattiḥ iti tpādakāni iti

idānīm kasya upajātam karma saṃsāra sampādakam kathañca nivarttakam iti upa darśayati aviduṣaḥ mithyājñānavataḥ dharma adharmau utpannau saṃsāram sampādayataḥ tat āha pravarttakāt saṃsāra sampādakāt dharmāt prakṛṣṭāt su alpa adharma sahitāt iṣṭāni ca tāni śarīra indriya viṣaya sukha ādīni taiḥ ki viśiṣṭaiḥ āśaya anurūpa karma anurūpaiḥ yogaḥ sambandhaḥ bhavati iti keṣu sthāneṣu brahma indra prajāpati pitṛ ṛṣi manuṣya lokeṣu iti tathā prakṛṣṭāt adharmāt su alpa dharma sahitāt aniṣṭa śarīra indriya viṣaya duḥkha ādibhiḥ yogaḥ keṣu preta tiyaṃga yoni sthāneṣu iti upasaṃhāram āha iti evam pravṛtti lakṣaṇāt tad svarūpa āt dharmāt adharma sahitāt deva manuṣya tiryak nārakeṣu punar punar saṃsārasya prabandhaḥ santānaḥ bhavati iti

pravartakāt dharmāt saṃsāra utpattim upadiśya nivarttakāt tad nivṛttim āha jñāna pūrvakāt tu kṛtāt iti jñānam pūrvam yasya sa tathā uktaḥ tasmāt kim rūpāt asaṅkalpita phalāt iti ittham me śarīra indriya viṣayāḥ sampadyantām na ittham iti ava na saṅkalpitam phalam yasya sa tathā uktaḥ tasmāt viśuddhe kule janma bhavati tasya jātasya daḥkha vigama upāya jijñāsā sampadyate kṛtaḥ sādhanāt atyantam duḥkha santate viyogaḥ sampadyate iti evam jijñāsoḥ ācārya upasaṅgamaḥ sampadyata tañca upasaṅgamya duḥkha santāna vyāvṛtteḥ uṣā ayam vijānāti tattva jñānāt śya sampadyate iti tatas śāstra abhyāsāta ṣaṭa padārtha tattva jñānam atpadyate tara ca utpanna ṣaṭpadārtha jñānasya ajñāna nivṛttiḥ bhavati tad nivṛttau virāgaḥ

kāraṇa bhāvena kāryasya anutpatteḥ viraktasya rāga dveṣa abhāvāt tābhyām jāyate yā dhana dharmom tau tad jau tayoḥ anutpattiḥ iti rāga dveṣa yodharma adharma janaka tvena upalabdha tad abhāve tad abhāvaḥ bhavati eva sañcitayoḥ ca nirodhaḥ tattva jñānāt apabhogāt vā tatas rāga ādi nivṛttau satyām nivṛtti lakṣaṇaḥ kevalaḥ dharmaḥ santoṣa sukham śarāra paricche

khedam ca utpādayati tat ca utpādya parama arthaḥ sarva padārthānām āranā tad darśanāt jātam parama artha darśana sakham karoti tatas kṛtvā nivarttate tadā nigata dharma adharma samākhyātam bījam yasya asau tathā uktaḥ tasya ātmanaḥ śarīra ādi nivṛttiḥ bīja abhāvāt eva punar śarīra ādyanat pattau satyām dagdha indhana anala vat apaśamaḥ mākṣaḥ iti yathā dagdha indhanasya analasya upaśamaḥ jvālā ādi rahitasya avasthānam avadati anta viśeṣa guṇa vimuktasya ātmanaḥ avasthānam mokṣaḥ iti nirṇītam ādi vākye

pariśeṣāta santānasiviḥ iti ) śabdasya lakṣaṇa parīkṣā artham āha śabdaḥ ambara guṇaḥ ityādi ambaraḥ uga tvāt śabdaḥ iti ukte saṃkhyā ādibhiḥ vyabhicāraḥ tad artham śrotra grāhyaḥ iti śabdaḥ tarasmāt bhidyate ambara guṇa tve sati śrotra grāhya tvāt iti kṣaṇikaḥ iti parokṣa artham parva pada apekṣam vā lakṣaṇam

nanu ca asiddham śabde kṣaṇika tvam pratyabhijñāna ādeḥ upalambhāt yam aham aśrauṣam śabdam tam etarhi śṛṇomi iti śrotuḥ vijñānam utpadyamānam upalabdham na ca idam apramāṇam anya tā grāhaka pramāṇa anupalabdheḥ tathā arthāpattyā ca dasya nitya tvam vijñāyate anitya tve hi saṅkata kāla anubhūta śabda vilaya uttara pala śabda antara upalambhāt asatitā tad artha pratipattiḥ na syāt sā ca upalabhyata śata tat anyathā anupapattyā śabdasya nitya tvam jñāyate

tat etat asat gṛhīta grāhi tvena pratyabhijñānasya apramāṇa tvāt anadhiga tārtha gantṛ pramāṇam iti sāmānya lakṣaṇa abhidhānāt atha anadhigata arthe pratya bhijñānam tat na adṛṣṭa artha tāyāḥ mithyātva prasaṅgāt atha svarūpeṇa adhi gata artham api idāni intanam deśa kāla ādi apekṣayā anadhigata arthañcā iti nanu evam api ubhaya doṣa upanipāta prasaṅgaḥ prameya sāmagryān ca deśa kāla ādeḥ antaḥ rbhāva abhyupagame anadhimata artha tvam etāvatā prameyasya pūrvam apratipatteḥ na ca śrotra vyāpāreṇa deśa kāla ādebra haṇam dṛṣṭam atha pramāṇa sāmagryām antarbhāvaḥ tarhi pramāṇasya anya tve api prameyasya tādavasthyāt adhigata artha viṣaya tvam eva tad apekṣayā caṃda viśeṣaṇam anyathā hi vyavacchedya abhāvāt anupapannam eva syāt

pramāṇa sāmagryā niyata vijñāna janaka tvāt sarvatra prameya bhedāt eva vijñāna bhedaḥ iti abhyupagama pratijñāna m anyatāyām kṣaṇika tā prasaṅgaḥ tasmāt anadhigata artha gantṛ pramāṇam iti ava vādinaḥ pramāṇam eva pratyabhijñānam tathā chinnodbhūta keśa nakha ādiṣu anya tve api sādṛśya vaśāt pratyabhijñānam sāmānya ādau ca artha tathā bhāvāt iti dvavidhyā palabdheviśeṣa anupalabdhau śabde pratyabhijñānam na ca vyañjakānām sandigdha tvāt apramāṇa tvam svatas prāmāṇyasya pūrvam eva pratiṣedhāt anyatas pramāṇāda abheda pratipatti abhyupagame ca tat eva astu alam pratyabhijñānena tathā vyañjakānā kṣaṇika tayā śabda jñāna anantaram eva tirobhāve śabdasya niviṣayam eva syāt pratyabhijñānam na ca vyañjakānām nitya tvam sarvadā śabda vyakti prasaṅgāt

atha pratyabhijñānāni athā anupapattyā tad kālam yāvat avasthānam na anyathā api tad bhāvāt anitya tve api sādṛśya vaśāt pratyabhijñānam utpadyate eva iti vivāda gocara āpannaḥ śabdaḥ abhivyaktaḥ pratyabhijñāna kālam yāvat na avatiṣṭhata śabda pratyaya viṣaya tvāt pūrva anubhūta śabda vat na ca pratyabhijñānam nitya tvāta pādanāya alam anitye api bhāvāt atha avasthāyi tvam sādhyate tatra api santata avasthāne tat eva dūṣaṇam avasthāna m ātrantu siddha sādhanam upalambha saṅketa smaraṇa krameṇa artha upalambhakāḥ yāvat avasthāna abhyupagamāt atha pūrva upalabdhe śabde varṣā divya vadhā namā pratyabhijñānāt antarāle avasthānam sādhyate na

anya tve api pratyabhijñāna upalabdhaḥ yathā bāla avasthāyām upalabdhe devadatte anya tve api vṛddha avasthāyām upa lambhāt pratyabhijñānam na ca atra avasthā bheda mātram eva śarīrasya iti vācyam avayava racanā parimāṇa rūpa ādi vyatirekeṇa tad anupalambhāt bāla avasthāyām hi śithila avayava racanā kumāra avasthāyām ca anyathābhūta iti tad bhedāt śarīrasya bhadaḥ avaśyam bhāvī asamavāyi karaṇa vināśena kārya dra vyasya vināśa upalabdheḥ parimāṇa bheda upalabdheḥ ca pūrva parimāṇa nivṛttau eva uttara parimāṇam

parimāṇavati parimāṇa ārambha pratiṣedhāt etat rupādiṣu api samānam parimāṇa vināśaḥ cā śraya vināśāt eva iti anya tvam eva bāla ādi śarīrāṇām parimāṇa bhedasya kuvalayādāḥ vanya tvena eva vyāpta tvāt atha parasparam vyāvṛttaḥ bāla ādi avasthā śabda abhidheyaḥ dhamaḥ tasya ca vyatireke vṛddha avasthāyām api bāla ādīnām upalambhaḥ syāt tenā virodhāt virodhe vā katham anya tvam asiddham avyatireke api teṣām āvirbhāva tirobhāvābhyām dharmiṇaḥ api tathā abhāva prasaṅgaḥ tasmāt śarīra bhede api sādṛśyāt saḥ eva ayam devadattaḥ iti jñāna vat śabde api pratyabhijñānam bhaviṣyati iti śabdaḥ palambhāt anantaram śrotra vyāpāreṇa eva tad abhāva pratīteḥ eka tva grāhakam pratyabhijñānama pramāṇam

karṇa śaṣkulī abhyupagame api kvacid śabdasya abhivyaktau tasya vyāpaka tayā sarva deśa avasthita puruṣāṇām upalambhaḥ syāt nirāvaraṇasya vyāpaka tva aviśeṣāt tathā eka deśāḥ tasya abhivyajyante teṣām abhede śabdasya eva abhivyaktiḥ iti tat eva dūṣaṇam bhede tu tad abhivyaktau katham śabdaḥ artham abhidadhyāt yadi ca śabda viśeṣaṇaḥ ca śabda abhāvaḥ paricchidyate viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāva lakṣaṇena eva sambandhena iti uktam pūrvam

atha śabdasya upalambha anantaram u manupalabdhiḥ mi añjaka abhāvāt na asattvā diti ced na sadbhāve pramāṇa abhāvāt āvaraṇa ādeḥ anupalambhāt ca na hi aindriya kasya atīndriyam āvaraṇam pramāṇena kvacid apalabdham abhyupagame api kvaci cśabdasya abhivyaktī tasya vyāpaka tayā sarva deśa avasthita puruṣāṇām upalambhaḥ syāt nirāvaraṇasya vyāpaka tva aviśeṣāt yadi ca śabda ātmakā niyata artha pratipāda kāḥ ca eka deśāḥ saṃjñā bheda mātram eva atha bherī daṇḍa saṃyogāt vega apekṣāt utpanna kriyaḥ vāyuḥ vegavān chrotra deśenāga tyā abhisambadhyate tad gatāni tu stimita vāyu antarāṇi protsārayati tatas pratibandhaka abhāve sati śrotram śabdasya grāhakam iti

nanu evam api aśeṣa śabda upa lambha prasaṅgaḥ saṃskṛte hi śrotra sarveṣām sānnidhyam na ca go śabda abhivyakti artha preritaḥ vāyu śva śabdam vyanakti iti vācyam vyañjakeṣu niyama anupalabdhaḥ yathā ghaṭa abhivyakti artham utpāditaḥ pradīpaḥ samāna indriya grāhya samāna deśa avasthita padārtha abhivyañjakaḥ iti tathā hi na śrotram pratiniyata saṃskāraka saṃskāryam samā na indriya gnāhi a samāna deśa avasthita vastu prakāśaka tvāt cakṣuḥ vat pradīpa a aṣṭabdha deśa vyatireka tā jñānam pradīpa saṃskṛtam na cakṣuṣā grahaṇam iti samāna deśa avasthita padam evaṃvidhāḥ ca rūpa rasa ādayaḥ na gṛhyante iti samāna indriya grāhya grahaṇam śabdāḥ vā vivāda viṣayāḥ pratiniyata vyañjaka vyaṅgyāḥ na bhavanti

samāna indriya grāhya samāna deśa avasthita tvāt ghaṭa ādi vat atra ca ye pratiniyata saṃskāraka saṃskāryāḥ na bhavanti cakṣa ghaṃṭa ādayaḥ te sa pakṣāḥ tatra hetoḥ sadbhāvaḥ tat vipa rītāḥ tu vipakṣāḥ tasmāt atyantam vyāvṛttiḥ iti pradīpena ca saṃskṛtam cakṣuḥ yugapad ghaṭa ādi prakāśakam iti dṛṣṭam evam śrotram api aśeṣa śabda upalambhakam syāt atra ca apekṣā buddhi vat aneka padārtha ālambanam eva ekam jñānam āśu bhāvena vā yugapad śabda prayogaḥ iti nanu ekasyām api pṛthivyām śukla ādi bhedānām saṃskṛtena api cakṣuṣā na yugapad prakāśanam evam ghrāṇa ādinā gandha ādeḥ iti evam api na hetoyvyabhicāraḥ sa pakṣaka deśa vṛtteḥ api gamaka tvāt

atha yathā cakṣuḥ samāna indriya grāhya samāna deśa avasthitānām api śukla ādi bhedānām na yugapad prakāśakam evam śrotram api syāt iṣṭañca pṛthivyāmanaka rūpa adhikaraṇa tvam api citra rūpa samarthana avasare satyam etata tathā api rūpa bhedānāḥ magrahaṇam saha kārya bhāvāt tathā ca nānā rūpa avayava upalambha sahakāri indriyam avaya vinyaneka rūpa grāhakam iti uktam tad sadbhāve vicitra pratibhāsanāt na para śrotrasya vāyunā saṃskṛtasya sarva śabdānām tatra sānnidhyāt agrahaṇe kāraṇam asti iti sāmānyāni tu pratiniyata vyañjaka vyaṅgyāni

na tu samāna deśāni sva avadha sarva gata tvāt eva iti vyabhicāra abhāvaḥ tathā ātapa sampad taiile gandha abhivyaktiḥ grīṣma avasāne tu dagdha sthalīṣu prathama jala dhara dhārā samparkāt na ca samāna deśa tvam yat vā jaladhara dhārā samparkāt bhū gata anila udbhave satya vayava kriyā krameṇa pravadravya nivṛttau utpanna pāka aidvari aṇuka ādi prakrameṇa dravya antara utpāde sati gandhaḥ abhi vyajyate iti yat ca abhivyajyate sāmānya rūpa ādi tat āśraya stham eva iti dṛṣṭam ekaḥ śabde api syāt tat tu na asti iti vyakti dharmaka tva abhāvaḥ

tathā vīṇā śabda abhivyañjakena rāsabha śabdasya api abhivyakta tvāt grahaṇe vīṇā śabdasya sarvadā anupalambhaḥ eva syāt na ca etat asti kvacid eva rāsabha śabdena vāṇā śabda ādi śabdānām abhibhava upalabdheḥ na ca ayam nitya pakṣe abhibhāvya abhi mavika bhāvaḥ ghaṭate tīvratara ādi bheda asambhavāt tīvrasya ca dhvanegrahaṇāt manda tyāgrahaṇam abhibhavaḥ na ca tīvraṇa vyañjakena ekasya grahaṇāt anyasya agrahaṇam upapadyate pajakeṣu niyama anupalabdheḥ iti uktam śabda pratyaya samāna adhikaraṇaḥ ca ayam tīvraḥ śabdaḥ mandaḥ śabdaḥ iti pratyayaḥ na vyañjaka pratyayena iti katham tīvratara ādi yajaka dharmaḥ tat evam tībra ādi bheda bhinna tvāt sukha ādi vat anitya tvam śabdānām jakānupalabdhau ca abhūtvā bhavanasya upalabdheḥ kārya tvāt anitya tvam ghaṭa ādi vat tathā paramātma guṇa anyatve sati vyāpaka viśeṣa guṇa tvāt sukha ādi vat tat ca ukta mā ākāśa adhikāre anitya viśeṣa gaṇam ākāśam salila ādi paramāṇu vyatireke sati bhūta tvāt kṣiti ādi vat pārimāṇḍalī ādhāra paratva anumeya paramātmā anya tve sati samavāyi kāraṇa tvāta kṣiti ādi vat eva

atha guṇa tve śabdasya anumānam na dravya karma jātīyaḥ śabdaḥ śrotra grahaṇa gyatvāt śabda tva ādi vat guṇaḥ śabdaḥ dravya karma anya tve sati sattā sambandhi pād rūpa ādi vat yat ca idam artha pratipatti anyathā anupapattyā śabdānām nitya tvam vajñāyate iti uktam tat asat anitya tve api sādṛśya upādāne satyartha pratipatte bhāvāt yatra yatra gakāra aukāra visarjanīyānām ittham bhūta ānupūrvīm upalabhase tatra go tva viśiṣṭaḥ arthaḥ pratipattavyaḥ pratipādayitavyaḥ ca iti saṅketa grahe sati pāvidham śabdam upalabhamānaḥ tam artham pratipadyate pratipādayati ca iti

tat evam anitya tve vyavasthite vināśa kāraṇam āha kārya kāraṇa ubhaya virodhi iti ādyaḥ śabdaḥ kāryeṇa virudhyate antyaḥ tu kāraṇam viruṇaddhi madhyamatāḥ tu yaṇa virudhyante kāraṇañca virudhanti iti saṃyoga vibhāga śabda jaḥ iti utpatti kāraṇam saṃyogāt vibhāgāt śabdāt ca śabda niṣpattiḥ iti sa dvividhaḥ kena rūpeṇa varṇa lakṣaṇaḥ avarṇa lakṣaṇaḥ ca iti akārāḥ dihakāra paryantaḥ varṇa lakṣaṇaḥ śaṅkha ādi nimittam yasya asau tad nimittaḥ avaṇa lakṣaṇaḥ iti ādipadena anyeṣām api nimitta kāraṇānām avarodhaḥ

tatra varṇa lakṣaṇasya utpattiḥ abhidhīyate ātma manasoḥ saṃyogāt asama vāyi kāraṇāt smṛti apekṣāt varṇa uccāraṇa icchā bhavati tad anantaram prayatnaḥ tam apekṣamāṇāt ātma vāyu saṃyogāt asamavāyi kāraṇāt vāyau samavāyikāraṇa karma sa ca utpanna karmā vāyurūvam gacchan kaṇṭha ādīn abhihanti iti ādipadā tālu oṣṭha ādeḥ grahaṇam tatas sthāna vāyu saṃyoga apekṣāt sthāna ākāśa saṃyoga āhaṇā tpattiḥ iti ākāśam samavāyi kāraṇam sthāna ākāśa saṃyogaḥ asamavāyi kāraṇa sthāna vāyu saṃyogaḥ ca apekṣā kāraṇam iti

avarṇa lakṣaṇaḥ api bherī ākāśa saṃyogāt utpadyate bherī daṇḍa saṃyogāya pekṣāt ityādi padena diś kāla ādegrahaṇam atra api ākāśam samavāyi kāraṇam bherī ākāśa saṃyogaḥ asamavāyi kāraṇam bherī daṇḍa saṃyoga ādi nimitta kāraṇam iti tathā veṇu parva vibhāga apekṣāt parva ākāśa vibhāgāt asamavāyi kāraṇāt ākāra śabdaḥ niṣpadyate iti

śabda jam śabdam upadarśayati evam saṃyogāda vibhāgāt ca pariniṣpan na śabdaḥ samantāt śabda antarāṇi ārabhate tasmāt api asamavāyi kāraṇāt sva kāra pratyāsati apekṣāt ākāśe anyaḥ śabdaḥ iti vīcī santāna vat śabda santāna yathā hi mahataḥ pāṣāṇa ādi abhighātādūpa jātā vīcī vīci antaram ārabhate sā api punar vīci antaram iti santānāḥ tadvat śabda santānaḥ iti evam santāna nyāyena śrotra deśam āgatasya grahaṇam

etat ca kalpyate anyathā karṇa śaṣkalyā kāśa saṃyoga upalakṣita nabhaḥ pradeśa vyatirekeṇa pradeśa antara samavāyāt teṣām avyāpya vatti tvena viśiṣṭa pratyāsatteḥ abhāvāt agrahaṇam eva syāt tat āha śrotra śabdayoḥ gamana asambhavāt santāna anabhyupagame na parasparam prāptiḥ prāptasya ca upalambhaḥ iti santānaḥ kalpyate nanu etasmin pakṣe śabdāḥ sva avaruddha nabhaḥ deśaḥ eva yadi śabda antaram āra bharan na kasya api upalambhaḥ syāta sarveṣām ekatra eva upakṣayāt atha pradeśa antare tāha brahma bhāṣitasya api upalambhaḥ asmad ādi śrotra deśe śabda antara ārambhāt

atha aṇu vivara mātre sva deśa anantaram ārabhate tarhi teṣām kṣaṇa śata ādi yavadhānena grahaṇam syāt tat tu na dṛṣṭam kṣaṇa dvaya ādi vyavadhānena śravaṇāt yāḥ ādyaḥ śabdaḥ śabda antaram na ārabhate śabda tvāt antya śabda vat antya śabdaḥ pā śabda antaram ārabhate śabda tvāt ādya śabda vat atas santāna pratiṣedhe śabda upa sambhāni atha anupapattyā vāyoḥ vyañjakasya āgamanam kalpyate ini manyante

na ca etat yuktam vyakti pakṣasya pūrvam eva pratiṣedhāt vāyārāgamane pramā māvāt ca na ca śabda upalabdhi reva pramāṇam santāna nyāyena api tad upapattaḥ paśca atra dūṣaṇam upanyastam tad vīcī nidarśana upanyāsāt nirastam yathā hi mahataḥ pāṣāṇa abhighātāt apajātā vīcī sva deśa anantara deśaḥ eva vīci antaram ārabhate na dādau evam śabdaḥ api sva kāraṇa pratyāsattim apekṣya anantara deśaḥ eva śabda antara bhārabhate iti na ca kṣaṇa śata ādi vya vadhānena grahaṇa prasaṅgaḥ ṣaṇṇām eva śabdānām tībra ādi bhedānām utpatteḥ tathā hi bherī daṇḍa abhighātāt upajāte śabde sānnihitasya tīvratamaḥ śabdaḥ iti jñānam tad anantaram vyavahitasya ca tīvataraḥ śabdaḥ iti jñānam

tatas ti ivaḥ mandaḥ mandataraḥ mandatamaḥ ca iti ṣaṭ bhedāḥ maṇa anubhūyante iti naḥ ānantya pakṣa uktaḥ doṣaḥ tathā hi bherī daṇḍa abhiṣā pādakaḥ eva śabdaḥ kalpitam bhūyāṃsam pradeśa vyāpya upajāyate iti anekaiḥ apyu palabhyata vāta na sarvatra santānaḥ yat ca id am uktam ~ na ādyaḥ śabdaḥ śabda antaram ārabhate śabda tvāt antya śabda vat iti tat na svatantra sādhanam svayam ādi anta śabda aprasiddhaḥ na ca dṛṣṭānta dāānti karmiṇoḥ aprasiddhau hetoḥ pakṣa dharma tvam bahis vyāptiḥ vā sambhavati iti atha para vyāptyā parasya aniṣṭa āpādanam etat tat na yadi pramāṇa pāvakā para vyāptiḥ tayā eva vādhyamāna tvāt viparīta anumānasya anutthānam jaya apramāṇa pūrvikā

tarhi prameya aprasiddha ra āśraya asiddham sādhanam dhāsiddhaḥ ca dṛṣṭāntaḥ iti śabdasya śabda antara ārambha pratiṣedhe svayam ādi anta viśeṣaṇa aprasiddhaḥ tasmāt vyakti pakṣa pratiṣedhe śabda upalambhāni atha anupapattyā santāna kalpanā kriyate iti na ca antya śabdasya ārambhaka tva parikalpanāyām pramāṇam asti sarvadā upalambha prasaṅagāt atas antya śabdasya sparśa vat adravya saṃyoga eka artha samavāyena pralayaḥ sva jñānāt upabhoga prāpaka adṛṣṭa apakṣayād vā iti vināśasya pramāṇena upalabdhaḥ tasya ca nirhetuka tva pratiṣedhāt ukta kāraṇāt eva vināśaḥ kalpyate iti alam

idānomitara padārtha vaidhapeṇa sva bheda vyāpakam utkṣepaṇa ādīnām sādhamyam tathā paraspara vyāvṛttam vaidhayam kāraṇañca nirūpayan āha utkṣepaṇa ādīnām iti na param dvayoḥ trayāṇāñca ki tarhi pañcānām api karma tva sambandhaḥ kamatvā palakṣitaḥ samavāyaḥ tathā ca utkṣepaṇa ādīni itarasmāt bhiyanta karmāṇoti vā vyavahartavyāni karma tva abhisambandhāt iti eka dravyavatva miti ekañca tat dravyañca iti eka dravyam tat asya asti iti eka dravya vāda tasya bhāvaḥ eka dravyava tvam ekam karmakasmin eva dravye vartata tara meva ekasmin iti kūtaḥ etata ekasmiḥ calite sarveṣām calana anupalabdhaḥ yatra api bahanām eka kālam calanam tatra api aneka tvam eva

kāraṇasya abhidhātā pratyāśrayam bhedāt anyatra ca samavetam abhighāta ādi anyatra samacāra kāraṇam iti abhyupagame ca aśeṣa dravya āśritasya utpattiḥ aviśeṣāt tathakāna dravye saṃyogāt vinaṣṭe karmaṇi āśraya antare api tasya ekatāyām vināśaḥ syātas ekasmiḥ ca aneka karma abhyupagame viruddha diś abhimukha tāyām parasparam prativara agamanam eva syāt eka diś abhimukha tā yāñca ekena eva karmaṇā saṃyoga vibhāgayoḥ janita tvāt na dvitīyasya sadbhāve pramāṇam asti tat uttara sa yogāt ca prāktana karma vināśaḥ karma antara utpattiḥ ca kvacid iṣi ate eva tasmāt yatra karma dvaya pratibhāsaḥ tatra āśu bhāvi tvena eva iti draṣṭavyam atha eka dravyavat tvam rūpa ādeḥ api iti kṣaṇika grahaṇam tathā api buddhayā ādibhiḥ vyabhicāra parihāra artham mūrta dravya vṛtti tva padam

atha kṣaṇika tve sati mūrta dravyeṣu eva vartamāna tvāt karma iti ukte vyabhi cāra abhāvaḥ satyam tathā api pada antaram sādharmya mātra pratipādana artham parīkṣā arthañca iti gurutva drava tva prayatna saṃyogebhyaḥ jāyate iti gurutva drava tva prayatna saṃyoga jam tasya bhāvaḥ tattvam iti udāharaṇañca etat anyasmāt api kāraṇāt tad utpatteḥ vyaḥ tañca guru tva ādikam kāyantira sampādakam api na samaditam karma vyatirekeṇa anyasya iti asādhāraṇam eva na ca evam sakala karma bheda vyāpakam iti vaidharnā mātram eva yat vā guru tva ādi anyatama kāraṇa janya tvam vivakṣitam a tathā sva kārya saṃyoga virodhi tvam iti saṃyoga mātreṇa vināśa adarśanāt iti sva kārya grahaṇam karma kārya tvañca vibhāga vega yoḥ api iti tatra vyabhicāra vāraṇāya saṃyoga grahaṇam atas sva kārya saṃyoga virādhi tvam asādhāraṇam api kvacid āśraya vināśena api vināśāt na pakṣa vyāpaka miti vaidharmya mātram eva tathā vibhāge saṃyoge api ca kartavye nirapekṣa kāraṇa tvam karmaṇaḥ svarūpam

nanu vibhāge anapekṣa kāraṇa tvam iṣṭam saṃyoge tu paśca abhāvinam prāktana sa yoga vināśam apekṣate iti anapekṣa tvam asiddham vastu bhūta kāraṇa apekṣayā tad upapatteḥ abhāva vyatirekeṇa ca vastu bhūtam kāraṇam na apekṣate iti anapekṣa miti uktam na ca anyasya etat sambhavati iti asādhāraṇam asamavāyi kāraṇa tvam iti asādhāraṇam itarasmāt vyāvṛttam guṇānām hi vaividhyam asamavāyi tvam nimitta tvañca utkṣepaṇa ādīnām ca asamavāyi kāraṇa tvam eva na dvaividhyam asti iti vipakṣāt atyantam vyāvṛttiḥ eva dvaividhya jāta paṃdhasya vivakṣita tvāta tathā sva para āśraya samaveta kārya ārambhaka tvam yā asman āśraye samavetam karma tatra āśraya antare ca samavetam vibhāgam saṃyogam ca ārabhate iti samāna jātīya anārambhaka tvam tathā ca utpannam karma vibhāgam saṃyogam ca ārabhamāṇam upalabdham na karma antaram iti ekasmim dharmiṇya nekasya karmaṇaḥ pūrvam eva pratiṣedhāt dravya anārambhaka tvam na karma dravyamā rabhate tasya uttara saṃyogena vinaśyat avasthasya kāraṇa tva asambhavāt iti sva bheda vyāpakam sādharmyam pratiniyata jāti yogi tvam iti pratiniyata jāti rutkṣepaṇa tva ādikā tad yogi tvam pañcānām api diviśiṣṭa kārī ārambhaka tvañca viśeṣaḥ parasparam iti

tat eva āha tatra utkṣepaṇam yad ūrdhvam bhajante iti ūrva bhājaḥ taiḥ saṃyoga kāraṇam adhābhābhiḥ ca vibhāga kāraṇam karma utpadyate kebhyaḥ keṣu ca iti guru tva dvatva prayatna saṃyogebhyaḥ samasta vyastebhyaḥ tad utkṣepaṇam iti udāharaṇa artham vega ādeḥ api tat kāraṇa tvāt śarīra avayaveṣu hasta pāda ādiṣu tad sambaddheṣu musala ādiṣu iti āśraya nirūpaṇam

tad viparīta saṃyoga vibhāga kāraṇam karma apakṣepaṇam iti ūrdhva bha abhi vibhāga kāraṇam adhobhāgbhiḥ ca saṃyoga kāraṇam iti ākuñcanam ṛjunaḥ dravyasya ye ayāvayavāḥ teṣām tad deśaḥ tad upalakṣita ākāśāḥ dipradeśa evibhāgaḥ saṃyogaḥ ca mūla pradeśaiḥ iti tad upalakṣita ākāśa ādi pradeśaiḥ eva yena karmaṇā samutpannena avayavī kuṭilaḥ san nṛjuḥ sampadyate tat prasā raṇam iti yat aniyata diś deśa saṃyoga vibhāga kāraṇam tat gamanam iti ukta pradeśebhyaḥ anye aniyata dika pradeśāḥ taiḥ saṃyoga vibhāga kāraṇam iti

upasaṃhāram āha iti etat pañcavidham api karma sat pratyayam asat pratyayañca iti pratyayaḥ kāraṇam tat ca sāmānya padena api sat iti viśeṣaṇāt prayatna ākhyam eva vivakṣitam pāramparyeṇa vā pratyaya kārya tvāt prayatnaḥ pratyayaḥ iti uktaḥ atas sat pratyayaḥ yasya tat tathā uktam karma prayatna pūrvakam iti yāvat asat pratyayam ayatna pūrvakam tat ca śarīra avayaveṣu tad sambaddheṣu bhavati iti etasmāt yat anyat tad apratyayam ayatna pūrvakam asmad ādi prayatnasya tatra avyāpārāt tat ca eteṣu anyeṣu ca dravyeṣu bhavati utkṣepaṇa ādi vilakṣaṇa tvāt gamanam eva iti karmaṇām jāti pañcatvam ayuktam kutas gamana aviśeṣāt gamanāt abhedāḥ diti ākṣepaḥ tat eva āha sarve kṣaṇikam kṣaṇika tvam nāma sarva karmasu samāna miti na svarūpa bhedāt bhedaḥ calana mātram utpannam sva āśrayasya saṃyoga vibhāgān karoti kaiḥ saha

ūrdhvam adhas tiryaka paramāṇu vivara mātraiḥ pradeśaiḥ iti yāvati pradeśe paramāṇoraṇa praveśaḥ sambhavati iti na kārya bhedāt api bhedaḥ sarvasya api etat kārya janaka tvāt tathā sarvatra ca gamana pratyayaḥ aviśiṣṭaḥ iti ūrdhvam gacchati agra pradeśāt ca mūla pradeśam gacchati mūlapradeśāt ca agra pradeśam gacchatoti tasmāt gamanam eva sarvam iti upasaṃhāraḥ na vargaśas pratyaya anu vṛtti vyāvṛtti darśanāt iti pratisamādhāna vākyam yat uktam sarvam gamana miti etat na utkṣepaṇa ādi vargeṣu pratyaya anuvṛtti vyāvṛtti darśanāt tat eva āha iha utkṣepaṇam para tra apakṣepaṇam iti evamādi sarvatra vargaśas iti varge varge pratyayā nu vṛttiā vṛttiḥ ca dṛṣṭā tathā hi utkṣepaṇam utkṣepaṇam iti utkṣepaṇa varge anuvartate

apakṣa paṇa ādi vargāt ca vyāvarttate tathā apakṣepaṇam sva varge anuvartate bheda antarāt ca vyāvatteta iti tat hatuḥ anugata vyāvṛtta jñāna hetuḥ utkṣepaṇa tva ādi sāmānya viśeṣaḥ avagamyate iti na gamana tvam ekam eva sāmānyam utkṣepaṇa ādi bhedānām paraspara vyāvṛtta jāti sambandhinām sadbhāvāt udādhupa sarga viśeṣāt teṣām paraspara viśeṣaḥ tathā hi utpūrva kṣepaṇam utkṣepaṇam apapūrvam apakṣepaṇam āt pūrva kuñcanam ākuñcanam prapūrvam sāraṇam prasāraṇam gamanam tu upasarga ābhāḥ vādeva viśiṣyate pratiniyata diś a viśiṣṭa kāryārambha tvāt upalakṣaṇa bhedaḥ api u rakṣepaṇa ādīnām siddhaḥ iti tathā ca ūvam saṃyoga kāraṇam adhas ca vibhāga kāraṇa mutkṣepaṇasya upalakṣaṇam iti evam āyuktam upalakṣaṇasya ca utkṣepaṇa tva ādeḥ bhedaḥ iti

evam api pañca eva iti avadhāraṇa anupapattiḥ utkṣepaṇa ādibhyaḥ atiricyamāneṣu niṣkramaṇam praveśanam ityādiṣu vargaśas pratyaya anuvṛtti vyāvṛtti darśanāt sāmānya viśeṣa sadbhāve sati karmaṇām ānantyam aniṣṭam anuṣajyate atha kārya bhedāt niṣkramaṇa ādiṣu pratyaya anuvṛtti sadbhāvaḥ na sāmānya viśaṣesadbhāvāt iti parāśayam āśaṅkya āha utkṣepaṇa ādiṣu api kārya bhedāt eva pratyaya anuvṛtti vyāva tiprasaṅgaḥ iti

yathā bahis deśena saṃyoga karaṇāt antardeśena ca vibhāga jananāt niṣkramaṇam viparītañca praveśanam evam urdhva deśena saṃyoga jananāt adhas deśena vibhāga jananā cca utkṣepaṇam ityādi bhaviṣyatoti atha utkṣepaṇa ādiṣu niṣkramaṇa ādiṣu ca samāne vargaśas pratyaya anuvṛtti vyāvṛtti sadbhāve sati utkṣepaṇa ādīnām eva jāti bhedaḥ na niṣkramaṇa ādīnām iti atra na viśeṣa hetuḥ asti iti

etat na jāti saṅkara prasaṅgāt tat āha niṣkramaṇa ādīnām jāti bhedāt pratyaya anuvṛtti vyāvṛttau satyām jāti saṅkaraḥ viruddha jāti samāveśaḥ prasajyate sa ca anyatra anupalabdheḥ aniṣṭaḥ yadi api sattā dravya tva ādi para apara bheda bhinnam ekasyām vyaktau asti tathā api na go tva aśva tva ādi upalabdham atra ca ekasyām vyaktau niṣka maṇa tva praveśana tva jāti prasaṅgaḥ katham iti āha dvayoḥ draṣṭroḥ ekasyām karma vyaktī yugapad niṣkramaṇa praveśana pratyayau dṛṣṭau iti kasya tat karmati āha ekasmāda pavarakāt apa varaka antaram gacchataḥ puruṣasya iti tathā hi dvayoḥ apavarakayoḥ ekam eva dvāram iti ubhayatra vyavasthitayoḥ puruṣayoḥ anyasmiḥ ca brajati puruṣe viśiṣṭa saṃyoga vibhāga upalambhāt yugapad niṣkramaṇa praveśana pratyayau dṛṣṭau eva

tathā ca dvāra pradeśe praviśati niṣkramati iti ca yaḥ hi draṣṭā svāpa vara kānta deśe vibhāgam bahis deśe ca saṃyogam upalabhate tasya niṣkramati iti pratyayaḥ bhavati yaḥ tu svāpavarakāḥ nta deśe saṃyoga bahis deśe ca vibhāgam upalabhate tasya praveśana pratyayaḥ bhavati yadā tu pratisīra ādi javanikā ādi apanītam bhavati ityādi padena anyasya api kuḍya ādeḥ āvaraṇasya apanayanaḥ tadā viśiṣṭasya kārya bhedasya anapalabdhar na niṣkramaṇa pratyayaḥ na api praveśana pratyayaḥ kim tarhi

gamana pratyayaḥ eva bhavati tasmāt atasyāḥ gamana vyaktau viruddha jāti samāveśa prasaṅgāt kārya bhedāt eva pratyaya bhedaḥ iti uktam tathā nālikāyām vaṃśa patra ādau patati draṣṭaṇām adhiḥ tiryak vyavasthitānāḥ yugapad bhramaṇa patana praveśana pratyayāḥ dṛṣṭāḥ iti jātīnām bhramaṇa tva ādīnām saṅkara prasaṅgaḥ iti sva pakṣe doṣa parihāra artham āha na ca evam utkṣepaṇa ādiṣu pratyayasakaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ yasya bhayāt viruddha jāti samāveśa prasaṅga parihāra artham kārya bhedena bhedā abhyupa gamyate iti upasaṃhāram āha tasmāt utkṣepaṇa ādīnām eva jāti bhedāt pratyayā vṛtti vyāvṛttī niṣkramaṇa ādīn āntu kārya bhedāt iti

paramatamāśaṅkate katham yugapad pratyaya bhedaḥ iti ced iti ara vivaraṇam atha matam yathā jāti saṅkaraḥ na asti evam aneka karma sakarāyāḥ vastuni na asti iti uktam eva atas katham ekasmin karmaṇi kāraṇa abhāvāt draṣṭaṇāḥ bhramaṇa patana praveśana pratyayāḥ paraspara vyāvatta ātmānaḥ bhavanti bhāvena kāryasya anutpatteḥ iti atra bramaḥ ityādi pratisamācā yat tvayā uktam kāraṇa abhāvena anutpattiḥ eva bhramaṇa ādi pratyayānām ityat adhyavāvaya vinodigdeśa saṃyoga vibhāga bhedāt tad upapatteḥ avayavaḥ ca avayavī ca iti avayava a ayavinau tayā udiś deśa viśiṣṭa saṃyoga vibhāgāḥ tad bhedāt iti tat avāha yaḥ hi draṣṭā avayavānām pārvataḥ paryāyeṇa diś pradeśaiḥ saṃyoga vibhāgān paśyati tasya bhramaṇa pratyayaḥ bhavati yaḥ tu avayavinyūja pradeśāt vibhāgam adhas sa yāgañca avekṣate tasya patati patram iti patana pratyayaḥ bhavati yaḥ punar nāli kānta daśe garla antar deśe saṃyogam bahis deśe ca vibhāgam paśyati tasya praviśati patram iti praveśana pratyayaḥ tasmāta siddhaḥ kārya bhedāt niṣkramaṇa ādīnām pratyaya bhedaḥ na jāti bhedāt iti

anye tu bhramaṇa recana syandana ujvalana ādi bhedena karmaṇā ām asaṅkhyāta tvā niṣkramaṇa ādīnām jāti bhedāt pratyaya bheda siddhau na kiñcid bādhakam asti iti atas sva matam iti na ca bhramaṇa recana ādīnām gamanaḥ eva antarbhāvaḥ iti manyante etat tu na yuktam tasya karma tva paryāya tvena vakṣyamāṇa tvāt jāti saṅkara prasaṅgasya ca bādhakasya dṛḍha tvāt iti

bhaktu utkṣepaṇa ādīnām jāti bhedāt bhedaḥ na niṣkramaṇa ādīnām atha gama va ki karma tva paryāyaḥ ghaṭaḥ kalaśaḥ iti paryāyavata āhosvit aparam sāmānyam utkṣepaṇa tva ādi vat iti cintyam kutas kāraṇāt te saṃśayaḥ iti ācāryasya praśnaḥ sa ca anupapannaḥ tathā hi sandigdhena praśne kṛte sati tad pratisamādhānam nyāyyam na tu saṃśaya karaṇena vacanam tasya sāmānya dharma ādibhyaḥ pūrvam eva utpatti nirūpaṇāt na eṣa doṣaḥ saṃśaya kāraṇa jñāne sati tad ucchittau upāya anuṣṭhānam upalabdha vyādhi kāraṇasya vaidyasya iva aprayāsena eva ghaṭataḥ iti manyamānaḥ kāraṇam praśnayati iti tat āha samasteṣu utkṣepaṇa ādiṣu bhramaṇa ādiṣu ca karma pratyaya vat gamana pratyaya aviśeṣāt karma tva paryāyaḥ iti gamyate yathā hyad kṣepaṇa karma apakṣepaṇa karma ityādi vyavahāra upalambhāt aśeṣa bheda vyāpakam karma tvam evam adhvam gacchati adhas gacchati ityādi vyavahāra upalambhāt gamanam apya śeṣa bheda vyāpakam iti atas karma tva paryāyaḥ iti jñāyate

na ca atra niścayaḥ eva iti āha yatas tutkṣepaṇa ādi vat viśeṣa saṃjñayā bhihitam tasmāt aparam sāmānyam syāt iti na hi viśeṣa darśanena gaṇanāyām tad avasare sāmānya saṃjñā nirdeśaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ yathā pṛthivī ādi saṃjñā avasare dravya saṃjñāyāḥ tasmāt ubhaya rūpa dharma upalambhāt viśeṣa anupalambha ādibhyaḥ ca kim karma vat gamana tvam param sāmānyam āhosvit utkṣepaṇa tva ādi vat aparam iti saṃśayaḥ kāryaḥ

na saṃśayaḥ kāryaḥ karma tvapaya aṃya tvāt ātma tva puruṣa tva vat paryāyaḥ eva gamana tvam iti sarvatra karma pratyaya vat gamana pratyaya upalambhāt iti nyāyāt atha viśeṣa saṃjñayā kimartham gamana grahaṇam kṛtam iti viśeṣa saṃjñā avasare sāmānya saṃjñā upadarśanasya adarśanāt na bhramaṇa ādi avarodha artha tvāt utkṣepaṇa ādi śabdaiḥ rana varuddhānāmasa gṛhītānām bhramaṇavatanasyandana ādīnām avarodha artham karma tva jñāpana artham iti anyathā hi gamana grahaṇam antareṇa yāni eva catvāri viśeṣa saṃjñā uktāni utkṣepaṇa ādīni tāni eva sāmānya viśeṣa saṃjñā viṣayāṇi prasajyeran iti sāmānya saṃjñā karma saṃjñā viśepa saṃjñā ca utkṣepaṇa ādi saṃjñā tad viṣayāṇi catvāri eva prasajyeran na bhramaṇa ādīni kutas etat viśeṣa saṃjñā viṣayāṇām eva sāmānya saṃjñā viṣaya tvāt tasmāt utkṣepaṇa ādi vat bhramaṇa ādīnām api karma tva jñāpana artham gamana grahaṇam kṛtam iti na ca etasmin pakṣa bhramaṇa ādīnām apara jāti sambandhe api dūṣaṇam tad apekṣayā ānantyasya abhyupagamāt yat ca gamana grahaṇāt bhramaṇa ādayaḥ saṅa gṛhītāḥ iti vākyam tat anyathā vyākhyātam

athavā astu aparam sāmānyam gamana tvam aniyata diś deśa saṃyoga vibhāga kāraṇeṣu bhramaṇāviṣu eva varttate na utkṣepaṇa ādiṣu katham tarhi teṣu gamana vyavahāraḥ iti āha gamana śabdaḥ tu utkṣepaṇa ādiṣu bhāktaḥ draṣṭavyaḥ kasmāt upacāra bījāt sva āśraya saṃyoga vibhāga kartṛ tva sāmānyāt iti yathā utpannam utkṣepaṇa ādi svā śrayasya padārtha antaraiḥ saṃyoga vibhāgān karoti tathā gamanam api iti na ca etasmai deva nimittāt utkṣepaṇa ādiṣu gamana vyavahāra vat gamane api utkṣepaṇa ādi vyavahāra prasaṅgaḥ kārya sadbhāvena kāraṇa kalpanāyāḥ pravartanāt na ca utkṣepaṇa ādiṣu gamana vyavahāra vat gamane api utkṣepaṇa ādi vyavahāraḥ dṛṣṭaḥ tasmāt acodyam etat atha pakṣa dvaya upanyāsāt kim atra ācāryasya abhipretam pañcānām pratiniyata jāti yogitva abhidhānāt gamana tvam aparam samānyam iti etat anye tu vāstava dūṣaṇasya para sāmānya pakṣe anabhidhānāt tat eva abhipretam iti manyante

pūrvam sat pratyayam asat pratyayañca karma uktam tatra sat pratyaya karma vidhiḥ kathami tyāha cikoṣiteṣu kartum abhīṣṭeṣu yajña adhyayana dāna kṛṣi ādiṣu ityādi padena bhojana ādegrahaṇam yajña ādiṣu ca tila ādi grahaṇa artham yadā hastam utkṣeptum icchati apakṣeptum vā tadā hastavati ātma pradeśe prayatnaḥ san jāyate tad utpattau ātmā samavāyi kāraṇam ātma manaḥ saṃyogaḥ asamavāyi kāraṇam icchā nimitta kāraṇam tat prayatnam gurutvañca apekṣamāṇāt ātma hasta saṃyāgāt asamavāyi kāraṇāt haste samavāyi kāraṇe karma utpadyate hasta vat sarva śarīra avayaveṣu padā diṣu śarore ca iti yathā ātma hasta saṃyāgaḥ asamavāyi kāraṇam prayatnaḥ tu nimitta kāraṇam hasta karma utpattau tathā sarva śarīra avayaveṣu śarīre ca samaveta karma utpattī ātma saṃyogaḥ asamavāyi kāraṇam prayatnaḥ nimitta kāraṇam iti atideśa arthaḥ tad sambaddheṣu api musala ādiṣu katham karma bhavati iti avyutpanna praśna anantaram āha hastena musalam gṛhītvā icchām karoti kim viśiṣṭām

utkṣipāmi hastena musalam iti evam rūpām tad anantaram hastavati ātma pradeśe prayatnaḥ tad anurūpaḥ tam apekṣamāṇāt ātma hasta saṃyogāt asamavāyi karaṇāt yasmin kāle haste sama vāyi kāraṇe karma utpadyate tasmin eva kāle tam eva prayatnam apekṣamāṇāt hasta musala saṃyogāt asamavāyi kāraṇāt musale api kāraṇe karma tatas dūram utkṣipte musale tad artha chā utkṣepaṇa icchā nivarttate sva kāraṇāt punar api apakṣepeṇa icchā utpadyate tad anantaram hastavati ātma pradeśe prayatnaḥ tad anurūpaḥ tam apekṣamāṇāt yathā uktāt saṃyoga dvayāt iti ātma hasta saṃyogāt musala hasta saṃyogāt ca prayatna apekṣād hasta musalayaḥ yugapad apakṣepaṇa karmaṇī bhavataḥ tatas antyena āvasānikena musala karmaṇā ulakhala musalayoḥ abhighāta ākhyaḥ saṃyogaḥ kriyate sa saṃyogaḥ asamavāyi kāraṇa bhūtaḥ musala gatam vegam apekṣamāṇaḥ apratyayam aprayatnam musale api utpatana karma karoti tat karma asamavāyi karaṇam abhighāta apekṣam musale samavāyi kāraṇe saṃskāma ārabhate tam apekṣya musala hasta saṃyogaḥ apratyayam aprayatna pūrvakam haste api utpatana karma karoti

nanu musala ulūkhala saṃyogāt musale karma utpatti sama kālam prāktana saṃkāra vināśe apekṣā kāraṇa bhāvāt na musale karma saṃskāram ārabhate tad abhāve ca hasta musala saṃyogaḥ katham haste apratyayam utpatana karma kuryāt iti āśaḍakyāha yadi api prāktanaḥ saṃskāraḥ vinaṣṭaḥ tathā api musala ulūkhala saṃyogaḥ paṭu karma utpādakaḥ kutas saṃyoga viśeṣa bhāvāta atas tasya karmaṇaḥ saṃskāra sācivye samarthom bhavati sacivasya bhāvaḥ sācivyam sāhāyyam tatra samarthaḥ bhavati iti

athavā prāktanaḥ eva paṭuḥ saṃskāraḥ abhidhātāt avinaśyan avasthitaḥ iti pakṣa antaram darśayati prāktanasya paṭa saṃskārasya avasthāne saṃskāravati punar saṃskāra ārambhaḥ na asti iti atas yasmin kāle saṃskāra apekṣāt abhighātāt apratyayam musale utpatana karma tasmin eva kāle tam eva saṃskāram apekṣamāṇān musala hasta saṃyogāt apratyayam haste api utpatana karma iti

pāṇi mukteṣu tomara ādiṣu gamana vidhiḥ gamana prakāraḥ katham iti āha yadā tomaram hastena gṛhītvā icchām karoti hastena utkṣipāmi tomaram iti tad anantaram tad anurūpaḥ prayatnaḥ tam apekṣamāṇāt yathā ukta saṃyoga dvayāt iti ātma hasta saṃyogāt hasta tomara saṃyogāt ca tomara hastayoḥ yugapad a ākarṣaṇa karmaṇī bhavataḥ prasārite ca haste dūramatkṣipte tad ākarṣaṇa arthaḥ tasya tomarasya ākarṣaṇa arthaḥ prayatnaḥ vyāvat tete tad anantaram tiryagū madhodūram āsannam vā kṣipāmi iti icchā san jāyate tiryak kṣipā mi ūrdhvam adhas dūram āsannam kṣipāmi iti tad anantaram tad anurūpaḥ prayatnaḥ iti āsan na mandaḥ dūre tīvraḥ eva iti tam apekṣamāṇaḥ tomara hasta saṃyogaḥ nodana ākhyaḥ

na udyanāda kayoḥ saha gamanāt na udyaḥ tomaraḥ na udakaḥ hastaḥ iti tayoḥ saṃyogaḥ prayatna apekṣaḥ tasmāt tomare karma utpannam nodana apekṣam tasmin saṃskāram ārabhate tomaraḥ samavāyi kāraṇam karma asamavāyi kāraṇam prayatnaḥ nimitta kāraṇam iti tatas saṃskāra nodanābhyām tāvat karmāṇi bhavanti yāvat hasta tomara yaḥ vimocanā arthana karmaṇā parasparam vibhāgaḥ iti tatas vibhāga anivṛtte nodane saṃskārāda samavāyi kāraṇāt tad anurūpāṇi karmāṇi bhavanti āpatanāt patanam yāvat iti saṃskārasya tīvratara ādi bheda bhinna tvāt karmāṇi api evam bhavanti iti

tathā yantram akteṣu śarapāṣāṇa ādiṣa gamana vidhiḥ katham kim viśiṣṭaḥ ca puruṣaḥ tān prayuṅkte kena vā prakāreṇa iti āha yaḥ balavān kṛta vyāyāmaḥ vastrayantra siddhaḥ vāmena kareṇa dhanuḥ viṣṭabhya dakṣiṇena śaram sandhāya iti bāhulyā pakṣayaṃtat saha śareṇa vartate iti sa śarā tām jyām muṣṭinā gṛhītvā icchām karāti sa jyeṣam ākarṣayāmi enam dhanuḥ iti saha jyayā vartate iti sajyaḥ sa pāsāviṣuḥ ca iti tathā uktaḥ tam enam sajya iṣum ākarṣayāmi dhanuḥ ca iti

na ca enam iti padam dhanuḥ śabdena abhisandhānīyam tasya napuṃsaka liṅga prayatat dhanuḥ iti syāt atho arddhat dipāṭhāt prayoga darśanāt vā kathañcidu māya liṅgatā iṣyate tathā api enam dhanuṣam iti syāt na tu enam dhanuḥ iti puṃlliṅga vakṣāyām api iti śabdena karmaṇaḥ abhihita tvāt dvitīyā vibhaktiḥ na bhavati canya tad anantaramaḥ icchā anantaram prayatnaḥ tam apekṣamāṇāt ātma hasta bhāgāt asamavāyi kāraṇāda haste samavāyi kāraṇe yadā eva ākarṣaṇa karma utpadyate prayatnam apekṣamāṇāt hasta jyā śara saṃyogāt asamavāyi kāraṇāt jyāyām śare samavāyi kāraṇe karma utpadyate prayatna viśiṣṭam hasta jyā saṃyogam apekṣamāṇābhyām jyā koṭi saṃyogābhyām asamavāyi kāraṇābhyām dhanuṣkoṭayoḥ samavete yā bhavataḥ dhanuṣi ca samavetam karma jyā dhanuḥ saṃyogāt asamavāyi śāt hasta jyā saṃyogam viśiṣṭam apekṣamāṇāt iti etat sarvam yugapad ekasmin kāle bhavati kāraṇasya yaugapadyāt

evam ākarṇāt karṇam yāvat ākṛṣṭe dhanuṣi na atas paramanena gantavya miti yat jñānam tatas tad ākarṣaṇa arthasya prayatnasya vināśaḥ tatas punar mokṣa ṇa icchā san jāyate tad anantaram tad anurūpaḥ prayatnaḥ tam apekṣamāṇāt ātma aṅguli saṃyogāt asamavāyi kāraṇāt aṅguliṣu mocana artha karma utpadyate tasmai daṅguli jyā vibhāgaḥ tatas vibhāgāt tad saṃyoga vināśaḥ tasmin vinaṣṭe pratibandhaka abhāvāt maṇḍalībhūtam dhanuḥ yathā avasthitam sthāpayati iti sthiti sthāpaka saṃskāraḥ dhanuṣi kārabhate tatra dhanuḥ samavāyi kāraṇam sthiti sthāpaka saṃskāraḥ asamavāyi kāraṇam adṛṣṭa ādi nimitta kāraṇam iti yadā eva dhanuṣi ākarṣaṇa karmaṇā maṇḍalīkṛte sthiti sthāpana artham sthiti sthāpaka saṃskārāt karma utpadyate tadā tam eva saṃskāram apekṣamāṇāt dhanuṣaḥ jyā saṃyogāt jyā śara saṃyogāt asamavāyi kāraṇāt jyāyām śare ca karma utpadyate tat utpannam sva kāraṇa apekṣam jyāyām saṃskāram ārabhate tam apekṣamāṇaḥ iṣu jyā saṃyogaḥ nodanam

tayoḥ saha gamanāt tasmāt iṣau ādyam karma utpadyate tat ca nodana apekṣa miṣau saṃskāram ārabhate tatra iṣuḥ samavāyi kāraṇam karma asamavāyi kāraṇam nodanam nimitta kāraṇam iti tasmāt saṃskārān nodana sahāyāt tāvat karmāṇi bhavanti yāvat iṣujyā vibhāgaḥ tad utpatau jyeṣvoḥ samavāyikāraṇa tvam iṣu karmaṇaḥ asamavāyi kāraṇa tvam śeṣa nimitta kāraṇam tatas vibhāgāt nivṛtte nodane karmāṇi uttarottarāṇi iṣu saṃskārāt eva āpatanāt iti patanam yāvat tāvat iti bahūni karmāṇi kramaśas kasmāt saṃyoga bahu tvāt tat sadbhāve api avināśe sarvadā iṣoḥ apātaḥ syāt

atha ekam api karma anekam saṃyogam kṛtvā śaktimān dyāt vinaśyati iti tarhi saṃskārasya anārabdha kāryasya avasthānāt anyat karma antaram iti apātaḥ eva syāt na ca saṃskārasya saṃyoga janaka tvam yena aneka kārya karaṇe śakti mān dyāt vināśaḥ syāt teṣām karma kāryatvāt tat taḥ tad utpāde karmaṇām eva vināśaḥ yuktaḥ na ca saṃskārāt abhinnam eva karma iti vācyam pratyaya bhedasya bheda lakṣaṇa tvāt tathā ca vegena gacchati iti vega anuraktaḥ gamana anuraktaḥ ca pratyayaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ tasmāt vegaḥ saṃyoga vat karmaṇaḥ artha antaram iti abhede tu manda gamana ādau api vegena gacchatoti pratyayaḥ syāt na ca etat asti

atha saṃyoga vibhāga upalambhāt anumīyate karma iti ced na saṃyoga vat indriya vyāpāreṇa eva karmaṇi api aparokṣa jñāna sadbhāvasya aviśeṣāt yathā hi vastunaḥ pradeśa antaraiḥ saṃyoga vibhāgāḥ pratyakṣeṇa pratīyante tadvat karma api iti yat ca pradeśa antaraiḥ saṃyoga vibhāga uphlambhe sati calati iti jñānam ānumānikam iti iṣṭam tat na yuktam nadī srotasyū vasthitasya sthāṇoḥ ta tsadbhāve api calana pratyaya adarśanāt ākāśe prakṣiptasya īṣoḥ tad abhāve api tad sadbhāva darśanāt

yat ca idam ekasmin sthāne pratikṣaṇam utpādāt tiṣṭhati iti vyavahāraḥ deśa antare ca tad bhāvāt gamana vyavahāraḥ iti uktam tat na yuktam kṣaṇa bhaṅga pratiṣedhāt atha saṃyoga bahu tvāt bahūni karmāṇi iti satyam na ca evam saṃskārasya api saṃyoga bahu tvāt bahu tvam tasya saṃyoga mātreṇa avināśāt vināśe vā karma antarāṇām utpattiḥ na syāt asamavāyi kāraṇa abhāvāt na ca ca ātmā iṣu saṃyogaḥ eva adṛṣṭa apekṣaḥ asamavāyi kāraṇam pratyakṣa anumānābhyām kāraṇa antara anupalambhe sati tat kalpanāyāḥ samāśrayaṇāt upalabhyate ca akṣa vyāpāreṇa eva vegaḥ tasya pratyākhyānam aśakyam

atha saṃskārāt upajāta karmaṇi uttara saṃyogāt vegasya karmaṇaḥ ca vinaśyattā anyayoḥ ca vega karmaṇoḥ utpadyamāna tā atas tayoḥ utpādaḥ prāktanayoḥ ca vināśaḥ iti kalpanāyām ki dūṣaṇam vinaśyat avasthasya asamavāyikāraṇa tvasya abhāvaḥ iti etat tathā hi na prāktanam karma saṃskāra antaram ārabhate na api prāktanaḥ vegaḥ karma antaram ubhayaḥ vinaśyat avastha tvena asamavāyi kāraṇa tva abhāvāt na ca anya dasamavāyi kāraṇam antarāle karmaṇaḥ sambhavati iti uktam yat ca saṃskārāt utpannam karma tat na saṃskāra antaram ārabhate apekṣā kāraṇa abhāvāt na api prāktanaḥ saṃskāraḥ apekṣā kāraṇam saṃskāravati saṃskāra ārambha pratiṣedhāt avaśyam karmā ntara utpatti sama kālam uttara saṃyogāt pūrva karma nivṛtti vat pūrva saṃskārasya api nivṛttiḥ vācyā na ca saṃyoga mātram apekṣā kāraṇam karmaṇaḥ saṃskāra ārambhe manda gatau adarśanāt tathā hi bhanda gatau saṃyoga sadbhāve api na karma saṃskāramāḥ rabhate iti upalabdham tasmāt ekaḥ eva saṃskāraḥ antarāle karmaṇaḥ apekṣā kāraṇāḥ bhāvāt iti

nanu evam tarhi saṃskārasya eka rūpa tvāt katham tīvratara ādi bheda bhinnānā karmaṇām utpattiḥ sahakāri bhedāt sa ca kārya bhedena eva jñeyaḥ tatra dṛṣṭasyā nupalabdhara dṛṣṭa ākhyaḥ kalpate iti kṣiptasya iṣoḥ pāta upalambhena ca vega vināśa prasiddheḥ tasya sa hetu tvāt anyasya ca vināśa hetoḥ abhāvāt aneka kārya karaṇe sati śakti prakṣayāt vināśaḥ kalpyate iti sā ca śaktiḥ adṛṣṭa viśeṣaḥ eva aneka karma sampādakaḥ etat ca aneka saṃskāra vādinā api abhyupagantavyam anyathā hi punar saṃskāra utpattariṣa urapātaḥ eva syāta tasmāt ṛkta nyāyena ekaḥ eva saṃskāraḥ iti

upasaṃhāram āha evam ātma adhiṣṭhitepu prayatna dvāreṇa anadhiṣṭhiteṣu sat pratya yama sat pratyayañca karma uktam idānīm anadhiṣṭhiteṣu bāhyeṣu śarīra asamba dveṣu ākāśa ādi nivṛttya catuṣa mahābhūteṣu iti paramāṇu nivṛtti artham apratyayam aprayatna pūrvakam karma gamana nodana ādibhyaḥ bhavati ādipadena abhighāta saṃyakta saṃyoga guru tva ādegrahaṇam tatra nodanam vyākhyāyate

garu tvadvatva prayatna vegāna samasta vyasta anapekṣamā yaḥ saṃyoga viśeṣaḥ nodanam parasparam avibhāga kṛtaḥ karmaṇaḥ kāraṇam iti saṃyogaḥ tanodanam iti ukte ati prasaṅgaḥ tad artha karmaṇaḥ kāraṇam iti abhighātā pi evam bhavati iti avibhāga kṛtaḥ iti padama tathā api atpannasya karmaṇā avaśyam vibhāga janaka tvam atas parasparam iti padam tathā api parasparam saṃyoginaḥ vibhāga janakasya karmaṇaḥ kāraṇam saṃyukta saṃyogaḥ api iti atas gurutva drava tva prayatna vān samasta vyasta anapekṣamāṇaḥ iti tatra yadā culukena udakam gṛhītvā vegena bhātakṣipati tadā sarve guru tva ādayaḥ sambhavanti iti tad apekṣam culuka udaka saṃyogaḥ nādanam vyasta pakṣe tu guru tvam apekṣaṇamāṇaḥ saṃyogaḥ nodanam

yathā sūkṣmaśā śākhā pari vyavasthāpitam atiśayena guru dravyam adhas gati hetuḥ bhavati śākhāyāḥ drava cama pakṣamāṇaḥ taṇa udaka saṃyogaḥ taṇe gamanam ārabhate vegam apekṣamāṇaḥ vāya vanaspati saṃyogaḥ vṛkṣa ādiṣu calana kāraṇam prayatna apekṣaḥ tu hasta musala saṃyogaḥ mutalakat pittau yadā ca prayatnena paṅge pādam apakṣipati tadā prayatna guru tve pakṣya pāda paṅka saṃyogaḥ paṅkam adhas nayati iti yadā ca pāṣāṇāt evegena pāte te paṅkana saṃyogaḥ tadā pāṣāṇa ādi gatam guru tvam vegañca apekṣamāṇam pāṣāṇa paṅka saṃyogaḥ nodanam iti yadā kaścid vegena kūpa ādau patati tadā gurutva apana vegān apekṣya devadatta udaka saṃyogaḥ adhas gati hetuḥ bhavati yadā ca jaladhara pārāsambandhāta taṇa ādeḥ adhas gamanam tadā guru tva drava tva vegān apekṣate ityādi aṣṭavyam tasmāt yathā ukta anodanāt caturdhu api mahābhūteṣu karma bhavati iti udāharaṇa mā āha yathā paṅka ākhyāyām pṛthivyām pāda ādi saṃyogāt yathā ukta viśeṣaṇāt iti

abhighātasya itarasmāda bheda artham āha vega apekṣaḥ yaḥ saṃyoga aviśeṣaḥ paraspara vibhāga hetoḥ ekasya karmaṇaḥ kāraṇam a saḥ abhighātaḥ iti vibhāga hetu karma kāraṇam na ādiḥ api iti parasparam vibhāga hetoḥ iti padam tathā api ātma manaḥ saṃyogena vyabhicāra parihāra artham vega apekṣaḥ iti padam na ca ātma manaḥ saṃyogaḥ paraspara vibhāga hetu sampādakaḥ vega apekṣaḥ iti

nanu ekasya iti padam vyartham abhidhātāt ubhayatra api karma upalabdheḥ satyam tathā api ekasya iti ādya karma jñāpana artham uttarottarāṇi vegāt eva bhavanti iti nodana ādiḥ ca uttara karmaṇām bahūnām api kāraṇam iti anye tu ekasya kāraṇa ṇam eva na tu ekasya eva iti avadhāraṇam manyante nodane api ekasya iti viśeṣaṇam evam vyākhyeyam udāharaṇantu yathā pāṣāṇa ādiṣu pāṣāṇa ādi abhighātāt iti saṃyukta saṃyoga nirūpaṇa artham āha tathā pāda ādibhiḥ nudyamānāyām ityādi

parasparam avibhāga kṛtaḥ karmaṇaḥ kāraṇam nodanam api iti atas nodana abhighāta yoḥ anyatara apekṣaḥ ubhaya apekṣaḥ vā yaḥ saṃyogaḥ sa saṃyukta saṃyogaḥ kvacid na uda na apekṣaḥ kvacid abhighāta apekṣaḥ kvacid ubhaya apekṣaḥ iti udāharaṇantu yathā paka ākhyāyām pṛthivyām kim viśiṣṭāyām pāda ādibhiḥ nudyamānāyām abhihanya mānāyām pṛthivyām vā ye pradeśāḥ na nudyante na sākṣāt pādena sambaddhayante na api abhihanyante na sākṣāt pāṣāṇa ādinā sambaddhayante teṣu api karma san jāyate pradeśāḥ samavāyi kāraṇam pāda ādibhiḥ ca sambaddha pradeśaḥ saha saṃyogaḥ asama bāyi kāraṇam pāda ādi saṃyogāḥ ca nimitta kāraṇam

patana nirūpaṇa artham āha guru tvāt yat adhas gamanam tat patanam vāyoḥ api adhas gamanam vṛkṣa koṭara ādiṣu urva pradeśena praviṣṭasya sambhavati iti tad vyavaccheda artham guru tvāt iti pṛthivī udakayoḥ iti āśraya nirūpaṇam patana āśrayaḥ samavāyi kāraṇam guru tvam asamavāyi kāraṇam guru tva vidhāraka saṃyoga prayatna vega abhāve satī iti nimitta kāraṇam darśayati iti yathā musala śarīra ādiṣu iti udāharaṇam hasta musala saṃyoga abhāvāt musale patanam prayatna abhāvāt śarīre vega abhāva ādiṣā viti tatra ādyam guru tvāt eva asamavāyi kāraṇāt utpadyate patanam tat ca utpannam sva kāraṇa apekṣam saṃskāram ārabhate tasmāt dvitīya ādīni tu patanāni gurutva saṃskāra abhyām asamavāyi kāraṇābhyām utpadyante

syandana nirūpaṇa artham āha srotaḥ bhūtānām apām sthalāt nimna abhisarpaṇam yat tat drava tvāt syandanam iti sthalā nimna abhisarpaṇam pāṣāṇa ādeḥ api iti srotaḥ bhūtānām iti padam sa ādeḥ api evam pravāhaḥ sambhavati iti apām iti grahaṇam tathā api apām dṛḍha hasta parigṛhītānām sthalāt nimna abhisarpaṇam na bhavati iti atas srotaḥ bhūtānām iti apām iti ca bāhulya apekṣayā na tu apām eva iti avadhāryate taila ādau api sadbhāvāt atas yat ukta rūpam abhisarpaṇam tat syandanam drava tvāt bhavati iti

katham iti avyutpannasya vistara parijñāna apekṣayā praśna antaram āha samantāt rodhaḥ saṃyogena avayavi drava tvam pratibaddham ityādi samantāt sarvatas rodhasā saha saṃyogena setu saṃyogena avayavi drava tvam pratibaddham udake kriyām na karoti na api avayava drava tvam syandanam ārabhate iti āha avayava drava tvam api ekārtha samavetam yatra hi avayava drava tvam tatra eva rodhaḥ saṃyogaḥ api iti atas tena eva pratibaddham uttara uttarāva yava drava tvāni tu saṃyukta saṃyogaiḥ prativaddhāni rodhaḥ saṃyukta avayavena anyaḥ saṃyogaḥ

tena api anyaḥ iti uttarottara avayava saṃyogaiḥ tad gata drava tvāni pratibaddhāni kriyām na ārabhante yadā tu setu bhedaḥ kṛtaḥ bhavati tadā samantāt pratibaddha tvāt avayavi drava tu asya karma ārambhaḥ na asti iti ayam asya arthaḥ mahā parimāṇa sambandhi tvāt avayavinaḥ na sūkṣma randhra deśa niṣkramaṇam setoḥ tu samīpa sthasyāḥ vayava drava tvasya kārya ārambhaka tvam tad pratibandhakasya saṃyogasya vyāvṛtteḥ tatas krameṇa uttarottara avayava drava tvānām vṛtti lābhaḥ kārya janaka tvam tathā hi setu samīpa sthasya avayavasya calane sati avayava antareṇa vibhāgāt tad saṃyogaḥ nivartate tatas dvitīya avayava drava tvam pratibandhaka abhāvāt kriyām ārabhate tatas stṛtīya avayava saṃyoga nivṛttau tad gatam drava tvam karma ārabhate iti evam uttarottarāṇām vṛtti lābhaḥ tatas saṃyuktānām eva abhisarpaṇam iti

yadi api saṃyogasya pratibandhakasya vināśe sati anyasya sarpaṇam tathā api tad jñāpana artha kramaśas saṃyuktānām eva abhisarpaṇam iti uktam tatas dravya ārambhaka saṃyoga vināśe sati pūrva dravya vināśaḥ tasmin sa pratibandhena santānena avasthitaiḥ rava yavaiḥ dīrgha dravyam ārabhyate tatra ca dravye kāraṇa guṇa pūrva krameṇa drava tvam utpadyate kāraṇa drava tvāni asamavāyi kāraṇam avayavini drava tva utpattau iti tatra kāraṇānām prabandhena paripāṭyā gamane avayavini yat karma utpadyate tat syanda na ākhyam iti

upasaṃhāram āha saṃskārāt karma īpu a ādiṣu uktam guru tva ādibhyaḥ ca tathā ānamaṇam saṃskārāt eva bhavati iti āha cana ādiṣu tad avayava anāñca pārvataḥ pratiniyata diś deśa saṃyoga vibhāga utpattau iti pratiniyatāḥ hi diś adeśāḥ cakra avaṣṭabdhāḥ taiḥ saha saṃyoge vibhāge ca kartavye yat avayavini karma utpadyate kutas saṃskārāt iti ādya daṇḍa cakra saṃyogāt asamavāyi kāraṇāt daṇḍa hasta saṃyoga apekṣāt upajātam cakre karma sva kāraṇa viśeṣa apekṣam saṃskāram ārabhate tatas saṃskāra nodanābhyām karmāṇi punar punar saṃskārāt eva avayaveṣu ca ādya karma utpattau nodana apekṣaḥ saṃyukta saṃyogaḥ asamavāyi kāraṇam tatas saṃskāra utpāde sati saṃskāraḥ api iti aniyata diś deśa saṃyoga vibhāga nimittam karma tabhramaṇam iti aniyata aidiś deśaiḥ saṃyoga vibhāgān karoti iti

kārya bhedena bhedam darśayati prāṇa ākhye tu vāyau karma kutas bhavati iti āha ātma vāyu saṃyogāt asamavāyi kāraṇāt icchā dveṣa pūrvaka prayatna apekṣāt utpadyate ki viśiṣṭasya iti āha jāgrataḥ iti kutas etat icchā anuvidhāna darśanāt iti recana icchātaḥ recanam pūraṇa icchātaḥ ca pūraṇam iti suptasya tu jīvana pūrvaka prayatna apekṣāt ātma vāyu saṃyogāt asamavāyi kāraṇāt prāṇa ākhye vāyau karma utpadyate iti kim atra pramāṇam suptasya jīvana pūrvakāt prayatnāt vāyau karma iti anu mānam tathā hi suptasya vāyukriyā prayatna kāryā parigṛhīta vāyu kriyā tvāt jāgrat avasthāyām tad vāyu kriyāvat yatra ca pratyakṣa anumānābhyām anyat kāraṇam na upalabhyate tatra adṛṣṭasya eva kāraṇa tvam atra ca anumānāt prayatna kārya tva prasiddhau icchā dveṣa pūrvaka prayatna abhāvāt suptasya jīvana pūrvaka prayatna kārya tvam niścīyate iti

evam catuṣu maha bhūteṣu nodana ādibhyaḥ karma vyākhyāyām ākāśa ādau kriyā śūnya tve kāraṇam āha ākāśa kāla diś ātmanaḥ sati api dravya bhāve niṣkriyāḥ sāmānya ādi vat amūrta tvāt yathā hi sāmānya ādeḥ amūrta tva aniṣkriya tvam tadvadā kāśa ādeḥ api iti marta tvena hi kriyāvat tvam vyāptam tat ca vyāvarttamānam ākāśa ādibhyaḥ sva vyāptam kriyāvat tvam gṛhītvā vyāvantaḥ iti tat eva āha mūrti rasarva gata dravya parimāṇam tad anuvidhāyinī ca kriyā yatra yatra kriyā tatra tatra mūrtiḥ iti sā ca mūtiḥ ākāśa ādiṣu na asti tasmāt na seṣām kriyā sambandhaḥ asti iti

atha yadi mūrti anuvidhāyinī kriyā manasaḥ tarhi martta tvāt kriyā sambandhī vācyaḥ iti āha sa vigrahe śarīra avaruddha manasi indriya antara sambandha artham yat jānata karma utpadyate tat kutas iti āha ātma manasoḥ saṃyogāt asamavāyi kāraṇāt icchā dveṣa pūrvaka prayatna apekṣāt kutas etat itthaṃbhūtāta prayatnāt jāgratas manaḥ kriyāta

tat āha anu abhiprāyamaḥ indriya antareṇa viṣaya antara upalabdhi darśanāta abhiprāya manaḥ iti abhiprāyān atikrameṇa yena eva indriyeṇa viṣaya grahaṇa abhiprāyaḥ bhavati tanava viṣaya upalabdhi darśanāt vijñāyate antaḥkaraṇasya icchāna vidhāyi kriyā āśraya tvam tena anadhiṣṭhitasya indriyasya viṣaya grāhaka tva asambhavādaḥ iti manaḥ sambandhaḥ niścīyate sa ca icchā anuvidhānāt tad pūrvaka prayatna janita kriyā kāryaḥ iti suptasya tu yat manasaḥ nirindriya ātma pradeśe pralīnasya indriya antara sambandha artha prabodha kāle karma tad ātma manasoḥ saṃyogāt asamavāyi kāraṇāt jīvana pūrvaka prayatnā pakṣāt upajāyate tathā hi suptasya manaḥ kriyā prayatna kāryā parigṛhīta antar karaṇa kriyā tvāt jānat avasthāyām takriyā vat apasarpaṇa karma upasarpaṇa karma ca ātma manasoḥ saṃyogāt asamavāyi kāraṇāt adṛṣṭa apekṣāt utpadyate iti mṛta śarīrāt vibhāga artha karma apasarpaṇam garbha śarīreṇa saṃyoga artham upasarpaṇam iti kadā puna stad apasarpaṇam

katham bhavati iti āha yadā jīvana sahakāriṇoḥ ityādi jīvanam vyākhyātam tad sahakāriṇoḥ dharma adharmayoḥ upabhogāt sukha duḥkha saṃvedanāt prakṣaya stadā tena śarīreṇa bhoktavyasya karmaṇaḥ abhāvāt śarīra antara upabhoga sampādaka karma sadbhāve api śarīrasya pātaḥ eva anyonya abhibhavaḥ vā iti sambhāvinaḥ pakṣa antara sthāpanyāsaḥ tathā hi śarīra antara upabhoga dāyakena balīyasā paripakvena karmaṇā bhārabdha śarīrasya upabhoga dāyaka tvena abhipravṛttasya karmaṇaḥ abhibhavaḥ bhoga dāna sāma upagamaḥ tīva śabda upalambhana mandasya agrahaṇam iva iti tatas jīvana sahāyasya kamaṇaḥ vaikalye sati tad pūrvakasya prayatnasya vaikalyāt ca prāṇa nirodhaḥ tad nirodhesati anyābhyām vṛtti labdha dharma adharmābhyām iti vṛttiḥ sahakāri kāraṇam

tayā labdhau tad saha kṛtau yau dharma adhamaum tābhyām ātma manaḥ saṃyoga sahakāribhyām mṛta śarīrāt vibhāga kāraṇam apasarpaṇa karma utpadyate tatas tasmāt śarīrāt bāharapagatam tābhyām eva dharma adharmābhyām sampāditam yat ātivāhika sūkṣma śara uram tana abhisambaddhayate tat sakrāntaḥ ca svarga narakam vā gacchati gatvā ca āśaya anurūpeṇa śarīreṇa saṃyujyate tad saṃyoga artham karma upasarpaṇa ākhyam iti ātivāhika śarāram ca āgama balāt abhyupagatam antaḥkaraṇasya parigṛhīta tvāt iti tathā na vilam etat adṛṣṭāt bhavati yogināñca bahis udrecitasya iti bahis deśaiḥ drācatasya manasaḥ abhipreta deśa gamanam punar punar pratyāgamanaḥ ca tathā sarga kāle atyagṇa śarīreṇa sambandha artham karma adṛṣṭa kāritam iti na kevalam etat anyat api mahābhūteṣu yat karma kim viśiṣṭam

pratyakṣa anumānābhyām anupalabhyamāna raṇam upakāra apakāra samartham iti arthaḥ tat api adṛṣṭa kāritam tat eva āha yathā sarga ādau sṛṣṭayādau aṇuṣu karma śarīra ādi sampādana artham agni vāyvorūḥ va tiryamgamane iti agneḥ u uddha jvalanam vāyoḥ tiryak gamanam prāṇinām upakāra apa kāra samartham iti mahābhūtānām bhū golaka deva kula ādīnām prakṣobhaṇam tad kampanam maṇīnām taskaram cauram prati gamanam ayasaḥ lohasya ayaskānta abhimukha tayā abhisarpaṇañca iti

atha sāmānyasya lakṣaṇa parīkṣā artham parama parañca dvividham sāmānyam ityādi prakaraṇam atra ca pūrva vibhāgasya abhidhānāt aniyama jñāpanena kārya kāraṇa bhāvā śaṅkā vyudāsaḥ sāmānya lakṣaṇa vibhāgayoḥ yathā dravyam pṛthivī aptejaḥ ityādi prayojanam iti upadarśayati sva viṣaya sarva gatam iti vipratipatti vyudāsaḥ tathā hi pare manyante sarva sāmānyam sarva gatam go tvam aśva piṇḍeṣu api asti aśvatvañca gopiṇḍa ādiṣu api iti anapalambhaḥ tu vyañjaka abhāvāt yatra ca vyajaka sadbhāvaḥ tatra abhivyaktiḥ yathā gopiṇḍeṣu go tvasya aśva piṇḍe aśva tvasya iti

tat ca asat go tvasya aśva ādi piṇḍeṣu sadbhāve pramāṇa abhāvāt a vyavasthite hi sadbhāve abhivyañjaka abhāvāt anupalabdhiḥ kalpyate atha sāmānyam sarvaiḥ sambadhyate vyāpaka tvāt ākāśa vat itya sti tra kiṃpramāṇam tatra sarvaiḥ samavāye sādhye sādhya vikalam udāharaṇam ākāśasya sarvatra samavāya abhāvāt saṃyogi tve tu sādhye sāmānyasya dravya rūpa tā prasaṅgaḥ na ca etat yuktam guṇa karmasu samavetasya upalambhāt dravyasya ca dravyaḥ eva saṃyogaḥ na anyatra iti tathā yuta siddhaya bhāvāt ca yuta siddhānāñca saṃyogaḥ iti atha sāmānyena sambandha mātram sādhyate

tatra api siddha sādhanam sva ādhāreṇa saṃyukta saṃyogasya sarvatra sadbhāvāt tathā hi go tva ādhāreṇa saṃyuktam ākāśa ādi tena ca saṃyuktam sarva mūrtam iti evam vyāpaka tvam api yadi sarvaiḥ saṃyogi tvam tat asiddham pakṣe tat eva hi sarva gata tva miti sādhyena aviśeṣaḥ eva tathā ākāśa āt eāpaka tve api na sarvaiḥ sambandhaḥ iti anekāntaḥ atha sarvaiḥ sambandhaḥ sādhyate sarvatra sannihita tvāt iti hetunā tat api asat ākāśa ādeḥ ta bhāve guṇa karma ādinā sambandha abhāvāt na ca viśiṣṭa sambandha anabhyupagame bhāvasya anya sānnidhyam paśyāmaḥ atas svaviṣaya sarva gatam eva sāmānyam go tvam gopiṇḍeṣu eva aśva tvam adhapiṇḍeṣu eva tatra eva upa lambhāt

abheda ātmakam aneka vṛtti iti lakṣaṇam darśayati abheda ātmakam eka svabhāvam anekatra vṛttiḥ yasya tad aneka vṛtti iti eka tve sati anekatra vartamāna tvāt sāmānyam tathā api avayavi saṃkhya ādibhiḥ vyabhicāra parihāra artham nitya tve satī iti viśeṣaṇam arthāt vyākhyeyam tathā api salila ādi paramāṇu rūpa ādayaḥ nityāḥ cā nekatra vartante tad artham eka tve sati iti viśeṣaṇam te tu aneka tve sati anekatra vartante iti tathā api ekatve nitya tve ca sati anekatra vartate samavāyaḥ tad artham sva vyatiriktayā vṛttyā vartamāna tve satī iti ca viśeṣaṇam adhyāhāryam

sarvam atra eva vākye labhyate adhyāhāraḥ na kāryaḥ iti ca anye tathā hi na vidyate bhedaḥ nānātvam vināśaḥ ca yasya iti tathā uktam tat eva ātmā svarūpam asya iti abheda ātmakam ekam avināśi ca iti labhyate anekatra vṛttiḥ yasya iti bahu vrīhiṇā vṛtteḥ vṛttimataḥ bhedā api upadarśitaḥ eva tasmāt ekatve nitya tve ca sati sama vāyena anekatra vartamāna tvāt sāmānyam itarasmāt bhidyate

nanu āśraya asiddham etat lakṣaṇam sāmānya sadbhāve pramāṇa abhāvāt yat ca anu gata jñānam na tat sāmānya sattām darśayati kalpanā jñāna tvāt tathā ca anādi vāsanā vaśāt anugata jñānam utpadyate na punar vāstavam sāmānyam asti tat uktam para rūpam svarūpeṇa yayā saṃvṛyate dhiyā eka artha pratibhāsinyāḥ bhāvān na āśritya bhedinaḥ

asya arthaḥ bhedinaḥ parasparam vyāvṛtta ātmānaḥ bhāvāḥ teṣām rūpam bhinnam sva rūpeṇa abhinnena saṃvṛyate pracchādyate yayā dhiyā kim viśiṣṭayā eka artha pratibhāsinyā iti eka śva arthaḥ pratibhāsate asyām sva gata ākāraḥ eva bāhyaḥ tasyāḥ niviṣaya tvāt iti tayā saṃvṛta nānātvāḥ saṃvṛtyā bhedinaḥ svayam abhedinaḥ iva ābhānti bhāvāḥ rūpeṇa kenacid

asya arthaḥ svayam bhedinaḥ api bhāvāḥ tathā saṃvṛtyā saṃvṛta nānātvāḥ santaḥ abhedinaḥ iva ābhānti na paramārthataḥ katham tarhi sāmānyam ucyate tat āha tad abhiprāya vaśāt sāmānyam sat prakītitam tat asat parama arthena yathā saṅkalpitam tayā paramārthataḥ asat api sāmānyam sat prakītitam tad abhiprāya vaśāt eka ākāra pratibhāsa vaśāt iti na ca sāmānyam vyaktīnām vyāvṛtta rūpa tvāt anyasya ca apratibhāsanāt iti āha vyaktayaḥ na anuyanti anyat anuyāyi na bhāsate jñānāt avyatiriktañced katham artha antaram brajet

tasmāt buddhiḥ eva tad anya vyatirekiṇaḥ padārthān āśritya utpadyamānā vika lpitā sva vāsanā prakṛtim anuvidadhāti iti bhinnam eṣām rūpam tirodhāya abhinnam ātmīyam rūpam adhyavasyati saṃsṛjantī saṃdarśayati sā ca eka sādhana sādhya tayā buddhi vartinām eva bhāvānām bahis iva parisphurantī sāmānyam iti ucyate sā ca sva vyatirikteṣu bhāveṣu bhavati iti viśeṣa viṣaya iti ucyate na paramārthataḥ tasmai danu gatavyāvṛtta svarūpa tvāt sāmānyam viśeṣaḥ ca na tu bāhyāḥ vivekinaḥ padārthāḥ na ca teṣu vikalpa vṛttiḥ katham teṣu bhavati iti parīkṣakāḥ khalu evam vivecayanti jātyā na tu vyavahāraḥ te tu sva ālambanām eva buddhim anugata ākārām bahīrūpa tayā manyamānāḥ dṛśya vikalpau arthau ekīkṛtya pravarttante pratipādayanti ca iti na tu nityam ekam anugatam viśeṣa vyatiriktam sāmānyam pratibhāsate iti

punar api uktam śabdaḥ artha aṃśaka māhā iti tatra anya apohaḥ ucyate ākāraḥ sa ca na arthe asti tam vadan artha bhāj katham iti vṛtti anupapatteḥ ca na vāstavam sāmānyam asti iti tathā ca ekatra vartamāna sāmānyam na eka deśena vartate tad abhāvāt na sarva ātmanā anyatra vṛtti abhāva prasaṅgāt tathā yena eva rūpeṇa ekatra vartate tena eva anyatra api iti abhyupagame sarva piṇḍānām eka tā prasaṅgaḥ atha svarūpa antareṇa tarhi svarūpa bhedāt tasya nānātvam prasajyate svabhāva antara nivṛttau ca anekatra vṛtti tvam virudhyate iti uktam deśa kāla avasthā viśeṣa viniyata eka saṃsarga avyavacchinna svabhāva antara virahāt anekatra vṛtte rekasya na deśa ādi viśeṣavatā anyena yogaḥ iti

tatra deśa viśeṣaḥ nagara ādiḥ kāla viśeṣaḥ vasanta ādiḥ avasthā viśeṣaḥ bālya ādiḥ teṣu viniyataḥ sarva ātmanā pratiṣṭhitaḥ yathā ukta svabhāvaḥ ca asau ekaḥ ca tena saṃsargaḥ sambandhaḥ tad saṃsargeṇa avyavacchinnama kroḍīkṛtam ukta svabhāvāt svabhāva antaram tena virahaḥ viyogaḥ tad rahita tvāt iti hetu arthaḥ aneka vṛtteḥ ekasya iti minirdeśaḥ na deśa ādi viśeṣavatā anyena yogaḥ iti sādhya dharma nirdeśaḥ rūpa ādi vat iti dṛṣṭāntaḥ prayogaḥ punar evam bhavati yasya yathā ukta svabhāva antara virahaḥ na tasya deśa ādi viśeṣavatā anyena yogaḥ yathā rūpa ādiḥ asti ca sāmānya ādeḥ asau iti viruddha upalabdhiḥ yadi ca ekam tena ca svarūpeṇa sarvaiḥ sambadhyeta sāmānyam sarva piṇḍānām eka deśa kāla avasthāyogita aprasaṅgaḥ tad deśa ādi viśeṣita piṇḍa vṛtti sva rūpa tvāt sāmānyasya yadā ca ekasmin piṇḍe deśa ādi viśeṣite samupa labhyate tadā eva aśeṣasya āśraya viśeṣitasya upalambhaḥ syāt tasya eka rūpa tvāt iti aneka vṛtti tva anabhyupagame ca rūpa ādi vat eka āśraya tvāt sāmānya rūpa tā na syāt iti

na ca sāmānyasya svabhāva antaram asti yena aneka vṛtti tvam sthāt iti uktam na ca sāmānyasya niyata āśrayeṇa sambandhe niyama hetuḥ asti iti tathā go tvam sambadhyamānam na gavā sambadhyate go tva sambandhāt pūrva piṇḍasya tat rapatva asambhavāt atha agavā sambadhyate tarhi tasya aśvena api sambandhaḥ syāt go tva abhisambandhāt pūrvam agorūpatāyāḥ sarvatra sādhāraṇa tvāta yatra ca gopiṇḍādiḥ varttate na tatra go tva ādi sāmānyam samavaiti iti tad āśrayiṇā tu sambaddhayate iti citram yatra asau vartate bhāvaḥ tena sambaddhayate na tu tad deśinantu vyāpnoti kim api etat mahā adbhutam

tathā piṇḍe brajati na sāmānyasya gamanam asti niṣkriya tvāta na api avasthānam piṇḍasya tad śūnyatā prasaṅgāt na bhāgena gamanam avasthānañca niraṃśa tvāt na api paścāt āgatya abhisambat dhayate pūrva tat śūnyasya anupalabdheḥ tat uktam na yāti na ca tatra āsīt asti paścāt na ca aṃśa vat jahāti pūrvam na ādhāram aho vyasana santatiḥ

tat etat asat jāti pradveṣa andhatayā pramāṇa mārga paribhraṣṭaiḥ abhihita miti samādhīyate tathā hi cakṣuḥ ādi vyāpāreṇa anugata jñānasya abādhyamānasya upa labdheḥ avaśyam anugatam nimittam vācyam na ca vāsanava nimittam tasyāḥ pūrvam eva pratiṣedhāt yadi ca vāsanā viśiṣṭa pratyaya hetuḥ bāhyā ca iti nā bheda mātram eva syāt bodha antarbhāve tu bodha rūpa tayā tasyāḥ sarvatra aviśeṣāt vikalpa vaicitryam na syāt gopiṇḍa darśanāt gavā ākāraḥ vikalpaḥ aśvapiṇḍa darśanāt ca aśva adhyavasāyī ityādi na ca deśa ādi bhedena api abādhyamānaḥ adhyavasāyaḥ niviṣayaḥ sambhavati iti para rūpam svarūpeṇa yayā saṃtriyate iti apāstam eva

yat ca idam vyaktayaḥ na anuyanti anyat anuyāyi na bhāsate iti asat etata anugata jñānena tasya pratibhāsanāt yathā hi sva lakṣaṇam vyāvatta rūpa tayā pratibhāsanāt asti evam anugata svarūpa tayā pratibhāsanāt sāmānyam apya sti iti yadi ca vyāvṛtti jñāne sāmānyasya apratibhā āsanāt asattvam syāt anugata jñāne api sva lakṣaṇasya apratibhāsanāt asattvam eva syāt tasmāt yathā abādhyamāna jñāne nīla ādeḥ pratibhāsanāt sattvam evam anugata jñāne pratibhāsanāt sāmānyasya api sattvam abhyupagantavyam vṛtti vikalpāt ebar bādhakasyā pramāṇa tvāt iti tathā hi vṛtti anupapatteḥ asattvam iti na idam svatantra sādhanam anekāntāt svatantre hi rūpa ādīnām sattvam anupapadyamāna vṛtti tvañca iti evam para pakṣe anupapadyamāna vṛtti tve api ākāśa ādīnām sattvam iti svarūpa asiddhaḥ ca vṛtteḥ samavāyasya sattvāt eka deśena sarva ātmanā ca na vartate iti ayuktaḥ viśeṣa pratiṣedhaḥ

prakāra antarasya asambhavāt abhinna svarūpa tvāt ca sāmānyasya na tatra eka deśa sarva śabdayoḥ pravṛttiḥ tayaḥ bhinneṣu eva pravṛtti darśanāt samavāyena ca varttate sāmānyam na eka deśena svarūpeṇa vā tasya eka deśasya svarūpasya ca āvṛtti rūpa tvāt iti yat eva ca ekasmin piṇḍe svarūpa sāmānyasya tat eva piṇḍa antare api anugata jñāna janaka tvasya sarvatra sambhavāt tat āha eka dvi bahuṣu piṇḍeṣu ātma svarūpa anuvṛtti darśanāt sva pratyaya kāraṇam iti sāmānyasya ātma svarūpam anuvṛttam abhinnam atas anuvṛtti pratyayasya anugatān asya kāraṇam iti

na ca sāmānyasya abhede padārthānām tathā abhāvaḥ tatas anya tvāt atas eva na ekasmin deśa ādi viśeṣite piṇḍe sāmānyasya upalambhāt aśeṣa viśeṣitasya apyu palambha prasaṅgaḥ teṣām aniyata diś deśa sambandhi tvena upalambha abhāvāt yathā eva ca krameṇa viśeṣāḥ upalabhyante tathā eva tad viśeṣitam sāmānyam api iti yadā hi paṇya ñca purā avasthita gopiṇḍānām vasanta samaye bāla ādi avasthā viśeṣitānām upalambhaḥ tadā tad viśeṣitam sāmānyam upalabhyate anyadā tu anya viśeṣitam iti piṇḍeṣu anugata jñāna janaka tvam sāmānyasya sarvatra avyabhicāri svarūpam tasmāda bhada ātmakam aneka vṛtti ca sāmānyam pratyakṣeṇa upalambhāt abhyupagantavyam yathā hi rūpam ekam eva ekatra vartamāna pratyakṣeṇa upalabdham tadvat ekam sāmānya manekatra iti

yat ca idam deśa ādi viśeṣita svabhāvāt aneka vṛtteḥ ekasya na deśa ādi viśeṣavatā anyana yogaḥ iti uktam tatra vyartha viśeṣaṇatā hetomiṇaḥ ca tathā hi eka saṃsarga avyavacchinna svabhāva antara virahāt na sāmānyasya viśeṣa antareṇa yogaḥ iti pratiṣedhe sādhye vyabhicāra abhāvāt sādhya sādhanayoḥ deśa ādi viśeṣaṇa manarthakam vyavacchedya sadbhāve hi viśeṣaṇasya arthavat ta upapatteḥ

atha yathā ukta svabhāva antara virahe katham anya yogaḥ sāmānya ādeḥ anya yoge vā katham yathā ukta svabhāva antara virahaḥ tayoḥ anyatra rūpa ādau pratibandha siddhiḥ iti ced na vyabhicārāt tathā hi rūpa āśrayasya rūpa saṃsarga avyavacchin na svabhāva antara virahe api rasa ādibhiḥ yogaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ tadvat sāmānyasya api āśraya antareṇa yogaḥ kena vāryate rūpa āśraya vat sāmānye api yathā ukta svabhāva antara asattvasyāḥ viśeṣāt iti asti ca rūpasya āśrayaḥ dravyam iti uktam

atha eka tvāt sāmānyasya anekatra samavāyaḥ pratiṣiddhayate tarhi yat ane katra samavetam tat anekam eva iti abhyupagame hetoḥ vyatireka avyabhicāreṇa eva gamaka tvāda ekatra samavetānām rūpa ādīnām ekatā prasajyeta na ca etat asti atha ekatvā dekatra eva samavāyaḥ sādhyate tat api anaikāntikam ākāśa ādeḥ eka tve api ekatra eva samavāya abhāvāt yadi anekatra samavāyāt aneka tva prasaṅgaḥ abhidhīyet tathā api yat ekam tat ekatra samavetam iti vyatireka abhāvaḥ sati api ākāśa ādau eka tve tad abhāvāt ekatra samavāyāt eka tvam iti etat api rūpa śabda ādibhiḥ anaikāntikam eka tvasya sāmānya viśeṣa rūpa tvāt tasmin sādhye hetoḥ anvaya vyatirekāḥ bhāvāt agamaka tvam evam nirviśeṣaṇasya hetoḥ antaraḥ sādhya sādhana bhāva prakāraḥ nirastaḥ tathā sa viśeṣaṇasya api hetoḥ ākāśa ādinā anaikāntika tvam tasya hi deśa ādi viśeṣavatā anyena yoge api tathā ukta svabhāva antara viraha upalabdheḥ

yat ca idam pradīpa prabhāyāḥ deśa ādi viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭāyāḥ na deśa ādi viśeṣavatā anyena yogaḥ iti udāharaṇam tatra api utpatterū + mava yava kriyā krameṇa vināśāḥ bhyupagamāt aneka kāla vyavadhāne deśa ādi viśeṣavatā anyena api yogaḥ sambhavati eva na ca pradīpa prabhāyām sādhya sādhana sadbhāve api hetoḥ vyabhicāra upadarśanāt gamaka tvam tathā sāmānyasya svabhāva antara virahaḥ asiddhaḥ atad ādhāra antarasya tad viśeṣaka tvena tad svabhāva antara tvāt pratīyate ca ādhāra ādheyayaḥ viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāvaḥ yathā sa dravyam

dravyasya sattā iti tasmāt svabhāva antara virahaḥ api sādhyaḥ eva iti tathā aneka vṛtta rekasya na deśa ādi viśeṣa vatā anyena yogaḥ iti prasaṅga nirdeśe sva vacana virodhaḥ tathā hi anya yoga pratiṣedhe na aneka vṛtti tvam bhavati iti atha sāmānya ādi paryāyaḥ ayam anekatra vṛttiḥ iti tathā api aneka vṛtti tva pratiṣedhaḥ anupapannaḥ sāmānyasva nitya tvai katve sati aneka vṛtti tva lakṣaṇa tvāt pratyakṣeṇa ca sāmānyasya aneka vṛtti tva prasiddheḥ tena bādhya tvāt anumānam apramāṇam tathā hi eka dvi bahuṣu piṇḍeṣu akṣa vyāpārāt atu gata jñānam utpadyamānam dṛṣṭam na ca idam bhrāntam pratyakṣa āgama saṃvādena visaṃvāda nivṛttau tad vyāptasya bhrānta tvasya nivṛtteḥ iti

na ca apohāt eva anugata jñānam tasya vyāvṛtti rūpa tā āyām avastu tvenā janakatvāt janaka tve vā tasya artha kriyā kāritvāt vastu tva prasaṅgaḥ atha vyāvṛttāt anyā vyāvṛttiḥ na iṣyate tarhi teṣām paraspara vyāvṛtta svarūpa tayā anugata jñāna janaka tvam na syāt yat ca idam ago vyāvṛttiḥ go tvam iti uktam tatra gavām svarūpa pratipatti mantareṇa tatas anyeṣām ago rūpatāyāma prasiddhiḥ tad aprasiddhau ca na gavām svarūpa pratipattiḥ iti anyonya āśraya tvam syāt yadi ca ekasmāt gopiṇḍāt anyeṣām agaḥ rūpa tā tarhi gopiṇḍānām api anyeṣa āma go rūpatā prasaṅgaḥ teṣām api ekasmāt gopiṇḍāt anya tvāt

atha sarvasmāt gopiṇḍāt anyeṣām ago tvam tat asat vargīkaraṇa nimittā sambhave sarveṣām gopiṇḍa nāma pratipattau tatas anyeṣām pratipattum aśakyatvāt yeṣāñca anugatam abhinna nimittam asti teṣām go sva rūpa prasiddhau tatas anyaḥ vyāvṛttiḥ pratīyate eva atha artha kriyā sāmānyāt anuvṛtti pratyayaḥ iti ced na artha kriyāṇām api parasparam vyāvṛtta tayā anugata jñāna ajanaka tvāt atha artha kriyāṇām anugatam abhinnam nimittam upagrāha kamiṣyeta tat eva tarhi sāmānyam

kā ca iyam artha kriyā yat sāmyāt anugata jñānam iti vācyam yadi vāha ādi rūpā sā ca manuṣya ādau api sambhavati iti tatra api gaugauḥ iti anugata jñāna prasaṅgaḥ na ca pakṣe sarvatra etat asti iti anugata jñāna abhāva prasaṅgaḥ atha jñānam eva anugata vyāvṛtta ākāram sāmānyam iti ced saḥ ayam aśva ārūḍhasya vismṛtaḥ aśvaḥ iti nyāyaḥ na hi anugata nimittam vinā anugata jñānam sambhavati vāsanādenimittasya pratiṣedhāt

yat api idam sāmānyasya ādhāre vrajati gamane kriyāvat tvam avasthāne cānā dhāratvam iti tat asat bādhaka upapattau gamana pratyayasya bhākta tvāt tathā ca mūrta tvena kriyāvat tvam vyāptam tat ca sāmānya ādibhyaḥ vyāvarttamānam sva vyāpta kriyāvat tvam gṛhītvā vyāvarttate iti niṣkiyam sāmānyādi mūrta tve sati eva anvaya vyatirekābhyām artheṣu kriyā upalabdheḥ sā eva yogya tā tad abhāvāt ca ākāśa ādau kriyā bhāvaḥ na vibhu tva pratibandhāt tad abhāve hi guṇa karma ādau api kriyāvat tva prasaṅgāt yadi ca kasyacid sāmānya ādhārasya gamanāt sāmānyasya api gamanam tarhi tasya avasthāne avasthānañca iti na gacchet nāri tiṣṭhet iti duruddharam vyasanam āpadyeta tasmāt saṃyoga vibhāga eka artha samavāyāt ādhāra gatam gamanam ādheye api āropya pratipadyate sāmānyam gacchati iti

yat ca idam na yāti na ca tatrāsodasti paścāt na ca aṃśa vat iti uktam tad sāmānya svarūpa upavarṇanam na tasya pratiṣedha param dravya svarūpa anupalambhena sāmānyasya asattve sarvasya api asattvam syāt tad itara asattvasya sarvatra aviśeṣāt sāmānyañca viśeṣeṣu anuvartamānam pratyakṣeṇa eva prasiddham iti tasya anupalambhaḥ asiddhaḥ yadi ca asattvam sāmānyasya katham sva lakṣaṇa viṣayam pratyakṣam sāmānya viṣaya manu mānam iti syāt atha atad rūpa parāyatta vastu mātra prakāśanāt sāmānyam sat iti proktam liṅga bheda apratiṣṭhiteḥ iti ayam asya arthaḥ dāha pāka ādi samartha agni vyatirekiṇaḥ jala ādayaḥ atad rūpāḥ tebhyaḥ vyāvṛttasya tārṇa pārṇa ādi viśeṣa rahitasya agni mātrasya jñāpanāt sāmānya viṣayaḥ dhūmaḥ tathā dhūma jñānam api adhūma vyāvṛtta tā arṇā ādi viśeṣa rahita dhūma mātra viṣayam iti

na etat yuktam sāmānya anabhyupagame mātrā abhidhānasya artha asambhavāt na ca apohaḥ eva mātrā abhidhānasya arthaḥ tasya avastu tvena ajanaka tvāt vastu tve ca vāstavam eva sāmānyam abhyupagatam iti kaḥ pratikūlaḥ anukūlam ācarati iti na ca agni vyaktīnām sāmarthyam tad grāhaka avinā abhāvasya eva aprasiddheḥ na ca dhūma upalambhāt agni sāmastya pratipattiḥ dṛṣṭā iti atha tārṇa ādīnām anyatamaḥ viśeṣaḥ mātrā abhidhāna viṣayaḥ tarhi katham sāmānya viṣayam anumātam na ca agni vyaktiṣu viśiṣṭa artha kriyā kāritayā samānā buddhiḥ kriyāṇām api parasparam vyāvṛtta tvā diti ukta nyāyāt etena yat uktam liṅga liṅgi dhiyoḥ eva pāramparyeṇa vastuni pratibandhāt tad ābhāsa śūnyayoḥ api avañcanam iti etat apāstam bhavati iti tayoḥ dvayoḥ sāmānya abhāve pāramparyeṇa api vastu pratibandha abhāvāt

na ca adhūma vyāvṛtta ākārāt vikalpāt anagni vyāvṛtta ākāraḥ vikalpaḥ tayoḥ avinā abhau asya aprasiddheḥ agni pratipattim antareṇāḥ nagnayaḥ na pratīyante tad apratipattau na agni pratipattiḥ itaretara āśraya tva prasaṅgāt na ca kāryatvena dhūmasya gamaka tvam iti uktam vyāpti samarthana avasare tasmāt sāmānyavatām avinā abhāva prasiddharanu mānam icchatā avaśyam sāmānyam abhyupaganta vyam anyathā hi vāstava sāmānyam vinā bhāvasya aprasiddhau saṅketa apratipatteḥ ca na anumāna śabdayoḥ pramāṇatā syāt iti asti ca tayoḥ prāmāṇyam tasmāt artha pratipattau pravarttamānasya artha kriyā saṃvādena visaṃvādi nivṛttau tad vyāptasya bhrānta tvasya nivṛttiḥ iti uktam pūrvam atas sva ātma rūpa anuvṛtti pratyaya kāraṇam iti

saṅgraha vākyasya vivaraṇam āha svarūpa abhedena eka rūpeṇa ādhāreṣu śābale yādi piṇḍeṣu prabandhena anuparameṇa pūrva piṇḍā parityāgena samavāya vṛttyā vartamā nam anu vṛtti buddhi kāraṇam iti eka dvi bahuṣu iti asya vivaraṇam ādhāreṣu iti abheda ātmaka padasya tu svarūpa abhedena iti katham iti avyutpanna praśnaḥ viparya stākṣepaḥ vā tathā ca eka piṇḍa upalambha kāle na anugatam sāmānyam pratibhāti dvitīya piṇḍa upalambha kāle api prathama piṇḍasya agrahaṇāt anugata jñāna abhāvaḥ eva yatra api ekam jñānam aneka piṇḍa ālambanam tatra api anugajñānasya anupalambhaḥ eva iti ākṣepe sati pratisamādhānam āha pratipiṇḍam sāmānya apekṣam ityādi

piṇḍa piṇḍam prati prabandhena sātatyena jñānānām utpattiḥ tasya añca satyā pūrva pūrva anubhava janita saṃskāra apekṣaḥ uttarottara pratyayaḥ abhyāsaḥ tena jānataḥ saṃskāraḥ tasmāt ca atīta jñāna prabandha pratyavekṣaṇam bhavati atītaḥ ca asau jñāna prabandhaḥ ca tasmin pratyavekṣaṇam smaraṇam bhavati jñāyate iti jñānam jñaptiḥ ca jñānam iti ubhaya viṣayam smaraṇam bhavati iti etat sadṛśā yā prāk upalabdhaḥ iti evam smaraṇāt samanugatam yat asti iti jñāyate tat sāmānyāmā tad sadaśaḥ ayam iti pratyabhijñānāt ca yata tad sādṛśyam bhinneṣu abhinna pratyaya tad sāmānyam iti vyavasthitam

tatra sattā param sāmānyam anuvatti pratyaya kāraṇam eva yathā paraspa viśiṣṭeṣu carma vastra kambala ādiṣu ekaram ānīla dravya abhisambandhāt nā nīlam iti pratyaya anuvṛttiḥ tathā paraspara viśiṣṭeṣu dravya guṇa kama viśiṣṭā sat sat iti pratyaya anuvṛttiḥ sā ca artha antarāt bhavitumahata yat tad artha antaram sā sattā iti siddhā sattāna sambandhāt sattā pratyaya anuvṛttiḥ tasmāt sā sāmānyam eva bhedam nirūpayati tatra sattā param sāmānyam atra ca mahā viṣaya tvā diti uktam eva sādhanam sā tu sattā sāmānyam eva kutas yatas anuvṛtti sya eva kāraṇam yadi api abhāva ādibhyaḥ vyāvṛtti jñānasya api hetuḥ sāmānyavatsu anuvṛttām eva buddhi janayati na vyāvṛttām atas sānā meva iti

tatra sāmānya mātrasya sat abhāve vyavasthāpite vispaṣṭā atha sa sadbhāva anumānam āha yat vā pūrva pratyakṣam uktam idānīm anumānam ucyata vyāpti samarthana artha dṛṣṭāntam vyācaṣṭe yathā paraspara viśiṣṭeṣu vyāvṛtteṣu carma vastra kambala ādiṣu anyasmāt artha antara bhūtāt nīla dravya sambandhāt nīla na pratyaya anuvṛttiḥ tathā paraspara viśiṣṭe dravya guṇa karmasu aviśiṣṭā sat sat iti pratyaya anuvṛttiḥ iti dārṭa antika nirūpaṇam sā ca pratyaya anuvṛtti sambandhāt bhavitum arhati yat tad artha antaram sā sattā iti siddhā sattā sambandhāt sat sat iti pratyaya anuvṛttiḥ tasmāt sāmānyam eva prayogaḥ tu dravya guṇa karmasu sat sat iti pratyayaḥ viśeṣya vyatirikta anugata nimitta nibandhanaḥ

bhinneṣu anugata pratyayāt kambala ādiṣu nīla dravya sambandhāt nīla nīlam iti jñāna vat sāmānyena ca viśeṣya vyatirikta anugata nimitta nibandhana tve sādhye na pācaka ādi jñānavyam bhicāraḥ teṣām api sa pakṣa tvāt tathā hi pācakaḥ iti jñāne paci kriyā nimittam tad abhijña tā vā tad sadbhāve kriyā uparame api pācakaḥ iti vyavahāḥ rāt evam daṇḍī iti jñāne daṇḍaḥ nimittam śulkaḥ iti jñāne ca guṇaḥ nimi ttam iti sarvatra vyatiriktam eva nimittam daṇḍa ādeḥ tu parasparam vilakṣaṇa tvāt anugata jñāna utpattau ekam abhinnam nimittam upagrāhakam abhyupagantavyam anyathā hi anugata jñāna ajanaka tvam eva syāt atas daṇḍeṣu daṇḍa tvam śukla ādiṣu ca tad sāmānyam iti vācyam yat ca idam sāmānyam sāmānyam iti anugata jñānam atra api ekatve nitya tve satya nekatra samavāyaḥ nimittam evam sarvatra nimitta antaram abhyūhyam

aparam dravya tva guṇa tva karma tva ādi ityādi padena pṛthivī tva ādeḥ grahaṇam anuvṛtti vyāvṛtti pratyaya hetu tvāt sāmānyam viśeṣaḥ ca bhavati iti tat eva āha tatra dravya tvam paraspara viśiṣṭeṣu vyāvṛtta svarūpeṣu pṛthivī ādiṣu anuvṛtti pratyaya hetutvāt sāmānyam guṇa karmabhyaḥ vyāvṛtti pratyaya hetu tvāt viśeṣaḥ yathā dravya tvam tathā guṇa tvam api paraspara viśiṣṭeṣu rūpa ādiṣu anuvṛtti pratyaya hetutvāt sāmānyam dravya karmabhyaḥ vyāvṛtti pratyaya hetu tvāt viśeṣaḥ tathā karma tvam paraspara viśiṣṭa ṣad kṣepaṇa ādiṣu anuvṛtti pratyaya hetu tvāt sāmānyam dravya guṇebhyaḥ vyāvṛtti pratyaya hetu tvāt viśeṣaḥ evam pṛthivī tva rūpa tva ukṣepaṇa tva go tva ghaṭa tva paṭa tva ādī nām api prāṇi aprāṇi gatānām anuvṛtti vyāvṛtti pratyaya hetu tvāt sāmānya viśeṣa bhāva siddhaḥ iti atideśaḥ prāṇa sambandhini piṇḍe gatāni go tva aśva tvādoni aprāṇi gatāni pṛthivī tva ādīni prāṇa śūnya ādhāra gatāni sva bhede anuvṛtti pratyaya hetu tvāt bheda antarāt vyāvṛtti pratyaya hetu tvāt ca teṣām sāmānya viśeṣa bhāvaḥ siddhaḥ iti

na ca ekasya vastunaḥ dvairūpya anupalabdheḥ katham tat eva sāmānyam viśeṣaḥ ca iti atha ekam atra pāramārthikam anyat ca upacaritam iti avirodhaḥ tatra kim mukhya vṛttyā sāmānyāni viśeṣāḥ vā iti āha etāni dravya tva ādīni prabhūta viṣaya tvāta prādhānyena mukhya vṛttyā sāmānyāni na hi viśeṣāṇām prabhūta viṣaya tvam sambhavāta ekaika dravya vṛtti tvāt sva āśraya viśeṣaka tvāt bhaktayā upacāreṇa viśeṣa ākhyā nīti vyāvṛtti pratyaya janaka tvam viśeṣāṇām svarūpam tasya iha api upalabdha īpacāra pravartate eva tathā hi dravya tva ādi sāmānyam sva āśrayam āśraya antarāt vyāpa viśinaṣṭi vyāvarttayati iti iti atas viśeṣa ākhyām api labhate

atha dravya tva ādīni dravya guṇa karmabhyaḥ artha antaram svarūpāṇi vā va lakṣaṇa bhedāt eṣām dravya gaṇa karmabhyaḥ padārtha antara tvam siddham a tat ca uktam abheda ātmakam aneka vṛtti iti padena atas eva ca nitya tvam yatas eva dravya ādibhyaḥ padārtha anta ratvam atas eva ca nitya tvam dravya guṇa karma ātmakasya bhāvasya anitya tvaḥ palabdheḥ

nanu ca anutpattimat tvena nitya tvam na dravya ādibhyaḥ padārtha antara tvena sāmānya ādi trayasya api nitya tvena sādhya tvāt na etat evam yatas dravya ādibhyaḥ vibhinna svarūpa sambandhi tvena pratibhāsanāt artha antara tvam atas eva ca nitya tvam utpatti vināśa kāraṇā sambhavāt tathā hi sāmānyasya utpatti kāraṇam na asti tad ādhārāṇām yugapada sambhavena samavāyi kāraṇa abhāvāt iti evam nirṇītam padārtha saṅkare

atha ekam eva sāmānyam sattā lakṣaṇam upādhi bhedāt bhinna pratyaya sampādakam itye tasya nirāsa artham āha dravya ādiṣu vṛtti niyamāt pratyaya bhedāt ca parasparata śca anya tvam iti e dravyeṣu eva dravya tvam guṇeṣu eva guṇa tvam ityādi vṛtti niyamaḥ pratyaya bhedaḥ tu dravyeṣu eva dravyam dravyam iti dravya tva vaśa ajñānam guṇeṣu ca guṇa tva yogāt guṇaḥ guṇaḥ ityādi tasmāt pratyaya bhedāt dravya ādiṣu vṛtti niyamāt ca parasparataḥ api anya tvam anyathā hi sarva padārtheṣu eka tvāt sāmānyasya vṛtti niyamaḥ pratyaya bhedaḥ ca na syāt

atha astu parasparataḥ anya tvam tathā api sva āśrayeṣu dravyam iti dravya tva vaśāt jñānam guṇeṣu ca guṇaḥ ityādi yasmāt tat kim ekam anekam vā iti āśaṅkā nirāsāya āha pratyekam sva āśrayeṣu ekam dravya tvam guṇeṣu ekam guṇa tvam iti evam śeṣeṣu api iti kutas etat lakṣaṇa aviśeṣāt anugata svarūpā viśeṣāt yat vā lakṣyate anena iti vā lakṣaṇam dravyam dravyam ityādi anugata jñānam tasya aviśeṣāt eva dravyeṣu dravya tvam guṇeṣu guṇa tvam anyathā hi ane nugata jñānam eva syāt
