yat vā anabhyāsa daśa āpanna etat jñāna prāmāṇyam etad prāmāṇya saṃśaya pūrva kālīna etat jñāna niścaya aviṣaye etat jñāna niścaya anantaram saṃdihyamāna tvāt aprāmāṇya vat na ca sva padasya prāmāṇya mātra paratvāt tad āśraya agrāhya tvena bādhaḥ sva padasya sambandhi paratvena samabhivyāhṛta para tvāt anyathā svasya paratvāt parasya ca sva tvāt tat etattvasya tat etat anyatvasya ca su aparasādhāraṇa tvāt svatas bādhāt pariśeṣaṇanyathāgrāhya tvam paratas grāhya tvam iti kaścid prathamam ca prāmāṇya jñānam vyatirekiṇā

nanu prāmāṇya prasiddhim vinā vyāpti agrahāt katham anumānam atha vyāghāta daṇḍa bhayena pramātadviṣaya siddhau tad dṛṣṭāntena jñeya tva ādinā vahneḥ pramāviṣaya tvam anumeyam tatas ca sāmānyatas tad siddhau na sādhya aprasiddhiḥ viśiṣya anirṇayāt na anvayitvā sādhāraṇye na ca prāmāṇyam na anugatam kim tu pratijñānam viṣaya prakāra bhedāt bhinnam tathā ca vahni jñānasya vahnaya vṛtti prakāra an avacchinna tva ādikam sādhyam tat ca aprasiddham iti vācyam

vahni jñānasya viśeṣya avṛtti prakāra an avacchinna tva ādikam sādhyamānam pakṣa dharma tā balena vahni viṣayaka pramātve paryavasyati iti ced tarhi prathamam kasya api sva artha prāmāṇya anumānam na syāt prāmāṇya niṣedha rupasya parakīya vyādhātasya tadā anupasthiteḥ svayam prāmāṇya niṣedhasya tat dhī pūrvaka tvāt prāmāṇyam aparijñāya prāmāṇya niṣedhena parakīya vyāghātasya ajñānāt ca pravṛtti saṃvāda visaṃvādābhyām tad hetu jñāna vaicitrya anumāne api yathā ukta rūpa prāmāṇyasya viśiṣya apratīteḥ iti

ucyate prāc bhavīya saṃskārāt viśeṣya āvṛttyaprakāraka tvam tadvati tad prakāraka jñāna tvam vā prāmāṇya mātram smṛtam vahni jñāna ādau sādhyamānam sarvanāma mahimnā pakṣa dharma tā balāt vahni jñānasya viśeṣya āvṛttyaprakāraka tva ādau paryavasyati svatas prāmāṇya niṣedhe prāthamika prāmāṇyajñānasya anyathā upapādayitum aśakya tvāt iti saṃpradāya vidaḥ

vayam tu brūmaḥ prathamam aprāmāṇya abhāvaḥ eva prāmāṇyam vyatirekiṇā sādhyam tatas eva niṣkampa pravṛtteḥ upapatteḥ tat eva vā sidhyat pakṣa dharma tā balena tadvati tad prakāraka tva ādikam ādāya sidhyati tad anantaram arthāt vā sidhyati iti vakṣyate tathā hi ayam vahni tvena anubhavaḥ na vahni tva abhāvavati vahni tva prakārakaḥ avahni vṛtti aprakārakaḥ na viśeṣya āvṛtti prakārakaḥ na vahni tva prakāraka tve sati vahni aviśeṣyakaḥ na vahni tva vyadhikaraṇa prakāra avacchinnaḥ na vahni avṛtti prakārakaḥ na vā dāha samartha viṣayaka prayatna janaka tve sati vahni tva prakāraka niścaya tvāt dāha samartha viśeṣyaka vahni tva prakāraka niścaya tvāt vā yat na evam tatra evam yathā vahni apramā tatra bādha anantaram smṛti upanīte bhrame vahni tva abhāvavati vahni tvena mama jñānam vṛttam iti aprāmāṇyam manasā eva paricchidyate māna antareṇa vā iti sarva siddham

evam vahni apramāyām vahni tva abhāvavati vahni tva prakāraka tva ādi samartha pravṛtti janaka tva abhāvayoḥ vyāpti grahe aprāmāṇya vyāpaka hetu abhāva abhāva rūpāt hetoḥ aprāmāṇya abhāva rūpam sādhyam sidhyati yad vyāpaka tayā hetu abhāvaḥ gṛhītaḥ tad abhāvaḥ eva hetunā sādhyate yatra tu abhāvasya vyāpaka tā hetu abhāvasya jñāyate sādhya prasiddhiḥ aṅgam tām vinā tad ajñānāt yatra tu bhāva vyāpaka tā hetu abhāvasya tatra na tad aṅgam tena vinā api vyatireka vyāpteḥ grahāt atas eva itara vyāpaka tā ākāśa tva abhāvasya gṛhīta iti ākāśa tvena aprasiddhaḥ eva itara anyonya abhāvaḥ sidhyati

viśeṣaṇa jñānam vinā katham prāmāṇya viśiṣṭa anumitiḥ iti ced prathamam na kathaṃcid jñāne prāmāṇyam iti ānum iti anantaram tena eva hetunā tatra eva prāmāṇya viśiṣṭa anumitiḥ abhāva viśeṣyaka prati iti anantaram abhāvavat bhū talam iti jñāna vat evam ca idam vahni tva prakāraka jñānam tadvati tad abhāvavati vā iti saṃśaya anantaram tad abhāvavati tad prakāraka tva vyatirekaḥ sidhyan tad prakāraka tām ādāya sidhyati tṛtīya prakāra abhāvena tena vinā sādhyasya upasaṃhartum aśakyatvāt jñāna nitya tva vat

yat vā idam vahni tva prakāraka jñānam vahni tva vat viṣaya kam vahni tva abhāva vat aviṣayaka tve sati sa viṣayaka tvāt yat na evam tat na evam yathā vahni apramā iti vyatireki antarāt tad siddhiḥ atirikta viṣaya tā pakṣe ayam vahni tvena anubhavaḥ avahni vṛtti vahni tva prakāraka viṣaya tākaḥ na vahni tva asamāna adhikaraṇa vahni tva prakāraka viṣaya tākaḥ na viṣayatā āśraya āvṛtti prakārakaḥ na vā iti sādhyam vahni vṛtti vahni tva prakāraka viṣaya tāka tvam viṣaya tā āśraya vṛtti prakāraka tvam vā arthāt sidhyati na tu prathamam sādhya aprasiddheḥ vahni bhrame ca viṣayatā āśrayaḥ na vahniḥ viṣaya tāyāḥ viśeṣya vṛtti tvāt iti bhrama tvena na siddha sādhanam

anye tu vahni bhrame yā viśeṣaṇa vṛttiḥ viṣaya tā sā viśeṣya vṛtti viṣaya tāyāḥ abhinna iti na sā vahni tva asamāna adhikaraṇa dharmān avacchinnā iti na siddha sādhanam iti na ca maṇi jñānasya prāmāṇya anumāne maṇi prabhāyām maṇi bhrameṇa pravṛttasya maṇi prāptau maṇi gocara prayatna janaka maṇi tva prakāraka niścaya tvam anaikāntikam iti vācyam maṇi prabhā viṣayaka jñānena bhinna viṣaya tayā maṇi gocara prayatna anutpādāt maṇi prāptiḥ tu na antarīyaka tvāt jñāna prayatnayoḥ asamāna kāla tve api anubhava smaraṇayoḥ iva manasā kārya kāraṇa bhāva grahaḥ iti na asiddhiḥ abhāva sādhyake ca nirvikalpakasya prathamam sa pakṣa tvena aniścayān na asādhāraṇyam tathā iyam pṛthivī iti anubhavaḥ pṛthivī tva abhāvavati pṛthivī tva prakārakaḥ na apṛthivī vṛtti prakārakaḥ na viśeṣya āvṛtti prakārakaḥ na

pṛthivī tva prakāraka tve sati pṛthivī aviśeṣyakaḥ na pṛthivī tva vyadhikaraṇa prakāra avacchinnaḥ na pṛthivī avṛtti prakārakaḥ na vā gandhavat viśeṣyaka pṛthivī tva prakāraka niścaya tvāt iti vyatirekī pṛthivī tva bhramaḥ pṛthivī tva abhāvavati pṛthivī tva prakārakaḥ iti na bhrama tvena siddha sādhanam na vā gandhavat viśeṣyakaḥ iti na vyabhicāraḥ pṛthivī tvavati pṛthivī tva prakāraka tva ādikam arthāt sidhyati viṣaya tā pakṣe ayam pṛthivī tvena anubhavaḥ apṛthivī vṛtti pṛthivī tva prakāraka viṣaya tākaḥ na pṛthivī avṛtti pṛthivī tva prakāraka viṣaya tākaḥ na pṛthivī tva asamāna adhikaraṇa pṛthivī tva prakāraka viṣaya tākaḥ na viṣayatā āśraya āvṛtti prakārakaḥ na vā iti sādhyam pṛthivī tva samāna adhikaraṇa pṛthivī tva prakāraka viṣaya tāka tva ādikam arthāt sidhyati

anye tu pṛthivī tva asamāna adhikaraṇa prakāra avacchinna viṣaya tāka tva abhāvaḥ sādhyaḥ gandha asamāna adhikaraṇa aprakāraka gandha samāna adhikaraṇa prakāraka viṣaya tā pratiyogi jñāna tvāt tena saṃśaya vyavacchedaḥ niścaya tvam vā tad viśeṣaṇam iti āhuḥ śītā pṛthivī iti anubhavaḥ pṛthivī aṃśe pramā eva pramā bhrama rūpe ca samūha ālambane na vyabhicāraḥ aṃśe tasya api pramātvāt viśeṣya bhedena viṣaya tā bhedāt ca na ca prakāra bhedena viṣaya tā bhedaḥ māna abhāvāt

yat tu iyam pṛthivī iti anubhavaḥ pṛthivī tva samāna adhikaraṇa dharma avacchinna pṛthivī viśeṣyaka viṣaya tākaḥ pṛthivī tva vyadhikaraṇa dharma anavacchinna pṛthivī viśeṣyaka viṣaya tākaḥ pṛthivī avṛtti dharmān avacchinna pṛthivī vṛtti viṣaya tākaḥ vā gandha asamāna adhikaraṇa dharma aprakāraka viṣaya tā pratiyogi jñāna tvāt agandhavat avṛtti pṛthivī tva prakāraka viṣaya tāka tvāt gandha samāna adhikaraṇa viṣaya tā pratiyaḥ gijñāna tvāt vā iti tat na sādhya aprasiddheḥ kim tu arthāt eva tat sidhyati evam yat prakāra vyāpya tayā yat gandha sneha samartha pravṛtti janaka tva kara caraṇa ādikam avagatam tadvati tad prakāraka jñāna tvam eva prāmāṇye liṅgam

nanu vahni jñānasya dāha samartha viṣaya tvam na dāha samarthaḥ ayam iti vyavasāya gamyam jñāna viṣaya tayoḥ tad aviṣaya tvāt na api tad anu vyavasāya gamyam puras varti dāha sāmarthyasya tad agocara tvāt vyavasāya upanīta dāha sāmarthyasya ca bhāne tat asāmarthyāt anyathā vyavasāya upanītasya purovartini vahni tvasya anuvyavasāya viṣaya tve svatas prāmāṇya graha āpatteḥ evam pṛthivī jala jñānayoḥ gandha sneha vat viṣayaka tva grahaḥ api anupapannaḥ iti

ucyate vahni tva prakāraka jñāna anuvyavasāye sati tatra viṣaye dāha sāmarthya jñāna anantaram tad smṛti upanīte vahni vyavasāye smṛti upanīta dāha samartha viṣayaka tvam evam jala pṛthivī jñānayoḥ smṛti upanītayoḥ jñāna upanīta sneha gandhavat viṣayaka tvam manasā paricchidyate gandha ādimati eva mama pṛthivī tva ādi anubhavaḥ iti gandha ādimattva pariccheda anantaram anubhavāt smṛti upanīte dhūma ādau vyāpti pariccheda vat cakṣuṣā candane saurabha jñāna vat ca

tarhi pṛthivī tva jñāne gandhavat viśeṣyaka tvāt cakṣuṣā gandhavati pṛthivī tva upanaya anantaram iyam pṛthivī iti pṛthivī tva prakāraka anubhave upanīte pṛthivī tvavati pṛthivī tva prakāraka tvam tathā tatra eva jñāne ghaṭa tva prakāraka tā viraha vat pṛthivī avṛtti prakāra abhāvavat tvam viśeṣya āvṛtti prakāra abhāvavat tvam vā prāmāṇyam manasā eva paricchidyatām iti svatas eva prāmāṇya grahaḥ iti ced na jñāna antara upasthāpita jñāna vṛtti prāmāṇya grahe paratas tvānapāyāt

yāvat jñāna grāhaka sāmagrī grāhya tvam yāvat svāśraya grāhaka grāhya tvam tad jñāna viṣaya ka janya jñāna ajanya janya jñāna grāhya tvam vā svatas tvam tad anyathāgrāhya tvam tu paratas tvam manasā ca evam prāmāṇya grahasya abhyupagame tad jñāna viṣaya ka janya jñāna janya jñāna grāhya tvāt na paratas tu ahāniḥ vyatireki anantaram tad jātīya tvena anvayinā grāhya tvāt na prāmāṇya anumānam yathā idam śarīra jñānam pramā kara caraṇavati śarīra jñāna tvāt sva śarīra jñāna vat na ca kara caraṇa antaravati kara caraṇa antara vat tva jñāne vyabhicāraḥ śarīra aṃśe tasya pramātvāt

etena kara caraṇavati śarīra jñāna tvāt iti atra kara caraṇa vat tvam na upalakṣaṇam vyāvṛtta upalakṣya abhāvāt na ca viṣaya tā jñāna viśeṣaṇam kara caraṇa vat tva prakāraka śarīra jñāna tvasya vyabhicārāt śarīram iti jñāne tad asiddheḥ ca viṣaya viśeṣaṇa tve kara caraṇa vat viṣayaka śarīra jñāna tvasya vyabhicārāt śarīra bhramasya api vastutas kara ādimat viṣayaka tvāt na api kara caraṇa ādi śūnye yat śarīra tvena jñānam tad anya tve sati iti vivakṣitam śūnyaḥ iti atra viṣaya tvam saptamī arthaḥ iti kara caraṇa śūnya viṣaya ka śarī jñāna ani aśarīra jñāna tvāt iti arthaḥ tathā ca asiddhiḥ śarīra jñānasya tat śūnya śarīra tva ādi viṣayaka tva niyamāt na vā kara caraṇa śūnye yat śarīra tvena jñānam na bhavati iti vivakṣitam tṛtīya arthasya viṣaya tve ukta doṣāt anyasya asambhavāt iti nirastam kara caraṇa vat viśeṣyaka śarīra tva prakāraka jñāna tvasya hetu tvāt śarīra bhrame ca kara caraṇavataḥ śarīrasya viśeṣaṇa tvāt viṣaya tā pakṣe kara caraṇa ādi śūnya niṣṭha śarīra tva prakāraka viṣaya tā pratiyogi tva śūnya tve sati śarīra jñāna tvāt iti hetuḥ

nanu na anya gṛhīta prāmāṇyam jñānam para prāmāṇya niścaya rūpam anavasthānāt na api sva jñāyamāna prāmāṇyam svatas prāmāṇya graha āpatteḥ atas agṛhīta prāmāṇyam eva jñānam para prāmāṇya niścaya rūpam āstheyam tathā ca vyavasāyaḥ api agṛhīta prāmāṇyaḥ eva sva viṣayam niścāyayatu kim viṣaya niścaya artham tad prāmāṇya niścayena atha vyavasāyasya aprāmāṇya darśanāt na tanmātrāt artha niścayaḥ tarhi prāmāṇya anumiteḥ api aprāmāṇya darśanāt na tatas api prāmāṇya niścayaḥ iti ced na brūmaḥ jñāna prāmāṇya niścayāt eva artha niścayaḥ iti kim tu yatra aprāmāṇyaśaṅkā na asti kara tala āmalaka ādi jñāne tatra vyavasāyaḥ eva artha niścayaḥ iti tatas eva pravṛttiḥ niṣkampā yatra anabhyāsa daśāyām prāmāṇya saṃśayena artha niścayam paribhūya artha saṃśayaḥ tatra prāmāṇya niścaya adhīna jñānāt artham niścitya niṣkampam pravartate na anyathā iti sarva anubhava siddham

atas eva agṛhīta prāmāṇyam eva jñānam para prāmāṇyam niścāyayati aprāmāṇya śaṅkā kalaṅka abhāvāt yatra tu prāmāṇya jñāne aprāmāṇya śaṅkayā prāmāṇya saṃśayaḥ tatra prāmāṇya jñāne prāmāṇya niścayāt eva prāmāṇya niścayaḥ evam yāvat aprāmāṇyaśaṅkam tad jñāna prāmāṇya niścayāt eva tat niścayaḥ na ca evam anavasthā carama jñāna prāmāṇyasya jñāna abhāvena koṭi smaraṇa abhāvena viṣaya antara saṃcāreṇa vā prāmāṇya saṃśayān avaśyam bhāvāt

anyathā bhaṭṭa mate prāmāṇyasya jñāna anumiti grāhya tvena anavasthā syāt guru mate api prāmāṇyasya sva grāhya tvam na sva grāhyam svarūpa prāmāṇyābhyām bahis bhūta tvāt para grāhya tve anavasthānāt kim tu pariśeṣa anumānena pramāṇa antareṇa vā grāhyam tathā ca tad prāmāṇyasya api sva grāhya tvam anyena eva iti anavasthā eva yat tu vyavasāyasya prāmāṇya niścayāt eva pravṛtteḥ na tasya api prāmāṇya anusaraṇam iti na anavasthā na ca prāmāṇya saṃśayāt aucitya āvarjitaḥ viṣaya saṃśayaḥ iti vācyam niścite saṃśaya abhāvāt anyathā svatas grahe api tad saṃśaye anavasthā iti

tat asat yadi prāmāṇya saṃśayāt na viṣaye saṃśayaḥ niścita tvāt tadā viṣaya niścaya artham prāmāṇya niścayaḥ vyarthaḥ prāthamika viṣaya niścayāt eva niṣkampa pravṛtti upapatteḥ na hi viṣaya saṃśayam anādṛtya prāmāṇya niścayaḥ pravṛtti hetuḥ iti uktam anya saṃśayāt anyatra niścite katham saṃśayaḥ iti ced anubhavam pṛccha yena sva sākṣikam eva prāmāṇya saṃśayasya viṣaya saṃśaya hetu tvam anumatam jñāna viṣaya tvam api prāmāṇya saṃśayam āsādya viṣaya saṃśāyakam

nanu liṅga pakṣa vyāpti ādīnām jñānasya prāmāṇya avadhāraṇe anavasthā anavadhāraṇe hetu asiddhiḥ atha liṅga ādi jñānam sva viṣaya avadhāraṇe kartavye sva prāmāṇyajñānam na apekṣate anumāna mātra uccheda prasaṅgāt liṅga ādi niścayasya ca sva kāraṇa adhīnasya sarva siddha tvāt iti ced na prāmāṇya saṃśayena liṅgasya api saṃdehāt na hi na liṅga jñāne prāmāṇya saṃśayaḥ avirodhāt iti

ucyate aprāmāṇya śaṅkā kalaṅka abhāve liṅga ādi jñānasya eva artha niścāyaka tvāt tad kalaṅke tu uktā eva gatiḥ yat tu vyavasāye kvacid aprāmāṇya śaṅkā bhavati kvacid na iti tvayā api vācyam evam bahu vitta vyaya āyāsa sādhye svarga sādhanam yāgaḥ iti jñānam na gṛhīta prāmāṇyam pravartakam prāmāṇya anumiteḥ pūrvam eva tasya vināśāt kim tu tad jñāna samāna viṣaya kama prāmāṇya śaṅkā śūnyam jñāna antaram eva

nanu evam bahu vitta vyaya āyāsa sādhye niṣkampa pravṛttau anupayogi tvāt niṣphalam prāmāṇya jñānam iti kim tad upāya anusaraṇena iti ced na svarga sādhanam yāgaḥ iti jñāna prāmāṇye niścite tad samāna viṣayaka jñāna antare aprāmāṇyaśaṅkā na bhavati iti jñāna antaram agṛhīta prāmāṇyam api sva artha niścaya rūpam niṣkampa pravṛttim janayati iti aprāmāṇya śaṅkā pratibandha dvārā niṣkampa pravṛttau upayujyate prāmāṇya jñānam iti na niṣphalam

yat tu anumānasya nirasta samasta vibhrama āśaṅkasya svatas eva prāmāṇya grahaḥ iti uktam tat dhūmavati vahni jñāna tvam anumiteḥ prāmāṇya niyatam anuvyavasāya upanītam atas viśeṣa darśanāt na tatra aprāmāṇi aśaṅkā iti prāmāṇya niścayāt eva aprāmāṇya śaṅkā virahāt artham niścitya niṣkampa vyavahāraḥ iti abhiprāyaḥ vastutas tu paratas pakṣe na kvacid api prāmāṇya grahaḥ pravartakaḥ iti evam anuvyavasāyasya prāmāṇya niyata tvāt na prāmāṇya śaṅkā na hi ajānan jānāmi iti pratyeti na vā ghaṭa jñāne paṭam jānāmi iti bhrame api anuvyavasāyena rajata tva ādikam vyavasāya prakāra tvena ullikhyate tat ca tathā eva

yat tu abhyāsa daśāyām jhaṭiti pracuratara niṣkampa pravṛtti darśanāt prāmāṇyam svatas eva gṛhyate anyatra tu paratas iti tat na viśeṣya niṣṭhā ati anta abhāva pratiyogi prakāra an avacchinna tva ādikam prāmāṇyam svatas grahītum aśakyam iti paratas eva gṛhyate jhaṭiti pravṛttiḥ tu kara caraṇa ādimati śarīra jñāna tva ādeḥ viśeṣasya anuvyavasāyena grahāt aprāmāṇya śaṅkā śūnyāt vyavasāyāt eva na prāmāṇya jñānam pravartakam iti uktam jhaṭiti tad samavadhānam tu sva kāraṇa adhīnam na hi pipāsūnām jhaṭiti pracuratarā samarthā ca pravṛttiḥ ambhasi iti pipāsā upaśamana śaktiḥ asya pratyakṣāḥ iti

utpadyate api prāmāṇyam paratas na tu svatas jñāna sāmagrī mātrāt tad janya tve apramā api pramā syāt anyathā jñānam api sā na syāt jñāna sāmagryām doṣa anupraveśāt apramā iti ced tarhi jñāna viśeṣa vada pramā pramā viśeṣaḥ syāt jñāna sāmagrī janya tvāt tasmāt pramā pramayoḥ vaicitryāt guṇa doṣa janya tvam atha yatra guṇa doṣau vinā tayoḥ abhāvaḥ tatra jñāna sāmagrī eva na asti tad sattve jñāna mātra utpatti prasaṅgāt iti ced na viśeṣa vinākṛta sāmānya kārya abhāvāt tad sāmagrīm ādāya hi sāmānya sāmagrī tām vinā na asti eva vā anyathā kārya viśeṣe kāraṇa viśeṣa ucchedaḥ

nanu yathā eka jātīya sāmagrī sattve api ghaṭayoḥ bhedaḥ yama jayoḥ vaidharmyam ca tathā pramā pramayoḥ bhedaḥ vaidharmyam ca bhaviṣyati atha anugata vyavahārāt pramātvam anugatam iti pramā mātre anugataḥ hetuḥ vācyaḥ anugata kāryasya ananugatāt anutpatteḥ iti ced na pramātvasya upādhi tvena kārya tāvat chedaka tve māna abhāvāt kārya mātra vṛtti dharma tvasya nīla ghaṭa tva ghaṭa jñāna tva ādau vyabhicārāt

atha pramā jñāna hetu atirikta hetu janyāḥ janya jñāna tvāt apramāvat iti ced na pramāyāḥ jñānasya tad hetu janya tayā sādhye bādhāt jñāna ajanaka janya tve virodhāt apramāyām tad asiddheḥ vyartha viśeṣaṇa tvāt vyāvartya aprasiddheḥ kim ca yat kiṃcid jñāna hetu apekṣayā sarva tad hetu apekṣayā vā atirikta tve indriya ādibhiḥ siddha sādhanāt

na api jñāna sāmānyasāmagrī atirikta sāmagrī janyā iti sādhyam pūrvavat siddha sādhanāt virodhāt ca na ca sāmānya viśeṣayoḥ sāmagrī dvayam pramāyāḥ jñāna bhinna tva āpatteḥ anyathā sāmagrī bheda asiddhiḥ tasya kārya bheda kalpya tvāt etena jñāna sāmānya hetu atirikta hetu janyā iti sādhyam pratyuktam sakala jñāna abhiprāye ca indriya ādibhiḥ siddha sādhanam jñāna tva abhiprāye hetu asiddhiḥ na api jñāna tva avacchinna kārya tva ani a kārya tva pratiyogika kāraṇa janyā iti sādhyam jñāna tvasya nitya vṛtti tayā kārya tva anavacchedaka tvāt

atha yat dharma āśrayasya asataḥ sattvam hetu adhīnam tad kārya tāvacchedakam jñāna tvam ca tathā na ca asate iti adhikam vyoma ādi sādhāraṇa sattva mātrasya hetu aniyamya tvāt iti ced na yadā āliṅgitasya svarūpam hetu adhīnam tad kārya tāvacchedakam lāghavāt jñāna tvam tu na tathā anitya jñāna tva iti karaṇe indriya ādibhiḥ yathāyatham siddha sādhanam teṣām pratyekam jñāna mātrā hetu tvāt

etena pramātvam jñāna tva avacchinna kārya tā nirūpita kāraṇa tā bhinna kāraṇa tā pratiyogika kārya tāvacchedakam jñāna tva sākṣāt vyāpya dharma tvāt apramātva vat iti nirastam pramātu asya nitya vṛtti tvāt anitya pramātvam tathā kārya mātra vṛtti dharma tvāt iti api nīla ghaṭa tva ādinā vyabhicāri anitya pramā pramā prama ubhaya hetu bhinna hetu janyāḥ janya tvāt apramāvat iti ced na doṣasya pitta ādeḥ sva viṣaya pramā hetu tvena apramāyām sādhya aprasiddheḥ ghaṭa dṛṣṭānta tve tayā eva vyabhicārāt śaṅkha ādi aṃśe pītaḥ śaṅkhaḥ iti jñānasya api pramātvāt kāraṇa vyakti bheda janya tvena siddha sādhanāt ca

atha pramā apramāvya āvṛtta dharma avacchinna kārya tva pratiyogika kāraṇa janyā apramāvijātīya kārya tvāt ghaṭa vat yadi pramā apramātvā asamāna adhikaraṇa rūpa nirūpita kārya tu apratiyogika kāraṇa janyā na syāt apramā syāt iti ced na apramāvya āvṛtta dharma avacchinna kārya tvam saṃyogasya tad pratiyogika kāraṇam indriya ādi iti tat janya tvena siddha sādhanāt apramāsa ādhāraṇa vyakti janya tvam ca agre apramātādātmye prayojakam iti tarkaḥ api aprayojakaḥ

atha anitya pramā pramā pramānyatara pratibandhaka janyā pramā pramānyatara tvāt apramāvat cākṣuṣa pramā cākṣuṣa bhrama ājanaka janyāḥ anitya pramātvāt rāsana pramāvat iti ced na pramājana kāsa ādhāraṇa vyakti bhedasya apramā pratibandhaka tvena cākṣuṣa bhrama ajanaka tvena ca siddha sādhanāt etena pramā sva virodhi anubhava pratibandhaka janyā anitya anubhava tvāt apramāvat durātpuruṣasya sthāṇu tayā jñāne saṃnidhau ca bhūyas avayava indriya saṃnikarṣasya virodhi sthāṇu anubhava pratibandhaka tvam puruṣa jñāna janaka tvam ca dṛṣṭam apramāyām tu pitta ādeḥ liṅga ādi bhramasya ca tathātvam iti nirastam

pramājanaka vyakti viśeṣasya apramā pratibandhaka tvam pramājanaka tvam ca asti iti siddha sādhanāt iti na pramāyām atirikta guṇa siddhiḥ kim ca pratyakṣa pramādau anugatasya artha antarasya guṇasya abhāvaḥ indriya saṃnikarṣa ādīnām ca ananugamaḥ na ca jātyā eva guṇa doṣau pramājanaka tvam guṇa tvam bhrama janaka tvam ca doṣa tvam ati prasaktam tanmātra janaka tvam ca asiddham iti

ucyate evam apramā api svatas eva syāt na tu paratas pramāvada sādhāraṇa kāraṇāt eva tad utpattau doṣasya tatra ahetutvāt atha jñāna sāmagrī sattve api viśeṣa adarśana ādi pitta ādeḥ anuvidhānāt apramāyām doṣaḥ hetuḥ iti ced tarhi viśeṣa darśana pitta ādi abhāva āditas tatra eva viṣaye pramā tad abhāvāt na iti pramāyām āgantuka kāraṇa apekṣā iti katham na paratas tvam api ca niyama garbhaḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ niyamaḥ ca na vyaktyoḥ eva vyabhicārāt ati prasaṅgāt ca iti niyama nirūpakam anuguṇam anugatam āstheyam evam ca apramāyām iva pramāyām api tad vyāvṛttam kāraṇam anugatam āstheyam

kim ca yat kāryam yat kārya vijātīyam tat tad kāraṇa vijātīya kārya janyam yathā ghaṭa vijātīyaḥ paṭaḥ anyathā kārya vaijātyasya ākasmika tva āpatteḥ ghaṭa jñāna jātīyam api kāryam tad vijātīya kārya kāraṇa vijātīya ghaṭa indriya saṃnikarṣa ādi janyam iti na vyabhicāraḥ evam ca anitya pramā apramā kāraṇa vijātīya kāraṇa janyā apramāvijātīya kāryatvāt ghaṭa vat evam ca anugatasya pramāhetu tve pramā sva virodhi anubhava pratibandhaka jātīya janyāḥ janyā anubhava tvāt apramāvat iti ādau api na siddha sādhanam

api ca anitya pramātvam kārya tāvacchedakam bādhakam vinā kārya mātra vṛtti dharma tvāt apramātva vat nīla ghaṭa tvam tu viśiṣṭam na kārya tā avacchedakam pratyeka anugata prayojaka dvayāt eva viśiṣṭa siddhiḥ ārthaḥ samājaḥ ghaṭa jñāna tva ādau tu bādhakam astu vā tatra api anugata bhojaka adṛṣṭa hetuka tvam anyathā kārya mātre na adṛṣṭam hetuḥ syāt evam anitya pramātvam anitya jñāna tva avacchinna kārya tva pratiyogika kāraṇa tā bhinna kāraṇa tā pratiyogika kārya tāvacchedakam anitya jñāna tva vyāpya kārya tāvacchedaka dharma tvāt apramātva vat iti anitya pramāya āma pramāvya āvṛtta anugata hetu siddhiḥ anyathā anugata kārya anupapatteḥ

tathā anitya pramātvam apramākāraṇa tā anavacchedaka rūpa avacchinna kāraṇatā pratiyogika kārya tāvacchedakam bhrama āvṛtti kārya tāvacchedaka tvāt ghaṭa tva vat cākṣuṣa pramātvam cākṣuṣa apramākāraṇa tā anavacchedaka rūpa avacchinna kāraṇatā pratiyogika kārya tāvacchedakam cākṣuṣa bhrama āvṛtti kārya tāvacchedaka tvāt ghaṭa tva vat anitya rajata pramātvam rajata apramākāraṇa tā vacchedaka rūpa anavacchinna kāraṇa tā pratiyogika kārya tāvacchedakam rajata bhrama āvṛtti kārya tāvacchedaka tvāt ghaṭa tva vat anyathā niyāmakam vinā cākṣuṣa ādi rajata jñānam kiṃcid rajata vṛtti prakārakam kiṃcid rajata āvṛtti prakārakam iti niyamaḥ na syāt jñāna sāmagryāḥ tulya tvāt

yat tu pramāyāḥ asādhāraṇa kāraṇa janya tve sādhye pramānya tvam upādhiḥ na ca pakṣa itara tvam tava īśvara jñānasya pramātvāt pakṣasya vyāvartya tvāt ubhaya siddha vyāvartaka tvam tantram na tu vyāvartyasya ubhaya siddhiḥ gauravāt vyatireke asādhāraṇa tvam ca pakṣetara tvasya anupādhi tve bījam tat ca atra na asti bhagavat jñānasya tvad saṃmatasya sa pakṣa tvāt iti

tat na vipakṣa bādhaka balena hetoḥ sādhya vyāpya tvena upādheḥ sādhya avyāpaka tvāt nanu astu pramāyām doṣa abhāvaḥ hetuḥ āgantuka bhāva anapekṣya jñāna sāmagrī janya tvam svatas tvam yat tu abhāvaḥ na kāraṇam kiṃtu daṇḍa tva ādi vat kāraṇa tāva chedaka tvena sāmagrī bheda upalakṣakaḥ iti tat na japā kusuma ādi saṃnidhau na pramā tad asaṃnidhau sphaṭika ādau pramotpatteḥ ananyathā siddha tvena hetu tvāt iti ced

na bhūyas avayava indriya saṃnikarṣa viśeṣa darśana ādi samavadhāne pramā tad abhāve tu apramā iti pramāyām guṇaḥ apramāyām tad abhāvaḥ hetuḥ iti eva kim na syāt atha asat artha viṣayaka tve sat artha viṣaya hetu abhāvaḥ na prayojakaḥ jñāne sat artha viṣaya tā niyamena tad asaṃbhavāt sat artha viṣayaka tve asat artha viṣaya kāraṇa abhāvaḥ hetuḥ saṃbhavati pramāyāḥ sat artha mātra viṣaya tva vat apramāyām asat artha mātra viṣaya tva abhāvāt iti ced

tarhi apramāyāḥ sat artha viṣaya tā na syāt hetu abhāvāt sat artha mātra viṣaya tve asat artha viṣaya hetu abhāvaḥ hetuḥ iti ced tarhi guṇaḥ eva tatra hetuḥ tad abhāvaḥ tu asat artha viṣaya tve prayojakaḥ iti astu nanu guṇa abhāvasya sādhāraṇa tvāt tat eva satyam asatyam ca na syāt guṇa tada bhāvayoḥ ekatra asattvāt iti ced na doṣa abhāve api tulya tvāt kvacid kaścid doṣaḥ iti guṇe api samānam

guṇa abhāva dasat mātra viṣayakam api jñānam syāt iti ced na doṣāt api asat mātra viṣaya ka jñāna āpatteḥ sarvatra viṣaye doṣaḥ na saṃbhavati iti guṇa abhāve api tulyam atha viśeṣa darśana ādiḥ guṇaḥ tad abhāvaḥ ca ananugataḥ iti na tau pramā pramāhetū kim tu doṣa tadabhāvau iti ced tarhi pitta ādiḥ doṣaḥ tad abhāvaḥ ca ananugataḥ iti tau api na tatra hetū sva pramāyām svābhāvasya vyabhicāraḥ ca

atha doṣa tvam na ekam na hi tad tat bhrama hetu tvam tat ātma ādau gata tvāt ananugamāt ca na api bhrama mātra hetu tvam pitta ādeḥ ananugata tvena tad abhāvāt asaṃbhavāt ca na api pramāhetu abhāva pratiyogi tvam anyonya āśrayāt pitta ādeḥ sva pramā hetu tvāt ca na api sva pramā bhinna pramā pratibandhaka tvam evam hi pratyakṣa pratibandhakasya sat liṅga parāmarśasya doṣa tvāt anumitiḥ pramā na syāt bhramaḥ ca syāt tasmāt kvacid kaścid doṣaḥ iti ced tarhi guṇe api tulyam syāt etat pramām bhramam ca akurvati jñāna hetu stome maṇḍūka vasā añjana doṣāt vaṃśa uraga vibhramaḥ tad abhāve vaṃśa pramā iti tatra doṣa abhāvaḥ pramā hetuḥ ityā anyatra api tathā kḷpta tvāt

maṇḍūka vasā nayane eva doṣaḥ na tvaci iti tatra doṣa abhāvāt tvacā vaṃśa pramā eva gauraḥ aham iti abheda bhrama hetu doṣa saṃskāra sattve api mama śarīram iti pramā iti ced na viśeṣa adarśanasya tatra hetu tvam na tu saṃskārasya tat asattve tad asiddheḥ na ca dūre cakṣuṣaḥ saṃnikarṣe api keśa ādau sajātīya saṃyoge pramā tad abhāve na iti tatra saṃyoga rūpaḥ guṇaḥ pramā hetuḥ iti anyatra api guṇa janyata iti vācyam tāvat deśa varti keśa sākṣātkāre sa hetuḥ tena vinā tad abhāvāt tava api tāvat dūra pramāyām sa hetuḥ saṃnikṛṣṭa keśa pramāyāḥ tena vinā api bhāvāt tatra api vā doṣa abhāvaḥ kalpyaḥ doṣa janya tve apramātvā āpātāt

nanu viśeṣa darśanam pramā hetuḥ viśeṣa adarśanasya doṣa tve tad abhāvasya hetu tvāt iti ced tarhi doṣa abhāva tvena sa hetuḥ na tu guṇa tvena bhāva tvena vā kim ca viśeṣa darśana pratibandhakāḥ pitta ādayaḥ doṣāḥ āvaśyaka tvāt na viśeṣa adarśanam na ca teṣām ananugata tvena viśeṣa darśana pratibandhaka tayā anugame lāghavāt viśeṣa adarśanam eva hetuḥ iti vācyam kvacid kaścid doṣaḥ iti anugamāt anyathā pittāditaḥ api apramā na syāt ananugamāt maṇyādeḥ iva ananugame api adoṣa tvāt ca tad abhāva kūṭasya hetu tvāt sarvatra viśeṣa adarśanam eva hetuḥ pitta ādeḥ ananugamena tatra upakṣayāt iti ced na pitta ādi utkarṣeṇa bhrama utkarṣāt pitta ādera doṣa tve ca viśeṣa pramā eva kutas na bhavati viśeṣasya viśeṣa antara adarśanāt iti yadā tadā anavasthā eva

kim ca viśeṣa darśanam na pramā mātre na vā pratyakṣa pramāyām hetuḥ vyabhicārāt tatra eva tad hetu tve anavasthā pātāt ca atha pratyakṣe indriya saṃnikarṣaḥ guṇaḥ aprama aṃśe tad arthasya asattvena saṃnikarṣa abhāvāt doṣaḥ hetuḥ na ca pramā aṃśe api sa hetuḥ adoṣa tva prasaṅgāt prama aṃśasya apramātva prasaṅgāt ca sākṣātkāri tvam ca indriya saṃnikarṣa janya tvāt iti ced na jñāne viṣaya rūpasya aṃśasya indriya tad doṣa ajanya tvāt aprama aṃśe ca indriya saṃnikarṣa abhāvena sākṣātkāri tvam na syāt

doṣasya tad hetu tve ati prasaṅgaḥ ananugamaḥ ca pramāyām ca yāthārthya prayojakam asti apramāyām doṣa vat iti ced na doṣa abhāvasya sattvāt iti ucyate pramā mātre na anugataḥ guṇaḥ kim tu tad tad pramāyām bhūyas avayava indriya saṃnikarṣa yatha artha liṅga sādṛśya vākya artha jñānānām yathāyatham pratyekam eva guṇa tvam anvaya vyatirekāt tad tad apramāyām pitta ādi liṅga bhrama ādīnām doṣa tva vat pratyakṣe viśeṣa darśanam api guṇaḥ tad anuvidhānāt

nanu viśeṣa darśana hetuḥ eva tad hetuḥ astu tad vyatirekāt eva tad abhāva upapatteḥ anyathā viśeṣa darśanam eva tatra kutas na syāt tatra api tad apekṣāyām anavasthānāt iti ced evam vyāpya viṣaya kavyāpaka pratyakṣa niyame anumitau iva puruṣa pratyakṣe prāmāṇya saṃśayaḥ na syāt kara ādimati puruṣa jñāna tvasya anuvyavasāyena niścayāt tava api viśeṣa darśanam vinā katham vyāpaka pratyakṣam iti ced na saṃśaya viparyaya uttara pramāyām tasya hetu tvāt mama api tad hetuḥ tatra eva hetuḥ iti ced na kara caraṇa cibuka ādīnām pratyekam viśeṣa tvena tad hetūnām ananu gata tayā tāddaśa pratyakṣe ahetu tvāt tad darśaneṣu ca vyāpya darśana tvam anugatam asti

nanu evam saṃśaya uttaram vyāpya jñāne sati anumitiḥ syāt na pratyakṣam anumiti sāmagryā balavat tvāt iti ced na anyatra tathā ātve api atra pratyakṣa sāmagryāḥ balavat tvāt tatra puruṣam paśyāmi iti anuvyavasāyāt atas eva viśeṣa darśana janya tvena jñātam bādhakam tad darśana janyam bādhyam anyathā bādhya bādhaka vyavasthā na syāt

na ca pramā bādhikā kara bhrama janya puruṣa jñānasya api sthāṇu jñāna bādhaka tvāt na api viparīta bodhaka tvena bādhakam bādhya tulya tvāt ananyathā siddham bādhakam iti ced na viśeṣa darśana janya tvasya eva tad artha tvāt na ca pītaḥ śaṅkhaḥ iti atra viśeṣa darśane api śvaitya pramā na iti na tad hetuḥ yat viśeṣa darśanam hi bhrama virodhi tad bhāvaḥ pramā hetuḥ

pratyakṣa bhrame ca pratyakṣa viśeṣa darśanam virodhi diś mohe gauraḥ aham iti bhrame ca tathā darśanāt tat ca tatra doṣān na asti api ca liṅga sādṛśya vākya artha bhrama doṣa abhāva mātrāt na anum iti ādiḥ iti satya parāmarśa ādi guṇa siddhiḥ evam pramāyāḥ guṇa janya tvena vede api pramā vākya artha yathā artha jñāna guṇa janyā iti tad āśraya īśvara siddhiḥ

nanu pratyakṣādāvastu guṇa janya tvam vede tu bhrama ādi abhāva catuṣṭayam pramā hetuḥ loke bhrama ādi abhāvaḥ eva pramā utpatteḥ iti ced na tatra lāghavāt vākya artha yathā artha jñānasya hetu tvena bhrama ādi abhāvānām anyathā siddha tvāt āptasya bhrama ādi abhāva mātreṇa vākya artha jñānam vinā tādṛśa vākya abhāvāt ca anyathā tava api tatra vaktṛ jñāna anumānam na syāt tasya ahetu tvāt

astu vā ubhayam api hetuḥ vinigamaka abhāvāt tathā api vede guṇa siddhiḥ na ca nitya nirdoṣa tvāt dṛṣṭāt eva vede prāmāṇya upapattau na aparidṛṣṭa nitya jñāna ādi sarvajña kalpanā gauravāt iti vācyam pramāṇavataḥ phala mukha gauravasya api svarga ādau ivādoṣa tvāt pūrvam kāraṇa tā graha samaye phala anupasthityā gaurava ajñānāt loke nitya tva abhāvāt ca

atha vede kartṛ asmaraṇa ādeḥ bādhakāt loke api nirdoṣa tvena eva pramā hetu tvam vede tu nitya tvena eva vaktuḥ abhāve api nirdoṣa tvam avadhāryate iti ced na bādhakasya bahuśas nirākariṣyamāṇa tvāt bhrānta pratāraka vākye ghaṭaḥ asti iti vākye paṭaḥ asti iti doṣa janya vākye ca visaṃvādāt prāmāṇe tad abhāvāt ca kim ca daiva vaśa saṃpannam caityam vandeta iti ādikam śuka bāla ādi vākyam api evam pramāṇam syāt vaktṛ doṣa abhāvāt pramāṇa anapekṣa tvena veda tulya tvāt ca

nanu tava api śuka ādi bhrānta pratāraka vākyam katham pramāṇam guṇa ajanya tvāt na ca guṇa ajanya tvāt vaktṛ tāt parya aviṣaya tvāt ca tad apramāṇam saṃvādena sādhye bādhāt yat tu bhrānta pratāraka vākye yogya tā eva na asti vaktṛ jñāta vākya artha ābādhaḥ hi yogyatā bhrama viṣayaḥ ca bādhitaḥ iti tat na ghaṭavati ghaṭaḥ na asti iti bhinna viṣaya tayā bhramasya ahetutvāt

kim ca vākya artha ābādhaḥ yogyatā lāghavāt vākya arthaḥ ca tatra ābādhitaḥ eva na ca śuka bāla ādi vākyāt artha bodhaḥ eva na bhavati kim tu evam ayam vadati iti evaṃprakārā pratītiḥ iti vācyam ākāṅkṣa ādeḥ anvaya bodha sāmagryāḥ sattve anubhavān apalāpāt saṃvādena yathārtha tva anubhavāt ca evam dhūma bhramāt vahnimatī eva vahni anumitiḥ na pramā syāt yathā artha liṅga jñāna ajanya tvāt na ca vahni antaram eva tatra viṣayaḥ pratyabhijñānāt go tva ādi eka vyaktike tad abhāvāt ca na api tatra anya tādātmya āropaḥ saṃsarga āropāt liṅga upadhāna aṃśe bhramatve api sādhya aṃśe pramātvāt iti

ucyate bhrānta pratāraka vākye śuka ādi vākye ca pramāṇa śabda tvena āpta ukta tvāt veda vat īśvarasya eva yathā artha vākya artha jñānam janakam tasya kārya mātre kartṛ tvāt śuka ādi vākyasya ca veda tulya tā doṣa abhāva vādinā api vācyā nanu evam śabda ābhāsa ucchedaḥ tasya api īśvara vaktṛka tvāt iti ced na tad vākya arthasya asattvena bhagavat jñāna agocara tvāt evam liṅga ābhāsa janya pramāyām api vahni vyāpya vat tva jñānam īśvarasya eva janakam iti saṃpradāya vidaḥ

brūmaḥ śābda pramāyām loke vaktuḥ yathārtha jñānam na guṇaḥ kim tu yogyatā ādikam yathārtha tad jñānam vā lāghavāt āvaśyaka tvāt ca bhrama pramāda vipralipsā janye vākye visaṃvādini na yathārtha yogya tā jñānam vākya arthasya bādhita tvāt evam karaṇa apāṭavāt anī asmin vaktavye anya abhidhāne visaṃvādini saṃvādini tu pramāṇam eva yogyatā ādi jñānam eva kvacid na asti

nanu evam nānā arthāt anya parāttātparya bhrame tam vinā eva vā yathārtha yogya tā ādi jñāne sati saṃvādya paraśakya jñānam api pramā iti tatra api tat vākyam pramāṇam syāt iti ced na iṣṭa tvāt tātparya viṣaye ca tat vākyam na tadā pramājanakam iti na pramāṇam evam vede api yathārtha yogya tā jñānam eva guṇaḥ iti na vaidika pramāyām guṇa janya tvena īśvara siddhiḥ syāt etat vede vaktuḥ yathārtha vākya artha jñānam api guṇaḥ loke pramāṇa śabdam prati tādṛśasya jñānasya hetu tvāt atas eva tava loke vaktṛ jñāna anumānam evam ca vedaḥ vākya artha gocara yatha artha jñāna vat svatantra puruṣa praṇītaḥ pramāṇa śabda tvāt gāmānaya iti vākya vat iti īśvara siddhiḥ

mā evam pramāṇa śabda tvam hi vākya artha yathā artha jñāna pūrvaka tām vinā api saṃbhavati āvaśyaka yogyatā ādi sattvāt yathārtha tad jñānāt vā iti upapāditam atas aprayojakam etat iti tathā api loke vākya artha jñānam pramāṇa vākye kāraṇam gṛhītam iti tena vinā katham tat iti ced na pravṛtti ādi artham hi prayojyasya vākya artha jñānam uddiśya etādṛśa padebhyaḥ vākya artham jñāsyati iti buddhyā vākya prayogaḥ iti anyathā siddham prathamam vaktuḥ vākya artha jñānam na tu tādṛśa pada āvalī prayoge tasya hetu tvam tādṛśa pada samūhasya pratyeka pada hetoḥ eva śuka ādi vat upapatteḥ

atha tātparya viṣaye vedaḥ prāmaṇam tātparyam ca tat pratīti icchayā uccāraṇam na ca asmad ādeḥ vedam vinā ati indriya veda artha gocara jñānam yena tat pratīti icchayā uccāraṇam bhavet na ca vedāt eva tat anyonya āśrayāt atas sakala veda artha darśinā yasya vedasya yad arthapratīti icchayā uccāraṇam kṛtam sa tatra pramāṇam iti tādṛśa icchā eva guṇaḥ tad janyāḥ veda artha pramā iti tad āśraya svatantra puruṣa dhaureya siddhiḥ iti ced

mā evam mīmāṃsā ādi sakala aṅga sācivyāt veda vākya artha jñānavata adhyāpakena tad tad artha pratīti icchayā vedasya uccāraṇam iti veda artha yathā artha vidaḥ tad tad arthe tātparyam asti eva evam pūrva pūrva tādṛśa adhyāpakena tad tad artha pratīti i chayā uccarita tvam tad paratvam avagamya uttarottareṣām veda artha pratyayaḥ iti anādiḥ tātparyaparaṃpara iti kim īśvareṇa

tarhi veda artha anabhijñā adhyāpakena uccāritavedasya na tad artha pratīti icchayā uccāraṇam iti tātparya abhāvāt na pramāṇam na vā tatas artha niścayaḥ iti ced na anādau saṃsāre tasya vedasya kadācid kenacid mīmāṃsā ādi adhīna veda artha jñānavatā tat pratīti icchayā uccāraṇam kṛtam tāvatā eva tat paratvam iti prābhākarāḥ tu prāmāṇyam svatas eva utpadyate jñāyate ca iti tathā hi niṣkampa pravṛtti aṅgam smṛti anubhava sādhāraṇam yathārtha tvam eva prāmāṇyam tat ca jñāna mātra sāmagrī janyam na tu guṇam doṣa abhāvam vā apakṣate sarva jñānānām yathārtha tvena avyabhicārāt ayathārthaḥ tu vyavahāraḥ tasya eva bādhya tvāt jñānam tu na bādhyate bādhaka abhimata jñāna tulya tvāt jñāne ca ayathārtha tva vyapadeśaḥ viparīta vyavahāra janana upādhikaḥ atha yathārtha tvasya prāmāṇya tve rajata jñānam śuktau katham apramāṇam aprāmāṇyam ca katham paratas utpadyate iti ced

na ayathārtha tvam na aprāmāṇyam sarva dhiyām yathārtha tvāt kim tu viparīta vyavahāra pravartaka tvam tat ca jñāna sāmagryām adhika doṣa anupraveśāt doṣa hetukā saṃsarga agrahāt vā utpanne jñāne doṣa sahakārāt vā dharma dharmiṇoḥ asaṃsarga agraha rūpam ekatva asaṃsarga āgraha sa hitam paratas utpadyate na tu jñāna mātra sāmagrītaḥ pramāyāmati prasaṅgāt unnīyate ca viparīta vyavahāra janaka tvam bādhakāt tasya tena tad anu vyavasāyena vā grahītum aśakyatvāt jñāna svarūpe ca na doṣa tad abhāvau hetū vyabhicārāt jñāna ayatha artha tve api yathārtha tvam jñāna sāmagrī janyam eva na tu guṇāt doṣa abhāvāt vā viparyaya ādeḥ api dharmi aṃśe yathārtha tvāt asat artha viṣaya tā doṣāt indriyāṇām asaṃnihite asat arthe sāmarthya abhāvāt

nanu doṣa mātram na kāraṇam kim tu tad apekṣā jñāna sāmagri iti yathārtha tve doṣa abhāva sāpekṣā sā hetuḥ iti ced na sā eva sāmagrī asat artha aṃśe doṣa sāpekṣā iti tad aṃśe jñānam ayathārtham sat artha aṃśe doṣa nirapekṣā iti tad aṃśe yathārtham na tu sā eva tatra eva jñāne doṣa tadabhāva sāpekṣā virodhāt yathārtha tve doṣa tad abhāvau na antarīyakau yathārtha tvam ca jñāna ullikhita prakāravat tvam arthasya yat dharmavat tvam arthasya tad prakāraka jñāna tvam vā

idam rajatam iti jñānam arthasya rajata tvam svasya rajata tva āśraya viṣayaka tvam yathārtha tva rūpam prāmāṇyam sva prakāśa tvena svayam eva paricchindat sva artha niścaya rūpam tat atiriktam ca na prāmāṇyam māna abhāvāt astu vā tat api svatas jñāyatām paratas vā mā vā jñāyi kim tad nirūpaṇena pravṛttau anupayogāt artham hi niścitya pravartate iti āvaśyaka artha niścayāt eva pravṛtti upapatteḥ

atha artha niścayāt eva pravṛttiḥ iti satyam kim tu evaṃrūpaḥ ayam arthaḥ iti niścayaḥ jñāna prāmāṇya graha adhīnaḥ iti ced na sarvam hi jñānam rajata rūpaḥ ayam arthaḥ ityādi a ākāram sva artha niścaya rūpam eva utpadyate kā tatra para apekṣā atas eva artha tathā tvam svayam eva paricchidyate iti svatas prāmāṇya grahaḥ yadi ca tat jñānam na sva artha niścaya rūpam tadā prāmāṇya jñānam api na prāmāṇya niścaya rūpam na vā tat adhīnam jñāna antaram api sva artha niścaya rūpam iti vyartham artha niścaya artham prāmāṇya nirūpaṇam prāmāṇya jñāne api sva viṣaya niścaya artham anya apekṣāyām anavasthā

kim ca paratas pakṣe gṛhīta prāmāṇyasya parasya prāmāṇya niścāyaka tve anavasthā atas yathā jñāna antaram agṛhīta prāmāṇyam eva para prāmāṇya niścaya rūpam yadā tu tad prāmāṇyajijñāsā tadā tasya api prāmāṇyam agṛhīta prāmāṇyena eva pareṇa niścīyate iti na anavasthā tathā artha jñānam api aniścita prāmāṇyam eva artha niścaya rūpam aviśeṣāt na hi utpanne jñāne artha saṃśayaḥ kim evam anevam vā iti atha jñānam artha niścaya rūpam api svam agṛhṇat katham sva prāmāṇyam gṛhṇīyāt iti ced tarhi sva prakāśa tve vivādaḥ arthasya tathā abhāva rūpam prāmāṇyam svatas eva gṛhyate iti tava api anumatam

atha svatas prāmāṇya grahe anabhyāsa daśā āpanna jñāne idam pramā na vā iti saṃśayaḥ na syāt niścite tad abhāvāt atas eva apramātva śaṅkayā arthe api kim evam anevam vā iti saṃśayāt na jñāna mātrāt kara tala āmalaka ādau api artha niścayaḥ vyabhicārāt iti ced na na hi atra jñāne satya tva asatya tva saṃśayaḥ sarva jñānānām satya tvāt kim tu agṛhīta bhedam jñāna dvayam ekam vā jñānam iti ākāraḥ jñānam pramā na vā iti saṃśayaḥ sa ca kāraṇa doṣa saṃśayāt sa ca jñāna antarāt nivartate

nanu anubhūti tvam pramātvam tat ca smṛti anyajñāna tvam smṛti tvam ca saṃskāra asādhāraṇa kāraṇaka tvam iti svatas na gṛhyate saṃskāra ādeḥ agrahāt atas eva na svatas eva utpadyate smṛti sādhāraṇa tvāt iti ced na pravṛtti aupayikam hi prāmāṇyam artha tathā tva niścaya tvam tat ca svatas eva gṛhyate utpadyate ca na tu anubhūti tva sahitam gauravāt tava api saṃvāda ādinā pravṛtteḥ prāmāṇyam yathārtha tvam eva anumīyate na tu anubhūti tve sati smṛtau vyabhicārāt smṛti anubhavayoḥ apramā pramāvi apadeśaḥ tāntrikāṇām sa apekṣa tva nirapekṣa tva nibandhanaḥ yathārtha anubhavaḥ mānam anapekṣatayā iṣyate iti taiḥ abhidhānāt iti

atra brūmaḥ prāmāṇya niścayaḥ niṣkampa pravṛtti hetuḥ na tad saṃśayaḥ iti anubhava siddham tvad anumatam ca tat ca prāmāṇyam na artha tathā tva niścaya rūpam anabhyāsa daśā āpanna jñānasya sva prakāśena anuvyāvasāyena vā artha tathā tva niścaya grahe api niṣkampa pravṛtti abhāvāt prāmāṇya saṃśayāt ca sarva dhiyām yathārtha tva niyamena artha tathā tva niścaya tvasya svarūpataḥ viṣayataḥ ca agṛhīta bheda jñāna dvaya rūpa bhrama sādhāraṇa tvāt tasmāt na bhrama samāna ākārāt idam rajatam iti jñānāt niṣkampa pravṛttiḥ kim tu tad vyāvṛtta ākārāt

atha tatra prāmāṇye na saṃśayaḥ tasya artha tathā tva niścaya tva rūpasya niścayāt kim tu agṛhīta bhedam jñāna dvayam viśiṣṭa jñānam vā iti saṃśayaḥ saḥ eva niṣkampa pravṛtti pratibandhakaḥ api atas tasya jñāna antarāt nivṛtau niṣkampa pravṛttiḥ iti ced tarhi yasya saṃśayaḥ vyatireka niścayaḥ ca yat pratibandhakaḥ tad niścayaḥ tad hetuḥ iti vyāpteḥ bhrama vyāvṛttasya viśiṣṭa jñāna tvasya niścayaḥ pravṛtti hetuḥ na tu artha tathātvasya bhrama sādhāraṇyāt tasmin satya pravṛtteḥ ca tad saṃśaya abhāva sahitasya artha tathā tva niścayasya pravartaka tve gauravāt

kim ca pravṛtti hetu jñānam vighaṭayate eva jñānasya tatra pratibandhaka tvam na ca iha tathā saṃśaye sati api tasya sattvāt api ca viśiṣṭa jñāna tvam eva prāmāṇyam bhrama vyāvṛtta tvāt na tu artha tathā tva niścaya tvam bhrama sādhāraṇa tvāt laukika parīkṣakāṇām bhrama vyāvṛtte prāmāṇya vyavahārāt tad atikrame pramātu asya pāribhāṣika tva āpatteḥ tasmāt bhrama vyāvṛtta tvāt niṣkampa pravṛtti hetu tvāt prāmāṇya saṃśaya nivartaka tvāt ca viśiṣṭa jñāna tvam eva prāmāṇyam

nanu astu tathā tat eva svatas gṛhyate iti ced na agṛhīta asaṃsarga dharma dharmi viṣaya eka jñāna tvam bhrama vyāvṛttam viśiṣṭa jñāna tvam tat tu svatas grahītum na śakyate agṛhīta asaṃsarga ādeḥ prāk anupasthiteḥ sāmagrī virahāt sva prakāśa tā hi sva mātra sākṣiṇī anyathā anabhyāsa daśāpanne api tasya svatas grahāt aprāmāṇi asaṃśayaḥ na syāt atas eva na jñāna sāmagrītaḥ eva prāmāṇyam utpadyate bhramasya api tathā tva āpatteḥ

navyāḥ tu avidyamāna bhedasya āgrahaḥ prāmāṇyam sa ca atyanta abhāvaḥ kadāpi tasya jñāna abhāvāt atyanta abhāva rūpa tayā svatas siddha tvena prāmāṇyam svatas iti ucyate vidyamāna bhedasya agrahaḥ aprāmāṇyam sa ca āgrahaḥ prāc abhāvaḥ agre bhedasya grahāt bheda grahe prasakte na sa jāyate doṣāt iti uttara kāla saṃsarga rūpasya tad paripālanasya doṣa janya tvena aprāmāṇyam paratas utpadyate

visaṃvādi saṃvādi vicitra vyavahāraḥ api vidyamānā vidyamāna bheda agraha rūpa vilakṣaṇa hetukaḥ eva vyavahāra upayuktam tu prāmāṇyam yathārtha tvam eva tat ca jñāna hetu mātra hetukam aprāmāṇyam doṣāt anabhyāsa daśā āpanne prāmāṇya saṃśayaḥ api vidyamānā vidyamāna bheda āgraha koṭi dvaya avalambī saḥ eva niṣkampa pravṛtti pratibandhakaḥ iti tat na niṣkampa pravṛtti hetuḥ hi prāmāṇyam grāhyam na tu anyat niṣprayojana tvāt tat ca yadi api avidyamāna bheda agraha rūpam tadā tat na svatas jñātum śakyate avidyamāna bheda āgrahasya tad pratiyoginaḥ asattvāt prāk anupasthiteḥ ca anabhyāsa daśāyām jñāne jñāte api avidyamāna bheda agrahe saṃśayāt ca

etena autsargikaḥ saṃsarga grahaḥ eva prāmāṇyam asaṃsarga āgrahaḥ eva aprāmāṇyam iti nirastam saṃsarga graha tvasya svena grahītum aśakyatvāt śakya tve vā anabhyāsa daśāyām api tad grahe tad saṃśayaḥ na syāt tasmāt bhrama vyāvṛttam niṣkampa pravṛtti hetuḥ prāmāṇyam agṛhīta saṃsarga dharma dharmi viṣayaka eka jñāna tva rūpam viśiṣṭa jñāna tvam saṃsarga jñāna tvam vā avidyamāna bheda agraha tvam vā svatas jñātum na śakyate kim tu viśeṣa darśana ādi janya jñānāt avadhāryate iti vajralepāyitam paratas prāmāṇyam iti utpattivādaḥ

atha kim tat prāmāṇyam na tāvat jātiḥ yogi avyakti vṛtti tvena pratyakṣa tve pramātu a saṃśaya anupapatteḥ pramātu asya anumeya tvāt ca sākṣāt tva ādinā saṃkara āpatteḥ ca bīja sāmyena guṇe api tasya doṣa tvāt tāra tva ādeḥ utkarṣa rūpa tayā jāti tva niyame ca ananya gatika tayā ca nānātvāt pramātva nānātve tu ananugamaḥ

kim ca evam apramāyāḥ aṃśe pramātvam na syāt jāteḥ vyāpya vṛtti tā niyamāt na ceṣṭāpattiḥ aṃśe saṃvādini visaṃvādini ca samūha ālambane pramātvā pramātvayoḥ anabhūyamāna tvena eka śeṣasya kartum aśakyatvāt atha viparyayasya aṃśe na pramātvam kim tu smṛti vat yathārtha tvam eva iti ced tarhi yathārtha anubhava tvam eva prāmāṇyam āvaśyaka tvāt na ca tat api iti vakṣyate

atha yathā bhāvaḥ abhāvaḥ vā na avyāpya vṛttiḥ iti niyamam tiraskṛtya ābādhita anubhava balāt saṃyoga tadabhāvayoḥ avyāpya vṛtti tvam tathā jātiḥ vyāpya vṛttiḥ eva iti vyāptim abhibhūya anubhava balāt eva pramātu a tada bhāvayoḥ avyāpya vṛtti tvam astu na ca yat avyāpya vṛtti tat na vyāpya vṛtti yat ca vyāpya vṛtti na tad avyāpya vṛtti iti vyāpteḥ pramātvasya na ubhaya rūpa tvam iti vācyam saṃyoga atyanta abhāve vyabhicārāt na ca tasya abhāva dvayam māna abhāvāt guṇa doṣayoḥ ekatra sattve avyāpya vṛtti tvam guṇa mātra sattve vyāpya vṛtti tvam iti anyathā upapatteḥ ca anyathā pramātu asya upādheḥ api anta abhāva sāmānādhikaraṇyam na syāt sāmānya tvāt na syāt ca ubhaya rūpa tvam iti

mā evam avacchedaka bhedam vinā viruddhayoḥ ekatra asam āveśāt apratīteḥ ca na ca viṣayaḥ eva aṃśa rūpaḥ pramātva vṛttau avacchedakaḥ tad viṣaya tvasya bhrame api sattvāt nanu viśeṣya āvṛtti aprakāraka tvam viśeṣya āvṛtti prakāraka tvam ca pramātva tadabhāvayoḥ vṛttau avacchedakam asti iti ced tarhi tayoḥ eva pramā pramāvyavahāra janakatvam astu āvaśyaka tvāt prathama upasthita tvāt ca kim jātyā na ca tat api iti vakṣyate na api yathārtha agṛhīta grāhi tvam loka siddha pramātvam dhārāvāhika buddhi avyāpteḥ na ca pratyakṣasya vartamāna artha grāhi tvena svāśra ya kṣaṇa viśiṣṭa stambha ādi grāhaka tvena agṛhīta grāhi tvam loka siddham anyathā eka samaye jñāna yaugapadya prasaṅgaḥ iti vācyam kṣaṇānām atīndriya tvāt sthulā upādhim ādāya vartamāna tva grahāt sva rūpa satkrami ka kṣaṇa utpattika tvena jñāna ayaugapadyāt

na ca stambha ādiṣu pratikṣaṇam guṇa karma ādi utpattiḥ asti yena tad ādāya agṛhīta grāhi tvam syāt vedāt krama utpanna veda artha gocara dhārā vāhika buddhi avyāpteḥ ca na api yathārtha anubhava tvam jñāne ghaṭa tva ādinā yathā śabda artha sādṛśya abhāvāt sādṛśya mātrasya bhrame api gata tvāt na ca guṇa janyā anubhava tvam doṣa abhāva janyā anubhava tvam vā tayoḥ ananugata tvāt pramā pramāni rūpya tvāt ca na api abādhita anubhava tvam bādhasya viparīta pramātvāt na api saṃvādi anubhava tvam jñāna antareṇa tathā ullikhyamāna tvasya saṃvādi tvasya bhrama sādhāraṇa tvāt na api samartha pravṛtti janaka anubhava tvam upekṣā pramāyām avyāpteḥ tad yogya tāyāḥ pramāni rūpya tvāt na api tattva anubhava tvam avastunaḥ abhānāt bhāne vā bhrama sādhāraṇyāt

na api viśeṣya niṣṭhā ati anta abhāva apratiyogi dharma prakāraka anubhava tvam saṃyoga ādi pramāvya āpteḥ abhāve vyāpya vṛtti tva viśeṣaṇe saṃyoga bhrame ativyāptiḥ tad atyanta abhāvasya eka tvāt na api viśeṣya vṛtti anyonya abhāva pratiyogi ta avacchedaka dharma aprakāraka anubhava tvam avyāpya vṛtti pramānupagrahāt mūle vṛkṣaḥ kapi saṃyogavān na agre iti abādhita anubhavāt saṃyoga vat anyonya abhāvasya avyāpya vṛtti tvāt bheda abhedaḥ evam syāt iti ced anubhavam upālambhasva yat balāt avaccheda bhedena atyanta abhāvavat anyonya abhāvasya api avyāpya vṛtti tvam upeyam atas eva pakve idānīm na śyāmaḥ iti dhīḥ samaya bhedāt aviruddhā tatra eva tad anyonya abhāvam avalambate

na api viśeṣya āvṛttyaprakāraka anubhava tvam ekaika viśeṣya āvṛtti nānā prakāraka samūha ālambana avyāpteḥ na ca prakārasya eka viśeṣya vṛtti tayā na viśeṣya āvṛtti tvam iti vācyam pramā pramārūpa samūha ālambana ati vyāpteḥ na ca yāvat viśeṣya āvṛtti tvam vivakṣitam eka eka viśeṣya vṛtteḥ yāvat viśeṣya āvṛtti tvena samūha ālambana avyāpteḥ eka viśeṣyake yāvat artha abhāvāt ca

atha viṣaya tāyāḥ āśrayaḥ viśeṣyaḥ jñānam tad pratiyogi bhrame ca śukti vṛttiḥ viṣaya tā vyadhikaraṇena rajata tvena avacchidyate rajata vṛttiḥ tu samāna adhikaraṇena rajata tvena viṣaya tā ca viṣaye na jñāna āhitā jñāta tā rūpā vivakṣitā apasiddhāntāt asiddheḥ atīta anāgata pramāyām tad abhāvāt ca kim tu jñānasya viṣaye viśeṣaṇa tā viśeṣaḥ kaścid para jñānam jñāna tvena tad viṣayam ca ghaṭa tvena jānataḥ ghaṭa mayam jānāti na veti saṃśayāt viṣaya jñāna svarūpa atiriktasya sva āśraya sva abhāva ādi viśeṣaṇa tā viśeṣasya avaśyam svīkārāt anyathā ghaṭa tvena jñātaḥ arthaḥ iti tṛtīya artha asaṃbhavaḥ prakāra tvam api viṣayasya jñāne viśeṣaṇa tā viśeṣaḥ eva na tu viṣaya tvam atiprasaṅgāt

evam ca viṣayatā samāna adhikaraṇa prakāraka anubhavaḥ prakāra samāna adhikaraṇa viṣaya tā pratiyogi anubhavaḥ vā sva samāna adhikaraṇa dharma prakāraka viṣaya tā pratiyogi anubhavaḥ vā sva samāna adhikaraṇa dharma avacchinna viṣaya tā pratiyegi anubhavaḥ vā pramā iti ced na nirvikalpaka avya āpteḥ viṣaya tā samāna adhikaraṇedantu aprakāraka bhramasya api pramātva prasaṅgāt ca bhramaḥ tatra aṃśe pramaiva iti ced tarhi anubhava tvam eva pramātvam vyartham adhikam anubhavaḥ eva kvacid aṃśe pramā pramā ca iti ced na ukta lakṣaṇe tādṛśa alābhāt atha sva vyadhikaraṇa prakāra an avacchinna viṣaya tā pratiyogi anubhavaḥ pramā samūha ālambane ca prativiśeṣyam viṣaya tā bhedāt eka vṛttiḥ viṣaya tā na apara vṛttinā avacchidyate atas na avyāptiḥ iti ced na

bhrama aṃśa pramāyām avyāpteḥ na hi yā viṣaya tā vyadhikaraṇa dharmeṇa avacchidyate sā tad anavacchinnā virodhāt na api prakāra vyadhi karaṇa viṣaya tva apratiyogi anubhavaḥ pramā prakāra vyadhi karaṇa viṣaya tā pratiyogini tad apratiyogi tvasya abhāvena bhrama aṃśa pramāvya āpteḥ na api sva vyadhikaraṇa dharma avacchinna viṣaya tva apratiyogi anubhavaḥ sva adhikaraṇa āvṛttya prakāraka viṣaya tā pratiyogya anubhavaḥ vā pramā tatas eva bhrame viṣaya tāyāḥ sva vyadhikaraṇa prakāra avacchinna tvāt sva adhikaraṇa āvṛtti prakāraka tvāt ca na api sva samāna adhikaraṇa anyonya abhāva pratiyogi ta avacchedaka dharmān avacchinna viṣaya tā pratiyogi anubhavaḥ pramā bhrama aṃśa pramāvya āpteḥ anyonya abhāvasya avyāpya vṛtti tvena avyāpya vṛtti pramāyāma vyāpteḥ ca

yat tu pramātvā pramātvayoḥ virodhaḥ eva bhramaḥ na pramā iti tad tuccham aṃśa bhedam ādāya ubhayasya anubhavāt anyathā bhramasya ubhaya bahis bhāva āpatteḥ etena sva vyadhikaraṇa prakārakam jñānam bhramaḥ tad anyaḥ anubhavaḥ pramā bhramaḥ dharmi aṃśe na pramā iti nirastam na api prakāra adhikaraṇa āvṛttya prakāraka viṣaya tā pratiyogi anubhavaḥ prakāra an adhikaraṇa avṛtti viṣaya tā pratiyogi anubhavaḥ vā pramā prameyam idam iti jñāne prakārān adhikaraṇasya aprasiddheḥ

kim ca rajata tva prakāraka viṣaya tāyāḥ rajata vṛtti tva niyamāt rajata tva avacchinnā eva rajata bhrame rajata vṛtti viṣaya tā atas rajata bhramaḥ api rajate pramā syāt atha rajata purovartinoḥ ekā eva viṣaya tā sā ca prakārān adhikaraṇa vṛtti dharma avacchinna eva iti ced tarhi dharmi aṃśe api tat jñānam pramā na syāt vyadhikaraṇa prakāraka tvasya tulya tvāt dharmi aṃśe tu rajate api pramā syāt

atha rajata aṃśe dharmi aṃśe ca tat jñānam pramā eva vaiśiṣṭya aṃśe na pramā iti ced na vaiśiṣṭyasya pūrva jñāna aviṣaya tvena aprakāra tvāt vaiśiṣṭya vṛtti viṣaya tāyām rajata tva puras vartinoḥ prakāra tvena bhramasya vaiśiṣṭya aṃśe pramātvā apramātvā āpātāt na api sva vyadhikaraṇa prakāra an avacchinna viṣaya tā pratiyogi anubhavaḥ pramā prameyam idam iti jñāne prameya tva prakāraka viṣaya tān āśrayasya aprasiddhyā avyāpteḥ

na ca saṃyogi tva ādinā prameya tva prakāraka viṣaya tā vyatirekaḥ ghaṭa ādau prasiddhaḥ iti vācyam pratiyogita avacchedaka rūpavat tvena pratiyogi jñānasya abhāva dhī hetutvāt kim ca yat kiṃcid vyadhikaraṇa prakāra an avacchinna tvam bhrama sādhāraṇam prakṛta jñāna vyadhikaraṇa prakāra an avacchinna tvam nirvikalpaka avyāptam tasya niṣprakāraka tvāt iti

ucyate yatra yat asti tatra tasya anubhavaḥ pramā tadvati tad prakāraka anubhavaḥ vā yatra yat na asti tatra tasya jñānam tad abhāvavati tad prakāraka jñānam vā apramā tad anyatve sati anubhava tvam eva vā pramātvam tad prakāraka tvam ca tad vaiśiṣṭya viṣayaka tvam tad viśeṣaṇa jñāna janya tvam vā īśvarasya tad viśiṣṭa viṣayam jñānam na tu tad prakārakam nirvikalpakam ca pramā pramābahirbhūtam eva vyavahāra anaṅga tvāt avyapadeśya padena tad upagrahasya nāma jāti ādi yojanā rahitam api pratyakṣam asti iti atra tātparyam idam rajatam iti jñānam idantu avati tad anubhava tvāt pramā rajata tva abhāvavati tad prakāraka jñāna tvāt apramā aṃśe samūha ālambanam ca na apramā eka prakāra abhāvavatī api tad apratīteḥ

nanu evam avyāpya vṛtti bhāva abhāvayoḥ ekatra pramā pramā ca syāt tad abhāvavati tad prakāraka jñāna tvāt iti ced na bhinna bhinna avacchedena hi vṛkṣe saṃyoga tad abhāvau na vṛkṣa mātre virodhāt ananubhavāt ca tathā ca yatra vṛkṣe saṃyogaḥ na tatra tad abhāvaḥ yad avacchedena yatra yat asti iti vā vivakṣitam

go tva ādeḥ api sāsnādi avacchedena vṛtteḥ pāka rakte śyāmaḥ ayam iti dhīḥ pramā eva kadācid tatra tad sattvāt idānīm śyāmaḥ iti tu apramā eva na ca yat tadbhyām lakṣaṇān anugamaḥ na hi pramā sarvatra pramā kim tu kvacid tathā ca kim jñānam kutra pramā iti tad tad viśeṣasya lakṣya tvena yat tadbhyām eva lakṣaṇam yuktam

anye tu anubhava tvam eva prāmāṇyam bhrame api aṃśam ādāya pramāvī avahārāt rajata ādi pramā pramā ca viśiṣya lakṣaṇīyā rajatatvavati tad anubhavaḥ tad abhāvavati tad anubhavaḥ vā ityādinā nanu anubhava tu asya pramā pra māsādhāraṇyena tat jñānasya na niṣkampa pravṛtti aṅga tvam iti ced satyam viśeṣa viṣaya pramāyāḥ eva pravartaka tvāt

atirikta viṣaya tā pakṣe viṣaya tā āśraya āvṛttya prakāraka anubhavaḥ pramā kevala anvayini viṣaya tā āśraya āvṛttiḥ avṛttiḥ eva prasiddhaḥ yat vā yat prakārikā yā viṣaya tā tad prakāra samāna adhikaraṇa viṣaya tākaḥ sva prakāra samāna adhikaraṇa viṣaya tākaḥ vā anubhavaḥ pramā jhryat prakāra āṭayā viṣaya tā tad prakāra vyadhi karaṇa viṣaya tākam sva prakāra vyadhi karaṇa viṣaya tākam vā jñānam bhramaḥ

prakāra bhedena ekatra viṣaya tā bhedaḥ iti lakṣaṇa dvaya samāveśāt pramā bhrama saṃkaraḥ yat vā viśeṣya niṣṭhā ati anta abhāva apratiyogi prakāraka viṣaya tā pratiyogī viśeṣya niṣṭa atyanta abhāva pratiyogi prakāra an avacchinna viṣaya tva pratiyogī vā viṣaya tā samāna adhikaraṇa atyanta abhāva pratiyogi prakāraka viṣaya tva apratiyogī vā viṣaya tā samāna adhikaraṇa atyanta abhāva pratiyogi prakāra an avacchinna viṣaya tā pratiyogī vā anubhavaḥ pramā

sva samāna adhikaraṇa prakāra an avacchinna viṣaya tā pratiyogi jñānam sva vyadhikaraṇa prakāra avacchinna viṣaya tā pratīyogi jñānam vā bhramaḥ idam rajatam iti bhrame ca viṣaya tā dvaye vyadhikaraṇa prakāra avacchinna tva tadanavacchinna tvayoḥ viṣaya tva pratiyogi tva tadapratiyogi tvayoḥ avirodhāt samūha ālambane ca viṣaya tā bhedāt na pramā pram ālakṣaṇe avyāpti ati vyāptī

vastutas tu viśeṣaṇa tā viśeṣaḥ na asti eva māna abhāvāt sāmānyatas jñāne jñāte tasya kvacid viśeṣaṇa tā iti sāmānyatas viśeṣaṇa tā jñāne api ghaṭa mayam jānāti na vā iti saṃdeha tādavasthyāt tasmāt ghaṭa tad jñānayoḥ svarūpa grahe api tadīya tvam tat viṣaya tvam na gṛhītam iti tad viṣaya tve saṃdehaḥ tadīya tvam ca saṃbandham vinā tad saṃbandha svabhāva tvam tat uktam prakāśasya sataḥ tadīyatā mātra nibandhanaḥ svabhāva viśeṣaḥ tad viṣaya tvam iti

saṃbandham vinā katham tadīya tvam saṃbandhasya eva svabhāva tvāt yathā tava eva viśeṣaṇa tāyām anyathā anavasthānāt anyatra api svarūpa saṃbandhe eṣā eva gatiḥ anyathā sāmānyena abhāva samavāyayoḥ jñāne adhikaraṇe jñāte tayoḥ saṃśayaḥ na syāt adhikaraṇa tad u bhaya svarūpāṇām jñāta tvāt tatra api abhāva samavāyayoḥ viśeṣaṇa tā viśeṣaḥ na gṛhītaḥ iti ced na sāmānyatas tat grahe api saṃśayāt

yuttu samūha ālambana viśiṣṭa jñānayoḥ viśeṣa anubhavāt viśiṣṭa jñāne viśeṣaṇa tā viśeṣaḥ viṣayaḥ iti tat na viśeṣaṇa tām ādāya api samūha ālambana saṃbhavāt tatra api viśeṣaṇa tā antara svīkāre anavasthā samūha ālambanāt tu viśiṣṭa jñānasya viśeṣaḥ kāraṇa kṛtaḥ kārya kṛtaḥ prakāra kṛtaḥ vā prakāraḥ api viśeṣaṇa tā viśeṣaḥ sa ca dharmiṇī eva astu iti ced na tam ādāya api samūha ālambana saṃbhavāt

nanu sarva jñānānām yathārtha tvāt pramāṇa lakṣaṇe vyāvartya aprasiddheḥ viśeṣaṇa vaiyarthyam anyathā ākhyātau māna abhāvāt tathā hi rajata arthi pravṛtti viṣaya tvam rajata tva prakāraka anubhava viṣaya tva vyāpyam rajata arthi pravṛtti viṣaya mātra vṛtti dharma tvāt rajata mātra vṛti dharma vat iti anyathā ākhyāti vyāpyam sidhyati iti aprāpta kāla tvam rajata mātra vṛtti tvam ca upādhiḥ śukti vṛtti jñāna viṣaya tā rajata tva prakārikā rajata arthitā janya pravṛtti viṣaya vṛtti viṣaya tā tvāt rajata vṛtti viṣaya tāvat iti atra rajata vṛtti tvam upādhiḥ rajata tvam arajata vṛtti jñāna viṣaya tāvacchedakam arajata viṣaya pravṛtti hetu jñāna prakāra tvāt śukti tva vat iti atra rajata āvṛtti tvam upādhiḥ

rajata tva prakārikā jñāna viṣaya tā arajata vṛttiḥ arajata niṣṭhā ati anta abhāva pratiyoginī vā arajata viṣaya pravṛtti hetu jñāna viṣaya tā tvāt śukti vṛtti viṣaya tāvat iti atra rajata āvṛtti tvam upādhiḥ viṣaya tāyāḥ nirasta tvāt ca vivāda padam rajata jñānam śukti viṣayakam śuktau pravartaka jñāna tvāt śukti jñāna vat iti atra jñāyamāna iṣṭa bheda agrahe kāraṇa tāvacchedakam rajata jñānam na pravartakam iti asiddhiḥ

śuktiḥ rajata jñāna viṣaya tā āśrayaḥ rajata arthi pravṛtti viṣaya tvāt rajata vat iti atra rajata tvam upādhiḥ śuktau rajata arthi pravṛttiḥ svadharmi dharmika rajata tva prakāraka jñāna sādhyāḥ rajata arthi pravṛtti tvāt rajata pravṛtti vat iti atra rajata viṣaya tvam upādhiḥ sva padārthān anugamaḥ ca tad parityāge tu rajata arthi pravṛtti dharmika rajata tva prakāraka jñānena ubhaya siddhena rajata smaraṇena artha antaram

ucyate rajata arthitā janyā śuktau pravṛttiḥ iṣṭa pravṛtti viṣaya viśiṣṭa jñāna sādhyā pravṛtti tvāt śuktau śukti arthi pravṛtti vat na ca iṣṭa viṣaya pravṛtti tvam upādhiḥ sādhana viśeṣita tvāt yat vā rajata icchā janya śukti viṣaya pravṛtti janaka rajatatva prakārakam jñānam śukti viśeṣyakam śukti pravṛtti prayojaka jñāna tvāt śuktau śukti arthi pravṛtti janaka jñāna vat avacchedaka tve api prayojaka tva at na asiddhiḥ hetu tvam api tasya sādhayiṣyāmaḥ tathāvidham idam jñānam vā rajata tva prakārakam rajata icchā janya pravṛtti hetu jñāna tvāt satya rajata jñāna vat

na ca grahaṇa smaraṇayoḥ viśiṣṭasya jñānasya vā pakṣa tve bādhaḥ āśraya asiddhiḥ vā ubhaya siddhena śukti niṣṭha pravṛtti hetu tvena pakṣa tvāt anyathā sādhya tad abhāvavataḥ pakṣa tvena anumāna ucchedaḥ samavāya ati indriya tva vādinam prati agṛhīta asaṃsargaka dharma dharmi viṣayakam ekam jñānam eva viśiṣṭa jñānam sidhyati na ca evam ubhaya ravyātiḥ na anyathā khyātiḥ iti vācyam vyadhikaraṇa prakāraka jñānasya tattvāt

na ca visaṃvādi pravṛtti ajanaka tvam upādhiḥ tathāvidhe idaṃjñāne rajata jñāne ca tvad mate sādhya avyāpaka tvāt na api doṣa ajanya tvam parasya jñāna mātre tathā tvāt anyathā tayoḥ eva sādhya avyāpaka tvāt na ca aprayojaka tvam iṣṭa purovarti viśiṣṭa jñānasya pravṛtti hetu tvāt atra prābhākarāḥ aprayojakam idam svatantra upasthita iṣṭa bheda agrahāt eva pravṛtti upapatteḥ kim viśiṣṭa jñānena pareṇa api āropaniyama artham tad abhyupagamāt na ca rajate pravṛttim prati viśiṣṭa jñānasya hetu tvāt iha api tad siddhiḥ pravṛtti mātre bheda agrahe sati iṣṭa purovarti jñānasya lāghavena hetu tvāt na tu sat api viśiṣṭa jñānam tantram gauravāt

na ca rajate iṣṭa purovarti bheda grahasya aprasiddhyā katham tad abhāvaḥ iti vācyam puras varti niṣṭhe bhede rajata pratiyogi tva jñāna viṣaya tva abhāvasya puras vartini iṣṭa bhinna tva prakāraka jñāna viṣaya tva abhāvasya vā hetu tvāt na ca abheda vyavahāraḥ vyavaharta vyadhī sādhyaḥ na tu tad abhāva āgrahāt anyathā bheda agrahāt bheda vyavahāra āpattiḥ iti vācyam icchā ādīnām jñāta puras varti mātra viṣaya tvāt abheda abhilāpaḥ api jñāta bhedasya asaṃsargā grahāt iti na ajñāte vyavahāraḥ

nanu pītaḥ śaṅkhaḥ na śvetaḥ iti bheda jñāne api śveta abheda anumityā śveta arthi pravṛtteḥ abheda dhīḥ tad hetuḥ iti ced na tava api pītaḥ śaṅkhaḥ iti abheda jñānāt pīta arthī na pravartate bheda anumiteḥ iti bheda āgrahaḥ eva tad hetuḥ syāt bhrama tvena jñātam abheda jñānam akiṃcitkaram iti yadi tadā bhrama tvena jñātam bheda jñānam api tathā yat vā iṣṭa bheda aviṣayakam jñānam pravartakam na ca abheda anumita āviṣṭa bhedaḥ viṣayaḥ atas eta pūrvam bheda pratyaye api sa pratyayaḥ na bheda grāhi iti diś moha pratibimba ādi pratyayāḥ nanu evam rajate api viśiṣṭa jñānam na sidhyet pravṛtteḥ bhedā grahādeva upapatteḥ idam rajata tayā jānāmi rajata tayā jñātam iti anubhavaḥ śuktau api tulyaḥ na ca śuktau rajata tva bādhāt saḥ api asaṃsarga āgrahaḥ

bādhasya api viśiṣṭa jñāna tve māna abhāvāt iti ced na tatra hi rajatasya na smṛtiḥ prāk ananubhavāt grahaṇam ca tasya dharmi viṣayakam yogi adharmi yogena rajata tva jāti grahāt iti artha siddham dharma dharmi viṣayakam ekam jñānam na ca rajata tvasya śukti anubhava viṣaya tve hetuḥ asti na ca pratyabhijñāna vat saṃskāra indriye hetū tayoḥ atra bhinna viṣayaka tvāt ekadā svatantra upasthita viruddha aneka bheda agrahe saṃśayaḥ

krameṇa upasthitān eka bheda āgrahaḥ yena sa kramika viparyaya dvaya rūpaḥ syāt anyathā tava api apratīkārāt na ca saṃśaya anantaram viparyaya daśāyām ubhaya bheda agrahe saṃśayaḥ eka bheda agrahe anyathā khyātiḥ doṣa mahimnā hi ekasya na svātantryeṇa upasthitiḥ kim tu abhāva viśeṣaṇa tayā iti tad bheda agrahaḥ api akiṃcitkaraḥ na ca saṃśaya anantaram dhūma bhramāt asti kvacid vahni arthi pravṛttiḥ na tu tena vinā na ca tasya svatantra upasthita vahni asaṃsarga āgrahaḥ dvāram saṃśaya anurodhena tasya prāk api sattvāt vahni anumitiḥ dvāram iti vācyam liṅga bhramasya hi nirvahni tvasya svātantryeṇa upasthiti pratibandhaka tvena niyamataḥ svatantra vahni smṛtiḥ dvāram iti na saṃśayānyatha āravyātī na ca parvatasya pratyakṣa tve vahneḥ ca smaraṇe pratyakṣa bhramāt na viśeṣaḥ iti sākṣāt karomi iti syāt na tu anuminomi iti vācyam liṅga jñāna anantara bhāvi tva pratisandhāna apratisandhānābhyām ubhaya saṃbhavāt

evam svatantra upasthitā aniṣṭa bheda āgrahaḥ api nivartakaḥ tena idam rajatam na śukttiḥ iti abhāva pratiyogi tvena aniṣṭa upasthiteḥ tad bheda agrahaḥ na nivartakaḥ śuktyabhāva asaṃsarga āgrahaḥ ca nakārasya arthaḥ iti na anyathā ākhyātiḥ aniṣṭa abheda grahasya nivartaka tve ca rajate eva na idam rajatam iti kṛtvā na nivarteta anyathā anyathā ākhyāti āpatteḥ atas eva rajate eva na idam rajatam iti jñāne api na pravṛtti anyathā ākhyātī rajata bheda asaṃsarga āgrahāt

nanu rajata raṅgayoḥ ime raṅga rajate iti atra pratyekam ubhaya bheda agrahe yugapad pravṛtti nivṛttī syātām iti ced na evaṃvidha bhrame māna abhāvāt kāryaḥ nneya dharmāṇām yathākāryam unnayanāt krama utpanna jñānayoḥ bheda agrahāt eka tva abhimānaḥ anyathā tava api svatantra ubhaya bheda agrahāt pratyekam rajatam raṅgam vā iti saṃśayaḥ syāt yat eva vā tatra viparyaya niyāmakam tatas eva pravṛtti nivṛttī syātām tad hetoḥ eva iti nyāyāt

yat tu prasakta pratiṣedha ātmā bādhaḥ akhyātau na yujyate sādhayati anyathā ākhyātim bādhaḥ eva hi naḥ sphuṭam iti tad viparītam paraspara viruddha tva aviśeṣeṇa bādhya tva avyavasthiteḥ viruddha arthakatayā utpanna tvam ca tulyam pūrveṇa api kvacid parasya bādhāt tasmāt abheda agrahāt prasañjitaḥ vyavahāraḥ bheda grahāt bādhyate iti yuktam

upekṣā bhrame ca śabda prayogaḥ bādhyaḥ tad īyatā mātra svabhāva tvāt tad viṣaya tvasya katham rajatīya mātra jñānam arajati iyam svabhāva vyāghātāt na ca ubhayīyam samūha ālambana āpatteḥ tat uktam anyasya hi anyathā ābhānam pratītya eva parāhatam parasmin bhāsamāne tu na param bhāsate yatas iti

viṣayam vinā eva tat ākāram jñānam iti sa ākāra vādaḥ jñāna ayatha artha tve ca jñāna mātrasya tad śaṅkayā na niṣkampa pravṛttiḥ na ca doṣa ajanya tva ādinā viśvāsaḥ bhramāt aviśvāse pravṛtti abhāva āpatteḥ na api tat jñānāt jñāna tvena tatra api aviśvāsāt tat ucyate aho bata mahān eṣa pramādaḥ dhīmatām api jñānasya vyabhicāri tve viśvāsaḥ kiṃnibandhanaḥ iti bhramasya ca sat mātra viṣayaka tvena ayathārtha tā asat viṣayaka tve asat khyātiḥ na ca tatra hetuḥ asti śabdasya āpta uktasya nirdoṣasya liṅgasya ca ahetu tvāt na ca śabda anumāna ābhāsāt sā yogyatā ādimattayā śabdasya liṅga vat tayā pakṣasya jñānācśābda anumitī na ca ābhāse tat jñānam asti hetu abhāvāt eva kim tu agṛhīta asaṃsarga jñāna dvayam tatra indriyasya saṃbaddha grāhaka tvāt na ca pratyabhijñāna vat

ukta uttara tvāt na ca doṣa vaśāt asaṃbaddhe api vijātīyam kāryam doṣasya ajanaka tvāt na hi duṣṭāt kuṭaja bījāt yavāṅkuraḥ bhasmakam ca na doṣaḥ kim tu vahneḥ udbhavaḥ tasya ca dāha sāmarthyam dṛṣṭam eva rasa arjanam tu na bhavati bhakṣya dāhāt dava dahana dagdha vetravījam ca naṣṭam eva tad bhasmanaḥ kadalī janaka tvam tat uktam sa ākāra vādāt asataḥ na bhānāt saṃvid virodhāt atha hetu abhāvāt dhiyām anāśvāsa bhayāt ca na iṣṭā yatas anyathā khyāti ḥ atas yathārthā tasmāt vivāda padam jñānam na vyadhikaraṇa prakārakam jñāna tvāt satya jñāna vat bheda agraha janya rajata tva prakāraka śukti icchāyām pratiyogi prasiddhiḥ jñāna tvam sva vyadhikaraṇa prakāra avacchinna viṣaya tā pratiyogi vṛtti na bhavati jñāna mātra vṛtti dharma tvāt pramātva vat na ca cakṣuḥ cākṣuṣa satya jñāna atirikta jñāna janakam indriya tvāt rasana vat iti pratirodhaḥ aprayojaka tvāt cākṣuṣa jñāna atirikta jñāna janaka tva upādheḥ anyathā ākhyāteḥ api dharmi aṃśe satya tvāt tulya nyāyatayā vyāpake api vyartha viśeṣaṇa tvāt ca

evam svarūpataḥ viṣayataḥ ca agṛhīta bhedam jñāna dvayam eva visaṃvādi pravatti hetuḥ tat uktam saṃnihita rajata śakale rajata matiḥ bhavati yādṛśī satyā bheda anadhyavasāyāt iyam api tādṛś parisphurati iti vyavahāra mātrasya bheda agrahajanya tve api tasya saṃvāda tadabhāvābhyām jñāne yathārtha tva ayatha artha tva vyapadeśaḥ atas eva loke uṣṇam jalam iti jñāne na ayathārtha tva vyapadeśaḥ upekṣā jñāne tu tad vyapadeśaḥ tad yogya tvāt

sidvāntaḥ tu satya sthale pravṛtti mātram pratīṣṭa purovarti jñāne hetu tayā vyavasthite ati prasaṅga vāraṇa artham viṣaya tayā vaiśiṣṭyam eva kāraṇa tāvacchedakam kalpyate lāghavāt kāraṇa tā graha samaye jñāna vitti vedya tayā śīghra upasthitika tvāt bādhaka abhāvāt ca svatantra upasthita iṣṭa bheda āgrahaḥ kāraṇam tādṛśa bheda agraha tvam ca kāraṇa tāvacchedakam gauravāt kalpanīya upasthitika tvāt ca viśiṣṭa jñāne api hetu tvena āvaśyaka tvāt bheda āgrahaḥ eva hetuḥ iti ced na

viśiṣṭa jñāne tad hetu tvasya tad kalpana uttara kalpya tvena pravṛtti kāraṇa tā graha samaye tad anupasthiteḥ na ca evam mithyājñāna kalpane gauravam pramāṇa pravṛtti samaye siddhi asiddhi parāhata tvena phala mukha gauravasya adoṣa tvāt pramāṇavataḥ tasya nyāyya tvāt evam ca visaṃvādi pravṛttiḥ api viśiṣṭa jñāna sādhyā pravṛtti tvāt satya pravṛtti vat kḷpta kāraṇam vinā anupapatteḥ ananyathā siddha tayā pravṛttyā samānīta viśiṣṭa jñāna balāt tad kāraṇam sa doṣam indriya ādi eva sarvatas balavatī hi anyathā anupapattiḥ na ca bheda agrahāt pravṛtti upapattiḥ api viparīta catuṣke yugapad pravṛtti nivṛtti āpatteḥ

na ca tatra māna abhāvaḥ ime raṅga rajate iti satya jñāna vat rajataraṅgayoḥ pratyeka bhrama sāmagryoḥ ekadā sattvena tādṛśa bhrama utpatteḥ ānubhavika tvāt anyathā samūha ālambana ucchede dvi tva ādi a pratyakṣata āpatteḥ ime raṅga rajate iti śabda ābhāsā t evaṃvidha bhrama saṃbhavāt ca mama doṣa mahimnā rajata raṅgayaḥ rajataraṅga bheda grahān na saṃśayaḥ tava ca ekatra svatantra ubhaya bheda agrahāt pratyekam raṅgam rajatam vā iti saṃśayaḥ syāt

atha yat dharma jñānāt yat upasthitiḥ tatra tad bheda agrahāt pravṛtti nivṛttī raṅga rajata dharmeṇa rajataraṅge smārite na tu raṅgarajate māṣa rāśi stham asī viṣaye māṣa arthi pravṛttiḥ masī nīlim asmārita māṣa bheda āgrahāt anubhūyamāna āropaḥ asiddhaḥ eva anyathā tava api pratyekam ubhaya jñānam syāt iti ced mā evam śabda ābhāsāt pratyakṣāt vā iṣṭa aniṣṭa upa sthitau tad abhāvāt mamatu eka dharmāt ubhaya upasthitau api rajataraṅgayoḥ tad tayā na jñānam doṣāt iti ubhaya siddham viparīta jñānam ca doṣāt na ca evam āvaśyaka doṣāt eva pravṛtti nivṛttī satya sthale tad abhāvāt na ca visaṃvādinī doṣāt indriya liṅga śabda ādi doṣāṇām ananugata tvāt tad janya jñāne ca jāti bhedāt

navyāḥ tu raṅga vṛtti tayā jñāta dharmasya rajate utkaṭākāṅkṣā tena saha bhūyas sahacāra darśanāt na raṅge alpa tathā tvāt iti tatra anutkaṭā sā evam rajata vṛtti tayā jñāta dharmasya api atas utkaṭākāṅkṣayā anutkaṭa ākāṅkṣā pratibandhāt na raṅge nivṛttiḥ evam rajate na pravṛttiḥ iti tat na ime raṅga rajate iti śabda ābhāsāt yugapad pravṛtti nivṛtti prasaṅgāt śabdāt upasthitau ākāṅkṣāyāḥ tulya tvāt kim ca evam dharmayoḥ bhūyaḥ alpa sahacāra avagamāt utkaṭān utkaṭa koṭikaḥ raṅgam rajatam vā iti saṃśayaḥ syāt utkaṭān utkaṭākāṅkṣā kalpane māna abhāvāt utkaṭa tva anirukteḥ ca

syāt etat saṃvādi visaṃvādi pravṛttyoḥ vaicitrye viśiṣṭa jñāna bheda āgrahau hetū kḷpta tvāt na tu viśiṣṭa jñāna satya tva asatya tve gauravāt asiddheḥ ca pravṛtti nivṛtti mātre ceṣṭā aniṣṭa purovarti jñānam hetuḥ iti na ananugamaḥ na tu viśiṣṭa jñānam gauravāt na ca bheda grahe ati prasaṅgaḥ viśiṣṭa jñānam bheda agraham ca viśeṣa dvaya hetum vinā sāmānya hetoḥ kārya anutpādāt na hi nirviśeṣam sāmānyam nāma anyathā andhasya tvac saṃbandhe mahati udbhūta rūpavati candra mahasi pratyakṣatā āpattiḥ dravya sākṣātkāra hetoḥ sattvāt

evam raṅge rajate ca visaṃvādinyau bhavataḥ bheda agrahāt na ca saṃvādinyau viśiṣṭa jñāna abhāvāt atha rajataraṅgayoḥ rajataraṅga bheda agrahāt visaṃvādinyau balāt syātām tad sāmagrī sattvāt visaṃvādinī tatra satya rajate na saṃbhavati iti ced atas eva bheda āgrahaḥ na tad hetuḥ tad sattve api tad abhāvāt na ca pravṛtti nivṛtti gatam visaṃvādi tvam saṃvādi tvam apekṣya tad hetunā te janyete kāraṇasya kārya anapekṣaṇāt iti

mā evam pravṛtteḥ aniṣṭa viṣaya tvam nivṛtteḥ iṣṭa viṣaya tvam visaṃvādaḥ tathā ca aniṣṭa viṣaya pravṛtta āviṣṭa viṣaya nivṛttau ca bheda āgrahaḥ hetuḥ iti katham tatas iṣṭa aniṣṭa viṣaya pravṛtti nivṛttī syātām tatra tasya asāmarthyāt iti atra brūmaḥ jñānam sva viṣaye pravartakam iti ādya pravṛttau saṃvādi pravṛttau ca sarvaiḥ avadhāritam lāghavāt bādhaka abhāvāt ca tatas iṣṭa jñānam śuktau pravartakam tat viṣayakam tad vyavahāra hetu tvāt sva aviṣaye tasya asāmarthyāt

atha bheda agrahāt grahaṇa smaraṇāt ca āvaśyakāt visaṃvādi pravṛtti upapatteḥ viśiṣṭa jñāna kalpane gauravāt ca sva aviṣaye api jñānam pravartakam iti kalpanāt sarvaiḥ prathamam avadhāritam api tyajyatām iti ced na prathama pravṛtta pramāṇa balena tatra api viśiṣṭa jñāna kalpanāt tatra bādhakam vinā tad virodhena kalpa antara anudayāt ca phala mukha gauravasya adoṣa tvāt anyathā prathamam sarvaiḥ gṛhītā api kārya anvite śaktiḥ siddhārtha darśanāt gauravāt ca parityajyeta iti sādhu samarthitam guru matam

nanu sva viṣaye jñānam pravartakam iti satyam kim tu visaṃvādi pravṛttau idam jñānam eva pravartakam na tu iṣṭa jñānam api tat hi jñāyamāna iṣṭa bheda agrahe kāraṇa tāvacchedakam lāghavāt iti daṇḍa tva vat anyathā siddham evam hi tad pratibaddha vyavahāra anukūla tvam tat viṣaya tvam rajata jñānasya śuktau na asti anyathā rajata jñānasya śukti viṣaya tva āpatteḥ saṃvādi pravṛttau ca iṣṭa jñānam pravartakam tasya viśiṣṭa jñāna tvāt abhedena avacchedaka tva abhāvāt iti mama siddhāntasāraḥ iti ced

ucyate svatantra anvaya vyatireka ādiṣṭa jñānam hetuḥ eva na tu itara hetu ta avacchedakam anyathā siddham vā na hi iṣṭa jñānam ādāya eva iṣṭa bheda āgrahasya anvaya vyatirekau yena daṇḍa tva vat tad avacchedakam na api iṣṭa jñānasya bheda agrahagarbha tvena anvaya vyatirekau yena daṇḍa rūpavat tat anyathā siddham anyathā agṛhīta bheda iṣṭa jñānam hetuḥ avacchedakaḥ bheda agrahaḥ iti eva kim na syāt tasmāt svatantra anvaya vyatirekāt ubhayoḥ api hetu tvam

kim ca iṣṭa viṣaya pravṛtti sthale pravṛtti mātram pratīṣṭa jñānasya hetu tvāt iyam api pravṛttiḥ tad janyā kḷpta hetum vinā kārya anutpatteḥ na ca iṣṭa jñāna janya tve iṣṭa viṣaya pravṛtti tvam avacchedakam gauravāt bādhakam vinā sāmānyayoḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāva niyamāt atas eva tat na upādhiḥ api atha tatra api idam jñānam pravartakam daiva adhīnam tasya iṣṭa viṣaya tvam api iti ced tarhi iṣṭe idam iti jñānāt eva pravṛttiḥ syāt na hi atra iva tatra api jñāyamāna iṣṭa bheda āgrahaḥ pravartakaḥ etena na rajata jñānam śukti viṣayakam tad pratibaddha vyavahāra ahetu tvāt iti nirastam asiddheḥ

nanu jñānam yathārtham eva iti vyāptiḥ eva tad bādhikā atas eva pravṛtti mātre viśiṣṭa jñānam iṣṭa jñānam ca hetuḥ lāghavāt sva viṣaye jñānam pravartakam sarvaiḥ eva adya pravṛttau tathā avagamāt asatya sthale iṣṭa jñānam api pravartakam na tu bheda agrahe hetu tāvacchedakam iti anyathā ākhyāti sādhanam na bhavati iti ced na teṣām anyathā siddhau anvaya vyatireka avadhārita kāraṇa tā mūlaka tvena taiḥ eva vyāpti bādhāt kḷpta hetum vinā kārya anutpatteḥ vipakṣe bādhaka abhāvāt ca jñāna ayatha artha tve api niṣkampa pravṛtti ādi upāyasya vakṣyamāṇa tvāt

etena saṃskāra indriyābhyām pratyabhijñāna vat śabda ābhāsa āditas vā parasparam saṃbandha virahiṇi ekam jñānam na bhavati iti jñānam yathārtham eva iti vyāptiḥ iti nirastam vyāpti ādi asiddheḥ sāmagrī sattve kārya āvaśyaka tvāt ca eka deśinaḥ tu rajata raṅgayaḥ rajataraṅga bheda agrahāt na yugapad pravṛtti nivṛttī na ca anyathā khyātiḥ doṣa vaśāt puras vartinam vihāya smṛta raja taraṅgābhyām purovartini bheda grahāt na ca rajata tvena smṛtiḥ saṃskāra gocara sarva rajata viṣayā syāt sāmānya pratyāsatteḥ tulya tvāt iti vācyam tat ta aṃśe rajata tve ca pratyāsattau api doṣāt smṛti anubhava pratibandha vat upapatteḥ

kim ca pratyakṣe sāmānyam pratyāsattiḥ smaraṇe tu manaḥ karaṇam saṃskāraḥ pratyāsattiḥ na tu tasya sāmānyam pratyāsattiḥ akaraṇa tvāt tat na ekaraṅga rajata mātra jñāna anantaram tayoḥ eva yama jayoḥ vā viparīta catuṣke ati prasaṅgāt anyathā ākhyāteḥ vā anye tu rajate na idam rajatam iti jñānam rajata tva asaṃsarga agraha rūpam rajata bheda asaṃsarga agraha rūpam pravṛtti pratibandhakam iti

tat na anya vṛtti tayā upasthitasya rajata tva asaṃsargasya rajata bhedasya ca raṅge asaṃsarga āgrahāt nivṛtti prasaṅgāt raṅge ca tayoḥ asaṃsarga grahe anyathā khyātiḥ rajate rajata bheda asaṃsargā saṃsargasya asaṃsarga āgrahāt nivṛttiḥ iti ced na bheda asaṃsarga asaṃsargasya bheda saṃsarga rūpa tvena rajata bheda saṃsarga asaṃsarga grahāt raṅge nivṛtti prasaṅgāt rajata bheda saṃsarga asaṃsarga grahe ca anyathā khyātiḥ rajata vṛtti tayā upasthite bhede rajata bhedena saha bheda āgrahaḥ pravṛtti pratibandhakaḥ evam raṅge nivṛttau api iti ced na evam api śabda ābhāsāt yugapad pravṛtti nivṛtti āpatteḥ pravṛtti nivṛtti viṣaya niṣṭha bhedayoḥ raṅga rajata bhedayoḥ ca śabdāt anupasthityā pratibandhaka tva abhāvāt

apare tu puras varti niṣṭhatayā jñāte bhede iṣṭa aniṣṭa pratiyogi tva abhāva grahāt pravṛtti nivṛttī tathā hi raṅge rajata bhedaḥ san api doṣān na bhāsate anyasmāt bhāsate eva tathā ca raṅga vṛtti tayā jñāte bhede rajata pratiyogi tva abhāva grahāt yathārthāt eva raṅge pravṛttiḥ raṅga pratiyogi tva abhāvaḥ san api doṣān na bhāsate iti tatra na nivartate evam rajata niṣṭhatayā upasthite bhede raṅga pratiyogi tva abhāva grahāt rajate nivartate rajata pratiyogi tva abhāvaḥ san api doṣān na gṛhyate iti na yugapad pravṛtti nivṛttī na ca raṅga vṛtti bheda tvam rajata bhede api asti iti tena rūpeṇa saḥ api bhāsate sāmānya buddheḥ sarva viśeṣa viṣaya tvāt tathā ca rajata bhede api tad pratiyogi tva abhāva grahe anyathā khyātiḥ iti vācyam pratyāsattau api raṅga vṛtti bheda tvena rajata bhedasya doṣeṇa agrahāt iti

mā evam idam rajatam iti jñānam anvaya vyatirekābhyām pravartakam iti anubhava siddham tat ca satya sthale viśiṣṭa jñānam anyatra jñāna dvayam ekam vā jñānam iti vivādaḥ tatra tat jñānam na pravartakam iti anubhava bādhitam tat api hetuḥ iti api na tasya satya sthale asiddha tvāt viśiṣṭa jñāna apekṣayā guru tvāt śabda ābhāsāt pravṛttau bheda ādi jñāna abhāvāt ca evam nivṛttau api anye tu iṣṭa vṛtti tayā gṛhyamāṇaḥ aniṣṭa vṛtti tayā ca agṛhyamāṇaḥ dharma sva āśraye pravartakaḥ iti sa ca dharmaḥ rajate rajata tvam raṅge rajata sādṛśyam evam nivṛttau api iti na yugapad pravṛtti nivṛttī iti

tat na evam hi ime raṅga rajate iti śabda ābhāsāt raṅga rajatayoḥ pravṛtti nivṛttī na syātām rajata vṛtti dharmasya ca raṅge raṅga vṛtti dharmasya rajate śabdāt anupasthiteḥ na ca śabda anantaram pratyakṣeṇa tayoḥ upasthitiḥ tatra hetuḥ na śabdaḥ iti vācyam ananyathā siddha śabda anuvidhānāt ime rajataraṅge iti svakīyam yathārtha jñānam anādṛtya tatra eva ime raṅga rajate iti pratāraka vākye viśvāsena pravṛtti nivṛtti darśanāt ca

itare tu rajate rajata tvam na gṛhyate doṣāt tathā ca rajata vṛtti tayā yāvat upasthita dharmasya rajata tvena bheda agrahān na pravartate raṅga vṛtti tayā upasthitasya ca kasyacid dharmasya rajata tvena bheda agrahādraṅge pravartate evam nivṛttau api yathā tava abheda grahe api māna antarāt bheda grahaḥ pravṛtti pratibandhakaḥ tathā rajate rajata bheda grahe api rajata vṛtti tayā yāvat upasthitasya rajata tvena mama bheda grahaḥ pravṛtti pratibandhakaḥ iti tat na etad apekṣayā viśiṣṭa jñānasya laghu tvena anvaya vyatirekābhyām ca hetu tvāt na ca hetu abhāvaḥ pratyabhijñāna vat saṃskāra indriyābhyām viśiṣṭa dhī saṃbhavāt tasya jñāna dvaya tve abheda ucchedaḥ tasya tad eka māna tvāt na ca eka viṣaya tvena tayoḥ paraspara sahakāritā nāma viśiṣṭa nāmi pratyakṣe tat ta aṃśe ca tad abhāvāt gauravāt ca na ca atiprasaṅgaḥ bheda agrahasya api tad hetu tvāt

atha pratyabhijñāyai ekatve api tat ta aṃśe na sākṣātkāri tvam tatra indriya asaṃnikarṣāt tat jñāna janya tvāt ca kim tu smṛti tvam purovarti abheda aṃśe ca sākṣāt tvam smṛti tvam anubhūti tvam ca na jātiḥ avyāpya vṛttiḥ vā iti ced tarhi saṃskārāt asaṃnikṛṣṭam api bhāsate iti tava api anumatam tathā ca tava eva rītyā pratyabhijñāna vat idam rajatam iti ekam jñānam astu tad sāmagrī sattvāt mama tu indriya janya tvāt jātya saṃkarāt ca sākṣātkāri tvam eva ubhaya tra

nanu yaḥ yat sākṣātkāraḥ sa tad indriya saṃnikarṣa janyaḥ na ca rajate saḥ iha asti iti ced na pratyabhijñāyai indriya janya tayā sākṣātkāri tvena tat tāyām nāmni ca vyabhicārāt saṃskārasya smṛteḥ vā saṃnikarṣa tvāt ca na ca rajata tva pratyakṣe saṃyukta samavāyasya pratyāsatti tvena hetu tvāt tam vinā na tat iti vācyam tad viśiṣṭa jñāne viśeṣaṇa jñāna upakṣīṇa tvena tasya ahetu tvāt na hi viśiṣṭa dhī sāmagrī sattve tena vinā tad vilambaḥ

kim ca viśeṣaṇa jñānam viśeṣya saṃbandhaḥ tayoḥ asaṃsarga āgrahaḥ iti pratyabhijñāsatya pratyakṣa sādhāraṇasya viśiṣṭa pratyakṣa hetoḥ bhrame api saṃbhavāt rajata sākṣātkāre rajata saṃyogasya hetu tve api viśeṣya saṃnikarṣa tvena hetu tā na tu rajata saṃyoga tvena yat sāmānye yat sāmānyam hetuḥ tad viśeṣe tad viśeṣasya hetu tva niyamāt saṃyogasya viśeṣya bhāna sām agryantarita tvena anyathā siddha tayā viśeṣa sāmagrī antarākalpanāt gauravāt ca pratyakṣa hetu tvena kḷpta viśeṣya saṃbandhāt eva tad upapatteḥ api ca pravṛttau svatantra upasthita iṣṭa bheda āgraha kāraṇa tva apekṣayā rajata sākṣātkāre viśeṣya saṃnikarṣa tvena hetu tvasya laghu tvāt

vastutas tu doṣāt bhramaḥ iti ubhaya siddham tatra bhramaḥ na asaṃsarga graha abhāvaḥ tasya adhikaraṇa rūpa tve asādhya tvāt tad jñāna rūpa tve ca tasya pramātvena doṣa ajanya tvāt bhrama sthāna abhiṣikta pramā doṣa janyā eva iti ced na tasyāḥ kḷpta sāmagryantara janya tvāt iti bhramaḥ asatyajñānam iti asaṃnikṛṣṭam api doṣāt bhāsate iti abhyupeyam api ca doṣasya viśiṣṭam eva jñānam vyāpāraḥ pravṛtau tad hetu tvasya kḷpta tvāt na ca bheda āgrahaḥ kalpanīya kāraṇa bhāva tvāt yat tu duṣṭāt kāryam na iti tatra bīja indriya sādhāraṇam na duṣṭa tvam ekam asti

evam pratyakṣam api anyathā ākhyātau mānam kāraṇa bādhā bhāvāt tathā hi idam rajata tayā jānāmi iti anuvyavasāya sākṣikam eva anyasya anyathā bhānam na hi viṣaya tve anuvyavasāyāt anyat pramāṇam na hi atad viṣayaḥ tad jñāna viṣaya tvena na vā tad aviṣayakam tad viṣayaka tvena anuvyavasīyate anuvyavasāyasya pramātu a niyamāt anyathā ghaṭa jñāne api kadācid paṭam jānām iti syāt na ca bheda agrahadaśāyām rajata jñāna viṣaya tva asaṃsarga āgrahaḥ śuktau bheda grahe api śuktiḥ rajata tvena mayā jñātā śuktau rajata ajñānam me vṛttam iti anuvyavasāyāt

atha vicāra sādhya asaṃsarga graha bādhyaḥ ayam asaṃsarga āgrahaḥ tena vicāram vinā bheda grahe api avatiṣṭhate iti ced na idam rajata tayā jānāmi iti atra śukti karmakarajata tu aprakāraka jñāna asaṃsarga āgrahasya ātmani asaṃbhavāt tādṛśa jñāna aprasiddheḥ na ca idam jānāmi iti rajatam jānāmi iti tad ākāraḥ tṛtīya arthasya prakāra tvena prakāriṇaḥ abhāne abhāna prasaṅgāt viśiṣṭa jñānam ca sarvatra viśeṣaṇa viśeṣyīyam iti anyathābhānam api tathā jñāne rajata tva anabhyupagamāt viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya viṣayaka tvāt ca na sa ākāra vādaḥ

yat tu jñāna mithyā tve bādhya bādhaka vyavasthā na syāt aviśeṣāt iti tat na ananyathā asiddhāyāḥ dhiyaḥ bādhaka tvāt tathā hi yatra duṣṭa aduṣṭa indriya janyam paraspara nirapekṣam ekatra viruddham jñāna dvayam utpadyate tatra prathamam anupajāta virodhi tvāt na anāgatam bādhate tasya aprāpta tvāt uttaram tu sva kāraṇāt utpadyamānam upajāta virodhitayā na anupamṛdya pūrvam utpattum arhati iti pūrvam bādha ātmakam utpadyate anyathā na utpadyeta eva na ca evam eva iti vācyam anubhava virodhāt yat āhuḥ

pūrvāt para balīyaḥ tvam tatra nāma pratīyate anyonya nirapekṣāṇām yatra janma dhiyām bhavet iti yatra pūrva apekṣam uttaram jñānam utpattum unmukham tatra upajīvya pūrva virodhena uttaram na utpadyate atas ajātam sat pūrvam katham bādhatām yathā pratyakṣa ādi viruddha anumitiḥ nanu bhramasya kim bādhyate na svarūpam tasya sattvāt na api rajata tva prakāraka tvam śukti viṣayaka tvam vā tayoḥ apanetum aśakyatvāt jātam hi tat rajata tvena śuktim viṣayīkṛtya na api vyavahāraḥ pravṛtti ādeḥ vṛtta tvāt na api anāgata vyavahāra janaka tvam tasya kāraṇa abhāvāt eva asaṃbhavāt
