ucyate bādhakena bhramasya bhramatu a buddhiḥ eva bādhaḥ yat tu dhiyām ayathārtha tve katham āśvāsaḥ iti tat na prāmāṇya graha upāyasya darśita tvāt satya tva niyame api sat asaṃsarga āgrahasya agṛhīta asaṃsargasya jñāna dvayasya ca bahuṣu darśanāt katham āśvāsaḥ atha sat asaṃsarga āgrahasya pratisandhānam vilambitam sat viṣaya tvam ca śīghra upasthitam iti autsargika sat viṣaya tva jñānāt viśvāsaḥ yatra tu kadācid saṃśayaḥ tatra jñāna antarāt eva saṃśaya nivṛttiḥ iti ced mama api autsargikam dhiyām satya tvam bādhakena apanodyate iti tad anavatārāt satya tva viśvāsaḥ

kim ca tava jñāna antare api aviśvāsaḥ viśeṣa darśanāt viśvāsaḥ tulyaḥ eva yathā ca tatra api na saṃdehaḥ tathā uktam paratas prāmāṇye anye tu smṛta yogya vaidharmya abhāvaḥ adhikaraṇam tat jñānam vā tat ca pratyakṣatas eva gṛhītam iti yuktaḥ viśvāsaḥ ayogye bhedake adhikaraṇe ca bheda saṃśaye jñāna antarāt viśvāsaḥ iti

tat na ubhayatra api jñāna antarāt viśvāsa tulya tvena śiṣya dandhana mātra tvāt vastutas tu bheda āgrahādeva abheda vyavahāra upapattauvabheda viṣaya tvam kvāpi na siddham asti iti katham sat viṣaya tva siddhiḥ yat tu doṣaḥ na hetuḥ iti tat na phala balena tathātvāt atha idam rajatam iti jñānam katham ayathārtham idaṃrajatayoḥ sattvāt na ca tad ubhaya tādātmyam asat ubhayam tādātmyam ca iti atas adhikasya abhāvāt tayoḥ ca sattvāt asattve vā asat khyātiḥ evam saṃsarga āropaḥ api iti

ucyate sat mātra viṣaya tve api tad abhāvavati tad prakāraka tvam prakāra vyadhi karaṇa viṣaya tāka tvam vā ayathārtha tvam prāñcaḥ tu tādātmya saṃsargayoḥ asatorā iva manyante viṣaya tvam na ca evam asat khyātiḥ sat uparaktasya atyanta asataḥ khyāti abhyupagamāt sat anuparaktasya akhaṇḍasya atyanta asataḥ khyātiḥ asat khyātiḥ na abhyupeyate kāraṇa abhāvāt tad anupapattiḥ tulyā eva iti ced na atra viśiṣṭa jñāna sāmagryāḥ darśita tvāt tat uktam vācaspati miśraiḥ tasmāt yat anyathā santam anyathā pratipadyate tad nirālambanam jñānam asat ālambanam matam iti

sā ca pramā caturvidhā pratyakṣa anumiti upamiti śābdī bhedāt evam catasṛṇām tāsām karaṇam pramāṇam api caturvidham pratyakṣa anumāna upamāna śabda bhedāt anyeṣām yathāyatham eṣu eva antar bhāvāt tathā ca vakṣyāmaḥ nanu na pratyakṣam tāvat indriya artha saṃnikarṣa utpannam jñānam avyabhicāri ātma anumiti smṛtyoḥ jñāna mātre ca ati vyāpteḥ ātmanaḥ arthasya manasā indriyeṇa saṃyogāt utpatteḥ īśvara pratyakṣa avyāpteḥ ca saṃnikarṣasya ca saṃyoga ādi rūpa tvena ananugamāt ca saṃyoga ādi anyatamasya ca anirdhārita eka paratve bhāga asiddhiḥ itara bheda sādhane vyartha viśeṣaṇa tvam ca indriya arthayoḥ eka janya tvasya lakṣaṇa tve vyartha viśeṣaṇa tvam na ca tayoḥ eka eka janya tvam eva lakṣaṇam ātma manaḥ janya tvena jñāna mātre gata tvāt indriyasya pratyakṣa nirūpya tvāt ca na api jñāta karaṇa ājanya tve sati satyaḥ anubhavaḥ pratyakṣam liṅga ādeḥ ajanakatayā jñānasya ajñātasya karaṇa tve anumiti ādau gata tvāt jñāna ajanyaḥ anubhavaḥ satyaḥ iti api na viśiṣṭa pratyakṣa avyāpteḥ tasya viśeṣaṇa jñāna janya tvāt na api satya tve sati sākṣātkāri tvam niyata vyañjaka abhāvena grahītum aśakyatayā tasya jāti tva asiddheḥ sattve vā tat eva lakṣaṇam vyavahāra nimittam ca astu kim jātyā

ucyate pratyakṣasya sākṣātkāri tvam lakṣaṇam cākṣuṣa ādi jñāne sākṣāt karomi iti anugata buddheḥ bādhakam vinā jāti viṣaya tvāt na ca indriya janya tvam tathā anyonya āśrayāt indriyasya atīndriya tvāt ca na ca niyata vyañjaka abhāvāt na jātiḥ go tva ādau sāsnādeḥ iva ananugatasya api cakṣuḥ karaṇaka anubhava tva ādeḥ vyañjaka tvāt

na ca jātau anugata vyañjaka niyamaḥ jñāna icchā sukha duḥkha ādeḥ tad abhāvāt pratyuta niyata vyañjaka sattve jātya siddhiḥ eva tatas eva anugata buddhi upapatteḥ nirvikalpakeśvara yogi pratyakṣe ca pratyakṣa tvam dharmi grāhaka māna siddham yoga ja dharma ajanya janya sva viṣaya ka sa vikalpakājanya sāmānya lakṣaṇa pratyāsattya janya janya pratyakṣasya lakṣaṇam anāgata gocara sākṣātkāra hetu pratyāsatti ajanya janya sākṣātkāra tvam

anye tu sāmānya jñāna pratyāsattyoḥ indriya saṃbaddha viśeṣaṇatā antarbhāvāt tat janyam pratyakṣam saṃgrāhyam eva iti sva viśeṣya janyam jñānam janya pratyakṣam ātma viśeṣyaka anumiti śābda smṛtiṣu viśeṣya tvena tasya na hetu tvam viśeṣyam vinā api tāsām utpatteḥ kim tu samavāyi tvena yat vā indriya janyam jñānam janya pratyakṣam indriya tvena janaka tvam vivakṣitam janya pratyakṣa mātre indriya tvena cakṣuḥ ādīnām kāraṇa tā anugata hetum vinā anugata kāryasya ākasmika tva āpatteḥ smṛti anum iti ādau ca manasaḥ na indriya tvena hetu tvam kim tu manaḥ tvena anyathā smṛti ādeḥ sākṣātkāra tva āpatteḥ

indriya tvam ca smṛtya janaka manassaṃyoga āśraya tvam prāṇa śarīra ātmānaḥ ca smṛti janaka manassaṃyogavantaḥ śabda itara udbhūta viśeṣa guṇān āśraya tve sati jñāna hetu manassaṃyoga āśraya tvam vā jñāna akaraṇakam jñānam iti tu vayam viśiṣṭa pratyakṣe ca viśeṣaṇa jñānam na karaṇam vyāpāra abhāvāt viśiṣṭa vaiśiṣṭya pratyakṣe ca viśeṣaṇa jñānam hetuḥ na tu viśeṣaṇa viśeṣaṇa dhīḥ api viśeṣaṇa dhī dvārā karaṇam māna abhāvāt pratyabhijñāyām tu tat ta asmṛtiḥ kāraṇam na tu saṃskāra dvārāḥ anubhavaḥ karaṇam tasyāḥ saṃskāra janya tve smṛtitva āpatteḥ smṛti tve lāghavena saṃskāra janya tvasya tantra tvāt tad hetutvena eva tad siddheḥ ca

prābhākarāḥ tu sākṣāt dhīḥ pratyakṣam sākṣāt tvam ca na jātiḥ niyata vyañjaka abhāvāt na api sa vikalpaka anapekṣa jñāna tvam pratyabhijñā sā dṛśya dvi tva ādi pratyakṣā vyāpanāt kim tu yat jñānam yat viṣaya tve sa vikalpakā janyam tat tatra sākṣāt hīḥ miti mātṛ prakāśe ca sarvam eva jñānam pratyakṣam jñāna ajanya tvāt jātau anugata dhīḥ api pratyakṣāḥ jāti vyakti nirvikalpaka janya tvāt sādṛśya ādi viśiṣṭa vaiśiṣṭya pratyakṣe ca na viśeṣaṇa jñānam hetuḥ tena vinā api yugapad indriya saṃnikṛṣṭe viśiṣṭa pratyaya udayāt

dīrgha ādi pratyakṣe ca na hasvādi jñāna apekṣā kim tu tad vyavahāre anumiti ādeḥ meyā aṃśe pratyabhijñāyāḥ ca tat ta aṃśe jñāna janya tvāt na pratyakṣa tvam kim tu parokṣa tvam eva miti mātraṃśe idanta aṃśe ca dvayoḥ eva pratyakṣa tvam yat tu tat tā prakāśe na tat tāsa vikalpaka tvena kāraṇa tā kim tu tat ta ajñāna tvena tat na anumiti ādau api liṅga ādi jñāna tvena anumeya ādi tulya tvāt iti

atra ucyate yadi tat tāyām pratyabhijñā parokṣa anubhava rūpā tadā na utpadyeta tad hetu liṅga ādeḥ abhāvāt tat ta ajñāna sahitam indriyam janakam iti ced tarhi indriya janya tvāt tatra sākṣāt dhīrā iva syāt na ca jñāna anapekṣa indriya janya tvam tatra tantram gauravāt jñāna sahita indriya janya tvena īdanta aṃśe api apratyakṣa tva prasaṅgāt ca na hi ekasmin jñāne janayitavye tad apekṣā tad anapekṣā ca saṃbhavati

aṃśe tat ubhayam api iti ced na jñāne aṃśasya viṣaya tvena tad ajanya tvāt evam miti mātraṃśe ca sarvam jñānam na pratyakṣam indriya ajanya tvāt sākṣātkāre tasya kāraṇa tvāt manaḥ janya tve anumeya aṃśe api tattva prasaṅgaḥ na ca jñāna mātra sāmagrī janya tvam pratyakṣa tve tantram gauravāt jñāna mātram ca na jñāna tvam tasya ajanya tvāt na api sarvam jñānam pratyakṣa jñāne pratyekam sarva jñāna sāmagrya janya tvāt sarva jñāna sāmagrya prasiddheḥ ca api ca jñāne avayava abhāvena aṃśaḥ viṣayaḥ eva viṣaye ca jñānam na kāraṇam atas anumiti pratyabhijñayoḥ sva viṣaye anumeye tat tāyām ca pratyakṣa tvam syāt viṣayasya sa vikalpakā janya tvāt

atha pratyabhijñāyām tad tāviṣaya tvena tat jñānam kāraṇam evam anum iti ādau meya viṣaya tve api mitimātri dantā dharmi viṣaya tve ca na jñānam kāraṇam kim tu jñāna sāmagri iti ced na tad viṣaya tvam hi jñāne sva kāraṇa adhīnam tadīya svabhāva tvam sva rūpa viśeṣaḥ sa ca eva daṇḍi jñāna ādau ca avyāptiḥ tasya anum iti ādi vat viśiṣṭa jñāna tvena viśeṣaṇa jñāna janya tvāt na ca parokṣa tvam upādhiḥ pratyabhijñāyām prathama utpanna jāti vyakti jñāne janye jāteḥ anugata pratyakṣe ca sādhya avyāpaka tvāt

pūrva vyakti vṛtti tve sati etat vyakti vṛtti tvam anugata tvam iti tatra pūrva anubhūta vyakteḥ viśeṣaṇa tvena tatra jñānasya anugata tva pratyakṣe kāraṇa tvāt anyathā prathamam api anugata dhī prasaṅgaḥ atas eva jñāna sākṣāt ajanyam jñānam pratyakṣam pratyabhijñāyām saṃskāraḥ eva sākṣāt janakaḥ jātau anugata dhīḥ api saṃskāra janyā evam sādṛśya ādi pratyakṣe api pratiyogi saṃskāraḥ eva kāraṇam iti nirastam daṇḍa anubhava janya daṇḍi pratyakṣe dhārāvāhika pratyakṣe ca avyāpanāt uttara viśiṣṭa jñāne pūrva viśiṣṭa anubhavasya eva viśeṣaṇa jñāna tvena hetu tvāt saṃskārasya smaraṇa itarājanaka tvāt ca anyathā pratyabhijñā ādeḥ saṃskāra janya tvena smṛti tvam syāt iti ukta tvāt

pratyakṣa viśeṣe saṃnikarṣa viśeṣaḥ hetuḥ ananugataḥ eva saṃyogena dravya grahaḥ saṃyukta samavāyena rūpa karmaṇoḥ grahaṇam saṃyukta samaveta samavāyena rūpa tva ādeḥ samavāyena śabdasya samaveta samavāyena śabda tva ādeḥ viśeṣaṇa tayā śabda abhāvasya indriya saṃbaddha viśeṣaṇa tayā samavāya ghaṭa abhāva ādeḥ yogya saṃnikarṣāt eva grahaḥ na saṃnikarṣa mātrāt

atha sūkṣma avayava avacchedena avayavi saṃyoge api na tat grahaḥ iti mahā avayava avacchedena saṃyogaḥ hetuḥ tathā ca avayava indriya saṃyogaḥ eva hetuḥ na ca grāhya saṃyoga avacchedaka avayava saṃyoga apekṣayā grāhya saṃyogasya laghu tvāt saḥ eva hetuḥ tasya atiprasakta tvāt etena sva avayava saṃyoga apekṣayā sva saṃyogasya laghu tvāt saḥ eva hetuḥ iti nirastam na api avacchedaka saṃyogena anyathā siddhau tatra api avacchedaka antara saṃyogena anyathā siddhiḥ iti saṃyogaḥ hetuḥ eva na syāt iti vācyam alpataratama bhāga avacchedena saṃyogasya hetu tve ati prasaṅgāt iti

mā evam dravya grahe avayavi mātra grahe vā sthūla avayava avacchedena saṃyogaḥ na na hetuḥ ātma trasa reṇu sūkṣma bhāga grahe vyabhicārāt kim tu ghaṭa ādi grahe sa hetuḥ evam ca ātma ādi dravya grahaḥ grāhya saṃyoga janyaḥ iti ghaṭa ādi grahaḥ api tadvat eva sva grāhya saṃyoga janyaḥ iti tasmin sati api ghaṭa ādi grahaḥ na asti iti yadi tadā sthūla avayava saṃyogaḥ avacchedakaḥ astu tad saṃyogaḥ api vā hetuḥ na tu kḷpta hetu parityāgaḥ

ced nanu saṃyukta samavāyena avayavi grahaḥ astu na tu saṃyoga ādiḥ tatra hetuḥ tasya rūpa ādi grahe kḷpta tvāt na ca lāghavāt saṃyogaḥ eva tathā tasya kalpanīya kāraṇa tvāt iti na ātma grahe indriya saṃyogasya kāraṇa tvāt anyatra api dravya sākṣātkāra tvena tathā kalpanāt na ca bahis indriya dravya grahe avayavi grahe vā saṃyukta samavāyaḥ kāraṇam lāghavena saṃyogasya eva kāraṇa tvena kalpanāt

nanu saṃyukta samavāyaḥ na gandha grāhakaḥ kiṃtu āśraya saṃyogaḥ evam gandha tva grahaḥ api āśraya āśraya saṃyogāt iti saṃyukta samaveta samavāyaḥ api na hetuḥ na ca gandhe sati gandha samavāyam vinā gandhāgrahaḥ asti na ca evam saṃyukta ghaṭe bhāvi gandha grahaḥ syāt gandhasya api sva grahe hetu tvāt na ca gandhasya pratyakṣa tvena indriya saṃnikarṣa āśraya tvam anumeyam śabda pratyakṣa hetoḥ samavāyasya gandhe api sattvāt gandha indriya saṃnikarṣa sādhane sādhya aprasiddheḥ

mā evam gandha samavāyi saṃyogasya hetu tve hi yadi gandha samavāyasya viśeṣaṇa tā tadā sa hetuḥ eva upalakṣaṇa tve ca saṃyukta dravya mātram upalakṣyam tathā ca ghaṭa saṃyogāt paṭa gandha graha prasaṅgaḥ atha sva samavāyi saṃyogaḥ hetuḥ tatra samavāyaḥ avacchedakaḥ iti ced tarhi saṃyogi samavāyasya hetu tve saṃyogaḥ avacchedakaḥ samavāyaḥ hetuḥ iti tulyam tat etat parivartya kṣauma paridhānam iti ucyate

nanu saṃyukta samavāyaḥ na saṃyogaḥ na vā samavāyaḥ na ubhau vā gandhe indriye ca āvṛtteḥ na ca indriyeṇa gandhasya paramparā sambandhaḥ paramparā hi saṃyoga samavāya aveba tatra virodhaḥ eva na adhikaḥ apasiddhāntāt iti ced na indriya tad saṃyoga tad āśraya samavāyānām eva paramparā sambandha tvāt anyathā nīlatva jāteḥ paramparā sambandhena vastra carma kambaleṣu anugata vyavahāra ucchedaḥ

nanu saṃyukta samaveta samavāyāt na rūpa tva ādi grahaḥ tad abhāvāt iti ced na tad anabhyupagame api rūpa ādi sādṛśyasya tatas grahāt na ca dravya sādṛśyāt eva tad vyavahāraḥ bādhakam vinā pratītyaviśeṣāt vaiparītya āpatteḥ āśraya vaisādṛśye api rūpa rasa ādeḥ sādṛśya anubhavāt ca rasa tva madhura tvac andha tva surabhi tva ādiḥ ca jātiḥ anugata pratyayāt rūpe ca yadi api idam nīlam iti anubhavaḥ na tu idam rūpam idam rūpam iti tathā api pītaḥ varṇaḥ nīlaḥ varṇaḥ iti varṇa ākāra anugata buddhiḥ asti rūpa tve mānam na ca cakṣuḥ ādi ekaika indriya grāhya tvam rūpa tva ādikam bādhakam vinā anugata buddheḥ jāti viṣaya tvāt indriya atīndriya tvena cakṣuḥ ādi agrahe api rūpa tva ādi pratīteḥ na hi ananu saṃhita upādheḥ upahita pratyayaḥ atīndriya rūpa rasa gandhān anumāna āpatteḥ ca yogyatāyāḥ rūpa tva ādi jāti nirūpya tvāt

yadi api tad mate nīla pīta ādi ekaikam eva nityam na atīndriyam tathā api cakṣuḥ ghrāṇa ādi rūpasya āloka pṛthivī ādi rūpa abhinna tvena pratyakṣa tva prasaṅgaḥ na ca ekam eva rūpam udbhūtam anudbhūtam ca iti virodhāt rūpa tva ādinā paraspara vyāvṛtta tayā jñātasya rūpa ādeḥ upalabdhyā tad kāraṇa tvena paraspara vyāvṛtta cakṣuḥ ādi anumitiḥ paraspara vyāvṛtta cakṣuḥ ādi anumitau ca cakṣuḥ grāhya tva ādinā rūpa ādi paraspara vyāvṛtta dhīḥ iti anyonya āśrayāt ca nīla pīta ādi pratītau bhinna bhinna karaṇa tva siddhau api tad tad karaṇa grāhya tvasya sarva rūpeṣu asiddhiḥ

nanu nīla pīta ādi upalabdhi karaṇeṣu gandha rasa sparśa avyañjaka tve sati nīla ādi vyañjaka tvāt āloka vat iti taijasa tvam prasādhya taijasa indriya grāhya tvena nīla ādau rūpa ākāra anugata dhīḥ evam gandha ādau api iti ced na evaṃpraṇālī jñāna abhāve api rūpa rasa ādau anugata pratyayāt nīla ākāra anugata buddheḥ ca nīla tvam jātiḥ na ca cakṣuḥ grāhya tvam tat pīta ādau gata tvāt

nanu ekaikāḥ eva nīla aruṇa ādi vyaktayaḥ nānāmasī nīlimni bheda grahe api tattvena pratyabhijñānāt na ca aneka vyakti vṛtti tve nitya tve jāti tva āpattiḥ jāteḥ saṃsthāna mātra vyaṅgya tvāt avayava avayavi vṛtti tvāt go tva ādinā para apara bhāva anupapatteḥ ca nīla itara ādi pratītiḥ ca tad anya rūpa asaṃbhedāt iti ced na pākena śyāmam naṣṭam raktam utpannam iti pratyayāt na ca asau bhramaḥ bādhaka abhāvāt na ca utpāda vināśa pratyayasya samavāyaḥ viṣayaḥ tad anullekhāt evam ca madhura ādi rasānām saurabhā saurabhāṇām ca gandhānām ekaika tvam syāt nīla ādi tulya tvāt evam astu iti ced na teṣām utpāda vināśa anubhavāt ekaika tve madhuratara tva ādi anupapatteḥ ca

nanu śrotreṇa samavāyena śabda grahe sarva śabda upalabdhiḥ syāt na ca karṇa śaṣkulī avacchedena utpannaḥ gṛhyate avacchedyasya ākāśa tvena aviśeṣāt tad anya tve śabdasya tatra asamavāyāt tasmāt yaḥ śabdaḥ yam prati yogyaḥ sa tena gṛhyate na anyaḥ na ca puruṣa viśeṣam prati yogya tvam na svarūpam ananugamāt na ca jātiḥ tasyāḥ niṣpratiyogika tvāt na hi gauḥ kaṃcid pratyagauḥ iti vācyam sa pratiyogika tvam hi na sa avadhi tvam dīrgha tva ādi vat na api itara dhīni rūpya tvam abhāva vat kim tu śabda grahe sā jātiḥ kāraṇam tad avacchedikā vā atas eva na kurvat rūpa tva praveśaḥ sahakāritāsu īkārāt sarva sādhāraṇa tvam iṣṭam eva sarvaiḥ tathā vyavahriyamāṇa tvāt go tve api tat eva tat śabda mātrasya yogya tvam ananugatam eva guṇa yogya tva vat iti

mā evam śabdasya pratyakṣa tvena pratyāsatti sādhanāt na ca samavāyaḥ ati prasaktaḥ anyaḥ anabhyupagataḥ iti vācyam karṇa saṃyoga avacchinna samavāyasya pratyāsatti tvāt karṇa saṃyogaḥ hi samavāya vṛttyā śabda ādhāra tāyām paricāyakaḥ evam ca iha śabdaḥ na iha śabdaḥ iti anubhavāt śabdasya avyāpya vṛtti tve siddhe yasya śabdasya samavāya vṛttyai ādhāratā karṇa saṃyogena avacchidyate sa gṛhyate yasya tu tad atyanta abhāvena avacchidyate sa na gṛhyate tathā saṃyogasya samavāyena ādhāratā hasta saṃyogena avacchidyate na tad abhāvena iti hasta saṃyoga avacchedena gṛhyate na anyatra anyathā hasta saṃyogasya anavacchedaka tve sarvam idam samānam iti saṃyogasya api sarvatra upalabdhiḥ syāt na ca evam samavāyaḥ api avyāpya vṛttiḥ samavāyena vṛttyā tasya ādhāra āvṛtti tvāt abhāvaḥ tu viśeṣaṇa tayā vyāpya vṛttiḥ eva

na ca evam sarvatra sarva śabda upalabdhiḥ syāt śabda samavāyasya sattve api anyatra śabda atyanta abhāva sattvāt atha vīṇā ādau śabdaḥ iti abādhita anubhava balāt tad avacchinnam nabhaḥ śrotram na tu karṇa avacchinnam eva karṇe na śabdaḥ kim tu vīṇāyām iti anubhavāt anyathā karṇe śabdaḥ iti dhīḥ syāt na ca ananta vīṇā ādi avacchedaka tvena ananta śrotra svīkāre gauravam śabda deśa tvena ekatve ca atiprasaṅgaḥ sarva deśānām śabda avacchedaka tvāt iti vācyam vīṇā ādi deśa tā grahasya bādhakam vinā pramāṇa tve gauravasya nyāyya tvāt pratyuta sarvatas dikṣu ananta śabda santāna utpāda krameṇa karṇa utpāde kalpanā gauravam māna abhāvāt na ca dūra saṃnidhānayoḥ śabdānām abādhita tāra manda tva ādi vaidharmya pratītyā bheda siddheḥ saṃtāna siddhiḥ dūra tva ādi doṣāt tāra tva agrahe manda tva āropāt tad upapatteḥ vyavahita karṇe śabda anutpāda vat vyavahita śabda anupalabdhiḥ nimitta vāyu saṃyoga abhāvāt

vyavadhāna abhāvasya hetu tvāt tasya saṃnidhi upakṣīṇa tvāt karṇa anupaghātaḥ api hetuḥ iti na tad upaghāte śabda grahaḥ iti mā evam karṇa avacchedena api śabda grahāt karṇa śaṣkulī api avacchedikā iti karṇa avacchinnam eva nabhaḥ śrotram āvaśyaka tvāt lāghavāt ca śabda mātra grahe tad anuvidhānāt śarīra saṃyuktasya sataḥ sākṣāt pratīti sādhanasya indriya tvāt karṇena vīṇā śabdam śṛṇomi iti tad kāraṇa tvena ābādhita anubhavāt ca na tu vīṇadikam ananta tvāt śabda mātra grahe tad ananuvidhānāt vīṇā ādi avacchinnasya nabhasaḥ śarīra asaṃyukta tvena anindriya tvāt vīṇayā śabdam śrṛṇomi iti ananubhavāt ca

katham tarhi vīṇāyām śabdaḥ iti jñānam śrūyamāṇasya śabdasya tad anadhikaraṇa tvāt iti ced na na hi sarvatra śabde mṛdaṅga ādi adhikaraṇa graha niyamaḥ anyathā kvacid api deśe saṃdeha viparyaya tad anud lekhānām anupapatteḥ yatra api asti tatra śarīre sukham itivat utpattaye paraṃparayā vīṇā ādi apekṣaṇāt tad adhikaraṇa tvam tava api vīṇāyāḥ śabdān āśraya tvena tathā eva adhikaraṇa tvāt

nanu evam karṇe aneka gakāra utpāde aneka grahaṇa prasaṅgaḥ na ca eka grahe anyagraha sāmagrī pratibandhikā kolāhale tathā adarśanāt iti ced na tāreṇa manda abhibhavāt tulya tve vā aneka grahasya iṣṭa tvāt bheda āgrahaḥ tu atyanta sārūpyāt evam ca vīṇā ādeḥ aśrotra tve maitreṇa aham anuvākam adhyāpitaḥ yad gītam tvayā śrutam tat mayā api iti ādi pratītīnām tad uccāraṇa ādi prayojya jātīya tvam viṣayaḥ śabde hi kāraṇa viśeṣa prayojyā jātiḥ avaśyam vācyā anyathā śabda viśeṣeṇa putra ādi anumānam na syāt jātim vinā viśeṣa antara abhāvāt evam ca karṇa avacchinnasya nabhasaḥ śrotra tve tena vīṇā ādi prabhava śabda grahaḥ na tatra santāna krameṇa utpādam vinā iti ananya gatika tayā tad kalpanā api prāmāṇikī

śabdena ca avyavahita paramāṇu deśa utpāda krameṇa na śabda ārambhaḥ yena meghaja ādi śabdānām bhū loka prāptiḥ yuga antare api na syāt kim tu megha ādi abhihata sarvatas gāmi mahā vāyoḥ mahati deśe saṃyoga nimittam āsādya ādya śabdena sarva digvartī śabdaḥ ekaḥ eva janyate nimitta saṃyoga anurodhi tvāt vibhu kāryāṇām uttarottareṇa api adhika adhika deśataḥ sarvatra ekaikaḥ eva śabdaḥ vīcī utpādyate atas eva sarvaiḥ eka śabda grahaḥ

vāyoḥ ca nayana vat mahā vegatayā śīghra gāmi tvena agrima śabda ārambhāt ādya śabda anantaram acireṇa eva śabda upalambhaḥ vāyoḥ eva ca mandataratamādi krameṇa manda ādi śabda utpattiḥ yat vā ādya śabdena kadamba golaka vat daśa diśi daśa śabdāḥ ārabhyante taiḥ ca daśa śabda santānāḥ iti nanu eka śabdena katham aneka śabda ārambhaḥ sāmagrī bhedāt iti ced na sarvatas aneka vāyu ādi sahakārāt prāc abhāva bhedāt vā

na ca tad itara hetu sākalye tad bhedāt na kārya bhedaḥ tathā adarśanāt iti vācyam kārya bhedaḥ hi sāmagrī bhedāt sa ca hetu antara bhedāt iva prāc abhāva bhedāt api anyathā samavāyi ādi bhede api kārya vaijātyam na syāt ghaṭa vyaktiṣu tathā adarśanāt pāka je rūpa ādau hetu antarā abhede api prāgabhāva pūrvarūpa ādi dhvaṃsa bhedena bhedāt ca

atha rūpa ādi eka eka prāgabhāva dhvaṃsayoḥ sarvatra tulya tve kim vinigamakam gandha ādi prāc abhāvānām rasa ādau vyabhicāre api gandha ādau rasa ādi prāc abhāvānām avyabhicārāt iti ced na vāyu sparśe gandha rasa rūpa prāc abhāva pradhvaṃsānām tejaḥ rūpe gandha rasa abhāvayoḥ jala rase gandha prāgabhāvasya vyabhicāreṇa ahetu tve sva prāga bhāva hetu tāyāḥ āvaśyaka tvāt pāka jeṣu rūpa rasa sparśeṣu gandha ādi prāgabhāvānām anyathā siddha tvāt ca rūpa ādiṣu tathā adarśanāt gandhe api sva prāgabhāvasya avaśya hetutvāt abhāva antarāṇām anyathā siddha tvam yat vā rūpa rasa sparśa tulya tve api agni saṃyoga viśeṣāt kvacid saurabham asaurabham ca utpadyate na ca agni saṃyogaḥ rūpa ādi mātre kāraṇam vyabhicārāt evam rasa ādau api nanu kārya mātre prāc abhāva mātram na hetuḥ tayoḥ vyatireka kālān avagamāt sarva muktau itara hetu abhāvāt eva kārya anutpādāt iti ced na hetu antara sattve api utpannasya punar anutpādena prāgabhāvasya hetu tvāt ekā sāmagrī janayati svabhāvāt iti ced na kārya anutpādasya sāmagrī viraha prayojya tva niyamāt

na ca kārya sahabhāvena kāraṇa tvam gauravāt na ca vinaśyat avasthe samavāyini kārya anutpatteḥ tathātvam iti vācyam tāvatā samavāyi kāraṇasya eva tathātvāt kāraṇa mātre māna abhāvena tasya aprayojaka tvāt nanu samaveta samavāyaḥ na grāhakaḥ śabda tva ādi jāteḥ abhāvāt iti ced na rūpa tva ādi nyāyena tad sādhanāt

nanu samavāya asiddheḥ na sā pratyāsattiḥ vipratipattiḥ ca śuklaḥ paṭaḥ iti pratītiḥ viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya sambandha viṣayā na vā iti atha jāti guṇa kriyā tadvantau mithas sambaddhau anubhūyete na hi asaṃbaddha svarūpa dvaye viśiṣṭa dhīvī a padeśau iti ced na saṃbaddha anubhavena hi saṃbandhaḥ na viśeṣaṇam bhāsate tasya prathamam ajñānāt saṃyoginau imau iti vat samavāyinau iti ananubhavāt ca na api viśeṣyaḥ anayoḥ samavāyaḥ iti ananubhavāt na api svarūpeṇa bhāsate samavāyam jānāmi iti viṣayatān anubhavāt

nanu nīlaḥ ghaṭaḥ ityādi anubhavaḥ viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya sambandha viṣayaḥ viśiṣṭa pratīti tvāt daṇḍi jñāna vat iti ced na aghaṭam bhū talam jñātam iṣṭam kṛtam ca iti atra vyabhicārāt saṃbandha viṣaya tve bādhakam vinā iti viśeṣaṇam iti ced na bādhaka abhāvasya eva samartha tve śeṣa vaiyarthyāt sādhaka abhāvena sat pratipakṣāt ca bādhaka abhāvasya sādhaka tva vat sādhaka abhāvasya bādhaka tvāt tasmāt ubhaya abhāve saṃśayaḥ syāt

na ca pratītiḥ eva samavāya sa adhikā tasyāḥ tad viṣaya tva asiddheḥ anyathā anyonya āśrayāt atha aghaṭam bhū talam jñātam ityādi api viśiṣṭa dhīḥ saṃbandha viṣayā kim tu bhrāntā bādhaka sattvāt iti ced tarhi bhū tale aghaṭa tvasya jñāta tva ādeḥ ca abhāvaḥ syāt tathā ca vyavahāra vilopaḥ saṃbandhaḥ ca na saṃyogaḥ samavāyaḥ vā anyataraḥ vā bādhāt asiddheḥ vā na api saṃbandha mātram jñāpaka tva ādinā siddha sādhanāt

na api aviśiṣṭa vyāvṛtta viśiṣṭa jñāna niyāmakaḥ abhāva jñāna ādau iva svarūpa saṃbandhena artha antara tvāt na ca saṃbandhi bhinna tvam sādhye viśeṣaṇam abhāva jñāna ādinā vyabhicārāt bādhaka abhāvasya ca viśeṣaṇa tvam hetau nirastam eva vinā api bhinna saṃbandham abhāva jñāna ādau iva viśiṣṭa dhī saṃbhavena aprayojaka tvāt ca viśeṣaṇa tā viśeṣa rūpaḥ prakāra ādi kṛtaḥ vā viśeṣaḥ saṃbandha āviṣaya tve api tulyaḥ

syāt etat avayava guṇa kriyā jāti tadvatām iha tantuṣu paṭaḥ iha paṭe śauklyam iha calanam paṭa tvam ca iti ihapratyayaḥ ādhāra ādheya saṃbandha nimittakaḥ yathārtheha pratyaya tvāt iha kuṇḍe badaram iti pratyaya vat iti ced na iha bhū tale ghaṭa abhāvaḥ jñānam ca ityādau vyabhicārāt bādhakam vinā iti asya nirasta tvāt tathā eva ādhāra ādheya bhāvāt eva upapatteḥ ca utpattaye sthitaye jñaptaye ca apekṣaṇīyasya ādhāra tvāt

anye tu śabda jāti rūpa ādiḥ indriya saṃbaddhaḥ pratyakṣa tvāt ghaṭa vat iti anumānāt saṃyoga bādhe indriya saṃbandha ghaṭaka tayā samavāya siddhiḥ indriyasya saṃbaddha grāhaka tvāt atas eva samāvāyaḥ na pratyakṣaḥ indriyeṇa asaṃbandhāt na ca saṃbandha tvena tad siddhiḥ anavasthānāt svabhāvāt eva jñāna vat sva saṃbaddha vyavahāra kāri tvāt ca samavāyaḥ hi saṃbandham vinā eva svabhāvāt eva kasyacid na ca jāti ādeḥ api svabhāvāt eva sva saṃbaddha vyavahāra kari tve samavāya vilopaḥ jāti ādeḥ indriya asaṃbandhe samavāyavat a pratyakṣa tva āpātāt iti

tat na samavāya svīkāre api svarūpa saṃbandhasya āvaśyaka tvāt ghaṭa jñānayoḥ bhū tala abhāvayoḥ iva vā dravyeṇa guṇa jāti ādibhiḥ svarūpam eva saṃbandhaḥ astu tathā ca śabdasya indriya viśeṣaṇa tayā śabda tvasya viśeṣaṇa viśeṣaṇa tayā rūpa ādi jāti ādeḥ indriya saṃbaddha viśeṣaṇa tayā rūpa tva ādeḥ indriya saṃbaddha viśeṣaṇa viśeṣaṇa tayā svabhāva saṃbandha rūpayā grahaṇa saṃbhave kim samavāyena dravye svabhāva saṃbandhāt na indriyeṇa grahaṇam iti katham guṇa ādeḥ tena grahaḥ iti ced samavāyena api na dravya grahaṇam iti tulyam

apare tu ekatra ghaṭe āma pākadaśāyām krameṇa śyāma rakta rūpa upalambhaḥ asti sa ca na tad ubhaya nibandhanaḥ rūpasya nitya tvena ekadā upalambha āpatteḥ nitya tvāt eva ca na tayoḥ utpāda vināśau tasmāt tayoḥ saṃbandhasya tau syātām saḥ eva samavāyaḥ iti tat na śyāmam naṣṭam raktam utpannam iti ādya bādhitām ubhavāt samavāyasya utpāda vināśa anullekhāt ca tvad mate tasya atīndriya tvāt anyathā avayavi jñāna gandha rasa ādeḥ api nitya tvam samavāyasya utpāda vināśau iti kim na rocayet na hi utpāda vināśa pratītiḥ aprāmāṇikī bādhakam vinā iti

ucyate guṇa kriyā jāti viśiṣṭa buddhayaḥ viśeṣaṇa saṃbandha viṣayāḥ viśiṣṭa buddhi tvāt daṇḍī iti buddhi vat na ca vyabhicāraḥ abhāva ādi viśiṣṭa buddheḥ api svarūpa saṃbandha viṣaya tvāt na ca evam atra api tena eva artha antaram yatas guṇa kriyā jāti viśiṣṭa buddhīnām pakṣa dharma tā balena viṣayaḥ saṃbandhaḥ sidhyan lāghavāt ekaḥ eva sidhyati saḥ eva samavāyaḥ na tu svarūpa saṃbandhaḥ tad tad svarūpāṇām ananta tvāt saṃbandha tvena akḷpta tvāt ca

athavā viśeṣaṇa saṃbandha nimittikāḥ iti sādhyam hetau tu satya tvam viśeṣaṇam viśeṣaṇa saṃbandhaḥ ca kāraṇa tvena ekaḥ eva sidhyati lāghavāt anugata kāryasya anugata kāraṇa niyamya tvāt ca na tu svarūpa saṃbandhaḥ teṣām ananugata tvāt ananta tvāt ca na ca ubhayam api aprayojakam viśiṣṭa sākṣātkārasya saṃbandha aviṣaya tve tad ajanya tve vā gavāśvādau api viśiṣṭa buddhi prasaṅgāt

navyāḥ tu guṇa kriyā jāti viśiṣṭa buddhiḥ saṃbandhi bhinna viśeṣaṇa saṃbandha viṣayāḥ nirviṣayaka bhāva viśeṣaṇaka viśiṣṭa buddhi tvāt itara nirūpaṇa anirūpya viśeṣaṇaka viśiṣṭa buddhi tvāt vā atas abhāva ādi viśiṣṭa budvau na vyabhicāraḥ na ca aprayojakam nirupādhi saṃbandha śāli tvāt saṃbandhaḥ ca aviśiṣṭa vyāvṛtta viśiṣṭa dhī niyāmakaḥ

yat vā indriya pratyāsatti tvena samavāya siddhiḥ tathā hi guṇa kriyā jāti sākṣātkāraḥ indriya saṃbandha sādhyaḥ janya pratyakṣa tvāt daṇḍi jñāna vat iti atas sākṣāt saṃbandha bādha kāraṇa tvena indriya saṃyukte saṃbandhaḥ sidhyan pakṣa dharma tā balāt lāghavena anugataḥ samavāyaḥ ekaḥ eva sidhyati anugata kāryasya anugata kāraṇa janya tvāt na tu saṃyukta viśeṣaṇa tā rūpa svarūpa saṃbandhaḥ tasya ca tad tad rūpa ādi rūpa tvena ananugata tvāt

evam rūpa tva rasa tva sākṣātkāre api kāraṇa tvena indriya saṃbandhaḥ samavāyaḥ eva anugataḥ sidhyati lāghavāt na tu indriya saṃbaddha viśeṣaṇa tā tasyāḥ rūpa tva ādi svarūpa tvena ananugata tvāt atas eva saṃyogaḥ viśeṣaṇa tā ca pratyāsattiḥ astu na tu samavāya ādi catuṣṭayam iti nirastam tasyāḥ tad tad svarūpa tvena ananugata tvāt pratyāsatti tvena abhyupagate ca samavāye pratyakṣatā saṃbandhi dvaya pratyakṣa tvāt nanu evam abhāva viśiṣṭa pratyakṣe api viśiṣṭa buddhi tvāt saṃyoga samavāya bādhe anugatam vaiśiṣṭyam saṃbandhaḥ viṣayaḥ nimittam ca bhavet iti ced

na tasya hi samavāyavat eka tve ghaṭa abhāvavati paṭavati paṭa abhāva dhī prasaṅgaḥ ghaṭa abhāva vaiśiṣṭyam eva hi paṭa abhāva vaiśiṣṭyam paṭa ābhā vaiśiṣṭi a sattve api paṭa abhāvaḥ na asti tatas tasya bhinna tvāt iti ced na paṭa abhāva abhāvasya abhāva tve saḥ api vaiśiṣṭyena sambandhena tatra asti vaiśiṣṭyasya eka tvāt vaiśiṣṭa casya eka tvāt paṭa abhāva abhāvasya bhāva tve ca paṭaḥ eva pratibandhakaḥ vācyaḥ evam paṭa abhāvaḥ paṭa abhāva dhī hetuḥ syāt vaiśiṣṭyena saṃbandhena tatra asti eva

vaiśiṣṭyasya pratyabhāva vyakti nānātve ca abhāva viśiṣṭa buddhau na ekaḥ saṃbandhaḥ kāraṇam viṣayaḥ vā iti tad abhāva pratyakṣe ananugatam eva vaiśiṣṭyam viṣayaḥ kāraṇam ca vācyam tathā ca ananugata tad tad svarūpa rūpāḥ viśeṣaṇa tā eva astu kḷpta tvāt kim ananta vaiśiṣṭyena samavāyasya vaiśiṣṭyasya ca pratyakṣa tve tvayā api indriya saṃbaddha viśeṣaṇatā svīkārāt

nanu samavāyasya ekatve katham rūpinī rūpa vyavasthā ghaṭena saha rūpa saṃbandha rūpa tvam samavāyasya na vāyunā iti ced na rūpa saṃbandha rūpa tvam samavāyasya svarūpam eva yadi tadā rasa saṃbandha rūpa tvam na syāt tayoḥ virodhāt anyat ca durvacam iti ced ucyate vāyau rūpa samavāya sattve api rūpa atyanta abhāvaḥ asti na ghaṭe katham evam adhikaraṇa svabhāvāt abādhita rūpinī rūpa pratīteḥ ca

nanu evam jñātaḥ ghaṭaḥ iti pratīteḥ jñāta tā api syāt vartamāne bādhaka abhāvāt atīta anāgatayoḥ ca tat dhīḥ bhrāntā iti ced na atīta anāgatayoḥ jñāta tāyāḥ abhāve vyavahāra abhāva āpatteḥ tasya jñāta tā asādhya tvāt na ca jñāta tā jñānam eva vyavahāra hetuḥ gauravāt atīta ādau jñāna tad viṣayau eva jñāta tā adhī gocarau iti ced tarhi vartamāne tau eva tad viṣayau na hi atīta vartamānayoḥ jñāta tā pratītyoḥ viṣaya vailakṣaṇyam īkṣāmahe

nanu rūpa ghaṭayoḥ na samavāyaḥ kim tu abhedaḥ daṇḍī puruṣaḥ iti atra daṇḍi puruṣayoḥ iva nīlaḥ ghaṭaḥ iti atra api nīla ghaṭayoḥ abadhita abheda anubhavāt nīlaḥ ghaṭaḥ daṇḍī puruṣaḥ iti buddhyoḥ viśeṣaṇa sambandha mātra gocara tve nīlaḥ ghaṭaḥ iti vat daṇḍaḥ puruṣaḥ daṇḍī puruṣaḥ iti vat nīlī ghaṭaḥ iti api syāt tasmāt ekatra abhedaḥ viṣayaḥ aparatra viśeṣaṇa saṃbandhaḥ viṣayeṇa eva dhiyām viśeṣāt

athavā viśeṣaṇa tā viśeṣya tāvacchedakayoḥ nīla tva ghaṭa tvayoḥ eka vṛtti tvam jñāyate daṇḍitva puruṣa tvayoḥ iva puruṣe evam nīla ghaṭa padayoḥ śābdam api sāmānādhikaraṇyam yujyate nīlatva ghaṭa tvābhyām bhinna pravṛtti nimittābhyām tayoḥ eka pravṛtteḥ na ca matupaḥ lopāt abheda upacārāt vā nīla padam nīla vat param iti vācyam na hi prayogam sādhakam brūmaḥ kiṃtu nīla ghaṭayoḥ abheda pratītim pade api na upacāra ādi kalpanā gauravāt mukhye bādhaka abhāvāt ca iti

ucyate śukla paṭa śabdayoḥ eka artha tve ghaṭaḥ kumbhaḥ iti vat śuklaḥ paṭaḥ iti saha prayogaḥ na syāt andhasya paṭa graha vat rūpa grahaḥ rūpa agraha vat paṭa agrahaḥ api vā syāt mahārajata rakte paṭa graha vat śukla grahaḥ śukla agraha vat paṭa agrahaḥ api bhavet paṭamānayā iti ukte yam kaṃcid śuklam ānayet apaṭaḥ paṭaḥ iti vat aśuklaḥ paṭaḥ iti virudhyeta paṭa śuklayoḥ abhedāt agri saṃyogāt ekatra śyāma raktayoḥ vināśa utpāde ghaṭasya tau syātām ghaṭa sattve vā tayoḥ api na syātām

atha śukla tva ādīnām dravya bhedāt tad bodha artham saha prayogaḥ andha ādinā śukla ādi grahe śukla tva ādīnām agrahaḥ upapadyate śukla tva ādi jāteḥ ca dravyeṇa abhedaḥ na samavāyaḥ kiṃtu svarūpa saṃbandhaḥ iti ced na śukla tva madhura tva surabhi tva uṣṇa tva ādīnām dravya vṛtti tve dravya grāhaka tvac ādibhiḥ grahaṇa prasaṅgāt rūpa tva ādīnām dravya vṛtti tve pratiniyata indriya grāhya tā eva na syāt yogya vṛtti tvena jāteḥ grahaṇa yogya tvāt tad tad jāti tvena yogyatve ananugamāt tasmāt rūpa tva ādīnām pratiniyata indriya grāhya tā api guṇa guṇi bhede mānam abhede ca katham paṭasya śuklam rūpam iti bheda buddhiḥ paṭaḥ nīlim eti buddhi prasaṅgaḥ ca

nanu ekānta abhede sarvam idam dūṣaṇam vayam tu bheda abheda vādinaḥ tathā ca bhedam ādāya apaunaruktyādi bheda abhede ca uktam eva pramāṇam pratyakṣam atha vā ubhaya siddha bhede sāmānādhikaraṇya dhīra bhede pramāṇam yat vā atyantam abhede bhede ca na sāmānādhikaraṇyam iti tatas eva bheda abheda siddhiḥ na ca bheda abhedayoḥ paraspara viraha rūpa tayā viruddhayoḥ katham ekatra samāveśaḥ iti vācyam saṃyoga tad abhāvayoḥ iva avirodhāt pāka anantaram raktaḥ ayam na śyāmaḥ iti abādhita anubhava balāt tatra eva tad anyonya abhāva siddheḥ tvayā api bheda abheda svīkārāt anyonya abhāva tvam avyāpya vṛtti nitya abhāvavat vṛtti abhāva tva sākṣāt vyāpya dharma tvāt atyanta abhāva tva vat nitya iti vā na viśeṣaṇam avyāpya vṛtti pratiyogika prāc abhāva pradhvaṃsayoḥ avyāpya vṛtti tvāt iti atas api bheda abheda siddhiḥ

ucyate tasya eva tatra abhāvaḥ avaccheda bhedena vartate jñāyate ca yathā saṃyoga ādi a bhāvaḥ śyāmā avacchinnasya tasya eva anyonya abhāvaḥ tatra eva rakta avacchinne tad anyonya abhāva abhāvaḥ ca śyāmā avacchedena tat iha api nīlasya anyonya abhāvaḥ ghaṭa tva avacchedena iti nīlāt ghaṭasya bhedaḥ astu abhedaḥ tu nīla anyonya abhāva abhāva rūpaḥ na ghaṭe ghaṭa tva avacchedena eva virodhāt eka avacchedena bhāva abhāvayoḥ ekatra āvṛtteḥ ajñānāt ca na api avacchedaka antareṇa ghaṭa tva avacchinne ghaṭe tad abhāvāt tad ajñāne api nīlaḥ ghaṭaḥ iti anubhavāt ca na ca anyonya abhāva rūpaḥ bhedaḥ astu abhedaḥ tu na bheda abhāvaḥ kim tu anyaḥ eva iti vācyam abheda vyavahāre tasya ahetu tvāt tasmāt nīlaḥ ghaṭaḥ iti atra nīla saṃbandhaḥ eva bhāsate tathā sati nīlī ghaṭaḥ iti dhīḥ syāt iti uktam iti ced nīlī ghaṭaḥ iti atra buddhau yadi saṃbandha viṣaya tvam āpādyate tat iṣyate eva matupaḥ lopāt abheda upacārāt vā nīla padam eva nīla vat param iti

nanu śabda rūpa ādiṣu viśeṣaṇa tā indriya saṃbaddha viśeṣaṇa tā vā grāhikāḥ tu kim samavāya ādinā atha viśeṣaṇa tāyām samavāyaḥ indriya saṃbaddha viśeṣaṇa tāyām ca saṃyukta samavāya ādiḥ upajīvyaḥ taiḥ vinā tayoḥ abhāvāt iti ced viśeṣaṇa tā svarūpe teṣām upajīvya tvam na tu tasyāḥ pratyāsatti tve api taiḥ vinā api samavāya abhāvayoḥ viśeṣaṇa tā sattvāt

saṃyukta samavāya ādiḥ api tatra asti iti ced āstām na tu pratyāsattiḥ kim tu viśeṣaṇa tā eva kḷpta tvāt saṃyukta samavāya ādikam vinā viśeṣaṇa tā rūpa ādau na jñāyate ced mā jñāyi na hi sā pratyāsattiḥ jñātā api tu svarūpa satī mā evam śabda ādīnām sākṣātkāra viṣaya tvena indriya saṃbandha anumitau śabda ādau samavāya ādikam jñātvā eva viśeṣaṇa tā grahaḥ iti avaśyam prathama upasthita tvāt samavāya ādiḥ eva viṣayaḥ na viśeṣaṇa tā carama upasthita tvāt

nanu abhāva grahe na indriya saṃbaddha viśeṣaṇa tā pratyāsattiḥ cakṣuṣā saṃyukte paramāṇu ādau yogyasya jala tva ādeḥ abhāva graha prasaṅgāt kim tu sva grāhya saṃbaddha viśeṣaṇa tā mahati vāyau udbhūta rūpa abhāvasya kusume saurabha abhāvasya guḍe tikta tva abhāvasya vā na cakṣuḥ ādinā grahaḥ api tu yogyā anupalabdhyā saḥ anumīyate indriya viśeṣaṇa tā api na pratyāsattiḥ cakṣuḥ ādinā sva viśeṣaṇa jala tva ādi abhāva graha prasaṅgāt yadi śabda abhāvaḥ pratyakṣaḥ tadā pratyāsatti antaram kalpyam tad abhāve pratyakṣaḥ eva na bhavati iti ced

mā evam lāghavāt indriya saṃbaddha viśeṣaṇa tā eva pratyāsattiḥ na ca evam paramāṇau jala tva ādi abhāva graha prasaṅgaḥ yatra hi yat sattvam anupalabdhi virodhi tatra tasya abhāvaḥ indriya saṃnikarṣeṇa gṛhyate na ca paramāṇu ādau jala tva ādi sattvam anupalabdhi virodhi yogya saṃyukta samavāya abhāvena pṛthivī tva vat anupabdhi saṃbhavāt mahati vāyu ādau udbhūta rūpa ādi abhāvaḥ cakṣuḥ ādi grāhyaḥ eva tatra udbhūta rūpa ādi sattve anupalabdhi anupapatteḥ atas eva stambhe piśāca tādātmya abhāvaḥ pratyakṣaḥ stambha tādātmye ca tasya stambhasya iva anupalambha asaṃbhavāt evam śabdasya api abhāvaḥ pratyakṣaḥ tadā tatra śabda sattvasya anupalabdhi virodhi tvāt iti tatra indriya viśeṣaṇa tā eva pratyāsattiḥ cakṣuṣi jala tva ādi sattvam ca na anupalabdhi virodhī iti cakṣuṣā na tad grahaḥ

nanu abhāve na viśeṣaṇa tā pratyāsattiḥ kim tu samavāyaḥ eva samavāya sādhaka viśiṣṭa pratīteḥ aviśeṣāt na ca samaveta tve tasya bhāva tva āpattiḥ bhāvasya tattve abhāva tva āpattiḥ iti vaiparītyasaṃbhavāt rūpa ādau pratyāsatti tvena samavāya kalpanam abhāve api tulyam viśeṣaṇa tā api tulyā prāc abhāva pradhvaṃsau pratiyogi āśraye samavetau pratiyogi āśraya nāśa janya dhvaṃsaḥ deśe samaye vā samavaiti tatra eva nirūpaṇāt na ca samavāyi nāśe dhvaṃsa nāśaḥ ghaṭa unmajjana prasaṅgāt bhāva tvasya upādhi tvāt ca anyathā tava api tasya janya tvena nāśāpattiḥ

atha evam anyonya atyanta abhāvayoḥ nitya tve aneka samaveta tve ca jāti tva prasaṅgaḥ na ca tatra bhāva tvam tantram gauravāt na ca abhāvānām viśiṣṭa pratītau viśeṣaḥ yena atra samavāya parityāgaḥ iti ced na ghaṭa tva abhāva ādeḥ jāti tve sattva dravya tva pṛthivī tva ādinā para apara bhāva anupapatteḥ teṣām vyāpya tve ghaṭe tad abhāva prasaṅgaḥ vyāpaka tve sāmānya ādau ghaṭa tva abhāvaḥ na syāt iti

ucyate samaveta tve dhvaṃsasya samavāyi kāraṇa nāśāt nāśaḥ syāt na ca nāśya tve bhāva tvam tantram gauravāt prāgabhāve abhāvāt ca asamaveta tve tad dhvaṃsasya janya tve api na nāśaḥ āśraya nāśa ādeḥ abhāvāt ghaṭa unmajjana āpatteḥ na naśyati iti ced na na hi prayojana kṣati bhayena sāmagrī na kāryam arjayati tasmāt unmajjana abhāva nirvāhaka dhvaṃsasya asamaveta tvam kalpyatām samavāyi nāśāt dhvaṃsa paraṃparākalpane ca ghaṭakapāla ādeḥ āparamāṇu nāśe ghaṭa ādi tad dhvaṃsa virādhī caramaḥ dhvaṃsaḥ paramāṇu vṛttiḥ syāt tathā ca na pratyakṣaḥ ghaṭa dhvaṃsasya kapāla samaveta tve ca na bhū tale nirūpaṇam syāt ubhaya vṛtti tve ca vyāsa jya vṛtti tvena kapālam vinā na nirūpyeta

nanu abhāva grahaḥ na indriyāt kim tu yogyā anupalabdheḥ tad upalambhe tad abhāva āgrahāt na ca evam bhāva buddhiḥ api abhāvānupalabdheḥ eva na indriyāt iti vācyam bhāva grahe indriya anuvidhānāt anyathā nimīlita akṣasya api ghaṭa abhāva anupalabdhyā ghaṭa graha prasaṅgaḥ atas eva bhāva grahe abhāva anupalabdhiḥ pṛṣṭha lagnā api na hetuḥ indriyeṇa anyathā siddha tvāt na hi indriya artha saṃnikarṣe sati tām vinā bhāva dhī vilambaḥ abhāva grahe api indriyam hetuḥ tad anuvidhānāt iti ced na abhāvena cakṣuḥ ādeḥ prāpti abhāvena āśraya grahe tad upakṣayāt

atha adhikaraṇa dhīḥ indriya vyāpāraḥ na ca tayā tad anyathā asidvam anyathā saṃnikarṣa upakṣīṇa tayā indriyam na hetuḥ syāt iti ced na hetu tve siddhe tad vyāpāra tvam tat eva na asti prāpti abhāvāt etena adhikaraṇa graha indriyayoḥ pṛthak anvaya vyatireka grahāt daṇḍa cakrayoḥ iva hetu tvam dvayoḥ iti nirastam prāpti abhāvena abhāva āgrāhaka tvāt na ca indriyam prāpta viśeṣaṇam aprāptam api gṛhṇāti saṃyukta samavāya ādi uccheda prasaṅgāt prāpta caitra gata aprāpta daṇḍasya api graha prasaṅgāt indriyasya prāpta grāhaka tvāt ca na ca viśeṣaṇa tā prāptiḥ anyatra tad akalpanāt na ca samavāye tad kalpanam tasya anabhyupagamāt tatas eva atīndriya tvāt vā atha abhāvasya indriya grāhya tvena saṃyoga ādi bādhe iha eva sā kalpyate rūpa ādau tad bādhe saṃyukta samavāya ādiḥ iva iti ced

tatra anupakṣīṇa indriya anuvidhānāt tathā eva iha sva āśraya grahaḥ eva tad upakṣīṇam lāghavāt na tu prāpti antara kalpanā gauravāt anyathā tvac anu vidhānāt rūpam vinā api vā ayudhīḥ pratyakṣā iti na sā sparśa liṅga grahe upakṣīyeta kim ca viśeṣaṇa tāyām indriya grāhya tvam tena sā iti anyonya āśraya tvam api ca viśeṣaṇa tā grāhya svarūpam eva na ca tvac ādau svarūpa saṃbandhaḥ hetuḥ kim tu yathāyatham saṃyoga samāvāyau na ca tayoḥ anyonya vyabhicārāt indriyam saṃbaddham gṛhṇāti iti eva vyāptiḥ iti vācyam dṛṣṭānte hi saṃbandhi gataḥ saṃbandhaḥ hetuḥ gṛhītaḥ cakṣuṣi anyatra api tathā na tu grāhya svarūpam saṃbandhasya saṃbandhi bhinna tva niyamāt na hi saḥ eva tat vān tena eva bhavati svarūpa saṃbandhasya hetu tve ca rūpa ādi grahaḥ api tatas eva astu kim samavāya ādinā atas saṃyoga viśeṣaṇate eva pratyāsattī iti ṣoḍhā kīrtanam api viphalam

etena āloka apekṣaṇe cakṣuḥ apekṣā tasya tad eka sahakāri tvāt iti nirastam prāptim vinā cakṣuṣaḥ ahetutvāt ālokasya ca pratiyogi grāhaka tvena yogyatā ghaṭaka tayā abhāva grāhaka tvāt na ca evam pratiyogi upalambhaka tvena cakṣuḥ api hetuḥ evam hi tat tat vyāpya itara tad ulambhaka sākalye anupalabdhiḥ grāhikā bhavati iti vācyam prāptim vinā tasya ahetutvena āśraya graha upakṣayāt

nanu evam andhasya tvac indriya upanīte nīle smṛta pītasya anupalabdhyā abhāva graha prasaṅgaḥ pratiyogi grāhaka indriya grāhya tve tu abhāvasya na ayam doṣaḥ andhasya cakṣuḥ abhāvāt iti ced na abhāva grāhaka tvena abhimatam indriyam āśraya graha upakṣīṇam tathā ca pratiyogi grāhaka indriyeṇa āśraya grahe anupalabdhyā abhāva grahāt anyathā cakṣussaṃyukte paramāṇau jala tva abhāva graha prasaṅgaḥ

atha evam vāyau rūpa abhāvaḥ jale tikta abhāvaḥ pāṣāṇe saurabha abhāvaḥ ca na gṛhyeta vāyu ādīnām pratiyogi grāhakaiḥ cakṣuḥ ādibhiḥ agrahāt na ca tava api te abhāvāḥ katham pratyakṣāḥ vāyu ādīnām tad indriya ayogya tvāt iti vācyam liṅgena tvac ādinā vā upanīte vāyu ādau yogya rūpa ādi abhāva viśeṣyakam pratyakṣam cakṣuḥ ādinā eva na vāyu ādi viśeṣyakam pratyakṣe yogya viśeṣyasya hetu tvāt iti ced na vāyu ādau rūpa ādi abhāva pratītanām anupalabdhi liṅgaka tvāt tava nīrūpaḥ vāyuḥ iti vāyu viśeṣya abhāva pratīti vat

atha bhū tale abhāva dhīḥ indriya janyā sākṣātkāri tvāt tatas eva viśeṣaṇa tā kalpanam api na ca sākṣātkāri tvam asiddham parokṣa tve ajñāta karaṇaka tva anupapatteḥ tathā hi mandira udare caitraḥ nipuṇam anusṛtaḥ api na ca upalabdhaḥ iti āpta vākya avagata anupalabdhyā śrotā anum inoti na āsīt tatra caitraḥ iti evam abhāvadhīḥ parokṣā ced tadā na ajñāta karaṇikā parokṣatva ajāteḥ jñāta karaṇa prayojya tvāt jñāta karaṇa tvam ca jñāna karaṇa tvam liṅga ādeḥ ajanaka tvāt tasmāt sākṣātkāri tvam ajñāta karaṇa tvāt na ca indriya janya tvam upādhiḥ tatas eva tad sādhanāt iti ced

mā evam parokṣa tvam hi na jātiḥ anubhava tvena saṃkara prasaṅgāt kim tu sākṣātkāri bhinna jñāna tvam evam ca abhāva jñānam parokṣam eva smṛti vat yathā ca jñāta karaṇa tve api śābda ādiḥ na anumitiḥ evam ajñāta karaṇa tve api indriya janyam sākṣātkārī anupalabdhi janyam tat vijātīyam anupalabdham yadi ca ajñāta karaṇa tvena sākṣātkāri tvam tadā jñāta karaṇa tvena śābda ādeḥ anumiti tva āpattiḥ jñāta karaṇa tve api liṅga ādi karaṇa bhedāt anumiti ādi phala bhedaḥ iti ced ajñāta anupalabdhi indriya karaṇa bhedāt phala bhedaḥ iha api evam ca sākṣātkāri tve indriya janya tvam parokṣa tve ca tad ajanya tvam prayojakam na tu jñāta ajñāta karaṇa janya tvam gauravāt smṛtau abhāvāt ca

nanu anupalabdhiḥ na mānam bhāva bhūta māna saha kṛtasya eva manasaḥ bāhya anubhava janaka tvāt iti ced na bhāva tvasya guru tvena aprayojaka tvāt anyathā indriya saha kṛtasya eva manasaḥ bāhya anubhava janaka tvām iti anumāna ādi na mānam syāt na ca idam abhāva jñānam bhāva māna saha kṛta mana ssādhyam bāhya abhāva jñāna tvāt liṅga ādi janya abhāva jñāna vat iti vācyam ayam abhāvaḥ na indriya grāhyaḥ abhāva tvāt ayogya abhāva vat iyam abhāva buddhiḥ na indriya janyāḥ abhāva buddhi tvāt liṅga ādi janya abhāva buddhi vat iti sat pratipakṣāt

atha pratiyogi grāhakam mānam tad abhāvam api gṛhṇāti yathā anumāna ādi pratiyogi grāhakam ca indriyam atas abhāva grāhakam iti ced na bhāva grāhakayoḥ eva liṅga śabdayoḥ tad abhāva āgrāhaka tvāt pratiyogi grāhaka jātīyam mānam tathā iti ced na upamāne vyabhicārāt na ca cakṣuṣṭvā ādi kama bhāva grāhaka vṛtti jāti tvāt upamāna tvam ca na jātiḥ iti vācyam prāptim vinā cakṣuḥ ādeḥ abhāva grāhaka tva sādhanāt

atha bhāva vṛtti abhāva bhramaḥ sa ca karaṇa doṣāt na ca pratiyogi smṛti āśraya grahānupalabdhayaḥ svarūpataḥ duṣṭāḥ kim tu indriyam pitta ādinā duṣṭam iti tat eva ca bhrama hetuḥ iti abhāva pramāyām api tat eva mānam iti ced na indriyasya api duṣṭa tvam doṣa sāhitya mātram na tu anyat tat ca anupalabdhau api tulyam na ca jñāta karaṇa ajanya bhrama tvena indriya janya tvam evam hi abhāva pramākaraṇa tvam api indriyasya tatas eva astu kim anayā kusṛṣṭyā evam astu iti ced na prāpti abhāvena ukta uttara tvāt kim ca asaṃnikṛṣṭe api doṣāt upanīte abhāve bhramaḥ indriyeṇa saṃbhavati cakṣuṣā pāṣāṇaḥ surabhiḥ iti bhrama vat abhāva pramā na saṃbhavati prāpti abhāvāt iti uktam

nanu adhikaraṇa abhāvayoḥ viśiṣṭa buddhiḥ asti sā na indriya janyāḥ abhāva buddhi tvāt na anupalabdhi janyāḥ bhāva buddhi tvāt na ubhaya janyāḥ jāti saṃkara prasaṅgāt atas ubhaya grāhakam indriyam abhyupeyam iti ced abhāvavat bhū talam iti anupalabdhi upanīta abhāva viśiṣṭa buddhiḥ indriyeṇa eva cakṣuṣā candanam surabhīti vat bhū tale ghaṭaḥ na asti iti ca cakṣuḥ upanīta bhūtale abhāva buddhiḥ anupalabdhyā eva ghrāṇena candane saurabham iti vat

yat tu vyāpāra abhāva at na anupalabdhiḥ pramāṇam vyāpāravataḥ eva karaṇa tvāt iti tat na kriyayā ayoga vyavacchedena saṃbandhi karaṇam na tu vyāpāra vat iti api viśeṣaṇam gaura vat iti atra ucyate pratiyogi grāhaka indriyeṇa āśraya grahaḥ na hetuḥ prāk na astita agrahe tu vyabhicārāt vāyu ādau ca rūpa ādi abhāva dhīḥ indriya janyā eva na anupalabdhi liṅga janyā anupalabdheḥ ajñānāt āpta vākyasya iva tad jñāpakasya abhāvāt

atha ajñātā eva rūpa ādi upalambhasya anupalabdhiḥ rūpa ādi anupalabdhim gṛhṇāti bhū tale ghaṭa abhāvam iva iti ced tvad mate upalambhasya atīndriya tvena yogyā anupalabdhyā upalambha abhāvasya grahītum aśakyatvāt anupalabdhi mātrasya abhāva āgrāhaka tvāt astu tarhi jñānam yogyam iti ced na apasiddhāntāt yogya tve api bhū talīya ghaṭa abhāve api jñātā eva yogyā anupalabdhiḥ liṅgam astu yogya ghaṭa upalambhasya anupalabdhyā graha saṃbhavāt kṛtam anupalabdhyā māna antareṇa

ghaṭa abhāva dhīra jñāta karaṇikā liṅga ādi anusaṃndhānam vinā jāyamāna tvāt iti ced na vāyu ādau rūpa ādi abhāva pratītiḥ api tathā atha rūpa ādi mattayā jñāta tva abhāvaḥ tad anumita rūpa vattā anupalabdhiḥ vā liṅgam iti ced na vāyu ādau jñāta tva abhāvasya api rūpa ādi abhāva tulya tayā grahītum aśakyatvāt vāyu ādau tasya pratyakṣa tve rūpa ādi abhāvaḥ api tathā astu na api kāya vāc vyavahāra abhāvena anupalabdhiḥ anamīyate upekṣā jñāna mūka svapnayoḥ darśanena vyabhicārāt na ca vyavahāra abhāva mātram liṅgam kasyacid vyavahāra abhāvasya vyabhicārāt sarva vyavahāra abhāvasya grahītum aśakyatvāt

kim ca ghaṭavat tayā jñāta tva abhāvena tad anumita anupalabdhyā vā liṅgena bhū tala ādau abhāva anumitiḥ astu kim māna antareṇa anupalabdhyā api ca pratiyogi grāhaka indriya janyam adhikaraṇa jñānam anupalabdhi sahakāri tadā syāt yadi tena vinā sā na abhāvam bodhayet na ca etat dṛṣṭam vāyu ādau rūpa ādi abhāve tathā dṛṣṭam iti ced na asiddheḥ na ca vyāpti balāt sahakāri tvam evam hi vāyu ādau rūpa ādi abhāva pratyayaḥ anupalabdheḥ bhavan tādṛśa āśrayam ākṣipet anākṣepe vai anupalabdheḥ nabhavet tatas na bhavati kim tu liṅgāt iti ced liṅgam api sā eva tat ca dūṣitam eva

kim ca na anupalabdhiḥ liṅgam tatas hi nīrūpaḥ vāyuḥ iti anumitiḥ syāt na tu vāyau rūpa abhāvaḥ iti api ca ghaṭavatī upalambha prāk kāle anupalabdhyā ghaṭa smṛtimataḥ kutas nābhauva dhīḥ ghaṭa abhāva abhāvāt iti ced tarhi abhāva rūpa artha janyā bhāva buddhiḥ artha janya tvena sākṣātkāriṇī indriya janyā ca syāt tadā ghaṭaḥ eva pratibandhakaḥ iti ced tathā api tad abhāvaḥ abhāva buddhau janakaḥ eva syāt

syāt etat gṛham upalabhya nirgataḥ caitraḥ yatra kenacid pṛṣṭaḥ tatra maitraḥ āsīt iti sa ca kṣaṇam dhyātvā anupalabdhyā tatra maitra abhāvam avagamya āha na āsīt tatra maitraḥ iti sā iyam prāṅna āstitādhīḥ na smṛtiḥ purā gehe anubhūyamāne maitra asmaraṇena tad abhāvān anubhavāt evam ca tatra eva indriya vyāpāram vinā eva anupalabdhyā abhāva anubhavāt anyatra api sā eva hetuḥ kḷpta tvāt tat āhuḥ sva rūpa mātram dṛṣṭam hi veśma ādi artham smaran atha tatra anyena astitām pṛṣṭaḥ tadā eva pratipadyate iti

mā evam prāṅānāstitāyām hi na tāvat ajñāta anupalabdhiḥ bhū tale ghaṭa abhāvasya iva abhāva grāhikā tadānīm gehasya viprakṛṣṭa tvena yogyā anupalabdheḥ abhāvāt na api jñātā anavasthā prasaṅgāt anupalabdheḥ api abhāva rūpa tayā anupalabdhi antareṇa grāhya tvāt upalambhasya anupalabdhiḥ ajñātā eva svarūpa satī maitra anupalabdhim gṛhṇāti ced tu ad naye upalambhasya atīndriya tvena tad abhāvasya yogyā anupalabdhi agrāhya tvāt atha gehasya yogya maitravat tayā smaraṇa arhasya smaraṇa abhāvaḥ tatra ajñātaḥ eva gehe maitra abhāva grāhakaḥ iti ced na svarūpa satas smaraṇa abhāvasya grāhaka tve tasmin satyabhāva saṃśaya viparyaya abhāva prasaṅgāt bhavati ca kadācid tatra āsīt iti viparyayaḥ tatra āsīt na vā iti saṃśayaḥ ca

atha doṣāt saṃśaya viparyayau na ca asādhāraṇam pramākaraṇam dūṣayantaḥ eva doṣāḥ saṃśaya ādi hetavaḥ bhavanti na ca atra svarasa siddhasya yogyā smaraṇasya kiṃcid dūṣitam iti vācyam doṣa sāhityam eva hi karaṇānām duṣṭa tā na hi dūra tva ādinā cakṣuṣaḥ kiṃcid apakriyate kim tu maṇyādeḥ dāhaḥ iva svarūpa satām eva pratibandhaka tvam iti ced na ajñātāt yogyā smaraṇāt tatra abhāva dhīritya siddheḥ kim tu manasā jñātāt yogya asmaraṇāt liṅgāt pramāṇa tvena kḷptāt tatra abhāva prati iti upapattau na anupalabdhiḥ pramāṇa antaram kalpyate

yogya smaraṇa abhāvaḥ na manaḥ grāhyaḥ pratyāsatti abhāvāt jñānasya ayogya tvāt vā iti ced na vāyu ādau rūpa ādi abhāva pratīteḥ alaiṅgika tvena indriya anuvidhānena tad janya tve siddhe indriya saṃbaddha viśeṣaṇa tāyāḥ pratyāsatti tva kalpanāt tat jñānam pratyakṣam jānāmi iti anubhavasya liṅga ādi ajanya tvāt na ca jñāta tā liṅgam nirākṛta tvāt tava api katham abhāve saṃśaya viparyayau iti ced na liṅga saṃśaya viparyayābhyām laiṅgika saṃśaya viparyaya darśanāt

yadā tu su nipuṇena eka jñāna viṣaya tā yogyasya maitrasya anubhave sati smaraṇa arhasya asmaraṇam avadhāryate tadā anumitiḥ pramā atas eva asmaraṇa mātrasya vyabhicāram upalabhya tat upekṣya viśiṣṭa asmaraṇam jñātu kāmasya praṇidhānam upayujyate anyathā dhyānam anupapannam svarūpa satas eva asmaraṇasya abhāva grāhaka tvāt tasmāt yogyā smaraṇam liṅga tvena eva upayujyate prayogaḥ tu tad geham tadā maitra abhāva vat tad tulya parimāṇa ādi yogi tayā smaraṇe api tadvat tayā asmaryamāṇa tvāt yat evam tat evam yathā ghaṭa abhāvavat bhū talam iti

atha abhāvaḥ bhāva ātmā eva tatas tatra saṃyoga ādiḥ eva grāhakaḥ iti na tatra viśeṣaṇa tā pratyāsattiḥ tatra prāñcaḥ asti tāvat iha bhū tale ghaṭaḥ na asti iti abādhitā buddhiḥ sā ca iyam na bhū tala ālambanā ghaṭavatī api prasaṅgāt na api kevala tad ālambanā atirikta kaivalya anabhyupagamāt bhū talam eva kaivalyam iti ced tarhi paunaruktyam adhikam abhede ādhāra ādheya bhāva anupapattiḥ ca

atha adhika abhāva vādinā api abhāvaḥ sa āśrayaḥ vācyaḥ deśa ādi niyamena vyavahārāt tathā ca asti bhū tale viśeṣaḥ yaḥ abhāva āśrayaḥ sa na bhū tala mātram ghaṭavatī api prasaṅgāt na abhauva yuktam anyonya āśrayāt na ca ghaṭa vat virodhāt iti ced na viśeṣasya eva abhāva āśraya tvāt sa ca ananugataḥ eva eka āśrayatā tu ananugatasya api ghaṭa āśrayatā iva bhavati

kim ca kutra abhāvaḥ iti yatra pratīyeta iti eva uttaram kva pratīyeta iti atra yatra asti iti eva anyathā go tva ādikam api na svīkriyeta tad āśraya viśeṣāt eva vyavahāra saṃbhavāt tathā api kīdṛśi bhū tale abhāvaḥ iti ced abhāva pūrva samaye kīdṛśam bhū talam iti praśne ghaṭa vat iti uttaram abhāva samaye abhāva vat iti madhya samayaḥ tu na asti eva iha bhū tale ghaṭaḥ na asti iti ādhāra ādheya bhāva pratīteḥ ca abhāva ādhāra tvam bhū talasya na pratīyate kiṃtu tanmātra buddhi viṣaya tvam iti ced aho vyākhyā kauśalam anubhavaḥ api vyākhyāya kathyate tanmātra padārtha anirvacanam ca na hi bhū tala baddhiḥ tanmātra buddhiḥ ghaṭa vat bhū tala buddheḥ api bhū tala buddhi tvāt sā buddhiḥ na bhū talasya kiṃtu ghaṭa bhū talayoḥ agnīṣomayoḥ iva devatā tvam iti ced na tatas bhū tala avi avahāra prasaṅgāt bhū talasya aviṣaya tvāt āśubhā vibhū tala viṣaya ka jñāna antarāt iti ced tarhi sā eva bhū tala buddhiḥ tanmātra budviḥ iti tad deśe ghaṭa abhāvasya vyavahāra prasaṅgaḥ

etena bhū tala indriya saṃnikarṣa jaghaṭa vat bhū tala indriya saṃnikarṣa ja jñānayoḥ viśeṣaḥ aṅgīkaraṇīyaḥ sāmagrī bhedasya kārya bheda niyata tvāt tathā ca saḥ eva tanmātra padārthaḥ iti nirastam tatas api bhū tala vyavahārāt pratiyogi tad vyāpya itara janitā bhū tala buddhiḥ abhāvaḥ iti ced na ghaṭavati tad janitāyāḥ api itara janita tvāt tanmātra janitā sā iti ced na mātrā arthasya abhāva tvāt tasya ca aparijñānāt ghaṭāviṣayā satī bhū tala viṣaya iti ced na ukta uttara tvāt

kiṃca pratiyogi nirūpaṇa adhīna nirūpaṇaḥ abhāvaḥ buddhiḥ tu na tathā pratiyogi prakāśam vinā api buddhi nirūpaṇāt vyavahāra artham dṛśya pratiyogi jñāna apekṣāḥ abhāvaḥ jñātaḥ eva iti ced na vyavahārasya vyavahartavya upalambha nibandhana tvena tathā adṛṣṭa cara tvāt yadi ca pratiyogi smaraṇa sāpekṣā tanmātra dhīra bhāva padārthaḥ tadā andhakāra ādau yā tanmātra dhīḥ sā abhāvaḥ na syāt tathā ca tatra vicaran kaṇṭakaiḥ vidhyeta kaṇṭaka smaraṇam vinā kaṇṭaka abhāva abhāvāt nirjane bandha vicchede api jala nissaraṇam na syāt tadānīm tanmātra buddheḥ sarvathā abhāvāt

kim ca tanmātra dhī nāśe ghaṭa unmajjana prasaṅgaḥ ghaṭa abhāva abhāvasya ghaṭa tvāt yadi ca abhāvaḥ na atiriktaḥ tadā yatra ghaṭa saṃsṛṣṭa tva buddhiḥ āsīt kutas tatra tanmātra dhīḥ mudgara pāta janyā atirikta viṣaya anaṅgīkārāt atirikta abhāve kim mānam iti ced na asti iti buddhiḥ eva nanu abhāva vyavahāra anupapattiḥ anyonya āśrayāt iti atra prābhākarāḥ ghaṭa vat bhū tala buddhi bhinnā bhū tala buddhiḥ abhāva vyavahāra kāraṇam na ca doṣāt ghaṭavati ghaṭavat tva ajñāne bhū tala jñānam abhāvaḥ syāt iti vācyam ghaṭavataḥ bhū talasya jñānāt bhinnasya bhū tala jñānasya abhāva tvāt tad bhramāt ca abhāva bhramaḥ

vastutas atyanta abhāve pratiyogim ad adhikaraṇa jñānasya aprasiddheḥ pratiyogi mat jñāna bhinnam adhikaraṇa jñānam vyadhikaraṇa abhāva vyavahāre kāraṇam samāna adhikaraṇa niṣedha pratītiḥ ca pratiyogi adhikaraṇayoḥ svarūpa bhedam ālambate tena ghaṭavat tvena jñāyamāne api bhū tale bhū talam ghaṭaḥ na iti pratītiḥ tathā ca yasya abhāva jñāna kāraṇa tvam pareṣām tat eva abhāva vyavahṛti kāraṇam astu na hi adhikaraṇa buddhim vinā tad buddhiḥ na ca bhū tala buddhiḥ tathā ghaṭavatī api prasaṅgāt na ca abhāva adhikaraṇa bhū tala viṣaya tvāt buddheḥ viśeṣaḥ pratiyogi sattve api prāk nā āsīt idam atra iti pratīteḥ

kim ca jñāna viṣaya bhū talasya abhāvaḥ yadi viśeṣaṇam tadā abhāva jñānam eva tat jñāna kāraṇam upalakṣaṇam ced na kaścid viśeṣaḥ pratiyegi mattayā anupalabdhiḥ api kāraṇam iti ced na pratiyogi mattayā upalambhe api prāk nā āsīt idam atra iti pratīteḥ buddhyoḥ ca viśeṣaḥ sva rūpa viśeṣau eva na anyonya abhāvaḥ anavasthānāt ātma āśrayāt vā bhū tala jñāna apekṣayā ghaṭa vat bhū tala jñāna tvam eva vā vaidharmya bhedaḥ na ca atirikta abhāva pakṣe api anyonya abhāve atyanta abhāve ca nitye mānam asti pratiyogini buddhi sthe adhikaraṇa svarūpasya eva anati prasañjaka tvāt na hi tatra adhikaraṇasya pratiyogi tādātmyam pratiyogimat tvam vā saṃbhavati atas eva abhāve abhāva antaram tvayā na svīkriyate adhikaraṇasya tad vairūpya abhāvāt

nanu arthena eva viśeṣaḥ buddheḥ na ca artha bhedaḥ asti mā evam na hi tāvat arthaḥ jñāna kāraṇam avaśyam kim tu sāmagrī viśeṣāt buddhi viśeṣaḥ jāyate dhārāvāhika buddhi vat yat vā ghaṭa vat bhū tala bhinnam bhū talam abhāvaḥ yatra pareṣām abhāvaḥ bhedaḥ ca svarūpam eva tādātmyena apratītau pratītiḥ iti tava api svarūpa bheda lakṣaṇam idānīm idam bhū talam ghaṭa vat bhū talam na bhavati iti pratīteḥ etāvān tu viśeṣaḥ yat tava samāna adhikaraṇa niṣedha pratītiḥ iyam anyonya abhāva bhedam avagāhate mama tu svarūpam

nanu yat eva bhū talam ghaṭa vat bhū talā bhinnam āsīt tat eva katham tat bhinnam iti ced na tava api abādhita samāna adhikaraṇa niṣedha pratīti balena anyonya abhāva siddhau tathā tvasya durvāra tvāt samaya bhedena eva bheda abhedau na virudhyete iti tu samam yadi ca ghaṭa vat bhū talā bhinnam tat idānīm syāt tadā ghaṭa vat bhū tala vyavahāraḥ tatra syāt ghaṭa tad abhāva avacchedaka bhedena anyonya abhāva tad abhāvau bhū tale vartete iti ced mama api bhū tala ghaṭa vat bhū tala buddhi avacchedena svarūpa bheda tad abhāvau vartete iti gṛhāṇa

nanu bhū tale ghaṭaḥ asti na vā iti saṃśayaḥ ghaṭaḥ na asti iti viparyayaḥ vā katham bhavet pratiyogini buddhi sthe adhikaraṇasya tat jñānasya ca abhāvasya upalambhāt iti ced na bhū tale tad jñāne vā ghaṭa vat bhinna tvasya ghaṭa vat bhū tala jñāna bhinna tvasya ca doṣa vaśena aniścayāt bhū tala tajjñāna svarūpāṇām ananugamāt katham anugata vyavahāraḥ iti ced na abhāve api tulya tvāt na hi abhāva tvam sāmānyam abhāva tva gata anyonya abhāva avyāpaka tvāt

na ca bhāva virodhi tvam virodhasya abhāva nirūpya tvāt bhāva abhāvayoḥ saha avasthāna abhāvasya svarūpa anatiḥ ekāt ca na api bhāva pratiyogi tvam pratiyogi tvasya abhāva viraha rūpa tvāt abhāva abhāva asya bhāvasya bhāva apratiyogika tvāt ca na api sa pratiyogika tvam samavāya sādṛśi a ādīnām api tathātvāt na api parakīya svabhāva tvam jñāna ādi gata tvāt svabhāva śabdasya svarūpa arthe ananugamāt ca na api sattā śūnya tvam sattāyām eva gata tvāt śūnya tvasya abhāva rūpa tvāt ca sattā atyanta abhāvavat tvam abhāva tvam atyanta abhāvaḥ ca abhāva tvānavagatau api avagataḥ iti ced na abhāve abhāva anabhyupagamāt tathā ātve api tatra eva tad abhyupagamāt

sattā bodha vidhura tvam abhāva tvam sāmānya ādau satta avagame api bādhāt sā tyajyate abhāvasya tad viruddha tayā eva pratiteḥ iti ced na virodhi tvasya sva rūpa anatiḥ ekāt saha anavasthāna niyamaḥ virodhaḥ iti ced na anavasthānasya avasthāna abhāva tvena ātma āśrayāt bhāva bhinna tvam iti ced na bhedasya svarūpa anyonya abhāva rūpa tve ukta doṣāt vaidharmyasya cintyamāna tvāt prāgabhāva tva ādeḥ abhāva nirūpya tvāt evam ced abhāve api na anugamaḥ tadā kim adhikena sva rūpa viśeṣāt eva ghaṭa vyavahāraḥ api astu iti ced na bhū tala vilakṣaṇa ghaṭa anubhavāt ekaḥ eva abhāvaḥ anugataḥ iti ced na tasya nitya tvena pratiyogi kāle api abhāva vyavahāra prasaṅgāt prāc abhāva ādi vyutpādana virodhāt ca yat vā abhāva vādinā api abhāva jñāna kāraṇam anugataḥ bhū tala buddhi viśeṣaḥ svīkāryaḥ tad varam saḥ eva astu prameyam pramāṇam ca sva prakāśa tvāt buddhīnām

nanu tanmātra buddheḥ abhāva tve tasyāḥ sva prakāśa tvena pratiyogi jñāna apekṣā na syāt iti ced na na grahaṇāya tad apekṣā kim tu vyavahārāya jñānasya satyām icchāyām vyavahāra artham adhika apekṣā iti ced na dṛṣṭā hi vyavahāra artham adhika apekṣāḥ yathā parimāṇasya dīrgha tva vyavahāre tathā hi adhika saṃkhyā avacchinna hasta vitasti ādi avacchedaḥ parimāṇasya dīrgha tvam tad viparītam tu hrasva tvam tādṛśa parimāṇam ca avayavi graha sama kālam eva anubhūtam dīrgha tva vyapadeśaḥ tu alpa saṃkhyā ādi avacchinna hasta ādi avacchedya parimāṇa jñānam apekṣate tanmātra buddheḥ abhāva tve dṛśya pratiyogi jñāna apekṣa tayā dṛśyatā saṃpatti artham keśa kīṭa ādi sūkṣma jijñāsā api arthavatī na ca tanmātra buddheḥ abhāva tve tad vināśe abhāva abhāve bhāva unmajjana prasaṅgaḥ iti mokṣe puruṣa antarasya niyame pramāṇam na asti iti ced na kāryāt kāraṇa kalpanāt na ca evam buddhi nāśe punar saṃsāritā buddhi dhārā sattvāt na ca sarva muktiḥ pramāṇa abhāvāt pratiyogimad adhikaraṇa bhinna adhikaraṇa svarūpasya abhāva tve sarvam samañjasam eva iti pūrva pakṣaḥ

siddhāntaḥ tu sa pratiyogikaḥ abhāvaḥ anubhūyate ghaṭaḥ na paṭaḥ na iti anubhavāt na tu tanmātram atas abhāva vitti vedya tvam pratiyoginaḥ pratiyogi jñāna adhīna jñāna tvam ca abhāvasya anubhava sākṣikam gosādṛśya vat na ca kevalam adhikaraṇam tat jñānam vā abhāvaḥ pratiyogi jñānam vinā api tad vitteḥ tad vittau pratiyoginaḥ aviṣaya tvāt ca sa pratiyogika tva abhāve ca kasya pratiyogī ghaṭaḥ

atha kevalam adhikaraṇam tat jñānam vā abhāvaḥ sa ca apratiyogikaḥ eva abhāva vyavahāraḥ tu pratiyogi jñānam apekṣate iti tasya pratiyāgī ghaṭaḥ ghaṭa tadabhāva vyavahārayoḥ virodhāt iti ced na iha ghaṭaḥ na iti nañarthasya pratiyogī ghaṭaḥ anubhūyate na tu abhāva jñāna anantara bhāvinaḥ abhāva vyavahārasya tasya abhāva anubhava samaye apratīteḥ vyavahriyate asau na tu anubhūyate iti ced na tādṛśa anubhavam vinā tathā vyavahāra abhāvāt vyavahāre pratiyogi jñāna apekṣā iti api na yuktam vyavahartavyajñānasya satyām icchāyām vyavahāre adhika apekṣāyāḥ adṛṣṭa cara tvāt lāghavāt iha tathā kalpyate na tu abhāvaḥ iti ced na vyavahāra mātre tathā kāraṇa tva anavadhāraṇāt vyavahāra viśeṣasya ananugata tvāt

hrasva tva dīrgha tve ca parimāṇa antare eva tava api adhika saṃkhyā avacchinna hasta ādi avacchedya tvam parimāṇasya hrasva tvam dīrgha tvam ca alpa adhikau adhi jñāna adhīna jñānam atas dravya sama kālam parimāṇa anubhave api na anubhūtam iti na tadā tad vyavahāraḥ go sādṛśyam yadi api gavaya gatāni sāmānyāni tad jñāna sama kālam eva anubhūtāni tathā api go vṛtti tve sati gavaya vṛtti tvam go sādṛśyam go jñāna adhīna jñānam iti na tadā sādṛśya vyavahāraḥ

syāt etat asti tāvat kasyacid jñānāt kvacid abhāva pada prayogaḥ sarva siddhaḥ tatra prayoga ālambanam bhū tala ādi eva ghaṭa vat atiriktā prakāśāt tatas ca yat apekṣam yasya abhāva pada prayoga viṣaya tvam tat tasya abhāvaḥ iti upeyate tad buddhi janita abhāva pada prayoga viṣaya tvam eva ghaṭa bhū talayoḥ pratiyogi anuyogi rūpaḥ sa bandhaḥ atas eva bhū talasya sa pratiyogika tvam tad buddhi janita abhāva pada prayoga viṣaya tvena tad buddhim vinā abhāva pada prayoga aviṣaya tvāt anena eva upādhinā ghaṭa abhāva ādi pada vyutpatti grahaḥ iti ced tat na abhāva pada prayoga ālambanam na bhū talam na hi bhū talam ghaṭa abhāvaḥ iti pratīti prayogau api tu bhū tale ghaṭa abhāvaḥ iti bhū tale ghaṭaḥ iti vat bhū tale ghaṭaḥ na asti iti bhū tala adhikaraṇa atirikta nañartha prakāśāt

api ca ghaṭa buddhi janita abhāva pada prayoga viṣaya tvam bhū talasya ghaṭa abhāva tvam tathā ca ghaṭa abhāva tve tasya avagate ghaṭa abhāva pada prayoga viṣaya tvam ghaṭa abhāva pada prayoga viṣaya tve ca jñāte tasya ghaṭa abhāva tvam iti anyonya āśrayaḥ pada pravṛtti nimitte avagate pada prayoga niyamāt ghaṭa abhāva tvam ca ghaṭa abhāva pade pravṛtti nimittam yadi ca bhū talam sa pratiyogikam tadā pratiyoginam vinā kevalam na bhāseta sādṛśya ādi vat ghaṭa abhāva pada prayoga daśāyām tat sa pratiyogikam na anyadā iti ced tarhi ghaṭa pratiyogika tve tasya ghaṭa buddhi janita abhāva pada prayoga viṣaya tvam sati ca tasmin ghaṭa pratiyogika tvam iti anyonya āśrayaḥ kevalasya apratiyogika tvāt evam ca go buddhi janita sadṛśa pada prayoga viṣaya tvam gavayasya go sādṛśyam astu kṛtam atirikta sādṛśyena iti sa pratiyogika padārtha apalāpaḥ

api ca na kevalam bhū talam abhāvaḥ bhū tala abhāvayoḥ ādhāra ādheya bhāva anubhavāt abhede tad anupapatteḥ duḥkha vat ātma bhinnasya ca ātmanaḥ duḥkha abhāva tve mokṣasya apuruṣa artha tva prasaṅgaḥ ātmanaḥ asādhya tvāt atha ghaṭa vat bhū tala jñāna bhinnam bhū tala jñānam abhāvaḥ tasya ca bhū tala ādhāra tā svarūpa saṃbandhena anubhūyate iti ced na tasya niṣpratiyogika tvena abhāva tva anupapatteḥ iti ukta tvāt

api ca tat jñānam kim sva rūpa sadeva abhāva vyavahāra kāraṇam bhū talādhikaraṇaka niṣedha rūpa tayā anubhūyānam vā na ādyaḥ svarūpa sataḥ bhū tala ādheya tayā prati iti anupapatteḥ na dvitīyaḥ ghaṭa vat bhū tala jñānasya tadānīm anupasthiteḥ tad bhinna jñānasya pratyetum aśakyatvāt kim ca yadi ghaṭa vat bhū tala jñānāt bhinna bhū tala jñānam abhāvaḥ tadā ghaṭavati doṣāt ghaṭavat tva ajñāne bhū tala jñānam abhāvaḥ bhavet tathā ca tat eva tadā eva ghaṭa vat ghaṭa abhāva vat ca syāt na syātām ca ghaṭa abhāva jñāna tad vyavahārau visaṃvādinau viṣaya ābādhāt

atha vastutas ghaṭavataḥ bhū talasya jñānāt bhinnam bhū tala jñānam abhāvaḥ na ca ghaṭavati bhū tala jñānam tathā vyavahāraḥ tu visaṃvādī tathāvidha bhrama adarśanāt iti ced tarhi ghaṭavataḥ bhū talasya jñānāt bhinna tvena jñānam bhū tala jñānam abhāva vyavahṛti hetuḥ na ca tad saṃbhavati sva prakāśena anuvyavasāyena vā adhikaraṇa jñāne tad aprakāśāt bheda pratiyoginaḥ anupasthiteḥ na ca jñāna antareṇa tathā anubhavaḥ yogyā anupalabdhyā tatra ghaṭa abhāva niścayam vinā tathā niścetum aśakyatvāt

api ca adhikaraṇa tad jñānānām ananugata tvena anugata abhāva vyavahāra anupapattiḥ na ca atirikta abhāva pakṣe api tathā abhāva tvasya anugatasya abhāvāt iti vācyam anugata abhāva tvam vinā api ghaṭa ādiḥ na paṭaḥ iti samāna adhikaraṇa niṣedhāt anugata vyavahāraḥ paṭānyonya abhāvena ekena evam ghaṭa ādau na go tvam iti anugata vyavahāraḥ ekena atyanta abhāvena kapāleṣu bhū taleṣu idānīm ghaṭaḥ vinaṣṭaḥ iti anugata vyavahāraḥ dhvaṃsena ekena ghaṭa anutpāda daśāyām eteṣu ghaṭaḥ na asti iti anugata vyavahāraḥ ekena prāc abhāvena evam catvāraḥ anugata niṣedha vyavahārāḥ catasṛbhiḥ eva vyaktibhiḥ kriyante tava tu abhāva catuṣṭayam tad tad adhikaraṇa tad tad buddhīnām ananugata tvāt na saṃbhavati anugata abhāva catuṣṭaya vyavahārasya pratyeka abhāvena upapādayitum aśakya tvāt iti atiriktā bhāva vyakti catuṣṭaya siddhiḥ tasya ca yathā abhāva tvena ekena eka padārtha tvam tathā anupadam eva vakṣyāmaḥ

syāt etat yasmin samaya viśeṣe yatra bhū tale abhāvaḥ paraiḥ svīkriyate tad samaya viśeṣa yogaḥ eva bhū talasya ghaṭa abhāvaḥ evam ca iha bhū tale ghaṭaḥ na asti iti ādhāra ādheya bhāva pratītiḥ api upapadyate samaya viśeṣa yogasya bhū tala vṛtti tvāt na ca samaya viśeṣa yogasya abhāva tve ananugamaḥ doṣaḥ atirikta abhāva pakṣe api tulya tvāt abhāva tvasya jāteḥ upādheḥ vā asattvāt yadi ca abhāva pratīti prayoga anugama artham tatra dharma antaram svīkriyate tadā samaya viśeṣa yoga vṛttyā iva tat astu lāghavāt iti tat na samaya viśeṣa yogasya niṣpratiyogika tvena abhāva vyavahāra asāmarthyāt kim ca bhū tala vat samaya viśeṣaḥ api abhauva ādhāratayā anubhūyate idānīm bhū tale ghaṭaḥ na asti iti pratīteḥ na ca tad samaya viśeṣe tad samaya viśeṣa yogaḥ abhede saṃbandha anupapattau ādhāra ādheya bhāva abhāvāt

api ca samaye kim abhāva āśraya tā eva viśeṣaḥ tad tad samaya svarūpam vā ādye abhāva svīkāraḥ dvitīye ananugamaḥ mama tu eka abhāva vyakteḥ eva tathā nānā samaya vṛtti tvāt kim ca samaya viśeṣa yogāt idānīm bhū talam iti pratīti prayogau syātām viśeṣaṇasya sva prakāraka viśiṣṭa pratyaya janaka tvāt na tu bhū tale ghaṭa abhāvaḥ iti yadi ca tad tad samaya viśeṣa yogāt bhū tale ghaṭa abhāva vyavahāraḥ tadā yādṛśa saṃsthāna viśeṣa viśiṣṭe kapāle ghaṭaḥ vartate tādṛśa kapāla ādikam eva tad tad samaya viśeṣa yogāt ghaṭa ādi vyavahāra janakam aḥ tu kim ghaṭa ādinā pratītiḥ ca tulyā

etena dṛṣṭaḥ tāvat ayam ghaṭaḥ atra ca patan dṛṣṭaḥ tathā mudgaraḥ dṛṣṭā karpara saṃhatiḥ param itaḥ abhāvaḥ na dṛṣṭaḥ aparaḥ tena abhāvaḥ iti śrutiḥ kva nihitā kim ca atra tad kāraṇam svādhīnā kalaśasya kevalam iyam dṛṣṭā kapāla āvalī iti nirastam mudgara pātāt vinaṣṭaḥ ghaṭaḥ iti prati iti atirikta vināśa anubhavāt na ca kevala bhū talam tat buddhiḥ vā tad janyā tena vinā api tayoḥ sattvāt tvad mate ca tayoḥ abhāva mātra tvena vināśa tva ayogāt yoge vā abhāva mātrasya vināśi tvā āpattiḥ

atha tvad mate yat vināśakam tat eva tad sahitam bhū talam jñānam vā vināśaḥ iti ced na mudgara pāta janyaḥ hi vināśaḥ anubhūyate na ca tasya eva tad janaka tvam sa pratiyogikaḥ ca vināśaḥ anubhūyate na ca mudgara pātaḥ tathā nanu abhāvena samam bhū talasya saṃbandha abhāvāt katham bhū tale ghaṭa abhāva pratyayaḥ svarūpa saṃbandhāt iti ced tarhi ghaṭa vat bhū talasya api catvarīya abhāvena svarūpa saṃbandhaḥ asti bhū talam abhāvaḥ ca iti adhikasya svarūpa saṃbandhasya abhāvāt

pratiyogi āropaḥ eva svarūpa saṃbandhaḥ atas eva āropya niṣidhyate iti ucyate iti ced na tatra abhāva saṃbandhe satya āropaḥ saḥ eva ca abhāva saṃbandhaḥ iti anyonya āśrayaḥ iti ced na saṃbandha antaram antareṇa viśiṣṭa pratyaya janana yogya tvasya svarūpa saṃbandha tvāt na ca ghaṭa vat bhū tala catvarīya abhāvayoḥ parasparam viśiṣṭa pratyayaḥ jñāna viṣayayoḥ samavāya sama vāyinoḥ iva saṃbandha antara abhyupagamane ca anavasthā abhiyā tad saṃbandha saṃbandhinoḥ api tādṛśa saṃbandha svīkārāt iti siddhaḥ atiriktaḥ abhāvaḥ iti tad grāhikā viśeṣaṇa tā iti siddham etat

grahaṇāt ṣoḍhā saṃnikarṣaḥ pratyakṣa viśeṣe kāraṇam viṣayeṇa āloka saṃyoga viśeṣaḥ ca tatra kāraṇam na tu cakṣuṣā prakāśa sthena cakṣuṣā andhakāra sthasya agrahaṇāt vaiparītye ca nanu evam para bhāga avacchedena āloka saṃyuktaḥ api ghaṭaḥ gṛhyeta na ca avayavi graha sāmagryāḥ sva avayava graha sāmagrī niyamāt para bhāga avacchinnaḥ na gṛhyate iti vācyam tri aṇuke vyabhicārāt pratyakṣa avayave ca sāmagrī bheda kalpane māna abhāvāt

atha abhimukha avayava avacchedena ghaṭa āloka saṃyogaḥ kāraṇam tarhi abhimukha avayava avacchedena cakṣuḥ āloka saṃyogaḥ api hetuḥ astu yadi ca āloka saṃyoga avacchinne cakṣuḥ saṃyogaḥ tathā samāna deśatā virodhaḥ ca nibiḍayoḥ eva anyathā paṭa mahārajatayoḥ paṭa udakayoḥ ca agraha prasaṅgaḥ tarhi ghaṭa saṃyoga avacchinne cakṣuḥ āloka saṃyogaḥ kāraṇam astu atha cālinī nyāyena āloka saṃyoga saṃnihite cakṣuḥ ghaṭa saṃyogaḥ kāraṇam tadā ghaṭa cakṣussaṃyoga saṃnihite cakṣuḥ āloka saṃyogaḥ hetuḥ aḥ tu iti ced na evam anvaya vyatirekābhyām viṣaya āloka saṃyogasya kāraṇa tve niścite tena eva upapattau na cakṣuḥ āloka saṃyogaḥ kāraṇam kalpyate

anye tu dvayoḥ api āloka saṃyogayoḥ kāraṇa tve viṣaya āloka saṃyogaḥ kāraṇam eva iti nanu abhimukha avayava avacchedena viṣaya āloka saṃyogayoḥ kāraṇa tve āvaśyaka saṃyogaḥ eva hetuḥ astu iti ced na avayava saṃyoga mātrasya ati prasakteḥ sva avayava saṃyogaḥ vaktavyaḥ tathā ca sva saṃyogaḥ eva lāghavāt avayava saṃyogena ca anyathā siddhau kāraṇa tā eva na syāt saṃyogasya iti uktam ālokasya udbhūta rūpam api vyañjakam anvaya vyatireki tvāt na tu tejaḥ kāraṇa tā avacchedekam tat ūṣma ādīnām cākṣuṣa tva abhāvāt na ca svātantryeṇa anvaya vyatireki tvāt dvayoḥ api hetu tvam anyathā daṇḍa ādeḥ api cakra avacchedaka tvam syāt iti vācyam udbhūta rūpa tejaḥ mātrayoḥ samavadhāne kārya anudayāt iti ced

mā evam udbhūta rūpasya tejaḥ tvam tejasaḥ ca udbhūta rūpa tvam vā avacchedakam iti vinigamaka abhāvāt ubhayoḥ api hetu tvāt daṇḍa cakrayoḥ iva ekaikam vihāya aparasya anvaya vyatireka abhāvāt evam cakṣuṣaḥ rūpam api vyañjakam vyañjaka tejaḥ rūpa tvāt āloka rūpa vat rūpasya vyañjaka tve udbhūta rūpa tvam tejaḥ gata udbhūta rūpa tvam vā na upādhiḥ vyabhicāreṇa gauraveṇa ca aprayojaka tvāt kim tu vyañjaka rūpam eva tathā lāghavāt viṣaya stham api rūpam udbhūtam sahakāri tad udbhave ca mānam indriya āloka ādi pratyāsannam mahat avayavi vāyu upanīta surabhi śīta ūṣma cakṣuḥ ādikam sākṣātkāra kiṃcid samavadhāna śūnyam apratyakṣa tvāt andhakāra stha ghaṭa vat iti

tat ca kāraṇam lāghavāt anugatam sāmanyam rūpa ādi vṛtti na dravya gatam ūṣmā ādau sparśa grahe rūpasya prabhā ādau rūpa grahe sparśasya graha prasaṅgāt udbhavatvā eka artha samavāya aviśeṣāt anyathā sparśa rūpayoḥ agraha prasaṅgāt na api ubhaya vṛtti rūpa ādi vṛtti tvena eva upapatteḥ rūpa sparśayoḥ tu tat nānā eka grahe api aparasya āgrahāt na ca rūpa tva ādinā para apara bhāva anupapattiḥ tāra tva ādi vat nānā tvāt rūpa ādi pratyakṣe ekaika udbhavasya eva prayojaka tvāt

nanu mahat tvaḥ eva udbhava tvam astu tat eva pratyakṣa tve tantram lāghavāt na rūpe api gauravāt iti ced na āśraya mahat tva udbhava abhāve api gandha sparśayoḥ pratyakṣa tvena udbhava tvam iti pratyakṣa mūrta viśeṣa guṇa tvena rūpe api udbhava tvāt na mahat tve sāmānya guṇa tvāt atha anudbhava tvam eva jātiḥ apratyakṣa tva prayojaka tvena sākṣāt eva tad kalpanāt tad abhāvāt pratyakṣa tvam iti ced na apratyakṣatāyāḥ pratyakṣa kāraṇa viraha prayojya tvena pratyakṣa kāraṇasya lāghavena jāteḥ kalpanāt na tu pratibandhaka tvena anudbhava tvam kalpayitvā tad abhāvaḥ kāraṇam gauravāt iti saṃpradāya vidaḥ

vayam tu brumaḥ śukla tva ādinā kāraṇa rūpa agni saṃyoga prayojyābhyām jātibhyām para apara bhāva anupapattyā rūpa vṛtti udbhava tvam anekam vācyam tathā ca udbhūta tvena kāraṇa tve ananugamaḥ tasmāt anudbhava tvam śukla tva ādi vyāpyam nānā jātiḥ tad abhāvakūṭaḥ tu pratyakṣa tve prayojakaḥ anyathā anugata pratyakṣa anupapatteḥ evam sparśa ādau api

atha vā udbhūta tvam anudbhūta tvam vā na jātiḥ kim tu rūpa tva vyāpya jātimat tvam eva udbhūta tvam tad abhāvaḥ anudbhava tvam pratyakṣe rūpe śuklataratama tva ādi jātimat tvāt ūṣma cakṣuḥ ādi rūpe tu śukla tva mātram eva tad vyāpya jātau māna abhāvāt utkarṣa abhāvāt na ca rūpa tvam eva mānam lāghavena tasya prayojaka tve pratyakṣa tva prasaṅgāt evam sparśa ādau api iti itas api mahat tve na udbhava tvam prayojakam vāyu ādau mahattva utkarṣe api apratyakṣa tvāt

nanu bharjana kapāla gataḥ vahniḥ vāri stha ghaṭa vyañjaka tejaḥ ca gṛhyeta vāri kapālayoḥ pratyakṣa tvena udbhūta rūpavat tvāt tayoḥ saṃyoga viśeṣaḥ eva pratibandhakaḥ iti ced na jalakapāla ādīnām āloka vyaṅgya tayā tad grahe pratibandhaka tva abhāvāt pratibandhaka tve vā bharjana kapāla vāri saṃyogi vahni saurālokayoḥ agraha prasaṅgaḥ saṃyoge ca na viśeṣaḥ jāti kṛtaḥ anyatara karma ja tu ā ādinā saṃkara prasaṅgāt tāra tva vat nānātve gauravāt na api tad saṃyoga bhedaḥ ananugamāt iti

mā evam jala stham tu tejaḥ gṛhyate eva ubhayoḥ svaccha tayā vivicya grahaḥ na bhavati bharjana kapāle ca anudbhūta rūpam udbhūta sparśam anyat eva tejaḥ tādṛśaiḥ avaya vaivahni sahacaritaiḥ ārabhyate ati tapta taila ādau kadācid udbhūta rūpa avayava praveśāt vahni ārambhaḥ api na ca evam dugdha sahacarita dadhi paramāṇubhiḥ eva dadhi ārambhaḥ dugdha dhvaṃsa janya dravya tvena khaṇḍa dugdha vat dadhnaḥ dugdha upādāna upādeya tvāt

nanu evam udbhūta rūpa vahni ādau udbhūta sparśaḥ na asti tad sahacarita tejaḥ antara niyamena tatra ūṣmabuddheḥ upapatteḥ udbhūta rūpa udbhūta sparśa sāmagrya ūrūṣmaṇi prabhā ādau virodha avadhāraṇāt iti ced na yam vahnim adrākṣam tam spṛśāmi iti abādhita pratyabhijñāna vaśāt darśana sparśanābhyām vahnau rūpa sparśayoḥ upalambhāt na ca tejaḥ tvam bādhakam udbhavān udbhavayoḥ nimitta bheda saṃsarga prayojya tvāt tejaḥ tu asya rūpavat vṛtti dravya tva sākṣāt vyāpya jāti tvena udbhūta rūpa sparśa vat vṛtti tvāt na ca udbhūta rūpa sparśayoḥ virodhaḥ

jala pṛthivyoru bhaya sattvāt tejasi virodhasya nimitta bheda upādhika tvāt iti udbhūta rūpa sahacaritayoḥ mahattva aneka dravyavat tvayoḥ yuganaddhavāhi tayā anvaya vyatireka tulya tve api dravya cākṣuṣa tve na aneka dravyavat tvam ubhayam vā tantram kim tu mahat tvam eva lāghavāt aneka dravya utkarṣam vinā api tūlaka ādau pracaya janyā utkṛṣṭa parimāṇāt pratyakṣa utkarṣa darśanāt ca dūra stha keśa rāśau dravya anutpādena mahat tva abhāve api ekakeśasya sajātīya saṃyogena aneka dravyavat tvāt dravya pratyakṣata iti aneka dravyavat tvam tatra tantram iti ced na aneka dravya saṃbandhi tvasya samavāyena prayojaka tvāt na tu saṃyogena atiprasaṅgāt tathā ca dūra grahaṇe sajātīya saṃyogasya aneka dravyavat tve sahakāritā vācyā sā mahat tve eva astu

nanu yadi udbhūta rūpavat tvam mahat tvam ca dravya pratyakṣatāyām sva rūpa yogya tā tadā daṇḍa tva vat tayoḥ kāraṇa tā na syāt iti ced na tat utkarṣāt pratyakṣa utkarṣeṇa tayoḥ kāraṇa tvāt na hi akāraṇa utkarṣam akāryam anuvidhatte daṇḍa tva ādau na evam prakāra bhedena ubhaya rūpa tvāt ca cākṣuṣa dravya jñāne viṣaya tvena tayoḥ kāraṇa tvam dravye anugata tvena kāraṇa tā avacchedaka tvam iti

nanu na udbhūta rūpavat tvam tatra tantram vāyoḥ pratyakṣa tvāt tathā hi vāyuḥ pratyakṣaḥ pratyakṣa sparśa āśraya tvāt mahat tve sati udbhūta sparśavat tvāt vā ghaṭa vat ūṣmā ādau pratyakṣa tvāt na vyabhicāraḥ na ca aprayojakam spārśana pratyakṣa tve mahat tve sati udbhūta sparśavat tvam prayojakam na udbhūta rūpavat tvam api gauravāt na ca pakṣa dharma avacchinna sādhya vyāpakaḥ sādhana avacchinna sādhya vyāpakaḥ ca udbhūta rūpavat tvam upādhiḥ spārśana pratyakṣa tve tasya aprayojaka tvāt tvac indriya vyāpāra anantaram vāyuḥ vātī iti pratīteḥ ca na ca sparśa liṅga agrahe tad upakṣayaḥ ghaṭe api tathā tva āpatteḥ laiṅgika tve ca sparśe vāyu vṛttiḥ iti dhīḥ syāt na tu anuṣṇa aśīta sparśaḥ vāyuḥ iti sparśa agrahe api śītaḥ vāyuḥ iti pratīteḥ ca na ca śīta dravya upanāyaka tvena anumite vāyau tathā dhīḥ bādhaka abhāvāt viśeṣa darśane satya āropa abhāvāt ca

atha ācākṣuṣa tvam spārśana tve bādhakam cakṣuṣā anupalabhyamānasya tvacā anupalambhāt iti ced tarhi cakṣuḥ eva dravya grāhakam tvacā sparśa mātram pratīyeta vāyau iva pratyabhijñā api tadvat eva atha anubhavasya durapahnava tvāt tvacā āśraya rahitaḥ eva sparśaḥ upalabhyate tadā vāyau api tulyam atha doṣa abhāve sati dravya grahe tad gata saṃkhyā ādi graha niyamāt vāyau sarvathā tad agrahāt na sa pratyakṣaḥ iti ced na na ca tāvat ayam vyaktau niyamaḥ pṛṣṭha lagna vastra ādeḥ saṃkhyā parimāṇa agrahe tvacā grahaṇāt tad jātīye tu phūtkāra ādau saṃkhyā parimāṇa ādīnām vāyu abhighātasya ca śarīre pratyakṣa tvāt

syāt etat bahis indriya ja dravya sākṣātkāre mahat tve sati udbhūta rūpavat tvam prayojakam sati saṃbhave tyāga ayogāt na tu janya indriya grāhya viśeṣa guṇavat tvam kārya mahat tva samāna adhikaraṇa viśeṣa guṇavat tvam vā rasana gata pitta dravyasya udbhūta tikta rasasya vāyu upanīta surabhi dravyasya ca pratyakṣatā āpatteḥ

mā evam na udbhūta rūpavat tvam tathā nayana gata pitta dravyasya ca pratyakṣatā āpatteḥ astu vā udbhūta sparśavat tvam tatra tantram na ca evam prabhāyām apratyakṣa tvam prabhā hi tejasaḥ rūpam na dravyam tad āśraya tejaḥ pratītiḥ pratyakṣa rūpa liṅga adhīnā eva yathā tava ūṣma ādi pratītiḥ tatra saṃyoga karma ādi katham pratyakṣam iti ced cāndra sauradīpa prabhā ādau tu na kathaṃcid indranīla ādi prabhāyāḥ rūpasya pūrva deśa anupalambhena uttara deśa upalambhena liṅgena tad āśraya tejaḥ saṃyoga vibhāga ādi anumānam iti tu ad naye yathā tvacā sparśa mātra graha anantaram phūtkāre saṃgoga ādīnām

etena dhūma bāṣpayoḥ aspārśana tvena udbhūta sparśa abhāve api cākṣuṣa tvam anyathā tad gata saṃyoga vibhāga karmaṇām pratyakṣatā na syāt liṅga abhāvāt iti nirastam na ca bahis indriya yogya aneka viśeṣa guṇavat tvam tantram tava trasareṇu prabhayoḥ apratyakṣata āpatteḥ gauravāt ca nanu evam vinigamaka abhāvāt ubhayoḥ api tathātvam astu tathā api vāyuḥ apratyakṣaḥ iti ced evam bahis indriya ja dravya sākṣātkāre cākṣuṣa tve spārśana pratyakṣa tve ca pratyekam udbhūta rūpavat tve sati udbhūta sparśavat tvam prayojakam paryavasyati iti gauravam mama tu cākṣuṣa tve udbhūta rūpavat tvam spārśana tve udbhūta sparśavat tvam yasya viśeṣe prayojaka tvam tasya anugatena rūpeṇa sāmānya prayojaka tvam iti dravya grāhaka bahis indriya vyavasthāpaka udbhūta viśeṣa guṇavat tvam sāmānya prayojakam iti lāghavam viśeṣasya sāmānyasya ca bhinna prayojya tva niyama anna ekam prayojakam

atha vāyuḥ yadi bahis indriya janya sākṣātkāra viṣaya dravyam spārśana sākṣātkāra viṣaya dravyam vā syāt udbhūta rūpaḥ syāt na ca evam tasmāt tathā tādṛśa sākṣātkāra viṣaya dravyasya rūpa janaka tva niyamāt iti ced na rūpa vat samaveta tvena hi dravyasya rūpa janaka tvam na tu tādṛśa sākṣātkāra viṣaya dravya tvena tasya rūpa janana uttara kālīna tvāt ghaṭaḥ yadi cakṣuḥ itara indriya grāhya dravyam syāt arūpam asparśam acākṣuṣa ādi syāt tvac indriyam yadi dravya grāhaka bahis indriyam syāt rūpa vat syāt sparśa grāhakam vā na syāt rūpa grāhi vā syāt cakṣuḥ vat na ca evam tasmāt na tathā iti ghaṭaḥ api na tvac indriya grāhyaḥ syāt tad gata saṃkhyā ādi jñānam phūtkāra ādau iva iti syāt spṛśāmi iti anuvyavasāyaḥ ca ghaṭa vat vāyau api

atha spārśana tve udbhūta sparśa vat udbhūtam rūpam api tantram udbhūta rūpavat tve cākṣuṣa tva vat spārśana tva darśanāt iti ced na udbhūta rūpavat tve sati api prabhāyām na spārśana tvam iti udbhūta sparśasya āvaśyaka tvena udbhūta rūpasya anyathā siddha tvāt na hi udbhūta sparśe sati udbhūta rūpa abhāvāt spārśana tva abhāvaḥ nanu evam sparśa gataḥ udbhavaḥ kāraṇam astu na tu rūpam akāraṇam iti ced tathā api sparśaḥ tad udbhavaḥ ca kāraṇam na tu rūpam api tasmin dvaye sati tad abhāvena tad abhāva adarśanāt vastutas rūpa sparśa gate udbhava tu ajātī kāraṇa tāva chedike na tu kāraṇe iti

ucyate dravyasya spārśana tve udbhūta sparśa mātram na tantram nidāgha ūṣmaṇi vāyu upanīta śīta uṣṇa dravye ca pratyakṣa tvena tad gata saṃkhyā parimāṇa saṃyoga vibhāga karmaṇām pratyakṣa tva prasaṅgāt yogi avyakti vṛtti tvena teṣām yogyatayā dravya grāhaka sāmagrī grāhya tva avadhāraṇāt na ca ūṣma ādi jātīye doṣa abhāve api ghaṭa ādau iva kara parāmarśe kadācid kena api saṃkhyā gṛhyate tathā udbhūta rūpavat tva mātrasya tathā tve cāndra ādi udyotasya nayana gata pitta dravyasya ca pratyakṣa tve tad gata saṃkhyā grahaḥ api syāt na ca ghaṭa ādau iva nipuṇam nibhālayantaḥ api tad gata saṃkhyā dvi tva ādi hasta vitasti ādi parimāṇam karma vā vīkṣāmahe iti eka eka vyabhicārāt vinigamaka abhāvāt ubhayam api bahis indriya dravya pratyakṣa tve prayojakam iti vāyuḥ apratyakṣaḥ na ca evam apasiddhāntaḥ pītaḥ śaṅkhaḥ ityādau nayana pitta pītim ā eva gṛhyate na tu pitta dravyam vayava tvāt prabhāyām iva tejasaḥ iti ṭīkā kṛtām abhidhānāt iti navīnāḥ

saṃpradāya vidaḥ tu calati pakṣi kāṇḍa ādau pūrva deśa vibhāga uttara deśa saṃyogayoḥ pratyakṣatā na syāt pūrva uttara deśasya prabhā maṇḍalasya anudbhūta sparśa tvena apratyakṣa tvāt tathā ca pareṣām calati iti pratītiḥ api tad liṅgikā na syāt asmākam api candra tārā ādau saṃyoga vibhāga liṅgaka gati anumānam na syāt na ca pūrva uttara deśe upalambha anupalambhābhyām saṃyoga vibhāgau anumāya tābhyām eva gati anumānam pūrva uttara deśayoḥ apratyakṣa tvena liṅga asiddheḥ tasmāt udbhūta rūpavat tvam tatra prayojakam iti vāyuḥ apratyakṣaḥ

nanu śītaḥ vāyuḥ iti āropaḥ na spārśanaḥ viśeṣyasya ayogya tvāt na ca prabhāyām tathā sāmānye bādhaka abhāvāt na api anumāna upanīte vāyau tvac indriya upanītaḥ śīta āropaḥ śīta dravya abheda āropaḥ vā manasā tad liṅga sparśa ādi catuṣkasya agrahaṇāt śīta sparśasya ātad liṅga tvāt na ca śīta dravya upanāyaka tvena anumite vāyau manasā śīta āropaḥ śītān āśraya tvena anumite vāyau tad anāropāt na api pītaḥ śaṅkhaḥ iti vat bahis indriya janyaḥ ayam bhramaḥ yena anumānika viśeṣa grahe api doṣa māhātmyāt bhavet śīta dravya upanayana janaka praṇālīm aviduṣaḥ api śītaḥ vāyuḥ iti pratyayāt ca na api liṅga ābhāsa janyā anumiti rūpaḥ bhramaḥ tat apratīteḥ śīta sparśasya vāyu liṅga tvena bhrama aviṣaya tvāt na ca śīta sparśa anumite dravye smṛta vāyu abheda āropaḥ vāyu viśeṣyaka śīta pratyayāt atas eva śīta sparśaḥ ayam vāyoḥ iti bhrama śarīram apāstam na ca svapna vibhrama vat sva utprekṣita padārtha saṃsarga āropavat ca mānasaḥ ayam tvac indriya vyāpāra anuvidhānāt iti

ucyate yathā vāyu vaidharmyeṇa jala vṛtti tayā gṛhītasya śīta sparśasya vāyau āropaḥ diś moha vat doṣa māhātmyāt tathā śīta sparśe vāyu liṅga tva āra upād vāyavīyatva anumānam na ca evam śītaḥ vāyuḥ iti pratītiḥ na syāt iti vācyam śītaḥ ayam vāyavīyaḥ iti jñāna anantaram śītaḥ ayam vāyuḥ iti ca manasā āropāt anuṣṇaḥ vāyuḥ iti vat
