atha tvac vyāpāra anantaram katham vā āyuḥ vātī iti pratītiḥ tad liṅga saṃyoga vibhāgayoḥ apratyakṣa tvāt na ca śarīre vāyu abhighātaḥ eva tat liṅgam abhighātasya saṃyoga tvena apratyakṣa tvāt iti ced na abhighāta janya sukha duḥkha viśeṣeṇa abhighātam unnīya tasya sparśavat vegavat janya tvam anumāya vegena karma anumānāt evam praṇālīm aviduṣaḥ tad pratyaya asiddheḥ

atha vāyuḥ śītaḥ vātī iti katham viśiṣṭa vaiśiṣṭya pratītiḥ ekā śīta viśiṣṭa pratīteḥ mānasa tvena karma pratīteḥ ānumānika tvena jāti saṃkara prasaṅgāt iti ced na śīta viśiṣṭa tvena smṛte vāyau karma anumānāt viśiṣṭa vaiśiṣṭyam na tu ubhayam viśeṣaṇam ekadā bhāsate na ca evam kalpanā gauravam doṣāya pratyakṣa tve balavat bādhaka sattvāt

evam bahis indriya ja dravya pratyakṣa tve udbhūta rūpavat tvasya prayojaka tve vyavasthite pratyakṣa tu asādhyaka anumāne pakṣa dharma avacchinnasya sādhyasya sādhana avacchinnasya vā vyāpakam udbhūta rūpavat tvam upādhiḥ na ca viśiṣṭasya vyabhicāra vyatirekayoḥ sādhane artha antaram viśeṣya vyabhicāra vyatireka siddhi paryavasānāt iti upādhau vakṣyāmaḥ

atha vāyu vat ātmā api na pratyakṣaḥ dravya pratyakṣa tve udbhūta rūpavat tvasya tantra tvāt na ca liṅga jñānam vinā eva aham jānāmi iti pratyayāt na laiṅgika tvam jñānam aviduṣaḥ jānāmi iti viśiṣṭa pratyaya abhāvena jñānasya liṅga tvāt na ca ghaṭam aham jānāmi iti vartamāna pratyayaḥ na syāt ghaṭa jñānasya anumiti pūrva tṛtī yakṣaṇe vināśāt iti vācyam sthūla samaya upādhim ādāya vartamāna pratyayāt yathā kulāle ceṣṭā darśanena karoti iti anumitiḥ iti

ucyate yaḥ aham ghaṭam adrākṣam saḥ aham ghaṭam spṛśāmi iti abheda pratyabhijñānāt ātmā pratyakṣaḥ na ca etat sparśana indriya janya jñāna āśrayaḥ aham tad darśana jñāna āśraya abhinnaḥ madīya ahaṃpratyaya viṣaya tvāt tad darśana jñāna aśraya tva vat iti ātmā abheda pratyayaḥ iti vācyam mad aṃśasya apratyakṣa tvena anumāna liṅga asiddheḥ na ca jñānena ātma anumānam tatas tatra jñāne ātmīyatva anumānam tatas madīya ahaṃpratyaya viṣaya tva jñānam ātmani iti vācyam evam praṇālīm aviduṣaḥ api yaḥ aham saḥ aham iti pratyayāt na ca vāyau pratyabhijñānam asti sadāgatimat tvena gatasya punar ajñānāt saḥ eva punar purovātaḥ iti pratīteḥ tad jātīya anumiti rūpa tvāt tasmāt vāyuḥ bahis indriya apratyakṣaḥ nīrūpa dravya tvāt ākāśa vat na ca sādhana avacchinna sādhya vyāpakam udbhūta sparśān āśraya tvam upādhiḥ udbhūta sparśasya tatra ahetutvena upādheḥ sādhya avyāpaka tvāt

kim ca udbhūta sparśavat tvasya bahis indriya janya dravya sākṣātkāra prayojaka tve suvarṇa rūpam tejaḥ dravyam pratyakṣam na syāt prabhāvat tasya anudbhūta sparśavat tvāt rūpam tu tasya udbhūtam eva kim tu upaṣṭambhaka pīta rūpa abhibhūtam abhibhavaḥ ca balavatsa jātīya saṃbandhaḥ evam andhakāre pītāgrahaṇe api abhibhavaḥ na ca evam andhakāre suvarṇa upalambha āpattiḥ abhibhūtasya api tejasaḥ grahāt na ca tejasi tejaḥ antaram vyañjakam iti vācyam rūpe gṛhyamāṇaḥ eva cakṣuṣā dravya grahāt suvarṇa rūpam abhibhavāt eva na upalabhyate upaṣṭambhaka rūpam ca āloka abhāvāt

atha yathā aruṇa kapila ādi rūpa abhibhūtam api vahni rūpam param ātmānam ca prakāśayati tathā kanakam api prakāśeta prakāśayet ca iti ced na tatra hi abhibhūta rūpa vahni saṃbaddhānabhibhūta rūpā vahni madhya ādi vyāpinī prabhā eva vyañjikā yat vā vahnau rūpa bhāsvara tve na abhibhūte kim tu śukla tva mātram suvarṇe tu rūpam abhibhūtam tena tad gata śukla tva bhāsvara tve anabhibhūte api vyakti agrahān na gṛhyete iti phala balāt kalpyate na ca pītim agurutva āśraya atiriktam tat asiddham asti hi suvarṇasya atyanta anala saṃyoge api pītam rūpam na tat vijātīyam tad anupapannam asati drava dravya saṃbandhe pārthive atyanta agni saṃyogasya pūrvarūpa vijātīya rūpa janakatva niyamāt jala saṃbandhe tad apagame ca paṭa ādau dāha ādāha darśanāt tat idam dhmāyamānam kanakam yadi atyanta agni saṃyogi pārthiva tve sati vijātīya rūpa pratibandhaka drava dravya saṃyuktam na syāt pūrvarūpa vijātīya rūpa vat syāt vahni saṃbaddha ghaṭa vat anyathā pārthivam na syāt jalam vā syāt agni saṃyogi vā na syāt

tat ayam prayogaḥ atyanta agni saṃyogi pītam vijātīya rūpa pratibandhaka drava dravya saṃyuktam atyanta agni saṃyogi tve sati pūrvarūpa vijātīya rūpa an adhikaraṇa pārthiva tvāt jala madhya sthita agni saṃyukta pīta paṭa vat yat vā pītam suvarṇam pīta rūpa atirikta rūpa utpatti pratibandhaka drava dravya saṃyuktam naktaṃdivam agni saṃyoge api pīta rūpa atirikta rūpa an āśraya tvāt tāvat paryantam agni saṃyukta jala madhya stha pīta paṭa vat na ca aprayojaka tvam virodhi drava dravya saṃbandham vinā pārthive atyanta agni saṃyogasya vijātīya rūpa janaka tvāt tat ca drava dravyam na jalam svābhāvika drava tva anāśraya tvāt na ca anudbhūtam tat śītala śilā tale agni saṃyogāt dāha darśanena anudbhūta drava tvasya dāha avirodhi tvāt naimittika drava tvāt ca na api tatas eva pārthiva tvam druta pārthivasya vijātīya rūpa pratibandhaka tve ghṛta ādau api tathā tva āpatteḥ tatra api rūpa parāvṛtti prasaṅgāt ca upaṣṭambhakasya api pārthiva tvena vijātīya rūpa apratibandhaka tvāt

yadi api tejaḥ antaram na naimittika drava tva adhikaraṇam na api vijātīya rūpa pratibandhakam kim tu tad janakam tathā api pratyakṣa dravya tvena tasya rūpavat tve pṛthivī jala anya tvena tejaḥ tvāt dharmi grāhaka māna siddham tathātvam pīta bhāga drava tvam api agni saṃyoge na naśyati druta tejaḥ pratibandhāt eva jala madhya stha agni saṃyukta ghṛta vat iti

atha yadi druta tejasaḥ vijātīya rūpa pratibandhaka tvam tadā jala stha paṭa vat druta suvarṇa madhya sthita paṭa ādeḥ api rūpa parāvṛttiḥ na syāt iti ced na loke suvarṇa tvena anubhūyamāne pīta dravye avinirbhāga vartinī upaṣṭambhake drutam tejaḥ vijātīyam rūpam pratibadhnāti na anyatra tathā eva anvaya vyatirekāt tarhi upaṣṭambhaka tvam anubhava siddham suvarṇasya iti asya āvaśyaka tvāt tasya eva svarūpa parāvṛttau pratibandhaka tvam astu kṛtam dṛṣṭa vijātīya tejaḥ kalpanayā iti ced na upaṣṭambhaka mātre hi vijātīya rūpa pratibandhaka svabhāva tvam druta tejasaḥ dharmi grāhaka māna siddha tvāt tasya tena eva rūpeṇa siddheḥ yadi drutam tejaḥ rūpa parāvṛtti pratibandhakam syāt paṭa ādi rūpa parāvṛttim api pratibadhnīyāt iti tarkasya tad viparyayasya ca siddhi asiddhi vyāhata tvāt anubhūyamāna suvarṇasya ca upaṣṭambhaka rūpa parāvṛtti pratibandhaka svabhāva tvam na dharmi grāhaka mānāt anyatas vā siddham yena pārthive asati virodhi drava dravya saṃbandhe agni saṃyogasya rūpa parāvartaka tvam anvaya vyatireka siddham paribhūyeta iti ācāryāḥ

navīnāstu atyanta agni saṃyogena anucchidyamāna pratyakṣa drava tva adhikaraṇam taijasam jala pṛthivībhyām anya tve sati rūpavat tvāt vahni vat na ca asiddhiḥ pratyakṣa dravya tva adhikaraṇa tvena tasya rūpavat tvāt na ca tat jalam sāṃsiddhika drava tvānāśraya tvāt naimittika drava tva ādhāra tvāt sneha śūnya tvāt vā lākṣā vat snehe sati sneha drava tva adhīna saṃgraha prasaṅgāt na ca pārthivam atyanta agni saṃyoge api anucchidyamānam yat drava tvam tad adhikaraṇa tvāt jala paramāṇu vat asati virodhi drava dravya saṃbandhe iti viśeṣaṇam tena kvathyamāna jala stha ghṛtena na vyabhicāraḥ na ca aprayojaka tvam atyanta anala saṃyogena lākṣā ādi ghṛta ādi pṛthivī drava tva ucchede pṛthivī drava tva tvam eva prayojakam asati bādhake anugatasya prayojaka tve saṃbhavati tyāga ayogāt na ca ghṛta drava tva tva ādikam ananugamāt na api naimittika drava tva tvam drava tva tvam eva vā suvarṇe drava tva uccheda prasaṅgāt

atha apārthivam api sāṃsiddhika drava tvam taile janya jala antare ca atyanta agni saṃyogāt ucchidyate atas anugatam eva tṛṇa araṇi maṇi nyāyena drava tva uccheda prayojakam iti ced na pṛthivī drava tva ucchede pṛthivī drava tva tvam jala drava tva ucchede janya jala drava tva tvam drava tva mātra ucchede ca janya rasa vat drava tvam prayojakam lāghavāt etena vivāda viṣayaḥ pṛthivī naimittika drava tva āśraya tvāt ghṛta vat iti sat pratipakṣa tvam apāstam anukūla tarka abhāvena agni saṃyogāt drava tva uccheda prasaṅga lakṣaṇa pratikūla tarkeṇa ca hīna bala tvāt

atha naimittika drava tve pṛthivī tvam samavāyikāraṇa tāvacchedakam asati bādhake tyāga ayogāt iti ced na ghaṭa ādau api naimittika drava tva prasaṅgāt na ca ghṛta lākṣā ādiṣu pṛthivī tva avāntaram kiñcid ekam anugatam naimittika drava tva samavāyi kāraṇa tāvacchedakam asti pṛthivī niyata naimittika drava tvam katham apṛthivyām iti ced na tāvat tiryak gamana ūrdhva jvalana vat tat jāti niyatam ghaṭa ādau abhāvāt na api pṛthivītva avāntara jāti viśeṣa niyatam ghṛtam vihāya lākṣā ādiṣu api bhāvāt

atha upaṣṭambhake pītim agurutva āśraye pārthive atyanta agni saṃyogena anucchidyamāna drava tva ādhāra tvam anaikāntikam na hi tejaḥ drava tva daśāyām tat adravam eva āste pītam drutam iti pratīteḥ iti ced na tatra drava tva abhāvāt pārthiva drava tvasya atyanta agni saṃyogena ucchitti āpattyā bādhakena druta pratīteḥ bhrama tvāt jala madhya sthitam asīkṣa uda ādeḥ iva tad avayavānām drava dravya saṃbandhena praśithila saṃyoga āśraya tvāt na tu teṣām drava tvam na ca evam ghṛta ādau api tathā drava tve tatra bādhaka abhāvāt

anye tu upaṣṭambhake drava tvam utpadyate eva anubhavasya durapahnava tvāt atyanta agni saṃyogena tad ucchedaḥ tu na bhavati drava dravyasya tejasaḥ pratibandhaka tvāt na ca evam druta tejasi māna abhāvaḥ tathā hi pītam drava tva adhikaraṇam drava tva uccheda pratibandhaka drava dravya saṃyuktam atyanta agni saṃyoge api anucchidyamāna drava tva ādhāra pārthiva tvāt kvathyamāna jala madhya sthita ghṛta vat na ca aprayojaka tvam atyanta agni saṃyogena virodhi drava dravya saṃbandha asaṃbandhe pārthiva drava tva uccheda an uccheda darśanāt

atha vā rūpavat tve jala anya tve ca sati taijasa tva pārthiva tva saṃdehe vivāda adhyāsitam drava tva adhikaraṇam taijasam asati drava dravya saṃyoge atyanta agni saṃyoge api anucchinna anitya drava tva ādhāra tvāt yat na evam tat na evam yathā jalam ghṛtam vā iti vyatirekī na ca asādha araṇyam agṛhyamāṇa viśeṣa daśāyām tasya doṣa tvāt

tathā hi yathā sādhya abhāva vat vyāvṛtta tvena pakṣe tasya sādhya sādhaka tvam tathā sādhya vat vyāvṛtta tvena sādhya abhāva sādhaka tā api syāt iti sat pratipakṣa utthāpaka tayā tasya doṣa tvam na ca sādhya abhāva sādhakasya pṛthivī tva siddhi paryavasāyinaḥ tulya bala tvam anukūla tarka abhāvena hīna bala tvāt yadi idam pārthivam syāt asati virodhi drava dravya saṃbandhe atyanta agni saṃyogena ucchidyamāna drava tvā adhikaraṇam syāt taila vat iti pratikūla tarkeṇa hīna bala tvāt

yadi idam jala anya rūpavat tve sati taijasam na syāt pārthivam syāt yadi ca pārthivam syāt atyanta agni saṃyogena ucchidyamānadratvā adhikaraṇam syāt iti anukūla tarka sadbhāvena pratikūla tarka abhāvena ca taijasatva sādhakasya adhika bala tvāt yadi ca asādhāraṇasya sādhya tad abhāva vat vyāvṛtta tvena tad ubhaya saṃśaya janakatayā doṣa tvam tathā api viśeṣa adarśana sahitasya saṃśāyaka tvam prakṛte ca anukūla tarka viśeṣa darśana saha kṛtasya vyatireki bhāvena sādhaka tvam tasmāt yadā sādhya tadabhāva koṭau na viśeṣa darśanam tadā asādhāraṇyasya doṣa tvam na ca evam śabdaḥ anityaḥ śabda tvāt ityādikam api hetuḥ syāt viśeṣa darśana daśāyām iṣṭa tvāt

anye tu tejaḥ tvam na adrava rūpavat mātra vṛtti rūpavat vṛtti dravya tva sākṣāt vyāpya jāti tvāt pṛthivī tva vat yat vā tejaḥ tvam druta vṛtti rūpavat vṛtti dravya tva sākṣāt vyāpya jāti tvāt jala tva vat na ca rasa vat vṛtti tvam upādhiḥ rasavat tvam drava tu asamāna adhikaraṇa atyanta abhāva pratiyogi adruta vṛtti dravya tva vyāpya dharma tvāt paṭatva vat iti druta tejassiddhau sādhya avyāpaka tvāt iti sāmānyatodṛṣṭena tejasi prasādhya vivāda adhyāsitam drutam taijasam atyanta agni saṃyogena anucchidyamāna aniti a drava tva adhikaraṇa tvāt na yat evam na tat evam yathā jalam iti vadanti

atha jhrādya anumāneṭa tejaḥ mātra āvṛtti tvam upādhiḥ na ca pakṣa itara tvam pradīpa tva ādeḥ api vyāvartya tvāt iti ced na balavat vipakṣa bādhakena vivāda viṣaye druta taijasa tva siddhau upādheḥ sādhya avyāpaka tvāt evam ca vivāda adhyāsite pārthiva tva taijasa tva sādhakāni yadi api bahūni anumānāni santi tathā api vipakṣa bādhaka tarkāt taijasa tva sādhakasya balavat tvam iti dhyeyam

atha drutadrutatara ādeḥ kramaśas pratīteḥ prabala anala saṃyogena suvarṇa nāśāt tad drava tvam naśyati iti asiddhaḥ hetuḥ na ca drava tva prāgabhāva asamāna adhikaraṇa drava tu a dhvaṃsa rūpaḥ ucchedaḥ na suvarṇe drava tva nāśe api agrima drava tvena utpādāt ghṛte ca tathā iti vācyam suvarṇe drava tva nāśe sati vinaṣṭa āśraye drava tva antarasya anutpādena drava tva prāgabhāva asamāna adhikaraṇa drava tva dhvaṃsasya sattvāt iti ced na suvarṇa drava tvam hi āśraya nāśāt vinaśyati na tu agni saṃyogāt yadi ca agni saṃyogāt vinaśyet tadā ghṛta vat na drava tva antaram utpadyeta drava tva ucchedaka agni saṃyogasya drava tva antara pratibandhaka tvāt tathā ca agni saṃyoge sati tad hetuka nāśa apratiyogi drava tva adhikaraṇa tvāt iti hetu arthaḥ athavā ghṛte drava tva uccheda samaye samāna adhikaraṇa drava tva sāmagrī samavadhānam na asti suvarṇe tu asti evam ca samāna adhikaraṇa drava tva sāmagrī samavahita agni saṃyoga janya dhvaṃsa pratiyogya vṛtti drava tva avāntara sāmānya vat drava tvam hetu arthaḥ

yat vā ghṛta paramāṇau agni saṃyoga daśāyām drava tva nāśe sati drava tva antaram na utpadyate tad ārabdha bhasmani drava tva abhāvāt evam suvarṇa paramāṇu drava tvam agni saṃyogāt ca yadi vinaśyet tadā tad ā ārabdha suvarṇam adravam syāt tathā suvarṇa ārambhakāḥ paramāṇavaḥ na pārthivāḥ atyanta agni saṃyogena anucchidyamāna drava tva adhikaraṇa tvāt jala paramāṇu vat taijasā vā tatas eva yat na evam tat na evam yathā ghṛta paramāṇuḥ iti vyatirekī jhrvāṭa evam apārthiva ārabdham taijasa ārabdham vā suvarṇam apārthivam taijasam vā atyanta anala saṃyoge api anucchidyamāna drava tva adhikaraṇa paramāṇu ārabdha tvāt iti anvaya vyatirekī ca iti

eka deśī tu drava tva adhikaraṇam na tejaḥ pīta vat na ca asiddhiḥ pītam drutam iti pratīteḥ pīta tve pārthiva tva āpattyā bādhakena pīta pratītiḥ bhramaḥ iti ced na śukla tve api apārthiva tva vat pīta tve api apārthiva tve bādhaka abhāvāt yathā naimittika drava tvam pṛthivī tve na tantram atiprasaṅgāt tathā pīta tve api gandha niyata tvam api naimittika drava tva vat eva pṛthivī jala anya tve sati rūpi tvena tejaḥ iti ced na aprayojaka tvāt anyathā jala tejaḥ anya tve sati sparśavat tvena vāyoḥ api pṛthivī tva āpatteḥ atha rūpa rasa gandhānām abhāvāt na tathātvam teṣām anudbhave ca pṛthivī udbhūta rūpa rasa gandha ādi anyatamavatī ityādi bahuvidha vyāpti virodhaḥ iti ced na tejaḥ adravam eva pratyakṣam tejaḥ pratyakṣa rūpa sparśa ādi anyatara vat eva sva para prakāśakam eva ityādi vyāpti virodhasya tejasi api sattvāt drava tva adhikaraṇam ca na pṛthivī iti tvayā eva sādhitam atas naimittika drava tva adhikaraṇam pītam suvarṇam dravya antaram eva iti āha

nanu indriya janya tvam sakhā ādi pratyakṣa avyāpakam pratyakṣa lakṣaṇam iti ced na jñāta karaṇa ajanyaḥ sukha ādi anubhavaḥ indriya janyaḥ janya pratyakṣa tvāt rūpa pratyakṣa vat janya sākṣātkārasya indriya janya tvāt iti tatra api tad lakṣaṇa sattvāt sparśa ādi aviṣaya tvena tvac ādinā na artha antaram gandha rūpa rasa sparśeṣu ekaika mātra sākṣātkāra ajanaka tvena pṛthivī ādi bheda siddhau niḥsparśam lāghavān niravayavam ca manaḥ

tat ca vibhu jñāna asamavāyi kāraṇa saṃyoga ādhāra tvāt nitya indriya tvāt nitya tve sati dravya anārambhaka dravya tvāt viśeṣa guṇa śūnya dravya tvāt ātma ādi vat na ca mahat tvam upādhiḥ sādhana vyāpaka tvāt iti nanu sukha ādikam mūrta saṃyoga asamavāyi kāraṇaka guṇa vṛtti guṇa tva avāntara jāti yogi nitya vṛtti anitya viśeṣa guṇa tvāt śabda vat pākaja rūpa vat ca iti ced na anātma vṛtti tvasya śabda bhinna viśeṣa guṇa grāhaka indriya ajanya tvasya śabdasya dravya tvena mūrta vṛtti guṇa tvasya ca upādhi tvāt aprayojaka tvāt ca kāraṇe mūrta tvasya guru tvāt astu vā śarīra ātma saṃyoga janya tvena artha antaram

atha asamavāyi adhīnaḥ vibhu kāryāṇām prādeśika tva niyamaḥ iti vibhu manaḥ yogāt ātma mātre sukha ādeḥ utpattau niyata deśa tā na syāt atas aṇu manaḥ iti mā evam kim asamavāyi kāraṇam sva avacchinne vibhukāryam janayati iti niyamaḥ sva avacchinne janayati eva iti vā sva avacchinnaḥ eva janayati iti vā ādye sukha ādeḥ adhika deśa tve āpādaka abhāvaḥ dvitīye aṇumanassaṃyoge api sva avacchinne adhika deśe ca janayet niyāmaka abhāvāt antye tava api sukha ādeḥ aṇu mātra deśa tā āpattiḥ manaḥ vaibhave api avirodhaḥ ca

atha nimitta candana ādi anurodhena sukha ādau nyūna adhika deśa tā nimitta vāyu saṃyogāt iva śabde na tu asamavāyi anurodhāt tathā ca sukha ādikam tad avacchinnaḥ eva utpadyate iti ced hanta tarhi vaibhave api tathā astu na ca vibhukārya asamavāyī sva avacchinne kāryam janayati eva bherī ākāśa saṃyogaḥ iva śabdam iti candana ādi avacchinne api sukha ādikam utpadyeta iti vācyam tad deśīya candana sukhe hi tad deśīya candana saṃbandha sāpekṣaḥ asamavāyī hetuḥ iti katham tat nirapekṣaḥ tat kuryāt candanam ca sva avacchinne sukha janakam katham svān avacchinne api tat utpādayet katham vā tad deśīya candana sukham tad deśa candana saṃbandha janyam tena vinā eva utpadyeta

atha manaḥ vaibhave sukha ādi utpattau niyataḥ upādhiḥ vācyaḥ tena nānā nimitta samavadhāne api tad avacchedena ekadā sukha daḥkha ādiṣu ekam eva utpadyate na nānā eka avacchedena ekadā ekaḥ eva vibhu viśeṣa guṇaḥ utpadyate iti niyamāt nimittasya tu avacchedaka tve nānā sukha ādikam utpadyeta śabda vat iti ced na śrotre karṇa śaṣkulī avacchedena nānā nimittāt aneka śabda utpādāt anyathā kolāhala grahaḥ na syāt nānā avacchedena ekadā candana dahana ādi saṃbandhe sukha duḥkhayoḥ ca ekadā anubhava siddha tvena iṣṭa āpādanāt na ca tad yaugapadya pratyayaḥ bhramaḥ bādhaka abhāvāt na ca anyatra kramāt atra api krama anumānam anyatra kramasya nimitta krama adhīna tvāt

evam ca vivāda viṣaya sukha duḥkhāni yugapad utpannā samavāyi kāraṇakāni yugapad utpadyamāna tvāt yugapad utpanna ghaṭa ādi vat abādhita anubhavāt ca na asiddhiḥ etena caraṇa duḥkham yadi śarīra avacchinnā samavāyi hetukam syāt śarīra vyāpakam syāt iti nirastam nimitta samavadhānasya tantra tve asya aprayojaka tvāt anyathā aṇu tva pakṣe śarīra vyāpakam sukha ādi na syāt ābhimānika abhyāsikamāna urathika sukheṣu jñāna icchā prayatna dveṣeṣu ca deśa aniyamaḥ śarīra avayaveṣu yat kriyāyām icchā tad avacchedena prayatnaḥ iti tatra eva ceṣṭā āvaśyaka tvāt aniyata deśa jñāna icchā ādau laghu tvāt ca anyathā aṇu tva pakṣe prayatnasya aṇu deśa tvam śarīra mātra deśa tvam vā syāt

anye tu sukha ādau tad nimitta avacchedena ātma manassaṃyogaḥ asamavāyī tanmātra sukha ādi upalambhāt na tu ātma mana ssaṃyoga mātram atiprasaṅgāt iti āhuḥ yāvati yat sukha ādi prāgabhāvaḥ tāvatī eva tad sukha ādikam utpadyate iti apare yat tu tad itara hetu sākalye tad vyāpaka tvena prāgabhāvasya āvaśyaka tvam iti tat na prāgabhāvasya ahetu tva āpatteḥ tad itara hetu sākalye tad abhāvena kārya abhāva abhāvāt

etena vyāpakam anavacchinnam na indriya m atiprasaṅgāt iti ākāśe karṇa śaṣkulī vat niyataḥ upādhiḥ vācyaḥ sa ca na śarīram tad avayava mātram vā niyataḥ tad avayavī vā ceṣṭā āśraya mātram vā nānā avayava avacchedena avyāpya vṛtti sukha ādi upalabdheḥ evam ca sūkṣmam indriyam upādhi tvena kalpanīyam tathā ca tat eva manaḥ kim upadheyena vibhunā tatra ca sarve eva hetavaḥ dharmi grāhaka māna bādhitāḥ iti nirastam

indriya tvena tasya śarīra mātrasya upādhi tve api nimitta vaśāt sukha ādeḥ niyata deśa tā upapatteḥ na ca ekadā aneka viṣaya indriya saṃbandhe yugapad jñāna anutpattyā indriya sahakāri tayā anumitam manaḥ aṇu tat eva sukha grāhakam indriyam lāghavāt iti tad vaibhava hetavaḥ bādhitāḥ iti vācyam bubhutsā vaśāt karaṇa dharma tvāt vā aṇu tva pakṣe śrotre aneka śabda samavāye api bubhutsita mātra śabda graha vat vyāsaṅga daśāyām yugapad jñāna anutpatteḥ upapatteḥ anyatra dīrgha śaṣkulī bhakṣaṇa ādau yugapad jñāna utpatteḥ iṣṭa tvāt iti

atra ucyate vyāsaṅga daśāyām indriyāṇām sva sva viṣaya saṃbandhe api ekasmāt jñānam na anyasmāt iti anubhava siddham atas yasya asaṃbandhāt na yugapad jñānāni tad indriya sahakāri krameṇa tat adhiṣṭhāyakam manaḥ tat eva sukha ādi grāhakam iti tasya dharmi grāhaka māna bādhitam vibhu tvam tathā hi cākṣuṣa jñānavataḥ maitrasya sva sva viṣaya saṃbaddhāni ghrāṇa rasana tvac śrotrāṇi sva sva viṣaya sākṣātkāra hetu saṃyoga śūnyāni tadānīm sva viṣaya sākṣātkārājanaka tvāt indriya asaṃbaddha ghaṭa vat

ekaikam vā pakṣaḥ anyathā hetu sākalye yugapad jñāna utpatti prasaṅgaḥ na ca vaibhave api adṛṣṭa vilambāt vilambaḥ tad itara hetu sākalye tasya api sattvāt indriya antara vilopa prasaṅgāt ca na ca bubhutsā vaśāt kramaḥ dṛśyate hi nṛtya darśanavataḥ bubhutsātaḥ abhimata viṣaya antara jñānam iti vācyam sā hi na sva viṣaya jñāne hetuḥ abubhutsite api jñāna udayāt na api anya jñāna pratibandhikā ghaṭa bubhutsāyām api paṭa jñāna udayāt bubhutsā ca kriyā hetu manaḥ gocara prayatna dvārāḥ indriya antarāt ākṛṣya abhimata artha grāhiṇī indriya antare manaḥ niveśayantī bubhutsita grahe hetuḥ anya grahe pratibaṃndhikā ca na tu sākṣāt atas eva bubhutsā sattve api manaḥ gocara praṇidhāna abhāve sā na kiṃcitkarī

nanu indriya manassaṃyoga viśeṣaḥ eva viṣaya viśeṣa grahe hetuḥ kalpyatām na ca evam siddha kāraṇa bhāvasya viśeṣa kalpane hetu antara ucchedaḥ tasya api anvaya vyatireki tvāt iti ced na indriya manassaṃyoge hi viśeṣaḥ na jāti rūpaḥ anugata hetu abhāvāt jāti saṃkara prasaṅgāt ca na api sahakāri rūpaḥ tasya eva hetu tā āpatteḥ

atha astu karaṇa dharma tvena kriyā kramaḥ ekam karaṇam ekatra ekadā eka avacchedena tulya deśe vai eka jātīyām anekām kriyām na karoti kim tu ekām eva ekatra ityādi viśeṣaṇāt kuṭhāra agni saṃyoga śabdeṣu na vyabhicāraḥ iti ced tarhi cakṣuḥ ādi avacchedena bhinna deśīya śabda vat paramāṇau iva vijātīyām agni saṃyoga vat anekām kriyām kuryāt eva

atha jñāna karaṇam ekatra ātmani ekadā ekam eva jñānam karoti samūha ālambana karaṇa vat katham anyathā nānā sāmagrī sattve samūha ālambanam ekam yat tu apara jñāna sāmagrī yadi tadā kārya avaśyaṃbhāvaḥ tat asattve kim karaṇa dharma tvena tasya sahakāri antara paryavasāyi tvāt iti tat na samūha ālambana sāmyāt karaṇasya ekadā eka mātra janaka tvena aparājanaka tayā tatra kāraṇa abhāvena eva sāmagrya sattvāt iti ced tarhi pañcasu yat ekam janayati na aparāṇi tatra niyāmakam āstheyam anyathā jñāna janane teṣām kalaham kaḥ samādadhyāt

kim ca evam yugapad jñānāni mā abhūvan yugapad jñānam tu kena vāryate eka samūha ālambana vat na ca cākṣuṣa tva ādi jāti saṃkara āpatteḥ na eka jñānam iti vācyam evam hi phala virodhena ekam api jñānam na janayet aviśeṣāt utpadyatām vā cākṣuṣa ādi vijātīyam jñānam sāmagrī sattvāt citra rūpavat phala balāt tatra tathā iti ced tarhi atra phala abhāve hetuḥ kalpyatām anyonya pratibandhakasya tattve vā jñānam eva na syāt na tu eka jñānam iti uktam

nanu cakṣuḥ ādi na saṃbhūya jana kam anya viṣaye anyasya asāmarthyāt śītam surabhi śubhram candanam iti atra iva kāraṇa antara anupanayanāt ca na ca sva sva viṣaya jñānāya udyatam indriyam kāraṇa antara sahakārāt tad tad viṣayam ādāya eva sva sva viṣayam jñāpayet iti vācyam bhinna viṣaya pramāṇānām saṃbhūya ajanaka tva niyamāt tat tat indriyam tad tat jñāna aṃśe janakam iti api na viṣayasya aṃśa tvāt iti ced

mā evam na hi indriyāṇām saṃbhūyakāri tvam kim tvā arthaḥ samājaḥ pratyeka jñāna sāmagrī sattvāt ekadā nānā jñāna prasaktau karaṇa dharma tvena manaḥ tāvat gocarām ekām eva jñāna kriyām utpādayet samūha ālambana vat na ca eka kriyā jananadaśāyāma para viṣaya kriyāyām manaḥ na samartham iti katham tām janayet iti vācyam bhinna kriyā āyām asāmarthye api eka kriyāyām sāmarthyāt

vastutas tu viśeṣa abhāvāt ekām iva aparām api buddhim janayet aviśeṣāt na ca ekām api iti aneka jñāna utpattiḥ jñānān utpattiḥ vā na tu eka viṣaya jñāna utpattiḥ iti niyāmakam āstheyam samūha ālambane phala balena paraspara apekṣita tvena ekā eva sāmagrī nanu manaḥ aṇu tve katham mandaḥ api bubhutsitaḥ śabdaḥ gṛhyate na anyaḥ atha śabde bubhutsā eva itara graha pratibandhikāḥ agrahasya tad anuvidhānāt ananya gatika kārya darśanāt bubhutsita śabda graha sāmagrī eva vā balavatī iti yadi manyase tadā vaibhave api tatas eva yugapad jñāna anutpattiḥ iti ced

mā evam bubhutsā na rūpa ādi grahe hetuḥ na vai itara grahe pratibandhika iti ukta tvāt kim ca rūpa ādi sakala bubhutsāyām paraspara pratibandhāt ajñānam bubhutsā adhīnasāmagrī balavat tvāt vā sarveṣām jñānam syāt na tu ekasya pañca avadhānasya sarveṣām jñānam bhavati eva iti ced na tatra api krama anumānāt anyathā sarva bubhutsa adhīnapraṇidhāne api anyeṣām katham na syāt nanu aṇu tve api daśabhiḥ paṭhyamānāsu gāthāsu tāvat gocara bubhutsāyām praṇidhāne ca ukta rītyā sarveṣām jñānam ajñānam vā na tu eka jñānam iti ced atra kaścid śrotra manassaṃyoge ātma manassaṃyoge vā kaścid viśeṣaḥ kārya unneyaḥ kiṃcid śabda grahe hetuḥ tad anya grahe pratibandhakaḥ iti

tat na vaibhave api indriya manassaṃyoga viśeṣasya tathā tve vyāsaṅga upapatteḥ anugata rūpa abhāvena prativyakti pratibandhaka tve hetu tve ca vyabhicārāt saṃyoge ca viśeṣasya jāti tve jāti saṃkaraḥ upādhi tve saḥ eva hetuḥ na manaḥ apare tu pratyakṣa anukūla indriya manassaṃyoga dvārā bubhutsā praṇidhānam ca pratyakṣa hetuḥ iti cākṣuṣa ādi bubhutsita grahe kḷpta tvāt tābhyām śrotre bubhutsita śabda avacchedena manaḥ saṃyujyate iti sa gṛhyate na anyaḥ kvacid praṇidhānam vinā eva tathā anyatra praṇidhāna adhīna kriyayā aśrūyamāṇa śabda avacchinna ātmanaḥ vibhajya bubhutsita śabda avacchedena manaḥ saṃyujyate iti tad grahaḥ na sarvasya iti

tad tuccham yugapad utpadyamānāsu viṃśatau gāthāsu tāvat gocara bubhutsāyām praṇidhāne ca tāvat gāthā avacchedena manassaṃyogāt i ugapad tāsām upalambha prasaṅgāt pratyeka sāmagrī sattvāt nikaṭa āhanyamāna ḍhakka ādi śabdānām śrotra vyāpaka tva niyamāt ca atha yatra kolāhale śrūyamāṇaḥ eva bubhutsita śabda grahaḥ tatra ubhaya śabda avacchedena manassaṃyogāt ubhaya grahaḥ kolāhale tu upekṣā jñānam tat iti tathā atrāpi iti ced tarhi kṛtam anayā kusṛṣṭyā abubhutsite upekṣā jñānam eva astu na ca tat api itas na śabda antaram aśrauṣam iti anubhavāt anyathā vaibhave api vyāsaṅga daśāyām itareṣām upekṣā jñānam eva iti

atra ucyate yadi api bubhutsā praṇidhāne na śabda graha mātre sahakāriṇī na vā itara graha pratibandhake tathā api nānā śabda samavāya daśāyām yaḥ śabda grahaḥ tatra tayoḥ tathā bhāvaḥ tathā eva tayoḥ anvaya vyatireka niyamāt yat vā kolāhale śrūyamāṇaḥ eva bubhutsita grahaḥ iti anye api kolāhala tvena tad viṣayāḥ eva bahūnām ca ekadā samavāye yugapad saṃnidhāne vā vyakti grahe tad gata gatvaka tva ādi grahaḥ na bhavati agṛhītaka tva ādi nānā śabdasya kolāhala buddhi viṣaya tvāt tasyām daśāyām bubhutsita śabdaka tva ādi jāti grahe bubhutsā eva śaraṇam eka kālīna bahu śabda bubhutsā ca na hetuḥ vyabhicārāt

yat tu kolāhalāt anyatra ekadā nānā śabda grahe śrotram na samartham kim tu eka śabda grahe vinigamikā bubhutsā eva iti tat na eka gīyamāna apekṣayā ekadā nānā gīya mānasajātīya gīta ādiṣu sukha ādi vailakṣaṇya anubhavāt atha dīrdha śaṣkulī bhakṣaṇe katham pañca jñānāni kramaḥ tatra iti ced na jñānānām yaugapadya pratyayasya bādhakam vinā pramātvāt vyāsaṅgaḥ bādhakaḥ iti ced tarhi manaḥ avayavi aḥ tu tena saṃkoca vikāsābhyām ubhayam upapadyate iti kecid

tat na yadi hi saṃkoca vikāsa hetuḥ adṛṣṭam tarhi tatas eva tat ubhayam astu kṛtam manasā na api eka pañca bubhutsayā tau bhavataḥ tasyāḥ ahetu tvāt hetu tve vā astu vibhu manaḥ avayavitaḥ laghu tvāt atha yathā kvacid bubhutsayā kvacid tīvra viṣaya indriya saṃnikarṣāt indriya manassaṃyogaḥ evam mana ssaṃkoca vikāsayoḥ bubhutsādikam hetuḥ iti ced tarhi pañca bubhutsāyām praṇidhāne ca sarvadā sarveṣām pañca jñānāni jāyeran pañca avadhāna jñāne kramaḥ eva

etena aṇu manaḥ pañcatayam astu avayavitaḥ laghu tvāt bubhutsā ādi vaśāt teṣām ekapañca indriya saṃbandhāt ubhayam upapadyate iti nirastam pañca bubhutsāyām sarveṣām pañca indriya saṃbandhe vyāsaṅga anupapatteḥ katham tarhi dīrgha śaṣkulī bhakṣaṇe gandha rasa rūpa sparśa śabdān pratyemi iti anuvyavasāyaḥ kramika jñāna pañcatayena yugapad manassaṃnikarṣa abhāvāt iti ced na anu vyavasāyasya ekatva asiddheḥ anuvyavasāyāḥ pañca eva samaya saukṣmyāt teṣām kramaḥ na gṛhyate

atha vā kramikā anuvyavasāya āhita saṃskārāt pañca jñāna viṣaya smṛtau anubhava tva āropāt yugapad pratyemi iti anuvyavasāyaḥ vibhu tve hetu abhāvāt ātma manassaṃyoga abhāvāt na ātma sukha ādi upalambhaḥ syāt dravya tvena ātma saṃyogi tva sādhane tu aja saṃyoga siddhau tatas eva tad vibhāgi tve api sarvadā tayoḥ paraspara viruddha saṃyoga vibhāga prasaṅgaḥ

nanu aṇu tve asamavāyi anurodhāt ceṣṭā hetu prayatnasya aṇu deśa tvam śarīra deśa mātra tvam vā syāt na tu śarīra tad ava yava deśa tvam yena kriyā niyamaḥ bhavet niyāmaka abhāvāt na ca nodana abhighātāt iva avyāpinaḥ api prayatnāt śarīra ādi kriyā atiprasaṅgāt evam ekadā viṃśati prayatna abhāvāt katham aṅgulīṣu viṃśatiḥ kriyāḥ na ca yaugapadya bhramaḥ bādhaka abhāvāt yugapad saṃnikarṣa abhāvena aṅgulyaḥ calanti iti samūha ālambana anupapatteḥ viṃśati jñānānām ekadā anu vyavasāya asaṃbhavāt agra paścāt bhāve vinigamaka abhāvāt ca krama utpāde ca bhrū nayana kara caraṇa ādi sakala śarīra avayavānām yugapad vicitra nānā karma samūha rūpam nṛtyam na pratyakṣam syāt tathā ca pratyeka karma janya sukhāt vilakṣaṇa sukha viśeṣaḥ na anubhūyeta iti

atra brūmaḥ sukhe candana ādi vat cikīrṣā eva niyāmikā yat kriyāyām cikīrṣā sā kriyā tad cikīrṣā janyāt prayatnāt bhavati tatra śarīra kriyā api tad cikīrṣā janyā t aṇu mātra deśāt api prayatnāt bhavati atha vā yasya kriyāyām cikīrṣā tad avacchedena prayatnaḥ utpadyate tena śarīra avacchedena utpanna prayatnāt eva śarīra kriyā evam viṃśati kriyā cikīrṣā janyā t aṇu mātra deśāt api prayatnāt viṃśati kriyāḥ yugapad utpadyante athavā aṅgulī viṃśati kriyāyām cikīrṣā iti viṃśati avacchedena viṃśati prayatna ādi viṃśati kriyā hetavaḥ utpadyante evam nṛtya ādau api etat cikīrṣā anuvidhānāt kriyā prayatnayoḥ adhyavaseyam tat evam aṇu mana ssiddhau tad grāhyāḥ ātma viśeṣa guṇāḥ buddhi sukha ādayaḥ iti na avyāpakam pratyakṣa lakṣaṇam

nanu vartamānam jñānam na mānasam kiṃtu svayam eva sva vyavahāra hetuḥ svasmin sati eva sva vyavahārāt na tu jñāna antaram apekṣate tad anvayatirekān anuvidhānāt jñāna antara viraha daśāyām sva virahāt eva sva vyavahāra virahāt svatas eva sva vyavahāra upapattau jñāna antara kalpane gauravāt ca ghaṭa ādi vyavahāre jñāna anvaya vyatirekāt aḥ tu tad apekṣā svīyam atītam anāgatam parakīyam ca jñānam sva vyavahāre jñāna antaram apekṣate eva vyavahāra kāle tad abhāvāt jñāna antara anvaya vyatireka anuvidhānāt ca

nanu evam icchā ādikam api sva vyavahāra jñānam na apekṣeta jñāna tulya tayā svayam eva sva vyavahāra śakta tvāt iti ced na vyavahārasya jñāna janya tva niyamena icchā ādi vyavahāre jñāna apekṣaṇāt atha jñāna mātram na vyavahāra hetuḥ atiprasaṅgāt kiṃtu vyavahartavya viṣayam iti jñāna vyavahāraḥ api tad viṣaya jñāna antarāt bhavet iti ced satyam svasya eva sva viṣayaka tvāt yat vyavahāra anukūla śakti yogi yat jñānam tasya eva tad viṣayaka tvāt śaktiḥ ca padārtha antaram na kāraṇa tā iti na anyonya āśrayaḥ sva vyavahāre jñānam śaktam iti sva viṣayakam vyavahāra śakti samavāya ādayaḥ ca svabhāvataḥ eva tadīyāḥ saṃbandha antare api anavasthānāt svabhāvaḥ eva śaraṇam

etena bheda niyataḥ viṣaya viṣayi bhāvaḥ katham abhede iti nirastam sva vyavahāra śakta tvasya sva viṣaya tvasya abhede api saṃbhavāt astu vā jñānasya svabhāva viśeṣaḥ eva sva viṣaya tvam saṃbandham vinā eva svabhāva viśeṣāt yathā jñānam ghaṭīyam ghaṭa vyavahāra janana yogyam svīyam api tathā kaḥ asau svabhāva viśeṣaḥ iti ced na ākhyātum aśakyatve api anubhava siddhasya svabhāva viśeṣasya mādhurya ādi viśeṣa vat pratyākhyātum aśakyatvāt yadi api svabhāva viśeṣaḥ iti vākyena ākhyāyate eva tathā api padena ākhyātum aśakyatvāt

atha vyavahāraḥ vyavahartavya bhinna jñāna sādhyaḥ katham tena vinā syāt iti ced na vyavahāram prati vyavaharta vyajñāna tvena hetu tvāt na tu vyavahartavya bhinna jñāna tvena gauravāt samūha ālambanam ca ekaika vyavahāra janaka tvāt ekaika viṣayakam api na tu samūha viṣayakam eva atiriktasya tasya asattvena saṃnikarṣa abhāvāt

bhrama sthale rajata vyavahāra anukūlā śaktiḥ asti eva rajata jñāne kim tu doṣāt abhibhūtā eva sā jāyate iti na tayā rajate vyavahāraḥ rajata jñānam na śuktau pravartakam kim tu indriya janyam idaṃjñānam eva rajata arthi pravṛtti artham tu upasthita rajata bheda agraham apekṣate iti rajata jñānam kāraṇa tāvacchedakam evam ca sva viṣaya tvam sva prakāśa tvam na tu sva vyavahāre jñāna antara anapekṣa tvam gauravāt anyathā jñānasya svāviṣaya tvena saṃskāra abhāvāt smaraṇam na syāt

yat tu sva vyavahāre jñāna antara anapekṣa tvam uktam tad sva prakāśa tva nirvāhaka tayā pramāṇam ca sva prakāśe pratyakṣam eva sarvāḥ pratītaye idam aham jānāmi iti evam ākārāḥ jñātāram jñānam jñeyam ca ullikhantyaḥ jāyante tatra ātmā kartṛ tvena jñeyam karma tayā jñānam kriyā tvena bhāsate atas jñātṛ jñeya sva viṣayam jñānam anubhūyate iti tripuṭī pratyakṣa vādinaḥ

nanu idam iti vyāvasāyaḥ tat uttaram idam aham jānāmi iti anuvyavasāyaḥ mānasaḥ iti ced na sva prakāśa tvena upapattau jñāna antara kalpane gauravāt pariśeṣāt ca sva prakāśa tvam para prakāśa tve hi jñānam eva na sidhyet māna abhāvāt na hi tatra jñāta tā liṅgam atīta anāgatayoḥ tad abhāvāt na api mānasam pratyakṣam ajijñāsitasya mānasa tve jñāna avirāmāt anavasthānāt viṣaya antara asaṃcārat ca jijñāsitasya grāhya tve jñānam na mānasam jijñāsā grāhi a ātma dharma tvāt saṃskāra vat iti anumāna pratirodhaḥ atas eva jijñāsām vinā eva sukha ādīnām mānasa tvam

jijñāsā api jñāna sādhya iti anavasthā dharmi jñāna icchā ādibhiḥ jñānasya nāśāt ca na pratyakṣa tvam atha jñānam mānasa pratyakṣam pratyakṣa ātma guṇa tvāt ātma viśeṣa guṇa tve sati kṣaṇa mātra sthāyi tvāt sukha vat jñānam pratyakṣa janaka indriya saṃnikarṣa āśrayaḥ pratyakṣa tvāt sukha vat iti ced na mānasa tve anavasthānāt

atas eva cakṣuḥ janyam jñānam na cakṣuḥ janya jñāna viṣayaḥ pratyakṣa tvāt rāsana vat na etat jñāna viṣayaḥ vā etat janaka indriya saṃnikarṣān āśraya tvāt gagana vat cakṣuḥ na cākṣuṣa jñāna grāhakam bahis indriya tvāt rasana vat iti pratipakṣa anumānam apāstam para prakāśa tve anavasthayā jñāna asiddhau āśraya asiddheḥ sva prakāśa tvena tad siddhau dharmi grāhaka māna bādhāt kim ca sva vyavahāra śakta tvam sva viṣaya tvam tat ca sva saṃnikarṣā janya tve svājanya tve ca na viruddham na ca sva vyavahāre śakta tvasya abhāvaḥ eva sādhyaḥ aprayojaka tvāt sva saṃnikarṣā janye svājanye vyavahāra śakte ghaṭa ādau vyabhicārāt ca

atas eva sva prakāśa tvena pūrva anubhava viṣaya tā tat tānubhūta mātra viṣaye smaraṇe utsargataḥ bhāsate jñāna antarasya anāvaśyaka tvāt svasya svājanya tve katham sva karmatā iti ced na atīta anāgatayoḥ iva sva viṣaya tvam na tu karma tvam viṣaya tvam ca abhede api sva vyavahāra śakta tvasya jñāna svabhāva viśeṣasya vā viṣaya tvāt na ca adhīkarma tayā śaśaśrṛṅga vat asattvam tasya kadāpi aprakāśāt dhī janya vyavahāra bhāgi tvam karma tvam sva prakāśe api tad anya phala bhāgi tvam ca ghaṭe api asiddham jñāta tā niṣedhāt jñāna anapekṣa indriya saṃnikarṣa jam jñānam pratyakṣam atas sarvam jñānam jñāna anapekṣa ātma manassaṃnikarṣa janya tvena sva ātmani pratyakṣam viśiṣṭa pratyakṣam ca na viśeṣaṇa jñāna janyam nirvikalpaka niṣedhāt

sa vikalpaka tvena jñāna ajanya jñānam vā pratyakṣam tena nirvikalpaka janyam jāti viśiṣṭa jñānam pratyakṣam na tu asādhāraṇa indriya ādi karaṇakam tena vinā api anumiti ādau sva ātma prakāśāt indriya ādikam tu artha prakāśaḥ eva hetuḥ tasya eva tad pratibaddha hetu janya tvāt iti atra ucyate pratyakṣam na sva prakāśe pramāṇam vyavasāyānām idam aham jānāmi iti ākāra asiddheḥ na ca evam anubhava virodhaḥ artha niścayena pravṛtti ādi darśanāt vyavasāyasya artha viṣaya tva mātram anubhūyate na tu sva viṣaya tvam api gauraveṇa tasya sva viṣaya bhāna tayā pravṛtti ahetutvāt anubhavaḥ api idam rajatam iti ādi eva

na ca evam idam aham jānāmi iti anubhava apalāpe upekṣaṇīyatā vyavasāya uttara kālam tad upagamāt idam rajatam iti ādi laukika anubhavāt vyavasāyasya tat ākāra tām niṣedhāmaḥ na tu anuvyavasāyasya nanu bhinna anuvyavasāye anavasthānāt vyavasāyaḥ eva anuvyavasāyaḥ iti ced tarhi para prakāśe bādhakāt sva prakāśa tva siddhau sarva pratītīnām idam aham jānāmi iti ākāra tā siddhiḥ tathā ca sva prakāśa tva asiddhau sarva pratītīnām idam aham jānāmi iti ākāra tvam asiddham iti na sā pratītiḥ sva prakāśa tve pramāṇam

api ca kriyāyāḥ kṛteḥ vā samavāyi tvam kartṛ tvam para samaveta kriyā phala śali tvam karaṇa vyāpāra viṣaya tvam vā karma tvam dhātvartha tvam anyat vā kriyā tvam idam aham jānāmi iti vyavasāye na bhāsate tad bodhaka indriya saṃnikarṣa abhāvāt kim tu idaṃviṣaya ka jñāna tva viśiṣṭasya jñānasya vaiśiṣṭyam ātmani bhāsate na ca sva prakāśe vyavasāye tādṛśam svasya vaiśiṣṭyam bhāsitum arhati pūrvam viśeṣaṇasya tasya ajñānāt tasmāt idam aham jānāmi iti na vyavasāyaḥ kiṃtu anuvyavasāyaḥ

syāt etat kartṛ tva ādi jñāna vaiśiṣṭyam ātmani mā jñāyi vyavahārasya sva viṣaya ka jñāna sādhya tva siddhau tat eva jñānam sva viṣayakam kalpyate lāghavāt jñāna vitti vedyaḥ ātmā api tad viṣayaḥ iti ātma viṣaya tvam sarva vittīnām iti ced na sva janaka indriya saṃnikarṣān āśraya tvena svasya svāviṣaya tvāt viṣaya tva niyāmaka indriya saṃnikarṣa ādeḥ abhāve sva viṣaya tva anupapatteḥ kāraṇam vinā kārya anutpādāt pratyakṣa ajanakasya pratyakṣa viṣaya tva anupapateḥ ca ātma dharma pratyāsatti anāśraye pratyakṣa viṣaya tāyāḥ janakatva vyāpta tvāt jñānasya pratyakṣa tvena indriya saṃnikarṣa āśraya tvāt manassaṃnikarṣa janya tvena māna satvam

tat ayam prayogaḥ vivāda adhyāsitam indriya janyam jñānam na etat jñāna viṣaya āśrayaḥ etat janaka indriya saṃnikarṣān āśraya tvāt etat ajanaka tvāt vā asaṃnikṛṣṭa vat na etat jñāna viṣayakam vā ātma dharma pratyāsatti anāśraya tve sati etat ajanya tve ca sati sākṣātkāri tvāt pratyakṣa viṣayaḥ jñānam sva pratyakṣa janaka indriya saṃnikarṣa āśrayaḥ pratyakṣa viṣaya tvāt iti manassaṃnikarṣa grāhyam cākṣuṣam jñānam na cakṣuḥ janya jñāna viṣayaḥ cakṣuḥ asaṃnikṛṣṭa tvāt ghaṭa vat jñānam prameyam eva iti vyāpti jñānam jñāna tva pratyāsattyā sva viṣayam īśvara jñānam ahetuka tvena sarva viṣaya tvāt sva prakāśam

nanu para prakāśaka tve jñānam eva na sidhyet anavasthānāt iti dharmi grāhaka mānāt sva prakāśa tva siddhau ananya gatika tayā svasya asaṃnikṛṣṭasya api pratyakṣa viṣaya tvam atas dharmi grāhaka māna bādhitāḥ tvadīya hetavaḥ iti ced na vitteḥ avaśya vedya tva abhāvena anavasthā vigamāt saṃyukta samavāyena manaḥ vedya tva abhāvāt apekṣaṇīya antara abhāvāt ca utpannā eva kutas na avaśya vedyā iti ced na sukha ādi tad buddhi ādi sāmagryā pratibandhāt viṣaya antara saṃcāra darśanena tasyāḥ balavat tvāt anudbhavāt iti kecid

yogi ātma viśeṣa guṇa tvāt jñāna tvāt jñānam pratyakṣam eva iti vyāpteḥ vitteḥ avaśya vedya tvena sva prakāśa tvam iti ced na vyāpteḥ asiddheḥ para prakāśaka tve anavasthānāt sva prakāśe kāraṇa anupapatteḥ saṃnikṛṣṭam eva pratyakṣam tat viṣaya janyam eva pratyakṣam iti vyāpteḥ ca anyathā kāraṇam vinā kāryān utpatti vyāpteḥ vinigamakam kāraṇa sattve api pratibandhāt kārya anutpāde kāraṇa tvam apratyūhyam kḷpta kāraṇam vinā kārya utpāde kāraṇa tā bhaṅgaḥ kārya anutpādaḥ ca

api ca para prakāśe anavasthānāt pariśeṣa anumānena jñānasya sva prakāśa tvam tathā ca sva prakāśa tva anumiteḥ api sva prakāśa tvam anum iti antaragamyam evam tasya api iti anavasthā sva prakāśa tva anumiti paramparā dvārā tava api syāt viṣaya antara saṃcārasya pratibandhaka tvam yāvat jijñāsam vā sva prakāśa tva anumitiḥ iti yadi tulyam para prakāśa tve api na ca jñānam sva prakāśam iti anumityā sva prakāśa tvam api sāmānya pratyāsattyā viṣayīkṛtam iti vācyam paratas pakṣe api tulya tvāt tvayā tad anabhyupagamāt ca

kim ca anum iti ādau jāti saṅkarāt na pratyakṣa tvam na ca jñāna sāpekṣam manaḥ janakam iti anumiti viṣaya vat ātmani na tat pratyakṣam tasya sva viṣaya tve jñānān apekṣā iti ced na jñānam jñāna janyam tat ca sva viṣaye sva ātmani ekam eva iti katham tad apekṣam tad anapekṣam ca viruddha tvāt na ca jñāna bhinna viṣaya tvam sa apekṣam tathā tve bahis jñānam pratyakṣam na syāt

atha anyasya anya viṣaya tve saṃnikarṣa ādiḥ niyāmakaḥ sva viṣaya tve kim tena anatiprasaṅgāt saṃnikarṣasya ananugamāt ca vyavahāre śakta tvam viṣaya tvam abhede saṃnikarṣam vinā api iti ced na anyatra pratyakṣa mātre saṃnikarṣasya hetu tvāt anyathā ananugamāpattiḥ atha yā vittiḥ na vedyā sā pramāṇa abhāvāt asatī iti tad adhīna sattvasya viṣaya paryantasya asattvam syāt iti ced na avirala lagna tad vitti vitti dhārā na abhyupeyate kim nāma kenacid kadācid kācid vittiḥ vyavahāra smaraṇa liṅga ādinā pratīyate iti sarvā pramāṇa siddhā eva iti abhyupagamāt

atha syāt evam yadi ghaṭaḥ ayam ghaṭam aham jānāmi iti atas adhikā ghaṭa vat vitti dhārā vāhi viṣaya śata bhāra mantharā kācid vittiḥ asmad ādeḥ utpadyamānā anubhūyeta na ca evam iti ced na anuvyavasāyaḥ viṣaya mātra nirūpyaḥ na tu tad viṣaya paraṃparā nirūpyaḥ gauravāt tathā ca jñāna jñāna tvena sarvāḥ vittiḥ asmad ādeḥ utpadyamānāḥ anubhūyate eva na ca evam anirmokṣaḥ yoga ja dharma pratyāsattyā sāmānya lakṣaṇayā vā vyāpti jñāna rūpasya ananu vyavasāyasya api sva viṣaya tva abhyupagamāt na ca tad vyavahāra śakta tvam tat viṣaya tvam tad viṣaya tvena tad vyavahāra kāraṇa tva grahe sati tad śakta tva jñānam tad śakta tvam ca tat viṣaya tvam iti anyonya āśrayāt kāraṇa tva graham vinā śakteḥ agrahāt tvad mate api rajata jñānasya śukti viṣaya tva āpatteḥ ca rajata arthi pravṛttau rajata jñānam hetuḥ na tu tad avacchedakam iti ukta tvāt lāghavena sva viṣaye jñānasya pravartaka tvam sarvaiḥ eva adya pravṛttau tathā avagamāt iti ced hanta evam anyathā ākhyātiḥ astu na tu anyathā siddha rajata jñānasya apravartaka tvam iti

etena yathā tad guṇa saṃvijñāna bahu vrīhi siddham kuṭādi padam aśakyam api kuṭam gaṇam ādāya eva pradhānam anya padārtham bodhayati tathā jñānam aviṣayam api ātmānam ādāya eva sva viṣaye vyavahāram karoti saṃskāram ca sva janya vyavahāra viṣaye jñānasya saṃskāra janaka tvāt sva janya vyavahāra viṣayaḥ sva ātmā viṣayaḥ ca iti prācīnam guru matam apāstam anyatra lāghavena jñānasya sva viṣaye vyavahāra saṃskāra janaka tva kalpanāt sva viṣaye sva ātmani vyavahāra saṃskāra ajanaka tvāt vyavahāra saṃskārayoḥ sva viṣaya jñāna sādhya tvena sva aviṣayaka jñāna asādhya tvāt

nanu jñānasya mānasa tve katham jānāmi iti viśiṣṭa buddhiḥ jñāna tva nirvikalpaka janya jñā na kṣaṇe viśeṣya abhāvena pratyakṣān utpatteḥ iti ced na jñāna nā śa kṣaṇe eva jñāne jñāna tva viśiṣṭa buddhiḥ viśeṣyasya pūrva kṣaṇa sattvāt pratyakṣe sva samaya varti tayā gauraveṇa viśeṣyasya ahetutvāt jānāmi iti vartamāna tvena sthūlaḥ upādhiḥ bhāsate na tu kṣaṇaḥ tasya atīndriya tvāt tatas jñāna viśiṣṭa buddhiḥ ātmani viśeṣaṇa jñānasya pūrva sattvāt viśeṣaṇam ca na viśiṣṭa pratyaya hetuḥ gauravāt kim tu tat jñānam āvaśyaka tvāt atas eva tat tām vinā api tad buddheḥ pratyabhijñā

yat tu vyavasāyana aśakṣaṇa utpanna vyavasāya antare jñāna tva viśiṣṭa buddhiḥ iti tat na tad hetoḥ abhāvāt anuminomi iti ādau anuvyavasāye anumiti tva abhāvāt ca yat vā jñānam jñāna tvam ca nirvikalpake bhāsate tatas jñāna tva vaiśiṣṭyam jñāne jñāna vaiśiṣṭyam ca ātmani bhāsate viśeṣye viśeṣaṇam viśeṣaṇe viśeṣaṇa antaram ca bhāsate iti eva hi viśiṣṭa vaiśiṣṭya arthaḥ

vastutas tu jñānam abhāvaḥ iva viśiṣṭa jñāna viṣayaḥ eva anuvyavasāyasya viṣaya rūpa viśeṣaṇa viṣaya kavya vasāya sādhya tvena viśiṣṭa jñāna sāmagrī sattvāt jñāna tvam api tatra bhāsate tad jñāna sāmagrī sattvāt aṃśe tad sa prakārakam niṣprakārakam ca iti narasiṃha ākāram tatra eva viśiṣṭa jñāne jñāna tva vaiśiṣṭyam bhāsate anuminomi iti ādau tu na tathā anuvyavasāye anumiti tva abhāvāt iti

tat ca pratyakṣam dvividham nirvikalpakam sa vikalpakam ca iti tatra nāma jāti ādi yojanā rahitam vaiśiṣṭyānavagāhi niṣprakārakam nirvikalpakam nanu jñāna tvam sa vikalpaka bhinna vṛtti iti atra kim mānam na pratyakṣam asiddheḥ atīndriya tva abhyupagamāt ca na ca vyavahāraḥ tasya sa vikalpaka sādhya tvāt na api idam na vivecitam pūrvam adhunā vivecayāmi iti anubhava pramāṇaka ava ālocana vikalpau bahu viśeṣaṇa jñāna ajñānābhyām tad upapatteḥ

nanu gauḥ iti pratyakṣam viśeṣaṇa jñāna janyam viśiṣṭa jñāna tvāt anumiti vat iti atha viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya jñāna sāmagrītaḥ sa ākāṅkṣa ubhaya viṣayam ekam viśiṣṭa jñānam tatra pratyakṣe yogya indriya saṃnikarṣāt anumitau pakṣa dharma tā balāt vyāpaka tva avacchedaka prakāreṇa śābde yogyatā ādi vaśāt padārtha tāvacchedaka rūpeṇa apūrvam eva viśeṣaṇam bhāsate upamitau api evam eva iti na kvāpi viśeṣaṇa jñānam janakam na ca pratyabhijñāyām tat ta anubhavaḥ tathā tat tānubhave api saṃskārasya anudbodhāt vilopāt vā pratyabhijñāna anutpādena udbuddhaḥ saṃskāraḥ eva pratyāsatti tayā viśeṣaṇa jñāna artham indriya sahakārī surabhi candanam iti ādau api viśeṣaṇa jñāna artham tat jñānam pratyāsatti sthānīyam indriya sahakāri bhramaḥ viśiṣṭa jñānam eva na asti iti ced

ucyate sādhya prasiddhi padārtha upasthiti vācya tva jñāna tatta anubhavānām anum iti ādi hetu tvam sādhya prasiddhi ādikam vinā anumiti ādeḥ asaṃbhavāt sādhya ādikam ca viśeṣaṇam iti tat jñāna manum iti ādi hetuḥ yadi api anumiti ādi pratyekam prati sādhya ādi viśeṣaṇa jñāna tvena na kāraṇa tā tathā api viśiṣṭa jñāna mātram prati viśeṣaṇa jñāna tvena kāraṇa tā bādhaka abhāvāt

syāt etat vahnimān itya ādi jñānam prati vahni jñānasya na viśeṣaṇa jñāna tvena kāraṇa tā dravya tvena vahni jñāne api vahnimān iti jñāna abhāvāt kim tu viśeṣaṇa tāvacchedaka prakāraka jñāna tvena atas na viśiṣṭa jñāne viśeṣaṇa jñānam hetuḥ viśeṣaṇa jñāna tvam api tatra asti iti ced na tasya atiprasakta tvāt anyathā siddheḥ ca na ca tādṛśa viśeṣaṇa jñāna janya tvam sādhyam bādhāt iti

tat na viśiṣṭa vaiśiṣṭya jñānam prati hi viśeṣaṇa tāvacchedaka prakārakam jñānam kāraṇam ubhaya siddham atas viśiṣṭa jñāna mātram prati viśeṣaṇa jñānam hetuḥ yad viśeṣayoḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ tad sāmānyayoḥ api bādhakam vinā kārya kāraṇa bhāva niyamāt anyathā sāmānya kārya ucchedaḥ na ca atiprasaṅgaḥ viśeṣa sāmagrī viraheṇa tad tad kārya viśeṣān udayāt na ca parokṣa tvam upādhiḥ pratyabhijñāyām sādhya avyāpaka tvāt na api viśiṣṭa viśeṣaṇaka tvam pakṣa itara tvāt iti mā evam tava api smṛti vat pūrva anubhavasya saṃskāra dvārā janaka tvāt siddha sādhanāt na ca avyavahita viśeṣaṇa jñāna janya tvam sādhyam aprayojaka tvāt pratyabhijñāvat smṛtyā eva upapatteḥ vā na api tatas eva avyavahita viśeṣaṇa anubhava janya tvam sādhyam aprasiddheḥ pratyabhijñāna ādau vyabhicārāt ca

atha tad kāla utpanna rūpa ādi viśiṣṭa pratyakṣe saṃskāra abhāvena smaraṇa abhāvāt pakṣa dharmatā balena nirvikalpaka siddhau anyatra api sāmagrī taulyāt tad siddhiḥ iti ced na pratyutpanna viśeṣaṇa sthale hi śukla tva ādi viśiṣṭa śukla vaiśiṣṭya bodhaḥ vā aviśiṣṭa tad viśiṣṭa bodhaḥ vā ādye śukla tva ādi smaraṇam prathamam tatas pratyakṣeṇa tad viśiṣṭa śukla bodhaḥ tatas śukla tva ādi viśiṣṭa śuklāḥ divaiśiṣṭya bodhaḥ dravyaḥ iti kim anupapannam śukla tva ādi jāti smaraṇam eva vā sāmānya lakṣaṇayā sakala rūpa ādi viṣayam astu dvitīye ananubhavaḥ na hi śukla tva ādi pratyaya vilakṣaṇam śukla rūpa ādi viśiṣṭa bodham kaścid anubhavati

atha jāgara ādi aviśiṣṭa anubhavaḥ viśeṣaṇa jñāna janyaḥ viśiṣṭa jñāna tvāt na ca tatra saṃskāra dvārā pūrva viśeṣaṇa anubhavaḥ tad janya viśeṣaṇa smaraṇam vā tatra saṃbhavati udbodhakam vinā saṃskārasya smaraṇe viśiṣṭa bodhe vā sāmarthya abhāvāt iti udbodhakam vaktavyam udbodhakam ca anyatra jñānam dṛṣṭam iti tat eva vācyam na ca tad viśiṣṭa jñānam eva tatra api viśeṣaṇa jñāna apekṣāyām anavasthā patteḥ iti ālocana siddhiḥ iti tat na sati api jñāne saṃskārān udbodhāt yasmāt phalam bhavati sa jñāna viśeṣaḥ tathā iti ced

na ananugata tvāt yad anantaram phalam dṛśyate tat eva ananugatam api udbodhakam kalpyate phala balāt iti ced tarhi jāgara kāraṇa anantaram saṃskāra udbodhaḥ asti iti tat eva kāraṇam astu kḷpta tvāt atas eva saṃskāra udbodhe na niyataḥ hetuḥ iti sadṛśa adṛṣṭa cintā ādyāḥ smṛti bodhakā iti āhuḥ evam ca praṇidhāna ādi sūtram api saṃgacchate api ca viśiṣṭa jñāna tvāt iti atra vyavacchedyam aviśiṣṭa jñānam tat ca aprasiddham siddhau vā vyartham anumānam jñāna tvam ca svataḥ asiddha vyāptikam nirvikalpake vyabhicārāt anavasthā pātāt ca

kim ca viśiṣṭa jñāna tvam na tāvat vastu gatyā viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya viṣaya ka jñāna tvam ālocanena vyabhicārāt na api viśeṣaṇa tva viṣayaka tvam atad vyāvṛtti bodha janaka jñāna viṣaya tvasya viśeṣaṇa tvasya tatra aprakāśāt na api vaiśiṣṭya viṣaya ka jñāna tvam tathā sati gauḥ iti vikalpe vaiśiṣṭyam viśeṣaṇam iti ālocanasya api tad viṣaya tvena viśiṣṭa jñāna tve anavasthā pātāt iti

na api sa prakāraka jñāna tvam prakāraḥ ca viṣaya tā viśeṣaḥ iti vācyam jñāna viṣaya svarūpa atiriktāyāḥ viṣaya tāyāḥ abhāvāt na ca viśeṣaṇa jñāna janya tvam sa prakāra tvam yad viśeṣaṇa jñāna janyam yat saḥ eva tatra prakāraḥ iti gauḥ iti vikalpe tasya eva sādhya tvāt īśvara jñānasya niṣprakāraka tva āpātāt ca na api atad vyāvṛtti viṣaya tvam viśiṣṭa jñāna tvam apohavāt anirāsena gauḥ iti vikalpe tathā tva asiddheḥ na api atad vyāvṛtti bodha janaka tvam tat ālocana vyāvṛtta anugata rūpam antareṇa atad vyāvṛtta bodha janaka tvasya grahītum aśakyatvāt na ca gauḥ iti jñānam etat anya sa vikalpakāni ajñāna bhinnam prameya tvāt yat vā cakṣuḥ cākṣuṣa sa vikalpaka jñāna atirakta jñāna janakam indriya tvāt iti tad siddhiḥ aprayojaka tvāt ubhayatra sa vikalpaka pada anantaram nirvikalpaka ādi pada prakṣepeṇa tṛtīya ādi jñāna siddhi prasaṅgāt ca iti

atra ucyate prāthamikam gauḥ iti pratyakṣam jñānam janya viśeṣaṇa jñāna janyam janya viśiṣṭa jñāna tvāt anumiti vat na ca smaraṇam tatra saṃbhavati tad janmani tena go tvasya ananubhavāt atha yathā bālasya adya pravṛtti balāt prāc bhavīya saṃskārāt vyāpti smaraṇam tathā iha api janmāntarīya saṃskārāt go tva smaraṇam astu prāthamika viśiṣṭa jñāna balāt iti ced na jīvana adṛṣṭena tatra saṃskāra udbodhāt tathā astu iha tu na vilakṣaṇam udbodhakam asti atas go tva asaṃnikarṣe api go tva smaraṇa prasaṅgaḥ yaḥ eva go tva indriya saṃnikarṣaḥ tava nirvikalpake hetuḥ saḥ eva saṃskāra udbodhakaḥ iti ced tarhi atra kḷpta kāraṇa bhāvāt go tva indriya saṃnikarṣāt go tva anubhavaḥ eva syāt smaraṇa sāmagrītaḥ anubhava sām agryāḥ balavat tvāt na ca tad viśiṣṭa jñānam pūrvam viśeṣaṇa jñāna abhāvāt iti arthān nirvikalpakam atas eva na tatra jñāna tvena viśiṣṭa jñāna tva anumānam kāraṇa bādhena bādhāt yadi ca anubhava sām agrītaḥ smaraṇam tadā nityānām vaidika arthānām ca smaraṇam syāt na tu anubhavaḥ

na ca go tva jñānam go tva jñāna janyam janya jñāna janyam janya viśeṣaṇa jñāna janyam ca iti anyatra darśanāt prathamam na go tva anubhavaḥ iti vācyam ekasya eva janya janaka tvā anavacchedaka tvāt anavasthā pātāt ca nanu gauḥ iti atra go tva vaiśiṣṭyam gavi bhāsate tathā ca tat viṣayakam jñānam syāt tat ca nirvikalpakam iti ced go tvam hi tatra viśeṣaṇam na tu tad vaiśiṣṭyam nanu tathābhūta viśeṣaṇa dhī janya viśiṣṭa jñāne viśeṣaṇam svadharma viśiṣṭam katham bhāseta pūrvam tasya anavagamāt avagame vā tasya api viśeṣaṇa antaravataḥ viśeṣaṇam iti anavasthā iti ced na gauḥ iti viśiṣṭa jñāne viśiṣṭasya go tvasya ābhānāt

atha sarvam viśeṣaṇam viśeṣaṇa vat eva go tva ādau api vyakti ādeḥ viśeṣaṇa tvāt iti ced astu tathā kim tu viśeṣaṇam viśeṣaṇa vat eva bhāseta iti na niyamaḥ anyathā gauḥ iti jñāne viśeṣaṇa tad viśeṣaṇa ananta paraṃpara aviṣaya tve viṣaya aparyavasāna prasaṅgaḥ kvacid nirviśeṣaṇasya api bhāne prathamatas api tathā syāt aviśeṣāt na ca viśiṣṭa jñāna tvāt iti atra hetoḥ vyartha viśeṣaṇa tvam yena viśeṣaṇena vinā vyāptiḥ grahītum na śakyate tasya eva sārthaka tvāt vyabhicāra vārakasya api sārthaka tve etat eva mūlam iha api jñāna tva viśeṣaṇa jñāna janya tvayoḥ viśeṣaṇam vinā vyāptiḥ grahītum na śakyate anavasthānāt sāmānyatas vyabhicāra avagamāt

atas eva cakṣuḥ taijasa tva ādi sādhane rūpa ādiṣu madhye rūpasya eva vyañjaka tvāt ityādau asiddhivārakam api viśeṣaṇam sārthakam tena vinā rūpasya eva vyañjaka tva āditi asya aprasiddheḥ vyāpti agrahāt viśeṣaṇam vinā api yatra vyāpti grahaḥ tatra vyartha viśeṣaṇa tvam yathā nīladhūma tva śarīra ajanya tva ādau yasya yatra yaḥ saṃbandhaḥ saḥ eva tatra tasya vaiśiṣṭyam tena hi sva asaṃbaddhebhyaḥ vyāvṛttaḥ bodhyate yathā daṇḍī puruṣaḥ iti jñāne daṇḍa saṃbandhaḥ puruṣe avagataḥ iti tena ayam adaṇḍa vyāvṛttaḥ bodhyate tathā gauḥ iti vikalpe api tathā ca viśeṣaṇa vat viśeṣya jñāna tvam viśiṣṭa jñāna tvam etat eva ātad vyāvṛtta bodha janaka tā avacchedakam

nanu daṇḍa puruṣa saṃbandhāḥ iti atra api daṇḍa saṃbandhaḥ puruṣe avagataḥ iti tatas api adaṇḍa vyāvṛtta puruṣa bodhaḥ syāt iti ced bhavati eva daṇḍa saṃbandhaḥ eva puruṣe daṇḍa jñānam vinā na jñāyate iti brūmaḥ yatra viśiṣṭa jñāna sāmagrī na asti tatra nirvikalpakam jñāna karaṇa janye sarvatra viśeṣaṇa jñāna janya tvāt na tat iti pratyakṣam eva etat iti

atas eva abhāve na nirvikalpakam tad buddhau pratiyogi adhikaraṇa jñānayoḥ kāraṇa tvena tad ubhaya viśiṣṭa jñāna sāmagrī niyamāt yadi abhāve na nirvikalpakam tadā ghaṭa abhāvavat bhū talam iti jñānam na syāt viśeṣaṇa jñānam vinā tad abhāvāt bhāve vā na nirvikalpaka siddhiḥ viśiṣṭa jñāna tvasya tatra eva vyabhicārāt iti ced na prathamam bhū tale ghaṭaḥ na asti iti buddhiḥ tatra bhū talam viśeṣaṇam abhāvaḥ viśeṣyaḥ viśeṣya jñānam ca na kāraṇam paścāt bhū tala viśeṣyakam ghaṭa abhāva vat iti jñānam

nanu indriya saṃbaddha viśeṣaṇa tayā abhāvaḥ gṛhyate iti uktam atas katham sa viśeṣyaḥ iti ced bhū tala viśeṣaṇa tayā svabhāva pratyāsattyā gṛhyate iti tad arthaḥ na tu abhāvasya viśeṣaṇa tayā bhāmam iti atas eva vāyau rūpa abhāvaḥ iti pratīteḥ cākṣuṣa tvam uktam ācāryaiḥ ayogya viśeṣye indriyasya asāmarthyāt jñāna tve ca nirvikalpakam viṣaya viśiṣṭa tva aṃśe sa vikalpakam api anuvyavasāyasya vyavasāya janya tvena niyamataḥ pūrvam viṣaya rūpa viśeṣaṇa bhānāt tatra eva jñāne tat eva jñānam niṣprakārakam sa prakārakam ca iti na viruddham aṃśa bhedam ādāya avirodhāt atas eva nirvikalpaka tva savikalpaka tve na jātī cākṣuṣa tva ādinā saṃkara āpatteḥ gauḥ iti sa vikalpakam api go tva aṃśe nirvikalpakam eva tatra prakāra ābhānāt bhāne vā anavasthā nirvikalpakā siddhiḥ ca

prakāraḥ ca dvividhaḥ viśeṣaṇa upalakṣaṇa bhedāt nanu vyāvartaka tva aviśeṣe katham tayoḥ bhedaḥ vyāvartaka tve sati sat viśeṣaṇam asat upalakṣaṇam yathā daṇḍī puruṣaḥ kuruṇā kṣetram iti ced na kāka vat devadatta gṛham jaṭābhiḥ tāpasaḥ iti ādau upari bhrāmyataḥ kākasya jaṭā ādeḥ asattve api aviśeṣaṇa tvāt upalakṣaṇa tvāt ca

etena vyāvṛtti bodha kāle vyāvartakam sat viśeṣaṇam asat upalakṣaṇam tena kāka ādīnām vyāvṛtti bodha samaye satām viśeṣaṇa tvam eva vyāvṛtti bodha samaye asatām upalakṣaṇa tvam atas eva kākaiḥ jaṭābhiḥ kuruṇā iti ādau itthaṃbhūta lakṣaṇe tṛtīyā iti nirastam vyāvṛtti bodha samaye sataḥ api upari bhramataḥ kāka ādeḥ aviśeṣaṇa tvāt upalakṣaṇa tvāt ca

na api viśeṣya vṛtti tve sati pratyāyya vyāvṛtti samāna adhikaraṇa tve sati vyāvartakam viśeṣaṇam yat vā yatra viśeṣya tva avacchedena vyāvṛttyā vā yad samāna adhikaraṇa tvena pratīyate tatra tad viśeṣaṇam viśeṣya tvam ca pratyāyya vyāvṛtti adhikaraṇam iti jaṭābhiḥ tāpasaḥ iti ādau jaṭā dau atiprasaṅgāt na hi tāpase na jaṭā vartate

na api viśeṣya samāna vibhaktika tvam viśeṣaṇa tvam kāka vat devadatta gṛham iti ādau upalakṣaṇe api gata tvāt anabhidhāna daśa āyāma viśeṣaṇatva apātāt ca atha vyāvartaka tve sati viśiṣṭa dhī viṣaya tvam viśeṣaṇa tvam viśiṣṭa buddhiḥ ca na viśeṣaṇa tva gocarāḥ gauravāt kiṃtu viśeṣaṇa viṣayā viśeṣaṇa upalakṣaṇa saṃdeha anupapatteḥ

atas eva cākṣuṣa tva ādi virodhaḥ upalakṣaṇa tve tu upalakṣitam saṃsthāna ādi viśiṣṭa dhī viṣayaḥ na kākavat tvam tad abhāve api tad gṛha pratīteḥ tādrūpyāt anyathā bhramatvā āpatteḥ na ca śabda upasthāpitasya katham śābda jñāna bahirbhāvaḥ iti vācyam tathā eva vyutpatteḥ na hi gaṅgāyām ghoṣaḥ iti atra pravāhaḥ api tīra avacchedaka tayā bhāsate kiṃtu tīra tvena tīra viśeṣaḥ eva anyathā ajahatsva artha asāmyāt na ca evam upalakṣaṇa padasya lākṣaṇika tvam aśakyasya saṃsthāna ādeḥ upasthāpanāt iti vācyam upalakṣaṇa buddhi upasthāpita kāraṇa antara janya saṃsthāna upasthityā tad anvaye tātparyāt iti

mā evam tathā vyutpatteḥ asiddheḥ na hi upalakṣaṇa padātiriktam upalakṣya upasthāpakam asti iti upalakṣaṇa padam sva artham upasthāpya upalakṣyam upasthāpayati iti lakṣaṇā eva syāt anyathā lakṣaṇa ucchedaḥ ghaṭaḥ na asti iti atra upalakṣaṇasya pratiyoginaḥ abhāva dhī viṣaya tvāt niyata upalakṣya abhāvāt ca na api vyāvartaka tve sati kriyā anvayi viśeṣaṇam anyat upalakṣaṇam kriyā hīne subhagaḥ ayam daṇḍī mahā bāhuḥ iti ādau daṇḍa ādeḥ aviśeṣaṇa tva āpātāt paraṃparayā upalakṣaṇe api kriyā anvayitvāt ca atha atad vyāvṛttiḥ vaiśiṣṭyam tathā ca viśiṣṭa jñāne atad vyāvṛttiḥ viṣayaḥ na viśeṣaṇam upalakṣaṇam vā tathā ca viśiṣṭa dhī kāraṇa jñāna viṣaya tve sati pratyāyya vyāvṛtti samāna adhikaraṇam viśeṣaṇam iti

tat na nīlam utpalam iti ādāvanīla anullekhe atad vyāvṛtti anullekhāt nīlam jānāmi iti anuvyavasāya virodhāt apohāpātāt ca atha vyāvartakam sākṣāt saṃbaddham nīla ādi paraṃpara asaṃbaddham gṛha upari bhramat kāka ādi tatra vyāvartanīyam adhitiṣṭhati yat hi sākṣāt eva tad viśeṣaṇam atas viparītam anyat daṇḍī pumān iti viśeṣaṇam atra daṇḍaḥ puṃso na jātiḥ anudaṇḍam asau ca tasya iti saṃbandhi dvaya atirikta sambandha ghaṭaka abhāve sati saṃbandhaḥ eva sākṣāt saṃbandhaḥ sa ca saṃyoga samavāya svarūpa saṃbandha sādhāraṇaḥ jñāne viṣayasya adhikaraṇe abhāvasya saṃbandhini samavāyasya asti iti teṣām api viśeṣaṇa tvam iti śiva āditya miśrāḥ

tat na gaura nityaḥ rūpavān calati rūpavati rasaḥ iti ādau jāte rūpasya ca sākṣāt saṃbandhe api upalakṣaṇa tvāt lohitaḥ sphaṭikaḥ ityādau paraṃparā saṃbandhe api lohita tvasya viśeṣaṇa tvāt atha anvaya pratiyogi upasthāpaka tayā anvitam upalakṣaṇam sākṣāt anvitam viśeṣaṇam kāka ādeḥ saṃsthāna ādi upasthāpaka tayā upayogāt atathātve daṇḍa ādi vat viśeṣaṇa tvam eva iti ced na upalakṣaṇasya lākṣaṇika tva āpatteḥ pratiyeginaḥ abhāve dharma antarān upanayāt ca

atha vyāvṛtti buddhi samaye viśeṣya saṃbaddham vyavartakam viśeṣaṇam tadānīm viśeṣya asaṃbaddham vyāvartakam upalakṣaṇam na ca jaṭā yadā yatra asti tadā tatra upalakṣaṇam atas eva tatra eva tat eva saṃbandha samaye viśeṣaṇam asaṃbandha samaye upalakṣaṇam iti tat na rūpavati ghaṭe rasaḥ iti ādau rūpasya viśeṣaṇa tva prasaṅgāt daṇḍī ā āsīt iti ādau atīte daṇḍasya aviśeṣaṇa tva apātāt ca

etena yatra yat viśeṣya tāvacchedaka dharmeṇa vyāvṛttyā vā samāna adhikaraṇa tvena pratīyate tatra tat viśeṣaṇam iti api pratyuktam atra ucyate daṇḍī puruṣaḥ iti jñāna anantaram daṇḍavatya daṇḍa vyāvṛttiḥ avagamyate iti pratyāyya vyāvṛtti adhikaraṇa tā puruṣasya daṇḍena avacchidyate na puruṣa tvena ati vyāpteḥ upalakṣaṇe tu gṛha tāpasa ādi niṣṭha pratyāyya vyāvṛtti adhikaraṇa tā na kāka jaṭa ādibhiḥ avacchidyate tat abhāvavatī api vyāvṛtti pratīteḥ kim tu saṃsthāna viśeṣavatvādinā

evam ca pratyāyya vyāvṛtti adhikaraṇa tāvacchedaka tve sati vyāvartakam viśeṣaṇam tad anya vyāvartakam upalakṣaṇam vyāvṛtti ullekha anantaram eva viśeṣaṇa tva buddhiḥ tad āhuḥ ācāryāḥ sat asat vā samāna adhikaraṇam vyavacchedakam viśeṣaṇam vyadhikaraṇam upalakṣaṇam iti asya arthaḥ sva adhikaraṇa mātra vṛtti vyāvṛtti bodhaka tvam sva avacchinna adhikaraṇa tā kavyāvṛtti bodhaka tvam sva an adhikaraṇa adhikaraṇa kavya āvṛttya bodhaka tve sati vyāvṛtti bodhaka tvam vā iti upalakṣaṇam tu sva an adhikaraṇe api vyāvṛttim bodhayati

athavā vivakṣita anvaya pratiyogi ta avacchedakam viśeṣaṇam daṇḍinam ānayā ityādau daṇḍaḥ tathā tad anavacchedakam upalakṣaṇam kākena devadattasya gṛhāḥ ityādau kākaḥ na gṛhasya devadatta anvaya pratiyogi tāvacchedakaḥ tad viraha daśāyām api devadatta anvaya avagamāt kim tu gṛha viśeṣaḥ eva upalakṣaṇa paricitaḥ atas eva anvaya apratiyogi tve api na upalakṣaṇa vaiyarthyam

yat vā yat anvita tayā jñātaḥ eva viśeṣye tātparya viṣaya itara anvaya dhīḥ tad vyavacchedakam viśeṣaṇam anevaṃbhūtam tad upalakṣaṇam upalakṣaṇān avacchinne api upalakṣye tātparya viṣayībhūta anvaya bodhāt ayam eva kārya anvayi viśeṣaṇam tad ananvayi upalakṣaṇam iti asya arthaḥ na tu tātparya viṣayībhūta viśeṣya anvaya bodha viṣaya tvam viśiṣṭa jñāna viṣaya tvam vā pratiyogi abhāva buddhi viṣayaḥ iti mate tad abhāvāt

yat vā viśeṣya anvayinā yasya avaśyam anvayaḥ tad avacchedakam viśeṣaṇam tat anyat upalakṣaṇam iti tatra upalakṣya viśeṣya mātra anvayāt yat vyāvartakam viśeṣya anvayinā anvīyate tad viśeṣaṇam tat anyat upalakṣaṇam iti vā yat vā tātparya viṣaya anvaya pratiyogī uddeśya anvaya pratiyogī vā dharmaḥ viśeṣaṇam tad anyat upalakṣaṇam iti alam vistareṇa

sa vikalpakam ca viśiṣṭa jñānam yathā gauḥ ayam iti tat ca sāmānya ādīnām parama artha sattvena artha ja tvāt indriyaja tvāt ca pratyakṣam kvacid saṃskāra sahakāri vaśena tat tāviśiṣṭasya idantā viśiṣṭā bheda ullekhī aindriyakaḥ vikalpaḥ nanu eka kārya sahakāri tvam anyatra pratyabhijñānam tu na ekam jñānam tad aṃśe pārokṣyasya idam aṃśe ca apārokṣyasya anubhavena viruddha dharma saṃsargāt na ca idam yathārtham aneka deśa kāla saṃbandhasya ekatra bādhāt eka kāla ādi saṃsarga tadabhāva vyavaccheda vat tad avinābhūta kāla antara ādi saṃbandha vyavacchedāt tat ayathārtha tve bahu viplaveta iti ced na pārokṣya apārokṣyayoḥ iha asiddheḥ indriya janya tvena aparokṣa tva niyamāt tat ta aṃśasya ca smṛti upanīta tvāt indriya saṃbaddha viśeṣaṇa tā pratyāsatteḥ na ca eka kāla saṃbandhaḥ kāla antara saṃbandha abhāvau inābhūtaḥ ekasmin nānā ādiś saṃbandhasya jñāne aneka viṣaya tvasya ca vyāghāta āpatteḥ sākṣātkaromi iti anuvyavasāye bādhaka abhāvāt ca

nanu kā iyam tat tā na tāvat atīta samaya saṃbandhaḥ anāgata gocara smṛti pratyabhijñayoḥ tad ta ullekhāt pratyakṣa anubhūyamāna ghaṭa ādau atīta samaya avaccheda anumāne tad tādhī vi apadeśayoḥ abhāvāt atīta samaya saṃbandha avagame api saḥ ayam na vā iti saṃśayāt sa na ayam iti viparyayāt tad abhāva avagame api saḥ ayam iti pratīteḥ atīta samaya viśiṣṭaḥ saḥ iti saha prayogāt kāle tad abhāvāt ca etena jñāta dharma antara vaiśiṣṭyam tat ta iti nirastam

na ca tad vṛtti guṇa ādikam eva tat tā tad avagame api tad anavagamāt tad anavagame api tad avagamāt ca na api atīta jñāna vaiśiṣṭyam pareṇa jñātaḥ iti jñāne api saḥ iti prayoga abhāvāt na api etat janma atīta sva jñāna vaiśiṣṭyam tad avagame api tat ta asaṃśaya viparyaya darśanāt atīta jñāna viśiṣṭaḥ saḥ iti saha prayogāt atīta anubhava viṣaya tvasya anubhava aviṣaya tvena smṛtyā tad ullekha anupapatteḥ ca

yat tu atīta anubhava viṣaya tvam tat tā tat ca anubhava aviṣaya tvena yadā jñāna antareṇa gṛhyate tadā sa ghaṭaḥ iti smaraṇam no ced pramuṣṭa tattākam ghaṭaḥ iti tat na atīta anubhava viṣaya tvasya anumitau bhāne api saḥ iti dhī vyapadeśayoḥ abhāvāt atīta anubhava viṣaya tva niścaye api tat ta asaṃśaya viparyaya darśanāt saha prayoga anupapatteḥ jñāna antareṇa atīta anubhava viṣaya tva grahe tad ta ullekhā patteḥ ca

atha atīta dharma vaiśiṣṭyam tat tā sa dharmaḥ kvacid samayaḥ kvacid jñāna ādiḥ na ca atīta dharma viśiṣṭaḥ saḥ iti saha prayoga anupapattiḥ dharma viśeṣam ādāya tad upapatteḥ tad apratītau api saḥ iti pratītiḥ asiddhā eva na ca atīta dharma viśiṣṭa pratītau api sa na vā iti saṃśayāt sa na ayam iti viparyayāt ca na evam iti vācyam niścita dharma itara dharma viśeṣa viṣaya tvena tayoḥ upapatteḥ iti ced mā evam yadi vastu gatyā yaḥ atītaḥ dharmaḥ tad vaiśiṣṭyam tat tā tadā anubhave api tad viṣaya tvāt tad ta ullekhāpattiḥ na api atīta tvena yaḥ bhāsate dharmaḥ tad vaiśiṣṭyam bhāsamāna dharmasya atīta tvena anubhava aviṣaya tvāt pratyuta vartamāna tvena anubhavāt smṛtau tad ullekhā anupapatteḥ ca

na ca anubhava anantaram yadā jñāna antareṇa atīta dharma vaiśiṣṭya bhānam tadā smṛtau tad ta ullekhaḥ na anyadā iti vācyam atīta dharmasya anumitau tad ta ullekhā patteḥ idantā api na tanmātra vṛtti guṇa ādikam anumāna ādinā tad avagame api ayam iti vyapadeśa abhāvāt pratyakṣeṇa tad avagame ayam iti vyapadeśaḥ iti ced na vācyasya pramāṇa gocara tayā vyapadeśasya niyantum aśakyatvāt guṇa ādau api tad nirvacane ananugamāt na ca etat vyakti āśraya tvam idam etat oḥ paryāya tvāt na api pratyakṣa jñāna gocara tvam acākṣuṣa tva āpatteḥ atīte tad anumāne ayam iti buddhi vyapadeśa abhāvāt smṛtyā api tad ullekhā patteḥ ca

atra kecid āhuḥ tat tedante smṛti anubhava bhāsinyau akhaṇḍe eva upādhī kḷpta dharma atirekiṇau evam ced antā saṃskāreṇa idantā eva tad tayā smaryate na ca tat tāyāḥ kvacid anārope katham āropaḥ iti vācyam pratyabhijñāyām tat ta aṃśe yathārtha tvāt idantān ullekhī anubhava prabhava smaraṇe dharma antaram eva tad tayā bhāsate atas eva ayam ghaṭaḥ iti na smaraṇam atas eva sarvā smṛtiḥ ayathārthāḥ ayathārtha anubhavā ca hari hara ādi anucintanam ca kavi kāvya mūla jñāna vat manoratha jñāna vat ca sa ākāṅkṣa padārtha jñāna prabhavam anubhava rūpam eva iti

tat na smṛteḥ pūrvam idanta upasthitim vinā tatra tat tāra upāsaṃbhavāt kim ca tat ta aṃśe ananubhūta gocara tvena smṛteḥ saṃskāra sīmā laṅghane idantā tad tayā smaryate iti atra māna abhāvāt ghaṭaḥ eva tat tayā smaryate iti astu lāghavāt iti atra ucyate anubhave kālaḥ dharma antaram vā yaḥ vartamāna tvena viṣayaḥ saḥ eva smaraṇasya anubhava smaraṇayoḥ eka viṣaya tve api smaraṇe tatra tad śabda prayogaḥ saṃskāra jajñānasya eva tad śabda prayoga hetu tvāt atas eva pratyabhijñāne tatra tad śabda prayogaḥ pratyakṣa anubhave tatra eva idaṃśabda prayogaḥ na tu viṣaya kṛtaḥ anubhava smaraṇayoḥ viśeṣaḥ atas eva ayam ghaṭaḥ iti anubhavāt ayam ghaṭaḥ iti na smaraṇam sa ghaṭaḥ iti smaraṇa kāraṇam sa ghaṭaḥ iti na anubhavaḥ

yat vā ayam ghaṭaḥ iti atra yat dharma vaiśiṣṭyam bhāsate tasya atīta tvam tat tā tad vaiśiṣṭyam ananubhūtam api smṛti viṣayaḥ idantā viśiṣṭa gocara saṃskārāt katham tat tāsmṛtiḥ iti ced na sa ghaṭaḥ iti smṛtim pratyanubhavasya hetu tva nirvāhaka tayā saṃskārasya tathā eva kalpanāt ayam ghaṭaḥ iti smṛteḥ sa ghaṭaḥ iti anubhavasya adarśanāt ca samāna viṣaya tvena smṛteḥ ayam ghaṭaḥ iti smṛtiḥ na sa ghaṭaḥ iti na anubhavaḥ ca syāt na ca evam smṛtiḥ ananubhūta tatta aṃśe anubhavaḥ syāt saṃskāra asādhāraṇa kāraṇaka tvena smṛti tvāt saha prayogaḥ ca dharma viśeṣam ādāya pratividheyaḥ atas eva saṃskāra hetu anubhava prāmāṇya pāratantryeṇa yathārtha tve api smṛtiḥ apramā iti sarva tantrasi dvāntaḥ

yat vā na iyam yathārthā tathā hi smṛtiḥ sva viṣaya vartamāna tva viṣayāḥ atīta anāgatā gocara pratīti tvāt pratyabhijñāvat pratīti tvāt vā ghaṭaḥ asti iti pratīti vat pratīteḥ samaya viśeṣa viṣaya tva niyamāt jñāna sāmagrī mahimnā ca ananubhūte api samaya aṃśe smṛtiḥ na tatra saṃskāra vyāpāraḥ anyathā siddha tvāt atas eva pāka rakte śyāmaḥ ayam iti dhiyaḥ ayathārtha tva vyavahāraḥ laukikānām śyāma tvasya vartamāna tvena avagamāt

etena śyāma dhīḥ tatra yathārtha eva ghaṭe kadācid tat sattvāt idānīm ayam śyāmaḥ iti ākāraḥ eva na iti apāstam atas eva atīta anāgata vahni agocara tve vidyamāna dhūmena parvate vahniḥ iti anumiteḥ vartamāna vahni viṣaya tvāt idānīm vahni niścayena vahni arthi pravṛttiḥ anyathā idānīm tad saṃdehe pravṛttiḥ na syāt yadā dhūmaḥ tadā vahniḥ iti vyāptau api tad ajñāna daśāyām pravṛtteḥ anyathā anupapatteḥ

yat vā sa ghaṭaḥ iti smṛtau tat tā viśiṣṭasya vartamāna tā bhāsate saṃskārasya vartamāna jñāna sāmagrī sahitasya eva hetu tvāt saḥ ayam idānīm ityādau tathā kalpanāt gehe sa ghaṭaḥ iti smaraṇāt niśśaṅka pravṛtteḥ ca anyathā tat tā viśiṣṭasya idānīm saṃdehe sā na syāt na ca vartamāna tva aṃśe ananubhūta viṣaya tvam vartamāna tvena anāgata vartamānasya pūrvam anubhavāt

evam ca smṛteḥ tathābhūtasya vartamāna tā viṣayaḥ tatra viśeṣyasya viśeṣaṇasya vā vartamāna tva abhāvāt smṛtiḥ ayathārtha eva na ca pūrvam tathā āsīt arthaḥ iti tat yathārtha tvam pāka rakte śyāmaḥ ayam iti jñānasya yathārtha tva prasaṅgāt pramuṣṭa tattā aṃśe ca smaraṇe avidyamāna dharma avacchedaḥ na bhāsate tad āhuḥ ācāryāḥ smṛteḥ yāthārthyam api kutas iti

pratyakṣa upajīvaka tvāt pratyakṣa anantaram bahu vādi sammata tvāt upamānāt prāc anumānam nirūpyate tatra vyāpti viśiṣṭa pakṣa dharma tā jñāna janyam jñānam anumitiḥ tad karaṇam anumānam tat ca liṅga parām arśaḥ na tu parāmṛśyamānam liṅgam iti vakṣyate atha anumānam na pramāṇam yogyā upādhīnām yogyā anupalabdhyā abhāva niścaye api ayogya upādhi śaṅkayā vyabhicāra saṃśayāt śataśas sahacaritayoḥ api vyabhicāra upalabdheḥ ca loke dhūma ādi darśana anantaram vahni ādi vyavahāraḥ ca sambhāvanā mātrāt saṃvādena ca prāmāṇya abhimānāt iti na apratyakṣam pramāṇam iti

na apramāṇa sādharmyeṇa aprāmāṇya sādhane dṛṣṭa sādharmyasya anumāna tvāt etad vākyasya sandigdha viparyasta anyataram pratyarthavat tvā tayoḥ ca parakīyayoḥ apratyakṣa tvāt anumānam apramāṇam iti vākyasya prāmāṇya aprāmāṇayoḥ vyāghātāt ca api ca anumāna aprāmāṇye pratyakṣasya api apramāṇa tā āpatteḥ prāmāṇyasya anumeya tvāt svatas ca prāmāṇya grahe tad saṃśaya anupapatteḥ vyāpti graha upāyaḥ ca vakṣyate

nanu anumiti hetu vyāpti jñāne kā vyāptiḥ na tāvat avyabhicarita tvam tat hi na sādhya abhāva vat avṛtti tvam sādhya vat bhinna sādhya abhāva vat avṛtti tvam sādhya vat pratiyogikān yonya abhāva āsāmānādhikaraṇyam sakala sādhya abhāva vat niṣṭhā abhāva pratiyogi tvam sādhya vadanyāvṛtti tvam vā kevalān vayinī a bhāvāt

na api sādhyāsā mānādhikaraṇyā anadhikaraṇa tvam sādhya vaiyadhi karaṇyānadhikaraṇa tvam vā tat ubhayam api sādhyān adhikaraṇān adhikaraṇa tvam tat ca tatra yad kiñcit sādhyān adhikaraṇa adhikaraṇe dhūme ca aprasiddham

atha idam vācyam jñeya tvāt ityādau samavāyitayā vācya tva abhāvaḥ ghaṭaḥ eva prasiddhaḥ vyadhikaraṇa dharma avacchinna pratiyogi tākā bhāvasya kevala anvayitvāt na ca evam ghaṭaḥ eva vyabhicāraḥ sādhya tāvacchedaka avacchinna pratiyogi tāka sādhya abhāva vat vṛtti tvam hi vyabhicāraḥ na ca vācya tva abhāvaḥ tādṛśaḥ ghaṭaḥ iti ced tarhi tādṛśa sādhya abhāva sāmāna adhikaraṇyā bhāvaḥ vyāptiḥ tathā ca aprasiddhiḥ pratiyogi avṛttiḥ ca dharmaḥ na pratiyogi ta avacchedakaḥ tad viśiṣṭa jñānasya abhāva dhī hetutvāt anyathā tad nirvikalpakāt api ghaṭaḥ na asti iti buddhi āpatteḥ gavi śaśa śṛṅgam na asti iti pratateḥ aprasiddheḥ śaśaśṛṅgam na asti iti ca śaśe śṛṅga abhāvaḥ iti arthaḥ

atha sādhyāsā mānādhikaraṇyā an adhikaraṇa tve sati sādhikaraṇa tvam vyāptiḥ kevala anvayini sādhyāsāmānādhikaraṇyam niradhikaraṇe ākāśa ādau prasiddham iti ced na sādhyāsāmānādhikaraṇyam hi na sādhyān adhikaraṇa adhikaraṇa tvam sādhya adhikaraṇa anadhikaraṇa tvam vā kevala anvayini yat kiṃcid sādhya adhikaraṇa an adhikaraṇe dhūme ca avyāpteḥ na api sva samāna adhikaraṇa atyanta abhāvā pratiyogi sādhya sāmānādhikaraṇyam parvatīya vahneḥ mahānasīya dhūma samāna adhikaraṇa atyanta abhāva pratiyogi tvāt dravya tva ādeḥ avyāpya vṛtti avyāpya ta āpatteḥ ca na ca pratiyogi virodhi tvam vyāpya vṛtti tvam vā abhāva viśeṣaṇam deyam saṃyoga ādau sādhye sattva ādeḥ anaikāntika tva abhāva prasaṅgāt na hi pratiyogi virodhī saṃyoga ādeḥ aparaḥ atyanta abhāvaḥ asti

adhikaraṇa bhedena abhāva bheda abhāvāt na api sādhana vat niṣṭhā anyonya abhāva apratiyogi sādhyavat katvam vyāptiḥ mūle vṛkṣaḥ kapi saṃyogavān na itya bādhita pratīteḥ tad anyonya abhāvasya api tatra sattvāt na ca evam bheda abhedaḥ avacchedaka bhedena tad sattva abhyupagamāt sādhana vat niṣṭhā anyonya abhāva apratiyogi sādhya vadyasya iti ṣaṣṭhī artha vyāpya vyāpaka bhāva anirūpaṇāt sādhya sādhanayoḥ vyāpti nirūpya tvāt vahnimat parvatasya dhūma vat mahānasa niṣṭhā anyonya abhāva pratiyogi tvāt ca viśeṣa abhāva kūṭāt eva abhāva vyavahāra upapattau sāmānya abhāve māna abhāvāt na api sādhana samāna adhikaraṇa yāvat dharma nirūpita vaiyadhi karaṇyān adhikaraṇa sādhya sāmānādhikaraṇyam sādhana samāna adhikaraṇasya prameya tva ādeḥ vaiyadhi karaṇya aprasiddheḥ mahānasa ādau samavāyitayā vahni vahnim atoḥ atyantān yonya abhāvayoḥ sattvāt dhūma ādau api ukta lakṣaṇa abhāvāt ca

atha anaupādhikaḥ sambandhaḥ vyāptiḥ upādhiḥ ca sādhya vyāpaka tve sati sādhana avyāpakaḥ vyāpaka tvam tu tadvat niṣṭhā atyanta abhāva apratiyogi tvam vyabhicāre ca avaśyam upādhiḥ pratiyogi tvam na virodhi tvam saha anavasthāna niyama lakṣaṇam go tva aśva tvayoḥ atathātvāt anyonya abhāva pratiyogini asattvāt ca kim tu yathā adhikaraṇa abhāvayoḥ sva rūpa viśeṣaḥ sambandhaḥ tathā pratiyogi tvam anuyogi tvam api abhāva viraha āma tvam vā iti ced

yat kiṃcid sādhya vyāpaka sādhana avyāpaka dharma niṣedhaḥ na dhūma ādau prakṛta sādhya vyāpaka sādhana avyāpaka dharmaḥ ca siddhi asiddhibhyām na niṣeddhum śakyaḥ yāvat sādhya vyāpake prameya tva ādau sādhana avyāpaka tvam yāvat sādhana avyāpake ca ghaṭa tva ādau sādhya vyāpaka tvam niṣidhyate iti ced na vyadhikaraṇa tvāt

yāvat sādhana avyāpakam avyāpakam yat sādhyasya yāvat sādhya vyāpakam vyāpakam vā yasya tattvam tat iti ced na sa upādheḥ api tathātvāt tathā hi sādhanasya vahneḥ avyāpakam yāvat ārdra indhanam tat pratyekam avyāpakam sādhya dhūmasya dvitīye sādhya dhūmasya vyāpakam ārdra indhanam tat vyāpakam mahānasīya vahneḥ na api sādhyam yāvat vyabhicāri tat avyabhicāri tvam anaupādhika tvam sādhya avyabhicāri tvasya eva gamaka tva sambhavāt tat ca dūṣitam

na api kātsrnyena sambandhaḥ vyāptiḥ eka vyaktike tad abhāvāt nānā vyaktike api sakala dhūma sambandhasya pratyeka vahnau abhāvāt atas eva na kātsrnyena sādhyena sambandhaḥ vyāptiḥ viṣam avyāpte tad abhāvāt ca na ca yāvat sādhana āśraya āśrita sādhya sambandhaḥ sādhana āśraya mahānasa ādau sakale pratyekam vahneḥ āśrita tva abhāvāt

na api sādhana samāna adhikaraṇa yāvat dharma samāna adhikaraṇa sādhya sāmānādhikaraṇyam yāvat dharma sāmānādhikaraṇyam hi yāvat dharma adhikaraṇa adhikaraṇa tvam tat ca aprasiddham na api svābhāvikaḥ sambandhaḥ vyāptiḥ svabhāva janya tve tad āśrita tva ādau vā avyāpti ati vyāpteḥ na api avinābhāvaḥ kevalān vayinī a bhāvāt atha sambandha mātram vyāptiḥ vyabhicāri sambandhasya api kenacid saha vyāpti tvāt dhūma ādi vyāptiḥ tu viśiṣya eva vaktavyā iti

tat na liṅga parāmarśa viṣaya vyāpti svarūpa nirūpaṇa prastāve lakṣaṇa abhidhānasya artha antara tvāt na ca sambandha mātram tathā tad bodhāt anum iti anutpatteḥ na api vyāpti pada pravṛtti nimittam idam sambandha jñāne api vyāpti pada aprayogāt kevala anvayini kevalānvayi saṃmbandhaḥ vyatirekiṇi sādhya vadanyāvṛtti tvam vyāptiḥ etayoḥ anumiti viśeṣa janaka tvam anumiti mātre pakṣa dharma tā eva prayojikā na ca atiprasaṅgaḥ viśeṣa sāmagrī sahitāyāḥ eva sāmānya sāmagryāḥ kārya janaka tva niyamāt iti kecid

tat api na sādhya vadanyāvṛtti tvasya dhūme asattvāt vahnimat parvatāni asmin dhūma sattvāt na ca sakala sādhya vadanyāvṛtti tvam vahnimatām pratyekam tathātvāt sarvatra lakṣaṇe sādhya tva sādhana tva tad abhimata tvānām vyāpti nirūpya tvena ātma āśrayaḥ sādhya tvam hi na siddhi karma tvam siṣā dhayiṣā viṣaya tvam vā mahānasīya vahnau tad abhāvāt na ca sāmānyatas vyāpti avagamaḥ asti eva parasya katham anyathā dūṣaṇena asādhaka tām sādhayet iti vācyam sva artha anumāna upayogi vyāpti svarūpa nirūpaṇam vinā kathā yāma praveśāt iti
atra ucyate pratiyogi asamāna adhikaraṇa yat samāna adhikaraṇa atyanta abhāva pratiyogi ta avacchedaka avacchinnam yat na bhavati tena samam tasya sāmānādhikaraṇyam vyāptiḥ

anya niṣṭha vahneḥ dhūmavat parvata vṛtti atyanta abhāva pratiyogi tve api tad pratiyogitā na vahni tvena avacchidyate dhūmavati vahniḥ na asti iti apratīteḥ sāmānya avacchinna pratiyogi tākā bhāvaḥ pṛthak eva anyathā sakala prasiddha rūpa abhāve prasiddha rūpa vat anya tve ca avagate vāyau rūpam na vā vāyuḥ rūpavān na vā iti saṃśayaḥ na syāt viśeṣa abhāva kūṭasya niścita tvāt

yat vā pratiyogi vyadhikaraṇa sva samāna adhikaraṇa atyanta abhāva apratiyoginā sāmānādhikaraṇyam yad samāna adhikaraṇānyonya abhāva pratiyogi yadvat na bhavati tena samam tasya sāmānādhikaraṇyam vā sva samāna adhikaraṇa anyonya abhāva apratiyogiyadvatka tvam vā anya vṛtti vahni tadvatoḥ anya vṛtti dhūma vat niṣṭhā atyanta abhāva anyonya abhāva pratiyogi tvāt vyadhikaraṇa vahni dhūmayoḥ na vyāptiḥ kiṃtu tad tad dhūmasya samāna adhikaraṇa tad tad vahninā na ca evam dhūma mātre na vyāptiḥ iti vācyam sarva dhūmavyakteḥ tathā tvena dhūma mātrasya vyāpya tvāt dhūma sambandhi vahniḥ tat vyāpyaḥ eva yugapad utpanna vinaṣṭayoḥ ca vyāptiḥ eva karmaṇi ca saṃyoga abhāvaḥ pratiyogi asamāna adhikaraṇaḥ

yat vā pratiyogi vaiyadhi karaṇyā avacchedaka avacchinna tvam atyanta abhāva viśeṣaṇam karmaṇi ca saṃyoga abhāvasya pratiyogi vaiyadhikaraṇyā avacchedaka avacchinna tvam eva na ca anyonya abhāvasya avyāpya vṛtti tvam abhedasya ābādhita pratyabhijñānāt vyāpya vyāpaka bhāva ajñāne api vastu sataḥ tathā tvena ajñāyamānasya sambandha tvena eva bhātasya ṣaṣṭhī artha tvam na ca evam ananugamaḥ doṣāya kasya kā vyāptiḥ iti ananugatasya eva lakṣya tvāt atha dhūmavati vahni hradau na staḥ dhūmavān vahnimat hradau na bhavati iti pratīteḥ vyāsa jya vṛtti pratiyogikau vahni vahnim atoḥ atyantānyonya abhāvau dhūmavati vidyeta iti katham ete lakṣaṇe iti ced na tādṛśa abhāva anabhyupagamāt abhyupagame vā tatra tat ubhayam pratiyogi na vahni vahnimantau

atha vā anaupādhika tvam vyāptiḥ tat ca yāvat svasamāna adhikaraṇa atyanta abhāva pratiyogi ta avacchedaka avacchinnam yat tad pratiyogikātyānta abhāva samāna adhikaraṇam yat tena samam sāmānādhikaraṇyam na hi evam sa upādhiḥ tatra sādhana samāna adhikaraṇa atyanta abhāva pratiyoginaḥ ārdra indhana vat tva ādeḥ upādheḥ yaḥ atyantā bhāvaḥ tena samam sādhyasya dhūma ādeḥ sāmānādhikaraṇya abhāvāt upādheḥ sādhya vyāpaka tvāt etat eva yāvat su avyabhicāri vyabhicāri sādhya sāmānādhikaraṇyam anaupādhika tvam gīyate

yat vā yāvat yat samāna adhikaraṇa atyanta abhāva apratiyogi pratiyogika atyanta abhāva sāmānādhikaraṇyam yasya tasya tat eva anaupādhika tvam sa upādhau tu sādhya vat niṣṭhā ati anta abhāva apratiyoginaḥ upādheḥ yaḥ atyanta abhāvaḥ tena samam hetoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyam upādheḥ sādhana avyāpaka tvāt yat vā yad sambandhi tāvacchedaka rūpavat tvam yasya tasya sā vyāptiḥ tathā hi dhūmasya vahni sambandhi tve dhūma tvam avacchedakam dhūma mātrasya vahni sambandhi tvāt vahneḥ tu dhūma sambandhe na vahni tvam avacchedakam dhūma asambandhini gata tvāt na hi ati prasaktam avacchedakam saṃyoga ādau tathā tva adarśanāt kiṃtu vahnau ārdra indhana prabhava vahni tvam dhūma sambandhi tāvacchedakam tādṛśam ca vyāpyam eva athavā yat sāmāna adhikaraṇyā avacchedaka avacchinnam yasya svarūpam tat tasya vyāpyam vahni sāmānādhikaraṇyam hi dhūme dhūma tvena avacchidyate sa upādhau tu upādhinā

atas eva sādhana tāvacchedaka bhinnena yena sādhana tā abhimate sādhya sambandhaḥ avacchidyate saḥ eva tatra sādhane viśeṣaṇam upādhiḥ iti vadanti atas eva ca tatra sādhana avyāpaka tve sati sādhana avacchinna sādhya vyāpaka tvam lakṣaṇam dhruvam vyabhicāriṇi sādhane ekatra sādhya tad abhāvayoḥ virodhena avacchedaka bhedam vinā tad ubhaya sambandha abhāvāt avaśyam sādhya sambandhi tā avacchedakam asti tat eva ca sādhana avacchinna sādhya vyāpakam sādhana avyāpakam tatra upādhiḥ

atas eva vyabhicāre ca avaśyam upādhiḥ iti saṃgacchate anyathā vyabhicārāt eva tatra āgamaka tvena vyabhicāreṇa na tad anumānam aprayojaka tvāt atas eva ca tasya sādhya sambandhi tāvacchedaka rūpa lakṣaṇa avyāptiḥ sādhana tā abhimate cakāsti iti sphaṭike japā kusuma vat upādhiḥ asau ucyate lakṣaṇam tu sādhya sādhana sambandha vyāpaka tve sati sādhana avyāpaka tvam viṣam avyāptaḥ tu na upādhipad a vācyaḥ pravṛtti nimitta abhāvāt dūṣaka tā ca tasya vyabhicāra unnāyaka tayā na ca vyabhicāra unnāyaka tvam eva aupādhika tvam aprayojaka sādhya vyāpaka vyabhicāriṇaḥ api upādhi tva āpatteḥ iti

sā iyam vyāptiḥ na bhūyas darśana gamyā darśanānām pratyekam ahetu tvāt āśu vināśinām kramikāṇām melakā bhāvāt na ca tāvat darśana janya saṃskārāḥ indriya saha kṛtāḥ vyāpti dhīhetavaḥ pratyabhijñāyām indriyasya tathā tva kalpanāt iti vācyam samāna viṣaye smaraṇe pratyabhijñāne ca saṃskāraḥ hetuḥ atas katham saṃskāreṇa vyāpti jñānam janyeta anyathā atiprasaṅgaḥ kim ca sambandha bhūyas darśanam bhūyassu sthāneṣu darśanam bhūyasām vā darśanam bhūyāṃsi vā darśanāni na tathā ekatra rūpa rasayoḥ dravya tva ghaṭa tvayoḥ ca vyāpti grahāt ekatra eva dhārāvāhike tad hī prasaṅgāt bhūyaḥ tvasya tri catur ādi tvena ananugamāt ca

api ca pārthiva tva lauha lekhya tva ādau śataśas darśane api vyāpti agrahāt tarka saha kṛtam tathā iti ced tarhi sahacāra darśana vyābhicāra adarśana sahakṛtaḥ saḥ eva vyāpti grāhakaḥ astu āvaśyaka tvāt kim bhūyas darśanena na ca tena vinā tarkaḥ eva na avatarati prathama darśane vyutpannasya tarka sambhavāt na ca evam eva astu tarkasya vyāpti graha mūlaka tvena anavasthānāt jāta mātrasya pravṛtti nivṛtti hetu anumiti janaka vyāpti jñānam tarkam vinā eva atas na anavasthā iti ced tarhi vyabhicārāt saḥ api na vyāpti grahe hetuḥ na ca etat buddhau avāntara jātiḥ asti sāmānya pratyāsattyā sarva upasaṃhārāt avinā bhāva grahaḥ sāmānya rūpa tā ca na sakṛt darśana gamya iti bhūyas darśana apekṣā iti ced na sāmānyasya hi pratyāsatti tvam lāghavāt na tu sāmānyatayā jñātasya tad anabhyupagamāt ca na ca kākatālīya tva ādi śaṅkā vyudāsa artham dvitīya ādi darśana apekṣā iti vācyam dvitīya ādi darśane api śaṅkā tādavasthyāt
