nanu anaupādhika tva jñānam vyāpti jñāne hetuḥ tad deśa kāla tatra avasthita ghaṭa ādīnām upādhi tva śaṅkā nirāsaḥ kasyacid sādhana vyāpaka tva jñānena kasyacid sādhya avyāpaka tva jñānena syāt tat ca bhūyas darśanam vinā na avatarati iti ced na ayogyā upādhi vyatirekasya anumāna adhīna jñāna tvena anavasthā pātāt atha sādhya sādhana sahacarita dharma antarāṇām upādhi tva saṃśaye na vyāpti grahaḥ atas teṣām anupādhi tva jñānam bhūyas darśana adhīna sādhya avyāpaka tva jñāne satī iti etad artham bhūyas darśana apekṣā atas eva yāvatā darśanena tat niścayaḥ tāvat bhūyas darśanam hetuḥ iti na vāra saṅkhyā niyamaḥ na vā an anugamaḥ

yadi api ca anyasya sādhya vyāpaka tva sādhana avyāpaka tva saṃśayaḥ na anya vyāpti graha pratibandhakaḥ tathā api tad ā ahita vyabhicāra saṃśayaḥ pratibandhakaḥ iti tad vidhūnanam āvaśyakam iti ced na ayogya upādhi saṃśaya adhīna vyabhicāra saṃśayasya tathā api anucchedāt sa ca na bhūyas darśanāt na api anumānāt iti uktam api ca bhūyas darśana āhita saṃskāraḥ na bahis indriya sahakārī tat vyāpāram vinā api ca sahacāra ādi jñānavataḥ vyāpti grahāt

na api manasaḥ indriya ādi vat bhūyas darśana janya saṃskārasya tad janya smaraṇasya vā pramāṇa antaratva āpatteḥ tasmāt pariśeṣāt sakṛt darśana gamyā sā tathā hi upādhi abhāvaḥ vyāptiḥ abhāvaḥ ca kevala adhikaraṇam tad kāla sambandhaḥ vā sva prakāśa rūpam tat jñānam vā tat ca prathama darśanena avagatam eva cakṣuḥ ādinā na ca adhikaḥ tad abhāvaḥ asti na ca pratiyogi jñānam adhikaraṇa ādi jñāna janakam yena upādhi jñānam vinā tat na syāt evam upādhi abhāve jñāte kiṃcid na jñātum avaśiṣyate upādhi abhāva vyavahāraḥ tu tat hiyam apekṣate dīrgha tva ādi vyavahāraḥ iva avadhi jñānam na ca evam rāsabha sambandha tulya vahni dhūma sambandha jñānāt eva anumitiḥ syāt iti vācyam upādhi smaraṇe sati upādhi tad vyāpya itara sakala tad upalambhaka samavadhāne ca upādhi anupalambha sahitasya kevala adhikaraṇa jñānasya anumiti hetu tvāt tad vyavahāra hetu tvāt ca

nanu evam prathama darśanena vyāpti niścayāt viśeṣa darśane sati rāsabha ādi saṃśaya vat tad saṃśayaḥ na syāt iti ced vyāpti jñāna anantaram kim vidyamānaḥ eva upādhiḥ maya upādhi tvena na jñātaḥ iti śaṅkayā gṛhīta vyāptau api saṃśayaḥ atas tatra bhūyas darśanena upādhi nirāsa dvārā vyāpti abhāva śaṅkā apanīyate yat vā jñāna prāmāṇya saṃśayāt vyāpti saṃśayaḥ yathā ghaṭa jñāna sāmagryām satyām ghaṭa jñāne sati tad prāmāṇya saṃśaya āhitaḥ tad saṃśayaḥ na tu ac rima saṃśaya anurodhena tatra ghaṭa jñānam eva na vṛttam iti kalpyate tathā iha api upādhi abhāvasya vyāpti tvāt tasya ca kevala adhikaraṇa rūpasya prathama darśane api niścita tvāt vyāpti grāhaka antarasya abhāvāt ca pariśeṣeṇa sakṛt darśanasya vyāpti grāhaka tvāt tad niścaye prāmāṇya saṃśayāt eva tad saṃśayaḥ

na ca evam rāsabhe api prathamam vyāpti paricchedaḥ syāt iti vācyam tatra vyāpteḥ abhāvāt pratyakṣe viṣayasya hetu tvāt kvacid asaṃsarga āgrahāt tathā vyavahāraḥ doṣa māhātmyāt na ca atra api tathā ārope sati nimitta anusaraṇam na tu nimittam asti iti āropaḥ iti abhyupagamāt kecid tu sādhana vat niṣṭhā atyanta abhāva apratiyogi sādhya sāmānādhikaraṇyam sādhana vat niṣṭhā anyonya abhāva apratigogi sādhyavat katvam vā vyāptiḥ tat ubhayam api yogyam pratyakṣeṇa vahni dhūma sambandha anubhavena prathamam avagatam eva mahānase yaḥ atyanta abhāvaḥ anyonya abhāvaḥ vā avagataḥ tasya pratiyogī na vahniḥ na vā vahnimān iti anubhavāt rāsabhe tathā avagame api agre sa bādhyate iti tat na evam hi tad vahni tad dhūmayoḥ eva vyāptiḥ syāt na tu dhūma tva vahni tva avacchedena na ca tad anumāna upayogi vahni tvam vahnimat tvam vā na pratiyogita avacchedakam iti prathamatas jñātum aśakyam eva iti

mā evam prakṛta sādhya vyāpaka sādhana avyāpakaḥ vā sādhana tva abhimatena samam prakṛta sādhya sambandhi tā avacchedakam viśeṣaṇam vā upādhiḥ ubhayathā api tad abhāvaḥ na vyāptiḥ siddhi asiddhibhyām tad niṣedha anupapatteḥ kim tu yāvat svavyabhicāri vyabhicāri sādhya sāmānādhikaraṇyam anaupādhika tvam tasya ca prathamam jñātum aśakyatvāt kim ca na vastu gatyā vyāpteḥ jñānam hetuḥ kim tu vyāpti tvena tat ca upādhya bhāva tvam na ca upādheḥ ajñāne tad abhāva tvena jñānam sambhavati viśeṣaṇa jñāna sādhya tvāt viśiṣṭa jñānasya na ca niyamataḥ prathamam upādhi dhīḥ asti yat ca uktam

pratiyogi jñānam vyavahāra hetuḥ na abhāva jñāne iti astu tāvat evam tathā api tad abhāvaḥ mā vyavahāri upādhi abhāva jñāna adhīnā anumitiḥ syāt eva upādhi jñānam vinā api na ca evam vastutas tu viśeṣa adarśane sahacāra ādi sādhāraṇa dharma darśanāt vyabhicāra saṃśayāt prathama darśane na vyāpti niścayaḥ atha vyabhicāra saṃśayaḥ na avyabhicāra niścaya pratibandhakaḥ grāhya saṃśayasya niścaya apratibandhaka tvāt anyathā saṃśaya uttaram kvāpi niścayaḥ na syāt iti ced na vyabhicāra saṃśayaḥ pratibandhakaḥ iti brūmaḥ kim tu viśeṣa adarśane sati sahacāra ādi sādhāraṇa dharma darśanāt saṃśayaḥ syāt na tu saṃśaya sāmagrītaḥ niścayaḥ iti kim ca yat hī sāmagrī yatra pratibandhikā viśeṣa adarśane tatra tat hīrapi iti vyabhicāra saṃśayaḥ api pratibandhakaḥ evam bhūyas darśanam api saṃśāyakam tarkaḥ tu anavasthā graste eva iti katham vyāpti grahaḥ

atra ucyate vyabhicāra jñāna viraha saha kṛtam sahacāra darśanam vyāpti grāhakam jñānam niścayaḥ śaṅkā ca sā ca kvacid upādhi sandehāt kvacid viśeṣa adarśana sahita sādhāraṇa dharma darśanāt tad virahaḥ ca kvacid vipakṣa bādhaka tarkāt kvacid svatassiddhaḥ eva tarkasya vyāpti graha mūlaka tvena anavasthā iti ced na yāvat āśaṅkam tarka anusaraṇāt yatra ca vyāghātena śaṅkā eva na avatarati tatra tarkam vinā eva vyāpti grahaḥ

tathā hi dhūmaḥ yadi vahni asamavahita ājanya tve sati vahni samavahitā janyaḥ syāt na utpannaḥ syāt iti atra kim dhūmaḥ avahneḥ eva bhaviṣyati kvacid vahnim vinā api bhaviṣyati ahetukaḥ eva vā utpatsyate iti śaṅkā syāt sarvatra sva kriyā vyāghātaḥ syāt yadi hi gṛhīta anvaya vyatirekam hetum vinā api kārya utpattim śaṅketa tadā svayam eva dhūma artham vahneḥ tṛpti artham bhojanasya para pratipatti artham śabdasya ca upādānam niyamataḥ katham kuryāt tena vinā api tad sambhavāt tasmāt tat tad upādānam eva tādṛśa śaṅkā pratibandhakam śaṅkāyām na niyata upādānam niyata upādāne ca na śaṅkā tat idam uktam tat eva hi āśaṅkyate yasmin āśaṅkyamāne sva kriyā vyāghātaḥ na bhavati iti na hi saṃbhavati svayam vahni ādikam dhūma ādi kārya artham niyamataḥ upādatte tad kāraṇam tat noti āśaṅkyate ca iti

etena vyāghātaḥ virodhaḥ sa ca saha anavasthāna niyamaḥ iti tatra api anavasthā iti nirastam sva kriyāyāḥ eva śaṅkā pratibandhaka tvāt atas eva vyāghātaḥ yadi śaṅkā asti na ced śaṅkā tatas tarām vyāghāta avadhiḥ āśaṅkā tarkaḥ śaṅkā avadhiḥ kutas iti khaṇḍanakāra matam api apāstam na hi vyāghātaḥ śaṅkā āśritaḥ kim tu sva kriyā eva śaṅkā pratibandhika iti na vā viśeṣa darśanāt kvacid śaṅkā nivṛttiḥ evam syāt na ca etādṛśa tarka avatāraḥ bhūyas darśanam vinā iti bhūyas darśana ādaraḥ na tu sa svatas eva prayojakaḥ

atas eva na tat āhita saṃskāraḥ māna antaram tarkasya apramātvāt tat ca pratyakṣa vyāpti jñāne hetuḥ tad abhāve api śabda anumānābhyām tad grahāt nanu sahacāra darśana vyabhicāra adarśana vat vyabhicāra śaṅkā viraha anukūla tarkayoḥ jñānam vyabhicāri sādhāraṇam iti na tatas api vyāpti niścayaḥ iti ced na sva rūpa satoḥ eva tayoḥ vyāpti grāhaka tvāt sat tarkāt vyāpti pramā tad ābhāsāt tad apramā viśeṣa darśana satya tva asatya tvābhyām puruṣa jñānam iva

apare tu yatra tarke vyāpti anubhavaḥ mūlam tatra tarka antara apekṣā yatra tu vyāpti smaraṇam hetuḥ tatra na tarka antara apekṣā iti na anavasthā asti ca jāta mātrāṇāḥ miṣṭa aniṣṭa sādhana tā anumiti hetu vyāpti smaraṇam tadānīm vyāpti anubhāvaka abhāvāt tad mūla anubhava mūlā ca agre api vyāpti smaraṇa paramparā iti yat tu anādi siddha kārya kāraṇa bhāva virodha ādi mūlāḥ kecid tarkāḥ iti tat na pramāṇa anuyoge anumānaḥ eva paryavasānāt na ca vyāpti grahānyatha anupapattyā eva tarkasya anādi siddha vyāptika tva jñānam iti vācyam anupapatteḥ api anumāna tvāt anye tu vipakṣa bādhaka tarkāt anaupādhika tva grahaḥ eva tad adhīnaḥ vyāpti grahaḥ iti tat api na tarkasya apramāṇa tvāt vyabhicāra ādi śaṅkā nirāsa dvārā pratyakṣa ādi sahakārī saḥ iti ced na anavasthā abhayena tarkam vinā vyāghātāt yatra śaṅkā virahaḥ tatra vyāpti grahe tarkasya vyabhicārāt

yat tu yogyānām upādhīnām yogyā anupalabdhyā abhāva grahaḥ ayogyānām tu sādhya avyāpaka tva sādhana vyāpaka tva sādha nāt abhāva grahaḥ iti anaupādhika tvam manasā sugraham iti tad tuccham anumānena tad sādhane anavasthānāt pramāṇa antarasya abhāvāt ye ca anukūla tarkam vinā eva sahacāra ādi darśana mātreṇa vyāpti graham vadanti teṣām pakṣa itara tvasya sādhya vyāpaka tva grahe anumāna mātram ucchidyeta anumāna mātra ucchedaka tvāt eva pakṣa itaraḥ na upādhiḥ iti ced bhrāntaḥ asi na hi vayam upādhi tvena tasya doṣa tvam ācakṣmahe sādhya vyāpaka tvena tad vyatirekāt pakṣe sādhya vyāvartaka tayā vyāpaka vyatireke vyāpya vyatirekasya vajra lepa tvāt ca api ca kara vahni saṃyogaḥ śakti atiriktā atīndriya dharma samavāyī janakatvāditi atra aprayojaka tvāt na sādhakam tatra vyāptasya pakṣa dharma tve kim aprayojakam nāma tasmāt vipakṣa bādhaka tarka abhāvāt na tatra vyāpti grahaḥ iti aprayojaka tvam iti

ukta vyāpti prakāreṣu anyonya abhāva garbhā eva vyāptiḥ anumiti hetuḥ lāghavāt atas na ananugamaḥ anaupādhika tvam tu tad lakṣaṇam nanu evam upādhiḥ asiddhi upajīvya tvena vyabhicāra vadha itvābhāsa antaram syāt na tu vyāpti abhāva tvena asiddhiḥ iti ced tat jñānam upajīvyam api na svatas dūṣakam na hi anyasya sādhya vyāpaka tva sādhana avyāpaka tva jñānam anyasya sādhya vyāpya tva jñāne pratibandhakam ati prasakteḥ vyabhicāra ajñānasya tadhetu tvāt tat buddhiḥ tathā na ca anaupādhika tva jñānam vyāpti jñāna hetuḥ iti uktam tathā ca vyabhicāra jñāna dvārā sa dūṣakaḥ evam ca para mukha nirīkṣaka tayā siddha sādhana vat na pṛthak na ca evam avyabhicārasya vyāpti tve vyabhicāraḥ tad abhāva tvena asiddhiḥ syāt iti vācyam sādhya abhāvavat vṛtti tvam hi vyabhicāraḥ tad abhāvaḥ ca na avi abhicāraḥ kevalān vayinī a bhāvāt kim tu sva samāna adhikaraṇa atyanta abhāva apratiyogi sāmānādhikaraṇyam na ca anayoḥ paraspara viraha tvam iti

vyāpti grahaḥ ca sāmānya lakṣaṇa apratyāsattyā sakala dhūma viṣayakaḥ katham anyathā parvatīya dhūme vyāpti agrahe tasmāt anumitiḥ sā ca indriya sambaddha viśeṣaṇa tā atiriktā eva vā tad viśeṣyaka pratyakṣe tad indriya saṃnikarṣasya hetu tvena anāgata ādau saṃyoga ādeḥ abhāvāt iti vadanti tad apare na manyante tathā hi dhūma tvā avacchinnā vyāptiḥ saṃnikṛṣṭa dhūma viṣaye dhūma tvena pratyakṣeṇa jñāyate tatas smṛtā sā tṛtīya liṅga parāmarśe pakṣa niṣṭha dhūma vṛtti tayā jñāyate tatas anumitiḥ tad anabhyupagame api sannikṛṣṭa dhūma viṣaye dhūma tvena dhūmaḥ vahni vyāpya iti anubhavaḥ tathā eva vyāpti smaraṇam tatas dhūmavān ayam iti vyāpti smṛti prakāreṇa dhūma tvena pakṣa vṛtti dhūma jñānāt anumitiḥ vyāpti anubhava tad smaraṇa pakṣa dharma tā jñānānām eka prakāraka tvena anumiti hetu tvāt gavā ādi padeṣu api śakti anubhava tad smaraṇa vākya artha anubhavānām eka prakāraka tvena hetu hetum at bhāvaḥ iti apūrve vakṣyate tatra yogyatā ādi balāt apūrva vyakti lābhaḥ anumāne tu pakṣa dharma tā balāt dhūmaḥ vahni vyāpya iti anubhavaḥ

na tu sarvaḥ dhūmaḥ vahni vyāpya iti yena sarva bhānā artham tad svīkāraḥ atha vahnimānayam iti anumitiḥ viśeṣaṇa jñāna sādhya aviśiṣṭa jñāna tvāt iti parvatīya vahni bhānā artham tad kalpane dhūme api tathā kvacid dhūmasya api vyāpaka tvāt iti ced na viśiṣṭa vaiśiṣṭya jñāne viśeṣaṇa tāvacchedaka prakāraka jñānasya āvaśyaka tvena hetu tvāt tat ca vṛttam eva na tu viśeṣaṇa jñānam api tathā gauravāt gauḥ ayam iti viśiṣṭa jñāne yugapad viśeṣye viśeṣaṇe saṃnikarṣaḥ eva kāraṇam na tu nirvikalpakam māna abhāvāt viśiṣṭa jñāna tvam eva mānam iti ced na ddaṣṭānta abhāvāt daṇḍī puruṣaḥ iti atra viśeṣaṇa dhī janyatva anabhyupagamāt viśiṣṭa vaiśiṣṭya jñāna tvāt api ca prameya tvena vyāptim paricchindan sarvajñaḥ syāt tathā ca parakīya jñāna viṣaye ghaṭa tvam na vā iti saṃśayaḥ na syāt prameya tvena tad anyatara niścayāt prameya tvena ghaṭam jānāti eva ghaṭa tvam tasya na jānāti iti ced na tat kim ghaṭa tvam na prameyam yena tat na jānīyāt sakala ghaṭa vṛtti dharmasya prameyat tvena tad ajñāna asambhavāt

ucyate yadi sāmānya lakṣaṇāḥ na asti tadā anukūla tarka ādikam vinā dhūma ādau vyabhicāra saṃśayaḥ na syāt prasiddha dhūme vahni sambandha avagamāt kāla antarīya deśa antarīya dhūmasya māna abhāvena ajñānāt sāmānyena tu sakala dhūma upasthitau viśeṣa adarśanena saṃśayaḥ yujyate yat tu pāka ādau cikīrṣā sukha ādau icchā na syāt siddhe icchā virahāt asiddhi asya ajñānāt tasmāt sukha tva ādinā jñāteṣu sarveṣu siddham vihāya asiddhe icchā bhavati iti abhyupeyam tat na prasiddhasya ajñāne api siddha gocara jñānāt eva icchā pravṛtti svābhāvyāt asiddhe tayoḥ utpatteḥ na ca atiprasaṅgaḥ samāna prakāraka tvena jñāna icchā kṛtīnām kārya kāraṇa bhāvāt na tu samāna viṣaya tvena api kvacid api akalpanāt samāna viṣayaka tve sati api samāna prakāraka jñāna abhāvena icchā kṛtyoḥ abhāvāt tasya āvaśyaka tvena gauravāt ca iti para siddhāntāt na ca sarvajña tve saṃśayaḥ na syāt iti doṣaḥ ghaṭaḥ saḥ iti ghaṭa tva prakārakam hi jñānam saṃśaya virodhi tat ca na vṛttam sva sāmagrī virahāt atas ghaṭa tva ādi sakala viśeṣa jñāne api sa ghaṭaḥ na vā iti saṃśayaḥ iti

upādhi jñānāt vyabhicāra jñāne sati na vyāpti niścayaḥ iti upādhiḥ nirūpyate tatra upādhiḥ sādhya tva abhimata vyāpaka tve sati sādhana tva abhimatā vyāpakaḥ anaupādhika tva jñānam ca na vyāpti jñāne hetuḥ atas vyāpaka tva ādi jñāne na anyonya āśrayaḥ yat vā vyāpaka tvam tadvat niṣṭhā atyanta abhāva apratiyogi tvam tad pratiyogi tvam ca avyāpaka tvam pratiyogi tvam ca tad adhikaraṇān adhikaraṇa tvam iti vadanti tat na sādhana pakṣa dharma avacchinna sādhya vyāpaka upādhi avyāpteḥ na ca tayoḥ anupādhi tvam dūṣaka tā bīja sāmyāt mitra atanaya tvena śyāma tva sādhane śāka pāka ja tvasya pratyakṣa sparśa āśraya tvena vāyoḥ pratyakṣa tve sādhye udbhūta rūpavat tvasya ca śāstre prayojaka tvena upādhi tva svīkārāt ca iti pakṣa itare ati vyāptiḥ ca na ca vyatireke parvata itara anyatvāt iti atra itara anyatvasya asiddhi vāraṇa artham parvata padam viśeṣaṇam iti vyatireke vyartha viśeṣaṇa tvāt na saḥ upādhiḥ bādha unnītasya api anupādhita āpatteḥ na ceṣṭāpattiḥ

itara anyatvasya aprasiddhyā viśeṣaṇam vinā vyāpti agraheṇa tat sārthaka tvāt vastu gatyā sādhya vyāpakaḥ pakṣetaraḥ upādhiḥ iti ced astu tathā tathā api pakṣa atirikte sādhya vyāpaka tā grahāt upādheḥ dūṣaka tvam tat ca tatra api asti anyathā pakṣe sādhya sandehāt anupādhi tve upādhi mātram ucchidyeta vipakṣa avyāvartaka viśeṣaṇa śūnya tvam viśeṣaṇam tena bādha unnīta pakṣa itarasya parigrahaḥ tatra pakṣasya eva vipakṣa tvāt na tu parvata itara tva ādeḥ iti ced na na hi vastu vipakṣa avyāvartaka viśeṣaṇa śūnyam

sarvatra prameya tva ādeḥ sattvāt tatra upātta iti viśeṣaṇe siddhi asiddhi vyāghātaḥ tathā api ca sādhya vyāpaka tva sādhana avyāpaka tve tatra staḥ iti tad vyāvṛttyā pakṣe sādhya vyāvṛttiḥ atas hetoḥ vyabhicāraḥ eva vyabhicāre ca avaśyam upādhiḥ iti pakṣetaraḥ eva tatra upādhiḥ syāt tāvat mātrasya eva dūṣaka tvāt ca vyartham viśeṣaṇam atas eva anumāna mātra ucchedaka tayā jāti tvāt na pakṣa itaraḥ upādhiḥ iti apāstam dūṣaṇa samartha tvena jāti tva abhāvāt etena pakṣa itara vyāvṛtti artham prakāra antaram api nirastam upādhi tva abhāve api dūṣaṇa samartha tvāt

atha upādhiḥ sva vyatirekeṇa sat pratipakṣa utthāpaka tayā dūṣaṇam pakṣa itara tva vyatirekaḥ ca na sādhya abhāva sādhakaḥ asādhāraṇa tvāt na tu vyabhicāra unnāyaka tayā dūṣaṇam yathā hi sādhya vyāpaka upādhya vyāpya tayā hetoḥ sādhya avyāpya tvam tathā sādhya vyāpya hetu avyāpaka tayā upādheḥ na sādhya vyāpaka tvam api sidhyet vyāpti grāhakasya ubhayatra api sāmyena vinigamaka virahāt tasmāt yathā sādhya vyāpyena hetunā sādhyam sādhanīyam tathā sādhya vyāpaka upa adhi vyāvṛttyā sādhya abhāvaḥ api sādhanīyaḥ vyāpti graha taulyāt iti dūṣaka tā bījam saḥ ayam sat pratipakṣaḥ eva iti

mā evam evam hi sat pratipakṣe upādhi udbhāvanam na syāt sa pratipakṣa antara vat kim ca evam bodha unnītaḥ api pakṣa itaraḥ na upādhiḥ syāt vyatireke asādhāraṇyāt nanu bādhe na upādhi niyamaḥ dhūmena hrade vahni sādhane tad abhāvāt na tu hetumati pakṣe bādhe pakṣa itara upādhi niyamaḥ pratyakṣe vahnau kṛtaka tvena anuṣṇa tve sādhye atejaḥ tu ādeḥ upādhi tva sambhavāt iti ced na tejaḥ mātra pakṣa tve atejaḥ tvam vinā anyasya upādheḥ abhāvāt kim ca parvata avayava vṛtti anya tvam parvata itara dravya tvam hṛd aparvata saṃyoga anādhāra tvam hṛd aparvata anyatva ādikam upādhiḥ syāt eva vyatireke asādha araṇya abhāvāt vyatirekiṇā sat pratipakṣa sambhavāt ca na ca asādha araṇyam

tasya api sat pratipakṣa utthāpaka tayā doṣa tvāt tasmāt ubhayoḥ api vyāpti grāhaka sāmye virodhāt na vyāpti niścayaḥ kim tu ubhayatra vyabhicāra saṃśayaḥ tathā ca vyabhicāra saṃśaya ādhāyaka tvena upādheḥ dūṣaka tvam tat ca pakṣa itare api asti tat uktam upādheḥ eva vyabhicāra śaṅkā iti bhavatu vā ukta nyāyena sakala anumāna bhaṅga bhiyā pakṣetaraḥ anupādhiḥ tathā api lakṣaṇam ativyāpakam na api sādhya samavyāpta tve sati sādhana avyāpaka tvam upādhi tvam dūṣaka tā bījasya vyabhicāra unnayanasya sat pratipakṣasya vā sāmyena viṣam avyāptasya api upādhi tvāt tathā dūṣaka tāyām sādhya vyāpya tvasya aprayojaka tvāt ca

atha sādhya prayojakaḥ dharmaḥ upādhiḥ prayojaka tvam ca na nyūna adhika deśa vṛtteḥ tasmin sati abhavataḥ tena vinā api bhavataḥ tad aprayojaka tvāt anyathā pakṣa itarasya api upādhi tva prasaṅgāt iti ced na dūṣaṇa aupayikam hi prayojaka tvam iha vivakṣitam tat ca sādhya vyāpaka tve sati sādhana avyāpaka tvam eva iti tat eva prayojakam na tu adhikam vyartha tvāt

atha upādhiḥ saḥ ucyate yat dharmaḥ anyatra pratibimbate yathā japā kusumam sphaṭika lauhitye upādhiḥ tathā ca upādhi vṛtti vyāpya tvam hetu tva abhimate cakāsti tena asau upādhiḥ na ca vyāpya tva mātreṇa dūṣaka tvam iti sādhya vyāpaka tā āpīṣyate tathā ca samavyāptaḥ eva upādhiḥ iti ced tat kim viṣam avyāptasya dūṣa ka tā bīja abhāva anna upādhi śabda vācya tvam tathātve api upādhi pada pravṛtti nimitta abhāvāt vā na ādyaḥ tasya api vyabhicāra ādi unnāyaka tvāt na aparaḥ na hi loke samavyāptaḥ eva anyatra svadharma pratibimba janake eva upādhi pada prayogaḥ lābha ādi upādhinā kṛtam ityādau lābha ādau api upādhi pada prayogāt kim ca na śāstre laukika vyavahāra artham upādhi vyutpādanam kintu anumāna dūṣaṇa artham tat ca sādhya vyāpaka tve sati sādhana avyāpaka tva mātram iti śāstre tathā eva upādhi pada prayogaḥ

anye tu yat abhāvaḥ vyabhicāra virodhī saḥ upādhiḥ na ca viṣam avyāptasya abhāvaḥ vyabhicāram viruṇāt hi tasya abhāve api vyabhicārāt asti hi anitya tva vyāpakam prameya tvam tat vyāpyam ca guṇa tvam na ca anitya tva guṇa tvayoḥ vyāptiḥ asti samavyāptikasya ca vyatirekaḥ tathā na hi sādhya vyāpaka vyāpyībhūtasya vyāpyam yat tat sādhyam vyabhicarati vyabhicāre ca antataḥsādhyam eva upādhiḥ abhede api vyāpya vyāpaka tvāt sādhana avyāpaka tvāt ca iti svīcakruḥ tat na tava api hi avyabhicāre sādhya vyāpya vyāpya tvam tantram āvaśyaka tvāt lāghavāt ca na sādhya vyāpaka vyāpya tvam api

bhavatā eva vyabhicārasya darśita tvāt na ca sādhya vyāpya vyāpya tvam eva anaupādhika tvam sādhya vyāpyam iti atra api hi anaupādhika tvam tat eva vācyam tathā ca anavasthā iti anaupādhika tve ca vyāpti lakṣaṇe yāvat iti padam sādhya vyāpaka tve viśeṣaṇam dattam eva kim ca yasmin sati anumitiḥ na bhavati tat eva tatra dūṣaṇam na tu yat vyatireke bhavati eva iti etat garbham viruddha tva ādeḥ api adoṣa tva āpatteḥ na api pakṣa dharma avacchinna sādhya vyāpaka tve sati sādhana avyāpaka tvanam upādhi tvam sādhana avacchinna sādhya vyāpaka upādhya vyāpanāt śabdaḥ abhidheyaḥ prameya tvāt iti atra aśrāvaṇa tvasya upādhi tva āpatteḥ ca śabda dharma guṇa tva avacchinna abhidheya tvam yatra rūpa ādau tatra aśrāvaṇa tvam vyāpakam pakṣe prameya tvasya sādhanasya avyāpakam hi tat ārdra indhanavat tva ādau upādhau pakṣa niyata tāddaśa dharma abhāvāt ca atha sādhana avacchinna sādhya vyāpaka tve sati sādhana avyāpakaḥ upādhiḥ tena dhvaṃsasya janya tvena dhvaṃsa pratiyogi tve sādhye sādhana avacchinna sādhya vyāpakam bhāva tvam upādhiḥ

śyāma tve śāka pākaja tvam upādhiḥ iti tat na pakṣa dharma avacchinna sādhya vyāpaka upādhya vyāpanāt jalam prameyam rasava tvāt iti atra rasavatva avacchinna sādhya vyāpaka pṛthivī tvasya upādhi tva prasaṅgāt sa upādhi tvāt asādhakam iti atra sādhana avacchinna sādhya vyāpaka vyabhicāri tve sādhana avacchinna iti asya vyartha tva prasaṅgāt ca kim ca pakṣa dvaye api viśiṣṭa sādhya vyabhicāram viśiṣṭa sādhya vyatirekam vā prasādhya paścāt kevala sādhya vyabhicāraḥ kevala sādhya vyatirekaḥ vā sādhanīyaḥ tathā ca artha antaram kevala sādhye hi vivādaḥ na tu viśiṣṭe atha prakṛta sādhya vyabhicāra siddhi artham viśiṣṭa sādhya vyabhicāraḥ sādhyaḥ iti ced na aprāpta kāla tvāt prathamam sādhya vyabhicāraḥ eva udbhāvyaḥ tatra asiddhau upādhiḥ iti ced tarhi prakṛta anumāne na upādhiḥ dūṣaṇam syāt kim ca sādhya vyabhicāra hetu tvena pakṣa dharma avacchinna sādhya vyāpaka vyabhicāraḥ eva upanyasanīyaḥ na upādhiḥ syāt etat paryavasita sādhya vyāpaka tve sati sādhana avyāpakaḥ upādhiḥ

paryavasitam sādhyam pakṣa dharmatā bala labhyam yathā śabdaḥ anitya tva atirikta śabda dharma atirikta dharmavān meya tvāt iti atra paryavasitam yat sādhyam anitya tvam tasya vyāpakam kṛtaka tvam upādhiḥ yadi ca tathā eva kṛtaka tvam api śabde sādhyate tadā anitya tvam upādhiḥ tat uktam vādyukta sādhya niyama cyutaḥ api kathakaiḥ upādhiḥ udbhāvyaḥ paryavasitam niyamayan dūṣa kata bīja sāmrājyāt iti anena pakṣa dharma sādhana avacchinna sādhya vyāpaka upādhiḥ saṃgṛhyate tāddaśa sādhyasya paryavasita tvāt iti tat na evam hi dvi aṇukasya sāvayava tve siddhe dvi aṇukam anitya dravyā samavetam janya mahat tva anadhikaraṇa dravya tvāt iti atra nisparśa dravya samaveta tvam upādhiḥ syāt bhavati hi nitya dravya samaveta tvam paryavasitam sādhyam tasya vyāpakam sādhana avyāpakam ca kim ca pakṣa dharmatā bala labhya sādhya siddhau niṣphalaḥ upādhiḥ tad asiddhau ca kasya vyāpakaḥ na hi sa upādhau pakṣa dharma tā balāt sādhyam sidhyati yasya vyāpakaḥ upādhiḥ syāt iti

atra ucyate yat vyabhicāri tvena sādhanasya sādhya vyabhicāri tvam saḥ upādhiḥ lakṣaṇam tu paryavasita sādhya vyāpaka tve sati sādhana avyāpaka tvam yat dharma avacchedena sādhyam prasiddham tad avacchinnam paryavasitam sādhyam sa ca dharmaḥ kvacid sādhanam eva kvacid dravya tva ādi kvacid mahānasa tva ādi tathā hi samavyāptasya viṣam avyāptasya vā sādhya vyāpakasya vyabhicāreṇa sādhanasya sādhya vyabhicāraḥ sphuṭaḥ eva vyāpaka vyabhicāriṇaḥ tad vyāpya vyabhicāra niyamāt sādhana avacchinna pakṣa dharma avacchinna sādhya vyāpakayoḥ vyabhicāri tvena sādhanasya sādhya vyabhicāri tvam eva yathā dhvaṃsasya anitya tve sādhye bhāva tvasya vāyoḥ pratyakṣa tve sādhye udbhūta rūpavat tvasya ca viśeṣaṇa avyabhicāriṇi sādhane viśiṣṭa vyabhicārasya viśeṣya vyabhicāri tva niyamāt atas eva na artha antaram viśeṣaṇa avyabhicāri tvena jñāte sādhane viśiṣṭa vyabhicāraḥ sidhyan viśeṣī asādhya vyabhicāram ādāya eva sidhyati pakṣa dharma tā balāt anyathā pratīteḥ aparyavasānāt na ca pakṣa dharma tā balāt prakṛta siddhau artha antaram

yat vā pratyakṣa sparśa āśraya tvam pratyakṣa tva vyabhicāri dravya tva avyabhicāri tve sati dravya pratyakṣa tva vyāpaka vyabhicāri tvāt mahattva vat tathā mitrātanaya tvam śyāma tva vyabhicāri mitra atanayatva avyabhicāri tve sati śyāma mitra atanaya tva vyāpaka vyabhicāri tvāt aghaṭa tva vat avyabhicāraḥ ca tad samāna adhikaraṇa atyanta abhāva apratiyogi tvam tat ca abhede api yat vā yaḥ sādhana vyabhicārī sādhya vyabhicāra unnāyakaḥ saḥ upādhiḥ tattvam ca sākṣāt paramparayā vā iti na artha antaram

kiṃca artha antarasya puruṣa doṣa tayā ābhāsa antarasya tatra abhāvāt upādhiḥ eva bhāva tva ādikam doṣaḥ na ca evam śabdaḥ abhidheyaḥ prameya tvāt iti atra aśrāvaṇa tvam jalam prameyam rasavat tvāt iti atra pṛthivī tvam upādhiḥ syāt kevala anvayitva sādhaka pramāṇena tatra sādhya siddheḥ upādheḥ viśiṣṭa avyāpaka tvāt na ca pakṣa itare sva vyāghātaka tvena anupādhau ati vyāptiḥ tatra anukūla tarka abhāvena sādhya vyāpaka tva aniścayāt sahacāra darśana ādeḥ tena vinā saṃśāyaka tvāt iti uktam

bādha unnīte ca anukūla tarkaḥ asti eva iti evam parvata avayava vṛtti anya tva ādeḥ api na upādhi tvam pakṣa mātra vyāvartaka viśeṣaṇavat tvāt atas eva dhūme ārdra indhana prabhava vahnimat tvam dravya bahis indriya pratyakṣa tve udbhūta rūpavat tvam mitra atanaya śyāma tve śāka pākaja tvam janyā nitya tve bhāva tvam upādhiḥ tat utkarṣeṇa sādhya utkarṣāt ananyathā siddha anvaya vyatirekataḥ vaidyakāt kāraṇa tā avagamena ghaṭa unmajjana prasaṅgena sādhya vyāpaka tā niścayāt tat kim kārya kāraṇayoḥ eva vyāptiḥ tathā ca bahudhā vyākulī syāt iti ced na tad upajīvyāni eṣām api anukūla tarkeṇa vyāpti grahāt yatra sādhya upādhyoḥ hetu sādhyayoḥ vā vyāpti grāhaka sāmyāt na ekatra vyāpti niścayaḥ tatra sandigdha upādhi tvam vyabhicāra saṃśaya upadhāyaka tvāt yadā ca tādṛśī ekatra anukūla tarka avatāraḥ tadā hetu tvam upādhi tvam vā niścitam pakṣetarasya sva vyāghātaka tvena na hetu vyabhicāra saṃśāyaka tvam atas na saṃdigdha upādhiḥ api saḥ

yat tu pakṣa itarasya yathā sādhya vyāpaka tvam tathā sādhya abhāva vyāpaka tvam api grāhaka sāmyāt tathā ca ubhaya vyāpaka nivṛttyā sādhya tad abhāvābhyām pakṣe nivartitavyam na ca evam tathā ca pakṣa itaraḥ sādhya vyāpaka tā saṃśayena sandigdhaḥ katham param dūṣayet iti tat na tathā hi sādhya vyāpaka tā pakṣam ālambya hetu vyabhicāra saṃśaya ādhāyaka tvena dūṣaṇam syāt eva

nanu yatra upādhiḥ tatra anukūla tarkaḥ yadi na asti tadā tad abhāvena eva vyāpteḥ agrahaḥ atha asti tadā sādhya vyāpya avyāpaka tvena upādhiḥ sādhya avyāpaka tva niścayāt na upādhiḥ iti ubhayathā api na upādhiḥ dūṣaṇam na ca vyāpti abhāva vyāpyam ubhayam atas upādhiḥ api tad abhāva unnayanena doṣaḥ iti vācyam upādheḥ ātma lābha artham anukūla tarka abhāva upajīvaka tvena tasya eva doṣa tvāt iti ced na sa upādhau ekatra sādhya tad abhāva sambandhasya viruddha tvāt avacchedaka bhedena tad ubhaya sambandhaḥ vācyaḥ tathā ca sādhanesādhya sambandhi tāvacchedaka rūpam anukūla tarkā bhāva upajīvanam antareṇa upādhiḥ āvaśyakaḥ tathā anukūla tarka abhāvaḥ api āvaśyakaḥ iti ubhayoḥ api vinigamaka abhāvāt dūṣaka tvam

anye tu yat vyāvṛttyā yasya sādhanasya sādhyam nivartate sa dharmaḥ tatra hetau upādhiḥ sa ca dharmaḥ yasya abhāvāt pakṣe sādhya sādhana sambandha abhāvaḥ yathā ārdra indhanavat tvam vyāvartate hi tad vyāvṛttyā dhūmavat tvamayaḥ golake atas eva tatra sādhya sādhana saṃbandha abhāvaḥ pakṣe evam bhāva tva vyāvṛttyā dhvaṃse janya tva anitya tvayoḥ sambandhaḥ nivartamānaḥ pakṣa dharma tā balāt anitya tva abhāvam ādāya sidhyati tathā vāyau udbhūta rūpavat tvam nivartamānam bahis dravya tve sati pratyakṣa tvam nivartayat pratyakṣa tva abhāvam ādāya sidhyati tathā ca ubhayatra api pakṣe sādhya abhāva siddhyā sādhya sādhana sambandha abhāvaḥ asti iti atas eva bādhānunnīta pakṣa itarasya anupādhi tvam sva vyāghātaka tvena tad vyatirekasya sādhya avyāvartaka tvāt iti

yat tu upādhi mātrasya lakṣaṇam vyatireki dharma tvam pakṣetaraḥ api kvacid upādhiḥ tat tad upādheḥ tu tad tad sādhya vyāpaka tve sati tad tad sādhana avyāpaka tvam na ca vahni dhūma sambandha upādhiḥ pakṣetara tvam syāt iti vācyam āpādya aprasiddheḥ iti tat na anumiti pratibandhaka jñāna viṣaya tā avacchedakam upādhi tvam iha nirūpyam tat ca na vyatireki tvam atiprasaṅgāt viśeṣa lakṣaṇe vahni dhūma sambandhe pakṣa itaratvasya upādhi tva prasaṅgāt ca

kecitu sādhana vyāpakaḥ api upādhiḥ kvacid yatra pakṣa āvṛttiḥ hetuḥ yathā karakā pṛthivī kaṭhina saṃyoga āditi atra anuṣṇa aśīta sparśavat tvam na ca tatra svarūpa asiddhiḥ eva doṣaḥ sarvatra upādheḥ dūṣaṇa antara saṃkarāt iti āhuḥ sādhyam ca na upādhiḥ vyabhicāra sādhane sādhya aviśiṣṭa tvāt anumiti mātra uccheda prasaṅgāt ca

sa ca ayam dvividhaḥ niścitaḥ sandigdhaḥ ca sādhya vyāpaka tvena sādhana avyāpaka tvena ca niścitaḥ vyabhicāra niścaya ādhāyaka tayā niścita upādhiḥ yathā vahnimat tvena dhūmavat tve sādhye ārdra indhana prabhava vahnimat tvam yatra ca sādhana avyāpaka tva san deha ssādhya vyāpaka tva saṃśayaḥ vā tad ubhaya sandehaḥ vā tatra hetu vyabhicāra saṃśaya ādhāyaka tayā sandigdha upādhiḥ yathā mitra atanaya tvena śyāma tve sādhye śāka ādi āhāra pariṇati ja tvam na ca tena eva hetunā śāka pākaja tvam api sādhyam tatra śyāma tvasya upādhi tvāt ubhayasya api sādhane artha antaram śyāma tva mātre hi vivādaḥ na tu ubhayatra na

ca evam dhūmāt vahni anumāne api vahni sāmagrī upādhiḥ syāt tatra vahninā iva tad sāmagrya api samam dhūmasya anaupādhika tva niścayāt atra tu mitra atanaya tva vyāpya śyāma sāmagryā sthātavyam iti atra kārya kāraṇa bhāva ādīnām vyāpti grāhakāṇām abhāvāt atas eva sādhya sāmagryā saha hetoḥ api yatra vyāpti grāhakam asti tatra sāmagrī na upādhiḥ yatra tu tat na asti tatra sā api upādhiḥ iti abhisandhāya sāmagrī ca kvacid na upādhiḥ na tu sarvatra iti uktam yathā tulya yogakṣemayoḥ upādheḥ vyāpaka tā āsandehe īśvara anumāne śarīra janya tva aṇu tva ādiḥ yathā ca śākapāka janya tvasya sādhya vyāpaka tā āsandehe mitra atanaya tve yat tu upādhi sandehaḥ na upādhiḥ na vā hetvābhāsa antaram iti tad udbhāvane niranuyojya anuyogaḥ iti tat na sandigdha anaikāntika vat vyabhicāra saṃśaya ādhāyaka tvena dūṣaka tvāt upādheḥ iva vyabhicāra niścaya ādhāyaka tayā

idānīm upādheḥ dūṣaka tā bījam nirūpyate na api asya vyatireka dvārā sat pratipakṣa tvena dūṣaka tvam tadā hi sat pratipakṣe sat pratipakṣa antara vat upādheḥ udbhāvanam na syāt na ca pratipakṣa bāhulyena adhika bala artham udbhāvanam śatam api andhānām na paśyati iti nyāyāt ekena api bahūnām pratibandhāt ca vyāpti pakṣa dharmate hi balam tat ca tulyam eva na tu bhūyaḥ tvam api ekasmāt api anumiti darśanāt sandigdha upādheḥ adūṣaka tā āpatteḥ ca tad vyatirekasya pakṣe sandigdha tvāt

api ca evam bādha unnīta pakṣa itarasya upādhi tvam na syāt vyatireke asādhāraṇyāt pakṣa vṛttiḥ ca upādhiḥ na syāt yathā ghaṭaḥ anityaḥ dravya tvāt iti atra kāryatvam andhakāraḥ dravyam svātantryeṇa pratīyamāna tvāt iti atra aśrāvaṇa tvam tad vyatirekasya pakṣa āvṛtti tvāt na ca na ayam upādhiḥ tad lakṣaṇa sattvāt anyathā api dūṣaka tva sambhavāt ca

kiṃca sādhya vyāpya avyāpaka tvena upādheḥ sādhya avyāpaka tve tad vyatirekeṇa katham sat pratipakṣaḥ na hi avyāpaka vyatirekāt avyāpya vyatirekaḥ na api vyāpti viraha rūpa tayā asiddha tvena anaupādhika tvasya vyāpti tva nirāsāt na api anaupādhika tva jñānasya vyāpti dhīhetu tvasya tattvena vyāpti jñāna kāraṇa vighaṭaka tayā vyāpya tva asiddhau antarbhāvaḥ na hi anyasya sādhya vyāpaka tva sādhana avyāpaka tva jñānam anya vyāpti jñānam prati pratibandhakam iti uktam na ca sādhya vyāpaka avyāpya tva jñāne vidyamāne sādhanasya sādhya vyāpya tva jñānam na utpattum arhati iti vācyam na hi sādhya vyāpaka vyāpya tva jñānam vyāpti jñāna kāraṇam

yena tad pratibandhakam syāt kiṃtu sādhya vyāpaka vyabhicāri tvena sādhya vyabhicāri tva jñāna dvārā na api vyabhicāra unnāyaka tvena yathā hi sādhya vyāpaka vyabhicāritayā sādhanasya sādhya vyabhicāri tvam anumeyam tathā sādhya vyāpya vyabhicāri tvena sādhya vyabhicāri tvam upādheḥ api anumeyam vyāpti grāhaka sāmyāt na api sādhya vyāpaka avyāpya tvena vyāpti viraha unnāyaka tayā sādhya vyāpya avyāpaka tvena upādheḥ eva sādhya avyāpaka tva sādhanāt tasmāt upādhiḥ hetvābhāsa antaram iti

ucyate ārdra indhanavat tva ādeḥ tarka ādinā sādhya vyāpaka tva sādhana avyāpaka tve niścite dūṣaka tā bīja cintanam yadi hi sādhya sādhana sahacāra darśanena upādhau sādhya vyāpaka tā niścayaḥ eva na asti tadā upādhi tva niścaya abhāvāt dūṣaka tā eva na asti iti kva bahirbhāva antar bhāva cintā kim ca sat pratipakṣa tayā vyāpya tva asiddha tayā svātantryeṇa vā yadi doṣa tvam sarvathā sādhya vyāpaka tā niścayaḥ vācyaḥ tena vinā teṣām abhāvāt tasmāt upādhi niścayāt vyabhicāra niścayaḥ tad saṃśayāt tad saṃśayaḥ iti vyabhicāra jñāna dvārā sādhya vyāpaka avyāpya tvena vyāpti viraha unnāyaka tayā vā upādheḥ dūṣaka tvam yat vā sādhya vyāpaka abhāva vat vṛtti tayā sādhya vyabhicāri tvam unneyam na ca sādhana abhāva vat vṛtti tvam upādhiḥ iti vācyam upādhi mātra uccheda prasaṅgāt sat pratipakṣe pūrva sādhana vyatireka vat avṛtti gagana ādau sādhya avyāpaka tvāt saṃyoga ādau hetau sādhana vyāpaka tvāt ca

atha upādhi ābhāsaḥ asādharaṇa viparyayaḥ yathā anvavyatirekiṇi sādhye bādha unnīta anya pakṣa itara tvam aprasiddha sādhya viparyayaḥ yathā kevala anvayini sādhye pakṣetara tva ādiḥ bādhita sādhya viparyayaḥ yathā vahniḥ uṣṇaḥ tejaḥ tu āditi atra akṛtaka tvam pakṣa avyāpaka viparyayaḥ yathā kṣiti ādikam sa kartṛkam kāryatva āditi atra aṇu vyatirikta tvam atra aṇu vyatirekasya kṣiti ādeḥ eka deśa vṛttyā bhāga asiddheḥ pūrva sādhana vyatirekaḥ yathā śarkarā rasaḥ anityaḥ anitya vṛtti guṇa tvāt

rasaḥ nityaḥ rasanā indriya janya nirvikalpaka viṣaya tvāt rasa tva vat iti ādau pūrva sādhana tāyāḥ prayoga anurodhi tvena avyavasthita tvāt kadācid nitya tva sādhana vyatirekasya upādhi tvam kadācid anitya tva sādhana vyatirekitvasya iti vastu vyavasthā na syāt upādheḥ nitya doṣa tvāt ca na hi yat yena sa upādhi sambaddham tat tena anupādhi tva sambaddham sambhavati na tu sat pratipakṣa ucchedaḥ pūrva sādhana vyatirekasya anupādhi tve bījam sthāpanāyāḥ yathābhāsa tvam tatra pūrva sādhana vyatirekasya sādhya vyāpaka tvena anupādhi tvāt na ca pūrva hetoḥ tatas eva asādhaka tvāt sat pratipakṣa vaiyarthyam tatra iti vācyam agṛhyamāṇa viśeṣa daśāyām sat pratipakṣa sambhavāt pūrva sādhana vyāpya vyatirekaḥ yathā akartṛkatva anumāne nitya tva ādiḥ pakṣa vipakṣa anyatara anyaḥ yathā prasiddha anumāne parvata jala hradānya tara anyatvam pakṣa itara sādhya abhāvaḥ yathā atra eva parvata itara agrimat tvam na ca atra vyartha viśeṣaṇa tvam dūṣaṇam tattve api upādheḥ ābhāsa tvāt tad tulyam ca yathā atra eva parvata itara indhanavat tvam evam vahni sāmagrya ādikam ūhyam

vyāpti anantaram pakṣa dharma tā nirūpyate tatra na tāvat saṃdigdha sādhya dharma tvam pakṣa tvam saṃdehaḥ hi na viśeṣaṇam parāmarśa pūrvam liṅga darśana vyāpti smaraṇa ādinā tasya nāśāt na upalakṣaṇam avyāvartaka tā āpatteḥ na api sādhaka bādhaka pramāṇa abhāvaḥ ubhaya abhāvasya pratyeka sattve api sattvāt na api abhāva dvayam tathā bādhaka pramāṇa abhāvasya vyartha tvāt hrada ādeḥ pakṣatve api bādha hetu asiddhi ādeḥ āvaśyaka tvena anumiti anutpādāt na api sādhaka pramāṇa abhāvaḥ śrotavyaḥ mantavyaḥ iti śrutyā samāna viṣayaka śravaṇa anantaram manana bodhanāt pratyakṣat daṣṭe api anumāna darśanāt eka liṅga avagate api liṅga antareṇa tad anumānāt ca mantavyaḥ ca upapattibhiḥ iti smaraṇāt atha siṣā dhayiṣita sādhya dharmā dharmī pakṣaḥ tathā hi mumukṣoḥ śabdāt ātma avagame api mananasya mokṣa upāya tvena siddhi viśeṣa anumiti icchayā ātma anumānam atas eva pratyakṣa parikalitam api artham anumānena bubhutsante tarkarasikāḥ na hi kariṇi ddaṣṭe cītkāreṇa tam anumimate anumātāraḥ iti vācaspati vacanayoḥ avirodhaḥ

anumitsā ta dvirahābhyām tat upapatteḥ iti ced na sandeha vat parāmarśa pūrvam siṣā dhayiṣāyāḥ api abhāvāt yogyatāyāḥ ca anirūpaṇāt siṣā dhayiṣā virahe api ghana garjitena megha anumānāt sva kāraṇa adhīna tṛtīya liṅga parāmarśa balena anapekṣita anumāna darśanāt ca iti ucyate siṣā dhayiṣā viraha saha kṛta sādhaka pramāṇa bhāvaḥ yatra asti sa pakṣaḥ tena siṣā dhayiṣā viraha saha kṛtam sādhaka pramāṇam yatra asti sa na pakṣaḥ yatra sādhaka pramāṇe satyasati vā siṣā dhayiṣā yatra vā ubhaya abhāvaḥ tatra viśiṣṭa abhāvāt pakṣa tvam yadi api pakṣatvasya kevala anvayitvāt na asya bhedaka tvam tathā api pakṣa pada pravṛtti nimittam uktam

pakṣa dharmasya vyāpti viśiṣṭa jñāna m anum iti hetaḥ nanu vyāpya tāvacchedaka prakāreṇa vyāpti smaraṇam pakṣa dharma tā jñānam tathā lāghavāt parāmarśa hetu tvena āvaśyaka tvāt ca evam dhūmaḥ vahni vyāpyaḥ dhūmavān aḥ ca ayam iti jñāna dvayāt eva anumitiḥ astu na ca anumitim prati vyāpya tva jñānam eva hetuḥ lāghavāt upajīvya tvāt ca iti vācyam tasya anumiteḥ pūrvam asiddhau yugapad upasthiti abhāvāt atha yathā tat tā viśiṣṭa smaraṇe sati indriya saṃnikṛṣṭe saḥ eva ayam iti abheda pratyayaḥ bhavati tathā indriya saṃnikṛṣṭe dhūme vahni vyāpya dhūma smaraṇe dhūma tva sādhāraṇa dharma darśanāt vyāpyaḥ ayam iti abheda pratyayaḥ syāt sāmagryā vṛtta tvāt iti saḥ eva anumiti hetuḥ iti ced na pratyakṣa sāmagrītaḥ anumiti sāmagryā balavat tvāt anumitiḥ eva utpadyate na tu vyāpya abheda pratyakṣam anyathā tava api parāmarśa anantaram tad anu vyavasāyaḥ vā bhavet na tu anumitiḥ eva atha vahni vyāpyaḥ dhūmaḥ iti smarataḥ parvatīya dhūma indriya saṃnikarṣeṇa prathamatas eva vyāpti dhūma tvayoḥ vaiśiṣṭyam yatra bhāsate viśeṣaṇa jñānasya pūrvam vṛtta tvāt tatra

yatra vā āpta vākyāt vahni vyāpi avān ayam iti jñānam tatra ubhayatra api lāghavāt pakṣa dharma vyāpya tva jñāna hetu tva kalpanāt anyatra api tathā iti ced na indriya asaṃnikṛṣṭe atīndriye ca liṅge pratyakṣa viśiṣṭa jñāna sāmagrī virahāt tena vinā anumiti anutpāda āpatteḥ asmad ukta sāmagryāḥ ca tatra api sattvāt na ca anumāna ādinā tatra parāmarśaḥ anavasthānāt atha yathā saḥ devadattaḥ gauraḥ na vā

paramāṇu guru tva adhikaraṇam na vā iti saṃśayaḥ bahis asvatantreṇa api manasā koṭi smaraṇa viśeṣa adarśana ādi sahakāri vaśāt janyate yathā vā nidrā sahakāreṇa bāhya svapna anubhavaḥ tathā iha api jñāna antara upanīta viśeṣye vyāpti smaraṇa saha kṛtena manasā parāmarśaḥ janyate tad anantaram anumiti darśanāt iti ced na vyāpti smaraṇa ādeḥ pramāṇa antara tā āpatteḥ tat eva hi pramāṇa antaram yat asādhāraṇam sahakārya āsādya manaḥ bahis gocara pramām janayati yathā indriya ādi saṃśaya svapnau tu na preme iti na nidrā ādeḥ pramāṇa antara tvam na ca tava api katham sa dhūmaḥ vahni vyāpya iti vyavahāraḥ

tadānīm tad vyāpya tva anubhāvaka abhāvāt iti vācyam tatra smṛta dhūme dhūma tvena vahni vyāpyatva anumānāt na ca tvad mate dhūma tvena vyāpya tva anubhavaḥ sambhavati atas eva yaḥ vahni vyāpyavān saḥ avaśyam vahnimān iti vyāpti jñānavataḥ anumitiḥ na anyathā atha parvatīya dhūme jñāte vahni vyāpyaḥ ayam na vā iti saṃśaye api anumitiḥ syāt iti ced na dhūmaḥ vahni vyāpya iti smaraṇe vidyamāne dhūma tva jñānasya viśeṣa darśana tvena saṃśaya abhāvāt anyathā parāmarśaḥ api kutas na syāt saṃśayena pratibandhāt iti ced tulyam na ca sāmānya niścayasya sāmānya saṃśaya nivartaka tvāt dhūma sāmānye saṃśayaḥ mā bhūt

viśeṣa saṃśayaḥ tu viśeṣa niścaya nivartanīyaḥ iti dhūma viśeṣe saṃśaya nirāsa artham pṛthak vyāpti niścayaḥ vācyaḥ iti vācyam yatra hi yat vyāvartaka dharma darśanam tatra na tad saṃśayaḥ tat ca sāmānye viśeṣe vā iti vastutas tu dhūma tva puraskāreṇa vyāpti smaraṇe pakṣa dharma tā jñāne ca anumitiḥ bhavati eva nanu bhāvaḥ abhāvaḥ vā ubhayathā api prameyam iti atra bhāva tva abhāva tvayoḥ vyāpyatāvaccheda kayoḥ agrahāt anumānam na syāt tad anya anyatva rūpasya antara tvasya liṅga tva abhāvāt iti ced na bhāva tva abhāva tva anyāni adharmavat tvasya liṅga tvāt evam dhūma āloka anyatara tvam api liṅgam atha yat vyatireka jñānam yat utpatti pratibandhakam tat tad niścaya sādhyam tathā ca pakṣa dharmasya vyāpya bheda jñānam anumiti pratibandhakam atas vyāpya abheda jñānam tat hetuḥ siddhyati iti ced na dhūma tva puraskāreṇa vyāpti smaraṇa pakṣa dharmatā jñāne sati viśeṣa darśanāt na dhūme vyāpya bheda jñānam

kim tu anumiteḥ eva tatra utpattiḥ tad sāmagrī sattvāt atas na vyāpya bheda jñānam anumiti pratibandhakam yena vyāpya abheda jñānam tat hetuḥ syāt na ca dhūma tva puraskāreṇa vyāpti smaraṇa pakṣa dharma tā jñāne iyam dhūma vyaktiḥ vahni vyāpyā na iti bhrāmyataḥ anumiti āpattiḥ atas viśiṣṭa jñānam tat hetuḥ iti vācyam dhūma tvasya viśeṣasya darśanena tādṛśa bhramānutpatteḥ tatra anumiti sadbhāvāt eva anyathā niścaya sāmagryām satyām bhrama anantaram parāmarśaḥ eva kutas na bhavati astu vā vyāpya tayā pakṣa dharma tayā ca avagatasya bheda agrahaḥ eva anumiti hetuḥ parāmarśa hetu tayā tasya āvaśyaka tvāt atas eva āsat nikṛṣṭa dhūma jñānāt api anumitiḥ na ca evam gauravam tadā viśiṣṭa jñāna anupasthiteḥ na ca janaka jñāna avirodhinaḥ jñānasya apratibandhaka tvāt bheda grahaḥ na pratibandhakaḥ iti vācyam abheda jñānasya ajanaka tvāt tvayā api liṅga parāmarśe tādṛśasya pratibandhaka tva svīkārāt ca

atha go tvam madhura tva avāntara jātiḥ vā liṅgam na syāt tad gata dharma antarasya abhāvāt atas eva tasya vilakṣaṇa tvāt iti ced na vyakteḥ eva tatra prakāra tvāt na hi gauḥ gotvam iti jñānayoḥ aviśeṣaḥ anyathā go tvam iti jñānasya nirvikalpaka tva āpattyā vyāpya tva grahe parāmarśe ca anupayogāt gavetara āvṛtti tve sati sakala go vṛtti tvam go tva tvam iti anubhavāt ca na ca evam anavasthā tad itara vṛtti tve sati tad vṛtti tvasya anubhavena apalāpa asambhavāt

atra ucyate ayam ālokaḥ dhūmaḥ vai ubhayathā api vahni vyāpya iti jñānam tatas anumitiḥ na ca dhūma tvena āloka tvena vā tatra niścayaḥ atha tad anya anya tvam eva tatra liṅgam na ca tad ajñāna daśāyām anumiti darśanāt na tathā iti vācyam dhūma ālokānya anyatva jñānam vinā tava api tatra vyāpya tva aniścayena tad artham tad bodha āvaśyaka tvāt iti ced na na hi dhūma ālokānya anya tvam dhūmānya anya tvam vā vyāpya tāvacchedakam gauravāt vyabhicārāḥ vāraka viśeṣaṇavat tvāt ca kim tu dhūma tva ādikam tat ca tatra saṃdigdham eva nanu tad anyā anyat vahni vyāpyam eva vyabhicāra abhāvena vyāpti viraha sādhanasya bādhita tvāt puruṣaḥ tu tatra nīladhūmavat tvāt iti atreva adhikena nigṛhyate na tu vyāpya tva asiddhyā iti ced na tad anyā anyat dhūma āloka svarūpam eva tat ca vyāpyam iti satyam na ca vastu gatyā vyāpya jñānāt anumitiḥ atiprasaṅgāt kim tu vyāpya tāvacchedaka prakāraka jñānāt na ca tad anya anya tvam vahni vyāpya tāvacchedakam iti uktam na ca tad anya anya tvāt vahni vyāpya tvam api tatra na anumeyam

vyartha viśeṣaṇa tvāt iti vācyam pratyakṣam hi tad anya anyatva viśeṣa darśanāt vyāpya tva jñānam janayati viśeṣaṇa jñāna viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya sambandha viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya indriya saṃnikarṣa tada saṃsarga āgraha viśeṣa darśanānām sattvena vahni vyāpya tva pratyakṣa sattvāt na ca evam na pratyakṣe api tad anya anyatva jñānam sahakārī iti vācyam anvaya vyatirekābhyām guroḥ api tasya viśeṣa darśana tvena pratyakṣa sahakāri tvāt tasmāt tat anya anyatva jñānam tatra vyāpya tā jñāna upakṣīṇam na tu sākṣāt anumiti hetuḥ iti kim ca vahni vyāpi avān ayam iti śābda jñāne vyāpyattva jñānam kāraṇam iti anyatra api tathā

atha vahni vyāpya tvam api vahni vyāpya tāvacchedakam tathā hi vahninirūpitā dhūma ādi pratyeka vṛttiḥ eva vyāptiḥ vyāpti tvena sakala dhūma ādi vṛtti vyāpti avacchedikā āśraya bhedena ca vyāpti bhedāt iti ced na sakala dhūma ādi vṛtti vyāptau māna abhāvāt yatra vahni vyāpyaḥ tatra vahniḥ iti vyāpti buddhau śābda vyāpya tva buddhau ca pratyeka vṛtti vyāpti āśrayatvasya eva viṣaya tvāt pratyeka vṛtti vyāpti jñānam vinā tad bodha abhāvāt api ca yatra dhūma tu a vyāptyoḥ vaiśiṣṭyam prathamam eva pratyakṣeṇa yugapad pakṣa dharme bhāsate tatra lāghavāt vyāpya tva jñāna tvam eva kāraṇa tāvacchedakam na ca evam atirikta viśiṣṭa jñāna kāraṇa tve gauravam doṣāya sa pramāṇaka tvāt kāraṇa tā graha daśāyām phala mukha gauravasya siddhi asiddhi bhyām adoṣa tvāt na ca asaṃnikṛṣṭe dhūme tad abhāvaḥ

bhavat matā anumiti hetu vyāpti smaraṇa dhūma tva jñāna sahitena manasā tad utpādāt yathā paramāṇuḥ niravayava dravyam nitya parimāṇavat tvāt ākāśa vat ityādau pratyeka anumāna upanīta atīndriya sādhya sādhanayoḥ ākāśa vṛtti tayā smaraṇe vyabhicāra ajñāne manasā vyāpti anubhavaḥ anumānayoḥ pratyeka tad ubhaya sahacāra viṣaya tvena vyāpti agrāhaka tvāt na ca atīndriya vyāpya tvam atīndriye anumeyam tatra api vyāpti grāhaka abhāvāt na ca tad upanaya sahitasya manasaḥ bahis artha pramā hetu tve upanayasya pramāṇa antara tvam indriya ādeḥ saṃnikarṣa vat upanayasya niyata vyāpāra abhāvena pramāya ām akaraṇa tvāt sahakāritā ca tad abhāve api bhavati bahis indriya liṅga sādṛśya ādi vyāpāram vinā api cintā upanīta padārthānām bādhakān avatāre saṃsarga anubhavasya sakala jana siddha tvāt katham anyathā kavi kā vya ādikam iti

syāt etat pakṣa dharmasya vyāpya tā jñānam na indriyeṇa vahneḥ asaṃnikarṣe tat niyata sāmānādhikaraṇyasya vyāpya tvasya asyogya tvāt na ca dhūma tvena sakala dhūma vyāpya tau agamāt dhūma viśeṣe saṃskārāt smaraṇāt vā upanīta vyāpya abheda grahaḥ pratyabhijñāne tat tā viśiṣṭasya iva iti vācyam evam hi dhūmavat tvena vahnimat tva jñānāt dhūma vat viśeṣe parvate saṃskāra vaśāt pratyakṣeṇa vyāpti jñāna apekṣeṇa vahni mada bheda grahaḥ vahnimat tva saṃsarga grahaḥ vā astu kim anumānena

pṛthak vahnimat tva smaraṇam tatra na asti kim tu vyāpti avacchedaka tayā iti ced na vahnimān na vā iti saṃśaya anurodhena svatantra vahnimat tva smaraṇāt na ca viśiṣṭa jñāne svatantra viśeṣaṇa jñāna tvena hetu tvam gauravāt atha yaḥ yatra viśiṣya pūrvam avagataḥ sa tatra saṃskāra vaśāt yathārtha pratyakṣe bhāsate yathā tat ta apratyabhijñāne na ca parvate viśiṣya purā vahniḥ avagataḥ yatra candane saurabham upalabdham tatra saṃskāra vaśāt cakṣuṣā surabhi candanam iti jñānam anyathā anumitiḥ iti ced tarhi pakṣa dharma dhūme api na purā viśiṣya vyāptiḥ avagata iti katham saṃskāra vaśāt tad gata vyāpti bodhaḥ pratyakṣeṇa

na ca sahacāra darśana janya saṃskāra sahitena indriyeṇa vyabhicāra jñāna abhāve sati mahānasīya dhūma vat parvatīya dhūme vyāpti avagamaḥ vahneḥ tu na pratyakṣa sāmagrī saṃnikarṣa abhāvāt iti vācyam hetu sādhya sākṣātkāram vinā pratyakṣeṇa vyāpti agrahāt na ca parvate vahni sākṣātkāraḥ na ca pakṣa dharmasya sādhya sāmāna adhikaraṇya viśeṣaḥ vyāptiḥ pakṣe sādhya graham vinā iti uktam

ucyate viśeṣaṇa jñānam tasya viśeṣye sambandhaḥ tayoḥ asaṃsarga āgrahaḥ viśeṣa darśanam viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya indriya saṃnikarṣaḥ gaurayam ityādi yathārtha viśiṣṭa pratyakṣa kāraṇam asti ca atra api vyāpti smaraṇam smṛta vyāpteḥ pakṣa vṛtti dhūme sattvam ekā eva hi sā vyāptiḥ tayoḥ asaṃsarga āgrahaḥ dhūma tva viśeṣa darśanam vyāpti viśiṣṭa dhūma indriya saṃnikarṣaḥ ca vyāpti viśiṣṭa jñāna kāraṇam na ca vahni viśiṣṭa jñāna sāmagrī vahneḥ asaṃnikarṣāt kaścid tu dhūma tve paramparā sambandhena vahni vyāpya tvam pūrvam gṛhītam tathā ca saṃskāra upanītam vahni vyāpya tvam paramparā sambandhena pakṣa vṛtti dhūma tve pratyabhijñāyate tad vṛtti tvena pūrvam anubhavāt evam ca dhūma tva vyāpya tva parāmarśāt eva anumitiḥ iti prāha

bhavatu tāvat evam tathā api jātiḥ eva liṅgam syāt na tu vyaktiḥ tathā ca sarva upasaṃhāreṇa vyaktau vyāpti graha artham sāmānya lakṣaṇa pratyāsatti vyutpāda nam aphalam syāt dṛśyate ca paramparā sambandha jñānam vinā jāti vyāptim aviduṣaḥ api dhūmāt vahni anumānam na hi vyāpya tāvacchedaka tayā bhāsamānasya avaśyam vyāpya tā grahaḥ māna abhavāt tasmāt pakṣa dharme vyāpti viśiṣṭa jñānam tad anantaram viśiṣṭa vaiśiṣṭya jñānam pakṣe vā tṛtīya liṅga parāmarśaḥ

anye tu sva samāna adhikaraṇa atyanta abhāva apratiyogi tvam vyāpaka tvam tad sāmānādhikaraṇyam ca vyāpya tvam tathā ca lāghavāt vyāpaka tā jñānam anumiti hetuḥ sādhyasya pakṣa dharma vyāpaka tā jñānam ca parāmarśaḥ na tu sādhya vyāptasya pakṣa dharma tā jñānam sādhya vyāpya vat pakṣa jñānam vā gauravāt atas eva yaḥ yaḥ dhūmavān sa saḥ agnimān iti udāharaṇa vākye sādhya ayoga vyavacchedena dhūma vyāpaka tā vahneḥ upadarśyate anyathā vahnimān ā iva dhūmavān iti anya yoga vyavacchedena udāharaṇa śarīram syāt doṣaḥ api vyabhicāra ādiḥ na pakṣa dharma vyāpakam sādhyam iti eva udbhāvyaḥ

atha parvata vṛtti dhūma vyāpakaḥ vahniḥ iti parāmarśaḥ yadi tadā parvatīya dhūmam prati vyāpaka tāyāḥ parvata dhūma sāmānādhikaraṇya naiyatyāt parvata vahniḥ parāmarśa viṣayaḥ eva iti kim anumeyam iti ced tarhi parvatīya dhūme niyata sādhya sāmānādhikaraṇyasya vyāpya tvasya jñānam sādhya sāmāna adhikaraṇya bhāna niyatam iti vyāpya tva bhāne api tulyam yadi ca smṛtā vyāptiḥ dhūme avagamyate tadā vyāpaka tve api samānam

vastutas tu vyāpaka tvam tadvat niṣṭhā atyanta abhāva apratiyogi tvam na tu dhūma sāmānādhikaraṇyam vyāpya tvam tu sāmānādhikaraṇya viśeṣaḥ iti tava eva anumitiḥ aphalā syāt na ca evam parāmarśasya cākṣuṣa tvam na syāt vyāpakasya viśeṣyasya indriya asaṃnikarṣāt iti vācyam iṣṭa tvāt asaṃnikṛṣṭa dhūma ādau iva mānasaḥ eva hi sarvatra parāmarśaḥ cakṣuḥ anvaya vyatireka anuvidhānam ca pakṣa vṛtti dhūma upanaya upakṣīṇam atha janaka jñāne upasarjana tayā bhātasya pakṣasya parvata ādeḥ anumitau prādhānyena bhānam na syāt na hi janaka jñāne upasarjana tayā avagatam janya jñāne prādhānyena bhāsate tathā adarśanāt na ca anumiteḥ tathā atvam asiddham parvataḥ ayam vahnimān iti anumiteḥ loka siddha tvāt iti ced

na puruṣasya daṇḍaḥ iti jñāna anantaram daṇḍī puruṣaḥ iti jñāna janya jñāna darśanāt anyathā tava api katham pakṣa viśeṣyaka tva niyamaḥ na hi kāraṇībhūta jñāne yat viśeṣya tayā bhāsate tat kāryībhūte api tathā iha bhū tale ghaṭaḥ na asti iti jñāna janye ghaṭa abhāvavat bhū talam iti jñāne tava ca vyabhicārāt tasmāt pakṣa vṛtti liṅga parāmarśasya ayam svabhāvaḥ yat sva āśraya viśeṣyikām anumitim janayati na atathā bhūtām evam mama api tulyam iti

evam liṅga parāmarśaḥ kāraṇam na tu parāmṛśyamānam liṅgam atha parāmarśa mātram na hetuḥ api tu liṅga parāmarśaḥ tathā ca liṅgam api hetuḥ viśiṣṭa kāraṇa tā grāhaka mānena bādhakam vinā viśeṣaṇasya api hetu tva grahāt na ca liṅgam parāmarśa paricāyaka tvena anyathā siddham paricaye viśeṣaṇa antara abhāvena liṅgam eva viśeṣakam tathā ca ananyathā asiddha tvāt tat api hetuḥ anyathā paricāyaka tayā saṃyogena anyathā siddham indriyam api kāraṇam na syāt

api ca dhūmavān vahnimān iti dhūma samāna kāla vahni viṣayā dhūma viśeṣaṇikā anumitiḥ jñāyamāna viśeṣaṇa janyā viśeṣaṇa samāna kāla tayā viśeṣya viṣaye aśābda viśiṣṭa bhāna tvāt daṇḍī puruṣaḥ iti viśiṣṭa pratyaya vat atas eva jñāyamāna viśeṣaṇa janya tvena viśeṣaṇa kāla vṛtti tayā viśeṣya bhāna naiyatyam yathā daṇḍī puruṣaḥ iti pratyakṣe tena dhūma samāna kālīna vahni siddhiḥ anyathā tad tad dhūma kāla vṛtti vahni anumānam na syāt samaya viśeṣam antar bhāvya vyāpti agrahāt kim ca liṅga karaṇa tva pakṣe parāmarśaḥ eva tad vyāpāraḥ parāmarśasya tu na vyāpāra antaram asti carama kāraṇa tvāt iti na tat karaṇam atra ucyate atīta anāgata dhūma ādi jñāne api anumiti darśanāt na liṅgam tad hetuḥ vyāpāra pūrva varti tayoḥ abhāvāt

na ca vidyamānam liṅga antaram eva tad hetuḥ tadā tasya aparāmarśāt parāmarśa aviṣayasya kāraṇa tā grāhaka abhāvāt bhāvini pakṣe vyakti aikyam eva vā yatra liṅgam tatra liṅga antara abhāvāt ca yadi ca vartamānam eva tatra liṅgam tadā vartamāna vahni anumāna upapattiḥ atha bhāvi bhūtam vā dhūma ādi na liṅgam kim tu tad prāc abhāvaḥ tad dhvaṃsaḥ ca vartamānaḥ eva tayoḥ api vahni samāna deśa tvāt iti ced na atīta bhāvi dina vṛtti tayā niścitāt vartamāna tayā sandigdhāt dhūmāt anumitau hi na prāc abhāva dhvaṃsau liṅge tayoḥ saṃdigdha tvāt na api dhūmaḥ tasya āvartamāna tvāt

kim ca bhūta bhā vivartamāna tva aviṣayāt parvate dhūmaḥ iti jñānāt yatra anumānam tatra kā gatiḥ sarvatra prāc abhāva ādi anyatamava tvam dhūma ādi atyanta abhāva abhāvavat tvam vā liṅgam iti ced na vyartha viśeṣaṇa tvena teṣām aliṅga tvāt anyatamatva ajñāne api dhūma jñānāt anumitisattvāt ca api ca dhūma prāc abhāva ādi na liṅgam na vā tad dhīra numiti kāraṇam prāc abhāva ādīnām vyartha tvāt āvaśyaka dhūma ādi jñānāt eva anumiti sambhavāt ca kim ca liṅgam na anumiti mātre hetuḥ liṅgam vinā api dhūlī paṭalāt liṅga bhrameṇa anum iti utpatteḥ na api liṅgam pramā anu mitau parāmarśaḥ anumiti mātre hetuḥ tad viśeṣa pramātvā pramātvābhyām eva anumiti tathā tvāt yat sāmānye yat sāmānyam prayojakam tad viśeṣe tad viśeṣasya prayojaka tvāt

atha parāmarśasya pramātvam vidyamāna liṅga viṣaya tvam tathā ca āyātam liṅgasya pramānum iti hetu tvam iti ced na bhāvinā bhūtena vā yadā kadācid vidyamānena api liṅgena parāmarśa pramātu a sambhavāt na anumiti pūrva samaye tad pramātvā anurodhena liṅgasya sattvam kāraṇa tvam vā dhūmakālīna vahni anumānam ca yadā yatra dhūmaḥ tadā tatra vahniḥ iti vyāpti jñānāt eva

atha vā dhūma kālaḥ pakṣa tāvat chedakaḥ pakṣa tā avacchedaka dharma samāna adhikaraṇam ca pakṣa dharma tā balāt sādhyam sidhyati iti dhūmakālīna vahni siddhiḥ yat tu vyāpāra abhāvāt na parāmarśaḥ karaṇam iti tathā eva kim tu vyāpti jñānam karaṇam parāmarśaḥ vyāpāraḥ na ca parāmarśasya saṃskāraḥ vyāpāraḥ parāmarśasya carama kāraṇa tvena saṃskāra utpādana samaye anum iti utpādanāt na api tarkaḥ vyāpti grāhakasya viṣaya pariśodhakasya vā tasya tad ajanya tvāt iti

tat ca anumānam trividham kevala anvayi kevala vyatirekyā anvaya vyatireki bhedāt tatra asat vipakṣam kevala anvayi tathā hi kevala anvayinaḥ abhidheya tvasya na vipakṣaḥ abhidhāne anabhidhāne ca vipakṣa tva vyāghātāt atha yathā ākāśa śabdāt śabda āśraya tvam anabhidheyam api upatiṣṭhate tathā abhidheya tva vipakṣasya anabhidheya tve api padāt upasthitiḥ syāt evam ca abhidheya tvam kutas api vyāvṛttam dharma tvāt go tva vat iti ced na vyāvṛt tattvasya avyāvṛtta tve vyāvṛtta tvam eva kevala anvayi vyāvṛtta tve atas eva vyāvṛttam vyāvṛtta tvam tat eva kevala anvayī iti dharma tvasya anaikāntika tvāt evam atyanta abhāva pratiyogi tvasya atyanta abhāva apratiyogi tve atyanta abhāva apratiyogi tvam eva kevala anvayi atyanta abhāva pratiyogi tve yat niṣṭhā ati anta abhāva pratiyogi anta abhāva pratiyogi tvam tat eva kevala anvayi na ca atyanta abhāva pratiyogi tvam vyāvṛtta tvam ca nānā iti vācyam anugata pratīti balena go tva vat tayoḥ siddheḥ

atra na tāvat avyāpya vṛtti atyanta abhāvaḥ kevala anvayī tasya pratiyogi avacchinne api atyanta abhāvāt atyanta abhāva apratiyoginaḥ ca kevala anvayitvāt na api āśraya nāśa janya guṇa nāśa atyanta abhāvaḥ tasya nāśasya sarvatra atyanta abhāvāt iti vācyam yatra hi pratiyogi prāgabhāvaḥ vartate tatra na tad atyanta abhāvaḥ vartate tathā ca nāśasya prāgabhāvaḥ yatra nāśa pratiyogi samāna deśe vartate tatra katham nāśa atyanta abhāvaḥ vartatām tarhi nāśasya tatra vṛttiḥ syāt iti ced na pūrvam tatra nāśa prāga bhāvasya eva sattvāt uttara kāle āśrayasya eva abhāvāt na api ākāśa atyanta abhāvaḥ kevala anvayī tasya api pratiyogi rūpa atyanta abhāva pratiyogi tvāt abhāva atyanta abhāvasya bhāva tvāt atha abhāva atyanta abhāvaḥ na pratiyogi rūpaḥ tathā sati anyonya abhāva atyanta abhāvaḥ pratiyogi rūpaḥ iti pratiyogi samāna deśaḥ anyonya abhāvaḥ na syāt iti ced na atyanta abhāva atyanta abhāvaḥ pratiyogi eva anyonya abhāva atyanta abhāvaḥ tu pratiyogi vṛtti rasādhāraṇaḥ dharmaḥ iti

ucyate vṛttimat atyanta abhāva apratiyogi tvam kevala anvayitvam ākāśa atyanta abhāvaḥ yadi api pratiyogi rūpa atyanta abhāva pratiyogī tathā api na sa vṛttimān iti ākāśa atyanta abhāvaḥ eva kevala anvayī tathā prameya tva abhidheya tva ādi kevala anvayi vṛttimataḥ atyanta abhāvasya apratiyogi tvāt nanu prameya tvam pramāviṣayatvam tat ca na kevala anvayi pramāyāḥ viṣaya tvasya ca ananugamāt iti vācyam pramā tvam eva hi paramparā sambandhāt ghaṭa ādau prameya tvam anugatam pramājātīya viṣaya tvam vā tathā api kevala anvayini saṃśaya abhāvāt katham anumitiḥ prameya tvam atra vartate na vā iti saṃśayaḥ ca na prameya pakṣakaḥ kiṃtu prameya tva pakṣakaḥ bhinna viṣayakaḥ prameya tva pakṣake ca astitva sādhyasya anvaya vyatireki tvam tathā ca ghaṭaḥ prameyaḥ na vā iti saṃśayaḥ mṛgyate sa ca na asti eva

atha pakṣaḥ sādhyavān na vā pakṣe sādhyam asti na vā iti saṃśayau samāna viṣayakau eva tat asya aḥ ti asmin iti matupaḥ vidhānāt iti ced na viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāva bhedena artha bhedāt mā evam yaḥ eva hi saṃśayaḥ pakṣe sādhya siddhi virodhī saḥ eva anumāna aṅgam āvaśyaka tvāt lāghavāt ca na tu samāna viṣayaka tvam api tatra tantram gauravāt prameya tvam ghaṭa niṣṭhā bhāva pratiyogi na vā iti saṃśayaḥ ca ghaṭaḥ prameyaḥ iti sādhya siddhi virodhī bhavati eva yat vā saṃśaya yogya tā eva anumāna aṅgam saṃśayaḥ ca tadānīm vināśāt na ca sā api sādhaka bādhaka pramāṇa abhāvaḥ prameya tva abhāva asiddhau tad pramāṇa asiddhaḥ tad abhāvā siddhiḥ iti vācyam pakṣa niṣṭhā atyanta abhāva apratiyogi tva jñānasya iva sādhya sādhaka tvena tadā abhāvasya eva yogyatā tvāt prameya tvam atyanta abhāva pratiyogī iti bhrāmyataḥ saṃśayaḥ iti anye

nanu eka rūpa vikalam idam katham gamakam tattve vā vyatireka vikala vat rūpa antara vikalam api gamakam syāt iti ced na anvaya vyatireka vyāptyoḥ anyatara niścayena anum iti anubhavāt yugapad ubhaya vyāpti upasthitau vinigamana abhāvena ubhayoḥ api prayojaka tve vyatireka upāsanā vyatirekaḥ ca vipakṣa vṛtti tva śaṅkā nivṛtti dvārā vyatireka vyāptau upayujyate atra tu vipakṣa abhāvena śaṅkā eva na udeti

kevala vyatirekī tu asat sapakṣaḥ yatra vyatireka sahacāreṇa vyāpti grahaḥ nanu vyatireki na anumānam vyāpti pakṣa dharma tā jñānasya tad hetu tvāt atra ca vyatireka sahacārāt tatra vyāptiḥ anvayasya na pakṣa dharma tā na ca vyāpta pakṣa dharma tvam sādhya abhāva vyāpaka abhāva pratiyogi tvam dvayam anumiti prayojakam iti vācyam ananugamāt na ca anyatara tvam tathā eka pramāṇa pariśeṣa āpatteḥ na ca tṛṇa araṇi maṇi nyāyena anumiti viśeṣe tad kāraṇa tvam iti vācyam vyatireki sādhye anumiti tva asiddheḥ ubhaya siddha kḷpta tad kāraṇasya abhāvāt na ca sādhya abhāva vyāpaka abhāva pratiyogi tvam eva anumiti prayojakam iti vācyam gauravāt kevala anvayinī abhāvāt ca

atha sādhya abhāva vyāpaka bhāva pratiyogi tvena sādhya vyāpya tvam eva anumīyate evam vyatireka vyāptyā anvaya vyāptim anumāya yatra anumitiḥ saḥ eva vyatirekī iti ucyate iti tat na anvaya vyāpteḥ gamaka tve vyatireka vyāpti upanyāsasya artha antara tā āpatteḥ anvaya vyāpti anukūla tayā ca tad upanyāse anvaya vyāptim anupanyasya tad upanyāsasya aprāpta kāla tvāt iti

ucyate nirupādhi vyatireka sahacāreṇa anvavyāptiḥ eva gṛhyate pratiyogi anuyogi bhāvasya niyāmāka tvāt anvaya vyatireki vat na ca evam vyāpti grahaḥ eva pṛthivī itara bhinna iti bhāsitam niyata sāmānādhikaraṇya rūpa tvāt vyāpteḥ iti ced satyam gandhavat tva avacchedena itara bhedasya sādhya tvāt atas eva ācāryaḥ pakṣa tāvat chedake na hetu tvam anumene pṛthivī tvam itara bheda vyāpyam iti pratītau api sarvā pṛthivī itara bhinnā iti pṛthivī viśeṣyaka buddheḥ vyatireki sādhya tvāt ca

yat vā vyatireka vyāpteḥ eva anvayena gamya gamaka bhāvaḥ sādhya abhāva vyāpaka sādhana abhāva abhāvena sādhanena pakṣe sādhya abhāva abhāvasya sādhyasya sādhanāt vyāpaka abhāvena vyāpya abhāva avaśyam bhāvāt atha evam na sā anumitiḥ kḷpta tad hetu liṅga parāmarśa abhāvāt anyathā ananugamaḥ iti ced na anumiti mātre vyāpti jñānasya prayojaka tvāt na ca evam atiprasaṅgaḥ anumiti sāmānya sāmagryām satyām api anumiti virahāt anum iti anutpatteḥ viśeṣa sāmagrī sāpekṣāyāḥ eva sāmānya sāmagryāḥ janakatvāt anvayi vyatireki viśeṣa dvaya sāmagrī ca na asti eva

nanu pṛthivī itarebhyaḥ bhidyate pṛthivī tvāt iti vyatirekiṇi sādhyam asiddham tathā ca na vyatireki nirūpaṇam na vā pakṣa tvam na vā liṅga janī a sādhya viśiṣṭa tad jñānam teṣām sādhya jñāna janya tvāt atha sādhyam prasiddham tadā yatra prasiddham tatra hetoḥ avagame anvayitvam anavagame asādhāraṇyam kiñca itara bhedaḥ na svarūpam adhikaraṇa pratiyoginoḥ pṛthivī jala ādyoḥ anumānāt prāk eva siddheḥ na api vaidharmyam jala ādi niṣṭhā atyanta abhāva pratiyogim atvam tat hi pṛthivī tva ādikam tat ca siddham eva na ca jala ādi niṣṭhā atyanta abhāva pratiyegi tvena pṛthivī tvam na siddham iti vācyam jala ādau pṛthivī tva atyanta abhāva graha daśāyām pṛthivī tve api tad pratiyogi tva grahāt anyonya abhāvaḥ tu bhedaḥ yadi api sādhyam sambhavati vaidharmya jñāna sādhya tvāt anyonya abhāva grahasya tathā api jala ādi pratiyogikānyonya abhāvasya aprasiddhiḥ na ca jala ādi pratyekānyonya abhāvaḥ sādhyaḥ asādha araṇya prasaṅgāt

atha pṛthivī tejaḥ bhinnā na vā iti saṃśayena tejaḥ bhinna tve avagate pṛthivī tejaḥ bhinnā satī jala ādi dvādaśa bhinnā na vā iti saṃśaye tejaḥ bhinna tve sati jala ādi dvādaśa bhinna tvam prasiddham tat eva sādhyam eka viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭe viśeṣaṇa antara buddheḥ eva viśiṣṭa vaiśiṣṭya jñāna tvāt evañca saṃśaya prasiddham sādhyam ādāya vyatireka ādi nirūpaṇam yat vā pṛthivī jala ādi bhinnā na vā iti pratyekam trayodaśa saṃśaya viṣayāṇām trayodaśa anyonya abhāvānām samudāyaḥ pṛthivyām avagataḥ vyatireka ādi nirupakaḥ na ca evam pṛthivyām eva sādhya prasiddheḥ vyatireki vaiyarthyam sādhya niścaya artha vyatireki pravṛtteḥ na ca asādha araṇyam samudita anyonya abhāvānām sādhya tve sa pakṣa abhāvāt iti ced na sādhya niścaye hi sādhya vyatireka niścayaḥ bhavati eva sādhya sandehe tad vyatireka saṃśayasya vajra lepa tvāt tathā ca saṃśaya rūpā sādhya siddhiḥ iti śiṣya bandhanam etena pṛthivī jala ādibhyaḥ bhinnā iti vipratipatti rūpa vādi vākyāt ākāṅkṣa ādi mataḥ apūrva artha pratipādakāt sādhya prasiddhiḥ iti parāḥ tam vākyāt eva pṛthivyām sādhya siddheḥ vyatireki vaiyarthyāt

na ca tad buddhau vādi vākya janya tvena apramāṇi asaṃśayāt niścaye api saṃśayaḥ iti tad niścaya artham vyatirekī iti vācyam tarhi saṃśaya prasiddham sādhyam tasya ca na vyatireka niścayāka tvam iti ukta tvāt sva artha anumāne tad abhāvāt ca ucyate ghaṭa ādau eva itara sakala bhedasya pratyakṣatas prasiddhiḥ ghaṭaḥ na jalādiḥ iti pratīteḥ nanu ayam anyonya abhāvaḥ na pratyakṣaḥ atīndriya pratiyogika abhāva tvāt paramāṇu saṃsarga abhāva vat yogyā anupalabdheḥ abhāva grāhaka tvāt nayana unmīlana anantaram stambhaḥ piśācaḥ na bhavati iti pratiteḥ bādhaka balena vāyuḥ vātī iti valliṅga graha upakṣīṇa tvāt iti ced na yaḥ hi ānupalambhaḥ adhikaraṇe pratiyogimattva virodhī saḥ abhāvam grāhayati na tu yogyā anupalabdhi mātram anyathā vāyau rūpa abhāva pratīti vat jala paramāṇau pṛthivī tva abhāva graha prasaṅgāt adhikaraṇe pratiyogi satvañca tarkitam yadi hi stambhaḥ piśācaḥ syāt stambha vat upalabhyeta na piśāca anupalambhaḥ syāt na ca pṛthivī jalāt bhidyate jala āvṛtti dharmavat tvāt tejaḥ vat

evam anyebhyaḥ api bheda siddhau dvādaśabhinna iti viśeṣaṇam dattvā samavāya bheda sādhanāt anvayinaḥ eva pṛthivyām trayāt aśa bheda siddhiḥ iti kim vyatirekiṇa iti vācyam jala ādi bhinnā satī samavāyibhinnā iti buddhau api trayodaśa bhinna iti buddheḥ vyatireki sādhya tvāt na ca ghaṭasya api pakṣa tvāt aṃśataḥ siddha sādhanam sarvā pṛthivī itara bhinna iti uddeśya pratīteḥ abhāvāt pakṣa tāvacchedaka nānātve hi tat atas eva anitye vāc manase iti atra anityā vāc iti buddheḥ uddeśyāyāḥ siddha tvāt aṃśataḥ siddha sādhanam anyathā anumāna mātra ucchedāt pakṣasya siddhasya eva sādhya tvāt na ca ghaṭaḥ katham pakṣaḥ sādhya niścayena saṃśaya siṣā dhayiṣayoḥ abhāvāt iti vācyam sarvā pṛthivī itara bhinnā na vā iti saṃśayasya tad prakāraka siṣā dhayiṣāyāḥ ca sāmānyatas ghaṭa viṣaya tvāt ghaṭa tvena viśeṣa darśanam siddhiḥ vā atas tena rupeṇa saṃśaya siṣā dhayiṣe na staḥ pṛthiva tvena tu bhavataḥ eva dhūmavān vahnimān iti dhūmava tvena vahni niścayepi parvate vahni saṃśaya vat

yat vā sarva tvena rūpeṇa na pakṣatā sarvatra avipratipatteḥ ghaṭa ādi eka deśe itara bhedasya pratyakṣa siddha tvāt tathā ca eka deśe vipratipattau sāmānye itara bheda sādhane artha antaram kintu sāmānyena pṛthivī tvena yāvat eva vipratipatti viṣayaḥ tāvatām eva pakṣatā viśeṣyān anugamāt tarhi pṛthivī itara bhinnā pṛthivī tvāt ghaṭa vat iti anvayinā eva itara bhedasya siddha tvāt kim vyatirekiṇā ghaṭa sādhāraṇa pakṣa tve api abheda anumāna vat pakṣasya api dṛṣṭānta tva avirodhāt pakṣa anyatvam hi tatra atantram kintu sādhyavat tayā niścita tvam prayojakam na ca pṛthivī tva agrahe pūrvam gṛhītam yatra sādhyam paścāt smaryate tatra hetu sādhya sāmānā adhikaraṇyā grahāt vyatireki avatāraḥ iti vācyam hetoḥ eva pakṣātāvacchedaka tvena ghaṭe pṛthivī tva graha daśāyām itara bheda sāmānādhikaraṇya graha avaśyaṃbhāvāt iti ced satyam

anvayi tulya tayā vyatirekiṇaḥ api sāmarthyāt anvaya apratisandhāna daśāyām vyatireki upanyāsasya aparyanuyojya tvāt tat uktam āstām tāvat ayam suhṛd upadeśaḥ kevala vyatireki lakṣaṇam tāvat nirvyūḍham athavā jala ādīnām trayodaśa anyonya abhāvāḥ trayodaśasu prasiddhāḥ pṛthivyām sādhyante atas eva ākāśe vyatirekiṇāḥ jala ādi milita pratiyogika anyonya abhāva apratītau api trayodaśa anyonya abhāvāḥ sādhyāḥ iti na anvayitvā sādhāraṇye

yat vā jalam tejaḥ prabhṛti dvādaśa bhinna pratiyogikān yonya abhāva vat dravya tvāt tejaḥ vat iti anumānāt trayodaśa bhinnasya sāmānyatas siddhau pṛthivyām trayodaśa bhinna tvam sādhyam na ca anvayitvam asādhāraṇyam vā pakṣāt anyatra sādhya aprasiddheḥ vastu gatyā pṛthivyām eva sādhya siddheḥ kim vyatirekiṇa iti ced na pṛthivī trayodaśabhinna iti vyatirekiṇam vinā apratīteḥ nanu evam pṛthivī jala ādi trayodaśa bhinna pratiyogikānyonya abhāvavatī dravya tvāt iti pṛthivī bhinna tad bhinna ādi siddhiḥ syāt iti ced na aprayojaka tvāt prakṛte ca anubhūyamāna jala ādi vaidharmyasya pṛthivī tva śabda āśraya tva ādeḥ atiriktam vinā anupapatteḥ

nanu itara bhedaḥ yadi anyonya abhāvaḥ tadā bhāvāt bhedaḥ na siddhyet abhāvasya abhāva antara abhāvāt yadi ca tena samam svarūpa bhedaḥ eva sādhyaḥ tadā ananugamāt anumāna apravṛttiḥ bhāvaḥ abhāvaḥ vā na bhavati iti abādhita pratīti balāt abhāvasya api anyonya abhāvaḥ asti iti kecid tat na apasiddhāntāt anatiprasakta adhikaraṇa svarūpa mātreṇa eva abhāva prati iti upapattau ca adhika abhāve māna abhāvāt ca iti ced na itara abhāva anyonya abhāvasya sādhya tvāt na ca evam abhāvāt aviveka tādavasthyam tena samam svarūpa bhedasya anvayinā vyatirekiṇā vā sādhya tvāt

anye tu pṛthivī tva bhinna dharma atyanta abhāvaḥ eva sādhyaḥ jala tva ādi pratiyogikāḥ tāvantaḥ atyanta abhāvāḥ vā tad tad asādhāraṇa tad tad dharma atyanta abhāva yogaḥ vā ete ca abhāvāḥ jala tvam na ghaṭa ādau ghaṭa ādi jala atyanta abhāva vat iti pratyakṣa ādeḥ kvacid tad tad vaidharmyāt eva prasiddhāḥ iti na aprasiddhiḥ tāvatam abhāvānām vaiśiṣṭyam na prasiddham iti ced kim etāvatā na hi tāvat vaiśiṣṭyam atra sādhyate kim tu jala tva ādīnām yāvantaḥ abhāvāḥ iha sādhyāḥ te ca tatra tatra prasiddhāḥ eva tāvat vaiśiṣṭya dhīḥ tu phalam anyathā siddha sādhanāt militānām api sādhya tve na aprasiddhiḥ kiñcid eka dharma avacchedaḥ hi bala ādi vat melakā arthaḥ sa na na asiddhaḥ na ca hetoḥ asādhāraṇyam tāvat abhāva yogī hi atra sa pakṣaḥ bhavati na tu tad eka deśa katipaya abhāvavān sādhya tāyāḥ tāvatya paryāpteḥ yat vā jala tva atyanta abhāvaḥ tejaḥ tvātya abhāva adhikaraṇa vṛttiḥ atyanta abhāva tvāt ghaṭa tva atyanta abhāva vat evam atyanta abhāva antara sāmānādhikaraṇyam api tatra sādhyam iti kva aprasiddhiḥ

kim ca itare tāvat prasiddhāḥ eva te ca bheda pratiyoginaḥ meya tvāt iti itara bhedaḥ api sugrahaḥ eva nanu pṛthivī na itara bhedavatī guru tva ādibhyaḥ jala vat iti pratirodhaḥ iti ced na itara bheda niṣedhaḥ hi itara abhedaḥ na tu tejaḥ prabhṛti abhedaḥ jalaḥ iti dṛṣṭāntasya sādhya vaikalyāt caturdaśa abhedānām ca ekatra virodhena asambhavāt caturdaśa bhedānām ca ekatra vṛttau na virodhaḥ

yat tu sādhya prasiddhau pṛthivī itara bhinnā tad sādhya adhikaraṇa pṛthivī anyatara tvāt tad adhikaraṇa vat pṛthivyām tad sādhyam anvayinaḥ eva setsyati iti tat na anyatara tvasya aliṅga tvāt iti ukta tvāt liṅga tve vā jala ādau api tad siddhi prasaṅgāt evam tarhi pṛthivī jalam pṛthivī tvāt yat na jalam tat na pṛthivī yathā tejaḥ iti sat pratipakṣaḥ astu iti ced na ajalasya ghaṭa ādeḥ pratyakṣatas eva pṛthivī tva niścaye vyatireka vyabhicārāt asya nyūna tvāt tad anavadhāraṇe tu sat pratipakṣa tvam iṣṭam eva

nanu jīvat śarīram sa ātmakam prāṇa ādimattvāt icchā ādikā aryavat tvāt vā iti vyatirekiṇi sādhya aprasiddhau katham vyatireka ādi nirūpaṇam nerāmyam ca na ghaṭasya pratyakṣa vedyam tasya tatra asāmarthyāt na anumāna gamyam nairātmya apratītau anvayinaḥ abhāvāt sa ātmaka tva pratītim vinā vyatirekiṇaḥ anupapatteḥ atha icchā samavāyi kāraṇa janyā kāryatvāt tat ca samavāyi kāraṇam pṛthivī ādi aṣṭa dravya bhinnam pṛthivī ādi tve bādhaka sattvāt iti pṛthivī ādi bhinna ātma siddhau tat vatvam jīvat śarīre sādhyate iti ced yadi sa ātmaka tvam ātma saṃyogavat tvam tadā ghaṭa ādau tat asti iti tatas hetu vyāvṛttau asādha araṇyam jñāna samāna adhikaraṇa jñāna kāraṇībhūta saṃyoga āśraya kārya tvam

sa ātmaka tvam śarīra ātma saṃyogasya jñāna kāraṇa tvāt ātma manasoḥ tathā ātve api akārya tvāt iti ced na śarīrāt anyatra asiddheḥ tatra prasiddhau siddha sādhanāt icchāyāḥ asamavāyi kāraṇa saṃyoga avacchedaka tvasya abhāvaḥ ghaṭa ādau dṛṣṭaḥ tad vyatirekaḥ śarīre sādhyate iti ced na icchāyāḥ asamavāyi kāraṇa saṃyoga vat chedaka tvasya śarīraḥ eva prasiddheḥ siddha sādhanāt anyathā asiddhi vyatireka ādya nirūpaṇāt aprasiddha sādhya saṃsargam iva sādhyam aprasiddham sādhayati vyatirekī iti ced na vyatireka ādya nirūpaṇāt asādhāraṇa dharmeṇa apratīta padārtha anumāne ghaṭa tva ādinā api sva icchā kalpi taḍittha ādi anumāna prasaṅgaḥ iti

ucyate icchā samavāyi karaṇa siddhau icchā tvam saṃyoga samavāyi kāraṇaka vṛtti nitya indriya grāhya viśeṣa guṇa vṛtti guṇa tva sākṣāt vyāpya jāti tvāt śabda tva vat sa ca asamavāyi kāraṇam saṃyogaḥ kiñcid avacchinnaḥ saṃyoga tvāt ātma saṃyoga mātrasya icchā janaka tve sa ātmaka tvam śarīre sādhyate yat vā ātmani icchādhāra tā mahat saṃyoga avacchedyāḥ janya vibhu viśeṣa guṇa ādhāra tā tvāt vāyu ādi saṃyoga avacchedya śabda ādhāra tva vat iti sāmānyatas siddham icchā dhāra tā ghaṭaka icchā samavāyi kāraṇa dravya saṃyogava tvam sa ātmaka tvam atas eva jñāna samāna adhikaraṇa jñāna kāraṇībhūta saṃyoga āśraya kārya tvam vā sa ātmaka tvam sva śarīre prāṇa ādimattvasya icchā ādimattvasya ca ceṣṭā avayava upacaya ādi vyāpya tva grahāt ghaṭa ādau ceṣṭā ādi viraheṇa prāṇa ādimattva icchā ādimattva viraha anumānam icchā ādi virahāt icchā ādi prayojaka icchā ādya āghāra tā ghaṭaka icchā ādya samavāyi kāraṇa saṃyāga viraha anumānam kārya abhāvavati kāraṇa abhāva niyamāt

na ca sa ātmaka tvam śarīra vṛtti śarīre bādhaka abhāvāt śarīra tva vat iti anvayinā eva sādhya siddheḥ kim vyatirekiṇa iti vācyam śarīram sa ātmakam iti śarīra viśeṣyaka buddheḥ vyatirekiṇam vinā anupapatteḥ upāya antarasya upāya antarāt ūṣaka tvāt ca yat vā ceṣṭā saṃyoga asamavāyi kāraṇikā saṃskāra janya kriyā tvat iti ceṣṭāyāḥ asamavāyi kāraṇa saṃyoga siddhau prayatna vat ātma saṃyogaḥ evam paryavasyati prayatna anvaya vyatireka anuvidhāyi tvāt evam ceṣṭāyāḥ asamavāyi kāraṇa saṃyoga āśraya tve sati śarīra tvam sa ātmaka tvam jīvat śarīre sādhyam ceṣṭāvat tvāt iti hetuḥ ceṣṭā virahaḥ ca ghaṭa ādau pratyakṣa siddhaḥ ceṣṭā virahāt tad asamavāyi kāraṇa saṃyoga virahaḥ api sugrahaḥ

yat vā jīvat śarīram tad avayavaḥ vā ātma bhinna tve sati ātma viśeṣa guṇa kāraṇa bhogān ādhikaraṇa āvṛtti saṃyoga vat prāṇa anyatve sati jñāna kāraṇībhūta prāṇa saṃyogavat tvāt yat na evam tat na evam yathā ghaṭaḥ ātma prāṇa saṃyogaḥ prāṇa manassaṃyogaḥ vā śarīra prāṇa saṃyogena eva anyathā siddhaḥ na kāraṇam bhoga ādhāra tvam bhoga samavāyi kāraṇa atirikta vṛtti sakala bhoga adhikaraṇa vṛtti tvāt prameya tva ādi vat iti tārkikī rītiḥ

kim ca saṃśaya upasthita sādhyasya vyatireka nirūpaṇam na yogyā anupalambhāt sādhya niścayam vinā yogyā anupalambha abhāvāt na api vyāpaka abhāvāt sādhya niścayam vinā tad vyāpaka tva niścaya abhāvāt na ca yadi icchā aṣṭa dravya atirikta dravya āśritā na syāt aṣṭān āśritā satī dravya āśritā na syāt rūpavat iti sādhya viparyaya koṭau pratikūla tarka saha kṛtaḥ sādhya saṃśayaḥ eva niścaya kāryam karoti atas eva etādṛśa saṃśaya upasthita kalpitaṅittha ādi sādhanam api apāstam tad viparyaye pratikūla tarka abhāvāt iti vācyam sādhya niścayam vinā sādhya vyatireka niśraya tad mūla tarkān avatārāt anyathā aṣṭa dravya atirikta dravya vṛtti tva nirūpaṇe tarka udayaḥ tarka udaye ca tad saha kṛta sādhya saṃśayasya sādhya vyatireka niścāyaka tvam iti

ucyate icchā āśraya dravya siddhau pṛthivī ādāvi chādhāra tā abhāve tat drayam pṛthivī ādi aṣṭa dravya bhinnam aṣṭa dravya āvṛtti dharmavat tvāt pṛthivī ādi tve bādhaka sattvāt vā iti aṣṭa dravya atirikta dravya siddhau icchāyām aṣṭa dravya atirikta dravyavat tvam aṣṭa dravya atirikta dravya vṛtti tvam vā sādhyate sādhya prasiddhi dravya tve icchā viśeṣya kāṣṭa dravya atirikta dravya āvṛtti tva pratīteḥ vyatireki sādhya tvāt

tathā api icchā aṣṭa dravya atirikta dravya āśritāḥ aṣṭa dravyām āśrita tve sati dravya āśrita tvāt aṣṭa dravya atirikta dravya tva vat iti sādhya prasiddhyā eva dṛṣṭānta prasiddheḥ anvayī hetuḥ syāt iti ced na anvaya vyāptyapratisandhāne vyatireka vyāpti pratisandhāna daśāyām vyatireki sambhavāt na ca dravya tva ādeḥ sa pakṣāt vyāvṛttau asādha araṇyam tat hi sādhya tad abhāva ubhaya sādhaka tvena sat pratipakṣa utthāpaka tayā doṣa āvaham prakṛte ca na hetoḥ sādhya abhāva sādhaka tvam vipakṣe bādhaka abhāvāt sādhya sādhaka tve tat sattvāt ca atas eva yāvat ekatra anukūla tarkaḥ na avatarati tāvat eva daśa aviśeṣe asādhāraṇyam doṣaḥ iti uktam suvarṇa taijasa tva sādhaka vyatirekiṇi śabdaḥ anityaḥ śabda tvāt iti ādau api tathā atha aṣṭa dravya ādhāra tva bādha anantaram icchā ādau guṇa tvāt eva aṣṭa dravya atirikta dravya vṛtti tvam sidhyati pakṣa dharma tā balāt prasiddha viśeṣa bādhe sāmānya jñānasya tad itara viśeṣa viṣaya tva niyamāt atas eva asarva viṣaya aniti a jñāna bādha anantaram kṣiti ādau kāryatvena jñāna janya tvam sidhyat nitya sarva viṣaya tvam jñānasya ādāya eva sidhyati iti ced

na bādhā anantaram aṣṭa dravya atirikta dravya viṣaya api anumitiḥ dravya āśrita tva prakārikā syāt anumiteḥ vyāpaka tāvacchedaka mātra prakāraka tva niyamāt na tu aṣṭa dravya atirikta dravya vṛtti tva prakārikā tasya pūrvam apratīta tvena prakāra tva asambhavāt iti tad prakārikā anumitiḥ vyatirekiṇā eva anādi ananta t vi aṇukādi yāvat pakṣīkaraṇe anādyana tantā vat upādana gocara aparokṣa jñāna tvam eva nitya sarva viṣayaka tvam etad anya nitya sarva viṣaya tvam vyatirekiṇaḥ eva sidhyati pakṣa dharma tā balena api vyāpaka tāvacchedaka prakāreṇa sādhya siddhiḥ bhavati na tu sādhya gata viśeṣa prakārikā atiprasaṅgāt

nanu aṣṭa dravya anāśrita icchā dravya āśritā iti yadi sādhyate tadā aṣṭa dravya atirikta dravya āśrita tvam antareṇa pratijñā arthaḥ eva na upapadyate satyam evam api aṣṭa dravya an āśrita icchāyām dravya āśrita tvam sidhyatu tasya aṣṭa dravya atirekyam kutas sidhyet atha sāmānya avyabhicāram ādāya māna antara upanītam tat tad anya tvam upajīvya aṣṭa dravya ani adravya vṛtti tā eva icchā ādeḥ paricchidyate jñāna antara upasthāpita viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭa jñānasya surabhi candanam ityādau darśanāt iti ced na māna antarāt niyamena anupasthiteḥ ye ca id chā āśraye pṛthivī ādi bhinna tvam na jānanti icchāyāḥ ca pṛthivī ādi anāśrita tvam na jānanti teṣām api anumānāt iti api āhuḥ

atha vyatirekī na anumānam sarvatra prameya tva ādinā sat pratipakṣa grasta tvāt iti ced na vipakṣa bādhakena vyatirekiṇaḥ balavat tvāt anye tu vyatirekiṇya bhāvaḥ eva sādhyaḥ sa ca aprasiddhaḥ eva sidhyati yasya abhāvasya vyāpakaḥ hetu abhāvaḥ gṛhītaḥ tasya abhāvaḥ pakṣe vyāpaka bhāva rūpeṇa hetunā sidhyati vyāpaka abhāvavat tayā jñāte vyāpya abhāva jñāna avaśyam bhāvāt tathā hi pṛthivī itarebhyaḥ bhidyate pṛthivī tvāt iti atra itarasya jala ādeḥ vyāpakaḥ pṛthivī tva abhāvaḥ gṛhītaḥ iti pṛthivī tva abhāva abhāva rūpeṇa pṛthivī tvena pṛthivyām itara anyonya abhāvaḥ aprasiddhaḥ eva sidhyati pratiyegi jñānasya vṛtta tvāt pratyakṣeṇa bhū tale ghaṭa abhāva vat

evam anyatra api avyāpya vṛtti icchāyāḥ sva āśraya tve siddhe sva āśraye yaḥ atyanta abhāvaḥ tad avacchedakam ghaṭa ādi sarvam tad avacchedena icchā anupalbhāt tathā ca icchā ati anta abhāva āśraya tāvacchedaka tva rūpasya na īrātmyasya ghaṭa ādau prāṇa ādi mattva abhāvaḥ vyāpakaḥ gṛhīta iti jīvat śarīre prāṇa ādimattvena icchā ati anta abhāva āśraya tva avacchedaka tvasya abhāvaḥ sa ātmaka tvam sādhyate

evam prāmāṇyasādhyaka vyatirekiṇī api vyadhikara prakāra avacchinna tvasya vyāpakaḥ samartha pravṛtti janaka tva abhāvaḥ apramāyām gṛhītaḥ atas vivāda adhyāsita anubhave samartha pravṛtti jaka tvena vyadhikaraṇa prakāra vat chinna tvasya abhāvaḥ sidhyati vyadhikaraṇa prakāra avacchinna tvam eva pramātvam nanu sādhya aprasiddhau katham sādhya viśiṣṭa jñanam viśeṣaṇa jñāna janyatvā dvi śiṣṭa jñānasya iti ced na pakṣe sādhya anumiti sāmagrī sattvāt pakṣa viśeṣaṇakaḥ sādhya viśeṣyakaḥ eva pratyayaḥ jāyate bhū tale ghaṭaḥ na asti iti abhāva viśeṣyaka pratyaya vat

tathā api sādhya abhāva vyāpaka abhāva abhāva rūpa hetumat tayā pakṣa jñānam vyatirekiṇi gamakataupayikam na ca sādhya prasiddhim vinā etādṛśa pratisandhānam sambhavati na ca vastu gatyāḥ yaḥ sādhya abhāvaḥ tad vyāpaka abhāva pratiyogi mattayā jñānam mṛgyate iti vācyam vyatirekya bhāsā anupapatteḥ iti ced na yaḥ abhāvaḥ yasya bhāvasya vyāpaka tvena gṛhītaḥ tad abhāva abhāvena tasya vyāpyasya abhāvaḥ pakṣe sādhyate iti anugatān ati prasaktasya gamakataupayika tvāt ayam ca vyatireki prakāraḥ sva arthaḥ eva param prati sādhya aprasiddhyā pratijña ādi asambhavāt iti sarvam samañjasam

vyatireki anumāna siddhau arthāpattiḥ na māna antaram tena eva tad artha siddheḥ syāt etat jyotiśśāstrāt tad kathita liṅgāt vā devadattasya śata varṣa jīvi tvam avagatam caramam śata varṣa jīvī gṛhaḥ eva iti niyame pratyakṣeṇa avagate paścāt yogyā anupalabdhā niścitaḥ gṛha abhāvaḥ jīvana niyama grāhaka pramāṇayoḥ bala abalā nirūpaṇāt bahis sattva kalpanam vinā niyama dvaya viṣayakam saṃśayam janayitvā jīvati na vā iti saṃśayam āpādya jīvana saṃśaya apanuttaye jīvana upapādakam bahis sattvam kalpayati iti yathā ukta sāmagrī anantaram bahis asti iti pratīteḥ tatra anvaya vyatirekābhyām saṃśaya dvārāḥ gṛha abhāvaḥ tad utpādita niyama dvaya viṣayaka saṃśayaḥ vā kāraṇam jīvana saṃśayaḥ eva vā karaṇe savyāpāraka tva aniyamāt pramāṇyoḥ virodha jñānam tat āhita saṃśaya dvārā karaṇam iti kaścid tadā jīvitvasya liṅga viśeṣaṇasya sandigdha tvena anumāna asambhavāt arthāpattiḥ māna antaram

nanu saṃśayasya kalpaka tve sthāṇu puruṣa saṃśayāt api tad eka koṭi nirvāha kalpanā pattiḥ na ca pramita saṃśayaḥ kalpana aṅgam jīvanasya tadānīm pramita tve saṃśaya abhāva prasaṅgāt jīvitva niścaye anumānadeva bahissattva niścayāt ca kadācid pramita tve ca prāc pramita puruṣa tvasya antarā tad saṃśaye kalpanā syāt kim ca jīvana saṃśayasya mṛte api dṛṣṭa tvāt na vyabhicāreṇa bahis sattva gamaka tvam iti ced

na yathā ukta sāmagrī prabhava saṃśayasya kalpana aṅga tvāt atas eva mṛta janiṣyamāṇayoḥ gṛha abhāva niścayaḥ na yathā ukta saṃśayam āpādayati iti na bahissattva kalpakaḥ gṛha abhāvaḥ ca yogyā anupalabdhi niścitaḥ na saṃśayaḥ iti atha jīvanam iyam agrāhaka pramāṇayoḥ yadi ca tulya bala tvam avagatam kva tarhi bahis sattva kalpanā viśeṣa darśana virahāt kalpane vā pramita jīvana nirvāhaka bahis sattva vat gṛha niyama nirvāhaka maraṇasya api ucita tvena tad kalpanā api syāt jīvana maraṇayoḥ saṃśaya aviśeṣāt atha tayoḥ ekam balīyaḥ aparama balam tadā ekena aparasya bādhaḥ eva iti na saṃśayaḥ

tasmāt yatra śata varṣa jīvi tvam avadhāritam gṛha abhāvaḥ ca niścitaḥ tatra bahis sattva kalpanam na tu jīvana saṃśaye evam ca devadattaḥ bahis san jīvitve sati gṛha niṣṭha atyanta abhāva pratiyogi tvāt iti vyatirekiṇā bahisattva jñānena arthāpattyā liṅga viśeṣaṇa jīvitva saṃśaye bahis sattva kalpanā ca na asti eva kim ca gṛha abhāva niścayaḥ prāmāṇa dvaya viṣaya saṃśayam janayitvā jīvana saṃśayam āpādya bahissattvam kalpayati iti na yuktam na hi yatas eva yat saṃśayaḥ saḥ eva tat niścayāya prabhavati atiprasaṅgāt mā evam

yathā ukta sāmagrī janita saṃśayavān evam tarkayati yogyā anupalabdhi gṛhītaḥ gṛha abhāvaḥ iti tat niścayaḥ su dṛḍhaḥ iti jīvana niyama grāhakayoḥ ekam bādhyam viruddhayoḥ apramāṇa tvāt tat iha maraṇam kalpayitvā jīvana grāhakam bādhyatām no vā bahis satvam kalpayitvā gṛha niyama grāhakam tatra bahis sattva kalpane gṛha niyama grāhaka mātra bādhā maraṇa kalpane tu śata varṣa jīvī devadattaḥ śata varṣa jīvaḥ gṛhaḥ eva iti niyama dvayasya api bādhā syāt tat āha jīvana bādhe tad niyama bādhasya āvaśyaka tvāt iti

kim ca adya jīvati śvas jīviṣyati ityādi bahutara kṣaṇa lava muhūrta ādi samayoṇa adhiniyatam jīvanam upalabdham iti tad bādhe bahutara vyāpti bādhaḥ devadatta tad avayava gaha sattvi āptiḥ ca alpā tathā abhāva svarūpa maraṇa apekṣayā bahissattvasya bhāvasya laghu tvāt yadi ca gṛhān yonya abhāva āśraya bahis padārtha vṛtti saṃyoga āśraya tvam bahis asattvam iti tad apekṣayā maraṇam eva laghu tathā api maraṇa apekṣayā jīvana mātram laghu iti tat eva kalpayitum arham tatas arthāpatti kalpitam jīvi tvam upajīvya anumānāt api bahis sattva jñānam bhaviṣyati iti etāvat tarka saha kṛtaḥ yathā uktapta āsām agrī prabhavaḥ saṃśayaḥ bahissattvam kalpayati

na ca vācyam tarkāṇām viparyaya aparyanasāyi tve ābhāsa tvam tad paryavasāne ca tat eva anumānam etat tarka sahāyam bahissattvam anumāyayiṣyati iti yatas lāghava gaurava tarkaṇām viparyaya aparyavasāyinām eva pramāṇa sahakāri tvam atas eva pratyakṣa śabdāt avapi saha kārī saḥ na ca tasyām daśāyām eva pramāṇa antaram asti tatas arthāpatti sahakāri tvam tarkasya

nanu sva kāraṇa adhīna svabhāva viśeṣāt tarka anugṛhīta yathā ukta saṃśayasya yadi bahis satva pramāpaka tvam tadā mṛte gṛhasthite vā tādṛśa saṃśayāt yatra bahis sattva kalpanā sā api pramā syāt iti ced na yathā hi pramāpakasya indriyasya doṣeṇa pramāśāk ti tirodhānāt aindriya bhramaḥ tathā yathā ukta saṃśayasya api doṣeṇa pramā śak titirodhānāt agraha kva bhrama saṃbhavāt parokṣa jñānānām janaka jñāna avibhrāma tve yathārtha tva niyamaḥ iti ced satyam pravṛttepi jīvana gṛha abhāva grāhaka pramāṇāyoḥ anyatara ābhāsa tvena ābhāsa tva saṃbhavāt yat vā doṣa abhāva saha kṛtasya yathā ukta saṃśayasya bahissatva pramāpaka tvam iti
