ucyate anayoḥ ekam bādhyam viruddha artha grāhaka tvāt iti sāmānyatas dṛṣṭāt eva tarka saha kṛtāt gṛha niyama grāhaka bādhe liṅga viśeṣeṇa jīvitva niścaye anumānāt bahissattva siddhiḥ tathā hi jīvana pramāṇa bādhe gṛha niyama pramāṇa utthāpita liṅgena maraṇa anumānāt pramāṇa tva abhimatayoḥ dvayoḥ api bādhā syāt gṛha niyama grāhaka māna bādhe ca niṣparipanthi jīvana pramāṇāt liṅga viśeṣaṇa jīvitva niścaye bādhyam iti jāyamāna anumitiḥ paramparā maraṇa jñāpakam viṣayīkaroti na tu bahis sattva paramparā sādhakam jīvana pramāṇam tathā ca sāmānyatas dṛṣṭāt eva gṛha niyama grāhaka bādhe jīvana pramāṇāt liṅga viśeṣaṇa jīvi tva niścaye anumānāt eva bahissattva jñānam iti kim artha āpattyā

nanu bahis sattva jñānam vinā jīvī gṛha eva iti asya brahmaṇā api bādhitum aśakyatvāt prathamam bahis sattva jñānam na tu gṛha niyama grāhaka bādha anantaram tat yena niṣparipanthi jīvana grāhakāt jīvi tva niścaye anumānam syāt na prāthamika bahis sattva jñānam arthāpattim vinā na ca gṛha niyama grāhiṇi tulya bale jāgarūke katham artha āpattyā api bahis sattva jñānam iti vācyam tarka sahakāreṇa arthāpatteḥ balavat tvāt bahis sattva jñānam utpādya gṛha niyama grāhaka māna bādhāt iti ced

na tarka sahakāreṇa sāmānyatas dṛṣṭasya balavat tvena gṛha niyama grāhaka bādha sambhavāt tasmāt yathā ukta saṃśaya daśāyām jīvana bādhe tat niyama bādhasya āvaśyaka tvāt iti tarka anantaram eva bahis sattva jñānam iti avivādam tatra kalpanīya pramāṇa bādhe yathā ukta saṃśaye tarkasya na sahakāri tvam gauravāt kim tu niyama grāhaka bādha dvārā bahis satva paramparā sādhake sāmānyatodṛṣṭe lāghavāt na ca sāmānyatodṛṣṭa avatāraḥ eva atra na asti iti vācyam anirdhirita eka bādha prāptau pratyeka bādha anukūla kalpanāyām vinigamakaḥ tarkaḥ bhavati na ca eka bādha prāptiḥ sāmānyatodṛṣṭam vinā

kim ca virodha jñāna anantaram ekam apramāṇam iti yadi dhīḥ na asti tadā prāmāṇya saṃśayaḥ na syāt na syāt ca jīvana saṃśayaḥ dvayoḥ api jīvana maraṇa niścāyaka tvāt atha ekam anayoḥ apramāṇam iti jñānam janayitvā sāmānyatodṛṣṭasya mā aparya vasita tvāt tat janita niyama dvaya saṃśaya ahita jīvana saṃśaya anantaram tarka avatāre bahis asti iti jñānam jāyamānam saṃśayasya kāraṇa tvam vyavasthāpayati iti ced

na yat eva hi viruddha artha grāhaka tvam tarkam vinākṛtam anirdhāritekā prāmāṇya anumitim ajījanat tat eva tarka saha kṛtam punar anusandhīyamānam gṛha niyama grāhaka pramāṇam iti anumitim bahis sattva jñāna anukūlām janayati sahakāri vaicitryeṇa ekasya api vicitra phala janaka tvāt na ca jīvana saṃśaya anantaram tad anusandhānam asiddham gṛha niyama grāhakasya jīvana grāhaka tva viruddha artha grāhaka tva anusandhānam vinā bahis sattva kalpane api abādha prasaṅgāt

atha yadi paryavasannam api pramāṇam punar anusandhīyamānam sahakāri viśeṣāt phala antara janakam tadā icchā dravya āśritā kāryatvāt iti sāmānyatodṛṣṭa dravya āśrita tva anumitau paścāt aṣṭa dravya vṛtti tva bādhe vyatirekiṇāḥ ātma siddhiḥ iti vijyete aṣṭadṛvya vṛtti tva bādha saha kṛtāt sāmānyatodṛṣṭāt eva punar anusandhīyamānāt tad siddheḥ iti ced

na anumiteḥ vyāpaka tā vacchedaka prakāraka tva niyamena tad prakāraka buddheḥ vyatireki sādhya tvāt vyatirekiṇaḥ api anyatra sāmarthya avadhāraṇena upāya antarasya adoṣāt ca api ca devattaḥ jīvana maraṇa anyatara pratiyogi prāṇi tvāt madvat iti sāmānyatodṛṣṭam lāghava sahakāreṇa jīvana pratīyogi tvam viṣayīkaroti tathā ca liṅga viśeṣaṇā niścayāt anumānāt eva bahissattva siddhiḥ

atha lāghava sācivyāt sāmānyatodṛṣṭasya api viśeṣa viṣaya tvāt niyama grāhaka pramāṇa utthāpita liṅgaka maraṇa anumānena jīvana grāhakasya iva asya api sat pratipakṣa tvam ekena api bhūyasām api pratibandha sambhavāt na ca tarkāt samā anyata udṛṣṭasya balavat tvam vyāpti pakṣa dharmate hi balam tat ca tulyam eva jñātam lāghava ākhya tarkasya viśeṣa mātra paryavasāyaka tvena vyāpti grāhaka tvasya tulya tvāt iti ced

tarhi pakṣa dharma tā balāt viśeṣa siddhiḥ kvāpi na syāt sarvatra sāmānya mukha pravṛtta pramāṇasya viśeṣa paryana sāne anya sādharmyeṇa sat pratipakṣa sambhavāt aprayojaka tvāt na viparīta sādhanam iti tulyam niyama grāhakasya aprayojaka tvāt jīvana grāhakasya tu sāmānyatodṛṣṭasya jyotiśśāstrāt yathārtha tvam eva vipakṣa bādhakam vyāpti grāhakam asti

tasmāt sāmānya mukha pravṛttasya sahakāri viśeṣāt viśeṣa parasya anumānasya tad viśeṣa vilakṣaṇa grāhaka pramāṇena sat pratipakṣa tvam na ca pramāṇa virādhena asya tarkaḥ na sahakārī iti vācyam tarkān avatāre viśeṣa paratva abhāvena avirodhāt tad avatāre tad adhika bala tvāt eva anyathā tarkān avatāre sat pratipakṣasya tad avatāre api tattvam na nivartate

kim ca evam artha āpattau api tad virodhena na saha kārī syāt yat uktam maraṇa kalpane śata varṣa avacchinna jīvī gṛhe eva iti asya api bādhaḥ iti tatra viśiṣṭa bādhaḥ na viśeṣya bādhāt maraṇe api jīvī gṛha eva iti asya viśeṣaṇasya ābādhāt kintu viśeṣaṇa bādhāt sa ca śata varṣiṇī vitva bādhaḥ eva viśeṣaṇa abhāva āyattaḥ viśiṣṭa bhāvaḥ api asti iti ced na viśeṣyavati viśiṣṭābhāvasya kevala viśeṣaṇa abhāva ātmaka tvāt viśiṣṭasya atiriktasya anabhyupagamāt

anye tu śata varṣa jīvī devadattaḥ jīvī gṛhaḥ eva gṛhe na asti iti pramāṇeṣu dvayoḥ avirodhe api tṛtīyam ādāya virodha jñānam asti tatra jīvī gṛhe eva iti apramāṇa ghaṭita pramāṇa dvaya virodha jñāna janita apramāṇi asaṃśaya āhita jīvana saṃśayāt pramāṇayoḥ avirodha upapādaka pramāṇa virodhi bahis satvam kalpyate yathā ukta saṃśayasya ayam eva svābhāvaḥ yat vastu gatyāḥ apramāṇam tat virodhi kalpayati virādha ghaṭakasya vastu gatyā apramāṇa tvam eva vinigamaka tvam iti tad tuccham apramāṇasya api pramāṇa tvena jñānāt tarka ādibhiḥ viśeṣa darśanam vinā yathā ukta saṃśaya anantaram bahis asti iti jñānam asiddham atas na phala balena tathā arthāpatti kalpanam kim ca mṛte gṛhasthite bahis sthite tādṛśa saṃśayāt eva bahissattvam gṛha sattvam maraṇam ca kalpyeta kasyacid kvacid vastu gatyāḥ apramāṇa tvāt arthāpatti ābhāsaḥ ca evam na syāt

syāt etat mā bhūt saṃśayaḥ karaṇam artha āpattau anupapattiḥ tu syāt tathā hi jīvī devadattaḥ gṛhe na asti iti jñāne sati bahissattvam vinā jīvataḥ gṛha asattvam anupapannam iti jñāna anantaram bahis asti iti dhīḥ asti tatra anvaya vyatirekābhyām anupapatti jñānam karaṇam na ca devadattaḥ bahis asti vidyamāna tve sati gṛha asattvāt ghaṭa vat iti anumānāt vidyamāna tve sati yatra yat na asti tad anya deśe tat asti yathā gṛhe eva koṇe asan aham madhye tiṣṭhāmi iti vyāpti prabhāva anumānāt vā bahissattva siddheḥ kim arthāpattyā iti vācyam hetu sādhyayoḥ sahacāra ajñāna daśāyām anupapatti jñāne api bahis sattva jñānāt sāmānyatas vyāptiḥ ca anumāne upasaṃhatum aśakyayā iti tad anya deśa siddhiḥ arthāpattyā eva

nanu jīvinaḥ gṛha sattvam anupapannam kim devadatta bahis asattvam vinā uta bahissattva mātram vinā na ādyaḥ prathamam devadatta bahissattva pratītau tena vinā idam anupapannam iti jñāna abhāvāt pratītau vā kim artha āpattyā arthāpattitaḥ eva tad pratītau anyonya āśrayaḥ tat uktam yatas anya tvam tasiddheḥ agre tad asiddheḥ iti na antyaḥ anyadīya bahissattva jñānam vinā anupapatti abhāvāt bahis sattva mātra siddhau api devadatta bahissatvau āsiddheḥ iti ced

na sāmānyena hi vinā anupapatti jñānam kāraṇam sāmānāni ākāreṇa viśeṣa jñānam phalam tathā hi jīvataḥ bahi sassattvam vinā gṛha asattvam anupapannam iti jñānam yasya gṛha asattvam anupapannam tatra bahisattvam kalpayati na anyatra devadattaḥ ca tathā iti siddhe devadatte bahissattvam kalpyate iti devadatta bahissattvam paryavasyati na tu tena rupeṇa kalpanā na vā tena vinā anupapatti jñānam kāraṇam yathā vahni mātra vyāptāt dhūmāt parvate vahni siddhiḥ na tu parvayatīya tvena eva dhūmāt tad siddhiḥ tena rupeṇa vyāpaka tva āgrāhāt

atha upādaka abhāvavatī upapādya abhāva aniyamaḥ anupapattiḥ na tva bhāva mātram ati prasaṅgāt evam ca vyatireka vyāptimataḥ upapādyāt vyatireki anumāna mudrayā eva sādhya siddheḥ kim artha āpattyā tathā hi devadattaḥ bahis san jīvitve sati gṛha asattvāt yat na evam tat na evam yathā mṛtaḥ gaha sthitaḥ vā na ca anya vyāptyai anyasya gamaka tve ati prasaṅgaḥ sādhya abhāva vyāpaka abhāva pratiyogi tvasya niyāmaka tvāt na ca artha āpattau svarupasatī vyāptiḥ liṅgam na anumānaḥ iti vācyam anupapatteḥ jñānam vinā kalpanā anudayāt artha atti ābhāsān avakāśāt ca

mā evam atra hi vyatireka vyāptiḥ anvayasya pakṣa dharma tvam iti vyāpti dhījanyam api bahis sattva jñānam na anumitiḥ tasyām vyāpti pakṣa dharma tā jñāna janya tā niyamāt na ca sādhya abhāva vyāpaka abhāva pratiyogi tvena pakṣa dharmasya jñānam anumiti prayojakam iha api ati iti vācyam kevala anvayini tad asambhavāt tad apekṣayā sādhya vyāpya tva jñānasya laghu tvāt ca atha vyatireka sahacārāt hetoḥ eva vyāpti dṛś dṛśyate evam ca anvayasya vyatirekasya ubhayasya vā sahacārāt vyāpti graha traividhye anumāna traividhyam atas eva dhūmaḥ daśa aviśeṣe anvayī vyatirekī anya vyatirekī ca iti ced

astu tāvat evam tathā api jīvi devadatta abhāvaḥ gṛhe vartamānaḥ na bahissattve liṅgam devadattā vṛtti tvāt bahis sattva gṛha niṣṭhā bhāvayoḥ vyadhikaraṇa tvena niyata sāmāna adhikaraṇyarupa vyāpti abhāvāt ca upari savitā bhūmeḥ ālokavat tvāt iti atra bhūmeḥ upari saṃnihita savitṛka tvena anumānāt na api gṛha niṣṭha abhāva pratiyogi tvam tad pratiyegi tvasya devadatta dharma tayā tad asaṃnikarṣe pratyakṣeṇa jñātum aśakyatvāt atas eva viśeṣya asaṃnikarṣāt tṛtīya liṅga parāmarśaḥ api na pratyakṣeṇa na ca vyatireka vyāpti gṛha niṣṭhā bhāvayoḥ jñānam sahakārya āsādya manasā eva na janyate iti vācyam sahakāriṇaḥ eva māna antara tva prasaṅgāt

atha vyāpti jñāna anantaram smaryamāṇa dhūmāt katham anumitiḥ ukta nyāyena tatra api liṅga parāmarśa abhāvāt iti ced na kathaṃcid katham tarhi vahni jñānam pakṣa dharma dhūma smṛti sahitāt dhūmaḥ vahnim vinā na asti iti anupapatti jñānāt iti gṛhāṇa atas eva dṛśyamānaḥ dhūmaḥ vahnim vinā anupānnaḥ iti yadā jñāyate tadā arthāpattiḥ eva yadā tu anupapati jñānam vinā vyāpya tvena pratisandhīyate tadā anumānam tvayā api tatra trividha anumāna svīkārāt vyatireka vyāptim upajīvya jīvi devadatta gṛha abhāvaḥ bahis satvam kalpayati

ucyate devadattā saṃnikarṣe api tasya gṛha niṣṭha abhāva pratiyogi tvam pratyakṣeṇa gṛhyate tathā hi gṛhe devadattasya abhāvaḥ iti pratyakṣam devadattam ṣaṣṭhī artham ca abhāva sambandham pratiyogi tva lakṣaṇam gocarayati sambandha jñānasya saṃbandhi dvaya viṣaya tvāt pratiyoginā samam abhāvasya saṃbandha antara abhāvāt gṛha niṣṭha abhāva pratiyogi tve ca pratyakṣa upasthite smṛta vyāpti vaiśiṣṭyam api pratyakṣeṇa su graham na ca devadatta viśeṣyakam bahissattva vyāpya gṛha niṣṭhā bhāva pratiyogi tva jñānam na asti iti vācyam pakṣa vṛtti liṅga parāmarśa mātrasya anumiti janaka tvāt adhikasya gaurava parāhata tvāt

atha vā anita prasakta sahakāri vaśāt manasā eva smṛta devadatta viśeṣyakaḥ tṛtīya liṅga parāmarśaḥ yathā ca na sahakāri māna antaram tathā upapāditam adhastāt nanu mayūraḥ parvata itare na nṛtyati nṛtyati ca iti jñāna anantaram parvate nṛtyati iti jñānam asti na ca vyatirekiṇaḥ tat sambhavati parvata nṛtya aprasiddhau tena vinā anupapatti pratisandhānam api na iti katham arthāpattiḥ api iti vācyam adhikaraṇam vinā anupapadyamānam nṛtyam prasiddha adhikaraṇa bādha saha kṛtam prasiddhā itaram adhikaraṇam kalpayati iti ced

na mayūra nṛtyam sādhikaraṇam nṛtya tvāt iti sāmānyatodṛṣṭam prasiddha adhiraṇa bādha sahakṛtam prasiddhā itaram parvatam adhikaraṇam ādāya nṛtya jñānam janayati yat vā parvata itare na nṛtyati iti śabdena nṛtya abhāva bodha anantaram mayūraḥ nṛtyati iti śabdāt jāyamānam jñānam parvata nṛtyam gocarayati prasiddha viśeṣa bādha saha kṛta sāmānya jñāna janaka pramāṇasya prasiddha itaram parvatam adhikaraṇa viśeṣam ādāya jñāna janaka tva niyamāt atas eva anitya jñāna ābādhanantaram kṣiti ādau jñāna janya tvam siddhyat nitya tvam ādāya siddhi ati iti ācāryāḥ

yat vā mayūra nṛtyam parvata adhikaraṇakam parvata itarān adhikaraṇa tve sati sādhikaraṇa tvāt parvata tva vat iti anvayavī atirekī athavā yaḥ sambhāvita tad tadirāvṛttiḥ san tad atirikta vṛttiḥ na bhavati sa tad vṛttiḥ bhavati iti sāmānyena yat tad artha antarbhāveṇa vyāptyā nṛtyasya parvata vṛtti tvam siddhyati evam pīnaḥ devadattaḥ divā na bhuṅkte iti atra api aprasiddha rātri bhojana sādhya pīna tva jñānam rātri bhojanam ādāya siddhyati

atha yathā abhojī pīnaḥ iti atra ayogya tā jñānam tathā pīnaḥ divā na bhuṅkte iti atra api divā bhojanasya bādhāt yogyatā ghaṭaka rātri bhojanasya pratīteḥ atas yogyatā ghaṭaka upasthitim vinā anvayam alabhamānam idam vākyam yogyatā ghaṭaka rātri bhojana upapādakam rātrau bhuṅaktaḥ iti vākyam kalpayitvā tena saha anvaya bodham janayati na ca evam lāghavāt rātri bhojanam eva kalpayitum yuktam śābdī hi ākāṅakṣā śabdena eva prapūryate iti nyāyena śabda upasthāpitam ādāya śabdasya anvaya bodha janaka tvāt evam ca śrūyamāṇa śabdasya anvaya bodhaka tvam yogyatā ghaṭaka upasthāpakena śabdena vinā anupapadyamānam tam kalpayitvā yatra anvaya bodham janayati tatra śruta arthāpattiḥ

dvāram ityādau pidhā ihi iti śabda kalpanam śruta artha āpattiḥ eva śabdaḥ ca yadi api śrūyamāṇaḥ bādhitaḥ tathā api abhiprāya sthaḥ kalpyate yathā guru mate svarga kāmaḥ yajeta iti atra sākṣāt sādhana tā ābādhe paramparā ghaṭakasya anupasthityā paraṃpara asā dhana tā jñāna virahaḥ yogya tā jñāna abhāvāt prasiddha pada sā māna adhikaraṇyā anupapattiḥ iti yogyatā jñānasya paramparā sādhana tā ghaṭakam apūrvam liṅa ādi vācyam kalpayati tatas svarga sādhanam yāgaḥ iti jñānam jāyate anyathā apūrvam api vācya na syāt iti

ucyate bādhaka pramāṇa abhāvaḥ anvaya virodhi rūpa virahaḥ vā yogyatā atas divā abhojane rātri bhojanā pratītau api bhojana sādhya pīna tvāt divā na bhuṅkte iti śabdāt hīḥ utpadyate na prati iti anupapattiḥ kim tu pratīta anupapattyā rātri bhojanam kalpyate atas eva apūrvam api na vācyam iti vakṣyate tasmāt na arthāpattiḥ anumānāt atiricyata

tat ca anumānam para artham nyāya sādhyam iti nyāyaḥ tad avayavāḥ ca pratijñā hetu udāharaṇa upanaya nigamanāni nirūpyante tatra na samasta rūpa upapanna liṅga pratipādaka vākyam nyāyaḥ atra eva vākye ati vyāpteḥ kiṃtu anumiti caram akāraṇa liṅga parāmarśa prayoja ka śābda jñāna janaka vākyam nyāyaḥ pratijña ādi pañca vākya eraka vākya tayā sva artha viśiṣṭa jñānam janyate tena ca viśiṣṭa vaiśiṣṭyā avagāhimāna antaram utthāpyate tena ca caram aparāmarśaḥ utpādyate iti nyāya janya śābda jñānasya parāmarśa prayojaka tā

anumiti caram akāraṇa liṅga parāmarśa prayoja ka śābda jñāna jana kaśābda jñāna janaka vākya tvam avayava tvam atas eva vahni vyāpya dhūma vān ayam iti vākye tad avayave ca na nyāya tad avayava lakṣaṇa ativyāptiḥ tena parāmarśasya tad avayavena parāmarśa janakasya jananāt yat tu saṃkṣepataḥ parāmarśa prayojaka vākya tvena viśeṣa abhāvāt saḥ api nyāya eva iti tat na kathā āyāmākāṅkṣā krameṇa abhidhānam iti prathamam viśiṣṭa vaiśiṣṭye ākāṅkṣā na asti iti tad abhidhāne nigrahāt iti vakṣyate anyathā cakṣuḥ ādeḥ api parāmarśa janakatayā nyāyatva āpattiḥ ākāṅkṣā virahaḥ tulyaḥ eva

anye tu pañca avayava vākyāt vijātīyam eva śābda jñānam utpadyate iti tat hī janaka vākya tvam nyāya tvam evam pratijñā ādi avayavāt api pratyekam vijātīyam śābda jñānam iti tad tat hījana ka śābda tvam eva tat tat lakṣaṇam iti tat na jñāna viśeṣa janaka tvam tad tat jñāna janaka tvam vā nyāye pratijñā ādau ca anati prasaktam anugata rūpam antareṇa dūrni rūpam iti tad svīkāre tasya eva lakṣaṇa tvāt anyathā jāti saṃkara prasaṅgaḥ

tatra pratijñā na sādhya nirdeśaḥ sādhya pade ati vyāpteḥ kim tu uddeśya anumiti hetu liṅga parāmarśa prayojaka vākya artha jñāna janaka tve sati uddeśya anumiti anyūnāna tirikta viṣaya kaśa abda jñāna janakam vākyam anyūnāna atirikta padam vihāya liṅga aviṣayaka tvam vā jñāna viśeṣaṇam tena udāharaṇa ādi vyudāsaḥ nigamanam ca na parāmarśa hetuḥ abādhita asat pratipakṣa tva jñāna janaka tvāt hetu abhidhāna prayojaka jijñāsā janaka vākya tvam vā liṅga aviṣaya kaliṅgi viṣaya ka jñāna janaka nyāya avayava vākya tvam vā itara avayavānām liṅga viṣaya ka jñāna janaka tvāt

pratijñātvam jātiḥ anyūna anati prasakta tāntrika vyavahārāt iti kecid tat na devadatta prabhava tva ādinā jāti saṃkara prasaṅgāt pratijñā janyam vijātīyam jñānam vyavahārāt iti tad janakam pratijñā iti api na tad janaka tvam janakatva jñānam vā na anugata rūpam antareṇa sambhavati iti uktasya anusaraṇīya tvāt etena śabdaḥ anityaḥ iti liṅgi dhī para vākya janya jñāna vṛtti kṛtaka tvā diti ādi vākya janya jñāna āvṛtti jāti yogi jñāna janaka vākyam pratijñā iti nirastam

nanu pratijñā na sādhana aṅgam vipratipatteḥ pakṣa parigrahe tatra pramāṇa ākāṅkṣāyām hetu abhidhānasya prāthamyāt iti ced na vipratipatti agre samaya bandha anantaram śabda anitya tvam sādhaya iti madhyasthasya vādinaḥ vā ākāṅkṣāyām śabda anitya tvam sādhyam na ca sādhya nirdeśam vinā hetu vākyam niṣpratiyogikam anvayam bodhayitum īṣṭe na ca vādi vākye anupasthitam api yogyatayā anveti atiprasaṅgāt na ca vipratipattitaḥ sādhya upasthitiḥ tasyāḥ prativādi vipratipattyā pramāṇa ādi vyavasthayā ca antarita tvāt para vipratipattim samaya bandham ca vinā sthāpanāyāḥ abhāvāt vipratipatti vākyasya pakṣa parigraheṇa paryavasita tayā nirākāṅkṣa tvāt ca āvṛttau tu sā eva pratijñā na ca avayava antarāt hetu anvaya yogyā sādhya upasthitiḥ na api avayava antareṇa ākṣepāt sādhya anvaye tad abhidhānam tad abhidhāne ca sādhya anvayaḥ iti anyonya āśrayāt tasmāt prati iti anupapattyā pratīta anupapattyā vā na iha ākṣepaḥ

anye tu śabda anitya tve pramāṇam vada iti yadi madhyasthasya anuyogaḥ tathā api pramāṇa mātre na ākāṅkṣā kiṃtu viśiṣṭe viśiṣṭam tu viśeṣaṇam sādhyam anabhidhāya na śakya abhidhānam na ca vastutas yat sādhyam tatra pramāṇam vada iti madhyastha niyogaḥ vādi dvaya madhye tad asambhavāt tasmāt sādhya abhidhānam vinā na hetoḥ ākāṅakṣāḥ na vā anvaya bodhaka tvam iti pratijñā sādhana aṅgam iti

sādhya nirdeśa anantaram kutas iti ākāṅkṣāyām sādhana tā vyañjaka vibhaktimat liṅga vacanam eva ucitam anyathā anākāṅkṣita abhidhāne nigraha āpatteḥ loke tathā eva ākāṅkṣā nivṛttiḥ iti vyutpatteḥ iti pratijñā anantaram hetu upanyāsaḥ hetu tvam ca anumitikāraṇī bhūta liṅga parāmarśa prayoja ka śābda jñāna janaka sādhya aviṣaya kaśābda dhī janaka hetu vibhaktimat śabda tvam hetu tva pratipādaka vibhaktimat nyāya avayava tvam vā udāharaṇa prayojaka ākāṅkṣā jana kaśābda jñāna janaka nyāyau ayava tvam vā sādhya aviṣayaka jñāna janaka hetu pañcamī anta anumiti para śabda tvam vā pratijñā vākya dhī janya kāraṇā kāṅkṣā nivartaka jñāna janaka hetu vibhaktimat vākya tvam vā pañcamī anta lākṣaṇika pada vat anumiti para vākya tvam vā hetu padena jñāna lakṣaṇāt anyathā liṅgasya ahetutvena hetu vibhakti arthān anvayāt tathā eva ākāṅkṣā nivṛtteḥ anumiti hetu jñāna kāraṇa dhūmavat tva aditi śabda janya jñāna vṛtti pratijña ādi janya jñāna āvṛtti jāti yogi jñāna janaka vākya tvam hetu tvam iti anye jātim vinā kena rūpeṇa jñānasya anumiti janaka tvam vākya viśeṣa janya tvasya api janya tā avat chedaka rūpa aparicaye durgrahāt iti apare

anvaya vyāpti abhidhāyaka avayava abhidhāna prayojaka jñāna janaka hetu tva pratipādaka vibhaktimat nyāya avayava tvam anvayihetu tvam etat eva vyatireka vyāpti abhidhāyaka pada prakṣepāt vyatireki hetu tvam anvaya vyatireka udāharaṇa ākāṅkṣā prayojaka tathā bhūta avayava tvam anvaya vyatireki hetu tvam yat vā pakṣa sa pakṣa sataḥ vipakṣa asataḥ hetu vacanam anvaya vyatireki atyanta abhāva apratiyogi sādhya samāna adhikaraṇa pakṣa sa pakṣa sat hetu vacanam kevala anvayi

yat vā a n u m i t i k ā r a ṇ ī b h ū t a p a r ā marśa prayoja kaśābda jñāna kāraṇa sādhya aviṣaya ka śābda dhī janaka pratīta anvaya sādhya sādhana vācaka hetu vibhaktimat śabda tvam anvayihetu tvam etat eva apratita anvaya sādhya sādhana iti viśeṣaṇāt vyatireki hetu lakṣaṇam kathāyām dhūmāt iti eva prayoktavyam na tu dhūmavat tvāt iti matupaḥ vyartha tvāt

sāmānyavat tve sati bāhya karaṇa pratyakṣa tva āditi a pārthakam vibhakti upasthāpita hetu tvena sāmānyavat tvasya vibhakti antara avaruddhasyānanvayāt iti kecid tat na sati saptam ībalāt sāmānyavat tvasya bāhya karaṇa pratyakṣa tvasya ca sāmānādhikaraṇya upasthitau viśiṣṭe hetutva anvayāt tathā eva vyutpatteḥ na hi ayam arthaḥ asmān na avagamyate iti

hetau ukte katham asya gamaka tvam iti ākāṅkṣāyām vyāpti pakṣa dharma tayoḥ pradarśana prāptau vyāpteḥ prāthamyāt tad pradarśanāya udāharaṇam tatra anumiti hetu liṅga parāmarśa para vākya janya jñāna janaka vyāpya tva abhimata vat niṣṭha niyata vyāpaka tva abhimata sambandha bodha janaka śabda tvam udāharaṇa tvam sāmānya lakṣaṇe sādhya sādhana sambandha bodhaka tvam sādhya sādhana abhāva sambandha bodhaka tvam ca viśeṣa lakṣaṇa dvayam

nyāya avayava dṛṣṭānta vacanam udāharaṇam iti tu na dṛṣṭānta prayogasya sāmayika tvena asārvatrika tvāt yaḥ yaḥ dhūmavān saḥ agrimān iti eva vyāpti pratīteḥ na api prakṛta anumiti hetu liṅga parāmarśa para vākya janya jñāna viṣaya vyāpti upanāyakam vacanam tat upanayā ati vyāpteḥ atas upanaya abhidhāna prayojaka jijñāsā janaka vākyam udāharaṇam etat eva anvaya vyatireka vyāpti viṣaya tva viśeṣitam viśeṣa lakṣaṇa dvayam iti anye

atra ca vyabhicāra vāraṇāya vīpsām āhuḥ yatra ca sāmānādhikaraṇyāt eva vyāptiḥ tatra na vīpsā kevalān vayinī a bheda anumāne ca vīpsāyām api vyabhicāra tādavasthyam iti tu vayam vīpsā ca yat pade na tat pade api virūpa upasthitayoḥ api tad padena parāmarśāt buddhi stha vācaka tvāt iti na vyutpatti virodhaḥ yathā yat yat pāpam pratijahi iti atra idam ca s ā d h y asādhana ubhaya āśraya vikalān upadarśita anvaya viparīta upadarśita anvayān upadarśita vyatireka viparīta upadarśita vyatireka bhedāt ābhāsa rūpam iti

udāharaṇa anantaram bhavatu vyāptiḥ tathā api vyāptam kim pakṣe vartate na vā iti ākāṅkṣāyām vyāptasya pakṣa dharma tva pradarśanāya upanayaḥ tatra anumiti kāraṇa tṛtīya liṅga parāmarśa janaka avayava tvam upanaya tvam iti sāmānya lakṣaṇam sādhya vyāpya viśiṣṭa pakṣa bodhaka avayava tvam sādhya abhāva vyāpaka abhāva pratiyogimat pakṣa bodhaka avayava tvam ca viśeṣa lakṣaṇa dvayam

udāharaṇa antaḥ eva prayogaḥ iti na vācyam tṛtīya liṅga parāmarśasya vyāpti pakṣa dharma tā avagāhinaḥ avayava antarāt alābhāt tad anabhyupagame api pakṣa dharma tāyāḥ alābhāt na ca hetu vacanāt eva tad avagamaḥ tasya kaḥ hetuḥ iti ākāṅkṣāyām eva pravṛtta tvena hetu svarūpa upasthāpakasya atatparatvāt vādi vākyāt eva ākṣepaḥ iti ced na tad arthasya asiddha tvena anākṣepaka tvāt anyathā pratijñā mātrāt eva sarva ākṣepe avayava antara vilayāt pratipādyānām svatas eva tad avagamaḥ iti ced na teṣām vyutpanna avyutpanna tayā sarvatra tad asambhavāt pratipādakena sva vyāpārasya nirvāhayitum ucita tvāt ca anyathā avayava antare api evam prasaṅgāt

upanaya anantaram nigamanam tat ca anumiti hetu liṅga parāmarśa prayoja ka śābda jñāna kāraṇa vyāpti pakṣa ta adhī prayukta sādhyadhī janakam vākyam na ca vyāpti pakṣa dharma tayoḥ caturbhiḥ eva avayavaiḥ paryāpteḥ kim tena iti vācyam abādhita asat pratipakṣa tvayoḥ alābhe caturṇām api aparyavasānāt atha abhidhāna bhidheyayoḥ vyāpti pakṣa dharma tāvat liṅga pratipādanāt eva paryavasānena avayava antarāṇām nirākāṅkṣa tvam viparīta śaṅkā nivṛtteḥ api tatas eva lābhāt anyathā nigamanena api tad avāraṇāt na hi tad viśeṣa darśam anādṛtya eva tat nivartakam siddha nirdeśa tayā vārayati iti ced na sva rūpa mātra abhidhānāt sādhya tva anupasthitau tasmāt iti hetu vibhakti ananvaya prasaṅgāt ca iti ced na vyāpti pakṣa dharma tā jñāne api bādhasat pratipakṣa buddheḥ sādhya jñāna anutpatti darśanāt tad abhāva abodhane samīhita anirvāhāt

vyāpteḥ atha bādha ādi virahasya prayojaka tvam na tu tad vodhasya māna abhāvāt asiddheḥ ca iti kim artham bādha ādi virahaḥ bodhanīyaḥ iti ced na yat avagame sati yat na bhavati tad tad abhāva jñāna sādhyam iti na ca ananvayaḥ tasmāt iti anvaya balāt eva hetu anākāṅikṣa tatva lakṣaṇa siddha tva jñānāt na tu anvayāt pūrvam iha kecid yathā tasmāt iti sarva nāmnā hetoḥ parāmarśaḥ pūrva ukta śeṣa rūpa lābhāya tathā sādhya aṃśasya api tathā iti sarva nāmnā siddha sthalaḥ iva virodhi vāraṇāya yuktaḥ iti āhuḥ

tat na tathā iti svarūpe prakāre sādṛśye vā ādye tathā ca ayam iti prakrāntāt tathā iti hetumān iti arthaḥ syāt tathā ca ananvayaḥ na hi hetumat tvāt eva hetumān iti anvitam na dvitīyaḥ sāmānyena pakṣasya api anvaya vyāptau praveśāt tad prakāra anvayaḥ tatra eva iti ananvayāt atas eva na tṛtīyaḥ api abheda anumāne ca anvayini tasmāt tathā iti sādṛśya abhāvāt bahūnām ca prakrame viśeṣyān anvayāt vādi vākye ca yogyatā anvaye ati prasaṅgāt

tasmāt iti atra vibhakti arthān anvayāt eva niyamaḥ tasmāt anityaḥ iti abhidhāne viśiṣya siddha tā avagabhyate pūrvam sādhyatayā uktasya samartha hetu saṃbandhena punar utkīrtanāt anyathā tad vaiyarthyāt saṃśaya prayojana ādayaḥ tu avayava lakṣaṇa abhāvāt eva na avayavāḥ kim tu nyāya aṅga tayā upayujyante iti na ādhikyam kaṇṭaka uddhārasya ca na sārvatrika tvam samaya viśeṣa upayogi tvāt iti

atha hetvābhāsāḥ tattva nirṇaya vijaya prayojaka tvāt nirūpyante tatra anumiti kāraṇībhūta abhāva pratiyegi yatha artha jñāna viṣaya tvam yat viṣayaka tvena liṅga jñānasya anumiti pratibandhaka tvam jñāyamānam sat anumiti pratibandhakam yat tattvam vā hetvābhāsa tvam daśā viśeṣe hetvoḥ eva asā dhāraṇa sat pratipakṣayoḥ ābhāsa tvāt tad buddheḥ api anumiti pratibandhaka tvam

yadi api bādhasat pratipakṣayoḥ pratyakṣa śābda jñāna pratibandhaka tvāt na liṅga ābhāsa tvam tathā api jñāyamānasya ābhāsasya atra lakṣaṇam yat vā pratyakṣa ādau bādhena na jñānam pratibadhyate kintu utpanna jñāne aprāmāṇyam jñāyate anumitau tu utpattiḥ eva pratibadhyate te ca savyabhicāra viruddha sat pratipakṣā siddha bādhitāḥ pañca

savyabhicāraḥ api trividhaḥ sādhāraṇā sādhāraṇa anupasaṃhāri bhedāt tatra savyabhicāraḥ sādhya tad abhāva prasañjakaḥ iti na tritayasādhāraṇam lakṣaṇam ekasya ubhayam pratyasādhaka tvāt anāpādaka tvāt ca na api ubhaya pakṣa vṛtti tvam ubhaya vyāvṛtta tvam vā tattvam ananugamāt atha sādhya saṃśaya janaka koṭi dvaya upasthāpaka pakṣa dharma tā jñāna viṣaya tve sati hetu abhimataḥ saḥ vipratipattiḥ tu pratyekam na tathā na vā pakṣa vṛttiḥ sādhāraṇam anvayena asādhāraṇam vyatirekeṇa anupasaṃhārī pakṣaḥ eva ubhaya sāhacaryeṇa koṭi dvaya upasthāpakaḥ

kevala anvayi sādhyakān upasaṃhārī ayam ghaṭaḥ etat tva āditya sādhāraṇaḥ ca sat hetuḥ eva tat ajñānam doṣaḥ puruṣasya atas eva asādhāraṇa prakaraṇa samayoḥ anitya doṣa tvam anyathā sat hetau bādha ādi jñāne hetvābhāsa ādhikya āpattiḥ na ca prameya tvena abheda anumāne śabdaḥ anityaḥ śabda ākāśa anyatara tvāt iti atra ca sādhāraṇe avyāptiḥ tayoḥ sādhya vada vṛtti tvena viruddha tvāt iti ced na etat ajñāne api sādhāraṇi ādi pratyekasya jñānāt udbhāvanāt ca sva para anumiti pratibandhāt udbhāvita etat nirvāha artham sādhāraṇa ādeḥ avaśyā udbhāvya tvena tasya eva doṣa tvāt ca

etena pakṣa vṛtti tve satya numiti virodhi saṃbandha avyāvṛttiḥ anaikāntikaḥ sa pakṣa vipakṣa vṛtti tvam ubhaya vyāvṛtta tvam anupasaṃhāri tvañcā anumiti virodhi tad sambandhaḥ pratyekam asti viruddhaḥ api anena rūpeṇa savyabhicāraḥ eva upādheḥ ca na saṅkaraḥ iti vakṣyate iti nirastam etat ajñāne jñānepivā āvaśyaka pratyeka jñānasya doṣa tvāt asādhaka tā anumitau vyartha viśeṣaṇa tvāt ca

atas eva sādhya avyāpya tve sati sādhya abhāva avyāpya hetvābhāsa tvam sādhya vat mātra vṛtti anyatve sati sādhya abhāvavat mātra vṛtti anya tvam vā iti parāḥ tam vyartha viśeṣaṇa tvāt prathamam hetvābhāsa tva ajñānāt ca gaganam anityam śabda āśraya tvāt ityādi bādha viruddha saṅkīrṇa asādhāraṇa avyāptiḥ iti kaścid na api sa pakṣa vipakṣa gata sarva sapakṣa vipakṣa vyāvṛtta anyatara tvam vyartha viśeṣaṇa tvāt anupasaṃhārya vyāpteḥ ca kiñca pakṣa atirikta sādhyavataḥ sa pakṣa tve prameya tvena abheda sādhane anupasaṃhārye avyāptiḥ pakṣa atirikta sādhyavataḥ aprasiddheḥ sādhyavataḥ sa pakṣa tve vivakṣite aprasiddhiḥ vṛttimataḥ dharmasya sādhya vat vipakṣa anyatara vṛtti tva niyamāt

na api pakṣa atirikta sādhya vat mātra vṛtti anyatve sati pakṣa atirikta sādhya abhāvavat mātra vṛtti bhinna tvam anupasaṃhārya vyāpteḥ dhūmāt au ati vyāpteḥ ca tasya pakṣe sādhyavati vṛtteḥ na api pakṣa vṛtti tve viruddha anya tve ca satya numiti aupayika sambandha śūnya tvam vyartha viśeṣaṇa tvāt etena anugatam sarvam eva lakṣaṇam pratyuktam pratyekam eva dūṣaṇa tvāt udbhāvane vādi nivṛtteḥ ca

ucyate ubhaya koṭī upasthāpaka tāvacchedaka rūpavat tvam tattvam tat ca sādhāraṇa tva ādi viruddha anya pakṣa vṛtti t tve sati a numiti virodhi sambandha avyāvṛttiḥ vā tena eva rūpeṇa jñātasya pratibandhaka tvāt parasya tathā eva udbhāvanāt ca lakṣaṇa anurodhena pratyekam eva hetvābhāsa tvam yat vā sādhya vat mātra vṛtti anyatve sati sādhya abhāvavat mātra vṛtti anya tvam tena asādhāraṇasya sādhya tad abhāva upasthāpaka tayā dūṣaka tva pakṣe na avyāptiḥ na ca evam ādhikye vibhāga vyāghātaḥ sva rūpa satānugata rūpeṇa trayāṇām ekīkṛtya mahā ṛṣiṇā vibhāga karaṇāt na ca evam sādhya abhāva jñāpaka tvena bādha prakaraṇa samayoḥ tad ajñāpakatayā anyeṣām upasaṃgrahaḥ kutas na kṛtaḥ iti vācyam svatantra icchasya niyoga paryanuyogān arha tvāt

tatra sādhāraṇa tvam na sādhya abhāva vat gāmi tvam sarvam anityam meya tvāt iti anupasaṃhārye bhūḥ nityāḥ gandhavat tva āditya sādhāraṇe saṃyoga ādi sādhyaka dravya tve ca ati vyāpteḥ atas eva na sādhya vat tad anya vṛtti tvam na api niścita sādhya vat tad anya vṛtti tvam sādhya vadanya vṛtti tvasya dūṣaka tvena śeṣa vaiyarthyāt

atas eva amukena ayam anaikāntikaḥ iti eva udbhāvyate tatas eva vādi nivṛtteḥ ca na tu sa pakṣa gata tvam api anupasaṃhāryaḥ vyāvartyaḥ anyathā tasya etat viśeṣa tva āpattiḥ iti ced tyaja tarhi tam adhikam klapte antarbhāvāt na api sa pakṣa vipakṣa gata tvam vyartha viśeṣaṇa tvāt viruddhaḥ vyāvartya iti ced na vipakṣa gāmi tvasya eva dūṣaka tve tasya api etat antar bhāvāt

atha pakṣāni asādhya vat tad anya vṛtti tvam sādhāraṇa tvam tena sarvam anityam meya tvāt iti anupasaṃhārye na ati prasaṅgaḥ na ca vyartha viśeṣaṇa tā ghaṭaḥ anityaḥ ghaṭa ākāśa ubhaya vṛtti dvitva āśraya tvāt iti anupasaṃhāryasya viruddhasya anaikāntika bhinnasya vyavacchedya tvāt iti ced na dūṣaka tā prayojaka rūpa bhedam antareṇa bhedasya eva anupapatteḥ sādhya vat vṛtti tve sati sarva sādhya vat anya vṛtti tvam iti api na vyartha viśeṣaṇa tvāt eka vyaktika sādhye tad abhāvāt ca etena hetvābhāsa antara vyavacchedakam viśeṣaṇam vyartham iti

ucyate vipakṣa vṛtti tvam sādhāraṇa tvam tanmātrasya dūṣaka tvāt viruddhasya api tattva jñāne vipakṣa vṛtti tā jñāna daśāyām sādhāraṇa tvam anyathā tasya hetvābhāsa antara tā āpatteḥ upādheḥ asaṅkaraḥ eva sarvam anityam meya tvāt iti anupasaṃhārī śabdaḥ nityaḥ śabda tvāt bhūḥ nityāḥ gandhavat tva āditya sādhāraṇaḥ ca vastu gatyā sādhya abhāvavat vṛtti tvena sādhāraṇaḥ api pakṣatādaśāyām udbhāvayitum na śakyate iti ubhayoḥ bhedena upanyāsaḥ

sarva sapakṣa vipakṣa vyāvṛttaḥ asādhāraṇaḥ nanu sa pakṣa tvam na sādhya vat mātrat tvam vipakṣa āvṛtteḥ vṛttimataḥ sādhya vat vṛtti tva niyamāt na api pakṣa atirikta sādhyavat tvam śabdaḥ anityaḥ śabda tvāt ityādeḥ vyāptidhīdaśāyām api asādhāraṇa tā āpatteḥ na ceṣṭāpattiḥ bādha pratirodhau vinā vyāpti pakṣa dharma tayā jñātāt anumiti niyamāt iti ced na sarva niścita sādhya vat vipa kṣa vyāvṛtta tvasya tattvāt

śabdatva anitya tva vyāpti grahe sati śabde sādhya niścayāt na ati vyāptiḥ na ca ghaṭaḥ ayam etat tvāt iti sat hetau ati vyāptiḥ sādhya sandeha daśāyām tasya hetvābhāsa tvāt yadi api bhūḥ nityāḥ gandhavat tvāt ityādiḥ vastutas sādhāraṇaḥ śabdaḥ nityaḥ śabda tvāt iti viruddhaḥ śabdaḥ anityaḥ śabda tvāt ityādiḥ sat hetuḥ eva vyāpti ajñānasya puruṣa doṣa tvāt iti udāharaṇa abhāvāt asādhāraṇaḥ na pṛthak tathā api pakṣatā daśāyām sādhya tad abhāva aniścayena tasya doṣa tvam anyathā pakṣatva bhaṅga prasaṅgāt

atha sarva sapakṣa vyāvṛttiḥ eva doṣaḥ na vipakṣa vyāvṛttiḥ api tasyāḥ anuguṇa tvāt pratyuta vipakṣa vyāvṛt tattvena vyatirekitayā para sādhya sādhakam eva upanyastam syāt na ca saṃśāyaka tayā doṣa tvam tat ca ubhaya vyāvṛtta tva jñānāt iti vācyam vyāpti grāhakam sahacāra jñānam tad abhāva dvāra eva sa pakṣa vyāvṛtti mātrasya doṣa tvāt

kiñca śabdaḥ anityaḥ śabda tvāt iti uktvā nivṛtte tāvat na idam udbhāvyam nyūna tvena eva vādi nigrahāt tad udbhāvane vādi nivṛtteḥ ca na ca nyūna tve tat upajīvyam asādha araṇya vyatirekeṇa api tad udbhāvanāt na ca vyatireki prayoge tad upanyāsaḥ vyāpti pakṣa dharmatayoḥ apratikṣepe akiñcitkara tvāt sva artha anumāne ca sarva sapakṣa vyāvṛttiḥ eva doṣaḥ iti uktam iti

ucyate śabda tvam sādhyavataḥ tad abhāvavataḥ ca nivṛtta tvena jñātam arthāt vyatirekitayā vā pakṣe sādhyam tad abhāvan ca sādhayet aviśeṣāt anyathā pakṣa vṛtti tva anupapattiḥ iti sādhya tad abhāva utthāpakatayā sva artha anumāne asādhāraṇaḥ doṣaḥ sat pratipakṣe dvau hetū tathā atra tu ekaḥ eva iti tayoḥ bhedaḥ asādhāraṇena vyatireki prayoge parasya sarva sapakṣa vyāvṛtta tva mātram udbhāvyam sādhya abhāva utthāpaka tvāt na tu vipakṣa vyāvṛtta tvam api pratikūla tvāt vyartha tvāt ca

yat vā vipakṣa vyāvṛtta tayā sādhyam iva sa pakṣa vyāvṛtta tayā sādhya abhāvam api sādhayet iti dṛṣṭānta tayā pratibanditayā vā tad udbhāvanam api lakṣaṇantu sarva sapakṣa vyāvṛtta tvam na tu vipakṣa vyāvṛtta tvam api vyartha viśeṣaṇa tvāt viruddham api anena upādhinā asādhāraṇam eva anyathā etat avagame viruddha tva ajñāne hetvābhāsa antara tā āpatteḥ

anupasaṃhāraḥ na asat sa pakṣa vipakṣaḥ siddhi asiddhi virodhāt na api kevala anvayi dharma avacchinna pakṣakaḥ kevala anvayi sādhyakasya sat hetu tvāt vyatireki sādhyakasya tu sādhya tad abhāva vat gāmi tvena sādhāraṇa tvāt anyathā saṃśaya ahetu tvena anaikāntika tā na syāt sarvam kṣaṇikam sattvāt iti sādhya aprasiddhyā vyāpya tva asiddham apārthakam vā sādhya prasiddhau tu sādhāraṇam eva na ca pakṣāni asādhya vat tad anya vṛtti tvam pakṣa atirikta sādhya abhāva vat vṛtti tvam vā sādhāraṇa tvam vyartha viśeṣaṇa tvāt na ca viruddham viśeṣaṇasya vyāvartyam iti uktam

na api atyanta abhāva pratiyogi sādhyaka tve sati kevala anvayi dharma avacchinna pakṣaka tvam sarvam abhidheyam meya tvāt iti atra vipratipattyā pakṣa tādaśāyām pakṣe sādhya aniścayena anupasaṃhāriṇī avyāpaka tvāt atha pakṣa atirikte vyāpti graha anukūlā pratīta sahacāraḥ anupasaṃhāryaḥ yadi ca pakṣe vyāpti grahaḥ kathañcid tadā śabda upadarśita vyāptika anumāna vat abheda anumāna vat ca sat hetuḥ eva iti ced na tatra eva sat hetau ati vyāpteḥ sarvasya pakṣa tve pakṣa atirikta aprasiddheḥ asādhāraṇa viruddhayoḥ ati vyāpteḥ ca dūṣaka tāyām vyartha viśeṣaṇa tvāt ca na ca dūṣaka tānaikāntika tvena na pratyekam iti vācyam artha gatyā vyartha viśeṣaṇa tvāt na api vipratipatti viṣaya mātra vṛtti tvam kevala anvayi sādhyake avyāpteḥ sarvasya pakṣa tve mātrā artha abhāvāt iti

ucyate vyāpti graha anukūla eka dharmī upasaṃhāra abhāvaḥ yatra sa hetu abhimataḥ anupasaṃhārī sa ca anvayena vyatirekeṇa vā sarvasya pakṣa tve dṛṣṭānta abhāvāt ghaṭaḥ anityaḥ ghaṭa ākāśa ubhaya vṛtti dvitva āśraya tvāt ityādau sādhya sādhana sāhacarya ajñānāt tasya viruddha tva ajñāna daśāyām anupasaṃhāri tvasya iṣṭa tvāt kevala anvayi dharma avacchinna pakṣakaḥ vā sarvam abhidheyam prameya tvāt iti sat hetau na kevala anvayī pakṣa tāvacchedakaḥ niścita sādhya vat vṛtti tvāt vipratipattyā sādhya aniścaya daśāyām pakṣa tve tad anupasaṃhārī eva vyatireki sādhyake sādhya abhāvavat vṛtti tva ajñāna daśāyām idam dūṣaṇam tad avagame api sādhāraṇa saṅkaraḥ eva evam vyāpya tva asiddheḥ jñāne tad udbhāvane ca ayam vyabhicāra vat upajīvya tvāt adoṣaḥ ghaṭa ākāśa ubhaya vṛtti dvitva āśraya tvañca viruddham eva etena anupasaṃhāri tva pratisandhāne yadi vyāpti grahaḥ tadā anumitiḥ eva tad abhāve vyāpya tva asiddhiḥ eva iti nirastam upajīvya tvāt iti

viruddhaḥ na sādhya abhāva vyāpyaḥ saṃyoga ādi sādhyake sat hetau ati vyāpteḥ na api sādhya vat niṣṭhā ati anta abhāva pratiyogi vyāpya tvam tattvam idam dravyam guṇavat tvāt ityādau saṃyoga ādi vyāpye ati vyāpteḥ kintu sādhya asamāna adhikaraṇa sādhya abhāva vyāpyaḥ sādhya vat anyonya abhāva vyāpyaḥ vā sādhya abhāva tvam sādhya virodhi tva mātram bhāva abhāva sādhāraṇam tena abhāve sādhye abhāva abhāvasya bhāva tve api na avyāptiḥ abhāva abhāvaḥ abhāva pratiyogi nirūpya tvena bhāva bhinnaḥ eva vā na ca bhāva tvena eva upapattau kim adhikena iti vācyam bādhakam vinā abhāva pratīteḥ pramātvāt anyathā atyanta abhāva anyonya abhāvayoḥ aprasiddhiḥ

atha sādhya hetvoḥ virodhe pakṣe sādhya sattve hetu asiddhiḥ hetu sattve sādhya abhāva siddhau bādhaḥ na ca pramāṇa antareṇa sādhya abhāva siddhau bādhaḥ na hetu tvena eva iti vācyam viśeṣaṇa vaiyarthyāt iti ced na hetoḥ pakṣe sādhya abhāva bādha anupasthāpane api prathama upasthita virodhasya eva upajīvya tvena doṣa tvāt

nanu sādhya abhāva sambandhaḥ vyabhicāraḥ eva doṣaḥ na tu tat niyata tvam api gauravāt asādhaka tve vyartha tvāt ca na ca sādhya asahacaritasya sādhya abhāva sahacaritasya vā gamaka tva bhrama rūpāyām aśaktau viśeṣaḥ asti yena aśakti viśeṣa unnāyaka tayā na vyartha viśeṣaṇa tā na ca anaikāntika sāmānya lakṣaṇe vipakṣa vṛtti tvam na viśeṣaṇam asādhāraṇa ādi avyāpteḥ sādhāraṇantu sa pakṣa vṛtti tva sahitam iti vācyam vipakṣa gāmi tvasya eva sādhāraṇa tvāt adhikasya vyartha tvāt na ca viruddham vyāvartyam vipakṣa gāmi tvena atra eva tad antar bhāvāt

atha anaikāntike vipakṣa sambandhaḥ na dūṣaka tā bījam asādhāraṇa ādi avyāpteḥ na ca tatra anyat eva bījam hetvābhāsa ādhikya āpatteḥ iti ced astu tāvat evam tathā api sādhāraṇe viruddha praveśaḥ vajra lepaḥ eva anye tu viruddha lakṣaṇe na vyartha tvam sādhāraṇasya vyavacchedya tvāt na api asādhaka tā anumitau etasya api vyāpya tvāt nīladhūma ādau ca vyāptiḥ asti eva iti na sva artha anumāne doṣaḥ parasya tu vyartha tvam adhikam na ca viruddha tvāt iti atra śabda ādhikyam iti

tat na arthaḥ hi liṅgam na ca vyabhicārauvāraka viśeṣaṇa avacchedena api vyāptiḥ gauravāt iti vakṣyate na ca artha gatyā vyartha tve api viruddha tvāt iti atra udbhāvanā śakyatvam āvaśyaka tad vivecane tad udbhāvanasya śakya tvāt iti hetu dvaya upanyāse ca adhikam prathamena dvitīyasya kṛta kartavya tayā duṣṭa bīja tvāt na ca nīladhūmāt ityādau viśiṣṭa kartavyam anyena kena api kṛtam dhūmavat tvāt iti anena eva kṛtam iti ced na tathā anupanyāsāt anyathā nīlān anvaya āpatteḥ

apare tu sādhya anavagata sahacāraḥ sādhya abhāva sahacārī viruddhaḥ anyathā pṛthivyām meya tvena itara bheda anumānam na viruddham syāt sādhya abhāva avyāpya tvāt na ca tad sādhāraṇam sa pakṣā sattvāt na ca sādhya sahacāra ajñāna daśāyām sādhāraṇā ativyāptiḥ tadā tasya api viruddha tvāt iti prāhuḥ tat na vipakṣa gāmi tva mātram dūṣaka tā prayojakam iti ukta tvāt atas eva vyabhicaritaḥ vyatirekī anaikāntikaḥ eva na api sādhya abhāva sādhaka tvam tad pramāpaka tvam vā sādhya abhāva sambandha buddhim vinā tad ajñānāt na api sādhya vat anyatva vyāpya tvam vyāpya tva vivecane vyartha viśeṣaṇa tvāt na api sva vyāpaka abhāva pratiyogi sādhyaka tvam sādhya abhāvasya hetu vyāpaka tva pratītau hetu sādhya abhāva sambandha bhānasya āvaśyaka tvāt

ucyate sādhya vyāpaka abhāva pratiyogi tvam viruddha tvam na ca pratiyoginoḥ ananvaye bhāsā mānaḥ eva tad abhāvayoḥ vyāpti grahaḥ bhinna grāhaka sāmagrīka tvāt anyathā vyatireki vilaya āpatteḥ yat vā vṛttimataḥ sādhya vada vṛtti tvam sādhya vat vṛtti tva anadhikaraṇa tvam sādhya asamāna adhikaraṇa dharma tvam sādhya vat vṛtti tva anadhikaraṇa dharmma tvam vā tattvam na ca vyatireki ati vyāptiḥ tatra sādhya aprasiddhyā tathā jñāna virahāt asādhāraṇe ca saṃkaraḥ eva anena api rūpeṇa tasya doṣa tvāt na ca sādhya vat vṛtti tve sati vṛttimat tva jñānāt sādhya abhāva vat gāmi tva jñānam āvaśyakam tena vinā sādhya vat vṛtti tva ajñānāt iti vācyam upajīvya tvena bhinna tvāt upajīvya tve api sādhyavati na vartate iti jñānam na svatas dūṣakam iti ced na asahacāra jñānasya virodhitayā vyāpti graha pratibandhaka tvāt vyabhicāra ajñāna virodhi tvena vyabhicāra jñāna vat

nanu viruddhasya sva artha anumāna doṣa tve api para artha anumāne apārthaka tvam ayogya tā jñānena niścitān anvayāt iti ced na ayogya tā jñānasya viruddha tva jñānepa jīvaka tvena tasya eva doṣa tvāt bādhe api evam sa ca ayam vidhi sādhane trividhaḥ sākṣāt sādhya abhāva vyāpya tvāt sādhya vyāpaka abhāva vyāpya tvāt sādhya vyāpaka viruddha upalambhāt yathā dhūmavān ayam yogya dhūmavat tayā anupalabhyamāna tvāt niragnika tvāt jalāśaya tvāt na ca sarvatra sādhya vyāpaka viruddha upalambhaḥ iti na traividhyam etat ajñāne api sādhya abhāva tad vyāpaka abhāva vyāpya tvena api jñātasya doṣa tvāt na ca dhūmavān ayam tat abhāvavat tvāt iti traya adhikam sva samāna adhikaraṇa atyanta abhāva apratiyogi tvam hi vyāpaka tvam tat ca abhede api dhūmavān ayam dhūma abhāvavat tayā upalabhyamāna tvāt tadvat tayā anupalabhyamāna tvāt iti anaikāntikam eva

niṣedha sādhane api trividhaḥ pratiyogi upalambhāt sādhya vyāpaka abhāva upalambhāt sādhya vyāpaka viruddha upalambhāt yathā niragnikaḥ ayam agnimat tvāt dhūma abhāva śūnya tvāt dhūmavat tvāt sarvaḥ ca ayam viśeṣaṇa dvārā api yathā kṛṣṇa aguru prabhava vahnimānayam kaṭuka asurabhi pāṇḍura dhūmavat tvāt ayañca bādha āśraya asiddha svarūpa asiddha asā dhāraṇa saṅkīrṇaḥ kvacid

sat pratipakṣa pūrva pakṣaḥ sat pratipakṣa tvam na samāna bala bodhita sādhya viparyaya liṅga tvam paraspara pratibandhena ubhayoḥ abodhaka tvāt balañca na sa pakṣa sattva ādi vyatirekiṇya bhāvāt na api samāna vyāpti pakṣa dharma tāvat tvam virodhena ekatra tad bhaṅga niyamāt na api vyāpti pakṣa dharma tayā jñāta tvam virodhi vyāpti pakṣa dharma viśiṣṭa jñānayoḥ anyatara bhrama tva niyamena nitya tva vyāpta śrāvaṇa tva ādi vaiśiṣṭyā prasiddhyā āropayitum aśakyatvāt na ca sādhya vyāpyasya pakṣa dharma tā pakṣa dharmasya vā sādhya vyāpyatā āropya iti vācyam ekatra tad ubhaya abhāvāt viśiṣṭasya aprasiddhyā tad vaiśiṣṭyasya āropa asambhavāt na api anirdhārita viśeṣeṇa bodhita sādhya viparyayaka tvam ubhayoḥ abodhaka tvāt viśeṣaḥ ca na vyāpti bhaṅga rūpaḥ ekatra tad bhaṅga niyamāt

ucyate sādhya virodhi upasthāpana samartha samāna bala upasthityā pratiruddha kārya liṅga tvam tattvam balañca vyāpti pakṣa dharmate virodhi bodhakāni agamaka taupayika rūpa sampattimat tayā jñāyamānena pratiruddha kārya tvam vā tattvam sthāpanāyāḥ vyāpti pakṣa dharma tvam ubhaya va ādi siddham vādinā tad abhāva anupanyāsāt dvitīyasya tattvam anyatara asiddham iti prathamena dvitīyam bādhitam iti sva artha anumānaḥ eva avaśyam doṣaḥ iti eke

tat na ekadā nirantarayoḥ vā ubhayoḥ vyāpti pakṣa dharma tayā jñātayoḥ pratipakṣa tvāt yugapad upasthiteḥ kāraṇa vaśena svaparasādhāraṇa tvāt atha vastunaḥ advyātmakattvena vyāpti pakṣa dharma tā bhaṅgaḥ ekatra āvaśyakaḥ iti saḥ eva doṣaḥ na ca tayoḥ virodha bhaṅge api upapatteḥ na vyāpti ādi bhaṅga niyamaḥ iti vācyam avirodhe api anumiti avirodhāt virodhe tu vyāpti ādi bhaṅga niyamāt iti ced na pratiruddha tva jñāna anantaram vyāpti ādi bhaṅga jñānam iti upajīvya tvena vyabhicāra vat asya api doṣa tvāt

nanu sādhya tad abhāvayoḥ iva tad vyāpya tvena avadhāritayoḥ virodhāt ekatra na niścayaḥ kintu saṃśayaḥ nirṇaye vā anyatara vyāpti saṃśayaḥ iti vyāpya tva asiddhiḥ iti ced na ubhayoḥ ekatra niścaya anantaram anyatara vyāpti saṃśayaḥ iti upajīvya tvena asya bhinna tvāt dūṣaka tā bījantu sama bala virodhi sāmagrī pratibandhena nirṇaya ājanaka tvam na tu vyāpti pakṣa dharma tā virahaḥ eva sat hetau api sat pratipakṣa tvāt ekatra vyāpti bhaṅga jñāna dvārā vā asya dūṣaka tvam cakṣuḥ ādeḥ ca na anumānena pratirodhaḥ tad upasthitau api phala darśanena tasya adhika bala tvāt

nanu evam vādi vākya mātrasya pratirodhaka tvena anumāna mātra ucchedaḥ na ca virodhi vākyasya nyūna bala tve lakṣaṇa ayogaḥ samāna bala tve pratirodhaḥ eva adhika bala tve nara śiraḥ śauca anumāna vat tena bādhaḥ eva iti vācyam agṛhyamāṇa viśeṣa daśāyām prativādi vākyena sarva anumāna pratirodha āpatteḥ anumānāt pūrvam paścāt vā anumāna antareṇa tasya nyūna adhika bala tvānirūpaṇāt nirūpaṇe vā anumāna vaiyarthya āpatteḥ

mā evam virodhi vākya mātrasya sama bala tva abhāvāt uktam hi vyāpti pakṣa dharmate balam iti pratyakṣa ādeḥ liṅga bhāvena eva anumiti pratirodhaḥ kathāyām tad upanyāsān arha tvāt yat tu virodhi vyāpya dvayasya asādhāraṇa tvāt saṃśaya janaka tvam dūṣaka tā bījam iti tat na ekaikam hi sat pratipakṣam na tu viśiṣṭam tādṛśañca na saṃśāyakam iti anumiti dvayasya prāmāṇya agrāhaka apravṛttiḥ dūṣaka tā bījam iti anye tat na paraspara pratibandhena anumiteḥ avān utpatteḥ

ratna koṣa kāraḥ tu sat pratipakṣābhyām pratyekam sva sādhya anumitiḥ saṃśaya rūpā janyate viruddha ubhaya jñāna sāmagryāḥ saṃśaya janaka tvāt saṃśaya dvārāḥ asya dūṣaka tvam na ca saṃśaya rūpā na anumitiḥ bādhasya iva virodhi upasthiteḥ anumiti sāmagrauvighaṭaka tvena avaghāraṇāt anyathā bādhe api anumiti āpatteḥ iti vācyam adhika balatayā bādhena pratibandhāt tulya bala tvāt anumitiḥ syāt eva sāmagrī sattvāt sādhya abhāva bodhasya ca tatra pratibandhaka tvam na tu tat bodhakasya cakṣuḥ ādeḥ pratyekam nirṇāyaka tvena avadhāritāt katham saṃśayaḥ iti ced na pratyekāt hi jñānum utpadyamānam arthāt saṃśayaḥ na tu pratyekam saṃśaya janaka tvam iti mene tat na sādhya tad abhāvayoḥ virodhena yathā eka jñānasya apara dhī pratibandhaka tvam tathā sādhya abhāva vyāpyavat tvasya api sādhya virodhi tvāt tat buddheḥ api sādhya dhī pratibandhaka tvāt virodhi jñāna tvasya pratibandhaka tve tantra tvāt

nibandhe tu hetvābhāsānām phala dvārakam lakṣaṇam anaikāntikānām anvayāt vyatirekāt vā koṭpī upasthāpaka tayā saṃśayaḥ phalam viruddhasya sādhya viparītasya jñānam apakṣa dharmaḥ api viruddhaḥ anyatra viparīta jñāna samarthaḥ eva bādhe anyatas viparīta jñānam na tu hetu abhimata ādeḥ nityaḥ ghaṭaḥ kārya tvāt iti viruddhe bādha saṅkare api adoṣaḥ asiddhe anaikāntika ādi catuṣṭaya jñānāni aliṅga tva jñānam bādhe pakṣa dharma hetau vyāpti bādhaḥ prakaraṇa same tu na vyāpti pakṣa dharma tā bādhaḥ phalam na api aliḍga tva jñānam vyāpti ādi buddhi sattvāt na api viparīta buddhiḥ sva sādhya viparītena aniyamāt na api saṃśayaḥ pratyekam koṭi dvayān upanayāt kintu katham atra tattva nirṇayaḥ iti jijñāsā phalam

tathā ca prakṛta sādhya hetvoḥ kim tattvam iti jijñāsā janikā vyāpti pakṣa dharma tā upasthitiḥ prakaraṇa samaḥ na hi anupasthite pratipakṣe ekasmāt jijñāsā kintu nirṇayaḥ eva atha jñātum icchā jijñāsā sā ca jñāna iṣṭa sādhana tā jñānāt saṃśayāt vā iti katham tena vinā virodhi sādhana jñāna mātrāt iti ced na asati prati pakṣe na jijñāsā sati tu sā iti anvaya vyatirekābhyām prakaraṇa samasya api jijñāsa janaka tvāt na ca anaikāntika ativyāptiḥ tatra hi saṃśaya dvārā sādhye jijñāsā atra tu hetu samīcīnatvaḥ iti

nanu parāmarśayoḥ eka dā anutpādāt katham pratirodhaḥ krama utpannayoḥ ekadā satvāt iti ced na eka anantaram apara hetu vyāpti pakṣa dharma tā jñānābhyām agrima vyāpti viśiṣṭa jñāna utpatti kāle pūrva parāmarśa nāśāt na ca ubhaya hetu vyāpti pakṣa dharma tā jñānānām paraspara pratibandhāt parāmarśa utpādaḥ iti vācyam vyāpti ādi jñāna catuṣṭayasya yaugapadya abhāvāt

yat tu vyāpti dvaya saṃskāra udbodhaka hetu dvaya jñānayoḥ paraspara pratibandhāt na ubhaya vyāpti smṛtiḥ iti dūṣaka tā bījam iti tat na vyāpti smṛtim vinā sat pratipakṣa abhāvāt vādibhyām vyāpti udbhāvanāt ca iti mā evam hetu dvaya samūha ālambanāt yugapad ubhaya vyāpti smṛtau ubhaya parāmarśa rūpam jñānam utpadyate atas ekadā viruddha kārya dvaya karaṇāt na ekam api kāryam utpadyate tādṛśa parāmarśaḥ ca sva artha anumāne pratyakṣa āditas parasya tu vādi upanyasta nyāya utthāpita pramāṇa avatārāt

asya ca kevala anvayinī api sambhavaḥ ghaṭaḥ abhidheyaḥ prameya tvāt iti atra abhidheya tvam ghaṭa niṣṭhā ati anta abhāva pratiyogi jāti anya tve sati ghaṭa mātra vṛtti anya dharma tvāt ghaṭa anyonya abhāva vat paṭa rūpavat ca ghaṭa niṣṭhā atyanta abhāvaḥ abhidheya tva pratiyogikaḥ ghaṭa vṛtti nitya abhāva tvāt ghaṭa niṣṭhā anyonya abhāva vat iti viśeṣa adarśana daśāyām na ca pakṣa aikyam api tantram virodhasya eva dūṣaka tve adhikasya vyartha tvāt iti

asiddhiḥ tu na vyāpti pakṣa dharma tā virahaḥ pratyekam ananugamāt atha pratyeka abhāve anugataḥ vyāpti pakṣa dharma tā viśiṣṭa abhāvaḥ asiddhiḥ yadi api viśiṣṭasya anya tve pratyeka abhāvaḥ eva saḥ iti ananugamaḥ tathā api viśeṣaṇa avacchinna pratiyogi kaḥ viśeṣya abhāvaḥ viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya sambandha abhāvaḥ vā viśiṣṭa abhāvaḥ anugataḥ iti ced na viśiṣṭa abhāva ajñāne api vyāpti ādi pratyeka abhāva jñāne udbhāvane ca anumiti pratibandhaḥ vādi nivattiḥ ca iti tad pratyeka abhāva avyāptiḥ anyathā teṣām hetvābhāsa antara tā āpatteḥ na ca viśiṣṭa abhāva dhī dvārā pratyeka abhāvaḥ doṣaḥ na tu svatas iti vācyam pratyeka abhāvasya svatas eva doṣa tva sambhavāt

vastutas viśiṣṭa abhāvaḥ doṣaḥ eva na pratyekasya samartha tve tena eva anyathā siddheḥ vyartha viśeṣaṇa tvāt pratyeka abhāvam ajñātvā na viśiṣṭa abhāva jñānam iti upajīvya tvāt viśiṣṭa abhāva anudbhāvane api pratyeka udbhāvane vādi nivṛtteḥ ca atas eva vyāpti pakṣa dharma tā viśiṣṭa jñāna viṣaya abhāva tvam pratyeka abhāva anugatam asiddha tvam vyabhicāra ādau asiddha tve api upajīvya tvena prāthamyāt tad udbhāvane vādi nivṛtteḥ ca sa svatas eva dūṣakaḥ tatra vyāpti siddhi artham upādhau tu udbhāvite vipratipadyate api tasya durūha tvāt vyabhicāreṇa eva tad anvayāt ca

yadi ca vyabhicāra ādikam ajñā tvā api asiddhi buddhiḥ tathā api upadheya saṅkare api upādheḥ asaṅkaraḥ eva iti nirastam vyartha viśeṣaṇa tvāt eva etena vyāpti pakṣa dharma tā anyatara abhāvaḥ asiddhiḥ iti pratyuktam anyataratva ajñāne api pratyeka abhāvasya doṣa tvāt vyartha viśeṣaṇa tvāt ca yat tu vyāpti pakṣa dharma tā pramiti virahaḥ āśraya asiddhyā anugataḥ asiddhiḥ tad pramiti sattve tatra anumiti pramiti āpatteḥ iti tat api vyartha viśeṣaṇa tvāt tad ajñāne api pratyeka jñānasya doṣa tvāt ca nirastam

vastutas tu prakṛta hetu vyāpti pakṣa dharma tā vaiśiṣṭyasya tad pramiteḥ ca aprasiddhyā tad abhāvaḥ jñātum udbhāvayituñcā śakyaḥ eva yat kiñci dvyāpti pakṣa dharma tā viśiṣṭa pramiti virahaḥ sat hetu sādhāraṇaḥ sva pramiti virahaḥ yat kiñcit pramiti virahaḥ vā sat hetau api sakala tad pramiti virahaḥ dūrni rūpaḥ vyātya bhāvāt eva tad grahe saḥ eva doṣaḥ upajīvya tvāt yadi ca pramiti virahaḥ svarūpa sannā iva doṣaḥ kāraṇa abhāva tvāt tadā vyāpti ādi bhramāt anumitiḥ na syāt na syāt ca hetvābhāsa tā jñāna garbha tallakṣaṇa abhāvāt

etena vyāpti pramiti pakṣa dharma tā pramiti viraha anyatara tvam asiddhiḥ anyatara tvat ca tad anya anya tvam tena ubhaya virahe api na avyāptiḥ iti nirastam vyartha viśeṣaṇa tvāt eva syāt etat vyāpti pakṣa dharma tābhyām niścayaḥ siddhiḥ tad abhāvaḥ asiddhiḥ atas eva avyāpte apakṣa dharme ca tadāropa rūpā siddhiḥ iti anumitiḥ na tu vyāpta pakṣa dharmāt api tat aniścaye na ca evam hetoḥ api ābhāsa tvam tad ābhāsasya api hetu tvam syāt daśā viśeṣe iṣṭa tvāt sā iyam svarūpa satī dūṣikā kāraṇa abhāva tvāt na ca vyāpti ādi pratyeka niścaya abhāvaḥ eva dūṣakaḥ āvaśyaka tvāt iti vācyam viśiṣṭa niścayasya hetu tve tad abhāvasya kārya anutpādaka tvāt iti

mā evam evam savyabhicāra ādeḥ api atra eva antarbhāva prasaṅgāt asiddheḥ svarūpa satyāḥ eva doṣa tve sva jñāna artham vyabhicāra ādi anudbhāvanāt yadi ca tasmāt siddhiḥ na upapadyate iti tasya upajīvya tvam tad āśrayā siddhi ādi jñānāt siddhiḥ na iti saḥ eva pṛthak doṣaḥ syāt asiddhiḥ ca jñātā parasya udbhāvyā iti sva jñāna artham udbhāvitā siddhi nirvāha arthañcā āśrayā siddhi jñānam āvaśyakam kathañca hetu tad ābhāsa vivekaḥ siddhau dvayoḥ api hetu tvāt asiddhau tad ābhāsa tvāt vyabhicāra ādeḥ sat hetau siddhim akhaṇḍayataḥ ca hetvābhāsa tva abhāvāt

atha suṣuptau jāgare api vyāpti pakṣa dharma tā sattve tat aniścaye anumiti anutpādaḥ hetvābhāsa prayojyaḥ savyabhicāra ādau tathā avadhāraṇa āditya siddhiḥ ajñātā api hetvābhāsaḥ na ca evam hetvābhāsa ādhikyam kḷpta antarbhāvaḥ vā tena rūpeṇa vyāpti asiddhi ādeḥ eva saṃgrahāt iti ced na evam savyabhicāra ādiḥ api asiddhiḥ syāt iti ukta tvāt upajīvanāt bhede āśraya asiddhi ādiḥ api pṛthak syāt suṣapti ādau anumiti abhāvaḥ kāraṇa abhāvāt kārya anutpādaḥ hi na pratibandhaka tvāt kintu kāraṇa abhāvāt api asati api pratibandhake vahni abhāvena dāha an utpatteḥ

atha anum iti anutpādaḥ hetvābhāsa pratyuktaḥ eva iti ced tarhi anumitau manaḥ yoga ādiḥ api na hetuḥ hetvābhāsāt eva anumiti anutpāde tad vyatirekeṇa anumiti anutpāda abhāvāt siddheḥ eva tad hetu tve carama kāraṇam eva hetuḥ syāt anye tu gamakataupayika pratidvandvi vyāpti pakṣa dharma tā viraha tad niyatayoḥ anyatara tvam hetvābhāsa tvam tatra adhika samāna balau bādha pratirodhau pratidvandvinau vyāpti pakṣa dharma tā virahaḥ ca asiddhiḥ tat niyatau ca savyabhicāra viruddhau na ca anayoḥ api asiddhi antarbhāvaḥ vyāpti viraha niyata tvena jñātayoḥ svātantryeṇa eva dūṣaka tvāt bhrame viśeṣa darśanasya eva iti tat na atra api vyāpti pakṣa dharma tā virahaḥ eva asiddhiḥ paryavasyati tatra ca uktam eva anyatara tvañca na lakṣaṇam vyartha viśeṣaṇa tvāt hetvābhāsa antara bahiṣkṛtasya vyāpti pakṣa dharma tā niścaya virodhinaḥ rūpasya vivakṣita tvāt tat ca āśraya asiddhi ādikam eva iti

ucyate āśraya asiddhiḥ svarūpa asiddhiḥ vyāpya tva asiddhiḥ ca pratyekam eva doṣaḥ pratyekasya jñānāt udbhāvanāt ca anumiti pratibandhāt na tu viśiṣṭa abhāvaḥ parāmarśa viṣaya abhāvaḥ vā vyartha viśeṣaṇa tvāt tasya jñānam udbhāvanam vinā api anumiti pratibandhāt anubhava siddham hi lakṣaṇam na tu lakṣaṇa anurodhena anubhava kalpanā parāmarśa viṣaya abhāva tvena anugatena trayāṇām asiddha tvena saṃgrahaḥ mahā ṛṣiṇā kṛtaḥ iti na vibhāga virodhaḥ hetvābhāsa ādhikyam vā

atas eva ye vyāpti viraha pakṣa dharma tā viraha rūpāḥ te asiddhi bheda madhyam adhyāsate tad anye ca yathāyatham vyabhicāra ādayaḥ iti siddhānta pravādaḥ api na ca evam sākṣāt pratibandhaka tvena bādha pratirodhayoḥ vyāpti viraha liṅga tvena savyabhicāra viruddhayoḥ api saṅgrahe vibhāga vyāghātaḥ svatantra abhiprāyasya niṣeddhum aśakyatvāt anyathā śāstre paribhāṣā ucchet āpatteḥ savyabhicāra ādeḥ api evam rūpa sattve api upajīvya tvena pṛthaktvam upadheya saṅkare api upādheḥ asaṅkarāt

nanu āśraya aprasiddhyā katham āśrayā siddhiḥ udbhāvyā na ca śaśīyatayā gavi śrṛḍganiṣedha vat vyoma kamalam iti vācyam śaśaśrṛṅga niṣedhaḥ na gavīti ukta tvāt iti ced vyoma kamalam iti niścitān anvaya tvena apārthakam āśraya viśeṣaṇā siddhyā ca āśraya asiddhiḥ asaṅkīrṇā vyāpti virahaḥ ca vyartha viśeṣaṇa ādau tad uktam ekāma siddhim pariharataḥ dvitīya āpatteḥ iti

upādhiḥ tu na vyāpti virahaḥ vahni vyāpaka dhūma avyāpaka dharmasya aprasiddhyā dhūme tad viraha asiddheḥ kintu yāvat sva vyabhicāri vyabhicāri sādhya sāmāna adhikarapyam anaupādhika tvam vyāptiḥ sādhya vyāpaka sādhana avyāpakaḥ ca dharma antaram na tu tad virahaḥ api tu tat niyataḥ na ca evam upajīvya tvena upādhiḥ hetvābhāsa antaram upajīvya tve api svatas adūṣaka tvena tad artham para mukha vīkṣaka tvāt na hi sādhya vyāpaka avyāpya tvam anumiti virodhi kintu vyabhicāra unnayanena sva vyatirekeṇa sat pratipakṣa tayā vā tat āha upādhau avaśyam vyabhicāraḥ upādheḥ eva vyabhicāra śaṅkā iti aprayojakān yathā siddhau sa upādhī na asiddhau pratikūla tarka anukūla tarka abhāvau upajīvya tve sati svatas dūṣakau api na hetvābhāsau sva rūpa satoreva pratibandhaka tvāt iti uktam

bādhaḥ na sādhya abhāva vat pakṣaka tvam pakṣa vṛtti abhāva pratiyogi sādhyaka tvam vā pakṣe sādhya abhāva jñāna mātrasya pramātu a jñānam vinā adhika bala tva ajñānena bādhā bhāvāt iti vakṣyate atas eva sādhya abhāva vat pakṣa vṛtti tvam api na asiddhi saṅkīrṇa bādha avyāpteḥ ca kintu sādhya abhāvavat tva pramā viṣaya pakṣaka tvam pramita sādhya abhāva vat pakṣaka tvam pakṣa niṣṭha pramāviṣayatva prakāra abhāva pratiyogi sādhyaka tvam vā iti vivakṣita vivekena sādhya abhāva ādi pramā eva doṣaḥ sā ca pramātvena jñātā na svarūpa satī hetvābhāsa tvāt pramātu ajñānam vinā adhika bala tva abhāvena adoṣa tvāt apramāyām api pramātu a jñāne anumiti pratibandhāt ca

atha sādhya abhāvavati pakṣe hetoḥ sattva jñāne vyabhicāraḥ tad ajñāne asiddhiḥ saṃśaya yogya tva abhāvena pakṣa tva abhāvāt āśrayā siddhiḥ ca na ca pakṣa bhinne vyabhicāraḥ doṣaḥ vyartha viśeṣaṇa tvāt sarva upasaṃhāra pravṛtta vyāpteḥ sādhya abhāvavati sādhanam iti avagamāt eva bhaṅgāt na ca evam sandigdha sādhya dṛṣṭānte sandigdha anaikāntika vat pakṣe vyabhicāra saṃśayāt anumāna mātra ucchedaḥ iti pakṣe sādhya sandehaḥ anumāna aṅgam iti vyāptasya pakṣa dharma tā jñānāt anum iti utpādena saṃśaya nivṛtteḥ anyathā viśeṣa darśanasya saṃśaya virodhitā bhajyeta na ca pakṣe sādhya abhāvam pratītya vyabhicāra jñānam iti upajīvya tvāt bādhaḥ pṛthak pakṣe sādhya abhāva pratītiḥ eva hi sādhya abhāva hetvoḥ sambandha ullekhinī iti eka vitti vedya tvena na upajīvya tvam anyathā bādha daśāyām pakṣe hetoḥ ajñāna da siddhiḥ eva

na ca udbhāvita vyabhicāra nirvāhāya bādha udbhāvanam āvaśyakam iti upajīvya tvam vyabhicāra udbhāvane param kathantān āvaśyaka tvāt tattve vā tat nirvāhyam eva dūṣaṇam kḷpta tvāt vahniḥ uṣṇaḥ kṛtakaḥ iti udbhāvanāt vahniḥ uṣṇaḥ iti udbhāvane lāghavam iti bādhaḥ pṛthak iti kaścid tat na pakṣe sādhya abhāva pramā sva artha anumāne yadi na doṣaḥ tadā pratyapi na syāt aviśeṣāt iti tad udbhāvanasya dūra nirasta tvāt

atha upanīta kāñcana maya tva viśiṣṭa vahni anumiteḥ sat liṅga janyāyāḥ ābhāsattvam hetvābhāsa adhīnam na ca anumiteḥ pūrvam tatra vyabhicāra jñānam viśiṣṭasya aprasiddhyā tad abhāvasya ajñānāt atas eva pakṣa asiddhiḥ api na atas kāñcana maya vahni abhāva rūpāt bādhāt anumāna ābhāsa tvam vyadhikaraṇa prakāra avacchinna pratiyogikaḥ ca atra abhāvaḥ iti ced na vastutas vyabhicārasya api tatra sattvāt jñānañca tasya bādhasi eva anum iti anantaram eva kiñca vahnau kāñcana maya tvasya anumitau eva bhāne kāñcana maya vahnimān itya numitiḥ na syāt viśiṣṭasya pūrvam ajñānāt vahnau liṅgasya asiddheḥ vyabhicārāt ca na ca anumiteḥ viṣaya abhāva adhīna pramātvam kintu hetvābhāsa adhīnam yasya hi jñānam anumiti pratibandhakam sa hetvābhāsaḥ na ca sādhya abhāvaḥ jñātaḥ pratibandhakaḥ iti na saḥ hetvābhāsaḥ

vastutas tu upanītasya anumitau bhāne māna abhāvaḥ pratyabhijñā ādau ca pratīti balena tad kalpanam anyathā pūrva upasthita sakala padārtha bhāne yathārtha anum iti ucchedaḥ api caivam para artha anumāne api upanīta bhāne bādhitaḥ arthaḥ upanītaḥ ayam mama bhātaḥ iti udbhāvanāt eva vijayeta vādī uddeśya anumiteḥ apratibandhāt na tatra bādhaḥ doṣaḥ iti ced tulyam sva artha anumāne api atas eva yatra sāmānyatas dṛṣṭa anumānam eva itara bādha sahāyam viśeṣa anumāpakam tatra bādhakānām ābhāsa tve tat prayuktam sāmānyasya adṛṣṭā api ābhāsa tvam iti bādhasyāsāṅkaryāt na ca yadi viśeṣa vipratipattau sāmānya pratijñā tadā artha antaram sāmānya vipratipattau tu na itaratra bādhaka apekṣā iti vācyam sva artha anumānaḥ eva evam bādhā saṅkarasya ukta tvāt iti a pāstam anumityapratibandhena tatra bādhasya adoṣa tvāt

nanu pakṣe sādhya abhāva graha vat sādhya abhāva vyāpya grahaḥ api dūṣakaḥ virodhi tvā aviśeṣāt tathā ca sādhya abhāva sambandhaḥ vyabhicāraḥ sādhya abhāva vyāpya sāmānādhikaraṇyam bādhaḥ sādhya abhāva vyāpyañca vahni tva ādikam eva iti ced na pakṣe hi sādhya abhāve jñāyamāne jñāte vā yadi sādhya abhāva vyāpya sāmāna adhikaraṇya buddhiḥ tadā vyabhicāraḥ eva

atha pakṣe sādhya abhāva buddhim vinā eva sā tarhi hetu sādhya abhāva vyāpyayoḥ agṛhyamāṇa viśeṣayoḥ sat pratipakṣa tvam atha tulya balena sat pratipakṣaḥ adhika balena bādhaḥ iti ced na gamakataupayika rūpa sākalyam hi balam tat ca dvayoḥ jñātam iti katham na sat pratipakṣa tvam gamaka tā bahis bhū tañca na balam atha sādhya abhāva vyāpya buddheḥ anyathā siddha tvam balam tadā tatas sādhanavati pakṣe sādhya abhāva anumitau anaikāntika tvam eva pakṣe sādhya abhāva graha vat iti yat uktam tat api asiddham tasya doṣa tva anabhyupagamāt anyathā hetvābhāsa antara tā āpattiḥ

atha hetutaḥ sādhya siddhi sambhā vanāyām vyabhicāra asiddheḥ bādhena hetoḥ asādhaka tve siddhe vyabhicāra siddhiḥ iti upajīvya tvāt bādhaḥ pṛthak anyathā hetoḥ asādhaka tve siddhe sādhya siddhi sambhāvanā virahāt vyabhicāra buddhiḥ tasya añca satyām hetoḥ asādhaka tva dhīḥ iti anyonya āśrayaḥ iti ced na sādhya siddhi unmukha hetu jñānasya pramita sādhya abhāva sahacarita hetu viṣaya tvena vyabhicāra jñāna tayā adūṣaka tvāt tathā api vyabhicāre sādhya abhāva pramā tantram tām vinā tad abhāvāt iti sā eva doṣaḥ iti ced satyam kintu sādhya abhāva pramā vyabhicāra jñāna tvena dūṣikā kḷpta tvāt na tu svatantrā atas eva pakṣe sādhya abhāva jñāna tvena pratibandhaka tvam na tu sādhya abhāva samāna adhikaraṇa sādhana jñāna tvena iti pratyuktam tasya laghu tve api akḷpta tvāt

atha pratyakṣa ādau pramā mātram prati svātantryeṇa bādhaḥ doṣa tvena kḷptaḥ iti anumitau api saḥ eva doṣaḥ iti ced na tarhi hetvābhāsaḥ anumiti asādhāraṇa doṣasya tatvāt manaḥ yoga abhava vat svarūpa satas eva pratibandhaka tvāt hetu tva abhimatā vṛtti tvena asādhaka tā āliṅga tva abhāvāt ca bādhita pakṣaka tvam liṅgam iti ced na anyatra tathā dūṣaka tva akalpanāt

ucyate pakṣe sādhya abhāva niścayaḥ sādhya abhāva jñāna pramātu a niścayāt jñāna mātrāt artha niścaye prāmāṇya graha vaiyarthyam bhrama tvena jñātāt artha niścaya prasaṅgaḥ ca tathā ca upajīvya tvena adhika bala tvena vā pakṣe sādhya abhāva jñānasya pramātu a niścaye savyabhicāraḥ na anyathā iti ubhayathā api sādhya abhāva niścaya adhīna vyabhicāra jñānāt pūrvam jñātam sādhya abhāva jñāna pramātvam eva doṣaḥ upajīvya tvāt

yadi ca pakṣe sādhya abhāva jñānasya pramātva niścayaḥ na anumiti virodhī tadā vyāpti pakṣa dharma tayā hetu jñānam viśeṣa darśana tvena pakṣe sādhya abhāva jñānam paribhūya sādhyam sādhayet eva parvate dhūmaḥ iva vahnim na ca sādhya abhāva buddhiḥ eva agṛhyamāṇa viśeṣā sat pratipakṣa vat pratibandhika iti vācyam rajate na idam rajatam iti jñāne api viśeṣa darśanena rajata tvasya śaṅkhe pīta tva jñāne śukla tvasya ca anumānāt vādi vākyena pakṣe sādhya abhāva jñānāt anumāna uccheda prasaḍgāt ca atha pakṣe sādhya abhāva pramā eva sādhya abhāva hetu viṣayāḥ vyabhicāra jñāna tvena doṣaḥ na tu tasyāḥ pramātu ajñānam api iti ced tarhi pramāyāḥ apramātu a jñāne bhrānta anumitiḥ na syāt na syāt ca pakṣe sādhya abhāva jñāna pramātu a bhramāt anumiti pratibandhaḥ

nanūpa jīvya tve api atra sādhya abhāva pramā iti jñānam na svatas dūṣakam kḷpta tvāt pakṣe sādhya abhāva niścayam kurvat vyabhicāra jñāna dvārā iti ced na atra sādhya abhāva pramā iti jñānāt niyamataḥ sādhya jñāna anudayāt tasya eva pratibandhaka tvāt śabda ādau tathā darśanāt sādhya abhāva pramā viṣaya vṛtti tvasya hetu vṛtti tvāt asādhaka tvena sādhya abhāva pramāyā hetvābhāsa tvam sādhāraṇye api jñāyamānam sat yat anumitim pratibadhnāti tasya eva hetvābhāsa tvam na ca sādhya abhāva pramātrā iti niścaya daśāyām pakṣe sādhya abhāva hetvoḥ jñānāt vyabhicāraḥ iti vācyam pramātu ajñānasya sādhya abhāva niścaya hetu tvena tad daśāyām tad abhāvāt pakṣa dharma tā balena prasiddham bādhāt na sidhyati iti bādhaḥ pṛthak prasiddhā abhāvavati pakṣe vyabhicārāt na tad siddhiḥ iti ced tarhi asat prasiddhā abhāvavati sa pakṣe vyabhicārāt tam api na sādhayet tad ajñānāt tad sādhane anumitiḥ apramā syāt

atha pakṣa vṛtteḥ anyaḥ eva dhūma ādiḥ sa pakṣe tarhi go tva pṛthivī tva dravya tva ādeḥ aprasiddha sāsnā ādi anumānam na syāt sāsnādi pratyeka vyabhicārāt yadi ca sādhya tāvacchedaka sāsnā tva ādi sāmānya avacchinna pratiyogitākā abhāvavati na go tva ādikam iti na vyabhicāraḥ tarhi dhūme api evam vyabhicāra abhāvāt sādhya tāvacchedakena prakāreṇa aprasiddham iva prasiddham api sādhyam dhūma go tva ādikam sādhayet yadi bādhaḥ na doṣaḥ iti vayam sādhya abhāvavat mātra sahacāraḥ na vyabhicāraḥ sādhya prāgabhāva dhvaṃsa vat vṛtti tvena vyabhicāritayā pṛthivī tva ādinā gandha ādeḥ dravya tva ādinā guṇasya anumāna bhaṅga prasaṅgāt kintu sādhya atyanta abhāva vat gāmi tvam evañca sva prāgabhāva dhvaṃsā avacchinna tad āśraye tad pratiyogi sādhane pakṣe vyabhicāraḥ na iti bādhaḥ dūṣaṇam

atha avacchedye siddha sādhanam avacchedake hetu asiddhiḥ viśiṣṭañca na anyat iti ced tarhi prāc abhāva dhvaṃsa pratiyoginoḥ eka vṛtti tvena eka samayatā api syāt atha yat samayā avacchedena tatra prāc abhāvaḥ pradhvaṃsaḥ vā na tad samaya avacchedena pratiyogi iti ced tarhi tad avacchedena pratiyogi sādhane na siddha sādhanam kintu bādhaḥ eva anyathā bhāva atyanta abhāvayoḥ api avyāpya vṛtti tva bhaṅgaḥ eka vṛtti tvāt avacchedaka bhedena vṛttiḥ iha api tulyā tatra deśa bhedaḥ avacchedakaḥ atra tu samaya bhedaḥ iti asiddheḥ api bādhaḥ eva upajīvyaḥ na ca evam upajīvya tvāt bādhavat siddha sādhanam api pṛthak upajīvyatvepi svatas adūṣaka tvāt na hi sādhya jñānam tat buddhi virodhi

dhārāvāhika jñāna udayāt na api anumiti virodhi anumitsayā pratyakṣa siddhe api anumāna darśanāt tad uktam pratyakṣa dṛṣṭam api anumānena bubhutsante tarkarasikāḥ iti śravaṇa anantaram manana darśanāt ca tasmāt siddhi mātra arthinaḥ siddhau na tad icchā siddhi viśeṣa arthinaḥ sā asti iti tasya anumitiḥ eva evañca siṣā dhayiṣita vighaṭana dvārā siddha sādhanam dūṣaṇam na tu svatas

nanu abhāva dhīḥ api na bhāva dhī pratibandhikā na idam rajatam iti bhrama anantaram rajata niścayāt naca abhāva pramā tathā api itaḥ śaṅkhaḥ iti pramāpayataḥ eva pītaḥ ayam iti bhrama darśanāt iti ced na virodhi jñānam hi pratibandhakam pratyakṣa bhramasya pratyakṣa pramā virodhinī sā ca śaṅkha ādau doṣāt na asti eva anumitau tu abhāva pramā mātram eva virodhi iti katham abhāva pramāyām bhāva anumitiḥ iti

sa ca ayam daśavidhaḥ dharma grāhaka māna bādhitam ghaṭaḥ avyāpakaḥ sattvāt iti pratyakṣeṇa paramāṇavaḥ sa avayavāḥ mūrta tvāt iti anumānena meruḥ pāṣāṇa mayaḥ parvata tvāt iti suvarṇa maya tva bodhaka āgamena sādhya pratiyogi grāhaka bādhitam vahniḥ anuṣṇaḥ kṛtaka tvāt iti pratyakṣeṇa śabdaḥ aśrāvaṇaḥ guṇa tvāt iti anumānena gavaya tvam gavaya pada apravṛtti nimittam jāti tvāt iti upamānena sādhya grāhaka bādhitam śuci nara śiraḥ kapālam prāṇi aṅga tvāt iti atra āgamena hetu grāhaka bādhitam jala anilau uṣṇau pṛthivītas viparīta sparśava tvāt tejaḥ vat iti pratyakṣeṇa manaḥ vibhu jñāna sama vāyi ādhāra tvāt iti anumānena rājasūyam brāhmaṇa kartavyam svarga sādhana tvāt agniṣṭoma vat iti rājasūya kartavyatā bodhaka āgamena iti

atha hetvābhāsānām asādhaka tā sādhaka tvena sat uttara tvam jāti ādīnāñcāsādhaka tā sādha araṇyena parāsādhaka tā sādhaka tayā sva vyāghātaka tvāt asat uttarattvam atha viruddha tva ādi jñānāt eva sva artha anumitiḥ iva para artha anumiteḥ api pratibandhe kim asādhaka tā anumānena yat vacasi vādi ukta dūṣaṇa avagatiḥ sa nigṛhītaḥ iti samaya bandhena kathā pravṛttau dūṣaṇa mātram udbhāvyam anyathārtha antara tvāt iti ced na dvayam

hi uddeśyam para artha anumiti pratibandhaḥ sthāpanāyāḥ asādhaka tā sādhanatvañca tatra ādyam dūṣaṇa mātra jñānāt eva dvitīyantu liṅga tva jñāpanāt pratibandhaka tva vadanena api rūpeṇa dūṣaka tva sambhavaḥ iti abhiprāyeṇa vā asādhaka tā sādhanam nanu evam pañca avaya prayoga apekṣā syāt anyathā nyūna tā āpattiḥ iti ced na dūṣaṇasya asādhaka tā vyāpya tvam aṅgīkṛtya kathā iti tad pakṣa dharma tāyāḥ eva udbhāvya tvāt anyathā adhika tva āpatteḥ

nanu evam kṛtaka tvena anitya tva anumāne api vyāptiḥ na abhidheyā ubhaya siddha tvāt iti ced na kathāyām samaya viṣaya tayā dūṣaṇe tu asādhaka tā vyāpti upasthiteḥ āvaśyaka tvāt anyathā kathakatva virodhāt nanu evam kṛtaka tvena anumāne tad vyāptim anaṅgīkṛtya api kathā sambhavāt yaḥ tu kathā ārambhe bādhasya asādhaka tva vyāptim na aṅgīkaroti tam prati tad dūṣaka tvam prasādhya pañca avayava prayogaḥ kartavyaḥ eva

yat tu dūṣaṇe pakṣa dharma tā mātram udbhāvyam tatra yatra vādinoḥ tathā samayaḥ anyatra tu pañcau ava prayogaḥ eva iti tat na kathā sampradāya virodhāt atha asādhaka tvam na pakṣe sādhya pratyaya ājanaka tvam tena api tattvena ajñāna daśāyām pakṣe sādhya bhrama jananāt kadācid ajanaka tvam sat hetau api nanu etat kāle sādhya viśiṣṭa pakṣa jñāna ajanakam tat na hi dūṣaṇa tva jñāna daśāyām pakṣe bhrama rūpā api anumitiḥ sādhya viśiṣṭa pakṣa jñānañca hatu tvena jñāna daśāyām prasiddham iti ced na sat hetau asat pratipakṣa tāt aśa ayam api pūrva kāle sādhya viśiṣṭa pakṣa jñāna ajanaka tvam asti iti asādhaka tā prasaṅgāt

atha pakṣe sādhya bhrama janaka tvam tat bādha viruddhayoḥ api tattva ajñāna daśāyām bhrama janaka tvāt iti ced na sat hetau sat pratipakṣe asādhāraṇe ca tattvena jñāna daśāyām sādhya bhrama janaka tvāt ajñāne sādhya pramājanaka tvāt na api vyāpti pakṣa dharma tā anyatara rāhityam sat pratipakṣa asā dhāraṇa sadhetoḥ a bhāvāt daśā viśeṣe tasya doṣa tvāt sādhya aprasiddhau prakṛta sādhya vyāptya prasiddheḥ ca na api anaikāntika ādi anyam atvam yat kiñcid anaikāntika tvasya ati vyāpteḥ prakṛta sādhya anaikāntika tvasya aprasiddha tvena kevala anvayi sādhane aprasiddheḥ aṃśataḥ siddha sādhanāt sādhya aviśeṣāt ca

yat tu etad kālīna etat pakṣīyatva avacchinna pratiyogika etad sādhya pramākaraṇa tva abhāvaḥ tad takāla tad tad pakṣa viṣaya sādhya tva abhimata anitya tva ādi pramā janaka tva abhāvaḥ vā asādhaka tvam na ca pratiyogi aprasiddhiḥ etad kālīnaitpakṣīyatva tad tad kāla tad tad pakṣa viṣaya tvayoḥ vyadhikaraṇayoḥ eva pratiyogi ta avacchedaka tvāt iti tat na sat hetoḥ sat pratipakṣatva ajñāna daśāyām api tādṛśa pramāyāma karaṇa bhāvena asādhaka tā āpatteḥ na api tṛtīya liṅga parāmarśasya apramā tvam tat viruddha ādau parāmarśa abhāvāt sat hetau sat pratipakṣe asādhāraṇe ca tat pramātvāt ca na api anumiti hetu bhūta abhāva pratiyogi jñāna viṣaya tvam tat sat hetau api kadācid vyabhicāritu a sat pratipakṣa tva jñānasya anumiti pratibandhaka tvāt

atha anumiti pratibandhaka pramāviṣaya tvam asādhaka tvam sat hetau vyabhicāra ādi bhramaḥ pratibandhakaḥ anumiti pratibandhaka tvañca vyabhicāra ādi pramāyāḥ tṛtīya liṅga parāmarśa vighaṭana dvārā tulya balatayā viṣaya tayā vā iti ced na sat pratipakṣayoḥ viruddhayoḥ vāstava tulya bala tva abhāvena tat bhramasya pratibandhaka tvāt na ca tulya balatayā jñāyamānena bodhita sādhya viparyaka tva jñānam pratibandhakam tat ca pramā eva iti vācyam tulya bala tā jñānam eva hi pratibandhakam na tu jñāyamāna tva jñānam gauravāt asiddheḥ ca na ca sat pratipakṣe anyatara aṅga vaikalya pramā eva pratibandhika iti vācyam anyatara tvam tat atad vṛtti na ca tad atad vṛtti sāmāna adhikaraṇyena jñāyamānasya doṣa tvam dharma mātrasya vyabhicāra jñānāt anum iti uccheda āpatteḥ anyatara aṅga vaikalya jñāna upajīvyasya tulya bala tva jñānasya eva pratibandhaka tvāt ca anyathā vyāpya tva asiddhi antarbhāva āpatteḥ

atha anaikāntika ādi jñānasya tad tad anumiti pratibandhaka tvam asādhaka tvam tathā hi idam anaikāntika ādi jñānam etat sādhyavat tayā etat puruṣasya etad kālīna etat pakṣaka anumiti pratibandhakam etat anaikāntika ādi jñāna tvāt etad anya tat jñāna vat iti ced na etat sādhya vat tayā etat pakṣaka anumiteḥ kadācid liṅga bhramāt prasiddhau api etat kālīna etat puruṣasya tādṛśa anumiti aprasiddheḥ na api samīcīn asādhya viśiṣṭa pakṣa viṣaya anumiti ajanaka tvam bādha viruddha asiddheṣu sādhya an adhikaraṇe pakṣe satyasādhya pratītya prasiddheḥ vahnimati bāṣpe dhūma bhramāt vahni anumiteḥ satya tvāt ca na ca anyaḥ eva vahniḥ tatra bhāsate māna abhāvāt tad vahneḥ pratyabhijñānāt eka vyaktike tad asambhavāt ca na ca sa anumitiḥ liṅga viṣaya tvena bhramaḥ anumitau liṅga bhāne māna abhāvāt

kiñca bhāvaḥ abhāvaḥ vā ubhayathā api prameyam iti satya anumitau bhāva tva abhāva tvavati prameya tva jñāne ekatra tayoḥ abhāvāt asatya anumitiḥ syāt na ca anyatara tvam liṅgam tad vyāptim aviduṣaḥ api anumiteḥ vyartha viśeṣaṇa tvāt ca atha sādhya vyāpya tvam eva tatra tantram tatra ca bādhaḥ na asti iti ced tarhi kūṭa liṅgāt anumitau vahni vyāpyavat tvam eva tantram vahni vyāpyañca kiñcid tatra asti eva atha kūṭa liṅge vahni vyāpya abheda pratīyate vahnau kūṭa liṅga vyāpakā bhedaḥ api anyathā kūṭasya eva vahni vyāpyatva apratīteḥ evañca kūṭa liṅga vyāpakaḥ vahni tvena bhāsate iti vahni anumitiḥ asatyā eva iti ced

na vahni vyāpya āloke dhūma āropāt yatra anumitiḥ tatra asiddhi bhede asatya tva abhāva āpatteḥ āloka vyāpake dhūma vyāpaka abhedāt atha liṅgam anumiti viṣayaḥ niyamataḥ pakṣa dharma tā jñāna viṣaya tvāt vyāpti jñāna viṣaya tvāt niyamena anumiti hetu viśeṣaṇa dhī viṣaya tvāt ca parvata tva vat sādhya vat ca kiñca eka viśeṣaṇava tvena jñāte viśeṣaṇa antara dhī sāmagrī tatra eva viśiṣṭa vaiśiṣṭyā anumitiḥ iti dhūma viśiṣṭaḥ eva vahni vaiśiṣṭya anumitiḥ iti nanu anumitau vyāpaka tva bhāne anumiti avicchedaḥ na ca phalībhūta jñāna nyūna viṣayasya eva parāmarśasya anumiti hetu tvam gauravāt viṣaya antara sañcārāt na anumitiḥ iti api na parāmarśasya carama kāraṇa tvāt pratyakṣa ādi sāmagrītaḥ balavat tvāt ca iti ced na siddha sādhanena vicchedāt

yadi api evam liṅga aṃśe apramātve api sādhya pramātvāt katham tasya asādhaka tvam tathā api ukta sādhaka tvam asti eva iti ced astu tāvat evam tathā api daivāt tatra dhūma sattve katham taṃdeśe api asatya tā atas eva ārdra indhana prabhavaḥ vahniḥ dhūma vyāpakaḥ na anyaḥ na ca vahni tvena vyāpaka tvāt anyaḥ api tathā tena vinā api dhūma sattvāt evam bāṣpe dhūma bhramāt dhūma vyāpakaḥ vahniḥ bhāsate sa ca tatra na asti eva iti na sa anumitiḥ satyā iti nirastam daivāt dhūma sattve satya tvāt iti

ucyate sva jñāna daśāyām pakṣe sādhya pratyaya ājanaka tvam asādhaka tvam tathā hi viruddha tva ādi jñānadaśāvartī idam pakṣe sādhya pratyaya ajanakam viruddha ādi tvāt pakṣa viśeṣaṇa mahimnā tad haśāyām pakṣe sādhya pratyaya ājanaka tvam siddhyati bādhita ādau api liṅga tva bhramāt pakṣe sādhya pratyaya janaka tvam iti na pratiyogi aprasiddhyā sādhya aprasiddhiḥ yat vā anumiti pratibandhaka tāvacchedaka rūpavat tvam asādhaka tvam tathā ahi idānīm idam anumiti pratibandhaka tāvacchedaka rūpa vat anaikāntika ādi tvāt jñāna vat anumiti pratibandhaka tāvaccheda kañca rūpam jñāne viṣaya tayā anaikāntika ādi tvam eva na ca sādhya aviśeṣaḥ upādhi viśeṣasya anumeya tvāt toya tvena pipāsā upaśamana samartha tāvacchedaka rūpa ratva anumāna vat

anye tu anaikāntika bādhita viruddheṣu avyāpya tvam vyāpya tva asiddhe anaikāntika tvam svarūpa asiddha sat pratipakṣa asā dhāraṇeṣu daśa aviśeṣe anumiti pratibandhaka jñāna viṣaya tvam asādhaka tvam na ca evam anaikāntikaḥ asādhakaḥ iti saha prayoga anupapattiḥ tatra avyāpya tvasya asādhaka śabda artha tvāt asādhaka tānanugamepi ca hetvābhāsa tvam anugatam eva yasya jñānam anumiti pratibandhakam tasya hetvābhāsa tvāt iti

evam anumāne nirūpite tasmāt jagat nirmātṛ puruṣa dhaureya siddhiḥ kṣiti ādau kāryatvena ghaṭa vat sa kartṛkatva anumānāt nanu kṣiti ādi pratyekam na pakṣaḥ tasya sva śabda ūna abhidhātum aśakyatvāt na api militam eka rūpa abhāvāt atas eva sa kartṛka tvāsa kartṛka tva vicāra ambhaka saṃśaya viṣayaḥ tathābhūta vivāda viṣayaḥ vā na pakṣaḥ eka rūpa abhāvena tayoḥ tāvat grahītum aśakyatvāt vādinoḥ niścita tvena saṃśaya abhāvāt na ca vādya numānayoḥ tulya bala tvena madhyasthasya saṃśayaḥ anumānābhyām tasya saṃśayaḥ madhyastha praśna anantarañcā anumānam iti anyonya āśrayāt ghaṭe api kadācid tayoḥ sambhavāt pratyekam saṃśaye vivāda āspada tvena anumāne artha antara tā āpatteḥ ca

na ca śarīra apekṣeṇa kartrā yat na kṛtam śarīra janyam janyam vā pakṣaḥ janyā ātma viśeṣa guṇa śabda phūtkāra sarga ādyaka ālīna veda ghaṭa ādi lipya ādi sampradāyānām īśvara mātra kartṛkāṇām asaṃgrahāt asiddheḥ ca adṛṣṭa dvārā śarīriṇopi kṣiti ādi kartṛ tvāt na api janya kṛtya janyam janyam ubhaya siddha kṛti janyāni ajanyam vā pakṣaḥ kṣiti ādīnām adṛṣṭa dvārā janya kṛti janya tvāt na api adṛṣṭa janaka kṛtya janyam janya kṛti sākṣāt ajanyam vā janyam pakṣaḥ īśvara kṛteḥ adṛṣṭa janaka tvena kṣiti ādau tad abhāvāt ghaṭa ādau api evam pakṣa tvena aṃśataḥ siddha sādhanāt na ca kṣitiḥ eva pakṣaḥ

aṅkureṇa sandigdha anaikāntika tvāt na ca niścita vipakṣe hetu sandehāt saḥ iti vācyam hetau sādhya abhāva vat gāmi tva saṃśayasya dūṣaka tvāt sa ca sādhya abhāvavati hetu sandehāt hetumati sādhya abhāva san dehāt vā ubhayathā api doṣaḥ na ca evam pakṣe api tat syāt anumāna mātra ucchedaka tvena itaratra tasya dūṣaka tvāt aṅkure hetoḥ aniścayena sandigdha anaikāntikam tad niścaye ca sādhya sandehavati sādhya anumitiḥ eva pakṣa vat sāmagrī sattvāt atas eva aṅkuraḥ pakṣa samaḥ iti ced

na tasya apakṣa tvena hetoḥ pakṣa dharma tā viraheṇa sthāpana anumāna aviṣaya tvāt tadā tasya api pakṣa tve pratijñā antara āpattiḥ anumāna antara adhīna tad sādhyānum iti anantarañca pakṣe anumitau itaretara āśrayāt na ekam api anumānam syāt tatra api kṣiti ādau sandigdhānaikāntāt kṣiteḥ vivāda viṣaya tve aṅkure prathamam sādhya sādhane artha antarāt ca kiñca evam ekaika upādāna abhijña siddhau api na īśvara siddhiḥ na api sarga ādyakālīnam dvi aṇukam pakṣaḥ paramprati sarga ādi asiddheḥ

kiñca sa kartṛka tvam na tāvat kṛtimat sahabhāvaḥ kṛti mat janya tvam vā asmad ādinā siddha sādhanāt upādāna gocara aparokṣa jñāna cikīrṣā ākṛti mat janya tvam tat iti ced na upādāna gocara tvam yadi yat kiñcit upādāna gocara tvam tadā asmad ādinā artha antara tvam jñāna ādi janya tvam api vivakṣitam na ca ghaṭa upādāna gocara aparokṣa jñāna ādīnām janakatvam sambhavati vyabhicārāt iti ced na kṣiti janaka adṛṣṭa janaka jñāna ādīnām upādāna aviṣaya tva niyamena adṛṣṭa dvārā taiḥ eva siddha sādhanāt na ca sākṣāt tat janya tvam vivakṣitam tat hi na kṛti janyā janya tve sati kṛti janya tvam sva janaka kṛtya vyavahita uttarakṣaṇa varti tvam vā ghaṭa dṛṣṭāntasya sādhya vikalatā āpatteḥ ghaṭa ādau kulāla ādi kartṛka tva abhāva prasaṅgāt ca na ca śarīra kriyāḥ dṛṣṭāntaḥ iti vācyam ghaṭena anaikāntika tvāt ceṣṭā tvasya upādhi tvāt ca

na api kṣiti ādi upādāna gocara tvam vivakṣitam aprasiddheḥ na ca upādāna śabdasya sambandhi śabda tvena ghaṭa kṣiti ādi pada samabhivyavahāre tad tad upādāna bodhaka tvam caitraḥ mātṛ bhaktaḥ maitra vat iti vācyam śābde hi bodhe tathā na ca atra śabdaḥ pramāṇam vādinoḥ anāpta tvāt anumāne tu anugatena vyāpaka tva grahe tena rūpeṇa vyāpaka siddhiḥ tat ca upādāna tvam eva iti katham na artha antaram kiñca evam ghaṭa ādau api tad tad upādāna tvena eva upasthityā sāmānyena rūpeṇa kutra api anupasthiteḥ vyāptiḥ eva na gṛhyeta api ca sāmānya lakṣaṇayā jñāna lakṣaṇayā yoga ja dharma rūpayā pratyāsattyā upādāna gocara aparokṣa jñāna cikīrṣā ākṛtimatā asmāt ādinā siddha sādhanam teṣām kṣiti avyavahita pūrva samaya asattve api tadvatas sattvāt adṛṣṭa dvārā teṣām api janakatva sambhavāt jñāna ādi sākṣāt janya tvasya ca nirasta tvāt

atha yoga ja dharma ajanya sa vikalpakā janya sāmānya lakṣaṇā pratyāsattyajanya janyā upādāna gocara aparokṣa jñāna cikīrṣā ākṛti mada janyam janyam pakṣaḥ yoga ja dharma ājanya sa vikalpakājanya sāmānya lakṣaṇā pratti āsattya janya upādāna gocara jñāna cikīrṣā ākṛtimat janyam iti sādhyam yat vā anāgata gocara sākṣātkāra janaka pratyāsatti ajanya janya jñāna ādi mada janyam janyam anāta gocara sākṣātkāra janaka pratyāsattya janya upādāna gocara aparokṣa jñāna ādi majjanyam iti sādhyam jñāna avyavahita uttara samaya varti i chātada vyavahita uttara samaya varti kṛtīnām janaka tvam vivakṣitam na tu jñāna ādīnām yaugapadyam paurvāparyam vā atas na sādhya aprasiddhiḥ na vā kṣiti ādau bādhaḥ iti

mā evam yoga ja dharma sāmānya jñāna rūpa pratyāsattīnām anāgata gocara sākṣātkārasya tad janaka pratyāsattīnāñca parasya aprasiddha tayā tad ajanyasya sākṣātkārasya aprasiddha tvena pakṣa sādhyayoḥ viśeṣaṇā siddhyā param pratyāśraya asiddheḥ sādhya aprasiddheḥ ca tad siddhau vā pakṣe tad ajanya tva asiddheḥ kṣiti janaka adṛṣṭa janaka kṛti cikīrṣā sākṣātkārāṇām yoga ja dharma ādyajanyānām adṛṣṭa dvārā kṣiti janaka tvena siddha sādhanāt na ca tādṛśa sākṣāt janya tvam vivakṣitam ghaṭa ādi dṛṣṭānte tad asambhavāt dṛṣṭānte ghaṭa ādau janaka iṣṭa sādhana tā jñānasya anumiti tvena janya sa vikalpa kavyāpti graha janya tvena sādhya aprasiddheḥ ca

nanu vyāpti balena sādhyam sidhyati vyāptiḥ ca yatra yatra kārya tvam tatra tad upādāna abhijña janya tvam iti rūpā na tu yat yat kāryam tad tad kiñcid upādāna abhijña janyam iti evañca yatra yatra kārya tvam tatra tad upādāna abhijña janya tvam iti viśiṣya vyāptyā kṣiti ādau kārya tvam kṣiti ādi upādāna abhijña janya tvam eva sādhayati atas na siddha sādhanam iti ced na ghaṭe paṭe ca kāryatvasya vyāpti grahaḥ kim pratyekam ghaṭa upādāna abhijña janya tvena tad tad upādāna abhijña janya tvena upādāna abhijña janya tvena vā ādye ghaṭa upādāna abhijña janya tva ādau kāryatvasya vyabhicāraḥ eva

dvitīye tu ananugata tad tad śabda abhidheya ghaṭa ādi upādāna gata anugata rūpa abhāvāt katham vyāpaka tā grahaḥ tad tad śabdasya svabhāvāt samabhivyāhṛta para tayā na ayam doṣaḥ iti ced na anumāne śabda svabhāva upanyāsasya aprayojaka tvāt atas eva idānīm devadattaḥ bahis asti vidyamāna tve sati gṛha asattvāt vidyamāna tve sati yaḥ yadā yatra na asti sa tadā tad atirikte deśe asti yathā aham eva bahis asan gṛha madhye tiṣṭhāmi iti atra pakṣa dṛṣṭānta sādhāraṇayatva tattvayoḥ anugatayoḥ abhāvāt na anvayī kintu vyatirekī iti uktam tṛtīye siddha sādhanam eva atha sarga ādyakālīnat vi aṇukam jñāna icchā ākṛti samāna kālīna sāmagrī janyam kāryatvāt ghaṭa vat adṛṣṭa sāmagrī janya tve adṛṣṭa tva āpattiḥ iti ced na paramprati sarga ādi asiddheḥ jñāna ādīnām siddhau api dvi aṇukā janaka tvāt udāsīna siddha aprayojaka tvāt ca
