etena sarga ādyakālīnam dvi aṇukam dvi aṇukā samavāyi kāraṇa samāna kālīna kṛti janyam iti nirastam dvi aṇukā samavāyikāraṇa samāna kālīna kṛti tvena gaurava aprayojaka tva abhyām ajanaka tvāt kiñca kārya tvam na tāvat yoga upasthita kṛti arha tvam asiddheḥ na api pūrva kāla asattve sati uttara kāla sambandhi tvam tad tad pūrva kāla tvasya ananugata tvāt sakala pūrva kālasya aprasiddheḥ na api kādācid ka tvam prāc abhāvena anaikāntika tvāt na api prāc abhāva pratiyogi tvam dhvaṃsena anaikāntika tvāt na api sattve sati tattvam sattā jāteḥ paramprati asiddheḥ svarūpa sattvasya ca dhvaṃse api sattvāt

yat tu ayam ghaṭaḥ etad ghaṭa janaka aniti ajñāna cikīrṣā ākṛti atirikta jñāna ādi janyaḥ kāryatvāt paṭa vat ityādi tat na vipakṣe bādhaka abhāvena aprayojaka tvāt anyathā ayam ghaṭaḥ etad ghaṭa janakān iti ādṛṣṭa atirikta adṛṣṭa janyaḥ kārya tvāt apara ghaṭa vat etad sukha duḥkha sākṣātkārau etat janaka anitya sukha dukha atirikta sukha duḥkha sādhyau sukha duḥkha sākṣātkāra tvāt ityādinā nitya dharma adharma sukha duḥkha āśrayasya api siddhi prasaṅgāt ayam ghaṭaḥ sva janaka anitya jñāna ādi atirikta jñānāt yajanyaḥ ghaṭa tvāt apara ghaṭa vat ityādinā sat pratipakṣāt ca

kecid tu dṛśyate tāvat abhimata viṣaya grāhiṇī indriye manaḥ niveśayataḥ puṃsaḥ manaḥ kriyā anukūlaḥ yatnaḥ tathā ca sarga ādyakālīna śarīra janya jñāna dhvaṃsā anādhāra kāla ādhāra jñāna janaka ātma manaḥ yoga janikā manaḥ kriyā tad manaḥ gocara prayatna anādhāra tad manaḥ gocara prayatna tad vyāpya itara sakala kāraṇa ādhāra kāla anantara kāla anādhāra ādya sattākā tat manaḥ kriyā tvāt sammata tanmanaḥ kriyāvat arthāt prayatna ādhāra kāla anantara kāla ādhārā sā kriyā sidhyati iti āhuḥ tat na sarga ādi akāle jñāna jana kamanaḥ saṃyoga janaka kriyāyām māna abhāvaḥ pūrva kriyayā eva saṃyoga sambhavāt īśvara vādinām tad manaḥ gocara prayatna an ādhāraḥ kālaḥ aprasiddhaḥ eva kriyā tvasya eva hetu tve vyartha viśeṣaṇa tvañca kiñca evam prayatna anādhāra kāla anantara kāla anādhāra tvam arthāt tad siddhau māna antarāt īśvara siddhau artha antara tvam iti

atra ucyate adṛṣṭa dvāra kopa ādāna gocara janya kṛtya janyāni samavetāni janyāni adṛṣṭa prāc abhāva vyāpya prāc abhāva apratiyogi upādāna gocara aparokṣa jñāna cikīrṣā ākṛtimat janyāni sva janaka adṛṣṭa uttara upādāna gocara aparokṣa jñāna cikīrṣā ākṛti mat janyāni vā aparokṣa jñāna cikīrṣā prayatna viṣayī bhavat upādānāni vā samaveta tve sati prāc abhāva pratiyogi tvāt yat evam tat evam yathā ghaṭaḥ tathā ca etāni tasmāt tathā ukta pakṣe kasyacid anantarbhāve api tat ādāya tathā eva niruktasya pakṣatu a nirdeśe samūha ālambana rūpā eva anumitiḥ utpadyate na ca janya kṛtya janya tvam tāvat ananugateṣu eka rūpa abhāvena grahītum aśakyam iti vācyam janya kṛtya janya tvam hi janya kṛti janyā anya tvam iti anya tvena rūpeṇa sāmānya lakṣaṇayā tāvatām upasthiteḥ

na ca janya tva viśeṣaṇa vyāvatrtyā aprasiddhiḥ prameyaḥ ghaṭaḥ iti vat avyāvartaka tve api tad uparakta buddheḥ uddeśya tvena tasya uparañjaka tvāt uktāni āma tvam eva sa kartṛka tvam atas eva ghaṭa bhoktā na ghaṭa kartā iti vyavahriyate evañca śabda phūtkāra ādīnām pakṣatā eva jñāna icchā ādīnām api pakṣa tvāt na sandigdha anaikāntika tā upādānasya siddha tve api upādeyasya asiddhatvena tadvat tayā tatra api cikīrṣā yat vā pakṣe hetau ca na samavetat tvam viśeṣaṇam tena dhvaṃsaḥ api pakṣaḥ sādhye ca upādāna padam kāraṇa mātra param anupādeyam eva vā janya icchā kṛtya janya tvañca pakṣe vivakṣitam tena kṛti dhvaṃsasya kṛti janya tve api icchā janya tva abhāvāt pakṣa tvam kṣitiḥ eva vā pakṣaḥ na ca aṅkure sandigdha anaikāntika tvam pakṣapakṣa samanairapekṣyeṇa ghaṭa ādau niścita vyāpteḥ liṅgasya tayoḥ darśanena ubhayatra anumiti avirodhāt na tu anumityoḥ anyaḥ anya apekṣa tvam yena anyonya āśrayaḥ syāt

pratijñāyāḥ aviṣaya tvāt tatra pakṣa sama vyapadeśaḥ na ca aṅkurasya pakṣa tvena anirdeśāt tatra na pakṣa dharma tā jñānam iti vācyam siṣā dhayiṣā viraha saha kṛta sādhaka pramāṇa abhāvavati liṅga jñānasya anumiti mātra kāraṇa tvāt tat ca kṣitau pañca avayavena aṅkure svatas eva iti na kaścid viśeṣaḥ yadi ca kṣitau hetu niścaya daśāyām aṅkurasya hetumat tayā na niścayaḥ tadā kva sandigdha anaikāntika tvam

atha pakṣa same sādhya abhāva sāmānādhikaraṇya saṃśayāt hetau vyāpti grahaḥ eva na utpadyate utpannaḥ api vā bādhyate iti ced tarhi mahān ase api dhūme vyāpti grahaḥ na syāt bhūtaḥ api vā bādhyate sandigdha vahnika parvatā parvata dhūmavatām eka dharma abhāvena apakṣa tvāt tasmāt sādhya sandehavati hetu niścayaḥ na doṣaḥ kintu guṇaḥ eva anyathā anumāna mātram ucchidyeta pakṣāt anyatra tat dūṣaṇam iti yat uktam tatra pakṣa anyatvam siṣā dhayiṣita sādhya anya tvam yadi tadā anapekṣita anumitiḥ na syāt

atha sandigdha sādhya anya tvam sādhaka bādhaka pramāṇa abhāva viṣaya anya tvam vā vivakṣitam tadā aṅkure api tat na asti atha pratijñā viṣaya anyatvam tadā sva artha anum iti ucchedaḥ niyata viṣaya jñāna ajanya tvena pakṣa viśeṣaṇāt sarva viṣaya jñāna siddhiḥ sādhye ca jñāna icchā prayatnānām viśeṣaṇa tvena viśiṣṭa sādhana tvam vivakṣitam tena na tad upalakṣita kṣetrajñena artha antaram sāmānyatas api sādhya nirddeśe pakṣa dharma tā balena abhimata viśeṣa siddhiḥ ca

nanu ādya sādhya dvaye ghaṭa ādi upādāna gocara aparokṣa jñāna cikīrṣā kṛtīnām eva janaka tvam āyātu iti artha antaram na ca teṣām vyabhicārāt kṣiti ādau na kāraṇa tvam iti vācyam anādau pravāhe kasyacid kadācid kṣiti dvi aṇuka ādi pūrvam ghaṭa ādi upādāna gocara jñāna ādi sattvāt na ca sarga ādyakālīnasya api pakṣa tvāt tatra īśvara siddhiḥ paramprati tat asiddheḥ iti ced na jñāna ādīnām trayāṇām sva viṣaya samaveta kāryam pratyeva janakatvā avadhāraṇena etat anumānasya tad aviṣaya tvāt atas eva anya upādāna gocara aparokṣa jñāna ādyajanya tvena pakṣa viśeṣaṇam api na yuktam tṛtīya sādhye tu na artha antaram kṣiti ādeḥ ghaṭa ādi upādāna asamaveta tvāt

nanu sāmānya lakṣaṇa ādi pratyāsattyā kṣiti ādi upādāna gocaram yat pratyakṣam tat janya tvam eva astu tathā ca īśvare na pratyakṣam na vā icchā prayatnau tayoḥ samāna adhikaraṇa jñāna aviṣaye asattvāt na ca tādṛśa pratyāsattya janya tvam pratyakṣa viśeṣaṇam paramprati asiddheḥ iti ced na dravya tvena jñāna lakṣaṇayā vā kapāla gocara pratyakṣe api ghaṭa ādau akartṛka tvāt kṣiti ādau sa kartṛka tva nirvāhakam jñānam sidhya t vilakṣaṇam eva sidhyati na ca avayava vibhāga dvārā kṣiti ādiṣu jala kṣepāt samudra ādiṣu hasta kṣepāt paramāṇu dvaya saṃyoge ca dvaṇukeṣu asmad ādi kartṛka tvāt aṃśataḥ siddha sādhanam iti vācyam tatra hi kṣiti nāśe asmad ādīnām kartṛ tvam na tu khaṇḍa kṣitau avasthita saṃyogebhyaḥ eva tad upapatteḥ sakala tad upādāna gocara jñāna icchā kṛtīnām abhāvāt ca atas eva dvayaṇuke api na kartṛ tvam jala kṣepāt adhika parimāṇaka samudra ādeḥ sa pakṣa tvam eva ghaṭasya iva

nanu ghaṭe sādhya vikala tvam anvaya vyatirekābhyām jñāna ādeḥ eva janakatvāt na tu tad āśrayasya dharmi grāhakasya anvaya vyatirekasya vā grāhakasya abhāvāt na ca ghaṭaḥ ātma janyaḥ utpattimat tvāt jñāna vat iti vācyam ātma samaveta tvasya upādhi tvāt ghaṭaḥ ākāśa janyaḥ utpattimat tvāt śabda vat iti vat aprayojaka tvāt ca iti ced mā evam prayatna vat ātma saṃyogaḥ ceṣṭā dvārā ghaṭa hetuḥ atas prayatna vat ātmā api hetuḥ na ca ātma saṃyoge sati api prayatnam vinā na ceṣṭā iti prayatnaḥ eva tad kāraṇam asamavāyi kāraṇam vinā kārya anutpatteḥ na ca ātma saṃyogasya kāraṇa tve api saṃyoge paricāyaka mātram ātmā iti vācyam saṃyoga mātrasya akāraṇa tvena saṃyogi viśeṣitasya hetu tvāt

ātma saṃyoga vyatireka prayukta kriyā vyatirekasya asiddheḥ na ātma saṃyogaḥ kāraṇam iti ced na yā kriyā vyadhikaraṇayadīya guṇa janyā sā tad saṃyoga asamavāyi kāraṇikā yathā sparśavat vega dravya saṃyoga jā kriyā iti vyāptyā tad siddheḥ na ca kriyāyāḥ mūrta mātra samavetā samavāyikāraṇaka tva niyamaḥ iti vācyam kārya mātra abhiprāyeṇa jñāna ādau vyabhicārāt viśiṣya aprayojaka tvāt asamavāyi kāraṇa saṃyoga āśrayasya tad kārya janaka tva niyamāt ca anye tu anukūla kṛti samavāyi tvam kartṛ tvam na tu janaka tve sati gauravāt kartari kāraka vyapadeśaḥ ca abhiyuktānām sa viśeṣaṇe hi iti nyāyena kṛti paryavasat naḥ eva evam jñāna icchā ākṛti janya tvam eva sādhyam tad āśraya tvam eva īśvarasya kartṛ tvam

atha ghaṭe kṛti sādhya iṣṭa sādhana tā jñānam cikīrṣā dvārāḥ hetuḥ tat ca pratyakṣam cikīrṣā viṣaye anāgate indriya āsannikarṣāt kintu anumiti rūpam tathā ca sādhya vikalaḥ dṛṣṭāntaḥ sādhya aprasiddhiḥ vā doṣaḥ iti ced na siddha vṛtti asiddha viṣayā hi kṛtiḥ siddha viṣaya pratyakṣe sati sambhavati na hi mṛd avayavānām saṃsthāna viśeṣe kṛti sādhya iṣṭa sādhana tā anumitau api avayavasya pratyakṣeṇa upasthitim vinā pravṛttiḥ atas eva yāge śabdāt tad upajī viliṅgāt vā kṛti sādhya iṣṭa sādhana tve avagate api haviḥ ādīnām pratyakṣeṇa anupasthitau na pravṛttiḥ na ca upādāna pratyakṣam pravartaka jñāna upakṣīṇam apratyakṣe paramāṇau tad kriyāyām iṣṭa sādhana tā jñāne api pravṛtti abhāvāt pravṛtti viṣayasya mṛdaṅga ādeḥ pratyakṣa tvāt na śabda phūtkāra ādinā vyabhicāraḥ

na ca abhimata grāhaka indriya saṃyoga artham manasi prayatna janya kriyā darśanāt cavī abhicāraḥ adṛṣṭa saha kṛta tvac indriyeṇa hi manaḥ vaha nāḍīnām upalambhena tad gocara prayatnāt nāḍī kriyā tatas sparśavat vegavat nāḍyā nodanāt manasi kriyā na tu prayatnāt atas eva jala ādi abhyavahāra mala utsarga hetu nāḍī nām anādi abhyāsa vāsanā vaśāt adṛṣṭa saha kṛta tvac indriyeṇa upalambhāt tad gocara prayatnaḥ

nanu evam ghaṭa ādau anumiti janya tva darśanāt īśvare anumitiḥ api siddhyat yathā ca pratyakṣasya indriya janya tve api nityam tat īśvare tathā anumiteḥ liṅga janya tvepi sā tatra nityā eva anityena anādi dvi aṇuka ādi ajananāt iti ced na sukha duḥkha abhāva ādi sādhana tā anumiteḥ hi hetu tvam ghaṭa ādau gṛhītam na ca bhagavati śarīra adṛṣṭa abhāvena sukham asti atas na kṣiti ādau tasya tathā anumitiḥ yathārthā sambhavati na ca tādṛśa anumiteḥ anumiti antarasya vā anumiti tvena ghaṭa ādau pravṛtti viṣaya pratyakṣa vat hetu tvam gṛhītam iti na īśvare anumitiḥ

nanu dveṣa janya kṛti sādhye cikīrṣā virahāt vyabhicāraḥ tad dṛṣṭāntena kṣiti ādau dveṣa sādhya tvāt īśvare dveṣaḥ api bhavet dveṣavataḥ saṃsāri tvena bhagavataḥ api tathā tu āpattiḥ iticed na na hi sarpa ādi dveṣāt eva tad nāśa anukūla vyāpāre kṛtiḥ utpattum arhati prayojanam antareṇa prekṣāvatām duḥkha eka phale kṛteḥ anutpatteḥ kintu duḥkha sādhana dhvaṃsam tad sādhya duḥkha anutpādam vā phalam uddiśya tad sādhana tā jñānāt tathā ceṣṭa sādhana tā jñānāt tatra icchā asti eva iti sā eva kṛti kāraṇam kḷpta tvāt dveṣaḥ tu paramparayā tad upakṣīṇaḥ kutas tarhi dveṣa siddhiḥ śatrum dveṣmi iti abādhita pratyayāt na ca adṛśyasya kartṛḥ anupalabdhi bādhaḥ anupalabdhi mātrasya bādhaka tve atīndriya ucchedāt yogyā anupalabdheḥ ca asiddheḥ paramātmanaḥ ayogya tva niyamāt śaśa śrṛṅga pratibandyā ca na adṛśya mātra nirāsaḥ paramāṇa ādi svīkārāt

na api ayogya kartṛ nirāsaḥ ceṣṭayā jñāna ādimataḥ paramātmanaḥ anumānāt paramprati tasya ayogya tvāt na api śrṛṅge paśutva vat aprayojakam kartuḥ kārya mātre kāraṇatva avadhāraṇāt pratibandi mātrasya ca adūṣaṇa tvāt śaśe paśu tvena ayogya śrṛḍga siddhiḥ kutas na iti ced na artha antara tvāt vipakṣe bādhaka abhāvena vyāpti asiddheḥ śrṛṅga tvasya yogya saṃsthāna viśeṣa vyaḍga tvena ayogyasya virodhena śaṅkitum aśakyatvāt śaśe śrṛṅgasya atyanta abhāvaḥ iti sarveṣām abādhita pratyakṣa bādhita tvāt ca

atha kṛti kāryayoḥ na anvaya vyatirekābhyām vyāpti grahaḥ tvad mate vyāpaka kṛteḥ sattve tad deśe samaye vā kṛti mātra vyatireka anirūpaṇāt nitya kṛteḥ anvayaḥ api na gṛhītaḥ vahni mātra vyatirekaḥ asti gṛhyate ca iti na ca evam ākāśa ātmanoḥ aprasiddhiḥ samavāyi mātrasya vyatireka anirūpaṇena kāryam samavāyi kāraṇa janyam iti vyāpteḥ asiddheḥ iti vācyam samavāyi kāraṇa tva grahe hi tad saṃsarga abhāvaḥ aprayojakaḥ nimitta mātra sādhāraṇa tvāt kintu yat samavāyi tatra kāryam yat na samavāyi tatra na iti anyaḥ anya abhāvam ādāya kāryam samavāyi janyam iti vyāpti graha sambhavāt

samavāyi tvena tayoḥ anyaḥ anya abhāvaḥ asti gṛhyate ca yat vā bhāva kāryam samavetam iti vyāptyā tayoḥ siddhiḥ iti yathā hi yat yat vahneḥ anvaye dhūmaḥ gṛhītaḥ tad tad vyatireke dhūma mātra vyatireka grahāt vahni dhūma mātrayoḥ vyāpti grahaḥ na tu parvatīya vahneḥ anvaya vyatireka grahāt na ca anya anvaya vyatirekābhyām anya vyāpti grahe atiprasaḍgaḥ iti vācyam yat viśeṣayoḥ anvaya vyatireka grahaḥ tad sāmānyayoḥ bādhakam vinā vyāpti grahāt sa ca vahni dhūma vyāpti grahaḥ utpadyamānaḥ sakala dhūma gocaraḥ dhūma tva puraskāreṇa prasiddha dhūma gocaraḥ eva vā bhavati tathā iha api kṛti viśeṣa kārya viśeṣayoḥ anvaya vyatireka grahaḥ bādhakam antareṇa kṛti kārya mātrayoḥ vyāpti grahe upāyaḥ na tu pakṣa dharma tā bala labhya viśeṣa anvaya vyatireka grahaḥ anumāna mātra uccheda prasaṅgāt

etena kāryatvasya vipakṣa vṛtti hataye sambhāvyate atīndriyaḥ kartā ced vyatireka siddhi vidhurā vyāptiḥ katham sidhyati dṛśyaḥ atha vyatireka siddhi manasā kartā samāśrīyate tad tyāge api tadā tṛṇa ādikam iti vyaktam vipakṣa īkṣaṇam iti nirastam nanu yadi kartṛ mātra vyāpti grahāt adṛśya kartṛ siddhiḥ tadā vahni mātra vyāpta dhūmāt adṛśya jāṭharīya vahni siddhiḥ api syāt na syāt adṛśya vahneḥ dhūmān utpatteḥ dṛśyasya eva tatra hetu tvāt nanu jñāna icchā prayatna traya vyatirekāt na kārya vyatirekaḥ kintu ekaika vyatirekāt tathā ca vyartha viśeṣaṇa tvena viśiṣṭa vyatirekaḥ na hetu vyatireka vyāpya iti na hetoḥ viśiṣṭa siddhiḥ sādhya avyāpaka abhāva pratiyoginaḥ eva sādhya gamaka tvāt iti ced na yatas ekaika vyatirekāt kārya vyatirekaḥ atas eva kārya tva ādeḥ ekaikam sidhyat trayam api sidhyati ārthaḥ tu samājaḥ

syāt etat aśarīraḥ nitya jñāna ādimān sarvajñaḥ kartā pakṣe vivakṣitaḥ ghaṭa ādau ca kāryatvasya tad viparīta kartṛ saha cāra darśanāt viśeṣa viruddha tvam iti ced na hetoḥ vivakṣita sādhya viparīta sahacāra mātrasya adūṣaka tvāt anyathā anumāna mātra uccheda prasaṅgāt na ca anitya jñāna asarvajña śarīra kartṛ tvena samam kāryatvasya vyāptiḥ asti yena viparīta sādhane viruddha tvam syāt tādṛśa vyāptiḥ ca tvayā mayā vā na aṅgīkriyate aṅkura ādau yogyā anupalambhena śarīra kartṛkatva abhāvāt

atha yathā darśana bala pravṛtta vyāptyā anitya jñāna ādimān kartā upaneyaḥ pakṣa dharma tayā ca nitya jñāna ādimān tathā copaneya viśeṣayoḥ virodhena vyāpti pakṣa dharma tayoḥ virodhāt paraspara sahakāritā virahān na anumānam viśeṣa virodhāt iti ced na anitya jñāna ādi kartṛ janya tvena vyāpti agrahāt jñāna ādimatkartṛ janya tva vyāpteḥ ca pakṣa dharma tā bala labhya viśeṣa avirodhāt kevalāyāḥ vyāpteḥ pakṣa dharma tāyāḥ ca pṛthak upanāyaka tva abhāvāt ca eka vaiyarthya prasaṅgāt tathā ca nirapekṣa tādaśāyām viśeṣa anupasthānāt eva na virodha jñānam sa apekṣatā daśa āyāntu saha upalambhāt eva virodha pratiyoginoḥ siddhi asiddhibhyām virodha jñāna abhāvāt ca liṅga viśeṣeṇa sādhya viśeṣeṇa virodhe ca viśeṣa virodhaḥ yathā candana prabhava vahnimānayam asurabhi dhūmavat tvāt iti

nanu jñāna tva nitya tvayoḥ kartṛ tva aśarīri tvayoḥ ca paraspara viruddha tvena eka dharmya samāveśāt katham nitya jñāna ādi kartṛ siddhiḥ iti ced na upasaṃhāra sthānasya abhāvāt tathā hi īśvare tad buddhau ca aśarīra tva kartṛ tve buddhi tva nitya tve ca upasaṃhriyamāṇe viruddhe na tu sva āśraya sthite ubhaya uccheda prasaṅgāt na ca īśvaraḥ tad buddhiḥ vā upasthitā upasthitau vā dharma grāhaka mānena tayoḥ virodha apahārāt anupasthite ca tad dvaye virodha jñānam akiñcatkaram eva asmad ādi buddhau vyoma ādau kuvinde mukta ātmani ca upasthite virodha upasaṃhārāt buddhi tva nitya tvayoḥ kartṛ tva aśarīra tvayoḥ anadhigame api īśvare aśarīra kartṛ tva nitya jñāna ādi siddhiḥ apratyūha eva atas eva nitya tva avayavatyoḥ virodha jñānam akiñcitkaram eva iti paramāṇu siddhiḥ īśvara tad buddhi ādi kantarkitam iti ced na tarkasya prasañjanasya saṃśayasya ca ajñāte asambhavāt

syāt etat ghaṭa ādau kṛti sādhya tā hasta ādi vyāpāra dvārā eva gṛhītā na tu sākṣāt na ca pitāputrayoḥ eka ghaṭa sādhana tvam iva prayatna hasta ādi vyāpārayoḥ sākṣāt sādhana tvam vācyam iti vācyam ghaṭa artham hasta vyāpāra vat kulāla samīpa sthasya hasta ādi vyāpāra śūnyasya tad ghaṭa kartṛ tva āpatteḥ na ca hasta ādi vyāpāravat tā aśarīrasya sambhavati anyādṛśī ca kṛti sādhyatā na dṛṣṭā śarīra tad vyāpārau ca aṅkure bādhitau iti kartuḥ api bādhaḥ eva anyathā tvad anumānāt eva kṣetrajñaḥ eva kartā anumīyate buddhi ādimat para ātmanaḥ yogyā anupalabdhi bādha abhāvāt śarīra vyāpāra dvārā eva kṣetrajñasya hetu tvāt śarīra vyāpārasya ca aṅkure bādhāt sa bādhitaḥ iti ced tarhi kartṛ mātrasya api tad dvārā eva ceṣṭa itara kārye kartṛ tva ādhāraṇat tad bādhe kartṛ mātra bādhaḥ api evañca kṛti sādhya tve śarīra vyāpāra janya tvam prayojakam iti saḥ eva upādhiḥ evam jñāna icchayoḥ api icchā ākṛti dvārā janaka tvam iti katham dvāram vinā kṣiti ādau janakatvam iti

ucyate janya mātre hasta ādi vyāpāra janaka kṛti tvena na janaka tvam ceṣṭāyām kṛtyā ādau ca vyabhicārāt kintu ghaṭa ādau ca tathā janaka tvam iti janya mātre kṛti mātrasya janakatva virodhi viśeṣayoḥ janya janaka bhāve bādhakam vinā sāmānyayoḥ api tathā abhāva niyamāt na hi viśeṣe viśeṣa prayojaka tvena sāmānya prayojaka tva virodhaḥ ceṣṭa itara kārye śarīra vyāpāra dvārā eva kṛteḥ hetu tvāt tena vinā kṣiti ādau na kṛti sādhya tvam iti ced na ceṣṭa itara kārya mātre śarīra vyāpāra janaka kṛti tvena na janaka tvam kṣiti ādau vyabhicārāt kintu tad viśeṣa ghaṭa ādau iti ukta tvāt

na ca evam āma vāta jaḍīkṛta kalevarasya prayatnāt eva ghaṭotpattiḥ syāt hasta ādi vyāpāram vinā eva kṛrteḥ hetu tvāt iti vācyam ghaṭe kṛti vat hasta ādi vyāpārasya api hetu tvāt yat uktam kṣetrajñaḥ eva kutas na anumīyate iti tatra hasta ādi vyāpāra kṛtimān yadi kṣetrajñaḥ abhimataḥ tadā hasta ādi vyāpāra kṛtimān kṣetrajñaḥ abhimataḥ tadā hasta ādi vyāpārasya aṅkure yogyā anupalabdhi bādhāt

atha hasta ādi vyāpāra rahita kṛtimān abhimataḥ tat om iti ucyate saḥ eva bhagavān īśvaraḥ atas eva sahabhāva nirūpaka tve niyata pūrva varti tvam kāraṇa tvam samavāyi asamavāyinoḥ tathā tvena nimitte api tathā abhāvāt anyathā pratibandhaka abhāva anantaram pratibandhaka sattva kāle kāryam syāt pratibandhaka abhāvasya pūrvam sattvāt na ca kṛteḥ sahabhāva nirūpaka tvam svatas kārya samaye abhāvāt tathā ca tad paricāyita vyāpāra dvārā tasyāḥ sahabhāva nirupaka tvam atas śarīra vyāpāra dvārā eva kṛteḥ janaka tvam na kevalāyāḥ iti apāstam

samavāyi asamavāyi pratibandhaka abhāvānām avinaśyat avastha tvena kāraṇa tvāt tathā eva anvaya vyatirekāt tena teṣām abhāve vinā śa kṣaṇe ca na kāryam anyathā prativyakti kārya sahabhāva nirūpaṇe kāryet patteḥ prāk sahabhāvasya nirūpayitum aśakyatvāt kāraṇa tva aniścayena kvāpi pravṛttiḥ na syāt iti tad jātīya tvasya avaśya vācya tve vinaśyat avastham katham saha bhāvena api vyavacchedyam atas sva rūpa yogya tā rūpā kāraṇa tā tatra api kārya abhāvaḥ tu sahakāri virahāt anyathā nimittānām pratyekam kārya sahabhāva nirūpaka tvena janaka tve gauravam prāgabhāvasya pratiyogi ajanaka tva prasaṅgāt ca anyathā utpannaḥ api ghaṭaḥ punar utpadyeta sāmagrī sattvāt

na ca saḥ eva tatra pratibandhakaḥ abhāva antarasya tatra akāraṇa tvena kāraṇībhūta abhāva pratiyogi tva rūpasya pratibandhaka tvasya prāgabhāva kāraṇa tvaḥ eva viśrāmāt na ca ekā sāmagrī ekadā ekam eva kāryam janayati svabhāvāt iti vācyam sāmagrī tat virahasya kārya tad abhāva prayojaka tvena sāmagryām satyām kāryasya tad abhāve kārya abhāvasya vajralepāyita tvāt

syāt etat kartā śarīryeva jñānam anityam eva buddhiḥ icchā dvāra eva icchā kṛti dvārā eva hetuḥ iti ādi prāthamika vyāpti pratyakṣa virodhāt na aśarīra nitya jñāna ādi kartṛ siddhiḥ atas eva śarīram anityam eva iti niyamāt na kartṛ tvena nitya atīndriya śarīra siddhiḥ īśvare na ca aprayojaka tvam nirupādhi tvena śaṅkā kalaṅkān avatārāt kāryatva sa kartṛka tvayoḥ api yadi nirupādhi tvam asti tadā api tulya bala tvena sat pratipakṣāt tad pratibandhoḥ tu na ca kārya tvam pakṣa dharma tā balāt balīyaḥ kartā śarīryā iva ityādau tu tat na asti iti vācyam jñānam anityam iti vyāpteḥ eva kṣiti ādau jñāna janya tva virodhi tvāt

evam kāryam jñāna janyam jñānam anityam eva iti anayoḥ virodhaḥ eva avirodhe tu dvayam api syāt tathā ca kṣiti ādau śarīrarya nitya jñāna paryavasāne virodhaḥ eva syāt kiñca jñānam anityam eva ityādau nitya jñāna ādeḥ aprasiddheḥ tad avyāvartaka tayā na upādhi tva niścayaḥ tad saṃśayaḥ vā kāryatva sa kartṛka tva vyāpti graha daśāyām śarīra vyāpāra avi abhicārāt upādheḥ niścayaḥ saṃśayaḥ vā asti iti tat na jñānam anityam eva ityādi vyāpteḥ asiddheḥ vipakṣa bādhaka abhāvena aprayojaka tvāt nirupādhi sahacāra darśana vyabhicāra adarśanāt eva vyāpti grahaḥ nirupādhi tvena vā vipakṣe bādhakam iti ced na avayavaḥ mahān eva tejaḥ udbhūta rūpam eva ityādi vyāpti grahāt parama aṇu nayana ādeḥ asiddhi prasaṅgāt

atha dravya cākṣuṣe aneka dravyavat tvasya sākṣātkāre viṣaya indri sannikarṣasya hetu tvāt tad mūlaka vipakṣa bādhakena paramāṇu ādi sādhakasya balavat tvāt paramāṇu ādi siddhau virodhi vyāpteḥ bādhaḥ na tu vaiparītyam vipakṣe bādhaka abhāvena tasya abalavat tvāt iti manyase tarhi jñāna ādi kārya kāraṇa bhāva avadhāraṇāt tad mūlaka vipakṣa bādhakena niṣkalaṅka vyāpti grahāt pakṣa dharma tā graha sahitān nitya jñāna ādi siddhau vyabhicārāt na vyāptiḥ anyathā sādhyam pakṣa atiriktaḥ eva ityādi nirupādhi sahacārāt vyāpti grahe sakala anumāna ucchedaḥ

vayantu brūmaḥ pakṣa dharma tā balāt nityam jñānam siddhyat buddhiḥ anityaiḥ eva iti vyāpti pratyakṣeṇa na pratibadhyate asmadā api buddhi viṣayaka tvena bhinna viṣayaka tvāt eka viṣaya virodhi jñānasya eva pratibandhaka tvāt nitya tva anitya tvayoḥ eka jātīye dravye avirodhāt buddhi mātre anitya tva avagamāt katham tad viśeṣe nitya tva buddhiḥ iti ced na buddhi mātrasya īśvarāni īśvara buddhi paratve virodhāt vyabhicārāt ca asmad ādi buddhi paratve ca bhinna viṣaya tvena apratibandhaka tvāt buddhi tvam nitya āvṛttyā iva iti avagatam atas katham tatra nitya vṛtti tva avagamaḥ iti ced na ubhaya siddha nitya avṛtti tva avagame api atirikta nitya vṛtti tva avagatau virodha abhāvāt buddhi tvam anitya tva vyāpyam avagatam na anitya tva abhāvavati jñātavyam iti ced na anitya tva vyāpya tvam anitya mātra vṛtti tvam tatra ca uktam eva etena kartā śarīryā iva ityādi api jñānam pratibandhakam iti nirastam

nanu kartṛ janya tve janya tvam na avacchedakam kintu ghaṭa tva ādikam eva tena eva rūpeṇa anvaya vyatireka grahāt āvaśyaka tvāt ca ananugatam api janya tā avacchedakam vahni janyatāyām dhūma tva ādi vat atha ghaṭa tva ādi vat janya tvam avacchedakam na hi viśeṣaḥ asti iti sāmānyam aprayojakam tathā ca vahni janya tve dhūma viśeṣaḥ prayojyaḥ asti iti na dhūma sāmānyam agnim gamayet tasmāt yat viśeṣayoḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ tad sāmānyayoḥ api bādhakam vinā tathā tva niyamaḥ iti ced na

tatra bādhaka abhāvāt atra ca jñānam anityam eva ityādi prāthamika bahu vyāptau bādhāt tulya tve vā vyāpti saṃśaya ādhāyaka tvāt na ca kārya kāraṇa bhāva mūlaka tvena kāryatva sakṛrtṛka tva vyāptiḥ balīyasi iti vācyam virodhi pratyakṣeṇa kārya kāraṇa bhāvasya eva asiddheḥ etena dhūma ādau vahni janya tāvacchedakam anugatam na sambhavati iha tu janya tvam anugatam asti atas bādhakam vinā na mucyate iti nirastam jñānam anityam eva ityādi sahacāra avasāyasya bādhakam vinā pakṣa dharma vyāpti paryavasāyi tvena bādhaka tvāt iti

mā evam nirupādhi tvena sahacāra avasāyasya sādhakam bādha kañca vinā sādhāraṇyena vyāpti saṃśaya ādhāyaka tvāt anyathā sādhyam pakṣa atirikte eva sukham duḥkha sambhinnam eva ityādi vyāpti grahasya kārya kāraṇa bhāva grāhaka bādhaka tve tad saṃśaya ādhāyaka tve vā kāryāt kāraṇa anumāna ucchede nirīham jagat jāyeta tasmāt yat viśeṣayoḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ tad sāmānyayoḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ balavatā bādhakena apanīyate na ca atra tat asti virodhi vyāpti sādhakasya vipakṣa bādhakasya abhāvāt

navyāḥ tu kāryam kartṛ janyam iti vyāptitaḥ aśarīra nitya jñāna kartaka rtrupasthitau jñānam anityam eva iti anena virodha pratisandhānam na tu tām vinā pratiyogi anupasthitau virodha anirūpaṇāt tathā ca upajīvya bādhāt jñānam anityam eva iti vyāpti jñānam akiñcitkaram eva atas eva pakṣa dharma tā vinākṛtam virodhi vyāpti jñānam na hetvābhāsa tayā uktam virodha pratiyogi siddhi asiddhi parāhata tvāt iti

syāt etat astu śarīra janya tvam upādhiḥ na ca pakṣa itara tva vat pakṣa mātra vyāvartaka viśeṣaṇavat tvāt sādhana viśeṣita tvāt sādhana tulya yogakṣema tvena sādhya vyāpaka tva aniścayāt ca na upādhi tvam iti vācyam ceṣṭa itara kāryeṣu śarīra vyāpāra dvārā eva kartuḥ kāraṇa tvāt śarīra saha kṛtasya eva sva kārye kāraṇa tvāt ca na hi śarīra vinākṛtaḥ kartā śarīra kriyām ceṣṭām ghaṭa ādikam vā janayati na ca yat saha kṛtam yat janakam tena vinā tad janakam atas arthāt śarīra janyam eva kartṛ janyam iti sādhya vyāpaka tva niścayāt pakṣa itara tva ādau ca vipakṣa bādhaka abhāvāt na sādhya vyāpaka tā niścayaḥ iti teṣām anupādhi tve bījam atas eva bādha unnītam vahni itara tvam vahnimat tvena dhūmavat tve sādhye ārdra indhana prabhava vahnimat tvam rasavat tvena gandhavat tve sādhye pṛthivī tvam upādhiḥ vipakṣa bādhakaiḥ teṣām sādhya vyāpaka tva niścayāt

na ca sādhana viśeṣita tvam api janya tvam hi prāc abhāva pratiyogi tvam śarīra janya tvañca śarīra kāraṇava tvam anyā nirakteḥ itara pada samabhivyāhāreṇa janya padāditara kāraṇakasya eva pratīteḥ tad arthaka tva kalpanāt iti vidhau vakṣyate atas eva śarīra kartṛka tvam upādhiḥ śarīra saha kṛtasya eva kartuḥ kāraṇa tvāt vyāpyam vyāpaka koṭau aniveśyataḥ eva pramāṇasya vyāpti grāhaka tvāt śarīra kartṛka tva sa kartṛka tvayoḥ na vyāpti grahaḥ iti ced na viśiṣṭa aviśaṣṭa bhedena vyāpya vyāpaka bhāva avirodhāt atas eva janya tvena kāraṇa janya tvam anumīyate iti

mā evam kartuḥ hi śarīra sahakāritā kim ghaṭa ādau kartavye kārya mātre vā sva kārye vā ādye kartā śarīram vinā ghaṭa ādikam na karoti iti kim āyātam kartuḥ kārya mātra karaṇe dvitīye ca kārya mātram kartṛ janyam iti na tvayā svīkriyate svīkāre vā śarīra ajanyam api kāryam kartṛ janyam iti sādhya avyāpaka tvam tṛtīye tu sva janya tvam na sva janya tāvacchedakam ātma āśrayāt tathā api yaca sa kartṛka tvam asti tatra śarīra janya tvam āvaśyakam iti tasya sādhya vyāpaka tvam tulya yogakṣema tvena hetu vyāpya tā saṃśaya ādhāyaka tvena sandigdha upādhi tvam vā iti ced na

lāghavena bādhakam vinā kartṛ janya tve sati janya tvam avacchedakam na tu śarīra janya tvam gauravāt tathā ca śarīra janya tvam na sa kartṛka tva vyāpakam ghaṭa ādau tvā arthaḥ samājaḥ ghaṭa tvena śarīra janya tu a niyamāt na tu vyāpka tva prayuktaḥ māna abhāvāt śarīra janya tvam na sa kartṛka tva vyāpakam tad vyāpya jala tva avyāpaka tvāt nitya tva vat iti bādhakāt hasta ādinā pi kartṛ tva nirvāheṇa śarīrasya aprayojaka tvāt sākṣāt prayatna adhiṣṭeya janya tvasya sādhana vyāpaka tvāt ca śarīra kartṛka tvam api na upādhiḥ janya mātre kartuḥ śarīra sahakāritā virahāt

atha yad viśeṣayoḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ tad sāmānyayoḥ api bādhakam vinā tathā niyamaḥ iti tvayā niraṭaṅki tathā ca kartṛ viśeṣa śarīra janya viśeṣayoḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāva niyamāt kartṛ mātra śarīra janya mātrayoḥ api tathā abhāvaḥ tathā ca śarīra janya tvam kartṛ janya tāvat śejakam iti bhavati upādhiḥ na ca evam ghaṭa tva vat śarīra janya tvam sa kartṛkatva vyāpyam na tu vyāpakam api iti vācyam ubhaya siddha sakala sa kartṛka vṛtti tvena sādhya vyāpaka tā nirṇayāt janya tve api sa kartṛkatva vyāpya tva grāhakam asti iti ced tarhi ubhayatra vyāpti grāhaka sāmye vinigamaka abhāvāt vyāpti saṃśaya ādhāyaka tvena sandigdha upādhiḥ vyāpya tva asiddhiḥ vā hetu vyāpya tā saṃśaya ādhāyakaḥ eva hi sandigdha upādhiḥ sa ca sādhya vyāpaka tve sādhana avyāpka tve vā ubhayatra vā saṃśayāt

na ca vācyam śarīra janya tvasa kartṛka tvayoḥ anvaya vyatireka jñāne janya tvasa kartṛka tvayoḥ tat grahaḥ āvaśyakaḥ iti lāghavāt tayoḥ eva vyāpti grahaḥ na tu upādhi sādhyayoḥ hetu sādhyayoḥ anvayavyatiḥ eka jñānañca śarīra janya tvānavagame api bhavati iti vinigamakam iti yatas na kartṛ mātra janyam ācayoḥ anvaya vyatirekābhyām vyāpti grahaḥ kartṛ mātrasya vyatireka abhāvāt kintu viśeṣayoḥ anvaya vyatirekeṇa kārya kāraṇa bhāvena vā sāmānyayoḥ tathā tva grahaḥ tau ca tulyau eva iti ced

ucyate astu tāvat ghaṭa tva vat janya tva śarīra janya tvayoḥ api kartṛ janya tāvat chedaka tvena sa kartṛkatva vyāpya tvam grāhaka taulyāt vinigamana abhāvāt virodha abhāvāt ca sa kartṛka tva vyāpakatvantu śarīra janya tvasya kutas ghaṭa tva vat avyāpakasya api janya tā avat chedaka tvāt ubhaya siddha sakartṛke anvaya vyatirekābhyām śarīra janya tvasi avyāpaka tva grahaḥ iti ced na śarīra janya tva vinivedya tvena tulya nyāyena ca prathamam kartṛ janya tve janya tvam avacchedakam kḷptam iti tad virodhena śarīra janya tu asya sa kṛrtṛka tva vyāpaka tvān avagamāt atas eva na sandigdha upādhi tvam

nanu ghaṭa ādau śarīra janya tve kartṛ janya tvam anugatam avacchedakam bādhaka abhāvāt na ca lāghavāt ghaṭa tva ādikam eva tathā kartṛ janya tve api janya tvasya ātathā tva āpatteḥ evam śarīra janya tvasya vyāpyam sa kṛrtaka tvam vahneḥ dhūmā eva iti bhavati upādhiḥ kiñca kartṛ janya tve janya tvam śarīra janya tve vā sa kartṛka tvam avacchedakam iti saṃśaye api na hetoḥ sādhya vyāpya tva niścayaḥ iti ced tarhi ghaṭa ādau kartṛ janya tve gṛhīte tasya śarīra janya tva avacchedaka tvam grahītavyam ghaṭe ca ghaṭa tva vat janya tvam api bādhakam vinā kartṛ janya tāvacśedakam gṛhītam atas janya mātre kartṛ janya tvāt na śarīra janya tve tad avacchedaka tvam prathama gṛhīta upajīvya virodhāt atas eva na tasya hetau vyāpti saṃśaya ādhāyaka tvam api

etena anaṇu tva kṣiti avayava vṛtti anyatva ādayaḥ upādhi tvena nirastāḥ janya tvasya sādhya vyāpya tvena teṣām sādhya avyāpaka tvāt tathā api kṣiti ādikam na kartṛ janyam śarīra ajanya tvāt gagana vat iti sat pratipakṣaḥ astu iti ced na asya prasiddha kartṛ janya tva abhāva viṣayaka tvāt apratīta pratiyogikasya abhāvasya nirūpayitum aśakyatvāt sthāpana anumānañca pakṣa dharma tā balāt prasiddha kartṛ bhinna kartṛka tva sādhakam atas bhinna viṣayaka tvāt na pratibadhya pratibandhaka bhāvaḥ atas eva tad vyāpaka rahita tva ādikam abhāva sādhakam bādhakam apāstam tasya prasiddha abhāva viṣayaka tvena aprasiddha abhāva viṣayaka tvāt vyakti sādhakasya ca viśeṣataḥ aprasiddha vyakti sādhaka tva niyamāt anyathā anumāna vaiyarthyāt

kartṛ janya tvam anugatam ghaṭa ādau prasiddham yat sādhyam tad abhāvaḥ mayā sādhyate iti ced kartṛ janya tvam anugatam api pakṣa dharma tā balena aprasiddham kartāram adāya paryavasyati tad abhāvaḥ tu prasiddhasya kartuḥ abhāvam ādāya siddhyati na aprasiddhasya anugatasya api kartṛ janya tvasya tad abhāvasya ca kartṛ vyakti ghaṭita tvāt anyathā vyakti tad abhāva asiddhi prasaṅgāt na ca evam sat pratipakṣa uccheda prasaḍgaḥ tasya go tva ādi eka bhāva abhāva sādhaka viṣaya tvāt

etena jñāna tvam na nitya vṛtti jñāna mātra vṛtti jāti tvāt smṛti tva vat jñānam na nitya guṇa vṛtti guṇa tva vyāpya jāti yogi cetana viśeṣa guṇa tvāt sukha vat ātmā na nitya viśeṣa guṇa ādhāra vṛtti dravya tva apara jātimān vibhu tvāt gagana vat iti ādi apāstam prasiddhe nitye vyoma ādau prasiddhāyāḥ ca rūpa tva jala tva ādi jāteḥ vyatireka viṣaya tvāt aprayojaka tvāt ca

kiñca kṣiti ādau śarīra ajanya tvam asiddham adṛṣṭa dvārā tad janya tvāt na ca adṛṣṭa advāraka janya jñāna ajanya tvam hetuḥ jñāne janya tva viśeṣaṇasya avyāvartaka tvena vyartha tvāt na ca sthāpanāyām pakṣa viśeṣaṇe api ayam doṣaḥ prameyaḥ ghaṭaḥ iti vat tad uparakta buddheḥ uddeśya tvāt api ca śarīrājanya tve vyartha viśeṣaṇa tvam lāghavena ajanya tvasya eva vyāpta tvāt na ca niṣprayojana viśeṣaṇavat tvam asiddham vyāpti graha upayukta viśeṣaṇa vat pakṣa dharma tā aupayika viśeṣaṇasya api sa prayojana tvāt vyabhicāra vārakasya api sārthaka tve anumiti prayojaka tvasya eva bīja tvāt vyabhicāra vāraka viśeṣaṇavati ā iva vyāpti grahaḥ iti ced na nirviśeṣaṇe api go tva ādau vyāpti grahāt tatra api vyakti viśiṣṭe vyāpti grahaḥ iti ced na svatas vyāvṛtta go tvasya vyabhicārāt anyathā anyonya āśrayāt api ca vyabhicāra vāraka viśeṣaṇavati ā iva vyāpti grahaḥ iti aprayojakam sahacāra darśana ādi sattve tad abhāvena vyāpti graha avilambāt vyabhicārauvāraka viśeṣaṇa śūnyaḥ eva vyāpti grahaḥ iti ced na prameya tvena jñāyamāne dhūme vyāpti grahāt

atha tatra upātta vyabhicārāvāraka viśeṣaṇa śūnya tvam vivakṣitam na ca tatra prameya tvam viśeṣaṇam upāttam iti ced na virodhāt na hi tatra upāttam tena śūnyañca iti sambhavati yat viṣayaka tvena parāmarśaḥ kāraṇam anumitau tad liṣ gam prakṛte ca vyabhicārāt anyathā siddheḥ ca na viśeṣaṇa viṣayaka tvena tattvam iti ced na dhūmasya avyāpya tva āpatteḥ vyabhicārāt tad viṣaya tvena anumiti akāraṇa tvāt atha ekam avacchedakam aparatra vyāptiḥ yat vā lāghavena vyāsa jya vṛttiḥ ekā eva vyāptiḥ iti viśiṣṭa vyāpti arthaḥ tatra viśeṣya tāvacchedakasya vyāpti anavacchedaka tvena viśeṣaṇasya tad avacchedaka tvam iti niyamāt eka vṛtti tva bādhe sati eva vyāsajya vṛtti tvam iti vyāpteḥ ca na śarīra janya tva abhāve nīladhūma ādau ca vyāptiḥ iti viśeṣa mātre sā tathā ca svarūpa asiddhiḥ tad vāraṇa artham viśeṣaṇa abhidhāne vyāpya tva asiddhiḥ iti ced na avyabhicārasya anaupādhika tvasya vā viśiṣṭe nīladhūma ādau sattvena tad vyatireka sādhane bādhāt na ca viśeṣya tvam upādhiḥ sādhana vyāpaka tvāt

kañca saurabha viśeṣa vat dhūma rahitam idam candana prabhava vahni rahita tvāt nirdhūmaḥ ayam ārdra indhana prabhava vahni rahita tvāt iti ādau api kāraṇa viśeṣa abhāvena kārya viśeṣa abhāva anumānam na syāt vahnirahita tva ādi kañca upādhiḥ bhavet vyatirekiṇī aṣṭa dravya atirikta dravyān āśrita tvañca hetu abhāva vyāpyam na syāt dravya an āśrita tvasya eva vyāpya tvāt rūpa ādiṣu madhye gandhasya eva vyañcaka tvāt ityādau tvayā api asiddhi vāraka viśeṣaṇa svīkārāt ca api ca gauraveṇa viśiṣṭasya vyāpaka tā api na syāt tathā ca sthāpana anumāne upādāna gocara aparokṣa jñāna cikīrṣā ākṛti mat janyatā dhūmena ārdra indhana prabhava vahniḥ ghaṭa tvena śarīra janya tva ādikam na anumīyeta

yat tu janyā anyaḥ anya abhāva apekṣayā śarīra janyā anyonya abhāvasya alpa tvāt teṣām eva vyāpya tvam iti viparītam eva lāghavam iti tat na virodha abhāvena bahūnām alpasya ca vyāpya tvāt snehe śīta sparśavatu a jala tvayoḥ gandha abhāve apṛthivī tva pṛthivī tva abhāvayoḥ iva anyathā nīladhūmasya eva vyāpya tve dhūma mātrasya avyāpya tva prasaḍgaḥ kiñca tu ad naye vahni anyonya abhāva apekṣayā janya tva atyanta abhāvasya eva vyāpya tā syāt eka tvāt prameya tva ādi ananta dharma viśiṣṭasya vyāptau api prayojana abhāvāt na anumāne tad upanyāsaḥ

atha lāghavena janya tvasya śīghra upasthitika tayā janyatā bhāva tvena śīghram vyāpti grahaḥ na tu śarīra janyā bhāva tvena vilambita pratītika tvāt yatra viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya anyatara abhāvavati sādhyam tatra viśiṣṭa abhāvasya api vyāptiḥ iti ced na evam sati utpattimat tve sati sattva ādikam anitya tva sa kartṛka tva vyāpya tayā na gṛhyeta śīghra upasthitika tayā ghaṭa tva ādeḥ eva tathātvāt yadi ca sāmānya viśeṣa abhāvāt virodha abhāvena ubhayasya api vyāpya tā tadā śarīra ajanya tva janya tva abhāvayoḥ api tulyam kiñca śarīra janya tvam viśiṣṭa tad abhāvam api viśinaṣṭi na tu sākṣāt tathā ca śarīra janya tva abhāvaḥ akhaṇḍaḥ eva hetuḥ atas na vyartha viśeṣaṇa tā na ca atra viśiṣṭa abhāvaḥ viśeṣya abhāvaḥ eva kṣiti ādau ajanyata āpatteḥ atas eva sthāpanāyām śarīra janya tvam upādhiḥ sādhya abhāva vyāpya abhāva pratiyogi tvena sādhya vyāpaka tva niyamāt vyartha viśeṣaṇe adhikam nigraha sthānam iti ced na hetu dvaya upanyāse hi adhikam iha tu viśiṣṭam ekam eva hetuḥ iti viruddha sthale uktam iti

ucyate nīladhūma ādau vyāptiḥ asti eva anyathā viśeṣāṇām avyāpya tve nirāśrayā vyāptiḥ syāt nīla tvam api na vyāpya tāvacchedakam gauravāt kintu dhūma tvam eva daṇḍa tvena kāraṇa tve rūpam iva dhūma tvañca na nīlimni kintu tad āśraye dhūmaḥ iti na nīladhūmasya hetu tvam nīladhūme nīlasya viśeṣaṇa tve tad viśiṣṭe na dhūma tvam upalakṣaṇa tve ca dhūmāt eva anumitiḥ kiñca vyāpya tāvacchedakasya eva hetu tāvat chedaka tvam iti na nīladhūma tvam tathā na ca evam dhūma tvasya avacchedaka tve api sāmagrī sattvāt nīladhūmāt anum iti utpattau hetvābhāsa tvam na syāt anumiti pratibandhakasya tattvāt iti vācyam tad abhāve api nīla dhūma prayukta sādhya vat pratyayasya bhrama tvena tad kāraṇa tvasya ābhāsa tva sambhavāt iti diś evam śarīra janya tve api na śarīram avacchedakam gauravāt yena viśeṣaṇena vinā vyāptiḥ na gṛhyate tasya eva vyāpya tāvacchedaka tva niyamāt

atas eva gandhasya eva vyañjaka tvāt iti atra aprasiddha tvena rūpa ādiṣu madhye iti viśeṣaṇam vinā vyāptiḥ grahītum na śakyate iti asiddhivārakam api viśeṣaṇam sārthakam eva surabhi dhūma viśeṣa ādau ca candana prabhava agni ādeḥ kāraṇa tvāt kāraṇa abhāvasya kārya abhāva prayojaka tayā vyāpya tva niścayaḥ vyāpake ca na vyartha viśeṣaṇa tā viśiṣṭasya kāraṇa tvena vyāpaka tvāt pariśeṣa vyatirekiṇi vipakṣa bādhakena ananya gatika tayā viśiṣṭasya vyāpaka tvāt viśiṣṭa abhāvasya hetu abhāva vyāpya tvam yatra ca vipakṣa bādhakam na asti tatra viśiṣṭasya vyāpaka tā api na yathā kāryasyat vi kartṛka tvena api śarīra janya tva abhāvaḥ akhaṇḍaḥ hetuḥ

yadi hi śarīra janya tvam sa kṛrtṛkatva prayojakam syāt tadā tad abhāva prayuktaḥ sa kartṛka tva abhāvaḥ iti tasya sādhya vyāpyatā syāt na ca evam kintu janya tvam lāghavāt tathā tathā aca ajanya tvam eva upādhiḥ sādhya vyāpya abhāvaḥ sādhya abhāva vyāpakaḥ iti niyamena tasya sādhya vyāpaka tā niścayāt sa kartṛka tva śarīra janya tvayoḥ vyāpti abhāvena tad abhāvayoḥ api vyāpti abhāvaḥ iti vyāpya tva asiddha tvāt ca atas eva śarīra janya tva abhāvasya akartṛka tva vyāpya tvāt tad abhāvayoḥ api vyāpya vyāpaka bhāvaḥ iti nirastam śarīra janya tvasya sa kartṛkatva aprayojaka tvāt na ca akartṛka tvam pūrva sādhana vyatireka tvena na upādhiḥ

sat pratipakṣa uccheda prasaṅgāt iti vācyam sthāpanāyāḥ yatra ābhāsa tvam tatra viśeṣa adarśana daśāyām sat pratipakṣe pūrva sādhana vyatirekasya sādhya avyāpaka tvena anupādhika tvāt yathā śabdaḥ anityaḥ guṇa tvāt iti atra śabdaḥ nityaḥ vyoma eka guṇa tvāt iti anena sat pratipakṣe guṇa tva abhāvaḥ na upādhiḥ jala paramāṇu rūpe sādhya avyāpaka tvāt na ca evam anaikāntika tvam eva tatra udbhāvyam sat pratipakṣam upekṣya tasya udbhāvanā anarha tvāt kiñca prāc abhāva pratiyogi tve sati samaveta tvasya tad pratiyogi tve sati sattvasya sattve sati utpattimat tvasya vā hetu tve eṣām anyatama vyatirekaḥ upādhiḥ iti na pūrva sādhana vyatirekaḥ atas eva ajanya tvasya na upādhi tvam dhvaṃse sādhya avyāpaka tvāt iti na doṣaḥ

anye tu yat niṣṭhā yat nirūpitā ca vyāptiḥ yena viśeṣaṇena vinā na gṛhyate tatra viśiṣṭam vyāpya tāvacchedakam akartṛka tva nirūpita abhāva niṣṭha vyāptau ca śarīram vinā eva pratiyogi tayā janya tvam avacchedakam kḷptam iti na śarīra janya tvam avacchedakam dhūme nīladhūma tvam iva ati gauraveṇa śarīra janya tvam apratiyogi tayā ca janya tvam na avacchedakam iti vyāpya tāvacchedaka abhāvāt na śarīra janya tva abhāvaḥ akartṛka tva vyāpyaḥ vyabhicāra abhāvāt tathā iti ced na kṣiti ādau eva vyabhicārāt anyathā kṣiti ādikam na adṛṣṭa hetukam śarīra janya tva abhāvāt ityādi api syāt

nanu astu tāvat aśarīra nitya jñāna ādi kartṛ anumitiḥ tathā api sa anumitiḥ ayathārthā aśarīre kartṛ tva jñāna tvāt jñāna icchā prayatneṣu nitya jñāna tvāt śarīrājanye sa kartṛka tva jñāna tvāt ghaṭaḥ kartā ghaṭa jñāna ādikam nityam vyoma sa kartṛkam iti jñāna vat iti sādhyam na ca upajīvya bādhaḥ anumitiḥ hi upajīvyā nanu astu tat yathārtha tvam api iti ced na kartṛ kāryayoḥ niru pādhi kārya kāraṇa abhāvena etasya aprayojaka tvāt anyathā parvate vahni anumitiḥ ayathārthāḥ ubhaya siddha vahnimat bhinne vahni jñāna tvāt ityādinā sakala anvaya vyatireki u chedaḥ

kiñca anumiteḥ ayātha arthyam anena jñāpyam na tu kāryam tathā ca doṣāt utpannasya anena jñāpane tatra ayam eva doṣaḥ doṣa antaram vā na ādyaḥ anyonya āśrayāt utpanne tasmin jñāpanam jñāpakāt eva ca tasmāt doṣāt tad utpattiḥ iti na antyaḥ asiddheḥ tarka apariśuddhiḥ tu na dūṣaṇam yadi īśvaraḥ kartā syāt śarīri syāt iṣṭa sādhana tā jñānavān syāt prayojanavān syāt anitya jñānavān syāt kṣiti ādi yadi sa kartṛkam syāt śarīri kartṛkam syāt ityādi tarkāṇām viparyaye āśraya asiddhi vyartha viśeṣaṇa tva ādinā viparyaya aparyavasānena ābhāsa tvāt

nanu kṣiti ādau eka kartṛ siddhiḥ kutas eka kartṛka tvena vyāpti abhāvāt na ca lāghavāt tasya apramāṇa tvāt sa kartṛka tva pramāṇāt eva lāghava saha kṛtāt tad siddhiḥ iti ced na tāvat anumiti mātre lāghavam sahakāri vyabhicārāt māna abhāvāt ca na hi liḍga parāmarśe sati tad vilambena anumiti bilambaḥ yena tad sahakāri syāt na api laghu anumitau anyaḥ anya āśrayāt na api vyakti anumitau dhūmena vahnyā anumitau eka dvi hasta ādi saṃśaya abhāva āpatteḥ sādhaka abhāvena nānātva asiddhau kartṛ siddheḥ eva eka kartṛ siddhiḥ iti ced na eka tva sādhaka abhāvena ekatva asiddhau kartṛ siddhiḥ eva nānātva siddhiḥ iti asya api suvacana tvāt

atha yam artham anālambamāna anumitiḥ pakṣe na sādhya saṃsargam viṣayīkaroti sa pakṣa dharma tā balāt sidhyati na tu adhikam api tathā ca dvitīyam kartāram aviṣayīkurvati api kartāram viṣayīkaroti eva iti na dvitīyam avagāhate ekaḥ tu kartā sidhyati tad aviṣaya tve kartṛ viṣaya tā eva na syāt eka viṣaya tva abhāve nānā viṣaya tvasya api abhāvāt tad ghaṭita tvāt tasya iti ced evam tarhi kartṛ ekatvam api na viṣayaḥ syāt eka tva viṣaya tvam vinā api kartṛ viṣaya tva sambhavāt vastu gatyā ekaḥ sidhyati na tvaketvena iti ced na eka tva asiddhyā vastu gatyā ekaḥ iti jñātum aśakyatvāt tathā ca īśvare ekatva aneka tvayoḥ nitya saṃśayaḥ iti

ucyate yatra pramāṇe laghu guru viṣaya tā sambhavati tatra lādhava sahakāritā kāraṇa tā kārya tā vyāpya tā ādi grāhake pratyakṣe pravṛtti nimitta grāhake upamāne śabda śakti grāhaka anumāne tathāvidha pramāṇa mātre ca sakala tāntrikaiḥ sahakāri tva kalpanāt evam lāghavam eva gauravam iti jñāna anantaram bādhakam vinā laghūnām eva kāraṇa tva kārya tva vyāpya tva pravṛtti nimitta tva śabda śakya tvānām jñāna darśanāt tatra api lāghavān ādare śabda śakya tva ādi saṃśaye tad mūlaka vyavahāra ucchedaḥ vinigamaka abhāvāt saḥ ayam vicāram ārabhate lāghavañca tad aṅgam na aṅgīkurute iti mahat sāhasam

nanu evam vastu gatyā nānā kartṛkeṣu ghaṭeṣu ghaṭa tvena kulāla kartṛka tva anumāne api bādhakānavatāradaśāyām lāghavāt eka kartṛ siddhiḥ syāt na ceṣṭāpattiḥ anumiti anantaram nānātva ekatve saṃśayāt iti ced na tatra api lāghavena kartṛ ā aikyam eva siddhyati tat sandehaḥ tu jñāna prāmāṇya saṃśayāt iti paścāt nānā kartṛka tva sādhaka pramāṇāt eva eka kartṛka tā anumānam tatra bādhyate na ca evam kṣiti ādi kartari api prāmāṇya saṃśayāt eka tva aneka tva saṃśayaḥ durucchedaḥ eka tve bādhakasya abhāvena prāmāṇya niścayāt na ca eka tva sādhaka abhāvaḥ eva bādhakaḥ anumiteḥ eva lāghava sahakāreṇa eka tva sādhaka tvāt

anye tu kṣitikartā aṅkura kartra bhinnaḥ aśarīra kartṛ tvāt aṅkura kartṛ vat iti abheda anumānāt eka kartṛ siddhiḥ na ca kṣitikartā aṅkura kartṛ bhinnaḥ aṅkura akartṛ tvāt kulāla vat iti sat pratipakṣaḥ anitya jñānānām āśraya tvasya upādhika tvāt iti āhuḥ atra api aprayojaka tve bheda abhedayoḥ gaurava lāghave eva śaraṇam tathā api katham nitya sarva viṣaya jñāna siddhiḥ pakṣa dharma tā balāt iti ced vyāpaka tayā avagatasya pakṣa sambandha mātram pakṣa dharmāt hetoḥ sidhyati tathā ca pakṣe tad upādāna gocara jñāna mātram sidhyet na tu nitya sarva viṣaya jñānam tena rūpeṇa vyāpaka tva āgrahāt na ca yena vinā anupapattiḥ saḥ api viṣayaḥ vyatireki vilaya āpatteḥ

tatra prāñcaḥ yam artham anālambamāna anumitiḥ pakṣe sādhya sambandham na viṣayīkaroti sa pakṣa dharma tā balāt sidhyati iti anupapatti mūlakaḥ anvayī pratīta anupapattyā ca vyatirekī tad iha ana ādi dvi aṇuka ādi kārya pravāhasya pakṣa tve tad upādānasya anādi jñāna gocara tvam vinā na upādāna gocara jñāna janya tvam anādi kārya pravāhasya anumitiḥ ālambate anāditā eva ca nityatā sarva muktau api tat sattvam anādi bhāva tvāt pakṣa tad upādāna viṣaya tā eva ca sarva viṣaya tā lāghavāt tu tāvat viṣaya kamana ādi ekam eva jñānam sidhyati na tu nitya aniti ajñānāni iti

navyāḥ tu anitya jñāna ajanya tvena pakṣa viśeṣaṇāt jñānam sidhyat nityam eva sidhyati anitye bādhāt iti vācaspati miśrāḥ tu lāghavāt eka jñāna siddhau utpattim ataḥ anādi kārya pravāham pratyajanaka tvāt pariśeṣaṇa nitya jñāna ādi siddhiḥ niyata viṣaya tā ca jñānasya kāraṇa adhīnā kāraṇañca nitya jñānāt nivartamānam niyata viṣaya tām ādāya nivartate iti sarva viṣaya tva siddhiḥ iti ṣaṣ padārthī pratipādaka veda kartṛ tvena īśvarasya ṣaṭpadārthī gocara sākṣātkāra tvena vā sārvajñyam ghaṭa ākāśa saṃyoga ādikam prati īśvarasya kartṛ tvāt ghaṭa ādi gocaram api jñānam siddham iti kecid

nanu ghaṭa ādīnām katham īśvara kartṛka tvam bhavati ghaṭaḥ īśvarakartṛkaḥ kāryatvāt kṣiti vat iti anumānāt iti ced na ghaṭasya dvi kartṛka tayā tad dṛṣṭāntena kṣiti ādeḥ api dvi kartṛka tā āpatteḥ tathā ca ghaṭa vat kṣitiḥ kṣiti vat ghaṭaḥ iti īśvara ānantyam kārye kartṛ tvena kāraṇa tā na tu dvi kartṛka tvena iti ced tarhi na īśvara kartṛka tvena kāraṇa tā kintu kartṛ tvena iti mā evam jñāna ādīnām nitya tvena sarva viṣaya tā ghaṭa ādi upādāna viṣaya tvam api iti katham na teṣām ghaṭa ādi kāraṇa tā kulāla ādi jñāna tulya tvāt

tad āhuḥ ācāryāḥ paramāṇu adṛṣṭa adhiṣṭhātṛ siddhau jñāna ādīnām nitya tvena sarva viṣaya tve vema ādi adhiṣṭhānasya api nyāya prāpta tvāt na tu tad adhiṣṭhāna artham eva īśvara siddhiḥ iti aham sarvasya prabhavaḥ mattaḥ sarvam pravartate iti ādi āgamāt ca ayam arthaḥ adhyavaseyaḥ atha īśvarasya sarvajña tve sarva viṣaya bhrānteḥ jñāne īśvaraḥ api bhrāntaḥ syāt bhramasya iva tasya api bhrama viṣaya viṣayaka tvāt iti ced na rajata tva prakāraka jñānavān ayam iti jñānam na bhramaḥ abhrāntasya tathātvāt idam rajatam iti jñāne rajata tvam prakāraḥ tena sa bhramaḥ īśvara jñāne ca rajata tva prakāraka tvam prakāraḥ iti sa na bhramaḥ atas eva asmad ādiḥ api bhrānti jñaḥ na bhrāntaḥ iti

syāt etat prayojanam vinā katham īśvaraḥ pravartate sukhasya abhāvāt adharma abhāvena nirduḥkha tvāt karuṇayā pravartate iti ced tarhi para sukha duḥkha prahāṇe prayojane tathā ca svargiṇam eva sṛjet na nārakiṇam dharma adharma paratantra tvāt tad anurūpam phalam prāpayati iti ced tarhi āvaśyaka tvāt karma nimittam eva jagat vaicitryam astu kim īśvareṇa anapekṣita kīṭa ādi jñānavatā karma nirapekṣa tve ca ekadā eva sadā ca sarga pralayau syātām jñāna ādīnām nitya tvāt kiñca tat prayatnasya karuṇā janya tvena śarīra ādi janya tva āpattau saṃsārita āpattiḥ iti

na īśvara anabhyupagame vicārasya āśraya asiddha tvāt tam abhyupagamya pṛcchasi ced tat ākarṇaya jagataḥ eva tad icchā viṣaya tvena sva iṣṭa sādhana tā jñāna sattvāt vastutas tu kṣiti ādi tad tad asādhāraṇa kramikā dṛṣṭa ādi sāmagrī samavahitāḥ īśvara jñāna ādayaḥ yadā bhavanti tadā kṣiti ādikam karoti iti vyavahāraḥ sarga pralayāsa ādhāraṇa kramikā dṛṣṭa ādi sāmagrī samavahita tvam eva tad icchāyāḥ cikīṣā sañji hīrṣā tve na ca evam kim tad jñāna ādinā iti vācyam kṣiti ādīnām kāryatvena jñāna janya tayā nitya jñāna ādīnām api janaka tvāt sukha ādi śabdayoḥ ātma ākāśa ādi vat

nanu aśarīrāt katham veda ghaṭa ādi śabda vyavahāra sampradāyaḥ ucyate sarga ādau adṛṣṭa upagṛhīta bhūta bhedāt mīna śarīra utpattau adṛṣṭa vat ātma saṃyogāt adṛṣṭa saha kṛta prayatna vat īśvara saṃyogāt vā sakala veda artha gocara jñānāt vivakṣā sahitān mīna kalevara kaṇṭha tālu ādi kriyā tad janya saṃyogāt veda utpattiḥ evam kulāla ādi śarīra avacchedena adṛṣṭa saha kṛta prayatna vat īśvara saṃyogāt tad buddhi icchā sahitāt ceṣṭā utpattau sakala ghaṭa ānukūla vyāpārāt ghaṭa utpattiḥ evam prayojya prayojaka jñānāya vyāpāra abhimata śarīra avacchedenā api adṛṣṭa sahakṛta īśvara jñāna icchā prayatnāt eva vāc vyavahāraḥ tatas tad darśī bālaḥ vyutpadyate saḥ ayam bhūta āveśa nyāyaḥ

yat tu yathā lipya ādinā mauni ślokaḥ anumāya paṭhyate tathā sarga antara utpannatatva jñānavatā bhoga artham sarga ādau utpannena manu ādinā sarvajña īśvara abhiprāya sthaḥ vedaḥ sākṣātkṛtyā anūdyate tatas agrima sampradāyaḥ saḥ eva ca kāya vyūham kṛtvā ghaṭa ādi vāc vyavahāram pravartayati iti matam tat na pratisarga ādi ananta sarvajña kalpanāyām gauravāt teṣām eva kṣiti ādi kartṛ tva sambhavena īśvarān anumānāt ca etena sarga ādau sarga antara siddha yoginaḥ eva kṣitikartāraḥ santu iti parāḥ tam sarga ādau ananta sarvajña siddhiḥ ca kim pramāṇa antarāt kṣiti ādi kartṛ grāhakāt vā na ādyaḥ tad asambhavāt na antyaḥ anādi dvi aṇuka ādi kārya pravāhasya sa kartṛkatva anumānāt lāghava sahakṛtāt ekasya eva sarvajñasya siddheḥ

atha īśvara jñāna mūlaka śabda śākti grahe prayojya vyāpāra anumita ghaṭa jñāne ghaṭa śabdasya kāraṇa tva grahaḥ bhramaḥ syāt tadīya jñānasya nitya tvāt tathā ca tad janya ghaṭa śabda śakti grahasya bhrama tve sa kala śābda jñānam bhramaḥ syāt bhrama paramparā mūlaka tvāt anitya sarvajña mūla ka śābda grahe ca na ayam doṣaḥ iti ced na vyāpāra anumitam idam ghaṭa jñānam ghaṭa pada janyam iti jñānasya śabda śakti graha kāraṇasya bhramatve api ghaṭa padam ghaṭa śaktam iti jñānasya yathārtha tvāt viṣaya ābādhāt na ca bhrama mūla tvena asya bhrama tvam anumeyam tad aṃśe vyadhikaraṇa prakāra abhāvena bādhāt bādhita viṣaya tvasya upādhi tvāt ca atas eva ghaṭam ānaya iti śabda anantaram sūtra sañcāra adhiṣṭhita dāru putrakasya ghaṭa ānayana vyavahāra darśanāt bālaḥ ghaṭa pade vyutpadyate tad mūla kaśābda jñānam api na bhramaḥ tasya api bhrama tve prayojya vyavahārāt idānīm vyutpattiḥ na syāt kim ayam prayojyaḥ cetana vyavahārāt vyutpannaḥ acetana vyavahārāt vā iti saṃśayasya vajra lepāya māna tvāt iti

viśvatas cakṣuḥ uta viśvatomukhaḥ viśvatas hastaḥ uta viśvataspād sam bāhubhyām dhamati sam patatraiḥ rdyāvā bhūmī janayan devaḥ ekaḥ ityādi śrutayaḥ uttamaḥ puruṣaḥ tu anyaḥ paramātmā iti udāhṛtaḥ yaḥ lokatrayam āviśya vibhatrti avyayaḥ īśvaraḥ ityādi smṛtayaḥ ca bahvyaḥ māna tvena anusandheyāḥ

syāt etat īśvara vat kāryeṇa eva śaktiḥ api anumīyate tathā hi yādṛśāt eva kara tala anala saṃyogāt dāhaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ tādṛśāt eva pratibandhake sati na jāyate atas yad abhāvāt kārya abhāvaḥ tat abhyupeyam vahni ādau tena vinā tad abhāva āyatta dāha abhāva anupapatteḥ iti vyatireka mukhena śakti siddhiḥ na ca adṛṣṭa vaiguṇyam dṛṣṭa sāt guṇye tad abhāvāt tasya tad artha tvāt anyathā dṛḍha daṇḍa nunnam api cakram na bhrāmyet

atha adṛṣṭa vilambāt api vilambaḥ yathā vandhyā strī samprayoge paramāṇu karmaṇi adhyayana tulya tve api ekatra phala abhāve ca iti ced na adṛṣṭa vilambaḥ hi na tad nāśān utpādau maṇi apasāraṇa anantaram dāha abhāva prasaḍgāt kiñca niyamataḥ maṇi sadbhāve kārya abhāvaḥ tad abhāve kāryam iti dṛṣṭa tvāt maṇi a ādi abhāvaḥ eva kāraṇam anyathā kadācimnaṇya ādi abhāve api tad abhāvāt kāryam na syāt vandhyā samprayoge tu dṛṣṭa vyabhicārāt adṛṣṭa vilambāt eva vilambaḥ adṛṣṭañca kvacid sākṣāt janakam anyathā paramparayā hetuḥ api na syāt na ca sama prajñayoḥ samañca nirantaram abhyastayoḥ ekaḥ pragalbhaḥ na aparaḥ iti dṛśyate na ca sarva utpattimatām adṛṣṭam nimitta kāraṇam agamyā gamana ādi sādhye sukhe vyabhicārāt tat hi na adharmāt sukha vat na api dharmāt tena hi agamyā gamanam utpādya

sukham utpādanīyam tathā ca agamya āgamana kāraṇa tvena na sa dharmaḥ śyena apūrvavat niṣiddha phalaka tvena anarthaka tvāt dāha pratikūlā dṛṣṭāt eva dāha abhāvaḥ iti ced na tasya uttejaka abhāva saha kṛta maṇya janya tve tatra ādāha arthinaḥ apravṛtti prasaṅgāt tat janya tve api tad utpādakāt eva dāha abhāvaḥ iti kim adṛṣṭena a prathama upasthita tvāt upajīvya tvāt ca pratibandhaka abhāva hetu tvasya tena abhyupagamāt adṛṣṭa utpattau śauca ācamana ādeḥ sādhāraṇasya atra api anvayaḥ syāt aśuceḥ eva tad utpattau śauce sati tad abhāva āpatteḥ pratipakṣa sannidhāpaka adṛṣṭasya eva pratibandhaka tve sati maṇya prayoge api dāha anāpattiḥ agrima kāle eva sannidhi darśanena tad asiddhi abhāvāt

astu tarhi uttejaka abhāva saha kṛta pratibandhaka abhāvasya anvaya vyatirekābhyām hetu tvam evam kevala uttejaka sadbhāve ubhaya sattve ubhaya abhāve ca viśiṣṭa abhāvaḥ anugataḥ hetuḥ tat ca maṇi a ādi abhāva tvena na tu pratibandhaka abhāva tvena iti na anyonya āśrayaḥ atas eva pratibandhaka tva abhimata maṇya ādīnām abhāvakūṭaḥ eva kāraṇam tena maṇi sadbhāve mantra ādi abhāve ca na kāryam anatirikta abhāva vādi mate ca vyavahāra artham tad sthāna abhiṣiktasya hetu tvam na ca abhāvaḥ na kāraṇam bhāvavat tad grāhaka taulyāt dṛṣṭañca kuḍya saṃyoga abhāvasya gatau anupalambhasya abhāva vijñāne vihita akaraṇasya pratyavāye nirdoṣa tvasya veda prāmāṇye janakatvam iti prāñcaḥ

mā evam viśiṣṭam hi na artha antaram yena tad abhāvaḥ anugataḥ syāt kintu viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya sambandhāḥ iti teṣām pratyeka abhāvasya hetu tve kvacid viśeṣya maṇya bhāvaḥ kvacid uttejakā bhāva rūpa viśeṣaṇa abhāvaḥ kvacid ubhayaḥ kāraṇam iti vyabhicāreṇa na ekam api hetuḥ syāt syāt etat pratiyogi bheda ādi vat pratiyogi ta avacchedaka viśeṣaṇa bhedāt api abhāvaḥ bhidyate anyathā pṛthivī ādi traya pratyeka rūpa abhāve avagate api vāyau rūpa saṃśayaḥ na syāt evañca yathā kevala daṇḍa sadbhāve daṇḍa puruṣa sadbhāve dvaya abhāve ca viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya ubhaya viraha prayuktaḥ kevala puruṣa abhāvaḥ abādhita anugata vyavahāra balāt pratīti siddhaḥ tathā viśeṣyasya pratibandhakasya abhāve viśeṣaṇasya uttejaka abhāvasya abhāve ubhaya abhāve ca kevala pratibandhaka abhāvaḥ viśeṣya viśeṣaṇa ubhaya abhāva vyāpakaḥ anugataḥ eva dāha akāraṇam astu

atha viśeṣaṇa ādi abhāvaiḥ eva kevala puruṣa ādi abhāva vyavahāraḥ eka śaktimat tvāt iti ced na anugata vyavahārasya anugata jñāna sādhya tvāt śakteḥ ca atīndriya tvāt atha uttejaka prayoga kāle maṇeḥ kaḥ abhāvaḥ na tāvat prāk pradhvaṃsa abhāvau tayoḥ pratiyogi asamāna kāla tvāt na ca śyāmaḥ ayam āsīt iti atra yathā śyāma dhvaṃsa prayuktaḥ śyāma ghaṭa tvena pakva ghaṭasya dhvaṃsaḥ eva na tu ghaṭa tvena tathā uttejaka abhāva dhvaṃsa prayuktaḥ uttejaka abhāvavat tvena maṇeḥ dhvaṃsaḥ eva iti vācyam dhvaṃsasya ananta tvena uttejaka apanaye api dāha prasaṅgāt na api atyanta abhāvaḥ tasya kādācid ka tva abhāvāt iti ced na yathā daṇḍa upanaya apanaya daśāyām kevala puruṣa abhāvaḥ utpāda vināśavān anyathā abādhita kevala puruṣa abhāva tad abhāva vyavahārayoḥ upapādayitum aśakyatvāt tathā uttejaka upanaya apanaya śṛṅkhalāyām pratibandhaka abhāvaḥ api tathā eva svīkaraṇīyaḥ tulya nyāya tvāt

yadi ca saṃsarga abhāva traya vaidharmyāt tatra na antarbhavati tadā turīyaḥ eva saṃsarga abhāvoḥ tu na hi kḷpta viśeṣa bādhe sāmānya bādhaḥ viśeṣa antaram ādāya api tasya sambhavāt anyathā kḷptānādi saṃsarga abhāva ādi vaidharmyeṇa dhvaṃsaḥ api na sidhyet vyavahārānyatha anupapattiḥ ca tulyā eva saḥ ayam asmākam sagotra kalahaḥ na tu śaktivādaḥ astu vā dhvaṃsaḥ eva asau saṃsarga abhāva vibhāge janyā bhāva tvena dhvaṃsasya vibhajanāt na ca evam vināśi tvena prāc abhāvaḥ eva saḥ paribhāṣāyāḥ aparyanuyojya tvāt yat vā atyanta abhāvaḥ eva asau tasya nitya tve api kādācid kā pratīti kārya anudayau pratyāsattikādācitka tvāt pratyāsattiḥ ca viśeṣaṇa abhāvaḥ viśeṣya abhāvaḥ ca tadā eva viśiṣṭa atyanta abhāva satvāt iti

tat na yadi hi atīta viśeṣaṇa avacchedena vidyamānasya eva viśeṣyasya dhvaṃsaḥ syāt tadā kṣaṇa rūpa atīta viśeṣaṇā avacchinna tvena pratikṣaṇam ghaṭasya vināśaḥ syāt iti kṣaṇa bhaṅga āpattiḥ kiñca vidyamānasya vinaṣṭa tvena apratīteḥ śikhā vinaṣṭā puruṣaḥ na vinaṣṭa iti viparīta ābādhita pratyayāt ca na viśeṣaṇa abhāve api viśeṣya dhvaṃsaḥ śyāmaḥ ayam āsīt kevalaḥ ayam āsīt puruṣaḥ iti ādau sa viśeṣaṇe hi iti nyāyena viśeṣyavati śyāma kaivalya ādi dhvaṃsaḥ eva pratīyate dhvaṃsasya dhvaṃsa anupapatteḥ ca na vidyamānasya dhvaṃsaḥ

etena uttejaka sadbhāve sati uttejaka abhāva viśiṣṭa maṇeḥ utpanna dhvaṃsasya uttejaka apanaya samaye dhvaṃsaḥ jātaḥ adhvastaḥ ca dhvaṃsaḥ kāraṇam iti na viphalaḥ uttejaka apanayaḥ iti apāstam vidyamāna dhvaṃsasya ca dhvaṃsa abhāvāt na ca dhvaṃsa anyaḥ saṃsarga abhāvaḥ viśiṣṭa abhāvaḥ iti vācyam utpanna abhāvasya vinaṣṭa pratīti hetu tayā tatas api vidyamānasya vinaṣṭa tva pratyaya āpatteḥ na api viśiṣṭa abhāvaḥ atyanta abhāvaḥ tathā hi saḥ eva kvacid viśeṣaṇa abhāva sahitaḥ kvacid viśeṣya abhāva sahitaḥ dāha kāraṇam iti ananugamaḥ tad avasthaḥ eva viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya abhāvayoḥ pratyāsatti tva avacchedaka anugata dharma abhāvāt

atha viśiṣṭa virodhi tvam viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya abhāvayoḥ anugatam tad avacchedakam asti tayoḥ sattvaḥ eva viśiṣṭa atyanta abhāva sattvāt iti ced tarhi viśiṣṭa virodhi tvena anugatena tayoḥ eva hi viśiṣṭa abhāva tvena dāha vyavahāra ādau janakatvam astu kṛtam tad upajīvina atirikta viśiṣṭa abhāvena atha uttejaka kāle vidyamāna atyanta abhāva anuvṛttau api uttejaka apanayane uttejaka abhāva vyaktiḥ yā jātā tad avacchinna maṇeḥ abhāvaḥ na tatra iti tadā na kārya audayaḥ tad tad uttejaka abhāvānām ananugata tvena anugata viśiṣṭa abhāva vyavahāra anupapatteḥ uttejaka abhāva tvena anugame ati prasaḍgaḥ eva

atha viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya abhāvayoḥ viśiṣṭa viredhi tvam anugata kāraṇa tāvacchedakam yatra tad anyatara abhāvaḥ tatra na viśiṣṭam yatra viśiṣṭam tatra na tayoḥ abhāvaḥ iti saha anavasthāna niyamasya virodhasya anubhava siddha tvāt iti ced na saha anavasthāna niyamaḥ na paraspara viraha rūpa tayā viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya abhāvasya pratyekam viśiṣṭa abhāva tayā tad pratyeka abhāva abhāvasya viśiṣṭa tva āpatteḥ tathā ca viśeṣya viśeṣaṇayoḥ pratyekam viśiṣṭa tva āpattiḥ tad abhāvasya tattvāt na ca ubhaya abhāva abhāvaḥ ubhayam viśiṣṭam evam hi abhāva dvayam viśiṣṭa abhāvaḥ na tu pratyeka abhāva rūpaḥ iti pratyeka abhāvāt viśiṣṭa abhāva vyavahāraḥ na syāt nā api paraspara viraha vyāpya tvam tat ākṣepaka tvam vā viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya abhāvasya viśiṣṭa abhāva tvena tat avyāpya tvāt tad anākṣepaka tvāt ca abhede tayoḥ abhāvāt

etena anyat api viśiṣṭa vyavahāra virodhi tva ādinā anugata tvam apāstam kena api anugatena rūpeṇa viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya abhāvasya viśiṣṭa abhāva tve pratyeka abhāva abhāvasya viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya anyatara mātrasya viśiṣṭa tva āpatteḥ tad abhāva abhāvasya tattvāt iti ukta tvāt tasmāt viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya abhāvaḥ viśeṣaṇa avacchinna viśeṣya abhāvaḥ na viśiṣṭa abhāvaḥ iti

atra ucyate viśeṣaṇa viśeṣyayoḥ sambandhāt viśiṣṭa vyavahāraḥ iti tayoḥ sambandha abhāvāt viśiṣṭa abhāva vyavahāraḥ iti ghaṭa tadabhāva vyavahārau iva ghaṭa sattva asattvābhyām na hi tayoḥ asambandhe viśiṣṭa vyavahāraḥ na vā tad abhāve sati na viśiṣṭa abhāva vyavahāraḥ yasya yatra yaḥ sambandhaḥ saḥ eva tatra tasya vaiśiṣṭyam sa ca sambandha abhāvaḥ viśeṣaṇa abhāvāt viśeṣya abhāvāt ubhaya abhāvāt sarvatra aviśiṣṭaḥ ekaḥ teṣām vyāpakaḥ anugata viśiṣṭa abhāva vyahāra ādi kāraṇam iha daṇḍī puruṣaḥ na asti iti atra tathā darśanāt atas eva daṇḍa mātra sadbhāve daṇḍa puruṣa sadbhāve ubhaya abhāve ca kaivalya puruṣayoḥ sambandha abhāvaḥ sarvatra asti iti anugataḥ kevala puruṣa abhāva vyavahāraḥ evañca pratibandhaka uttejaka abhāvayoḥ sambandha abhāvaḥ dāha kāraṇam sa ca pratibandhaka abhāve pratibandhaka uttejaka sadbhāve ubhaya abhāve ca asti sarvatra pratibandhaka uttejaka abhāvayoḥ sambandhaḥ na asti iti pratīteḥ

nanu evam yatra pratibandhaka uttejaka abhāvau tatra api dāhaḥ syāt adhikaraṇa bhāvayoḥ atirikta sambandha abhāvāt iti ced na tad abhāvaḥ api svarūpa sambandhasya abhāvāt sarvatra svarūpa sambandhāt eva adhikaraṇa abhāvayoḥ vaiśiṣṭya pratīteḥ tathā api pratibandhaka uttejaka abhāvau eva svarūpa sambandhaḥ tayoḥ abhāvaḥ ca pratibandhaka abhāvaḥ utteja kañca dāha kāraṇam tathā ca ubhaya abhāve uttejakā satve param dāhaḥ syāt uttejakavati pratibandhake dāhaḥ na syāt iti ced na adhikaraṇa abhāvau eva svarūpa sambandhaḥ tayoḥ ghaṭa vat bhū tala cattu arīya tada bhāvayoḥ api svarūpa sattve ghaṭavati ghaṭa abhāva vyavahāra āpatteḥ kintu upa śliṣṭa svabhāva tvam tat ca sambandha antaram vinā viśiṣṭa pratyaya janana yogya tvam na ca ghaṭa vat bhū tala catvarīya tadabhāvayoḥ viśiṣṭa pratyaya janana yogya tvam asti

ghaṭavati kadāpi ghaṭa abhāva pratyaya an udayāt tat iha api pratibandhaka uttejaka abhāvayoḥ viśiṣṭa pratyaya janana yogya tvam svarūpa sambandhaḥ anyathā uttejakavati pratibandhake catvarīya uttejaka abhāva viśiṣṭa pratyaya āpatteḥ tādṛśa svarūpa sambandha abhāvaḥ ca pratibandhaka abhāve pratibandhaka uttejaka sadbhāve ubhaya abhāve ca aviśiṣṭaḥ eva yat vā adaṇḍa puruṣasya abhāve daṇḍī puruṣaḥ na pratiyogī tasya adaṇḍa tva abhāvāt kintu tad anyaḥ tasya abhāvaḥ daṇḍi sadbhāve api daṇḍa mātra sattve ubhaya asattve ca aviśiṣṭaḥ iti tasmāt kevala puruṣa abhāva vyavahāraḥ anugataḥ

tat uktam na hi daṇḍini satya daṇḍānām anyeṣām na abhāvaḥ kintu daṇḍa abhāvasya eva iti yuktam anyathā tatra anyeṣām iti padasya vyartha tā āpatteḥ tathā kevala pratibandhaka abhāve uttejaka saha kṛtaḥ pratibandhakaḥ na pratiyogī tasya kevala tva abhāvāt kintu tad anyaḥ tad anyasya ca kevala pratibandhakasya abhāve uttejaka sahita pratibandhaka sattve uttejaka mātra sattve ubhaya asattve vā viśiṣṭaḥ eva iti na ananugamaḥ uttejaka apanaye ca kevala pratibandhakaḥ asti iti na tad abhāvaḥ iti dāhaḥ na bhavati iti

nanu na pratibandhaka abhāvaḥ kāraṇam eka daṇḍa anvaye ghaṭa utpatti vat pratibandhaka sattve api pratibandhaka antara abhāve api kārya anudayāt na hi yāvat kāraṇa tāvacchedaka avacchinnam tāvat anvaye api kāryam iti ced na pratibandhaka abhāva tvena na kāraṇa tvam anyaḥ anya āśrayāt kintu maṇi ādi abhāva tvena iti ukta tvāt tattve api vā ghaṭe daṇḍa salila ādi vat pratibandhaka abhāvakūṭasya dāha hetu tvāt yat vā pratibandhaka tva avacchinna pratiyogikaḥ eva abhāvaḥ kāraṇam sa ca yāvat viśeṣa abhāva niyataḥ iti na pratibandhaka sattve apara pratibandhaka abhāve api kārya udayaḥ pratibandhakasya ca saṃsarga abhāvaḥ hetuḥ tena tad sattve tad anyaḥ anya abhāve api na kāryam anvaya vyatirekābhyām vyāpti kāraṇa tvayoḥ grahe saṃsarga abhāvasya tvayā api hetu tva aṅgīkārāt anyathā sāmagrī vyāpakayoḥ sattve tad anyonya abhāve kārya vyāpya abhāva āpattau kārya kāraṇa vyāpya vyāpaka bhāve vyāghātāt

kiñca tava api pratibandhaka abhāve śaktiḥ asti iti tad sattve tad anyaḥ anya abhāvam ādāya śakti sattva prasaḍgaḥ na ca sa durvacaḥ na vā prāc abhāva ādi tvena ananugama vyabhicārau pratiyogi adhikaraṇayoḥ saṃsargam āropya yaḥ niṣedhaḥ sa saṃsarga abhāvaḥ bhū talam ghaṭa saṃsargaḥ na iti atra bhū tale ghaṭa saṃsargasya saṃsargaḥ na āropyate kintu tādātmyam

vayantu brūmaḥ yatra pratiyoginam adhikaraṇe samāropya niṣedha avagamaḥ sa saṃrgā bhāvaḥ yatra ca adhikaraṇe pratiyogita avacchedakam āropya niṣedha avagamaḥ saḥ anyonya abhāvaḥ bhū talam na ghaṭaḥ iti atra bhū talasya ghaṭa tva avagamāt ghaṭa tvam eva ca ghaṭa tādātmyam āropasya hetu tve kim mānam iti ced mā bhūt tāvat anyat na idam iha na idam idam iti abādhita vilakṣaṇa vyavahārasya eva tatra māna tvāt iti

nanu pratibandhaka atyanta abhāvaḥ na hetuḥ tasmin sati api kārya abhāvāt na hi kara ādau maṇi ati anta abhāvaḥ tad saṃyoga atyanta abhāvaḥ vā maṇeḥ sva avayava vṛtti tvāt saṃyogasya ca avyāpya vṛtti tvāt atas eva na tad prāgabhāva pradhvaṃsau hetū tayoḥ kara ādau avṛtteḥ guṇa karma ādeḥ ca pratibadhya tva anāpatteḥ ca tasya janya dharmān āśraya tvena tatra tayoḥ abhāvāt na ca anyaḥ saṃsarga abhāvaḥ asti iti ced na saṃsarga avacchinna pratiyogikasya abhāva viśeṣasya sati pratibandhake abhāvāt sa ca samaya viśeṣa avacchedena saṃsargi tayā atyanta abhāvaḥ eva tathā eva anvaya vyatireka avadhāraṇāt

atha evam pradhvaṃsa prāgabhāva sthale samaya viśeṣa avacchinna atyanta abhāvena eva upapattau na tayoḥ siddhiḥ atyanta abhāvaḥ hi avyāpya vṛttiḥ tasya ca ekatra bhāva abhāve kvacid deśaḥ avacchedakaḥ kvacid kāle iti ced na tatra vidyamāna tā virodhi tvena eva kapāle na ghaṭaḥ iti pratīti vailakṣaṇyāt na tu evam bhū tale ghaṭa abhāva pratītiḥ

anye tu bhaviṣyati ghaṭaḥ ghaṭaḥ naṣṭaḥ iti vilakṣaṇa pratītyoḥ atyanta abhāvena ekena samarthayitum aśakyatvāt anyaḥ eva ayam saṃsarga abhāvaḥ iti api āhuḥ etena viśeṣaṇa abhāva viśeṣya abhāva tad ubhaya abhāva ghaṭitam sāmagrī trayam eva astu hetuḥ dāhe ca jāti traya kalpanam iti pratyuktam anugata hetu sattvāt dāha vaijātyasya yogyā anupalambha bādhita tvāt ca vyakti yogya tayā eva jāti yogya tvena yogye ayogya jāti abhāvāt

nanu praharam mā daha ityādau sa avadhi mantra pāṭhe mantra vināśe dāhaḥ syāt na ca saṅkalpa viṣaya kāla viśeṣaḥ eva tatra pratibandhakaḥ saṅkalpa nāśe samayasya svatas aviśeṣāt na ca uddeśya tvam eva tatra viśeṣaḥ tasya vināśāt na ca uddeśya dhvaṃsaḥ api hetuḥ tasya yāmāt ūrdhvam api sattvāt na ca mantra pāṭha janitam adṛṣṭam eva tatra pratibandhakam tad kāla dāhā prāpti kapāla nāśya tvena na agre dāha apratibandhaḥ iti vācyam pratibandhaka mantra pāṭhasya aniṣiddha tvena avihita tvena ca adṛṣṭa ajanaka tvāt tad ācārasya vigīta tvena śruti ādi ananumāpaka tvāt iti ced

mā evam uddeśya tva jñāna āhita saṃskāra viṣaya kālasya pratibandhaka tvāt nanu pratibandham akurvata apratibandhaka tvena śaktim ana pakapakurvatām mantra ādīnām na pratibandhaka tvam atas śakti siddhiḥ na ca kārya anutpādaḥ eva pratibandhaḥ tad janaka tvam eva pratibandhaka tvam iti vācyam kārya anutpādaḥ hi tatra na tad prāc abhāvaḥ na vā tad uttara kāla sambandhaḥ tasya mantra ādyajanya tvāt iti ced na mantra ādīnām apratibandhaka tvāt tad prayoktāraḥ tu pratibandhakāḥ te ca kiñcitkarā eva mantra ādau ca kārye kāraṇa upacārāt svārthika kan pratyayāt vā tathā vyapadeśaḥ pratibandhaḥ ca sāmagrī virahaḥ mantra ādi abhāva ghaṭita sāmagrī virahaḥ ca mantra ādiḥ eva tad abhāva abhāvasya tattvāt

navyāḥ tu na pratibandhaka abhāvaḥ kāraṇam na vā śaktiḥ kintu tad tad kālīna dāha viśeṣam prati tad tad kāla pratibandha itara vahneḥ kāraṇa tvam iti pratibandhaka abhāvaḥ kāraṇa tāvacchedakaḥ na tu kāraṇam daṇḍa tva vat ākāśa ādau tu eka vyaktike na yathā kāraṇa tvam kvacid pratibandhe api anyatra śabda utpatteḥ kintu bherī ādeḥ tathā kāraṇa tvam iti tad pratibandhe na śabda utpattiḥ iti āhuḥ

tat na vahni pratibandhaka abhāvayoḥ anvaya vyatireka taulyena ubhayasya api kāraṇa tvāt na tu ekam eva avacchedakam vinigamaka abhāvāt kiñca yasmin sati api yad abhāvāt kārya abhāvaḥ tasya kāraṇa tvam āyāti na tu tad avacchedaka tvam na hi kārya ayoga vyavacchedaḥ kāraṇa tvam kintu niyata pūrva sattvam tat ca sahakāri viraha prayukta kārya abhāve api akṣatam anyathā cakra sahita daṇḍa tvena kāraṇa tve saha kāri ucchedaḥ yasya yat dharmam avagamyā eva niyata pūrva sattvam agamyate tasya tad avacchedakam daṇḍa tvam iva sahakārī tu na tathā

nanu mā bhūt arthāpattiḥ śaktau mānam anumānantu syāt tathā hi sthiraḥ avayavī janaka daśā viśiṣṭaḥ vahniḥ ajana ka daśā vyāvṛtta bhāva bhūta dharmavān janaka tvāt kuṇṭha kuṭhārāt tīkṣṇa kuṭhāra vat dāhya asaṃyukta vahneḥ dāhya asaṃyukta vahni vat ca pratibandhaka sattve saṃyoga ādeḥ ajanaka daśa āvarti tvena tad atiriktā atīndriya bhāva bhūta dharma siddhiḥ yadi api śakteḥ bhāva hetu janya tvena na ajanaka daśā vyāvṛtta tvam tathā api ukta viśiṣṭāyāḥ tathā tvam yat vā dharme atīndriya tvam viśeṣaṇam na ca dṛṣṭānta siddhiḥ tulya ādhāra tve api loha viśeṣa ghaṭita kuṭhāre vilakṣaṇa chidā kriyā rūpa kārya balāt ati indriya tīkṣaṇa tva siddhiḥ

athavā tathābhūtaḥ eva vahniḥ kārya anukūlā atīndriyāt viṣṭha dharma samavāyī janaka tvāt ātma vat atīndriya tvañca yadi api na sākṣātkāra aviṣaya tvam anitya sākṣātkāra aviṣaya tvam yoga ja dharma ādyajanya sā akṣātkāra aviṣaya tvam vā param svam vā pratyasiddheḥ saṃyoga ādi pañcaka janya jñāna aviṣaya tvam aindriyakāṇām api tathā api saṃyoga ādi anyatara pratyāsati janya sākṣātkāra aviṣa tvam ubhayava ādi siddham anyataratvañca tat anya anya tvam na ca abhāva atīndriya tvam tasya asiddheḥ na ca vahnau sthiti sthāpake na artha antaram tatra tad abhāvāt kriyāyāḥ vegena adṛṣṭa vat ātma saṃyogena vega utpatteḥ na ca ātma tvam nitya tvam vā upādhiḥ sparśa eka tva ādimati dvi aṇuke sādhya avyāpaka tvāt

yat vā piṇḍībhūtaḥ vahniḥ dāha anukūlāt viṣṭhā ati indriya bhāva bhūta dharmavān dāha janaka tvāt ātma vat na ca ātma tvam upādhiḥ adṛṣṭa tvasya dāha anukūla tvena adṛṣṭe sādhya avyāpaka tvāt athavā kara vahni saṃyogaḥ kārya anukūlā atīndriya dharma samavāyī janaka tvāt ātma vat dvi aṇuka vat ca na ca ātma tvam dravya tvam vā upādhiḥ dvi aṇuka eka tva sparśa ādau sādhya avyāpaka tvāt yat vā pratibandhaka daśāyām pratyakṣa sakala dāha hetu samavahitaḥ dāha ajanakaḥ vahniḥ janaka daśā vṛtti kārya anukūla bhāva bhūta dharma śūnyaḥ ajanaka tvāt kuṇṭha kuṭhāra vat yat vā tathābhūtaḥ vahniḥ dāha janaka daśā vṛtti dāha anukūla bhāva bhūta dharma śūnyaḥ dāha ajanaka tvāt dāhyā saṃyukta vahni vat anukūla tvañca kārya abhāva prayojaka abhāva pratiyogi tvam kāraṇa tad avacchedaka sādhāraṇam dṛḍha daṇḍa tvena kāraṇa tve dṛḍha tva abhāvāt api kārya abhāva darśanāt iti

ucyate sādhyam vinā api ubhaya siddha pratibandhaka abhāvāt eva janakatvā ādi hetu sambhavāt vipakṣa bādhaka abhāvena anumānānām aprayojaka tvam yadica sahacāra darśana vyabhicāra adarśana upādhi anupalambha mātrāt eva vyāpti grahaḥ tadā śakti siddhi anantaram tena eva hetunā sādhye śakti atirikta tva prakṣepeṇa śa dvitīya ādi tādṛśa dharmam vinā api prathama anumita śaktyā eva janakatvā ādi upapatteḥ na tādṛśa ananta dharma siddhiḥ iti ced hanta evam śaktim vinā api tad artha siddheḥ kim śaktyā yat hi īśvara anantya vat na śakti ānantyam iti uktam tad abodhāt kārya mātre hi kartṛ tvena kāraṇa tvam na tu īśvara tvena dvi kartṛka tva ādinā vā gauravāt ghaṭe tvā arthaḥ samājaḥ

evam ajanakadaśā vyāvṛta tvena eva prayojaka tvam na tu bhāva bhūta tvena iti gauravāt api ca bhāva kārya mātrasya samavāyi kāraṇa janya tvena śakteḥ api tathā tvāt śakti anukūlā śaktiḥ aparā samavāyi kāraṇe mantavyā evam sā api samavāyi kāraṇa janyā iti tad anukūla śakti svīkāre śakti anavasthā kiñca prathama anumāne ajanaka tvam na svarūpa ayogya tvam vahnau kuṭhāre ca tad abhāvāt kintu kārya anupadhānam

tathā ca tad anupadhāna daśā ayam api vahnau śaktiḥ kuṭhāre taikṣṇyam iti bādhaḥ dṛṣṭānta asiddhiḥ ca loha viśeṣāṇām eva sa atiśayāt chidājanaka tvam iti na ati indriya taikṣṇya siddhiḥ agrima caturṣu bahis indriya apratyakṣa tvam upādhiḥ tulya yogakṣema tve api sandigdha upādhi tvena dūṣaka tvāt api ca janakatvasya kevala anvayitvena vyatireka aprasiddhyā na anvayavyatirekī na ca janakatva abhāvasya śaktau eva prasiddhiḥ anyonya āśrayāt na ca guru vacana paramparātaḥ eva vākya artha tayā tad siddhiḥ tu ad naye siddhārthasya apramāṇa tvāt na ca parārdha saṅkhyāyām sādhya janaka tva vyatirekayoḥ prasiddhiḥ apratyakṣāyāḥ śabda eka vedyāyāḥ tasyāḥ pratyakṣeṇa sādhya hetu vyatirekayoḥ grahītum aśakyatvāt

etena paṇḍā pūrve api tad siddhiḥ apāstā syāt etat tṛṇa araṇi maṇīnām vahnau kāraṇa tvāt eka śaktima tvam upeyam eka jātīya kārye eka jātīya kāraṇa tva niyamāt vahni avāntara jātīye teṣām pratyekam kāraṇa tvam iti ced na vahni jātīyasya akasmika tā āpatteḥ kāraṇa gata eka rūpam apahāya kārya gata bahutara rūpa kalpane gauravāt tṛṇa araṇi maṇi prabhava vahniṣu avāntara jāteḥ anupalambha bādhi tvāt ca yatra ca tad tad indhana prayojyam pradīpa dāru dahana ādau vaijātyam anubhūyate tatra kāraṇeṣu eka śaktimat tvam api na asti kiñca gomaya vṛścika prabhava vṛścika ādiṣu vaijātya kalpane tad prabhava vṛścikeṣu api vaijātyam kalpyam evam tad prabhava tad prabhaveṣu api iti vaijātya ānantyam

vijātīya kāraṇānām vijātīya kārya janaka tva niyamāt na ca tayoḥ na ekaḥ vṛścikaḥ buddhi vyapadeśayoḥ aviśeṣāt yadi vijātīyeṣu eka kārya śakti samavāyāt na kārya viśeṣāt kāraṇa viśeṣaḥ tad abhāvāt tad abhāvaḥ kvāpi anumīyeta tad abhāve api tad jātīya śaktim ataḥ anyasmāt api tad utpatti sambhavāt iti ced vahni vṛścika ādau evam etat nirūpita niyata vahni ādi kāraṇaka dhūma ādau kutas na tad anumānam anyathā kārya vaijātye api tṛṇasya vahni viśeṣaḥ iva vahni tvena dhūma viśeṣaḥ eva kāraṇa tvam na tu dhūma mātre tṛṇa ādi prabhava tva graha anantaram vahni avāntara jāti graha vat vahni tadajanya janya tva jñāna anantaram dhūmāvāntara jāti grahaḥ bhaviṣyati iti api āśaṅkyeta bādhakam vinā dhūma tvena vahnikārya tā iti ced tarhi bādhakam vinā dhūmam prati bahni tvena kāraṇa tā iti api tulyam

yat tu tṛṇa tvena kāraṇa tva c rahasya upajīvya tvāt tat rakṣā artham vahnau jāti viśeṣaḥ eva kalpyate iti tat na vahni tvena kāryatva grahāt tad rakṣā artham tṛṇa ādau śakti kalpanā aucityāt yathā ca anvaya vyatirekābhyām tṛṇa phūtkārayoḥ paraspara sahakāri tvam tathā eva tad śaktyoḥ api paraspara sahakāri tvena vahni anukūla tvam tathā eva kārya darśanāt evam tṛṇa araṇi maṇi phūtkāra nirmantha nataraṇi kiraṇānām vahni anukūla śaktima tvena kāraṇa tve api phūtkāreṇa tṛṇāt eva nirmanthanena āraṇeḥ eva pratiphalita taraṇi kiraṇaiḥ maṇeḥ eva agni utpattiḥ na tu maṇi phūtkāra ādibhyaḥ maṇi phūtkāra śaktyoḥ paraspara sahakāri tva virahāt yat tu tṛṇa phūtkāra ādi stoma traye viśiṣṭe śaktiḥ iti tat na tṛṇa tvena gṛhīta kāraṇa tā bhaṅga prasaṅgāt iti

ucyate tṛṇa raṇimaṇi phūtkāra ādi vyaktīnām ānantyena prativyakti bhāva hetu janita ananta śakti svīkāre gauravam tāvat ananta vyakti janya ananta vahni vyaktiṣu jāti kalpane lāghavam iti tat eva kalpyate na ca jātau yogyā anupalabdhi bādhaḥ gomaya vṛścika prabhava vṛścikayoḥ īṣat nīlatva kapila tva vyaṅgya vaijātyasya pratyakṣa siddha tvāt tṛṇa janya nānā vahni vyaktiṣu tṛṇa janya tva jñāna anantaram maṇi janya vyāvṛtta anugata buddhiḥ asti jāti viṣayā tṛṇa janya tvena upādhinā sā iti ced na bādhakam vinā anugata buddheḥ tat vyaṅgya jāti viṣaya tva niyamāt na ca gomaya vṛścika prabhava vṛścika paramparāyām ananugata jātyāpattiḥ gomaya janya vṛścika prabhava vṛścikeṣu vṛścika prabhava tu ajāteḥ sattvāt vahni mātre ca dāha sparśavān avayavaḥ tad saṃyogaḥ pavana ādiḥ ca kāraṇāni na ca tṛṇa ādikam vinā api tad utpatti prasaḍgaḥ viśeṣa sāmagrīm ādāya eva sāmānya sāmagryāḥ janakatvāt

nanu tṛṇa araṇi maṇīnām vahnau kāraṇa tva grahe śakti vaijātyayoḥ anyatara kalpanam tad grahaḥ ca na anvaya vyatirekābhyām vyabhicārāt atha araṇi maṇī abhāvavati stoma viśeṣe tṛṇam vinā vahni vyatirekaḥ tṛṇa anvaye vahniḥ iti anvaya vyatirekābhyām tatra eva stome tad itarasakala hetu samavadhāne tṛṇa anvaye avaśyam vahniḥ iti niyata anvayena rāsabha ādi vyāvṛttena tṛṇa ādi kāraṇa tā grahaḥ iti ced na tṛṇam vinā api vahniḥ iti jñāne sati vahni niyata pūrva varti tvasya kāraṇa tvasya grahītum aśakyatvāt tṛṇājanye vahnau maṇeḥ kāraṇa tva grahaḥ iti ced na vyabhicāreṇa vahnau tṛṇa janya tva agrahe tad ajanya tvasya api agrahāt vahni mātrasya eva tad ajanya tvāt ca na ca maṇyajanya tvena tṛṇa janya tva grahaḥ anyaḥ anya āśrayāt

yat tu yatra kāraṇa tā grāhakam na asti tatra vyabhicāraḥ tad graha paripanthi iti tat na abādhita niyata pūrva varti tva abhāva grahe tad grahasya asambhavāt abhāva pramāyām bhāva jñāna anudayāt iti ucyate ukta grāhakaiḥ vahni niṣṭha kārya tā nirūpita kāraṇa tāvacchedaka rūpavat tvam tṛṇasya tṛṇa niṣṭha kāraṇa tā nirūpita kārya tāvacchedaka rūpavat tvam vahneḥ vā akārya akāraṇa vyāvṛttam rūpam paricchidyate na tu tṛṇa tvena kāraṇa tvam vahni tvena kārya tvam vā tat ca ubhayathā api sambhavati vahni tvena kārya tayā tad anukūla śaktima tvena ca tṛṇa ādīnām kāraṇa tayā vahni tva avāntara jāti viśeṣeṇa kārya tayā vā tatra vinigamakam uktam eva

atha tṛṇa araṇi maṇīnām abhāva traye na kāryam abhāva traya abhāve kāryam iti anvaya vyatireka abhyām abhāva traya abhāva tvena tṛṇa ādīnām kāraṇa tvam iti na vyabhicāraḥ abhāva abhāvasya bhāva paryavasanna tvāt iti ced abhāva traya abhāvaḥ kim tṛṇa ādi pratyeka vyāpakaḥ anyaḥ eva uta tṛṇa ādi pratyekam eva ādye abhāvasya kāraṇa tvam iti kim āyātam tṛṇa ādi kāraṇa tve dvitīye tṛṇasya na araṇi maṇya bhāva abhāva tvam tad ubhaya tva āpatteḥ etena abhāva traye na kāryam tad abhāve kāryam iti anvaya vyatirekābhyām tṛṇa ādi pratyekasya kāraṇa tva grahaḥ iti parāḥ tam

syāt etat mā bhūt sahaja śaktiḥ ādheya śaktiḥ tu syāt eva tathā hi vrīhīn prokṣati iti atra kāla antara kārya anukūlaḥ atīndriyaḥ atiśayaḥ prokṣaṇa janyaḥ asti iti ubhaya vādi siddham sa vrīhi samavetaḥ na vā iti saṃśaye vrīhi niṣṭhaḥ eva vācyaḥ katham anyathā prokṣitānām eva teṣām kāla antare avaghāta ādau viniyogaḥ na ca mantra ādi saha kṛta tvam eva vrīhiṣu viśeṣaḥ teṣām cira dhvasta tvāt

nanu katham prokṣitasya eva avaghāta ādau anyaḥ vrīhīn avahanti iti śruteḥ tad mātra anvaye api upapatteḥ atha vrīhibhiḥ yajeta vrīhīn prokṣati vrīhīn avahanti puroḍāśaiḥ yajeta iti atra yathā puroḍāśe prakṛti apekṣāyām avahata vrīhīṇām avayava anuvṛtti dvāra anvayaḥ prokṣaṇe ca yāga artham upātta vrīhiṇām tathā avaghāte vrīhi ākāṅkṣāyām prokṣitānām eva anvayaḥ bādhakam vinā śabdānām sannihita viśeṣa paratva niyamāt vyakti vacanānām sannihita viśeṣa paratvam iti nyāyāt anyathā prakaraṇa ādi sannihita tyāge tad anya sannidhi kalpane gauravam iti ced

na tarhi ekasya dvayam yatra prokṣaṇam tatra avaghātaḥ na tu prokṣaṇa viśiṣṭe yatra rūpam tatra rasaḥ iti vat tathā ca prokṣaṇasya śabdena kāla antara kārya janakatvā bodhāt katham tat nirvāha artham atiśaya kalpanam prokṣitāḥ vrīhayaḥ avaghātāya kalpante iti vākya śeṣāt prokṣaṇa viśiṣṭasya avaghāte kāraṇa avabodhaḥ iti ced astu tāvat evam tathā api prokṣitāḥ iti atra bhūte kta anuśāsanāt atīta prokṣaṇe vrīhau avaghāta anvayaḥ tathā ca avaghāte prokṣaṇa dhvaṃsaḥ kāraṇam na tu prokṣaṇam iti ced

mā evam prokṣaṇam avaghāta janakam pramāṇataḥ tad artham upādīyamāna tvāt avaghāte vrīhi vat na ca asiddhiḥ aprokṣite avaghāta abhāvat avaśyam avaghāta artham prokṣaṇa upādānāt na ca vyāpāram vinā tathā sambhavati na ca prokṣaṇa dhvaṃsaḥ eva vyāpāraḥ pratiyoginaḥ ahetutva āpātāt anyathā yāga ādau api tathā syāt phalasya ca niyata samaya utpattika tvam apūrvavat svabhāvāt eva bhaviṣyati na ca prokṣitāḥ vrīhayaḥ tathā niranvaya dhvasta tvena upalakṣaṇasya ahetutvāt kurūṇām kṣetram iti atra tu kuru jñānasya itara vyāvṛtta kṣetrajña vyavahāra janaka tvam na tu kuroḥ anyathā yāga upalakṣitaḥ yajvā eva svargam phaliṣyati kim apūrveṇa na ca devadatta ādi a śarīram devadatta viśeṣaṇa guṇa janyam janya tve sati tad bhoga sādhana tvāt tat nirmata sragvat iti tad siddhiḥ janma antarīyaiḥ adṛṣṭa janaka tva abhimataiḥ jñāna icchā prayatnaiḥ siddha sādhanāt

tasmāt prokṣaṇa ādayaḥ bhāva bhūtam atiśayam janayantaḥ eva kāla antara bhāvi kārya janakāḥ pramāṇataḥ tad artham upādīyamāna tvāt roga cikitsā vat sa ca atiśayaḥ lāghavāt phala samāna adhikaraṇaḥ iti vrīhi niṣṭhaḥ eva tena tad samavahita tvam vrīheḥ sākṣāt sambandhāt puruṣa niṣṭhatvena ca vrīhīṇām sākṣāt sambandha abhāvāt paramparā sambandhe gauravāt na sākṣāt vrīhi samavahita tvam syāt kiñca yaḥ yat gata phala arthi tayā kriyate sa bādhakam vinā tad gatam eva tat anukūlam atiśayam janayati roga cikitsā vat atha prokṣaṇam puruṣa samaveta atiśaya janakam kāla antara bhāvi kārya janaka tve sati vihita tvāt yāga vat anyathā vidhi virodhāt iti ced na kṛṣi cikitsā ādinā vyabhicārāt aprayojaka tvāt ca tena vinā api vidhi sambhavāt sa ca prativrīhi nānā eva na ca evam eka vrīhi nāśe phalān udayaḥ tāvat saṃskāraṇām abhāvāt iti vācyam saṃskāra tvena prayojaka tve kiñcid samavadhāne api daṇḍa ādi vat kārya sambhavāt

astu vā sakala vrīhi niṣṭhaḥ ekaḥ eva na ca eka vrīhi nāśe tad nāśāpattiḥ kiñcid āśraya nāśasya vṛkṣa ādau ivakārya nāśaka tvāt iti ucyate atiśaya grāhaka mānāt lāghava sahakṛtāt saḥ ekaḥ eva sidhyati na nānā puruṣa niṣṭhaḥ ca tathā hi prokṣaṇam apūrva janakam dṛṣṭa dvāra abhāve sati kāla antara bhāvi kārya janakatayā vihita tvāt yāga tad aṅga vat kṛṣi ādau dṛṣṭa dvāra sambhavāt na vyabhicāraḥ na vā aprayojaka tvam yāgadāna homa ādi tad aṅgānām apūrva janaka tve dṛṣṭa dvāra abhāvesati kāla antara bhāvi kārya janakatayā vihita tvasya eva prayojaka tvāt anyasya ananugamāt na ca yaḥ yat gata phala arthi tayā kriyate sa bādhakam vinā tad gatam eva tat anukūlam phalam janayati iti niyamaḥ śatru vadham uddiśya pravartite śyena yāga ādau vyabhicārāt vipakṣe bādhaka abhāvāt ca na ca yat uddeśena yat kriyate na tat tatra bhāvi kāryā anukūlā atiśaya janakam iti vyāptiḥ haviḥ tyāga ādibhiḥ vyabhicārāt

nanu prokṣita vrīhiṇā adṛṣṭasya janita tvāt barhiṣaḥ iva na tasya punar upayoga antaram syāt viniyukta viniyoga virodhāt upayoge vā tad jātīya antaram api upādīyeta aviśeṣāt na vrīhīn avahanti iti atra ukta nyāyena prokṣitasya eva vrīheḥ anvayāt vidheḥ durlaṅghya tvāt yathā barhiḥ tṛṇāti barhiṣi haviḥ āsādayati iti atra yat vā vicitrāḥ saṃskārāḥ kecid uddeśya sahakāriṇaḥ eva agrima kārya kāriṇaḥ yathā abhicāra saṃskāraḥ yam deham uddiśya prayuktaḥ tad apekṣaḥ eva tad sambaddhasya eva duḥkham janayati tathā prokṣaṇa saṃskārāḥ api uddeśya vrīhi saha kṛtāḥ eva agrim a kārya kartāraḥ yathā kārīri janita saṃskāra ādhāra puruṣa saṃyogāt jalam ucām a dṛṣṭa samavadhānam tathā prokṣaṇa janyā dṛṣṭa vat ātma saṃyogāt vrīhīṇām uttara kriyā viśeṣāḥ kartṛ karma sādhana vaiguṇyāt phala abhāvaḥ tulyaḥ eva āgāmika tvāt cāṇḍāla ādi sparśasya āhavanīya ādi saṃskāra nāśaka tva śruteḥ vyadhikaraṇasya api apūrva nāśaka tvam dharma nāśe karma nāśa apāra gamana vat niṣiddha kīrtana vat ca
