kiñca prokṣaṇa janyā atiśayaḥ vrīhi niṣṭhaḥ na nānā ātma vṛtteḥ ekasmāt api ukta nyāyena kārya upapatteḥ na api ekaḥ eka dvitra āśraya nāśānām pratyekam ananugamena kārya nāśe āśraya mātra nāśasya janaka tvāt eva vrīhi nāśena tad nāśāt apara prokṣita vrīhīṇām ananvaya āpatteḥ atha vrīhin prokṣatīti īpsitatama dvitīya aśruteḥ kriyā janyā iṣṭa phala bhāgi tvam vrīheḥ eva avagamyate na ca apūrvasya vrīhi vṛtti tvam sākṣāt sambandhasya eva autsargika tvāt iti ced na dhātu artha tāvacchedaka saṃyogena vrīhikarma tā upapatteḥ na ca saṃyoga avacchinnaḥ eva vyāpāra viśeṣaḥ prokṣaṇa arthaḥ tathā ca katham prokṣaṇa eka deśasya prokṣaṇa sādhyatayā anvayaḥ iti vācyam saṃyogasya upalakṣaṇa tvena āpadārtha tvāt anyathā grāmam gacchati ityādau kā gatiḥ kā vā saktūn prokṣati ityādau tatra ādheya śakti abhāvāt

kiñca ghaṭam sākṣātkaroti ityādau kriyā janya saṃskāra ādīnām ghaṭa vṛtti tvāt saṃskārasya svarūpa sambandhena ghaṭa vṛtti tvam vahnim anuminoti ityādi vat prayoga sādhuḥ eva vā dvitīyā iti yadi tadā prakṛte api tathā astu atha pratimā ādau pratiṣṭhā janyam na yajamāna adṛṣṭam pūjya tve prayojakam bhoga ādinā tad nāśe api pūjya tvāt tad sattve api cāṇḍāla ādi sparśena apūjya tvāt anya dharmam pratyanya dharmasya anupayogāt ca na ca pratiṣṭhā dhvaṃsaḥ tathā tatas eva upajīvya pratiṣṭhā prayojaka tva bhaṅga āpatteḥ ca tasmāt pratiṣṭhā janyāḥ aspṛśya sparśa ādi nāśyā pratimā ādi niṣṭhā śaktiḥ abhyupeyāḥ iti ced pratiṣṭhā vidhinā pratimā ādau devatā sannidhiḥ ahaṅkāra m amakāra rūpaḥ kriyate sva sādṛśya darśinaḥ citra ādau iva jñānasya nāśe api saṃskāra sattvāt aspṛśya sparśa ādinā ca tad nāśaḥ acetana devatā pakṣe ca yathā artha pratiṣṭhita pratyabhijñānasya aspṛśya sparśa ādi viraha saha kṛtasya tathātvam pratiṣṭhitam yūjayet iti vidhi balāt tad tad pratisandhānasya āvaśyaka tvāt iti prāñcaḥ

navyāḥ tu pratiṣṭhā vidhinā eva tava ādheya śakti vat apūrva antaram janyate tad adṛṣṭa vat ātma saṃyoga aśrasya pūjya tvam aspṛśya sparśena tad nāśe ca apūjya tvam iti āhuḥ vayantu brūmaḥ pratiṣṭhitam pūjayet iti vidhi vākyena pratiṣṭhāyāḥ kāraṇa tvam na bodhyate kintu bhūta arthe kta anuśāsanāt atīta pratiṣṭhāyām pūjya tvam bodhyate tathā ca pratiṣṭhā dhvaṃsaḥ pratiṣṭhākā ālīnaya avada spṛśya sparśa ādi pratiyogikānādi kāla saṃsarga abhāva sahitaḥ pūjya tva prayojakaḥ sa ca prāc abhāvaḥ atyanta abhāvaḥ ca kvacid kāminī caraṇa abhighāta dohada ādibhiḥ aśoka puṣpa utkarṣa darśanāt api na ādheya śakti siddhiḥ samaya viśeṣa avacchinna caraṇa dohat ādi saṃyoga dhvaṃsasya eva kāraṇa tvāt caraṇa abhighāta ādi ākṛṣṭa bhāga antara janita vṛkṣāt eva vā tad upapatteḥ kāla antare puṣpa ādi utkarṣāt vṛkṣa avayava upacaya avaśyambhāvena vṛkṣa bheda āvaśyaka tvāt na api tāmra kāṃsi a ādau astu bhasma saṃyoga ādi janya śuddhi rūpā ādheya śaktiḥ tad saṃyoga dhvaṃsasya saṃyoga samāna kālīna aspṛśya sparśa ādi pratiyogikayā vadana ādi saṃsarga abhāva sahitasya śuddhi padārtha tvāt

bhasma ādi saṃyoga janitaḥ kāṃsya ādi upabhoga kartṛ niṣṭhaḥ saṃskāraḥ eva śuddhiḥ iti anye abhimantrita payaḥ pallava ādau api samaya viśeṣa avacchinna abhimantraṇa dhvaṃsaḥ eva vyathā ādi apanāyakaḥ tad tad mantra devatā sannidhiḥ eva vā kalama bīja ādīnām āparamāṇu anta bhaṅge tatra ca avāntara jāteḥ abhāve niyata kalama jātīya ādi siddhiḥ api paramāṇu pāka ja viśeṣāt eva kārya vṛtti rūpa ādi sajātīyasya pūrvarūpa vijātīyasya paramāṇau pākaja rūpa ādeḥ ubhaya siddha tvāt yathā hi kalama bījam yava ādeḥ jātyā vyāvartate tathā tad paramāṇavaḥ api pākajaiḥ eva evam māgha karṣaṇa ādi janitāt paramāṇu pāka paramparā viśeṣā deva haimantika sasya utpattiḥ

etena lākṣā rasa avaseka ādayoḥ vyākhyātāḥ nimitta viśeṣa janita pāka jāt tad tad phala viśeṣaḥ yathā hārīta māṃsam harindra anala sādhitam upayogāt sadyas vyāpādayati na anyathā sādhitam ityādi yatra ca toya tejaḥ vāyuṣu na pāka jaḥ viśeṣaḥ tatra udbhavān udbhava drava tva kaṭhina tva ādayaḥ viśeṣāḥ tad upanāyaka adṛṣṭa viśeṣāt eva tulā ādau ca adhivāsa ādi pūrvaka tulā ārohaṇa sāmagrī tulyasya satya asatya pratijña tva sahitā prācīna dharma adharma phale tad jaya bhaṅgau janayati yat vā aham niṣpāpaḥ pāpavān vā iti tulā adhirūḍha abhiśasta jñāna viśeṣa sahitā sā tathā

tat āhuḥ tān tu devāḥ prapaśyanti svaḥ ca eva antara pūruṣaḥ iti atha vā pratijñā aśuddhi aśuddhī apekṣyatayā dharma adharmau janyete tābhyāñca jaya parājayau satya asatya pratijña abhiśasta tulā ārohaṇasya iṣṭā aniṣṭa phala tvena arthataḥ vidhi niṣedhāt abhiśastaḥ satya pratijñaḥ vijaya kāmaḥ tulām ārohet asati apratijñaḥ na tulām arohet iti śruteḥ unnayanāt yat vā tayā devatā sannidhiḥ kriyate tāḥ ca karma anurūpam liṅgam abhivyañcayanti

kaḥ tarhi śakti padārthaḥ kāraṇa tvam tat ca svasva vyāpi a itara sakala sampattau kārya abhāva vyāpaka abhāva pratiyogi tvam atha vā yatra kārya abhāva vyāpya tā itara abhāva avacchinnā tad kāraṇam bīje aṅkura abhāva vyāpya tā na bīja tvena avacchidyate itara sam avadhāne sati bījāt aṅkura sambhavāt ki yat vā anyāsam avadhāna avacchinna kārya an utpatti vyāpya tvam kāraṇa tvam rāsabha ādeḥ svatas eva kārya abhāva vyāpya tā anyāsam avadhānasya vaiyarthyena anavacchedaka tvāt ananyathā siddha niyata pūrva varti jātīya tvam vā tattvam

anyathā asiddha tvañca tridhā yena saha eva yasya yam prati pūrva varti tvam avagamyate yathā ghaṭam prati daṇḍa rūpasya anyam prati pūrva varti tve jñātaḥ eva yam prati yasya pūrva varti tvam avagamyate yathā śabdam prati pūrva varti tve jñātaḥ eva jñānam pratyākāśasya anyatra kḷpta niyata pūrva vartinaḥ eva kārya sambhave tad saha bhūta tvam yathā gandhavati gandha anutpādāt gandham prati tad prāgabhāvasya niyata pūrva varti tva kalpanāt pākaja sthale gandham prati na tu avagamyamāne yatra janyasya pūrva varti tve avagate janakasya pūrva bhāvaḥ avagamyate tatra janyena janakasya anyathā siddhiḥ

yatra ca janakasya tathātve avagate janyasya pūrva bhāva avagamaḥ tatra tad dvārā tasya janaka tvam eva sati tu jāyate tad jātīyam prati tat ananyathā siddham ananyathā siddha niyata pūrva varti tvam kāraṇa tvam iti anye tat na īśvara tad buddhi ādīnām asaṃgrahāt tad vyatirekasya tad samavadhāna vyatirekasya vā abhāvāt kāryasya anyathā anupapadyamāna tā vyavasthāpya tvam vā ananyathā siddha tvam nanu evam atirikta śaktau sādhaka bādhaka pramāṇa abhāvāt nityam saṃśayaḥ na ca sādhaka abhāvasya bādhaka tvam bādhaka abhāvasya api sādhaka tvāt iti ced na sādhaka abhāvena vahnau anyatra siddha

parama prayojanam anumānasya apavargaḥ ātmā vai are śrotavyaḥ mantavyaḥ nididhyāsitavyaḥ sākṣāt kartavyaḥ iti śruteḥ sa ca samāna adhikaraṇa duḥkha prāc abhāva asaha vṛtti duḥkha dhvaṃsaḥ nanu na asau puruṣa arthaḥ atīta duḥkha ghu aṃsasya siddha tvāt anāgata duḥkhasya dhvaṃsayitum aśakyatvāt vartamānasya puruṣa prayatnam vinā eva virodhi guṇa nāśya tvāt atīta duḥkha vat hetu ucchede puruṣa vyāpāraḥ prāyaścitta vat iti ced na tat kim hetu ucchedasya sukha duḥkha abhāva itara tvena svatas apuruṣa artha tvāt anāgatā anutpādam uddiśya kriyamāṇa tvāt ca yathā tatra duḥkha anutpādaḥ puruṣa arthaḥ tathā iha api iti vivakṣitam atha anutpādasya prāc abhāva tvena asādhya tvāt phala antarasya abhāvat ca ananya gatika tayā kaṇṭaka nāśa vat duḥkha sādhana nāśaḥ eva svatas puruṣa arthaḥ tathā iha api iti vā ubhayathā api duḥkha dhvaṃsasyā puruṣa artha tvam eva na ca tayoḥ api puruṣa artha tvam iti vakṣyate

mā evam duḥkha antara dhvaṃsasya āyatna sādhya tve api tādṛśa duḥkha dhvaṃsasya mithyājñāna uccheda dvārā puruṣa prayatna adhīna tattva jñāna sādhya tvāt tathā hi tattva jñānāt savāsana mithyā jñāna abhāve doṣa an utpattau pravṛti abhāve adṛṣṭa anutpattau janma abhāve tādṛśa duḥkha dhvaṃsaḥ bhavati atha carama duḥkhe utpanne tad dhvaṃsaḥ tad jñānāt eva bhaviṣyati tad anutpāde ca tattva jñānāt api na syāt iti ced na pratiyogi vat tattva jñānasya api tad hetu tvāt tulya vat ubhayoḥ api kāraṇa tvāt tena vinā tad nutpatteḥ atas eva śukasya tattva jñānam utpannam iti tasya tat dhvaṃsaḥ utpannaḥ na asmad ādīnām iti ced anādau saṃsāre tat kutas na utpannam sva kāraṇa abhāvāt iti ced na anvaya vyatireka anuvidhāyinaḥ tattva jñānāt anyasya anviṣyamāṇasya abhāvāt muktau sa dhvaṃsaḥ asti eva tasmin sati muktiḥ asti eva iti sa mukti utpādaka utpādya iti sarva vādī upagatam muktiḥ sā anyā vā

nanu evam dhvaṃsa artham duḥkham upādeyam tad anutpādya dhvaṃsa anutpādāt iti ced satyam puruṣa artha heta tvena loke duḥkha tad sādhanayoḥ api upādāna darśanāt anāgata kumbha nāśa artham mudgara ādau pravṛtti darśanāt anāgata duḥkha dhvaṃsa artham api pravṛttiḥ carama duḥkha dhvaṃsaḥ na duḥkha dhvaṃsa tvena uddeśyaḥ ayatna siddha duḥkha antara dhvaṃsa vat apuruṣa artha tvāt iti ced na samāna adhikaraṇa duḥkha prāc abhāva asaha vṛtti duḥkha dhvaṃsa tvena tasya uddeśya tvāt duḥkha asambhinna sukha vat tasya ca puruṣa prayatna sādhya tvam eva iti uktam

etena duḥkha dhvaṃsa tvam eva mokṣa tvam tad tad ātma yāvat duḥkha dhvaṃsa samvalana daśāyantu tathā vyapadeśaḥ prati puruṣam duḥkha dhvaṃsa stomasya vyakti sthānīya tvāt tejaḥ bhāve samvalite andhatama sapada prayoga vat yathā samvalitaḥ eva dvau iti buddhi vyapadeśau pravṛttiḥ api samvalana artham iti apāstam militānām asādhya tvāt melakasya anatirikta tve ati prasaṅgāt atirikta tve janyasya dhvaṃsa āvṛtteḥ ajanyasya puruṣa artha tva abhāvāt sādhya tayā saṃvalane bhoga avaśyam bhāvāt andhatamasā ādau tathā samvalaḥ eva prayogāt etena saṃskāra ajanaka bhoga viṣaya duḥkha dhvaṃsaḥ saṃskāra ajanaka anubhava dhvaṃsaḥ vā muktiḥ na ca ati vyāptiḥ janakatvasya ajanayati api bhāvāt iti nirastam apuruṣa artha tvāt

anye tu duḥkha prāc abhāva asaha vṛtti duḥkha sādhana dhvaṃsaḥ mokṣaḥ loke ahi kaṇṭaka ādi nāśasya vaidike prāyaścitta ādau pāpa nāśasya ananya gatika tayā duḥkha sādhana dhvaṃsa tvena puruṣa artha tvāt atha ahikaṇṭaka ādi pāpam vā nāśyatām tena tat janyam duḥkham na bhavati iti duḥkha anutpādam uddiśya pravṛtteḥ duḥkha anutpādaḥ eva prayojanam na tu duḥkha sādhana abhāvaḥ sukha duḥkha bhāva itara tvāt iti ced na duḥkha anutpādasya prāc abhāva tvena anāditayā asādhya tvāt na ca tad pālanam sādhyam pālanam hi na tad svarūpam tasya asādhya tvāt na uttara samaya sambandhaḥ abhāve sambandhi dvaya atiriktasya tasya aprāmāṇika tvāt anabhyuparamāt ca na api sambandhi dvaya svarūpam sādhyam prāgabhāvasya api asādhya tvāt samaya tad upādhyoḥ ca prayatnam vinā eva siddheḥ

atha duḥkhe dveṣāt yathā tad bhāve icchā tathā duḥkha sādhane dveṣāt tad abhāve api icchā tayā tad sādhane pravṛttiḥ iti ced na yat icchayā yat sādhane yasya pravṛttiḥ tasya eva tad prayojana tvam iti duḥkha sādhana abhāvasya eva prayojana tvāt atha cikirṣa ayoni prayatne prayojana jñāna apekṣā tena vinā upāye cikīrṣā virahāt na tu dveṣa yoni yatne aniṣṭa sādhana tā jñānāt ahikaṇṭaka ādau dveṣaḥ dveṣāt tad nāśa anukūlaḥ yatnaḥ utpadyate ayam eva hi dveṣa svabhāvaḥ yat pratibandhakam vinā sva viṣaya nāśa anukūlam yatnam utpādayati anyathā prayatna dvaividhya anupapatteḥ atas eva phalam vinā eva utkaṭa krodha andhānām ātma ghāte pravṛttiḥ iti ced na prayojanam anuddiśya dveṣa mātrāt duḥkha eka phalake prekṣāvatām prayatna anutpādāt krodhāndhanām api tātkālikaḥ phala abhimānaḥ asti eva utkaṭa rāga andhānām iva para dāra ādau api pravṛtteḥ iti

tat na duḥkham me mā bhūt iti uddiśya prāyaścitta ādau pravṛtteḥ duḥkha anutpādasya eva prayojana tvāt na ca prāc abhāvasya asādhya tvam duḥkha sādhana vighaṭana dvārā tasya api kṛti sādhya tvāt duḥkha sādhana samavadhāna daśāyām kṛtau satyām duḥkha sādhana nāśe satya grima samaye prāc abhāva svarūpam asti tena vinā na asti iti anvaya vyatirekayoḥ tatra sattvāt ghaṭe api kṛtau satyām agri makṣaṇe tat sattvam tayā vinā na iti eva kṛti sādhya tvam na tu prāc asataḥ agri makṣaṇe sattvam utpattiḥ gauravāt kṛtim vinā na yat svarūpam tad kṛti sādhyam tad prāgabhāva svarūpantu na tathā iti ced na kṛti dhvaṃse api ghaṭa sattvena agri makṣaṇe iti āvaśyaka tvāt atas eva yoga vat kṣemasya api anāgata aniṣṭa anutpāda janakasya parīkṣaka pravṛtti viṣaya tvam iti vakṣyate niṣedha apūrva prastāve

nanu prāyaścitta nāśya pāpa janya duḥkhasya prāgabhāvaḥ yadi asti tadā duḥkham āvaśyakam tasya pratiyogi janaka tva niyamāt na asti ced tarhi tad abhāvāt eva duḥkha anutpādaḥ iti ubhayathā api prāyaścittam aphalam tasmāt duḥkha sādhana dhvaṃsa mukhena prāgabhāvasya sādhyatā iti tatra eva kṛti sādhya tva paryavasānāt duḥkha sādhana dhvaṃsaḥ eva puruṣa arthaḥ na tu duḥkha anutpāda arthitayā iti tatra prāgabhāva sattva asattva vicāraḥ vāyasa darśana vicāra vat

atha tadā api prāgabhāvasya asattve tad abhāvāt pāpam na duḥkha sādhanam iti na tad nāśa artham pravartate tasya sattve ca pāpam ādāya eva tasya duḥkha utpādaka tva niyamāt prāyaścitte sati api gale pādikayā pāpa avasthānam iti na tatas pāpa nāśaḥ iti ced na prāgabhāvasya asattve api duḥkha sādhana jātīya nāśasya puruṣa artha tvāt sattve api pāpa antaram ādāya api tasya duḥkha janaka tva sambhavāt prāyaścittāt pāpa nāśaḥ syāt eva iti prāgabhāva sattva asattva sandehe api prāyaścitta ādau pravṛttiḥ apratyūha eva iti

ucyate tatra duḥkha prāc abhāvaḥ asti eva tasya eva duḥkha anutpāda rūpa tvena puruṣa artha tvāt sa ca pāpa nāśa dvārā prāyaścitta sādhyaḥ iti prāgabhāva satvepi na niṣphalam prāyaścittam tena prāc abhāvena duḥkham avaśyam jananīyam iti ced satyam kintu pāpa antaram āsādya na ca evam prāyaścittam aphalam duḥkha anutpādena tasya saphala tvāt na ca duḥkha anutpādasya api duḥkha anutpāda antaram eva phalam tat ca tatra na asti iti aphala tvam svarūpa satas eva tasya puruṣa artha tvāt anavasthānāt ca atas anena pāpena duḥkham me mā bhūt iti vidyamāna pāpa nāśa artham prāyaścitte pravṛttiḥ

etena cīrṇa prāyaścitte duḥkha prāgabhāvaḥ na asti eva anyathā tasya pratiyogi nāśya tvena anirmokṣa prasaṅgāt na ca prāyaścitta vaiphalyam na vā bhagavataḥ duḥkha maya karma upadeśaka tvena anāpta tvam tasya pāpa dhvaṃsena eva saphala tvāt prāc abhāva aniścaye api naraka sādhana pāpa niścayāt tad nāśa artham pravṛttiḥ iti apāstam duḥkha sādhana dhvaṃsasya svatas apuruṣa artha tvāt pāpa antareṇa tad pratiyogi janane tad nāśāt tasmāt duḥkham me mā bhūt iti uddiśya tad sādhana dhvaṃsa artham pravṛttiḥ iti duḥkha anutpādaḥ eva puruṣa arthaḥ na tu duḥkha sādhana dhvaṃsaḥ iti sthitam api ca na tāvat duḥkha maya saṃsāra bīja mithyājñānasya dhvaṃsaḥ muktiḥ tattva jñānāt tad nāśe api śarīra dharma ādi sattva daśāyām mukti prasaṅgāt na api śarīra indriya buddhi ādi tad nidāna dharma adharma dhvaṃsaḥ acīrṇa prāyaścitta karmaṇām bhoga eka nāśya tvena tattva jñāna anāśya tvāt bhoga dvārā tad nāśasya ca apuruṣa artha tvāt iti

apare tu duḥkha atyanta abhāvaḥ muktiḥ yadi api para duḥkha atyanta abhāvaḥ svatas siddhaḥ eva sva duḥkha atyanta abhāvaḥ sva ātmani asambhavī ghaṭa ādau ati prasaktaḥ asādhyaḥ ca tathā api duḥkha sādhana dhvaṃsaḥ eva sva vṛtti duḥkha atyanta abhāva sambandhaḥ sa ca sādhyaḥ eva na ca evam āvaśyaka tvena saḥ eva muktiḥ tasya svatas apuruṣa artha tvena duḥkha abhāvam uddiśya tatra pravṛtteḥ duḥkhena atyantam vimuktaḥ carati iti atra atyanta abhāva tvena mukti śravaṇāt ca yadi api duḥkha sādhana dhvaṃsaḥ na puruṣa arthaḥ atyanta abhāvaḥ ca na sādhyaḥ tathā api viśiṣṭasya puruṣa artha tvam viśeṣaṇa sādhya tvena viśiṣṭa sādhyatvañca ahikaṇṭaka ādi nāśasya api tad tad vyakti sādhya duḥkha atyanta abhāvam uddiśya tad sambandha tvena eva sādhyatā iti

tat na adharma ādi duḥkha sādhana dhvaṃsasya na mukti nirvāhaka tvam iti ukta tvāt kiñca nānāgata sva vṛtti duḥkhasya atyanta abhāva sambandhaḥ sādhyaḥ muktasya anāgata sva vṛtti duḥkhasya anabhyupagamāt abhyupagame vā amukta tva āpātāt atyanta abhāva sambandha virodhāt ca na api utpannasya sva vṛtti duḥkhasya tad vṛtteḥ tatra atyanta abhāva sambandha virodhāt tad abhāvasya svatas siddha tvāt atīta duḥkha abhāvasya anuddeśya tvāt ca na api parakīya duḥkha atyanta abhāva sambandhaḥ tasya svatas siddha tvāt api ca duḥkha sādhana dhvaṃsasya na atyanta abhāva sambandha tve mānam asti duḥkha sādhana dhvaṃsā dau asya duḥkhasya atyanta abhāvaḥ iti buddhi vyapadeśau staḥ iti ced na tasya samāna adhikaraṇa duḥkha asamāna kāla duḥkha abhāva viṣaya tvena api upapattau atirikta sambandha aviṣaya tvāt

etena sarva duḥkha prāc abhāva saṃsarga abhāvaḥ muktiḥ ghaṭa ādeḥ ca na mukta tvam duḥkha sādhana dhvaṃsa viśeṣita etat yoginaḥ mukta padārtha tvāt tathā eva vyavahārāt yoga rūḍhibhyām paṅkaja ādi pada vācya tva vat iti nirastam prāc abhāva saṃsarga abhāvasya svataḥ anuddeśya tvāt pratyuta atyanta abhāvasya asādhya tvena dhvaṃsa rūpa tvena tasya duḥkha rūpa tayā heya tvāt

prābhākarāḥ tu ātyantika duḥkha prāgabhāvaḥ muktiḥ na ca tasya anādi tvena apuruṣa artha tvam kadācid kṛti anapekṣa tve api pratiyogi janaka adharma nāśa mukhena tasya kṛti sādhya tvāt kṛtī adhīna tattva jñānāt adharma nāśe satya grima samaye duḥkha prāgabhāva svarūpat na asti tayā vinā adharmeṇa duḥkha ājananāt na tad prāgabhāva svarūpam asti iti ghaṭa vat kṛti sādhya tvāt vyavasthāpitañca tvayā prāgabhāvasya kṛti sādhya tva mahikaṇṭaka ādi nāśa prāyaścitta kṣema arthi pravṛtti sthale na ca evam yugapad a dharma dhvaṃsaḥ eva muktiḥ prāgabhāvasya anāditayā vivakṣita vivekena tatra eva kṛti sādhya tva paryavasānāt iti vācyam adharma dhvaṃsasya svatas apuruṣa artha tvāt duḥkha anutpāda hetu tvena eva tasya prayojana tā vācyā sā ca katham asādhya tve prāgabhāvasya syāt iti atas eva duḥkha janma ityādi sūtram api saṃgacchate anyathā mithyājñāna ādi anutpādānām duḥkha anutpāda ahetu tvena asaṅgatam syāt iti āsthiṣatā iti

tad atisthavīyaḥ tathā hi astu prāgabhāvasya sādhya tvam tathā api tasya pratiyogi janaka tva niyamāt muktasya api duḥkha utpāda prasaḍgaḥ adharma śarīra ādi sahakāri virahāt na duḥkha utpāda prasaṅgaḥ iti ced tarhi uttara avadhi vidhura tvena anādeḥ atyanta abhāva tva āpattau prāc abhāva tva vyākopaḥ pratiyogi janaka nāśya jātīya tvena tatra prāc abhāva tva vyapadeśaḥ vastutas nityaḥ eva saḥ iti ced na nitya tvena atyanta abhāva rūpa tayā pratiyogi janaka nāśa mukhena tasya asādhya tvāt ca

api ca mukteḥ prāgabhāvasya samāna adhikaraṇam bhāvi duḥkham na pratiyogi tasya abhāvāt bhāve vā amukta tva āpātāt na api samāna adhikaraṇam atītam vartamānañca tad prāgabhāvasya vinaṣṭa tvāt na api vyadhikaraṇam anya vṛtti duḥkhasya anyatra atyanta abhāvena prāc abhāvāt tasya pratiyogi samāna deśa tvāt na ca duḥkha mātram pratiyogi sva parāvṛtteḥ duḥkha mātrasya aprāmaṇika tvāt tasya atyanta asataḥ nitya nivṛtta tvena tad nivṛttaye prekṣāvat pravṛtti anupapatteḥ ahikaṇṭaka ādi nāśa prāyaścitta ādi sādhya duḥkha prāgabhāvasya kalañja bhakṣaṇa prāgabhāvasya ca samāna adhikaraṇam eva bhāvi duḥkham bhakṣaṇañca pratiyogi

nanu duḥkha abhāvaḥ na puruṣa arthaḥ sukhasya api hāneḥ tulyāyavyaya tvāt na ca bahutara duḥkha anuviddha tayā sukhasya api prekṣā vadheya tvam āvaśyaka tvena duḥkhasya eva heya tvāt sukhasya nirupadhi icchā viṣaya tvāt anyathā duḥkhān anuviddha tayā tathātvena puruṣa artha tva virodhāt iti ced na sukham anuddiśya api duḥkha bhīrūṇām duḥkha hāna artham pravṛtti darśanāt duḥkha abhāvasya svatas eva puruṣa artha tvāt na hi duḥkha abhāva daśāyām sukham asti iti uddiśya duḥkha hāna artham pravartate vaiparītyasya api sambhave sukhasya api apuruṣa artha tva āpatteḥ atas duḥkha abhāva daśāyām sukham na asti iti jñānam na duḥkha abhāva arthi pravṛtti pratibandhakam tasmāt avivekinaḥ sukha mātra lipsavaḥ bahutara duḥkha anuviddham api sukham uddiśya śiraḥ madīyam yadi yāti yātu kṛtvā para dāra ādiṣu pravartamānāḥ varam vṛndāvane ramye ityādi vadantaḥ na atra adhikariṇaḥ

ye ca vivekinaḥ asmin saṃsāra kāntāre kiyanti duḥkha durddināni kiyatī sukha khadyotiketī kupita phaṇi phaṇā maṇḍala chāyā pratimam idam iti manyamānāḥ sukham api hātum icchanti te atra adhikāriṇaḥ na ca bhoga arthi nām apravṛttau puruṣa artha tā hīyate kasyacid apravṛttau api cikitsā ādeḥ puruṣa artha tvāt atha duḥkha abhāvaḥ api na āvedyaḥ puruṣa arthatayā iṣyate na hi mūrchā ādi avastha artham pravṛttaḥ ddaśyate sudhīḥ

puruṣa artha tve sukha vat jñāyamāna tva niyamāt na ca muktau jñānam sambhavati iti ced na hi duḥkha abhāvam jānīyām iti uddiśya pravṛttiḥ kintu duḥkham me mā bhūt iti uddiśya iti atas duḥkhasya abhāvaḥ eva puruṣa arthaḥ tasya jñānañca sva kāraṇa adhīnam na tu puruṣa artha tā upayogi sukhī syām iti uddiśya pravartate na tu sukham jānīyam iti sukham eva tathā astu na tu tad avagamaḥ tasya āvaśyaka tvena anyathā siddha tvāt gauravāt ca

kiñca bahutara duḥkha jarjara kalevarāḥ duḥkha abhāvam uddiśya maraṇe api pravartamānāḥ dṛśyante na ca maraṇe tasya jñānam asti na te vivekinaḥ iti ced na puruṣa artha tve viveka anupayogāt kiñca carama duḥkha anubhave anāgata duḥkha dhvaṃsaḥ api viṣayaḥ tathā ca agri makṣaṇe tad uparamaḥ tad viṣayaka tvañca vinaśyat avastham jñānam asti iti vartamānam api aciram anubhūyate jñāna samaye mukti lakṣaṇasya sattvāt na jñānam mukti virodhi pramāṇantu duḥkha tvam deva datta duḥkha tvam vā sva āśraya asamāna kālīna dhvaṃsa pratiyogi vṛtti kārya mātra vṛtti dharma tvāt santati tvāt vā etat pradīpa vat santati tvañca nānā kālīna kārya mātra vṛtti dharma tvam evam sukha tva ādau api sādhyam tena sakala ucchede mokṣeḥ na ca aprayojaka tvam

santati ucchede mūla ucchedasya prayojaka tvāt prakṛte ca mithyājñānasya saṃsāra mūlasya śravaṇa ādi krameṇa utpanna tattva jñānāt nivṛttiḥ sambhavati eva ātmā jñātavyaḥ na sa punar āvartate iti śrutiḥ ca pramāṇam rātri satra nyona artha vāda upanīta punarāvṛtteḥ adhikāri viśeṣaṇa tvāt saḥ ātma jñaḥ na punar āvartate na punar śarīrī bhavati iti arthaḥ ātmā vai are śrotavyaḥ mantavyaḥ nididhyāsitavyaḥ sākṣāt kartavyaḥ iti upakramya duḥkhena atyantam vimuktaḥ carati iti śrutiḥ ca mānam

ācāryāḥ tu aśarīram vāvasantam priya apriye na spṛśataḥ iti śrutiḥ tatra pramāṇam vāvasantam iti yaṅluki tena saṃsāritādaśāyām kṣaṇa mātram aśarīra tvena na anyathā siddhiḥ nanu dvandva svarasena milita sukha duḥkha ubhaya niṣedhaḥ pratīyate sa tu nitya vat prāptaḥ eva ekaika niṣedhe ca vākya bheda āpattiḥ na ca muktau pramāṇam iti ced na dvi tvena ekena rūpeṇa upasthitayoḥ pratyekam niṣedha anvaye api vākya bheda abhāvāt dhava khadirau chindhi iti atra pratyekam chidā anvayaḥ iva na hi tatra milita chidā api ca na priya apriya rūpam kiñcitasti iti milita niṣedhaḥ api ekaika anvaye pratyeka abhāve vā bhavet tatra eka anvayasya aśarīre ayogya tvāt pratyeka abhāvaḥ eva paryavasyati atas eva sarva muktiḥ api sarva duḥkha santati pakṣīkaraṇe tad siddheḥ anyathā muktiḥ api na syāt tatra eva vyabhicārāt

yadi ca ubhaya ātmānaḥ eva kecid tadā tad śaṅkayā mokṣa artham na kaścid pravarteta śama dama bhoga an abhiṣvaṅga ādi mukti cihnena śruti siddhena sandeha nivṛttiḥ iti ced na saṃsāri tvena mukti yogya tvāt na tu tad viśeṣaṇa śama ādimattvena sāmānye bādhake sati eva yogyatāyāḥ viśeṣa niṣṭha tvāt kiñca śama ādayaḥ śrutau sahakāritayā bodhitāḥ na tu yogyatayā tattve api saṃsāri tvena te api sādhanīyāḥ śama ādikam api hi kāryam tatra api saṃsāri tvena eva yogyatā sāmānye bādhaka abhāvāt

na ca nitya sukha abhivyaktiḥ muktiḥ sā hi na nityā mukta saṃsāriṇoḥ aviśeṣa prasaṅgāt na utpādyā tad hetu śarīra ādi abhāvāt jñāna mātre sukha mātre vā tad hetutva avadhāraṇāt na ca saṃsāri daśāyām tad hetuḥ sāmānye bādhaka abhāvāt atas eva svarga ādau śarīra kalpanā kiñca tad janakam na tāvat ātma manaḥ yogaḥ tasya adṛṣṭa ādi nirapekṣasya ajanaka tvāt viṣaya mātrapekṣaṇe tu saṃsāridaśāyām api tad abhivyakti prasaḍgaḥ na api yoga jaḥ dharmaḥ sahakārī tasya utpanna bhāva tvena vināśi tve apavarga nivṛtti āpatteḥ na ca tad janyā abhivyaktiḥ anantā tasyāḥ api atas eva nāśāt

atha tattva jñānāt savāsana mithyā jñāna nāśe doṣa abhāvena pravṛtti ādi abhāvāt dharma adharmayoḥ anutpāde prācīna dharma adharma kṣayāt duḥkha sādhana śarīra ādi nāśaḥ eva tatra hetuḥ atas eva tasya ānantyena abhivyakti pravāhaḥ api anantaḥ iti ced na śarīram vinā tad anutpatteḥ tasya tad hetu tve māna abhāvāt ca na ca mokṣa arthi pravṛttiḥ eva tatra mānam duḥkha hāna arthitayā api tad utpatteḥ na ca nitye sukhe mānam asti nityam vijñānam ānandam brahmā ānandam brahmaṇaḥ rūpam tat ca mokṣe pratiṣṭhitam ityādi śrutiḥ mānaḥ i atha sukhasya brahma abheda bodhanāt eva ayogya tā anityam sukham vihāya vākya artha tvena nitya sukha siddhiḥ svarga vat na tu nitye sukhe siddhe tad abheda bodhanam

yena anyonya āśrayaḥ yat vā nityam sukham bodhayitvā tat abhinnam brahma bodhyate na ca vākya bhedaḥ vākya eka vākya tvāt iti ced na ātmanaḥ anubhūyamāna tvena tat abhinnasya nitya sukhasya api anubhava prasaṅgāt sukha mātrasya sva gocara sākṣātkāra janaka tva niyamāt tad ananubhave vā ātmanaḥ api anubhavaḥ na syāt atha ātmā bhinnam nitya sukham anubhūyate eva sukha tvam tu tatra na anubhūyate iti ced na sukha anubhava sām agrāḥ eva sukha tva anubhāvaka tvāt tasmāt ānandam brahma iti matu arthīyāt pratyaya anta tvena andavat tvam bodhyam tena abhedaḥ anyathā napuṃsa kaliṅga tva anupapatteḥ

etena brahmā dvaita sākṣāt kārāt avidyā nivṛttau vijñāna sukha ātmakaḥ kevalaḥ ātmā apavarge vartate iti vedāntimatam apāstam sva prakāśa sukha ātmaka brahmaṇaḥ nitya tvena mukta saṃsāriṇoḥ aviśeṣa prasaṅgāt puruṣa prayatnam vinā tasya sattvāt apuruṣa artha tvāt ca a tridaṇḍinaḥ tu ānanda maya paramātmani jīva ātma layaḥ mokṣaḥ layaḥ ca liṅga śarīra apagamaḥ liṅga śarīrañca ekādaśa indriyāṇi pañca mahābhūtāni sūkṣma mātrayā sambhūya avasthitāni jīva ātmani sukha duḥkha avacchedakāni iti āhuḥ tat na liṅga śarīra dhvaṃsasya svatas duḥkha sādhana abhāva tayā apuruṣa artha tvāt na ca upādhi śarīra nāśe aupādhika jīva nāśaḥ layaḥ sva nāśasya apuruṣa artha tvāt brahmaṇaḥ nitya tvena tat abhinnasya nāśa anupapatteḥ bheda abhedasya ca virodhena abhāvāt

na api anupaplavā cit santatiḥ apavargaḥ āvaśyaka tvena anupaplavasya duḥkha abhāvasya puruṣa artha tvena cit santateḥ aparuṣa artha tvāt śarīra ādi kāraṇam vinā cit santateḥ anutpādāt ca na hi cittamātram tad sāmagrī śarīra ādi vaiyarthya āpatteḥ na api duḥkha hetu tvena ātmanaḥ hānam eva muktiḥ sukha duḥkha abhāva itara tvena apuruṣa artha tvāt jñāna rūpa ātma hānasya āyatna siddheḥ atirikta hānasya aśakya tvāt

yat tu yogā ṛddhi sādhya niratiśaya ānanda mayīm jīvanmuktim uddiśya pravṛtteḥ kāraṇa vaśāt ātyantika duḥkha abhāva rūpām muktim āsādayati iti matam tat na parama mukteḥ apuruṣa artha tva āpatteḥ viraktasya mokṣe adhikārāt sukha uddeśena apravṛtteḥ ca mokṣe ca sarva āśramiṇām adhikāraḥ āśrama catuṣṭayam upakramya saḥ brahma saṃsthaḥ amṛta tvam eti iti śruteḥ saṅkoce kāraṇa abhāvāt ākāṅakṣāyāḥ aviśeṣeṇa anantaryasya aprayojaka tvāt katham tarhi mokṣa śramaḥ caturthaḥ vai yaḥ bhikṣoḥ parikīrtitaḥ iti pravajyām mokṣa āśramam āhuḥ gṛhasthasya ca putra dāra ādi saṅgaḥ durvāraḥ iti asādhāraṇyena tathā upadeśāt tattva jñāna niṣṭhaḥ gṛhasthaḥ api mucyate iti āgamāt ca

evam sthite mokṣam upakramya ātmāvāḥ are śrotavyaḥ mantavyaḥ nididhyāsitavyaḥ sākṣāt kartavyaḥ iti śrutiḥ śrutibhyaḥ ca śarīra ādi bhinnam ātmānam avadhārya śāstreṇa padārthān vivicya tad bodhita upapattibhiḥ tasya sthirīkaraṇa rūpam mananam vidadhāti na ca śabda upapatti janya tattva jñānāt sākṣātkāri saṃsāra bīja savāsanam idhya ajñāna nivṛttiḥ diś moha ādau tathā anupalabdheḥ atas śruti smṛti upadiṣṭa yoga vidhinā cira nirantarā dāra sevita nididhi āsana janya yoga ja dharmāt ātma tattva sākṣātkāram saṃsāra bīja savāsana mithyā jñāna nihanana samartham āsādya doṣa abhāvat pravṛtti ādeḥ abhāve anāgata dharma anutpāde anādi bhava sañcita karmaṇām bhogena kṣayāt apavṛjyate upadeśa mātrāt śarīra bhinna ātmā avagame api anya paratva śaṅkayā saṅkāsūkasya na aśraddhā amala kṣālanam iti mananam āvaśyakam tathā ca mantavyaḥ ca upapattibhiḥ iti śrutiḥ eva upapatti bodhakasya śāstrasya apavarga hetu tvam bodhayati mananasya tad eka sādhya tvāt evañca śama dama brahmacarya ādi upabṛṃhita yāvat nitya naimittika sandhyā upāsana ādi karma sahitāt tattva jñānāt muktiḥ

syāt etat jñāna karmaṇoḥ na sama prādhānyena samuccayaḥ karmaṇām svākyāt phala antara artha tvena śruta tvāt mokṣa artha kalpanā virodhāt tattva jñānasya karma nairapekṣyeṇa mukti hetu tva pratīteḥ ca na api aṅga aṅgi bhāvena tathā hi na karma sannipatya upakārakam tattva jñāna śarīrā nirvāhaka tvāt na api prayāja ādi va dārāt upakārakam sva vākyate eva karmaṇām prayojana lābhena phalavat sannidhau aphala tva abhāvāt upapatti viruddhaḥ ca jñāna karma samuccayaḥ kāmya niṣiddhayoḥ tyāgāt na api asaṅkalpita phala vat kāmya karma samuccayaḥ caturtha āśrama virodhāt atas eva na yāvat nitya naimiktaka samuccayaḥ api na api yati āśrama vihitena karmaṇā tattva jñāne sati gṛhasthasya api mukteḥ

jñānam pradhānam na tu karma hīnam karma pradhānam na tu buddhi hīnam tasmāt tayoḥ eva bhavet prasiddhiḥ natu eka pakṣaḥ vihagaḥ prayāti nyāya gata dhanaḥ tattva jñāna niṣṭhaḥ atithi priyaḥ śrāddha kṛt satya vādī ca gṛhasthaḥ api vimucyate iti smṛteḥ na ca ananugatam api sādhanam svarga vat apavarge prakāra bheda abhāvāt na ca apavarga arthi kartavya tayā karmāṇi vihitāni yena tat samuccayaḥ syāt tasmāt sannyasya sarva karmāṇi iti smṛteḥ sarva karma sannyāsaḥ jñāna mātrāt ca mokṣaḥ iti

mā evam sva sva āśrama vihitena karmaṇā jñānasya sama prādhānyena samuccayāt jñāna karmaṇoḥ tulya tvena mukti artha tva abhidhānāt tathā ca śrīmat bhagavat gītā sve sve karmaṇi abhirataḥ saṃsiddhim labhate naraḥ sva karmaṇa tam abhyarcya siddhim vidanti mānavaḥ śrī viṣṇupurāṇe tasmāt tad prāptaye yatnaḥ kartavyaḥ paṇḍitaiḥ naraiḥ tad prāpti hetuḥ vijñānam karma ca uktam mahāmate

hārītaḥ ubhābhyām eva pakṣābhyām yathā khe pakṣiṇām gatiḥ tathā eva jñāna karmabhyām prāpyate brahma śāśvatam śrutiḥ ca satyena labhyaḥ tapasā hi aṣaḥ ātmā samyak jñānena brahmacaryeṇa ca iti etat mulakam eva parijñānāt bhavet muktiḥ etat ālasya lakṣaṇam kāya kleśa bhayāt ca eva karma na icchanti paṇḍitāḥ

na ca phala antara artha tvena śrutasya karmaṇaḥ phala antara artha tvam anupapannam tathā vākya svarasāt jñāna tulya tā pratīteḥ tad tad phala janaka tve api hi karmaṇam śabdaḥ eva mānam evam anyatra api bhavatu vai ārāt upakāri tayā aṅga aṅgi bhāvena samuccayaḥ sa prayāja ādi vat apūrva dvāra eva yat tu jaḍa bharata upākhyāne na papāṭha guru proktām kṛta upanayanaḥ śrutim na dadarśa ca karmāṇi śāstrāṇi jagṛhe na ca iti tad yogi dharma saṅga tyāga artham jāti smara tvena na śikṣitāni iti evaṃparam vā tat uktam jñeja jātismaraḥ dvijaḥ sarva vijñāna sampannaḥ sarva śāstra artha tattva vid iti

atra kecid anutpanna tattva jñānasya jñāna arthinaḥ tad pratibandhaka adharma nivṛtti dvārā prāyaścitta vadārāt upakārakam karma sannipatya upakārakantu tattva jñānam utpanna tattva jñānasya tu antarā labdha vṛṣṭeḥ kārīri samāpti vat ārabdha āśrama paripālanam loka saṃgraha artham yadi api loka saṃgrahaḥ na prayojanam sukha duḥkha abhāva tad sādhana itara tvāt tathā api akaraṇe lokānām na ca vigānāt nintya tvena yat jñānam tad parihāra artham tad karma sādhya duḥkha utpādanena adharma kṣaya arthañca iti

tat na tattva jñānam pratyaṅga tva pakṣe karmaṇām hi apūrva dvārāḥ janaka tvam durita dhvaṃsa kalpanātaḥ laghu tvāt tasmāt yāni karmāṇi upanīta mātra kartavya tvena vihitāni sandhyā upāsana ādīni tāni mokṣa arthibhiḥ api avaśyam kartavyāni tad parityāgasya pratyavāya hetu tvena āśāstrīya tvāt saṅkoce māna abhāvāt niṣiddhāni kāmyāni ca bandha hetu tvāt mukti paripanthīni iti tyajyante dhana mūlāni ca dhana tyāgāt eva tyajyante saḥ ayam saṃnyasya sarva karmāṇi iti asya arthaḥ ayam eva hi sannyāsa padārthaḥ

tathā ca gītā kāmyānām karmaṇām nyāsam sannyāsam kavayaḥ vidaḥ niyatasya tu sannyāsaḥ karmaṇaḥ na upapadyate mohāt tasya parityāgaḥ tāmasaḥ parikīrtitaḥ iti tattva jñānam dharma dvārā mukti sādhanam vihita tvena dharma janaka tvāt iti dharmasya eva prādhānyam sa ca dharmaḥ muktyā eva phalena nāśyate iti kecid tat na mithyājñāna nivṛttyā dṛṣṭa dvāreṇa eva upapattau adṛṣṭa kalpanā anavakāśāt anyathā bheṣaja ādiṣu api tathā syāt evañca tatra eva vihita tvasya vyabhicāraḥ

atra vadanti saṃsāra kāraṇa uccheda krameṇa kārya ucchedāt mokṣaḥ evañca tattva jñāna mātrāt eva mithyājñāna ucchedāt apavargaḥ tatra na tasya karma sahakāri tvam mithyājñāna unmūlane karma vinākṛtasya eva tasya diś moha ādau hetu tva avadhāraṇāt karmaṇām apavarga hetu tā śrutiḥ ca tattva jñāna dvārā api upapadyate sākṣāt tasya aśruteḥ tattva jñānavataḥ ca adhikāre nitya akaraṇe api doṣa abhāvena pratyavāya abhāva upapatteḥ anyathā bhoga artham vihita niṣiddha ācaraṇena dharma adharma utpattau mokṣa abhāva prasaṅgaḥ nanu tad tad tīrtha dāna mahā snāna kāśī maraṇa ādi karmaṇām tattva jñāna nairapekṣyeṇa mukti hetu tvam śrūyate tat katham tattva jñānam eva tad hetuḥ na ca teṣām tattva jñānam eva vyāpāraḥ anupadam tattva jñāna anutpādāt adṛṣṭa dvārā tad hetu tvam vācyam tathā cāpa varga kāraṇam eva dṛṣṭam kalpyatām lāghavāt na ca tattva jñāna pratibandhaka adharma nāśaḥ eva teṣām vyāpāraḥ pratibandhaka durita dhvaṃsataḥ apūrvasya laghu tvāt

atha tad tad karmaṇām ananugamāt katham muktiḥ anugatā duḥkha dhvaṃse prakāra abhāvāt iti ced na guṇa nāśe samavāyi asamavāyināśa virodhi guṇānām na aśaka tva niyamāt tad tad nāśa viśeṣe tu tat tad hetuḥ iti ced tarhi tad tad duḥkha dhvaṃse tat tad karmaṇām api tathātvam astu tava api tattva jñāne tattpratibandhaka durita dhvaṃse ca ananugatānām eva tad tad karmaṇām janaka tvam mumukṣum uddiśya vihita tvam vā anugatam asti iti ced na jñāna karmaṇoḥ nirapekṣa kāraṇa tā śravaṇat vrīhi yava vat vikalpaḥ eva nirapekṣa eka sādhana avaruddhepara sa ādhana anvayaḥ na vikalpam antareṇa sambhavati ākāṅkṣā virahāt iti nyāyāt sāhitya bodhakam vinā ekam pratyanekasya hetu tā yatra śabdena bodhyate tatra vikalpena anvayaḥ yathā vrīhi yavayoḥ iti vyutpatteḥ vā vastutas tu dṛḍha bhūmi sava āsana mithyā jñāna unmūlanam vinā na mokṣaḥ iti ubhaya siddham tādṛśa mithyā jñāna nāśe ca anvaya vyatirekābhyām tattva jñāna kāraṇa tvam avadhāritam atas na tena vinā saḥ iti tatra api tattva jñānam āvaśyakam yadi api mithyājñāna nāśe virodhi guṇasya eva hetu tvam

tathā api mithyājñāna prāc abhāva asaha vṛtti mithyā jñāna dhvaṃsasya tad eka sādhya tvam ātmā jñātavyaḥ na sa punar āvartate iti śruteḥ mokṣam prati tattva jñānasya hetu tva avadhāraṇāt tam eva viditvā atimṛtyum eti na anyaḥ panthāḥ vidyate ayanāya iti śrutyā tattva jñānam vinā na mokṣaḥ kintu tasmin sati eva iti pratipādanāt ca anyathā svarga ādau na śarīra ādayaḥ kalpyeran karmaṇām tattva jñāna dvārā api mukti janaka tva sambhavāt pramāṇavataḥ gauravañca na doṣāya karmaṇām tattva jñāna viśeṣaḥ eva janaka tvam atas na tatra ananugamaḥ doṣāya vārāṇasī maraṇasya tattva jñāna phala janaka tvam āgamāt eva avagamyate tattva jñānāt adatta phalāni eva karmāṇi prāyaścittāt iva vinaśyanti ananyathā siddha śabda balāt na ca prāyaścittasya durita utpatti nimittaka tvam pāpa nāśa phala śravaṇāt

atas eva na brahmahatyā ādīnām prāyaścitta duḥkham eva phalam naraka phala śruti virodhāt prāyaścitta vidhi vaiyarthyāt ca duḥkha eka phala tvena tatra apravṛtteḥ na api karma antara adhikāraḥ eva phalam mahāpātaka atirikte anadhikāra abhāvāt anyathā yat kiñcit pāpavataḥ akṛta prāyaścitta tvena anadhikāra āpatteḥ prāṇāntike tad abhāvāt ca śrūyate hi bhidyate hṛdaya granthiḥ chidyante sarva saṃśayāḥ kṣīyante ca asya karmāṇi tasmin dṛṣṭe para ātmani iti smṛtiḥ api jñāna agniḥ sarva karmāṇi bhasmasāt kurute arjunaḥ iti

na abhuktam kṣīyate karma iti atra ca prāyaścitta ādi smṛtitaḥ saṅkocasya āvaśyaka tvena śabda bodhita nāśaka anāśya karma paratvam lāghavāt na tu tat tad anya karma paratvam gauravāt pāpa puṇya kṣaya hetūnām bahutara tvāt jñānasya na aśaka tvam śabda bodhyam iti uktam atha bhasmasāt padasya lākṣaṇika tvena yathā vahneḥ paramparayā bhasma tathā jñānāt karma kṣayaḥ iti arthaḥ tathā ca na abhuktam kṣīyate karma iti smṛtiḥ utsargataḥ bhogena eva kṣayam āha ananyathā siddha prāyaścitta vidhinā sā bādhyate jñāna nāśya tvañca bhoga dvārā api sambhavati iti abādhe sambhavati bādha kalpanā na iti ced na kamaṇaḥ bhoga nāśya tve jñānasya anāśaka tvāt na hi bhogaḥ tattva jñāna vyāpāraḥ tathā aśravaṇāt tena vinā api karmaṇaḥ eva tad upapatteḥ ca karmaṇaḥ bhoga nāśya tve tattva jñāna anupayogāt

yat tu na abhuktam iti smṛti virodhena kṣīyante ityādi śruteḥ anyathā varṇanam tat na smṛteḥ pratyakṣa veda bādhita tvena viruddha arthaka vedān anumāpaka tvāt vāmadeva saubhari prabhṛtīnām kāya vyūha śravaṇāt tattva jñānena kāya vyūham utpādya bhoga dvārā karma kṣayaḥ iti ced na tapaḥ prabhāvāt eva tattva jñāna anutpādepi kāya vyūha sambhavāt bhoga janana arthañca karmabhiḥ avaśyam tad tad kāya niṣpādanam iti na tatra tattva jñāna upayogaḥ yaugapadyañca kāyānām tad janaka karma svabhāvāt tapaḥ prabhāvāt vā na ca jñānam bhoga dvārā karma nāśakam iti uktam

etena āgamayoḥ paraspara virodhāt anirṇaye vimati padam karma bhoga nāśyam prāyaścitta ādi anāśya tve sati karma tvāt bhukta bhujyamāna karma vat iti anumānāt nirṇayaḥ iti apāstam jñānasya prāyaścitta tulya tvena aprayojaka tvāt śruti bādhita tvāt ca śabda bodhita nāśakānāśya tu asya upādhi tvāt ca akṛta pradhānena kṛta pradhānena ca aṅga apūrveṇa vyabhicārāt ca tasya pradhāna yāga ādi nāśya tvāt na ca tasya api yāgasya iva svarga phalaka tvam iti tat nāśya tvam eva adhikṛta adhikāre api svarga kāmasya adhikārāt anyathā niṣphale apravṛtteḥ iti vācyam svarga phala tve aṅga tva virodhāt pravṛttiḥ ca phalavat yāga arthi tayā tat uktam pradhāne rāgāt aṅge vaidhi iti

nanu tāvat eva asya ciram yāvat na vimokṣaḥ atha sampatsyate kaivalyena iti śruteḥ tāvat eva asya utpanna tattva jñānasya ciram vilambaḥ yāvat na utpanna karmaṇaḥ vimokṣaḥ atha sampatsyate kaivalyena iti atra bhogena kṣayayitvā iti śeṣaḥ na ca śeṣe māna abhāvaḥ sati api vijñāne karma avasthāne kḷpta sāmarthyasya bhogasya eva na aśaka tvena ākṣepaka tvāt iti ced na tattva jñāne sati tattva jñāna daśāyām na mokṣaḥ kintu tad agri makṣaṇaḥ iti ārtha tvena api upapatteḥ

yat tu akṛta pradhānaṅga apūrva abhiprāyam etat jñāna agriḥ sarva karmāṇi ityādi teṣām kāryāṇām nāśaka antara abhāvāt iti tat na pradhāna arthi tayā kḷptānām tad abhāve tad sāmagrya siddheḥ tad sattve api sarva karma padasya karma antara parigrāhakasya saṅkoce māna abhāvāt yat api bhasmasātkaraṇa ādinā phalājanaka tvam ucte tatu ajñānāt kṛtam api vihitam karma na phalāya iti tathā ca śrutiḥ tat yathā puṣkara palāśena apaḥ śliṣyante ityādi tat api na na hi bhasmasāt karaṇam kṣayaḥ ca anutpattiḥ ucyate na ca lakṣaṇā mukhye bādhaka abhāvāt

ucyate karmaṇaḥ bhoga nāśya tve api jñānasya karma nāśaka tvam bhogasya tattva jñāna vyāpāra tvāt na ca bhoga mātrasya eva karma nāśe sāmarthyāt tattva jñāna vyabhicāraḥ karma prāgabhāva asaha vṛtti karma nāśe yugapad karma bhoge vā avi abhicārāt atas eva anumānena āgama bādhā prayojaka tvena ca śruti vākya śeṣe māna abhāvaḥ utpanna tattva jñānasya apavarga vilamba upapādana artham ukta rītyā bhogasya eva ākṣepāt iti tat asya apavargasya parama puruṣa arthasya śruti siddham kāraṇam anumānam iti viviktam iti

atha upamānam nirūpyate tatra sādṛśya pramākaraṇam upamānam iti kecid sādṛśyañca padārtha antaram tathā hi sādṛśya vyavahārāt abādhitāt asti sādṛśyam tat ca na pratipadārtham ekam sarvasya sarva sadṛśa tva āpatteḥ su sadṛśa manda sadṛśa vyavahārasya tat ekatve anupapatteḥ ca na ca vyañjaka bhūyaḥ sāmānya alpa tva bhūyaḥ tvābhyām tat dhīḥ iti vācyam bahubhiḥ alpaiḥ ca vyajyamāna ghaṭa ādau hrāsa vṛddhyoḥ adarśanāt vyañjaka abhimatāt eva vyavahāra siddhau atirikta asiddheḥ ca na api saṃyoga vat vyāsa jya vṛtti anekam go tva upalakṣita sādṛśya āśraya tvāt gavaya vat goḥ api su sadṛśa tva prasaṅgāt gorasat nikarṣe saṃyoga vat apratyakṣa tva prasaṅgāt ca pratyakṣa tve vā gavaya nirūpita sādṛśyasya eka vitti vedya tvena goniṣṭhatayā cākṣuṣa tva prasaṅgaḥ kintu pratyāśrayam bhinnam na ca ekaikasya vyabhicārāt anugata rūpa abhāvāt ca anugata pratyayaḥ sādṛśya pada vyutpattiḥ ca na syāt iti vācyam anugata ākāra vitti vedya sādṛśya tva sāmānyāt sapta padārtha atirikta tvāt vā jāti vat antya viśeṣa vat ca sva lakṣaṇāt vā tayoḥ upapatteḥ

tat ca na dravyam guṇaḥ karma vā guṇa karma vṛtti tvāt na ca sadṛśa āśraya tvāt eva tatra vyavahāraḥ āśraya vaisādṛśye api tatra tad pratīteḥ atas eva na āśraya sādṛśya asaṃsarga āgrahāt saḥ bādhaka abhāvāt aviśeṣeṇa vaiparītya sambhavāt ca na api sāmānyam tat hi na sarva vṛtti ekam anabhyupagamāt su sadṛśa manda sadṛśa vyavahāra anupapatteḥ ca

atha vijātīya tve sati a vayava guṇa karma vṛtti bhūyas sāmānyam tat atas eva dūra sthe pratiyogini bhūyaḥ sāmānya ajñānāt na tathā sādṛśya pratyayaḥ vanam prāsādāḥ iti vat bahu tvasya samudāya tvasya vaikalya tvāt ekam sādṛśyam iti dhī prayogau anyathā vana ādi api artha antaram syāt sāmānyasya bahutva alpa tvābhyām su sadṛśa manda sadṛśa vyavahāraḥ tat ucyate sāmānyāni eva bhūyāṃsi guṇa avayava karmaṇām bhinna pradhāna sāmāni a vyaktam sādṛśyam iṣyate iti

na sājātye api aravinda dvaya vat sajātīya avayava ādi śūnye guṇa ādau jātau ca sadṛśa pratyayāt visadṛśayoḥ karabha rāsa bhayoḥ tat sattvāt ca na api dharmi antare dharmi antara vṛtti dharma bāhulyam asādhāraṇa dharma śūnya tve sati tad gata bhūyas dharmavat tvam vā sva niṣṭhā atyanta abhāva pratiyogi dharma samāna adhikaraṇa bhūyas dharmavat tvam vā tri catur pañca ādi bhedena bhūyas tvasyānanugamāt na ca kapiñjala vat tritva paryavasannam visadṛśayoḥ api hasti maśakayoḥ sādṛśya prasaṅgāt tat uktam

evam jāti guṇa dravya kriyā śaktiṣu dharmataḥ ekaika dvi tri sādharmya bhedāt ekatra citra tā iti atha vyāvartaka dharma apekṣayā tad gata dharma bāhulyam sādṛśyam bāhulyañca tri catur ādiṣu anugatam hasti maśakayoḥ tu bahu vyāvartakam sādhāraṇantu alpam ete eva kiñcid bheda adhiṣṭhānam sādṛśyam ucyate iti ced na vyāvartaka sama saṅkhyena alpena agaṇitena api dharmeṇa sādṛśya vyavahārāt kiñca sāmānyāni āśraya bhedena abhinnāni bhavanti sādṛśyantu bhinnam sāmānyam niṣpratiyogikam tat anirūpyañca sādṛśyantu sa pratiyogikam tat hīvyaṅgyañca

atha bhede sati tad gata bhūyaḥ sāmānyavat tvam sādṛśyam bhedaḥ ca pratyāśrayam anyaḥ sa pratiyogikaḥ ca iti ced tarhi sādṛśyasya bheda ghaṭita tvena sa avadhi tve tasmāt sadṛśaḥ iti syāt na tu tena tasya vā sadṛśaḥ iti syāt na ca sādṛśyasya api sa pratiyogika tvena tasmāt sadṛśaḥ iti syāt sa avadhau hi tathā pratīti prayogau na tu pratiyogini abhāve api ghaṭāt iti pratīti prasaṅgāt

api ca tad dharmavat tvam yadi sādṛśyam tadā tad tad bhinnatayoḥ saṅkaraḥ syāt tad dharmavattā hi tad tā tad anyā ca tadvat tā yadi ca tatra eva tadvat tā tadā tat eva tadvat iti syāt tathā ca tad dharma vat tā pratyabhijñāna vat saḥ ayam iti syāt na tu tadvat ayam iti evam tadvat tā eva hi tat ta iti gavaye api go buddhi vyapadeśau syātām go gata sāmānya yogi tvena go vat tatta āśraya tvāt na viśeṣaḥ pratyakṣa tvāt na samavāyaḥ vṛttimat tvāt iti adhikam sādṛśyam

yat tu sādṛśyam bhāvaḥ abhāvaḥ vā bhāvaḥ api sa guṇam nirguṇam vā nirguṇam api āśritam anāśritam vā āśritam api sāmānya vat niḥsāmānyam vā sāmānyavat tve spandaḥ aspandaḥ vā nirguṇam niḥsāmānyam āśritam eka āśritam aneka āśritam vā iti yathāyatham sapta padārtha antargatam iti tat na vyavahāra anupapattyā tad bahirbhāvāt anyathā etādṛśa vikalpena sāmānya viśeṣa samavāyānām api dravya ādi traya sādharmyāt tad tad antarbhāvaḥ syāt iti

ucyate asādhāraṇa ani atad gata bhūyas dharmavat tvam tad sādṛśyam yad jāti ādi sādhāraṇam bheda āghaṭita tayā ca niravadhi tad gata bahu dharmavat tvam tat nirūpyam iti itara nirūpya tvam eva tasya sa pratiyogika tvam tava api sādṛśye tat eva sa pratiyogika tvam na tu bheda dīrgha ādi vatsa avadhi tvam tasmāt sadṛśaḥ iti pratyaya āpatteḥ bahu tvañca tri catur ādi sādhāraṇam iti na ananugamaḥ na ca atiprasaṅgaḥ hasti maśakayoḥ api prāṇi tva sukhi tva duḥkhi tvā ādinā sādṛśyāt atas eva vaisādṛśye api āhlāda janaka tva ādinā candraḥ iva mukham puṣṭi ādinā mahiṣī iva gauḥ iti bahu alpa tad gata dharmavat tvena su sadṛśa tva manda sadṛśa tvam atas eva gavaye go sādṛśyam pṛṣṭaḥ tad dharmavat tvam eva vivecayati varāham gāvaḥ anudhāvanti iti atra go sādṛśyam varāhe api uktam tad dharmavat tvena upamāna upameya vyavahāraḥ kāvya ādau sādhya sādhana vattā mātreṇa dṛṣṭānte pakṣa sādṛśya vācakavati prayogaḥ parīkṣakāṇām na ca ete gauṇāḥ mukhye bādhaka abhāvāt tasmāt kenacid dharmeṇa kasyacid kvacid sādṛśyavat tvam ananugatam asti

kiñca yādṛśa bahu tad dharmavat tva jñānam sādṛśya vyañjakam tat eva tad vyavahāra niyāmakam astu kim adhikena anyathā tri catur ādi tve tu vyañjakam api bahu dharma vat tva mananugatam syāt vyañjakam ananugatam api vahnau pratyakṣa ādi vat iti ced na tatra abhivyaktīnām vaijātyāt dhūma āloka ādau vahni vyāpya tvam eva anugatam atra api tat vyāpya tvam asti iti ced tarhi yādṛśam tat vyāpya tvam tat eva tad vyavahāra nimittam na ca tad gata bahu dharmavat tvam na vyañjakam eva anubhava virodhāt tad gata bhūyodharmasya bahu alpa tva jñānam vinā su sadṛśa manda sadṛśa tva jñāna abhāvāt ca

atha tad gata bahu dharmavat tvam na sa pratiyogikam sādṛśyantu na tathā iti vyavahartavya sādhakam iti ced na sādṛśya vat tasya api sa pratiyogika tvāt yat tu tad tātadvat tayoḥ saṅkaraḥ syāt iti tat na tatra eva tad dharmavattā tad abhedaḥ vā tat tā sā ca saḥ ayam iti pratyakṣa jñāne bhāsate bhede bhāsamāne tad anyasmin tad dharma vat tā tadvat tā yatas bhavati tadvat ayam na tu saḥ iti tayoḥ bhedāt

nanu evam vyakti antare go tva grahe tad govat iyam iti syāt na tu iyam api gauḥ iti ced na go tva mātrasya tad anya vyakti vṛtti tva samuccayāt ekatra nānā sambandha an avagamāt tad go vṛtti bahu dharma jñāne bhavati eva tad govat iyam iti tathā api ayam api śṛṅga ādimān iti samuccaya dhīḥ syāt na tu go sadṛśaḥ iti ced na ekatra ubhaya sambandhaḥ samuccayaḥ anya gata bhūyas dharmavat tvam anyatra sādṛśyam iti vivekāt

navīnāḥ tu vilakṣaṇa sukha dvaye itarasa kala vyāvṛttam sādṛśyam anubhūyate na tu tad ubhaya mātra vṛtti jātiḥ asti tad ubhaya abhāve jāteḥ anāśraya tvena anitya tva prasaṅgāt na api janyam dharma antaram asti iti adhikam sādṛśyam upeyam tava api samāna dharmavat tvam vyañjakam vinā katham tatra sādṛśya abhivyaktiḥ iti ced na pratīti balāt dravye tathā guṇa ādau tu vyabhicārāt atas eva na vyañjakena anyathā siddhiḥ tad abhāve api sādṛśya anubhavāt iti

tad tuccham vilakṣaṇam sukha dvayam na sukha mātra hetu janyam sukha antarasya api tādṛśatva āpatteḥ kintu vilakṣaṇa adṛṣṭa janyam tat ca adṛṣṭam vihita tad dhetu kriyā viśeṣa anuṣṭhānāt anyeṣām api asti iti teṣām api tādṛśāni sukhāni bhavanti iti teṣu kāraṇa viśeṣa prayojyāḥ vilakṣaṇa jātiḥ asti tasmāt jīvānām ānantyāt anādi nidhana tvāt utpanna anāgata vijātīyam na sukham asti evam duḥkha ādi kārya antare api na hi anutpanna jātīyam anutpatsyamāna jātīyam vā kāryam asti yat ca vyakti nāśe jāteḥ anitya tvam āpāditam tat api na na aśaka abhāvāt atas eva dvayoḥ api tad avasthānam

api ca ekatra pratiyogi bhedena sādṛśyam bhinnam na tu ekam su sadṛśa manda sadṛśa vyavahārāt tathā ca yogya tvāt eka grahe sarva graha prasaṅgaḥ pratiyogi gata bhūyas dharma jñānasya vyañjakasya kramāt krame tat eva vyavahāra nimittam iti uktam kiñca evam vaisādṛśyam api syāt na ca sādṛśya abhāvaḥ tad vaiparītyasya api sambhavāt sādṛśya abhāva tvena eva pratītiḥ viśabdasya niṣedha arthaka tvāt iti ced tarhi gauḥ iva mahiṣi iti atra pāvana tva kṣīra vat tva ādinā vivakṣita sādṛśya anāśraye gavaye vaisādṛśyam na syāt na hi tatra go sādṛśyam tad abhāvaḥ ca tasmāt sādharmya vaidharmye sādṛśya vaisādṛśye

yat tu tad vṛtti aneka dharmavat tvam sādṛśyam tena abhede api gaganam gagana ākāram sāgaraḥ sāgara upamaḥ rāma rāvaṇayoḥ yuddham rāma rāvaṇayoḥ iva ityādau sādṛśyam na ca evam goḥ api go sadṛśa tve gavaya pada abhidheya tva āpattiḥ tatra sādṛśya padasya viśeṣe tātparyāt anyathā mahiṣe atiprasaṅgaḥ iti tat na tasya tena vā sadṛśaḥ iti prayogāt na ca abhede sambandhaḥ saha arthaḥ vā sambhavati gaganam gagana ākāram ityādau tu gagana ādi eva etādṛśa dharma vat na anyat iti atra tātparyam

yat vā sthāna antarīya gagana sāgarayoḥ upamāna tvam tayoḥ yuddha viśeṣe tayoḥ eva yuddha antaram upamānam iti nanu ayam devadattaḥ tad anyaḥ vā bhavatu tad sadṛśaḥ tāvat ayam iti bheda abheda saṃśaye api sādṛśya niścayāt atiriktam sādṛśyam astu iti ced na devadatta dharma mātra abhiprāyeṇa eka deśe sādṛśya pada prayogāt katham anyathā saḥ eva ayam na tu tad sadṛśaḥ iti tad sadṛśaḥ ayam na tu saḥ iti pratīti prayogau na ca atra sadṛśa padam bheda mātra param iti yuktam mukhye sambhavati lakṣaṇāyāḥ ayogāt tasmāt na padārtha antaram sādṛśyam iti

syāt etat mā bhūt padārtha antaram tathā api pratyakṣāt śabdāt vā gavaye go sādṛśya jñānāt gavaya sadṛśaḥ gauriti jñānam upamitiḥ na ca etat pratyakṣam asat nihita viśeṣyaka tvāt na anumānam liṅga abhāvāt na ca gavaya gatam sādṛśyam liṅgam apakṣa dharma tvāt atha sadṛśa dvaya antara darśane yaḥ yat gata sādṛśya pratiyogī sa tad sadṛśa iti pratyakṣeṇa vyāpti grahe sati gavaya gata sādṛśya pratiyogi tvāt gauḥ ga vaya sadṛśaḥ iti anumitiḥ iti ced na vyāpti graham vinā eva prathamam api pratyakṣāt śabdāt vā go sadṛśam gavayam jñātvā gavi gavaya sādṛśya jñāna udayāt

kiñca gavi gavaya sādṛśyam na sādhyam prathamatas tad apratīteḥ gavaya gata sādṛśya pratiyogi tvañca gavi na pratyakṣam viśeṣyasya āsannikarṣāt iti na anumiti gamyam tad liṅgasya api tad gata tvena apratyakṣasya liṅga antara gamya tvena anavasthānāt na ca gauḥ etat gavaya sadṛśaḥ gavaya gata babhūyas avayava ādi sāmānyavat tvāt gavaya antara vat iti rāmam gavaya antara ajñāne api gavi gavaya sadṛśa tva pratyayāt atas eva gavi gavaya gata go sādṛśyam go gata gavaya sādṛśyam vinā anupapadyamānam tat kalpayati na hi go sadṛśaḥ gavaye etad visadṛśaḥ gauḥ iti vācyam iti nirastam gavaya nirūpita go sādṛśya prasiddhau tena vinā anupapatti jñāna abhāvāt kiñca tava arthāpattiḥ vyatireki anumānam na ca gavaya gata sādṛśya pratiyogi tvam gavi pratyakṣa ādinā jñātum śakyam iti uktam

nanu evam karabhe go vaidharmya jñānāt gavi karabha vaidharmya jñānam api māna antarāt syāt iti ced na gavi karabha vaidharmyam yadi karabha vṛtti dharma abhāvavat tvam tadā smṛte gavi prāk asti tāvat anupalabdheḥ gamyam eva atha karabha āvṛtti dharmavat tvam tadā go dharmā gavi gṛhītāḥ eva idānīm smṛta go dharmāṇām karabhe abhāva mātram adhikam gamyam tat ca pratyakṣāt eva atha tad pratiyogika etad niṣṭha sādṛśye bhāsamāne samāna saṃvid saṃvedya tayā etad pratiyogika tad niṣṭha sādṛśyam vaidharmyañca jñātam eva iti ced na viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya pratiyogi bhedena samāna saṃvid saṃvedya tva asiddheḥ etad sadṛśaḥ etat vidharmā saḥ iti etat viśeṣyaka pratyaya anudayāt ca tad viśeṣyaka pratyakṣe tad sannikarṣasya hetu tvāt

nanu pratyakṣe viśeṣya sannikarṣaḥ hetuḥ na tu yāvat viśeṣya sannikarṣaḥ gauravāt anyathā atīta anāgata vartamāna vyāpya viśeṣya kavya āpti pratyakṣam na syāt iti ced na atīta anāgata viśeṣye sāmānya lakṣaṇāyāḥ sattvāt atha gavaya sādṛśyam gavi gavaya gata śṛṅgi tva ādi sāmānyavat tvam tat ca gavaye go sādṛśye bhāsamāne gavi bhātam eva yat vā go gata śṛṅgi tvādeḥ gavaya gata tvam gavaye go sādṛśyam evam tasya eva gavaya gatasya go gata tvam gavi sādṛśyam tat ca indriyeṇa eva jñātam sāmānyasya eka tvena indriya sannikṛṣṭa tvāt ayam sā eti viparīta pratyabhijñāyām iva iti ced satyam go viśeṣyaka gavaya gata śṛṅgi tva ādi jñānam na indriya janyam gorasat nikarṣāt tasmāt etat sadṛśaḥ etat vidharmā etasmāt dīrghaḥ saḥ iti jñānam na anumānāt viśeṣya āsannikarṣe tad gata bahu liṅga ajñānāt evañca sa pratiyogika padārtha jñāne tad pratiyogika padārtha jñānam upamānam tat āhuḥ

pratyakṣa ādikam vinā arthāt artha antara jñānam pūrveṣām upamānāt vigārhitam etat tathā hi paraspara sadṛśam hasti ādikam pratyakṣam atas yaḥ yat sādṛśya pratiyogī sa tad sadṛśaḥ iti sāmānyatas vyāpti jñāne sati gauḥ ga vaya sadṛśaḥ tad sādṛśya pratiyogi tvāt yathā bhrātuḥ bhaginī gavaya gata sādṛśya pratiyogi tvañca gorgavaya gata sādṛśya vitti vedyam eva sādṛśye goḥ pratiyogi tvena eva jñānāt anyathā sādṛśye gorananvaya āpatteḥ yat tadbhyām sāmānyatas vyāpti graham vinā etat sadṛśaḥ saḥ iti phala asiddheḥ yat tadbhyām vyāpti grahe asmākam vyatirekī pareṣām artha āpattiḥ iti anyat etat

sādṛśyasya ubhaya vṛtti dharmasya kiñcid viśeṣya sannikarṣāt pratyakṣeṇa bhānam yāvat viśeṣya sannikarṣasya aprayojaka tvāt anyathā ayam saḥ iti bhrānta viparīta pratyabhijñāyām kā gatiḥ manasā eva ca etat niṣṭha sādṛśya pratiyogi tva grahaḥ pratyakṣa viśeṣyaka tvam parāmarśe na prayojakam iti uktam kīdṛśa gavayaḥ iti jijñāsāyām yathā gauḥ tathā gavayaḥ iti śruta uttarasya tathābhūte piṇḍe dṛṣṭe tathā ayam iti atideśa vākya artha anusandhāne ayam gavaya śabda vācyaḥ iti matiḥ upamāna phalam na ca iyam vākya mātrāt apratyakṣīkṛta piṇḍasya api prasaṅgāt na api pratyakṣa mātrāt aśruta vākyasya api prasaṅgāt na api tayoḥ samāhārāt sa hi pramāṇa samāhāraḥ vā phala samāhāraḥ vā ādye pramāṇa tve sati samāhāraḥ samāhṛtayoḥ vā prāmāṇyam na ādyaḥ

phala an ekatve samāhāra anupapatteḥ tasya paraspara sahakāri rūpa tvāt na antyaḥ vākya pratyakṣayoḥ bhinna kāla tvāt vākya tad arthayoḥ smṛti dvāra upanaye api samaya pariccheda asiddheḥ phala samāhāre ca tad antarbhāve śabda anumānayoḥ api pratyakṣa tva prasaṅgaḥ tat kim tad phalasya pramāṇa bahis bhāvaḥ eva antarbhāve vā kiyatī sā matiḥ tad tad asādhāraṇa indriya ādi sāhityam asti tarhi sādṛśya jñāne api visphāritasya cakṣuṣaḥ vyāpāraḥ asmin sati tasya anupayogāt upalabdha gosādṛśya viśiṣṭa gavaya piṇḍasya vākya artha smṛtimataḥ kāla antare api tad anusandhāna balāt samaya pariccheda utpatteḥ tasmāt āgama pratyakṣābhyām anyat eva idam āgama smṛti sahitam sādṛśya jñānam upamāna pramāṇam iti jarat naiyāyikāḥ jayanta prabhṛtayaḥ

tat na vaidharmya avyāpteḥ yadā udīcyena krameṇa kam nirgatya uktam dhikkarabham ati dīrdha grīvam pralamba capala oṣṭham kaṭhora tīkṣṇa kaṇṭaka āśinam kutsita avayava sanniveśam apasadam paśūnām iti tat upaśrutya dākṣiṇātyaḥ uttarāpatham gatvā tādṛśam vastu upalabhya nūnam asau karabhaḥ iti pratyeti tatra kim mānam na tāvat upamānam sādṛśya abhāvāt na ca pramāṇa antaram sambhavati

ucyate na tāvat anugatam śakya tā avacchedakam upalakṣaṇam vā vinā pratyabhijñānataḥ śarīra eka tva vādinām śarīra viśeṣe caitra ādi padavat adhyakṣa tvena śṛṅga grāhaka tayā gavaya ādi pada śakti grahaḥ gavaya antare api bhāvāt na api anadhyakṣe gati antara upasthite paribhāṣātaḥ ākāśa dipada vat atas eva adhyakṣa tvāt ca upalakṣaṇasya ca śaktau bahirbhāva abhāvāt tadvat eva na api yoga nirvacanāt pācaka ādi pada vat anyathā pacikriyā anupahite pacati iti na prayogaḥ syāt atas tad anuguṇa jñāna ādi yogini śaktiḥ avacchedaka tayā tu upalakṣaṇe api iti yogāt na api upasthita nimitta saṅkocanāt svarga ādi pada vat tad abhāvāt atas gandha ādi upalakṣitena pṛthivī tvena nimittena pṛthivī ādi pada vat sādṛśya ādi upalakṣite gavayatva ādau gavaya ādi padānām śaktiḥ iti tu paramārthataḥ anyathā phalasya ābhāsa tve māna tva virodhāt na ca pūrvam gavayatvam upasthitam upasthāpaka abhāvāt na ca gavaya padāt eva tad upasthitiḥ anyonya āśrayāt

atha vākyāt eva anena samayaḥ paricchinnaḥ kevalam agre api abhijānāti yogena īdṛśaḥ gavaya pada vācya tvena avagataḥ saḥ ayam iti na upamānasya viṣayaḥ iti ced na na hi sādṛśyam eva nimittam apratītānām avyavahāra prasaṅgāt gauravāt ca na api gavayatvam tad anupasthiteḥ atas eva na ubhayam svayam pratīta sama saṅkrāntaye atideśa vākya prayoga anupapatteḥ gavayatve hi ayam vyutpannaḥ na go sādṛśye nimittasya gavatu asya pratīteḥ

nanu yadi api tat vākyam samaya pariccheda pūrvam na ajījanat tathā api tat eva vākyam smṛtam sat pravṛtti nimittam paricchetsyati adhyayana samaya gṛhītaḥ iva vedarāśi ḥ aṅgepāṅga paryavasitaḥ kāla antare na ca vākya arthasya iva asya prāk eva bodhita tvāt paryavasitam iti vācyam goḥ sādṛśya upalakṣaṇa tva nimitta tvayoḥ sandehāt paścāt gavayatve avagate tarka lāghava sahakārāt sādṛśyasya upalakṣaṇa tve niścite gaṅgāyām ghoṣaḥ iti atra iva anvaya bodhaḥ bhaviṣyati iti ced na upalakṣaṇa nimitta tva sandehe api yaḥ go sadṛśaḥ sa gavaya pada vācyaḥ iti sāmānādhikaraṇya mātreṇa anvaya upapattau māna antara upanīta anapekṣaṇāt rakta ārakta sandehe api paṭaḥ bhavati iti vākya vat anyathā paryavasite api vākye māna antara sahakārāt tad anvaya buddhau vākya bheda āpatteḥ gaṅgāyām ghoṣaḥ iti atra tu padārthaḥ eva anvaya ayogyaḥ iti yuktam tatra māna antara apekṣaṇam yadi ca pratīta saṃsarga balāya ataḥ api arthaḥ vākyasya eva tadā vākya bheda āpattiḥ

atha tātparya anupapattyā yaṣṭīḥ praveśaya iti vat tad lakṣaṇāḥ tu gavaya pada vyutpannam prati tad buddheḥ utpattaye vākyam āptena uktam tat ca na pravṛtti nimitta upādānam vinā na ca go sādṛśyam tathā iti tātparyataḥ go sādṛśya padena go samāna adhikaraṇam gavaya tvam upalakṣitam kalpyate na tu yathā dhūmaḥ asti iti atra vahnau tātparyam anumānena nirvahati iti na lakṣaṇā na ca atra pramāṇa antaram asti iti yena tat nirvāhyam upamānasya asiddheḥ anyathā anyonya āśrayāt na ca vākye na lakṣaṇā tasyāḥ pada dharma tvāt iti vācyam eka padaḥ eva lakṣaṇā padā antarantu niyāmakam iti asya vakṣyamāṇa tvāt

atha gavayatvena lakṣaṇayā tad upasthitau api vyakti vācya tā na jñāyeta tad śabdāt iti viśiṣṭa vācya tā grāhaka māna antaram avaśyam svīkaraṇīyam na ca yat niṣṭhaḥ dharmaḥ yat pada vācyaḥ saḥ api tad vācyaḥ iti niyamaḥ jāti pade vyabhicārāt iti ced na pravṛtti nimitta vat vācya tva bodha tāt paryaka tvena jñāta ati deśa vākye gavayatva viśiṣṭa vyakteḥ eva lakṣaṇataḥ atha yadi gavayatve sākṣāt tātparyam go sadṛśa padasya gṛhītam tadā lakṣaṇā na ca sākṣāt tātparyam avadhṛtam anyathā dhūmaḥ asti iti atra api sāmyāt iti ced na upasthāpaka antara abhāve tātparyasya eva sākṣāt tātparya rūpa tvāt na ca upamānam eva tathā anyonya āśrayāt

mā evam yatra pravṛtti nimitta viṣaya bodhane na tātparyam yaḥ go sadṛśaḥ sa gavaya śabda vācyaḥ iti svarūpa ākhyāna mātram tatra api ukta sāma grītaḥ samaya paricchittiḥ bhavati eva na ca tatra vyutpitsu vyutpattaye pravṛtti nimitta viśeṣe tātparyam yat anupapattiḥ lakṣaṇā bījam syāt api ca dhikkarabham ati dīrgha grīvam ityādi vākyasya karabha nindātāt paryakasya pravṛtti nimitta paratva abhāve api tādṛśa piṇḍam anubhavataḥ smarataḥ ca vākya artha mayam karabha śabda vācyaḥ iti bhavati matiḥ na ca tatra pravṛtti nimitta viśeṣe tātparyam asti lakṣaṇāyāḥ bījam nindā paratvāt

kiñca sarvatra anvaya anupapattiḥ eva lakṣaṇābījam yaṣṭīḥ praveśaya ityādau api prakaraṇa ādinā puraskāra ādi prayojanaka tvam praveśanasya avagatam tādṛśe ca praveśana ādau yaṣṭi ādeḥ ananvayāt tātparyānupapatteḥ api tātparyam ajñātvā jñātum aśakyatvena tad artham prakāraṇa ādeḥ avaśyā upajīvya tvāt atha prakaraṇa ādeḥ ananugamaḥ tātparyavyāpya tvena tad anugame tātparyānupapattiḥ eva tat bījam astu lāghavāt iti ced na dhūma ādi vat ananugatasya api vyāpya tva avirodhāt tasmāt gavaya śabdaḥ kasyacid vācakaḥ śiṣṭaiḥ prayukta tvāt iti sāmānyatas niścite api gavayatva viśiṣṭaḥ dharmī gavaya pada vācyaḥ iti lāghavāt nirṇeyam tat ca pramāṇa sahakāri na ca tasyām daśāyām pramāṇa antaram asti atas yad pramāṇa sahakāri tad pramāṇa antaram āstheyam

atha astu anumānam tathā hi gavaya śabdaḥ gavayatva viśiṣṭa dharma vācakaḥ asati vṛtti antare vṛddhaiḥ prayujyamāna tvāt gavi go śabda vat iti ced na gavayatva viśiṣṭaḥ yaḥ dharmī tasya vācaka tvac rahe api gavayatvasya pravṛtti nimitta tva asiddheḥ na ca śaktim ajñātvā vṛtti antaram kvāpi avadhārayitum śakyate sāmānādhikaraṇya mātrasya nimitta upalakṣaṇa tā sādhāraṇa tvāt

atha go sādṛśyasya pravṛtti nimitta tāyām gaurava avatāre na upamānasya avatāraḥ tathā ca tarkeṇa itara apravṛtti nimittattve niścite gavaya padam gavayatva pravṛtti nimittakam itara apravṛtti nimittaka tve sati sa pravṛtti nimittaka tvāt yat na evam tat na evam iti ced na tarkasya aniścāyaka tvāt na ca ayam tarkaḥ vyāpti graha mūlakaḥ yena viparyaya anumānāt artha siddhiḥ

atha gavaya padam sa pravṛtti nimittakam iti sāmānyatodṛṣṭam eva tarka saha kṛtam gavaya padasya itarā pravṛtti nimittaka tvam paricchinatti na tu māna antaram kalpayitvā tarkaḥ sahakārī kalpyate iti ced na idam sa pravṛtti nimittakam anyat ca na pravṛtti nimittam iti buddhau api gavayatva pravṛtti nimittakam gavaya padam iti māna antaram vinā apratīteḥ anumiteḥ vyāpaka tāvacchedaka mātra prakāraka tva niyamāt

atha yathā icchāyām sāmānyatodṛṣṭena viśeṣa bādhaka saha kṛtena aṣṭa dravya an āśraya tvam pratīyate anyathā viśeṣa bādhakānām dravya vyatireka viṣayaka tvena aṣṭa dravyān āśraya tvam kena grāhyam tathā atra api gaurava ākhya tarka saha kṛta sāmānyatodṛṣṭa āditara apravṛtti nimittaka tve jñāte paścāt sa vyatirekī syāt kalpya pramāṇa antara apekṣayā kḷpta pramāṇa sahakāri tvasya yukta tvāt iti ced na icchāyām ekaika bādha saha kṛta apara bādhakaiḥ eva tāvat dravya viśiṣṭa vaiśiṣṭyāt aṣṭa dravyān āśraya tva paricchedāt na tu sāmānyatodṛṣṭena viśeṣaṇa dvayoḥ paricchittya eva viśiṣṭa vaiśiṣṭya bodha nirvāhāt tarkānavatāradaśāyām tasya paricchedaka tvāt ca na ca vyāpti param idam vākyam yaḥ go sadṛśaḥ sa gavaya padārthaḥ iti vākyāt avagata vyāpteḥ anumiti udaya ādayam gavaya pada vācyaḥ go sadṛśa tvāt atideśa kāla avagata piṇḍa vat iti vācyam na hi go sadṛśam jñātvā anena pṛṣṭaḥ sa kiṃśabda vācyaḥ iti kintu sāmānyatas gavaya padārtham avagatya sa kīdṛś iti tathā ca yad yoga prāthamyābhyām tasya eva vyāpya tvam tatas kim tena

atha lakṣaṇa param idam vākyam kiṃlakṣyakaḥ asau iti praśna arthaḥ evañca vācyaḥ iti prayoktavya param asau gavayaḥ iti vyavahartavyaḥ go sadṛśa tvāt yaḥ tu na tathā na asau go sadṛśaḥ yathā hastī iti ced na na hi hasti ādīnām vilakṣaṇa tve pramāṇam asti sarva prayogasya durjñeya tvāt katipaya vyavahārasya anaikāntika tvāt na ca kīdṛś kiṃliṅgakaḥ iti praśna arthaḥ na hi anena liṅgam ajñātvā gavaya padasya vācaka tvam kasyacid ca tat vyāpya tvam na avagatam yena tad artham praśnaḥ pravṛtti nimitta viśeṣa liṅge praśnaḥ gavaya padam yena nimittena vartate tasya kim liṅgam iti arthaḥ iti ced

na hi tad anumānam eva iti anena niścitam yatas iti syāt jñāna hetu mātra praśne tad viśeṣeṇa uttaram iti ced na aviśeṣāt indriya sannikarṣam api uttarayet vanam gataḥ drakṣyasi iti tasmāt nimitta bhede eva ayam praśnaḥ kīdṛś ga vayaḥ kena nimittena gavaya padam pravartate gavayatvasya sākṣāt upadarśayitum aśakyatvāt pṛṣṭaḥ sa tad upalakṣakam sādṛśyam ācaṣṭe paścāt ca dṛṣṭe api piṇḍe atideśa vākya artham smarataḥ tarka sahakārāt gavayatva viśiṣṭaḥ dharmī gavaya śabda vācyaḥ iti pravṛtti nimitta viśeṣa paricchittiḥ upamāna phalam

atha gauraveṇa anya animittaka tve sati sa nimittaka tvāt iti vyatirekiṇaḥ eva gavayatva pravṛtti nimittaka tva ādhīḥ iti ced na vyāptya mūlaka tayā gauravasya tad viparyayasya vā apramāṇa tvāt tatra apramāṇe saha kāritā mātreṇa anya nimitta tva śaṅkāyām katham upamānam iti ced na gaurava saha kṛta upamānāt eva anya animittaka tve sati sa nimittaka tva paricchedāt astu gaurava saha kṛtāt sa nimittaka tva mānāt eva gavayatva nimittaka tva siddhiḥ na ca evam vyatireki ucchedāt kāryatve paryavasite bādhaka anantaram vyatireki udayāt yatra ca prathamam vyatireka abhāvaḥ tatra kārya tvāt eva phalam anya animittaka tvam sa nimittaka tvañcā iti buddhau api gavayatva nimittakam gavaya padam iti buddheḥ asiddheḥ ukta tvāt kiñca atra vyavahāreṇa pravṛtti viśeṣe pada śakti grahaḥ na tu tad nimitte tena apratibandhāt na gaurava ati vyāpti ādinā itara nirāse go tva ādeḥ nimitta tva grahaḥ gaurava ādeḥ atarka tvāt apramāṇa tvāt ca tasmāt vyaktau śakti grahaḥ eva lāghava ādi sāhityena itara animittaka tve sati go tva ādi nimittaka tvam avadhārayati

sarvatra tat eva upamāna phalam iti kaścid tat na śakti grāhakam eva lāghava ādi saha kṛtam nimittam api avadhārayati yathā kṣiti ādau kartuḥ eka tām atha evam bhinna kartṛkeṣu lāghavāt kāryam eka kartṛ tām bodhayet bodhayati eva paścāt bādhakena tyajyate iti ced na bādhita viṣaya tvena ābhāsa tvāt alaghuni laghu jñānasya ayathārtha tvena tad janyā anumiteḥ ābhāsa tvāt ca na ca upamitiḥ eva itara vyutpattiḥ anyathā tad anirukteḥ iti vācyam vyutpatteḥ śabda sahakāri tve māna antara tve vyāghātāt vyutpattiḥ tu yām buddhim āsādya padārtha viśeṣa bodhaḥ sā

anye tu yat tat ādi padānām anugata eka rūpa abhāvena ekatra eva śakti grahāt anyatra api iti pada antara vyavahāraḥ pada antara vaidharmyāt na pramāṇa antaram upamānam iti tat na buddhi stha tva ādinā upalakṣaṇena sādhāraṇena śakti grahāt buddhi viśeṣāt eva viśeṣa paryavasānam tathā eva vyavahārāt anyathā māna antare api doṣaḥ na hi anugata rūpa pratītau eva tatra śakti grahaḥ

yat tu mātṛ ā ādi padānām janaka strī tva ādinā śakti grahe katham maitra mātra ādi lābhaḥ na ca samabhivyāhāra viśeṣāt iti vācyam padārthaḥ hi padārtha antaram anveti janaka strī tvañca na tathā iti katham maitra ādinā janakatvā anvayaḥ iti māna antaram iti tat na janakatvasya janya sāpekṣa tvena yogya tva ādinā maitreṇa anvayāt lakṣaṇantu upamiti karaṇa tvam upamiti tvañca jātiḥ na ca asiddhiḥ kāraṇa viśeṣe kārya vaijātyam āvaśyakam iti kāraṇa vyaṅgya tvāt

yat vā niyata dharma samāna adhikaraṇa śabda pravṛtti nimitta jñānam upamitiḥ prakāra tayā śabda śakti viṣaya tvam nimitta tvam agṛhīta samayaka saṃjñayā vākya artha sāmānādhikaraṇyena saṃjñā nimitta prakāra tā paricchedaḥ vā kiñcid vākya artha sāmānādhikaraṇyena saṃjñā nimitta prakāra tā paricchedaḥ vā go visadṛśaḥ na gavayaḥ iti atra api paramparayā tatra tātparyam asti eva iti sarvam avadātam

atha śabdaḥ nirūpyate prayoga hetu bhūta artha tattva jñāna janyaḥ śabdaḥ pramāṇam nanu śabdaḥ na pramāṇam tathā hi karaṇa viśeṣaḥ pramāṇam karaṇañca tat yasmin sati kriyā bhavati eva na ca śabde sati pramā bhavati eva iti na ayam śabdaḥ pramāṇam na ca śabdaḥ na pramāṇam iti vākyasya prāmāṇya aprāmāṇyayoḥ vyāghātaḥ asya aprāmāṇye api etad utthāpyamāna avisaṃvādāt iti ced na ākāṅkṣa ādimataḥ padārtha smaraṇa ādi vyāpāravataḥ pramāṇa tvena tathābhūtāt pramā utpatteḥ āvaśyaka tvāt atathābhūta tve ca phala ajanaka tvasya karaṇa antara sāmyāt

tathā api śabdaḥ na pramāṇa antaram padārtha saṃsargasya anumānāt eva siddheḥ tathā hi gām abhyāja daṇḍena iti padāni vaidika padāni vā tātparya viṣaya smārita padārtha saṃsarga jñāna pūrvakāṇi ākāṅkṣādimat pada kadamba tvāt ghaṭamānayā iti vat yogyatā sattimat tve sati saṃsṛṣṭa artha paratvāt tad para sannidhi mat tvāt vā iti na hetuḥ saṃsṛṣṭaḥ hi yaḥ arthaḥ tad para tvam tad para sannidhimat tvam vā asiddham saṃsargasya prāc apratīteḥ saṃsṛṣṭa tva prakāraka pratīti paratvam tad prakāraka pratīti para sannidhimat tvam vā anāpta ukte nirākāṅkṣe ca vyabhicāri saṃsargasya bahu prakāraka tve api na anabhimata saṃsarga siddhiḥ tasya tātparya viṣaya tvāt anyathā śabdāt api abhimata anvaya bodhaḥ na syāt atas eva viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāva vat arthakāni tad bodha pūrvakāṇi vā iti na sādhyam

yat tu smārita artha saṃsargavanti iti sādhyam matvarthaḥ ca liṅga tayā jñāpaka tvam na ca anyonya āśrayaḥ pūrva pūrva anumiti hetu tvena anādi tvāt tat na jñāpaka tva mātreṇa artha asiddheḥ pramāpaka tve tena eva vyabhicārāt jñāna avacchedaka tayā ca saṃsarga siddhiḥ jñāna jñānasya tad viṣaya viṣayaka tva niyamāt saṃsarge ca sambandhinaḥ eva viśeṣaka tvāt pakṣa dharma tā balāt vyāpaka tvena agṛhītasya api saṃsarga viśeṣasya siddhiḥ

atha evam bhrānti jñānam api bhramaḥ syāt na ceṣṭāpattiḥ īśvarasya api bhrānta tva āpatteḥ idam rajatam iti bhramāt iva śuktau rajata jñānavān ayam iti bhramasya jñānāt bhrānti jña pravṛtti āpatteḥ ca yat tu bhrama viṣaya viṣayaka tvena na bhrama tvam bhrama viṣayāṇām siddhi asiddhi parāhata tvāt iti tatra vakṣyāmaḥ mā evam asat viṣayaka tvena na bhrama tvam bhrama viṣayāṇām sattvāt kintu vyadhikaraṇa prakāraka tvena na ca bhramasya jñāne vyadhikaraṇam prakāraḥ rajata tva prakāraka tvasya bhrame api sattvāt anyathā bhrānti ucchedaḥ pramāṇa abhāvāt

nanu pratāraka vākye vyabhicāraḥ viśeṣa darśanena tatra saṃsarga jñāna abhāvāt na ca saṃsargam atītya vākya racanā na sambhavati iti āhāryam tasya saṃsarga jñānam sambhavati iti vācyam tāvat pada jñānāt eva śukasya iva vākya racana upapatteḥ anyatra api tasya eva tantra tvāt iti ced na etat vākyam etasya padārtha saṃsargam bodhayiṣyati iti āśayena vākya prayogāt tasya api saṃsarga jñānāt yogyatā āvirahāt ca atas eva visamva ādi vākye śuka vat uccarite na vyabhicāraḥ śabdāt saṃsarga pratyayaḥ tu yogya tā bhramāt atha saṃsarga jñānam vinā śukasya anyasya vā samvādi vākye bhrānta pratāraka vākye ca vyabhicāraḥ katham vā tatra saṃsarga pramā vaktṛ jñāna anumāna asambhavāt iti ced na yadi tatra saṃsarga pramā tadā veda tulya tā iti uktam ākāṅkṣā yogyatā āsattiḥ ca jñāta upayujyate anyathā śābda bhramānupapatteḥ iti

ucyate artha jñānam pravartakam na tu tat jñāna jñānam gauravāt vyabhicārāt ca atas rajata jñānavān ayam iti jñānam na pravartakam kintu idam rajatam iti jñānam idam api jñānam rajata viṣayakam iti ced satyam na tu rajata tva prakārakam pravarta kañca tathā anyathā bhrāntasya iva bhrānti jñasya api pravṛtti prasaṅgaḥ tad ubhaya saṅkara āpattiḥ ca etena lakṣaṇa ādi anurodhāt tātparya grahaḥ vākya artha dhī hetuḥ tātparyañca padārtha saṃsarga viśeṣa pratīti uddeśyaka tvam tathā ca tad grāhaka anumānāt eva tātparyajñāna avacchedaka tayā saṃsarga siddhiḥ iti apāstam kiñca vyāpaka tāvacchedaka prakārikā anumitiḥ atas smārita padārtha saṃsarga jñāna pūrvakāṇi iti anumitiḥ syāt na tu rajata jñāna pūrvakāṇi iti tasmāt pravartakam jñānam śabdāt eva atas eva pravṛtti artham anuvādaka tā śabdasya iti apāstam śābda anumityoḥ bhinna prakāraka tvāt eka viṣaya tva abhāvena ananuvādaka tvāt tasya eva pramāṇa tvāt

nanu ete padārthāḥ tātparya viṣaya mithas saṃsargavantaḥ ākāṅkṣa ādimat pada smārita tvāt yogyatā sattima tve sati saṃsarga para pada smārita tvāt vā anāpta ukte yogya tā virahāt na vyabhicāraḥ tatra bādhaka sattvāt tad janya jñānasya bhrama tvāt eka ākāra vākyasya api bādhaka sattva asattvābhyām yogyā yogya tvāt atha pratipattuḥ jijñāsām prati yogyatā sā ca śrotari tad utpādya saṃsarga avagama prāgabhāva rūpa ākāṅkṣā bādhaka pramāviraho yogya tā avyavahita saṃsarga pratiyogi jñānam āsattiḥ tāḥ ca svarūpa satyaḥ hetavaḥ na tu jñātāḥ gauravāt tad bodham vinā anvaya anubhave vilamba abhāvāt saṃsarga nirūpya tvena prathamam duravadhāraṇa tvāt ca iti na tāni liṅga viśeṣaṇāni iti ced

na yogyatā ādi śūnya tve api tad abhimānena saṃsarga pratyayāt anyathā śābda ābhāsa uccheda prasaṅgaḥ rājā putram ākāṅkṣati puruṣam vā iti saṃśaye viparyaye ca vākya artha dhī pratibandhāt ca yogyatāyāḥ ca saṃśaya sādhāraṇam jñāna mātram hetuḥ sva para bādhaka pramāvirahar kvacid niścīyate api yathā iha ghaṭaḥ na asti iti atra sva yogya anupalabdhyā ghaṭa abhāva niścayena anyasya api ghaṭa pramāviraho niścīyate kvacid bādhaka pramā mātra viraha saṃśaye api anvaya bodhaḥ bādha saṃśayasya adūṣaṇa tvāt kiñca tava api yogyatā ādikam prāmāṇye prayojakam āpta uktatvatya tathātve gauravāt anāpta ukte api saṃvādena prāmāṇyāt ca evañca jñāyamāna karaṇe prāmāṇya prayojaka tayā jñānam āvaśyakam iti tāsām jñānam hetuḥ tat ca samabhivyāhāra viśeṣa ādinā iti

mā evam yatra vimalam jalam iti aśru tvā eva nadyāḥ kacche mahiṣaḥ carati iti śṛṇoti tatra akāṅkṣa ādikam asti na ca nadī kacchayoḥ saṃsargaḥ iti vyabhicārāt atas eva na tanmātram prayojakam prāmāṇye atha yāvat samabhivyāhṛtā iti api liṅga viśeṣaṇam katipaya padasmāriṇaḥ tu saṃsarga pratyayaḥ liṅga abhimānāt iti ced na tad sandehe api vākya artha a agamāt tatra saṃsarga bhrāntiḥ iti ced na anya kāraṇa abhāvena padam eva bhrānti janakam tathā ca aduṣṭam sat tad eva abhrāntim janayat kena vāraṇīyam asaṃsarga āgra haḥ tatra iti ced

na saṃsarge bādhaka abhāvāt atha āpta ukta tvam liṅga viśeṣaṇam tat eva vā liṅgam na ca nadī kacchayoḥ saṃsarge āpta ukta tvam āpta ukta tvañca prāmāṇye tantram iti tadvat tayā jñāyamānasya hetu tvena tatra jñānam āvaśyakam vyāptimat tayā jñātasya iva liṅgasya tad avagamaḥ ca loke bhrama ādi a mūlaka tayā mahā jana parigraheṇa vede smṛtau ca iti ced na yatra kutracid āpta tvam anāptasya api sarvatra āpta tvam apramitam bhrānteḥ puruṣa dharma tvāt prakṛta vākya artha yathārtha jñāna vat tvan ca āpta tvam prathamam durgraham bhrama ādi a mūlaka tvasya pravṛtti saṃvāda ādeḥ ca tad grāhakasya ajñānāt pravṛttiḥ ca sandehāt api kiñca prakṛta saṃsarge ayam abhrāntaḥ yathārtha jñānavān vā iti saṃsargam apratītya jñātum aśakyam vākya arthasya apūrva tvāt

vayantu brūmaḥ bādhaka pramāṇa abhāvaḥ yogyatā sā ca na liṅga viśeṣaṇam bādhaka pramāṇa mātra virahasya sarvatra niścetum aśakyatvāt tad saṃśaye api śabdāt anvaya bodhāt ca śabda prāmāṇye tu yogyatāyāḥ saṃśaya niścaya sādhāraṇam jñāna mātram prayojakam iti śabdaḥ pramāṇam iti jaran mīmāṃsakāḥ tu loke vaktṛ jñāna anumānāt tad upajīvi saṃsarga anumānāt vā vākya artha siddhau śabdasya anuvādaka tvam vede tu tad bhāvāt svātantryeṇa prāmāṇyam iti vadanti tat na vede kḷpta sāma grītaḥ loke api saṃsarga pratyayāt anyathā anuvādaka tā api na syāt liṅgasya pūrva tve api vyāpti smṛti vilambena tad vilambāt anāpta uktau vyabhicārāt veda tulyā api sāmagrī na niścāyikā iti ced na cakṣuḥ ādeḥ tathā tvena tad śaṅkāyām api pramāpaka tvāt jñāyamānam karaṇam sandehe na niścāyakam liṅga vat iti ced na saṃśayaḥ hi na vākye tasya niścayāt

na tad janya jñāna prāmāṇye tasya tad uttara kālīna tvāt na āpta ukta tve tad niścayasya anaṅga tvāt nanu loke āpta ukta tva sandehe vākya artha dhīḥ na iti tat niścayaḥ hetuḥ tathā ca vākya artha gocara yatha artha jñāna janya tva grāhakāt tad upajīvinaḥ anumānāt vākya artha dhīḥ iti ced na vede tat rahitasya api sāmarthya avadhāraṇāt tad niścaye api veda anukāreṇa paṭhyamānam anu ādi vākyaḍa pauruṣeya tva abhimāni nogau amīmāṃsakasya artha niścayāt na ca asau bhrāntiḥ bādhaka abhāvāt pauruṣeya tva niścaya daśāyām api tasya tathātvāt

na ca asaṃsarga āgraha mātram tat arthasya tathā abhāve api asaṃsarga āgraha tve saṃsarga uccheda āpatteḥ na ca āpta ukta tva niścaya rūpa kāraṇa bādhāt saṃsarga jñāna bādhaḥ vyabhicāreṇa hetu tāyām eva bādhāt laukika tvena jñāte tad aṅgam iti ced na māna abhāvāt vākya arthasya apūrva tvena liṅga abhāvena tad graha asambhavāt nanu anāpta ukta tva śaṅkā vyudāsaḥ aṅgam sa ca vede apauruṣeya tva niścayāt loke ca āpta ukta tva avadhāraṇāt iti ced na tasya aśakya tvāt yadi ca apauruṣeya tva niścaye sati eva vedāt artha pratyayaḥ tadā doṣavat puruṣa apraṇīta tve satya ākāṅkṣa ādimat pada smārita tvena vede padārtha saṃsarga siddhiḥ astu iti vedaḥ api anuvādakaḥ syāt tad uktam vyasta puṃdūṣaṇa āśaṅkaiḥ smārita tvāt padaiḥ amī anvitāḥ iti nirṇīte vedasya api na tad kutas na ca evam śabdasya pramāṇa tvam api anumānāt eva vākya artha pramotpatteḥ iti

prābhākarāḥ tu vyabhicāri śabda vyāvṛttam avyabhicāryī anugata pramā prayojakam upeyam yad abhāvāt anāpta ukta vākyāt apramā anyathā kārya vaicitryam na syāt tatra jñātam upayujyate jñāyamāna karaṇe jñāna upayogi vyabhicāri vailakṣaṇya tvāt pramā hetu tvāt vā vyāpti vat śabda śakti vat ca iti anyathā śabda ābhāsa uccheda prasaṅgaḥ na ca āpta ukta tvam tathā saṃvādāt pramāṇe śuka udīrite bhrānta pratāraka saṃvādi vākye vede ca tad abhāvāt āpta ukta tva anumāne vyabhicāri vyāvṛtta liṅga abhāvāt ca bhāve vā tadvatas eva śabdasya pratyāyaka tvāt

etena apramā hetu tvam na bhrama pramāda vipralipsā karaṇa apāṭavānām parasparam vyabhicārāt militasya avyāpaka tvāt kintu ā āpta ukta tva abhāvasya apramā hetu tvam tad abhāvaḥ ca āpta ukta tvam pramā hetuḥ iti apāstam āpta ukta tvasya prathamam liṅga abhāvena jñātum aśakyatvāt atas eva vyabhicāra śaṅkā virahaḥ hetuḥ sā ca loke bhrama ādi mūla iti āpta ukta tva anumānāt ucchidyate vede ca apauruṣeya tva niścayena iti nirastam abhimata vākya arthasya apūrva tvena sādhya aprasiddheḥ vede sa doṣa puruṣa apraṇīta padasmārita tvena saṃsarga siddheḥ anuvāda katāpateḥ ca na api doṣa abhāvaḥ bhrānta pratāraka vākya janya jñāne pratyakṣeṇa agṛhīta saṃvāde tad abhāvāt doṣa abhāvasya hetu tvāt tatra vākyam mūkam eva vyavahāraḥ tu pratyakṣāt iti ced na anubhava apala apāpātāt tad hetu tve vivādāt vede api anuvādaka tā āpatteḥ ca

kiñca doṣa abhāvasya pramā hetu tve apramāyām doṣaḥ kāraṇam tasya ca pratyekam hetu tve vyabhicāraḥ militasya tatve ekasmāt pramā na syāt bhrama ādīnām pratyekam doṣa tve ananugamaḥ militasya tu tatve ekasmāt apramānu daya prasaṅgaḥ tasmāt lāghavāt yathārtha tātparyaka tvam śābda pramā prayojakam tatra yathā artha vākya artha pratīti prayojaka tvam loka vedasādhāraṇam tad abhāvāt apramā saḥ eva doṣaḥ na hi jātyā eva kaścid doṣaḥ tad vighātaka tvāt ca bhrama ādīnām doṣa tvam atas eva bhrānta pratāraka vākyam śukādi vākyañca pramāṇam saṃvādāt atas eva anya ghaṭa abhiprāyeṇa gehe ghaṭaḥ asti iti ukte yatra ghaṭa antaram dṛṣṭvā tam ānayati tatra anya para tvāt śabdaḥ na pramāṇam vyavahāraḥ tu pratyakṣāt eva yaṣṭīḥ praveśaya iti ca mukhya artha bodhe na pramāṇam yat paraḥ śabdaḥ sa śabda arthaḥ iti nyāyāt tat ca tātparyyam jñātam upayujyate jñāyamāna karaṇe jñāna upayogi vyabhicāri vailakṣaṇyāt vyāpti vat śakti vat ca

anyathā anya parāt anya anvaya bodhaḥ na syāt iti śabda ābhāsa ucchedaprasaṅgaḥ tad bhramāt ca śābda bhramaḥ atas eva yaṣṭīḥ praveśaya iti atra lakṣaṇā nānā arthe vinigamanā ca tayoḥ tātparya graha mūlaka tvāt yadi ca yatra vāstavam tātparyam tam śabdaḥ bodhayati tadā lakṣaṇāyām mukhya artha anvaya anupapatti upayogaḥ na syāt atas eva pacati iti ukte anya uktena svayam smṛtena vā kalāya padena upasthite kalāyam pacati iti anvaya bodhaḥ na bhavati tātparyyā niścayāt na ca tātparyya grāhakasya prakaraṇa ādeḥ prāthamyāt āvaśyaka tvāt ca śabda sahakāritā na tu tātparyya grahasya iti vācyam teṣām ananugata tvena paraspara vyabhicārāt ahetu tvāt tātparyya grāhaka tātu ananugatānām api vyāpya tvāt dhūma ādīnām iva tat ca tātparyam vede nyāya gamyam yatra nyāyāt tātparyam avaghāryate saḥ eva veda arthaḥ loke ca na kevalam nyāya anusāri tātparyyam iti na nyāya gamyam kintu pum abhiprāya niyantritam

nyāya aviṣaye api puruṣa icchā viṣaye pratīti janaka tvāt puṃvacasām vaktā ca parakīya vākya artha jñāna utpādana icchayā vākyam uccārayati sā ca icchā yadi vaktuḥ yathā artha vākya artha jñāna pūrvakā bhavati tadā eva param tad uccāraṇasya pum abhipreta yathā artha vākya artha jñāna para tvam yathārtha jñāna icchā vyāpyam nirvahati iti vaktuḥ yathā artha vākya artha jñāna vat tām avijñāya yathārtha pratīti paratvam jñātum na śakyate iti prathamam āpta vākyāt vec tṛ jñāna anumāna pūrvakam artha tathā tvam anusandhāya yathārtha tātparyya niścayaḥ anumānañca idam vākyam bhrama ādi viśiṣṭa jñānayoḥ anyatara janyam vākya tvāt iti tatas bhrama ādi nirāse sati pariśeṣāt vākya artha jñāna anumānam ayam vaktā sva prayukta vākya artha yathārtha jñānavān bhrama ādyajanya vākya prayoktṛ tvāt ahabhiva

na tu āpta tvāt sādhya aviśeṣāt tatas ete padārthāḥ yathocita saṃsargavantaḥ yathā artha jñāna viṣaya tvāt āpta ukta pada smārita tvāt vā mad ukta padārtha vat iti nanu vaktuḥ jñāna viśeṣaḥ anumeyaḥ jñāne ca arthaḥ eva viśeṣaḥ na tu artha adhīnaḥ anyaḥ arthena eva viśeṣaḥ iti aupacārikī tṛtīyā tathā ca vākya artha jñāna viśeṣaḥ anumeyaḥ tasya ca aprasiddhyā na vyāpti grahaḥ atas eva asmin vākya arthe ayam abhrāntaḥ āptaḥ vā iti jñātum aśakyam iti śabdaḥ eva tam artham vodhayet iti ced na

tātparya avadhāraṇa artham tvayā api aśābdāḥ eva saṃsarga viśeṣa pratīteḥ avaśya abhyupeya tvāt anyathā kva tātparya nirūpaṇam atas eva āpta ukta tva bhrāma ādyajanya tva nirūpaṇam api sukaram śābdantu saṃsarga jñānam prathamam na bhavati jñāna antarantu bhavati eva na ca evam śabdaḥ na pramāṇam tad arthasya prāk eva siddheḥ iti vācyam tava api tulya tvāt nanu tathā api katham artha viśeṣa siddhiḥ viśeṣeṇa vyāpti agrahāt iti ced na yathā yaḥ yatra pravartate sa tat jñāna ati iti sāmānyatovyāpti jñāne pāka ādau pravṛtti darśanāt pāka viṣaya ka kāryyata ajñāna anumānam yathā ca ceṣṭā viśeṣa darśanāt daśa saṃkhyā abhiprāya mātra jñāne ghaṭe tad ceṣṭā darśanāt ghaṭe daśa tu ajñānam tathā sāmānyatovyāpti ātrā api viśeṣa siddhiḥ

yat vā idam vākyam sa ākāṅkṣa etad artha viṣayaka eka jñāna hetukam āpta ukta tve sati etad artha pratipādaka tvāt mad vākya vat tatas ete padārthāḥ paraspara saṃsargavantaḥ sa ākāṅkṣa tve sati eka jñāna viṣaya tvāt satya rajata jñāna viṣaya vat evam vaktuḥ yathā artha vākya artha jñāne anumite prakaraṇa ādinā vaktṛ abhipreta yathārtha pratīti paratva jñānam tatas veda tulya tayā śabdāt artha pratyayaḥ iti anuvādakaḥ śabdaḥ vaktṛ jñāna avacchedaka tayā saṃsarga anumānāt vā vākya arthasya prāk eva siddheḥ yat tu saṃsarga agrahe bhramaḥ tad abhāvaḥ ca saṃsarga grahaḥ eva iti bhrama abhāve anumīyamāne saṃsarga jñāna anumā iva anumitam iti āptatva anumāna antargatam eva vaktṛ jñāna anumānam na tu vaktṛḥ jñāna anumāne tat liṅgam iti tat na bhramaḥ hi jñāna dvayam agṛhīta bhedam tad abhāvaḥ ca gṛhīta bheda jñānam na hi jñāna abhāve suṣuptau bhrama vyavahāraḥ tatas bhrama abhāva niścaya anantaram vaktṛ jñāna anumānam kiñca yadi āptā uktṛtvā anumānam eva vaktṛ jñāna anumānam tarhi yādṛśam liṅgam tādṛśam eva gamakam astu iti
