na idānīm agrima padārthayoḥ nānā tvāt ananugamena vyāpti agrahāt śabdena tathā pratipādayitum aśakyatvāt gauravāt ca na ca kṛtitaḥ siddham iṣṭa sādhanam iti jñānāt cikīrṣā na hi siddham kaścid cikīrṣati kṛteḥ pūrva kṛtitaḥ siddham iti jñāna abhāvāt ca na ca kṛti sādhya tvena pāka ādeḥ iṣṭa sādhana tvāt sādhana tvam api sādhyam na hi kṛti sādhya tvena pākasya odana sādhana tā iti uktam tasmāt kṛta kriyamāṇa vilakṣaṇam kṛtī anantara bhaviṣyattā rūpam kṛti sādhya tvam cikīrṣā prayojakam tādṛśañca sādhana tva virodhi ā iva kiñca sādhana tvasya siddha mātra dharma tvāt sādhana tva jñānam icchā virodhi hi kaścid siddham icchati iti uktam etena vṛṣṭyādāviṣṭa sādhana tā jñānam upāya it chā kāraṇa tvena kḷptam iti nirastam katham tarhi svatas asundare vṛṣṭi ādau icchā tad sādhya iṣṭa jñānāt iti gṛhāṇa

anye tu sukha duḥkha abhāva tad sādhaneṣu icchā prayojakam anugatam uddeśya tvam puruṣa artha pada vedanīyam dharma antaram asti anugata kāryasya anugata kāraṇa niyamya tvāt tat eva duḥkha tad sādhana vyāvṛtam sukha tad sādhana ādau cikīrṣā prayojakam iti na ca duḥkha virodhi tvam eva tathā asti iti vācyam saha anavasthāna niyama virodhasya asambhavāt vadhya ghātaka bhāvasya eka samaye sāmānādhikaraṇya abhāvasya ca yatna ādi sādhāraṇyāt iti tat na tad ajñāne api sukha tva jñānāt icchotpatteḥ na hi sukha tve jñāte dharma antara jñānam vinā na iccha iti tathā tve svatas prayojana hāni āpatteḥ tat eva hi svatas prayojanam yat avagatam sat sva vṛttitayā iṣyate kiñca anugata dharma kalpanā api kāraṇe na ca sukha ādi icchā kāraṇam

anāgata tvāt kintu tad avagamaḥ tarhi sukha ādi jñāne tat sva rūpa sadeva icchā prayojakam astu iti ced na yathā hi uddeśya tvam sukha jñāna ādiṣu utpadyate anyatara tvāt tṛṇa araṇi maṇinyāyāt vā tathā eva icchā eva jāyatām kṛti sādhya tvañca kṛtau satyām agri makṣaṇe svarūpam na kṛtim vinā kṣema sādhāraṇañca etat kṛti sādhya tvañca na kṛteḥ pūrvam

nanu kṛtau naṣṭāyām san api dharmaḥ na kāryaḥ tathā ca katham kārye apūrve kāminaḥ anvayaḥ kṣaṇika tvena kriyā tulya tvāt iti ced na yat vṛtti kāmya sādhana tvam tatra kārya tā buddheḥ prayojaka tvāt na tu kārya tā viśiṣṭasya kāmya sādhana tā iti vyāptiḥ nanu pāka ādau kṛti sādhya tā jñānam na pratyakṣeṇa kṛti antaram pāke sati kṛti sādhyatā jñānam tasmin sati kṛtiḥ iti anyonya āśrayāt kṛti sādhyata uttīrṇe cikīrṣā akṛtya uḥ asambhavāt ca iti ced na pākaḥ mad kṛti sādhyaḥ mad kṛtim vinā asattve sati mad iṣṭa sādhana tvāt daiva ādi anadhīna tve sati mad iṣṭa sādhana tvāt vā mad bhojana vat iti anumānāt sva kṛti sādhya ta ajñānam

yasya yat iṣṭa sādhanam yat kṛtim vinā yadā na sambhavati tat tadā tad kṛti sādhyam iti vyāptoḥ asiddhasya iṣṭa sā dhana tva abhāvāt balavat aniṣṭān anubandhi tvan ca liṅga viśeṣaṇam tena na madhu viṣa saṃmpṛkta anna bhojane vyabhicāraḥ atīta pāke ca kṛti sādhyata uttīrṇe na vyabhicāraḥ sāmānyatas tasya api kṛti sādhya tvāt atīta tā daśā yāñca atīta odana icchā viraheṇa iṣṭa sādhana tva abhāvāt atas eva nidāgha dūna dehaḥ varṣati vāride tīyadāt toya lābha sambhāvanāyām vā saraḥ avagāhane na pravartate iṣṭa santāpa śānti sādhana toya sambandhasya sva kṛtim vinā api siddhi pratisandhānena liṅga abhāvena sva kṛti sādhya tva jñāna abhāvāt yadā ca mata kṛtim vinā na sambhavati iti pratisandhate tadā pravartate

yasya santāpa śānti mātram iṣṭam sa saraḥ avagāhanasya iṣṭa sā adhana tvam eva na pratisandhatte upasthita vṛṣṭitaḥ api tat tad sambhavāt iti kaścid tat na toya sambandha tvena santāpa śanti sādhana tvam tasya ca saraḥ avagāhane api sattvāt anyathā vṛṣṭiḥ api tad sādhanam na syāt saraḥ avagāhanāt api tad siddheḥ kārya sādhana tvañca kṛti sādhya tve na liṅgam pāka ādi vat odana ādeḥ api pravṛtteḥ pūrvam kṛti sādhya tva jñāne hetu abhāvāt

nanu evam liṅga jñānam eva pravartakam astu prāthamika tvāt āvaśyaka tvāt ca na ca lāghavāt kṛti sādhya tva jñānam tathā kṛti sādhyata anumitau tadā māna abhāvena yugapad upasthiti abhāvāt pravṛtti sāmagrya anumiti pratibandhāt ca iti ced na liṅga jñāne kṛti sādhya tva aprakāśe tad prakāraka cikīrṣāyām tasya ahetu tvāt atas eva liṅga antara jñānam api na pravṛtakam

nanu pāka ādiḥ kṛtaḥ kriyamāṇaḥ vā na pakṣa tasya kṛti sādhya tve bādhāt na api anāgataḥ bhāvi pāke māna abhāvena āśraya asiddheḥ pāka tvam bhaviṣyat vṛtti sāmānya tvāt go tva vat iti mānam iti ced na māna abhāvena go tve api tasya aprasiddheḥ pāka mātram pakṣaḥ iti ced na mātrā arthaḥ yadi pāka tvam tadā bādhaḥ liṅgāsiddhiḥ ca sarva pāka paratve ca tasya siddha bhāge bādhaḥ anāgata bhāge ca āśraya asiddhiḥ vartamāna ādi udāsīnaḥ pākaḥ pakṣaḥ pāka sāmānye ca kṛti sādhya tvam na bādhitam iti api na

siddhasya pakṣa tvam na asiddhasya iti anumiteḥ siddha viṣaya tve bādhāt bhinna viṣaya tve vā siddha viṣaya icchā pravṛtti ādi anutpādaka tvāt ca kṛta kriyamāṇa sādhāraṇa kṛti sādhya tva jñānāt eva asiddha viṣayā cikīrṣā kṛtiḥ ca utpadyate ananya gatika tvena tathā kāraṇa svabhāva kalpanāt iti ced tarhi yādṛśam kṛti sādha tvam cikīrṣāyām prakāraḥ tādṛśam jñāne na asti iti anya prakāraka jñānāt eva cikīrṣā syāt tathā ca liṅga jñānam eva pravṛtti hetuḥ astu prāthamika tvāt yat tu smṛta pāke kṛti sādhya tva asaṃsargā grarhā pravṛttiḥ sa ca asaṃsarga grahaḥ iṣṭa sādhana tā grahāt iti tat na smṛta pākasya siddha tvena tatra kāryatva asaṃsarga grahe anumāna bādhāt smṛta pākasya siddhatvam tadā na gṛhyate iti ced

tarhi smṛta pākasya siddha tva grahe odana arthī pāke na pravarteta siddhaudanaḥ api pāke tṛptaḥ api bhojane pravarteta tatra siddha tva grahāt tad asaṃsarga grahaḥ iti cat tulyam api ca smṛta pāke kāryatva asaṃsargāt vidyamānā saṃsarga āgrahāt visaṃvādinī pravṛttiḥ syāt kiñca evam siddha pāka jñānāt ajñāte asiddhe pāke icchā pravṛttī syātām iti atra brūmaḥ pāke kṛti sādhya tvam siddhyat siddhe bādhāt anagāta pākam ādāya sidhyati pakṣa tā avacchedaka dharma sāmānādhikaraṇyam sādhyamānasya liṅgena siddhati iti anumāne kḷpta tvāt yathā prasiddha vahni bādhe api vahni mātram na bādhitam iti aprasiddhaḥ api vahniḥ sidhyati

tathā prasiddha pāke kṛti sādhya tva bādhe api pāka mātre na bādhitam iti aprasiddham pākam ādāya tat sidhyati aprasiddhayoḥ pakṣa sādhyayoḥ siddhau aviśeṣāt tasmāt asiddhasya kvacid siddhe siddhe siddhasya ca kvacid aprasiddhasya ca asiddhe siddhiḥ tena anumā tridhā anyathā kṛti sādhya iṣṭa sādhana tā pakṣe api pāka ādau kṛti sādhya tvam katham avagamyeta kiñca tava api iṣṭa sādhana tā jñānāt katham vṛṣṭi ādau icchā siddhatvasya icchā virodhi tvāt anāgatasya jñātum aśakyatvāt atas eva siddha asiddha viṣaya tva nirāsena sukha ādi jñānāt phale api na icchā iti na vṛṣṭyādāviṣṭa sādhana tā api na ca vṛṣṭi ādi sādhya iṣṭa jñānāt vṛṣṭi ādau icchā icchāyāḥ siddha asiddha vṛṣṭi ādi tad phala viṣaya tva vikalpa grāsāt

atha sāmānya lakṣaṇa pratyāsattyā vṛṣṭi ādi tvena sukha ādi tvena ca siddha asiddha vṛṣṭi ādi tad phala viṣayakam jñānam utpannam tena siddham virodhinam tyaktvā asiddha viṣaya icchā utpadyate yadi ca sāmānya lakṣaṇam na asti tadā yena rūpeṇa iṣṭa sā adhana tva graha tena rūpeṇa jñāte siddhe vā icchā utpadyate anvaya vyatirekābhyām tādṛśa jñānasya tādṛśa icchā janaka tva avadhāraṇāt sukha icchāyām api evam iti ced tarhi mama api pākatva avacchedena kṛti sādhya tā jñānāt anāgate cikīrṣā tat ca jñānam sakala pāka viṣayam sannikṛṣṭa pāka viṣayam vā iti anyat etat bālasya vyāpti ādi a graheṇa ādyā pravṛttiḥ jīvana adṛṣṭa udbodhita janma antara saṃskāra janyāt stana pānam kāryam iti smaraṇāt tava api iṣṭa sādhana tā smaraṇāt tatra pravṛttiḥ ananya gatika tvāt na ca janma antare api paryanuyogaḥ janma dhārāyāḥ anādi tvāt pratyakṣa anumāna mūlaka tvāt ca na andha paramparā

vastutas tu śuṣka kaṇṭatayā bālaḥ duḥkham anubhavan virodhitayā sukham smarati tatas sukha tva jñānāt sukha vṛtti kārya tvam sukha vṛtti tayā antaraṅga tvāt na tu stana pānam iṣṭa sādhanam iti smaraṇam sukha āvṛtti tvena bahis aṅga tvāt sukha kārya tvañca stana pāna dvārā janma antara anubhūtam iti kārya tva smaraṇe stana pānam api viṣayaḥ tena stana pāne kāryatva jñānāt eva pravṛttiḥ iṣṭa sādhana tā jñānasya tadānīm sāmagrya bhāvāt evañca ādya pravṛttau kāryatva jñānam prayojakam kḷptam iti agre api tat eva pravartakam kḷpta tvāt navīnaḥ tu mama idam kṛti sādhyam iti jñānam na pravṛtakam anāgata viṣaye pratyakṣa anumānayoḥ asambhavāt

kintu yādṛśasya puruṣasya kṛti sādhyam yat dṛṣṭam tādṛśa tvam ātmanaḥ pratisandhāya tatra pravṛtate tathā hi odana kāmasya tad sādhana tā jñānavataḥ ca taṇḍula ādi upakaraṇavataḥ pākaḥ kṛti sādhyaḥ aham api ca tādṛśaḥ iti jñānāt iti jñānāt pāke pravartate evañca anya kṛta pāke kṛti sādhya tā jñānam ātmanaḥ pāke kṛti sādhya tva prayojaka viśeṣaṇa vat tva jñānañca pravartakam anyatra api pravṛttiḥ evam eva iti anāditā eva atas eva sañjāta bādhaḥ caitya vandane viṣa bhakṣaṇe ca na pravartate iṣṭa sādhanatā jñānavataḥ hi tat kṛti sādhyam na ca sañjāta bādhaḥ tatra iṣṭa sādhana tā jñānavān evam tṛpti icchāvataḥ api bhojanam kṛti sādhyam tṛptaḥ ca na tṛpti icchāvat tvam ātmani avaiti iti na bhojane pravartate

ati navīnāḥ tu yādṛśasya ityādau avigīta tvam tad kṛtau viśeṣaṇam āhuḥ sañjāta bādhaḥ tu viṣa bhakṣaṇam caitya vandanañca vigīta kṛti sādhya tvena eva jānāti iti tatra na pravartate vṛtti viṣayaḥ ca sāmānyatas kāla asambhinnaḥ pāka ādiḥ jñāyate pravṛtti mahimnā ca anāgata pāka siddhiḥ cikīrṣā ca kāla asambhinna viṣayā na tu bhāvinam kṛtyā sādhayāmi iti ākārā eva iti

atra ucyate viṣa bhakṣaṇa divya avṛttam kṛti sādhya tva jñāne iṣṭa sādhana tvam viṣaya tayā avacchedakam lāghavāt na tu sva viśeṣaṇa vat tā pratisandhāna janya tvam gauravāt na ca siddhāsiddha avasthayoḥ sādhya tva sādhana tvayoḥ virodhaḥ nirviśeṣitayoḥ tayoḥ avirodhāt pākaḥ asiddhaḥ sādhyaḥ siddhaḥ sādhanañca iti anubhavāt tadā sādhya tvam hi tadā sādhana tvasya virodhi niyamataḥ tena eva tasya pratikṣepeṇa saha anavasthāna niyamāt na tu sādhana tvasya anyadā sādhana tvasya vā tayoḥ apratikṣepāt anyadā sādhana tve api sādhana tvam asti eva sāmānya abhāve viśeṣa abhāva prasaṅgāt evantadāḥ asiddha tvasya tadā siddha tvam virodhi

nayamatas tasya eva pratipakṣepāt na tu siddha tva mātram anyadā api tatra siddha tva abhāva prasaṅgat nirviśeṣitayoḥ virodhe ca siddha tva asiddhatvayoḥ ca anyataradeva pāka ādau syāt na tu samaya bhede api ubhayam na ca tadā kṛti sādhya tve sati tadā iṣṭa sādhana tva jñānam pravartakam atas eva vājapeyena yajeta iti atra yāgasya karaṇa avasthāyām siddha tvena na vājapeyasya sādhya tā ekadā tayoḥ virodhāt iti karma nāmadheya tvam na tu karaṇasya siddha tvena sādhya tva virodhaḥ yāga svarūpe tayoḥ sattvāt

atha viruddhayoḥ avaccheda bhedam ādāya ekatra pratītiḥ syāt na ca kṛti sādhya tva iṣṭa sādhana tvayoḥ samaya bhedam ādāya ekatra pratītiḥ asti tathā liṅga abhāvāt iti ced na sādhya tva sādhana tvayoḥ avirodhasya ukta tvāt evam siddhatvā siddha tvayoḥ bhāva abhāva rūpa tve api na virodhaḥ eka dharma gata tvena māna siddha tvāt tasmāt saṃyoga tadabhāvayoḥ iva yena prakāreṇa yayoḥ virodhaḥ tena tayoḥ eka dharma gata tvam na pratīyate na tu rūpa antareṇa api iti api ca yadi sādhya tva sādhana tvayoḥ virodhaḥ tadā tava api iṣṭa sādhana tvena kārya sādhana tvena vā kārya tvam na anumīyeta hetu sādhyayoḥ virodhena sāmāna adhikaraṇya abhāvena vyāpti asiddheḥ pakṣe sādhya sādhanayoḥ anyatara sattve bādhā siddhyoḥ anyatara prasaṅgāt ca na ca vācyam idānīm mad kṛti sādhya tvam sādhyam agre mad iṣṭa sādhana tvam hetuḥ

daiva ādi anadhīna tve sati yat agre mad iṣṭa sādhanam tat idānīm mad kṛti sādhyam iti vyāptiḥ tathā ca samaya bhedam ādāya sādhya tva sādhana tvayoḥ avagamaḥ iti idānīm agrima padārthayoḥ nānā tvāt anugata rūpa abhāvena vyāpteḥ agrahāt pāka nyāyena anyatra api tad tad samaya antar bhāvena sādhya tva sādhana tvayoḥ apratītiḥ pratītau vā mama api idānīm kṛti sādhya tve sati agre iṣṭa sādhanam iti jñānam pravartakam astu na ca pāke sādhya iṣṭaka tvena kṛti sādhya tvam anumeyam asiddha avasthāvataḥ hi pāka ādiṣṭa anutpatteḥ pākasya siddhatvam avagamya tad sādhya tvam iṣṭasya avagantavyam asiddha tvañcau agamya kṛti sādhya tvam iti siddha tva asiddha tvayoḥ arva rodhaḥ atra api durvāraḥ api ca sva viśeṣaṇa dhī janya kārya tā jñāna abhāvāt sukhe katham cikīrṣā na hi kṛti sādhya tā jñāna mātrāt sā sañcāta bādhasya viṣa bhakṣaṇa ādau cikīrṣā prasaṅgāt atha upāya cikīrṣāyām tad kāraṇam icchā kāraṇa sukha tva jñāne kṛti sādhya tvam yadā viṣayaḥ tadā sukhe cikīrṣā no ced icchā mātram iti dvayam eva cikīrṣā hetuḥ iti ced

tarhi icchā hetu jñāne yadā kṛti sādhya tvam bhāsate tadā cikīrṣā no ced icchāmācam iti eva sukha tad upāya cikīrṣā kāraṇam astu lāghavāt sukha tva jñāna vat iṣṭa sādhana tā jñānasya api icchā kāraṇa tvāt atas eva pāke iṣṭa sādhana tā jñāne kṛti sādhya tvam viṣayaḥ iti tatra cikīrṣā na tu vṛṣṭi ādi jñāne tad viṣaya tvam iti icchā mātram sukha cikīrṣāyām icchā kāraṇa jñāne kṛti sādhya tā viṣayake cikīrṣā janakatva avadhāraṇāt anyathā tatra cikīrṣā anutpatteḥ

vastu tas tu upāya cikīrṣā iṣṭa sādhana tā jñāna sādhyāḥ upāya icchā tvāt vṛṣṭi chāv na ca bhoga cikīrṣā vat tena vinā api syāt iti aprayojaka tvam upāya icchāyāḥ tad anvaya vyatireka anuvidhānāt vṛṣṭeḥ ca svatas asundara tvena icchā anutpatteḥ anugata upāya icchāyām anugatasya prayojaka tve sambhavati bādhakam vinā tyāga ayogāt ca na ca cikīrṣā anya tve sati upāya icchātvam icchā tvam vā tad janya tve prayojakam gauravāt

sukha icchāyām tad abhāvāt ca evañcopāya cikīrṣāyām iṣṭa sādhana tva jñāne dhruve ati prasaṅga vāraṇa artham kṛti sādhya tva nirvāha arthañca kṛti sādhya tvam api viṣaya tayā avacchedakam astu na tu tad vihāya tanmātram kḷpta kāraṇam vinā kārya anupapatteḥ atas eva stana pāna pravṛttau api upāya it chā kāraṇa tvena gṛhītasya iṣṭa sādhana tva jñānasya api kalpanam dṛṣṭa anurodhi tvāt kalpanāyāḥ nanu sādhana tvam icchā virodhi tasya siddha dharma tvāt vṛṣṭi ādau tad sādhya iṣṭa jñānātā icchā iti ced na nirviśeṣitayoḥ siddha tva asiddha tvayoḥ virodhena icchā sādhana tvayoḥ avirodhāt tadā asiddhatvam tadā siddha tvam ca na icchā sādhana tvayoḥ prayojakam iti tathā na jñāyate eva

yat tu tad sādhya iṣṭa jñānāt vṛṣṭi ādau icchā iti tad tuccham asiddha avasthāt vṛṣṭi ādeḥ iṣṭa nityatteḥ tasmāvadvayam siddha tvam avagantavyam icchā anurodhi tvāḥ ca asiddha tvam iti tatra api virodhaḥ eva vṛṣṭau satyām iṣṭa tayā vinā na iti anvaya vyatireka grahasya vṛṣṭi siddhatnam ādāya dṛṣṭi nirūpita iṣṭa sādhyaka tva grāhaka tvāt kiñca cikīrṣā janya kṛti sādhyam maṇḍalīkaraṇam iti artha pratipādakam maṇḍalī kuryāt iti vākyām pramāṇam syāt viṣaya ābādhāt

etena navīna matam api apāstam parasya hi kṛti sādhya tva odana kāma nāvat tva iṣṭa sādhana tā jñānānām jñānam tathā ātmanaḥ odana kāma nāvat tva iṣṭa sādhana tā jñānasya jñānam na pravṛtti kāraṇam gauravāt kintu mad kṛti sādhya tve sati mad iṣṭa sādhana tā jñānam eva lāghavāt yathā ca sādhya tva sādhana tvayā urivirodhaḥ anāgatasya pāka ādeḥ kṛti sādhyatā jñānañca tathā upapāditam eva kiñca para kṛti sādhya tvam ajñātvā api sva kṛti sādhya iṣṭa sādhana tā jñānāt sva kalpita lipya ādau yauvanam kāma udrekāt sambhoga ādau pravṛtteḥ ca tat eva pravartakam

vastutas tu siddha viṣaya ka kṛti sādhya ta ajñānāt katham kṛtyā sādhayāmi iti icchā siddhe icchā virahāt asiddhasya ajñānāt atha siddha viṣayāt eva kṛti sādhya tā jñānāt asiddha viṣayā kṛti sādhya tvena icchā jñāyate icchāyāḥ asiddha viṣaya tva svabhāva tvāt eka prakāraka tvena jñāna cikīrṣayoḥ kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ na tu eka viṣaya tve sati gauravāt icchāyāḥ anāgata viṣaya tvāt tasya ca ajñānāt tathā tva darśanāt sukha ādi icchāyām api evam iti ced na asiddha viṣaya icchā anu rodhena anāgata jñāna upāyasya darśita tvāt astu ca evam tathā api kṛti sādhya tā jñāne iṣṭa sādhana tvam eva vyāvartaka m astu sva parakīya iṣṭa sā adhana tā jñāna phala kāmanā jñāna apekṣayā laghu tvāt iṣṭa sādhana tā jñāna jñānasya phala kāmanā jñānasya ca hetu tve māna abhāvāt ca

navyāḥ tu sva kṛti sādhya ta ajñānam eva pravartakam tena sva kṛtya sādhye vṛṣṭi ādau kārīḥ yāñca kṛṣīvalasya na pravṛttiḥ na ca san jāta bādhasya viṣa bhakṣaṇe pravṛtti prasaṅgaḥ sva kṛti sādhya ta ajñāna viṣaye iṣṭa tvasya svarūpa satas pravṛttau sahakāri tvāt na ca san jāta bādhasya viṣa bhakṣaṇāt ā icchāsti iṣṭa sādhana tvena ajñānāt atīta bhojane api atas eva na pravarteta tṛpteḥ siddha tayā icchā viraheṇa bhojane tad upādhika iṣṭa tva abhāvāt atīta tṛptau icchā na asti iti tad sādhane api iṣṭa tva abhāvāt eva na pravṛttiḥ na ca evam pāke na pravarteta

tasya svarasataḥ iṣṭa tva abhāvāt iti vācyam iṣṭa sādhana tva jñānena tasya api iṣṭa tvāt hanta evam prāthamika tvāt iṣṭa tva artham avaśya apekṣaṇīya tvāt ca kṛti sādhya tve sati iṣṭa sādhana tā jñānam eva cikīrṣā kāraṇam astu iti ced na iṣṭa sādhana tva abhāve api bhoge cikīrṣā sattvāt tasyām sva kṛti sādhya tva jñāne sati iṣṭa tvam eva kāraṇam na tu iṣṭa sādhana tvam vyabhicārāt pāka ādau tad anvaya vyatirekau api iṣṭa tva upakṣīṇau evam bhoge api pravartā iti ced na iṣṭa sādhana tā pakṣe api mukti rūpa iṣṭa sādhane sukhe pravarteta iti tulyam sukhe cikīrṣā bhavati eva kṛtiḥ tu na bhavati kṛteḥ siddha vṛtti asiddha kriyā viṣaya tva niyamāt iti ced talyam tasmāt sva kṛti sādhya tvam vidhiḥ iṣṭa tvam sahakārī iti mā evam iṣṭa sādhana tā jñānasya upāya icchāyām hetu tva avadhāraṇāt tasyāḥ tad janya tva niyamāt i chāyāḥ sva viṣaya icchā anutpādaka tva niyamāt ca nanu siddhaudanaḥ kutas pāke na pravartate odana mātrasya siddha tvena iṣṭatva abhāvāt atas eva atīta bhojana ādau na pravṛtate atīta tṛṣṇā ādi virahāt

nanu sāmudrika vida ākhyāte bhāvi yauva rājye bhoga sādhane sva kṛti sādhya tve sati iṣṭa sādhana tva jñānāt kutas na pravartate bhāvi rājyasya asiddha tvāt pravṛtteḥ siddha viṣaya tva niyamāt rājya upāya aparicayāt ca tad paricaye ca pravartate eva devatā ārādhana ādau iti ced na siddhe cikīrṣā viraheṇa yāga ādau api apravṛtti prasaṅgāt devatā ārādhana ādeḥ api asiddha tvena tatra api apravṛtti prasaṅgāt ca kiñca rājya upāya aparicaye tatra mā pravartiṣṭa sva kṛti sādhyeṣṭa sādhana tvena jñāte rājye pravarti prasaṅge kim āyātam na hi kṛti sādhya iṣṭa sādhana tvena jñāne api tad upāya jñānam tatra pravartakam gauravāt bhinna viṣaya tvāt ca iti ced mā evam yauvane hi tāvat pravartate eva rājye bālye tu rājya upāyam akṛtvā mad kṛtya idānīm rājyam na sidhyati iti sva kṛti a sādhyata ajñānāt eva na pravartate

yathā taṇḍulam vinā pāke sva kṛti asādhyata ajñānāt rājya upāye tu sva kṛti sādhyeṣṭa sādhana tvena jñāte devatā ārādhana ādau pravartate eva atas eva vrīhi avaghātam akṛtvā puroḍāśaḥ tam akṛtvā yāgaḥ tam akṛtvā apūrvam sādhayitum na śakyate iti kramaśas avaghāta ādau pravartate na yugapad siddha vṛtti asiddha kriyā viṣaya svabhāva tvāt pravṛtteḥ yāga anantarañca na apūrve pravartate kṛti antaram vinā eva yāga kṛtitsta sambhavāt iṣṭa sādhane ceṣṭā utpattinā antarīyaka duḥkha adhika duḥkha ājanaka tvam viśeṣaṇam na tu tad jñāna abhāvaḥ kāraṇam kintu tat eva viṣaya tayā kāraṇa tāvacchedakam lāghavāt tena madhu viṣa sampṛkta anna bhojane na pravṛttiḥ pareṇa api pravṛtti pūrvam liṅga viśeṣaṇa tvena anyathā vā tad jñāna viniyoga svīkārāt evañca alpa āyāsa sādhya ādiṣṭa utpatti sambhave bahu āyāsa sādhye na pravṛttiḥ atas eva śruta svarga phalaka tve api bahu vitta vyaya āyāsa sādhye jyotiṣṭoma ādau phala bhūmā kalpa pate anyathā alpa āyāsa sādhyāt eva svarga siddhi sambhave tatra apravṛttau ananuṣṭhāna lakṣaṇam aprāmāṇyam tad vidheḥ syāt

balavat aniṣṭān anubandhi tvañca na viśeṣaṇam bahu vitta vyaya āyāsa sādhya bahutara duḥkhasya api abalavat tvam kvacid alpa duḥkhasya api balavat tvam iti anugatasya tasya abhāvāt na ceṣṭā apekṣayā aniṣṭasya adhika tvam balavat tvam tasya api ukta atiriktasya ananugamāt āstikasya niṣiddha tvena jñāte api pravṛttiḥ rāga dveṣayoḥ utkaṭa tvena naraka sādhana tva jñāna tirodhānāt

nanu na kalañjam bhakṣayet iti atra vidhi artha niṣedha anupapattiḥ tad bhakṣaṇasya tṛpti rūpa iṣṭa sādhana tvāt na ca asura avidyā ādi vat paryudāsa lakṣaṇayā virodhi aniṣṭa sādhana tva bodhanam nañaḥ asamasta tvāt kriyā saṅgata tvena pratiṣedha vācaka tva vyutpatteḥ ca iti ced na viśeṣyavati viśiṣṭa niṣedhasya sa viśeṣaṇe hi iti nyāyena viśeṣaṇa niṣedha paryavasāyitayā kalañja bhakṣaṇam iṣṭa utpattinā antarīyaka duḥkha atirikta duḥkha sādhanam iti na kalañjam bhakṣayet iti anena bodhanāt iṣṭa sādhana tā vācakasya vidheḥ sāmānyatas niṣedha anupapatteḥ balavat aniṣṭān anubandhi iṣṭa sādhana tva viśeṣa niṣedha tātparyam tathā ca aśakya viśeṣa niṣedha paratvam nañaḥ iti kaścid tat na yathā hi ayogya tayā sa chidram vihāya ghaṭa tvena tad itara anvayaḥ na tu chidra itara tvena yugapad vṛtti dvaya virodhāt tathā atra api balavat aniṣṭa an anubandhi tvena anupasthitau katham tat niṣedhaḥ

śyenena abhicaran yajeta iti atra katham vidhi pravṛttiḥ hiṃsāyāḥ balavat aniṣṭa anubandhi tvāt iti ced na tatra kṛti sādhya tve sati iṣṭa sādhana tvam eva yogyatayā anveti na tu balavat aniṣṭān anubandhi tvam api ayogya tvāt nindā artha vādena prāyaścitta upadeśena ca hiṃsāyāḥ balavat aniṣṭa anubandhi tva avagamāt atas eva vihite api śyene vigānāt na tāttvika pravṛttiḥ rāga dveṣayoḥ utkaṭa tvena aniṣṭa anubandhi aṃśasya tiraskārāt kasyacid pravṛttiḥ iti eke

anye tu abhicārasya vairi vadha phalaka tvena śruta tvāt badha sādhana tvena śyenaḥ vidhīyate na tu vadha sādhya naraka sādhana tvena narakasya phala tvena aśruteḥ na ca janaka janakasya janakatva niyamaḥ kumbhakāra pitṛ paramparāyāḥ kumbha janakatva āpattaḥ vidhinā eva śyenasya balavat aniṣṭaḥ nanubandhi tva bodhanāñca na ca śyenasya naraka ahetu tve apekṣita vairi vadha hetu tve vā avigānena pravṛttiḥ syāt iti vācyam śyenāt vadhaḥ vadhāt ca avaśyam narakaḥ iti pratisandhānena vigānāt

nanu śyenaḥ maraṇa phalaka vyāpāra tvena hiṃsā sā ca naraka janikā iti ced na na hi sākṣāt paramparā sā dhāraṇa maraṇa phalaka vyāpāraḥ hiṃsā kūpa ādau vinaṣṭe gavi tad kartuḥ go vadha kartṛ tva āpatteḥ vadhyasya api hantuḥ mṛtyu utpādana dvāreṇa ātma hantṛ tva prasaṅgāt ca na hi anutpādita manyuḥ kaścid kam api vyāpādayati kintu anuniṣpādi maraṇa phala kaḥ vyāpāraḥ hiṃsā yad anantaram maraṇam bhavati eva na ca śyenaḥ tathā kintu khaṅga hanana ādikam eva atha maraṇonukūla vyāpāraḥ maraṇet deśena anuṣṭhīyamānaḥ hiṃsā śyenaḥ ca tathā kūpa ādau ca na maraṇa uddeśena anuṣṭhīyamāna tvam iti ced

na evam sati gauravāt maraṇān uddeśena kṣipta nārāca adha brāhmaṇe ca hiṃsā na syāt kiñca hinasti dhātu arthe avacchedakam phalam avyavahitam eva maraṇam avyavahita phalakasya eva vyāpārasya dhātu vācya tvāt anyathā paramparāyāḥ viklitti phalaka anna kāma iṣṭa taṇḍula kraya ādau api pacati iti prasaṅgāt evam khaṅga ubhighāta anantaram yatra vilambena maraṇam vraṇa pāka paramparayā vai anne viṣa prayogena vā tatra hantṛ tvam prāyaścitta ādi ca na syāt iti ced na prāyaścitta tulya tā artham hi tatra hantṛvya apadeśaḥ gauṇaḥ vinigama kañca lāghavam eva

vastutas tu maraṇa uddeśena kṛtaḥ adṛṣṭāt vārakaḥ tad anukūla vyāpāraḥ hiṃsā śyenaḥ ca adṛṣṭa dvārā maraṇa sādhanam atas na hiṃsā yadi ca adṛṣṭa dvārā api maraṇa sādhanam hiṃsā syāt tadā saptamī taila abhyaṅgasya adṛṣṭa dvārā iṣṭa bhāryā vināśa īhetu tvāt abhyaṅga kartuḥ hiṃsaka tva āttiḥ atas eva kūpa ādau gomaraṇe api na vadha kartṛ tvam tat kartuḥ gala lagna anna maraṇe na bhoktuḥ na vā pariveṣayituḥ ātma hantṛ tvam brahma hantṛ tvam vā vraṇa pāka paramparayā vilambena viṣa prayogena ca hantṛ tvam mukhyam eva na tu anuniṣpādi maraṇa phalaka tvam gala lagna anna maraṇe sva hantṛ tva āpatteḥ anya uddeśena kṣipta nārācena hate brāhmaṇe brahma hantṛ tvam na syāt iti ced na iṣṭa āpatteḥ vyāpadeśaḥ tu gauṇaḥ prayogaḥ lakṣaṇayā api samarthayitum śakyate tad pakṣe ati prasaṅgaḥ vārayitum na śakyate iti idam eva vinigamakam atas eva atad uddeśena kṛte api niṣiddhe prāyaścitta arddham uktam

apare tu anabhisaṃhita nara antara vyāpāram advārīkṛtya maraṇa sādhanam hiṃsā khaḍga kārasya anabhisaṃhita nara antara vyāpāra dvārāḥ maraṇa sādhana tvam tasya hi nara antara vyāpāraḥ nābhisaṃhitaḥ kintu dhana lābhaḥ iti khaḍga kāraḥ na ghātakaḥ viṣasya anne prakṣepeṇa nara antara vyāpāraḥ bhojanam eva abhisaṃhitaḥ anena idam bhoktavyam iti abhisandhāya viṣa prayogāt iti hiṃsā eva anne viṣa prayogaḥ iti tat na gala lagna kavalāt i atra maraṇam tatra pariveṣayituḥ ghātaka tā āpātāt anena idam bhoktavyam iti abhisandhāya pariveṣaṇāt bhoktuḥ ātma hantṛ tva āpatteḥ ca anabhisaṃhita nara antara vyāpāram advārīkṛtya maraṇa anukūla anna bhakṣaṇa nuṣṭhānāt atas eva avyavahita prāṇa viyoga phalakaḥ vyāpāraḥ hiṃsā vraṇa pāka paramparayā mṛte tu hantṛ tvam vyāpārasya avyavadhāyaka tvāt iti nirastam

syāt etat na iṣṭa sādhatā vidhiḥ nitye sandhyā upāsana ādau phala abhāvāt atha na asti eva tat nityam yatra artha vāda ādikam vidhi vākye vā na phalam śrutam asti sandhyām upāsate ye tu satatam śaṃsita vratāḥ vidhūta pāpāḥ te yānti brahma lokam sanātanam iti ādi artha vādāt dadyāt aharahar śrāddham pitṛbhyaḥ prītim āvahan ityādi vidhi vākya śravaṇāt ca kṛtvā acintayātu ucyate yatra na phala śrutiḥ tatra viśvajit nyāyāt svargaḥ phalam iti ced na kāmanā upādhi kārya tvena yāga vat nitya tā bhaṅga prasaṅgāt aharahar śrutyā hi tad kāla jīvi mātra kṛti sādhyam sandhyā vandanam avagatam kāmanā upādhi kārya tve ca yadā phala kāmanā na asti tadā tad samayaḥ eva tad kartavyatā na syāt na hi tad kāle phala kāmanā vaśyambhāvaḥ

pramāṇa abhāvāt kiñca prathama pravṛtta itara nirapekṣā hara har śrutyā jīvi mātrasya adhikāraḥ avagataḥ tathā ca tad sāpekṣa caram apravṛtti arthavāda upanīta phala kāmasya na tatra adhikāraḥ prathama pravṛttā aharahar śruti virodhāt nitye phala śruteḥ artha vādasya ca stutau tātparyam atas eva pratyavāya parihāraḥ api na phalam tad kāmanā upādhi kārya tve nitya tā kṣateḥ kiñca nitye kartavya tā bodhanāt prāk na pratyavāye pramāṇam asti vidheḥ kartavya tvam avagamya kartavyā karaṇe pratyavāya kalpanam vidhiḥ ca phala abhāvena prathamam mūkaḥ eva evañca pratyavāya pramitau vidhi pravṛttiḥ tad pravṛttau ca kartavyā karaṇe pratyavāya kalpanam iti anyonya āśrayaḥ

apare tu na vidheḥ kartavya tvam avagamya kartavyā karaṇe pratyavāya kalpanam yena anyonya āśrayaḥ kintu nindā artha vādena prāyaścitta upadeśena ca upāsanasya prakṛti arthasya tāvat vyāpāra svarūpasya abhāvaḥ pratyavāya hetuḥ avagataḥ tathā ca sandhyā upāsana abhāvaḥ pratyavāya dvārāḥ duḥkha sādhanam tad abhāvaḥ sandhyā upāsanam duḥkha sādhana abhāva tvena phalam prāyaścitte pāpa dhvaṃsa vat iti tad sādhana tvena kṛtiḥ bodhyate vidhinā na ca evam pratyavāya parihāraḥ eva phalam astu iti vācyam parihārasya prāc abhāva rūpa tvena anāditayā asādhya tvāt na ca upāsana ākaraṇam pratyavāya hetuḥ na upāsana abhāvaḥ tathā ca duḥkha sādhana abhāva tvena kṛtiriṣṭāḥ na tu upāsanam iti vācyam nindā artha vādasya ubhayatra sattvena ubhayasya api tathā tvāt iti tat na evam api kāmya tve nitya tā kṣati prasaṅgāt kiñca akurvan vihitam karma ityādinā na upāste yaḥ ca paścimām ityādinā ca karaṇa bhāvasya eva pratyavāya hetu tvam bodhyate na tu tad viṣaya abhāvasya anyathā akartuḥ pratyavāyaḥ na anyasya iti katham syāt viṣaya abhāvasya sādhāraṇyāt

vastutas tu kṛti sādhya tve sati iṣṭa sādhana tā jñānam pravartṛka tvena niryūḍham na ca kṛtau kṛti sādhya tvam asti iti atas na kiñcid etat navyāḥ tu nitya apūrva prāgabhāvaḥ durita dvārā duḥkha sādhanam tad abhāvaḥ apūrvam duḥkha sādhana abhāva tvena iṣṭam tad sādhana tvena kṛti sādhya tvena ca sandhyā upāsanam vidhīyate iti tat na nindā artha vāda ādinā sandhyā upāsana abhāvaḥ tad akaraṇam vā pratyavāya hetuḥ avagataḥ na tu apūrvā bhāvaḥ prathamam pramāṇa abhāvena tad anupasthiteḥ vidheḥ iṣṭa sādhana tva bodhaka tvāt pariśeṣeṇa apūrvam iṣṭam kalpyate iti ced

tarhi viśva jit nyāyena svargaḥ eva phalam kalpyatām kāmya tvasya tvayā api svīkārāt kiñca vidhi pravṛttau apūrva jñānam apūrva jñāne ca vidhi pravṛttiḥ iti anyonya āśrayaḥ yāvat nitya naimittika nirvāhasya tad tad āśrama vihita karmaṇām samyak paripālanasya ca brahma loka avāptiḥ phalam śrūyate tathā ca nityasya saphala tvam iti kecid tat na tasya vidheḥ nitya vidhim upajīvya pravṛttiḥ tasya ca phala abhāvena prathamam mūka tvāt anyathā paraspara sāpekṣa tvena anyonya āśrayaḥ tasmāt kārya tā eva vidhiḥ nanu nitye vedāt kārya tā jñāne api prayojana jñānam vinā katham pravṛttiḥ na hi prayojanam anuddiśya mandaḥ api pravartate iti ced na nitye phala bādhena pravṛtti mātre prayojana jñānasya aprayojaka tvāt kāmye api prayojana jñānam na sākṣāt pravartakam upāya aviṣaya tvāt prayojane apravṛtteḥ ca kintiṣṭa sādhana tā jñāna dvārā kārya tā jñāne upakṣīṇam eva katham ayam niścayaḥ nitye iṣṭa sādhana tā jñāna asambhavāt kārya tā ajñānasya vedāt api sambhavāt

nanu niṣphale duḥkha eka phale vā prekṣāvatām katham pravṛttiḥ veda adhīna kārya tā jñāna sattvāt saphala pravṛttau api tasya eva tantra tvāt yat tu laukike niṣphale duḥkha eka phale vā na pravartate tat iṣṭa sādhana tā āliṅgakasya kārya tā ajñānasya veda adhīnasya vā abhāvāt na ca duḥkha eka phala tva jñānam pravatti pratibandhakam sati kārya tā jñāne tasya pratibandhakatvā darśanāt atha vā kāmye liṅaḥ apūrva vācaka tvāt nitye api liṅā upāsana ādi viṣaya kamapūrvam bodhyate tat ca niṣphalam api svatas eva sukha vat prayojanam nityam abhyarthyam ānañca iti ucyate sarvatra nitye phala śravaṇāt jīvi phala kāmasya samvalita adhikāraḥ yathā uparāge naimittikam snāna śrāddha ādi phala śruteḥ kāmyam akaraṇe prāyaścitta ādi śruteḥ ca niyata kartavya tākam

yathā vā ṣoḍaśa śrāddhasya preta tva vimukti kāmanā śruteḥ preta tva vimukti hetu ṣoḍaśa śrāddhe saṅkalpam vidhāya mahājanānām ācārāt kāmya tvam nindā artha vādena akaraṇe pratyavāya śruteḥ avaśya kartavya tvam tathā sandhyā upāsanam api phala śruteḥ kāmyam akaraṇe naraka śruteḥ prāyaścitta upadeśāt ca niyata kartavya tākam yat tu yāge kāmya tve api na niyata kartavya tāka tvam tad akaraṇe prāyaścitta anupadeśāt na ca nitye phala kāmanāyāḥ asambhavaḥ tri kāla kāmyaḥ tava pāṭha vat nitye phala kāmanām ambhavāt yat tu prathama pravṛtta āharaḥ śrutyā tad kāla jīvimācasya adhikāra bodhanāt na phala kāmasya adhikāraḥ iti tat na aharahar śruti artha vādayoḥ prathama gṛhīta eka vākyatā balena tad kāla jīvi phala kāmasya sa āvalita adhikārāt arthavāda upasthita phala anvayam vinā eka vākyatā bhaṅgāt na ca artha vādasya stuti paratva at na eka vākyatā bādhakam vinā sva artha aparityāgāt vidhi vākya upasthite phale vidhi vākya stha phalam ādāya eva aharahar śrutyā kārya tā bodhanāt

nanu evam tad kāla jīvi kāminaḥ adhikāre yadā phala kāmanā virahaḥ tadā aśuceḥ iva adhikāra abhāvāt niyata kartavyatā na syāt adhikṛta akaraṇe pratyavāyaḥ na tu akaraṇa mātraḥ iti ced na naimittike api tad kāle kasyacid kāmanā virahiṇaḥ aniyata kartavyatā āpatteḥ atha apavāda abhāvena autsargikī phala kāmanā asti eva phala jñānasya sva viṣayaka icchā janaka svabhāva tvāt yasya tu mumukṣa apavādena phala antare kāmanā na asti tasya akaraṇe api na pratyavāyaḥ iti na tat niyata kartavya tāka tvam naimittike tathā nitye api mumukṣayā phala kāmanā bādhena akaraṇe api na pratyavāyaḥ iti tulyam kiñca arthavāda upasthita phala upādhikartavya tve avagate akurvan vihitam karma ityādi vākyāt śauce sati sandhyā vandana akaraṇe nindā artha vādena ca naraka śruteḥ prāyaścitta upadeśāt ca pratyavāyaḥ kalpyate tad phala kāmanā virahe api pratyavāya parihāra artham niyamataḥ pravartate vidhi pravṛtti anantaram pratyavāyasya prāmāṇika tvāt akaraṇet mukhasya karaṇena pratyavāya prāgabhāvasya sādhya tvāt naimittike phala upādhi kartavya tve kāmanā virahe api niyata kartavya tāvat

yat tu niṣphale api nitye veda adhīna kārya tā jñānāt pravartate iti tat na duḥkha eka phala tvena jñāyamāne prekṣāvatām kṛteḥ anutpāda niyamāt ayogya tayā nitye kṛti sādhya tvasya bodhayitum aśakyatvāt atas eva sandhyā upāsanam aphalam api kriyate veda bodhita kartavya tāka tvāt iti āśaṅkya guru matam etat na guroḥ matam iti abhiprāyeṇa īpekṣitavān ācāryaḥ

yat tu paṇḍa apūrvam svatas eva prayojanam iti uktam tat api na evam tava api kāmya tve nitya tva hāni āpatteḥ kiñca sukham duḥkha abhāvaḥ ca mukhyam prayojanam tad sādhanañca gauṇam nitya apūrvantu teṣu na ekam api paṇḍa apūrva tvāt kāmyāpūrvañca sukha hetuḥ gauṇam prayojanam pravartaka vidhi anurodhena tat api pravartakam kalpyate iti ced na pravartanīyena lokena tasya prayojana tvena ajñānāt guruṇā nitya apūrvam prayojanam uktam iti ucyamāne api na ādaraḥ prekṣāvatām mukti svargau ca alaukikau api sukha duḥkha abhāvasa jātīya tayā prayojane tasmāt evam vadan guruḥ api laghuḥ eva

tat ayam saṅkṣepaḥ nitye duḥkha eka phala tvena pravṛtti anupapatteḥ phala upādhi kartavya tā tat ca phalam duḥkha sādhana abhāvaḥ pāṇḍa apūrvam vā iti tad icchā pravṛci artham pratyaham upeyā tām vinā pravṛtti anupapatteḥ tathā ca artha vādikam vidhi vākya śru tañca phalam astu kṛtam anyena na ca kāmanā virahe niyata kartavyatā na syāt apūrva ādi icchā virahe api tulya tvāt pratyavāya parihā artham niyamataḥ pravṛttiḥ tulyā eva yatra ca na phala śrutiḥ tatra viśvajit nyāya iti

nanu idam iṣṭa sādhanam iti jñānāt etat sādhyam iṣṭam iti jñānāt ca pravṛtti darśanāt prathamasya eva pravartaka tve kim vinigamakam ucyate phala icchāyām sva viṣaya viśeṣyaka jñānasya hetu tvena kḷpta tvāt upāya cikīrṣā api bādhakam vinā tathā vastutas tu kṛti sādhya yāgasya sādhyaḥ iṣṭa jñānasya pravṛrtaka tve yajeta iti padāt prathamam kṛti sādhyaḥ yāgaḥ iti jñānam tatas kṛti sādhya yāgasya sādhyaḥ iṣṭaḥ iti jñānam viśeṣaṇa jñāna sādhya tvāt viśiṣṭa jñānasya iti jñāna dvayam tava mama tu yāgaḥ kṛti sādhyaḥ iṣṭa sādhanam iti ekam eva jñānam na ca kṛti sādhya tvam yāge bodhayitvā kṛti sādhya yāgasya sādhyaḥ iṣṭaḥ iti liṅā bodhayitum śakyam api eka sva artha anvayam aparada arthe bodhayitvā tad anvita apara sva artha nvaya bodhaka tvasya pade avyutpatteḥ yajipade ca kṛtyā yāga anvayam bodhayitvā paryavasite punar sva artha anvaya bodhaka tve āvṛtti prasaṅgaḥ

atha sādhyam iṣṭam yasya iti sādhya iṣṭaka tvam śakyam tathā ca bahu brīhi artha apekṣayā iṣṭasya sādhanam iti ṣaṣṭhī arthasya laghu tvāt tat eva śakyam kiñca tad sādhya tvam na niyamataḥ tat uttara sattvam daṇḍa sādhye ghaṭe vyabhicārāt na api tad avacchinna kṣaṇa uttarakṣaṇaḥ eva sattvam eva kāra vyavacchedya tad anuttara samayasya ākāśe aprasiddheḥ śabdasya tat asādhya tva āpatteḥ atas eva na tad abhāva vyāpaka abhāva pratiyogi tvam rūpe rasa sādhya tva āpatteḥ ca na api tad avadhika uttara tva vyāpya samaya sambandhaḥ uttara tva vyāpya tvam hi uttara tva an adhikaraṇa kāla āvṛtti tvam tat ca ākāśe aprasiddham gurutarañca tasmāt tad sādhanaka tvam eva tad sādhya tvam evañca lāghavāt tad sādhana tva jñānam eva pravartakam na tu tad sādhanaka tva jñānam iti syāt etat iṣṭa tva jñānasya pravartaka tve tṛptaḥ api bhojane pravarteta

manasā tṛpteḥ iṣṭa tva jñānāt atha svarūpa satī api phala icchā kāraṇam sā ca siddha tayā tṛptau na asti iti ced tarhi hantā evam āvaśyaka tvāt phala icchā eva kāraṇam na tu tat jñānam gauravāt kiñca icchā jñānasya kāraṇa tve icchā kāraṇam na syāt sva jñānena tad nāśāt icchā tad jñāna dhārā kalpane anavasthānāt api ca icchā viṣayaḥ sukham iti jñānam na mānasam sukhasya asiddha tayā tad viśeṣya ka sākṣatikārasya tad sannikarṣam vinā abhāvāt odana ādau api iṣṭa tva jñānam na sambhavati manasaḥ bahis asvātantryāt na api cakṣuḥ ādinā jñātaḥ kṛtaḥ iti vat iṣṭa tva jñānam tatra viśeṣya sannikarṣāt vastutas tu iṣṭasya viśiṣya sukha tva ādinā ajñāne yāga pākāt āviṣṭa sādhana tā jñānepya pravṛtti prasaṅgaḥ iṣṭasya alpa adhika bhāvena nānā prakāra tvena ca viśiṣya anadhyavasāyāt na ca iṣṭa viṣaya tā avacchedaka sukha tva ādeḥ upalakṣaṇam iṣṭa tvam sukha duḥkha abhāva tad sādhaneṣu anugatasya upalakṣyasya abhāvena ananugamāt iti

ucyate yatra icchā tad sādhana tā jñānam eva loka vedasādhāraṇam pravartakam teṣām sukha duḥkha abhāva tad sādhana tvena icchā viṣayāṇām ananugatanām api vastu sadicchā viṣaya tvam eva anugamakam evam yadā sukha ādau icchā bhavati sva kṛti sādhya tve sati sukha ādi sādhanam iti jñānam tadā pāka ādau pravartate nanu evam pravartaka jñāna viṣayasya nānā tvena tad śaktasya vidhi pratyayasya nānā artha tva prasaṅgaḥ iti ced na sukha tva ādinā anugatam iṣṭa tvena ananugatam phalam prati sādhana tvasya yāgadeḥ liṅga ādinā bodhanāt tathā ca phalānām anugama artham phala icchā śakyā na tu icchā jñāna kāraṇa tvena

atha evam sukha ādi sādhana tvena jñānam pravartakam tat na śakyam ananugamāt yat ca śakyam iṣṭa sādhana tvam tat jñānam na pravartakam iti vidheḥ pravartaka tā na syāt iti ced sākṣāt evam eva kintu iṣṭa sādhanam yāgaḥ iti liṅā bodhite iṣṭa ākāṅkṣāyām kāmya tvena śrutaḥ svargaḥ eva iṣṭa tvena avagamyate tad anantaram svarga kāma pada samabhivyāhārāt svarga sādhanam yāgaḥ iti jñānam pravartakam utpadyate evañca vidhi janya jñāna janyam jñānam pravartakam yat tu sarveṣām eva vidheḥ na sākṣāt pravṛtaka tvam vidhi bodhakāt sva kṛti sādhya tva ādeḥ anavagamāt sva iṣṭa sādhana tvañca aham iṣṭa sādhana yāgakaḥ svarga kāma tvāt darśa vākya avagata svarga kāma vat iti anantaram arthāt pratīyate tat na yatra icchā tad sādhanam iti śābda jñānāt eva pravṛtti upapatteḥ tad pratītiḥ niṣphalā

anye tu sādhana tva mātram vidhi arthaḥ svarga ādi sādhana tāla ābhaḥ tu samabhivyāhārāt iṣṭa sādhana tā pakṣe api tasya upajīvya tvāt tathā hi yajeta iti anena yāgaḥ kṛti sādhyaḥ sādhanañca iti bodhite sādhanasya sādhya ākāṅkṣāyām kāmanā viṣaya tvena śrutaḥ asiddhaḥ svargaḥ eva sādhana ākāṅkṣī sādhya tvena avagamyate upasthita tvāt na ca yāgasya sādhana ākāṅkṣā kṛti sādhya tvena eva upasthiteḥ atas eva viśva jit ādau svargaḥ eva sādhya tvena kalpyate iti iṣṭa sādhana tā vidhi pakṣe api tarati mṛtyum tarati brahya hatyām yaḥ aśvamedhena yajate iti ādi artha vāde vidhi bodhya iṣṭa sādhana tvasya artha vādāt eva avagamāt kutas vidhi kalpanam iti ced na avinā abhāvāt tathābhūta sādhana tvasya vidheya tva vyāpta tvāt vyāpaka anupalambha bādha uddhārāya vā prayojana abhāvāt na tad kalpanam tatra iti api āhuḥ yat tu iṣṭa sādhanatva abhidhāne karaṇe liṅaḥ anuśāsanāt darśa paurṇamāsābhyām iti anabhihita adhikāra vihitā tṛtīyā na syāt iti tat na upāya tā mātra abhidhāne api tad viśeṣa karaṇa tva anabhidhānāt vastutastu abhihita anvaya labhyam yāga iṣṭa sādhana tvam iṣṭa sādhana tva mātrasya vidhi artha tvāt

navyāḥ tu cikīrṣā dvārā jñānasya kṛtau hetu tā cikīrṣā ca kṛtau icchā sanaḥ prakṛti artha gocara icchā vāci tvāt pipakṣa ādi vat na tu kṛti viṣaya pāka ādi viṣaye kṛti sādhya tva prakāraka icchā abhidhāyaka tvam pāka ādeḥ prakṛti anabhidheya tvāt na hi kṛti vācakasya tad viṣaya vācaka tvam karoti iti ukte tad viṣaya saṃśayāt evañca kṛta āviccheṣṭa sādhana tā jñānāt tad sādhya iṣṭa jñānāt vā vṛṣṭi ādau tathā kalpanāt yadā ca kṛtau icchā tadā sā eva cikīrṣā anyatra icchā mātram na tu kṛti sādhya tā jñānāt kṛtau kṛti sādhya tva abhāvāt

atha pākam kṛtyā sādhayāmi iti icchā anubhava siddhā anubhava apalāpe upekṣaṇīyatva āpatteḥ sā ca kṛti sādhya tā jñānāt sā ca cikīrṣā pada apratipādya api kṛti hetaḥ samāna viṣaya tvāt na tu kṛti icchā kṛti hetuḥ kṛti viṣaya aviṣaya tvāt iti ced asti tāvat pāka kṛtau icchā vṛṣṭī icchāvat asti ca kṛti sādhya tva kārikā icchā pāke tathā api kṛti chā eva kṛti kāraṇam lāghavāt na tu kṛti sādhya tva prakārikā icchā gauravāt dhātu arthān uparakte kṛti svarūpe icchā eva na udeti iti ced na pāka ādi kṛti iṣṭa sādhana tā jñānāt pāka kṛtau icchā tatas kṛtiḥ iti abhyupagamāt na ca avagati pravṛttyoḥ samāna viṣaya tvam ubhaya siddham

tasya eva vicārya tvāt katham tarhi pākam kṛtyā sādhayāmi iti icchā yathā vahni sādhya tvena iṣṭa sādhana tā avagamāt vahninā pākam sādhayāmi iti icchā tathā kṛti sādhya tvena iṣṭa sādhana tvāt pākasya pākam kṛtyā sādhayāmi iti icchā anyathā tad tad upāya sādhya tvena icchā pāka ādau tad tad upāya sādhya tva prakāraka jñānāt syāt iti ananta kāraṇa kalpanā syāt mama tu upāya icchāyām iṣṭa sādhana tā jñānam eva hetuḥ kriyā dvārā kṛteḥ iṣṭa sādhana tva jñāne kriyāyāḥ api iṣṭa sādhana tvam viṣayaḥ iti kṛtīcchā bhavantī kriyā āviṣayā api bhavati iti jñāna icchā prayatnānām samāna viṣaya tā api atas eva pākam cikīrṣati iti cikīrṣā viṣaya tayā pākaḥ pratīyate yat vā icchā viṣaya viṣaya tayā pākaḥ pratīyate iti tasya karma tā grāmam jigamiṣati śatrum jighāṃsati iti atra grāma ādeḥ iva na hi grāma ādau icchā

siddha tvāt atas eva bhoge sukhe ca cikīrṣā tad anukūla kṛteḥ iṣṭa hetu tvāt anyathā kṛti sādhya iṣṭa sādhana tā pakṣe tad cikīrṣā āsām agryantaram kalpyeta evañca sandhyā vandanam duḥkha sādhana abhāva rūpa tvena iṣṭam tad sādhanam kṛtiḥ iti liṅarthaḥ anyathā kṛtiḥ na kṛti sādhyā sandhyā vandanañca na iṣṭa sādhanam iti kasya kṛti sādhya tve sati iṣṭa sādhana tvam vidhyathaḥ syāt atas eva eka pratyaya abhidheya tva pratyāsatteḥ antaraṅga tayā vidhi pratyaya abhidheya iṣṭa sādhana tvasya kṛtau eva anvayaḥ na prakṛti arthe tathā eva cikīrṣā kāraṇa jñāna janaka tvāt prakṛti arthasya ca kṛtau viṣaya tvena anvayaḥ iti ucyate vahni sādhya tvena kṛti sādhya tvena vā na pākasya odana sādhana tā iti uktam katham tarhi vahninā pākam sādhayāmi iti icchā iti ced

na iṣṭa sādhana tvena jñāte yatra yat sādhya tvam jñāyate tatra tad sādhya tvena icchā bhavati iti yatheṣṭa sādhana tvena jñāte pāke vahni sādhya tva jñānāt vahninā sādhayamīti icchā evam kṛti sādhya tvena avagate iṣṭasya sādhana tā jñānāt kṛtyā sādhayāmi iti icchā tathā ca iṣṭa sā dhana tvena kṛti sādhya tvena ca jñāte kṛti sādhya tva prakārikā icchā na tu iṣṭa sādhana tā jñāna mātrāt iti ācāryāḥ tu pravartakam iṣṭa sādhana tā jñānam eva liṅarthaḥ tu āpta abhiprāyaḥ lāghavāt pākam kuryāḥ kuryām iti atra vidhiliṅaḥ sambodhya sva kartṛka kriyā icchā abhidhāyaka tvena ājñā prārthanā śaṃsana ādi liṅaḥ vakpradīcchā abhidhāyaka tvena liṅa mātrasya icchā vācaka tva kalpanāt ca evañca svarga kāmaḥ yajeta iti asya svarga kāmasya kṛti sādhya tayā yāgaḥ yāga yatnaḥ vā āpteṣṭaḥ iti arthaḥ tatas yaḥ vyāpāraḥ yasya kṛti sādhya tayā yat vyāpāra viṣayakaḥ prayatnaḥ vā yasya āptena iṣyate sa tasya balavat aniṣṭān anubandhi iṣṭa sādhanam iti vyāpti grahāt yāgasya iṣṭa sādhana tvam anuminoti tathā hi yāgaḥ mad iṣṭa sādhanam mad prayatna viṣaya tayā āptena iṣyamāṇa tvāt

yathā mad pitrā mad prayatna viṣayatayā iṣyamāṇam mad bhojanam mad iṣṭa sādhanam tathā cadam tasmāt tathā evam na kalañjam bhakṣayet iti asya mama kalañja bhakṣaṇa prayatnaḥ na āpta icchā viṣayaḥ iti arthaḥ tatas kalañja bhakṣaṇam mama balavat aniṣṭa sādhanam mad iṣṭa sādhana tve sati api āptena mad prayatna viṣaya tayā aniṣyamāṇa tvāt yathā mad pitrā mad prayatna viṣaya tayā aniṣyamāṇam madhu viṣa sampṛkta anna bhojanam mama balavat aniṣṭa sādhanam tathā ca idam tasmāt tathā sa ca āptaḥ veda vyākhyātāḥ bhagavān īśvaraḥ eva yaḥ tu vede pauruṣeya tvam na upaiti tam prati vidhiḥ eva tāvat garbhaḥ iva śruti kumāryyāḥ puṃyoge pramāṇam na tarhi lāghavam tātparya gauravāt i īśvara adya nanta kalpanāt iti ced

na lāghava ādinā icchā bodhaka tvena loke niṅaḥ pramāṇa siddha tvena phala mukha gauravasya adoṣa tvāt na tu kartuḥ asmaraṇam bādhakam prāk eva nirāsāt tṛptikām anayā viṣa bhakṣaṇa pravṛttasya viṣa bhakṣaṇam tad kṛti sādhya tayā na īśvareṇa iṣyate tatas viṣa bhakṣaṇasya īśvara icchā viṣaya tve api na tena vyabhicāraḥ yat vā yat kāma kṛti sādhya tvena yaḥ vyāpāraḥ āptena iṣyate sa tasya iṣṭa sādhanam viṣa bhakṣaṇañca tṛpti kāma kṛti sādhya tvena na īśvara icchā viṣayaḥ māna abhāvāt atas eva na kalañjam bhakṣayet iti atra kalañja bhakṣaṇam tṛptikām anayā bhakṣaṇa pravṛttasya kṛti sādhya tvena āpta icchā viṣayaḥ na iti tasya īśvara icchā viṣaya tve api viśiṣṭa niṣedhaḥ upapadyate abhiprāya vidhi pakṣe balavat aniṣṭa an anubandhi tvamānumānikam iṣṭa sādhana tā vidhi pakṣe tu tat api śakyam iti gauravam iti

atha svarga kāmaḥ yajeta iti ādā iṣṭa sādhana tvam kārya tvam vā yat vidhiḥ sa samabhivyāhṛta kriyā anvayī tad anya anvayī vā atra guravaḥ na āhatya kriyā kārya tayā liṅā bodhayitum śakyate svarga kāma niyojya anvaya yogya tā jñāna virahāt kāmanā viśiṣṭasya hi mama idam karyam iti boddhṛ tvam niyojya tvam tat kāmanāyāḥ tad bodha upayoge sati bhavati sa ca kāmanā anantaram kāmya sādhana tā bodhāt kārya bodhe sati syāt evañca svarga sādhana tā bodhe sati svarga kāma niyojya anvayogya tā na ca kāla antara bhāvi svarge kriyā sākṣāt paramparayā vā sādhanam iti śabdaḥ bodhayitum arhati āśu vināśi tvāt paramparā ghaṭakān upasthiteḥ ca tṛtīya prakāra abhāvāt ca anyathā tam ādāya sādhana tva sambhavāt kalpyam api apūrvam na syāt iṣṭa sādhana tā vidhi pakṣe sphṛṭā eva anupapattiḥ kārya tā vidhi pakṣe anvaya prakāra tayā sādhana tvam śābdam iti phalatas na kaścid viśeṣaḥ atas kriyā atas anyat svarga sādhanatā arham kriyā kārya tā nirvāhakam liṅā ādi arthaḥ

nanu sva jātīye anvaya darśanam yogyatā dṛṣṭañca ghṛta pānasya āśu vināśinaḥ kāla antare pṛṣṭi hetu tvam iti ced na yathā kathañcid sājyātyasya ayogye api sattvena yogyatāyāḥ avyāvartaka tva āpatteḥ padārtha tāvat chedakena sājāti asya ādya jātaḥ payaḥ pibati ityādau prakṛte ca asambhavāt tasmāt anvaya prayojaka rūpavat tvam sājātyam atas eva dravya dravya tvam seka karaṇa tve prayojakam iti ayogyaḥ vahniḥ tat iha āśu vināśinaḥ kāla antara bhāvi phala janaka tve phala samaya paryanta sthāyi vyāpāra janaka tvam prayojakam atas apūrvam vinā sājātyam eva na gṛhyate ghṛta pānasya tu vaidya kopasthita dhātu sāmyam ādāya puṣṭi sādhana tva yogya tā jñānam vijñasya

atha bādhaka pramāṇa abhāvaḥ yogya tā na ca sādhana tva mātre bādhakam sākṣāt tad bādhe api paramparā sādhana tvam ādāya tad viśrānti sambhavāt na ca yogyā anupalabdhyā dvārasya bādhāt paramparā sādhana tvam api bādhitam saṃskārasya iva tasya sambhavāt anyathā vācye api apūrve kriyā kāmikāyām na syāt kāmya asādhana tvāt na hi yat eva ayogyam tad paścāt yogyam ayogya tve ca niṣphalaḥ prayāsaḥ na ca kāmi kāryam apūrvam tad arthi kāryā ca kriyā iti vācyam yāge rāgāt iti anena virodhāt tathā api dvāra anupasthityā paramparā sādhanam iti jñānam na bhavet iti ced satyam kintu svarga sādhanam yāgaḥ iti jñānam sākṣāt parampara uda āsīnam vastu gatyā paramparā sādhana tva viṣayakam utpadyamānam na ayogya tayā paribhavitum śakyam yadi ca sākṣāt paramparā viśeṣa dvaya vyatiriktam sāmānyam na asti eva tadā ananugamaḥ kim vā viśeṣayasi sākṣāt paramparayā vā iti na ca yāvat viśeṣa bādhe tad vādhitam

paramparā sādhana tve abādhāt iti mā evam yogya tā hi sva bādhaka pramāviḥ aho vā sakala bādhaka pramāviraho vā ādye vahninā siñcati ityādī sva bādhaka pramāta dvirahau samaya bhedena staḥ iti tat eva yogyam ayogyañca iti prāptam dvitīye tu yogyā anupala badhyā tat niścayaḥ aśakyaḥ para pramāyāḥ ayogya tvāt na ca vācyam sakala bādhaka pramāvirahar svarūpa sannā iva prayojakaḥ iti ayogye yogya tā bhramāt anvaya bodha abhāva prasaṅgāt anyasya tatra bādhaka pramā sattvāt anvaya prayojaka rūpavat tvena bādhaka pramāviḥ aho niścīyate iti ced tarhi prāthamika tvāt sā eva yogya tā na ca sā prakṛte sambhavati iti uktam kiñca eka viśeṣa bādhe śābda sāmānya jñānam tad itara viśeṣa prakāra tā niyatam chidra bādhe chidra itara ghaṭa jñāna vat na ca dvāra anupasthityā prakṛte tathā ghaṭate

etena yat uktam praśasta rūpavān caitraḥ iti atra gaura śyāma viśeṣān avagame api rūpa mātravagamyate tadvat viśeṣān avagame api sādhana tva mātram iti tat pratyuktam tatra eka viśeṣa bādhā bhāvena audāsīni asambhavāt etena svarga kāma anvaya balāt kriyāyāḥ phala sādhana tvam tat balāt ca paṭoḥ saṃskārasya iva sthāyi tvam kalpyatām kim apūrveṇa saṅkalpa viśeṣasya yāgasya agre pratyakṣa anupalabdhiḥ ātma viśeṣa guṇānām prathama kṣaṇaḥ eva sva viṣayaka pratyakṣa janana svabhāvāt astu na ca evam kriyā antaram api tathā pramāṇa abhāvāt evam loka prasiddha kriyā kārya tva vyutpattiḥ api bhagnāḥ na bhavati iti parāḥ tam svarga sādhana tā yogya tayā svarga kāma anvayaḥ tad anvaye ca sthāyi tvam iti anyonya āśrayāt loke dharma grāhaka mānena kriyāyāḥ kṣaṇika tva niścayāt ca

nanu deva pūjā arthaḥ yajiḥ pūjā ca ārādhanā gauravita prīti hetuḥ kriyā atas devatā prīti dvārāḥ yāgasya svarga sādhana tvam prīteḥ kṣaṇika tve api prīti anubhava janita saṃskāra dvārā tad sambhavāt atas eva āgneya ādau prīti bhāgitayā agni ādeḥ uddeśya tvam iti ced na yat deva pūjāyām iti hi śābdika smṛtiḥ smṛti tvāt eva na svatas pramāṇam na ca yāgasya devatā prīti hetu tve svargasya devatā prīti sādhya tve vā māna antaram asti

vastutas tu cetane deve mānam eva na asti yatra ca viṣṇu prīti kām a ādi vādaḥ asti tatra viṣṇuḥ eva prītiḥ na tu viṣṇoḥ ṣaṣṭhī artha lakṣaṇā doṣāt viṣṇu śabdasya prīti viśeṣa vācaka tvam vedaḥ eva kalpyate na ca deva pūjā artha yaji anvaya balāt tathā anyonya āśrayāt nanu evam āgneya ādīnāṃṣaṇṇām kṣaṇika tvāt yogyatā anavagatau parama apūrva kāraṇa tvānavagame katham apūrva kalpanā iti ced na kāmye apūrva vācya tva sthitau āgnaneya ādau tad vārā sādhana tvasya yogyatā sambhavāt na tu prathamam

nanu yaḥ brāhmaṇāya avaguret tam śatena yātayet iti atra brāhmaṇa vadha udyamasya śata yātanā hetutva avagame yathā durita apūrvam kalpyate tathā iha api iti ced na avaguret yātayet iti atra hetu hetumatorliṅiti anuśāsanāt liṅā avagoraṇa śata yātanayoḥ niyatam paurvāparyam bodhyate pratyakṣeṇanubhava smaraṇayoḥ iva tat ca sādhana tve sādhana sādhana tve vā ubhayam api madhya varti ghaṭitam iti dūrita kalpanam saṃskāra vat iha tu vidhi anuśiṣṭaḥ liṅ kārya tām āha kiñca kāmī kāmyāt anyat kāmya avyavahita sādhana tayā jñātam eva kartavya tayā avaiti iti niyamāt na kriyāyām kāminaḥ anvayaḥ yogyaḥ na ca tṛpti kāmasya pāke pravarteḥ vyabhicāraḥ odana kāmasya tatra pravṛtteḥ tṛpti kāmanā tu tad kāmanā upayoginī na tu sākṣāt anyathā sādhana sādhane pravṛttiḥ na syāt kāmya sādhana tvam pravartakam lāghavāt iti ced na bhojana kāmasya siddhaudanasya pāke pravṛtti prasaṅgāt tasya odana dvārā bhojana sādhana tva aviśeṣāt viśeṣaṇe tu yatra avyavahita sādhanam pākaḥ tat na kāmyam yat ca kāmyam tatra na avyavahita sādhanam pākaḥ iti na pravṛttiḥ

nanu pākasya siddha odana dvārā bhojana sādhana tvam na sambhavati dvārasya asādhya tvāt odana antara dvārā ca tathā pratisandhāne avyavahita viśeṣaṇe api kutas na pāke pravartate odana antare dvāre sākṣāt sādhana tvāt iti ced na pākasya bhojana sādhana tve viśeṣasya aprayojaka tayā odana mātrasya dvāra tvāt tasya ca sādhya tvau iva ādāt odana viśeṣe ca siddhe odana kāmanā virahāt na tulya tvam nanu odane siddha tvāt yathā na kāmanā tatas eva dvāra tā api na atha odana antarasya asiddha tvam ādāya dvāra tā tarhi kāmanā api syāt tasya asiddha tvāt iti ced

na pākasya eka viśeṣa dvāra tā bādhaḥ na viśeṣa antara dvāra tā virodhī sakala viśeṣasya ekatra dvāra tva asambhavāt eka viśeṣa siddhau tu tanmātra kāmanā vicchidyate na hi sakala viśeṣa siddha tvena sāmānya kāmanā vicchedaḥ sakala viśeṣa siddheḥ asambhavena tad anuccheda prasaṅgāt athavā kāmyāt anyat sākṣāt asādhana tvena jñāyamānam yat kartavya tayā kāmī budhyate tad kāmya avyavahita sādhanam antarā kṛtvā eva yat vā kāmyāt anyat kāmī prathamam kāmya avyavahita sādhanam kartavya tayā avaiti paścāt tad dvārāḥ avyavahita sādhanam iti prathamam yāge kāmi kārya tā ābodhaḥ ayogya tā aparāhataḥ eva

uttānāḥ tu vivāda viṣayaḥ liṅ samabhivyāhṛta kriyā anvita kārya tā bodhikā pramāṇa liṅtvāt laukika liṅvat liṅupa sthāpyam kārya tvam samabhivyāhṛta kriyā anvitam liṅupa sthāpi a kāryatva tvāt paceta iti kāryatva vat yāgaḥ vā kāryatva anvitaḥ liṅsambandhi dhātu pratipādya tvāt pāka vat iti anumānāt kriyā kāryatva avagamena apūrvam kalpyam iti tatra prathame yāga anvita kārya tva bodhaka tvam liṅaḥ bodhyate na tu kriyate na ca yogyatā jñānam vinā tad sambhavati iti uktam eva na hi yogyatā ādikam vinā eva tad anumāna prāmāṇya prayojana mātrāt anvitam abhidhīyate śabdena na antyau kuryāt iti atra vyabhicārāt vedasya anuvādaka tā pātāt ca nanu apūrvam vyutpatti virahaḥ tathā hi prasiddhārtha svarga kāma pada samabhivyāhārāni atha anupapattyā upasthite śaktiḥ grahītavyā na ca śābda anubhavāt pūrvam apūrvam upasthitam

māna abhāvāt apūrva tva vyāghātāt avācya tva apātāt ca na ca liṅā ādinā tad upasthitiḥ vyutpatti anantaram tad pravṛttau anyonya āśrayāt na ca kārya tvena upalakṣite tatra śakti grahaḥ upalakṣaṇam hi smaraṇam anumānam vā agṛhīte sambandha āgrahāt aśakyam iti mā evam kārye dharmaṇi kāryatvena śakti grahāt kāryatva viśiṣṭañca upasthitam eva tatas anvita abhidhāna daśāyām yāga viṣayakam kāryam iti anubhavaḥ svarga kāma anvayā yogya tayā ghaṭa ādikam tiraskṛtya kriyā bhinne yogya tā vaśā t yāga viṣayaka apūrvam paryavasyati na tu apūrva tvena śakti grahaḥ na ca apūrvam kāryam iti anubhavaḥ bhavati ca sāmānyatas sambandha buddhiḥ sahakāri vaśāt viśeṣa buddhi upāyaḥ yathā tava eva kartṛ mātre sambandha grahāt kartṛ viśeṣa siddhiḥ

nanu kāryatvena api kim ghaṭa ādau śakti grahaḥ uta apūrve ubhayatra vā na ādyaḥ anya pratipattau anya śakti grahān upayogāt na antyau prāc anupasthiteḥ iti ced na yena hi rūpeṇa śabdena anubhavaḥ janyate tena rūpeṇa śakti grahaḥ padārtha smaraṇañca śābda anubhava hetuḥ na hi prameya tvena śakti grahaḥ padārtha smaraṇañca śābda anubhava hetuḥ evañca ghaṭa ādau eva kārye śaktā liṅiti śakti grahaḥ tatas kāryam iti smaraṇam tatas yogyatā ādi vaśāt pracura dravya guṇa karmāṇi kāryaṇi vihāya yāga viṣayakam kāryam iti anubhavaḥ bhavan apūrvam ālambate yogya tvāt ca tasya na ca apūrvam smṛti gocāraḥ iti vācyam śakti graha padārtha smṛti śābda anubhavānām samāna prakāraka tā mātraiḥ hetu hetum at bhāva avadhāraṇāt lāghavāt āvaśyaka tvāt ca na tu kvacid sahacāra mātreṇa anvaya pratiyoginaḥ eva upasthitiḥ tathā gauravāt go padāt apūrva gavān anubhava prasaṅgāt ca viśiṣṭa vaiśiṣṭya bodhe sarvatra tathā eva anyathā parvatīya vahniḥ vyāpaka tayā na avagataḥ iti katham tad anvayaḥ anumitau

nanu sāmānya lakṣaṇayā pratyāsattyā sarvāḥ eva vyaktayaḥ vyāpti hagrahe śakti grahe ca viṣayībhavanti katham anyathā parvatīya dhūma vyādaya grahe tasmāt anumitiḥ iti ced na yena rūpeṇa vyāpti grahaḥ tena rūpeṇa vyāpya tvena vā pakṣa dharma tā grahaḥ anumitau kāraṇam astu kim tayā api ca sā yadi asti mama api na asti ced tava api kiñca tava darśane sā asti iti sutarām apūrva vācya tā kāryatvena hi rūpeṇa apūrvasya api śakti graha viṣaya tvam padārtha smṛti viṣaya tvañca na ca evam apūrva tva kṣatiḥ yāga viṣaya tva ādeḥ viśeṣasya kārye liṅa vinā anupasthiteḥ yathā parvatīya tva bhānam vahnau na anumitim vinā nanu kārye yadi kriyā sādhāraṇena liṅa śaktiḥ kriyā ca ayogyā iti yogyā pūrva lābhaḥ tadā nitya niṣedha apūrvayoḥ alābhaḥ na hi tatra ayogya tayā kriyā tyaktum śakyate phala aśravaṇāt kalpanā yāñca vīja abhāvāt na ca ekatra nirṇītaḥ śāstra arthaḥ anyatra tathā eva iti nyāyāt tatra api apūrvam eva liṅarthaḥ iti yuktam na hi apūrva tvena śakti grahaḥ kintu kāryatva viśiṣṭe dharmaṇi

kriyā ca tathā bhavati eva na ca kāryeṇa samam kriyāyāḥ anvayān upapattyā apūrve paryavasānam abhedasya api anvayāt iti mā evam na hi loke paceta ityādau kārye dharmaṇi śaktiḥ kalpitā kintvana nī alabhye kṛti rūpe kāryatva mātre dharmaṇaḥ pāka ādeḥ dhātoḥ eva upasthiti sambhavāt kriyā kāryatvasya anvitā abhidhāna labhya tvāt tathā ca dharmiṇi vede śaktiḥ kalpanīyā sā ca kriyā nirāsena eva na hi kriyāyāḥ kāryatva anvaya yogya tve dharmaṇi śaktiḥ kalpayitum śakyate tasmāt ayogya tayā kriyā nirāsa anantaram tat atiriktaḥ eva śaktiḥ kalpanīyā na ca kriyā atirikta karyāt

kārya mātram laghu tatas kriyā api śakyā eva iti vācyam yatas na brūmaḥ kriyā atirikta kārya tvena śaktiḥ kintva yogya tayā kriyāyām nirastāyām dharmaṇi śakti kalpana samaye yat kriyā atiriktam tatra śaktiḥ na tu śakti grahe kriyā praveśaḥ na hi yat pratyukta anupapattyā yat kalpanam tat eva tasya viṣayaḥ evañca kāryatvena api tad atirikta kārye eva śakti kalpanāt nitya niṣedhayoḥ api tat eva upāsana ādi anvaya yogyam liṅā abhidhīyate na tu kāryatva mātram dharmaṇi bādhaka abhāvāt lakṣaṇa aprasaṅgāt ca ghaṭa ādiḥ tu liṅa śakti grahe na tiraskriyate na puraskriyate ubhayathā api gauravāt anvita abhidhāna daśā yāntva yogya tayā tasya apraveśaḥ vidhi pratyayasya ca tatra aprayogaḥ kevalasya tasya asādhu tvāt dhātu samabhivyāhāra sthale ca tad arthena anvaya bodha janana niyamena ghaṭa ādi apratipādaka tvāt atas eva aprayogāt eva aprayogaḥ apūrva tvam vā prayoga upādhiḥ iti vadanti

atha apratipādya ghaṭa ādi vṛtti tayā na kārya tvam pravṛtti nimittam pratipādya mātra vṛtteḥ eva tathātvāt anyathā prameya tvam eva tathā astu iti ced na yad prakārikā hi pratipattiḥ pada janyā tat eva tatra pravṛtti nimittam phala kalpya tvāt śakteḥ na tu pratipādya mātra vṛtti sāsnādau vyabhicārāt na ca prameya tvam tathā tad hedhasya apravartaka tvāt atas eva loke liṅ lākṣaṇikī kriyā bhinne dharmaṇi vede śakti kalpanāt na ca laukikānām apūrve tātparyam sambhavati pūrvam pramāṇa antareṇa apratīteḥ kriyā sādhāraṇa śaktau api loke lakṣaṇā eva paceta iti atra hi pāka kārya tā a agamyate tatra kāryatve liṅaḥ tāt paryam lāghavāt na dharmaṇi kriyāyāḥ dhātu labhya tvāt tat āhuḥ

tātparyat hi vṛttiḥ na tu vṛtteḥ tātparyam iti tṛtīyāyāḥ karaṇa tva ekatva vat kāryam kāryatvañca na svatantram śakyam kintu viśiṣṭam viśiṣṭāt ca viśeṣaṇam anyat eva iti kāryatve lakṣaṇā na ca kāryatva viśiṣṭa dharmī upasthitau api dharmi aṃśam apahāya kriyāyām kāryatva anvayaḥ astu kim lakṣaṇayā iti vācyam na hi itara dharma gata tvena upasthitasya dharmi antara ākāṅkṣā asti atas svatantra kārya tva upasthitaye lakṣaṇā yathā puroḍāśa kapālena tuṣān upavapati iti atra puroḍāśa arthi tayā tad anvita tvena upasthitasya kapālasya na upavāpa aṅkṣā iti svatantra kapāla upasthitaye adhiṣṭhāna lakṣaṇā na ca vyutpatti virodhaḥ na hi loke kriyā kārya tve śaktiḥ avadhiritā yena virodhaḥ bhavet kintu kāryatva mātre kriyāyāḥ dhātu labhya tvāt na ca dharmi antare śaktau api tad bhaṅgaḥ tasmāt prakṛti artha anvita sva artha bodhaka tvam pratyayānām gṛhītam pratyaya arthaḥ ca apūrvam api iti na virodhaḥ astu vā loke liṅaḥ kriyā kārya tve śaktiḥ tathā api tad aṅgam vinā eva na anartha nyāyena vede dharmi antare śaktiḥ tām vinā svarga kāma anvaya asambhavāt

anye tu paceta iti ādau dhātunā eva pākaḥ kāryaḥ abhidhīyate liṅ tatra tātparyagrāhikā na tu śaktā niyamataḥ tādṛśi eva tad prayogāt sāmānya śabdasya viśeṣa paratvañca na vṛtti antara nirvāhyam atas eva vartamāna tva ādau na laḍādi śaktiḥ iti loke śakti agrahāt na vyutpatti virodhaḥ iti tat asat liṅaḥ kāryatve aśaktau paci padāt kārya tva jñāna anupapatteḥ yugapad vṛtti dvaya virodhāt na ca ajahatsva arthā ubhaya sādhāraṇasya anupasthiteḥ iti diś

yat vā jñāne padānām śaktiḥ śakya tvāt evañca liṅpadam ekatra uccāraṇe sthāyi tva svarga janakatva kārya tvānām jñāne śaktam iti vyutpattiḥ sthāyi jñāna ādi kañca upasthitam eva tatas liṅa padena ekatra uccāraṇe yogyatā ādi vaśāt yāga viṣayakam sthāyi svarga janakam kāryyam iti ekam jñānam anubhava rūpam pracura dravya guṇa karma vilakṣaṇa viṣayam kriyate na ca evam nānā arthavat ekaika jñāne śakti grahāt ekaika viṣayaḥ anubhavaḥ bhavet

na samudita viṣayaḥ iti vācyam śakti graha kāle ekatra uccāraṇaḥ iti viśeṣaṇa mahimnā tad sambhavāt nānā arthe tu pramāṇa abhāvena gauravena ca śakti grahe tasya apraveśāt tathā api amīṣām samūha ālambanam syāt na tu parasparam vaiśiṣṭya jñānam iti ced na sa ākāṅkṣa dharma dharma gocara eka jñānasya eva viśiṣṭa jñāna tvāt na ca samūha ālambana sambhedaḥ tasya nirākāṅkṣa viṣaya tvāt astu vā upasthiteṣu agṛhīta asaṃsargeṣu sthāyi tva svarga janakatva kāryatveṣu śaktiḥ agṛhīta asaṃsargakasya api viśiṣṭa jñāna samāna śīla tvāt atas ukta nyāyena tāvat viṣayakam ekam jñānam liṅa padena janyate evam eva alaukika artheṣu svarga ādi padeṣu śakti grahaḥ

nanu bhavatu ukta prakāreṇa śaktigrahaḥ tathā api liṅa padāt yāga viṣayaka kārya anubhave satya pūrva lābhāt svarga kāma anvayaḥ sambhavati iti upapādaka pratisandhāne prasiddhārtha svarga kāma pada samabhivyāhārānyatha anupapattyā liṅaḥ kārye śakti kalpanam na hi prathamam upapādaka pratisandhānam vinā artha āpattiḥ sambhavati na ca śakti kalpanāt pūrvam upapādaka śarīra niviṣṭam apūrvam jñātam iti ced tat kim yaḥ eva viśeṣaḥ upapādakaḥ pakṣa dharma tā balāt sidhyati tad pratisandhānam artha āpattau kāraṇam tathā tve pūrvam gṛhīta mātrasya kalpya tve klapana uccheda āpattiḥ tasmāt yathā sāmānyatas bhojanasya pīna tva sambandha avagamāt upapādaka tarke sati kalpanātaḥ viśeṣa avagamaḥ

yathā vā sāmānya śakta vyakti vācaka padena samabhivyāvahāra vaśāt viśeṣa abhidhānam evatra api kārya mātra vācaka tve kārya viśeṣa lābhaḥ sambhavati iti tarkita upapādaka pratisandhānāt bhavati artha āpattyā śakti kalpanam yāga viṣaya kañca kāryam na ghaṭa ādi tasya sa viṣaya ka tva abhāvāt viṣaya tvañca jñāna ghaṭayoḥ iva svabhāva sambandhaḥ vā tad nirūpaṇa adhīna nirūpaṇa tvam vā tad samāna saṃvid saṃvedya tvam vā vyāvṛtta sādhana tvam vā iti asti hi yāga dāna homa janyā pūrvāṇām tulya rūpa sādhana antara vyavacchedena pratyeka mātra janya tvam tat uktam viśabdaḥ hi viśeṣa arthaḥ sinotiḥ bandhaḥ ucyate viśeṣeṇa sinoti iti viṣayaḥ atas niyāmakaḥ iti

nanu yena rūpeṇa śakti grahaḥ tena rūpeṇa kāryatva śaktāt liṅpadāt lakṣaṇayā kārya upasthitau yogyatā ādi vaśāt apūrva lābhaḥ astu kārya smaraṇam hi anvita abhidhāna upayogi na tu apūrva smaraṇam tat ca padena padārthena vā iti na kaścid viśeṣaḥ kāryañca śakya kārya tva sambandhi tayā avagatam eva iti ced na liṅaḥ lākṣaṇika tvena apūrva ananubhāvaka tvāt na ca itara anvitasva artha śaktasya yajyādi padasya itat ara pūrvam ādāya anubhāvaka tvam iti vācyam itara upalakṣita sva artha anvaya mātre hi padānām śaktiḥ na tu itaratra gauravāt pada antara labhya tvāt ca lakṣaṇa āyāñca tīra upalakṣita anvaya śāli sva artha anubhāvaka tvam itara padasya tīrasya tu saṃskārāt upasthitiḥ asat nihitena anvita abhidhāna abhāvāt na ca apūrvam saṃskāra viṣayaḥ kiñca yajipadena svarga kāma kārya viṣayaḥ yāgaḥ iti anubhavaḥ bhavet lakṣaṇāyām itara padasya lakṣaṇīya viśeṣaṇa sva artha viśeṣyaka anubhava janaka tvāt na ca etādṛśaḥ bodhaḥ ākāṅkṣitaḥ na ca yāga aviśeṣita kārya mātreṇa svarga kāma anvayaḥ pratīyate kintu yāga viṣayaka kārya viśeṣe tathā ca tathāvidha bodha artham liṅaḥ kārye śaktiḥ eva iti

atra ucyate anvaya prayojaka rūpavat tvam na yogyatā anāpta ukte payasā siñcati iti atra sati api anvaya prayojaka drava dravya tve bādhaka pramāyām anvaya ābodhāt atha yogya tve api sva bādhaka pramāvirahar kāraṇam tarhi saḥ api avaśya apekṣaṇīyaḥ iti lāghavāt sā eva yogya tā evañca tat eva yogyam ayogyañca syāt iti ced satyam yathā daśā viśeṣe tat eva sā kāṅkṣam anākāṅkṣam āsannam anāsannañca tathā sva bādhaka pramāta dvirahadaśāyām tat eva anvaya bodhe yogyam ayogyañcā abhidhīyate sva bādhaka pramāyām tad virahe vā yogya ayogya tā vyavahāra darśanāt sva bādhaka pramāvira hadaśāyām yogyatā ādi sattve api vahninā siñcati iti atra anvaya bodhaḥ apramā doṣa vat puruṣa praṇīta tvāt sāmānyabhānasya kiñcid viśeṣa bhāna niyata tvāt viśeṣa ābhāne katham tat bhāsate iti ced

na vastu gatyā paramparā sādhanam viśeṣaḥ bhāsate eva paramparā sādhanatvantu prakāraḥ na bhāsate tad prakāra bhāne hi paramparā ghaṭaka jñānasya hetu tvāt yathā ghaṭena jalam āhara iti atra yogyatayā chidra itara ghaṭe ghaṭa tvena bhāsate na tu chidra itara tvena tathā sati lakṣaṇāyām yugapad vṛtti dvaya virodhena ghaṭān anvaya prasaṅgāt ubhaya sādhāraṇa rūpeṇa anupasthiteḥ ca na ajarhasva arthā

atha saṃskārāt tad upasthitiḥ na ca subvi vibhaktīnām prakati artha gata sva artha anvaya bodhaka tva vyutpatteḥ tatra vibhakti arthaḥ na anvīyeta iti vācyam prakṛti arthaḥ hi prakṛti pratipādyaḥ lakṣaṇīya anvaya anurodhāt sa ca saṃskāra sahakārāt prakṛte api na ca tasya aniyatāt bodhakāt na niyatā tad upasthitiḥ phala balena tathā kalpanāt iti ced

na śabda upasthāpitena eva śabdasya anvaya bodhaka tvāt na ca evam ākāśa pada aśakyasya saṃskāra upasthitasya śabda āśraya tvasya katham śābda anubhava viṣaya tvam iti vācyam niyamataḥ yat dharmavat tvena upasthite yatra śakti grahaḥ tad smaraṇa janaka saṃskārasya tad dharma viṣaya tā niyamena tad bodhakāt eva tad aṃśe api udbodha niyamena ākāśa padāt aśakyasya api tasya bhānāt astu vā tat api śakyam yadi niyamataḥ upasthitiḥ saha prayogasya vāci ādi paratvena api upapatteḥ vastutas tu niyata upasthitiḥ eva na asti astu vā padāt api nirvakalpakam tarhi anvaya bodha daśāyām itara anvaya anupapatti abhāvāt agre api kalpanā na syāt iti ced tarhi tava api kārya tā bodha anantaram aupādānika sādhana tā bodhaḥ na syāt aupādānika bodhe anupapatti bodhasya hetu tvāt kalpanā mātra ucchedaḥ ca evam syāt pratīta anupapatti mūlaka tvāt kalpanāyāḥ

vastutas tu bādhaka pramā virahasya yogyatā tve saṃśaya sādhāraṇam jñāna mātram eva tasyāḥ prayojakam tena yatra bādhaka pramāniḥ cayaḥ tatra eva anvaya bodha abhāvaḥ anyatra tu tad dhīmātra acchā abda bodhaḥ iti yāge api yogyatā saṃśayena anvaya bodhaḥ pratibandha bādha saṃśayasya apratibandhaka tvāt anyathā anumāna ādi uccheda prasaṅgāt apūrva vācya tve api apūrva svarga sādhana tā saṃśayāt yogya tāyāḥ saṃśayaḥ eva apūrvasya prathamam svarga sādhana tvā niḥ cayāt upādānasya anvita abhidhāna uttara kālīna tvāt sādhaka bādhaka pramāṇa abhāvena dvāra sambhau anayā sādhana tva sambhauvanātaḥ svarga kāma anvayaḥ iti tulyam api ca yathā na kriyā sthirā iti ayogyā tathā kāryam apūrvam api viśiṣṭam na sthiram kṛteḥ vinaṣṭa tvāt na ca adhiṣṭhāne apūrva mātre sādhana tvam tasya padārtha eka deśa tvena anvaya apratiyogi tvāt

anye tu anvaya virodhi rūpa virahaḥ yogyatā atas eva vahninā siñcati iti atra tat bhrame bhavati anvaya bhramaḥ yāgeca anvayavirādhi rūpa virahaḥ yogyā anupalabdhyā sugamaḥ eva na ca yāge āśu vināśi tvam kāla antarabhāviphala janakatva virodhī iti ca ācyam anubhave kvātha pāne ca āśu vināśini kāla antara bhāvi phala janaka tvāt yāge api antatas tad sattvāt anyathāpūrva vaiphalyāt asmāt anvaya prayojaka rūpavat tvam laghu iti ced na tad sattve api anāpta ukte vyabhicārāt anvaya virodhi tvena yat kiñcit pratisandhānam tatra asti eva antatas bādhaka pramā viṣayatu asya eva virodhinaḥ jñānāt iti

kāmya sādhana tva jñānam eva pravartakam lāghavāt siddhaudanaḥ tṛpti kāmaḥ laghu upāye bhojane pravartate na tu pāke guru upāya tvāt jala ādi arthī ca sannihite atas eva jyotiṣṭoma ādau śruta svarga phalaka tve api guru upāya tvena ananuṣṭhāna lakṣaṇā prāmāṇya āpattyā phala bhūmā kalpyate iṣṭa utpatti anāntarīyaka śrama janaka tvam vā pratibandhakam api ca kāmya avyavahita sādhana tayā jñātam eva yadi kāmī kartavyatā avaiti iti niyamaḥ tadā pūrvam api kārya tayā na avagamyeta anvita abhidhānāt pūrvam kāmya sādhana tā bodhaka abhāvāt upādānasya anvita abhidhāna uttara kālī tvāt atas eva kāmyāt anyat ityādi prakāra dvayam nirastam

kārya tā buddhī pravṛttau vā kāmya sādhana tvasya eva hetu tvāt na ca kārye ghaṭa ādau liṅśakti grahaḥ yathā liṅśakti graha kāle svarga kāma anvayā yogya tvāt kriyā nirāsaḥ tathā yāga anvaya anupapattyā ghaṭa ādiḥ nirasaḥ api syāt na hi yoga viṣayakaḥ ghaṭa ādiḥ sambhavati anyathā anvita abhidhāna daśāyām api tad nirāsaḥ na syāt syāt etat svarga kāma anvaya an upapattyā tad anvaya yogye liṅśakti grahaḥ sthāyikāryañca tathā atas śakti graha kāle kriyā nirāsaḥ yujyate na ghaṭa ādeḥ yajipadam antar bhāvya svarga kāma pada liṅpadābhyām anvita abhidhāna daśāyām ghaṭa ādi nirāsaḥ yāga anvayogya tvāt iti tat kim śakti graha kāle yāga anvaya anupapattiḥ hasta pihitā yena ghaṭa ādi nirāsikā sā na pratisandhīyeta pratyuta pratyayasya antaraṅga prakṛti artha anvayam bodhayate eva itara anvaya bodhaka tvam iti tad anvaya anupapatti pratisandhānam eva prāthamikam

puruṣa doṣāt apratisandhāne śakti grahaḥ bhramaḥ eva ghaṭa ādeḥ aśakya tvāt puruṣa viśeṣam prati apūrvavācya tā āpatteḥ ca ghaṭa ādīnām ananta tvena yadi tad nirāsaḥ na śakyaḥ tadā anvita abhidhāna daśāyām api na syāt pāka ādīnām kriyā tvena iva pṛthivī tva ādinā nirāsa sambhavāt ca evam ca pracura dvya guṇa karmasu nirasteṣu kkaḥ kārye dharmaṇi śakti grahaḥ na ca viśeṣe niraste api kārya sāmānyam na nirastam iti vācyam na hi viśeṣa aviṣayam sāmānya jñānam sambhavati etena apūrva sādhāraṇa kārya tvena ghaṭa ādau śaktigrahaḥ iti parāḥ tam agṛhīta asaṃsargeṣu sthāyi tva kārya tva svarga janaka tveṣu tad jñāneṣu vā śaktigrahaḥ iti api parāḥ tam sthāyinām ghaṭa ādīnām nirāsāt dharma mātre ca śakti grahasya prakṛte anupayogāt kiñca teṣu śakti grahaḥ samuditeṣu pratyekam vā na ādyaḥ

prathamam samudāyasya eka jñāna aviṣaya tvāt viṣaya tve vā pūrvam eva viśiṣṭasya sattve apūrva tva vyāghātaḥ eka jñāna viṣaya sākāṅkṣa dharma dharmaṇoḥ eva viśiṣṭa tvāt na dvitīyaḥ evam hi liṅā āpadāt smaraṇa trayam yajipadāt ca yāga smaraṇam na ca caturṇām teṣām yaugapadyam asti na ca pratyekam śakti grahe api samudita viṣayakam ekam eva smaraṇam liṅpadāt iti yuktam samudāyasya pūrvam ananubhavāt smaraṇañca yadi sā kāṅkṣa dharma dharma viṣayakam ekam tadā apūrva tva kṣatiḥ eka jñāna ārūḍhayoḥ sa ākāṅkṣa dharma dharmiṇoḥ eva viśiṣṭa tvāt tat niyata tvāt vā etena svarga dipadeṣu agṛhīta asaṃsarga dharma dharmaṣu śaktigrahaḥ iti vyudastam pratyeka samudāya viṣaya ka smaraṇa vikalpa grāsāt astu vā liṅaḥ kārye lakṣaṇa yathā hi mañcāḥ

krośanti ityādau puruṣa viśeṣaḥ prāk ananubhūtaḥ api anubhūyate itara padāt lākṣaṇikasya anubhāvaka tvāt tathā apūrvam api astu ca svarga kāma kārya viṣayaḥ yāgaḥ iti anubhave svarga kāma yāgayoḥ anvaya prakāra tayā apūrva lābhaḥ yat vā svarga kāma kārya viṣayaḥ yāgaḥ iti śābda anubhava anantaram arthāt yāga viṣayakam kāryam iti jñānam anupapatti prabhavam atas eva śābda bodha anantaram aupādānika bodhāt pravṛttiḥ kiñca apūrva vācya tve api na kalañjam bhakṣayet iti āditaḥ kalañja bhakṣaṇa abhāva viṣaya kamapūrvam avagamyā api na pravarteta tad abhāve tathā ahi bhakṣaṇe rāgāt asya kartavyatā buddhiḥ jātā śabdāt ca bhakṣaṇa abhāve niṣphalāt kāryāt saphalam garīyaḥ iti nyāyena sukha hetau bhakṣaṇaḥ eva pravarteta na tad abhāve niṣedha apūrvam eva phalam iti ced

na tasya sukha duḥkha abhāva anyatayā paṇḍa tvena tad ajanakatayā ca gauṇa mukhya prayojana tva abhāvāt sukha vat apūrvam api prayojanam iti ced na loke tathā anavagamāt alaukikayoḥ svarṇa apavargayoḥ loka avagata prayojana sukha duḥkha abhāva jātīya tayā prayojana tvam vede api kāmya sthale kāmya sādhanasya eva apūrvasya gauṇa prayojanasya liṅa abhidhānam kāmya sādhana tā jñānam vinā kāmi kārya tvasya bodhayitum aśakyatvāt na tu svatas prayojana tvena tatra asāmarthyāt anupayogāt ca pravṛtteḥ bhojana ādau iva loka kḷpta kāmya sādhana tā jñānāt kārya tā jñānāt vā gauṇa prayojana tvena eva upapatteḥ na api nitya niṣedhayoḥ apūrvam svatas prayojanam liṅā abhidhīyate kāmya sthale hi dharma grāha kaliṅā ādinā pravartaka kārya tvena apūrvam abhihitam atas nitya ādau api kāryatvena apūrva bodhanam na tu svatas prayojana tvena nanu nitye loka veda avagata gauṇa mukhya prayojana abhāve sati liṅā iva apūrvasya svatas prayojana tvam bodhayati tena vinā pravṛtti paratva anirvāhāt iti ced

na nirūpa dhi icchā viṣaya tvam hi svatas prayojana tvam apūrvasya siddham liṅā bodhanīyam na ca tādṛśa icchā viṣayaḥ apūrvam kvacid api siddham na ca liṅā iva apūrvacchām janayitvā tām bodhayati tasyāḥ tatra asāmarthyāt i chāyāḥ sāmagrī antara janya tvāt ca atas api kāmye nitye ca icchā viṣaya tvam prayojana tvam apūrvasya liṅādinā na bodhyate apūrva icchāyāḥ śābda jñānāt pūrvam asattvāt kintu śābda kārya tā jñānāt sā iti atha nitye kāryatvena eva apūrvasya abhidhānam na tu svatas prayojana tvena kintu liṅā apūrve bodhite tasya svatas prayojana tvam icchā viṣaya tvam sambhavati sukha jñāna vat apūrva jñānasya api svatas eva icchā janaka tvāt tatas kāmya apūrva sādhana tā jñānāt nitye kārya tā bodhāt pravṛttiḥ iti ced na apūrva jñānasya icchā hetu tvena ākḷpta tvāt kāmya apūrve hi loka kḷpta iṣṭa sādhana tā jñānāt eva icchā na tu apūrva tva jñānāt śāstra sthasya śāstra ja kartavya tā jñānam balavat iti ced saphala viṣayam tathā idañca niṣphala viṣayam

atha pravṛttimataḥ nivṛtti niyoge adhikāraḥ iti yadā bhakṣaṇa pravṛttaḥ tadā tad niṣedhe śābda kārya tā ādhīḥ iti tayā viparīta prayatne janite rāgāt kriyā utpattiḥ tena eva pratibandhāt rāga kārita pravṛttim upajīvya hi nivṛtti kārya tā śāstreṇa bodhitā atas tena bodhane sva phalam viparīta kṛtiḥ avaśyam utpādya iti śāstrasya balavat tvam iti ced na nivṛtti kārya tā ābodhe api nivṛttau prayatnaḥ eva na utpadyate yasya pratibandhaka tā syāt syāt ca nivṛtti kārya tā bodhakam apramāṇam niṣphala tvena tatra kṛteḥ abhāvāt atha kalañja abhakṣaṇasya nindā artha vādena balavat aniṣṭa sādhana tva avagamāt tad bhakṣaṇe na pravartate iti ced

evam api kalañja bhakṣaṇe nivartatām tad abhāve niṣprayojana tayā pravṛttau kim āyātam iti etena nitya apūrva sādhane sandhyā vandana ādau api pravṛttiḥ apāstā kriyāyāḥ kaṣṭa tvāt tad apūrvasya paṇḍa tvāt svatas aprayojana tvāt ca tasmāt loke paceta ityādau kāryatva iṣṭa sādhana tva rūpa dharma śakta tvena jñātā liṅ svarga kāmaḥ yajeta iti ādau tad anvayam yāge yogyatā ādi vaśāt bodhayati iti na vede dharmiṇi śakti kalpanā pratītā ca svarga sādhana tā sākṣāt asādhanasya yāgasya vyāpāram antareṇa anupapadyamānā tat nirvāhakam vyāpāram apūrvam kalpayati

nanu nirupadhi pūrva vartitā kāraṇa tā sā vyāpāreṇa nirvāhyate iti atra kaḥ arthaḥ kim kriyate uta jñāpyate na ādyaḥ uttara varti tvena vyāpārasya tatra asāmarthyāt na itaraḥ liṅā eva tad bodhanāt cira dhvastam kāraṇam vyāpāreṇa vyāptam iti ced na vipakṣe bādhaka abhāvena aprayojaka tvāt anyathā aindriyakam kāraṇam atīndriya vyāpārakam iti yāga anubhavayoḥ darśanāt tathā kalpyeta prāyaścitta ādīn āñca phala pratibandhaka tvam eva prāyaścittasya tasmāt enasaḥ pūtoḥ bhavati iti yat phalam śrutam asti tasya niṣiddha kriyā ataḥ phala bhāj na bhavati iti arthaḥ dharmaḥ kṣarati kīrtanāt iti ca kīrtanāt vihita kriyā kṣarati phalam na janayati iti arthaḥ kṣarati iti atra bādhakam vinā na lakṣaṇa iti ced na upasthita tvena vihita kriyāyām eva dharma pada śakti grahasya bādhaka tvāt na ca etasya mukhya tva artham padārtha antare śaktiḥ

lakṣaṇa uccheda āpatteḥ vihita kriyā kartṛ tva jñānena dhārmaka pada prayogāt ca etena devadatta ādi a śarīram devadatta viśeṣa guṇa prerita bhūta pūrvakam janya tve sati tad bhoga sādhana tvāt tad nirmata sraj vat iti anumānāt tad siddhiḥ iti parāḥ tam janma antarīya jñāna ādibhiḥ eva tad janaka tva abhimataiḥ siddha sādhanāt iti mā evam ciradhvastasya vyāpāra satve kāraṇa tvam iti nirūpa adhi anvaya vyatirekābhyām vyāvadhāraṇāt yāgasya cira dhvasta kāraṇa tvena vyāpāra kalpanāt kārye vyāpārasya pṛthak anvaya vyatireka grahaḥ tad vyāpāraka tve upādhiḥ iti ced na saṃskāre tad abhāve api anubhavasya tad vyāpāraka tvāt na ca aprayojaka tvam yāgaḥ yadi cira dhvasta tve sati sa vyāpāraḥ na syāt svarga sādhanam na syāt ghaṭa vat iti vipakṣe bādhāt na ca atra kāraṇa tā grāhaka abhāvaḥ upādhiḥ tena api samam vyāpti avadhāraṇe tasya api āpādanāt na ca aindriyakasya atīndriya vyāpāravatu a niyamaḥ sa vya apāra tve kārya avyavahita pūrva samaye asattvasya upādhi tvena aprayojaka tvāt

nanu evam sandhyā vandana ākaraṇasya duḥkha sādhana tva śruteḥ tad karaṇa prāgabhāvaḥ duḥkha hetuḥ tathā ca tasya sthira tvena duḥkha janana sambhavāt na pāpe pramāṇam na ca prāyaścitta vaiphalyam prāyaścitta abhāva saha kṛtasya eva tasya tad janaka tvāt yat tu prāc abhāva nāśaḥ eva tena kriyate iti tat na dhvaṃsa prāc abhāvān avacchinna kālasya pratiyogi kāla tvena tadā karaṇa āpatteḥ iti ced na sandhyā kālīnākaraṇasya duḥkha janaka tvena viśiṣṭasya sandhyā kāla apagame anupagamāt na ca sandhyā kālīnākaraṇe viśeṣaṇam kintu pratiyogini karaṇe tathā ca viśiṣṭa abhāvaḥ sthiraḥ eva iti vācyam sandhyāyāḥ hi akaraṇe anvayaḥ tasya padārtha tvāt na tu karaṇe tasya padārtha eka deśa tvena apradhāna tvāt tathā api dhvaṃsaḥ eva vyāpāraḥ astu tava sahabhāva anirūpakasya api kāraṇa tvāt tasya ananta tve api svabhāvāt sa avadhi phala janaka tvam yat ca yat dhvaṃsaḥ hetuḥ tatra tad prāc abhāvaḥ api iti ced

na dugdha dhvaṃsa janya dadhri mithyā adhīdhvaṃsa sādhya muktau ca vyabhicārāt pratibandhaka abhāva tvena hetu tve tathā abhāvāt ca dhvaṃsena anupapattiḥ katham tena eva samādhātavyā iti ced na dhvaṃse sati tad vyāpāra tva jñānam vinā anupapatteḥ tad vyāpāra tva kalpanayā śānteḥ iti mā evam pratiyogi dhvaṃsayoḥ ekatra ajanaka tvāt na hi niyamataḥ yat hvaṃse sati yat bhavati tat tatra kāraṇam na ca saṃsarga abhāva tvena hetu tve tathā iti vācyam vyabhicāra abhāvena tasya api prayojaka tvāt

atha śabdāt yāga kāraṇa tā vyāpāram vinā tad anupapatteḥ tad janya dhvaṃsasya kāraṇa tva kalpanam iti ubhayam api janakam anyatra tu māna abhāvāt na tathā iti ced na yāga dhvaṃsasya yāga janya svargam prati janakatvasya pramāṇa antara virodhena artha āpattyā api akalpanāt astu tarhi devatā prītiḥ eva vyāpāraḥ iti ced na yāgasya devatā prīti hetu tve māna abhāvāt gaṅgā snāna ādau devatā viraheṇa tad asambhavāt na ca tatra api tad prītiḥ tasya tad prīti hetutve māna abhāvāt lāghavena kartṛ bhoktṛ gata vyāpāra kalpanāt ca

nanu na ayam niyamaḥ putra kṛta gaya aśrāddha ādinā pitari pita kṛta jāta iṣṭyā putre ca adṛṣṭa utpatteḥ atha tatra api kartari eva adṛṣṭam vihita kriyāyāḥ yāgasya iva kartṛ gata adṛṣṭa janaka tvāt na ca mukte putre tad adṛṣṭa nāśāt pitari na svargaḥ syāt iti vācyam adṛṣṭasya phala nāśya tayā pitari svarga abhāvena adṛṣṭa anāśāt sva vṛtti bhoga janaka adṛṣṭasya mukti virodhi tvāt na tu pitṛ gatam adṛṣṭam janyate mukte pitari doṣa abhāvena yoginām iva vihita kriyāyāḥ pitṛ adṛṣṭa ajanaka tvāt tathā tve ca sāṅgam api śrāddha ādikam niṣphalam syāt iti tad vidheḥ a prāmāṇya āpattiḥ putra āgata adṛṣṭena ca mukte pitari sukha utpattau na virodhaḥ yoginām iva sukha utpattau doṣasya ahetutvāt atha pitṛ sukham pitṛ puṇya janyam iti pitari puṇyam tena vinā tad asambhavāt na putre tatra phala prasaṅgāt iti pitṛ svarga kāmanā janya kriyā pitṛ puṇya hetuḥ iti putra kriyā api tad janikā iti ced

evam pitṛ kriyā api pitṛ puṇya janikā iti na tām vinā pitari puṇyam putrakriya ca putra puṇya janikā iti putre puṇyam pitṛ svarga kāmanā janya puṇya tvena pitṛ svarga hetuḥ astu tat puṇyam pitṛ vṛti tad sukha hetu puṇya tvāt na putra vṛtti tad sukha ahetu puṇya tvāt iti ced na tat puṇyam na pitṛ vṛtti tad kṛtya janya puṇya tvāt putra vṛtti vā tad kṛta puṇya tvāt tasmāt pitṛ svarga kāmanā janya puṇya tvena pitṛ svarga hetu ta iti putraḥ eva tat puṇyam iti mā evam svarga upapādakam hi apūrvam svarga āśraye kalpyate prathama upasthita tvāt lāghavāt kalpanāyāḥ sākṣāt upapādaka viṣaya tvāt ca na ca svarga hetu kāmanā āśraye svarga kāmanā janya kriyā kartari vā vilamba upasthitika tvāt gauravāt paramparayā svarga upapādaka tvāt ca yadi ca putra kṛta puṇyena muktasya pituḥ śarīra ādi utpattiḥ sukhañca syāt tadā sākṣi vidhayā asatya abhidhāna ādi patra kriyā janya pāpena sa viṣṭhāyām kṛmiḥ bhūtvā pitṛbhiḥ saha pacyate

iti ādi bodhita naraka bhāgitā api muktasya pituḥ syāt tathā ca putra kṛta tathāvidha śaṅkayā na kaścid mokṣa artham brahmacarya ādi duḥkhena ātmānam avasādayet duḥkhena atyantam vimuktaḥ carati na sa punar āvartate na sa punar āvartate iti śruti virodhaḥ ca tathā ca muktasya sukha duḥkhe śarīrañca bhavati iti apadarśanam mukte pitari śrāddha ādinā doṣa abhāvāt eva na adṛṣṭam utpadyate na ca evam sa aṅgaśrāddhasya api niṣphala tvam adṛṣṭa utpattau svarūpa sataḥ doṣasya aṅgasya vaiguṇyāt yathā vighna hetu durita śūnyena kṛtam maṅgalam na pāpa dhvaṃsam janayati svarūpa satas pāpasya aṅgasya abhāvāt evañca yāgasya api vyadhikaraṇaḥ vyāpāraḥ bhaviṣyati iti

ucyate vihita kriyayā kartṛ gata vyāpāra dvārā kāla antara bhāvi phalam janyate iti utsargaḥ sa ca balavatā bādhakena apodyate prakṛte ca bādhakam na asti yathā śāstra deśitam phalam anuṣṭhātarī iti utsargaḥ putra kṛta gāyā śrāddhasya pitṛ svargam prati pitṛ kṛta jāta iṣṭeḥ putra pūta tva ādikam prati hetu tvasya śāstreṇa bodhanāt

nanu ayam niyamaḥ eva pitṛ yajña jāta iṣṭi ādau paramparā sambandhena kartṛ gatam eva phalam na hi yasya kasya api pitari putre vā phalam kintu sva pitṛ putrayoḥ tathā ca sva pitṛ gata tvam svarga bhāgi pitṛka tvam vā paramparā sambandhaḥ phalena putrasya evam pūta putraka tva ādikam api pitṛ gatam eva na ca phalasya kartṛ gata tvam sākṣāt sambandhena eva iti vācyam grāma paśu putra hiraṇya ādīnām paramparayā kartṛ gata tvam iti vyabhicārāt na hi grāma ādāyaḥ sākṣāt kartṛ sambaddhāḥ evam phalasya sākṣāt kartṛ gāmi tva bodhane śāstrasya utsargaḥ na tu phalasya kartṛ gāmitā bodhane

yat tu svarga bhāgi pitṛka tvam na phalam tad kāmanāyāḥ adhikāri viśeṣaṇa tva abhāvāt pitṛ gata svarga kāmaḥ ityādi śruteḥ svatas ca tathā kāmanayā pravṛttau śruta kāmanā viraheṇa prayoge aṅga vaiguṇyāt phala abhāva prasaṅgaḥ kiñca svarga bhāgi pitṛka tvam viśiṣṭam tatra viśeṣyam tat pitṛka tvam na kāmyam na vā phalam siddha tvāt tad asādhya tvāt ca kintu viśeṣaṇam pitṛ gata svargaḥ iti saḥ eva phalam iti tat na na hi svarga bhāgi pitṛka tvam phalam api tu svargeṇa samam putrasya paramparā sambandha rūpam tat uktam iti ucyate yadi paramparā sambandhena putra gata tvam pitṛ svargasya tadā saṃyukta samavāya ādinā putra itarasya api phalam syāt sa sambandhaḥ na śāstreṇa bodhitaḥ iti ced tarhi svarga bhāgi pitṛka tvam api na tathā śāstreṇa ābodhita tvāt grāma paśu hiraṇyādīnāñca siddha tvena na kāmya tvam
