sarvadā nitye samarthe sati sva kālaḥ eva kāryam bhavat katham tad anvaya vyatirekā anuvidhāyī iti ced tarhi kāra nakṣaṇāt pūrvam paścāt ca anādyanante tad abhāva viśiṣṭe kvacid eva tad abhāva samaye bhavat kāryam katham tat anuvidhāyi iti samānam nityasya pratikṣaṇam aneka kārya kāri tve kramaśas aneka svabhāva tva siddheḥ katham eka tvam syāt iti ced kṣaṇikasya katham iti samaḥ paryanuyogaḥ sa hi kṣaṇa sthitiḥ ekaḥ api bhāvaḥ aneka svabhāvaḥ vicitra kārya tvāt nānā artha kṣaṇa vat na hi kāraṇa śakti bhedam antareṇa kārya nānā tvam yuktam rūpa ādi jñāna vat yathā eva karkaṭikā ādau rūpa ādi jñānāni rūpa ādi svabhāva bheda nibandhanāni tathā kṣaṇi sthiteḥ ekasmāt pradīpa ādi kṣaṇāt vartikā dāha taila śoṣa ādi vicitra kāryāṇi śakti bheda nimittakāni vyavatiṣṭhante anyathā rūpa ādeḥ api nānātvam na syāt

nanu ca śaktimataḥ artha antara anartha antara pakṣayoḥ śaktīnām aghaṭanāt tāsām parama artha sattva abhāvaḥ tarhi rūpa ādīnām api pratīti siddha dravyāt artha antara anartha antara vikalpayoḥ asaṃbhavāt parama artha sattva abhāvaḥ syāt syāt vādibhiḥ citra jñāna vat jāti antarasya śaktimataḥ arthasya upagamāt ca na ukta doṣa anuṣaṅgaḥ

atha pratyakṣa buddhau pratibhāsamāna tvāt rūpa ādayaḥ paramārtha santaḥ na punar tad śaktayaḥ tāsām anumāna buddhau pratibhāsamāna tvāt iti api ayuktam kṣaṇa kṣaya svarga prāpaṇa śakti ādīnām aparama artha sattva prasaṃgāt tatas yathā kṣaṇikasya yugapad aneka kārya kāri tve api ekatva avirodhaḥ tathā akṣaṇikasya kramaśas aneka kārya kāri tve api iti anavadyam sthira ākāraḥ api parama arthaḥ iti

tat evam sakala bādhaka abhāvāt apratikṣepa arhāṇām ārthatā abhimatānām sthira sthūla sādhāraṇa ākārāṇām paramārtha tva siddheḥ abhrāntena tad grāhi pratyakṣeṇa sva lakṣaṇa lakṣaṇa tattvasya viruddha tvam siddhi ati eva nanu na eṣa doṣaḥ saugata abhimata sva lakṣaṇa tattvasya avācya tvāt iti ced tad asaṃgatam avācya śabdena sva lakṣaṇa tattvasya vācya tvāt sva vacanena eva sva pratijñā hāneḥ darśanāt

nanu avācya śabdena api na sva lakṣaṇa svarūpam ucyate tena āropita sāmāni a ākārasya eva abhidhānāt iti ced vyāhatam etat sāmānya ākhya para rūpa vācinā avācya śabdena sva lakṣaṇa svarūpa abhidhānasya viruddha tvāt nīla śabdena pīta abhidhāna vat tat uktam yukti anuśāsane svāmibhiḥ avācyam iti atra ca vācya bhāvāt avācyam eva iti anyathāpratijñām sva rūpataḥ ced para rūpa vāci svarūpa vācī iti vacaḥ viruddham iti tatas na avācya tā ekāntaḥ śreyān iti katham api pratyakṣa virodhaḥ duḥśakaḥ parihartum tasmāt su vyavasthityam pratijñā dṛṣṭa viruddham śākya śāsanam iti

tathā tāthāgata śāsanam iṣṭa viruddham tad abhimata kṣaṇa kṣaya ekānta viruddhasya ātma ādīnām kathaṃcid nitya tvasya anumānena sādhanāt tathā hi yat sat tat sarvam kathaṃcid nitya tvam sarvathā kṣaṇike krama yaugapadyābhyām artha kriyā virodhāt sattva anupapatteḥ iti atra na tāvat dhetoḥ anaikāntika tvam sarvathā nitya tve sattvasya abhāvāt sarvathā kṣaṇika tva vat tad abhāvaḥ ca kramākrama anupapatteḥ tad anupapattiḥ ca pūrva apara svabhāva tyāga upādāna anvita rūpa abhāvāt sakṛt aneka śakti ātmaka tva abhāvāt ca na hi kūṭasthe pūrva uttara svabhāva tyāga upādāne staḥ kṣaṇike ca anvitam rūpam asti yatas kramaḥ kāla kṛtaḥ deśa kṛtaḥ vā syāt na api yugapad aneka svabhāva tvam yatas yaugapadyam kauṭasthya virodhāt sarvathā eka rūpa tvāt kūṭasthasya eka rūpa tayā tu yaḥ tri kāla vyāpī saḥ kūṭasthaḥ iti abhidhānāt niranvaya kṣaṇika tva vyāghātāt ca tathā krama akramān ekānta ātmakasya eva siddheḥ sahakāri krama ākrama apekṣayā tatra krama yaugapadya kalpanā api na sādhīyasī svayam tad apekṣā krama itara svabhāva tva abhāve tad anupapatteḥ

tad kāryāṇām tad apekṣā na punar nityasya kṣaṇikasya ca iti api na śreyaḥ teṣām tad akārya tva prasaṃgāt tad sahitebhyaḥ saha kāribhyaḥ kāryāṇām utpatteḥ anyathā anutpatteḥ tad kāryatva nirṇayaḥ iti ced tarhi yena svabhāvena ekena sahakāriṇā sahabhāvaḥ tena eva sarva sahakāriṇā yadi tasya syāt tadā eka kārya karaṇe sarva kārya karaṇāt krama kārya anutpattiḥ saha kārī antara abhāve api ca tad sahabhāvāt sakṛt eva sakala kārya utpattiḥ prasajyeta svabhāva antaraiḥ sahakāri antara sahabhāve tasya krama ākrama vṛtti aneka svabhāva tva siddheḥ kutas nityam ekatva svabhāvam kṣaṇikam vā vastu krama yaugapadyayoḥ vyāpakam syāt kathaṃcid nityasya eva krama ākrama aneka svabhāvasya tad vyāpaka tva pratīteḥ

etena vipakṣe hetoḥ bādhakasya vyāpaka anupalambhasya vyatireka niścayaḥ kathaṃcid nitye pratyakṣa pravṛtteḥ pradarśitaḥ pratyeyaḥ tatas satyam kathaṃcid nityam eva sādhayati iti siddham śauddhodani śāsanam iṣṭa viruddham iti tathā ca śubha aśubha anuṣṭhāna puṇya pāpa śu abhra svarga ādi para loka badha bandha kāraṇa mokṣa mokṣa kāraṇa bandha mokṣa phala baddha muktā ādi parokṣa tad kāraṇa svarūpa pratipādakaḥ api bauddha āgame na pramāṇam dṛṣṭa iṣṭa viruddha āgama sama kartṛkasya tasya atīndriyeṣu atitarām aprāmāṇya āpatteḥ iti na bauddhānām dharma anuṣṭhānam pratiṣṭhām iyarti kim bahunā bauddhaiḥ yat yat abhidhīyate tat sarvam asat eva tad abhimata sarva tattvasya śūnya tvāt

tathā hi vikalpaḥ abhilāpa saṃbandha artha grahaṇa rūpaḥ paraiḥ iṣṭaḥ sa ca na asti eva na hi tāvat viṣayasya abhilāpena tad gatena eva saṃbandhaḥ tatra tad abhāvāt smaraṇa upanītena saṃketa kāla pratipannena iti ced na smaraṇasya nirvikalpaka tve tad viṣayasya sva lakṣaṇa tve na kvacid upanayana anupapatteḥ vyavasāya rūpa tve ca tena api sva viṣayaḥ abhilāpa saṃbandhaḥ eva smarttavyaḥ tad abhilāpaḥ api tathāvidhāḥ eva tad smaraṇena iti anavasthiti prasaṃgāt smaraṇasya tad anabhisaṃbandha vastu vedi tve api vyavasāya svabhāva tve pratyakṣasya api tat kim na syāt sva abhidhāna viśeṣa apekṣayā eva arthāḥ niścaiḥ vyavasīyante iti ekānta tyāgāt nāmnaḥ sva lakṣaṇasya api sva abhidhāna viśeṣa anapekṣasya eva vyavasāya vacanāt

evam anavasthā ādi doṣa upanipātāt nāma smaraṇa ubhāvena kvacid vikalpā na siddhyet smaraṇa upanīta nāma saṃbaddha artha grahaṇasya eva vikalpa tvāt vikalpa abhāvena na kvacid pratyakṣam akṛta vikalpena pratyakṣeṇa bahis antar vā gṛhītasya api agṛhīta kalpa tvāt kṣaṇa kṣaya ādi saṃvedana vat pratyakṣa abhāve na kvacid anumānam pratyakṣa pūrvaka tvāt tasya iti sakala pramāṇa abhāvaḥ tad abhāve sakala prameya abhāvaḥ pramāṇa apāye prameya vyavasthā anupapatteḥ iti saugata abhimatam sarvam tattvam śūnyam eva syāt

tathā ca saugataḥ heya upādeya upāya rahitaḥ ayam ahrīkaḥ kevalam vikrośati iti upekṣā arhaḥ eva iti kṛtam ati vistareṇa dṛṣṭa iṣṭa viruddha tvāt tad matasya asatya tva siddheḥ dṛṣṭa iṣṭeṣu dṛṣṭa iṣṭa virodhāt sugata uditaḥ parokṣeṣu tad eka tvāt āgamaḥ na pramāṇa tām vikalpa abhāvataḥ sarva hāneḥ bauddha vacaḥ akhilam bhavet pralāpa mātra tvāt na avadheyam vipaścitām dṛṣṭa iṣṭābhyām viruddha tvāt na satyam śākya śāsanam na ca tena pratikṣepaḥ syāt vādasya iti niścitam
tathā sāṃkhya śāsanam api dṛṣṭa iṣṭa viruddham evam hi tāvat ākhyānti sāṃkhyāḥ

sarvam idam jagat pradhānam ayam pradhānam ca sattva rajaḥ tamasām sāmya avasthā svarūpam tathā ca tad granthāḥ sattvam laghu prakāśakam iṣṭam avaṣṭambhakam calam ca rajaḥ guru varaṇakam eva tamaḥ sāmya avasthā bhavet prakṛtiḥ tatra yat iṣṭam prakāśakam laghu tat sattvam iti ucyate sattva udayāt praśastāḥ eva pariṇāmāḥ jāyante yat ca calam avaṣṭambhakam dārakam grāhakam vā tat rajaḥ iti ucyate rajasaḥ udayāt rāga pariṇāmāḥ eva jāyante yat guru āvaraṇakam ajñāna hetu bhūtam tat tamaḥ iti nirūpyate tamasaḥ udayāt dveṣāt ajñāna pariṇāmāḥ eva jāyante sattva rajaḥ tamasām sāmya avasthā prakṛtiḥ prakṛteḥ mahān tatas ahaṃkāraḥ tasmāt gaṇaḥ ca ṣoḍaśakaḥ tasmāt api ṣoḍaśakāt pañcabhyaḥ pañcabhūtāni

jagat utpādikā prakṛtiḥ pradhānam bahu dhānakam iti prakṛteḥ abhidhānāni tatas prakṛteḥ mahān utpadyate āsarga pralaya sthāyinī buddhiḥ mahān tatas mahataḥ sakāśāt ahaṃkāraḥ utpadyate aham jñātā aham sukhī aham duḥkhī ityādi pratyaya viṣayaḥ tatas ahaṃkārāt gandha rasa rūpa sparśa śabdāḥ pañca tanmātrāḥ sparśana rasana ghrāṇa cakṣu śrotrāni pañca buddhīndriyāni vāc pāṇi pāda pāyu upasthāni pañcakarmendriyāni manaḥ ca iti ṣoḍaśa gaṇāḥ samutpadyante teṣu ṣoḍaśa gaṇeṣu pañca tanmātrebhyaḥ pañcabhūtāni samutpadyante

tat yathā gandha rūpa rasa sparśebhyaḥ pṛthivī rasa rūpa sparśebhyaḥ jalam rūpa sparśābhyām tejaḥ sparśāt vāyuḥ śabdāt ākāśaḥ samutpadyate iti sṛṣṭi kramaḥ etāni caturviṃśati tattvāni pañcaviṃśatkaḥ jīvaḥ ṣaḍviṃśatikaḥ paramaḥ iti nirīśvara sāṃkhyāḥ ṣaḍviṃśakaḥ maheśvaraḥ saptaviṃśatiḥ paramaḥ iti sa īśvara sāṃkhyāḥ teṣu tattveṣu mūlaprakṛtiḥ avikṛtiḥ mahādādyāḥ prakṛti vikṛtayaḥ sapta ṣoḍaśakaḥ ca vikāraḥ na prakṛtiḥ na vikṛtiḥ puruṣaḥ

iti evam prakṛti puruṣayoḥ bheda vijñānāt prakṛti nivṛttau puruṣasya suṣupta puruṣa vat avyakta caitanya upayogena sva rūpa mātra avasthā lakṣaṇaḥ mokṣaḥ tasya ca upāyaḥ pañcaviṃśati tattva parijñānam eva pañcaviṃśati tattva jñaḥ yatra kutra āśrame sthitaḥ jaṭī muṇḍī śikhī keśī mucyate na atra saṃśayaḥ iti vacanāt

tat etat kapila matam dṛṣṭa viruddham tathā hi tāvat puruṣa vyatirikta sarva arthāḥ pradhāna mayāḥ kāpilaiḥ iṣṭāḥ tat ca pradhānam sarvadā vartate nitya tvāt sarvatra ca vartate tasya vyāpaka tvena abhyupagamāt sarvatra ca saṃpūrṇa tayā vartate tasya sarvathā aniravayava tvena iṣṭa tvāt tathā ca sarvam sarvatra vartate iti āyātam sarva mayam pradhānam sarvatra sākalyena vartate iti abhyupagame sarvam sarvatra vartate iti asya avaśyam abhyupagantavya tvāt nanu iṣṭa āpādanam idam sarvam sarvatra ca aste iti kāpilaiḥ ururīkaraṇāt iti ced tat idam hi spaṣṭam dṛṣṭa viruddham pratyakṣena pratiniyata deśa kālasya eva arthasya darśanāt na hi pratyakṣena sarvam sarvatra dṛśyate aṅgulī agre hasti yūtha śata ādeḥ api darśana prasaṃgāt

nanu na eṣa doṣaḥ sarvasya sarvatra sadbhāva api yatra yasya āvirbhāvaḥ saḥ eva tatra dṛśyate na punar anyaḥ tirohitaḥ iti arthānām darśana yogya ayogya tva vyavasthiteḥ iti ced kaḥ ayam āvirbhāvaḥ nāma prāk anupalabdhasya vyañjaka vyāpārāt upalambhaḥ iti ced sa ca nityaḥ vā anityaḥ vā yadi anityaḥ tadā sa prāk asan kāraṇaiḥ kriyeta anyathā nitya tva prasaṃgāt tathā ca ghaṭa ādiḥ api tadvat prāk asan kāraṇaiḥ kriyatām na ca evam satkārya vāda virodhāt āvirbhāvaḥ prāk asan kāraṇaiḥ kriyeta na punar ghaṭa ādiḥ iti sva ruci vacana mātram nirupapattika tvāt yadi nityaḥ tadā tat eva sarvatra sarvasya darśanam syāt āvirbhāvasya sadā sattvāt

atha āvirbhāvasya prāk tirohitasya sataḥ eva kāraṇaiḥ āvirbhāva antaram iṣyate tarhi tasya api anyat tasya api anyat āvirbhāvanam iti anavasthānāt na kadācid ghaṭa ādeḥ āvirbhāvaḥ syāt atha āvirbhāvasya upalambha rūpasya tad rūpa āvirbhāva antara anapekṣa tvāt prakāśasya prakāśa antarā anapekṣa tva vat na anavasthā iti matam tarhi tasya kāraṇasya kāraṇāt ātma lābhaḥ abhyupagantavyaḥ utpatti abhivyaktibhyām prakāra antara abhavāt tatra ca ukta doṣaḥ iti na āvirbhāvaḥ siddhyet

yat tena tirobhāve api pratyādiṣṭa prāyaḥ tasya nitya anitya pakṣayoḥ ukta doṣa anuṣaṅgāt āvirbhāvasya nirasta tvena tṛtīya pakṣena ca asambhavāt evam āvirbhāva tirobhāvayoḥ asiddhau tad vaśāt kvacid kasyacid pratīteḥ anupapatteḥ sarvam sarvatra dṛśyatām na ca evam iti pratyakṣa virodhaḥ tad avasthaḥ eva

tathā sati upalabdhi yogya tve sati anupalabdheḥ na asti pradhānam tad abhāve tad nimittakāḥ mahat ādayaḥ api na siddheyuḥ iti sarva abhāvaḥ tathā api vaiyyātyāt mahat ādi sṛṣṭi prakriyā ucyate tadā ayam praṣṭavyaḥ kim idam mahat ādikam pradhānasya kāryam vā pariṇāmaḥ vā iti prathamam pakṣe na tāvat sataḥ tasya kāryatvam sarvathā sataḥ kāraṇa vaiyyarthāt puruṣa vat yadi sat sarvathā kāryam puṃvan na utpattum arhati iti vacanāt na api asataḥ asat akaraṇāt upādāna grahaṇāh sarva asaṃbhava abhāvāt śaktasya śakya karaṇāt kāraṇa bhāvāt ca satkāryam iti sva siddhānta virodhāt sarvathā api asataḥ utpatti virodhāt ca yadi asat sarvathā kārya tat mā jani khapuṣpaka vat iti vacanāt

dvitīya pakṣe pariṇāminaḥ bahudhānakasya pariṇāmāḥ mahat ādayaḥ atyantam bhinnā vā syuḥ abhinnā vā tatra pariṇāmānām tad abhinnānām kramaśas vṛttiḥ mā bhūt pariṇāminaḥ akrama tvāt tatas bhinnānām vyapadeśaḥ na syāt saṃbandha asiddheḥ anupakāraka tvāt na tāvat pradhānam pariṇāmānām upakārakam tad kṛta upakāra antarasya kāryatve sat asat pakṣa ukta doṣa anuṣaṃgāt pariṇāma tva itara abhinnānām krama utpattiḥ mā bhūt bhinnānām vyapadeśaḥ na syāt sambandha asiddheḥ anupakārāt upakāra antara kalpanāyām anavasthā prasaṃgāt pariṇāmaiḥ pradhānasya upakāre yāvantaḥ hi pariṇāmāḥ tāvantaḥ tasya upakārāḥ tad kṛtāḥ tatas yadi bhinnāḥ tadā tasya iti vyapadeśaḥ api mā bhūt saṃbandha asiddheḥ anupakāraka tvāt tadvataḥ taiḥ upakāra antare api saḥ eva paryanuyogaḥ iti anavasthā tatas te yadi abhinnāḥ tadā tāvat dhā pradhānam bhidyeta te vā pradhāna eka rūpa tām pratipaderan iti pradhānasya upakārāṇām ca avasthānā sambhavaḥ

atha na bhinnaḥ na api abhinnaḥ pariṇāmaḥ kevalam mahat ādi rūpena pradhānam pariṇamate daṇḍa kuṇḍala ādi ākāraiḥ sarpa vat iti ced tat etat sva iṣṭa nitya ekānta bādhakam pūrva uttara ākāra parihāra avāpti sthiti lakṣaṇa pariṇāma abhyupagame nitya aniti ātmaka tvasya avaṣyam bhāvāt tat evam aneka bādha kopanipātāt pradhāna ādi caturviṃśati tattvāni na vyavatiṣṭhante tat avyavasthitau bhogya abhāve puṃsaḥ bhoktṛ tva abhāvāt abhāvaḥ syāt tasya tad lakṣaṇa tvāt tatas prakṛti puruṣa tattvayoḥ avasthāna abhāvāt sāṃkhya abhimatam sarvam tattvam punar api śūnyam jāyate iti tat katham pratyakṣa siddham syāt syāt urvī parvata tarva ādi padārthānām brahma maya vat pradhāna maya tvasya api pratyakṣeṇa anupalakṣaṇāt siddham sāṃkhya śāsanam dṛṣṭa viruddham

tathā tat iṣṭa viruddham ca kāpila abhimatasya kūṭastha nitya puruṣasya kathaṃcid tad anitya tva sādhaka anumānena viruddha tvāt tat ca idam vivāda āpannaḥ puruṣaḥ syāt anityaḥ anitya bhoga abhinna tvāt yat ittham tat ittham dṛṣṭam yathā bhoga svarūpam iti na asiddham bhogasya anitya tvam anitya bhogaḥ utpattimat tvāt jñāna vat iti anumānāt tad siddheḥ

katham utpattimān bhogaḥ iti ced para apekṣa tvāt tadvat eva para apekṣaḥ asau buddhi adhyavasāya apekṣa tvāt buddhi avasitam artham puruṣaḥ cetayate iti vacanāt bhogasya buddhi adhyavasāya anapekṣa tve puṃsaḥ sarvatra sarvadā sarva bhoga prasaṃgāt bhogya saṃnidhi savyapekṣa tayā kādācid ka tvāt ca anityaḥ siddhaḥ bhogaḥ tasya ca puruṣāt bhede tena tasya gagana ādeḥ iva puruṣa antarasya iva vā bhoktṛ tvā anupapatteḥ tatas bhogasya abhede tad rūpa tayā puruṣasya kathaṃcid anitya tvam siddhyati iti samyak idam sādhanam ātma anitya tvam sādhayati tatas sūktam sāṃkhya matam iṣṭa viruddham iti

tathā caturvidha varṇa āśrama tad tad vidheya vividha ācāra puṇya papa para loka bandha mokṣa tad kāraṇa tad phala baddha muktā ādi svarūpa pratipādakaḥ sāṃkhya āgamaḥ na pramāṇam dṛṣṭa iṣṭa viruddha āgama abhinnasya tasya parokṣa tad karaṇeṣu prāmāṇya saṃbhāvanā anupapatteḥ iti na teṣām dharma anuṣṭhānam pratiṣṭhām iyarti kim atra bahunā uktena yat kiṃcid sa īśvara nirīśvara sāṃkhyaiḥ asaṃkhyāvadbhiḥ ākhyāyate tat sarvam mṛṣā eva tad abhimata sakala tattvānām āvirbhāva ādyapākaraṇa dvāreṇa śūnya tvasya āpādita tvāt iti alam prasaṃgena dṛṣṭa iṣṭa viruddha tvāt sāṃkhya śāsanasya asatya tva siddheḥ dṛṣṭa iṣṭeṣu dṛṣṭa iṣṭa virodhāt sāṃkhya saṃmataḥ parokṣeṣu tat eka tvāt āgamaḥ na pramāṇa tām āvirbhāva cyutau sarva cyuteḥ sāṃkhya vacaḥ akhilam bhavet pralāpa mātra tvāt na avadheyam vipaśicatām na sāṃkhya śāsanam satyam dṛṣṭa adṛṣṭa iṣṭa bādhatas na ca tena pratikṣepaḥ syāt vādasya iti niścitam
atha vaiśeṣika matam api dṛṣṭa iṣṭa viruddham tāvat idam hi teṣām ākūtam :

buddhi sukha duḥkha icchā dveṣa prayatna dharma adharma saṃskārāṇām navānām ātma viśeṣa guṇānām atyanta ucchittau ātmanaḥ sva ātmani avasthānam mokṣaḥ anyathā ātmanaḥ atyanta viśuddhi abhāvāt iti dravya guṇa karma sāmānya viśeṣa samavāyānām padārthānām sādharmya vaidharmya tattva jñānam niḥśreyasa hetuḥ śaivapāśupata ādi dīkṣā grahaṇa jaṭā dhāraṇa tri kāla bhasma uddhūlana ādi tapaḥ anuṣṭhāna viśeṣaḥ ca

tatra dravyāṇi pṛthivī ap tejaḥ vāyu ākāśa kāla diś ātma manāṃsi sāmānya viśeṣa saṃjñā uktāni nava eva tad vyatirekeṇa saṃjñā antara anabhidhānāt guṇāḥ rūpa rasa gandha sparśa saṅkhyā parimāṇa pṛthaktva saṃyoga vibhāga paratva aparatva buddhi sukha duḥkha icchā dveṣa prayatnāḥ ca kaṇṭha uktāḥ saptadaśa caśabda samuccitāḥ ca guru tva drava tva sneha saṃskāra adṛṣṭa śabdāḥ saptā eva iti evam caturviṃśati guṇāḥ utkṣepaṇa apakṣepaṇa ākuñcana prasāraṇa gamanāni iti pañca eva karmāṇi gamana grahaṇāt bhramaṇa recana spandana ūrdhva jvalana tiryak patanana manonnamana ādayaḥ gamana viśeṣāḥ na jāti antarāṇi sāmānyam dvividham param aparam ca anuvṛtti pratyaya kāraṇam

tatra param sattā mahā viṣaya tvāt sā ca anuvṛtteḥ eva hetu tvāt sāmānyam eva dravya tva ādi aparam alpa viṣaya tvāt tat ca vyāvṛtteḥ api hetu tvāt sāmānyam sat viśeṣa ākhyām api labhate nitya dravya vṛttayaḥ antyāḥ viśeṣāḥ te khalu atyanta vyāvṛtti buddhi hetu tvāt viśeṣāḥ eva ayutasiddhānām ādhārya ādhāra bhūtānām yaḥ sambandhaḥ ihapratyaya hetuḥ sa samavāyaḥ evam dharmaiḥ vinā dharmiṇām uddeśaḥ kṛtaḥ ṣaṇṇām api padārthānām sādharmyam astitvam abhidheya tvam jñeya tvam āśrita tvam ca anyatra nitya dravyebhyaḥ dravya ādīnām pañcānām api samavāyi tvam aneka tvam ca guṇa ādīnām pañcānām api nirguṇa tva niṣkriya tve

ityādi anekavidham sādharmyam vaidharmyam ca iti tattva jñānam mokṣa hetuḥ tat yathā duḥkha janma pravṛtti doṣa mithyā jñānānām uttarottara apāye tad anantara abhāvāt apavargaḥ tatra tattva jñānāt mithyājñānam nivartate mithyājñāna nivṛttau tad janya rāga dveṣa nivṛttiḥ tad doṣa nivṛttau tad janya kāya vāc manaḥ vyāpāra rūpa pravṛtti nivṛttiḥ tad pravṛtti nivṛttau tad janya puṇya pāpa bandha lakṣaṇa janma nivṛttiḥ iti āgāmi karma bandha nivṛttiḥ tattva jñānāt eva bhavati

prāk upārjita aśeṣa karma parikṣayaḥ tu bhogāt eva na anyathā tathā ca uktam : na abhuktam kṣīyate karma kalpa koṭi śataiḥ api avaśyam anubhoktavyam kṛtam karma śubha aśubham iti tatra api : kurvan ātma svarūpa jñaḥ bhogāt karma parikṣayam yuga koṭi sahasrāṇi kṛtvā tena vimucyate iti ekaḥ pakṣaḥ ātmanaḥ vai śarīrāṇi bahūni manuja īśvaraḥ prāpya yoga balam kuryāt taiḥ ca sarvām mahīm varet bhuñjīta viṣayān kaiścid kaiścid ugram tapaḥ caret saṃharet ca punar tāni sūryaḥ tejaḥ gaṇān iva iti ekasmin eva bhave bahubhiḥ śarīraiḥ prāk uparjita aśeṣa phala bhogaḥ iti aparaḥ pakṣaḥ

tatas ca bhogāt prāk upārjita aśeṣa karma parikṣayaḥ ekaviṃśati bheda bhinna duḥkha nivṛttiḥ iti tāni duḥkhāni kāni iti ced saṃsargaḥ sukha duḥkhe ca tathā artha indriya buddhayaḥ pratyekam ṣaḍvidhāḥ ca iti duḥkha saṅkhyā ekaviṃśatiḥ iti sakala puṇya pāpa parikṣayāt tad pūrvaka buddhi sukha duḥkha icchā dveṣa prayatna saṃskārāṇām api parikṣayaḥ ātmanaḥ kaivalyam mokṣaḥ iti

tat etat aulūkya śāsanam tāvat dṛṣṭa viruddham tad abhimatasya avayava a ayavinoḥ guṇa guṇinoḥ kriyā kriyāvatoḥ jāti vyaktyoḥ bheda ekāntasya tad abheda grāhiṇā pratyakṣeṇa viruddha tvāt na hi avayavi ādiḥ avayava ādibhyaḥ sarvathā abhinnaḥ eva pratyakṣe pratibhāsate api tu kathañcid abhinnaḥ eva tantubhyaḥ tad ātāna vitāna avasthā viśeṣa rūpasya paṭasya karpaṭī ādeḥ citra jñāne nīla ādi nirbhāsa vat tatra eka lolībhāvam upagatānām rūpa ādīnām gacchataḥ puruṣāt bālya ādi vat sthiti ādi vat vā tad avasthā viśeṣa bhūta kriyāyāḥ sāmānyavataḥ arthāt vaisādṛśya vat tad dharma bhūta sādṛśya lakṣaṇa sāmānyasya anartha antara tayā sakala loka sākṣikam adhyakṣeṇa adhyavasāyāt

nanu samavāyāt tebhyaḥ avayavi ādiḥ anartha antaram iva pratibhāsate iti ced na avayavi ādi pratyakṣasya sarvatra bhrānta tva prasaṅgāt timira āśu bhra maṇa nauyāna saṅkṣobha ādi āhita vibhramasya dhāvadhvādi darśana vat asat ākāra viśiṣṭa artha grahaṇāt tathā ca avyabhicāri tvam pratyakṣa lakṣaṇam asambhavi syāt na ca ete avayava ādayaḥ ime avayavi ādayaḥ samavāyaḥ ca teṣām ayam iti pratyakṣa buddhau visrasāḥ bhinnāḥ sakṛt api pratīyante pratyakṣatām ca svīkartum icchanti iti te amī amūlya dāna krayiṇaḥ pratyakṣa buddhau ātma anarpaṇena pratyakṣa tā svīkaraṇāt

na ca para upavarṇita svarūpaḥ samavāyaḥ eva vyavatiṣṭhate yatas bhinnānām abheda pratibhāsaḥ iṣyate tathā hi : nitya vyāpaka eka rūpa tayā paraiḥ abhimataḥ sa samavāyaḥ samavāyi āśritaḥ anāśritaḥ vā yat āśritaḥ tadā paramārthataḥ upacārāt vā tatra na paramārthataḥ samavāyaḥ samavāyi āśritaḥ tayoḥ sambandha abhāvāt na hi tāvat tayoḥ samavāyaḥ sambandhaḥ samavāyasya eka tvāt samavāyasya samavāya antareṇa vṛttau tasya api tad antareṇa eva vṛttiḥ iti anavasthā upanipātāt na api saṃyogaḥ tasya guṇa tvena dravya āśrita tvāt adravya tvāt ca samavāyasya

na api viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāvaḥ sambandha antara abhisambaddha artheṣu eva asya pravṛtti pratīteḥ daṇḍa puruṣa ādi vat anyathā sarvam sarvasya viśeṣaṇam viśeṣyam ca syāt na ca samavāya samavāyinām sambandha antara abhisambaddha tvam saṃyoga samavāyayoḥ anabhyupagamāt viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāva antareṇa sambaddha tve tasya api tad antareṇa sambaddheṣu eva pravṛttiḥ iti anavasthānāt

na api adṛṣṭam ṣoḍhā sambandha vādi tva vyāghātāt yadi ca adṛṣṭena samavāyaḥ sambadhyate tarhi guṇa guṇī ādayaḥ api atas eva sambaddhāḥ bhaviṣyanti iti alam samavāya ādi kalpanayā iti na sambandha antareṇa samavāyasya sambandhaḥ sidhyati nanu na samavāyasya sambandha antareṇa sambandhaḥ asmābhiḥ iṣṭaḥ yena anavasthā ādi doṣāḥ syuḥ api tu agneḥ uṣṇa tā vat svatas eva asya sambandhaḥ yuktaḥ svatas eva sambandha rūpa tvāt na saṃyoga ādīnām tad abhāvāt na hi ekasya svabhāvaḥ anyasya api anyathā svatas agneḥ uṣṇa tva darśanāt jala ādīnām api tat syāt iti ced

tat api pralāpa mātram yatas pratyakṣa prasiddhe padārtha svabhāve svabhāvaiḥ uttaram vaktum yuktam pratyakṣeṇa pratīte arthe yadi paryanuyujyate svabhāvaiḥ uttaram vācyam dṛṣṭe kā anupapanna tā iti vacanāt anyathā tathā uttareṇa sarvasya sva iṣṭa siddhi prasaṅgāt na ca samavāyasya svatas sambandha tvam saṃyoga ādīnām tu tasmāt iti adhyakṣa prasiddham tad svarūpasya adhyakṣa agocara tva pratipādanāt atas eva atīndriyaḥ sattā ādīnām iva pratyakṣeṣu vṛtti abhāvāt sva ātma gata saṃvedana abhāvāt ca iti praśasta pāda bhāṣye abhidhānāt samavāyaḥ padārtha antareṇa sambadhyamānaḥ na svatas sambadhyate sambadhyamāna tvāt rūpa ādi vat iti anumāna virodhāt ca

yādi ca agni pradīpa śva māṃsa ādīnām uṣṇa prakāśa aśuci tva vat samavāyaḥ sva parayoḥ sambandha hetuḥ tarhi tad dṛṣṭānta avaṣṭambhena eva jñānam sva parayoḥ prakāśa hetuḥ kim na syāt tathā ca jñānam jñāna antara vedyam prameya tvāt iti viplavate kim ca yathārthānām sat ātmakasya bhāvasya na anyaḥ sattā yogaḥ asti evam dravya ādīnām vṛtti ātmakasya samavāyasya na anyā vṛttiḥ asti tasmāt sva ātma vṛttiḥ iti manvānaḥ padārthānām saṃvedana ātmakasya jñānasya na anyatas saṃvedanam tasmāt svatas saṃvedanam iti kim na manyet bhāva vat tādātmya aviśeṣāt tad aviśeṣe api sattā dṛṣṭāntena samavāyasya eva svatas vṛttiḥ syāt na punar jñānasya sva saṃvedanam iti sva ruci viracita darśana pradarśana mātram svatas sambandhaḥ iva svatas saṃvedane api sva ātmani kriyā virodha abhāvāt anyathā tatra api tad prasaṅgāt tasya ekasya eva saṅghaṭanīya saṅghaṭaka tva bhāvāt

yat ca ucyate samavāyaḥ sambandha antaram na apekṣate svatas sambandha tvāt ye tu sambandha antaram apekṣante na te svatas sambandhāḥ yathā ghaṭa ādayaḥ na ca ayam na svatas sambandhaḥ tasmāt sambandha antaram na apekṣate iti tat api manoratha mātram saṃyogena anekāntāt sa hi svatas sambandhaḥ sambandha antaram ca apekṣate na hi svatas asambandha svabhāva tve saṃyoga ādeḥ paratas tat yuktam atiprasaṅgāt samavāyaḥ padārtha antareṇa saṃśleṣe sambandha antaram apekṣate padārtha antara tvāt yat ittham tat ittham yathā saṃyogaḥ tathā ca ayam tasmāt tathā eva iti anumāna bādhita viṣaya tvāt ca

kim ca yathā samavāyaḥ svarūpa apekṣayā bhedāt tad avyatirikta ghaṭanīya ghaṭaka ākāra apekṣayā bhedāt bheda abheda ātmakaḥ sidhyati tathā avayavi ādi apekṣayā bhedāt tad apṛthak bhūta avayava apekṣayā bhedāt sarvam vastu bheda abheda ātmakam jāti antaram sidhyet virodha ādi dūṣaṇānām samavāya dṛṣṭa antena apasāraṇāt iti arhan mata siddhiḥ tasya tat iṣṭa tvāt abheda bheda ātmakam artha tattvam tava iti vacanāt tad mata siddhau para abhimata bheda ekānta rūpam vastu kha puṣpa vat asat eva syāt svatantrā anyatarat khapuṣpam iti vacanāt tat evam svatas paratas ca samavāyasya samavāyiṣu vṛttiḥ na syāt avṛttimat tvāt samavāya vṛtteḥ na paramārthataḥ samavāyaḥ samavāyi āśritaḥ paraiḥ tasya svātantrya abhyupagamāt ca

na api upacārāt upacāra nimitta abhāvāt nanu nimittam upacārasya samavāyiṣu satsu samavāya jñānam samavāyi śūnya deśe samavāya jñāna asambhavāt iti ced tat asat diś ādīnām api evam āśrita tva prasaṅgāt mūrta dravyeṣu sat su upalabdhi lakṣaṇa prāpteṣu diś liṅgasya idam atas pūrveṇa ityādi pratyayasya kāla liṅgasya ca paratva aparatva ādi pratyayasya sadbhāvāt mūrta dravya āśrita tva upacāra prasaṅgāt tathā ca anyatra nitya dravyebhyaḥ iti vacana vyāghātaḥ nitya dravyasya api diś ādeḥ upacārāt āśrita tva siddheḥ tatas na upacārāt api āśrita tvam samavāyasya

atha anāśritaḥ samavāyaḥ iti matam tadā na sambandhaḥ samavāyaḥ sambandhibhyām bhinnasya ubhayā āśritasya eva saṃyoga vat sambandha tva vyavasthiteḥ tathā ca prayogaḥ : samavāyaḥ na sambandhaḥ sarvathā anāśrita tvāt yaḥ yaḥ sarvathā anāśritaḥ sa sa na sambandhaḥ yathā diś ādiḥ sarvathā anāśritaḥ ca samavāyaḥ tasmāt na sambandhaḥ iti na ca atra asiddhaḥ hetuḥ samavāyasya paramārthataḥ upacārāt ca āśrita tvasya nirākṛta tvāt

syāt ākūtam : samavāyasya dharmiṇaḥ apratipattau hetoḥ āśraya asiddha tvam pratipattau dharmi grāhaka pramāṇa bādhitaḥ pakṣaḥ hetuḥ ca kāla atyaya apadiṣṭaḥ prasajyate samavāyaḥ hi yatas pramāṇāt pratipannaḥ tatas eva ayuta siddha sambandha tvam pratipannam ayuta siddhānām eva sambandhasya samavāya vyapadeśa siddheḥ iti

tat api na sādhīyaḥ samavāya grāhiṇā pramāṇena āśritasya eva samavāyasya aviṣvagbhāva lakṣaṇasya pratipatteḥ tasya anāśrita tva abhyupagame ca asambandha tvasya prasaṅgena sādhanāt sādhya sādhanayoḥ vyāpya vyāpaka bhāva siddhau parasya vyāpya abhyupagame tat na antarīyakasya vyāpaka abhyupagamasya pratipādanāt na hi anāśrita tvam asambandha tvena vyāptam diś ādiṣu asiddham na api anaikāntikam anāśritasya kasyacid sambandha tva aprasiddheḥ vipakṣe vṛtti abhāvāt tatas eva na viruddham na api sat pratipakṣam tasya anāśritasya api sambandha tva vyavasthāpaka anumāna abhāvāt iti

na pareṣām samavāya sambandhaḥ asti yatas tad vaśāt bhinnānām api avayavi ādīnām abhedena pratipattiḥ upapadyeta tatas te bhedena eva pratiyeran na ca evam atas pratyakṣa virodhaḥ duḥśakaḥ parihartum pareṣām kim ca pratipādita prakāreṇa samavāyasya asambhave saṃyogasya api asambhavaḥ tasya kāryasya kāraṇa samavāya abhāve anupapatteḥ evam sambandha abhāve na kiñcid vastu bheda ekānta vādi mate vyavatiṣṭhate

tathā hi : tāvat paramāṇūnām saṃyoga abhāve dvi aṇuka ādi prakrameṇa avayavinaḥ anutpatteḥ kārya rūpa bhūta catuṣṭaya abhāvaḥ tad abhāve tad kāraṇa caturvidha paramāṇavaḥ api na sambhāvyante kārya liṅga tvāt kāraṇasya kārya bhrānteḥ aṇu bhrāntiḥ kārya liṅgam hi kāraṇam iti vacanāt tathā bhūta catuṣṭayā sattve parāpara ādi pratyaya apāyāt idam atas pūrveṇa ityādi pratyaya apāyāt ca na kālaḥ diś ca vyavatiṣṭhate tathā bherī daṇḍa ādi ākāśa saṃyoga abhāvāt saṃyoga ja śabdasya anutpattiḥ sarvatra avayava saṃyoga abhāve tad vibhāgasya api ayogāt vibhāga ja śabdasya api anutpattiḥ tayoḥ anudaye śabda ja śabdasya asambhavaḥ iti sakala śabda anutpatteḥ ākāśa vyavasthāpa kopāya apāyāt ākāśa hāniḥ tathā ātma antaḥkaraṇa saṃyoga asiddheḥ buddhi ādi guṇa anutpattiḥ tad abhāve ca ātma vyavasthāpa kopāya asattvāt ātma tattva hāniḥ tathā buddhi anutpattau manasaḥ asiddhiḥ kramatas jñāna utpatteḥ manaḥ liṅga tvāt yugapad jñāna anutpattiḥ manasaḥ liṅgam iti vacanāt evam saṃyoga abhāve sarva dravya abhāvaḥ

athavā samavāya abhāve sattā samavāya asambhavāt sarva dravyaḥ pracyutaḥ sarva dravya hānau tad āśrita guṇa karma sāmānya viśeṣāṇām asiddhiḥ āśraya abhāve sati āśrayiṇām abhāvāt tantu abhāve paṭa abhāva vat iti saṃsarga hāneḥ sakala artha hāniḥ durnivārāḥ vaiśeṣikāṇām upanipatati tat uktam svāmi samantabhadra pādaiḥ : abheda bheda ātmakam artha tattvam tava svatantrā anyatarat khapuṣpam avṛttimat tvāt samavāya vṛtteḥ saṃsarga hāneḥ sakala artha hāniḥ iti evam vicāryamāṇāḥ sarvathā abhinna avayava avayavi a ādayaḥ svayam eva na santi yatas pratyakṣeṇa na pratibhāseran tad pratyanīkāḥ ca kathañcid abhinnāḥ te pratyakṣataḥ pratibhāsantaḥ iti sthitam dṛṣṭa viruddham vaiśeṣika matam iti

tathā tat iṣṭa viruddham ca tathā hi vivāda āpannam tanu karaṇa bhuvana ādikam buddhimat hetukam kāryatvāt ghaṭa ādi vat iti jagataḥ maheśvara kṛta tvam yaugaiḥ vyavasthāpyate tat ca anumāna viruddham tad bādhaka anumāna sadbhāvāt tat ca idam na īśvaraḥ tanu ādīnām kartā aśarīra tvāt yaḥ evam saḥ evam yathā ātmā tathā ca ayam tasmāt tathā eva iti na ca atra asiddhaḥ hetuḥ tasya śarīra tva ayogāt tat śarīrasya sāvayavasya nitya tva anupapatteḥ nityasya api tat śarīrasya buddhimat kāraṇā pūrvaka tve tena eva kāryatva ādi hetūnām vyabhicārāt tasya buddhimat kāraṇa sa pūrva tve vā parāpara śarīra kalpanāyām anavasthā prasaṃgāt pūrva pūrvasya śarīreṇa uttarottara sva śarīra utpattau bhavasya nimitta kāraṇa tve sarva saṃsāriṇām tathā prasiddheḥ īṣvara kalpanāvaii arthāt sva upabhogya bhuvana ādi utpattau api teṣām eva nimitta kāraṇa tva upapatteḥ iti tad kāryatva acetana upadāna tva sanniveśa viśiṣṭa hetavaḥ gamakāḥ syuḥ aśarīram vā vasantam na priya apriye spṛśataḥ iti āgama virodhāt ca

evam tasya aśarīra tve siddhe na īśvaraḥ tanu ādīnām kartā syāt vitanu karaṇasya tasya tad kṛteḥ ayogāt tādṛśaḥ api nimitta bhāve karmaṇām acetana tve api tad nimitta tvam avipratiṣiddham sarvathā dṛṣṭānta vyatikramāt yathā eva hi kulāla ādi satanu karaṇaḥ kumbha ādeḥ prayojakaḥ dṛṣṭāntaḥ tanu karaṇa bhuvana ādīnām aśarīra indriya īśvara prayojaka tva kalpanayā vyatikramyate tathā karmaṇām acetanānām api tad nimitta tvam kalpanayā buddhimān api dṛṣṭāntaḥ vyatikramyatām viśeṣa abhāvāt

syāt matam sa śarīrasya api buddhi icchā prayatanavataḥ eva kulāla ādeḥ kāraka prayokṛtvam dṛṣṭam kuṭādi kāryam kartum abuddhyamānasya tad adarśanāt buddhimataḥ api icchā apāye tad anupalabdheḥ tat icchāvataḥ api prayatna abhāve tad anupalambhāt vitanu karaṇasya api buddhimataḥ sraṣṭum icchataḥ prayatnavataḥ śaśvat īśvarasya samasta kāraka prayoktṛ tva upapatteḥ na dṛṣṭānta vyatikramaḥ sa śarīra tva itarayoḥ kāraka prayuktim pratyanaṅga tvāt na hi dṛṣṭānta dārṣṭa antikayoḥ sāmyam asti tad viśeṣa virodhāt iti tat ayuktam buddhi ādīnām api tasya asaṃbhavāt īśvaraḥ jñāna cikīrṣā prayatna trayavān na bhavati aśarīra tvāt mukta ātma vat iti tad abhāva siddheḥ aśarīra tva aviśeṣe api sādi muktānām eva buddhi ādi rahita tvam na tu anādi muktasya īśvarasya iti ced na anādi muktā siddheḥ

īśvarasya aśarīra tvam sādi aśarīra tvāt mukta ātma aśarīra tva vat iti tad bādhaka sadbhāvāt atra api aśarīra tva aviśeṣe api mukta ātma aśarīra tvam eva sādi na tu īśvara aśarīra tvam iti ced na anupapattika tvāt jagat kartṛ tva sarvajña tva ādīnām īśvara viśeṣaṇānām vivāda gocara tve na tatas vailakṣaṇya abhidhāna anupapatteḥ tathā api yadi tathā iṣyate tarhi kāryatva aviśeṣe ghaṭa paṭa kaṭa kaṭaka śaṭaka mukuṭa ādīnām buddhimat hetuka tvam na tu mahī mahīdhara mahīruha ādīnām iti kim na iṣyate akṛta samayasya api kṛta buddhi utpādakebhyaḥ ghaṭa ādibhyaḥ tad anutpādaka bhuvana ādīnām vailakṣaṇyasya api saṃbhavāt evam aśarīra tve buddhi icchā prayatna vattva asiddheḥ tad asiddhau sakala kāraka prayoktṛ tva anupapatteḥ sūktam īśvaraḥ tanu ādīnām na kartti

tathā api yadi vaiyyātyāt īśvaraḥ kartti abhidhīyate tadā prāṇinām vicitra ghora duḥkha śatāni īśvaraḥ karoti vā na vā yadi na karoti tadā taiḥ kārya tva ādi hetūnām vyabhicāraḥ atha karoti iti matam tat asaṃbhāvyam iha hi kaścid asarva jñaḥ praṇaṣṭa rāga dveṣaḥ muniḥ anyaḥ vā sādhuḥ para pīḍām na karoti kila saḥ eva mahā rṣīṇām api ārādhyaḥ sarvajñaḥ vīta rāga dveṣa mohaḥ bhagavān maheśvaraḥ prāṇinām animittam asahya vividha ugra duḥkha paramparām utpādya jagattrayam paripīḍayati iti katham idam prakṣāvadbhiḥ saṃbhāvyate tad karaṇe vā tasya ati ugra apūrva rākṣasatvam eva na tu mahabhiḥ stutyam maheśvara tvam iti tasya tad karaṇam asaṃbhāvyam

nanu na prāṇinām īśvaraḥ duḥkham utpādayati iti ced na duḥkha hetūnām api pāpa karmaṇām īśvara kṛta tve tasya eva duḥkha hetu tva siddheḥ tad pakṣa upakṣipta doṣa anuṣaṃgāt teṣām tad akṛta tve tanu karaṇa ādeḥ api tad kṛta tvam mā bhūt viśeṣa abhāvāt karmabhiḥ īśvara sādhaka hetūnām anaikāntika tvāt ca karmaṇām abuddhimat nimitta tve api kāryatva artha kriyā kāritva sthityā pravartanānām saṃbhavāt yadi kalpayitvā api īśvaram avaśyam karma anumanyate tadā kevalam karma eva tanu karaṇa ādi nimittam iṣyatām kim anena īśvareṇa pramāṇa bādhitena tathā ca pareṣām pāramparya pariśrama parihāraḥ syāt

nanu katham acetanānām karmaṇām vicitra upabhogya yogya tanu karaṇa ādi utpādaka tvam iti ced katham unmatta madirā madana kodrava ādīnām unmāda ādi vicitra kārya utpādaka tvam katham vai ayaskānta viśeṣāṇām loha ākarṣaṇa bhramaṇa ādi kārya kāri tvam iti abhidhīyatām tathā adṛṣṭa tvāt iti ced tatas eva prakṛtaḥ svabhāva vyālambhaḥ api nivartyatām tathā sukha duḥkha lābha alābha ādīnām adṛṣṭam kāraṇam asti dṛṣṭa kāraṇa vyabhicārānyatha anupapatteḥ iti anumita tvāt na ca evam īśvarasya api anumita tvāt apala ambha prasaṃga nivṛttiḥ syāt iti śaṅkanīyam tad anumānasya aneka doṣa duṣṭa tvāt

tathā hi tanu kraṇa bhuvana ādeḥ kārya tva ādi sādhanam kim ekabuddhimat kāraṇa tvam sādhyet aneka buddhimat kāraṇam vā prathama pakṣe prāsāda ādinā aneka sūtra dhāra yajamāna ādi hetunā tad anaikāntikam dvitiya pakṣe siddha sādhanam nānā prāṇi nimitta tvāt tad upabhogya tanu ādīnām teṣām tad adṛṣṭa kṛta tvāt etena buddhimat kāraṇa sāmānya sādhane siddha sādhanam uktam tad abhimata viśeṣasya adhikaraṇa siddhānta nyāyena api asiddheḥ sāmānya viśeṣasya sādhya tvāt adoṣaḥ iti ced na dṛṣṭa adṛṣṭa viśeṣa āśraya sāmānya vikalpa dvaya an ativṛtteḥ dṛṣṭa viśeṣa āśrayasya sāmānyasya sādhya tve sveṣṭa vighātāt adṛṣṭa viśeṣa āśrayasya sāmānyasya sādhya tve sādhya śūnya tva prasaṃgāt nidarśanāya dṛṣṭa itara viśeṣa āśrayasya sāmānya sādhane api sva abhimata viśeṣa siddhiḥ kutas syāt

adhikaraṇa siddhānta nyāyāt iti ced kaḥ ayam adhikaraṇa siddhāntaḥ nāma yat siddhau anya prakaraṇa siddhiḥ saḥ adhikaraṇa siddhāntaḥ tatas dṛṣṭa adṛṣṭa viśeṣa āśraya sāmānya mātrasya buddhimat nimittasya jagatsu prasiddhau prakaraṇa ājagat nirmāṇa samarthaḥ samasta kārakāṇām prayoktrā sarvadā avilupta śaktiḥ vibhuḥ aśarīra tva ādi viśeṣa āśrayaḥ eva siddhyati iti ced syāt evam yadi sakala jagat nirmāṇa samarthena ekena samasta kārakāṇām prayoktrā sarvajña tva ādi viśeṣeṇa api tena avinābhā vidṛṣṭa itara viśeṣa adhikaraṇa buddhimat kāraṇa sāmānyam kutaścid siddhyet na ca siddhyati aneka buddhimat kāraṇena eva sva upabhogya tanu ādi nimitta kāraṇa viśeṣeṇa tasya vyāpta tva siddheḥ samarthanāt

tathā sarvajña vīta rāga kartṛka tve sādhye ghaṭa ādinā anaikāntikam sādhanam sādhya vikalam ca nidarśanam sa rāgā sarvajña kartṛka tve sādhye apasiddhāntaḥ sarvathā kārya tvam ca sādhanam tanu ādauvasiddham tasya kathaṃcid kāraṇa tvāt kathaṃcid kāryatvam tu viruddham sarvathā buddhimat nimitta tvāt sādhyāt viparītasya kathaṃcid buddhimat nimitta tvasya sādhanāt tathā pakṣaḥ api anumāna bādhitaḥ syāt na īśvaraḥ tanu ādīnām kartā jñāna ādi rahita tvāt mukta vat iti prāk ukta anumānasya tat bādhakasya bhāvāt iti jagataḥ buddhimat hetuka tvam na siddhyati sādhakasya abhāvāt bādhakasya saṃbhavat tatas sūktam iṣṭa viruddham vaiśeṣika matam iti

vaiśeṣika sama siddhāntāḥ naiyāyikāḥ tu evam āmananti pramāṇa prameya saṃśaya prayojana dṛṣṭānta siddhānta avayava tarka nirṇaya vāda jalpa vitaṇḍā hetvābhāsa chala jāti nigraha sthānām tattva jñānāt niḥśreyasa adhigamaḥ kim ca bhakti yoga kriya yoga jñāna yoga trayaiḥ yathāsāṃkhyam sālokyam sārūpyam sāmīpyam sāyujyam muktiḥ bhavati

tatra maheśvaraḥ svāmī svayam bhṛtyaḥ iti tad cittaḥ bhūtvā yāvajjīvam tasya paricaryā karaṇam bhakti yogaḥ tasmāt sālokya muktiḥ bhavati tapaḥ svādhyāya anuṣṭhānam kriyā yogaḥ tatra unmādaka ādi vya poha artham ādhyātmika ādi duḥkha sahiṣṇu tvam tapaḥ praśānta mantrasya īśvara vācinaḥ abhyāsaḥ svādhyāyaḥ tat ubhayam api kleśa karma kṣayāya samādhi lābhāya ca anuṣṭheyam tasmāt kriyā yogāt sārūpyam sāmīpyam vā muktiḥ bhavati vidita padārthasya īśvara praṇidhānam jñāna yogaḥ

parameśvara tattvasya prabandhena anucintanam paryālocanam īśvara praṇidhānam tasya yogasya yama niyama āsana prāṇāyāma pratyāhāra dhāraṇā dhyāna samādhayaḥ aṣṭa aṅgāni tatra deśa kāla avasthābhiḥ anitya tāḥ puruṣasya viśuddha vṛtti hetavaḥ yamāḥ ahiṃsā brahmacāryāsteya ādayaḥ deśa kāla avasthāpekṣiṇaḥ puṇya hetavaḥ driyā viśeṣāḥ niyāmāḥ deva arcana pradakṣiṇa saṃdhyā upāsana japa ādayaḥ yoga karma virodhi kleśa jaya ādi arthaḥ ca raṇa bandhaḥ āsanam padmaka svastika ādiḥ koṣṭhasya vāyoḥ gati chedaḥ prāṇāyāmaḥ recaka pūraka kumbhaka prakāraḥ śanais śanais abhyasanīyaḥ samādhi pratyanīkebhyaḥ samantāt svāntasya vyāvartanam pratyāhāraḥ cittasya deśa saṃbandhaḥ dhāraṇā tatra ekatānatā dhyānam dhyāna utkarṣāt nirvāta acala pradīpa avasthānam iva ekatra cetanasā avasthānam samādhiḥ etāni yoga aṅgāni mumukṣuṇā maheśvare parām bhaktim āśrayityā abhiyogena sevitavyāni tatas acireṇa kāleṇa bhagavantam anaupamya svabhāvam pratyakṣam paśyati tam dṛṣṭvā niratiśayam sāyujyam niḥśreyasam prāpnoti

tat etat tārkika matam dṛṣṭa iṣṭa viruddham prāc anantaram pratipādita prakāreṇa eva pratyakṣa anumāna virodhayoḥ atra api upapatteḥ atas na atra pṛthak tad virodha samarthanam upakramyate kim ca tad abhyupagata padārtheṣu indriya buddhi manasām artha upalabdhi sādhaka tvena pramāṇa tvāt prameyeṣu antarbhāva anupapatteḥ anyathā eka aneka ātmaka tva siddheḥ saṃśaya ādīnām prameya tve ca vyavasthāna anupapatteḥ viparyaya an adhyavasāyayoḥ pramāṇa ādi ṣoḍaśa padārthebhyaḥ artha antara bhūtayoḥ pratīteḥ ca na ṣoḍaśa padārtha vyavasthā

tathā evam naiyāyika vaiśeṣika siddhāntasya dṛṣṭa iṣṭa viruddha tve siddhe caturvidha varṇa āśrama vat tad vidheya vividha ācāra puṇya pāpa para loka bandha mokṣa tad kāraṇa tad phala baddha muktā ādi svarūpa pratipādakaḥ api yaugāgamaḥ na pramāṇam dṛṣṭa iṣṭa viruddha āgama abhinnasya tasya atīndriyeṣu tad kāraṇeṣu ca prāmānya saṃbhāvanā anupapatteḥ iti na teṣām dharma anuṣṭhānam pratiṣṭhām iyarti kim vā bahubhiḥ ālāpaiḥ aulūkyaiḥ tārkikaiḥ ca laukikam vaidikam vā yat kiṃcid ucyate tat sarvam mṛṣā eva tad abhimata sarva tattvānām saṃsarga asaṃbhavena śūnya tvasya āpādita tvāt iti alam ati prapañcena dṛṣṭa iṣṭa viruddha tvāt naiyāyika vaiśeṣika matayoḥ asatya tva siddha tvāt dṛṣṭeṣu iṣṭeṣu dṛṣṭa iṣṭa virodhāt yauga saṃmataḥ parokṣeṣu tad eka tvāt āgamaḥ na pramāṇyatām saṃsarga hāneḥ sarva artha hāneḥ yaugavacaḥ akhilam bhavet pralāpa mātra tvāt na avadheyam vipaścitām dṛṣṭa iṣṭābhyām viruddha tvāt na satyam yauga śāsanam na ca tena pratikṣepaḥ syāt vādasya iti niścitam
atha mīmāṃsaka matam api dṛṣṭa iṣṭa viruddham

mīmāṃsakeṣu tāvāt evam bhāṭṭāḥ bhaṇanti pṛthivī ap tejaḥ vāyu diś kāla ākāśa ātma manaḥ śabdatamāṃsi iti ekādaśa eva padārthāḥ tad āśrita guṇa karma sāmāni a ādīnām tad svabhāva tvena tādātmya saṃbhavān na padārtha antaram iti evam padārtha yāthātmya jñānāt karma kṣayaḥ bhavati iti prābhākaraḥ tu dravyam guṇaḥ kriyā jāti saṃkhyā sādṛśya śaktayaḥ samavāyaḥ kramaḥ ca iti nava syuḥ guru darśane tatra dravyāṇi pṛthivī ādayaḥ guṇāḥ rūpa ādayaḥ kriyā utkṣepaṇa ādi jātiḥ sattā dravya tva ādi saṃkhyā eka tvadvatva ādiḥ sādṛśyam go pratiyogikam gavaya gatam anyat gavaya pratiyogikam go gatam sādṛśyam anyat śaktiḥ sāmarthyam sā anumeyā eva guṇa guṇyādīnām saṃbandhaḥ samavāyaḥ ekasya niṣpādana anantaram anyasya niṣpādanam kramaḥ prathama āhuti ādi pūrṇa āhuti paryantam iti evam nava eva padārthāḥ eteṣām yāthātmya jñānāt niḥśreyasa siddhiḥ iti ācakṣate

kim ca vedam adhītya tad artham jñātvā tad ukta nitya naimittaka kāmya niṣiddha anuṣṭhāna kramam niścitya tatra vihita anuṣṭhāne yaḥ pravartate tasya svarga apavarga siddhiḥ bhavati tri kāla saṃdhyā upāsana japa deva ṛṣi pitṛ tarpaṇa ādikam nitya anuṣṭhānam darśa paurṇamāsa grahaṇa ādiṣu kriyamāṇa naimittika anuṣṭhānam tad dvayam api niyamena kartavyam kutas akurvan vihitam karmam pratyavāyena lipyate iti vacanāt putra kāmya iṣṭi ādikam aihikam kāmya anuṣṭhānam jyotiṣṭoma ādikam āmutrikam kāmya anuṣṭhānam śyena abhicaran yajet iti ādikam niṣiddha anuṣṭhānam tad kramam niścitya teṣu anuṣṭhāneṣu vihita anuṣṭhāne yaḥ pravartate sa svarga apavargau prāpnoti

api ca nyāya arjita dhanaḥ tad tattva jñāna niṣṭhaḥ atithi priyaḥ śraddhakṛt satya vādī ca gṛhasthaḥ api vimucyate iti vacanāt mumukṣūṇām pravrajyayā bhavitavyam iti niyamaḥ na asti tatra api mokṣa arthaḥ na pravarteta tatra kāmya niṣiddhayoḥ nitya naimittike kuryāt pratyavāya jihāsayā iti bhāṭṭāḥ pratyavāya parihāra kāmena nitya naimittaka anuṣṭhānayoḥ pravartanāt tayoḥ api kāmya anuṣṭhāna kukṣau nikṣepāt tad karaṇam api mokṣa kāṃkṣiṇā na avadhīyate iti prābhākarāḥ pratyūcire

tat etat mīmāṃsaka matam tāvat dṛṣṭa viruddham mīmāṃsaka ākhyaiḥ bhāṭṭaiḥ prābha ākaraiḥ ca pṛthivī ādayaḥ arthāḥ sattā ādi sāmānyatas anuvyajyante tat ca sattā ādi sāmānyam sarvathā nityam niravayavam ekam vyāpakam iti taiḥ abhimatam tat tu pratyakṣa viruddham sadṛśa pariṇāma lakṣaṇasya sāmānyasya anityasya asarva gatasya rūpa ādi vat aneka vyakta ātma tayā aneka rūpasya eva pratyakṣatas pratīteḥ na hi bhinna deśāsu vyaktiṣu sāmānyam ekam pratyakṣatas sthūṇā ādau vaṃśa ādi vat pratīyate vyakteḥ utpāda vināśe api anutpādam avināśam vā yatas tat pratyakṣam syāt tat idam para udita svarūpam sāmānyam pratyakṣa buddhau ātmānam na samarthayati pratyakṣatām ca svīkartum icchati iti amūlya dāna krayitvāt satām upahāsa āspadam eva syāt

tathā api yadi yājñikā vaiyātyāt tathā eva iti vivadante tarhi tatra brūmaḥ ekatra vyaktau sarva ātmanā vartamānasya anyatra vṛttiḥ na syāt tatra hi vṛttiḥ tad deśe gamanāt piṇḍena saha utpādāt tad deśe sadbhāvāt aṃśavat tayā vā syāt na tāvat gamanāt anyatra piṇḍe tasya vṛttiḥ niṣkriya tva upagamāt kim ca pūrva piṇḍa parityāgena tat tatra gacchet aparityāgena vā na tāvat parityāgena prāktana piṇḍasya go tva parityāktasya agorūpatā prasaṃgāt na api aparityāgena aparityākta piṇḍasya asya anaṃśasya rūpa ādeḥ iva gamana asaṃbhavāt na hi aparityakta pūrva ādhārāṇām rūpa ādīnām ādhāra antara saṃkrāntiḥ dṛṣṭā na api piṇḍena saha utpādāt tasya anitya tā anuṣaṃgāt na api tad deśe sattvāt piṇḍa utpatteḥ prāk tatra nirādhārasya asya avyavasthāna abhāvāt bhede vā sva āśraya mātra vṛtti tva virodhaḥ na api aṃśavat tayā niraṃśa tva pratijñānāt tatas vyakti antare sāmānyasya abhāva anuṣaṃgāt

pareṣām prayogaḥ ye yatra na utpannā na api prāk avasthāyinaḥ na api paścāt anyatas deśāt āgatam antar te tatra āsantaḥ yathā kara uttamāṅge tat viśāṇam tathā ca sāmānyam tat śūnya deśa utpāda tve ghaṭa ādike vastuni iti tat uktam na yāti na ca tatra āsīt asti paścāt na ca aṃśa vat jahāti pūrvam ādhāram aho vyasana saṃtatiḥ iti nanu eṣa doṣaḥ bheda vādinām eva na tu mīmāṃsakānām taiḥ sāmānya vyaktyoḥ tādātmya aṅgīkaraṇāt tādātmyam asya kasmāt ced svabhāvāt iti gamyatām iti abhidhānāt iti ced teṣām vyakti vat tasya asādhāraṇa sādharaṇa rūpa tva anuṣaṃgāt vyakti utpāda vināśayoḥ ca asya api tad yogi tva prasaṃgāt

na sāmānya rūpa tā vā sādhāraṇa rūpa tvam utpāda vināśa yogi tvam ca asya na abhyupagamyate tarhi viruddha dharma adhyāsataḥ vyaktibhyaḥ asya bhedaḥ syāt uktam ca tādātmyam ced matam jāteḥ vyakti janmani ajāta tā nāśaḥ anāśaḥ ca kena iṣṭaḥ tadvat ca ananvayaḥ na kim vyakti janmani ajātā ced āgatāḥ na āśraya antarāt prāk āsīt na ca tad deśe sā tayā saṃgatā katham vyakti nāśe na ced naṣṭā gatāḥ vyakti antaram na ca tat śūnye na sthitā deśe sā jātiḥ kva iti kathyatām vyakteḥ jāti ādi yoge api yadi jāteḥ sa na iṣyate tādātmyam katham iṣṭam syāt anupapluta cetasām iti evam aneka doṣa duṣṭa tvāt yājñikā anujñāta sāmānyam khara viṣāṇa vat asat eva syāt

yat tu tad sadbhāva sādhanam uktam paraiḥ piṇḍa bhedeṣu go buddhiḥ ekago tva nibandhanā gavā bhāsi eka rūpābhyām eka gopiṇḍa buddhi vat na śābaleyāt go buddhiḥ tatas anya ālambanā api vā tad abhāve api sadbhāvāt ghaṭe pārthiva buddhi vat iti ādiḥ tat sarvam siddha sādhanam anuvṛtta pratyayasya sadṛśa pariṇāma lakṣaṇa sāmānya ālambanatva siddheḥ

na hi vayam bauddha vat sāmānyasya apahnavotāraḥ kevalam para parikalpita sarvathā anitya tva ādi viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭam eva sāmānyam na mṛṣyāmahe sarvathā nityasya ekasya anaṣṭasya sarva gatasya vicāramāṇasya asaṃbhavāt nityam sat ādi sāmānyam pratyabhijñāyamāna tvāt śabda vat iti ced na hetoḥ viruddha tvāt kathaṃcid nityasya iṣṭa viruddhasya sādhanāt sarvathā nityasya pratyabhijñāna ayogāt tat eva idam iti pūrva uttara paryāya vyāpinā ekatra pratyayasya upapatteḥ paurvāparya rahitasya pūrva apara pratyaya viṣaya tva asaṃbhavāt dharmau eva pūrva apara bhūtau na dharmi sāmānyam iti ced katham tat eva idam iti abheda pratītiḥ pūrva apara svabhāvayoḥ atīta vartamānayoḥ tat iti atīta parāmarśinā smaraṇena idam iti vartamāna ullekhinā pratyakṣeṇa ca viṣayī kriyamāṇayoḥ parasparam bhedāt

sat ādi sāmānyāt ekasmāt tayoḥ kathaṃcid bheda abheda pratipattiḥ iti ced siddham tasya kathaṃcid anitya tvam anitya svadharma avyatirekāt na hi anityāt abhinnam nityam eva yuktam anitya sva ātma vat sarvathā nityasya krama yaugapadyābhyām artha kriyā virodhāt ca tat anityam sāmānyam viśeṣa ādeśāt śabda vat tatas eva anekam tadvat sat iti ādi sva pratyaya aviśeṣāt ekam sattā ādi sāmānyam iti ced na sarvathā sva pratyaya aviśeṣasya asiddha tvāt pratipad ā ādi vyaktau sat iti ādi pratyayasya viśeṣāt tad vyakti viṣayaḥ viśeṣa pratyayaḥ iti ced tarhi tāḥ vyaktayaḥ sāmānyāt sarvathā yadi bhinnāḥ pratipadyante tadā yaugamata praveśaḥ mīmāṃsakasya sa ca ayuktaḥ tad mate saṃbandhasya nirasta tvāt tasya iti vyapadeśa anupapatteḥ

atha kathaṃcid abhinnāḥ tadā siddham sāmānyasya viśeṣa pratyaya viṣaya tvam viśeṣa pratyaya viṣayebhyaḥ viśeṣebhyaḥ kathaṃcid abhinnasya sāmānyasya viśeṣa pratyaya viṣaya tā upapatteḥ viśeṣasva ātma vat tatas na ekam eva sattā ādi sāmānyam na api anaṃśam kathaṃcid sa aṃśatva pratīteḥ sa aṃśebhyaḥ viśeṣebhyaḥ anartha antara bhūtasya sa aṃśatva upapatteḥ tad sva ātma vat tathā na sarva gatam tat sāmānyam vyakti antarāle anupalabhyamāna tvāt tatra anabhivyakta tvāt tasya anupalambhaḥ iti ced tatas eva vyakti sva ātmanaḥ iva tatra anupalambaḥ astu tatra tasya sadbhāva vedaka pramāṇa abhāvāt asattvāt eva anupalambaḥ iti ced sāmānyasya api viśeṣa abhāvāt asattvāt eva anupalambhaḥ astu vyakti antarāle tasya api sadbhāva vedaka pramāṇa abhāvāt pratyakṣataḥ tathā ananubhavāt khara viṣāṇa ādi vat na hi bhinna deśāsu vyaktiṣu sāmānyam ekam yathā sthūṇā ādiṣu vaṃśa ādiḥ iti pratīyate yatas yugapad bhinna deśa sva ādhāra vṛtti tve sati eka tvam tasya siddhyet sva ādhāra antarāle astitvam sādhayet iti tat evam aneka bādhaka sadbhāvāt bhāṭṭa prābha ākaraiḥ iṣṭam
